Tuale nitah le zingmawng om a, a ni khatna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien in, “Tui le tui kikalah vanthamzawl khat om hinlen tui le tui khen heh,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in vanthamzawl bawlin vanthamzawl tunga tuite le vanthamzawl nei-a tuite a khenkhie hi. Tua ma bangin a om pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien in vanthamzawl pen “Van” ci hi. Tuale nitah le zingmawng om a, a ni nina ahi hi.","ref":"2Pet 3:5"},"9":{"text":"Pasien in, “Van nei-a om tuite mun khatah kikhawm hinlen, leigaw kidawh heh,” a ci hi. A ci bangin a pieng pai hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien in leigaw pen “Lei” ci a, tui kikhawmtuote pen “Tuipi” ci hi. Pasien in tua khu hoi a sa hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in, “Leitang in singkung lopate posah hinlen, a tang nei singkungte, a ga sunga a tang om singga kungte, amau’ nam cietin leitungah po heh,” a ci hi. Tua ma bangin a pieng pai hi."},"12":{"text":"Leitang in singkung lopate amau’ nam ciet tawh kizui-in, khaici a nei lopate le amau’ nam ciet tawh kizui-in a sunga tang a nei a ga singkungte piengsah hi. Tua khu Pasien in hoi a sa hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale nitah le zingmawng om a, a ni thumna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasien in, “Sun le zan a khen dingin vanthamzawl ah khuovahte om heh; tuate khu khuohunte, nite le kumte ciemte nading hi hinlen,"},"15":{"text":"leitung a tanvah dingin vanthamzawl ah khuovah hi uheh,” a ci hi. A ci bangin a om pai hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasien in khuovah gol ni bawl a, khuovah a golzaw pen sun a uh ding, khuovah a neuzaw pen zan a uh dingin bawl a, aasite zong a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung a tanvah ding,"},"18":{"text":"sun le zan tunga thunei ding, le khuovah le khuomiel a khen dingin Pasien in vanthamzawl ah tuate a koi hi. Pasien in tua khu hoi a sa hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin nitah le zingmawng om a, a ni lina ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Pasien in, “Tuite in hinna nei ganhing honpite piengsah hinlen, leitung vanthamzawl ah vate leng uheh,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in tuipi ganhing golpite le hinna a nei a pia thei ganhing namcin le a leng thei va namcin amau’ namcietin a piengsah hi. Tua khu Pasien in hoi a sa hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasien in amate thupha pie a, “Cipha-in pungin tuipi sung dim unlen, leitungah vate pung uheh,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale nitah le zingmawng om a, a ni ngana ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasien in, “Leitung in amau’ nam cietin hinna nei ganhingte piengsah heh. Amau’ nam cietin innsate, a bawhva ganhingte le gamsate pieng uheh,” a ci hi. Tua ma bangin pieng pai hi."},"25":{"text":"Pasien in gamsa, innsa le a bawhva ganhing zosie amau’ nam cietin a piengsah a, tua khu Pasien in hoi a sa hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in, “Eima’ lim, eima’ mel sunin mihing siem vai; amate in tuipi sunga ngate, vantunga vate, innsa, gamsa zosie, le leitunga a bawhvate zosie tungah thu neisah vai,” ci hi.","ref":"1Cor 11:7"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in ama’ lim sunin mihing siem a, ama in Pasien’ lim bangin amate a siem hi. Ama in pasal le numei a siem hi.","ref":"Mat 19:4; Mrk 10:6"},"28":{"text":"Pasien in ama gel thupha pie a, Pasien in ama gel kungah, “Cipha-in pung unlen leitung luodimin zo un; tuipi sunga ngate, vana leng vate, le leitunga gamta hinna nei zosie tungah thu nei un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 5:1-2"},"29":{"text":"Pasien in, “En un, na tung vuah leitung maitang cin tenga om, a tang nei kungno zosie le a ga sunga a tang nei singkung zosie kang pie zo hi; note in an-in tuate na nei ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale leitung ganhing zosie, vana va zosie, leitunga a bawhva zosie, hinna hu a nei zosiete tungah an dingin kunghing zosie kang pie zo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ma bangin a pieng pai hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasien in a siemsa na vannuoi en a, hoi a sa mama hi. Tuale nitah le zingmawng om a, a ni guhna ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua bangin van le lei le a sunga na om zosie kiman sieng hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuale a ni sagina ni-in Pasien in a nasep zosie man a, a ni sagi ni-in a sepna zosie panin a tawlnga hi.","ref":"Heb 4:4, 10"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in ni sagi ni thupha pie-in siengthosah hi, bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in siemcil nasepna zosie manin tua ni-in a tawlnga hi.","ref":"Pei 20:11"},"4":{"text":"Tamte pen a kisiemcil lai-a van le lei tangthu ahi hi. Topa Pasien in van le lei a bawl ni-in"},"5":{"text":"leitungah singkung lopa kici a po nai sih hi. Azieh pen Topa Pasien in leitungah guo a zusah nai sih hi, lo hlo ding zong koima a om nai sih hi.","title":"Siemcilna Thu adang Khat (Pien 1:26-30)"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin lei nei panin tuihu phulto-in leitung zosie a nomsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa Pasien in lei panin leivui tawh mihing bawl a, a nahkuo sungah hinna hu mop hi; tuale mipa pen hinna nei mihing a suoh hi.","ref":"1Cor 15:45"},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasien in nisuona lamah Eden um khat a bawl hi; ama in tua munah a siemsa mipa koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Pasien in lei sung panin a etlawm, a tuituoh singkung namcin posah a, um laikimah hinna singkung le a sie le a pha theina singkung zong a posah hi.","ref":"Kln 2:7; 22:2, 14"},"10":{"text":"Um a nomsah dingin Eden panin gun khat luong a, khum mun panin tua gun kikhenzahin gun li a pha hi."},"11":{"text":"Gun masa pen a min Pishon hi a, kham pienna Havilah gamsung zosie kuolkhumin a luong pen ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua gama khamte hoi thei mama a, khum munah bedolak singnai le onyx suong manpha a pieng hi."},"13":{"text":"Gun a nina pen a min Gihon hi a, Cush gam kuolkhumin a luong pen ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Gun a thumna pen a min Tigris hi a, Assyria gam nisuona lamah a luong hi. Gun a lina pen a min Euphrates ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa Pasien in Eden um hlo ding le a cing dingin mipa koi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale Topa Pasien in tua mipa kungah, “Um sunga singga zosie na dei bangin na ne thei ding hi;"},"17":{"text":"hinanle a sie le a pha theina singga na ne sih ding hi, azieh pen na neh ni-in na si ding hi,” ci-in thu a pie hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa Pasien in, “Mipa ama guoha a op ding hoi lo hi; ama a hu ding kithuopi khat ka bawlpieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa Pasien in lei panin gamsa zosie le vana leng va zosie siem a, a min uh bang ahisah eimah ci-in a thei nuom ziehin mipa kungah tuate a peipi hi; hinna a nei zosie, tua mipa’ law bangbang a min uh hi paipai hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua mipa in ganhing zosie, vana leng va zosie le gamsa zosie min a vaw ciet hi; ahi vangin mipa a hu thei ding mi khat zong a om sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa Pasien in tua mipa a kimut suohsah mama a, tuale ama a kimu hi; tua ciengin ama in a nahgu khat la a, a lahna mun teng a telin a tuomsahkia hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa Pasien in mipa tung pana a lah a nahgu pen numei khatin bawl a, mipa kungah tua nu a zawpi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin mipa in, “Tam pen ka gute pana ka gu le ka tel pana ka tel ahi hi; ama pen Mipa sung pana kila ahi ziehin Numei kici ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin pasal in a nu a pa nuasie-in a zi tawh kigawm a, ama gel pum khat a suoh uhi.","ref":"Mat 19:5; Mrk 10:7-8; 1Cor 6:16; Eph 5:31"},"25":{"text":"Tuale mipa le a zi a guohtangin a om tuoh gel a, a maizum sih uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Topa Pasien bawlsa gamsa cinteng sangin gulpi a pilkhel pen ahi hi. Ama in numei kungah, “Pasien in, ‘Um sunga singga khat beh ne lo ding,’ ang ci amah?” a ci hi.","title":"Mawna Masapen le Danpiehna (Rom 5:12-21)","ref":"Kln 12:9; 20:2"},"2":{"text":"Numei in gulpi kungah, “Um sunga singgate ka ne thei uhi;"},"3":{"text":"ahi vangin Pasien in, ‘Um laikima singga pen neh zong na neh lo ding uh, khoi zong na khoi lo ding uh ahi hi. Tua bang na bawl uleh na si ding uhi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin gulpi in numei kungah, “Na si sih ding uhi;"},"5":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile tua singga na neh ciengun na mit uh kihongin a sie le a pha thei-in Pasien tawh na kibah ding lamtah uh Pasien in thei hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n numei in tua singkung a mu ciengin neh dingin tuituohsa a, a mit zong a la mama hi. Tuale mi pilsah dingin tua singkung a deihuoi lam a mu ciengin tua nu in a ga loin a ne hi; tua nu in ama tawh a omton a pasal zong themkhat pie a, a pasal in zong a ne hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nipi-un a mit uh kihong a, a guohtanga a op lam a kithei uhi; tuale ama gel in theina khui-in ama gel adingin puon a bawl uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nitah lam nidai hunin um sungah Topa Pasien peina huging ama gel in a za vua, tuale Topa Pasien’ opna panin mipa le a zinu, umlai singkungte lahah a kiphuol uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa Pasien in mipa hlanin ama kungah, “Nang hei-a om na hei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “Um sungah na huging ka za a, ka guohtanga ka op ziehin zau-in ka kiphuol hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Guohtanga na op lam koi hing gen ahiei? Ne si’n, kang ci tua singga na ne ta amah?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipa in, “Kithuopi dinga nei pieh numei in singga ei pie a, ka ne hai ta hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa Pasien in numei kungah, “Bang dinga hici gamtat na hiei?” a ci hi. Numei in, “Gulpi in ei sol a, ka ne hai ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Cor 11:3; 1Tim 2:14"},"14":{"text":"Topa Pasien in gulpi kungah, “Tam bangin gamta zo na hi ziehin, ganhing zosiete le gamsa zosiete lahah samsiet na thuoh ding hi; na awm tawh na kithol ding a, na hin sung tungtawnin leivui na ne ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang le numei kikal le na suonlehlahte le tua nu suonlehlahte kikalah kilangneina ka omsah ding hi; ama in na lutang ang tuoncil ding a, nang in ama’ ketul na tuhpieh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 12:17"},"16":{"text":"Ama in tua numei kungah, “Naupaaina-ah gimnate nasie tahin ka khangsah ding a, a thuohla pipi-in nau na suoh ding hi. Hinanle na pasal ma na lunggul bembom ding a, ama in nang tungah ang uh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale mipa kungah, “Nang in na zi thugen mangin, ‘Na ne sih ding hi,’ ci-a kang thupieh singga ne zo ta na hi ziehin, nangma vangin leitang kisamsie hi; na hin sung tungtawnin gim le tawlin na semin an na ne ding hi;"},"18":{"text":"nang adingin ling le khaute hing po ding a, nang in gamlaha ante lohingte na ne ding hi.","ref":"Heb 6:8"},"19":{"text":"Lei-ah na peikia masangsie na maitangah opsakai-in an na ne ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile nang pen leivui pana ang kila na hi hi; nang leivui na hi a, leivui ma ah na peikia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipa in a zi pen mihing zosie’ nu ahi ziehin a min Eve vaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale Topa Pasien in mipa le a zi adingin savun puon bawlpiehin ama gel a silsah hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa Pasien in, “En un, mipa pen eite khat tawh kibang a, a sie le a pha a thei ta hi; tu-in mipa in hinna singga lo hinlen hing ne kha mawh leh ang nungta den ta ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 22:14"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in mipa pen a pienna leitang hlo dingin Eden um panin a sawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in mipa a notmang hi; ama in hinna singkung zuotna lampi a cing dingin Eden um nisuona lamah meikuong namsau tawh Cherub-te a pangsah hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in mipa in a zi Eve luppi a, ama gai-in Cain nei a, “ Topa panpina tawh mi khat ka nga zo hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Cain in Abel That"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a naupa Abel neikia hi. Tu-in Abel pen tuucingpa ahi a, Cain pen lo hlopa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A hun a cin ciengin Cain in Topa kungah lei pana a pieng singga biehna peipi a,"},"4":{"text":"Abel in zong a tuuhonte lahah tacilte le a thau tuituoh pente peipi hi. Topa in Abel le ama’ biehna thusimpieh a,","ref":"Heb 11:4"},"5":{"text":"ahi vangin Cain le ama’ biehna a thusimpieh sih hi. Tuaci’n Cain lungthah mama a, a mai a tuop hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Cain kungah, “Bang dingin lungthahin bang dingin mai tuop na hei?"},"7":{"text":"A hoi bawl lacin ang kisanpieh lo ding amah? A hoi na bawl sih leh, mawna in kotbiengah ang buh khinkhian hi; ama lunggul pen nang na hi a, ahi vangin tua pen na zaw lo a poimaw ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Cain in a sanggampa Abel kungah, “Lo va kuon ta vai,” ci hi. Lo a tun ciengun Cain a sanggampa Abel tawh kihau-in ama a that hi.","ref":"Mat 23:35; Luk 11:51; 1Jhn 3:12"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Cain kungah, “Na sanggampa Abel hei-a om ahiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ka thei sih hi; ka sanggampa kem pa ka hi laizang amah?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, “Bang teng pi khat bawl zo na hi tai? Ngai vawi; leisiet panin na sanggampa’ sisan kei kungah ang kiko hi!","ref":"Heb 12:24"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in na khut pana a luongkhie na sanggampa’ sisan hup dinga a kamkah leitang tungah nang samsiet thuoh na hi ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Leitang na hlaw ciengin nang adingin lei panin an a pieng nawn sih ding hi; nang pen leitungah a galtai, a vahvai na hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Cain in Topa kungah, “Kei dan ei kipiehna pen kei thuoh zawh ding za sangin nasie zaw me izaw!"},"14":{"text":"Tuni-in leitang panin kei nei notmang ta a, na maitang panin kei ka kiphuol ding hi; kei a galtai le leitungah a vahvaih ding ka hi ta a, kei ei mu poma in ei that ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ama kungah, “Tua bang hi lo ding hi! Mi khatpo in Cain a tha leh a za sagi-in phulahna thuoh ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama a tuohkha mi koima in ama a tha lo nadingin, Topa in Cain tungah melcina khat a koi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa kung panin Cain pei dawhin Eden um nisuona lam Nod gamah a teng hi."},"17":{"text":"Cain in a zi luppi a, ama gai-in Enoch nei hi. Tuale ama in khuo sat a, tua khuopi pen a tapa Enoch’ min tapin Enoch a hisah hi.","title":"Leitung Khuosahzie Kipatna"},"18":{"text":"Enoch’ sung panin Irad suoh a, Irad pen Mehujael’ pa ahi hi. Mehujael pen Methushael’ pa ahi a, Methushael pen Lamech’ pa ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Lamech in zi ni nei a, a khat’ min Adah ahi a, adang khat’ min Zillah ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Adah in tapa Jabal nei a, ama pen puonbuh sunga teng, gankhawite pienna pupi ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"A sanggampa’ min Jubal ahi a, lyre le theile tumte zosie’ pienna pupi ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Zillah in Tubal-cain nei a, sumngo le sia vanzah nam zosie a bawlpa ahi hi. Tubal-cain’ sanggamnu pen Naamah ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Lamech in a zite kungah, “Adah le Zillah aw, ka aw ngai un. Lamech’ zite aw, ka thugen ngai un: Kei ei liemsah mi khat ahi, kei ei sat tangval khat keima in ka that ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Cain tung bawn-a a za sagi-a phu kila ahile, a tahtahin Lamech a thatte a za sawmsagi le sagi vei-in phu kila ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 18:22"},"25":{"text":"Adam in a zi luppi leuleu a, tua nu in tapa khat nei-in a min Seth phuo hi. Azieh pen tua nu in, “Cain in Abel a tha ziehin Pasien in Abel tangin kei adingin tapa adang khat ei pie zo hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Seth’ Suonlehlahte"},"26":{"text":"Seth in zong tapa khat nei a, a min Enosh a hisah hi. Khum hunin mite in Topa’ min a lo pan ta uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam pen Adam suonlehlahte’ khang laibu ahi hi. Pasien in mihing a siem lai-in ama in Pasien’ mel tawh kisunin amate a bawl hi.","title":"Adam’ Suonlehlahte, Noah le a Tate Dong (1Khg 1:1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ama gel pasal le numei-in a na siem a, a kisiem hun lai-in ama gel “Mihing” ci-in na minvaw a, tuaci’n ama gel thupha a pie hi.","ref":"Pien 1:27-28; Mat 19:4; Mrk 10:6"},"3":{"text":"Adam kum za le kum sawmthum a phah ciengin a kisutpi, ama’ lim le mel a puo tapa khat nei a, a min Seth ahisah hi."},"4":{"text":"Seth’ pa ahi zaw ciengin Adam kum zagiet sung a hing hi; ama in adang tanute le tapate nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin Adam hin sung teng zosie pen kum zakuo le sawmthum ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"6":{"text":"Seth kum za le kum nga sung a hin zaw ciengin ama pen Enosh’ pa a suoh hi."},"7":{"text":"Enosh a suo zaw ciengin Seth kum zagiet le kum sawmthum hing a, tanu le tapate a nei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua bangin Seth’ khan sung teng zosie kum zakuo le kum sawm le ni ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"9":{"text":"Enosh kum sawmkuo sung a hin zaw ciengin Kenan’ pa a suoh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kenan a suo zaw ciengin Enosh kum zagiet le sawm le nga hing a, tapa le tanute a nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bangin Enosh’ khan sung teng kum zakuo le nga ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"12":{"text":"Kenan kum sawmsagi a hin zaw ciengin Mahalalel’ pa a suoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mahalalel a suo zaw ciengin Kenan kum zagiet le kum sawmli hing a, tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua bangin Kenan khan sung teng zosie kum zakuo le sawm ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"15":{"text":"Mahalalel kum sawmguh le nga a hin zaw ciengin Jared’ pa a suoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Jared a suo zaw ciengin Mahalalel kum zagiet le sawmthum hing a, tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua bangin Mahalalel’ khan sung teng zosie kum zagiet le sawmkuo le nga ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"18":{"text":"Jared kum za le kum sawmguh le ni a hin zaw ciengin Enoch’ pa a suoh hi."},"19":{"text":"Enoch a suo zaw ciengin Jared kum zagiet hing a, tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bangin Jared khan sung teng zosie kum zakuo le sawmguh le ni ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"21":{"text":"Enoch kum sawmguh le nga a hin zaw ciengin Methuselah’ pa a suoh hi."},"22":{"text":"Methuselah a suo zaw ciengin Pasien tawh Enoch kum zathum sung zawhton a, tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin Enoch’ khan sung teng zosie kum zathum le sawmguh le nga ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasien tawh Enoch a zawhton hi; tua ciengin Pasien in ama a lah ziehin ama om nawn lo hi.","ref":"Heb 11:5; Jude 14"},"25":{"text":"Methuselah kum za le sawmgiet a hin zaw ciengin ama pen Lamech’ pa a suoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Lamech a suo zaw ciengin Methuselah kum zasagi le sawmgiet le ni hing a, tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua bangin Methuselah khan sung teng zosie kum zakuo le sawmguh le kuo ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"28":{"text":"Lamech kum za le sawmgiet le ni a hin zaw ciengin tapa khat’ pa a suoh hi;"},"29":{"text":"ama in ama’ min Noah hisah a, “ Topa samsietsa leitang panin tam mipa in i nasepna ule i khut tawh i sep uh gimnate panin ei nuomtuomsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Noah a suo zaw ciengin Lamech kum zanga le sawmkuo le nga hing a, tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bangin Lamech khan sung teng zosie kum zasagi le sawmsagi le sagi ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."},"32":{"text":"Noah kum zanga a phah zaw ciengin, Noah pen Shem, Ham, le Japheth-te’ pa a suoh hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leisiet maitangah mite pun a kipat ciengun amate in tanute a nei vua,","title":"Mihing Gitlona"},"2":{"text":"Pasien’ tapate in amate hoi a sa uhi. Tuale amate in a dei zosie uh telin zi-in a la uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Mihingte sungah ka hlagau a teng den sih ding hi, azieh pen amate cilesa ahi uhi; amau’ khan kum pen kum za le sawmni hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in leitungah Nephilim a kici mite om a, tuale khum zaw ciengin zong Pasien’ tapate in mihing’ tanute a luppi ciengun ta a nei uhi. Tamte pen khanglui lai-a mi thahat mi minthangte ahi uhi.","ref":"Job 1:6; 2:1; Gam 13:33"},"5":{"text":"Leitungah mihing gitlona lien mama a, tuaci’n Topa in mihing lungsim ngaisutna poma a sie ngentang ahina thu a mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing a siemkhah pen Topa a kisia a, tua thu in a lungsim a dasah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in, “Ka siemsa mihing, ganhing, a bawhva ganhingte le vana leng vate tawh ka sumaimang ding hi. Azieh pen amate ka siemkhah ka kisia hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Noah in Topa’ maipha a mu hi.","ref":"Mat 24:37; Luk 17:26; 1Pet 3:20"},"9":{"text":"Tam teng pen Noah’ suonlehlahte ahi hi. Noah a thuman mi khat ahi a, a khan sungin paubaang lo hi; Pasien tawh Noah a zawhton hi.","title":"Noah in Pasien Lungdamsah","ref":"2Pet 2:5"},"10":{"text":"Tuale Noah in tapa thum nei a, Shem, Ham, le Japheth-te ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in Pasien’ muna-ah leitung kisiegawp a, leitung pen tatsietna tawh a kidim hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuale Pasien in leitung pen a kisie-in a mu hi; bangzieh ahei cile leitungah mi zosie a siehuoi-in a gamta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien in Noah kungah, “Mi zosie suhmaimang dingin ka khentat zo hi, azieh pen amate ziehin tatsietna tawh leitung a kidim hi; tu-in leitung tawh amate ka susie ton ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Nang mama in taasing tawh tembaw khat bawl in; tua tembaw sungah khan a dan danin omsah inlen, a sung le a pu singnai tawh hubih in."},"15":{"text":"Na bawl dan ding tam bang ahi hi: Tembaw a dung tong zathum, a vai tong sawmnga, le a sanna tong sawmthum hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tembaw adingin a innkhum khat bawl inlen, tua tung tong khat ciengah hiel bawl in; tembaw pangah kotpi khat bul in; a dan neita, a ni na, le a thumnate bawl in."},"17":{"text":"Kei lam panin vansin nei-a om zosie, a sunga a husang thei zosie a susie dingin leitungah tuizin ka tungsah ding hi; leitunga om zosie a si ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in nangma tawh ka thuciemna ka kipsah ding hi; nangma, na tapate, na zi le na tapate’ zite tawh tembaw sungah na lut ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale hinna nei zosie, mi zosie lah panin nangma tawh a hington dingin nam khatah ni ciet tembaw sungah na peipi ding hi; tuate anu le apa hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Vate lah panin amau’ nam cietin, lei-ah a bawhva ganhing zosie amau’ nam cietin nam khatah ni ciet na kungah ang pei ding vua, tuate a hin nadingin na kem ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A kine thei an namcin zong la inlen tuate khol in; tuate pen nangma le amate adingin an hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Noah in tuate a bawl hi; Pasien in ama tunga a thupieh zosie ama in a bawl hi.","ref":"Heb 11:7"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Noah kungah, “Nangma le na innkuonpi zosie tembaw sungah lut un. Azieh pen tam khang mite sungah nang beh ka mai-ah a thumanin kang mu zo hi.","title":"Tuizinpi (Luk 17:26-27)"},"2":{"text":"Ganhing a sieng zosie nupa kop sagi le ganhing a sieng lo nupa kop khat la in."},"3":{"text":"Tuale vana leng vate zong nupa kop sagi ma, leitungah a ci man lo nadingin kemcing in."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ni sagi ciengin leitungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung guo ka zusah ding a, leitung maitang panin ka bawlsa hinna nei vannuoi ka sumang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale Noah in Topa’ thupiehsa zosie a un-in a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Leitungah tuizin a tun lai-in Noah kum zaguh a pha hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale tuizin panin a suotah nadingun Noah, a tapate, a zi le a mote tawh tembaw sungah a lut uhi.","ref":"Mat 24:38-39; Luk 17:27"},"8":{"text":"Pasien in Noah a thupieh bangin ganhing a siengte, ganhing a sienglote, vate, lei-a a bawhva zosie lah panin"},"9":{"text":"a nupa kopin Noah tawh tembaw sungah a lut uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ni sagi a cin zaw ciengin leitungah tuizin a tung hi."},"11":{"text":"Noah’ khan a kum zaguhna kum, a hla nina, tua a hla ni sawm le ni sagi ni-in vantunga om a thuh mama tuinah zosie pawhkeh a, vantung tawlet zosie kihong hi.","ref":"2Pet 3:6"},"12":{"text":"Leitungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli guo zu hi."},"13":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in Noah le a tapate, Shem, Ham, Japheth, le Noah’ zi le a mote thum, amate tawh tembaw sungah a lut uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate tawh gamsa zosie a nam ciet, innsa zosie a nam ciet, lei-a a bawhva poma a nam ciet, le va poma a nam ciet, va namkim, le hlanei zosie a nam cietin a lut uhi."},"15":{"text":"Noah’ tembaw sungah hinna hu nei zosie kopni cietin a lut uhi."},"16":{"text":"Pasien in Noah tunga a thupiehsa bangin hinna a nei zosie, a nupa-in tembaw sungah a lut uhi; tuale Topa in ama kot a khalu hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitungah ni sawmli sung a kizomin gua a zuzu hi; tuale tui tam semsemin tembaw a lamto a, leitungah khangin a sangto lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Leitungah tui khang valuhin tuitungah tembawpi a lamto hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitungah tui nahpi tahin a khan ziehin vansin nei buppi-a a om muol sang zosie a hlummang hi;"},"20":{"text":"muolteng tungah tui letto lai a, tuate tungah tong sawm le tong nga thuhin hlummang hi."},"21":{"text":"Leitungah hinna a nei zosie, vate, innsate, gamsate, lei-a a hon gamtat ganhing zosie le mi zosie a si sieng hi;"},"22":{"text":"leigaw lahah a nahvanga hinna hu a nei poma a si sieng uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in mihing, ganhing, a bawhvate le vana leng vate, leitunga hinna a nei poma a sumaimang hi; Noah le tembaw sunga a ompite beh a suohta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ni za le ni sawmnga sung leitungah tui a khang hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in Noah le ama tawh a omton gamsate le innsate a phawh hi. Tuale Pasien in leitungah hui langsah a, tui a kiem hi;","title":"Tuizin Kiem"},"2":{"text":"a thuhna-a om tuinahte le vantunga tawlette kikha a, guo kitheusah hi,"},"3":{"text":"tuale leitung panin tuite a kiem hieihiei hi. Ni za le sawmnga a cin zaw ciengin tuite a kiem sieng hi;"},"4":{"text":"a hla sagina, a ni sawm le ni sagina ni-in Ararat muol tungah tembaw kinga hi."},"5":{"text":"A hla sawmna dongin tui kiem hieihiei a, a hla sawmna, a ni khat ni-in muol dawn sangte a kidawh ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni sawmli a cin zaw ciengin Noah in a bawlsa tembaw tawlette hongin"},"7":{"text":"va-ah khat a hla hi; tuale leitungah tui a kan masangsie a leng kawikawi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin leitungah tui a kiem ta amah ci a thei nadingin vakhu khat a hlakia hi;"},"9":{"text":"ahi vangin lei maitang zosie-ah tui let lai ahi ziehin a tuh nading maimaw-in tembaw sungah tua vakhu a kilekia hi. Tuaci’n ama in a khut zahin vakhu man a, tembaw sungah a peipi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in ni sagi sung ngahkia a, tuale tembaw panin tua vakhu a hlakia hi;"},"11":{"text":"nitah lamin ama kungah vakhu kilekia a, olive singna a tuhtha khat a nephu-ah petin a tunpi hi; tuaci’n Noah in leitung panin tuite kiem zo hi, ci-in a thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ni sagi ma ngahkia-in, tua vakhu a hla kia hi; tua vakhu ama kungah a kilekia ta sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Noah a khan kum zaguh le khatna, a hla masa, tuami hla ni masa pen ni-in leitungah tui a kang sieng hi; tuale Noah in tembaw khuna ladawhin a khuodah leh leitang pen a na hul sipsep ta hi."},"14":{"text":"A hla nina, tua hla ni sawmni le sagi ni-in leitung a hul sieng ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in Noah kungah,"},"16":{"text":"“Nangma le na zi, na tapate le na mote tawh tembaw panin peidawh ta un."},"17":{"text":"Na ompi hinna nei zosie - vate, ganhingte le lei-a a bawhva zosie - leitungah nosangin, khanpha-in a pun thei nadingin peipi in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n a tapate le a zi le a mote tawh Noah a pei hi."},"19":{"text":"Ganhing zosie, a bawhva zosie, le va zosie, leitunga a gamta zosie a innkuon kuonin tembaw panin a pusuoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Noah in Topa adingin maitam khat lam a, ganhing le va siengtho zosie lahah khat ta la-in maitam tungah meihal biehnate a pie hi.","title":"Noah Tunga Pasien’ Kamciem"},"21":{"text":"Tuale Topa in tua gimnamtui a zah bepin a lungsim sungah, “Mihing ziehin leitang ka samsie nawn sih ding hi. Azieh pen mihing’ lungsim ngaisutnate naupang ahi lai vua kipanin a gilo ahi tabo hi. Tu-a ka bawl bangin hinna nei zosie zong ka susie nawn sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Leitung a om laisie khaitu hun le anlah hun, khuovot hun le khuolum hun, khal hun le phalbi hun, sun hun le zan hunte tawp lo ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien in Noah le a tapate thupha pie a, amate kungah, “Cipha-in pung unlen, leitung luodim un.","title":"Noah tawh Thuciemna","ref":"Pien 1:28"},"2":{"text":"Leitung ganhing namcin teng, vana leng va namcin teng, lei-a a bawhva cinteng le tuipi sunga a om zosie in hing giingin ang zatah ding uhi; na khut sung vuah tuate ang kipie hi."},"3":{"text":"A pia thei a nungta ganhing zosie na an uh hi ding hi. Keima in ante lohing note kang pieh bangin na vannuoi zong note kang pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin hinna ahi sisan pen a sa tawh na ne ton sih beh ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16, 23; 15:23"},"5":{"text":"Na hinna uh ahi sisan tangin sisan ma ka kal valon ding hi: Ganhing zosie tung le mihingte tungah ka kal ding a, mi khat ciet’ sisan tangin midang khat ciet’ sisan ka kal ding a, mihing hinna tangin mihing sisan ma ka kal ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing sisan suo poma, mihing ma in tua mipa sisan a suo ding hi. Azieh pen Pasien in ama’ lim bangin mi a bawl hi.","ref":"Pien 1:26; Pei 20:13"},"7":{"text":"Tuale cipha-in pung unlen, leitung luodimin a sungah pung un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 1:28"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in Noah le a ompi a tapate kungah,"},"9":{"text":"Kei ka hile nangma le na nua-a na suonlehlahte le,"},"10":{"text":"no tawh a omton hinna nei zosie, vate, innsate, le note tawh a omton leitung gamsa zosie, tembaw sung pana a pusuoh zaza tawh ka thuciemna ka kipsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinna a nei zosie, tuizin tawh sumaimangkia ngai nawn loin, leitung susie dingin tuizin ka tunsahkia ngai nawn lo nadingin note tawh ka thuciemna ka kipsah hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasien in, “Tam pen keima, note le no tawh ang omton hinna nei zosie kikala ka bawl, mai lama ang pieng ding na suonlehlahte dinga lim ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Meii lahah ka sakhi-guihlung ka kaisah zo a, tua pen kei le leitung kikalah thuciemna lim hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Leitungah meiilum kaisahin meiilum lahah sakhi-guihlung a kimu leh,"},"15":{"text":"keima, nohaw le hinna a nei zosie tawh ka thuciemna ka phawh ding a, hinna a nei zosie susie dingin tuizin tung ngai nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Meiilum lahah sakhi-guihlung a op ciengin keima in ka en ding a, Pasien le leitunga om hinna nei zosie kikalah tawntung thuciemna ka phawh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien in Noah kungah, “Tam pen kei le leitunga om hinna nei zosiete kikalah ka kipsahsa thuciemna lim ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tembaw pana pusuoh Noah’ tapate pen Shem, Ham, le Japheth-te ahi uhi. Ham pen Canaan’ pa ahi hi.","title":"Noah le a Tapate"},"19":{"text":"Tam mihing thum teng pen Noah’ tapate ahi vua, tam teng panin leitung buppi mi tawh a kidim hi."},"20":{"text":"Noah pen lohlo mi ahi a, lengga um bawl masa pa ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in lenggazu themkhat dawnin a kham a, tuale puonbuh sungah puon sil loin a lum hi."},"22":{"text":"Canaan’ pa Ham in a pa a guohtanga a lup a mu bepin, a pulama om a sanggam ni tegel kungah a ko hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shem le Japheth in puon khat la-in, a liengko tuoh vuah a baang vua, nuatawnsa-in pei-in a pa uh’ guohtang opna a khupieh uhi; ama ni in a lengat zieh gelin a pa uh’ guohtanga a opna a mu sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"A zukhamna panin Noah a khuophaw ciengin ama tungah a tapa tumpen gamtat dan teng thei a,"},"25":{"text":"ama in, “Canaan in samsiet thuoh hinlen, a sanggamte adingin sila ngiempen hi taheh."},"26":{"text":"Ama in zong, “ Topa ka Pasien in Shem thupha pie hinlen, Canaan, ama’ sila hisah heh."},"27":{"text":"Pasien in Japheth adingin mun bawlpieh hinlen, Shem’ puonbuhte sungah ama tengsah heh. Tuale Canaan pen ama’ sila hisah heh,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuizin tunzaw ciengin Noah kum zathum le kum sawmnga sung hing lai hi."},"29":{"text":"Noah’ khan sung teng pen kum zakuo le kum sawmnga ahi hi; tuale ama a si hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Noah’ tapate ahi Shem, Ham, le Japheth-te’ suonlehlahte ahi hi; tuizin a tun zaw ciengin amate in tapate a nei uhi.","title":"Noah Panin Minamte Pieng (1Khg 1:5-27)"},"2":{"text":"Japheth’ suonlehlahte: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, le Tiras ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Gomer’ suonlehlahte: Ashkenaz, Riphath, le Togarmah ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Javan’ suonlehlahte: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, le Rodanim ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam teng panin tuipi gei-a teng mite a kizel uhi. Tam teng pen Japheth’ suonlehlahte ahi vua, amau’ gam sungah amau’ kamham ciet zangin, a innkuon kuonun amau’ ci le namte lahah a teng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ham’ suonlehlahte: Cush, Egypt, Put, le Canaan ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Cush’ suonlehlahte: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, le Sabteca ahi hi. Raamah’ suonlehlahte: Sheba le Dedan ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Cush pen Nimrod’ pa hi a, leitungah a thahat galhang masa pen ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa mai-ah ama pen mi thahat sabengpa khat ahi hi; tua ahi ziehin ama pen, “ Topa mai-ah Nimrod bangin mi thahat sabeng pa,” na kici hi."},"10":{"text":"A kumpi gam kipatna Babel, Erech, le Accad ahi a, tam teng zosie Shinar gam sungah a om hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua gam panin Assyria gam sungah pei-in Nineveh, Rehoboth-ir, Calah,"},"12":{"text":"Nineveh le Calah kikalah Resen khuopite a sat hi; Calah pen khuopi lien ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Egypt pen Lud-te, Anam-te, Lehab-te, Naphtuh-te,"},"14":{"text":"Pathru-te, Casluh mite le Caphtor-te’ pienna pupi hi a, tuate panin Philistia-te pieng hi."},"15":{"text":"Canaan pen a ta masa Sidon le Heth’ pa ahi a,"},"16":{"text":"Jebus-te, Amor-te, Girgash-te,"},"17":{"text":"Hiv-te, Arki-te, Sin-te,"},"18":{"text":"Arvad-te, Zemari-te le Hamath-te’ pienna pupi ahi a, tam teng nua-ah Canaan-te a kithezah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Canaan-te’ gam in Sidon panin Gerar lam muhin Gaza cieng dong ban a, Sodom lam panin Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, le Lasha cieng dong ban hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ innkuon, amau’ kamham, amau’ leitang le amau’ minamin Ham’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Eber mi zosie pienna pupi, Japheth’ upa, Shem sung panin zong tate a pieng hi."},"22":{"text":"Shem’ suonlehlahte: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, le Aram ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Aram’ suonlehlahte: Uz, Hul, Gether, le Mash ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Arpachshad in tapa Shelah nei hi; Shelah in Eber tapa khat ma nei hi."},"25":{"text":"Eber in tapa ni nei a, a masa pen Peleg kici-a, ama hun sungin a gam kiphalsuo ahi ziehin a naupa’ min pen Joktan ahisah hi."},"26":{"text":"Joktan pen Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"27":{"text":"Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,"},"28":{"text":"Obal, Abimael, Sheba,"},"29":{"text":"Ophir, Havilah, le Jobab-te’ pienna pa ahi hi. Tam teng zosie pen Joktan’ suonlehlahte ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Amau’ tenna gam pen Mesha panin Sephar lam muhin nisuona lam muoltung gam cieng dong ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ innkuon, amau’ kamham, amau’ leitang le amau’ minamin Ham’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tam teng pen a khangsimna uh zui-a, a gam sung vuah Noah tapate’ innkuon ahi hi. Tuizin tun zaw ciengin tam teng tung panin leitungah minamte a kithezah hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amasa-in leitung buppi in kamham khat le kamteng kibang a nei uhi.","title":"Babel Tausang"},"2":{"text":"Nisuona lam panin a na lal vua, Shinar gam sungah zanglei mun khat mu-in tua mun ah na teng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat kiho-in, “Hing pei un, tehlei khengin halgaw vai,” kici uhi. Amate in suong tangin tehlei a zang vua, a tuhkip nadingin suongmeihol nai zang uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Hing pei un, eimahaw adingin khuopi khat le a khumvum in vantungte dong a ban ding tausangpi khat lam vai-in, i min than nadingin bawl vai; tua banga i bawl sih leh leitung buppi-ah i kithethang ta ding uhi,” a kici uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mihingte’ lamsa khuopi le tausang en dingin Topa a kumsuh hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “En un, amate minam khat ahi vua, amate zosie in kamham khat a nei uhi; tam pen a sep ding uh a kipatna ahi nabo hi; amate adingin sep dinga a gelte uh bangma a pieng thei nawn sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hing pei un, kuonsuh vai-in khatlekhat a thugen uh a kithei lo nadingin khum munah a kamham uh va sawpawi ta vai,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in leitung muncin tengah amate thezah sieng a, a khuopi bawl uh a khawl ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tam khuopi pen Babel kici hi. Azieh pen Topa in khum munah leitung mi zosie’ kamham a sawpawipieh hi; khum mun panin Topa in leitung muncin tengah amate a thezah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam teng pen Shem’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi. Shem kum zakhat a cin, tuizin tun zaw kum ni ciengin ama in Arpachshad kici tapa khat a nei hi;","title":"Shem’ Suonlehlahte (1Khg 1:17-27 ; Luk 3:34-36)"},"11":{"text":"Arpachshad pien nua-in Shem kum zakhat pha ta a, tapate le tanu dangte zong nei hi."},"12":{"text":"Arpachshad kum sawmthum le kum nga a phah zaw-in, Shelah kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"13":{"text":"Shelah pien nua-in Arpachshad kum zali le kum thum dam lai a, tanute le tapa dangte zong nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Shelah kum sawmthum a phah zaw-in, Eber kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"15":{"text":"Eber pien nua-in Shelah kum zali le kum sawmthum dam lai a, tanute le tapa dangte zong nei hi."},"16":{"text":"Eber kum sawmthum le kum li a phah zaw-in, Peleg kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"17":{"text":"Peleg pien nua-in Eber kum zali le kum sawmthum dam lai a, tanute le tapa dangte zong nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Peleg kum sawmthum a phah zaw-in, Reu kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"19":{"text":"Reu pien nua-in Peleg kum zani le kum kuo dam lai a, tanute le tapate zong nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Reu kum sawmthum le ni a phah zaw-in, Serug kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"21":{"text":"Serug pien nua-in Reu kum zani le kum sagi dam lai a, tanute le tapa dangte zong nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Serug kum sawmthum a phah zaw-in Nahor kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"23":{"text":"Nahor pien nua-in Serug kum zani dam lai a, tanute le tapa dangte zong nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Nahor kum sawm ni le kum kuo a phah zaw-in Terah kici tapa khat nei hi;"},"25":{"text":"Terah pien nua-in Nahor kum za le sawm le kuo dam lai a, tanute le tapa dangte zong nei hi."},"26":{"text":"Terah kum sawm sagi a phah zaw-in Abram, Nahor, le Haran te nei hi."},"27":{"text":"Tu-in Terah’ suonlehlahte tam teng ahi hi. Terah in Abram, Nahor le Haran nei a, Haran in Lot nei hi.","title":"Terah’ Suonlehlahte"},"28":{"text":"Haran pen a pienna Chaldea gam Ur khuo-ah a pa Tera a si masangin a si hi."},"29":{"text":"Abram le Nahor in zi nei uhi; Abram’ zi min pen Sarai hi a, Nahor’ zi min pen Haran’ tanu Milcah ahi hi. Milcah le Iscah’ pa pen Haran ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tu-in Sarai ciing a, ta a nei thei sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Terah in a tapa Abram le Haran’ tapa, a tupa ahi Lot, le a tapa Abram’ zi ahi a monu Sarai zawpi a, Canaan gam lam zuonin Chaldea gam Ur khuo panin a peiton uhi. Ahi vangin Haran a tun ciengun khum munah a teng uhi."},"32":{"text":"Terah’ khan sung kum zani le kum nga hi a, Haran-ah ama a si hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Abram kungah, “Na gam, na be na phung le na pa’ inn nuasie inlen, kang lah ding gamah pei in.","title":"Abram a Kihlatna (Sawl 7:2-5)","ref":"Sawl 7:2-3; Heb 11:8"},"2":{"text":"Minam lien khatin kang bawl ding a, thupha hing pie-in, na min ka liensah ding a, tuaci’n midangte adingin thupha na hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang thupha ang piete thupha pie-in, nang ang samsiete ka samsie ding hi; nang tungtawnin leitung minam zosie in thupha a ngalaw ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gal 3:8"},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa gensa bangin Abram pei a, Lot in zong a zui hi. Haran pan a peikhietin Abram kum sawm sagi le nga a pha hi."},"5":{"text":"Abram in a zi Sarai, le a sangampa’ tapa Lot, a kholsa a nei a lam teng, le Haran-a a sila nei teng zawpi-in, Canaan gam lam a zotpi hi. Canaan gam a tun ciengun,"},"6":{"text":"Abram in tua gam nawhin Shechem mun, Moreh gangpi sing lahah a tung hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abram tungah Topa kilang a, tuale ama kungah, “Na suonlehlahte tungah tam gam ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama in a kunga a kilang Topa adingin maitam khat a lam hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:5; Gal 3:16"},"8":{"text":"Tua mun panin Bethel nisuona lam muol tungah kituon a, nitumna lam Bethel, nisuona lam Ai khuo kikalah a puonbuh a sung hi. Khum munah Topa adingin maitam khat a lam a, ama in Topa’ min loin thu a ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Negeb gam lam zuonin khuolzin kia dingin Abram kipan a, tua mun a tun dongin a banbanin a pei hi."},"10":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Canaan gamah kielpi a tung hi. Tuaci’n kielpi a siet huoi ziehin Egypt gamah a pem dingin Abraham a peisuh hi.","title":"Egypt-ah Abram"},"11":{"text":"Egypt gam a lut kuonin a zi Sarai kungah, “Nang pen numei melhoi khat na hi hi;"},"12":{"text":"Egypt-te in ang mu cieng ule amate in, ‘Tam nu ama’ zi ahi hi,’ ang ci ding uhi; tua bepin kei ei thatin nang ang hinkhawi ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Nang vang tawh kei ei kihinkhawi-in ei na kihoi bawl nadingin ka sangamnu-in hing kigen in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 20:2; 26:7"},"14":{"text":"Egypt gamah Abram a tun bepin Egypt-te in a zi a et ule melhoi a sa mama uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale Pharaoh’ vaisaite in ama nu a mu ciengun, Pharaoh mai-ah a phat uhi. Amate in Pharaoh’ inn sungah tua numei a peipi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua nu ziehin kumpipa in Abram a limbawl hi; tuaci’n ama in tuute, bawngtangte, laatangte, numei le pasal silate, laanute, le kalaoh-te a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Abram’ zi Sarai ziehin Pharaoh le a innkuonpite tungah gimna lienpi a tungsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh in Abram hlanin ama kungah, “Kei bang nei law ahiei? Ama na zi ahi lam bang dinga nei gen lo ahiei?"},"19":{"text":"Bang dinga ama, ‘Ka sanggam nu hi,’ na ci-a ka zi dinga nei lahsah ahiei? Tu-in na zi tanah om hi. Ama zawpi inlen pei in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama tawh kisai-in Pharaoh in a mite thupie a, amate in a zi le a neisa teng tawh lampi-ah a hla uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abram in a zi, a neisa zosie, le Lot tawh, Egypt panin Negeb gam lam a zuonto hi.","title":"Abram le Lot Kikhen"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in Abram in ganhing, ngun, le kham a hau mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Negeb gam panin Bethel le Ai khuo kikala a puonbuh a lamcilna mun le,"},"4":{"text":"a maitam bawl masahna mun dongah ama pei a, khum munah Abram in Topa kungah thu a ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Abram tawh a zawhton ahi Lot in zong tuuhon, ganhon, le puonbuhte a hau ta a,"},"6":{"text":"tuaci’n a ni gela a tenton thei nadingin leitang in ama gel a va zo nawn sih hi; azieh pen ama gel’ neisa tam sengin a tengton thei ta sih gel hi,"},"7":{"text":"tuale Abram’ gancingte le Lot’ gancingte kikalah kihauna a om ta hi. Tua gamah khum hunin Canaan-te le Perez-te a teng uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abram in Lot kungah, “Kei le nang kikal, na gancingte le ka gancingte kikalah kihauna kici omsah sih vai; bangzieh ahei cile ei tegel pen sanggam khat i hibo hi."},"9":{"text":"Na mai-ah gam buppi om hi lo amah? Keima kung panin kikhen khie ta’n. Nang veilama na pei leh, kei zietlamah ka pei ding hi; nang zietlama na pei leh kei veilamah ka pei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Lot in a kim a pam en a, tuale Jordan zanglei mun zosie in tui limtahin nga-in Topa’ um tawh hitale, Zoar lama Egypt leitang tawh hitale kibang hi, ci-in a mu hi. Tam pen Topa in Sodom le Gomorrah a suhsiet masang ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 2:10"},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Lot in ama adingin Jordan zanglei zosie teel a, nisuona lam zuonin Lot a zin hi. Ama gel tam bangin khatlekhat a kikhen uhi."},"12":{"text":"Zanglei-a khuopite lahah Lot tengin Sodom dongah a puonbuhte khinin a om laitahin, Canaan gamah Abram a teng hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua laitahin Sodom mite pen migilo ahi vua, Topa tunga mawna lien bawlte ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Lot tawh ama a kikhen zaw ciengin Topa in Abram kungah, “Tu-in na opna panin leilu lam, leitaw lam, nisuona lam, le nitumna lam ento in;"},"15":{"text":"azieh pen na mu gam zosie nang le na suonlehlahte kang pie peisuoh ding hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:5"},"16":{"text":"Keima in na suonlehlahte, leitung leivui za-in tampi ka phasah ding hi; tuaci’n mi khat in leitunga leivui a sim thei leh na suonlehlahte zong kisim thei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ding inlen, leitang a dung a vai kantanin pei in. Azieh pen nang tungah tua gam kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n a puonbuh tuo-in Abram pei a, Hebron gamsung, Mamre gangpi singte lahah a teng hi; ama in khum munah Topa adingin maitam khat a lam hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shinar Kumpipa Amraphel, Ellasar Kumpipa Arioch, Elam Kumpipa Chedorlaomer, le Goiim Kumpipa Tidal-te hun lai-in,","title":"Lot’ Saltanna le a Kihutkhietna"},"2":{"text":"tam kumpite in Sodom Kumpipa Bera, Gomorrah Kumpipa Birsha, Admah Kumpipa Shinab, Zeboiim Kumpipa Shemeber, le Bela (tua pen Zoar) kumpite tawh a kido uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tam teng kipawlin Siddim kuom (Ci Tuipi) ah a galkapte a gawm uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in kum sawm le ni sung Chedorlaomer’ na a sem uhi. Ahi vangin kum sawm le thumna a cin ciengin amate in a ledo uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kum sawm le li a cinin Chedorlaomer le a panpi kumpite a pei vua, Ashteroth-kalnaim gama Rephaim, Ham gama Zuzim, Shaveh-kiriathaim gama Emim,"},"6":{"text":"le Seir muol tunga Hori mite gam, senel gam monga om El-paran gam dong a la uhi;"},"7":{"text":"tua ciengin a kilekia vua, En-mishpat (Kadesh) ah pei-in Amalek-te’ gam zosie le Hazazon-tamar gama a teng Amor-te zong a zo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Sodom kumpipa, Gomorrah kumpipa, Admah kumpipa, Zeboiim kumpipa, le Bela kumpipa (tua pen Zoar) a kuonkhie vua, Siddim kuomah kipawltonin,"},"9":{"text":"Elam kumpipa Chedorlaomer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal, Shinar kumpipa Amraphel, le Ellasar kumpipa Arioch tawh a kido vua, kumpi li in kumpi nga a do uhi."},"10":{"text":"Siddim kuom pen suongmeihol nai khuhte tawh a kidim hi. Sodom kumpi le Gomorrah kumpite a tai ciengun, tua khuhte sungah pawlkhat a kie vua, a omlai teng muol tungah a tai uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n galte in Sodom le Gomorrah-te’ neisa zosie a tomgam vua, amau’ lampi-ah a pei uhi;"},"12":{"text":"amate in Sodom-a a teng Abram naupa’ tapa Lot le a nei a lam teng zong tomgam piehin a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a suohta mi khat pei-in, Eshcol le Aner’ sanggampa, Amor mi Mamre’ gangpi singte gei-a a teng Hebrew mi Abram kungah a gen hi; tam teng pen Abram’ kipawlpite ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Sala a tupa a kimatna thu Abram in a zah ciengin, a inn sunga a suoh galsim dan a siem mi zathum le sawm le giet zawpi-in Dan dong del uhi."},"15":{"text":"Zan lai-in amate sim dingin ama’ galkapte, ama le a nasemte khenin amate a vatgawp vua, Damaskas’ leilu lam Hobah cieng dong a del uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a tupa Lot le a neisa zosie, numei le a galmatte tawh a peipikia hi."},"17":{"text":"Abram in Chedorlaomer kumpipa le a panpi kumpite a zawna panin a kilekia zaw ciengin, ama dawn dingin Shaveh kuom (Kumpipa’ Kuom) ah Sodom kumpipa a pei hi.","title":"Melchizedek in Abram Thupha Pie (Heb 7:1-2)"},"18":{"text":"Salem Kumpipa Melchizedek in an le lenggazu a puoh hi; ama pen Sangpen Pasien’ siempu ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in tua pa thupha pie a, “Van le lei a siem, Sangpen Pasien in Abram thupha pie taheh!"},"20":{"text":"Na galte na khut sunga ang pie Sangpen Pasien in thupha nga taheh,” a ci hi. Abram in na vannuoi’ sesawm-suo-sekhat ama a pie hi.","ref":"Heb 7:1-10"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Sodom kumpipa in Abram kungah, “Mi teng ei pie’n len, van zosie nangma’n kitan ta’n,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Abram in Sodom kumpipa kungah, “Van le lei a bawl Sangpen Topa Pasien kungah ka kiciem zo ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang in, ‘Abram keima hausah ahi hi,’ na ci khah lo nadingin na neisa vauzam khat ahi a, kedap khau khat ahi a, ahi sihle na neisa khat popo ahi zongin ka la sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tangvalte’ nehsate le kei ang zawpite’ satanh ding teng simlo bangma zamtawng ka la sih ding hi. Aner, Escol, le Mamre-te amau’ satanh ding pie in,” a ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng zaw ciengin a mangmuna sungah Topa’ kammal Abram tungah tung a, “Abram aw, zau sin, keima na lum ka hi hi. Na thaman gol mama ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Abram tawh Pasien’ Thuciemna (Heb 11:8-10)"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Abram in, “ Topa Pasien aw, kei bang nei pie diei? Azieh pen ta ka nei nai sih a, ka inn luo ding pen Damascus khuo mi Eliezer ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Abram in, “Nangma in suonlehlah nei pie sih a, tuaci’n ka inn sunga a suoh sila khat ka gamhluo ding ahi ta hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kungah Topa’ kammal tung a, “Tam mipa pen na gamhluopa ahi sih ding hi; nangma-a’ tahtah lo buong koima na gamhluopa ahi sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a pulamah Abram peipi a, “Van lam enin aasite na sim thei leh sim in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Na suonlehlahte tua bang ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 4:18; Heb 11:12"},"6":{"text":"Tuale ama in Topa a um a, Topa in tua khu dihna-in a simpieh hi!","ref":"Rom 4:3; Gal 3:6; Jas 2:23"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah, “Tami gam na luo nading vua Chaldea gam Ur khuo pana note ang peipi pa keima Topa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “ Topa Pasien aw, tua gam ka luo ding lam bangci thei ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Bawnglaa kum thum a cingsa khat, keelnu kum thum a cingsa khat, tuutang kum thum a cingsa khat, gam vakhu no khat le palva no khat ka kungah hing peipi in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in tam teng zosie peipi a, tuate phal ni ciet suo-in phal khat le phal khat kimai ngatin a koi hi; ahi vangin vate phal ni a suo sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ganhing site tungah sasielne vate a tuh uh ciengin Abram in tuate a heumang hi."},"12":{"text":"Ni a tum ciengin Abram a kimut a suoh mama a, tuale ama tungah a zauhuoi mielkingpi khat tu hi.","ref":"Job 4:13-14"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Abram kungah, “Amau’ gam ahi lo gam khatah na suonlehlahte pemta-in a om ding vua, khum munah amate sila suohin kum zali sung kibawlsie ding hi, ci theicien in!","ref":"Pei 1:1-14; Sawl 7:6"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin a na a seppieh uh minamte tungah thukhenna ka tungsah ding a, tua zaw ciengin nei le lam tampi tawh amate a peikhie ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:40-41; Sawl 7:7"},"15":{"text":"Nang na hi leh na pu na pate kung lungnuom tahin na zuon ding a, a vuoikawnin ang kivui ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Khang lina ciengin amate tam munah a peikia ding uhi; azieh pen Amor-te’ mawna kicing nai lo hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ni a tum zaw khuo a miel ciengin a kiphalsuo sate kikalah meikhu beel khat le meivah kuong khat a pei hi."},"18":{"text":"Khum ni-in Topa in Abram tawh thuciemna bawl a, “Na suonlehlahte tungah tam leitang, Egypt gun panin Euphrates gun cieng dong,","ref":"Sawl 7:5"},"19":{"text":"Ken-te, Keniz-te, Kadmon-te,"},"20":{"text":"Hit-te, Periz-te, Rephaim-te,"},"21":{"text":"Amor-te, Canaan-te, Girgash-te, le Jebus-te’ leitang ka pie hi,” a ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Abram’ zi Sarai in ta nei lo hi. Ama in Hagar min nei Egypt-te sila numei khat a nei hi.","title":"Ishmael Suona"},"2":{"text":"Sarai in Abram kungah, “ Topa in ka ta nei ding ei khahtan lam na thei hi; pei inlen ka sila numei nu va luppi ta’n; ama sung pana ta nei ding ka hi kha ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Abram in Sarai’ thugen a mang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Canaan gamah Abram kum sawm a ten zaw ciengin Abram’ zi Sarai in Egypt mi a sila numei Hagar la-in a pasal Abram kungah a zi-in a pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Hagar luppi-in tua nu a gai hi; tuale a gai lam a kithei ciengin a pinu simmaw bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Sarai in Abram kungah, “Kei tunga a manlo-a ei kibawlna pen nang tungah tung taheh! Na kawi dingin ka sila numei kang pie a, ama in a gai lam a kithei bepin kei ei simmaw bawl hi. Topa in nang le kei kikalah thu khen taheh!” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Abram in Sarai kungah, “Na thuneina sungah na sila numei a om hi; na dei bangin ama tungah bawl in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Sarai in tua nu a huotbawl pai a, ama kung panin a taimang hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in senel gam ciatui gei khatah tua nu a mu hi. Tua pen Shur zotna lampi gei-a ciatui ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Sarai’ sila numei Hagar aw, nang hei pana hing pei a, hei lam zuon ding na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ka pinu Sarai kung pana a taimang ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in ama kungah, “Na pinu kungah peikia inlen ama tungah ki-ap in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in ama kungah, “Na suonlehlahte nahpitahin ka pungsah ding a, amate kisim zo lo ding hi,” zong a cibe lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale Topa’ vantungmi in ama kungah, “Tu-in nang in nau na pai zo a, tapa khat na nei ding hi; Topa in na gentheina hing thudon zo ahi ziehin, ama’ min pen Ishmael na phuoh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama pen mihing lahah a gelsuoh laa bang ding a, ama’ khut in mi zosie langpangin, mi zosie’ khut in zong ama a langpang ding hi; a sanggamte zosie galbawlin a nungta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama a hopi Topa pen, “Nang, El-roi na hi hi,” ci-in a min phuo hi; azieh pen tua nu in, “Keima in Pasien ka mu zo tahtah ta a, tuale ama ka mu zaw-in kei a hing lai ka hi amah?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tua tuikhuh pen a min Beer-lahai-roi kici hi; tua khu Kadesh le Bered kikalah a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Abram in Hagar tawh tapa khat a nei hi. Abram in Hagar tawh a nei a tapa pen a min Ishmael phuo hi.","ref":"Gal 4:22"},"16":{"text":"Hagar in ama adingin Ishmael a nei hunin Abram kum sawmgiet le guh a pha hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abram kum sawmkuo le kuo a phah ciengin ama kungah Topa kilah a, ama in, “Keima, Vanglien Pasien ka hi hi; ka mai-ah hoi gamtat inlen kawbaang sin.","title":"Thuciemna’ Lim (Pei 12:43–13:2)"},"2":{"text":"Keima le nangma kikalah ka thuciemna ka bawl ding a, a tampitah kang phasah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abram mai kunsuh a, Pasien in ama kungah,"},"4":{"text":"“Tami khu kei adinga nangma tawh ka thuciemna ahi hi: Nang, minam tampite’ pa na hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na min Abram hi nawn lo ding a, Abraham hi ta ding hi. Azieh pen minam tampite’ pa dingin kang bawlzo ta hi.","ref":"Rom 4:17"},"6":{"text":"Keima in nahpi tahin kang ciphasah ding hi. Minam liente kang suosah ding a, nang sung panin kumpite ang pieng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in nang le nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte tungah Pasien ka hi nadinga tawntung thuciem ahi dingin, kei le nang le nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte tungah a khan tungtawnun ka thuciemna ka kipsah ding hi.","ref":"Luk 1:55"},"8":{"text":"Tulaitah pemta na hina leitang ahi Canaan leitang zosie, nang le nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte tungah na nei den dingun kang pie ding hi; kei pen amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:5"},"9":{"text":"Pasien in Abraham kungah, “Nang le nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte in a khangkhangun ka thuciem na zui ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tami khu nang le kei kikal, nang le nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte tawh kikala na zui ding uh ka thuciem ahi hi: Note lahah pasal zosie in tep a tan ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 7:8; Rom 4:11"},"11":{"text":"Nang in na vundawn na tan ding a, tua pen keima le note kikalah thuciemna lim khat hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na khang tungtawnun note lahah a om pasal poma, na inn sung pieng silate, le na suonlehlahte ahi lo sum tawh na lei uh pasal poma a suo zaw uh ni giet a cin ciengin a tep uh kitan ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na inn sunga piengte hile na sum tawh na lei silate hile, a nipi-in a tep kitan ding hi. Tuaci’n na tahsa sung vua ka thuciem pen kumtawn thuciem hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tep kitan lo pasal poma, ka thuciem palsat ahi a, ama’ mite kung panin kisumaimang ding hi; ama in ka thuciemna palsat zo hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Pasien in Abraham kungah, “Na zi Sarai ahile Sarai na ci nawn sih ding a, ama’ min Sarah hi ta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama thupha ka pie ding a, tua banah ama tung panin tapa khat zong kang pie ding hi. Ama thupha ka pie ding a, ama in minam liente a piengsah ding hi; ama sung panin minamte’ kumpite pieng ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abraham a mai tuolkunin nui a, “Kum za pha pasal khat in ta nei thei ding amah? Kum sawm kuo a pha Sarah in ta a nei na ngel diei mah?” ci-in a lungsim sungah ama le ama a kiho hi."},"18":{"text":"Abraham in Pasien kungah, “Na mai-ah Ishmael hing nungtasah po lacin,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasien in, “Hilo hi, na zi Sarah in nang adingin tapa khat nei ding a, a min Isaac na phuo ding hi. Ama tawh ka thuciemna ka sukip ding a, tua khu ama zaw cienga a suonlehlahte adingin kumtawn thuciem ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ishmael adinga na ngetna ahileh ka za zo hi; ama thupha pie-in ka ciphasah ding a, pungsahin tampitah ka phasah ding hi; kumpi sawm le nite’ pa hi ding a, minam thupi khat ka suohsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuovei tuhun ciengin Sarah sung panin nang dinga ang suoh ding Isaac tawh ka thuciem ka sukip ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama tawh a kiho zaw ciengin Abraham kung panin Pasien a peito ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abraham in a tapa Ishmael le a inn sunga suoh pasal popo, silate ahi a, sum tawh kileite ahi zongin, ama’ inn sunga a om pasal zosie a unpi-in zawpi a, Pasien in ama kunga a gensa bangin tua ni mama-in a tep uh a tan hi."},"24":{"text":"Abraham a tep a kitan lai-in kum sawmkuo le kuo pha hi."},"25":{"text":"A tapa Ishmael a tep a kitan lai-in kum sawm le thum pha hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ni mama-in Abraham le a tapa Ishmael a tep uh kitan hi."},"27":{"text":"A inn sunga pasal zosie, inn sunga suohte ahi a, gamdang mite’ tung pana sum tawh kileite ahi zongin, ama tawh a tep uh kitan ton hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mamre gangpite gei puonbuh lutna-ah sun nisat laitahin Abraham to a, tua laitahin ama kungah Topa kilang hi.","title":"Abraham le Sarah Tapa Khat Kikham"},"2":{"text":"Ama a khuodah to leh a gei-a a ding mi thum a mu hi. Amate a mu bepin a dawn dingin puonbuh lutna panin tai a, tuolah bawhsuh hi.","ref":"Heb 13:2"},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka Topa aw, na maipha ka nga leh na nasempa ei hleng sin."},"4":{"text":"Tui tawmkhat lasah vai-in na keng uh sil unlen sing hlim nei-ah khawl tadi un."},"5":{"text":"Na nasempa kunga nang tun zo tah ngalun na toidam nadingun an halkhat hing tawi vangin, tua zaw ciengin peisuoh bep un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in, “Na ci bangin bawl in,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Sarah’ puonbuh sungah Abraham lutpai zinzianin ama kungah, “Annel hoite a tena thum mallangtahin bawl inlen, metnawi-in mohin hing bawl in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Bawnghon lahah Abraham tai-in, bawngno a dawng tuituoh khat man a, a nasempa pie-in a sa naw bawlsah mama hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin bawngnawi thaukhal, bawngnawi, bawngsa minsa tawi-in a mai vuah a lui hi; singhlim nei-ah a neh laitahun a gei vuah ama a ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in a kungah, “Na zi Sarah hei-a om ahiei? a ci ule ama in, “Khum taha puonbuh sungah,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin khat in, “Nau suo hun ciengin na kungah pel loin kang peikia ding a, na zi Sarah in tapa khat nei ding hi,” a ci hi. Sarah in ama’ nua puonbuh lutna-ah na ngai hi.","ref":"Rom 9:9"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in Abraham le Sarah a vuoikawn ta vua, a kum uh a ham mama ta hi; Sarah zong a numei ngaina teng tawp zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n Sarah amatangin nui a, “Kei ka vuoi zaw, ka pasal a vuoi zaw-in nuom ka sa na ding amah?” a ci hi.","ref":"1Pet 3:6"},"13":{"text":"Topa in Abraham kungah, “Bang dingin Sarah nuinui-in, ‘Tu-in kei lah vuoikawn ta’ng a, kei ta nei tahpi ding ka mah? ci ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Topa adingin a lamdang seng khatpo a om amah? A kisesa nau suo hun ciengin na kungah kang peikia ding a, Sarah in tapa khat a nei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 1:37"},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin a zau ziehin Sarah in niel a, “Ka nui sih hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Hina ve aw, nui ma teh,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum mun panin mite pei-in Sodom lam a en uhi; amate hla dingin a lampi vuah Abraham in a zui hi.","title":"Sodom Tunga Thukhenna"},"17":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka sil bawl dingte Abraham kungah ka pha talawm ding amah?"},"18":{"text":"Abraham pen nam lien le nam thahat suoh ding a, leitung minam zosie in ama ziehin thupha ngalaw ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Pha vawt sih vang. Azieh pen Topa in Abraham tunga a ciemsa thu a tunsah thei nading, ama zaw cienga a pieng a tate le a innkuonpite in dihna le thutang sepna tawh Topa’ lampi a zui nadingun a hil dingin ama ka teelzo hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Sodom le Gomorrah langkhatah kikona bangza tahin lienin, a mawna uh bangza tahin siehuoi ahi tadiei!"},"21":{"text":"Ka kunga ang tung kikona bangin amate a gamta uh amah ci a kan dingin ka kumsuh kul hi; tua banga ahi sihle zong ka va thei ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa mai-ah Abraham a din laitahin khum mun panin mite kihei-in Sodom lam zuonin a pei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abraham in va nai a, “Mi thumante, migilote tawh phietmangtha tahpi ding na hi amah?"},"24":{"text":"Gentena-in tua khuopi sungah mi thuman sawmnga om leh tua sunga om mi thuman sawmngate ziehin tua khuopi ngaidam loin tua mun phietmang ding na hi amah?"},"25":{"text":"Mi thumante, migilote tawh a kibah nadingin mi thumante le migilote thatton ding ci bang silte bawl vawt sin! Tua bangin na bawl poma sih ding hi! Leitung pumpi thukhenpa in a dihin khen lo ding amah?” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, “Sodom khuopi sungah mi thuman sawmnga ka mu leh amate ziehin a khuozangun ka ngaidam ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Abraham in dawng a, “Leivui le vut bang bep lel ahi keima in Topa kungah thu ei gensah in."},"28":{"text":"Gentena-in mi thuman sawmnga muna dingah mi nga in sam ta leh tua mi nga a sap ziehin a khuozangin na susie veve diei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Khum munah mi sawmli le nga ka mu leh ka susie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Abraham in ama hopikia a, “Gentena-in khum munah mi sawmli cieng beh om taleh,” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Mi sawmlite ziehin ka susie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “ Topa aw, na lungthahsah sinlen thu kang gen ding hi. Gentena-in khum munah mi sawmthum kimu taleh,” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Mi sawmthum ka mu leh ka susie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa kungah thu ei gensah in. Gentena-in mi sawmni cieng beh kimu taleh,” a ci hi. Ama in dawngin, “Mi sawmnite ziehin ka susie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “ Topa aw, na lung thahsah sinlen khatvei kang gen lai ding hi. Khum munah mi sawm kimu leh,” a ci hi. Ama in dawngkia a, “Mi sawmte ziehin ka susie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Abraham tawh a kiho zaw ciengin a lampi-ah Topa a pei hi; tuale a inn ah Abraham a kilekia ta hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nitah lamin Sodom ah vantungmi ni tung a, Sodom khuo kulkotpi ah Lot na to hi. Lot in tua gel a galmu bepin a dawn dingin ding a, a mai tuolah kunin,","title":"Sodom’ Sietna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka pute aw, hing thum ing. Na nasempa’ inn lamah hing kihei-in hing gieh ta unlen, na keng uzong sil un; tua ciengin zingmawng tungin thobai-in na maban uh na zom na ding uhi,” a ci hi. Ama gel in, “Hilo hi; ko pen khuolai tuol-awnga gieh ding ka hibo uhi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in nahpi-in ama gel a hlo hi; tuaci’n ama kungah ama gel kihei-in a inn sungah a lut uhi; tuale ama gel adingin pawi khat a bawlpieh a, tol saw lo anlum emin a ne uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lup masangun tua khuosung mite, Sodom khuomite, a teh a khangin mi zosie in tua inn a imtawm uhi;"},"5":{"text":"amate in Lot a hlan vua, “Tuzan na kunga zin hing tungte hei-ah a om ta uh ahei? Amate ka luppi thei nadingun ka kung vuah hing peipi in,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Lot zong kotkhah panin tua mite kungah pei-in a kot lekha a,"},"7":{"text":"“Ka sanggamte aw, hing thum ing. Tam bangin gitlo gamtat sih un."},"8":{"text":"En un, pasal tawh lumton nai lo ta ngahnu ni ka nei hi; note kungah tua gel hing puoh vangin na nop bangbangun ama gel tungah kigamtat ta un; tam mite bangma law sih beh un, azieh pen ka innhlim bel a ang lut ahi bo uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a dawngkia vua, “Nuakin vawi!” a ci uhi. Tuale amate in, “Tam mipa ta sungah pemta khat a ang tung hi lel bo a, thukhen dan a ang kinei viel amah! Tu-in amate sangin nang kang khelbawl zaw ding uhi,” a ci uhi. Tua ciengin Lot a phul tentun vua, kotkhah phukeh dingin a nai tehteh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin inn sunga mite in a khut uh zahin inn sungah Lot kaiphitin amate tawh kot a kikhalu uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale inn kotkhah-a om pasalte, a gol a neu-in kotkhah a mu lo nadingun amate in a mit uh a tawsah hi.","ref":"2Kum 6:18"},"12":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin mite in Lot kungah, “Tam sungah adang koi a om lai ei? Mahte, tapate, tanute ahi sihle tam khuopi sungah mi khatpo na nei leh tam panin pusuopi in.","title":"Sodom le Gomorrah Kisusie (Mat 11:23-24 ; Luk 17:28-32)"},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa mai-ah a mite kimawsahna awging lien luo mama a, a susie dingin Topa in kote ei sawl zo ahi ziehin tam mun a susie ding ka hi ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Lot pei-in a tanute a kinunpi ding amah dingte kungah, “Ding unlen, tam mun panin peidawh ta un; azieh pen Topa in tam khuopi a suhsiet ding ahi ta hi,” a ci hi. Hinanle amahte adingin ama pen a ciemmui tawh a kibang lel hi."},"15":{"text":"Zingmawng phalvah ciengin vantung mite in, “Tho inlen, tam sunga a om na zi le na tanu nite la in. Tua ahi sihle khuopi danpiehna sungah no zong na sigam ding uhi,” ci-in Lot kungah genin a pausawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama a onton lai hi; tuaci’n Topa in ama a hepi ziehin vantung mite in ama, a zi le a tanu nite a bantang ah kai-in a pusuopi vua, khuopi pulamah a nuasie uhi.","ref":"2Pet 2:7"},"17":{"text":"Amate in pulam a tut zaw ciengun, “Na hinna uh taipi un; kinua hei sih unlen, zanglei mun khatpo ah zong khawl vawt loin muol tungah kitai pai un, ahi sihle na sigam sieng ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Lot in amate kungah, “Hilo hi, ka pute aw;"},"19":{"text":"en un, na mitmu-un na nasempa in maipha ka nga zo a, ka hinna nei hutdam nadingun kei tungah migitna lienpi nei lah zo ta uhi; ahi vangin muol tungah ka taizo sih a, gimna in ei nua phahin si ding ka zau hi."},"20":{"text":"En un, tai nading khopin khum khuopi a nai a, khuopi neu khat ahi hi. Khum tahah ei taisah un; khuopi neu khat hi lel lo amah? Tua hile suohta bep vang!” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in tua pa kungah, “Hoi mama hi, tam maipha zong nang kang pie a, na khuopi gen pen ka lumlet sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Kinaw inlen khum munah tai in. Azieh pen khumtah na tun masangsie ken bangma ka bawl thei sih hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin khum khuopi pen Zoar kici hi."},"23":{"text":"Zoar-ah Lot a tun ciengin leitungah ni suoh zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin van panin Topa in Sodom le Gomorrah khuopite tungah kaat le meikuong a zusah hi;"},"25":{"text":"ama in khuopite, zanglei zosie, khuopi sunga a teng mi zosie le leitunga po bangkim a lumlet hi.","ref":"Mat 10:15; 11:23-24; Luk 10:12; 17:29; 2Pet 2:6; Jude 7"},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nua-a om Lot’ zi a kinua hei le cikhuom a suoh hi.","ref":"Luk 17:32"},"27":{"text":"Topa mai a dinnasa munah zingmawng tungin Abraham a pei hi;"},"28":{"text":"ama in Sodom, Gomorrah le zanglei muncin teng a ensuh leh meikhuh pana a khu bangin leitang pan meikhu kitung valuh pi a mu hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasien in zanglei tunga om khuopite a suhsiet ciengin Abraham a phawh a, Lot’ tenna khuopite a lumlet ciengin tua a lumletna panin Lot a peikhiesah hi."},"30":{"text":"Zoar ah a ten ngam lo ziehin Zoar panin Lot peito-in a tanu nite tawh muol tungah a teng hi, azieh pen Zoar ah ama teng ngam lo hi; tuaci’n suonghawm sung khatah a tanu nite tawh a teng uhi.","title":"A Zumhuoi Moab le Ammon Pienna Zungpi"},"31":{"text":"A tanu tapen in a naunu kungah, “I pa lah vuoi ta a, tuale leitung ngaina banga i kiluppi ding pasal khat zong leitungah a om sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Hing pei in, i pa lenggazu tekham vai, i pa tungtawnin suonlehlah i kepcing thei nadingin ama tawh lumton vai,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama gel in khum zanin a pa uh lenggazu a tekham uhi; tuale a unu pei-in a pa tawh a lumton hi. A pa in a tanu a lup lam le a thawkia lam a thei sih hi."},"34":{"text":"A zing ni-in a unu in a naunu kungah, “En in, zani zanin i pa tawh ka lumton hi; tu zanin zong ama zu tekham vai. Tua ciengin i pa tungtawnin suonlehlahte i kepcing nadingin va pei inlen, ama tawh va lumton ta’n,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum zanin zong a pa uh zu a tekham uhi; tuale a naunu pei-in ama tawh a lumton hi; a pa in a tanu a lup lam le a thawkia lam a thei sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua bang danin a tanu tegel a nipi-un a pa utawh a kigai uhi."},"37":{"text":"A unu in tapa khat nei a, a min Moab phuo hi; ama pen tuhun Moab-te’ pienna pa ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"A nau in zong tapa khat nei a, a min Benammi ahisah hi; ama pen tuhun Ammon-te’ pienna pa ahi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum tah panin Negeb gam lamah Abraham khuol a zin a, Kadesh le Shur kikal Gerar ah a teng hi. Gerar ah pemta bangin a ten laitahin,","title":"Gerar ah Abraham le Sarah"},"2":{"text":"Abraham in a zi Sarah pen, “Ka sanggamnu hi,” a ci le Gerar’ Kumpipa Abimelech in zong mi sawlin Sarah a lasah hi.","ref":"Pien 12:13; 26:7"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin zan khat Abimelech’ mangah Pasien pei-in a kungah, “Zi dinga na lah numei ziehin a si ding na hi hi; azieh pen ama pasal neisa ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hunin Abimelech in tua nu kung neh nai lo hi; tuaci’n ama in, “ Topa , mawpeng minam khat a susie ding na hi amah?"},"5":{"text":"Amama in keima kungah, ‘Ama ka sanggamnu hi,’ ei ci hi lo amah? Tuale amama in zong, “Ama ka sanggampa hi,” ei ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin lungsim siengtho le khut siengtho tawh tam banga gamta ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mang sungah Pasien in, “A hi hi, lungsim siengtho tawh na bawl ahi lam ka thei hi; tua banah kei tungah nang maw lo nadinga nang ang kempa khu keima ka hi hi. Tua zieha ama kang khoisah lo ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin tu-in tua mipa’ zi piekia in; azieh pen ama kamsang khat hi a, ama in nang thu ang ngetpieh ding a, tuaci’n nang na hing ding hi. Ahi vangin ama na piehkia sih leh nangma le na mite na unpi-un pel loin na si ding lam uh thei in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawngin Abimelech a tho bai a, ama in a nasemte zosie hlanin tam thu teng a unpi-in a kung vuah a gen hi; tuale mite a zau mama uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abimelech in Abraham hlanin ama kungah, “Ko tungah bang hing bawl na hiei? Kei tung le ka kumpi gam tungah tam bang khielna lienpi nang tunsah nadingin nang tungah ken bangza-in mawna bawl ka hei? Keima tungah nang bawl dinga a kilawm lo nate nang bawlzo hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Abimelech in Abraham kungah, “Bang ngaisun a, tam na bawl ahiei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Abraham in, “Tam munah Pasien zatahna a om vawt sih ding a, ka zinu ziehin ei that ding uhi, ci-a ka ngaisut zieha tam ka bawl ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua banah ama ka sanggamnu tahtah ahi a, ka pa’ tanu hi-in, ahi vangin ka nu’ tanu ahi sih hi; tuale ama keima’ zi ang suoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien in ka pa’ inn panin ei pusuohsah ciengin keima in ama kungah, ‘Ka tunga nang bawl lo a phamaw na migitna tam ahi hi: I peina mun zosie-ah ama ka sanggampa ahi hi, ei ci’n,’ ka ci hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abimelech in tuu le bawngtangte, sila numei le sila pasalte la-in Abraham a pie a, ama kungah a zi Sarah zong a piekia hi."},"15":{"text":"Abimelech in, “Na mai-ah ka leitang a om hi; na nopna mun popo-ah teng in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in Sarah kungah, “En in, na sanggampa ngun tang tulkhat ka pie zo hi; tami khu na oppi mi zosie mai-ah na maw nei lo lam kipulahna ahi hi; na maw lo lam kilang kilkel hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abraham in Pasien kungah thu ngen hi; tuale Pasien in Abimelech damsah a, ama gel in ta a nei thei nadingin a zi le a sila numeite zong a damsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in Abraham’ zi Sarah ziehin Abimelech innkuon’ naubute zosie a khacip pieh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in a gensa bangin Sarah tungah bawl a, Topa in a khapsa bangin Sarah adingin a bawl hi.","title":"Isaac’ Suona (Heb 11:11)"},"2":{"text":"Sarah gai a, Pasien in ama kunga a gensa hun a vuoi zaw-in Abraham in tapa khat nei hi.","ref":"Heb 11:11"},"3":{"text":"Abraham in Sarah tawh a nei a tapa’ min Isaac a phuo hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasien in ama a thupiehsa bangin ni giet a phah ciengin Abraham in a tapa Isaac a tep a tanpieh hi.","ref":"Pien 17:12; Sawl 7:8"},"5":{"text":"A tapa Isaac a suo hunin Abraham kum zakhat a pha hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Sarah in, “Pasien in kei adingin nuizat nading ei bawlpieh zo hi. A za tapo in ei nuipi ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in, “Sarah in nau nawi pie ding hi, ci-in Abraham kungah koi in gen ngai poma ding ahei? Hizongnanle a vuoi a teh zaw-in ama tawh tapa khat ka nei hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua naupang khangin nawi a tang hi; Isaac in nawi a tan ni-in Abraham in pawi thupi khat a bawl hi.","title":"Hagar le Ishmael Kinotmang (Gal 4:21-30)"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Abraham tawh a nei Egypt mi Hagar’ tapa in a tapa Isaac a ciemmui bawlna Sarah in a mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Abraham kungah, “A tapa tawh tami sila numei nu notmang dawh ta’n; bangzieh ahei cile tami numei’ tapa in ka tapa Isaac tawh gou luoton lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gal 4:29-30"},"11":{"text":"Ama’ tapa zieha a pieng thu in Abraham lunggimsah mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in Abraham kungah, “Naupang le na sila numei ziehin lunggim sin; Sarah in na kunga ang gen popo a gen bangin bawl lel in, azieh pen Isaac tungtawnin nang adingin na suonlehlahte kisim ding hi.","ref":"Rom 9:7; Heb 11:18"},"13":{"text":"Tua sila numei’ tapa zong na cihlah ma ahi ziehin minam khatin ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawngin Abraham a thobai a, an le savun tuithawl la-in Hagar a pie a, a liengko ah khaipiehin naupang tawh a sawlmang dawh ta hi. Tua nu pei-in Beer-sheba senel gamah a vah kawikawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Savun thawl sunga tui a tawp ciengin ama in sawlbawh nei khatah tua naupang a sep dawh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama nu pei-in thalkap khat tan a gamlatna munah a tapa elngatin a to hi; azieh pen ama in, “Tua naupang’ si ei ensah sih un,” a ci hi. Naupang elngatin ama a to laitahin a aw neiza tawh awngin a kap vapo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in naupang pa’ kaa a za hi. Van panin Pasien’ vantungmi in Hagar hlanin a kungah, “Hagar aw, bang in nang hing lungkhamsah ahei? Zau malmal sin; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in naupang opna munah a kaana awging a za zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Hing pei in, tua naupang phong inlen, na khut tawh tupom in, bangzieh ahei cile ama minam lien khat ka suohsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in tua nu’ mit a honpieh a, tuikhuh khat a mu hi. Ama pei-in savun thawl-ah tui a dim a, naupang pa dawn dingin a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasien in tua naupang ompi a, ama a khanglien hi; ama gamlahah teng a, thalkap siem khat a suoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Paran gamlahah ama a teng hi; tuale a nu in ama adingin Egypt panin zi khat a lahpieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Abimelech le a galkapmangpa Phicol in Abraham kungah, “Na sepna zosie-ah Pasien in nang ang ompi hi;","title":"Abraham le Abimelech in Thuciemna Bawl","ref":"Pien 26:26"},"23":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin tu-in nang in kei, ka suonlehlahte le ka neisa zosie tungah a man lopi-in ei bawl loin, na tungah thuman tawh kang gamtat bangin kei tung le pemta banga na tenna leitang tungah nang gamtat nadingin Pasien tawh ka kungah hing kiciem in,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale Abraham in, “Ka kiciem hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Abimelech’ nasemte in a na lahpiehsa uh ahi tuikhuh tawh kisai-in Abraham in a lungkim lona teng Abimelech kungah a gen ciengin,"},"26":{"text":"Abimelech in, “Tam koi pen bawl ci ka thei sih hi; nang in lah ka kungah nang gen sih a, tuni dongin tam thu ka za sih hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abraham in tuute le bawngtangte la-in tuate Abimelech a pie a, ama gel in thuciemna khat a bawl uhi."},"28":{"text":"Abraham in tuuhon lah panin tuuno anu sagi a tuom koi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuale Abimelech in Abraham kungah, “Tami na tuomkoi tuuno anu sagite, bang na cinopna ahiei?” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in, “Tami tuikhuh pen keima tawsa ahina ka teci dingin tami tuuno anu sagite ka khut sung panin na sang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ziehin tua mun Beer-sheba kici hi; azieh pen tua munah ama gel a nipi-un a kiciem uhi."},"32":{"text":"Beer-sheba ah thuciemna khat a bawl zaw ciengun a galkapmangpa Phicol tawh Philistia-te’ gamah Abimelech a kinuale hi."},"33":{"text":"Abraham in Beer-sheba ah makeng kung khat suon a, khum munah Tawntung Pasien Topa’ min tawh thu a ngen hi."},"34":{"text":"Philistia-te’ gamah Abraham, pemta bangin sawt veipi a teng hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thu teng zaw ciengin Pasien in Abraham a zelah hi. Ama in a kungah, “Abraham!” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Tanah om ing,” a ci hi.","title":"Isaac tawh Biehpieh nading Thupiehna (Heb 11:17-19)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “Na it na tapa, na tapa neisun Isaac zawpi inlen Moriah gamah pei in. Khum muna nang kunga kang lah ding muoltung khatah meihal biehna-in ama ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawngin Abraham thobai a, a laa phaw guongin a nasem tangval ni tawh a tapa Isaac a peipi hi; ama in meihal biehna-a zah dingin sing a tom a, ama dingkhie-in Pasien in ama a lahsa mun gamlatna dongah a pei hi."},"4":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Abraham a khuodah leh a gamlapi panin khum mun a galmu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abraham in a tangvalte kungah, “Laa tawh tanah na om un; naupangpa le kei khumnah ka va pei ding uhi; ko gel in Pasien ka va bie ta ding vua, tua ciengin na kung vuah kang peikia ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Abraham in meihal biehna sing la-in Isaac puosah a, ama in mei le nam a puo hi. Tuaci’n ama gel a zawhton uhi."},"7":{"text":"Isaac in a pa Abraham kungah, “Pa aw!” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Tanah om ing, ka ta aw,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Tanah mei le sing om napi meihal biehna ding tuuno hei sunga om ahiei?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Abraham in, “Pasien in meihal biehpiehna dingin tuuno ei pie ding hi, ka ta aw,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama gel a peiton uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien’ lahsa munah a tun ciengun Abraham in tua munah maitam khat lamin sing a cieng hi. Ama in a tapa Isaac lep-ia in, maitam tunga singvum tungah a siel hi.","ref":"Jas 2:21"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abraham in a khut zahin a tapa that dingin naam a la hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ vantungmi in vantung panin ama hlan a, “Abraham, Abraham!” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Tanah om ing,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “Naupangpa tungah na khut nga sin. Ama bangma law sin. Azieh pen tu-in Pasien na giin lamtah ka thei ta hi, bangzieh ahei cile na tapa, na tapa khat na neisun kei adingin na it lo lam ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Abraham a khuodah leh hamphul lahah a ki-a awh tuutang khat a nua-ah na om hi. Abraham pei-in tua tuu man a, a tapa tangin meihal biehna-in a pie hi.","ref":"Heb 11:17-19"},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abraham in tua mun pen “ Topa in ei sih hi,” ci-in min vaw a, tuni dongin, “ Topa’ muol tungah ei kisih ding hi,” kici hi."},"15":{"text":"Van panin Topa’ vantungmi in Abraham a ni veina hlan a,"},"16":{"text":"“Nang in tam thu na bawl zo a, na tapa neisun it lo na hi ziehin, “Kei mama kang kiciem hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"“Nang thupha kang pie tahpi ding a, na suonlehlahte vana aasite le tuipi gei-a senel bangin tampi ka phasah ding hi.
