Nangma’ suonlehlahte in a galte uh’ tunkot a luo ding vua,","ref":"Heb 6:13-14; Heb 11:12"},"18":{"text":"ka thu na ngai ziehin na suon na hlahte ziehin leitung minam zosie in thupha a ngalaw ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 3:25"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin tangvalte kungah Abraham kinuale-in Beer-sheba ah a peiton uhi; tuale Beer-sheba ah Abraham a teng hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam teng zaw ciengin Abraham kungah, “En in, Milcah in zong na sanggamnu Nahor tawh tate nei hi:","title":"Nahor’ Suonlehlahte"},"21":{"text":"Uz a tapen, Buz a nau, Aram’ pa Kemuel,"},"22":{"text":"Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, le Bethuel-te ahi uhi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"23":{"text":"Bethuel pen Rebekah’ pa ahi hi. Milcah in Abraham’ sanggamnu Nahor tawh tapa giet nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua tham loin a meinu Reumah in Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, le Maacah-te a nei hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sarah kum za le sawmni le sagi sung a nungta hi; tam pen Sarah’ khankum ahi hi.","title":"Sarah’ Sina le A Kivuina"},"2":{"text":"Sarah pen Canaan leitang Kiriath-arba (tua pen Hebron) munah a si hi. Sarah ziehin Abraham da-in a kap hi"},"3":{"text":"A misi kung panin Abraham dingdawhin Hit-te kungah,"},"4":{"text":"“Kei pen note lahah ang teng khuolmi le pemta ka hi bo hi; ka muna panin ka misi ka vui thei nadingin a han ding mun khat ei pie un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 11:9, 13; Sawl 7:16"},"5":{"text":"Hit-te in Abraham kungah,"},"6":{"text":"“Ka pu aw, ko thu ei ngai in; kote lahah nang a thahat ulien na hi hi. Ka hante uh na deina penpen-ah na misi vui lel in; na misi vui nading han koima’n ang hlaw vawt sih ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Abraham dingin tua gammi ahi Hit-te lamah a kun hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Ka muna panin ka misi vui ding nei phal uleh ka thugen ei ngai unlen, Zohar’ tapa Ephron kungah"},"9":{"text":"ama’ neisa Machpelah leihawm ka tanh dinga ei pieh nadingin ei ngetpieh un; tua khu ama’ logei-a om ahi hi. Misi vui nading muna ka nei dingin a man ding cingtaha ka pieh dingin ama in na muna vuah kei tungah ei piesah un,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua laitahin Hit-te lahah Ephron a to hi. Hit mi Ephron in khuopi tunkota ang lut Hit-te zosie’ zah dingin Abraham dawng a,"},"11":{"text":"“Hi lo hi, ka pu aw, na ngai in; ka lo nang kang pie a, tua sunga om ka leihawm zong nang kang pie hi; ka mipite mai-ah nang kang pie hi; na misi vui lel in,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua gam mite’ mai-ah Abraham a kunsuh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tua gam mite’ zahin Ephron kungah, “Pha na saha ahile ka thugen ngai in! Lo man kang pie ding hi; khum sungah ka misi ka vui thei nadingin kei tung panin a man sang in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ephron in Abraham a dawngkia a,"},"15":{"text":"“Ka pu aw, ka thugen ngai in; leitang beh khat in ngun shekel zali man hi. Nang le kei kikalah tua pen bang hi lel ahei? Na misi kivui lel in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ephron tawh Abraham a thukim uhi; tuale Abraham in Ephron adingin Hit-te’ zaha a gensa, tua hun laitaha sumbawlte tena tawh kituohin ngun shekel zali a te hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Mamre nisuona lam Machpelah-a om Ephron’ lo, a sunga om a lo le leihawm tawh, tua mun zosie-a om lo sunga singkung zosie, le lo gam kimvela a po singkung zosie tawh,"},"18":{"text":"Hit-te mai le a khuopi tunkota ang lut mi zosie’ mai-ah a tanh dingin Abraham tungah kipie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin Canaan gama om Mamre (tua pen Hebron) lam a kinga ahi Machpelah lolai-a leihawm sungah Abraham in a zi Sarah a vui hi."},"20":{"text":"Lo le a sunga leihawm pen Hit-te tung panin si vuina zah dingin Abraham tungah kipie hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Abraham vuoi-in a kum a tam mama ta hi; tuale Topa in sil bangkimah Abraham thupha a pie hi.","title":"Isaac le Rebekah Kinunna"},"2":{"text":"Abraham in a neisa zosie tunga vaihawm, a inn sunga a tapen a nasempa kungah, “Ka phei kawmah na khut hing koi in."},"3":{"text":"Van le lei Pasien, Topa tawh kang kiciemsah ding a, ka tenpi Canaan-te’ tanute lahah ka tapa’ zi ding na la sih ding a,"},"4":{"text":"ka pienna gama ka tanaute kungah pei-in ka tapa Isaac’ zi ding na va la zaw ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"A nasempa in a kungah, “Numei nu in tam gamah ei zui nuom kha lo ding hi. Tuale na pienna gamah na tapa ka peipikia diei mah?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Abraham in ama kungah, “Khum munah ka tapa na son peipikia vawt lo ding thu thei siem in."},"7":{"text":"Ka pa’ inn pan le ka pienna gam panin kei ei ladawhin, ‘Na suonlehlahte tungah tam gam kang pie ding hi,’ ci-in ei hopi-in kei tunga ang kiciem Topa vantung Pasien in na mai-ah ama’ vantung mite hing sawlin nang in ka tapa’ zi ding khat na la ding hi"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin numei in ang zui nuom vawt sih leh, tami ka kiciemna panin nang na peng ding hi. Khum gamah ka tapa na peipi vawt sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu Abraham’ phei kawmah a nasempa in a khut koi-in tam thu tawh kisai-in ama kungah a kiciem hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin nasempa in a pupa’ kalaoh sawm kai a, ama kung panin a deitel letsong namkim la-in a pei hi; tuale ama dingin Aram-naharaim gam Nahor khuopi-ah a pei hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in Khuopi pulam tuikhuh gei-ah kalaohte a bawhsah hi; tua hun pen nitah lam hi a, numeite tui tawi dinga a pusuo hun tah ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka pu Abraham Pasien Topa aw, tuni-in lawcinna ei pie inlen, ka pupa Abraham tungah itna kip hing lah in."},"13":{"text":"Tuikhuh gei tam sungah kei ka ding a, khuopi ngahnute tui tawi dingin ang kuon uhi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in, ‘Tui ka dawn thei nadingin na tuibeel hing ngasuh in,’ ka ci ciengin, ‘Dawn inlen na kalaohte zong tui hing dawnsah vang,’ ei ci penpen nu khu na nasempa Isaac dinga na sesa numei hing hisah ta’n. Tami tawh ka pupa tungah itna kip na lah lam ka thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"A thugen a man masangin Abraham sanggampa Nahor in a zi Milcah tawh a nei a tapa Bethuel’ tanu Rebekah in a liengko tungah tuibeel puo-in a pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama ngaibaang mama a, koima tawh a lumton ngai nai lo ngahnu bih khat ahi hi. Tuikhuh ah tua nu kumsuhin a tuibeel dimin a peito hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama dawntuo dingin nasempa tai pai a, “Hepina tawh na beel sung panin tui themkhat ei dawnsah in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Ka pu aw, dawn in,” a ci a, a khut tungah a beel ngiemsuhsahin a dawnsah hi."},"19":{"text":"A dawn ding tui a pieh zaw ciengin tua nu in, “Na kalaohte in zong a kham masangun a dawn ding uh tui va tawi ta vang,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in ganhing tuipiehna kuong sungah tui nawsunin a beel guohsahin tui tawi dingin tuikhuhah taikia-in a kalaoh zosie adingin tui a tawi hi."},"21":{"text":"Mipa in a khuolzinna Topa in a lawcingsah zo ta amah, a lawcingsah sih ahei ci a thei nadingin sip dide-in tua nu a kaihlit khinkhian hi."},"22":{"text":"Kalaohte in tui a dawn zaw uh ciengin, mipa in tua nu adingin shekel lang a gih kham nahba khat, le a khuta a but ding shekel sawm a gih kham taucien ni la-in pie a,"},"23":{"text":"tuale ama in, “Nang koi’ tanu na hiei, ei gen in. Na pa’ inn ah ka zangie nading uh ko adingin innkhan a om diei?” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua nu in ama kungah, “Milcah in Nahor tawh a nei a tapa Bethuel’ tanu ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Butu le gan an ding tampi le gie nading mun zong ka nei uhi,” cibe lai hi."},"26":{"text":"Mipa lu kunin Topa bie a,"},"27":{"text":"ama in, “Ka pupa tunga a itna kip le a muonhuoina a taisan lo ka pupa Abraham’ Pasien, Topa in thupha nga taheh. Kei ka hileh ka pupa’ sanggamte inn zotna lampi-ah ama in ei peipi zo hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua numei tai-in tam thu teng a nu’ innkuonpite kungah a gen hi."},"29":{"text":"Rebekah in sanggam pasal khat nei a, a min Laban ahi hi; Laban zong tuikhuha mipa kungah a tai pai hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in nahba le a nau nu’ khuta tauciente mu a, “Mipa in tam bangin ang gen hi,” ci-in a sanggamnu Rebekah’ thugen a zah behin mipa kungah ama a peipai hi; tuale tuikhuh-a kalaohte gei-ah ama na ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Hing tum in, Topa’ thupha piehpa aw, bang dingin a pulamah ding den na hei? Inn ka puo zo ta a, kalaohte adingin mun a om hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n inn sungah mipa a lut hi; tuale Laban in kalaoh vante suo-in kalaohte neh ding butu le ganhingte an pie a, ama’ keng le a zawpite’ keng sil nading tui zong a pie hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mai-ah neh ding an kilui hi; ahi vangin ama in, “Ka thu ka genzaw masangin an ka ne sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Hing gen in,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in, “Kei, Abraham’ nasempa ka hi hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa in nahpi tahin ka pupa thupha pie a, ama mihau khat ahi ta hi; Pasien in ama tungah tuuhon, bawnghon, ngun le kham, sila pasal le sila numei, kalaohte le laate tampi pie zo hi."},"36":{"text":"Ka pu’ zi Sarah in a vuoi nua-in ka pupa tawh tapa khat nei hi; ama in a neisa zosie ama a pie hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka pupa in ei kiciemsah a, ‘A gam vua ka tenna Canaan-te’ tanute ka tapa’ zi dingin na la sih ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka pa’ innkuon, ka tanaute kungah pei-in ka tapa ading zi khat na la ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Keima in ka pupa kungah, “A numei in ei zui nuom lo kha thei ding hi,’ ka ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in keima kungah, ‘A thu ka man Topa in nang tawh a vantungmi sawlin na peina-ah ang lawcingsah na ding hi. Nang in ka tanaute le ka pa’ innsung panin ka tapa adingin zi khat na la ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Ka tanaute kunga na pei leh ka kiciemna pan na peng ding hi; amate in tua nu nang pie vateh sih nan uleh ka kiciemna panin na peng veve ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"42":{"text":"“Tuni-in tuikhuh ah pei-in, ‘Ka pupa Abraham Pasien, Topa aw, tu-a ka peina lampi-ah ei lawcingsah in!"},"43":{"text":"Tuikhuh gei tam sungah keima ka ding hi; tui tawi dinga ang pei ngahnu nu kungah, “Ka dawn dingin na tuibeel sunga tui themkhat ei saw in, kang thum hi,” ka ci ding a,"},"44":{"text":"tuale ka kungah, “Kidawn in, na kalaohte ading zong nang sawpieh vang,” ei ci nu khu ka pupa’ tapa dinga Topa in a sesa numei hing hisah in,’ ka ci hi."},"45":{"text":"“Ka lungsim sunga ka thunget a man masangin a liengko tungah a tuibeel puosa-in Rebekah ang pusuoh hi; tuikhuh ah ama peisuhin tui a tawi hi. Tuale ama kungah, ‘Tui ei dawnsah in,’ ka ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua nu in a liengko tunga om tuibeel ang khiesuh pai a, ‘Dawn aw, na kalaohte zong tui hing pie vang,’ ei ci pai hi. Tuaci’n ka dawn a, ama in kalaohte zong tui a pie hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua zaw cieng in tua nu kungah, ‘Nang koi tanu na hiei?’ ci-in ka dong hi. Tua nu in, ‘Nahor in Milcah tawh a nei a tapa Bethuel’ tanu ka hi hi,’ ei ci hi. Tuaci’n a nahkuo-ah nahba ka basah a, a khutah taucien ka bunsah hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin lukunin Topa ka bie a, a tapa ading ka pupa sanggampa’ tanu ka nga nadingin lampi mana keima ei pui ka pupa Abraham’ Pasien, Topa ka phat hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin tu-in ka kiziet hei ding le ka kivei hei ding ka thei nadingin ka pupa tungah muonhuoi tah le a mantahin na gamtat ding uleh ei gen un; na gamtat sih ding uleh zong ei gen un,” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciengin Laban le Bethuel in dawng a, “Tam thu Topa kung pana ang pei ahi hi. Nang kungah a sie ahi a, a pha ahi zongin kang gen thei sih uhi."},"51":{"text":"En in, na mai-ah Rebekah om hi. Ama la-in pei unlen, Topa in ang gensa bangin ama na pu tapa’ zi hisah in,” a ci uhi."},"52":{"text":"Abraham’ nasempa in tam thu a zah ciengin Topa mai leilahah a kunsuh hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuale nasempa in ngun le kham kizepnate le puonte lakhie-in amate tungah Rebekah a pie hi; ama in a naupa le a nu zong a manham kizepnate a pie hi."},"54":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama le a zawpite in an ne tui dawnin a om vua, khumnah a zan gie uhi. Zingmawng a thaw ciengun ama in, “Ka pupa kungah ei peisahkia ta un,” a ci hi."},"55":{"text":"A sanggampa le a nu in, “A tawmpen ni sawm sung beh khat ko tawh ngahnu nu hing omsah lai un; tua ciengin hing peisah na va ung,” a ci uhi."},"56":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “ Topa in ka khuolzinna ei lawcingsah zo ta ahi ziehin, ei kihehsah nawn da un; ka pupa kung zuonkia dingin ei peisah ta un,” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Amate in, “Ngahnu nu hlanin ama dong vai,” a ci uhi."},"58":{"text":"Tuale Rebekah a hlan vua, “Tampa na zui pai ta diei mah?” a ci uhi. Ama in, “Zui vang,” ci pai lien hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in zong a sanggamnu uh Rebekah le a cing nu, Abraham’ nasempa le a mite tawh a peisah uhi."},"60":{"text":"Tuale amate in Rebekah thupha pie-in ama tungah, “Kote’ sanggamnu aw, a tul tampite’ nu hi ta’n len; na suonlehlahte in a galte uh’ tunkotte luo ta uheh!” a ci uhi."},"61":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rebekah le a nasem numeite a ding dawh vua, kalaohte tungah tuongin mipa a zui uhi; tua bangin nasempa in Rebekah zawpi-in a lampi-ah a pei hi."},"62":{"text":"Tu-in Beer-lahai-roi panin Isaac pei-in Negeb gamah a teng hi."},"63":{"text":"Nitah lamin gamlaha pei dingin Isaac a pusuoh hi; a khuodah leh ama in kalaoh ang peite a mu hi."},"64":{"text":"Tuale Rebekah khuodahin Isaac a mu ciengin a kalaoh tung panin naw kumsuh a,"},"65":{"text":"a nasempa kungah, “Khum gamlaha eite ei dawn dinga ang pei pa koi ahiei?” a ci hi. Nasempa in, “Ka pupa ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a maituom la-in a kikhu hi."},"66":{"text":"Tuale a nasempa in Isaac kungah a sepnasa zosie a gen hi."},"67":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaac in a nu Sarah’ puonbuh sungah tua nu a tumpi hi. Ama in Rebekah la-in ama pen a zi a suoh hi. Ama in tua nu a it hi. Tuaci’n a nu si zaw ciengin Isaac a hlamuong hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham in zi dang khat la a, a min Keturah ahi hi.","title":"Abraham in Keturah Kinunpi (1Khg 1:32-33)"},"2":{"text":"Tua nu in ama tawh Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, le Shuah nei hi"},"3":{"text":"Jokshan pen Sheba le Dedan’ pa ahi hi. Dedan tate pen Asshurim, Lethusim, le Leummim ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Midian’ tate pen Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, le Eldaah ahi hi. Tam teng zosie, Keturah’ suonlehlahte ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Abraham in a neisa zosie Isaac tungah a pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin a zi dang tawh a nei a tate zong ama dam sungin letsongte pie a, a tapa Isaac kung panin nisuona lam manaw-in nisuona gamah amate a sawlmang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tam pen Abraham khankum ahi a, kum za le kum sawmsagi le nga ahi hi.","title":"Abraham’ Sina"},"8":{"text":"Abraham in a nukhia pen a hu sang a, a vuoi, kum tampi a pha, a khanghamin si a, a mite tawh kigawm hi."},"9":{"text":"A tapa Isaac le Ishmael in Mamre nisuona lam Hit mi Zohar’ tapa Ephron’ logam Machpelah leihawm sungah ama a vui vua,"},"10":{"text":"tua mun pen Abraham in Hit-te kung pana a lei ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 23:3-16"},"11":{"text":"Abraham si nua-in Pasien in a tapa Isaac thupha a pie hi. Tuale Beer-lahai-roi ah Isaac a teng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tam teng pen Abraham in Sarah’ sila numei, Egypt mi Hagar tawh a nei Abraham’ tapa Ishmael’ suonlehlahte ahi hi.","title":"Ishmael’ Suonlehlahte (1Khg 1:29-31)"},"13":{"text":"Tam teng pen a suona dungzui-in a kiminvaw Ishmael tate’ min ahi hi: A suoh masapen Nebaioth ahi hi; tuale Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,"},"14":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa,"},"15":{"text":"Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, le Kedemah ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tam teng pen Ishmael’ tate ahi vua, a khuo, a giephuol, le a be utawh kizui-in ulien sawm le nite ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"(Tam pen Ishmael’ khankum ahi a, kum za le kum sawmthum le sagi ahi hi; ama in a hu tawpna sangin si a, a mite tawh kigawm hi.)"},"18":{"text":"Amate, Havilah panin Assyria lam zotna Egypt tawh kigalsai Shur khuo-ah a teng uhi; ama’ mite zosie gei-ah ama a teng hi."},"19":{"text":"Tam teng pen Abraham tapa Isaac’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi: Abraham pen Isaac’ pa hi a,","title":"Esau le Jacob Suona le a Khangno Hun (Rom 9:10-12)"},"20":{"text":"Isaac kum sawmli a phahin Paddan-aram gama Aram mi Bethuel’ tanu Laban’ sanggamnu Rebekah tawh kinung hi."},"21":{"text":"Isaac in a zi adingin Topa kungah thu ngen hi, azieh pen ama in ta nei lo hi; Topa in a thungetna dawngin a zi Rebekah a gai hi."},"22":{"text":"A sunga nausen gel kibuonbuon uhi. Tuale ama in, “Tam bang ahi mawh leh bang dinga nungta bep ka diei?” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Topa dong dingin ama a pei hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Na gil sungah minam ni om a, na sunga pieng mihing nite a kikhen ding hi; khat pen a khat sangin hatzaw ding a, a uzaw in a nauzaw’ na sem ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 9:12"},"24":{"text":"A suo hun a tun ciengin a gil sungah takop a om hi."},"25":{"text":"A suoh masa pen a cisan sa-in suoh a, a pum tung zosie mul nei tawh kibang hi; tuaci’n amate in a min Esau phuo uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a khutin Esau’ ketul tu kawmin a sanggampa a suoh hi; tuaci’n ama pen a min Jacob kiphuo hi. Ama in tuate a nei hunin Isaac kum sawmguh a pha hi."},"27":{"text":"Naupangte a khangliet ciengun Esau pen gamsung mi sabeng siem khat hi a, Jacob pen mi kamtawm, puonbuh sunga teng mi ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Isaac in a samat a neh ziehin Esau a it hi; ahi vangin Rebekah in Jacob a it hi."},"29":{"text":"Khatvei Jacob in ancim a huon laitahin Esau a gamvana pan a gilkielsa-in a tung hi.","title":"Esau in A Innluoza Zua (Heb 12:16)"},"30":{"text":"Esau in Jacob kungah, “Ka gil nah kiel seng ahi ziehin tua na ancim san halkhat ei nesah in!” a ci hi. (Tua ahi ziehin ama’ min Edom kici hi.)"},"31":{"text":"Jacob in, “Na innluoza ei zua masa in,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Esau in, “A si ding ka hi ta hi; innluoza banga ka man ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Jacob in, “Amasa-in ka mai-ah hing kiciem in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a kungah ama kiciem a, Jacob kungah a innluoza a zua hi.","ref":"Heb 12:16"},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in Esau an le beme pie a, ama in ne-in dawn a, tuale dingin a lampi-ah a pei hi. Hi ci bangin Esau in a innluoza a simmaw bawl hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham hun lai-a kielpi masa banah tu-in gam sungah kielpi khat a tung hi. Gerar ah Philistia Kumpipa Abimelech kungah Isaac a haw hi.","title":"Isaac le Abimelech"},"2":{"text":"Isaac kungah Topa kilahin, “Egypt gamah peisuh sin; nang kang lah ding gamah teng in."},"3":{"text":"Tam gamah pemta bangin teng inlen, nang hing ompi-in thupha kang pie ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile nang le na suonlehlahte tungah tam gam kang pie ding a, na pa Abraham tunga ka ciemsa kiciemna ka tungsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na suonlehlahte vana aasi bangin tampi ka phasah ding a, na suonlehlahte tungah tam gam teng zosie ka pie ding hi; na suonlehlahte ziehin leitung minam zosie in thupha a ngalaw ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 22:16-18"},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Abraham in ka thumangin ka sawlna, ka thupiehnate, ka thukipte le ka thukhamte a zui hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gerar ah Isaac a teng hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum muna mite in a zi vai a dawh uh ciengin ama in, “Ama ka sanggamnu ahi hi,” a ci hi. Azieh pen, “Rebekah pen ngaibaangin tua gam mite in ama ziehin ei that kha va uh,” ci-in ngaisun ahi ziehin, “Ka zi ahi hi,” a ci ngam sih hi.","ref":"Pien 12:13; 20:2"},"8":{"text":"Khum munah Isaac sawtveipi a op zaw ciengin Philistia Kumpi Abimelech in a tawlet pan a khuodah leh Isaac in a zi Rebekah a no laitah a mu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abimelech in Isaac hlanin, “Na zi tahtah hi mawh lo amah! Tuale bang dinga, ‘Ka sanggamnu hi,’ na ci ahei?” a ci hi. Isaac in ama kungah, “Ama ziehin silaw kha vang ci-a ka ngaisut zieh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Abimelech in, “Ko tunga nang bawl tami khu bang ahiei? Mite khatpo na zi tawh na lumton thei mai ding a, tua hile ko tunga khielna ei tun na hi ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abimelech in mi zosie galgih a, “Tampa ahi a, a zinu ahi zongin a khoi kha poma kithat ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Isaac in tua leitangah khai tu a, tua kum ma-in a za zakhat a la hi. Topa in thupha pie a"},"13":{"text":"tua pa mihau khat a suoh hi; mihau mama khat a suo dongin a nei a lam a kibelap semsem hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in tuuhon, bawnghon, le innkuon tampi nei a, Philistia-te in ama a eng uhi."},"15":{"text":"(A pa Abraham hun lai-a a pa’ nasemte in a na taw uh tuikhuh zosie tu-in Philistia-te in lei vua-in a khacip sieng uhi.)"},"16":{"text":"Abimelech in Isaac kungah, “Ko kung panin pei ta un; nang pen ko adingin vang lien ta luo teh,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum mun panin Isaac pei-in Gerar kuom sungah phuol satin khum sungah a teng hi."},"18":{"text":"Isaac in a pa Abraham’ hun lai-a kitosa tuikhuhte a topha kia hi; azieh pen Abraham a si zaw ciengin Philistia-te in tuate a khacip sieng uhi; tuale ama in a pa na phuosa minte ma a phuokia hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Isaac’ nasemte in tua kuom sungah tuikhuh to-in tuisam luonna khat a mu vua,"},"20":{"text":"Gerar gancingte le Isaac’ gancingte kihau-in “Tuikhuh ko-a’ hi bo,” a kici uhi. Tuaci’n ama in tua tuikhuh Esek ci-in min phuo hi. Azieh pen amate le Isaac kisel hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuikhuh adang khat a tokia vua, tua vai-ah zong a kihaukia leuleu uhi; tuaci’n ama in tua tuikhuh’ min Sitnah ahisah hi."},"22":{"text":"Khum mun panin ama kituonin tuikhuh adang khat to a, tua vai-ah a kihau nawn sih uhi. Tuaci’n ama in tua tuikhuh’ min Rehoboth hisah a, “Tu-in Topa in eite adingin mun ei bawlpieh zo a, tam gamah i pung ding uhi” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Khum mun panin Beer-sheba ah ama peito hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale khum ni zan ma-in ama kungah Topa kilah a, “Keima na pa Abraham’ Pasien ka hi hi; zau sin, azieh pen ka nasempa Abraham ziehin nang kang ompi a, nang thupha hing pie-in na suonlehlahte tampitah kang phasah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in khum munah maitam khat lamin Topa bie a, khum mun ma-ah a puonbuh a sung hi. Khum munah Isaac’ nasemte in tuikhuh khat a to uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gerar panin a thudawhpi pa Ahuzzath le a galkapmangpa Phicol tawh ama kungah Abimelech haw hi.","ref":"Pien 21:22"},"27":{"text":"Isaac in a kung vuah, “Note in kei ei muda-in na kung pan vua nei nawmang uh hi napi-in bang dingin kei kunga hing haw na hi uh ahei? “ a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in, “ Topa in nang ang ompi lam cien tahin ka mu zo ta uhi. Tuaci’n nang le ko kikalah kiciemna khat om leh ka ci vua, tuale nang tawh thuciemna khat bawl vai-in,"},"29":{"text":"tuaci’n kote in nang hing sukha vawt loin na tungah sil hoi bawl ding ci simlo note bangma hing law lo a, lungnuom taha kang peisah tehteh bangin, nang in zong kote tungah sietna nang bawl sih ding hi. Tu-in nang pen Topa’ thupha pieh na hi hi,” a ci uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate adingin pawi khat bawlpiehin an ne tui dawnin a om uhi."},"31":{"text":"Zingmawngin amate thobai-in khatlekhat kiciemna a bawl uhi; Isaac in a lampi vuah amate hla a, ama kung panin lungnuomin a pei uhi."},"32":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in Isaac’ nasemte pei-in a tawsa uh tuikhuh tawh kisai-in ama kungah a gen vua, “Tui ka mu ta uhi!” a ci uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in tua pen a min Shibah phuo hi; tua ziehin tuni dongin tua khuopi’ min Beer-sheba kici hi."},"34":{"text":"Esau kum sawmli a phah ciengin Hit mi Beeri’ tanu Judith le Hit mi Elon’ tanu Basemath a zi-in a la hi;","title":"Esau’ Zi Hit-te"},"35":{"text":"ama gel in Isaac le Rebekah’ hinkhuo gentheisah mama uhi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Isaac vuoi-in a mit mangin khuo a mu thei nawn lo ciengin ama in a tapa tapen Esau hlan a, ama kungah, “Ka tapa aw,” a ci hi; ama in dawng a, “Kei tanah om ing,” a ci hi.”","title":"Isaac in Jacob Thupha Pie"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “En in, kei ka vuoi ta hi; ka si ding hun ka thei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ziehin tu-in na hiemte ahi na thallawngte le na thal la inlen, gamlahah pei-in kei adingin sa va beng ta’n."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka si masangin thupha kang pieh thei nadingin ka du danin an tui mama hing huon inlen, ka neh dingin ka kungah hing peipi in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Isaac in a tapa Esau a hopi laitahin Rebekah in na ngaidap hi. Tuaci’n Essau in a pa a puoh ding sa beng a gam a kuon ciengin,"},"6":{"text":"Rebekah in a tapa Jacob kungah, “Na sanggampa Esau kungah na pa thugen ka za a,"},"7":{"text":"‘Ka si masangin Topa mai-ah thupha kang pieh thei nadingin ka kungah gamsa ei puoh inlen, ka neh dingin an tui mama hing bawl in,’ a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in ka tapa aw, kang sawl bangin ei mang in."},"9":{"text":"Na pa du danin antui ka bawl thei nadingin keelhon lahah va pei inlen keelno a hoi ni hing peipi in."},"10":{"text":"A si masangin thupha ang pieh thei nadingin na pa neh dingin ama kungah tuate na puoh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jacob in a nu Rebekah kungah, “En in, ka sanggampa Esau a mulpha ahi a, kei pen a cinel ka hi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka pa in kei ei tham kha thei ding a, koi thupha nga tah sangin ama simmaw tawh ka kibang ding a, kei le kei samsiet kitun ka suohzaw thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"A nu in ama kungah, “Ka tapa aw, keima tungah nang ang kisamsietna tu taheh; ka thu ei mang tapo inlen, va pei-in ka kungah keelnote ei puoh in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama pei-in tuate manin a nu kungah a peipi hi; tuale a nu in a pa dei danin an tui mama a bawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rebekah in a inn-a a kep, a tapa uzaw Esau’ puonhoi pente la-in a tapa nauzaw Jacob a silsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale ama in a khut tung le a cinelna mun a ngawng tengah keelnote’ vun a silsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama nu in a bawlsa antuite le anlumte a tapa Jacob a pie hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pa kungah ama pei a, “Ka pa aw,” a ci hi; tuale ama in, “Tanah om ing; nang koi na hei, ka tapa aw?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Jacob in a pa kungah, “Keima na tapa tapen Esau ka hi hi. Nei gen bangin ka bawl zo ta hi; tu-in to inlen kei thupha nei pieh thei nadingin ka sa matsa ne in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Isaac in a tapa kungah, “Ka tapa aw, bangci a nang hici mat zuai thei ahiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “ Topa na Pasien in kei ei lawcinsah zieh ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaac in Jacob kungah, “Ka tapa aw, ka ta Esau tahtah na hi amah, awle na hi sih ahei ci kang thei nadingin kang tham thei nadingin ka kung ei nai vawi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pa kungah Jacob peito-in ama a tham a, tuale ama in, “A aw lah Jacob’ aw a bang a, ahi vangin a khut lah Esau’ khut a bang vanuh in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"A sanggampa Esau’ khut bangin a khutte a mul a phat ziehin ama in a khencien thei sih hi; tuaci’n ama thupha a pie hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in, “Nang ka tapa Esau tahtah na hiei mah? a ci hi. Ama in, “Hi ma ing,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Keima in na sa matsa ne-in thupha kang pieh thei nadingin ka kungah hing peipi in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a kungah a peipi a, ama in a ne hi; tuale ama in lenggazu zong ama kungah peipi-in ama in a dawn hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa Isaac in ama kungah, “Ka kung hing nai inlen ei nam in, ka tapa aw,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in nai phei-in ama a nam hi; tuale ama in a puon gim dihin ama thupha pie a, “Ah, ka tapa gimnam khu Topa’ thupha a piehsa gamlah gimnam tawh kibang hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien in na tungah van daitui, leitang hoi le an le lenggazu a kiningcingin hing pie taheh."},"29":{"text":"Mite in na na semin, na mai-ah minamte kun uheh. Na sangamte tungah a topa hi inlen, na mai-ah na nu’ tapate kun uheh. Nang ang samsie poma samsiet hi hinlen, nang thupha ang pie poma thupha nga hi taheh!” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 11:20; Pien 12:3"},"30":{"text":"Isaac in Jacob thupha a pieh zaw, a pa Isaac kung panin Jacob a pei zaw diemin a gamvana panin Esau a tung hi.","title":"Esau’ Taan Thupha (Heb 12:17)"},"31":{"text":"Ama in zong an tuituoh huonin a pa kungah a peipi hi. Ama in a pa kungah, “Kei thupha nei pieh thei nadingin ka pa thoto inlen na tapa’ sa matsa ne in,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"A pa Isaac in ama kungah, “Nang koi na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Kei na tapa tapen Esau ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua bepin Isaac nahpitahin ling a, “Tua ahile ka kunga a gamsa matsa ei puohpa koi hi mawh ahei? Nang hing pei masangin tua teng a unpi-in ka ne zo a, ama thupha ka pie zo ta hi. Hi hi, ama thupha nga ding ahi mawh ta khula!” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Esau in a pa thugen a zah bepin nahpitah le nasie tahin kapin a pa kungah, “Kei thupha ei pie bo ven, kei zong, izaw ka pa!” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “Na naupa zuouthu tawh ang pei-in na thupha la siengzo hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Esau in, “Ama’ min Jacob a kivaw khu man ngel hi lo amah? Azieh pen ama in ni vei ei sol zo hi. Ama in ka innluoza ei lahpieh hi; tuale en in, tu-in ka thupha ei lahpieh leuleu hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Kei adingin thupha khat beh na hen ta sih amah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 25:29-34"},"37":{"text":"Isaac in Esau dawng a, “Ama pen na topa dingin ka bawl zo ta hi. A na sem dingin a sanggam zosie ka pie zo a, an le lenggazu tawh ama ka va zo hi. Tua ahi ciengin nang adingin bang kang bawlpieh thei nawn ding ahei, ka tapa aw?” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Esau in a pa kungah, “Ka pa aw, thupha khat beh na nei ta sih amah? Kei thupa ei pie in, kei zong, ka pa aw!” a ci hi. Tuale Esau nahpitahin kap hi.","ref":"Heb 12:17"},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa Isaac in a dawng hi: En in, na tenna mun khu leitang hoi panin a kigamla ding a, van daitui tawh zong a kigamla ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Na namsau tawh na nungta ding a, nang in na sanggampa’ na na sem ding hi. Hizongle ama na ledo ciengin, na ngawng panin a hahkol na kuoitan ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 11:20; Pien 36:8; 2Kum 8:20"},"41":{"text":"A pa in Jacob thupha a pieh zo tah ziehin tu-in Esau in Jacob muda a, tuale Esau in, “Ka pa ading kaa le mau hun ang nai ta hi; tua ciengin ka naupa Jacob ka that ding hi,” ci-in ama le ama a kiho hi.","title":"Esau’ Thangpaina Panin Jacob Suohta"},"42":{"text":"Hizongle Rebekah kungah a tapa tapen ahi Esau’ thugen teng kigen hi; tuaci’n ama in a tapa nauzaw Jacob hlansahin ama kungah, “Na upa Esau in nang hing tha sawmin ama le ama kihenem hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka tapa aw, tu-in ka thu ei mang in; Haran-a ka naupa Laban kungah mallangtahin va tai-in,"},"44":{"text":"na tunga na sanggampa thangpaina a ven masangsie ama tawh bakhat sung va omton inlen,"},"45":{"text":"na sanggampa a thangpaina ang ven a, a tunga na bawlna teng a mangngil zaw dong cieng va om ta’n. Tua ciengin mi sawlin khum mun panin kang lasah ding hi. Nikhat thu-in na nipi gelin bang dingin hing tan ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rebekah in Isaac kungah, “Hit numeite ziehin ka hinkhuo ka cimtah ta hi. Jacob in tam gama numeite lah panin tam bang Hit numeite hing kinunpi mawh leh kei adingin ka hinkhuo bang matlap om ding ahei,” a ci hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaac in Jacob hlanin ama thupha pie a, tuale thuhilin, “Canaan numeite tawh na kinung sih ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Paddanaram-a na nu’ pa Bethuel’ inn ah thakhatin pei in; khum muna na nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tanute khat zi-in va la ta’n."},"3":{"text":"Mi honpi khat na suo thei nadingin Vanglien Pasien in nang thupha hing pie hinlen, hing ciphasahin tampi hing phasah taheh."},"4":{"text":"Pasien in Abraham a piehsa, tu-in pemta banga na tenna leitang na nei thei nadingin ama in Abraham’ thupha nangma le na suonlehlahte tungah hing pie taheh,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 17:4-8"},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin Isaac in Jacob a peisah hi; tuale Jacob le Esau’ nu Rebekah’ sanggampa Aram mi Bethuel’ tapa Laban opna Paddanaram-ah ama a pei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Isaac in Jacob thupha pie zo a, khum tah panin Paddanaram-ah zi la dinga a sawl lam le thupha a piehin, “Canaan numeite na tenpi sih ding hi,” ci-in ama thuhil a,","title":"Esau in Ishmael’ Tanu Kinunpi"},"7":{"text":"Jacob in nu le pa thu mangin Paddanaram ah a pei zo lam Esau in a thei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Canaan numeite in a pa Isaac a lungkimsah lo lam uh zong Esau in a thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Ishmael kungah Esau pei a, a neisa a zite banah Abraham’ tapa Ishmael’ tanu, Nebaioth’ sanggamnu Mahalath a zi-in a la hi."},"10":{"text":"Jacob in Beer-sheba khuo nuasie-in Haran lam zuonin a pei hi.","title":"Bethel Muna Jacob’ Mangmat"},"11":{"text":"Mun khatah ama tung a, ni tumzo ahi ziehin tuanah a zan gie hi. Tua munah suongtum khat la a, tangkhamin nei-in a lum hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in mang man a, tua a mangin leitungah kalei khat kidaw-in a dawn in van holto hi; tua kalei tungah Pasien’ vantung mite kato kumsuhin a om uhi.","ref":"Jhn 1:51"},"13":{"text":"A gei-ah Topa ding a, “Kei pen na pu Abraham’ Pasien le Isaac’ Pasien, Topa ka hi hi; nang le na suonlehlahte tungah a tunga na lupna leitang kang pie ding hi;","ref":"Pien 13:14-15"},"14":{"text":"na suonlehlahte lei-a leivui za-in a tam ding vua, nitumna lam, nisuona lam, leilu lam le leitaw lamah na kizel ding uhi; nang le na suonlehlahte tungtawnin leitung minam zosie in thupha ngalaw ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 12:3; 22:18"},"15":{"text":"Nang hing ompi-in na peina po-ah kang cing ding a, tam gamah kang peipikia ding hi, ci thei in; bangzieh ahei cile na tunga kang ciemsa thute ka bawl sieng masangin nang kang nuasie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kimutna panin Jacob a khanglo a, “Tam munah Topa om tahtah a, ken lah ka thei kha vawt sih hi!” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale ama zau a, “Tami mun bangza taha zau huoi ahiei! Tami khu Pasien’ inn lo adang hi lo a, tami khu vantung lutna kotpi ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawngin Jacob thobai a, ama in a tangkham-a a zah suongtum la-in khuomin phut a, a tungah sathau a sungsuh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in khum mun a min Bethel a hisah hi; ahi vangin a masa-in khum khuopi’ min Luz ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in kiciemna khat bawlin, “Pasien in kei ei ompi a, tami ka peina lampi-ah ei kemin neh ding an le sil ding puonte ei pieh a,"},"21":{"text":"ka pa’ inn lumah lungmuong taha ka tunkia leh, Topa khu ka Pasien ahi ding a,"},"22":{"text":"khuoma ka phu tami suongtum zong Pasien’ inn ahi ding hi; kei nei pieh zosie tungah sesawm- suo-sekhat pel loin nangma kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in a khuolzin maban zom a, nisuona lam mite’ gam a tung hi.","title":"Jacob, Rachel tawh Kimu"},"2":{"text":"Ama a khawdah leh gamlahah tuikhuh khat le a gei-a a lum tuuhon thum a mu hi; azieh pen tua tuikhuh panin tuuhonte tui kipie hi. Tuikhuh vang tunga a om suong pen gol mama a,"},"3":{"text":"tuuhon zosie khum munah a kisuhtuo ciengun tuucingte in tuikhuh vang suong a liadawh vua, tuute tui pie-in tuikhuh vang tung ama opna ngai-ah tua suong a koikia zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Jacob in a kung vuah, “Ka sanggamte aw, hei pana hing pei na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Haran pana hing pei hi ung,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Nahor’ tapa Laban na thei kha vuoi mah?” a ci hi. Amate in”Thei ma ung,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Ama a dam beh nai mah?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Dam na,” ci-in a dawng vua, “A tanu Rachel zong a tuuhon tawh tamnah ang pei,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in, “En in, ni lah sang lai hi; gan hawi hun nai lo hi. Tuute tui pie unlen, pei-in an maisah lai un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in, “Tuuhon zosie ang kisuhtuo a, tuikhuh vang suong a kiliadawh masangin tuuhonte tui ka pie thei sih uhi; tua ciengin tuute tui ka pie thei beh uhi,” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate tawh a kiho laitahin Rachel a pa’ tuute a tung hi; azieh pen ama tuate cing ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in Jacob in a nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tanu Rachel le a nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tuute a mu ciengin peito-in tuikhuh vang panin suong lia a, a nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tuute tui a dawnsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in Rachel namin a kap vapo hi."},"12":{"text":"Jacob in Rachel kungah ama pen a pa’ tanau ahi lam le Rebekah’ tapa ahi lam a gen hi. Tuale ama tai-in a pa kungah a gen hi."},"13":{"text":"A sanggamnu’ tapa Jacob’ thu Laban in a zah ciengin ama dawn dingin a tai hi; ama kawipomin nam a, a inn ah a peipi hi. Jacob in tam thu zosie gen a,"},"14":{"text":"tuale Laban in ama kungah, “Nang pen ka gu ka tang le ka tel ka vo tahtah na hi khula!” a ci hi. Ama kungah hla khat sung a taam hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Laban in Jacob kungah, “Nang, keima’ tanau na hi ziehin bangma lemlaw nei loin ka na ei seppieh ding na hi amah?” Ei gen in, na thaman ding bang ahei?” a ci hi.","title":"Jacob, Laban’ Tanu tawh Kinung"},"16":{"text":"Tu-in Laban in tanu ni nei hi; a uzaw’ min Leah ahi a, a nauzaw’ min Rachel ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Leah pen a mit-ha nem a, Rachel pen ngaibaangin a mel hoi hi."},"18":{"text":"Jacob in Rachel ngai hi; tuaci’n ama in, “Na tanu a naunu kang thalawna-in kum sagi na na kang seppieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Laban in, “Midang tungah ama ka pieh sangin nang tungah kang pieh ding hoizaw hi; keima kungah hing om in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in Rachel a nga nadingin kum sagi sung na sem a, ama a itna ziehin ama adingin tua hunte ni tawmno khat tawh kibang hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in Laban kungah, “Ama tawh ka lupton thei nadingin ka zi ei pie in. Bangzieh ahei cile ka hun cing zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Laban in tua muna a om mi zosie khawmin pawi khat a bawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin nitah lamin ama in Jacob kungah a tanu Leah a zawpi hi; tuale ama in tua nu luppi hi."},"24":{"text":"(Laban in a tanu Leah tungah a nasem numei dingin ama’ numei nasem nu Zilpah a pie hi.)"},"25":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin Leah na hi mawh hi! Tuale Jacob in Laban kungah, “Kei bang bawla nei bawl ahiei? Rachel ka nga nadingin na na hing seppieh hi lo ka mah? Bang dinga nei sol ahei?” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Laban in, “ A unu kanin a naunu mo hlah pen ko gamah kizang lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tam nu adingin nipi kal khat sung mopawi mansah phot inlen, adang kum sagi ma ka na nei seppieh thamanin a khat pen zong kang pie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Jacob in a ci bangin semin tua nu’ mopawi hun a mansah phot hi. Tua ciengin Laban in a tanu Rachel a zi dingin a pie hi."},"29":{"text":"(Laban in a nasem numei Bilhah a tanu Rachel tungah a nasem numei dingin a pie hi.)"},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in Rachel zong luppi a, ama in Leah sangin Rachel a itzaw hi. Ama in adang kum sagi sung Laban’ na a seppieh hi."},"31":{"text":"Leah a ki-it lo lam Topa in a thei ciengin ama in a naubu a honpieh hi; ahi vangin Rachel a ciing hi."},"32":{"text":"Leah gai-in tapa khat nei-a, a min Reuben phuo hi; azieh pen ama in, “ Topa in ka gentheina ei mu zo hi. Tu-in ka pasal in kei ei it valon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama gaikia-in tapa khat nei a, tuale ama in, “ Topa in kei ei kimuda lam za zo ahi ziehin ama in tam tapa zong ei pie zo hi,” ci hi; tuale ama in a min Simeon a phuo hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama gai leuleu-in tapa khat nei a, “Tu-in ama tawh tapa thum nei zo ka hi ziehin ka pasal in kei ei pawl ta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ziehin ama’ min Levi phuo hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama gai leuleu-in tapa khat nei a, “Tam hunin Topa ka phat ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama in ama’ min Judah phuo hi. Tua ciengin a tathang ta hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rachel in Jacob tawh ta a nei lo lam a kimu bepin ama in a sanggamnu a eng hi; tuale ama in Jacob kungah, “Ta ei neisah in, tua ahi sih mawh leh kisi ta vang!” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Rachel tungah Jacob lungthah mama a, tuale ama in, “Na naubu a khahtan thei dingin Pasien’ muna om ka hi son amah?” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Ka nasem numei Bilhah tanah om hi; ama in ka phei tungah ta suohin ama ziehin ken zong ta ka nei thei nadingin ama luppi in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Jacob kungah a nasem numei Bilhah a zi dingin a pie hi; tuale Jacob in tua nu a luppi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bilhah gai-in Jacob tawh tapa khat nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rachel in, “Pasien in kei thu ei khen zo a, ama in ka aw zong za zo-in tapa khat ei pie zo hi,” a ci hi; tua ahi ziehin ama in a min Dan phuo hi."},"7":{"text":"Rachel’ nasem numei Bilhah gaikia-in Jacob tawh tapa a nina nei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rachel in, “Nahpitaha kibuonna tawh ka sanggamnu buonin ka zo ta hi,” a ci hi; tuaci’n ama in a min Naphtali phuo hi."},"9":{"text":"Leah in a tathang zo ahi lam a kithei ciengin ama in a nasem numei Zilpah la-in a zi dingin Jacob a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Leah’ nasem numei Zilpah in Jacob tawh tapa khat a nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale Leah in, “Kampha!” ci a, tuaci’n a min Gad phuo hi."},"12":{"text":"Leah’ nasem numei Zilpah in tapa a nina nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Leah in, “Lungdam sam ing e! Azieh pen numeite in kei mi lungdamnu ei ci ding uhi,” a ci hi; tuaci’n ama in a min Asher phuo hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangbu lah hun laitahin lolai-ah Reuben a vahkawi leh zawldei-ai kungte mu a, a nu Leah kungah tuate a puoh hi. Tua ciengin Rachel in Leah kungah, “Hepina tawh na tapa’ zawldei-ai themkhat ei pie vawi” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Leah in, “Ka pasal nei lahpieh thuneu na sa amah? Ka tapa’ zawldei-ai zong ei lahpieh lai ding na mah?” a ci hi. Rachel in, “Ahi leh na tapa’ zawldei-ai man dingin nang tawh tuzanin ama ang lumton thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Nitahin a lo panin Jacob vai a tun ciengin a dawn dingin pusuoh a, “Ka kunga nang lup kul ding hi. Azieh pen ka tapa’ zawldei-ai tawh nang kang thapsa ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n khum zanin ama tawh a lumton hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale Pasien in Leah’ ngetna ngai a, ama gai-in Jacob tawh tapa a ngana nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Leah in, “Ka pasal tungah ka nasem numei ka pieh ziehin Pasien in ka thaciel ei piezo ta hi,” a ci hi; tuaci’n a min Issachar phuo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale Leah gaikia a, Jacob tawh tapa a guhna nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Leah in, “Pasien in kei moken hoi khat ei pie zo hi. Tu-in ka pasal in kei ei patawi ding hi. Azieh pen ama tawh tapa guh ka nei ta hi,” a ci hi; tuaci’n ama in a min Zebulun phuo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tanu khat nei a, a min Dinah phuo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in Rachel phawh a, Pasien in ama’ thu ngai-in a naubu a honpieh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama gai-in tapa khat nei a, “Pasien in ka zalatna a lamang ta hi,” a ci hi;"},"24":{"text":"tuale ama in a min Joseph phuo a, “ Topa in tapa dang khat ei piehbe heh!” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Rachel in Joseph a nei zaw ciengin Jacob in Laban kungah, “Ka inn le ka gamah ka pei thei nadingin kei ei sawl in.","title":"Laban Ziehin Jacob Cithei"},"26":{"text":"Nang kunga ka thalawsa ka zite ka tate ei pie inlen ei peisah in, azieh pen na na kang seppieh lam na thei hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin Laban in ama kungah, “Tua banga thu nei gensah leh, ka aisanna tung panin nang vang tawh Topa in kei thupha ei piezo hi, ci ka thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Na thaman ding hing gen inlen kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Jacob in ama kungah, “Na na bang ka ci sep a, ka khut sungah na gante bang hing cipun ahei ci nang mama in na thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen kei ang tun masangin na gantate tawmno khat ahi a, tuate tampitahin a khang hi; tuale ka kiheina muncin tengah Topa in nang thupha ang pie hi. Ahi vangin tu-in ka innkuonpite ading zong bang cih ciengin vaihawm ta ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Nang bang kang pie diei?” a ci hi. Jacob in, “Bangma zamtawng ei pie sin; tami nei bawlpieh ding po leh na tuuhonte va-in kang cinpieh ding hi:"},"32":{"text":"Na tuuhon zosie lahah ei vahsah inlen, tuate lah panin tuu a puong zosie, a pawl zosie, tuuno a vom zosie, le keelte lah panin a pawl le a puong zosie ei pieh in; tua teng ka thaman hi taheh."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n mailam hunah ka thamante en dinga nang pei ciengin ka thumanna kei adingin teci ahi ding hi. Keel lahah a puong lo le a pawl lo poma le tuuno lahah a vom lo poma, kei kunga a kimu khah leh, guhin kisim pailien ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Laban in, “Hoi e! Na cisa bangin hi taheh,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin Laban in khum ni-in keeltang a dung pawl le a bem pawlte, keelpi a puong le a pawlte, a ci tunga themkhat a kang pawl tapo ladawhin a tapate a cingsah hi;"},"36":{"text":"tuale Jacob in Laban’ tuuhon a omlai teng a cin laitahin ama in ama le Jacob kikal nithum khuolzinna munah tua ganhonte peipi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in hieng sing, zuonmuot sing, le theiba panin a ba thate sat a, a hawte khe siengin a sunga a kangte a kidawhsah hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in tuipiehna kuong sunga gantate mai-ah a haw kikhesa singbate koi hi. Tam pen gantate tui dawn dinga a peina uh tuidawnna mun ahi hi. Tui dawn dinga amate a pei ciengun a kizangmat vua,"},"39":{"text":"tuale singbate mai-ah gantate kizangmatin, tuaci’n gantate in a dung pawl, a puong le a pawl tate a nei uhi."},"40":{"text":"Jacob in tuunote khenkhie a, tua gantate Laban’ gantate lahah a dungpawl le a vomcip teng lam a ngasah hi; tuale ama’ tan ding teng tuom koi-in Laban’ tuuhonte tawh koiton lo hi."},"41":{"text":"Ganta thahatte a zangmat hun sielin, singbate lahah a kizangmat thei nadingun Jacob in tuuhonte masanga gan tuipiehna kuong sungah singbate koi hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi vangin ganta zawngkhalte mai-ah tua singbate koi lo hi; tuaci’n ganta zawngkhal teng pen Laban-a’ suohin ganta thahat teng pen Jacob-a’ a suoh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ci bangin mipa nahpitahin hau a, ama in ganta honpi, sila numei, sila pasal, kalaohte le laa tampitah a nei hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Laban’ tapate in, “Jacob in i pa-a’ zosie la zo ta hi; ama in i pa tawh kisai tami hauna zosie nga zo hi,” a ci uh Jacob in a za hi.","title":"A Innkuon le a Ganhonte tawh Jacob Tai"},"2":{"text":"Laban in masanglai bangin maipha tawh ama a don nawn lona lam Jacob in mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Jacob kungah, “Na pu na pa le na tanaute’ gamah kilekia in, nang kang ompi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in mi sawlin a ganhon opna gamlahah Rachel le Leah hlansah a,"},"5":{"text":"a kung vuah, “Na pa un masanglai bangin maipha tawh kei ei don lo lam ka mu hi. Ahi vangin ka pa’ Pasien in kei ei ompi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka tha nei zosie tawh na pa uh’ na ka sep lam na thei uhi;"},"7":{"text":"ahi vangin na pa un kei ei solin ka thaman sawmvei khel a, hizongle kei ei bawlsiet ding Pasien in phal lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in, ‘A pawl teng na thaman ding hi heh,’ a ci leh ganhon zosie in ta a pawl ngentang a nei uhi. Tuale ama in, ‘A dung pawl teng na thaman hi heh,’ a ci leh ganhon zosie in ta a dungpawl a nei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam bangin Pasien in na pa’ ganhonte la-in kei ei pie hi."},"10":{"text":"“Ganhonte zangmat hunin ka khuodah leh keelpi tunga kikhap keeltang zosie a dungpawl, a bempawl, a puonga a opna khu ka mangin ka mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ vantungmi in ka mangin ka kungah, ’ Jacob,’ ei ci-a, tuale keima in, “Tanah om ing!’ ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Dahto inlen en in, keelpi tunga kikhap keeltang zosie dungpawl, bem pawlin puong uhi; bangzieh ahei cile na tunga Laban gamtat zosie ka mu zo ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei pen nang in khuom khat sathau nu-in kei tungah kiciemna nang bawlna mun Bethel Pasien ka hi hi. Tu-in tam gam nuasie pailien inlen na pienna gamah kilekia in,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 28:18-22"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rachel le Leah in ama dawngin, “I pa’ inn sungah ei dinga a kinuasie tanh le luo khat beh a om ei mah?"},"15":{"text":"Ama in ei gel pen gamdangmi banga ei ngaituo hi lo amah? Azieh pen ama in eite ei zua zo a, ei dinga ei kipie sum zang mang zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasien in i pa tung pana a lahpieh neisa zosie eite le i tate-a’ ahi hi; tua ahi ciengin tu-in Pasien in na kunga ang gen popo bawl in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob tho a, kalaoh tungah a tate le a zite a tuongsah hi;"},"18":{"text":"tuale ama in a ganhon zosie, a nei a lam zosie, Paddanaram gam sunga a nei a ganhon zosie hawi-in a pa Isaac’ tenna Canaan gam zuonin a pei hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuumul heu dingin Laban a kuon laitahin Rachel in a pa’ innsung pasien-te na gu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Jacob in a tai sawm lam ama kungah gen loin Aram mi Laban sol hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n a neisa vannuoi tawh ama tai hi. Ama in a kipatna-ah Euphrates gun kanin Gilead gam muoltung lam a manaw hi."},"22":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Jacob a tai lam Laban kungah kigen hi.","title":"Laban in Jacob Nuaphah"},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a sanggamte zawpi-in ama a phah masangsie Gilead muoltung gamah ni sagi sung a del hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Aram mi Laban kungah zanlai a mangin Pasien pei-in ama kungah, “Jacob kungah thupha ahi a, thusie ahi zongin kamteng khat zong na gen lo nadingin kidawm in,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Laban in Jacob a nuaphah hi. Tu-in Jacob in Gilead muoltung gamah a puonbuh na lam a, Laban in Gilead muoltung gamah a sanggamte tawh giephuol a sat uhi."},"26":{"text":"Laban in Jacob kungah, “Na bawl bang ahei? Kei nei sol a, ka tanute zong namsau lahsanin galmat bangin na peipi zo ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang dingin kei ei solin bangma ei gen loin na daptai mawh na hei? Tawm le lyre tumin guolnopna late tawh hing hla buong sam ding hi veng maw."},"28":{"text":"Tuale bang dingin ka tanute le ka tapate tawh mangpha pai-in ei kitawpsah beh lo na hei? Na mot gamtat mama hi."},"29":{"text":"Nang bawlsietna khop ding thu ka nei hi; ahi vangin zani zanin na pa’ Pasien in ei hopi a, ‘Jacob kungah thupha ahi a, thusie ahi zongin kamteng khat zong na gen lo nadingin kidawm in,’ ei ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Na pa’ inn na ngai seng zieha a pei ding hi nan lacin bang dinga ka pasien-te na guh mawh ahei?” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Jacob in Laban dawng a, “Ka kung panin pauhat thu tawh na tanute nang kaidawh khah ding ka zau zieh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanle na pasien-te na muna penpen koikoi hitaleh kihinkhawi lo ding hi. I sanggamte muna-ah ka kunga om nang-a’ teng kawh inlen kilah in,” a ci hi. Rachel in tua pasien-te a guh lam Jacob in a thei sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob’ puonbuh sungah Laban lutin, tuale Leah’ puonbuh, le a nasem numei gel’ puonbuhte sungah zong lut a, ahi vangin ama in tuate a mu sih hi. Leah’ puonbuh panin ama pei-in Rachel’ puonbuh sungah a lut hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua laitahin Rachel in innsung pasien-te la-in kalaoh phaw kawmah koi-in a tungah a to hi. Laban in puonbuh sung teng zosie long a, ahi vangin tuate a mu sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuale ama in a pa kungah, “Na mai-ah kang din thei lo ziehin ka pu lungthah sin. Numei’ ngaina nin ka nei zieh ahi bo hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a sui vangin innsung pasien-te a mu sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob lungthah a, Laban phawhsie gawpin, “Ka tatkhielna bang ahiei? Tamza taha nei del nadingin ka mawna bang ahiei?"},"37":{"text":"Ka van zosie na lonsieng vangin na innsung van bang teng ahiei na mu? Ei gel kikalah amate in thu a khen thei nadingun kei sanggamte le nang sanggamte mai-ah tuate hing koi in."},"38":{"text":"Tami tam kum sawmni sung nang tawh kang om zo ta hi; na tuupite le na keelpite a tatol om loin na ganhonte lahah tuutang sa ka ne sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Gamsate’ thasate zong na kungah kang puoh ngai vateh sih hi; kei mama in tua bang supnate ka thuoh hi; sunlai-a kigute hile zanlai-a kigute hile kei nei losah hi."},"40":{"text":"Kei pen tu-a bang ka hi hi. Sunlai-in nisa in ei katum a, zanlai-in khuovot in ei tawpkangin ka kimu thei sih hi."},"41":{"text":"Tami kum sawmni sung na inn ah ka om hi. Na tanu nite ziehin kum sawm le li sung nangma’ na semin kum guh sung na ganhonte ka cing a, ka thamante sawmvei na khel hi."},"42":{"text":"Ka pa’ Pasien, Abraham’ Pasien, le Isaac’ Giinpa kei lamah ang om lo khat hi leh, khut guoha nei sawlmang tahpi ding ahi hi. Pasien in ka gentheina le ka khut tawh ka sepnate mu a, zani zanin nang ang phawhsie hi,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin Laban in dawngin Jacob kungah, “Tanu teng keima’ tanu, naupang teng keima’ naupang, ganhon teng keima’ ganhon ahi a, khum na mu teng zosie khu keima-a’ ahi hi. Ahi vangin tam ka tanute tung ahi a, amate sunga pieng naupangte tungah ahi zongin tuni-in ken bang law thei ding ka hei?","title":"Laban le Jacob in Thuciemna Khat Bawl"},"44":{"text":"Tu-in hing pei inlen nang le kei in thuciemna khat bawl vai; nang le kei kikalah teci hisah vai,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in suong khat la-in khuomin phut hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuale Jacob in a sanggamte kungah, “Suongte khawm un,” ci a, amate in suong la-in a lomin a cieng uhi; amate in tua suongcien gei-ah an a ne uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tua khu Laban in Jegar-sahadutha ci-a, ahi vangin Jacob in Galeed ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Laban in, “Tam suongcien pen tuni-in nang le kei kikala teci ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama in tua khu Galeed, ci-in minvaw a,"},"49":{"text":"a khuom pen Mizpah ci hi. Azieh pen Laban in, “Ei tegel khatlekhat i opton lo ciengin Topa in nang le kei kikalah ei cing tuoh taheh."},"50":{"text":"Ka tanute na bawlsiet a, ahi sihle ka tanute banah zi na lah be leh ei tawh koima a opton sih vangin nang le kei kikalah i teci Pasien ahi lam khu phawh in,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciengin Laban in Jacob kungah, “Keima in nang le kei kikala ka phusa tami suongcien le khuom en in."},"52":{"text":"Nangma ang susie dingin tami suongcien kalsanin na kungah kang pei lo nading, nang zong kei ei susie dingin tam suongcien kalsanin kei kunga nang pei lo nadingin tami suongcien teci ahi a, tami khuom zong teci ahi hi."},"53":{"text":"Abraham’ Pasien le Nahor’ Pasien - amate pate’ Pasien- in eite kikalah thu khen taheh,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a pa Isaac’ Giinpa tawh Jacob a kiciem hi."},"54":{"text":"Tuale Jacob in a sangna munah biehpiehna lui a, an ne dingin a sanggamte hlan hi; tuale amate in an a ne vua, zan tungtawnin muoltung gamah a taam uhi."},"55":{"text":"Zingmawng tungin Laban tho a, a tute le a tanute tawpin thupha a pie hi; tua ciengin ama pei-in inn lamah a kilekia hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jacob zong a lampi-ah peisuoh a, Pasien’ vantung mite in ama na dawn uhi;"},"2":{"text":"Jacob in tuate a mu bepin, “Tami khu Pasien’ giephuol ahi hi!” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in khum mun pen Mahanaim ci-in min a phuo hi."},"3":{"text":"Jacob in a sanggampa Esau opna mun Edom gam Seir leitangah kamtaite a masangah sawlin","title":"Esau A Lungdam Nadingin Letsong Kihlah"},"4":{"text":"amate thu a hil a, “Ka pu Esau kungah tam bangin na va gen ding uhi: Na nasempa Jacob in, ‘Laban tawh pemta bangin ka teng a, tu dong ciengin ka om hi;"},"5":{"text":"tuale keima in bawngtang, laa, ganhon, sila pasal, sila numeite ka nei hi; na muna-ah maipha ka mu thei nadingin ka pu kungah a gen dingin kang sawl hi, ci hi,’ va ci un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Jacob kungah kamtaite a kilekia vua, “Na pu Esau kungah ka va pei ta vua, tuale nang ang dawn dingin ama ang pei-in mihing zali ang zawpi hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob nahpitahin zau-in a lungkham hi; tuale ama’ zawpite, ganhonte, bawnghonte, le kalaohte pawl ni-in khen a,"},"8":{"text":"“Esau ang pei-in pawlkhat a suhsiet leh, a kinuasie pawlkhat suohta ding hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale Jacob in, “Aw, ka pa Abraham’ Pasien le ka pa Isaac’ Pasien, ka kungah, ‘Na gam le na tanaute kungah kilekia in, na tungah sil hoi kang bawl ding hi,’ ei ci Topa aw,"},"10":{"text":"na nasempa kunga nei lahsa itna kip le muontahna vannuoi lahah a neupen khat zong a tang dingin ka kilawm vawt sih hi; azieh pen keima in ka ciengkhut beh tawh tami Jordan ka kantan hi. Tu-in pawl ni ka suoh ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ka sanggampa’ khut, Esau’ khut sung panin ei hun in, ci-in kang thum hi, azieh pen ama ka giing hi; ama ang pei-in, kote zosie, nute, naupangte tawh ka unpi-un ei that thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle nang in, ‘Na tungah sil hoi kang bawl ding a, na suonlehlahte tuipi senel za-in a tam sengin a kisim thei loin ka bawl ding hi,’ nei ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 22:17"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum zanin tua munah ama gieh a, a neisa lah panin a sanggampa Esau adingin letsong"},"14":{"text":"keelpi zani le keeltang sawmni, tuupi zani le tuutang sawmni"},"15":{"text":"kalaoh nawisuh sawmthum le a note, bawngpi sawmli le bawngtang sawm, laapi sawmni le laatang sawm a la hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a nasemte khut sungah tam teng amau’ hon cietin pie a a nasemte kungah, “Ka masangah pei unlen ganhonte honkhat le honkhat kihalsah un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a masapen pa kungah, “Ka sanggampa Esau tawh na kituo vua, ‘No koi-a’ na hi uh ahei? Hei-a haw sawm na hi uh ahei? Na masang vua om tuate koi-a’ ahei?’ ci-a ang dawh leh,"},"18":{"text":"note in, ‘Tam teng pen na nasempa Jacob-a’ ahi hi; tamte ka pu Esau kungah letsonga ang kihlah ahi hi; tua tham loin ama ka nua vuah om hi,’ ci-un,” ci-in thu a hil hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in tua ma bangin a ni na, a thumna, le gantahon a zuite zosie kungah, “Esau tawh na kituo ciengun a kibangin na gen ding vua,"},"20":{"text":"note in , ‘Tua tham loin na nasempa Jacob ka nua vuah om hi,’ na ci ding uhi,” ci-in thu a hil hi. Azieh pen ama in, “Ka masanga a pei letsong tawh ama ka lungdamsah zo kha ding a, tua zaw ciengin a mai ka mu thei ding hi,” ci-in ngaisun hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n a mai-ah letsongte a peisah hi; khum zanin giephuol ah ama a gieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Khum zan ma-in ama tho-in a zi nite, a nasem numei nite, le a tapa sawm le khatte zawpi-in Jabbok tanmun a kantan hi.","title":"Peniel-ah Jacob in Buon"},"23":{"text":"Ama in amate zawpi-in luigal a kaipi a, tua ma bangin a neisa zosie a galkaisah hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama guohin Jacob a om hi; tuale zingmawng khuovah dongin mi khat in ama a buon hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua mipa in Jacob a zaw lo lam a thei ciengin, ama in a khelgu a suhpieh hi; tua mipa tawh a kibuon ziehin Jacob’ khelgu a kilawi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Khuovah ding hi ta, ei hla in,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Jacob in, “Thupha nei pieh sih leh kang hla sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Hos 12:3-4"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a kungah, “Na min bang ahiei? “ a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Jacob,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin mipa in, “Na min Jacob kici nawn loin Israel kici ta ding hi, azieh pen Pasien le mite tawh kibuonin na zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 35:10"},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in ama dongin, “Hepina tawh na min ei gen in,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in, “Bang dinga ka min nei dawh ahei?” a ci hi. Tua munah ama in Jacob thupha a pie hi.","ref":"Thkna 13:17-18"},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in tua mun Peniel, ci-in a min phuo hi. “Bangzieh ahei cile kimaituo-in Pasien ka mu zo a, hizongle ei kihinkhawi hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"A khelgu a kilawi ziehin ama khelbai a, Peniel a kantan laitahin ni a suoh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ziehin tuni dongin Israel-te in khelkom tunga a om khel thagui a ne sih uhi. Ama in Jacob’ khelkom, a khel thagui a suhpieh zieh ahi hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jacob khuodahin a en leh mi zali tawh ang zawhton Esau a mu hi. Tuaci’n ama in Leah, Rachel, le a nasem numei nite kungah a tate a khen hi.","title":"Jacob le Esau Kimu"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a masangah numei nasemte le a tate koi a, tua ciengin Rachel le Joseph a nukhia penin koi hi."},"3":{"text":"A masang vuah ama pei-in a sanggampa kung a tun masangin sagi vei tuolah a kun hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama dawn dingin Esau tai a, ama pomin ngawngkawi-in a nam vatuh a, tuaci’n a kap uhi."},"5":{"text":"Esau a khuodahin numeite le naupangte a mu ciengin ama in, “Nang zawpi tamte khu koi ahi vuoi?” a ci hi. Jacob in, “Pasien in lungsietna tawh na nasempa a pieh tate ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin nasem numeite le a tate in nehin a kun uhi;"},"7":{"text":"tua ma bangin Leah le a tate zong a kung nehin a kun uhi. A nukhia penin Joseph le Rachel in nehin a kun uhi."},"8":{"text":"Esau in, “Ka kituopi tami a honte zosie bang na cinopna ahiei?” a ci hi. Jacob in, “Ka pu’ maipha sui na ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Esau in, “Ken zong a kicing tahin nei ing, ka sanggampa aw, nang’ neite nangma adingin kikep kon in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jacob in, “Hi lo hi; na maipha ka mu leh nei hepina tawh ka khut panin ka letsongte ei sanpieh in; bangzieh ahei cile na maitang ka mu khu Pasien’ maitang mu ka bang tahtah vawt hi. Azieh pen nang in tam bang angvanna tawh kei nei sangzo hi"},"11":{"text":"Nei hepina tawh na kunga kang tawi ka letsong ei sanpieh in. Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in ei lungsiet mama a, ka tulmaw zosie ka nei hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a kut tentun ziehin tuate a sanpieh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esau in, “I lampi zuonin khuolzin vai. Nangma tawh hing zawhton vang,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongle Jacob in ama kungah, “Naupangte a hat lo lam ka pu in na thei a, tuuhonte, ganhonte, bawnghon le keel hon nawitep laite keima’ kep ding ahi hi; ni khat kinaw hawl seng leh ganhon zosie a si sieng ta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na nasempa mai-ah ka pu na pei inlen, ka mai-a ganhonte kalsuon le naupangte kal tawh dan kituohin Seir-a ka pu kung kang tun dongin damdamin kang peipi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Esau in, “Kang zawpi mi pawlkhat kang nuasiepieh ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Jacob in, “Kei tungah ka pu bang dinga hici migit sengseng na hei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in Seir lamah Esau a kilekia hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle Succoth lamah Jacob khuolzinin ama adingin inn khat lam a, a ganhonte adingin hlamphengte a bawl hi; tua ahi ziehin khum mun pen a min Succoth, kici hi."},"18":{"text":"Paddanaram pana peina lampi, Canaan gam sunga om Shechem khuopi-ah damle bitin Jacob a tung hi; tuale ama in tua khuopi mai-ah phuol a sat hi.","title":"Shechem-ah Jacob Tung"},"19":{"text":"Shechem’ pa Hamor’ tapate kung panin a puonbuh lamnasa leitang pen dangka zakhat tawh a lei hi.","ref":"Josh 24:32; Jhn 4:5"},"20":{"text":"Ama in khum munah maitam khat tung a, a min El-Elohe-Israel a phuoh hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in khum gam numeite kunga haw dingin Jacob tawh a nei Leah’ tanu Dinah a kuon hi.","title":"Dinah A Kibuonna"},"2":{"text":"Khum gam ulien Hiv mi Hamor’ tapa Shechem in a mu ciengin, ama in tua nu manin pauhat thu tawh a luppi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Jacob’ tanu Dinah a lunggul vatuh hi; ama in tua nu ngai-in awnem no tawh a hopi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Shechem in a pa Hamor kungah, “Tami numei nu ka zi dingin ei lahpieh in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Shechem in a tanu Dinah a suhthaang lam Jacob in a za hi; ahi vangin a tate gamlahah ganhonte tawh a om uhi. Tuaci’n amate a tun masangsie-in Jacob ham loin a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Jacob hopi dingin ama kungah Shechem’ pa Hamor haw a,"},"7":{"text":"khum hun tahin gamlah panin Jacob’ tapate a tung uhi. Amate in tam thu a zah ciengun a sin uh so-in a lungthah mama uhi, azieh pen Jacob’ tanu tawh a lupton ziehin ama in Israel sungah mot gamtatna tun hi, bangzieh ahei cile tua bang pen bawl dinga a kilawm vawt lo thu ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Hamor in amate a hopi a, “Ka tapa Shechem in na tanu uh a lunggul vangut hi; hepina tawh a zi dingin ama ei pie un."},"9":{"text":"Ko zi le ta-in ei zong un; na tanute ei pie unlen, ka tanute uzong la un."},"10":{"text":"Ko lahah nang teng ding vua, no adingin leitang ang kipie ding hi; a sungah tengin sum bawl unlen nei le lam zong khol un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Shechem in zong a pa le a sanggamte kungah, “Na maipha ei musah unlen, ka kunga na gen popo uh kang pie ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mo man le letsong na dei bangun a tam thei zaza ei ngen un, nei nget bangbang uh kang pie ding hi; ka zi dingin numei nu ei pie ta popo un,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a sanggamnu uh Dinah a suhthaangsa ahi ziehin Jacob’ tate in Shechem le a pa Hamor solna tawh a dawng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in, “Tep tan lo mipa tunga ka sanggamnu uh ka pieh ding uh hi thei ka sa sih uhi. Tua bang pen ko adingin mindai huoi luo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tami thu khat tungtawn behin kang thukimpi ding uhi: Ko tawh na kibah nadingun no lahah pasal zosie a tep uh kitan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka tanute uh kang pie ding vua, tuaci’n ko adingin na tanute ka la ding uhi. Tuale note lahah kote hing tengin mi khat i suoh ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka thu ei mang loin tep na tan sih uleh ka tanu uh kai-in ka pei ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amau’ thusun in Hamor le Hamor’ tapa Shechem lungdamsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tangvalpa in Jacob’ tanu a dei seng ziehin tami bawl ding pen a kiheh sih hi. A innkuonpi zosiete lahah ama a kipatawi pen ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n a khuopi vuah Hamor le a tapa Shechem pei-in a khuosung mite tawh a kiho vua,"},"21":{"text":"“ Tam mite ei tungah thunuom mama uhi; gam sungah tengsahin summet bawlsah vai, azieh pen amate dingin gam zai mama hi; a tanute uh zi-in la vai-in, i tanute uzong amate pie vai."},"22":{"text":"Eite lahah a ten ding uh thukimin mi khat i suo thei nading tam thu khat beh a om hi. Amate tep a kitan ma bangun eite lahah pasal zosie tep kitan ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amau’ ganhonte, amau’ nei le lamte, le a ganhingte zosie uh eite -a’ ding hi lo amah? Amate tawh kithukim lel phot vai. Tua hile eite lahah amate ang teng ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale khuopi tunkot pana a pusuoh mi zosie in Hamor le a tapa Shechem’ thugen a mang uhi; tuale khuopi tunkot pana a pusuoh pasal zosie tep a kitan uhi."},"25":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in amate in na a sah laitahun Jacob’ tapa nite, Dinah’ sanggam Simeon le Levi in a namsau uh tawi-in thei lo kalin khuopi a sim vua, pasal zosie a that uhi.","title":"Dinah’ Sanggamte in Phula"},"26":{"text":"Ama gel in namsau tawh Hamor le a tapa Shechem thatin Shechem inn sung panin Dinah kaiphitin a pei uhi."},"27":{"text":"Jacob’ tapa dangte zong a pei vua, siluong tungah lam hla-in a sanggamnu uh kisuhthangna khuopi a bulu uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in ganhonte le bawnghonte, laate, a khuopi sung ule a lo sung vua om popo a tomgam sieng uhi."},"29":{"text":"A nei a lam zosie uh, a naupang zosie ule a zite, a inn sung vua om zosie manin gal vanlahin a puomang uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Simeon le Levi kungah, “No tegel in tami gama a teng Canaan-te le Periz-te tungah nei gimsiesah vua, kei tungah lunggim nei guon uhi; ka mite lah halno khat ahi bo a, kei ei do dingin amate kisutuo-in ei simin ei bulu uleh kei le ka innkuonpite ei kisusie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in, “Ka sanggamnu uh numei pahtat banga kibawl dingin a kilawm amah?” a ci uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien in Jacob kungah, “Dingin Bethel-ah peito inlen khum munah va teng in. Na sanggampa Esau kung panin na taimang lai-in na kunga ang kilah Pasien adingin khum munah maitam khat bawl in,” a ci hi.","title":"Bethel-ah Jacob Kilekia","ref":"Pien 28:11-17"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in a innkuonpite le a zawpi zosiete kungah, “Na lah vua om gamdang pasien-te paimangin no le no kisiensuo unlen na puonsilte uh khel un;"},"3":{"text":"tua ciengin ka lungkham huna ei dawng, ka peina cintenga ei ompi Pasien adingin khum munah maitam khat ka bawl thei nadingin Bethel-ah peito vai,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a nei uh gamdang pasien-te zosie, le a bila a ba uh bilbate, Jacob tungah a pie uh hi. Jacob in Shechem khuo gei gangpi sing phungah tuate a phuol hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate khuolzinin a pei laitahun koima in a nuadel lo nadingin Pasien kung panin a kimvel vua om khuopite tungah zauhuoina khat tung hi."},"6":{"text":"Jacob le a zawpi mi zosie Canaan gam sunga om Luz (Bethel) ah a tung vua,"},"7":{"text":"ama in khum munah maitam khat lamin a min Elbethel, phuo hi. Azieh pen a sanggampa kung panin ama a taimang lai-in tua mun ama kungah Pasien mama a kilang hi."},"8":{"text":"Rebekah a cingnu Deborah si a, Bethel hlanglam gangpi sing nei khatah kivui hi. Tuaci’n khum mun Allonbakuth, kici hi."},"9":{"text":"Paddan-aram pan a pei ciengin Jacob kungah Pasien kilangkia a, ama thupha a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien in ama kungah, “Na min Jacob ahi hi; Jacob ang kici nawn sih ding hi, na min Israel hi ta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama Israel kici hi.","ref":"Pien 32:28"},"11":{"text":"Pasien in ama kungah, “Keima Vanglien Pasien ka hi hi. Pung inlen tampi pha in; na sung panin minam khat le minam honkhat pieng ding a, na sung panin kumpite pieng ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Abraham le Isaac tunga ka pieh tua leitang nang kang pie ding a, nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte tungah zong tua leitang ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 17:4-8"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tawh a kihona mun panin Pasien a peito hi."},"14":{"text":"Jacob in ama tawh a kihona munah suong khuom khat a phut hi; tuale ama in tua tungah dawn thei biehna a sung hi, tua tungah sathau zong a sung hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in Pasien tawh a kihona mun pen a min Bethel, a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 28:18-19"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Bethel panin amate khuol a zin uhi; Ephrath panin a gamla sim lai mun a gei ciengun Rachel a nau suo hun tung a, takei-in a gim mama hi.","title":"Benjamin Suona le Rachel’ Sina"},"17":{"text":"Ama nu takei-in a thuohla mama laitahin naudom nu in ama kungah, “Zau sin. Azieh pen tu-in nang in tapa adang khat na nei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua nu’ hlagau a peikhiet laitahin, (bangzieh ahei cile ama a si hi) tua nu in a min Benoni ci-in phuo hi; ahi vangin a pa in ama’ min pen Benjamin hisah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Rachel si-in Ephrath (Bethlehem) zuotna lampi-ah kivui a,"},"20":{"text":"Jacob in tua nu’ hankhuh ah khuom khat phut hi; tuni dongin khum muna om pen Rachel’ han muolsuong ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel in a khuolzin zom a, Eder tausang galkhat ah a puonbuh a lam hi."},"22":{"text":"Khum gamah Jacob a ten laitahin Reuben in a pa’ meinu Bilhah luppi hi; tua thu Israel in a za hi. Tu-in Jacob’ tapate sawm le ni ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 49:4"},"23":{"text":"Leah’ tapate: Reuben (Jacob’ ta masa pen), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, le Zebulun ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Rachel’ tapate: Joseph le Benjamin ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Rachel’ nasem nu Bilhah’ tapate: Dan le Naphtali ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Leah’ nasem nu Zilpah’ tapate: Gad le Asher ahi hi. Tam teng pen Paddan-aram gama a nei Jacob’ tapate ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Abraham le Isaac pemta banga a tenna Mamre, ahi sihle Kiriath-arba (tua pen Hebron)-a om a pa Isaac kungah Jacob a va haw ta hi.","title":"Isaac’ Sina","ref":"Pien 13:18"},"28":{"text":"Tu-in Isaac’ khan kum pen kum za le kum sawmgiet ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuale Isaac in a hu nukhia pen a sang hi; ama vuoi-in a kum tam a, a mite kungah a kigawm hi; a tapa Esau le Jacob in ama a vui uhi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Esau’ (tua pen Edom) suonlehlahte ahi hi.","title":"Esau’ Suonlehlahte (1Khg 1:35-42)"},"2":{"text":"Esau in Canaan-te panin a zite a la hi. Hit mi Elon’ tanu Adah, Hiv mi Zibeon’ tapa Anah’ tanu Oholibamah,","ref":"Pien 26:34"},"3":{"text":"le Nebaioth’ sanggamnu, Ishmael’ tanu Basemath ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 28:9"},"4":{"text":"Adah in Esau tawh Eliphaz nei hi; Basemath in Reuel nei hi;"},"5":{"text":"Olibamah in Jeush, Jalam, le Korah nei hi. Tam teng pen Canaan gam sunga a nei Esau’ tapate ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esau in a zite, a tapate, a tanute, a innsung mi zosie, a gantate, a ganhon zosie, le Canaan gama a lam a neisa zosie tawh a la hi; a sanggampa Jacob kung pan a gamla sim mun khatah ama kituon hi."},"7":{"text":"A neisate uh a tam seng ziehin a tengton thei sih uhi. A ganhonte uh ziehin a tenna uh leitang in amate a va zo ta sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Seir muoltung gamah Esau teng hi; Esau pen Edom ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam teng pen Sier muoltung gama Edom mite’ pupi Esau’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tam teng pen Esau’ tapate ahi hi: Esau’ zi Adah’ tapa Eliphaz, Esau’ zi Basemath’ tapa Reuel ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Eliphaz’ tapate: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, le Kenaz ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"(Timna pen Esau’ tapa Eliphaz’ a meinu ahi hi; ama in Eliphaz tawh Amalech nei hi.) Tam teng pen Esau’ zi Adah’ tapate a hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam teng pen Reuel’ tapate ahi hi: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, le Mizzah ahi hi. Tam teng pen Esau’ zi Basemath’ tapate ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng pen Esau’ zi, Zibeon’ tapa Anah’ tanu Oholibamah’ tapate ahi hi: Jesuh, Jalam, le Korah ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam teng Esau’ tapate’ be le phungte ahi hi. Esau’ ta masa pen Eliphaz’ tate: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,","title":"Be le Phungte le Edom Kumpite"},"16":{"text":"Korah, Gatam, le Amalech-te’ be le phungte ahi hi; tam teng pen Edom gam sunga Eliphaz’ be le phung te ahi hi; amate pen Adah’ tapate ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam teng pen Esau’ tapa Reuel’ tapate ahi uhi: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, le Mizzah-te’ be le phungte ahi uhi; tam teng pen Edom gam sunga Reuel’ be le phungte a hi uhi; amate pen Esau’ zi Basemath’ tapate ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam teng pen Esau’ zi Oholibamah’ tapate ahi hi: Jeush, Jalam, le Korah-te’ be le phungte ahi hi; tam teng pen Anah’ tanu Esau’ zi Oholibamah sunga a pieng be le phungte ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tam teng pen Esau’ (tua pen Edom) tapate ahi a, tam teng amau’ be le phungte ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam teng pen khum gama a teng Hori mi Seir’ tapate ahi hi: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,"},"21":{"text":"Dishon, Ezer, le Dishan-te ahi hi; tam teng pen Edom gam sunga Seir’ tapate ahi Hori mite’ be le phungte ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Lotan’ tapate pen Hori le Heman ahi hi; tuale Lotan’ sanggamnu Timna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Shobal’ tapate pen Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, le Onam ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tam teng pen Zibeon’ tapate ahi uhi: Aiah le Anah ahi hi. Ama pen a pa Zibeon’ laate a cin laitahin gamlahah tuisa pulna ciatui a mu pa Anah ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Anah’ tapate ahile Dishon le Anah’ tanu Oholibamah ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Dishon’ tapate pen Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, le Cheran ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ezer’ tapate pen Bilhan, Zaavan, le Akan ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Dishan’ tapate pen Uz le Aran ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tam teng pen Hori mite’ be le phungte ahi uhi: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,"},"30":{"text":"Dishon, Ezer, le Dishan ahi hi. Tam teng pen Seir gama be le phung zui-a Hori mite’ be le phungte ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tam teng pen Israel-te tungah koima kumpi khat beh in a uh masangin Edom gam sunga kumpite ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Beor’ tapa Bela in Edom gam sung uh a, a khuopi min Dinhabah ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Bela si a, Bozrah khuomi Zerah’ tapa Jobab in ama tangin uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Jobab si a, Teman-te’ gammi Husham in ama tangin uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Husham si a, Moab gam sungah Midian mite a zo Bedad’ tapa Hadad in ama tangin a uh a, a khuopi min Avith ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Hadad si a, Masrekah khuomi Samlah in ama tangin uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Samlah si a, Euphrates gun gei-a om Rehoboth khuomi Shaul in ama tangin uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Shaul si a, Akbor’ tapa Baalhanan in ama tangin uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Achbor’ tapa Baalhanan si a, Hadar in ama tangin uh a, a khuopi min Pau ahi hi. Ama zi’ min Mehetabel hi a, Mezahab’ tanu Matred, Matred tanu Mehetabel ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ innkuon le amate tenna, amau’ min tawh kizui-a Esau’ be le phung minte ahi hi: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth"},"41":{"text":"Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,"},"42":{"text":"Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,"},"43":{"text":"Magdiel, le Iram-te’ be le phungte ahi uhi. Tam teng pen amau’ lahsa, a tenna gam utawh kizui-a Edom’ (Esau pen Edom’ pa ahi hi) be le phungte ahi uhi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A pa pemta banga a tenna Canaan gamah Jacob a teng hi.","title":"Joseph in Zaliet nading Mangman"},"2":{"text":"Tami pen Jacob’ innkuon tangthu ahi hi. Kum sawm le kum sagi pha ta ahi ziehin Joseph in a sanggamte tawh tuuhonte a cing hi; ama pen a pa’ zite tapate ahi Bilhah le Zilpah hu ahi hi; Joseph in amau’ hoi lona thu a pa kungah tut hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Israel in a teh zaw-a a nei tapa ahi ziehin a tapa dang teng sangin Joseph a itzaw a, ama ading puontuol bansau khat a khuipieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pa un a sanggam zosie teng sangin Joseph a it zawh lam a thei bepun ama a muda vua, hoitahin zong a hopi thei va-ia sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Joseph in khatvei mang khat a man a, a sanggamte kungah a mang a va gen taleh ama a muda semsem uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Tam ka mang mat ngai un:"},"7":{"text":"Eite in lolai-ah buphai i lomhen vua, tuale thakhatin ka buphai ang tho-in ang ding tang hi; tua ciengin tua kimah na buphaite uh ang kikhawm a, ka buphai mai-ah a kun uhi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"A sanggamte in ama kungah, “Kote ei uh tahtah ding na hi amah? Ko tunga uhna aana ang nei tahtah ding na hi amah?” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n a mang le a thugen teng ziehin ama a muda semsem uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in mang adang khat mankia a, tuale ama’n zong a sanggamte kungah tua a mang a gen a, “En un, mang adang khat ka man hi. Ka mai-ah ni, hla, le aasi sawm le khatte a kun uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a pa le a sanggamte kungah tua a mangmat a gen leh a pa in ama a phawhsie a, “Tami na mang mat khu a bangci mang bep ahiei? Na mai-ah kei le na nu le na sanggamte a tuolkun dinga ang pei tahtah ding ka hi uh amah?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sanggamte in ama a haza vua, ahi vangin a pa in a lungsim sungah tam thu a ciemte hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:9"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in a pa uh’ tuuhonte cing dingin Shechem gei-ah a sanggamte a pei uhi.","title":"A Sanggamte in Joseph Zua"},"13":{"text":"Tuale Israel in Joseph kungah, “Shechem ah na sanggamte in tuuhonte cing hi lo uh amah? Hing pei in, amate kungah kang sawl ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Tanah om ing,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama kungah, “Tu mama-in pei inlen, na sanggamte le tuuhonte a dam na vuoi mah va en tan; ka kungah ei genkia in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Hebron kuom panin ama a sawl hi. Shechem ah ama a tung a,"},"15":{"text":"gamlah ah a vahvaih mi khat in ama a mu hi; tua mipa in ama kungah, “Bang sui na hei?” ci-in a dong hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka sanggamte sui ka hi hi,” a ci hi; mipa in, “A tuuhonte uh hei sunga a cin uh ahei, hepina tawh ei gen in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua mipa in, “Pei zo ta uh, azieh pen, ‘Dothan-ah pei vai,’ a kici uh ka za hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Joseph in a sanggamte a nua zui a, Dothan ah amate a mu hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in a gamlapi panin ama a galmu vua, ama kung a tun masangun ama tha na sawm uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Tanah mangman pa hing pei ta ei,” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in hing pei un, ama thatin dum sung khatah khiesuh vai; tua ciengin gamsa khat in ama valtum ta ci vai-in, a mangmatte bang ang suoh ngel ei en phot vei,” a kici uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Reuben in tua thu a zah ciengin ama in, “A hinna lahpieh lieng sih vai,” a ci a, tuaci’n amate khut sung panin ama a hunkhie hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate khut sung panin ama hunkhie-in a pa kungah tunpikia thei kha leng ci a ngaisutna tawh Reuben in a kung vuah, “Sisan suohsah sih un. Senel gama tami dum sungah ama khie unlen, ahi vangin ama tungah bangma na khut nga sih un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sanggamte kungah Joseph a tun ciengin a puontuol bansau a na sutpieh uhi;"},"24":{"text":"tuale ama kai-in dum sung khatah a khiesuh uhi. A dum pen a hawm ahi hi; a sungah tui om lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate an ne dingin a to uhi. A khuodah uleh Gilead panin a kalaohte utawh singnai, lingsi, le myrrh gimnamtuite, Egypt gama a puosuh dinga a pei Ishmael khuolzinte a mu uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah in a sanggamte kungah, “I sanggampa thatin ama’ sisan phuol leih i lemlaw uh bang pen ahei?"},"27":{"text":"Hing pei un, Ishmael-te kungah ama zua vai. Ama tungah i khut nga sih vai, bang ding ahei cile ama i sanggampa, eima’ cilesa ahi bo hi,” a ci hi.
