Tuale a sanggamte a thukim uhi."},"28":{"text":"Midian sumbawlte in a nawh uh ciengin amate in Joseph kaito-in dum sung panin a domto vua, Ishmael mite kungah ngun shekel sawmni tawh a zua uhi. Tuale amate in Egypt gamah Joseph a peipi uhi.","ref":"Sawl 7:9"},"29":{"text":"Dum sungah Reuben peikia a, tuami dum sungah Joseph a op lo lam ama in a thei ciengin a puon a ehmal hi."},"30":{"text":"A sanggamte kungah kilekia-in, “Naupang pa om nawn lo hi; kei hei lamah ka kihei ta diei?” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Joseph’ puon la-in keel khat a go vua, sisan lahah tua puontuol a die uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in a pa kungah tua puontuol bansaupi a puoh vua, “Tam hing mu ung e; na tapa’ puontuol ahile ahi lo kivel aw,” a ci uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in a thei pai a, “Ka tapa’ puon ahi na khula! Gamsa gilo khat in ama netum zo hi; Joseph a ki-ehmal tahtah lah ahi ta’n,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in a puon ehmal a, la-ip puon a kawngah tengin ni tampi sung a tapa a kaa hi."},"35":{"text":"A tapate le a tanu zosie in ama henep ding a hanciem vangun ama kihenem zo lo hi; tuale ama in, “Hi lo hi, ka kaa kawmin ka tapa kung Misikhuo ah ka pei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua bangin ama ziehin a pa a kap hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua kikal sungin Midian-te in Pharaoh khut nei-a uliente lahah khat ahi kumpi inncing galkapmangpa Potiphar kungah Joseph na zua uhi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in a sanggamte kung panin Judah a peisuh a, Adullam mi Hirah kici pa khat kungah a teng hi.","title":"Judah le Tamar"},"2":{"text":"Khum munah Judah in Canaan mi khat’ tanu Shua mu hi; tua nu tawh ama kinungin a luppi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua nu gai-in tapa khat nei a, a min Er phuo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua nu gaikia-in tapa khat nei a, ama in a min Onan phuo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua nu in tapa khat nei leuleu a, a min Shelah phuo hi. Ama a pien laitahin Chezib gamah tua nu a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Judah in a ta masa Er adingin zi khat a lahpieh hi; tua nu’ min Tamar ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa muna-ah Judah’ ta masa Er khu a gilo a, Topa in ama that hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah in Onan kungah, “Na sanggampa’ zi luppi inlen, tua nu tungah pasal’ sanggampa tavuon sem in; na sanggampa adingin suonlehlah piengsah in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Onan in tate pen ama ading ahi lo lam thei ahi ziehin a sanggampa’ zi a luppi sielin a sanggampa’ khang a kizop lo nadingin a bawtui tuolah a buosuh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa muna ah ama’ gamtat a lungkimhuoi lo ziehin ama zong a that hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah in a monu Tamar kungah, “Ka tapa Shelah a gol masangsie na pa’ inn ah meigongin va om in,” a ci hi. Azieh pen a sanggamte bangin ama zong a si ding a zau hi. Tuaci’n a pa’ inna om dingin Tamar a pei hi."},"12":{"text":"Hun phabep khat zaw ciengin Judah’ zi, Shua’ tanu a si hi; Judah a dan a hun a ven ciengin Adullam mi a guolpa Hirah tawh Timnah khuo-a ama’ tuumul heute kungah a peito hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tuumul heu dingin Timnah ah na innpipa ang peito hi,” ci-in Tamar kungah a kigen ciengin,"},"14":{"text":"a meigong puonte suo-in a lu puon khu-in ama kituom a, Timnah khuo peina lampi gei-a om Enaim khuo lutna munah ama na to hi. Azieh pen ama in Shelah a khan kihlit lam a thei a, hizongle ama tawh a kinungsah tuom sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Judah in ama a mu bepin ama in a mai a na tuom ziehin numei pahtat ding khatin a ngaisun hi."},"16":{"text":"Lampi gei ama kungah va pei a, a monu ahi lam a thei lo ziehin, “ Hing pei in, kei tawh lumton vai,” a ci hi. Khum nu in, “Kei nei luppi thei nadingin bang nei pie diei?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “Ka ganhonte lah panin ganno khat hing puoh vang,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Tuami nei puoh masangin vankhap khat nei pie diei mah?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Bang vankhap kang pie diei?” a ci hi. Tua nu in a dawng a, “Na seal le a awna khau le na khut sunga om na ciengkhut,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in tua teng a pie a, ama tawh lumtonin tua nu a gai hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu dingto-in a peikhie a, a kikhuna puon suodawhin a meigong puonte a silkia hi."},"20":{"text":"Numei nu tung panin vankhap lakia dingin Judah in Adullam mi a guolpa a ganno tawh a sawl ciengin ama in tua nu a mu zo ta sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in khuo mite kungah, “Enaim lam gei biehinnpi sunga numei pahtat nu hei sunga om ahiei ?” ci-in a dong hi. Amate in, “Tami munah numei pahtat koima om ngai sih,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judah kungah ama kilekia a, “Ama ka mu sih hi; tua banah khuo mite in, ‘Tami munah numei pahtat om ngai sih,’ ei ci bo vuh,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Judah in a dawng a, “Ka vante ama-a’ bangin kem ta mai heh. Tua hi si leh ei kinuisan ding hi; ken tami ganno ka puoh a, nang in tua nu na mu lo lam na thei hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zaw hla thum bang ciengin Judah kungah, “Na monu a pahtat ahi bo hi; tham loin a pahtatna zieha gai ahi hi,” ci-in kigen hi. Tuale Judah in, “Kaiphit unlen ama kihaltum heh,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama a kipusuopi laitahin ama in a innpipa kam vaihlah a, “Kei tam teng a nei pa tawh kigai ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Hepina tawh ciemte in, tami seal le a awna khau le ciengkhut, tam teng koi-a’ ahiei?” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah in tua vante ama-a’ ahi lam a thei a, “Ka tapa Shelah tawh ka kinunsah lo lang kalsie ama pen kei sanga a thudih zaw ahi hi,” a ci hi. Ama pen tua nu tawh lumton kia nawn lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua nu a kinisuo hun a tun ciengin a naubu sungah takop a om hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama takei-in na a sah laitahin khat in a khut a dawhsah hi; tuale naudom nu in vau sandup khat la-in a khut tungah khi a, “Tami khu ang dawh masa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Hizongle ama in a khut a nuakaih zaw lienin a sanggampa a suoh hi; tuale ama in, “ Nang adinga a vang na kibawltawm!” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama’ min Perez kiphuo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin a khut tungah vauzam dupsan kikhisa-in a sanggampa a suoh hi; ama’ min Zerah kiphuo hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Egypt ah Joseph kipeipi suh a, khum muna a peipi suh ahi Ishmael-te kung panin Egypt mi, Pharaoh’ ulien inncing galkapmangpa Potiphar in ama na lei hi.","title":"Joseph le Potiphar’ Zi"},"2":{"text":"Joseph tawh Topa a omton a, a lawcing mi khat a suoh hi; Egypt mi a pupa’ inn ah ama a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in ama ompi a, a khut tawh a bawlsa zosie mavangsah hi, ci-in a pupa in a mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph in a mai-ah maipha nga-in ama’ na a sem hi; ama in a innsungah a makai-in koi a, a neisa zosie a uhsah hi."},"5":{"text":"A a innsung le a neisa zosie tungah vaisai-a a koi huna kipan Joseph ziehin Topa in Egypt mipa’ innsung thupha a pie hi; innsung hitale lo sung hitale ama’ neisa zosie tungah Topa’ thupha a tung hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a neisa vannuoi Joseph khut sungah a ap sieng hi; khum munah a an neh ding simlo bangma lunghimawna a nei sih hi. Joseph ngaihbaangin melhoi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hun khat zaw ciengin a pupa’ zi in ama zawlmit ha a, “Kei ei luppi in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a niel a, a pupa’ zinu kungah, “En in, kei ziehin inn sungah ka pupa in lunghimawna kici bangma nei nawn loin a nei vannuoi ka khut sungah koi zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami inn sungah ama kei sanga a lienzaw ahi tuon sih a, nang ama’ zi na hi ziehin nang khat ci simlo kei kung panin ama in a keptuom bangma khat beh a om sih hi. Tua ahi ziehin kei in bangci bangin tam bang gitlona lienpite bawlin Pasien tungah maw thei ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in ni khat zaw ni khat Joseph a zawl vangin, ama tawh lupton ding hitale ama tawh opton ding hitale a thukim sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin ni khat, a nasep sem dingin ama inn sungah a lut a, tua inn sungah midang koima khat beh a op lo laitahin,"},"12":{"text":"tua nu in ama a puonin man a, “Ei luppi in!” a ci hi. Hinanle tua nu khut sungah a puon nuasie-in inn pulamah a taimang hi."},"13":{"text":"A khut sungah a puon nuasie-in inn pulamah ama a tai khu tua nu in a mu bepin,"},"14":{"text":"a innkuonpite hlanin amate kungah, “En un, eite ei simmaw dingin ka pasal in Hebrew mi khat i lah vuah ang tut hi! Kei tawh a lumton dingin ama ang lut a, kei zong nahpitahin ka kiko pai hi;"},"15":{"text":"ka aw sangsahin ka kiko a zah bepin ama in ka gei-ah a puon nuasie-in inn pulamah a taimang ta hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A pu inn a tun masangsie-in tua nu in a puon a kemcing hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua nu in ama kungah tua thu ma a gen a, “Kei ei no dingin i lah vua nang tut Hebrew nasempa ang lut a, ahi vangin"},"18":{"text":"ka aw sangsahin ka kiko bepin ama in ka gei-ah a puon nuasie-in inn pulamah a taimang hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na nasempa in kei ei bawl dan tam bang ahi hi,” ci-in a zinu in ama kunga a thugen teng a pupa in a zah ciengin a hangzah gawp hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Joseph’ pupa in ama manin kumpipa’ thongkiete kikoina thong sungah ama a khum hi; tua thong sungah ama a om hi."},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin Joseph tawh Topa a omton a, ama tungah a itna kip a lah hi; ama in thongcing pa’ maipha a ngasah hi."},"22":{"text":"Thongcing pa in thong sunga om thongkie mi zosie Joseph’ et dingin ap a, khumi muna kisem zosie ama sepsa vive ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in ama a oppi ziehin Joseph’ etna sunga a om poma thongcing pa in donin zong a nei vet sih hi; tuale a bawl na khat popo ah Topa in a dau a peisah hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw a sawt loin Egypt kumpipa’ haitawi pa le moh-em pa in a pu uh Egypt kumpipa a lungthahsah uhi.","title":"Thongkie Nite’ Mang"},"2":{"text":"A ulien nite ahi haitawi makaipa le moh-em makaipa tungah Pharaoh lungthah a,"},"3":{"text":"Joseph kikhumna thong sung, inncing mangpa’ inn sungah ama gel a khum hi."},"4":{"text":"Inncing mangpa in Joseph’ et dingin ama gel ap hi; tuale ama in ama gel a kem a, thong sungah ama gel bakhat sung kikhum hi."},"5":{"text":"Thong sunga kikhum Egypt kumpipa’ haitawi pa le moh-empa in zan khatin a ni gelin mang a man tuoh vua, a mang uh a tuom tuoh le a mang’ khietna uzong a tuom tuoh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingmawngin ama gel kungah Joseph a pei ciengin a lunggim-a om ama gel a va mu ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu’ inn sunga ama tawh a kikhumton Pharaoh’ uliente kungah, “Bang dinga tuni-in damai na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama gel in, “Mang ka man vua, tuate khie thei ding mi koima a om sih hi,” a ci uhi. Tuale Joseph in ama gel kungah, “Mang khieh theina Pasien-a’ hi lo amah? Kei kungah tuate ei gen un, kang thum hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph kungah haitawi makaipa in a mang gen a, ama in, “Ka mangin ka mai-ah lenggui khat a om a,"},"10":{"text":"tua lenggui tungah a bazam thum om hi. Ang sel behin ang paa pai a, a bawhte lengga min hi pai hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka khut sungah Pharaoh’ hai a om hi. Lenggate ka la a, tuate a tui hlawhin Pharaoh khut sungah tua hai ka koi hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in ama kungah, “A khietna tam bang ahi hi: A bazam thumte ni thum ahi hi;"},"13":{"text":"ni thum sungin Pharaoh in na lu hing phong ding a, na za-ah ang koikia ding hi; nang in ama’ haitawi na hi lai-a na bawl ngai bang lienin ama khut sungah Pharaoh’ hai na koikia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin na tungah thu ang hoi leh kei ei mangngil sin; hepina tawh Pharaoh’ kungah ka thu ei genpiehin kei tungah hing migi inlen, tuaci’n tam mun panin kei ei ladawh in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei ci le, a tahtahin kei pen Hebrew-te’ gam pana ei na kigu ka hi hi. Amate in tami thong miel sunga ei khum valia nadingun bangma ka bawl sih hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Moh-em makaipa in Joseph mang khieh a hoi lam ahi hi, ci-a a mu ciengin ama in Joseph kungah, “Kei zong mang khat ka man hi: Ka lu tungah mohlaw thum om a,"},"17":{"text":"tua law tungta pen sungah Pharaoh adingin a ki-emsa an namkim om a, ahi vangin ka lu tunga law sung panin vate in tuate a ne uhi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Joseph in dawng a, “A khietna tam bang ahi hi: Law thumte, ni thum ahi hi;"},"19":{"text":"ni thum sungin Pharaoh in na lu hing phong ding a- nang tung panin! - sing dawn khatah hing khai-in vate in na sa a ne ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"A ni thum ni, Pharaoh’ suo ni-in ama’ nasemte zosie adingin pawi khat bawl a, tuale ama in nasemte lahah a haitawi makaipa’ lu le a moh-empa’ lu a phong hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in haitawi makaipa pen ama’ haitawina mun ma-ah koikia a, Pharaoh’ khut sungah a hai a koi hi;"},"22":{"text":"ahi vangin Joseph’ khiet bangin ama in moh-em makaipa a khailia hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin haitawi makaipa in Joseph phawh kha nawn lo a, ama a mangngil ta hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw kum ni bih a cin ciengin Pharaoh in mang man a, a mangin Nile gun gei-ah a din laitahin,","title":"Joseph in Pharaoh’ Mang Khiehpieh"},"2":{"text":"Nile gun panin a zol thau sepsop bawngpi sagi pusuoh a, phai lopate a mai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Nile gun sung panin a melsie le a gawngtam bawngpi dang sagi pusuoh a, Nile gun gei-a bawngpi dangte kungah a ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"A melsie le a gawngtam bawngpi sagite in a thau a zol sepsop bawngpi sagite a netum uhi. Tuale Pharaoh khanglo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kimu-in a ni veina mang a mankia hi; a tahsa a hoi buvui sagi kung khatah vui hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin nisuona hui in a semdaang gawp buvui hawm sagi a po hi."},"7":{"text":"Buvui hawmte in a tahsa buvui sagite a valtum hi. Pharaoh a khanglo a, tua pen a mang a na hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Zingmawngin Pharaoh a lungkham hi; tuaci’n ama in Egypt mitphiel siem zosie le a mipil zosie hlansah hi. Pharaoh in amate kungah a mang gen a, hinanle Pharaoh kungah a mang khie thei koima a om sih hi.","ref":"Dan 2:2"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin haitawi makaipa in Pharaoh kungah, “Tuni-in ka khielnate ka phawhkia hi."},"10":{"text":"Khatvei lai-in Pharaoh, a nasemte tungah lungthah a, kumpi inncing galkap mangpa’ inn sungah kei le an huon makaipa ei khum hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ni gelin zan khat thu-in mang ka man gel a, ka mangte gel in khietna a tuom tuoh nei hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpi inncing galkap mangpa’ nasem Hebrew tangval khat tawh ka omton vua, ka mang uh ka gen ciengun ka mang om dan tuoh uh dung zui-in ei khiehpieh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in ka tung vua ei khiehpieh ma bangin ang tung mintah hi; kei ka za-ah ei kikoikia a, an huonpa pen kikhailum hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in Joseph hlansah a, ama thong mielpi sung panin mallang tahin kipeipi hi. Ama in a khamul heu-in a puon a khel zaw ciengin Pharaoh mai-ah a pei hi."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “Mang khat ka nei a, tua ka mang a khie thei koima a om sih hi. Nang in mang kigen khat na zah leh tua mang na khie thei hi, ci-in ei kigen ka za hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph in Pharaoh a dawng a, “Ka pilna tawh mang khie thei ka hi sih hi. Pharaoh tungah Pasien in a hoi lamin hing dawng na va,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “Ka mangin Nile gun gei-ah ka ding hi;"},"18":{"text":"Nile gun panin a thau a zol sepsop bawngpi sagi ang pusuoh a, phai lopate a mai uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin a hepi huoi, a melsie mama le a gawngtam adang bawngpi sagi ang pusuoh kia hi. Egypt gam sung zosie-ah tam bang ganhing melsie ka mu ngai nai sih hi."},"20":{"text":"A gawngtam le a melsie bawngpite in amasa bawngpi thau a zol sepsop sagite a netum vua,"},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin tuate a neh zaw ciengun, koima in a neh lam uh a thei sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate a thau tuom sih vua, amasa lai bangin melsie lai veve uhi. Tua ciengin ka khanglo hi."},"22":{"text":"A ni veina ka kimukia a, ka mangin buvui hoi sagi kung khat tungah a vui ka mu hi."},"23":{"text":"Nisuona lam hui in semdaangin a gawtasah buvui hawm sagi ang po hi;"},"24":{"text":"tua buvui hawmte in buvui hoi sagite a valmang hi. Mitphiel siemte kungah ka gen a, ahi vangin ka kunga ei gencien thei koima a om sih hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in Pharaoh kungah, “Pharaoh’ mang tegel pen khat ahi bo a, a khietna kibang ahi hi; Pasien in Pharaoh kungah a bawl dingte ang lah zo hi."},"26":{"text":"A hoi bawngpi sagite, kum sagi ahi a, a hoi buvui sagite pen kum sagi ma ahi hi. A mang khietna a kibang ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuate zaw cienga ang pusuoh a gawngtam le a melsie bawngpi sagite khu kum sagi ahi a, nisuona lam huipi in a semdaang buvui hawm sagite pen kielpi kum sagi ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Pharaoh kunga kang gen bangin Pasien in Pharaoh kungah a sil bawl ding ang lah zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Egypt gam sung zosie-ah kum sagi sung an kihau ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuate zaw ciengin kum sagi kielpi tung ding a, Egypt gam sunga hauna zosie kimangngil ding hi; tua kielpi in gam sung teng a netum ding hi."},"31":{"text":"A nuazui kielpi a natsiet seng ziehin gam sung hau hunlaite a kithei kha ta sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Pharaoh’ mangmat a kithuop pen khu Pasien’ sesa hi, a cinopna hi a, Pasien in bakhat sungin ang tungsah ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Pharaoh in mi pilvang le misiem khat kitel inlen, Egypt gam sung vaisai dingin koi in."},"34":{"text":"Pharaoh in gam sungah makaite se inlen, an a kihauh kum sagi sungin Egypt leitanga pieng ante nga-a-khat la in."},"35":{"text":"Ang tung ding tami kum hoi sunga an zosie amate khawmsah inlen, neh dingin khuopite sunga Pharaoh’ uhna nei-a khuopite sungah kholsahin kemcingsah in."},"36":{"text":"Tua an pen kielpi zieha gam sung a siet lo nadingin Egypt gam sunga ang tung ding kum sagi kielpi dal nadinga a kikoicing an hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tami a thugel dan pen Pharaoh le a nasem zosie in hoi a sa uhi.","title":"Joseph’ Zakhanna"},"38":{"text":"Pharaoh in a nasemte kungah, “ Ama sunga Pasien’ hlagau a opna, tam bang midang i mu zo ding uh amah?” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “Pasien in nang tungah tam teng zosie pi hing lah zo ahi ziehin, nang banga mi pilvang le mi siem koima dang a om sih hi."},"40":{"text":"Ka inn sungah na vaihawm ding a, ka mite zosie in na thupieh bangin a gamta ding uhi; kumpi topha tawh kisai-in ahileh nang sangin kei ka lienzaw beh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:10"},"41":{"text":"Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “En in, Egypt gam zosie-ah thunei vaihawmin kang koi zo hi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Pharaoh in a suoikaina khutsip a khut panin sutin Joseph bunsah a, puon hoi tawh zemin a ngawngah kham khainieng khat a awsah hi.","ref":"Dan 5:29"},"43":{"text":"Ama in sakol leeng a nina pen tungah ama’ nei-a pa a tosah hi; tuale a masanga pei mite kiko-in, “Khupdin un!” a ci uhi. Tua ahi ciengin Egypt gam zosie tungah ama a vaihawmin a pang hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua tham loin Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “Keima Pharaoh ka hi a, Egypt gam sung zosie-ah nangma’ thu loin koima khut lehin vai a hawm thei sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Pharaoh in Joseph min Zaphenath-paneah a phuo hi. Ama in On khuo siempu Potiphera’ tanu Asenath tawh a kinungsah hi. Tuaci bangin Joseph in Egypt gam sungah thuneina nga hi."},"46":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh’ nasemin a lut lai-in Joseph kum sawm thum pha hi. Pharaoh’ opna panin Joseph pusuohin Egypt gam zosie-ah a zin kawikawi hi."},"47":{"text":"An hau kum sagi sungin leitang in an tampi a piengsah hi."},"48":{"text":"Egypt gamah kum sagi an a kihau sungin ama in an zosie khawm a, khuopite-ah a khol hi; tuale ama in khuopi zosie-ah a kima lote sunga a pieng ante a khol hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph in tuipi-a senel za-in antang tampi khol a, te zawh ding ahi lo ziehin ama in a te ding a khawl vawt hi."},"50":{"text":"Kielpi a tun masangin Joseph in On khuo siempu Potiphera’ tanu Asenath tawh tapa ni a nei hi"},"51":{"text":"Joseph in a tapa masa’ min Manasseh hisah hi. Ama in, “Pasien in ka hamsatna zosie le ka pa’ innkuon zosie ei mangngilsah hi,” a ci hi."},"52":{"text":"A nina pen Ephraim a phuo hi. “Ka hamsietna gam sungah Pasien in keima a pung dingin ei siem hi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Egypt gamah kum sagi sung anhau hun a tawp ta hi;"},"54":{"text":"tuale Joseph’ gensa bangin kum sagi kielpi kipan hi. Gam zosie-ah kielpi a tun vangin Egypt gam sung tengah an a om hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:11"},"55":{"text":"Egypt gam zosie a kiel ciengin Pharaoh kungah an ngenin mite a kiko uhi. Pharaoh in Egypt mi zosie kungah, “Joseph kungah pei un; ama ci bangin gamta un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 2:5"},"56":{"text":"Gambup ah kielpi a tunkim bepin Joseph in ansalte phetin Egypt-te a leisah hi, azieh pen Egypt leitangah kielpi a nasie mama hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua tham loin leitung zosie-ah kielpi nasie mama ahi ziehin antang lei dingin leitung mi zosie Joseph kungah a pei uhi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gamah an a op lam Jacob in a thei ciengin a tapate kungah, “Bang dinga khatlekhat hici kigum-et giagua mawh na hi uh ahei?","title":"Joseph’ Sanggamte Egypt-ah Haw"},"2":{"text":"“Egypt gamah an om hi, ci thu ka za hi; puhsi lo-a i hin thei nadingin peisuh unlen khum sungah an va lei ta un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:12"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n an lei dingin Joseph’ tapa sawmte Egypt ah a peisuh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jacob in a sanggamte tawh Joseph’ sanggampa Benjamin zawhsah lo hi, azieh pen ama tungah sietna a tun khah ding a zausah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Canaan gamah kielpi a tun ziehin Israel’ tapate zong an lei dinga pei mite tawh Egypt gamah a peiton uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Joseph pen tua gam uhpa ahi a, gammi zosie tunga an zuapa ama ahi hi. Joseph’ sanggamte pei-in a maitang uh leilam ngatin a mai-ah a kun uhi."},"7":{"text":"Joseph in a sanggamte a mu ciengin a thei a, hinanle geltate bangin bawlin a na khauh hopi hi. Ama in, “Hei pana hing pei na hi vuoi?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Canaan gam pana an lei dinga ang pei ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Joseph in a sanggamte a thei vangin amate in ama a thei ta sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate tawh kisai a mang matte Joseph in a phawh hi. Ama in a kung vuah, “Note pen thukante na hi uhi; gam sung gitnat lona en dinga ang pei hi ngel uteh!” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 37:5-10"},"10":{"text":"Amate in a kungah, “Hi vawt sih ung ka pu aw; na silate an lei dinga ang pei ka hi bo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ka unpi-un pa khat’ hlah ka hi bo vua, mi citah ka hi bo uhi; na nasemte thukante ka hi vawt sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a kung vuah, “Hi lo hi, gam sung gitnat lona en dinga ang pei hi bo uteh!” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in, “Kote, na nasemte sanggam pasal sawm le ni ka hi vua, Canaan gama mipa khat’ tate ka hi uhi; tu laitahin a tum pen ka pa uh tawh om a, hinanle khat pen om nawn lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joseph in amate kungah, “Na kung vua kang gensa bang tehteh ahi hi; note, thukan ma hi bo uteh!"},"15":{"text":"Kang ze-et dan ding pen tam bang ahi hi: Pharaoh a hin ma bangin na nautum pen uh tam sunga ang pei sih poma leh tam mun panin na pei thei sih ding uhi!"},"16":{"text":"Note lah panin khat pei unlen na sanggampa uh hing zawpi ta un. Na sung vuah thuman a om amah, om lo ahei ci-in a kimu nading, na thugente uh a kikantel thei nadingin thong sungah no adang teng om tadi un; tua ahi sihle Pharaoh a hin ma bangin thukante na hi valon uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in thong sungah a unpi-un ni thum sung a khumcip hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Joseph in amate kungah, “Pasien ka zatah ziehin tam bangin gamta un, tua hile na hing ding uhi:"},"19":{"text":"Mi citah na hi uleh ang kikhumna uh tam munah na sanggamte uh khat omsah un. Na innkuonpite uh’ kieldo nadingin no adang teng in an puo-in pei ta unlen,"},"20":{"text":"ka kungah na nau tumpen uh hing peipi un. Tua bang hi leh na thu gen uh a man hi ding a, na si sih ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tua banga bawl dingin amate a thukim uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat in, “Kasai, eite i hi leh i sanggampa uh tunga i bawl mawna dan a lokia i hi ta uhi; ama in eite kunga ang thum lai-in a lungkhamna i mu vua, hinanle a thu i ngai sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin i tung vua tami lungkhamna ang tung ahi hi,” ci-in a kiho uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Reuben in amate dawng a, “Na kung vuah tua naupang pa bawlsiet lo ding hing gen hi lo ka mah? Ahi vangin ka thu nei mang sih uhi. Tuaci’n tu-in eite tungah ama’ sisan phu ang kingen ahi ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 37:21-22"},"23":{"text":"Kamphen khat tungtawnin amate a hopi ziehin Joseph in amau’ ham a tel lam a thei sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale amate kung panin ama kihemin a kap hi. Tua ciengin peikia-in amate a hopi hi. Ama in Simeon tuom teelin a muna vuah khau tawh a khisah hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in a ip dimun antang guonpieh a, a ip sung ciet vuah a sum uh koi piehkia-in, a khuolzinna vua a neh ding uh lam-an zong a guonpieh nadingun thu a pie hi. Amate dingin tam bangin kibawlpieh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in a laate uh antang puosahin a dingkhie uhi.","title":"Canaan-ah Joseph’ Sanggamte Kilekia"},"27":{"text":"Amate lahah khat in giena mun vuah a laa an pie dingin a ip a hong leh a ip gongah a sum mu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in a sanggamte kungah, “Ka sum na kikoikia hi. Ka ip sungah om ei!” a ci hi. Tam thu ziehin lungkia-in citunin khatlekhat a ki-en vua, “Pasien in eite tunga ang bawl tami khu a bangci thu ahi tai?” a kici uhi."},"29":{"text":"Canaan gama a pa uh Jacob kung a tun ciengun, amate in a tung vua thu pieng zosie a sut vua,"},"30":{"text":"“Tua gam a uhpa in ei khauh hopi a, tua gam thu a kandapin ei ngawh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin kote in a kungah, “Ko mi citah ka hi vua, thukante ka hi sih uhi."},"32":{"text":"Pa khat’ hlah sanggam pasal sawm le ni ka hi vua, ka sanggam uh khat a om nawn sih a, a tum pen tu laitahin ka pa utawh Canaan gamah a om hi,” ka ci uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua gam a uhpa, tua mipa in ka kung vuah, ‘Mi citah na hina uh tam tawh kithei ding hi: Na sanggamte uh khat ka kungah nuasie unlen, na innkuonpite’ kiel do nadingin antang guong unlen, na lampi vuah pei un."},"34":{"text":"Na nautum pen uh keima kungah hing peipi ta unlen, note pen thukante hi loin mi citahte na hi zawh lam uh keima in kang thei ding hi. Tua ciengin na sanggampa uh kang suohta sah ding a, gam sungah sum na bawl thei ding uhi,’ ei ci hi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in a ip uh a buh sieng ciengun a van ciet vuah a sumip ciet uh na om mawh hi. Amate le a pa un a sum kitunte a mu ciengun a patau uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuale a pa uh Jacob in a kung vuah, “Ka tate nei taansah zo ta uhi: Joseph lah om ta lo, Simeon lah om ta lo, tu-in Benjamin a peipi lai ding na hi uhi. Kei tunga tam teng zosie pi ang pieng ahi ta khula!” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin Reuben in a pa kungah, “Na kungah ama kang tutkia sih tah leh ka tapa tegel kitha ta’n. Ka khut sungah ama hing koi in. Na kungah ama kang tutkia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “A sanggampa si a, ama beh om ta bo ahi ziehin note tawh ka tapa a peisuh sih ding hi. Na khuolzin nading uh lampi-ah ama in sietna bang lo khat hing tuoh kha mawh leh note in Misikhuo-ah dana tawh ka samkang na tun ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in gam sungah kielpi nasie mama hi.","title":"Benjamin tawh a Sanggamte Peikia"},"2":{"text":"Amate in Egypt gam pana a puoh uh antang a khawn zaw ciengun a pa un a kung vuah, “Kuonkia unlen an halkhat va leibe kia ta un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Judah in ama kungah, “Tua mipa in khautahin ei hilkhol a, ‘Na sanggampa nang zawpi sih uleh ka mai na mu sih ding uhi,’ ei ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka sanggampa tawh nei zawsah ding leh, an lei dingin ka kuonsuh ding uhi;"},"5":{"text":"nei zawsah sih dinga ahile ka kuonsuh sih ding uhi, azieh pen tua mipa in ka kung vuah, ‘Na sanggampa utawh nang zaw sih uleh ka mai na mu sih ding uhi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel in, “Mipa kungah bang dingin sanggam dang khat ka nei uhi, ci-in genin ei hici bawlsiet na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a dawng vua, “Mipa in kote le ka tanaute uh thu limtahin ei dong a, ‘Na pa uh a dam lai ei mah? Sanggam dang na nei na vuoi mah?’ ei ci hi. Ama in tam banga ei dawhna teng a dawngkia ka hi bo uhi. ‘Na sanggampa hing zawpisuh ta un,’ ei ci ding lam bang ka ci thei ding uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah in a pa Israel kungah, “Tangvalpa ei zawpisah in. Nangma, kote, le i nausente si loin i hin thei nadingin ka va pei ta ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kei mama ama adinga a kikham kang hi ding hi; ama tangin kei tungah mawna nei suon thei hi. Na kungah ama kang tutkia sih a, na mai-ah kang koikia sih tah leh tua mawna kei ei puosah zing ta’n."},"10":{"text":"A vaikai lo khat hi leih tu-in nivei a kilekia zo ding ka hi ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa uh Jacob in amate kungah, “Tua bang ahi vawt tah leh tam bangin bawl un: Na ip sung vuah gam sunga a tuituoh pen singga pawlkhat puo unlen, tua pa tungah letsong dingin lingsi halkhat, khuoizu halkhat, singnai, myrrh panamtui, pistachio ga, le almond gate puosuh un."},"12":{"text":"Na sum uh a zani vom un. Na vangong sung vua kikoi sumte puokia un; a kiphawh kha lo zong hi thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na sanggampa uh zawpi ta unlen, tua mipa kungah peikia ta un."},"14":{"text":"Ama in tua adang na sanggampa ule Benjamin ang hlakia thei nadingin Vanglien Pasien in mipa mai-ah note hing lungsiet taheh. Kei ka hile ka tate ka tan le zong a tan hi ta mai veng,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in letsong la-in sum a zani a kenbe vua, Benjamin zong a zawpi uhi. Tua ciengin Egypt gamah a peisuh vua, Joseph mai-ah a ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph in amate tawh ang zawhton Benjamin a mu ciengin a inncingpa kungah, “Inn sungah mite peipi inlen, tam mite sun an nehpi nuom ka hi ziehin gan khat go-in a baisa-in na omsah in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Joseph’ gen bangin tua mipa in bawl a, Joseph’ inn sungah tua mite a zawpi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Joseph’ inn ah a kizawpi ziehin a zausi vua, amate in, “A masa lai-a i ip sung vua kikoi sumte ziehin i tung vuah thu sui-in sila tengta-in ei bawlin i laate a mat thei nading vua ei kipeipi hi ta,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph’ inncingpa kungah a peito vua, inn kotbiengah ama tawh a kiho uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in, “Ka pu aw, a masa-in an lei dingin kang peisuh uhi;"},"21":{"text":"giena mun ka tun ciengun ka ip ka hong ule ka sum uh a gih za a kimin ka ip gong ciet vuah na om hi. Tua ahi ziehin tua sumte kang puokia uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua banah an lei nading sum kang kenbe lai uhi. Ka sumte uh ka ip sung vuah koi pen koi ahei, ci ka thei sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in dawngin, “Kilungnuom sah unlen zau sih un; na Pasien ule na pate uh’ Pasien in na ip sung vuah na gou ding vua ang koipieh hi ding hi; na sum uh ka nga na hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in amate tungah Simeon a peipi hi."},"24":{"text":"Inncingpa in Joseph’ inn ah amate zawpi-in tui pie a, a keng uh silin a kalaohte uh an a pieh zaw ciengin,"},"25":{"text":"tua munah a an neh ding lam uh a zah ziehun sun lai-a Joseph ang pei cienga a pieh ding uh letsong a baisa-in a koi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Inn ah Joseph a tun ciengin amate in inn sunga a tawi uh letsongte ama kungah a peipi vua, ama’ mai lei lahah a kun uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in dam le dam lo thu teng dongin, “Na gen uh na pa vuoi uh a dam dam nai mah? Ama a hing lai ma amah?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in, “Na nasempa ka pa uh dam lai hi; ama hing lai hi,” a ci uhi. Tuale a lu uh kunin zatahna a pie uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph a dahto leh a nu’ tapa a sanggampa Benjamin mu a, ama in, “Ka kunga nei gen uh na nautum pen uh tampa ahiei mah? Pasien in nang hing khuotuo taheh, ka tapa aw!” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua bangin a sanggampa a ngai seng ziehin Joseph pusuohin a kap dingin a kisa hi. Tuaci’n inndan tuom khatah pei-in kap hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin a maiphietin a pusuoh hi; ama le ama ki-ip kenkonin, “An ei thua un,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in Joseph ama guohin nesahin, amate zong a tuom ma-in nesah a, a an nehpi Egypt-te in a tuom ma-in a nesah uhi, azieh pen Hebrew-te tawh ankuong imton pen Egypt-te adingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate a suoh masa a suo kum utawh kizui le a tumpen a khangdawnna tawh kizui-in ama mai-ah a to ciengun mite in lamdangsa-in khatlekhat a ki-en uhi."},"34":{"text":"Joseph’ sabuoi pan a tanh ciet uh kithuapieh a, hinanle amau’ tanh sangin Benjamin-a’ a za nga-in a tamzaw hi. Tuaci’n amate in an ne tui dawnin ama tawh a guol nuom uhi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a inncing pa thu pie a, “Tua mite’ ip sungah a puoh khop zaza uh an guon inlen, a ip gong ciet vuah a sum uh koi in.","title":"Joseph in Benjamin Hen"},"2":{"text":"Ka hai, ngun hai pen a an lei nading sum tawh nautum pen pa’ ip gong ah guonpieh in,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in Joseph’ gen bangin a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Zingmawng khuova behin a laate utawh mite kipeisah hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuopi panin amate tomkal no khat a pei zaw uh ciengin Joseph in a inncingpa kungah, “Pei inlen tua mite va del ta’n; amate na phah ciengin a kung vuah, ‘Bang dinga a hoi pen a sie tawh ei thuh na hi uh ahei? Bang dinga ka pu’ ngun hai na guh uh ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Ka pu in tami hai tawh zu a dawn hi lo amah? Ama in aisanna-a tami hai a zah tahtah hi lo amah? Tam bang na bawl ziehun na khiel uhi,’ va ci ta’n,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate a phah ciengin ama in a kung vuah tam thu teng a genkia hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in, “Bang dinga ka pu in tam bang kammalte nang gen mawh ahei? Na nasemte tua banga gamta ding ahi vawt sih uhi!"},"8":{"text":"En in, Canaan gam panin ka ip gong vua ka mu uh sumte na kungah kang puokia uhi; tua ahile na pu’ inn panin ngun ahi a, kham ahi zongin bang dinga ka guh tah lawm ding uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Na nasemte lahah tua hai a kimuna pen pa kithat taheh; tham loin ko adang teng zong ka pu’ sila kang hi ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “Na ci bang uh hi taheh: A kimuna pa ka sila hi ding a, hizongle no adang teng a suohta-in na pei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin a milipin a ip uh lei ah ngasuhin a ip ciet uh a nawhon pai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in long pai a, a tapen panin kipanin a tumpen tawh a tawp hi; tuale Benjamin’ ip sungah tua hai kimu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin amate in a puon uh a ehmal vua, a laate uh van suonin khuopi lamah a kilekia uhi."},"14":{"text":"Joseph’ inn ah Judah le a sanggamte a tun ciengun khum munah Joseph na om lai hi; tuale ama’ mai lei lahah amate a kun uhi."},"15":{"text":"Joseph in amate kungah, “Na gamtat uh bangci gamtat ahiei? Kei aisan thei mi khat ka hi lam nei thei sih uh amah?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale Judah in, “Ka pu kungah bang thu ka gen thei ding uh ahei? Bang gen thei ding ka hi uh e? Ko le ko bangci kiphel thei ding ka hi uh ahei? Pasien in na nasemte’ khielna mu zo hi; tua ahile tam sunga om kote le a khut sunga hai kimuna pa zong, ka pu’ sila ka hi ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle ama in, “Tua bangin sem vawt sih vang! Hai a kimuna a nei pa beh ka sila hi ding hi; ahi vangin no na hi uleh na pa kung vuah lungnuomin peito ta un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah Judah peito a, “Ka pu aw, hepina tawh na nasempa in ka pu’ bil kawmah kam khat ei gensah inlen, na nasempa tungah lungthah sin; bang ding ahei cile nang pen Pharaoh ma tawh kibang na hi hi.","title":"Benjamin Suotah nading Judah in Ngen"},"19":{"text":"Ka pu in a nasemte nei dong a, ‘Pa ahi a, sanggam ahi zongin na nei vuoi mah?’ nei ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale kote in ka pu kungah, ‘Pa vuoi khat ka nei vua, a khangham zaw cienga a nei sanggam pasal khat ka nei uhi. A sanggampa si zo hi. A nu’ tate sung panin ama beh omlai a, a pa in ama it mama hi,’ kang ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin nangma in na nasemte kungah, ‘Ka mit tawh ama ka mu thei nadingin ka kungah hing zawpisuh ta un,’ nei ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Kote in zong ka pu uh kungah, ‘Tua tangvalpa in a pa nuasie thei mawh sih va. Azieh pen a pa nuasie leh a pa si thei mawh ding hi,’ kang ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin nang in na nasemte kungah, ‘Na nautum pen uh nang zawpi sih uleh ka mai na mu nawn sih ding uhi,’ nei ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Na nasempa ka pa uh kung ka tun ciengun ka pu thugen teng ama kungah ka gensawn uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ka pa un, ‘Peikia unlen an themkhat va leikia ta un,’ ei ci ciengin"},"26":{"text":"kote in, ‘Ka peisuh thei sih ding uhi. Ka nautum pen utawh ka zawton uleh beh ka peisuh ding uhi; azieh pen ka nautum utawh ka zaw sih ngeingei uleh tua mipa mai ka mu thei sih ding uhi,’ ka ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin na nasempa ka pa un ka kung vuah, ‘Ka zi in tapa ni a nei na thei uhi;"},"28":{"text":"khat in lah ei nuasie ta a, keima in ama pen a ki-ehmal zo hi ta, ka ci hi. Khum huna kipanin ama ka mu ta sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka kung panin tami a khat zong na lah kia vua, ama tungah sietna khat ang tun leh, Misikhuo ah ka samkangte dana tawh na peipisuh ding uh ahi ta hi,’ ei ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in na nasempa ka pa kungah ka tun ciengun tami tangvalpa zawpi sih uleng, tangvalpa’ hinna khu ama’ hinna tawh a kikhiton ziehin,"},"31":{"text":"kote tawh tua tangvalpa ka zawton lo uh ama in ei mu ciengin ama si mawh ding hi; ko na nasemte in dana tawh na nasempa ka pa uh’ samkangte Misikhuo-a a puohsuh ka hi ta ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen na nasempa keima khu tua tangvalpa tangin ka pa kunga kikham ka hi a, ‘Na kunga ama kang nuatut sih tah leh na muna-ah tua mawna ka khan tawntungin ka puo ding hi,’ ka ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in hepina tawh tangvalpa tangin ka pu kungah keima na nasempa sila-in ei omsah zing inlen; a sanggamte tawh tua tangvalpa peisahkia in."},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen tua tangvalpa zawpi loin ka pa kung bangci zot thei ding ka hei? Ka pa tunga ang tung ding gimna ka en ngam sih hi,” a ci hi."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kunga a ding mi zosie mai-ah Joseph ki-ip zo nawn loin, “Ka kung panin mi zosie peikhie sah un,” ci-in kiko hi. Tuaci’n a sanggamte kungah Joseph a kipulah ciengin ama kungah koima dang om lo hi.","title":"A Sanggamte Kungah Joseph Kipulah","ref":"Sawl 7:13"},"2":{"text":"A gingin kap ahi ziehin Egypt-te le Pharaoh’ inn kuonte in za uhi."},"3":{"text":"Joseph in a sanggamte kungah, “Keima Joseph ka hi hi. Ka pa a hing lai nai mah?” a ci hi. Hinanle a sanggamte in ama a dawng sih vua, tuaci’n ama mai-ah amkham gawp uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in a sanggamte kungah, “Ka kung ei nai un,” a ci hi. Tuale amate in ama kung a nai uhi. Ama in, “Kei pen Egypt gama nei zua uh na sanggampa uh Joseph ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in lungkham sih unlen, tam munah nei zua ziehun zong kithangpai suo sih un; azieh pen mihing’ hinna a hu dinga Pasien in na masang vua ei na sawl ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen gam sungah tam kum ni sung kielpi tung zo hi; lo hlaw lo nading le an lah lo nading kum nga sung omlai hi."},"7":{"text":"Na mai vuah leitunga a omlai teng a kemcing ding le a suohta no mi tampitah hinsuo dinga Pasien in kei ei na sawl ahi bo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n tam sunga kei ei sawl pen note na hi sih vua, Pasien ahi zaw hi; ama in Pharaoh khut nei-ah a ulien penin ei bawlin ama’ innkuonpi zosie le Egypt gam bup-ah vaihawm dingin keima ei koi zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka pa kungah mallang tahin va pei unlen ama kungah, ‘Na tapa Joseph in tam bangin gen hi: Pasien in Egypt gam buppi’ vaihawmin ei koi zo hi; ka kungah hing peisuh taheh. Kiheh sih heh."},"10":{"text":"Goshen leitangah na teng ding a, nang le na tate le na tate’ tate, na tuuhonte, na bawnghonte, le na nei zosie tawh ka gei-ah na om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ang tung ding kielpi kum nga omlai ahi ziehin nang le na innkuonpite, le na neisa zosie tungah zawnna a tun lo nadingin khum sungah kang va ding hi, ci hi,’ va ci ta un.","ref":"Sawl 7:14"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in keima in ka kam tawh na kung vua kang thugente noma’ mit le ka nau Benjamin’ mit in nei mu uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka pa kungah Egypt gama keima ei kipatawi dan le na mu zosie uh na gen ding uhi. Kinaw unlen tam sungah ka pa hing zawpisuh ta un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a sanggampa Benjamin ngawng kawi kawmin puasuhin kap a, Benjamin in zong ama ngawng kawi-in a kap hi."},"15":{"text":"tuale ama in a sanggam zosie tawpin a kaa hi; tua zaw ciengin a sanggamte in ama a hopi uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Joseph’ sanggamte ang pei zo ta uhi,” ci thu Pharaoh’ inn sungah a kizah ciengin Pharaoh le a nasemte a lungdam uhi."},"17":{"text":"Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “Na sanggamte kungah, ‘Hici bangin gamta un: Na ganhingte’ van suo unlen Canaan gamah peikia un."},"18":{"text":"Na pa ule na innkuonte va la unlen keima kungah hing pei ta un. Tuaci’n Egypt gama mun hoipen note kang pie ding a, leitang hoi sunga piengte na ne ding uhi,’ ci-in."},"19":{"text":"Nangma in na genbe lai dingah, ‘Tam bangin gamta un: Na tate le na zite vua dingin Egypt panin leengte kengin na pa uh hing zawpi unlen hing pei ta un."},"20":{"text":"Egypt gam sung mun hoi zosie nomau-a’ ahi ziehin na neisate uh ngaisutin nei da lel un,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua bang ma-in Israel’ tapate a gamta uhi. Pharaoh’ thupieh dung zui-in Joseph in amate leeng pie a, lampi-a a neh ding uh an zong guon hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in puon sil khat ciet amate guon hi; ahi vangin Benjamin pen ngun shekel zathum le puon sil nga guon hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in tam teng a pa a hlah ahi hi: Egypt’ van hoite a puo laa sawm khat, le antang, moh, le lampi-a a pa neh ding an puo ding laapi sawm ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sanggamte sawl a, amate a pei ciengun ama in a kung vuah, “Lampi-ah kihau malmal sih un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Egypt gam panin a peito vua, a pa uh Jacob kung Canaan gam a tung uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuale amate in a kungah, “Joseph hing lai hi! Egypt gam buppi nangawn ah ama vaihawmpi pa ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Ama a lungam gawp hi; ama in amau’ thugen um thei lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joseph’ thugen zosie ama kungah a gen uh ciengin ama kipuoh nadinga Joseph in a sawl leengte a mu bepin, a pa uh Jacob’ lungsim a hingkia hi."},"28":{"text":"Jacob in, “Pha zo ta! Ka tapa Joseph hing lai hi. Ka si masangin pei-in ama ka mu ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A neisa zosie tawh Israel khuolzin a, Beer-sheba a tun tahin a pa Isaac’ Pasien tungah biehpiehnate a pie hi.","title":"Jacob in A Innkuonpi Zosie Egypt-ah Zawpi (Pei 6:14-25)"},"2":{"text":"Zanlai a mangmuna-ah Pasien in Israel hopi a, “Jacob, Jacob,” ci hi. Ama in, “Kei tanah om ing,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Kei pen na pa’ Pasien ahi, Pasien ka hi hi; Egypt gam peisuh ding zau sin, azieh pen khum sungah minam lien khatin kang bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei mama in Egypt ah hing zawpi suhin kang peipito kia ding hi; tuale Joseph’ mit in na mit tungah a khut nga ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Beer-sheba panin Jacob a dingkhie hi; Israel’ tapate in ama tuon nadinga Pharaoh’ hlah leengte tungah a pa uh Jacob, a tate, le a zite a puo uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in a ganhonte ule Canaan gam sunga a lam uh vante la-in a peipi vua, Jacob le a suonlehlahte zosie ahi,","ref":"Sawl 7:15"},"7":{"text":"a tapate, le a tapate’ tapate tawh, a tanute, le a tapate’ tanute; ama’ suonlehlahte zosie Egypt gamah a peipi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng Egypt gama pei Jacob’ suonlehlahte’ min ahi hi. Jacob’ ta a upa pen Reuben"},"9":{"text":"le Reuben’ tapate: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, le Carmi ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Simeon’ tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, le Canaan numei’ tapa Shaul ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Levi’ tapate: Gershon, Kohath, le Merari ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah’ tapate: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, le Zerah ahi hi. (ahi vangin Canaan gamah Er le Onan a si hi); tuale Perez’ tapate pen Hezron le Hamul ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Issachar’ tapate: Tola, Puvah, Jashub, le Shimron ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Zebulun’ tapate: Sered, Elon, le Jahleel ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"(tam teng pen Paddanaram-ah Leah tawh a nei Jacob’ suonte hi a, a tanu Dinah tawh zong ahi hi; a tapate zosie a tanute zosie sawmthum le thum ahi hi.)"},"16":{"text":"Gad’ tapate: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, le Areli ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Asher’ tapate: Imnah, Ishvah, Ashvi, Beriah, le a sanggamnu uh Serah ahi hi. Beriah’ tapate: Heber le Malchiel ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"(Tam teng pen Laban in a tanu Leah tunga a pieh Zilpah’ tapate ahi hi; ama in Jacob tawh tam teng nei a, mimal sawm le guh ahi hi.)"},"19":{"text":"Jacob’ zi Rachel’ tapate: Joseph le Benjamin ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Joseph in Egypt gamah On khuo siempu Potiphera’ tanu Asenath tawh Manasseh le Ephraim nei hi.","ref":"Pien 41:50-52"},"21":{"text":"Benjamin’ tapate: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, le Ard ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"(Tam teng pen Rachel tawh a nei Jacob’ suonte hi a, a unpi-in mimal sawm le ni ahi hi.)"},"23":{"text":"Dan’ tapa Hushim ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Naphtali’ tapate: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, le Shillem ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"(Tam teng pen Laban in a tanu Rachel’ tunga a pieh Bilhah in Jacob tawh a nei tapate hi a, a unpi-in mimal sagi ahi hi.)"},"26":{"text":"Egypt gam sunga a lut Jacob-a’ ahi ama suonlehlah, Jacob tate’ zite kisim lo, a unpi-in mimal sawmguh le guh ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Joseph in Egypt gam-a a nei a tapate ni ahi hi; Egypt gama pei Jacob’ innkuon zosie sawm sagi ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel in ama’ mai Goshen ah lam lah dingin Joseph kungah Judah a masawl hi. Goshen gamah a tun ciengun,","title":"Goshen ah Jacob Teng"},"29":{"text":"Joseph in a leengte kithawisahin a pa Jacob dawn dingin Goshen ah a peito hi. Ama kungah a va kihil ta a, tuale ama ngawng kawi-in bapi khat sung a kap hi."},"30":{"text":"Israel in Joseph kungah, “Kei mama in a hing lai na hi lam hing mu zo ka hi ziehin tu-in ka si thei ta hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Joseph in a sanggamte le a pa’ innkuonpite kungah, “Pharaoh kungah keima va peito-in, ‘Ka kungah Canaan gama a teng ka sanggamte le ka pa’ innkuonpite ang ptung zo ta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua mite pen gankhawite ahi ziehun amate tuucingte ahi uhi. Amate in a tuuhonte uh, a bawnghonte ule a nei a lam zosie uh ang peipi uhi,’ ka va ci ta ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Pharaoh in ang hlat a, na kung vuah, ‘Bang sem na hi vuoi?’ ang ci ciengin,"},"34":{"text":"‘Na nasemte in ka neu lai panun tu dongin koma le ka pate ka ni-un gancing mi ka hi uhi,’ na ci ding uhi. Tua hileh Goshen leitangah na teng thei ding uhi, azieh pen Egypt-te adingin tuucing kici poma a kidahhuoi ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph pei-in Pharaoh kungah, “Ka pa le ka sanggamte, a tuuhonte, a bawnghonte ule a neisa zosie utawh Canaan gam panin ang pei uhi; tu-in Goshen gamah a om uhi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama in a sanggamte lahah mihing nga zawpi-in Pharaoh kungah a peipi hi."},"3":{"text":"Pharaoh in a sanggamte kungah, “Na nasep uh bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Amate in Pharaoh kungah, “Ka pu ka pate uh ma bangin na nasem kote tuucing ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Pharaoh kungah, “Tam gamah pemta dinga ang pei ka hi uhi; azieh pen Canaan gamah kielpi a natsiet ziehin khum munah na nasemte’ gantate neh ding hampa lohing a om nawn sih hi. Tu-in Goshen gamah na nasemte ei tengsah in, kang thum uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in Joseph kungah, “Na kungah na pa le na sanggamte ang tung zo ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma mai-ah Egypt leitang a om hi. Gam hoipen munah na pa le na sanggamte tengsah in; Goshen leitangah amate tengsah in; amate lahah mi pilvang a om lam na thei leh ka ganhingte kem dingin koi in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in a pa Jacob zawpi-in Pharaoh’ mai-ah laa a, tuale Jacob in zong Pharaoh thupha a pie hi."},"8":{"text":"Pharaoh in Jacob kungah, “Kum bang za na pha tai?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jacob in Pharaoh kungah, “Leisiet ka pemta hinkhuo khu kum za le kum sawmthum ahi hi; ka nuntah hun pen tomin hamsa hi. Kum sawtveipi pemta a na hi sung uh ka pate’ kumte tawh tekah thei ding ahi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in Pharaoh thupha a pie a, Pharaoh’ opna panin a pei hi."},"11":{"text":"Pharaoh’ thupieh bangin Joseph in amau’ nei dingin Egypt gama leitang hoipen ahi Rameses leitang pie a, tua sungah a pa le a sanggamte a tengsah hi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph in a pa, a sanggamte, le a pa’ innkuonpi zosie a ne ding za tawh kituohin an a va hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in ahile kielpi a natsiet seng ziehin gam zosie-ah an om nawn lo hi. Kielpi ziehin Egypt gam le Canaan gam a vulnaang gawp uhi.","title":"Egypt Kielpi"},"14":{"text":"Egypt gam le Canaan gam sunga antang lei nadinga a khel uh sum kinga zosie Joseph in a kaikhawm hi; tuale Joseph in Pharaoh’ inn ah tua sum teng a puoh hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gam le Canaan gam sunga sum zosie a tawp sieng zaw ciengin Joseph kungah Egypt mi zosie a pei vua, “An ei pie in! Bang dingin na muna-ah si ding ka hi uh ahei? Azieh pen ka sum teng uh tawp sieng zo hi,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph in dawng a, “Na sum uh a tawp sieng tah leh na ganhonte ei pie un. Keima in an kang pie ding a, na gante utawh i kikhel ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Joseph kungah a ganhonte a peipi uhi; tuale Joseph in sakolte, tuuhonte, bawnghonte, le laate khelna-in amate an a pie hi. Tua kumin amate an pie a, a ganhon zosie utawh a khelpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua kum a tawp zaw, a kumkia ciengin a peikia vua, “Ka sum uh a tawp lam ka pu kungah kang pha thei sih uhi. Ka ganta zosie ulah ka pu-a’ ahi ta hi. Ka pumpite ule ka mun ka gamte uh ci simlo ka pu’ muna-ah bangma om nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma’ muna-ah kote le ka gam uh a siton ding ka ta uh amah? Koma le ka leitang uh an tawh ei khel in. Koma, ka leitang utawh Pharaoh’ sila ka hi ding uhi; kielsi loin ka hin nading ule ka gam uh a hawmsuo lo nadingin khaici ei pie in,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph in Pharaoh adingin Egypt gam zosie a lei hi. Amate tungah kielpi a natsiet ziehin Egypt mi zosie in a logamte uh a zuamang uhi; tuale leitang teng Pharaoh-a’ a suoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte ahile, ama in Egypt mongkhat panin mong khat dongin amau’ sila-in bawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in siempute’ leitang beh lei lo hi; bangzieh ahei cile siempute in Pharaoh kung panin a kiciengtan za an a nga vua, Pharaoh in a pieh an tawh amate a luhing thei uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate in a leitangte uh a zua sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in mite kungah, “Tu-in noma le na leitang uh Pharaoh adingin ka lei zo hi. Tam sungah note dingin khaici a om hi; leitang tungah vaw un."},"24":{"text":"Anlah hun ciengin Pharaoh tungah nga-a-khat na pie ding vua, nga-a-li pen khaici ding, noma le na innkuonpite le na tate an neh dingin na tang ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in, “Ka hinna uh nei hun zo hi; ka pu uh lungdam heh, Pharaoh’ sila ka hi ta ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh in nga-ah-khat nei ding hi, a ci pen, tuni donga a om, Egypt leitang tawh kisai-in Joseph in ngaina kip khatin a bawl hi. Siempute’ leitang beh Pharaoh-a’ suoh lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Egypt gam sung Goshen leitangah Israel teng hi; tua sungah neisa tampi nei-in suonlehlah tampi a pha uhi.","title":"Jacob’ Hinkhuo Nukhia Hunte"},"28":{"text":"Egypt gamah Jacob kum sawm le kum sagi sung teng hi; tuaci’n Jacob’ khan kum za le sawmli le sagi ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel a si ding hun a nai ciengin ama in a tapa Joseph hlanin a kungah, “Na mitmu-in maipha ka nga leh ka phei nei-ah na khut hing koi inlen, thuman thutah tawh nei bawl nadingin hing kiciem in. Egypt gamah ei vui poma sin."},"30":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate tawh ka lupton ciengin Egypt gam panin ka luong ei puo inlen, amau’ kivuina hanah ei vui in,” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Na gen bangin ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 49:29-32; 50:6"},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka kungah hing kiciem in,” a ci hi; tuale a pa kungah ama kiciem hi. Tua ciengin ama’ lupna khawhlung ah Israel a kunsuh hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami zaw ciengin Joseph kungah, “Na pa a cina hi,” ci-in kigen hi. Tuaci’n ama in a tate ni, Manasseh le Ephraim a zawpi hi.","title":"Jacob in Joseph’ Tate Thupha Pie (Heb 11:21)"},"2":{"text":"Jacob kungah, “Na tapa Joseph na kungah hing tung ta,” a kici ciengin ama in a tha sanin lupna tungah a to hi."},"3":{"text":"Jacob in Joseph kungah, “Canaan gam Luz khuo-a ka kungah Vanglien Pasien hing kilahin thupha ei pie a,"},"4":{"text":"ama in keima kungah, “Nang kang ciphasah ding a, tampi-in kang khangsah ding hi; mi honpi khat kang suohsah ding a, nang zaw cienga na suonlehlahte in a nei zing dingin tam leitang ka pie ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Egypt gam nangma kung kang tun masanga Egypt gam sunga a suoh na tapa nite tu-in keima-a’ ahi hi; Reuben le Simeon-te ma bangin Ephraim le Manasseh zong keima-a’ hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate zaw cienga a pieng ta le naute pen nangma-a’ hi ding hi. Amau’ gouluona tawh kisai-in a sanggamte’ minin amate kiciemte ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen Paddan panin ka pei lai-in Canaan gam Ephrath khuo tun kuon, Canaan gam lamkalah ka da ka kaa nadingin Rachel in ei na sisan a, Ephrath (tua pen Bethlehem) peina lampi-ah ama ka vui hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 35:16-19"},"8":{"text":"Jacob in Joseph’ tate a mu bepin, “Tam naupangte koi-a’ ahiei,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Joseph in a pa kungah, “Pasien in tam sunga ei pieh ka tapate ahi hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Thupha ka pieh thei nadingin hepina tawh ka kungah hing peipi in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in Jacob a khangham ziehin ama in khuo a mu thei ta sih hi. Tuaci’n Joseph in ama kungah amate a peipi hi; tuale ama in amate tawpin a kawipom hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel in Joseph kungah, “Na maitang mu dingin ka kinem vawt sih hi; Pasien in tam sungah na tate zong ei musah hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in ama gel a pa’ khup panin ladawhin lei lam nga-in a kunsuh hi."},"13":{"text":"Joseph in Ephraim’ zietlam khut, Jacob’ veilam khutah, Manasseh’ veilam khut, Jacob’ zietlam khutah a nipi-in ama gel kai-in ama lam nehin a peipi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jacob in a khut zahin a naupa Ephraim’ lu tungah ngam a, Manasseh a suoh masa pen ahi ziehin a khut kipaipe sahin a lu tungah a veilam khut ngam hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Joseph thupha pie a, “Ka pu ka pa Abraham le Isaac in ama’ mai-ah a na peina Pasien, tuni dong ka hinkhuo vannuoi-ah ka tuucingpa ahi Pasien,"},"16":{"text":"sietna zosie panin ei tankhie vantungmi in naupangte thupha pie taheh; amate sungah keima’ min le ka pu ka pate ahi Abraham le Isaac’ minin kilo hinlen; amate mihonpi khatin leitungah pung ta uheh” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A pa in Ephraim’ lu tungah a zietlam khut a koi pen Joseph in a mu ciengin lung kim lo hi; tuaci’n ama in a pa’ khut la dawh a, Ephraim’ lu tung panin Manasseh’ lu tungah koipieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Joseph in a pa kungah, “Tua bang hi lo hi, ka pa aw! Tam pa a suoh masa zaw ahi ziehin na zietlam khut ama’ lu tungah koi in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pa in a niel a, “Thei ing, ka ta aw, ka thei hi; ama zong mi nam khat suohin a lien ding hi. Ahi vangin ama sangin a naupa a lienzaw ding a, ama’ suonlehlahte minam honpi khat suoh ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in ama in amate thupha pie a, Note’ min tawh Israel-te thupha kipie ding a, ‘Ephraim le Manasseh bangin Pasien in note hing bawl taheh,’ a ci ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in Manasseh mai-ah Ephraim a koi hi.","ref":"Heb 11:21"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in Joseph kungah, “Kei a si ding ka hi ta a, ahi vangin Pasien in nang hing ompi-in na pu na pate’ leitangah ang peipikia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in ka namsau le ka thalpi tawh Amor’ mite khut tung pana ka na lah ahi tanh lah panin na sanggamte sangin tanh khat a tamzaw-in kang pie hi,” a ci hi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jacob in a tapate hlan a: “Ang tung ding hunte-ah na tung vuah bang teng ang pieng ding ci kang gen thei nadingin hing ki-im un, a ci hi.","title":"Jacob’ A Tawpna Kam Vaihlah"},"2":{"text":"Jacob’ tapate aw, hing kikhawmin za unlen, na pa Israel’ thugen ngai un."},"3":{"text":"Reuben, nang ka tapa tapen, ka thahatna le ka tacil, zalien pente tunga zalien pen le thunei pente’ tunga thunei pen na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuihuol bangin na sih ding a, tungnung pen zong na hi sih ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile na pa’ lupna-ah na kato hi; nang ka lupna tungah na ka a, ka lupna na buasah hi!"},"5":{"text":"Simeon le Levi, unau ahi hi; a namsaute uh pen tatsietna’ hiem ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Amau’ kikhopna-ah ei lutsah ngai sinlen; amate tawh ei kipawlsah sin. Bangzieh ahei cile amate lungthahin mi a that vua, amate in guolnop apmaina-in bawngtangte’ kapzahui a sattan pieh uhi."},"7":{"text":"A lungthahna uh a zauhuoi a, a thangpaina uh a giinhuoi ziehin amate in samsiet nga ta uheh! Jacob sungah amate khenkhe-in amate Israel sungah ka thezah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah aw, na sanggamte in nang ang phat ding uhi; na galte’ ngawngah na khut a om ding hi; na mai-ah na pa’ tapate ang kun ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Judah, humpi khanglai ahi hi; ka ta aw, nangma in na samatsa na nehna panin na kipeito ta hi. Humpi apa bangin ama kize-in a lum hi. Humpi anu tawh a kibang ama koi in phong ngam ding ahei?","ref":"Gam 24:9; Kln 5:5"},"10":{"text":"Ama tungah sieh le kaih a tun masang, mite in ama’ thu a man masangin, Judah panin kumpi ciengkhut le ama’ keng kikala uhpa’ ciengkhut kikhin lo ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"Ama in lenggui-ah a sakolno khi-in, lenggui hoi penah a laano khi a, lenggazu sungah a puonte sawpin, lenggatui san sungah a puonsilte sawp hi;"},"12":{"text":"a mitte lenggazu sangin sanzaw a, a hate bawngnawi sangin kangzaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Zebulun tuipi gei-ah teng ding a, tembaw khawlna mun suoh ding hi. Sidon khu ama’ gamgi hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Issachar, a hat laa tawh kibang a, tuuhuong kikalah lum hi;"},"15":{"text":"ama in khawlna mun hoi khat le leitang nop tuoh khat mu hi. Tuaci’n ama in van puo dingin a liengko niemsah a, thona aana nasepna ah ama sila a suoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Dan in Israel minam khat bangin a mipite thu a khen ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Dan, lam gei-a gulpi hi ding a, lam dunga gul gunei hi ding hi. Sakol tunga tuong pa a thalpua nadingin ama in sakol’ ketul a tuhpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa aw, keima in na hutdamna ka ngah hi."},"19":{"text":"Misuomte in Gad sim ding a, ahi vangin ama in amau’ ketul a sim ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Asher’ a an tui ding a, ama in kumpi antuite a bawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Naphtali, a kihla sakhipi ahi a, a melhoi sakhinote a nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Joseph, singba gapha ahi a, ciatui gei-a po singba gapha hi-in, kul tungah a bate a zam hi."},"23":{"text":"Thal kap siemte in nasie tahin ama a do vua, amate in thal tawh kapin ama a genthei bawl uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanle a thal nem ngai loin a bante gang mama hi. Jacob’ Vanglien Pa’ khut, Israel Suongpi, Tuucingpa’ min,"},"25":{"text":"ang hu ding na pa’ Pasien, thupha ang pie ding Vanglienpa , vantunga om thuphate, leinei a thuhna sunga thuphate, nawi le sul thuphate, na tungah ang pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Na pa’ thuphate pen kumtawn muolte’ thuphate, tawntung muoltangte’ thuphate sangin a lienzaw hi. Tua thuphate, Joseph’ lu tung, a sanggamte lahah a kituomkoi pa’ talpang tungah hing tu taheh."},"27":{"text":"Benjamin khu ngie gilkiel ahi a, zingmawngin a sa mat nawmvalin, nitah ciengin a matsa teng a hawm hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam teng zosie Israel minam sawm le nite ahi vua, tam pen a pa un amate khat ciet tawh kituohin thupha a pieh kawma a kung vua a gen thute ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in amate thuhilin a kung vuah, “Kei ka hi leh ka mite tawh a kigawm ding ka hi ta hi. Hit mi Ephron’ lolai-a suonghawm sungah ka pu ka pate tawh ei vuiton unlen,","title":"Jacob’ Sina le Kivuina"},"30":{"text":"tuami suonghawm khu Mamre nisuona lam Machpelah lomun Canaan gam sunga om ahi a, Abraham in hankhuh dinga a na leisa mun ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 23:3-20"},"31":{"text":"Tua munah Abraham le a zi Sarah kivui hi; tua mun ma-ah Isaac le a zi Rebekah zong kivui hi; tuale keima in tua munah Leah ka na vui hi.","ref":"Pien 25:9-10; Pien 35:29"},"32":{"text":"A lo le a sunga om suonghawm pen Hit-te kung pana kilei ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Jacob in a tate thuhil a man zaw ciengin a lupna tungah laitat a, a nukhia pen a husangin a mipite kung a zuon ta hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:15"}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph a pa tungah pua-in a pa kaa-in a nam hi."},"2":{"text":"Joseph in a pa luong a muot lo nadinga a bawl dingin zatui siemte thu a pie hi. Tuaci’n zatui siemte in Israel zatui a nu uhi;"},"3":{"text":"amate in tami bawl nadingin ni sawmli sung hun a zang uhi, bang ding ahei cile tua khu zatui nu nadinga a kisam hun ahi hi. Tuale Egypt-te in ni sawm sagi sung ama kaa uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama zieha kaana nite a tawp ciengin Joseph in Pharaoh’ innkuonte kungah, “Tu-in na mai vuah maipha ka nga leh hepina tawh Pharaoh kungah tam bangin thu ei genpieh un:"},"5":{"text":"Ka pa in ei kiciemsah hi; ama in, ‘Kei a si ding ka hi ta hi. Canaan leitanga keima dinga ka lemsa hankhuh sungah nei vui ding hi,’ ei ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin ka pa ka vui thei nadingin tu-in ei peitosah in; tua ciengin kang kilekia ding hi, ci hi, ei va cipieh ta un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 47:29-31"},"6":{"text":"Pharaoh in dawng a, “Peito-in ang kiciemsah bangin na pa va vui ta’n,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pa vui dingin Joseph a peito hi. Ama tawh Pharaoh’ nasemte zosie, a innsung upate, le Egypt gam sunga upate zosie,"},"8":{"text":"Joseph’ innkuonte zosie, a sanggamte, a pa’ innkuonte tawh zong a peito uhi. Gosheh gamah a tate uh, a tuuhonte uh, le a bawnghonte beh uh kinuasie hi."},"9":{"text":"Leengte le sakol galkapte tawh ama a peito hi. Amate a pawlcing mama uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jordan gun galkhat, Atad’ bucilna phuol a tun ciengun, khum munah nahpitahin a kap uhi; tuale ama in a pa ziehin ni sagi sung dana hun a zang hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum gama a teng Canaan-te in Atad’ bucilna phuola kaa le mau a mu ciengun, “Tam khu Egypt-te adinga a nasie mama kaa le mau ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Tua ahi ziehin khum mun pen Abel-Mizraim kici hi. Khum mun khu Jordan gun galkhat ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate tunga a vaihlah bangin a tapate in a bawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in Canaan gamah ama a puo vua, Abraham in hankhuh dinga Hit mi Ephron’ kung pana a na leisa ahi Mamre nisuona lam Machpelah mun lolai-a suonghawm sungah a vui uhi.","ref":"Sawl 7:16"},"14":{"text":"A pa a vui zaw ciengin a sanggamte le a zawpito mi zosie tawh Egypt ah ama a kilekia hi."},"15":{"text":"A pa uh si zo ci a thei ciengun Joseph’ sanggamte in, “Joseph in eite ei lungsim puohin ama tunga i bawlsa uh khielnate a unpi-in ei thuhkia mawh leh maw?” a kici uhi.","title":"Joseph in A Sanggamte’ Mawna Maisah"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Joseph kung a nai vua, “Na pa in a si masangin tam thuhilna ei nei a,"},"17":{"text":"‘Joseph kungah tam bangin gen un: Na sanggamte in na tunga sietna ang bawl ziehun a khielnate uh maisah in, kang thum hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin tu-in hepina tawh na pa Pasien’ nasemte khielna ei maisah in,” a ci uhi. Amate in ama a hopi ciengun Joseph kap hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sanggamte zong kapin ama’ mai-ah a pua vua, “Tami munah na silate ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joseph in a kung vuah, “Zau sih un! Kei Pasien muna om ka hi amah?"},"20":{"text":"Note in kei siet nading na gel vangun, Pasien in tuni-a a sep bangin mi tampite’ hinna a humbih thei nadingin a hoi dinga a na gel ahi bo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n zau sih ulen, keima in noma le na tate kang va ding hi,” a ci hi. Tam bang danin amate a lungnuomsah a, kamhlum no tawh amate a hopi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph, ama le a pa’ innkuonte tawh Egypt gamah a teng uhi; tuale Joseph kum za le kum sawm a hing hi.","title":"Joseph’ Hun Nukhia le A Sina (Heb 11:22)"},"23":{"text":"Joseph in Ephraim’ tate khang thumna dong mu hi; Manasseh’ tapa Machir’ tate zong Joseph’ khup tunga suoh ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in a sanggamte kungah, “Kei a si ding ka hi ta hi; ahi vangin na kung vuah Pasien ang pei valon ding a, tuale ama in tami leitang panin Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tunga a ciemsa leitangah note ang peipito ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joseph in Israel-te kiciemsah a, “Na kung vuah Pasien ang pei ciengin tami mun panin ka gu ka tangte na puoto ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 13:19; Josh 24:32; Heb 11:12"},"26":{"text":"Kum za le kum sawm a phahin Joseph a si hi; ama zatui kinu a, Egypt gam sunga misi kuong khatah kikoi hi."}}}}},"2":{"info":{"name":"Peikhietna","shortname":"Pei","abbr":[],"desc":"Peikhietna (exodus)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jacob tawh Egypt gama a zawhton, a innkuon ciet utawh ahi Israel’ tapate’ min ahi hi:"},"2":{"text":"Reuben, Simeon, Levi, le Judah,"},"3":{"text":"Isschar, Zebulun, le Benjamin,"},"4":{"text":"Dan le Naphtali, Gad le Asher-te ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 46:8-27"},"5":{"text":"Jacob pana a pieng zosie a unpi-in sawm sagi a pha hi. Joseph pen Egypt gamah a na om zo ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph, a sanggamte zosie, le tua khangmi zosie a si sieng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te cipha-in tampi a pha uhi; amate tamin hat citahin a hat vua, tuaci’n gam sung teng a dim uhi.","ref":"Sawl 7:17"},"8":{"text":"Tu-in Egypt gamah Joseph a thei lo kumpi khat a khang hi.","title":"Israel-te Kibawlsie","ref":"Sawl 7:18"},"9":{"text":"Ama in a mite kungah, “En un, Israel mite ei sangin tam zaw-in zong a thahat zaw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hing pei un, pilvang tahin amate bawl vai, tua banga i bawl sih leh amate ang pung ding a, gal le sa hing om leh ei do dingin i galte ang pawl ding vua, i gam panin ang taimang ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin thona-aana sepsahna tawh amate a gawt dingin a tung vuah nasem uhte a koi uhi. Amate in Pharaoh adingin ankholna khuopite ahi, Pithom le Rameses-te a lam uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle a kibawlsiet ciengin amate tampi pha semsemin a kizelthang zaw vua, tuaci’n Egypt-te in Israel-te giing mama uhi."},"13":{"text":"Egypt-te in Israel-te na semsahin a gawgam mama vua,"},"14":{"text":"buoncil nasep le a hamsa tehlei bawl nasep le lolai-a nasep namkim tawh a hinkhuo uh a genthei sah uhi. A sepsahna zosie vuah amate a gawgam mama uhi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in Hebrew naudomte, khat’ min Shiphrah, le adang khat’ min Puah a kicite kungah,"},"16":{"text":"“Hebrew numeite nau na dop ciengun nausuona topha tungah a to nausen en unlen, tapa ahile that un; tanu ahileh na hinkhawi ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin naudomte in Pasien a giing uhi; amate in Egypt kumpipa thupieh mang loin nausen pasalte a hinkhawi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Egypt kumpipa in naudomte hlansahin amate kungah, “Bang dinga tam bang na na sep vua, nausen pasalte na hinkhawi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Naudomte in Pharaoh kungah, “Hebrew numeite pen Egypt numeite tawh kibang lo hi; bang ding ahei cile amate a thahat mama vua, naudomte tun masangin a na suoh zo ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien in naudomte a limbawl hi; tuale mite pungin a thahat mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Naudomte in Pasien a giin ziehun amate tungah Pasien in innkuonte a pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in ama’ mite zosie thupie a, “Hebrew-te sung panin a pieng tapa zosie Nile gun sungah na pai ding vua, ahi vangin tanu kici popo na hinkhawi ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:19"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Levi’ suonte khat pei-in Levi numei khat zi-in a la hi.","title":"Moses’ Suona le A Khangno Hun (Heb 11:23)"},"2":{"text":"Tua numei gai-in tapa khat a nei hi; ama in a deihuoi nausenno khat ahi hi, ci-a a mu ciengin tua nausen hla thum sung a phuol hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in nausen a phuol zawh nawn lo ciengin pumpeng tawh kiphan law khat bawlin suong meihol nai le singnai tawh a zut hi; tua nu in law sungah nausen sielin gun gei-a pumpeng nawng lahah a koi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama bang ang kilaw ei ci a thei nadingin a gamla mun khatah a sanggamnu a ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A kisil dingin Pharaoh’ tanu gunah a peisuh a, a nasemte gun gei-ah a vah uhi. Pharaoh’ tanu in pumpeng lahah law khat mu a, tua law a la dingin a nasem nu khat a sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in tua law a hon ciengin nausen mu hi. Tua nausen a kap hi. Ama in nausen a khuotuo a, “Tam pen Hebrew tate lahah khat hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sanggamnu in Pharaoh’ tanu kungah, “ Kei va pei-in Hebrew numeite lahah naucing ding mi khat kang suipieh diei mah?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Pharaoh’ tanu in ama kungah, “Hoi hi, va sui ta’n,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama kuonin a nausen’ nu hlan hi."},"9":{"text":"Pharaoh’ tanu in ama kungah, “Tami nausen la inlen kei adingin ei keppieh in, na thaman kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tua numei in nausen la-in a kem hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua nausen a gol ciengin ama in Pharaoh’ tanu kungah a peipi a, tuaci’n ama’ ta dingin a la hi. Ama in tua nausen’ min Moses hisah hi. Azieh pen ama in, “Tui sung panin ama ka kaikhie hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni khat, Moses a gol zaw ciengin a mite kungah pei-in a thona-aana a septe uh a mu hi. Egypt mi khat in a sanggam Hebrew mi khat a sat ama in mu hi.","title":"Midian ah Moses Tai (Heb 11:24-25)"},"12":{"text":"Ama khuodah kawikawi a, mi koima mu lo ahi ziehin tua Egypt mipa thatin senel lahah a phuol hi."},"13":{"text":"A zing ni-a ang peikia ciengin ama in a kihau Hebrew mi ni a mu hi; a khielpa kungah, “Bang dinga na guolpa na vuoh ahiei?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “Ko tungah vaihawm thukhen dingin nang koi pen’ ang se ahiei? Egypt mipa na tha bangin kei ei tha sawm na hi amah?” a ci hi. Tua bepin Moses in, “Ka silbawl ei kithei hi ta,” ci-in ngaisunin a zau hi."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh in tua thu a zah ciengin Moses tha dingin a sui hi. Ahi vangin Pharaoh kung panin Moses a taimang hi. Midian gamah tengin tuikhuh gei khatah a to hi."},"16":{"text":"Midian siempu pa in tanu sagi nei hi. Tui tawi dingin a pei vua, a pa uh’ ganhingte dawn dingin a tui-um te a dim uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuucing pawlkhat pei-in amate a notmang uhi. Moses ding to-in amate a hu a, a tuuhonte uh tui a piehpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"A pa Reuel kungah a tun ciengun, “A bangci-a tuni-a hing hici tun bai na hi vuoi?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in, “Egypt mipa khat in tuucingte khut sung panin ei hunkhie a, ko adingin tui nangawn ei tawipiehin tuuhonte zongtui ei piehpieh hi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in a tanute kungah, “Ama hei sungah a om ei? Bang dinga tua mipa nang nuasie uh ahiei? An nehpi dingin va hlan ta un,” ci-in a sawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mipa tawh opton ding Moses thukim a, tua pa in a tanu Zipporah tawh Moses a kinungsah hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua nu in tapa khat nei a, a min Gershom a phuo hi. Azieh pen ama in, “Kei gamdanga teng pemta ka hi ta hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Hun sawtpi zaw ciengin Egypt kumpipa a si hi. A saltanna ziehun Israel-te kapin mau-in kiko uhi. A saltanna panun huna ngenin a kikona uh Pasien kung a tung hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasien in a tauna uh za a, Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tawh a thuciemna a phawh hi."},"25":{"text":"Pasien in Israel-te a en a, tuale Pasien in amate a phawh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Midian-te’ siempu ahi a sungpa Jethro’ tuuhonte a cing hi. Ama in gamlah nitumna lamah a tuute peipi a, Pasien’ muol Horeb a tung hi.","title":"Sawlbawh Kuong Lahah Moses (Pei 6:2–7:7 ; 11:1-4 ; 12:35-36)"},"2":{"text":"Khum mun sawlbawh lah meikuong sung panin ama kungah Topa’ vantungmi kilang hi; ama in a et leh tua sawlbawh kuong a, hinanle a katum sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in, “Kei va pei-in tami ka sil mu lamdang ka en ding a, bang dinga sawlbawh katum lo ahei ci ka va kan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"A en dinga ama a peina Topa in a mu bepin Pasien in sawlpang kawm panin ama hlan a, “Moses, Moses!” ci hi. Ama in, “Tanah om ing,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Ei nai sin! Na kenga na kedapte sutdawh in, azieh pen tua na dinna mun khu mun siengtho ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in, “Keima in na pa’ Pasien, Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien, le Jacob’ Pasien ka hi hi,” a cibe lai hi. Moses in Pasien a et ngam lo ziehin a mai a hum hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Egypt gama ka mite thuoh gimna ka mu zo ta hi; amate tunga nasem uhte ziehin keima in a kikona uh aw ka za zo hi. A thuoh uh gimnate ka thei a,"},"8":{"text":"Egypt-te khut sung panin amate a hunkhie ding le khum gam panin a hoi a tanzau leitang, bawngnawi le khuoizu a luonna leitang, Canaan-te, Hit-te, Amor-te, Perez-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te’ opna munah amate a peipi dingin kang peisuh zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in ka kungah Israel-te kikona ang tung zo a, Egypt-te in amate a gawtna ka mu zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n hing pei-in Egypt panin ka mi Israel-te a peipi dingin Pharaoh kungah kang sawl ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:30-34"},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Pasien kungah, “Kei koi ka hi a, Pharaoh kungah pei-in Egypt panin Israel-te va peipi ta ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “Nangma tawh kang omton ding hi; tami khu nangma ang sawl keima ka hina lim hi ding hi: Egypt panin Israel-te na peipi zaw ciengin tami muol tungah Pasien na bie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Pasien kungah, “Israel-te kungah pei inlen amate kungah, ‘Na pate uh’ Pasien in na kung vuah ei sawl hi,’ vaci taleng amate in, ’A min bang ahei?’ ci-in ei dong uleh amate kungah bang ka gen ta diei?” a ci hi.","title":"Pasien’ Min Kipulah","ref":"Pei 6:2-3"},"14":{"text":"Pasien in Moses kungah, “ KEIMA AHI KEIMA ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Israel-te kungah, ‘ KEIMA a kici pa in na kung vuah keima ei sawl hi,’ ci-in tam bangin na gen ding hi,” a cibe lai hi.","ref":"Kln 1:4, 8"},"15":{"text":"Pasien in zong Moses kungah, “Tam bangin Israel-te kungah, ‘ Topa , na pate uh’ Pasien, Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien, le Jacob’ Pasien in na kung vuah kei ei sawl hi,’ na ci ding uhi: Tam pen keima min’ hi tawntung ding a, tam pen khang tawntungin ei kilawna hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Pei-in Israel upate khawm inlen a kung vuah, “ Topa , na pu na pate uh’ Pasien, Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien le Jacob’ Pasien keima tungah ang kilah zo hi. Egypt gam sungah na tung vua ang kibawlna ka mu zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt’ gimna panin Canaan-te, Hit-te, Amor-te, Perez-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te’ leitang, bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna leitangah note kang peipito ding hi,’ ci hi,” va ci ta’n."},"18":{"text":"Amate in na thu ang ngai ding uhi; tuale Egypt kumpipa kungah nang le Israel upate pei-in ama kungah, “ Topa ahi Hebrew mite’ Pasien in kote ei kimupi zo hi; ka Pasien uh ahi Topa tungah biehna ka lui thei nadingun ni thum peina gamlahah ei peisah in,’ va ci ta un."},"19":{"text":"Hizongle khut thahat khat’ paubawlna longal tawh Egypt kumpipa in note ang peisah lo ding lam ka thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka khut zahin tua sunga ka bawl ding na lamdangte tawh Egypt-te ka vatmai ding hi; tua zaw ciengin ama in note ang peisah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in Egypt-te muna-ah tam mihingte maipha ka pie ding hi. Na pei ciengun khut guoh tawh na pei sih ding uhi;"},"22":{"text":"numei a kici poma in a vengte le a inn sunga zintungte kung panin ngun le kham tawh kibawl kizepnate le puonsil nihtente a ngen ding vua, na tapate le na tanute na silsah ding uhi; tua bangin note in Egypt-te’ van na lahpieh ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 12:35-36"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in, “Ahi vangin amate in kei ei tahsang loin ahi sihle ka thu ei ngai sih hinlen, ‘Nangma kungah Topa hing kilaa sih,’ ei ci mawh uleh bang ka law ta diei?” ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"A Lamdang Moses’ Vanglietna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Na khut sunga khu bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ciengkhut,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Tua khu tuolah sep vawi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in tua ciengkhut tuolah a sep leh gul khat a suoh hi; tuale ama kung panin Moses a nuakin hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Na khut zah inlen tua gul a mei-ah man in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a khut zahin gulpi a man le ama’ khut sungah ciengkhut khat a suoh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tuaci’n amate in a tahsan thei nadingun nangma kungah Topa , a Pasien uh ahi Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien le Jacob’ Pasien ang kilangzo hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Na puontuol kawmah na khut koi in,” khatvei a cikia hi. Ama in a puontuol kawmah a khut a koi hi; ama in a khut a lah ciengin a khut phah gawp a, vua bangin a ngo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in, “Na puontuol kawmah na khut koikia vawi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a puontuol kawmah a khut koikia-in a khut a lakia leh a tahsa ngai ma bangin a omkia hi."},"8":{"text":"“Amate in nang ang tahsan sih vua, ahi sihle lim masa pen a thudon sih phiel ule zong lim nukhia pen tahsang kha thei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tami lim ni tegel nangawn tahsang loin ang thudon sih uleh Nile gun panin tui halkhat la-in lei gawta lahah na sung ding hi; tuale Nile gun pana na lah ding tui pen lei gawta tungah sisan a suoh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Topa kungah, “Ka Topa aw, tu masie ahi a, na sila pa nei hopi tu mama nangawnin ahi zongin kei mi dangnal ka hi ngai vawt sih hi; a muon ham vahuot le a lei awhpi ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ama kungah, “Mihingte kam koi pieh ahiei? Koi in amate hamsah thei lo, ahi sihle bil bingsah, khuo musah, ahi sihle mit tawsah ahei? Topa , ahi keima’ bawl hi lo amah?"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in kuon inlen na kam tawh kang om ding a, na thugen ding kang hil ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle ama in, “Ka Topa aw, hing thum ing, midang khat sawl zaw in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses tungah Topa a sin so a, ama in, “Levi mi na sanggampa Aaron om hi lo amah? Ama in hoitahin thu a gen thei lam ka thei hi; tu nangawnin nang ang dawn dingin ama ang pei a, nangma ang mu ciengin a lung a nuom ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang in ama hopi-in a kam sungah thu na muom ding hi; nangma’ kam le ama’ kam tawh keima kang om ding a, na sep na bawl ding uh kang hil ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in mite tungah nang adingin thu a gen ding hi; ama pen nang adingin na kamin ang pang ding a, nang zong ama adingin a Pasien bangin na pang ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na khut sungah tami ciengkhut tawi inlen, tua tawh limte na bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"A sungpa Jethro kungah Moses peikia-in a kungah, “Hing thum ing, Egypt gama ka unaute a hing lai uh amah, a en dingin amate kungah ei hawsah in,” a ci hi. Tuale Jethro in Moses kungah, “Lungnuom tahin pei in,” a ci hi.","title":"Egypt-ah Moses Kilekia"},"19":{"text":"Midian gam sungah Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt gamah peikia in; azieh pen nangma ang tha sawm mi zosie si sieng zo hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in a zi le a tapate a la a, laa tung khatah amate tuongsahin Egypt gamah a peikia uhi; tuale Moses in a khut sungah Pasien’ ciengkhut a tawi hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt gamah na peikia ciengin Pharaoh mai-ah na sep thei dinga kang piehsa na lamdang zosie na bawl ding thei gige in; ahi vangin keima in a lungtang ka khausah ding a, tuaci’n mite a peisah sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin nangma in Pharaoh kungah, ‘ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Israel ka tapa a tapen ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima nang kungah, “Ama in kei ei bieh thei nadingin ka tapa peisah in,” kang ci hi.
