Ahi vangin nang in ama a pei ding na phal sih hi; tu-in keima in na tapa a tapen pa ka that ding hi,’ vaci ta’n,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 12:29"},"24":{"text":"Lamkal mun khatah amate a zan gie vua, Topa in Moses na dawnin ama tha ding a na hanciem hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Zipporah in suonghiem khat la-in a tapa’ tep tanpieh a, tua tawh Moses’ keng thamin, “A mantahin nang pen kei tungah sisan tawh ka mopa na hi hi!” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama guohin a omsah hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Teptanna hangin sisan tawh ka mopa na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in Aaron kungah, “Moses dawn dingin gamlahah pei in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama a pei hi; tuale ama in Pasien’ muolah ama mu-in a nam hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in ama a sawlna thu zosie le a bawl dinga a sawl limte zosie Moses in Aaron kungah a gen hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses le Aaron pei-in Israel upate a unpi-in a kaikhawm uhi."},"30":{"text":"Aaron in Moses kungah Topa gensa thu zosie a unpi-in a gen a, mite muna-ah limte a bawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Mite in a um uhi; Topa in Israel-te a thudon lam za-in, a gentheina uh a mu lam a thei ciengun amate kunin Pasien a bie uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Pharaoh kungah Moses le Aaron a pei vua, “Israel Pasien Topa in, ‘Senel gama kei kungah pawi khat a bawl thei nadingun ka mite peisah in,’ ci hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Butu Kihal Lo Tehlei"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharaoh in, “Ama thugen mangin Israel-te ka peisah na valia dingin Topa kici pa khu koi ahiei? Tua Topa ka thei kha vawt sih a, Israel-te zong ka peisah sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Ka kung vuah Hebrew-te’ Pasien ang kihil hi; Topa ka Pasien uh tungah biehpiehna ka lui thei nadingun ni thum khuolzinna senel gamah kote ei peisah in, tua ahi sihle ama in kote tungah pulnatna ahi sihle namsau ang tungsah ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Egypt kumpipa in ama gel kungah, “Moses le Aaron aw, bang dinga mite na sem thei lo-a na koi gel ahei? Na nasep uh kisep khinkhian lel un!” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Pharaoh in a thugen zom a, “Tu-in gam mite sangin amate a tamzaw ta vua, hizongle amate nasep na khawlsah nuom lai uhi!” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Pharaoh in khum ni ma-in nasem uhte le nasem vante thu pie a,"},"7":{"text":"“Masang lai bangin mite tungah tehlei bawl nading butu na pie nawn sih ding uhi; Peisah unlen amate ding butu khawmsah un."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate kungah masang lai-a a tehlei khenza ma na ngen ding uhi; a khen za ding uh khiem sih un, bangzieh ahei cile amate mi thada ahi uhi; tua ziehin amate in, “Ka Pasien uh kungah biehpiehna ka bawl thei nadingun ei peisah in,’ ci-in a kiko uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate tungah nasep a hamsa zaw suon un; tua hile amate nasep kitahla-in zuou thu kigente a don ta sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n nasem uhte le mite’ nasep vante pei-in mite kungah, “Pharaoh in, ‘Butu kang pie ta sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Pei unlen na sui thei theina vuah kisui tawm ta un. Ahi vangin na nasep uh themkhat mama kikhiem lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n butu tangin hampa khawm dingin Egypt gam zosie-ah mite a kikhenzah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Nasem uhte in kin ngaisutin, “Butu ang kipieh lai ma bangin nisiela nasep ding za ma uh zo un,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Pharaoh’ nasem uhte in Israel nasep vante kisat gawpin, “Bang dinga masang lam bangin zani le tuni-a man dinga ang kipie tehlei bawl zo lo na hi uh ahei?” ci-in amate kidong hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel’ nasep vante pei-in Pharaoh kungah, “Bang dinga na nasemte tam banga na bawl tah lawm ahei?"},"16":{"text":"Na nasemte butu ei kipie sih a, ahi vangin amate in ka kung vuah, ‘Tehlei bawl un!’ ei ci uhi. Na nasemte ei kisat dan en vawi! Na mite tungah na thuman sih hi,” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “Note na thasie uhi, na thasie uhi; tua ahi ziehin, “Pasien kungah biehna pie dingin ei peisah in,’ na ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in pei unlen na sem un. Azieh pen butu ang kipie sih ding a, hizongle tehlei a mal ngaina za ma na bawl veve ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in, “Ni sima na tehlei seh za uh khiem lo ding,” a ci ciengun Israel’ nasep vante in thu hamsa a tuo lam a kithei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Pharaoh kung panin a pei ciengun amate dawn dinga a na ngah Moses le Aaron tawh a kimu uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in, “ Topa in note hing enin thu hing khen taheh! Bangzieh ahei cile Pharaoh le a nasemte muna-ah ko a khiel nei suohsah vua, ko tha nadingin a khut sung vuah namsau khat na koi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa lamah Moses kihei kia-in,” Topa aw, bang dinga tam mite na bawlsiet ahei? Bang dinga kei nei sawl gumsan ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Pharaoh kungah na min tawh thu gen dinga ka pei masah lai-a kipanin ama in tam mite a bawlsie zo hi. Nang in na mite suotah nading bangma na bawl vawt sih hi,” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kung ah, “Tu-in Pharaoh tunga ka bawl ding na mu ding hi: Ama in a vanglien khut tawh amate a peisah valon ding hi; ama in a vanglien khut khat tawh a gam sung panin amate a notmang ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Israel-te Hutkhiet ding Kigen (Pei 3:1–4:17)"},"2":{"text":"Pasien in zong Moses hopi-in ama tungah tam bangci hi: “Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Abraham, Isaac le Jacob-te tungah Vanglien Pasien-in ka kilang a, ahi vangin amate kungah ka min Topa ci-in ka kitheisah sih hi.","ref":"Pien 17:1; 28:3; 35:11; Pei 3:13-15"},"4":{"text":"Keima in pemta bangin a tenna uh Canaan leitang pieh dingin amate tawh thuciemna ka kipsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in Egypt-te khut sungah saltang Israel-te’ mauna aw zong ka za zo a, ka kamciemna ka phawh zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel-te kungah, “Keima Topa ka hi hi. Keima in Egypt-te’ vangih panin note kang hla ding a, amau’ sila hina panin kang suohta sah ding hi. Keima in a thahat a kizah ban le thukhenna nasep lien tawh kang tan ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima’ mi dingin note kang la ding a, na Pasien uh ka hi ding hi. Egypt mite’ vangih pana a suohta sah, Topa ka hina uh note in na thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob-te tungah pieh dinga ka ciemsa leitangah note kang peipi ding a, na luo dingun tua leitang kang pie ding hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi,’ ci-un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te kungah tam thu a gen hi. Ahi vangin a lungsim uh a kitapzanna le a gimsie a saltanna ziehun amate in Moses’ thugen a ngai sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah,"},"11":{"text":"“Pei inlen a gam panin Israel-te a peisah nadingin Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kungah va gen ta’n,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Topa hopi a, “Israel-te in ka thugen a ngai sih uhi; tua ahi ziehin a dangnal lo kei thugen bangci bangin Pharaoh in ei ngai ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam bangin Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh le Israel-te tungtang thu Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi a, Egypt gam panin Israel-te a hla nadingun amate thu a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng pen amahaw’ be lutangte ahi uhi: Israel’ tapa tapen Reuben’ tapate: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, le Carmi ahi hi; tam teng pen Reuben’ innkuonte ahi uhi.","title":"Moses le Aaron’ Khangsimna (Pien 46:8-27)"},"15":{"text":"Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, le Canaan numei‘ tapa shaul ahi hi; tam teng pen Simeon’ innkuonte ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tam teng pen a khang utawh kizui-in Levi tapate’ min ahi hi: Gershon, Kohath, le Merari ahi a, Levi kum za le kum sawmthum le sagi a hing hi."},"17":{"text":"Gershon tapate: amate’ innkuon ciet tawh kizui-in Libni le Shimei ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron le Uzziel hi a, Kohath pen kum za le kum sawmthum le thum a hing hi."},"19":{"text":"Merari tapate: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Tam teng pen amau’ khang tawh kizui-in Levi’ innkuonte ahi uhi.","ref":"Gam 3:17-20; 26:57-58; 1Khg 6:16-19"},"20":{"text":"Amram in a pa’ sanggamnu Jochebed zi-in la a, tua nu in ama tawh Aaron le Moses nei hi. Amram kum za le kum sawmthum le sagi a hing hi."},"21":{"text":"Izhar tapate: Korah, Nepheg le Zichri ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Uzziel’ tapate: Mishael, Elzaphan le Sithri ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Aaron in Amminadab’ tanu, Nahshon’ sanggam nu Elisheba zi-in a la hi. Tua nu in ama tawh Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Korah’ tapate: Assir, Elkanah le Abiasaph hi a, tam teng pen Korah-te’ innkuonte ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in Putiel’ tanute khat zi-in a la hi. Tua nu in ama tawh Phinehas nei hi. Tam teng pen a innkuon kuonin Levi-te’ be lutangte ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in, “Egypt panin Israel-te a honhonin peikhiet pi in,” a cina mite pen tam Aaron le Moses-te ma ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Egypt panin Israel-te a kipeipi nading thu Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh tawh a kiho mite pen tam Moses le Aaron ma ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah Topa in Moses a hopi ni-in,","title":"Moses le Aaron in Pasien’ Thupiehte Mang"},"29":{"text":"ama in, “Keima in Topa ka hi hi. Nang tunga kang gen zosie Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kungah gen in,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Topa kungah, “En in, kei pen thugen siem lo mi ka hi hi. Bang dingin Pharaoh in kei thugen ei ngai ding ahei?” a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “En in, keima in Pharaoh tungah Pasien bangin nang kang bawl zo a, na sanggampa Aaron pen na kamsangpa hi ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Nang kang thupieh zosie na gen ding a, na sanggampa Aaron in ama’ leitang panin Israel-te a peisah nadingin Pharoah kungah a gen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharaoh’ lungtang ka khausah ding a, Egypt gamah ka limte le na lamdangte ka tamsah ding hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:36"},"4":{"text":"Pharaoh in na thu ang ngai lo ciengin keima in Egypt tungah ka khut ka nga ding a, thukhenna nasepna lienpite tawh ka mipi Israel-te a honhonin Egypt gam panin ka peipi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt-te lang khatah ka khut zahin amate sung panin keima in Israel-te ka peikhietpi ciengin Egypt-te in keima Topa ka hina ei thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin Moses le Aaron-te in a bawl uhi; Topa’ thupieh bangin amate in a sem uhi."},"7":{"text":"Pharaoh tawh ama gel a kiho hunin Moses kum sawmgiet pha a, Aaron kum sawmgiet le kum thum pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron kungah,","title":"A Lamdang Aaron’ Ciengkhut (Pei 4:1-5)"},"9":{"text":"“Pharaoh in na kung vuah, ‘Na lamdang khat hing bawl un,’ ang ci ciengin nangma in Aaron kungah, ‘Na ciengkhut la inlen Pharaoh mai-ah sepsuh in, tua ciengkhut gul ang suoh ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh kungah Moses le Aaron pei-in Topa thupieh bangin a bawl uhi; Aaron in Pharaoh le a uliente mai-ah a ciengkhut a sepsuh a, gul khat a suoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in mipilte le ai siemte hlan hi; Egypt mitphiel siemte in zong a siemna utawh tua bang lien ma-in a bawl thei uhi."},"12":{"text":"A ciengkhut ciet uh a sepsuh vua, tuate gul vive a suoh hi; ahi vangin Aaron’ ciengkhut in amau-a’ a valtum hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa gensa bangin Pharaoh’ lungsim khauh lai a, ama in a thugen uh a ngai nuom sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Pharaoh’ lungtang khauh mama a, ama in mite peisah nuom lo hi.","title":"Gimna Khatna: Tui Sisan Suoh"},"15":{"text":"Zingmawngin gunah Pharaoh a pei ciengin ama kungah pei in; ama tawh kimu dingin gun gei-ah ding inlen, gul a suoh ciengkhut pen ma na khut sungah tawi in."},"16":{"text":"Ama kungah, ‘Senel gamah keima ei bieh thei nadingun, “Ka mite peisah in, ci-in a gen dingin Hebrew-te’ Pasien, Topa in na kungah kei ei sawl hi,” ci-in gen in. Ahi vangin tu dongin ama’ thu na mang nai vaset sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Topa in, “Keima Topa ka hina tami tawh na thei ding hi,” ci hi. En in, ka khut sunga ciengkhut tawh Nile gun sunga tui ka sat ding a, tua tui sisan a suoh ding hi.","ref":"Kln 16:4"},"18":{"text":"Gun sunga om ngate si-in, a gun mama uithan ding a, Egypt-te in Nile guntui a dawn thei sih ding uhi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Aaron kungah, ‘Na ciengkhut la inlen tuate sisan a suo thei nadingin Egypt tuite uh tung, a gunte uh tung, a tuilamte uh tung, a tui tawdawhte uh tung le a buol zosie uh tungah na khut zah in; tuale Egypt gamsung zosie-ah sisan om ding a, sing beel le suong beel sung teng nangawnah sisan om ding hi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in Topa’ thupieh bang ma-in a bawl uhi. Ama in Pharaoh le a uliente muna-ah tua ciengkhut vihto-in gun sunga om tua tui sat a, gun sunga tui zosie sisan a suoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Gun sunga ngate a si sieng hi. Tua guntui khu a ui ziehin Egypt-te in tui a dawn thei sih uhi. Egypt gam mun zosie-ah sisan a dim hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanle mitphiel siem Egypt mite in a siemna utawh tua bang lien ma-in bawl thei uhi; tuaci’n Topa gensa bangin Pharaoh’ lungtang a khauh ngai bangin khauh a, a thu uh ngai lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Pharaoh kihei-in a inn sungah lut a, a lungsim sung nangawnah tam thu ngaisutin a nei nawn sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in guntui a dawn thei lo ziehun Egypt-te zosie in Nile gun kimah dawn ding tui a to uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in Nile gun a sat zaw ni sagi pha ta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kung ah, “Pharaoh kungah pei-in ama kungah, ‘ Topa in tam bangci hi: “Amate in keima ei bieh thei nadingun ka mite peisah in.","title":"Gimna Nina: Uphawhte"},"2":{"text":"Amate na peisah nuom sih leh uphawh tawh na gam buppi gimna kang pie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nile gun sungah uphawh a dim ding hi; na kumpi inn sung, na lupna inndan sung, na lupna tung, na uliente’ inn sung le na mipite’ inn sung, na lungthu tung ule na annel pawina kuong sung teng vuah ang lut ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma tung, na mite tung le na ulien zosie tungah uphawhte ang kato ding hi,” ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Aaron kungah, ‘Gunte, tui zawite, le buoltuite tungah na ciengkhut tawh na khut zah inlen, Egypt leitang tungah uphawhte katosah in,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Aaron in Egypt’ tuite tungah a khut a zah hi; tuale uphawhte kato a, Egypt leitang a tuommang hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanle mitphiel siemte in a siemna utawh tua bang lien ma-in a bawl thei vua, Egypt leitang tungah uphawhte a katosah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron hlanin, “Kei le ka mite kung panin uphawhte a lah nadingin Topa kungah thu ngen un. Topa kungah biehna lui dingin mite ka peisah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in Pharaoh kungah, “Na kung pan le na innte panin uphawhte kihemin Nile gun sung behah a om den nadingin bang hun ciengin nang ading, na uliente ading le na mipite adingin thu hing ngetpieh ding ka hei, ei gen in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, ”Zing cieng,” a ci hi. Moses in, “ Topa kohaw’ Pasien tawh a kibang koima om lo hi, ci na thei nadingin na ci bang hi taheh!"},"11":{"text":"Uphawhte in nang le na innte, na uliente le na mite ang peisan ding hi; Nile gun behah amate kinuasie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh kung pan Moses le Aaron a pei uhi; tuale Moses in Pharaoh tunga a tunsah uphawhte tawh kisai-in Topa kungah a kiko hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Moses ngetna bangin a bawl hi: Inn sung, innhuong sung, le lote lahah uphawhte a si hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in a lom lomin tuate a khawm vua, gam sung teng a uithan sieng hi."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh in a noptuom lam a mu ciengin a lungtang khausah a, Topa gensa bangin amate’ thu ngai lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Aaron kungah, ‘Egypt gam buppi-ah gam tho a om nadingin na ciengkhut zah inlen leivui sat in,’ ci-in,” a ci hi.","title":"Gimna Thumna: Gam thote"},"17":{"text":"Tuale amate in tua bang ma-in a bawl uhi; Aaron in a ciengkhut tawh a khut zahin leivui sat a, mihing tung le ganhing tungah a kibangin gam thote tu hi; Egypt gambuppi sunga leivui zosie gam tho a suoh sieng hi."},"18":{"text":"Mitphiel siemte in a phuolsel uh siemna tawh gam tho suosah ding a hanciem vangun a bawl thei sih uhi. Mihingte le ganhingte tungah gam tho a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Mitphiel siemte in Pharaoh kungah, “Tami khu Pasien’ khutme ahi bo hi!” a ci uhi. Hinanle Pharaoh’ lungsim khauh a, Topa gensa bangin a thugen uh a ngai sih hi.","ref":"Luk 11:20"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Zingmawng tho bai inlen, tuikhuh zuonin Pharaoh ang pei ciengin a mai-ah na kilah inlen ama kungah, ‘ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Amate in keima ei bieh thei nadingun ka mite peisah in.","title":"Gimna Lina: Ankuong Thote"},"21":{"text":"Tua bang hi loin ka mite na peisah nuom sih leh nang, na uliente, na mite tung le na inn sung tengah ankuong tho honpite kang hla ding hi; Egypt-te’ innte le tuate’ tenna leitang zong ankuong tho honpite tawh a kidim ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua ni ciengin tami leitangah kei Topa ka hina na thei nadingun, ka mite tenna Goshen leitang ankuong tho honpite in a bop lo nadingin ka tuom koi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin ka mite le na mite kikalah kilamdanna khat ka bawl ding hi. Zing ciengin tam ciemtena ang om ding hi,” ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in tua bang ma-in bawl a, ankuong tho honpite in Pharaoh’ inn sung le a uliente’ inn sung teng a bawm valuoi hi; ankuong thote ziehin Egypt gamsung zosie-ah leitang kisie hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron hlanin ama in, “Pei un, tam gam sungah na Pasien uh tungah biehna lui un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in, ”Tua banga bawl ding pen dih lo hi; azieh pen ka Topa ka Pasien uh kunga ka lui uh biehna pen Egypt-te adingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi. Egypt-te muna-ah a kidah uh biehna lui uleng amate in suong tawh ei seplia lo ding uh amah?"},"27":{"text":"Ni thum sung peina gamlahah pei-in, ama’ ei thupieh bangin Topa ka Pasien uh kungah biehna ka va lui ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh in, ”Gamlapi-ah na pei sih ding po uleh gam lahah Topa na Pasien uh tungah biehna lui dingin kang peisah ding hi. Kei adingin thu ei ngetpieh in,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in, “Nangma kung panin ka pei zaw behin Topa kungah thu ka ngen ding a, zing ciengin Pharaoh kung pan, a uliente kung pan le a mite kung panin ankuong tho honpite a leng mang sieng ding hi; Topa kunga biehna a pie ding mite phal lona tawh Pharaoh hing zuoutat kia nawn poma sin,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh kung pan Moses pei-in Topa kungah thu a ngen hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa in Moses’ nget bangin a pie a, Pharaoh kung, a uliente kung, le a mite kung panin ankuong tho honpite lengmangsahin khat zong a om nawn sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharaoh in a lungtang khausah lai veve a, mite peisah nuom lo hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Pharaoh kungah pei-in ama kungah, ‘Hebrew-te’ Pasien Topa in tam bangci hi: Amate in keima ei bieh thei nadingun ka mite peisah in.","title":"Gimna Ngana: Ganhing Natna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate peisah nuom loin na tuhkon den leh,"},"3":{"text":"Topa’ banhat in na lozau-a a om ganhingte ahi, sakolte, laate, kalaohte, bawnghonte, le tuuhonte tungah pul natna tawh ang vatmai ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle Israel-a’ zosie khat beh a si lo nadingin Israel-te’ ganhingte le Egypt-te’ ganhingte kikalah Topa in kilamdanna khat a bawl ding hi,” ci hi, va ci ta’n,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in hun khat se a, “Zing ciengin Topa in gam sungah tami ang sem ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A zing ciengin Topa in tua bangin sem hi; Egypt-te’ ganhing zosie si sieng a, ahi vangin Israel-te’ ganhing khat zong si lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Pharaoh in thukante sawlin Israel-te’ ganhing khat zong a si lo lam thei hi. Ahi vangin Pharaoh’ lungtang khauh lai a, ama in mite peisah lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses le Aaron kungah, “Meikhuh sunga vut na khut dimin ham unlen, Pharaoh muna-ah Moses in vantung lamah tua vut theto heh.","title":"Gimna Guhna: Uilut (Thkna 28:27)"},"9":{"text":"Tua khu Egypt gam buppi-ah leivui nel suoh ding a, Egypt gam buppi-ah mihing le ganhingte tungah uilut hima a suoh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n meikhuh panin ama gel in vut la-in Pharaoh’ mai-ah a ding vua, Moses in vantung lamah tua vut a theto leh tuate in mihingte le ganhingte tungah uilut hima naikul a piengsah hi.","ref":"Kln 16:2"},"11":{"text":"Uilut hima ziehin Moses mai-ah mitphiel siemte a ding zo nawn sih uhi. Bang ding ahei cile mitphiel siemte le Egypt-te zosie in zong uilut a vei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Pharaoh’ lungtang khausah a, Moses kungah Topa in a gensa ma bangin ama in a thu uh ngai lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Zing ciengin thobai-inlen, Pharaoh mai-ah kipulahin ama kungah, ‘Hebrew-te’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangci hi: Amate in keima ei bieh thei nadingun ka mite peisah in.","title":"Gimna Sagina: Vanto le Gielpi"},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile leitung buppi-ah keima tawh a kibang koima khat beh om lo hi, ci na thei nadingin keima in tami hunin nang, na uliente, le na mite tungah ka pul natna zosie kang tungsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen tu-in ka khut zahin pul natna tawh nang le na mite kang vatmai thei a, leitung panin zong kang sumai thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle nangma kang hinkhawina pen tam zieh ahi hi: Na tungah ka vanglietna kang lah nading le leitung buppi-ah ka min a kiphuongzah thei nading ahi hi.","ref":"Rom 9:17"},"17":{"text":"Nang le nang na kiliensah lai vaset a, ka mite langbawlin a pei ding uh na phal sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Zing cieng tu bang hunin Egypt gam kisat huna kipan tuhun donga a kimu ngai nai lo, a nasie penpen gielpi ka kiesah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mi sawl inlen lozau-a na ganhingte le na nei na lam zosie munbih khatah tuosah in; tuate tungah gielpi ang kieh ciengin kibuhna munah a kipeipi lo, lozau-a a om mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin a si ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Pharaoh’ uliente lahah Topa’ kammal a zatah pawlkhat in munbih khatah a salte ule a ganhingte a nawtaisah uhi."},"21":{"text":"Topa’ kammal a thusim lo mite in lozau-ah a salte ule a ganhingte a nuasie uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt gam sung zosie-a om mihing, ganhing le Egypt gamsung lote lahah a po singkung zosiete tungah gielpi a kieh thei nadingin vantung lamah na khut zah in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantung lamah Moses in a ciengkhut zah a, Topa in van tosahin giel kiesah a, leitungah meikuong a kumsuh hi. Topa in Egypt gamah gielpi kiesah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuami laikimah gielpi le meikuong khawl loin phe lahlah a, gam khat ahi zaw a kipanin Egypt gamsung buppi-ah tam banga gielpi siehuoi a kie ngai nai sih hi.","ref":"Kln 8:7; 16:21"},"25":{"text":"Tumi gielpi in Egypt gambup sung lozau lahah a om na vannuoi, mihing le ganhing a ni-in a satpaai hi; gielpi in lozau-a kung zosie zong satpai a, lozau-a singkung zosie zong vattan hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel-te tenna Goshen gam behah gielpi kie lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in mi sawlin Moses le Aaron a hlansah a, ama gel kungah, “Tun-in ahile kei ka khiel zo ta hi; keima le ka mipite ka khiel vua, Topa a dih hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa kungah thum un! Pasien’ vanto le giel kicing zo ta! Kang peisah ta ding vua, na thaam uh a ngai nawn sih hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in ama kungah, “Tam khuopi panin ka pusuo behin Topa lamah ka khut ka zah ding hi. Leitung in Topa -a’ ahi hi, ci-in na thei nadingin vanto khawlin gielpi veng ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang le na uliente in Topa Pasien na giin nai vaset lo lam uh ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"(Tu-in anthul kungte le mangbuham kisie hi. Bang ding ahei cile mangbuhamte a vui laitah ahi a, anthul kungte a paa laitah ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin mangbu le mangbumante kisie lo hi. Azieh pen tuate khangham nai lo hi.)"},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh kung panin khuopi pulamah Moses peikhie a, Topa lamah a khut a zah ciengin vanto le gielpi khawl pai a, leitungah guo zu nawn lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharaoh in guopi, gielpi le vanto a theu zo lam a mu ciengin ama khatvei khiel lai a, ama le a uliente in a lungtang uh a khausah uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Moses tungtawnin a gensa bangin Pharaoh’ lungtang khausah a, Israel-te peisah lo hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Pharaoh kungah va pei in; azieh pen amate lahah tami ka limte ka lah thei nading le","title":"Gimna Gietna: Kauphete (Joel 1:2-4)"},"2":{"text":"Egypt-te ka motbawlna le amate lahah bang limte bawl zo ka hei, ci thu na tate le na tute’ zaha na gen thei nading le, keima Topa ka hi lam na thei nadingin ama’ lungtang le a uliente’ lungtang ka khausah hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh kungah Moses le Aaron pei-in, “Hebrew-te’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangci hi: ‘Ka mai-a nang kiniemkhieh ding bang tanvei niel sawm na hei? Amate in keima ei bieh thei nadingun ka mite peisah in."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ka mite pei ding na niel leh zing ciengin na gam sungah kauphe kang tungsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Koima in leitang a mu thei lo nadingin kauphete in lei maitang zosie tuommang ding uhi. Kauphe in giel khiehmawhte netum a, lozau-a na suon uh singkung zosie valtum sieng ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na innsung, na ulien zosie’ innsung le Egypt-te zosie’ inn sungah leitunga a pien vua kipan tuni dongin na pu na pate in a mukhah ngai nai lo uh kauphete a dimin ang om ding hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciengin ama kihei-in Pharaoh kung pan a pusuoh hi."},"7":{"text":"Pharaoh’ uliente in ama kungah, “Eite tungah tam mipa bang tanvei thangkam banga hing om ding ahei? Amate in a Pasien uh ahi Topa a bieh thei nadingun mite peisah in. Egypt a kisiet lam a thei nai lo na hi amah?” ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharaoh kungah Moses le Aaron kipeipi kia a, ama in a kung vuah, “Pei unlen na Topa na Pasien uh va bie ta un! Ahi vangin koi teng pei ding na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in, “Ka khangnote le ka khanghamte tawh ka pei ding uhi; ka tapate, ka tanute, ka ganhingte le ka bawnghonte utawh ka pei ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ pawi ka kham ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Pharaoh in amate kungah, “Note tawh na naupangte kang peisah tah leh no tawh Pasien ang om tahtah hi ta ven! Keima in kang sieng genin, na lungsim sung vuah ngimna hoi lo na nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bang hi thei buong lo e! No pasal teng pei unlen, Topa va bie ta un, azieh pen noma’ ang nget ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Pharaoh kung panin amate kinotmang hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt leitangah kauphete tu-in, gielpi’ khiehmawh kung zosie a neh thei nadingin Egypt leitang tungah na khut zah in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in Egypt leitang tungah a ciengkhut zah a, Topa in khumi ni sun tungtawn le khumi ni zan tungtawnin leitang tungah nisuona hui a langsah hi; zingmawng ciengin nisuona hui in kauphete a puoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Nidang hunin a om ngai nai lo, bangma cih hunin zong a om ngai nawn lo ding, Egypt leitang tung zosie-ah kauphe honpi tung a, Egypt gam buppi-ah a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitang a miel zo ding za-in kauphete in lei maitang vannuoi a tuomcip hi; amate in gam sunga om kung zosie le gielpi’ khiehmawh singkung ga zosie a netum uhi; Egypt leitang tung zosie-ah gamlah singkungte hile kungnote hile a na dawng khat beh om lo hi.","ref":"Kln 9:2-3"},"16":{"text":"Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron naw hlat a, “ Topa na Pasien uh’ tung le nogel tungah ka khiel zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu tung tami ka mawna ei maisah in. Ama in ka kung panin tami sina a lah nadingin na Topa Pasien kungah thum in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Pharaoh kung panin ama pei-in Topa kungah thu ngen hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in tuami nisuona huipi pen a hat mama nitumna huipi suohsah a, kauphete tawmangin San Tuipi denna-in nei hi; Egypt gam sungah kauphe khat zong om nawn lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Pharaoh’ lungtang khausah a, Israel-te peisah nuom lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt leitang tungah khuomiel, a kitham thei za-a khuomiel a om thei nadingin vantung lamah na khut zah in,” a ci hi.","title":"Gimna Kuona: Mutzin"},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in vantung lamah a khut zah a, Egypt gam leitang zosie-ah nithum sung mutzin a tung hi.","ref":"Late 105:28; Kln 16:10"},"23":{"text":"Ni thum sung amate khatlekhat a kimu thei sih vua, a opna panun koima a pupiel thei sih hi; ahi vangin Israel-te’ tenna munah khuo a vah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in Moses hlanin, “Pei unlen Topa va bie ta un. Na tuuhonte ule na bawnghonte uh beh nuasie un. Na tate uh nangawn zong na zawpi thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in, “ Topa ka Pasien uh’ tungah biehpiehnate le meihal biehnate nei piehsah lo phamaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka ganhingte uzong koma tawh a zawton lo phamaw a, ganhing kecin khat zong kinuasie thei lo ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa ka Pasien uh ka bieh nadingun tuate lah panin pawlkhat ka deitel ding uh phamaw hi. A mun ka tun masangun Topa bieh nadingin bang pen zang ding ci ka thei nai sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hizongle Topa in Pharaoh’ lungtang khausah a, a pei ding uh phal lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharaoh in ama kungah, “Ka kung panin peimang ta’n! Ka mai nei mukia lo nadingin kidawm in. Azieh pen ka mai nei mu ni ni-in na si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Na gen bangin hi taheh! Na mai kang mu ngai nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Pharaoh le Egypt tungah gimna khat ka tungsah lai ding hi; tua zaw ciengin tam mun panin ama in note ang peisah ding hi. Ama in note ang peisah ciengin ang notmang sieng ding uhi.","title":"A Nukhia Pen Gimna Genkholna (Pei 3:21-22 ; 12:35-36)"},"2":{"text":"Pasal poma in a vengte’ kung pan, numei poma in zong a vengte’ kung panin ngun le kham kizepnate a nget nadingun mite kungah gen in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt-te muna-ah Topa in mite maipha pie hi. Tua tham loin Moses mama zong Egypt leitang tung, Pharaoh’ uliente muna le mipite muna-ah mi thupi mama khat a suoh hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in, “ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Zankim pawlin Egypt gam muncin tengah ka pei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gama tacil zosie, a kumpi topha tunga to Pharaoh’ tacil pen a kipan, an gawina nua-a om nasem numei’ tacil zosie, le ganhing lah panin tacil zosie si ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Egypt gam buppi-ah bangma huna tua bang a om ngai lo, mai lamah zong a omkia ngai nawn lo ding kaana le mauna lienpi a om ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Egypt le Israel a tuom khen lenlon hi, ci na thei nadingun Israel-te, mihing hile ganhing hile, ui khat in zong kawh lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima kungah na uliente uh hing peisuhin, ka mai-ah ang lukun ding vua, ‘Nang le nangma ang zui mi zosie peidawh ta un,’ ang ci ding uhi. Tua ciengin kei ka pei ding hi,” a ci hi. Pharaoh’ kung panin a lungsosa-in peikhie hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt-ah nalamdang ka tam bawl thei nadingin Pharaoh in na thu ang ngai sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Pharaoh mai-ah Moses le Aaron in na lamdang tam teng a bawl uhi; ahi vangin Topa in Pharaoh’ lungtang khausah a, a leitang panin Israel-te peisah lo hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah Topa in Moses le Aaron kungah tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Amasa pen Peisan Pawi Kibawl (Gam 9:1-14 ; Thkna 16:1-8 ; Ezk 45:21-25)"},"2":{"text":"Tami hla pen note dingin hla kipatna hi ding hi; note dingin kum khat sunga a hla masa pen hi ding hi"},"3":{"text":"Israel mihon vannuoi kungah gen unlen, khumi hla ni sawm ni-in amate in a innkuon ciet vua dingin tuuno khat ta a la ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuuno luong khat ne dinga innkuonmi a tawm seng leh, a kinaipi pen a vengte tawh tua luong khat kitang ding uhi; a ne ding mi phaza tawh kituohin tuuno sa kihawm ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na tuuno uh paubaang lo, kum khat a cingsa apa khat hi ding hi; tuami adingin tuu ahi sihle keel khat popo na la thei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua tuuno, khumi hla ni sawm le ni li cieng dong na khum ding uhi; tua ciengin Israel mihon zosie in nitah lamin tuami gan go ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a si kimkhat la-in a sunga a nehna uh inn kotkhah khuom nite le a bangtung zawl nu ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in khumi zan ma-in tuuno sa ne ding uhi; amate in mei-ah tua sa hangin tol saw lo anlum le tangkhate tawh me ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua sa a sielin ahi sihle tui tawh huonin na ne sih ding vua, ahi vangin mei tungah a lu a kengte le a sungkuote na hang ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Zingmawng dongin tuate khawnla khat beh na omsah sih ding uhi; zingmawng donga a kikhawngla popo na haltum ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na neh dan ding uh tam bang ahi hi: Na kawng uh kigahin na keng vuah kedap bunin, na khut vuah na ciengkhut uh na tawi ding uhi; tuale mallang tahin na ne ding uhi. Tuami khu Topa’ Peisan Pawi ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen khum zanin Egypt leitang ka nawhsuoh ding a, Egypt leitang tunga om tacil zosie, mihingte le ganhingte a nipi-in ka vatmai ding hi; Egypt pasien-te zosie tungah thu ka khen ding hi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Na tenna uh inn tunga sisan khu no adingin lim khat hi ding hi: Keima in sisan ka mu ciengin kang kalsan ding vua, Egypt leitang ka vatmai ciengin zong ang susie ding gimna na tung vuah ang tung sih ding hi.","ref":"Siem 23:5; Gam 9:1-5; 28:16; Thkna 16:1-2"},"14":{"text":"Tami ni pen note dingin phawna ni hi ding hi. Note in Topa tungah tuami ni pen pawi bawlna ni-in na zang ding uhi; na khang tungtawnun biehna ngaina kip khatin na nei zing ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tol saw lo anlum na ne ding uhi; a ni masa ni-in na inn panun tol na hemdawh ding uhi, azieh pen mi khatpo in a ni masa panin a ni sagi ni dongin tol kisaw anlum a neh leh Israel sung panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in a siengtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uhi, tuale a ni sagi ni-in zong a siengtho kikhopna khat ma na nei ding uhi; mi zosie’ neh ding an na huon ding uh ci simlo, tua hun sung tengin bangma na kisem lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tolsaw lo anlum pawi na bawl ding uhi, bang ding ahei cile tua ni ma-in keima in Egypt leitang panin na mihonte uh ka peipi hi: Na khang tawntungun tami ni pen biehna ngaina kip khatin na nei zing ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"A hla masa pen, a ni sawm le ni li ni panin ni sawmni le ni khat nitah dongin tol kisaw lo anlum na ne ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na inn sung vuah ni sagi sung tol kici kimukha lo ding hi; koipo, pemta ahi a, gammi ahi zongin tol kisaw a neh leh Israel mihonpi lah panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tol kisaw poma na ne sih ding uhi; na tenna zosie vuah tol kisaw lo anlum na ne ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Israel upate zosie hlanin amate kungah, “Pei unlen, na innkuon vua dingin tuunote teelin peisan tuuno go un."},"22":{"text":"Hyssop’ na lomkhat la-in kuong sunga om sisan sungah die unlen, tua kuong sunga sisan tawh bangtung zawl le kotbieng khuom nite nu un. Zingmawng masangin koima in na inn kot pulam uh na kal sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt-te vatmai dingin Topa in ang nawh ding a, bangtung zawl le kotbieng khuom nite tunga sisan a mu ciengin Topa in tuami kotpi a peisan ding a, na inn sung vuah note ang vatmai ding a susie pa a lutsah sih ding hi.","ref":"Heb 11:28"},"24":{"text":"Note le na tapate in biehna ngaina kip khatin tami dan na zang zing ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Note ang ciemsa bangin Topa in ang pieh ding leitangah na tun ciengun tami sil bawldan na zui ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Na tate un na kung vuah, ‘Tami sil kibawl bang a cinopna ahiei? ci-a ang dot ciengun,"},"27":{"text":"‘Tami Topa’ peisan biehpiehna ahi hi. Azieh pen ama in Egypt-te vatmai-in, ahi vangin ei innkuon teng ei hinkhawi lai a, Egypt gam sungah Israel’ innkuonte a peisan hi,’ na ci ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tuale mite lukunin Pasien a bie uhi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron a thupieh bangin Israel-te pei-in a gamta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Zankim ciengin Topa in Egypt gam sunga om tacil zosie, a kumpi topha tunga a to Pharaoh’ tacil-a kipan thongmiel sunga a om saltangte’ tacilte le ganhingte’ tacil zosie a vatmai hi.","title":"Gimna Sawmna: Tacilte Sina (Pei 11:1-10)","ref":"Pei 4:22-23"},"30":{"text":"Khumi zanin Pharaoh le a uliente le Egypt mi zosie a tho uhi; tuale Egypt gam sungah kaana lienpi a om hi. Azieh pen misi om lona inn khat zong om lo hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Moses le Aaron a zan thuta a, ama gel kungah, “Ding un, ka mite lah panin noma ni le Israel-te peikhie ta un! Pei unlen na gen bangun Topa bie un."},"32":{"text":"Na gen bangun na tuuhonte ule na bawnghonte uh zawpi unlen peimang ta un. Kei zong thupha ei pie un!” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Manlang taha tua gam a nuasie nadingun Egypt-te in mite a hantawh uhi, azieh pen amate in, “I unpi vua a si sieng ding i hi ta uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Peikhietna: Rameses Panin Succoth"},"34":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite in tol a kisaw masangin a annel lom uh la-in, puon tawh annel pawina a kuongte uh tunin a liengko tung vuah a puo uhi."},"35":{"text":"Moses in a kung vua a gen bangin Israel-te a gamta uhi; amate in Egypt-te kung pan ngun le kham kizepnate, le puonte a ngen uhi."},"36":{"text":"A ngette uh a pieh nadingun Topa in Egypt-te’ muna-ah mite maipha pie hi. Israel-te in tua bangin Egypt mite’ na a tomgampieh uhi.","ref":"Pei 3:21-22"},"37":{"text":"Numei le naupangte kisim lo, Rameses panin Succoth-ah Israel-te pasal tul zaguh keng tawh a pei uhi."},"38":{"text":"Minam kisawhal honpite, tuuhon le bawnghon, ganhing tampite zong amate tawh a peiton uhi."},"39":{"text":"Amate in Egypt pana a ken uh annel lom panin tol kisaw lo moh a em uhi; tuate pen tol kisaw lo ahi hi, azieh pen Egypt panin amate kinotmang a, khuongai man lo lienga ang pei ziehun a an neh ding uzong a guong man sih uhi."},"40":{"text":"Egypt-ah Israel-te a ten hun sung uh kum zali le kum sawmthum ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 15:13; Gal 3:17"},"41":{"text":"Kum zali le kum sawmthum a cin tuami ni ma-in, Egypt leitang panin a unpi-un Topa’ mihonte a peikhie uhi."},"42":{"text":"Egypt leitang panin a peipi thei nadingun khum zan pen Topa adingin zanha ni ahi hi. Israel-te zosie in a khang khangin khum zan pen Topa adingin zanha zanin a tang zing ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron kungah tam bangin gen hi: Tam pen Peisan pawi bawl dan ding ngaina kip ahi hi: Gamdang mi koima in tua khu a ne sih ding hi.","title":"Peisan Pawi Bawldan Ding Hilna (Pien 17:9-14 ; Pei 12:1-13)"},"44":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kileisa sila poma in tep a kitan zaw ciengin ne thei ding hi;"},"45":{"text":"suoh le salte ahi sihle a kiciel nasemte in ne thei lo ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua pen inn khat sungah kine ding hi; inn pulamah a sa na pusuopi sih ding vua, a gu khat zong na tawngsah sih ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 9:12; Jhn 19:36"},"47":{"text":"Israel mihon buppi in tami pawi a bawl ding uhi."},"48":{"text":"Na tentonpi uh pemta khatpo in Topa kungah peisan pawi a bawl nop leh a mipi pasal zosie a tep uh kitan ding hi; tua ciengin ama in tuami a bawl nadingin a kungah neh ding hi; tuolsung mi khat bangin ama kingaisun ding hi. Hizongle tep tan lote in ne thei lo ding ahi;"},"49":{"text":"tuolsung mite le na lah vua a teng khuol mite adingin zui ding thukham khat beh om ding hi,” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron a thupieh bangin Israel-te zosie in a bawl uhi."},"51":{"text":"Khumi ni ma-in Topa in Egypt gam panin Israel-te a honhonin a peipi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi:"},"2":{"text":"Tacil zosie keima adingin siensuo un; Israel-te lahah mihing hitale ganhing hitale, naubu hong masa pen popo kei-a’ ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 3:13; Luk 2:23"},"3":{"text":"Moses in mite kungah, “Na sal tanna Egypt gam panin na pei ni uh ahi tami ni phawh un, azieh pen Topa in a thahat khut tawh khum mun panin note ang peipi hi; tol kisaw anlum kine lo ding hi.","title":"Tol Kisaw Lo Anlum Pawi (Pei 12:14-20)"},"4":{"text":"Abib hla sung, tuni-a peikhie na hi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in pieh dinga na pu na pate kunga a na ciemsa bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna leitang, Canaan-te, Hit-te, Amor-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te’ tenna leitangah ang peipi ciengin tami hla sungin tami na bawl ding uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tol kisaw lo anlum na ne ding vua, a ni sagi ni-in Topa adingin pawi khat om ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tol kisaw lo anlum kine ding hi. Na neisate sung vuah tol kisaw anlum kimu lo ding a, na tenna uh mun zosie-a na lah vuah zong tol kici kimukha lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum ni-in na tapate uh kungah, ‘Egypt panin ka peikhiet lai-in Topa in kei adinga ei bawlpieh zieh ahi hi,’ ci-in na gen ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na kam sung vuah Topa’ thuhilna a op thei nadingin note dingin tami khu na khut tung vuah lim khat hi ding a, na talpang tung vuah phawna khat hi ding hi; azieh pen Topa in a thahat khut tawh Egypt leitang panin note ang peipi hi."},"10":{"text":"A kise hunin kum khat pan kum khat, tami biehna ngaina kip na zui ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Ama in note tung le na pu na pate uh tunga a ciemsa bangin Topa in Canaan leitangah ang peipi hun cieng le na tung vuah tuami gam ang pieh ciengin,","title":"Tacil Siensuona"},"12":{"text":"Topa adingin naubu hong masa zosie na tuomkoi ding uhi. Na ganhon uh tacil apa zosie Topa -a’ hi ding hi.","ref":"Pei 34:19-20; Luk 2:23"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin laa tacil poma tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uhi; na tat sih uleh a ngawng na hiatawng ding uhi. Na tapate uh lah panin tacil poma na tanh ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mai lam hunah na tapa in tami bang a cinopna ahiei?’ ci-a ang dawh ciengin ama kungah, ‘Saltanna Egypt panin a thahat khut tawh Topa in ei na peipi hi."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh in lungkhauh tahin peisah ding ei na niel ciengin Topa in Egypt gam sunga tacil zosie, mihing tacil le ganhing tacil zosie a thatgam hi. Tua ahi ziehin naubu hong masa apa zosie Topa tungah biehpiehna-in ka pie hi, ahi vangin ka tapate sung pana a pieng tacil zosie ka tankia hi,’ na ci ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua khu na khut tungah lim bang hi ding a, na talpang tungah ciemtena lim bang hi ding hi. Azieh pen Topa in a banhat tawh Egypt gam panin eite ei peipi hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Pharaoh in mite a peisah ciengin Philistia gam lam naizaw tamaleh, Pasien in tua lamah amate peipi lo hi; azieh pen Pasien in, ‘Mite in gal le sa tuoh uleh a lungsim uh kikhelin Egypt gamah kinuale thei kha ding uhi,” ci-in ngaisun hi.","title":"Meii Khuom le Mei khuom (Pei 40:34-38 ; Gam 9:15-23 ; 1Kum 8:10-11)"},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in San Tuipi lam manaw-in senel gam lamah mite a kuol peipi hi. Israel-te gal do dinga a kithawisa-in Egypt gam panin a peito uhi."},"19":{"text":"Joseph in, “Pasien in ang phawh kha valon ding vua, tua zaw ciengin tami mun panin ka gu ka tangte na puo ding uhi,” ci-in Israel-te kungah lipkhaphuoi kiciemna tawh a vaihlah ziehin Moses in Joseph’ gu le tangte a puo hi.","ref":"Pien 50:25; Josh 24:32"},"20":{"text":"Succoth pan amate a ding vua, senel gam mong, Etham-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"21":{"text":"A sun a zanin khuol a zin thei nadingun sunin lam lah ding meii khuom khat tawh, zanin khuovah pie ding mei khuom khat tawh, a mai vuah Topa a pei hi."},"22":{"text":"Suna meii khuompi, le zana mei khuompi in mite mai ama’ opna mun lawi lo hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi:","title":"San Tuipi Galkaina"},"2":{"text":"“Israel-te kinua hei-in Migdol le tuipi kikal, Pi-hahiroth mai, Baal-zephon gei-ah giephuol a sat ding gen in; tuipi gei, tuami gal khatah giephuol na sat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Pharaoh in Israel-te tawh kisai-in, ‘Tami gam sungah amate vahvai-in senel gam in vuanelh zo ta hi,’ ci ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Pharaoh’ lungtang ka khausah ding a, amate a nuadel ding hi. Pharaoh le a galkap zosie tungtawnin minthanna ka nga ding hi; tuale Egypt-te in Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tua bang ma-in amate gamta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mite taimang sieng zo ta hi, ci-in Egypt kumpipa kungah a kigen ciengin Pharaoh le a uliente’ lungsim kikhelin amate in, “I na ei seppieh Israel-te i peisah pen bangci gamtat mawh ta i hi uh ahei?” a kici uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a leeng kithawisahin a galkapte a la hi;"},"7":{"text":"a deiteel leng zaguh le Egypt leeng zosie a uhte tawh ama a kuonton hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Egypt kumpi Pharaoh’ lungtang khauhsahin hangsan taha a pei Israel-te a nuadel hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt-te ahi Pharaoh’ sakolte, leengte, a leeng hawl zosie le a galkapte in amate a nuadel uhi; amate in tuipi gei-ah giephuol satin a opna uh ahi Pi-hahiroth khuo gei, Baal-zephon khuo mai-ah a pha uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pharaoh in amate a neh ciengin Israel-te a kinua hei vua, amate lamah Egypt mite a kuon uhi. A zau seng ziehun Topa tungah Israel-te a kiko uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in Moses kungah, “Egypt gama han a op lo ziehin senel gama si dinga nei zawpi amah? Egypt gam pana nei peipina tawh ka tung vua bang teng bawl mawh na hei?"},"12":{"text":"‘Ei ci opsah lel inlen Egypt-te’ na ei semsah in,’ ci-in Egypt gama na kunga kang gen pen uh tami thu ma hi lo amah? Azieh pen senel gama ka si sangun Egypt-te’ na ka sep uh kote dingin hoizaw ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in mite kungah, “Zau sih unlen ding kip un. Tuale en un, tuni-in Topa in note dinga ang sep ding a hutkhietna mu un; azieh pen tuni-a na mu uh Egypt-te na mukia ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in note dingin gal ang simpieh ding a, tuaci’n na op hit hiet ding beh uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Bang dingin kei tunga hing kiko na hi uh ahei? Israel-te mainawtin a pei ding uh gen in."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te in tuipi laikimah tuolgaw a tot thei nadingun na ciengkhut lamto inlen, tuipi tungah na khut zahin khenkhe in."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Egypt-te’ lungtang ka khausah ding a, amate in ang del ding uhi; tuaci’n keima in Pharaoh le a galkap zosie, a sakol leengte, a leeng hawlte tungtawnin minthanna ka nga ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pharaoh le a sakol leengte le a leeng hawlte tungtawnin minthanna ka nga ciengin Egypt-te in Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel galkapte mai-a a pei Pasien’ vantungmi kikhinin amau’ nua-ah a pei hi; a mai panun meii khuom kikhin a, a nua vuah a om hi."},"20":{"text":"Egypt galkapte le Israel galkapte kikal ah tua meii a pei hi; tuale tua munah meii le khuomiel omton a, tuami in zan khuomiel a tangsah hi; zan tawntungin khatlekhat kinai kha loin a om uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut a zah hi. Topa in zan tawntungin nisuona lam huipi hat tawh tuipi lemutsahin gamgaw a suohsah hi; tuale tua tuipi phal ni-in kikhen hi."},"22":{"text":"Amau’ ziet le vei-ah tuite kawm bangin omin tuipi tunga leigaw lahah Israel-te lam a pei uhi.","ref":"1Cor 10:1-2; Heb 11:29"},"23":{"text":"Egypt-te ahi Pharaoh’ sakolte zosie , a leengte le a leenghawlte in a nuadel vua, tuipi laikim amau’ nua-ah a pei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Zingmawng khuo va ciengin Topa in mei le meii khuom sung panin Egypt galkapte ensuh a, Egypt galkapte patausah gawp hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in a amau’ leengkangte a awsah ziehin hamsapi-in a hawl uhi. Egypt-te in, ”Israel-te mai panin taimang ta vai, azieh pen Topa in amate dingin Egypt-te a do hi,” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Egypt-te tung, a leengte uh tung, le a leeng hawlte uh tungah tami tui ang luonkia nadingin tuipi tungah na khut zah in,” a ci hi.","title":"A Nuadelte Tui Sungah Kiesuh"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuipi tungah Moses in a khut zah a, zingmawng khuo a va ciengin tua tuipi a luon ngai bangin a luongkia hi. Tua tuipi panin Egypt-te a tai ciengun Topa in Egypt-te tuipi lam sena-in nei hi."},"28":{"text":"Tui peikia-in leengte, leeng hawlte le tuipi sunga amate a del Pharaoh’ galkapte a unpi-in tui in hlummang hi; amate khat zong suohta lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuipi laikim leigaw tungah Israel-te a pei vua, a ziet a vei vuah kawm bangin tuite a om hi."},"30":{"text":"Khum ni-in Topa in Egypt-te khut sung pan Israel-te tam bangin na hunkhie hi; tuale Israel-te in gunpieu-a si Egypt-te a mu uhi."},"31":{"text":"Israel-te in Egypt-te tungah Topa’ bawl nasepna lienpi a mu uhi. Tuaci’n mite in Topa a giing vua, Topa le a nasempa Moses a um uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses le Israel-te in Topa kungah tami la a sa uhi: “ Topa tungah zeila sa vang, azieh pen vangnei tahin ama guol zo hi; sakolte le a tunga tuongte tuili lai-ah sepmang zo hi.","title":"Moses’ La (Pei 14:13-14 ; Late 78:12-14)","ref":"Kln 15:3"},"2":{"text":"Topa khu ka zaitha le ka thahatna ahi a, ama ka hutdamna a suoh zo hi. Ama ka Pasien ahi a, ama ka phat ding hi. Keima in ka pa’ Pasien phatin ama ka liensah ding hi.","ref":"Late 118:14; Isa 12:2"},"3":{"text":"Topa khu galhang pa hi a; ama’ min khu Topa ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Ama in tuipi sungah Pharaoh’ leengte le a galkapte sepsuh a, San Tuipi sungah ama’ deiteel uliente a tummang uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuihuol in amate khucip a, suongtum bangin a thuhna munah amate a tumsuh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, na zietlam khut khu thahat sil bawl theina hi a- Topa aw, na zietlam khut in dogalte a vatmai hi."},"7":{"text":"A thupi na vanglietna tawh ang langbawlte na bungbulet hi; na lungthahna na lengsah a, tua in hampa bangin amate katumsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Na husan in tuipi li bang cingsahin, tuihuolpi zong cienphung bangin dingsah hi; tuili lai-a tui thuhte zong a khalh gawpsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Dogalte in, ‘Ka del ding a, ka nuaphah ding hi, gal vanlahte ka hawm ding a, tuate ka deizaza ka kitan ding hi. Ka namtem ka dawh ding a, amate ka khut tawh ka susie ding hi,’ a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na hui tawh na sem ciengin tuipi in amate a tuomcip hi. Tuipi gimnei sungah amate ngentang bangin a tumsuh uhi."},"11":{"text":"“ Topa aw, pasien-te lahah nangma tawh kibang koi om ahei? Sienthona-ah a lien, thupina-ah a lipkhap huoi, na lamdangte a bawl, nangma tawh kibang koi om ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Na zietlam khut na zah a, lei in amate a valtum hi."},"13":{"text":"“A tul ngai lo na itna tawh nangma in na tatsate na pui a; a siengtho na tenna munah na hatna tawh amate na pui hi."},"14":{"text":"Mite in za-in a kiling vua; Philistia gama tengte, lungkhamna in a tukon hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Edom uhpite lungkie-in, Moab makaite zau-in a ling vua; Canaan gam sunga tengte zosie lungkhamin a tuisuoh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate tungah zauna le citutna a tung hi. Topa aw, na mite in a kalsan masang, na tatsa mite in a kalsan masangin, na ban hat ziehin amate suongtum bangin pia loin om uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, na ten nadinga na bawlsa mun, Topa aw, na khut tawh na phusa biehbuh ah, amate na pui a, nangma’ luo muol tungah amate na suon hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa khu kumtawnin a maang zing ding hi, ci-in la a sa uhi."},"19":{"text":"Pharaoh’ sakolte, a leengte le a leenghawlte tawh tuipi sungah a pei lai-un Topa in a tung vuah tuipi tuite luongsahkia hi; ahi vangin tuipi laikim leihul tungah Israel-te a pei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron’ sanggamnu kamsang Miriam in a khutah tawm a tawi hi; numei zosie lamin a tawmte utawh a zui uhi.","title":"Miriam’ La"},"21":{"text":"Amate tungah Miriam in la sa hi: “ Topa kungah la sa un, azieh pen thupi tahin ama a guol zo hi. Ama in tuili lai-ah sakol le a hawlte a sepmang hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in San Tuipi pan Israel-te peipi a, Shur senel gam zuonin a pei uhi. Senel gamah nithum sung lam a pei vua, tui a mu sih uhi.","title":"Tuikha Hlumsahkia"},"23":{"text":"Marah a tun ciengun tui kha ahi ziehin Marah tui a dawn thei sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin khum mun pen Marah ci-in a min kiphuo hi."},"24":{"text":"Moses tungah mite a phun vua, “Bang dawn ding i hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa kungah ama kiko a, Topa in ama singthem khat lah hi; ama in tui sungah tua singthem a sep pai leh tuami tui a hlum pai hi. Topa in khum munah amate dingin thukham khat le ngaina kip khat bawlin khumi munah amate a zelah hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa na Pasien uh’ aw limtah ngai-in ama muna-ah a manin na semin a thupiehte na thudon vua, a thukhamte na zui uleh note tungah Egypt gama ka tunsah natnate khat zong kang tungsah sih ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile kei khu note ang damsah Topa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ciatui sawm le ni phulna le lutu kung sawm sagi a pona Elim ah a tung uhi; tuale amate in khum mun tui gei-ah giephuol a sat uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elim panin Israel mihon vannuoi vai a ding uhi; tuale Egypt gam pan a dinkhiet zaw uh a hla nina ni sawm le ni nga ni-in Elim le Sinai kikala om Sin senel gamah Israel-te a tung uhi.","title":"Vantung Pan Anlum"},"2":{"text":"Senel gamah Israel mihon vannuoi in Moses le Aaron a phunsan uhi."},"3":{"text":"Israel-te in ama gel kungah, “Sabel phungah to-in khamtahin an ka neh lai-un Topa’ khutlumin Egypt leitangah na kisi tazaw uleng izaw; bang ding ahei cile a kikhawm tami mihon buppi kielsisah dinga tami senel gama nei peipi gel ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Note dingin vantung panin anlum guo bangin ka zusah ding a, mite pei-in khumi ni-a a khamkhop ding uh anlum nisielin a luoh ding uhi. Tua bang danin amate in ka thuhil a zui uleh a zui lo uh ka zelah ding hi.","ref":"Jhn 6:31"},"5":{"text":"Tua anlum luoh dinga a kisah ciengun a ni guh ni-in nidanga a luo za uh a zani a luoh ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses le Aaron in Israel-te zosie kungah, “Nitah ciengin Topa pen Egypt gam pana note ang peipi pa ahi lam na thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa tunga na phunna uh ama in za zo ahi ziehin zingmawng ciengin Topa’ vanglietna na mu ding uhi. Azieh pen ka tung vua na phunphun uh, ko bang hi mawh ka hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Moses in, “A tunga na phunphun uh Topa in za zo ahi ziehin Topa in na tung vuah nitah cienga na neh dinguh sa, le zingmawng cienga khamtaha na neh ding uh an ang pieh ciengin kote bang ka hi uh ahei? Na phunphun uh pen kote tunga phun na hi sih vua, Topa tunga phun na hi uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Aaron kungah, “Israel mihon vannuoi tungah, ‘Ama in na phunna uh za zo a hi ziehin a nai-ah hing neh un,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Aaron in Israel mihonte a hopi laitahin gamlah a en vua, amate in mei lahah Topa’ vanglietna a kilang hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah,"},"12":{"text":"“Israel-te’ phunna ka za zo hi. Amate kungah, ‘Khuomut ciengin sa na ne ding vua, zingmawng ciengin khamtahin an na ne ding uhi; tua ciengin keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Nitah ciengin vamimte lengin giephuol khucip hi; zingmawngin giephuol kimah daicim a daldalin kie hi."},"14":{"text":"Daicim a kap ciengin senel gam lei maitang tungah a pa dihdeh a phal phala a om, vuakhal tawh a kibang na hoi khat a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel-te in a mu ciengun khatlekhat in, “Tam bang ahiei?” a kici uhi. Azieh pen amate in tua khu bang ahei ci a thei sih uhi. Moses in amate kungah, “Tami pen Pasien in na neh ding vua ang pieh an ahi hi.","ref":"1Cor 10:3"},"16":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh tam bang ahi hi: ‘Na milipun tam an na dei zaza uh khawm ciet un. Na puonbuh sung vua mi phaza tawh kizui-in mi khat adingin omer khat ciet na khawm ding uhi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua bang ma-in Israel-te a gamta vua, kimkhat in a tamzaw, kimkhat in a tawmzaw a khawm uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin omer tawh a te ciengun a tampi khawmte-a’ dimval loin themno khat a khawmte-a’ zong cingla tuon lo hi; amate in a milipin a kisap za ciet a khawm uhi.","ref":"2Cor 8:15"},"19":{"text":"Moses in amate kungah, “Zingmawng dongin koima in tuate hen sih heh,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Moses’ thugen a mang sih uhi; mi pawlkhat in zingmawng dongin tuate halkhat a hen vua, tuale than tu-in a ui sieng hi. Amate tungah Moses a lungthah hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in zingmawng sielin a neh khop ding ciet uh a khawm uhi; ahi vangin ni a ham ciengin tuate zungmang sieng hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in a ni guh ni-in an a zani, omer ni ciet a khawm uhi. Moses kungah mihon makai zosie pei-in a gen ciengun"},"23":{"text":"Moses in amate kungah, “Tam khu Topa’ ei thupieh ahi hi: ‘Zingcieng pen a lipkhap huoi tawlngah ni, Topa dinga Sabbath siengtho ni ahi hi; na em nuom teng uh emin na huon nuom teng uh huon unlen, zingmawng dongin na khamval teng uh koicing un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:8-11"},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Moses’ thupieh bangin zingmawng dongin tuate a koicing uhi; tuale tuate pen ui zong ui loin than zong tu lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Moses in, “Tuni pen Topa dinga sabbath ahi ziehin tuni-in tuate ne un; tuni-in gamlahah tuate na mu sih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ni guh sung tuate na khawm ding uhi; ahi vangin a ni sagina sabbath ni-in bangma om lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in an khawm dingin mi pawlkhat a pei vua, bangma a mu mintah sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Ka thupiehte le ka thuhilte bang tanvei ei niel sawm na hi uh ahei?"},"29":{"text":"En un! Topa in na tung vuah sabbath ang pie zo ta hi, tua ahi ziehin ama in ni guh ni-in na tung vuah ni ni khom ding an ang pie hi; a koima po na opna ciet vuah om un; a ni sagi ni-in na opna panun heima pusuoh sih un,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n a ni sagi ni-in mite a toi om uhi."},"31":{"text":"Israel innkuon in tua khu manna a ci uhi; tua khu nannan tang tawh kibangin a meel kang a, khuoizu tawh kibawl mopheng tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Gam 11:7-8"},"32":{"text":"Moses in, “ Topa’ thupieh tami ahi hi: ‘Egypt leitang panin kang peipi lai-un amate in senel gamah note kang vana an a mu thei nadingun na khang tungtawnun tuate omer dim khat koicing sah un,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses in Aaron kungah, “Beel khat la-in tua sungah manna omer dim khat sung inlen, na khang tawntung vua a kikem zing dingin Topa mai-ah tuate koi in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 9:4"},"34":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin Aaron in thuciemna mai-ah kepcing dingin tuate koi hi."},"35":{"text":"A ten nading uh leitang a tun masang uh, kum sawmli sung Israel-te in manna a ne uhi; Canaan gamgi a tun masangun amate in manna a ne uhi.","ref":"Josh 5:12"},"36":{"text":"Omer khat pen ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat ahi hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehsa bangin Israel mi buppi Sin senel gam panin Israel mi buppi a banbanin khuol a zin uhi. Amate in Rephidim-ah giephuol a sat uhi, ahi vangin khum munah mite dawn ding tui om lo hi.","title":"Suongpi panin Tui (Gam 20:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Moses tawh mite a kihau vua, “Ka dawn ding uh tui ei pie’n,” a ci uhi. Moses in a kung vuah, “Bang dinga kei nei phin uh ahei? Bang dinga Topa na zelah uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin khum munah tui du-in mite a dangta uhi; tuale Moses tungah mite phunin, “Bang dinga dangta-a si dingin Egypt panin kote, ka tate ule ka ganhingte uh ei peitopi na hei,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa tungah Moses kiko a, “Tam mite bang ka law ta diei? Suong tawh ei seplia dinga kisa ahi ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Israel upate pawlkhat zawpi inlen mite mai-ah pei in; na khut sungah Nile gun na satna ciengkhut tawi inlen pei in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Horeb-a suongpi tung na mai-ah keima ka na ding ding hi. Tua suongpi sat lacin mite dawn thei dingin tua suongpi panin tui ang phul ding hi. Israel upate muna-ah tua bang ma-in Moses a gamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in khum mun pen Massah le Meribah ci-in a min phuo hi, bang ding ahei cile Israel-te in, “Eite’ lahah Topa a om amah, a om sih ahei,” ci-in a kihau vua, amate in Topa a zelah uhi.","ref":"Gam 20:2-13"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amalek-te kuonin Rephidim-ah Israel-te tawh a kido uhi.","title":"Amalek-te in Israel Simin Lel. (Pien 14:7 ; Gam 13:29 ; 14:25)"},"9":{"text":"Moses in Joshua kungah, “Eite dingin mi pawlkhat teelin Amalek-te do dingin kuon in. Keima in zing ciengin ka khut sungah Pasien’ ciengkhut tawi-in muol dawnah ka ding ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses’ gensa ma bangin Joshua gamta a, muoldawn ah Moses, Aaron, le Hur-te a kato laitahun Amalek-te tawh a kido uhi."},"11":{"text":"Moses in a khut a sangkhai laisie Israel-te in a zo vua, a khut a niemkhieh ciengin Amalek-te in a zo uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses a khut a kham hi. Tuaci’n amate in suongtum khat la-in ama’ nei-ah a koi vua, tua suong tungah Moses a tosah uhi. Aaron le Hur-te, khat langkhatah, a khat a lang khatah pangin a khut gel a dom uhi; tuaci’n nitum cieng dongin a khut gel kipden hi."},"13":{"text":"Joshua in Amalek le ama’ mite namsau tawh a zo gawp hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kung ah, “Ciemtena ahi dingin laibu sungah tami thu giel inlen, Joshua’ zahin tua thu sim in: Keima in vansin nei panin Amalek-te kiphawna ka phietmai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:17-19; 1Sam 15:2-9"},"15":{"text":"Moses in maitam khat lam a, tua khu Topa in keima’ zawna diel ahi hi, ci-in a min phuo hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa’ zawna diel tunga khut! Topa in a khang khangin Amalek-te a do ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien in Moses le a mi Israel-te dinga a sepna teng le, Topa in Egypt panin Israel-te a peipina thu zosie Moses’ sungpa, Midian siempu Jethro in a unin a za sieng hi.","title":"Jethro’ Thumopna (Thkna 1:9-18)"},"2":{"text":"Moses in a zi Zipporah a peisah zaw ciengin a sungpa Jethro in ama le"},"3":{"text":"a tapa nite a la hi. A khat pen’ min Gershom ahi hi. (azieh pen ama in, “Gamdangah pemta ka hi hi,” a ci hi.)","ref":"Pei 2:21-22; Sawl 7:29"},"4":{"text":"tuale adang khat’ min Eliezer ahi hi. (azieh pen ama in, “Ka pa’ Pasien in keima ei hupa ahi a, Pharoah’ namsau panin kei ei hun hi,” a ci hi)."},"5":{"text":"Moses’ sungpa Jethro in senel gam Pasien’ muol tunga Moses in giephuol a satna mun, ama kungah Moses’ tapate le a zi a peipi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Moses kungah, “Keima, na sungpa Jethro, na zi le na tapa gel tawh na kungah kang pei hi,” ci-in kam vaihlah hi."},"7":{"text":"A sungpa tawh kimu dingin Moses a pei hi; a mai-ah kunin ama nam hi; a ni tuohun dam ii ci-in kihopi-in puonbuh sungah a lut uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in a sungpa kungah, Topa in Israel-te a khuolna tawh Pharaoh le Egypt-te tunga a bawlsa zosie, amate in lampi-a a tuokhah uh hahsatna zosie le Topa in amate a hutkhietna thu zosie a unpi-in a gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt-te khut sung panin amate a hutkhietna, le Israel-te tunga Topa in a bawl sil hoi bangkim ziehin Jethro a lungdam hi."},"10":{"text":"Jethro in, “Egypt-te le Pharaoh khut sung panin note ang hunkhie Topa in thupha nga taheh."},"11":{"text":"Topa pen pasien zosie sanga a lietzawh lam tu-in ka thei hi, azieh pen Egypt-te in Israel-te tungah kiphatsahna tawh a gamtat lai-un amate na hunkhie hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses’ sungpa Jethro in Pasien mai-ah meihal biehna le biehpiehnate a peipi hi; tuale Moses’ sungpa tawh Pasien mai-a an neton dingin Aaron le Israel upa zosie a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"A zing ni-in mite tunga thu khen dingin Moses a to a, zingmawng panin nitah dongin a kimkotah mite a ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Moses’ sungpa in mite dinga a sepna zosie a unpi-in a mu bepin ama in, “Mite dinga na nasep tami khu a bang bep ahiei? Nang ngentang mawh gumto-in na kimvelah bang dinga mite nitang tuma na dinsah ahei?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses in a sungpa kungah, “Azieh pen Pasien’ deina kanin ka kungah mite ang pei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kisietna khatpo a nei ciengun keima kungah amate ang pei-in khatlekhat kikalah thu ka khenpieh a, Pasien’ ngaina kipte le amate kungah ama’ dei lamte ka theisah hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Moses’ sungpa in ama kungah, “Na nasep dan a hoi vawt sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangma le na mite, na ni tuohun na gim seng ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile nang adingin tua nasep gih luo hi; nang guohin na sem zo sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in ka kamteng ngai in. Thuhoi hing mop vangin, Pasien in nang hing om pi taheh! Mipi tangin Pasien mai-ah na ding ding a, Pasien mai-ah a kilung nopmawnate uh na tut ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"Pasien’ ngaina kipte le a dei lamte amate na hil ding a, a vazin ding ule a na sepdan dingte uh na theisah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mipi lah panin Pasien a zatah mi, a muontah mi, guhgol a muda mi, na sem thei mipilte na sui ding hi; tua bang mite pen a tul, a za, a sawmnga, a sawmte tungah ulienin na koi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in mite’ thu khensah tawntung in. Thu thupi teng zosie na kungah kipuohsah inlen, ahi vangin thuneu bepte amau le amau khensah lel in. Tua hile nangma dingin ang baizaw deu ding a, amate in na vangih ang puohpi ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Pasien’ sawl bangin tam banga na sep leh na puo zo ding a, tam mite zosie a inn ciet vuah lungnuomin a pei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in a sungpa’ thu ngai-in a gen zosie a unin a bawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Moses in Israel zosie sung panin nasem thei mipilte teelin mipi tunga lutangte le, a tul, a za, a sawmnga, le a sawmte tunga vaihawm ulienin amate a koi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mite tungah amate in thu a khen tawntung uhi; Moses kungah thuhahsate beh a tut vua, ahi vangin thuneu bepte amate in a khentawm uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in a sungpa peisah a, a gamah ama a peikia hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt leitang panin Israel-te a peikhiet zaw uh a hla thumna khum ni ma-in amate Sinai senel gam a tung uhi.","title":"Sinai Muolah Israel-te Tung (Thkna 5:1-22)"},"2":{"text":"Rephidim panin amate khuolzinin Sinai senel gamah a lut vua, tua senel gamah giephuol a sat uhi; Israel-te in khumi muna muol mai-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien kungah Moses peito hi; Topa in muol panin ama lhanin ama kungah, “Jacob’ innkuonte le Israel-te kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi:"},"4":{"text":"Egypt-te tunga ka bawlna le muvanlai’ hla tungah hing puo-in ka kunga kang tut na mu zo ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in ka thu mangin ka thuciemna na zui uleh mi namcin lah panin keima’ gou nei manpha na hi ding uhi. A tahtahin leitung vannuoi keima- a’ hi a,"},"6":{"text":"hinanle note na hi ule keima dingin siempu minam, le minam siengtho na hi ding uhi. Tam teng khu Israel-te kunga na gen ding uh thute ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 1:6; 5:10"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses pei-in mipi upate hlan a, Topa in ama a thupieh tam thu zosie amate mai-ah a sung hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi zosie in, “ Topa’ gensa poma ka sem ding uhi,” ci-in lung kituohin a dawng uhi. Moses in Topa kungah mite’ thugente a tut hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Kang hopi ciengin mite in a zah thei nading ule ang muon zing nadingun na kunga meii sapi sungah kang pei ding hi,” a ci hi. Topa kungah Moses in mite’ thugente a gen ciengin,"},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Mite kungah va pei ta’nlen tuni le zing sung tengin amate siensuo in. A puonsilte uh sawpsah inlen,","title":"Mite Kisiensuo"},"11":{"text":"a ni thum ni adingin kithawisah in, bangzieh ahei cile a ni thum ni-in mi zosie’ mu-in Sinai muol tungah Topa ang kumsuh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mite adingin a kimvelah dai na kai ding a, ‘Muol tungah kato loin, a muolmong zong na thamkhah lo nadingun kidawm un. Tua muol a thamkha poma kithat ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Koima’ khut in ama thamkha lo ding a, ahi vangin suong tawh ama kiseplia-in ahi sihle thaltangte tawh ama kikaplia ding hi; ganhing hile mihing hile kihinkhawi lo ding hi,’ na ci ding hi. Pengkul sawt veipi a kimut ciengin muol tungah amate a kato ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 12:18-20"},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n muol tung panin mite kungah Moses kumsuh hi. Ama in mite siensuo a, amate in a puonte a sawp uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in mite kungah, “A ni thum ni adingin kithawi un; numei gei-ah pei sih un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A ni thum ni zingmawngin van to-in tun phe a, muol tungah meii sapi a om hi. Pengkul kimut gin a ngai seng ziehin giephuol a om mi zosie a citun uhi.","ref":"Kln 4:5"},"17":{"text":"Pasien tawh kimu dingin giephuol panin Moses in mite a zawpi hi. Muol bulah amate a ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in mei sung tua muol tungah Topa a kumsuh ziehin meikhu in Sinai Muol a tuommang hi; meikhuh sunga meikhu bangin a tung lamah meikhu kileh to a, tua laitahin tua muol buppi nahpitahin kiling hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:11-12"},"19":{"text":"Pengkul aw a nah gin semsem laitahin Moses in hopi a, Pasien in vanto lahah ama a dawng hi."},"20":{"text":"Sinai muol vumah Topa a kumsuh ciengin muol tungah Topa in Moses hlan a, tuale Moses a peito hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Kumsuh inlen, Topa en dingin mite in tua daithaw a kansan lo nadingun va hilkhol ta’n; tua hi sihle amate lah panin mi tampi in a silaw ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa lam a neh siempute na ngawn zong kisiensuo tawmsah in. Tua ahi sihle amate tungah Topa lungthah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in Topa kungah, “Sinai muol tungah mite kikato sah lo hi; azieh pen nang mama in kote nei hilkhol a, ‘Muol kimvelah dai kai inlen siengthosah in,’ nei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Kumsuh inlen Aaron hing zawpito in; ahi vangin siempute ahi a, mite ahi zongin Topa kunga pei dingin daithaw hing kalsah sin; a tua ci teitei uleh a tung vuah ama lungthah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n mipi lamah Moses kumsuhin a kung vuah a gen hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in tam thu teng a gen hi:","title":"Thupieh Sawmte"},"2":{"text":"Kei pen saltanna gam Egypt pana ang peipi Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi;"},"3":{"text":"keima mai-ah pasien dangte na nei sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Noma adingin tung lama vantung hile, nei-a leitung hile, leisiet nei-a om tuisung hile a om na khat popo tawh a kisun milim na bawl sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuate mai-ah na kun sih ding vua, tuate na bie sih ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile kei pen note’ Topa Pasien, a thangsie Pasien ka hi a, kei ei nuolte tungah a pate uh’ khielna, a khang thumna le a khang lina dongin, a tate uh tungah dan a pie Pasien ka hi hi,","ref":"Pei 34:17; Siem 19:4; 26:1; Thkna 4:15-18; 27:15"},"6":{"text":"ahi vangin keima ei it a, ka thupieh a zui mite’ suonlehlah tungah khang tul khatna dongin itna kip a lah pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Pei 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 7:9-10"},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ min a sie lamin na zang sih ding uhi, azieh pen ama’ min a zang khiel poma Topa in maw pengsah lo ding hi.","ref":"Siem 19:12"},"8":{"text":"Sabbath ni phawh unlen a siengtho-in tang un.","ref":"Pei 16:23-30; 31:12-14"},"9":{"text":"Ni guh sungin na nasep ding zosie uh na sem ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin a ni sagi ni pen Topa na Pasien uh’ sabbath ni ahi hi. Nang, na tapa, na tanu, na sila pa, na sila nu, na ganhingte ahi sihle na khuo sung vua pemtate in bangma na na sem sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Siem 23:3"},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ni guh sungin Topa in van le lei, tuipi le tuate sunga a om sil zosie bawl hi, hinanle a ni sagi ni-in a tawlnga hi; tua ziehin Topa in sabbath ni thupha pie-in siengthosah hi.","ref":"Pien 2:1-3; Pei 31:17"},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na tung vua ang pieh leitangah na hin sawt thei nadingun na nu le na pa zatah un.","ref":"Thkna 27:16; Mat 15:4; 19:19; Mrk 7:10; 10:19; Luk 18:20; Eph 6:2-3"},"13":{"text":"Mi na that sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 9:6; Siem 24:17; Mat 5:21; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jas 2:11"},"14":{"text":"Ang na kawm sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 20:10; Mat 5:27; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jas 2:11"},"15":{"text":"Na na gu sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:11; Mat 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9"},"16":{"text":"Na vengte lang khatah a manlo teci na pang sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:1; Mat 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20"},"17":{"text":"Na vengte’ inn na deigaw sih ding uhi; na vengte’ zi hile, a sila pasal hile, a sila numei hile, a bawngtang hile, a laa hile, na vengte’ na khat popo na deigaw sih ding uhi.","ref":"Rom 7:7; 13:9"},"18":{"text":"Mi zosie in vanto le tunphe, pengkul gin, le muola meikhu a mu ciengun zau-in a ling vua, gamlapi-ah a ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"tuale Moses kungah, “Kote ei hopi in, na thugen ka ngai ding uhi. Ahi vangin Pasien in ei hopi sah sin. Nei hopi sah mawh leh ka si ta ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 12:18-19"},"20":{"text":"Moses in mite kungah, “Zau sih un. Bang ding ahei cile ama zahtahin na maw lo nadingun note zelah dinga Pasien ang pei ahi zaw hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Pasien’ opna khuomiel sapi lam a neh laitahin a gamla-ah mite a ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi: Israel-te kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: “Vantung panin kang hopina noma ma in na thei zo uhi.","title":"Maitam tawh Kisai Thukham"},"23":{"text":"Kei tawh kopin ngun pasien-te na bawl sih ding vua, noma adingin kham pasien-te zong na bawl sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Keima dingin lei maitam khat beh na bawl uh a ngai a, tuami tungah na meihal biehnate ule thunuoma na biehnate uh ahi na tuute ule na bawngtangte utawh biehpiehna pie un; ka min ka kiphawsahna muncin tenga na kung vuah keima hing pei-in thupha kang pie ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima dingin suong maitam khat nei bawlpieh vua ahile tua khu a kisehsa suongte tawh na bawl sih ding uh; azieh pen tua tungah na sekhu utawh na suhkhah uleh a buasah na hi ta uhi.","ref":"Thkna 27:5-7; Josh 8:31"},"26":{"text":"Na guohtang opna teng uh a kidaw lo nadingin ka maitam tungah kalei tawh na kato sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen amate mai-a na pieh ding biehna ngaina kipte ahi hi:","title":"Silate tawh Kisai Thukham (Thkna 15:12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Hebrew mi sila khat na lei ciengin ama in kum guh sung na sem ding a, ahi vangin kum sagi a cin ciengin leibat nei loin a suota-in pei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama guoha ang pei ahile ama guoh ma-in peikhie kia ding hi; zi neisa-a ang pei ahile a zi tawh ama peikhie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A pupa in ama zi khat guon a, tua nu in ama tawh tapate ahi a, tanute ahi zongin a nei leh, a zi le a tate pen a pupa-a’ hi ding a, a guohtangin ama a pei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin sila pa in, “Ka pupa, ka zi, le ka tate ka it ka ngai hi. A suohta-in ka pei sih ding hi,” a ci leh"},"6":{"text":"a pupa in Pasien mai-ah ama peipi ding hi. Kotpi-ah ahi a, kotpi khuom-ah ahi zongin ama kipeipi ding hi; tuale a pupa in siatul khat tawh a bil vupieh ding hi; tuale ama in a hin sung tungtawnin ama’ na a sem ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasal khat in a tanu sila-in a zua leh tua nu pen sila pasalte pei bangin pei lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama dinga a sekholsa tua numei in a pupa a lungkimsah sih leh, ama in tua nu kitansah ding hi; ama in a dih lopi-in tua nu a na bawl ziehin gamdang mite tungah zua theina thu nei lo ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a tapa’ zi dinga tua nu a sesa ahile a tanu khat bangin tua nu bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in zi dang khat a lah leh a zi masa’ nga ding hamphatnate ahi a anneh, a puonsil le a anglum piehnate a khiem tuon sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in tua nu dingin tam thu thum teng a bawl sih leh leibat nei lo, sum pieh kul loin pei thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi khat satin a sisah poma kithat ding hi.","title":"Tatsietna tawh Kisai Thukham"},"13":{"text":"Tua khu a sawmhlim ahi sih a, Pasien’ nasepna tawh a pieng ahi zawh leh tuol thatpa a tai thei nading note dingin mun khat ka koi ding hi.","ref":"Gam 35:10-34; Thkna 19:1-13; Josh 20:1-9"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in midang khat tha sawmin a kihaupi a, lebawlna tawh tua pa a tha leh thalia pai dingin ka maitam panin tua mithat pa na kaiphit ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"A pa hile a nu hile a vuo poma kithat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khat a gu poma, tua a kigu mipa a kizua zosa ahi a, ama kunga omlai ahi zongin kithat ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:7"},"17":{"text":"A pa ahi sihle a nu samsie poma kithat ding hi.","ref":"Siem 20:9; Mat 15:4; Mrk 7:10"},"18":{"text":"Mite kihau a, khat in adang khat suong tawh sepin, ahi sihle a khuttum tawh a tup a, a mi suhkhah pa a si lo vangin lupmun tung ngahin omin,"},"19":{"text":"ahi vangin ama pongdawh kia a, ciengkhut tawh a pulam a vakhiet kawi zo leh, a liempa’ a thasup hun tangin sum pie-in a dam dongin a kep ding ci simlo, a mawna panin tua mivuo pa a peng ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Sila nei pa in sila pasal ahi a, sila numei ahi zongin khat moltum tawh satin tua sila pa a phuolsi pai leh, a nei pa dan kipie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin ni khat ahi a, ni ni ahi zongin tua sila a hin leh, ama dan kipie lo ding hi; azieh pen tua sila pa khu ama’ neisa ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Mite kihau-in nupi gailai khat liemsahin a ta a tol a, hinanle liemna dang khat in a nuathuol nawn sih po leh, a liemsah mipa pen nupi nu’ pasal nget zaza tawh kigaam ding a, lieusum pen thukhen mangte’ ciengtan zaza pie ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Sietna khatpo in a thuolkia leh hinna tangin hinna,"},"24":{"text":"mittang tangin mittang, ha tangin ha, khut tangin khut, keng tangin keng,","ref":"Siem 24:19-20; Thkna 19:21; Mat 5:38"},"25":{"text":"meikah tangin meikah, liemna tangin liemna, vuohna tangin vuohna pie ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Sila nei pa in sila pa ahi a, sila nu ahi zongin a mit satin a suhsiet leh, a mit lieuman dingin tua sila pa a suohta-in peisah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Sila nei pa in a sila pasal ahi a, a sila numei ahi zongin a hatang khat a suhtawng leh, a ha lieuman dingin sila pa a suohta-in peisah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Bawngtang khat in pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a ki tawh a pihlia leh suong tawh tua bawngtang kiseplia ding a, a sa kine lo ding hi; ahi vangin tua bawngtang nei pa pen mawna tawh kipeng ding hi.","title":"Neisa tawh Kisai Thukhamte"},"29":{"text":"A tawpsa hunin zong tua bawngtang in mipih zongsang a, a neipa kihil napi tua bawng a khum tuon sih a, tuale pasal khat ahi a, numei khat ahi zongin a thalia leh, tua bawngtang zong kiseplia ding a, a nei pa zong kithat ding hi."},"30":{"text":"A nei pa tungah luongman a kinget leh a nei pa in ama’ hinna tat nadingin sum kingen zaza pie ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bawngtang in tangval khat ahi a, ngahnu khat ahi zongin a ki tawh a pih leh, a nei pa tungah tam bang dan ma-in kibawl ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawngtang in sila pa khat ahi a, sila nu khat ahi zongin a ki tawh a pih leh, a nei pa in sila nei pa tungah ngun shekel sawmthum pie ding a, tua bawngtang suong tawh kiseplia ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Mi khat in dum honsa-in nuasie-in, ahi sihle dum khat to-in tua dum sin loin a koi a, tua dum sungah bawngtang khat ahi a, laa khat ahi zongin a kieh leh,"},"34":{"text":"dum nei pa in a manh za lieu-in, ama in a nei pa sum pie ding a, ahi vangin tua ganhing sisa pen ama in tang ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Mi khat’ bawngtang in adang khat’ bawngtang liemsahin tua bawngtang a si leh amate in bawngtang a hinglai pen zua-in a manh a hawm ding uhi; tuale amate in ganhing sisa pen zong hawm ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua bawngtang pen a tawpsa hunin mi pih a na zongsangsa ahi a, a nei pa thu kihil napi tua bawngtang a khum sih leh, a nei pa in bawngtang tangin bawngtang ma tawh lo ding a, ahi vangin ama in ganhing sisa pen tang ding hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi khat in bawngtang khat ahi sihle tuu khat gu a, tuale that a, go ahi sihle a zua leh, guta pa in bawngtang khat tangin bawngtang nga, le tuu khat tangin tuu li pie ding hi.
