(3b) Guta pa in ditkiana bawl ding a, hizongle tua banga a bawl zawh sih leh a guhtat ziehin ama kizua ding hi.","title":"Ditkiana Thukhamte"},"2":{"text":"(4) A kigu ganhing pen bawngtang ahi a, laa ahi a, tuu ahi zongin guta pa khut sungah a hingin a kimu leh guta pa in a za ni-in dinkia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Guta khat a inn lu laitah kimu-in a si nading za-in kisat leh tua sisan luonna ziehin mawna om lo hi;"},"4":{"text":"(3a) ahi vangin tua pen ni suo zawa pieng thu ahile sisan luonna ziehin mawna a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khat in lo khatah ahi a, lengga lo-ah ahi zongin gan tasahin ahi sihle midang khat’ lolai-ah gan hla-in a tatsah leh, a lo ahi sihle a lengga lo pana a pieng ga hoipen tawh ditkiana bawl ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mei in gamlah a law a, bu a ki-atsa kikholvumte ahi a, bukungte ahi zongin a kahtum leh, mei hal masa pa in a cing tahin dinkia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khat in a vengpa kungah sum ahi sihle vante kep dingin ap a, a vengpa’ inn panin tuate kigumangin, tua guta pa a kimat leh ama in a za ni-in dinkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Guta pa a kimat sih leh inn nei pa in a vengpa’ vante tungah a khut a nga amah a nga sih ahei ci thu a kitel nadingin Pasien mai-ah inn nei pa kipeipi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Neisa kituna thu khat popo ah, bawngtang, laa, tuu, puonsil, ahi sihle a mang na khat popo, mi khat in, “Tam kei-a’ hi,” a cina tungtangah, Pasien mai-ah alang nite’ thu kitut ding hi; Pasien in a mawsah mipa in a khat pa tungah a za ni-in lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khat in midang khat tungah laa, bawngtang, tuu, ahi sihle ganhing dang khat popo a kep dingin a ap a, tua gan a si ahi a, a liem ahi a, a kikaimang ahi zongin koima in a mu sih leh,"},"11":{"text":"khat pa in a khat’ neisa tungah ka khut ka ngah tah leh ci-in Topa mai-ah kiciemna tawh ama ni kikalah thu kikhen ding hi; a nei pa in tua kiciemna khu a sang ding a, ditkiana kibawl lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua a vante a kigu ahile a nei pa kidinkia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Gamsa neh ahile teci dingin tua gan peipisah in; tua ganhing nehmawh teng pen kilokia lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in midang khat’ gan khat a kawm a, a nei pa op lo kalin tua ganta liemin ahi sihle a si leh a kicingin ditkiana kinei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A nei pa a op leh ditkiana kinei lo ding hi. A kikawm ahile kawm manh beh kingen ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasal khat in kinunpi dinga zuthawl kipie nai lo ngahnu khat zawlin a luppi leh tua nu’ manh dingin moman pie ding a, zi-in la pai ding hi.","title":"Taangpi le Biehna Thukhamte"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pa in tua nu ama adingin a phal sih leh ama in ngahnu siengthote’ moman za sum pie ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 22:28-29"},"18":{"text":"Dawi-aitawi numeite na hinkhawi sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 18:10-11"},"19":{"text":"Ganhing a luppi mi poma kithat ding hi.","ref":"Siem 18:23; 20:15-16; Thkna 27:21"},"20":{"text":"Topa beh simlo pasien khat popo tungah biehpiehna a lui poma kisusie ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:2-7"},"21":{"text":"Pemta khat popo tungah tatkhiel loin na gawt sih ding uhi, azieh pen no zong Egypt gamah pemta na hi ngai uhi."},"22":{"text":"Meigong hile taga hile na bawlsie sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:9; Siem 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"23":{"text":"Amate na bawlsiet vua ka kunga ang kiko uleh keima in amau’ kikona ka za valon ding hi;"},"24":{"text":"ka lungthahna kuongin namsau tawh note kang that ding a, na zite uh meigong suohin na tate uh taga a suoh ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na lah vuah a zawng ka mite khat popo tung sum leitawi na pieh uleh a tung vuah sum leitawi a pie pa bangin na om sih ding uhi; note in amate tung panin a met na la sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 25:35-38; Thkna 15:7-11; 23:19-20"},"26":{"text":"Na vengpa ang pon puon na lah leh, nitum masangin ama kungah tua puon na piekia ding hi;"},"27":{"text":"bang ding ahei cile tua khu na vengpa in a kihui nadinga a zah a puon nei sun hi kha thei ding hi; bang silin tua mipa a kimu ta ding ahei? Keima kungah na vengpa ang kiko leh keima in ka za ding hi, azieh pen kei mi lainat siem pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:10-13"},"28":{"text":"Pasien na gensie sih ding vua, na mite tunga makaipa na samsie sih ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 23:5"},"29":{"text":"Na anlahna pan ule na lengga suhna pan vua ang letdawhte panin biehna pieh ding na kiheh sih ding uhi. Keima tungah na tacilte uh nei pie ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Na bawngtangte ule na tuute uh panin zong tua ma bangin nei pie ding uhi: Ni sagi sung api tawh om ding hi; a ni giet ni-in kei tungah nei pie ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Note pen keima tunga ang kisiensuote na hi uhi; tua ahi ziehin gamlahah gamsa in a nehsa ganhing sa kici na ne sih ding uhi; note in uite na pie ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 17:15"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A man lo thu na thezah sih ding uhi. Elna tawh teci pang dingin mi gilote tawh na kikhut zop sih ding uhi.","title":"Mikim Ading Thutang","ref":"Pei 20:16; Siem 19:11-12; Thkna 5:20"},"2":{"text":"Sietna bawl dingin mi a tamzaw’ thu na zui sih ding uhi; thu kineina-ah teci na pan ciengun mi a tamzaw lamah pangin thutang na lehei sih ding uhi;"},"3":{"text":"thu kineina-ah mizawngte zong na angvan tuom sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:15"},"4":{"text":"Na galte uh’ bawngtang hile a laa hile a gammang na tuokhah uleh na puohkia ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Note ang muda pa khat’ laa a van tawh a pua na mu uleh na peisan mawh sih ding vua, a keng tawh a dinkia thei nadingin na hu ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 22:1-4"},"6":{"text":"Na mipi a zawngte thu kineina tungtangah thutang na lehei sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"A man lo pi-a mi mawsahna khu a gamlapi-ah pelh unlen, maw nei lo pa le midih pa that sih un. Bang ding ahei cile keima in a tatkhiel pa ka suohta sah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Guhgol sum in uliente’ mit tawsah a, thuman mite’ thu a lehei ziehin guhgol na la sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:15; Thkna 16:19"},"9":{"text":"Pemta khat na gawt sih ding uhi; note in pemta’ lungsim na thei uhi, azieh pen note zong Egypt gamah pemta na hi ngai uhi.","ref":"Pei 22:21; Siem 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"10":{"text":"Kum guh sung na lo vuah khai tu-in a piengte na kaikhawm ding uhi;","title":"Kum Sagina le Sabbath"},"11":{"text":"ahi vangin a kum sagina ciengin na mipi uh a zawngte in a neh thei nadingun leitang na tawlngasahin hlaw loin lo na khul ding uhi; gamsate in amate’ nuasie teng ne ding uhi. Na lengga lote ule na olive lote uzong tua bang ma-in na bawl ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 25:1-7"},"12":{"text":"Ni guh sung na nasep na sem ding vua, ahi vangin na bawngtangte ule na laate uh a khawl thei nading le, na inn sung vua a suoh silate le pemtate in tha tha a nga thei nadingun a ni sagi ni-in na tawlnga ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:9-11; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Siem 23:3; Thkna 5:13-14"},"13":{"text":"Na kung vua kang gensa zosie thusim unlen, pasien dangte’ min lo kha sih un; na kam panun tuate kizasah sih un."},"14":{"text":"Keima adingin kum khatin pawi thumvei na bawl ding uhi.","title":"Kumcin Pawite (Pei 34:18-26 ; Thkna 16:1-17)"},"15":{"text":"Tolsaw lo anlum pawi na bawl ding uhi; keima in kang thupieh bangin Abib hla a kisesa hunin ni sagi sung tol saw lo anlum na ne ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile tua hla sungin Egypt panin note na peikhie uhi. Ka mai-ah khutguoh tawh koima ang kilaa lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 12:14-20; Siem 23:6-8; Gam 28:17-25"},"16":{"text":"Lo sunga na tu uh, na na sepna uh a ga masate tawh anlah pawi na bawl ding uhi. Lo sunga khaici na tu hun vua kipanin na sepna uh a ga na kaikhop uh kum tawp ciengin an kaikhopna pawi na bawl ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 23:15-21, 39-43; Gam 28:26-31"},"17":{"text":"Topa Pasien mai-ah na pasal zosie uh kum khatin thumvei kilaa ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tol kisawsa sil khat popo tawh ka biehpiehna si na pieton sih ding vua, ahi sihle ka pawi-a kipie a thaute zingmawng dongin na omsah sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ inn ah leitanga pieng na anpal uh a hoi pen na peipi ding uhi. Api’ nawizu tawh keelno na huontha sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 34:26; Thkna 14:21; 26:2"},"20":{"text":"Ka bawlsa munah note ang peipi ding le lamkalah ang cing dingin na mai vuah vantungmi khat ka sawl ding hi.","title":"Canaan Zaw Nading Kikamciem"},"21":{"text":"Ama thusimin ama’ aw ngai un; ama ledo sih un. Ama sungah ka min om ahi ziehin ama in na thu palsatte uh ang maisah sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ aw limtahin ngai-in ka thu gen zosie na sep uleh na galte’ gal ka hi ding a, na langte’ lang ka hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na mai vuah ka vantungmi pei-in Amor-te, Hit-te, Perez-te, Canaan-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te kungah hing peipi-in, amate ka phietmang ciengin,"},"24":{"text":"a pasien-te uh’ mai-ah kun loin, a na uzong sem loin, amau’ gamtat bangin na gamta sih ding vua, a pasien-te uh suhsiet piehin a milim khuompite uh na satguoi pieh ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh na bie ding vua, keima in na an ule na tui uh thupha ka pie ding hi; keima in note lah panin natna ka lamang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na gam sung vuah nausie le a ciing koima om lo ding hi; keima in note kang vuoisi sah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Na mai vuah ka zauhuoina ka sawl ding a, na phuhkhah ding mi zosie lungbuoisahin, na kung panun na galte zosie kihei-in ka taisah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Keima in na mai panun Hiv-te, Canaan-te le Hit-te a notmang dingin natna ka sawl ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Leitang gamkhing suohin na langkhat vuah gamsa ang tam luo ding ahi ziehin kum khat sungin na mai panun amate ka notmang sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Khumi gam a luo khop ding za-a na tam masangun na mai panun them khat khatin amate ka delmang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"San Tuipi panin Philistia-te’ tuipi dong le senel gam panin Euphrates gun dongin na gamgi uh ka phut ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile keima in na khut sung vuah tua gama tengte kang pie ding a, na mai vuah amate na delmang ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate le a pasien-te utawh thuciemna na bawl sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na gam sung vuah amate teng lo ding hi. Tua hi sihle amate in kei tungah note ang mawsah ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile a pasien-te uh na bieh uleh tua khu note dingin thangkam khat ang hi tahtah ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua cieng in ama in Moses kungah, “Nangma le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel upate sawm sagi tawh Topa kungah peito unlen, a gamla panin bie un.","title":"Thuciemna Sisan"},"2":{"text":"Topa nai-ah Moses beh pei ding hi; ama’ nai-ah adangte a pei sih ding vua, ama tawh mite peito lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses a pei a, ama in Topa’ thugen zosie le biehna ngaina zosie, mipie kungah a gen hi; mi zosie in kituoh tahin a dawng vua, “ Topa’ thu gen zosie ka bawl ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale Topa’ thugen zosie Moses in a giel hi. Ama zingmawngin thobai-in muol bulah maitam khat lam a, Israel minam sawm le nite tawh kituohin khuom sawm le ni phut hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Topa tungah meihal biehna le thunuoma biehnate a lui dingin Israel khangnote a sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in gansi alang la-in kuong sungah koi a, maitam tungah gansi alang the hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in thuciemna laibu la a, mipite’ zahin tua laibu a sim hi. Tuale amate in, “ Topa’ thugen zosie bawlin thu ka mang ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Moses in gansi la-in mipi tungah the a, ama in, “Tami thu zosie tawh kizui-in Topa in note tawh a bawlsa thuciemna sisan en un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 26:28; Mrk 14:24; Luk 22:20; 1Cor 11:25; Heb 9:19-20; 10:29"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel upate mi sawm sagi a peito vua,","title":"Pasien tawh Muol Tungah"},"10":{"text":"tuale amate in Israel’ Pasien a mu uhi. A keng nei-ah a sienthona van mel tawh kibang, sapphire suongmanpha tawh a kibawl suongpha bang dan khat om hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel makaite tungah Pasien in a khut ngam lo hi; amate in zong Pasien a mu vua, an ne tui dawnin a om uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Muol tunga keima kungah hing peito inlen, tua tahah ei na ngah in; amate lam lah nadinga ka gielsa thukham le thupieh kigielna suongpehte kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nasempa Joshua tawh Moses dingkhie a, Pasien’ muol tungah Moses a peito hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in upate kungah, “Na kung vua kang peikia masangun tam sungah ei ngah un; azieh pen note tawh Aaron le Hur a om hi; thu nei popo ama gel kungah pei thei hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin muol tungah Moses peito a, meei in muol a tuom hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ vanglietna Sinai Muol tungah kumsuh a, meei in ni sagi sung tua muol a tuomcip hi; a ni sagi ni-in ama in meei lah panin Moses hlan hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in Topa’ vanglietna ang kilah dan pen Israel mite’ muna-ah muol vuma a katum mei tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Meii lahah Moses lut a, muol tungah a peito hi. Sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung muol tungah Moses a thaam hi.","ref":"Thkna 9:9"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Biehbuh Ading Biehnate (Pei 35:4-9)"},"2":{"text":"Keima ading biehna ang peipi nadingun Israel-te kungah gen in; alungtang sungah a pie nuom mi zosie tung panin kei adingin biehna na sang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate tung pana na san ding biehna khu tam teng ahi hi: Kham, ngun, sumngo,"},"4":{"text":"a dum, a dupsan, le a ausan puonte le hoitaha kigan puonte, keelmul,"},"5":{"text":"a sana kibum tuutang vunte, savun kizutnem sa, gising,"},"6":{"text":"meivahte ading sathau, nu sathau ding le gimnamtui dingin sil namtuite,"},"7":{"text":"siempu puon le awmdal-a kikhai ding suongsan le onyx suongte ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate lahah ka ten thei nadingin kei adingin amate mun siengtho khat bawlsah in."},"9":{"text":"Biehbuh le a vanzah zosie’ lim dan ding tawh kisai-in na kunga kang lah zosie tawh kituohin na bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in gising tawh singkuong khat bawl ding uhi; adung tong ni le alang, avai tong khat le khap, a sanna tong khat le khap hi ding hi.","title":"Thuciemna Singkuong (Pei 37:1-9)"},"11":{"text":"Nangma in kham citah tawh tuami singkuong a sung a puo na zut ding a, a tung kimvelah kham tawh a geihuol na bawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma in tua singkuong adingin kham kuol li sungin singkuong keng lite tungah tuate na bul ding a, apang khatah kuol ni, apang lang khatah kuol ni ma na bul ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Gising singzawl na sui ding a, kham tawh tuate na zut ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Singkuong puoh nadingin singkuong panga a kuolte sungah a zawlte na siet ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Singkuong’ bilte sungah zawlte om suoh ding hi; tuate kilakhie lo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma in singkuong sungah kang pieh ding thuciemna na koi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin kham citah tawh hepina topha! khat na bawl ding hi; adung tong ni le khap, avai tong khat le khap hi ding hi.","ref":"Rom 3:25; Heb 9:5"},"18":{"text":"Kham Cherub ni na bawl ding hi; hepina topha mong tuohah a kikheng tua Cherub-te na omsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Among khatah Cherub khat bawl inlen, among lang khatah Cherub khat ma bawl in; among tuohah Cherub-te na bawl ding a, tuate hepina topha tawh sakhatin na bawl ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Cherub-te in a tung lamah a hlate zahin, a hlate tawh hepina topha lie suhin khatlekhat kimaingat ding hi; Cherub-te’ maitang in hepina topha lam nga ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Singkuong tungah hepina topha na koi ding a, singkuong sungah nangma kang pieh ding thuciemna na koi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hepina topha tung, thuciemna singkuong tunga om Cherub nite kikal panin nang kang kimupi ding a, khumi munah Israel-te adinga ka thupiehte zosie a unpi-in nangma tungah kang pie ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Gising tawh sabuoi khat na bawl ding a, adung tong ni, avai tong khat, a sanna tong khat le khap hi ding hi.","title":"Ompina Anlum Ading Sabuoi (Pei 37:10-16)"},"24":{"text":"Kham citah tawh tua sabuoi na zut ding a, a kimvelah kham tawh a geihuol na bawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Sabuoi kimvelah avai khutpeh cie a pha zawlpeh khat na bawl ding a, tua zawlpeh kimvelah kham tawh a geihuol na bawl ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua sabuoi adingin kham kuol li na bawl ding a, a ning li, a keng lite-ah na hen ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Sabuoi zawn nading zawlte a tu dingin a zawlpeh gei-ah a kuolte om ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Gising tawh zawlte bawlin kham tawh na zut ding a, tamte tawh sabuoi kizawng ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Gimnamtui adingin kuongdaite le pakante, dawn thei biehna sun nadingin thawlte le haite na bawl ding hi; kham citah tawh tuate na bawl ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima’ mai sabuoi tungah Ompina Anlum na koi zing ding hi.","ref":"Siem 24:5-8"},"31":{"text":"Kham citah tawh meivah tunna khat na bawl ding hi. Meivah tunna bul le a kungte pen sehta tawh kikhensa hi ding hi; a haite, a nunte le a papete tua tawh kisamat ding hi;","title":"Meivah Tunna (Pei 37:17-24)"},"32":{"text":"a pangte panin ba guh meng ding a, a pang khatah meivah tunna ba thum mengin, a pang lang khatah meivah tunna ba thum ma meng ding hi;"},"33":{"text":"a ba khat ciet tungah a nun le a pape a om almond ga tawh a kibang hai thum, le adang ba khat ciet tungah a nun le a pape a om almond ga tawh a kibang hai thum ma om ding a, meivah tunna panin a ba guh mengkhie ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua meivah tunna tung mama-ah a nunte le pape khat ciet a nei almond ga tawh a kibang hai li om ding hi."},"35":{"text":"A kopa a menkhietna a masa pen nei-ah a nun khat om ding a, a kop nina nei-ah a nun khat ma om ding hi. A kop tawpna nei-ah a nun khat om ding a, meivah tunna panin a ba guh mengkhie ding hi."},"36":{"text":"A nunte le a bate kisamat ding a, a unpi-in kham citah tawh kikheng hi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama adingin meivah sagi na bawl ding hi; a mai teng a tanvah dingin meivahte kikoi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"A meitena taite le a dopna kuongte kham citah hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"A umlebeel zosie kham citah talent khat tawh kibawl ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Muol tunga kang lah lim dan bangbanga tuate na bawl ding ahi lam thei in.","ref":"Sawl 7:44; Heb 8:5"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua tham loin a kop-a kihiaton vau hoi tawh a kigan a dum, a dupsan le a ausan dalna puon sawm le a dum, a dupsan le a ausan khaute tawh biehbuh na bawl ding hi; khutsiemte in a bawl cherub-te tawh tuate na bawl ding hi.","title":"Biehbuh (Pei 36:8-38)"},"2":{"text":"Dalna puon pen adung tong sawmni le giet ciet hi ding a, avai tong li ciet hi ding hi; dalna puon zosie a unpi-in kikim ciet ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Dalna puon ngate khatlekhat kikhuituo ding hi; adang dalna puon ngate zong khatlekhat kikhuituo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A kikhuituo a masa dalna puon a geita pen’ puonmong gei guolah vaudum tawh a bilvangte na bawl ding hi; tua bang ma-in a kikhuituo a nina dalna puon a geita pen’ puonmong gei guolah a bilvangte na bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Dalna puon khat tungah bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituo a nina dalna puon mongah bilvang sawmnga ma na bawl ding hi; a bilvangte khatlekhat kimaingat ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Biehbuh buppikhat a suo thei nadingin kham kilna sawmnga bawlin, tua kilnate tawh dalna puonte khatlekhat na kimatsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Biehbuh tunga om puonbuh a tung khu nadingin kelmul tawh a kigan dalna puonte zong na bawl ding hi; dalna puon sawm le khat na bawl ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua dalna puon adung tong sawm thum ciet hi ding a, avai tong li ciet hi ding hi; tua dalna puon sawm le khatte kikim ciet ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Dalna puon ngate ama le ama na kikhuituosah ding a, dalna puon guhte zong khuituo-in a guhna puon pen puonbuh mai-ah na hlip ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A kikhuituo dalna puon a geita pen’ mongah bilvang sawmnga na bawl ding a, a kikhuituo a nina dalna puon geita pen mongah bilvang sawmnga ma na bawl ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Puonbuh buppikhat a suo thei nadingin sumngo kilna sawmnga na bawl ding a, a bilvangte sungah a kilna teng hengin puonbuh na kimatsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Puonbuh puon dalna puon a valkhie, puon alang val pen biehbuh nua lamah kaisuh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Puonbuh puon adung lam, pang khatah tong khat le alang, a pang lang khatah tong khat le alang val pen biehbuh tungkhu dingin tam lampang le khum lampangte-ah kaisuh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A sana kibum tuutang’ vun le kelvun hoite tawh puonbuh khuna na bawl ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Biehbuh adingin a poto ding gising khuompehte na sui ding hi.","title":"Khuompehte"},"16":{"text":"Khuompeh khat adung tong sawm hi ding a, avai tong khat le khap ta hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuompehte a kibulton thei nadingin khuompeh khatah a zang ni ta om ding hi; biehbuh khuompeh zosie adingin tamte na bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Biehbuh’ khuompehte tam bangin na sui ding hi: Leitaw lampang adingin khuompeh sawmni na sui ding hi;"},"19":{"text":"khuompeh sawmnite zungah ngun tawh kibawl a tunna sawm li na bawl ding a, a zang nite adingin a masa khuompeh zungah a tunna ni, le a bana khuompeh khat zungah a zang nite adingin a tunna ni ma hi ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"biehbuh a pang nina lam, leilu lampanga a om khuompeh sawmnite le"},"21":{"text":"ngun tawh a kibawl a tunna sawmli adingin khuompeh khatah a tunna ni, adang khuompeh khat bulah a tunna ni ma hi ding hi;"},"22":{"text":"nitumna lam kinga biehbuh nualam adingin khuompeh guh na sui ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Biehbuh nualam a ningte adingin khuompeh ni na sui ding hi;"},"24":{"text":"tuate pen a nei lamah kikah ding a, hizongle a kuol masa-ah a dawn kimat ding hi; a ni tuohin tua bang hi ding a, tua tegel in a ning ni piengsah ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngun tawh a kibawl a tunna sawm le guh adingin khuompeh giet hi ding hi; khuompeh khatah a tunna ni ta om ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Gising kotgolte na sui ding a, biehbuh pang khat a khuompeh adingin kotgol nga,"},"27":{"text":"le biehbuh pang lang khat khuompehte adingin kotgol nga, nitumna lam kinga biehbuh sialam panga khuompehte adingin kotgol nga hi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Kotgol a laita khuompeh laikim dong a banto pen mong khat panin mong khat dongin pei suoh ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Khuompehte kham tawh na zut ding a, kotgolte a tu dingin a kuolte kham tawh na bawl ding hi; kotgolte kham tawh na zut ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin muol tunga ang kilahsa gelna bangbangin biehbuh na lam ding hi."},"31":{"text":"A dum, a dupsan, a ausan, le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoi tawh a kigan dalna puon khat na bawl ding hi; tua puonte pen cherub-te tawh khutsiem taha kigan hi ding hi.","title":"Dalna Puon"},"32":{"text":"Ngun tawh a kibawl a tunna lite tunga a om, kham vankhaina nei, kham tawh kizut gising khuompi lite tungah tuate na khai ding hi."},"33":{"text":"A kilnate-ah dalna puon khaisuhin, dalna puon sung tua munah thuciemna singkuong na koi ding hi; dalna puon in note dingin a siengtho pen mun le a siengtho mun khen ding hi.","ref":"Heb 6:19; 9:3-5"},"34":{"text":"Hepina topha pen a siengtho pen mun, thuciemna singkuong tungah na koi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Dalna puon pulamah sabuoi na koi ding a, sabuoi tawh a kimaingat biehbuh leitaw lam pangah meivah khuom na koi ding hi; leilu lampangah sabuoi na koi ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Puonbuh kotkha dalna puonkhai dingin a dum, a sandup, a ausan, le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoi tawh a kigan, hieu tawh kikhui-in hoi taha kizem khat na bawl ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Kotkhah puonkhai adingin gising khuompi nga bawlin kham tawh na zut ding hi; a vankhainate pen kham hi-in, tuate adingin sumngo tawh a kibawl a tunna nga na bawl ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adung tong nga, avai tong nga a pha maitam khat na bawl ding hi; tua maitam in a kikim ning li nei-in, tong thum sang ding hi.","title":"Meihal Biehna Maitam (Pei 38:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Tua maitam ning li teng tungah a ki na bawl ding hi; a kite maitam tawh kicimatin sumngo tawh na zut ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Vut khol nading beelte le kawbia-te, kuongte, siakate le vutluona pehte na bawl ding hi; a vanzah zosie sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuami-a zah dingin sumngo sialen khat zong na phan ding hi; tua sia-len tunga a ning li tengah sumngo kuol li na vaw ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Sialen in maitam kimcieng a batsuh thei nadingin maitam zawl nei-ah na bul ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Maitam dingin gising zawlte na bawl ding a, sumngo tawh tuate na zut ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"a kipuoh ciengin maitam pang nite tungah a zawlte a op thei nadingin a kuol vangte sungah a zawlte kikhum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Siapehte tawh maitam a lai pen na hawmsah ding hi. Muol tung nangma kunga ang kilahsa bang lienin tuate kibawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Biehbuh tuol na bawl ding hi. Leitaw lampang in tong zakhat a sau, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoi tawh a kigan a kikhaisuh dalna puonte nei ding hi;","title":"Biehbuh Tuol le A Khainate (Pei 38:9-20)"},"10":{"text":"a khuompi sawmni le a tunna sawmni pen sumngo tawh kibawl hi ding a, ahi vangin khuomte tunga vankhainate le a gaanate ngun tawh kibawl hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Leilu lampang zong a sauna tua za ma hi ding a, a kikhaisuh dalna puon tong zakhat hi-in, a khuom sawmni le a tunna sawmnite sumngo tawh kibawl ding a, ahi vangin khuompite tunga vankhainate le a gaanate ngun tawh kibawl hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna lampangah buhtuol a vailam adingin khuom sawm le a tunna sawm tawh tong sawmnga a sau a kikhaisuh dalna puon om ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Buhtuol nisuona mailam zong avai tong sawmnga hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pang khatah a kikhaisuh dalna puon tong sawm le nga hi ding a, khuom thum le a tunna thum tawh hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A pang langkhatah a kikhaisuh dalna puon pen tong sawm le nga hi ding a, khuom thum le a tunna thum tawh hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Buhtuol kotpi dingin tong sawmni a sau, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kop-a kihiation vau hoite tawh a kigan, hieu tawh kikhui-in a kizem kot puonkhai khat om ding hi; tua in khuom li le a tunna li nei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Buhtuol kimvela khuom zosie ngun tawh kigah ding hi; a vankhainate ngun hi-in a tunnate sumngo hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Buhtuol adung tong zakhat, avai tong sawmnga, a sanna tong nga hi ding a, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoi tawh a kigan a kikhaisuh dalna puon le sumngo tawh kibawl a tunnate tawh hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Biehbuh sunga vanzah ding poma, a khetphim zosie le buhtuol-a khetphim zosie sumngo tawh kibawl hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Meivah a kuon zing thei nadingin, mei-a vah ding a kigawtguoi olive ga, sathau siengtho, Israel-te in nangma kungah ang tawi nadingin thu na pie lai ding hi.","title":"Meivah Ading Sathau (Siem 24:1-4)"},"21":{"text":"Tua meivah a kuon zing thei nadingin Aaron le a tapate in kikhopna puonbuh sung, thuciemna singkuong mai-a dalna puon pulamah, nitah pan zingmawng dongin Topa mai-ah vil ding uhi. Tua khu a khantan vua Israel-te in a zui ding uh ngaina kip khat hi ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima kunga siempu na a sem dingin Israel-te lah panin na sanggampa Aaron, a tapate- Nadab le Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar-te tawh, nangma kungah peipi in.","title":"Siempu Puonte (Pei 39:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in thupina a tan thei nadingin na sanggampa Aaron ading puonsil siengthote na bawlpieh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka siempu na sem dinga Aaron a kisiensuo thei nadingin pilna lungtang a nei, bawl thei siemna ka guotsa mi zosie kungah Aaron’ puonte a gatpieh nadingun na gen ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A puon gat dingte uh tam teng ahi hi: Awmdal khat, siempu puon khat, puontuol khat, sih li a nei puonah tungsil pawl bilbiel khat, dielkhim khat le kawnggah khat ahi hi. Keima kunga siempu na a sem ding Aaron le a tapate adingin puonah siengthote a bawl ciengun"},"5":{"text":"amate in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le hoitaha kigan puonte zang ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vaute le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh khutsiem taha kigan siempu puon bawl ding uhi.","title":"Siempu Puon"},"7":{"text":"Siempu puon pen a liengko-a khikip nadingin among nite-ah a kimat liengkaih puon ni nei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuami tunga a om a kizem kawnggah zong a bawl dan le a vanzahte tua bang ma hi ding a, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh kibawl hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Onyx suong ni la-in tua gel tungah Israel tapate’ min na giel ding a,"},"10":{"text":"a suona utawh kizui-in suong khat tungah amau’ min guh teng gielin, a omlai guhte’ min pen suong dang khat tungah na giel ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Suong manpha at pa in khutsip a khuoh bangin tua suong nite tungah Israel tapate’ min khenkuohin na giel ding hi; kham tawh kibawl a geiviel sungah tuate na koi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel tapate phawna suong dingin siempu puon’ liengkaih puon tungah tua suong tegel na bul ding hi; Aaron in a liengko tegel tungah phawzing nadingin Topa mai-ah amau’ min puo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kham tawh kibawl a geiviel le"},"14":{"text":"khauhuol banga kihuol, kham citah khainieng kipheh ni na bawl ding hi; a bulnate tungah a kihuol khainiengte na bul ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Siemnel tahin thukhenna awmdal khat na bawl ding ahi; siempu puonah a kibawl bangma-in na bawl ding hi; kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh na bawl ding hi.","title":"Awmdal (Pei 39:8-21)"},"16":{"text":"Tua khu a kikim ning li nei-in thuop ni hi ding a, a dunglam khap khat, a vailam khap khat ma hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua sungah suong guol li-in na cieng ding hi. A guol masa, carnelian, chrysolite, le emerald suongte hi ding hi;"},"18":{"text":"a guol nina, turquoise, sapphire, le suongkangte hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A guol thumna, jacinth, agate, le amethyst suongte hi ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"a guol lina, beryl, onyx, le jasper suongte hi ding a, kham geiviel sungah kibul ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel tapate’ min tawh kituohin a min uh a kigielna suong sawm le ni om ding hi; tuate pen minam sawm le nite adinga a min ciet uh a kigielna khutsipte tawh kibang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A awmdal dingin khauhuol bangin kham citah khainieng kipheh na bawl ding hi;"},"23":{"text":"a awmdal dingin kham kuol ni na bawl ding a, awmdal mongte-ah tuate na bul ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Awmdal monga a kuol nite sungah kham khauhuol ni tegel na khum ding hi;"},"25":{"text":"khauhuol mong nite a bulna nite tawh na zom ding a, siempu puon’ liengkaih puon mai lamah tua bangin na zom ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Kham kuol ni bawlin, tua a kuol tegel awmdal mong ni, a sunglam mong kawnggah banah na bul ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kham kuol ni na bawl ding a, siempu puon liengkaih ni tegel’ nei a mailam, hoitaha kigan siempu puonkhau a kizopna tung son ah na bul ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hoitaha kigan siempu puonkhau tungah a beh den thei nading le siempu puon tung panin awmdal a hlagin lo nadingin siempu puon kuolah khauhuol dum khat tawh kigahton ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin, Topa mai-ah phawzing nadingin a siengtho munah a pei ciengin, Aaron in a lungtang tunga om thukhenna awmdal sungah Israel tapate’ min puo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Thukhenna awmdal sungah Urim le Thummim na koi ding a, Topa mai-ah a pei ciengin Aaron’ lungtang tungah tuate om ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron in a lungtang tungah Israel-te’ thukhenna pen Topa mai-ah puo tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Gam 27:21; Thkna 33:8; Ezr 2:63; Neh 7:65"},"31":{"text":"Siempu puontuolpi pen puondum vive tawh na bawl ding hi.","title":"Siempu Puon Adangte (Pei 39:22-31)"},"32":{"text":"A laikimah lu khum nading a vang khat nei ding a, puon-ngawng banga a kike lo nadingin a ngawng vang kimvelah ki-aiha kai ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Puontuolpi mong nei lam pen a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vaukhaute tawh a kizem mang kawlsing ga na bawl ding a, tuate kikalah kham sialawng na bawl ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Puontuolpi mong kimvelah kham sialawng le mang kawlsing gate, a kikahhal dimdiemin a ban banin na khai ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Aaron in siempu na a sep ciengin tua puon sil ding a, Topa mai a siengtho munah a tum cieng le a pusuo ciengin ama a si lo nadingin a ging kiza ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Kham citah tawh a peh khat na bawl ding a, khutsip tunga lai kigielte bangin tua tungah, “ Topa ading Siengtho,” ci-in na gielkuoh ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua pen dielkhim tungah khauhuol dum khat tawh na khi ding hi; tua pen dielkhim mailamah om ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua pen Aaron’ talpang ah om ding a, Israel-te in letsong siengthote a piehna uh ahi, a siengtho silpieh ah khielna khatpo a op leh Aaron in lukhuh ding hi; Topa mai-ah amate a kisan thei nadingin a talpang vuah tua a peh om zing ding hi."},"39":{"text":"A puon tungsil ding pen khau hoi tawh sih li nei, a pawlin na gan ding a, khau hoi tawh dielkhip khat zong bawlin hieu tawh a kikhui a kizem kawngga khat na bawl ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate adingin puon tungsilte, kawnggahte, le lukhute na bawlpieh ding hi; thupina tawh a kidim nadingin tuate na bawl ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate in keima kungah siempu na a sep thei nadingun na sanggampa Aaron le a tapate na silsah ding a, amate sathau nu-in na sem dingin kipsahin na siensuo ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A guoh vua a opna uh a khu dingin amate dingin puon hoi tawh bawngbi sungtente na bawlpieh ding hi; tuate in kawng panin phei cieng dong ban ding uhi;"},"43":{"text":"kikhopna puonbuh sungah a pei cieng uh ahi a, a siengtho munah na sem dingin maitam nai-ah a pei ciengun ahi zongin, Aaron le a tapate in tuate sil ding uhi. Tua hi sihle amate in amau’ tung ma-ah mawna kisuontawm suohin si ding uhi. Tami pen ama le a nuasie a suonlehlahte adingin a om zing ngaina kip khat hi ding hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate in ka siempu na a sep thei nadingun a tung vuah siensuona tam bangin na bawl ding hi. Paubaang lo bawngtangno khat le tuutang ni,","title":"Siempute Suhdetna (Siem 8:1-36)"},"2":{"text":"tol saw lo anlum, sathau kihal tol saw lo mohte, sathau tawh a kizut tol sawlo mophengte la in. Tuate pen mangbunel tawh na bawl ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Law khat sungah tuate na koi ding a, a law tawh tawi-in bawngtang le tuutang ni zong na peipi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh kotbiengah Aaron le a tapate na zawpi ding a, tui tawh amate na sil ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin puonte la-in, puon tungsil le siempu puontuolpi, siempu puon le awmdal, Aaron na silsah ding a, hoitaha kigan siempu puon gaana tawh ama na gah ding hi;"},"6":{"text":"a lu tungah diel na khimsah ding a, dielkhim tungah kumpi lukhu siengtho na khusah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nu sathau la-in a luzangah sungsuhin na nu ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin a tapate zawpi-in puontungsil na silsah ding a,"},"9":{"text":"kawnggahte tawh gahin, a lutung vuah lukhute na khusah ding hi; tawntung ngaina kip a omsa ma bangin siempu nasepna pen amau-a’ hi ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron le a tapate na sudet ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh mai-ah bawngtang na peipi ding hi. Aaron le a tapate in bawngtang’ lu tungah a khut uh ngam ding a,"},"11":{"text":"Topa mai, kikhopna puonbuh lutna mai-ah tua bawngtang na go ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bawngtang si themkhat la-in na khutme tawh maitam kite tungah na nu ding a, a omlai a si teng zosie maitam zungah na sung ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A gilpi tuom a thau zosie le a sin tuom a tepkai le a kal ni le a kal tuom a thaute la-in maitam tungah tuate na hal ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin bawngtang sa le a vun le a eehte, giephuol pu lamah mei tawh na hal ding hi; tua khu mawna zieha biehna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuutangte khat la-in Aaron le a tapate in tuutang luzangah a khut a ngam ding vua,"},"16":{"text":"tuale tuami tuutang go-in a si la-in maitam kimvelah na the ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuutang semnenin a sungkuo le a kengte na sawp sieng ding a, a sabate le a lu tawh tuate koitonin,"},"18":{"text":"maitam tungah tuutang sa a unpi-in na hal ding hi; tua khu Topa tunga meihal biehna hi ahi a; a gimnamtui, Topa tunga mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi.","ref":"Eph 5:2; Phil 4:18"},"19":{"text":"Tuutang adang khat na la ding hi; tuale Aaron le a tapate in a luzangah a khut uh ngam ding a,"},"20":{"text":"tua tuutang go-in a si them khat la-in Aaron’ zietlam bildawn, a tapate’ zietlam bildawn, amau’ zietlam khutpi dawn le amau’ zietlam kepi dawnte nu-in, a si omlai teng maitam apang zosie-ah na the ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin maitam tunga om gansi themkhat le nu sathau themkhat la-in Aaron le a puonte tung le a tapate le a puonte tungah na the ding hi; tua ciengin ama le a puonte a siengtho hi ding a, a tapate le a tapa’ puonte zong a siengtho hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuutang thau, a mei thau, a sungkuo tuom a thau, a sin tunga beh a tepkai, a kalgel a tuom a thau, le a phei zietlam (azieh pen tua khu suhdetna tuutang ahi hi)"},"23":{"text":"le Topa mai-a om tol saw lo anlum law sung panin anlum khat, sathau tawh kibawl anlum beh khat, le mopheng khat na la ding hi;"},"24":{"text":"tam teng pen a unpi-in Aaron’ khutphang le a tapate’ khutphang tungah na koi ding a, Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna dingin tuate na lamto ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin a khut sung panun tuate na la ding a, Topa mai-ah a namtui dingin gimnamtui meihal biehna maitam tungah mei tawh na haltum ding hi. Tua khu Topa tunga mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Aaron suhdetna dinga kigo tuutang’ awmpheu la-in Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in na lamto ding hi; tua khu nangma’ tanh hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A kivei biehna dinga kilamto a awmpheu le suhdetna biehna tuutang pana Aaron le a tapate tanh ding ahi a kivei biehna dinga kilamto a mal na siensuo ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam teng pen Aaron le a tapate dinga Israel-te tung pana a kaih zing ding uh ahi hi, azieh pen tami khu biehna khat ahi hi; tua khu Israel-te in Topa tunga thunuom biehna dinga a pieh uh a biehpiehna uh pana biehna khat hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A siengtho Aaron’ puonsilte pen ama’ si nua ciengin a tapate kipie ding hi; tua puonte sungah amate sathau kinu-in kisudet ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama’ siempu za a laih a tapa in siengtho munah na sem dingin kikhopna puonbuh ah a pei ciengin ni sagi sung tua puonte sil ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Suhdetna tuutang na la ding a, mun siengtho khatah a sa na huon ding hi;"},"32":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah tuutang sa le law sunga anlum ne ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Amate mama in kisuhdet nading le kisiensuo nadingin thoidamna an a ne ding vua, hizongle midangte in ne thei lo ding hi. Azieh pen tuate a siengtho ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Suhdetna sa ahi a, anlum ahi zongin zingmawng donga a op lai leh aval teng mei-ah na haltum ding hi; tua khu a siengtho ahi ziehin kine lo ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Kang thupiehsa bang lienin Aaron le a tapate tungah na bawl ding hi; ni sagi sung tungtawn amate na sudet ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Thoidamna bawl nadingin mawna zieha biehna-in bawngtang khat zong nisielin na pie ding hi. Thoidamna na bawl ciengin maitam adingin zong mawna zieha biehna na pie ding a, tuale maitam sathau nu-in na siensuo ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Maitam adingin ni sagi sung thoidamna bawlin na siensuo ding a, tua maitam a siengtho pen hi ding hi; tua maitam a tham poma siengtho ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tu-in maitam tunga na pieh ding tam teng ahi hi: Nisielin kum khat a pha tuuno ni ta na pie ding hi.","title":"Nisim Biehnate (Gam 28:1-8)"},"39":{"text":"Zingmawngin tuuno khat na pie ding a, nitah lamin adang tuuno khat na pie ding hi;"},"40":{"text":"tuuno a masa tawh olive thau kigawtvui hai khat’ seli-suo-sekhat tawh kihal annel law khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat, le dawn thei biehna dingin lenggazu hai khat’ se li-suo-se khat hi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Nitah lamin tuuno adang khat na pie ding a, zingmawnga bang ma-in a gimnamtui ding, Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biehna dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehna na piehtha ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua khu na khang tawntung vua kikhopna puonbuh lutna Topa mai-a na bawl zing ding uh meihal biehna hi ding a, keima in khum munah hing kimupi-in kang holimpi ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Khum munah Israel-te ka kimupi ding a, keima’ vang in khum mun ka siengthosah ding hi;"},"44":{"text":"kikhopna puonbuh le maitam ka siensuo ding hi; ka siempu na sem dingin Aaron le a tapate zong ka siensuo ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Israel-te lahah ka teng ding a, amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Amate lahah ka ten thei nadingin Egypt gam pana a peipi pa Topa a Pasien uh ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi; Keima amau’ Topa ka hi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gimnamtui hal nading maitam khat na bawl ding hi; tua khu gising tawh na bawl ding hi.","title":"Gimnamtui Maitam (Pei 37:25-28)"},"2":{"text":"Adung tong khat, avai tong khat hi ding hi; a kikim ning li nei hi ding a, a sanna tong ni hi ding hi; a kite maitam tawh sa khat suoh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A tung le a pang kimkot zosie le a kite pen kham citah tawh na zut ding hi; a kimvelah kham geihuol na bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Maitam adingin kham kuol ni na bawl ding hi; a geihuol nei-a kigalsai a pang tuohah tuate bawlin tuate tawh maitam puo ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gising tawh ciengzawlte na bawl ding a, kham tawh tuate na zut ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma tawh ka kituo nading mun, thuciemna tunga om hepina topha mai, thuciemna tunga om dalna puon mai-ah tua maitam na koi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Aaron in tua tungah a tuinam gimnamtui a hal ding hi; ama in tua khu zingmawng sielin meivahte a tan ciengin a hal ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aaron in nitahin meivahte a koi ciengin tuate hal ding a, tua khu na khang tawntung vua Topa mai-a na hal zing ding uh gimnamtui biehna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua tungah a sieng lo gimnamtui hitale, meihal biehna hitale, an tawh biehna hitale na pie sih ding hi; tua tungah dawn thei biehna na sung sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuami maitam’ kite tungah Aaron in kum khatin khatvei ta thoidamna ngaina kip khat a bawl ding hi. Ama in na khang tungtawnun tuate adingin mawna zieha biehna si tawh kum khatin khatvei thoidamna bawl ding hi. Tua khu Topa tunga a siengtho pen ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses tam bangin a hopi hi:","title":"Mun Siengtho Ading Shekel Lang"},"12":{"text":"Israel-te mi phaza simin sazien na lah ciengin amate a kisim ziehin a tung vuah gimna a tun lo nadingin, min simna laibu a kibawl ciengin a luong man dingun Topa tungah a unpi-un kitatna pie ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Min simna-ah a mintuong tapo in a pieh ding tami ahi hi: biehinn shekel dung zui-in shekel lang (shekel khatah gerah sawmni om hi), Topa tungah biehna-in pie ding hi.","ref":"Pei 28:25-26; Mat 17:24"},"14":{"text":"Min simna sunga kihal kum sawmni panin a tungsie poma in Topa tungah biehna pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na nuntah nading vua thoidamna bawl nadingin Topa tungah biehna na pieh ciengun, mihaute in shekel lang sangin a tamzaw a pie sih ding vua, mizawngte in a tawmzaw a pie tuon sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Israel-te kung panin thoidamna sum na la ding a, tua pen kikhopna puonbuh nasep nadingin na koi ding hi; tuami sum pen na nuntah nading vua kipie Israel-te’ kitatna sum ahi a, Israel-te adingin Topa mai-a phawsahna hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses tam bangin hopi hi:","title":"Kisilna Sumngo Kuong"},"18":{"text":"Kisil nadingin sumngo kuong khat le a tunna sumngo khat ma na bawl ding hi. Tua khu kikhopna puonbuh le maitam kikalah na koi ding a, tuale a sungah tui na sung ding hi;","ref":"Pei 38:8"},"19":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in tua tui tawh a khut ule a keng uh a sil ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuhah a pei cieng uh ahi a, Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biehna lui dinga maitam nai-ah a pei cieng uh ahi zongin, a si lo nadingun tui tawh kisilsieng ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"A si lo nadingun amate in a khut ule a keng uh a sil ding uhi: Tua pen amate, Aaron, le a suon a hlahte dingin a khang tawntung vua a zui ding uh ngaina kip khat hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses tam bangin hopi hi:","title":"Nu Sathau le Gimnamtui (Pei 37:29)"},"23":{"text":"A hoipen a namtuite tam bangin la in: Myrrh gimnamtui shekel zanga le a namtui singgui thah tua za’ alang, shekel zani le sawmnga a gih, le a hlum a tuinam gimnamtui zani le sawmnga,"},"24":{"text":"biehinn shekel tawh kite, singgui thah nam khat zanga, le olive thau bung khat;"},"25":{"text":"le gimnamtui bawlte bawl ma bangin nu sathau siengtho dingin tamte na gawm ding hi; tua khu nu sathau siengtho hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Nangma in tua tawh kikhopna puonbuh le thuciemna singkuong,"},"27":{"text":"sabuoi le a vanzah zosie, meivah khuom le a vanzahte, le gimnamtui halna maitam,"},"28":{"text":"le meihalna maitam le vanzah zosie tawh, kuong le a tunna tawh na nu ding hi;"},"29":{"text":"tuate a siengtho pen ahi thei nadingin na siensuo ding a, tuate a tham kha poma siengtho ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in ka siempu nasep a sep thei nadingun Aaron le a tapate sathau nu-in na siensuo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Israel-te kungah, “Tami khu na khang tawntung vua a siengtho keima’ nu sathau hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Mi maimaite’ pum tungah tua sathau kizang lo ding a, tua banga kigawm sathau dang na bawl sih ding uhi; tua khu a siengtho hi a, note dinga a siengtho ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua tawh a kibangin a hal mi poma ahi a, a kilawm lo mi khatpo tungah a nupieh mi poma ahi zongin a mite lah panin kihemkhieding hi, Topa in ci hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi: A namtui nate, stacte, onycha, galbanum, gimnamtui tahtah tawh a namtui nate (a phaza kikim ciet) la inlen,"},"35":{"text":"gimnamtui bawlte’ bawl bangin ci saw inlen a nieh baang lo biehna gimnamtui bawl in;"},"36":{"text":"tuate kimkhat na gawtvui ding a, keima in kang kimupina ding mun kikhopna puonbuh sunga thuciemna’ mai-ah pawlkhat na koi ding hi; tua khu nang dinga a siengtho pen ahi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tam banga a kihalna dan tawh kizui-in gimnamtui na bawl ciengun note dingin na bawl sih ding uhi; tua khu Topa adingin a siengtho-in na ngaisun ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua tawh kibanga gimnamtui a bawl poma a mipite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi.","ref":"Pei 37:29"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses a hopi hi:","title":"Bezalel le Oholiab (Pei 35:30–36:1)"},"2":{"text":"En in, keima in Judah minam Hur’ tapa ahi Uri’ tapa Bezalel khu a minin ka hlan zo ta hi:"},"3":{"text":"Pasien’ hlagau tawh ama ka kidimsah zo a, lim hoite a gel ding, kham, ngun, le sumngo tawh na a bawl ding, bul ding suong a kheng ding, singzep nasep a sem ding, le khutsiem nasep zosie a sem thei dingin siemna, pilna, le khutsiem nasep zosie sep theina ka pie zo ta hi.","merge":"4"},"6":{"text":"Tua beh hi tham loin, Dan minam Ahisamach’ tapa Oholiab tawh ama ka seton ahi ta hi; keima in nang kang thupieh zosie amate in a bawl thei nadingun khutsiem mi zosie tungah zong siemna ka pie zo hi:"},"7":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh, thuciemna singkuong, a tunga om hepina topha, le puonbuh sunga na zosie,"},"8":{"text":"sabuoi le a vanzahte, a siengtho meivah tunna le a vanzah zosie, gimnamtui maitam,"},"9":{"text":"meihal biehna maitam le a vanzah zosie, kuong le a tunna,"},"10":{"text":"hoitaha kigan puonte, Aaron le a tapate in siempu na a sep cieng vua a sil ding uh puon siengthote,"},"11":{"text":"siengtho muna zah ding ahi nu sathau le a tuinam gimnamtuite bawl ding uhi. Keima in na kunga kang thupieh bang lienin amate in a bawl ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Sabbath Thukham"},"13":{"text":"Israel-te kungah nangma ma in na gen ding hi: “Ka sabbath-te na tang ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tam pen note ang siengthosah Topa ka hi lam na thei nadingun keima le no kikalah na khang tawntung vua lim khat hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Sabbath na tang ding uhi, azieh pen note dingin tua ni khu a siengtho ahi a, tuami ni a buasah poma kithat ding hi; tuami ni-a na sem poma a mite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Niguh sungin nasep kiman ding hi. Hizongle a ni sagi ni pen a thupi tawlngahna sabbath ni khat hi a, Topa adingin a siengtho ahi hi; sabbath ni-in na khat a sem poma kithat ding hi.","ref":"Pei 20:8-11; 23:12; 34:21; 35:2; Siem 23:3; Thkna 5:12-14"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel-te in sabbath a kemcing ding vua, amate in a khang tawntung vua tawntung thuciemna-in tua sabbath a tang ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tami pen keima le Israel-te kikalah lim khat hi zing ding hi. Ni guh sungin Topa in van le lei siem a, a ni sagi ni-in toi omin a tha dimkia hi, ci in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:11"},"18":{"text":"Pasien in Sinai Muol tungah Moses a hopi zaw ciengin Pasien’ khutme tawh kigiel thuciemna suongpeh ni ama a pie hi.","title":"Thuciemna Suongpeh Ni"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Muol tung panin Moses a kumsuh ha lam mite in a thei ciengun Aaron kimvelah kikhawmin ama kungah, “Hing pei inlen, kote dingin ka mai vua pei ding pasien-te ei bawlpieh in; Egypt gam pan ei peipito pa Moses lah bang suoh ta ahei ka thei sih uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Kham Bawngno (Thkna 9:6-29)","ref":"Sawl 7:40"},"2":{"text":"Aaron in amate kungah, “Na zite, na tapate ule na tanute uh’ bil tunga a ba uh kham bilbate sutdawh unlen ka kungah tuate hing peipi un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi zosie in a bil vua a ba uh kham bilbate a sutdawh vua, Aaron kungah tuate a peipi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in amate kung panin kham la-in sumtui sunna sungah a sung a, bawngno lim khat a bawlpieh hi; tuale amate in, “Israel aw, tamte khu Egypt leitang pana ang peipito na pasien-te uh ahi hi!” a ci uhi.","ref":"1Kum 12:28; Sawl 7:41"},"5":{"text":"Aaron in tua a mu bepin a mai-ah maitam khat a lam hi; tuale Aaron in tangtawh a, “Zing cieng pen Topa ading pawi bawl ni hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingmawngin amate tho bai-in meihal biehnate a lui vua, thunuom biehnate a peipi uhi; tuale anne tuidawn dingin mite a to vua, zu khamin numei le pasal guolnuomin a thangtat uhi.","ref":"1Cor 10:7"},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Thakhatin kumsuh in! Egypt leitang pana na peitopi na mite a lelamin a gamta sieng ta uhi;"},"8":{"text":"ka thupieh lampi panin amate a piel zuai ta uhi; amate dingin a kituisun bawngno lim khat bawlin tua tungah biehpiehna lui-in a bie vua, tuale ‘Israel aw, tamte khu Egypt leitang pana ang peipito na pasien-te uh ahi hi!’ ci uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Keima in tam mite bang zatahin ngawngkhauh ahi uh ahei ci ka mu zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in amate tungah ka sinso-in ka manthaisah nadingin kei guohin ei omsah un. Nang na hi leh minam lien khatin kang bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Topa a Pasien kungah thum vangut a, “ Topa aw, nangma in na vanglietna le na banhat tawh Egypt leitang pana na peipi na mite tungah bang dingin sinso ding na hei?"},"12":{"text":"Bang dingin Egypt-te in, ‘Muol tunga a tha ding le lei maitang pana a suhmaimang dinga ngaisutna gilo tawh amate a peipi hi bo,’ ci ding uh ahei? A zauhuoi na lungthahna panin kihei in; na lungsim khelin na mite tungah gimna tungsah vawt sin."},"13":{"text":"Amate tungah nangma ma na kiciem a, ‘Na suon na hlahte van tunga aasi za-in tamsahin, ka ciemsa tam leitang zosie na suon na lahte tungah a unpi-in ka pie ding a, amate in tua leitang a luo zing ding uhi,’ ci-a na genna na nasemte Abraham, Isaac, le Israel hing phawh bo in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 17:8; 22:16-17"},"14":{"text":"Tuale Topa a lungsim kikhelin a mite tunga a tunsah sawm sietna a tungsah nawn sih hi.","ref":"Gam 14:13-19"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses kihei-in a khut sunga om thuciemna suongpeh ni, a pang langni tuoh, a nua le ama-a kigiel suongpehte tawi-in muol tung panin a kumsuh hi."},"16":{"text":"Suongpehte ahile Pasien’ bawl ahi a, suongpehte tunga kikhuoh laigielte zong khu Pasien’ laigiel ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Joshua in mite kiko gamlumna a zah ciengin Moses kungah, “Giephuol ah gal kidona aw ging hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanle ama in, “Tua khu a zote’ awging hi lo a, a lelte’ awging zong hi lo hi; kei zah pen mi guolnuomte’ kikona awging ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Giephuol nai a tun lien tahin ama in bawngno le lamvuikai mipite mu a, Moses a lungthah sengin a khut sung panin suongpehte a paimang a, muol bulah a tawkeh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in a bawlsa uh bawngno la-in mei tawh hal a, gawtvui-in tui tungah thezah a, Israel-te in tua tui a dawnsah hi."},"21":{"text":"Moses in Aaron kungah, “A tung vua mawna lienpi na tunsah nadingin tam mite in na tungah bang ang bawl uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale Aaron in, “Ka Topa aw, kilungsosah seng sin; sietna bawl ding mite a uh lam na theisa ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in keima kungah, ‘Ka masang vua a pei ding pasien-te ei bawlpieh in; Egypt gam pana ei peipito tami Moses lah bang suoh ta ahei ka thei zo ta sih uhi,’ ei ci uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in amate kungah, ‘Kham nei popo in hing sutdawh ta un!’ ka ci hi; tuaci’n amate in keima kungah tuate ei pie vua, mei sungah ka sep leh tami bawngno lim ang suoh hi bo!” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Moses in mipite’ phengtatnate a mu bepin (azieh pen Aaron in a galte uh’ simmaw nuisat dingin amate a na phengtatsah hi),"},"26":{"text":"giephuol tunkotah Moses ding a, “ Topa lamah koi teng na pang vuoi? Keima kungah hing pei un!” a ci leh ama kimvelah Levi’ tapate a unpi-un a kikhawm pai uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuale ama in a kung vuah, “ Topa , Israel-te’ Pasien in, ‘No a koimapo in na pang vuah namsau kikuo ciet un! Giephuol cin tengah tunkot khat pan tunkot khatah kile kawikawi unlen, a koimapo in na sanggampa, na guolpa, le na vengpa that ciet un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Moses’ thupieh bangin Levi mite a gamta vua, khum ni-in mihing tul thum bang a si hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Tuni-in na tung vuah thupha ang tunsah thei nadingin note khat ciet in na tapa uh ahi a, na tanu uh ahi zongin na suplaw vua, Topa na sem dingin noma le noma na ki-ap uhi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"A zing ni-in Moses in mite kung ah, “Mawna lienpi khat na bawl zo uhi. Hinanle Topa kungah tu-in ka peito ding a, na mawna ziehun thoidamna ka bawl kha thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa kungah Moses kilekia a, “Ala, tam mite in mawna lienpi khat bawl zo uhi; amate adingin kham pasien-te bawl tawm uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in a mawna uh maisah in, na maisah zawh sih ding leh nangma’ gielsa laibupi panin ka min ei phiet dawh ta’n,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 69:28; Kln 3:5"},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Moses kungah, “Ka tunga ang maw poma ka laibu panin ka phiet ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in pei inlen na kunga kang gensa munah mite peipi in; en in, na mai-ah ka vantungmi ang pei ding hi. Hizongle daantat ni ding ang tun ciengin a mawna ziehun amate ka daantat ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron’ na bawlsa bawngno tungah amau’ gamtatnasate ziehin mite tungah Topa in pul natna a tungsah hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Nangma le Egypt gam pana na peitopi mite tawh pei-in tami mun nuasie unlen, Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tungah, ‘Na suonlehlahte tungah ka pie ding hi,’ ci-a ka khapsa gamah pei un.","title":"Sinai Nuasie Ding Thupiehna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in na masang vuah vantungmi khat ka sawl ding a, Canaan-te, Amor-te, Hit-te, ka notmang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna leitangah peito un; ahi vangin lamkalah hing thatgam kha ding ka hi ziehin na kung vuah kang peito sih ding hi. Azieh pen note mi ngawngkhauh na hi uhi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Mite in tam bang kamkhauhte a zah ciengun kapin a mau vua, koima in kizepna puonte a sil sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in, “Israel-te kungah, ‘Nohaw mi ngawngkhauhte na hi uhi; na lah vuah bano khat sung hing pei leng note kang thatgam ta ding uhi. Tuaci’n na kizepnate uh suodawh unlen, note bang hing law ding ka hei ci ka khensat ding hi,’ ci-in,” ci-a Moses kunga a gensa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ziehin Israel-te in Horeb Muol panin a kizepnate uh a suo sieng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Moses in puonbuh la-in giephuol pulam a gamla munah a lam thei zel hi; ama in tua pen kikhopna puonbuh, ci hi. Topa a sui tapo in giephuol pulama om kikhopna puonbuh lamah a pei uhi.","title":"Giephuol Pulam Puonbuh"},"8":{"text":"Puonbuh sungah Moses a pei sielin mi zosie a ding to vua, a milipin a puonbuh kotbieng ciet vuah dingin puonbuh sung a tum dongin Moses a kaihlit uhi."},"9":{"text":"Puonbuh sungah Moses a lut ciengin meii khuompi tuol suhin puonbuh kotbiengah ding a, Topa tawh Moses a kiho hi."},"10":{"text":"Puonbuh kotbiengah meii khuom a din lam a mu bepun a puonbuh kotbieng vuah mite dingto-in a unpi-un a kun uhi."},"11":{"text":"Lawmta kiho bangin maitang kituo-in Topa in Moses a hopi zel hi. Tua ciengin giephuol lamah ama a kilekia hi; ahi vangin Nun’ tapa, a nasem tangval Joshua in puonbuh a nuasie sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Topa kungah, “En in, nangma in ka kungah, ‘Tam mite zawpito in,’ nei ci hi; ahi vangin kei tawh koi zawhton ding ahei, ci nei theisah sih hi. Hinanle nang in, ‘Na minin nang kang thei a, ka mai-ah maipha zong na mu zo hi,’ nei ci zo hi.","title":"Moses’ Thumpiehna"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in na muna-ah maipha nga zo ka hi leh, nangma kang thei nading le na muna-ah maipha ka nga thei nadingin na lampite ei lah in. Tam minam khu na mite a hina zong ngaisun bo in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “Nangma tawh ka ompina zawhton ding a, toidamna kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale ama in a kungah, “Na ompina in ei zawpi sih ding leh tam panin kote ei puoh da mai in."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen nang in nei zawpi sih mawh leh, keima le ka mite in nangma’ muna-ah maipha ka nga lam uh bangci kithei ding ahei? Tua bang danin leisiet maitanga mi zosie sung panin keima le na mite a tuom vilvel ka hi ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Nang ngetsa ngeingei ma kang bawlpieh ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile ka muna-ah maipha na nga zo ta a, na min tawh nang kang thei hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in, “Kang thum hi, na vanglietna ei lah in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Na mai-ah ka hoina zosie ka peisah ding a, na mai-ah keima’ min,’ Topa ’ ci-in ka phuongzah ding hi; tuale ka lungsiet nop mite ka lungsiet ding a, ka hepi nop mite ka hepi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “Nangma in ka mai na mu thei sih ding hi; azieh pen kei ei mute koima a hing om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in a ban zom a, “En in, ka kunga na din nading suong tungah mun khat om hi;"},"22":{"text":"keima’ minthanna vang in ang nawh laitahin suongpi pawhkeh kikalah nang kang koi ding a, kang kalsan masangsie ka khutin nang kang lie ding hi;"},"23":{"text":"tua ciengin ka khut ka ladawh ding a, ka tawkhi na mu ding hi; ahi vangin ka mai kimu lo ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “A masa tawh a kibangin suongpeh ni sui inlen, na tawhkehsa amasa suongpehte tunga kigiel thute ma tua suongpehte tungah ka giel ding hi.","title":"Moses in Suongpeh A Tha Bawl (Thkna 10:1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Zingmawngin kithawi-in Sinai Muol tungah peito inlen, muol dawn khum mun keima kungah nang mama hing kilah in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma tawh koima hing katosah sin len, muol tung zosie tengah koima hing omsah sin; tua muol mai-ah tuuhon hitale, bawnghon hitale gamtasah sin,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in a masa bangin suongpeh ni a sui hi; tuale zingmawngin ama thobai a, Topa thupiehsa bangin a khut sungah suongpeh ni tawi-in Sinai Muol tungah a kato hi."},"5":{"text":"Meii lahah Topa kumsuh a, ama tawh khum munah dingtonin a min, “ Topa ,” ci-in a pulah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama mai-ah Topa pei a, “ Topa , Topa , hepi siem le khuotuo siem Pasien, lungthah bailo-in itna kip le muonhuoina tawh a kidim,"},"7":{"text":"a khang tul khatna dongin itna kip nei-in, khielna, thupalsatna le mawna a ngaidam, hinanle mawna mawh maisah loin, pate’ khielna tate tung le tute tungah, khang thum khang li donga a thuh pa,” ci-in a pulah hi.","ref":"Pei 20:5-6; Gam 14:18; Thkna 5:9-10; 7:9-10"},"8":{"text":"Tuale Moses in leilam nga-in a lu naw kunsuhin a bie hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Tu-in nangma muna-ah maipha ka nga leh Topa aw, kang thum hi, kote tawh Topa hing pei in. Tam mite ngawngkhauh minam ahi zongun ka khielna ule ka mawna uh ei ngaidam inlen, na gouluo dingin kote ei la in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in tam bangci hi: Keima in thuciemna khat ka bawl hi. Nangma’ mite zosie mai-ah leitung muncin tenga a om minam khatpo tunga a kibawl ngai nai vawt lo na lamdangte ka bawl ding hi; amate lahah na tenna uh mi zosie in Topa’ nasepna a mu ding uhi; azieh pen note tunga ka sil bawl ding pen a zauhuoi mama ahi hi.","title":"Thuciemna Kibawlthakia (Pei 23:14-19 ; Thkna 7:1-6 ; 16:1-17)"},"11":{"text":"Tuni-a kang thupieh khu zui in. En in, na mai-ah Amor-te, Canaan-te, Hit-te, Perez-te, Hiv-te, le Jebus-te ka notmang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na peina ding gama a teng mite tawh thuciemna na bawl khah lo nadingin kidawm in. Na bawl khah leh note dingin awna thang a suoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A maitamte uh na phel ding vua, a biehna songte uh kuoitawngin a siengtho a khuomte uh zong na satpua ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 16:21"},"14":{"text":"(Pasien dang na bie sih ding hi. Azieh pen ama’ min Thangsie ahi Topa khu a thangsie Pasien ahi hi)."},"15":{"text":"Tua gama teng mite tawh thuciemna na bawl sih ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile amate in a pasien-te utawh pahtatna bawlin a pasien-te uh kungah a kithoi ciengun amate lahah mi pawlkhat in ang hlan ding vua, a siemsa uh na ne kha ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na tapate uh’ zi dingin a tanute uh la-in, tuale a pasien-te utawh pahtatna a bawl a tanute un na tapate uh pen a pasien-te utawh ang pahtatsah kha ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"A kisung pasien-te na bawl sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:4; Siem 19:4; Thkna 5:8; 27:15"},"18":{"text":"Tolsaw lo anlum pawi na bawl ding uhi. Abib hla, a kisesa hun sung tengin kang thupieh bangin ni sagi sung tol saw lo anlum na ne ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile note Abib hla sungin Egpyt panin na peikhie uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:14-20; Siem 23:6-8; Gam 28:16-25"},"19":{"text":"Naubu a hong masa pen na ganhingte uh, bawng le tuu tacil apa zosie keima-a’ ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 13:2"},"20":{"text":"Laa a tacil tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding vua, na tat sih uleh a ngawng na hiatawng ding uhi. Na tacilte zosie uh na tanh ding uhi. Khut guoh tawh koima ka mai-ah hing kila lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 13:13"},"21":{"text":"Ni guh sung na na sem ding vua, ahi vangin a ni sagi ni-in na tawlnga ding uhi; lohlaw hun le anlah hun sung na ngawnin na tawlnga ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:9-10; 23:12; 31:15; 35:2; Siem 23:3; Thkna 5:13-14"},"22":{"text":"Nipikalte’ pawi, mangbu a tung masa pawi, le kumbei an kaikhop pawi na bawl ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 23:15-21, 39-43; Gam 28:26-31"},"23":{"text":"Na pasalte a unpi-un Israel Pasien ahi Topa Pasien mai-ah kum khatin thumvei kilaa ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na masang vuah minam dangte ka notmang ding a, na gamgi uh ka golkeh ding hi; Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah kum khatin thumvei a kilaa dingin na peito sungun koima in na leitang uh ang deigaw sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tol tawh ka biehpiehna sisan na pieton sih ding vua, zingmawng dongin peisan pawi biehpiehna kikoi lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 12:10"},"26":{"text":"Na leitang vua a pieng a gamasate lahah a tuituoh pen Topa na Pasien uh’ inn ah na peipi ding uhi. Api’ nawizu tawh keelno na huontha sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 26:2; Thkna 14:21"},"27":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi: “Tam thute giel in; tam thute tawh kituohin nangma le Israel tawh thuciemna khat ka bawl zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Khum munah ni sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa tawh Moses omton hi; ama an ne lo tuidawn loin a om hi. Tuale ama in suongpehte tungah thuciemna kammalte ahi thupieh sawmte a giel hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in a khut sungah thuciemna suongpeh ni tawi-in Sinai Muol tung pan a kumsuh ciengin, Pasien tawh ama a va kiho zo ziehin a maivun a tan lamtah Moses in a thei sih hi.","title":"A Vangtang Moses’ Maitang"},"30":{"text":"Aaron le Israel mi zosie in Moses a mu ciengun a maivun taang a, ama kungah a pei ngam sih uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in amate hlan hi; tuale Aaron le mihon makaite zosie zong ama kungah a peikia vua, Moses in amate a hopi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin a nai-ah Israel-te zosie a pei vua, ama in Topa in Sinai Muol tunga ama kunga a gen zosie thupiehna-in amate tungah a pie hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses in amate a hopi zaw ciengin maikhuna khat tawh a maitang a khu hi;"},"34":{"text":"ahi vangin Topa tawh holim dingin ama mai-ah Moses a tum sielin a pusuokia masangsie a maikhuna a ladawh hi; ama pusuohin Israel-te kungah ama tunga kipie thute a gen ciengin,"},"35":{"text":"Israel-te in Moses’ maivun taang mu uhi; tuale ama tawh kiho dinga a pei masangsie-in Moses in maikhuna tawh a mai a khukia hi.","ref":"2Cor 3:7-16"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Israel mihon zosie a khawm a, amate kungah thu a gen hi: Tam teng khu Topa in na bawl ding vua ang thupieh ahi hi:","title":"Sabbath Ngainate"},"2":{"text":"Ni guh sungin nasep kiman ding a, hinanle a ni sagi ni-in Topa tungah a thupi tawlngahna sabbath siengtho na nei ding uhi. Khum ni-in na khat a sem poma kithat ding hi.","ref":"Pei 20:8-11; 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; Siem 23:3; Thkna 5:12-14"},"3":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in na tenna uh mun zosie-ah mei na taw sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Israel mihon zosie tungah thu gen hi: Tami khu Topa ang thupieh ahi hi.","title":"Biehbuh Bawl Nading Kiginkholna (Pei 25:1-9 ; 39:32-43)"},"5":{"text":"Note lah panin Topa tunga pieh ding biehna pie un; kiphalna lungtang a nei poma in Topa’ biehnate hing tawi uheh. Tuate pen: kham, ngun le sumngo,"},"6":{"text":"a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le hoitaha kigan puon; keelmul,"},"7":{"text":"a san-a kibum tuutang vunte le savun hoite ; gising,"},"8":{"text":"meivah ading sathau, nu sathau le a tuinam dingin gimnamtuite,"},"9":{"text":"siempu puon le a awmdala bul dingin onyx suong le suong dangte ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Note lahah siemna nei zosie hing pei-in a bawl ding uh Topa’ thupieh zosie pen: biehbuh,"},"11":{"text":"a puonbuh le a tung khuna, a vankhainate le a khuompehte, a zawlte, a khuomte, le a tunnate;"},"12":{"text":"singkuong a zawlte tawh, hepina topha, le kotkhah puonkhai;"},"13":{"text":"sabuoi a zawlte le a vanzah zosie tawh, le Ompina Anlum;"},"14":{"text":"mei tan nading meivah tunna zong, a vanzahte le a meivahte tawh, le meivah ding sathau;"},"15":{"text":"le panamtui maitam a zawlte tawh, nu sathau le a tuinam gimnamtuite le biehbuh kotbienga zah ding puonkhai;"},"16":{"text":"meihal biehna maitam, sumngo sialen, a zawlte, a vanzahte zosie, kuong le a ngahna tawh;"},"17":{"text":"buhtuol-a puonkhaite, a khuomte le a tunnate tawh, le buhtuol tunkot ading puonkhai;"},"18":{"text":"biehbuh khetphimte, huong khetphimte, le a khauhuolte;"},"19":{"text":"mun siengtho sunga na sep cienga zah ding hoitaha kigan puonte, siempu Aaron le a tapate in siempu a sep cieng vua a sil ding uh puon siengthote ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses opna panin Israel mihon zosie a peikhie uhi.","title":"Biehbuh Ading Biehnate"},"21":{"text":"Tuale a lungtang a sukha le piehnopna lungsim a nei poma a pei vua, kikhopna puonbuh le a nasep nading zosie, le puon siengthote-a zah dingin, Topa’ biehna a tawi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n piehnopna lungtang a nei zosie, numei pasal pei-in samkilte, bilbate, min gielna khutsipte, le khibate le kham vanzah kisiemna cinteng a peipi vua, a milipin Topa kungah kham biehna a puoh uhi."},"23":{"text":"A dum, a dupsan, a ausan vauzamte, puon hoi, keelmul, a san-a kibum tuutang vunte, ahi sihle savun hoite ahi zongin a nei mi poma in tuate a tawi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin, a pie zo tapo in Topa’ biehna-in tuate a peipi uhi; nasepna kimang thei ding gising nei zosie in zong a peipi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Numei khutsiem zosie in a khut utawh pat a heh vua, amate hehsa a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vauzamte le hoitaha kigan puonte a peipi uhi;"},"26":{"text":"a khutsiemnate uh zah nopna lungtang a nei numei zosie in keelmul a gan uhi."},"27":{"text":"Makaite in siempu puon le awmdala bul dingin onyx suong le suong dangte a peipi vua,"},"28":{"text":"gimnamtui le meivaha thal ding sathau, nu sathau, le gimnamtuite a peipi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungtawnin sep dinga a thupiehsa nasep nadingin pieh nopna lungtang a nei Israel numei pasal zosie in Topa tungah nop thu-a biehna-in tuate a peipi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Israel-te kungah thu gen hi: En un, Topa in Judah minam, Hur’ tapa, Uri’ tapa Bezalel a minin hlan zo hi;","title":"Bezalel le Oholiab (Pei 31:1-11)"},"31":{"text":"Topa in Pasien’ hlagau tawh ama kidimsah zo a, lim hoite a gel ding, kham, ngun, le sumngo tawh na a bawl ding, bul ding suong a seh ding, singzep nasep a sem ding, le khutsiem nasep zosie a sem thei dingin siemna, pilna, le khutsiemna zosie sep theina a pie zo hi.","merge":"32"},"34":{"text":"Topa in ama le Dan minam Ahisamach’ tapa Oholiab tungah midangte hilsawn theina a pie zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in khutsiem nasep, gelsiem nasep, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le hoitaha kigan puon, ahi sihle puonzep siem nasep; siemgat siemna, le gelsiemna nasep ahi zongin nasep namkim a sem dingin a tung vuah siemna a guon hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel le Oholiab le mun siengtho nasep khat popo a sem thei dinga Topa in siemna le theitelna a guot mi poma in Topa’ thupiehsa zosie tawh a kituohin sem ding uhi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Bezalel le Oholiab le Topa in nasep siemna a guot mi, na sep nopna lungtang a nei mi vannuoi hlan hi;"},"3":{"text":"amate in Moses tung panin mun siengtho nasep nadinga Israel-te in nop thu-a a pieh uh biehnate a sang uhi. Zingmawng sielin ama kungah nop thu-a kipie biehnate a puoh den lai vua,"},"4":{"text":"tuaci’n a nasepna ciet panun mun siengtho nasep namkim a sem thei khutsiem zosie pei-in,"},"5":{"text":"Moses kungah, “ Topa in i sep ding vua ei sawl na i sep nadingin mipite in a kisam za sanga a tamzaw ei puoh uhi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in thupie-in giephuol mun zosie ah, “Pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin, mun siengtho adingin piehkhietna adang hing pieh da ta un,” ci-in tang kitawhsah hi. Tuaci’n a pieh ding uh mipite kihlo hi;"},"7":{"text":"azieh pen nasep nadingin a pieh uh nate valkhe ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Nasem mite lah panin siemna a nei mi zosie in puondal sawm tawh biehbuh bawl uhi; tuate pen a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puon le a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh kibawl a, khutsiem taha kibawl cherub-te tawh a zem uhi.","title":"Biehbuh Lamna (Pei 26:1-37)"},"9":{"text":"Dalna puonte tong sawmni le tong giet ciet sau a, tong li ciet gol hi; dalna puon zosie a golna kikim ciet hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in dalna puon ngate khatlekhat khuituo a, adang dalna puon ngate zong khatlekhat ma a khuituo hi."},"11":{"text":"A kikhuituo a masa dalna puon geita pen’ among gei guolah vaudum mel bilvangte bawl hi; tua ma bangin ama in a kikhuituo a nina dalna puon a geita pen’ among gei guolah zong tuate ma a bawl hi;"},"12":{"text":"ama in dalna puon khat tungah bilvang sawmnga bawl hi; a kikhuituo a nina dalna puon mongah zong bilvang sawmnga ma bawlin a bilvangte khatlekhat kimaingat hi."},"13":{"text":"Kham kuol sawmnga bawlin, ama in a kuolte tawh dalna puonte khatlekhat kimatsah hi; tuaci’n biehbuh buppi khat a suoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in biehbuh tung puonbuh khu nadingin keelmul tawh kibawl dalna puonte zong bawl hi; ama in dalna puon sawm le khat bawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Khumi dalna puonte pen adung tong sawm thum ciet, avai tong li ciet pha hi; tua dalna puon sawm le khatte’ gol dan kikim ciet hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in dalna puon ngate khatlekhat khuituo-in adang guhte zong khatlekhat ma a khuituo hi."},"17":{"text":"A kikhuituo a masa dalna puon geita pen’ among gei guolah a bilvang sawmnga bawl a, ama in a kizoppi ding dalna puon gei-ah a bilvang sawmnga ma a bawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Puonbuh buppi khat a suo thei nadingin ama in tua puonbuh a kimatsah dingin sumngo kilna sawmnga a bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Puonbuh adingin ama in a sana kibum tuutang vun le savun hoi tawh a pulam khuna khat a bawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehbuh adingin ama in a kitungto ding gising khuompehte a bawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Khuompeh khat adung tong sawm, avai tong khat le khap ciet ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A bul nadingin khuompeh khat in a zang ni ta nei hi; ama in biehbuh khuompeh zosie adingin tami a bawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Biehbuh’ khuompehte ama in tam bangin a bawl hi: Leitaw lampang adingin khuompeh sawmni;"},"24":{"text":"le khuompeh sawmnite zungah a tunna sawm li ngun tawh, a zang nite adingin khuompeh a masa zungah a tunna ni, khuompeh adang khat’ zungah adang nite adingin a tunna ni ma a bawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in biehbuh a pang nina lam, leilu lampanga khuompeh sawmnite le"},"26":{"text":"ngun tawh a kibawl a tunna sawmli adingin khuompeh khatah a tunna ni, adang khuompeh khat zungah a tunna ni ma a bawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Nitumna lam, biehbuh nualam adingin ama in khuompeh guh a bawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Biehbuh nualam a ningte adingin ama in khuompeh ni zong a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuate a nei lamah kikah a, ahi vangin a kuol masa-ah a dawn kimat hi; ama in a ning nite adingin tua bangin ni a bawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngun tawh kibawl a tunnate tawh khuompeh giet a om hi: A tunna sawm le guh omin khuompeh khat zungah a tunna ni ta a om hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in gising zawlte, biehbuh pang khatah khuompehte adingin zawl nga,"},"32":{"text":"biehbuh a pang lang khatah khuompehte adingin zawl nga, nitumna lam biehbuh sialam pangah khuompehte adingin zawl nga ma a bawl hi."},"33":{"text":"A zawl a laita pen, khuompeh laikim dong a ban pen khu mong khat panin mong khat dong a pei suohsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in khuompehte kham tawh zutin zawlte a tu dingin kham tawh a kuolte bawl a, a zawlte kham tawh a zut hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in a engdum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan dalna puon khat bawl a, ama in a kihoi bawl cherub-te tawh gattha-in zem hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua puon adingin gising tawh a kibawl khuompi li bawl a, ama in tuate kham tawh a zut hi; a vankhainate uh kham ahi a, ama in tua khuomte adingin ngun tawh kibawl a tunna li a sung hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in puonbuh tunkot adingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vaute le hieu tawh kikhui-in a kizem, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puon tawh kotkhah puonkhai khat le;"},"38":{"text":"a khuompi ngate a vankhainate tawh a bawl hi. Ama in kham tawh tuate’ luzepna zutin a gaanate kham ahi a, ahi vangin a tunna ngate sumngo ahi hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel in gising tawh singkuong bawl hi; tua pen adung tong ni le khap, avai tong khat le khap, a sanna tong khat le khap ahi hi.","title":"Thuciemna Singkuong Bawlna (Pei 25:10-22)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kham citah tawh tua singkuong, a sung a puo zutin a kimvelah kham geihuol a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a ning lite adingin kham kuol li, a pang khatah kuol ni, a pang langkhat adingin kuol ni ma a bul hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in gising singzawlte zong sui a, kham tawh tuate a zut hi."},"5":{"text":"Singkuong puoh nadingin singkuong panga a kuolte sungah a zawlte siet hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in kham citah tawh hepina topha khat bawl hi; adung tong ni le khap, avai tong khat le khap ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in sehta tawh kikheng kham tawh Cherub ni bawl hi; hepina topha mong tuohah tuate gel a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Cherub khat mong khatah, Cherub khat a mong langkhatah om hi; a mong nite-ah hepina topha tawh sakhatin cherub-te a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Cherub-te in a hlate a tunglamah a zahto vua, a hlate utawh hepina topha liesuhin ama gel khatlekhat a kimaingat hi; cherub-te’ mai pen hepina topha lam kinga hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in gising tawh sabuoi zong bawl a, adung tong ni, avai tong khat, a sanna tong khat le khap ahi hi.","title":"Ompina Anlum Sabuoi Bawlna (Pei 25:23-30)"},"11":{"text":"Kham citah tawh tua sabuoi zut a, a kimvelah kham tawh a geihuol khat a bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in sabuoi kimvelah a vailam khutpeh cie a pha a zawlpeh khat bawl a, tua zawlpeh kimvelah kham geihuol khat a bawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua sabuoi adingin kham kuol li bawlin a ning li, a keng lite-ah a kuolte a gah hi."},"14":{"text":"Sabuoi zawn nading zawltangte a tu dingin a zawlpeh gei-ah a kuolte om hi."},"15":{"text":"Sabuoi zawn nadingin gising singzawlte bawl a, kham tawh tuate zut hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in gimnamtui adingin sabuoi tunga vanzah ding kuongdaite, pakante, le dawnthei biehna sun nading kuongkumte, le thawlte kham citah tawh a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in kham citah tawh meivah tunna khat zong a bawl hi. Meivah khuombul le a kungte sehta tawh kikheng ahi hi; a haite, a nunte le a papete tua meivah tunna tawh a kisamat ahi hi.","title":"Meivah Tunna Bawlna (Pei 25:31-40)"},"18":{"text":"Tuale a pangte panin ba guh mengsawn a, pang khatah meivah tunna ba thum mengin, a pang lang khatah meivah tunna ba thum ma a meng hi;"},"19":{"text":"ba khat ciet tungah a nun le a pape a om, almond ga tawh a kibang hai thum, le adang ba khat ciet tungah a nun le a pape a om, almond ga tawh a kibang hai thum ma kibawl hi. Tuaci’n ba guhte meivah tunna panin a mengsawn hi."},"20":{"text":"A meivah tunna tung mama-ah a nunte le a papete tawh a om, almond ga tawh a kibang hai li om a,"},"21":{"text":"meivah tunna panin ba guh a kopte’ bulah tua tawh sa khat ahi a nun khat om hi."},"22":{"text":"A nunte le a bate kisamat a, a unpi-in sehta tawh kikhengsa kham citah ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Meivah sagite le a taitete le a kuongte kham citah tawh kibawl ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in meivah tunna le vanzahte zosie kham citah talent khat tawh a bawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in gising tawh adung tong khat, avai tong khat a pha gimnamtui maitam bawl hi; tua maitam in a kikim ning li nei a, a sanna tong ni pha hi; a kite pen tua maitam tawh kisamat ahi hi.","title":"Gimnamtui Maitam Bawlna (Pei 30:1-5)"},"26":{"text":"Ama in a tungzang, a kimvelah a pangte le a kite kham citah tawh a zut hi; tuale a kimvelah kham geihuol khat"},"27":{"text":"le a zawn nading ciengzawlte a tu dingin a pang tuoh a geihuol nei-ah kham kuol ni a bawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in gising tawh ciengzawlte sui-a, kham tawh tuate a zut hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in gimnamtui bawlte’ bawl ma bangin nu sathau siengtho le a siengtho a namtui ahi gimnamtui zong a bawl hi.","title":"Nu Sathau le Gimnamtui Bawlna (Pei 30:22-38)","ref":"Pei 30:22-38"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in adung tong nga, avai tong nga a pha maitam khat gising tawh a bawl hi; tua pen a ning li kikim hi a, a sanna tong tong thum pha hi.","title":"Meihal Biehna Ding Maitam Bawlna (Pei 27:1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Tua maitam’ ning lite tungah a kite bawl hi; a kite maitam tawh kicimat a, sumngo tawh tuate zut hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in vut khol nading beelte, kawbiate, kuongte, siakate, le vutluona pehte bawl a, maitam vanzahte zosie sumngo tawh bawl hi;"},"4":{"text":"Maitam adingin a zawl nei-ah maitam kimcieng a bansuh, len banga kiphan, sumngo sia-len khat a bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a zawlte tu dingin sumngo sialen ninglite tungah a kuol li a sung hi;"},"6":{"text":"ama in maitam adingin gising zawlte bawlin tuate sumngo tawh a zut hi."},"7":{"text":"A puoh nadingin maitam pangte-a om a kuolte sungah a zawlte heng hi;
