ama in singpehte tawh maitam a lai hawmsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in kikhopna puonbuh tunkotah na sem numeite’ hlimlangte panin sumngo tawh kisilna kuong le a tunna a bawl hi.","ref":"Pei 30:18"},"9":{"text":"Ama in buhtuol a bawl a, leitaw lampang buhtuol puon kikhaite pen a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puon tawh kibawl a, tong zakhat a sau hi;","title":"Biehbuh Tuol Bawlna (Pei 27:9-19)"},"10":{"text":"a khuompi sawm ni le a tunna sawmni te pen sumngo tawh kibawl a, ahi vangin khuompi tunga vankhainate le a ganate pen ngun ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Leilu lampang a kikhaisuh dalna puon tong zakhat pha hi; a khuompi sawmni le a tunna sawmni te sumngo tawh kibawl ahi hi, ahi vangin khuompi tunga vankhainate le a ganate ngun ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna lampang a kikhaisuh dalna puon tong sawmnga hi a, khuompi sawm hi-in, a tunna sawm ma ahi hi; khuompi-a vankhainate le a ganate ngun ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A mailam, nisuona lam manaw zong tong sawmnga ma ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Kotpi pang khat a kikhaisuh dalna puon tong sawm le nga ahi a, khuompi thum le a tunna thumte tawh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A pang langkhat ading zong tu bang ma ahi hi; buhtuol lutna kotkhah a pang langkhat cietah a kikhaisuh dalna puon pen tong sawm le nga hi a, khuompi thum le a tunna thum tawh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Buhtuol kimvela puon kikhaisuhte zosie pen a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuompi adingin a tunna sumngo hi a, ahi vangin a vankhainate le a ganate ngun ahi hi. Khuom luzum tuomnate’ kizutna khu ngun ahi a, buhtuol khuompi zosie ngun gaana tawh kigah hi."},"18":{"text":"Buhtuol lutna puonkhai pen a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte ahi a, hieu tawh kikhui-in kizem hi. Buhtuol-a kikhaisuhte tawh kizui-in tong sawmni sau-in, a vailam tong nga sau hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuompi li le a tunna lite sumngo tawh kibawl a, a vankhainate ngun hi-in, khuom luzum tuomnate le a gaanate’ kizutna khu ngun ma ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Biehbuh le buhtuol kimvel adingin khetphim zosie sumngo tawh kibawl ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam teng pen siempu Aaron’ tapa Ithamar makaina nei-ah Levi-te’ sep ding biehbuh ahi thuciemna biehbuh ciemtena sazien ahi hi.","title":"Biehbuh Vanzahte"},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh zosie Judah minam Hur’ tapa, Uri’ tapa Bezalel in a sem hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama tawh a semton pen Dan minam, Ahisamach’ tapa Oholiab kici pa ahi a, ama pen suongkhuoh a siem, a etlawm sil suhtuo siem, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vaute le hoitaha kigan puon hoite a zep siem mi khat ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Nasep nadinga kizang kham zosie, biehbuh lamna-a kizang, le a kipie khamte, biehinn shekel-in talent sawmni le kuo le shekel za sagi sawmthum pha hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi simna sunga kihal mihonte kung panin a kinga ngunte, biehna shekel-in talent zakhat le shekel tulkhat za sagi sawm sagi le nga a hi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi khat in beka khat ta (biehinn shekel-in shekel lang) pie a, a pie mi, kum sawmni panin a tungsie mi simna-a kisim poma tul zaguh le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga pha hi.","ref":"Pei 30:11-16; Mat 17:24"},"27":{"text":"Ngun talent zakhat pen biehbuh khuom tunnate le dalna puon khuom tunnate dinga kisung ding ahi hi. A tunna zakhat ading talent zakhat ahi a, a tunna khat ciengin talent khat ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Shekel tulkhat zasagi sawmsagi le nga lah panin khuompite tungah vankhaina-in bawl a, a khuom luzum tuomnate zutin tuate adingin a gaana a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"A kipie sumngo pen talent sawmsagi le shekel tulni le zali ahi hi;"},"30":{"text":"tua tawh ama in kikhopna puonbuh lutna tunkotte adingin khuom tunnate, sumngo maitam, sumngo sialen le maitam vanzah zosie,"},"31":{"text":"buhtuol kimvela khuom tunnate, buhtuol lutna tunkot’ khuom tunna te, biehbuh’ khetphim zosie le buhtuol kimvela khetphim zosie a bawl hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siengtho muna nasep nadingin amate in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vauzamte tawh a kilimgat puon a bawl uhi; Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin Aaron adingin puonsil siengthote a gatpieh uhi.","title":"Siempute’ Puon Bawlna (Pei 28:1-43)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vaute le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh siempu puon a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"A dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul vauzamte le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte, siemnel taha a kizep nadingin, khampehte a pa dihdehin kisehin, a themthemin khauzamin ki-atsan hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in siempu puon dingin liengkaih puon bawlin among nite gelah a zom uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin a kiga nadingin a kilimgat tua tunga puon om pen kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumulte, vaute le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh kibawl hi; a vanzahte le a sep dan pen a kibang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel tapate phaza tawh kizui-in onyx suongte kitat a, tua suongte tunga khutsip tungah min a kikhetkuoh bangin minte kikhenkuoh a, tuaci’n kham tawh kibawl a zepna sungah kikoi hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin ama in Israel tapate phawna suong dingin siempu puon’ liengkaih puon tungah tua suong tegel bul hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in siempu puon bangin kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh siemnel tahin awmdal a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua awmdal in a kikim ning li nei a, tua awmdal pen thuop ni-in kibawlin adung khap khat, avai khap khat pha hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in tuami sungah suong guol li-in a cieng vua, a guol masa pen carnelian , chrysolite, le emerald suongte ahi hi;"},"11":{"text":"a guol nina pen turquoise, sapphire, le suongkang zolte ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"A guol thumna pen jacinth, agate, le amethyst suongte ahi hi;"},"13":{"text":"a guol lina pen beryl, onyx, le jasper suongte ahi hi. Kham tawh kibawl a zepna sungah tuate kikoi hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel tapate’ min tawh kituohin a minte uh a kigielna suong sawm le ni om hi; tuate pen khutsip tunga min gielna tawh a kibang a, minam sawm le nite adingin a min ciet uh kigiel hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in awmdal adingin khauhuol tawh a kibang a kihuol kham citah khainieng a bawl uhi;"},"16":{"text":"tuale awmdal adingin kham a zepna ni le kham kuol ni bawlin awmdal’ mongte ah tua kham kuol ni a koi uhi;"},"17":{"text":"tuale amate in awmdal’ mongte-a kikoi kham kuol nite sungah kham khauhuol ni tegel a khum uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in a zepna ni tegel tungah khauhuol mong nite a zom uhi; tua bangin siempu puonah liengkaih puon masang lamah a bul uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kham kuol ni a bawl vua, khum tegel pen siempu puon tawh a kizom a sunglam gei, awmdal mong ni gelah a vaw uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in kham kuol ni a bawl vua, siempu puon liengkaih ni tegel nei a mailam, a kihoi gat siempu puonkhau a kizopna tung sonah a vaw uhi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin, hoitaha kigan siempu puon khau tungah a beh den thei nading le siempu puon tung panin awmdal a hlagin lo nadingin siempu puon kuolte ah khauhuol dum khatin a gah uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in vaudum beh tawh a kigan siempu puontuolpi zong bawl hi;"},"23":{"text":"puon gawlan kihong bangin puontuolpi laikimah a vang om a, a kikee lo nadingin tua a vang kimkotah ki-aiha kai hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in a mongah a dum, a dupsan, a ausan vaukhaute le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh kizem mang kawlsing gate a bawl uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin kham citah sialawngte zong a bawl vua, puontuolpi mong kimvela mang kawlsing gate kikalah tua sialawngte a koi uhi;"},"26":{"text":"siempu nasep nadingin puontuolpi mong kimvelah sialawng khat le mang kawlsing ga khat, khat zaw khat kikahhal diemdiemin a ban banin kikhai hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin amate in Aaron le a tapate adingin khau hoi tawh kigan puontungsilte"},"28":{"text":"le khau hoi tawh kigan lukhute, hoitaha kigan puon hoite tawh kibawl bawngbi sungten hoite,"},"29":{"text":"le a kop-a kihiaton vau hoite tawh a kigan puonte tawh a kibawl kawnggah le hieu tawh kizem a dum, a dupsan, a ausan puonte zong a bawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in kumpi lukhu siengtho adingin kham siengtho a peh khat a bawl vua, khutsip tunga lai kigielte bang ma-in tua tungah, “ Topa dinga ki siensuosa,” kici laiteng a gielkuoh uhi."},"31":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin amate in dielkhim tungah khauhuol dum khat tawh a khi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tam bangin kikhopna puonbuh ahi biehbuh nasep zosie kimansieng hi; Israel-te in Topa’ thupiehsa bang lienin a sem sieng zo ta uhi.","title":"Nasep Kimanzo (Pei 35:10-19)"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in biehbuh, a puonbuh le a vanzah zosie, a vankhainate, khuompehte, a zawlte, a khuompite le a tunna te;"},"34":{"text":"a sana kibum tuutang vunte le savun nemte tawh a kibawl a tungkhu le kot puonkhai dalna puon;"},"35":{"text":"thuciemna singkuong, a zawlte le hepina topha tawh;"},"36":{"text":"sabuoi le a vanzah zosie, le Ompina Anlum;"},"37":{"text":"meivah kibulsa kham meivah tunna le a vanzahte zosie le a kivah ding sathau;"},"38":{"text":"kham maitam, nu sathau le a tuinam gimnamtuite le puonbuh kotbieng adingin puonkhai;"},"39":{"text":"sumngo maitam le sumngo sialen, a zawlte le a vanzah zosie; kisilna kuong le a ngahna;"},"40":{"text":"buh tuola puon kikhaite, a khuompite, a tunnate le buhtuol tunkot puonkhai, a khauhuolte le a khetphimte; kikhopna puonbuh ahi biehbuh nasepna kizang van zosie;"},"41":{"text":"siempu nasepna dinga a siengtho muna kizang ding hoitaha kigan puonte, siempu Aaron ading biehna puon siengtho le a tapate’ puonte, Moses kungah a tawi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Israel-te in Topa’ thupiehsa bang lienin na zosie a sem uhi."},"43":{"text":"Moses in nasep zosie van a, Topa’ thupieh bang lienin amate in nasep a zawsieng lam uh a mu ciengin amate thupha a pie hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Biehbuh Kidingsah, a Vanzahte Kikhol"},"2":{"text":"Hla masa a ni masa ni-in kikhopna puonbuh ahi biehbuh na lam ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua sungah thuciemna singkuong koi-in, dalna puon tawh singkuong na dal ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A sungah sabuoi na tumpi ding a, a om dan ding bangin na koi ding hi. Meivah tunna zong a sungah tumpi-in a meivahte na bul ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuciemna singkuong mai-ah gimnamtui hal nadingin kham maitam na koi ding a, biehbuh lutna adingin kotpuonkhai na khai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh ahi biehbuh lutna mai-ah meihal biehna maitam na daw ding a,"},"7":{"text":"kikhopna puonbuh le maitam kikalah kisilna kuong koi-in, a sungah tui na sung ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A kimvelah buhtuol na bawl ding a, buhtuol tunkotah kotpuonkhai na khai ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin nu sathau la-in, biehbuh le a sunga om zosie nu-in biehbuh le a sunga om zosie na siensuo ding hi. Tuaci’n biehbuh a siengtho ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Meihal biehna maitam le a sunga vanzah zosie zong sathau nu-in na siensuo ding a, tua maitam a siengtho pen hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kisilna kuong le a ngahna zong sathau nu-in na siensuo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah Aaron le a tapate zawpi-in, tui tawh amate na sil ding a,"},"13":{"text":"Aaron in ka siempu na a sep thei nadingin ama puon siengthote silsahin, sathau siengtho nu-in na siensuo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A tapate zong zawpi-in puontungsilte na silsah ding a,"},"15":{"text":"amate in ka siempu na a sep thei nadingun a pa uh sathau na nu bangin amate zong na nu ding hi: Sathau a kinu ziehun a khantanun siempu ahi peisuoh ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in ama a thupiehsa bang lienin Moses in sil bangkim a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"A kum nina a hla masa, a ni masa ni-in biehbuh kidingsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in biehbuh dingsah hi; a tunnate pha-in a khuompehte phut a, tuale a zawlte khumin a khuompite phut hi;"},"19":{"text":"tuale ama in biehbuh tungah a tungkhu puon zah a, tuaci’n Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin puonbuh tung a khu hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin ama in thuciemna la-in singkuong sungah koi a, singkuong tungah a zawlte hlungin tua singkuong tungah hepina topha koi hi;"},"21":{"text":"Ama in biehbuh sungah singkuong peipi a, kotpuonkhai dalna puon khai suhin thuciemna singkuong a dalbih hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin, ama in biehbuh leilu lampang, dalna puon puolam, kikhopna puonbuh sungah sabuoi pha a,"},"23":{"text":"Topa mai tua sabuoi tungah anlum a koi ding dan bangin a koi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in kikhopna puonbuh sung, biehbuh leitaw lam pang sabuoi tawh kigalsai-in meivah tunna koi a,"},"25":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin ama in Topa mai-ah meivahte a tung hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin ama in kikhopna puonbuh sung, dalna puon mai-ah kham maitam tung a,"},"27":{"text":"tua tungah a tuinam gimnamtui biehna a halvam hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in biehbuh lutna adingin kot puonkhai zong a khai hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin ama in kikhopna puonbuh ahi biehbuh lutna-ah meihal biehna maitam tung a, tua tungah meihal biehna le an tawh biehnate a pie hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in kikhopna puonbuh le maitam kikalah kisilna kuong koi a, a sungah kisil nading tui koi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua tui tawh Moses le Aaron le a tapate in a khut ule a kengte a sil uhi."},"32":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin kikhopna puonbuh a tum cieng ule maitam lam a neh ciengun a kisil uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in biehbuh kimvelah a buhtuol bawl a, tuaci’n buhtuolah kotpuonkhai a khai hi. Tuaci’n Moses nasep a man sieng hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin meii in kikhopna puonbuh tuomin biehbuh sungah Topa’ minthanna a dim hi.","title":"Meii le Minthanna (Pei 13:21-22 ; Gam 9:15-23)","ref":"1Kum 8:10-11; Isa 6:4; Ezk 43:4-5; Kln 15:8"},"35":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh meii in a tuomcip ziehin a sungah Moses a lut thei sih hi."},"36":{"text":"A khuolzin sung tungtawn uh biehbuh tung panin meiilum a kilahto popo ciengin Israel-te in ma nawhin a pei uhi;"},"37":{"text":"ahi vangin meiilum a kilahto sih leh a kilahto masangsie-in ma a nawh sih uhi."},"38":{"text":"Azieh pen a khuol zinna tungtawn vuah Israel innkuonte zosie’ mitmu-in biehbuh tungah sunin Topa’ meii om a, zanin meii lahah meikuongin a om hi."}}}}},"3":{"info":{"name":"Siempu Laibu","shortname":"Siem","abbr":[],"desc":"Siempu laibu (leviticus)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hlanin kikhopna buh panin tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Meihal Biehna"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Note khatpo in Topa tungah ganhing biehna na lui ciengun bawnghon pan ahi sihle tuuhon pan hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua biehna khu bawnghon pana meihal biehna ahile, genbaang lo apa khat na pie ding hi; Topa mai-ah tua biehna nangma tanga ang kisanpieh thei nadingin kikhopna buh tunkotah na peipi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Meihal biehna ganhing lu tungah na khut na ngam ding a, tua khu nangma adingin thoidamna-in kisang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa mai-ah tua bawngtang kigo ding a, Aaron’ suon siempute in tua gansi peipi-in kikhopna buh tunkota om maitam ning li tengah the ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin meihal biehna ganhing a vun hawhin kisemnen ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Siempu Aaron’ tate in maitam tungah meitaw-in mei tungah sing bop ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aaron’ suon siempute in a sanente le a lutang le a thaute maitam’ mei sing tungah koi ding uhi;"},"9":{"text":"ahi vangin a sungkuote le a kengte tui tawh sawp sieng ding uhi. Tua ciengin siempu pa in meihal biehna dingin tua teng a unpi-in maitam tungah haltum ding hi. Tua khu Topa dinga a namtui meihal biehna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Meihal biehna dinga na zah letsong pen tuu ahi a, keel ahi zongin a hon lah pan ahile genbaang lo apa khat hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa mai maitam sahlam pangah tua gan kigo ding a, Aaron’ suon siempute in maitam ning li tengah gansi the ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"A sate kisemnen ding a, siempu pa in maitam meitunga om sing tungah a lutang le a thaute tawh a koiton ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"ahi vangin a sungkuo le a kengte tui tawh kisawp sieng ding hi. Tua ciengin siempu pa in a unpi-in pie-in maitam tungah haltum ding hi. Tuami khu meihal biehna ahi a, Topa in namtui a sah mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa tungah na lui uh biehna pen vate tawh meihal biehna ahile vakhu ahi sihle paalva khat zawzaw na teel ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Maitam-ah siempu pa peipi-in a lu hiatawng ding a, maitam tungah hal ding hi. Tua maitam pangah a si tasah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a tangkhai le a sunga om teng ladawhin maitam nisuona lam vutbuohna munah paikhie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A hlakui gel panin balkeh ding a, hinanle a hiatawng sih ding hi. Tua ciengin siempu pa in mei tunga om sing tung, maitam tungah haltum ding hi; tua khu meihal biehna ahi a, Topa in namtui a sah mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi khatpo in Topa tungah an tawh biehna a lui leh a biehpiehna pen annel hi ding hi; biehna luipa in a biehpiehna tungah sathau buohin panamtui koi ding a,","title":"An tawh Biehnate"},"2":{"text":"Aaron’ suon siempute kungah peipi ding hi. Ama in annel le sathau khutdim khat le panamtui zosie a lah zaw ciengin, siempu pa in melcina satanh dingin tua teng maitam tungah haltum ding hi. Tua khu Topa in namtui a sah mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale an tawh biehna dinga kizangmawh teng pen Aaron le a tapate-’a hi ding hi. Tua khu Topa tunga kipie meihal biehna lah panin a siengtho pen khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Meibunga ki-em an tawh biehna na lui ciengin tol saw lo sathau kinu mo, ahi sihle sathau kinu, tol sawlo mopheng hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na biehpiehna pen khangbeel dai sunga kikang an tawh biehna ahile tol saw lo, sathau kisaw annel hi ding hi;"},"6":{"text":"tua khu ehmal inlen a tungah sathau sung in; tua khu an tawh biehna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Na biehna pen mo kanna sia khangbel sunga kikang an tawh biehna ahile sathau tawh kihal annel hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa kungah khat zawzaw tawh kibawl an tawh biehna na peipi ding hi; siempu pa kungah a kipeipi ciengin ama in maitam-ah peipi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Siempu pa in an tawh biehna lah panin melcina satanh teng ladawhin maitam tungah hal ding hi. Tua khu Topa tunga a namtui mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"An tawh biehna dinga a kizangmawh teng pen Aaron le a tate-a’ hi ding hi; tua khu Topa tunga meihal biehna lah panin a siengtho pen khat ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa tunga na tawi an tawh biehna pen tol sawlo hi ding hi. Azieh pen Topa kungah tol ahi a, khuoizu ahi zongin meihal biehna-in na hal sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa kungah anpal tawh biehna na tawi thei ding a, hizongle a gimnamtui dingin maitam tungah kipie lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"An tawh biehna-ah Pasien tawh na kiciemna pen ci saw loin na om vawt sih ding a, na biehna zosie-ah ci na saw ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa tungah gamasa biehna na lui leh gamasa biehna adingin a vuitha pana kila a kigawtvui, mei tawh a kihanggawte na pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A tungah sathau sungin panamtui na buoh ding hi; tua khu an tawh biehna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Siempu pa in melcina satanh dingin a kigawtvui an pawlkhat le sathau le a panamtui zosie tawh a haltum ding hi; tua khu Topa tunga meihal biehna ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na biehna pen thunuom biehna ahi a, bawnghon lah panin anu ahi sihle apa na tawi leh Topa mai-ah genbaang lo khat hi ding hi.","title":"Thunuom Biehnate"},"2":{"text":"Biehna ganhing lutungah na khut ngamin kikhopna buh tunkotah na go ding hi; Aaron’ suon siempute in maitam kimvelah gansi the ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Thunuom biehna panin Topa tungah mei tawh biehna dingin a gilpi tuom a thaute le a sungkuote kima om a thaute zosie tawh;"},"4":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal tegel le a kal tegel tunga om a thau, le a kal tegel tawh kilahtha ding ahi a sin tunga beh a tepkaite na pie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron’ suonte in mei tunga om sing tunga meihal biehnate tawh maitam tungah tuate hal ding uhi. Tua khu Topa dinga a gimnamtui mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa tunga na tawi thunuom biehna khu tuu le keel honte lah panin anu ahi a, apa ahi zongin a genbaang lo khat hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Biehna dinga tuuno khat na tawi leh Topa mai-ah na peipi ding a,"},"8":{"text":"gan lutungah na khut na ngam ding hi. Kikhopna buh mai-ah tua gan kigo ding a, Aaron’ suonte in maitam kimvelah a si the ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa tungah meihal biehna dingin thunuom biehna panin a thaute, a ngumgu dong cienga ki-attan a meithau zosie le a gilpi tuom a thaute le a sungkuo kima om a thaute zosie tawh;"},"10":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal gela a thaute tawh, a kal gel tawh kilahtha ding ahi a sin tunga beh a tepkai pie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in Topa tungah mei tawh kihal an tawh biehna dingin maitam-ah tua teng hal ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na biehna khu keel khat ahile Topa mai-ah tua keel na peipi ding a,"},"13":{"text":"tuale a lutungah na khut na ngam ding hi; tua pen kikhopna buh mai-ah na go ding hi; tuale Aaron’ suonte in maitam kimvelah tua gansi the ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua lah panin Topa tungah meihal biehna dingin a gilpi tuom a thaute le a sungkuote’ tunga om a thau zosie tawh;"},"15":{"text":"a kawnga a kal gel le a thau tawh, a kal tegel tawh kilahtha ding ahi a sin tunga beh a tepkai na pie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in a gimnamtui dingin mei tawh kihal an tawh biehna dingin maitam tungah tuate hal ding hi. A thau zosie Topa -a’ ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua khu na khang tawntung vua na tenna uh mun zosie-ah a kip tawntung thukham hi ding hi: Note in a thau ahi sihle a si kici poma na ne vawt sih ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah,","title":"Mawna Zieha Biehnate"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Mi khatpo in bawl lo ding ahi Topa’ thupiehte khatpo sawm khol lopi-in a bawl khah ciengin:"},"3":{"text":"Sathau siengtho kinusa siempu pa maw-in mipite tungah tua bangin mawna a tut leh, ama in mawna zieha biehna dingin Topa tungah genbaang lo bawngtangno khat pie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Topa mai kikhopna buh tunkotah tua bawngtang peipi-in bawngtang lutungah a khut ngam ding hi; Topa mai-ah tua bawngtang kigo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Sathau siengtho kinusa siempu pa in bawngtang’ si themkhat la-in kikhopna buh sungah a tawi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempu pa in tua bawngtang si sungah a khutme die-in, Topa mai mun siengtho dalna diel mai-ah a si kimkhat sagi vei the ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Siempu pa in kikhopna buh sung Topa mai-a om gimnamtui halna maitam sakite tungah tua gansi nu ding a, ama in kikhopna buh tunkot mai-a om meihal biehna maitam bulah adang gansite zosie sung ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in mawna zieha biehna bawngtang panin a thau zosie, a sungkuo a tuom a thau zosie le a sungkuo kimvela om a thau zosie;"},"9":{"text":"a kawnga a kal gel le tuate tunga om a thaute; le a kal gel tawh kilahtha ding a sin tunga beh a tepkai te,"},"10":{"text":"thunuom biehna bawngtang panin tamte a kilah ma bangin ama in la ding a, siempu pa in meihal biehna maitam tungah tuate haltum ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in bawngtang vun le a tel zosie, le a lu a kengte, a sungkuo le a eeh-"},"12":{"text":"bawngtang sa a omlai teng zosie- giephuol pulam mun siengtho khatah peipi-in sing kitaw mei tungah hal ding hi; tua pen vut kibuohna munah kihal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Sawmhlim lopi-in Israel mihon buppi khiel kha-in a kikhawm mihonte in tua thu phawkha loin amate in bawl lo ding, ci-in Topa in a thupiehte khat po semin khielna a tut uleh;"},"14":{"text":"a bawlsa uh mawna a kithei ciengin mawna zieha biehna dingin a kikhawm mihonte in bawngtang khat peipi-in kikhopna buh mai-ah tawi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mihon upate in Topa mai, bawngtang lu tungah a khut a ngam ding vua, tuaci’n Topa mai-ah tua bawngtang kigo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Sathau kinusa siempu pa in kikhopna buh sungah bawngtang si kimkhat peipi ding a,"},"17":{"text":"siempu pa in tua gansi sungah a khutme die-in, dalna puon mai Topa mai-ah gansi sagi vei the ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in kikhopna puonbuh sunga om Topa mai-a maitam kite tungah tua gansi kimkhat nu ding a, a sidang teng pen kikhopna buh tunkota om meihal biehna maitam bulah sung ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a thau zosie la dawhin maitam tungah haltum ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna bawngtang a bawl bang lien ma-in tami bawngtang zong bawl ding hi; amate adingin siempu pa in thoidamna bawlpiehin a mawna uh thoidamin a om ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in giephuol pulamah bawngtang puo-in a masa bawngtang a hal ma bangin hal ding hi; tua khu mi honpite dingin mawna zieha biehna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa Pasien in bawl lo ding a ci ama’ thukhamte lahah khat popo, vaihawmpa khat in sawm lopi-in bawlkha-in mawna a tut ciengin,"},"23":{"text":"a gamtatnasa mawna a kitheisah leh, ama in genbaang lo keeltang khat biehna-in peipi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in keeltang lu tungah a khut ngam ding a, Topa mai, meihal biehna gan kigawna munah tua keeltang go ding hi; tua khu mawna zieha biehna ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Siempu pa in a khutme tawh mawna zieha biehna dinga kizang gansi kimkhat la ding a, meihal biehna maitam kite nu-in, meihal biehna maitam bulah a omlai gansi zosie sung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Thunuom biehna dinga kizang sathaute ma bangin, ama in a thau zosie maitam tungah a hal ding hi. Tua ahi ziehin siempu pa in a mawna ziehin ama ading thoidamna bawlpieh ding a, tua pa’ mawna kimaisah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa’ thukhamte lahah bawl lo ding a kici thukhamte khatpopo na lah vuah mi maimai khat in sawm lopi-in bawlin a maw leh,"},"28":{"text":"na gamtatnasa khielna ang kithei ciengin na bawlsa mawna zieha na biehna dingin genbaang lo keel anu khat na tawi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna gan lu tungah na khut na ngam ding a, tuale meihal biehna munah mawna zieha biehna kigo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Siempu pa in a khutme tawh gansi kimkhat la-in meihal biehna maitam kite nu ding a, a sidang teng maitam bulah sung ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Thunuom biehna dinga kigo gan thaute a kilah bangin ama in a thau la dawhin Topa dinga a gimnamtui dingin siempu pa in maitam tungah tuate hal ding hi. Tua bangin siempu pa in note tangin thoidamna bawlin na mawna uh kimaisah ding hi.","ref":"Gam 15:27-28"},"32":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna dingin tuuno khat na tawi leh, tua tuuno genbaang lo hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna gan lu tungah na khut na ngam ding a, tuale meihal biehna gan kigawna munah mawna zieha biehna dingin tua gan kigo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Siempu pa in a khutme tawh mawna zieha biehna dinga kigo gansi la-in, meihal biehna maitam kite tungah nu ding a, a sidang teng pen maitam bulah sung ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Thunuom biehna panin tuu thau a kilah bangin a thau zosie na la ding a, siempu pa in Topa tunga meihal biehna tawh maitam tungah tuate hal ding hi. Tua bangin siempu pa in na bawlsa na mawnate tangin thoidamna hing bawlpiehin na mawna kimaisah ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lahah khatpo teci pang dingin thukhen zumah ang kihlat ciengin na musa ahi sihle na theisa thute teci pang thei napi na gen nuom lo ziehin na maw leh dan na thuoh ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Ahi sihle note lahah khatpo in a sieng lo na khat po- a sieng lo gamsa sisa luong hitaleh a sieng lo innsa sisa luong hitaleh a sieng lo a awmtal ganhing - khatpo hitaleh thei kha lopi-in a khoikhah leh- abua na hi a, a maw na hi ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi sihle nang in mi khat a niehsah thei a sieng lo na khat popo- a sien lo lam thei loin na khoikhah leh- tua khu na thei ciengin a maw na hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi sihle note khatpo in ngaisutna hoi hitaleh, a sie hitaleh mite kiciem ngaina dan namkhat popo na kam tawh a thei loin na kiciem pah khah leh, na maw lam na thei ciengin tamte khat popo-ah a maw na hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tamte khat penpen ah na maw lam na kiphaw ciengin tua na bawlsa mawna na pulah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale na bawlsa mawna dan dingin Topa tungah mawna zieha biehna-in ganhon panin tuuno anu khat ahi sihle keel anu khat na peipi ding hi; siempu pa in nang tangin na mawna zieha thoidamna ang bawlpieh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuuno khat na pieh zo sih leh na bawlsa mawna dan dingin Topa tungah vakhu ni ahi sihle paalva ni na peipi ding a, khat pen mawna zieha biehna le a khat pen meihal biehna ading hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Siempu pa kungah tuate na peipi ding a, ama in mawna zieha biehna ding pen pie masa ding a, a ngawng botsan loin hialawi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in maitam pangah mawna zieha biehna gansi kimkhat the ding a, maitam bulah a si dang teng hlawhkang ding hi; tua khu mawna zieha biehna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale ama in ngaina kip om bangin meihal biehna dingin a nina pen pie ding hi. Tua bangin siempu pa in na bawlsa mawna ziehin nang tangin thoidamna hing bawlpieh ding a, na mawna kimaisah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin vakhu ni ahi sihle paalva ni na pieh zo sih leh na bawlsa mawna zieha biehna dingin annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat mawna zieha biehna dingin na peipi ding hi; tua khu mawna zieha biehna ahi ziehin a tungah sathau buoh loin gimnamtui zong na koi sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua pen siempu pa kungah na peipi ding a, siempu pa in phawna satanh dingin a sipdim khat hamin Topa kung meihal biehna tawh maitam tungah halton ding hi; tua khu mawna zieha biehna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin siempu pa in tamte khat popo na bawlsa mawna ziehin thoidamna ang bawl pieh ding a, na mawna kimaisah ding hi. An tawh biehna bang ma-in a val teng siempu pa in tang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Lohkiana Biehnate"},"15":{"text":"Note lahah mi khatpo in theikhol lopi-in thupieh a palsat a, a siengtho Topa’ vante khat popo-ah a maw khah ciengin, a mawna ziehin Topa tungah biehna dingin tuuhon sung panin genbaang lo tuutang khat tawi ding a, amanh ding pen biehinn shekel zangin ngun shekel tawh kikhel, amanh kise zaza hi ding hi; tua khu mawna zieha biehna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Sil siengtho tunga na khielna ziehin lokiana na bawl ding a, se nga-suo- sekhat gawmbe-in siempu pa kungah na pie ding hi. Nang tangin siempu pa in mawna zieha biehna tuutang tawh thoidamna ang bawlpieh ding a, tuaci’n na mawna kimaisah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehte in bawl dingin kilawm lo hi a ci na khat popo thei lona tawh note lahah khatpo in bawlkha-in na maw uleh mawna a tut zo na hi ta a, tuaci’n nang in mawna dan na thuoh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna dingin siempu pa kungah tuuhonte lahah genbaang lo tuutang khat, ahi sihle tua tawh amanh kikim khat na tawi ding hi; tuale siempu pa in theikhol lo-a na bawlkhah a khielna ziehin nangma tangin thoidamna ang bawlpieh ding a, tuaci’n na mawna kimaisah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua khu mawna zieha biehna shi hi; nang pen Topa mai-ah khielna a bawl zo na hi ta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:"},"2":{"text":"Note lahah mi khatpo in van kepsah thu-ah ahi zongin, vankhap thu-ah ahi zongin a vengpa solthopin a na a guhpieh a, ahi sihle a vengpa’ na a lahpieh a,"},"3":{"text":"ahi sihle na mang khat a mu ciengin tua thu-ah zuouthu genin na a tampite lahah mi khat in a bawl thei na khat tawh kisai-in a man loin a kiciem a Topa’ thu a palsat leh,"},"4":{"text":"mawna a bawl zaw-in a khiel lam a kithei ciengin a guh vante hitale, a lahpieh vante hitale, ama kikemsah vante hitale, van mang a mukiate hitale,"},"5":{"text":"a man loin ciemtui dawnna tawh a nga adang vante hitale, amanh za lokia ding a, senga-suo-sekhat piehbe ding hi. A mawna a kiphaw ni-in ama in vannei pa kungah lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in mawna zieha biehna dingin Topa tungah tuuhonte lahah a genbaang lo tuutang khat, ahi sihle tua tawh amanh kikim khat peipi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Siempu pa in Topa mai-ah ama tangin thoidamna bawlpieh ding a, tuaci’n mi khat’ bawl thei mawna khat popo-ah ama kimaisah ding hi.","ref":"Gam 5:5-8"},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Biehpiehna Tawh Kisai Thuhilnate"},"9":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate thupie inlen tam bangin gen in: Tam pen meihal biehna bawldan ahi hi. Meihal biehna pen tap tunga maitam tungah zan tungtawn zingmawng dongin om zing ding a, maitam tungah mei kikuongsah zing ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Siempu pa in a saihadiel bawngbi sungten a ten zaw ciengin a saihadiel puontuol sil ding hi; tuale ama in maitam tunga a tumvam meihal biehna vutte luoh ding a, maitam gei-ah tuate koi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin a puonte suo-in puon dangte silkia ding a, giephuol pulam a siengtho mun khatah a vutte puo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Maitam tungah mei kikuongsah den ding hi; kimitsah ngai lo ding hi. Zingmawng sielin siempu pa in sing bopin a tungah meihal biehna koi ding a, thunuom biehna thau teng hal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Maitam tungah mei kikuongsah zing ding hi; kimitsah ngai lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam khu an tawh biehna bawldan ahi hi: Aaron’ tapate in maitam mai-a Topa mai-ah tuate pie ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in tuate lah panin annel sipdim khat le an tawh biehna sathau, biehna tunga om gimnamtui zosie tawh la-in ama phawna satanh khat pen Topa dinga a namtui dingin maitam tungah hal ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in a mawhteng a ne ding uhi; tua pen a siengtho mun khatah tol saw loin kine ding hi; amate in kikhopna buh tuolah ne ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua pen tol tawh ki-em lo ding hi. Meihal biehna ei kipiehna sung panin amate tanh dingin ka pie zo hi; tua pen khielna zieha biehna le mawna zieha biehna bangin a siengtho pen ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A khang tawntung vua amau’ tanh ding ahi, Topa dinga mei hal biehnate panin Aaron suonte lahah pasal vannuoi in ne ding uhi; tuate tawh kisukha na khatpo a siengtho suoh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:"},"20":{"text":"Tam pen ama sathau siengtho a kinu ni-in Aaron le a tapate in Topa kunga a peipi ding uh biehna ahi hi: A kibawl zing ahi an tawh biehna dingin annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat, alang zingmawngin, alang nitahin pie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua pen khangbeldai tung khatah sathau tawh kibawl ding hi; a pheng phengin ki-emin a ki-ehmal an tawh biehna bangin limtahin halsa-in na peipi ding a, Topa tungah a gimnamtui dingin tuate na tawi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron’ suonte lah panin ama zalaih dinga sathau kinusa siempu pa in tuate bawl ding hi; tam pen a unpi-in mei-a kihal ding Topa’ tanh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Siempu pa dinga kipie an tawh biehna vannuoi a unpi-in kihal ding hi; kine lo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:"},"25":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Tam khu mawna zieha biehna bawldan ahi hi. Meihal biehna gan kigawna mun Topa mai-ah mawna zieha biehna gan kigo ding hi; tua khu a siengtho pen ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna a luipieh siempu pa in tuate ne ding hi; kikhopna buhtuol sunga mun siengtho khatah tuate kine ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A sa a thamkha poma a siengtho suoh ding hi; tuale puon tungah a gansi a kithekhah ciengin nangma in a siengtho mun khatah tua gansi kithekhahna son teng na sawp ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Sa huonna leibeel kitawkeh ding hi; ahi vangin taubeel-a kihuon ahile tui tawh silin kinawtval ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Siempute lah panin pasalte in tua biehna sate a ne thei ding uhi; tua khu a siengtho pen ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Hizongle siengtho munah thoidamna bawl nadingin kikhopna buh sunga kipeipi gansi kilahna ahi mawna zieha biehna sa kine lo ding hi; mei tawh kihal ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khielna zieha biehna bawldan tam bang ahi a, tua khu a siengtho pen ahi hi;"},"2":{"text":"amate in meihal biehna kigawna munah khielna zieha biehna go-in maitam pang zosie-ah a si kithe ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Biehna-a kipie ding a thaute: a meithau, a sungkuo tuom a thau,"},"4":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal gel le a tunga om a thau tawh, a kal gel tawh kilahtha ding ahi a sin tunga beh a tepkai tawh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa tungah meihal biehna dingin siempu pa in maitam tungah tuate hal ding hi; tua khu khielna zieha meihal biehna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempute lah panin pasal poma in tua silpiehte ne ding hi; tua pen a siengtho mun khatah kine ding hi; tua khu a siengtho pen ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Khielna zieha biehna le mawna zieha biehna a kibang ahi a, a bawldan zong kibang hi; thoidamna a bawlpieh siempu pa in tuate tang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ma bangin mi khatpo’ meihal biehna a pie siempu pa in ama’ piehsa tua meihal biehna ganvun tang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Meibung sunga ki-em ahi an tawh biehna vannuoi le khangbeeldai ahi sihle khangbeel-a kikang zosie pen a pie siempu pa-a’ hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle adang an tawh biehna vannuoi, sathau kihal ahi a, a gum tangpi ahi zongin Aaron’ suonte zosie in a kikimin hawm ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam pen mi khatpo in Topa tunga a pieh thei ding thunuom biehpiehna silpieh bawldan ahi hi.","title":"A Kihilbe Thute"},"12":{"text":"Lungdamkona-a na pieh ahile tua lungdamkona biehna pen tol saw lo sathau tawh kihal moh, tol saw lo sathau tawh kizut mohpheng, le sathau tawh hoitaha kipawi annel mohte tawh na pieton ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungdamkona dingin thunuom biehpiehna tawh tol kisaw anlum mohte na biehna-in na peipi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tami biehna khat ciet panin Topa tunga letsong dingin moh khat ta na pie ding hi; thunuom biehna gansi a the siempu pa in tua moh tang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Lungdamkona-a thunuom biehna sa pen a kipieh ni ma-in kine pai ding hi; zingmawng dong khat zong na hen sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin na pieh biehpiehna pen kiciemna zieha biehna ahi sihle nop thu-a biehna ahile tua biehpiehna sa pen na pieh ni ma-in kine pai ding a, a zing ciengin khawnla teng kine ding hi;"},"17":{"text":"ahi vangin a biehpiehna sa a omlai teng pen a ni thum ni-in kihaltum ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in thunuoma kipie biehna sa khat popo a kineh leh tua pen kisang lo ding a, a pie pa tungah zong minphat kipie lo ding hi; tua khu a mudahuoi a suoh ding a, a ne mipa in ama’ khielna a puo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A bua na khat popo tawh a kisukha sa kine lo ding hi; mei tawh kihaltum ding hi. A sieng mi zosie in tua sa ne thei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa dinga kipie thunuom biehpiehna sa pen a sientho lo laitahin a ne mite pen a mipite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Note lahah mi khatpo in a bua na khat- mihing sien lona buana hitale ganhing sien lona hitale a buasa na khat popo hitale a tham a- tua zaw ciengin Topa dinga kipie thunuom biehpiehna sa a neh leh a mipite lah panin tua mipa kinotmang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:"},"23":{"text":"Israel mite kungah tam bangin ci in: Bawngtang thau ahi sihle tuu thau ahi sihle keel thaute na ne sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"A mawh si ganhing ahi a, gamsate’ neh ganhing thaute ahi zongin nadangin kizang thei ding a, hizongle a sa na ne sih ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa tunga meihal silpieha kizang ganhing thau a ne poma a mipite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na tenna mun khat popo-ah va ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin a si khat popo na ne sih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Sisan a ne mi poma a mipite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi.","ref":"Pien 9:4; Siem 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16, 23; 15:23"},"28":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:"},"29":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangci in: Note lahah Topa tunga thunuom biehpiehna a pie ding mi khatpo in tua thunuom biehpiehna panin Topa kungah tua biehna peipi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Nangma’ khut tehteh tawh Topa ading meihal biehna na peipi ding hi; Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in a awmpheu a kivei thei nadingin a thau a awmpheu tawh na peipi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Siempu pa in maitam tungah a thau hal ding a, ahi vangin a awmpheu pen Aaron le a tapate-a’ hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Thunuoma na biehpiehna panun siempu pa tungah biehna-in a zietlam phei na pie ding uhi;"},"33":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate lah panin thunuom biehna a pie mipa in ama’ tanh dingin a zietlam phei nga ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile a kivei biehna panin a awmpheu le a kipie a phei pen keima in Israel mite tung panin thunuoma a pieh uh biehpiehnate sung panin la dawhin, Israel mite tung panin kumtawna a tanh den dingun siempu Aaron le a tapate tungah ka pie zo ta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tam pen Topa tunga kipie mei tawh kihal biehnate sung pan Topa’ siempu na sem dinga a kipeipi huna kipanin Aaron le a tapate tungah a kihawmpieh a tanh uh ahi hi;"},"36":{"text":"tam teng pen Israel mite kung panin Topa in a khantan vua a kaih zing dingun amate sathau a nil ni-in thu pie zo hi."},"37":{"text":"Tam teng pen meihal biehna, an tawh biehna, mawna zieha biehna, khielna zieha biehna, siempu suhdetna biehna, le thunuoma biehpiehna bawl dan ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tam teng pen Sinai senel gamah Topa tunga biehnate a lui nadingun Israel mite a thupieh hun lai-a Topa in Sinai Muol tunga Moses a thupiehte ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Siempu Suhdetna Dante"},"2":{"text":"Aaron le ama tawh a om a tapate, puonte, nu sathau, mawna zieha biehna bawngtang khat, tuutang ni, le tol saw lo anlum law khat la inlen;"},"3":{"text":"tuale kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah Israel mihonte kaikhawm in."},"4":{"text":"Moses in zong Topa’ thupieh bangin a bawl hi. Kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah mihonte a kikhop ciengin,"},"5":{"text":"Moses in mihonte kungah, “ Topa in tami khu sep dinga ei thupieh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Aaron le a tapate zawpi-in tui tawh amate a sil hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a puontungsil ama silsahin kawngga tawh gah a, a puontuolpi le a siempu puon zong a silsah hi. Tua ciengin ama in hoitaha kigan kawnggah tawh a siempu puon gah a, ama tungah a siempipuon tua tawh khi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in ama tungah awmdal bulin a awmdal sungah Urim leh Thummim koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a lu tungah diel khimsah a, a diel tung a mai lamah, Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin kham kizepna, a siengtho kumpi lukhu a khusah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in nu sathau la-in biehbuh le a sunga om van zosie nu-in tuate a siensuo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in maitam tungah tuate kimkhat sagi vei the-in maitam le vanzah zosie, le kuong le a tunna zong nu-in tuate a siensuo hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in Aaron’ lu tungah sathau kimkhat buohsuhin a siensuo hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Moses in Aaron’ tapate zawpi-in ama in amate puontungsilte silsah a, kawnggate tawh gahin a lu tung vuah lukhute a khi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in mawna zieha biehna bawngtang peipi a, Aaron le a tapate in mawna zieha biehna bawngtang lu tungah a khut uh ngamin"},"15":{"text":"tua bawngtang kigo hi. Moses in gansi la a, a khutme tawh maitam ki zosie tungah a si kimkhat nu-in maitam siensuo a, tua ciengin maitam bulah a si sungsuh hi. Tua bangin ama in maitam adingin thoidamna bawlin a siensuo hi."},"16":{"text":"Moses in a sungkuo kimvela om a thau zosie le a sin tunga beh a tepkaite, le a kal gela a thau tawh la-in maitam tungah tuate a hal hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin ama in bawngtang le a vun, a tel le a eeh teng giephuol pulamah mei tawh a hal hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in meihal biehna dingin tuutang a peipi hi. Aaron le a tapate in tuutang’ lu tungah a khut uh ngamin"},"19":{"text":"tua tuu kigo hi. Moses in maitam pang zosie si tawh the hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuutang kisemnen a, Moses in a lu le a sanente le a thaukhalte mei tawh a hal hi."},"21":{"text":"A sungkuo le a kengte tui tawh a kisawp zaw ciengin Moses in maitam tungah tuutang a luongpi-in a hal hi; tua khu Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Topa tunga gimnamtui meihal biehna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in suhdetna tuutang ahi tuutang a nina pen a peipi hi. Aaron le a tapate in tuutang’ lu tungah a khutuh ngamin"},"23":{"text":"tuutang kigo hi. Moses in a si kimkhat la-in Aaron’ zietlam biltep, a zietlam khutpi, le a zietlam kepi nu hi."},"24":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate a kipeipi zaw ciengin Moses in a zietlam biltep, a zietlam khutpite le a zietlam kepite tungah gansi kimkhat the a, a omlai gansi teng pen Moses in maitam pang zosie-ah the hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in a thau, a meithau, a sungkuote tunga om a thau zosie, a sin tunga beh a tepkai, le a kal gel le a thau tawh le a zietlam phei a la hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in Topa mai-a tol saw lo anlum law sung panin tol saw lo moh khat, sathau kisaw anlum moh khat, le mopheng khat la a, a thau tung le a zietlam phei tungah tuate koi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in Aaron le a tapate’ khut sungah tam teng zosie koi-in Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in a vei hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in a khut sung panun tuate la-in meihal biehna tawh maitam tungah a hal hi. Tami khu siempu suhdetna biehna ahi a, Topa dinga a gimnamtui meihal biehna ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in a awmpheu la-in Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in a vei a, tuami khu Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin siempu suhdetna biehna tuutang pana Moses’ tanh ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in nu sathau kimkhat le maitam tunga om gansi kimkhat la a, Aaron le ama’ puon tung, a tapate le a puon tung vuah zong a the hi. Tam bangin ama in Aaron le a puonte, le a tapate le a puonte uzong a siensuo hi."},"31":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a tapate kungah, “Kikhopna puonbuh tunkotah a sa huon unlen, ‘Aaron le a tapate in tua sa a ne ding uhi,’ ci-in kei thu ei kipieh bangin, siempu suhdetna biehna law sunga anlum tawh tua munah ne unlen;"},"32":{"text":"tuale a sa le anlum a omlai teng pen mei tawh na haltum ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Siempu pa dingin suhdetna ni a cin masang, kikhopna puonbuh pulamah ni sagi sung na pusuoh sih ding uhi. Azieh pen note ang kisuhdet nading ni sagi sawt ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuni-a kibawlsa bangin note adinga thoidamna a kibawl nading Topa in thu pie zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah ni sagi sung, sun le zanin na om den ding vua, na si lo nadingun Topa’ thupiehte na zui ding uhi; azieh pen tua bang dingin keima tungah thu ei kipie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in Topa in Moses tung tawna a thupieh zosie a sem uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in a ni giet ni-in Aaron le a tapate le Israel upate hlan hi.","title":"Aaron Siempu Suona Pawi Kibawl"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Aaron kungah, “Mawna zieha biehna dingin genbaang lo bawngtang ano khat le meihal biehna dingin tuutang khat la inlen, Topa mai-ah tuate pie in."},"3":{"text":"Israel mite kungah, ‘Mawna zieha biehna dingin keeltang khat la in; meihal biehna dingin genbaang lo kumkhat a pha bawngno khat le tuuno khat,"},"4":{"text":"le Topa mai-ah thunuoma biehpiehna dingin bawngtang khat le tuutang khat la in; tuale sathau kisaw an tawh biehna pie in. Bangzieh ahei cile tuni-in na kung vuah Pasien ang kilang ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh mai-ah Moses’ thupieh teng a peipi uhi; tuale a nai-ah mihon zosie pei-in Topa mai-ah a ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale Moses in, ”Tami pen note tungah Topa’ vanglietna ang kilaa thei nadinga na bawl ding vua Topa ang thupieh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Aaron kungah, “Maitam lam neh inlen na mawna zieha biehna le na meihal biehna pie in. Topa’ thupieh bangin nangma ading le mite adingin thoidamna bawl in; tuale mite adingin biehpiehna bawl inlen amate dingin thoidamna bawlpieh in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 7:27"},"8":{"text":"Aaron in maitam lam nehin ama adingin mawna zieha biehna bawngno go hi."},"9":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate in ama kungah si a tawi vua, ama in tua si sungah a khutme dawn phumin maitam’ kite tungah nu hi; tua site a omlai teng maitam bulah a sungsuh hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin ama in maitam tungah mawna zieha biehna panin a thau, a kal gel le a sin tunga beh a tepkaite a hal hi;"},"11":{"text":"tuale a sa le a vun teng zong giephuol pulamah a hal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin meihal biehna gan a go hi. Aaron tapate in ama a si a pie vua, tua a si pen maitam pang zosie-ah the hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in meihal biehna a nennenin a lutang tawh ama kungah tawi-in maitam tungah a hal uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a sungkuo le a kengte sawp a, tuate maitam tungah meihal biehna tawh a halton hi."},"15":{"text":"Abanah ama in mite’ biehna a pie a, mite adingin zong mawna zieha biehna keel a pie hi. Ama in tua keel go a, a masa-a bangin mawna zieha biehna dingin a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in meihal biehna peipi a, bawldan ngaina a om bangin biehpiehna a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Zingmawnga meihal biehna banah an tawh biehna a peipi a, tuate a sipdim khat la-in maitam tungah mei tawh a hal hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in mite adingin thunuoma biehna dingin bawngtang le tuutang go hi. Aaron’ tapate in ama kungah a si a peipi vua, maitam pang zosie-ah ama in tua si the a,","ref":"Siem 3:1-11"},"19":{"text":"bawngtang le tuutang thau-a meithau, a sungkuo tuom a thau, a kal gel le tuate tunga a tuom a thaute, le a sin tunga beh a tepkai teng a peipi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amasa-in a awmpheu tungah a thau a koi vua, maitam tungah tua a thaute kihal hi;"},"21":{"text":"Moses’ thupiehsa bangin Aaron in a awmpheute le a zietlam pheite, Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in a vei hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in mite lamah a khut lamto-in amate thupha a pie hi; ama in mawna zieha biehna, meihal biehna, le thunuom biehnate a lui zaw ciengin a peisuh hi.","ref":"Gam 6:22-26"},"23":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh sungah Moses le Aaron a lut vua, ang pusuo cieng gelin mipite thupha pie a, tuaci’n Topa’ minthanna mi zosie tungah kilang hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa tung panin mei pusuohin maitam tunga meihal biehna le a thaute a katum hi; tuale mi zosie in tua mei a mu ciengin awngin a mai tuolkun uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Aaron’ tapate Nadab le Abihu in a panamtui beel tuoh gel la-in tuate sungah meikam koi-in a tungah panamtui a koi uhi; Topa in tua banga a thupieh vawt lopi-in ama gel in a mai-ah a sieng lo mei a pie uhi.","title":"Nadab leh Abihu"},"2":{"text":"Tuale Topa’ opna panin meikuong pusuohin Topa mai-ah ama gel katumin a si uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Aaron kungah, “Tami khu Topa’ gen nop thu ahi a, ama in ‘Ka gei-a omte tungtawnin ka sienthona ka lah ding a, mi zosiete mai-ah ei kiminthangsah ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Aaron a sip dide hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Aaron’ pano ahi Uzziel’ tapate Mishael le Elzaphan hlan a, a ama gel kungah, “Hing pei un, mun siengtho mai panin giephuol pulam mun khatah na sanggamte puodawh ta un,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses’ sawl bangin ama gel a pei vua, giephuol pulamah a puon tungsil gel tawh zawngin a puo uhi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a tapate Eleazar le Ithamar kungah, “Na lu tung vua na sam bahkaisah sih gel inlen, na puon gel botkeh sih un, tua banga na bawl uleh na si ding vua, tuami lungthahna in mihon zosie vatmai ding hi; hinanle na sanggamte Israel innkuon buppi ahile Topa’ sawl meikuong ziehin thum le tau-in a om ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh lutna pulam kal sih gel in, na kal gel leh na si ding uhi; azieh pen no gel tungah Topa’ nu sathau a om hi,” a ci hi. Moses’ gen bangin ama gel a gamta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale Topa in Aaron kungah tam bangin gen hi:"},"9":{"text":"Nang na hi a, na tapate ahi zongin kikhopna puonbuh sunga na lut ciengin na si lo nadingun lenggazu ahi a, khamthei zu ahi zongin na dawn sih ding uhi; tua khu na khang tawntung vua a om zing ding ngaina kip ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mun siengtho le taangpi mun, a bua le a sieng na khen ding uhi;"},"11":{"text":"tuale Topa in Moses tung tawna a gensa thukham zosie Israel mite na hil ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a omlai a tapate, Eleazar le Ithamar a hopi hi: Mei tawh a kihal Topa’ biehnate sung panin a val lai an tawh biehna la unlen, maitam gei-ah tol saw loin ne un, bang zieh ahei cile tua khu a siengtho pen ahi hi;"},"13":{"text":"tua pen Topa tunga meihal biehnate sung panin nangma le na tapate’ kaih ahi ziehin mun siengtho khatah na ne ding uhi; azieh pen tua bang dinga kei thu ei kipie ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 6:14-18"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kivei a awmpheu le a kilamto a phei pen nangma le na tapate, le na tanute in zong mun siengtho khatpo-ah na ne thei ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile tuate pen Israel mite in thunuoma a biehpiehna uh pana nangma le na tapate adinga a kisesa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in a kilamto a phei le a kivei a awmpheu, mei tawh a kihal biehna thaute tawh, Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in a tawi ding uhi; Topa’ thupiehsa bangin nangma le na tapate in tuate na kaih zing ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 7:30-34"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in mawna zieha biehna keel thu khu a kan leh tua keel pen na kihaltum dawh ta hi! A omlai Aaron’ tapate, Eleazar le Ithamar tungah ama lungthah a,"},"17":{"text":"“Bang dingin mun siengtho sungah mawna zieha biehna na neh lo uh ahei? Azieh pen tua khu a siengtho pen ahi a, amau’ tangin Topa mai-ah thoidamna bawl in mihonte’ khielna na lahdawh thei nadingun Pasien in na tung vuah tuate ang pie zo ta hi.","ref":"Siem 6:24-26"},"18":{"text":"Munsiengtho sung lamah tua gansi kipeipi lo hi. Ka thupiehsa bangin tua khu munsiengtho sunga na neh ding vua kilawm ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Aaron in Moses hopi a, “En in, tuni-in amate in Topa mai-ah a mawna uh zieha biehna le a meihal biehnate uh a pie zo ta uhi. Hizongle kei tungah tua bang nate ang tung zo hi! Tuni-in mawna zieha biehna a ne kha hi poma leng, Topa a thukim mawh diei?” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses in tua thu a zah bepin a thukim hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:","title":"An Sieng le An Sienglo"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite hopi-in tam bangin gen un: Tam teng pen leitunga om ganhingte lahah na neh thei ding uh ganhingte ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A kecin a kaa, ehnel a hlai ganhing poma- tua bangte na ne thei ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ehnel-hlaite lah pan hitale kecin-kaate lah pan hitale tamte na ne sih ding uhi: Kalaoh in ehnel a hlai vangin a kecin kaa lo hi; tua khu note dingin sieng lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Sakih ganhing in ehnel a hlai vangin a kecin kaa lo hi; tua khu note dingin sieng lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Bilpi in annel a hlai vangin, a kecin kaa lo hi; tua khu note dingin sieng lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Voh a kecin a kaa vangin, ehnel hlai lo hi; tua khu note dingin sieng lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam bang sate ne loin a sisate zong na tham sih ding uhi; tuate pen note dingin sieng lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tui sunga om zosiete lah panin tam teng na ne thei ding uhi. Tuipi sung hitale lui sung hitale, hla le lip a neite zosie na ne thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuipi ahi sihle lui sunga om hla le lip a nei lo, tui sunga a hontat ganhingte le tui sunga om adang hinna a nei ganhing zosiete lahah khat popo pen"},"11":{"text":"note dingin a kidahhuoi hi den ding hi. Tuate’ sa na ne sih ding vua, a sisate zong a kidahhuoi-in na ngaisun ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tui sunga om hla le lip nei lo zosie note dingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Vate lah panin tam teng pen a kidahhuoi-in na ngaisun ding uhi. Tuate kine lo ding hi; tua a kidahhuoite: muvanlai, langta, luimu,"},"14":{"text":"mumeikaa, mukhau namcin;"},"15":{"text":"va-ah namcin;"},"16":{"text":"ostrich vapi, pengpeleuh, vatawt, musi namcin;"},"17":{"text":"keising, tuimu, simbu,"},"18":{"text":"gam vatawt, tui vatawt , musane,"},"19":{"text":"gun vapi, tuiva kengsau namcin, le huitun le bahte ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Kengli tawh lam a pei, hla a nei ganhing zosie note dingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin hla a nei, kengli tawh a pei ganhingte lahah a kitom nadinga a kepheng tungah a kizom keng tampi a neite na ne thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuate lah panin na neh thei dingte uh: kauphe kitom nam zosie, kauphe zol nam zosie, khuomkhit nam zosie, le khuombai nam zosie ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin keng li nei-in hla a nei ganhing dangte zosie note dingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tam teng ziehin a sieng lo na hi ding uhi; a sisa ganhing a tham poma nitah masang a sieng lo na hi ding vua,","title":"Ganhing Sienglote"},"25":{"text":"tua gan sisa khat popo lahah a sa themkhat a puo poma in a puonte sawp sieng ding a, nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A kecin kaa nanle ehnel a hlai lo ganhing zosie note dingin a sieng lo ahi hi; tuate khatpo a tham khate a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kengli tawh lam a pei ganhingte lah panin a kephang tawh lam a pei zosie note dingin a sieng lo ahi hi; tuate lahah a si khatpo a thamkhate nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding a,"},"28":{"text":"gan sisa a puo pa in a puonte sawp siengin nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding hi; tua teng pen note dingin a sieng lo ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Leitunga a bawhva ganhingte lahah tam teng pen note dingin a sieng lo ahi hi: bui, zusa, tangpi namcin,"},"30":{"text":"taldep, tang, thangkhit, senel thangkhit, talmam te ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"A hontat ganhing zosie lah panin note dingin tam teng pen a sieng lo hi ding hi; tuate khatpo a si ciengin a tham poma nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuate a si ciengin a tuhna nate, sing vanzah, puon, savun, la-ip le na khatpo-a kizang vanzah khatpo hitale a sieng lo hi ding hi; tua teng pen tui sungah kidie ding a, nitah masang a sieng lo hi dinghi; tua zaw ciengin a sieng hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Leibeel sungah tuate khatpo a kieh leh, tua sunga om zosie a sieng lo hi ding a, tua leibeel na tawkeh ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua beel sunga a om a kine thei an khatpo tungah tua bang tui khatpo a tuh leh a sieng lo hi ding hi; tua bang beel sunga om a kidawn thei tui poma a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ganhing sisa themkhat a tuhna poma a sieng lo hi ding hi; meibung lungthu hitale, tap tung hitale kitawkeh ding hi; tua teng pen a sieng lo hi a, note dingin a sieng loin a om suoh ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuinah ahi sihle tuibem sunga omte a sieng hi ding a, tua ganhing tawh a kithukha na khatpo pen a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua dinga a kituomkoi khaici tungah tua gan sisa themkhat a tuh leh, tua khaici pen a sieng ahi hi;"},"38":{"text":"ahi vangin tui sungah khaici kidie-in tua a sisate themkhat tua tunga a tuh leh, tua pen note dingin a sieng lo ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Na neh thei ding uh ganhing khat a si leh tua gan sisa a tham poma pen nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ganhing sa a ne poma in a puonte sawp ding a, nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding hi; tuale ganhing sisa a luonghawm a puote in a puon a sawp ding vua, nitah masang a sieng lo hi ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Leitunga a hontat ganhing poma a kidahhuoi ahi hi; tuate kine lo ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A awm-a kithol poma, le kengli-a vah poma, ahi sihle keng hau, leitunga hontat ganhing zosie na ne sih ding uhi; azieh pen tuate a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A hontat ganhing khatpo tawh noma le noma a kidahhuoi-in na om sih ding uhi; tuate tawh noma le noma na kiniehsah sih ding vua, na kiniehsah uleh a sieng lo na suoh ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi; tua ahi ziehin kei a siengtho ka hi ziehin noma le noma kisiengsah un. Leitunga a bawhva ganhing khatpo tawh noma le noma kiniehsah sih un.","ref":"Siem 19:2; 1Pet 1:16"},"45":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note’ Pasien ahi dingin Egypt gam pana nohaw ang peitopi Topa ka hi hi; kei a siengtho ka hi ma bangin no zong na siengtho ding uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tam teng pen vasate, tui sunga gamta hinna a nei ganhing zosie le leitunga a bawhva hinna a nei ganhing zosie tawh kisai ngainate ahi a,"},"47":{"text":"tuaci’n hinna a nei ganhingte, a sieng le a sieng lo, a sa neh thei ding le a sa neh thei lo dingte na khen ding uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi a,","title":"Nausuo Zaw Cienga Numeite Kisiensuona"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite kungah tam bangin gen in, a ci hi: Numei khat gai-in ta pasal khat a nei leh a nin nei lai ma bangin ni sagi sung tua nu a sieng lo hi ding hi;"},"3":{"text":"a ni giet ni-in a tapa a tep kitan ding hi.","ref":"Pien 17:12; Luk 2:21"},"4":{"text":"A siluonna panin a kisiensuo nading hun pen nisawm thum le ni thum sung hi ding hi; a kisiensuona ni a cin masangin a siengtho na khatpopo tham thei lo ding a, mun siengtho sungah zong lut thei lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in ta numei khat a nei leh a nin nei hun lai ma bangin nipikal ni sung a sieng lo hi ding hi; a siluonna a kisiensuo nading hun pen ni sawm guh le ni guh sung hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A kisiensuona ni a cin zaw ciengin, tua nu in a tapa ading ahi a, a tanu ading ahi zongin kikhopna puonbuh lutna siempu pa kungah meihal biehna dingin kum khat a pha tuuno khat, le khielna biehna dingin paalva khat ahi sihle vakhu khat peipi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Topa mai-ah tuate peipi-in tua nu adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi; tua ciengin a siluonna panin tua nu a sieng hi ding hi. Tam pen tanu hitale tapa hitale a nei nu adingin zui ding ngaina ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua nu in tuuno a pieh zawh sih leh paalva ni ahi sihle vakhu ni tawi ding a, khat pen meihal biehna le adang khat pen khielna biehna hi ding hi; tuale siempu pa in tua nu adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding a, ama a sieng hi ding hi.","ref":"Luk 2:24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron kungah tam bangci hi:","title":"Phah natna, Namtuomtuomte le A Kilahna Limte"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat in ama’ tahsa vun tungah a cibaw khat hitale, hima khat hitale cikang khat hitale a nei a, a tahsa vun tungah phah natna suoh thei ding dan a a op leh, siempu Aaron ahi sihle ama’ tapa siempute khat popo kungah kipeipi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Siempu pa in a ci tunga hima vel ding a, a hima munah a multe kangin a hima zong a ci tunga a vun sangin a thuh tum zaw-a a kimu leh, tua pen phah natna ahi hi; siempu pa in a vel zaw ciengin ama a sieng loin kise hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ ci tunga a vun sungah a hima kang napi a vun sangin a thuh tum lo zaw-in a kimu a, tua sunga a multe a kan sih leh siempu pa in ama ni sagi sung zia a tangsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Siempu pa in a ni sagi ni-in vel ding a, a hima a ngaingai a na hi a, a ci tunga a kizel sih leh siempu pa in ni sagi sung ma zia tangsahkia lai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempu pa in a ni sagi ni-in velkia ding a, a hima khipin a kizel nawn sih leh ama sieng hi, ci-in siempu pa in a phuongzah ding hi; tua pen hima maimai ahi bo hi; tuale ama in a puonte sawp sieng ding a, tua ciengin a sieng hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a sientho nadingin siempu pa kungah a kilaa zaw ciengin a hima pen a vun sung tenga a kizelmang tah leh siempu pa kungah ama kilahkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Siempu pa in cienvel ding a, a vun sung tengah a hima a kizelmang zo tah leh siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi; tua khu phah natna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khat in phah natna a vei leh siempu pa kungah kipeipi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Siempu pa in velcien ding a, a vun sungah a mul a kangsah cibaw a kang a op a, tua a cibaw sungah a tel sosuong a op leh,"},"11":{"text":"tua khu a cilah vun sunga a om a dam thei nawn lo phah natna ahi hi. Siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi; ama a sieng lo ahi ziehin zia kitang sah lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin siempu pa muna danah tua natna in a vun a phuhkhe a, a lutang panin a kephang dongin a tuommang zo tah leh,"},"13":{"text":"siempu pa in cienvel ding a, a natna in a ci tung zosie a tuommang tah leh, tua natna tawh kisai-in ama sieng hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi; a ci tung zosie a kansah zo tah ziehin ama a sieng ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a ci tungah a matha ang opkia leh ama a sieng lo hi ding hi;"},"15":{"text":"siempu pa in a ma tha pen cienvelin ama sieng lo hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi. Tua khu phah natna ahi ziehin tua a ma tha pen a sieng lo ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin a ma tha ang kankia leh siempupa kungah ama pei ding hi;"},"17":{"text":"siempu pa in ama velin, a natna a kang a suo zo tah leh siempu pa in natna veipa pen sieng hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi. Ama pen a sieng ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mi khat’ tahsa vun tungah a damsa uilut khat a op a,"},"19":{"text":"tua uilut munah cibaw a kang khat ahi sihle a san kang khat a op leh tua pen siempu pa kungah kilah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Siempu pa in velcienna nei ding a, a vun sangin a thuh zaw-in a multe a kang a suo leh siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi; tua khu phah natna ahi a, uilut pana ang phuhkhe ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hizongle siempu pa in cienvelin tua tunga a multe a kan sih a, a vun sangin thuh tumzaw loin a dup leh siempu pa in ni sagi sung ama zia tangsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A vun sunga a kizel tah leh siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi; tua khu phah natna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua a cikang pen mun khatah om denin a kizel sih leh tua khu uilut hima pawn ahi bo hi; siempu pa in ama sieng hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi sihle tahsa in a vun tungah meikahma khat a nei a, tua meikahma a tha mun pen a san kang ahi sihle a kang ang suo leh,"},"25":{"text":"tua pen siempu pa in a cienvel ding hi. Tua cikang tunga a om a multe kangin a vun sangin a thuhzawh leh tua khu phah natna ahi hi; tua pen meikahna pana ang phuhkhe ahi a, siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi. Tua khu phah natna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin siempu pa in velin cikang tunga om a mul a kan sih a, a vun sangin thuh tumzaw loin a dup leh, siempu pa in ama ni sagi sung zia tangsah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in siempu pa in ama velcien ding hi; a vun sunga a kizel leh siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi. Tami khu phah natna ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin mun khatah tua cikang om denin a vun sungah kizel loin a dup leh, tua khu meikahna pana cibaw ahi bo a, siempu pa in ama sieng hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi. Azieh pen tua khu meikahna pana hima pawn ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasal ahi sihle numei in a lutang tung ahi sihle a kha-ah natna khatpo a nei ciengin,"},"30":{"text":"siempu pa in tua natna cienvel ding hi. Tua natna pen a vun sanga a thuhzaw-in a kimu a, tua sunga om a multe engdangin a ngat zitzet leh siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi; tua khu cithah ahi a, luphah ahi sihle khaphah natna ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Siempu pa in tua cithah natna velin a vun sangin a thuhzaw lo bangin kimu-in tua sungah mulvom a op sih leh siempu pa in ni sagi sung cithah natna tawh tua pa khumcipin zia tangsah ding hi."},"32":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in siempu pa in cithah natna vel ding hi; tua cithah a kilaw sih a, a sungah a mul engdang loin, a vun sangin a cithah a thuh lo zaw banga a kimu leh,"},"33":{"text":"ama in a sam heukieu ding a, hizongle a cithah mun teng heu lo ding hi. Siempu pa in a cithah natna tawh ama ni sagi khumbe lai-in zia tangsah ding hi."},"34":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in siempu pa in tua cithah vel ding hi; a cithah in a vun sung law loin a vun sangin a thuh lozaw-a a kimu leh, siempu pa in ama sieng hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama sieng hi, ci-in a kiphuongzah zaw ciengin a cithah in a vun sung a zel leh,"},"36":{"text":"siempu pa in ama vel ding hi. A vun sungah a cithah a kizel zo tah leh siempu pa in mul eng sui kul nawn lo hi; ama a sieng lo ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin a mittang sungah cithah a noptuom zo tah a, a sungah a mulvom po-in a cithah a dam zo tah leh ama a sieng ahi hi; siempu pa in ama sieng hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Pasal ahi sihle numei in a tahsa vun tungah cikangte a nei leh"},"39":{"text":"siempu pa in velin a kandang leh tua khu a vun a phukeh hima ahi hi; ama a sieng ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Mi khatpo a lu tunga a sam pulin a lu a tol vangin ama a sieng ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"A talpang le a ankhawibaw’ sam a pul a, a pang a tawl vangin ama a sieng ahi bo hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lutol tungah ahi sihle a pangtawl tungah a san kang hima a op leh, tua khu a lutol tung ahi sihle a pangtawl tunga a pusuoh phah natna ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Siempu pa in ama velcien ding hi; tua ahima baw pen a lutol tungah hitale a pangtawl tungah hitale, tahsa vun tunga phah natna op dan banga a kangsan ahile,"},"44":{"text":"ama phah natna vei ahi a, ama a sieng lo ahi hi. Siempu pa in ama sieng lo hi, ci-in a phuongzah ding hi; a lutang tungah a natna a om hi."},"45":{"text":"Phah natna vei pa in puonsiete sil ding a, a lu tunga a samte bawhkaisah lo ding hi; ama in a nephu humin, ‘Sienglo, Sienglo,” ci-in kiko ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Natna a nei laisie ama a sienglo hi ding hi; ama a sienglo ahi hi. Ama guoh teng ding hi; ama’ tenna pen giephuol pulam hi ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Puonsil tawh kisai tam bang ahi hi: Tua puon tungah phah natna a op ciengin samul puon hitale saihadiel puon hitale,"},"48":{"text":"adung le avai-a kigan saihadiel puon, samul puon, savun, le savun tawh kibawl na khat popo tungah a tuh ciengin,"},"49":{"text":"puon tungah tua hima a engin hitale a sanin hitale adung le avai-a kigan puon, savun, le savun tawh kibawl na khat popo tungah a tuh leh, tua khu phah natna ahi a, siempu pa kungah kilah ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Siempu pa in tua natna vel ding a, natna baang vante ni sagi sung tuomkoi ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Ama in a ni sagi ni-in a natna vel ding hi. Tua natna pen adung le avai-a kigan puon, savun, le bang khat popo-a kizang savun tunga a kizel zo tah leh, tami khu mi a law thei phah natna ahi hi; tua khu a sieng lo ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua natna pen adung le avai-a kigan puon, samul, saihadiel, savun khat popo tunga a tuh leh ama in tua puonte mei tawh hal ding hi, azieh pen tua khu mi a law thei phah natna ahi hi; tua khu mei sungah kihal ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Siempu pa in velin, tua natna pen adung le avai-a kigan puon tung le savun khat popo tunga a kizel sih leh,"},"54":{"text":"siempu pa in natna a banna tuami van sawp dingin amate thupie ding a, ama in adang ni sagi sung ma tua van a tuomkoi ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Natna a banna van a kisawp zaw ciengin siempu pa in vel ding hi. Tua natna a kilaw sih nanle a natna mun a mel a kikhel sih leh, tua khu a sieng lo ahi hi; a sung lamah ahi sihle a pu lamah tua phah natna cikang a op leh, tua khu mei-ah na hal ding hi."},"56":{"text":"Siempu pa in a natna a kisawp zaw ciengin velin tua natna a dup leh, ama in adung le avai-a kigan puon tung pan hitale savun khat popo tung pan hitale tua cikang opna mun teng ehbal ding hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua natna adung le avai-a kigan puon tung hitale savun tawh kibawl van khatpo tungah hitale ang opkia leh, tua khu a kilaw thei ahi hi; tua natna banna teng mei tawh na hal ding hi."},"58":{"text":"Hizongle adung le avai-a kigan puon, le savun khatpo a kisawp sieng zaw ciengin natna a ven leh a ni veina kisawp ding a, tua puon a sieng hi ding hi."},"59":{"text":"Tam khu samul puon ahi a, saihadiel puon le adung le avai-a kigan puon, le savun van khat popo tungah ahi zongin a baang phah natna tawh kisai a sieng le a sieng lo khinkhai thei nading ngaina ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangci hi:","title":"Miphahte le Miphahte’ Inn Siensuona"},"2":{"text":"Tam pen a kisiensuo ni-in miphah pa zui ding ngaina hi ding hi: Siempu pa kungah ama kipeipi ding a,","ref":"Mat 8:4; Mrk 1:44; Luk 5:14; 17:14"},"3":{"text":"giephuol pulamah siempu pa pei-in velcienna khat bawl ding hi. Tua phah natna veipa a natna a dam leh,"},"4":{"text":"siempu pa in a kisiensuo pa dingin vata hinglai a sieng ni, taamtah sing, a ausan puon le hyssop la dingin amate a sawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Siempu pa in leibeel sung khat a kikoi tuisieng tungah vata khat tha dingin thupie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in tua vata hinglai pen taamtah sing le a ausan puon le hyssop-te tawh lahtha-in, tuisieng tunga kithat vata si’ sungah tuate le vata hinglai pen die ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in phah natna pana kisiengsah ding pa tungah sagi vei the ding hi; tua ciengin ama sieng hi, ci-in phuongzahin tua vata hinglai pen gamlahah hla ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A kisiensuo ding pa in a puonsilte sawpsiengin a sam heu ding a, tui sungah kisilin ama a sieng hi ding hi. Tua zaw ciengin giephuol ah ama pei ding a, ahi vangin puonbuh pulamah ni sagi sung om ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in a mul zosie heu sieng ding hi: A lu, a khamul, a mitkhu mul le a mul zosie heu ding hi; tua ciengin a puonsilte sawpin tui sungah kisil ding a, ama a sieng hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in ama in genbaang lo tuuno apa ni, le genbaang lo kum khat a pha tuuno khat, le an tawh biehna sathau kisawsa annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo- sethum le sathau log khat la ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama a siensuo siempu pa in a kisiensuo ding pa pen tam teng tawh, kikhopna buh lutna Topa mai-ah koi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Siempu pa in tuuno apa khat la-in sathau log khat tawh khielna zieha biehna-in pie ding a, Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in tuate lamto ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in mawna zieha biehna le meihal biehna gan kigawna mun siengtho-ah tua tuuno go ding hi; azieh pen mawna zieha biehna bangin khielna zieha biehna pen siempu pa-a’ ahi hi; tua khu a siengtho pen ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Siempu pa in khielna zieha biehna si themkhat la ding a, a kisuonsuo ding pa’ a zietlam biltep tung, a zietlam khutpi tung, le a zietlam kepi tungah tua si nu ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Siempu pa in sathau log khat panin themkhat la-in a veilam khut phangah sung ding a,"},"16":{"text":"a veilam khut sunga om sathau sungah a zietlam khutme die-in a khutme tawh sathau themkhat Topa mai-ah sagi vei the ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Siempu pa in a khut sunga a omlai sathau themkhat, a kisiensuo ding pa’ a zietlam biltep, a zietlam khutpi, le a zietlam kepi nu-in khielna zieha gansi tungah koi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Siempu pa’ khut sunga sathau omlai teng pen a kisiensuo ding pa’ lu tungah nupieh ding hi. Tua ciengin siempu pa in Topa mai-ah ama adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A sien lona panin a kisiensuo ding pa ading thoidamna bawl nadingin siempu pa in mawna zieha biehna pie ding hi. Tua ciengin ama in meihal biehna go ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"tuale siempu pa in maitam tungah meihal biehna le an tawh biehna te koi ding hi. Tua bangin ama adingin siempu pa in thoidamna bawlin ama a sieng hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanle ama a zawn ziehin tampi a pieh zawh sih leh ama ading thoidamna bawl nadingin ama in a kivei ding, khielna zieha biehna dingin tuuno khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kisaw annel ephah’ sesawm-suo- sekhat le sathau log khat pie ding hi;"},"22":{"text":"vakhu ni ahi sihle paalva ni zong a pieh zawh bangbangin pie ding a, khat pen mawna zieha biehna hi ding a, a khat pen meihal biehna hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in ama in Topa mai, kikhopna puonbuh lutna, siempu pa kungah ama’ kisiensuo nadingin tuate tawi ding hi;"},"24":{"text":"tuale siempu pa in khielna zieha biehna tuuno le sathau log khat la ding a, a Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in tuate lamto ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Siempu pa in khielna zieha biehna tuuno go ding a, tua khielna zieha biehna sasi themkhat la-in a kisiensuo pa’ a zietlam biltep, a zietlam khutpi, le a zietlam kepi nu ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Siempu pa in a veilam khutkuoh sungah sathau themkhat sung ding a,"},"27":{"text":"a veilam khut sunga om sathau themkhat, Topa mai-ah a zietlam khutme tawh sagi vei the ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Siempu pa in a khut sunga om sathau themkhat, a kisiensuo ding pa’ a biltep, a zietlam khutpi, le a zietlam kepite tungah khielna zieha biehna gan si kikoina munah nu ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A khut sunga sathau omlai teng pen siempu pa in a kisiensuo ding mipa adingin Topa mai-ah thoidamna bawl nadingin a lu tungah nupieh ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in vakhu ahi sihle paalva a piehzo zawzaw pie-in,"},"31":{"text":"khat pen mawna zieha biehna ding, a khat pen meihal biehna dingin an tawh biehnate tawh piehtha ding hi; tuale siempu pa in a kisiensuo pa dingin Topa mai-ah thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tami khu phah natna a vei, siensuo nading biehna a lui zo lo mipa dinga ngaina ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:"},"34":{"text":"Keima in na luo ding vua kang pieh Canaan gamah nang pei uh ciengin na tenna mun inn khatah phah natna kang tunsah leh,"},"35":{"text":"inn nei pa pei-in siempu pa kungah, “Ka inn sungah natna nam khat a om tawh kibang sa ing,” ci-in gen ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Siempu pa in tua inn sunga om van zosie a sieng lo a kici lo nadingin, tua natna kan dingin siempu pa a pei masangin tua inn a hawma a op nadingin thupie ding hi; tua zaw ciengin inn van dingin siempu pa pei ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in a natna vel ding hi; inn kawm tung tengah natna omin, a engsim le a sansim ahi a, tua pen kawm maitang sangin a thuh zawh tuoh leh,"},"38":{"text":"inn sung panin inn mai kotah siempu pa pusuohin ni sagi sung kot khahcip ding hi."},"39":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in siempu pa peikia-in cienvel ding hi; kawm tung tengah tua natna a kizel leh,"},"40":{"text":"siempu pa in tua natna banna suongte khawhdawhin khuo pulam nin buohna mun khat a pai dawh dingin thupie ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in inn sunglam kizutna zosie hiet siengsahin, a khawdawh uh a kizutna themneng zosie khuo pulam nin buohna mun khatah buo ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in suong dangte la-in tua suongte munah a koi ding vua, a zutna dang khat la-in tua inn zut ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in suongte ladawhin a inn hiet siengin a zut sieng zaw ciengin tua inn sungah natna a tunkia leh,"},"44":{"text":"siempu pa pei-in cienvel ding hi; inn sung tengah tua natna a kizel zo tah leh, tua khu inn sunga om a zauhuoi phah natna ahi hi; tua pen a sieng lo ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in tua inn a suong a sing le a kizutna zosie phelsah ding a, khuo pulam nin buohna mun khatah a puosah ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua inn a kikha hun sunga a lut mi zosie nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi;"},"47":{"text":"tua inn sunga a lum mi zosie in a puonte a sawp sieng ding uhi; tua inn sunga anne zosie in zong a puonte a sawp sieng ding uhi."},"48":{"text":"Siempu pa pei-in a cienvel a, tua inn a kizut zaw ciengin natna a kizel nawn sih leh siempu pa in tua inn sieng hi, ci-in phuongzah ding hi; tua natna dam zo hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua inn siensuo nadingin ama in vata ni, taamtah sing le a ausan khau le hyssop na tawh lahtha-in,"},"50":{"text":"vatate lahah khat pen tua tuisieng tunga leibeel sungah that ding a,"},"51":{"text":"tua vata hinglai tawh taamtah sing, hyssop sing le a ausan khaute lahtha-in, tua tenga kigo vata’ si tawh tuisieng sungah die-in tua inn sagi vei the ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua bangin ama in vata’ si tawh, tuisieng tawh, vata hinglai tawh, taamtah sing, hyssop sing le a ausan puon tawh a inn siengthosah ding hi;"},"53":{"text":"tuale ama in khuopi pulam gamlahah tua vata hinglai hla ding hi; tuaci’n ama in tua inn adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding a, tua inn a sieng hi ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Tami khu phah natna khatpo tawh kisai sep ding ngaina ahi hi: Cithah ading,"},"55":{"text":"puonte le inn sunga om phah natnate ading,"},"56":{"text":"cibaw ahi sihle hima ahi sihle cikhangte ading,"},"57":{"text":"bang hun ciengin sieng lo a, bang hun ciengin sieng ahei ci-in khinkhai thei nading ahi hi.
