Tami khu phah natna tawh kisai bawldan ngaina ahi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin ci hi:","title":"Citung Pana Nin Luongkhiete"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite kungah tam bangin gen in: Pasal khatpo a pumpi panin a neitah tui a pei ciengin tua tui in ama a niehsah hi."},"3":{"text":"A neitah tui zieha a sienlona tambang ahi hi: A pumpi panin a neitah tui a pei a, a pumpi panin a neitah tui pei a khawl zongin ama adingin sienlona ma hi veve hi."},"4":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa’ lupna zosie a sieng lo hi ding hi; tuale ama’ tona sil zosie a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’ lupna a thamkha poma in a puonte sawp siengin tui sungah kisil ding a, nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa khat’ tona tunga a to kha zosie in a puonsilte uh a sawp sieng ding vua, amate zong tui sungah kisilin nitah dong a sieng lo hi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua a neitah tui a pei pa a thamkha mi poma in a puonsilte sawp sieng ding a, tui sungah kisilin nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa in a sieng mite tungah cil a siet leh amate in a puonsilte uh sawp siengin tui sungah a kisil ding vua, tuaci’n nitah dongin a sieng lo ahi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa’ tuonna sakolphaw khatpo zong a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama’ nei-a a om na khat popo a thamkha mi zosie pen nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding a, tua bang nate a puo kha zosie in a puonsilte sawp sieng ding a, tui sungah kisilin nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa in tui sungah a khut sil lopi-in a thamkhah mi zosie in a puonsilte uh a sawp sieng ding vua, tui sungah kisilin nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa in a thamkhah lei tawh a kibawl vanzah poma kitawkeh ding hi; sing tawh a kibawl vanzahte tui sungah kisawp ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A neitah tui pei pa khat a neitah tui luonna a sien ciengin, a sien nadingin ni sagi dong simto ding hi; ama in a puonte sawp ding a, tuisieng sungah kisilin ama a sieng hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in ama in vakhu ahi sihle paalva ni la-in kikhopna puonbuh lutna Topa mai-ah pei-in siempu pa kungah tuate pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Siempu pa in tuate, khat mawna biehna ding le adang khat meihal biehna-in pie ding hi; tuale siempu pa in a neitah peina ziehin Topa mai-ah thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khatpo in bawtui a te leh tui sungah kisil ding a, nitah dongin ama a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua bawtui tuhna puon ahi sihle savun zosie tui tawh kisawp ding a, nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasal khat numei khat tawh lumtonin a bawtui a te leh a ni gelin tui sungah a kisil ding vua, nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Numei khat in a pum tung pana a hun mana a nei a nin a pei ciengin, ni sagi sung a niehin om ding a, ama a thamkha popo nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A nin nei sungin a lupna na zosie a sieng lo hi ding hi; ama’ tona sil zosie zong a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ lupna a thamkha poma in a puonte sawp sieng ding a, tui sungah kisilin nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama’ tona a thamkha poma in a puonte sawp sieng ding a, tui sungah kisilin nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi;"},"23":{"text":"mi khatpo in ama’ lupna ahi sihle a tona na khatpo a thamkhah leh nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasal khatpo tua nu tawh lumtonin ama’ sienlona ama tunga a tun leh ni sagi sung ama a sieng lo hi ding hi; tuale ama’ lup khahna lupna zosie a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Numei khat in a nin nei hun sung hi lopi-in ni tampi sung a si pei ahi a, a nin pei hun valin nin a nei leh a nin nei ni hun sung teng ama a sieng lo hi ding hi; a nin pei hun sung bang ma-in ama a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A nin nei hun sung tungtawna a lupna zosie a nin nei sunga a lupna tawh kibangin kingaisun ding hi; a nin nei sungin a sieng lo ahi ma bangin a tona zosie zong a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tam nate a tham kha poma a sieng lo hi ding a, a puonte sawpin tui sungah kisil ding a, nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"A nin neina panin a sien leh ni sagi dong simto ding a, tua zaw ciengin ama a sieng hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in tua nu in gam vakhu ni ahi sihle paalva ni la-in, kikhopna puonbuh lutna siempu pa kungah peipi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Siempu pa in khat pen mawna biehna dingin pie ding a, a khat pen meihal biehna dingin pie ding hi; a nin neina hang tawh a sien lona ziehin siempu pa in Topa mai-ah tua nu adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bangin a laizang vua a om ka biehbuh a buasah ziehun, a sien lona uh sungah a si lo nadingun a sien lona panun Israel mite na tuomkoi ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tami khu a neitah tui peite dinga bawldan ngaina ahi hi: Bawtui a te zieha a sieng lo a suoh mipa ading,"},"33":{"text":"tua nu a nin nei huna thazawm hun sung ading, a neitah tui a luong numei le pasal a koimapo ading, le a sieng lo numei tawh a lumton mipa ading ahi hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron’ tapa nite in Topa mai nehin a silaw zaw cieng gelin Topa in Moses hopi hi.","title":"Thoidamna Ni"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah gen hi: Thuciemna singkuong tunga hepina topha mai, dalna puon sunglam siengtho munah a nop hunhuna ang mawh pei lo nadingin na sanggampa Aaron kungah gen in. Ang mawh pei leh a si ding hi; azieh pen tua hepina topha tunga meiilum lahah keima ka kilaa hi.","ref":"Heb 6:19"},"3":{"text":"Mun siengtho sungah Aaron ang lut dan ding tam bang ahi hi: Mawna zieha biehna dingin bawngtangno khat le meihal biehna dingin tuutang khat tawh ang lut ding hi.","ref":"Heb 9:7"},"4":{"text":"Ama in a siengtho saihadiel puontungsil sil ding a, a pumpi tungah saihadiel bawngbi tengin saihadiel kawngga tawh kigah ding a, saihadiel dielpi khim ding hi. Tam teng pen a siengtho puonte ahi hi. Tui sungah ama kipumsil ding a, tua ciengin tua puonte sil ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Israel mihonte kung panin mawna zieha biehna dingin keeltang ni le meihal biehna dingin tuutang ni la ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aaron in amama adingin mawna zieha biehna-in bawngtang khat pie-in, ama le a innkuonpite adingin thoidamna bawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in keel ni la-in kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah koi ding hi;"},"8":{"text":"Aaron in tua keel tegel tungah ai sanin, khat pen Topa ading, adang khat pen Azazel ading ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa ading aai a tuhna keel pen Aaron in peipi-in mawna zieha biehna-in pie ding hi;"},"10":{"text":"ahi vangin Azazel dinga ai a tuhna keel pen gamlahah Azazel kungah sawl dawhin thoidamna a kibawl thei nadingin Topa mai-ah a hingin kipeipi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aaron in amama adingin mawna zieha biehna-in bawngtang khat pie-in, ama le a innkuonpite adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi; amama adingin zong mawna zieha biehna-in bawngtang go ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in Topa mai maitam panin meikam a dim meiluona kuong khat le, a kigawtvui gimnamtui khutdim ni la-in dalna puon sungah peipi ding a,"},"13":{"text":"gimnamtui khu in thuciemna singkuong tunga om hepina topha a tuom thei nadingin Topa mai-a mei tungah tua gimnamtui koi ding hi. Tua banga a bawl sih leh ama si ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in bawngtang si kimkhat la-in, a khutme tawh hepina topha a mailam tungah the ding a, hepina topha mai-ah a khutme tawh sagi vei the ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in mite adingin mawna zieha biehna keel go-in dalna puon sungah a si peipi ding a, bawngsi a the ma bangin a si the-in hepina topha tung le hepina topha mai-ah the ding hi.","ref":"Heb 9:12"},"16":{"text":"Ama in tua bangin Israel mite’ sienlona, amau’ thupalsatna, le amau’ mawna teng zosie ziehin mun siengtho adingin thoidamna bawl ding a, amau’ sienlona laizanga amate tawh a om den kikhopna puonbuh adingin tam bang ma-in bawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mun siengtho sungah thoidamna bawl dingin a lut huna kipanin ama ading, a innkuonpite ading, le a kikhawm Israel mihon zosie adingin thoidamna a bawl zaw a pusuokia masangsie, kikhopna puonbuh sungah koima om thei lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa mai-a a om maitam-ah pei-in maitam siensuona bawl ding a, bawngtang si le keelsi kimkhat la-in maitam kimvela om a kite nu ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in tua tungah a si kimkhat a khutme tawh sagi vei the-in siensuo ding a, Israel mite’ sienlona panin siengthosah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in siengtho mun le kikhopna puonbuh le maitamte adingin thoidamna a bawlpieh zaw ciengin keel hinglai peipi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron in a hinglai keel lu tungah a khutgel ngam ding a, Israel mite’ khielna zosie, amau’ thupalsatnate zosie, amau’ mawnate zosie le amau’ khielna zosie thumpieh ding a, keel lu tungah tua teng suonin tuami nasep sem dinga a kisesa mi khatin gamlahah tua keel heumang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua keel in a tungah amau’ khielna zosie puo-in gammang tulahah pei ding hi; tuale gampa lahah a keel kihla ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin kikhopna puonbuh sungah lut ding a, mun siengtho a lut masah lai-a a sil saihadiel puonte sutdawhin tua munah nuasie ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 44:19"},"24":{"text":"Ama in mun siengtho khatah tui tawh kipumsilin a puonte sil ding hi; tua ciengin pusuohin a meihal biehna le mite’ meihal biehna pie-in, ama ading le mite adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in maitam tungah mawna zieha biehna thau haltum ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Azazel kunga keel a hlapa in a puonte sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, tua zaw ciengin giephuol zuon thei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Siengtho munah thoidamna dinga a si kipeipi ahi mawna zieha biehna bawngtang le khielna zieha biehna keelte pen giephuol pulamah kipeipi ding hi; a vunte, a telte le a ehte mei tawh kihaltum ding hi.","ref":"Heb 13:11"},"28":{"text":"Tuate a halpa in a puonte sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, tua zaw ciengin giephuol lam zuon thei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami khu note dingin tawntung thukham hi ding hi: Hla sagina, tua hla a ni sawm ni-in, no le no kidehin tuolsung mi hile na lah vua ang pem khuolmi hile bangma na sem sih ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen tuami ni-in na sien nadingun thoidamna kibawl ding hi; Topa mai-ah na mawna zosie panun na sieng ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tam pen note dinga a bukim tawlngahna Sabbath ahi a, no le no na kideh ding uhi; tua khu tawntung thukham ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"A pa tangin siempu dingin sathau kinu-in a kisudet siempu pa in a siengtho saihadiel puon silin thoidamna bawl ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in mun siengtho adingin thoidamna bawl ding a, kikhopna puonbuh le maitam adingin zong thoidamna bawlin, siempute ading le a kikhawm mihonte zosie adingin zong thoidamna bawl ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tami khu kum khatin khatvei amau’ mawna vannuoi ziehin Israel mite adingin thoidamna bawl nadinga a kizang den ding ngaina kip ahi hi. Topa’ thupiehsa bangin Moses in a bawl hi.","ref":"Siem 23:26-32; Gam 29:7-11"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses a hopi hi:","title":"Ganhingte Kigawna"},"2":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate le Israel mite zosie tungah tam bangin gen in: Tam pen Topa ang thupiehsa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel innkuonte khatpo in bawngtang hile, tuuno hile, keel hile, giephuol sungah ahi a, giephuol pulamah ahi zongin a gaw a,"},"4":{"text":"Topa’ biehbuh mai-a Topa kungah biehna khat ahi dingin kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah tuate a peipi sih leh, ama in tua sisan a luongsah khielna a lukhuh ding hi; ama in si luongsah zo ahi ziehin a mite lah panin ama kihemkhie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam pen Israel mite in gamlaha a pieh uh amau’ biehnate a peipi thei nading uh, kikhopna puonbuh lutna-a Topa tung ahi, siempu pa tungah tuate a peipi thei nading ule thunuom biehna-in Topa kungah biehpiehnate a tawi thei nading uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempu pa in kikhopna puonbuh lutna, Topa’ maitam tungah a si the-in Topa tunga a gimnamtui dingin a thau hal ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a mawpi uh, a bieh uh keel-dawite adingin kithoina a bawl nawn sih ding uhi. Tami khu amate dingin a khantan vua ngaina kip khat hi zing ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate kungah tam bangin na genbe ding hi: Israel innkuonte lah panin hile amate lahah a teng pemtate kung panin hile, meihal biehna ahi sihle biehpiehna a pie mi khatpo in"},"9":{"text":"Topa tunga pieh dingin kikhopna puonbuh lutna-a ang peipi sih leh, a mite lah panin tua pa kihemkhie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel innkuonte lah pan hile amate lahah a teng pemtate lah pan hile, mi khat in si khatpo a neh leh, tuami si a ne mipa tungah ka maigum ding a, mite lah panin ama ka hemkhie ding hi.","title":"Si Neh ding Kikhaam","ref":"Pien 9:4; Siem 7:26-27; 19:26; Thkna 12:16, 23; 15:23"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen si sungah tahsa hinna a om hi; maitam tungah note dingin thoidamna bawl nadingin na tung vuah tua si kang pie zo hi; bang ding ahei cile si pen mi khat a hinna thei nadinga thoidamna bawlna ding ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 9:22"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel mite tungah tam bangin ka gen zo hi: Note lahah koima in si ne lo ding a, note lahah a teng pemtate khatpo in zong tuami si ne lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi khatpo in hile, note lahah ang teng pemtate lahah khatpo in hile, a gamvana-ah a kine thei gamsa khat ahi sihle a kine thei vata khat a mat leh a si hlawhin leivui tawh vuatha ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinna a nei ganhing zosie adingin a si khu a hinna ahi hi; tua ziehin keima in Israel mite tungah ka gen zo hi: Ganhing khatpo’ si na ne sih ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile ganhing zosie’ hinna pen a si ahi hi; tua si a ne poma kihemkhie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A mawh si hile gamsate in a na ehmalsa ganhingte hile a ne mi poma, tuolsung mi hile pemtate hile a puonte sawpin tui sungah kisil ding a, nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding hi; tua ciengin a sieng hi ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a puon uh sawp loin ahi a, kisil loin ahi zongin a op uleh amau’ khielna a lukhuh ding uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in gen hi:","title":"Numei-pasal Luptonna"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite kungah tam bangin gen in: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Na tenna uh Egypt leitanga a teng mite’ gamtat bangin na gamta sih ding vua, kang peipi nading Canaan leitanga a teng mite’ gamtat bangin zong na gamta sih ding uhi. A thukhamte uzong na zui sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka biehna ngaina kipte na tang ding vua, ka thukhamte na zui ding uhi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka thukhamte le ka biehna ngaina kipte na zui ding uhi; tua banga a zui pa khu a hing ding hi: Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Neh 9:29; Ezk 18:9; 20:11-13; Luk 10:28; Rom 10:5; Gal 3:12"},"6":{"text":"Note koima in luppi dingin na kinaipi uh tanaute khatpo na nai sih ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Na nu na luppi ziehin na pa na mindaisah sih ding hi; ama na nu ahi ziehin na luppi sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na pa zi’ na luppi sih ding hi; tua khu na pa’ mindai nading ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 20:11; Thkna 22:30; 27:20"},"9":{"text":"Tuol sunga suoh ahi a, khuol gama suoh ahi zongin, na sanggamnu, na pa’ tanu, ahi sihle na nu’ tanute na luppi sih ding hi.","ref":"Siem 20:17; Thkna 27:22"},"10":{"text":"Na tapa’ tanu ahi sihle na tanu’ tanute na luppi sih ding hi, azieh pen amau’ maizumna pen nangma’ maizumna veve ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Na pa pana a pieng, na pa’ zi tanu na luppi sih ding hi. Azieh pen ama na sanggam nu ahi bo hi."},"12":{"text":"Na pa’ sanggamnu na luppi sih ding hi; ama nu pen na pa’ si le sa ahi bo hi."},"13":{"text":"Na nu’ sanggamnu na luppi sih ding hi, azieh pen ama na nu’ cilesa ahi bo hi."},"14":{"text":"Na pa’ sanggampa na luppi sih ding hi; tua pen ama’ zi na nai sih ding hi, a ci nopna ahi hi; ama pen na innlah nu ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 20:19-20"},"15":{"text":"Na monu na luppi sih ding hi: Ama na tapa’ zi ahi hi; ama na luppi sih ding hi.","ref":"Siem 20:12"},"16":{"text":"Na sanggampa’ zi na luppi sih ding hi; tua khu na sanggampa’ mindaina ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 20:21"},"17":{"text":"Numei khat le a tanu na luppi sih ding a, luppi dingin tua numei’ tapa’ tanu ahi sihle a tanu’ tanute na la sih ding hi.; amate nangma’ cilesa ahi bo vua, tua banga gamtatna pen gamtat sietna ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 20:14; Thkna 27:23"},"18":{"text":"A sanggamnu suon dingin na nuphal nu zi-in na la sih ding a, a sanggamnu hin lai pima-in ama na luppi sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Numei khat a nin pei-in a sien lo laitahin luppi dingin na neh sih ding hi.","ref":"Siem 20:18"},"20":{"text":"Na sanggampa’ zi na luppi sih ding a, tua nu tawh na kibuasah sih ding hi.","ref":"Siem 20:10"},"21":{"text":"A kithoi nadingun Molech tungah na suon na hlahte khatpo na pie sih ding a, Pasien’ min na daisah sih ding hi. Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Siem 20:1-5"},"22":{"text":"Numei khat tawh na lupton bangin pasal khat tawh na lumton sih ding hi; tua khu sil kidahhuoi ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 20:13"},"23":{"text":"Ganhing khatpo tawh maw-in tua tawh na kibuasah sih ding a, numei khatpo in zong ganhing khatpo mawpi dingin ama’ pumpi a pie sih ding hi; tua khu piensuolna ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 22:19; Siem 20:15-16; Thkna 27:21"},"24":{"text":"Tam teng khatpo tawh noma le noma na kibuasah sih un, azieh pen na masang vua ka nawdawh minamte in tam bang gamtatna zosie tawh amau le amau a kibuasah uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua bangin leitang a bua a suoh hi; tuale khielna ziehin tua leitang dan ka pie ding a, leitang in ama tunga a teng mite a luokhie hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanle na lah vua a teng tuolsung mi hile pemtate hile ka thukhamte le ka biehna ngaina kipte na zui ding uhi,"},"27":{"text":"(azieh pen na masang vua a om tuolsung mite in a kidahhuoi tam nate zosie a sem vua, tuaci’n leitang a bua ahi ta hi);"},"28":{"text":"tua bang ahi sihle ama na buasah ziehun na masang vua minamte a luohkhiet bangin leitang in note ang luokhie ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen tam kidahhuoi nate a sem poma a mite lah panin kinotmang ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n na mai vua kizang tam a kidahhuoi khatpo na sepkhah lo nading ule tuate tawh na kibuasah lo nadingun kang thuhil zui un: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin ci hi:","title":"Siengtho Gamtatna ding Ngainate"},"2":{"text":"Israel mihonte zosie tam bangin hopi in: Note na siengtho ding uhi, azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien uh ka siengtho hi.","ref":"Siem 11:44-45; 1Pet 1:16"},"3":{"text":"Note khat ciet in na nu le na pa zatahin ka Sabbath-te na tang ding uhi. Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Pei 20:8, 12; Thkna 5:12, 16"},"4":{"text":"Milimte lamah kihei sih unlen, noma dingin a kisungtawm pasien-te bawl sih un: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Siem 26:1; Pei 20:23; 34:17; Thkna 27:15"},"5":{"text":"Topa tungah thunuom biehna na pieh ciengun, note tangin tuate a kisan thei nadingin tam bang danin pie un."},"6":{"text":"Na pieh ni ma uh ahi sihle a zing ciengin kine ding hi; a ni thum ni donga a kine lo a val poma mei tawh kihal ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in a kineh lai leh tua pen a kidahhuoi ahi hi; tua pen kisang lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua a ne mi zosie in mawna dan thuoh ding uhi. Azieh pen amate in Topa tunga sil siengtho pen a niehsah zo ahi ta vua, tua bang mi poma a mite sung panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na leitang tung panun an na lah ciengun na lo gei dongun na la sih ding vua, na ansangh uzong na khawm sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na lengga lo vuah lenggate na lo sieng sih ding vua, tuola a kie lenggate zong na tung sih ding uhi; mizawngte le pemtate adingin tuate na nuasiepieh ding uhi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Siem 23:22; Thkna 24:19-22"},"11":{"text":"Na guta sih ding uhi; a man loin zong na gamta sih ding vua, khatlekhat na kisol sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:15-16; Thkna 5:19-20"},"12":{"text":"A man loin ka min tawh na kiciem sih ding vua, na Pasien uh’ min na daisah sih ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Pei 20:7; Thkna 5:11; Mat 5:33"},"13":{"text":"Na vengte na sol sih ding uhi; na guta sih ding uhi; noma dingin zingmawng cieng dongin nasem khat’ thaman na kem sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 24:14-15"},"14":{"text":"Bilbingte hamsiet loin mittawte mai-ah a suikhah ding nate na koi sih ding uhi; na Pasien na zatah ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:18"},"15":{"text":"A dih lo thukhenna na nei sih ding uhi; mizawngte deisah tuom loin miliente na mai-et tuom sih ding uhi: thuman tawh na vengte thu na khen ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:6-8; Thkna 16:19"},"16":{"text":"Na mite lah vuah mi gensiete bangin suhva tova sih unlen, na vengte’ sisan tawh phattuom na sui sih ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Na lungtang sung vuah na tanaute khatpo na muda sih ding uhi; na vengte thu na hil ding uhi, tua hi sihle ama’ khielna na puo ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 18:15"},"18":{"text":"Na mite uh khatpo tungah phu la loin na kilungsimpuoh sih ding vua, noma na ki-it bangun na vengte na it ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Mat 5:43; 19:19; 22:39; Mrk 12:31; Luk 10:27; Rom 13:9; Gal 5:14; Jas 2:8"},"19":{"text":"Ka thukhamte na zui ding uhi. Namdangte tawh na gante uh ta na neisah sih ding uhi; na lo vuah khaici nam ni na vaw sih ding uhi; khau nam ni tawh a kigan puon zong na sil sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 22:9-11"},"20":{"text":"Pasal khat in midang khat tawh kikhamsa hi napi a kitan nai lo ahi sihle suotahna kipie nai lo sila nu khat a luppi leh thukanna kinei ding hi. Tua nu suohta nai lo ahi ziehin amate kithat lo ding hi;"},"21":{"text":"hizongle tua pa in amama adingin khielna zieha biehna dingin tuutang khat, kikhopna puonbuh lutna Topa kungah peipi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Siempu pa in ama’ bawlsa mawna dingin khielna biehna tuutang tawh Topa mai-ah ama adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding hi; tuale a bawlsa a mawna kimaisah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Khum gamah lutin neh dingin singkung namcin na suon ciengun tua singgate a kikham bangin na ngaisun ding uhi; note dingin tua singgate kum thum sung kikham ding a, kine lo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A kum lina ciengin a ga zosie lungdamna biehna-in Topa tungah kituomkoi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kum ngana ciengin note dinga tuate ang ga semsem nadingin a gate na ne thei ding uhi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"26":{"text":"Na khatpopo a si tawh na neton sih ding uhi. Mailam thugen kholna ahi sihle aisanna na nei sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 9:4; Siem 7:26-27; 17:10-14; Thkna 12:16, 23; 15:23; 18:10"},"27":{"text":"Na lu kimvelin na sam uh heusieng loin na khamul mongte uzong na tan sih ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Misite adingin na citung uh liemsah loin na ci tung vuah ciemtena khatpo na sun sih ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Siem 21:5; Thkna 14:1"},"29":{"text":"Gam sung pahtatna suohin gamtat sietnate tawh a kidim lo nadingin pahtatna tawh na tanute na daisah sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 23:17"},"30":{"text":"Ka Sabbath-te na tang ding vua, ka mun siengtho na zatah ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Siem 26:2"},"31":{"text":"Dawilawm neite le bumtawite lamah kihei sih un; amate tawh a kibuasah dingin amate sui sih un: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:11; 1Sam 28:3; 2Kum 23:4; Isa 8:19"},"32":{"text":"Khanghamte mai-ah dingin putehte’ maitang na zatah ding uhi; na Pasien uh na zatah ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"33":{"text":"Na gam sung vuah pemta khat tawh na tenton ciengun tua pemta pa na gawt sih ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Na tentonpi uh pemta khat pen note dingin tuolsung mi hi ding hi; noma bangin pemtate na it ding uhi, azieh pen no zong Egypt gamah pemta na hi ngai uh: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Pei 22:21; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"35":{"text":"A sau tena, a gih tena, ahi sihle a nem tenate-ah a man lo zangin mi na sol sih ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tawikhaina a man, tawisuong a man, ephah a man, hin a mante na nei ding uhi: Egypt gam pana note ang peipi keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:13-16; Pau 20:10; Ezk 45:10"},"37":{"text":"Ka thukham zosie le ka biehna ngaina kipte zosie zui-in tuate na tang ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin ci hi:","title":"Siengthona Palsat Zieha Thuoh ding Daante"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite kungah tam bangin genbe lai in: Israel mite khatpo hile Israel gam sunga a teng pemtate hile, Molech tunga a tate khatpo a pie mipa kithat ding hi; gam sung mite in suong tawh seplia ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Molech tungah a tate pie a, ka mun siengtho buasahin ka min siengtho a daisah ziehin, kei mama in amate ka maisiet ding a, mite lah panin amate ka hemkhie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Molech tungah a tate a pieh ciengun gamsung mite in amate a mu lo kipangin tua pa a tha sih uleh,"},"5":{"text":"kei mama in amate le a innkuonpite ka maisiet ding a, Molech tunga a pahtatna vuah amate a zui mi zosie a mite lah panun ka hemkhie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Dawilawm neite le bumtawite lamah mi khatpo kihei-in tuate thu a dawh leh, keima in tua pa ka maisiet ding a, mite lah panin ama ka hemkhie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin no le no ki-ap unlen siengtho un. Azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thukhamte zui unlen tuate tang un; Keima Topa ka hi hi; keima in note kang siengthosah hi."},"9":{"text":"A pa ahi sihle a nu a samsie poma kithat ding hi; a pa ahi sihle a nu a samsiet zo tah ziehun amate tungah amau’ sisan tu ding hi.","ref":"Pei 21:17; Mat 15:4; Mrk 7:10"},"10":{"text":"Pasal khat in a vengpa’ zi tawh ang a kikawm leh, angkawm nu le awngkawm pa a ni gelin kithat ding hi.","ref":"Pei 20:14; Siem 18:20; Thkna 5:18"},"11":{"text":"A pa’ zi tawh a lumton mipa in a pa’ min daisah ahi hi; a ni gel in kithat ding hi; ama gel’ sisan luonna khu ama gel tung ma-ah tu hi.","ref":"Siem 18:8; Thkna 22:30; 27:20"},"12":{"text":"A monu tawh pasal khat a lupton leh a nipi-in ama gel kithat ding hi; ama gel a piensuol ahi vua, ama gel’ sisan luonna ama gel tung ma-ah tu hi.","ref":"Siem 18:15"},"13":{"text":"Pasal khat in numei a luppi ma bangin pasal khat a luppi leh a ni gelin a kidahhuoi khat bawl ahi uhi; ama gel kithat ding hi; ama gel’ sisan luonna pen ama gel ma tungah tu ding hi.","ref":"Siem 18:22"},"14":{"text":"Pasal khat in a zi dingin numei khat a lah a, a nu tawh zong a lahton leh tua khu gamtatsietna ahi hi; na lah vuah gamtatsietna a ven thei nadingin tua pa le ama gel mei tawh kihaltum ding hi.","ref":"Siem 18:17; Thkna 27:23"},"15":{"text":"Pasal khat in ganhing khat a luppi leh ama kithat ding hi; a ganhing zong na that ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Numei khat in ganhing khatpo nehin tua ganhing a luppi leh tua numei le ganhing na that ding uhi; amate kithat ding a, a sisan uh pen amau’ tung ma-ah tu ding hi.","ref":"Pei 22:19; Siem 18:23; Thkna 27:21"},"17":{"text":"Pasal khat in ama’ sanggamnu, ahi sihle a pa’ tanu, ahi sihle a nu’ tanu la-in tua nu a luppi a, tua nu in zong tua pa a luppi leh tua khu muolphona ahi a, a mite’ muna pan amate kihemkhie ding hi; ama in a sanggamnu a luppi zo tah leh ama in dan a thuoh ding hi.","ref":"Siem 18:9; Thkna 27:22"},"18":{"text":"Pasal khat, nin nei numei khat tawh lumtonin tua nu a mawpi leh tua pa in tua nu’ si luonna a dawhsah a suoh a, tua nu in zong tua pa’ si luonna a dawhsah ma ahi hi; a mite sung panun a nipi-in ama gel kihemkhie ding hi.","ref":"Siem 18:19"},"19":{"text":"Na nu’ sanggamnu ahi sihle na pa’ sanggamnu na luppi sih ding uhi; tua khu ama’ tanaute tawh mawna ahi ziehin a amau’ mawna amate ma in khu ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Pasal khat in a pa’ sanggampa’ zi tawh a lupton leh ama in a pa’ sanggampa a mindaisah ahi hi; ama gel in mawna dan a thuoh ding uhi; hlah le suon nei loin a si ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:12-14"},"21":{"text":"Pasal khat in a sanggampa’ zi a lah leh tua pen siengtho lona ahi hi; a sanggampa a mindaisah ahi hi; ama gel in suon le hlah a nei sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:16"},"22":{"text":"Kang peipi nading gam in ang luohkhiet lo nadingin ka thukham zosie le ka biehna ngaina kipte zosie zui-in na tang ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Na masang vua ka delmang ding minamte’ ngainate na zui sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate in tam na zosie a bawl ziehun amate ka kidah hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin na kung vuah kang gen zo hi: A leitang uh na luo ding vua, keima in noma’ nei dingun bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna leitang kang pie ding hi. Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi; mite lah panin note kang khenkhie zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ganhing a siengte, ganhing a sieng lote, le va a sieng le a sieng lote na khen ding uhi; note in in nieh hi, ci-in na se ding vua ka koisa ganhing hile va hile leitunga a vah ganhing khatpo tawh hile a kidahhuoi-in na om sih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Keima adingin na siengtho uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa ahi keima ka siengtho a, keima-a’ na hi thei nadingun mite lah panin kang tuomkoi zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin dawilawm nei mi ahi sihle bumtawi mi poma kithat ding hi; suong tawh amate kiseplia ding a, amau’ sisan pen amate tung ma-ah tu hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi: Aaron’ tapa siempute hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: A unau sanggamte lahah a koima in misi khat po,","title":"Siempute’ Sienthona"},"2":{"text":"a kinaipi pente ahi, a nu, a pa, a tapa, a tanu, a sanggampa-te hang ci simlo ama le ama kibuasah lo ding hi;"},"3":{"text":"tua ma bangin a sanggam nungah nu hangin ama kibuasah thei ding hi, azieh pen tua nu in pasal a nei lo ziehin ama tawh kinai ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a mite lahah mi khat’ pasal khat bangin ama le ama kibuasah loin kimindaisah lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A lutung vuah a behkieu mun a bawl sih ding vua, a khamul mong uzong tantom loin a ci tung vuah liemma themkhat zong a bawl sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:27-28; Thkna 14:1"},"6":{"text":"A Pasien tung vuah a siengtho ding vua, a Pasien uh’ min a daisah sih ding uhi; azieh pen amate in a Pasien’ uh an ahi mei tawh Topa’ biehna a pie uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate a siengtho ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in numei pahtat ahi sihle numei a buasate a kinunpi thei sih ding uhi; a pasal in a khulsa numei zong a kinunpi sih ding uhi. Azieh pen amau’ Pasien adingin siempute a siengtho uhi,"},"8":{"text":"tuale amate in na Pasien uh’ an a pieh ziehun amate a siengtho-in na ngaisun ding uhi; Note ang siengsah pa, Topa ahi keima ka sientho ziehin note dingin amate siengtho ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Siempu khatpo’ tanu in a pahtatna tawh ama le ama a kidaisah leh a pa daisah ahi hi; ama nu mei tawh kihaltum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A guolte lah panin a kitawisang, a lu tunga sathau siengtho kibuoh, le a puonte sil dinga a ki-apsa siempu pa in a sam paw loin koi lo ding a, a puonsilte zong ehsah lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi siluong opna munah ama pei lo ding hi; a nu ahi sihle a pa luong nangawn tawh ama le ama kibuasah lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mun siengtho pulamah pusuoh loin a Pasien’ mun siengtho zong daisah lo ding hi; azieh pen ama tungah Pasien-a’ ahi suhdetna sathau a om hi. Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama pen ngahnu siengtho numei beh tawh kinung ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in meigong, ahi sihle a kikhulsa numei, ahi sihle a buasa numei, le a pahtat numei, tam teng tawh kinung lo ding hi. A tanaute lah panin ngahnu siengtho khat tawh kinung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khu ama in a tanaute lahah ama’ suonlehlahte a daisah lo nading ahi hi; azieh pen ama a siengsah pa keima Topa ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"17":{"text":"Aaron hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: A khang khanga na suonlehlahte lahah poina a nei mi koima in an pie dingin a Pasien neh thei lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen poina a nei mittaw ahi sihle khelbai, ahi sihle maihem ahi sihle khut le keng a behsau,"},"19":{"text":"khut tawng keng tawng,"},"20":{"text":"ahi sihle ngumbaw, ahi sihle mitun cing lo, ahi sihle mit hem, ahi sihle cithah vei, ahi sihle hima nei, ahi sihle a cilkeh poma in ei neh thei lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Aaron siempu pa’ suonlehlahte sung panin Topa’ meihal biehna pie dingin a nai-ah koima pei lo ding hi; tua pa pen poina nei ahi ziehin a Pasien’ an pie dingin a nai-ah pei lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in a Pasien’ anlum, a siengtho pente le a siengtho nate ne thei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in poina a nei ziehin ka mun siengthote a daisah lo nadingin dalna puon ahi sihle maitam lamah pei thei lo ding hi, bang ding ahei cile keima Topa ka hi hi; keima in amate ka siengsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangin Moses in Aaron le a tapate le Israel mi zosie kungah a gen hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"A Siengtho Biehnate Zahna"},"2":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in ka min siengtho a daisah lo nadingun Israel mite in keima tunga ang pieh a siengtho silpiehte a zatah siem nadingun hil in; keima Topa ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate kungah tam bangin gen in: Na khang tawntungun na suonlehlahte uh mi khatpo in a sien lo laitahin, Topa tunga Israel mite pieh ahi silpieh siengtho nate a nai leh ka opna panin keima in tua pa ka hemkhie ding hi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aaron’ suonlehlahte lah panin phah natna vei ahi sihle a neitah tuiluong khatpo in ama a sientho masangsie tua a siengtho nate ne thei lo ding hi. Misi a tham zieha a sieng lo poma, a bawtui luon zieha a sieng lo poma,"},"5":{"text":"ama a bua thei nadinga a bawhva ganhing khat a tham poma, ama’ sien lona pen bang bang hi tale,"},"6":{"text":"tua bang na khatpo a tham pa pen nitah dongin a sieng lo hi ding a, tui sungah a kipumsil sih leh ama in tua a siengtho nate a ne sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ni a tum ciengin ama a sieng hi ding hi; tua zaw ciengin ama in a siengtho nate ne thei ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama’ an tuate ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in sapul sa ahi sihle gamsate’ pelup sa ne lo ding a, tua tawh ama a sieng lo a kisuohsah sih ding hi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in khielna bawlin mun siengtho a buasah ziehun tua sungah a si lo nadingun ka thuhilte a zui ding uhi. Amate a siengsah pa khu keima Topa ka hi hi."},"10":{"text":"A pulam mi in silpieh siengthote ne thei lo ding hi. Siempu pa’ inna om pemtate in hile, a kiguoi tengtate in hile tua silpieh siengthote a ne thei sih ding uh;."},"11":{"text":"ahi vangin siempu khat in a sum tawh mi khatpo a lei leh tua pa in tuate ne thei ding a, a inn sunga a suoh mite in ama’ an a ne thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Siempupa’ tanu khat in a pulam mi khat a kinunpi leh tua nu in silpieh siengthote ne thei lo ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"ahi vangin siempupa’ tanu pen suonlehlah nei loin meigong ahi sihle a kikhul ahi a, a ngahnut lai ma bangin phungkia-in a pa’ inn a zotkia leh tua nu in a pa’ an ne thei ding hi. A pulam mi in tua an ne thei lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in tupna nei loin silpieh siengtho a neh khah leh ama in a na manza’ senga lahah sekhat belapin, siempu pa tungah silpieh siengtho pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa tunga a pieh uh Israel mite’ silpieh siengthote koima in buasah lo ding a,"},"16":{"text":"tua a siengtho silpiehte nehna ziehin amate in khielna zieha biehna pieh ding kisam za dongin tua khielna a puosah sih ding hi: Azieh pen keima Topa ka hi hi; keima in amate ka siengsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Santhei Biehnate"},"18":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate le Israel mi zosie hopi inlen a kung vuah tam bangin gen in: Israel innkuonte lahah hile, Israel gam sunga a teng pemtate lahah hile, mi khatpo in Topa tungah kiciemna ahi sihle nop thu-a biehna ahi meihal biehna a pieh ciengin,"},"19":{"text":"tuate ang kisanpieh thei nadingin bawngtang hile tuu hile keel hile genbaang lo apa khat na pie ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Genbaang khatpo na pie sih ding uhi. Azieh pen note dingin tuate kisang lo ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:1"},"21":{"text":"Mi khatpo in a kiciemna khat ahi sihle nop thu-a a biehna khat a tangtun thei nadingin bawnghon pan hile, tuu le keel hon pan hile Topa tungah thunuoma biehpiehna khat a pieh ciengin a kisan thei nadingin a ganhing pen a bukim hi ding hi; paubaanna om lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa tungah ganhing a mittaw, ahi sihle a liem, ahi sihle a gutawng, ahi sihle hima nai nei, ahi sihle cithah vei ahi sihle hima pawn neite na pie sih ding vua, ahi sihle meihal biehna dingin maitam tungah tuate khatpo na koi sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Nopthu-a biehna dingin bawngtang khat ahi sihle a keng tuomsau ahi sihle a keng tuomtom tuu khat na pie thei ding uhi; ahi vangin kiciemna dingin tuate kisang lo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa tungah a ciltang liemsa ahi sihle a ciltang kitawkehsa ahi sihle a ki-atkhesa, ahi sihle a kiladawhsa ganhing khatpo na pie sih ding vua, na gam sung vuah tua bangin na bawl sih ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh tunga an tawh silpieh dingin gamdang mi khatpo kung pana kinga ganhingte na sang sih ding uh;. azieh pen amate genbaangin melsie uh ahi ziehin note dingin tuate kisang lo ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin ci hi:"},"27":{"text":"Bawng khat ahi sihle tuu khat ahi sihle keel khat a suo ciengin a nu tawh ni sagi sung omton ding a, a ni giet ni panin tua ganno pen Topa kungah mei tawh a kihal biehna dingin kisang thei ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin bawnghon lah panin hile, tuu le keelhon lah panin hile, api pen a tasen tawh ni khat thu-in na goton sih ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Lungdamkona silpieh ahi biehpiehna na lui ciengun, note tanga ang kisan thei nadingin Topa tungah tua biehpiehna na pie ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Khumi ni ma-in tuate kine ding hi; zingmawng dongin khat beh na hen si ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin ka thupiehte zui-in na tang ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel mite lahah ei kisiensah thei nadingin ka min siengtho na daisah sih ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi; keima in note ka siengsah hi,"},"33":{"text":"na Pasien uh ahi dingin Egypt gam panin ang peipi pa keima ka hi hi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"A Kise Pawite (Gam 28:16–29:40)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: A siengtho biehpieh kikhopnate ahi hi, ci-in na tangtawh ding uh a kisesa Topa’ pawite tam teng ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ni guh sungin nasep kizo ding hi; hizongle a ni sagi ni pen a bukim tawlngahna Sabbath, a siengtho biehpieh kikhopna ahi hi; note in na na sem sih ding uhi: tua khu na tenna zosie vuah Topa dinga Sabbath ahi hi.","title":"Sabbath, Peisan Pawi, le Tol Saw lo Anlum","ref":"Pei 20:8-10; 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Thkna 5:12-14"},"4":{"text":"Tam teng pen a kise Topa’ pawite, amate dingin a kise huna na bawlpieh ding uh a siengtho biehpieh kikhopnate ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A hla masa, tua hla a ni sawm le ni li ni a nitah lamin Topa tungah peisan pawi biehna om ding a,","ref":"Pei 12:1-13; Thkna 16:1-2"},"6":{"text":"tua hla a ni sawm le ni nga ni pen Topa tungah tol saw lo anlum pawi ahi hi; ni sagi sung tol saw lo anlum na ne ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in a siengtho biehpieh kikhop khat na nei ding vua, leitung nate na sem sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen note in Topa tungah ni sagi sung meihal biehna na pie ding uhi; a ni sagi ni-in siengtho biehpieh kikhop khat om ding hi: note in leitung nate na sem sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:14-20; 23:15; 34:18; Thkna 16:3-8"},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi hi:","title":"Gamasate tawh Biehna"},"10":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Keima in na tung vua kang pieh ding gamah lutin bu na at ciengun siempu pa kungah na buphai at masa pen uh na tawi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"San thei-a na op nadingun Topa mai-ah ama in tua buphai vei ding a, sabbath zaw a zing ciengin siempu pa in tua buphai a vei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Buphai na vei ni-un Topa tungah meihal biehna dingin tuuno apa khat Topa na pie ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua tawh kipiehtha ding an tawh biehna dingin sathau kisawsa annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-seni hi ding hi; tua khu Topa kipie a gimnamtui ding meihal biehna ahi hi; tua tawh a kipiehtha ding dawn thei biehna dingin lenggazu hin khat’ seli-suo- sekhat hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na Pasien uh’ biehna na tawi masang uh, tua ni masangin anlum ahi sihle a ki-em an ahi sihle ansielte na ne sih ding uhi: Tua khu na tenna mun vannuoi vuah na khang tawntung vua na zui ding uh ngaina khat hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Sabbath ni zaw ciengin a kivei biehna dingin buphai na tawi ni vua kipanin nipi sagi na simto ding uhi; tuate pen a bih hi ding hi.","title":"Nipi Pawite"},"16":{"text":"Sabbath sagina zaw a zing cieng dong ni sawmnga dong na simto ding uhi; tua ciengin Topa kungah an tha tawh biehna na pie ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"A kivei biehna dingin na tenna uh panin Topa tungah ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-seni tuoh tawh a kibawl anlum ni na tawi ding uhi; tuate pen annel tawh a kibawl, tol tawh ki-em, Topa tungah anpal-a kipie dingte ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Anlum tawh kum khat a pha, a paubaang lo tuuno sagi, bawngno khat, le tuutang ni na pie ding uhi. Tuate, an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh Topa tunga kipiehtha meihal biehna hi ding hi; tuate pen Topa a lungkimsah a gimnamtui mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat, le thunuom biehna dingin kum khat a pha tuuno apa ni na pie ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Siempu pa in Topa mai-ah tuate a kivei biehna-in anpal anlum le tuuno ni tawh veiton ding hi; siempu pa adingin tuate Topa mai-ah a sieng hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in note in tang na tawh ding uhi; note in a siengtho biehpieh kikhop khat na nei ding uhi; note in leitung nasepte na khawl ding uh. Tam pen na tenna uh mun vannuoi-ah na khang tawntung vua na zui zing ding uh thukham ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 23:16; 34:22; Thkna 16:9-12"},"22":{"text":"Na leitang pan vua an na lah ciengun na lo gei dong uh la loin, na ansanghte uzong na khawm sih ding uhi; tuate pen mizawngte le pemtate na nuasiepieh ding uhi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Siem 19:9-10; Thkna 24:19-22"},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Pengkul Pawite"},"24":{"text":"Israel mite kungah tam bangin gen in: A hla sagi veina, tuami hla masa ni-in a bukim tawlngahna ni khat, pengkul awte tawh phawna a kibawl a siengtho biehpieh kikhop khat na nei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Note in leitung nasepte na sem sih ding uhi; mei tawh Topa’ meihal biehna na peipi ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Thoidamna Ni"},"27":{"text":"Tu-in tam a hla sagina a ni sawm ni khu thoidamna ni ahi hi; note adingin a siengtho biehpieh kikhop khat hi ding hi: Noma le noma na kideh ding vua, tuaci’n Topa tungah meihal biehna na pie ding uhi;"},"28":{"text":"tuami ni bup sung tungtawnin na na sem sih ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile tuami khu Topa na Pasien mai vuah note tanga thoidamna bawl nadingin thoidamna bawl ni ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua nibup sung tungtawnin ama le ama kidehna a bawl lo poma a mite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuami nibup sung tungtawnin tua banga nasem poma a mite lah panin ka susie ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Note in na na sem sih ding uhi: Tuami ni pen na khang tungtawn vua na tenna uh mun zosie-ah zui ding thupieh khat hi zing ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuami ni pen note dingin a bukim tawlngahna Sabbath ni khat hi ding a, noma le noma na na kideh ding uhi; tua hla a ni kuo nitah panin a nitah kia dong na Sabbath uh na tang ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 16:29-34"},"33":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Buh Pawite"},"34":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Tami hla a sagina ni sawm le nga ni panin ni sagi sung, Topa adingin buh pawite om ding hi."},"35":{"text":"A ni masa ni pen a siengtho biehpieh kikhop hi ding hi; note in leitung nasepte na sem sih ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ni sagi sung note in mei tawh kihal Topa’ biehna na lui ding uhi; a ni giet ni-in a siengtho biehpieh kikhop khat nei-in Topa’ meihal biehna na lui ding uhi; tua khu a thupi kikhopna khat ahi hi; note in leitung nasepte na sem sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 16:13-15"},"37":{"text":"Tam teng pen a kisesa Topa’ pawite ahi a, a siengtho biehpieh kikhopna hunin tuate na zang ding vua, Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biehnate- meihal biehna, an tawh biehna, thoidamnate le dawn thei biehnate amau’ ni cietin na pie ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tam teng pen Topa’ Sabbath-te, na letsongte uh, na kiciemna zieh vua na biehnate zosie ule kiphalna tawh na biehnate zosie ban vuah na pieh dingte uh ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tu-in leitanga a piengte na kaikhop zaw uh, a hla sagina ni sawm le ni nga panin ni sagi sung Topa’ pawi na bawl ding uhi. A ni masa ni pen a bukim tawlngahna ni khat hi a, a ni giet ni zong a bukim tawlngahna ma hi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in a etlawm sing gate, lutu bate, a na pha singbate le luidunga a po gielhehte na la ding uhi; tuale Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah ni sagi sung na guolnuom ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tua pen kum simin ni sagi sung Topa’ pawi-in na mang ding uhi; tua khu na khang tungtawn vua a kip den ding thukham hi ding a, tua pen a hla sagina sungin na bawl ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Buh sungah ni sagi sung na teng ding uhi; Israel gam sunga tuolsung mi zosie buh sungah teng ding uhi,"},"43":{"text":"tuaci’n Egypt gam panin amate ka peipi lai-in buh sunga Israel mite ka tensahna thute na suonlehlahte un a thei ding uhi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Pei 23:16; 34:22"},"44":{"text":"Tua bangin Moses in Israel mite tungah Topa’ pawi a kisate a phuongzah hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Meivah (Pei 27:20-21)"},"2":{"text":"Meivah a kuon den thei nadingin olive ga kigawivui sathau siengtho na kungah ang tawi nadingun Israel mite thupie in."},"3":{"text":"Kikhopna buh sung, thuciemna dalna diel pulamah nitah panin zingmawng dongin Topa mai-ah tua meivah a kuong den dingin Aaron in koi ding hi; tua khu na khang tungtawn vua na zui ding uh thukham hi den ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in kham citah tawh kibawl meivah tunna khuom tung Topa mai-ah meivahte koi den ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Annel la-in tua panin moh sawm le ni na em ding a, moh khat ciengin annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo- seni ta hi ding hi.","title":"Biehbuh Ading Anlum"},"6":{"text":"Tuate kham citah sabuoi tungah zawn ni-in na koi ding a, zawn khatah guh ta om ding hi.","ref":"Pei 25:30"},"7":{"text":"Annlum tawh melcina biehna dingin Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biehna a kipieh thei nadingin zawn khat cietah gimnamtui siengtho na koi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Sabbath ni sielin Aaron in kumtawn thuciemna-in Israel mite tangin tuate a ngaina bangin Topa mai-ah koi den ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuate pen Aaron le a tapate nga ding satanh ahi a, amate in mun siengtho khatah ne ding uhi. Azieh pen tuate Topa tunga meihal silpieh lah panin ama’ nga den ding a satanh siengtho pen ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 12:4; Mrk 2:26; Luk 6:4"},"10":{"text":"Israel mite lah panin a nu Israel-te, a pa Egypt-te ahi mi khat peikhie hi; giephuol sungah Israel numei’ tapa le Israel mi khat kihau uhi.","title":"Pasien Gensietna le Daanpiehna"},"11":{"text":"Israel numei’ tapa in tua gensie-in a samsie hi. Amate in Moses kungah tua pa a peipi uhi. Ama’ nu min pen Shelomith ahi a, Dan minam, Debri’ tanu ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate tungah Topa’ khensatna a kitel masangin tua mipa a khumcip uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:"},"14":{"text":"Tua Pasien’ min gensie pa giephuol pulamah peipi in. Tuale a za tapo in ama’ lu tungah khut ngamin mihon zosie in ama suong tawh sepsah in."},"15":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Pasien a samsie poma in ama’ mawna khu ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ min a gensie mipa kithat ding a, mihon buppi in suong tawh tua a gensie pa sep ding uhi. Pemtate hile tuolsung mite hile tua Min Siengtho a gensiet ciengun amate kithat ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing khat a that poma kithat ding hi.","ref":"Pei 21:12"},"18":{"text":"Ganhing khat a that poma in tua tangin ditkiana bawl ding a, hinna khat tangin hinna khat hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Midang khat a poisah mi poma ama bawl bangin ama tungah kithuhkia ding hi:"},"20":{"text":"Gu pen gu ma tawh, mit pen mit ma tawh, ha pen ha ma tawh kithuh ding hi. Ama in mi khat a liemsah bang ma-in ama kiliemsah ding hi.","ref":"Pei 21:23-25; Thkna 19:21; Mat 5:38"},"21":{"text":"Ganhing khat a that pa in tua ganhing’ manh lo ding hi; ahi vangin mi that pa kithat ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Note in pemtate ading le tuolsung mite adingin a kibang thukham na nei ding uhi: Bangzieh ahei cile keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","ref":"Gam 15:16"},"23":{"text":"Tam bangin Moses in Israel mite hopi hi; tuale amate in giephuol pulamah mi samsie pa peipi-in suong tawh a seplia uhi. Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Israel mite a gamta uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Sinai Muol tungah Moses hopi-in tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Sabbath Kum (Thkna 15:1-11)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen a kung vuah tam bangin gen in: Note kang pieh ding leitangah na tun ciengun tua leitang in Topa adingin sabbath tang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum guh sung lo na pawi ding vua, kum guh sung na lengguite uh heuhin a ga na khawm ding uh;."},"4":{"text":"ahi vangin a kum sagina sungin leitang ading a bukim tawlngahna sabbath khat om ding a, Topa ading sabbath hi ding hi. Na lo uh na pawi sih ding vua, na lenggui uzong na heuh sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Anlah nua-a ali pote na at sih ding vua, a kiheuh lo na lengguite na khawm sih ding uhi: Tua khu leitang adingin a bukim tawlngahna kum hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua sabbath kum sunga leitang pana a piengte- note, na sila numeite le pasalte, a kiguoi na nasemte ule no tawh a tengton pemtate in na ne thei ding uhi;"},"7":{"text":"azieh pen tua na leitang panun a pieng zosie na ganhonte ading zong le na gam sung vua gamsate dingin an hi ding hi.","ref":"Pei 23:10-11"},"8":{"text":"Kum nipi sagi hun pen kum sawmli le kum kuo ahi thei nadingin kum nipi sagi, kum sagi mun sagivei na simto ding uhi.","title":"Jubilee Kum"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin hla sagina a ni sawm ni-in pengkul na gingsah ding uhi; note in hla sagina a ni sawm ni ahi thoidamna ni-in na gam sung zosie vuah pengkul na gingsah ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"A kum sawmngana na siengthosah ding vua, gam sung mun zosie-a teng mi zosie tungah suotahna thu na phuongzah ding uhi. Tua khu note dingin jubilee khat hi ding hi: Na unpi-un na logam ule na inn ciet vuah na kilekia ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua kum sawmnga cinna pen note adingin jubilee khat hi ding hi: Lo pawi lo, a lipote la lo, a kiheuh lo lengguite khawm loin na om ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua khu jubilee ahi hi; tua khu note dingin siengtho ding hi: Note in gamlah pana a piengte beh na ne ding uhi"},"13":{"text":"Tami jubilee kum sungin na neisa uh na logam ciet vuah a koimapo na peikia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na vengte kunga na zua cieng ule na vengte kung pana na lei ciengun khatlekhat na kisol sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Jubilee zaw ciengin a kum phaza tawh kituohin na vengte tung panin na lei ciengun a zuate in an pieng ding kum phaza tawh kituohin a manh tan ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"A kum a tam leh a manh sangsahin, a kum a tawm leh a manh na tawmsah ding uhi; azieh pen an pieng ding kum tawh kituohin na tung vua ang kizua ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Khatlekhat kisoltuoh loin na Pasien uh na giing zaw ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua leitang tungah lungmuong tahin na ten thei nadingun ka thukhamte zui-in ka biehna ngaina kipte na tang ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua leitang in an piengsahin gilva tahin an ne-in, a sungah lungmuong tahin na teng ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Note in lo pawi loin an lah at sih mawh leih a kum sagina kum ciengin bang i ne ta ding vuoi? na ci kha thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in kum thum sung khom ding an a pien thei nadingin a kum guhna kumin note dingin ka thupha kang peisah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A kum gietna kumin lo na pawi ciengun anlui na ne ding uhi; antha ang tun nading a kum kuona masang anlui na ne ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Leitang keima-a’ ahi ziehin kumtawnin kizuamang thei lo ding hi; note na hi uleh keima tawh a omton pemta le leitang kawmte na hibo uhi."},"24":{"text":"Na leitang neina zosie vuah leitang tatkia thei dingin na bawl ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na tanaute uh khatpo in a hamsat ziehin a leitang behkhat a zua leh, a tanau a kinaipi pen pa pei-in tua a sanggampa’ zuasa leitang tankia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua mipa in a tan ding koima a nei sih a, hizongle ama ang citheikia ciengin a tat nading sum a kicingin ang mukia leh,"},"27":{"text":"a leitang a zua ni panin a kum phaza kisimin, a zuana pa kungah a piehbe ding teng lekia ding a, tuaci’n a neisate kipiekia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuate a ngakia thei nadingin sum a kicinga a nei sih leh, tua a vanzua pen a leipa kungah jubilee dong om ding hi; Jubilee hun ciengin kipiekia-in tua neisa kilekia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Mi khatpo in khuo kulpi sungah tenna inn khat a zua leh, a zua huna kipanin kum khat a cin zaw ciengin tankia thei ding hi; tatkia theina ding hun pen kum khat sung hi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Kum khatbih a cin zaw masangin tua inn a kitat zawh sih leh, tua khuo kulpi sunga om inn pen a khan tawntunga a nei den dingin a leipa kungah kipie ding hi; Jubilee ciengin tuate kipiekia lo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin kul a nei lo a kimvela khuota innte ahileh, gamlaha lote tawh kibangin kiciemte ding hi; tuate kitanthei kia-in jubilee hun sungin kipiekia ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Levi-te’ nei khuopite tungtang thu-ah, Levi-te in tua khuopite sunga a nei uh innte a tawntungin tatkia theina thu nei ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Levi-te tung panin tua bang neisate-khuopi khat sunga a nei uh a kizuasa innte kitankia thei ding a- jubilee hun sungin kipekia ding hi; azieh pen Levi-te’ khuopite sunga innte pen Israel mite lahah amate’ neisa ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin a khuopi uh kim gamlaha lote pen kizua thei lo ding hi; azieh pen tuate amau’ nei den ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Hamsatna ziehin na tanau khatpo un note ang bel leh amate na va ding uhi; amate pen note tawh khuolmi pemta bangin teng ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 15:7-8"},"36":{"text":"Amate tung panin a met la masa sih unlen, tua ahi sihle a met a khang la loin na Pasien ging zaw un; amate, note lahah tengsah un."},"37":{"text":"Amate tungah na sum uh a metin palahsah loin, a metin na an uzong na pie sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 22:25; Thkna 23:19-20"},"38":{"text":"Kei pen na Pasien uh ahi ding le note’ tunga Canaan leitang ang pie dingin Egypt pan ang peipi Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"39":{"text":"No ang belte lahah mite in a zawn ziehin na tung vua ang kizua uleh, silate bangin amate na bawl sih ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Amate pen a kiciel nasemte ahi sihle a kihen nasemte bangin note tawh omden ding uhi. Jubilee kum masangin amate in na na uh a sem ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin na khut sung panun a tate utawh amate a suohta ding uhi; a inn uh lam zuonin a peikia ding vua, a pu a pa’ gamah a kilekia ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Azieh pen Egypt gam pana ka peipi amate pen keima’ nasemte ahi uhi; silate kizua bangin amate kizua lo ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Pauhat thu tawh amate na uh sih ding vua, na Pasien uh na giingzaw ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Note’ nei thei ding sila numeite le sila pasalte tam bang ahi hi: Na kimvel vua a om minamte lah panin sila numeite le sila pasalte na lei thei ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Note tawh a tengton pemtate lah pan le na gam sung vua a suoh note tawh a tengton amau’ innkuon lah panin na lei thei ding uhi; amate pen na neisa uh a suoh thei ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Na nua cieng vua na tate uh’ nei le luo dingin amate na koi thei ding uhi. Silate bangin amate na bawl thei ding vua, ahi vangin na sanggamte uh Israel-te ahile, mi koima in adang khat tungah ngongtatna tawh uh lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 21:2-6; Thkna 15:12-18"},"47":{"text":"Note lahah khuolmi pemta khat ang cithei a, na tanaute un hamsatna tuohin tua pemta pa kungah amau le amau a kizua vua, ahi sihle tua pemta pa’ innkuon khatpo tungah a kizua uleh,"},"48":{"text":"amau le amau a kizua zawciengun a kitatkia theina ding thu nei ding uhi; amau’ sanggamte khatpo in amate tankia thei ding a,"},"49":{"text":"ahi sihle amau’ pano ahi sihle amau’ pano’ tapa amate tankia thei ding a, ahi sihle amau’ innkuon sunga si le sa-a a kinaipi uh khatpo in amate tan thei ding hi; ahi sihle a cithei vua ahile amau le amau zong kitan thei ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua pemta pa tunga amate a kizua kum panin jubilee kum dong a kum teng zosie a unpi-in a leipa tawh tuot ding uhi; a kizua manh pen a kum phaza tawh kituot ding hi: A neipa tawh a omton hun sung teng pen a kiciel nasem khat’ thaman tawh a kikimin kise ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Kum tampi a sap lai leh a kileina manh tawh kituohin amau’ kitatna pie ding uhi;"},"52":{"text":"tuale Jubilee kum masang kum tawmno in a sap lai leh tam bangin tuot ding uhi: Amate in nasep kum kisam dung zui-in amau’ kitat manh pie ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Amate pen a kumkumin a kicieltawm nasem khat bangin tua pa’ thuneina sungah a om ding vua, ahi zongin ama in note’ muna-ah amate gamtahin uh lo ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Tam dan teng lahah khat penpen tawh amate a kitat sih leh, Jubilee hun ciengin amate le a ompi a tate utawh a suohta ding uhi."},"55":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Israel mite pen kei adingin ka nasemte ahi uhi; amate pen keima in Egypt leitang pana ka peitopi ka nasemte ahi uhi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Noma adingin milimte na bawl sih ding vua, a kikhuoh milimte hile biehna songte hile phut loin na bieh dingun na gam sung vuah suong milimte na koi sih ding uhi; azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi.","title":"Thumanna’ Thamante (Thkna 7:12-24 ; 28:1-14)","ref":"Siem 19:4; Pei 20:4; Thkna 5:8; 16:21-22; 27:1"},"2":{"text":"Ka Sabbath-te na tang ding vua, ka mun siengtho zong na zatah ding uhi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka thukhamte zui-in ka thupiehte na man vua, citah tahin tuate na tan uleh,"},"4":{"text":"na tung vuah a hunin guotuite kang pie ding a, leitang in ga ga-in lolai-a kungte zong a ga ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bucil hun le lengga law hun kiphamat ding a, lengga law hun le lopawi hun kizom ding hi; gilva tahin an na ne ding vua, na gam sung vuah lungnuom tahin na teng ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 11:13-15; 28:1-4"},"6":{"text":"Na gam sung vuah nopsahna hing pie-in lungmuong tahin na lum ding vua, koima in ang zausah sih ding uhi; keima in gam sung panin gamsa gilote ka delmang ding a, namsau in na gam uh ang nawh sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na galte na delgam ding vua, na masang vuah namsau tawh amate a pua ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mi nga in mi zakhat delin mi zakhat in na galte tul sawm na del ding uhi; na mai vuah na galte namsau tawh a pua ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in note kang angvan ding a, zong hing pungsahin tampi kang phasah ding hi; note tawh ka kiciemna ka tukip ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Anlui a kikholte na ne ding vua, antha khol nadingin anluite na hemsieng ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in na laikim vuah ka tenna mun ka koi ding a, note kang kidah sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Note lahah hing pei-in na Pasien uh ka hi ding a, note zong ka mite na hi ding uhi.","ref":"2Cor 6:16"},"13":{"text":"Amau’ sila na hi nawn lo nadingun Egypt gam panin note ang peipi Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi; keima in na hahkolte uh ka hliehtawng zo a, a dingtangin lam kang peisah zo ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka thu mang loin ka thupiehnate zosie na zui sih vua,","title":"Thumanlona’ Daante (Thkna 28:15-68)"},"15":{"text":"ka thukhamte ngielin ka biehna ngaina kipte na huot vua, ka thupiehnate zosie zui loin ka thuciemna na suhsiet uleh,"},"16":{"text":"na tung vuah keima in tam bangin kang bawl ding hi: Keima in note tungah zauna, a dam thei lo natna le hinna a lamang thei cisa natna kang tungsah ding hi. Na galte in tuate netum ding uh ahi ziehin lo na pawi vangun a mawhna hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima in note kang maisiet ding a, na galte in ang zo gawp ding uhi; na galte in ang uh ding vua, koima del lopi-in na sitai ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua za dongin thuoh napi-in ka thu na ngai nai vaset sih uleh na mawnate uh ziehin a za sagi vei-in dan kang pie lai ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Note’ kiletsahpi na vanglietnate uh keima in ka hiatawng ding a, na vantung uh sia bangsahin na leitang uh sumsan ka bangsah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na thatang uh a mawhna-in kizang ding hi: Na leitang un an piengsah loin na gam sung vua singkungte ga lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima nei langbawl lailai vua, ka thu na man sih uleh na mawnate uh ziehin na tung vuah a za sagi vei-in gimna kang tungsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Note lahah gamsa gilote hing hla-in na tate uh ang tawmang ding a, na ganhonte uzong ang susie ding hi; amate in note mi tawmno khat ang suohsah ding a, tuaci’n na lampite uh gamkhing a suoh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam banga gimna na thuohna utawh kei lam nang kingat nai sih vua kei nei langbawl lai vaset uleh,"},"24":{"text":"ken zong tam bangin note kang langbawl lai ding hi: Kei mama in na mawnate uh ziehin note a za sagi vei-in kang sat ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thuciemna phu la dingin na langkhat vuah namsau kang tungsah ding hi; na khuopite sung vua na nuakia uleh na lah vuah natna kang tungsah ding a, na galte uh’ khut sungah ang kipie ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Note’ hinna an ka suhsietpieh ciengin numei sawm in lungthu khatah na anlum uh a em ding vua, amate in na anlumte uh tawite-in themkhat ta behin a hawm ding uhi; na ne ding vua, ahi vangin na kham sih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hizongle tua bang pima tawh ka thu ngaituon loin nei langbawl lai vaset uleh"},"28":{"text":"ken zong thangpaina tawh note kang langbawl lai ding hi; kei mama in na mawnate uh ziehin a za sagi vei-in dan kang pie ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Note in na tanute ule a tapate uh’ sa na ne ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Keima in na munsangte uh susie-in na gimnamtui halna uh ahi maitamte ka phua ding hi; noma’ milim’ siluong hawmte tungah na luonghawmte uh ka seng ding hi. Keima in note kang kidah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Keima in na khuopite uh siesahin na mun siengthote uh gamkhing ka suohsah ding a, na gim namtuite uh ka dih sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Leitang ka siesah ding a, tuaci’n tua tunga a teng na galte un lamdang a sa ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Minamte lahah kang thezah ding a, note tawh kido nadingin namsau a pai panin ka dawh ding hi; na leitang uh gamkhing suoh ding a, na khuopite uzong hawmsuoh ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin na galte uh’ leitangah na om sung uh, gamkhinga a kinuasie laisie, leitang in a sabbath kumte tangin nuom a sa ding hi; tua ciengin tua leitang tawlnga-in a sabbath kumte tangin nuom a sa ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Leitang in a gamkhinga a op sungin, ama tunga note na ten lai vua a nga khah lo tawlngahna sabbath-te nga ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Keima in note sung panin a galte uh’ leitangah a hinglaite tungah lungsim gimna ka tungsah ding hi; hui in a mut nathel gin khat in amate ka taisah ding a, mi khat namsau masanga a tai bangin amate tai-in koima del loin a puamat ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Koima del lopi-in namsau mai pan a suotah nadinga a kitai bangin khatlekhat na kipalpua ding uhi; tuale note in na galte nan zawh nadingin vanglietna na nei sih ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Minamte lahah na mangthai ding vua, na galte uh’ leitang in ang valtum ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Note sung panin a galte leitanga a omlaite amau’ khielnate ziehin a thazawm ding uhi; a pu a pate’ khielna ziehin amate zong thazawm ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima langkhatah amate a zuou gamtat vua, tua tham loin kei ei lang bawl vua,"},"41":{"text":"tuaci’n ken zong lang bawlin a galte uh’ leitangah amate ka peipi hi; tua ciengin tep tan lo amau’ lungsimte kiniemkhiehin a khielnate ziehun amate a kipuophat uleh,"},"42":{"text":"keima in Jacob tawh ka thuciemna ka phawhkia ding hi; keima in Isaac tawh ka thuciemna le Abraham tawh ka thuciemnate zong phawhkia-in tua leitang zong ka phawhkia ding hi.","ref":"Pien 28:13-14; Pien 26:3-4; Pien 17:7-8"},"43":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in leitang a nuasie ding vua, amate om loin gamkhing ahi sung tengin leitang in a sabbath kumte tangin nuom a sa ding hi. Amate in ka biehna ngaina kipte niel ngamin ka thukhamte a huot ziehun a mawna uh a kipuopha ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Hizongle tuate zosie ziehin a galte uh’ gam sunga a op ciengun amate ka nuol sih ding a, ahi sihle amate tawh ka thuciemna a pelh za dingin amate ka pumhuot sih ding hi; azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate ka angvan ziehin amate’ Pasien ahi dingin keima in Egypt gam panin minamte’ muna-ah ka peipi a pu a pate utawh ka thuciemna ka phawh ding hi: Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tam teng pen Sinai Muol tungah Moses tungtawna Topa in ama le Israel mite kikala a bawl thukipte, biehna ngaina kipte le thukhamte ahi hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Kiciemna tawh Kisai Biehnate"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite hopi inlen amate kungah tam bangin gen in: Mi khat in mihing khat’ manhza tawh kikim thu tawh kisai Topa tungah a tuom vilvelin kiciemna a bawl ciengin,"},"3":{"text":"pasal khat’ kikimpi a manh pen tam bang hi ding hi: Kum sawmni panin kum sawmguh a phate’ kikimpi amanh dingin mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in ngun shekel sawmnga hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Numei ahile a kikimpi amanh dingin shekel sawmthum hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kum nga panin kum sawmni cieng a pha pasal khat ahile pasal’ kikimpi amanh dingin shekel sawmni hi ding a, numei’ kikimpi amanh dingin shekel sawm hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hla khat pan kum nga cieng a pha, pasal khat’ kikimpi amanh dingin ngun shekel nga hi ding a, numei khat’ kikimpi amanh dingin ngun shekel thum hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khat kum sawmguh le a tungsie ahile pasal khat’ kikimpi amanh dingin shekel sawm le nga hi ding a, numei adingin shekel sawm hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khatpo in tua a kikimpi za a piehzawh sih leh siempu pa kungah amate kipeipi ding a, siempu pa in amate’ manh phaza ding tanpieh ding hi; siempu pa in a kiciem mi khatpo’ pieh zawh za ciet tawh kizui-in amanh tan ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa tungah biehna-in kitawi thei ganhing tawh kisai ahile Topa tungah tua banga a kipie na khatpopo a siengtho ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ganhing tangin adang khat tawh kihleng lo ding a, a hoite a hoilote tawh, a hoilote a hoite tawh kihleng lo ding hi. Ganhing khat adang khat tawh na hlen leh, tua ganhing le na hlenna ganhing tegel a nituohin siengtho ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa tungah biehna-in a kitawi thei lo ganhing sieng lo khat tawh kisai ahile siempu pa’ mai-ah tua ganhing kipeipi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Siempu pa in a hoi le a hoi lo tawh kizui-in amanh za se ding hi: Siempu pa se bang bang amanh hi pai ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua ganhing a kitankia ding ahile a kisesa amanh’ senga- suo-sekhat kibelap ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat po in Topa’ kungah a inn khat a siengtho dingin a ap leh, siempu pa in tua inn a hoi le a hoi lo tawh kizui-in amanh se ding hi: Siempu pa se bangin kip ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A inn ap pa in a tat nuomkia leh amanh kitansa’ se nga-suo-sekhat piehbe ding a, tuaci’n a inn tangkia thei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khat in Topa tungah a gamhluo leitang beh khat a ap leh amanh ciengtan dan ding pen khaici pieng ding tawh kizui-in kise ding hi: Mangbuham homer khat kipawitheina leitang pen ngun shekel sawmnga hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua mipa in jubilee kum kipatin a logam a ap leh amanh kisena zaza kip ding hi;"},"18":{"text":"ahi vangin tua lo pen jubilee zaw cienga ki-ap ahile siempu pa in jubilee kumkia dong a omlai kumte tawh kituohin tua logam’ manh tuot ding a, jubilee kum tunkia nadinga a kisam lai kumte tawh kizui-in tuot ding a, a kum tawh kizui ma-in amanh khiem ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuami lo a ap pa in ama’ piehsa lo a tat nuomkia leh amanh kitanza’ senga-suo -sekhat piehbe ding a, tuaci’n a nei masa pa kungah tua lo tungkia ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"ahi vangin tua lo a kitatkia sih a, ahi sihle midang khat kunga kizuasa ahile kitankia thei nawn lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin jubilee hun sungin tua lo a kipieh ciengin Topa tunga ki-apsa lo bangin a siengtho hi ding hi; tua khu siempupa-a’ hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi khat in a gamhluo logam ahi lo, a leisa logam khat Topa tunga a ap leh"},"23":{"text":"siempu pa in jubilee kum dong tawh kituohin tua logam’ manh za ding tuot ding a, tua ni-a kipanin Topa tungah a manh kiseza pen a siengtho silpiehin a pie ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Jubilee kum sungin tua logam pen a kileina logam neipa tungah kilekia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Van manh sena zosie mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in kise ding hi: Gerah sawmni ciengin shekel khat ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin ganno tacilte Topa- a’ ahi ziehin koima in ap thei lo ding a, bawng ahi a, keel ahi zongin tuate Topa -a’ ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuate pen ganhing sieng lo ahile amanh kise za’ senga-suo- sekhat tungdipin kitanh ding hi; a kitat sih leh amanh kisena bangin kizua ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi khat in a nei, Topa tunga suhsiet dinga ki-apsate, mihing hitale ganhing hitale, gamhluo logamte hitale, kizua thei lo ding a, zong kitankia thei lo ding hi; a ki-ap na zosie pen Topa adingin sil siengtho pen ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:14"},"29":{"text":"Suhsiet dinga ki-apsa mite kitankia thei lo ding hi; amate kithat ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Leitang pana pieng sawm-ah-khat zosie khaici ahi a, singga ahi zongin Topa -a’ ahi hi; tuate pen Topa adingin siengtho hi."},"31":{"text":"Amau’ sawm-ah-khat a tanhkia nuomte in amanhza’ senga-suo-sekhat tungdip ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawnghonte le tuuhonte panin sawm-ah-khat zosie le tuucingpa’ ciengkhut nei-a pei ganhing zosie’ sawm-ah-khat poma Topa adingin a siengtho hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Koima in tuate hoi hi, hoi lo hi, ci-in ahi zongin, ahi sihle adang khat tawh hlen dingin ahi zongin kantel thei lo ding a, zong hleng thei lo ding hi; mi khat in tua khu a hlen leh ama’ hlen pen le a hlenna ganhing a nituohin a sieng hi ding a, kitankia thei lo ding hi.","ref":"Gam 18:21; Thkna 14:22-29"},"34":{"text":"Tam teng pen Sinai Muol tunga om Israel mite adingin Topa in Moses tunga a hil thupiehte ahi hi."}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Gamlah Vana","shortname":"Gam","abbr":[],"desc":"Gamlah vana (numbers)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate, Egypt gam pan a pei zaw uh a kum nina, a hla nina a ni masa ni-in, Sinai senel gam kikhopna puonbuh sungah Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Israel-te Miphaza Simna"},"2":{"text":"Israel mihon buppi, a be a phung sung vuah pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin pasal poma a milipin a phaza sim in;"},"3":{"text":"Israel sungah kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding mi poma a phaza sim in. Nang le Aaron in a pawlpawlin a min uh na khum ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"A minam ciet panin pasal khat ciet, a pupa innkuon lutang pen ciet in ang hu ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Note ang hu dingte’ min tam teng ahi hi: Reuben panin, Shedeur’ tapa Elizur;"},"6":{"text":"Simeon panin, Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel;"},"7":{"text":"Judah panin, Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon;"},"8":{"text":"Issachar panin, Zuar’ tapa Nethanel;"},"9":{"text":"Zebulun panin, Helon’ tapa Eliab;"},"10":{"text":"Joseph’ tapate: Ephraim panin, Ammihud’ tapa Elishama; Manasseh panin, Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel;"},"11":{"text":"Benjamin panin, Gideoni’ tapa Abidan;"},"12":{"text":"Dan panin, Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer;"},"13":{"text":"Asher panin, Ochran’ tapa Pagiel;"},"14":{"text":"Gad panin, Deuel’ tapa Eliasaph;"},"15":{"text":"Naphtali panin, Enan’ tapa Ahira ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam teng pen mihonpi sung pana a kiteel amau’ be lutangte, a pawlpawla a kikhen Israel-te lutangte ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in a min kilosa tam mite a zawpi vua,"},"18":{"text":"a hla nina, a ni masa ni-in Israel mihonte a kaikhawm uhi. Amate in a be sung vuah a pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pana tungsie mite’ min a khum vua,"},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin ama in Sinai senel gamah amate a phaza a sim hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel’ tapa tapen Reuben’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"21":{"text":"Reuben’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmli le tulguh le zanga ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Simeon’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"23":{"text":"Simeon’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tulkuo le zathum ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Gad’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"25":{"text":"Gad minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmli le tulnga le zaguh sawmnga ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Judah’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan thum thei ding pasal poma:"},"27":{"text":"Judah minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmsagi le tulli le zaguh ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Issachar’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah a pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"29":{"text":"Isaachar’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tulli le zali ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Zebulun’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"31":{"text":"Zebulun’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tulsagi le zali ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Joseph’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"33":{"text":"Joseph’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmli le zanga ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Manasseh’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"35":{"text":"Manasseh’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmthum le tul ni le zani ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Benjamin’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding poma:"},"37":{"text":"Benjamin’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmthum le tul nga le zali ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Dan’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"39":{"text":"Dan’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmguh le tul ni le zasagi ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Asher’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"41":{"text":"Asher’ minam lahah a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmli le tulkhat le zanga ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Naphtali’ suonlehlahte panin amau’ pienna gui, amau’ be sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a min om bangin a milipin kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan tum thei ding pasal poma:"},"43":{"text":"Naphtali’ minam lahah a a kiciemte mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tul thum le zali ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tam teng pen Israel’ makai sawm le nite panpina tawh Moses le Aaron in amau’ innkuon ciet tanga a na sim uh mite ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel gam sungah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a kum sawmni pan a tungsie paltan kuon thei ding Israel-te mi phaza buppi-"},"46":{"text":"tul zaguh le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 26:1-51"},"47":{"text":"Hinanle amau’ pupa minam min zui-in Levi-te pen amate tawh kisimton lo hi."},"48":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah a gen zo hi:"},"49":{"text":"Levi minamte beh na ciemte sih ding a, amate pen adang Israel-te tawh na simton sih ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Thuciemna biehbuh le a sunga vanzah zosie, le tua tawh kisai na zosie a uh dingin Levi-te na sezaw ding hi; amate in biehbuh le a sunga vanzah zosie puo-in biehbuh kemcingin, biehbuh kimvelah phuol sat ding uhi."},"51":{"text":"Biehbuh a kituo ding ciengin Levi-te in a phet ding uhi; biehbuh a kilam ding ciengin zong Levi-te ma in lam ding uhi. A kunga a pei a pulam mi khat popo kithat ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Adang Israel-te pen amau’ galphuol cietah a pawlpawlin phuol sat ding uhi;"},"53":{"text":"hinanle Israel mihonpite tungah lungthahna a tun lo nadingin Levi-te in thuciemna biehbuh kimkotah phuolsat ding uhi; tuale Levi-te in thuciemna biehbuh cin ding tavuon la ding uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tua bangin Israel-te a gamta uhi; amate in Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin a sem uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Giephuol Satdan le Galkuonna"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te in amau’ dielkhai nei cietah amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in giephuol a sat ding uhi; amate in a pang simah kikhopna puonbuh lam mai ngatin phuol sat ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Nisuona lampangah nisuo lam nga-in a pawlpawla giephuol sat dingte pen Judah pawlte hi ding uhi. Judah mite’ makai pen Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon hi a,"},"4":{"text":"ama pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmsagi le tulli le zaguh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama zomah phuolsat ding pen Issachar minam hi ding hi. Issachar minam makai pen Zuar’ tapa Nethanel hi ding a,"},"6":{"text":"ama pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tulli le zali ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zebulun minam hi ding hi: Zebulun minam makai pen Helon’ tapa Eliab hi ding a,"},"8":{"text":"ama pawl miphaza pen tul sawmnga le tulsagi le zali ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Judah’ giephuolah a pawlpawla omte pen a unpi-in tulza le tul sawmgiet le tulguh le zali pha hi. A kipei ciengin amate masa ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Leitaw lampangah a pawlpawla giephuol sat ding pen Reuben pawlte hi ding hi. Reuben minam makai pen Shedeur’ tapa Elizur hi ding a,"},"11":{"text":"ama pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmli le tulguh le zanga ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama zomah phuol sat ding pen Simeon’ minam hi ding hi. Simeon minam makai pen Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel hi ding hi a,"},"13":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tulkuo le zathum ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gad minam hi ding hi: Gad minam makai pen Reuel’ tapa Eliasaph hi ding a,"},"15":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmli le tulnga le zaguh le sawmnga ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Reuben’ giephuolah a pawlpawla a omte pen a unpi-in tulza le tul sawmnga le tulkhat le zali le sawmnga pha hi. A nina-ah amate pei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Kikhopna buh pen giephuol’ laikima om Levi-te’ giephuol tawh peiton ding hi; a phuolsat hun lai ma bangun amau’ mun cietah a dielkhai ciet utawh pei ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nitumna lampangah a pawlpawla giephuol sat ding pen Ephraim pawlte hi ding hi. Ephraim minam makai pen Ammihud’ tapa Elishama hi ding a,"},"19":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmli le zanga ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama zomah Manasseh minam hi ding hi.
