Manasseh minam makai pen Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel hi ding a,"},"21":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmthum le tulni le zani ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Benjamin minam hi ding hi: Benjamin minam makai pen Gideoni’ tapa Abidan hi ding a,"},"23":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmthum le tulnga le zali ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ephraim’ giephuolah a pawlpawla a omte pen a unpi-in tulza le tulgiet le zakhat pha hi. A thumna-ah amate pei ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Leilu lampangah a pawlpawla giephuol sat ding pen Dan pawlte hi ding hi. Dan minam makai pen Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer hi ding a,"},"26":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmguh le tulni le zasagi ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama zomah phuol sat ding pen Asher minam hi ding hi. Asher minam makai pen Ochran’ tapa Pagiel hi ding a,"},"28":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmli le tulkhat le zanga ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Naphtali minam hi ding hi: Naphtali minam makai pen Enan’ tapa Ahira hi ding a,"},"30":{"text":"ama’ pawl mi phaza pen tul sawmnga le tulthum le zali ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Dan’ giephuolah a pawlpawla a omte pen a unpi-in tulza le tul sawmnga le tulsagi le zaguh pha hi. Amate pen a pawlpawlin a nukhia penin pei ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tam pen amau’ pupa innkuon zui-a kisim Israel-te ahi vua, giephuolah a pawlpawla a om mimal buppi pen tul zaguh le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin Israel-te lahah Levi-te kisimton lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin Israel-te gamta uhi. Amate in a galkap honpite tawh giephuol a sat vua, mi zosie in a be le a pupa innkuon zui-in tua bang ma-in a pei uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam pen Topa in Sinai Muol tungah Moses a hopi lai-a Aaron le Moses’ pienna guite ahi hi.","title":"Aaron’ Tapate (Siem 10:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Tam teng pen Aaron tapate’ min ahi hi: A tapa tapen Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar ahi hi;","ref":"Gam 26:60"},"3":{"text":"tam teng pen siempu sathau kinusa, siempu na sem dinga kisudetsa Aaron tapate’ min ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Sinai senel gam Topa mai-ah mei siengtho lo a pieh ciengun Topa mai-ah Nadab le Abihu a si vua, ama gel in ta a nei sih uhi. A pa uh Aaron hin sungin Eleazar le Ithamar in siempu sem uhi.","ref":"Siem 10:1-2; Gam 26:61"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Levi-te’ Mawpuohte"},"6":{"text":"Levi minamte a nai-ah peipi inlen, amate in siempu Aaron a hu thei nadingin a mai-ah koi in."},"7":{"text":"Biehbuhah a sep ciengun ama le a kikhawm mihon buppi adingin kikhopna buh mai-ah amate in na a sem ding uhi;"},"8":{"text":"amate in kikhopna buh vanzah zosie a vaan ding vua, biehbuh-ah a sep ciengun Israel-te’ nasep ding teng sem ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma in Aaron le a tapate tungah Levi-te na pie ding hi; amate pen Israel-te lah panin ama tunga kipumpieh ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin nangma in Aaron le a suon a hlahte’ min na khum ding hi; amate pen siempu’ na sem dingte ahi vua, amate kunga a pei a pulam mi khatpopo kithat ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"12":{"text":"Israel-te lahah naubu hong tacil zosie tang dingin keima in Israel-te lahah Levi-te ka sang hi. Levi-te pen keima-a’ hi ding hi,"},"13":{"text":"azieh pen tacil zosie keima-a’ ahi hi. Egypt gam sungah tacil zosie ka thagam lai-in, Israel sunga tacil zosie, mihingte le ganhingte a ni-in keima adingin ka siensuo hi; amate pen keima-a’ hi ding hi. Keima Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Pei 13:2"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Sinai senel gamah Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Levi-te Mi Phaza Simna (Gam 1:47-54)"},"15":{"text":"Levi-te, a pupa’ innkuonkuon le a bebe-in sim in. Hla khat pan a tungsie pasal poma na sim ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama thu a kipieh bangin Topa’ kammal tawh kizui-in Moses in amate a sim hi."},"17":{"text":"Levi tapate’ min pen: Gershon, Kohath, le Merari ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Gershon tapate’ min pen: Libni le Shimei ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Kohath’ tapate min pen: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Merari’ tapate min pen: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Tam teng pen amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in Levi-te’ bete ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Libni mite le Shimei mite pen Gershon-te’ be ahi uhi; tam teng pen Gershon-te’ bete ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate, hla khat panin a tungsie pasal zosie a kisimna-ah tulsagi le zanga a pha uhi."},"23":{"text":"Gershon-te be in nitumna lam biehbuh nua-ah giephuol a sat ding vua,"},"24":{"text":"Gershon-te’ pupa innkuon lutang pen Lael’ tapa Eliasaph ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh sunga Gershon tapate’ nasep pen a biehbuh, puonbuh a tuomna tawh, kikhopna puonbuh lutna puonkhai,"},"26":{"text":"buhtuol puon kikhaite, biehbuh le maitam kimvela om buhtuol lutna puonkhai, le khauhuolte le tuate tawh kisai nasep zosie ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Kohath-te be pen Aram-te, Izhar-te, Hebron-te, le Uzziel-te ahi hi; tam teng pen Kohath-te’ be ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hla khat le a tungsie pasal zosie, biehbuh nasep a sem poma a kisimna-ah tulgiet le zaguh a pha vua, amate in mun siengtho cin ding tavuon nei uhi."},"29":{"text":"Kohath-te’ be in biehbuh leitaw lamah giephuol a sat ding vua,"},"30":{"text":"Kohath-te’ bete sung panin a pupa innkuon lutang pen Uzziel’ tapa Elizaphan ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Amau’ nasep dingte pen thuciemna singkuong, sabuoi, meivah tunna, maitamte, mun siengtho sunga siempupa nasepna vanzahte, kidalna puonkhai le tam teng tawh a kisai nasep zosie van ding ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Siempu Aaron’ tapa Eleazar pen Levi makaite tungah a uhpi pa hi ding a, mun siengtho cing dinga kikoi mite’ nasepna vil ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Mahli-te le Mushi-te pen Merari-te’ be ahi uhi: Tam teng pen Merari-te’ be ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Hla khat panin a tungsie a kisim pasal poma tulguh le zani ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Merari’ bete lahah a pupa innkuon lutang pen Abihail’ tapa Zuriel ahi hi; amate in biehbuh leilu lampangah giephuol sat ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Merari’ tapate et dinga kise nasep ahile biehbuh khuompehte, a zawlte, a khuompite, a tunnate, a nengthem zosie le tua teng tawh kisai nasep zosie ahi hi;"},"37":{"text":"a buhtuol kimvela khuompite, a tunnate, khetphimte, le a khaute tawh zong ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Nisuona lampang biehbuh mai, nisuona maingatin kikhopna puonbuh mai-ah giephuol sat dingte pen mun siengtho sungah Israel-te dinga bang khat popo a seppieh dingte ahi Moses, Aaron le Aaron’ tapate ahi uhi; a nai-a pei a pulam mi popo kithat ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in Topa’ thupiehna tawh amau’ be zui-in a sim uh hla khat le a tungsie Levi-te pasal zosie tul sawmni le tulni pha hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Israel-te lahah hla khat pan a tungsie tacil pasal zosie’ min ciemte inlen amau’ min sim in.","title":"Tacil Kitatna"},"41":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te lahah tacil zosie tang dingin keima dingin Levi-te nei sanpieh ding a, Israel-te’ ganhonte lahah tacil zosie tang dingin Levi-te’ ganhonte nei sanpieh ding hi- keima Topa ka hi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in ama a thupieh bangin Moses in Israel-te lahah tacil zosie’ min ciemte hi."},"43":{"text":"A min kiciemte, a kisim hla khat panin a tungsie tacil pasal zosie tul sawmni le tulni le zani le sawmsagi le thum ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"45":{"text":"Israel-te lahah tacil zosie tang dingin Levi-te sang inlen, amau’ ganhonte tang dingin Levi-te’ ganhonte sang in. Levi-te pen keima-a’ ahi hi. Keima Topa ka hi hi."},"46":{"text":"Levi-te sangin zani le sawmsagi le thumin a tamzaw Israel tacilte kitat manh dingin"},"47":{"text":"mun siengtho shekel tena tawh kizui-in shekel khatah gerah sawmni a pha shekel nga na sang ding hi."},"48":{"text":"A tamzawte kitatna sum pen Aaron le a tapate tungah pie in."},"49":{"text":"Tuaci’n Levi-te in a tat uh a tamzawte kitatna sum pen Moses in la hi;"},"50":{"text":"ama in mun siengtho shekel tena tawh kizui-in tulkhat le zathum le sawmguh le nga a la hi."},"51":{"text":"Topa’ thugen tawh zui-in Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin tatna sumte Moses in Aaron le a tapate a pie hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Kohath-te"},"2":{"text":"Levi-te lah panin Kohath-te khenkhie inlen amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in"},"3":{"text":"kikhopna buh tawh kisai na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mi zosie sim in."},"4":{"text":"Kohath-te in kikhopna buh sungah a siengtho pen nate tawh kisai nasepte sem ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Giephuol a kituon ding ciengin a sungah Aaron le a tapate lutin kidalna puon a la ding vua, tua puon tawh thuciemna singkuong khu ding uhi;"},"6":{"text":"tua ciengin savun hoi tawh a tuom ding vua, tua tungah amate in puondum khu-in a zawlte hlung ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ompina anlum sabuoi tungah puondum a pha ding vua, tua tungah kuongdaite, gimnamtui pakante, kuongkumte, le tuibuoh nading thawlte a koi ding uhi; tua tunga om den ding anlum zong kikoi ding hi;"},"8":{"text":"tua ciengin amate in puon-ausan khat tawh tuate a khu ding vua, savun hoi tawh tuomin a zawn nadingin zawlte a bilah bul ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in puon a dum khat a la ding vua, meivah khuom pen, a meivahte, a taite-te, a kuongte, le sathau koina vanzah zosie tawh khu ding uhi;"},"10":{"text":"tuale amate in vanzah zosie zong savun hoi tawh tuomin a zawnna ding tal tungah khang ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in kham maitam tungah puondum khat a pha ding vua, savun hoi tawh tuomin a zawlte a bul ding uhi;"},"12":{"text":"tuale mun siengtho sunga kizang vanzah zosie la-in puondum khatah tunin savun tawh a tuom ding vua, a zawnna ding tal tungah a khang ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in maitam tunga vutte luohin a tungah puon a dupsan khat pha ding uhi;"},"14":{"text":"tuale amate in nasepna dinga kizang maitam vanzah zosie, vut luonate, tawkeu-kate, kawbiate, le kuongte, maitam vanzah zosiete a tungah koi-in tua tungah savun hoi tawh tuomin a zawlte bul ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in mun siengtho le mun siengtho vanzah zosie a khu zaw uh giephuol a tuon ciengun tuate a puo dingin Kohath mite a pei ding vua, ahi vangin amate in a siengtho nate a tham sih ding uhi. A tham khah uleh a si ding uhi. Tam teng pen Kohath-te puoh ding kikhopna puonbuh nate ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Siempu Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in meivah tui, gimnamtuite, a hunhuna kipie an tawh biehna, nu sathaute, biehbuh buppi le a sunga om na zosie, mun siengtho le a sunga a vanzah zosie enin vil ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"18":{"text":"Levi-te lah panin Kohath-te’ bete na susie sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A siengtho pen nate kungah a pei ciengun si loin a hin nadingun amate hicisah in: Aaron le a tapate a sungah lutin amau’ sep ding le a puoh ding ciet uh se ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hizongle a siengtho nate en dingin a sungah Kohath-te bakhat sung nangawn a tum sih ding uhi; a tum uleh si ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Gershon-te le Merari-te"},"22":{"text":"Gershon-te zong, amau’ pupa innkuon le a be zui-in sim in;"},"23":{"text":"kikhopna buh sungah na sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mite a min na khum ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tam pen Gershon bete’ nasep le a van puoh ding uh ahi hi:"},"25":{"text":"Amate in biehbuh dalna puonte, kikhopna puonbuh le a tuomna tawh, tua tungah a pulam khuna savun hoi, kikhopna buh kotkhah puonkhai,"},"26":{"text":"le buhtuol puon kikhaite, biehbuh le maitam kimvela om buhtuol lutna puonkhai, a khauhuolte, le amau’ nasep nadinga vanzah zosie a puo ding uhi; amate in tua teng tawh kisai nasep a kisam zosie sem ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Gershon-te’ nasepna zosie, a puoh ding teng zosie uh, a sep ding teng zosie uh, Aaron le a tapate’ thupiehna bang hi ding hi; a puoh ding zosie ule a bawl ding zosie uh amate na ap ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam pen kikhopna buh tawh kisai Gershon bete’ nasep ahi a, amau’ nasepna teng pen siempu Aaron’ tapa Ithamar’ uhna nei-ah om ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Merari-te, amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in;"},"30":{"text":"biehbuh sunga na sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga cieng a pha mi zosie a min na khum ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam pen kikhopna buh sungah a sep ding zosie uh ahi hi: Biehbuh khuompehte, a zawlte, a khuompite, le a khuom tunnate tawh,"},"32":{"text":"buhtuol kimvela om khuompite a tunnate tawh, a khetphimte, a khauhuolte, vanzah zosie le , amau’ nasepna tawh kizom na zosie ahi hi; amau’ puoh dinga kise vante a minin na lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tam teng pen Merari bete nasep ding hi a, siempu Aaron’ tapa Ithamar khut nei-ah kikhopna puonbuh tawh kisai a sep ding zosie uh ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses, Aaron le mihon makaite in amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in Kohath-te a min a khum uhi.","title":"Levi-te Kisimna"},"35":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh tawh kisai na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan sawmnga a pha mi zosie;"},"36":{"text":"amau’ be zui-in a min kikhum pen tulni za sagi le sawmnga pha hi."},"37":{"text":"Tam teng pen kikhopna puonbuh sunga nasem Kohath-te be zosie’ mi phaza kisimna hi a, Moses tungtawnin Topa in thu a pieh bangin Moses le Aaron in min a khum uhi."},"38":{"text":"Gershon-te, amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in a min uh kikhum a,"},"39":{"text":"kikhopna puonbuh sunga na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mi zosie,"},"40":{"text":"amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in a min kikhum mi tulni zaguh le sawmthum pha uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tam teng pen Moses le Aaron in Topa’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in kikhopna puonbuh sunga na a sem thei ding Gershon-bete’ min kikhumna ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Merari-te, amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in kisim a,"},"43":{"text":"kikhopna puonbuh sunga na a sem thei ding mi zosie-"},"44":{"text":"amau’ be zui-in a min a kikhum mi tulthum zani pha hi."},"45":{"text":"Tam pen Moses tungtawnin Topa’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in Moses le Aaron in min a khum Merari bete mi phaza ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Amau’ be le amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in Moses, Aaron, le Israel makaite in a min a khum Levi-te,"},"47":{"text":"kikhopna puonbuh tawh kisai na sem thei ding le van a puo thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mi zosie,"},"48":{"text":"amau’ mimal kisim pen tulgiet le zanga le sawmgiet ahi hi."},"49":{"text":"Moses tung tawna Topa’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in a sep ding a puoh ding ciet uh kise hi; Topa in Moses a thupiehna tawh kizui-in ama in tua bangin amau’ min a khum hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Abua Mite (Siem 15:1-33)"},"2":{"text":"Amate in miphahte, ahi sihle nin neite le misi tawh kisuhkhah zieha abua mi poma giephuol pulamah a nawmang nadingun Israel-te thu pie in;"},"3":{"text":"amate lahah ka tenna a giephuol uh a niehsah lo nadingun amate, pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin giephuol pulamah na notmang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Israel-te in a bawl vua, giephuol pulamah amate a notmang uhi; Topa thupieh bangin Israel mite gamta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Mawna Pulahna le Lokiana (Siem 6:1-7)"},"6":{"text":"Israel-te kungah tam bangin gen in: Midang khat tungah pasal khat ahi sihle numei khat a tatkhiel a, Topa tungah muonhuoi loin khielna a bawl ciengin,"},"7":{"text":"a gamtatnasa mawna pulah ding hi. A tatkhielna a cingin lokia ding a, ama in tua tungah nga-ah-khat belapin a tatkhielna pa kungah pie ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A liem mipa in khielna zieha lokiana a sang ding a kinaipi tanau a nei sih leh, tua khielna zieha lokiana pen Topa kungah siempu pa adingin tung ding a, siempu pa in a khiel pa thoidam nadinga kibawl thoidamna tuutang pen zong tanbe lai ding hi.","ref":"Siem 6:1-7"},"9":{"text":"Israel-te’ silpieh siengtho zosie lahah siempu pa kunga a peipi uh letsong zosie ama-a’ hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Silpieh siengtho zosie pen amau-a’ ahi hi; mi khatpo in siempu pa tunga a pieh poma ama-a’ hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"A Muonhuoi lo Zi Tungtang Thu"},"12":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen amate kungah tam bangin gen in: Mi khatpo’ zi vahvai-in a pasal tungah a thuman sih a,"},"13":{"text":"pasal khat in tua nu na luppi-in hizongle a pasal in tua khu a thei sih a, tua nu ama le ama a kibuasah hi napi koima in thei loin a khiel laitahin zong a kimat lo ziehin ama langkhatah teci pang ding mi a op lo vangin;"},"14":{"text":"a pasal in tua nu tungah ginmawna lungsim nei-in abuasa-in a upmaw a; ahi sihle abua lo kimlai ama tungah ginmawna lungsim nei-in mi tawh tua nu a ginmaw leh;"},"15":{"text":"tua pa in siempu pa kungah a zi peipi ding hi. Tuale ama in tua nu adingin a kisam mangbuham ephah khat’ sawm-ah-khat peipi ding hi. Ama in tua tungah sathau sung loin gimnamtui zong koi lo ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile tam khu ginmawna zieha an tawh biehna ahi a, khielna phawkia nadinga an tawh biehna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in a nai-ah tua nu peipi-in Topa mai-ah koi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Siempu pa in leibeel khat tawh tui siengtho la ding a, biehbuh kem tunga leivui themkhat la-in tua tui sungah sung ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Siempu pa in numei nu’ sam hlamkhe-in Topa mai-ah koi ding a, ama’ khutah ginmawna zieha an tawh biehna ahi an tawh phawkiana biehna tawisah ding hi. Siempu pa in ama’ khut sungah samsietna tuisie tawi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in tua nu kiciemsah ding a, “Nang in na pasal’ uhna nei-a na om sungin koima’ pasal in hing luppi loin, a sieng lo lama a kihei lo na hi leh, samsiet ang tun thei tami tuisie panin suohta in."},"20":{"text":"Hizongle na pasal’ uhna nei-a na om sungin vahvai-in nang le nang na kibuasah a, na pasal simlo pasal dang khatin ang luppi a ahile,"},"21":{"text":"siempu pa in tua numei kiciemsahin ama kungah, “ Topa in na sulbu hing kiesahin na gilpi ang pawhsah ciengin, na mite lahah hamsie le kiciemna-a zah dingin Topa in hing bawl taheh;"},"22":{"text":"tu-in tami tuisie in na gil sung zui hinlen, na gilpi pawhsahin na sulbu kiesah taheh!” ci ding hi. Tuale numei in, “Amen. Amen,” ci ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in tua samsietna thu zosie laibu sungah gielin a unpi-in tuisie sungah sawp sieng ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in samsietna a tun thei tua tuisie pen numei nu dawnsah dinga, ama sungah tua tui lutin aicim taangkha bang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Siempu pa in numei nu’ khut sung panin ginmawna zieha an tawh biehna la ding a, ama in Topa mai-ah tua an tawh biehna pen vei-in maitam ah peipi ding hi;"},"26":{"text":"siempu pa in phawna satanh dingin an tawh biehna lahah khutdim khat hamin maitam tungah hal ding a, tua ciengin numei nu tuisie dawnsah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in numei nu tuisie a dawnsah zaw ciengin, numei nu ama le ama kibuasahin a pasal tunga a muonhuoi lo ahile, ama sungah samsietna a tun thei tua tuisie lutin aicim tangkha bang ding a, a gilpi pawhin a sulbu kie ding a, tuaci’n mite lahah tua numei samsietna-in kizang ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin a numei ama le ama kibuasah lo a, a sieng ahi nah leh ama a khiel lo ahi a, tuaci’n ama nu suohta-in ta nei thei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam pen a pasal’ uhna sunga a om zi khat vahvai-in a kibuasah ciengin,"},"30":{"text":"ahi sihle a pasal in ama tungah ginmawna lungsim nei-in a zi mi tawh a upmaw ciengin tua bang kiginmawna thute-a zah ding thukham ahi hi; tua ciengin ama in Topa mai-ah tua numei koi ding a, tua ciengin siempu pa in numei nu tungah tam thukham zosie zang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasal pa pen khielna panin suohta ding a, ahi vangin numei in ama’ khielna puo ding hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in Israel-te kungah tam bangin gen in:","title":"Nazir Mite"},"2":{"text":"Pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin, amau le amau Topa tunga a kituomkoi nadingun a tuom vilvela kiciemna ahi Nazir kiciemna a bawl ciengun,"},"3":{"text":"lenggazu le khamtheizu panin amate a kituomkoi ding uhi; zu pana a kibawl zuthua le adang zuthuate dawn loin, lengga a hing ahi a, a gaw ahi zongin a dawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Luk 1:15"},"4":{"text":"Nazir mite banga zia a tan sung teng uh lenggui pana pieng bangma a ne sih ding vua, a tangte ahi sihle a hawte nangawn zong a ne sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"A nazir kiciemna hun sung teng zosie-un a lutung vuah mulmetna a tukha sih ding hi; Topa adinga amau le amau kiciemna hun a cin masangsie amate a siengtho ahi ding uhi; amate in a zangsam uh a sau-in khawi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa dinga a kituomkoi hun sung zosie-un mi siluong nai-ah a pei sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"A nu ahi sihle a pa, a sanggamnu ahi sihle a sanggampa nangawn a si zongin amau le amau a kibuasah sih ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien tunga amau’ kisiensuona khu a lu tung vuah a om hi."},"8":{"text":"Nazir mite banga a om hun sung zosie uh Topa dingin a siengtho ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khatpo a gei vuah thakhatin si-in a kisiensuona sam a buasah uleh a ni sagi ni, a kisiensuo ni-in a sam uh heu ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in siempu pa kunga kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah vakhu ni ahi sihle palva no ni a tawi ding vua,"},"11":{"text":"siempu pa in khat pen mawna zieha biehna-in pie-in, adang khat pen meihal biehna-in nei ding a, amate dingin thoidamna a bawlpieh ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate pen misi luong zieha a khiel ahi uhi. Khum ni ma-in a lu a siensuo ding vua,"},"12":{"text":"nazir mite banga a tuom om uh hun sung tengin Topa dingin amate a kituomkoi ding vua, khielna zieha biehna dingin kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat a peipi ding uhi. A kisiensuosa lutang abua zo tah ziehin masang lama hunte kisim nawn lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam pen a kisiensuo hun uh a cin cienga a zui ding uh Nazir mite ngaina ahi hi: Kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah amate kipeipi ding a,"},"14":{"text":"Topa tungah a letsongte uh pie-in meihal biehna dingin kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa khat, mawna zieha biehna dingin kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno anu khat, le thunuoma biehna dingin paubang lo tuutang khat,"},"15":{"text":"le tol saw lo anlum law khat, sathau tawh kipawi annel mohte, le tol saw lo sathau kinu mophengte, le an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate a peipi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa mai-ah siempu pa in tua teng peipi ding a, mawna zieha a biehnate ule a meihal biehnate uh pie-in,"},"17":{"text":"tuutang pen thunuom biehpiehna adingin Topa tungah tol saw lo anlum law tawh pieton ding hi; siempu pa in an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehna tawh zong pieh tha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin nazir mite in kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah a kisiensuosa ahi a sam uh a heukieu-in a kisiensuo a lutang panun a samte uh a la ding vua, thunuom biehpiehna nei-a a om mei sungah hal ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Siempu pa in a kihuon minsa tuutang lieng le law sung pana tol saw lo moh khat, le tol saw lo mopheng khat la ding a, amate in a kisiensuosa a lutang vua samte a heukieu zaw ciengun nazir mite’ khutphang sungah tuate koi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna dingin siempu pa in tuate a vei ding hi; tua teng pen a awmsa le a phei tawh siempu pa adingin a siengtho ama’ tanh ahi hi. Tua ciengin nazir mite in lenggazu dawn thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tam pen kiciemna a nei nazir mite zui ding thukham ahi hi. Adang a pieh zaw zaza uh banah, Topa tunga a pieh ding uh amau’ biehna pen nazir kiciemna bang hi ding hi. Amau’ kiciemna bangin a bawl ding vua, siensuona thukham bang a zui ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 21:23-24"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Siempu Thupha Piehna"},"23":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate hopi inlen, tam bangin Israel-te thupha na pie ding uhi, ci-in gen in: Nangma in amate kungah,"},"24":{"text":"Topa in note thupha hing pie hinlen; hing kem taheh."},"25":{"text":"Topa in na tung vuah a maitang hing tangsahin, hing lungsiet taheh;"},"26":{"text":"Topa in hing maingatin, note nopsahna hing pie taheh, na ci ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te tungah keima’ min a koi ding vua, keima in amate thupha ka pie ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in biehbuh dingsahin a vanzah zosie sathau nu-in siensuo a, tuale maitam le a vanzah zosie teng sathau nu-in a siensuo a man ni-in,","title":"Lamkaite’ Biehnate"},"2":{"text":"Israel makaite, amau’ pupa innkuon makaite, a kisim mite a uh minam makaite in biehna a pie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in a tungkhu nei leeng guh le bawngtang sawm le ni, makai ni in leng khat ciet, makai khat in bawngtang khat ciet Topa mai-ah biehna-in a peipi uhi; amate in biehbuh mai-ah tuate a pie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:"},"5":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh nasepna-a zah dingin amate tung panin tam teng sang inlen, a nasep ciet utawh kizui-in Levi-te pie in."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in leengte le bawngtangte la-in Levi-te tungah tuate a pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Amau’ nasep tawh kizui-in Gershon-te kungah leeng ni le bawngtang li a pie hi;"},"8":{"text":"ama in siempu Aaron’ tapa Ithamar uhna nei-ah na a sem Merari-te tungah a nasep utawh kizui-in leeng li le bawngtang giet a pie hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in Kohath-te tungah bangma pie lo hi. Azieh pen liengko-a a puoh ding uh siengtho nate kep ding amate tavuon kipie hi."},"10":{"text":"Maitam sathau a kinu hun ciengin makaite in zong maitam apna ding biehnate a pie uhi; makaite in a biehna uh maitam mai-ah a pie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Maitam ap nadingin makai khat in ni khat ciet a biehna uh pie ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"A ni masa ni-a biehna piepa pen Judah minam, Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon ahi hi;"},"13":{"text":"ama’ silpieh pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dinga sathau tawh kihal annel tuituoh tua a kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"14":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"15":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"16":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"17":{"text":"thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon’ silpieh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni ni ni-in Issachar-te makai Zuar’ tapa Nethanel in biehna a pie hi;"},"19":{"text":"a biehna dingin ama in mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun pakan khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuongdai khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau tawh kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"20":{"text":"shekel sawmsagi a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"21":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"22":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"23":{"text":"thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga a hi hi. Tam pen Zuar’ tapa Nethanel’ silpieh ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Zebulun-te makai Helon’ tapa Eliab ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"26":{"text":"shekel sawmsagi a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"27":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"28":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"29":{"text":"thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Helon’ tapa Eliab’ silpieh ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"A ni li ni-in Reuben-te makai Shedeur’ tapa Elizur ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau tawh a kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong tegel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"32":{"text":"shekel sawmsagi a khai gimnamtui kham pakan khat;"},"33":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"34":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"35":{"text":"thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Shedeur’ tapa Elizur’ silpieh ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"A ni nga ni-in Simeon-te makai Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel ahi hi:"},"37":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau tawh kihal annel tuituoh kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"38":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"39":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"40":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"41":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel’ silpieh ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"A ni guh ni-in Gad-te makai Deuel’ tapa Eliasaph ahi hi:"},"43":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"44":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat tawh;"},"45":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"46":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"47":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Deuel’ tapa Eliasaph’ silpieh ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in Ephraim-te makai Ammihud’ tapa Elishama ahi hi:"},"49":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"50":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"51":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"52":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"53":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Ammihud’ tapa Elishama’ silpieh ahi hi."},"54":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in Manasseh-te makai Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel ahi hi:"},"55":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"56":{"text":"shekel sawmsagi a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"57":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"58":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"59":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel’ silpieh ahi hi."},"60":{"text":"A ni kuo ni-in Benjamin-te makai Gideoni’ tapa Abidan ahi hi:"},"61":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"62":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"63":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"64":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"65":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Gideoni’ tapa Abidan’ silpieh ahi hi."},"66":{"text":"A ni sawm ni-in Dan-te makai Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer ahi hi:"},"67":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"68":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"69":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"70":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"71":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga a hi hi. Tam pen Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer’ silpieh ahi hi."},"72":{"text":"A ni sawm le khat ni-in Asher-te makai Okran’ tapa Pagiel ahi hi:"},"73":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"74":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"75":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat;"},"76":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"77":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Tam pen Okran’ tapa Pagiel’ silpieh ahi hi."},"78":{"text":"A sawm le ni ni-in Naphtali-te makai Enan’ tapa Ahira ahi hi:"},"79":{"text":"Ama biehna pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel zakhat le sawmthum a khai ngun kuongdai khat, shekel sawmsagi a khai ngun kuong khat, an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh tua kuong gel a dimvum tuoh tawh;"},"80":{"text":"shekel sawm a khai gimnamtui a dim kham pakan khat;"},"81":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat,"},"82":{"text":"mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat;"},"83":{"text":"le thunuom biehpiehna dingin bawngtang ni, tuutang nga, keel apa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga hi hi. Tam pen Enan’ tapa Ahira’ silpieh ahi hi."},"84":{"text":"Maitam sathau a kinu ni-in tua maitam ap nadinga Israel lamkaite in a pieh uh biehna pen tam teng ahi hi: Ngun kuongdai sawm le ni, ngun kuong sawm le ni,"},"85":{"text":"ngun kuongdai khat ciengin shekel zakhat le sawmthum khai-in ngun kuong khat ciengin shekel sawmsagi khai a, ngun kuong zosie pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel tulni le zali khai hi."},"86":{"text":"Gim namtui a dim kham pakan sawm le nite, mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in khat in shekel sawm khai a, kham pakan zosie shekel zakhat le sawmni khai hi;"},"87":{"text":"meihal biehna dingin ganhon zosie ahi bawngtang sawm le ni, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawm le ni, an tawh biehnate tawh; tuale mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa sawm le ni;"},"88":{"text":"thunuom biehpiehna dingin ganhon zosie ahi bawngtang sawmni le li, tuutang sawmguh, keel apa sawmguh, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawmguh ahi hi. Tam teng pen maitam sathau a kinu zaw cienga apna biehnate ahi hi."},"89":{"text":"Kikhopna buh sungah Topa tawh kiho dingin Moses a lut ciengin cherub ni gel kikal thuciemna singkuong tunga om hepina topha tung panin ama a hopi awging a za hi; tua bang awging in Moses a hopi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Meivah Sagite (Pei 25:31-40)"},"2":{"text":"Aaron hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Meivahte na koi ciengin meivah sagite in meivah tunna mai teng a tan dingin koi in."},"3":{"text":"Tua bangin Aaron in a bawl hi. Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin ama in meivah tunna mai teng a tan dingin meivahte koi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam meivah tunna kibawl dan pen kham tawh kiseh ahi hi. A tunna panin a papete dongin a kiseh ahi hi; Topa in Moses a lahsa lim dan dung zui-in ama in meivah tunna a bawl hi.","ref":"Pei 25:31-40; 37:17-24"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Kisiensuona le Levi-te’ Nasep"},"6":{"text":"Israel-te lah panin Levi-te ladawh inlen siensuo in."},"7":{"text":"Amate siensuo nadingin a tung vuah tam bangin bawl in: Siensuona tui a tung vuah the inlen, a pumtung zosie uh mulmetna tawh metsah inlen, a puonte uh sawpin amate ma na kisiensuosah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin bawngtangno khat le sathau kihal annel tuituoh tawh kibawl an tawh biehna na la sah ding a, nang in mawna zieha biehna dingin adang bawngtangno khat na la ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh mai-ah Levi-te na zawpi ding a, Israel mihon buppi na khawm ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa mai-ah Levi-te na zawpi ciengin Israel-te in Levi-te tungah a khut uh a ngam ding vua,"},"11":{"text":"amate in Topa’ na a sep thei nadingun Aaron in Israel-te lah panin Levi-te, Topa mai-ah a kivei biehna-in a pie ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Levi-te in bawngtangte’ lu tungah khut a ngam ding vua, Levi-te ading thoidamna bawl nadingin Topa tungah mawna zieha biehna-in khat, meihal biehna-in a khat, na pie ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron le a tapate mai-ah Levi-te na dingsah ding a, Topa tunga a kivei biehna-in amate na pie ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua bangin Israel-te lah panin Levi-te na tuomkoi ding a, Levi-te keima-a’ hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate siensuo-in a kivei biehna-in na pieh zaw ciengin kikhopna puonbuh-ah na sem dingin Levi-te lut ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel-te lah panin kei tungah amate ang kipie sieng ahi ta uhi. Israel-te’ tacil zosie, naubu a hong masa zosie tangin keima adingin amate ka la zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel-te lah panin tacil zosie mihing hile ganhing hile a nipi-in keima-a’ ahi hi. Egypt gam sungah tacil zosie ka thagam ni-in keima dingin amate ka siensuo a,","ref":"Pei 13:2"},"18":{"text":"ahi vangin Israel-te lah panin tacil zosie tangin Levi- te ka la zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tham loin kikhopna puonbuh-ah Israel-te dinga na sem ding le mun siengtho tawh kinai-a a pei Israel-te lahah gimna a tun lo nadinga thoidamna a bawlpieh dingin Israel-te lah panin Aaron le a tapate tungah letsongin Levi-te ka pie zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses le Aaron le Israel mihonpi zosie in Levi-te tungah tua bangin a bawl uhi; amate tawh kisai-in Topa in Moses kunga a thupiehsa bang lien ma-in Israel-te in Levi-te tungah a bawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mawna panin Levi-te kisiensuo-in a puonte a sawpsieng uhi; tua ciengin Aaron in a kivei biehna-in Topa mai-ah amate pie a, a sientho nadingun Aaron in amate dingin thoidamna a bawlpieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron le a tapate opna kikhopna puonbuh sunga na a sem dingin Levi-te a sungtum uhi. Levi-te tawh kisai-in Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin amate tungah a bawl uhi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"24":{"text":"Tam pen Levi-te tunga zah ding ahi hi: Kikhopna puonbuh nasepna sunga a sem dingin kum sawmni le nga pan a tungsie a phate kipan ding uhi;"},"25":{"text":"tuale kum sawmnga a phah vua kipanin nasepna pan khawlin bangma a sem nawn sih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh sunga a sanggamte a hu thei bep ding vua, hizongle amate in na a sem nawn sih ding uhi. Tam bangin Levi-te nasep ding na sepieh ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate Egypt panin a peizaw uh a kum ni cin kum, a hla khatna sungin Sinai senel gamah Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Sinai-ah Peisan Pawi Kibawl (Pei 12:1-20)"},"2":{"text":"A kise hunin Israel-te in peisan pawi bawlsah in."},"3":{"text":"A kise hun, tami hla ni sawm le li khuomut ciengin a thukham zosiete le a ngainate tawh kizui-in na bawl ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in Israel-te kungah peisan pawi a bawl nadingun a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"A hla masa, a ni sawm le li khuomut ciengin Sinai senel gamah amate in peisan pawi a bawl uhi. Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bang lienin Israel-te gamta uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:1-13"},"6":{"text":"Tu-in misi luong thamkhah zieha abua mi pawlkhat om a, tuaci’n khum ni-in amate in peisan pawi a bawl sih uhi. Khum ni-in Moses le Aaron mai-ah amate a pei vua,"},"7":{"text":"ama kungah, “Misi luong thamkhahna ziehin ka sientho sih vangun a kise hunin Israel-te lahah bang dingin Topa’ biehna ei kipiesah lo ahei?” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Moses in amate kungah, “Note’ thu tawh kisai-in Topa’ thupieh ka zah masangsie na ngah tadi un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"10":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Note lahah mi khatpo in ahi a, na suon na hlahte uh khatpo in ahi zongin misi luong a khoikhah ziehin abua ahi a, ahi sihle a khuolzin laitah ahile Topa tungah amate in peisan pawi a bawl thei lai veve ding vua,"},"11":{"text":"a hla nina a ni sawm le li ni khuomut ciengin pawi bawlin lopa khaate tawh tol saw lo anlum me ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Zingmawng dongin bangma hen nei loin a gute zong a tawngsah sih ding uhi; amate in peisan pawi ngaina zosie tawh kizui-in a bawl ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:46; Jhn 19:36"},"13":{"text":"Hizongle khuolzin lo napi-in a sieng mi khatpo in peisan pawi a bawl sih leh a kise huna Topa’ biehna pie lo ahi ziehin a mite kung panin kihemkhie ding hi; tua bang mipa in a mawna paat a thuoh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Note lahah a teng pemta khatpo in Topa tungah peisan pawi a bawl nop leh peisan pawi thukhamte le a ngaina kipte bangin bawl ding hi; note in pemtate le tuolsung mite dingin ngaina a kibang na nei ton ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Biehbuh a din ni-in meii in biehbuh le thuciemna biehbuh a tuomcip hi; tuale nitah panin zingmawng cieng dongin biehbuh tung son-ah meikuong bangin a om hi.","title":"Meiilum le Mei (Pei 13:21-22 ; 40:34-38)"},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin a om den hi: Sunin meii in tuomin zanin meikuong tawh kibang khat in a tuom hi."},"17":{"text":"Puonbuh tung pan tua meii a kilahto popo ciengin Israel-te a dingkhie uhi; tuale meii khawlna munah Israel-te in giephuol a sat uhi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehna tawh Israel-te a dingkhie vua, Topa’ thupiehna tawh giephuol a sat uhi. Biehbuh tungah meii a khawl laisie giephuol-ah amate a om uhi."},"19":{"text":"Biehbuh tungah ni tampi sung meii a om cieng nangawnin Israel-te in Topa’ sawlna mangin a dingkhie sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ni tawmno khat sung biehbuh tungah meii om thei zel a, Topa’ thupieh tawh kizui-in giephuol-ah a om uhi. Tua ciengin Topa’ thupieh tawh kizui-in amate a dingkhie uhi."},"21":{"text":"Khat veivei nitah pan zingmawng dongin tua meii a om hi; tuale zingmawngin meii a kilahto ciengin amate a dingkhie vua, ahi sihle sun khat le zan khat a omlai le zong, meii a kilahto ciengin amate a dingkhie uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ni ni ahi a, hla khat ahi a, a hun sauzaw ahi zongin, biehbuh tung sonah meii a khawl laisie giephuol-ah Israel-te om denin a dingkhie sih uhi; hizongle tua meii a kilahto ciengin a dingkhie uhi."},"23":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehna tawh amate in giephuol a sat vua, Topa’ thupiehna tawh a dingkhie uhi. Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin amate in Topa’ sawlna a mang uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Ngun Pengkulte"},"2":{"text":"Ngun pengkul ni bawl in; tuate na bawl ciengin na kheng ding a, mipite khop nading le giephuol phel nadingin tuate na zang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A ni-in a kimuton ciengin kikhopna puonbuh lutna nangma mai-ah mihon buppi kikhawm ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle khat beh a kimut leh nangma mai-ah Israel minamte’ lutang ahi makaite kikhawm ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Patau pengkul na mut ciengin nisuona lam panga giephuol-ate dingkhie-in;"},"6":{"text":"patau pengkul a ni veina na mut ciengin leitaw lama giephuol-ate dingkhie ding uhi. Amate a dinkhiet ding poma ciengun patau pengkul kimut ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin mihonpi a kikaikhop ding ciengin pengkul na mut ding a, hizongle patau pengkul na mut sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aaron’ tapa siempute in pengkul a mut ding uhi; tami khu note dinga na khang tawntung vua a kipden ngaina khat hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na gam sung vuah note ang gawt na galte do dinga na kuon ciengun, Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah ang kiphaw nadingin pengkulte tawh patauna aw na gingsah ding vua, tuaci’n na galte khut uh sung panin ang kihundam ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na lungdam hun uh, a kise na pawi hunte uh, na hla kipat hunte uh, na meihal biehnate ule na thunuom biehpiehnate vuah zong pengkulte na tum ding uhi; tuate pen na Pasien uh mai-ah note phawna-in kimang ding hi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"11":{"text":"A kum nina, a hla nina, a ni sawmnina ni-in thuciemna biehbuh tung son panin meii kilato hi.","title":"Sinai Pana Dinkhietna"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Sinai senel gam panin phuol khat pan phuol khatah Israel-te a dingkhie vua, tuaci’n Paran gamlahah meii a khawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses tungtawnin Topa’ thupiehna tawh amate a khat veina khuolzin a kipan uhi."},"14":{"text":"Judah giephuol dielkhai neite a pawlpawlin a dingkhie masa vua, Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon in mihon buppi a makai hi."},"15":{"text":"Zuar’ tapa Nethanel in Issachar minam honpite makai hi;"},"16":{"text":"Helon’ tapa Eliab in Zebulun minam honpite makai hi."},"17":{"text":"Biehbuh a kiphel ciengin biehbuh a puo Gershon-te le Merari-te a dingkhie uhi."},"18":{"text":"A zomah Reuben-te’ giephuol dielkhai neite a pawlpawlin a dingkhie uhi; tuale Shedeur’ tapa Elizur in tua mihon buppi a makai hi."},"19":{"text":"Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel in Simeon minam honpite a makai a,"},"20":{"text":"Deuel’ tapa Eliasaph in Gad minam honpite a makai hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin a siengtho nate a puo Kohath-te a dingkhie uhi; amate tun masangin biehbuh na kiphut zo hi."},"22":{"text":"A zomah Ephraim-te’ giephuol dielkhai neite a pawlpawlin a dingkhie vua, Ammihud’ tapa Elishama in tua mihon buppi a makai hi."},"23":{"text":"Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel in Manasseh minam honpite a makai a,"},"24":{"text":"Gideoni’ tapa Abidan in Benjamin minam honpite a makai hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin giephuol zosie’ nuadala a pang Dan mite’ giephuol dielkhai neite a pawlpawlin a dingkhie vua, Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer in tua minam honpite a makai hi."},"26":{"text":"Ochran’ tapa Pagiel in Asher minam honpite a makai a,"},"27":{"text":"Enan’ tapa Ahira in Naphtali minam honpite a makai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam pen Israel-te a dinkhiet cieng vua a pawlpawla a pei dan uh ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in a sungpa Midian mi Reuel’ tapa Hobab kungah, “ Topa in, ‘Na tung vuah kang pie ding hi,’ a cina mun zuona pei ding ka hi uhi. Hing pei inlen ko tawh zawhton vai, nang kang limbawl ding uhi; azieh pen Topa in Israel-te tungah sil hoi pieh ding ei kamciem zo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “Kang pei sih ding hi. Ka leitang le ka tanaute kungah ka pei zaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Kote ei taisan sin. Azieh pen gamlahah giephuol sat nading mun na thei ziehin ka lampu ding uh na hibo hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua banah kote ei zui lacin, Topa in ka tung vua a sep sil hoi poma kote tawh kibangin kang bawlpieh ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ muol panin amate dingkhie-in ni thum peina khuol a zin vua, khawl mun sui dingin a masang vuah Topa’ thuciemna singkuong, nithum lam na peikhol hi."},"34":{"text":"Giephuol pan amate a dinkhiet ciengun sunin a tung vuah Topa’ meii a om hi."},"35":{"text":"Singkuong a dinkhiet popo ciengin Moses in, “ Topa aw, tho-in, na galte kithezah hinlen, nang ang mudate na mai panin taimang ta uheh,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 68:1"},"36":{"text":"A khawl popo ciengin ama in, “ Topa aw, Israel a tul a tul sawmte kungah hing kinuale in,” a ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tuosietnate ziehun Topa’ zahin mite a phun ciengin Topa in tua thu za-in lungthah mama hi. Tua ciengin amate langkhatah Topa’ mei kuongin giephuol ninglam kimkhat a katum hi.","title":"Senel Gama Phunna"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses tungah mite a kiko vua, Topa kungah Moses in thungen a, tua mei a mit hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ mei in amate a kahtum ziehin khum mun pen Taberah kici hi."},"4":{"text":"Amahaw lahah om mi nautangte in antui a dugaw mama uhi; tuale Israel-te zong a kapkia vua, “I neh ding sa nei beh lei izaw!"},"5":{"text":"Egypt gamah man pieh lo-a i neh uh ngate, tangmaite, dawnpawlte, kaisuon pumte, kaisuon sante, le kaisuon kangte i phawh uhi;"},"6":{"text":"ahi vangin tu-in i tha i zung uh lah a bei sieng ta a, i et ding uh tam manna simlo bangma dang om poma lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Manna pen nanan tang tawh kibang a, a mel bedolak singnai tawh kibang hi."},"8":{"text":"Mite pei kawikawi-in a khawm vua, an gawina tawh gawi-in ahi sihle sum sungah a suguoi vua, beel sungh huonin mohin a bawl uhi; a tui dan pen sathau tawh kikangzol sipsep moh tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pei 16:31"},"9":{"text":"Zanin giephuol tungah vua a kieh ciengin manna tawh kieton hi.","ref":"Pei 16:13-15"},"10":{"text":"A puonbuh lutna zosie vuah a innkuonkuonin mite’ kaana Moses in a za hi. Tua ciengin Topa lungthah mama ahi ziehin Moses lungkim lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in Topa kungah, “Bang dingin na nasempa ei ci bawlsiet na hei? Bang dingin na maipha ei musah loin tam mite zosie’ vangih kei tunga nang ngah ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Tam mite zosie ka gil sunga ka pai amah? A pu a pate tungah pieh dinga ka ciemsa leitangah, ‘Nau cingnu in nawitep lai nausen a puoh bangin amate na kang sungah puo inlen peipi in,’ ci-in nang in kei kunga nei ci thei nadingin amate kei sunga pieng ahi uh amah?"},"13":{"text":"Tam mite zosie ka pieh ding hei sungah sa nga mawh ding ka hei? Bangzieh ahei cile amate kap kawmin ka kungah, ‘Ka neh ding uh sa ei pie in!’ a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam mi zosie kei guohin ka ci nading ka thei sih hi. Azieh pen kei adingin amate puoh gih luo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam banga kei ei bawl ding na hi leh thakhatin ei that zaw vet in. Na muna-ah maipha ka nga leh ka gentheina ei musah sin,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Moses kungah, “Nang in mite’ upa le a tung vuah ulien sem hi, ci-a na thei Israel upa mi sawmsagi kei adingin ei kholpieh in; kikhopna buhah amate zawpi inlen tua munah amate nang tawh mun hing lasah in.","title":"Upa Sawm Sagite"},"17":{"text":"Keima hing kumsuhin khum munah nang tawh i kiho ding hi; na sunga om ka hla themkhat ladawhin amau’ sungah ka guong ding hi; nang guohin a unpi-in na puoh lo nadingin amate in mite’ vangih ang puohpi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Mite kungah, ‘Zing cieng adingin no le no kisiensuo un, sa na ne ding uh; bang ding ahei cile Topa’ zahin na kap vua, ‘I neh ding uh sa nei lei izaw! Eite adingin Egypt gam a nuomzaw tahtah hi,’ na ci uhi. Tua ahi ziehin Topa in sa ang pie ding a, na ne ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ni khat sung beh, ahi sihle ni ni sung beh, ahi sihle ni nga sung beh, ahi sihle ni sawm sung beh, ahi sihle ni sawmni sung beh ne khop loin,"},"20":{"text":"na nahkua hawm vua a let masangsie le na luohsuo dong ciengun hla khat sung tungtawn sa na ne ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile note in na lah vua om Topa nuolin ama’ mai-ah na kap vua, “Bang dinga Egypt i nuasie uh ahei?” na ci uhi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in, “Keima tawh a kisimton lei galkap tul zaguh pha hi; nang in, ‘Hla khat tungtawn a neh dingun amate sa pie vang!” na ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate dingin tuuhonte le bawnghonte kigo leh a kicingzo ding amah? Amate dingin tuipi sunga ngate kiman leh a kicingzo ding amah?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “ Topa’ sil bawltheina a kiciengtan na sa amah? Ka thugente nang adingin a mana ang tun leh ang tun lo tu-in na mu ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses pei-in mite kungah Topa’ thugen teng a gen a, ama in mite’ upa sawmsagi kaikhawmin puonbuh kimvelah a omsah hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin meii sungah Topa kumsuhin ama hopi a, ama’ sunga hla themkhat ladawhin upa sawmsagite sungah a guong hi; tuale amate tungah tua hla a tuh ciengin kamsangte bangin thu a gen uhi. Hizongle tua bangin amate a gamtakia nawn sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Giephuol-ah mi ni a om vua, khat Eldad kici-in, a khat Medad kici a, ama gel sungah tua hla a lut hi. Misimna-ah ama gel a kihal vua, hinanle puonbuh-ah pei loin giephuol-ah thuphuon a gen uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tangval khat tai-in Moses kungah, “Eldad le Medad in giephuol sungah thuphuon gen uhi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuale ama’ teel mite lahah Moses’ nasem Nun’ tapa Joshua in, “Ka pu Moses, ama gel khawlsah in!” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in ama kungah, “Kei adinga a thangsie na hi amah? Topa’ mite zosie kamsang hi sieng hinlen, Topa in a sung vuah a hla hing guong leh ka cizaw a!” a ci hi,"},"30":{"text":"Tuale giephuol-ah Moses le Israel upate a kilekia uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa kung pan hui langin tua hui in tuipi panin vamimte puoh a, giephuol kung tam lampang ni khat peina cieng, khum lampang ni khat peina cieng ma, giephuol gei-ah kiesah a, lei maitang tungah pi thum bang a sa hi.","title":"Vamimte"},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n sun tungtawn, zan tungtawn le a zing cieng tungtawnin mite in vamimte a khawm uhi; a tawm khop pen in homer sawm a khawm vua, amate dingin giephuol kimvelah tuate a pho uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin vamim’ sa a kikhawn masang, a hakawm vuah sa baang laipi ma-in mite tungah Topa’ lungthahna kikuontaw a, gimna lienpi khat tawh Topa in mite a vatmai hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum mun pen Kibroth-hattaavah kici hi. Azieh pen khum munah amate in sa dugaw mite a vui uhi."},"35":{"text":"Kibroth-hattaavah panin Hazeroth dongin mite a zin uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hazeroth-ah amate a ten laita hun Moses in Cush numei khat kinunpi ahi ziehin a kinunpi Cush numei tungtangah Miriam le Aaron in ama gensie hi;","title":"Miriam le Aaron in Moses Haza"},"2":{"text":"tuale ama gel in, “ Moses tungtawn beha Topa in thu gen ahi amah? Eite tung zong tawnin thu gen hi lo amah?” a ci uhi. Topa in tua thu a za hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Moses kici pa pen leitunga om mi zosie sangin mi nunnem zaw ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in thakhatthu-in Moses, Aaron le Miriam kungah, “Kikhopna puonbuhah no teng thum hing pei un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a thumun a pei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin meii lahah Topa kumsuhin kikhopna puonbuh lutna ah dingin Aaron le Miriam hlan hi; tuale ama gel zong mai lamah a pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in ama gel kungah, “Ka thugente ngai un: Na lah vuah kamsangte a op ciengin, keima Topa in mangmunate tawh a tung vuah keima le keima ka kitheisah a; mang sungah zong amate ka hopi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka nasem Moses tawh tua bang ahi sih a; ka inn sung thu vannuoi ama ki-ap sieng ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 3:2"},"8":{"text":"Keima in ama tawh kimaituo-in thu ka gen a, a kitel lo kamham tawh hi loin; a kiteltahin ka hopi a, tuaci’n ama in Topa’ mel a mu hi. Tua ahile bang dinga ka nasempa Moses gensiet ding zau lo na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama gel tungah Topa’ lungthahna kuongin a pei ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Puonbuh tung panin meii a pei ciengin Miriam phah a, vua bangin a ngo hi. Miriam lamah Aaron a kihei leh tua numei a phah lam a mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aaron in Moses kungah, “Ka pu aw, ka mot gamtat zieh vua ka bawl uh mawna ziehin kote dan ei pie sin."},"12":{"text":"Ama a nu gilsung pan a suo cienga atel avo alang beisa-a suoh nausen hing bangsah sin,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale Moses in Topa kungah, “Ama damsah in, Pasien aw, hing thum ing,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Moses kungah, “A pa in tua numei’ maitang cilphit leh tua numei ni sagi sung zumsi lo ding amah? Ni sagi sung giephuol pulamah ama puse inlen, tua zaw ciengin ama kipeipi kia thei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 5:2-3"},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n giephuol pulamah ni sagi sung Miriam kipuse hi; tuale Miriam a kipeipi masangsie khuolzin zom dingin mite a dingkhie sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Hazeroth panin mite a dingkhie vua, Paran gamlahah giephuol a sat uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah,","title":"Canaan-ah Thukante Kisawl (Thkna 1:19-33)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel-te tunga ka pieh Canaan gam vaan dingin mite sawl inlen, amate lahah makai ahi, minam khat sung panin mi khat ciet sawl in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ thupieh tawh kizui-in Moses in Paran gamlah panin Israel-te lahah makai zosie a sawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ min tam teng ahi hi: Reuben minam panin Zaccur’ tapa Shammua;"},"5":{"text":"Simeon minam panin Hori’ tapa Shaphat;"},"6":{"text":"Judah minam panin Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb;"},"7":{"text":"Issachar minam panin Joseph’ tapa Igal;"},"8":{"text":"Ephraim minam panin Nun’ tapa Hoshea;"},"9":{"text":"Benjamin minam panin Raphu’ tapa Palti;"},"10":{"text":"Zebulun minam panin Sodi’ tapa Gaddiel;"},"11":{"text":"Joseph minam (Manasseh minam) panin Susi’ tapa Gaddi;"},"12":{"text":"Dan minam panin Gemalli’ tapa Ammiel;"},"13":{"text":"Asher minam panin Michael’ tapa Sethur;"},"14":{"text":"Naphtali minam panin Vophsi’ tapa Nahbi;"},"15":{"text":"Gad minam panin Machi’ tapa Geuel ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam teng pen gam ensim dinga Moses in a sawl mite’ min ahi hi. Nun’ tapa Hoshea pen Moses in Joshua ci-in a min khelpieh hi."},"17":{"text":"Moses in Canaan gam vaan dingin amate sawlin a kung vuah, “Negeb gam sung khum munah peito-in, muoltung gamah kato unlen,"},"18":{"text":"a gam bang tawh kibang a, a sunga teng mite thahat maw, ahi sihle zawngkhal, citawm maw, ahi sihle citam,"},"19":{"text":"a tenna gam uh hoi maw, ahi sihle hoi lo, a tenna a khuopite uh giephuol maimai maw, ahi sihle kulpi tawh ki-im maw,"},"20":{"text":"a leitang lei hoi maw, ahi sihle hoi lo, tua sungah sing po maw, ahi sihle po lo, hing en ta un. Hangsan unlen tua gama a ga pawlkhat zong hing peipi ta un,” a ci hi. Khum hun pen lengga palte min hun tah ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate a peito vua, Zin gamlah panin Lebo-hamath khuo gei Rehob mun dongin gam a vaan uhi."},"22":{"text":"Negeb lamah amate peito-in Hebron a tung uhi; tua munah Anak’ suon le hlahte ahi Ahiman-te, Shesai-te, le Talmai-te a na om uhi. (Hebron khuo pen Egypt gama Zoan khuo sangin kum sagi-in kisat masazaw hi.)"},"23":{"text":"Eshcol Kuom a tung vua, khum munah lengga bawh khat beh a ba tawh sattanin mihing ni in ciengzawl khatin a zawngton uhi. Amate in mang kawlsingte le thei themkhat zong a puo uhi."},"24":{"text":"Israel-te in khum tah panin a bawh khat a sattan ziehun khum mun pen Eshcol Kuom kici hi."},"25":{"text":"Ni sawmli a cin zaw ciengin gam vaanna panin amate kilekia uhi.","title":"Thukante Thupuohna"},"26":{"text":"Paran gamlah Kadesh mun Moses le Aaron le Israel mihonte kungah amate a tung uhi; tuale mihon zosie’ tung le amate tungah thu a puoh vua, tua leitanga gate amate a lah uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amate in Moses kungah, “Nei sawlna leitang ka va pha ta uhi; tua gamah bawngnawi le khuoizu luong a, tam khu a gate ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hizongle tua gama tengte a thahat vua, a khuopite uh kul tawh a ki-im a, zong gol thei mama hi; tam teng banah khum munah Anak’ suonlehlahte ka mu uhi."},"29":{"text":"Negeb gamah Amalek-te a teng uhi; muoltung gamah Hit-te, Jebus-te, le Amor-te teng uhi; tuipi gei le Jordan gun dungah Canaan-te a teng uhi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Caleb in Moses mai-ah a mite sipsahin amate kungah, “Thakhatin pei-in a gam uh va la ta vai, azieh pen khum gam i zo thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tawh a peito mite in, “Tua mite do dinga kuonto zo ding i hi malmal sih uhi. Bang zieh ahei cile amate pen eite sanga a hatzaw mawngmawng uh ahi bo hi,” a ci uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a sielamin Israel-te tungah a gam vanna uh thu a puoh vua, “A van dinga ka va peina uh leitang in a sunga tengte a valtum hi. Khum gam sunga mi ka mu vannuoi uh gol thei mama uhi."},"33":{"text":"Khum munah Nephilim-te (Nephilim panin Anak-te pieng hi) ka mu uhi; amate lahah ko le ko ka ki-et ciengun khuombai cie behin ka kimu vua, amau’ ei muna-ah zong tua bangma ka hi lel uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Pien 6:4"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin mihon zosie khum zanin kiko-in a kap vapo uhi.","title":"Mite in Ledo"},"2":{"text":"Tuale Israel-te zosie in Moses le Aaron a phunsan vua, mihon buppi in a kung vuah, “Egypt gamah kisi dawh ta lei izaw! Ahi sihle tami gamlahah kisi dawh ta lei izaw!"},"3":{"text":"Bang dinga Topa in tami gamah namsau-a si dinga ei na peipi a ta diei? Ka zite ule ka nausente uh lah galte’ hingmat ding bep ahi ta uhi; Egypt gamah kilekia uleng hoizaw lo ding amah?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate khatlekhat a kiho vua, “Makai khat tel vai-in, Egypt-ah kilekia vai,” a kici uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm Israel mihonpi zosie’ mai-ah Moses le Aaron a khupboh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale gam vante lahah a kihal Nun’ tapa Joshua le Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb in a puonte a botkeh vua,"},"7":{"text":"Israel mihon buppi kungah, “A van dinga ka va peina uh gam pen a hoi mama gam khat ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Eite tunga Topa a lungkim leh bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna khum gamah ei peipi-in khum gam ei pie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa langpan sih popo unlen; tua gama mite giing sih un, azieh pen eite dingin amate pen i neh ding uh an ahi bo uhi; a kung panun a kidalna uh kiladawh ahi ta a, Topa in eite ei ompi hi; amate giing sih un,” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin mihon buppi in suong tawh selia dingin amate a galgih uhi. Tua ciengin kikhopna puonbuh sunga om Israel mi zosie tungah Topa’ minthanna a kilang hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Tam mite in bang tanvei kei ei simmaw ding uh ahei? Amate lahah ka bawlsa limte om napi bang tanvei kei ei um lolai ding uh ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Pul natna tawh amate vatmai-in tapa’ za panin ka phiet ding a, amate sanga a lienzaw le a thahatzaw minamin nangma kang bawl ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Topa kungah, “Tua hi mawh leh Egypt-te in tua thu a na za ding uhi. Azieh pen nangma in amate lah panin na thahatna tawh tam mite na peipi ahi a,","title":"Mite Dingin Moses in Thumpieh"},"14":{"text":"amate in tam gam mite kungah tua thu a na gen ding uhi. Topa aw, amate in tam mite laizangah na om lam za zo uhi; bang ding ahei cile Topa aw, kimaituo-in nang ang kimu a, amate tungah nangma’ meii zamin sun ciengin meiilumin, zan ciengin meikuongin a masang vuah na pei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in tam mite a unpi-un tha khatin that sieng mawh lacin nangma’ thu a zasa minamte in,"},"16":{"text":"‘Amahaw tunga pieh dinga a kamciemsa leitangah Topa in tam mite tut zo lo ahi ziehin ama in gamlahah amate thatgam ta hi,’ ci ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in nangma in hopi-in na kam ciem a,"},"18":{"text":"‘ Topa lungthah bai loin, a itna kip kicing a, mawna le khielnate maisahin, hinanle a mawte siengsah loin, pate’ mawna tate tungah, khang thum khang lina dongin thuh hi,’ na ci ciengin Topa a vang lien taheh."},"19":{"text":"Egypt gama a peikhiet vua kipan tu dong nangawnin tam mite’ khielna na maisah ma bangin a lien mama na itna kip dung zui-in tam mite’ khielna maisah in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Na nget bangin ka maisah hi;"},"21":{"text":"hinanle - kei ka nungta a, Topa’ minthanna khu leitung kidim ding ahi ma bangin-"},"22":{"text":"Egypt le gamlahah ka bawlsa ka vanglietna le ka limte mu zo napi-in keima sawmvei ei ze-etin ka aw a ngai lo mite in,"},"23":{"text":"a pate uh tunga pieh dinga ka ciem leitang koima in a mu sih ding uhi; keima ei simmaw mi koima khat beh in tua leitang a mu sih ding uhi.","ref":"Heb 3:18"},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka nasempa Caleb in lungsim tuom a puo a, lungsim tahpi tawh keima ei zui ahi ziehin a va peina gamah ama ka peipi ding a, a suonlehlahte in tua gam a luo ding uhi.","ref":"Josh 14:9-12"},"25":{"text":"Tu-in khum kuom tengah Amalek-te le Canaan-te a ten ziehun zing ciengin kihei-in San Tuipi zotna lampi zui-in gamlahah pei un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in ama gel kungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Kibusim Sawmna Lenankia"},"27":{"text":"“Tam a gilo mihonte in bang tanvei kei ei mawsah ding uh ahei? Keima in Israel-te’ ei mawsahna ka za zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate kungah gen in: Topa in, “Kei a nungta ka hi ma bangin tua na thugente ma uh na tung vuah kang bawl ding hi,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami gamah na luonghawmte uh lum ding hi; na mi phaza zosie uh, mi kisimna sunga kihal teng, pasal kum sawmni pana tungsie, kei ei phunsante,","ref":"Heb 3:17"},"30":{"text":"Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb le Nun’ tapa Joshua simlo, na tenna ding vua ka kiciemna leitangah khat beh na tung sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin galte mat ding na ci uh na tasente uh ka peipi ding a, amate in na thusim lo uh leitang a thei ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin note na hi uleh tami gamlahah na luong uh a lum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Anukhia pen gamlahah na luonghawm uh a kisiel masang, gamlahah na tate uh kum sawmli sung tuucing ahi ding vua, na up lona ziehun amate in gimna a thuoh ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 7:36"},"34":{"text":"Note in na gam van sung ni phaza tawh kizui-in ni sawmli, ni khat ciengin kum khat, na khielna uh kum sawmli sung na thuoh ding vua, ka lungkimlona na thei ding uhi,’ a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Keima Topa in ka gen zo hi; kei ei do dinga kikhawm tam a gilo mihon zosie tungah tam bangin ka bawl valon ding hi; tam gamlah ah mangthai-in khum munah a si gam ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Gam van dinga Moses in a sawl mite kilekia-in a gam thu a sielamin a tut ziehun mihonte Topa a phunsansah,"},"37":{"text":"khum gam tungtang a sielama a gen tua mite, Topa mai-ah gimna tawh a sigam uhi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin gam van dinga a kuonte lahah Nun’ tapa Joshua le Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb tegel beh hing lai uhi."},"39":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te zosie tungah tami thute a gen ciengin nahpitahin mite a kap uhi."},"40":{"text":"Zingmawng phalvah tahin tho-in muoltung gam muolsang dawnah a peito vua, “Eite tanah i om uhi. Topa’ ciemsa munah i peito ding uhi. Bang ding ahei cile eite i maw zo ta hi,” a ci uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in, “Bang dinga Topa’ thupiehna na palsat uh ahei? Tua khu a tangtung sih ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Note lahah Topa om lo ahi ziehin peito sih unlen, na galte in kisatlia sah sih un."},"43":{"text":"Amalek-te le Canaan-te in khum munah hing do ding ahi ziehin namsau tawh na sigam ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile Topa nua na zuina panun kilekia na hi ziehun Topa in note ang ompi ta sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ thuciemna singkuong le Moses in giephuol nuasie lo napi amate in muoltung gam muolsang dawn kato ding a ngaisun veve uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin muoltung gama a teng Amalek-te le Canaan-te kumsuhin amate a zo gawp vua, Hormah cieng dong a nuadel uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Biehna Tuomtuomte"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen a kung vuah tam bangin gen in: Kang pieh leitanga teng dingin na tun ciengun,"},"3":{"text":"Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biehna bawl nadingin bawnghon pan ahi a, tuuhon pan ahi zongin na pieh ciengun, Topa dinga a namtui dingin meihal biehna hile, biehpiehna hile, nop thu-a biehna hile, kiciemna khat tangtun nading biehna hile, a kise hunte sunga biehna hile na pieh uleh,"},"4":{"text":"tua biehna a pie ding popo in Topa tungah annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat, sathau hin khat’ seli- suo-sekhat tawh a kibawl an tawh biehna pie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua banah dawn thei biehna dingin lenggazu hin khat’ seli-suo-sekhat, meihal biehna ahi sihle biehpieh nadingin tuuno khat ciet tawh na pie ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuutang adingin annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-seni, sathau hin khat’ sethum-suo -sekhat tawh kibawl an tawh biehna na pie ding uhi;"},"7":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui dawn thei biehna dingin lenggazu hin khat’ sethum-suo-sekhat na pie ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Meihal biehna ding ahi a, thuciemna khat tunsah nading ahi a, thunuom biehna ding ahi zongin, Topa tungah bawngtang khat na pieh ciengun,"},"9":{"text":"tua bawngtang tawh annel ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sethum sathau hin lang tawh kihal an tawh biehna na pie ding vua,"},"10":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui, mei tawh kihal biehna-in dawn thei biehna lenggazu hin khat’ alang na pie ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bawngtang khat ciet ahi a, tuutang khat ciet ahi zongin, tuuno apa khat ciet ahi a, keelno apa khat ciet tawh ahi zongin piehton dingin tua bangin kibawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na pieh uh ganhing phaza tawh kizui-in mi zosie in tua bangin a bawl ciet ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui, mei tawh kihal biehna a pieh ciengun, Israel tuolsung mi zosie in tami nate tam bangin a bawl ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Note tawh a tengton pemta khat hile, note lahah a khang tawntunga ang teng khat hile, ama in Topa tungah a gimnamtui, mei tawh kihal biehna a pieh nop leh note bawl bang ma-in a bawl ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Note le note lahah a teng pemta mihonte in ngaina khat beh nei ding a, tua khu na khang tawntung vua na zui ding uh ngaina kip khat hi den ding hi; Topa mai-ah note le pemtate na kibang ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Note le na ompi uh pemtate adingin a kibang thukham khat le ngaina kip khat om ding hi.","ref":"Siem 24:22"},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"18":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen tam bangin gen in: Kang peipi nading gam na tun vua,"},"19":{"text":"tua gama pieng an na neh ciengun, Topa tungah silpieh na pie ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na anneh masah pente uh panin silpieh dingin moh lum khat na pie ding uhi; tua khu an cilna pana silpieh na pieh bangun na pie ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Na khang tawntung vua na anlah masa pen uh Topa tungah silpiehin na pie ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Moses kungah a na gensa tam thupiehte zosie-"},"23":{"text":"Topa in a thupiehte a pieh ni le a pieh zaw-a kipanin na khang tawntung vua Topa in Moses tungtawna ang thupieh zosie na zui sih uleh-"},"24":{"text":"mihonpi’ thei loin sawm khol lopi-a kibawl ahile mihon zosie in Topa tungah a gimnamtui dingin ngaina kip a om bangin meihal biehna dingin bawngtangno khat an tawh biehna, dawn thei biehna tawh na pieton ding vua, mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat na pie ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Siempu pa in Israel mihon zosie adingin thoidamna bawlpieh ding a, tuaci’n amate kimaisah ding hi; tua khu sawm khol lopi-a khielna hi a, amate in a khielna zieh vua Topa tungah mei tawh kihal a biehna ule a mawna zieh vua a biehna uh, Topa mai-ah a peipi zo ta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Israel mihon buppi le amate lahah teng pemtate zong kimaisah ding hi. Azieh pen tua khielna-ah mi buppi kihal hi."},"27":{"text":"Sawm khol lopi-in mi khat a maw leh mawna zieha biehna dingin kum khat a pha keelnu khat pie ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Sawm khol lopi-in mi khat in khielna a bawl ciengin tua pa adingin siempu pa in Topa mai-ah thoidamna bawlpieh ding a, thoidamna a kibawlpieh zaw ciengin a mawna kimaisah ding hi.","ref":"Siem 4:27-31"},"29":{"text":"Israel-te lahah a teng tuolsung mipa le pemta pa adingin- a gamta khiel a koima po in ngaina kibang khat na nei ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuolsung mi ahi a, pemta ahi zongin hangsan taha khielna a bawl teitei mi poma Topa simmaw ahi a, a mite lah panin kihemkhie ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa’ thu simmaw-in a thupieh a palsat ziehin tua bang mipa pen kihemkhie kilkel ding a, ama’ khielna ama in thuoh ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Gamlahah Israel-te a op lai-un, Sabbath ni-in singtom mi khat a mu uhi.","title":"Sabbath Tang lote Daanpiehna (Pei 31:12-17)"},"33":{"text":"A singtom laitah a mu teng in Aaron le Moses, le mihon bup mai-ah ama a peipi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ama banglaw ding ci kicien lo ahi ziehin ama a khumcip tadi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses kungah, “Tua mipa thalup ding ahi hi; giephuol pulamah mipi zosie in suong tawh seplia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin mipi zosie in giephuol pulamah peipi-in suong tawh ama a seplia uhi."},"37":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Puon Mongtep"},"38":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen a khang tungtawnun a puon mong vuah a tep bawlin, tua a puon mongtep ciet tungah khaudum khat khisah in.","ref":"Thkna 22:12"},"39":{"text":"Tua puon mongtep na mu ciengun na lungsim deigawna ule na mittang’ deinate uh zuikha loin, Topa’ thupieh zosie phawhin na zui nading uh ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka thupieh zosie phawhin na zui ding vua, na Pasien uh tungah na siengtho ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Na Pasien uh ka hi thei nadinga Egypt gam pana ang peipi Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi: Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Levi’ tapa Kohath, Kohath’ tapa Izhar, Izhar’ tapa Korah in Reuben suonlehlahte- Eliab’ tapate Dathan le Abiram, le Peleth’ tapa On- tam teng pui a,","title":"Korah, Dathan, le Abiram-te’ Ledona","ref":"Jude 11"},"2":{"text":"a kikhawmte lah panin a kiteel mi minthang, mihonte’ makai Israel-te pasal zani le sawmnga tawh Moses ledo uhi."},"3":{"text":"Moses le Aaron langpang dingin amate a kikhawm vua, ama gel kungah, “Valkai ta luo gel teh! Mihonpi zosie a unpi-in a siengtho vua, amate lahah Topa om hi. A kikhawm Topa’ mihonte tungah bang dinga kitawisang tuom na hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in tua thu a zah bepin a mai kunsuh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Korah le a pawlte zosie kungah, “Zing ciengin Topa in ama-a’ koi pen hi a, koi siengtho-in, ama kungah koi pei thei ding ahei ci ei theisah ding hi. Ama in a kungah a teel ding mipa peisah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hici bawl un: Korah le na pawl zosie in gimnamtui halna beelte la unlen,"},"7":{"text":"zing ciengin tuate sungah mei koi-in, Topa mai-ah tua meite tungah gimnamtui koi un. Topa in a teel mipa pen a siengtho hi ding hi. No Levi-te valkai ta luo uteh!” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Korah kungah, “No Levi-te aw, tu-in za un!"},"9":{"text":"Topa’ biehbuh nasep sem dinga ama kung neh thei dingin Israel’ Pasien in Israel mihonte lah panin note ang tuomkoi a, mihonpi mai-ah hing dingsahin amau’ na ang sepsah khu note dingin a thuneu na sa uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Ama in a kungah nang le na sanggam Levi-te zosie hing peisah zo ta hi; hinanle nang in siempu nasep zong tu lai vaset ding na mah?"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa do dinga nangma le na pawl zosie ang kisutuo na hi uhi. Tam banga na phunsan nadingun Aaron bang hi mawh ahei?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Eliab’ tapa Dathan le Abiram hlan dingin mi sawl a, ahi vangin ama gel in, “Kang pei sih ding uhi!"},"13":{"text":"Nang in senel gamah thagam dingin bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gam panin kote nei peipi a, ka tung vuah thunei vaihawm dinga na kibawl khu a thuneu na sa amah?"},"14":{"text":"Bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gamah kote nei peipi sih a, ka gouluo dingun lengga umte le lote zong nei pieh lo lam kitel sieng ta hi. Tam mite’ mit kheudawh sawm na hi amah? Kang pei sih ding uhi!” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Moses thangpai mama a, Topa kungah, “A biehna uh thusimpieh sin. Amate tung panin laa khat zong ka la sih a, amate khat zong ka bawlsie sih hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Moses in Korah kungah, “Nang le na pawl zosie, nang, amate le Aaron tawh zing ciengin Topa mai-ah na kilaa ding uhi;"},"17":{"text":"tuale na milipun gimnamtui beel tawi ciet unlen a sungah gimnamtui koi-in, tuaci’n Topa’ mai-ah mi zosie in gimnamtui beel zani le sawmnga hing tawi un. Nangma le Aaron in zong na gimnamtui beel ciet hing kitawi un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n mikim in a gimnamtui beel ciet tawi-in a sungah mei koi-in a tungah gimnamtui a koi vua, kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah Moses le Aaron tawh a dington uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Korah in Moses le Aaron do dingin kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah mihon zosie khawm hi. Topa’ vanglietna mihonte lahah kilang hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"21":{"text":"Bakhat sungin amate ka suhsiet thei nadingin tam mihonte lah panin kihem un."},"22":{"text":"Amate kunsuhin, “Pasien, mi zosie’ hlagau a pie Pasien aw, mi khat’ khielna ziehin mihon zosiepi tungah lungthah ding na mah?” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"24":{"text":"Mihonte kungah tam bangin gen in: Korah, Dathan, le Abiram-te’ tenna mun panin peidawh ta un."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses dingin Dathan le Abiram kungah a pei hi; Israel’ upate in ama a zui uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite kungah, “Tam migilote’ puonbuh panin kihem dawh unlen, amau’ na bangma khat zong tham sih un. Na tham uleh amau’ khielna zosie ziehin ang kihemkhie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Korah, Dathan, le Abiram-te’ tenna mun panin amate a peikhie uhi; Dathan le Abiram-te pusuohin a zite a tate ule a tasente utawh a puonbuh lutna vuah a dington uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuale Moses in, “Tami nasep pen keima thu-a ka bawl ahi sih a, Topa in tami nasep zosie a sem dinga kei ei sawl ahi lam tam bang tawh na thei ding uhi:"},"29":{"text":"Tam mite si ngaina banga ang si vua, ahi sihle mite’ tuo khah ngaite ma ang tuo vua ahile, Topa in kei ei sawl lo ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in thei ngai lo na khat piengsahin leitang in a kamkahin a neisa zosie utawh a valtum a, a hingtang vua Misikhuo-a a peipisuh leh, tam mite in Topa a simmaw lam na thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in tam thu teng a gen zaw behin a nei vuah lei a pawhkeh hi."},"32":{"text":"Leitang in a kam kahin amate, a innkuonpite uh, Korah tawh a kipawl mi vannuoi le a neisa zosie valtum hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate le a neisa zosie utawh a hingtangun Misikhuo-ah a tumsuh uhi; leitang in amate khucipin mihonte lah panin a mangthai ta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amau’ kikona ziehin a kimvel vua om Israel zosie taimang uhi. Azieh pen amate in, “Leitang in eite zong ei valtum kha va!” a ci uhi."},"35":{"text":"Topa kung panin mei lengkhie a, gimnamtui pie mi zani le sawmnga a katum hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"37":{"text":"Siempu Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in meikuong sung panin gimnamtui beelte a lah dawh nadingin gen in; tua ciengin a gamlapi-ah tua mei thethang in."},"38":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amau’ hinna tawp za donga a khiel tam mite’ gimnamtui beelte siengtho hi. Tua gimnamtui beelte maitam sinna dankuong phengin kheng un, azieh pen amate in Topa mai-ah tuate a pieh zo tah ziehun tuate khu a siengtho ahi hi. Tua bangin Israel-te adingin tuate lim khat hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempu Eleazar in mei in a kahtum mite’ pieh gimnamtui sumngo beelte a la hi; tuale maitam sinna-in tuate kikheng hi."},"40":{"text":"Korah le a pawlte a bah lo nadingin Topa in Moses tungtawnin ama kungah a gen bangin Aaron’ suonlehlah ahi lo a pulam mipa in Topa mai-ah gimnamtui pie-a a pei lo nadingin tuate khu Israel-te tunga phawsahna khat ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Hinanle a zing ciengin Israel mihonpi zosie in Moses le Aaron langpangin, “No gel in Topa’ mite na that sieng uhi,” a ci uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tuale ama gel langpangin mihonpi a kikhop zo ciengun, kikhopna puonbuh lamah Moses le Aaron a khuodah uhi; meii in puonbuh tuom a, tuaci’n Topa’ minthanna a kilang hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin kikhopna puonbuh mai-ah Moses le Aaron a pei vua,"},"44":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in a kungah,"},"45":{"text":"“Bakhat sungin amate ka suhsiet thei nadingin tam mihonpite lah panin peidawh ta’n,” a ci hi. Tuale ama gel a mai kunsuh uhi."},"46":{"text":"Moses in Aaron kungah, “Na gimnamtui beel la inlen a tungah maitam pana mei le gimnamtui koi in. Manlang tahin mihonte kungah tua khu tawi inlen amate dingin thoidamna bawlpieh in.
