Bangzieh ahei cile Topa kung panin lungthahna pusuoh zo a, gimna kipan zo hi,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses’ thupiehsa bangin Aaron in la-in mipite laikim-ah a tai hi. Mipite lahah gimna a kipan zo tahpi a, ama in gimnamtui koi-in mite adingin thoidamna a bawlpieh hi."},"48":{"text":"A si le a hingte kikalah ama a ding hi; tuale gimna a veng hi."},"49":{"text":"Korah tungtanga a site simlo, tam gimna tawh a si mi tul sawm le tulli le zasagi pha hi."},"50":{"text":"Gimna a ven zaw ciengin kikhopna puonbuh lutna Moses kungah Aaron a peikia hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Aaron’ Ciengkhut Meng"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen amau’ pupa innkuon sunga makai zosie tung panin amau’ pupa innkuon khat ciet dingin ciengkhut khat, ciengkhut sawm le ni la inlen, a ciengkhut ciet vuah a min ciet uh giel in."},"3":{"text":"Levi’ ciengkhut tungah Aaron’ min giel in. Azieh pen a pupa innkuon lutang khat adingin ciengkhut khat ciet om ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh sung, thuciemna mai, nangma kang kimupina munah tuate koi in."},"5":{"text":"Ka teel mipa’ ciengkhut ang meng ding hi; tua bangin na tung vua Israel-te’ phun mielmuolna teng ka tawpsah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te a hopi hi; makaite zosie in a pupate’ innkuon zui-in makai khat ciengin khat ta, ama tungah ciengkhut sawm le ni a pie vua, Aaron’ ciengkhut zong amau’ ciengkhut lahah a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n thuciemna puonbuh sung Topa mai-ah Moses in tua ciengkhutte a koi hi."},"8":{"text":"A zing ciengin thuciemna puonbuh sungah Moses a lut ciengin Levi innkuon adingin Aaron ciengkhut mengin na ngumin na pallun a, almond min ga na ga hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Topa mai panin Israel zosie kungah ciengkhut zosie a peipi a, amate in enin a ciengkhut ciet uh a la uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale Topa in Moses kungah, “A ledo mite tungah hilkholna ahi ding le kei nei phunsan uh na tawp nadingun thuciemna mai-ah Aaron’ ciengkhut koikia un. Tua ahi sihle amate a si ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 9:4"},"11":{"text":"Tua bangin Moses in a bawl hi; Topa thupieh bang lien ma-in ama in a bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel-te in Moses kungah, “A sigam ding ka hi ta uhi; kote a mangthai ding ka hi ta uhi; ka unpi-un a mangthai hi ta ung!"},"13":{"text":"Topa’ biehbuh nai-a a pei poma a si ding hi. Tuale kote ka unpi vua sigam ding ka hi ta uh amah?” a ci uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Aaron kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Mun siengtho tawh kisai-a mawsahna teng nang le na tapate le na pupa innkuonte in na puo ding vua, siempu nasepna tawh kisai-a mawsahna teng nang le na tapate beh in na puo ding uhi.","title":"Siempute le Levi-te’ Mawpuohna"},"2":{"text":"Thuciemna puonbuh mai-ah nang le na tapate na op laitahun no ang pawl ding le note’ na ang sep hu thei nadingun na pate nam ahi Levi minam na sanggamte zong zawpi in."},"3":{"text":"Amate in note’ nasep le puonbuh nasep zosie sem ding uhi. Ahi vangin mun siengtho ahi sihle maitam vanzahte nehin a pei sih ding uhi. A pei uleh amate le note na ni-un na si ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in kikhopna puonbuh vaipuoh teng a sem dingin note hing pawlin kikhopna puonbuh nasep zosie sem ding uhi; a pulam mi koima in ang neh sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Israel-te tungah lungthahna a tun ngai nawn lo nadingin noma ma in mun siengtho nasepte le maitam nasepte na sem ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Israel-te lah pan na sanggam uh Levi-te a la pa keima ka hi hi; tu-in ahile amate pen kikhopna puonbuh nasep a sem dinga Topa tunga kipumpieh noma’ letsong ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang le na tapate in maitam tawh kisai na zosie le dalna puon sunga om na zosie-ah na siempu nasep uh kintahin na sem ding uhi. Na siempu nasep uh pen letsong-a kang pieh ahi hi; ang nai a pulam mi poma kithat ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Aaron tam bangin a hopi hi: Keima tunga ei kipie biehnate ahi Israel-te’ letsong siengthote a sai dingin nang kang koi zo hi; nang tung le na tapate tungah siempu tanh ahi zing dingin tuate kang pie zo hi.","title":"Siempute’ Tanh"},"9":{"text":"Mei tawh a kihal dingte lah panin nang dinga a kihen, a siengtho pen nate in: sil siengtho pena kei kunga ei pieh uh a biehna zosie uh, an tawh biehna, mawna zieha biehna, le khielna zieha biehnate, nang le na tapate-a’ hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A siengtho pen na khat bangin tuate na ne ding uhi; pasal kici poma in ne thei ding hi; tua khu note dingin a siengtho hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam zong khu noma-a’ ahi hi: Israel-te’ a kivei biehna letsongte zosie sung panin a kituomkoi poma nang le na tapate le na tanute’ kaih ahi zing dingin tuate kang pie hi; na inn sunga a siengtho mi popo in ne thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima in sathau tuituoh pen teng, lenggazu le an a tuituoh pen teng, Topa tunga amau’ pieh a tuituoh pen ante, note kang pie zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa tunga a tawi uh, a leitang vua a pieng ga masa zosie noma-a’ hi ding hi; na inn sunga om a siengtho mi popo in ne thei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel-te sunga ki-ap na vannuoi noma-a’ hi ding hi.","ref":"Siem 27:28"},"15":{"text":"Topa tunga kipie naubu phukeh masa zosie, mihing hile ganhing hile noma-a’ hi ding hi; hizongle mihing tacil pen khu na tanh ding vua, ganhing sieng lo tacil zong na tanh ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hla khat pana kituot tuate tatman pen mun siengtho shekel tawh kizui-in ngun shekel nga-in na se ding uhi. (tua khu gerah sawmni ahi hi.)"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin bawng tacil, ahi sihle tuu tacil, ahi sihle keel tacilte na tanh sih ding uhi; tuate a siengtho ahi hi. Maitam tungah tuate na the ding vua, Topa tungah a gimnamtui, mei tawh kihal biehna-in tuate’ thau na hal ding uhi;"},"18":{"text":"hizongle a kivei a awmsa le a mal zietlam khu noma-a’ ahi ma bangin a sate zong noma-a’ hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa tunga Israel-te in a pieh a siengtho biehna zosie, keima in nang le na tapate le na tanute tungah na kaih zing ding vua kang pieh ahi hi; tami khu nang le na suonlehlahte adingin zong ci tawh Topa mai-a tawntung thuciemna ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Aaron kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Amau’ gamah luo na nei sih ding a, amate lahah bangma tanh zong na nei sih ding hi; nangma’ tanh keima ka hi a, Israel-te lahah nangma’ luo ka hi hi."},"21":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh sungah keima in a na sepna uh ka thuhkiana-in Israel gam sunga sawm-ah-khat zosie amau’ luo dingin Levi-te tungah ka pie zo hi.","ref":"Siem 27:30-33; Thkna 14:22-29"},"22":{"text":"Tu-a kipanin Israel-te kikhopna puonbuh-ah a pei nawn sih ding vua, a pei teitei uleh khielna bawlin a si ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Levi-te in kikhopna puonbuh sunga nasep a sem ding vua, a khielna paat uh a puo ding uhi; tua khu na khang tawntung vua ngaina kip khat hi ding hi. Ahi vangin amate in Israel-te lahah tanh nei lo ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa tungah biehna dinga a tuomkoi uh Israel-te’ sawm-ah-khat pen amau’ tanh dingin Levi-te tungah ka pie zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"26":{"text":"Levi-te hopi inlen tam bangin na gen ding hi: Keima in Israel-te tung panin na tanh ding vua kang pieh ahi sawm-ah-khat na san ciengun, tua sung panin Topa tungah biehna-in sawm-ah-khat sung panin sawm-ah-khat ma na khensawn ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua na silpiehte uh, ancilna pana an le lengga suhna pana kipie bangin noma’ letsongin kiciemte ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Note in zong Israel-te tung pana na san uh sawm-ah-khat zosie lah panin Topa tungah biehna-in tam bangin na khenkhie ding uhi; tuate sung panin siempu Aaron tungah Topa’ biehna na pie ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Na tung vua ang kipie letsong zosiete lah panin Topa ading biehna zosie na tuomkoi ding uhi; tuate zosie lah panin a hoi pente na siensuo ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amate kungah zong tam bangin gen in: Tuate lah panin a hoi pente na tuomkoi zaw ciengun, a omlai teng pen Levi-te adingin ancilna phuol pan le lengga suhna pana a piengin kisimpieh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Nang le na innkuonpite in mun khat popo-ah na ne thei ding uhi; azieh pen tua khu kikhopna buh sunga na nasep thaman uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuate lahah a hoi pen na pieh ciengun tam thu ziehin mawsahna na thuoh sih ding uhi. Ahi vangin sina na thuoh lo nadingun Israel-te’ letsong siengtho na buasah sih ding uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Bawnglaa San Pawi Bawlna"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh thukham le ngainate tam bang ahi hi: Na kung vuah poina a nei lo, nuol a baang lo, a tunga hahkol kivaw nai lo, bawnglaa a san khat ang peipi nadingun Israel-te kungah gen un."},"3":{"text":"Siempu Eleazar tungah tua khu na pie ding vua, giephuol pulamah kikai-in ama’ mai-ah kigo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Siempu Eleazar in a khutme tawh a si kimkhat la ding a, kikhopna puonbuh mai lamah tua a si sagivei the ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin a muna-ah tua bawnglaa kihal dinghi; a vun, a tel, le a site, a eh tawh kihaltha ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempu pa in taamtah sing le hyssop le puon ausan khat la-in bawngla kihalna munah sepsuh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in a puonte sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, tua zaw ciengin giephuolah pei thei ding hi; ahi vangin nitah dongin siempu pa abua hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Bawnglaa a hal mipa in a puonte tui sungah sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding hi; nitah dongin ama abua hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a siengtho mi khat in tua bawnglaa kihalna vutvam khawmin giephuol pulam a sieng mun khatah khol ding hi; Israel mihonpite’ kisiensuona tui-a zah dingin kikoicing ding hi. Tam pen siensuo biehna ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 9:13"},"10":{"text":"Bawnglaa kihalna vutvam khawm pa in a puonte sawp ding a, nitah dongin abua hi ding hi. Tam pen Israel-te le amate lahah a teng pemtate tungah kumtawn ngaina khat hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Misi luong khatpo a thamkha mite ni sagi sung abua hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A ni thum ni le a ni sagi ni-in tui tawh kisiensuo-in, tuaci’n amate a siengtho hi ding hi; ahi vangin a ni thum ni le a ni sagi ni-in a kisiensuo sih uleh, a sieng suoh thei lo ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Misi khat thamkha poma le a sisate’ luong a thamkha a kisiensuo lo poma Topa’ biehbuh a buasah ahi hi; Israel lah panin tua bang mite kihemkhie ding hi. Amate tungah siensuona tui kithe lo ahi ziehin abua-in a om suoh ding uhi; amau’ sienlona pen a tung vuah a baang lai hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam khu puonbuh sunga mi khat a si cienga zah ding thukham ahi hi: Puonbuh sunga a tum zosie le puonbuh sunga om mi zosie ni sagi sung abua hi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"A tunga asin kikhu lo umlebeel poma a sieng lo ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Namsau tawh gamlaha kithat mi ahi a, ahi sihle si ngaina-a si ahi zongin, misi gu ahi a, ahi sihle han ahi zongin a thamkha poma ni sagi sung abua hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Abua mipa adingin a kihal siensuo biehna vutvamte la-in beel sung khatah tui luonglai tawh hal ding uhi;"},"18":{"text":"tua ciengin a sieng mi khat in hyssop la-in tui sungah die ding a, puonbuh tung, vanzah zosie tung, tua sunga om mi zosie tung le misi gu, a kithat mi, misi, ahi sihle han ahi zongin a tham mi poma tungah the ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A ni thum ni le a ni sagi ni-in a sieng mipa in a sieng lo mipa tungah the ding a, tua bangin a ni sagi ni-in amate siensuo ding hi. Tua ciengin a puonte uh sawpin tui sungah a kipumsil ding vua, nitah ciengin a sieng ahi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Abua hi napi amau le amau a kisiensuo lo mite pen Topa’ mun siengtho a buasah ahi ziehun mihonpi lah panin tua mite kihemkhie ding hi. A tung vuah siensuona tui kithe lo ahi ziehin abua ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua khu amate dingin kumtawna kizang ding thukham khat hi ding hi. Siensuona tui a the pa in a puonte sawp ding a, tua siensuona tui a thamkha poma nitah dongin abua hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Abua mipa’ thamkhah na khat popo abua hi ding a, tua na a thamkha mi popo zong nitah dongin abua hi ding hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hla masa penin Zin gamlah-ah Israel mihonpi zosie a tung vua, Kadesh-ah a om uhi. Khum munah Miriam si a, khum mun ma-ah kivui hi.","title":"Meribah’ Tuite (Pei 17:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in mihonpi ading tui a om sih hi; tuaci’n Moses le Aaron langpang dingin amate a kikhawm uhi."},"3":{"text":"Moses tawh mite kihau-in, “ Topa mai-a i sanggamte a na si lai-un eite zong na kisidawh tazaw leih izaw!"},"4":{"text":"Bang dinga kote le ka ganhingte a siton dinga Topa’ mihonte, tami mun gamlaha nei peipi ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Bang dingin Egypt gam panin tami sietna mun tut dinga nei peipito ahei? An ahi a, thei ahi a, lenggui ahi a, mang kawlsing ahi zongin a opna mun a hi sih hi; tui dawn ding nasan a om sih hi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin mihonte lah panin kikhopna puonbuh lutna-ah Moses le Aaron a pei uhi. Ama gel zong a kunsuh vua, tuaci’n a tung vuah Topa’ vanglietna kilang hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:"},"8":{"text":"Ciengkhut la-in, nang le na sanggampa Aaron in mihonte khawm unlen, a mitmu vua suongpi in tui a pulsah nadingin tua suongpi thupie un; tua bangin suongpi panin a dawn ding uh tui na pie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama’ thupiehsa bangin Moses in Topa mai-ah ciengkhut a la hi."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in suongpi mai-ah mihonte kaikhawmin a kung vuah, “Ngai un, no langpangte aw, tami suongpi panin note ding tui kang pulsah ding uh amah?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in a khut lamto-in a ciengkhut tawh tua suongpi nivei a sat hi; tui tampitah pulkhie-in mihonte le ganhingte in a dawn uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Moses le Aaron kungah, “Israel-te muna-ah keima in ka sienthona ka lah thei nadingin nei muon lo zieh gelin amate ka piehsa gam sungah tam mihonte na tunpi sih ding gel hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam teng pen, Meribah tui phuola Topa tawh Israel-te a kiselna, amate lahah amama a siengtho-a a kilahna muna thupieng ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 17:1-7"},"14":{"text":"Moses in Kadesh panin Edom kumpipa kungah kamtaite sawl a, “Na sanggampa Israel in tam bangin a gen hi: Nangma in ka tung vua ang tungsa hahsatna zosie na thei hi:","title":"Edom Tawna Pei ding Kiphal lo"},"15":{"text":"Egypt-ah ka pu ka pate a na peisuh vua, tuaci’n Egypt-ah sauveipi ka na teng uhi; Egypt mite in ko le ka pu ka pate ei na bawlsie uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa kungah ka kiko ciengun ama in ka aw uh ei za a, vantungmi khat hing sawlin Egypt panin ei peipi a, tu-in nangma’ gam ning Kadesh khuo-ah ka om uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in na gam ei nawhsah in. Lolai hile, lengga umte hile ka nawhkha sih ding vua, tuikhuh khatpo-a tui zong ka mawh dawn sih ding uhi; Kumpipa’ Lamlienpi dung zui-in ka pei ding vua, na gam sung ka kal masangun ziet le vei-ah ka piel sih ding uhi,” a cisah hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin Edom in ama kungah, “Ka gam sung na nawh thei sih ding uhi; nang nawh paupau uleh no ang do dingin namsau tawh kang kuon ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel-te in, “Lamlienpi tawnin ka peito ding uhi; ko le ka ganhingte in na tui uh ka dawn uleh a manh kang pie ding uhi. Tam pen thu neuno khat ahi lel bo hi; keng tawh ei nawhsah maimai in,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “Na nawh thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi. Edom mite, galkap tampi le galvan tampi tawh amate do dingin a kuon uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua bangin Edom mite in a gam uh nawh ding a phal sih uhi; tuaci’n amate kung panin Israel mite a kiheikia uhi."},"22":{"text":"Kadesh panin a ding vua, Hor muol-ah Israel mipi buppi a tung uhi.","title":"Aaron’ Sina"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Edom gamgi Hor muol-a Moses le Aaron kungah,"},"24":{"text":"“Aaron a mite kung zuonsah ta gel in. Bang ding ahei cile Meribah tuiphuol-ah no gel in ka thupieh nei ledo zieh gelin Israel mite tunga ka piehsa leitangah ama lut lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron le a tapa Eleazar zawpi inlen, Hor muol-ah peipi to in;"},"26":{"text":"Aaron puonsilte suodawh inlen a tapa Eleazar silsah in. Ahi vangin Aaron a mite kungah kigawm ta ding a, khum munah si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh bangin Moses gamta a, mihonte’ mitmu-in amate Hor muol-ah a kato uhi."},"28":{"text":"Moses in Aaron’ puonte suopiehin a tapa Eleazar silsah hi; tuale tua muol dawnah Aaron a si hi. Muol dawn panin Moses le Eleazar a kumsuh uhi.","ref":"Pei 29:29; Gam 33:38; Thkna 10:6"},"29":{"text":"Mihon buppi in Aaron si a mu bepun Aaron ziehin Israel’ innkuon sung mi zosie ni sawmthum sung a kap uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Canaan-te Negeb gama teng Arad kumpipa in Atharim lam zui-in Israel-te pei ci thu a zah ciengin ama in Israel-te na do a, pawlkhat salin man hi.","title":"Sumngo Gul"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in Topa tungah kiciemna khat a bawl vua, “Ka khut sung vuah tam mite nei pieh tahtah leh amau’ khuopite ka susie ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te’ thugen ngai-in Canaan-te a pie hi; tuale amate in a khuopite le amate a susie uhi; tuaci’n khum mun pen Hormah kici hi."},"4":{"text":"Hor Muol panin dingkhie-in Edom kimvela pei dingin San Tuipi zotna lampi a zui vua, hinanle lamkim-ah mite a lungkie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mite in Pasien le Moses a gensie vua, “Bang dingin senel gama si dingin Egypt panin ei peipito na hei? An le tui lah om lo, bangma man lo tami an zong ka kidah uhi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in mite lahah gul guphate hla a, tuate in mite tu-in Israel-te tampitah a si uhi.","ref":"1Cor 10:9"},"7":{"text":"Moses kungah mite pei-in, “ Topa le nangma hing langpangin kampau kha ka hi ziehun ka maw uhi. Ka kung panun tam gulte a lah dawh nadingin Topa tungah thungen in,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Moses in mite adingin thu ngen hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Gul gupha khat’ lim bawl inlen khuom tung khatah khai in. Gul in a tuh mi poma khumi a en ding vua, a hing ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in sumngo gul khat bawlin khuom tung khatah a khai hi. Gul in mi khatpo a tuh sielin ama in tua sumngo gul enin a hing pai hi.","ref":"2Kum 18:4; Jhn 3:14"},"10":{"text":"Israel-te dingkhie-in Oboth-ah giephuol sat uhi.","title":"Moab-a Zinna"},"11":{"text":"Oboth panin a dingkhie vua, nisuona lam Moab gamgi-a om senel gam, Iye-abarim munah giephuol a sat uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khum mun panin dingkhie-in Zered Kuom-ah a gieh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khum panin a dingkhie vua, Amor-te’ gamgi pana kihlungsuh senel gam sung Arnon gun galkhatah giephuol a sat uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Arnon gun pen Moab-te le Amor-te kikala om Moab-te’ gamgi ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa’ Gal Dona Laibu sungah, “Suphah gama Wahep khuo le a luite. Arnon gun"},"15":{"text":"le Ar mun dong a bansuh, Moab gamgi dunga kihlung, Arnon le guom kente,” kici hi."},"16":{"text":"Khum panin Beer munah a pei uhi; khum mun pen Topa in Moses kungah, “Mite kaikhawm inlen amate tui ka pie ding hi,” a cina tuikhuh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in tam la a sa uhi: “Tuikhuh aw, phul in! Tuami adingin la sa un!"},"18":{"text":"Kumpi ciengkhut le amau’ ciengkhutte tawh, makaite in a na taw, miliente in a na taw tuikhuh aw,” a ci uhi. Senel gam panin Mattanah,"},"19":{"text":"Mattanah panin Nahaliel, Nahaliel panin Bamoth,"},"20":{"text":"Bamoth panin gamgawta kimusuh theina Pisgah muol dawn gei, Moab gam sunga kihlungsuh kuom khatah a tung uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in Amor kumpipa Sihon kungah kamtaite sawlin,","title":"Kumpi Sihon Kizo (Thkna 2:26-37)"},"22":{"text":"“Na gam nawhin ei peisah in; lolai ahi a, lengga huon ah ahi zongin ka piel sih ding uhi; tuikhuh khatpo-a tuite zong ka dawn sih ding uh; na gam sung ka kal masangsie-un Kumpipa’ Lamlienpi-ah ka pei ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle Sihon in Israel-te a gam nawhsah ding a phal sih hi. Sihon in a mite zosie kaikhawm a, Israel-te do dingin senel gamah a kuon hi; Jahaz mun-ah ama tungin Israel-te a do hi."},"24":{"text":"Israel-te in namsau tawh ama thatin Arnon panin Jabbok dong, Ammon-te opna dongin a gam a lahpieh uhi; azieh pen Ammon-te’ gamgi a thahat mama hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel-te in tam khuopi zosie a la vua, Heshbon gam sunga Amor-te’ khuopi zosie le a khuotate zosie-ah a teng uhi."},"26":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Heshbon pen Moab kumpi masa pa simin Arnon cieng dong a gam zosie a na lahpieh Amor-te’ kumpipa Sihon’ khuopi ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin lasate in, Heshbon-ah hing pei un. Lamkia unlen Sihon’ khuopi kipsah un."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen Heshbon panin mei pusuoh a, Sihon khuopi panin meikuong pusuoh hi. Moab-te’ khuopi Ar le Arnon muolsang a uhte a katum hi."},"29":{"text":"Moab aw, vangsie ma cia! Chemosh mite aw, a kisie hi ta uteh! Ama’n Amor kumpipa Sihon kungah a tapate galtai-in bawl a, a tanute galmatin a omsah ta hi.","ref":"Jer 48:45-46"},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n amau’ suon le hlahte Heshbon panin Dibon dongin a kisie vua, mei in Medeba cieng dong a bat masang ka siesah uhi,” ci-in sa uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bangin Amor-te’ gamah Israel-te a teng uhi."},"32":{"text":"Moses in Jazer khuo thu kansim dingin mi a sawl hi; tuale amate in a khuotate la-in khum muna na omsa Amor-te a suon uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kihei-in Bashan lampi-ah a peito uhi; tuale amate do dingin Bashan kumpipa Og le a mi zosie Edrei-ah a kuon uhi.","title":"Kumpi Og Kizo (Thkna 3:1-22)"},"34":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in Moses kungah, “Ama giing sin; azieh pen na khut sungah ama’ mi zosie le ama’ leitang zosie kang pie zo hi. Heshbon a uh Amor kumpipa Sihon tunga na bawl bang ma-in ama tungah zong na bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n a hing khat zong a om nawn lo za dongin ama le a tapate le a mite zosie a that uhi; tuale amate in ama’ gam luo uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te vai a ding vua, Jericho gei Jordan gungal Moab zanglei-ah giephuol a sat uhi.","title":"Israel Samsie dingin Balaam Kithuta"},"2":{"text":"Zippor’ tapa Balak in Israel-te in Amor-te tunga a bawl teng zosie mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate a tam seng ziehun Moab-te in tua mite a giing mama uhi; Israel-te a giin ziehun Moab-te a zausi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Moab-te in Midian upate kungah, “Bawngtang in lolai-a lopa a lie bangin tam mipite in tu-in i kimvel vua om zosie a liehtum ding ahi ta uhi,” a ci uhi. Zippor’ tapa Balak pen khum hun laitahin Moab kumpipa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Amaw gama om Euphrates gun gei Pethor khuo-a teng Beor’ tapa Balaam kungah kamtai sawl a, “Egypt gam panin mihon khat ang pei uhi; lei maitang tengah a kithezah vua, kei banah a teng uhi.","ref":"Gam 31:8; 2Pet 2:15-16; Jude 11"},"6":{"text":"Kei sanga a thahat zawh ziehun tu-in hing pei inlen tam mite ei samsietpieh in; tua hile amate ka zo kha thei ding a, khum gam panin ka notmang zo kha thei ding hi; azieh pen na thupha pieh poma in thupha nga a, na samsiet poma samsietin a om hi, ci ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moab upate le Midian upate in a khut sung vuah aisan man ding tawi-in a kuonkhie uhi; Balam kungah amate tungin Balak’ thu vaihlah teng a sung uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Tu zanin tanah gieh unlen, kei tunga Topa in ei hopi bang lienin na kung vuah thu kang puohkia ding hi,” a ci hi; tuaci’n Balaam kungah Moab uliente a gieh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Balaam kungah Pasien pei-in, “Nang tawh a omton tam mite koi ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Balaam in Pasien kungah, “Moab kumpipa Zippor’ tapa Balak in ka kungah tam bangin mi ang sawl hi:"},"11":{"text":"‘Egypt panin mihon khat ang pei vua, lei maitang tengah a kithezah uhi; tu-in hing pei inlen, tam mite ei samsietpieh in; tua hile keima in amate simin ka notmang zo kha thei ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasien in Balaam kungah, “Amate na zui sih ding hi; tua mite na samsie sih ding hi, azieh pen amate thupha kipie ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawng ciengin Balaam tho a, Balak’ uliente kungah, “Na gam ciet vuah pei ta un, azieh pen Topa in note tawh zawton ding ei phal lo hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moab uliente dingkhie-in Balak kungah a pei vua, “Balaam in kote ei zui nuom lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Balak in tuate sanga a tamzaw le a zatahhuoizaw uliente khatvei sawlkia hi."},"16":{"text":"Balaam kungah amate a tung vua, a kungah, “Zippor’ tapa Balak in tam bangin gen hi: ‘Kei kunga nang pei ding bangma in kikai-awhsah sin;"},"17":{"text":"azieh pen patawina lienpi kang pie valon ding a, ka kunga nang gen popo kang bawlpieh ding hi. Hing pei inlen tam mite ei samsietpieh in,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle Balaam in Balak’ nasemte kungah, “Balak in ngun le kham a inndim ei pie ding hi phiel le zong Topa’ thupieh kalvalin a tawmzaw ahi a, a tamzaw ahi zongin ka bawl thei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in kei kungah bang thu ang genbe lai diei mah ci thu ka thei nadingin adangte ma bangin tuzan tanah gieh tadi un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Khum zanin Balaam kungah Pasien pei-in, “Nang ang hlan dinga tua mite ang pei ahi uleh tho inlen zui in; ahi vangin kang sawlte beh bawl in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawngin Balaam tho a, a laaphaw pha-in Moab lamkaite tawh a zawhton hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama a pei ziehin Pasien lungthah mama a, ama do dingin Topa’ vantungmi lampi ah na pang hi. A laa tungah ama tuong a, a nasemte ni a zawpi hi.","title":"Balaam, Laa, le Vantungmi"},"23":{"text":"Tua laa in a khut sungah namsau dawsa-in lampi-a a ding Topa’ vantungmi a mu hi; tuaci’n lampi panin tua laa pielin gamlahah a pei hi; tuale Balaam in lampi-a a peikia nadingin a laa a sat hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin lengga lo kikal, a pang tuohah phung a opna lam kawcih laitahah Topa’ vantungmi na ding leuleu hi."},"25":{"text":"Laa in Topa’ vantungmi a mu ciengin phungbang phu-in tua tawh Balaam’ keng a gawtkha hi; tuaci’n ama in a laa a satkia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a masangah Topa’ vantungmi na pei-in zietlam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin kihei nading om lona mun kawcih khatah na ding leuleu hi."},"27":{"text":"Laa in Topa’ vantungmi a mu bepin Balaam’ nei-ah a lumsuh hi; tuale Balaam lungthah mama a, a ciengkhut tawh a laa a sat hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in a laa kam a honpieh a, Balaam kungah, “Thumvei tahpi nei sat va-ia nadingin nang bang kang law ahei?” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Balaam in a laa kungah, “Nang in kei nei motbawl zieha khu! Ka khut sungah namsau tawi poma leng maw! Kang tha pai lien ding a khula!” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin laa in Balaam kungah, “Na khang tungtawnin tuni dong na tuonna na laa hi lo ka mah? Na tungah tam bang danin kang bawl ngai ta amah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ei bawl ngai sih teh,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Balaam’ mit a honpieh a, ama in a khut sungah namsau dawsa-in lampi-a a ding Topa’ vantungmi a mu hi; tuale ama zong a lu kunin lei-ah a bawhsuh hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in ama kungah, “Bang dinga na laa thumveitah na sat ahiei? Nangma’ lampi pen ka mai-ah letatna ahi ziehin nang ang langpang dinga ang kuon ka hi hi."},"33":{"text":"Laa in kei ei mu-in thumvei dong ei pel hi. Ei pel lo khat hi poma leh tu mama-in kang that zo tahtah ta ding a, na laa ka suohtasah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam in Topa’ vantungmi kungah, “Kei ei pang dingin lampi-ah na din ding lam ka thei lo ziehin ka khiel zo hi. Tua ahi ziehin kei tungah na lungkim sih leh tu-in inn lam ka kilekia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in Balaam kungah, “Tua mite tawh zawh in; hizongle kang sawl teng beh na gen ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Balak uliente tawh Balaam a zawhton hi."},"36":{"text":"Balaam ang pei zo ta ci thu Balak in a zah ciengin gamgi mong a gamla pena a om, Arnon in gamgi-a a bawl mun Ir-moab-ah ama tawh kimu dingin a pei hi."},"37":{"text":"Balak in Balaam kungah, “Nang ang hlan dingin mi hing sawl hi lo ka mah? Bang dinga ka kunga hing pei lo na hei? Nang ang patawi la ding ka hi amah?” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kungah, “Tu-in na kung kang tung zo hi. Ahi vangin thu khatpo ka gen thei nading ken thu ka nei amah? Ka kam sunga kikoi Pasien’ thute beh a gen ding ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balak tawh Balaam zawh a, Kiriath-huzoth khuo-ah a tung uhi."},"40":{"text":"Bawngtangte le tuute tawh Balak kithoi a, Balaam le a ompi uliente kungah tuate a puoh hi."},"41":{"text":"A zing ciengin Balak in Balaam zawpi a, Bamoth-baal munah a peipito hi; tuale ama in khum mun panin Israel mite pawlkhat a mu thei hi.","title":"Balaam’ Thuphuon Masa"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam in Balak kungah, “Kei adingin tami munah maitam sagi ei lampieh inlen, bawngtang sagi le tuutang sagi ei pie’n,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Balaam gen bangin Balak gamta a, Balak le Balaam in maitam khatah bawngtang khat le tuutang khat ta a pie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam in Balak kungah, “Kei ka va pei kalin tami mun na meihal biehnate gei-ah na om in. Kei ei dawn dingin Topa ang pei kha ding hi. Ama in kei ei lah popo na kungah kang gen ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin muolvum pawn gawta tung khatah ama a kato hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in Balaam kimupi a, Balaam in ama kungah, “Maitam sagi ka siem zo ta a, maitam simah bawngtang khat le tuutang khat ta ka pie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Balaam’ kam sungah thu khat koi a, ama kungah, “Balak kungah peikia inlen tam bangin na gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Balak kunga a kilekia ciengin ama le Moab ulien zosie tawh ama’ meihal biehna gei-ah na ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam in a thuphuon tam bangin a gen hi: Balak in Aram panin keima ei peipi zo ta a, nisuona muolte panin Moab kumpipa in keima ei peipi hi: ‘Hing pei inlen, Jacob ei samsietpieh in. Hing pei inlen Israel mite hing hosie in!’ ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien in a samsiet lo mite bangci samsiet thei ding ka hei? Topa in a hosiet lo mite bangci hosiet thei ding ka hei?"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile suongpi dawn panin ama ka mu a, muoltangte tung panin ama ka en hi. A tuomten minam khat om a, tuate khu minamte lahah kisim kha lo hi!"},"10":{"text":"Jacob’ leivui khu koi in sim zo-in, ahi sihle Israel’ meii-leivui khu koi in sim zo ding ahei? Mi dih pa’ sina bangin keima ei sisah inlen, ka hun tawpna ding zong ama-a’ bangsah in!” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balak in Balaam kungah, “Kei bang nei law ta e? Ka galte samsie dinga kang zawpi hi bo a, tu-in nang in amate bangma na law lo banah thupha na pie zawsop hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “ Topa in gen dinga ka kam sunga a koi thu don loin ka koi ding amah?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Balak in ama kungah, “Khum mun panin amate na mu thei nadingin mundang khatah ei zui in; amate a unpi-un na mu sih ding a, khenkhat beh na mu thei ding hi; tua ciengin khum mun panin amate ei samsietpieh in,” a ci hi.","title":"A Niveina Balaam’ Thuphuon"},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Zophim gamlah Pisgah muol vumah ama a zawpi hi. Ama in maitam sagi lam a, maitam simah bawngtang khat le tuutang khat ta a pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kungah, “ Topa tawh khum muna ka va kimu kalun na meihal biehnate gei tam munah na ding in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Balaam va kimupi-in a kam sungah thu koi-in ama kungah, “Balak kungah peikia in. Na gen ding thu tam teng ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama kungah a tun ciengin a meihal biehnate gei-ah Moab uliente tawh ama na ding a, Balak in ama kungah, “ Topa in bang thu ang gen ei?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam in a thuphuon tam bangin a gen hi: “Balak aw, tho inlen ngai in. Zippor’ tapa aw, ka thu gen ngai in:"},"19":{"text":"Zuou a gen dingin Pasien khu mihing ahi sih a, a lungsim khel dingin ama mihing hi lo hi. Ama in kamciem zo a, tua khu a sem sih ding amah? Ama’n gen zo hi, tua khu tangtun lo ding amah?"},"20":{"text":"En in, kei in thupha pieh nading thupiehna ka nga hi. Ama’n thupha pie zo a, ken ka dawhkia thei ta sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Jacob tungah vangsietna a mu sih a; ama in Israel-te lahah gimna zong a mu sih hi. Topa amau’ Pasien, amate tawh a omton a, amate lahah ama pen kumpipa ci-in kitangko hi."},"22":{"text":"Egypt panin amate a peipi Pasien khu amate adingin gam bawngtang’ kite tawh kibang hi."},"23":{"text":"A tahtahin ci leih Jacob do nading bum a om sih a, Israel-te do nadingin aisanna a om sih hi; tu-in Israel le Jacob tungah, ‘Pasien in a bangci sep ahei mu un,’ kici ding hi."},"24":{"text":"En un, humpi api bangin mite a thoto vua, humpi bangin a dieng vazawh uhi! A samatsa a neh masang, a savai’ si a dawn masang, a lum sih hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balak in Balaam kungah, “Amate samsie poma sin len, thupha zong pie poma sin,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Balaam in Balak kungah, “ Topa’ gen popo ka bawl ding hi,’ ang ci hi lo ka mah?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Balak in Balaam kungah, “Tu-in hing pei in, mun dangah kang peipi ding hi. Khum mun panin amate nei samsietpieh nading Pasien in ang lungkimpi kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Balak in gam gawta kimusuhna Peor muol dawnah Balaam zawpi hi."},"29":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kungah, “Tami munah kei dingin maitam sagi ei lampieh inlen, bawngtang sagi le tuutang sagi ei pie’n,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Balaam ci bangin Balak gamta a, maitam simah bawngtang khat le tuutang khat ta a pie hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Israel-te thupha pieh ding Topa a lungkim lam Balaam in mu a, tuaci’n a hun dangte bangin aisan dingin a kuon nawn sih a, ahi vangin senel gam lam a maingat hi.","title":"A Thumveina Balaam’ Thuphuon"},"2":{"text":"Balaam a khuodah leh Israel-te a bebe-in giephuol sata om a mu hi. Tua ciengin a tungah Pasien’ hlagau tung a,"},"3":{"text":"ama in a thuphuon tam bangin a gen hi: Beor’ tapa Balaam’ thuphuon, a mit ciim khuomu theipa’ thuphuon,"},"4":{"text":"Pasien’ thute a za pa’ thuphuon, Vanglienpa’ mangmu pa thuphuon, lum hit hiet napi a mit siing lo pa’ thuphuon:"},"5":{"text":"Jacob aw, na puonbuhte bang za-in etlawm a, Israel aw, na giephuolte bangza-in hoi ahei!"},"6":{"text":"A gamlapi-a kihlung, lutu singna tawh kibang a, gun gei-a om umte tawh kibang hi. Topa suonsa aloes panamtui kungte tawh kibang a, lui gei-a po taamtah kungte tawh kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"A phelkhai sung panin tui luong ding a, ama’ khaici in tui nieng tahin nga-in, a kumpipa uh Agag sangin thupizaw ding a, ama’ kumpi gam khu a kitawisang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt pana amate a peipi Pasien khu amate adingin gam bawngtang’ kite tawh a kibang hi. Ama in a galte ahi minamte valmangin, ama in a gu a tangte a hliehtawng ding hi. Ama in a thaltang tawh amate a kap ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Humpi apa bangin bawhin a lumsuh hi. Humpi anu bangin ama a lumsuh hi. Koi in ama khu phong ngam ding ahei? Nang thupha ang pie poma in thupha nga hinlen, nang ang samsie poma in samsiet nga taheh,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 12:3; 49:9"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam tungah Balak lungthahin a khuttum a ziel hi. Balak in Balaam kungah, “Ka galte samsie dinga kang hlat ahi a, ahi vangin nang in amate thumvei tah thupha na pie zawsop hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in na inn ah kipei ta’n! ‘Patatman tampitah hing pie vang,’ kang ci ngel hiven, hinanle Topa in na patatman ang khahtan hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kungah, “Keima kunga nang sawl na kamtaite kungah,"},"13":{"text":"‘Balak in kham le ngun inndim khat ei pie phiel nanle Topa’ gen kalvalin kei dei bangin a sie ahi a, a pha ahi zongin ka bawl thei sih hi; Topa’ gente beh ka gen ding hi,’ ci-in gen zo hi lo ka mah?"},"14":{"text":"Tu-in ka mite kungah ka pei ding hi; nidang hun ciengin tam mite in na mite tungah bang teng bawl ding uh ahei, ci thu kang kikuppi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a thuphuon tam bangin a gen hi: “Beor’ tapa Balaam’ thuphuon, a mit ciim khuomu theipa’ thuphuon,","title":"A Liveina Balaam’ Thuphuon"},"16":{"text":"Pasien’ thu a za pa’ thuphuon, Sangpen Pa’ pilna a thei pa’ thuphuon, Vanglienpa’ mangmu pa thuphuon, ama puasuhin, hinanle a mit siing lo pa’ thuphuon:"},"17":{"text":"Ke’n ama ka mu a, ahi vangin tu hi nai lo hi; ke’n ama ka en a, ahi vangin ama nai pah nai lo hi. Jacob sung pan aasi khat ang suoh ding a, Israel sung pan kumpi ciengkhut khat ang pieng ding hi. Tua in Moab’ gamgi dung teng satguoi ding a, ama in Seth-te’ gam zosie satcim ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Edom pen mi’ neisa suoh ding a, Seir zong a galte’ neisa a suoh ding hi. Tua laitahin Israel mite in hangsan tahin sem ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jacob sung panin uhpa khat ang pieng ding a, Ir khuopi sunga a suohtate kisusie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Amalek gam enin, a thuphuon tam bangin a gen hi: “Amalek, mi namte lahah a masa pen ahi a, ahi vangin a tawpna-ah kumtawn manthaina a thuoh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Ken mite enin, a thuphuon tam bangin a gen hi: Na tenna munkip ahi a, suongpi kawmah na bu kikoi hi;"},"22":{"text":"ahi vangin Ken ahile haltum dinga kisesa ahi hi. Asshur in bang tanvei galmatin ang nei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in thuphuon tam teng a genkia hi: “Kadei sei! Pasien in tamte a sep cieng, koi hing zo ding ahei?"},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Kittim panin tembawte ang pei-in Asshur le Eber genthei bawl ding hi; ama zong kumtawnin mangthai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Balaam tho-in a inn ah kilekia a, Balak zong a lampi-ah a pei hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shittim-ah Israel-te a op laita hun mite in Moab numeite tawh numei-pasal pahtatna a kipan uhi.","title":"Peor-a Baal Biehna"},"2":{"text":"Tam numeite in amau’ pasien biehpiehna-ah mi a ciel vua, mite in an ne-in amau’ pasien-te mai-ah a kun uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bangin Peor-ah Baal tawh Israel-te a na kizom vua, tuaci’n Israel-te tungah Topa’ lungthahna a kuong hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Israel-te kung pan a zauhuoi Topa’ lungthahna a kihei nadingin mipi lamkai zosie man inlen, Topa mai-ah suntang laipi-in khailia in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses in Israel thukhente kungah, “Peor-a Baal tawh a kizom na mite uh koipo na that ciet ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zaw lien ciengin kikhopna buh tunkotah amate kapin a op laitahun Moses’ muna le Israel mihon buppi’ muna-ah Israel-te khat pei-in a innkuonpite kungah Midian numei khat a peipi hi."},"7":{"text":"Siempu Aaron’ tapa, Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in a mu ciengin dingin mihonte lah panin a peikhie hi. A khut sungah teipi khat tawi-in,"},"8":{"text":"Israel mipa puonbuh sungah nuadel a, Israel mipa le a numei, a ni gelin a gilpi pailetin a dawtlia hi. Tuaci’n Israel mite lah panin gimna a veng hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua gimna tawh a si mimal tul sawmni le tulli pha hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"11":{"text":"“Siempu Aaron’ tapa, Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in Israel-te tunga ka lungthahna damsahkia zo hi. Keima in pamai ka sah bangin ama in pamai sa ahi ziehin pamai ka sahna tawh Israel-te ka susie sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, ‘Ka thuciem ahi nopsahna ama ka pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a Pasien adingin pawnthaw tahin a na pan zieh le Israel-te adingin thoidamna a na bawl ziehin, tua khu ama le ama zaw-a a suonlehlahte adingin tawntung siempu hina thuciemna hi ding hi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Midian numei tawh a kithatton Israel mipa’ min pen Simeon-te’ pupa innkuon lutang Salu’ tapa Zimri ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A kithat Midian numei nu’ min pen Midian-te’ innkuon pana pupa innkuon lutang Zur’ tanu Cozbi ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah,"},"17":{"text":"“Midian-te genthei bawl inlen amate zo gawp in;"},"18":{"text":"azieh pen amate in a khelpilna utawh note ang gimsah gawp vua, Peor tawh kisai thu le Peor ziehin gimna ni-a a kithat, amau’ sanggamnu, Midian ulien khat’ tanu Cozbi thu-ah note ang sol uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pul natna zaw ciengin Topa in Moses le siempu Aaron’ tapa Eleazar kungah,","title":"Khangtha Mi Phaza Simna"},"2":{"text":"“A kikhawm Israel mipi buppi kum sawmni pan a tungsie, amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in Israel sung panin paltan tum thei ding poma sim in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses le siempu Eleazar in Jericho galkhat Jordan gun gei, Moab zanglei-ah amate tawh kiho a,"},"4":{"text":"“ Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin, “Kum sawmni pan a tungsie teng sim un,” a ci hi. Egypt gam pan a a pei Israel-te:"},"5":{"text":"Israel’ ta masa Reuben ahi hi. Reuben’ suonlehlahte: Hanoch pan Hanoch bete; Pallu pan Pallu bete;"},"6":{"text":"Hezron pan Hezron bete; Carmi pan Carmi bete ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tam teng khu Reuben’ bete ahi uhi; amate mi tul sawmli le tulthum le zasagi le sawmthum pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale Pallu’ tapa Eliab ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Eliab’ tapa teng pen: Nemuel, Dathan, le Abiram ahi uhi. Tam Dathan le Abiram pen Korah tawh kipawlin Topa a na langdo lai-un Moses le Aaron langdo dinga mihonte lah pana na kiteel Dathan le Abiram tegel ma ahi a,"},"10":{"text":"lei in a kam kahin Korah tawh amate val tumin amau’ pawl teng a si sieng uhi; mei in zong mi zani le sawmnga a kahtum ciengin amate pen midangte dingin kithuhilna a suoh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Korah’ tapate si lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Simeon’ suon lehlahte: Nemuel pan Nemuel bete; Jamin pan Jamin bete; Jachin pan Jachin bete;"},"13":{"text":"Zerah pan Zerah bete; Shaul pan Shaul bete ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng pen Simeon bete ahi vua, mimal tul sawmni le tulni le zani pha uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Gad suonlehlahte: Zephon pan Zephon bete; Haggi pan Haggi bete; Shuni pan Shuni bete;"},"16":{"text":"Ozni pan Ozni bete; Eri pan Eri bete;"},"17":{"text":"Arod pan Arod bete; Areli pan Areli bete ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam teng pen Gad namdangte ahi vua, mimal tul sawmli le zanga pha uhi."},"19":{"text":"Judah’ tapate pen Er le Onan ahi uhi; Er le Onan pen Canaan gamah a si uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Judah’ suonlehlahte: Shelah pan Shelah bete; Perez pan Perez bete; Zerah pan Zerah bete;"},"21":{"text":"Perez-te: Hezron pan Hezron bete; Hamul pan Hamul bete ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tam teng pen Judah bete ahi vua, mimal tul sawmsagi le tulguh le zanga pha uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Issachar’ suon le hlahte: Tola pan Tola bete; Puvah pan Puvah bete;"},"24":{"text":"Jashub pan Jashub bete; Shimron pan Shimron bete ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tam teng pen Issachar bete ahi vua, mimal tul sawmguh le tulli le zathum pha uhi."},"26":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Zebulun suole hlahte: Sered pan Sered bete; Elon pan Elon bete; Jahleel pan Jahleel bete ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tam teng pen Zebulun bete ahi vua, mimal tul sawmguh le zanga pha uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Joseph’ tapate: Manasseh le Ephraim ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh’ suonlehlahte: Machir pan Machir bete; Machir pen Gilead’ pa ahi a; Gilead pan Gilead bete ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tam teng pen Gilead’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi: Iezer pan Iezer bete;"},"31":{"text":"Asriel pan Asriel bete; Shechem pan Shechem bete;"},"32":{"text":"Shemida pan Shemida bete; Hepher pan Hepher bete ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tu-in Hepher’ tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lo a, hizongle tanu a nei hi. Zelophehad tanute’ min in Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, le Tirzah ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tam teng pen Manasseh bete ahi vua, mimal tul sawmnga le tulni le zasagi pha uhi."},"35":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Ephraim’ suonle hlahte: Suthelah pan Suthelah bete; Becher pan Becher bete; Tahan pan Tahan bete ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Suthelah’ suonlehlahte: Eran pan Eran bete ahi uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ be zui-a Joseph’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Benjamin suonle hlahte: Bela pan Bela bete; Ashbel pan Ashbel bete; Ahiram pan Ahiram bete;"},"39":{"text":"Shephupham pan Shephupham bete; Hupham pan Hupham bete ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Bela’ tapate pen Ard le Naaman ahi uhi: Ard pan Ard bete; Naaman pan Naaman bete ahi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ be zui-in Benjamin’ suonlehlahte ahi a, mimal tul sawmli le tulnga le zaguh pha uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Dan’ suonlehlahte: Shuham pan Shuham bete ahi vua, tam teng pen amau’ be zui-in Dan suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Shuham bete zosie: mimal tul sawmguh le tulli le za li pha uhi."},"44":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Asher suonle hlahte: Imnah pan Imnah bete; Ishvi pan Ishvi bete; Beriah pan Beriah bete ahi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Beriah’ suonlehlahte: Heber pan Heber bete; Malchiel pan Malchiel bete ahi uhi."},"46":{"text":"Asher’ tanu’ min Serah ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Tam teng pen Asher bete ahi vua, mimal tul sawmnga le tulthum le zali pha uhi."},"48":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in Naphtali’ suonle hlahte: Jahzeel pan Jahzeel bete; Guni pan Guni bete;"},"49":{"text":"Jezer pan Jezer bete; Shillem pan Shillem bete ahi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ be zui-in Naphtali mite ahi vua, amate a kisimna ciengin tul sawmli le tulnga le zali pha uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tam teng pen a kisim Israel mi phaza hi a, tul zaguh le tulkhat le zasagi le sawmthum pha uhi."},"52":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah,"},"53":{"text":"“Mi phaza tawh kizui-in a luo dingun tam mite tungah leitang kihawm ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Minam tamte gouluo a tam na pie ding a, minam tawmte gouluo a tawm na pie ding hi. Minam zosie a mi phaza tawh kizui-in gouluo kipie ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Ahi vangin leitang pen aisanna tawh kihawm ding a, amau’ be min zui-in a luo ding uhi."},"56":{"text":"Aisanna tawh kizui-in a tamte tungah a tam, a tawmte tungah a tawmin a gouluo uh kihawmpieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Amau’ be zui-in a kisim Levi’ suonlehlahte: Gershon pan Gershon bete; Kohath pan Kohath bete; Merari pan Merari bete ahi uhi."},"58":{"text":"Tam teng pen Levi’ bete ahi uhi: Libni bete, Hebron bete, Mahli bete, Mushi bete, le Korah bete ahi uhi. Tu-in Kohath pen Amram’ pa ahi hi."},"59":{"text":"Amram’ zi min pen Levi sung pan Egypt gama a suoh Levi’ tanu Jochebed ahi hi. Tua nu in Amram tawh Aaron, Moses, le a sanggamnu uh Miriam nei hi."},"60":{"text":"Aaron’ tate pen Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar te ahi uhi.","ref":"Gam 3:2"},"61":{"text":"Hinanle Nadab le Abihu pen Topa mai-ah mei siengtho lo tawh biehna a pieh lai-un a si uhi.","ref":"Siem 10:1-2; Gam 3:4"},"62":{"text":"Pasal poma hla khat pana tungsie, amau’ sung pan a kisimte tul sawmni le tulthum pha uhi. Azieh pen Israel-te lahah amaw tanh kipie lo ahi ziehin Israel-te lahah amahaw kisimton lo hi."},"63":{"text":"Tam teng pen Moses le siempu Eleazar in Moab zanglei, Jordan gun gei Jericho gala a sim mite ahi uhi."},"64":{"text":"Tam teng lahah Moses le siempu Aaron in Sinai senel gama a simsa uh Israel-te khat zong kihal nawn lo hi."},"65":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in, “Senel gamah amate a si ding uhi,” a na cisa ahi hi. Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb le Nun’ tapa Joshua simlo amate khat beh om nawn lo hi.","ref":"Gam 14:26-35"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph’ tapate sung panin Manasseh’ tapa Machir, Machir’ tapa Gilead, Gilead’ tapa Hepher, Hepher’ tapa Zelophehad’ tanute a nai-ah a pei uhi. A tanute’ min pen: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, le Tirzah ahi hi.","title":"Zelophehad’ Tanute"},"2":{"text":"Amate, Moses le siempu Eleazar mai, makaite mai le mihon zosie mai, kikhopna buh tunkotah a ding vua,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka pa uh gamlah ah a si hi; Korah tawh kipawlin Topa langpanga a kikhawmte lahah ama a kihal kha sih hi, ahi vangin ama’ mawna zieha si ahi bo hi; ama in tapa a nei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in tapa a nei lo ziehin bang dingin a be sung panin ka pa uh’ min kiphiet talawm ding ahei? Ka pa sanggamte lahah ka luo ding uh ei pie un,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Moses in Topa mai-ah amau’ thu a tut hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:"},"7":{"text":"Zelophehad’ tanute thugen a dih ahi hi. A pa uh’ sanggamte lahah amate zong gamh na pie ding a, a tung vuah a pa uh’ gamh na tungsah ding hi.","ref":"Gam 36:2"},"8":{"text":"Israel-te tungah, ‘Pasal khat tapa nei loin a si leh ama’ gamh a tanu na luosah ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in tanu a nei sih leh ama’ gamh a sanggam pasalte na luosah ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in sanggam pasal a nei sih leh ama’ gamh pen a pa’ sanggam pasalte na luosah ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"A pa in sanggam pasal a nei sih leh ama’ gamh pen a be sunga a sanggam kinaipi pen na pie ding vua, ama in tua gamh a tang ding hi,’ ci-in na gen ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Abarim muol vumah kato inlen, Israel-te tunga ka pieh leitang en in.","title":"Moses’ Zalaih ding Joshua Kise (Thkna 31:1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Na mu zaw ciengin na sanggampa Aaron ma bangin nang zong na mite kung na zuon ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Zin senel gamah keima le mihonpite ka kihau lai-un ka thugen nei langpang uhi. Nang in amau’ mitmu-in tua tuite-ah ka siengthona na lah sih hi. (Tam teng pen Zin senel gam, Kadesh gam Meribah tui-a thupiengte ahi hi.)","ref":"Thkna 3:23-27; 32:48-52"},"15":{"text":"Moses in Topa hopi-in ama kungah,"},"16":{"text":"“Mihonte, a cing nei lo tuute a bah lo nadingin mi zosie’ hlagau a uh Topa Pasien in tua mipite lahah a sungtum a pusuoh thei ding, amate a pui ding le a lutpi ding, tua mihonte a uh dingin mi khat se in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 22:17; Ezk 34:5; Mat 9:36; Mrk 6:34","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Moses kungah, “A sunga Hlagau nei mipa ahi Nun’ tapa Joshua zawpi inlen ama tungah na khut ngam in.","ref":"Pei 24:13"},"19":{"text":"Siempu Eleazar le mihon zosie mai-ah ama dingsah inlen amau’ muna-ah za pie in."},"20":{"text":"Israel mihon zosie in a thu a man thei nadingin thuneina pawlkhat ama na pie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa mai-ah Urim tawh ama dinga thu a dawhpieh ding siempu Eleazar mai-ah ama a ding ding hi; ama’ thu tawh ama le a oppi Israel-te zosie, le mihon vannuoi pusuoh ding a, ama’ thu ma tawh a sungtum ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 28:30; 1Sam 14:41; 28:6"},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ thupieh bangin Moses a gamta hi. Ama in Joshua kai-in siempu Eleazar le mihon zosie mai-ah dingsah hi;"},"23":{"text":"ama tungah a khut ngam a, Topa in Moses tungtawna a gen bangin ama tungah thuneina za a pie hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:23"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Nisiel Biehnate (Pei 29:38-46)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel-te thupie inlen amau’ tungah tam bangin gen in: Keima dinga mei tawh kihal biehna an, a gimnamtui keima-a’ pen a kise hunin ka kungah nei pieh ding uh phawh un."},"3":{"text":"Nangma in amate kungah, Tami khu Topa tunga na pieh ding uh mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi, na ci ding hi: Tatsat lo biehna-in nisielin paubang lo kumkhat a pha tuuno ni na pie ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Zingmawngin tuuno khat na pie ding vua, khuo a mut ciengin adang tuuno khat na pie ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Note in an tawh biehna dingin annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat le a kigawi sathau ephah khat’ seli-suo-sekhat zong halin na pie ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tam pen Sinai Muol tunga kikipsah, Topa tungah a gimnamtui dinga kitatsatlo-a kipie mei tawh kihal biehna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Dawn thei biehna pen tuuno khatah hin khat’ seli-suo-sekhat hi ding hi; Topa tunga dawn thei biehna dingin siengtho munah lenggazu-cia pen na sung ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuuno adang khat pen zingmawnga a khat ma bangin khuo a mut ciengin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehna tawh na pie ding uhi; note in Topa tungah a gimnamtui dingin mei tawh kihal biehna na lui ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in kum khat a pha, paubang lo tuuno ni le an tawh biehna-in sathau tawh kihal annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm-suo- seni le dawn thei biehna tawh hi ding hi.","title":"Sabbath Biehnate"},"10":{"text":"Tam pen a kitatsatlo meihal biehna le dawn thei biehnate banah Sabbath siela na bawlbe ding uh meihal biehna ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 12:5"},"11":{"text":"Na hlate uh a kipat sielin Topa tungah meihal biehna na pie ding vua, bawngtang guol ni, tuutang khat, paubang lo kum khat a pha tuuno apa sagi hi ding hi;","title":"Hlasiel Biehnate"},"12":{"text":"bawngtang khatah an tawh biehna-in sathau kihal annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm-suo -sethum zong hi ding hi; tuale tuutang khatah an tawh biehna dingin sathau kihal annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-seni hi ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"tuuno zosie adingin an tawh biehna-in sathau kihal annel tuituoh sesawm-suo-sekhat hi ding a, tua khu Topa tungah mei tawh kihal a gimnamtui meihal biehna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Bawngtang khatah dawn thei biehna-in zu hin khat’ alang, tuutang khatah hin khat’ sethum-suo -sekhat, tuuno khatah hin khat’ seli-suo-sekhat hi ding hi. Tami khu kum khat sungin a hla siela meihal biehnate ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa tungah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat kipie ding hi; tua pen kitatsatlo-a meihal biehna le dawn thei biehnate bana kipie ding ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hla masa a ni sawm le li ni-in Topa’ Peisan Pawi kibawl ding hi.","title":"Peisan Pawi Biehnate (Siem 23:5-14)","ref":"Pei 12:1-13; Thkna 16:1-2"},"17":{"text":"Tam hla a ni sawm le nga ni pen pawi bawl ni ahi hi; ni sagi sung tol saw lo an kine ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in siengtho kikhopna khat om ding a, leitung nate na sem sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Topa tungah meihal biehna-in bawngtangno ni, tuutang khat, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa sagi na pie ding uhi; tuate pen paubang lo hi ding hi, ci thei un."},"20":{"text":"Amau’ an tawh biehna pen sathau kihal annel tuituoh hi ding hi: Bawngtang khatah annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sethum na pie ding vua, tuutang khatah sesawm-suo-seni hi ding hi;"},"21":{"text":"tuuno sagite khatah sesawm-suo-sekhat na pie ding uhi;"},"22":{"text":"thoidamna bawl nadingin mawhna zieha biehna-in keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam teng pen zingmawng tatsatlo-a kibawl meihal biehnate banah na bawlbe ding uh ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangma-in mei tawh kihal an tawh biehna ahi, Topa tunga a gimnamtui, ni sagi sung ni sielin na pie ding uhi; tatsatlo-a kibawl meihal biehna le dawn thei biehnate banah tuate kipiehbe ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in a siengtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uhi; tua ni-in leitung nasepte na sem sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:14-20; 23:15; 34:18; Thkna 16:3-8"},"26":{"text":"Topa tungah biehna-in ga masa na pieh ni uh, nipikal pawi sung antha na pieh ni-un a siengtho kikhopna khat na bawl ding uhi; khum ni-in leitung nate na sem sih ding uhi.","title":"Nipi Pawi Biehnate (Siem 23:15-22)"},"27":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui meihal biehna na lui ding vua, bawngtang ano ni, tuutang khat, le kum khat a pha tuuno apa sagi hi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Amau’ an tawh biehna dingin bawngtang khatah sathau kihal annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sethum, tuutang khatah sesawm-suo-seni,"},"29":{"text":"le tuuno sagite khatah sesawm-suo-sekhat ciet na pie ding uhi;"},"30":{"text":"note ading thoidamna bawlna-in keel apa khat hi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"A tatsatlo-a bawl meihal biehna le an tawh biehnate banah tuate le dawn thei biehna na piehbe ding uhi. Tua teng pen paubang lo hi ding hi.","ref":"Pei 23:16; 34:22; Thkna 16:9-12"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hla sagina a ni masa ni-in a siengtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uhi; note in leitung nasepte na sem sih ding uhi. Khum ni pen note dingin pengkul na tum ni ding uh ahi a,","title":"Pengkul Pawi Biehnate (Siem 23:23-25)"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui meihal biehna-in bawngtang ano khat, tuutang khat, le kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sagi na pie ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"An tawh a biehna uh pen sathau kihal annel tuituoh hi ding a, bawngtang khatah ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sethum, tuutang khatah sesawm-suo -seni,"},"4":{"text":"le tuuno sagite khatah sesawm-suo-sekhat ciet hi ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"noma ading thoidamna bawl nadingin mawna zieha biehna-in keel apa khat hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam teng pen hla tha meihal biehna le an tawh biehna, tatsatlo meihal biehna, an tawh biehna, le tuate dinga ngaina a om bangin Topa ading a gimnamtui le mei tawh kihal biehna ahi dawn thei biehnate banah bawlbe lai dingte ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tam hla a sagina a ni sawm ni-in a siengtho kikhopna khat na bawlin noma le noma na kideh ding uhi; note in na na sem sih ding uhi.","title":"Thoidam Ni Silpiehte"},"8":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui meihal biehna-in bawngtang ano khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sagi na pie ding vua, tuate pen paubang lo hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"An tawh a biehna dingun bawngtang khatah sathau kihal annel tuituoh ephah khat’ sesawm- suo-sethum, tuutang khatah sathau kihal annel tuituoh sesawm-suo-seni,"},"10":{"text":"tuuno sagite khatah sesawm-suo- sekhat hi ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"thoidamna bawl nadingin mawna zieha biehna, tatsatlo meihal biehna, an tawh biehna, le dawn thei biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat tawh hi ding hi.","ref":"Siem 16:29-34"},"12":{"text":"Note in a hla sagina ni sawm le ni nga ni-in a siengtho kikhopna khat na bawl ding uhi; leitung nasepte na sem sih ding uhi. Topa adingin ni sagi sung pawi na bawl ding uhi.","title":"Buh Pawi Biehnate (Siem 23:33-44)"},"13":{"text":"Topa tungah a gimnamtui, mei tawh kihal biehna dingin bawngtang ano sawm le thum, tuutang ni, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawm le ni na pie ding uhi. Tuate pen paubang lo hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"An tawh a biehna dingun bawngtang sawm le thumte khatah ephah khat’ sesawm-suo-sethum, tuutang nite khatah sesawm suo seni,"},"15":{"text":"le tuuno sawm le lite khatah sesawm-suo-sekhat hi ding hi;"},"16":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna, an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna adingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A ni ni ni-in bawngtang ano sawm le ni, tuutang ni, kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sawm le li,"},"18":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-a a kiciengtan bangin bawngtangte, tuutangte, le tuunote adingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh kipie ding hi;"},"19":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna, an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in bawngtang sawm le khat, tuutang ni, le kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sawm le li,"},"21":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-in a kiciengtan bangin bawngtangte, tuutangte, le tuunote adingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh hi ding hi;"},"22":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna le an tawh biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A ni li ni-in bawngtang sawm, tuutang ni, le kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sawm le li,"},"24":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-in a kiciengtan bangin bawngtangte, tuutangte, le tuunote tawh pieh dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh hi ding hi;"},"25":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna, an tawh biehna, le dawnthei biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A ni nga ni-in bawngtang kuo, tuutang ni, kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sawm le li,"},"27":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-in a kiciengtan bawngtangte, tuutangte, le tuunote tawh pieh dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh hi ding hi;"},"28":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna le an tawh biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A ni guh ni-in bawngtang giet, tuutang ni, le kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sawm le li,"},"30":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-in a kiciengtan bawngtangte, tuutangte, le tuunote tawh pieh dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh hi ding hi;"},"31":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna, an tawh biehna, le dawn thei biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in bawngtang sagi, tuutang ni, le kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sawm le li,"},"33":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-in a kiciengtan bawngtangte, tuutangte, le tuunote tawh pieh dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate tawh hi ding hi;"},"34":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehna, le dawn thei biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"A ni giet ni-in note in kikhopna thupi khat na nei ding uhi; leitung nate na sem sih ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Topa dingin a gimnamtui, meihal biehna dingin bawngtang khat, tuutang khat, kum khat a pha paubang lo tuuno apa sagi,"},"37":{"text":"a phaza tawh kizui-in a kiciengtan bawngtang, tuutang, le tuunote tawh pieh dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate hi ding hi;"},"38":{"text":"tatsatlo meihal biehnate banah mawna zieha biehna dingin keel apa khat zong hi ding hi.","ref":"Pei 23:16; 34:22; Siem 23:34; Thkna 16:13-15"},"39":{"text":"Na kiciemna zieh vua biehnate le nop thu-a na biehnate ban vuah na meihal biehnate uh bangin an tawh na biehnate uh, dawn thei na biehnate uh, le thunuoma na biehnate uh, a kise na pawi hunte vuah tam teng, Topa tungah na pie ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Moses in Israel-te tungah a unpi-in a gen hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Israel minam lutangte tungah tam bangin a gen hi: Topa’ thupieh tam ahi hi.","title":"Numeite’ Kiciemna"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat in Topa tungah kiciemna khat a nei cieng ahi a, ama le ama a kikhi nadinga kamciem khat a nei ciengin ahi zongin, ciempel lo ding hi; a kam pana a gingkhie zosie dung zui-in gamta ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 23:21-23; Mat 5:33"},"3":{"text":"Numei khangdawng khat in a pa’ inna a op lai-in Topa tungah kiciemna khat a nei ciengin a khangdawn lai, a pa inna a op lai-a kamciemna tawh ama le ama kikhi a,"},"4":{"text":"a pa in ama le ama a kikhina ahi a kiciemna ahi sihle a kamciem za napi bangma a gen sih leh ama’ kiciemna zosie a kip hi ding hi; tua ciengin ama le ama a kikhina ahi a kamciem zosie zong a kip hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pa in tua thu a zah hunin ama kungah a lungkim lona thu a gen leh, a kiciemna le ama le ama a kikhina ahi a kamciem zong kip lo ding hi; a pa in ama kungah a lungkim lona thu a gen ziehin Topa in tua nu maisah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua nu in ama le ama a kikhi nadingin thuciemna a bawl zaw ahi a, ngaisut masah lopi-in a kam tawh a kimawh ciem zaw ahi zongin, pasal a nei a,"},"7":{"text":"tuale a pasal in tua thu a zah behin a zi kunga bangma a gen sih leh, tua nu’ kiciemna a kip hi ding a, ama le ama kikhina ahi a kamciem zong a kip hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pasal in tua thu a zah behin a zi kunga a lungkim lona thu a gen leh ama le ama kikhina ahi numei tunga om kiciemna le ngaisut masah lopi-a a hamnate ama in phietpieh ding hi; tuale Topa in tua nu’ mawna maisah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"(Ahi vangin meigong numei khat ahi a, mi khulsa numei khat ahi zongin ama le ama a kikhina ahi a kiciemna pen ama tungah kip ding hi)"},"10":{"text":"Ama in a pasal’ inn ah kiciemna khat a bawl a, ahi sihle ciemtui dawnna khat tawh ama le ama a kikhi leh,"},"11":{"text":"a pasal in tua thu za napi, ama kungah bangma gen loin ama tunga lungkim lona thu a gen sih leh ama’ kiciemna zosie kip ding a, ama le ama kikhina ahi kamciem zosie zong kip ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pasal in tua thute a zah behin a phietpieh leh a kiciemna tawh kisai-in a kam sung pana a ging tapo ahi a, ama’ kamciemna tawh kisaite ahi zongin kip lo ding hi. A pasal in tuate phietpieh zo ahi ziehin tua nu’ mawna Topa in maisah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuciemna khatpo ahi a, ama le ama a kiniel nading kikhina kamciem khatpo ahi zongin a pasal in kipsah thei, a pasal in phietmang thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pasal in ni khat zaw ni khat ama kungah bangma a gen sih leh ama in a zi tunga om thuciemna zosie ahi a, a kamciem zosie ahi zongin a kipsah ahi hi; tua teng a zah behin ama kungah bangma a gen lo ziehin ama in tua teng a kipsah zo ahi ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in tua teng a zah zaw-in a nua phiet leh ama’ khielna ama in puo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam teng pen pasal le a zi, le a pa’ inn sunga a nungah a khangdawn lai-a a om a tanu le a pa tawh kisai zui dinga Topa in Moses tunga a thupieh ngainate ahi hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in ama kungah,","title":"Midian-te tawh Kidona"},"2":{"text":"“Midian-te tungah Israel-te’ phu la in; tua zaw ciengin na mipite kung na zuon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in mite kungah, “Midian-te tungah Topa’ phulahna a sem ding, pei-in Midian-te a do dingin na mite pawlkhat galhiem guon un."},"4":{"text":"Israel minamte lah panin galdo dingin nam khatah mi tulkhat ta na kuonsah ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel tul tampite lah panin minam khatah tulkhat ta kidong a, gal do dingin mi tul sawm le tulni galhiem kiguon hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in amate, minam khatah tulkhat ta, a khut sungah biehinn vanzahte le patau kona pengkulte a tawi siempu Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas tawh galdo dingin a kuonsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Midian-te a do vua, pasal zosie a that uhi."},"8":{"text":"A mi tha uh adangte banah Midian kumpi nga teng: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, le Reba a that uhi; amate in Beor’ tapa Balaam zong namsau tawh a that uhi."},"9":{"text":"Israel-te in Midian numeite le a tasente salin a man nuhi; amate in a tuuhonte ule a na zosie uzong galvan lahin a la sieng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a tenna uh khuopite le a giephuol zosie uh mei tawh a haltum vua,"},"11":{"text":"ahi vangin gal sunga a mat zosie uh, mihing le ganhingte a peipi sieng uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jericho mun Jordan gei, Moab zanglei giephuola om Moses, siempu Eleazar, le Israel mihonpite kungah a galmatte ule a vanlahte a tut uhi."},"13":{"text":"Moses, siempu Eleazar, le mihon makai zosie zong giephuol pulamah vai dawn dingin a pei uhi.","title":"Galdona Pan Kilekia"},"14":{"text":"Galdona pana ang pei mi tul tampi a uhte le mi za tampi a uh galkapmangte tungah Moses lungthah hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses in amate kungah, “Numei zosie na hinkhawi uh amah?"},"16":{"text":"Tam sunga om numeite in Peor vai-ah Balaam’ thuhilna ziehin Topa tungah Israel-te a zuoutatsah vua, tuaci’n Topa’ mihonte lahah gimna a tung hi.","ref":"Gam 25:1-9"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in nausente lahah pasal poma that unlen, pasal tawh a lumtonsa numei poma zong that un."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin pasal tawh a lumton nai lo ngahnuno zosie noma dingin hingkhawi un."},"19":{"text":"Ni sagi sung giephuol pulamah om un; mi khat po a that ahi sihle misi luong a thamkha poma in a ni thum ni le a ni sagi ni-in noma le na galmatte uh na kisiensuo ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na puon zosie uh, savun tawh kibawl na zosie, keel mul tawh kibawl na zosie le sing tawh kibawl na zosie na siensuo ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Siempu Eleazar in gal sunga kuon galkapte kungah tam bangin a gen hi: “ Topa in Moses a thupieh thukham ngaina tami ahi hi:"},"22":{"text":"Kham, ngun, sumngo, sia, langva, le hangeh,"},"23":{"text":"mei a do zo poma mei-ah kihalin a sieng hi ding hi. Ahi vangin siensuona tui tawh zong kisiensuo ding hi; tuale mei a do zo lo poma tui tawh kisiensuo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in na puonte uh sawpin a siengtho na hi ding uhi; tua zaw ciengin giephuol ah na pei thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in ama kungah,","title":"Galmatte le Vanlahte Hawmna"},"26":{"text":"“Nangma, siempu Eleazar, le mihonte’ pupa innkuon lutang teng in gal sunga kiman teng, mihing le ganhing, a ni-in sim un."},"27":{"text":"Gal van kingate khen ni suo unlen, gal kuon galhangte le mihonte hawmpieh un."},"28":{"text":"Topa’ sieh dingin gal a kuon galhangte’ satanh panin mihingte, bawngtangte, laate, tuuhonte ahi sihle keelte zanga ciengin khat ta tuomkoi un."},"29":{"text":"Tua lah panin alang la-in Topa tunga biehna dingin siempu Eleazar tungah pie un."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te’ nga alang sung panin mihingte, bawngtangte, laate, tuuhonte ahi sihle keelte-ganhing zosie- sawmnga ciengin khat ta la-in Topa’ biehbuh a kem Levi-te tungah na pie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Moses le siempu Eleazar in a bawl uhi."},"32":{"text":"Galkapte in a lah zaw ciengin vanlah a omlaite a gawmin: Tuutang tul zaguh le tul sawmsagi le tulnga,"},"33":{"text":"bawng tul sawmsagi le tulni,"},"34":{"text":"laa tul sawmguh le tulkhat,"},"35":{"text":"le pasal tawh a lumton nai lo ngahnuno a unpi-in tul sawmthum le tulni ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Gal kuonte’ nga ahi tanh alang pen tuu tul zathum le tul sawmthum le tulsagi le zanga hi a,"},"37":{"text":"Topa’ sieh ding pen tuu zaguh le sawmsagi le nga ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Bawng tul sawmthum le tulguh hi a, tua lah panin Topa’ sieh ding pen sawmsagi le ni ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Laa tul sawmthum le zanga hi a, tuate lah panin Topa’ sieh ding pen sawmguh le khat ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Mihing tul sawm le tulguh hi a, tuate lah panin Topa’ sieh ding pen mihing sawmthum le ni ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Moses in siempu Eleazar tungah Topa bieh nading siekaih a pie hi."},"42":{"text":"Galkapte tung panin Moses in Israel-te tanh dinga a khenkhiet alang teng ahile,"},"43":{"text":"mihonte’ tanh alang teng pen tuu tul zathum le tul sawmthum le tulsagi le zanga,"},"44":{"text":"bawng tul sawmthum le tulguh,"},"45":{"text":"laa tul sawmthum le zanga,"},"46":{"text":"le mihing tul sawm le tulguh ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te’ nga alang sung panin mihing le ganhing sawmnga ciengin khat ta la a, Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Topa’ biehbuh a kem Levi-te tungah a pie hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkap a tul tampite tunga uliente ahi, tul tampi a uhte le za tampi a uhte, Moses kungah a pei vua,"},"49":{"text":"“Ko na nasemte in ka uhna nei vua om galhangte ka sim zo ta vua, khat zong a pelem ka om sih uhi."},"50":{"text":"Topa mai-ah kote dinga thoidamna bawl nading, Topa’ biehna dingin kham tawh kibawl nate, banbulte le tauciente, min gielna khutsipte, bilbate, le khite, ka mu ciet uh kang tawi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"51":{"text":"Moses le siempu Eleazar in amate tung panin khutsiemna tawh kibawl kham zosie a sang uhi."},"52":{"text":"A tul tampi a uhte le a za tampi a uhte tung pana kinga Topa’ tunga a pieh uh khamte a unpi-in shekel tul sawm le tulguh le zasagi le sawmnga gih hi."},"53":{"text":"(Galkapte in amate ading ciet van a kilah uhi.)"},"54":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses le siempu Eleazar in a tul tampi le a za tampi a uhte’ tung panin khamte a sang vua, Topa mai-ah Israel-te a kiphaw nadingin kikhopna buh sungah a koi uhi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Reuben-te le Gad-te in ganhon tampi a nei uhi. Jazer gam le Gilead gam pen gan khawi nadingin a hoi lam a mu ciengun,","title":"Galzawna le Jordan Gal Gamhawmna (Thkna 3:12-22)"},"2":{"text":"Gad-te le Reuben-te pei-in Moses, siempu Eleazar, le mihon makaite hopi-in,"},"3":{"text":"“Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, le Beon-"},"4":{"text":"Israel mihonte mai-ah Topa in a na lah gamte pen gan cinna gam hoi ahi hi; na nasemte in gan ka nei uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in, “Na muna-ah maipha ka nga uleh na nasemte’ luo dingin tami gam ei pie in; Jordan gal ei kaisah da mai in,” a cibe lai uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Moses in Gad-te le Reuben-te kungah, “Note tam munah to ziuzieu-in na sanggamte gal sima kuon ding ahi uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"Topa in a piehsa gam a pei nading vuah Israel-te bang dinga lungkiesah dinga kisa na hi uh ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Kadesh-barnea panin gam van dingin ka sawl lai-in na pu na pate un tam bang ma ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Eshcol Kuom tungto-in tua gam a mu ciengun, Topa in a piehsa gam a pei nading vuah Israel-te a lungkiesah uhi.","ref":"Gam 13:17-33"},"10":{"text":"Khum ni-in Topa lungthahna kikuontaw a, tuale kiciemin,"},"11":{"text":"‘Amate in a lungsim tahpi utawh kei ei zui lo uh ahi ziehin Egypt gam pana ang peito mite lah panin kum sawmni pan a tungsie koima khat beh in Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tungah pieh dinga ka ciem gam-"},"12":{"text":"Kenaz mi Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb le Nun’ tapa Joshua-te longal in a mu sih ding uhi, azieh pen amahawn lungsim tahpi tawh Topa a zui sih uhi,’ a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel-te tungah Topa’ lungthahna kikuontaw a, Topa mai-ah sietna a bawl tua khangmi zosie a manthai sieng masangsie-un, gamlahah amate kum sawmli sung vaivasah uhi.","ref":"Gam 14:26-35"},"14":{"text":"No mawneite’ suonte, na pu na pate uh’ tangin Israel-te tungah Topa’ a huoisie lungthahna a pungsah dinga ang khang na hi uhi!"},"15":{"text":"Ama zui loin na piel uleh ama in gamlah-ah amate nuasiekia ding hi; note na hi uleh tam mi zosie a susie na hi ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah a pei vua, “Ka gante vua dingin tuuhuong bawlin ka tate vua dingin khuo ka sat ding vua,"},"17":{"text":"ahi vangin a tun nading mun uh amate ka tut masangsie-un, Israel-te mai-ah galhiem tawi-in a madawhin ka pei ding uhi. Tua kikal sungin tam gama a teng mite ziehin ka naupangte uh kul tawh ki-im khuopite sungah a teng ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Israel-te zosie in a luo ding uh a nga sieng masangsie-un ka inn vuah ka kinuale sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jordan galkhat le a bansie pen amate tawh ka luoton sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tam lam gal Jordan nisuona lam teng pen kohaw’ luo ding ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moses in a kung vuah, “Tam bangin note gamta-in, gal do dingin galhiem tawi-in Topa mai-ah na pei vua,"},"21":{"text":"ama in a mai panin a galte a nawdawh masang galhiem a tawi nohaw zosie in Topa mai-ah Jordan gun na galkai vua,"},"22":{"text":"Topa mai-a leitang a kilah masangsie - Topa tung le Israel-te tungah na sep ding teng uh a zo suohin na kilekia thei ding vua, tam leitang pen Topa mai-ah noma’ neisa ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanle tami na bawl sih uleh Topa tunga a khiel zo na hi ta vua, na khielna un ang sulzui ding khu kitheitel un."},"24":{"text":"Na naupangte vua dingin khuopite sat unlen, na gante vua dingin tuuhuong bawl un; ahi vangin na kamciemsa bangun bawl un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gad-te le Reuben-te in Moses kungah, “Ka pu uh’ thupieh bangin na nasemte ka gamta ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka naupangte uh, ka zite uh, ka tuuhonte uh, ka ganhon zosie uh pen Gilead gam khum munah a om suoh ding uhi;"},"27":{"text":"hinanle ka pu ei thupieh bangin na nasemte in galhiem tawi-in Topa ading gal sim dingin ka galkai ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate tawh kisai-in Moses in siempu Eleazar, Nun’ tapa Joshua, le Israel minamte’ pupa innkuon lutang teng tungah thu a pie hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in a amate kungah, “Gad-te le Reuben-te, galvante silin gal sim dingin Topa mai-ah a kithawisa poma in note Jordan gun hing galkaipi-in na mai vuah gal ang zawpi ding vua, tua ciengin note in zong amau’ nei dingin Gilead gam na pie ding uhi;"},"30":{"text":"ahi vangin note tawh hiem tawi-in a galkai sih uleh zong Canaan gam sunga note lahah gam nga veve ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Gad-te le Reuben-te in a dawngkia vua, “ Topa gensa bangin na nasemte tungah ka gamta ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hiem tawi-in Topa mai Canaan gam ka galkai ding vua, ahi vangin kohaw’ luo ahi ka neisa uh pen Jordan tam lam pangah a om ding hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Josh 1:12-15"},"33":{"text":"Moses in Gad-te, Reuben-te, le Joseph’ tapa Manasseh minam alangte tungah, Amor kumpi Shihon’ gam le Bashan kumpi Og’ gam, a gamsung le a khuopite, a gamgi huop sunga khuopi zosie tawh amate a pie hi."},"34":{"text":"Gad-te in Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,"},"35":{"text":"Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,"},"36":{"text":"Beth-nimrah, le Beth-haran, kul tawh ki-im khuopite, le tuuhuongte a lamkia uhi."},"37":{"text":"Reuben-te in Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,"},"38":{"text":"Nebo, le Baal-meon (min pawlkhat kikhel), le Sibmah khuopite a lamphakia uhi; a lamphat uh khuopite min tha a phuo uhi."},"39":{"text":"Manasseh’ tapa Machir’ suonlehlahte, Gilead-ah pei-in tua gam a la vua, khum sunga om Amor-te a suonmang uhi;"},"40":{"text":"tuaci’n Moses in Manasseh’ tapa Machir tungah Gilead pie a, khum munah ama a teng hi."},"41":{"text":"Manasseh’ tapa Jair pei-in a khuotate uh la a, tuate Havvoth-jair ci-in min a phuo hi."},"42":{"text":"Nobah pei-in Kenath le a khuotate la a, ama’ min tapin Nobah a phuoh hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses le Aaron makaina tawh Egypt gam pan Israel-te a honin a pei lai-un, galkap kivaipuoh dan tawh a khuolzinna uh mun teng pen tam teng ahi hi.","title":"Israel-te Khuolzinna Munte"},"2":{"text":"Moses in Topa’ thupiehna tawh phuol khat pan phuol khat a amau’ kipatna munte a giel hi. Tam teng pen amau’ kipatna mun tawh kizui-in a giephuolte uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A hla masa, tua hla ni sawm le ni nga ni-in Rameses panin a dingkhie uhi; peisan pawi a manzaw a zing ni-in Egypt-te’ mitmu-in Israel-te hangsan tahin a peikhie vua,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in amate lahah a satlia a tacil uh zosie Egypt-te in a vui laitah uh ahi hi. Topa in a pasien-te uh tung nangawnah thu a khen hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Rameses pan Israel-te ding khie-in Succoth-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Succoth pan ding khie-in senel gam mong Etham-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"7":{"text":"Etham panin amate dingkhie-in Baal-ephon tawh kimaingat Pi-hahiroth lamah a kiheikia uhi; amate in Migdol mai-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pi-hahiroth pan dingkhie-in tuipi kantanin senel gamah a pei vua, Etham senel gamah nithum sung lamah pei-in Marah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"9":{"text":"Marah pan dingkhie-in Elim a tung uhi; Elim-ah tuinah sawm le ni le lutu kung sawmsagi om a, khum munah giephuol a sat uhi."},"10":{"text":"Elim panin a dingkhie vua, amate in San Tuipi gei-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"11":{"text":"San Tuipi pan a ding khie vua, Sin senel gamah giephuol a sat uhi."},"12":{"text":"Sin senel gam pan amate a dingkhie vua, Dophkah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"13":{"text":"Dophkah pan amate dingkhie vua, Alush-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"14":{"text":"Alush pan a ding khie vua, mite dawn ding tui a om lona Rephidim-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"15":{"text":"Rephidim pan a dingkhie vua, Sinai senel gamah giephuol a sat uhi."},"16":{"text":"Sinai senel gam pan a dingkhie vua, Kibroth-hattaavah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kibroth-hattaavah pan a dingkhie vua, Hazeroth-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hazeroth pan a dingkhie vua, Rithmah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"19":{"text":"Rithmah pan a dingkhie vua, Rimmon-perez-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"20":{"text":"Rimmon-perez pan a ding khie vua, Libnah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"21":{"text":"Libnah pan a dingkhie vua, Rissah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"22":{"text":"Rissah pana dingkhie vua, Kehelathah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kehelathah pan a dingkhie vua, Shepher Muol ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"24":{"text":"Shepher Muol pan a dingkhie vua, Haradah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"25":{"text":"Haradah pan a dingkhie vua, Makheloth-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"26":{"text":"Makheloth pan a dingkhie vua, Tahath ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tahath pan a dingkhie vua, Terah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"28":{"text":"Terah pan a dingkhie vua, Mithkah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"29":{"text":"Mithkah pan a dingkhie vua, Hashmonah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hashmonah pan a dingkhie vua, Moseroth-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"31":{"text":"Moseroth pan a dingkhie vua, Bene-jaakan-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"32":{"text":"Bene-jaakan pan a dingkhie vua, Hor-haggidgad-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hor-haggidgad pan a dingkhie vua, Jotbathah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jotbathah pan a dingkhie vua, Abronah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"35":{"text":"Abronah pan a dingkhie vua, Ezion-geber ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ezion-geber pan a dingkhie vua, Zin senel gam ah giephuol a sat uhi (tua khu Kadesh mun ahi
