hi)."},"37":{"text":"Kadesh pan a dingkhie vua, Edom gammong-Hor Muol ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"38":{"text":"Egypt pan Israel-te a peikhiet zaw uh a kum sawmlina, a hla ngana, a ni masa ni-in Topa’ thupiehna tawh Hor Muol tungah siempu Aaron kato a, khum munah a si hi.","ref":"Gam 20:22-28; Thkna 10:6; 32:50"},"39":{"text":"Hor Muol tungah Aaron a si laitahin kum za le kum sawmni le kum thum pha hi."},"40":{"text":"Canaan gam Negeb-a a teng Canaan mi Arad kumpipa in Israel-te ang pei hi ci thu a za hi.","ref":"Gam 21:1"},"41":{"text":"Hor Muol panin a dingkhie vua, Zalmonah-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"42":{"text":"Zalmonah pan a dingkhie vua, Punon-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"43":{"text":"Punon pan a dingkhie vua, Oboth-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"44":{"text":"Oboth pan a dingkhie vua, Moab gam sung Iye-abarim ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"45":{"text":"Iyim pan a dingkhie vua, Dibon-gad ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"46":{"text":"Dibon-gad pan a dingkhie vua, Almon-diblathaim-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"47":{"text":"Almon-diblathaim pan a dingkhie vua, Nebo tun masang Abarim muolte-ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"48":{"text":"Abarim muolte pan dingkhie-in Moab zanglei Jordan gungei Jericho-ah giephuol a sat uhi;"},"49":{"text":"amate in Jordan gei Beth-jeshimoth panin Moab zanglei-a om Abel-shittim dongin giephuol a sat uhi."},"50":{"text":"Moab zanglei Jordan gungei Jericho khuo-ah Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Canaan Zaw nading Lamlahna"},"51":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen a kung vuah tam bangin gen in: Jordan gun kansanin Canaan gam na tun ciengun,"},"52":{"text":"na mai panun tua gama a teng zosie notmang sieng unlen, a suong milim zosie uh suhsiet piehin, a kisung a milimte uh na susie ding vua, a munsang zosie uh na phelmang ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Khum gam pen na nei ding vua kang pieh ahi ziehin tua leitang note in tang unlen a sungah teng un."},"54":{"text":"Na be na phung utawh kizui-in aisanna tawh tua leitang na hawm ding uhi; mici tamte a golzaw pie-in mici tawmte a neuzaw na pie ding uhi; mi khatpo tunga ai a tuhna popo ama-a’ hi pai ding hi; na be na phung sung vua na pate uh nam tawh kizui-in khum gam na luo ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 26:54-56"},"55":{"text":"Ahi vangin na mai panun khum gama a na tengsa mite na nawmang sih uleh, na opsah lai uh mite pen note dingin na mit uh ang do, na pang uh ang sun ling tawh a kibang ding uhi; amate in na tenna gam vuah ang lung gimsah ding uhi."},"56":{"text":"Amate tungah bawl dinga ka ngaisut bangin na tung vuah kang bawl ding hi, ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Gamgite"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te thupie inlen a kung vuah tam bangin gen in: Canaan leitangah na lut ciengun (Canaan gam, na luo ding vua gamgi hielsa a kang piehte tam teng ahi hi)"},"3":{"text":"na leitaw lampang uh pen Zin senel gam panin Edom pang teng hi ding hi. Na leitaw lam gamgi uh pen nisuona lamah Si Tuipi mong pan kipan ding hi;"},"4":{"text":"na gamgi uh Akrabbim katona leitaw lamah kawi-in Zin kansan ding a, a mong tawpna pen Kadesh-barnea leitaw lam hi ding hi; tua ciengin Hazar-addar dong pei suohin Azmon kansan ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"Azmon panin Egypt Lui lamah gamgi kawi-in Tuipi-ah tawp ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Nitumna lam gamgi dingin Tuipi Lien le tua ’ gun dung teng na tang ding uhi; tam pen nitumna lam na gamgi uh hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Leilu lam na gamgi uh tam hi ding hi: Tuipi Lien panin Hor Muol dong na gamgi uh na ciemte ding uhi;"},"8":{"text":"Hor Muol panin Lebo-hamath dong na ciemte ding vua, gamgi mong in Zedad dong ban ding hi;"},"9":{"text":"tua ciengin Ziphron dong gamgi kihlung ding a, a mong pen Hazar-enan ah tawp ding hi. Tami khu leilu lam na gamgi uh hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nisuona lam na gamgi uh Hazar-enan panin Shepham dong na ciemte ding uhi;"},"11":{"text":"gamgi pen Shepham panin Ain nisuona pang lama om Riblah dongah peisuh ding a, tua gamgi peisuhin Chinnereth tuipi nisuona lam gamken dong bansuh ding hi;"},"12":{"text":"Jordan dongin gamgi peisuh ding a, a mong pen Si Tuipi ah tawp ding hi. Tam pen a kimvela gamgi nei na gam uh hi ding hi, ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te thupie-in tam bangin a gen hi: Tam pen minam kuo le minam alangte tungah pieh dingin Topa in a thupieh, aisanna tawh na luo ding uh leitang ahi hi;","ref":"Gam 26:52-56"},"14":{"text":"azieh pen Reuben minamte, amau’ innkuonte, le Gad minam amau’ pupa innkuonte in a gouluo uh a la zo ta vua, Manasseh minam alangte in zong a la zo ta uhi;"},"15":{"text":"Minam ni gel le minam alangte in a gouluo dingun nisuona lam, Jordan gal Jericho nisuona lam teng a la uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Josh 14:1-5"},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Minam Makaite"},"17":{"text":"Na luo ding uh leitang ang hawmpieh dingte min pen siempu Eleazar le Nun’ tapa Joshua-te ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na luo ding uh leitang hawm dingin minam simah makai khat ta na la ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ min ahi hi: Judah minam sung panin Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Simeon minam sung panin Ammihud’ tapa Shemuel ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin minam sung panin Chislon’ tapa Elidad ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Dan minam sung panin makai khat, Jogli’ tapa Bukki ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Joseph’ tapate sung panin: Manasseh minam makai khat, Ephod’ tapa Hanniel ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ephraim minam sung panin makai khat, Shiphtan’ tapa Kemuel ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Jebulun minam sung panin makai khat, Parnach’ tapa Eli-zaphan ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Issachar minam sung panin makai khat, Azzan’ tapa Paltiel ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Asher minam sung panin makai khat, Shelomi’ tapa Ahihud ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Naphtali minam sung panin makai khat, Ammihud’ tapa Pedahel ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam teng pen Israel-te adingin Canaan gamah leitang hawm dinga Topa in thu a pieh mite ahi uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jericho khuo Jordan gun gei Moab zanglei-ah Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Levi-te’ Khuopite"},"2":{"text":"Amate in luo-in a nei ding uh sung panin Levi-te a sunga a ten nading khuopite a pieh nadingun Israel-te thu pie in; khuopite kimvela lonona mun teng zong Levi-te na pie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuopite pen amau’ tenna hi ding a, lonona munte zong amau’ tuuhonte le bawnghonte, amau’ ganhonte le amau’ ganta zosie-a’ hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Levi-te na pieh ding uh khuopi lonona munte in khuopi kul panin a kimkot tong tulkhat huom ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Khuopi pulam te inlen nisuona lampang tong tulni, leitaw lampang tong tulni, nitumna lampang tong tulni, leilu lampang tong tulni hi ding a, a laikimah khuopi om ding hi; tam pen amau’ khuopi lonona munin a nei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Levi-te na pieh uh khuopite sungah kibuhna khuopi guh kihal ding a, khum munah mi thatpa na taisah ding vua, tua banah khuopi sawmli le ni na piehbe ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Levi-te na pieh ding uh khuopi zosie a unpi-in sawmli le giet hi ding a, lonona gamte tawh hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel-te’ neisa lah panin na pieh ding uh khuopite tawh kisai-in, mi citamte tung panin tampitah na la ding uhi; mi citawmte tung panin tawmkhat beh na la ding uhi. Amau’ luo gamh tawh kizui-in Levi-te tungah a khuopite uh a pie ciet ding uhi.","ref":"Josh 21:1-42"},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses hopi-in tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Kibuhna Khuopite"},"10":{"text":"Israel-te hopi inlen a tung vuah tam bangin gen in: Jordan galkai-in Canaan gam na tun ciengun, sawm lopi-in"},"11":{"text":"khum munah mi khat a thatkha pa a tai thei nading, noma ading kibuhna khuopi dingin khuopite na tel ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mihonpite mai-ah thukhenna a thuoh masangin, tua mithatpa a si lo nadingin khuopite pen phula pa kung pana na kibuhna uh hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Noma adinga na ciemte uh khuopite ahile khuopi guh hi ding hi:"},"14":{"text":"Kibuhna khuopi dingin Jordan galkhatah khuopi thum, Canaan gam sungah khuopi thum na ciemte ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Sawm lopi-in mi khat a that khate khum munah a tai thei nadingin tam khuopi guhte pen Israel-te, note lahah a teng gamdang mite ahi sihle bakhat sung a peemte adingin kibuhna hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in sia vanzah khat tawh midang khat satin tua mipa a si leh ama tuolthat ahi hi; tua tuolthat pa kithat ding hi.","title":"Tuolthana le Sisan Phulahna"},"17":{"text":"Ahi sihle mi khat in mi si thei nading ahi a khut sunga a tawi suong tawh midang khat sepin a si leh, ama tuolthat ahi hi; tua tuolthat pa kithat ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi sihle mi khat in mi a si thei nading ahi sing tawh kibawl hiem khat tawh midang khat satin a si leh, ama tuolthat ahi hi; tua tuolthat pa kithat ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua tuolthat pa pen sisan phulapa in that ding hi; ama gel a kimu ciengun sisan phulapa in tuolthat pa that ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ma bangin mudana ziehin mi khat in adang khat sawnpua-in, ahi sihle na buhdapin bangkhat tawh khaw-in a si a,"},"21":{"text":"tua ahi sihle kigalbawlin a khut tawh tumin tua mipa a si leh, tua mitum pa kithat ding hi; tua mipa pen tuolthat ahi hi; ama gel a kimu ciengin sisan phulapa in tuolthatpa that ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin kigalbawlna om lopi-in midang khat thakhatin sawnpua-in, ahi sihle buhdap loin bang khat tawh sepin,"},"23":{"text":"ahi sihle si thei nading suongtum khatpo tawi-in, a galte zong hi beh lo, suhliem zong sawm lo hi tama le sawm lopi-in midang khat tungah tua suongtum in khieh kha-in tua mipa a si leh,"},"24":{"text":"mi honpite in tuolthat pa le sisan phulapa’ kikalah tam ngaina kipte tawh kituohin thu khen ding uhi;"},"25":{"text":"sisan phula pa khut sung panin mihonpi in tuolthat pa hunkhie ding uhi. Tua ciengin a kibuh masahna khuopi-ah tuolthat pa puohkia ding uhi. Sathau siengtho kinu siempu lien pa a si masangsie tua khuo-ah tuolthat pa a teng ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuolthat pa in hun khatpo-ah a buhna masa khuopi’ gamgi kansanin a pei a,"},"27":{"text":"sisan phula pa in a kibuhna khuopi pulamah ama mukha-in phula pa in tua tuolthat pa a tha leh, ama in sisan suona ziehin mawna a puo sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen siempu lien pa a si masangsie tua mipa pen kibuhna khuopi sungah a om ding hi; ahi vangin siempu lien pa a si zaw ciengin tuolthat pa inn ah pei thei ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 19:2-4; Josh 20:1-9"},"29":{"text":"Tam teng pen na khang tawntung vua na tenna uh mun zosie-ah thukham le ngaina kipte hi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Mi khat in midang khat a tha leh tecite’ theina siasanin tuolthat pa kithat ding hi; ahi vangin teci khat beh’ tecipanna tungtawnin koima khat beh kithat lo ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"31":{"text":"Tua banah sina dan thuoh dinga kilawm mipa khat a kitatna ding sum na sang sih ding uhi; tuolthat pa kithat ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Kibuhna khuopi-a a taisa mi khatpo, siempu lien pa a si masangin kilekia-in gam sungah a ten thei nadingin kibuhna khuopi-a galtai pa kitat nading sum na sang sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na tenna uh leitang na buasah sih ding uhi, sisan in leitang buasahin a sisan suohsah pa’ sisan longal tua leitang siensuo thei ding adang om lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Na tenna uh leitang na buasah sih ding vua, keima’ tenna leitang zong na buasah sih ding uhi; azieh pen keima Topa Israel-te lahah ka teng hi, a ci hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph’ suon Manasseh, Manasseh’ tapa Machir, Machir’ tapa Gilead, Gilead’ suon pupa innkuon lutang teng in nai-in Moses le Israel-te’ pupa innkuon lutang teng mai-ah a hopi uhi;","title":"Innluo Numeite’ Pasal Neina"},"2":{"text":"“Aisanna tawh Israel-te luo ding leitang a pieh nadingin Topa in ka pu thu a pie hi; a tanute tungah ka sanggampa uh Zelophehad’ gamhluote a pieh nadingin Topa in ka pu thu a pie hi.","ref":"Gam 27:7"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel minam dangte’ tapate khat penpen tawh a kinun uleh ka pate uh’ gamhluo panin amau’ gamhluo teng kila ding a, a pasal neina uh minamte’ gamhluo-ah kigawm in; tuaci’n ka ngasa uh gamh lah panin kilakhie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel-te’ jubilee a tun ciengin amau-a’ teng a pasal neina minamte tungah kigawm ding hi; ka pate uh’ gamhluote lah panin amau’ gamhluo kilakhie ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Topa genna dung zui-in Israel-te thu pie a, “Joseph’ suonlehlahte’ thugente a dih ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam pen Zelophehad’ tanute tawh kisai-in Topa’ thupieh hi a, ‘Hoi a sah pente utawh kinung uheh; ahi vangin a kinunpi ding uh pen a pa uh’ be le phung mite beh hi ding a,"},"7":{"text":"tuaci’n phung khat pan adang phung khatah Israel-te’ gamh kituon thei lo ding hi; azieh pen Israel-te zosie in a pate uh’ gamh a kemcing ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Israel-te zosie in a pate uh’ gamh a tan suoh thei nadingun Israel-te lahah gamhluo ding a nei tanu poma in a pate uh’ be sung panin pasal khat tawh kinung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamh pen phung khat panin adang phung khatah kituon thei lo ding hi; azieh pen Israel minam zosie in amau’ gamh ciet a kemcing ding uhi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Zelophehad’ tanute gamta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, le Noah-te, a pate uh’ sanggamte’ tapate tawh kinung uhi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph’ tapa Manasseh suonte’ bete tawh kinungin, tuaci’n a pa uh’ minam le be sungah a gamhluo uh om suoh den hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam teng pen Moab zanglei, Jordan luigei-a Jericho mun, Israel-te kungah Moses tungtawnin Topa in a gensah thupiehnate le ngaina kipte ahi hi."}}}}},"5":{"info":{"name":"Thuhilkiana","shortname":"Thkna","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuhilkiana (deuteronomy)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Moses in Jordan galkhat senel gam sung, Suph tawh a kigalsai, Paran le Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, le Di-zahab kikala om Israel zosie tungah a na gen thute ahi hi.","title":"Horeb Thupiengte Kisutkia"},"2":{"text":"(Kadesh-barnea pen Horeb panin Seir Muol tawnin ni sawm le ni khat kipei hi.)"},"3":{"text":"A kum sawmlina, hla sawm le khatna a ni masa ni-in Topa in amate kungah gen dinga a thupieh bang lienin Moses in Israel-te a hopi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam pen ama in Heshbon gam a uh Amor-te’ kumpipa Sihon, Ashtaroth, le Endrei gam a uh Bashan kumpipa Og a zaw zo cieng ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35"},"5":{"text":"Moab gam Jordan galkhat-ah Moses in tam thukham a hilcien hi:"},"6":{"text":"Horeb muolah Topa i Pasien in eite ei hopi a, ‘Tami muolah na sawt op zo ta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na khuolzin maban uh zomkia unlen Amor-te’ muoltung gam le a kima gamte zong- Arabah gam, muoltung gam, Shephelah gam, Negeb gam, le tuipi dung teng- Canaan-te’ gam le Lebanon gam, gun golpi ahi Euphrates dongin pei un."},"8":{"text":"En un, na masang vuah leitang ka koi zo hi; pei unlen keima in na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, le a nua vua a suonlehlahte tungah pieh dinga ka kamciem leitang luo un,’ ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in na kung vuah, “Na vai uh keima guoh in ka puo zo sih hi.","title":"Minam Makaite Kisena (Pei 18:13-27)"},"10":{"text":"Tuni-in vana aasi za a pha dingin Topa na Pasien un ang pungsah zo ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa na pu na pate uh’ Pasien in a za tulin hing pungsah hinlen na tung vuah ang thuciemsa bangin thupha hing pie taheh!"},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam bang na kiphinna uh vangihte kei guoh in bangci puoh zawh ding ka hei?"},"13":{"text":"Na minam sung ciet panun na makai dingun mipil, thuthei, le a zatahhuoi mite tel un,” kang ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Note in, “Kote adingin na thugente hoi hi,” ci-in nei dawng uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n na minam makaite uh ahi mipil le a kizatah mite ka la a, na tung vuah a tul uh, a za uh, a sawmnga uh, a sawm uhte, le uliente-in ka pangsah a, na minam zosie sung vuah makai vaihawm dingin ka koi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Khum hun lai-in na thukhen vaihawmte uh tam bangin thu ka hil hi: “Na unaute uh kikala kihehnate za unlen a dih lamin khenpiehin mite khatlekhat kikal ahi a, tuolsung mi le pemtate kikalah ahi zongin dihtahin thu khen un."},"17":{"text":"Thu khenna-ah guptuom paituom na nei sih ding uhi: Mi a neu a lien ci loin a kibangin a thu ngaipieh un; thukhenna pen Pasien-a’ ahi bo ziehin koima na giing sih ding uhi. Thu khatpo hamsa na sah luot uleh ka kungah hing tut un, keima’n ka khen ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum hunin na bawl ding zosie uh kang hil zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa i Pasien ei thupiehsa bang lienin Horeb panin i dingkhie vua, Kadesh-barnea i tun masangsie-un, Amor-te’ muoltung gam zotna lamkala na musa uh a gol a zauhuoi senel gam zosie i nawh uhi.","title":"Gamsung Lut ding Israel-te Nuom Lo (Gam 13:1-33)"},"20":{"text":"Keima in na kung vuah, “ Topa i Pasien ei pieh Amor-te’ muoltung gam na tung zo ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"En un, Topa na Pasien un note tungah tua leitang ang pie zo hi; peito unlen, Topa na pu na pate uh’ Pasien in ang kamciemsa bangin va luo ta un; zau sih unlen lungkie sih un,” kang ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Na unpi-un keima kungah nang pei vua, “Eite dinga gam van dingin i masang vuah mi sawl masa vai-in, i peito nading lampi le i zot ding khuopite tawh kisai-in eite kungah thu hing tutkia uheh,’ nei ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Keima in zong tua bang gelna pen hoi tuoh ka sa a, minam khatah khat, note lah panin mi sawm le ni ka teel hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate dingkhie-in muoltung gamah a pei to vua, tuale Eshcol kuomah pei-in a va dap-et ta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua leitanga pieng singga pawlkhat i kungah ang tawisuh uhi. Amate in i kung vuah thu ang tutkia vua, “ Topa i Pasien in ei pieh ding gam pen leitang hoi ahi hi,” ei ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin na peito nuom sih uhi. Note in Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehte na langpang uhi;","ref":"Thkna 9:23; Heb 3:16"},"27":{"text":"na puonbuh sung vuah na tawngphun vua, “ Topa in eite ei muda ziehin Amor-te khut sungah ei pie-in suhmaimang dinga Egypt gam pana ei peipi ahi bo hi."},"28":{"text":"Hei lam manaw-a pei ding i hi uh ahei? I sanggamte thugen in ei lung kiesah a, “Eite sangin khum gam mite a golzaw vua, zong a sangzaw uhi; khuopite gol a, van holin kulpi tawh ki-im hi! Khum munah Anak’ suonte ka mu tahtah uhi!’ na ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"“Keima in na kung vuah, “Amate zatah sih unlen zong giing beh sih un."},"30":{"text":"Na masang vua a pei Topa na Pasien un Egypt gam sungah na mitmu mama-un a bawl bangin ama in note dingin gal ang simpieh ding a,"},"31":{"text":"mi khat in a tapa a puoh bangin tam mun nang tun masangsie-un, Topa na Pasien un na khuolzinna uh lam tungtawn senel gamah ang bangci puoh ahei ci na musa uh ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:18"},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam bang thu om hi napi, na Topa na Pasien uh na muong sih uhi.","ref":"Heb 3:19"},"33":{"text":"Ama in na giephuol sat nading uh mun ang suipieh ding le na pei nading uh lampi ang lah dingin na mai vuah zanin mei, sunin meii-in a pei hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in na thugente uh a zah ciengin lungthahin tam bangin kiciem hi:","title":"Israel-te’ Ledona Daan Kipie (Gam 14:20-45)"},"35":{"text":"“Na pu na pate uh tungah pieh dinga ka kamciemsa gam hoi pen Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb lobuong tami khang gilote lahah koima khat beh in a mu sih ding hi.","ref":"Heb 3:18"},"36":{"text":"Ama in a lungsim zosie tawh Topa a zui ziehin ama le a suonlehlahte tungah a totsa leitang ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Note ziehin kei tung nangawnah zong Topa lungthah a, “Nang zong khum gam na lut sih ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Khum munah na kithuopi pa Nun’ tapa Joshua a lut ding hi; ama hantawh in, azieh pen ama Israel-te khum gam luosah ding pa ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Khum gamah galte mat bep ding hi bo na ci uh na nausente ule tu laitaha a sie le a pha a khen thei nai lo na tate uh a lut ding hi; keima in tua gam pie-in amate in tua gam a luo ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin note na hi leh, San Tuipi lam manaw-in senel gamah kilekia un,’ ei ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Note in nei dawngkia vua, “ Topa tungah ka maw zo ta uhi! Topa i Pasien in eite ei thupieh bang lienin peito-in galdo dingin a kigingsa-in ka om uhi,” nei ci uhi. Tuaci’n na milipun na galvante uh tawi-in na kawng uh na gah ciet vua, muoltung kato ding na bai ngaisut uhi."},"42":{"text":"” Topa in keima kungah, ‘Amahaw kungah gen inlen, ‘Na lah vuah kei om lo ka hi ziehin kuonto da mai unlen gal zong va do da lel un. Na do pau uleh na galte un ang zo ding hi, ci-in,’ ei ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Na kung vua kang gen vangin note in nei mang nuom sih uhi. Topa’ thupiehna na langpan vua, muoltung gamah na peito paupau uhi."},"44":{"text":"Ang sim dingin muoltung gama na teng ahi Amor-te ang kuon vua, Seir gam Hormah dongah khuoi bangin hing delin ang zogawp uhi."},"45":{"text":"Note na kilekia vua, Topa mai-a na kaa ciengun, Topa in na aw uh ang thupisim sih a, zong ang thudon sih hi."},"46":{"text":"Nidanga bangin Kadesh ah ni tampi na thaam zaw ciengun,","title":"Senel Gam Kumte"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in keima ei gensa bangin San Tuipi lam manaw-in senel gam i zinkia vua, Seir Muol kimvelah ni tampitah i vahvai uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:4"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah tam bangin ei gen hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Tam muol kimah sauvei khop na vahthap zo ta uhi. Leilu lam naw ta un."},"4":{"text":"Mite tam bangin thu pie in: Sier gama a teng na sanggamte ule Esau’ suon le hlahte’ gam sung a nawh ding na hi uhi. Amate in ang giing ding uhi, tua ahi ziehin kidawm mama unlen","ref":"Pien 36:8"},"5":{"text":"amate tawh kido sih un. Bangzieh ahei cile a luo dingin Esau tungah Seir Muol pie zo ka hi ziehin na ketot cie nangawn uzong amau’ leitang kang pie sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate tung panin na neh ding uh an sum tawh na lei ding uhi; amate tung panin na dawn ding uh tui zong sum ma tawh na lei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na sepna zosie vuah Topa na Pasien un thupha ang pie valon ding hi; ama in tam senel gam lienpi na peina uh ang thei hi. Tam kum sawmli sungin note tawh Topa na Pasien uh ang omton hi; bangma na kisam sih uhi,” ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Seir gama a teng i sanggam Esau’ tate i pelh vua, Arabah lampi, Elath lampi le Ezion-geber lampi lam i zui nawn sih uhi. Moab senel gam lampi dung teng manaw-in i pei ciengun,"},"9":{"text":"Topa in ka kungah tam bang ei ci hi: “Moab-te gimsah sih unlen, amate tawh galin kido sih un. Bangzieh ahei cile Lot’ suon le hlahte nei dingin Ar khuo pie zo ka hi ziehin, na nei dingun amau’ leitang behkhat zong kang pie sih ding hi,’ ei ci hi.","ref":"Pien 19:37"},"10":{"text":"(Anak-te banga a tun sang, a tam le a lien Emim-te khum munah nidangin teng ngai hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate pen Moab-te in Emim-te a ci vangun Anak-te ma bangin amate zong Rephaim-te in kingaisun uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua tham loin Seir gamah Hor-te a na teng ngai vua, ahi vangin Topa in amau’ nei dinga a pieh leitangah Israel-te in a na bawl bangin, Esau’ suon le hlahte in zong amate na suonin na susie a, amau’ tenna mun na luo uhi.)"},"13":{"text":"“Tua ciengin Zered Lui kantan un,” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n eite in Zered Lui i kantan uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate tawh kisai-in Topa a kiciemsa bangin giephuol panin galhang khangmite zosie a si sieng dong ahi, Kadesh-barnea panin Zered Lui i kantan dong kikal kum sawmthum le kum giet sung khuol i zin uhi.","ref":"Gam 14:28-35"},"15":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un giephuol panin a si sieng dongun a langkhat vuah Topa’ khut a pang tahpi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihingte lah panin galhang zosie a si zaw ciengin"},"17":{"text":"Topa in ka kungah,"},"18":{"text":"“Tuni-in Ar khuo-a Moab gamgi a kantan ding na hi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amor-te’ gamgi na neh ciengun amate phin sih unlen galin zong kido sih un, azieh pen na nei dingun na tung vuah Ammon-te’ gam kang pie sih ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile Israel-te tungah tua leitang ka pie zo hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Pien 19:38"},"20":{"text":"(Khum gam pen Rephaim gam zong na kici ngai hi. Khumi munah Rephaim-te na teng ngai vua, ahi vangin amate pen Ammon-te in Zamzummim-te ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Anak-te banga a tun sang, a thahat le a citam mite ahi uhi. Hinanle Ammon-te in amate suonin amau’ munah a ten thei nadingun Topa in Ammon-te mai-ah amate a susie hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in Sier-a a teng Esau’ suonlehlahte adingin amate mai-ah Hor-te a suhsiet ma bangin amate in zong tua mite susie-in gam nei lo a suo vua, tuni dongin amau’ gam a luo suoh uhi."},"23":{"text":"Caphtor pana ang pei ahi Caphtor-te in Gaza tawh a kinai-a na tengsa Avvim-te susie-in amau’ munah teng uhi.)"},"24":{"text":"“Na khuolzin maban zom unlen Arnon Lui kansan un. En un, na khut sung vuah Heshbon Kumpipa, Amor-te Sihon le ama’ leitang kang pie zo hi. Ama suon dingin kipan unlen ama va sim ta un."},"25":{"text":"Tuni-in vansin nei-a om mite in ang zatah nading ule ang giin nadingun ka bawl ding a, amate in na thu a zah ciengun citunin note ziehin a lung gim ding uhi,’ ei ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Kedemoth senel gam panin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon kungah kamtai sawlin tam bang kilemna ding thu ka puohsah hi:","title":"Kumpi Sihon Zawna (Gam 21:21-30)"},"27":{"text":"“Na gam sung nei nawsah leh lampi behah ka pei ding vua, ziet le vei-ah ka piel sih ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ka neh ding uh an sum tawh lei dingin nei zua ding a, ka dawn ding uh tui sum ma tawh lei dingin nei pie ding hi. Ka keng utawh ei nawhsah maimai in."},"29":{"text":"Jordan kantanin Topa ka Pasien un ei pieh gam ka tun masangin Seir-a teng Esau’ suonte le Ar-a teng Moab-te in ei peisah bang lienin ei peisah in,” ka ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon in ei peisah lo hi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien un tuni-a a bawl bangin na khut sung vuah ama a pieh thei nadingin a lungsim a khausah a, a lung zong a phengsah hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah, “En in, na tungah Sihon le a leitang pieh kang kipan zo ta hi. A leitang na luo nadingin tu-in a lah kipan in,” ei ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n eite do dingin Jahaz ah Sihon le a mite zosie ang kuon ciengun"},"33":{"text":"Topa i Pasien in eite tungah ama ei pie hi; eite in a tapate le a mite zosie tawh ama i that uhi."},"34":{"text":"Khum hunin ama’ khuopi zosie i la vua, khuopi sima pasal, numei, le naupangte i su maimang uhi. A suohta khat beh i nuasie sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"I lahsa uh khuopi sunga van kinuasie teng tawh eima’ kep dingin ganhonte beh i la uhi."},"36":{"text":"Arnon Lui monga (tua lui-a om khuopi zong kihal hi) om Aroer panin Gilead dongin eite adingin khuopi kul a sang seng khat beh a om sih a, Topa i Pasien in a unpi-in i khut sung vuah ei pie hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ammon-te’ leitang na neh sih vua, Topa i Pasien’ ei thuhil bang lienin Jabbok Lui a tunglam gam buppi le muol tunga om khuopite zong na pel uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bashan peina lam manaw-in i peito ciengun eite ei do dingin Endrei ah Bashan Kumpipa Og le a mite zosie ang kuon uhi.","title":"Bashan Kumpi Og Zawna (Gam 21:33-35)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah, “Ama giing sin, azieh pen ama le a mite le a leitang tawh nang tungah kang pie zo hi. Heshbon a uh Amor kumpipa Sihon tunga na bawl bangin ama tungah zong bawl in,” ei ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa i Pasien in Bashan kumpipa Og le a mite zosie zong eite tungah ei pie hi. Amate a suohta khat zong om lo za dongin i satlia uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum hunin eite in a khuopi zosie uh i la uhi; Bashan gam sunga om Og kumpi gam, Argob gambup, le khuopi sawmguhte i la vua, amate tung pan i lah lo uh khuopi khat zong a om sih hi;"},"5":{"text":"khuota tampite simlo, ta khuopite zosie a unpi-in kul sangpite, kotpite le kotgolh zawlpite tawh thuop ni-a kibawl ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Heshbon-a Sihon kumpipa i bawl bangun a khuopi sung ciet vua pasalte, numeite, le naupangte zosie i sumaimang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin a ganhon zosie ule khuopi sunga gal vanlah zosie eima’ dingin i la uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum hunin Jordan galkhata om Amor kumpi nite tung panin Arnon Lui pan Hermon Muol dong"},"9":{"text":"(Sidon-te in Hermon pen Sirion ci-in Amor-te in Senir ci uhi),"},"10":{"text":"muoltung zanggam khuopite zosie, Gilead gambuppi le Bashan gam zosie, Salecah le Edrei cieng dong, Bashan-a om Og kumpipa gam khuopite i la uhi."},"11":{"text":"(Tu-in Rephaim-te lahah a omlai Bashan kumpipa Og beh ahi hi. Ama’ lupna pen sia tawh kibawl ahi a, tua pen Ammon-te’ khuopi Rabbah ah kimu thei lai hi. Tongtena ngaina tawh a kite ciengin a sauna tong kuo ahi a, a vailam tong li ahi hi.)"},"12":{"text":"Khum hun lai-a i lah uh leitang tawh kisai ahile, Reuben-te le Gad-te tungah keima in Arnon Lui monga om Aroer sahlam gam, Gilead muoltung gam alang le a khuopite tawh zong ka pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in Gilead gama a omlai teng le Og’ kumpi gam ahi Bashan gam zosie, Manasseh minam alangte tungah ka pie hi. (Argob gam buppi ahi Bashan gam zosie pen Rephaim leitang kici hi;"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh mi Jair in Bashan kici Agrob gam zosie, Geshur-te le Maacath-te’ gamgi cieng dong la a, tua khuote ama’ min tapsah a, tuni dongin Havvoth-jair kici lai hi.)"},"15":{"text":"Keima in Gilead gam pen Machir tungah ka pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima in Gilead panin Arnon Lui cieng dong, a laikima lui pen gamgi hisahin, Ammon-te’ gamgi lui ahi Jabbok cieng dong tawh Reuben-te le Gad-te tungah ka pie hi;"},"17":{"text":"keima in Arabah gam zong, Jordan gun le a gungeite tawh, Chinnereth panin Tuipi Si ahi Arabah tuipi cieng dong, nisuona lama om Pisgah muolpang kensuh teng tawh amate ka pie hi."},"18":{"text":"Khum hunin tam bangin thu kang pie hi: “ Topa i Pasien in na luo dingun tam leitang ang pieh vangin a madawh dingin na galkapte zosie galvan tawh kivonin na sanggam Israel-te mai-ah galkai masa ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na zite, na tate, le na ganhonte (ganhon tampi tah na nei lam uh ka thei hi) ahile note kang piehsa khuopite-ah a om ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"No tunga ang pieh bangin Topa in na sanggamte uh tungah zong tawlngahna ang pieh ciengin, amate in zong Topa na Pasien un Jordan galkhata ang pieh ding leitang a luo vua, tua ciengin keima in na tung vua kang piehsa gam cietah na unpi-un na pei thei ding uhi,” kang ci hi.","ref":"Josh 1:12-15"},"21":{"text":"Khum hunin keima in Joshua zong tam bangin thu ka pie hi: “ Topa na Pasien in tam kumpi nite tunga a bawlsa zosie na mitin na mu zo hi. Tuaci’n na nawh lai ding kumpi gam zosie tungah zong Topa in tua ma bangin ang bawl ding hi"},"22":{"text":"Amate giing sin. Azieh pen nang adinga ang dopieh pa khu Topa na Pasien ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima in khum hunin zong Topa kungah tam bangin ka thum hi:","title":"Moses in Canaan Gal-et"},"24":{"text":"“ Topa Pasien aw, na nasempa tungah na lietna le na hatnate ang lah pan na hi na bo hi; vantungah ahi a, leitungah ahi zongin tua bang nasepte le sil thupite nangma bawl banga a bawl thei bang pasien om ahei!"},"25":{"text":"Jordan gala a om tua muoltung gam hoi le Lebanon mu dingin ei galkaisah ta’n,” ka ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanle note ziehin kei tungah Topa lungthah a, ka thumna a sang sih hi. Topa in keima kungah, ‘Phazo ta! Tam thu ka kungah hing genkia nawn sin!"},"27":{"text":"Pisgah dawnah kato inlen, na kimvela nitumna lam, leilu lam, leitaw lam, le nisuona lam gal et in. Hoitahin en in. Azieh pen tam Jordan gun na galkai nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Gam 27:12-14; Thkna 32:48-52"},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joshua thu pie inlen, ama hantawhin thakhausah in. Bangzieh ahei cile tam mite mai-ah ama pei-in galkai ding a, nangma in na mu ding leitang amate luosah ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Beth-peor tawh kigalsai kuom sungah i om uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te aw, tu-in note nungta-in, Topa na pu na pate uh’ Pasien in note ang pieh ding leitangah lutin na luo thei nadingun kang hil thukhamte le ngaina kipte mang unlen zui un.","title":"Moses in Thuman ding Thupie"},"2":{"text":"Kang thupiehte belap loin zong ladawh sih unlen, kang thupieh ahi Topa na Pasien uh’ thukhamte na zui ding uhi.","ref":"Kln 22:18-19"},"3":{"text":"Peor-a Baal tawh kisai-in Topa’ silbawlte le Peor-a Baal nuazuite zosie Topa na Pasien un bangci suhsiet ci thu note in na mit-un na mu zo ta vua,","ref":"Gam 25:1-9"},"4":{"text":"na Topa Pasien uh a tukip note zosie tuni-in na hing lai uhi."},"5":{"text":"En un, Topa ka Pasien in kei ei thupieh bang lienin lutin na lah ding uh gam sungah na zui ding uh thukhamte le ngaina kipte kang hil zo ta hi"},"6":{"text":"Limtahin tuate zui un, azieh pen tami in mite tungah na pilna ule na thu khinkhai theina uh ang talang ding a, amate in tam thukham zosie a zah ciengun, “A tahtahin tam minam liente pen a pil le thu khinkhai thei mite hi bo vuoi!,” ang ci ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa i Pasien uh i ko sielun i kung vuah i Pasien ang nai op za-in tua bang Pasien a nei adang minam lien hei-ah om ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Tuni-in na mai vua kang koipieh thukham bucing bangin a dih thukham le ngaina kip a nei minam lien adang hei-ah om ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin na mit un a musa nate na khantanun mangngil kha-in na lungsim panun a peidawh lo nadingin limtahin ngaisunin kikemcing un; na tate ule na tute uzong theisah un."},"10":{"text":"Horeb ah na Topa Pasien uh mai-ah na din lai-un, Topa in keima kungah, “Leitunga a nuntah laisie-un ei giing a, a tate a hilsawn thei nadingun amate tungah ka thute ka zahsah thei nadingin keima kungah mite hing khawm in,” ei cina thu na tate ule na tute tungah theisah un;"},"11":{"text":"“Muolpi mei in ka-in van tungah meikhu kitung valuh a, meiivom in a tuom laitahin muol zungah na ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin mei sung panin Topa in note hing hopi a, a thugente na za vua, hizongle a meel mu loin a aw beh na za uhi.","ref":"Pei 19:16-18; Heb 12:18-19"},"13":{"text":"Ama in note zui dingin na kung vuah ama’ thuciemna ahi, thupieh sawmte ang gen hi; ama in suongpeh ni tungah tuate giel hi.","ref":"Pei 31:18; 34:28; Thkna 9:10"},"14":{"text":"Note galkai-in tua gam na luo cieng vua na zui ding uh thukhamte le ngaina kipte hil dingin khum hunin Topa in keima thu ei pie hi.","ref":"Pei 21:1"},"15":{"text":"Horeb ah mei sung panin Topa in na kung vuah thu ang gen lai-in a meel na mu lo ziehun,"},"16":{"text":"lim khatpopo, pasal tawh kisun ahi a, numei tawh kisun ahi zongin,","ref":"Pei 20:4; Siem 26:1; Thkna 5:8; 27:15"},"17":{"text":"leitunga om ganhing khatpo ahi a, hui lahah a leng hla a nei va khatpo tawh kisun ahi zongin,"},"18":{"text":"leitunga a bawhva khatpo tawh kisun ahi a, leinei tui sunga om ngasa khatpo tawh kisun ahi zongin, noma’ adingin milim khengtawmin na siet gamtat khah lo nadingun kidawm un.","ref":"Rom 1:23"},"19":{"text":"Van lamah dahto-in Topa na Pasien un muncin tengah vannuoi mite dinga a piehsa ni, hla le aasite, le vantung na zosie na etto ciengun tua nate lamah kihei-in a mai vuah kunin, amau’ na na sep khah lo nadingun kidawm un."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-a na omdan bang vua ama’ mi na hi thei nadingun Topa in sia meikhuh tawh a kibang Egypt panin hing la-in ang peipi zo ta hi.","ref":"Pei 19:5; Thkna 7:6; 14:2; 26:18; Titu 2:14; 1Pet 2:9"},"21":{"text":"Note ziehin keima tungah Topa lungthah a, Jordan gun ka galkai lo nading le, na luo ding vua ang pieh gamhoi sungah ka lut lo nadingin Topa na Pasien uh a kiciem hi.","ref":"Gam 20:12"},"22":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Jordan gun galkai loin tam leitangah ka si ding a, ahi vangin note galkai-in tua gamhoi na luo ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa na Pasien un note tawh a bawl thuciemna mangngilin, Topa na Pasien un bawl vawt lo dinga ang kham lim khatpopo tawh kibangin a kikheng milim noma dinga na bawlkhah lo nadingun kidawm un."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa na Pasien uh khu mi katum thei meikuong tawh kibang a, a thangsie Pasien ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 12:29"},"25":{"text":"Note in tu le ta nei zo-in no le no khum gamah ngaimuongin na op zaw ciengun, na khatpopo tawh kisunin a kikhengtawm milim na bawlna ule, Topa na Pasien uh’ mitmu-in sil hoi lo na bawlna ziehun ama na lungthahsah uleh,"},"26":{"text":"Jordan gun galkai-in na luo ding uh gam panin na manthai sieng nadingun na langkhat vuah teci a pang dingin keima in vanpi le leipi ka ko hi; tua gamah note sawtvei teng loin ang kisusie cip ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in mite lahah note ang thethang ding a, Topa in ang pui nading minamte lahah a citawmno khat behin na om ta bo ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Khum munah mite’ khut tawh a kibawl, khuomu thei lo, khuo za thei lo, a ne thei lo, gimnam a za thei lo singlesuong pasien-te’ na na sem ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 28:36"},"29":{"text":"Khum mun panin note in Topa na Pasien uh na sui ding vua, na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh na sui uleh ama na mu ding uhi.","ref":"Jer 29:13"},"30":{"text":"Genthei thuohin mailam hun ciengin na tung vuah tam thute zosie ang tun ciengin, Topa na Pasien uh lamah kihei-in a thu na mang ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh khu a hepi thei Pasien ahi ziehin hing nuasie loin hing susie lo ding a, ama in na pu na pate utawh a thuciemna a mangngil sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen tu-in Pasien in leitung ah mihing a piensah ni-a kipanin note’ pien masang a tawpsa hun le nite kan unlen, van mongkhat pan mongkhat donga thute zong kan un. Tam bang sil thupite pieng ngai-in, a kiza ngai ta mawng amah?"},"33":{"text":"Note in mei sung panin Pasien’ aw za-in na hin lai bangun a hing lai koi minam om ahei?"},"34":{"text":"Ahi sihle Topa na Pasien un na mitmu-un Egypt gamah note dinga a bawl ma bangin zelahna, lim le na lamdangte, gal le sa, a vanglien le a thahatna le a zauhuoi mama tawh pasien dangkhat popo in minam dang khat panin minam khat ama’ mite hisah dingin va la-in peipi dingin a hanciem ngai amah?"},"35":{"text":"Topa pen Pasien ahi hi, ci-a na thei nadingun na tung vuah tam thu ang kilah ahi a, ama simlo koima dang a om sih hi.","ref":"Mrk 12:32"},"36":{"text":"Note ang khal thei nadingin vantung panin a aw ang zasah hi. Mei sung panin ama’ kammal na zah laitahun, ama in leitungah note mei thupitah ang musah hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in na pu na pate uh a it ziehin a nua sang vua a suonlehlahte hing teelin amama in Egypt panin vanglietna tawh note ang peipi a,"},"38":{"text":"na mai vuah no sanga nam thupizaw le a hatzaw mite delmangin tuni banga na ten thei nadingun a gam sung vuah ang peipi a, na luo dingun a leitang uh ang pie hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa pen vantung le leitungah Pasien ahi hi, ci-in tuni-in thei unlen, na lungsim sung vuah vom un; koima dang a om sih hi."},"40":{"text":"Noma mama le noma’ nua-a na suon na hlahte uh’ hoi nading le Topa na Pasien un kumtawn dinga ang pieh gam sungah kumsawt na hin thei nadingun keima in na kung vuah tuni-a kang gen a thukhamte le a thupiehte zui un."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Jordan nisuona lamah khuopi thum a khenkhie hi.","title":"Jordan Nisuona Lam Kibuhna Khuopite"},"42":{"text":"A tawpsa hunin kigalbawlna om lo napi, sawm lopi-in midang khat a that kha pa tua munah tai thei ding hi; khuopi khat popo-ah tua mithat pa tai-in nungta ding hi:"},"43":{"text":"Reuben-te dingin senel gam muolzanga Beza khuo, Gad-te dingin Gilead gam sunga Ramoth khuo, le Manasseh-te dingin Bashan gam sunga Golan khuote ahi hi.","ref":"Josh 20:8-9"},"44":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te mai-a a na koi thukham khu tami ahi hi.","title":"A nivei Thugenkiana"},"45":{"text":"Tami ngainate, thukipte, le thukhamte pen Egypt pan Israel-te a peikhiet ciengun Moses in hopi-in a gen thute ahi a,"},"46":{"text":"Egypt pan a peikhiet ciengun Moses le Israel-te in a na zaw gawp uh ahi Heshbon-a kumpi a sem Amor-te’ kumpipa Sihon gam sung, Jordan gungal lam Beth-peor tawh a kigalsai kuom sunga a op laitah vua a gen thute ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Amate in Bashan kumpi Og gam Jordan nisuona lama om Amor-te’ kumpi nite gam a lahpieh uhi:"},"48":{"text":"Arnon Lui monga om Aroer panin Sirion Muol dong (khum pen Hermon kici) kihlungsuh a,"},"49":{"text":"Jordan nisuona lam Arabah gam zosie huomin Pisgah muolken nei-a om Arabah Tuipi dong ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te zosie hlan a, amate tungah tam bangin a gen hi: Israel-te aw, tuni-in keima in na kung vua kang gen ding thukhamte le ngaina kipte za un; tuate sinin limtahin na zui ding uhi.","title":"Thupieh Sawmte (Pei 20:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Topa i Pasien in Horeb ah eite tawh thuciemna khat a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in i pu i pate tawh tam thuciemna a bawl hi loin tuni-a a hinglai eite zosie tawh zong a bawl ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in muol tung mei sung panin note tawh kimaituo-in ang hopi uhi."},"5":{"text":"(Khum hunin note tungah Topa’ thute phuongzah dingin Topa le na kikal vuah keima ka ding hi! Azieh pen note in meikuong na giing vua, muoltungah na kato ngam sih uhi.) Ama in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"6":{"text":"Keima pen saltanna Egypt leitang pana note ang peipito Topa na Pasien uh ka hi a,"},"7":{"text":"note in keima mai-ah pasien dang na nei sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tunga vantung ahiei, nei-a leitung ahiei, ahi sihle leinei-a om tui sung ahiei-a a om na khatpopo tawh a kisun milim khat popo noma dingin na bawl sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuate mai-ah kun loin zong na bie sih ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile keima Topa na Pasien uh pen a thangsie Pasien ka hi a, keima ei niel mite tungah a pate’ mawna a tate tungah khang thum khang lina dongin ka thuh a,","ref":"Siem 26:1; Thkna 4:15-18; 27:15"},"10":{"text":"ahi vangin keima ei itin ka thupiehna a zui mite tungah a khang tul khatna dongin itna kip ka lah hi.","ref":"Pei 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 7:9-10"},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ min a sie lamin na zang sih ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa in a sie lamin ama’ min a zang mite maw lo hi, ci lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 7:9-10"},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang thupieh bangin sabbath ni a siengtho-in tang un.","ref":"Pei 16:23-30; 31:12-14"},"13":{"text":"Na nasep ding zosie uh ni guh sungin na sem ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a ni sagi ni pen Topa na Pasien uh’ sabbath ni ahi hi; nangma, na tapa na tanu, na sila pa le na sila nu, na bawngtang, na laa, na ganhonte khat popo le na khuopi sunga om pemtate tawlnga ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Siem 23:3"},"15":{"text":"Egypt gamah sila na hina ule tua mun panin Topa na Pasien un a thahat khut le a kizah ban tawh ang peipina na phawh ding uhi; tua ahi ziehin sabbath ni na tan nading uh Topa na Pasien un thu ang pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang pieh ding leitang tungah khan kum sawtin na nopsah thei nadingun Topa na Pasien uh’ ang thupieh bangin na nu le na pa zatah un.","ref":"Thkna 27:16; Mat 15:4; 19:19; Mrk 7:10; 10:19; Luk 18:20; Eph 6:2-3"},"17":{"text":"Tuol na that sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 9:6; Siem 24:17; Mat 5:21; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jas 2:11"},"18":{"text":"Ang na kawm sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 20:10; Mat 5:27; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jas 2:11"},"19":{"text":"Na gu sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:11; Mat 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9"},"20":{"text":"Na vengpa lang khatah zuouthu teci na pang sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:1; Mat 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20"},"21":{"text":"Na vengpa’ zi na deigaw sih ding uhi. Na vengpa’ a inn, a lo, a na sempa, a nasemnu, a bawngtang, a laa, ahi sihle na vengpa’ na khat popo na deigaw sih ding uhi.","ref":"Rom 7:7; 13:9"},"22":{"text":"Topa in tam thu teng pen mei kuong, meei, le mielking lah panin muoltunga kikhawm note zosie tungah awging lienpi tawh ang gen ahi a, ama in adang a genbe tuon sih hi. Ama in suongpeh ni tungah tuate gielin keima tungah ei pie hi.","title":"Pasien’ Deina Gen Palai Moses (Pei 20:18-21)"},"23":{"text":"Mei in muol a kah laitahin khuomiel sung panin awging na zah ciengun keima kungah na minam lutang zosie le na upate ang pei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Note in, “En vawi, Topa i Pasien in eite tungah a vanglietna le a thupina ei lah zo a, mei sung panin a awging i za zo hi. Pasien in mi hopi napi mite hinglai veve a, tuni-in i mu uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n bang ziehin eite tu-in si ding i hi uh ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile tua meikuong gimnei-in ei katum ding hi; i Topa Pasien’ awging i zahkia lai uleh a si ding i hi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite’ zah bangin meikuong sung panin Pasien’ aw za-a a hinglai koi om ahei?"},"27":{"text":"Nang mama a kungah va pei inlen, Topa i Pasien’ gen ding zosie va za tan. Tua ciengin ka kung vuah Topa Pasien’ ang gen zosie hing gen inlen, tuaci’n kote in zong mangin ka sem ding uhi,” na ci uhi.","ref":"Heb 12:18-19"},"28":{"text":"Kei nei hopi ciengun Topa in na thugen uh na za a, tuale Topa in keima kungah tam bangin ang gen hi: “Tam mite in na kunga ang thugen uh ka za zo hi; a gen zosie uh a manin a gen uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amate le a suonlehlahte uh a nopsah tawntung thei nadingun keima ei giingin ka thupieh zosie zui den nopna tam bang lungsim puo den tave ule izaw!"},"30":{"text":"Pei inlen a kung vuah, ‘Na puonbuh sung vuah kilekia ta un,’ va ci tan."},"31":{"text":"Hizongle tam mun keima kungah ding inlen, amate luo dinga ka pieh leitangah a ten ciengun a zui ding vua na hilsawn ding thupieh zosie, thukham zosie le ngaina kip zosie na kungah kang gen ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa na Pasien un ang thupiehsa banga na gamtat nadingun kidawm un; zietlam ahiei veilam ahiei-ah na piel sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na luo ding uh gamah nungta-in, nuomsa-in kumsawt na hin thei nadingun Topa na Pasien un ang thupiehsa lampi bang lienin na zui ding uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng pen note galkai-in na luo ding uh gamah na tun ciengun na zui ding vua Topa na Pasien un note tungah kang hil dinga ei thupieh, thukhamte le ngaina kipte ahi hi,","title":"A Lien Thupieh"},"2":{"text":"tuaci’n na hinkhuo uh a sawt thei nadingin note, na tate ule na tute un na hin sung tungtawnun Topa na Pasien uh zatahin, kei ei hil sawnsah a thukhamte le a thupieh zosie na zui ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel aw, na nopsah thei nading le na pu na pate uh’ Pasien Topa nangma tunga ang ciemsa bangin, note zong bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gamah na pun na men thei nadingun tam thute ngai unlen limtahin zui un."},"4":{"text":"Israel-te aw, za un: Topa i Pasien pen Topa khat beh ahi hi.","ref":"Mrk 12:29"},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh, na lungtang zosie, na hinna zosie le na hatna zosie utawh na it ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 22:37; Mrk 12:30; Luk 10:27"},"6":{"text":"Keima in tuni-a note kang pieh tam thute na lungtang vuah vom lenlon un."},"7":{"text":"Na tate hil unlen, inn ah na op uh cieng, khuolai na va uh cieng, na lup uh cieng le na thaw uh ciengin amate genpi un."},"8":{"text":"Na khut tung vuah lim dingin tuate khi unlen, na zangpai vuah melcina-in tuate suong un."},"9":{"text":"Na kotbieng khuomte tung le na tunkotte tung vuah tuate giel un.","ref":"Thkna 11:18-20"},"10":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na pu na pate uh ahi Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob-te tungah pieh dinga a na ciemsa gam, na lam lo uh a gol a hoi khuopite,","title":"Thuman Lokhah ding Hilkholna","ref":"Pien 12:7; 26:3; 28:13"},"11":{"text":"na khol lo uh sil hoi tawh kidim innte, na taw lo uh tuikhuhte, na suon lo uh lengga guite, le olive kungte opna gamah hing peipi-in khamtahin na neh zaw ciengun,"},"12":{"text":"saltanna Egypt gam panin note ang peipi Topa na mangngil khah lo nading uh kidawm un."},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh na zatah ding uhi; ama’ na beh na sem ding vua, ama’ min beh tawh na kiciem ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 4:10; Luk 4:8"},"14":{"text":"Na kimvel vua mite’ pasien-te ahi pasien dangte na zui sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen note tawh ang omton Topa na Pasien uh pen a thangsie Pasien ahi hi. Na langkhat vuah Topa na Pasien uh’ lungthahna hing kikuontaw ding a, tuaci’n lei maitang panin note ang susie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Massah munah ama na zelah bangun Topa na Pasien uh na zelah sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 17:1-7; Mat 4:7; Luk 4:12"},"17":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang thupiehte, a thukipte, a thukhamte limtahin na zui ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in na pu na pate uh tunga pieh dinga a ciemsa leitang hoi-ah lutin na luo thei nading ule na nopsah thei nadingun Topa muna-ah a man le a hoi nate bawl unlen,"},"19":{"text":"Topa ang kamciem bangin na mai panun na galte zosie uh notmang un."},"20":{"text":"Ang tung ding hunah na tapate un, “ Topa i Pasien in note ang thupieh ahi thukipte, thukhamte le ngaina kipte bang a cinopna ahei?” ci-in ang dawh ciengun"},"21":{"text":"na tapate uh kungah, “Egypt gamah Pharaoh’ salin i na om vua, ahi vangin Egypt panin Topa in a banhat tawh ei na peipi hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in i muna vuah Egypt, Pharaoh le a innkuonpite zosie tungah a lien le a cizathuoi lim le na lamdangte ei na lah hi."},"23":{"text":"I pu i pate tungah pieh dinga a na ciemsa leitangah ei puoh dingin khum mun panin ei na peipi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin i hoi zing nading ule tuni-a banga ei hinsuo thei nadingin, Topa i Pasien zatatin tami thukham zosie i zui nadingin Topa in thu ei pie hi."},"25":{"text":"Ei thupiehsa bangin Topa i Pasien uh muna ah tam thupieh vannuoi limtahin i zui uleh, thuman sungah i om ding uhi,” na ci ding uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na luo ding uh gamah hing puohin na lut ciengun, na mai vuah no sanga a thahatzaw le a tamzaw minam sagite ahi Hit-te, Girgash-te, Amor-te, Canaan-te, Perez-te, Hiv-te, le Jebus-te delmangin,","title":"Teeltuom Mite (Pei 34:11-16)","ref":"Sawl 13:19"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un nohaw tungah amate hing pie-in, amahaw na zaw zo ciengun, a unpi-in na susiemang ding uhi. Amate tawh thuciemna bawl sih unlen a tung vuah hepina zong lah sih un."},"3":{"text":"Amate tawh zi le ta-in kizong sih unlen, a tapate uh tungah na tanute pie loin, na tapate uh adingin zong a tanute uh la sih un."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen pasien dangte’ na sem dingin keima ei zuina panun na tate uh a pielsah ding uhi. Tua ciengin note tungah Topa’ lungthahna kikuontaw ding a, tuaci’n thakhatin note ang susie ding hi"},"5":{"text":"Hinanle amate tungah tam bangin na bawl ding uhi: Amau’ maitamte susie-in amau’ khuom siengthote satcim unlen, amau’ khuom siengthote phua-in, amau’ milimte mei tawh hal un.","ref":"Thkna 12:3"},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien uh tungah note a siengtho mi na hi uhi; Topa na Pasien un leitung mi zosie lah panin ama’ mi ding le ama’ gougil nei dingin note ang teel zo hi.","ref":"Pei 19:5; Thkna 4:20; 14:2; 26:18; Titu 2:14; 1Pet 2:9"},"7":{"text":"Midangte sanga na tamzawh zieh vua note tungah Topa hing lunglutin ang teel na hi sih uhi. Bang ding ahei cile mi namcinte lahah note a citawm pen na hi bo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in na saltanna uh Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh’ khut sung pan ang hutkhiet a, a vanglietna tawh ang peipina pen Topa in note hing itin na pu na pate uh kunga a kiciemna a zuina zieh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa na Pasien un Pasien ahi a, ama itin ama’ thupiehna a zui mite tungah khang tul tampi dongin a thuciemna le a itna a tukip a thuman Pasien a hina thu le,"},"10":{"text":"ama a niel mite tungah suhsietna tawh a thuh pa a hina thu thei un. Ama a niel mite tungah kiheh loin ama in susietna tawh a thuh pai hi.","ref":"Pei 20:5-6; 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 5:9-10"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tuni-in na kung vua kang gen thupiehte, thukhamte, le ngaina kipte limtahin zui un."},"12":{"text":"Note in tami ngaina kipte kukal tahin na zui uleh note tungah Topa na Pasien un na pu na pate uh tunga a na ciemsa thuciemna’ thumanna khu a tukip ding hi.","title":"Thumanna Zieha Thuphate (Siem 26:1-13 ; Thkna 28:1-14)"},"13":{"text":"Ama in note hing itin, thupha hing pie-in, ang pungsah ding hi; na sung vua piengte, na leitang pan vua a piengte, na an ule na lenggazu uh, na sathaute ule na ganhonte uh hing pungsahin, na tuuhonte ule na keelno honte uzong thupha ang pie ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi zosie lahah thupha nga pen minam na hi ding vua, noma lahah ahi a, na ganhonte lah vuah ahi zongin ta nei lo a ciing a om sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Note sung panin Topa in natna vannuoi hemkhie ding hi; note tungah Egypt gam’ natna huoisie zosie ang tung sih ding hi, ahi vangin ama in ang muda mite tungah tuate a tungsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na tung vua ang pieh minam zosie a unpi-in na susie ding vua, amate na khuotuo sih ding uhi; note dingin amate pen thang anta ang hi ding uh ahi ziehin a pasien-te na bie sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 11:13-17"},"17":{"text":"Na lungsim sung vuah, “Eite sangin tam minamte a tamzaw uhi; amate bang i ci suon zo ding uh ahei? na ci khah uleh"},"18":{"text":"giing malmal sih un. Topa na Pasien un Pharaoh le Egypt-te zosie tunga a bawl,"},"19":{"text":"na mit utawh na mu uh zelahna lienpite, lim le na lamdangte, khut thahat le a kizah bante tawh ang peipi Topa na Pasien uh phawh un. Topa na Pasien un na giin uh mi zosie tungah tua bang lienin a bawl ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Topa na Pasien un a omlaite le a kiphuolte a kisuhsiet sieng masangsie, amate lahah gimna a tungsah ding hi"},"21":{"text":"Noma tawh ang omton Topa na Pasien uh pen a lien le a giinhuoi Pasien ahi ziehin amate giing sih un."},"22":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na masang vuah tam minamte themthemin notmang ding hi; note in thakhatin na notmang thei sih ding uhi. Tua hi mawh leh note dingin gamsate ang tam seng ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle Topa na Pasien un na tung vuah amate ang pie ding a, amahaw a kisuhsiet masangin kipatausah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in na khut sung vuah a kumpite uh ang pie ding a, note in vansin nei panin amau’ min na phietmang ding uhi; amate na suhsiet zo masangsie-un na langkhat vuah koima pang zo lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate pasien-te’ limte mei tawh na hal ding uhi. Tua thangah awh thei ding na hi ziehun tuate tunga om ngunte ahi a, khamte ahi zongin deigaw sih unlen noma dingin zong la sih un; bangzieh ahei cile tua khu Topa na Pasien uh adingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Na inn sung vuah a kidahhuoi nate tumpi sih un. Tua hile tuate bangin suhsiet dinga kituomkoite na suoh ding uhi. Tua nate kidahin na huot mama ding uh ahi hi, azieh pen tua nate suhsiet dinga kituomkoi ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note nungta-in na pun nading ule na pu na pate uh tungah Topa in a ciemsa gamah pei-in na luo thei nadingun tuni-in note kang pieh tami thupiehte zosie kukal taha na zui nadingun thu kang pie hi.","title":"Cithei Hunin Pasien Mangngil Lo Ding Hilkholna"},"2":{"text":"Note ang suhnem thei nading, a thupiehte na zui vuoi mah, na zui sih vuoi ci-a a thei nading le na lungtang vuah bang om ahei ci-in a thei nadingin amate in note ang zelahna-in Topa na Pasien un tam kum sawmli sung senel gamah lam saupi tah ang puina khu phawh un."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte pen an beh tawh nungta ahi sih a, Topa’ kam sung pana a pusuoh thu zosie tawh nungta hizaw hi, ci-in ang theisah nadingin note hing gilkielsahin hing sunem a, tua ciengin no na hi vua, na pu na pate ahi zongin na thei ngai nai lo uh manna tawh ang va hi.","ref":"Mat 4:4; Luk 4:4"},"4":{"text":"Tami kum sawmli sungin na el vua na puonsil uh sie loin na keng uzong pawm vawt lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n nu le pate in a tapa a khal bangin Topa na Pasien un no ang khalna thu na lungtang vuah thei un."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama’ lampi zuina le ama zatahna tawh Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehte zui un."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa na Pasien un muol le guoma a luong luite opna, ciatui le tuisamte a luonna leitang"},"8":{"text":"mangbu le mangbuham, lenggui le theikung, mang kawlsing opna leitang, olive kungte le khuoizu luonna leitang,"},"9":{"text":"an cilbawl loin kitasap bangma om lo-a an na neh theina uh leitang, a suongtumte sia hi a, a muoltangte panin sumsan na taw theina uh leitang ahi gam hoi-ah note ang peipi hi."},"10":{"text":"Gilva tahin an na ne ding vua, gam hoi ang pieh ziehin Topa na Pasien uh na phat ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni-in keima in na tung vua kang gen a thupiehte, a ngaina kipte le a thukhamte na zui lona utawh Topa na Pasien uh na mangngil khah lo nading uh kidawm un."},"12":{"text":"Gilva tahin na neh zaw uh cieng, inn hoite lamin tuate sungah na ten uh cieng,"},"13":{"text":"na ganhonte ule na tuuhonte uh a pun cieng le na khamte ule na ngunte uh ang tam a, na nei na lam zosiete uzong ang kiningcin ciengin,"},"14":{"text":"no le no kiliensah pai sih unlen, saltanna Egypt gam pana ang peipi Topa na Pasien mangngilh sih un."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a lien a zauhuoi senel gamah gul guneite, mom-aite lah le tui op lona gamgawta lahah note ang peipi hi. Ama in na dawn dingun meisuong tawh a kibang suongpi panin tui a phulsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Senel gamah na pu na pate un a thei ngai lo uh manna tawh ang va a, a tawpna-ah na hoi nadingun hing niemkhiehin hing ze-et hi.","ref":"Hos 13:5-6"},"17":{"text":"No le no in, “Ka vanglietna le ka khut thahat in tam hauna ei ngasah ahi hi,” ci sih un."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle tuni-a a bawl bangin na pu na pate uh tungah a kiciemna a kipsah thei nadingin Topa na Pasien uh phawh zing un, bangzieh ahei cile hauna ang pie pa ama ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh mangngilin pasien dangte’ nua zui a, a na uh semin na bieh uleh, na si tahtah ding uhi, ci-in tuni-in limtahin kang hilkhol hi."},"20":{"text":"Note’ masanga Topa suhsiet minamte bangin note zong na kisie ding uhi, azieh pen note in Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na mang sih uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te aw ngai un! Note sanga a tamzaw le a thahatzaw minamte, van holh a kulpi kiciengto khuopite a suonkhie dingin Jordan gungal kai-in a pei ding na hi ta uhi.","title":"Pasien Ledona Paatte"},"2":{"text":"A mite pen na theisa uh ahi a tunsang a thahat Anak’ suonte ahi uhi. Amate pen “Anak-te langah koi pang zo ding ahei,” a kici na zah ngaisa uh mite ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin note’ Topa Pasien pen mi a katum thei meikuong bangin na masang vua a peipa ahi lam tuni-in thei un. Topa in ang kamciemsa bangin amate suon dawhin mallang tahin na suhsiet thei nadingun, ama in na masang vuah amate gal lelsahin a zogawp ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na mai vuah amate a nawdawh ciengin na lungsim sung vuah, ‘ Topa in tami leitang a luo dinga ei puohna pen ka dihna zieh uh ahi hi,’ ci kha vawt sih un; Topa in na mai vuah amate a nawdawhna khu tam minamte’ gitlona zieh hizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Na dihna zieh ule na lungsim manna zieh utawh a gam uh a luo ding na hi sih vua, tam minamte’ gitlona ziehin Topa in kiciemna tawh na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tunga a na kamciemsa thu a tangtun nadinga Topa na Pasien un na mai vua amate a nawmang ahi zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin na dihna ziehun Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua tam gam hoi ang pieh ahi lo lam thei un; azieh pen mi lungkhauhpi na hi bo uhi."},"7":{"text":"Senel gamah Topa na Pasien uh phinin na lungthahsah dante uh phawh unlen mangngil sih un; Egypt gam panin na pei ni vua kipan tam mun na tun dongun Topa na ledo mielmuol uhi."},"8":{"text":"Horeb muol nangawn-ah Topa na thangpaisah vua, na tung vuah Topa a lungthah seng ziehin note susie dingin a baisa-in a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in note tawh a bawl thuciemna suongpehte sang dingin muol tungah ka kato lai-in, sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung ka thaam hi; an ne lo, tui dawn loin ka om hi.","ref":"Pei 24:18"},"10":{"text":"Topa in Pasien’ khutme tawh kigiel suongpeh ni kei ei pie hi; tuate tungah muol tunga na kikhop ni vua Topa in na kung vuah mei sung pana ang gensa thu zosie om hi."},"11":{"text":"Sun sawmli le zan sawmli a cin zaw-in Topa in tua kiciemna suongpeh ni tegel keima ei pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah, “Tho inlen tam panin peisuh meng in. Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt pana na zawpi na mite a siet gamtat sieng ta uhi. Ka thupieh lampi panin a kihei zuai ta vua, amate dingin a kisung milim khat a bawl zo ta uhi,” ci-in ang gen hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banah Topa in keima kungah, “Tam mite ahile a lungkhauh tahtah mite ahi hi, ci-in ka mu zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate susie-in vansin nei pan a min uh ka phietmai thei nadingin keima guoh ei omsah un; tuale amate sangin a thahatzaw le a citamzaw minamin nang kang bawl ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n muolpi a kuon vapuol laitahin kihei-in muol tung panin ka kumsuh hi; kiciemna suongpeh nite ka khut ni tegel sungah a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin noma dingin a kisung bawngno lim khat na bawlna utawh Topa na Pasien uh tungah na maw zo tahpi lam uh ka mu a, tuaci’n Topa in ang thupiehsa lampi panin na kihei zuai ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei zong ka khut gelin tua suongpeh nite ka tawi a, ka khut tegel panin tuolah sepin na muna vuah ka guoicimsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin a masa-a ka bawl ngai bangin Topa mai-ah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung ka khupbawhkia hi; ama tunga na bawl uh na mawna zosie zieh ule ama mai-ah a sie na gamtatnate utawh Topa na lungthahsah ziehun an ne lo tui dawn loin ka om hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note tungah Topa’ lungthahna nasie seng ahi ziehin ama in note ang suhsiet ding ka zau hi. Hizongle Topa in khumi hunin zong ka thu ei ngai hi.","ref":"Heb 12:21"},"20":{"text":"Aaron tungah Topa thangpai mama a, ama susie dingin a baisa-in om a, ahi vangin khumi hun ma-in Aaron tangin zong ka thumpieh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in note ang mawsah ahi na bawl uh bawngno lim la-in mei tawh haltumin ka sukeh a, leivui a suo dongin ka gawtvui hi; tua a vuite muol pan a luongsuh luidungah ka pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Taberah, Massah, le Kibroth-hattaavah munte-ah zong Topa phinin na lungthahsah uhi.","ref":"Pei 17:7; Gam 11:3, 34"},"23":{"text":"Topa in Kadesh-barnea panin note ang sawl a, “Peito unlen kang piehsa leitang va luo ta un,” ei ci hun lai-in Topa na Pasien uh’ thupieh langpangin ama muong loin, a thu zong na mang sih uhi.","ref":"Gam 13:25–14:38; Thkna 1:21, 26; Heb 3:16"},"24":{"text":"Ama in note ang thei zaw a kipan Topa langpangin na ledo ngitnget uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in note ang suhsiet sawm ciengin sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa mai-ah khupbawh a ka op sung tungtawnin,"},"26":{"text":"Topa kungah thu ka ngen a, “ Topa Pasien aw, na lietna tawh na tatsa, na banhat tawh Egypt pana na peipi na mite susie sin."},"27":{"text":"Na nasem Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob-te phawh in; tam mite’ lungkhauhna, gitlona, le mawnate thulah seng sin."},"28":{"text":"Tua bang hi sih mawh leh nei peipina gama a teng mite in, ‘ Topa in amate a ciemsa leitangah a peipi thei lo zieh le a muda ziehin senel gama a thagam dinga a peipi hizaw hi,’ ci mawh kha ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate pen na vanglietna le a kizah na ban tawh na peipi nangma’ neisa mite ahi hi,” ka ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Topa in keima kungah, “A masa gel bangin suongpeh ni sehin muoltung ka kungah hing kato inlen, sing singkuong khat bawl in.","title":"A Niveina Suongpehte (Pei 34:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Tua suongpeh gel tungah na sekehsa suongpeh masate tunga thu teng kang giel ding a, singkuong sungah tuate na koi ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n gising tawh singkuong khat bawlin, a masa gel bangin suongpeh ni ka seh a, ka khut sungah tua suongpeh gel tawi-in muol tungah ka kato hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin mihon kikhop ni-in Topa in mei sung panin muoltung na kung vua ang gensa thupieh sawmte, a masa-a kigiel bangin tua suongpehte tungah giel hi; tuale Topa in tua suongpehte kei tungah ei pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n kihei-in muol tung panin ka kumsuh a, ka bawlsa singkuong sungah tua suongpehte ka koi a, tuale Topa ei thupieh bangin tua sungah suongpehte a om hi."},"6":{"text":"(Beeroth-bene-jaakan panin Moserah ah Israel-te khuol zinin khum munah Aaron si-in tua munah kivui hi; a tapa Eleazar in ama’ za luo-in siempu sem hi.","ref":"Gam 20:28; 33:38"},"7":{"text":"Tua mun panin Gudgodah ah amate khuolzinin Gudgodah panin lui tuite a luonna gam Jotbathah ah a pei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Topa in tuni donga Topa mai-ah dinga ama’ na sem ding, ama’ min tawh thupha pie ding, le Topa’ thuciemna singkuong puo dingin Levi-te a tuomkoi hi.","ref":"Gam 3:5-8"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin Levi in a tanaute lahah tanh hile luo hile a nei sih a, Topa na Pasien un ama kungah a kamciem bangin Topa khu ama’ luo ahi hi.)"},"10":{"text":"A masa-a ka bawl bangin muol tungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung ka om hi. Topa in tua hunin zong ka thu ei ngaipieh leuleu hi. Topa in note ang susie nuom sih hi.","ref":"Pei 34:28"},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei kungah, “A pu a pate tunga pieh dinga ka ciemsa leitangah pei-in a luo thei nadingun tho inlen, mite mai-ah na khuolzin ban zom in,” ei ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel-te aw, tu-in Topa na Pasien un na tung panun bang ang kalh ahei? Na hoi nadingun na Topa na Pasien beh uh zatatin a lampite zosie zui-in, ama na it vua, na lungtang zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh Topa na Pasieh uh’ na semin,","title":"Thukham Laigilte"},"13":{"text":"tuni-a kang gen thupiehte le Topa na Pasien uh’ thukhamte na zui ding uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Vantung le vantungte’ vantung, leitung le a sunga om zosie note’ Topa Pasien-a’ ahi a,"},"15":{"text":"hinanle Topa in na pu na pate tung behah itna lungtang a koi a, tuni-a ma bangin mite zosie lah panin amau’ suon le hlah ahi note ang teel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin na lungsim tepte tan unlen lungkhauh nawn sih un."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien uh khu a lien Pasien hi a, a thahat, a giinhuoi, deidan a nei lo, guhgol zong a la lo, pasien-te’ Pasien, topate’ Topa ahi hi.","ref":"1Tim 6:15; Kln 17:14; 19:16; Sawl 10:34; Rom 2:11; Gal 2:6; Eph 6:9"},"18":{"text":"Meigong tagate adingin ama in thu a tangin khenin pemtate it a, an le puon a pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Pemtate na it ding uhi, bang ding ahei cile note zong Egypt gamah pemta na hi ngai uhi."},"20":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh na zatah ding uhi; ama beh na bie ding uhi; ama na tudet ding vua, ama’ min tawh na kiciem ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama na phat ding uh ahi h; ama pen note adinga na mit utawh na musa uh tam a lien le a giinhuoi nate ang bawlpieh pa na Pasien uh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Egypt gamah na pu na pate mi sawmsagi a peisuh vua, tu-in Topa na Pasien un vana aasi za-in ang pungsah zo ta hi.","ref":"Pien 15:5; 22:17; 46:27"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh na it ding vua, a thuhilna, a thukhamte, a ngaina kipte, le a thupiehte na zui zing ding uhi.","title":"Thumanna Zieha Thamante"},"2":{"text":"Note in na phaw ding vuah tuni-in na tate uh (na Topa Pasien uh’ khalna a thei nai lo ahi sihle a mu nai lo na tate uh hi loin), a vanglietna, a thahatna, le a kizah a banhat,"},"3":{"text":"Egypt kumpi Pharaoh le a gam sung zosie tunga a bawl a limte le a silbawlte;","ref":"Pei 7:8–12:13"},"4":{"text":"Egypt galkapte, a sakolte le a leengte tunga a sil bawlte; no ang nuadel lai-un San Tuipi in amate a taisah a, Topa in tuni dongin amate a suhsietna;","ref":"Pei 14:28"},"5":{"text":"tam mun na tun masangun senel gamah na tung vua ang bawlte;"},"6":{"text":"Reuben’ tapa Eliab, a tapa Dathan le Abiram-te tunga a sil bawlte; Israel zosiete laikimah lei in a kamkahin a innkuonpite, a puonbuhte ule a zui mi zosie a valtumnate ngaisun un;","ref":"Gam 16:31-32"},"7":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Topa in a bawlsa na lienpi zosiete a unpi-in na mit mama utawh na mu zo ta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin thahatin na luo ding uh leitangah pei-in galkai-in na luo thei nadingun tuni-a na kung vua kang gen tami thupieh zosie a unpi-in zui un,"},"9":{"text":"tuale Topa in na pu na pate ule a suonlehlahte tungah pieh dinga a na ciemsa ahi bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gamah kum sawt na hing ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen note lutin na va luo ding uh gam khu ante huon ah khaici tu-in na keng vua tui na buohna uh ahi note’ hing peikhietna Egypt gam tawh a kibang sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin luo dingin na galkaina uh leitang pen van guotui a ngah muol le guom gam,"},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un a kep leitang ahi hi. Topa na Pasien uh’ mit in kum kipat a kipanin kum tawp dongin tua leitang a mitsuon den hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuni-a na tung vua kang gen a thupiehte zosie na man vua, Topa na Pasien uh na lungsim zosie uh, na hinna zosie utawh itin ama’ na na sep uleh,"},"14":{"text":"ama in a hunin na leitang vua dingin guo masa le guo nukhia ang zusah ding a, na an uh, na lenggazu, ule na sathau uh na kaikhawm thei ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in na ganhonte vua dingin na gam sung vuah lodawng ang posah ding a, khamtahin an na ne ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kikemcing un, tua ahi sihle pasien dangte’ na sem ding le tuate bie dingin ang kizawl ding a, tuaci’n na pielmang kha ding uhi,"},"17":{"text":"azieh pen na tung vuah Topa’ lungthahna mei bangin ang kuongin ama in vantungte khahcip ding a, tuaci’n guo zu loin leitangah bangma a pieng sih ding hi. Tua ciengin Topa in ang pieh ding uh tua gamhoi-ah na mangthai pai ta ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 26:3-5; Thkna 7:12-16; 28:1-4"},"18":{"text":"Tami ka thugente na lungsim ule na nuntahna vuah vom lenlon unlen, na khut vuah limin khi-in na zangpai vuah melcina-in na suong ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Inn na op ciengun ahi a, na va ciengun ahi zongin, na lup ciengun ahi a, na thaw ciengun ahi zongin, na tate tungah khumte hil unlen genpi un."},"20":{"text":"Na inn kotkhah mung tung ule na tunkot uh tungah tuate giel unlen,","ref":"Thkna 6:6-9"},"21":{"text":"tuaci’n leitung’ a tungah vantungte a op laisie amate tungah pieh dingin Topa in na pu na pate a na ciemsa gam sungah no le na tate na khansau ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh itin ama’ lampi zosie na zui vua, ama tudetin kang gen tam thupieh zosie limtaha na zui uleh,"},"23":{"text":"Topa in na masang vuah tam minamte zosie delmang ding a, no sanga minam thupizaw le a thahatzaw minamte na suonmang ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Na keng un a totna mun zosie noma-a’ hi ding a, senel gam panin Lebanon dong le Euphrates Gun panin nitumna tuipi dong na gam uh hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note langkhatah koima pang zo lo ding a, ama in ang kamciem bangin Topa na Pasien un na tot ding uh gam zosie-ah note giinna le zatahna a omsah ding hi.","ref":"Josh 3:1-5"},"26":{"text":"En un, tuni-in na mai vuah thupha le samsietna ka koi hi:"},"27":{"text":"Tuni-a kang gen Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehte na zui uleh thupha ahi hi;"},"28":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehte mang loin tuni kang gen lampi panin na kihei vua, na thei ngai lo uh pasien dangte’ nua na zui uleh samsietna hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Luo dinga na lutna ding uh gamah Topa na Pasien un ang peipi ciengin, Gerizim Muol tungah thupha koi-in Ebal Muol tungah samsietna na koi ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 27:11-14; Josh 8:33-35"},"30":{"text":"Na theisa bangun tua muol tegel pen Jodan gal, a gamla simsim nitumna lam, Arabah gam sunga a teng Canaan-te’ gam sung, Gilgal tawh a kigalsai Moreh gangpi sing gei-ah a om hi."},"31":{"text":"Jordan kantanin na nei ding vua Topa na Pasien un ang pieh leitang luo dingin na pei cieng ule tua leitang luo-in na ten ciengun,"},"32":{"text":"tuni-a na mai vua kang koipieh thukhamte le ngaina kipte zosie limtaha na zui ding uh ahi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen na pu na pate uh’ Topa Pasien in leitunga na ten laisie-un na luo ding vua ang piehsa gam sungah limtaha na zui ding uh thukhamte le ngaina kipte ahi hi.","title":"Dawi Biehna Biehbuhte Kisusie"},"2":{"text":"Na suonmang ding uh minamte in a bieh pasien-te opna mun, muol sangte, muoltangte, le singnim nei zosie na susie ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"A maitamte uh phelmangin a khuom siengthote satguoi a, a khuom siengthote mei tawh haltumin a pasien-te’ uh limte zong mei tawh haltum un. Tuaci’n amau’ munte panin a min uh na phietmang ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 7:5"},"4":{"text":"Tua bang dan tawh Topa na Pasien uh na bie sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na minam zosie uh sung panin ama’ min koi nadingin teelin ama op nadinga a bawlna mun na suizaw ding uhi. Khum munah na pei ding vua,"},"6":{"text":"na meihal biehnate ule na biehpiehnate uh, na sawm-ah-khatte ule na silpiehte uh, na kamciem uh letsongte, nop thu-a na pieh uh biehnate le na bawnghonte ule na tuuhon tacilte uh, khum tahah na peipi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ mai khum munah na ne ding vua, Topa na Pasien un na sepna zosie vuah thupha ang pieh ziehin no le na innkuonpite na kipah ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Eite zosie in hoi i sah dan bangin tam munah i bawl bangun na gamta sih ding uhi,"},"9":{"text":"azieh pen Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh gam le tawlngahna mun na lut nai sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jordan gun galkai-in Topa na Pasien un luo dinga ang pieh leitangah na ten cieng ule, lungnuomin na ten thei nadingun na kimvel vua om na galte uh panin bihtahin tawlngahna ang pieh ciengin,"},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ama’ min ten nadinga a teelna munah kang thupieh zosie na peipi ding uhi: Tua teng pen na meihal biehnate ule na biehpiehnate uh, na sawm-ah-khatte ule na silpiehte uh, Topa tunga na kamciemsa uh ahi na deituom uh letsong zosie ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah na tanu na tapate uh, na sila uh numei pasalte le na khuo sung vua a teng Levi-te tawh na lungdam ton ding uhi. (bangzieh ahei cile amate in tanh ahi a, luo ahi zongin a nei sih uhi.)"},"13":{"text":"Na tuona mun po vuah na meihal biehnate na pieh lo nadingun kidawm un."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle na minamte uh sung panin Topa in a teelna mun khat behah na meihal biehnate na pie ding vua, khum munah kang thupieh zosie na bawl ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle Topa na Pasien un ang pieh thupha tawh kizui-in na khuopite uh khat popo sungah na dei hunhun-un sa go-in na ne thei ding uhi; sangai le sakhi sate a kineh ma bangin a sieng le a bua kideidan loin na ne thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin a si na ne sih ding uhi; tui bangin tuolah na buo ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 9:4; Siem 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 15:23"},"17":{"text":"Na khuopite sung vuah na an uh sawm-a- khatte, na lenggazu ule na sathaute uh, na bawnghonte ule na tuuhonte uh sung panin tacilte, pieh dinga na kiciemsa uh letsongte khat popo ahi sihle kiphalna tawh na pieh uh biehnate le na silpiehte uh na ne thei sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un a teel nading mun, na Topa Pasien uh mai-ah, note le na tanu na tapate uh, na sila pasalte, na sila numeite, le na khuopi sung vua a teng Levi-te in na ne ding vua, na sepna zosie vuah Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah na kipah ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na gam sung vuah na ten laisie-un Levi-te na thusim lo khah ding uh kidawm un."},"20":{"text":"Ang kamciemsa ma bangin Topa na Pasien un na gam uh ang kehpieh ciengin sa na du ziehun, “Sa ka ne ding uhi,” ci po locin sa na du hunhunun na ne thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Note kung panin Topa in ama’ min op nadinga a teelna mun a gamlat seng leh note kang thupiehsa bangin Topa in ang piehsa na bawnghonte uh pan ahi a, na tuuhonte uh pan ahi zongin khat popo na go thei ding vua, tuaci’n na khuopite sung vuah na du hunhunun na ne thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sangai ahi a, sakhi ahi zongin a kineh bangin na ne thei ding uhi; mi a sieng le a buate in a kibangin na ne thei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"A si na neh lo ding beh uh thei siem un; bangzieh ahei cile sisan khu hinna ahi a, sa tawh hinna na neton sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua sisan ne loin tui bangin tuolah na buo ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 17:10-14"},"25":{"text":"Topa muna-ah a dihin na gamtat ziehun noma le na nua vua na tate uh a nopsah thei nadingin tua si ne sih un."},"26":{"text":"Hinanle na pieh ding uh silpieh siengthote, le na kiciemsa uh letsongte la-in Topa in a teel nading munah na peipi ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Topa na Pasieh uh’ maitam tungah na meihal biehnate uh’ a sa le a si na pieton ding uhi; na Topa Pasien uh’ maitam gei-ah note in adang na biehpiehnate uh’ site na sung ding vua, ahi vangin a sa na ne thei ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ mitmu-in a hoi le a dihin na gamtat ziehun, note le na nua vua na tate a khantanun a nopsah den thei nadingin tuni-a kang gen tam thute zosie man dingin ngaisun un."},"29":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na mai vua na suonmang ding uh minamte hemkhie-in, amate suon dingin a leitang vuah na ten ciengun,","title":"Milim Bieh Lo Ding Hilkholna"},"30":{"text":"na mai vuah amate a kisuhsiet zaw ciengin amate zui-in na awkhah lo nadingun kidawm un: “Tam minamte in amau’ pasien-te a bangci bieh uh ahei? Ke’n zong tua bangin bawl nuom ing,” ci-in a pasien-te tawh kisai thute kan sih un."},"31":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh tungah tua bangin na bawl sih ding uhi. Azieh pen amau’ pasien-te dinga a kidahhuoi a silbawlte zosie uh Topa in muda hi. Amau’ pasien-te dingin a tapate ule a tanute nangawn uh mei sungah a hal uhi."},"32":{"text":"Kang thupieh zosie limtahin na zui ding uhi; tua khu belap loin zong na lakhie sih ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 4:2; Kln 22:18-19"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lahah kamsangte ahi a, mangsante ahi zongin ang khan a, theisahna limte ahi a, ahi sihle hilkholnate ahi zongin kang lah ding hi, ci-in ang kamciem a,"},"2":{"text":"a gen uh tua theisahna limte le hilkholna limte ang tangtun a, tuale amate in, “Adang pasien-te zui-in (na thei ngai lo uh pasien-te) tuate bie vai,” ang ci uleh,"},"3":{"text":"tua kamsangte’ thu ahi a, mangsante’ thu ahi zongin na thuse sih ding uhi; azieh pen Topa note’ Pasien khu na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh na it tahtah uh amah ci-a Topa in ang zelahna ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ nua zui-in ama na zatah ding vua, a thupiehnate zui-in a thu na mang ding vua, ama’ na sem in ama na tukip ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hizongle tua kamsangte ahi a, mangsante ahi zongin kithat ding hi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien un na zui ding vua ang thupieh lampi pana na piel nading ule Egypt gam panin hing peipi-in saltanna inn pana ang tan Topa na Pasien uh langpan ding thu a gen uhi. Tuaci’n na sung panun sietna na hemkhie ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na sanggampa, na pa’ tapa, ahi sihlna nu’ tapa, ahi sihle nangma’ tapa, ahi sihle nangma’ tanu, ahi sihle na kawilai na zi, ahi sihle na it pen na guolpa nangawn in ang dapzawl a, nangma le na pu na pate un a thei ngai lo uh pasiente, na kim na pam uh a nai a gamla, leimong khat pan mong khat a om mite in a bieh pasien dangte khatpo, “Va pei-in va bie ta vai,” ang ci leh,","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"tua bang mite’ thugen mang loin zong na thudon sih ding uhi. Amate tungah khuotuona le lainatna nei loin zong na dal sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate na that zaw lai ding uhi; amate that dingin a tung vuah na khut na lam masa pen ding a, tua zaw ciengin mi zosie in ang zui ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in saltanna gam Egypt pana ang peipi Topa na Pasien uh kung panin na piel nading uh a hanciem ziehin suong tawh ama na seplia ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te zosie in tua thu za-in a zausi ding vua, tua bang gitlona a bawlkia ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un tenna dinga ang pieh khuopi khat popo-ah,"},"13":{"text":"mi ginalo pawlkhat note lah panin peikhie dawhin, “Va pei-in na thei ngai nai lo uh pasien dangte va bie ta vai,” ci-in khuopi sunga a tengte a puikhiel lam na zah uleh,"},"14":{"text":"a thu na kan ding vua, limtahin sittelna na nei ding uhi.
