Note lahah tua bang a kidahhuoi na a kisem tahpi ahile,"},"15":{"text":"namsau tawh tua khuopi sunga tengte thatin khuo sung mi zosie le a ganhonte uh zong namsau tawh na susie ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na vanlah zosie uh khuopi sung mipi kikhopna-ah khawmin khuopi le galvan kila zosie na Topa Pasien uh tungah meihal biehna bangin a bupin mei tawh haltum un; tua khuopi khu buathah kholna ahi zing ta ding a, a kilamkia nawn sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na pu na pate tungah Topa a kiciem bangin, a zauhuoi ama’ lungthahna panin kihei a, na tung vuah ama’ lainatna hing lahin tua ama’ lainatna sungah note ang punsah thei nadingin, suhsiet dinga a ki-apsa na khatpopo na khut sung vuah omsah sih un."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-a na kung vua kang gen bangin Topa na Pasien uh’ aw ngai-in ama’ thupiehte zosie na zui uleh, Topa na Pasien uh’ muna-ah a dih nate a sem na hi uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note na hi uleh Topa na Pasien uh’ tate na hi uhi. Misite ziehin noma le noma kikuikeh sih unlen, na humsam zong heukieu sih un.","title":"Lawki Sepdante Kikhaam","ref":"Siem 19:28; 21:5"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien uh tungah a siengtho mite na hi uhi; leitung mi zosie lah panin ama’ nei gougil dinga Topa in ang teelsa na hi uhi.","ref":"Pei 19:5-6; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 26:18; Titu 2:14; 1Pet 2:9"},"3":{"text":"A kidahhuoi na khat popo na ne sih ding uhi.","title":"Ansieng le Annieh"},"4":{"text":"Na neh thei ding uh ganhingte tam teng ahi hi: Bawng, tuu, keel,"},"5":{"text":"sakhitang, sangai, sim sakhi, sathah, saza, zo sakhi, le gamtuu-te ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ganhingte lah panin a kecin a kaa, ehnel a hlai ganhing kici poma na ne thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ehnel hlai a, a kecin a kaa zongin tam bang sate na ne thei sih ding uhi: Kalaoh, bilpi, le sakihte in ehnel a hai vangin a kecin a kaa lo ziehin note adingin a nieh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Voh a kecin a kaa vangin ehnel hlai lo ahi ziehin note dingin a nieh ahi hi. Tuate’ sa na ne sih ding vua, a luong zong na tham sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tui sunga om zosie lah panin hla le lip a nei zosie na ne thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hla le lip a nei lo poma na ne sih ding uhi; tua khu note adingin a nieh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Va sieng zosie na ne thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam teng na ne sih ding uhi: Muvanlai, langta, luimu,"},"13":{"text":"mumeika, mukhau namcin;"},"14":{"text":"va-ah nam zosie;"},"15":{"text":"va-kalaoh, pengpeleuh, vatawt, musi nam zosie;"},"16":{"text":"keising le simbu, gam vatawt,"},"17":{"text":"le senel-simbu, musane le tuimu,"},"18":{"text":"gun vapi, tui va kengsau nam popo; lailen le baah te ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hla a nei insect ganhing zosie note adingin a sienglo ahi hi; tuate kine lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hla a nei ganhing a sieng poma na ne thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"A mawhsi ganhing poma na ne sih ding uhi; na khuo sung vua a teng khuol mite neh dingin na pie thei vua, ahi sihle gamdang mite kungah na zua thei ding uhi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien uh tungah a siengtho mi na hi uhi. Keelno a pi’ nawizu tawh na huonton sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:19; 34:26"},"22":{"text":"Kumsielin na lo vua a pieng, na khaici panun a pieng zosie sawm-ah-khat na tuomkoi ding uhi.","title":"Sawm-ah-khat tawh kisai Zui thute"},"23":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh na zatah zing thei nadingun, ama’ min ten nadinga a teelna mun Topa na Pasien uh’ mai-ah na an uh, na lenggazu uh, na sathau uh sawm-ah-khat le na bawnghonte ule na tuuhon tacilte uh na ne ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hizongle Topa na Pasien un thupha ang pieh ciengin, na Topa Pasien un a min koi nadinga a teel mun khu na kung panun a gamlat seng ziehin sawm-ah-khat na puoh zawh sih uleh,"},"25":{"text":"tuate sum na suo ding uhi. Na khut sung vuah tua sumte na tawi ding vua, Topa na Pasien un a teelna munah pei-in;"},"26":{"text":"na lunggul popo uh bawngtang, tuu, lenggazu, kham thei zu, ahi sihle na du popo uh leina-in tua sumte na zang ding uhi. Na Topa Pasien uh’ mai khum munah kipah tahin noma le na innkuonpite tawh na ne ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Na khuo sung vua a teng Levi-te in tanh le luo ding a nei lo ziehun amate thuse loin om sih un."},"28":{"text":"Kum thum a cin sielin tua kuma a pieng na an uh’ sawm-ah-khat zosie peipi-in na khuo sung vuah na khol ding uhi;"},"29":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na sep na bawlna zosie vuah thupha ang pieh thei nadingin note bangin tanh ahi a, luo ahi zongin a nei lo ziehun na khuo sung vua a om Levi-te, pemtate, tagate, meigong numeite pei-in khamtahin tua ante a ne ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 27:30-33; Gam 18:21"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sagi a cin sielin leiba maisahna na nei ding uhi.","title":"Sabbath Kum tawh Kisai Thukhamte (Siem 25:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Maisahna ding dan tam bang ahi hi: Mi a leitawi poma in a vengte’ bat leibate maisah ding hi. Topa’ maisahna kiphuong zo ahi ziehin leitawi a pie poma in a sanggampa’ bat ahi a, a mipi a vengpa’ bat leiba ahi zongin phulkia nawn lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdang mite kung panin na phul thei ding vua, hizongnanle na sanggam khat popo in noma-a’ ang batte na maisah ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin note lahah a tasam koima om lo ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien un na luo ding ule na nei ding vua ang pieh leitangah Topa in thupha ang pie valon ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khu note kang pieh Topa na Pasien uh’ thu mangin tuni-a kang gen tami thupiehte zosie limtaha na zui uleh cina ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang kamciemsa bangin thupha ang pieh ciengin, minam tampite na leitawisah ding vua, ahi vangin nomate in koima-a’ na leitawi sih ding uh; minam tampite tungah vai na hawm ding vua, hizongle no tungah amate in vai a hawm sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding gama na khuote uh khat popo sungah na sanggam khat uh note lahah a tasam a op leh na lungtang khausah sih unlen, tua a tasam na vengpa hu lo-in om sih un."},"8":{"text":"Note na vautat zaw ding vua, a kisap za phaltahin na leitawi ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 25:35"},"9":{"text":"“A kum sagina, maisahna kum hing nai ta hi,” ci-in na lungsim sung vuah ngaisutna gilo khat ang omin, a tasam na vengpa uh galbawlin bangma pie loin na op lo nadingun kidawm un; na vengpa zong ang kiko-in Topa tungah ang khie kha thei ding a, tua hile khielna bawl na suoh ta ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A hlawnna-in na pie ding vua, na pieh ciengun zong kiphal tahin na pie ding uhi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien un tam thu ziehin na sep na bawlna zosie vuah thupha ang pie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Leitungah mi tasam tawp ngai lo ding a, tua ahi ziehin, “Gam sunga om mizawngte le tasam sanggamte tungah phaltahin na pie ding uhi,” ci-in thu kang pie hi.","ref":"Mat 26:11; Mrk 14:7; Jhn 12:8"},"12":{"text":"Na unau, Hebrew pasal khat ahiei, ahi sihle Hebrew numei khat ahiei na kungah ang kizua-in kum guh sung na na ang seppieh leh, a kum sagina ciengin tua mipa na suohta sah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma kung panin sila pasal khat a suohta-in na peisah ciengin a khutguohin na peisah sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na tuuhonte lah, na ancilna lah le na lengga suhna lah panin phalna tawh na pie ding a, Topa na Pasien in thupha ang piehna bangin na pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gamah sila na hina ule Topa na Pasien un ang tatkhiet uh ahi lam phawh un; tam thu ziehin tuni-in na tung vuah tam thupieh kang pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Hizongle ama in nuom hing sa-in, nangma le na innkuonpite ang it ziehin, “Na kung panin ka pei sih ding hi,” ang ci vawt tah leh"},"17":{"text":"siatul khat la-in kotbieng dappha-in a bil na vut ding a, tuaci’n ama na sila ahi zing ta ding hi. Na sila numei zong tam bangma-in na bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangma kung panin a suohta-in na peisah ciengin hamsa ngaisut sin. Bang ding ahei cile a kiciel nasemte’ thamanza tawh kum guh sung nangma’ na ang sep pieh zo ta uhi; tuale Topa na Pasien un na sepna zosie vuah thupha ang pie ding hi.","ref":"Siem 25:39-46"},"19":{"text":"Na bawnghon ule na tuuhon panun tacil apa poma Topa na Pasien uh tungah na siensuo ding uhi; na bawnghon tacilte utawh na semton loin, na tuuhon tacilte uzong a mul na heu sih ding uhi.","title":"Ganhing Tacilte","ref":"Pei 13:12"},"20":{"text":"Topa in a teelna munah a kum kumin Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah na innkuonpite utawh na ne ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin poina khatpo, a khelbai a mittaw, ahi sihle poina gol a nei khat popo ahile, Topa na Pasien uh tungah biehpiehna-in na pie sih ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sangai ahiei sakhi ahiei na neh bangun, na khuo sung vuah mi buate le mi siengte in a kibangin na ne ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin a sisan na ne sih ding uhi; tui bangin tuolah a si na buo ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 9:4; Siem 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16, 23"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un Abib hla sungin Egypt panin zanin note ang peipi ziehun Abib hla tang unlen, Topa na Pasien vua dingin peisan pawi-in mang un.","title":"Peisan Pawi Ki-enphakia (Pei 23:14-17 ; 34:18-24)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in ama’ min ten nadinga a teel ding munah tuuhon pan ahi a, bawnghon pan ahi zongin Topa na Pasien vua dingin peisan pawi biehpiehna na pie ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua pen tol kisaw anlum tawh na me sih ding uhi. Na khang tawntungun Egypt gam pana nang peikhiet ni uh na phaw zing nadingun tol saw lo anlum ahi gimna anlum tawh ni sagi sung na me ding uhi. Azieh pen Egypt gam panin bungle benga ang peikhie na hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na gam sung zosie vuah ni sagi sung note lahah tol kici a kimu sih ding hi. A ni masa nitahin na gawsa uh sa khat zong zan thapai-in zingmawng dong na omsah sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding na khuopite uh khat popo-ah peisan pawi biehpiehna na lui thei sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ama’ min a ten nadinga a teelna mun behah nitum zaw nitah, Egypt gam pana na peikhiet uh hunin peisan pawi biehpiehna na lui ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un a teel ding munah huonin na ne ding uhi; zingmawng ciengin na puonbuh vuah na peikia thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ni guh sung tol saw lo anlum na nezom ding vua, a ni sagi ni-in Topa na Pasien vua dingin a thupi kikhopna khat na nei ding uhi. Tua ni-in na na sem sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:1-20; Siem 23:5-8; Gam 28:16-25"},"9":{"text":"Phieukawi tawh bu na at ni vua kipanin nipikal sagi na simto ding uhi.","title":"Nipikal Pawite Ki-enphakia"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa na Pasien uh kung pana na nga uh thupha dung zui-in nop thu-a biehna tawh Topa na Pasien vua dingin nipikal pawi na bawl ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh mai, ama’ min om nadinga Topa na Pasien un a teel ding munah, noma le na tapate, na tanute, na sila pasalte, na sila numeite, na khuopite sunga om Levi-te, note lahah a om gamdang mite, pa nei lote, le meigong numeite tawh na lungdam ton ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt gamah sal na hina uh phawh unlen, tam thukhamte limtahin zui un.","ref":"Siem 23:15-21; Gam 28:26-31"},"13":{"text":"Na ancilna ule na lengga suhna panun an na kaikhop ciengun ni sagi sung buh pawi na bawl ding uhi.","title":"Buh Pawite Ki-enphakia"},"14":{"text":"Na pawi bawl sungun nangma le na tapa na tanute, na sila pasalte le na sila numeite, Levi-te, gamdang mite, pa nei lote, le na khuo sung vua a om meigong numeite tawh na lungdam ton ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in a teel nading munah Topa na Pasien vua dingin ni sagi sung pawi na bawl ding uhi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien un na hlawsa ule na sepna zosie vuah thupha hing pie ding ahi ziehin pawi na bawl hamtang ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 23:33-36, 39-43; Gam 29:12-38"},"16":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un a teel ding mun ama mai-ah na pasal zosie uh kum khatin thumvei kilaa ding uhi: Tolsaw lo anlum pawi, nipikal pawi, le buh pawi-te ah zong kilaa ding uhi. Topa mai-ah khut guoh tawh na kilaa sih ding uhi;"},"17":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un thupha ang piehza uh zui-in mi zosie in ahi theina za tawh a pie ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang pieh ding na khuopi zosie vuah, na minam sung teng vuah thukhente le uliente na koi ding vua, mite adingin a manin thu a khen ding uhi.","title":"Tuolsung Thukhente le Uliente"},"19":{"text":"Note in thutang na leheisih ding uhi; huptuom paituom zong na nei sih ding uhi; note in guhgol na ne sih ding uhi, azieh pen guhgol in mipilte’ mit tawsah a, midihte’ dihna lehei pieh hi.","ref":"Pei 23:6-8; Siem 19:15"},"20":{"text":"Note nungta-in Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding leitangah tengin na luo thei nadingun thutang behbeh na zui ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Topa na Pasien vua dinga na siem uh maitam gei-a khuom siengtho adingin sing khuom khat popo na phut sih ding uhi;","title":"A Kikhaam Biehpieh Dante","ref":"Pei 34:13"},"22":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un a muda ahi suong tawh kibawl biehna song zong na phut sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 26:1"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawng ahi a, tuu ahi zongin, poina a nei, kisapna khat a nei poma Topa na Pasien uh’ tungah biehpiehna-a na nei lo ding uh ahi hi; azieh pen tua khu Topa na Pasien vua dingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang pieh ding ahi khuopite khatah note lahah a teng pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a thuciemna palsatin Topa na Pasien uh’ muna-ah a siet gamtatna a kimu a,"},"3":{"text":"keima in ka kham pasien dangte ahi ni ahi a, hla ahi a, vantunga om na khat popo’ na sem dingin pei-in tuate bie-in ahi zongin,","ref":"Pei 22:20"},"4":{"text":"na kung vuah tuate ang kigenin a thu na zah uleh limtahin na kantel ding vua, Israel-te sungah tua bang kidahhuoi nate a pieng tahpi ma ahile,"},"5":{"text":"tua ciengin a siet gamtat numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin na khuo pulam vuah peipi-in numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin suong tawh na seplia ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Teci ni ahi sihle thum genna tawh sina thu kikhen ding hi; teci khat beh’ thu genna tawh mi kithat lo ding hi.","ref":"Gam 35:30; Thkna 19:15; Mat 18:16; 2Cor 13:1; 1Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28"},"7":{"text":"Tecite in a kithat ding pa tungah a khut uh a hlang masa ding vua, tua zaw ciengin mipi zosie in a khut uh a hlang ding uhi. Tuaci’n note lah panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi.","ref":"1Cor 5:13"},"8":{"text":"Na khuo sung vuah mi khatlekhat kithana, mi khatlekhat dih kituna, mi khatlekhat kivuoh kisatnate ang op a, note dingin thu hamsa seng ang op leh, Topa na Pasien un a teel ding munah thakhatin peito-in,","title":"Siempute le Thukhente’ Khensatnate"},"9":{"text":"tua huna thukhen ding Levi siempute le thukhente na kikuppi ding uhi; amate in zong na kung vuah thukhenna ding ang gen ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in a teel ding mun panin na kung vua ang gen bangun na bawl ding vua, ang kihil vannuoi limtahin na sem ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Noma dinga ang gen uh thukham ahi sihle na kung vua ang zahsah uh thukhensatna bangin a unpi-in na zui ding uhi; na kung vua amate in ang gen thukhensatnate panin veilam ahi a, zietlam ahi zongin na piel sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ kungah a na sem dinga kikoi ahi siempu pa’ thu ahi a, thukhenpa’ thu ahi zongin mang loin a valkai-a a gamta mi poma kithat ding hi. Tuaci’n Israel-te sung panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mi zosie in za-in a zausi ding vua, a valkai-in a gamta nawn sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding gam luo-in na ten zaw uh, “I kimvela om minam zosiete bangin ei uh ding kumpi khat i koi ding hi,” na ci ciengun,","title":"A Kiciengtan Kumpi’ Thuneinate","ref":"1Sam 8:5"},"15":{"text":"na tung vuah kumpi-in Topa na Pasien un a teel mipa na koi thei tahpi ding uhi. Na tung vuah kumpi-in na sanggamte lah vuah khat penpen na koi thei ding uhi; na sanggam uh ahi lo gamdang mi khat kumpi-in na koi thei sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua nangawn zong ama’ aituomin sakol tampi nei thei lo ding hi. Topa in na kung vuah, “Khum lampi-ah na kilekia ngai sih ding uhi,” ang cisa ahi ziehin, ama in sakol lei be dingin Egypt gamah mite a peisahkia sih ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:28; 2Khg 1:16; 9:28"},"17":{"text":"A lungsim a kiheimang lo nadingin ama dingin zi tampi a lahbe sih ding; ama dingin ngun le kham zong a valkai-in a khol sih ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:14-22, 27; 11:1-8; 2Khg 1:15; 9:27"},"18":{"text":"A kumpi topha tungah a to ciengin Levi siempute mai-ah ama adinga a kiteisawn tami thukham bu khat nei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in tami thukham sunga a om thute le tam ngainate limtaha a zuina tawh, Topa a Pasien zatah dan a thei nading, a mite tungah kilietsahna lungsim a nei lo nading, thupiehnate a zietlam ahiei a veilam ahiei-ah a pielsan lo nading le, Israel kumpi gam sungah ama le a suon a hlahte in sauveipi sung vai a hawm thei nadingun tami laibu khomvom ding a, a hin sung tungtawnin tua sunga om thute sim ding hi.","merge":"20"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siempu ahi Levi minam zosie in Israel-te bangin tanh ahi a, luo ahi zongin a nei sih ding vua, amate in Topa’ tanh ahi biehpiehnate a ne thei ding vua,","title":"Siempute le Levi-te’ Hamphatnate"},"2":{"text":"hinanle a unau dangte lahah luo a nei sih ding uhi; ama in amate tungah a ciem bangin Topa khu amau’ luo ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:20"},"3":{"text":"Mite pieh biehpiehnate lah panin bawng ahi a, tuu ahi zongin siempute’ kaih ding ahi hi: Siempute tungah a lieng, a khagu ni le a gilpi a pie ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na anpal, na lenggazu, na sathau, na heu masah uh na tuumul uh na pie ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa’ min tawh na sem den dingin Topa na Pasien un na minam zosie lah panun Levi-te a teelsa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Levi-te khat in Israel gamah a tenna, na khuopite uh khat popo nuasie-in Topa’ teelna munah a nop hun hunin ang pei thei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa mai-ah na sema om a guol Levi-te zosie ma bangin Topa a Pasien’ minin na sem thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in innkuon’ van neite a zuana uh panin sumlut nei nan ule, amate tawh a kikimin neh ding satanh nga ton ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un note ang pieh ding gamah na tun ciengun, a mudahuoi khum mite’ gamtatnate na zui sih ding uhi.","title":"Naupang Kithoina, Aisanna, le Mitphielte Kikham"},"10":{"text":"Note lahah a tapa ahi a, a tanu ahi zongin meihal kithoina-a a zang, ai a san, khutlam a en, mailam thu a gen, ai a tawi,","ref":"Siem 19:26; Pei 22:18"},"11":{"text":"bum a zang, sihla thu a dong, a sisate thu a dong koima kimu lo ding hi.","ref":"Siem 19:31"},"12":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile tam teng a sem poma Topa adingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi; tam bang a kidahhuoi gamtatnate ziehin Topa na Pasien un na mai panun amate notmang hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh tungah na citah den ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 5:48"},"14":{"text":"Na suonmang dawh ding uh tam minamte in khutlam ente le aisante thu a ngai vua, hizongle note na hi ule tua bangin na gamtat ding uh Topa na Pasien un ang phal sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un noma dingin na sanggamte uh lah panin keima tawh a kibang kamsang khat ang khangsah ding hi; note in tua kamsangpa thu na ngai ding uhi.","title":"Moses tawh Kibang Kamsangtha Khat","ref":"Sawl 3:22; 7:37"},"16":{"text":"Horeb muolah na kikhop ni-un, “Si kha ding ka hi ziehun Topa ka Pasien uh’ aw ei zasahkia nawn sin. Tam meikuong vanglien zong ei musah nawn sin,” ci-in Topa na Pasien uh kungah tam thu na ngen uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in kei tam bangin ei dawngkia hi: “A thugente uh man hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate dingin a minam sung panun nangma tawh a kibang kamsang khat ka khangsah ding hi; keima in kamsangpa’ kam sungah ka thute ka koi ding a, amate tunga ka thupieh zosie a unpi-in a gen ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka min tawh a gen ding kamsangpa’ thugen a don lo poma kei mama in ka mawsah ding hi.","ref":"Sawl 3:23"},"20":{"text":"Hizongle kamsang khat in kei thupieh lopi-in ka min tawh thu a gen ngam a, ahi sihle pasien dangte’ min tawh thu a gen leh, tua kamsangpa si ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Na lungsim sung vuah, “ Topa’ gen lo thu bang i ci thei uh ahei na ci kha thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Kamsang khat in Topa’ min tawh thu genin tua thu ang tun sih a, ang man sih leh tua thu khu Topa’ gen ahi sih hi. Tua khu kamsangpa in a uong get ahi bo hi; Ama na giin ding uh hi lo hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un a gam uh note ang pieh minamte a suhsiet zaw, note in zong amate suonin a khuopite ule a innte vuah na ten zaw ciengun,","title":"Kibuhna Khuopite tawh Kisai Thukhamte (Gam 35:9-28 ; Josh 20:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh gam sungah khuopi thum na tuomkoi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuolthat khat popo tua khuote khat penpen ah a tai thei nadingin, Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh tua leitang a gamlatna na te ding vua, mun thumin na khen ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tami pen sawmhlim hi loin kigalbawlna zong om ngai lopi-in mi khat a that hai kha, khum munah tai-in a teng mithat pa’ kungtung thu ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Gentena-in, mi khat sing phua dingin adang khat tawh gamlah pei-in, khat zawhsang in sing phua dingin a hei lamto a, tuale a heiga panin a heitang kitawhin a guolpa satkha-in tua pa a si leh; tua mithat pa tai-in tam khuopite khat popo-ah ama’ hinna a hu thei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hizongle ama gel kigalnei ngai lo ahi ziehin sina thuoh dinga kilawm lo hi tama le, phula nuompa in a lungthah sulin nua delin lampi a gamlat ziehin ama pha-in tua mithat hai kha pa mawh tha kha thei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in thu kang pie hi: Khuopi thum na tuomkoi ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na pu na pate uh tungah kiciemin amate tungah gam buppi a khap bangin na gam uh ang kehpieh leh,"},"9":{"text":"tuni-a kang pieh thukhamte zosie limtahin zui a, Topa na Pasien uh itin ama’ lampi na zui zingna uh ahi ziehin tua khuopite banah adang khuopi thum ma na belap lai ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh ding leitang tungah maw baang lo mi khat’ sisan luong loin, na tung vuah tua sisan mawna ang tun lo nading ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in adang khat muda a, ama na buhdapin na vuo na satin tua mipa a tha a, tua khuopite lahah khat pen pena a tai leh,"},"12":{"text":"mithat pa’ khuo upate in tua mun panin ama peisahin tha dingin phulapa kungah ap ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama na khuotuo sih ding uhi; note na nopsah thei nadingun Israel-te sung panin maw baang lote’ sisan luonsahna zieha khielna na hemkhie ding uhi.","ref":"Josh 20:1-9"},"14":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na nei ding vua ang pieh ding gam, le ang kipie ding leitang tungah khanglui mite in a na phusa uh na vengte’ kigisuong khin sih un.","title":"Neisa Gamgi","ref":"Thkna 27:17"},"15":{"text":"Mi khat in a bawlkhah mawna khatpo ahi a, khielna khatpo a bawlna-ah ahi zongin tua mipa mawsah nadingin teci khat beh kicing lo ding hi. Teci ni ahi sihle teci thum thugenna tawh mawsahna kikipsah pan beh ding hi.","title":"Teci tawh Kisai Thukhaam","ref":"Gam 35:30; Thkna 17:6; Mat 18:16; Jhn 8:17; 2Cor 13:1; 1Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28"},"16":{"text":"Huotna lungsim a nei teci khat in mi khat’ tatkhielna a mawsah dinga a pei leh,"},"17":{"text":"thukinei tegel a ni tuohin Topa mai le khum huna siempute le thukhente mai-ah a kilaa ding vua,"},"18":{"text":"tuaci’n thukhente in limtahin kanin teci pa pen teci zuou ahi a, adang khat pa’ langkhatah a man lopi-a teci pang ahile"},"19":{"text":"adang khat tungah ama in bawl dinga a sawm bang lienin ama tungah na bawl ding uhi. Tuaci’n note sung panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"A omlai mite in za-in a zau ding vua, note lahah tam bang mawna lien a bawlkia ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mi na khuotuo sih ding uhi: hinna tangin hinna, mit tangin mit, ha tangin ha, khut tangin khut, keng tangin keng hi ciet ding hi.","ref":"Pei 21:23-25; Siem 24:19-20; Mat 5:38"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na galte do dingin na kuon vua, sakolte le a leengte, le a galkapte uh no-a’ sangin a tamzaw-a na mu ciengun amate na giing sih ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Egypt gam pana ang peipi Topa na Pasien un note ang ompi hi.","title":"Gal tawh Kisai Ngainate"},"2":{"text":"Gal na do masangun siempu pa a mai-ah pei-in galkapte hopi ding a,"},"3":{"text":"a tung vuah tam bangin gen ding hi: “Israel-te aw, za un! Tuni-in na galte do dingin na nai uhi. Lungkie sih un, zau sih un, patau sih unlen amahaw giing sih un;"},"4":{"text":"azieh pen na tung vuah guolzawna ang pie ding, na galte ang dopi dingin note tawh ang kuonton pa khu Topa na Pasien uh ahi hi,” ci ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin uliente in a galkapte kungah thu a gen ding vua, “Inn tha lam zo napi a ap nai lo a om ei mah? Gal sungah ama si-in midang khat in a inn ap kha ding ahi ziehin a inn ah ama peikia leh hoi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Lenggui huon bawl zo napi a ga ne nai lo na om uh amah? Gal sungah ama si-in midang khat in a ga ne kha ding ahi ziehin a inn ah ama peikia leh hoi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A zi ding dong zo napi a tenpi nai lo koi om ahei? Gal sungah ama si-in midang khat in tua numei la kha ding ahi ziehin a inn ah ama peikia leh hoi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Uliente in galkapte kungah thu a genbe lai ding vua, “A zau, a lungkie koi om ahei? Ama lungkieh bang ma-in a guolte lungkiesah kha ding ahi ziehin a inn ah ama peikia leh hoi ding hi,” a ci ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Uliente in galkapte kungah a thugen a manzaw ciengiu, a tung vua a vaihawm dingin galkapmangte se ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Khuopi khat do dinga na neh ciengun kilemna thu genpi masa un."},"11":{"text":"Na kilemna thu gen uh ang san thei vua, na tung vua ang ki-ap uleh tua sunga om mi zosie in thona-aana tawh na na ang seppieh ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Na kung vuah kilemna dei-in ang ki-ap sih vua ang do zawsop uleh, tua khuo na imtawm pai ding uhi; tuale"},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na khut sung vuah tua khuo ang pieh ciengin namsau tawh pasal zosie na that ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin noma adingin numeite, naupangte, ganhingte, le khuo sunga adang na zosie, a kinuasie van zosie na la ding vua, Topa na Pasien un note ang piehsa na galte’ vante utawh na nuomsa ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tam nai-a khuopite ahi lo, no kung pana a gamla khuopi zosie tungah hici bangin na bawl ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh tam mite’ khuopite sunga a om hinna nei zosie na hinkhawi sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un thu ang piehsa bang lienin Hit-te le Amor-te, Canaan-te le Perez-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te na sumaimang ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pasien-te dinga a bawl uh ahi a kidahhuoi gamtatnate zosie ang hil thei lo nading ule note in zong Topa na Pasien uh tungah tuaci banga na maw lo nading uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuopi khat lah thei nadingin tua khuopi simin sawtveipi na imtawm uleh, khuopi-a singkungte’ hei tawh na phua sih ding uhi. Tuate panin a ga na neh thei vangun tua singkungte na phua sih ding uhi. Note ang imtawm dingin gamlaha om singkungte mihing ahi uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"A ga a kine thei lo singkung hi, ci-in na thei teng beh uh na susie ding uhi. Na kidopi uh khuo na lah zawh masangsie-un imtawmna-a na zah dingun tuate na phua thei ding uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na nei ding vua ang pieh ding leitang tunga lopangah si luong lum khat kimu-in a that a kithei sih leh,","title":"Mithat a Kithei lopa tawh Kisai Thukham"},"2":{"text":"na upate ule na thukhente uh pei-in khumi tuol luong lupna kima khuopite a gamlatna te ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Siluong tawh kinai pen khuo upate in na sem nai lo, kol kivaw nai lo, bawnglaa khat a kai ding uhi;"},"4":{"text":"tua khuopi upate in lo-a kihlo nai lo, khaici zong a kivaw ngai nai lo, le a kang ngai lo tuiluong opna lui khatah tua bawnglaa kaisuhin tuami lui-ah bawnglaa’ ngawng a tan ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa na Pasien un a na sem ding le Topa’ min tawh thupha a pie dinga Levi siempute a teelsa ahi ziehin amate pei-in kithuneina le kihauna zosie amau’ thu tawh kikhen ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A kithat mipa tawh kinai pen khuopi upa zosie in lui sunga a ngawng kitan bawnglaa tungah khut a sil ding vua,"},"7":{"text":"“Ka khut un tam sisan a luongsah sih a, a kitha lam zong ka mu sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, na hutdamsa na mi Israel-te’ mawna ei maisah in; na mi Israel-te lahah midih sisan luonna omsah sin,” ci-in a tangko ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa muna-ah a manin na gamtat ziehun note lah panin maw baang lo sisan suona na hemkhie ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na galte uh do dingin na kuon vua, Topa na Pasien un na khut sung vuah amate hing pie-in salin na mat ciengun,","title":"Galmat Numeite"},"11":{"text":"salte lahah numei melhoi khat mu-in, tua nu deigaw-in na tenpi nuom vua ahile,"},"12":{"text":"na inn vuah tua numei na zawpi ding uhi: Ama in a sam heukieu-in a cin tan ding a,"},"13":{"text":"a sila puonte suo dawhin na inn sungah hla khat bup ang omin a nu a pa ngai-in a kap ding hi; tua zaw ciengin ama na luppi thei pan ding a, nang a pasal hi-in, ama na zi hi thei pan ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama tunga na lungkim zo sih leh, a nopna po-ah na peisah ding hi. Ama na daisahsa ahi ziehin sum tawh zua lo-in sila bangin zong na bawl sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi khat in zi ni nei a, khat dei-in a khat dei lo a, a deinu le a deilo nu in ta nei tuohin a tapa neicil pen a deilo nu tawh a hin ahile,","title":"Tacilte’ Nga dingte"},"16":{"text":"a tapate tungah a neisa goute a hawmpieh ciengin a deilo nu’ tapa sangin a deinu’ tapa a deisah zawh ziehin a deinu’ tapa pen a ta cilin bawl thei lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a deilo nu’ tapa pen a tacilin pom ding a, a nei zosie’ tanh ni pie ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile tua pa pen a pa’ thahatna tawh a pieng masa pen ahi ziehin tacil hina za ama-a’ ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mi khat in a lungpheng, a ledo thei, nu thu pa thu ngai lo, a kihil cienga thu a mang nuom lo tapa khat a nei leh,","title":"Thumanglo Tapate"},"19":{"text":"a nu le a pa in a khuopi upate kung, khuopi tunkotah tua mipa peipi-in,"},"20":{"text":"amate in a khuo upate kungah, “Tam ka tapa uh pen mi lungpheng le mi ledo thei, sap thei lo le zuhai anhai bep ahi hi,” ci ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuo pasal zosie in suong tawh ama seplia ding uhi. Tuaci’n na laizang vuah sietna na hemkhie ding uhi; tuale Israel-te zosie in za-in zau ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mi khat in sina cing mawna bawlin ama kithat a, sing tung khatah ama a khai ciengun,","title":"Thukhaam Tuomtuomte"},"23":{"text":"sing tungah zan tungtawnin a luong om lo ding hi; khumi ni ma-in na vui pai ding uhi, azieh pen sing tunga kikhai mi poma Pasien’ samsietna thuoh ahi hi. Topa na Pasien un luo dinga ang pieh ding na leitang uh na buasah sih ding uhi.","ref":"Gal 3:13"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na vengpa’ bawngtang ahi a, a tuu ahi zongin a gammang na mu vua ahile kitheimaw bawl loin a neipa kungah na kaikia ding uhi."},"2":{"text":"Na kim nai vuah a neipa teng loin a nei na thei sih uleh na inn vuah kai-in, a nei pa in ang nget masangsie na kem ding uhi; tua ciengin na piekia ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na vengpa’ laa zong tua bang ma-in na bawl ding uhi; a puonsilte zong tua ma bangin na bawl ding uhi; na vengpa in a mansuo adang na mukiate uzong tua ma bangin na bawl ding uhi. Panpi loin na om sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na vengte’ laa ahi a, bawngtang ahi zongin lam lai-a pua na mu uleh na kitheimaw bawl sih ding uhi; note in na phawhto piehkia ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 23:4-5"},"5":{"text":"Numei in pasal’ puon sil loin pasal in zong numei’ puon sil lo ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile tua banga a gamta poma Topa na Pasien uh adinga a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Singdawn ahi a, lei lah ahi zongin vabu khat a no ahi a, a tui tawh ahi zongin omin a pi in a no ahi a, a tui ahi zongin a op laitah na mu uleh, a no tawh a pi na lahtha sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na nopsah nading ule sauvei na hin thei nadingun a pi hla-in a no beh na la ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Inn tha na lam ciengun na innkhumzang kimvel vuah a imna na bawl ding uhi; tua tung panin mi a kieh leh tua inn ah sisan suosah mawna na tut lo nading uh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Na lenggui lo vuah khaici nam ni na vaw sih ding vua, na vaw uleh na vawsa uh ankung le na lenggui lo vua piengte a nipi-in kisie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bawngtang khat le laa khat hahkol vawtonin lo na kaisah sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Samul le patkhau a kiganton puon na sil sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:19"},"12":{"text":"Na kihuina na puonzal uh a gei ning lite tungah puonmongtep na bawl ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 15:37-41"},"13":{"text":"Gentena-in pasal khat in numei khat a tenpi a, ahi vangin ama a luppi zaw ciengin dei nawn loin","title":"Nu-le-pa Optonna tawh Kisai Thukhamte"},"14":{"text":"tua nu mawsah a, “Tami numei zi-in ka nei hi. Ahi vangin ama tawh ka lupton ciengin ngahnu siengtho a hina lim mawngmawng ka mu sih hi,” ci-in tua nu a mindaisah leh,"},"15":{"text":"tua ngahnu nu’ pa in khuopi upate kung kotpi-ah ngahnu nu’ siengthona talang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngahnu nu’ pa in upate kungah, ‘Tam mipa tungah a zi dingin ka tanu ka pie a, ahi vangin a dei nawn sih hi;"},"17":{"text":"tu-in ama in, ‘Na tanu ngahnu siengtho a hina lim mawngmawng ka mu sih hi,’ ci-in mawsahna thu a gen hi. Ahi vangin tamte khu ka tanu ngahnu siengtho a hina lim ahi hi,’ a ci ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in khuopi upate mai-ah tua puon a pha ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khuopi upate in tua mipa zawpi-in dan pie ding uhi;"},"19":{"text":"ngun shekel zakhat tawh ama a lieusah ding uhi. (tua khu numeino’ pa tungah a pie ding uhi.) Azieh pen ama in Israel ngahnu siengtho khat a min siesah ahi hi. Ama pen ama zi ma hi ding a, a hin sung tungtawnin tua nu khul thei nawn lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin tami mawsahna a man hi-in, ngahnu siengtho a hina lim a kimu mawngmawng sih leh,"},"21":{"text":"amate in a pa’ kotbieng ah tua ngahnu nu peipi-in khuopi pasalte in suong tawh seplia ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a pa’ inn sungah pahtatna tawh Israel-te lahah maizumna a tun hi. Tua bangin note sung panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pasal khat, midang khat’ zi tawh a lupton laitahin a kimat leh, tua numei a luppi pa le a numei a ni gelin kithat ding hi. Tuaci’n Israel-te lah panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Zi dinga kikhaamsa ngahnu siengtho khat om a, pasal khat in khuopi sungah mu-in ama a luppi leh,"},"24":{"text":"a ni gelin tua khuopi tunkotah na zawpi ding vua, khuopi sungah tua ngahnu nu om napi kiko-in huna a nget lo zieh le, tua pasal in a vengpa’ zi a suhsiet pieh ziehin suong tawh a nipi-in na seplia ding uhi. Tuaci’n note lah panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin pasal khat in a kikhaamsa numei khat gamlahah mu-in, tua pasal pa in ama buonin a luppi leh, tua numei a luppi pa beh kithat ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ngahnu nu bangma na law sih ding uhi; tua ngahnu nu in sina cing khielna a bawl sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile tam thu pen mi khat in a vengpa do-in a tha tawh kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in lopang lahah tua nu a va tuo khah ziehin a kikhaamsa numei in huna ngenin kiko kha thei ding hi, ahi vangin ama hunkhie ding koima om lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasal khat in a kikhaam nai lo ngahnu khat tuohin tua numei buonin luppi a, a lupton laitahun a kimat leh,"},"29":{"text":"a luppi pa in ngahnu nu’ pa kungah ngun shekel sawmnga pie ding a, tua numei a zi hi ding hi. Azieh pen ama in tua numei a suthaang zo ta a, tuaci’n ama in a nuntah lai teng tua numei khul thei nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 22:16-17"},"30":{"text":"Pasal khat in a pa’ zi tenpi lo ding a, a pa-a’ te tawh minsie lo ding hi.","ref":"Siem 18:8; 20:11; Thkna 27:20"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa mite kikhopna-ah a ciltang a kisuguoi ahi sihle a pasal neitah a ki-attan poma kihal thei lo ding hi.","title":"Kikhopna Pana Kipusete"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ mite kikhopna-ah zawlta poma kihal thei lo ding hi. Topa’ mite kikhopna-ah a suon a hlahte uh a khang sawmna dong na ngawnin kihal thei lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ mite kikhopna-ah Ammon-te ahi a, Moab-te ahi zongin kihal thei lo ding hi. Topa’ mite kikhopna-ah a suonlehlahte a khang sawmna dong nangawnin kihal thei lo ding hi,"},"4":{"text":"azieh pen Egypt panin na peikhiet lai-un amate in lampi-ah an le tui tawh ang na lamdot sih vua, ang samsie dingin Mesopotamia gama om Pethor khuo panin Beor’ tapa Balaam ciel zawsop uhi.","ref":"Gam 22:1-6"},"5":{"text":"(Hinanle Topa na Pasien un Balaam’ thu a mang sih hi; Topa na Pasien un note ang it ziehin, Topa na Pasien un tua samsietna pen no adingin thupha-in ang heipieh hi.)","ref":"Neh 13:1-2"},"6":{"text":"Note in na nuntah laisie-un amau’ nopsah nading le hau nading na bawlpieh ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Note in Edom mite khatpo na huot bawl sih ding uhi, azieh pen amate na sanggam uh ahi hi. Egypt-te khatpo zong na huot bawl sih ding uhi, azieh pen amau’ gamah note zong pemta na hi ngai uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ mite kikhopna-ah amate sung pana a pieng a khang thumna panin kihal thei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Na galte uh do dingin giephuol-ah na om ciengun, a kilawm lo na khat popo panin na kikem ding uhi.","title":"Siengthona, Ngaina, le Mi Hepi nading Thuhilnate"},"10":{"text":"Na lah vuah mi khatpo in zanlai-in bawtui a te ziehin a bua leh, giephuol panin tua pa pusuoh ding hi; giephuol sungah ama lut lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nitah ciengin tui tawh ama kipumsil ding a, ni tum ciengin giephuol sungah lut theikia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Giephuol pulamah dailen nading mun khat na tuom nei ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na vanzahte ban vuah tuzum khat na nei ding uhi; a pulamah dai na len ciengun tua tawh lei tokuohin na zun na eh uh lei na vuakia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa na Pasien ukhu no ang hun ding le na khut sung vuah na galte ang pie dingin na giephuol utawh ang zinton ahi hi, tua ahi ziehin ama in na lah vuah a kilawm lo na khatpo a mu lo nading le ang vamangsan khah lo nadingin na giephuol uh a sientho kul ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A neite kung panin no kunga ang tai silate na piekia sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na khuopite lah panun amau’ teelna mun, amau’ lungkim penna, na lah vuah note tawh ang teng ding uhi; amate na gawt sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Biehinnpi sungah Israel’ tanute koima numei pahtatin om thei lo ding hi; Israel tapate zong biehinnpi sungah koima khat beh a pahtatin om thei lo ding hi.","ref":"Siem 19:29"},"18":{"text":"Numei pahtat nu kiguoina thaman ahi a, pasal pahtat pa kiguoina thaman ahi zongin Topa na Pasien uh’ inn sungah thuciemna khat popo-a pieh dingin na tawi sih ding uhi, azieh pen tamte khu a ni tuohin Topa na Pasien vua dingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Na sanggam Israel khat tungah sum ahi a, neh ding an ahi zongin na khat popo a met deina tawh na leitawi sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Gamdang mi khat tungah a metin leitawi na pie thei ding vua, hinanle na sanggam Israel mipa tungah a metin leitawi na pie sih ding uhi. Tam teng pen luo dinga na lut nading uh gam sungah Topa na Pasien un nasepna zosie vuah thupha ang pieh thei nading ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 22:25; Siem 25:36-37; Thkna 15:7-11"},"21":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh tungah thuciem na na bawl ciengun, na ciemna uh na tangtun nadingun hun khinto sih un; bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien un na kung vuah ang phul valon ding a, na tung vuah khielna ang hi ta ding hi.","ref":"Gam 13:1-16; Mat 5:33"},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin thuciemna bawl ding na kideh vua ahile na tung vuah khielna om lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na kam utawh Topa na Pasien tung vuah na dei bang vua na kiciemsa ma bangun na kam sung pan vua a pusuoh poma limtahin na sem ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Na vengpa lengga lo-a na kuon uleh na du zaza uh, na kham dongun lengga na ne thei ding vua, ahi vangin na seu sung vuah bangma khat na guong sih ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na vengpa’ ankung ding laite lahah na pei ciengun na khut utawh a vuite na hiet thei ding vua, ahi vangin na vengpa’ ankung ding laite phieukawi tawh na at sih ding uhi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi khat in numei khat a zi-in a lah a, ahi vangin tua nu tungah mawsahna ding thu a mu ziehin lungkim loin ama in khulna lai giel a, tua nu’ khut sungah pie-in a inn panin tua nu peisah hi. Tua ciengin tua nu in tua pa’ inn nuasie a,","title":"Kitenna le Kikhulna Thukhamte","ref":"Mat 5:31; 19:7; Mrk 10:4"},"2":{"text":"a nua-ah pei-in midang khat’ zi a suoh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pasal nukhia pen in zong ama dei nawn loin khulna lai gielin a khut sungah pie a, a inn panin a peisahkia a, (ahi sihle a kitenpi a pasal nukhia pen a si hi);"},"4":{"text":"a inn pana a peisah a pasal masa in tua nu a bua zaw ciengin a zi-in kilasah kia thei lo ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile tua khu Topa dinga a kidahhuoi ahi a, tuaci’n Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh ding leitang tungah khielna na tunpi sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Pasal khat a zi nei cilin gal kuon lo ding a, tua tawh kipaikan nasep khatpo zong kisemsah lo ding hi. A kitenpi a zi tawh kum khat sung a inn ah lungdam tahin omton hit hiet ding hi.","title":"Thukham Tuomtuomte"},"6":{"text":"Koima in an gawina sum hitale, an gawina suongpeh tungnung pen hitale khapna-in la thei lo ding hi, azieh pen tua khapna ziehin nuntahna a lahpieh na suoh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khat in Israel midang khat a guhdap a, sila bangin a bawl ahi a, a zua ahi zongin a kimat leh tua guta pa kithat ding hi. Tuaci’n note lah panin sietna na hemkhie ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 21:16"},"8":{"text":"Phah natna na vei lo nadingun kikemcing siem mama un; keima in amate ka thupieh bangin Levi siempute in ang hil bangun na gamta ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 13:1–14:54"},"9":{"text":"Egypt panin khuol na zin lai-un lampi-ah Topa na Pasien un Miriam tunga a bawlnate phawh un.","ref":"Gam 12:10"},"10":{"text":"Na vengpa kungah na khatpo na leitawi ciengun vankhap la dingin a inn ah na lut sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Inn pulamah na ngah ding vua, tuaci’n leitawi na pieh pa in na kung vuah a vankhap ang peipi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua pa mizawng ahile vankhap dinga ang pieh puon na luppi sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ni tum ciengin na vengpa in tua puon tawh lumin thupha ang pieh thei nadingin vankhap ang pieh pen na piekia ding uhi; tua khu Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah note ang kipatahna ahi ding hi.","ref":"Pei 22:26-27"},"14":{"text":"A zawng le a cimaw nasema na ciel uh, adang Israel-te ahi a, na gam sung na khuopite uh khatpo sunga a teng pemtate ahi zongin a thaman uh na henpieh sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Nisimin a thaman uh nitum masangin na pie ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate mizawng ahi vua, a hinkhuo uh tuate tunga kinga ahi bo hi; na pieh sih uleh Topa tungah amate kiko-in ang sawm ding vua, tuaci’n na maw ta ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:13"},"16":{"text":"Tate ziehin pate kithat lo ding a, pate ziehin zong tate kithat lo ding hi; amau’ khielna ciet zieh behin mite kithat ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pemta khat ahi a, taga khat ahi zongin amate adingin thutang na lehei sih ding uhi; meigong nu’ puon zong vankhapin na lahpieh sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Egypt gamah sila na hina ule Topa na Pasien un khum mun panin ang tatkhietna na phawh ding uhi; tua ahi ziehin tam banga na gamtat ding uh thu kang pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Na lo vuah na an uh na lah ciengun buphaite na mangngil khah vua ahile, a lakia dingin na pei ta sih ding uhi; bangkim na sepna vuah na Topa Pasien un note thupha ang pieh thei nadingin pemtate, pa nei lote, le meigong numeite adingin tuate kinuasie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na olive kungte uh na sat ciengun a bate na sat sih ding uhi; tuate khu pemtate, pa nei lote, le meigong numeite ading ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Na lengga huon panun lengga na law ciengun ansangh na khonkia sih ding uhi; tuate pen pemtate, pa nei lote, le meigong numeite ading ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Egypt gama sila na hina uh na phawh ding uhi; tua ahi ziehin keima in tam bangin na gamtat nadingun thu kang pie hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ni thu kitu-in zumah kiheh hinlen, a kikal vuah thukhente in thu a khenpieh a, khat pa dih tangsahin a khat pen mawsah hi."},"2":{"text":"A mawpa sat thuoh dinga kilawm ahile thukhen pa in ama khuplup sah ding a, ama in a khielna dung zui-in ama mai-ah a kisat ding za satsah ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sawmli vei kisat thei ding a, hinanle tua val hi lo ding hi; tua sanga a tamzaw a kisat leh, na muna vuah na vengpa a kineubawl a suoh ding hi.","ref":"2Cor 11:24"},"4":{"text":"Bu a cil bawng a kam na hen sih ding uhi.","ref":"1Cor 9:9; 1Tim 5:18"},"5":{"text":"Sanggam pasalte a teng ton vua, a lah vuah khat si-in tapa a nei sih leh, a si pa’ zi pen innkuon pulama geltate khat tawh kinung thei lo ding hi. A pasal’ sanggampa in ama luppi-in a mo en ding a, ama tungah pasal sanggampa khat’ sep ding nasep sem ding hi.","title":"Levi-te’ Kitenna"},"6":{"text":"Tuale Israel-te lahah ama inn-gamh ahi lo nadingin tua nu tawh a nei masah a tapa pen a sisa a sanggampa’ ta-in kibawl ding hi.","ref":"Mat 22:24; Mrk 12:19; Luk 20:28"},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua pa in a sanggampa’ zi ahi a mo a et nuom vawt sih leh khuopi tunkota upate kungah a sanggampa’ zi pei ding a, “Ka pasal’ sanggampa in Israel-te lahah a sanggampa’ suonlehlah kizop ding a nuom sih hi; pasal sanggampa’ nasep kei tungah sem nuom lo hi,” ci ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin a khuopi upate in ama hlanin hopi ding uhi. Tuale ama in, “Ama ka tenpi nuom sih hi,’ a ci teitei leh,"},"9":{"text":"tua pa kungah upate’ mitmu-in a sanggampa’ zi peito-in a kedap sutpieh ding a, a maitang cil phitin, “A sanggampa’ innkuon a zomto nuom lo mipa tam bangin kibawl taheh,” ci-in pholah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel-te lahah ama’ innkuon pen, “A kedap kisutpieh pa’ innkuon,” kici ding hi.","ref":"Ruth 4:7-8"},"11":{"text":"Mite khatlekhat a kihau a, khat pen’ zi in a kihaupi a langpa khut sung panin a pasal hunkhie dingin kisa-in, a khut tawh tua pa neitah a matpieh leh,","title":"Thupieh Dangte"},"12":{"text":"tua nu’ khut na sattan ding uhi; na khuotuo vawt sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na ip sung vuah tawisuong nam ni, a gol le a neu, na puoton sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na inn sung vuah a tena nam ni, a gol le a neu, na koiton sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Note in tawisuong a cing le a man na nei ding uhi; Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding leitangah na hin sawt nadinguna tena a cing le a man na nei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen tua banga sil bawl zosie le a dih lo-a na sem zosie, Topa na Pasien uh tungah a kidahhuoi ahi uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:35-36"},"17":{"text":"Egypt panin khuol na zinna vuah Amalek-te in no tunga ang bawlna,"},"18":{"text":"basamin na nguoi ciengun lampi-ah note ang dona, le na nua vua ang pha zo lo zosie ang thagam piehna uh phawh un; amate in Pasien a giing sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa na Pasien un na nei ding vua gouluo-a ang piehsa leitang tung muncin tengah Topa na Pasien un na galte zosie panun tawlngahna ang pieh hun ciengin, vansin nei panin Amalek-te phawna na phietmang ding uhi; mangngil vawt sih un.","ref":"Pei 17:8-14; 1Sam 15:2-9"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na luo ding vua ang pieh ding leitangah pei-in tua leitang luo-in khum munah na ten ciengun,","title":"Anpalte le Sawm-ah- khat"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding leitanga pieng ga zosie panin a ga masa pawlkhat la-in law khat sungah na koi ding vua, Topa na Pasien un ama’ min om nadinga a teelna munah na pei ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:19"},"3":{"text":"Tua huna na sem siempu pa kungah pei-in ama kungah, “ Topa in ei pieh dinga ka pu ka pate uh tunga a ciemsa leitangah kang tung ta uhi, ci-in tuni-in Topa na Pasien kungah kang ko uhi,” na ci ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Siempu pa in na khut sung panun law la-in Topa na Pasien uh’ maitam mai-ah tua law a koi ciengin,"},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ mai-ah, “Ka pu uh pen mi vahvai Aram-te ahi hi; ama Egypt-ah a peisuh a, tua muna a pem lai-in mi tawmno khat ahi bo hi. Tua munah a vanglien, a thahat, le minam tampi ang hi ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt-te in ei bawlsia-in na hamsa pipi ei semsahin ei gimsah vua,"},"7":{"text":"tuaci’n kote zong ka pu ka pate uh’ Pasien Topa tungah ka kiko vua, Topa in ka aw uh ei za-in ama in ka thuohna uh, ka gimna uh, le ka gentheinate uh ei mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in a thahat a khut, a kizah a banhat, a zauhuoi a vanglietna, lim le na lamdangte lahna tawh Egypt panin ei na peipi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in tami munah ei na tunpi-in, bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna tami leitang ei pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa aw, nang in ko nei pieh leitanga a pieng gamasa pen tu-in kang peipi uhi,” na ci ding uhi. Topa na Pasien uh’ mai-ah tuate na koi ding vua, Topa na Pasien uh’ mai-ah na kun ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa na Pasien un noma le na innkuonpite tunga ang pieh na hoi zosie ziehin, noma le Levi-te le note lahah a teng pemtate tawh na lungdamton ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Sawm-ah-khat pieh kum ahi a kum thumna kumin na hlawsa uh panin sawm-ah-khat zosie na pieh zaw ciengun, (tua khu sawm-ah-khat pieh kum ahi hi) amate in na khuopite sung vuah an ne-in a gilva thei nadingun Levi-te, pemtate, tagate, le meigong numeite tunga na pieh uh na hlawsa uh sawm-ah-khat na pieh zaw ciengun,","ref":"Thkna 14:28-29"},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah tam bangin na gen ding uhi: “Ka inn sung panin a siengtho tanh teng ka tuomkoi zo a, kei nei sawlna bangin na thupiehna zosie dung zui-in Levi-te, pemtate, tagate, le meigong numeite tungah ka pie zo hi; keima in na thupiehnate palsat loin ka mangngil sih hi:"},"14":{"text":"Ka da ka kaa sungin zong sawm-ah-khat ka ne sih hi; ka bua sungin zong tuate la loin misite tungah tuate ka pie sih hi. Topa ka Pasien’ thu ka mang zo a, kei nei thupieh bang lienin ka sem zo hi."},"15":{"text":"A siengtho nangma tenna vantung panin ei ensuh inlen, ka pu ka pate uh tungah bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gam na ciemsa bangin, na mi Israel-te nei piehsa leitang thupha ei pie in,” na ci ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuni mama-in na tung vuah Topa na Pasien un na zui ding uh tami thukhamte le ngaina kipte ang pie hi; tuaci’n na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh tuate limtahin na zui ding uhi.","title":"Hanthot Thukhupna"},"17":{"text":"Tuni-in na Pasien uh ahi dingin Topa’ thukimna na nga zo ta uhi: tuale a lampite zui a, a thukhamte, a thupiehte, le a ngaina kipte kemcingin ama’ thu na man ding uh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-in Topa in na tung vua ang ciemsa bangin ama in ama’ nei ding mi le ama’ thukhamte a zui dingin na thukimna uh a nga zo ta hi;","ref":"Pei 19:5; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; Titu 2:14; 1Pet 2:9"},"19":{"text":"ama in a bawlsa minam zosiete tungah a kiphatzaw, a minthangzaw, le a kipatawizaw-in ang koi ding hi; tuale ama’ ang ciemsa bangin Topa na Pasien uh adingin a siengtho mi na suoh ding uhi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses le Israel upate in tam bangin mi zosie thu vaihlah uhi: Tuni-a kang gen uh thupiehna zosie zui un.","title":"Ebal Muol tunga Kigiel Suongtum le Maitam (Josh 8:30-35)"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding leitanga pei dingin Jordan na galkai ni-un, suongtum golte na phut ding vua, a zutna tawh a tung na zutmam ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh’ Pasien Topa in ang ciem bangin Topa na Pasien un ang pieh ding bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna leitang lut dingin na galkai ciengun, tua suongte tungah tam thukham sunga a om thu zosie a unpi-in na giel ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jordan na galkai zaw ciengun Ebal muol tungah tam suongte na phut ding vua, tuni-a kang thupiehte tawh kizui-in tam suongte phutin a zutna tawh a tung na zutmam ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khum munah Topa na Pasien uh adingin maitam khat na lam ding vua, suongte tawh maitam bawlin tuate tungah sia vanzahte na zang sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"A kisui lo suongtumte tawh Topa na Pasien uh’ maitam na bawl ding uhi. Tua ciengin tua maitam tungah Topa na Pasien uh adingin meihal biehnate pie unlen,","ref":"Pei 20:25"},"7":{"text":"khumi munah thunuom biehpiehnate ne-in, Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah nuomsa un."},"8":{"text":"Tua suongte tungah tam thu zosie kicien tahin na giel ding uhi.","ref":"Josh 8:30-32"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses le Levi siempute in Israel-te zosie hopi-in tam bangin a gen uhi: Israel-te aw, sip dide unlen ngai un! Tuni mama-in Topa na Pasien uh’ mite na hi ta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa na Pasien uh’ thu mangin tuni-a kang gen ama’ thupiehnate le ama’ thukhamte na zui ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in Moses in mite tam bangin thuhil hi:","title":"Samsietna Sawm le Nite"},"12":{"text":"Jordan na galkai zaw ciengun mite thupha a pie dingin Gerazim muolah tam teng ding ding uhi: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, le Benjamin-te ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:29; Josh 8:33-35"},"13":{"text":"Tuale Ebal muol tungah mi samsie dingin tam teng ding ding uhi: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, le Naphtali-te ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te zosie tungah Levi-te in awging lienpi tawh tam bangci ding uhi:"},"15":{"text":"“ Topa adingin a kidahhuoi khut siempa’ khut tawh a kibawl, a kikheng ahi a, a kisung ahi zongin milim bawlin a biedap poma samsietin om taheh,” a ci ding vua, tuale mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci-in a dawngkia ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:4; 34:17; Siem 19:4; 26:1; Thkna 4:15-18; 5:8"},"16":{"text":"“A nu ahi a, a pa a hi zongin a zatah lo poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:12; Thkna 5:16"},"17":{"text":"“A vengpa’ kigisuong a khin poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen! “ci ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 19:14"},"18":{"text":"“Mittawpa lam a puikhiel poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:14"},"19":{"text":"“Pemta, taga le meigong numeite tungah thutang a leheipieh poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 22:21; 23:9; Siem 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18"},"20":{"text":"“A pa’ zi niih lempieh a, a pa’ zi tawh a lumton poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:8; 20:11; Thkna 22:30"},"21":{"text":"“Ganhing khat popo tawh a lumton mi poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 22:19; Siem 18:23; 20:15"},"22":{"text":"“A nu’ tanu, a pa’ tanu, ahi sihle a sanggamnu tawh a lumton poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:9; 20:17"},"23":{"text":"“A sungnu tawh a lumton poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:17; 20:14"},"24":{"text":"“A vengpa a thatdap poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Mawna nei lopa tha nadinga guhgol a la poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Tam thukham sunga om thu zosie zui loin a tukip lo poma samsietin om taheh,” ci ding uhi. Mi zosie in, “Amen!” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Gal 3:10"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na man vua, keima in tuni-a na tung vua kang gen ama’ thupiehte zosie limtaha na zui uleh, Topa na Pasien un leitunga minam zosiete tungah ang koi ding a,","title":"Thumanna Zieha Thuphate (Siem 26:3-13 ; Thkna 7:12-24)"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na man uleh na tung vuah tam thuphate zosie ang tung ding hi:"},"3":{"text":"Khuopi sungah thupha na nga ding vua, khuotate-ah zong thupha na nga ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na sung pan vua a piengte, na leitang pan vua a pieng gate, na ganhonte, na bawnghonte ule na tuuhonte uh pungin thupha na nga ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na lawte ule na annel pawina kuongte vuah thupha om ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sungtum uh ciengin thupha na nga ding vua, na pusuo ciengun zong thupha na nga ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in na mai vuah ang langpang na galte a lelsah ding hi; note ang langpang dingin lampi khat panin ang kuon ding vua, lampi sagi-in na mai vuah a taimang ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na ansalte ule na sepna zosie vuah Topa in thupha ang tungsah ding hi; Topa na Pasien un note ang pieh ding leitangah ama in thupha ang pie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehte zui-in ama’ lampi na tot nah uleh na tung vua ang ciemsa bangin a mi siengtho dingin Topa in note ang sukip ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Leitung mi zosiete in Topa mina ang kihlat lam a thei ding vua, ang giing ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in na pu na pate uh tungah pieh dinga a na ciemsa leitangah noma sung pana a piengte, na ganhon pan vua a piengte le na leitang pan vua a piengte tungah Topa in note nahpitahin ang hausah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na leitang tung vuah a hunin guo a zusah ding le na sepna zosie vuah thupha ang pie dingin Topa in vantung le a gou hoi kholna inn ang honpieh ding hi. Minam tampite na leitawisah ding vua, hizongle note in mi kungah na leitawi sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na kung vuah tuni-a keima in kang gen Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehte mangin tuate limtahin na zui vua, tuni-in na kung vua kang gen kammalte panin amau’ nasem dingin pasien dangte zui-in zietlam ahi a, vei lam ahi zongin na piel sih nah po uleh, Topa in a mei lamin ang bawl sih dinga, a lutang lamin ang bawl ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:13-17","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Hinanle Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na man sih vua, tuni-a kang gen ahi ama’ thupiehte le a thukham teng zosie limtaha na zui sih uleh, tam samsietna zosie in note ang pha dinga, na tung vuah ang tu ding hi:","title":"Thumanlona Genkholna"},"16":{"text":"Khuopi sungah ang kisamsie ding a, khuota-ah zong ang kisamsie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na lawte ule na annel pawina kuongte kisamsie ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na sung vua a piengte, na leitang pan vua a pieng gate, na bawngte ule na tuuhonte uh zong kisamsie ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na sungtum ciengun ang kisamsie ding a, na pusuo ciengun zong ang kisamsie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima ei nuasie-in na gamtatsietnate uh ziehin ang kinaw suhsiet masangun Topa in na tung vuah gimna, patauna, galgihnate ang tungsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in na luo ding vua na lut nading uh leitang panin ang suhmang masangin natna in ang bawmsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in kumzawnna, cithuo natna, cipawm natna, a sa mama khuolumna le guotui kanna, huisa mutgawpna, le maaibuoh natnate tawh ang gimsah ding a, tuaci’n na sigam masangsie-un ang del ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na lutung vua om vantung zong sumngo bangin sanin guo zu lo ding hi; na nei vua om leitung zong siatang bangin sah giagua ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in na gam sung vua guote leivui ang suohsah ding a, ang kisuhsiet masangsie-un van panin na tung vuah tuate ang kiesuh ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in na galte uh mai-ah ang guolelsah ding hi; amate a do dingin lam khatin na kuonton ding vua, a masang vuah lam sagi-in na taimang ding uhi. Leitung kumpi gamte zosie adingin cimulthaw huoi na hi ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Na luonghawmte uh vana leng vate le leitunga om ganhing zosie’ an hi ding a, tuate delmang ding mi koima om lo ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in na damkia thei lo nadingun Egypt uilutte le hima naikulte, hima lipneite le cithahte tawh note ang gimsah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in motna, mittawtna, le lungsim buoina tawh note ang gimsah ding hi;"},"29":{"text":"miel lahah mittawte a kimaimaw bangin suntanglai pi-in na kimaimaw ding vua, ahi vangin na lampi uh na mu thei sih ding uhi; mite’ bawlsiet le bulu-in na om zing ding vua, ang panpi ding koima a om sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Zi dingin numei khat na khaam ding vua, ahi vangin midang khat in ama a na luppi ding hi. Inn na lam ding vua, a sungah na teng sih ding uhi. Lengga um na bawl ding vua, a ga na nekha sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Na mitmu-un na bawngtangte uh kigo ding a, a sa na nekha sih ding uhi. Na maitang vuah na laate uh ang kiguhpieh ding a, na kung vuah ang kipiekia nawn sih ding hi. Na tuute uh na galte kipie ding a, ang hu ding koima om lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Na tapate ule na tanute uh midangte kipie ding a, sun nitang tumin amate na en ngetngut ding uhi; na et na lamun na mit uh a kham ding a, hizongle amate bangma na law zo sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na thei ngai lo uh minam khat in na leitang pan vua a piengte le na sepsa zosie uh ne sieng ding hi; ang kibawlsie-in ang kigawt zing ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Na mit vua na mu ding uh nate ziehin na motlaw va-ia ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Topa in na damkia thei lo nading uh a nasie mama uilut natna tawh na khup ule na keng ban vuah, na ketawte panun na luvum dongun ang genthei bawl ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Noma le na pu na pate un a thei ngai nai lo minam khat kungah Topa in noma le na tung vuah vaihawm dinga na koi uh na kumpipa uh ang peipi ding a, khum sungah singlesuong tawh kibawl pasien dangte’ na na sem ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Topa in ang peipina mi zosiete lahah a cizathuoi, paunah le thugentena na suoh ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Lo-ah khaici na tu ding vua, hinanle themno khat beh na la bo ding uhi, azieh pen kauphe in a netum ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Lengga um bawlin na pawngil sipsep ding vua, hizongle lenggazu dawn loin a ga zong na lo sih ding uhi, azieh pen na lengga uh lung neh ding ahi bo hi."},"40":{"text":"Na gam sung zosie vuah olive kung na nei ding vua, hinanle a thau na kinu tuom sih ding uhi. Azieh pen na olive gate uh pulmang ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tanu le tapate na nei ding vua, hinanle noma-a’ hi den lo ding hi, bang ding ahei cile amate salin kiman ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Na singkungte ule na leitang pan vua a pieng ga zosie khuombai an ahi ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Note sangin na lah vua om pemtate a sangzaw semsem ding vua, note na niem suhsuh ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Amate in note ang leitawi ding vua, hizongle note in amate leitawi na pie zo sih ding uhi; amate a lutang suoh ding a, note a meidawn na suoh ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in na kung vua ang gen thupiehte le thukhamte zui loin, Topa na Pasien uh’ thu mang lo na hi ziehun ang kisuhsiet masangsie-un na tung vuah tam samsietna zosie ang tung ding a, note hing nuadelin ang nua phah ding uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tuate pen noma le na suonlehlahte lahah lim le hilkholna lim hi zing ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Sil bang kimah kiningcinga note na op lai-un lungdam kipah tahin Topa na Pasien uh’ na sem lo na hi ziehun,"},"48":{"text":"Topa in note do dinga ang sawl ding na galte uh’ na, gilkiel dangtana, guohtanga opna, bangkim tasapna tawh na sem ding uhi. Note ang suhsiet masangsie-in na ngawng vuah sia hahkol ang bul ding uhi."},"49":{"text":"Topa in a gamlapi, leimong pan muvanlai bangin note ang taw dingin a ham na thei lo uh minam,"},"50":{"text":"a giinhuoi minam, khanghamte a zatah vawt lo le khangnote zong maipha a pie tuon lo minam khat na kung vuah ang sawl ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Note na sigam masangsie-un na gannote ule na leitang pieng a gate hing nehtum piehin ang suhsiet masangsie-un an, lenggazu, sathau, na ganhonte uh ahi sihle na tuuhon note uzong ang henpieh sih ding uhi."},"52":{"text":"Note in na muon uh kul muonhuoi a sangpite a cipzan masangin amate in na gam sung zosie vua a om na khuopi zosie ang imtawm ding uhi; Topa na Pasien un note ang pieh na gam sung zosie vua a om na khuopi zosie sung vuah ang imtawm ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Na galte un na khuopi zosie uh imtawm ding a, na cimaw hun sungun Topa na Pasien un ang pieh, na sung pan vua a pieng na tanute ule na tapate uh’ sa na ne ding uhi."},"54":{"text":"Note lahah mi pien hoi le a kimipisah penpen pa in zong a sanggam, a kawilai a it a zi, a si nukhia pen a tate nangawn zong an a pie nuom sih ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Na khuopite sung vuah ang ki-imtawm nading u le na galte un ang lungkhamsah nading uh hun sungah neh kitasam ding ahi ziehin ama in a neh a tate’ sa koima a hawm nuom sih ding hi."},"56":{"text":"Note lahah a ngehsuo, a cithei pen numei, ama ngehsuo-in a ci a sa a nel seng ziehin a ketaw tawh tuol a tuon nuom va-ia lo nu in zong a it a kawilai a pasal, a tanute le a tapate adingin a sunga pieng naungehte le a kalkawm pana a peikhie a naulapte nangawn a phal sih ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile a khuopite sung vuah ang ki-imtawmna le na galte un ang lungkhamsah nading hun sungah neh kitasam seng ding ahi ziehin ama in a tate a nedap ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 6:28-29; Kaa 4:10","merge":"57"},"58":{"text":"Tam laibu sunga kigiel tami thukham kammalte limtahin na zui sih vua, a vanglien, a cizathuoi min, Topa na Pasien na zatah sih uleh,"},"59":{"text":"Topa in noma le na suonlehlahte tungah a nasie le a dam thei lo gimnate le a zauhuoi natsaute tawh ang nuoicip ding hi."},"60":{"text":"Ama in na giin uh Egypt natnate ang tungsahkia ding a, tuate in na tung vuah ang bawmden ding hi."},"61":{"text":"Note ang kisuhsiet masangsie, tam thukham laibu sungah kiciemte sih nanle natna dang le gimna zosie zong Topa in na tung vuah ang tungsah ding hi."},"62":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in vana aasi za pha nan locin themno khat na hi ta ding uhi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na mang nuom sih uhi."},"63":{"text":"Ang hausah cieng ule ang punsah ciengun Topa a lungkim bang lien ma-in, ang sietsah ding cieng ule ang manthaisah ding ciengun zong Topa lungkim veve ding hi; na luo ding uh gam na lut vua kipanin ang kiphungkal ding hi."},"64":{"text":"Topa in leimong khat pan mong khat, minam zosie lahah ang thethang ding hi; noma le na pu na pate un zong a thei ngai nai lo uh singlesuong tawh kibawl pasien dangte’ na na sem ding uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tua minamte lahah lungnopna na mu sih ding vua, na ketaw uh a tatna khop ding tawlngahna mun zong na mu sih ding uhi. Khum munah Topa in lungsim patauna, mitgimna, lungsim zawngkhalnate ang pie ding hi."},"66":{"text":"Na hinkhuo uh lunghimawna tawh na om zing ding uhi; sun le zanin zau denin lungmuonna hinkhuo na nei sih ding uhi."},"67":{"text":"Na lungsim un a giin zauna le na mit un a mu ding nate’ ziehin zingmawngin, “Nitah hi leh!” na ci ding vua, nitahin zong, “Zingmawng hi leh!’” na ci ding uhi."},"68":{"text":"Na mukia nawn sih ding uhi, ci-a kang kamciemsa lampi ahi Egypt gamah Topa in tembaw tawh ang peipikia ding hi; tua sunga na galte kung vuah sila numei le sila pasal dingin na kizua ding vua, ahi vangin koima in ang lei sih ding uhi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Topa in amate tawh Horeb ah a na bawlsa a thuciemna banah Israel-te tawh Moab ah thuciemna a bawl nadinga Moses a thupieh thuciemna kammalte ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te zosie hlanin a kung vuah tam bangin a gen hi: Topa in Egypt gam sungah na mitmu-un Pharaoh tung, a silate zosie tung le a gam sung zosiete tungah a bawlna,","title":"Moab ah Thuciemna Kibawlpha"},"3":{"text":"na mit un a musa ze-etna lienpite, limte le na lamdang thupi zosiete na thei zo ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuni dongin Topa in na tung vuah thu na tel nading uh lungsim ahi a, na mu thei nading uh mit ahi a, na zah thei nading uh bil ahi zongin ang pie sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in senel gam sungah kum sawmli sung kang pui zo ta hi. Na el vua na puonte uh sie loin na kedapte uzong a sie sih hi;"},"6":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh ka hi lam nei thei nadingun neh ding anlum le dawn ding lenggazu ahi a, khamthei zu ahi zongin na ne sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tami munah nang pei ciengun ei do dingin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon le Bashan kumpipa Og ang pei uhi, ahi vangin amate i zo uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35"},"8":{"text":"Amau’ leitang i la vua, Reuben-te, Gad-te le Manasseh minam alangte tungah luo dingin i pie hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na sepna uh bangkim ah na lamzan thei nadingun tami thuciemna kammalte limtahin zui un."},"10":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un tuni-a note tawh a bawl ahi Topa na Pasien uh’ thuciemna sungah na lut thei nadingun, tuni-in ama in ama’ mi dinga ang kipsah thei nading, le na tung vuah ang ciemna le na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tungah a kiciemna bangin na Pasien uh ahi thei nadingin na minam lutangte uh, na upate uh, na uliente uh, Israel pasal zosie, na tate uh, na zite uh, na giephuol sung vua om pemtate, na sing uh ang tompieh, na tui uh ang tawipiehte a kipan note zosie tuni-in Topa na Pasien uh’ mai-ah na ding uhi.","merge":"11"},"14":{"text":"Kiciemin ka bawl tam thuciemna pen tuni-in i Topa Pasien mai-a a ding note beh tawh ka bawl ahi sih a,"},"15":{"text":"tuni-a note tawh ang omton lo mite tawh zong a bawlton ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Egypt gama i ten dan i giedan ule i nawhkhah uh minamte laikima i pei dan uh zong na thei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amau’ sil kidahhuoi, singlesuong tawh a kibawl, ngun le kham tawh a kibawl, a lah vua a om milimte na mu zo ta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Note lahah numei ahi a, pasal ahi a, innkuon ahi a, minam khat ahi zongin tua minamte’ pasien-te bie dingin Topa i Pasien kung panin a lungsim kihei om kha thei ding hi. Note lahah a gunei singhui khat huihla-in a ga khalawng khat ang ga kha thei ding hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33"},"19":{"text":"Tami kiciemna kammal a za zosie in a lungsim vuah amau le amau thupha kipie tawmin, “Lungkhautahin ka gamtat vangin ka suohta veve ding hi,” a ci mi ang om kha ding hi. (Tua ahi ciengin mihoi le misie, a kibangin gimna a tungsah ding hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Amau’ langkhatah meikhu bangin Topa’ lungthahna le thangsietna kitungto ding ahi ziehin Topa in amate a maisah nuom sih ding hi. Tami laibu sunga a kigiel samsietna zosie amate tungah tung ding a, Topa in mun vannuoi panin amau’ min phiet maimang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam thukham laibu sunga kigiel samsietna thuciemte tawh kituohin tuosietna thuoh dingin Topa in Israel minam zosie lah panin amate a tuomin a la ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mai lamah ang khang ding na tate ule gamlapi pana ang pei gamdang mite in tua gam kisietna le Topa in a tunsah gimnate a mu ding vua,"},"23":{"text":"a leitang zosie uh kaat le ci tawh a katum, khaici kivaw lo, bangma a po lo, lopa zong a po zo lona mun, a sinso zieha Topa in a suhsiet Sodom le Gomorrah, Admah le Zeboiim-te’ kisietna tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24-25"},"24":{"text":"Amate le leitung minam zosie in lamdang a sa ding vua, “Bang zieha Topa in tami gam ahi ci bawl va-ia adiei? Tam lungthahna lienpi a piengsah khu bang ahi ta diei?” a ci tahtah ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mite in, “Tam pen Egypt pana amate a peipi lai-in amate tawh a bawl, a pu a pate’ Pasien ahi, Topa’ thuciemna amate in nuasie-in,"},"26":{"text":"a thei ngai lo uh pasien dangte le ama in amate tunga a pieh lo pasien dangte langah a kihei vua, tuate’ na semin a bieh zieh uh ahi hi;"},"27":{"text":"tuaci’n khum gamah Topa’ lungthahna a tung a, tam laibu sunga kigiel samsietna zosie tua leitangah a tungsah hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in sinsona, lungham thangpaina tawh a leitang panun a notmang a, tuni-a i mu bangun gam dangah amate a notmang hi,” ci ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Thusimte Topa i Pasien-a’ ahi a, ahi vangin ang kilah thute ahile eite le i tate-a’ hi-in, tam thukham sunga thu zosie i zui zing ding uh ahi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na mai vua ka koi tami thuphate le samsietna zosiete na tung vuah ang tun ciengin, Topa na Pasien un ang nawkhietna minam zosiete lahah tam thute phawhkia-in,","title":"Pasien’ Thumanna Kigen"},"2":{"text":"tuni-a note kang thupieh bangin Topa na Pasien uh kungah noma le na suon na hlahte na kilekia vua, na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh ama’ thute na man uleh,"},"3":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un hing nuomsa sah kia-in na tung vuah lainatna ang nei ding a, ang thethangna mi zosie lah panin Topa na Pasien un ang kaikhawmkia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Leimong khat nangawnah nang kinawdawh nan ule Topa na Pasien un tua mun panin ang khawm ding a, ang peipikia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na pu na pate uh’ neisa gamah hing peipi-in tua gam na luo ding uhi; ama in na pu na pate uh sanga a citheizaw le a pungzaw-in note ang siem ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua banah na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh Topa na Pasien uh itin na hin thei nadingun, Topa na Pasien un noma le na suon na hlahte’ lungsim tep ang tanpieh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un ang bawlsie na galte ule na langte tungah tami samsietna zosie ang tungsah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ thu na mangkia ding vua, tuni-a kang gen ama’ thupiehte zosie na zui ding uhi,"},"9":{"text":"tuale Topa na Pasien un na sepnate zosie vuah, na sung pan vua piengte, na ganhonte sung pana piengte, na leitang pan vua piengte zosie-ah na dau uh ang peisah ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile na pu na pate uh tungah ama a lungkim bangin note tungah zong Topa ang lungkimkia ding a,"},"10":{"text":"tuale na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh Topa lamah na kihei ziehun tami thukham laibu sunga a kigiel ama’ thupiehte le ama’ thukhamte zuina tawh Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na man uleh ama in ang daupeisah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A tahtahin tuni-a kang gen tami thupieh pen note adingin a hamsa seng sih a, zuila ding zong ahi sih hi.","title":"Hinna Teel ding Hanthotna"},"12":{"text":"“I zah thei nading ule i zui thei nadingun vantungah koi va kato-in ei va lahpieh ta ding ahei?” na ci thei nadingun vantunga om ahi sih hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tua thu za-in i zui thei nadingun koi in tuipi galkhat kantanin ei lahpieh ding ahei?” na ci thei nadingun zong tuipi gala om ahi kan sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Om lo hi, a thu na kung mama vuah a om hi; a thu na zui thei nadingun na kam sung ule na lungsim sung vuah a om hi.","ref":"Rom 10:6-8"},"15":{"text":"En un, tuni-in na mai vuah hinna le nopsahna, sina le sietna ka koi zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh itna, ama’ lampite totna, ama’ thupiehte, a thukhamte le a ngaina kipte zuina tawh, tuni-in na kung vua kang gen Topa na Pasien uh’ thupiehnate na man uleh, note nungta-in pungin gou luo dinga na lut nading uh gam sungah Topa na Pasien un thupha ang pie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin na lungsim uh kihei-in a thugen za loin pasien dangte mai-a a kun ding le a na a sem dinga na lampiel uleh,"},"18":{"text":"keima in tuni-in note kungah kang gen hi, note na mangthai ding uhi; Jordan galkai-in a lut ding le a nei dinga na peina uh gam sungah sauvei teng loin na mangthai ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in tuni-in na langkhat vuah teci a pang dingin vanpi le leipi ka ko a, na mai vuah hinna le sina, thuphate le samsietnate ka koi zo hi. Noma le na suon na hlahte uh a hin thei nadingin nuntahna teel unlen,"},"20":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh itin a thu mangin, ama tukip un; azieh pen Topa in na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tungah a pieh dinga a ciemsa gamah na ten thei nadingun note adingin tua khu nuntahna le khansauna ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 12:7; 26:3; 28:13"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te zosie kungah tam thute a unpi-a a gen zaw ciengin","title":"Joshua in Moses’ Za Luo"},"2":{"text":"ama in a kung vuah, “Tu-in kei kum za le kum sawmni ka pha ta hi. Dei bangin ka pia zo nawn sih a, Topa in ka kungah, ‘Tami Jordan gal na kai sih ding hi,’ ei ci zo hi.","ref":"Gam 20:12"},"3":{"text":"Topa na Pasien mama uh na mai vuah ang galkai ding hi. Ama in na mai vuah tam minamte susie ding a, amate na suonmang ding uhi. Topa’ kamciemsa bangin na mai vuah Joshua a galkai ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in Amor-te’ kumpi Sihon le Og tung le a gam uh tunga a bawl bangin amate tungah zong a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35"},"5":{"text":"Topa in na tung vuah amate ang pie ding a, na kung vua kang thupieh zosie tawh a kituohin amate tungah na bawl ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Thahat unlen hangsan un; zau sih unlen amate giing sih un. Azieh pen no ang zawpi pa khu Topa na Pasien uh ahi hi; ama in note ang cimaw sah sih ding a, zong ang nuasie sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in Joshua hlanin Israel-te zosie’ mitmu-in ama kungah tam bangin a gen hi: “Thahat inlen hangsan in, bangzieh ahei cile Topa in a pu a pate uh tungah pieh dinga a ciemsa gamah tam mite zawpi ding khu nangma na hi hi; nangma in amate khum gam na luosah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na masanga a peipa khu Topa ahi hi. Nangma tawh ama ang om ding hi; ama in nang hing cimawsah loin, zong hing nuasie lo ding hi. Zau sinlen lungkie sin,” a ci hi.","ref":"Josh 1:5; Heb 13:5"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in tam thukham giel a, tuaci’n Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo Levi’ tapa siempute le Israel upa zosie tungah a pie hi.","title":"Kum Sagi Siela Kisim ding Thukham"},"10":{"text":"Moses in tam bangin amate thu a pie hi: “A kisesa leiba kimaisah kum ahi kum sagi a cin siel, buh pawi hunin","ref":"Thkna 15:1; 16:13-15"},"11":{"text":"ama’ teel nading mun Topa na Pasien uh mai-ah a kilaa dingin Israel-te zosie ang pei ciengun, amau’ zahin Israel-te zosie mai-ah tam thukham na sim ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in za-in Topa na Pasien uh zatah a, tami thukham sunga kammal zosie limtahin a zui thei nadingun nupi, papi, naupangte le na khuo sung vua a teng pemtate khawm in."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n tami thukham a thei nai lo a tate un zong za-in, Jordan galkai-in na nei ding uh gama na ten laisie uh na Topa na Pasien uh zatah dan ding ang thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Na si ding hun ang nai ta hi; ama ka sawl thei nadingin Joshua hing hlan inlen, kikhopna puonbuh sungah nangma zong hing om in,” ci hi. Tuaci’n Moses le Joshua pei-in kikhopna puonbuh sungah a om vua,","title":"Moses le Joshua in Pasien’ Thuhilna Sang"},"15":{"text":"puonbuh kotpi gei meii khuomah Topa kilang hi; puonbuh kotah meii khuom a kitung hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses kungah, “Na pu na pate tawh a lumton bai ding na hi ta hi. Tua ciengin a pei nading uh gam sunga gamdang pasien-te tawh tam mite a pahtat ding uhi; amate in kei ei nuasie-in amate tawh ka bawlsa ka thuciemte a palsat ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin a tung vuah ka sin a so ding hi. Keima in amate nuasie-in ka mai ka phuol ding hi; amate olno tahin nehtumin a om ding vua, amate tungah a zauhuoi gimna tampi a tung ding hi. Khum ni ciengin, ‘Eite lahah i Pasien ang op lo ziehin tami gimnate i tunga ang tung hi lo amah?’ a ci ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin pasien dangte lamah a kihei ziehun a gamtatnasa uh gitlona zosie ziehin ka mai ka phuol tahtah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in tami la giel inlen, Israel-te tungah hil in; Israel-te langkhatah kei dinga teci a suoh dingin a kam sung vuah tami la mop in."},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen a pu a pate uh kungah kiciemin ka khapsa bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gamah amate tunpi siengin, tuaci’n amate in an khamtahin ne-in a thau milmel zaw ciengun, pasien dangte lamah kihei-in a na uh semin kei ei simmaw ding vua, ka thuciemna zong a susie ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"A tung vuah a zauhuoi gimna tampi a tun ciengin a langkhat vuah tami la teci-in a pang ding hi, azieh pen a suonlehlate’ kam sung panin tami la mangngil thei loin a om ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile keima in amate pieh dinga ka ciemsa gamah ka tut masang, tu nangawnin zong bang bawl nuom uh ci ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ni ma-in Moses in tami la gielin Israel-te a hil hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Nun’ tapa Joshua sawl a, “Thahat inlen hangsan in, bangzieh ahei cile amate pieh dinga ka ciemsa leitang tungah Israel-te na peipi ding hi; nangma tawh kang om ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 27:23; Josh 1:6"},"24":{"text":"Moses in a tawp dongin laibu khat sungah tami thukham kammalte a giel zaw ciengin,"},"25":{"text":"Moses in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo Levi-te thu pie a,"},"26":{"text":"“Tami thukham laibu la unlen Topa na Pasien uh’ thuciemna singkuong gei-ah koi un; na langkhat vuah teci dingin khum munah omsah un."},"27":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile bangza taha a ledo mi le a lungkhauh mi na hi uh ahei ci kang thei hi.
