Ka hin sung bawna na lah vuah Topa ledo na hi uleh ka si nua ciengin bang zatahin na ledo kan zaw lai ding vuoi izaw!"},"28":{"text":"Tami kammalte amau’ zahin genin, a langkhat vuah teci-a pang dingin vanpi le leipi ka ko thei nadingin keima kungah na minam upate ule na ulien zosie uh hing khawm un."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen ka si nua ciengin nang siet gamtat valon ding vua, kang thupieh lampi panin na piel ding lam uh ka thei hi. Mailam hun ciengin Topa muna-ah siet gamtatin na khut utawh na bawlsate uh ziehin ama lungthahsah ding na hi ziehun na tung vuah gimna ang tung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses in a kikhawm Israel mi buppi’ zahin tami la guite a dawng tawp dongin a sut hi:","title":"Moses’ La"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantungte aw, na ngai un, kang hopi ding uhi; ka kam pana ka thugente leitung in za taheh."},"2":{"text":"Guomal bangin ka thuhilte phi-in, daicim bangin ka thugente kie hinlen; lo dawng tunga guophi le ankung tunga guozu bang taheh."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ min ka tangko ding hi; eite’ Pasien tungah vanglietna pie un!"},"4":{"text":"Ama suongpi hi a, a nasepte bukimin a lampite zosie khu dihtatna ahi hi. A zuou lo thuman Pasien ahi a, midih le mi thutang ahi hi;"},"5":{"text":"hinanle a letat a tate in ama tungah gamtat sie-in, amate pen a lampiel le a lungkawi khang mite ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mimaw, mingolte aw, tam bangin Topa thuh ding na hi uh amah? Note ang piengsah, ang siem, ang kipsah na pa uh hi lo amah?"},"7":{"text":"Hun luite phawh unlen, muol ei khupsan hunte lungngai un; na pa dong un, ama in ang theisah ding hi; na upate dong locin ang gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Sangpen Pa in minamte gou pie a, mihing ten nading mun a se ciengin, pasien-te a phaza zui-in mite’ gamgi a phut hi;","ref":"Sawl 17:26"},"9":{"text":"Topa’ tanh khu ama’ mite ahi a, Jacob khu ama kipie a tanh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in senel gamgawta munah ama a va hi. Ama in ama dalin khoi a, a mittang a diem bangin amate diemin a kem hi."},"11":{"text":"A bu tawhnawi-in a note tungah a hla a zap, a hla zahin a note a man, a hlakui tawh a note a puo muvanlai bangin,"},"12":{"text":"Topa beh in ama a pui a; ama tawh gamdang pasien omton lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in leitung a sangna-ah amate tengsah a, lo-a piengte tawh a va hi; suong kawm panin khuoizu tawh ama va a, meituh suong panin sathau a nesah hi;"},"14":{"text":"bawnghon panin bawng thaukhal, tuuhon panin tuunawi, tuunote le tuutangte’ thau tawh; Bashan bawnghonte le keelte, mangbu hoi pente tawh lengga panin lenggatui san na dawn uhi."},"15":{"text":"Jacob in khamtahin a ne hi; Jeshurun ang thau-in a keng tawh ei lepeh ta hi. Na thau ziehun na sa uh dim phitphet a, na zol sipsep uhi! Ama in ama a bawl pa Pasien nuasie a, a kihutdamna Suongpi a simmaw bawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate pen pasien dangte tawh a hazat thei nadingin a gamta vua, a kidahhuoi nate tawh ama a lungthahsah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien ahi lo dawite, a thei khah ngai lo uh pasien-te, na pu na pate un a giin lo uh, tu nai-a ang tung tha ahi, pasien-te kung po-ah biehpiehna a pie uhi.","ref":"1Cor 10:20"},"18":{"text":"Note in ang hing pa Suongpi na phawhkha ta sih vua, ang siem pa Pasien na mangngil ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in mu-in haza a, ama in a tanute le a tapate a nol hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in: Keima in a kung panun ka mai ka phuol ding a, a tawpna-ah amate bang ang suoh vuoi ka en ding h; bangzieh ahei cile amate pen a letat khang mite ahi vua, muon tah lo tate ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Pasien a hi lote tawh ka hazat nadingin ei bawl vua, a milimte utawh ei lungthahsah uhi. Tua ahi ciengin keima in mihinga sim tah lo mite tawh a hazat thei nadingun amate ka bawl ding a, a maw mama minam khat tawh ka thangpaisah ding hi.","ref":"1Cor 10:22; Rom 10:19"},"22":{"text":"Bang zieh ahei cile ka lungthahna mei bangin kuong a, Misikhuo dongah a kuong hi; tua in leitung le a tunga piengte a valtum a, muol le tang bulpite a kuongsah hi."},"23":{"text":"A tung vuah gimna ka khol ding a, a langkhat vuah ka thaltangte ka zang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate gilkielin a sigam ding vua, a sa mama meikuong le a siehuoi natna in amate valtum ding hi. A pet dingin a ha hiem gamsate, a tu dingin gu a nei gulte ka sawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Gawldung lahah namsau in amate thatgam ding a, tuaci’n innkhan sungah zauna lienpi om ding hi. Azieh pen tangval le ngahnu, nawi tep nausente, samkangte tawh a that ton ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate thethangin mihing lah panin a kiphaw khahna uh phiet ding ka ngaisun hi;"},"27":{"text":"ahi vangin alangte in a ngaisun khiel vua, “Ka khut un guol a zo hi. Tam teng zosie a sem khu Topa ahi sih hi,” hing ci kha ding ahi ziehun galte in ei phin ding ka zau hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Ngaisutna nei lo minam ahi uhi; a sung vuah theitelna om lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Mipil hi pawse uleh, tam thute a thei ding uhi; a tawpna-ah bang pieng ding ci a khinkhai thei ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"A Suongpi un amate zua sih hinlen, Topa in amate piekhie sih leh, bangci-in mi khat in mi tulkhat gamdelin, mi ni in mi tul sawm taisah zo ding ahei?"},"31":{"text":"Eite’ Suongpi le amau’ suongpi kibang lo hi; i galte mimaw ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"A lenggui uh Sodom lenggui ahi a, Gommorah lengga um pana ang kipan ahi hi; a lengga uzong a gunei lengga ahi a, a bawhte zong a kha hi."},"33":{"text":"A lenggazu uh gulpi gu le muoltan gupha tawh kibang hi."},"34":{"text":"Tami khu ka kungah kikhol a, ka gou kholna sunga kikoi hi lo amah?"},"35":{"text":"Phulahna le thuhkiana khu kei-a’ hi a, a hun ciengin amate a keng uh a taal ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile a tuosiet hun ding uh nai mama ta a, a siet nading uh mallangtahin a tung hi.","ref":"Rom 12:19; Heb 10:30"},"36":{"text":"A vang bei lam ule sila le a suohta koima a op lo lam uh a mu ciengin, Topa in ama’ mite dih a tangsah ding a, ama’ nasemte tungah lainatna a nei ding hi.","ref":"Late 135:14"},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tam bangin ci ding hi: A kibuhna uh suongpi,"},"38":{"text":"a biehpiehna uh sathau ne-in, dawn thei a biehna uh a dawn amau’ pasien-te hei-ah om uh ahei? Tuate thosahin kihusah unlen, na kidalna hisah un!"},"39":{"text":"Tu-in thei un; kei, keima nangawn ama ka hi hi. Kei simlo pasien dang koima a om sih hi. Ka that a, ka hingsah hi; ka liemsah a, ka damsah hi; ka khut sung panin a hunkhie zo koima om lo hi."},"40":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile vantung lamah khut lamto-in tam bangin ka kiciem hi: Keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin,"},"41":{"text":"a te lihleh ka namsau tatin, thukhen dingin tua ka mat ciengin; ka galte tungah phu ka la ding a, ei mudate ka thuhkia ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Ka thaltangte si ka khamsah ding a, ka namsau in satah a nawmval ding hi. Tuate pen a samsau galte, a kithat mite le a kiman mite’ sisan pan hi ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Vante, ama’ mite aw, phat unlen, no pasien zosiete aw, ama bie un! Bangzieh ahei cile a ma in a tate’ sisan phu la dinghi; ama in a langte tungah phu a la ding hi. Ama a mudate thuhkia ding a, ama’ mite adingin tua gam a siensuo ding hi.","ref":"Rom 15:10; Kln 19:2"},"44":{"text":"Moses pei a, mite’ zahin ama le Nun’ tapa Joshua in tam lamalte zosie a sut uhi."},"45":{"text":"Moses in tam lamal zosie a sut zaw ciengin,"},"46":{"text":"ama in a kung vuah tam bangin a gen hi: Tuni-a na kung vuah teci panga kang gen tami thute zosie ciemte un; na tate un tami thukham kammalte limtahin a zui thei nadingun thupieh bangin gen un."},"47":{"text":"Tami pen note dingin thu mawhna ahi sih a, na hinna uh ahi a, luo dinga Jordan gal na kaina uh gam sungah ahi zongin tami thu ziehin sawt veipi na nungta ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Khum ni mama-in Topa in Moses tungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Moses a Si ding Kigenkhol"},"49":{"text":"“Jericho gal lam, Moab gam sunga Nebo Muol le Abarim muolvum ah kato unlen, Israel-te’ tan dinga ka pieh Canaan gam va gal-et ta un;"},"50":{"text":"Hor Muol tungah na sanggampa Aaron si-in a mite tawh a kigawm bangin, nang zong na katona muolvumah na si ding a, na mite tawh na kigawm ding hi;"},"51":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Zin gam, Kadesh khuo gei-a Meribah tui phuol, Israel-te lahah nei upna na hlasuo ta a, Israel-te lahah ka siengthona na kemcing ta sih hi."},"52":{"text":"A gamlapi panin khumi gam na gal-et bep ding a, ahi vangin Israel-te tunga ka pieh gam sungah na lut sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 27:12-14; Thkna 3:23-27"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam pen Pasien’ mi ahi Moses in a si masanga Israel-te thupha a piehna ahi hi.","title":"Israel-te Tungah Moses’ a Tawpna Thuphapiehna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in: Sinai panin Topa ang pei a, Seir panin ni bangin eite tungah ang suoh hi. Paran Muol panin ama ang tang a, misiengtho tul tampite tawh ama omton hi; ama’ ziet lamah ama’ mihonpite om uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hi tahtah hi, mite lahah ang ki-angvan pa aw, nangma khut sungah ama’ misiengtho zosie a om hi; nangma kalsuonna zui-in amate ang pei vua, amate in nangma tung panin lamlahna a nga uhi."},"4":{"text":"Jacob mihonte nei dingin Moses in thukham khat ko ei pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Mipi’ makaite kikhawmin Israel minam zosie a kikhop ciengun, Jeshurun ah kumpi khat a pieng hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’ mite a tawm vangun Reuben-te nungta hinlen, si vawt sih heh."},"7":{"text":"Tuale ama in Judah thu ah tam bangin a gen hi: Topa aw, Judah’ aw ngai inlen, a mite kungah peipi in; ama adingin a khutte khausah inlen, a galte a dona ah a hupa-in pang in."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Levi thu ah tam bangin a gen hi: Levi tungah na Thummim pie inlen, na midih pa tungah na Urim pie in. Massah-a na zelah mi pa khu Meribah tuite-ah na kihaupi pa ahi hi;","ref":"Pei 17:7; 28:30; Gam 20:13"},"9":{"text":"a nu le a pa kungah, “Amate thuse sing,” a ci pa ahi hi: ama in a sanggamte thuse loin, a tate a nelsie hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate in na thu a mang vua, na thuciemna zong a zui uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in Jacob tungah na ngaina kipte a hil vua, Israel-te tungah na thukhamte a hil uhi; amate in na masangah panamtui a koi ding vua, na maitam tungah meihal biehna buppi a pie ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, ama’ nate thupha pie inlen, ama’ khutsuote sanpieh in; ama’ galte’ kawng hiatawng inlen, ama mudate a thokia zo lo dingin sugawp in."},"12":{"text":"Ama in Benjamin thu ah: Topa in a it mipa hlamuongin a om hi. Sangpen Pasien in sun tungtawn ama kemin, ama in a liengko kikalah a it mipa a omsah hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in Joseph thu ah: Topa in ama’ leitang, tung lama a om vantung letsong hoi pente le nei lam-a om tui thuhte tawh;"},"14":{"text":"ni hanga a pieng ga hoi pente le hla hanga a pieng a hoi pente tawh;"},"15":{"text":"tanglai muolte tunga a pieng a hoi a tuituoh pente le tawntung muolte’ hauna tawh;"},"16":{"text":"leitunga letsong a hoi pente a dim le Sinai muol tunga a teng pa’ angvanna tung taheh. Joseph’ lu tungah tam teng zosie tung hinlen, a sanggam pasalte lahah ulien pa’ lu tungah tung taheh."},"17":{"text":"Bawngtang bangin a tacil thahat hi! Ama’ ki, zangsiel’ ki tawh kibang hi; ama in tua a kite tawh mi pih ding a, leimong dongah amate a notmang ding hi; sim zawh lo Ephaim-te tua bang ahi a, sim zawh lo Manasseh-te zong tua bangma ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in Zebulun thu ah: Zebulun aw, na pusuona-ah kipah in; Issachar aw, na puonbuh sungah kipah in."},"19":{"text":"Amate in a muol vuah mite a hlan ding uhi; amate in khum munah a man biehpiehna pie ding uhi; azieh pen amate in tuipi tung le senel tunga a kiphuol goute a ciemkha uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in Gad thu ah: Gad a liensah pa in thupha nga taheh! Humpi bangin Gad a kuol hi; ama in a ban le a luzang a ehbal hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in ama adingin mun hoipen a teel a,. azieh pen ama dingin a makaite’ tanh kikoi pieh hi; minam makaite’ ngaza ma ama zong kingasah a, ama in mipi makai semin, Topa’ thutang le Israel-te ading ngaina kipte a bawlpieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in Dan thu ah: Dan pen Bashan pana dieng vazawh humpi no ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in Naphtali thu ah: Naphtali aw, maipha tawh nuomsa-in, a bukim Topa’ thupha nei inlen, na gam dingin tumlam le leitaw lam na nei in."},"24":{"text":"Ama in Asher thu ah: Asher in tapa dangte sangin thupha nga zaw taheh. A sanggamte’ angvan hi hinlen, a gam sungah olive thau dimlet taheh."},"25":{"text":"Na kotgolh zawlte sia le sumngo tawh kibawl hi ding hi; na hin laisie-in na thahatna khu tua bang ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Jeshurun aw, nang ang hu dingin van tunga a tuong a lietna tawh vanpi-a om, Pasien tawh a kibang koima dang om lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in tangtawng Pasien zo gawpin tanglai hatnate a vatmai a, na galte na mai-ah naw dawhin, “Susie un!” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te hlamuongin teng ding a, Jacob’ tenna mun pen a buoi sih ding hi. Vantung in van daitui a khiehna mun, an le lenggazu pienna gamah a teng ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel aw, nang mi nuomsa na hi hi! Nang ang kipanpina lum le na guolzawna namsau ahi, Topa in nang banga a hutdam mi koi om ahei? Na galte in hing mai-etin, na kung ang pei ding vua, tuaci’n note in a elzang uh na tuoncil ding uhi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moab zangleite panin Jericho tawh kigalsai Nebo Muol, Pisgah dawnah Moses a peito hi. Topa in gam zosie, Gilead panin Dan cieng dong,","title":"Moses Si-in Moab Gamah Kivui"},"2":{"text":"Naphtali gam zosie, Ephraim gam le Manasseh gam, Judah gam zosie Nitumna lam Tuipi dong,"},"3":{"text":"Negeb le lutu kung khuopi kuom a kici Jericho panin Zoar cieng dong ama lah hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Tam gam, keima in Abraham, Isaac le Jacob tungah kiciemin, ‘Na suon na hlahte tungah kang pie ding hi,’ ka ci leitang ahi hi; keima in na mit tawh kang musah zo ta a, hizongle khum munah na galkai sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 12:7; 26:3; 28:13"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ thupieh bangin Moab gam sungah Topa’ nasem Moses a si hi."},"6":{"text":"Beth-peor tawh kigalsai Moab gam kuom khatah ama kivui a, hinanle koima in tuni dongin a kivuina mun thei lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Moses a si-in kum za le kum sawmni pha hi; a mit miel nai loin a tha zong kie nai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni sawmthum sung Israel-te in Moab zanglei-ah Moses a kaa uhi; tua ciengin Moses zieha kaana le mauna teng a veng hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in ama tungah a khut ngam zo ahi ziehin Nun’ tapa Joshua lungsim pilna tawh kidim hi; tuale Israel-te in ama’ thu a mang vua, Topa’ thupiehsa bangin a gamta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Israel mite sungah Moses banga Topa in kimaituo-a a thei kamsang dang koima om lo hi.","ref":"Pei 33:11"},"11":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah Topa in Pharaoh le a nasem zosie le a gam buppi tungah lim le na lamdangte bawl dinga a sawl ama a dem zo koima a om sih a,"},"12":{"text":"Moses in a thahat a nasepnate zosie le a zauhuoi a vanglietna a lahnate zosie, Israel mi zosie’ muna-a a bawl ahi hi."}}}}},"6":{"info":{"name":"Joshua","shortname":"Josh","abbr":[],"desc":"Joshua laibu (the book of joshua)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses a si zaw ciengin Topa in Moses’ a hupa Nun tapa Joshua hopi-in,","title":"Pasien in Joshua a Sawlna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka nasempa Moses si zo hi. Tu-in ding inlen nangma le tam mite zosie in Jodan gun kantanin Israel-te tunga ka pieh gam sungah pei un."},"3":{"text":"Moses tunga ka ciemsa ma bangin na ketaw in a totna mun popo nangma kang pie zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Senel gam le tam Lebanon gama kipanin gun lienpi Euphrates gun dong, nitumna lama Tuipi Lien lam, Hit-te leitang zosie nangma’ gam hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na hin sung tungtawnin koima in ang langpan zo sih ding hi. Moses tawh ka opton bangin nang tawh zong kang om ton ding hi; kang tamasah sih ding a, zong kang nuasie sih ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:24-25; Thkna 31:6, 8; Heb 13:5"},"6":{"text":"Thahat inlen hang in; azieh pen na pu na pate uh pieh dinga ka ciemsa leitang tam mite na luosah ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:6, 7, 23"},"7":{"text":"Tha hatin hang inlen, ka nasempa Moses ang pieh thukham zosie tawh kizui-in na gamtat ding limtahin ngaisun in; na peina popo-ah na lawcin thei nadingin zietlam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin piel sin."},"8":{"text":"Na kam le tami thukham laibu na kilawisah sih ding hi; tua sunga kigiel teng zosie tawh kizui-in limtaha na gamtat thei nadingin sun le zanin na lung ngaingai ding hi. Tua hile na ma vang ding a, na lawcing ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam bangin thu kang pie hi: Tha hat inlen hang in. Zau sinlen lungkie sin, azieh pen na peina popo-ah nangma tawh Topa na Pasien ang om hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in mipi uliente thupie a,","title":"Busim Dinga Kithawina"},"11":{"text":"“Giephual ah pei unlen, mite tam bangin thupie un: ‘Na lam-an ding uh kiging un; azieh pen Topa na Pasien un na nei ding vua ang pieh leitang a luo dingin ni thum sungin tam Jordan a galkai ding na hi uhi,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Joshua in Reuben-te, Gad-te, Manasseh minam alangte kungah,"},"13":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasien un tawlngahna hing pie-in tam leitang ang pie ding hi, ci-in Topa’ nasem Moses a thupieh phawh un."},"14":{"text":"Moses in Jordan gal khat a ang pieh leitangah na zite, na tasente ule na ganhingte a om ding uhi. Ahi vangin note lahah galhang zosie in hiem tawi-in Jordan kantanin na sanggamte mai-ah pei-in,"},"15":{"text":"Topa in no ang pieh bangin na sanggamte uh tungah tawlngahna pie-in, Topa na Pasien un amate a pieh leitang a luo masangsie-un na panpi ding uhi. Tua ciengin na leitang vuah kilekia-in, Topa’ nasem Moses in Jordan gal nisuona lamah ang pieh leitang na luo ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 32:28-32; Thkna 3:18-20; Josh 22:1-6"},"16":{"text":"Amate in tam bangin Joshua a dawng uhi: “Kote in nei thupieh zosie ka sem ding vua, nei sawlna popo-ah ka pei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Sil bangkimah Moses thu ka man bang tehtehun na thu ka mang ding uhi. Topa na Pasien in Moses a ompi bangin nang zong hing ompi taheh."},"18":{"text":"Na thupiehnate a ledo le na kammal a mang lo poma, na thupieh popo a mang lo poma kithat ding hi. Thahatin na han ding beh ahi hi,” a ci uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Nun’ tapa Joshua in Shittim panin thukan ding mi ni sawl a, “Pei-in gam va en ta unlen, a diehdiehin Jericho khuo va en ta un,” a ci hi. Ama gel zong pei pai-in Rahab kici numei pahtat khat’ inn ah tungin a gieh uhi.","title":"Jericho ah Thukante Kisawl (Heb 11:31)","ref":"Heb 13:11; Jas 2:25"},"2":{"text":"Jericho kumpipa kungah, “Gam sung en dingin Israel-te pawlkhat tuzanin ang tung hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jericho kumpipa in Rahab kungah mi sawl a, “Na inn sunga ang tum, na kunga ang tung mite hing peipi in. Azieh pen gam buppi thu a kandap dinga ang pei uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle tua numei in mi nite la-in a phuoldap hi. Tua ziehin ama in, “Hima hi, tua mite ka kungah ang pei ma uhi, ahi vangin hei sung pana hing kipan gel ahei ka thei sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Kulkotpi a kikha hun khuomiel ciengin tua mite a peikhie uhi. Tua mite hei lam manaw gel ahei ci zong ka thei tuon sih hi. Ama gel del meng un, azieh pen na pha lai ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in innkhum zangah tua mite peipi to-in butu kung a lomloma kikoina munah a phuol hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite in Jordan lamah tanmun dong delin a delte a peikhiet zaw lienun kulkotpi kikha pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama gel a lup masangin innkhum zanga a kung vuah Rahab kato a, tua gel kungah,"},"9":{"text":"“ Topa in tam leitang note ang pie zo hi, ci ka thei a, tuaci’n kang giing mama vua, tam gam sunga teng mi zosie zong na mai vuah a zausi sieng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt panin nang peikhiet lai-un Topa in na mai vuah San Tuipi a kansahna le Jordan galkhata om Amor-te’ kumpi nite ahi Sihon le Og tungah na bawlnate uh ka za zo uhi.","ref":"Pei 14:21; Gam 21:21-35"},"11":{"text":"Tam thu ka zah behun ka lungkie vua, note ziehin a koimapo tungah hanna kici a om ta sih hi. Topa na Pasien uh pen tunglam van le neilam leitung Pasien ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin tu-in na tung vua kang dih gamtat bangin no zong ko innkuon tungah nang dihtat nadingun, Topa’ minin ka kungah hing kiciem unlen ciemtena dihtah khat ei pie un."},"13":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte, ka sanggam numeite, le amate tawh a kisai zosie ei hinkhawi pieh unlen, sina panin ka hinna uh ei hunkhie un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama gel in tua nu kungah, “Nangma’ hinna khu kogel’ hinna ahi hi! Tami ka nasep uh nei sawmsiet sih po nah leh Topa in ko tungah tami leitang ei pieh ciengin na tungah migitah le muonhuoi tahin kang gamta ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rahab in tawlet panin khauhuol tawh ama gel a khiesuh hi, bang ding ahei cile ama’ inn pen khuopikul pulam panga kilam ahi a, khuopikul sungah ama a teng hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua nu in ama gel kungah, “Muol tung lam zuonin pei ta gel in, tua hile ang nuadelte tawh na kituoh sih ding gel hi. Ang delte ang kilekia masangsie tua munah ni thum sung kiphuol gel in; tua ciengin na pei nading vuah na pei thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Mite in tua nu kungah, “Tam gam kang sim vua, nei khaisuhna tami tawlet-ah tam khauhuol san na na khi sih a, na inn sunga na nu le na pa, na sanggam pasalte, le na innkuonpi zosie na na khop sih leh, na tunga nei kiciemsah tami kiciemna panin ka peng ding uhi.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Na inn sung kotkhah panin mi khatpo pusuohin lam dungah a vahkawi a, sina a tuo leh ama’ sina tungtangah ama in maw puo ding a, ko maw ka peng ding uhi; ahi vangin inn sunga na ompi uh mi khatpo tungah a khut hlangkha ang op leh ama sina tungtangah maw ka puo ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanle tu-a kogel’ nasepnate nei gen leh nei kiciemsah tam kiciemna panin ka peng ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in, “ Na gen bang gelin hi taheh,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in tua gel a sawl dawh a, ama gel a pei ta uhi. Tua ciengin ama in tawlet-ah khauhuol san a khi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama gel dingkhie-in muol tung lamah a pei vua, a delte a kilekia masangsie-in khum munah ni thum sung a om uhi. A delte in lam tungtawnin a sui vua, bangma a mu sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin muol tung panin mi nite a kumsuhkia uhi. Ama gel zong galkai-in, Nun’ tapa Joshua kung a tung uhi; a tung vua a pieng zothu sie a gen uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama gel in Joshua kungah, “ Topa in leitang zosie i khut sungah ei pie tahtah zo hi; tua tham loin eite mai-ah gam sunga teng mi zosie a lungtawp sieng uhi,” a ci uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A zing ciengin Joshua tho bai-in Israel-te zosie tawh Shittim panin dingkhie-in Jordan gun a tung uhi. Khum mun a galkai masangun a gieh uhi.","title":"Israel-te Jordan Galkai"},"2":{"text":"Ni thum a cin zaw ciengin giephuolah uliente pei-in"},"3":{"text":"mite thu a pie vua, “Levi siempute in Topa na Pasien uh’ thuciemna singkuong a puoh na mu ciengun na opna mun panun dingkhie-in na zui ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tami lampi zui ngai nai lo na hi ziehun na pei nading uh lampi na thei nading uh ahi hi. Ahi vangin noma le thukham singkuong kikalah mun awng tong tulni bang om ding hi; a gei-ah pei sih un,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in mite kungah, “No le no kisiensuo un; azieh pen Topa in zing ciengin na lah vuah na lamdang ang bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Joshua in siempute kungah, “Thuciemna singkuong puo unlen mite mai-ah peisuoh un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n thuciemna singkuong puo-in mite mai-ah a pei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah, “Amate in Moses ka ompi ma bangin nang zong kang ompi ding lam a thei nadingun Israel-te zosie’ muna-ah tawisang kang kipan ta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute kungah, ‘Jordan tuite gei-ah na tun ciengun Jordan tui sungah pia loin ding den un,’ ci-in thu na pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Israel-te kungah, “Ei nai unlen Topa na Pasien uh’ kammalte ngai un,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Joshua in, “Na lah vuah a hing Pasien omin ama in na mai panun pel loin Canaan-te, Hit-te, Perez-te, Girgash-te, Amor-te, le Jebus-te a nawkhietna tami thu tawh na thei ding uhi:"},"11":{"text":"Leitung zosie Topa’ thuciemna singkuong khu na masang uh Jordan lui sungah pei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in Israel minamte sung panin nam khatah mi khat ta, mi sawm le ni teel un."},"13":{"text":"Leitung buppi’ Topa ahi Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute’ ketaw in Jordan tuite a totkhah ciengin, a tunglam pana a luongsuh Jordan tuite khawl ding hi; tuate lom khatin a kicieng ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Jordan galkai dingin a puon buh panun mite a dinkhiet ciengun mite mai-ah thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute a pei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Anlah hun sung tungtawnin Jordan lui khangin a pieu teng zosie-ah a let hi. Tuaci’n Jordan ah thuciemna singkuong puote a tung vua, tui mongah thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute’ keng a kidie ciengin,"},"16":{"text":"a sahlam pana a luongsuh tuite khawlin a gamlapi Zarethan gei-a khuopi Adam-ah lomkhatin kikholin kicieng a, Tuipi Si kici Arabah tuipi-a a luongsuhte zong a kikhentat sieng hi. Tua ciengin Jericho tawh a kigalsaina munah mite a galkai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Leigaw tungah Israel-te zosie a pei sung uh, minam bupin Jordan a kantan zawh masangsie-un, Jordan laikim leigaw tungah Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute a ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minam zosie in Jordan a galkai zaw ciengun, Topa in Joshua kungah tam bangin a gen hi:","title":"Gilgal-ah Suongtum Sawm le Ni Kiphut"},"2":{"text":"“Minam khat panin mi khat ta, mite sung panin mi sawm le ni teel in,"},"3":{"text":"tuale amate thupie inlen, ‘Jordan gun laikim siempute’ keng a dinna mun panin suongtum sawm le ni la-in puo unlen, tu zana na giena mun vuah tuate koi un,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Israel-te lah panin mi khat ta, a sesa mi sawm le nite a hlan hi."},"5":{"text":"Joshua in amate tungah, “ Topa na Pasien uh’ thuciemna singkuong opna mai Jordan gun laikimah pei unlen, Israel minamte sung panin mi khat in suongtum khat ta la-in na liengko vuah puo un."},"6":{"text":"Tam khu na lah vuah theisahna lim hi ding hi. Mailam hunah na tate un, “Tam suongtumte bang a cinopna ahei?’ ci-a ang dawh ciengun a kung vuah,"},"7":{"text":"Topa’ thuciemna singkuong mai-ah Jordan tuite kikhenkhe hi. Tua in Jordan a galkai ciengin Jordan tuite kikhenkhe a, tuaci’n tam suongtumte Israel-te adingin kumtawn phawna hi ding hi,” na ci ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Joshua’ thupiehsa bangin Israel-te a gamta uhi. Topa in Joshua kunga a gensa bangin Israel minamte a phaza tawh kizui-in Jordan gun laikim panin suongtum sawm le ni la-in tuate puo-in a galkai vua, a gienamun vuah tuate a koi uhi."},"9":{"text":"(Joshua in thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute’ keng dinnasa mun, Jordan gun laikimah suongtum sawm le ni phut hi; tuale tuni dongin khum munah tuate a omlai hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Moses in Joshua a thupiehsa zosie tawh kizui-in mite tungah a genkhie dingin Topa in Joshua tunga a thupieh zosie a unpi-in a kiman sieng masangsie, Jordan laikimah singkuong a puo siempute a ding den uhi. Mallang tahin mite a galkai uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mi zosie a galkai sieng zaw behun mite mai-ah Topa’ thukham singkuong le siempute a galkai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in amate a vaihlahsa bangin Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte in hiem tawi-in Israel-te mai-ah a galkai uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mi tul sawmli kim bang gal do dingin hiem tawi-in Jericho zanglei lam Topa mai-ah a galkai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ni-in Israel-te mai-ah Topa in Joshua lamsang hi; tuale amate in Moses a zatah bang ma-un a hinsung tungtawnun Joshua zong a zatah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah,"},"16":{"text":"“Jordan panin thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute ang peikhiet nading thu pie in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Joshua in, “Jordan panin hing peikhie un,” ci-in siempute thu a pie hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo siempute, Jordan laikim pan peikhie-in, siempute’ ketaw in leigaw a tot ciengun, Jordan tuite a luon ngaina bangin a mun ciet vuah luongkia-in a masa lai bangin a piau zosie-ah a let hi."},"19":{"text":"Hla masa a ni sawm ni-in Jordan panin mite pei to-in Jericho ni suona lam gamgi tunga om Gilgal ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"20":{"text":"Jordan pana a puoh uh suongtum sawm le nite, Joshua in Gilgal-ah phut a,"},"21":{"text":"Israel-te kungah, “Mai lam hunah na tate un a pate kungah, ‘Tam suongtumte bang a cinopna ahei?’ ci-in a dawh ciengun,"},"22":{"text":"‘Leigaw tungah Israel-te pei-in tam Jordan kantan uhi,’ ci-in na tate na theisah ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen eite i galkai zawh masangsie-un, Topa na Pasien un a na kansah San Tuipi tunga a bawl bangin, Topa na Pasien un na kantan zawh masangsie-un Jordan tuite a kangsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua khu Topa’ khut thahat mama hi, ci-in leitung mi zosie in a thei nading le Topa na Pasien uh na giin tawntung nading uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jordan nitumna gal khat a om Amor-te’ kumpi zosie le tuipi gei-a om Canaan-te’ kumpi zosie in Israel-te in a kantan zaw masang amate adingin Jordan tuite Topa in a kansahna thu a zah ciengun a lung uh kie a, Israel-te ziehin lungtawp uhi.","title":"Khangthate Tep Kitan"},"2":{"text":"Khum hunin Topa in Joshua kungah, “Meituh suong nam bawl inlen Israel-te a ni veina a tep tanpieh in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in meituh suong nam bawlin Gibeath-haaraloth ah Israel-te’ tep a tanpieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Joshua in a tep uh a tanna thu tam bang ahi hi: Egypt pan a peikhiet zaw ciengun senel gam tawnin a khuolzin hun sungun pasal galhang zosie a si sieng ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"A peikhie mi zosie a tep uh a kitan sieng zo vangin senel gam tawnin Egypt panin a khuolzin hun sung vua a suoh mi zosie a tep uh kitan nai lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel-te in Topa’ thu a ngai lona ziehun Egypt pana a peikhie minam buppi le galhang mite a si sieng dongun senel gamah kum sawmli sung khuol a zin uhi. A pu a pate uh tungah pieh dinga a ciemsa bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gam a musah lo nadingin amate tungah Topa kiciem hi.","ref":"Gam 14:28-35"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in a tep uh a tanpieh mite pen amau’ tanga ama in a piensah a tate uh ahi hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate lamkalah a tep uh kitan nai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"A minam bupun a tep uh a kitan zaw ciengin a giephuol ciet vuah a dam masangsie-un a om uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah, “Tuni-in na kung panun Egypt simmawna ka zielmang zo hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tuni dongin khum mun pen Gilgal kici hi."},"10":{"text":"Gilgal ah Israel-te giephuol satin a om laitahun tua hla a ni sawm le li ni nitahin Jericho zanglei-ah peisan pawi a bawl uhi.","title":"Gilgal ah Peisan Pawi","ref":"Pei 12:1-13"},"11":{"text":"Peisan pawi zaw a zing cieng, khum ni mama-in khum gama a pieng tol saw lo moh le bukan a ne uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khum gama piengte a neh ni-un manna a om nawn sih a, tuaci’n khum kumin Canaan leitanga pieng ante a ne ta uhi.","ref":"Pei 16:35"},"13":{"text":"Jericho khuo gei-ah Joshua a tun ciengin a khuodah leh, a khut sungah namsau dawsa-in ama’ mai-a a ding mi khat a mu hi. Ama kungah Joshua pei-in, “Nang ko pawl na hiei, ahi sihle ka langte’ pawl na hiei,” a ci hi.","title":"Joshua’ Mangmuna"},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “ Koima’ pawl ka hi sih hi; Topa galkapte’ galkapmangpa dinga ang pei ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Joshua lei-ah bawhsuhin bie a, ama kungah, “Ka Topa in a nasempa keima bang ei sawl nuom na hei?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa galkapte’ galkapmangpa in Joshua kungah, “Na keng panin na kedap sutdawh in, azieh pen na dinna mun a siengtho ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ma bangin Joshua a gamta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Israel-te ziehin Jericho kulpi a sunglam le a pulam kikhacip hi; koima pusuoh thei lo, sungtum thei lo hi.","title":"Jericho Kila-in Kisusie"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah, “En vawi, na khut sungah a kumpipa le a galhangte tawh Jericho khuo kang pie zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuopi kimvelin pei-in galhang zosie in khuopi khatvei kimvel ding uhi. Tua bangin ni guh sung na bawl ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Siempu sagi in thuciemna singkuong mai-ah tuutang ki pengkul sagi tawi ding uhi. A ni sagi ni-in khuopi sagi vei kimvelin siempute in pengkul tum ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuutang ki sawtveipi a gin sah ciengun, tua pengkul gin na zah behun nahpi tahin mi zosie a awng ding uhi; tuale khuopi kulpi cimzanin a mailam ciet vuah mi zosie tangtahin a pei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Nun tapa Joshua in siempute hlanin a kung vuah, “Thuciemna singkuong zawng unlen, Topa thuciemna singkuong mai-ah siempu sagi in tua tuutang ki pengkul sagite tawisah un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in mite mai-ah, “Mai nawt unlen khuopi kimkotin pei un; Topa’ thuciemna singkuong mai-ah hiem tawi mite peisah un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Joshua in mite a thupiehsa bangin Topa mai-ah tuutang ki pengkul a tawi siempu sagite madawhin pengkul a tum vua, Topa’ thuciemna singkuong in amate nua a zui hi."},"9":{"text":"Pengkul tum siempute mai-ah hiem tawite a pei uhi; pengkulte a kitumsuoh laitahin thukham singkuong nua-ah nuadalte a pei uhi."},"10":{"text":"Joshua in mite tungah tam bangin thu a pie hi: “A awng dinga kang gen ni masang na awng sih ding vua, na aw uh kizasah loin kam khat beh na ham sih ding uhi. Tua ciengin na awng ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ thukham singkuong in khatvei khuopi a kimvel hi; giephuol-ah a kilekia vua, tuanah a zan gie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin zingmawngin Joshua tho bai a, siempute in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ thuciemna singkuong mai-a a pei tuutang ki pengkul sagi a tawi siempu sagite peisuohin pengkul a tumsuoh uhi. A mai vuah hiem tawite pei-in, pengkul a kitum suoh laitahin Topa’ thuciemna singkuong nua-ah nuadalte a pei uhi."},"14":{"text":"A ni ni ni-in khatvei khuopi a kimvel vua, tua ciengin giephuol-ah a kilekia uhi. Tua bangin ni guh sung a bawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"A ni sagi ni khuova patin tho bai-in tua bang ma-in khuopi sagivei a kimvel uhi. Khum ni behin khuopi kimkotah sagivei a pei uhi."},"16":{"text":"A sagiveina ah siempute in pengkul a tum ciengun Joshua in mite kungah, “Awng un! Azieh pen Topa in na tung vuah khuopi ang pie zo ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuopi le a sunga om zosie Topa tungah biehna-in kisusie ding hi. Ama in i sawl uh kamtaite a na phuol ziehin numei pahtat Rahab le ama tawh a inn sunga om teng beh hing ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Suhsiet dinga ki-apsa na khatpo deigaw-in la-in, Israel-te’ giephuol kisietna suohsahin amate tungah lungkhamna na tunsah khah lo nadingun kidawm un."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin ngun le kham zosie, le sumsan le sia tawh kibawl vante Topa adingin a siengtho hi. Topa’ gou kholna-ah tuate tung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite awngin pengkulte kitum hi. Mite in pengkul awging a zah behun nahpi tahin a awng uleh kulpi a cimzan hi; tuaci’n amate mai cietah mi zosie tangtahin khuopi sungah lutin khuopi a la uhi.","ref":"Heb 11:30"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in khuopi sunga om nupi, pasal, khanglai le tehsie, bawng tang, tuu le laa zosie namsau tawh a thatgam uhi."},"22":{"text":"Joshua in khum gam a kandap mi nite kungah, “Numei pahtat nu’ inn ah va pei ta unlen, ama tunga na ciemsa bangun numei le ama tawh kisai zosie hing peipi un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n thukan tangvalte va tumin Rahab, a nu le a pa, a sanggamte le ama tawh kisai zosie, inn sung panin a peipi uhi. Numei nu’ innkuonpi zosie a zawpi vua, Israel-te’ giephuol pulamah a koi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in a khuopi le a sunga om zosie mei tawh halin Topa’ goukholna sungah ngun le kham, sumsan le sia tawh kibawl vante a koi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin numei pahtat Rahab, a innkuonpi le ama tawh kisai zosie, Joshua in a hingkhawi hi. Tua huna kipanin Israel gam sungah tua nu’ innkuonte a teng uhi. Azieh pen ama nu in Jericho khuo thu a kandap dinga Joshua in a sawl kamtaite a phuoldap hi.","ref":"Heb 11:30"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in tami kiciemna gen a, “Tami Jericho khuopi lamkia ding a hanciem poma Topa mai-ah kisamsie taheh!. Ama in a tacil luong tawh a khuombul phut ding a, a ta tumpen luong tawh khuopi tunkotte phut ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 16:34"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Joshua ompi hi; tuale gam sung zosie-ah a min a thang hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanle a ki-ap vante tawh kisai-in Israel-te tam bangin a zuoutat uhi: Judah minam Zerah’ tapa Zabdi, a tapa Carmi, a tapa Achan in a ki-ap vante pawlkhat a la hi; tuale Israel-te tungah Topa’ lungthahna a kuong hi.","title":"Achan’ Mawna le a Kidantatna"},"2":{"text":"Joshua in Jericho panin Bethel ni suona lam Beth-aven gei-a om Ai khuo ah mi sawlin amate kungah, “Peito unlen gam va endap ta un,” a ci hi. Tua mite peito-in Ai khuo a endap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate Joshua kungah kilekia-in a kungah, “Mi zosie kuonto kul lo hi; mi tulni ahi sihle mi tul thum kim khat kuonto-in Ai khuo simsah lel in. Mi tawmno khat ahi bo ziehun khum sungah mi buppi gimsah da in,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum munah mi tul thum bang a kuonto uhi; tuale Ai mite mai-ah amate a taimang sieng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ai khuo mite in sawmthum le guh bang a that vua, khuopi kulpi pulam panin Shebarim mun dongah delin kumsuhna munah a that uhi. Mite lungkie-in a lungsim uh tui a suoh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in a puonte ehmalin nitah dongin Topa’ singkuong mai-ah ama le Israel upate tuolah a khupbawh uhi, tuale amate in a lutang uh leivui a buoh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Joshua in, “Ah, Topa Pasien! Ko ei susie ding Amor-te’ khut sunga ei pie dingin bang dinga tam mite Jordan galkhatah ei peipi poma na hei? Jordan galkhatah a teng dingin a lungkim hi tazaw mai uleng izaw!"},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, a galte kung panin Israel-te a kilekia ta uhi. Tu-in ke’n bang gen thei ding ka hei!"},"9":{"text":"Canaan-te le tam gama teng mi zosie-in tam thu a za ding vua, tuaci’n amate in kote ei imtawmin leitung panin ka min uh ei phietpieh ding uhi. Tua ciengin a lien mama nangma’ min bang na law ta diei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah, “Dingto vawi! Bang dinga lei lahah khupbawh na hei?"},"11":{"text":"Israel a khiel zo ta uhi; amate tunga ka pieh ka thuciemnate a palsat zo uhi. Amate in a ki-ap vante pawlkhat a la uhi; amate in gu-in a zuou gamtat vua, a neisate lah vuah tua vante a koi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel-te in a galte uh nang zo lo uhi; amate pen suhsiet dinga ki-ap van khat a suo zo tah ziehun a galte masangah a nuakia uhi. Na lah vuah a ki-ap vante na suhsiet sih uleh kang ompi nawn sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mite na siensuo khu zom inlen, ‘Zing cieng adingin no le no kisiensuo ciet un; azieh pen Topa , Israel Pasien in, ‘Israel-te aw, na lah vuah a ki-ap vante om hi; note lah panin a ki-ap vante na lah masangsie-un na galte uh mai-ah na ding zo sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ziehin zing ciengin na minam namun nang pei ding uhi. Topa in a lah minam sung panin a bebe-in ang pei ding hi. Topa in a lah a be sung panin a innkuonkuonin ang pei ding hi. Topa in a lah a innkuon sung panin a mimi-in ang pei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A ki-ap vante tawh a kimanton pa, a neisa zosie tawh mei-in kihal ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ thuciemna palsatin Israel-te lahah zum huoi-in ama gam ta hi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawngin Joshua tho bai-in, Israel-te a minam namin peipi a, Judah minam kila hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in Judah be a nai-ah peipi a, Zerah-te be kila hi; tuale ama in a innkuonkuonin Zerah-te be peipi a, Zabdi kila hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a innkuonpite khat tata-in peipi a, Judah minam Zerah’ tapa Zabdi, a tapa Carmi, a tapa Achan kila hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Achan kungah, “Ka tapa aw, Israel Topa Pasien min thangsah inlen, ama kungah na mawna pulah in. Tu-in bang ahiei na bawl kei ei gen inlen, bangma ei pha sin,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Achan in Joshua dawng a, “Tua khu aman ahi hi; Israel Topa Pasien tungah ka maw zo ta hi. Ka gamtatna tami ahi hi:"},"21":{"text":"Shinar panin vanlahte lahah puon hoi khat le shekel zani a khai ngun, le shekel sawmnga a khai kham tawn khat ka mu ciengin ipla-in ka lakha ma hi. Tu-in tuate ka puonbuh sung lei lahah kiphuol a, a nei lamah ngunte kikoi hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in kamtaite sawlin a puonbuh lamah a tai uhi; tuale a puonbuh sung lei nei-ah a ngun na kiphuol tahpi hi."},"23":{"text":"Puonbuh panin tua vante ladawhin Joshua le Israel-te zosie kungah a peipi uhi; tuale amate in Topa mai-ah tuate a thezah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua le ama tawh a om Israel-te zosie in Zerah’ tapa Achan le a ngun, a puon, a kham tawn, a tapate, a tanute, a bawng, a laa, a tuu, a puonbuh le a nei vannuoi a la uhi; tuale amate in Achor Kuom dongah tuate a peipi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Joshua in, “Bang dinga kote tunga gimna ei tut na hei? Tu ni-in Topa in na tungah gimna ang tungsah ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Israel-te zosie in suong tawh Achan a seplia uhi; amate in tua teng mei tawh halin suong tawh a sep vua,"},"26":{"text":"tuale a tungah suongtum lompi a sungvum vua, tuni dongin a omlai hi. Tua ciengin Topa’ lungthahna a dai hi. Tua ahi ziehin tuni dongin tua mun Achor Kuom kici hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua kungah Topa in, “Zau sinlen lungkie sin. Galkap zosie zawpi inlen Ai khuo-ah tu-in peito in. En in, nangma tungah Ai kumpipa le a mite, a khuopi le a leitang kang pie zo hi.","title":"Ngien tawh Ai Khuo Kila-in Kisusie"},"2":{"text":"Jericho le a kumpipa tungah na bawl bangin Ai le a kumpipa tungah zong na bawl ding hi; van kinuasiete le a ganhingte beh galvan lahin noma dingin na la ding uhi. Khuopi nua lamah a sim ding na koidap ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ai khuo sim dingin mite a kuonto uhi. Joshua in galhang mi tul sawmthum teelin zanin sawl a,"},"4":{"text":"“Tua khuopi sim dingin a nua lamah na buhdap ding uhi; khuopi panin gamla pei sih un, hinanle na unpi-un a kigingsa-in om un."},"5":{"text":"Kei le ka ompi mi zosie in khuopi kang nai ding vua, a masa lai bangin ei do dinga ang kuon ciengun amate mai panin ka na tai ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khuopi panin amate ka nawdawh masangun amate in ei del ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile, ‘A masa lai bangin i kung panun amate a tai uhi,’ ci ding uhi. Amate kung panin ka tai laitahun"},"7":{"text":"na kibuhna mun panun ang pei-in khuopi na la ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile Topa na Pasien un na khut sung vuah amate ang pie ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khuopi na lah zaw ciengun Topa’ thupiehsa bangin gamta-in mei tawh khuopi na hal ding uhi; thei un, thu kang pie zo uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in amate a sawldawh hi; a kibuh nading munah amate pei-in Ai ni tumna lam, Bethel le Ai kikalah a pang uhi; ahi vangin tua zanin giephuol ah Joshua a gieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Zingmawngin Joshua tho bai-in mite khawm a, mite mai-ah Israel upate tawh Ai-ah a peito uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama tawh a omton galkap zosie a pei to vua, khuopi mai nehin Ai lei lulam pangah giephuol a sat vua, Ai le a kikal vuah luihawm khat a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in mi tulnga bang peipi-in khuopi nitumna lam Bethel le Ai kikalah a kibudap sah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n galkapte, khuopi leilu lamah galkap phuolpi koi-in, khuopi nitumna lamah nuadalte koi hi. Ahi vangin khum zanin kuom sungah Joshua a gieh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ai kumpipa in tam a mu ciengin ama le ama’ mite zosie le khumi khuo-a teng zosie, zingmawngin a thobai vua, Arabah tawh a kimaingat ahi kimutuona ding munah Israel-te tawh gal kido dingin mallangin a kuon uhi; ahi vangin ama do dingin khuopi nua lamah a pangdap mi a op lam ama in thei lo hi."},"15":{"text":"A mai vuah Joshua le Israel-te zosie a lel kipangin senel gam manaw-in a tai uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate del dingin khuopi sunga om mi zosie kikai khawmin Joshua a del uleh khuopi pan amate a na kihemmang ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ai khuo le Bethel khuo sungah Israel-te a del lo pasal khat beh a om sih hi; amate in khuopi kot honsa-in nuasie-in, Israel-te a nuadel uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Joshua kungah, “Na khut sunga om namsau Ai khuo lam ngatin zah in; azieh pen na khut sungah tua khuo kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Joshua in khuopi lamngatin a khut sunga om namsau a zah hi."},"19":{"text":"A khut a zah behin a buhdap galkapte a opna mun panun a dingkhie vua, mailam nawtin a nawtai mama uhi. Khuopi sungah lutin a la vua, tua khuopi mei tawh a hal uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ai mite in a nua-et uleh vantung lamah khuopi meikhu kitungto a mu uhi. Tam lam ahi a, khum lam ahi zongin a tai thei nawn sih uhi. Azieh pen senel gama a tai mite kinua hei-in a delte a do uhi."},"21":{"text":"A budapte in khuopi a lah zawhna ule Joshua le Israel-te zosie in a kitungto khuopi meikhu a mu ciengun kilehei-in Ai mite a vatgawp uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate do dingin khuopi panin adangte a kuonto uhi; tuaci’n Israel-te in pawlkhat langkhatah, pawlkhat adang khatah a kui-im uhi. Tuale amate a hinglai le a suohta khat zong om lo za dongin Israel-te in a vatmai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ai kumpipa a hingin kiman a, Joshua kungah kipeipi hi."},"24":{"text":"Israel-te in senal gam zanga amate a delna Ai khuo mi zosie thatin, namsau tawh a unpi vua a sigam zaw ciengun Ai khuo-ah Israel-te zosie kilekia-in namsau tawh tua khuopi a sim uhi."},"25":{"text":"Khum ni-a a si Ai khuo mi zosie numei le pasal a kigawmin tulsawm le tulni pha hi."},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Ai khuomi zosie a tha sieng masangin Joshua in a namsau lapna a khut a dawhkia sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in Joshua a thupieh dung zui-in, Israel-te in ganhingte le khuopi sunga van kinuasiete beh gal vanlahin a la uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in Ai khuopi hal a, tua khuopi pen tuni-a bangin buathah kholna suohsah den hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuale ama in nitah dongin sing tungah Ai kumpipa a khai hi; tuale ni a tum ciengin Joshua in thu pie-in, amate in sing tung panin a luong a khiesuh vua, khuopi kulkotpi lutna-ah pai-in a tungah suongtum lompi a cieng vua, tuni dongin tua suongcien a omlai hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Israel Pasien Topa adingin Ebal muol tungah maitam khat lam a,","title":"Joshua in Thuciemna Bawlpha (Thkna 27:4-5)"},"31":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses in Israel-te a thupiehsa bangin Moses’ thukham laibu sungah, “A tungah sia vanzah a kizang lo, suongtum tawh a kikheng lo maitam,” ci-in kigiel hi; tua tungah Topa adingin meihal biehnate pie-in thunuam biehpiehnate a lui uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:25"},"32":{"text":"Tua munah Joshua in Israel-te mitmu-in suong tungah Moses gielsa thukham a tei hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:2-8"},"33":{"text":"Israel mite thupha a pieh thei nadingun Topa’ nasem Moses thupiehsa bangin Israel mi zosie pemta hile tuolsung hile, a upate uh, a uliente ule a thukhente utawh, Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo Levi siempute mai, thuciemna singkuong langkhat, Gerizim Muol mai lamah mi alang, Ebal Muol mai lamah mi alang a ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in thukham laibu sunga kigiel thuphate le samsietnate, thukham sunga om kammal zosie a unpi-in a sim hi."},"35":{"text":"Joshua in Moses’ thupieh kammal zosie Israel mi honpi zosie, numeite, nausente le amate lahah a teng pemtate zosie mai-ah a sim lo khat zong om lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:29; 27:11-14"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Jordan galkhatah a om muoltung gam le lei ngiemna gam Tuipi lien dung peisuoh Lebanon donga teng Hit-te, Amor-te, Canaan-te, Periz-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te in tam thu a zah ciengun,","title":"A Ngien Utawh Gibeon-te Amau le Amau Kihun"},"2":{"text":"Joshua le Israel-te sim dingin lungsim kikhatin a kisutuo uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Gibeon-a teng mite in Jericho le Ai tunga Joshua bawlsate a zah ciengun"},"4":{"text":"amate lam panin tam bangin a solbawl uhi: Amate pei-in lam-ante guongin, a laate adingin a siesa ip le a paatsa, a lui a kiphaw lenggazu-umte a guong vua,"},"5":{"text":"a keng vuah a kiphaw, a paatsa kedapte bulin a paatsa puonte a sil uhi; a an zosie uzong a gawta le a apkai vive ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Gilgal giephuola om Joshua kungah pei-in ama le Israel-te tungah, “Kote pen a gamlapi pana ang pei ka hi uhi; tuaci’n tuni-in kote tawh thukimna khat hing bawl un,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle Israel-te in Hiv-te kungah, “Kote lahah a teng mite na hi kha thei ding uhi. Tua bang hi mawh leh note tawh thukimna bang ka ci bawl thei ding uh ahei?” a ci uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:32; 34:12; Thkna 7:2"},"8":{"text":"Amate in Joshua kungah, “Na nasemte ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi. Tuale Joshua in, “No koite na hi vuoi?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in, “ Topa na Pasien uh’ min zalin na nasemte a gamla mama gam pana ang pei ka hi uhi; azieh pen ama’ thu le Egypt gam sunga a sepkhiet zosie,"},"10":{"text":"le Jordan galkhata om Amor kumpi nite ahi Ashtaroth-a a teng Heshbon kumpi Sihon le Bashan kumpi Og tunga a sepsa zosie a kigenna ka za zo uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35"},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka upate ule ka gam vua ka tenpi uh mi zosie in kote kungah, ‘Na khuolzin nading vuah lam-an guong un; amate tawh a kimu dingin pei unlen a kung vuah, “Na nasemte ka hi uhi; tu-in hing pei unlen kote tawh thukimna khat hing bawl un,” va ci ta un,’ ei ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tanah ka mohte uh om hi. Na kung vua ang haw dinga kang din khiet ni uh, khuolzin lam-an dinga ka guon lai-un a lumlai a, hizongle tu-in en un, gawta-in a apkai sieng ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tami lenggatui savun bungte zong ka thun patun a tha ahi a, tu-in a sie sieng ta hi; tami ka puonte ule ka kedapte uzong lam saupi kang peina vuah a siepaat sieng ta hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n makaite-in a lam-an uh a ne vua, Topa tung panin lamlahna a ngen sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale Joshua in amate a hinkhawi nading kilemna thuciem a bawl hi; tuale amate tungah mihonpi makaite a kiciem uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hizongle amate tawh thukimna a bawl zaw uh nithum a cin ciengin, amate pen a vengte ahi lam ule amate lahah a tengte ahi lam a za uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te dingkhie-in a ni thum ni-in a khuopite vuah a tung uhi. A khuopite uh pen Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth le Kiriath-jearim ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin mihonpi makaite in Topa , Israel Pasien’ min tawh a tung vuah kiciemna a nei zo ziehun Israel-te in amate a do sih uhi. Tua ciengin mihon zosie makaite tungah a phun uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle makai zosie in mihonpi zosiete tungah, “ Topa , Israel Pasien’ minin a tung vuah i kiciem zo ta vua, tu-in amate i sukha sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate tunga i bawl ding uh tam ahi hi: Eite in amate tunga i bawl uh thuciemna ziehin eite tungah lungthahna ang tun lo nadingin amate i hingsah ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Makaite in a kung vuah, “Amate hingsah un,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n amate tawh kisai makaite khensatsa bangin mihonpi zosie adingin sing suite le tui tawite a suoh uhi."},"22":{"text":"Joshua in amate hlanin a kung vuah, “Kote lahah teng napi bang dingin, ‘Na kung panin a gamlapi-ah ka teng uhi,’ ci-in ei sol na hi uh ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in samsiet thuoh na hi vua, note lahah mi pawlkhat a tawntungin sila, ka Pasien’ inn adingin sing suite le tui tawite na hi ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in Joshua dawngin, “Bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien un ama’ nasem Moses tungah gam buppi nang hing pie-in na mai panin gam sunga teng mi zosie a suhsiet tahtah nading thu a piehna ko na nasemte kungah ei kigen hi. Note ziehin ka si ding uh ka zau mama vua, tuaci’n tam bangin ka na bawl uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in kote pen na khut sunga om ka hi uhi: Na muna-ah a hoi le a man na sah bangin ka tung vuah ei bawl in,” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in amate adingin tam bangin a bawl hi: Ama in Israel-te panin amate a hunkhie hi; amate a that sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua ni-in Joshua in mihonpite ading le ama in a teel nading munah Topa’ maitam ading singtomte le tuitawite suohsah a, tuni dongin a sem uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua in Ai khuo a lah dan, tua khuo a suhmaimang dan, Jericho le a kumpite tunga a bawl dan teng le Gibeon-a tengte in Israel-te tawh kilemna bawlin amate lahah a opton dan teng uh Jerusalem Kumpi Adoni-zedek in a zah ciengin,","title":"Ni Khawl"},"2":{"text":"ama zau mama hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Gibeon pen kumpi khuopite khat ma bangin khuopi lien khat ahi a, Ai khuo sangin gol zaw-in a mite zosie galhang vive ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalem Kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Hebron Kumpipa Hoham, Jarmuth Kumpipa Piram, Lachish Kumpipa Japhia, le Eglon Kumpipa Debir-te kungah kamtai sawlin,"},"4":{"text":"“Hing kuonto-in ei panpi unlen, Gibeon va sim ta vai. Azieh pen ama in Joshua le Israel-te tawh kilemna a bawl hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amor kumpi ngate - Jerusalem kumpi, Hebron kumpi, Jarmuth kumpi, Lachish kumpi, Eglon kumpite - in a galkapte uh kaikhawmin a galkap zosie utawh a kuonto vua, Gibeon galah giephuol satin a do uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gibeon-te in Gilgal giephuol-a Joshua kungah kamtai sawlin, “Na nasemte ei nuasie sin; mallang tahin ko kungah hing peito-in ei hunkhie inlen ei panpi in; azieh pen ko ei do dingin muoltung gama teng Amor kumpi zosie ang kikhawm ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gilgal panin ama le a galkap zosie le a thahat galhangte zosie tawh Joshua a kuonto hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah, “Amate giing sin, azieh pen na khut sungah amate kang pie zo hi; na mai-ah amate khat beh a ding zo sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in Gilgal panin zan tungtawn peito-in thakhatthu-in amate a busim hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te mai-ah Amor-te a zausisah a, Gibeon-ah nasie tahin amate that gamin Beth-horon katona lamah a delto vua, Azekah le Makkedah dongah a vatgawp uhi."},"11":{"text":"Israel-te mai-ah amate a taimang laitah, Beth-horon kumsuhna-ah a peisuh laitahun van panin Topa in gieltang golpite Azekah khuo cieng dong, amate tungah kiesahin amate a si uhi; Israel-te in namsau tawh a tha sangin tua gielpi zieha a si mi tamzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te khut sungah Amor-te a pieh ni-in Joshua in Topa hopi hi; tuale ama in Israel-te muna-ah, “Ni aw, nang Gibeon-ah, Hla aw, nang Aijalon kuomah khawlden in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale minamte in a galte uh tungah phu a lah zo masangsie-un, ni ding denin hla zong a khawlden hi. Jashar laibu sungah tami thu kigiel hi lo amah? Van kimlai-ah ni khawl a, ni khat bup bang a tumpah sih hi.","ref":"2Sam 1:18"},"14":{"text":"Tua masang hitale tua hun zaw hitale Topa in mihing khat’ thu a ngai tua ni bang nidang om ngai lo hi; azieh pen Topa in Israel-te dingin gal dopieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in ama tawh a om Israel-te zosie tawh Gilgal-a giephuol-ah a kilekia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin tami kumpi ngate a taimang vua, Makkedah leihawm sungah a kiphuol uhi.","title":"Kumpi Nga Kizo"},"17":{"text":"Tuale Joshua kungah, “Makkedah leihawm sunga kiphuol kumpi ngate kimu zo ta hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"18":{"text":"Joshua in, “Leihawm kam sungah suongtum golpite lia unlen a cing ding mi koi un;"},"19":{"text":"ahi vangin khum sungah om sih un; na galte del unlen, a nualam panin sim un. A khuopi sung vuah lutsah sih un, azieh pen Topa na Pasien un na khut sung vuah amate ang pie zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Joshua le Israel-te in a sigam sieng dongun amate tampi tah a thazaw uh cieng, khuopi muonhuoi sungah a suohta lai mite a lutzaw ciengun,"},"21":{"text":"Makkedah giephuol-a Joshua kungah mi zosie dam le bihin a kilekia uhi; Israel-te langkhatah a kamkeh ngam koima om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in, “Leihawm kam hong unlen, tua leihawm panin kumpi ngate ka kungah hing peipi un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in tua bangin bawlin leihawm panin kumpi ngate, Jerusalem kumpi, Hebron kumpi, Jarmuth kumpi, Lachish kumpi, le Eglon kumpite, ama kungah a peipi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in Joshua kungah kumpi ngate a peipi zaw ciengun, Joshua in Israel-te zosie hlanin ama tawh a kuonton galhang makaite kungah, “Keima ei nai unlen tam kumpite ngawngah na keng uh ngam un,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin amate in zong nai-in a ngawng vuah a keng a ngam uhi."},"25":{"text":"Joshua in amate kungah, “Zau sih unlen, lungkie sih un; thahat unlen, hang un; azieh pen Topa in na do uh na gal zosie uh tungah tam bangin a bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in amate satlia-in sisah a, singkung nga tungah a khai hi. Nitah dongin sing tungah amate a khai uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ni a tum ciengin Joshua in thu pie a, singtung panin amate a lakhie vua, a kiphuolna ngai uh leihawm sungah a pai uhi; amate in leihawm kam sungah suongtum golpite a koi vua, tuni dongin tua suongtumte a omlai hi."},"28":{"text":"Khum ni-in Joshua in Makkedah khuo la-in, namsau tawh tua khuo le a kumpipa a vatmai hi; ama in tua khuo sunga om zosie sumaimang hi; koima khat beh a hen sih hi. Ama in Jericho kumpipa tunga a bawl bangin Makkedah kumpipa tungah zong a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua le a op tonpi Israel-te zosie, Makkedah panin Libnah-ah a peisuoh vua, Libnah a sim uhi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te khut sungah tua khuo le a kumpipa zong a pie hi; tuale ama in tua khuo le a sunga om mi zosie namsau tawh vatmai a, koima khat beh hen nei loin Jericho khuopi tunga a bawl bangin a kumpipa tungah a bawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua banah Joshua in ama tawh a omton Israel-te tawh Libnah panin a pei suoh vua, Lachish imtawmin a bulu uhi."},"32":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te khut sungah Lachish pie a, ama in a ni ni ni-in Lachish la a, Libnah a bawl bangin tua khuo le a sunga om mi zosie namsau tawh a vatmai hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin Lachish a hu dingin Gezer Kumpipa Horam kuonto hi; tuale Joshua in ama le a mi zosie khat beh hen nei loin namsau tawh a vatmai hi."},"34":{"text":"Lachish panin Joshua le Israel-te zosie pei suohin, Eglon khuo imtawmin a bulu uhi;"},"35":{"text":"tuale khum ni ma-in tua khuo a la vua, namsau tawh a vatmai uhi; Lachish a bawl bangin khum ni ma-in tua khuo sunga om zosie nasie tahin ama in a sumaimang hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te zosie tawh Eglon panin Hebron-ah Joshua a peito hi. Amate in tua khuo bulu-in"},"37":{"text":"a la vua, a kumpipa, a khuopite le a sunga om mi zosie namsau tawh a vatmai hi; amate in Eglon tunga a bawl bangin tua khuo le a sunga om mi zosie a sumaimang uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel zosie tawh Debir-ah Joshua kilekia-in tua khuo a bulu vua,"},"39":{"text":"ama in a kumpipa le a khuo zosie tawh tua khuo a la hi; amate in namsau tawh amate a vatmai vua, khuo sunga om mi zosie a sumaimang uhi; ama in koima hen a nei sih hi; ama in Hebron le Libnah le a kumpipa tunga a bawl bangin Debir le a kumpipa tungah zong a bawl hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in gam buppi, muoltung gam, Negeb gam, leingiem gam, gamken teng le a kumpi zosie a zo sieng hi; ama in koima khat zong a hen sih a, ahi vangin Topa , Israel Pasien in a thupieh bangin a husang zosie a sumaimang hi."},"41":{"text":"Kadesh-barnea panin Gaza cieng dong, le Goshen gam zosie Gibeon cieng dong, Joshua in a zo gawp hi."},"42":{"text":"Israel-te’ Topa Pasien in Israel-te adingin gal a dopieh ziehin Joshua in hun khat sungin tam kumpi zosie le a leitang uh a la sieng hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in ama tawh a omton Israel-te zosie tawh Gilgal-a a giephuol vuah a kilekia hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hazor Kumpipa Jabin in tam thu a zah ciengin, Madon Kumpipa Jobab kung, Shimron kumpipa kung, Achshaph kumpipa kung,","title":"A Kipawlton Leilu Lam Canaan Kumpite Kizo"},"2":{"text":"leilu lam muol tung gama om kumpite kung, Chinneroth leitaw lama om Arabah gam sung, le lei ngiemna mun nitumna lama om Naphoth-dor gam sunga om kumpite kung,"},"3":{"text":"nisuona le nitumna lama om Canaan-te, Amor-te, Hit-te, Periz-te, muoltung gama om Jebus-te, Mizpah gam Hermon nei-a om Hiv-te kungah thu a puoh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate tuipi gei-a senel bangin a galkap honpi, galkap honte zosie le a tam mama sakolte le leengte tawh a kuon uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tami kumpite zosie in amau’ galkapte gawmin Israel-te do dingin a kuon vua, Merom lui-ah giephuol a satton uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Joshua kungah, “Amate giing sin, azieh pen zing cieng tu hunin amate a unpi-un a sisa-in Israel-te tungah ka pie ding hi; a sakolte uh a kapzahui na vatsan ding vua, a leengte uh mei tawh na hal ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua zong a galkap zosie tawh thakhatin Merom lui gei-a amate kungah pei-in a va sim uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Sidon Lien le Misrephoth-maim cieng dong, le nisuona lam Mizpeh kuom dong amate a del Israel-te’ khut sungah amate a pie hi. A suohta khat beh a om nawn lo dongin a that gam uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa thupiehsa bangin Joshua in amate tungah a bawl hi; ama in a sakolte uh a kapzahui vatsan piehin a leengte uh mei tawh a halpieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Khum hunin Joshua kiheikia-in Hazor la a, namsau tawh a kumpipa a vat hi. Khum hun masangin Hazor khuo pen tua kumpipa gamte zosie’ lutang ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum sunga teng zosie namsau tawh vatmai-in a sumaimang uhi; a husang thei khat beh kihingkhawi lo a, tuale ama in mei tawh Hazor a haltum hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses in a thupiehsa bangin Joshua in tua kumpite opna khuo teng le a kumpi teng uh la a, namsau tawh vatmai-in a sumaimang hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle Joshua in a na haltum Hazor simlo, muol tunga khuopite khat zong Israel-te in hal lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel-te in galvan lah dingin tami khuopite sunga van kinuasiete le ganhingte a la uhi; ahi vangin amate a suhsiet masangsie-un namsau tawh a vatmai vua, a husang thei khat zong a hen sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in a nasempa Moses a thupieh ma bangin Moses in zong Joshua thu piesawn a, tuaci’n Joshua zong tua bang ma-in a gamta hi; Topa in Moses a thupieh zosie Joshua in sep loin a nuasie khat zong om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in tam gam zosie a la hi: Muoltung gam, Negeb gam zosie, Goshen gam zosie, gam niem gam le Arabah gam, Israel muoltung gam le a ngiemna gam,","title":"Joshua’ Gamlahte’ Thu a Tomkim"},"17":{"text":"Seir lama kihlungto Halak Muol panin Hermon Muol nei Lebanon kuoma om Baal-gad cieng dong a la hi. Ama in a kumpi zosie uh man a, vat gawpin a that hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua kumpite zosie le Joshua sauveipi a kido hi."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon-a teng Hiv-te longal Israel-te tawh kilemna a bawl khuopi khat zong om lo hi; tua khuote zosie gal sunga a lah uh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bang lienin amate kihepi loin a kisuhsiet kilkel nading le a amate a cigam thei nadingun Israel-te tawh kido dinga ang kuon thei nading uh pen Topa’ nasep ahi hi.","ref":"2Sam 1:18"},"21":{"text":"Khum hunin Joshua pei-in muoltung gam, Hebron, Debir, Anab le Judah muoltung gam zosie pan le Israel muoltung gam zosie panin Anak-te a notmang hi; Joshua in a khuopite utawh amate a susiemang hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel-te’ gam sungah Anak-te khat beh om nawn lo hi; Gaza, Gath, le Ashdod sung behah pawl khat omlai hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Moses tunga a gensa zosie bangin Joshua in gam buppi a la hi; Joshua in amau’ minam tanh tawh kizui-in Israel-te tungah a luo dingun gamh-in a pie hi. Tuale tua gamah gal a veng hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nisuona lam Jordan galkhat, Arnon Lui panin Hermon Muol cieng dong, Arabah nisuona lam zosie, tam teng pen tu-in Israel-te in zo-in a lahsa uh kumpite’ gam ahi hi:","title":"Moses’ Zaw Kumpite (Gam 21:21-35)"},"2":{"text":"Heshbon-a teng Amor-te Kumpipa Sihon, Arnon Lui monga om Aroer pan, le kuom laikim panin Gilead phallang khat ahi Ammon-te gamgi Jabbok gun cieng dong,"},"3":{"text":"le Arabah panin Chinneroth Tuipi nisuona lam, le Beth-jeshimoth peina lamah Si Tuipi ahi Arabah tuipi dong, le a hlanglam-ah Pisgah gamken bul dong ahi hi;"},"4":{"text":"tuale Ashtaroth le Edrei-a teng Rephaim-te kumpi nukhiate lahah khat ahi Bashan kumpipa Og ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Hermon Muol le Salecah, le Bashan gam zosie, Geshur-te le Maacath-te’ gamgi cieng dong, le Gilead gam phallang khat panin Heshbon Kumpipa Sihon’ gamgi cieng dong a uh hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35; Thkna 2:26–3:11"},"6":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses le Israel-te in amate a zo uhi; tuale Topa’ nasem Moses in Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte tungah amau’ tan dingin leitang a pie hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"7":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jordan nitumna lam panga Joshua le Israel-te in a na zawsa kumpi gamte hi a, Lebanon kuom sung Baal-gad panin Seir lama kihlungto Halak Muol cieng dong hi a, (Israel minamte amau’ tanh ding tawh kizui-in Joshua in a luo ding vua a pieh,","title":"Joshua’ Zaw Kumpite"},"8":{"text":"muoltung gam sung, lei ngiemna gam sung, Arabah gam sung, muolpang gamken teng, senel gam sung, le Negeb gam sunga om Hit-te, Amor-te, Canaan-te, Periz-te, Hiv-te, le Jebus-te’ gamte ahi hi):"},"9":{"text":"Jericho kumpi khat, Bethel kunga Ai kumpi khat"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem kumpi khat, Hebron kumpi khat,"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth kumpi khat, Lachish kumpi khat,"},"12":{"text":"Eglon kumpi khat, Gezer kumpi khat,"},"13":{"text":"Debir kumpi khat, Geder kumpi khat,"},"14":{"text":"Hormah kumpi khat, Arad kumpi khat,"},"15":{"text":"Libnah kumpi khat, Adullam kumpi khat,"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah kumpi khat, Bethel kumpi khat,"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah kumpi khat, Hepher kumpi khat,"},"18":{"text":"Aphek kumpi khat, Lasharon kumpi khat,"},"19":{"text":"Madon kumpi khat, Hazar kumpi khat,"},"20":{"text":"Shimron-meron kumpi khat, Achshaph kumpi khat,"},"21":{"text":"Taanach kumpi khat, Megiddo kumpi khat,"},"22":{"text":"Kedesh kumpi khat, Carmel gam sunga Jokneam kumpi khat,"},"23":{"text":"Naphath-dor sunga Dor kumpi khat, Galilee sunga Goiim kumpi khat,"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah kumpi khat, a unpi-in kumpi sawmthum le khat ahi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Joshua vuoi-in a kum a tam mama ta hi; tuale Topa in ama kungah, “Nang lah vuoi-in na kum a tam ta a, gam lah ding tampitah omlai hi,” a ci hi.","title":"A Kizo Nai lo Canaan Gamkhente"},"2":{"text":"Gam lah ding a omlai tam teng ahi hi: Philistia gam sung zosie le Geshur gam zosie,"},"3":{"text":"(Egypt nisuona Shihor panin leilu lama Ekron gamgi dong, tua pen Canaan-te’ gamin kiciemte hi; Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, le Ekron gamte a uh Philistia mi nga a om hi) le Avvim gam,"},"4":{"text":"leitaw lama Canaan-te’ leitang zosie, le Sidon-te’ gam ahi Mearah gam, Amor-te’ gamgi ahi Aphek cieng dong,"},"5":{"text":"le Gebal-te’ leitang, le Lebanon gam zosie, nisuona lamah Hermon Muol nei-a Baal-gad panin Lebo-hamath cieng dong,"},"6":{"text":"Lebanon panin Misrephoth-maim cieng dong, Sidon-te zosie nangawn ahi hi. Kei mama in Israel-te mai panin amate ka notmang ding hi; nang kang thupiehsa bangin Israel-te tungah a luo dingun leitang beh hawm in.","ref":"Gam 33:54"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in minam kuo le Manasseh minam alangte tungah a luo dingun tam leitang hawm in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Manasseh minam alang dang khatte tawh Reuben-te le Gad-te in Topa’ nasem Moses in amate a piehsa bangin nisuona lam Jordan galkhatah gamh nga zo uhi:","title":"Jordan Nisuona Lam Gamte","ref":"Gam 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"9":{"text":"Arnon Lui monga om Aroer pan, le kuom laikima om khuopi, le Medeba panin Dibon cieng donga kihlung phei muolzang gam zosie;"},"10":{"text":"le Ammon-te’ gamgi cieng dong ahi Heshbon-a kumpi a sem Amor-te’ kumpipa Sihon’ khuopite zosie;"},"11":{"text":"Gilead le Geshur-te’ gam le Maacath-te’ gam, le Hermon Muol zosie, le Salecah dong Bashan gam zosie;"},"12":{"text":"Ashtaroth le Edrei-a kumpi sem Bashan gam sunga Og kumpi gam zosie (Rephaim-a a suohtate lahah a ma beh om hi); Moses in tam teng zo-in a notmang hi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongle Israel-te in Geshur-te ahi a, Maacath-te ahi zongin notmang lo hi; ahi vangin tu-ni dongin Israel-te lahah Geshur-te le Maacath-te a teng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Moses in Levi minamte tung behah gouluo pie lo hi; ama in a kung vuah a gensa bangin Israel-te’ Topa Pasien tunga kipie meihal biehnate pen amau’ gouluo ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"15":{"text":"Moses in Reuben minamte tungah amau’ be tawh kizui-in gouluo a pie hi.","title":"Reuben Kipie Gam"},"16":{"text":"Amau’ gouluo pen Arnon Lui gei-a om Aroer pan, le kuom laizanga om khuopi, le Medeba gei-a muolzang zosie,"},"17":{"text":"Heshbon, le muolzang tunga om a khuopite zosie; Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,"},"18":{"text":"Jahaz, Kademoth, Mephaath,"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Sibmah, le tua kuom muoltunga om Zereth-Shahar,"},"20":{"text":"Bethpeor, Pisgah kenpang suh, le Bethjeshimoth ahi a,"},"21":{"text":"muolzang khuopi zosie, le Moses in Midian makaite Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, le Reba, tua gama teng Sihon’ uliente tawh a na zaw ton ahi Heshbon-a kumpi sem Amor mi Kumpi Sihon’ kumpi gam zosie ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Beor’ tapa, aisan siempa Balaam zong, Israel-te in adang a thate lahah namsau tawh a thatton uhi."},"23":{"text":"Reuben-te’ gamgi pen Jordan le a gunpang ahi hi. Tam pen amau’ be tawh kizui-in a khuopite le a khuoneute tawh Reuben-te’ gouluo ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Moses in Gad minamte tungah zong amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in gouluo a pie hi.","title":"Gad-te’ Gam"},"25":{"text":"Amau’ gam pen Jazer, le Gilead khuopi zosie, Rabbah nisuona lama om Aroer cieng dong Ammon-te’ leitang phallang khat,"},"26":{"text":"le Heshbon panin Ramath-mizpeh le Betonim cieng, le Mahanaim panin Debir gam cieng,"},"27":{"text":"le Beth-haram kuom sungah Beth-nimrah, Succoth, le Zaphon, Heshbon-a kumpi Sihon’ kumpi gam a omlai teng, Jordan le a gunpang teng, Chinnereth Tuipi a niemna lam mong cieng dong, Jordan galkhat nisuona lam dong ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam pen amau’ be tawh kizui-in a khuopite ule a khuoneute tawh Gad-te’ gouluo ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Manasseh minam alangte tungah gouluo a pie hi. Amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Manasseh minam alangte tungah kihawm hi.","title":"Manasseh Minam Alangte’ Gam (Nisuona)"},"30":{"text":"Amau’ gam pen Mahanaim panin Bashan gam sung zosie kansanin Bashan kumpi Og’ kumpi gam buppi, le Bashan gam sunga om Jair-te tenna zosie, khuopi sawmguhte,"},"31":{"text":"le Bashan-a Og’ kumpi gam khuopite ahi Gilead alang le Ashtaroth, le Edrei khuopite ahi hi. Tam teng pen amau’ be tawh kizui-in Machir-te alang adingin Manasseh’ tapa Machir mite tungah kipie hi."},"32":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jericho nisuona lam Jordan galkhat, Moab zanglei-ah Moses in a hawm gouluote ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin Levi minamte tungah Moses in gouluo pie lo hi; Israel-te’ Topa Pasien a kung vua a gensa bangin ama pen amau’ gouluo ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:20; Thkna 18:2"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen siempu Eleazar in Nun tapa Joshua le Israel minam sunga be lutang teng tunga a hawmpieh Canaan gam sunga Israel-te’ nga gouluote ahi hi.","title":"Jordan Nitumna Lam Gam Hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Minam kuo le alangte adingin Topa in Moses a thupiehsa bangin aisanna tawh amau’ gouluote kihawm hi.","ref":"Gam 26:52-56; 34:13"},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Jordan galkhata minam ni le alangte tungah Moses in gouluo a pie zo ta hi. Hizongle ama in amate lahah Levi-te bangma gouluo pie lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Joseph mite pen minam ni-in kikhen a, Manasseh le Ephraim minamte ahi uhi. Khum gam sungah Levi-te ading tanh kipie lo a, ahi vangin tenna ding khuopite le a ganhingte vua dingin lonona gamte kipie hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33; 34:14-15; Thkna 3:12-17"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupieh bangin Israel-te a gamta uhi; amate in leitang a hawm uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gilgal-a Joshua kungah Judah mite a pei uhi; tuale Keniz-te Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb in a kungah, “ Topa in nang le kei tawh kisai-in Kadesh-barnea-ah Pasien’ mi Moses tunga a thugente na thei hi.","title":"Caleb Tungah Hebron Kipie","ref":"Gam 14:30"},"7":{"text":"A gam vandap dingin Topa’ nasem Moses in Kadesh-barnea panin ei sawl lai-in kum sawmli ka pha hi; tuale keima in ama tungah a man bangin thu ka puoh hi.","ref":"Gam 13:1-30"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei tawh a peito ka guolte in mite a lungkiesah uhi; hizongle keima in lungsim tahpi tawh Topa ka Pasien ka zui hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum ni-in Moses a kiciem a, ‘ Topa ka Pasien na lungsim tahpi tawh zui na hi ziehin na keng tawh na totsa leitangte nangma le na tate adingin gouluo ahi zing ding hi,’ ei ci hi.","ref":"Gam 14:24"},"10":{"text":"Tu-in na mu bangin ama in a cisa ma bangin gamlahah Israel-te a pei sung, Topa in Moses tungah tam thu a gen huna kipanin kum sawmli le kum nga sung, Topa in ei nungtasah hi; tuale tuni-in kei kum sawmgiet le kumnga ka pha ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Moses in ei sawl lai ma bangin tuni-in ka tha a hat lai hi; ka thatang zong gal do nading le vaikuon vaitun nadingin khum hun lai-a ka thatang ma bang lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in khum ni-a Topa in a gensa tam muoltung gam kei ei pie in; azieh pen kul tawh ki-im khuopite tawh Anak-te khum sungah bangci om ci na zahsa uh ahi hi; Topa in ei ompi ding a, Topa’ ci bangin amate ka notmang zo kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in ama thupha pie a, Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah gouluo dingin Hebron a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in lungsim tahpi tawh Israel-te’ Topa Pasien a zui ziehin tuni dongin Hebron pen Keniz mi Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb’ gouluo a suoh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-a tam Hebron’ min pen nidang lai-in Kiriath-arba kici hi; tam Arba pen Anak-te lahah mi lienpen khat ahi hi. Tuale khum gamah gal kidona a veng hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Judah mite’ nga pen leitaw lam Edom gamgi dong tung a, leitaw lam a gamla pen mun Zin gam dong bansuh hi.","title":"Judah’ Gam"},"2":{"text":"Leitaw lam amau’ gamgi pen Si Tuipi tawpna dong, leitaw lam kinga tuidawh panin kipan hi;"},"3":{"text":"leitaw lam Akrabbim katona pan peisuohin Zin dong ban a, Kadesh-barnea leitaw lama Hezron dung zui-in Addan cieng dong peito a, Karka lamah kihei-in,"},"4":{"text":"Azmon dungah peisuoh a, Egypt Lui-ah pusuohin tuipi-ah a tawp hi. Tam pen na leitaw lam gamgi ding uh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale nisuona lam gamgi pen Si Tuipi ahi a, Jordan gun tunna dong ahi hi. Leilu lampang gamgi pen Jordan gun tunna tuipi dawh panin kipan hi;"},"6":{"text":"tuale Beth-hoglah lamah gamgi peito-in, Beth-arabah leilu lamah peisuoh a, Reuben tapa Bohan’ Suongtumpi dongin tua gamgi peito a,"},"7":{"text":"Akor Kuom panin Debir dong gamgi peito a, leilu lam manaw-in Adummin katona tawh kimaingat-a om Gilgal lamah kihei hi; En-shemesh lui dungah gamgi pei-in En-rogel ah tawp hi;"},"8":{"text":"tua ciengin Jebus-te’ (Jerusalem a cina); leitaw lam kumsuhna a om Hinnom’ tapa kuomah gamgi peito a, Rephaim kuom leilu lam mong, nitumna lam Hinnom kuom galkhatah a kihlung muol dawnah gamgi kato hi;"},"9":{"text":"tua ciengin muolvum panin Nephtoah tuite’ tuinah dongah kihlung a, tua panin Ephron Muol khuopite-ah kihlung phei hi. Tua ciengin Baalah (Kiriath-jearim a cina) lamah gamgi kuol pei hi."},"10":{"text":"Baalah nitumna lam Seir Muolah gamgi kiviel a, tua panin peisuohin Jearim Muol (Chesalon a cina) leilu lam muolken ah peisuohin Beth-shemesh-ah peisuh a, Timnah gei-ah peisuoh hi;"},"11":{"text":"Ekron leilu lam muolken ah gamgi pei a, Shikkeron ah kivielin, tuale Baalah muol zui-in Jabneel-ah pusuoh hi; tua ciengin tuipi-ah tawp hi."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna lam gamgi pen tuipi lien Mediterranean le a dung teng ahi hi. Tam pen amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Judah mite kimvela gamgi ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Joshua a thupiehna tawh kizui-in ama in Judah mite lahah Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah tanh khat ahi Kiriath-arba, Hebron a cina, (Arba pen Anak’ pa hi) a pie hi.","title":"Caleb in Ama’ Tanh La (Thkn 1:11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Caleb in khum panin Anak’ tapa thumte Sheshai, Ahiman le Talmai, Anak’ suonlehlahte a notmang hi.","ref":"Thkn 1:20"},"15":{"text":"Khum panin Debir-a tengte sim dingin ama kuon to hi; tu-a Debir a min pen nidangin Kiriath-sepher kici hi."},"16":{"text":"Caleb in, “Kiriath-sepher sim-a, a la zo pa tungah a zi dingin ka tanu Achsah ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Caleb’ sanggampa Kenaz’ tapa Othniel in la zo hi. Tuale ama in a zi dingin a tanu Achsah a pie hi."},"18":{"text":"A kungah tua nu a tun ciengin a pa kungah logam khat ngen dingin a pausawl hi. A laa tung panin a kum ciengin Caleb in tua nu kungah, “Bang dei na hei?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua nu in ama kungah, “Letsong khat ei pie in. Negeb gamah nei koi tah ngalin cia tuikhuhte zong ei pie in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Caleb in ciatui tungta le ciatui neitate ama a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Judah minamte’ gouluo ahi hi.","title":"Judah Khuopite"},"21":{"text":"Lei tawlam gam mong Edom gamgi lamah Judah minamte’ nei khuopi te: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,"},"25":{"text":"Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (Hazor a kici)"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema, Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba, Biziothiah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, Iim, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, le Rimmon: a unpi-in khuopi sawmni le kuo, a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuale lei ngiemna lamah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, Gederothaim: khuopi sawm le li le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilan, Mizpah, Jokthe-el,"},"39":{"text":"Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,"},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, le Makkedah: khuopi sawm le guh le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Achzib, le Mareshah: khuopi kuo le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ekron, a khut nei-a teng le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi;"},"46":{"text":"Ekron panin tuipi dong, Ashdod lam nai-a om zosie, a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Ashdod, a khuopite le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi; Gaza, a khuopite le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi; Egypt Lui dong le Tuipi Lien gei cieng dong tawh ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuale muoltung gamah, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,"},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (Debir a kici),"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,"},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon, le Giloh: khuopi sawm le khat, a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Arab, Dumah, Eshan,"},"53":{"text":"Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Kiriath-arba (Hebron a kici), le Zior: khuopi kuo le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"55":{"text":"Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah, le Timnah: khuopi sawm le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"58":{"text":"Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Maarath, Beth-anoth, le Eltekon: khuopi guh le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"60":{"text":"Kiriath-baal (Kiriath-jearim a kici) leh Rabbah: khuopi ni le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"61":{"text":"Senel gamah Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,"},"62":{"text":"Nibshan, Ci Khuopi, le En-gedi: khuopi guh le a khuoneute utawh ahi hi."},"63":{"text":"Ahi vangin Judah mite in Jerusalem-a teng Jebus-te a notkhie zo sih uhi, tuaci’n tuni dongin Jebus-te pen Judah mite tawh Jerusalem-ah a tengton uhi.","ref":"Thkn 1:21;
