2Sam 5:6; 1Khg 11:4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph-te’ tanh pen Jericho luite’ nisuona lam Jericho gei Jordan panin senel gamah pei a, Jericho panin muoltung gamte tawnin Bethel dong peito hi;","title":"Ephraim-te’ Gam"},"2":{"text":"tua ciengin Bethel panin Luz-ah pei-in Archi-te’ gam Ataroth lam kantan hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin nitumna lam Japhlet-te’ gam lamah peisuh a, Beth-horon Neinung gam cieng dongah peisuh hi. Tua ciengin Gezer-ah pei-in tuipi-ah tawp hi."},"4":{"text":"Joseph-te’-Manasseh le Ephraim-in amau’ gouluo a nga uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amau’ innkuon zui-in Ephraim-te’ gam pen a nei-a bang ahi hi: Amau’ gamgi pen nisuona lamah Ataroth-addar hi a, Beth-horon Tungnung dong ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale a gamgi pen khum panin tuipi cieng dongah pei hi; leilu lamah Michmethath a om hi; tua ciengin Taanath-shiloh lamah nisuona lamah gamgi kuol pei a, nisuona lam Janoah dong peisuoh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Janoah panin Ataroth le Naarah ah peisuh a, Jericho nawhin Jordan-ah tawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah panin nitumna lam Kanah Lui-ah gamgi pei-in tuipi-ah tawp hi. Tam teng khu amau’ innkuon kuonin Ephraim minamte’ gouluo ahi a,"},"9":{"text":"Manasseh-te’ gouluo sung panin Ephraim-te adinga a kikhenkhie khuopite, le a khuoneu zosiete tawh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle amate in Gezer sunga teng Canaan-te a notmang sih vua, tuaci’n tuni dongin Canaan-te, Ephraim-te lahah a teng vua, ahi vangin thona-aana nasep kisemsah hi.","ref":"Thkn 1:29"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama pen Joseph’ tacil ahi ziehin Manasseh minam tungah tanh kipie hi. Manasseh’ tapa Gilead’ pa Machir tungah Gilead le Bashan gam kipie hi. A ziehpen ama galhang mi ahi hi.","title":"Adang Manasseh Minam Alang (Nitumna Lam)"},"2":{"text":"Manasseh minam a omlaite Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, le Shemida-te tungah amau’ innkuon zui-in tanh kipie hi; tam teng pen a innkuon zui-a Joseph tapa Manasseh’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Manasseh’ tapa, Machir’ tapa Gilead’ tapa Hepher’ tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lo a, tanu beh nei hi; tuale a tanute’ min in: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, le Tirzah ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Siempu Eleazar le Nun’ tapa Joshua le makaite mai-ah a pei vua, “Ka sanggam pasalte tawh gouluo ei piehton nadingin Topa in Moses thu a pie hi,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Topa’ thupiehna bangin ama in a pate uh’ sanggamte lahah amate gou a pie hi.","ref":"Gam 27:1-7"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Jordan galkhata om Gilead le Bashan banah Manasseh tungah tanh sawm kie hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Manasseh’ tanute in a tapate tawh gou a nga ton uhi. A omlai Manasseh-te tungah Gilead leitang kipie hi."},"7":{"text":"Manasseh gam in Asher panin Shechem nisuona lama om Michmethath dong ban hi; tua ciengin leitaw lamah En-tappuah-te’ gamgi peisuh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah leitang pen Manasseh-a’ ahi a, ahi vangin Manasseh’ gamgi-a om Tappuah khuo pen Ephraim tapate-a’ ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kanah Lui-ah gamgi a peisuh hi. Manasseh’ khuopite lahah leitaw lama om tam sunga khuopite, Ephraim-a’ ahi hi. Tua ciengin lui leilu lampangah Manasseh’ gamgi peito-in tuipi-ah tawp hi."},"10":{"text":"Leitaw lam gam pen Ephraim-a’ hi a, leilu lam teng Manasseh-a’ hi-in, tuipi pen a gamgi ahi hi; leilu lamah Asher gam banin nisuona lamah Issachar dong ban hi."},"11":{"text":"Issachar le Asher gam sungah Manasseh in Beth-shean le a khuoneute, Ibleam le a khuoneute, Dor-a tengte le a khuoneute, Endor-a tengte le a khuoneute, Taanach-a tengte le a khuoneute, le Megiddon-a tengte le a khuoneute tang lai hi. (a thumna pen Naphath ahi hi.)"},"12":{"text":"Hinanle Manasseh-te in tam khuopite a luo zo sih uhi. Ahi vangin khum gamah Canaan-te a teng suoh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te a thahat ciengun amate in Canaan-te thona-aana nasep semsahin a notmang sieng sih uhi.","ref":"Thkn 1:27-28"},"14":{"text":"Joseph’ minam in Joshua hopi a, “Bang dingin gouluo dingn kote tanh khat le se khat beh ei pie na hei? Topa in kote thupha ei pie-in tampi ka pha ta uhi?” a ci uhi.","title":"Joseph’ Minam in Langpang"},"15":{"text":"Joshua in a kung vuah, “No mi tampi pha-in no dingin Ephraim muoltung gam teng a neu seng leh gamlahah peito unlen noma dingin Periz-te’ gam le Rephaim-te’ gammang lahah gam sat un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph’ minam in, “Ko adingin muoltung gam kicing zo lo hi; hinanle zanglei-a teng Canaan-te zosie, Beth-shean le a khuoneute le Jezreel kuom sunga tengte in sia sakol leengte nei uhi,” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Joseph’ innkuon Ephraim-te le Manasseh-te kungah, “Note mi tampi na hi tahtah ta vua, zong na thahat mama uhi; note in tanh khat beh na nga sih ding vua,"},"18":{"text":"muoltung gam noma-a’ hi ding a, gammang tulah hinanle vat ngilin a gamla pen gamgi tawp dongin na luo ding uhi; azieh pen Canaan-te in sia sakol leengte nei-in thahat mama nan ule amate na notmang zo ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shiloh-ah Israel mihon buppi a kikhawm vua, khum munah kikhopna puonbuh a lam uhi. A mai vuah khum gam zawsa-in a om hi.","title":"A Omlai Minamte’ Gamte"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te lahah gouluo kipie nai lo minam sagi omlai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in Israel-te kungah,” Topa , na pu na pate uh Pasien in no ang piehsa leitangah pei-in tua gam na luo ding uh bang tanvei ziekai lai ding na hi uh ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Minam khat panin mi thum ta ei pie unlen, amate tua gamah vah kawikawi-in amau’ luo dinga ngaisutna tawh a leitang omzie lai tawh a ciemte dingin amate ka sawl ding hi. Tua ciengin ka kungah ang peikia ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua leitang pen se sagi-in a khen ding vua, Judah pen leitaw lam ama’ gam ma-ah om suohin Joseph’ innkuonte leilu lam ama gam ma-ah om ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua leitang khen sagi-in na khen ding vua, tam sunga ka kungah na ciemtena uh nang peipi ding uhi; keima in tam mun Topa i Pasien mai-ah note dingin ai ka san ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Levi-te in note lahah tanh a nei sih uhi, bang ding ahei cile Topa’ siempu nasep khu a gouluo uh ahi hi; tuale Gad, Reuben, le Manasseh minam alangte in Topa’ nasem Moses in amate a piehsa Jordan nisuona lam galkhatah amau’ gouluo a nga zo ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite kuonkhie uhi; tuale Joshua in leitang ciemtena giel dinga pei mite thu pie a, “Gam sungah vah kawikawi-in leitang ciemtena hing giel unlen, ka kungah hing peikia un; tuale Shiloh muna Topa mai tami munah note dingin ai ka san ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite kuonin gam sungah a suhva a tova vua, laibu khat sungah tua gam a khuokhuo-in khen sagi-in a khen uhi; tua ciengin Shiloh giephuola Joshua kungah a pei uhi."},"10":{"text":"Joshua in Topa mai Shiloh-ah amate dingin ai a san hi; tuale khum munah Joshua in Israel-te khat ciet tungah a tanh ciet uh a hawmpieh hi."},"11":{"text":"Benjamin minam sunga a innkuonte utawh kizui-in aisanna tung a, amate kipie gam pen Judah minam le Joseph minamte kikalah kie hi.","title":"Benjamin’ Gam"},"12":{"text":"Leilu lam panga amau’ gamgi pen Jordan panin kipan hi; tua ciengin leilu lamah Jericho leilu lam muolken banto a, tua ciengin muoltung gam nawhin nitumna lamah pei hi; tuale Beth-aven sehnel gamah tawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Khum panin gamgi in leitaw lamah Luz lam manaw a, Luz (Bethel a kici) muolken dongah peisuh a, khum panin Beth-horon Neinung leitaw lama om muoltunga Ataroth-adder khuo-ah tungsuh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin gamgi in mundang zuonin nitumna lamah kihei-in pei a, Beth-horon galkhat leitaw lama om muol panin nitumna lampang leitaw lamah kihei a, Judah minamte-a’ ahi Kiriath-baal (Kiriath-jearim kici) ah tawp hi. Tami in a nitumna lam pang a piengsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim khuopi gei-ah leitaw lam gamgi kipan hi; tua panin Ephron ah gamgi pei a, Nephtoah Tuite nah cieng dong tung hi;"},"16":{"text":"tua ciengin Rephaim kuom leilu lam monga om Hinnom tapa’ kuom kigalmuna gamgi muol ah gamgi a pei hi; tua ciengin Jebus-te’ muolken leitaw lam Hinnom kuomah peisuhin En-rogel ah a tungsuh hi;"},"17":{"text":"tua ciengin leilu lam manaw-in kawi a, En-shemesh ah peisuohin, khum panin Adummim katona galkhat, Geliloth ah a pei hi; tua ciengin Reuben’ tapa Bohan’ Suongpi-ah a peisuh hi;"},"18":{"text":"tuale Beth-arabah muolken leilu lamah gamgi peisuohin Arabah-ah peisuh hi;"},"19":{"text":"tua ciengin Beth-hoglah muolken leilu lam dong gamgi kihlung hi; Jordan mong leitaw lam, Si Tuipi dawh leilu lamah Jordan lui tawpna leitaw lamah gamgi a tawp hi; tam pen leitaw lam gamgi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Jordan gun in nisuona lamah gamgi a piengsah hi. Tam khu a innkuon zui-in a kimvel vuah a gamgi a gamgi-a Benjamin minamte’ gouluo ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in amau’ innkuon zui-a Benjamin minamte’ khuopite Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,"},"22":{"text":"Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,"},"24":{"text":"Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, Geba - khuopi sawm le ni le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi:"},"25":{"text":"Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"Mizpah, Chephirah, Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (Jerusalem a cina), Gibeah le Kiriath-jearim, khuopi sawm le li le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi. Tam pen a innkuon utawh kizui-in Benjamin minamte’ gouluo ahi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Simeon minam dingin aisan a niveina tung hi; amau’ gouluo in Judah minamte’ gouluo gam sung huom hi.","title":"Simeon-te’ Gam"},"2":{"text":"A gouluote uh pen Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,"},"3":{"text":"Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,"},"4":{"text":"Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,"},"5":{"text":"Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,"},"6":{"text":"Beth-lebaoth, le Sharuhen khuopi- sawm le thum le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi;"},"7":{"text":"Ain, Rimmon, Ether, le Ashan - khuopi li le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi;"},"8":{"text":"Negeb gam Ramah-a om Baalath-beer cieng dong le a kima om khuoneute zosie tawh ahi hi. Tam pen a innkuon zui-a Simeon minamte’ gouluo ahi hi.","ref":"1Khg 4:28-33"},"9":{"text":"Simeon minam’ gouluo in Judah minamte’ gam sung kimkhat a huom hi; azieh pen Judah minamte’ tanh pen amate dingin gol luo a, tua ziehin Simeon minam in amau’ gouluo sung panin gouluo a ngasawn uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Zebulun minam dingin aisan a thumveina tung hi. Amau’ gouluo gamgi in Sarid cieng dong ban hi;","title":"Zebulun-te’ Gam"},"11":{"text":"tua ciengin nitumna lamah a gamgi peito-in, Maralah ah peisuoh a, Dabbesheth va su ta a, tua ciengin Jokneam nisuona lama om lui ban hi;"},"12":{"text":"Sarid panin nisuona lamah kilehei a, nisuona lam zuonin Chisloth-tabor gamgi dong tung hi; khum panin Daberath-ah pei-in Japhia cieng banto hi;"},"13":{"text":"khum panin nisuona lama suolam nawtin Gath-hepher, Eth-kazin suolam nisuona lam nawtin Rimmon ah peisuohin Neah lamah kawi hi;"},"14":{"text":"tua ciengin leilu lama gamgi Hanathon lamah kihei a, Iphtah-el kuomah tawp hi."},"15":{"text":"Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, le Bethlehem-khuopi sawm le ni le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam pen a innkuon tawh kizui-in Zebulun minamte’ gouluo hi a, tam pen amau’ khuopite le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"A innkuon utawh kizui-in Issachar minamte dingin aisan a liveina tung hi.","title":"Issachar-te’ Gam"},"18":{"text":"A gam in Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,"},"19":{"text":"Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,"},"20":{"text":"Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,"},"21":{"text":"Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, le Beth-pazzez teng huom hi."},"22":{"text":"Gamgi in Tabor, Shahazumah, le Beth-shemesh zong ban a, Jordan lui-ah a gamgi tawp hi; a khuopi uh sawm le guh le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ innkuon zui-in Issachar minamte’ gouluo ahi a, a khuopite ule a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Asher minam dingin aisan a ngaveina tung hi.","title":"Asher-te’ Gam"},"25":{"text":"Amau’ gamgi huomte pen Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,"},"26":{"text":"Allammelech, Amad, le Mishal-te kihal hi; tua in Nitumna lamah Carmel le Shihor-libnath ban a,"},"27":{"text":"tua ciengin nisuona lamah kihei-in Beth-dagon ah pei a, leilu lam Beth-emek le Neiel lamah Zebulun le Iphtahel kuom dong ban hi; tua ciengin leilu lam Cabul,"},"28":{"text":"Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, le a Lien Sidon cieng dongah peito lai hi;"},"29":{"text":"tua ciengin Ramah ah gamgi kihei a, kul tawh ki-im Tyre khuopi dong tung hi; tua ciengin Hosah ah gamgi kihei a, tuipi ah tawp hi. Mahalab, Achzib,"},"30":{"text":"Ummah, Aphek, le Rehob - khuopite huom a -khuopi sawmni le ni le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam pen a innkuon zui-a Asher minamte’ gouluo ahi a, tam khuopite a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Naphtali minam dingin aisan a guhveina tung hi.","title":"Naphtali-te’ Gam"},"33":{"text":"A gamgi pen Heleph, Zaanannim-a om gangpi sing pan, le Adami-nekeb, le Jabneel panin Lakkum cieng dong pei hi; tuale Jordan ah a tawp hi;"},"34":{"text":"tua ciengin nitumna lam Aznoth-tabor ah gamgi kihei a, khum panin Hukkok ah pei-in leitaw lamah Zebulun sukha a, nitumna lamah Asher, nisuona lamah Jordan-a Judah ban hi."},"35":{"text":"Kulpi tawh a ki-im khuopite pen Ziddim, Zer, Hamath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,"},"36":{"text":"Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,"},"37":{"text":"Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,"},"38":{"text":"Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, le Beth-shemesh - khuopi sawm le kuo le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tam pen a innkuon tawh kizui-in Naphtali minamte’ gouluo ahi a, a khuopite le a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Amahaw’innkuon tawh kizui-in Dan minamte dingin aisan a sagiveina tung hi.","title":"Dan-te’ Gam"},"41":{"text":"Ama’ gouluo gam in Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,"},"42":{"text":"Shaalabin, Aijalon, Ithlah,"},"43":{"text":"Elon, Timnah, Ekron,"},"44":{"text":"Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,"},"45":{"text":"Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,"},"46":{"text":"Joppa galkhata om Me-jarkon le Rakkon-a gamte tawh huom hi."},"47":{"text":"Dan-te in a gam uh a tan bepun Dan-te kuonto-in Leshem a sim vua, amate manin namsau tawh a thazaw ciengun tua gam luo-in a sungah a teng vua, a pupi uh Dan’ min la-in Leshem pen Dan a phuo uhi.","ref":"Thkn 18:27-29"},"48":{"text":"Tam khu amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Dan minamte’ gouluo ahi a, tam khuopite, a khuoneute tawh ahi hi."},"49":{"text":"Amate in leitang tampitah gou-in a hawm sieng zaw ciengun Israel-te in Nun’ tapa Joshua zong amate lahah gouluo a pie uhi.","title":"Joshua’ Gouluo"},"50":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh bangin amate in ama’ nget khuopi, Ephraim muoltung gama om Timnath-serah pen ama a pie uhi. Ama in tua khuopi lamkia-in a sungah a teng hi."},"51":{"text":"Tam teng siempu Eleazar le Nun’ tapa Joshua le Israel minam innkuon lutangte in kikhopna buh lutna, Topa mai Shiloh ah aisanna tawh a hawm uh gouluote ahi hi. Tuaci’n amate in leitang hawmna a man uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Joshua hopi-in,","title":"Kibuhna khuopite (Gam 35:9-28 ; Thkna 19:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel-te kungah, ‘Moses tungtawnin na kunga kang gen bangin kibuhna khuopite se in."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n sawm lopi-in ahi a, thei lona ziehin ahi zongin mi khatpo a that khapa a tai thei nading ahi hi; tua teng pen note dingin sisan phulapa kung panin kibuhna hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam khuopite khatpo-ah mithatpa tai-in khuopi tunkot lutna-ah ding ding a, tua khuopi upate kungah a thu gen ding hi; tua ciengin khuopi sungah a taipa kipeipi-in om nading mun khat kipie ding a, amate tawh omton ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Phulapa in ama a nuadel leh amate in tuapa tungah mithatpa a pie sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile a vengpa pen theikhielna tawh kithat kha ahi bo a, a tawpsa hun sungin a vengpa tawh kigalneina bangma om lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Thukhenna thuoh dingin mihon mai-ah ama a din masangsie, le tua hun laitaha siempu lien pa a si masangsie-in, tua khuopi sungah ama om den ding hi: Tua zaw ciengin mi thatpa pen a khutkhielna khuo sunga a inn ah peikia thei ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Naphtali muoltung gam sunga om Galilee gam sung panin Kadesh, Ephraim muoltung gam sungah Shechem, le Judah muoltung gam sungah Kiriath-arba (Hebron a kici) khuote a tuomkoi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale amate in Jericho nisuona Jordan galkhatah Reuben minam sung panin muoltung zang sehnel gama om Bezer khuo, Gad minam sung panin Gilead gam sunga om Ramoth khuo, le Manasseh minam sung panin Bashan gam sunga om Golan khuote a se uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam teng pen Israel-te zosie le amate lahah a peem khuolmite adingin sawm lopi-a mi khatpo a that khapa in mihonpi mai-ah a din masang, phulapa khutlum tawh si loin a tai thei nadinga kise khuopite ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 35:6-32; Thkna 4:41-43; 19:1-13"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua, le Israel minam innkuon lutangte kungah Levi innkuon lutangte a va pei vua;","title":"Levi-te Kipie Khuopite (1Khg 6:54-81)"},"2":{"text":"Canaan gam Shiloh muna om amate kungah, “Ka ten nading uh khuopite le ka ganhonte vua dingin Moses tungtawnin a lonona gamte tawh ko ei kipieh ding Topa in thu pie zo hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Gam 35:1-8"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te in Topa’ thupiehsa bangin amau’ gouluo gamte sung panin Levi-te tungah a nei-a khuopite le lonona gamte a pie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kohath innkuonte dingin aisan tung hi. Tuaci’n siempu Aaron’ suonlehlah ahi Levi-te in Judah, Simeon, le Benjamin minamte tung panin aisanna tawh khuopi sawm le thum nga uhi."},"5":{"text":"A omlai Kohath-te in Ephraim minam, Dan minam, le Manasseh minam alangte tung panin aisanna tawh khuopi sawm nga uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gershon-te in Issachar minam, Asher minam, Naphtali minam, le Bashan gam sunga om Manasseh minam alangte tung panin aisanna tawh khuopi sawm le thum nga uhi."},"7":{"text":"Merari-te in amau’ innkuon tawh kizui-in Reuben minam, Gad minam, le Zebulun minamte tung panin khuopi sawm le ni nga uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungtawnin a thupiehsa bangin Israel-te in Levi-te tungah aisanna tawh tam khuopite le a lonona gamte a pie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Judah minam le Simeon minam sung panin a min kigiel tua khuopite a pie vua,"},"10":{"text":"amate tungah aisanna a tuh masah ziehin Levi-te ahi Kohath innkuon sung panin Aaron’ suonlehlahte tungah tuate tung hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in Judah muoltung gama Hebron a kici Kiriath-arba, (Arba pen Anak’ pa ahi hi) le a kimvela lonona gamte tawh a pie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua khuopi’ lote le a khuoneute pen Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah a nei dingin kipie zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in siempu Aaron’ suonle hlahte tungah mi thatte dinga kibuhna khuopi Hebron a lonona gamte tawh, Libnah a lonona gamte tawh,"},"14":{"text":"Jattir a lonona gamte tawh, Eshtemoa a lonona gamte tawh,"},"15":{"text":"Holon a lonona gamte tawh, Debir a lonona gamte tawh,"},"16":{"text":"Ain a lonona gamte tawh, Juttah a lonona gamte tawh, Beth-shemesh a lonona gamte tawh, tam minam nite sung panin khuopi kuo a pie uhi."},"17":{"text":"Benjamin minam sung panin Gibeon a lonona gamte tawh, Geba a lonona gamte tawh,"},"18":{"text":"Anathoth a lonona gamte tawh, Almon a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li a pie uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aaron suonlehlahte’ khuopite, a siempute a unpi-in khuopi sawm le thum le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Levi-te innkuon sung panin Kohath be ahi a omlai Kohath-te tungah a kipie khuopite pen Ephraim minamte-a’ sung pan ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ephraim muoltung gama om khuopite sung panin mi thatte adingin Shechem a lonona gamte tawh, Gezer a lonona gamte tawh,"},"22":{"text":"Kibzaim a lonona gamte tawh, Bethhoron a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li amate kipie hi."},"23":{"text":"Dan minam sung panin: Elteke a lonona gamte tawh, Gibbethon a lonona gamte tawh,"},"24":{"text":"Aijalon a lonona gamte tawh, Gath-rimmon a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li kipie hi."},"25":{"text":"Manasseh minam alangte sung panin: Taanach a lonona gamte tawh, Gath-rimmon a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi ni kipie hi."},"26":{"text":"Kohath innkuon a omlai mite gouluo nga khuopite a unpi-in a lonona gamte tawh khuopi sawm ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Levi innkuon sunga om Gershon-te tungah mi thatte kibuhna khuopi dingin Manasseh minam alangte gouluo nga sung panin Bashan gam sunga om Golan khuopi le a lonona gamte tawh, Beeshterah khuopi a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi ni kipie hi."},"28":{"text":"Issachar minam sung panin: Kishion-a lonona gamte tawh, Daberath a lonona gamte tawh,"},"29":{"text":"Jarmuth a lonona gamte tawh, En-gannim a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li kipie hi;"},"30":{"text":"Asher minamte sung panin Mishal a lonona gamte tawh, Abdon a lonona gamte tawh,"},"31":{"text":"Helkath a lonona gamte tawh, le Rehob a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li kipie hi."},"32":{"text":"Naphtali minamte sung panin: mi thatte kibuhna khuopi dingin Galilee gam sunga om Kedesh a lonona gamte tawh, Hammoth-dor a lonona gamte tawh, Kartan a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi thum kipie hi."},"33":{"text":"Gershon-te’ innkuon tuomtuomte’ khuopite a unpi-in sawm le thum le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Levi mi a omlai Merari innkuonte tungah, Zebulun minam sung panin: Jokneam a lonona gamte tawh, Kartan a lonona gamte tawh,"},"35":{"text":"Dimnah a lonona gamte tawh, Nahalal a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li kipie hi."},"36":{"text":"Reuben minam sung panin: Bezer a lonona gamte tawh, Jahaz a lonona gamte tawh,"},"37":{"text":"Kedemoth a lonona gamte tawh, Mephaath a lonona gamte tawh, khuopi li kipie hi."},"38":{"text":"Gad minam sung panin: mi thatte adingin kibuhna khuopi Ramoth le a lonona gamte tawh, Mahanaim a lonona gamte tawh,"},"39":{"text":"Heshbon a lonona gamte tawh, Jezar a lonona gamte tawh, a unpi-in khuopi li kipie hi."},"40":{"text":"Levi innkuon a omlai ahi Merari innkuon tuomtuomte ading khuopi kipiete a unpi-in sawm le ni ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Israel-te’ gouluo lahah Levi-te’ khuopi a unpi-in a lonona gamte tawh sawm li le giet ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tam khuopite in a kimvel vuah lonona gam a nei ciet uhi; tami khuopi zosie zong tua bang ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tam bangin Topa in amau’ pu le pate tungah pieh dinga a na ciemsa leitang zosie Israel tungah pie a, amate in tua gam luo-in tua munah a teng uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tuale a pu a pate tungah a ciemsa bangin sil bangkimah Topa in amate a lungmuongsah hi; Topa in amau’ khut sungah a gal zosie uh a pieh ziehin a galte uh khat beh in amate nang zo lo hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te tunga a ciemsa thuhoi zosie khat beh a pelem om lo hi; a unpi-in tangtung kim hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Reuben-te, Gad-te le Manasseh minam alangte hlan a,","title":"Nisuona Lama Minamte A Gam Vuah Kilekia"},"2":{"text":"a kung vuah, “ Topa’ nasem Moses in ang thupieh zosie a unpi-in na zui sieng zo ta vua, kang thupiehna zosie-ah ka thu na mang zo ta uhi;","ref":"Gam 32:20-32; Josh 1:12-15"},"3":{"text":"tam ni tampi sung tuni dongin na unaute na taisan sih vua, Topa na Pasien uh’ ang sawlna limtahin na zui zo ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale tu-in ama in a ciemsa bangin Topa na Pasien un amate tawlngahna a pie hi; tua ahi ziehin Topa’ nasem Moses in ang piehsa Jordan galkhat, na tan ding uh gama om na puonbuh lam vuah kihei-in pei un."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses in ang pieh thupiehna le thuhilna ahi, Topa na Pasien uh it ding, a lampi zosie zui ding, a thupiehnate zui ding, ama bel ding le na lungsim zosie ule na hinna zosie utawh ama’ na nasep ding uh limtahin ngaisun un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joshua in amate thupha pie-in peisah a, tuale amate a innlam vuah a pei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in Manasseh minam alangte tungah Moses in Jordan nisuona lam Bashan gam sungah amau’ tan ding gam pie zo hi; hinanle Joshua in adang alangte tungah Jordan nitumna a unaute uh Israel-te tungah neisa a pie hi. Joshua in a puonbuh vuah amate sawldawhin thupha a pieh ciengin,"},"8":{"text":"ama in a kung vuah, “Hauna lienpi, ganhon tampi le ngun, kham, sumngo, sia le puon tampi tawh na puonbuh vuah peikia un; na galte uh’ van na tomte uh na unaute tawh hawm un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte, Moses tungtawnin Topa’ thupieh banga a nga uh amau’ leitang ahi Gilead gam zuon dingin Canaan gam sunga om Shiloh munah Israel-te tawh kikhenin inn ah a kilekia uhi."},"10":{"text":"Canaan gam sung Jordan gei-a om gam ah a tun ciengun Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte in Jordan gei-a tua munah maitam gol mama khat a lam uhi.","title":"Jordan Nisuona Lama Phawna Maitam"},"11":{"text":"Israel-te in Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte in Jordan gei-a om gam sung, Canaan gamgi dung, Israel-te’ gam lampangah maitam khat a lam uh a za uhi."},"12":{"text":"Israel-te in tua thu a zah ciengun amate a do dingin Shiloh munah Israel mihon buppi a kikhawm uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in Gilead gama Reuben-te, Gad-te le Manasseh minam alangte kungah siempu Eleazar tapa Phinehas,"},"14":{"text":"le ama tawh uhpi mi sawm, Israel minam innkuon panin khat ciet, Israel innkuonte lahah innkuon lutang ahite vive sawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Gilead gam sunga om Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte kungah amate pei-in a kung vuah,"},"16":{"text":"“ Topa’ mihon buppi in, ‘ Topa ledona-ah tuni-in noma dingin maitam khat lamna tawh Topa zuina panin kihei-in Israel Pasien tungah na gamtatna sa uh ahi tam na letatna ukhu bang bep ahei?","ref":"Thkna 12:6, 13-14"},"17":{"text":"Topa’ mihon buppi tungah khum zieha gimna khat ang tunna, ei le ei i kisiensuo nai lona uh ahi Peor-a i mawna uh kicing sa nai vaset loin, tuni-in Topa zuina panin kiheikia ding na hi uh amah? Tuni-in Topa na ledo uleh zing ciengin Israel mi vannuoi tungah ama ang lungthah ding hi.","ref":"Gam 25:1-9","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in na leitang uh a sieng lo ahile Topa’ biehbuh kitunna mun Topa’ leitangah hing pei unlen kote lahah luo hing nei un; Topa ledo beh sih unlen, ahi sihle Topa i Pasien’ maitam ahi lo noma dinga maitam khat lamna tawh kote ei ledo sih un."},"20":{"text":"A ki-ap vante tungah Zerah’ tapa Achan a muonhuoi lo ziehin Israel mihonpi zosie tungah lungthahna tung hi lo amah? Ama’ mawna ziehin ama beh si lo hi!’ ci uhi,” ci-in a gen uhi.","ref":"Josh 7:1-26"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Reuben-te, Gad-te le Manasseh minam alangte in Israel innkuon lutangte dawngin,"},"22":{"text":"“ Topa , pasien-te’ Pasien!, Topa , pasien-te’ Pasien! Ama in thei hi; Israel-te in zong thei ta uheh! Tam khu ledona ahi a, Topa upna pana ka peikhiel nading ule, Topa zuina pana ka piel nading vua maitam lam ka hi uleh tuni-in kote ei hinkhawi da heh; tua ahi sihle zong tua tungah meihal biehna ahi a, an tawh biehna ahi a, thunuam biehna ahi zongin pieh nadinga a lam ka hi uleh Topa mama in ei thuh taheh.","merge":"23"},"24":{"text":"Tua bang ahi sih hi! Ang tung ding hunte-ah na tate un ka tate uh kungah, ‘Israel Pasien Topa tawh no bang kisai na hi uh ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile no Reuben-te le Gad-te, le ko kikalah Topa in gamgi dingin Jordan bawl zo hi; Topa sungah tanh na nei sih uhi,’ a ci khah ding uh zauna tawh ka bawl uh ahi bo hi. Tuaci’n ka tate un Topa a bieh ding uh na tate un khahtan kha ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin, ‘Meihal biehna ahi a, biehpiehna ding ahi zongin hi loin, ama opna ah ka meihal biehnate uh, ka biehpiehnate ule thunuam-a ka biehnate utawh Topa’ na kasep na uh ko le no kikal le ei haw zaw cienga i suonlehlahte kikalah teci dingin maitam khat bawl vai. Tua bang hi sih mawh leh ang tung ding hunte-ah na tate un ka tate uh kungah, “ Topa sungah tanh na nei sih uhi,” ci thei kha ding uhi,’ ka ci uhi.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Tua ziehin ang tung ding hunte-ah ko tung ahi a, ka suonlehlahte uh tungah ahi zongin tam bangin ang kici leh, ‘Meihal biehna ding ahi a, biehpiehna ding ahi zongin hi loin, no le ko kikalah teci dinga ka pu ka pate un a bawl Topa’ maitam lim en un,’ i ci ding uhi, ci-in ka ngaituo uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama biehbuh mai-a om Topa ka Pasien uh’ maitam simlo meihal biehna ahi a, an tawh biehna ahi a, biehpiehna ding ahi zongin maitam khat lamna tawh Topa ledo-in Topa zuina pana a piel ka hi vawt sih uhi."},"30":{"text":"Siempu Phinehas le ama tawh a om mihon uhpi, Israel innkuon lutangte in Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh-te thugen a zah ciengun a lungkim mama uhi."},"31":{"text":"Siempu Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in Reuben-te, Gad-te le Manasseh-te kungah, “ Topa dona sil sie na bawl lo ziehun eite lahah Topa om hi, ci-in tuni-in i thei hi. Tu-in note in Topa in gim a pieh nading panin Israel-te na hunkhie uhi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gilead gama om Reuben-te le Gad-te kung panin Israel-te opna Canaan gamah Eleazar’ tapa siempu Phinehas le uhpite kilekia-in amate kungah thu a puoh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua a thupuoh un Israel-te lungdamsah hi; tuale Israel-te in Pasien phatin Reuben-te le Gad-te’ tenna leitang susie-in amate gala a sim ding uh thu a gen nawn sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Reuben-te le Gad-te in tua maitam “Teci” ci-in phuo uhi; “Azieh pen Topa in Pasien a hina thu i kikal vuah teci khat ahi hi,” a ci uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Israel’ kimvela om a galte zosie panun tawlngahna a pieh zaw a sawtpi ciengin Joshua zong vuoi-in kum tampi pha ta hi.","title":"Joshua in Mite Thuhil"},"2":{"text":"Joshua in Israel zosie, upate le makaite, thukhente le uliente hlanin a kung vuah, “Tu-in kei vuoi-in kum tampi ka pha ta hi;"},"3":{"text":"tuale note ziehin Topa na Pasien un tam minam zosie tungah a sepsa zosie na mu zo ta uhi. Bang ding ahei cile note dinga gal ang dopieh pa khu Topa na Pasien uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A omlai minamte ahile Jordan panin Tuipi Lien nitumna lam donga keima in ka suhmangthaisa minamte zosie tawh, na minamte uh’ gouluo dingin na tung vuah kang pie zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na mai vuah amate nua sawnin na muna panun a notmang ding hi; tuale Topa na Pasien un na tung vua ang ciem bangin amau’ gam na luo ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Moses’ thukham laibu sunga kigielte zosie limtahin zui-in semin, ziet le vei-ah piel sih unlen,"},"7":{"text":"tuaci’n tam sunga na lah vua a omlai tam minamte tawh kicisaw loin, a pasiente uh’ min lo loin, tuate tawh zong kiciem loin, amau’ na zong sem loin, amau’ mai-ah zong kun sih unlen,"},"8":{"text":"tuni donga na gamtat bangun Topa na Pasien uh pom lenlon zaw un."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in na mai vuah a lien le a thahat minamte a delmang zo ta hi; note ahile tuni dongin koima khat beh in ang nang zo nai sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na tung vua ang ciemsa bangin note dinga ang dopieh pa khu Topa na Pasien uh ahi ziehin note mi khat in mi tulkhat na taimangsah zo uhi.","ref":"Thkna 3:22; 32:30"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa na Pasien uh na it ding uh hoitahin ngaisun un."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note nuakia-in tam sunga na lah vua om a hing sun teng tawh kipawlin amate tawh kitengin, note in a numeite tenpi-in amate in zong na numeite a tenpi uleh,"},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un na mai vuah tam minamte a notmang nawn sih ding hi, ci-in teltahin thei ta un; ahi vangin Topa na Pasien un ang pieh tam gam hoi panin na manthai masangun amate no adingin piel le thang ang hi ding vua, na pang uh kisatna ciengduoi le na mit sung uh ang sun ling tawh kibang ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Tu-in leitung mi zosie’ ngaina zui-in a pei ding ka hi ta a, Topa na Pasien un note tawh kisai a kamciem zosie pelem lo hi, ci na lungsim ule na hinna zosie vuah na thei uhi; a unpi-in note dingin tangtungin khat zong kipelh lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin note tawh kisai-in Topa na Pasien un ang kamciem na hoi zosie note dingin ang tangtun bang lienin Topa na Pasien un ang piehsa tam leitang hoi panin note ang suhsiet masangin, Topa in na tung vuah sietna zosie ang tungsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in ang piehsa Topa na pasien uh’ thuciemna palsatin pasien dangte kungah pei-in, a na uh semin, a mai vua na kun uleh, Topa na Pasien un note tawh kisai ang ciem sil hoi zosie a tun ma bangin, na tung vuah Topa lungthahna ang kuong ding a, note tunga ang pieh leitang hoi panin mallangin na mangthai ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in Shechem-ah Israel minam zosie a kaikhawm a, a upate, a makaite, a thukhente, le a vaihawmte hlan hi; tuale Pasien mai-ah amate ciet a kipulah uhi.","title":"Minamte in Thuciemna Thasuosah"},"2":{"text":"Joshua in mite kungah, “Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Tang lai-in na pu na pate uh - Terah le a tapate Abraham le Nahor- Euphrates gun galkhatah tengin pasien dangte’ na sem uhi.","ref":"Pien 11:27"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin gungal panin na pu uh Abraham la-in Canaan gam muncin tengah ka peipi kawikawi a, a suonlehlahte tampi ka phasah hi. Ama tungah Isaac ka pie a,","ref":"Pien 12:1-9; 21:1-3"},"4":{"text":"Isaac tungah Jacob le Esau ka pie hi. A nei dingin Seir muoltung gam Esau ka pie a, hizongle Egypt ah Jacob le a tate a peisuh uhi.","ref":"Pien 25:24-26; 36:8; 46:1-7; Thkna 2:5"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in Moses le Aaron sawlin a gam sunga ka sepnate tawh Egypt ka gimsah a, tua zaw ciengin note kang peipi hi.","ref":"Pei 3:1–12:42"},"6":{"text":"Egypt panin na pu na pate uh ka peipi ciengin tuipi na tung uhi; tuale Egypt-te in na pu na pate uh’ leeng le sakol tung tuongte tawh San Tuipi dong del uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa tungah a kiko ciengun ama in note le Egypt-te kikalah khuomiel koi a, a tung vuah tuipi luongsahin amate a hlummang sah hi; tuale Egypt tunga ka bawl nate na mit utawh na mu uhi. tua zaw ciengin senel gamah zong hun sawtpi na teng uhi.","ref":"Pei 14:1-31"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jordan galkhata teng Amor-te’ leitangah note kang peipi hi; amate in hing do-in, na khut sung vuah amate kang pie hi, tuale a leitang uh na luo vua, keima in na mai vuah amate ka susie hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel do dingin Moab kumpipa Zippor’ tapa Balak a kuon hi. Ama in note ang samsie dingin Beor’ tapa Balaam cielin sawl a,"},"10":{"text":"ahi vangin keima in Balaam thu ka mang sih hi; tua ziehin ama in note thupha ang pie hi; tuaci’n keima in Balak khut sung panin note kang hunkhie hi.","ref":"Gam 22:1–24:25"},"11":{"text":"Jordan galkhatah pei-in Jericho na tun ciengun, Jericho khuo mite in ang do uhi. Tuale Amor-te, Periz-te, Canaan-te, Hit-te, Girgash-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te in zong note ang do vua, na khut sung vuah amate kang pie hi.","ref":"Josh 3:14-17; 6:1-21"},"12":{"text":"Na masang vuah tunpi ka sawl a, tua in na mai panun Amor kumpi nite a delmang hi; tua khu na namsau ule na thaltang utawh na nawkhiet uh ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pei 23:28; Thkna 7:20"},"13":{"text":"Na sep lo uh leitang, na sat lo uh khuopite kang pie a, tuate sungah na teng uhi; na suon lo uh lenggui huon pan le olive lo panin a ga na ne uhi.","ref":"Thkna 6:10-11"},"14":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Topa zatah unlen, lungsim tahpi le thumanna tawh ama’ na sem un; na pu na pate un Gun gal le Egypt gam sungah a na a seppieh uh pasien-te koi dawh ta unlen, Topa’ na sem ta un."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Topa’ na na sep nuom sih uleh, gun galkhatah a na na seppieh uh na pu na pate uh’ pasien ahi a, na tenna uh gam sunga om Amor-te’ pasien ahi zongin, a na na seppieh ding popo uh tuni-in teel un; ahi vangin kei le ka innkuonpite in ahile Topa’ na ka sem ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin mite in a dawng vua, “Adang pasiente’ na sem dingin Topa ka taisan vawt sih ding uhi;"},"17":{"text":"azieh pen saltanna Egypt gam panin eite le i pu i pate ei peipi-in, i muna vua tua bang lim thupite a bawl pa khu Topa i Pasien ahi hi. Ama in i peina lampi tungtawn le i nawh khah mi zosie lahah eite ei kemcing hi;"},"18":{"text":"tuale Topa in i mai vuah tua gama teng Amor-te zosie a notmang hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama i Pasien ahi ziehin eite in zong Topa’ na i sem ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle Joshua in mite kungah, “ Topa’ na na sem thei sih ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile ama pen a siengtho Pasien ahi a, a thangsie Pasien zong ahi hi; ama in na thupalsatnate uh ahi a, na mawnate uh ahi zongin ang maisah sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa taisanin gamdang pasien-te’ na na sep uleh, na tung vuah ama ang migit zaw ciengin kihei-in na tung vuah sietna bawlin ang maimangsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Mite in Joshua kungah, “Hi lo hi, Topa’ na ka sem bo ding uhi!” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joshua in mite kungah, “ Topa’ na sep ding na teelna vuah no le no teci na hi uhi,” a ci hi. Tuale amate in, “Teci ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua ahile note lahah a om gamdang pasien-te paidawh unlen, Israel Pasien, Topa lamah na lungsim uh nga un,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Mite in Joshua kungah, “ Topa ka Pasien’ na ka sem ding vua, a thu ka mang ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in Joshua in mite tawh Shechem ah thuciemna bawl a, amate dingin thukham le biehna ngaina kipte a bawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Joshua in Pasien’ thukham laibu sungah tam thute a giel hi. Ama in suongtum golpi khat la-in tua muna Topa’ biehinn sung gangpi sing kung nei-ah phut hi."},"27":{"text":"Joshua in mi zosie kungah, “En un, tam suongtum i langkhat vuah teci ahi ding hi; azieh pen Topa in i kunga a thugen zosie tam suongtum in a za zo hi; tua ahi ziehin na Pasien uh tungah a man loin na gamtat khah uleh, tam suongtum khu na langkhat vuah teci hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n amau’ gouluona cietah Joshua in mite a peisah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam thu teng zaw ciengin, Topa’ nasem Nun’ tapa Joshua si a, a khan kum za le kum sawm pha hi.","title":"Joshua le Eleazar Sina"},"30":{"text":"Amate in a gouluo gam Gaash Muolvum leilu lam Ephraim muoltung gama om Timnath-serah ah ama a vui uhi.","ref":"Josh 19:49-50"},"31":{"text":"Joshua’ khang sung tungtawn le Joshua sanga si nukhia zaw upate’ khang sung tungtawnin Israel in Topa’ na sem a, tuale amate in Topa in Israel dinga a sep zosie a thei uhi."},"32":{"text":"Israel-te in Egypt pana a puoh uh Joseph’ gute, Shechem’ pa Hamor’ tapate tung panin Jacob in dangka zakhat tawh a leina Shechem khuo leikhawh sungah a vui uhi; tam mun pen Joseph suonlehlahte’ gouluo gam a suoh hi.","ref":"Pien 33:19; 50:24-25; Pei 13:19; Jhn 4:5; Sawl 7:16"},"33":{"text":"Aaron’ tapa Eleazar a si hi; tuale amate in Ephraim muoltung gam sunga a tapa Phinehas tunga kipie Gibeah ah ama a vui uhi."}}}}},"7":{"info":{"name":"Thukhente","shortname":"Thkn","abbr":[],"desc":"Thukhente laibu (the book of judges)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua a si zaw ciengin Topa kungah Israel-te in thu a dong vua, “Canaan-te sim dingin koi kuonto masa ding ka hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Canaan a Unpi-in Israel-te in Zo Lo (Josh 15:13-19)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Judah kuonto ding hi. Ama’ khut sungah tua gam ka pie hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Judah in a sanggam Simeon kungah, “Canaan-te sim dingin kei ei kipie gamah ei zui to in; kei zong nang ang kipie gam sungah kang zui ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Simeon in ama a zui hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah kuonto a, Topa in a khut sung vuah Canaan-te le Periz-te a pie hi; tuale amate in Bezek khuo-ah mi tul sawm a that uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in Bezek-ah Adoni-bezek a tuoh vua, tuale ama tawh kido-in Canaan-te le Periz-te a zo uhi."},"6":{"text":"Adoni-bezek a tai hi; ahi vangin ama delin a man vua, a khutpi gel le a kepi gel a tansanpieh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Adoni-bezek in, “A khutpi le a kepi a kitansan kumpi sawmsagite in ka sabuoi nei-a annengkiete tung ngai uhi; ka gamtatnasa bangin Pasien in kei ei thuh hi,” a ci hi. Amate in Jerusalem ah ama a peipi vua, tuale khum munah ama a si hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah mite in Jerusalem khuo simin a la uhi. Amate in namsau tawh vatin mei tawh khuopi a hal uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Negeb gam sunga muoltung gam, le lei ngiemna sunga teng Canaan-te sim dingin Judah mite a kuonsuh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hebron (Hebron min pen nidanglai-in Kiriath-arba kici) a teng Canaan-te sim dingin Judah a kuon hi; tuale amate in Sheshai, Ahiman, le Talmai a zo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khum mun panin Debir (Debir min pen nidang lai-in Kiriath-sepher kici) a tengte sim dingin a pei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Caleb in, “Kiriath-sepher simin a la zo poma a zi dingin ka tanu Achsah ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale Caleb’ naupa Kenaz’ tapa Othniel in tua khuo la hi; tuale ama in a zi dingin a tanu Achsah a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama kungah tua nu a tun ciengin a pa kungah lo khat a nget nading tua nu a hasawl hi. A laa tung panin tua nu a kum ciengin Caleb in ama kungah, “Bang dei na hiei?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nu in ama kungah, “Letsong khat ei pie in; Negeb gam sungah keima nei koi ngalin Gulloth-mayim zong ei pie vet in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Caleb in zong Gulloth Tungnung le Gulloth Neinung a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Moses’ sungpa Ken minam Hobab’ suonlehlahte, Arad gei Negeb gama om Judah-te’ senel gamah Judah mite tawh lutu khuopi panin a peito vua, Amalek-te tawh a tengton uhi."},"17":{"text":"A sanggam Simeon tawh Judah peiton a, Zephath-a teng Canaan-te zo-in a khuopi a susie uhi. Tuaci’n khumi khuopi’ min Hormah kici hi."},"18":{"text":"Judah in Gaza le a gam, Ashkelon le a gam, Ekron le a gamte a la hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Judah ompi hi, tuale ama in muoltung gam teng luo a, ahi vangin zang gama tengte delmang zo lo hi, azieh pen amate in sia sakol leeng nei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Moses in a gensa bangin Caleb tungah Hebron kipie hi; tuale ama in khum panin Anak’ tapa thumte a delmang hi.","ref":"Josh 15:13-14"},"21":{"text":"Hinanle Benjamin-te in Jerusalem-a teng Jebus-te na delmang lo uhi, tuaci’n tuni dongin Benjamin-te tawh Jerusalem ah Jebus-te tengton uhi.","ref":"Josh 15:63; 2Sam 5:6; 1Khg 11:4"},"22":{"text":"Bethel sim dingin Joseph’ innkuonte a kuonto uhi; tuale Topa in amate a ompi hi."},"23":{"text":"Joseph’ innkuonte in Bethel (tua khuopi min pen nidang lai-in Luz kici) ah thukante a sawl uhi."},"24":{"text":"Thukante in khuopi pana a pusuoh mi khat a mu ciengun ama kungah, “Khuopi lutna lampi ei lah in, hoitahin kang bawl ding uh,” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in khuopi sung lutna lampi amate lah hi; tuale amate in tua khuopi namsau tawh a vatmai vua, ahi vangin tua mipa le a innkuonte a suohtasah uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hit-te gamah tua mipa pei-in khuopi khat sat a, a min Luz ci-in a phuoh hi. Tuni dongin a min kici suoh hi."},"27":{"text":"Manasseh in Beth-shean le a khuoneute-a tengte, Taanach le a khuoneute-a tengte, Dor le a khuoneute-a tengte, Ibleam le a khuoneute-a tengte, Meggido le a khuoneute-a tengte a delmang lo ziehin khum gam sungah Canaan-te a teng suoh uhi."},"28":{"text":"Israel-te a thahat ciengun Canaan-te thona-aana nasep a semsah vua, ahi vangin amate a delmang sih uhi.","ref":"Josh 17:11-13"},"29":{"text":"Ephraim-te in Gezer-a teng Canaan-te a delmang sih uhi; hizongle Gezer-a amate lahah Canaan-te a teng uhi.","ref":"Josh 16:10"},"30":{"text":"Zebulun-te in Kitron-a tengte ahi a, Nahalol-a tengte ahi zongin a delmang sih uhi; ahi vangin amate lahah Canaan-te tengin thona-aana nasemte a suoh uhi."},"31":{"text":"Asher-te in Acco-a tengte, Sidon-a tengte, Ahlab-a tengte, Akzib-a tengte, Helbah-a tengte, le Aphik-a tengte, Rehob-a tengte a notmang sih vua,"},"32":{"text":"hizongle khum gama teng Canaan-te lahah Asher-te a teng uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in a delmang sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Naphtali-te in Beth-shemesh a tengte, Beth-anath a tengte notmang loin khum gama om Canaan mite lahah a teng zaw uhi; hizongle Beth-shemesh a tengte, Beth-anath a tengte pen amate dingin thona-aana nasemte a suoh uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amor-te in muoltung gamah Dan-te a notkia vua, zang gamah a peisuhsah sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Har-heres, Aijalon, le Shaalbim-ah Amor-te a teng suoh vua, hizongle a tung vuah Joseph innkuonte’ khut gihtahin kinga-in thona-aana nasemte a suoh uhi."},"36":{"text":"Amor-te’ gamgi pen Akrabbim katona panin Sela le a tunglam teng pana kipan ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Gilgal panin Bochim ah Topa’ vantungmi peito a, “Egypt panin kang peipito a, na pu na pate kungah pieh dinga ka kamciemsa leitangah kang lutpi zo hi. Keima in, ‘No tawh ka thuciemna ka palsat ngai sih ding hi.","title":"Israel-te’ Thumanlona"},"2":{"text":"No lam panin khum gama tengte tawh thuciemna bawl sih un. A maitamte uh phelmang un,’ kang ci hi; ahi vangin kang thupieh na mang sih uhi. Bang bawl na hi uh ahei en un!","ref":"Pei 34:12-13; Thkna 7:2-5"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in na mai panun amate ka delmang sih ding hi, ka ci hi. Ahi vangin amate pen na gal uh suoh ding a, amau’ pasien-te no dingin thang ahi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in Israel-te zosie tungah tam thute a gen ciengin mite kiko-in a kap uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum mun Bochim ci-in min a phuo vua, khumi munah Topa tungah biehpiehna a pie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Joshua in mite a peisah zaw ciengin a luo ding uh gam la dingin Israel-te a unpi-un a kuon uhi.","title":"Joshua’ Sina"},"7":{"text":"Joshua’ hin sung le ama sanga a sawt hinzaw upate zosie’ hin sung tungtawnin mite in Topa’ na a sem vua, Topa in Israel-te dinga a sep na lienpite a mu uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Nun’ tapa Joshua kum za le sawmkhat a phahin a si hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gaash muol leilu lam, Ephraim muoltung gam sunga om Timnath-heres khuo-a ama’ luona huom sungah ama a vui uhi.","ref":"Josh 19:49-50"},"10":{"text":"Tham loin tua khang mite zosie a pu a pate uh kungah a kigawm vua, amau’ nua-ah Topa hile, Israel-te dinga a septe hile a thei lo khang dang khat a khang hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa muna-ah Israel-te siet gamtatin Baal-te a bie uhi;","title":"Israel-te Muonhuoi lona"},"12":{"text":"tuale Egypt gam pana amate a peipi a pu a pate uh’ Pasien ahi Topa a nuasie uhi; amate in a kimkot vua mite’ pasien-te nua a zui vua, tuate mai-ah kunin Topa a lungthahsah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in Topa nuasie-in Baal le Astartes pasien-te a bie uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel tungah Topa a sin so a, a na uh a lahpieh le a na uh a sut mite tungah amate a pie a, a kimvel vua a galte uh tungah zua-in, tuaci’n amate in a galte a nang zo nawn sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Gal sim dinga a kuon sielun, Topa in a kung vua a genkholsa le a ciemsa bangin amau’ langkhatah Topa’ khut pangin hamsietna tungsah hi; tuale amate a lungdong mama uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin a na uh a lahpieh mite’ khut sung panin amate a hunkhie dingin Topa in thukhente a khangsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a thukhente uh’ thu nangawn a ngai nuom sih uhi; azieh pen amate in pasien dangte lunggulin tuate mai-ah a kun uhi. Topa’ thupiehte a mang a pu a pate uh’ na zui lampi panin amate a piel zuoi vua, a gamtat dan uh a zui ta sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amate dingin Topa in thukhente a koi sielin Topa in thukhente ompi a, thukhente hin sung tungtawnin a galte uh’ khut sung panin amate a hunkhie hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate a gimsah le a bawlsie mite ziehin amau’ tauna a khuotuo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hizongle thukhente a si sielin amate nuatawn kia-in a pu a pate sangin a sie zaw-in a gamta vua, pasien dangte’ nua zui-in a mai vuah kunin a bie uhi. A gamtatnate uh ahi a, a lungkhauhnate uh ahi zongin a khie tuon sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te tungah Topa a sin a so hi; tuale ama in, “Tam mite in a pu a pate uh tunga ka thupieh ka thuciemna palsatin ka thu a ngai lo ziehun,"},"21":{"text":"Joshua in a si lai-a a nuasie minamte khat mama zong a mai vuah ka delpieh nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"A pu a pate un Topa’ lampi a zui bangun amate in a zui le a zui lo uh Israel-te ze-et nadingin"},"23":{"text":"Topa in tua minamte thakhatin delmang loin hen phot lai a, Joshua’ khut sungah amate a pie sih hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Canaan gamah galsimna a thei kha nai lo Israel-te ze-et nadinga Topa in a hen minamte ahi uhi.","title":"Gam Sunga A Omlai Minamte"},"2":{"text":"(Israel khang sawnsawnte in galsimna a thei nading, nidangin galsimna a thei ngai lote tungah galsim zie a hil nading beh ahi hi.) :"},"3":{"text":"Philistia gamuh mi ngate, Canaan-te zosie, Sidon-te, le Baal-hermon Muol panin Lebo-hamath lutna cieng dong Lebanon Muol tunga teng Hiv-te ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Moses tungtawnin amau’ pu le pate tunga a thupiehsa ahi Topa’ thupiehnate, Israel-te in a mang uh amah ci a kithei nadingin tua teng pen Israel-te ki-zelahna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Canaan-te, Hit-te, Amor-te, Periz-te, Hiv-te, le Jebus-te’ lahah Israel-te a teng uhi;"},"6":{"text":"amate in a tanute uh zi-in la-in amau’ tanute a tapate uh’ zi dingin a pie uhi. Amate in a pasien-te uh a bie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa muna-ah Israel-te a siet gamtat vua, Topa a Pasien uh mangngilin Baal-te le Asherah milimte a bie uhi.","title":"Othniel"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel-te tungah Topa a sin so a, ama in Aram-naharaim kumpipa Khushan-rishathaim tungah amate a zua hi. Israel-te in kum giet sung Kushan-rishathaim’ na a sem uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanle Topa tungah Israel-te a kiko ciengun Israel-te’ tanpa dingin Topa in Caleb’ naupa Kenaz’ tapa Othniel a khangsah hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama tungah Topa’ hlagau tung a, ama in Israel-te thu a khen hi; galsim dingin ama kuon a, tuale Topa in a khut sungah Aram kumpipa Kushan-rishathaim pie a, ama in Kushan-rishathaim a zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n a gam in kum sawmli sung tawlngahna a nei hi. Tua ciengin Kenaz’ tapa Othniel a si hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa muna-ah Israel-te a siet gamtat kia uhi; tuaci’n Israel-te do dingin Topa in Moab kumpipa Eglon a thahatsah hi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa muna-ah amate a siet gamtat uhi.","title":"Ehud"},"13":{"text":"Ammon-te le Amalek-te tawh kipawlin ama kuonin Israel a zo hi; tuale amate in lutu khuopi a la uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te in Moab kumpi Eglon’ na kum sawm le giet sung a sem uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa tungah Israel-te a kiko ciengun Topa in amate hunkhie dingin Benjamin-te, Gera’ tapa, a veilawng pa, Ehud a khangsah hi. Israel-te in Moab kumpipa Eglon tungah ama tungtawnin sieh le kaih a puoh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ehud in ama dingin a langni-a a hiem, tong khat a sau namsau khat bawl hi; ama in a puonnei a zietlam phei tungah tua namsau a khi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Moab kumpipa Eglon tungah sieh le kaih a pie hi. Eglon pen a thau mama khat ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ehud in sieh le kaih a pieh zaw ciengin sieh le kaih a puohte a lampi vuah a peisah hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Gilgal kunga suong kikheng milimte opna panin ama kilekia a, “Kumpipa aw, nang adingin thusim gen ding khat ka nei hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa in, “Na dai vuo!” a ci-a, ama a cing zosie a kung panin a pusuoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Innkhumzang a innkhan vot sungah ama tanga a to laitahin ama kungah Ehud pei-in, “Pasien kung panin nang tungah gen ding thu khat ka nei hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama a tona panin a dingto hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ehud in a zietlam phei-a om namsau a veilam khut tawh manin Eglon’ gilpi a dawt hi;"},"22":{"text":"a namsau banah a nambul tumsuh a, a gil panin a namsau dawh lo ahi ziehin a thau in a namsau tuommangin a eeh a lawt hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin talaap -ah Ehud pusuohin ama tunga innkhumzang innkhan kotte khahin tuate a kil hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama a peizaw ciengin nasemte a pei uhi. Innkhumzang inndei kotkhah kikil a mu ciengun amate in, “Ama inndei vot sunga awng haw hi va,” ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n a ci nading uh thei lo za dongin a ngah vua, a innkhumzang kotte a hon tuon nai lo ciengin tawhtang la-in a hong uleh a pupa uh a sisa-in tuong tunga a lum a mu uhi."},"26":{"text":"Amate a kiheh kalun Ehud suohta-in suong milimte kalsan a, Seirah-ah tai-in a suohta hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama a tun ciengin Ephraim muoltung gamah pengkul tum hi; tuale muoltung gam panin ama tawh Israel-te peisuhin a lutang dingun ama a koi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Ka nua ei zui un; bangzieh ahei cile Topa in na khut sung vuah na galte uh ahi Moab-te ang pie zo hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in a nua zuisuh vua, Moab peina Jordan tanmunte la-in koima’ galkai ding a phal sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Khum hunin a thahat, a siem Moab-te zosie tul sawm bang a that uhi; a suohta koima a om sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in Israel-te’ khut sungah Moab-te in guol lel uhi. Khum gam in kum sawmgiet sung tawlngah hun a nei hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin ciengzum khat tawh Philistia-te mi zaguh a that pa Anath’ tapa Shamgar a khang hi. Ama in zong Israel-te a hunkhie hi.","title":"Shamgar"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ehud a si zaw ciengin Topa muna-ah Israel-te a siet gamtatkia uhi.","title":"Deborah le Barak"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Hazor-a kumpi sem, Canaan kumpipa Jabin’ khut sungah amate a pie hi; ama’ galkapmangpa pen Harosheth-ha-goiim ah a teng Sisera ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin huna ngen dingin Topa tungah Israel-te kiko uhi; azieh pen ama in sia sakol leeng zakuo nei a, Israel-te kum sawmni sung nahpi tahin a bawlsie hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hunin Lappidoth’ zi kamsang numei Deborah in Israel-te thu a khen hi."},"5":{"text":"Ephraim muoltung gam sung Ramah le Bethel kikala om Deborah lutu kung nei-ah ama to zel hi; tuale thukhensah dingin ama kungah Israel-te a peito uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in mi sawlin Naphtali gam Kedesh panin Abinoam’ tapa Barak hlansahin ama kungah, “ Topa , Israel-te’ Pasien in, ‘Pei in, Tabor Muol tungah panmun la inlen, Naphtali minam le Zebulun minam sung panin mi tulsawm zawpi in."},"7":{"text":"Keima in Jabin’ galkapmangpa Sisera, a sakol leengte le a galkapte tawh Kishon Lui ah nangma tawh kimu dingin ka kaidawh ding hi; tuale keima in na khut sungah ama kang pie ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Barak in tua nu kungah, “Nang tawh i zaw ding leh ka pei ding hi; nang tawh i zaw sih ding leh ka pei sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Kang zawpi valon ding hi; ahi vangin na peina ding lampi in nang minthanna ang tunpi sih ding hi, azieh pen Topa in numei khat’ khut sungah Sisera a pie ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Deborah dingin Barak tawh Kedesh ah a pei hi."},"10":{"text":"Barak in Kedesh ah Zebulun-te le Naphtali-te a thuta hi; tuale a nua-ah galhang mi tulsawm kuonto uhi; tuale ama tawh Deborah a kuonto hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in Ken-te Herber in Moses’ sungpa Hobab’ suon le hlahte ahi adang Ken-te tawh a kikhen a, Kadesh gei-a Elon-bezaanannim cieng dongah a puonbuh a lam hi."},"12":{"text":"Sisera kungah Tabor Muolah Abinoam’ tapa Barak, peito zo hi, ci-in a kigen ciengin,"},"13":{"text":"Sisera in a sakol leeng zosie, sia sakol leeng zakuo, le ama tawh a omton galkap zosie, Horosheth-ha-goiim panin Kishon Lui-ah a thuta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Deborah in Barak kungah, “Peito in! Bangzieh ahei cile tuni pen Topa in na khut sungah Sisera ang pieh ni ahi hi. Na mai-ah Topa pei tahtah hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama a zui galhang tul sawm tawh Tabor Muol panin Barak a peisuh hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in Barak mai-ah Sisera le a sakol leeng zosie le a galkap zosie a patausah hi; a sakol leeng tung panin Sisera kumsuhin a keng tawh taimang a,"},"16":{"text":"tua lai tahin Barak in a sakol leengte le a galkapte Harosheth-ha-goiim cieng dong del hi. Sisera’ galkapte a unpi-un namsau tawh a sigam uhi; a suohta koima om lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in Ken-te Heber’ zi Jael’ puonbuh -ah a keng guohin Sisera a tai hi; azieh pen Hazor kumpipa Jabin le Ken-te Heber’ be kikalah kilemna a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Sisera dawn dingin Jael pusuohin ama kungah, “Hing kihei in, ka pupa aw, kei lam hing kihei in; zau sin,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama zong tua nu lamah kihei-in puonbuh sungah lut a, tua nu in tuongpha puon tawh ama a khu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tua nu kungah, “Ka dangta ahi ziehin hepina tawh ka dawn ding tui halkhat ei pie in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in bawngnawi koina savun thawl hongin a dawn ding tui pie-in ama a khu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “Puonbuh kotah ding inlen, mi khatpo ang pei-in na kungah, ‘Tam munah mi khatpo a om ei?’ ang ci leh, ‘Om sih,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Heber’ zi Jael in puonbuh kilna sia hiem khat la a, a khutah seh khat tawi-in ama kungah damtahin pei a- gim seng kisa-in a kimut laitahin- a sia hiem in ama pailetin lei a bat dongin a ankhaibaw-ah khensuh a - tuaci’n ama a si hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Barak in Sisera a del ciengin ama tawh kimu dingin Jael pusuohin ama kungah, “Hing pei in, na mi sui kang lah ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a puonbuh sungah ama a lut hi; tuale a ankhaibaw-ah puonbuh sia hiem kikhenin a sisa-in Sisera na lum hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in Pasien in Israel-te mai-ah Canaan kumpipa Jabin a guolelsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Canaan kumpipa Jabin a suhsiet masangin Canaan kumpipa Jabin tungah Israel-te’ khut a khauh semsem hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Deborah le Abinoam’ tapa Barak in khum ni-in la a sa vua:","title":"Deborah’ La"},"2":{"text":"“Israel ah a samte uh a sau ciengin, mite amate mama kiphal tahin a kipieh uh ciengin- Topa phat un!"},"3":{"text":"“Za un, kumpite aw; Na bil uh daw un, uliente aw; Topa tungah la ka sa ding a, Israel-te’ Pasien, Topa tungah la ngaih ka sa ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa , Seir pan na pei cieng, Edom gam pan na kuonkhiet cieng, leitung kiling a, vante in buosuhin meiite in tui a sungsuh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa , Sinai-a Pa mai, Israel’ Pasien, Topa mai-ah muolte a kiling hi.","ref":"Pei 19:18"},"6":{"text":"“Anath’ tapa Shamgar hun lai, Jael hun lai-in khuol honzinte khawlin, khuolzinte in lampelh a zui uhi."},"7":{"text":"Israel sunga lohlote a cithei vua, a galvan lahpiehte utawh a thau milmel uhi. Azieh pen Deborah aw, nang na khang a, Israel sungah nu bangin na khang hi."},"8":{"text":"A tha pasien-te a kiteel ciengin, tunkotah gal a om hi. Israel tul sawmlite lahah lum le tei a kimu amah?"},"9":{"text":"Mite lah panin kiphal tahin a kipumpieh Israel galkapmangte lamah ka lungsim a pei hi. Topa phat un."},"10":{"text":"“A thu gen un, no laa kangte tunga tuongte, puonpha hoi tunga tote le lampi dunga peite aw."},"11":{"text":"“Tui phuola lasiemte’ awging in Topa’ guolzawna, Israel gam ama lohlote’ guolzawnate, khum munah a awiawi uhi. “Tua ciengin kul tunkotte ah Topa’ mite a peisuh uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Tho in, tho in, Deborah! Tho in, tho in, la khat sa in! Ding in, Barak, na galmatte peipi in, Abinoam’ tapa aw."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin milien a omlaite peisuh uhi; Ama ading a thahat mite do dingin Topa’ mite peisuh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ephraim panin amate tua kuomah a kuon vua, nang, Benjamin, na unaute tawh ang zui uhi; Machir panin galkapmangte peisuhin, Zebulun panin galkap mangpa’ ciengkhut tawite a peisuh uhi;"},"15":{"text":"Issachar uliente, Deborah tawh a pei vua, Barak tungah Issachar a thuman hi; amate in kuom sungah ama a nuadel uhi. Reuben bete lahah lungsim ki-etcienna nasie tahin a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuuhonte ading theile tum ngai dingin bang dinga tuukhumnate lahah tuongbaang na hi ahei? Reuben bete lahah lungsim ki-etcienna nasie tahin a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Jordan galkhatah Gilead om hi; tuale bang dinga Dan-te tembaw tawh om uh ahei? Asher-te tuipi pieu-ah a to lai vua, a kumsuhna mun vuah a teng uhi."},"18":{"text":"Zebulun-te pen sina a simmawte ahi vua; Naphtali-te zong, gamlah a sanna munah tua bang ma ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Kumpite kuonin a do vua, tua zaw ciengin Canaan kumpite in Megiddo tuite gei, Taanach ah a do uhi; amate in a kinuasie ngunte a nga tuom sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Van panin aasite in a do vua, a lampi ciet panun Sisera do uhi."},"21":{"text":"Kishon guntui khang in amate tai a, a lomlen tuikhang, Kishon tuikhang in taimang hi. Ka hlagau aw, hattahin mainawt in!"},"22":{"text":"“Tua ciengin sakol a kopdien ziehin, sakol taite’ ketot gin in leithuong hot hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in, “Meroz samsie in, a sunga tengte nasie tahin samsie in. Azieh pen Topa a panpi dingin amate ang pei sih vua, thahat pa dona-ah Topa a panpi dingin ang kuon sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"“Numeite lahah thupha nga pen Jael, Ken-te Heber’ zi, puonbuh sunga teng numeite lahah thupha nga pen ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in tui ngen a, tua nu in bawngnawi a pie hi. Tua nu in uliente’ zah kuongkum sungah bawngnawi thaukhal a puoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a khutah puonbuh khetphim tawi a, a zietlam khutah nasemte’ sehta a tawi hi; ama in Sisera khatvei sat a, a lutang satguoi-in, ama in satzanin a ankhaibaw a khen pailet hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama bawhsuhin a pua a, tua nu’ kengbul ah ama a lum ta hi; tua nu kengbul ah ama bawhsuhin a pua hi; a bawhsuhna tua munah, ama pua-in a si hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tawlet pan Sisera’ nu khuodah a, vathang panin a en hi: ‘Bang dingin sakol leeng ang pei ding tu tanvei sawt ahei? Bang dingin sakol leengpei ginte hici kiheh ahei?’ a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"A numei pil pente in a thugen a dawng vua, a tahtahin ama le ama kidawng ahi bo hi;"},"30":{"text":"‘Amate in a kinuasie vante mu-in hawm hi lo uh amah?- Pasal khat in nungah khat ta ahiei, ni ta ahiei; a kinuasie puon kibumte Sisera ading, a kinuasie puon kibum kizemte, a kibum a kizem puon nite ka ngawng ading amah?’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"“Tuaci’n na gal zosie a si sieng ta uhi, Topa aw! Ahi vangin na guolte pen a vanglietna tawh a suoh ni tawh kibang taheh,” a ci uhi. Tuale khum gam in kum sawmli sung tawlngah hun a nei hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa muna-ah Israel-te a siet gamtat vua, Topa in Midian-te’ khut sungah amate kum sagi sung a pie hi.","title":"Midian-te’ Bawlsietna"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te tungah Midian-te a guolzo uhi; tuale Midian-te ziehin Israel-te in a kibuh nadingun muol tung tengah suonghawmte le mun muonhuoite a bawl uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel-te in khai a tu popo ciengun Midian-te, Amalek-te, le nisuona lam mite in a sim zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate do nadingin giephuol satin Gaza kim cieng donga a po lei pana piengte a suhsietpieh vua, tuaci’n Israel gamah neh ding khat zong hen loin tuu, bawngtang, le laa khat zong hen a nei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen amate le a ganhonte a kuonto uha, kauphe honpi banga a tam a puonbuhte uh nangawn a pua uh hi. Amate ahi a, a kalaohte uh ahi zongin kisim zo lo hi; tuaci’n amate a tun ciengun khum gam teng a susie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Midian-te ziehin Israel-te nahpi tahin kiniemkoi hi; tuale Israel-te’ Topa tungah huna ngenin amate a kiko uhi."},"7":{"text":"Midian-te ziehin Israel-te’ Topa tungah a kiko ciengun,"},"8":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te kungah kamsang khat a sawl hi; tuale ama in a kung vuah, “Israel-te’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in saltanna gam Egypt panin note kang peipi to hi;"},"9":{"text":"tuale Egypt-te’ khut sung pan le ang bawlsie mi zosiete’ khut sung panin kang hunkhie a, na mai vuah amate delmangin a gam uh kang pie hi;"},"10":{"text":"tuale keima in na kung vuah, ‘Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi; note in na tenna gam vua Amor-te’ pasien-te na zatah sih ding uhi,’ kang ci hi. Ahi vangin ka thu na ngai sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi pei-in Ophrah-a Abiezer-te Joash’ neisa ahi gangpi sing phungah to a, tua laitahin Joash’ tapa Gideon in Midian-te mu lo dingin lengga suhna-ah mangbu a cil hi.","title":"Gideon a Kihlatna"},"12":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi a kungah kilang a, “Nang a thahat galhang pa aw, Topa in nang ang ompi hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Gideon in ama kungah, “Pu aw, Topa in ko ei ompi ahile bang dinga tamte zosie ka tung vua hing tung ahei? Ka pu ka pate un, ‘ Topa in Egypt panin ei peipi to hi lo amah? ci-a a gengen uh a lamdang ama’ nasepte zosie hei-a om sieng dawh ta ahei?’ a ci hi. Ahi vangin tu-in Topa in ei nuasie zo a, Midian-te’ khut sungah ei pie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama lamah Topa kihei-in a kungah, “Tami na thahatna tawh pei inlen, Midian-te’ khut sung panin Israel-te va tankhie in; keima in nangma kang sawl hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Ahi vangin pu aw, bangci bangin Israel-te hunkhie zo ding ka hei? Kei, Manasseh lahah be zawngkhal pen ka hi a, ka innkuon sungah zong a neupen ka hi bo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Hinanle keima in kang ompi ding a, Midian-te a unpi-in na vatmai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Tu-in na maipha ka mu leh kei tawh a kiho mi pa khu nang na hina lim khat ei lah in."},"18":{"text":"Na kungah letsong puoh dingin hing pei-in na mai-ah kang koi masangsie tam mun panin na pei sin,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Nang kilekia masang ka na om ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n a inn ah Gideon pei-in keelno khat le annel ephah khat tol saw lo moh-in a bawl hi; ama in law sungah a sa koi-in beel sung khatah a satui koi a, tua teng gangpi sing phunga ama kungah peipi-in a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasien’ vantungmi in ama kungah, “Sa le tol saw lo moh la-in tam suongpi tungah koi inlen, a tungah satui sung in,” a ci hi. Ama in tua bangma-in a bawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi in a khut sunga om ciengkhut dawn tawh sa le tol saw lo moh a khoi hi; tuale suong panin mei pusuohin sa le tol saw lo moh katum a, ama’ muna panin Topa’ vantungmi a mang hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi ahi lam Gideon in thei hi; tuale Gideon in, “Ei panpi in, Topa ! Bang ding ahei cile Topa’ vantungmi kimaituo-in ka mu zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in ama kungah, “Na tungah nopna om taheh; zau sin, na si sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gideon in Topa dingin tua munah maitam khat lamin tua khu Topa in kilemna ahi hi, ci-in a min a phuo hi. Tua khu Abiezer-te’ Ophrah khuo-ah tuni dongin a omlai hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in tuami zanin ama kungah, “Na pa bawngtangte sung pan kum sagi a pha bawngtang a nina pen la inlen, na pa’ nei Baal maitam phelin, a gei-a om a siengtho khuom phua in;"},"26":{"text":"tuale tam sung mun muonhuoi dawnah Topa na Pasien uh adingin maitam khat lamin suongte a ngaina bangin koi in; tua ciengin bawngtang a nina pen la inlen na phua ding a siengtho khuom sing tawh meihal biehna pie in,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gideon in a nasemte mi sawm peipi-in Topa in ama tunga a gen bangin a bawl hi; ahi vangin ama in sunlai-a a bawl ding pen a innkuonpite le a khuo mite a giin ziehin zanlai-in a bawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Zingmawng phalvah kisemin khuo mite a thaw uh ciengin, Baal maitam kiphelin a gei-a khuom siengtho kiphua a, a kilamsa maitam tungah bawngtang a nina pen kipie hi.","title":"Gideon in Baal’ Maitam Susie"},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in, “Tami koi pen bawl ahiei?” ci-in khatlekhat a kici uhi. Thu kanin thu a dawh zaw ciengun amate kungah, “Joash’ tapa Gideon bawl ahi hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuomite in Joash kungah, “Na tapa in Baal maitam phelin a gei-a om ama’ khuom siengtho a phua ziehin ama ka tha thei nadingun na tapa hing peipi in,” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joash in a langkhatah a pang mi zosie kungah, “Baal adinga thugen ding na hi uh amah? Ahi sihle ama panpi-in hum ding na hi uh amah? Ama a panpi poma zingmawng ciengin kithat ding hi. Ama pasien ahile ama le ama kihun taheh. Bangzieh ahei cile a maitam kiphel zo hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khum ni-in Gideon pen, “Baal in ama dem taheh,” a ci nopna ahi Jerubbaal min kivaw hi. Azieh pen Gideon in a maitam phelpieh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin Midian-te, Amalek-te le nisuona lama mite zosie a peiton vua, tuale Jordan galkai-in Jezreel Kuom ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hizongle Gideon tungah Topa’ hlagau tung hi; tuale ama in pengkul gingsah a, ama a zui dingin Abiezer-te kihlan hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in Manasseh gam zosie-ah kamtaite sawl a, amate zong ama zui dingin kihlan hi. Ama in Asher, Zebulun, le Naphtali-te kungah zong kamtaite sawl a, ama tawh kimu dingin a peito uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gideon in Pasien kungah, “Na gensa bangin keima’ khut tawh Israel-te na tatkhiet ding lam ka thei nadingin,","title":"Tuumul Lim"},"37":{"text":"bucilna kem tungah tuumul lom khat ka koi ding hi. Tuumul tung behah daitui omin leilah zosie a na gaw leh, na gensa bangin ka khut tawh Israel-te na tatkhiet ding lam ka thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua bangma-in a pieng hi. A zing ciengin ama thobai-in a tuumul tui a hiakang leh tuumul panin daitui kuongkum khat dim a hiakang hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gideon in Pasien kungah, “Kei tungah lungthah sin, khatvei ei hamsah lai in; tuumul tawh khatvei beh ei sinsah lai in; kang thum hi. Tuumul tung beh gawsah inlen, leilah zosie-ah daitui omsah in,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Khum zanin Pasien in tua bangma-in a bawl hi. Tuumul tung beh gaw a, leilah zosie-ah daitui a om hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerubbaal (tua pen Gideon) le ama tawh a omton galkapte zingmawngin thobai-in Harod tuikhuh gei-ah giephuol a sat uhi; tuale Midian-te’ giephuol pen amau’ opna leilu lam, Moreh muol nei, kuom sungah a om hi.","title":"Gideon in Lamdangsa-in Midian-te Zo"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Gideon kungah, “A khut sung vuah Midian-te ka pieh nadingin nang tawh a omton galkapte tam luo hi. Israel in min phatna teng kei tung panin la-in, ‘Ka hatna in keima ei hunkhie zo hi,’ ci kha ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in galkapte’ zahin tangtawh inlen, ‘Zau le linga a om poma inn ah kilekia ta un,’ ci-in,” a ci hi. Tua bangin Gideon in amate sittel hi; tul sawmni le tulni kilekia-in tul sawm omlai hi.","ref":"Thkna 20:8"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Gideon kungah, “Galkapte a tam na lai hi; tui opna-ah peipisuh inlen, khum munah nang adingin amate ka sittel ding hi. Keima in, ‘Tam pa tawh na kuon ding hi,’ ka ci ciengin nang tawh ama kuon ding hi; tuale, ‘Tam pa tawh na kuon sih ding hi,’ ka ci ciengin nang tawh ama kuon lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in tui opna-ah galkapte zawpisuh hi; tuale Topa in Gideon kungah, “Ui in tui a lie banga a lei tawh tui a lieh zosie a langkhatah na koi ding hi; tui dawn dingin khupdinin a kam sunga a khut koi zosie adang khatah na koi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A lei tawh tui a lieh mi zathum pha hi; ahi vangin adang galkap zosie in tui dawn dingin a khupdin uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Gideon kungah, “Tui a lieh mi zathum tawh kang hunkhie ding a, na khut sungah Midian-te kang pie ding hi. Adangte zosie a inn vuah peisah ta’n,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a khut sung panun galkapte’ tuithawlte le a pengkulte uh a la hi; tuale Israel dangte a puonbuh vuah peisah a, ahi vangin mihing za thumte a omsah hi. Midian-te’ giephuol pen ama’ opna nei kuom sungah a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum zan ma-in Topa in ama kungah, “Tho inlen giephuol sim in; azieh pen na khut sungah kang pie zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Na sim ngam sih leh, giephuolah na nasempa Purah tawh peisuh in;"},"11":{"text":"tua hile a thu gen uh na za ding a, tua zaw ciengin giephuol sim nadingin na khutte ang thakhauh ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin giephuola om galkapte galpanna munah a nasempa Purah tawh a peisuh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kuom dung tengah Midian-te, Amalek-te le nisuona lam mite zosie a lum vua, kauphe bangin a tam uhi; tuale a kalaohte uh tam seng ahi ziehin tuipi gei-a senel bangin kisim zo lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Gideon a tun ciengin mi khat in a guolpa kungah mang khat na gen hi; tuale ama in, “Mang khat ka man hi, tua ka mangin Midian-te’ giephuol sungah mangbuham tawh a kibawl moh lum khat ang kilia-in puonbuh ban a, tua puonbuh sat kha-in a pua hi; tua puonbuh kikhulehin tuolah a kiphengpha ta hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"A guolpa in, “Tam pen Israel mi Joash’ tapa Gideon’ namsau lo adang hi vawt lo hi; Pasien in a khut sungah Midian-te le a galkap zosie pie zo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Gideon in a kigen mang le a khietna a zah ciengin ama in Pasien bie-in Israel-te’ giephuolah kilekia hi; tuale ama in, “Tho un; azieh pen Topa in na khut sung vuah Midian galkapte hing pie zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in mi zathumte pawl thumin a khen zaw ciengin a unpi-un a khut vuah pengkulte le a sungah meila kiguong beelhawmte a tawisah a,"},"17":{"text":"ama in, “Kei ei en unlen, ka bawl bangin bawl un. Giephuol mong ka tun ciengin ka bawl bangin bawl un."},"18":{"text":"Kei le ka ompi zosie in pengkul kang tum ciengun, note in zong giephuol kimvel zosie-ah pengkul hing mut pai unlen, ‘ Topa le Gideon ading,’ ci-in awng un,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gideon le a ompi mi zakhat in galvil a laita pen a kihlen laitahin giephuol mongah pei-in pengkul a mut uhi; tuale amate in a khut sung vua om beelte a satkeh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a pawl thumun pengkul mutin beelte a satkeh vua, veilam khut tawh meila tawi-in zietlam khut tawh a mut ding uh pengkul a tawi uhi; tuale amate in, “ Topa le Gideon ading namsau khat!” ci-in a awng uhi."},"21":{"text":"Giephuol kimvela a mun ciet panun a unpi-un a ding vua, giephuol sunga om mi zosie tai-in a tai kawmun a awng uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pengkul zathum a tum ciengun, Topa in namsau tawh a galte zosie khatlekhat kivatsah hi; tuale Zererah lam manaw-in Beth-shittah cieng, le Tabbath gei Abel-meholah gamgi dongin galkapte a taimang uhi."},"23":{"text":"Naphtali, Asher, le Manasseh-te zosie sung panin Israel mite kihlan a, tuaci’n amate in Midian-te a del uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ephraim muoltung gam zosie-ah Gideon in kamtaite sawl a, “Midien-te do dingin hing kuonsuh unlen, a tuite uh Beth-barah dong le Jordan dongin lahpieh un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Ephraim mi zosie kihlan a, Bethbarah dong ciengah luite a la vua, Jordan zong a la uhi."},"25":{"text":"Midian-te makai nite Oreb le Zeeb a man vua, Midian-te a del kawmun Oreb suongpi-ah Oreb thatin, lenggasuhna-ah Zeeb that uhi. Jordan gala om Gideon kungah amate in Oreb le Zeeb’ lutangte a peipi uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ephraim-te in ama kungah, “Midian-te do dinga na kuon lai-in kote nei ciel lo khu bang dan a nei bawl ahiei?” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n amate in nahpitahin ama a mawsiet uhi.","title":"Gideon’ Guolzawna le Phulahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in amate kungah, “Note tawh tekah dingin ken tu-in bang bawl zo tuon ka hei? Abiezer lengga i law sangin Ephraim-te’ lengga sangh i khon ma hoizaw hi lo amah?"},"3":{"text":"Pasien in na khut sung vuah Midian makaite Oreb le Zeeb ang pie zo ta hi; note tawh tekah dingin ken bang ka sem zo tuon mawh ahei?” a ci hi. Ama in tam thu a gen ciengin ama tunga a lungthahna uh a veng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gideon le ama tawh a om mi za thumte, Jordan ah tungin a galkai vua, basamin a gil uh kiel mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Succoth-te kungah, “Kang thum hi, ka nuazuite mohlum halkhat pie un, azieh pen amate a husam ta vua, kei ka hi leh Midian kumpite Zebah le Zalmunna ka nuadel laitah ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 83:11"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Succoth uliente in, “Na galkapte moh ka pieh nadingun na khut sungah Zebah le Zalmunna a om zo ta amah?” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Gideon in, “Tua ahile hoi pai ei, Topa in ka khut sungah Zebah le Zalmunna ei pieh zaw ciengin gamlah lingte le lingkungte tungah na tahsa uh ka tuoncil ding hi,” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua mun panin Penuel ah peito-in a kung vuah tam bangma-in a ngen leh Penuel-te in zong Succoth-te’ dawn bang ma-in na dawngkia uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Penuel-te kungah, “Guolzo-a kang kilekia tah ciengin tam tausang ka satguoi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in Zibah le Zalmunna-te, nisuona lam mite’ galkapte zosie sung pan a omlai teng, mi tul sawm le tulnga bang a pha lai a galkapte utawh, Karkor ah a om uhi; bangzieh ahei cile galhiem a tawi thei mi tul za le tul sawmni si zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihonte in a tot uh Nobah le Jogbelah nisuona lampi zui-in Gideon pei-in galkapte a sim hi; azieh pen a galte a kiging kha sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Zebah le Zalmunna tegel a taimang uhi; tuale ama in nuadel pai-in Midian-te’ kumpi nite ahi Zebah le Zalmunna manin a galkap zosie a patausah hi."},"13":{"text":"Galsimna panin Heres katona lam zui-in Joash’ tapa Gideon a kilekia hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in Succoth-te tangval khat manin thu dong hi; tuale tua pa in ama adingin Succoth uliente le upate sawmsagi le sagi a min a gielpieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Succoth-te kungah ama va tung a, “Note in kei kungah, ‘A basam na galkapte moh ka pieh nadingin na khut sungah Zebah le Zalmunna a om zo ta amah,’ ci-a nei galgihna uh Zebah le Zalmunna tanah om hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in khuo upate manin gam lingte le lingkungte la-in tuate tawh Succoth-te a tuoncil hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in Penuel tausang satguoi a, tua khuomite zong that hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Zebah le Zalmunna kungah, “Tabor-a na thate uh a bangci mite ahi vuoi?” a ci hi. Ama gel in, “Amate a unpi-un nangma a bang uhi; amate, kumpipa’ tate tawh a kisun uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Amate pen ka sanggamte, ka nu’ tate ahi uhi; Topa a hing ahi ma bangin amate na hinkhawi hi locin ken zong note kang that sih ding hi,” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a tapa tapen Jether kungah, “Pei inlen amate va that ta vawi!” a ci hi. Ahi vangin tangval pa in a namsau dawh ngam lo hi, azieh pen ama naupang lai hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zebah le Zalmunna in, “Hing pei inlen ei that in; azieh pen pasal in pasal tha ma puo bo,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Gideon dingto a, Zebah le Zalmunna thatin a kalaoh uh’ ngawnga hlade lim tawh kibang kizepnate a la hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in Gideon kungah, “Nang le na tapa le na tupa in zong kote ei uh ta un; azieh pen kote Midian-te’ khut sung panin nei hunkhie zo ta hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Gideon’ Milim Biehna"},"23":{"text":"Gideon in a kung vuah, “Note kang uh sih ding a, ka tapa in zong ang uh sih ding hi; Topa in note ang uh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gideon in amate kungah, “Na kung vuah kang nget nuom khat om hi; van kinuasie na lah sung panun bilba khat ciet ei pie un,” a ci hi. (Azieh pen tua galte Ishmael-te ahi ziehin kham bilbate a nei uhi.)"},"25":{"text":"“Kiphaltahin tuate kang pie ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi. Tuaci’n puon a pha vua, mi zosie in a lah uh van kinuasie sung panin tua puon tungah bilbate a sep uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a nget kham bilbate a gihna pen kham shekel tulkhat le zasagi pha hi. (Midian kumpite zah hlade lim kizepnate, khainiengte, puon dupsante le a kalaohte uh ngawng kimvela om ngawng-awte kisim lo hi.)"},"27":{"text":"Gideon in tua teng panin siempu puon khat bawlin ama khuopi Ophrah khuo-ah koi hi; tuale Israel-te zosie in tua munah siempu puon bie-in a pahtat vua, Gideon le a innkuonpite adingin thang khat a suoh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te mai-ah Midian-te guol lelin a lu a phongkia zo nawn sih uhi.
