Tuaci’n Gideon’ khang sungin tua gam in kum sawmli sung tawlngah hun nga hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama inn ah Joash’ tapa Jerubbaal pei-in a teng hi.","title":"Gideon Sina"},"30":{"text":"Tu-in Gideon in ama’ hin tehteh tapa sawm sagi nei hi, azieh pen ama in zi tampitah nei hi."},"31":{"text":"Shechem-a teng a meinu in tapa khat nei a, ama in a min Abimelech a phuo hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joash’ tapa Gideon vuoisi a, Abiezer-te gam Ophrah khuo-a om a pa Joash’ hanah kivui hi."},"33":{"text":"Gideon a si zaw behin Israel-te kiheikia-in Baal-te tawh a pahtatkia vua, a pasien uh dingin Baalberith a bawl uhi."},"34":{"text":"Israel-te in mun zosie panin a galte zosie’ khut sung pan amate a hunkhie Topa a Pasien uh a phawhkha nawn sih uhi;"},"35":{"text":"tuale Jerubbaal (Gideon a kici) in Israel-te tungah a na bawlsa sil hoite zosie ziehin amate in Jerubbaal innkuonte tungah lungdamna bangma a lah sih uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Shechem-a a nu’ sanggamte kungah Jerubbaal’ tapa Abimelech haw a, a nu’ be le phungte zosie kungah,","title":"Kumpi Uhna Gam Phu ding Abimelech Hanciem"},"2":{"text":"“Shechem-a ulien zosie’ zah dingin gen inlen, ‘Jerubbaal tapa sawmsagite in ang uh ding ule mi khat in ang uh ding, no adingin koi hoi zaw ahei?’ a ci hi. Kei na gu le na sa uh ka hi lam zong phawh un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nu’ sanggamte in ama tangin Shechem ulien zosie’ zah dingin tam thu teng a gen uhi; tuale Abimelech zui ding lamah a lungsim uh a hawi hi, azieh pen amate in, “Ama i sanggam pa ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Baal-berith biehinn panin nguntang peh sawmsagi ama a pie vua, tuaci’n Abimelech in ama’ nua a zui, kimanna a nei lo le mi ngoltolte tua tawh a ciel hi."},"5":{"text":"Ophrah-a a pa’ inn ah ama pei-in suong khat tungah Jerubbaal’ tapa a sanggam sawmsagite that hi; hizongle Jerubbaal’ tapa tumpen Jotham suohta hi, a zieh pen ama kiphuol hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shechem ulien zosie le Beth-millo khuo mite zosie a kikhawm vua, tuaci’n pei-in amate in Shechem-a gangpi song gei-ah Abimelech kumpi a suohsah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jotham kungah tua thu a kigen ciengin ama pei-in Gerizim Muol dawnah ding a, nahpi-in kiko-in a kung vuah, “No Shechem uliente aw, Pasien in na thu uh ang ngaipieh nadingin ka thu ngai un.","title":"Singkungte tawh Thugentena"},"8":{"text":"Ni khat, a kumpi ding uh sathau nu dingin singkungte a kuon uhi. Tuaci’n amate in olive kung kungah, ‘Ko ei uh in,’ a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Olive kung in a kung vuah, ‘pasien-te le mite kipatawina ka thaute nuasie-in singkungte uh dingin hing pei ding ka mah?’ ci-in a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin singkungte in theikung kungah, ‘Hing pei inlen, ko ei uh in,’ a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle theikung in amate kungah, ‘Ka hlumna le ka ga tuituohte nuasie-in singkungte uh dingin hing pei ding ka mah?’ ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin singkungte in lenggui kungah, ‘Hing pei inlen, ko ei uh in,’ a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle lenggui in a kung vuah, ‘pasien-te le mite a lungnuomsah ka zu nuasie-in singkungte uh dingin hing pei ding ka mah?’ a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n singkung zosie in thangling kungah, ‘Hing pei inlen, ko ei uh in,’ a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Thangling in singkungte kungah, ‘Lungsim tahtah tawh na tung vuah kumpi dinga sathau nei nu sawm uleh, hing pei unlen, ka hlim-ah hing bu un. Tua ahi sihle thangling kung pan mei pusuohin Lebanon taamtahte katum taheh,’ a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin tu-in lungsimtah le zatahna tawh kumpi-in Abimelech bawlin, Jerubbaal le a innkuonte zong limbawlin ama’ sepsate tawh kituoha a gamta ma na hi uh amah,"},"17":{"text":"a zieh pen ka pa in a luong khamin gal hing do piehin Midian-te’ khut sung panin ang hunkhie zo uhi;"},"18":{"text":"ahi vangin tuni-in ka pa’ innkuon na ledo vua, a tapa mi sawmsagite suong khat tungah thatin, a sila numei tawh a nei a tapa Abimelech zong na sanggampa uh a hina hang tawh Shechem uliente tungah kumpi-in na bawl vua-"},"19":{"text":"keima in kang ci-in, note in tuni-in lungsimtah le zatahna tawh Jerubbaal le a innkuonpite tunga na bawl uh ahi po leh, note zong Abimelech tungah lungdam unlen no tungah zong ama lungdam taheh;"},"20":{"text":"ahi vangin tua bang ahi tahpi sih leh Abimelech sung panin meikuong pusuoh hinlen Shechem le Beth-millo uliente katum taheh. Shechem le Beth-millo uliente sung panin meikuong pusuoh hinlen, Abimelech katum taheh,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sanggampa Abimelech a giin ziehin Jotham taimangin Beer khuo-ah pei-in tua munah a teng hi."},"22":{"text":"Abimelech in Israel-te tungah kum thum sung uh hi.","title":"Abimelech’ Puana"},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in Abimelech le Shechem uliente kikalah hlagau gilo khat sawl hi; tuale Abimelech tungah Shechem uliente a zuoutat uhi."},"24":{"text":"Jerubbaal’ tapa sawmsagite tungah tatsietna phu a kilah thei nading, amate a that a sanggampa uh Abimelech, le a sanggamte tha nadinga ama’ khut a thahatsah Shechem uliente tungah amau’ sisan luonna paat a tun thei nadinga tami thu pieng ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Shechem khuo uliente in ama tungah a galbawlna-un muol dawn tengah a buhdap ding mi a koi vua, tua lampi-a pei zosie na suom uhi; tuale Abimelech tungah tua thu kipuoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ebed’ tapa Gaal a sanggamte tawh Shechem-ah a kituon vua, Shechem uliente in ama a muong uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amate lo kuonin a lenggui panun lengga khawmin a cil vua, pawi a bawl uhi. Tua ciengin a pasien uh’ inn sungah lutin an ne tui dawnin omin Abimelech a zako uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ebed’ tapa Gaal in, “Ama’ na i seppieh va-ia nadingin Abimelech koi hi a, ei Shechem mite koi i hi uh ahei? Jerubbaal’ tapa le ama’ ulien Zebul in Shechem’ pa Hamor-te’ na sem uh hi lo amah?"},"29":{"text":"Tam mite ka khut nei hi uleh izaw! Tua hile Abimelech suon dawhin ama kungah, ‘Na galkap khan inlen hing kuon in,’ ka ci ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Khuopi a uh Zebul in Ebed’ tapa Gaal’ kammalte a zah ciengin a sin a so hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in Arumah-a om Abimelech kungah kamtai sawlin, “En in, Shechem-ah Ebed’ tapa Gaal le a sanggamte ang pei ta vua, nang hing langpangin khuopi a tawhnawi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in na ompi galkapte tawh zanin pei-in lozau-ah na buhdap un."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin zingmawng ni ang suo behin tho unlen khuopi sim un; a ompi galkapte tawh nang do dinga ang kuon ciengin a tung vuah na hi thei tawpin na bawl in,” cisah hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abimelech le a ompi galkap zosie zanin a tho vua, Shechem sim dingin pawl li kisuo-in a buhdap uhi."},"35":{"text":"Ebed’ tapa Gaal pusuohin khuopi tunkot lutna-ah a din ciengin Abimelech le a ompi galkapte zong a kibuhna panun dingto uhi."},"36":{"text":"Gaal in amate a mu ciengin Zebul kungah, “En in, muolvum panin mite hing kumsuh!” a ci hi. Zebul in a kungah, “Muol hlimte mi banga na mu hi bo va,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Gaal hamkia-in, “En in, Tabbur-erez panin mite ang peisuh a, Elon-meonenim lam panin mi pawlkhat ang pei uhi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zebul in ama kungah, “A na ka sep nadingun Abimelech koi ahiei?’ ci-a na kisielna tu-in hei sungah a om ta e? Tu-in kuon unlen amate tawh kido un,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n Shechem uliente mai-ah Gaal kuonin Abimelech tawh a kido hi."},"40":{"text":"Abimelech in ama del a, a mai-ah ama a tai hi. Kulpi tunkot lutna cieng dong mi tampi liemin a puamat uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuaci’n Arumah-ah Abimelech a teng hi; tuale Shechem-ah amate a ten thei nawn lo nadingun Zebul in Gaal le a sanggamte a notmang hi."},"42":{"text":"A zing ciengin lozau-ah mite a pei vua, tuale Abimelech kungah tua thu a kigen ciengin"},"43":{"text":"a galkapte a peipi a, pawl thumin khenin lozau-ah a buhdap uhi. Ama khuodahin khuopi panin mite ang kuonkhie a mu ciengin amate do dingin kipanin a thatgam sieng hi."},"44":{"text":"Adang pawl nite in lozau-a mi zosie gamdelin a tha laitahun, thakhatthu-in, Abimelech le a ompi a pawlte mai a nawt vua, khuopi lutna tunkotah na ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Abimelech in tua ni sung tungtawnin khuopi sim hi; ama in tua khuopi la-in a sunga om mite that hi; tuale ama in tua khuopi susie-in ci a the hi."},"46":{"text":"Shechem Tausang uliente zosie in tua thu a zah ciengun El-berith biehinnpi, mun muonhuoi sungah a lut uhi."},"47":{"text":"Shechem Tausang ulien zosie a kikhawmtuo ta uhi, ci-in Abimelech kungah kigen hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuaci’n a ompi galkap zosie tawh Zalmon Muol tungah Abimelech a kuonto hi. Abimelech in a khutin hei khat la-in geupakang lomkhat sat a, tuate lato-in a liengko-ah a puo hi. Tua ciengin a ompi galkapte kungah, “Ka bawl nei musa bangun ka bawl bang bangin mallangin bawl un,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaci’n galkap zosie in geupakang a tom vua, amate in Abimelech zui-in mun muonhuoi sim nadingin a koi vua, mun muonhuoi mei tawh halin Shechem Tausang mi zosie, numei pasal mi tulkhat bang a si hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciengin Thebez ah Abimelech pei a, Tebez simin giephuol sat a, tua khuo a la hi."},"51":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua khuopi sungah tausang muonhuoi khat om a, numei pasal zosie le khuopi ulien zosie tua sungah tai-in kot a kikhalu vua, tausang khumvumah a kato uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tausang tungah Abimelech pei-in tua khuopi sim a, mei tawh hal dingin tausang kotkhah a nai hi."},"53":{"text":"Ahi vangin numei khat in Abimelech’ lutungah an gawina suongpeh tungnung khat khiesuhin a lugu a keh hi.","ref":"2Sam 11:21"},"54":{"text":"Ama in a galvan tawi tangvalpa mallangin hlanin ama kungah, “Mite in, ‘Numei khat in ama that hi,’ a ci lo nadingin na namsau dawh inlen ei that in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tangvalpa in a namsau tawh sun pailetin ama a si hi."},"55":{"text":"Israel-te in Abimelech si a mu ciengun a unpi-un inn lam a zuon uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tua bangin a sanggam sawmsagite thatin a pa tunga a khielna ziehin Pasien in Abimelech’ khielna a thuhkia ahi hi;"},"57":{"text":"tuale Pasien in zong Shechem mite’ gitlonate zosie a lu tung vua tukia dingin bawl a, a tung vuah Jerubbaal tapa Jotham’ samsietna a tung hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abimelech zaw ciengin Israel-te hunkhie dingin Ephraim muoltung gam Shamir-a teng Issachar mipa Dodo’ tapa Puah, Puah’ tapa Tola a khang hi.","title":"Tola le Jair"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Israel-te tungah kum sawmni le kum thum sung thu khen a, tua ciengin si a, Shamir ah kivui hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin Israel-te kum sawmni le kum ni sung thu a khen Gilead-te Jair a khang hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in laa sawmthum tunga a tuong tapa sawmthum nei hi; tuale amate in tuni dongin Gilead gam sungah Havvoth-jair a kici khuopi sawmthum a nei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jair si-in Kamon ah kivui hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa muna-ah Israel-te a siet gamtatkia vua, Aram-te’ pasien-te, Sidon-te’ pasien-te, Moab-te’ pasien-te, Ammon-te’ pasien-te, le Philistia-te’ pasien-te ahi Baal-te le Astaroth-te a bie uhi. Amate in tua bangin Topa nuasie-in ama a bie sih uhi.","title":"Ammon-te’ Bawlsietna"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te tungah Topa a sinso a, Philistia-te’ khut sung le Ammon-te’ khut sungah amate zua a,"},"8":{"text":"tua kumin Israel-te nuoizanin a bawlsie uhi. Jordan gungal Amor-te’ leitanga om Israel-te zosie kum sawm le kum giet sung amate in a bawlsie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Judah, Benjamin, le Ephraim innkuonte sim dingin Ammon-te zong Jordan a galkai uhi; tuaci’n Israel-te nahpitahin a lungdong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa kungah Israel-te kiko-in, “Na tungah kang maw zo ta uhi, azieh pen ka Pasien uh nuasie-in Baal-te ka bie ta uhi” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te kungah, “Egypt-te le Amor-te, Ammon-te le Philistia-te kung panin note hing hunkhie hi lo ka mah?"},"12":{"text":"Sidon-te, Amalek-te, Maon-te in zong note ang bawlsie uhi; tuale kei tungah nang kiko vua, a khut sung panun note kang hunkhie hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle kei ei nuasie-in pasien dangte na bie uhi; tua ahi ziehin note kang hunkhie nawn sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pei unlen na teelsa uh pasien-te kungah kiko un. Na lungkham hunun amate kihunkhie sah un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa tungah Israel-te in, “Ka maw zo ta uhi; hoi na sah bangin ka tung vuah ei bawl in; hinanle kote tuni-in ei hunkhie in!” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate lah panin gamdang pasien-te paimangin Topa a bie uhi; tuale Israel-te’ gimthuoh a mu ding ama in a thuohzo nawn sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin galhiem tawi dingin Ammon-te kihlan a, Gilead-ah giephuol a sat uhi; tuale Israel-te zong peitonin Mizpah ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"18":{"text":"Gilead makaite khatlekhat in, “Ammon-te sim dingin koi kipan masa ding ahei? Ama Gilead-a teng mite zosie’ lutang hi ding hi,” a kici uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Gilead-te ahi Jephthah pen a thahat galhang khat hi a, numei pahtat khat’ tapa ahi hi. Jephthah’ pa pen Gilead ahi hi.","title":"Jephthah"},"2":{"text":"Gilead’ zi in zong ama tawh tapate nei hi; tuale a zi’ tapate a gol ciengin Jephthah a not dawh vua ama kungah, “Nang in i pa inn sungah bangma gou na luo sih ding hi; azieh pen nang numei dang khat’ tapa na hi bo hi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sanggamte kung panin Jephthah taimang a, Tob gamah a teng hi. Jephthah kungah mi ginalo teng a kikhawm vua, ama tawh mi bulu dingin a kuon uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hun tomkal khat zaw ciengin Ammon-te in Israel-te sim uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ammon-te in Israel-te a sim ciengun Tob gam panin Jephthah la dingin Gilead upate a pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Jephthah kungah, “Ammon-te i do thei nadingin hing pei inlen ka lamkai-un hing pang in,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jephthah in Gilead upate kungah, “Kei ei nuolin ka pa inn sung pana ei notmang no teng ma hi lo na hi uh amah? Tuaci’n tu-in na lungkham ciengun bang dinga kei kunga hing pei na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead upate in Jephthah kungah, “Bang bang ahi ta zongin tu-in nang lama ang kihei ka hi ta uhi. Kote tawh hing zawhton inlen Ammon-te do vai-in tuaci’n kote le Gilead-a teng mi zosie’ lutangin hing pang in,” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Jephthah in Gilead upate kungah, “Ammon-te tawh kido dinga inn lamah nei peipikia vua, Topa in kei tungah amate ei pieh leh na lutang uh ka hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Gilead upate in Jephthah kungah, “I kikal vuah Topa teci hi ding hi; na ci bangin ka gamta tahtah ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gilead upate tawh Jephthah pei a, mite in amate tungah lutang le makai-in ama a koi uhi; tuale Jephthah in tam thu zosie Mizpah khuo-a Topa mai-ah a gen hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jephthah in Ammon-te’ kumpipa kungah kamtaite sawl a, “Ka gam sim dingin kei kunga nang pei nadingin kei le nang kikalah bang thu om ahei?” a cisah hi."},"13":{"text":"Ammon-te’ kumpipa in Jephthah’ kamtaite dawngin, “Egypt panin Israel-te ang pei lai-in Arnon pan Jabbok le Jordan cieng ka gam ei lahpieh zieh ahi hi; tua ahi ziehin tu-in thudamin ei piekia in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Jephthah in Ammon-te’ kumpipa kungah kamtaite sawlkia a,"},"15":{"text":"“Jephthah in tam bangin ci hi: Israel-te in Moab gam hitale Ammon gam hitale lahpieh lo hi,"},"16":{"text":"ahi vangin Egypt panin amate ang peito lai-un senel gam tawnin San Tuipi ah hing pei-in Kadesh ang tung uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in Edom kumpi kungah kamtaite sawlin, ‘Na gam ei nawhsah in,’ a cisah uhi, hinanle Edom kumpipa in a thu ngai lo hi. Amate in Moab kumpipa kungah zong a sawl vua, hizongle ama a thukim sih hi. Tuaci’n Kadesh ah Israel-te a om uhi.","ref":"Gam 20:14-21"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin senel gam tawnin khuol a zin vua, Edom gam le Moab gam kimvelin pei-in Moab gam nisuona lampangah a tung vua, Arnon galkhatah phuol a sat uhi. Arnon gun pen Moab gamgi ahi ziehin Moab gamah a lut sih uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:4"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in Heshbon-a kumpi a sem Amor-te’ Kumpi Sihon kungah kamtaite sawl hi; tuale Israel-te in ama kungah, ‘Ka gam uh zuon dingin na gam ei nawhsah in,’ a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin a gam nawh dingin Sihon in Israel-te a muong sih hi. Tuaci’n Sihon in a mite zosie kaikhawmin Jahaz-ah giephuol satin Israel-te tawh a kido uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa , Israel-te’ Pasien in Israel-te khut sungah Sihon le a mipi zosie pie a, amate in a zo uhi; tuaci’n Israel-te in khum gam sunga teng Amor-te’ leitang zosie a luo uhi."},"22":{"text":"Arnon gun panin Jabbok lui cieng le senel gam panin Jordan gun cieng, Amor-te’ gam zosie a luo uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-24"},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in Topa , Israel-te’ Pasien in ama’ mi Israel-te hamphat nadingin Amor-te a zo hi. Nang in amau’ mun lahpieh sawm na hi amah?"},"24":{"text":"Na nei dinga na Pasien Chemosh in ang piehte nei zaw lel lo ding na mah? Ko phattuom nadinga Topa ka Pasien un a na zawsa na zosie a luo dingte hi lo ka hi uh amah?"},"25":{"text":"Moab kumpipa Zippor’ tapa Kumpi Balak sanga a gina zaw na hi amah? Ama Israel-te tawh kitawmaw ngai-in a kido ngai amah?","ref":"Gam 22:1-6"},"26":{"text":"Israel-te, Heshbon le a khuoneute, Aroer le a khuoneute, le Arnon gun dung khuopi zosie-ah a ten uh kum zathum hun sung tengin bang dingin tuate lakia lo na hei?"},"27":{"text":"Nang tunga a khiel kei ka hi sih a, kei tungah gal na bawl ziehin kei tunga a khiel nang na hizaw hi. Topa thukhen pa in Israel-te le Ammon-te kikalah tuni-in thu khen taheh,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ammon-te’ kumpipa in ama kunga thu puoh Jephthah a thusim sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jephthah tungah Topa’ hlagau tung a, ama in Gilead le Manasseh nawhin Gilead gam Mizpah-ah peisuoh a, Gilead gam Mizpah panin Ammon-te kungah a peisuoh hi.","title":"Jephthah’ Kiciemna"},"30":{"text":"Topa tungah Jephthah in kiciemna bawl a, “Ka khut sungah Ammon-te nei pieh leh,"},"31":{"text":"Ammon-te kung panin guolzo-in ka kilekia ciengin kei ei dawn dinga ka kot pana ang pusuoh popo Topa -a’ hi ding a, meihal biehna-in ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate do dingin Ammon-te kungah Jephthah galkai a, Topa in a khut sungah amate a pie hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in Aroer panin Minnith kimnai cieng dong khuopi sawmni, le Abel-keramim cieng dong mi tampitah that hi. Tuaci’n Israel mite mai-ah Ammon-te a guollel uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mizpah-a ama inn ah Jephthah a tung hi; tuale ama dawn dingin tawm le dah tawh a tanu lam kawmin a pusuoh hi. Tua nu pen ama’ ta khat neisun ahi hi; ama lo buong tapa hile tanu hile adang a nei sih hi.","title":"Jephthah’ Tanu"},"35":{"text":"A tanu a mu bepin a puon ehkehin, “Ala, ka tanu! kei nei neusah mama hi; nang pen ka lungkhamna lienpi na hi ta hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa tungah ka kam ka kah zo ta a, ka kiciemna ka dawhkia thei ta sih hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 30:2"},"36":{"text":"Tua nu in ama kungah, “ Topa tunga na kam na kah zo tah leh na kam sung pana a pusuoh bangin kei tungah hing bawl lel in. Tu-in Topa in na gal Ammon-te tungah phu ang lahpieh zo hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuale ama in a pa kungah, “Kei tungah tam thu hing pieng taheh: Kei va pei-in muoltung tengah vah kawikawi-in kei le ka guolte in ngahnu siengtho ka hina ka va kaa thei nadingun hla ni sung hun ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in, “Va pei in,” ci-in tua nu hla ni sung a peisah hi. Tuaci’n ama le a guolte a dingkhie vua muoltung tengah a ngahnu siengtho hina a va kaa ta uhi."},"39":{"text":"Hla ni a cin ciengin a pa kungah a kilekia a, ama in a bawlsa a kiciemna bangin ama tungah a bawl hi. Tua nu pasal tawh lumton ngai nai lo hi. Tuaci’n khum panin Israel-te’ ngaina khat pieng a,"},"40":{"text":"kum khatin ni li sung kum simin Gilead-te Jephthah’ tanu ziehin a thum dingin Israel’ tanute a pei uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim-te galhiem tawi dingin kihlan a, amate Zaphon galkai-in Jephthah kungah, “Ammon-te sim dingin galkai-in na kuontonpi dingin bang dingin ko ei ciel lo na hei? Na inn tawh kang buhal ding uhi!” a ci uhi.","title":"Minamte Kikal Kikamtamna"},"2":{"text":"Jephthah in a kung vuah, “Keima le ka mite in ko nasie taha ei bawlsie Ammon-te tawh buoina ka nei laitahun kang ciel vangin amau’ khut sung panin nei hun tuon sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Nei hut lo ding uh ka thei bepin ka hinna khamin Ammon-te do dingin ka na galkai a, Topa in ka khut sungah amate ei pie hi. Tua ahile bang zieha kei ei do dinga tuni-a hing kuonto na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jephthah in Gilead mi zosie khawmin Ephraim-te tawh a kido uhi; tuale Gilead mite in Ephraim-te a zo uh hi, azieh pen, “Ephraim-te le Manasseh-te lungsim sungah no Gilead-te pen Ephraim-te pana a taimangte na hi uhi,” a ci ngai zieh uh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gilead-te in Ephraim-te a do vua, Jordan tanmunte a la uhi. A taimang Ephraim-te khatpo in, “Ei galkaisah in,” a ci sielin Gilead mite in a kungah, “Ephraim-te na hi amah?,” a ci uhi. Tuale ama in, “Hi sing,” a ci ciengin,"},"6":{"text":"ama kungah, “Tua ahile Shibbolet ci vawi,” a ci uleh ama in a manin lo thei lo ahi ziehin, “Sibboleth,” ci hi. Tua ciengin ama manin Jordan tanmunte-ah a that uhi. Khum hunin Ephraim-te tul sawmli le tulni a si hi"},"7":{"text":"Jephthah in Israel-te kum guh sung thu khen hi. Tua ciengin Gilead-te Jephthah si a, Gilead gam sunga ama khuo-ah kivui hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin Bethlehem-a Ibzan in Israel-te thu khen hi.","title":"Ibzan, Elon, le Abdon"},"9":{"text":"Ama in tapa sawmthum nei hi. Ama’ be pulamte tawh a tanu sawmthumte kinungsah a, a pulam panin a tapate adingin numei sawmthum a la hi. Ama in Israel-te kum sagi sung thu khen hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ibzan si a, Bethlem khuo-ah ama kivui hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin Zebulun-te Elon in Israel-te kum sawm sung thu khen hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zebulun-te Elon si a, Zebulun gam Aijalon ah ama kivui hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin Pirathon-te Hillel’ tapa Abdon in Israel-te thu khen hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in laa sawmsagi tunga a tuong thei tapa sawmli le tupa sawmthum nei hi; ama in kum giet sung Israel-te thu khen hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pirathon-te Hillel’ tapa Abdon si a, Amalek-te’ muoltung gam Ephraim-te leitanga om Pirathon ah ama kivui hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa muna-ah Israel-te a siet gamtatkia vua, Topa in Philistia-te khut sungah kum sawmli sung amate a pie hi.","title":"Samson Suona (Gam 6:1-21)"},"2":{"text":"Dan minam sung panin Zorah-te a min Manoah kici mi khat a om hi. A zinu pen a ciing hi a, ta nei lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua numei kungah Topa’ vantungmi kilahin, “Ta nei loin a ciing hi nan lacin gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in kidawm inlen lenggazu hile khamthei zucia hile dawn sinlen, a sieng lo khat popo zong ne sin,"},"5":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile nang in nau pai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi. Tua naupang pen a suo-a kipanin Pasien tungah Nazir mi ahi ding ziehin a lutungah mulmetna tukha lo ding hi. Philistia-te’ khut sung panin Israel-te hunkhie dinga kipan ding pa ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 6:1-5"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua numei nu pei-in a pasal kungah, “Ka kungah Pasien’ mi khat ang pei a, a melpuoh pen Pasien’ vantungmi khat tawh kibangin dipkuot huoi mama hi; ama hei pana ang pei ci ka dong sih a, a min zong ei gen lo hi;"},"7":{"text":"ahi vangin ama in keima kungah, ‘Gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi. Tuaci’n lenggazu hile khamthei zucia hile dawn sinlen, a sieng lo bangma ne sin. Azieh pen tua naupang a suo-a kipanin a si dongin Pasien tungah nazir mi hi ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Manoah in Topa kungah thu ngen a, “ Topa aw, kang thum hi. Kote kunga nang sawl Pasien’ mipa hing peisahkia inlen, ang suoh ding naupang pa tawh kisai ka bawl dan ding uh ei hilsah in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien in Manoah thugen ngai a, lolai-ah tua nu a to laitahin ama kungah Pasien’ vantungmi a peikia hi; ahi vangin a pasal Manoah ama tawh om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua nu nawtai-in a pasal kungah, “Khatveini-a ka kunga ang kilah mipa ang kilahkia hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Manoah zong ding pai-in a zinu zui a, tua mipa kungah pei-in ama kungah, “Tam nu kunga thugen pa nang na hiei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Manoah in, “Tu-in na thugen teng ang tangtun ciengin naupang’ hinkhuo ding bang hi ding a; ama in bang bawl ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in Manoah kungah, “Ama tunga ka gensa zosie numei nu na kipilvang taheh."},"14":{"text":"Ama in lenggui pana a pieng khat popo ne thei lo ding hi. Ama in lenggazu hile khamthei zucia hile dawn thei loin, a sieng lo na khat popo zong ne thei lo ding hi. Ama tunga ka thupieh zosie a zui kul ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi kungah Manoah in, “Khawl phot tadi inlen, nang adingin keelno khat hing bawl va ung,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in Manoah kungah, “Nei khawlsah le zong na an hing nehpieh sih vang; ahi vangin meihal biehna ding na siem nop leh Topa tungah pie in,” a ci hi. (Azieh pen Manoah in ama Topa’ vantungmi ahi lam a thei sih hi.)"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Manoah in Topa’ vantungmi kungah, “Na thugen teng ang tangtun ciengin nang kang patawi thei nadingun, na min bang ahiei?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ vantungmi in ama kungah, “Ka min bang dinga nei dawh ahei? Tua pen a lamdang mama ahi bo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 32:29"},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Manoah in keelno khat le an tawh biehna laton a, tuale ama tungah na lamdangte a bawl Topa adingin suong tungah a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Maitam panin vantung lamah meikuong a kato ciengin, Manoah le a zinu in a et laitahun maitam meikuong sungah Topa’ vantungmi kato hi; tuale amate a mai kunin leilahah a bawhsuh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Manoah le a zinu kungah Topa’ vantungmi a kilaakia nawn sih hi. Tua ciengin Manoah in ama Topa’ vantungmi ahi lam a thei na bo hi."},"22":{"text":"Manoah in a zinu kungah, “Pasien mu zo i hi ziehin a si valon ding i hi hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin a zinu in ama kungah, “Ei tha sawm hi leh Topa in i khut sung panin meihal biehna le an tawh biehnate ei sanpieh lo ding a, ahi sihle ama’ thu zosie ei lah loin tam bang nate tu-in ei pulah lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua numei in tapa khat nei a, a min Samson a phuoh hi. Naupang khanglien a, Topa in ama thupha a pie hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa’ hlagau in Zorah le Eshtaol kikal Mahaneh-dan ah Samson hansuo ding a kipan hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei Timnah ah Samson hawsuh a, ama in Timnah ah Philistia numei khat a mu hi.","title":"Samson’ Zineina"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin peito-in a nu le a pa kungah, “Timnah khuo-ah Philistia numei khat ka mu hi; tu-in ka zi dingin ei lahpieh un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle a nu le a pa in, “A tep kitanlo Philistia-te kung pan zi na lah nadingin na tanaute lah le i mite lahah numei khat beh om lo amah?” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin Samson in a pa kungah, “Ka zi dingin tua nu ei lahpieh teitei in, azieh pen tua nu in ei lungkimsah hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"A nu le a pa in tam thu Topa kung pan ahi lam a thei sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile ama in Philistia-te do nading paulap a sui laitah ahi hi. Khum hun lai-in Philistia-te in Israel-te a uh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nu le a pa tawh Timnah ah Samson a peisuh hi. Timnah lenggui lote-ah ama a tun ciengin humpi khanglai khat in na hawhsan hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama tungah Topa’ hlagau tung a, mi khat in keelno khat a balkeh bangin a khut guoh tawh humpi a balkeh hi. Ahi vangin tua a sil bawl a nu kung ahi a, a pa kungah ahi zongin gen lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama peisuhin tua numei tawh kiho a, tua nu in ama a lungdamsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zaw a sawt loin tua nu la dingin peikia a, humpi luonghawm en dingin ama lampielin a en leh humpi luonghawm sungah khuoi na pul a, a zu na om hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a khut tawh tuate sawhin peisuoh a, a pei kawmin a ne hi. A nu le a pa kungah a tun ciengin ama gel themkhat hawmin a ne uhi. Hizongle ama gel kungah ama in humpi luonghawm sung panin tua khuoizu a lah lam gen lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua numei kungah a pa peisuh a, tangvalte bawl dan ngaina a om bangin Samson in pawi khat a bawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Mite in ama a mu ciengun ama uop dingin mi sawmthum puoh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Samson in amate kungah, “Note kungah thu hahsa khat hing gen vang. Pawi bawl ni sagi sungin a thu mukhie-in bang ahei ci nei gen thei uleh saihadiel puon sil sawmthum le pawipuon sil sawmthum kang pie ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin bang ahei ci nei gen thei sih uleh saihadiel puon sil sawmthum le pawipuon sil sawmthum kei nei pie ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in a kungah, “Na thu hahsa ei gen in; ngai phot sei mah,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “A ne pa sung panin neh ding kimkhat pieng a, a thahat pa sung panin a hlum kimkhat pieng hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ni thum sungin tua thu hahsa bang ahei ci a gen thei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"A ni li ni-in Samson’ zi kungah, “Ka kung vuah tua thu hahsa bang ahei ci ang gen nadingin na pasal zawl in. Tua ahi sihle nang le na pa’ inn mei tawh kang halvam ding uhi. Ko ei zawngtumsah dinga tam sunga nei hlat amah?” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n a mai-ah Samson’ zi kapin, “Kei ei muda bo teh; ei ngai tahtah sih teh. Ka mite kungah thu hahsa khat na dong a, hinanle a khietna nei gen sih hi,” a ci hi. Ama in tua nu kungah, “En in, ka nu le ka pa kunga zong ka gen lopi bang dinga nang kunga kang gen ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Pawi bawl sung buppi ni sagi sung a mai-ah tua nu kap hi. Tua nu in ama kungah nget citahin a nget vangut ziehin a ni sagi ni-in a kungah a gen dawh ta hi. Tua ciengin tua nu in a mite kungah tua thu hahsa a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni sagi a cin ni, ni tum masangin tua khuomite in ama kungah a gen vua, “Khuoizu sanga hlumzaw ding bang hi a, humpi sanga hatzaw ding bang ahei?” a ci uhi. Tuale ama in amate kungah, Ka bawnglaa tawh lo hlo sih locin, ka thu hahsa na thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tungah Topa’ hlagau khautahin tung a, Ashkelon ah a peisuh hi. Ama in tua khuomite sawmthum that a, a vante uh lahpiehin thu hahsa a gen thei mite tungah a pawipuonte a pie hi. A lung sosa-in a pa’ inn lam a zuonkia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Samson zinu zong a kinun ni vua a molie pa a kipie ta hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw a sawt lo mangbu lah hunin Samson in keelno khat puo-in a zi kunga haw dingin a kuon hi. Ama in, “Ka zi innkhan sungah ka lut nuom hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin a sungpa in ama lutsah lo hi.","title":"Samson in Philistia-te Zo"},"2":{"text":"A sungpa in, “Nang in ama nuol zo ta ci kang telcien hi; tuaci’n na guolpa zi dingin ka na pie ta hi. A naunu ama sangin hoizaw hi lo amah? Ama tangin na la sih ding amah?” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Samson in amate kungah, “Tutungin Philistia-te tungah sietna ka bawl le zong ei kimawsiet lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Samson pei-in ngie zathum man a, meila zong a la hi; tuale ama in ngiete a mei le a mei kimatsahin a mei uh kikalah meila a koi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in meilate a hal zaw ciengin Philistia-te’ ankung a polaite lahah ngiete hla a, buphaite le bukung a polaite, lengga umte le olive lote zong haltum hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Philistia-te in, “Tam koi bawl ahiei?” ci-in dong uhi. Amate in, “Timnah-te’ mahpa Samson hal ahi hi. Azieh pen a sungpa in a zi lahpiehin a guolpa a na pieh dawh zieh ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Philistia-te peito-in tua nu le a pa mei tawh a haltum uhi."},"7":{"text":"Samson in a kung vuah, “Note’ bawl tami ahile kei ka kiciem hi. Na tung vua phu ka lah zawh masangsie ka ta sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a tawbuh a khelbuh uh satin mi tampi that hi; tuale ama peisuh a, Etam suongpi pawhkeh sungah a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Philistia-te a peito vua, Judah gamah giephuol satin Lehi a sim uhi."},"10":{"text":"Judah mite in, “Bang dinga ko ei do dinga hing peito na hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi. Amate in zong, “Samson a hen ding le ama in ko tunga ei bawl bangin ama tunga bawl dinga ang peito ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Etam suongpi pawhkeh-ah Judah mite mihing tulthum peisuhin Samson kungah, “Philistia-te in eite ei uh lam na thei sih amah? Tua ahile nang in ko bang bawla nei bawl ahiei?” a ci uhi. Ama in, “Amate in kei tunga ang bawl banga amate tunga zong ka bawl ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Philistia-te’ khut sungah kang pieh thei nadingun nangma hen dinga ang kuonsuh ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi. Samson in amate kungah, “Noma mama in kei nei tha lo nadingun kei tungah hing kiciem un,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Hi lo hi, nangma hing henin amau’ khut sungah kang pie beh ding vua, nang kang that sih ding uhi,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n khauhuol tha ni tawh ama henin tua suongpi panin a peipi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Lehi ah a tun ciengin ama dawn dingin Philistia-te awng kawmin a pei uhi; tuale ama tungah Topa’ hlagau khautahin tung a, tuale a khut tunga om henna khauhuolte mei in a kahtum anthul khau tawh kibang a, a khut panin a kihennate zungmang zieu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in laa’ khagu a tha khat mu a, a khut zahin tua khagu la-in tua tawh mihing tulkhat that hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale Samson in, “Laa khagu khat tawh a lom a lomin, laa khagu khat tawh mihing tulkhat ka that hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A thu gen a man zaw ciengin a laa khagu a paidawh uhi; tuale khum mun pen Ramath-lehi kici hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama a dangta mama a, tuale ama in Topa hlanin, “Na nasempa khut tawh tam guolzawna lienpi nei pie zo ta hi. Tu-in kei a dangta-a si ding le a tep kitanlo mite’ khut sunga pua ding ka hi ta amah?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in Lehi-a om kuoh sung munkhat pawhkehsah a, tua panin tui a phul hi. Tui a dawn leh a tha kidimkia-in a thakhaukia hi. Tua ahi ziehin khum mun En-hakkore kici a, tuni dongin Lehi ah a omlai hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale ama in Philistia-te’ uh hun sungin Israel-te kum sawmni sung thu a khen hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samson, khatvei Gaza ah a haw le tua munah numei pahtat khat mu-in a luppi hi.","title":"Samson le Delilah"},"2":{"text":"Gaza-te kungah, “Tam munah Samson ang tung zo ta,” ci-in kigen hi. Tuaci’n amate in khuopi a imtawm vua, zan tungtawnin khuopi tunkotah ama a buhdap uhi. Zan tungtawnin sip dide-in a om vua, “Khuovah cieng dong ngah vai; tua zaw ciengin ama that vai,” ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin zankim dong cieng beh Samsom lum hi. Zankim ciengin ama tho-in khuopi tunkot kotkhahte le a khuom nite tu-in a kotgolhte le adang teng zosie tawh bot zuonin a liengko-ah tuate puo a, Hebron mai-a muol vumah tuate a puoto hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Samson in Sorek kuomah a min Delilah a kici numei khat a ngai hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua nu kungah Philistia uliente pei-in, “Ama hing zol inlen, ama ia-cipin zothaw-in ka nuoinet thei nadingun bang in ama tua ci thahatsah ahei ci thu hing thei in; tuale ngun tang peh tul le zakhat ciet kang pie ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Delilah in Samson kungah, “Bang pen in nang ang hatsah a, mi khatpo in bangci leh hing zo thei-in khau tawh hing hencip thei ding ahei ci thu hepina tawh ei gen in,” a ci hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Samson in tua nu kungah, “A gaw nai lo thalkhau a tha sagi tawh ei hen uleh ka hat nawn sih ding a, mi maimai khat ka bang ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Philistia uliente in tua nu kungah a gaw nai lo thalkhau tha sagi a peipi vua, tua nu in tuami khaute tawh ama a hen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua laitahin innkhan sungah ama buh ding mite a om vua, tua nu in ama kungah, “Philistia-te in hing sim ve aw, Samson!” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in mei a suhkhah cienga a kitat zieu lel patkhaute bangin tua thalkhaute bottat zieu hi. Tuaci’n ama’ thahatna thusim kithei zo lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Delilah in Samson kungah, “Kei nei simmaw bawl a, zuouthu nei gen hi; nang bang hing kici hen thei ding hepina tawh ei gen in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “Khauhuol a tha a kizang nai lo tawh ei hen uleh ka hat nawn sih ding a, mi maimai khat ka bang ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n Delilah in khauhuol a thate la-in tuate tawh ama henin ama kungah, “Philistia-te in hing sim ve aw, Samson!” (Mite in ama innkhan sungah buhdap uhi) a ci hi. Hizongle vaukhau bawsan bangin ama in a khut henna khauhuolte a botsan zieu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Delilah in Samson kungah, “Tu dongin nei simmaw bawl a, zuouthu nei gen hi; nang bang hing kici hen thei ding ahei ci ei gen in,” a ci hi. Ama in tua nu kungah, “Ka luzanga ka samtel sagite siemphei tawh gantonin ciempeh tawh khenkip lacin ka hat nawn sih ding a, mi maimai khat ka bang ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama a lup laitahin Delilah in a luzanga a samtel sagite la-in siemin gan a, ciempeh tawh khenkip hi. Tua ciengin ama kungah, “Philistia-te in hing sim ve aw, Samson!” a ci hi. Hinanle a kimutna panin khanglo-in a ciempeh, a siembu, le a siem a kaigawp hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in ama kungah, “Na lungsim nei pieh vawt lopi bangci dan a, ‘Nang kang it hi,’ nei ci thei ahei? Tu-in thumvei vilvel kei nei simmaw bawl a, ang thahatsah bang ahei ci nei gen nuom sih hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A tawpna-ah tua nu in nisimin a kutkut ciengin, sina dong dingin ama a lunggim hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in tua nu kungah a thusim zosie gen a, “Ka lu tungah mulmetna a tukha ngai sih hi; azieh pen ka nu gil sung panin Pasien dinga nazir mi ka hi tabo hi. Ka sam ei kiheupieh leh ka hatna in ei nuasie ding hi; tua hile ka tha zawm pai-in midang maimai khat tawh ka kibang ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a thusim zosie ei gen sieng ta hi, ci Delilah in a thei bepin ama in mi sawlin Philistia uliente hlansah a, “Tu-in hing kuonto ta un, bang ding ahei cile a thusim zosie ei gen sieng zo ta hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin tua nu kungah Philistia uliente a kuonto vua, a khut sung vuah sum a tawi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua nu in a phei tungah ama a kimusah hi; tuale ama nu in mi khat hlanin a luzanga om a samtel sagite a heusah hi. Ama a thakieh kipan pai a, a hatna in ama a nuasie ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in, “Philistia-te in hing sim ve aw, Samson!” a ci hi. A kimutna panin ama a khahlaw ciengin, “Nidanga bangin peikhie vangin kei le kei kithingin suohta na vang,” ci-in a ngaisun hi. Ahi vangin Topa in a nuasie zo lam ama in a thei sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Philistia-te in ama manin a mit tegel a dawt thawppieh uhi. Amate in Gaza ah ama peipi suhin sumngo kol a bul uhi; tuale ama in thong sung angawina-ah an a gawi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kiheu zaw ciengin a luzanga a samte khan ding a kipankia pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Tu-in amau’ pasien Dagon tungah kithoina thupi khat bawl dingin Philistia uliente kikhawmin a guol nuom uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in, “I pasien in i khut sungah i galpa Samson ei pie zo hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Samson’ Sina"},"24":{"text":"Mite in ama a mu ciengun a pasien uh a phat uhi. Azieh pen amate in, “I pasien in eite khut sungah i galpa, i gam susie pa, tampitah ei that pa ei pie zo hi,” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"A lungsim uh a nop ciengin, “Ei guolnuomsah dingin Samson va hlan ta un,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n amate in thong sung panin Samson hlanin a guolnop nadingun a ki-apmaipi uhi. Amate in khuompi ni kikalah ama a dingsah uhi;"},"26":{"text":"tuale Samson in a khuta a kai pa kungah, “Ka kingap nadingin inndo khuompite ei thamsah in,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua laitahin a inn pen numei pasal tawh kidim hi; Samson a ki-apmai laitah a en Philistia ulien zosie le innkhum zangah numei le pasal mi tulthum bang a om uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samson in Topa hlanin ama in, ” Topa Pasien aw, tami khatvei beh kei ei phawh inlen keima’ mit tegel ei dawt thawppieh Philistia-te tungah khatvei beh phulahna tawh ka thuhkia thei nadingin tu beh lienin ei thahatsah in, Pasien aw,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Samson in inndo khuompi nite zamin a zietlam khutin khat, a veilam khutin khat tuoh tu-in ama gihna tawh tua khuomte-ah kingam hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samson in, “Philistia-te tawh ei sitonsah in,” a ci hi. A tha nei zosie tawh tha la dingin ama a kisang hi; tuale uliente le a sunga om mi zosie tungah a innpi a cimsuh hi. Tuaci’n a hin sunga a mi tha sangin a sina-a a mi tha tamzaw hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sanggamte le a innkuonpi zosie kuonsuhin a luong la-in a puoto vua, Zorah le Eshtaol kikala om a pa Manoah’ hanah a vui uhi. Ama in kum sawmni sung Israel-te thu a khen hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim muoltung gamah Micah a kici mi khat a om hi.","title":"Micah le Levi-pa"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a nu kungah, “Ngun tang peh tul le zakhat ang kilahpieh zieha awsie na suo a, kei zahna nangawnah na gen pen khu keima kungah a om hi; keima lah ahi hi; ahi vangin tu-in nangma tungah kang piekia ding hi,” a ci hi. A nu in, “ Topa in ka tapa thupha hing pie taheh!” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ngun peh tul le zakhat a nu kungah a piekia hi; tuale a nu in, “Tam ngun pen a kisung milim khat a bawl dingin ka khut sung pan ka tapa ading Topa tungah ka siensuo hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a nu kungah tua sumte a piehkia ciengin a nu in ngun tang zani la-in ngunseh pa kungah pie a, ama in a kisung sia milim khatin a sunpieh hi; tua pen Micah’ inn ah a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mipa Micah in biehbuhno khat nei a, siempu puon khat le teraphim bawlin a tapate lahah khat siempu semsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Israel gamah kumpi om nai lo hi; amau’ hoisah bang cietin mi zosie a gamta uhi.","ref":"Thkn 21:25"},"7":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Judah gam Bethlehem ah Judah be tangval khat a om hi. Ama Levi-te khat ahi a, khum munah a teng hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua mi pa in a muna mun khat popo-a teng dingin Judah gam Bethlehem a nuasie hi. A nasep a zop thei nadingin Ephraim muoltung gam sunga Micah’ inn ah ama a tung hi."},"9":{"text":"Micah in ama kungah, “Hei pana hing pei na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Judah gam Bethlehem khuo-a om Levi-te ka hi a, ten nading mun khat popo sui dinga ang pei ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Micah in ama kungah, “Kei kungah hing om inlen kei adingin pa le siempu hing hi ta’n; kum khatin ngun peh sawm, puon sil khat le na neh ding kang sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua mipa tawh omton dingin Levi-pa thukim pai a, tua tangvalpa ama kungah a tapate khat bangin a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n Micah in tua Levi tanggvalpa siempu-in koi a, Micah inn sungah a teng hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Micah in, “Tu-in Topa in ka dau ei peisah ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi, bangzieh ahei cile Levi-pa ka siempu a suoh zo hi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Israel sungah kumpi om lo hi. Khum hun lai-in Dan-te in a ten nading uh gam a sui uhi; bangzieh ahei cile khum hun dongin Israel minamte lahah amate luo ding gam kipie lo hi.","title":"Dan-te Khuolalna"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Dan-te in Zorah le Eshtaol panin tua gam endap ding le a mukhie dingin amau’ be buppi sung panin galhang pasal nga a sawl uhi; tuale amate in tua mite kungah, “Va pei unlen gam va sui ta un,” a ci uhi. Ephraim muoltung gama Micah’ inn ah amate a tun ciengun tua munah a taam uhi."},"3":{"text":"Micah’ inn ah amate a op laitahun a aw-in tua Levi tangvalpa a thei pailien uhi; tuaci’n amate pei-in ama kungah, “Nang tam munah koi hing puoh ahiei? Tam munah bang bawl na hiei? Tam munah na nasep bang ahiei?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Micah in kei dingin tam bang tam bang teng ei bawlpieh hi. Ama in ei cielin ama’ siempu ka suoh hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah, “Kang vaikuonna uh ka lawcing ding vuoi mah ci ka thei nadingun Pasien kungah ei dawhpieh in,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Siempu pa in, “Lung nuomin pei un. Na nasep ding uh Topa’ mit in a en zing hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasal ngate pei-in Laish a tun ciengun tua sunga teng mite pen Sidon-te bang dan ma-in galmuongin daitah le ngaimuongtahin a om vua, leitungah bangma tasap nei loin a hauna uh a mukhie uhi. Tua tham loin Sidon-te tawh a kigamla vua, Aram-te tawh kizopna a nei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Zorah le Eshtaol-a om a unaute kung a tun ciengun amate kungah, “Bang gen ding na nei vuoi?” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in, “Hing pei un, amate sim dingin va kuonto ta vai; bang ding ahei cile a gam ka musa uh ahi a, hoi mama hi. Bang khat beh bawl sawm lo na hi uh amah? Pei ding kiheh sih un, lutin tua gam va luo ta vai."},"10":{"text":"Na pei ciengun bangma a khophawh veteh lo mite kung na tung ding uhi. Tua gam a zai mama a- Pasien in na khut sung vuah tua gam ang pieh tahtah ahi hi- leitungah tasapna bangma khat beh a op lona mun khat ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Zorah le Eshtaol panin galhiem tawi Dan-te be pasal zaguh a kuon vua, tuale"},"12":{"text":"amate peito-in Judah gam Kiriath-jearim munah giephuol a sat uhi. Tam thu ziehin tua mun Mahaneh-dan kici a, Kiriath-jearim nitumna lamah a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Khum mun panin Ephraim muoltung gamah amate peisuohin Micah’ inn a tung uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum gam (Laish a kici) endap dinga a pei pasal ngate in a kithuopi mite kungah, “Tam innte sungah siempu puon khat, teraphim, le a kisung sia milim khat a om lam na thei vuoi mah? Tua ahi ziehin tu-in na bawl ding uh ngaisun un,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum lamah amate kihei-in Micah’ inna om tangvalpa Levi inn ah tungin ama a hopi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kulkotpi lutna-ah galhiem tawi Dan-te pasal za guh a din laitahun"},"17":{"text":"gam endap pasal ngate a sungah a lut vua, amate in sia kisung milim, siempu puon, le teraphim-te a la uhi. Galhiem a tawi pasal za guhte tawh kulkotpi lutna-ah siempupa a ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Micah’ inn sungah tua pasalte lutin a kisung sia milim, siempu puon, le teraphim-te a lah ciengun siempupa in a kung vuah, “Bang bawl na hi vuoi?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in, “Ham sin! Na khutin na kam humin ei zui inlen, ka pa ule ka siempu uh hing hi ta’n. Nang adingin mi khat’ inn sunga siempu hi ding hoizaw amah, tua ahi sihle Israel-te sungah minam le be siempu hi ding hoizaw ahei?” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu pa in a ngetna uh a sang hi. Ama in siempu puon, teraphim, le milim-te la-in mite tawh a peiton hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n amai vuah a tasente uh, a ganhonte ule a vante uh nuasie-in khuolzin a zom uhi."},"22":{"text":"Micah’ inn pan a gamla sim khat a tun ciengun Micah’ inn gei-a innte sunga om pasalte a kiciel vua, amate in Dan-te nuadelin a pha uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in a kinuahei Dan-te awhsanin Micah kungah, “Tam bang mihonpi tawh nang pei nadingin bang thu om ahei?” a ci uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in dawngkia a, “Note in ka bawlsa ka pasien-te le ka siempu pa la-in a na peipi uhi, tuale ke’n bang nei lai ka hei? Tua ahile bang hangin, “Bang thu om ahei?”ci-in kei ei dong na hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Dan-te in ama kungah, “Kote lahah na aw kizasah vet sin. Tua hi sihle a lungtom ka guolte in nang hing simin na hinna le na innkuon’ hinna na tan kha bep ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a lampi vuah Dan-te a pei uhi. Micah in ama adingin amate thahat luo hi, ci-in a mu ciengin ama kihei-in a inn lam a zuon hi."},"27":{"text":"Dan-te in Micah’ bawlsate le a siempu pa a lahpieh zaw ciengun a gamdai le a khophawh veteh lo mite opna Laish-ah a tung vua, namsau tawh amate vatin mei tawh khuopi a hal uhi.","title":"Laish ah Dan-te Teng"},"28":{"text":"Sidon tawh kigamla-in Aram tawh kizopna a nei lo ziehun amate a hunkhie ding koima a om sih hi. Tua khuopi pen Beth-rehob te’ neisa kuom sungah a om hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate in khum khuopi pen Israel’ suon, amau’ pienna a pu uh Dan min tapin Dan ci uhi; ahi vangin nidang lai-in Laish khuo kici hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Dan-te in amate dingin milim a phut uhi. Moses’ tapa, Gershom’ tapa Jonathan le a tapate in salin tua gam a kipeipi masang dongin Dan-te dingin siempu a sem uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n Shiloh ah Pasien’ biehbuh a om hun sung tungtawnin Micah’ bawlsa milim a kemcing uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Israel-te sungah kumpi om loin Ephraim muoltung gam monga a teng Levi-te khat in Judah gam Bethlehem panin a mei dingin numei khat a la hi.","title":"Levi-pa’ Meinu"},"2":{"text":"Hizongle a meinu ama tungah lungthahin Judah gam Bethlehem-a a pa’ inn ah nuatai a, khum tahah hla li sung bang a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kam nemno tawh tua nu a hopi ding le a peipikia dingin a pasal a kuon hi. Ama in a nasempa le laa ni a zawpi hi. A pa’ inn ah a tun ciengin tua nu’ pa in ama mu-in lungdamna tawh a dawn dingin a pei hi."},"4":{"text":"A sungpa, tua nu’ pa, in ama taamsah a, ama tawh ni thum sung a omton hi; tuaci’n an ne tui dawnin a om vua, tua munah ama a taam hi."},"5":{"text":"A ni li ni zingmawngin tho bai-in a pei dingin a kithawi uhi; hinanle a sungpa in a mahpa kungah, “An themkhat ne inlen na tha khausah phot in. Tua ciengin na pei na sih ding amah,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua mi nite to-in an ne tui dawnin a om uhi; tuale numeino’ pa in mipa kungah, “Tuzan giehkia ta unlen nuomtahin om un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"A pei dingin tua mipa a din ciengin a sungpa in a zan taamkia masangsie a hlo tentun hi."},"8":{"text":"A ni nga ni zingmawngin a pei dingin ama thobai hi; tuale a sungpa in, “An ne phot tadi in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n nikai dongin ama gel a khawl vua, a ni gelin an ne tui dawnin a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Mipa, a meinu le a nasempa a pei dingin a din ciengun a sungpa, numei nu’ pa in ama kungah, “En in, ni nai ta hi, khuomu ding ahi ta hi. Tuzan giehkia lai un. En in, ni a tum dihtah ta hi. Zan taam unlen nuomtahin omkia ta un. Zing cieng zingmawngin tho bai unlen na inn lam vuah pei un,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle tua mipa zan taam nawn lo hi; ama dingin a pei a, Jebus khuo galkhatah (Jerusalem a cina) a tung hi. Ama a phaw kivaw laa ni le a meinu tawh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Jebus khuo gei a phah ciengun ni tum dihtah a, a nasempa in a pu kungah, “Tun hing pei in, tam Jebus-te’ khuopi lamah kihei-in a sungah zan taam vai,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Hizongle a pupa in ama kungah, “Israel mite-a’ ahi lo, gamdang mite’ khuopi sungah kihei-in i lut sih ding uhi; Gibeah lamah i peisuoh zaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nasempa kungah, “Pei vai, tam munte khat penpen i tun nading hanciemin, Gibeah ahi sihle Ramah ah zan taam vai,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n nawtsuohin a lampi vuah a pei uhi; tuale Benjamin-te’ gam Gibeah gei a tun tahun ni a tum hi."},"15":{"text":"Gibeah ah pei-in a gieh dingin khum lamah a kihei uhi. Ama pei-in khuopi tuol-awngah a to a, ahi vangin koima in amate a inn vuah a tungsah nuom sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin nitahin puvuoi lo kuon vai pei khat a om hi. Khum pa pen Ephraim muoltung gam pan ahi a, Gibeah ah a teng hi. (Khum muna tengte pen Benjamin-te ahi uhi.)"},"17":{"text":"Tua puvuoi pa khuodah a, khuopi tuol-awng lai-a keng tawh khuolzin pa a mu ciengin ama in, “Hei-a haw ding na hi a, hei pana hing pei na hiei?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Judah gam Bethlehem panin Ephraim muoltung gam mong lam zuon dinga ang nawh ka hi uhi. Judah gam Bethlehem-a pei ka hi a, ka inn lam zuon ding ka hi hi. Koima in a inn ah ei tungsah nuom lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Ko na nasemte in ka laate dingun butu le gan-an, keima, numei nu le kang zawpi uh tangvalpa dingin zong moh le lenggazu ka nei vua, bangma ka kisam sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Puvuoi pa in, “Na tungah nopna om taheh. Na kisap zosie kang bawlpieh ding hi. Tuol-awngah gieh vawt sin,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in inn ah amate zawpi-in a laate uh an pie hi; amate in a keng uh silin an ne tui dawnin a om uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate a kiguolnop suo laitahun-khuopi sunga mi tatsie honkhat in tua inn a kui-im vua, a kotkhah a tum gawp uhi. Innteh puvuoi pa kungah, “Na inn sunga ang lut mipa ka luppi thei nadingun hing pusuohsah in,” a ci uhi.","title":"Gibeah’ Mawna"},"23":{"text":"Innteh pa pei-in a kung vuah, “Hi lo hi, ka sanggamte aw, tam bangin gamtat sie sih un. Tam mipa ka zinpa ahi ziehin tam bangin gamtat sie sih un."},"24":{"text":"Tam sungah ka ta ngahnu le ama’ meinu a om hi; tu-in ama gel hing peipi vang. Ama gel buonin na dei bangun kibawl ta un; hinanle tam mipa tungah tua bangin gamtat sie malmal sih un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 19:5-8"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua mite in ama thu gen a ngai sih uhi. Tuaci’n tua pa in a meinu manin amate tungah a pie hi. Amate in tua nu buonin zan tungtawn khuova dongin a sauthang uhi. Amate in zingmawng phalva kisem pat tahin tua nu a peisah uhi."},"26":{"text":"Khuo a vah bepin numei nu pei-in a pupa opna tua mipa’ inn kotbiengah nisuo dongin a pua hi."},"27":{"text":"Zingmawngin a pupa tho-in inn kotkhahte hong a, a pei dingin a kisa leh sangkil tungah a khut ngamin inn kotkhahah a lum a meinu a mu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “Tho in, pei ta vai,” a ci hi. Hinanle ama in a dawng sih hi. Tua ciengin ama in a laa tungah tua nu a puo hi; tuale a inn lam a zuon hi."},"29":{"text":"Inn a tun ciengin ama in nam khat la-in a meinu tu-in a phei a liengin se sawm le se ni suo-in semnen a, Israel gam zosie-ah a hawm hi.","ref":"1Sam 11:7"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a mi sawlte kungah, “Israel-te zosie tungah, ‘Egypt gam panin Israel-te a peito vua kipan tuni dongin tam bang thu a pieng ngai ta amah? Tam thu ngaisun un, kikum unlen genkhie un,’ na ci ding uhi,” ci-in amate thu a pie hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te zosie, Dan panin Beer-sheba dong, Gilead gam zong a kihal, a kuon vua, Topa mai Mizpah ah kengkhatkhai bangin mihonpi a kikhawm uhi.","title":"Adang Minamte in Benjamin-te Sim"},"2":{"text":"Israel minam zosie sung panin mipi makai zosie a kikhawm vua, namsau a tawi keng-galkap tul zali, Pasien’ mite kikhopna-ah amate mama a kipie uhi."},"3":{"text":"(Tu-in Benjamin-te in Mizpah ah Israel-te a peito zo lam a za uhi.) Israel-te in, “Ei gen un, bangci dan a tam tatsietna hing pieng ahei?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"A kithat numei nu’ pasal Levi-pa in dawng a, “Benjamin-te’ gam Gibeah ah a zangie dingin keima le ka meinu ka tung uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gibeah uliente ang kuonto vua, zan lai-in ka tunna inn ei kui-im uhi. Amate in kei tha ei sawm vua, a si dongin ka meinu a buon uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka meinu la-in ka semnen a, Israel-te’ luo gam sung zosie-ah kang hawm hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in Israel gam sungah a kidahhuoi le a mothuoi na a sem uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n no Israel-te zosie aw, tu-in na ngaisutna uh gen unlen tam sungah kikum un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi zosie kengkhatkhai bangin a ding pai vua, “I puonbuhte-ah koima khat zong pei loin, koima khat zong inn lamah i kilekia sih ding hi"},"9":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in Gibeah tunga i bawl ding uh tam bang ahi hi: Tua khuo sim dingin aisanna tawh i kuonto ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Israel gama a na gamtatsa uh mindaina teng zosie ziehin Benjamin-te’ gam Gibeah a thuhkia ding ahi galkapte’ anneh tuidawn a puo dingin Israel minam zosie sung panin mi zakhat lahah sawm khat, tulkhat lahah zakhat, tul sawm lahah tulkhat i la ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n khuopi sim dingin Israel mite zosie mihing khat bangin kithutuohin a kikhawm uhi."},"12":{"text":"Benjamin minam zosie kungah Israel minamte in mi sawlin, “Note lahah na bawl uh mawna bang ahiei?"},"13":{"text":"Tua ziehin kote in tu-in amate thatin Israel sung pan sietna ka hepkhiet thei nadingun Gibeah-a mi ginalote ei pie un,” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin Benjamin-te in a unau Israel-te’ thu gen a ngai sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Israel-te tungah gal bawlin a kuon dingin khuopite panin Benjamin-te a kikhawm uhi."},"15":{"text":"Khum ni-in Benjamin-te in a khuopite uh panin Gibeah-a a teng mite banah namsau tawi mi tul sawmni le tulguh a khawm uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tam galkap zosiete lah pana kituomtel a veilawng mi zasagi a om hi; amate pen a unpi-un suongtang tawh samzam kapin a khiel lote ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Israel-te in Benjamin-te simlo, namsau tawi thei galkap mihing tul zali a khawm vua, a unpi-un galsiem mite ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Bethel kato dingin Israel-te a peisuoh vua, “Benjamin-te sim dingin koi pen kuonto masa ding ka hi uh hei?” ci-in khum munah Pasien a dong uhi. Topa in, “Judah kuonto masa ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te zingmawngin tho-in Gibeah khuo sim dingin giephuol a sat uhi."},"20":{"text":"Benjamin-te sim dingin Israel-te a peito uhi; tuale Benjamin-te sim dingin Israel-te in Gibeah ah panmun a la uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gibeah panin Benjamin-te kuonin tua ni-in Israel-te tul sawmni le tulni a satlia uhi."},"22":{"text":"(23) Israel-te kuonto-in Topa mai-ah nitah dongin a kap uhi. Amate in Topa a dong vua, “Ka unau Benjamin-te tawh gal kisim dingin ka va naikia ta ding vuoi mah?” a ci uhi. Topa in, “Amate sim dingin kuonto un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"(22) Israel-te kihansuo-in a ni masa ni-a a panmun ma vuah gal a pangkia uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n a ni ni ni-in Benjamin-te sim dingin Israel-te mai nawt uhi."},"25":{"text":"A ni ni ni-in amate sim dingin Gibeah panin Benjamin-te kuonkhie-in Israel-te mi tul sawm le tulgiet a satlia vua, amate a unpi-un namsau tawite ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a galkap buppi-un Israel-te zosie Bethel-ah kilekia-in tua mun Topa mai-ah to-in a kap uhi; amate in tua ni nitah dongin an a tang uhi."},"27":{"text":"Israel-te in Topa a dong vua, (azieh pen khum hun lai-in tua munah Pasien’ thukham singkuong om a,"},"28":{"text":"Aaron’ tapa Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in khum hunin tua mai-ah na a sem hi), “Ka unau uh Benjamin-te sim dingin khatvei kuonkia lai ding ka hi uh amah, tua ahi sihle khawl ding ka hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi. Topa in dawng a, “Kuonto un, azieh pen zing ciengin na khut sung vuah amate kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel-te in Gibeah kimkotah a buhdap dingin mi a koi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin a ni thum ni-in Benjamin-te sim dingin Israel-te a kuonto vua, a masa-a bangin Gibeah langkhatah panmun a la uhi."},"31":{"text":"Galkapte do dinga Benjamin-te a kuon ciengin khuopi panin amate kipeikhiesah hi. A masa-a bangin amate in galkapte liemsahin thalup a kipan vua, Bethel lama a peito pen le Gibeah lama a pei lamlienpi dung teng, le gamzang lai-ah Israel-te sawmthum bang a that uhi."},"32":{"text":"Benjamin-te in, “A masa-a bangin i mai vuah amate kizo ta hi,” ci-in a ngaisun uhi. Hinanle Israel-te in, “Nuakin vai-in khuopi panin lamlien lamah amate peisah vai,” a kici ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Geba nitumna lam panin a budap Israel mite a nawtai laitahun, Baal-tamar ah Israel mite a nuatawn vua, gal sim dingin panmun a lakia uhi."},"34":{"text":"Gibeah khuo a sim dingin Israel-te zosie sung panin a kituomtel mi tul sawm a kuon vua, gal kidona a nasie mama hi. Ahi vangin Benjamin-te in amate tungah gimna a tun baih lam ding a thei sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Israel-te mai-ah Topa in Benjamin-te a zo hi; khum ni-in Israel-te in Benjamin-te tul sawmni le tulnga le zakhat a that vua, a unpi-un namsau tawite ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Benjamin-te a guollel lam a kithei uhi. Benjamin-te in mun a awn uhi, azieh pen Israel-te in Gibeah sim dinga a koi uh a buhdap galkapte a muong uhi."},"37":{"text":"A buhdap galkapte zong nawpei-in Gibeah a bulu uhi. Tua ciengin khuopi sunga om mite zosie namsau tawh a satlia sieng uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tu-in Israel mite le a buhdapte kikalah thukimna khat om a, amate in khuopi sung panin meikhu lompi a suosah to ciengun"},"39":{"text":"gal sim dingin Israel mipite kiheikia ding uhi. Ahi vangin Benjamin-te in Israel-te liemsahin thalia ding a kipan uhi; mihing sawmthum bang a that uhi; tuaci’n amate in, “Kido masah lai-a bangin i mai vuah amate kizo tahtah ta hi,” a ci uhi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuopi panin meikhu lompi meilum bangin kato dinga a kipat ciengin Benjamin-te a kinua hei vua, tuale a khuopi buppi katumin vantung lamah meikhu kato a mu uhi!"},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel mite a kihei vua, Benjamin-te a lungkie uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate tungah gimna a tun ding hun a nai lam a thei uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel-te kung panin amate kinuale-in gamlah a manaw uhi; ahi vangin gal in amate a nuaphah a, khuopi pana a pusuoh mite in a kikal sung tengah amate a that sieng uhi."},"43":{"text":"Amate in Benjamin-te a that vua, Nohah panin Gibeah nisuona mun dongah amate delin a tuoncil uhi."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin-te mi tul sawm le tulgiet a si vua, a unpi-in galhang vive ahi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Amate kihei-in senel gam lam Rimmon suongpi zuonin a tai vua, lamlienpi dungah mi tul nga kisatlia a, Gidom dongin kidelin mi tulni kithat hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in namsau tawi a kithat Benjamin-te zosie tul sawmni le tul nga pha a, a unpi-un galhang vive ahi uhi."},"47":{"text":"Hinanle mi zaguh kihei-in senel gam Rimmon lam zuonin a tai vua, Rimmon suongpi-ah hla li sung a om uhi."},"48":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Benjamin-te sim dingin Israel-te kilekia-in namsau tawh a khuopi, a mihing le a ganhingin a om zosie a vatlia uhi. A omlai khuopite zong mei tawh a hal uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Mizpah ah Israel-te a kiciem zo ta vua, “Koima khat beh in i tanute uh Benjamin-te tawh i kinungsah sih ding uhi,” a kici uhi.","title":"Cigamna Ding Panin Benjamin-te Kihunkhie"},"2":{"text":"Tuale Bethel ah mite pei-in khum sunga Pasien mai-ah amate nitah dong to-in nahpitahin a kap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in, “Israel-te’ Pasien, Topa aw, tuni-in Israel-te sungah minam khat a pelem nadingin tam thu bang dinga hing pieng ahei?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"A zing ciengin mite tho bai-in tua munah maitam khat a lam vua, meihal biehna le thunuom biehpiehnate a pie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel-te in, “Israel minamte zosie sung panin Topa kunga kikhopna ah koi teng hing pei lo ahei?” a ci uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa kunga a pei lo mite tawh kisai-in Mizpah ah kiciemna lienpi khat a bawl vua, “Tua mipa kithat ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hizongle Israel-te in a unau uh Benjamin dingin a laina vua, “Tuni-in Israel sung panin minam khat a kihemkhie ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Amau’ zi dingin i tanute pie sih vai ci-in Topa tungah i kiciem zo tah ziehun eite in a hinglaite ading zi bangci guot ding i hi uh ahei? a kici uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua bepin amate in, “ Topa kung Mizpah ah Israel minamte ang pei lo a om ei?” a ci uhi. Amate in Jabesh-gilead panin kikhopna giephuolah koima khat beh a pei lo lam a phawh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen mite lahah min a kihlat ciengin khum munah Jabesh-gilead khuo-a tengte khat zong om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum sungah mihonte in galkap mihing tul sawm le tulni a sawl vua, “Pei unlen Jabesh-gilead khuo-a tengte, namsau tawh nupite le naupang neute tawh va that ta un."},"11":{"text":"Tam bangin na bawl ding uhi; pasal zosie le pasal tawh a lumtonsa numei zosie na sumaimang ding uhi,” ci-in thu pie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Jabesh-gilead khuo-a tengte lahah pasal tawh a lumton ngai nai lo ngahnu siengtho zali a mu vua, Canaan gam sunga a om Shiloh giephuolah a peipi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin mihonte in Rimmon suongpi-a om Benjamin-te kungah thu a puoh vua, amate tungah kilemna thu a gen uhi."},"14":{"text":"Khum hunin Benjamin-te kilekia-in Jabesh-glead numei a hingkhawite uh amate a pie uhi; hizongle amate adingin numei kicing zo lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in Israel minam sungah kikhenkehna a opsah ziehin Benjamin-te tungah mite in lainatna a nei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihonpi upate in, “Benjamin-te sungah numei om nawn lo ahi ziehin a hinglaite zi bangci guot ding i hei?” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale amate in, “Israel-te sung panin minam khat a manthai lo nadingin a hinglai Benjamin-te adingin gamhluo a op lo phamaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite in lah amau’ zi dingin i tanute i pie thei ta sih uhi,” a ci uhi. Azieh pen Israel-te a kiciemzo ta vua, “Benjamin-te tawh a tanu kinungsah poma in samsietna thuoh taheh,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in, “En un, Bethel sah lam, Bethel panin Shechem peitona lamlienpi nisuona lam, Lebonah leitaw lama om Shiloh ah Topa adingin kumsim pawi bawlna om hi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in Benjamin-te thu hil in, “Va pei-in lengga lote-ah va kibuhdap ta un."},"21":{"text":"Lamvui lahah Shiloh nungahte a lam dinga ang pei ciengin, lengga lote panin pusuohin na zi dingun khat ciet man unlen Benjamin gamah peipi un."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka kung vuah a pate ahi sihle a sanggamte hing pei-in ei mawsah leh amate kungah, ‘Nohaw hing kiphal mai unlen amate zi ei guonsah un; bangzieh ahei cile mikim zi ding gal sungah ka matpieh zo sih uhi. Ahi vangin note in na tanute uh amate tawh na kinunsah uh hi sam lo ahi ziehin no zong na maw tuom sih uhi,’ ka ci ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin Benjamin-te a gamta uhi; amate in a laamte lah panin numei khat ciet zi dingin manin a taipi uhi. Tua ciengin amate pei-in a gam vuah a kilekia vua, khuopite lam phakia-in tuate sungah a teng uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum hunin amau’ minam le a innkuonpi ciet tawh khum panin Israel-te a pei vua, khum panin a gam ciet a zuon uhi."},"25":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Israel-te sungah kumpi om lo hi; amau’ hoisah bangin mi zosie a gamta uhi.","ref":"Thkn 17:6"}}}}},"8":{"info":{"name":"Ruth","shortname":"Ruth","abbr":[],"desc":"Ruth laibu (the book of ruth)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thukhente in a uh hun lai-in khum gam sungah kielpi khat tung a, Judah gam Bethlehem khuomi khat, a zi le a tapa ni tawh Moab gama teng dingin a pei uhi.","title":"Moab ah Elimelech’ Innkuon Pei"},"2":{"text":"Tua pa’ min Elimelech ahi a, a zinu’ min Naomi hi-in, a tapa nite’ min pen Mahlon le Chilion ahi hi; ama gel pen Judah gam Bethlehem-a Ephrathah-te ahi uhi. Ama gel Moab gamah pei-in tuanah a teng den uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle Naomi’ pasal Elimelech si a, a tapa ni tawh ama a nuasie hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam tegel in Moab-te zi-in a la uhi; khat nu’ min Orpah ahi a, adang khat’ min Ruth ahi hi. Khum munah kum sawm sung bang a ten zaw ciengun"},"5":{"text":"Mahlon le Chilion zong a ni gelin si a, a tapa ni le a pasal in tua nupi nu a nuasie hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mo tegel tawh Moab gam pana kilekia dingin a kisa hi. Azieh pen Topa in a mite ve a, an neh tuidawn a pieh dan thute Moab gam panin ama in za zo hi.","title":"Naomi le Moab Monu"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n a tenna mun panin a mo tegel tawh Judah gam peikia dingin a lampi vuah a pei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Naomi in a mo tegel kungah, “Na inn tuoh vuah pei ta unlen, na nute utawh om un. A sisate le kei tungah nei lim bawl bangun Topa in hing limbawl taheh."},"9":{"text":"Topa in na pasalkia uh’ inn tuohah lungnopna mu dingin hing siem taheh,” a ci hi. Tua bepin ama gel namin awngin a kikaa uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama gel in ama kungah, “Hi lo e, na mite kungah ko zong hing pei va ung,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Naomi in, “Kilekia zaw un, ka tanute aw, bang dinga kei ei zui ding na hi uh ahei? No gel’ pasal ding tapa neikia lai ding ka mah?"},"12":{"text":"Kilekia un, ka tanute aw, na inn vuah pei un; azieh pen pasal nei dingin kei ka vuoi ta hi. Pasal nei dingin kilamen ma leng zong tu zan mama-in pasal nei kia-in, tapa neikia phiel ta ma leng zong,"},"13":{"text":"a gol dong uh ngah zo ding na hi uh amah? Hi lo hi, ka tanute aw, Topa in kei ei bawlsiet ziehin no sangin kei ka lung a khamzaw hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin awgingin a kikaa kia uhi. Orpah in a innpinu namin mangpha pai a, hinanle Ruth in a innpinu a bel lenlon hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Naomi in, “En vawi, a mipite le a pasien-te kungah na guolnu peikia zo hi. Na guolnu nua kizui ta’n,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ruth in, “Nang nuasie nading ahi a, nang kang zuina panin ka kinuale nading ahi zongin ei pausawl da in! Na peipeina-ah ka pei ding hi; na giegiena-ah ka gieh ding hi; na mite keima’ mi hi ding a, na Pasien keima’ Pasien hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na sisina-ah ka si ding a, tuanah ka kivui ding hi, sina nangawn in nang kung panin ei khen leh Topa in ei dawm sih hinlen, a nasie zaw-in ei bawl lai taheh!” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Naomi in ama a zui ding a khentat lam a thei bepin ama kungah bangma gen nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Bethlehem a tun dongun a ni gelin a peisuoh uhi. Bethlehem a tun tahun ama gel ziehin a khuozangun a linglawng vua, nupite in, “Tam nu Naomi ma amah?” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in amahaw kungah, “Naomi ei ci nawn sih unlen, Mara ei ci un. Azieh pen Vanglienpa in nahpi tahin ei gimsah hi."},"21":{"text":"A dimletin ka peikhie a, ahi vangin Topa in a hawmin ei tunpikia hi; Topa in kei ei huotbawlin Vanglienpa in ka tungah gimna ang tunsah zaw ciengin, bang dingin kei Naomi ei ci na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moab gam pana a kilekia a monu Moab numei Ruth tawh Naomi a peikia hi. Ama gel pen Bethlehem ah mangbuham lah kipat laitahin a tung uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Naomi in a pasal lam panin a sanggam, Elemelech innsung mi Boaz a kici mihau mi thupi khat nei hi.","title":"Boaz tawh Ruth Kimu"},"2":{"text":"Moab numei Ruth in Naomi kungah, “Lo-ah ei kuonsah inlen, maipha ka muna popo pa’ nua-ah ansangh va khon ta vang,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Va pei tan, ka tanu aw,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 19:9-10; Thkna 24:19"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama kuonin anlate nua-ah ansangh a khon hi. Tuale Elimelech’ innkuon Boaz’ lo ah a va kuonkha ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zaw lienin Bethlehem panin Boaz ang pei a, ama in anlate kungah, “Note tawh Topa hing om taheh” a ci hi. Amate in zong, “ Topa in nang thupha hing pie taheh,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin anlate a uh a nasempa kungah, “Tam koi’ ngahnu ahiei? a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Anlate a uh a nasempa in, “Moab gam pana Naomi tawh ang kilekia Moab numei ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua numei in, ‘Kang thum hi, ansangh ei khonsah inlen anlate’ nua-a bulomte lahah a tuolkiete ei tungsah in,’ ei ci hi. Tuaci’n ama ang pei-in zingmawnga kipanin tu cieng dongin bakhat sung nangawn khawl loin a sem hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Boaz in Ruth kungah, “Tu-in ngai in ka tanu aw, ansangh khon dingin lo dangah kuon sin, tam lo nuasie sinlen ka nasem numeite gei-ah om lenlon in."},"9":{"text":"Lolai-ah an kilahna sa en lenlon inlen, amau’ nua zui in. Tangvalte in nang ang bawlsiet lo nadingin thu ka pie zo hi. Na dang a ta leh pei inlen tui beel sunga tangvalte’ tui tawisa dawn in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuol kunsuhin khupbawh a, “Kei gamdang mi khat hi lel bo ing a, bang dinga kei nei hici phaw a, na maipha ka mukhah adiei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Boaz in ama dawngin, “Na pasal a si zaw-a kipanin na innpinu na limbawlna le na nu na pa le na pienna gam nuasie-in na thei ngai lo mite kunga nang peina thu a kimin ei kigen zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in na silbawlte ziehin thaman hing pie-in, ama’ hla hlim nei bel dinga nang zot Israel-te’ Pasien Topa tung panin thaman bucing nga ta in!” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ruth in, “Ka pu aw, na mai-ah maipha ei ngasah zom lai in. Azieh pen kei na nasem numeite lahah khat zong ahi lo kimlai, na nasemnu tungah nang kamsiem a, nei hlamuongsah hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Boaz in anneh hun ciengin tua nu kungah, “Tanah hing pei in, anlum pawlkhat ne inlen, lenggazu sungah na an die in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n anlate gei-ah ama to-in tua pa in bukan kimkhat a pie hi. Ama in a kham masangsie ne a, khamval pawlkhat omlai hi."},"15":{"text":"Ansangh khonin ama a dinkia ciengin Boaz in a tangvalte hil a, “Buphai lahte nangawnah na khonsah unlen na maizumsah sih un."},"16":{"text":"Anlom kihensate lah panin zong kimkhat ladawhin ama’ khon dingin na nuasie unlen ama na phawhsie sih un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in nitah dongin lolai-ah ansangh a khon hi. Tua ciengin ama in a khonsate cil a, mangbuham ephah khat bang a pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in tuate puo-in khuo sungah a pei a, ama in ansangh bangza khon ci a innpinu in a mu hi. Tua ciengin ama in a an khawnla teng zong la-in a innpinu a pie hi."},"19":{"text":"A innpinu in ama kungah, “Tuni-in hei sungah ansangh na va khon tai? Koi’ lo-ah na kuon ei? Nang ang phawhkha pa in thupha nga taheh,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a innpinu kungah a naseppite thu gen a, “Tuni-a ka na sepna pa’ min Boaz ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Naomi in a monu kungah, “A migitna in a hinglaite ahi a, a sisate ahi zongin a nuasiesah vawt lo Topa in ama thupha pie taheh!” a ci hi. Naomi in ama kungah, “Tua mipa khu i tanaute, i kinaipi pente lahah khat ahi hi,” zong a cibe lai hi.","ref":"Siem 25:25"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moab numei Ruth in, “Ama in ka kungah, ‘Ka anlah sieng zaw masangsie ka nasemte kungah om in,’ ei ci lai hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Naomi in a monu Ruth kungah, “Ka tanu aw, a numeite tawh na kuonton pen hoizaw hi. Tua hi sihle lo dangah ang kibawlsie kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Boaz’ numeite nai-ah Ruth om a, mangbu le mangbuham lah zo masangsie ansangh khonin a innpinu tawh a omton hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A innpinu Naomi in ama kungah, “Ka tanu aw, na nopsah nadingin sil muonhuoi khat kang suipieh ding kisam hi.","title":"Ancilna-ah Ruth le Boaz"},"2":{"text":"A nasem ngahnute tawh na nasepna i sanggampa Boaz tanah tu-in a om hi. En in, ama in tu zanin ancilna-ah mangbuham zoi-in a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Kisilin sathau kinu inlen na puon hoipente silin ancilna lamah peisuh in; ahi vangin a neh a dawn a man masangsie ama kungah na pei lam kitheisah sin."},"4":{"text":"Ama a lup ciengin a lupna encien in; tua ciengin, pei-in a keng lem inlen lum in; tuale ama in na bawl ding ang gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a kungah, “Na gen zosie ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama ancilna-ah peisuhin a innpinu hil bang tehtehin a gamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Boaz in a neh a dawn zaw ciengin a lung nuom a, a lum dingin anphuol gei-ah a pei hi."},"8":{"text":"Zankim laitahin thakhatin khangloin a kihei leh a khawdop-ah numei khat na lum hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Nang koi na hiei?” a ci hi. Tua nu in dawng a, “Kei na nasemnu Ruth ka hi hi; na puon tawh na nasemnu ei hui in, azieh pen ka tanau kinaipi pen na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa in nang thupha hing pie taheh, ka ta nu aw; tam a nukhia pen na citahna in a cil lai-a sangin hoizaw peh hi; nang in a hau hitale a zawng hitale tangvalte’ nua po na zui sih hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ka tanu aw, zau sinlen na nget zosie kang seppieh ding hi. Azieh pen ka khuo-a mi zosie in numei kizen na hi lam a thei uhi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in na sanggam kinaipi pen khat ka hi khu a man vangin kei sanga na kinaipizaw adang sanggam khat omlai hi.","ref":"Ruth 2:20"},"13":{"text":"Tuzanin tanah om tadi inlen, zingmawng ciengin na tungah tanau kinaipi pente’ mawpuoh ang sep leh hoi hi; ama semsah in. Ama in nang tungah tanau kinai pente’ mawpuoh ang sep nuom sih leh, Topa a hing ahi ma bangin keima in nang tungah tanau kinaipi pente’ mawpuoh teng kang sem ding hi. Zingmawng dongin tam sungah lum in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n zingmawng dongin a khawdop-ah tua nu lum a, ahi vangin mi mel kimucien thei masangin ama a tho hi; azieh pen Boaz in, “Ancilna phuol-a nang pei lam koima in kitheisah sin,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Na puon hing la inlen daw in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tua nu in daw a, ama in mangbuham law guh te-in a guonpieh hi; tua ciengin ama khuopi sungah a pei hi."},"16":{"text":"A innpinu kungah ama a tun ciengin na dong a, ”Ka tanu aw, bang nang ci ei?” a ci ciengin tua nu in zong ama’ tungah tuapa’ bawlna zosie gen a,"},"17":{"text":"“Tam mangbuham law guh ei guon hi, azieh pen ama in, ‘Na innpinu kungah na khutguohin pei sin,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Naomi in, “Ka tanu aw, thu bang hing ci pien ding ci na thei masangin ngah tadi in, azieh pen ama ang mawh op sih ding a, tuni-in vai zosie ang siengsah na ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kulpi tunkotah Boaz peito-in khumnah a to zaw lienin, a tanau a kinaipi pen, Boaz in a gen mipa a pei hi. Tuaci’n Boaz in, “Lawm aw, hing pei in; tanah hing to in,” a ci hi. Tuale ama pei-in a to hi.","title":"Boaz le Ruth Kinunna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Boaz in khuo upa sawm zawpi-in ama in, “Tanah to un,” a ci hi; tuaci’n amate a to uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a tanau kinaipi pen kungah, “Moab gam pana ang kilekia Noami in i sanggampa Elimelech’ leitang phalkhat a zua hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam thu nang kungah gen dingin ka ngaisun a, ‘Tam sunga a to mite’ mitmu le ka upate’ mitmu-in lei in,’ kang ci hi. Na tat ding le tan in; na tat sih ding leh a thu ka thei nadingin ei gen in; bangzieh ahei cile nang masangah a tan ding mi koima om lo hi. Nang zom kei ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in, “Keima’n tan vang,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Boaz in, “Naomi khut sung pan tua leitang na lei ni-a kipanin a sipa’ gamh pen a sipa’ min tawh a op suoh thei nadingin a sipa’ zi meigongnu Ruth zong a leitha na hi pai ta hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale a tanau kinaipi pen pa in, “Keima’ gouluo kisusie loin keima adingin tam ka tan thei sih ding hi. Ka tat theina khuon nang mama-in kilah tan, azieh pen ke’n ka tan thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Nidang lai-a Israel-te sungah tatna le kikhelna thu tawh kisai ngaina tam bang ahi hi: vaihawmna khat a kip ahi nadingin mi khat in a kedap suo-in adang khat tungah a pie hi; tam pen kipsahna bawldan ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n a tanau kinaipi pen pa in Boaz kungah, “Nangma dingin kilei in,” a ci ciengin ama in a kedap a sut hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:9"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Boaz in upate le mi zosie kungah, “Tuni-in Naomi tung panin Elimelech, Chilion le Mahlon’ neisa zosie ka lei zawhna thu teci na hi uhi."},"10":{"text":"A tanaute le a pienna khuo tunkot panin misi pa’ min a kisuhmang lo nadingin, ama’ gamhluona-ah misi pa’ min a kizop thei nadingin Mahlon’ zi meigong Moab mi Ruth zong ka zi dingin ka la zo ta hi; tuni-in no teng tecite na hi uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5-6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin tunkota om mi zosie le upate in, “Ko teci ka hi uhi. Topa in Israel minam a piengsah Rachel le Leah bangin na inn sunga ang lut numei nu hing bawl taheh. Ephrathah ah ta le nau nei inlen, Bethlehem ah na minthang taheh.","ref":"Pien 29:31"},"12":{"text":"Topa in tam numeino tungtawna ang pieh ding tate, Judah in Tamar tawh a nei Perez innkuon bang taheh,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Pien 38:27-30"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Boaz in Ruth la-in ama a zi a suoh hi. Ama gel a lupton ciengun Topa in ama gaisah a, tapa khat nei hi.","title":"David’ Khanggui (Mat 1:2-6)"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin nupite in Naomi kungah, “Tuni-in tanau kinaipi pen nei loin ang omsah lo Topa in thupha nga ta hinlen; tuale Israel-te sungah ama’ min thang taheh!"},"15":{"text":"Ama pen hinna ang piekia pa, le na vuoi cienga ang va pa hi ding hi; azieh pen na tapa sagi sangin a thupizaw, nang ang it na monu’ nei tapa ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Naomi in nausen la-in a kang sungah tawi a, nau cingnu a suoh hi."},"17":{"text":"A veng nupite in ama’ min a phuo pieh vua, “Naomi sung pan tapa khat suoh,” a ci uhi.
