Amate in a min Obed a phuo uhi; ama pen Jessi’ pa suoh a, Jessi pen David’ pa a suoh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng pen Perez’ suonlehlahte ahi hi: Perez pen Hezron’ pa,"},"19":{"text":"Hezron pen Ram’ pa, Ram pen Amminadab’ pa,"},"20":{"text":"Amminadab pen Nahshon’ pa, Nahshon pen Salmon’ pa,"},"21":{"text":"Salmon pen Boaz’ pa, Boaz pen Obed’ pa,"},"22":{"text":"Obed pen Jessi’ pa, Jessi pen David’ pa ahi hi."}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"1 Samuel","shortname":"1sam","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel masa laibu (the first book of samuel)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim muoltung gama Rama-thaim ah Ephraim mi Zuph’ tapa Tohu, a tapa Elihu, a tapa Jeroham, a tapa Elkanah a kici mi khat a om hi.","title":"Samuel Suona le a Ki-apna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in zi ni nei hi; khat’ min Hanah ahi a, a khat’ min Peninah ahi hi. Peninah in ta nei a, ahi vangin Hannah in nei lo hi."},"3":{"text":"A kumkumin ama’ khuo panin tam mipa Eli’ tapa nite Hophni le Phinehas in Topa’ siempu a sepna uh mun Shiloh ah Vanglien Topa bie ding le biehpiehna pie dingin kato zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni-in Elkanah in biehpiehna a lui ciengin a zi Peninnah le a tanute a tapate zosie tungah tanh a pie hi;"},"5":{"text":"ahi vangin ama in Hannah tungah tanh ni a pie hi, azieh pen Topa in a naubu khahpieh zongle ama in Hannah it veve hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a naubu a khahpieh ziehin alang nu in a lungthah thei nadingin ama nahpitahin a phin zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n kum sielin tuaci den uhi; Topa’ inn ah a kato sielun ama in tua nu a phin zel hi. Tua ahi ziehin Hannah kapin an ne lo hi."},"8":{"text":"A pasal Elkanah in, “Hannah, bang zieha kap na hiei? Bang dinga an na neh lo ahiei? Bang dinga lungkham na hiei? Nang adingin tapa sawm sangin manphazaw hi lo ka mah?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Shiloh ah a neh a dawn zaw ciengun Hannah ding dawhin Topa mai-ah ama le ama a kipulah hi. Tua laitahin Topa’ biehinn khuom pangah siempu Eli na to hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama nah lungkham mama a, Topa kungah thu ngenin nahpi tahin kap hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua nu in tami kiciemna a bawl hi: “Vanglien Topa aw, na nasemnu’ lunggimna ei enin nei phawh a, keima ei mangngil loin na nasemnu tungah nausen pata khat nei pieh leh, a si dongin na mai-ah nazir mi-in kang ap ding hi. Ama in zu hile khamtheite hile dawn lo ding a, a lu tungah mulmetna tukha lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 6:5"},"12":{"text":"Topa mai-ah ama thu ngenin a op laitahin, Eli in tua nu’ kam na en hi."},"13":{"text":"Hannah in dai dide-in thu ngen hi; a nephu beh pia-in a aw kiza lo hi; tua ahi ziehin Eli in zukhamin a ngaisun hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Eli in ama kungah, “Bang tanvei zukhamin mite’ nuisatin om ding na hei? Na zuneh khawl in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Hizongle Hannah in, “Hi lo hi, ka pu aw, mi lungkham le mi liengvai numei khat ka hi hi; lenggazu hile khamtheizu hile ka ciem vawt sih a, Topa mai-a ka lungsim teng a sunghla dawh ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lo numei danin ei ngaisun sin, azieh pen ka lung a gim seng le ka cimaw nah seng zieha a ham ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Eli in, “Lungmuongin pei in; Israel-te’ Pasien in ama tunga na ngetsa thu ang pie hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Na mitmu-in na nasemnu maipha ei musah in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin numei nu zong a opna munah pei-in a pasal tawh an ne tui dawnin a om a, a maisuo in da mai a puo nawn sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Zingmawngin amate thobai-in Topa mai-ah a bie uhi; tua ciengin Ramah-a a inn vuah amate a peikia uhi. Elkanah in a zi Hannah luppi a, Topa in ama a phawh hi."},"20":{"text":"A hun a cin ciengin Hannah gai-in tapa khat nei hi. Ama in a min Samuel a phuoh hi, bangzieh ahei cile tua nu in, “Ama Topa tunga ka nget ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Elkanah le a innkuonpite zosie Topa tungah kumsim biehpiehna le a thuciemna pie dingin a kato uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Hannah a peito sih hi; bang ding ahei cile ama in a pasal kungah, “Naungeh in nawi a tan behin Topa opna-ah kilaa-in tua munah a op suoh zing thei nadingin ka zawpi ding hi; tawntunga nazir-in ama ka ap ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama’ pasal Elkanah in ama kungah, “Hoi na sah pen bangin bawl inlen, a nawi tan dong ngah in; Topa in a kammal hing kipsah taheh,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n numei nu omin nawi a tansah masangsie a tapa a khoi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua nu in nawi a tansah zaw ciengin, kum thum a pha bawngtang khat, annel ephah khat, le lenggazu savun thawl khat tawh ama a zawpito hi. Tua nu in Shiloh-a Topa’ inn ah ama peipi hi; tua naupang khangdawng lai hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in bawngtang go-in Eli kungah naupang a peipi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Aw ka pupa! Nang a hingzing na hi ma bangin ka pupa aw, kei pen Topa tungah thungenin na opna tam sunga a ding numei ka hi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tam naupang adingin thu ka nget ziehin Topa in ama tunga ka thungetna ei pie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama pen Topa ka kawm zo hi. A hin laisie Topa tungah ama a kipie ahi ta hi,” a ci hi. Tua nu in khum munah Topa adingin ama a nuasie hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hannah in thu ngen a, “ Topa sungah lungdamin ka kipah hi; ka Pasien sungah ka hatna kitawisang hi. Ka guolzawna sungah ka kipah ziehin, ka kam in ka galte ka simmaw bawl hi.","title":"Hannah’ Thungetna (Luk 1:46-55)"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa banga a Siengtho koima om lo a, nang simlo koima dang a om sih hi; I Pasien tawh kibang Suongpi dang om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kiphatsahna kam ham nawn sinlen, na kam sung panin kilietsahna pusuohsah nawn sin; bang zieh ahei cile Topa khu a thei Pasien hi a, gamtatnate ama tawh a kitawikhai hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thahatte’ thaltang kikuoitan a, hinanle mi hatlote a thahat uhi."},"5":{"text":"A gilvate in a neh ding a thalaw vua, a gilkielte gilva zawsop uhi. Ta nei lo nu in ta sagi nei a, hinanle ta tam nei nu a lung a zuong hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in thatin hingsahkia hi; ama in Misikhuo ah peipi suhin a thotosah hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in zawngsahin hausah hi; ama in niemkhieh suhin ama in a domsang hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in leivui panin mizawngte phongto a; ama in ninphuol panin mi tasamte lamto hi. Uliente tawh amate totonsah a, amate a zatahhuoi tona a luosah hi. Azieh pen leitung khuompite Topa -a’ hi a, tuate tungah ama in leitung koi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ama in thuman mite’ kalsuonna encih a, ahi vangin migilote ahileh khuomiel lahah kisumang ding hi; azieh pen thagum hatna tawh mi guolzo lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa ! Ama a langpangte kivatmai ding hi; vantungah Sangpen Pa in vantosah ding hi. Leimongte dongin Topa in thu a khen ding hi; ama in a kumpipa tungah thahatna pie ding a, a sathau nupa’ vanglietna a tawisang ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 1:46-55"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ramah-a a inn ah Elkanah pei a, tua laitahin siempu Eli’ opna-ah naupang pa in Topa’ na a sem hi.","title":"Eli’ Tapa Gilote"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in Eli’ tapate pen mi ginalote ahi uhi; amate in Topa ahi a,"},"13":{"text":"mite tunga siempute’ nasep dingte ahi zongin a thusim sih uhi. Mi khatpo in biehpiehna a pieh ciengin, a sa a so laitahin a khutah siakeu kathum nei khat tawi-in siempu pa’ nasempa pei a,"},"14":{"text":"tuale ama in a siakeu tawh khangbel ahi a, niengbel ahi a, belpi ahi a, bel sung ahi zongin a sunsuh hi; siakeuka dawna a baang zosie siempupa in ama adingin a la hi. Shiloh-ah a pei Israel-te zosie tungah tam bangin a bawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua banah a thau a kihal masangin siempu pa’ nasem khat pei-in biehna pie mipa kungah, “Siempupa ading em ding satel ei pie in; azieh pen ama in nang tung pan sa minsa ang sang sih ding a, a siel vateh ang sang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale mipa in ama kungah, “A thau ei hal masasah inlen, tua ciengin na dei zaza kilah ta’n,” a ci leh ama in, “Hi lo e, tu mama-in ei pie’n; nei pieh sih leh kang paulahpieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam bangin Topa muna-ah tangvalte’ khielna a sie huoi mama hi; azieh pen amate in Topa’ biehnate a simmaw bawl uhi."},"18":{"text":"Samuel pen saihadiel siempu puon a sil, Topa mai-a nasem naupang khat ahi hi.","title":"Shiloh ah Naupang Samuel"},"19":{"text":"A nu in ama adingin puontuol neu khat a gatpieh let a, kumsiel biehna pie dingin a pasal tawh a peito ciengin ama kungah kum simin a puoh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Eli in Elkanah le a zi thupha pie a, “Ama in Topa tunga a pieh tami letsong tangin Topa in nang tam numei tawh ta nei dingin hing thuhkia taheh,” a ci hi; tua ciengin a inn vuah a pei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale Topa in Hannah phawh a, ama gai-in tapa thum le tanu ni a nei hi. Topa opna-ah naupang Samuel a khang hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in Eli a vuoi mama ta hi. Ama in Israel-te zosie tungah a tapate gamtatdan teng le a nasem numeite tawh kikhopna puonbuh kotbienga a luptonna thu zosie a za hi.","title":"Eli’ Innkuon Langkhatah Genkholna"},"23":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Bang dingin tua bang silte pi na bawl tahlawm uh ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie tung panin na gamtatsietnate uh ka za hi."},"24":{"text":"Hi lo hi, ka tapate aw, Topa’ mite in a genthang kawikawi uh ka thu zahte a hoi vawt sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi khat in midang khat tunga a khiel leh ama dingin Topa tungah mi khat in thumpieh thei hi; ahi vangin mi khat Topa tungah khiel leh koi in thumpieh thei ding ahei?” a ci hi. Ahi vangin a pate uh’ thu a mang sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate a kitha ding pen Topa’ deina ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in naupang Samuel a pumpi khanglien a, tuaci’n ama in Topa le mite’ maipha a nga toto hi.","ref":"Luk 2:52"},"27":{"text":"Eli kungah Pasien’ mi khat pei-in, “ Topa in, ‘Egypt gama Pharaoh’ khut nei-ah salin a op lai-un a pupi le a innkuonte kungah keima le keima ka kilah hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel minam zosie lah panin ka maitam-a gimnamtui hal ding, le ka mai-ah siempu puon silin ka siempu dingin ama ka teel hi; tuale keima in Israel mite tung pana mei tawh kihal keima ei kibiehna zosie na pupi innkuon tungah ka pie hi.","ref":"Pei 28:1-4; Siem 7:35-36"},"29":{"text":"Bang dingin keima ei kibiehnate le ka thupieh ahi keima ei kipie biehnate dugaw etin , ka mi Israel-te’ pieh a tuituoh pen teng tawh kivahthau-in, kei sangin na tapate patawizaw na hei?’ a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ziehin Israel-te’ Pasien Topa in a tangko hi: ‘Na innkuonpi le na pu na pate’ innkuonpite ka mai-ah a sungtum a pusuoh thei zing ding uhi,’ a ci hi; ahi vangin tu-in Topa in a tangko hi: ‘Tua bang hi thei nawn lo ding hi; bang ding ahei cile kei ei patawite ka patawi ding a, kei ei simmawte ka simmaw ding hi."},"31":{"text":"En in, na innkuon sungah tehsie khat beh a om lo nadingin na innsung le na pa inn sungah thahatna ka suhmaimang hun ang tung ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in Israel-te tunga ka pieh daupeinate na lungkham hunin dugawna mit tawh na en ding hi; na innkuon sungah tehsie om ngai nawn lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ka maitam pana ka hepkhiet lo ding note lahah khat, ama’ hlitui a luongsah ding le ama a lunggim sah dingin kihingkhawi ding hi; na innkuonpite zosie a unpi-in namsau tawh si ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Na tapa nite, Hophni le Phinehas tunga tung ding thu khu nang adingin ciemtena lim ahi ding a, ni khat thu-in a ni-in a si ding uhi.","ref":"1Sam 4:11"},"35":{"text":"Ka lungtang sung le ka lungsim sunga om banga sem dingin a citah siempu khat keima dingin ka khangsah ding hi. Innkuon buldetin ama ka siem ding a, ka sathau nupa’ mai-ah sungtumin pusuoh zing ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Na innkuon sunga a suohta laite in ngun peh khat hile, anlum lomkhat hile a ngen ding in a kungah pei-in, ‘An themkhat ka nei thei nadingin siempupa’ opna mun khat popo-ah ei koi in, ci-in kang thum hi, ci ding uhi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Eli’ khut nei-ah naupang Samuel in Topa’ na a sem hi. Tua hun lai-in Topa’ thu cieu mama hi; mangmuna zong om zep lo hi.","title":"Samuel Kihlatna le Kamsang Nasep"},"2":{"text":"Tua hunin a mit mang dinga a kipan zo Eli in khuo mu thei loin a lupna-ah lum hi;"},"3":{"text":"Pasien’ meivah mit nai lo a, Pasien’ singkuong opna Topa’ biehinn sungah Samuel lum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “ Samuel! Samuel!” ci-in hlan a, tuale ama in, “Tanah om ing!” ci-in"},"5":{"text":"Eli kungah tai a, tuale ama in, “Nei hlat ziehin tanah ka om hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in, “Kang hlan kha sih hi, ka tapa; lumkia ta’n,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama pei-in a lum hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Samuel!” ci-in hlankia hi. Samuel tho-in Eli kungah pei a, ama in, “Nei hlat ziehin tanah ka om hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in, “Kang hlan sih hi, ka ta aw; lumkia in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hun lai tahin Samuel in Topa thei nai lo a, Topa in ama hopi ngai nai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Samuel a thumveina hlankia hi. Tuale ama tho-in Eli kungah pei a, “Nei hlat ziehin kei tanah ka om hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Topa in naupangpa hlan hi, ci Eli in a thei ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Eli in Samuel kungah, “Pei inlen valum ta’n; ama in ang hlat leh, ‘ Topa aw, ei gen in, na nasempa in a ngai hi,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Samuel pei-in a opna ah a lum hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa pei-in tua tahah ding a, a masa lai-a bangin “Samuel! Samuel!” ci-in a hlan hi. Samuel in, “Gen in, na nasempa in a ngai hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Samuel kungah, “En in, Israel gamah bang khat ka bawl ding a, tua thu a za mi vannuoi ciza lia ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuami ni-in ama’ innkuon tungtang ka gensa zosie a patna pan a tawp tanpha-in Eli tungah ka tungsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A tapate in Pasien’ mindaisah a, a tate’ khielna thei napi ama in a khaam lo ziehin kumtawnin ama’ innsung gimna ka pieh ding thu ama kungah ka gen hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ziehin Eli innkuon’ khielna biehpiehna tawh ahi a, silpieh tawh ahi zongin khang tawntungin mai nawn lo ding hi, ci-in Eli’ innkuon tungah ka kiciem hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Zingmawng dong tua tahah Samuel lum hi; tua ciengin ama in Topa’ inn kotkhahte a hong hi. Samuel in Eli kungah a mangmuna a gen ngam sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Hizongle Eli in Samuel hlanin ama kungah, “Samuel, ka tapa aw,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Tanah om ing” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Eli in, “Ama in na kunga ang gen bang ahiei? Kei kungah ei im malmal sin. Na kunga ang gen zosie ka kungah ip nang nei leh Pasien in nang hing dop bawl sih taheh,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Samuel in bangma ip nei loin a unpi-in a gen sieng hi. Tua ciengin Eli in, “Ama Topa hizuh a; ama in hoi a sah bangin kibawl taheh,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel khanglien a, Topa in ama ompi-in a thugente khat zong tuolah kiesah lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel zosie in Samuel pen a muontah Topa’ kamsang khat a hina thu Israel-te zosie in Dan panin Beer-sheba dongin a thei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Shiloh ah Topa’ kilah peisuoh hi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ kammal tungtawnin Shiloh ah Samuel kungah Topa amama kilah hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale Israel mi zosie tungah Samuel’ kammal a tung hi. Khum hun lai-in Israel-te do dingin Philistia-te a kikhawm vua, Israel-te zong amate do dingin kuon uhi; amate in Ebenezar ah giephuol satin Philistia-te in Aphek ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"2":{"text":"Israel-te do dingin Philistia-te a kiguol dimdem vua, amate a kido uleh Philistia-te in Israel-te zo-in galphuol sungah mi tulli kim bang that uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Singkuong Kiman"},"3":{"text":"Giephuol sungah galkapte a pei ciengun Israel upate in, “Tuni-in Topa in Philistia-te mai-ah bang dinga gal ei lelsah adiei? Eite lahah ama hing pei-in i galte’ khut sung panin ei hutdam thei nadingin Shiloh panin tam tahah Topa’ thuciemna singkuong puo vai,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite in Shiloh ah mi sawlin khumtah panin Cherub-te tunga to Vanglien Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo uhi. Khum tahah Pasien’ thuciemna singkuong tawh Eli’ tapa tegel Hophni le Phinehas a omton uhi.","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"5":{"text":"Topa’ thuciemna singkuong giephuol sung a tun ciengin Israel zosie nahpi-in a awng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Philistia-te in kikona awging a zah ciengun amate in, “Hebrew-te’ giephuolah tam bang kikona awging vapuoh bang deina adiei?” a ci uhi. Giephuolah Topa’ singkuong tung zo ta hi ci thu a thei ciengun,"},"7":{"text":"“Giephuol sungah amau’ pasien-te tung zo hi,” a ci ziehun Philistia-te a zau uhi. Amate in, “Gim nga i hi ta uhi! Azieh pen nidangin tam bang pieng ngai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Gim nga i hi ta uhi! Koi in tami a thahat pasien-te’ khut sung panin ei hunkhie zo ding ahei? Tamte khu gimna a tuomtuomte tawh gamlahah Egypt-te a thatgam pasien-te ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Philistia-te aw, amate noma’ sila a suo ngai bangun Hebrew-te’ sila na suo lo nadingun hang unlen, kipasalsah un; kipasalsah unlen do un,” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Philistia-te in a do uhi; Israel-te in gal lelin a inn ciet vuah a unpi-un a tai sieng uhi. Mi tampitah kithat hi, azieh pen Israel keng gakap mi tul sawmthum a si hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien’ singkuong kiman hi; tuale Eli’ tapa tegel Hophni le Phinehas zong si hi."},"12":{"text":"Benjamin mi khat galphuol panin tai-in a puon ehkehsa le a lutunga leivui bangsa-in tuami ni ma-in Shiloh ah a tung hi.","title":"Eli’ Sina"},"13":{"text":"Ama a tun ciengin Eli in Pasien’ singkuong lunghimawpi ahi ziehin lampi gei-a ama’ tona tungah to-in na khuodahdah hi. Khuopi sungah tua mipa pei-in a thu teng a gen ciengin khuopi sunga mi zosie a awng pai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Eli in tua kikona a zah ciengin, “Tami gamlumna bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Tua ciengin tua mipa naw pei-in Eli kungah a gen hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Eli kum sawmkuo le kum giet pha a, a mit mangin khuo mu thei lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua mipa in Eli kungah, “Keima, galphuol pana ang pei ka hi hi; tuni-in galphuol panin kang tai hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ka tapa bang a ciei?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Kamtaipa in dawngin, “Philistia-te mai-ah Israel-te a taimang zo ta vua, galkapte lahah a kithat mi tampi om hi. Na tapa tegel Hophni le Phinehas si zo hi, Pasien’ singkuong zong galte in ei matpieh ta hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in Pasien’ singkuong a genkhah laitahin tunkot gei ama’ tona panin Eli thalpua-in a ngawng tawngin a si hi, azieh pen ama tehsie ahi ta a, a pumpi a gih hi. Ama in Israel-te kum sawmli sung thu a khen hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in a monu Phinehas’ zi gai-in a suoh kuon ahi hi. Ama in Pasien’ singkuong a kimatna, le a innpipa le a pasal sina thu a zah ciengin kunin nau a suoh hi; azieh pen ama takeih natna in tun hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama a si dihtah bepin ama a kem naudom numeite in, “Zau sin, azieh pen tapa khat na nei hi,” a ci uhi. Hizongle ama in dawnglo-in zong thudon lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in, “Minthanna in Israel taisan zo hi,” a cinopna-in nausen’ min Ichabod phuoh hi, azieh pen Pasien’ singkuong a kimat zo zieh le a innpipa le a pasal zieh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Pasien’ singkuong kiman zo ahi ziehin minthanna in Israel taisan zo hi,” a ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistia-te in Pasien’ singkuong a mat zaw ciengun, Ebenezar panin Ashdod ah a tut uhi;","title":"Philistia-te le Singkuong"},"2":{"text":"tua zaw ciengin Philistia-te in Dagon inn sungah Pasien’ singkuong puo-in Dagon gei-ah a koi uhi."},"3":{"text":"A zing ciengin Ashdod-te a thobai vua, tuale Topa’ singkuong mai lei lahah mai kunin Dagon na pua hi. Tuaci’n amate in Dagon a la vua, a opna ngai-ah a koikia uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle a zing cieng zingmawngin a thobai vua, Topa’ singkuong mai lei lahah mai kunin Dagon na pua leuleu a, Dagon lutang le a khut tegel kisattanin sangkil tungah na om hi; Dagon pen a pumpi beh na omlai hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua thu ziehin Dagon siempute le Ashdod-a Dagon inn-a lutte in tuni dongin Dagon sangkil tung a sia sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ashdod-te tungah Topa’ khut gih a, ama in uilut tawh Ashdod-te sung le a gam sung gawtin a zausah hi."},"7":{"text":"Ashdod-te in sil omdan teng a mu bepun, “Eite tawh Israel-te Pasien’ singkuong om thei poma lo ding hi; azieh pen ama in eite le i Pasien Dagon ei genthei bawl hi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi sawlin Philistia ulien zosie a khawmtuo vua, “Israel-te Pasien’ singkuong bang i law diei?” a ci uhi. Gath-a tengte in a dawng vua, “Ko kungah Pasien’ singkuong koisah vai,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Gath ah Israel-te Pasien’ singkuong a tuo uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanle amate in Gath ah a tut zaw ciengun Topa in tua khuopi langpanin zauna tampi piengsah hi; ama in a khuopi mite a teh a khangin gimsahin uilut a veisah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ekron ah Israel-te’ Pasien’ singkuong a puoh uhi. Hinanle Ekron ah Pasien’ singkuong a tun ciengin Ekron khuo mite a kiko vua, “Bang dingin eite le i mite that dingin Israel Pasien’ singkuong i kung vua ang tut uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate in mi sawlin Philistia uliente zosie a khawm vua, “Ko le ka mite a tha lo nadingin Israel-te Pasien’ singkuong puodawh ta unlen, a opna ngai-ah peisahkia ta un,” a ci uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile a khuopi sung mun zosie-ah sina cing patauna a om hi. Pasien in khum munah amate a genthei bawl mama hi;"},"12":{"text":"a silo sunteng zong uilut a vei vua, tuaci’n khuopi sungah kaa le mau vantung dongah a kato hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistia-te gam sungah Topa’ singkuong hla sagi sung a om hi.","title":"Israel ah Singkuong Kilekia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Philistia-te in siempute le aisante hlanin, “ Topa’ singkuong bang i law diei? Ama opna munah bang tawh peisah ding i hei ei gen un,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in, “Israel-te’ singkuong na sawldawh ding uleh a guohin sawl sih un, bangbang hile khielna zieha biehna pie un. Tua ciengin na dam ding vua, bang zieha note kung pana a khut a khin nai lo lam na thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in, “Khielna zieha ama tunga i pieh ding biehna khu bang ahiei?” a ci uhi. Amate in a dawng vua, “Philistia uliente phaza tawh kituohin kham uilut nga le kham simbeng nga hi ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile no tung le na uliente uh tungah a kibang gimna ang tung hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n na gam sung uh ang susie na uilut limte ule na simbeng limte uh bawlin, Israel-te’ Pasien tungah minthanna na pie ding uhi; ama in note le na pasien-te ule na gam tung vuah a khut ang zangsah thei kha ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt-te le Pharaoh in a lungsim uh a khausah bangin bang dingin na lungsim uh khausah ding na hi uh ahei? Ama in amate a ki-apmaipi zaw ciengin, amate in peisah a, tuaci’n amate peikhie uh hi lo amah?"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin tu-in leeng tha khat le kol kivaw nai lo bawngpi no nei ni a baisa-in koi unlen, leengah tua bawngte vaw un. Ahi vangin a kung panun a note kai unlen inn ah peipi un."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ singkuong la-in leeng tungah koi unlen, khielna zieha biehna na pieh uh kham limte a singkuong khat sungah guongin a gei-ah koi un. Tua ciengin sawldawh unlen, a peina dingah peisah un."},"9":{"text":"Tuale en khinkhien un; bawngte in a gam zuonin Beth-shemesh lamah a peito leh, sietna golpi a tungsah pa ama hi ding hi; ahi vangin a peito sih leh ei gawtpa ama ahi sih hi; eite tunga a pieng mawhmawh hi, ci-in i thei ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mite in tua bang ma-in a bawl uhi; a no nei bawngpi ni kai-in bawng leengah a vaw vua, inn ah a note a khum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ singkuong pen kham simbeng le a uilut limte uh opna singkuong tawh leeng tungah a koiton uhi."},"12":{"text":"Lamlien dung zui-in Beth-shemesh lam muhin bawngte tangtahin a pei vua, a pei kawmun a hamham uhi; zietlam hile veilam hile a kihei sih vua, tuale Philistia uliente in Bethshemesh ’ gamgi dongin a nua a zui uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in Beth-shemesh mite in kuom sungah mangbu a at laitah uh ahi hi. Amate khuodahin singkuong a mu ciengun a en dingin kipahtahin a pei uhi."},"14":{"text":"Beth-shemesh mi Joshua lo-ah a leeng tung a, khum tahah a khawl hi. Khum tahah suongtum golpi khat a om hi; tuacin a leeng singte phelkehin Topa tungah meihal biehna-in a bawngpite a pie uhi."},"15":{"text":"Levi-te in Topa’ singkuong le a panga kham milim opna singkuong la-in suongtumpi tungah a koi uhi. Tua ciengin Beth-shemesh mite in Topa tungah meihal biehnate le biehpiehnate a pie uhi."},"16":{"text":"Philistia ulien ngate in tua teng a mu bepun khum ni ma-in Ekron-ah a kilekia uhi."},"17":{"text":"Philistia-te in khielna zieha biehna dinga Topa tunga a pieh uh kham uilutte: Ashdod ading khat, Gaza ading khat, Ashkelon ading khat, Gath ading khat, Ekron ading khat;"},"18":{"text":"Ulien ngate’ uh Philistia-te khuopi kulpi nei le khuoneu kul nei lote adingin a khuo phaza utawh kizui-in kham simbengte tawh zong ahi hi. Amate in Topa’ singkuong a koina gei vua suongtumpi pen Beth-shemesh mi Joshua’ lo-ah tuni dongin teci ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa’ singkuong a muoh ciengun Jeconiah’ suonlehlahte, Beth-shemesh mite tawh a lungdam ton sih uhi; tuale ama in amate sawm sagi that hi. Topa in mite lahah mi tampitah a tha tah ziehin mite da-in a kap uhi.","title":"Kiriath-jearim-a Singkuong"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Beth-shemesh mite in, “Tam a siengtho Pasien, Topa mai-ah koi om zo ding ahei? I kung panun hemdawhin koi kungah i peisah diei?” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kiriath-earim a tengte kungah patong sawlin, “Philistia-te in singkuong ei puohkia zo ta uhi. Hing peisuh unlen na kung vuah puoto un,” a ci uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale Kiriath-jearim mite pei-in Topa’ singkuong a puoto vua, muol tunga Abinadab’ inn sungah a tut uhi. Amate in Topa’ singkuong kem dingin a tapa Eleazar a siensuo uhi.","ref":"2Sam 6:2-4; 1Khg 13:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim ah singkuong a om ni-a kipanin hun saupi sung, kum sawmni kim bang, Israel innkuon zosie in Topa ngai-in a thum vangut uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in Israel innkuon zosie kungah, “Na lungsim zosie utawh Topa lamah a kiheikia na hi uleh, gamdang pasien-te le note lah panin Astartes-te paimang un. Na lungtang uh Topa lam ngatin ama’ na beh sem un, tua hile ama in Philistia-te’ khut sung panin ang hunkhie ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Samuel in Thukhen Sem"},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel mite in Baal-te le Astartes-te a paimang vua, Topa’ na beh a sem uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in, “Mizpah-ah Israel zosie a unpi-in khawm unlen, note dingin Topa tungah thu ka ngen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Mizpah ah a kikhawm vua, tui sawhin Topa mai-ah a sung uhi. Khum ni-in an a tang vua tuami munah, “ Topa mai-ah i khiel ta uhi,” a ci uhi. Tuale Samuel in Mizpah ah Israel mite thu a khen hi."},"7":{"text":"Mizpah ah Israel mite kikhawm zo hi, ci thu Philistia-te in a zah ciengun Israel do dingin Philistia uliente a kuonto uhi. Israel mite in tua thu a zah ciengun amate in Philistia-te a giing uhi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mite in Samuel kungah, “ Topa i Pasien in Philistia-te’ khut sung panin ei hunkhiet thei nadingin ama tungah thunget khawl vawt sin,” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Samuel in nawi ne lai tuuno khat la-in Topa tungah meihal biehna-in a buppi-in a pie hi; Topa tungah Israel adingin Samuel kiko a, tuale Topa in ama a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Samuel in meihal biehna a pieh laitahin Philistia-te in Israel do dingin a nai uhi; ahi vangin tua ni-in vanto tawh a kibang awging tawh Topa in Philistia-te do-in a amkhamsah gawp hi; tuale Israel mai-ah amate kinotmang hi."},"11":{"text":"Mizpah panin Israel mite peikhie-in Philistia-te a nuadel vua, Beth-car galkhat cieng dongin a vatmai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in suong khat la-in Mizpah le Jeshanah kikalah phut a, a min Ebenezer phuoh hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama in, “ Topa in tu cieng dong ei panpi hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Philistia-te kizo a, Israel gam sungah a lutkia nawn sih uhi; Samuel hun sung zosie Topa’ khut in Philistia-te a langpang hi."},"14":{"text":"Philistia-te in Israel tung pana a lahsa uh khuopite, Ekron pan Gadth dong kikal sung teng, Israel tungah kipiekia hi; tuale Philistia-te’ khut sung panin Israel in a gam uh a ngakia hi. Israel le Amor-te kikalah zong kilemna a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Samuel in a hin sung tungtawnin Israel tungah thu a khen hi."},"16":{"text":"A kumkumin Bethel, Gilgal, le Mizpah ah zin kawikawi hi; tuale ama in tam munte zosie-ah Israel mite thu a khen hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum munah a inn a op ziehin Ramah ah a pei zel hi; ama in khum muna Israel tungah zong a dihin thu khen a, Topa adingin maitam khat zong khum munah a lam hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel a vuoi bepin ama in Israel tungah a tapate thukhenin koi hi.","title":"Israel in Kumpi Khat Ngen"},"2":{"text":"A tapa tapen Joel ahi a, a nina pen Abijah ahi hi; ama gel pen Beer-sheba a thukhente ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle a tapate in ama’ tawn dante zui loin, sum lamah a kihei vua, guhgol la-in, thutang a lehei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel upa zosie kikhawmin Ramah-a Samuel kungah a pei vua,"},"5":{"text":"tuale ama kungah, “Nang na vuoikawn ta a, na tapate in lah na tawndante a zui sih uhi; tua ciengin mi namdangte ma bangin kote ei uh ding kumpi khat ei guon in,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Thkna 17:14"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in, “Kote ei uh ding kumpi khat ei pie in,” a ci ciengun tam thu in Samuel lungkimsah lo hi. Samuel in Topa kungah thu ngen a,"},"7":{"text":"Topa in Samuel kungah, “Mite in na kunga ang gen uh thu zosie mang in; azieh pen nang ang nuol ahi sih a, amate tunga kumpi sem dingin kei ei nuol uh ahi zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt pan amate ka peipi ni-a kipan tuni dongin kei ei nuasie-in pasien dangte’ na a sem vua, kei tunga ei bawl bangun nang tunga zong ang bawl uh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin tu-in a thugen uh ngai in; amate lipkhaptahin na hilkhol beh ding hi. Amate tunga a uh ding kumpipa’ sepzie ding teng lah in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Samuel in ama kunga kumpi a ngen mite kungah Topa’ thugen zosie a gen hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Note tunga ang uh ding kumpipa’ gamtatzie ding teng tam bang ahi hi: Ama in na tapate uh la-in leengte-ah nasemin a sakol nasem ding, a leengte mai-ah a tai dingin se ding hi;"},"12":{"text":"tuale ama adingin a tulkhat uhte, le a sawmnga uhte, pawl khatte a lo kai-in a an at ding, le a gal vanzah le a leeng vanzahte bawl dingin se ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in panamtui bawl ding, an huon ding, le moh em dingin na tanute uh a la ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in na lo te uh, na lengga lote uh, na olive lote uh lah panin a hoipen teng la-in a nasemte a pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in na an le na lenggate uh’ sesawm-suo-sekhat la-in a uliente le a nasemte a pie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in na nasem pasalte, na nasem numeite, na bawnghonte, na laate lah panun a hoi pente la-in ama’ na sem dingin koi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in na tuuhonte uh sawm-a- khat la ding a, ama’ sila na hi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khum ni-in noma dinga na teelsa uh na kumpipa uh ziehin na kap ding uhi; hizongle khum ni ciengin Topa in ang dawng sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin mite in Samuel’ thugen a mang sih uhi; amate in, “Hi lo e! Ka tung vua ei uh ding kumpi khat nei ding pen ka khensatsa uh ahi bo hi,","title":"Israel’ Kumpi Nget Kipie"},"20":{"text":"tuaci’n kote zong minam dangte ma bangin ka kumpipa un ka tung vuah thu ang vaihawm ding a, ka mai vuah hing pei-in ka galte uh ei do pieh ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mite’ thugen zosie Samuel in a zah zaw ciengin ama in Topa’ bilkawm-ah tua teng a gensawnkia hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Samuel kungah, “A thugen uh mang inlen amate tungah kumpi khat koi in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Samuel in Israel mite kungah, “Mi zosie na inn ciet vuah pei ta un,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin-te sung panin Aphiah’ tapa Bekorath, a tapa Zeror, a tapa Abiel, a tapa Kish a kici Benjamin-te mihau khat a om hi.","title":"Saul Kumpi-in Kiteel"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Saul kici tapa khat nei a, tangval meihoi khat ahi hi. Israel mite lahah ama sanga a melhoizaw koima om lo hi; midang zosie ama’ liengko cieng beh a pha uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Saul’ pa Kish’ laate a mang hi. Tuaci’n Kish in a tapa Saul kungah, “Naupang khat zawpi inlen, laate va sui ta un,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ephraim muoltung gam teng le Shalishah gam teng zawtin a sui vua, ahi vangin a mu sih uhi. Shaalim gam teng a nawh vangun khum gamah a om sih hi. Tua ciengin Benjamin gam teng a nawh vangun zong a mu tuom sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Zuph gamah a tun ciengun Saul in a zawpi naupangpa kungah, “Kia ta vai. Tua hi sihle ka pa in laate lunghimaw nawn loin ei gel ei lunghimawpi ta zaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Hizongle ama in, “Tami khuo sungah Pasien’ mi khat om a, ama pen a kizatah mi khat ahi hi; a gen popo a manin tung hi. Tu-in khumnah va pei ta vai; ama in i khuolzinna thu ei genthei kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in naupangpa kungah, “Ahi mawh vangin pei leih tua mipa bang i tut diei? Azieh pen i ip sunga i mohte lah tawp zo ta a, Pasien’ mipa kunga i tawi ding letsong a om sih hi. Ei gel in bang i nei ei?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Naupangpa in Saul dawngkia-in, “Tamnah ngun shekel seli-suo-sekhat ka nei hi. I lampi ang gen nadingin ama ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"(Nidang lai-in Israel sungah mi khat in Pasien kungah thu dong dingin a pei ciengin, “Hing pei in, thumu pa kungah va pei ta vai,” ci hi; azieh pen tulai taha kamsang i cite pen nidang lai-in thumu pa kici hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Saul in naupangpa kungah, “Hoi hi; hing pei inlen va pei ta vai,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Pasien’ mipa opna khuopi-ah a pei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khuopi lam zuonin muol tungah a peito laitahun tui tawi dinga a kuon ngahnu pawlkhat tawh a kituoh vua, amate kungah, “Thumu pa tanah a om ei mah?” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in, “Om ma, na mai diem vua pei ahi hi. Kinaw un; khuopi sungah tu mama-in ama pei zo hi, azieh pen tuni-in biehbuhno-ah mite in kithoina a nei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khuopi sung na lut behun biehbuhno-ah an ne dinga a peito masangin ama na mu ding uhi. Biehpiehna thupha pie ding ahi ziehin ama pei masangin mite in an a ne sih ding uhi. Tua zaw ciengin a kihlante in ne thei pan beh uhi. Tu-in peito un, bang ding ahei cile ama na tuoh pailien ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate khuopi-ah a peito uhi. Khuopi sungah amate a lut laitahun biehbuhno lam zuona ang peito Samuel a mu uhi."},"15":{"text":"Saul a pei masang a zani-in Topa in Samuel kungah thu na gen zo ta hi:"},"16":{"text":"“Zing cieng tu bang hunin na kungah Benjamin gam panin mi khat kang sawl ding a, ka mi Israel tunga a uh dingin ama sathau na nu ding hi. Ama in Philistia-te’ khut sung panin ka mite a hunkhie ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile a kikona uh ka kungah hing tung zo ahi ziehin ka mite’ thuohna ka mu zo hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Samuel in Saul a mu ciengin, Topa in ama kungah, “Na kunga kang gen mipa tanah a om hi. Ka mite’ tunga a uh ding pa khu ama ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in tunkot sung lamah Samuel nai-in ama in, “Kang thum hi, thumu pa’ inn hei sung ahiei?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel in Saul dawngin, “Keima, thumu pa ka hi hi; ka masanga biehbuhno-ah peito in, azieh pen tuni-in kei tawh an na ne ding a, zingmawng ciengin nang hing peisahin, na lungsima om zosie kang gen ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A tawpsa ni thum lai-a a mang na laate uh ahile kimu zo ta ahi ziehin ngaisutin nei nawn vet sin. Nang tung le na pupa innkuon sung zosie tungah Israel mi zosiete’ lungtup a op sih leh koi pen tungah om tava na ci ahei?” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Kei pen Israel minamte sung pan a citawm pen Benjamin-te ka hi a, keima’ innkuon zong Benjamin minam sunga innkuon zosiete sung pan a ginalo pen ka hi bo uhi. Tua ahile bang dinga tam banga nei hopi ahei?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in Saul le a nasem naupangpa hlanin innkhan sungah zawpi a, mi sawmthum bang a pha a kihlan mite lahah tona thupi pen-ah ama a tosah hi."},"23":{"text":"Samuel in anhuon pa kungah, “Na tuom koi in ci-a kang pieh tanh pen hing la vawi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Anhuon pa in samal le tua tawh a om teng la-in Saul mai-ah a lui hi. Samuel in, “En in, nang adinga kang tuomhenpieh teng na mai-ah kilui hi. Ne in; bang ding ahei cile a kise hun ciengin lenglate tawh na neh thei dinga na mai-a kikoi ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n khumi ni-in Samuel in Saul tawh an a ne ton hi."},"25":{"text":"Biehbuhno panin khuopi sungah amate a peisuh ciengun innkhum zangah Saul adingin lupna khat na kipha a, ama a kimu dingin a lum hi."},"26":{"text":"Zingmawng khuo va zaw ciengin Samuel in innkhum zanga Saul hlanin, “Na pei nading munah kang sawl thei nadingin tho in,” a ci hi. Saul zong tho-in khuopi gawlzin lamah ama le Samuel a pei uhi."},"27":{"text":"Khuopi gei lamah a peisuh laitahun Samuel in Saul kungah, “Tua naupangpa i mai-ah a peisuoh nadingin gen inlen, ama a peisuoh zaw ciengin nangma tungah Pasien’ kammal kang theisah thei nadingin tanah bakhat sung khawl phot in,” a ci hi.","title":"Samuel in Saul Sathau Nu"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel in sathau thawl khat la a, a lu tungah buohin ama nam hi; ama in, “ Topa in ama’ mi Israel-te tunga uhpa dingin nang sathau ang nu zo hi. Topa’ mite tungah uhpa na hi ding a, a kimvel vua om a galte uh khut sung panin amate na hunkhie ding hi. Tu-in Topa in ama’ gouluote tungah uhpa dinga sathau ang nu zo a hina lim tam bang hi ding hi:"},"2":{"text":"Tuni-in kei kung panin na pei ciengin Benjamin-te gam Rachel’ han gei-a Zelzah ah mi ni tawh na kituoh ding hi; ama gel in na kungah, ‘Na sui sui uh laate kimu zo a, tu-in ahile na pa in tuate lunghimawpi nawn loin nang ang lunghimawpi zaw ta a, “Ka tapa bang ka law ta diei?” a ci hi,’ ang ci ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum mun panin na pei lai ding a, Tabor-a gangpi lahah na tung ding hi; tua munnah Bethel-a Pasien kung a peito, kelno thum a kai mi khat, anlum thum a puo adang khat, le savun tuithawl dimtah lengga tui a puo mi khat, mi thum in nang ang dawn ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in nang hing muohin anlum ni ang pie ding vua, tua khu amate tung pana na san ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Philistia khuocingte opna mun Gibeath-elohim na tung ding hi; tua khuopi sung na tun ciengin a mai vuah harp, tawm, theile, le lyre lasahna tawh lamin awngin biehbuhno pana ang kumsuh kamsang honkhat tawh na kituoh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ hlagau in nang hing manin amate tawh lamin awngin kam na sang ding a, mi tuomdang khatin na kikhel ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in tam limte na tuo khah ciengin sep dinga hoi na sah popo sem in. Azieh pen Pasien in nang ang ompi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale ka masanga Gigal ah na peisuh ding hi; tua ciengin meihal biehna le thunuom biehna pie dingin na kungah kang peisuh ding hi. Na kungah hing pei-in na bawl ding teng kang lah masang, ni sagi sung nei na ngah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Samuel nuasie dingin a kinua hei leh Pasien in ama tungah lungtang dang khat a pie hi; khum ni-in tam lim teng zosie a unpi-in a tangtung hi.","title":"Saul in Kamsang"},"10":{"text":"Khum mun panin Gibeah lam a pei laitahun kamsang honkhat in ama a na lamdot uhi. Tuale Pasien’ hlagau in ama man a, amate tawh lamin awngin kam a sang hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama a thei ngai mi zosie in kamsangte tawh a kamsante a mu ciengun, khatlekhat a kiho vua, “Kish’ tapa tungah bang tung adiei? Saul zong kamsangte khat ahi ta amah?” a kici uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khum muna om pasal khat in dawng a, “A pa uh koi ahi diei?” a ci hi. Tua ziehin, “Saul zong kamsangte khat ahi ta amah?” ci paunah khat a pieng hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama lamin awngin kam a san zaw ciengin inn ah a pei hi."},"14":{"text":"Saul’ pano in ama le naupangpa kungah, “Hei sunga va pei na hi vuoi?” a ci hi. Ama in dawngin, “Laate sui ka hi uhi; kimu zo nawn sih va ci-a ka thei bepun Samuel kungah ka va hawta uhi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Saul’ pano in, “Samuel in na kunga ang gen teng kei kungah ei gen in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Saul in a pano kungah, “Ama in ka kung vuah laate kimu ta hi, ci-in ei gen hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Samuel’ gen a kumpi suo nading thu ama tungah bangma gen lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Samuel in Mizpah-a Topa kungah mite khawm a,","title":"Saul Kumpi-in Kiphuongzah"},"18":{"text":"a kung vuah, “Israel-te’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Egypt panin Israel-te ka peipi a, Egypt-te’ khut sung le note ang bawlsie kumpi gamte zosie’ khut sung panin kang hunkhie hi,’ a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle na gentheina ule na cimawnate pan vua note ang hunkhie na Pasien uh tuni-in nuolin, ‘Hi sih! ko tungah kumpi khat koi in,’ na ci uhi. Tua ahi ziehin tu-in na minam zui ule na be uh zui-in Topa mai-ah kilah un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in Israel minam zosie a nai-ah a zawpi a, aisanna tawh Benjamin minam kila hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Benjamin minamte a innkuon kuonin peipi a, aisanna tawh Matri innkuon kila hi. A tawpna-ah Matri innkuon a mi malin peipi a, aisanna tawh Kish’ tapa Saul kila hi. Hinanle ama a sui ciengun ama kimu zo lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in, “Tua mipa tam sungah ang pei amah?” ci-in Topa a dongkia uhi. Tuale Topa in, “En un, ama vanlom lahah kiphuol hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate tai-in khum panin ama a zawpi uhi. Ama’ mite lahah a din ciengin adangte zosie a liengko cieng beh a pha uhi."},"24":{"text":"Samuel in mi zosie kungah, “ Topa in a teelsa mipa na mu vuoi mah? Mite zosie lahah ama tawh kibang koima om lo hi,” a ci hi. Tuale mi zosie in, “Kumpipa khansau taheh!” ci-in a awng uhi."},"25":{"text":"Samuel in kumpipa’ thuneina le a nasep dingte mite kungah gen hi; tuale amate in zong laibu khatah gielin, Topa mai-ah a koi uhi. Tua ciengin Samuel in a inn ciet vuah mite a peisah hi."},"26":{"text":"Gibeah-a a inn ah Saul pei a, Pasien in a lungsim a khoikhah mi thahatte zong ama tawh zawhton uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hizongle kimanna a nei lo mi pawlkhat in, “Tam pa in ei bangci hut zo ding ahei?” a ci uhi. Amate in ama a simmaw vua, ama kungah letsong a tawi sih uhi. Hinanle ama a sip dide hi. Tu-in ahile Ammon-te’ kumpipa Nahash in Gad-te le Reuben-te nasie tahin a bawlsie hi. Ama in a zietlam mit ciet uh kheipieh a, Israel hun ding mi pie lo hi. Ammon-te’ kumpipa Nahash in Israel-te a zietlam mit a kheipieh lo Jordan kuom tengah koima a om sih hi. Ahi vangin Ammon-te’ kung panin pasal tul sagi a suohta vua, Jabesh-gilead ah a lut uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hla khat bang zaw ciengin Ammon mi Nahash peito-in Jabesh-gilead a imtawm hi; tuale Jabesh mi zosie in Nahash kungah, “Ko tawh thukimna hing bawl in. Na na kang sem ding uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Saul in Ammon-te Zo"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ammon mi Nahash in amate kungah, “Tam thu hangin no tawh thukimna ka bawl ding hi. Keima in mi zosie’ mit zietlam kheipieh dawhin Israel zosie tungah simmawna ka omsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jabesh upate in ama kungah, “Israel gam sung zosie-ah kamtai ka sawl thei nadingun khuo ngai hun ni sagi sung ei pie’n. Tua ciengin ko ei hun ding mi khat zong a op sih leh na khut sungah kang kipie ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Saul’ khuo Gibeah ah kamtaite a tun ciengun amate in mite zahin thu a gen uhi; tuale mi zosie nahpitahin a kap uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in bawngtangte nua zui-in lo panin Saul a pei hi; tuale Saul in, “Bang thu om a mite hici kaa ahi vuoi?” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Jabesh mite’ thute ama kungah a gen uhi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in tam thu teng a zah ciengin ama tungah Pasien’ hlagau khautahin tungin nahpitahin a sin a so hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in bawng lengkai kap khat la-in tuate go-in semnen a, kamtaite sawlin Israel gam mun zosie-ah hlah a, “Saul le Samuel nua zui-a kuon lo poma a bawngte tunga a kibawl bangin kibawl ding hi!” ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciengin mite tungah Topa giinna tung a, mihing khat bangin kithutuohin a kuonkhie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Bezek ah mite a kaikhop ciengin Israel-te tul zathum pha a, Judah panin tul sawmsagi pha hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in kamtai-a peite kungah, “Jabesh-gilead a tengte kungah gen un: ‘Zing sun ciengin hutkhietna na nga ding uhi,’ ci-un,” a ci hi. Kamtaite tungin Jabesh-a tengte kungah a gen ciengun amate a lungdam mama uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jabesh-a tengte in Nahash kungah, “Zing ciengin na kungah kang kipie ding vua, hoi na sah bangin ka tung vuah nei bawl ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"A zing ciengin Saul in mite pawl thumin a khen hi. Giephuol sungah zingmawng tungin a pei vua, sun nisat dongin Ammon-te a satlia uhi; tuale mi ni nangawn omton thei lo ding za dongin a suohta sunte a kithezah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mite in Samuel kungah, ‘Saul in eite ei uh ding amah?’ a ci pen khu, “Koi na hi vuoi? Amate i tha thei nadingin ka kung vuah ei pie’n,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Saul in, “Tuni-in mi khat zong kithat lo ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tuni-in Topa in Israel tungah hutkhietna ei puoh hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Samuel in mite kungah, “Hing pei un, Gilgal ah peito vai-in khum munah kumpi dingin Saul kipsah phakia vai,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gilgal ah mi zosie a pei vua, amate in tua mun Topa mai Gilgal ah kumpi-in Saul a koi uhi. Khum tahah amate in Topa mai-ah thunuom biehna a pie vua, khum tahah Saul le Israel-te zosie nahpitahin a kipah uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel in Israel-te zosie kungah, “Ka kunga na thugen zosie uh ka ngai zo ta a, na tung vuah kumpi khat ka koi ta hi.","title":"Samuel’ Vaihlah Thugenna"},"2":{"text":"En un, tu-in na makaipa uh kumpi ahi hi; kei vuoi-in ka sam kang zo a, hizongle ka tapate note tawh a om uhi. Ka neu lai-a kipan tuni tanpha-in note kang makai zo ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tanah kei ka om hi; Topa mai le a sathau nu pa mai-ah ka mawna hing pulah un. Koi bawngtang ka lahpieh ahei? Ahi sihle koi laa ka lahpieh ahei? Ahi sihle koi ahei ka sol? Koi ahei ka bawlsiet? Ahi sihle ka mit tawt nadingin koi khut sung panin guhgol la ka hei? Ka langkhatah teci hing pang unlen, tua teng kang dinkia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in a kungah, “Nang in kote nei sol sih a, zong nei bawlsie sih a, mi khat popo kung panin zong guhgol na la sih hi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Ka khut sungah bangma na mu lona uh na langkhat vuah Topa teci ahi a, ama’ sathau nu pa zong tuni-in teci ahi hi,” a ci hi. Amate in, “Ama teci ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Samuel in mite kungah, “Moses le Aaron a na se, Egypt gam pan na pu na pate uh a na peipi Topa khu teci ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 6:26"},"7":{"text":"Tua ziehin tu-in note le na pu na pate adingin Topa’ hutdamna nasep zosie Topa mai note tungah hing pulahin kang mawsah thei nadingin na ding lai tadi un."},"8":{"text":"Egypt gamah Jacob a pei ciengin Egypt-te in na bawlsie-in, tua ciengin Topa tungah na pu na pate a na kiko vua, ama in Egypt panin na pu na pate peipi-in tam munah amate a tengsah ahi Moses le Aaron, Topa in a sawl hi.","ref":"Pei 2:23"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Topa a Pasien uh a mangngil uhi; tuale ama in Hazor kumpipa Jabin’ galkapmangpa Sisera’ tung, Philistia-te, tung le Moab kumpipa tungah amate zua a, tam mite in amate a sim uhi.","ref":"Thkn 3:12; 4:2; 13:1"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa kungah amate kiko-in, ‘Kohaw ka khiel ta uhi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa ka taisan ta vua, Baal-te le Ashtaroth-te’ na ka sem ta uhi; ahi vangin tu-in ka galte’ khut sung panin ei hunkhie in, na na ka sem ding uhi,’ a ci uhi.","ref":"Thkn 10:10-15"},"11":{"text":"Topa in Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah le Samson sawlin na kim na pam zosie vua na galte uh’ khut sung panin note ang hunkhie hi; tuale lungmuongin na teng uhi.","ref":"1Sam 3:20; Thkn 4:6; 7:1; 11:29"},"12":{"text":"Hizongle note sim dingin Ammon kumpipa Nahash ang kuon na mu ciengun, Topa na Pasien uh pen na kumpi uh hi napi note in kei kungah, ‘Hi sih, kumpi khat ma in ei uh ding hi bo,’ na ci uhi.","ref":"1Sam 8:19"},"13":{"text":"En un, noma’ teelsa, noma’ ngetsa kumpipa tanah a om hi; en un, Topa in na tung vuah kumpi khat koi zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa zatahin a na semin a thu zong mangin, Topa’ thupieh na langpan sih vua, noma le ang uh kumpipa in na ni-un na Topa Pasien uh’ nua na zui uleh thu ang hoi ding hi;"},"15":{"text":"ahi vangin note in Topa’ thu na man sih vua, Topa’ thupieh na langpan uleh Topa’ khut in note le na kumpipa uh ang langpan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in dai dide-in om unlen, na muna vuah Topa in ang bawl ding ahi tam na lienpi en un."},"17":{"text":"Tuhun pen mangbu at laitah hi lo amah? Van ang tosah nading le guo ang zuhsah nadingin Topa kungah thu ka ngen ding hi; tuale noma adinga kumpi khat na ngetna ziehun Topa muna-ah na gitlo gamtatnate uh a lien mama ahi lam mu-in na thei ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Samuel in Topa tungah thu ngen a, khum ni-in Topa in van tosahin guo zusah hi; tuale mi zosie in Topa le Samuel zatah citahin a zatah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mi zosie in Samuel kungah, “Na nasemte ka si lo nadingun Topa na Pasien tungah thu ei ngetpieh in; azieh pen ka mawnate uh banah koma adingin kumpi khat ka nget ziehun sietna ka belap lailai uhi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Samuel in mite kungah, “Zau sih un; tam gitlona zosie na bawl zo ta uhi, hinanle Topa na zuina uh pan piel sih unlen na lungsim zosie utawh Topa’ na sem un;"},"21":{"text":"tuale hattuomna ei pie thei lo, ei hunkhie thei lo, kimanna a nei lo nate lamah piel sih un, azieh pen tuate in kimanna nei lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in ama’ min lienpi a khuolna-in a mite nolh lo ding hi. Azieh pen ama’ mi-a note ang bawl ding Topa’ deilam ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua tham loin kei ka hi leh note adingin Topa kungah thungetpieh lona tawh ka na maw vawt sih ding hi; tuale keima in a hoi le a man lampi note kang hil ding hi"},"24":{"text":"Topa beh zatah unlen na lungsim zosie utawh citahin ama’ na sem un; azieh pen ama in note dinga ang bawlpiehsa na lienpite ngaisun un."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin sietna na bawl nah lai uleh, note le na kumpipa uh na ni-un ang kisumaimang ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul kumpi a suo patin kum sawmthum pha a, ama in kum sawmni le kum ni sung Israel uh hi.","title":"Thukham tawh Kituoh Lo Saul’ Biehpiehna"},"2":{"text":"Saul in Israel sung panin mi tul thum teel hi; tul nite Michmash le Bethel muoltung gamah Saul tawh a om vua, tul khatte Benjamin gam Gibeah-ah Jonathan tawh a om ton uhi; ama in mi a omlai teng a puonbuh vuah peisah hi."},"3":{"text":"Jonathan in Geba-a om Philistia khuocingte zo hi; tuale Philistia-te in tua thu a na za uhi. Tuale Saul in gam zosie-ah pengkul mut a, “Hebrew-zosie zasah un!” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Saul in Philistia khuocingte a zawna le Philistia-te adingin Israel huothuoi a hina zong Israel in a zah ciengin, Gilgal ah Saul panpi dingin mite kihlan hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel tawh kido dingin Philistia-te a kikhawm vua, leeng tul sawmthum, sakol galkap tulguh, le a galkapte tuipi gei-a senel za-in a tam uhi; amate zong peito-in Beth-avan nisuona lam Michmasah ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Philistia-te in Israel nah neh mama uh ahi ziehin lungkham mangbahna sungah a op lam uh a kithei ciengun suonghawm sung, leihawm sung, suong kawhawm lah, han lah le tuikhuh sung lah po-ah a kiphuol uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hebrew mi pawlkhat in Jordan gun kantanin Gad le Gilead gamah a galkai uhi. Gilgal ah Saul om lai a, mi zosie in a citun sa-in ama a zui uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Samuel’ hun ciengtan ahi ni sagi sung a ngah hi; ahi vangin Gilgal ah Samuel pei nawn loin Saul kung panin mite a taimang sieng ta uhi.","ref":"1Sam 10:8"},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in, “Kei kungah meihal biehna le thunuom biehnate hing tawi un,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in meihal biehna a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in meihal biehna a man lien ciengin Samuel a tung hi; tuale ama a dawn ding le a muoh dingin Saul a pusuoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Samuel in, “Bang bawl na hiei?” a ci hi. Saul in dawngkia a, “Kei kung panin mite a taimang vua, a ni ciengtan hun sungin nang lah nang tung sih a, Michmash-ah Philistia-te a kikhop uh ka mu ciengin,"},"12":{"text":"keima in, ‘Tu-in Gilgal ah keima ei do dinga ang kumsuh ding uh ahi ta a, ken lah Topa maipha ka ngen nai sih hi,’ ka ci hi; tuaci’n kei mama in meihal biehna ka na paupieh ta hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Samuel in Saul kungah, “Nang na mot gamtat ta hi; nang in thu ang pie Topa na Pasien’ thupieh na zui ta sih hi. Topa in Israel tungah na kumpi gam kipsah zing ding hi,"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin tu-in na kumpi gam kizomsuoh lo ding a, Topa in ama’ lunglamsu mi khat a sui zo hi. Topa ang thupieh na zui lo ziehin ama’ mite tungah a uh dingin Topa in ama a se zo ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:22"},"15":{"text":"Samuel ding dawhin Gilgal panin Benjamin gam Gibeah ah peito a, a omlai mi teng in galkap lut dingin Saul nua zui uhi; Gilgal panin Bejamin gam Gibeah lam naw-in amate a peito uhi. Saul in ama tawh a omton mite sim a, pasal zaguh bang a pha hi.","title":"Gal Do Ding Kiginna"},"16":{"text":"Saul, a tapa Jonathan, le a ompi mite Benjamin gam sung Gibeah ah a om uhi; ahi vangin Philistia-te in Michmash ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale Philistia-te’ giephuol panin galguh pawl thumin a kuonkhie uhi; pawlkhat Shual gam Ophrah lamah kihei-in,"},"18":{"text":"adang pawlkhat in Beth-horon lam manaw-in pawl khatte gamlah Zeboiim kuom a kimusuhna muoltung lamah a kihei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Khum hunin Israel gam sung zosie-ah siakheng khat zong kimu lo hi; azieh pen Philistia-te in, “Hebrew-te in namsau hile teipi hile kheng thei lo ding hi,” a ci uhi;"},"20":{"text":"tuaci’n Philistia-te kungah amau’ bawng lohlawna tu, tuzum, hei, ahi sihle a phieukawi-te uh kheng dingin Israel-te a peisuh let uhi;"},"21":{"text":"lohlawna tu le tuzum khenhiem man pen shekel sethum- suo-seni hi a, hei khenhiem man le ciengkhuta sia phu man shekel khat sethum-suo-sekhat ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n gal a kisim ni-in Saul le Jonathan tawh a omton mi khat popo’ khut sungah namsau hile teipi hile a om sih hi; hinanle Saul le a tapa Jonathan in tuate a nei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tu-in Michmash peina ciengkotah Philistia khuopicingte a cing dingin a pei uhi.","title":"Jonathan in Philistia-te Simgawp"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Saul’ tapa Jonathan in a galvan puo tangvalpa kungah, “Hing pei in, gal khat a Philistia khuocingte kungah va pei ta vai,” a ci hi. Hinanle ama in a pa kungah a pei ding lam gen lo hi."},"2":{"text":"Migron-a om Gibeah nawla mang kawlsing kung nei-ah Saul a om hi; ama tawh galkap zaguh bang omton a,"},"3":{"text":"tuate tawh Shiloh ah siempupuon a tawi Topa’ siempu Eli’ tapa Phinehas, a tapa Ichabod, a sanggampa Ahitub’ tapa Ahijah zong a om uhi. Mite in Jonathan a pitmang lam a thei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Philistia khuocingte’ opna-a pei ding Jonathan in a na hanciemna ciengkot a pang khatah suongdawh khat om a, a pang lang khatah zong suongdawh khat ma a om hi; a khat min Bozez ahi a, a dangkhat min Seneh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Suongdawh khat pen Michmash mai leilu lamah dawhin a khat pen Geba mai leitaw lamah a dawh hi."},"6":{"text":"Jonathan in a galvan puo tangvalpa kungah, “Hing pei in, a tep kitanlo dawibie mi tam khuocingte kungah va pei ta vai; Topa in ei adingin ei seppieh kha ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile hutdam nadingin a tam le a tawm in Topa khahtan zo lo hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"A galvan puopa in ama kungah, “Na lungsim sunga na bawl nuom zosie bawl in. Nangma tawh kang omton hi; na ngaisut bang teng kei ngaisutna zong ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonathan in, “Tu-in khum mite kungah va galkai ta vai-in, amate kungah va kila ta vai."},"9":{"text":"Amate in i kung vuah, ‘Na kung vua kang pei masang ei na ngah un,’ a ci uleh i opna munah sip dide-in na ding vai-in, a kung vuah va peito da vai."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle amate in, ‘Kohaw kungah hing peito ta un,’ ei ci uleh va peito vai; azieh pen Topa in i khut sungah amate ei pie zo hi. Tam khu eite dingin lim hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n a ni-un Philistia inncingte kungah pei-in a va kimusah ta uhi; tuale Philistia-te in, “En un, a kiphuolna uh leihawm panin Hebrew-te ang pusuoh ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khuocing mite in Jonathan le a galvan puopa na muoh vua, “Ko kungah hing peito un; bang khat hing ensah va ung,” a ci uhi. Jonathan in a galvan puopa kungah, “Ka nua ei zuito-in; azieh pen Topa in Israel’ khut sungah amate a pie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a khut le a keng tawh Jonathan kato a, a galvan puopa in a zui hi. Jonathan in Philistia-te vatmai a, a galvan puopa in a nua-ah amate that hi."},"14":{"text":"Jonathan le a galvan puopa in mi a tha masah lai-un lo acre khat dung zui-in lokaina kuoh dung tawnlang sungah mi sawmni bang that uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin giephuol sung, lozau sung, le mite lahah patauna a om hi; khuocingte le gal bulute nasan a citun uhi; Zil kiling hi; tua khu patauna lienpi khat a suoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Benjamin-te’ gam sunga Gibeah-a Saul’ galvilte in a et ciengun tam lam le khum lama a kikhin valuoi mite a mu uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in a kunga om galkapte kungah, “Mi sim unlen i sungpanin koi peikhie ahei thei un,” a ci hi. Mi a sim zaw ciengun Jonathan le a galvan puopa na om lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Saul in Ahijah kungah, “Pasien’ singkuong tanah hing peipi in,” a ci hi. Azieh pen khum hun lai-in Pasien’ singkuong Israel-te tawh a zawhton hi."},"19":{"text":"Saul in siempu pa a hopi laitahin Philistia-te’ giephuol sungah buoina a khang tehteh hi; Saul in siempupa kungah, “Na khut ladawh ta’n,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul le ama tawh a zawhton mi zosie kikhawmin galphuol lam zuonin a pei uhi; tuale kitawhnawina lienpi khat na om a, khatlekhat namsau tawh a kivat ciet uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in Philistia-te tawh nidanglai-a na omtonsa le giephuola amate tawh na pei zosa Hebrew-te kihei-in Saul le Jonathan tawh a omton Israel-te lamah a pang uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Ephraim muoltung gama a kiphuoldap Israel-te zosie in Philistia-te galtai zo ta uhi, ci thu a zah ciengun amate in zong galphuolah a dap zui uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in khum ni-in Israel-te galzawna a ngasah hi. Beth-aven kal dongin galkidona om a, Saul tawh a omton galkapte a kigawmin tul sawm bang pha hi. Ephraim muoltung gam dongin galkidona kizel hi."},"24":{"text":"Saul in khum ni-in mot gamtatna khat a bawl hi. Ama in galkapte tungah kiciemna khat na koi a, “Nitah masang le ka galte tungah phu ka lah zawh masangin an a ne poma samsiet nga taheh,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n galkapte koima in an a ciem sih uhi.","title":"Saul A Kimotciemna"},"25":{"text":"Khuoiphang opna mun khatah galkap zosie a tung vua, tuatah leilahah khuoizu na om hi."},"26":{"text":"Khuoiphang opna munah galkapte a tun ciengun khuizu a na hlita dildel hi; ahi vangin amate in a kam sung vuah a khut uh a koi sih uhi. azieh pen amate in kiciemna a giing uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hizongle a pa in galkapte tungah kiciemna tawh a tomlaw lam Jonathan in a za kha sih hi; tuaci’n ama in khuoiphang sunga om ciengkhut diesuhin khuoizu a lieh leh a mit pelin a tha a hatkia hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkapte lahah khat in, “Na pa in kiciemna tawh nasietahin galkapte na tomlaw a, ‘Tuni-a an ne mi koipo samsiet tang taheh,’ a ci hi. Tuale galkapte gilkielin a basam uhi,” a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonathan in, “Ka pa in gam sung a gentheisah hi; tam khuoizu themno khat ka ciep ziehin ka mit ang pelin ka tha ang hatkiana khu en un."},"30":{"text":"Tuni-in galkapte in a galvanlah-te uh a dudu-un ne uleh bangza tahin a hoizaw lai diei; bang ding ahei cile tu-in Philistia-te in mi tampi i that zo nai sih hi,” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in khum ni-in Michmash panin Aijalon dong Philistia-te a satpua zaw ciengun galkapte a basam uhi;"},"32":{"text":"tuaci’n galvan kinuasiete tungah galkapte bawhsuhin, lei lahah tuu le bawngtangte le bawngnote a go uhi; tuale a galkapte in tuate a si tawh a ne uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul kungah thu kitut a, “En in, galkapte in a si tawh sa a neh ziehun Topa tungah a maw uhi,” kici hi. Tuale ama in, “Note na zuou gamtat ta uhi. Ka mai-a tam sungah suongtum golpi khat hing lia un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 9:4; Siem 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16, 23; 15:23"},"34":{"text":"Saul in, “Galkapte lahah no le no na kithezah unlen a kung vuah, ‘Mi zosie in a bawngtang uh hile a tuu uh hile tanah hing peipi-in gosah unlen, a sa ne uheh; a si pum a nehna tawh Topa tungah maw sih un,’ ci-un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n khum zanin galkapte zosie in a bawngtangte uh kai-in khum munah a go uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuale Saul in Topa adingin maitam khat a lam hi; tua khu ama in Topa dinga a bawl masah pen maitam ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in, “Zanin Philistia-te va delsuh ta vai-in zing khuovah masangin va sugam ta vai; mi khat zong hen sih vai,” a ci hi. Amate in, “Hoi na sah bangin bawl in,” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin siempupa in, “Tanah Pasien dong masa tadi vai,” a ci hi.","title":"Jonathan Si Dihtah"},"37":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in Pasien dong a, “Philistia-te nuadela va peisuh ta ding ka mah? Israel’ khut sungah amate nei pie diei mah?” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Pasien in khum ni-in ama a dawng sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Saul in, “No mipi makaite aw, na unpi-un tanah hing pei un; tuni-in tam mawna bang hing ci pien ahei ci guizui vai."},"39":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Israel a hundam Topa a hin ma bangin, ka tapa Jonathan tung nangawnah tua mawna a om le zong ama si valon ding hi!” a ci hi. Ahi vangin mi zosie lahah ama a dawng koima om lo hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama in Israel zosie tungah, “Note langkhatah om unlen, kei le ka tapa Jonathan a langkhatah ka om ding uhi,” a ci hi. Mite in Saul kungah, “Hoi na sah bangin bawl in,” a ci uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tua bepin Saul in, “Israel’ Pasien Topa aw, tuni-in bang dinga na nasempa nei dawn lo ahei? Tami khielna kei tungah ahi a, ka tapa Jonathan tungah ahi zongin a op leh “Israel’ Pasien Topa aw, ai a kisan ciengin Urim hing hisah in. Ahi vangin tam khielna na mi Israel tunga tu ahile ai a kisan ciengin Thummim hing hisah in,” a ci hi. Tua aisanna in Jonathan le Saul kawh a, ahi vangin mipite a peng uhi.","ref":"Gam 27:21; 1Sam 28:6"},"42":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in, “Kei le ka tapa kikalah aisan un,” a ci hi. Tuale Jonathan kila hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in Jonathan kungah, “Bang ahiei na bawl ei gen vawi,” a ci hi. Jonathan in ama kungah, “Ka khut sunga ka tawi ciengkhut dawn tawh khuoizu themno khat ka ciem kha hi; tanah om ing, kei a si ding ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Saul in, “Jonathan aw, nang na si sih tah leh Pasien in kei ei dop bawl sih taheh!” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin mite in Saul kungah, “Israel sungah tam guolzawna lienpi a piengsah Jonathan si ding ahi amah? Si mawngmawng sih va! Topa a hing ahi ma bangin a lutunga a samzam khat zong tuolah a kie sih ding hi; azieh pen ama in tuni-in Pasien tawh kopin na a sem zo hi,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n mite in Jonathan a tankhie vua, tuale ama a si nawn sih hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in Philistia-te a nuadel khawl a, Philistia-te zong a mun ciet a zuon uhi."},"47":{"text":"Israel tungah Saul kumpi a suo zaw ciengin muncin tenga a galte zosie, Moab-te, Ammon-te, Edom-te, Zobah kumpite, le Philistia-te a do hi; a kiheina popo-ah ama in gal a zo hi.","title":"Saul’ Galdo Lai Dingte"},"48":{"text":"Ama in hangtahin gal do a, Amalek-te vatpua-in amate a suom mite’ khut sung panin Israel a hunkhie hi."},"49":{"text":"Tu-in Saul’ tapate Jonathan, Ishvi, le Malchishua ahi uhi; tuale a tanu nite: a uzaw’ min Merab ahi a, a naunu’ min Michal ahi hi."},"50":{"text":"Saul’ zinu min Ahinoam ahi a, Ahimaaz’ tanu ahi hi. A galkap mangpa’ min Abner ahi a, Saul’ pano Ner’ tapa ahi hi;"},"51":{"text":"Kish pen Saul’ pa ahi a, Abner’ pa Ner Abiel’ tapa ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Saul a hin sung tungtawnin Philistia-te tawh kidona a om hi; tuale Saul in mi thahat khat popo ahi a, galhang khat popo ahi zongin a mu ciengin a galkap dingin a la hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel in Saul kungah, “ Topa in ama’ mi Israel tungah kumpi dingin nang sathau nu dingin kei ei sawl hi; tua ahi ziehin tu-in Topa’ thugen ngai in.","title":"Saul in Amalek-te Zo, Kumpipa Hingmat","ref":"1Sam 10:1"},"2":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi, ‘Egypt panin Israel-te a peito lai-un lam kalah Israel-te a langpan ziehun Amalek-te dan ka pie ding hi.","ref":"Pei 17:8-14; Thkna 25:17-19"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in kuonin Amalek-te va sim unlen, a neisa zosie uh va susiemang ta un; amate hinkhawi loin numei le pasal, nausen le nawitep laite, bawngtang le tuu, kalaoh le laa-te that sieng un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in zong mi hlanin Telaim-ah mi phaza sim a, lei galkap mi tul zani le Judah mi tul sawm pha hi."},"5":{"text":"Amalek khuopi-ah Saul pei a, kuom sungah a buhdap hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in Ken-te kungah, “Pei un! Dingdawh un! Amalek-te lah panin kihemkhie un, tua ahi sihle amate tawh kang susie ton ding hi; azieh pen Egypt panin a peito lai-un Israel mi zosie tungah migitna na lah uhi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Amalek-te lah panin Ken-te a kihemkhie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Saul in Havilah panin Egypt gam nisuona lama om Shur dongin Amalek-te a zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Amalek-te’ kumpipa Agag hingmat a, ahi vangin namsau tawh mi zosie that hi."},"9":{"text":"Saul le mite in Agag, le tuu le bawng a hoi pente, bawngno le tuuno a thaute, le van manpha zosie hinkhawi-in a susie sih uhi; amate in a kithuse lo le bangma man lo zosie teng a susie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Samuel kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:","title":"Kumpi Dingin Saul Kinuol"},"11":{"text":"“Kumpi-a Saul ka koikhah ka kisia hi, azieh pen keima ei zuina panin kinua hei-in ka thupiehte sem lo hi,” a ci hi. Samuel lungthah a, zan tungtawnin Topa tungah a kiko hi."},"12":{"text":"Zingmawngin Saul dawn dingin Samuel thobai a, tuale Samuel kungah, “Carmel-ah Saul pei-in tua munah ama dingin phawna muol suong khat phut a, a kilekia ciengin Gilgal-ah a peisuoh hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"13":{"text":"Saul kungah Samuel a pei ciengin Saul in ama kungah, “ Topa in nang thupha hing pie taheh; keima in Topa’ thupiehna ka sem zo hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Samuel in, “Tua ahile ka bila ka zah tuu hamte le bawng hamte bang ahiei?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Saul in, “Tuate Amalek-te kung pana ang peipi uh ahi hi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa na Pasien tungah biehpiehna dingin mite in a tuituoh pen tuute le bawngte a hen uhi; hizongle adang teng ka that sieng ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in Saul kungah, “Khawl vawi! Tuzanin ka Topa in ka kunga ei thugen pen nang kungah hing gen vang,” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Hing gen in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Samuel in, “Nangma mi neuno khatin na kingaisut vangin Israel minamte’ lutang na hi sih amah? Topa in Israel tungah kumpi dingin sathau ang nu zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale Topa in na sem dingin nangma ang sawl a, ‘Pei in; mawnei Amalek-te va thatgam sieng inlen, a si sieng dongun va sim tan,’ ei ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale bang dinga Topa’ thu mang lo na hei? Bang dingin van kinuasiete zamin Topa’ mitmu-in a sie gamta na hei?” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Saul in Samuel kungah, “ Topa’ thu ka mang zo a, Topa in ka sep dinga ei sawl nasepna-ah ka pei zo hi. Amalek-te’ kumpipa Agag kang peipi zo a, Amalek-te zong ka sumang zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin mite in gal vanlahte, tuute le bawngte, suhsiet dinga ki-ap sil hoi pente, Gilgal-a Topa tungah biehpiehna dingin a la uhi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale Samuel in, “ Topa in meihal biehnate le biehpiehnate, Topa thu man ding za-in dei luo ahi amah? Biehpiehna sangin thu man ding hoizaw tahtah a, tuutang thaute sangin thu ngai ding hoizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ledona pen aisan mawna sangin neuzaw tuon lo a, lungkhauhna zong khielna le milim biehna ma tawh kibang ahi hi. Nang in Topa’ thu niel zo na hi ziehin, ama’n zong kumpi hina panin ang nuol ta hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Saul in Samuel kungah, “Kei ka khiel zo hi; bangzieh ahei cile mite giingin a thu uh ka man khah ziehin Topa’ thupiehna le nangma’ thute ka palsat zo ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in kang thum hi, ka khielna ei ngaidam inlen, Topa ka bieh thei nadingin ei zuikia ta’n,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Samuel in Saul kungah, “Kang zuikia sih ding hi; azieh pen nangma in Topa’ thu na niel zo ta a, Topa in Israel tunga kumpi na hina panin ang nuol zo ta hi."},"27":{"text":"A pei dingin Samuel a kihei ciengin Saul in a puontuolpi mongah a nua mat leh a puon a ehkeh hi."},"28":{"text":"Samuel in ama kungah, “Tuni ma ma-in Topa in nang kung panin Israel’ kumpi gam botkehin nang sanga a hoizaw na vengpa tungah a pie zo ta hi.","ref":"1Sam 28:17; 1Kum 11:30-31"},"29":{"text":"Tua banah Israel’ Minthanna Pa in a thu dawhkia lo ding a, a lungsim zong a khel sih ding hi. Azieh pen a lungsim khel dingin ama mihing hi lo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in, “Kei ka maw zo ta hi; hinanle tu-in ka mi upate mai le Israel mai-ah ei patawi inlen, Topa na Pasien ka bieh thei nadingin kei ei zuikia ta’n,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul’ nua zui-in Samuel a kilekia hi; tuale Saul in Topa a bie hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in, “Amalek kumpipa tam sung keima kungah hing peipi in,” a ci hi. Tuale a citunsa-in ama kungah Agag a pei hi. Agag in, “Tam pen sisie-a sina tahtah ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin Samuel in, “Na namsau in nute ta nei lo-a a koi bangin, na nu zong numeite lahah ta nei loin a om ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Samuel in Gilgal-a Topa mai-ah Agag a tuntan hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ramah ah Samuel a pei hi; tuale Gibeah-a ama’ inn ah Saul a pei hi."},"35":{"text":"Samuel in a si dongin Saul mu nawn lo hi, ahi vangin Saul tungtangah Samuel da mama hi. Tuale Topa in Israel tungah kumpi dingin Saul a koi khah a kisia hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Samuel kungah, “Saul ziehin bang tanvei da ding na hei? Israel tungah kumpi dingin ama ka nuol zo ta hi. Na sathau bung sungah sathau a dimin thal inlen dingdawh in; keima in Bethlehem-a Jessi kungah kang sawl ding hi, azieh pen a tate lah panin keima dingin kumpi khat ka koi zo ta hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Kumpi-in David Sathau Kinu"},"2":{"text":"Samuel in, “Bangci pei thei ding ka hei? Saul in za leh ama in kei ei that ding hi,” a ci hi. Topa in, “Bawnglaa khat kai inlen ama kungah, ‘ Topa tungah biehpiehna pie dinga ang pei ka hi hi,’ ci-in."},"3":{"text":"Biehpiehna-ah Jessi hlan inlen na bawl ding teng kang hil ding hi; tuale nangma in a min kang gen pa sathau nei nupieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh bangin Samuel gamta a, Bethlehem ah a ma a pei hi. Ama dawn dingin khuopi upate citun kawmin a pei vua, ama kungah, “Thuhoi-a hing kalsuon na hiei mah?” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in, “Thuhoi ahi hi; Topa kungah biehpiehna pie dinga ang pei ka hi hi; noma ciet kisiensuo unlen biehpiehna-ah kei tawh hing pei un,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in Jessi le a tapate siensuo-in biehpiehna-ah amate a hlan hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate a tun ciengun ama in Eliab en a, “Tu-in ahile Topa mai-ah Topa’ sathau nu pa om tahtah hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in Samuel kungah, “A melpuoh ahi sihle a duong sanna lam en sin, azieh pen keima in ama ka nuol zo hi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa in mihingte’ mu bangin a mu sih hi; amate in a putham melpuoh dan en a, hinanle Topa in lungtang a en hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jessi in Abinadab hlanin Samuel mai-ah a peisah hi. Ama in, “ Topa in tampa zong teel lo hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Jessi in Shammah peisah leuleu hi. Tuale ama in, “ Topa in tampa zong teel lo hi,” ci leuleu hi."},"10":{"text":"Jessi in Samuel mai-ah a tapa sagite a peisah a, tuale Samuel in Jessi kungah, “ Topa in tam mite khat zong teel lo hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Samuel in Jessi kungah, “Na tapa zosie tana om sieng ma uh ahiei mah?” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “A nautum pen om lai hi, ahi vangin ama tuucinga om ahi bo hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Samuel in Jessi kungah, “Mi sawl unlen ama hing zawpi ta un; azieh pen ama tam sunga ang tun masangsie i kipan thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in mi sawlin ama a tumpi hi. Ama cisan suo-in dam mel puo a, a mit ha dan kilawm a, a mel zong hoi hi. Topa in, “Ding inlen ama sathau nu in; tampa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in sathau bung la-in a sanggamte mitmu-in ama sathau a nu hi; tuale khum ni-a kipanin David tungah Topa’ hlagau khautahin a tung hi. Tua ciengin David dingdawh a, Ramah ah a pei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in Saul kung panin Topa’ hlagau a peidawh a, Topa kung panin hla gilo khat in ama a bawlsie hi.","title":"David in Saul adingin Lyre Lasahna Tum"},"15":{"text":"Saul’ nasemte in ama kungah, “Tu-in en in, Pasien kung panin hla gilo khat in nang ang bawlsie hi."},"16":{"text":"I pu un tu-in ang kem na nasemte tungah lyre a tumsiem mi pawlkhat a sui nadingun thu pie in; na kungah Pasien’ kung pana ang pei hla gilo ang tun ciengin ama in tuami ang tum ding a, na ci ang dam ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in a nasemte kungah, “A tum siem mi khat ei suipieh unlen, ka kungah hing zawpi un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tangvalte khat in dawng a, “Bethlehem-a Jessi’ tapa, tumging tum siem, galhang, galdo siem, thugen lama a pilvang, mi melpieng khat ka mu hi; tuale Topa in ama a ompi hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in Jessi kungah kamtaite sawlin ama kungah, “Tuucinga om na tapa David ka kungah hing sawl in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Jessi in laa khat kai-in anlum, lenggazu savun thawl khat, keelno khat puosahin Saul kungah a tapa David a peisah hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul kungah David tung a, tuaci’n ama na semin a pang hi. Saul in ama it mama a, a galvan puopa a suoh hi."},"22":{"text":"Jessi kungah Saul in mi sawlin, “Ka na semin David hing omsah ta’n, azieh pen ama in ka maipha a mu hi,” a cisah hi."},"23":{"text":"Saul tungah Pasien kung pana hla gilo a tuh popo ciengin David in a lyre la-in a khut tawh tum a, tuaci’n Saul thathokia-in nuomtuom a, ama kung panin hla gilo a peikhie hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Philistia-te in gal sim dingin a galkapte a khawm uhi; Judah gam Socoh ah amate kituo-in Socoh le Azekah kikal Ephes-dammim ah giephuol a sat uhi.","title":"David le Goliath"},"2":{"text":"Saul le Israel-te zong kikhawmin Elah kuomah giephuol a sat vua, Philistia-te do dingin a kithawi uhi."},"3":{"text":"A galkhat muol tungah Philistia-te dingin Israel zong a gal langkhat muol tungah a ding vua, a kikal vuah kuompi khat a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Philistia-te’ giephuol panin Gath khuomi Goliath a kici a makai, a tun tong guh le khap khat a sang mipa khat a pusuoh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in sumngo sia lukhu khu-in sia songkhol tawh kivon hi; a sia songkhol sumngo shekel tulnga gih hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a keng gelah sumngo ngaltuom bun a, a liengko-ah sumngo teikhaw khat kikhai hi."},"7":{"text":"A teibul pen siem lawngpi tawh kibang a, a teimuh pen sia shekel zaguh gih hi; tuale ama mai-ah a lum tawipa a pei hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama dingto-in Israel gal lamkaite awhsan a, “Bang zieha galsim dinga hing kuon na hi uh ahei? Kei Philistia mi khat ka hi a, no Saul’ nasemte hi lel lo uh na mah? No lah panin pasal khat hing teel unlen ka kungah hing peisah un."},"9":{"text":"Ama’n kei ei do-in ei tha zawh leh no sila kang suoh ding uhi; ahi vangin ken ama zo-in ka tha zawh leh ko sila nang suoh ding vua kote’ na na sem ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale Philistia-te in, “Tuni-in Israel gal lamkaite kang tawh hi! I kido thei nadingin mi khat ei pie un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Saul le Israel zosie in Philistia-pa’ thugen a zah uh ciengin lungkie-in nahpitahin a zau uhi."},"12":{"text":"David pen Judah gam Bethlehem-a Ephrathah-te Jessi min nei pa’ tapa ahi a, ama in tapa sagi nei hi. Saul hun lai-in tua mipa vuoi-in kum tampi pha ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Jessi’ tapa a tapen thumte in galphuol-ah Saul a zui uhi; gal phuola kuon a tapa thumte’ min pen, a tapen Eliab, ama zomah Abinadab, le a thumna Shammah ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"David a tumpen ahi hi; a tapen thum in Saul a zui vua,"},"15":{"text":"ahi vangin Bethlehem-a a pa’ tuute va dingin Saul kung panin David kuon zelin a tung zel hi."},"16":{"text":"Ni sawmli sung zingmawng nitahin Philistia-pa pei-in a va ding let ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Jessi in a tapa David kungah, “Na ute puoh dingin tami ankan ephah khat le tam anlum sawm guong inlen, giephuolah na ute kungah a mallangin va puoh in,” a ci hi;"},"18":{"text":"tam bawngnawi khal pheng sawmte zong tawi inlen, tul a uh galkapmangpa puoh in. Na ute’ luhin suongpo dan va mu ta’nlen, amate tung panin melcina themkhat hing tawi ta’n,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua laitahin Saul, amate, le Israel mi zosie Elah kuomah a om vua, Philistia-te tawh a kido uhi."},"20":{"text":"Jessi thu pieh bangin zingmawng phalvahin David tho a, a cing ding mi khat tawh a tuute nuasie-in a ante puo-in a pei hi. Galsim dinga kithawi galkap honpite in galdo kikona a awh lai tahun giephuolah David a tung hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel le Philistia-te, a kido dingin galkap le galkap a kiguol uhi."},"22":{"text":"David in van cing pa’ khut sungah a an puohte nuasie-in galkapte kungah a tai a, ama pei-in a sanggamte a hopi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate tawh a kiho laitahin Philistia gal makaite sung pan Gath-a Philistia-te’ makai Goliath min nei pa pusuohin a masa-a a thugen teng ma a gen hi. Tuale David in a thugen a za hi."},"24":{"text":"Israel-te zosie in tua mipa a mu ciengun ama kung panin taimangin a zau mama uhi."},"25":{"text":"Israel-te in, “Tami ang peito pa na mu vuoi? Israel-te a tawh dinga ang peito tahtah ahi hi. Kumpipa in ama a that zo mipa tungah sum tampi tawh patawi-in a tanu tawh kinungsah ding a, Israel sungah ama’ innkuonte suotahna a pie ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"David in a gei-a ding mite kungah, “Tam Philistia-pa thatin Israel tung panin zakona a lamang pa adingin bang kibawlpieh ding ahei?” a ci hi. Hingzing Pasien’ galkapte a tawh valiang dingin tami a tep kitan lo Philistia-pa khu koi hi viel ahei?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Mite in ama a kibang ngiamin a dawng vua, “Ama a that mipa tungah tua a kigensa bangin kibawl ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"28":{"text":"David in mite kungah thu a gen laitahin a u tapen Eliab in na za hi; tuale David tungah Eliab a sinso a, “Bang dinga hing peisuh na hiei? Gamlahah tuu tawmnote koi tawh nang nuasie ahiei? Na kimot muonna le na lungsim gitlona ka thei hi; azieh pen gal kidona en lel dinga hing peisuh hi bo teh,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"David in, “Tu-in ke’n bang ka bawl ei?
