Thu dawhna maimai khat hi lel bo” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama kung panin midang khat kungah kihei-in a gen ngaiteng ma a gen hi.; tuale mite in a masa-a bangin a dawngkia uhi."},"31":{"text":"David’ thugente a kizah bepin amate in Saul kungah a gensawn vua, tuale Saul in ama hlansah hi."},"32":{"text":"David in Saul kungah, “Ama ziehin koima lungkiesah sin; na nasempa pei-in tami Philistia-pa tawh va kisuol ta vang,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Saul in David kungah, “Tam Philistia-pa tawh kisuol dingin pei thei sih va teh; bangzieh ahei cile nang naupangno khat na hi na bo a, ama a tangval lai-a kipanin galhang mi khat a na hi ta bo hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin David in Saul kungah, “Na nasempa in a pa’ tuute ka cing let hi; tuale humpi ahi a, vompi ahi zongin ang pei-in tuute lah panin tuunote ang taw sielin,"},"35":{"text":"keima in tuate nuadelin ka satpua a, a kam sung panin tuuno ka lahpieh hi; tuale ei pet dingin ang din ciengin a khagu-ah manin vat gawpin ka that ngai hi."},"36":{"text":"Na nasempa in humpi le vompi a nipi-in a that ngai zo ta hi; ama in hingzing Pasien’ galkapte a tawh viel ziehin a tep kitan lo tami Philistia-pa zong tuate khat tawh kibang lel ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"David in, “Humpi kecin le vom kecin pana ei hunkhie ahi tua Topa in tami Philistia-pa’ khut sung panin zong ei hunkhie ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Saul in David kungah, “Va pei ta’n, nang tawh Topa hing om taheh!” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Saul in a galvante David silsah hi; ama in a lu tungah sumngo lukhu khusah a, sia songkhol a silsah hi."},"39":{"text":"David in a galvan tungah Saul’ namsau kuo a, tuate tawh ama kingainase nai lo ahi ziehin pei dingin a kisah leh a pei thei sih hi. Tua bepin David in Saul kungah, “Tam teng tawh lam ka pei thei sih hi; azieh pen tamte tawh ka kingainase nai sih hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n David in tuate a suodawh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a khutah a ciengkhut tawi-in lui panin a zol kilkel suongtang nga tengin tuucinna thungpi sungah tuate a guong hi; ama in a khut sungah a saili tawi-in Philistia-pa kung a zuon hi."},"41":{"text":"Philistia-pa pei-in a mai-ah a lum tawipa tawh a pei David lam a neh hi."},"42":{"text":"Philistia-pa khuodahin David a mu ciengin ama pen a cisan suoh, a mel hoi tangval no khat ahi nah bo ziehin a simmaw hi."},"43":{"text":"Philistia-pa in David kungah, “Cieng tawh ka kunga nang kuon nadingin kei ui ka hi amah?” a ci hi. Philistia-pa in a pasiente’ min tawh David a samsie hi."},"44":{"text":"Philistia-pa in David kungah, “Ka kungah hing pei in, hui lahah vate le gamlah gamsate tungah na sa ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanle David in Philistia-pa kungah, “Ka kungah namsau, teipi, le teikhaw tawh nang kuon hi; hizongle nangma in na tawh vagiap Israel galkapte’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa’ min tawh na kunga ang kuon ka hi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuni-in Topa in ka khut sungah nang ei pie ding a, nang hing satlia-in na lu ka tansan ding hi; tuale tuni mama-in hui lahah a leng vate le leitung gamsate tungah Philistia galkap a site’ luonghawm ka pie ding hi. Israel sungah Pasien khat a op lam leitung mi zosie in a theithei nading ule,"},"47":{"text":"Topa in namsau le teipi tawh a hutkhiet lo lam tam muna kikhawm mi zosie in a theithei nading uh ahi hi; bang zieh ahei cile galdona pen Topa a’ hi a, ama in ka khut sung vuah note ei pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"David tawh kisuol dingin Philistia-pa in David a neh tehteh ciengin, David zong Philistia-pa tawh kisuol dingin galkapte gal kidona mun zuonin mallangin a tai hi."},"49":{"text":"David in a khut tawh a thungpi sung sawh a, suongtang khat la-in a kap leh Philistia-pa’ talpang a kha hi; a talpangah tua suongtang tumsuhin ama tuoltang sena-in kinei hi."},"50":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in saili khat le suongtang khat tawh Philistia-pa zo a, Philistia-pa satpuo-in that hi; David’ khut sungah namsau a om sih hi.","ref":"2Sam 21:19"},"51":{"text":"Tua ciengin David tai-in Philistia-pa tungah a ding hi; ama in Philistia-pa’ namsau manin a pai pan dawh a, tuale ama that hi; tua ciengin ama in tua tawh a lu a tan hi. Philistia-te in a galhangpa uh si a mu ciengun a taimang sieng uhi.","ref":"1Sam 21:9"},"52":{"text":"Israel le Judah galkap-te awngin a ding vua, Gath le Ekron kulkotpi cieng dongah Philistia-te a del vua, Shaaraim lampi dung panin Gath le Ekron dongin gal sunga a liem Philistia mite a puamat sieng uhi."},"53":{"text":"Philistia-te a delna panun Israel-te kilekia-in a giephuol uh a bulu uhi."},"54":{"text":"David in Philistia-pa’ lutang la-in Jerusalem ah peipi hi; ahi vangin ama in a puonbuh sungah a galvan teng koi hi."},"55":{"text":"Saul in Philistia-te do dinga a kuon David a mu ciengin ama in galkapmangpa Abner kungah, “Abner, tami tangvalpa khu koi’ tapa ahiei?” a ci hi. Abner in, “Nang a hing na hi ma bangin kumpipa aw, ka thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"56":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Tua tangvalno koi’ tapa ahei, dong in,” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Philistia-pa a thana panin David kilekia a, Abner in a khut sunga a tawi Philistia-pa’ lutang tawh Saul mai-ah ama a peipi hi."},"58":{"text":"Saul in ama kungah, “Tangvalpa, koi’ ta na hiei?” a ci hi. David in, “Bethlehem-a na nasempa Jessi’ tapa ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Saul a hopi zaw-in Jonathan’ lungsim le David’ lungsim kikhiton a, Jonathan in ama’ pumpi za-in ama a it hi.","title":"David tawh Jonathan’ Thuciemna"},"2":{"text":"Saul in khum ni panin ama kungah David omsah a, a pa’ inn ah a peisah nawn sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonathan in a pumpi za-in David a it ziehin ama tawh thuciemna khat a bawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Jonathan in a sil lai a puontuolpi sutin a galvante, a namsau, a thalpi, le a kawngga nasan David a pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Saul’ sawlna khat popo-ah David pei-in a matun ahi ziehin Saul in a galkapte a uh dingin ama a koi hi. Mi zosie, Saul’ nasemte nangawn zong a lungkim uhi."},"6":{"text":"Philistia-pa a thana panin David pei-in, amate in inn lam a zot ciengun, Kumpi Saul dawn dingin tawm neute le tumgingte tawi-in Israel khuopi zosie sung panin a lam kawmun lasa-in numeite a pusuoh uhi."},"7":{"text":"A guolnop kawmun numeite khatlekhat in la a sa vua, “Saul in a tulin that, David in a tul sawmin that,” a ci uhi.","ref":"1Sam 21:11; 29:5"},"8":{"text":"Tam lasahna ziehin Saul lungthah mama a, tua in ama lungkimsah vet lo hi. Ama in, “ David a tul sawma thatin a gen vua, kei a tul beh thatin ei gen uhi. Kumpi’ min ka puoh simlo bang nei nawn ka hei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-a kipanin Saul in David a encih den hi."},"10":{"text":"A zing ciengin Pasien kung panin hlagau gilo khat in Saul bawh a, tuale nisima a bawl ngai bangin David in lyre lasahna a tum laitahin a inn sungah Saul a hang gawp hi. Saul in a khut sungah a teipi a tawi hi;","title":"David Tha Nading Saul Hanciem"},"11":{"text":"tuale Saul in a teipi a khaw hi, azieh pen ama in, “Kawm tawh David kiltha vang,” ci-in a ngaisun hi. Hizongle a ni vei-in David kihem man hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in ama ompi-in ahi vangin Saul kung panin a kihep dawh ziehin Saul in David a giing hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in ama kung panin David hemkhie-in ama mihing tulkhat uhin koi hi; tuale David kuonin galkapte a makai hi."},"14":{"text":"A sepna bangkimah David a lawcing hi; azieh pen Topa in ama a ompi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in lawcinna lienpi a nei lam Saul in a mu ciengin lamdangsa-in a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel le Judah zosie in David a it uhi; azieh pen sungtum pusuohin amate a makai pa khu ama ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in David kungah, “Tanah ka tanu a tapen Merab a om hi; na zi dingin ama kang pie ding hi; kei adingin hangsan lel inlen Topa’ gal do in,” a ci hi. Azieh pen Saul in, “Ama tungah ka khut ka hlang sih ding hi; Philistia-te in kisep ta uheh,” ci-in ngaisun hi.","title":"David in Michal Tenpi"},"18":{"text":"David in Saul kungah, “Kumpipa’ mahpa hi thei nadingin kei koi ka hi a, Israel sungah ka tanaute, le ka pa’ innkuonte koi ahi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin David tungah Saul’ tanu Merab a kipieh ding hun tah ciengin Meholah-te Adriel tungah a zi dingin tua nu kipiezaw ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Saul’ tanu Michal in David a ngai hi. Saul kungah tua thu a kigen ciengin ama lungdamsah hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Ama adingin thaang ahi thei nading le ama tungah Philistia-te’ khut a tuh thei nadingin ama tungah tua nu piesah vang,” ci-in ngaisun hi. Tua ziehin Saul in David kungah a ni veina genin, “Tu-in nang ka mahpa ding na hi ta hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Saul in a nasemte thu pie a, “David dap hopi unlen ama kungah, ‘En in, na tungah kumpipa lungkim a, a nasem zosie in nang ang it uhi. Tua ahi ciengin tu-in kumpipa’ mahpa suoh in,’ ci-un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul’ nasemte in David kungah tam thu teng a gendap uhi. Tuale David in, “Kei mizawng mingau le a vangta khat ka hi lam mu napi-in kumpipa’ mahpa hi thei nading khu thuneu na sa uh amah?” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Saul’ nasemte in ama kungah, “David in a hici gen ma hi bo,” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in, “David kungah tam bangin na gen ding uhi, ‘Kumpipa in a galte tungah phu a lah thei nadingin Philistia-te’ vuntep zakhat ci simlo bangma moman a dei sih hi,’ na ci ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tu-in Saul in Philistia-te’ khut lumin David a sisah sawm hi."},"26":{"text":"A nasemte in David tungah tam bang thute a gen ciengun kumpipa’ mahpa a hi ding pen David lungkim mama hi. A kini ciem uh a tawp masangin,"},"27":{"text":"David tho-in a mite tawh kuon a, Philistia-te mi zakhat a that uhi. Kumpipa’ mahpa suo thei nadingin kumpipa tungah a kima kipie ding amau’ vuntepte David in a va puoh ta hi. Tuale Saul in a zi dingin a tanu Michal ama a pie hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in David a ompi lam le Saul’ tanu Michal in ama a ngai lam a thei ciengin"},"29":{"text":"Saul in David a giingzaw kan lai hi. Tuaci’n Saul khu khum huna kipanin David’ gal ahi ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin gal do dingin Philistia galkapmangte a kuonkhiet simin Saul’ nasem zosie sangin David in guol a zozaw hi. Tua ahi ziehin David a minthang semsem hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul in a tapa Jonathan le a nasem zosie kungah David tha ding thu a gen hi. Ahi vangin Saul’ tapa Jonathan in David a pahta mama hi.","title":"Jonathan in David Thumpieh"},"2":{"text":"Jonathan in David kungah, “Ka pa in nang ang tha sawm hi; tua ziehin zingcieng zingmawngin kikemcing in; a sipna mun khatah va kiphuol ta’n."},"3":{"text":"Keima hing pei-in nangma’ opna gamlahah ka pa gei-ah kang ding ding a, ka pa tawh nang vai ka va kiho ta ding hi; bang khatpo ka zah leh na kungah kang gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jonathan in a pa Saul kungah David genpha a, a kungah, “Na nasempa David tungah kumpipa maw kha malmal sin; azieh pen nang tungah ama ang maw ngai sih a, a sil bawlte nang adingin a hoi vive ahi hi;"},"5":{"text":"Philistine-pa tawh a kido lai-in ama’ khut sungah a nuntahna a kham ziehin Topa in Israel-te zosie adingin guolzawna lienpi piengsah hi. Nangma in tam thu na mitin na mu a, na lungdam hi; tua ahi ziehin thu om lopi-in bang dingin David thana tawh maw nei lo mipa tungah maw ding na hei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in Jonathan thugen a mang hi; Saul kiciem a, “Ama kithat poma lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jonathan in ama kungah David hlanin tam thu zosie a gen hi. Tua ciengin Jonathan in Saul kungah David zawpi a, a nidanga ma bangin a sepna ngai-ah a semkia hi."},"8":{"text":"Gal kidona khatvei omkia a, Philistia-te do dingin David a kuon hi. David in amate nahpi tahin do a, a mai-ah amate a taimang uhi.","title":"Saul Kung Pan David A Suotah Nading Michal in Hu"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a khut sungah teipi tawi-in a inn sungah Saul a to laitah, David in tumging a tum laitahin Topa kung panin hlagau gilo khat Saul tungah a tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Saul in a teipi-in David kawm tawh kiltha ding a sawm a, ahi vangin ama in Saul pelh a, tuaci’n kawmah a teipi kiphut hi. Khum ni zanin David taimangin a suohta hi."},"11":{"text":"Saul in David’ inn a encih dingin kamtaite sawl a, zingmawng ciengin ama tha a sawm hi. David’ zi Michal in ama kungah, “Tu zanin na hinna na hutdam sih leh zing ciengin ang kithat ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 59 Thulu"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n Michal in tawlet panin David khiesuh hi; tuale ama tai-in a suohta hi."},"13":{"text":"Michal in milim khat la-in a lupna tungah koi hi; tua nu in a lutang sonah kelmul tangkham khat khamsahin puon tawh khu hi."},"14":{"text":"Saul in David man dingin kamtaite a sawl ciengin ama in, “Ama a ci na hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in David en dingin kamtaite a sawl hi. Ama in, “Ama ka tha thei nadingin a lupna pumin hing peipi to ta un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Kamtaite a tun ciengun a lutunga kelmul tuomna tawh a kikhu milim khat lupna tungah na om hi."},"17":{"text":"Saul in Michal kungah, “Bang dinga tam banga nei sol a, ama a suotah nadinga ka galpa na taisah ahei?” a ci hi. Michal in Saul dawng a, “Ama in ka kungah, ‘Ei peisah in; bang dinga nang kang tha ding ahei?’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in David taimangin suohta hi; Ramah-a Samuel kungah ama pei-in, Saul in a tunga a bawlsiet dan zosie a gen hi. Ama le Samuel pei-in Naioth khuo-ah a teng uhi.","title":"Ramah ah Samuel tawh David Kipawl"},"19":{"text":"Saul kungah, “Ramah-a Naioth khua-ah David om hi,” kici hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in David man dingin kamtaite a sawl hi. Samuel in makai-in kamsang honte lamin awngin a op uh amate in a mu ciengun Saul’ kamtaite tungah Pasien’ hlagau tungin amate zong lamin awngin kam a sang uhi."},"21":{"text":"Saul kungah tam thu a kigen ciengin ama in adang kamtaite sawlkia a, amate zong lamin awngin a om uhi. Saul in a thum veina kamtaite sawlkia a, amate zong lamin awngin a om veve uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua bepin amama Ramah ah pei a, Secu -a om tuikul lienpi-ah a tung hi; ama in, “Samuel le David hei-a om gel ahei?” ci-in a dong hi. Tuale mi khat in, “Ama gel Ramah-a Naioth khua-ah a om uhi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama zong Ramah-a Naioth manaw-in a pei hi; tuale a tungah Pasien’ hlagau a tung hi. Ramah-a Naioth mun a tun masang a pei kawmin lamin awngin ama in kam a sang hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in a puon suodawhin Samuel mai-ah lamin awngin a om hi. Khum ni sun tungtawn le zan tungtawnin a guohtangin ama a om hi. Tua ahi ziehin, “Kamsangte lahah Saul zong a kihal ta amah?” kici hi.","ref":"1Sam 10:11-12"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ramah-a Naioth panin David a taimang hi. Jonathan kungah tungin ama mai-ah, “Bang ahiei ka bawl? Bang ahiei ka khielna? Ama in kei ei thasawm valia nadingin na pa tunga ka mawna bang ahiei?” a ci hi.","title":"David le Jonathan Kilawmtatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ama kungah, “Hing that laizang lo e! Si malmal sih vateh. Ka pa in kei thei loin thuneu hile thulien hile bangma a bawl ngai sih hi; tuale bang dingin ka pa in tam thu kei kungah ei pha ding ahei? Ei pha malmal sih va!” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin David zong kiciem a, “Na pa in kei nei patah lam a thei siem mama hi; tuale ama in, ‘Ama da luo ding ahi ziehin Jonathan theisah da vang,’ ci-in ngaisun hi. Hinanle a tahtahin Topa hingin nang mama zong na hin ma bangin, keima le sina kikalah kal khat beh om hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonathan in na gen popo kang bawlpieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"David in Jonathan kungah, “Zing cieng hladet ni ahi a, kumpipa tawh sabuoi-a ka to lo ding a kilawm sih hi; ahi vangin a ni thum nitah dong lolai-ah ka kiphuol thei nadingin kei ei peisah in.","ref":"Gam 28:11"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin kei ka om lo lam na pa in ei thei khah leh ama kungah, ‘David in ama’ khuo Bethlehem ah va tai pah tavang ci’n kei kungah limtahin ang kingen hi; azieh pen khum sungah ama’ innkuon zosie adingin kumsiel biehpiehna a om hi,’ na ci ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Hoi e!’ a ci leh na nasempa adingin thu hoi hi ding hi; ahi vangin ama a thangpai leh sietna lam ngaisun zo hi, ci thei in."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na nasempa mitgitna tawh ei bawl in; azieh pen nang tawh a siengtho thuciemna sungah na nasempa na tunpi hi. Ahi vangin kei sunga khielna a op leh nang mama in ei that in; bang dinga na pa kunga nei peipi ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Hing kithat laizang lo e! Ka pa in na tungah sietna a tunsah ding a ngaisut lam ka thei nah leh na kungah kang gen talawm sih ding amah?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Jonathan kungah, “Na pa in nang hing ngawh dawn taleh koi in kei ei gen ta diei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jonathan in David dawng a, “Hing pei in, lolai-ah pei vai,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a ni gelin lo-ah a pei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Jonathan in David kungah, “Israel Pasien, Topa’ minin ka kiciem hi! Zing cieng tu bang hunin ahi sihle a ni thum ni-in ka pa’ lungsim tawng kang kan zaw ciengin ama in David tungah lungsim pha a nei leh, mi sawlin na kungah hing theisah na lo ding ka mah?"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka pa in nang tungah sietna ang bawl sawm a, tuale nang hing theisah loin bihtaha na pei nadingin kang sawl sih tah leh Topa in keima Jonathan ei dawm sih taheh!"},"14":{"text":"Kei ka hin lai khah leh kei tungah Topa’ thuman itna ei lah in; ahi vangin kei ka si tah leh"},"15":{"text":"Topa na ngawnin lei maitang panin David’ gal teng zosie sumang nanle keima innkuon panin na thuman itna sumang ngai vawt sin,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 9:1"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Jonathan in David’ innkuon tawh kiciemna khat bawlin ama in, “ Topa in David’ galte sulzui taheh,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Jonathan in zong ama a itna David tungah kiciempha kia hi; azieh pen ama’ pumpi a it za-in ama a it hi."},"18":{"text":"Jonathan in ama kungah, “Zing cieng pen hladet ni ahi hi; na tona awng ding ahi ziehin nang ang kiphawh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Thai ciengin nang na peisuh ding hi; na kiphuol masahna munah pei inlen, khum sunga suongpi pangah om in."},"20":{"text":"Keima in muiciem bangin khum lam galah thaltang thum kang kap ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin naupang khat sawlin ama kungah, ‘Pei inlen, thaltangte va sui ta vawi,’ ka ci ding hi. Tua naupang kungah, ‘En vawi, thaltangte nangma kung talam galah tu hi, tung in,’ ka ci leh tua ciengin nang ang pei ding na hi hi, azieh pen Topa a hing ahi ma bangin nang dingin lungmuon huoi a, zauna om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin naupang kungah, ‘En vawi, thaltangte na gal khat lamah tu hi,’ ka ci leh peimang ta’n; azieh pen Topa in nang ang sawlmang ahi ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang le kei in i gensa thu tawh kisai-in nang le kei kikalah Topa teci ahi zing hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n David lo-ah a kiphuol hi. Hladet ni a tun ciengin an ne dingin kumpipa a to hi."},"25":{"text":"Nidanga bangin kawm gei-a a tona tung, ama’ tona-ah kumpipa a to hi. Saul’ gei-ah Abner a to laitahin Jonathan a ding hi; ahi vangin David’ mun a awng hi."},"26":{"text":"Saul in khum ni-in bangma gen lo hi; azieh pen ama in, “Ama tungah thu bang ahiei khat pieng hi ding hi; ama sienglo hi, ama a sieng lo tahtah ahi hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin a ni ni ni, hladet zaw a zing ni-in David’ tona a awng hi. Tuale Saul in a tapa Jonathan kungah, “Bang zieha Jessi’ tapa zani hile tuni hile an nehna-a ang pei lo ahei?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Jonathan in Saul dawng a, “Bethlehem-a pei dingin limtahin kei kungah David ang kingen hi;"},"29":{"text":"ama in, “Kei ei peisah in; azieh pen ka innkuonte khuo sunga biehpiehna bawl ding ahi vua, khum sunga om dingin ei thuta uhi. Tuaci’n tu-in nei hepina tawh ei peisah inlen ka sanggamte ei musah in,’ ei ci hi. Tami thu zieha kumpipa sabuoi-ah ama ang pei lo ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua bepin Jonathan tungah Saul a sin so hi. Ama kungah, “ A letat, a ledo numei’ tapa! Nang mama le na nu’ maizum nadingin Jessi’ tapa na panpina thu a thei lo ei sa na mah?"},"31":{"text":"Azieh pen leitungah Jessi’ tapa a hin laisie nangma na hi a, na kumpi gam ahi zongin kip lo ding hi. Tu-in va hlansah inlen ka kungah hing peipi in; a si valon ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonathan in a pa Saul dawng a, “Bang zieha ama kithat ding ahei? Ama’n bang bawl ahei?” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin Saul in ama khaw dingin a teipi a vih hi; tuaci’n a pa in David a tha sawm lam Jonathan in a thei ta hi."},"34":{"text":"Sabuoi panin a lungthah sengin Jonathan dingdawh a, tua pawi a ni ni-in an zong a ne ta sih hi, azieh pen a pa in David mindaisah ahi ziehin David a dapi hi."},"35":{"text":"A zing ciengin David tawh a kiciemna lo-ah naupang khat zawpi-in Jonathan a pei hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in naupang pa kungah, “Tai inlen ka thaltang kapte va tung ta vawi,” a ci hi. Naupang pa a tai lai tahin ama hlengin thaltang khat a kap hi."},"37":{"text":"Jonathan’ thaltang tuhna munah naupang pa a tun ciengin Jonathan in naupang pa hlan a, ama kungah, “Thaltang na galkhat lamah om hi lo amah?” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Jonathan in naupang pa hlan a, “Manlang in, kinaw inlen uoikai den sin,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Jonathan’ naupang pa in thaltangte khawmin a pupa kungah a pei hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin naupang pa in bangma a thei kha vateh sih a, Jonathan le David behin a silbawl a thei uhi."},"40":{"text":"Jonathan in a galhiemte naupangpa pie a, ama kungah, “Pei inlen tam teng khuopi lamah na peipi in,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Naupang pa a pei zaw lienin suongcien pang panin David dingin lei-ah bawhsuh hi. Ama thumvei bawhsuhin, tuale ama gel khatlekhat kinamin khatlekhat a kikaa uhi; David a nah kaazaw lai hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonathan in David kungah, “Ei gel Topa’ min tawh kiciemin, ‘Keima le nangma kikal le keima’ suonlehlahte le nangma’ suonlehlahte kikalah kumtawnin Topa ang om ding hi,’ i cisa ahi ziehin lungmuong tahin na pei in,” a ci hi. Ama dingin a pei hi; tuale Jonathan zong khuopi lamah a pei hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nob khuo-a siempu Ahimelech kungah David haw hi. David dawn dingin Ahimelech a citunsa-in pei-in ama kungah, “Bang zieha nangma tanga hing pei-a koima tawh hing zawh lo na hiei?” a ci hi.","title":"David le Anlum Siengtho"},"2":{"text":"David in siempu Ahimelech kungah, “Kumpipa in na khat ei sawlin ka kungah, ‘Nang kang sawlna thu le kang hil thute koima theisah sin,’ ei ci hi. Tangvalte tawh khum mun khum mun tengah kimutuona ding khat ka bawl zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin tu-in na khut sungah bang na nei ei? Anlum lum nga ahi sihle tana om popo khat ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Siempupa in David dawng a, “Tutahin anlum mawhmawh ka nei sih hi, tangvalte khu numei pana a kikoicing zo po uleh- anlum siengtho beh ka nei hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"David in siempupa dawngin, “Ka peikhiet popo ciengun numei panin ka kikoicing den uhi; khuolzin mawhmawh cieng nangawnin zong tangvalte’ neitah a siengtho hi; tuni-in a neitahte uh bang za-in siengtho kan lai ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempupa in anlum siengtho ama a pie hi; bang ding ahei cile anlum a kilah ni-in anlum a lumlai tawh a kilaih pai ding, Topa mai pana a kila Ompina Anlum simlo anlum dang om lo hi.","ref":"Mat 12:3-4; Mrk 2:25-26; Luk 6:3; Siem 24:5-9"},"7":{"text":"Khum ni-in tua tahah Topa mai-a kihen Saul’ nasemte khat a om hi; a min Doeg ahi a, Saul’ gancingte makai pa hi a, Edom-te ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"David in Ahimelech kungah, “Teipi hile namsau hile khat beh na nei sih amah? Kumpipa nasepna a kinaw seng ziehin ka teipi hile ka namsau hile kang puo man ta sih hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Siempupa in, “Elah kuoma na tha Philistia-pa Goliath’ namsau, puon tawh tunsa-in tanah siempipuon nua-ah a om hi; tua na dei leh kilah in, azieh pen tuami khat simlo tanah bangma om lo hi,” a ci hi. David in, “Tua bang adang om sih va; kei ei pie ta’n,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 17:51"},"10":{"text":"Tua ni-in David dingin Saul kung panin tai a, Gath kumpipa Achish kungah a pei hi.","title":"Gath ah David Tai"},"11":{"text":"Achish’ nasemte in ama kungah, “Tam mipa khu a gam kumpipa David hi lo amah? Khatlekhat laam kawmin la sa-in, ‘Saul in a tulin that, David in a tul sawmin that,’ ci-in a la tap pa uh hi lo amah?” a ci uhi.","ref":"1Sam 18:7; 29:5"},"12":{"text":"David in a lungsimah tam thute ciemte a, Gath kumpipa Achish a giing mama hi.","ref":"Late 56 Thulu"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in amate mai-ah a gamtat dan kheel a, a muna vuah a maw a kipang hi. A kulkotkhahte tung lah po kui gawp a, a khamul tungah a khatetui a kaisuhsah nianua hi.","ref":"Late 34 Thulu"},"14":{"text":"Achish in a nasemte kungah, “En un, tam mipa a maw ahi lam na mu uhi; tua ahile bang dinga ama ka kunga nang peipi uh ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Ka opna-ah mimaw-a kibawl dingin tam mipa nang peipi nadingun kei mimawte kisam ka hi amah? Tam mipa ka inn sunga ang lut ding ahi amah?” a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in khum mun a nuasie a, Adullam leihawm-ah a suohta hi; a sanggamte le a pa’ innkuon zosie in tua thu a zah ciengun khum mun ama kungah a peisuh uhi.","title":"Adullam ah David le A Nuazuite","ref":"Late 57 Thulu; 142 Thulu"},"2":{"text":"A lungkham poma, leiba nei poma, le a lungkim lo poma ama kungah a kituo uhi; tuale amate tungah ama makai a suoh hi. Ama tawh a omton mi zali tang bang pha hi."},"3":{"text":"Khum mun panin Moab gam Mizpah ah David a pei hi. Ama in Moab kumpipa kungah, “Pasien in keima dingin bang ei bawlpieh ding ahei ci ka thei masangin na kungah ka nu le ka pa hing omsah in, kang thum hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Moab kumpipa kungah ama gel nuasie a, mun muonhuoi sungah David a om hun sung zosie-in ama tawh a omton uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsang Gad in David kungah, “Mun muonhuoi-ah om den sin; nuasie inlen Judah gam sungah pei in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n David peikhie-in Hereth gammang lahah a pei hi."},"6":{"text":"David le a mite a opna kithei zo ci thu Saul in a za hi. A khut sungah a teipi tawi-in a kimvelah a nasemte zosie a ding vua, tuale Gibeah-a makeng singkung sang nei-ah Saul a to hi.","title":"Saul in Nob Siempute That"},"7":{"text":"Saul in a kimvela a ding a nasemte kungah, “Tu-in ngai un, no Benjamin-te aw; Jessi’ tapa in note zosie tungah lo le lengga umte hing pie-in a tul uh, a za uhin ang koi ding uh amah?"},"8":{"text":"Bang dingin na unpi-un kei ei sawmdap na hi uh ahei? Ka tapa in Jessi’ tapa tawh kipawlna a bawl ciengin koima khat beh in nei theisah sih vua, tuni-a kibawl bangin ka tapa in kei ei do-in ei na lambuh nadingin ka nasempa a hantawhna vai-ah zong koima na da vateh sih vua, ka kungah zong nei gen vawt sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Edom mi Saul’ nasemte makai Doeg in dawng a, “Nob khuo-a Ahitub’ tapa Ahimelech kungah Jessi’ tapa a haw lam ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa kungah ama adingin thu a dawhpieh a, neh le tah pie-in Philistia-pa’ namsau zong ama a pie hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 21:7-9; Late 52 Thulu"},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in Ahitub’ tapa Ahimelech le a pa’ innkuonte ahi Nob khuo-a siempu zosie hlansah hi; tuale amate a unpi-un kumpipa kungah a pei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Saul in, “Ahitub’ tapa aw, tu-in ngai in,” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Tanah om ing, ka pu aw,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Saul in ama kungah, “Bang dingin nang le Jessi’ tapa kidap kupin kei ei do na hi uh ahei? Ama in tuni-a a bawl bangin kei ei ledo-in ei na buh thei nadingin an le tui le namsau pie-in bang dingin Topa kungah ama ading thu dawhpieh na hei?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ahimelech in kumpipa dawng a, “Na nasem zosie lahah David bangin koi thuman ahei? Ama kumpipa’ tupa ahi a, sep dinga na sawlte ama in nawsep a, na inn sungah ama a kipatawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama dingin Pasien kungah thu ka dawhpieh tuni a masa pen ahi amah? Hi vawt lo hi! Kumpipa in a nasemte tungah hile ka pa’ innkuonte khatpo tungah hile mawsah sin; azieh pen na nasempa in tam thute khat popo-ah a tam hile a tawm hile bangma a thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ahimelech, nang le na pa’ innkuonte a si valon ding na hi uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama’ kiima ading a cingte kungah, “Kihei-in Topa’ siempute that un, azieh pen amate zong David tawh pangton uhi; amate in ama a tai lam a thei geguh uh kei ei ko lo uhi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Topa’ siempute do dingin kumpipa’ nasemte in a khut uh a lamto sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua bepin kumpipa in Doeg kungah, “Doeg, nangma kihei inlen siempute that in,” a ci hi. Edom mi Doeg kihei pai-in siempute a phiel hi; khum ni-in ama in saihadiel siempu puontuol a sil mi sawmgiet le nga tah that hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in siempute’ khuo ahi Nob khuo namsau tawh a vatmai hi; ama in namsau tawh numei le pasal, naupang le naungeh, a bawngtang, a laa le a tuute dongin a that sieng hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ahitub’ tapa, Ahimelech’ tapate lahah Abiathar a kici khat suohta a, David kungah a tai hi."},"21":{"text":"Abiathar in David kungah Saul in Topa’ siempute a tha lam a gen hi."},"22":{"text":"David in Abiathar kungah, “Khum ni-in Doeg khum tahah om ahi ziehin ama in Saul kungah gen valon va, ci ka thei hi. Na pa’ innkuonpi mi zosie’ sina khu keima zieh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima kungah om inlen zau sin; bangzieh ahei cile tha dinga kei ei suite in nang zong tha dinga ang sui ahi hi; Keima tawh bihtahin na om ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in amate in David kungah, “Philistia-te in Keilah simin ancilna munte a bulu uhi,” ci-in a gen uhi.","title":"David in Keilah Khuopi Hunkhie"},"2":{"text":"David in Topa dong a, “Pei-in Philistia-te ka bulu diei mah?” a ci hi. Topa in David kungah, “Pei in Philistia-te bulu inlen, Keilah hunkhie in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin David’ mite in ama kungah, “En in, Judah gam tami sunga ki-om bawn i zau lai uhi; Philistia-te sim dingin Keilah ah va kuon ta leih bangza-in i zauzaw kan lai ding vuoi?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Topa dong phakia hi. Topa in ama dawng a, “Ingheh, Keilah ah peisuh in; bang ding ahei cile na khut sungah Philistia-te kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Keilah ah David le a mite a pei vua, Philistia-te tawh kido-in a ganhonte uh a lahpieh vua, amate zong tampitah a that uhi. Tua bangin David in Keilah mite a hunkhie hi."},"6":{"text":"Keilah-a David kungah Ahimelech’ tapa Abiathar a tai ciengin a khut sungah siempipuon khat tawh peisuh hi."},"7":{"text":"Keilah ah David tung zo hi, ci thu Saul kungah kigen hi. Tuale Saul in, “Pasien in ka khut sungah ama ei pie zo ta hi; bangzieh ahei cile kulkotpite le siazawl kotgolh a nei khuopi sung khatah lutin ama le ama a kikhalu hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Saul in galsim ding, Keilah-a kuonsuh ding, David le a mite imtawm dingin mi zosie a thuta hi."},"9":{"text":"Saul in ama tungah sietna bawl ding a sawm lamtah David in a thei ciengin ama in siempu Abiathar kungah, “Na siempipuon tanah hing peipi in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"David in, “Israel Pasien, Topa aw, keima ziehin khuopi a susie dingin Keilah ah Saul ang kuon hi, ci thu na nasempa in za zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale tu-in na nasempa’ zah bangin Saul ang kuonsuh ding amah? Israel’ Pasien, Topa aw, na nasempa ei gen in, kang thum hi,” a ci hi. Topa in ama kungah, “Ama ang kuonsuh ding ma ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in, “Keilah mite in Saul’ khut sungah kei le ka mite ei ap ding uh amah?” a ci hi. Topa in, “Ang ap ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bepin David le a mite zaguh tang khat dingdawhin Keilah a nuasie uhi; a pei theina popo vuah a pei uhi. Keilah panin David a suotahna thu Saul kungah a kigen ciengin ama in a vai a khawl phot hi."},"14":{"text":"Ziph Senel muoltung gam sung, senel gam sung mun muonhuoi-ah David a om hi. Nisielin Saul in ama sui a, ahi vangin Topa! in ama’ khut sungah David pie lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Saul in tha dinga a sui kawi a thei ciengin Ziph Senel gam Horesh ah David a om hi.","title":"Senel Gamah David in Saul Pelh"},"16":{"text":"Horesh khuo-a om David kunga haw dingin Saul’ tapa Jonathan a kuon hi; ama in Topa tungtawnin khum munah a khutte a hatsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in David kungah, “Zau malmal sin; azieh pen ka pa Saul’ khut in nang ang mu sih ding hi; nang pen Israel tungah kumpi na hi ding a, kei nang zom ka hi ding hi; ka pa Saul in zong tam thu thei hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa mai-ah a ni gelin thuciemna a bawl uhi; Horesh ah David om lai a, Jonathan a inn ah a pei hi.","ref":"1Sam 18:3"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gibeah-a Saul kungah Ziph-te peito-in ama kungah, “Jeshimon leitaw lam Hachilah muoltunga om Horesh mun muonhuoite sung kote lahah David kiphuol hi.","ref":"Late 54 Thulu"},"20":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, tu-in nang peisuh nuom hunin hing peisuh in; kote bawl ding ahile na khut sungah ama kang pieh ding uh ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Kei tungah lainatna nang nei ziehun Topa in thupha hing buoh ta uheh!"},"22":{"text":"Va pei inlen va kiciensah lai ta’n; ama hei sung mun liena om hi a, tuale khum sungah koi in ama mu ahei, ci va thei ta’n; bangzieh ahei cile ama pen a pilkhel mama ahi hi, ci-in ka kungah ei kigen hi."},"23":{"text":"A kimvel en kawikawi-in a kibuhna muntah hing thei unlen, thu kicien tawh ka kungah hing peikia un. Tua ciengin noma tawh kang pei ding hi; gam sungah ama a op leh Judah a tul tampite lah panin ka longdawh teitei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate a ding vua, Ziph-a pei dingin Saul masangah a na mapei uhi. Jeshimon leitaw lam Arabah gam sung Maon senel gamah David le a mite a om uhi."},"25":{"text":"Saul le a mite pei-in ama a sui uhi. A kisui lam David kunga a kigen ciengin ama suongpi-ah peisuhin Maon senel gamah a om hi. Saul in tua thu a zah bepin Maon senel gam dongah David a del hi."},"26":{"text":"Muol pang khatah Saul pei a, David le a mite muol pang lang khatah a pei uhi. Saul le a mite in David le a mite man dingin a nai semsem ciengun, Saul kung panin a suotah thei nadingin David a nawtai mama hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul kungah kamtai khat tungin ama in, “Kinaw inlen hing pei in. Bangzieh ahei cile Philistia-te in gam sung ei sim uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in David a nuadel khawl a, Philistia-te sim dingin a kuon hi; tua ahi ziehin khum mun pen Suotahna Suongpi kici hi"},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum mun panin David peito-in En-gedi mun muonhuoite sungah a teng hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul in Philistia-te a nuadelna panin a kilekia ciengin ama kungah, “En-gedi senel gamah David om hi,” ci-in kigen hi.","title":"David in Saul’ Nuntahna Hinkhawi"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in Israel zosie sung panin a kituomteel pasal tul thum zawpi-in Gamkel Suongpi lamah David le a mite sui dingin a kuon hi."},"3":{"text":"Lam gei-a tuubuhte gei-ah ama pei a, khum tahah leihawm khat a om hi; tuale awnghaw dingin Saul tua sungah a lut hi. Tua leihawm sungtawng penah David le a mite na to uhi.","ref":"Late 57 Thulu; 142 Thulu"},"4":{"text":"David’ mite in ama kungah, “ Topa in, ‘Na khut sungah na galpa kang pie ding a, pha na sah bangin ama tungah na bawl ding hi,’ ei ci ni khu tuni ahi ta hi,” a ci uhi. Tua ciengin David pei-in Saul’ puontuol tep a dap tanpieh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin a puontuol tep a tansan ziehin David a lung a nuom sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a mite kungah, “ Topa’ sathau nu pa ahi ka Topa tungah tam banga ka khut hlan khah ding pen Topa in ei kham hi; bang ding ahei cile ama pen Topa’ sathau nu pa ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 26:11"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in a mite nahpi tahin phawhsie a, Saul a do ding uh a phal sih hi. Tua ciengin Saul tho-in leihawm nuasie a, a pei nading lampi-ah a pei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin David zong tho-in leihawm pan pusuohin Saul a nua hlat a, “Ka pu kumpipa!” a ci hi. Saul kinua hei-in a et ciengin David in a mai tuol ngatin khupbawhin zatahna a pie hi."},"9":{"text":"David in Saul kungah, “Bang ding a, ‘David in na siet nading sui hi,’ a ci mite’ thugen ngai na hi ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Tuni mama-in Topa in nang leihawm sung, ka khut sungah ei pieh lam na mit-in na mu zo ta hi; tuale mi pawlkhat in nang a that dingin ei tawh vua, ahi vangin ken nang kang hinkhawi hi. Keima in, ‘Ka pu tungah ka khut ka hlang sih ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile ama pen Topa’ sathau nu pa ahi hi,’ ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pa aw, ka khut sunga na puontuol tep khu en vawi; azieh pen kei khutah khielna ahi a, kumpi langpanna ahi zongin a op lona, na puontuol tep tansanin nangma kang tha lona thu tawh a kicienin na thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Nang in kei tha dingin nei sui vangin nang tungah kei ka khiel sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in nang le kei kikalah thu khen taheh! Topa in na tungah ka phu la taheh; ahi vangin keima in nang tungah ka khut ka hlang sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Khanglui paunah khatah, ‘Mi gilote panin gitlona hing pieng,’ a ci bang ahi hi; ahi vangin nang tungah ka khut ka hlang sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel kumpipi koi do dinga hing kuon na hei? A koi pen nuadel na hei? Ui si khat amah? Uihih khat ahiei?","ref":"1Sam 26:20"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin thukhenpa khu Topa hi hinlen, ama in nang le kei kikalah thu khen taheh. Ama in tam thu van hinlen ka vai ei panpi-in nang langkhatah ka dihna hing talang taheh,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"David in Saul kungah tam thu teng a gen zaw ciengin Saul in, “Tami nang awsuo amah, ka tapa David?” a ci hi. Saul awngin a kap hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in David kungah, “Kei sangin nang na thumanzaw hi; azieh pen keima in nang tungah a sie ka bawl laitahin nang in kei tungah a pha tawh nei thuh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in na khut sungah ei koih laitahin nang in kei ei that loin nei limbawlna tuni-in nei tel gen zo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang zieh ahei cile koi in a galpa mu-in bihtahin peisah ding ahei? Tuaci’n tuni-in kei tungah nei bawlna ziehin Topa in sil hoi tawh thaman hing pie taheh."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in nang kumpi a suoh valon ding na hi, ci ka thei hi. Na khut sungah Israel kumpi gam kip ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ziehin keima nua-a ka suon ka hlahte thatgam loin ka pa’ innkuon panin ka min na suhmang lo nadingin Topa’ min tawh ka kungah hing kiciem in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul tungah David a kiciem hi. Tua ciengin Saul a inn ah a pei hi; ahi vangin mun muonhuoi-ah David le a mite a peito uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Samuel a si hi; tuale Israel zosie a kikhawm vua, ama ziehin kapin mau-in a om uhi. Amate in Ramah-a a inn ah ama a vui uhi. Tua ciengin David tho-in Paran senel gamah a peisuh hi.","title":"Samuel Sina"},"2":{"text":"Maon ah mi khat om a, a nasepna pen Carmel ah a om hi. Tua mipa hau mama hi; ama in tuu tulthum le keel tulkhat nei hi. Carmel ah ama in tuumul a met hi.","title":"David le Nabal’ Zinu"},"3":{"text":"Tua mipa’ min Nabal ahi a, a zinu’ min Abigail ahi hi. Tua numei in tei le melhoi thuo a, ahi vangin a pasal pen omdan thei lo le a gamtatsie khat ahi hi; ama pen Caleb-te khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nabal in tuumul heu hi, ci thu David in senel gamah a za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in tangval sawm sawl a, tuale David in tua tangvalte kungah, “Carmel ah va peito ta un, tuale Nabal kungah va haw ta ulen ka min tawh ama va hopi ta un."},"6":{"text":"Tam bangin ama na hopi ding uhi: ‘Nang tungah nopna om taheh, na innkuonpite tungah nopna om taheh, na neisa zosie tungah zong nopna om taheh."},"7":{"text":"Nang in tuumul heu mi na nei hi, ci thu ka na za hi; ko kungah na tuucingte om a, amate bangma ka law sih uhi, amate in Carmel-a a op sung tengun bangma khat beh a mansuo sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na tangvalte uh dong locin amate in nang kungah ang gen ding uhi. Tua ahi ziehin ka tangvalte in maipha musah in; azieh pen pawi ni-a hing tung ka hi uhi. Na khut sunga na nei bang bang na tapa David le na nasemte tungah ei pie ta’n, kang thum hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tangvalte a tun ciengun David’ min tawh tam thu zosie Nabal kungah a gen uhi; tua ciengin amate in a ngah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Nabal in David’ nasemte dawng a, “David koi ahiei? Jessi’ tapa koi ahiei? Tulai-in a pute kung pana a taimang nasem tampi om hi."},"11":{"text":"Hei pana hing puoh ci ka thei lote tungah ka anlum le ka tui le ka tuumul heute dinga ka gaw ka sate la-in pie ding ka hi amah?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n David’ tangvalte kilekia-in a tun ciengun tam thu zosie ama kungah a gen uhi."},"13":{"text":"David in a mite kungah, “Mi zosie in na namsau uh kuo ciet un!” a ci hi. Tuale mi zosie in a namsau a kuo ciet uhi; David in zong a namsau a kuo hi; tuale mi zali tang khat in David a zui vua, van ngahin mi za ni a om uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle tangval khat in Nabal’ zinu Abigail kungah thu gen a, “Ka pupa uh hopi dingin David in senel gam panin kamtai a sawl hi; tuale ama in amate a na hosie gawp hi."},"15":{"text":"Hizongle kote tungah tua mite a hoi mama vua, sietna zong ka thuoh sih vua, amate tawh ka opton sung tengun lolai-ah zong bangma zamtawng ka mansuo sih uhi;"},"16":{"text":"amate tawh tuu cinga ka opton sungun sun le zanin pal bangin ei dal uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in tam thu thei inlen, na bawl ding kingaituo in; azieh pen ama khansie-in koima’n hopi thei lo ahi ziehin ka pu ule a innkuon zosie tungah sietna tunsah ding kingaituo zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abigail kinaw mama-in anlum lum zani le lenggazu savun tuithawl dim ni, tuu a minsa nga, ankan law nga, a kiphogaw lengga bawh zakhat, le theiga tawh kibawl moh zani la-in laa tungah tua teng guong a,"},"19":{"text":"tuale a nasemte kungah, “Na pei masa un; na nua uh kang zui ding hi,” a ci hi. Hizongle ama in a pasal Nabal kungah gen lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama nu laa tungah tuongin muol pang a gei lai tahin, ama lamah David le a mite a pei uhi; tuale ama nu in amate na dawn hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in David in, “Tam mipa’ neisa zosie bangma khat beh a pelem lo nadingin senel gama ka na cinpieh pen a mawhna suoh hi; ama in ka nasep hoite a sie tawh ei thuh hi."},"22":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin a nei zosie lahah pasal khat nangawn ka hinkhawi tah ma leh Pasien in keima David ei dawm sih taheh,” a na ci zo ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Abigail in David a mu ciengin nawtai-in a laa tung pan kumsuhin David mai-ah pua-in tuolah a bawhsuh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama khupbawhin ama kungah, “Ka pu aw, tua khielna keima tung behah hing tu taheh; na nasemnu in na bilkawmah thu ei gensah inlen, na nasemnu’ thugen ei ngaipieh in, ci-in kang thum hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka pu in tam mi khansie Nabal thupi ngaisut malmal sin; azieh pen a min banga ama a gamta ahi lel bo hi; a min Nabal ahi a, ama mimaw ahi bo hi; ahi vangin ka pu in nang sawl tangvalte keima na nasemnu in ka na mukha sih hi."},"26":{"text":"“Tua ahi ciengin tu-in ka pu aw, Topa hingin nang zong na hin ma bangin, sisan suosahna tawh na khiel nading le na khut tawh phu na lah nading panin Topa in ang hloh bangin, tu-in na galte le ka pupa tunga siet nading a suite Nabal bang ta uheh."},"27":{"text":"Tu-in na nasemnu in ka pupa kang puoh tami letsong pen ka pupa nuazui tangvalte ei piesah in."},"28":{"text":"Na nasempa’ gamtat khielna ei maisah in, kang thum hi; azieh pen ka pu in Topa’ galte na do ziehin Topa’ in ka pu innkuon hing kipsah tahtah ding a, na hin laisie-in nang sungah sietna a kimu sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Mi khatpo in tha dinga ang del leh Topa na Pasien in a hing mite a humbihna sungah ka pu’ hinna a humbih ding hi; ahi vangin ama in saili kap bangin na galte hinna a kapmang ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in nang tawh kisai-a thu hoi a gensa zosie tawh kizui-in, Israel tungah kumpi dingin nang ang koi zaw ciengin,"},"31":{"text":"thu om lopi-in sisan luonsahna zieh ahi a, ahi sihle ama le ama a kihutdamna ziehin ahi zongin, ka pu in lungsim gimna ding thu ahi a, lungsim natna ding thu ahi zongin na nei sih ding hi. Topa in ka pupa ang limbawl ciengin na nasem nu ei phawh bo in,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"David in Abigail kungah, “Tuni-in kei ei vaidot dinga nang ang sawl Israel’ Pasien Topa in thupha nga taheh!"},"33":{"text":"Tuni-in mithana le keima’ khut tawh phulah nading panin kei ei kem nangma le na ngaisut siemna in thupha nga taheh!"},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma ang liemsah nading panin ei kham Israel’ Pasien Topa a hin tahtah ma bangin, kei ei dawn dingin a mallangin ang pei lo khat hi poma lacin, zing ciengin Nabal’ pasal khat zong ka hinkhawi vawt sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in tua nu tung panin a puohte a sang hi; ama in tua nu kungah, “Na inn ah lungnuomin na peito in; en in, keima in na thu ka ngai zo a, na ngetnate kang pie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Nabal kungah Abigail tung a, ama in a inn ah kumpipa pawi tawh a kibang khat a na bawl hi. Zu kham seng ahi ziehin Nabal a lung a nuom mama hi; tuaci’n tua nu in ama kungah zingmawng khuova masangsie-in bangma a gen sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Zingmawng cieng, Nabal a zukham a ven ciengin a zi in ama kungah tam thu teng a gen hi; tuale a lungtang si-in ama suongtum bang hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua zaw ni sawm bang ciengin Topa in Nabal vat a, tuale ama a si hi."},"39":{"text":"David in Nabal a si thu a zah ciengin ama in, “Ka tungah Nabal’ ei zakona ei thuhpiehin sietna panin a nasempa ei kem Topa in thupha nga taheh; Topa in Nabal’ gitlona amama a lukhuhsah kia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin David in mi sawlin a zi dingin Abigail a helsah hi."},"40":{"text":"Carmel-a Abigail kungah David’ nasemte a tun ciengun ama kungah, “David in ama’ zi dinga a la dingin na kungah ko ei sawl hi,” a ci uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ama dingin a mai lei lam nga-in kunsuh a, “Na nasemnu uh pen ka pupa nasemte’ keng silpieh ding sila ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Abigail naw dinin laa tungah a tuong hi; a nasem numei nga in ama a kem hi. Ama nu in David’ nasemte nua zui-in David’ zi-in a om hi."},"43":{"text":"David in Jezreel-a Ahinoam zong na kinunpi zo hi; a ni gelin ama’ zi a suoh hi."},"44":{"text":"Saul in a tanu Michal, David’ zi pen Gallim-a Laish’ tapa Palti tawh na kinungsah zo hi.","ref":"2Sam 3:14-16"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ziph-te Gibeah-a Saul kungah a pei vua, “Jeshimon tawh kigalsai Hachilah muol tungah David kiphuol hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"David in Saul Nivei Hinkhawi","ref":"Late 54 Thulu; Late 54 Thulu"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul tho a, a kiteel Israel mi tulthum tawh David sui dingin Ziph senel gamah a kuonsuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Saul in Jeshimon tawh kigalsai, lampi gei-a om Hachilah muol tungah giephuol a sat hi. Ahi vangin senel gamah David a omlai hi. Saul in ama a sulzui lam a thei ciengin"},"4":{"text":"David in thukante sawl a, Saul a tun tahtah lam a thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin David dingin Saul’ giephuol satna munah a pei hi; tuale David in Saul a galkapmangpa Abner tawh a lupna mun a mu hi. Giephuol sungah Saul lumin a kimvelah galkapte in giephuol a sat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Hit-te Ahimelech le Joab’ sanggampa Zeruiah’ tapa Abishai kungah, “Saul’ giephuolah keima tawh a va kuonsuh ding koi na hi vuoi?” a ci hi. Abishai in, “Kei nang tawh hing kuonsuh vang,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n zanin galkapte kungah David le Abishai a pei uhi; khum sunga giephuolah Saul na kimu a, a khawhlung leilahah a teipi na kiphut hi; tuale ama kimvelah Abner le a galkapte a lum uhi."},"8":{"text":"Abishai in David kungah, “Tuni-in Pasien in na khut sungah na galpa ang pie zo ta hi; tua ziehin tu-in teipi-in khatvei beh hing khaw vangin lei tawh hing kiltha vang; ni vei khaw ding kisam lo hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin David in Abishai kungah, “Ama that sin; bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ sathau nupa tungah a khut hlang poma khielna panin a peng ding na sa amah?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"David in, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin, Topa in ama a satlia ding hi; ahi si leh zong a si hun ang tung ding hi; ahi sihle galphuolah va kuonsuhin a si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ sathau nu pa tungah ka khut ka hlan ding Topa in ei khaam hi; hinanle tu-in a khawhlung a teipi le tuithawl la inlen pei vai,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 24:6"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in Saul’ khawhlunga teipi le tuithawl la-in a pei uhi. Amate a unpi-un a kimut sieng ziehun koima in mu lo a, koima in zong a thei sih a, koima khat zong a khanglo sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile ama tungah Topa in a kimut uh a suohsah mama hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin David galkhatah galkai a, amate kikal saupi kihalin muol dawnah a ding hi."},"14":{"text":"David in galkapte le Ner’ tapa Abner hlan a, “Abner! Ei dawng lo ding na mah?” a ci hi. Tua bepin Abner in dawngin, “Kumpipa hlan nang koi na hiei?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"David in Abner kungah, “Nang pasal hi lo na mah? Israel sungah nang tawh kibang koi om ahei? Tua ahile bang dinga na pu kumpipa cing lo na hei? Bangzieh ahei cile na pu kumpipa susie dingin mi khat ang pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam banga na gamtat pen a hoi vawt sih hi. Topa a hing ahi ma bangin a si dinga kilawm na hi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ sathau nu pa ahi na pupa na vil sih hi. Tu-in en in, kumpipa’ teipi le a khawhlunga tuithawl hei-ah a om ei?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Saul in David’ awsuo a thei a, “Ka tapa David, tami nang aw amah?” a ci hi. David in, “Ka pupa kumpipa aw, tami keima’ awsuo ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in genbe a, “Bang dingin ka pupa in a nasempa a leisui ahei? Ke’n bang ka bawl ahei? Ka tungah bang khielna om ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in ka pu kumpipa in a nasempa’ thugente za in. Keima ei do dinga ang hansuo pen Topa ahile ama in ka biehna ei sang taheh; ahi vangin mihingte ahile, Topa mai-ah samsiet thuoh uheh. Azieh pen amate in Topa’ gouluo ka tanhna panin ei notmang vua, ‘Pei inlen, pasien dangte’ na va sem in,’ ei ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Topa opna panin a kigamla leitang tungah ka sisan kiesah sin; azieh pen muol dawnah vala man dinga mi a kuon bangin thomi bang bep lel kei ei that dingin Israel kumpipa nang kuon hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in, “Ka gamta khiel ta hi; ka ta David aw, hing peikia ta’n, bangzieh ahei cile nangma’ muna-ah ka hinna manpha mama ahi ziehin nang kang bawlsie ngai nawn sih ding hi; kei mimaw ka hi a, khielna lienpi ka bawlkha ta hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"David in dawng a, “Tanah na teipi om hi, kumpipa! Tangvalte khat hing peisah inlen hing lasah in."},"23":{"text":"Topa in mi zosie a dihna le a citahna ziehin thaman a pie hi; bangzieh ahei cile tuni-in Topa in ka khut sungah nangma ei pie a, hinanle Topa’ sathau nu pa tungah ka khut ka hlang sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuni-in ka mitmu-in na hinna a manphat ma bangin keima’ hinna zong Topa’ mitmu-in manpha hinlen gimna zosie panin Topa in nang hing hunkhie taheh,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in David kungah, “Thupha nga ta in, ka tapa David! Nangma in na tampi na sem ding a, tuate na muolsuo ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n David ama’ lampi-ah pei a, Saul zong ama’ opna-ah a kilekia hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in a lungsim sungah, “Ni khat ni ciengin Saul’ khutlumin ka si thei kha ding hi; Philistia-te gama tai ding sangin kei adingin a hoizaw bangma om lo hi; tua hile Israel gamgi huom sunga Saul in ei sui den pen ang lungkie ding a, ama’ khut sung panin ka suohta ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"David in Gath Kumpipa Achish’ Na Seppieh"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n David ding a, ama kunga om pasal zaguh tawh Gath kumpipa, Maok’ tapa Achish kungah a pei hi."},"3":{"text":"David, ama le a galkapte tawh, pasal teng zosie a innkuonpite tawh, David, a zi tegel Jezreel-a Ahinoam le Carmel-a Nabal’ zi meigongnu Abigail tawh, Gath-a Achish tawh a tengton hi."},"4":{"text":"Gath ah David tai zo hi, ci Saul kungah a kigen ciengin ama in David sui nawn lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Achish kungah, “Na mitmu-in maipha ka nga leh ka ten thei nading gam sung khuopi khatah mun ei pie in; bang dingin na nasempa nang tawh kumpi khuopi sungah tengton ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni-in Achish in ama tungah Ziklag khuo a pie hi; tua ahi ziehin tua khuo pen tuni dongin Judah kumpite-a’ ahi ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Philistia-te gam sungah David a ten hun kum khat le hla li sung ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in David le a mite kuonto-in Geshur-te, Girzi-te, le Amalek-te a sim uhi; azieh ahile tam mite pen Telam -a pan, Shur lampi panin Egypt gam dongin a na tengsate ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"David in khum gam simin pasal hile numei hile khat beh a hinkhawi sih hi. Ahi vangin tuute, bawngte, laate, kalaohte, le puonsilte la-in Achish kungah a peikia hi."},"10":{"text":"Achish in, “Tuni koi va sim ta na hiei?” ci-in a dawh ciengin David in, “Judah-te’ Negeb gam,” ahi sihle, “Jerahmeel-te’ Negeb gam,” ahi sihle, “Ken-te’ Negeb gam,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"David in, “Amate in i thu teng hing gen va-un, ‘David in tam bangin bawl hi,’ ci kha va uh,” ci-in a ngaisut ziehin David in Gath-a thu tut thei ding popo numei hile pasal hile khat zong a hinkhawi sih hi. Tua khu Philistia-te’ gam sungah a ten hun sung tenga ama’ gamtat zie ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Achish in David muong a, “Ama mi Israel-te a si muda thei nadingin ama le ama kibawl zo hi; tua ahi ziehin ama ka nasem ahi zing ding hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Philistia-te in Israel do dingin a galkapte a khawm uhi. Achish in David kungah, “Nangma le na mite, galkapte sungah keima tawh a kuonton ding na hi lam kithei in,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"David in Achish kungah, “Hoi mama hi, na nasempa in bang bawl thei ahei ci na thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Achish in David kungah, “Hoi mama hi, khan tawntungin kei ei cingpa-in kang koi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Samuel si zo a, ama ziehin Israel zosie a kap vua, ama’ khuopi Ramah ah ama a vui uhi. Saul in a gam sung panin dawilawm neite le bumtawite a notmang hi.","title":"Saul in Dawilawm Neite Thudong (Thkna 18:9-14)","ref":"Siem 20:27; Thkna 18:10-11; 1Sam 25:1"},"4":{"text":"Philistia-te a kikhawm vua, Shunem ah pei-in giephuol a sat uhi. Saul in zong Israel zosie khawm a, Gilboa ah giephuol a sat uhi."},"5":{"text":"Saul in Philistia galkapte a mu ciengin zau-in a lungsim a linglawng hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in Topa thu a dawh ciengin Topa in a mang tawh hile Urim tawh hile kamsangte tawh hile dawng lo hi.","ref":"Gam 27:21"},"7":{"text":"Tua bepin Saul in a nasemte kungah, “Ama kungah pei-in thu ka dawh thei nadingin dawilawm nei numei khat ei va suipieh ta un,” a ci hi. A nasemte in, “Endor ah dawilawm nei khat a om hi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul in a mel selin puon dang sil a, ama le mi ni tawh khum mun a zuon uhi. Zanin amate kungah numei khat a pei hi. Ama in, “A sisa hlate khat tung panin thu ei dawhpieh inlen, nang kungah a min kang law popo ei hlatto pieh in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua numei in ama kungah, “Saul in a gam sung panin dawilawm neite le bumtawite a hepkhietna thu na thei giagua ahi hi. Tua hi napi bang dinga ka si nading thang ei sie na hei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle ama kungah Saul kiciem a, Topa a hing ahi ma bangin tam thu ziehin na tungah gimna ang tung vawt sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin numei in, “Koi pen kang hlatpieh diei?” a ci leh ama in, “Samuel ei hlatpieh in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Numei in Samuel a mu ciengin pengzah pai a, tuale numei in Saul kungah, “Bang dinga nei sol ahiei? Nang Saul na hi vele!” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama kungah, “Zau sin, bang ahiei na mu?” a ci hi. Numei in Saul kungah, “Lei pana ang pusuoh hlagau khat ka mu hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “A mel puoh dan bang a ci ei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Puvuoi khat ang peito hi; ama in puontuolpi khat sil hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Samuel ahi lam Saul in thei a, a mai tuolah kunin khupbawhin zatahna a pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Samuel in Saul kungah, “Bang dinga nei hlatto kia-a nei hici buoisah ahei?” a ci hi. Saul in dawng a, “Ka lung a kham mama hi, bangzieh ahei cile Philistia-te in ei simin ka kung panin Pasien a kihemdawh a, kamsangte tawh hile mangte tawh hile ei dawng nawn lo hi; tuaci’n bang bawl ding ka hei, ci ei hil dinga kang hlat ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Samuel in, “ Topa in nang ang taisan a, ama na gal suoh zo napi bang dinga kei thu nei dawh lai ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei tung tawna ang gensa bangin na tunga ang sem ahi hi; azieh pen Topa in na khut sung panin kumpi gam balkehin na vengpa David pie zo hi.","ref":"1Sam 15:28"},"18":{"text":"Topa’ thu mang loin Amalek-te tunga ama’ lungthah mama na tawh kizui-in sem lo na hi ziehin tuni-in Topa in nang tunga tam bang ang sep ahi hi.","ref":"1Sam 15:3-9"},"19":{"text":"Tham loin Topa in Philistia-te khut sungah nang tawh Israel ang pieton ding hi; tuale zing ciengin kei tawh nang le na tapate i om ton ding uhi. Topa in Philistia-te’ khut sungah Israel galkapte a pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Samuel thugen teng ziehin zausi-in thakhatthu-in tuolah Saul a tawnpua pai hi; sun khuo zan khuo bangma a neh lo ziehin a tha a zawm hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul kungah tua numei pei a, ama a zau seng lam a mu ciengin ama kungah, “Na nasemnu in na thu ka ngai zo hi; ka luong khamin keima kunga nang gen bangin ka bawl zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in nang in zong na nasemnu’ thu ei ngai in; na mai-ah anlum halkhat ei luisah in. Na lampi-ah na pei ciengin na thahat nadingin ne in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in niel a, “Ka ne sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin tua numei tawh kithuo-in a nasemte in a ci teitei uhi; tua bepin ama in a thu uh a mang hi. Tuaci’n lei panin ama tho-in lupna tungah a to hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in tua numei in a inn ah bawngno thau khat nei a, mallang tahin go-in annel la-in meh a, tol saw lo anlum a em hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua nu in Saul le a nasemte mai-ah lui a, tuale amate in a ne uhi. Tua ciengin khum zanin amate dingin a peikhie uhi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Philistia-te in a galkap zosie uh Aphek ah a khawmtuo vua, Israel-te in Jezreel-a tuikhuh gei-ah giephuol a sat uhi.","title":"Philistia-te in David Nuol"},"2":{"text":"Philistia uliente a tul tul, a za za-in a kizawt laitahun David le a mite zong Achish tawh a nua lamah a pei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Philistia galkapmangte in, “Tami Hebrew-te tam muna bang bawl ahi uh ahei?” a ci uhi. Achish in Philistia galkapmangte kungah, “Tampa, ni tampi le kum tampi keima tawh a omton Israel kumpi Saul’ nasempa David hi lo amah? Ka kunga ang tai-a kipan tuni cieng dongin ama tungah khielna ka mu sih hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle ama tungah Philistia galkapmangte a lungthah uhi; tuale Philistia galkapmangte in, “Na koina munah a kilekia thei nadingin tua mipa peisahkia in; gal kidona sungah eite tawh ama a kuonton sih ding hi, tua ahi sihle gal kidona sungah i langin ang pangkha ding hi. Azieh pen tam mipa in a pupa tawh kilemna bangci bawl thei ding ahei? Tam sunga om mite’ lutangte tawh a bawl ding hi lo amah?"},"5":{"text":"Tampa khu, ‘Saul in a tulin that, David in a tul sawmin that,’ ci-a amate khatlekhat a lam kawmun la a tap pa uh David hi lo amah?” a ci uhi.","ref":"1Sam 18:7; 21:11"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Achish in David hlanin ama kungah, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin nang na thuman a, gal sungah kei tawh na kuonton na tunton ding man ka sa hi; azieh pen keima kunga nang tun ni-a kipan tuni dongin na tungah khielna bangma ka mu sih hi. Hinanle uliente in nang ang dei sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in kilekia in; hlamuong tahin pei ta’n; Philistia uliente lung himaw nading bangma bawl da mai in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"David in Achish kungah, “Bang ahiei ka bawl? Ka pu kumpipa’ galte do-in ka pei thei lo nadingin na nasem dinga kang lut ni-a kipan tuni dongin na nasempa tungah bang mu na hei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Achish in David dawngkia a, “Keima’ muna-ah nang pen Pasien’ vantungmi khat bangin kaw baanglo na hina thu ka thei hi; hinanle Philistia galkapmangte in, ‘Eihaw tawh gal kidona sungah ama ang kuonto sih ding hi,’ a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin tu-in nang zawpi na pupa’ nasemte tawh zingmawngin thobai unlen, note adinga ka koisa munah pei un,” a ci hi. Ka mai-ah hoitahin sem zo na hi ziehin, thu hoi lo kigente tawh kisai-in lung himawna-in nei sin. Zingmawng a kipan thobai unlen, khuova behin kihem pai ta un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Philistia gama kilekia dingin a mite tawh David zingmawng phalvahin dingkhie a, hinanle Jezreel-ah Philistia-te a peito uhi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in a ni thum ni-in Ziglak ah David le a mite a tun ciengun, Amalek-te in Negeb le Ziklag sim zo uhi. Amate in Ziklag simin mei tawh a haltum vua,","title":"David in Ziklag Kisuhsietna Phula"},"2":{"text":"numeite le a sunga om mi zosie , a lien a neu-in a man uhi; amate khat zong a that sih vua, ahi vangin a peina vuah amate a zawpi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Khuopi sungah David le a mite a tun ciengun mei tawh tua khuopi a kihaltum a mu vua, a zite ule a tanu a tapate uh salin a kimat siengna thu a thei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin a thazawt dongun David le a zawpi mite awngin kap uhi."},"5":{"text":"David’ zi tegel, Jezreel-a Ahinoam le Carmel-a Nabal’ zi meigongnu Abigail zong salin kiman hi.","ref":"1Sam 25:42-43"},"6":{"text":"David nahpi-in a lungkham hi; azieh pen mi zosie in a tanute ule a tapate uh ziehin a lungsim uh kisie a, suong tawh selia ding a gen uhi. Ahi vangin Topa a Pasien in David a thakhausah hi."},"7":{"text":"David in Ahimelech’ tapa siempu Abiathar kungah, “Siempupuon hing peipi in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Abiathar in David kungah siempipuon a peipi hi.","ref":"1Sam 22:20-23"},"8":{"text":"David in zong Topa thu dong a, “Tam mihonte ka del diei mah? Amate ka pha zo na diei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Del in; bangzieh ahei cile amate na nuaphah valon ding a, na hunkhie zo tahtah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n David le a zawpi galkap zaguh tawh kuonin a kinuasie mite’ giena Besor Lui-ah a tung uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle David in a del peisuoh hi; ama le mi zali ahi uhi; Besor Lui galkai dinga a gim seng mi zani a kinuasie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in gamlahah Egypt-te khat mu-in David kungah a peipi uhi. Amate in ama an a pie vua, ama in an ne-in dawn ding tui zong a pie uhi;"},"12":{"text":"amate in theiga tawh a kibawl moh themkhat le lengga kiphogaw bawh ni zong a pie uhi. Ama in a neh zaw ciengin a tha a dimkia hi; azieh pen ni thum le zan thum sung an le tui ciem lo ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in ama kungah, “Nang koite na hiei? Nang hei pan na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Amalek-te khat’ nasem ka hi a, Egypt tangval khat ka hi hi. Tu masang ni thum lai-in ka cina ahi ziehin ka pupa in ei nuasie hi."},"14":{"text":"Kote in zong Chereth-te’ Negeb gam, Judah-te’ gam le Caleb-te’ gam ka sim uhi; tuale Ziklag mei tawh ka hal uhi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “Tam galsim pawl kungah nei zawpisuh diei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Kei nei tha lo nading ahi a, ka pupa’ khut sunga nei ap lo nading ahi zongin Pasien’ minin kei tungah hing kiciem in. Tua hile amate kungah kang zawpisuh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a zawpisuh ciengin Philistia-te gam le Judah gam pana a galvan lahte uh a tam seng ziehin mun zosie-ah kithethangin an ne tui dawnin lamin a na om uhi."},"17":{"text":"David in zingmawng phalvah panin a zingni nitah dongin sim a, kalaoh tung tuonga a taimang tangval zali simlo amate lahah khat zong suohta lo hi."},"18":{"text":"David in Amalek-te in a lahsa van zosie lahpiehkia a, a zi tegel zong hunkhie hi."},"19":{"text":"A lien a neu, tanu tapate hile galvan kilate ahi sihle a kitomgam na khat popo hile khat zong pelam lo hi; David in a unpi-in a peipikia hi."},"20":{"text":"David in ganhing dangte masanga kihawi bawnghon, keelhon le ganhon zosie zong man sieng hi; mite in, “Tami khu David’ galvan lahte ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin a gim seng ziehun David nua a zui zo lo, Besor Lui-ah a kinuasie mi zanite kungah David a tung hi. David le a zawpi mite dawn dingin amate a kuon vua, David in mite kung a tun ciengin amate a hopi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin David tawh a zawhton pasalte lahah migilo le kimanna a nei lo mi zosie in, “Eite tawh hing peisuoh lo uh ahi ziein, pasal khat ciet in a zite le a tate zawpi-in a peipi ding ci simlo i lahpieh uh vante bangma khat zong amate i pie sih ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin David in, “Sanggamte aw, Topa in ei piehsa nate tua bangin na bawl sih ding uhi; ama in eite ei hinkhawi a, i khut sung vuah ei bulu dinga ang kuon mihonte ei pie zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tami thu-ah koi in na thugen uh ang mang mawh ding ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile galkuonpa’ tanh za ma, phuol ngahpa in zong tang ding hi; amate in a kibangin a tang ciet ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Khum ni-a kipanin tuni dongin ama in Israel adingin thukham le biehna ngaina kipin a bawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Ziklag ah David a tun ciengin ama in a na lahte pawlkhat Judah upa a guolte kungah hlah a, “ Topa’ galvan kilate sung pan noma dinga letsong kang puoh ahi hi,” a ci hi;"},"27":{"text":"tua i van teng pen Bethel-te ading, Negeb gama Ramoth-te ading, le Jattirte ading,"},"28":{"text":"Aroer-te ading, Siphmoth-te ading , Eshtemoa-te’ khuopite ading ,"},"29":{"text":"Racal-te ading, Jerahmeel-te’ khuopite ading, le Ken-te’ khuopite ading,"},"30":{"text":"Hormah, Bor-ashan, Athach-a omte ading,"},"31":{"text":"Hebron-a omte ading, le David le a mite pei ngaina muncin tenga mite ading ahi hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Philistia-te in Israel a sim uhi; tuale Philistia-te mai-ah Israel mite a taimang vua, Gilboa Muol tungah tampitah a puamat uhi.","title":"Saul le A Tapate’ Sina (1Khg 10:1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Philistia-te in Saul le a tapate a nuaphah uhi; tuale Philistia-te in Saul’ tapate ahi Jonathan, Abinadab le Malchishua a that uhi."},"3":{"text":"Gal in Saul nahpitahin a neh hi; thalkapte’ thaltang in ama kha-in nah liem mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in a galvan puopa kungah, “Tam tep tan lote ang pei-in ei dawtlia vua, apmaina-in ei nei lo nadingun na namsau dawh inlen ei dawtlia ta’n,” a ci hi. Hizongle tua galvan puopa in a bawl nuom sih hi; azieh pen ama a cimul a tho hi. Tuaci’n Saul in ama’ namsau la-in tua nam dawn tungah puasuhin a si hi."},"5":{"text":"A galvan puopa in Saul si a mu bepin ama zong a namsau tungah puasuhin ama tawh a siton hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Saul le ama’ tapa thum teng le a galvan puopa le ama mi zosie nikhat thu-in a si sieng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jezreel kuom galkhat le Jordan galkhata om Israel mite in Israel mite taimangin Saul le a tapate kithat zo hi, ci a zah ciengun a khuopite uh nuasie-in a tai uhi; tuale Philistia-te pei-in tua khuopite a luo uhi."},"8":{"text":"A zing ni-in misite’ puon hawhkhie dingin a kuon ciengun Saul le a tapa thum’ luong kilawmlia a mu uhi."},"9":{"text":"Saul’ lu tanin a galhiem a hawhkhe vua, a milimte’ opna innte le mite kungah tam lungdamna thu a puoh dingin Philistia gam sung mun zosie-ah kamtaite a sawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in Astarte biehinn sungah a galhiemte a koi uhi; tuale amate in Beth-shan kulbangah a lu a khai uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jabesh-gilead mite in Saul tunga Philistia-te bawldan a zah ciengun"},"12":{"text":"galhang pasal zosie a ding vua, tuaci’n zan tungtawnin pei-in Beth-shan kulbang panin Saul le a tapate’ luong a la uhi. Amate Jabeshah tungin tua munah a haltum uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a gute la-in Jabesh-a makeng kung nei-ah vui-in ni sagi sung an a tang uhi."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"2 Samuel","shortname":"2sam","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel nina laibu (the second book of samuel)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul a si zaw, Amalek-te zo-in David a kilekia ciengin Ziklag ah David ni ni sung a taam hi.","title":"David in Saul le Jonathan Kaa"},"2":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in a puon ki-ehmal, a lutanga leivui baang mi khat Saul’ giephuol panin a tung hi. David kung a tun bepin ama lei-ah bawhsuhin zatahna a pie hi."},"3":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “Nang hei pana hing pei na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Israel giephuol pana hing suohta ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “Bang thu a om ei? Ei gen vawi!” a ci hi. Ama in, “Gal phuol panin galkapte a taimang vua, hinanle galkap tampitah pua-in a si uhi; tuale Saul le a tapa Jonathan zong a si hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in ama kunga thu puoh tangvalpa kungah, “Saul le a tapa Jonathan a si lam bang na ci thei ahiei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama kunga thu puoh tangvalpa in, “ Gilboa Muol ah ka va om kha ta hi. Tuale sakol leengte le sakol siemte in ama a na neh laitahun tua munah Saul a teipi tungah na kingam hi."},"7":{"text":"A nualam a en leh kei ei mu-in ei hlan hi. Keima in ka dawng a, ‘Tanah om ing siepa,’ ka ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale ama in keima kungah, “Nang koi na hiei?” ei ci hi. Ke’n ka dawng a, ‘Amalek-te khat ka hi hi,’ ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in kei kungah, ‘Hing pei inlen ei that ta’n; azieh pen ka lel mama ta a, hizongle ka hing kenkon lai hi,’ ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n a tungah dingin ama ka that hi. Azieh pen a pua zaw ciengin ama hing nawn sih va ci ka thei hi. A lu tunga om kumpi lukhu le a ban tunga om bantuom ladawhin tuate tam sunga ka pu kungah kang tut hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 31:1-6; 1Khg 10:1-6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in a puonte la-in botkeh hi; tuale a ompi mi zosie in zong tua bangma-in a bawl uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul, a tapa Jonathan, Topa’ galkapte le Israel innsung mite namsau tawh a si ziehun da-in kapin nitah dongin an a tang uhi."},"13":{"text":"David in ama kunga thu puoh tangvalpa kungah, “Hei pana hing pei na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Kei Amalek-te pemta khat’ tapa ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"14":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “ Topa’ sathau nu pa that dinga na khut na hlan mawngmawng na zau sih amah?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in tangvalte khat hlanin ama kungah, “Tanah hing pei inlen ama satlia in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a satsuh pai a, ama a si hi."},"16":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “Na sisan na lutungah tu taheh; bangzieh ahei cile na kamham in nangma langkhatah teci pang a, ‘ Topa’ sathau nu pa ka that zo ta hi,’ na ci hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"David in tami kaala tawh Saul le Jonathan kaa a,"},"18":{"text":"(ama in Judah mite kungah tami “Thaltang La” a kihil nadingin thu pie hi; tuami la Jashar Laibu sungah kigiel hi. Ama in:","ref":"Josh 10:13"},"19":{"text":"Israel aw, na minthanna, na munsangte tungah kithat! Mi hatte bangci pua sieng!"},"20":{"text":"Gath ah gen sinlen, Ashkelon gawl lamah zong gen sin; tua hile Philistia tanute kipah ding a, a tep kitanlo mite’ tanute lungdamin a kipah ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"No Gilboa muolte aw, daitui hile, guotui hile, ga nei logamte hile, na tung vuah omsah da un! Azieh pen mihatpa’ lum bua zo a, Saul’ lum sathau kinu nawn lo hi."},"22":{"text":"A kithat pa’ sisan panin, mi thahat pa’ thau panin, Jonathan’ thaltang kinuale loin, Saul’ namsau a guohkia sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Saul le Jonathan a kihe vua, a it huoi mama uhi! A si a hinun ama gel a kikhen vawt sih uhi; muvanlai sangin ama gel gangzaw a, humpi sangin zong ama gel hatzaw hi."},"24":{"text":"No Israel tanute aw, Saul ziehin kap un. Puonsan nel silin a nuom op ziuzieu, na puon tung vua kham kizepna suongte aw, ama ziehin kap un."},"25":{"text":"Galphuol sungah, mi hatte bangci pua! Na muol sangte tungah Jonathan kithat-in lum ta."},"26":{"text":"Nang ziehin ka lung a kham hi, sanggam Jonathan aw; nei itna a gol sengin, nei itna lamdang a, numei’ itna sangin lienzaw hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi hatte bangci pua, galhiemte bangci siet!” a ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin David in Topa dong a, “Judah khuopite khat popo-ah ka peito diei mah?” a ci hi. Topa in ama kungah, “Peito in,” a ci hi. David in, “Koi penah ka peito diei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Hebron ah,” a ci hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi-in David Sathau Kinu"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in a zi tegel, Jezreel-a Ahinoam le Carmel-a Nabal’ zi meigongnu Abigail tawh khum munah a peito uhi.","ref":"1Sam 25:42-43"},"3":{"text":"David in a zawpi mite, mi zosie a innkuonpi ciet tawh peitopi hi; tuale Hebron khuopite-ah amate a teng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum munah Judah mite pei-in Judah kumpi dingin David sathau a nu uhi. Amate in David kungah, “Saul a vuite pen Jabesh-gilead mite hi,” ci-in a gen ciengun","ref":"1Sam 31:11-13"},"5":{"text":"David in Jabesh-gilead mite kungah kamtaite sawl a, “Na pu uh Saul tungah tam bang citahna lahin na vui ziehun Topa in thupha hing pie ta uheh!"},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Topa in na tung vuah itna kip le thumanna hing lah taheh! Tam banga na gamtat ziehun note thaman kang pie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na khut khausah unlen hang un; azieh pen na pu uh Saul si zo a, Judah innkuon in amate tungah kumpi dingin kei sathau ei nu zo uhi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hizongle Saul’ galkapmangpa Ner’ tapa Abner in Mahanaim ah Saul’ tapa Ishbaal a peipi hi.","title":"Israel Kumpi Ishbaal"},"9":{"text":"Ama in Gilead, Ashur, Jezreel, Ephraim, Benjamin, le Israel zosie tungah kumpi dingin ama a bawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel uh dinga ama a kipatin Saul’ tapa Ishbaal kum sawmli pha a, ama in kum ni sung uh hi. Ahi vangin Judah innkuon in David’ nua zui uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hebron-a Judah innkuon tungah David kumpi a suo hun sung pen kum sagi le hla guh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mahanaim pan Gibeon zuonin Ner’ tapa Abner le Saul’ tapa Ishbaal’ nasemte a pei uhi.","title":"Gibeon-a Galkidona"},"13":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Joab le David’ nasemte peikhie-in Gibeon buolah amate a na dawn uhi. Pawlkhat buol langkhatah a to laitahun adang khat a buol langkhatah a to uhi."},"14":{"text":"Abner in Joab kungah, “Tangvalte a mai-ah peisah vai-in i mai vuah kisuolsah vai,” a ci hi. Joab in, “Amate a mai-ah hing peisah in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate a mai-ah pei-in a galkai kawmun Benjamin le Saul’ tapa Ishbaal adingin sawm le ni, le David’ nasemte adingin sawm le ni a kise uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in a kisihpi ciet uh a lutangah manin a namsau tawh a langpa a dawt ciet uhi; tuaci’n amate a puaton ciet uhi. Tua ziehin Gibeon-a khum mun pen Helkath-hazzurim kici hi."},"17":{"text":"Khum ni-in gal kidona a nasie mama hi; tuale David’ nasemte in Abner le Israel mite a zo uhi."},"18":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa thumte, Joab, Abishai, le Asahel, khumnah a om uhi. Tu-in Asahel pen sakhi lee bangin a keng a mallang hi."},"19":{"text":"Asahel in Abner nuadel a, ama a del kawmin zietlam ah hile veilam ah hile a piel sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abner in a nua enin, “Nang, Asahel na hi amah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Ingheh, keima ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Abner in ama kungah, “Na ziet na vei kihei inlen, tangvalte khat penpen manin a van khat kilah in,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama a nuadelna panin Asahel a kinua hei tuom sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Abner in Asahel kungah, “Kei ei del nawn sinlen piel ta’n; bang dingin ke’n nang tuolah hing satlia ta lawm ding ka hei? Tua bang bawl mawh leng na sanggampa Joab kungah bangci bangin ka maitang laa nawn ding ka hei?” a ci leuleu hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama a kinua hei nuom tuon sih hi. Tuaci’n Abner in teipi dawn tawh a gilpi khaw a, tuaci’n a teipi in pailetin a el lamah a pusuoh hi. Khum munah ama puasuhin a puana munah a si hi. Tuale Asahel pua-in a sina munah a pei mi zosie pia loin a ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanle Joab le Abishai in Abner a nuadel vua, nitum laitahin ama gel Gibeon gamlah peina lampi tunga om Giah mai-a kihlung Ammah muol a tung uhi."},"25":{"text":"Benjamin-te, Abner kimah kikhawmin pawlkhat a suoh uhi; amate muol dawn khatah a pang uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Abner in Joab hlan a, “Namsau in mi a nawmval den ding ma amah? A tawpna ah hamsa zaw ding hi, ci thei lo na hi amah? A sanggamte a nuadelna panin a kihei nadingun na mite thu na pieh ding bang tanvei sawt lai ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Joab in, “Pasien a hin ma bangin hing genkha sih lacin, mite in a sanggamte uh zingmawng cieng dong khawl vawt loin a del peisuoh ding uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Joab in zong pengkul mutin tuale mi zosie a khawl uhi; amate in zong Israel-te nuadel nawn loin gal zong a do nawn sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Abner le a mite in khum zan tungtawnin Arabah lam tawnin khuol a zin uhi; amate in Jordan a kantan vua, tuale sunlai masang zingmawng tungtawnin pei-in Mahanaim ah a tung uhi."},"30":{"text":"Abner a nuadelna panin Joab a kilekia a, ama in mi zosie a kaikhop zaw ciengin Asahel simlo David’ nasemte mi sawmkuo le kuo a pelem uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin David’ nasemte in Abner’ mite ahi Benjamin-te zathum le sawmguh a that uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in Asahel luong a puo vua, tuaci’n Bethlehem-a om a pa hanah a vui uhi. Joab le a mite zan tungtawn pei-in Hebron ah khuo a vah hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul’ innkuon le David’ innkuonte kikalah sau veipi kidona om hi; David thahat semsem a, Saul thanem semsem hi.","title":"David Lamah Abner Tai"},"2":{"text":"David in Hebron-ah tapate nei hi: A tapa tapen Jezreel-a Ahinoam tawh a nei Amnon ahi hi;"},"3":{"text":"a tapa nina pen Carmel-a Nabal’ zi Abigail tawh a nei Chileab ahi hi; a tapa thumna pen Geshur Kumpipa Talmai’ tanu Maacah tawh a nei Absalom ahi hi;"},"4":{"text":"a tapa lina pen Haggith’ tapa Adonijah ahi hi; a tapa ngana pen Abital’ tapa Shephatiah ahi hi;"},"5":{"text":"a tapa guhna pen David’ zi Eglah tawh a nei Ithream ahi hi. Tam teng pen Hebron-a David pana a piengte ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul’ innkuonte le David’ innkuonte kikalah kidona a om sungin Saul’ innkuon sungah Abner a thahat semsem hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in Saul in Aiah’ tanu Rizpah min nei khat mei-in sie hi. Tuale Ishbaal in Abner kungah, “Bang dinga ka pa’ meinu na luppi ahei?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ishbaal’ thugente ziehin Abner lungthah mama hi; ama in, “Kei Judah dinga ui lutang bang lel ka mah? Keima in na pa Saul’ innkuonte, a sanggamte, le a guolte tungah tuni dong citahna ka lah den ziehin David’ khut sungah note kang pieh nai lo ahi bo a, ahi vangin nang in tu-in tami numei tawh kisai-in nei mawmat hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Saul’ innkuon panin kumpi gam khinin Dan panin Beer-sheba cieng dong Israel le Judah tungah David’ kumpi topha phut dingin David tungah Topa in a na ciemsa thu ama adingin ka tunsah sih tah ma leh Pasien in keima Abner ei dawm sih taheh!” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 15:28","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Ishbaal in kam khat zong Abner dawng ngam lo hi, azieh pen ama a giing mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Abner in Hebron -a om David kungah kamtai sawlin ama kungah, “Tam gam koi uh ding ahei?” a ci hi. Kei tawh thuciemna hing bawl in. Israel zosie nang lamah ang pei nadingin keima’n nang kang panpi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “Hoi hi; nang tawh thuciemna khat ka bawl ding hi. Ahi vangin na kungah kang nget nop khat a om hi; kei tawh kimu dinga nang pei ciengin Saul’ tanu Michal nang zawpi sih leh ka mai na mu sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Saul’ tapa Ishbaal kungah kamtaite sawl a, “Philistia-te vuntep zakhat tawh ka leisa ka zi Michal ei pie in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 18:27"},"15":{"text":"Ishbaal in mi sawlin a pasal Laish’ tapa Paltiel kung pan tua nu a lasah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pasal in ama zui a, Bahurim peina lam tungtawn a nua-ah a kaa kawmin a zui hi. Tua ciengin Abner in ama kungah, “Inn lamah kilekia ta’n!” a ci hi.
