Tuaci’n ama a kilekia hi."},"17":{"text":"Abner in Israel upate kam vaihlah a, “A tawpsa hun khat lai-in David na kumpi dingun na sui kawikawi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in tahsuosah un; azieh pen Topa in David kungah kamciem zo hi: Ka nasempa David tungtawnin Philistia-te le a galte zosie’ khut sung panin ka mi Israel ka hunkhie ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Abner in zong Benjamin-te tungah a gen hi; tua ciengin Israel zosie le Benjamin innkuon zosie in zong tua bang bawl dingin a baisa-in a om uhi, ci thu Hebron-a David kungah a gen dingin Abner a pei hi."},"20":{"text":"Hebron-a David kungah mi sawmni tawh Abner a pei ciengin, David in Abner le a zawpi mite adingin pawi khat a bawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Abner in David kungah, “Amate in nangma tawh thuciemna a bawl thei nading ule na lungsim sunga om bangin amate zosie tungah na uh thei nadingin, kei va pei-in ka pu kumpipa kungah Israel zosie ka va kaikhawm ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zaw lientahin a galsimna panun Joab tawh David’ nasemte tungin na tampi a tut uhi. Ahi vangin Hebron-a David kungah Abner na om lo hi; azieh pen David in ama a na sawldawh ta a, ama lungmuongin a na pei ta hi.","title":"Joab in Abner That"},"23":{"text":"Joab le a zawpi galkap zosie a tun ciengun Joab kungah, “Kumpipa kungah Ner’ tapa Abner pei a, ama lungmuongin peikia zo hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joab pei-in kumpipa kungah, “Bang bawl na hi ahei? Na kungah Abner ang haw hi; a suotah thei nadinga bang dinga ama na sawldawh ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Nang ang sol ding, na sungtum na pusuo ang thei ding, le nasepna zosie ang kan dinga Ner’ tapa Abner na kunga ang haw ahi lam na thei gegu ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"David kung panin Joab a pei zaw ciengin ama in Abner kungah kamtaite sawl a, amate in Sirah Tuikhuh panin ama a nua zawpikia uhi; ahi vangin David in tua thu thei lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Hebron ah Abner a kilekia ciengin Joab in kituom hopi dingin tunkot phung lamah ama zawpi a, tuale ama in a gil a sutpieh hi. Tuaci’n Joab’ sanggampa Asahel’ sisan luonna ziehin ama a si hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin, David in tua thu a zah ciengin ama in, “Ner’ tapa Abner’ sisan ziehin Topa mai-ah keima le ka kumpigam a tawntungin maw ka baang sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Joab lutung le a pa’ innkuonte zosie tungah tami khielna tu taheh; tuale Joab’ innkuon tawh nin pei mi hile, a phah mi hile, ciengkhut khun mi hile, namsau tawh a kithat mi hile, anneh ding nei lo mi tawh hile kilawi ngai sih taheh!” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Gibeon-a galkidona-ah a sanggampa uh Asahel a thapieh ziehin Joab le a sanggampa Abishai in Abner a that uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Joab le a optonpi mi zosie kungah, “Na puonsilte uh botkehin la-ip puon sil unlen Abner adingin kap un,” a ci hi. Tuale kumpipa David in mi siluong a zui hi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in Hebron ah Abner a vui uhi. Abner’ hanah kumpipa a gingin kap a, mi zosie zong a kap uhi."},"33":{"text":"Abner adingin kumpipa in kaateng a lo a, Abner, mimaw khat’ si banga mawh si ding na ta amah?"},"34":{"text":"Na khutte kikan lo a, na kengte kol kibul lo hi; mi gilote mai-a puate bangin nang zong na pua ta hi,” a ci hi. Tuale ama ziehin mi zosie a kap uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin ni a op sungin an ne dingin David a zawl uhi; ahi vangin David kiciemin, “Ni tum masangin an hile, na khat popo hile ka tep leh Pasien in keima ei dawm sih taheh!” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Mi zosie in tua thu a phawh vua, tua in amate a lungdamsah hi; kumpipa’ sep zosie in zong mi zosie a lungkimsah hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi zosie le Israel zosie in Ner’ tapa Abner kithana thu-ah kumpipa kikum kha lo hi, ci thu khum ni-in a thei uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuale kumpipa in a nasemte kungah, “Israel sungah ulien le mi thupi khat si zo hi, ci thu note in na thei nai sih uh amah?"},"39":{"text":"Sathau kinu kumpi ka hi vangin tuni-in kei ka tha zawngkhal mama hi. Zeruiah’ ta tam mite khu kei adingin a thuohha mama hi. Gitlo a bawlpa a gitlona bangin Topa in thuhkia taheh!” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hebron-ah Abner si zo ci thu Saul’ tapa Ishbaal in a zah ciengin a thakiem a, Israel zosie lungkie uhi.","title":"Ishbaal Kithat"},"2":{"text":"Saul’ tapa in galsim pawlte makai mi ni nei hi; khat pa’ min Baanah hi a, adang khat pa’ min Rechab ahi hi. Ama gel pen Beeroth pan Benjamin mi Rimmon’ tapate ahi uhi, azieh pen Beeroth khu Benjamin-a’ in kisim hi."},"3":{"text":"(Gittaim-ah Beeroth mite a tai vua, tuni dongin khum tahah pemta-in a om uhi.)"},"4":{"text":"Saul’ tapa Jonathan in tapa khelbai khat nei hi. Jezreel panin Saul le Jonathan’ si a kizahin ama kum nga a pha hi. A naucing nu in ama la-in a taipi hi; tuale ama nu a nawtai na lamin naupangno khiehsuo-in a khel a bai hi. Ama’ min Mephibosheth ahi hi.","ref":"2Sam 9:3"},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Beeroth mi Rimmon’ tapate Rechab le Baanah a kuon vua, sun nisat hun pawl, Ishbaal’ inn ah a sunkim tawlngah hun laitahin a tung gel hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama gel zong mangbu la ding a kipang vua, inn sungah lutin a gilpi a sutkehpieh vua, tua ciengin Rechab le a sanggampa Baanah a suohta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in ama’ lupna khan sunga a lupna tungah a lup laitahin inn sungah ama gel a lut uhi; ama gel in ama simin a that vua, a lu a tan uhi. Tua ciengin a lutang la-in Arabah lampi zui-in zan tawn tungin a pei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hebron-a om David kungah ama gel in Ishbaal’ lutang a tut vua, tuale kumpipa kungah, “Tha dinga ang sui na gal Saul’ tapa Ishbaal’ lutang tam sungah om hi; Topa in tuni-in Saul le a suonlehlahte tungah ka pu kumpipa’ phu la zo hi,” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"David in zong Beeroth-te Rimmon’ tapa gel ahi Rechab le a sanggampa Baanah dawngin, “Hahsatna zosie panin keima’ hinna ei hunkhie Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,"},"10":{"text":"mi khat in ka kungah, ‘En in, Saul si ta,’ ci-a ang gen ciengin ama thuhoi puohin a kingaituo a, ken lah ama manin Ziklag-ah ka that hi; tam pen keima in ama’ thupuoh zieha ka pieh thaman ahi hi.","ref":"2Sam 1:1-16"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahile ama’ inn sung, ama’ lupna tungah mi dihpa khat a that migilopa tungah bang za-in sietna kibawl zaw kan lai ding ahei! Tu-in na khut sung vuah ama’ sisan hing ngenin leitung panin kang susie sih ding uh amah?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in tangvalte thu pie a, ama gel a that uhi; ama gel in a khut a keng tegel sattanin Hebron-a buol gei-ah a luonghawm a khai uhi. Hinanle Ishbaal’ lutang la-in Hebron-a Abner’ hanah a vui uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hebron-a David kungah Israel minamte zosie pei-in, “En in, kote nangma’ gu le nangma’ tel le vo ka hi uhi.","title":"Israel’ Kumpi-in David Sathau Kinu (1Khg 11:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Hun khat lai, kote tungah Saul kumpi ahi lai-in, Israel a peipi le a tunpi pa khu nangma na hi hi. Topa in na kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Ka mi Israel a cing ding pa na hi a, Israel tungah a uhpa ding na hi hi,” ei ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hebron-a kumpipa kungah Israel upa zosie a pei uhi; tuale Kumpi David in Topa mai Hebron ah amate tawh thuciemna khat bawlin Israel tungah kumpi dingin David sathau a nu uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpi a sep kipatin David kum sawmthum pha a, kum sawmli sung uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Hebron ah Judah gam kum sagi le hla guh sung uh hi; tuale ama in Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le thum sung Israel zosie le Judah uh hi.","ref":"1Kum 2:11; 1Khg 3:4; 29:27"},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa le a mite khum gama teng Jebus-te sim dingin Jerusalem-ah a pei vua, amate in David kungah, “Tam sungah nang lut zo vet sih ding hi. Mittaw le khelbaite na ngawnin ang notmang zo ding uhi,” a ci hi. “Tam sungah David ang lut zo sih ding hi,” ci-in ngaisun uhi.","title":"A Kigawm Kumpigam Khuopi Dingin Jerusalem Kihisah (1Khg 11:4-9 ; 14:1-7)","ref":"Josh 15:63; Thkn 1:21"},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin David in tu-a David khuopi ahi Zion mun muonhuoi a la hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum ni-in David in, “Jebus-te a vatgawp nuom poma in David in a muda mite ahi mittawte le khelbaite sim dingin tuizawl dungah pei taheh,” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin Topa’ inn sungah mittawte le khelbaite lut lo ding hi,” kici hi."},"9":{"text":"David in mun muonhuoi a la a, David khuopi ci-in a min phuo hi. David in khuopi kimkotin Millo sunglam zosie panin khuopi a lam hi."},"10":{"text":"Vanglien Pasien, Topa tawh a opton ziehin David a vanglien semsem hi."},"11":{"text":"Tyre kumpipa Hiram in David kungah kamtaite le tuum singte, le David’ inn a lampieh khutsiemte, le leiseh siemte zong a puoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel tungah ama kumpi-in Topa in a kipsah zona le ama’ mi Israel ziehin ama’ kumpi gam a tawisang lam David in a theicien hi."},"13":{"text":"Hebron panin a tun zaw ciengin David in Jerusalem panin zineute le zite lahbe lai hi; tuale David in tanu le tapate a neibe lai hi."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem-a pieng David’ tate min: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"15":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,"},"16":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada, le Eliphelet ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpi-in Israel tungah David sathau a kinu zo lam Philistia-te in a zah ciengun David sui dingin Philistia-te zosie a kuonto uhi; hizongle David in tua thu na za-in munmuonhuoi-ah na peisuh hi.","title":"Philistia-te Zogawp (1Khg 14:8-17)"},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Rephaim kuomah Philistia-te pei-in a kithezah uhi."},"19":{"text":"David in Topa dong a, “Philistia-te sim dingin ka kuonto diei mah? Ka khut sungah amate nei pie diei mah?” a ci hi. Topa in David kungah, “Kuonto in. Azieh pen keima in na khut sungah Philistia-te kang pie tahtah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Baal-perazim ah David pei a, khum munah David in amate a zogawp hi. Ama in, “Tuikhang in a phulmang bangin Topa in ka mai-ah ka galte phulmang zo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ziehin khum mun Baal-perazim ci-in a min kiphuo hi."},"21":{"text":"Philistia-te in khum munah a milimte uh a nuasie vua, David le a mite in tuate a puomang uhi."},"22":{"text":"Philistia-te a kuonto kia vua, Rephaim kuomah a kithezahkia uhi."},"23":{"text":"David in Topa thu a dawh ciengin ama in, “Na kuonto sih ding hi; amau’ nua lamah kuol pei inlen lungli singte galkhat panin amate del in."},"24":{"text":"Lungli singte tung panin galte’ ketot gin na zah ciengin kigingsa-in om in; azieh pen Philistia-te a vatmai dingin na mai-ah Topa a pei hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh bangin David gamta hi; tuale ama in Geba panin Geza dongin Philistia-te a vatmai hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel-te a kiteelkhie mi tul sawmthum khawmkia hi.","title":"David in Jerusalem ah Singkuong Puo (1Khg 13:5-14)"},"2":{"text":"Khum mun panin Cherub-te tunga om, Vanglien Topa’ min tawh a kilo Pasien’ singkuong a zawng dingin a optonpi mi zosie tawh Baale-judah ah David a pei uhi.","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"3":{"text":"Leeng tha tungah Pasien’ Singkuong a puo vua, muol tunga om Abinadab’ inn panin a peipi uhi. Abinadab’ tapate Uzzah le Ahio in leeng tha khat tawh","ref":"1Sam 7:1-2"},"4":{"text":"Pasien’ singkuong a hawi uhi; tuale singkuong mai-ah Ahio a pei hi."},"5":{"text":"David le Israel’ innkuon zosie in a tha nei za-un, Topa mai-ah late, lyre lasahnate, harp lasahnate, tawmte, kuongtuote, le daltuote tumin a lam uhi."},"6":{"text":"Nacon’ ancilna phuol a tun ciengun bawngtangte in leeng a lawthing ziehin Uzzah in Pasien’ singkuong a khut tawh zamin tu kha hi."},"7":{"text":"Uzzah tungah Topa’ lungthahna a tung hi; tuale ama in a khut tawh singkuong a zap ziehin Pasien in khum munah ama a vatlum hi; tuale Pasien’ singkuong gei-ah ama a si hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien in Uzzah a tha ziehin David lungthah mama hi; tuaci’n tuni dongin khum mun pen Perez-uzza ci-in a min kiphuo hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum ni-in David in Topa a giing hi; ama in, “Keima’ kep dingin “ Topa’ singkuong bang hing ci tun thei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n David khuopi sunga ama’ kep dingin Topa’ singkuong a kitut ding David nuom lo hi; tua sung tangin David in Gitt mi Obed-edom’ inn ah a tut hi."},"11":{"text":"Gitt mi Obed-edom’ inn ah Topa’ singkuong hla thum sung a thaam hi; tuale Topa in Obed-edom le a innkuonpi zosie thupha a pie hi.","ref":"1Khg 26:4-5"},"12":{"text":"Kumpi David kungah, “Pasien’ singkuong ziehin Topa in Obed-edom innkuon le ama’ nei zosie thupha pie hi,” ci-in kigen hi. Tuaci’n David pei-in Obed-edom’ inn panin David khuopi sungah kipahtahin Pasien’ singkuong a peipi hi;"},"13":{"text":"tuale Topa’ singkuong a puote in kal guh a suon zaw ciengun ama in bawngtang khat le bawngno thau khat biehpiehna-in a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa mai-ah a tha nei za-in David lam hi; David in saihadiel siempupuon khat sil hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n David le Israel mi zosie in kikona le pengkul tumna tawh Topa’ singkuong a peipito uhi."},"16":{"text":"David khuopi sungah Topa’ singkuong a tun lai tahin tawlet panin Saul’ tanu Michal khuodah a, tuale ama in Topa mai-ah David Kumpipa lamin a dieng vazawh a mu hi; tuale ama nu in a lungsim sungah a simmaw dap mama hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Topa’ singkuong a lutpi vua, tuale David in ama dinga a na lamsa ahi puonbuh sung ama mun dingah koi hi; tuale Topa mai-ah David in meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate a pie hi."},"18":{"text":"David in meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate a pieh zaw ciengin Vanglien Topa’ minin mite thupha pie a,"},"19":{"text":"mite zosie lahah Israel mihon buppi, numei le pasalte moh pheng khat, saba khat , le lenggagaw pheng khat ciet a pie hi. Tua ciengin mi zosie a inn ciet vuah a pei uhi."},"20":{"text":"A innkuonte thupha pie dingin David a peikia hi. Hinanle David dawn dingin Saul’ tanu Michal pei a, tuale ama in, “Mi kheltat khatpo in zumzie thei loin a guohtanga a op bangin, a nasem numeite muna-ah tuni-in a guohtanga a om Israel kumpipa khu ama le ama bangci kipatawi a ta diei!” a ci hi.","ref":"1Khg 16:43"},"21":{"text":"David in Michal kungah, “ Topa’ mi Israel tungah ulien dinga ei koi dingin na pa le a innkuonte zosie tanga kei ei teel Topa mai ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam sangin a simmawhuoi zaw-in kei le kei ka kibawl lai ding a, keima’ mitmu mama-in a ginalo ka hi ding hi; hinanle nangma’ gen numeite in kei ei zatah mama ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Saul’ tanu Michal a si dongin ta nei thei nawn lo hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in a inn ah kumpipa teng a, Topa in a kimvela a galte zosie panin ama tawlngahna a pieh zaw ciengin,","title":"David tawh Pasien’ Thuciemna (1Khg 17:1-15)"},"2":{"text":"kumpipa in kamsang Nathan kungah, “Tu-in en in, kei taamtah sing inn ah ka teng a, ahi vangin Pasien’ singkuong puonbuh sungah a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Nathan in kumpipa kungah, “Pei inlen, na lungsim sunga om zosie bawl in; bang ding ahei cile Topa in nang ang ompi hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle tua zan ma-in Nathan kungah tam bangin Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"5":{"text":"Nang va pei-in ka nasempa David kungah tam bangin va gen ta’n: Topa in tam bangin a ci hi: Ten na ding inn khat ei lampieh ding na mah?"},"6":{"text":"Egypt panin Israel mite ka peipito ni-a kipan tuni dongin inn sungah ka teng nai sih a, puonbuh le biehbuh sungah ka vah kawikawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi zosiete lahah ka vana mun zosie-ah keima in ka mi Israel a cing dinga ka thupieh Israel minam makai khatpo tungah, “Bang dingin kei adingin taamtah sing inn khat beh ei lampieh lo na hei?” ci-in kam khat beh ka gen ngai amah?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in ka nasempa David kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Lodawnna mun, tuute na zuina panin ka mi Israel tungah ulien dingin kang la hi;"},"9":{"text":"tuale na peina popo-ah hing ompi-in na mai panin na galte zosie kang hepkhietpieh hi; tuale keima in leitunga miliente’ min bang ma-in nang adingin min lien khat kang bawlpieh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in ka mi Israel adingin mun khat se-in amate ka tu ding hi, tuaci’n a mun ciet vuah a ten thei nadingun amate kisubuoi nawn lo ding hi; tuale nidang lai bangin migilote in,"},"11":{"text":"ka mi Israel tungah thukhen mangte ka koi huna kipanin amate gimsah nawn lo ding hi; tuale na gal zosie panin tawldamna nang kang pie ding hi. Tua tham loin na tungah Topa in suonlehlah ang pieh ding thu Topa in ang gen zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Na hinna nite tawpin na pu na pate tawh na lupton ciengin, nangma sung pana ang suoh ding na cihlahte nangma nua-ah ka khangsah ding a, ama’ kumpi gam ka phut ding hi.","ref":"Late 89:3-4; 132:11; Jhn 7:42; Sawl 2:30"},"13":{"text":"Ama in ka min dingin inn khat lam ding a, keima in a kumpi gam’ topha a tawntungin ka kipsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima ama’ pa ka hi ding a, ama keima’ tapa hi ding hi. Ama in khielna a bawl ciengin mite zah ciengduoi tawh ama dan ka pie ding a, mihingte tung panin gimna ka thuohsah ding hi.","ref":"Late 89:26-27; 2Cor 6:18; Heb 1:5"},"15":{"text":"Hinanle keima in na mai pana ka delmang Saul tung panin ka itna kip ka lahdawh bangin ama kung panin ka ladawh sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka mai-ah na suon na hlahte le na kumpi gam a kip zing dingin kibawl ding a, na kumpi topha kumtawnin kip ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 89:36-37"},"17":{"text":"Nathan in tam thu zosie le tam mangmuna zosie tawh kituohin David kungah a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi David sungtumin Topa mai-ah to a, “ Topa Pasien aw, tu cieng dong tam banga nei kep nei hui nadingin kei koi ka hi a, ka innkuon bang ahi ahei?","title":"David’ Thungetna (1Khg 17:16-27)"},"19":{"text":"Tua banah Topa Pasien aw, tami khu nangma’ mai-ah thu neuno khat hi lai hi; nang in sauveipi cienga ang tung ding na nasempa’ innkuonte thu zong na gen zo ta hi. Tami khu mite adingin thuhilna hing hisah ta’n, Topa Pasien aw!"},"20":{"text":"David in nang tungah bang ang gen be thei na diei? Bangzieh ahei cile nangma in na nasempa na thei siem hi, Topa Pasien aw!"},"21":{"text":"Na thuciemna bang le na lungsim tawh kizui-in na nasempa in a thei nadingin tam thulien zosie na bawl zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien aw, ka bil vua ka zahsa zosie uh bangin nang na lien hi; azieh pen nang bang koima om lo a, nang simlo Pasien dang om lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel tawh a kibang nangma’ mi khu koi ahiei? Ama’ mite mai-ah minamte le a pasien-te uh a delgamna tawh ama dingin min bawlin amate dingin a lien a zauhuoi nate bawlpieh a, Pasien pei-in ama’ mi dinga a tatkhiet vawt adang minam leitungah a om ngai ta mawng amah?","ref":"Thkna 4:34"},"24":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma’ mi suoh zing dingin na mi Israel na sudet zo hi; tuale a, Topa aw, nang amau’ Pasien na suoh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuale Topa Pasien aw, tu-in na nasempa le a suonlehlahte tawh kisai-in a tawntungin na gensa thu kipsah in; na kamciemsa bangin bawl in."},"26":{"text":"Tua hile ‘Vanglien Topa khu Israel tunga Pasien ahi hi,’ ci-in na min ang kiliensah zing ding hi; tuale na mai-ah na nasempa David’ innkuonte kumpi-in kikipsah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa aw, ‘Nang adingin innkuon khat kang pie ding hi,’ ci-in na nasempa tungah tam thu nei hilsa ahi hi. Tua ahi zieha na nasempa in na kungah tam thungetna kang nget ngam ahi bo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu-in Topa Pasien aw, nang Pasien na hi a, na thugente man a, na nasempa tungah tami sil hoi na kamciem zo hi;"},"29":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin tu-in na mai-a a om zing thei nadingin na nasempa’ innkuonte thupha na pieh ding lungkim in; bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien aw, nang in na gen zo a, na thupha tawh na nasempa’ innkuon thupha kipie zing ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw hun khat ciengin David in Philistia-te simin a zo hi; David in Philistia-te’ khut sung panin Metheg-ammah a la hi.","title":"David’ Galsimte (1Khg 18:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Moab-te zong zo-in tuolah lumsah a, khauzam khat tawh amate a te hi; ama in tha dingin guol ni le hinkhawi dingin guol khat dim a te hi. Moab-te ahile David’ nasemte suohin sieh le kaihte a pie uhi."},"3":{"text":"A uhna gam ngakia nuomin Euphrates lui-ah Zobah kumpipa Rehob’ tapa Hadadezer a pei laitahin David in ama a vatlum hi."},"4":{"text":"David in sakol galkap tulkhat le zasagi le lei galkap tul sawmni man hi. David in leengkai sakol zosie a kapzahui vatsan a, hinanle leeng zakhat adingin a kicing a hen hi."},"5":{"text":"Damascus gama Aram-te, Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer a panpi dingin a kuon ciengun David in Aram-te tul sawmni le tulni that hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Damascus gama Aram-te lahah khuocingte koi hi; tuale Aram-te pen David’ nasemte a suoh vua, sieh le kaih a pie uhi. Topa in a peina popo-ah David guolzawna a pie hi."},"7":{"text":"David in Hadadezer’ nasemte in a puoh uh kham tawh kibawl lumte a lahpieh a, Jerusalem-ah tuate a peipi hi."},"8":{"text":"David Kumpipa in Hadadezer’ khuopite Betah le Berothai panin sumngo tampi a la hi."},"9":{"text":"David in Hadadezer’ galkap zosie a zawna thu Hamath kumpipa Toi in a zah ciengin,"},"10":{"text":"ama in Hadadezar do-in a zawna hangin ama a hopi ding le a noppi dingin Toi in Kumpi David kungah a tapa Joram a sawl hi. Hadadezer pen Toi tawh galin a kido ngai zel hi. Joram in ngun, kham, le sumngo tawh kibawl nate a puoh hi;"},"11":{"text":"David in a zawsa minam zosiete panin a ap ngun le khamte tawh"},"12":{"text":"Edom, Moab, Ammon-te, Philistia-te, le Zobah kumpipa Rehob’ tapa Hadadezer in a nuasie van teng zong Topa tungah ap hi."},"13":{"text":"David in ama’ minthan nadingin a bawl hi. A kinuale lamin ama in Ci Kuom ah Edom-te tul sawm le tulgiet that hi.","ref":"Late 60 Thulu"},"14":{"text":"Ama in Edom ah khuocingte a koi hi; ama in Edom gam mun zosie-ah khuocingte koi a, tuale Edom-te zosie David’ nasemte a suoh uhi. Tuale a peina popo-ah Topa in David guolzawna a pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel gam sungah David a maang hi; tuale David in a mi zosie tungah thutang le thuman zang hi.","title":"David’ Uliente (1Khg 18:14-17)"},"16":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in galkapte uh hi; Ahilud’ tapa Jehoshaphat pen thuciemte pa ahi hi;"},"17":{"text":"Ahitub’ tapa Zadok le Abiathar’ tapa pen Ahimelech siempu ahi uhi; Seraiah pen thuvanpi pa ahi hi;"},"18":{"text":"Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah in Chereth-te le Peleth-te tungah uh a, David’ tapate siempu ahi uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in, “Jonathan ziehin ama tungah ka migitna ka lah thei nadingin Saul’ innkuon sungah mi khatpo a om lai ei mah’” ci-in dong hi.","title":"Mephibosheth Tunga David’ Migitna","ref":"1Sam 20:15-17"},"2":{"text":"Saul’ innkuon sungah a min Ziba a kici nasempa khat om a, ama David kungah a hlan uhi. Kumpipa in ama kungah, “Nang Ziba na mah?” a ci leh ama in, “Na nasempa hi na’ng!” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Pasien’ migitna ama tungah ka lah thei nadingin Saul’ innkuon sungah mi khat beh a om lai diei mah?” a ci hi. Ziba in kumpipa kungah, “Jonathan’ tapa khat omlai hi; ama pen a khelbai ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 4:4"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ama hei-a om ahiei?” a ci hi. Ziba in kumpipa kungah, “Lodebar-a Ammiel’ tapa Machir’ inn ah om hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi David in mi sawlin Lodebar-a Ammiel’ tapa Machir’ inn panin ama a lasah hi."},"6":{"text":"David kungah Saul’ tapa Jonathan, a tapa Mephibosheth a pei a, tuale a mai tuol kunin zatahna a pie hi. David in, “Mephibosheth!” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Na nasempa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “Zau sin, azieh pen na pa Jonathan ziehin na tungah migitna kang lah ding hi; keima in na pu Saul’ leitang zosie nang tungah kang piekia ding a, ka sabuoi-ah an na ne zing ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in zatahna pie-in, “Ui sisa khat bang lel kei nei hici bawl nadingin na nasempa bang hi mawh ka hei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Saul’ nasempa Ziba hlanin ama kungah, “Saul le a innkuon sung mite’ neisa zosie na pu’ tupa kungah ka pie zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma le na tapate le na nasemte in ama adingin lo na hlo ding vua, na pu’ tupa in anneh ding a nei nadingin lo-a piengte na puoh ding uhi; hizongle na pu’ tupa Mephibosheth in ka sabuoi ah an a ne zing ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua hun laitahin Ziba in tapa sawm le nga le nasem sawmni nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ziba in kumpipa kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa in a nasempa nei thupieh zosie bangin na nasempa in a sem ding hi,” a ci hi. Mephibosheth in kumpipa’ tapate khat bangin David’ sabuoi-ah an a ne hi."},"12":{"text":"Mephibosheth in a min Mica a kici tapa tangval khat nei hi. Tuale Ziba’ inn-a a teng zosie zong Mephibosheth’ nasemte a suoh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa’ sabuoi-ah an a neh zing ziehin Jerusalem ah Mephibosheth a teng hi. Tu-in ama pen a khel a langni-a bai ahi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw hun khat ciengin Ammon-te’ kumpipa si-in a tapa Hanun in ama’ za luo hi.","title":"Ammon-te le Aram-te Kizo (1Khg 19:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"David in, “Keima tungah a pa ang thuman gamtat bangin Nahash’ tapa Hanun tungah zong thumanin ka gamta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a pa tawh kisai-in ama henem dingin David in palaite a sawl hi. Ammon-te’ gam sungah David’ palaite a tun ciengun,"},"3":{"text":"Ammon-te’ makaite in Hanun kungah, “Nang ang henem dingin ama in a kamtaite ang sawl ziehin David in na pa patawi hi, ci-in na ngaisun tahtah amah? David in khuo sung a en ding, thu kandap ding, le a thalpai dinga a mite ang sawldap hi lo amah?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hanun in David’ palaite manin a khamul uh alang ciet heukieupieh a, a puonsilte uh a laikim, a pheizum huop zo maimai-in tansanpiehin amate a sawlmang hi."},"5":{"text":"David kungah tua thu a kigen ciengin amate dawn dingin mi a sawl hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate nahpitahin a maizum uhi. Kumpipa in, “Na khamul uh a saukia masangsie Jericho ah hing om tadi unlen, tua ciengin hing peikia un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ammon-te in David’ huot mi a suo zo lam uh a kithei bepun, Ammon-te in mi sawlin Beth-rehob le Zobah-a Aram-te lei galkap tul sawmni le kumpi Maacah mi tulkhat tawh, Tob mite tul sawm le tulni a ciel uhi."},"7":{"text":"David in tua thu a zah ciengin Joab le galkap galhang zosie a sawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Ammon-te a kuon vua, galsim dingin tunkot lutna-ah panmun a la uhi; ahi vangin Zobah le Rehob-a Aram-te, Tob-te, le Maacah-te, gam sungah a tuom om ciet uhi."},"9":{"text":"Joab in a nua le ama-ah ama sim dingin galte a pan lam a mu ciengin Israel mi pawlkhat tuomteelin Aram-te sim dingin a pangsah hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in Ama’ mi a omlai teng a sanggampa Abishai’ uhna sungah koi a, Ammon-te do dingin a pangsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei dingin Aram-te a thahat seng uleh kei nei hu ding hi; hizongle nang dingin Aram-te a thahat seng uleh kei hing pei-in nang kang hu ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kihatsah inlen, i mipite ading le i Pasien’ khuopite adingin hangsan vai; tuale ama’ hoisah bangin Topa in hing bawl taheh,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joab le ama tawh a pangton mite in Aram-te tawh kido dingin a kuon uhi; tuale ama mai-ah amate a taimang uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ammon-te in Aram-te a taimang uh a mu ciengun amate zong Abishai’ mai-ah a tai vua, khuopi sungah a lut uhi. Tua ciengin Ammon-te tawh a kidona panun Joab kilekia a, Jerusalem ah a tung hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te in amate a zaw lam Aram-te in a thei ciengun a kikhawm uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hadadezer in mi sawlin Euphrates galkhata Aram-te a hlansah hi; tuale a makai uh ahi Hadadezer’ galkapmangpa Shobach tawh Helem ah amate a tung uhi."},"17":{"text":"David kungah tam thu a kigen ciengin ama in Israel zosie khawm a, Jordan galkai-in Helem ah a tung uhi. David sim dingin Aram-te na pangin ama tawh a kido uhi."},"18":{"text":"Israel mai-ah Aram-te a tai uhi; tuale David in leeng zasagi a hawi Aram-te, le sakol tung tuong mi tul sawmli that a, a galkapmangpa uh Shobach a liemsah hi, tuaci’n khum munah ama a si hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel-te in a zawna thu Hadedazer’ nasem kumpi zosie in a thei ciengun, Israel-te tawh kilemna a bawl vua, a khut nei vuah a om uhi. Tuaci’n Aram-te in Ammon-te a panpi ngam nawn sih uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Galsim dingin kumpite a kuonkia hun uh khuokhal lai-in David in Joab, le a optonpi a uliente, le Israel zosie a sawl hi; amate in Ammon-te a sugawp vua, Rabbah a kui-im uhi. Ahi vangin Jerusalem-ah David a om hi.","title":"David in Bathsheba’ Angkawm","ref":"1Khg 20:1"},"2":{"text":"Khatvei nitah kai lamin a lupna panin David tho a, kumpi inn khumvum tungah a vah kawikawi ciengin inn khumvum panin a kipumsil numei khat galmu kha hi; tua numei nu pen melhoi mama hi."},"3":{"text":"David in tua numei a kan dingin mi khat a sawl hi. “Tua nu, Eliam’ tanu, Hit mi Uriah’ zi Bathsheba hi, ci-in kigen hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in kamtaite sawlin tua nu a hlansah hi. Ama kungah tua nu pei a, ama in tua nu a luppi hi. (Khum hun lai tahin tua nu a nin nei zaw a kisiensuo laitah ahi hi.) Tua ciengin a inn ah tua nu a pei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua numei a gai hi; tuale ama in mi sawlin David kungah, “Nau ka paai hi,” ci-in a gensah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in Joab kungah thu puoh a, “Hit mi Uriah ka kungah hing sawl in,” a ci hi. Tuale Joab in David kungah Uriah sawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama kungah Uriah a tun ciengin David in Joab bangci op a, mite bang a ci vua, galdona bangci mavan ahei cite a dong hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Uriah kungah, “Na inn ah peisuh inlen na keng va sil ta’n,” a ci hi. Kumpipa’ inn panin Uriah pusuoh a, kumpipa tung panin letsong khat in ama a nuazui hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pupa’ nasem zosie tawh kumpipa’ kotpi gei-ah Uriah lumin a inn ah peisuh lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in David kungah, “Uriah a inn ah peisuh lo hi,” ci-in a gen ciengun David in Uriah kungah, “Khuolzin hing tung na hi sih amah? Bang dingin na inn ah peisuh lo na hei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Uriah in David kungah, “Buhte sungah singkuong, Israel, le Judah a om uhi; tuale ka pu Joab le ka pu’ nasemte lopang-ah gieh uhi; tua ziehin bang dingin anne tuidawn ding le ka zi tawh lumton dingin ka inn ah peisuh thei mawh ding ka hei?” a ci hi. Topa a hing ahi bang ma le nangma a hing na hi bang ma-in tam bangin ka gamta vawt sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Uriah kungah, “Tuni zong tanah om phot inlen zing cieng kang peisah ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n khum ni-in zong Jerusalem-ah Uriah a taam hi. A zing ciengin"},"13":{"text":"David in ama an le zu nehpi dingin ciel a, ama zu a khamsah hi; nitah lamin a pu’ nasemte tawh a lupna tunga lum dingin ama pusuoh a, hinanle a inn lamah a peisuh sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin David in Joab lai khat hlah a, tua lai Uriah in a puosah hi.","title":"David in Uriah Thatsah"},"15":{"text":"A laihlah sungah, “Galhanna pen munah Uriah a madawhin pangsah inlen, ama kivatpua-in a si thei nadingin ama kung panin nangma nuakin in,” ci-in a giel hi."},"16":{"text":"Joab in khuopi a bulu laitahin mihat galhangte om hi, ci-a a theina munah Uriah a pangsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuo sung mite kuonin Joab tawh a kido uhi; tuale mite lahah David’ nasemte kimkhat a si hi. Hit mi Uriah zong kithat hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joab in mi sawlin gal kidona thu zosie David kungah a gen hi;"},"19":{"text":"tuale ama in kamtaipa thuhil a, “Gal kidona thu zosie kumpipa kungah na gen zaw ciengin,"},"20":{"text":"kumpipa lungthahin ama in na kungah, ‘Bang dinga khuopi lam nai senga galdo dinga va kuon ta na hi uh ahei? Kulpi bang tung panin ei kap va uh ci na thei sih uh amah?"},"21":{"text":"Jerubbaal’ tapa Abimelech koi in that ahei? Numei khat in kul tung panin ama tungah an-gawina suongpeh a tungta lam a khiehsuh ziehin Thebez ah ama si hi lo amah? Bang zieha kulpi lam nai-a pei na hi uh ahei?’ ang ci leh, ‘Na nasempa Hit mi Uriah zong si hi,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkn 9:53"},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n kamtaipa pei-in a tung a, Joab in a gen dinga a sawl thu zosie David kungah a gen hi."},"23":{"text":"Kamtaipa in David kungah, “Mite in ei thazaw-in gamlahah ei do dingin ang kuon uhi; hinanle kote in zong tunkot lutna-ah amate ka notkia uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin kul panin thalkap siemte in na nasemte ei na kap uhi; kumpipa’ nasem pawlkhat si-in Hit mi na nasem Uriah zong a si hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"David in kamtaipa kungah, “Joab kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi, ‘Tami thu ziehin kilungkhamsah sin, bangzieh ahei cile tu-in namsau in mi khatzaw cienga khat a vat ngai ma hi lel hi; na khuopi sim hanciemin lumlet in,’ ci-in Joab hantawh in,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Uriah’ zi in a pasal si a zah bepin a pasal ziehin da-in a kap hi."},"27":{"text":"Kaa le mau teng a ven zaw ciengin David in mi sawlin ama hlansah a, ama David’ zi suohin ama tawh tapa khat a nei hi. Hinanle David’ gamtatna tungah Topa a lungkim sih a,"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"tuale Topa in David kungah Nathan a sawl hi. Ama pei-in a kungah, “Khuopi khat sungah mi ni om a, khat hau-in a khat zawng hi.","ref":"Late 51 Thulu"},"2":{"text":"Mihaupa in tuuhon le bawnghon tampi nei hi;"},"3":{"text":"ahi vangin a zawngpa in a leisa tuuno a nu khat losie bangma a nei sih hi. Ama in tua tuuno anva a, ama le a tate tawh a khangton hi; tua tuuno in ama’ an ne-in a hai panin dawn a, a kang sungah lumin ama adingin a tanu khat tawh a kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Khatvei, mihaupa’ inn ah zin khat tung a, tuale ama in ama kunga tung zinpa neh dingin a tuuhon pan hile a bawnghon pan hile khat zong a gaw nuom sih a, mizawngpa’ neisun a tuuno lahpiehin ama kunga tung zinpa a gaw zawsop hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua mipa tungah David a sinso mama hi. Ama in Nathan kungah, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin tam banga a gamta mipa a si dingin kilawm hi;"},"6":{"text":"ama in hepina nei loin tam bangin gamta ahi ziehin tua tuuno a za li-in a sangkia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Nathan in David kungah, “Tua mipa khu nang na hi hi! Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Keima in Israel tungah kumpi-in nang sathau kang nu a, Saul’ khut sung panin kang hunkhie hi;"},"8":{"text":"keima in na pu’ inn kang pie a, na pu’ zite na kang sungah a om hi. Israel innkuon le Judah innkuon zong nangma kang pie hi; tuale tam teng a tawm luo ahile tua sangin a tamzaw kang piehbe lai ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama muna-ah a sie gamta dingin bang dingin Topa thugen simmaw na hei? Namsau tawh Hit mi Uriah satlia-in na zi dingin ama’ zi na la a, Ammon-te’ namsau-in ama na that zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang in kei ei thusim loin na zi dingin Hit mi Uriah’ zi la zo na hi ziehin namsau in na inn a lawi ngai sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Keima in na innkuon sung panin nangma langah buoina ka piengsah ding hi; tuale na muna-ah na zite la-in na vengpa ka pie ding a, tuale ama in suntang laipi-in na zite a luppi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang in na dapbawl ahi hi; ahi vangin keima in Israel zosie mai-ah suntang laipi-in ka bawl ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 16:22"},"13":{"text":"David in Nathan kungah, “ Topa tungah ka maw zo hi,” a ci hi. Nathan in David kungah, “Tu-in Topa in na mawna la sieng zo hi; nang na si sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle tam bang gamtatna tawh Topa thusim lo na hi ziehin na sung pana ang pieng ding nausen si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin a inn ah Nathan a pei hi. Uriah’ zi in David tawh a nei nausen pen Topa in vatin nahpi-in a ci a na pai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nausen adingin Pasien kungah David in a thum hi; David in zong an tangin tuolpuongah a zan lup hi.","title":"Bathsheba’ Nausen Si"},"17":{"text":"Ama pangah ama’ innsung upate a ding vua, tuolpuong panin a thawto nadingin ama a zawl uhi; ahi vangin ama thoto nuom loin amate tawh zong an ne nuom lo hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in tua nausen a si hi. Tua nausen a si lam David’ nasemte in David a ko ngam sih uhi; azieh pen amate in, “Ama in nausen hinlai bawnin i hopi vangin i thugen ngai nuom lo hi; tua ahile ama kungah nausen si ta ci’n bang i ci gen thei ding ahei? Ama le ama ang kibawlsie kha thei ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle a nasemte’ kidap ho David in a mu ciengin nausen si hi, ci-in a thei ta hi; tuale David in a nasemte kungah, “Nausen a si ta amah?” a ci hi. Tuale amate in zong, “Ama si ta,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuolpuong lah panin David tho-in kisil a, sathau kinu-in a puonte a khel hi. Topa’ inn sungah ama tumin Pasien bie hi; tua ciengin a inn ah ama a pei hi; tuale ama in an a nget ciengin amate in a mai-ah an a lui vua, tuale ama in a ne hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nasemte in ama kungah, “Tam banga na gamtat a bang bep ahei? Nausen a hin lai-in an tangin na kap hi; ahi vangin nausen a si bepin tho-in an na ne zawsop hi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in, “Nausen a hin lai-in an tangin ka kap hi; azieh pen keima in, ‘Nausen a hin nadingin Topa in ei lungsiet khah ding koi in thei ahei?’ ka ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in ama si ta zuh a; bang dinga ken an ka tan tha ding ahei? Ama ka hingsah theikia ding amah? Ama kungah kei ka pei ding a, ahi vangin kei kungah ama ang kinuale ta sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in a zi Bathsheba hlai a, a kungah pei-in a luppi hi; tuale ama in tapa khat nei a, tuale ama in a min Solomon hisah hi. Topa in ama it a,","title":"Solomon Suoh"},"25":{"text":"tuale kamsang Nathan tungtawnin thu a puoh hi; tuaci’n ama in Topa ziehin a min Jedidiah a phuoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in Joab in Ammon-te’ Rabbah simin kumpi khuopi a la hi.","title":"Ammon-te Kinuoicip (1Khg 20:1-3)"},"27":{"text":"Joab in David kungah kamtaite sawlin, “Rabbah ka sim zo hi; tua banah a khuopi tuikhuh zong ka la zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin tu-in mi a omlai teng khawmtuo inlen, khuopi langah phuol satin khuopi la in; tua ahi sihle kei mama in tua khuopi ka la ding a, keima’ min a puo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in mi zosie kaikhawmin Rabbah ah pei a, tua khuopi simin a la hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in Milcom lu tung panin a kumpi lukhu a lahpieh hi; tua lukhu kham talen khat gih a, a sungah suong manpha khat a om hi; tuale David’ kumpi lukhu tungah tua suong manpha kikoi hi. Ama in khuopi sunga van kinuasie tampitah zong a peipi hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in a sunga om mite peipi-in sing-at ding, tuzumte le sia heite tawh na sem dingin koi a, tehlei khenna-ah amate na a semsah hi. Tua bangin ama in Ammon-te’ khuopi zosie tungah a bawl hi. Tua ciengin David le mi zosie Jerusalem ah a kilekia uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun phabeppi khat ang tawp hi. David’ tapa Absalom in sanggam numei a melhoi mama khat nei a, a min Tamar kici hi; tuale David’ tapa Amnon in tua nu a deigaw hi.","title":"Amnon le Tamar"},"2":{"text":"Amnon in a sanggamnu Tamar a dei seng ziehin a natlaw vawt hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama pen ngahnu siengtho ahi ziehin Amnon in ama bangma law thei lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Amnon in David’ sanggampa Shimeah’ tapa Jonadab kici guolpa khat nei hi; ama pen mi khel mama khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Amnon kungah, “Kumpipa tapa aw, bang dinga zingmawng khat zaw zingmawng khat hici gawn semsem mawh na hei? Ei gen lo ding na mah?” a ci hi. Amnon in ama kungah, “Ka sanggampa Absalom’ nau nu Tamar deigaw ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Jonadab in ama kungah, “Na lupna tungah lum inlen a cina kipang in; tuale ang ve dinga na pa ang pei ciengin ama kungah, ‘Keima in mu-in ama’ khut panin an ka neh thei nadingin Tamar hing pei-in ka neh ding bangkhat ei bawlpieh heh,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Amnon lumin a cina a kipang hi; tuale a ve dingin kumpipa a pei ciengin Amnon in kumpipa kungah, “Ama’ khut panin an ka neh thei nadingin ka nau nu Tamar hing pei-in ka muna-ah moh pheng ni haw khat nang bawlsah nadingin kang thum hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in inn-a Tamar kungah mi sawl a, “Na sanggampa Amnon’ inn ah va haw ta’nlen a neh ding an va bawlpieh ta’n,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sanggampa Amnon lupna inn ah Tamar a va haw ta hi. Tua nu in annel lom la-in meh a, ama muna-ah mophengte bawlin tua mohte a em hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in khangbel la-in a mai-ah a thuapieh vangin ama in a ne nuom sih hi. Amnon in, “Ka kung panin mi zosie pusuohsah in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama kung panin mi zosie a pusuoh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amnon in Tamar kungah, “Na khut panin an ka neh thei nadingin inndan sungah an hing tawi in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Tamar in a bawlsa mophengte la-in inndan sung ama’ sanggampa Amnon kungah tuate a peipi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle a neh dingin tuate ama kungah a tawi ciengin, ama in tua nu pummatin ama kungah, “Hing pei inlen kei ei luppi in, ka sanggamnu aw,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua nu in dawng a, “Hi lo hi, sanggampa aw, ei paubawl sin; azieh pen Israel sungah tam bangin kigamta ngai lo hi; tam bangin gitlo gamtat vawt sin!"},"13":{"text":"Hei sungah ka mai laa ngam nawn ding ka hei? Nang zong Israel sungah mi ginalo khat na hi ta ding hi. Tua ahi ziehin tu-in kang thum hi, kumpipa kungah gen in; bang ding ahei cile ama in nang tawh kei ei khaam lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in tua nu thugen a ngai sih hi; tuale ama nu sangin a hatzawh ziehin ama in hatthawthu tawh buonin a luppi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amnon in Tamar a nah huot mama hi; a cil-a ama nu a lunggulna sangin a huotna a lienzaw ta vanuh hi. Amnon in tua nu kungah, “Pei dawh ta’n!” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle tua nu in ama kungah, “Hi lo hi, ka sanggampa aw; azieh pen kei tunga nei bawlsa khielna sangin kei nei sawldawhna lienzaw hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a nasem tangvalpa hlanin, “Ka kung panin tami numei notmang inlen, ama nua-ah kot kalh in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"(Tua nu in puontuolpi a ban nei khat a sil hi; azieh pen kumpipa’ tanu ngahnu siengthote nidang lai-in tua banga na kivon uh ahi hi.) Tuaci’n a nasempa in a pulamah tua nu notdawhin kot a kalh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Tamar in a lu tungah vut buohin ama’ sil puontuolpi bansau botkeh hi; ama nu in a lu tungah a khut koi-in a peikawmin a gingin kap hi."},"20":{"text":"A sanggampa Absalom in ama kungah, “Na sanggampa Amnon in ang luppi ta amah? Tu-in dai in, sanggamnu aw; ama na sanggampa ahi hi; tam thu na lungsimah koi da ta’n,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Tamar pen a sanggampa Absalom’ inn ah numei lungzuong khatin a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpi David in tam thu teng zosie a zah ciengin lungthah mama a, ahi vangin ama pen a tacil ahi a, ama a it ziehin a tapa Amnon dan a pie sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Absalom in Amnon kungah a pha hile a sie hile bangma gen vet lo hi; azieh pen ama in a sanggamnu Tamar a buon ziehin Absalom in Amnon a muda hi."},"23":{"text":"Kum ni bih a cin zaw ciangin Absalom in Ephraim gei-a Baal-hazor ah tuumul heu pawi bawl a, Absalom in kumpipa’ tapate zosie hlan hi.","title":"Absalom in a Sanggamnu’ Kibawlsietna Phula"},"24":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah Absalom pei a, “Na nasempa in tuumul heute ka nei hi; nei hepina-in kumpipa le a nasemte, na nasempa tawh nang pei zo ding vuoi mah?” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in Absalom kungah, “Hi sih, ka tapa aw, ka unpi-un ei peisah sin; hing pei uleng zong nang adingin vangih ka suoh ding uhi,” a ci hi. Ama in paugen a, ahi vangin ama pei nuom loin ama thupha a pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Absalom in, “Tua bang ahi thei vawt sih ding leh ka sanggampa Amnon beh tawh ei zawhsah in, hing thum ing,” a ci hi. Kumpipa in ama kungah, “Ama bang dinga nang tawh hing pei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin Absalom in ama tawh Amnon le kumpipa’ tapa zosie a zawsah masangsie ha genin a gen hi. Absalom in kumpipa’ pawi tawh a kibang pawi khat a bawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Absalom in a nasemte thu pie a, “Amnon’ zu lungnop hun khu melci unlen, keima in na kung vuah, ‘Amnon sat un,’ kang ci ciengin ama that un. Zau sih un; kei mama-in thu hing pie zo hi lo ka mah? Kihangsah unlen, hangsan un,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Absalom thupiehsa bangin a nasemte in Amnon a bawl uhi. Tua ciengin kumpipa’ tapa zosie dingin a laa tung ciet vuah tuongin a tai uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amate lamkal a gei laitahun David kungah thu tung a, “Absalom in kumpipa’ tapate that sieng ta, koima khat beh kihen nawn sih,” kici hi."},"31":{"text":"Kumpipa dingin a puonte botkeh a, tuol sena’n a kinei pai hi; tuale ama kunga a ding a nasem zosie in a puon a botkeh uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin David’ sanggampa Shimeah’ tapa Jonadab in, “Kumpipa’ tapa zosie that sieng ta uhi, ci-in ka pu in ngaisun sin; Amnon khat maimai si ahi bo hi. Amnon in a nau nu Tamar a pumbuon ni-a patin Absalom in tam thu a na vaihawmsa ahi ta bo hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ziehin tu-in kumpipa’ tapa zosie si sieng ta hi, ci-in ka pu in tam thu na lungsim sungah koi sin; azieh pen Amnon khat maimai si ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin Absalom a taimang hi. Galvil tangvalpa a khuodah leh muolpang Horonaim lampi panin mi tampi a pei mu hi."},"35":{"text":"Jonadab in kumpipa kungah, “En in, kumpipa’ tapate ang pei ta uhi; na nasemte gen bangin pieng tahpi hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"A thugen a man zaw lienin kumpipa’ tapate tungin awngin a kap uhi; tuale Kumpipa le a nasem zosie zong nahpitahin a kap uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin Absalom taimang a, Geshur kumpipa Ammihud’ tapa Talmai kungah a pei hi. A tapa ziehin David ni khat zaw ni khat a kapkap hi.","ref":"2Sam 3:3"},"38":{"text":"Geshur ah Absalom tai a, khum sungah kum thum sung a om hi."},"39":{"text":"Kumpipa’ lungtang sungah Absalom kunga haw ding a hlagul hi; azieh pen tu-in Amnon sina tung tangah ama a kihlai zo ta hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Absalom tungah kumpipa’ lungsim a om lamtah Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in a thei hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Absalom Kilekia"},"2":{"text":"Joab in Tekoa ah mi sawlin khum mun panin numei pil khat zawpi hi. Ama in tua numei kungah, “A kap kipang in; dana puonte sil in, sathau kinu sinlen, ni tampi sung si-uop numeite bangin om in."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah pei inlen ama kungah tam bangin gen in,” a ci hi. Tuale Joab in tua nu tungah a thugen dingte a mop hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah Tekoa numei a tun ciengin a mai tuolah kunin zatahna a pie hi. Ama in, “Ei hu in, Kumpipa aw!” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua nu kungah, “Na lungkhamna bang ahei?” a ci hi. Tua nu in dawng a, “Kadei, kei pen meigong numei khat ka hi hi; ka pasal lah si zo ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Na nasem nu in tapa ni nei a, lolai-ah ama gel a kihau uhi; a phel ding koima om loin khat in a khat pa satin a that hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in a innkuon buppi-un na nasem nu’ langkhatah a ding uhi. Amate in, ‘Ama in a tha a sanggampa’ hinna tangin ama ka tha thei nadingun a sanggampa a satpua pa ei pie in, gamhluo pa nangawn zong ka susie ding uhi,’ ei ci uhi. Amate in a omlai ka kinepna pa tua bangin ei suhsietpieh vua, leitungah ka pasal’ min le a suonlehlah themkhat zong a om lo dingin ei bawl uhi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in tua nu kungah, “Na inn ah pei in, keima in nang tungtang thu ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tekoa numei in kumpipa kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa aw, kei tung le ka innkuon tungah mawna tu hinlen, kumpipa le a mangtona mawpeng taheh,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Na kungah mi khatpo in thu khatpo ang gen leh ka kungah tua mipa hing peipi in. Ama in nang ang thamkia ngai nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Sisan phulapa in that nawn loin ka tapa a kisuhsiet lo nadingin hepina tawh kumpipa in na lungsim sungah Topa na Pasien hing phawh bo in,” a ci hi. Ama in, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin na tapa’ samzam khat zong tuolah kie lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin numei nu in, “Hepina tawh na nasem nu in ka pu kumpipa tungah kam khat ei gensah in,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Gen in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Numei nu in, “Tua ahile Pasien’ mite langkhatah bang dinga tam bang na bawl sawm ahei? Bang ding ahei cile tam bang khensatna a piehna-ah kumpipa in a gamdel mipa inn ah na hlatkia masangsie, kumpipa ama le ama a kimawsah ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Eite i unpi-in i si ding hi; eite pen tuola kibuo a kiluoh thei lo tui tawh kibang i hi uhi. Ahi vangin Pasien in hinna khat pen a mawh lah sih hi; ama in a opna pana a kipuse mi khat a khantana a kihawlkhiet lo nadingin ama in lampi gelpieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in ka pu kunga tam thu gen dinga ang pei ka hi hi, azieh pen mite in kei ei zausah hi; na nasem nu in, ‘Kumpipa kungah thu ka gen ding hi; kumpipa in a nasem nu’ ngetna ang sem kha ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kumpipa in za-in, Pasien’ gouluo panin kei le ka tapa ei sumangton ding mipa’ khut sung panin a nasem nu a hunkhie ding hi,’ ci-in a ngaisun hi."},"17":{"text":"Na nasem nu in, ‘Ka pu kumpipa’ kammal in ei toidamsah ding hi,’ ci-in ngaisun hi; bangzieh ahei cile ka pu kumpipa pen a sie le a pha khentel thei Pasien’ vantungmi tawh kibang hi. Nang tawh Topa na Pasien hing omton taheh!” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 19:27"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in numei nu dawng a, “Kang dawh popo ei pha sin,” a ci hi. Numei nu in, “Ka pu kumpipa in gen in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Tam thu zosie Joab’ hing thupieh ahiei mah?” a ci hi. Numei nu in dawng a, “Ka pu kumpipa aw! nang a hing tahtah na hi ma bangin, ka pu kumpipa in na gensa thute panin koima zietlam hile veilam hile a piel thei sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile kei ei sawlpa pen na nasem pa Joab ahi hi; na nasem nu’ kam sunga tam thu ei mop pa zong khu ama ma ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Na thu peizie na khel nadinga na nasempa Joab in tam thu a bawl ahi hi. Ahi vangin ka pu in leitunga om na vannuoi theithei nadingin Pasien’ vantungmi’ pilna tawh a kibang pilna na nei hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Joab kungah, “Hoi mama hi, tam kang pie hi; va pei inlen tangval Absalom hing zawpikia in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuolah Joab khupbawhin zatahna pie a, kumpipa thupha a pie hi; tuale Joab in, “Kumpipa in a nasempa ngetna pie zo ta ahi ziehin tuni-in ka pu kumpipa mai-ah maipha ka nga zo hi, ci thu na nasempa in ka thei ta hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joab kuon pai a, Geshur ah pei-in ama in Jerusalem ah Absalom a zawpi hi."},"24":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ama a inn ah peisah in; ka opna-ah ama ang pei sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n a inn ah Absalom pei-in kumpipa opna-ah pei lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Israel zosie sungah a melhoina ziehin Absalom banga phattah ding koima om lo hi; a ketaw panin a luzang dong ama tungah muhkaw ding bangma om lo hi.","title":"David in Absalom Maisah"},"26":{"text":"Ama in a luzang sam a heu ciengin (bangzieh ahei cile kum tawp sielin ama in a sam a heu let hi; a sam a gih seng ciengin a heu hi), a luzang sam tawi a te a, kumpipa’ tawikhaina-ah a te ciengin shekel zani gih hi."},"27":{"text":"Absalom sung panin tapa thum, le Tamar kici ta numei khat a pieng hi; tua nu pen numei melhoi khat ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa’ opna-ah pei loin Jerusalem ah kum ni tangcim Absalom a teng hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Absalom in kumpipa kungah ama zawpi dingin Joab hlan ding mi a sawl hi; ahi vangin ama kungah Joab pei lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a nasemte kungah, “En un, Joab’ logam, kei-a’ tawh kizon lien ahi hi. Khumtahah ama in mangbuham nei hi; pei unlen mei tawh vahal ta un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Absalom’ nasemte in tua logam mei tawh a hal uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joab dingin a inn-a om Absalom kungah haw a, “Na nasemte in bang dinga ka logam ei halpieh uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Absalom in Joab dawng a, “En in, nang kam kang vaihlah hi: Kumpipa kungah nang hing sawlin, “Bang dinga Geshur pana hing pei ka hei? Khum munah om lai leng kei adingin hoi zaw ngel ding hiven,” a cisah dingin tam sungah hing pei ta’n ang ci ka hi hi. Tu-in kei kumpipa opna-ah ei peisah inlen, mawna ka nei tah leh zong ama in ei that taheh!’ ka ci hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joab in kumpipa kunga a gen ciengin ama in Absalom hlan dingin mi sawl pai hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa kungah ama haw a, kumpipa mai-ah khupbawhin a mai tuolah a kun hi; tuale kumpipa in Absalom a nam hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin Absalom in sakol leeng khat le a sakolte, le a mai-a tai ding mi sawmnga a kithawisah hi.","title":"Absalom in Kumpi Tokhom Tu"},"2":{"text":"Absalom thobai-in kul kotpi lam gei-ah ding zel hi; tuale mi khatpo in thu nei-in kumpipa mai-ah a tut ciengin Absalom in hlan zelin, “Koi khuo pan na hiei?” a ci hi. Mipa in, “Na nasempa, Israel sunga tua minam tua khuote ka hi hi,” a ci ciengin"},"3":{"text":"Absalom in, “En in, na thunei pen hoi a, zong a dih hi; ahi vangin kumpipa in na thu ang zahpi ding mi koima ngansie a nei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Absalom in a genbe lai a, “Gam sunga thukhen khat hi leng maw! Tua ciengin mi tawh kiheh, ahi sihle thunei zosie ka kungah hing pei va-un, ke’n zong a thu uh a tangin khenpieh ma ding hi veng,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama tungah zatahna pie dingin mi khat in ama kung nai-in a pei sielin a khut zahin tupomin a nam zel let hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin Absalom in kumpi kunga thukhensah dinga ang pei Israel-te tungah a gamta hi; tuaci’n Absalom in Israel mite’ lungsim a guhpieh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kum li a cin ciengin Absalom in kumpipa kungah, “Hebron ah ei peisah inlen, Topa kungah ka ciemsa ka thuciem ei bawlsah in, ci-in kang thum hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Aram-a Geshur ah ka op laitahin na nasempa in thuciem khat ka na bawl hi: Jerusalem ah Topa in ei peipikia tahtaha ahile Hebron ah Topa ka bie ding hi, ka ci hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama kungah, “Lungmuong tahin pei in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tho-in Hebron-ah ama a pei hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Absalom in Israel minam zosie kungah kamtaite sawldapin, “Note in pengkul gin na zah behun tam bangin awng un: Hebron ah Absalom kumpi suoh zo hi!’ ci-un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem panin Absalom tawh mi za ni a pei uhi; amate ahile a kiciel zinte ahi vua, lungsim hoi tawh pei-in bangma thu a thei sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Absalom in biehpiehna a pieh laitahin a khuopi Gilon panin David’ thu kuppipa Gilon-te Ahitophel a hlansah hi. Sawmdapna thahat semsem a, Absalom nuazui mi a khang tehteh hi."},"13":{"text":"David kungah kamtai khat tung a, “Absalom lamah Israel-te’ lungtang pei sieng zo hi,” ci-in a gen hi.","title":"Jerusalem panin David Taimang"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Jerusalem-a ama tawh a omton ama’ ulien zosie kungah, “Tho un! Tai vai, tua hi sihle Absalom kung panin i suotah nading uh om lo ding hi. Manlang un, tua hi sihle ama in ei pha pai ding hi, ama in i tung vuah gimna ang tungsah ding a, namsau tawh khuopi ang sim ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa’ uliente in kumpipa kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa in na khensat popo sem dingin na nasemte a baisa ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa pei-in inn ngaih dinga a nuasie a mei numei sawmte simlo a innkuon zosie in ama’ nua a zui uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa pei-in mi zosie in ama’ nua a zui uhi; tuale inn tawpna pen khatah amate a khawl uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ama’ ulien zosie in ama a makhel uhi; tuale Chereth-te zosie, Peleth-te zosie, le Gath pana ama ang zui Gitt-te mi za guhte zosie, kumpipa’ mai nawhin pei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gitt-te Ittai kungah, “Nang in zong bang dinga nei zui ahiei? Nuakia inlen kumpipa tawh omton in; bangzieh ahei cile nang gamdang mi na hi a, na gam pana ang kinotmang na hi bo hi."},"20":{"text":"Zani ahiei khat a ang tung pan hi bo cin a, kei na ngawn in zong nang hei lam zuon ding ci kang thei lo laitahin tuni-in kote tawh a vah kawikawi dingin kang pui ding amah? Na sanggamte zawpi inlen peikia ta’n; tuale Topa in nang tungah a itna kip le a thumanna hing lah taheh,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanle Ittai in kumpipa dawng a, “ Topa hing a, ka pu kumpipa zong a hing ahi ma bangin, ka pu kumpipa opna popo-ah si leng hing leng na nasempa kang pei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"David in Ittai kungah, “Tua ahile pei in, peisuoh in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Gitt-te Ittai, a mite zosie le a zawpi numei naupang zosie tawh a peisuoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi zosie a pei laitahin gam sung mi zosie a gingin a kap uhi; kumpipa in Kidron Lui galkai-in mi zosie in senel gam lam a manaw uhi."},"24":{"text":"Abiathar a peito a, tuale Zadok zong Levi-te zosie tawh pei-in Pasien’ thuciemna singkuong a puo uhi. Mite in khuopi a kal zaw masangsie amate in Pasien’ thuciemna singkuong a nga phot tadi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Zadok kungah, “Khuopi sungah Pasien’ singkuong puokia in. Topa’ maipha ka mu leh ama in kei ei puohkia ding a, tuami le a opna mun ei musahkia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, ‘Nang tungah lungkim sing,’ ei ci leh tanah kei ka om hi, ama in hoi a sah bangin kei tungah bawl taheh,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in zong siempu Zadok kungah, “En in, nuom tahin nangma le Abiathar, na tapa nite Ahimaaz le Abiathar’ tapa Jonathan tawh khuopi sungah peikia ta un."},"28":{"text":"En un, kei thu ei puoh dingin nangma kung panin thu ang tun masang senel gam sunga tanmunte-ah kang na ngah ding hi,” cibe lai hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalem-ah Zadok le Abiathar in Pasien’ singkuong a puokia vua, tua munah ama gel a om uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Olive Muoltung katona lam zuonin a pei pumin David kap a, puon kilukhu-in a keng guohin lam a pei hi; a zawpi mi zosie puon kilukhusa-in a peito pumun a kap uhi."},"31":{"text":"David kungah, A sawmsim mite lahah Ahithophel zong Absalom tawh kipawl hi,” ci-in kigen hi. David in, “ Topa aw, kang thum hi. Ahithophel’ thumopte motna-in na heipieh in,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Pasien biehna muol vumah David a tun ciengin a dawn dingin a puontungsil balkehsa le a lu tungah leivui bangsa-in Archi mi Hushai a pei hi.","title":"Hushai, David’ Thukan Suoh"},"33":{"text":"David in ama kungah, “Kei nei zui suoh leh kei adingin vangih na hi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuopi sungah peikia-in Absalom kungah, ‘Kumpipa aw; masang lai-a na pa’ nasem ka hi ma bangin tu-in zong nangma’ nasem ka hi ding hi,’ ci-in va gen ta’n, tua hile keima dingin Ahithophel’ thumopte na sumit thei ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Khum munah nang tawh siempu Zadok le Abiathar ang om ding uhi. Tuaci’n kumpipa’ inn sunga na thu zah poma Zadok le Abiathar siempu tegel kungah gen in."},"36":{"text":"Khum munah amau’ tapa gel, Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz le Abiathar’ tapa Jonathan, tawh a omton uhi; tuale ama gel tungtawnin na thuzah zosie kei nei theisah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalem ah Absalom a lut laitahin David’ guolpa Hushai zong khuopi sungah a pei hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in muolvum a hlen zep tahin Mephibosheth’ nasempa Ziba in anlum zani, lengga a kiphogawsa bawh zakhat, khal theiga zakhat le lenggazu savun thawldim khat a puo, a phaw kivawsa laa ni tawh ama na lamdot hi.","title":"David’ Alangte","ref":"2Sam 9:9-10"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa in Ziba kungah, “Tamte bang dinga nei puoh ahei?” a ci hi. Ziba in dawng a, “Laate kumpipa’ innkuonte tuon nading, anlum le khal theigate tangvalte neh ding, le lenggazu pen senel gama a basamte dawn ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Tua ahile na pu’ tapa hei sunga om ahiei?” a ci hi. Ziba in kumpipa kungah, “Ama Jeruaslem-ah om hi. Bang ding ahei cile ama in, ‘Tuni-in Israel innkuon in ka pu’ kumpi gam keima ei piekia ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 19:25-27"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Ziba kungah, “Mephibosheth’ neisa zosie tu-in nang-a’ ahi ta hi,” a ci hi. Ziba in, “Keima in nang zatahna kang pie hi; ka pu kumpipa’ muna-ah maipha ei musah ta’n,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Bahurim-ah Kumpi David a tun ciengin ama a samsie dingin Saul’ innkuon sunga a innsung mi, Gera’ tapa Shimei kici pa khat a pei hi; a samsiet kawmin ama a peikhie hi.","title":"Shimei in David Samsie"},"6":{"text":"Ama in Kumpi David le a nasemte zosie suong tawh sep hi; tua laitahin mi zosie le galhang zosie a ziet a vei-ah a om uhi."},"7":{"text":"Shimei in a samsiet kawmin, “Peimang! Peimang! Tuol thatpa! Mi ginalo Pa!"},"8":{"text":"Ama tanga na uh Saul innkuonte’ sisan luongsah na hi ziehin Topa in nang tungah ang thuh zo hi; tuale Topa in na tapa Absalom tungah na kumpi gam a pie zo hi. En in, gimna in ang nuaphah zo hi; bangzieh ahei cile nang sisan luongsah mipa na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zeruiah’ tapa Abishai in kumpipa kungah, “Tami uisi tawh a kibang lel khat in bang dinga ka pu kumpipa hici samsiet viel ding ahei? Ei kuonsah inlen a lu ei tansah in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in, “No Zeruiah’ tapate aw, kei le no bang kisai i hei? Topa in ama kungah, ‘David va samsie tan,’ a ci zieha ei samsiet ahile koi in, ‘Bang dinga na tuaci bawl ahei?’ ci thei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"David in Abishai le a nasem zosie kungah, “Keima’ tapa bawn in tha dingin ei sui zuh a; tu-in tam Benjamin mipa in bangza-in ei suizaw kan lai ding ahei! Ama’ thu-in omsah unlen ei samsiesah lel un; bangzieh ahei cile Topa in ama a sawl zong hi thei kha ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in ka gentheina ei ensuhin tuni-in tam banga ei kisamsietna ziehin Topa in a hoi tawh kei ei thuh kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n lampi-ah David le a mite a pei vua, ama tawh kigalsai muolpangah Shimei a pei laitahin, ama in a pei kawmin ama samsie-in suong tawh sepin leivui a the hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa le a zawpi mi zosie lamba-in Jordan ah a tung uhi; tuale khum munah ama kitoidamsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Jerusalem ah Absalom le Israel-te zosie a tung uhi; Ahithophel zong ama tawh a om hi.","title":"Ahithophel’ Thumopna"},"16":{"text":"Absalom kungah David’ guolpa, Archi mi Hushai a tun ciengin Hushai in Absalom kungah, “Kumpipa damsawt heh! Kumpipa dam sawt heh!” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Absalom in Hushai kungah, “Tam khu na guolpa tunga na thumanna pen amah? Bang dinga na guolpa tawh zawh lo na hiei?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Hushai in Absalom kungah, “Hi lo hi; Topa le tam mite le Israel-te zosie in a teelsa uh mipa-a’ ka hi ding a, ama tawh ka om ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua banah a koi pen’ na sem ding ka hei? Ama’ tapa hi lo ding amah? Na pa’ na ka sep bang lienin nangma’ na zong ka sem ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Absalom in Ahithophel kungah, “Thu ei kuppi in; bang bawl ding i hei?” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahithophel in Absalom kungah, “Na pa in inn ngah dinga a nuasie a meite va luppi ta’n; tua hile na pa’ huot thei dinga nang le nang na kibawl lam Israel zosie in za-in tuaci’n nang tawh ang om mi zosie’ khutte ang thakhau tuom ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in zong innkhum zangah Absalom adingin puonbuh khat a lam uhi; Israel zosie’ mitmu-in Absalom in a pa’ meite a luppi hi.","ref":"2Sam 12:11-12"},"23":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Ahithophel’ thumopte Pasien’ thuphuon bangin kingaisun hi; tuaci’n David le Absalom in Ahithophel’ thumopte zosie thupi sim tuoh uhi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua tham loin Ahithophel in Absalom kungah, “Mi tul sawmle tulni ei teelsah in, keima kuonin tuzanin David va nuadel ta vang."},"2":{"text":"Ama a gim le a lungkieh petin keima in va simin ka va zausisah ding hi; tua hile ama panpi zosie a taimang sieng ding uhi. Keima in kumpipa ngentang ka that ding a,"},"3":{"text":"tuale motha nu in a pasal kung a zot bangin na kungah mi zosie kang zawpikia ding hi. Nang pen mi khat lien beh tha ding a sui na hi a, midang zosie lungnuomin om ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ngaisutna in Absalom le Israel upa zosie a lungkimsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Absalom in, “Archi mi Hushai zong va hlan ta un. Ama’ thugen ngai phot vai,” a ci hi.","title":"Hushai’ Thumop"},"6":{"text":"Absalom kungah Hushai a tun ciengin Absalom in, “Ahithophel’ thugen tam teng dan ahi hi; ama’ genna banga i man ding uh amah? Ahi sihle nang in gen in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hushai in Absalom kungah, “Tu tunga Ahithophel’ ang thumop a hoi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hushai in a genban zom a, “Na pa le a mite galhang behbeh ahi vua, gam sunga a note a kilahpieh vompi bangin a hangsan lam uh na thei hi. Tua banah na pa galbawl kiva mama khat ahi hi; galkapte tawh zanin ama a giehton sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu nangawnin ama dum khat sungah ahiei, ahi sihle mundang khatah ahiei kiphuol zo ta kha ding hi. I galkapte uh pawlkhat kido cilna-ah si uleh tua thu a za poma in, ‘Absalom nuazui galkapte lahah mi a si tam mama hi,’ ci ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin humpi lungtang a kuo galhangpa nangawn cieng zau-in lungkie ding hi; azieh pen na pa galhang ahi a, ama panpi zosie zong galhat ngentang a hina thu Israel zosie in a thei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ang thumop nop pen ahile Dan panin Beer-sheba dong, tuipi gei-a senel za-a a tam Israel mi zosie na kungah khawm inlen, nang mama gal sim dingin kuon in."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in eite in zong i mumuna vuah amate i sim ding vua, amate tungah tuol a daitui kie bangin i kie ding uhi; ama hile ama panpite hile khat beh suohta lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Khuopi sunga a nuakia leh Israel zosie in tua khuo sungah khauhuol tawi-in suongpem khat nangawn a kimu lo dongin kuom sungah tua khuopi i kaimang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Absalom le Israel mi zosie in, “Ahithophel’ thumop sangin Archi mi Hushai’ thumop hoizaw hi,” a ci uhi. Bang ding ahei cile Topa in Absalom tungah sietna a tunsah thei nadingin Ahithophel’ thumop khu a guolel mawng dinga Topa’ sesa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hushai in siempu Zadok le Abiathar kungah, “Tua bang tua bangin Ahithophel in Absalom le Israel upate kungah thu a mop hi; tuale keima in zong tua bang tua bangin thu ka mop hi.","title":"Hushai in David’ Suotah ding Gen"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mallangin mi sawl gel inlen David kungah, “Tu zanin senel gam tanmunte-ah na gieh sinlen, ahi thei bang bangin na galkai zaw in; tua hi sihle kumpipa le a zawpi zosie ang kivaltum ding hi,’ ci-in gensah in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Enrogel ah Jonathan le Ahimaaz in a ngah uhi; nasem numei khat va pei zelin ama gel kungah thu gen a, ama gel in zong kumpi David kungah tua thu a gensawn zel uhi; bangzieh ahei cile khuopi sungah mite’ mu-in ama gel lut ngam lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin naupang khat in ama gel mu-in Absalom kungah a sawm hi; tuaci’n a ni gelin a nawtai pai vua, a inn huong sunga tuikhuh nei Bahurim-a mi khat kungah tungin tua tuikhuh sungah a kumsuh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua mipa’ zi in tuikhuh kamsin khat la-in tuikhuh kam tungah pha a, tua tungah an a pho hi; tua thu koima’n a thei sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Numei nu’ inn ah Absalom’ nasemte a tun ciengun, “Ahimaaz le Jonathan hei ta uh ahei?” a ci uhi. Tua numei nu in amate kungah, “Ama gel luigal a kai zo ta uhi,” a ci hi. Amate in a sui kawikawi vua, a mu zo lo bepun Jerusalem-ah a kilekia uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate a peizaw ciengun tuikhuh panin ama gel a kato vua, kumpi David kungah a gen ding teng va pei-in a gen uhi. Ama gel in David kungah, “Pei inlen luigal kai ta naw’n; azieh pen tua bang tua bangin nangma langkhatah Ahithophel in thumop hi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n David le a zawpi mipi zosie kisa pai-in Jordan gun a galkai uhi; khuo a vah ciengin Jordan galkai lo mi koima om nawn lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahitophel in a thumop a kizui lo lam a thei ciengin a laa phaw pha a, tuaci’n a khuo-a inn ah a pei hi. Ama in a inn sung vaiteng hawmin a gui-awh hi; ama si-in a pa’ hanah kivui hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel mite zosie tawh Absalom Jordan a galkai laitahun Mahanaim ah David a tung hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Absalom in galkapte tunga a uh dingin Joab’ munah Amasa koi hi. Amasa pen Joab’ nu Zeruiah’ naunu Nahash’ tanu Abigail tawh kinung Ishmael mi Ithra kici mipa khat’ tapa ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel-te le Absalom in Gilead gamah giephuol sat uhi."},"27":{"text":"Mahanaim ah David a tun ciengin Ammon-te’ gam Rabbah panin Nahash’ tapa Shobi, le Lo-debar panin Ammiel’ tapa Machir, le Rogelim panin Gilead mi Barzillai in"},"28":{"text":"lupnate, kisilna kuongte, le leibeelte, mangbu, mangbuham, an, ankan, bepi le besante,"},"29":{"text":"khuoizu le bawngnawi-thaukhalte, tuu le sathaukhalte zong David le a zawpite neh dingin a puo uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in, “Senel gamah galkapte gilkielin gimin dangta uhi,” a ci uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in a zawpi a mite khawmin a tultul a uhte le a zaza a uhte-in a koi hi:","title":"Absalom’ Sina le Gallelna"},"2":{"text":"Tuale David in a galkapte se thum a suo a, sekhat Joab’ uhna nei-ah, sekhat Joab’ sanggampa Zeruiah’ tapa Abishai’ uhna nei-ah, sekhat Gitt mi Ittai’ uhna nei-ah koi hi. Kumpipa in mite kungah, “Kei mama zong no tawh kang kuon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin mite in, “Nang, nang kuon sih ding hi. Azieh pen kote tai uleng amate in khawh ei sa lo ding hi. Mi alang khat si nan uleng zong khawh ei sa tuom lo ding uhi. Ahi vangin kote mi tulsawm za-in nang na manpha hi; tua ahi ziehin ei hu ding khuopi panin mi hing sawl lacin hoizaw hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in amate kungah, “No hoisah pen bangin kang bawl na ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n gal sim dingin galkapte zosie a tultul a zaza-in a kihonzawt laitahun kul tunkot pangah kumpipa a ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in Joab, Abishai, le Ittai-te kungah, “Keima nei khuolna-un tangvalpa Absalom hing dawm bo vuo izaw,” a ci hi. Mi zosie in Absalom tawh kisai-a kumpipa in galkapmang zosie tunga a thupiehte a za uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n gamlahah Israel do dingin galkapte a kuon uhi; tuale Ephraim gammang tulahah a kido uhi."},"7":{"text":"Khum munah David’ nasemte in Israel mite a zo vua, khum ni-in mi kithat a tam mama a, a si mi tul sawmni pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Gam sung muncin tengah gal kidona kizel hi; tuale khum ni-in namsau’ tha sangin gamlahah a si mi tamzaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Absalom in David’ nasemte tuoh kha khelkhel hi. Absalom a laa tungah tuong a, gangpi sing golpi a ba pha mama nei khatah a laa tai-in gangpi ba lahah a lutang awh a, a laa taisuohin vanlelei kikalah a kikhaisa-in ama a kinuasie hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khat in mu a, Joab kungah, “Gangpi singba kawmah Absalom a kikhailawng ka mu hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Joab in ama kunga thugen pa kungah, “Bang e na gen, ama na mu i! Tua ahile bang dinga khumnah ama satlia-in tuoldenna nang nei pai lo ahiei? Ngun peh sawm le kawnggah khat beh hing pie ngel ma ding hi veng,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua mipa in Joab kungah, “Ka khut sungah ngun shekel tulkhat nangawn ei kipie le zong kumpipa’ tapa tha nadingin ka khut ka hlang sih ding hi; azieh pen kote zahin kumpipa in nang, Abishai, le Ittai tam bangin thu ang vaihlah hi: Keima nei khuolna-un tangvalpa Absalom hing dawm bo un!’ ang ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Thu dang khatah kei zuoutatin ama’ hinna that mawh leng, (kumpipa tungah bangma phuolsel om lo hi), nang mama kikangkoi-in nei hum tuom sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Joab in, “Tam bangin nang tawh hun mawh tawpsah sih vang,” ci-in ama in teipi thum la-in gangpi singba kawmah a hinglai-in Absalom’ lungtang sontah sun pailet hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale Joab’ galhiem a puo tangval sawm in Absalom imtawmin a satlia uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joab in zong pengkul tum a, Israel-te a delna panun galkapte a kilekia uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Joab in galkapte a khaam hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Absalom luonghawm a la vua, gamlaha dum golpi khat sungah ama pai-in ama tungah suongcien gol mama khat a ciengto uhi. Khum laitahin Israel-te zosie a inn ciet vuah a taimang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Absalom in ama’ khan sungin kumpipa’ kuomah khuompi khat la-in ama adingin phut hi, azieh pen ama in, “Keima’ min a kiphaw nading tapa ka nei sih hi,” a ci hi; ama in tua khuompi pen ama’ min tap a, tuni cieng dongin Absalom’ Muolsuong kici hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz in, “Keima ei taisah inlen, Topa in a galte’ vanglietna panin ama hunkhie zo hi, ci-in kumpipa kungah thu ei puohsah in,” a ci hi.","title":"David in Absalom’ Si Za"},"20":{"text":"Joab in ama kungah, “Tuni-in nang in lungdamna thu na puoh thei sih ding hi; nidang khat ciengin thu na puoh thei pan beh ding a, ahi vangin tuni-in tua bang na bawl thei sih ding hi, azieh pen kumpipa’ tapa si zo hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joab in Cush mipa kungah, “Pei inlen na sil musa teng kumpipa kungah va gen in,” a ci hi. Cush mipa zong Joab mai-ah kunin a tai pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz in Joab kungah, “Bangbang hi leh Cush mipa’ nua-ah ei taisah in,” cikia hi. Joab in, “Lungdamna thu puohna ziehin thaman nga tuom ngap lo ding, bang dinga tai sawm na hei, ka tapa aw?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in, “A suoh nuom suoh, kei zong ka va tai ta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in, “Tai in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin zanglei lam zuonin Ahimaaz a tai a, Cush mipa a makhel hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua laitahin kul kotpi a sungta pen le a puta pen kikalah David a to hi. Galvil pa kulkotpi khumzang a pang panin kato-in a dahto leh ama guoha ang tai mi khat a mu hi."},"25":{"text":"Galvil pa awngin kumpipa kungah gen hi. Kumpipa in, “Ama guoh ahile lungdamna thu hing tut ahi hi,” a ci hi. Ama nawtai-in a neh semsem hi."},"26":{"text":"Galvil pa in mituom a tai khat mukia hi; galvil pa in kot cingpa hlanin ama kungah, “En in, mituom khat ama guohin ang taikia ta!” a ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Ama zong lungdamna thu ang puoh ma ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin galvil pa in, “Pasal ang tai masa pa Zadok’ tapa Ahimaaz’ taidan tawh kisun sa veng aw,” a ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Ama mihoi ahi a, lungdamna thuhoi tawh ang tung ahi hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa kungah Ahimaaz kiko a, “Na zosie hoi hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciengin kumpipa mai-ah a mai kunin tuolah khupbawh a, “ Ka pu kumpipa’ langkhatah a khuttum a ziel mite nangma khut sunga ang pie Topa na Pasien in thupha nga taheh,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Tangval Absalom a dam nai mah?” a ci hi. Ahimaaz in dawng a, “Joab in na nasempa ei sawl laitahin buoina lienpi khat ka mu a, ahi vangin bang ahei ci ka thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Kihei inlen tanah ding in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama kihei-in pia lo-in a ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Cush mipa a tung hi; tuale Cush mipa in, “Ka pu kumpipa adingin lungdamna thu ahi hi! Azieh pen tuni-in Topa in na dihna a talang zo ta a, nangma langkhatah a ding mi zosie’ vanglietna panin ang hun zo hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Kumpipa in Cush mipa kungah, “Tangvalpa Absalom a dam nai mah?” a ci hi. Cush mipa in dawng a, “Ka pu kumpipa’ galte, le na siet nadinga na langa dingte zosie tua tangvalpa bang taheh,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Kumpipa’ lungsim nahpi-in sukha a, tunkot tunga inndanah a kato pumin a kap hi; tuale ama in, “Aw ka tapa Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa Absalom! Nang si tangin kei sizaw ve leng izaw. Aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!” a ci hi.","title":"David in Absalom Kaa"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joab kungah, “Absalom ziehin kumpipa kap le mau-in om hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-a galzawna pen galkap zosie adingin dana le kaana a suoh ta hi; azieh pen khum ni-in galkapte in, “Kumpipa a tapa ziehin a da mama hi,” ci-in thu za uhi."},"3":{"text":"Galtaite maizumin a daptun vakhuan bangun khum ni-in khuopi sungah galkapte a daplut uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in a mai khu-in nahpi tahin kap a, ‘Aw ka tapa Absalom, Aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa’ inn sungah Joab tum a, ama in, “Tuni-in nangma’ hinna, na tanu na tapate’ hinna, na zite le na meite’ hinna ang hunkhie na galkap ulien zosie na maizumsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang ang mudate na it a, nang ang itte na muda zawsop hi. Nang adingin galkapmangte le galkap uliente bangma ahi lo lamtah tuni-in na sulang zo ta hi; azieh pen Absalom hing hinlen, kote zosie tuni-in si sieng uleng na nop zawh ding ka thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu mama-in va pei tanlen na nasemte kamdam no tawh va hopi in; azieh pen na pei sih poma leh tuzan ciengin mi khat zong nang kungah om nawn lo ding hi, ci-in Topa’ minin ka kiciem ngam hi. Tuale tam thu pen na tangval-a kipan tu cieng dong na tunga ang tungsa gimna khat popo sangin nang adingin ang siehuoi zaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa dingin kultunkot gei-ah a to hi. Galkapte kungah, “En un, kultunkotah kumpipa a to hi,” ci-in kigen sieng hi; tuale kumpipa mai-ah galkap zosie a pei uhi. Khum hun laitahin Israel-te zosie a inn ciet vuah a taimang sieng uhi."},"9":{"text":"Israel minam zosie sungah mi zosie a kisel vua, tuale amate in, “Kumpipa in i galte khut sung panin ei hlakhie a, Philistia-te khut sung panin ei hunkhie hi; tuale tu-in Absalom ziehin gam sung panin ama taimang zo hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah David Kihlankia"},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite tungah kumpi dingin sathau i nupa uh lah gal sungah si zo hi. Tua ahi ziehin tu-in bang dinga kumpipa nua zawpikia nading bangma na gen lo uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpi David in siempu Zadok le Abiathar tungah tam thu puoh a, “Judah upate kungah tam bangin gen un: Kumpipa a inna peipi nukhia pen ding na hi uh amah?’ ci un. Kumpipa kungah Israel mi zosie’ thugen tung zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Note ka tanau na hi vua, note ka tel ka vo na hi uhi; bang dinga kumpipa peipi nukhia pen hi ding na hi uh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Tuale Amasa kungah, “Nang ka tel ka vo hi lo na mah? Tuaci’n tu-a patin nang Joab’ tanga ka galkapmangpa na hi sih tah leh Pasien in kei ei dop bawl sih taheh” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amasa’ thugen in Judah mi zosie’ lungsim hawisahin a kithukhatsah pai a, amate in zong kumpipa kungah thu puohin, “Nangma le na nasemte zosie hing kilekia ta un,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jordan ah kumpipa kilekia hi; tuale kumpipa dawn ding le Jordan gal kaipi dingin Gilgal ah Judah a pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpi David dawn dingin Benjamin-te Gera’ tapa Shimei zong Judah mite tawh mallangin a peisuh hi;","ref":"2Sam 16:5-13"},"17":{"text":"ama tawh Benjamin mi tulkhat a om hi. Tuale Saul’ innsung nasem Ziba, a tapa sawm le nga le a nasem sawmni tawh a zawh vua, kumpipa’ mai Jordan ah nawtai suhin,"},"18":{"text":"kumpipa’ innkuonte a galkaipi ding le ama dei banga na sem dingin tanmun ah amate a galkai uhi. Jordan a galkai kuon ding ciengin kumpipa mai-ah Gera’ tapa Shimei bawhsuh a,"},"19":{"text":"kumpipa kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa in Jerusalem na nuasie ni-a na nasempa in na tunga kang bawl khielna ka pu in ei mawsah loin ei ciemte sin; Kumpipa in ngaisutin ei nei sin.","title":"David in Shimei a Hepina"},"20":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile na nasempa in ka maw lam ka thei hi; tua ahi ziehin, en in, ka pu kumpipa dawn dinga ang kuonsuh Joseph’ innkuon zosie sung panin tuni-in ang tung masa pen ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Abishai in a dawng a, “Shimei in Topa’ sathau nupa a samsiet ziehin ama tha pai ding hi lo amah?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin David in, “No Zeruiah’ tapate aw, tuni-in kei ei langpang dinga bang hing kikumthaw na hi uh ahei? Israel gam sungah tuni-in mi khatpo kithat ding amah? Bangzieh ahei cile tuni-in Israel-te’ kumpipa ka hi lam thei buong sam hi lo ka mah?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa in Shimei kungah, “Nang na si sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale kumpipa in ama tungah kiciemna a bawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Kumpipa dawn dingin Saul’ tupa Meiphibosheth a peisuh hi; Kumpipa a pei ni-a kipanin dam le bihin a tunkia ni dongin ama in a keng sil lo, a khamul heu loin a puon zong sawp lo hi.","title":"David le Mephibosheth Kimu","ref":"2Sam 9:1-13; 16:1-4"},"25":{"text":"Kumpipa tawh kimu dingin Jerusalem a tun ciengin kumpipa in, “Mephibosheth, bang dinga kei nei zui lo ahiei?” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “Ka pu, kumpipa aw, ka nasempa in kei ei sol hi; azieh pen na nasempa in a kungah, ‘A tungah tuongin kumpipa tawh ka zaw thei nadingin kei dingin ka laa-phaw va guong tan,’ ka ci hi.
