Azieh pen na nasempa a khelbai ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in ka pu kumpipa kungah na nasempa ei mindaisah zo hi. Hinanle ka pu kumpipa pen Pasien’ vantungmi tawh a kibang hi; tua ahi ziehin hoi na sah bangin ei bawl in."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen ka pu kumpipa mai-ah ka pa’ innkuon zosie si ding beh ngaha om ahi bo uhi. Hinanle nang in na sabuoi-a an a ne mite lahah kei nei koi hi. Tua ahi ciengin kumpipa kungah bang hamphatna kang ngen kan nawn ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama kungah, “Bang dinga na kungtung thu na hici gengen ahei? Ka khensatsa ahi hi: Nangma le Ziba in leitang na hawm ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Mephibosheth in kumpipa kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa dam le bihin inn nang tun buongin ama a unpi-in lasah in,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Rogelim panin Gilead-te Barzillai a peisuh hi; Jordan gal khatah a cing dingin kumpipa tawh ama a peisuh hi.","title":"Barzillai’ Tunga David’ Migitna","ref":"2Sam 17:27-29"},"32":{"text":"Barzillai pen a khangham mama mi khat ahi a, kum sawmgiet a pha hi. Mahanaim ah kumpipa a op laitahin ama in an le tui na sih zing hi, azieh pen ama mihau mama khat ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Kumpipa in Barzillai kungah, “Jerusalem-a ka kungah ei zui in, keima’n nang va vang,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin Barzillai in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa tawh Jerusalem-a kang peito na valia dingin kei kum bangza hing lai ding ka hei?"},"35":{"text":"Tuni-in kum sawmgiet ka cing ta hi; a nuom le a nuom lo zong ka khen thei tha ding amah? Na nasempa in ka neh ka dawnte zong a tui lam ka thei nawn beh ding amah? Lasa numei le pasalte’ awging zong ka za thei nawn beh ding amah? Tua ahi ciengin bang dinga na nasempa, ka pu kumpipa vangih kibelap na bep dinga hing om ding ka hei?"},"36":{"text":"Na nasempa in Jordan tuipi gal khatah bakhat sung ang zui ding hi. Bang dinga kumpipa in khum bang thaman ei pieh son ding ahei?"},"37":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa’ han gei-a keima’ khuo sunga ka si thei nadingin na nasempa hepina tawh ei kilesah kia ta’n. Hinanle tanah na nasempa Chimham om hi; ka pu kumpipa tawh ama zawhton heh; tuale nangma’ hoisah popo ama adingin bawlpieh in,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Kumpipa in dawng a, “Chimham tawh ka zawh ding a, nang hoisah bangin ama ading ka bawlpieh ding hi; tuale kei tung pana na dei vannuoi nang adingin kang bawlpieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi zosie in Jordan galkai-in kumpipa zong a galkai hi; kumpipa in Barzillai namin thupha pie a, tuale a inn ah ama a kilekia hi."},"40":{"text":"Gilgal dongah kumpipa a peisuoh hi; tuale Chimham zong ama tawh a zawh hi; Judah mi zosie le Israel mi alang in zong a pei nading lampi-ah kumpipa a hla uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel mi zosie in pei-in kumpipa kungah, “Bang dinga ka sanggam uh Judah mite in nangma hing gumangin, kumpipa le a innkuonte, le David’ mi zosie ama tawh, Jordan galah zawpi uh ahei?"},"42":{"text":"Judah mi zosie in Israel mite dawngin, “Kumpipa pen ko tawh a kinai tanau ka hi zieh uh ahi hi. Tuale tam thu-ah bang dinga lungthah na hi uh ahei? Kumpipa’ sum tawh anne tuidawn ka hi son uh amah? Ahi sihle ama in kote letsong khatpo ei pie amah?” a ci uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel mite in Judah mite dawngkia-in, “Kumpipa sungah tanh sawm ka nei vua, David’ sungah zong no sangin tam ka neizaw uhi. Tuale note in bang dinga nei ci nuoisie uh ahei? I kumpipa nua lahkia dinga thugen masa koma ka hi sih uh amah? Ahi vangin Israel mite’ thugen sangin Judah mite thugen a bunzaw hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Benjamin mi, Bichri’ tapa Sheba a kici mi ginalo khat khum sungah na om kha hi. Ama in pengkul mutin, “David sungah tanh i nei sih a, Jessi’ tapa sungah gamh i nei sih hi! Israel aw, mi zosie na puonbuh vuah pei un!” ci-in a kiko hi.","title":"Sheba’ Langpanna","ref":"1Kum 12:16; 2Khg 10:16"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel mi zosie in David a nuasie vua, Bichri’ tapa Sheba a zui uhi; ahi vangin Judah mite in Jordan panin Jerusalem cieng dong a kumpipa uh kiptahin a zui uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem-a a inn ah David a tung hi; tuale kumpipa in a inn ngah dinga a nuasie a mei sawmte khawmin inn khatah amate cingsahin an le tui a pie hi, ahi vangin ama in amate a luppi nawn sih hi. Tuaci’n a si dongun inn sungah amate kikhumcipin meigong numei bangin hinkhuo a mang uhi.","ref":"2Sam 16:22"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Amasa kungah, “Ni thum sungin Judah mi zosie ka kungah hing khawm inlen, nang mama zong tanah hing om in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judah hlan dingin Amasa a kuon hi; ahi vangin a kiniciem hunin ama tung loin a kiheh hi."},"6":{"text":"David in Abishai kungah, “Tu-in Bichri’ tapa Sheba in Absalom sangin ei bawlsie zaw ding hi; na pu’ nasemte zawpi inlen ama va nuadel ta’n, tua ahi sihle ama’n ama adingin kul tawh ki-im khuopite mu-in eite kung panin a pitmang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Abishai’ nua-ah Joab le Chereth-te, Peleth-te, le mi thahat zosie kuon uhi; Bichri’ tapa Sheba nuadel dingin Jerusalem panin amate a kuon uhi."},"8":{"text":"Gibeon-a suongpi opna mun a phah tahun, amate tawh kimu dingin Amasa a pei hi. Tu-in Joab in galkap puon sil a, tua tungah a pai-a kisiet namsau khat kivaw kawnggah khat a kawngah a gah hi; ama a mai-ah a pei phei leh tua namsau tuolah kie hi."},"9":{"text":"Joab in Amasa kungah, “Ka sanggampa, na dam nai mah?” a ci hi. Tuale Joab in ama nam dingin a zietlam khutin a khamulah Amasa a man hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Amasa in Joab’ khut sungah namsau a op lam a phawh kha sih hi; Joab in a gilpi dawtpiehin a sungkuo teng tuolah luongkhe-in ama a si hi. Tua ciengin Joab le a sanggampa Abishai in Bichri’ tapa Sheba a nuadel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale Amasa gei-ah Joab’ mite khat dingin ama in, “Joab panpi poma, le David-a’ ahi poma in Joab nua zui un,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Lam lienpi tunga ama’ sisan sungah Amasa kidie-in a om hi. Tuale lamlienpi-a pei mi zosie in ama a mu ciengun a dinkhawl uhi. Ama kunga a pei mi zosie a khawl lam a mu ziehin ama in lamlienpi panin gamlahah Amasa’ luong puo-in ama puon khat a se hi."},"13":{"text":"Lamlienpi panin ama’ luong a kihep sieng bepin Bechri’ tapa Sheba del dingin Joab’ nua-ah mi zosie a peisuoh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Sheba in Beth-maacah gam Abel dong Israel minam zosie a nawhsuoh hi; tuale Bichri’ mi zosie kikhawmin ama’ nua zui-in a sungah a tum uhi."},"15":{"text":"Joab’ galkapte pei-in Beth-maacah gam Abel ah ama a kui-im uhi; amate in khuopi tawh kimaingatin kulpi mai-ah leicien a bawl uhi. Joab’ galkapte in kulpi a cipzan thei nadingin a susie uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin numei pilvang khat in khuopi panin hlanin, “Ngai un! Ngai un! Joab kungah gen un, ‘Tam tahah hing pei in, nangma kungah thu kang gen nuom hi,’ ci-un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua numei nu gei-ah ama pei a, tua nu in, “Joab kici nang na mah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Hi na’ng,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Na nasemnu’ thugente ei ngaipieh in,” a ci hi. Ama in dawngin, “Kang ngaipieh hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama nu in, “Khanglui lai-in mite in, ‘Abel ah thu dongsah un,’ a ci thei zel uhi; tuaci’n amate in thukhenna na bawl zel uhi."},"19":{"text":"Kei pen Israel sungah kilemna a dei le a muontah mi khat ka hi hi; nang in Israel sungah nu tawh a kibang khuopi khat suhsiet na sawm hi; bang dingin Topa’ gouluo valtum ding na hei?” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Joab in dawng a, “Valtum ding hile suhsiet ding hile bawl vawt sih vang!"},"21":{"text":"Tua khu thuman ahi sih hi! Ahi vangin Ephraim muoltung gam mi Bichri’ tapa Sheba a kicipa khat in kumpi David do nading a khut a hlang hi; ama beh ei pie in, tua hile khuopi panin ka pei ding hi,” a ci hi. Numei nu in Joab kungah, “Kulpi panglam na kungah a lutang ang kisepsuh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin numei nu in a pilna zangin khuopi sunga mi zosie kungah a pei hi. Tuale Bichri’ tapa Sheba’ lu tansanin Joab sena-in a nei uhi. Tuaci’n ama in pengkul mut a, Joab in Jerusalem-a kumpipa kung a zot lai tahin, khuopi panin amate kithezahin a inn ciet a zuon uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tu-in Joab in Israel galkap zosie makai hi; Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah in Chereth-te le Peleth-te a makai hi;"},"24":{"text":"Adoram pen thona-aana nasemte uhpa ahi hi; Ahilud’ tapa Jehoshaphat pen thuciemte pa ahi hi;"},"25":{"text":"Sheva pen thuvanpi pa ahi hi; Zadok le Abiathar pen siempute ahi uhi;"},"26":{"text":"tuale Jair mi Ira zong David’ siempu ahi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in kum khat zaw kum khat, David’ khan sungin kum thum sung kielpi a tung hi; tuale David in Topa kungah thu dong hi. Topa in, “Ama in Gibeon-te a tha ziehin Saul le a innkuon tungah sisan luonsahna zieha khielna a om hi,” a ci hi.","title":"David in Gibeon-te’ Phula"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in Gibeon-te hlanin amate a hopi hi. (Tu-in Gibeon-te pen Israel mite ahi sih vua, Armor mi a omlaite ahi uhi. Amate hinkhawi dingin Israel mite kiciem zo napi Israel mite le Judah mite ading a deisah luotna-in Saul in amate thagam ding na hanciem hi.)","ref":"Josh 9:3-15"},"3":{"text":"David in Gibeon-te kungah, “Note dingin bang kang bawlpieh diei? Topa’ gouluo thupha na pieh thei nadingun bangci danin kilemna kang bawl thei diei?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Gibeon-te in ama kungah, “Kote le Saul ahi sihle a innkuon tawh kikal thu pen ngun le kham tawh a mai thei ding ahi sih hi; Israel sunga mi khatpo ka tha zieh vua zong lungkim zawh nading a om sih hi. Ama in, “Note ading kang bawlpieh ding bang hi, na ci uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in kumpipa kungah, “Israel gam sung teng zosie-ah mun ka nei lo nadingun kote ei thatgamin ei suhsiet sawm mipa-"},"6":{"text":"kote tungah a tapa sagite ei piesah inlen, kote in zong Topa’ muoltunga om Gibeon-a Topa mai-ah amate ka khailia ding uhi,” a ci uhi. Kumpipa in, “Amate kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in David le Saul’ tapa Jonathan kikala om Topa tawh kiciemna ziehin Saul’ tupa, Jonathan’ tapa Mephibosheth a hinkhawi hi.","ref":"1Sam 20:15-17; 2Sam 9:1-7"},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in Aiah’ tanu Rizpah’ tapa ni, Saul tawh a nei Armoni le Mephibosheth; le Saul’ tanu Merab in Meholah mi Barzillai’ tapa Adriel tawh a nei a tapa ngate a la hi;","ref":"1Sam 18:19"},"9":{"text":"ama in Gibeon-te tungah tua teng pie a, amate in Topa mai muol tungah a khailia uhi. Amate a sagi-in a siton uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Aiah’ tanu Rizpah in la-ip puon la-in, anlah huna kipan guotui kieh dongin suong khat tungah ama adingin pha a, tua misi luongte tungah sunlai-in vana leng vate hile zanlai-in gamsate hile a tusah sih hi."},"11":{"text":"David kungah Saul’ meinu Aiah’ tanu Rizpah’ bawl dante a kigen ciengin"},"12":{"text":"David pei-in Gilboa muol tungah Philistia-te in Saul a tha lai vua Philistia-te in amate a khailupna mun Bethshan-a mipi kikhopna panin amate a guhpieh Jabesh-gilead mite tung panin Saul’ gute le a tapa Jonathan’ gute a lakia hi.","ref":"1Sam 31:8-13"},"13":{"text":"Ama in khum mun panin Saul le a tapa Jonathan’ gute a puoto hi; tuale amate in a kikhailum mite’ gute zong a khawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Zela khuo Benjamin’ leitang, a pa Kish’ han sungah Saul le a tapa Jonathan’ gute a phum vua, kumpipa’ thupieh zosie a sem uhi. Tua zaw ciengin Pasien in khum gam adinga thumnate a sang hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel tawh Philistia-te a kidokia vua, ama’ nasemte tawh David a kuonsuh hi. Amate in Philistia-te a sim vua, David a gim mama hi.","title":"David’ Mite Hanciemna (1Khg 20:4-8)"},"16":{"text":"Migolte suonlehlahte khat, a teipi sumngo shekel zathum a gih, galhiem a tha khat a kuo Ishbi-benob in David ka that ding hi, a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle ama hum dingin Zeruiah’ tapa Abishai pei a, Philistia mipa simin that hi. Tua ciengin ama tungah David’ mite kiciemin, “Israel’ meivah na suhmit lo nadingin ko tawh galdo dingin nang kuon nawn sih ding hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"1Kum 11:36; Late 132:17"},"18":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin Gob ah Philistia-te tawh gal kidona omkia hi; tua ciengin Hushath mi Sibbecai in migolte’ suonlehlahte khat ahi Saph that hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gob ah Philistia-te tawh galkidona adang khat om leuleu hi; Bethlehem-te Jaare-oregim’ tapa Elhanan in a teibul siamgante’ siemlawng cie bang a pha, Gitt-te Goliath that hi."},"20":{"text":"A khutphang langkhat tuohah khutme guh, a kephang langkhat tuohah keme guh, a unpi-in sawmni le li a nei migol khat a opna mun ahi Gath ah gal om leuleu hi; ama zong migolte’ suonlehlahte khat ma ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Israel a tawh ciengin David’ sanggampa Shimei’ tapa Jonathan in ama that hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam mi li teng Gath-a migolte’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi; David le a nasemte’ khutlum tawh amate a si uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in a galte zosie’ khut sung le Saul’ khut sung panin ama a hutkhiet ni-in David in tam latengte Topa kungah na sa hi.","title":"David’ Lungdamkona La (Late 18:1-50)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a gen hi: “ Topa khu ka suongpi, ka kulpi, kei ei hunkhie pa,"},"3":{"text":"ka Pasien, ka kibuhna ka suongpi, ka lum le ka hutdamna saki, ka mun muonhuoi le ka belh, ka hundam pa ahi hi.; nangma in a tatsie mite panin kei nei hundam hi."},"4":{"text":"A phat tah Topa ka hlan a, ka galte khut sung panin kei ei kihundam hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sina tuihuolte in kei ei imtawm a, manthaina tuikhangte in keima ei nawh hi;"},"6":{"text":"Misikhuo khauhuolte in kei ei kantawm a, sina thangte in kei ei dawntuo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka genthei hunin keima in Topa’ kungah ka thum hi; ka Pasien kungah keima ka tau hi. A biehinn panin ama in ka aw za a, ama in ka kikona a bil ei ngat hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama’ lungthah ziehin leitung kithingin, nahpi-in kilawh gawp a, vantung dopphate kiling gawp hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama’ nahkuo panin meikhu a pusuoh a, ama’ kam sung panin mi katum thei mei a pusuoh hi; ama tung panin mei-am a kuong hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in vantungte kunsahin a kumsuh vua; ama’ keng nei-ah khuomu tawkhalpi om hi."},"11":{"text":"Cherub khat tungah ama tuongin leng a; hui’ hlate tungah ama kimu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a kimvelah khuomiel a siem a, a tungkhu dingin tui kikhawmtuo meii sapi zang hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama’ mai-a a taang sung panin mei-amte a kuong hi."},"14":{"text":"Van panin keh kie bangin Topa awngsuh a; Sangpen Pa in ama’ aw a gingsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in thaltangte kapin tuate thethang a, ama in tun phesahin amahaw a delmang hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ phawsiet zieh le ama’ nahkuo panin a naahu a hla ziehin, tuipi tawdopte kimu a, leitung bulpite kidawh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mun sang panin ei banin ei kai a, tui hatpi lah panin ei kaikhie hi."},"18":{"text":"A thahat ka galte kung pan le ei mudate kung panin kei ei hunkhie hi; azieh pen amate a thahat mama hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka tuosiet ni-in kei ei bulu vua, ahi vangin Topa khu ka kingapna ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in mun tanzau ah kei ei zawpi a; ka tungah a lungkim ziehin ama in kei ei hunkhie hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka dihna tawh kizui-in Topa in thaman ei pie a; ka khutte a sienthona tawh kizui-in ama in kei ei dinkia hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ lampite ka zui zo ta a, keima in gitlo bawlin ka Pasien ka taisan sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama’ ngaina kip zosie, ka mai-ah a op ziehin, ama’ thukhamte panin kei ka piel sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama mai-ah kaw ka baang sih a, khielna panin ka kikoicing hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in keima’ thumanna zui le ama muna-ah ka sienthona zui-in kei ei dinkia zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Thuman mi tungah thumanna na lah a; kawbaang lo mi tungah kawbaan lona na lah hi.","ref":"Late 18:25"},"27":{"text":"A siengtho mi tungah na sienthona na lah a, a lungkawi mite tungah na letatna na lah hi."},"28":{"text":"Nang in mi neilutte na hunkhie a, hinanle a kiliensah mite na niemkhieh hi."},"29":{"text":"A tahtahin Topa aw, nang ka meivah na hi a, Topa in keima’ khuomiel a vahsah hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang ziehin galkap honkhat ka sumaimang a, Ka Pasien ziehin khuokul khat ka kan zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam Pasien a lampi bukim a; Topa’ kamciem a tangtung hi; ama a bel zosie adingin kidalna lum ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa simlo Pasien koi ahei? I Pasien simlo, suongpi koi ahei?"},"33":{"text":"Pasien in keima thahatna ei guon a, ka lampi ei gol honpieh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in keima’ kephangte sazuhpi kephang bangsah a, a sangna munah ei ding kipsah hi.","ref":"Hab 3:19"},"35":{"text":"Ama in galsim nadingin ka khutte ei cil a, tuaci’n ka bante in sumngo thal a kuoi zo hi."},"36":{"text":"Na hundamna lum kei nei pie zo ta a, nangma’ ei panpina in kei nei liensah hi."},"37":{"text":"Suohta tahin kal nei suonsah a, ka kitawnkhaw sih hi;"},"38":{"text":"ka galte delin ka susiemang a, amate a manthai masangun kei ka kinuale sih hi."},"39":{"text":"A tho zo nawn lo dingin amate sumangin ka satpua a; ka kephang nei-ah amate puamat uhi."},"40":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma in galdo nadingin thahatna kawnggah tawh nei gah a; kei ei dote ka nei-ah na siel hi."},"41":{"text":"Nangma in ka galte, kei ei mudate, na nuakiasah a, keima in amate ka susie gawp hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate a khuodah vua, ahi vangin a hundam ding koima om lo hi; Topa kungah a kiko vua, hinanle ama in dawng lo hi."},"43":{"text":"Leivui bangin amate ka satvui a, lam lai-a buon nawi bangin amate ka tuonmat a, ka sianal hi."},"44":{"text":"Kei ei langpang mite panin kei nei hunkhie a, minamte’ lutangin nei koi hi; ka theikhah lo mite in ka na a sem uhi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang mite ka mai-ah kunin ka thugen a zah behun, ka thu a mang uhi."},"46":{"text":"Gamdang mite a lungkie vua, a mun muonhuoite panin citunin a peikhie uhi."},"47":{"text":"Topa hing hi! Ka suongpi in thupha nga hinlen, ka Pasien, ka hundamna suongpi, kitawisang taheh."},"48":{"text":"Phu ei lahpieh Pasien in mite ka keng nei-ah koisuh a,"},"49":{"text":"ka galte khut sung panin ei peipi a; ei langpangte tungah ei tawisang hi. Thagumhat mite khut sung panin ama in kei ei hunkhie hi."},"50":{"text":"Topa aw, tam thu ziehin minamte lahah kang phat ding a, na minphatna la ka sa ding hi.","ref":"Rom 15:9"},"51":{"text":"Ama pen a kumpipa adingin hutdamna tausang ahi a, ama in a sathaunu pa David le a suonlehlahte tungah tangtawngin a itna kip a lah hi,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng khu David’ kam nukhiate ahi hi: Pasien in a tawisang mipa, Jacob’ Pasien in sathau a nu pa, Israel a thahat pa’ angvan pa, Jessi tapa David’ thuphuon tam bang ahi hi: Topa’ hlagau in kei tungtawnin thu gen a,","title":"David’ Kam Nukhiate"},"2":{"text":"Ka kam sungah ama’ kammal a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel Pasien in thu gen zo a, Israel Suongpi in kei kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Mi khat in mite tungah thumanna tawh uhin Pasien zatahna tawh a uh ciengin,"},"4":{"text":"tua khu zingmawng meii kai lo ni-a a suoh ni taang tawh kibang a, guo a zuh zaw ciengin lei lahah a po lopa dawngte tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka innkuon zong Pasien tawh tua bangma hi lo amah? Azieh pen ama in kei tawh tawntung thuciemna bawl zo a, na zosie a hoi a kipin a bawl hi. Ama in ka lunggulna le ei panpina zosie ang kibelapsah sih ding amah?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien thei lote ahi uleh a kipaimang ling kungte tawh kibang hi; bangzieh ahei cile khut guoh tawh amate kitham thei lo hi;"},"7":{"text":"tua bangte a tham ding poma in siatawn ahi sihle teizum zang a, amate mei tawh a kihaltum sieng hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam teng David’ nei galhang mite’ min ahi hi: Josheb-basshebeth pen Tahchemon-te a hi hi; ama pen Thumte a uhpa ahi hi; ama in a teipi tawi-in mi zagiet thakhatin that hi.","title":"David’ Mi Thahat Mite (1Khg 11:10-47)"},"9":{"text":"Ama zomah Ahohi’ tapa, Dodo’ tapa Eleazar pen galhang thumte lahah khat ahi hi. Khum munah galsim dinga kikhawm Philistia-te a phin lai-un David tawh ama a om hi. Israel-te a nuakia vua,"},"10":{"text":"ahi vangin a dinna tuolah ama a ding den hi. A bante khamin a khut le a namsau a kimat dongin ama in Philistia-te a satlia hi. Topa in khum ni-in guolzawna lienpi tungsah hi. Tua ciengin ama kungah mite a kilekia vangun misite van khawm ding beh ahi bo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama zomah Harar mi Agee’ tapa Shammah ahi hi. Beli a dima a pona mun Lehi-a lozau-ah Philistia-te a kikhawm uhi; tuale Philistia-te kung panin galkapte a taimang uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hizongle ama lozau laikimah pangin tua lo hung a, Philistia-te that hi; tuale Topa in guolzawna lienpi a piengsah hi."},"13":{"text":"Anlah kipat hunin Adullam leihawm-a om David kungah ama pawl dingin uhpi sawmthumte sung panin mi thumte a peisuh vua, tua hun laitahin Philistia-te honkhat in Rephaim kuomah giephuol a sat uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin mun muonhuoi sungah David a om hi; tuale Bethlehem ah Philistia khuocingte a om uhi."},"15":{"text":"David in lunggulna tawh, “Mi khat in Bethlehem tunkot gei-a tuikhuh panin ka dawn ding tui ei saw leh nuom sam vang e!” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bepin galhang thumte in Philistia-te’ galphuol a phukeh vua, tunkot gei-a om Bethlehem tuikhuh panin tui tawi-in David kungah a peipi uhi. Ahi vangin ama in tua tui dawn lo hi; ama in Topa adingin tua tui a sung hi,"},"17":{"text":"azieh pen ama in, “ Topa aw, tami tui ka dawn vawt sih ding hi. A hinna uh khama a va peite’ sisan ken ka dawn thei ding amah?” a ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama in a dawn sih hi. Galhang thumte in tam bangin a sem uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Zeruiah’ tapa Joab’ sanggampa Abishai pen mi Sawmthumte a uhpa ahi hi. Ama in a teipi tawh mi zathum simin that a, ama in mi Thumte banah minthanna nga hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing Sawmthumte sung panin ama a mindawh pen ahi a, amau’ makai a suoh hi. Ahi vangin ama in tua mi Thumte ban zo lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Kabzeel khuo panin Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah zong a hang le galdo a siem, na golpi a sempa khat ahi hi; ama in Moab-te Ariel’ tapate ni a satlia hi. Vua kieh ni khatin ama zong peisuhin leihawm sunga om humpi khat that hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Egypt-te a melhoi khat that hi. Egypt-pa in a khutah teipi tawi hi; ahi vangin Benaiah in ciengkhut khat tawi-in ama kungah pei a, Egypt-pa’ khut sung panin a teipi lahpiehin ama’ teipi ma tawh ama that hi."},"22":{"text":"Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah in tua bang teng na bawl a, galhang Thumte banah min na nga hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama pen mi Sawmthumte lahah a min kidawh a, ahi vangin ama in mi Thumte pha zo deu lo hi. David in ama pen ama cingte uhpa-in koi hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi Sawmthumte lahah Joab’ sanggampa Asahel; Bethlehem-te Dodo’ tapa Elhanan;"},"25":{"text":"Harod-te Shammah, Harod-te Elika;"},"26":{"text":"Palti-te Helez; Tekoa-te Ikkesh’ tapa Ira;"},"27":{"text":"Anathoth-te Abiezer; Hushath-te Mebunnai;"},"28":{"text":"Ahoh-te Zalmon; Netophah-te Maharai;"},"29":{"text":"Netophah-te Baanah’ tapa Heleb; Benjamin-te’ gam sunga om Gibeah-te Ribai’ tapa Ittai;"},"30":{"text":"Pirathon-te Benaiah; Gaash gei-a kuom panin Hiddai;"},"31":{"text":"Arbath-te Abi-albon; Bahurim-te Azmaveth;"},"32":{"text":"Shaalbon-te Eliahba; Jashen’ tapate: Jonathan"},"33":{"text":"Harar-te Shammah’ tapa , Harar-te Sharar’ tapa Ahiam;"},"34":{"text":"Maacah-te Ahasbai’ tapa Eliphelet; Gilon-te Ahithophel’ tapa Eliam;"},"35":{"text":"Carmel-te Hezro, Arbi-te Paarai;"},"36":{"text":"Zobah-te Nathan’ tapa Igal; Gad-te Bani;"},"37":{"text":"Ammon-te Zelek; Beeroth-te Naharai; Zeruiah’ tapa galhiem a tawi Joab; Beeroth-te Naharai;"},"38":{"text":"Ithri-te Ira, Ithri-te Gareb,"},"39":{"text":"Hitt-te Uriah; a unpi-in sawmthum le sagi ahi hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei Israel tungah Topa a sinsokia a, amate langkhatah David hantawhin, “Pei inlen Israel le Judah mite va sim ta’n,” a ci hi.","title":"David’ Israel le Judah Miphaza Simna (1Khg 21:1-6)"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in Joab le ama tawh a omton galkapmangte kungah, “Mi bangza pha ahei ci ka thei nadingin Dan panin Beer-sheba dong Israel minam zosie lahah pei-in mi phaza va sim ta un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle Joab in kumpipa kungah, “ Topa na Pasien in mi a za zakhatin pungsah hinlen, ka pu kumpipa’ mit in a mu thei lai dingin hing bawl taheh! Ahi vangin bang dinga ka pu kumpipa in tam thu na bawl nuom mawh ahei?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle kumpipa thugen in Joab le galkapmangte a thuzaw hi. Tuaci’n Israel mi phaza a sim dingin kumpipa opna panin Joab le galkapmangte a dingkhie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate Jordan galkai-in Aroer le kuom laikima om khuopi pan kipanin Gad lam manaw-in Jazer lamah a peisuoh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate Gilead-ah a tung vua, khum tah panin Hitt-te’ gam Kadesh a tung uhi; tuale khum panin amate Dan ah a tung vua, Dan panin kuol pei-in Sidon a tung uhi,"},"7":{"text":"tuale Tyre kulpi, Hiv-te le Canaan-te’ khuopi zosie-ah a amate tung uhi; tuale khum panin Judah-te’ Negeb lam Beer-sheba ah a pei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n a gam sung zosie a kuolva zaw uh, hla kuo le ni sawmni a cin zaw ciengin Jerusalem-ah a peikia uhi."},"9":{"text":"Joab in a kumpipa kungah a kisimsa mi phaza gawm a puoh hi: Israel sungah namsau tawi thei galkap tul zagiet om a, Judah sungah tul zanga a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin khum zaw ciengin ama in mi a sim zo tah ziehin David kisia mama hi. David in Topa kungah, “Ka silbawlsa tung tangah nahpi tahin ka maw hi. Ahi vangin tu-in, Topa aw, nang tungah kang thum hi. Na nasempa’ khielna ei ngaidam in. Azieh pen ka mot gamtat hai kha ta hi,” a ci hi.","title":"David’ Mawna Tunga Thukhenna (1Khg 21:7-17)"},"11":{"text":"Zingmawngin David a thaw ciengin David’ thumu pa kamsang Gad tungah Topa’ thu tung a,"},"12":{"text":"“Pei inlen David kungah tam bangin gen in: Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Nang tungah thu thum kang pie hi. Khat penpen teel in, na tungah kang bawl ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n David kungah Gad pei-in a gen hi. Ama in, “Kum thum sung na gamah kielpi ang tungzaw ding mah? Na galte in hla thum sung hing gamdelin a masang vuah taizaw ding na mah? Ahi sihle ni thum sung na gamah pul natna hing tungzaw ding amah? Tu-in ngaisun inlen ei sawlpa kungah bang dawnna puohkia ding ka hei khentat in,” ci-in dong hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Gad kungah, “Ka lung a kham mama hi; ama’ ei hepina lien seng ahi ziehin mihing’ khut sungah ei tungsah sih hinlen, Topa’ khut sungah tungzaw vai,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in zingmawng panin a kise hun cieng dongin Israel-te tungah pul natna a tungsah hi; tuale Dan panin Beer-sheba dongin mi tul sawm sagi a si hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jerusalem a susie dingin vantungmi in a khut a zah laitahin Topa in sil hoi lo bawl ding ki-awi loin mite lahah sietna bawlpa vantungmi kungah, “Pha zo ta; tu-in khawl ta’n,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Jebus-te Araunah’ ancilna gei-ah Topa’ vantungmi a om hi."},"17":{"text":"David in mi susie vantungmi a mu bepin ama in Topa kungah, “A maw kei beh ka hi hi, a gitlo gamtat kei beh ka hi bo hi; tami tuute in bang a bawl uh ahei? Kang thum hi, keima le ka innkuonpite tung behah na khut hing hlang in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Khum ni-in David kungah Gad pei-in, “Peito inlen Jebus-te Araunah’ ancilna-ah Topa dingin maitam khat va bawl ta’n,” a ci hi.","title":"Ancilna Kem Tunga David’ Maitam (1Khg 21:18-27)"},"19":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehsa bangin Gad’ hilna bang zui-in David a peito hi."},"20":{"text":"Araunah in a ensuh leh kumpipa le a nasemte ama kung lam zuona ang peito a mu hi. Araunah zong a pusuoh hi; tuale David mai-ah tuolkunin a khupbawh hi."},"21":{"text":"Araunah in, “Ka pu kumpipa’ na nasempa kungah bang dinga hing haw na hei?” a ci hi. David in, “Mite tung panin pulnatna a ven thei nadingin na ancilna kilei hinlen tuami tungah Topa adingin maitam khat kilam leh ka ci hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Araunah in David kungah, “Hoi na sah bangin ka pu kumpipa in la inlen biehna pie in; meihal biehna dingin bawngtangte le na meitaw nadingin ancilna peehte le bawng lokaina hahkol singte tanah a om hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, keima Araunah in tam teng zosie kumpipa tungah kang pie hi,” a ci hi. Tuale Araunah in kumpipa kungah, “Nangma tungah Topa na Pasien in hepi lungsiet tahin hing thuh taheh,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in Araunah kungah, “Hi lo hi, tamte pen nangma tung panin a man pie-a kang lei ding ahi bo hi. A man bangma pie loin Topa ka Pasien tungah meihal biehna ka pie sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n David in ngun shekel sawmnga tawh ancilna phuol le bawngtang tegel a lei hi."},"25":{"text":"David in khumnah Topa adingin maitam khat bawl a, meihal biehna le thunuoma biehna a pie hi. Tuaci’n Topa in khum gam ading thumnate dawng a, Israel sung panin pul natna a veng hi."}}}}},"11":{"info":{"name":"1 Kumpite","shortname":"1kum","abbr":[],"desc":"Kumpite masa laibu (the first book of kings)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi David vuoi-in a kum a tam ta hi; tuale amate in puon tampi silsah nan ule a ama a khuo lum thei lo hi.","title":"Kumpi Zalai ding Kibuoina"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nasemte in ama kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa dingin nungah siengtho khat kisui hinlen, ama in kumpipa enin a kemnu hi taheh; ka pu kumpipa a khuo lum thei nadingin a kang sungah lum heh,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in zong Israel gam sung zosie-ah nungah melhoi khat sui-in Shunem-te Abishag a mu vua, kumpipa kungah a zawpi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua nungahno a mel hoi mama hi. Ama nu pen kumpipa kemnu suohin ama’ na sem a, hizongle kumpipa in ama a luppi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Haggith’ tapa Adonijah ama le ama kitawi sangin, “Kei kumpi ka hi ding hi,” a ci hi; ama in ama adingin sakol leengte le sakol tung tuongte, le a mai-a tai ding mi sawmnga kithawisah hi.","ref":"2Sam 3:4"},"6":{"text":"A pa David in, “Bang dinga hici gamtat na hei?” ci-in khatvei beh zong dongin a phawhsie ngai sih hi. Ama pasal melhoi mama khat ahi a, Absalom zoma suoh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Zeruiah’ tapa Joab le siempu Abiathar tawh vai a hawm a, amate in Adonijah a panpi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin siempu Zadok, Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah, le kamsang Nathan, Shimei, Rei, le David’ aituom galhangte in Adonijah a panpi sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Enrogel gei-a om Zoheleth suongpi pangah Adonijah in tuute, bawngtangte, le ganta thaute tawh biehpiehna nei a, ama in a sanggam zosie, kumpipa’ tapate, le Judah gam sunga kumpi uliente zosie hlan a,"},"10":{"text":"hinanle ama in kamsang Nathan hile, Benaiah hile, galhangte hile, a sanggampa Solomon hile hlan lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Nathan in Solomon’ nu Bathsheba kungah, “Haggith’ tapa Adonijah kumpi suoh dawh melin, i pu David in lah tua thu a theikhah lo lam a za nai lo na mah?","ref":"2Sam 12:24"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nangma’ hinna le na tapa Solomon’ hinna na hutdam thei nadingin tu-in hing pei inlen thu khat nang hil vang."},"13":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in kumpi David kungah pei-in ama tungah, ‘Ka pu kumpipa in nasemnu tungah, “Keima’ zaluo kumpi ding khu na tapa Solomon ahi a, tuaci’n ama ka kumpi topha tungah a to ding hi,” ci-in hing kiciem hi lo na mah? Tua ahile bang dinga Adonijah kumpi suoh thei ahei?’ va ci ta’n."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum sunga kumpipa tawh na holim laitahin keima hing sungtumin na thugen teng kang kipsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa innkhan sungah Bathsheba a tum hi; Kumpipa vuoi mama ta hi; Shunem-te Abishag in kumpipa kem hi."},"16":{"text":"Bathsheba in kumpipa tungah zatahna pie-in kun a, tuale kumpipa in, “Bang dei na hiei?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua nu in zong ama kungah, “Ka pu aw, na nasemnu tungah Topa na Pasien’ min tawh tam bangin nang kiciem ngai hi: Na tapa Solomon in ka kumpi za luo-in ka kumpi topha tungah a to ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in ka pupa kumpipa in na thei lo vangin, Adonijah thakhatin kumpi suoh zo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in biehpiehna-in bawngtangte, ganta thaute, le tuute, tampi pie zo a, kumpipa’ tapate zosie, siempu Abiathar, le galkapmangpa Joab zong a hlan hi; ahi vangin ama in na nasempa Solomon hlan lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka pu kumpipa aw, na nua ciengin ka pu kumpipa’ topha tungah koi to ding ci thu amate kungah na gen ding ngahin Israel zosie in nang mit tuhna-in ang nei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua bang hing hi sih mawh leh na pate tawh ka pu kumpipa na lupton ciengin kei le ka tapa Solomon khu mawneite banga ei kingaisun pai lien ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa tawh tua nu a holim laitahin kamsang Nathan a lut hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah, “Tam munah kamsang Nathan om hi,” ci-in kigen hi. Kumpipa mai-ah a pei ciengin ama in kumpipa zatahna pie-in a mai tuolah a kun hi."},"24":{"text":"Nathan in, “Ka pu kumpipa aw, ‘Adonijah in keima’ za luo-in kumpi sem ding a, ka kumpi topha tungah a to ding hi,’ ci-in na gen zo ta amah?"},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tuni-in a peisuh zo ta a, ama in biehpiehna dingin bawngtangte, ganta thaute, le tuute, tampitah go a, kumpipa’ tate zosie, galkapmang Joab, le siempu Abiathar hlanin tu-in ama adingin pawi a bawl vua, ‘Kumpi Adonijah dam sawt heh!’ a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in na nasempa keima le siempu Zadok, Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah le na nasempa Solomon-te ei hlan lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka pu kumpipa in tam thu nangma’ sep ahi a, na nua cienga na kumpi topha tunga koi to ding ahei ci thu na nasemte ei theisah lo na ta amah?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpi David in dawng a, “Keima kungah Bathsheba hing hlan un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa opna-ah ama pei-in kumpipa mai-ah a ding hi.","title":"Solomon Kumpi Suona (1Khg 29:22b-25)"},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa kiciem a, “Hahsatna zosie pan ka hinna ei hundam Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,"},"30":{"text":"nangma tungah Topa Israel Pasien’ min tawh kiciemin, ‘Na tapa Solomon in ka kumpi za luo ding a, keima tangin kumpi topha tungah a to ding hi,’ ka cisa ma bangin tuni-in zong ka cikia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mai tuol kunin Bathsheba in ama zatahna pie a, “Ka pu kumpi David hing tawntung heh!” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Kumpi David in, “Ka kungah siempu Zadok, kamsang Nathan, le Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah hing peisah un,” a ci hi. Kumpipa mai-ah a tun ciengun"},"33":{"text":"kumpipa in amate kungah, “Na pu’ nasemte peipi-in ka sakol tungah ka tapa Solomon tuongsah unlen, Gihon ah hing peipisuh ta un."},"34":{"text":"Khum munah siempu Zadok le kamsang Nathan in Israel tungah kumpi dingin ama sathau nusah un; tua ciengin pengkul mut unlen, ‘Kumpi Solomon dam sawt heh!’ ci un."},"35":{"text":"Ama’ nua zui-in na peito ding uhi. Ama sungtumin ka kumpi topha tungah tosah un; keima tangin ama kumpi a suoh ding hi; azieh pen keima in Israel le Judah tungah a uh dingin ama ka koi zo hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah in kumpipa dawng a, “Hi taheh! Topa , ka pu kumpipa’ Pasien in tua bangin kipsah taheh."},"37":{"text":"Ka pu kumpipa tawh Topa a opton bangin Solomon tawh zong omton hinlen, ka pu kumpi David’ topha sangin ama’ topha liensah zaw taheh,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempu Zadok, kamsang Nathan, Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah, Chereth-te le Peleth-te peisuhin David’ laa-sakol tungah Solomon tuongsahin Gihon-ah a zawpi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Khum mun puonbuh sung panin siempu Zadok in sathau koina bung la-in ama in Solomon a nu hi. Tua ciengin amate in pengkul mutin mi zosie in, “Kumpi Solomon dam sawt heh!” a ci uhi."},"40":{"text":"Mi zosie in ama zui-in peito-in theile a tum vua, nahpitahin lungdamin a kipah vua, a gamlumna un lei a kilingsah valia hi."},"41":{"text":"Adonijah le a ompi lengla zosie in pawibawl a man zaw ciengun tam thu a za uhi. Joab in pengkul kimut ging a zah bepin, “Bang dinga khuopi sung hici gin vapual adiei?” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Ama in thu a gen laitahin siempu Abiathar’ tapa Jonathan a tung hi. Adonijah in, “Hing lut in. Nang pen mi gina khat na hi ziehin thuhoi hing puoh valon vateh” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Jonathan in Adonijah dawng in, “Hi lo hi, bangzieh ahei cile i pu Kumpi David in Solomon kumpi suohsah zo hi;"},"44":{"text":"kumpipa in ama tawh siempu Zadok, kamsang Nathan, Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah, Chereth-te, le Peleth-te sawlin a kumpipa’ laa-sakol tungah ama a tuongsah zo ta uhi;"},"45":{"text":"siempu Zadok le kamsang Nathan in kumpi dingin ama Gihon ah sathau a nu zo ta uhi; tuale amate khum panin lungdam kipahin a kato zo ziehun khuopi sungah gamlumna a om hi. Na zah husa khu tami ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tu-in kumpi topha tungah Solomon a to hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua tham loin i pu kumpi David a lungdampi dingin kumpipa’ nasemte a pei vua, “Pasien in nangma’ min sangin Solomon’ min thangsahzaw hinlen, nangma’ topha sangin ama’ topha lienzawsah taheh,” a ci uhi. A lupna tungah biehna lui-in kumpipa kunsuh a,"},"48":{"text":"‘Tuni-in keima muna-ah ka suonlehlahte khat ka kumpi topha tunga to dinga a pie Topa , Israel Pasien in thupha nga taheh,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ciengin Adonijah’ lengla zosie a citunsa-in a lampi ciet vuah a pei ta uhi."},"50":{"text":"Adonijah in Solomon a giin ziehin dingin maitam kite a tupom hi."},"51":{"text":"Solomon kungah, “Adonijah in Kumpi Solomon a giing hi; en in, ama in maitam kite tupom a, ‘Kumpi Solomon in namsau tawh na nasemte a tha lo nadingin ka kungah Kumpi Solomon hing kiciem masa heh,’ ci hi,” kici hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuaci’n Solomon in, “Ama in a migitna a lah thei leh a samzam khat zong tuolah kie lo ding hi; ahi vangin ama sungah gitlona a kimu leh ama si ding hi,” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Solomon in maitam panin ama a peipisuh nadingun mi a sawl hi. Kumpi Solomon zatahna pie dingin ama pei hi; tuale Solomon in ama kungah, “Na inn ah pei in,” a ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David a si ding hun a nai ciengin ama in tam bangin a tapa Solomon thu a vailhah hi:","title":"Solomon Tunga David’ Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"“Kei ka hi leh leitung mi zosiete’ peina lampi-ah a pei ding ka hi ta hi. Thakhauh inlen hangsan in."},"3":{"text":"Moses’ thukham sunga kigiel bangin Topa na Pasien’ thuhilnate kemcingin a lampite tawn inlen, a thukhamte, a thupiehte, a biehna ngainate, le a teci pannate zui siem in. Tua bangin bawl po lacin na sepna zosie le na kiheina zosie-ah na dau ang pei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima tawh kisai-in ama in: ‘Na tapate in a lungsim zosie ule a hinna zosie utawh keima mai-ah thuman tahin gamtat ding a lim ngaisut nah po uleh Israel kumpi topha tunga to ding mi na kitasam ngai sih ding uhi,’ ci-in a thugenna Topa in a kipsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tua tham loin Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in keima ei bawlna, gal sunga a si mite’ phula kinei-in gal ven hun sunga a mawh tha Israel galkapmang ni, Ner’ tapa Abner le Jether’ tapa Amasa tunga a bawlnate ziehin, a kawnga kigah a kawngga le a kephanga a kedap tungah gal sunga sisan luong teng a tusah hi, ci zong na thei hi.","ref":"2Sam 3:27; 20:10"},"6":{"text":"Tua ziehin na pilna tawh kizui-in sem inlen, a samkang tawh hlamuongin Leinei gamah ama peisuhsah sin."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle Gilead mi Barzillai’ tapate tungah thuman tahin gamta inlen, na sabuoi-a annete tawh ankuong imtonsah in; azieh pen na sanggampa Absalom kung panin ka tai lai-in tua bang thumanna tawh kei ei na bawl uhi.","ref":"2Sam 17:27-29"},"8":{"text":"Keima in Mahanaim ka zot ni-in a gimnei awsie tawh keima ei gausam, Bahurim pana ang pei Benjamin-te Gera’ tapa Shimei zong na kungah a om hi; ahi vangin kei ei dawn dingin Jordan ah ama ang pei lai-in ama tungah Topa’ min tawh ka kiciem a, ‘Namsau tawh nang kang that sih ding hi,’ ka ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 16:5-13; 19:16-23"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama maw nei lo bangin ngaisun tuon sin, azieh pen nang mi pil khat na hi hi; nang in ama na law dan ding na thei lel ding hi. A lu tunga a samkang khu sisan tawh Leinei gamah na peisuhsah hamtang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pu a pate tawh David lumton a, David khuopi sungah ama kivui hi.","title":"David’ Sina (1Khg 3:4 ; 29:26-28)"},"11":{"text":"Israel tungah David kum sawmli sung maang hi; Hebron ah ama kum sagi sung maang a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le kum thum sung maang hi.","ref":"2Sam 5:4-5; 1Khg 3:4"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pa David’ topha tungah Solomon a to hi; tuale ama’ kumpi gam kiptahin kiphut hi.","ref":"1Khg 29:23"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon’ nu Bathsheba kungah Haggith’ tapa Adonijah a va haw ta hi. Tua nu in, “Thunuom tawh ang haw na hiei mah?” a na ci hi. Ama in, “Thunuom tawh ang haw hi ma ing,” a ci hi.","title":"A Kumpigam Solomon in Phutdet"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin, “Nang kungah kamkhat kang gen thei diei mah?” a ci hi. Tua nu in, “Gen in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Tami kumpi gam kei-a’ ahi lamtah na thei hi. Israel zosie in kei a maang dingin ei lamen uhi; ahi vangin tam kumpi gam kihei-in ka sanggampa-a’ a suoh ta hi, bangzieh ahei cile tam thu pen Topa kung pan ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale tu-in nang tungah nget ding khat ka nei hi; ei hlaw malmal sin,” a ci hi. Tua nu in ama kungah, “Gen in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “Hepina tawh ka zi dingin Kumpi Solomon kungah Shunem-te Abishag ei ngetpieh in. Ama in na thu ang niel sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 1:3-4"},"18":{"text":"Bathsheba in, “Hoi mama hi; nangma tangin kumpipa kungah ka va gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Adonijah tangin ama tungah thu gen dingin Kumpi Solomon kungah Bathsheba a pei hi. Tua nu dawn dingin kumpipa ding a, tuale ama mai-ah a kun hi; tua ciengin a kumpi topha tungah ama to a, tuale kumpipa’ nu to nadingin kumpi topha khat lasahin ama’ zietlamah tua nu a to hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in, “Nang kungah thu neuno khat nget ding ka nei hi; ei hlaw sin,” a ci hi. Tuale kumpipa in tua nu kungah, “Na nget nop pen ngen in, ka nu aw; kang hlaw sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in, “Na sanggampa Adonijah zi dingin Shunem-te Abishag pie in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa in a nu dawng a, “Bang zieha Adonijah zi dinga Abishag nang nget ahiei? Ama adingin kumpi gam zong ngetpieh vet ve! Azieh pen ama ka upa ahi hi; ama ding beh ngen sinlen siempu Abiathar le Zeruiah’ tapa Joab ading zong ngetpieh vet ve!” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ minin Kumpi Solomon kiciem a, “Adonijah in tam thu gel zo ahi ziehin ama’ hinna in a sawn sih tah ma leh Pasien in keima ei dawm sih taheh!"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in kei ei sudetin ka pa David’ kumpi topha tungah ei koi a, ama’ ciemsa bangin keima tung le ka suon ka hlahte tungah kumpi gam ei pie Topa a hing ahi ma bangin tuni-in Adonijah kithat ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpi Solomon in Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah a sawl hi. Ama in tua pa satlia-in a si hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa in siempu Abiathar kungah, “Na gam ahi Anathoth ah kipei ta’n; azieh pen nang zong a si dinga kilawm na hi hi. Ahi vangin ka pa mai-ah Topa Pasien’ singkuong na puohpiehna le ka pa thuoh gentheina zosie na thuohpi ziehin tu tadi-in kang that sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 22:20-23; 2Sam 15:24"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Solomon in Topa’ siempu ahina panin Abiathar khawlsah a, Topa in Shiloh-ah Eli innkuon tawh kisai a gen thute tua bangin tungsah hi.","ref":"1Sam 2:27-36"},"28":{"text":"Joab in Absalom a panpi sih vangin Adonijah a panpi na thu Joab tungah thu tha a tun ciengin Topa’ puonbuh sungah Joab tai pai a, maitam kite a tupom hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon kungah, “ Topa’ puonbuh sungah Joab tai-in tu-in maitam pangah om hi,” ci-in a kigen ciengin Solomon in Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah sawl a, “Va pei-in ama va satlia ta’n,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ puonbuh sungah Benaiah pei-in ama kungah, “Kumpipa in thu ei pie a, ‘Hing pusuoh heh,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Hizongle ama in, “Hi lo hi, tam sungah ka sizaw ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Benaiah in kumpipa tungah thu tutkia a, “Joab in tam bangin thu gen a, tam bangin ei dawng hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Kumpipa in dawngkia a, “Ama gensa bangin ama va satlia inlen hing vui ta’n; a thu om lopi-in Joab in sisan a luonsah mawna pen keima le ka pa’ innkuon tung panin tua bangin la dawh ta’n."},"32":{"text":"Topa in ama’ sisan luonsahna pen ama’ lu tung ma-ah a tusahkia ding hi. Azieh pen ka pa David’ thei lo kalin ama in ama sanga a thumanzaw le a hoizaw mi ni, Israel galkapmang Ner’ tapa Abner le Judah galkapmang Jether’ tapa Amasa a busim a, namsau tawh that hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joab’ luzang le a suon a hlahte’ lu zangah a tawntungin ama gel’ sisan ang tungkia ding hi; ahi vangin David tung, a suon a hlahte tung, ama’ innkuon tung, le ama’ kumpi topha tungah Topa kung panin nopna om zing ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah kuonto a, ama satin that hi; tuale gamlaha a inn ah ama kivui hi."},"35":{"text":"Kumpipa in Joab tangin galkapmang dingin Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah koi a, Abiathar tangin siempu Zadok koi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei hlansahin ama kungah, “Nangma dingin Jerusalem ah inn khat lamin tuanah teng inlen, tua panin heima sung kal nawn sin."},"37":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na pei-a Kidron Lui na galkai ni ni-in a si valon ding na hi lam kithei pai in; nangma’ sisan nangma’ lu tungah a tu ding hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Shimei in kumpipa kungah, “Thukhenna a dih hi; ka pu kumpipa gensa bangin na nasempa gamta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Jerusalem ah ni tampi sung Shimei a teng hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin kum thum zaw ciengin Gath Kumpipa Maacah’ tapa Achish kungah Shimei’ nasemte ni a tai uhi. Shimei kungah, “Gath ah na nasemte om hi,” ci-in a kigen ciengin"},"40":{"text":"Shimei ding pai a, laa phaw pha-in a silate sui dingin Gath-a Achish kungah a pei hi; Shimei pei-in Gath panin a silate a peipikia hi."},"41":{"text":"Jerusalem panin Gath ah Shimei pei-in a kilekia lam Solomon kungah a kigen ciengin"},"42":{"text":"kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei hlansahin ama kungah, “ Topa tawh kang kiciemsah a, ‘Nang pusuohin mun khat popo-ah na pei ni ni-in a si ding na hi lam thei valon in,’ ci-in lipkhap tahin hing gen hi lo ka mah? Nangma in keima kungah, ‘Tua thukhenna dih hi; ka sang hi,’ nei ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua bang hi napi bang dingin Topa tungah na kiciemna palsatin kang thupiehte zui lo na hei?” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Kumpipa in Shimei kungah, “Ka pa tunga sietna na bawl zosie na lungsim sungah a unpi-in na thei hi; tuaci’n Topa in na gamtat sietna teng nangma lu tungah ang tusahkia ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi vangin Kumpi Solomon in thupha nga ding a, Topa mai-ah David’ kumpi topha kisudet tawntung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah thu a pie hi; tuale ama pei-in Shimei sat hi, tuale ama a si hi. Tuaci’n Solomon’ khut sungah kumpi gam kikipsah hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kiten kipina vai ziehin Egypt kumpi Pharaoh tawh Solomon in kipawlna a bawl uhi; ama in Pharaoh’ tanu la a, ama’ inn, Topa’ inn le Jerusalem kimvelah kulpi lam a man masang, David khuopi sungah tua nu a peipi hi.","title":"Solomon in Pilna Ngen (2Khg 1:2-13)"},"2":{"text":"Hinanle Topa’ min tawh biehinn kilam nai lo ahi ziehin mite in munsangte-ah biehpiehna a nei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Topa it a, a pa David’ thukhamte a zui hi; ama beh in munsangte-ah biehpiehna pie-in gimnamtui a hal hi."},"4":{"text":"Biehpiehna pie dingin khum mun Gibeon ah kumpipa a pei hi, bangzieh ahei cile tua khu mun sang thupi pen ahi hi; Solomon in tua maitam tungah meihal biehna tulkhat a pie zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Gibeon ah zanlai a mangin Solomon kungah Topa kihil hi; tuale Pasien in, “Kang pieh ding khat ngen in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale Solomon in, “Nang in nasempa ka pa David tungah a lien le a kip itna na lah zo hi, bangzieh ahei cile nangma tungah muonhuoina, dihna, thumanna lungsim tawh ama a gamta hi; tuale nangma in ama adingin tami a lien itna kip na koipieh zo ta a, tuale tuni-in ama’ topha tunga a to ding tapa khat na pie zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahile tu-in Topa ka Pasien aw, keima naupangno khat ka hi vangin ka pa David tangin na nasempa kumpi-in nei koi zo ta hi. Keima in sungtum dan ding le pusuo dan ding tahpi zong ka thei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"A lien le a tam seng zieha a phaza a kisim zo lo, na teelsa mite lahah na nasempa a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na nasem pa in na mite ka uh thei nading le, a sie le a pha ka khentel thei nadingin thu theitelna lungsim ei pie in; azieh pen tam na mite koi in uh zo ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tami Solomon’ ngetna in Topa a lungkimsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in ama kungah, “Nang in na khansau nading hile, na hau nading hile, na galte zaw nading hile na ngen sih a, a sie le a pha khentel thei nadingin tami theitelna ngen na hi ziehin,"},"12":{"text":"tu-in keima in na nget bangin nang kang pie ding hi. Keima in pilna le khentel theina lungsim nang kang pie tahtah hi; nang masangin nang tawh a kibang mi a om ngai sih a, na nua ciengin zong nang tawh kibang mi a om ngai ta sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Nang in na nget khah lo ahi na khan sung tungtawnin hauna le patawina zong kang pie ding hi; nangma tawh tekah thei ding kumpi dang koima a om sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na pa David bangin ka lampite tawnin ka thukhamte le ka thupiehte na zui nah po leh na hinkhuo ka sawtsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon a khanglo hi; tua khu a mang ahi bo hi. Jerusalemah ama pei a, Topa’ thuciemna singkuong mai-ah dingin meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate pie a, a nasem zosie adingin pawi khat a bawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Hun khat ciengin kumpipa kungah numei pahtat ni pei-in a mai-ah a ding uhi.","title":"Solomon’ Pil Thukhenna"},"17":{"text":"A numei khat in, “Ka pu aw, tami numei tawh inn sung khatah ka tengton hi; tami inn sungah ama a op sungin keima in tapa khat ka nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka ta nei zaw a ni thum ni-in tami numei in zong ta ang nei hi. Ko gel ka omton uhi; inn sungah koima dang tawh ka omton sih gel hi, koma gel beh ka om uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in zanlai-in a lupna-ah a tapa netpha kha ahi ziehin tami numei’ tapa a si hi."},"20":{"text":"Zankim laitahin ama na tho a, na nasemnu ka kimut kalin ka kang sunga ka tapa ei na lahpiehin keima’ tapa pen a kang sungah na siel a, a sisa ama’ tapa pen ka kang sungah a na siel hi."},"21":{"text":"Zingmawngin ka ta nawi pie dingin ka thaw ciengin ama a sisa-in ka mu hi; ahi vangin zingmawngin limtahin ka et ciengin tua pen keima sung pana a suoh tapa a na hi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin a numei dang khat in, “Hi lo hi, a hing tapa pen kei-a’ ahi a, a si tapa pen nang-a’ ahi bo hi,” ci-in a gen hi. Amasa nu in, “Hi lo hi, tapa a si pen nang-a’ ahi a, tapa a hing pen kei-a’ ahi bo hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa mai-ah ama gel a kisel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in, “Khat nu in lah, ‘A hing pen ka tapa ahi a, a si pen na tapa ahi hi,’ ci hi. Adang khat in zong, ‘Hi malmal sih! A si pen na tapa ahi hi; a hing pen ka tapa ahi hi,’ ci zel hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in, “Namsau khat hing la un,” a ci le kumpipa mai-ah namsau khat a peipi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Naupang a hing pen phal ni suo un; tua ciengin khat tungah alang pie unlen, adang khat tungah alang pie un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin tapa a hing pen’ nu in a lungsimah a tapa a khuotuo ziehin kumpipa kungah, “Ka pupa aw, hepina tawh a hinglai naupang pen ama pie in; ama that malmal sin!” a ci hi. A khat pen in, “Ke’n lah tang sih vang, ama’n lah tang da taheh; phalsuo lel un,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in a dawngkia hi: “Naupang a hinglai pen amasa numei pie un; ama that sih un. Tua nu pen ama’ nu ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel mi zosie in kumpipa thukhenna a za uhi; tuale amate in kumpipa lamdang a sa uhi, azieh pen ama in thu a tanga a khen thei nadingin ama’ sungah Pasien’ pilna a om lam amate in a thei uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in Israel zosie tungah kumpi sem a,","title":"Solomon’ Vaihawm Uliente"},"2":{"text":"tuale tam teng pen ama’ vaihawm ulienpite ahi hi: Zadok’ tapa Azariah pen siempu ahi hi;"},"3":{"text":"Shisha’ tapa Elihoreph le Ahijah-te pen thuvanpite ahi uhi; Ahilud’ tapa Jehoshaphat pen thuciemte ahi hi;"},"4":{"text":"Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah pen galkapmangpa ahi hi. Zadok le Abiathar-te pen siempute ahi uhi;"},"5":{"text":"Nathan’ tapa Azariah pen uliente tunga nasep uh ahi hi; Nathan’ tapa Zabud pen siempu le kumpipa’ lawm ahi hi;"},"6":{"text":"Ahishar pen kumpi inn uhpa ahi hi; Abda’ tapa Adoniram pen thona-aana nasemte uhpa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi zosie tungah Solomon in ulien sawm le ni nei a, tua teng in kumpipa le a innkuonte adingin anneh tuidawn a sih uhi; mi khat in kum khatin anneh tuidawn hla khat ta a sih ciet ding uh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amau’ min pen: Ephraim muoltung gam sungah Ben-hur;"},"9":{"text":"Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, le Elon-bethanan sungah Bendeker;"},"10":{"text":"Arubboth ah Ben-hesed; (Socoh le Hepher gam zosie ama-a’ ahi hi);"},"11":{"text":"Naphath-dor gam zosie-ah Ben-abinadab; (ama in Solomon’ tanu Taphath zi-in nei hi);"},"12":{"text":"Taanach, Megiddo, le Jezreel’ nei lam Zarethan panga om Beth-shean gam zosie, le Beth-shean panin Abel-meholah dong, Jokmeam galkhat pang langkhat dongah Ahilud’ tapa Baana;"},"13":{"text":"Rammoth-gilead sungah (ama in Gilead sunga om Manasseh’ tapa Jair’ khuoneute le Bashan sunga om Argob gam sung, kulpite le sumngo zawlte a nei khuopi lien sawmguh nei hi) ah Bengeber;"},"14":{"text":"Mahanaim-ah Iddo’ tapa Ahinadab; Mahanaim khuo sungah;"},"15":{"text":"Naphtali ah Ahimaaz: (ama in Solomon’ tanu Basemath zi-in la hi); Iddo’ tapa Ahinadab:"},"16":{"text":"Asher le Bealoth ah Hushai’ tapa Baana;"},"17":{"text":"Issachar-ah Paruah’ tapa Jehoshaphat;"},"18":{"text":"Benjamin-ah Ela’ tapa Shimei;"},"19":{"text":"Amor-te’ kumpi Sihon le Bashan kumpi Og gam ahi Gilead gam sungah Uri’ tapa Geber ahi hi. Judah gam sungah ulien khat a om hi."},"20":{"text":"Judah le Israel pen tuipi gei senel za-in a tam uhi; amate in a du a dei teng uh ne-in dawnin a lungdam uhi.","title":"Solomon’ Uhna Thupina"},"21":{"text":"Solomon in Euphrates pan Philistia-te gam, Egypt gamgi nangawn dongah kumpi gam zosie a uh hi; amate in Solomon’ hin sung tungtawnin sieh le kaihte puohin a na a sem uhi.","ref":"Pien 15:18; 2Khg 9:26"},"22":{"text":"Solomon’ nisiel anneh dingin annel cor sawm thum le annel cor sawmguh,"},"23":{"text":"bawngtang thau sawm, le lodawng tawh a kivathau bawng sawmni, tuu zakhat, sakhitangte, sazuhte, sanangte, le a vasa thaute kisim nai lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in Euphrates nitumna lam gam zosie tawh Tiphsah panin Gaza cieng dong, Euphrates nitumna lampang kumpi zosie uh hi; ama’ kimvela zosie kilemin a om hi."},"25":{"text":"Solomon hin sungin Judah le Israel pen lungmuongin a om a, mi zosie in Dan panin Beer-sheba cieng dong nangawnin a lenggui le a theiphungte uh uopin lungmuongtahin a teng uhi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in a sakol leengte dingin buh a nei ciet sakol tul sawmli le sakol tunga tuong mi tul sawm le tulni zong nei hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:26; 2Khg 1:14; 9:25"},"27":{"text":"Uliente in amau’ sih hla-in kumpi Solomon le kumpi Solomon’ sabuoi tunga ankuong a impi mi zosie’ neh ding a pie ciet uhi; amate bangma a kitasam sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amau’ nasep ciet tawh kizui-in a kisapna munah sakol leengte le sakol taihatte anva nadingin mangbuham le butu zong a puoh uhi."},"29":{"text":"Pasien in Solomon tungah pilna tampi, thukhen siemna le tuipi gei senel za-a tam theina pie a,","title":"Solomon’ Pilna Kithang"},"30":{"text":"tuaci’n Solomon’ pilna in nisuona lam mi zosie’ pilna le Egypt pilna zosie a khupsin sieng hi."},"31":{"text":"Midangte sangin ama a pilzaw a, Ezrah-te Ethan, le Mahol’ tapa Heman, Calcol, le Darda te sangin zong a pilzaw lai hi; a kimvela minam zosie lahah a minthanna a kizel sieng hi.","ref":"Late 89 Thulu"},"32":{"text":"Ama in paunah tul thum phuo a, a laphuo teng dawng tul le dawng nga pha hi.","ref":"Pau 1:1; 10:1; 25:1; Sol 1:1"},"33":{"text":"Ama in Lebanon-a taamtah a patin kulh tunga po hyssop dongin singkung lopate’ thu a gen hi; ama in ganhingte, vate, a bawhvate, le ngate’ thu zong gen hi."},"34":{"text":"Solomon’ pilna thu ngai dingin minam zosie a pei uhi; ama’ pilna thu a zasa leitung kumpite zosie zong a pei uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in amate in a pa’ munah ama kumpi dingin Solomon sathau nu zo ta uh, ci Tyre Kumpipa Hiram in a zah ciengin Solomon kungah a nasemte a sawl hi; bangzieh ahei cile Hiram le David a kilawmta den uh ahi hi.","title":"Kiginkholna le Biehinn Vanzahte (2Khg 2:1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram kungah kam vaihlah a,"},"3":{"text":"“ Topa in ama’ ketaw nei-ah amahaw a koi masangin ama a kui-im a galte tawh kidona ziehin ka pa David in a Topa Pasien’ min dingin biehinn na lam zo lo hi, ci na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in Topa ka Pasien in ka kimkotah tawlngahna ei pie zo ta hi; ei langpang hile, hamsietna hile om nawn lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in ka pa David kungah, ‘Na kumpi topha tunga ka koi ding na tapa in nangma tangin ka min dingin biehinn a lam ding hi,’ ci-in a gensa bangin Topa ka Pasien’ min dingin biehinn khat lam ka sawm hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12-13; 1Khg 17:11-12"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima adingin Lebanon taamtah singte a kiphua thei nading thupie in. Keima’ nasemte le nangma’ nasemte in a semton ding vua, na nasemte dinga na se zaza thaman nang tungah kang pie ding hi; azieh pen ko kungah Sidon-te banga sing sui siem khat beh a op lo lam na thei hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Solomon’ thugen teng Hiram in a zah ciengin ama a kipah mama a, tuale ama in, “Tuni-in tam minam lien a uh dingin David tunga tapa pil a pie Topa in thupha nga taheh,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hiram in Solomon kungah kam vaihlah a, “Ka tunga nang thupuoh ka za zo ta hi; taamtah sing le taapi sing tawh kisai na kisap zosie kang sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Lebanon panin ka nasemte in tuipi-ah tua teng ang puohsuh ding uhi; keima in tuipi tunga laam thei dingin tua teng phawngin kang bawl ding a, nangma’ genna munah kang tungsah ding hi. Khum munah nangma in na lah thei dingin tua singte amate ka phelsah ding hi. Ka innkuonte neh ding an ei sihin ka deina na kicingsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hiram in Solomon’ deigaw taamtah le taapi sing zosie a sih hi."},"11":{"text":"A innkuonte neh dingin Solomon in zong mangbu cor tul sawmni le sathau tuituoh cor sawmni dim ama a pie hi. Solomon in Hiram tungah kumsimin tam teng a pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama tungah a ciemsa bangin Topa in Solomon pilna a pie hi. Hiram le Solomon kikalah kilemna a om hi; tuale ama gelin kithukimna khat a bawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in Israel zosie panin thona-aana sem dingin mi a khon hi; a mi khonte tul sawmthum pha hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in hla khatin amate tul sawm a kikhelin Lebanon lamah a sawl hi; Lebanon-ah hla khat sung omin inn ah hlani sung om ding uhi; Adoniram in thona-aana nasep uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Solomon in nasem mi tul sawm sagi le muoltung gama suong kheng dingin zong mi tul sawmgiet nei a,"},"16":{"text":"ama in nasepna van ding le nasem mite uh dingin kuligawng tul thum le zathum zong nei lai hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupiehna bangin suong kikheng zolsate tawh biehinn khuombul a phu thei nadingun suong golte le a manpha suongte a to uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Solomon’ innlamte, Hiram’ innlamte le Gebal-te in suongkheng nasep a sem vua, biehinn lam nadingin sing le suong a khol uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gam panin Israel-te a peidawh lang kalsie kum zali le kum sawmgiet a cin kum, Israel-te’ tunga Solomon in a uh a kum lina, a hla nina Ziv hla sungin ama in Topa’ biehinn lam ding a kipan hi.","title":"Solomon in Biehinn Lam (2Khg 3:1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Topa dinga Kumpi Solomon in a lam biehinn adung tong sawmguh hi a, avai tong sawmni pha-in, a sanna tong sawmthum a pha hi."},"3":{"text":"Biehinn laikim mai-a talaap pen biehinn vailam tawh kikimin tong sawmni pha a, inn mai lamah a thuhna tong sawm pha hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in biehinn adingin vathang nei tawlette a bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in biehinn pang tuoh le a sunglam biehinn kawm kimkotin a kawm tungah inn lam a, tua gel in a laikim le mun siengtho sungnung nei tuoh uhi; tuale ama in a kimkotah inndante zong bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"A khan neita pen tong nga zai a, a laita pen tong guh, le a thumna tong sagi zai hi. Kawm sungah innkam a lut lo nadingin ama in inn pulam pang kimkot adingin a nanna singpehte bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Biehinn a kilam laitahin sehta ging hile, hei ging hile, sia vanzah ging khat popo a kizah lo nadingin, suongkhuh-a kilemsa suongte tawh biehinn kilam hi."},"8":{"text":"Biehinn hlang lamah inn khan laita pen ading lutna kot kibawl hi: A khan laita penah kalei kuol tawh kikato a, a khan laita pen panin a thumna-ah kikato hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in inn lam a, tuale a man sieng hi; ama in innkamte hlungin a tungkhu dingin taamtah singpehte a bawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in a inn buppi tungah a lambete zomin a khan khat ciengin tong nga ta sang a, taamtah singte-in a biehinn tawh kizom hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon tungah Topa’ thu tung a,"},"12":{"text":"“Na inn lam tami biehinn tawh kisai-in ka thukhamte zui-in ka ngaina kipte mang a, ka thupiehte zosie kemcingin tuate na zui leh, nang tungah keima in na pa David tunga ka kamciemna kang kipsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel mite lahah ka teng ding a, ka mi Israel-te ka nuasie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Solomon in inn lamin a man sieng hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in taamtah singpehte tawh innsung kawm dap hi; tuong panin innciing dong le innku dongin a sunglam teng taamtah singpeh dap hi; tuale a tuong pen taapi singpeh tawh a tuom hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in tuong panin innku dong innsia lam tong sawmni taamtah singpehte tawh lam a, tuale tami siengtho pen mun, mun siengtho sungtawng dingin a inn sungah a bawl hi.","ref":"Pei 26:33-34"},"17":{"text":"Mun siengtho sungtawng mai-a innsung pen tong sawmli sau hi."},"18":{"text":"Inn sunga taamtah singte umga le pape pallun bangin kizempawl hi; a unpi-in taamtah sing ngentang hi a, suong kici kimu lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong koi nadingin a sungtawng penah mun siengtho sungtawng bawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Mun siengtho sungtawng pen tong sawmni sau-in tong sawmni ma zai a, tong sawmni sang hi; ama in tua pen kham citah tawh zutmam hi; ama in taamtah sing maitam khat zong a bawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Solomon in kham citah tawh inn sunglam zutin, tua ciengin mun siengtho sungtawng mai lamah kham khainieng kipaivei-in hlung a, kham tawh a zut hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua banah biehinn buppi kham tawh zutzol a, ama in a unpi-a a nuzol masangsie a nunu hi; mun siengtho sungtawng a maitam buppi nangawn zong kham tawh a zut hi.","ref":"Pei 30:1-3"},"23":{"text":"Ama in mun siengtho sungtawngah cherub lim ni olive sing tawh bawl a, tong sawm tuoh sang hi.","title":"Biehinn Vanzahte (2Khg 4:1-10 , 19-22 ; 5:1)"},"24":{"text":"Cherub a hla langkhat, tong nga sau-in, cherub a hla alang dang khat, tong nga ma sau hi; a hla langkhat mong panin a mong langkhat dong tong sawm pha hi."},"25":{"text":"Cherub khat pen zong tong sawm ma pha hi; cherub tegel a sauna le a piendan gel a kithakhat ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Cherub khat a sandan tong sawm hi a, a khat zong tua za ma ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in inn sungtawng penah tua cherub-te tung hi; cherub tegel’ hla tuoh kizah a, khat’ hla in kawm banin, adang khat pen’ hla in zong kawm langkhat ban hi; inn laikimah a hla langkhat gel kisutuo hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in cherub tegel kham tawh a zut hi.","ref":"Pei 25:18-20"},"29":{"text":"Ama in a sunglam le a pulam innkhante a kimkotin innkawm zosie tungah cherub-te, lutu kung le pape limte tawh zemsuoh hi."},"30":{"text":"A sunglam le a pulam inndan sunga tuongte zong kham tawh a zut hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in mun siengtho sungtawng lut nadingin olive sing kotpi pehte bawl hi; bangtung zawl le kotpi khuomte in ning nga nei hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in cherub-te, lutu kung le pape lim kibawlte tawh olive sing kotpi nite a tuom hi; ama in cherub-te le lutu kungte tungah kham a zutmam hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ma bangin ama in inn sung lut nadingin ning li a nei olive sing kotkhuomte bawl a,"},"34":{"text":"taasing kot peh ni zong bawl hi. Kot peh nite kihlip thei a, adang kot peh nite zong kihlip thei hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua a kotpehte tungah ama in cherub milimte, lutu kung milimte, le pape limte tawh zem a, a zepnate kham tawh a zutmam hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in a kikheng suong guol thum le taamtah singzawl guol khat tawh a tuol sungta pen bawl hi."},"37":{"text":"A kum lina, Ziv hla-in Topa’ inn khuombul kiphut hi."},"38":{"text":"A kum sawm le khatna, a hla gietna Bul hla-in a inn khan zosie le a kigen zosie bangin innpi lam kihiel bawl hi. Ama in kum sagi sung tua inn a lam hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in ama’ inn ding kum sawm le kum thum sung lam a, a inn buppi-in a man sieng hi.","title":"Solomon’ Kumpi Inn le Inndangte"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Lebanon Gammang Inn khat lam a, adung tong zakhat, avai tong sawmnga, a sanna tong sawmthum pha a, taamtah khuompi guol thum tungah taamtah innkam kihlungin tua tunga kilam ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Guol khatah sawm le nga a om khuompi sawmli le nga tunga kilam inndan tungson teng taamtah sing tawh kikhu hi."},"4":{"text":"A pang kawm tegel tungah tawlet guol thum tuoh om a, a tawlet guol thumte khatlekhat kimaingat ciet hi."},"5":{"text":"Kotpi zosie le kotpi khuomte zosie a pang kikim ning li nei vive hi a, a guol thumin tawlet khatlekhat kimaingat ciet hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in adung tong sawmnga, avai tong sawmthum a pha Khuompi Kikhopna kici khat a lam hi. A mai lamah innhlap om a, tua in khuompite nei-in tuate mai-ah a tungkhu khat a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a thukhennate a tangko nadingin Thutang Tokhom kici Kumpi Tokhom Innpi khat lam a, a tuong panin a innku cieng dong taamtah sing tawh kituom hi."},"8":{"text":"Innpi nua lamah ama’ ten nading inn zong tua ma bangin kilam hi. Solomon in a zi dinga a lah Pharaoh’ tanu om nadingin tuami innpi bang ma khat zong a lam hi.","ref":"1Kum 3:1"},"9":{"text":"Tam teng zosie, a khuombul pan a khum dong, biehinn tuol pan leituol golpi dongin a kite banga kitan, a nua le a mai suong-at tawh a ki-at suong manphate tawh kibawl hi."},"10":{"text":"A khuombul pen suong manpha ngentang hi a, tong giet panin tong sawm a pha suong lienpi vive ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A tung lamah a kite banga a kitan a manpha suongte le taamtah sing om hi."},"12":{"text":"Leituol golpi in a kimvelah suong kikhengsa guol thum simin taamtah sing guol khat nei hi; tua ma bangin Topa’ biehinn tuol sungnung le talaap in zong nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in Kumpi Solomon in Tyre panin Hiram hlanin a hopi hi.","title":"Sumngo Khengpa Hiram’ Silbawlte"},"14":{"text":"Ama pen Naphtali minam meigongnu’ tapa ahi a, a pa Tyre mi sumngo khen nasep a sempa ahi hi; ama pen sumngo nasepna-ah siemna, theina, le pilna tawh kidim hi. Solomon kungah ama pei-in sep ding zosie sem hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in sumngo khuompi ni a sung hi. Khuompi khat tong sawm le tong giet sang a, a khuom pum kimkot tong sawm le tong ni pha hi; khuom a nina zong tua za ma ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Khuompi tegel dawn a bul dingin a kisung sumngo khuom luzepna ni zong a bawl hi; khuom luzepna khat tong nga sang a, adang khuom luzepna khat tong nga ma sang hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuom luzepna tegel a zep nadingin lenta banga kiphan sumngo khainieng bawl hi; khuom luzepna khat adingin tuate sagi, adang khuom luzepna khat adingin sagi ma ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mang kawlsing ga limte tunga om khuom luzepna tuom nadingin lenta banga kiphante’ kimvelah khuomte guol ni-in bawl hi; ama in khuom luzepna dang khatah tua ma bangin a bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Talaap khuompi dawn a om khuomlu zepnate tong li sangin unoh pa lim tawh kizem hi."},"20":{"text":"Khuompi tegel tungah lenta banga kiphan gei-a om a dawh bem tungah khuomlu zepnate kikoi hi; a kimvelah guol ni-in mang kawlsing ga zani om hi; a khuomlu zepna dang khatah zong tua bang ma ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in biehinn talaap-ah khuompite phut hi. Leitaw lamah khuom khat phut hi; ama in a min Jachin phuoh hi. Ama in leilu lamah khuom dang khat phut a, a min Boaz phuoh hi."},"22":{"text":"Khuompite dawnah unoh pa kibawl lim om hi. Tua bangin khuompite a bawl kiman sieng hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kisung tuikuong pi khat bawl hi; tua tuikuong pen a bem hi a, a gei khat panin a gei khat tong sawm pha a, tong nga thuhin a kimkot tong sawm thum pha hi."},"24":{"text":"A geiviel nei-ah tuikuongpi kimvelin tong sawm ciet a pha a khawhte a om hi; tua a khawhte guol ni pha a, a tuikuongpi tawh kisuntha hi."},"25":{"text":"Bawngtang sawm le nite tungah tuikuongpi kikhang a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, tuale thum in nisuona lam nga hi; tua teng tungah tuikuongpi kikoi hi. A nua lam ciet un a sung lam a nuangat dimdiem uhi."},"26":{"text":"A tuikuongpi khutphang cie-in sa hi; a geiviel pen unoh pa tawh kibang hai geiviel bangin kibawl hi; tua sungah tui bath tulni bang ta thei hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in sumngo tawh kibawl tui kuong tunna sawm zong bawl hi; tuate tong li sau, tong li gol, tong thum sang ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"A tunnate tam banga kibawl ahi hi: Tuate in a geizepna nei hi; a geizepnate a kungah kibul hi;"},"29":{"text":"a kunga kibul a geizepnate tungah humpite, bawngtangte, le cherub-te om hi. Tua a kungte tung, humpite le bawngtangte tung le nei-ah a geiguol a sawi-a kizem pakuolte zong om hi."},"30":{"text":"A tunna khat ciet in sumngo lengpeite le sumngo lengpei zawl li nei hi; a ning lite-ah tuikuongpi nannate a om hi. Tua a nannate a kisung ahi a, a pang cietah pakuolte om hi."},"31":{"text":"A gong pen a tunna panin tong khat sang to hi; a gong pen a tunna a kibawl bangin bem a, tong khat le alang thuh hi; a gongah lim kigielte om hi; a khawhte sih li nei-in kibawl a, a bem hi lo hi."},"32":{"text":"A geizepnate nei-ah a lengpei li a om hi; a tunnate tungah a lengpei zawlte a om hi; a lengpeite tong khat le alang sang hi."},"33":{"text":"A lengpeite sakol leengpei bangin kibawl hi; a pei zawl, a peikuol, a peikalna, le a kalna bulte zosie pen a kisung ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"A tunna ning cietah a nanna li ciet om hi; tua a nannate pen a tunnate tawh sakhat ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"A tunna dawnah tong lang a sang vielbem khat om hi; a tunna dawnah a kipsahnate le a geizepnate a tunna tawh sa khat a kibawl ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"A kipsahnate le a geizepnate tungah mun awngza ciet tawh kizui-in cherub-te, humpite, le lutu kungte tawh zemin a kimvelah pakuol a bawl hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in tam bangin a tunna sawm a bawl hi; a unpi-in a kibangin kisung a, a golna le a lim a mel a kibang ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in sumngo tuikuong sawm bawl hi; tuikuong khatah tui bath sawmli bang ta hi; tua tuikuong khat pen tong li ciet ahi hi; a tunna sawm adingin tuikuong khat ciet a om hi.","ref":"Pei 30:17-21"},"39":{"text":"Ama in biehinn leitaw lamah tua a tunnate nga koi a, leilu lamah nga ma koi hi; ama in biehinn hlanglam nisuona lam ningah tuikuongpi koi hi."},"40":{"text":"Hiram in beelte, kawbiate, le kuong te zong bawl hi. Tuaci’n Hiram in Kumpi Solomon adingin Topa’ biehinn lam nasep zosie a man sieng hi:"},"41":{"text":"Khuompi nite, khuompite dawn a kuong tawh kibang a lubawh ni, le khuompite dawn a kuong tawh kibang a lubawh nite tuom nadingin len banga a kiphan nite;"},"42":{"text":"len banga kiphan nite adingin mang kawlsing ga zali, khuompite dawn a kuong tawh kibang a lubawh nite tuom nadingin len banga kiphan khat adingin mang kawlsing ga guol ni;"},"43":{"text":"a tunna sawm, a tunnate tunga om tui kuongpi sawm;"},"44":{"text":"tui kuongpi khat, le tui kuongpi nei-a om bawngtang sawm le nite ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Beelte, kawbiate, le kuongte, Hiram in Topa’ biehinn sungah Solomon dinga a bawl tam vanzah zosie pen a te silsel sumngo vive-a kibawl ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jordan zanglei, Succoth le Zarethan kikal beel lei-a a sunsah ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Solomon in tua vante zosie a tam seng ziehin tawite zo lo hi; tua sumngo gihna za kithei lo hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuaci’n Solomon in Topa’ biehinn sunga vanzah vannuoi a bawl hi: kham maitam, Ompina Anlum ading kham sabuoi,","ref":"Pei 25:23-30; 30:1-3"},"49":{"text":"mun siengtho sungtawng mai, leitaw lam pangah nga omin, leilu lam pangah nga a om kham citah meivah khuomte, kham tawh kibawl papete, meivahte, le taitete;","ref":"Pei 25:31-40"},"50":{"text":"panamtui ading haite, taitete, kuongte, pakante, le kham citah vutluona; siengtho pen mun biehinn sungtawng pena kotte le biehinn laikima kotte ading kham kotbilte ahi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Kumpi Solomon in Topa’ biehinn a lamna zosie kiman sieng hi. Solomon in a pa David’ siensuosa ngun, kham le vanzahte peipi-in Topa’ biehinn sunga gou kholna-ah tuate a khol hi.","ref":"2Sam 8:11; 1Khg 18:11"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong puoto dingin Zion a kici David khuopi panin Jerusalem khuo sunga Kumpi Solomon mai-ah Israel upate le minam lutang zosie le Israel pupa innkuon makaite a kaikhawm hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Apna (2Khg 5:2-14)","ref":"2Sam 6:12-16; 1Khg 15:25-29"},"2":{"text":"A hla sagina Ethanim hla sung pawi hunin Israel mite zosie Kumpi Solomon kungah a kikhawm uhi.","ref":"Siem 23:34"},"3":{"text":"Israel upa zosie pei-in siempute in singkuong a puo uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Topa’ singkuong, kikhopna puonbuh, le puonbuh sunga om a siengtho vanzah zosie a peito pi uhi; siempute le Levi-te in tuate a puoto uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon le a mai-a kikhawm Israel mi buppi in biehpiehna dingin singkuong mai-ah tuu le bawngtang tampi a pieh ziehun tuate a phaza kisim zo lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempute in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong pen a kikoi nading mun biehinnpi sunga mun siengtho sungtawng, siengtho pen mun, cherub-te’ hlalim nei-ah a peipi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Cherub gel in singkuong tungah a hla a zah ziehun tua cherub gel pen singkuong le a zawlte’ tungkhu a suoh hi."},"8":{"text":"A zawlte sau mama ahi ziehin mun siengtho sungtawng mai-a siengtho pen mun panin a zawl mongte a kimu tabo hi; hinanle a pulam panin kimu lo hi; tuni dongin khum sontah ma-ah tua zawl tegel a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Singkuong sungah Egypt gam panin a pei lai-un Topa in Israel-te tawh thuciemna a bawlna ahi Horeb-ah Moses in suongpeh ni a na koite sim lo bangma dang om lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:5"},"10":{"text":"Siengtho mun panin siempute a pusuo ciengun Topa’ biehinnpi meii in tuom a,"},"11":{"text":"tua meii ziehin siempute in na a sem thei sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ minthanna vang in Topa’ biehinn a tuom hi.","ref":"Pei 40:34-35"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in, “ Topa in khuomiel sapi lahah a ten ding gen zo hi.","ref":"Late 18:11; 97:2"},"13":{"text":"Keima in nangma adingin a kitawisang inn khat, kumtawn na ten nading mun khat ka lam zo hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm Israel-te zosie a din laitahun kumpipa kihei-in thupha a pie hi.","title":"Solomon’ Thugenna"},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka pa David tunga a kam tawh a ciemsa teng a tangtungsah Israel Pasien Topa in thupha nga taheh. David in,"},"16":{"text":"‘Egypt pan ka mi Israel-te ka peipi ni-a patin khum munah ka min a op zing nadingin Israel minamte lahah biehinn khat lam nading khuopi khat zong ka teel sih hi; hinanle ka mi Israel-te a uh dingin David ka teel hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:4-11; 1Khg 17:3-10"},"17":{"text":"Israel Pasien Topa’ min dingin biehinn khat lam ding ka pa David in a na lung bat zo ta bo hi."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle Topa in ka pa David kungah, ‘Keima’ min dinga biehinn khat lam na sawm khu thu hoi ahi hi;","ref":"2Sam 7:1-3; 1Khg 17:1-2"},"19":{"text":"hinanle nang in tua biehinn na lam sih ding a, nang tung pana ang pieng ding na tapa in keima’ min dingin tua biehinn lam ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12-13; 1Khg 17:11-12"},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Topa in a bawlsa a thuciemna a tudet hi; azieh pen ka pa David tangin kei ka khang hi; Topa ciemsa bangin Israel kumpi topha tungah to-in Israel Pasien, Topa’ min dingin biehinn ka lam zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt gam panin amate ka peipi lai-in i pu i pate tawh a bawl Topa’ thuciemna opna singkuong adingin mun khat ka bawlpieh hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm Israel zosie’ opna Topa’ maitam mai-ah Solomon dingin van lamah a khutte a zah hi.","title":"Solomon’ Apna Thungetna"},"23":{"text":"Ama in, “Israel Pasien Topa aw, tunga om vantungah hile, nei-a om leitungah hile, a lungsim zosie tawh na mai-ah gamta-in na nasemte tungah thuciemna a tudet le itna kip a lah, nangma tawh a kibang Pasien a om sih a,"},"24":{"text":"nang in ka pa David tunga na gensa thuciemna na kipsah hi; na kam tawh na kamciem a, tuni-in na khut tawh na tangtungsah hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel’ Pasien Topa aw, ama kungah, ‘Keima mai-ah nang na gamtat bangin na tapate in keima mai-ah a gamtat vua, a pei nading uh lampi a etsiem nah po uleh keima mai-ah Israel kumpi topha tunga a to ding mi na kitasam ngai sih ding uhi,’ ci-in nangma in na nasempa David na kamciem tukip in.","ref":"1Kum 2:4"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel Pasien aw, na nasempa ka pa David kunga na thugensa na kamciem kipsah in."},"27":{"text":"“Hinanle Pasien leitungah a teng tahtah diei mah? Vantung le vantung a sangpen nangawn in nang hing dawl lo ahile keima lamsa tami biehinn in bangza-in nang hing dawl lo zaw kan lai ding ahei!","ref":"2Khg 2:6"},"28":{"text":"Na nasempa’ thungetna le ang thumna ei thudon inlen, Topa ka Pasien aw, tuni-a na nasempa in na mai-a ang ngetna, a kikona le a thungetna ei ngai in;"},"29":{"text":"‘Khum sungah ka min a om ding hi,’ na cina mun biehinn lam sun le zanin en zing inlen, tam muna keima na nasempa thungetnate ei za in.","ref":"Thkna 12:11"},"30":{"text":"Amate in tami mun lam nga-in thu a nget ciengun na nasempa le na mi Israel-te’ thumna ngai in; na tenna vantung panin ei za inlen, ka mawna uh ei ngaidam in."},"31":{"text":"“A vengpa tungah mi khat maw-in ama a kiciemsah a, ama pei-in tam biehinn sung na maitam mai-ah a kiciem leh,"},"32":{"text":"vantung panin za-in sem inlen, na nasemte tungah thukhenin a mawpa thuohsahin ama’ gamtatna ama lukhuh sah inlen, a dih mipa a dihna talangin a dihna tawh kizui-in thaman pie in."},"33":{"text":"“Nangma tungah ang maw ziehun galte mai-ah na mi Israel a guollel ciengin, amate nangma lamah ang kihei kia-in na min ang law vua, tami biehinn sungah thu ngenin na tunga ang thum uleh,"},"34":{"text":"vantung panin za-in na mi Israel’ mawna ngaidam inlen, a pu a pate tunga na piehsa leitangah amate tunpikia in."},"35":{"text":"“Nang tunga ang maw ziehun vankot kikhahin guo a zuh nawn lo ciengin, tam mun lamah thu ngenin na min ang law vua, amate dan na pieh ziehin a mawna panun a kiheikia uleh,"},"36":{"text":"vantung panin za inlen na nasemte, na mi Israel’ mawna ngaidam in; tuale lamate zui ding lampi hoi na hil ciengin na mite tungah a luo ding vua na piehsa leitang tungah guo zusah in."},"37":{"text":"“Gam sungah kielpi tungin, pul natna hile, ankung natna hile, ankung zawngkhalna hile, kauphe hile, lung hile ang op a; a galte in amau’ khuopi khat popo kuikhumin, bangbang gimna, bangbang natna hile;"},"38":{"text":"mi khatguoh in hile, na mi Israel-te zosie in hile, a lungsim natna uh thei-in tami biehinn lamah amate in a khutte uh zahin bangbang thungetna hile bangbang thumna hile ang bawl uleh;"},"39":{"text":"na tenna vantung panin za inlen ngaidam in. Tua ciengin amau’ gamtatna zosie tawh kizui-in amau’ lungsim na thei bangin hing bawl in.
