Azieh pen nangma beh in mihing lungsim na thei hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka pu ka pate tunga na piehsa leitang tungah a hin sung zosie uh amate in nang ang zatah ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"“Tua ma bangin na mi Israel ahi lo gamdang mi khat nangma min ziehin khuol gamla panin ang pei a,"},"42":{"text":"(azieh pen amate in a lien mama na min, na banhat, le na banzahnate a za ding uhi), tami biehinn lamah thu ang nget ciengin,"},"43":{"text":"nangma in na tenna vantung panin za inlen, tua gamdang mipa in nang tunga ang ngetna zosie tawh kizui-in bawl in. Na mi Israel bangin leitung mi zosie in na min hing thei-in ang zatah nading le ka lamsa tami biehinn nangma’ min tawh a kilo zo ahina amate in a thei nading uh ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"“A galte do dingin na mite kuonin, bang lam bang lamah amate sawl ta lacin, na teelsa khuopi lam, Topa kung le nangma’ min dinga ka lamsa biehinn lamah thu ang nget vua ahile,"},"45":{"text":"van tung panin a thungetna ule a thumna uh za-in amau’ vai panpi in."},"46":{"text":"“Amate na tungah ang maw vua - bangzieh ahei cile a maw lo koima om lo hi - amate tungah na lungthah a, galte khut sungah amate pie-in, amate kimanin tua galte a gamla ah ahi a, a nai ah ahi zongin a kikai mang a;"},"47":{"text":"ahi vangin sal dinga a kipeipina gam sungah khuo phawhin a kisiakia a, ‘Kohaw ka maw ta vua, gitlo gamtatin ka khansie ta uhi,’ ci-in a leitang panun na tungah ang thum vua;"},"48":{"text":"amate sala a zawpi a galte’ leitangah a ngaisutna zosie ule a lungsim zosie utawh kisiakia-in, nangma in na teelsa khuopi, a pu a pate uh na piehsa amau’ leitang, le na min dinga ka lamsa biehinn lam nga-in na kunga thu ang nget uleh;"},"49":{"text":"vantung na tenna panin a thu ngetna ule a thumna uh za-in, amau’ vai-ah panpi in,"},"50":{"text":"tua ciengin na tunga ang maw na mite le na tunga ang gamtanate ule amau’ thupalsatnate zosie maisah inlen, a galte in amate tungah lainatna a nei thei nadingin a mitmu-un amate tungah lainatna nei in."},"51":{"text":"(Azieh pen amate, Egypt sia meiphuol sung pana na peipi nangma’ mi le nangma’ gouluo ahi uhi.)"},"52":{"text":"Na nasempa thumna le na mi Israel thumna mittuhna-in nei inlen, amate in nang ang hlat sielun na bil na ngat in."},"53":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt panin ka pu ka pate na peipi lai-in na nasempa Moses tungtawnin na kamciemsa bangin na gouluo ahi dingin leitung mi zosiete lah panin amate na tel zo hi, Topa Pasien aw,” a ci hi."},"54":{"text":"Tu-in Topa tungah Solomon in tami thungetnate le tami thumnate zosie a khan zaw ciengin vantung lamah a khutte zahsa-in a khupdinna mun Topa’ maitam mai panin ama a dingto hi;","title":"A Kikhawmte Solomon in Thupha Pie"},"55":{"text":"ama dingin awging tawh a kikhawm Israel mi zosie thupha pie hi:"},"56":{"text":"“A ciemsa zosie dung zui-in a mipi Israel tungah tawlngahna a pie Topa in minthanna nga taheh; ama in a nasempa Moses tung tawna a gensa thuciem hoite zosie khat zong a kipel om lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:10; Josh 21:44-45"},"57":{"text":"I pu i pate tawh a na opton bangin eite tawh Topa i Pasien hing om taheh; ama in eite ei nuasie loin ei taisan sih heh,"},"58":{"text":"ahi vangin ama in i pu i pate a thupiehsa ama’ lampi zosie a zui ding, le ama’ thupiehnate, a thukhamte, le a ngaina kipte a zui dingin i lungsimte ama lamah hawisah taheh."},"59":{"text":"Topa mai-ah keima’ thumna kammalte sun le zanin Topa i Pasien nai-ah omin, ama in nisielin a kisam bangin a nasempa’ vai le a mi Israel’ vai ei panpi taheh;"},"60":{"text":"tuaci’n leitung mi zosie in Topa pen Pasien hi, ci-in a thei ding uhi; koima adang om lo hi."},"61":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa i Pasien tungah noma ma ki-ap unlen tuni-a bangin a thukhamte zui-in a thupiehnate mang un,” a ci hi."},"62":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa, le ama tawh a om Israel mi zosie in Topa mai-ah biehna a pie uhi.","title":"Solomon in Biehpiehnate Pie (2Khg 7:4-11)"},"63":{"text":"Solomon in thunuom biehna dingin Topa tungah bawngtang tul sawmni le tulni le tuu tul zakhat le tul sawmni a pie hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa le Israel mi zosie in Topa’ biehinnpi a ap uhi."},"64":{"text":"Kumpipa in khum ni ma-in Topa’ biehinn mai-a om inntuol laikimteng a siensuo hi; azieh pen meihal biehnate, an tawh biehnate, le thunuom biehpiehna’ thaute adingin Topa’ mai-a om sumngo maitam neu luo-in dawl zo ta lo ahi ziehin tua munah meihal biehnate, an tawh biehnate le thunuoma biehna thaute a pie hi."},"65":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum hun lai-in Solomon le a ompi Israel mi zosie in Topa i Pasien mai-ah ni sagi sung, Hamath panin Egypt Lui dongin kikhopna thupi mama khat bawlin pawi a khaam uhi."},"66":{"text":"Ama in a ni giet ni-in mite a peisah hi; amate in kumpipa thupha pie-in Topa in ama’ nasempa David le ama’ mi Israel tungah migitna a lahna zosie ziehin lungdamna le kipahna tawh a inn ciet a zuon uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Topa biehinn le kumpi inn lam zo ta a, a lam nop zosie a lam zaw ciengin,","title":"Solomon Kungah Pasien Kilahkia (2Khg 7:11-22)"},"2":{"text":"Gibeon-a ama kunga a kilahsa bangin Solomon tungah Topa a niveina kilah hi.","ref":"1Kum 3:5; 2Khg 1:7"},"3":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Nangma in keima kunga na thungetna le na thumnate ka za zo hi; keima in tam na lamsa biehinn ka siensuo zo a, khum sungah keima’ min a tawntungin ka koi zo ta hi; khum mun ka mit suon den ding a, ka lungsim ka tengsah den ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma na hi leh, ka mai-ah na pa David gamtat bangin lungsim citah le thutang tawh na gamtat a, kang thupieh zosie semin ka thukhamte le ka ngaina kipte na zui nah leh,"},"5":{"text":"keima in na pa David kungah, ‘Israel kumpi topha tunga to ding mi na kitasam ngai sih ding hi,’ ci-a ka na ciemsa bangin Israel-te tungah na kumpi topha ka kipsah peisuoh ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 2:4"},"6":{"text":"Nangma na hi a, na tate ahi zongin, keima nei zuina uh panin pielmangin, na mai vua ka koi ka thupiehnate le ka thukhamte na zui sih vua, pasien dangte’ na a sem ding le a bie dingin na pei uleh,"},"7":{"text":"keima in ka piehsa gam panin Israel ka notmang ding hi; tuale keima’ muna panin ka min dinga ka siensuosa tuami biehinn ka paimang ding a, mi zosie lahah Israel pen paunah le zakona-in kinei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tami biehinn buathah lom suohin a gei-a suoh kha zosie in datmaw-in a ehneh ho ding uhi; tuale amate in, ‘Bang dinga Topa in tami gam le tami biehinn tam banga a bawl tah lawm adiei?’ a ci ding uhi.","ref":"2Kum 25:9; 2Khg 36:19"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Egypt gam panin a pu a pate a peipi Topa a Pasien uh taisanin pasien dangte a pom vua, amate in tuate bie-in a na a seppieh zieh uh ahi hi; tua ahi ziehin amate tungah Topa in tam gimna a tunsah ahi hi,’ ci ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Solomon in inn nite, Topa’ biehinn le kumpi inn a lam zaw kum sawmni a cin kumin,"},"11":{"text":"Tyre Kumpipa Hiram in Solomon’ dei zaza taamtah sing, taa sing le khamte a sih zaw ciengin, Kumpi Solomon in Galilee gam sunga khuopi sawmni Hiram a pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle Solomon’ pieh khuopite en dingin Tyre panin Hiram a zin ciengin tua teng in ama lungkimsah zo lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ziehin ama in, “Ka sanggam aw, kei nei pieh tam khuopite bangci khuopi dan bep ahei?” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tuni dongin tuate Cabul gam kici hi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle kumpipa tunga Hiram in a pieh kham talent zakhat le talent sawmni pha hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam pen Topa’ biehinn, ama’ inn, Millo le Jerusalem kulpi, le Hazor, Megiddo, le Gezer-te lam nadinga Solomon in aana tawh a sepsah thalut teng tuotna ahi hi.","title":"Solomon’ Nasep Adangte (2Khg 8:3-16)"},"16":{"text":"(Egypt kumpi Pharoah peito-in ama in Gezer la-in mei tawh haltum a, khuopi sunga teng Canaan-te thatin Solomon’ zi ahi ama’ moken dinga tua khuopi a pieh ahi hi;"},"17":{"text":"tuaci’n Solomon in Gezer lamphakia hi). Bethhoron neinung pen"},"18":{"text":"Baalath, le khum gamsung senel gamah Tamar,"},"19":{"text":"le Solomon’ vankholna khuopite zosie, le leengte ading khuopite, sakol galkapte ading khuopite, le Jerusalem sung, Lebanon sung, le ama’ uhna gam sung zosie-ah zong Solomon in a lam nop popo a lam hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel mi ahi lo Amor-te, Hit-te, Perez-te, Hiv-te, le Jebus-te sung panin a omlai mi zosie,"},"21":{"text":"Israel-te in a tha sieng zo lo, tua gam sungah amau’ nua-a omlai a suonlehlahte, Solomon in thona aana sem dingin a lah ziehin tuni dongin tua bang ma-in a om uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanle Solomon in Israel-te salin a bawl sih hi; amate pen galkapte, ama’ uliente, ama’ galkapmangte, ama’ galkap bute, sakol leengte le sakol galkap uhte ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tam teng Solomon’ inn lam nasep a uh ulienpite ahi uhi: nasep a uh ulienpite mi zanga le sawmnga ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin David khuopi panin Solomon in ama dinga a lam a inn ah Pharaoh’ tanu a peito hi; tua ciengin ama in Millo a lam hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa dinga Solomon in a lam maitam tungah meihal biehnate le thunuom biehpiehnate kum khatin thumvei pie a, ama in Topa mai-ah gimnamtui a hal hi. Tuaci’n ama in biehinn lam a man sieng hi.","ref":"Pei 23:17; 34:23; Thkna 16:16"},"26":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in Edom gam sung San Tuipi dunga om Eloth kici mun nai-a Ezion-geber ah tembaw honkhat a bawl hi.","title":"Solomon Sumsui Nasepte (2Khg 8:17-18)"},"27":{"text":"Hiram in tembaw honte tawh a nasemte, tuipi tung nasep a kiva tembaw nasemte, le Solomon’ nasemte tawh a sawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Ophir ah amate pei-in tuatah panin kham talent zali le sawmni a puo vua, kumpi Solomon kungah tuate a peipi uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon’ minthanna a zah ciengin, (Topa’ min zieha a minthanna) thudawhna hamsate tawh a ma zelah dingin ama kungah haw hi.","title":"Sheba Kumpinu Hawna (2Khg 9:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"A namtui nate, kham tampi le suong manphate a puo kalaohte, le ama’ nuazui honpite tawh Jerusalem ah tua nu pei hi; tuale ama Solomon kung a tun ciengin a lungsim sunga om zosie a gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in tua nu thudawh zosie a unpi-in a dawng hi; Kumpipa in tua nu tungah a gencien thei lo thuhamsa khat beh om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon’ pilna, a lamsa a inn,"},"5":{"text":"a sabuoi-a kilui an, a uliente tona, le a nasemte’ kep le khoi dan, a puonsil a nihtente uh, ama an a piete, le Topa’ inn sunga meihal biehna zosiete a mu ciengin a hla tawh zong teng nawn lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in kumpipa kungah, “Keima in ka gam panin na sepsate le na pilna thu kigen ka zahte a man ahi a,"},"7":{"text":"hinanle pei-in tua thu kigente ka mit tawh ka mu masangsie ka tahsang sih hi. Keima kungah alang nangawn ang kigen nai sih hi; na pilna le na hauna in ka zah thute a khupsin sieng hi."},"8":{"text":"Na zite mi hampha ahi uhi! Nangma hing khoi-in nangma’ pilna a tawntunga a za den tam nasemte zong mi hampha ahi uhi!"},"9":{"text":"Nangma tungah lungkimin Israel kumpi topha tunga ang tosah Topa na Pasien in thupha nga taheh! Topa in Israel a it zing ziehin nangma in thutang le thuman na sep thei nadingin ama in kumpi-in nang ang bawl hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in kumpipa tungah kham talent za le sawmni, le gimnamtui tampi le suong manphate a pie hi. Sheba kumpinu in Kumpi Solomon tunga a pieh za-a a tam gimnamtuite a kipuoh ngai nawn sih hi.","ref":"Mat 12:42; Luk 11:31"},"11":{"text":"Tua tham loin Ophir panin kham a puo Hiram’ tembaw honte in Ophir panin cingsing le suong manpha tampitah a puoh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua cingsingte Topa’ biehinn le kumpipa’ inn dona-in zang a, lasate ading lyre lasahna le harp lasahna-in zong a bawl hi; tua bang cingsingte tuni dongin kipuoh ngai nawn lo a, zong kimu ngai nawn lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Khum hun sungin Kumpi Solomon in kumpi letsongte a pieh banah ama in a dei a nget zosie zong Sheba kumpinu tungah a pie hi. Tua ciengin a nasemte tawh a gam zuonin tua nu a pei hi."},"14":{"text":"Kum simin Solomon kunga a tung kham a gihna talent zaguh le sawmguh le guh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua banah summet bawlte le sumbuhte, Arabia kumpite le gamsung uhpite tung pana a peite zong omlai hi."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in a kikheng kham tawh kibawl lum a gol zani bawl hi; lum a gol khat bawlna-ah kham shekel zaguh lut hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a kikheng kham tawh a kibawl lum zathum bawl hi; lum khat ciengin kham mina thum ta lut hi; tuale kumpipa in Lebanon Gamlah Inn a kici sungah tua lumte koi hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa in saiha tawh kumpi topha golpi khat zong bawl a, kham hoipente tawh tua topha zut hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpi topha in kalei ciel guh nei hi. Kumpi topha tunglam pen a nualamah a bemin kibawl a, a tona pang tuohah ban ngahnate omin tua ban ngahnate pangah humpi ni a ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Kalei ciel guh’ mong cietah khat ciet a om humpi sawm le ni a ding hi. Koima’ kumpi gam sungah tam banga kibawl kumpi topha om ngai lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon’ tuidawnna hai zosiete kham tawh kibawl ahi a, Lebanon Gamlah Inn sunga kizang kuong le beel zosie zong kham tawh kibawl vive hi a, ngun tawh kibawl khat beh om lo hi; Solomon hun lai-in ngun pen bangma-in kisim lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen kumpipa in Tarshish tembaw honpi khat nei a, tuipi tungah Hiram’ tembaw honte tawh a peiton vua, kum thum a cin sielin Tarshish tembaw honte khatvei ta pei-in kham, ngun, saiha, zawngmang, le utongte puoh zel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin Kumpi Solomon in a hauna le a pilna tawh leitung kumpi zosie a khupsin hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasien in a lungsim sunga a guot a pilna ngai dingin leitung buppi in Solomon’ opna a leisui uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ama kunga a haw mi zosie in a kumkumin letsong, ngun le kham tawh kibawl nate, puonsilte, galvante, gimnamtuite, sakolte, le laa-sakolte tampi puoh uhi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in leengte le sakol tung tuongte khawm hi; ama in leeng tul le zali tuonna sakol tul sawm le tulni nei a, leeng koina khuopite le Jerusalem-a kumpipa’ opna munah tuate koi hi.","ref":"1Kum 4:26"},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jerusalem ah ngun suong bangin olsahin Shephalah-a theitheh sing bangin vausah hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:17"},"28":{"text":"Solomon sakol leina gam pen Egypt gam le Kue gam hi a, kumpipa’ sumbawlte in Kue gamah a manpie-in a lei uhi.","ref":"Thkna 17:16"},"29":{"text":"Egypt panin leeng khat ngun shekel zaguh, sakol khat shekel za le sawmnga-in kinga hi; tuaci’n kumpipa’ sumbawlte tungtawnin Hit-te’ kumpite zosie le Aram-te’ kumpite kungah tuate kizuasawn hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in Pharaoh’ tanu banah gamdang numei tampi deigaw hi: Moab-te, Ammon-te, Edom-te, Sidon-te, le Hit numeite ahi hi.","title":"Solomon’ Khielnate","ref":"Thkna 17:17"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te kungah, “Amate tawh na kinung sih ding vua, amate zong note tawh a kinung sih ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in a pasien uh’ nua na zui nadingun na lungsim uh ang hawisah tahtah ding hi,” ci-a na gensa minamte sung pan hi a, Solomon in tam mite ngai-in a pom hi.","ref":"Pei 34:16; Thkna 7:3-4"},"3":{"text":"Ama’ zite lahah kumpi tanu zi za sagi, le mei zathum nei hi; tuale a zite in ama’ lungsim a heipieh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Solomon a vuoi ciengin a zite in pasien dangte lamah ama’ lungsim heipieh uhi; a pa David’ lungsim bangin ama’ lungsim Topa a Pasien tungah dih zo nawn lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Solomon in Sidon-te’ nusien Asterte, le a kidahhuoi Ammon-te’ bieh Milcom nua a zui hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa muna-ah Solomon siet gamtat a, a pa David bangin Topa zui tahtah lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in Jerusalem nisuona lam muol tungah Moab-te-a’ ahi a kidahhuoi Chemosh le a Ammon-te-a’ ahi a kidahhuoi Molech dingin mun sang khat a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in gimnamtui halin amau’ pasien-te tungah biehpiehna a pie a gamdang zi zosie dingin tua bang ma-in a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kunga ni veitah kilahsa Topa , Israel Pasien panin a lungsim a heimang ziehin Solomon tungah Topa a lungthah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua pasien dangte’ nua a zui lo nadingin ama tungah thu a piehsa ahi hi; hinanle ama in Topa’ thupieh bangin zui lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in Solomon kungah, “Tam pen nangma’ lungsim puoh ahi a, nangma kang thupieh ka thuciemna le ka thukhamte na zui lo ziehin nangma tung panin na kumpi gam balkehin na nasempa tungah ka pie tahtah ta ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin na pa David ziehin nangma’ hin sungin ka bawl sih ding hi; na tapa’ khut sung panin ka balkeh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongnanle keima in tua kumpi gam buppi ka balkeh sih ding hi; ka nasempa David zieh le ka teelsa Jerusalem ziehin na tapa tungah minam khat ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon a langpang dingin Topa in Edom-te Hadad a khangsah hi; ama pen Edom kumpi innsung mi khat ahi hi.","title":"Solomon’ Galte"},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Edom gamah David a op lai-in misi vui dingin galkapmang Joab kuonto-in Edom gam sunga pasal zosie that hi."},"16":{"text":"(Azieh pen Joab in Edom gama pasal zosie a na thagam masangin khum munah ama le Israel-te zosie hlaguh sung om uhi);"},"17":{"text":"ahi vangin Egypt ah a pa’ nasem Edom-te pawlkhat tawh Hadad a taimang hi. Tua hunin Hadad naupangno khat ahi na bo hi."},"18":{"text":"Midian panin a ding vua, Paran ah a tung uhi; Paran panin mi a zawpi vua, ama tungah inn le lo, neh le tah le tenna ding leitang a pie Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kung Egypt gamah a tung uhi."},"19":{"text":"Pharaoh’ muna-ah Hadad in maipha lienpi mu a, a zi dingin a nuphalnu, Kumpinu Tahpene’ sanggamnu a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Tahpenes’ sanggamnu in ama tawh tapa Genubath nei a, Tahpenes in Pharaoh’ inn ah tua naupang kem hi; Pharaoh’ inn sunga Pharaoh’ tapate lahah Genubath om hi."},"21":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh David lumton a, galkapmang Joab si ta ci thu Hadad in Egypt panin a zah ciengin Hadad in Pharaoh kungah, “Ka gam ka pei thei nadingin ei dingkhie sah in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharaoh in ama kungah, “Keima tawh na opna-ah bang kisapna nei-a na gam pei ding na hici sawm ahei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Hi lo hi, ei peisah ta teitei in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Solomon langpang dingin Pasien in adang khat ahi a pupa Zobah kumpi Hadedezer kung pana a tai Eliada’ tapa Rezon a khangsah hi."},"24":{"text":"David in mi a tha zaw ciengin Rezon in a kimvelah mi kaikhawmin ama misuom pawl’ makai a suoh hi; amate Damascus ah pei-in khum munah a teng vua, tuale Damascus ah ama kumpi a semsah uhi."},"25":{"text":"Solomon’ hun sung tawn tungin Israel langpangin ama om a, Hadad ma bangin lungkhamna a piengsah hi; ama in Israel simmaw a, Aram gamsungah a maang hi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon’ nasem, Zeredah-a Ephraim-te, Nebat’ tapa, a nu’ min Zeruah kici meigong Jeroboam in kumpipa ledo hi. Ama in","title":"Jeroboam’ Ledona"},"27":{"text":"kumpipa a ledona thu pen tam zieh ahi hi: Solomon in Millo lam a, a pa David’ khuopi kulpi sunga a vangte a hubih hi."},"28":{"text":"Jeroboam a kici pa pen nasep siem khat hi a, tua tangvalpa pen mi kukal khat hi, ci thu Solomon in a mu ciengin Joseph inn sungah thona-aana tawh nasemte uh dingin a koi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Jerusalem pan Jeroboam a pei ciengin, Shiloh-a kamsangpa Ahijah in lampi-ah ama na dawn hi. Ahijah in puontha khat na sil hi. Ama gel beh gamlahah a om uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ahijah in a puon tha-ah manin phal sawm le phal ni a suo hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in Jeroboam kungah a gen hi: Nangma dingin phal sawm la in; bang ding ahei cile Israel Pasien Topa in tam bangin ci hi, ‘En in, keima in Solomon’ khut sung panin a kumpi gam ka balkeh ta ding a, nangma tungah minam sawm kang pie ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Ka nasempa David zieh le Israel minamte sung pana ka teelsa khuopi Jerusalem ziehin ama adingin minam khat a om ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in keima ei nuasie zo a, ama in Sidon-te’ nusien Astarte, Moab-te’ pasien Chemosh, le Ammon-te’ pasien Milcom bie-in ka lampi a zui sih a, ka muna-ah ama a manin gamta loin, a pa David bangin ka thukhamte le ka ngaina kipte a zui sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanle ama kung panin a kumpi gam buppi ka lahpieh sih ding hi; ka thupiehnate le ka thukhamte a zui pa, keima’ teel ka nasempa David vangin ama’ hin sung tungtawnin uhpa-in ama ka bawl ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ tapa tung panin kumpi gam ka la ding a, nangma tungah minam sawm kang pie ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanle ka nasempa David in ka min koi nadinga ka teelsa khuopi Jerusalem-a keima’ mai-ah ama in meivah khat a nei den thei nadingin a tapa tungah minam khat ka pie ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in nangma hing la-in, na dei zaza tungah na uh ding a, Israel-te tungah kumpi na hi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Ka nasempa David bangin ka thukhamte le ka thupiehnate zui-in kang thupieh zosie mangin ka tawndante na zui a, keima’ muna-ah dihtaha na gamtat leh nangma tawh kang omton ding a, David dingin ka lampieh bangin nang dingin zong inndet khat ka lam ding a, keima in nangma tungah Israel kang pie ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin David’ suonlehlahte dan ka pie ding a, hinanle a tawntung hi lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ziehin Solomon in Jeroboam tha dingin a sui hi; ahi vangin Egypt ah Jeroboam tai-in Egypt kumpi Shishak bel a, Solomon a si dongin Egypt ah a om den hi."},"41":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon’ nasep a omlaite, le a silbawl zosie le a pil a siemna zosie, Solomon’ Nasepna Laibu sungah kigiel sieng zo ta hi lo amah?","title":"Solomon’ Sina"},"42":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem-a Israel mi zosie tungah a uh hun kum sawmli sung ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Solomon lumton a, tuaci’n a pa David khuopi sungah ama kivui hi; tuale a tapa Rehoboam in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama kumpi suohsah dingin Shechem ah Israel mi zosie a pei zo tah ziehun Rehoboam zong a pei hi.","title":"Sahlam Minamte A Tuomin Om (2Khg 10:1–11:4)"},"2":{"text":"Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam in tua thu a zah ciengin (azieh pen Kumpi Solomon kung pan a taina Egypt ah a omlai hi), Egypt panin Jeroboam a kilekia hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in mi sawlin ama a hlan uhi; tuale Jeroboam le a kikhawm Israel buppi pei-in Rehoboam kungah,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa in ka hahkol uh a gihsah hi. Tua ziehin tu-in na pa’ nasep a hamsate le kote tunga ei suon a hahkol gihte hing zangsah in. Tua hile nangma’ na ka sem ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in amate kung ah, “Ni thum sung va pei unlen, tua ciengin ka kungah hing peikia un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n mite a pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Rehoboam in a pa Solomon hin lai-a a na sem khangham mite hlanin thu kuppi a, “Tam mite ka dawn nadingin ngaisutna bang nei ci pieh ding vuoi?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Tuni-in tam mite’ nasem suohin, a na uh nasep a, kam hoino tawh na dawn leh amate na nasem ahi zing ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in khanghamte’ ngaisutna piehte thuse loin tu-a ama’ mai-a ding a khanguol tangvalte po thu a kuppi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “’Na pa in ko tunga ei suon hahkol hing zangsah in,’ ei ci mite bang ka ci dawn diei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"A khanguol tangvalte in ama kungah, “Na kungah, ‘Na pa in ka hahkol uh a gihsah hi, ahi vangin nang in kote adingin hing zangsah in,’ ang ci mite kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi; amate kungah, ‘Ka pa’ kawng sangin ka khutme a sazaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ka pa in na tung vuah hahkol gih ang suon hi. Keima in na hahkol uh kang belap lai ding hi. Ka pa in khauhuol tawh note ang thuhil a, hinanle keima in cieng lingnei tawh note thu kang hil ding hi,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in, “Ni thum ni-in hing peikia un,” a ci ma bangin Rehoboam kungah Jeroboam le mi zosie a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua kumpipa in mite ngawh dawn a, ama in khanghamte’ ngaisutna piehte thuse loin,"},"14":{"text":"khangnote’ ngaisutna piehna bangin a tung vuah gen a, “Ka pa in na hahkol uh ang gihsah hi, ahi vangin keima in na hahkol uh ka belap ding hi; ka pa in note cieng tawh ang thuhil hi. Keima in cieng lingnei tawh note kang thuhil ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in mite’ thu a ngai sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in Shilon-te Ahijah tungtawnin Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam tunga a gensa thu a tangtun thei nadinga Topa in a piensah thu kiheina ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa in a thu uh a ngai lo lamtah Israel zosie in a mu ciengun mite in kumpipa a dawng vua, Kote in David sungah tanh bang ka nei uh ahei? Jessi tapa sungah gamhluo ka nei sih uhi. Israel aw, na puonbuh ah pei in! David aw, tu-in na innsung beh en in,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n a puonbuh ah Israel a pei hi.","ref":"2Sam 20:1"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Rehoboam in Judah khuopite sunga teng Israel-te uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi Rehoboam in thona-aana nasemte uhpa Adoram a sawl ciengin Israel zosie in suong tawh ama a seplia uhi. Jerusalem-a tai dingin a sakol leengah kumpi Rehoboam a nawtuon hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuni dongin Israel in David’ innkuonte a ledo hi."},"20":{"text":"Jeroboam a kinuale zo ahi lamtah Israel zosie in a zah bepun amate in zong mi sawlin kikhopna-ah ama hlansah a, Israel zosie tungah kumpi a semsah uhi. Judah minam khat beh simlo David’ innkuonte a zui koima dang om lo hi.","title":"Kumpigui Masa: Jeroboam in Israel Uh"},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Rehoboam a tun ciengin, Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam in kumpi gam a ngakia thei nadingin Israel innkuon sim dingin Judah’ innkuonte zosie le Benjamin minam, a kiteel galkap tul zakhat le tul sawmgiet kaikhawm hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ mipa Shemaiah tungah Pasien’ thu a tung hi:"},"23":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa, Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam tung, Judah le Benjamin’ innkuon zosiete tung, le a omlai mite tungah gen in."},"24":{"text":"“ Topa in tam bangin gen hi, ‘Na kuonto sih ding vua, na sanggam Israel mite na do sih ding uhi. Mi zosie a inn vuah pei uheh. Azieh pen tam thu pen keima kung pan ahi hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in zong Topa’ thu a mang vua, Topa’ thugen bangin inn lam a zuonkia uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeroboam in Ephraim muoltung gamah Shechem satin khum munah a teng hi; ama khum panin pei-in Penuel a sat hi.","title":"Jeroboam’ Kham Bawngnote"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeroboam in a lungsim sungah, “Tu-in David’ innkuonte tungah kumpi gam kiheikia thei kha ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem-a Topa’ biehinn-ah biehpiehna pie dingin tam mite kuonto den uleh a pupa uh Kumpi Rehoboam lamah a lungsim uh kiheikia ding hi; amate in kei ei thatin Judah Kumpi Rehoboam kungah a kilekia ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in mite thu kuppi kawikawi a, kham bawngno lim ni a bawl hi. Ama in mite tungah, “Jerusalem ah sauvei na peito zo ta uhi. Israel mite aw, tamtahah Egypt gam pana ang peipi na pasiente uh a om hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 32:4"},"29":{"text":"Ama in khat Bethel ah koi a, a khat pen Dan ah koi hi."},"30":{"text":"Mi kimkhat a bie dingin Bethel ah, adangte Dan cieng dong a pei ziehun tam pen mawna khat a suoh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in munsangte tungah zong innte lam a, mi zosiete lah panin Levi-te ahi lo mite siempu-in koi hi."},"32":{"text":"Jeroboam in Judah gam sungah pawi kibawl bangin hla giet a cin ni, a ni sawm le nga ni-in pawi khat bawl a, maitam tungah biehpiehnate a pie hi; tuaci’n ama in Bethel ah zong bawlin a bawlsa bawngno milimte tungah biehpiehna a pie hi. Ama in Bethel ah a bawlsa munsang siempute koi hi."},"33":{"text":"Hla giet a cin ni, a ni sawm le nga ni, ama beh in a gelna hla sungin Bethel-a a bawlsa maitam ah peito hi; ama in Israel mite adingin pawi khat bawlin gimnamtui hal dingin maitam ah a peito hi.","ref":"Siem 23:33-34"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gimnamtui hal dingin maitam gei-ah Jeroboam a din laitahin, Topa’ thu tawh Judah panin Bethel ah Pasien’ mipa khat a tung hi.","title":"Judah Pana Pasien’ Mipa"},"2":{"text":"Pasien’ mipa in Topa’ thu tawh maitam lang khatah kikozah a, “Maitam, maitam aw, Topa in tam bangin gen hi: ‘David’ innkuon panin Josiah min nei tapa khat ang suoh ding hi; tuale ama in gimnamtui a hal, munsang tunga om siempute nangma tungah siem thoina-in ang pie ding a, mihing’ gute nangma tungah kihal ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 23:15-16"},"3":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in ama in lim khat pie a, “Tami khu Topa in a gensa lim ahi hi: ‘Maitam kiphelkhe ding a, a tunga om vutvamte kithezah ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in Bethel ah maitam a langpan Pasien’ mipa thugen a zah ciengin maitam panin Jeroboam in a khut a zah kawmin, “Ama man un,” ci hi. Ahi vangin ama lama a zah a khut gawta-in a nuadaw thei ta sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ thu tawh Pasien’ mipa in lim khat a piehna tawh kizui-in maitam zong kiphelkhe-in maitam panin vutvamte kithezah hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa in Pasien’ mipa kungah, “Ka khut a ngai a bah thei nadingin tu-in kei dingin thu ei ngetpieh inlen, Topa na Pasien’ maipha ka nga thei nadingin zong ei thumpieh in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Pasien’ mipa in Topa tungah a thumpieh hi; tuale kumpipa’ khut damin a ngai bangkia hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Pasien’ mipa kungah, “Innah ei zui inlen an neton vai, keima in letsong khat hing pie vang,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hizongle Pasien’ mipa in kumpipa kungah, “Na kumpi gam phal khat ei hawm nan lacin na inn ah kang haw sih ding hi; khum munah an zong ne loin tui zong ka dawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam bangin kei thu ei pie hi: An ne loin tuisih zong na dawn sih ding a, na peina lampi zui-in na kilekia sih ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama lampi dangah pei a, Bethel ah ang peina lampi zui-in a kilekia ta sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Bethel ah khum hun lai-in kam sang puvuoi khat a teng hi. A tapate khat pei-in khum ni-a Pasien’ mipa in Bethel ah a sepsa thu teng ama kungah a gen hi; ama in kumpipa kunga a gen thute zong a pa uh kungah a gen uhi."},"12":{"text":"A pa un amate kungah, “Ama hei lamah a pei ta e?” a ci hi. A tapate in Judah gam pana Pasien’ mipa peina lampi a lah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a tapate kungah, “Kei ading laa khat a topha ei vawpieh un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in laa khat a topha a vaw vua, laa tungah ama a tuong hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in Pasien’ mipa nuadel a, gangpi sing nei khatah a to laitah a mu hi. Ama in khumpa kungah, “Judah gam pana ang pei Pasien’ mipa kici nang na hiei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tua pa kungah, “Ka inn ah ei zui inlen an hing ne ta’n,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Hizongle ama in, “Nang tawh kang kilekia thei sih ding a, na inn sungah zong kang lut thei sih ding hi; tam munah zong nang tawh an ka ne sih ding a, tui zong ka dawn sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima kungah Topa in tam bangin gen hi: ‘Khum munah an zong ne loin tui zong na dawn sih ding a, na peina lampi lamah nang kilekia sih ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin adang khat in ama kungah, “Kei zong nang banga kamsang khat ka hi a, Topa’ thu tawh vantungmi khat in ka kungah thu ang gen a, “An ne ding le tui dawn dingin na inn ah ama hing zawpikia in,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in khumpa a sol ahi bo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tawh Pasien’ mipa kilekia-in a inn ah an ne-in tui a dawn hi."},"20":{"text":"Sabuoi-ah ama gel a to laitahin ama a zawpikia kamsangpa kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi;"},"21":{"text":"tuale Judah gam pana a pei Pasien’ mipa kungah ama kiko-in, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Nang in Topa’ thugen mang loin Topa na Pasien in na kunga ang gensa thupiehna na zui sih a,"},"22":{"text":"ahi vangin ama in na kungah, ‘An ne sinlen tui dawn sin,’ ang cina munah kilekia-in an ne-in tui dawn na hi ziehin na pu na pate’ hanah na luonghawm kivui lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasien’ mipa in an ne-in tui a dawn zaw ciengin amate in a zawpikia uh ahi kamsangpa’ laa phaw a vawpieh uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pei laitahin humpi khat in ama na dawntuo-in ama a petlia hi. A luonghawm lampi-ah kipai a, ama’ gei-ah a laa a ding hi; humpi zong a luonghawm gei-ah a ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Mite in a nawhkha vua, lampi-ah a luong kipai-in a luong gei-ah humpi a ding a mu uhi. Amate zong pei-in kamsang puvuoi pa tenna khuopi sungah tua thu a gen uhi."},"26":{"text":"Lamkim pana ama a zawpi kamsangpa in khumi thu a zah cieng in, “Tua pa pen Topa’ thugen a mang lo Pasien’ mipa ahi hi. Tua ahi ziehin Topa in ama kunga a gensa tawh kizui-in Topa in humpi tungah ama pie a, tua in ama ehmalin a tha ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a tapate kungah, “Kei ading laa phaw ei vawpieh un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in khat a vawpieh vua,"},"28":{"text":"ama a va pei ciengin lampi-a a luonghawm kipai le laa le a luonghawm gei-ah humpi a ding a mu hi. Humpi in a luonghawm ne loin a laa zong bangma law lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Kamsangpa in Pasien’ mipa’ luonghawm domto-in a laa tungah khang a, kaa ding le vui dingin khuopi sungah a peipi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in ama’ hanah tua luonghawm a vui hi; tuale amate in ama uopin a kaa vua, “Kadei, ka sanggampa!” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in tua pa a vui zaw ciengin a tapate kungah, “Kei ka si ciengin tua Pasien’ mipa kivuina hanah ei vui un; ama’ gute gei-ah ka gute koi un,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in Bethel-a maitamte le Samaria khuopite sunga a om munsang tunga kithoina mun zosie’ langkhatah Topa’ thu tawh a thugente tung valon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tam thute a pien zaw nangawnin zong a gitlona panin Jeroboam kihei nuom tuon lo a, tua lemahin mi zosie lah panin munsangte tunga siempu sem ding mi a sekia hi; ama in siempu a suoh nuom popo munsangte-a siempu dingin a siensuo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tam thu pen lei maitang panin Jeroboam innkuon tungah vatmai ding le suhmang ding a tun mawna a suoh hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Jeroboam’ tapa Abijah a cina hi.","title":"Jeroboam’ Innkuon Tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Jero-boam in a zi kungah, “Pei inlen, Jeroboam’ zi na hi lam ang kithei lo nadingin na mel kisel inlen, Shiloh ah va haw ta’n; azieh pen tam mite tungah kumpi ka hi nadingin keima kunga thu ang gen kamsangpa Ahijah khum sungah a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Anlum sawm, moh halkhat le khuoizu thawl khat kengin khum pa kungah va haw ta’n; ama in naupang tunga a pieng ding thu na kungah ang gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bang ma-in Jeroboam’ zi a gamta hi; ama kithawi-in Shiloh lam zuon a, Ahijah’ inn a tung hi. Tua hunin a kum tam ziehin Ahijah a mit mangin khuo mu thei lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in Ahijah kungah, “A tapa tungtang nang thu ang dong dingin Jeroboam’ zi ang pei hi; azieh pen a tapa a cina hi. Nangma in tua nu kungah tua bang tua bangin na gen ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua nu a tun ciengin numei dang khat a kipang hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ahijah in tua nu kotbieng a gei laitah a keng gin a zah ciengin ama in, “Hing lut in, Jeroboam zi aw; bang dinga midang khat kipang na hei? Nang adingin thu hamsa khat ei kiguon hi."},"7":{"text":"Pei inlen Jeroboam kungah gen in, ‘Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Mite lah panin nangma hing domsangin ka mi Israel tungah makai-in kang bawl a,"},"8":{"text":"tuale David’ innkuonte panin kumpi gam balkehin nangma tungah kang pie hi; hinanle ka thupiehnate kemcingin a lungsim zosie tawh keima ei zui-in, ka muna-ah thuman beh tawh a gamta ka nasempa David tawh na kibang sih a,"},"9":{"text":"na mai-a om mi zosie sangin a sie zaw-in na gamta zo a, vahmangin nang adingin pasien dangte le a kisung milimte na bawl ziehin kei nei lungthahsah a, na nua lam sena-in keima nei nei hi;"},"10":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin mi khat in a tumvam dongin bawng-eh a halvam bangin keima in Jeroboam’ innkuon tungah sietna tungsahin, Jeroboam innkuon panin Israel gama om sal hile, a suohta mi hile, pasal zosie sumangin ka that ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 15:29"},"11":{"text":"Jeroboam’ mi, khuopi sunga a si popo a sa uite in ne ding hi; tuale gamlaha a si popo vana a leng vate in ne ding hi; azieh pen Topa in gen zo hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ding inlen na inn lamah pei in. Na keng tawh khuopi sung na tot ciengin tua naupang pa a si ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel zosie in ama kaa-in a vui ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Jeroboam innkuon sung panin Israel Pasien Topa a lungkimsahna thu ama tungah themkhat a kimu ziehin Jeroboam innkuon sung panin ama beh hanah kivui ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua tham loin tu nangawnin zong Topa in Israel tungah ama adingin kumpi khat a khangsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tui sunga pumpeng a kithin bangin Topa in Israel a vat ding hi; ama in a pu a pate tunga a pieh tam gamhoi panin Israel phungkal ding a, Euphrates galkhatah a thezah ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile amate in a khuom siengthote uh bawlin Topa lungthahsah uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jeroboam’ mawnate le Israel-te a bawlsah mawnate ziehin ama in Israel nuasie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeroboam’ zi tho-in pei a, Tirzah ah a tung hi. Tua nu a inn sangkil a tun laitahin tua naupang a si hi."},"18":{"text":"A nasem kamsangpa Ahijah tungtawnin Topa’ thugenna tawh kizui-in Israel zosie in ama kaa-in a vui uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in Jeroboam’ gamtatna omlai teng, a galdona le a gam uhnate, Israel Kumpite’ Khanggui Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi.","title":"Jeroboam’ Sina"},"20":{"text":"Jeroboam’ maan hun sung kum sawmni le ni ahi hi; tua ciengin a pu a pate tawh ama lumton a, a tapa Nadad in ama’ za luo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam in Judah uh hi. Gam a uh patin Rehoboam kum sawmli le khat pha a, ama’ min koi nadinga Topa in Israel minam zosie sung pana a teel khuopi Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le sagi sung uh hi. A nu’ min Naamah ahi a, Ammon-te ahi hi.","title":"Rehoboam in Judah Uh (2Khg 11:5–12:16)"},"22":{"text":"Topa’ muna-ah Judah in sietna bawl hi; a pu a pate bawl zosie sangin a tam zaw-in amau’ mawnate tawh ama hazatna dingin a bawl uhi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in amate dingin munsangte, biehna songte, khuom siengthote, muolsang zosie le singna dawng zosie tengah khuom siengthote a phut uhi;","ref":"2Kum 17:9-10"},"24":{"text":"tua gam sungah pasal pahtatte zong a om hi. Topa in Israel-te mai-a a delmangsa ahi a kidahhuoi minamte gamtatnate bangin amate a gamta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Kumpi Rehoboam’ a kum ngana kumin Jerusalem sim dingin Egypt kumpi Shishak a kuonto hi;","ref":"2Khg 12:2-8"},"26":{"text":"ama in Topa’ biehinn sunga goute le kumpipa’ inn sunga goute a unpi-in a tomgam a, Solomon’ bawlsa kham lumte zong a la hi;","ref":"1Kum 10:16-17; 2Khg 9:15-16"},"27":{"text":"tuaci’n Kumpi Rehoboam in tua teng tangin sumngo awmphawte bawlin kumpi inn kotcing ahi inncing uliente khut sungah tuate ap hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sungah kumpipa a pei sielin inncingte in tuate puo-in inncinna khan sungah a koikia uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tu-in Rehoboam’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"30":{"text":"Rehoboam le Jeroboam kikalah gal kidona om ngitnget hi."},"31":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Rehoboam lumtonin David khuopi ah a pu a pate tawh kivuiton hi. A nu’ min Naamah ahi a, Ammon-te ahi hi. A tapa Abijam in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Nebat’ tapa Kumpi Jeroboam’ kum sawm le gietna kumin Abijam in Judah gam uh ding kipan hi.","title":"Abijam in Judah Uh: Milim Biehna le Gal Kisimna (2Khg 13:1-22)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kum thum sung Jerusalem uh hi. Ama’ nu min Maacah ahi a, Abishalom’ tanu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A pa in ama mai-a a na bawl mawna zosie ama in zong a bawl hi. A pa David’ lungtang puoh bangin Topa a Pasien tungah a lungtang a thuman zo sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa a Pasien in David ziehin Jerusalem-ah ama meivah khat pie a, ama’ nua-ah tapa khat koi-in Jerusalem a sukip hi;","ref":"1Kum 11:36"},"5":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Hit mi Uriah tungtang khat ci simlo Topa muna-ah David a dihin gamta a, a hin sung tungtawnin a thupieh khat popo panin ama piel lo hi.","ref":"2Sam 11:1-27"},"6":{"text":"A hin sung tungtawnin Rehoboam le Jeroboam kikalah gal kidona a om zing hi.","ref":"2Khg 13:3-21"},"7":{"text":"Abijam gamtatna a omlai teng le a sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah? Abijam le Jeroboam kikalah gal kidona a om hi."},"8":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Abijam lumton a, David khuopi sungah ama kivui hi. Tua ciengin a tapa Asa in ama’ za luo hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel kumpi Jeroboam’ kum sawmni na kumin Asa in Judah gamah maan ding kipan hi;","title":"Asa in Kumpi Sem (2Khg 14:1–15:19)"},"10":{"text":"ama kum sawmli le khat sung Jerusalem ah maang hi. A pi’ min Maacah ahi a, Abishalom’ tanu ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A pupi David gamtat bangin Topa muna-ah Asa a dihin a gamta hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in gam sung panin pasal pahtat zosie sumangin a pu a pate bawlsa milim zosie paimang sieng hi.","ref":"2Khg 15:8-15"},"13":{"text":"Tua nu in Asherah adingin a huothuoi milim khat a bawl ziehin kumpinu hina panin a pi Maacah zong a hemkhie hi; Asa in tua nu’ milim tuntanin Kidron Lui-ah a haltum hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin munsangte a kihemkhie sih hi. Hizongle ama a hin sung tungtawnin Topa tungah Asa’ lungtang a thuman hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ inn sungah a pa kiciemna letsongte le ama’ kiciemna letsongte - ngun, kham, le um le beelte a peipi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate khan hun sung tungtawnin Asa le Israel kumpi Baasha kikalah gal kisimna a om hi.","title":"Aram tawh Kipawlin Israel Do (2Khg 16:1–17:1)"},"17":{"text":"Judah sim dingin Israel kumpi Baasha kuonto a, Judah Kumpi Asa kung panin koima a sungtum le a pusuoh a om thei lo nadingin Ramah khuo a lam hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Asa in Topa’ inn sunga goute le kumpipa’ inn sunga kinuasie goute la-in a nasemte khut sungah a pie hi. Kumpi Asa in Damascus-a teng, Aram kumpipa, Hezion’ tapa Tabrimmon, a tapa Ben-hadad kungah tuate puoh a,"},"19":{"text":"“Ka pa le na pa ma bangin keima le nangma kikalah kipawlna khat omsah vai: Nangma kungah ngun le kham letsong kang puoh hi; kei kung panin ama a nuakin thei nadingin pei inlen Israel kumpi Baasha tawh na kipawlna va sutat ta’n,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Benhadad in kumpi Asa’ thugen mang a, Israel khuopite sim dingin a galkap uliente sawlin, Ijon, Dan, Abel-bethmaacah, le Chinneroth zosie, Naphtali gam zosie tawh a zo sieng hi."},"21":{"text":"Baasha in tua thu a zah ciengin Ramah lam dinkhawl a, Tirzah ah a teng hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi Asa in Judah gam sung zosie-ah koima a pelem om loin tangtawhna khat a bawl hi: Amate in Baasha in khuo lamna-a a zah Ramah-a sing le suongte a nawn sieng uhi; tuate tawh Kumpi Asa in Benjamin-te’ khuo Giba le Mizpah a lam hi."},"23":{"text":"Tu-in Asa’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a thahatna zosie, a sep zosie, le a lam khuopite, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah? Ahi vangin ama a vuoi ciengin a kengah natna a nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pu a pate tawh Asa lumton a, a pupi David khuopi sungah a pu a pate tawh ama kivui hi; a tapa Jehoshaphat in ama’ za luo hi."},"25":{"text":"Judah kumpi Asa’ kum nina kumin Jeroboam’ tapa Nadab in Israel tunga maan ding kipan a, Israel ah kum ni sung maang hi.","title":"Israel-ah Nadab in Kumpi Sem"},"26":{"text":"Topa’ muna-ah ama siet gamtat a, a pu a pate’ lampi ma zui-in Israel mawna a bawlsah hi."},"27":{"text":"Issachar innkuon Ahijah’ tapa Baasha in ama sawmsim hi; tuale Baasha in Philistia-te’ khuo Gibbethon ah ama a satlia hi; azieh pen Nadab le Israel zosie in Gibbethon khuopi a busim laitah uh ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judah kumpi Asa’ kum thumna kumin Baasha in Nadab that a, ama in Nadab’ za luo hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama kumpi ahi zaw behin Jeroboam’ innkuon zosie that hi; Topa in Shilon-te a nasempa Ahijah’ tungtawna a gensa dung zui-in a unpi-in a suhsiet dongin ama in Jeroboam’ innkuon ah mi khat zong hen lo hi.","ref":"1Kum 14:10"},"30":{"text":"Tua khu ama’ mawna le Israel a mawsahna ahi Jeroboam’ mawnate zieh le Israel Pasien Topa a thangpaisahna zieh ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tu-in Nadab’ gamtatna a omlai teng, le a sep zosie, a unpi-in Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"32":{"text":"A hin sung tungtawnun Asa le Israel kumpi Baasha kikalah gal kidona a om hi."},"33":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa’ kum thumna kumin Ahijah’ tapa Baasha in Tirzah-a Israel zosie sunga maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Kumpigui A Nina: Israel’ Tungah Baasha in Kumpi Sem"},"34":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat a, Jeroboam’ zui lampi le Israel a khielsah ama mawna ma a zui hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Baasha langpangin Hanani’ tapa Jehu tungah Topa’ thu tung a,"},"2":{"text":"“Keima in leivui panin nang kang domsang a, ka mi Israel tungah makai-a kang koi hi napi, nang in Jeroboam’ lampi ma zui-in ka mi Israel na mawsah a, a mawna utawh ka thangpai nadingin kei nei kuontaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in Baasha le a innkuon ka phietmang ding a, Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ innkuon bangin nangma’ innkuon ka bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Baasha-a’ ahi khuopi sunga a si popo uite in ne ding hi; tuale ama-a’ ahi gamlaha a si popo vana leng vate in ne ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Baasha’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a septe, le a thahatna, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"6":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Baasha lumton a, Tirzah ah ama kivui hi; tuale a tapa Elah in ama’ za luo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua tham loin Jeroboam innkuon tawh kibangin Topa muna-ah a sie lama a gamtatna zosie zieh le ama’ khuta a nasepna tawh ama thangpai sahin Jeroboam le a innkuonte a suhsiet ziehin, Hanani’ tapa kamsangpa Jehu tungtawnin Baasha le a innkuonte langkhatah Topa’ thu a tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Asa’ kum sawmni le guhna kumin Baasha’ tapa Elah in Tirzah ah Israel tunga maan ding kipan a, ama kum ni sung maang hi.","title":"Elah in Israel Uh"},"9":{"text":"Hinanle sakol leeng alang a uhpa a nasem Zimri in ama a sawmsim hi. Tirzah-a kumpi innsung a uhpa Arza’ inn ah zukhamin Tirzah ah ama a op laitah,"},"10":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Asa’ kum sawmni le sagina kumin Zimri pei-in satpuo a, ama thatin ama’ za luo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in uh ding a kipat a kumpi topha tunga a to zaw behin Baasha’ innkuonte a unpi-in that hi; ama in a tanaute pasal khat beh ahi a, a guolte ahi zongin khat zong hingkhawi lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Kamsangpa Jehu tungtawnin Baasha langah Topa’ kammal omsa dung zui-in Zimri in Baasha’ innkuonte zosie tua bangin a susie hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen Baasha le a tapa Elah’ bawlsa mawnate ziehin Israel khielsahin, a milimte utawh Israel Pasien Topa a lungthahsah zieh uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in Elah’ gamtatna a omlai teng, le a sep zosie, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigel hi lo amah?"},"15":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Asa’ kum sawmni le sagina kumin Zimri in Tirzah ah ni sagi sung uh hi. Tua ciengin Philistia-te-a’ ahi Gibbethon sim dingin galkapte in giephuol a sat vua,","title":"Kumpigui Thumna: Zimri in Israel Uh"},"16":{"text":"tuale giephuol a sat galkapte in, “Zimri in sawmsimin kumpipa that zo hi,” ci thu a za uhi; tua ziehin Israel zosie in khum ni-in giephuol-ah galkapmang Omri Israel kumpi ahisah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gibbethon panin Omri le a ompi Israel zosie kuonto-in Tirzah a kui-im uhi."},"18":{"text":"Zimri in tua khuopi a kilah zo lam a mu ciengin kumpi’ inndan kulpi sungah lutin kumpipa’ inn tawh mei-in kihaltha-in a si hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua banga a kibawlna pen a bawlsa ama’ mawnnate, Topa muna-ah a siet gamtatna, Jeroboam’ pienzie a zuina, a bawlsa a mawna, le Israel in mawna a bawlsahna zieh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Zimri’ gamtatna a omlai teng, le a mi sawmdapnate, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel mite pawl ni-in a kikhen uhi; mipi alang in kumpi sem dingin Ginath’ tapa Tibni zui-a, alang in Omri a zui hi.","title":"Kumpigui Lina: Omri in Israel Uh"},"22":{"text":"Hinanle Omri’ nuazuite in Ginath’ tapa Tibni nuazuite a zo zaw uhi; tuale Tibni si-in Omri kumpi a suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Asa’ kum sawmthum le khatna kumin Israel-te tunga maan ding kipan hi; ama kum sawm le ni sung maang a, Tirzah ah kum guh sung maang hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in Shemer kung panin ngun talent ni tawh Samaria muol a lei hi; ama in kul tawh tua muol im a, tua muol a nei pa Shemar’ min tapin a lamsa khuopi min Samaria phuoh hi.","title":"Samaria Khuopi Tha"},"25":{"text":"Topa muna-ah Omri a sie-in gamta hi; ama mai-a mi zosie sangin a sie zaw-in ama a gamta hi."},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ tot lampi zosie, le Israel a khielsah a mawnate, a milimte utawh Israel Pasien, Topa a thangpaisahna uh a zui hi."},"27":{"text":"Tu-in Omri’ nasep a omlai teng, le a thahatna lahna, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"28":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Omri lumton hi; tuale Samaria ah ama kivui hi; a tapa Ahab in ama’ za luo hi."},"29":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Asa’ kum sawmthum le gietna kumin Omri’ tapa Ahab in Israel tungah maan ding kipan a, Samaria ah kum sawmli sung Israel tungah maang hi.","title":"Ahab in Israel Uh"},"30":{"text":"Omri’ tapa Ahab in ama’ mai-a mi zosie sangin Topa muna-ah a sie zaw-in a gamta hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama adingin Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate zui ding pen a bai tawh a kibah ma bangin, ama in Sidon-te’ Kumpi Ethbaal’ tanu Jezebel zi-in la a, ama pei-in Baal’ na semin bie hi.","title":"Jezebel tawh Ahab Kinungin Baal Bie"},"32":{"text":"Ama in Samaria-a a lam Baal inn sungah Baal adingin maitam khat phut hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahab in zong khuom siengtho khat bawl a, Ahab in ama’ masanga Israel kumpi zosie sangin Israel Pasien, Topa thangpai nading tam a bawlzaw hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama hun lai-in Bethel-te Hiel in Jericho a sat hi. tuale Topa in Nun’ tapa Joshua tungah a gensa dung zui-in, a tacil Abiram tanlaw liengin ama in khuombul na phut a, a tapa tumpen Segub tanlaw-in a khuo kotpite na phut hi.","ref":"Josh 6:26"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Gilead-a Tishbe khuo panin Tishbe-te Elijah in Ahab kungah, “A mai-a ka dinna Israel Pasien, Topa a hing ahi ma bangin keima thu tawh loin ang tung ding kumte sungah daitui hile, guotui hile a om sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Guotui Kan Ding Elijah in Magen","ref":"Jas 5:17"},"2":{"text":"Ama kungah Topa’ thu tung a,"},"3":{"text":"“Tam mun panin pei-in nisuona lamah kihei inlen, Jordan’ nisuona lam Cherith Lui-ah kiphuol in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuami lui tui na dawn ding a, khum munah nang ang va dingin va-ahte thu ka pie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama pei-in Topa’ thugen bangin gamta hi; ama zong pei-in Jordan nisuona lam Cherith Lui gei-ah a teng hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingmawngin ama kungah va-ahte in anlum le sa puoh zelin, nitahin zong anlum le moh ma a puoh uhi; tuale ama in lui panin tui a dawn hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum gam sungah guo a zuh lo ziehin bakhat zaw ciengin tua lui a kang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah Topa’ thu tung a,","title":"Zarephath Meigongnu"},"9":{"text":"“Tu-in Sidon mite’ khuo Zarephath ah pei inlen khumnah va teng ta’n; azieh pen nang ang va dingin meigong numei khat thu ka pie zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 4:25-26"},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n dingin Zerephath-ah ama a pei hi. Khuopi tunkot a gei ciengin khumtahah meigong numei khat in sing a na tom hi; ama in tua nu hlanin, “Hai khat tawh ka dawn ding tui ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tui pie dinga a kisah laitahin ama in tua nu hlanin, “Anlum halkhat zong na khutah ei tawi ta’n,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua nu in, “ Topa na Pasien a hing ahi ma bangin bangma moh emsa ka nei vawt sih hi, beel sungah annel khutdim khat le um sungah sathau halkhat beh ka nei tabo hi; tu-in inn ah pei-in keima le ka tapa adingin tuate bawlin ka neh thei nadingun singkang ni hawkhat a tom dinga ang kuon ka hi a, tuate ka neh zaw cieng gel le a si ding ka hi mai gel hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Elijah in tua nu kungah, “Zau sin; pei inlen na gensa bangin va bawl ta’n; hizongle kei ading moh neuno khat hing bawl masa inlen ka kungah hing tawi in, tua zaw ciengin nangma le na tapa adingin bawl in."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Topa in leitungah guo ang zuhsah ni masangin beel sunga annel tawp ngai lo ding a, um sunga sathau zong kiem ngai lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nu pei-in Elijah’ gen bangin a bawl hi. Tuaci’n tua nu, tua pa, le tua nu’ innkuon in ni tampi sung tua an a ne uhi."},"16":{"text":"Elijah tungtawnin Topa’ thugen tawh kizui-in beel sunga annel tawp lo a, um sunga sathau zong kiem lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin inn neinu, tua numei’ tapa a ci na hi; a natna na sie semsem ahi ziehin a huu tawpin a si hi.","title":"Elijah in Meigongnu’ Tapa Hingsahkia"},"18":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin tua nu in Elijah kungah, “Pasien’ mipa aw, bang dinga nei langpan ahei? Ka mawna ei phawhsah ding le ka tapa sisah dinga ka kunga hing pei na hi hi!” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in tua nu kungah, “Na tapa ei pie in,” a ci hi. Ama in tua nu kang sung panin ama domto a, a giena innkhan tungnungah puoto-in a lupna tungah a siel hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa tungah ama kiko a, “ Topa ka Pasien aw, a tapa thana tawh ka zin tunna tam meigong nu’ tung nangawnah tuosietna na tunsah amah?” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin naupangno tungah ama thumvei kihlung phei-in Topa tungah kiko a, “ Topa ka Pasien aw, tami naupangno hingsahkia in,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 4:34-35"},"22":{"text":"Topa in Elijah’ tauna a ngai hi; ama kungah naupangno hinna peikia-in ama a hingkia hi."},"23":{"text":"Elijah in tua naupangno la-in, innkhan tungnung panin a inn sungah zawpi a, a nu kungah tut hi; tua ciengin Elijah in, “En in, na tapa hing zo hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n numei in Elijah kungah, “Tu-in ahile nangma Pasien’ mi na hina le nangma’ kam sunga Topa’ thute a man ahina ka thei ta hi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni tampi zaw, guotui kan kum thum a cin kumin Elijah kungah Topa’ thu tung a, “Pei inlen, Ahab kungah nang mama va kila ta’n; keima in leitungah guo ka zusah ta ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Ahab Tunga Elijah’ Thupuoh"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama ma Ahab kunga kila dingin Elijah a kuon hi. Samaria ah kielpi na sie mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahab in kumpi inn uhpa Obadiah a thuta hi. (Khum hun lai-in Obadiah in nahpitahin Topa a zatah hi;"},"4":{"text":"Jezebel in Topa’ kamsangte a tha lai-in Obadiah in kamsang zakhat zawpi a, sawm nga ta-in leihawm sung khatah phuolin an le tui tawh a va hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ahab in Obadiah kungah, “Gam sunga ciatui a opna zosie le lui zosie-ah pei in; i sakolte le i laa-sakolte i hinsuo nadingin lopa khat beh i mu thei kha ding a, tua hile ganhing kimkhat i tan sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama ni in zong a sui nading gam a hawm pai gel hi; Ahab mama mun khat lamah pei-in, Obadia mama mun khat lamah a pei hi."},"7":{"text":"Lampi-ah Obadiah a pei laitahin Elijah in ama na dawn hi; Obadiah in ama thei pai a, a mai tuolkunin, “Nang ka pu Elijah na hiei mah?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “Ka hi hi. Pei inlen na pu kungah, ‘Elijah tanah om,’ ci-in va gen ta’n,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Ahab’ khut sungah na nasempa tha dinga nei pieh nadingin ke’n bangci bangin mawna bawl ka hi ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Topa na Pasien a hing ahi ma bangin ka pu in nangma sui dingin a sawl lo minam le kumpi gam khat zong om lo hi; tuale amate in, ‘Tam tahah om lo hi,’ a ci ciengun nangma ang mu lona thu uh ama in kumpigam hile, minam hile a kiciemsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in nangma in, “Pei inlen na pu kungah, “Elijah tanah a om hi,’ ci-in va gen ta’n,’ nei ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma kung panin ka pei zaw behin Topa’ hlagau in ka thei lona munah nang ang puo ding hi; tuaci’n keima pei-in Ahab kungah va gen ta leng ama in nang ang mu zawh lo ciengin, keima na nasempa in ka khangno lai-a kipanin Topa ka zatah vangin ama in kei ei that ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Jezebel in Topa’ kamsangte a tha lai-in Topa’ kamsangte mi zakhat, sawmnga ta-in leihawm sungah phuolin, an le tui tawh amate ka vana le ka silbawlte ka pu kungah ang kigen kha nai sih amah?"},"14":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in nangma in, “Pei inlen na pu kungah, ‘Tam sungah Elijah om hi, va ci ta’n,’ nei ci hi,” a ci hi; tua hile ama in keima ei that valon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Elijah in, “A mai-a ka dinna Vanglien Topa a hing ahi ma bangin tuni-in ama kungah kei mama ka kilah teitei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ahab tawh kimu dingin Obadiah kuonin ama kungah a gen hi; tuale Elijah tawh kimu dingin Ahab a kuon hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahab in Elijah a mu ciengin ama kungah, “Israel a lunggimsah pa nang na hiei mah?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “Keima in Israel ka lungkhamsah sih hi; hinanle nangma in Topa’ thupiehnate na nuasie a, Baal-te nua na zui ziehin nang le na pa’ innkuon in a lungkhamsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ziehin tu-in mi sawl inlen, Carmel Muol keima kungah Israel mi zosie, le Jezebel’ sabuoi-a an ne Baal kamsang zali le sawmnga le Asherah kamsang zalite hing khawm in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Israel mi zosie kungah mi sawlin Carmel Muolah kamsangte a kikhawmsah hi.","title":"Elijah’ Guolzawna"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi zosie lamah Elijah pei a, tuale ama in, “Ngaisutna kibang lo thu ni kikalah bang tanvei kikai-awh ding na hi uh ahei? Topa khu Pasien ahile zui unlen, Baal ahi lezong kizui ta un,” a ci hi. Mite in kamkhat beh a dawng sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elijah in mite kungah, “ Topa’ kamsang sung pan kei, kei ngentang ka om tabo a, ahi mawh vangin Baal’ kamsangte zali le sawmnga a pha uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kote kungah bawngtang ni ei pie tuoh un; amate bawngtang khat teelsah unlen, a sa semnenin sing tungah koisahin a tungah meitawsah sih un; keima in bawngtang adang khat go-in sing tungah ka koi ding a, ahi vangin a tungah mei ka taw sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin na pasien uh’ tungah thu ngen unlen, keima in zong Topa tungah thu ka ngen ding hi; mei tawh thungetna ei dawng pasien pen Pasien tahtah ahi hi,” a ci hi. Mi zosie in a dawng vua, “Na thugen hoi e!” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elijah in Baal’ kamsangte kungah, “Note mi tam na hi ziehun noma dingin bawngtang khat teel unlen bawl masa un; tua ciengin na pasien uh tungah thu ngen un. Hizongle a tungah mei taw sih un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in amate kipie bawngtang la-in a bawl vua, zingmawnga kipanin sunkim dongin Baal’ tungah thu ngenin, “Baal aw, ei dawng bo ven!” a ci uhi. Hizongle bangma awging om loin koima khat in zong dawng lo hi. A bawlsa uh maitam kimvelah amate a kitom vazawh uhi."},"27":{"text":"Sunkim ciengin Elijah in amate ehneh ho a, “Kinah ko bo ve un! Ama pasien tahtah ahi a, a thu lungngai pet khat ahiei, ahi sihle a vah dawh khat ahiei, ahi sihle khuolzin khat ahiei, ahi sihle a kimutpet khat ahiei, phawh ding kisam khat ahiei zong hi kha thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate nahpitahin kiko-in a ngaina bangun a pumpi tung vuah si a luon dongin namsaute le siazumte tawh a kisun tepop uhi."},"29":{"text":"Sunkim zaw biehpiehna hun cieng dongin a kikoko vangun awging khat zong kiza lo, zong kidawng loin zong kithuh lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elijah in mi zosie kungah, “Ka kungah ei nai ta un,” a ci hi. Tuale mi zosie in ama kung a nai uhi. Ama in a masa-in a kisiesa Topa’ maitam a puophakia hi;"},"31":{"text":"Elijah in, “Na min Israel kici ding hi,” ci-a Topa’ thu tunna Jacob’ tapa minam a phaza zui-in suong sawm le ni a la hi;","ref":"Pien 32:28; 35:10"},"32":{"text":"tua suong teng tawh Topa’ minin maitam khat a lam hi. Tua ciengin tua maitam kimvelah khaici law ni a ta dingin hawhlam khat a bawl hi."},"33":{"text":"A banah ama in a ngaina bangin sing koi a, a bawngtang semnenin tua sing tungah a khangto hi. Ama in, “Beel li sungah tui dim unlen, meihal biehna tung le sing tungah sung un,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “A ni veina bawlkia un,” a ci hi. Amate in zong a ni veina a bawlkia uhi. Ama in, “A thum veina bawl un,” a ci a, a thum veina bawl leuleu uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n maitam kimvelah tui luongin hawhlam-ah zong tui a vei hi."},"36":{"text":"Kithoina hun ciengin kamsang Elijah a nai-ah pei-in, “Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasien, Topa aw, Israel sungah nangma Pasien na hina, nangma’ nasempa ka hina, le tami sil zosie nangma’ thu tawh ka bawl ahina thu tuni-in kitheisah in."},"37":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma Pasien na hina le a lungtang uh na heipiehkiana thu tam mite in a thei nadingin ei dawng in, Topa aw, ei dawng in,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ meikuong kiesuh a, a meihal biehna, a sing, a suongte, le a leivuite kavamin hawhlam sunga tui nangawn a kanggaw sieng hi."},"39":{"text":"Mi zosie in tuate a mu ciengun tuolah a bawhsuh vua, “ Topa pen Pasien tahtah ahi hi; Topa pen Pasien tahtah ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"40":{"text":"Elijah in amate kungah, “Baal’ kamsangte man un; khat zong suotasah sih un,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin amate in a man uhi; tuale Elijah in Kishon Lui-ah zawpisuhin tua munah amate that sieng hi."},"41":{"text":"Elijah in Ahab kungah, “Peito-inlen an ne-in tui dawn in; azieh pen guo zuh ding a huging kiza ta hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Guotui Kan Tawp"},"42":{"text":"Tuaci’n anne tuidawn dingin Ahab a peito hi. Carmel Muol vumah Elijah kato hi; khum muna lei lahah ama kunin a khupte kikalah a maitang koi hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in a nasempa kungah, “Tu-in peito-in tuipi lam va en ta’n,” a ci hi. Ama peito-in khuodah a, tuale ama in, “Bangma om sih,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Sagivei peikia in,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"A sagiveina-ah ama in, “En in, tuipi panin mi khat’ khutphang cie sanga a golzaw lo meii themno khat ang kato hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Peito inlen Ahab kungah, ‘Guo in ang khum masangin na sakol leengte guong inlen peisuh tanaw’n,’ va ci ta’n,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Bano khat sungin meii le hui kithuo-in van ang dup hi; guo tampi zong ang zu hi. A sakol leeng ah Ahab tuongin Jezreel ah a pei hi.","ref":"Jas 5:18"},"46":{"text":"Hizongle Elijah tungah Topa’ vanglietna tung hi; ama in a kawng gahin Ahab mai Jezreel lutna lamah na tai hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahab in Jezebel kungah Elijah’ gamtatna zosie le Baal kamsangte namsau tawh a thagam dan teng gen sieng hi.","title":"Jezebel Kung panin Elijah Tai"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jezebel in Elijah kungah kamtai sawl a, “Zing cieng tu bang hunin amate na tha bangin nangma kang tha sih tah leh pasien-te in kei ei dawm sih heh,” cisah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama a zau hi; ama tho-in a hinna a taipipai hi; Judah-te’ khuo Beer-sheba ah ama a tung hi; khumnah ama in a nasemte a nuasie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in gamlahah ni khat lam pei-in luonglau phung nei khatah a to hi. Ama in a si nading thu ngen a, “Pha zo ta, Topa aw, tu-in ka hinna kilah ta’n, azieh pen ka pu ka pate sangin ka hoizaw tuon sih hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 4:3"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin luonglau phung nei khatah lumin a kimu hi. Thakhatthu-in vantungmi khat in ama khoi-in ama kungah, “Tho inlen an ne in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama a khuodah leh a lutang gei-a suong sa tungah a ki-em moh khat le tui hai khat a om hi. Ama in ne-in dawnin a lumkia hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi a ni veina peikia-in ama khoi a, “Tho inlen an nekia in, tua hi sihle na khuolzin nading gamla mama lai hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama zong tho-in anne tuidawnin om a, an a neh huvangin ni sawmli le zan sawmli sung lam pei zo a, Pasien’ muol Horeb a tung hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua muna leihawm khatah lutin a zangie hi. Tua ciengin ama tungah Topa’ thu tung a, “Elijah, nang tana bang bawl na hiei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “Vanglien Pasien, Topa adingin ka pawnthaw mama hi; azieh pen Israel-te in na thuciemna nuasie-in na maitamte a paimang vua, namsau tawh na kamsangte a that sieng uhi. Kei ngentang ka om ta bo a, keima zong tha dingin ei sui lai vaset uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Pusuoh inlen, muolvum Topa mai-ah ding in,” a ci hi, azieh pen Topa in ang nawh ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua laitahin huipi nahpitahin langin muolte a sem tepal a, Topa mai-a suongtumte zong a satkeh sieng hi; ahi vangin tua hui sungah Topa om lo hi; tua hui a kap zaw ciengin zil ling a, ahi vangin zilling lahah Topa om lo hi.","title":"Horeb-ah Elijah in Pasien Mu"},"12":{"text":"Zil a kilin zaw ciengin meikuong om a, ahi vangin meikuong sungah zong Topa om kan lo hi. Meikuong a mi zaw ciengin awnem hiuhiau khat a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua awging Elijah in a zah ciengin a puontuol tawh a mai khu-in pusuoh a, leihawm lutna-ah a ding hi. Ama kungah aw khat gingin, “Elijah, tam sunga bang bawl na hiei?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “Vanglien Pasien Topa adingin ka pawnthaw mama hi; azieh pen Israel-te in na thuciemna nuasie-in na maitamte a paimang vua, namsau tawh na kamsangte a that uhi. Kei ngentang ka om tabo a, kei nangawn zong tha dingin ei sui lai vaset uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 11:3"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ama kungah, “Pei inlen, Damascus senel gam zuonin kilekia ta’n. Na tun ciengin Aram tunga kumpi dingin Hazael sathau na nu ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 8:7-13"},"16":{"text":"Nang in Israel tunga kumpi dingin Nimshi’ tapa Jehu sathau na nu ding a, nang tanga kamsang dingin Abel-meholah khuomi Shaphat’ tapa Elisha sathau na nu ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 9:1-6"},"17":{"text":"Hazael in a na tha khah lo poma Jehu in that ding hi; tuale Jehu in a na thakhah lo poma Elisha in that ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle Israel sungah Baal mai-a a lu kun lo, ama a nam kha lo mihing tul sagi ka hen lai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 11:4"},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum mun panin ama pei a, Shaphat’ tapa Elisha in bawng kap khat tawh lo a kai laitah a mu hi. A masangah bawngtang kap sawm le kap ni om a, a nukhia pen bawngkap tawh lo kai ahi hi.","title":"Elisha, Elijah’ Nuazui Suoh"},"20":{"text":"Ama in a bawngtangte nuasie-in Elijah nuadel a, “Ka nu ka pa tawh ei kivaihlahsah phot inlen, tua ciengin na nua kang zui ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Elijah in ama kungah, “Kilekia ta’n, ke’n nang bang kang ci son ahei?” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama a zuina panin Elisha kilekia-in bawngtang kap khat manin go a, bawng hahkolte singin zangin a sa huon a, mi hawmpiehin a ne uhi. Tua ciengin ama dingin Elijah’ nua zui a, tuaci’n ama’ nasem a suoh hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aram Kumpipa Ben-hadad in a galkapte khawm hi; ama a panpi kumpi sawmthum le ni, le sakolte le leengte a om hi. Samaria sim dingin ama kuonto a, tua khuopi kuikhumin a bulu hi.","title":"Aram-te tawh Ahab A Kidona"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in khuopi sunga om Israel Kumpipa Ahab kungah kamtaite sawlin ama kungah a gen hi: “Tam bangin Ben-hadad in a gen hi:"},"3":{"text":"Na ngun le na kham teng keima-a’ ahi hi; na zi hoi pente le na tate zong keima-a’ ma ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in dawng a, “Ka pu, kumpipa aw, na gen bangin keima le ka neisa zosie a unpi-in nangma-a’ ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Kamtaite kilekia-in, “Ben-hadad in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Na kungah mi kang sawl a, “Keima kungah na ngun, na kham, le na zi na tate hing puoh in,’ ei cisah hi,” a ci hi;"},"6":{"text":"hizongle zing cieng tu bang hunin na kungah ka nasemte kang sawl ding a, amate in nangma’ innsung le na nasemte’ innsung hing longin amau’ dei popo tungah khut nga-in a la ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in gamsung upa zosie hlan a, “Tu-in en un! Tam mipa in bangza tahin buoi nading sui ahei ci thei un; azieh pen ama in ka zite, ka tate, ka ngun le ka kham teng a la dingin mi ang sawl hi; keima in ama’ thu ka niel sih hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin upa zosie le mi zosie in ama kungah, “A thu ngai sinlen, zong thukim sin,” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Ben-hadad’ kamtaite kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa kungah tam bangin gen un: Na nasempa kunga nei kalh masah zosie ka bawl ding hi; ahi vangin tami thu ka bawl thei sih hi,” a ci hi. Kamtaite pei-in ama kungah thu a puoh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ben-hadad in ama kungah mi sawl a, “Samaria leivui khu ka nua ei zui zosie’ khutkuoh a dim tah ma leh, pasien-te in kei ei dawm sih hinlen, tam sanga a nasie zaw-in ei bawl taheh,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in dawng a, “Ama kungah na gen un: Gal a zaw cienga galvan a suodawh pa a kiphatsah bangin galvan tawh a kivon pa kiphasah sih heh,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in ama in buhte sungah kumpite tawh zu a dawn laitahun, Ben-hadad in tam thu a zah ciengin ama in a mite kungah, “Panmun la un!” a ci hi. Tuale khuopi sim dingin panmun a la uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpi Ahab kungah kamsang khat peito a, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi. Tam mihon tampi zosie na mu ei mah? En in, tuni-in na khut sungah amate kang pie ding hi; tuale keima Topa ka hi lam na thei ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Ahab’ tungah Kamsangte Langpanna"},"14":{"text":"Ahab in, “A koi pen tawh nei pieh ding ahei?” a ci hi. Ama in, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi. Gamkaih uhpa’ nasemte tawh, ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Koi in galsim a pan masa diei?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Nangma hi vecin,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in gamkaih uhpa’ nasem zani le sawmthum le ni a khawm hi; tua zaw ciengin Israel mi zosie, tul sagi a khawm hi."},"16":{"text":"Ben-hadad in a kipawlpi kumpi sawmthum le nite tawh buh sungah zu dawnin zukhamin a op laitah uh sunkim hunin amate a kuon uhi."},"17":{"text":"Gamkaih a uh khangnote a kuon masa uhi. Ben-hadad in thukante sawl a, amate in ama kungah, “Samaria panin mi ang kuon uhi,” ci-in thu a puoh uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Kilemna bawl dinga hing kuon ahi uleh na hingmat un; galsim dinga ang kuon ahi uleh zong a hing ma-in na man un,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuopi panin gamkaih uhpa’ nasemte le amate a zui galkapte a kuonkhie uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khat in a kisihpi ciet uh a that vua, Aram-te taimangin Israel in amate a nuadel a, hinanle Syria kumpipa Ben-hadad pen sakol tung tuongte tawh sakol khatah tuongin a taimang hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel kumpipa peikhia-in sakolte le sakol leengte busim a, Aram-te zo-in tampitah that hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa kungah kamsangpa pei-in ama in, “Hing pei in, kithakhausah inlen, bang bawl ding ci limtahin ngaisun in; azieh pen khuokhal ciengin nang ang do dingin Aram kumpipa ang kuonto kia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Aram kumpipa’ nasemte in ama kungah, “Amau’ pasien pen ahile muoltung pasien-te ahi a, tuaci’n eite sangin amate a hatzaw uhi; ahi vangin amate tawh zanglei-ah kido leih amate sangin i hat zaw valon ding hi.","title":"Aram-te in Gallel"},"24":{"text":"Tam bangin zong bawl in: Kumpite amau’ panmun ciet panin khawlsah inlen, amau’ munah galkapmangte koi in;"},"25":{"text":"tuale na taansa galkapte tawh a kikim galkapte, sakol tangin sakol, leeng tangin leeng khawm in; tua ciengin zanglei-ah amate tawh i kido ding vua, amate sangin i hatzaw tahtah ding uhi,” a ci uhi. Ama in a thu uh mangin a gen bangin a bawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Khuokhal hun sungin Ben-hadad in Aram-te khawm a, Israel do dingin Aphek ah a kuonto hi."},"27":{"text":"Israel-te a kikhawm vua, lam-an a kiguon zaw ciengin amate do dingin a kuon uhi; Israel mite in a mai vuah keelta hon ni a kizawt bangin Aram-te tawh kimaingatin giephuol a sat vua, Aram-te ahile gam sung a dim uhi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien’ mipa khat in nai-in Israel kumpipa kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Aram-te in, ‘ Topa pen muoltung pasien ahi a, zanglei pasien hi lo hi,’ a ci ziehun nangma’ khut sungah tami a lien mi honpite zosie kang pie ding a, keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate in zong ni sagi sung kimaingatin giephuol a sat uhi. A ni sagi ni-in galdo a kipan uhi; ni khat sungin Israel-te in Aram-te’ lei galkapte tul zakhat that uhi."},"30":{"text":"A omlai teng Aphek khuopi sungah a taimang uhi; tuale a kinuasie mihing tul sawmni le tul sagi zong kulpi cim in a vuanel hi. Ben-hadad zong taimang a, a kiphuol dingin khuopi sungah a lut hi."},"31":{"text":"A nasemte in ama kungah, “En in, Israel innkuon’ kumpite pen hepina a nei kumpite ahi uhi, ci-in ka za uhi; ka kawng vuah la-ip puon tengin ka lu tung vuah khauhuol vielin Israel kumpipa kungah ei hawsah in; ama in nang ang hinkhawi mel zong kithei lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n a kawng vuah la-ip puon tengin a lu vuah zong khauhuol vielin Israel kumpipa kungah a haw vua, “Na nasempa Ben-hadad in, ‘Hepina tawh ei hingkhawi teitei bo heh,’ ci hi,” a ci uhi. Ama in, “Ama a hing lai ahi amah?” a ci hi. Ama ka sanggampa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tu-in mite in a thugen thakhatin man thei-in a zop pai vua, “Hi hi, na nasempa Ben-hadad hing lai hi,” a ci uhi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Pei unlen ama ka kungah hing peipi un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama kungah Ben-hadad a pei hi; tuale ama in a sakol leeng tungah ama tuongsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Ben-hadad in ama kungah, “Ka pa in na pa-a’ a na lahpieh khuopite kang piekia ding hi; tuale ka pa in Samaria sungah a bawl ma bangin nang in Damascus ah nangma adingin sumbuh na bawl thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Israel kumpipa in thuhkia a, ”Tua na gen thute banga na sep leh nang kang hla ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in khum mipa tawh thukimna khat bawlin a peisah hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehna tawh kamsang honte lahah khat in adang khat kungah, “Keima ei sat in!” a ci hi. Ahi vangin tua mipa in ama sat nuom lo hi.","title":"Kamsang Khat in Ahab Mawsah"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ama kungah, “ Topa’ thu mang lo na hi ziehin ka kung pan a na pei zaw behin humpi khat in nang ang that ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama kung pan a pei zaw ciengin humpi khat tawh ama kituoh a, ama a petlia pai hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:24"},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in midang khat mukia a, “Keima ei sat in!” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tua mipa in zong ama tehpuong pai-in a liemsah hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsangpa peikhie-in lampi-ah kumpipa ngah a, puon tawh a mit khu-in a mel a sel hi."},"39":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama a nawh laitahin kumpipa kungah kiko a, “Gal sungah na nasempa ka va kuon ta hi; tua ciengin galkap khat in ka kungah mi khat ang zawpi a, ‘Tam mipa na cing in. Ama na taisuo leh ama tangin nangma hing kithat ding a, ahi sihle ngun talent khat na lieu ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Muncin tengah na nasempa ka kitahla kalin ama na taimang hi,” a ci hi. Israel kumpipa in, “Nangma’ thukhenna bang hi taheh; Nang mama in thu na kikhen ta hi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a mit tuom a hawh leh Israel kumpipa in ama pen kamsangte khat ahi lamtah a thei pai hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsangpa in ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Tha dinga ka bawl mipa na pitsuo ziehin ama’ hinna tangin nangma’ hinna, ama’ mite tangin nangma’ mite kila ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Israel kumpipa lungkimlo le maikhingin inn lam zuonin Samaria a tung hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A sawt loin tam bang thu teng a pieng hi: Jezreel-te Naboth in Samaria kumpi Ahab’ kumpi inn gei-ah lengga lei khat nei hi.","title":"Naboth’ Leengga Lei"},"2":{"text":"Ahab in Naboth kungah, “Na lengga lei kei inn tawh kinai ahi ziehin ante cinna huon dingin ei pie ta’n; keima in a tangin tua sanga a hoizaw lengga lei khat kang pie ding hi; tua ahi sih a, nang dinga a hoi zawh leh a man ding sum kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle Naboth in, “Ka pu ka pate’ gamh nang kang pieh ding pen Topa in phal vawt lo hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jezreel-te Naboth in ama kungah thu a gen ziehin Ahab lungkimlo le maikhingsa-in inn lam a zuon hi; azieh pen ama in, “Ka pu ka pate’ gamh nang kang pie sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama a lupna tung sena-in kinei a, a mai hei-in an ne loin a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama kungah a zi Jezebel pei a, “An neh lona za ding dongin bang dinga hici lunggim na hei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “Bangzieh ahei cile Jezreel-te Naboth kungah, ‘Na lengga lei sum tawh ei leisah in; tua ahi sih a, na dei zawh leh lengga lei adang khat nang pie vang,’ ka ci hi; ahi vangin ama in ei dawngin, ‘Ka lengga lei kang pie sih ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"A zi Jezebel in ama kungah, “Tulaitah Israel a uhpa hi lo na mah? Tho-in an ne inlen kilung nuomsah in; keima in Jezreel-te Naboth’ lengga lei kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Ahab’ min tawh laihlahte giel a, tuate tungah Ahab’ seal kitum hi; ama’ khuopi sunga Naboth tawh a teng upate le milien teng tungah a lai hlah ding teng a hawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua nu in a laihlahte sungah, “An tan ding khat tangtawh unlen, mihonpite lahah Naboth mun thupi-ah tosah un;"},"10":{"text":"ama tawh kimaingatin mi ginalo ni koi-in ama langpangin a mawna suisah unlen, ‘Nang in Pasien le kumpipa na samsie hi,’ cisah un."},"11":{"text":"Ama’ khuomi, khuopi sunga teng upate le mi thupi a zatahhuoi teng in Jezebel’ gen bangin amate tungah a bawl uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in zong an tan nading thu khat a tangtawh vua, mipite lah mun thupi-ah Naboth a tosah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mi ginalo ni pei-in ama tawh kigalsai-in a to uhi; tuale mipite mai-ah mi ginalote in ama’ mawna a sui vua, “Naboth in Pasien le kumpipa samsie hi,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n amate in khuopi pulamah ama kaiphitin suong tawh a seplia uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jezebel kungah amate in thu tutin, “Naboth suong tawh kiseplia zo hi; ama si zo hi,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Naboth suong tawh kisepin a si zo lam Jezebel in a zah zaw behin Jezebel in Ahab kungah, “Pei inlen, sum tawh lei dinga na kut ama in a phal lo, Jezreel-te Naboth’ lengga lei la-in tang in; azieh pen Naboth hing nawn loin si zo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Naboth a sina thu Ahab in a zah behin Jezreel-te Naboth’ lengga lei-ah Ahab kuonsuhin a tang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tishbe-te Elijah kungah Topa’ thu tung a,","title":"Elijah in Pasien’ Thukhenna Gen"},"18":{"text":"“Samaria gam a uh Israel Kumpi Ahab tawh kimu dingin va kuonsuh in; Naboth’ lengga lei a lahpieh dingin khumnah ama a op laitah ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma in ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Ama thatin na lahpieh ta amah? ci-hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi. Nangma in ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: ‘Uite in Naboth’ sisan a liena munah nangma’ sisan zong ui in lieh ding hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 22:38"},"20":{"text":"Ahab in Elijah kungah, “Ka galpa aw, kei nei mu zo ta amah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “ Topa’ muna-ah nang le nang a sie bawl dingin kipumpieh na hi ziehin nang kang mu ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in nang tungah gimna kang tungsah ding hi; nang hing paimangin Israel gam sungah Ahab’ mi kici poma sal hile, a suohta hile ka sumaimang ding hi;"},"22":{"text":"nang in kei nei lungthahsah zieh le Israel in mawna na bawlsah ziehin na innkuon zong Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ innkuon le Ahijah’ tapa Baasha’ innkuon tawh kang kibangsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Jezebel’ tungtang thu zong Topa in gen a, ‘Uite in Jezebel’ kulpi gei-ah Jezebel a ne ding uhi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 9:36"},"24":{"text":"Ahab tawh kisai khuopi sunga a si mi khat popo ui in ne ding hi. Tuale gamlahah a si mi khat popo vana leng vate in ne ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"(A tahtahin a zi Jezebel’ hantawhna ziehin Topa muna-ah Ahab bangin a sie bawl dinga a kipumpieh koima dang om nai lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te mai-ah a delmang Amor-te gamtat bangin milimte bie-in kidahhuoi-in a gamta hi.)"},"27":{"text":"Ahab in tua thu teng a zah ciengin ama in a puonte botkeh a, a pum tungah la-ip puon silin an tangin la-ip puon tungah lum hi; ama cimaw lungkia-in a vaiva hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tishbe-te Elijah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"29":{"text":"“Ka mai-ah Ahab a kiniemkhieh dan na mu ei mah?
