Keima mai-ah amama tua bangin kiniemkhieh ahi ziehin a hin sungin ama tungah gimna ka tungsah sih ding hi; hizongle a tapa’ hun sungin a innkuonte tungah gimna ka tungsah ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aram le Israel-te kum thum sung gal kido loin a om uhi.","title":"Aram Langah Judah tawh Kipawla Galsimna (2Khg 18:1-34)"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin kum thum a cin kumin Israel kumpipa kungah Judah kumpi Jehoshaphat hawsuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in a nasemte kungah, “Ramoth-gilead khu ei-a’ ahi a, hizongle Aram kumpipa’ khut sung panin lahkia ding bangma i sawm lo lam na thei vuoi mah?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ramoth-gilead ah gal do dingin i kuonton diei mah?” a ci hi. Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa dawng a, “Kei le nang a kibang i hi hi; ka mite nangma’ mi ahi a, ka sakolte nangma’ sakol ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanle Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kungah, “ Topa thu dong masa phot in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in kamsang zali bang khawmin amate kungah, “Ramoth-gilead sim dingin ka kuon diei, ahi sihle ka khawl zaw diei?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Kuonto in; azieh pen Topa in kumpipa’ khut sungah ang pie ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanle Jehoshaphat in, “Tam sungah thu i dawh thei ding Topa’ kamsang adang koima khat beh om lo amah?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kungah, “ Topa thu i dawh thei nading, Imlah’ tapa Micaiah a kici mi khat omlai hi; hizongle ama in ka thu a hoi lamin ei gen ngai sih a, gimna ding vive a gen den ziehin ama ka muda hi,” a ci hi. Jehoshaphat in, “Kumpipa in tua bangin thugen sin,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in ulien khat hlanin, “Imlah’ tapa Micaiah mallangin va hlan ta’n,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua laitahin Samaria tunkot lutna ancilna phuola kumpi topha tungah Israel kumpipa le Judah Kumpipa Jehoshaphat to-in a kumpi puon utawh kizemin a om uhi; tuale kamsang zosie in ama gel mai-ah kam a sang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekiah in ama adingin sia sakite bawlin, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: amate pen tamte tawh amanthai dongin na sun ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Kamsang zosie in tua bang ma-in kam a sang vua, “Ramoth-gilead ah kuonto inlen guolzo in; Topa in kumpipa’ khut sungah ang pie ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Micaiah hlan dinga a kuon kamtaipa in ama kungah, “En in, kithukhatin kamsang teng’ thugen pen kumpipa adingin a hoi lam vive ahi hi. Nang in zong amate bangin a hoi lamin genpieh ta’n,” a ci hi.","title":"Micaiah in Gallel ding Magen"},"14":{"text":"Hizongnanle Micaiah in, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin, Topa in ka kunga ang gen popo ka gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa kung a tun ciengin kumpipa in ama kungah, “Micaiah, Ramoth-gilead ah galsim dingin i kuon diei, ahi sihle i khawl tadi diei ?” a ci hi. Ama in zong dawng a, “Kuonto inlen va guolzo ta’n; Topa in kumpipa’ khut sungah ang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Hizongle kumpipa in ama kungah, “ Topa’ minin keima kungah thu dang kici bangma gen loin thuman beh nang gen nadingin bangza vei hing kiciemsah ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Micaiah in, “Israel zosie tuucing a nei lo tuute bangin muoltung tengah a kithethang ka mu hi. Topa in, ‘Tam mite in pu a nei sih uhi; lungnuom tahin a inn ciet vuah pei uheh,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 27:17; Mat 9:36; Mrk 6:34"},"18":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ama in kei tungtang thu a hoi lamin khat mama zong ang gen sih ding a, gimna ding beh ang gen ding hi, ci thu na kungah kang gen tamal sih amah?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Micaiah in, “Tua ahi ziehin Topa’ thugen ngai in: Keima in a kumpi topha tungah Topa to-in, a ziet a vei-a a ding vantung mihonpi ka mu hi.","ref":"Job 1:6; Isa 6:1"},"20":{"text":"Topa in, “Ramoth-gilead ah ama kato-in a si thei nadingin koi pen in Ahab va zawl ta ding ahei?’ a ci hi. Tua ciengin khat in thu khat genin adang khat in thudang khat gen a,"},"21":{"text":"tuale Topa mai-ah hlagau khat pei-in ding a, ‘Keima’n va zawl ta vang,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in, ‘Bang na ci zawl diei?’ ci-in ama dong hi. Ama in dawng a, “Keima pei-in a kamsangte zosie’ kam sungah zuouthei hlagau khat ka va hi ta ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ciengin Topa in, ‘Ama a va zawl ding na hi a, nangma in na zo ding hi; pei inlen va tuaci bawl ta’n,’ a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n nangma in en in, Topa in tami na kamsangte zosie’ kam sungah zuouthei hlagau khat koi zo ta hi; Topa in nangma dingin gimna na tuo ding a khensatsa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Chenaanah’ tapa Zede-kiah in Micaiah zuonto-in phebeh a, “ Topa’ hlagau in nangma kunga thu ang gen dingin bang lampi tawh kei ei kalsan thei ahei?” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Micaiah in dawngkia-in, “A kiphuol dingin innkhan sungtawngah na pei ni ciengin thei na vecin,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in, “Micaiah man unlen khuopi uhpa Amon le kumpipa’ tapa Joash kungah puohkia ta un."},"27":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Kumpipa in tam bangin gen hi: Thongah tam mipa khum unlen, lungnuom taha kang tunkia masangin an le tui na gieutausah un,” ci hi,’ va ci ta un,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Micaiah in, “Lungnuoma nang kilekia poma leh Topa in kei tungtawnin thu a gen lo hi taven,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “No teng zosie in na unpi-un za un!” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpi Jehoshaphat a kuonto uhi.","title":"Ahab’ Gallelna le A Sina (2Khg 18:28-34)"},"30":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Kei le kei mel kiselin gal sungah va kuon ta vang. Ahi vangin nang in na kumpi puonte sil in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Israel kumpipa in a mel selin gal sungah a kuon hi."},"31":{"text":"Tu-in Aram kumpipa in a leeng makai mi sawmthum le nite thupie a, “Milien hile, mineu hile koima tawh kido sih unlen, Israel kumpipa beh tawh kido un,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Leeng makaite in Jehoshaphat a mu ciengun amate in, “Khum pa Israel kumpipa hi ngelngel ei,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n ama tawh kido dingin a kihei pai uhi; tuale Jehoshaphat a kikozah pai hi."},"33":{"text":"Leeng makaite in tuapa Israel kumpipa ahi lo lamtah a thei ciengun ama a nuadel na panun a kilekia uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in a thal kuoi-in a mawh kap a, tuale thei khah lopi-in Israel kumpipa’ galhiem awmdal kikalah lutin ama a kha hi; tuaci’n ama in leenghawl pa kungah, “Kei liem zo ta ka hi ziehin kilekia inlen, gal sung panin ei puomang ta’n,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Khum ni-in gal kidona nasie mama a, kumpipa in Aram-te maingatin nitah a si dongin a leeng tungah a kingam hi; a liemma panin leeng dop lamah a sisan a luongsuh hi."},"36":{"text":"Nitum kuon ciengin galkapte lahah tangtawhna khat om a, “Koipo ama’ khuopi ciet-ah, a koimapo ama gam ciet ah!” kici hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa si a, Samaria ah kipeipi hi; amate in Samaria ah kumpipa a vui uhi."},"38":{"text":"Samaria buol gei-ah a leeng a sawp vua, Topa gensa kammal dung zui-in uite in a sisan liehtumin tua sungah numei pahtatte a kisil uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tu-in Ahab’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a septe zosie, a saiha inn lamte, le ama’ na sat khuopi zosie, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh Ahab lumton hi; tuale a tapa Ahaziah in ama’ za luo hi."},"41":{"text":"Israel Kumpi Ahab a kum lina kumin Asa’ tapa Jehoshaphat in Judah uh ding a kipan hi.","title":"Judah ah Jehoshaphat Maang (2Khg 20:31–21:1)"},"42":{"text":"Gam uh ding a kipatin Jehoshaphat kum sawmthum le nga pha a, kum sawmni le nga sung Jerusalem uh hi. A nu’ min pen Azubah ahi a, Shilhi’ tanu ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in a pa Asa’ lampi zosie zui hi; tua lampi panin ama piel loin, Topa muna-ah a manin gamta hi; hinanle munsangte a kilamang sih a, munsangte tungah mite in siemthoi-in gimnamtuite a hal lai uhi."},"44":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa tawh zong kilemna a bawl hi."},"45":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoshaphat’ gamtatna a omlai teng, ama in a lah a thahatna, le a galdo dan, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"46":{"text":"Ama in a pa Asa’ hun lai-in gam sunga pasal pahtat omlai teng a that sieng hi."},"47":{"text":"Edom ah kumpi om a, a khut nei-a pa khat in kumpi sem hi."},"48":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in Ophir kham sui-in a pei nadingin Tarshish tembawte a bawl hi; ahi vangin Ezion-geber ah tembawte a kisiet ziehin amate a pei thei sih uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ahab’ tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Tembawte tungah keima’ nasemte le nangma’ nasemte peitonsah in,” a ci hi, hinanle Jehoshaphat a nuom sih hi."},"50":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Jehoshaphat lumton hi; a tapa Jehoram in ama’ za luo hi."},"51":{"text":"Judah kumpi Jehoshaphat a maan kum sawm le sagina kumin Ahab’ tapa Ahaziah in Samaria panin Israel tungah maan ding kipan a, kum ni sung Israel tungah a maang hi.","title":"Israel tungah Ahaziah Maang"},"52":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat a, a nu le a pa’ lampi le Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ lampi a zui hi."},"53":{"text":"Ama in Baal’ na semin a bie hi; ama in a pa gamtat ma bangin Israel Pasien, Topa a lungthahsah hi."}}}}},"12":{"info":{"name":"2 Kumpite","shortname":"2kum","abbr":[],"desc":"Kumpite nina laibu (the second book of kings)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahab a si zaw ciengin Moab in Israel ledo hi.","title":"Elijah in Ahaziah Mawsah"},"2":{"text":"Samaria-a a innkhan tungnung vathang panin Ahaziah kiesuhin a liem hi; tuaci’n ama in kamtaite sawlin amate kungah, “Va pei ta unlen tam ka liemna pan ka dam zo na diei, Ekron pasien Baal-zebub va dong ta un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle Topa’ vantungmi in Tishbe khuomi Elijah kungah, “Ding inlen, Samaria kumpipa’ kamtaite kimupi-in amate kungah, ‘Israel sungah Pasien a op nawn lo ziehin Ekron pasien Baal-zebub kunga thu dong dinga kisa na hi uh amah?’ ci in."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Na katona na lupna na kan nawn sih ding a, nang a si valon ding na hi hi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Elijah a pei hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah kamtaite a kilekia vua, kumpipa in amate kungah, “Bang dinga hing kilekia na hi vuoi?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in dawngin, “Kote tawh kimu dingin mi khat ang pei a, ama in ka kung vuah, ‘No ang sawl kumpipa kungah peikia unlen ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Israel sungah Pasien om nawn lo ahi ziehin Ekron pasien Baal-zebub thu dong dinga mi na sawl amah? Tua ahi ziehin, ‘Na lupna na kan nawn sih ding a, nang na si valon ding hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “No ang kimupipa le tami thu teng ang gen pa bangci bang mi ahiei?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in dawngin, “Ama pen mul hau khat ahi a, a kawngah savun kawnggah a gah hi,” a ci uhi. Tuale ama in, “Ama pen Tishbe mi Elijah ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:4; Mrk 1:6"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in ama kungah mihing sawmnga a uhpa a mihing sawmnga tawh a sawl hi. Muol dawn khat a na to Elijah kungah ama kato-in a kungah, “Pasien’ mipa aw, kumpipa in, ‘Hing peisuh heh,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle Elijah in mihing sawmnga a uhpa dawng a, “Pasien’ mipa ka hi leh van panin meikuong ang kiesuh hinlen, nangma le na mihing sawmngate katum taheh,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin van panin meikuong kiesuhin ama le a mihing sawmnga a katum hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama kungah mihing sawmnga a uh adang khat a mihing sawmnga ma tawh a sawlkia hi. Ama kato-in tua mipa kungah, “Pasien’ mipa aw, tam khu kumpipa thupieh ahi hi: Mallang tahin hing kumsuh in!” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Elijah in amate dawng a, “Pasien’ mipa ka hi leh van panin meikuong ang kiesuh hinlen, nangma le na mihing sawmngate katum heh,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin van panin meikuong kiesuhin ama le a mihing sawmngate a katum hi.","ref":"Mat 3:4; Mrk 1:6"},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa in mihing sawmnga a uh a thumna pa mihing sawmnga tawh sawlkia leuleu hi. Tuaci’n mihing sawmnga a uh a thumna pa peito a, Elijah mai-ah pei-in khupdinin pua a, ama kungah tau-in, “Pasien’ mipa aw, hing thum ing, na muna-ah keima’ hinna le nangma’ nasem tam mihing sawmngate’ hinna manphasah in."},"14":{"text":"En in, vantung panin meikuong kiesuhin mihing sawmngate a uh a masa nite a mi sawmnga tuoh utawh a katum uhi; ahi vangin tu-in na muna-ah ka hinna manphasah in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi in Elijah kungah, “Ama tawh zawhsuh in; ama giing malmal sin,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama dingin kumpipa kungah ama tawh peisuh a,"},"16":{"text":"ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Nangma in Ekron pasien Baal-zebub thu dong dingin kamtaite sawl tahtah na hi ziehin, Israel sungah thu dawh ding Pasien a om nawn sih amah? Tua ahi ziehin nangma in na katona na lupna na nuasie sih ding a, na si valon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Elijah in a gensa Topa’ thu tawh kizui-in ama a si hi. Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat’ tapa Jehoram uh a kum nina kumin a sanggampa Joram in ama’ za luo hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Ahaziah in tapa nei lo hi.","title":"Ahaziah’ Sina"},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Ahaziah’ gamtatna a sepsa a omlai teng, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in vantungah pumpei tawh Elijah a lahto kuonin Elijah le Elisha-te Gilgal panin inn lam zuonin lamkalah a om uhi.","title":"Vantungah Elijah Kato"},"2":{"text":"Elijah in Elisha kungah, “Tanah na om in; bangzieh ahei cile Topa in Bethel cieng dong pha dingin kei ei sawl hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Elisha in, “ Topa hingin nangma zong a hing na hi ma bangin, nang kang nuasie sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Bethel ah ama gel a peisuh uhi."},"3":{"text":"Elisha kungah Bethel-a om kamsang honkhat a pei vua, amate in, “Tuni-in nangma kung panin Topa in na pupa a lah ding lam na thei ei mah?” a ci uhi. Tuale ama in, “Hi hi, ka thei hi; dai dide un,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Elijah in ama kungah, “Elisha, tanah na om in; azieh pen Topa in Jericho cieng dong pha dingin ei sawl hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in, “ Topa hingin nangma zong na hin ma bangin nang kang nuasie sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama gel Jericho-ah a zawhton uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jericho-a om kamsang honkhat in Elisha nai-in ama kungah, “Tuni-in Topa in nang kung pan na pupa a lah ding lam na thei ei mah?” a ci uhi. Ama in dawng a, “Hi hi, ka thei hi; dai dide un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elijah in ama kungah, “Tanah na om in; Topa in Jordan cieng dong pha dingin ei sawl hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in, “ Topa hing a, nangma zong a hing na hi ma bangin nang kang nuasie sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama gel a zawhton suoh lai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kamsang hon sawmngate in zong zui-in Jordan gei-ah a din laitahun ama gel tawh a kigamla deu-in kamsangte a ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elijah in a puontuol ladawhin ziel a, tua tawh tui a sat hi; tuol gumgaw-ah ama gel a galkai masangsie langkhat tuohah tua tui a kikhenzah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama gel a galkai zaw ciengun Elijah in Elisha kungah, “Nangma kung panin kei ei kilahto masangin nang adinga kang bawlpieh ding na dei ei gen in,” a ci hi. Elisha in, “Na hlagau tanh ni ei luosah in, hing thum ing,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 21:17"},"10":{"text":"Ama in dawngkia a, “A hahsa na khat nang ngen hi; ahi vangin nang kung pana kei ei kilahto laitah nei mu leh na sil nget ang kipie ding hi; nei mu sih leh ang kipie lo ding hi” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Lam pei kawmin ama gel a holim laitahun mei leeng khat le mei sakolte in ama gel khenkhe-in pumpei tawh vanah Elijah a kato hi."},"12":{"text":"Elisha in a et kawmin awng a, “Ka pa, ka pa! Israel leengte le a sakol tung tuongte!” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama kimu thei nawn loin ama in a puonsilte manin ehkehin phal ni a suo hi.","ref":"2Kum 13:14"},"13":{"text":"Ama in Elijah kung pana a kiesuh puontuol tungin a kilekia a, Jordan pieu-ah a ding hi.","title":"Elisha in Elijah’ Za Luo"},"14":{"text":"Ama in Elijah tung pana kie puontuol la-in tui sat a, “Elijah’ Pasien Topa hei sunga om ahiei?” a ci hi. Ama in tui a sat ciengin a lang khat tuohah tui kikhenin Elisha a galkai hi."},"15":{"text":"Jericho-a om kamsang honte in a gal mu ciengun, “Elisha tungah Elijah’ hlagau tu hi,” ci-in a tangko uhi. Ama tawh kimu dingin kuonin ama mai-ah a tuolkun uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Tu-in en in, na nasemte lahah mi thahat sawmnga i nei uhi; amate sawl inlen na pupa suisah in, kang thum hi,” a ci uhi. Topa’ hlagau in ama domto-in muoltung khat ahi sihle hawhguom khat a a khiehsuh dawh khat hi va,” a ci uhi. Ama in thuhkia a, “Hi lo hi, amate sawl sin,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongnanle amate in a maizum dongin a gengen ciengun ama in, “Amate sawl un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n mihing sawmngate sawlin ni thum sung a sui vangun ama a mu zo sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amate a kilekia ciengun (Jericho ah ama a om hi) ama in amate kungah, “Na kung vuah, ‘Pei sih un,’ hing ci hi lo ka mah?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in khuopi sunga mite in Elisha kungah, “Ka pu in na mu bangin tami khuopi opna pen mun hoi ahi hi; ahi vangin a tuineh hoi loin leitangah bangma pieng lo hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Elisha in Nalamdangte Bawl"},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Kuongkum a tha khat hing peipi unlen a sungah ci koi un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in zong ama kungah a peipi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuinah-ah ama pei-in a sungah ci sung a, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Tami tui a hoi-in ka bawl zo hi; tu-a patin tami tui pan sina hile, nausietna hile pieng nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Elisha’ thugen tawh kizui-in tuni dongin tua tui khu tui hoi a suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in khum mun panin Bethel a zuonto hi; lampi a peito laitahin khuopi pan naupang honkhat pei-in ama a zako vua, “Dawtol pa! peimang ta’n, dawtol pa! peimang ta’n,” a ci uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama kinua hei-in amate a mu ciengin Topa’ min tawh amate a samsie hi. Tua ciengin gamlah panin vompi ni pei-in tua naupang sawmli le nite a ehmal sieng hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama khum mun panin Carmel ah a peisuoh a, tua ciengin Samaria ah a peikia hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Jehoshaphat’ kum sawm le gietna kumin Samaria sung Israel tungah Ahab’ tapa Jehoram in kumpi sem hi; ama kum sawm le ni sung a maang hi.","title":"Jehoram in Israel Uh"},"2":{"text":"A nu le a pa za-in ama a sie-a a gamtat lo vangin Topa muna-ah a sie-in a gamta hi, azieh pen ama in a pa na bawlsa Baal biehna song pen hemkhie tei sam hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawna ma pomlai hi; tua panin ama kikoicing lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Moab kumpipa Mesha pen tuu khawi pa ahi a, ama in kum sielin Israel kumpipa tungah tuuno tul zakhat le tuutang zakhat’ mul pie zel hi.","title":"Moab-te tawh Gal Kidona"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ahab a si ciengin Moab kumpipa in Israel kumpipa a ledo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum hun laitahin Kumpi Jehoram in Samaria panin Israel mi zosie khawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama pei-in Judah Kumpi Jehoshaphat kungah, “Moab kumpipa in kei ei ledo zo hi; Moab sim dingin kei tawh nang kuon diei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Kang kuon ding hi; nangma tawh kang omton a, ka mite nangma-a’ ahi a, ka sakolte zong nangma’ sakol ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Hei lamah i kuon diei?” ci-in dong hi. Jehoram in dawng a, “Edom senel gam zui-in i kuon ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel kumpipa, Judah kumpipa, le Edom kumpipa-te a kuon uhi; amate ni sagi sung a kuol pei zaw ciengun a galkapte ule a peipi uh a ganhingte adingin tui a om nawn sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in, “Eh ka dei! Topa in ei kumpi thum teng Moab’ khut sunga pieh dinga ei na hlat ahi mawh vele,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jehoshaphat in, “Tam sungah Topa ei dawhpieh thei ding Topa’ kamsang khat beh a om sih amah?” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa’ nasemte khat in, “Elijah’ khut tunga tuisung pa, Shaphat’ tapa Elisha tam sungah om hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in, “ Topa’ kammal in ama a ompi hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama kungah Israel kumpipa le Jehoshaphat le Edom kumpipa a hawsuh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Elisha in Israel kumpipa kungah, “Nang tawh bang kisai ka hei? Na pa’ kamsangte ahi sihle na nu’ kamsangte kungah kipei ta’n,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Israel kumpipa in ama kungah, “Hi lo hi; Moab kumpipa’ khut sungah ko kumpi thum teng pieh dinga ei hlanpa khu Topa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Elisha in, “A na ka seppieh Vanglien Topa a hing ahi ma bangin Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat a thusim lo khat hi poma leng ka mit hemin zong kang en sih ding a, a mu-in zong kang mu sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle tumging tumsiem khat ei hlatpieh un,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin tumging siempa in a tumging a sai laitahin Topa’ vanglietna ama tungah a tung hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Tami lui gawta pen tui ka dimsah ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Hui le guo na mu sih ding vua, ahi vangin nangma le na bawng honte le na gantate utawh na dawn dingin khum lui gawta pen tui ka dimsah ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tam pen Topa muna-ah thuneu no khat ahi hi. Bang ding ahei cile ama in na khut sungah Moab-te zong ang pie ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma in kulpi tawh a ki-im khuopi zosie le a kituomteel khuopi zosie na zo ding hi; singkung hoi zosie zong phua-in, tuinah zosie na kangsah ding a, leitang zosie suong tawh kidimsahin hawllei na suohsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"A zing cieng zingmawng biehpieh hun pawl ciengin gamsung teng tui tawh a kidim masangin thakhatthu-in Edom lam panin tui luon a kipan hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate sim dingin kumpite kuonto zo ci thu Moab-te zosie in a zah ciengun a khang pen panin a vuoi pen dongin galvan sil thei zosie hlanin gamgi lamah a kikhawm uhi."},"22":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin amate a thobai uleh nisa in tui tung khaw a, Moab-te in a galkhat lam vua om tui pen sisan bangin a sanin a mu uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in, “Tami sisan ahi hi; kumpite khatlekhat kido-in khatlekhat kithat hi ngel ding hi. Tua ahi ciengin tu-in, Moab-te aw, van kinuasie teng va la ta vai!” a ci uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate Israel’ giephuol a tun ciengun Israel-te dingin a mai vua a tai Moab-te a busim uhi; Moab gam a lut kawmun amate in a bansim toto uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in khuopite a thalpaih vua, suong in a khucip dongin lei hoina gam zosie tungah mi zosie in suong a sep uhi; amate in a tuinah teng uh khahcipin singkung hoi zosie a phua sieng uhi. Kir-hareseth behah suongtum kulpite om a, saili tawi teng in kui-imin a busim uhi."},"26":{"text":"Gal in ama lam a naw lam Moab kumpipa in a thei ciengin Edom kumpipa sontah phukeh dingin namsau tawi mi za sagi tawh a kuon hi; ahi vangin amate in a phukeh zo sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ama’ zaluo ding a tapa kai-in kul tungah meihal biehna-in a pie hi. Israel-te tungah a lien mama lungthahna tungin ama kung panin amate nuakinin a gam vuah a kilekia uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Elisha kungah kamsang honte lahah mi khat’ zi kiko a, “Na nasem ka pasal si hi; tuale na nasempa in Topa a zatah lam na thei a, ahi vangin ka tapa nite sila dinga la dingin a leibatna pa ang kuon hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Elisha le Meigongnu’ Sathau (1Kum 17:14-16)"},"2":{"text":"Elisha in tua nu kungah, “Nang adingin bang kang bawlpieh diei? Innah bang na nei ei, ei gen in?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Na nasemnu in inn ah sathau bung khat ci longal bangma zamtawng a nei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “A pulamah pei-in na vengte zosie’ beel hawm teng va kawm ta’nlen hing tawm kawm vawt sin."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin sungtumin na tapate tawh kot kikhalu unlen, tam beel zosie sungah sung in; beel khat a dim sielin tuomkoi paipai in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum nu in ama nuasie-in a tapate tawh kot a kikhalu uhi; amate in tua nu kungah beelte a puohpuoh vua, tua nu in zong beel sungah na sungsung hi."},"6":{"text":"Beel teng a dim ciengin tua nu in a tapa kungah, “Beel dang khat ei pie in,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin a tapa in tua nu kungah, “Beel dang om nawn sih,” a ci hi. Tua bepin sathau a kang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua nu pei-in Pasien’ mipa kungah gen a, tuale ama in, “Pei in, tua sathau zua inlen na leiba sang in. Tua hile na zahmawh teng tawh nangma le na tapate na hing thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni khat Elisha in Shunem khuo nawhkha a, tua khuo sunga a teng a cithei numei khat in an ne dingin ama hlan hi. Tuaci’n ama in khum lam a nawh sielin khum sungah baangin an ne zel hi.","title":"Shunem Numeinu’ Tapa Kithosahkia (1Kum 17:17-24)"},"9":{"text":"Tua nu in a pasal kungah, “En in, i lampi ang nawh zing tam mipa pen Pasien’ mi tahtah ahi lam ka thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Eite kunga ang tun sielin innkhum tungah ama’ gie nadingin kawm a nei innmeng khat bawlpiehin, tua sungah ama dingin lupna khat, sabuoi khat, topha khat le meivah khat koipieh vai,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni khat ama tua mun a tun ciengin innkhan tungah kato-in a lum hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a nasempa Gehazi kungah, “Shunem numei hlan in,” a ci hi. Ama in tua numei a hlat ciengin ama mai-ah tua nu a ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tua mipa kungah, “Tua nu kungah gen in, ‘Ko adingin tam lunggimna zosie na thuoh hi. Nangma dingin bang kang bawlpieh diei? Kumpipa kungah ahi sihle galkapmangpa kungah nangma tangin thu khat popo ang kigenpieh ding na dei a om ei mah?’ ci in,” a ci hi. Tua nu in dawng a, “Keima’ mite lahah teng ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua bang ahile ama dingin bang a kibawlpieh thei diei?” a ci hi. Gehazi in dawng a, “Thu khat beh om hi, ama in tapa nei loin a pasal lah vuoikawn zo hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua nu hlan in,” a ci hi. Ama in tua numei a hlat zaw ciengin kotbieng ah tua nu a ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “Khuovei tu bang hun ciengin tapa khat na tawi ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua nu in dawng a, “Hi lo hi, ka pu Pasien’ mipa aw; na nasemnu sol sin,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 18:14"},"17":{"text":"Elisha in tua nu kungah a gensa bangin tua numei nau pai a, khuovei a hun a tun ciengin ama in tapa khat a nei hi."},"18":{"text":"A nausen a gol ciengin ni khat a pa kung anlate lahah a va haw ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a pa kungah, “Aw kadei, ka lutang na, ka lutang na!” a ci hi. A pa in a nasempa kungah, “A nu kungah va koi ta’n,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in domin a nu kungah peipi hi; a nu’ phei tungah sunkim dongin to a, tuale ama a si hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua nu kato-in Pasien’ mipa’ lupna tungah a siel a, kot khalu-in a nuasie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in a pasal hlanin, “Mallang tahin Pasien’ mipa kungah va haw-in kang kile pai thei nadingin nasemte khat le laa khat ei puoh in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in, “Bang zieha tuni-a ama kunga haw ding na hei? Hladet ni lah hi lo, sabbath ni zong lah hi lo,” a ci hi. Tua nu in, “Hing hoi na va” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in laa phaw pha-in a nasempa kungah, “Gan kinawsah in; kang gen sih nah leh muon peisah sin,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua nu pei a, Carmel Muol tunga Pasien’ mipa kung a tung hi. Pasien’ mipa in tua nu a pei a mu ciengin a nasempa Gehazi kungah, “En in, khum tahah Shunem numei khat ang pei hi;"},"26":{"text":"tua nu dawn dingin thakhatin va tai ta’nlen ama kungah, ‘Na dam ei mah? Na pasal a dam ei mah? Naupang a dam ei mah?’ va ci ta’n,” a ci hi. Tua nu in dawng a, “Hoi gawp na,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Muol tunga Pasien’ mipa kung a tun ciengin tua nu in a keng a tupom pai hi. Gehazi in sawnthop dingin tua nu a nai hi. Ahi vangin Pasien’ mipa in, “Ama tua ci opsah lel in; azieh pen ama a lung kham seng zieh ahi bo hi. Topa in keima kungah a thu ei imin keima kungah ang genkha sih hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in, “Ka pu kungah ta pasal kang ngen amah? Kei ei puikhiel sin, hing ci hi lo ka mah?” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in Gehazi kungah, “Na kawng gah inlen na khut sungah ka ciengkhut khunin pei ta’n. Mi khatpo tawh na kituo khah leh hopi sin len, mi khatpo in ang hopi le zong dawng sin; tuale naupang maitangah ka ciengkhut va nga ta’n,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua naupang’ nu in, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin nang lo tawh ka pei sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama dingin tua nu a zui hi."},"31":{"text":"Gehazi na mapei-in tua naupang tungah a ciengkhut a ngah vangin awging hileh hinna lim hile bangma om lo hi. Ama dawn dingin a kilekia a, tuale ama kungah, “Naupang khanglo nai lo hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Inn sungah Elisha a lut ciengin a lupna tungah a sisa-a a lum tua naupang a mu hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama lut a, ama gel beh kot kikhalu-in Topa tungah thu a ngen uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin lupna tungah ama kato-in naupang tungah kingam a, naupang’ kam le ama’ kam tuo-in, a mit tungah ama’ mit omsah a, a khut tungah ama’ khut a omsah hi; ama tunga a zam phei laitahin naupang’ pum a lum hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama kumsuh kia-in innkhan sungah pei kawikawi a, tua ciengin ama kato-in naupang tungah a zamkia leuleu hi; naupang in sagivei hahthi loin a mit tegel hah hi.","ref":"Pien 18:14"},"36":{"text":"Elisha in Gehazi hlanin, “Shunem numei hlan in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n tua nu hlan hi. Tua nu a tun ciengin ama in, “Na tapa kilah in,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua nu pei-in a kephungah pua-in tuolah a kunsuh hi; tua ciengin ama in a tapa la-in a pei hi."},"38":{"text":"Gilgal-ah Elisha a kilekia ciengin khum gam sungah kiel a tung hi. Ama mai-ah kamsang honte a to laitahun ama in a nasempa kungah, “Beelpi suong inlen kamsangte adingin me huon in,” a ci hi.","title":"Elisha in Sabeel Siensuo"},"39":{"text":"Me sui dingin amate lahah khat gamlahah a pei hi; ama in gam-um gui khat mu-in a puontuol dimin tua gam umga loin kilekia a, tuate bang ahei ci thei lopi-in atnenin mebeel sungah bua hi."},"40":{"text":"Amate in mite neh dingin an a thua uhi. Ahi vangin me a neh laitahun, “Pasien’ mipa aw, beel sungah si theina gu om!” ci-in a kiko uhi. Amate in an a ne thei ta sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua ahile an themkhat hing la un,” a ci hi. Ama in beel sungah tua an pai a, “Mite neh dingin an lui-in nesah un,” a ci hi. Tuale beel sungah neh thei lo ding bangma a om nawn sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Baal-shalishah panin mi khat pei-in Pasien’ mipa kungah anpal anlum, mangbuham lum sawmni, le bupal vuitha a ip sungah guongin a peipi hi. Elisha in, “A neh dingun tam sunga mite pie un,” a ci hi.","title":"Elisha in Mihing Zakhat Anva (Mat 14:13-21 ; 15:32-39)"},"43":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nasempa kungah, “Mi zakhat mai-ah tami bang ka ci lui thei ding ahei?” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in, “Mite pie inlen nesah in. Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Amate in ne-in themkhat val lai ding hi,’ ci hi,” cikia hi."},"44":{"text":"Ama in a mai vuah tuate lui-in amate in a ne vua, Topa’ gensa bangin pawlkhat a val lai hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aram kumpipa’ galkapmang Naaman pen mi thupi le a pupa’ maipha nga mipa khat ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama tungtawnin Topa in Aram-te guolzawna a pie hi. Ama pen a thahat galhang khat ahi vangin phah natna a vei hi.","title":"Naaman Kidamsahna"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in a galsimna khat vuah Aram-te in Israel gam panin ngahnuno khat manin tua nu in Naaman zi’ na semin a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a pi kungah, “Samaria-a kamsangpa kungah ka pu va haw leh ci tei ing e! Ama in a phah natna damsah thei ngelngel va,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Naaman pei-in Israel gam pana numeino’ thugente a pu kungah a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Aram kumpipa in, “Tua ahile va pei ta’nlen, Israel kumpipa tungah lai khat ka hlah ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama kuonin ngun talent sawm, kham shekel tulguh le pawi puon sawm a keng hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Israel kumpipa kungah tua laihlah keng a, tua sungah, “Tami laihlah na nga ciengin a phah natna na damsah nadingin na kunga ka nasempa Naaman kang sawlna thu thei in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in tua laihlah a sim ciengin a puon ehkeh a, “Mi khat’ phah natna a damsah dingin tam mipa in kei tungah thu ei vaihlah thei nadingin kei mi that thei ahi sihle mi hingsah thei Pasien ka hi amah? En un, keima tawh kihau nading a hanciem ahi lam thei un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle Israel kumpipa in a puonte a balkehna thu Pasien’ mipa Elisha in a zah ciengin kumpipa kungah mi sawl a, “Bang dinga na puon na balkeh va-ia ahei? Ama in Israel gam sungah kamsang a op lam a thei nadingin ka kungah ama hing peisah in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sakolte le a sakol leengte tawh Naaman pei-in Elisha inn kotbiengah a khawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Elisha in ama kungah kamtai khat sawlin, “Pei inlen, Jordan gun sungah sagivei va kisil ta’n. Tua hile na ci na sa a ngai bangkia-in na siengtho ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Naaman lungthahin peikhie a, “Keima kungah ama pel loin hing pei-in hing ding vanin, a Pasien Topa’ min hing lo vanin, ka ciphah tungah a khut hing zahin ka phah natna hing damsah va, ci-a ka ngaisut hi bo a!"},"12":{"text":"Israel tui zosie sangin Damascus gama Abana le Pharpar gunte hoizaw peh hi lo amah? tuate sungah kisilin ka sieng thei sih ding amah?” a ci hi. Ama kihei-in a lungthahsa-in a pei hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nasemte in ama nai-in ama kungah, “Ka pu aw, kamsangpa in sil hamsa khat bawl dinga ang sawl le zong na bawl ding hi lo amah? Ama in nangma kungah, ‘Kisil inlen siengtho in,’ ci-in tam thu zosie ang gen pen nang in na bawl dingin bangza-in hoizaw kanlai ding ahei?” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama peisuhin Pasien’ kamsangpa genna tawh kizui-in Jordan gun sungah sagivei a kiphum hi; naupangno cilesa bangin ama’ cilesa a ngai bangkia-in a sieng sitset hi.","ref":"Luk 4:27"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ mipa kungah ama le a pawlte zosie a kilekia uhi; ama pei-in a mai-ah ding a, “Tu-in ahile Israel gam sung khat beh simlo, leitung mundang zosie-ah Pasien a om lo lam ka thei zo hi; hepina tawh na nasempa tung panin letsong khat ei sanpieh in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “A na ka seppieh Topa a hing ahi ma bangin bangma ka sang sih ding hi!” a ci hi. Ama in a san nadingin a paugen vangin ama in a khia veve hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua bepin Naaman in, “Tua ahi vawt leh hepina tawh laa-sakol ni puoh khop ding leitang ei piesah in; bangzieh ahei cile na nasempa in Topa tung simlo, pasien dangte khat popo tungah meihal biehna hile, biehpiehna hile pie nawn lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanle tami thu khat tungah, “ Topa in na nasempa’ mawna ei maisah in: Rimmon inn sunga bie dingin tua munah ka pupa a tum ciengin, ka ban tungah ama kingamin Rimmon inn sungah ka kun hi. Rimmon inn sunga ka kun ciengin Topa in tami thu khat tungah na nasempa ei maisah taheh,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in tua pa kungah, “Nuomtahin pei in,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama kung panin Naaman pei-in a gamla lo mun khat a tun ciengin,"},"20":{"text":"Pasien’ mipa Elisha’ nasem Gehazi in, “Aram-te Naaman in ama a pieh nate ka pupa in sang loin tua mipa peisah mawh hi. Topa a hing ahi ma bangin ama nuadelin ama kung panin na themkhat beh ka nga ding hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi.","title":"Gehazi’ Huoihamna"},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gehazi in Naaman a nuadel hi. Mi khat in ama a nuadel lam Naaman in a mu ciengin ama dawn dingin a sakol leeng tung panin ama kumsuh a, “Bangkim a hoi hi sam va izaw?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “A unpi-in hoi hi. Hizongle ka pu in, ‘Ephraim muoltung gam panin keima kungah kamsangte ni tu mama-in ang tung uhi; hepina tawh amate ngun talent khat le pawi puon sil ni pie in,’ ci-a a gen dingin kei ei sawl hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Naaman in, “Hepina tawh talent ni sang tamai ve,” a ci hi. Ama in a san thei nadingin kun a, ippi ni-in ngun talent ni khi-in pawi puon ni tawh, a nasem mihing nite pie-in Gehazi’ mai-ah tuate puosah hi."},"24":{"text":"Khuosung kulpi a tun ciengun ama in amate kung panin ippite la-in tuate inn sungah a khol hi; ama in tua mite sawldawh a, tuale amate zong a pei uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ama sungtumin a pupa mai-ah a ding hi; tuale Elisha in ama kungah, “Gehazi, nang hei-a haw na hiei?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Na nasempa heima sungah pei sing,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanle ama in tua pa kungah, “Nang ang dawn ding mi khat hing kumsuhin nang tawh ka hlagau zawhton hi lo amah? Sum le puonsilte, olive umte le lengga lote, tuute le bawngtangte, nasem numeite le nasem pasalte san ding hun ahi amah?"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nangma le na suonlehlahte tungah Namaan’ phah natna a tu den ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n vua bangin Hehazi vamin a phahsa-in Elisha kung panin a pei hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in kamsang honte in Elisha kungah, “Na theisa bangin nangma’ khut nei-a ka opna mun uh kote adingin kuocih luo hi.","title":"Heitang Tawh Kisai Na Lamdang"},"2":{"text":"Jordan-ah keima ei peisah inlen, tuanah singluong khat ciet puo-in ka ten nading uh mun khat ei bawlsah in,” a ci uhi. Ama in dawngin, “Tua bangin bawl un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate khat in, “Na nasemte tawh hing kuon in, kang thum hi,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in dawng a, “Hing kuon na vang,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nasemte tawh ama a kuon hi. Jordan a tun ciengun sing a phua uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in singluong a phua laitahin tui sungah a heitang a kiehsuo hi; ama awngin, “Ehei, Ka pupa! Tami hei zong mi-a’ kikawm ahi bo’n,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ mipa in, “Hei sunga kiesuh ahiei?” a ci hi. Ama in a kiehna mun ama kungah a hil ciengin ama in ciengkang khat sattanin tua sontahah sepin a heitang a lamtosah hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in, “La to aw,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a khut tawh zamin tuami heitang a la hi."},"8":{"text":"Khatvei Aram kumpipa le Israel a kido ciengun ama in a uliente kuppi hi. Ama in, “Khum mun khum munah ka giephuol ka sat ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Aram-te’ Busimna Kikhahtan"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ mipa in Israel kumpipa kungah thu puoh a, “Aram-te ang peisuh ding ahi ziehin tami mun na nawh khah lo nadingun kidawm un,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Pasien’ mipa genna munah kam vaihlah hi. Amate a kigalgin thei nadingun khatvei nivei sanga a tamzaw thu hilkhol hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin Aram kumpipa patau mama hi; ama in a uliente hlanin amate kungah, “Tu-in ei gen un, eite lahah Israel kumpipa lama a pang koi na hi vuoi?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin a uliente khat in, “Ka pu, kumpipa, koima pang sih. Israel gama om kamsang Elisha in Israel kumpipa kungah na lupna tunga na thugente a na gen sawn ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “Va pei ta’nlen ama hei sunga om ahei va sui ta’n.; keima in mi sawlin ama ka mansah ding hi,” a ci hi. Ama kungah, “Dothan-ah ama om hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in tua munah sakolte le sakol leengte le galkap hon tampite sawl hi; zan lai-in amate pei-in tua khuopi a kui-im pai uhi."},"15":{"text":"Zingmawngin Pasien mipa’ nasem khat thobai-in a pei leh khuopi kimkot zosie-ah sakolte le sakol leengte tawh galkap honpi a om hi. A nasempa in, “Ehei, pu! Bang i ci ta diei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a dawngkia a, “Zau sin, bangzieh ahei cile amate tawh a omte sangin eite tawh a omte tamzaw hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elisha in tam bangin thu ngen hi: “ Topa aw, ama in khuo a mu thei nadingin a mit honpieh in, kang thum hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Topa in nasempa’ mitte honpiehin ama in khuo a mu hi; Elisha’ kimvel zosie-a muol tungah sakolte le meikuong sakol leengte a dimin a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama do dingin Aram-te a kuonsuh uh ciengin Elisha in Topa kungah thu ngen a, “Tam mite mittawtna tawh vatmai in, kang thum hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Elisha’ nget bangin ama in mittawtna tawh amate a vatmai hi."},"19":{"text":"Elisha in amate kungah, “Tam pen a lampi ahi sih a, tam zong a khuopi ahi sih hi; ei zui un, na sui uh mipa kungah kang peipi ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in Samaria ah amate a peipi hi."},"20":{"text":"Samaria ah amate a lut behun Elisha in, “ Topa aw, tam mite in khuo a mu thei nadingun amau’ mit honpieh in,” a ci hi. Topa in a mit uh honpieh a, Samaria khuo sunga a om lam uh a kithei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in amate a mu bepin Elisha kungah, “Ka pa, amate ka that diei?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “That sin! Na thasawm mite, na namsau le na thalpi tawh na mat ahi son amah? Amate in an ne-in tui a dawn thei nadingun amai vuah an le tui lui in; tuale a pu uh kungah amate peisah in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in ama adingin pawi lienpi khat bawlpieh hi; amate in an ne-in tui a dawn zaw ciengun a lampi vuah amate a peisah a, tuale a pupa kung zuonin a pei uhi. Tuale Israel gam sung a sim dingin Aram-te a kuon nawn sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zaw hun khat ciengin Aram kumpipa Ben-hadad in a galkap zosie khawm hi; Samaria do ding le a kuikhum dingin ama a kuonto hi.","title":"Ben-hadad in Samaria a Kui-imna"},"25":{"text":"Amate in a kuikhum den ziehun Samaria-ah kiel nasie mama a, laa lutang khat ngun shekel sawmgiet, gam kaisuon hai khat seli-suo-sekhat ngun shekel nga-in a kizua dongin kielpi a tung hi."},"26":{"text":"Kulpi tungah Israel kumpipa a pei laitahin ama kungah numei khat kiko a, “Ei panpi ven, ka pu kumpipa!” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in, “Hi lo hi! Topa kipanpisah zaw in. Ke’n nang bang kang ci panpi thei kan ding ahei? Ancilna phuol pan ahi sihle lengga tui suhna pana kang panpi ding amah?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in tua nu dong a, “Na lungkhamna bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Tam numei in ka kungah, ‘Na tapa ei pie in; tuni-in ama i ne ding a, kei tapa zing ciengin i ne ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka tapa’ sa huonin ka ne uhi. A zing ciengin ama kungah, ‘Na tapa ei pie in, a sa i ne ding hi,’ ka ci hi. Hizongle tua nu in a tapa a na phuolmang ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 28:57; Kaa 4:10"},"30":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua numei’ thugen a zah ciengin a puonte a ehkeh hi; ama khuopikul tunga a pei laitah ahi ziehin mite in a pumpi nei lamah la-ip puon a sil lam a mu uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Tu ni-in Shaphat’ tapa Elisha’ lutang a liengko tunga a op sih tah ma leh Pasien in kei ei dawm sih hinlen, a nasie zaw-in ei bawl lai heh,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in ama mai-ah mi khat a sawl hi. Tu-in a inn sungah Elisha to a, ama tawh upate a to ton laitah ahi hi. Kamtaipa a tun masangin Elisha in upate kungah, “Tam mithat pa in ka lu tan dingin mi khat ang sawl lam na thei vuoi mah? Kamtai pa ang tun ciengin kot khah unlen, ama lang khatah kotpi tucip un. Ama nua-ah a pu’ ketot ging kiza hi lo amah?” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate tawh a holim laitahin ama kungah kumpipa peisuh a, “Tami gimna Topa kung pan ahi hi! Bang dingin Topa sungah kinem na lai ding ka hei?” a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin Elisha in, “ Topa’ kammal za in: Tam bangin Topa in gen a, zing cieng tu bang hunin Samaria kul tunkotah annel law khat shekel khatin kizua ding a, mangbuham law ni shekel khatin kizua ding hi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa a khuta a kingapna galkap bupa in Pasien’ mipa kungah, “ Topa in vantung tawlette nangawn hong nanle tam bang pieng thei ding amah?” a ci hi. Ahi vangin ama in, “Na mit tawh na mu ding a, ahi vangin na ne kha sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua laitahin khuopi tunkot pulamah miphah li om a, amate khatlekhat in, “Bang dinga i si tanpha vua tam sunga mawh toto ding i hi uh ahei?","title":"Aram-te Taimang"},"4":{"text":"‘Khuopi sungah lut vai,’ ci lei lah khuopi sungah kielpi tung a, tua munah i si ding uhi; tam sungah to den vai ci lei lah a si veve ding i hi uhi. Tua ahi ziehin Aram-te’ giephuolah va pei vai; amate in ei mawh hingkhawi khah uleh i hing ding a, ei tha ule lah a si veve ding ma i hi lel uhi,” a kici uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n nitum kuonin Aram-te’ phuolah a pei uhi; ahi vangin Aram-te’ phuol mong a tun uleh tua munah koima a na om nawn sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in sakol leengte, sakolte le galkap honpi husate Aram galkapte zasahin amate khatlekhat in, “Israel kumpipa in ei do dingin Hit kumpite le Egypt kumpite ciel hi,” a kici uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n ni tum kuonin amate tai-in a puonbuhte uh, a sakolte ule a laate uh nuasie-in a hinna a taipi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tam miphahte giephuol mong a tun ciengun puonbuh khat sungah lutin an ne tui dawnin a om vua, ngun, kham, le puonsilte tomgamin tuate a phuol uhi. Tua ciengin peikia-in puonbuh dang khatah a lut vua, khum panin zong vante tuo-in tuate a phuol leuleu uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate khatlekhat a kiho vua, “I sepzie uh man lo hi. Tuni pen kipah ni ahi hi; bangma gen loin i dai op vua, zingmawng khuova dong i nga uleh gimna i thuoh ding uhi; tua ziehin va pei-in kumpipa’ innkuonte kungah va gen ta vai,” a kici uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate zong pei-in khuopi tunkot cingte a ko vua, tuale amate kungah, “Aram-te’ giephuol ka va haw ta vua, khum sungah a kikhi sakolte le laate le a bang banga om puonbuhte simlo, koima kimu kha lo a, koima’ husa zong kiza loin bangma dang om lo hi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin tunkot cingte kiko-in kumpipa’ innkuonte kungah tam thu a tangko uhi."},"12":{"text":"Zanin kumpipa tho-in a nasemte kungah, “Aram-te in ei do dinga a kisah dan uh kang gen ding hi. Amate in i kiel lam a thei uhi; tuaci’n amate gamlahah a kiphuol dingin giephuol a nuasie vua, ‘Khuopi panin ang pei ciengun amate hing matin khuopi sungah i lut ding hi,’ ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"13":{"text":"A nasemte khat in, “Tam sunga kinuasie teng in a sisa Israel mihonpi ma bangin thuoh veve ding ahi ziehin mi pawlkhat in a omlai sakolte sung panin nga kaisah hi; amate sawlin en phot vai,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in sakol tung tuong mi ni hlanin kumpipa in Aram galkapte nua-ah amate sawl a, “Pei unlen va thei ta un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama gel in Jordan dong a del uhi; lam dung tengah Aram-te a kinaw na lam vua a kiehsah uh puonte le vanzahte a na kithethang ziezuo hi. Tuaci’n kamtaite kinuale-in kumpipa kungah a gen uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin mite pei-in Aram-te’ giephuol a bulu uhi. Tuaci’n Topa gensa dung zui-in annel law khat shekel khatin kizua a, mangbuham law ni shekel khatin kizua hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in kumpipa in a khuta a kingapna galkap bupa pen tunkot uh dingin koi hi; ama kungah kumpipa a peisuh lai-in Pasien’ mipa thugensa bang lien ma-in mite in a si dongin tunkotah ama a tuoncil uhi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ mipa in kumpipa kungah, “Zing cieng tu bang hunin Samaria tunkotah mangbuham law ni shekel khatin kizua ding a, annel law khat shekel khatin kizua ding hi,” a ci ciengin"},"19":{"text":"galkap bupa in Pasien’ mipa dawng a, “ Topa in vantung tawlette nangawn hong nanle tam bang pieng thei ding amah?” a ci hi. Tuale ama in dawngin, “Na mit tawh na mu ding a, hinanle na nekha sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bang ma-in ama tungah tung tahpi hi; mite in tunkotah ama tuoncilin a si hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Elisha in a tapa a hinkiasah numei kungah, “Tho-in na innkuon tawh pei inlen, na ten theina mun khat popo-ah teng in; azieh pen Topa in kielpi khat tunsah ding thupie zo a, gam sungah kum sagi sung kielpi tung ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Shunem Numei’ Leitang Kipiekia","ref":"2Kum 4:8-37"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua numei dingin Pasien’ mipa thugen bangin gamta hi; a innkuon tawh tua nu pei-in Philistia-te gamah kum sagi sung a teng hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum sagi a cin zaw, Philistia-te gam panin tua numei a kinuale ciengin, a inn le a leitang ngen dingin kumpipa kungah a pei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua laitahin Pasien’ mipa nasem ahi Gehazi le kumpipa kiho a, “Elisha’ sepsa na lien zosie ei gen in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Elisha in a sisa mi a hinsah kiana thu kumpipa kungah a gen laitahin, a tapa a hinkiasah numei in a inn le a leitang ngen dingin kumpipa kungah a pei hi. Gehazi in, “Ka pu, kumpipa aw, tam sungah a numei om a, Elisha in a hinkiasah a tapa zong tam sungah om hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa in numei kungah tua thu a dawh ciengin ama in a gen hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa in tua nu adingin ulien khat koi a, “Leitang a nuasie ni-a patin tuhun dong lo pana a pieng phiengsie zosie tawh ama-a’ teng a unpi-in piekia in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Ben-hadad a cinat laitahin Damascus-ah Elisha a pei hi. Ama kungah, “Pasien’ mipa tam sungah ang pei hi,” ci-in a kigen ciengin","title":"Ben-hadad’ Sina"},"8":{"text":"kumpipa in Hazael kungah, “Letsong khat kengin Pasien’ mipa dawn dingin va pei ta’n. Ama tungtawnin Topa tungah, ‘Tam natna panin ka damkia na diei,’ ci-in va dong ta’n,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama dawn dingin Damascus-a pieng na hoi nam tuomtuom kalaoh sawmli puohkhop letsong kengin Hazael a kuon hi. Ama lutin ama mai-ah a din ciengin ama in, “Na tapa Aram Kumpipa Ben-hadad in nang kungah ei sawl a, “Tami natna panin ka damkia na diei,’ ci hi,” a ci hi"},"10":{"text":"Elisha in, “Pei inlen ama kungah gen in, ‘Na damkia valon ding hi,’ va ci ta’n; hinanle ama a si valon nading thu Topa in kei kungah ei lah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama a zalat dongin mit phe loin Elisha in Hazael a encien hi. Tua bepin Pasien’ mipa a kap hi."},"12":{"text":"Hazael in, “Ka pu, bang dinga kap na hiei” ci-in dong hi. Ama in dawng a, “Azieh pen Israel mite tunga na bawl ding sietna ka thei hi; nang in a kulpite uh mei tawh na hal ding a, a tangvalte uh namsau tawh thatin, a naupangnote uh lei denna-in na nei ding hi, tuale naupaai lai numeite’ gil na kheipieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Hazael in, “Ui bang bep lel na nasempa tami sil thupi bawl dingin bang ahi ahei?” a ci hi. Elisha in dawng a, “Aram tunga nang kumpi na hi nading thu Topa in kei kungah ei lah zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:15"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Elisha nuasie-in ama kungah, “Elisha in bang ang gen ei?” a ci a pupa Ben-hadad kung a tung hi. Tuale ama in dawngin, “Ama in na damkia valon nading thu kei kungah ei gen hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Hizongle a zing ciengin a netpha la-in tui sungah die a, kumpipa a si dongin ama in a mai-ah tua puon a zah hi. Tuale Hazael in ama’ za luo hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel kumpi Ahab’ tapa Joram a kum ngana kumin Judah Kumpi Jehoshaphat’ tapa Jehoram maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Judah ah Jehoram Maang (2Khg 21:1-20)"},"17":{"text":"Kumpi a suo hunin kum sawmthum le ni pha a, ama in kum giet sung Jerusalem uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahab’ tanu ama’ zi ahi ziehin Ahab innkuonte’ gamtatsa bangin Israel kumpite’ lampi ma a zui hi. Topa’ mitmu-in a sie-in ama a gamta hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle ama in ama le a suonlehlahte tungah tawntung meivah khat pieh dingin kam ciem zo ahi ziehin a nasempa David ziehin Topa in Judah a susie nuom sih hi.","ref":"1Kum 11:36"},"20":{"text":"Ama hun sungin Edom-te in Judah’ uhna a ledo vua, amau’ aituom kumpi khat koi uhi.","ref":"Pien 27:40"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jehoram in a sakol leeng zosie tawh Zair-ah a galkai hi. Ama zanin kuon a, ama a imtawm Edom-te le sakol leeng bupate a busim hi; ahi vangin inn ah a galkapte a taimang uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuni dongin Edom-te in Judah gam uhna a ledo uhi. Khum hun ma-in Libnah in zong a ledo hi."},"23":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoram’ gamtatna a omlai teng le ama sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh Jehoram lumton a, David’ khuopi sungah kivui hi; a tapa Ahaziah in ama’ za luo hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel kumpi Ahab’ tapa Joram a kum sawm le nina kumin Judah kumpi Jehoram’ tapa Ahaziah maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Judah ah Ahaziah Maang (2Khg 22:1-6)"},"26":{"text":"A maan a kipatin Ahaziah kum sawmni le ni pha hi; ama kum khat sung Jerusalem ah maang hi. Ama’ nu min Athaliah ahi a, Israel kumpi Omri’ tunu ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama Ahab’ innkuonte’ mahpa ahi ziehin Ahab’ innkuonte gamtat ma bangin Topa mitmu-in a sie-in gamta a, Ahab innkuonte’ lampi ma a zui hi."},"28":{"text":"Ramoth-gilead ah Aram kumpipa Hazael sim dingin Ahab’ tapa Joram tawh Ahaziah a kuonton uhi. Tua tahah Aram-te in Joram a liemsah uhi."},"29":{"text":"Rama ah Aram kumpipa Hazael tawh a kidona vuah Aram-te in ama a liemsahna uh liemmate kem dingin Jezreel ah kumpi Joram a kilekia hi. Jezreel ah Ahab’ tapa Joram a liem ziehin ama a ve dingin Judah kumpi Jehoram’ tapa Ahaziah a kuonsuh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsang Elisha in kamsang honte lah panin khat hlanin ama kungah, “Na kawng gah inlen, tami sathau bung tawi-in Ramoth-gilead ah va haw ta’n.","title":"Jehu Sathau A Kinuna"},"2":{"text":"Na tun ciengin khumnah Nimshi’ tapa Jehoshaphat, a tapa Jehu sui in; a sungah lutin a guolte lahah kaikhie inlen, innkhan sungtawng khatah lutpi in."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin sathau um la-in a lu tungah sungsuh inlen, ‘ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Israel tunga kumpi sem dingin sathau kang nu hi,’ ci hi,” va ci ta’n. Tua ciengin kot hong inlen tai in; khuomuong sin,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ramoth-gilead ah kamsang tangvalpa a pei hi."},"5":{"text":"Galkap bute in kikupna a nei laitahun ama tung a, tuale ama in, “Galkap bupa aw, nang adingin thu khat kang puoh hi,” a ci hi. Jehu in, “Kote lahah koi pen gen a kinei na hei?” ci-in a dong hi. Galkap bupa, nang ang gen ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jehu dingin inn sungah lut hi; tangvalpa in a lu tungah sathau sungin ama kungah, “Israel Pasien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in Topa’ mite ahi Israel tunga kumpi sem dingin nang sathau kang nu hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:16"},"7":{"text":"Jazebel tungah ka nasem kamsangte’ sisan le Topa nasem zosie’ sisan phu ka lah thei nadingin na pupa Ahab’ innkuon na satlia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Ahab’ innkuon zosie a mangthai ding hi; keima in Israel sungah Ahab’ innkuon panin pasal poma, sal hile, sal lo hile ka sumaimang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ innkuon le Ahijah’ tapa Baasha’ innkuon bangin Ahab innkuon ka bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Jezreel gam sungah uite in Jezebel’ sa a ne ding vua, koima in ama vui lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin kot hongin ama a taimang hi.","ref":"1Kum 21:23"},"11":{"text":"A pu’ nasemte kungah Jehu a tunkia ciengin amate in a kungah, “Bangkim a hoi ma ahiei mah? Bang hing bawla tua mimaw pa na kunga hing haw ahiei?” a ci uhi. Ama in a kung vuah, “Tam mipa dan le a thugen bielbualte na thei uhi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in, “Mi zuou pa! Ko ei gen in!” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n ama in, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Israel tunga kumpi dingin keima in nang sathau kang nu hi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in zong mallangtahin a puonte uh suo-in kalei tungnung pen ah a pha uhi; tuale pengkul mutin, “Jehu, kumpi hi,” ci-in a tangtawh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Nimshi’ tapa Jehoshaphat, a tapa Jehu in Joram a sawmdap hi. Aram kumpi Hazael langpangin Ramoth-gilead ah Israel zosie tawh khuo cingin Joram a om hi;","title":"Israel kumpi Joram Kithat"},"15":{"text":"ahi vangin Aram kumpipa Hazael tawh a kido lai-a Aram-te in a liemsahna liemma a kem dingin Jezreel- ah kumpi Joram kilekia zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jehu a sakol-leeng tungah tuongin a dam lo lupmun tung a ngah Joram opna Jezreel ah haw hi. Joram ve dingin Judah kumpi Ahaziah na tungsuh zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Jezreel ah galvil pa khat tausang tungah ding a, tuale ama in Jehu’ pawlte a tun laitah mu a, “Mi honkhat ka mu hi,” a ci hi. Joram in, “Sakol tung tuong mi khat la-in, amate dawn dingin sawl inlen, ‘Thu hoi ahiei mah?’ cisah in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama dawn dingin sakol tung tuong pa pei-in ama in, “Kumpipa in tam bangin gen hi, ‘Thu hoi-a hing haw na hi uh amah,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Jehu in dawngkia a, “Thuhoi le nang bang kisai na hei? Ka nua ei zui in,” a ci hi. Tua galvil pa in thu zasahin, “Kamtai pa in amate kung pha napi ama ang kilekia ta sih hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in sakol tung tuong a nina pa sawlin a kung vuah pei a, “Kumpipa in tam bangin gen hi: ‘Thuhoi-a hing haw na hi uh amah?’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Jehu in dawng a, “Thuhoi le nang bang kisai na hei? Ka nua ei zui in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Galvil pa in thu zasahkia a, “Ama in amate kung pha napi ama kilekia nawn lo hi. Nimshi’ tapa Jehu’ leeng hawl dan tawh kibang hi; azieh pen ama in mimaw bangin a hawl hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Joram in, “Kithawi un,” a ci hi. Amate in a sakol leeng a guonpieh uhi. Tua ciengin Israel kumpi Joram le Judah kumpi Ahaziah, a sakol leeng tuoh vuah tuongin a dingkhie uhi; amate zong Jehu tawh kimu dingin a kuon vua, ama tawh Jezreel mi Naboth’ lo-ah a kimu uhi."},"22":{"text":"Joram in Jehu a mu ciengin, “Jehu, thuhoi-a hing haw na hiei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Na nu Jezebel’ bum le aisanna le numei pahtatte a op laisie bang thuhoi om thei ding ahei,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sakol kamkai lehei-in Joram tai a, Ahaziah kungah, “Ahaziah, kumpi suon sawm!” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Jehu in a tha nei za tawh a thalpi kuoi-in ama’ lungtang sontah pailet dingin Joram’ liengko kikal kap hi; tuale a sakol leeng sungah ama a tumsuh hi."},"25":{"text":"Jehu in ama a hupa Bidkar kungah, “Domto inlen Jezreel-te Naboth’ neisa leitangah pai in; azieh pen a pa Ahab nua-ah nang le kei, kimai kimin i tuonton lai-in ama langpangin Topa in tami thuphuon a gen phawh in:"},"26":{"text":"“Zani-in Naboth’ sisan le a tapate’ sisan ka mu ziehin tami leitang tung tehteh-ah kang thuh ding hi, ci-in ka kiciem hi,’ Topa in ci hi. Tua ahi ziehin Topa’ thugen dung zui-in tu-in ama domto inlen, tua leitang tungah ama pai in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 21:19"},"27":{"text":"Judah kumpi Ahaziah in tua thu a mu ciengin Beth-haggan lamah a tai hi. Jehu in ama nuadel a, “Ama zong kap un!” a ci hi. Ibleam gei, Gur katona sontah sakol leeng tungah amate in ama a kap uhi. Tua ciengin Megiddo ah ama tai-in tua munah a si hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Ahaziah Kithat (2Khg 22:7-9)"},"28":{"text":"A uliente in Jerusalem ah sakol leeng khat tawh ama a puo vua, David’ khuopi sunga ama’ hanah a pu a pate tawh a vuiton uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ahab’ tapa Joram a kum sawm le khatna kumin Ahaziah in Judah tungah maan ding kipan hi."},"30":{"text":"Jezree ah Jehu a tun ciengin Jezebel in tam thu na za hi; tua nu in a mitte zutin a lu zem a, tawlet panin a khuodah hi.","title":"Jezebel’ Sina"},"31":{"text":"Tunkot-ah Jehu a lut laitahin ama in, “Nang Zimri, na pu that pa, thu hoi-a hing haw na hiei mah?” na ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in tawlet lam ento-in, “Kei lamah koi teng na om vuoi? Koi e?” a ci hi. Numeite a uh cilgesa pasal ni ahiei thum ahiei in ama a ensuh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua nu hing sepsuh un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in tua nu a sepsuh uhi; ama’ sisan kimkhat kawm tung le sakolte tungah kithethang a, tuaci’n ama a tuoncil uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama sung tumin an ne-in tui a dawn hi; ama in, “A kisamsie numei enin va vuibawl ta un; azieh pen ama kumpipa’ tanu ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanle tua nu vui dinga a pei ciengun amate in a lugu, a kephang le a khutphang cite simlo bangma dang a mu nawn sih uhi."},"36":{"text":"Amate kilekia-in Jehu kungah a gen ciengun ama in, “Tam pen a nasempa, Tishbe mi Elijah tung tawna Topa na gensa ahi hi: ‘Jezreel gam sungah uite in Jezebel’ sa a ne ding uhi;","ref":"1Kum 21:23"},"37":{"text":"koima in, ‘Tami Jezebel ahi hi,’ a ci thei lo nadingin Jezreel gam sunga lolai-ah Jezebel’ luonghawm ehlei bang ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Samaria ah Ahab in tapa sawm sagi nei hi. Tuaci’n Jehu in lai gielin Samaria-a teng Jezreel uliente tung, upate tung le Ahab’ tapate a cingte tungah tua laite hlahin,","title":"Ahab’ Suonlehlahte A Kihonthana"},"2":{"text":"“Note tawh na pu uh’ tapate omin na dei bang vua na zah thei uh sakol leengte le sakolte, kul tawh a ki-im khuopite le galvante na nei ziehun,"},"3":{"text":"na pu’ tapate lahah a hoipen khat teelin a pa’ kumpi topha tungah tosah unlen, na pupa’ innkuon adingin gal sim un,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate a zau mama vua, “En un, kumpi nite nangawn in ama nang zo lo hi; tua ahile eite in bang i ci nan zo mawh ding ahei?” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpi innsung vaipuo pa le khuopi uhpa in upate le a cingte tawh Jehu kungah kam vaihlahin, “Kote nangma’ nasemte ka hi uhi; na gen popo ka sem ding uhi. Koima khat beh kumpi-in ka bawl sih ding uhi; hoi na sah bangin kibawl in,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jehu in amate kungah laihlah a nina gielkia a, “No kei lamah ang omin ka thu mang dingin a baisa-in na op uleh na pu uh’ tapate’ lutang la unlen, zing cieng tu bang hunin Jezreel-a ka kungah hing peipi ta un,” a ci hi. Tu-in kumpipa’ tapa sawm sagite pen amate a khansuo khuopi uliente tawh a omton uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate kungah a laihlah a tun ciengin kumpipa’ tapa sawm sagite manin a that uhi; bawng sungah amau’ lutang a guong vua, Jezreel-a Jehu kungah a hlah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kamtaipa pei-in ama kungah, “Amate in kumpipa tapate’ lutang ang puo zo ta uhi,” ci-in a gen ciengin ama in, “Zingmawng dongin tunkot lutna-ah lom ni-in koi un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Zingmawngin ama a pusuo ciengin dingin mi zosie kungah, “Note pen maw peng na hi uhi. Ka pupa sawmdapin a that keima ka hi hi. Hinanle tam teng zosie a satlum koi ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ahab’ innkuon tawh kisai-in Topa in a gen thu, Topa’ kammal khat zong tuolah kie lo ding hi, ci-in thei un; azieh pen a nasempa Elijah tung tawna a gensa thu Topa in sem zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jehu in koima hen nei lo za dongin Jezreel khuo sunga Ahab’ innkuon a om sun teng, ulien zosie, a lawm it zosie, le siempu zosie that sieng hi.","ref":"Hos 1:4"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama dingin Samaria ah a pei hi. Lamkal, Tuucingte opna ahi Beth-eked a tun ciengin,"},"13":{"text":"Jehu in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah’ sanggamte mu-in, ama in, “No koi na hi vuoi?” a ci hi. Amate in a dawng vua, “Kote Ahaziah’ tanaute ka hi uhi; Jezreel-a om kumpipa’ tapate le kumpinu’ tapate kunga haw dinga ang kuonsuh ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “Amate hingmat in,” a ci hi. Amate in tua mite hingmat in, Beth-eked dum sungah mi sawmli le ni that hi; ama in koima khat beh a hingkhawi sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in khum mun a nuasie ciengin ama dawn dinga a pei Rekhab’ tapa Jehonadab tawh kituoh hi; Jehu in tuapa hopi-in ama kungah, “Nang tungah ka lungtang a thuman bangin, kei tungah na lungtang a thuman ei mah?” a ci hi. Jehonadab in dawng a “Man hi,” a ci hi. Jehu in, “Tua ahile na khut ei hlah in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a khut a hlah hi. Jehu in sakol leeng tungah ama kaito hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei ei zui inlen, Topa ading ka deiluotna hing en in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in a sakol leeng tungah ama a tuongsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Samaria a tun ciengin Topa in Elijah kunga a gensa dung zui-in Jehu in amate a suh maimang dongin Samaria-a om Ahab’ innkuonpi a omlai teng zosie a that sieng hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jehu in mi zosie khawmtuo-in amate kungah, “Ahab in Baal’ na themkhat sem hi; ahi vangin Jehu in tam semzaw ding hi.","title":"Baal Biete Kithana"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Baal kamsangte zosie le a siempu zosie ka kungah hing sawl un; koima pelemsah sih un; azieh pen keima in Baal tungah kithoina thupi khat ka nei ding hi; a pelem poma kihingkhawi lo ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Jehu in Baal bie mi zosie a suh maimang thei nadinga ngian tawh a bawl ahi bo hi."},"20":{"text":"Jehu in thu pie a, “Baal ading a thupi kikhopna siengtho khat bawl un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in a tangko uhi."},"21":{"text":"A pei lo koima khat beh om loin Baal bie mi zosie a pei nadingin Jehu in Israel gam sung zosie-ah thu a zasah hi; Baal a bie zosie a pei vua, a pei lo mi khat zong om lo hi. Baal biehinn a kawm khat panin a kawm khat dong dimin Baal biehinn sungah amate a lut uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in kizepna puon kempa kungah, “Baal bie zosie adingin puon hing la in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate dingin ama in puonte a peipi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rechab’ tapa Jehonadab tawh Baal biehinn sungah Jehu tum hi; ama in Baal bie mite kungah, “Note lahah Topa a bie mi om loin Baal biete beh a op nadingin sui unlen en un,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kithoinate le meihal biehnate a zom suoh uhi. Tu-in Jehu in a pulamah mi sawmgiet koi a, “Na khut sung vua kang pieh khat popo a hlasuo pa in ama’ hinna a tan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Meihal biehna pieh a man zaw behin Jehu in a cingte le uliente kungah, “Va lut unlen, va that ta un; mi khat zong pitsah sih un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n namsau tawh amate a that uhi. A cingte le uliente in amate a pulam sena’n a nei vua, Baal biehinn kulpi sung a lut uhi."},"26":{"text":"Baal biehinn sunga om Baal biehna song la-in a hal uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Baal biehna song phelkhe-in Baal biehinn a susie vua, tuni dongin ehbuh a suohsah uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua bangin Jehu in Israel sung panin Baal a phietmang sieng hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin Bethel le Dan-a kham bawngnote a bawl zieha Israel a khielsah, Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate panin Jehu a kihei tuom sih hi.","ref":"1Kum 12:28-30"},"30":{"text":"Topa in Jehu kungah, “Nang in man ka sah thu limtaha na sep zieh le ka lung lam banga Ahab’ innkuonte na bawlna ziehin khang lina dongin Israel kumpi topha tungah na tapate a to ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jehu in a lungsim zosie tawh Israel Pasien Topa’ thukham limtahin zui kha lo hi; Israel a khielsah Jeroboam’ mawna panin ama a kihei tuon sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Topa in Israel gam pawlkhat khep ding kipan hi. Hazael in Israel gam sung zosie-ah amate a zo hi.","title":"Jehu’ Sina"},"33":{"text":"Jordan nisuona lam, Gilead gam zosie, Gad-te, Reuben-te, Manasseh-te, Arnon Lui gei-a om Aroer panin Gilead le Bashan gam zosie a zomang hi."},"34":{"text":"Tu-in Jehu’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a sep zosie le ama thahatnate zosie, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh Jehu lumton a, amate in Samaria ah ama a vui uhi. A tapa Jehoahaz in ama’ za luo hi."},"36":{"text":"Jehu in Samaria panin Israel tungah kum sawmni le giet sung uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahaziah’ nu Athaliah in a tanu a si lam a thei ciengin ama in kumpi innkuon zosie tha a sawm hi.","title":"Athaliah in Judah Uh (2Khg 22:10-12)"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ahaziah’ sanggamnu Kumpi Joram’ tanu Jehosheba in Ahaziah’ tapa Joash man a, tha dinga kikoi kumpipa’ tapate lah pan gumang hi; tua nu in lupna khan khatah ama le a cingnu koi hi. Tua bangin ama a kitha lo nadingin Athaliah’ mu loin tua nu in ama a phuoldap hi;"},"3":{"text":"Athaliah gam sunga a maan laitahin tua nu tawh ama kum guh sung omin Topa’ biehinn sungah a kiphuol hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle a kum sagina kumin siempu Jehoiada in mi sawlin Topa’ biehinn sunga a kungah Car-te’ galkap bute le kumpi inncingte a hlansah hi. Ama in amate tawh thuciemna khat bawl a, Topa’ biehinn sungah amate a kiciemsah hi. Tua ciengin ama in a kung vuah kumpipa’ tapa lah hi.","title":"Jehoiada in Nausen Joash Sathau Nu (2Khg 23:1-11)"},"5":{"text":"Ama in amate thu pie a, “Na sep ding uh tami ahi hi: Sabbath ni-in nasep khawlin kumpipa’ inncing no sethum-suo-sekhat in"},"6":{"text":"(Sur’ tunkotah adang sethum-suo-sekhat om a, a cing galkapte nualam tunkot ah adang sethum-suo-sekhat a om hi) kumpi inn na cing ding uhi;"},"7":{"text":"tuale Sabbath ni-a na sep a lut no khen nite in Topa’ biehinnpi na cing ding uhi!"},"8":{"text":"na khut sung vuah na hiem ciet utawh kumpipa na kimkot ding uhi; tuale a cing galkapte lam a neh popo kithat ding hi. Kumpipa’ sungtumna le a pusuona-ah ama tawh omton un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Galkap bute in siempu Jehoiada’ thupieh tawh kizui-in a bawl uhi; sabbath ni-a nasep lut dingte tawh Sabbath ni-a nasep khawl dingte peipi cietin siempu Jehoiada kungah a tung uhi."},"10":{"text":"Siempu pa in galkap bute tungah Topa’ biehinn sunga kumpi David’ teipite le lumte pie hi;"},"11":{"text":"mi zosie in a khut sung vuah a hiem ciet uh tawi-in biehinn kimvelah kumpipa cing dingin a ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in kumpipa’ tapa peipi-in a lu tungah kumpi lukhu khusah a, tuaci’n thuciemna laibu ama a pie hi; amate in ama kumpi hi, ci-in a tangko uhi; a khut uh bengin, “Kumpipa dam sawt heh,” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"13":{"text":"Athlaliah in a cingte le mite’ husa a zah ciengin Topa’ biehinn sunga mite kungah ama a pei hi;","title":"Athaliah Sina (2Khg 23:12–24:1)"},"14":{"text":"tua nu a khuodah leh ngaina a om bangin biehna song gei-ah kumpipa dingin kumpipa gei-ah galkap bute le pengkul mutte a om vua, gammi zosie kipahin pengkul a mut uhi. Athaliah in a puon ehkehin, “Kumpi suon sawm! Kumpi suon sawm!” ci-in a kiko hi.","ref":"2Kum 23:3"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu Jehoiada in galkapte a uh galkap bute thupie a, “Galkapte kikalah tua nu peipi unlen, ama’ nua a zui poma namsau tawh that un,” a ci hi. Bangzieh ahei cile siempu pa in, “ Topa’ biehinn sungah ama that sih un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in tua nu man uhi; kumpipa’ inn lutna Sakol Tunkot lamah ama nu pei a, tua munah ama nu kithat hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate Topa’ mi ahi nadingun Jehoiada in Topa le kumpipa le mite kikalah thuciemna khat bawl hi; kumpipa le mite kikalah zong a bawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Baal biehinn sungah gam mi zosie pei-in a biehinn a phelmang uhi; amate in a maitamte le a milimte sukehin tua maitamte mai-ah Baal siempu Mattan a that uhi. Siempu pa in Topa’ biehinnah a cingte a koi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in galkap bute, Car-te, a cingte, le gam mi zosie, kaikhawm hi; tua ciengin Topa’ biehinn panin kumpipa zawpisuhin a cingte’ tunkot tawnin kumpipa’ inn a zuon uhi. Kumpite’ topha tungah ama a to hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n gam mi zosie a kipah uhi; tuale kumpipa’ inn ah namsau tawh Athaliah a kitha zaw langsie khuopi sung a sip dide hi."},"21":{"text":"Jehoash a maan ding a kipatin ama kum sagi a pha hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehu’ kum sagina kumin Jehoash a maan ding kipan a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmli sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min pen Zibiah ahi a, Beer-sheba mi ahi hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Kipuopha (2Khg 24:1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Siempu Jehoiada in ama thu a hil ziehin Jehoash in a uh sung tungtawn Topa muna-ah a dihin a gamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle munsangte a kipaimang tuom sih hi; mite in munsangte tungah biehpiehna le biehnate a pie lai veve uhi."},"4":{"text":"Jehoash in siempute kungah, “ Topa’ biehinn sunga kipeipi a siengtho nate’ kitatna sum zosie, milip’ pieh dinga kise sum le nop thu-a Topa’ biehinn sunga kipeipi sumte,","ref":"Pei 30:11-16"},"5":{"text":"huna pie khat ciet tung panin siempute in la uheh; tuale biehinn puo dinga poimaw a sahna poma uh puosah un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpi Jehoash’ uh kum sawmni le thumna kum dongin siempute in tua biehinn a puo sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kumpi Jehoash in siempu Jehoiada le siempu dangte hlanin a kung vuah, “Bang dinga biehinn na puo lo uh ahei? Tua ziehin tu-in huna piete tung panin sum la nawn sih unlen, biehinn puophat nadingin a sumte ap un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempute in mite tung panin sum la nawn loin biehinn zong puo nawn lo dingin a kithukim uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu Jehoiada in singkuong khat la-in a sin vut vang a, Topa’ biehinn sung lutna zietlam pang maitam tungah koi hi; kotkhah a cing siempute in tua singkuong sungah Topa’ biehinn sunga kipeipi sum zosie a koi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Singkuong sungah sum tampi om ci thu a thei ciengin kumpipa’ thuvanpi pa le siempu lien pa kuonto -in Topa’ biehinn sunga om sumte simin ip tawh a tun uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn nasem uhte’ khut sungah a tawitesa uh sumte a pie uhi; tua ciengin amate in Topa’ biehinn a van khutsiemte le inn lamte a guoi vua,"},"12":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn puo nading sing lei nading, suong taw nading, le biehinn puona khat popo-a zah dingin leilesuong innlam siemte le suongkhengte tungah tuate a pie uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ biehinn adingin ngun kuongte, taitete, kuongkumte, pengkulte, ahi sihle kham hile, ngun vanzah khat popo hile, Topa’ biehinn sunga kipeipi sumte panin kibawl lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa’ biehinn a puo nasemte tungah tua sumte kipie hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate a dihtat seng ziehin nasemte kunga a piehsawn ding vua a khut sung vua ki-ap sumte tung panin amate in sum zahna sazien a ngen sih uhi.","ref":"2Kum 22:7"},"16":{"text":"Amate in Topa’ inn ah khielna zieha biehna sumte le mawna zieha biehna sumte a peipi sih uhi; tuate pen siempute-a’ ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 7:7"},"17":{"text":"Khum hunlai-in Aram kumpipa Hazael kuonto a, Gath simin a la hi. Ahi vangin Hazael in Jerusalem do dinga peito dingin a mai a ngat leh,"},"18":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Jehoash in Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, le Ahaziah, ama’ pu le pate, le Judah kumpite in a apsa pieh dinga a kamciem uh letsong zosie le a kamciemsa letsongte le Topa’ inn sung le kumpipa gou kholna sunga a kimu kham zosie la-in Aram kumpipa Hazael kungah a puoh hi. Tua ciengin Jerusalem panin Hazael a peikhie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in Joash’ gamtatna a omlai teng le a sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?","title":"Joash’ Sina (2Khg 24:23-27)"},"20":{"text":"A nasemte dingkhie-in sawmdapna khat a gel vua, Silla zotsuhna lampi Millo inn sungah Joash a that uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama a si nadinga a satlia pa khu a nasempa Shimeath’ tapa Jozacar le Shomer’ tapa Jehozabad ahi uhi. Amate in David’ khuopi sungah a pu a pate tawh ama a vui uhi; tua ciengin a tapa Amaziah in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Ahaziah’ tapa Joash a kum sawmni le thumna kumin Jehu’ tapa Jehoahaz in Samaria panin Israel ah maan kipan a, kum sawm le sagi sung a maang hi.","title":"Jehoahaz in Israel Uh"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ mitmu-in ama siet gamtat a, Israel a khielsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate a zui hi; tuate panin ama kihem lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel tungah Topa’ lungthahna kikuontaw a, tuaci’n ama in Aram kumpipa Hazael’ khut sungah amate pie den mielmuol a, tua ciengin Hazael’ tapa Benhadad’ khut sungah zong a pie den mielmuol hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jehoahaz in Topa kungah thum a, Topa in ama’ thumnate a ngai hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Aram kumpipa in Israel a kibawlsietna le Aram kumpipa in amate a bangci bawlsiet ahei ci ama in mu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Aram-te’ khut sung panin a suotah thei nadingun Topa in Israel tungah hundampa khat a pie hi. Nidang lai bangin a inn vuah Israel mite a teng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel a khielsah Jeroboam innkuon’ mawnate panin a kihem sih vua, tuate a zui zawsop uhi; khuom siengtho zong Samaria ah a omlai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Aram kumpipa in amate a susie a, ama in amate vutvai a suosah tah ziehin Jehoahaz kungah sakol galkap sawmnga sanga a tamzaw lo, sakol leeng sawm le lei galkap tul sawm bang beh a om tabo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoahaz’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a sep zosie le a vangliatna, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh Jehoahaz lumton a, Samaria ah ama a vui uhi; tua ciengin a tapa Joash in ama’ za luo hi."},"10":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Joash a kum sawmthum le sagina kumin Jehoahaz’ tapa Jehoash in Samaria panin Israel ah maan ding a kipan hi; ama kum sawm le guh sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Jehoash Maang"},"11":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama a siet gamtat a, Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawna zosie panin a kihem sih hi; ama in tuate a zui zawsop hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoash’ gamtatna a omlai teng, ama sep zosie le Judah kumpipa Amaziah a dona a thahatnate, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh Joash lumton a, ama’ kumpi topha tungah Jeroboam a to hi; Israel kumpite tawh Samaria ah Joash kivuiton hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in Elisha in a si nading natna a vei ciengin ama kungah Israel kumpi Joash hawsuhin a mai-ah kap a, “Ka pa, ka pa! Israel sakol leengte le a sakol tunga tuongte!” ci-in a kiko hi.","title":"Elisha’ Sina","ref":"2Kum 2:12"},"15":{"text":"Elisha in ama kungah, “Thal khat le thaltangte hing la vawi,” a ci hi; tuaci’n ama in thal khat le a tangte a la hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Israel kumpipa kungah, “Thalpi kuoi in,” a ci hi; tuale ama in a kuoi hi. Elisha in kumpipa’ khut tungah a khut a ngam hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Na tawlet nisuona lamah hong vawi,” a ci hi’ tuale ama in a hong hi. Elisha in, “Na thal kap in,” a ci hi’ tuale ama in a kap hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “ Topa’ guolzawna thaltang, Aram-te tunga guolzawna thaltang! Bangzieh ahei cile amate na tha sieng masangin Aphek ah Aram-te na do ding hi,” a ci hi;"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Thaltangte lakia in,” ci hi; tuale ama in a lakia hi. Ama in Israel kumpipa kungah, “Tuate tawh lei lah sat in,” a ci hi; ama in thumvei satin a khawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tungah Pasien’ mipa lungthah a, “Ngavei ahiei, guhvei ahiei khat na sat ding a kilawm ahi hi; tua hile amate na tha masangin Aram-te na satlia ding a, ahi vangin tu-in thumvei maimai na sat ding ahi ta bo hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Elisha si a, amate in ama a vui uhi. Tu-in Moab mihonte in khumi kum khal hun sungin tua gam a sim zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khat a kivui laitahin misuomte honkhat kimu a, Elisha’ hankhuh-ah siluong a pai uhi; tua mipa in Elisha’ gute a tham lien leh ama hingkia-in a keng tawh a ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in Aram kumpipa Hazael in Jehoahaz’ uh sung tungtawnin Israel a bawlsie hi.","title":"Aram Khuopite Israel in Lakia"},"23":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in amate khuotuo-in lainatna nei hi; Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tawh a thuciemna ziehin amate lamah kinga hi; ama in amate susie loin tu dongin ama’ mai panin amate a notmang sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Aram kumpipa Hazael a si ciengin a tapa Ben-hadad in ama’ za luo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa Jehoahaz’ tung panin gal sungah Hazael in a lahsa khuopite Hazael’ tapa Ben-hadad tung panin Jehoahaz’ tapa Jehoash in lakia hi. Jehoash in Ben-hadad thumvei zo a, ama in Israel khuopite ngakia hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz’ tapa Jehoash a kum nina kumin, Judah kumpi, Joash’ tapa Amaziah maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Amaziah in Judah Uh (2Khg 25:1–26:2)"},"2":{"text":"Ama maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmni le kuo sung maang hi.
