A nu’ min Jehoaddin hi a, Jerusalem-te ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa muna-ah a dihin ama gamta a, hinanle a pu David bang zo lo hi; ama in a pa Joash’ bawlsa zosie a bawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin munsangte a kihemkhie tuom sih hi; munsangte-ah mite kithoi-in biehnate a pie veve lai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’ khut sungah kumpi thuneina dettahin a nei behin a pa kumpipa a that a nasemte ama in that hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in a thupieh Moses thukham laibu sungah, “Tate’ ziehin pate kithat lo ding a, pate’ ziehin tate kithat lo ding hi; ahi vangin mi zosie amau’ mawna ziehin a si ding uhi,” ci-a a kigiel dung zui-in ama in mi thatte’ tate that lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"7":{"text":"Ama in Ci Kuom-ah Edom-te tul sawm thatin, Sela busimin a la hi; ama in a min dingin Jokthe-el phuo a, tuni dongin tua min kip peisuoh lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amaziah in Israel kumpi, Jehu’ tapa Jehoahaz, a tapa Kumpipa Jehoash kungah kamtaite sawl a, “Hing pei inlen khatlekhat kimaituo-in kitalsih vai,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpi Amaziah kungah kam vaihlahin, “Lebanon-a om thangling kung khat in Lebanon-a om taamtah kung khat kungah mi sawin, ‘’A zi dingin ka tapa tungah na tanu pie in,’ ci hi; ahi vangin ama gamsa khat a vasuoh ta a, tua thangling a tuoncil hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma in Edom-te na zo tahpi a, tua in na lungsim a liensah gawp hi. Na minthanna tawh lungkim lel inlen inn ah om khinkhian in; bang dinga nangma le Judah’ pua nadingin buoina bawl ding na hei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Amaziah in a thu ngai lo hi. Tuaci’n Israel kumpipa Jehoash a kuonto hi; Judah-a’ ahi Beth-shemesh gal kidona sungah ama le Judah Kumpipa Amaziah khatlekhat kimaituo-in a kisi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Israel in Judah zo hi; mi zosie a inn ciet vuah a taimang uhi."},"13":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Beth-shemesh ah Ahaziah’ tapa Joash, a tapa Judah kumpipa Amaziah man hi; ama in Jerusalem lam zuon a, Ephraim tunkot panin Innning Tunkot dong, Jerusalem kulpi tong zali sung satcim hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa’ inn sung goukholna sunga a om kham le ngun zosie le Topa’ biehinn sunga a kimu umlebeel zosie tomgamin, a mite zong a man hi; tua ciengin Samaria ah ama a peikia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoash nasep le a gamtatna a omlai teng, a vanglietna le Judah Kumpipa Amaziah tawh a kidona, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"16":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Jehoash lumton a, Israel kumpite tawh Samaria ah kivui hi; tua ciengin a tapa Jeroboam in ama’ za luo hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel kumpipa, Jehoahaz’ tapa Jehoash a si zaw ciengin Judah kumpipa, Joash’ tapa Amaziah kum sawm le nga sung hing lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Amaziah’ nasepna a omlai teng, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"19":{"text":"Amate in Jerusalem-ah ama a sawmdap vua, ama Lachish ah a taimang hi. Ahi vangin Lachish ah a nuadel ding mi sawlin tua tahah ama a that uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in sakol tawh ama a puo uhi; David’ khuopi Jerusalem ah a pu a pate tawh ama kivui hi."},"21":{"text":"Judah mi zosie in kum sawm le guh a pha Uzziah a la vua, a pa Amaziah’ za a luo dingin kumpi-in ama a bawl uhi."},"22":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Kumpi Amaziah a lupton zaw ciengin Elath lampha kia-in Judah ngasah kia hi."},"23":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Joash’ tapa Amaziah a kum sawm le ngana kumin, Israel kumpipa, Jehoash’ tapa Jeroboam Samaria ah maan ding kipan a, ama kum sawmli le khat sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Jeroboam Nina Maang"},"24":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi; Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate panin ama a kihem tuon sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in Gath-hepher pana kamsangpa Amittai’ tapa, ama’ nasem Jonah tungtawnin Topa Israel Pasien thugenna tawh kizui-in Israel gamgite, Lebo-hamath panin Arabah Tuipi dong ngakia hi.","ref":"Jhn 1:1"},"26":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Israel’ thuohna nasie mama hi, ci-in Topa in mu hi; sal hile, sal lo hile a suohta koima om lo a, Israel panpi ding koima om lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanle vannei leitungah Topa in Israel’ min phietmang ding thu genkha lo a, tuaci’n ama in Jehoash’ tapa Jeroboam khut tawh amate hunkhie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu-in Jeroboam’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a sepsa zosie, a vanglietna, a galsimna le Judah in a na nei ngai Damascus le Hamath khuopite Israel dinga a ngakiana, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"29":{"text":"A pu a pate ahi Israel kumpite tawh Jeroboam lumton hi; a tapa Zechariah in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpi Jeroboam a kum sawmni le sagina kumin Judah kumpipa Amaziah’ tapa Azariah maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Azariah in Judah Uh (2Khg 26:3-23)"},"2":{"text":"Ama a maan ding a kipatin kum sawm le guh pha a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga le ni sung maang hi. A nu’ min Jecoliah ahi a, Jerusalem-te ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A pa Amaziah’ bawl bang lienin Topa muna-ah a manin a gamta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin munsangte a kihemkhie tuon sih hi; munsangte tungah mite kithoi-in biehna pie lai veve uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in a si dongin phah natna tawh kumpipa a gawt ziehin inn tuomah a teng hi. Kumpipa’ tapa Jotham in kumpi inn sung thu zosie van a, tua gam mite uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Azariah’ gamtatna a omlai teng le a sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"7":{"text":"A a pu a pate tawh Azariah lumton hi; amate in David’ khuopi sunga a pu a pate tawh ama a vui uhi; a tapa Jotham in ama’ za luo hi.","ref":"Isa 6:1"},"8":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Azariah a kum sawmthum le gietna kumin Samaria ah Jeroboam’ tapa Zechariah hla guh sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Zechariah Maang"},"9":{"text":"A pu a pate na bawlsa bangin Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi. Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam mawnate panin ama a kikoicing sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Jabesh’ tapa Shallum in ama a sawmdap a, tuale mipite mai-ah ama satpua-in that hi, tuale ama tangin a maang hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in Zechariah’ sepna a omlai teng, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"12":{"text":"Tam pen Jehu’ kunga a na gen, “Khang lina dongin na tapate kumpi topha tungah to ding uhi,” a ci Topa’ thuciemna ahi hi. Tua bang ma-in a pieng hi.","ref":"2Kum 10:30"},"13":{"text":"Judah kumpi Uzziah a kum sawmthum le kuona kumin Jabesh’ tapa Shallum maan ding kipan a, ama Samaria ah hla khat sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Shallum Maang"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tirzih panin Samaria ah Gadi’ tapa Menahem tungto hi; ama in Jabesh’ tapa Shallum satlia-in that hi; ama tangin ama maang hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Shallum’ sepna a omlai teng le ama in a sepsa a mi sawmdapna, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"16":{"text":"Amate in khum hunin ama adingin a kotpite uh a hon lo ziehun Menahem in Tiphsah le a sunga om zosie le Tirzah panin a gam sung teng a bulu hi. Ama in gam sunga numei naupai zosie’ gil a kuikehpieh hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah kumpi Azariah a kum sawmthum le kum kuona kumin Gadi’ tapa Menahem in Israel tungah maan ding kipan a, Samaria ah kum sawm sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Menahem Maang"},"18":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi; a hin sung tungtawnin Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate panin ama kikoicing lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Khum gam a sim dingin Assyria kumpi Pul kuonto hi; a kumpi aana a tuhkip thei nadinga a panpi dingin Menahem in Pul tungah ngun talent tulkhat a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Menahem in Assyria kumpipa tunga a pieh dingin mihau zosie, mi khat ciengin ngun shekel sawmnga ta, Israel tung panin a dong hi. Tuaci’n Assyria kumpipa kilekia-in gam sungah gieh nawn lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in Menahem’ sepna a omlai teng le a septe zosie, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"22":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Menahem lumton a, a tapa Pekahiah in ama’ za luo hi."},"23":{"text":"Judah kumpi Azariah a kum sawmngana kumin Menahem’ tapa Pekahiah in Samaria panin Israel tungah maan ding kipan hi. Ama kum ni sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Pekahiah Maang"},"24":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi; Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate panin ama kikoicing lo hi."},"25":{"text":"A galkap bupa Remaliah’ tapa Pekah in Gilead-te mihing sawmnga tawh ama sawmdap a, Samaria-a kumpipa’ inn kulpi sungah ama le Argob le Arieh-te tawh suomtha hi; tuale ama thatin ama tangin maang hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in Pekahiah’ nasepna a omlai teng le a sep zosie, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"27":{"text":"Judah kumpi Azariah a kum sawmnga le nina kumin Remaliah’ tapa Pekah in Samaria panin Israel tungah maan ding kipan a, ama kum sawmni sung maang hi.","title":"Israel ah Pekah Maang"},"28":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi; Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam’ mawnate panin ama kikoicing lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel kumpi Pekah hun sungin Assyria kumpi Tiglath-pileser kuonin Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, le Galilee, le Naphtali gam zosie a la hi; tuale Assyria ah salin a mite kai hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elah’ tapa Hoshea in Remaliah’ tapa Pekah sawmdapin ama busimin a that hi. Ama in Uzziah’ tapa Jotham a kum sawm nina kumin ama tangin maang hi."},"31":{"text":"Tu-in Pekah’ gamtatna a omlai teng le a sep zosie, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel kumpi Remaliah’ tapa kumpi Pekah a kum nina kumin Judah kumpi Uzziah’ tapa Jotham in uh ding kipan hi.","title":"Judah ah Jotham Maang (2Khg 27:1-9)"},"33":{"text":"Ama in uh ding a kipatin kum sawm le nga pha a, kum sawm le guh sung Jerusalem ah uh hi. A nu’ min Jerusha ahi a, Zadok’ tanu ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"A pa Uzziah’ gamtat bang lienin Topa muna-ah ama a dihin a gamta hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanle munsangte a kihemkhie tuon sih hi; munsangte tungah mite kithoi-in biehna pie lai veve uhi. Ama in Topa’ biehinn kotkhah tungnung pen a bawl hi."},"36":{"text":"Tu-in Jotham’ nasepna a omlai teng le a sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"37":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Topa in Judah sim dingin Aram kumpipa Rezin le Remaliah’ tapa Pekah sawl ding kipan hi."},"38":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Jotham lumton a, David’ khuopi sungah kivui hi; a tapa Ahaz in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Remaliah’ tapa Pekah a kum sawm le sagina kumin Juda kumpi Jotham’ tapa Ahaz maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Ahaz in Judah Uh (2Khg 28:1-27)"},"2":{"text":"A kumpi sep kipatin Ahaz kum sawmni pha a, ama kum sawm le guh sung Jerusalem ah maang hi. A pu David’ gamtatsa bangin a Pasien Topa muna-ah a dihin gamta lo a,"},"3":{"text":"Israel kumpite’ lampi ma zuizaw hi. Topa in Israel mite mai-ah a na delgamsa ahi minamte na zah a huothuoi tawndante ama in zui-in a tapa nangawn kithoina-in mei tawh a hal hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:31"},"4":{"text":"Ama in muoltunga munsangte tung le sing hlim nei teng tungah kithoina bawlin biehnate pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerusalem sim dingin Aram kumpi Rezin le Israel kumpi Remaliah’ tapa Pekah kuonto hi; amate in Ahaz a kui-im vua, ahi vangin a zo sih uhi.","ref":"Isa 7:1"},"6":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Edom kumpipa in Edom adingin Elath lakia a, tuale Elath panin Judea-te a notmang hi; tuale tuni donga a tenna uh Elath ah Edom-te a pei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahaz in Assyria kumpi Tiglath-pileser kungah kamtaite sawl a, “Keima na tapa le na nasempa ka hi hi. Hing kuonto inlen, keima ei sim Aram kumpipa le Israel kumpipa’ khut sung panin ei hunkhie in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahaz in Topa’ inn sung le kumpipa’ goukholna sunga a kimu ngun le khamte la a, Assyria kumpipa kungah letsongin a hlah hi."},"9":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa in ama’ thugen a ngai hi; Damascus sim dingin Assyria kumpipa kuonto-in tua khuo la-in Kir-ah a mite galmatin a puo hi; tua ciengin ama in Rezin that hi."},"10":{"text":"Assyria kumpi Tiglath-pileser tawh kimu dingin Damascus-ah kumpi Ahaz a haw ciengin Damacus-a om maitam a mu hi. Kumpi Ahaz in siempu Uriah kungah maitam lim, a kibawl dan a neng a tawnga a kibahpi khat a hlah hi."},"11":{"text":"Siempu Uriah in maitam a bawl hi; Damascus panin Kumpi Ahaz in a hlah bang dan tawh kizui-in Kumpi Ahaz a tun masangin Damascus panin siempu Uriah in maitam na bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Damascus panin kumpipa a tun ciengin kumpipa in tua maitam a vel a, tua ciengin kumpipa in maitam lam nehin a tungah a kato hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a meihal biehna le an tawh biehna pie-in, ama in a dawn thei biehnate sung a, maitam tungah thunuom biehna sisan a the hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a maitam le Topa’ biehinn kikal panin Topa mai-a om sumngo maitam a ladawh a, tua pen leilu lama om ama’ maitam tungah a koi hi.","ref":"Pei 27:1-2; 2Khg 4:1"},"15":{"text":"Kumpi Ahaz in siempu Uriah thupie a, “Gam sung mi zosie’ meihal biehna, an tawh biehna le a dawn thei biehna utawh maitam thupi pen tungah zingmawng meihal biehna, nitah an tawh biehna, kumpipa’ meihal biehna le a an tawh biehnate halton in; tua ciengin maitam tungah meihal biehna sisan zosie le biehpiehna sisan zosie the in; ahi vangin sumngo maitam pen keima’ thudawhna ding hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Siempu Uriah in kumpi Ahaz’ thupieh zosie a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Ahaz in a ki-ngahna singte sattan a, tuale ama in tuate panin khutsilna kuong hemdawh hi; ama in a nei-a sumngo bawngtangte tung panin tui kuongpi hemdawh a, suongciel tungah koi hi.","ref":"1Kum 7:23-39; 2Khg 4:2-6"},"18":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn panin ama in kumpi inn sunga sabbath ni-a kumpipa zah dinga kibawl tungkhu a nei lampi le kumpipa lutna lampi pulam a hemdawh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahaz nasep a omlai teng, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"20":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Ahaz lumton a, David’ khuopi sungah a pu a pate tawh kivui hi. A tapa Hezekiah in ama’ za luo hi.","ref":"Isa 14:28"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Ahaz’ a kum sawm le nina kumin Elah’ tapa Hoshea in Samaria panin Israel tungah maan ding a kipan a, ama kum kuo sung maang hi.","title":"Hoshea in Israel Uh"},"2":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat a, hinanle ama mai-a Israel kumpite bang lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama sim dingin Assyria kumpipa Shalmaneser kuonto hi; Hoshea pen a khut nei mi suohin ama sieh le kaih a pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Assyria kumpipa in Hoshea’ lebawlna mu hi; azieh pen ama in Egypt kumpi So kungah kamtaite sawlin kumsiela a pieh bangin sieh le kaihte a pie nawn sih hi. Tua ahi ziehin Assyria kumpipa in ama manin thong sungah a khum hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Assyria kumpipa in gam sung zosie simin Samaria dong ban hi; kum thum sung tua khuopi a kui-im hi.","title":"Assyria ah Israel Salin Kipuoh"},"6":{"text":"Hoshea a kum kuona kumin Assyria kumpipa in Samaria la hi; ama in Israel-te, Assyria ah a peipi hi. Ama in Halah gam sung, Habor gam, Gozan gun le Medes khuopite sungah amate a koi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tami thu a pienna pen Egypt kumpi Pharaoh’ khut nei Egypt gam panin amate a peipi Topa a Pasien uh tungah Israel mite a maw zieh uh ahi hi. Amate in pasien dangte a bie vua,"},"8":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite mai-a a delmang minamte’ ngaina le Israel kumpite in a na pat ngainate a zui zieh uh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel mite in a Topa a Pasien uh’ lang khatah a man lo thute a dapbawl uhi;"},"10":{"text":"amate in muolsang zosie le a na dawng sing hlim nei zosie-ah amate dingin songte le khuom siengthote a phut uhi.","ref":"1Kum 14:23"},"11":{"text":"Khum mun amate mai-a Topa in a na nawmang minamte’ bawl bangin amate in munsang zosie-ah biehnate a lui uhi. Amate in a hoi lo nate semin Topa lungthahsah uhi;"},"12":{"text":"Topa in amate kungah, “Note in tamte haw’ na na sem sih ding uhi,” a ci milimte’ na a sem uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongle Topa in kamsang zosie le thumu zosie tungtawnin Israel le Judah hilkhol a, “Na pu na pate uh ka thupiehsa thukhamte le ka nasem kamsangte tung tawna na kung vua thu kang puoh tawh kituohin na tatsietnate uh panin kihei-in ka thupiehnate le ka thukhamte zui un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a thu ngai loin, Topa a Pasien uh a um lo a pu a pate ma bangin a lungkhauh uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in ama’ thukhamte le a pu a pate tawh a bawlsa a thuciemna le amate tunga a pieh hilkholnate a thusim sih uhi. Amate in milim zuoute nuazui-in mizuou a suoh uhi; amate bangin gamta sih un ci-in Topa in a thupieh tawh kisai-in, amate in a kim a pam vua om minamte a zui uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in Topa a Pasien uh’ thupieh zosie nuolin amate dingin bawngno lim ni a kheng vua, khuom siengtho khat a bawl uhi; amate in vantunga na om zosie bie-in Baal’ na a sem uhi.","ref":"1Kum 12:28"},"17":{"text":"Amate in a tanute le a tapate kithoina-in mei ah a hal uhi; amate in aisanna le khutlam etnate a zang uhi; tuale Topa muna-ah amate siet gamtat ding kiphalin ama a lungthahsah uhi.","ref":"Thkna 18:10"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel tungah Topa lungthahin ama in ama’ muna panin amate a hemkhie hi; Judah minam khat beh ci simlo, koima dang om nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Judah in Topa a Pasien uh’ thupiehnate zui loin Israel in a na bawltawm ngainate a zuipi hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Israel’ suonlehlahte zosie a nuol hi; ama in amate dan pie a, ama kung panin a hawlkhiet masangin mi bulute’ khut sungah amate a pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in David innkuon panin Israel a khenkhiet zaw ciengin amate in Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam kumpi-in a koi uhi. Jeroboam in Topa a zuina panin Israel notmangin mawna lienpi a bawlsah hi."},"22":{"text":"Jeroboam in a na bawlsa mawna zosie Israel mite in a bawl uhi; a nasem kamsangte tungtawnin a genkholsa bangin a mu lona munah Topa in Israel a hepkhiet dongin tuate panin amate a kikoicing sih uhi. Tuaci’n tuni dongin a gam panun Assyria-ah salin Israel a om hi.","merge":"23"},"24":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa in Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, le Sepharvaim panin mite peipi-in Israel mite tangin Samaria khuopite-ah amate a koi hi; amate in Samaria gam luo-in a khuopite-ah amate a teng uhi.","title":"Assyria in Samaria ah Mi Tengsahkia"},"25":{"text":"Tua muna a ten cilun amate in Topa bie lo uhi. Tua ahi ziehin Topa in amate a that humpite amate lahah a sawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n Assyria kumpipa kungah, “Nangma in puohin Samaria khuopite-a na koi minamte in khum gamte pasien’ thukham a thei sih uhi; tua ahi ziehin ama in humpite a lah vuah a sawl hi. Amate in tua gamte pasien’ thukham a thei lo ziehun humpite in amate that hi,” ci’n kigen hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Assyria kumpipa in thu pie a, “Khum sungah tua gam pana nang peipi uh siempute lahah khat puoh un; khum munah ama pei-in tengsah unlen, a gam sung pasien’ thukhamte amate hilsah un,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Samaria pana a puoh uh siempute khat pei-in Bethel ah teng hi; ama in Topa bangci bieh ding ci thu amate kungah a hil hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin minam zosie in a pasien ciet uh a kibawl vua, minam zosie in amau’ tenna khuopi sungah Samaria mite’ bawlsa munsangte-a biehbuhnote sungah tuate a koi uhi;"},"30":{"text":"Babylon mite in Succoth-benoth pasien, Cuth mite in Nergal pasien, Hamath mite in Ashima pasien;"},"31":{"text":"Avva mite in Nibhaz le Tartak pasiente a bawl uhi; Sepharvaim-te in Sephavaim pasien-te ahi, Adrammelech le Anammelech biehna-in mei-ah a tate a haltum uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in Topa zong a bie vua, munsangte-a biehna siempu sem dingin a sung panun mi namkim se-in tuate in munsangte-a biehbuhnote-ah amate dingin biehpiehna a pie uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Topa a bie vua, a kipuohna gam mite’ tawndan zui-in a pasien-te uh’ na zong a semton uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in tuni dongin nidanga a zah uh amau’ ngainate a zomsuoh lai uhi. Amate in Topa bie loin Topa in Israel ci-in a minvaw Jacob tate tunga a thupiehsa thukhamte, ngaina kipte, zui ding ngainate, le a thupiehte a zui sih uhi.","ref":"Pien 32:28; 35:10"},"35":{"text":"Topa in amate tawh thuciemna khat bawl zo a, amate thupie in, “Note in pasien dangte bie loin, a mai vuah zong kun loin amau’ na zong na sem sih ding vua, amate kungah na kithoi sih ding uhi,","ref":"Pei 20:5; Thkna 5:9"},"36":{"text":"ahi vangin Egypt gam panin a lien mama vanglietna le a kizah a banhat tawh note ang peipi Topa na bie zaw ding uhi, a mai-ah noma ma kunin ama tungah na kithoi ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 6:13"},"37":{"text":"Ama in note dinga a giel thukhamte, ngaina kipte, zui ding ngainate le thupiehnate zui dingin na ngaisun zing ding uhi. Note in pasien dangte na bie sih ding vua,"},"38":{"text":"note tawh ka bawlsa thuciemna na mangngil sih ding uhi. Note in pasien dangte na bie sih ding vua,"},"39":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh na bie zaw ding uhi; ama in na gal zosie’ khut sung panin note ang hunkhie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanle amate in ngai loin nidanga a ngaina lui a zangsuoh uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuaci’n tam minamte in Topa a bie vua, ahi vangin amau’ khentawm ahi milimte’ na zong a sem uhi; tuni dongin a pu a pate uh gamtat bangin a tate ule a tute uh a gamta lai uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpi, Elah’ tapa Hoshea a kum thumna kumin Judah kumpi, Ahaz’ tapa Hezekiah maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Judah Uh (2Khg 29:1-2 ; 31:1)"},"2":{"text":"Ama a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmni le kuo sung maang hi. A nu’ min Abi ahi a, Zechariah’ tanu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A pu David bangin Topa muna-ah ama a manin gamta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in munsangte hemkhie-in biehna songte susie a, khuom siengtho a phuamang hi. Tua hun dongin Israel mite in tua tungah biehnate a pieh ziehun ama in Moses’ na bawlsa sumngo gulpi satguoi hi; tua pen Neshutan kici hi.","ref":"Gam 21:9"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Israel Pasien, Topa muong hi; tuaci’n ama’ nua-a Judah kumpite zosie lahah hile ama mai-ate lahah hile ama bang koima khat beh om lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in Topa a tudet hi; ama’ nua a zuina panin ama kihem ngai loin Topa in Moses kunga a gen thupiehnate a zui hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama tawh Topa a om hi; a peina popo-ah ama lawcing hi. Ama in Assyria kumpipa ledo a, ama’ na a sem sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in galvilna tausang panin kulpi nei khuopi dong, le Gaza le a gam sung cieng dongin Philistia-te a sim hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel kumpi, Elah’ tapa Hoshea a kum sagina kum ahi, kumpi Hezekiah a kum lina kumin Samaria sim dingin Assyria Kumpipa Shalmaneser kuonto-in imtawm a,"},"10":{"text":"kum thum a cin ciengin Samaria kila hi. Israel kumpi Hoshea’ kum kuona kum ahi, Hezekiah’ kum guhna kumin Samaria kila hi."},"11":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa in Assyria ah Israel-te puoh a, Halah gam sung, Habor gam, Gozan lui le Media khuopite sungah amate a tengsah hi,"},"12":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile amate in Topa a Pasien uh’ thu mang loin, a thuciemna ahi Topa’ nasem Moses’ thupieh zosie palsat uhi; amate in thu ngai loin, thu zong a mang sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah a kum sawm le lina kumin kulpi a nei Judah khuopite zosie a sim dingin Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib kuonto-in tua khuo teng a la hi.","title":"Sennacherib In Judah Sim (Isa 36:1-22 ; 2Khg 32:1-19)"},"14":{"text":"Judah kumpi Hezekiah in Lachish-a Assyria kumpi kungah mi sawl a, “Ka gamta khiel ta hi; ka kung panin nuakia ta’n; nei nget popo kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi. Assyria kumpipa in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kungah ngun talent zathum le kham talent sawmthum ngen hi."},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah in Topa’ biehinn sung le kumpipa’ goukholna-a om ngun zosie ama a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hunin Hezekiah in Topa’ biehinn kotte tung pan le Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in innkhuom tunga a zut khamte khawhin Assyria kumpipa tungah tua teng a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa in Tartan-te, Rabsaris mite le Rabshakeh-te, galkap hon tampi tawh Lachish panin Jerusalem-a Kumpi Hezekiah kungah a sawl hi. Amate kuonto-in Jerusalem a tung uhi. Amate a tun ciengun amate pei-in Puonsawppa’ Lo zotna lampi-a om buol tungnung tuilahna gei-ah a ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa a hlat ciengun amate kungah kumpi inn uhpa Hilkiah’ tapa Eliakim, thuvanpi pa Shebna le thuciemte Asaph’ tapa Joah-te a pei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Rabshakeh in amate kungah, “Hezekiah kungah gen un: Kumpi thupi, Assyria kumpipa in tam bangin gen hi: Tam banga na kimuonna uh bang pen suong na hi uh ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Note in thu kigen maimai haw po galdo nadinga galsiemna le thahatna-in ngaisun na hi uh amah? Kei nei ledo nadingun a koi pen suong na hi uh ahei?"},"21":{"text":"Tu-in note in a tunga a kingam poma’ khut a sun ding pumpeng kikuoitan kung khat tawh a kibang lel Egypt na suong uhi. Ama a suong mi zosie tungah Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh pen tua bang lel ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in keima kungah, ‘ Topa ka Pasien ka suong uhi,’ na ci uleh Hezekiah in a munsangte le a maitamte hepkhiet piehin Judah le Jerusalem kungah, “Jerusalem-a tami maitam mai-ah na bie ding uhi,” a ci pa pen ama hi lo amah?"},"23":{"text":"Tu-in hing pei un, ka pupa ahi Assyria kumpipa tawh kikhapna khat bawl un. No lam panin a tunga tuong ding mi na nga zo ding uleh sakol tulni kang pie ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Egypt-te’ leengte le sakol tungtuongte muong na hi uleh ka pu’ nasemte lahah a neupen galkap bu khat zong bangci nan zo ding na hi uh ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Topa tawh loin tam mun simin a susie dinga ang kuonto ka hi amah? Topa in keima kungah, “Tami gam sim dingin kuonto inlen susie in,” ei ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hilkiah’ tapa Eliakim, Shebnah, le Joah in Rabshakeh kungah, “Kang thum uhi, kote in Aram ham thei ka hi ziehun na nasemte Aram hamin ei hopi in. Kulpi tunga mite zahin Jew hamin ei hopi sin,” a ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin Rabshakeh in a kung vuah, “Ka pupa in na pupa uh kung le no kung beha tami thugen dingin ei sawl a, amau’ eh ma ne-in amau’ zun ma a dawn, note tawh siton dinga kul tunga omte kungah zong ei sawl tuom sih amah?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rabshakeh dingto-in a Jew hamin a gingin kiko a, “Kumpi lien, Assyria kumpipa’ thu za un!"},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Hezekiah kisolsah sih un, azieh pen ama in ka khut sung panin note ang hunkhie zo sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in eite ei hunkhie tahtah ding a, Assyria kumpipa’ khut sungah tami khuopi kipie lo ding hi, ci-a Hezekiah’ ang genna tawh Topa suong luo sih un,’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Hezekiah’ thu ngai sih un. Bangzieh ahei cile Assyria kumpipa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Keima kungah hing pei-in keima tawh noma’ leitang tawh kibang mun le gam, an le lengga pienna, moh le lengga um opna, olive thau le khuoizu pienna gamah si loin na hin zawh thei nading uh gamah kang tut masangin a koima po in noma’ lengga ciet kinehin noma’ theiga ciet ne a, noma’ tuinah ciet pan tui na kidawn ding uhi. Ama in na kung vuah, “ Topa in note ang hunkhie ding hi,” ci-in Hezekiah in ang lekai ciengin a thu na mang sih un.","merge":"32"},"33":{"text":"Minamte’ pasien khatpo in Assyria kumpipa’ khut sung panin a gam hunkhie zo ngai amah?"},"34":{"text":"Hamath le Arpad’ pasien-te heita uh ahei? Shepharvaim, Hena, le Ivvah’ pasien-te lah? Amate in ka khut sung panin Samaria a hunkhie zo ngel vuoi mah?"},"35":{"text":"Topa in ka khut sung panin Jerusalem a hutkhiet nadingin gam zosie-a pasien-te lahah a koi pen in ka khut sung panin a gam uh hunkhie zo ngai ahei?’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in, “Koima in dawng sih un,” ci-in thu a pieh ziehin mite sip dide-in kam khat beh a dawngkia sih uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi inn uhpa, Hilkiah’ tapa Eliakim, thuvanpi pa Shebnah, le thuciemte pa Asaph’ tapa Joah-te a puon uh ehkehsa-in Hezekiah kungah a pei vua, Rabshakeh’ thu gen teng ama kungah a gen uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in tam thu a zah ciengin a puonte ehmalin la-ip puon sil a, Topa’ biehinn sungah ama a pei hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Isaiah Thukuppi (Isa 37:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kumpi innsung uhpa Eliakim, thuvanpi pa Shebna, le khangham siempute la-ip puon silsahin Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isaiah kungah a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Hezekiah in tam bangin gen hi: Tuni pen lungkham ni, ei kiphawsiet ni, mindai ni ahi hi; nausente a suo hun tung a, suo zawh nading tha a nei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"A pupa ahi Assyria kumpipa in a hing zing Pasien simmaw dinga a sawl Rabshakeh’ thugen zosie Topa na Pasien in za-in, Topa na Pasien in a zahsa thute niel zo ta kha ding hi; tua ahi ziehin a omlai teng adingin thu ngetpieh in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah’ nasemte Isaiah kung a tun ciengun"},"6":{"text":"Isaiah in amate kungah, “Na pupa uh kungah tam bangin gen un. Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Assyria kumpipa’ nasemte in keima ei gensietna, na zahsa uh thute ziehin zau sih un."},"7":{"text":"Ama in kam baleng khat za-in a gamah a kilekia nadingin ama sungah hlagau khat ka koi ding hi; keima in ama’ gam ma-ah namsau tawh ka sisah ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in Lachish nuasie zo lam a zah ziehin Rabshakeh kilekia a, Assyria kumpipa in Libnah a simlam a mu hi.","title":"Sennacherib’ Galgihna (Isa 37:8-13)"},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa in Ethiopia Kumpi Tirhakah tungtang thu a zah ciengin, “En in, nang ang sim dingin ama kuon zo hi,” a ci ciengin ama in Hezekiah kungah kamtaite sawlkia a,"},"10":{"text":"“Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kungah tam bangin na gen ding uhi: Assyria kumpipa khut sungah Jerusalem kipie lo ding hi, ci-a ang kamciem na muon na suon uh ahi na Pasien un kisolsah sih un."},"11":{"text":"En in, Assyria kumpite in gam zosie tunga a bawlnasa, tuate a suhsietna dan nangma in na zahsa ahi hi. Nangma ang kihunkhie zo diei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate in a na suhsietsa minamte, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, le Telassar gama Eden mite, tua minamte’ pasien-te in amate a hunkhie zo ta uh amah ?"},"13":{"text":"Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim khuopi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa, ahi sihle Ivvah kumpipa hei sunga om uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah in kamsangte tung panin laih kihlah nga-in a sim hi; tua ciengin Topa’ biehinnah Hezekiah kato-in Topa mai-ah tua laihlah a pha hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Thungetna (Isa 37:14-35)"},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah in Topa mai-ah thu ngen a, “Cherub-te tunga a to Topa Israel Pasien aw, leitung kumpi gam zosie sung panin nangma, nangma beh Pasien na hi hi; nangma in leitung le vantung na bawlsa ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, na bil daw inlen, ka thugen ei za in. Topa aw, na mit hah inlen ei en in; Sennacherib in hingzing Pasien a zako nadinga ang hlah a thugente za in."},"17":{"text":"A tahtahin, Topa aw, Assyria kumpite in minamte le a gam uh susie-in"},"18":{"text":"meikhuh sungah a pasien-te uh a paipieh uhi. Tuate pasien hi loin mihing khut tawh a kibawl singlesuong ahi bo ziehin amate kisusie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in Topa kohaw’ Pasien aw, leitung kumpi gam zosie in nang, nang beh Pasien na hi lamtah a thei nadingun ama’ khut sung panin kote ei hunkhie in, kang thum hi, Topa aw,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Hezekiah kungah mi sawl a, “Israel Pasien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib tungtang ka kunga na thungetna keima in ka za zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama tawh kisai-in Topa’ gensa thu tam bang ahi hi: ‘Zion tanu, ngahnu siengtho in nang ang simmaw a, ang thupise sih hi. Jerusalem tanu in na nuasang-ah a lu ang peisan hi."},"22":{"text":"‘Koi pen zako a, koi pen gensie na hei? Koi na langpanna tawh na aw sangsahin, kilietsahna tawh mit leh vapial na hei? Israel’ a Siengtho Pa, a langpan na hi hi!"},"23":{"text":"Na kamtaite tungtawnin Topa na zako zo hi. “Ka sakol leeng tampite tawh muolsang dawnah ka kato zo a, Lebanon cieng dong ka tung zo hi; a taamtah sing sangpente le a taapi sing hoipente ka phuomang ta hi. A gamla pen khawlmun le a gammang pen lahah keima ka lut zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Keima in tuikhuhte to-in, gamdang tuite ka dawn a, ka ketaw tawh Egypt lui zosie ka gawtasah hi,” na ci hi."},"25":{"text":"‘Sawtlai panin ka na gelsa ahi lam za kha lo na mah? Tanglai peh panin lai-a ka gelsa ahi a, tu-a ka tunsah ding thute kulnei khuopite nin bulom bangin na guoicimsah nading,"},"26":{"text":"amau’ sunga tengte a hatna uh kiemin, amate zausi-in a amkham gawp vua; gamlah singno dawngte le lopa ngehte bang le innkhum tunga lopate bangin a op laitah, a khangliet masangun a gawta dinga ka gelsa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"“ ‘Ahi vangin keima in na dinna, le na tona, na pusuona le na sungtumna, ka tunga na lungthahna ka thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Kei tunga na thangpai zieh le na kiphatsahna ka bilkawmah ang lutna ziehin na nah-ah nahpheh hing bulin, na kamah kamkaih kang vaw ding a, nang kuonna lam ma-ah kang leheikia ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“ ‘Nang adingin tam khu melcina ahi ding hi: Tu kumin ama thu-a a pote na ne ding a, a kum nina ciengin a li pote na ne ding hi; a kum thumna ciengin khai tu-in na at ding a, lenggui suonin a ga na ne ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Judah innkuon sunga a suohta a omlai teng in singkung bangin a thuhna lamah zunghlakia-in a tung lamah ga neikia ding uhi;"},"31":{"text":"azieh pen Jerusalem panin a omlai teng a peikhie ding vua, Zion muol panin a hingsun honkhat a peikhie ding uhi. Topa’ deiluotna in tam thu a bawl ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in Assyria kumpipa tawh kisai-in tam bangin a gen hi: Tami khuo sungah ama lut loin thaltang khat zong kap lo ding hi. Khuopi mai-ah lum tawh pei loin khuopi simna dingin gal nanna leicien cieng lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama a peina lampi ma zui-in kilekia ding hi; tami khuopi sungah ama pei lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen keima zieh le ka nasempa David ziehin tam khuopi hunkhie-in ka cing ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua zanin Topa’ vantungmi kuon a, Assyria-te giephuolah galkap tul zakhat le tul sawmnga that hi; zingmawng khuo va ciengin tua teng zosie misi luonghawm na hi hi.","title":"Sennacherib’ Guollelna le A Sina (Isa 37:36-38 ; 2Khg 32:20-23)"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin inn lamah Assyria Kumpipa Sennacherib pei a, Nineveh ah a teng hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in a pasien Nisroch’ biehinn sunga a bieh laitahin, a tapate Adrammelech le Sharezer in namsau tawh ama thatin Ararat gamah a tai uhi. A tapa Esar-haddon in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Hezekiah a cina-in si dihtah hi. Amoz’ tapa Isaiah pei-in ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Na innkuon vai hawm in, azieh pen nang na si ding hi; na damkia nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Cinatna (2Khg 32:24-26 ; Isa 38:1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah kawm lam nga-in Topa kungah thu ngen hi:"},"3":{"text":"“ Topa aw, na mai-ah thuman le lungsim zosie tawh ka gamtatna, le na muna-ah a hoi ka sepzona thu tu-in ei phawh in, kang thum hi,” a ci hi. Hezekiah kaa citahin kap hi."},"4":{"text":"Isaiah in inntuol laita a kal masangin ama kungah Topa’ thu tung a,"},"5":{"text":"“Kilekia inlen ka mite makaipa Hezekiah kungah gen in. Na pu David’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in na thungetna ka za zo hi, na hlitui luongte ka mu zo hi; keima in kang damsah tahtah ding hi; a ni thum ni-in Topa’ biehinn ah na peito ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in na khan kum sawm le kum nga kang belap ding hi. Assyria kumpipa khut sung panin nangma le tami khuopi ka hunkhie ding hi; keima’ zieh le ka nasempa David ziehin tami khuopi ka hu ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaiah in, “Thei tawh a kibawl moh khat hing la un. Ama a damkia nadingin amate in tuate la-in a uilut nusah un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah in Isaiah kungah, “ Topa in keima ei damsah nading le a ni thum ni-a Topa’ biehinn-a ka peito nading a lim bang hi ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Isaiah in, “ Topa in a ciemsa thu a bawl nadingin tami khu nang adingin Topa kung pan lim hi ding hi: Nihlim kal sawm a matawn zo hi; kal sawm nuatawn kia ding amah?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah in dawng a, “Nihlim kal sawm a matawn ding pen a ngaina ahi hi; tua nihlim kal sawm nuatawnsah kia zaw in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa kungah Isaiah kiko a, ama in Ahaz’ ni-nai tungah a nitumsa a hlim kal sawm a lekaikia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hunin Babylon Kumpipa, Baladan’ tapa Merodach-baladan in laihlahte le letsong khat tawh Hezekiah kungah kamtaite a sawl hi, azieh pen ama in Hezekiah a ci na hi, ci-in a za hi.","title":"Babylon pan Palaite (Isa 39:1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Hezekiah in amate na muoh hi; ama in a goukholna inn zosie, ngun, kham, a gim namtuite, sathau mantamte, a galvante, a vankoina innte sunga om zosie amate a ensah hi; ama’ innsung hile ama’ gam sung zosie-a vante hile Hezekiah in amate a etsah lo khat beh a om sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Hezekiah kungah kamsang Isaiah haw-in ama kungah, “Tam mite in bang gen uh ahei? Hei pana hing pei-a nang kunga hing haw uh ahei?” a ci hi. Hezekiah in dawng a, “Amate pen Babylon gam, a gamlapi pana ang kipan ahi tabo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Amate in na inn sungah bang teng a mu vuoi?” a ci hi. Hezekiah in dawng a, “Ka inn sunga a om zosie a mu uhi; ka vankoina inn sungte panin amate ka etsah lo bangma a om sih hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaiah in Hezekiah kungah, “ Topa’ thugen ngai in:"},"17":{"text":"Na inn sunga van zosie, le tuni donga na pu na pate in a na kholsa van zosie Babylon ah a kipuohmang nading hun ang tung ding hi; bangma khat beh kihen lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:13; 2Khg 36:10"},"18":{"text":"Nangma sunga a pieng na tapa te pawlkhat kikaimang ding hi; amate in Babylon kumpi’ kumpi inn sunga nasem dingin numei uh dingin cilgesa-in a om ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:14-15; Dan 1:1-7"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah in Isaiah kungah, “Na gensa Topa’ thugen khu a hoi hi,” a ci hi. Azieh pen ama in, “Kei hun sungin kilemna le bihna a om nah leh hoi lel hi lo amah?” ci-in a ngaisun hi."},"20":{"text":"Hezekiah’ nasep a omlai teng, a vanglietna, le tuikhuh le tuilahna to-in khuopi sunga tui a tunsahna, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?","title":"Hezekiah’ Sina (2Khg 32:32-33)"},"21":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Hezekiah lumton a, a tapa Manasseh in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh a maan ding a kipatin kum sawm le ni pha hi; ama kum sawmnga le nga sung Jerusalem ah maang hi. A nu’ min Hephzibah ahi hi.","title":"Judah ah Manasseh Maang (2Khg 33:1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite mai-ah Topa in a na delmangsa a huothuoi minamte’ gamtatnate ama in zui-in, Topa’ muna-ah a sie-in a gamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a pa Hezekiah’ a na suhsietsa munsangte a lamphakia hi; Israel kumpipa Ahab’ bawlsa bangin ama in Baal adingin maitamte phutin khuom siengtho khat bawl a, vantung na zosie bie-in tuate’ na a sem hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem-ah ka min ka koi ding hi,” a cinasa Topa’ biehinn sungah ama in maitamte a lam hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:13"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ biehinn tuol ni gel tungah vantung nate zosie adingin maitamte a lam hi."},"6":{"text":"Meihal biehna-in ama in a tapa pie a, mailam thugenkholna le khutlam etnate semin, dawilawm neite le bum tawite tawh kigop hi. Ama in Topa muna-ah sietna tampi semin ama a lungtang thahsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in David le a tapa Solomon kungah, “Ama in Israel minam zosie sung panin ka teelkhiet tam biehinn sung le Jerusalem ah ka min ka koi zing ding hi, a cina biehinn sungah ama’ bawlsa Asherah milim a koi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in ka thupiehsa zosie dung zui le ka nasempa Moses in amate a thupiehsa thukham zosie tawh kizui-in limtaha a zui nah po uleh, keima in a pu a pate uh tunga ka piehsa gam panin Israel’ kengte ka vahvaihsah nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:3-5; 2Khg 7:12-18"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a ngai nuom sih uhi. Topa in Israel mite mai-a a thasa minamte’ gamtat sangin a sie zaw-in a gamtat nadingun Manasseh in amate a lelamin a pui hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in a nasem a kamsangte tungtawnin thu gen a,"},"11":{"text":"“Judah Kumpipa Manasseh in tami a huothuoite a bawl ziehin, ama mai-a Amor-te’ gamtat sangin a siezaw-in gamta a, a milimte tawh Judah zong a mawsah hi;"},"12":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Israel Pasien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Jerusalem le Judah tungah tua thu a za kha tapo’ bil a vut ding sietna ka tungsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mikhat in a khup a thalin kuong a nawt bangin keima in Jerusalem nawtin ka khuleh ding hi. Samaria adingin tena pikhau, le Ahab innkuon’ tena suongkhai ka hlung ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in ka gouluo ding ahi a omlai teng paidawhin a galte uh khutah ka pie ding hi; tuaci’n amate pen galte’ kivana ahi ding vua, a gal zosie in a tomgam van a suoh ding uhi,"},"15":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Egypt panin a pu a pate uh a peikhiet vua kipanin tuni dongin ka muna-ah a sie-in amate gamta-in kei ei lungthahsah uhi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua tham loin Topa muna-ah amate a siet gamtat nadingun ama in Judah mite a mawsah banah, Jerusalem mong khat panin mong khat dongah sisan a dim dongin Manasseh in maw nei lote’ sisan tampi luongsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Manasseh’ nasep a omlai teng, a silbawl zosie, le ama bawlsa a mawna, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"18":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Manasseh lumton a, tuale Uzza’ um sung, ama’ inn um sungah kivui hi. A tapa Amon in ama’ za luo hi."},"19":{"text":"Amon maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le ni pha a, kum ni sung Jerusalem ah maang hi. A nu’ min Meshullemeth hi a, Jotbah-te Haruz’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Amon in Judah Uh (2Khg 33:21-25)"},"20":{"text":"A pa Manasseh’ gamtat dan bangin Topa muna-ah ama a sie-in a gamta hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in a pa totsa lampi teng zui a, a pa in a na a seppieh milimte’ na ma semin tuate a bie hi,"},"22":{"text":"ama in a pu a pate’ Pasien ahi Topa nuasie a, Topa’ lampi zui lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Amon’ nasemte in ama a sawmdap vua, ama inn sungah kumpipa a that uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin gam mite in Kumpi Amon a sawmdap mi zosie thatin ama munah kumpi-in a tapa Josiah a koi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Amon’ bawlsa a gamtatna a omlaite Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"26":{"text":"Uzza’ um sunga ama’ hanah ama kivui hi; tua ciengin a tapa Josiah in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah maan ding a kipatin kum giet pha hi; kum sawmthum le khat sung Jerusalem ah ama maang hi. Anu’ min Jedidah ahi a, Bozkath-te Adaiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah ah Josiah Maang (2Khg 34:1-2 , 8-33)","ref":"Jer 3:6"},"2":{"text":"Topa muna-ah a manin gamta a, a pa David’ lampi zosie zui hi; zietlamah hile veilamah hile ama piel lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi Josiah a kum sawm le gietna kumin, kumpipa in Topa’ biehinn ah a thuvanpi pa Meshullam’ tapa Azaliah, a tapa Shaphan sawl a,","title":"Hilkiah in Thukham Laibu Mu (2Khg 34:8-28)"},"4":{"text":"“Siempu lien pa Hilkiah kungah peito inlen, kotcingte in mite kung pana a donsa uh Topa’ biehinn sunga kipeipi sum buppi a phaza ama simsah in;"},"5":{"text":"tua sumte, Topa’ biehinn a vaan nasemte’ khut sungah piesah in. Topa’ biehinn sunga innphawte tungah tua sum amate piesah in."},"6":{"text":"Tuate pen khutsiemte, innlamte, leilesuong innlam siemte ahi uhi; tuate pen biehinn puo nadinga zah ding sing lei nading le suong taw nading ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle thumanin a gamtat ziehun amate tung panin a khut sung vua ki-ap sum zahna sazien kingen lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 12:15"},"8":{"text":"Siempu lien pa Hilkiah in thuvanpi pa Shaphan kungah, “ Topa’ biehinn sungah thukham laibu ka mu hi,” a ci hi. Hilkiah in Shaphan tungah tua laibu a pieh ciengin ama in a sim hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa kungah thuvanpi pa Shaphan pei-in thu zasah a, “Na nasemte in biehinn sunga om sumte Topa’ biehinn uhte khut sungah a pie zo ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Thuvanpi pa Shaphan in kumpipa thu zasah a, “Siempu Hilkiah in laibu khat ei pie zo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Shaphan in kumpipa mai-ah tua laibu a gingin a sim hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in thukham laibu sunga thu kigente a zah ciengin a puonte a ehmal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in siempu Hilkiah, Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, Micaiah’ tapa Achbor, thuvanpi pa Shaphan, le kumpipa’ nasem Asaiah thu pie a,"},"13":{"text":"“Pei unlen, tami laibu sunga a kimu thute tawh kisai-in kei ading, mite ading, le Judah zosie adingin Topa kungah va dong ta un, bangzieh ahei cile i pu i pate in tami laibu sunga thute, eite tawh kisai-a a kigiel zosie tawh kizui-in a sep lo ziehun, eite tungah a kikuontaw Topa’ thangpaina lien hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Harhas’ tapa Tikvah, a tapa Shallum, puon kempa’ zi kamsangnu Huldah kungah siempu Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, le Asaiah-te a pei uhi; amate in ama’ tenna Jerusalem-a Veng Nina-ah thu a dong uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah pholah a, “Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Keima kunga ang sawl mipa kungah gen un."},"16":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in tam mun le a sunga teng zosie tungah Judah kumpipa in laibu sunga a sim gimna zosie ka tungsah tahtah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in kei ei nuasie-in pasien dangte tungah biehna a pie vua, a khut utawh a silbawl zosie un kei ei lungthahsah ahi ziehin tam munah ka lungthahna so-in a veng nawn sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa kunga thu dong dinga note ang sawl Judah kumpipa kungah tam bangin na gen ding uhi. Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Na zahsa thute tawh kisai-in,"},"19":{"text":"tami mun le a sunga teng mite tungah gamkhing le samsiet ahi nading uh ka thugen na zah ciengin na lungsim kisia-in Topa mai-ah nang mama neilutin, na puonte ehmalin ka mai-a na kaa ziehin keima in na thugen ka za ta hi, Topa in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na pu na pate utawh kang gawmton ding a, lungmuongtahin na han vuah kang kaikhawm ding hi; tami muna kang tunsah ding gimna zosie na mu kha sih ding uhi,” a ci hi. Amate in kumpipa kungah tua thu a puohkia uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Judah le Jerusalem upa zosie ama kunga kikhawm dingin thu a pie hi.","title":"Josiah’ Puophatna (2Khg 34:29-33)"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn-ah kumpipa peito a, ama tawh Judah mi zosie, Jerusalem-a teng zosie, siempute, kamsangte, le mi zosie, a neu a lien tawh a pei uhi; ama in Topa’ biehinn sunga a kimu thuciemna laibu sunga kigiel thu zosie amau’ zahin a sim hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuompi gei-ah kumpipa ding a, tam laibu sunga kigiel thuciemna kammalte a sep nading, a lungtang le a hinna zosie tawh Topa nua a zui nading, a thupiehnate, a thupiehte, le a thukhamte a zui nadingin ama in Topa mai-ah thuciemna khat a bawl hi. Tua thuciemna sungah mi zosie a kihal uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in siempu lien pa Hilkiah, a nina siempute, le kot cingte in Topa’ biehinn sung panin Baal le Asherah dinga kibawl vanzah zosie, le vantung nate zosie bieh nadinga a kibawl zosie a peipi nadingun thu a pie hi; ama in Jerusalem pulam Kidron lolai-ah tuate halin Bethel ah a vutvamte a puo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Judah khuopite le Jerusalem kimvela munsangte tungah biehna pie dinga kisesa milim siempute notmang a, Baal tung, ni tung, hlapi tung, aasi honpite tung, le vantung na zosie tunga siemthoi mite zong a notmang hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sung panin ama in Asherah milim la-in Jerusalem pulam Kidron Lui-ah puo-in hal a, gawtvui-in mi nautangte’ han tungah a vuite the hi.","ref":"2Kum 21:3; 2Khg 33:3"},"7":{"text":"Ama in Asherah dinga numeite puon gatna mun Topa’ biehinn sunga pasal pahtatte’ inn a phelkhepieh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Judah khuopite panin siempu zosie peipi a, Geba panin Beer-sheba dongin siempute in siemthoina-a a zah uh ahi munsangte a susie hi; ama in khuopi tunkot veilam, khuopi uhpa Joshua’ tunkot lutna muna om munsangte a phelmang hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jerusalem Topa’ maitam ah munsanga sem siempute a peito sih vua, hizongle a sanggamte lah vuah tol saw lo anlum a ne uhi."},"10":{"text":"Molech tungah a tanu hile, a tapa hile kithoina-in koima in a haltum thei lo nadingin Hinnom Kuom sunga om Topheth milim a buasah uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:21; Jer 7:31; 19:1-6; 32:35"},"11":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ biehinn lutna, numeite a uh cilgesa pasal Nathan-melech’ innkhan gei-a inntuolah Judah kumpite in ni tunga a ap uh sakolte a hemmang hi; tua ciengin ama in mei tawh ni sakol leengte a hal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua panin ama in Judah kumpite in a na bawlsa, Ahaz’ innkhan tungnung khumzanga om maitamte le Topa’ biehinn tuol nite sunga Manasseh in a na bawlsa maitamte pheldawhin satguoi a, a nengtawng teng Kidron Lui-ah pai hi.","ref":"2Kum 21:5; 2Khg 33:5"},"13":{"text":"Solomon in Sidon-te’ kidahhuoina ahi Astarte pasien-nu ading, le Moab-te’ kidahhuoina ahi Chemosh pasien ading , Ammon-te’ kidahhuoina ahi Milcom pasien adinga a lam, Jerusalem nisuona lam, Sietna Muol leitaw lama munsangte a susie hi.","ref":"1Kum 11:7"},"14":{"text":"Ama in biehna songte satkehin, khuom siengthote phuamang a, mihing gu in tua mun teng a tuomsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua tham loin ama in Israel a mawsah Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam in Bethel-a a na phusa munsang tunga maitam tawh a phelmang a, munsang haltumin a gawtvui hi; ama in khuom siengtho zong a haltum hi.","ref":"1Kum 12:33"},"16":{"text":"Josiah a kihei leh ama in muol tunga om hante mu hi; tuale ama in mi sawlin hante sung panin gute lasah a, Pasien’ mipa in a tangko Topa’ kammal dung zui-in ama in maitam tungah tuate halin a buasah hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:2"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Tua sunga ka mu phawna muolsuong bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Khuo mite in ama kungah, “Bethel-a maitam tungah na bawlsa tam thute a genkhol, Judah pana ang pei Pasien’ mipa’ han ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:30-32"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Ama khawlsah khinkhian un; koima in ama’ gute khin sih un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in Samaria pana a pei kamsangpa’ gu le ama’ gute a khuci omsah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tham loin Josiah in Israel kumpite’ na bawlsa, Topa a lungthahsahna uh ahi Samaria khuopite sunga munsang biehbuhnote zosie a hemmang hi; ama in Bethel-a a na bawlsa bang lienin amate tungah a bawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in maitam tungah tua sunga om munsanga sem siempu zosie thatin amate tungah mihing gute a hal hi. Tua ciengin Jerusalem ah ama kilekia hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa in mi zosie thu pie a, “Tam thuciemna laibu sunga a kigiel bangin Topa na Pasien uh kungah peisan pawi bawl un,” a ci hi.","title":"Peisan Pawi Kibawl (2Khg 35:1-19)"},"22":{"text":"Israel tunga thu a khen thukhente’ huna kipanin hitale Israel kumpite ahi sihle Judah kumpite’ hun sung zosie-ah hitale tam bang peisan pawi kibawl ngai lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Kumpi Josiah’ uh kum sawm le gietna kumin Jerusalem-a Topa kungah tami peisan pawi kibawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua tham loin Topa’ biehinn sunga siempu Hilkiah in a mu laibu sunga kigiel thukham kammalte a kipsah thei nadingin Judah gam le Jerusalem-a om dawilawm neite, ai tawite, teraphim-te , inn dawite, le a kidahhuoi zosie a paimang hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama’ mai-a Moses’ thukham dung zui-in a lungtang zosie, a hinna zosie, le a hatna zosie tawh Topa’ lamah a kihei ama tawh a kibang kumpi om lo a, ama’ nua-ah ama tawh a kibang kumpi khat beh khang nawn lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Manasseh in ama a lungthahsahna zosie hangin Judah tungah a sin so-in a gim nei mama a lungthahna lienpi panin Topa kihei nai lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka muna panin Israel ka hepdawh bangin Judah zong ka hemdawh ding hi; ka teelsa tami khuopi Jerusalem le, ‘Khum sungah ka min a om ding hi,’ ka cina biehinn ka nuol ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu-in Josiah’ gamtatna a omlaite, le a sep zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?","title":"Gal Sungah Josiah Si (2Khg 35:20–36:1)"},"29":{"text":"Ama’ hun sungin Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh Neco, Euphrates gun-a Assyria kumpipa kunga haw dingin a kuonto hi. Ama tawh kimu dingin kumpi Josiah pei hi; ahi vangin Pharaoh Neco in Megiddo ah Josiah a mu ciengin a that hi."},"30":{"text":"A nasemte in Megiddo panin Jerusalem ah ama’ luong puo-in ama’ hanah a vui uhi. Khum gam mite in Josiah’ tapa Jehoahaz la-in sathau a nu vua, a pa munah kumpi-in ama a koi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Jehoahaz maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le thum pha hi; hla thum sung ama Jerusalem ah maang hi. A nu’ min Hamutal ahi a, Libnah-te Jeremiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Jehoahaz’ Maanna le A Saltanna (2Khg 36:1-4)"},"32":{"text":"A pu a pate gamtatnasa bang lienin Topa’ muna-ah ama a siet gamtat hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in Jerusalem a uh thei lo nadingin Pharaoh Neco in Hamath gam sung Riblah khuo-ah ama khum a, gam sungah ngun talent zakhat le kham talent khat siehin kai hi."},"34":{"text":"Pharaoh Neco in a pa Josiah munah Josiah’ tapa Eliakim kumpi-in koi a, tuale ama’ min Jehoiakim-in a khel hi. Ahi vangin ama in Jehoahaz a peipi hi; Egypt ah ama tungin khum sungah a si hi.","ref":"Jer 22:11-12"},"35":{"text":"Jehoiakim in Pharaoh tungah ngun le kham a pie a, ahi vangin Pharaoh’ ngetza sum a pieh zawh nadingin a gam sungah phiengsieh a dong hi. Pharaoh Neco tunga a pieh dingin amau’ neina tawh kizui-in ama in gam sung mite kung panin ngun le kham a dong hi."},"36":{"text":"Jehoiakim maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha hi; Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat sung maang hi. A nu’ min Zebidah ahi a, Rumah-te Pedaiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah ah Jehoiakim Maang (2Khg 36:5-8)","ref":"Jer 22:18-19; 26:1-6; 35:1-19"},"37":{"text":"A pu a pate’ gamtat bang lienin Topa’ muna-ah ama a siet gamtat hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama’ hun sungin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kuonto hi; Jehoiakim kum thum sung ama’ sila a suoh hi; tua ciengin Jehoiakim kiphinin ama a ledo hi.","title":"Galte in Judah Tuoncil","ref":"Jer 25:1-38; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Topa in ama a langpang dingin Chaldea mihonte, Aram mihonte, Moab mihonte, le Ammon mihonte a sawl hi. Ama’ nasem kamsangte tungtawnin ama’ gen Topa’ kammal dung zui-in ama in Judah a langpang ding le a susie dingin amate a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"A tahtahin Manasseh’ mawnate, a bawlsa mawnate zosie ziehin ama’ muna panin amate a khin thei nadingin Topa’ thupiehna tawh Judah tunga tam thute a tung ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale mawna nei lo mite’ sisan a luonsahnate zosie zieh zong ahi hi. Ama in mawna nei lo mite’ sisan tawh Jerusalem a kidimsah ziehin Topa in ama’ mawna maisah nuom lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoiakim’ sepna a omlai teng, le a bawl zosie, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Sutna Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh ama a lumton hi; tua ciengin a tapa Jehoiachin in ama’ za luo hi."},"7":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in Egypt kumpipa-a’ ahi Egypt Lui panin Euphrates Gun dongin a unpi-in lahpieh zo ta ahi ziehin ama’ gam panin Egypt kumpipa a kuonkia nawn sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiachin maan ding a kipatin kum sawm le giet pha hi; ama hla thum sung Jerusalem ah maang hi. A nu’ min Nehushta ahi a, Jerusalem-te Elnathan’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Jehoiachin’ Maanna le Saltanna (2Khg 36:9-10)"},"9":{"text":"A pu a pate gamtat bang lienin Topa muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Jerusalem-ah Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ nasemte kuonto-in tua khuopi a kui-im uhi."},"11":{"text":"A nasemte in a kui-im laitahin tua khuopi-ah Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar a tung hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoiachin in Babylon kumpipa tungah ama-a kipan a nu, a uliente, le kumpi inn sunga uliente a kipie uhi. Ama in a uh a kum gietna kumin Babylon kumpipa in ama salin a man hi.","ref":"Jer 22:24-30; 24:1-10; 29:1-2"},"13":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ inn sunga gou zosie le kumpipa’ inn sunga goute puomang hi; tamte zosie Topa in a na genkholsa ahi ma bangin ama in Babylon kumpipa Solomon in a na bawlsa Topa’ biehinn sunga a om kham vanzah zosie a tawguoi sieng hi.","title":"Jerusalem Kilahna"},"14":{"text":"Ama in Jerusalem mi zosie, ulien zosie, galhang zosie, sala kiman mi tul sawm, khutsiem zosie le siakheng zosie, a gama mi zawng pente ci sim lo, koima hen nei loin a peipi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Babylon ah Jehoiachin peipi hi; ama in Jerusalem panin Babylon ah kumpipa’ nu, kumpipa’ zite, a uliente, le gam upate galmatin peipi hi.","ref":"Ezk 17:12"},"16":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in galsim thei ding galhang mite zosie, le mi thahat zosie a unpi-in tul sagi, le khutsiemte le siakhengte tulkhat, galmatin Babylon ah a peipi hi."},"17":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in ama tanga kumpi-in Jehoachin’ gangpa Mattaniah koi a, ama’ min Zedekiah-in a khelpieh hi.","ref":"Jer 37:1; Ezk 17:13"},"18":{"text":"Zedekiah maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le khat pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat sung maang hi. A nu’ min Hamutal ahi a, Libnah-te Jeremiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah ah Zedekiah Maang (2Khg 36:11-14 ; Jer 52:1-3a)","ref":"Jer 27:1-22; 28:1-17"},"19":{"text":"Jehoiakim’ gamtat bang lienin Topa’ muna-ah ama a siet gamtat hi."},"20":{"text":"A tahtahin, Jerusalem le Judah in Topa a lungthahsah ziehun ama kung panin amate a notmang hi. Zedekiah in Babylon kumpipa a ledo hi.","ref":"Ezk 17:15"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in a uh zaw a kum kuona, a hla sawmna, a ni sawm ni-in Jerusalem sim dingin Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar a galkap zosie tawh kuonin a kui-im hi; amate in a kimvelah tua khuo kui-im nading panmun a bawl uhi.","ref":"Jer 21:1-10; 34:1-5; Ezk 24:2"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpi Zedekiah a kum sawm le khatna kum dongin tua khuopi kikui-im hi."},"3":{"text":"A hla lina, a ni kuo ni-in tua khuopi sungah kielpi nasie ahi ziehin tua gam mite neh ding an om nawn lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuopi ki-imna kulbang mun khat a phetvang vua, khuopi kimvelah Chaldea-te a om vangun, kumpipa’ um gei-a kulbang gel kikalah zan lai-in a galkapte tawh kumpipa tai a, Arabah lam manaw-in a pei uhi.","ref":"Ezk 33:21"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Chaldea galkapte in kumpipa delin Jericho zanglei-ah a pha uhi; a galkap zosie kithethangin ama a nuasie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa manin ama tunga thukhen, Riblah-a Babylon kumpipa kungah a peipi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Zedekiah’ muna-ah a tapa thatin tua ciengin Zedekiah’ mit a kheipieh uhi; amate in ama kol bulin Babylon ah a peipi uhi.","ref":"Ezk 12:13"},"8":{"text":"A hla ngana, a ni sagi ni-in, Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar a kum sawm le kuo cin kumin, Jerusalem ah Babylon kumpipa’ nasem, a cingte a uh galkap bupa Nebuzaradan a tung hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ biehinn, kumpipa’ inn, le Jerusalem khuo sunga inn zosie hal hi; ama in inn thupi zosie haltum hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:8"},"10":{"text":"A cingte a uh galkap bupa tawh a omton Chaldea galkap zosie in Jerusalem kimvela om kulbangte a satguoi uhi."},"11":{"text":"A cingte a uh galkap bupa Nebuzaradan in khuopi sunga kinuasie a omlai teng le Babylon kumpipa lama a taite, mi honpi a omlai teng tawh salin a peipi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin a cingte a uh galkap bupa in lengga um bawl ding le lo kai dingin tua gammi a zawngpen pawlkhat a nuasie hi."},"13":{"text":"Chaldea-te in Topa’ biehinn sunga a om sumngo khuompite, Topa’ biehinn sunga a om tuikuong tunnate, le sumngo tuikuongpi tawguoi siengin Babylon-ah a sumngo a puo uhi.","ref":"1Kum 7:15-26; 2Khg 3:15-17; 4:2-5"},"14":{"text":"Amate in beelte, kawbiate, taite te, gimnamtui halna kuongte, le biehbuh nasepna-a kizang sumngo vanzah zosie,","ref":"1Kum 7:45; 2Khg 4:16"},"15":{"text":"vutluonate le haite zong a la uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn adingin Solomon in a bawl khuompi nite, tuikuongpi khat, a tunnate, sumngo tawh a kibawl tam bang vanzah zosie ahile a gihna te zawh ding hi lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuompi khat a sanna tong sawm le giet hi a, tua tungah sumngo khuomlu zepna khat a om hi; tua khuomlu zepna pen a sanna tong thum ahi hi; khuomlu zepna kimvelah a unpi-a sumngo tawh kibawl lenta banga kiphante le mang kawlsingte a om hi. Khuompi nina zong tua ma bangin lenta banga kiphan ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A cing galkap bupa in siempu lien pa Seraiah, siempu a nina Zephaniah, le kotcing mi thum man hi;"},"19":{"text":"khuopi panin galkapte a uh galkap bupa khat, le khuopi sunga om kumpipa’ thudawhpite mi nga man hi. Gamsung mite a khawm galkap mangpa’ thuvanpi pa zong man hi. Khuopi sunga a om gamsung mi sawmguh zong man hi."},"20":{"text":"A cing galkap bupa Nebuzaradan in amate manin Riblah-a Babylon kumpipa kungah peipi hi."},"21":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in amate sat a, Hamath gam sunga Riblah-ah that hi. Tuaci’n ama’ gam panin Judah salin kikai hi."},"22":{"text":"Judah gam sunga a omlai teng tunga uhpi dingin ama in Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah se hi.","title":"Judah Uhpi-in Gedaliah Kikoi (Jer 40:5–41:18)"},"23":{"text":"Tu-in galkap bute zosie le a mite, Babylon kumpipa in uhpa dingin Gedaliah a sena thu a zah uh ciengin, amate zong a mite utawh Mizpah-a Gedaliah kungah a pei uhi. A minte uh pen Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael, Kareah’ tapa Johanan, Netophah-te Tanhumeth’ tapa Seraiah, le Maacath-te Jaazaniah ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate le a mite kungah Gedaliah kiciem a, “Chaldea uliente ziehin zau sih un. Gam sungah tengin, Babylon kumpipa’ na sem un. Tua hile no adingin thu a hoi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 40:7-9"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin a hla sagina a cin ciengin kumpipa innkuon sung panin Elishama’ tapa Nethaniah, a tapa Ishmael mihing sawm tawh kuon a, Gedaliah le Judea-te le Mizpah-a ama tawh a omton Chaldea-te simin that hi.","ref":"Jer 41:1-3"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a sang a ngiemin mi zosie le galkap bute kithawi-in Egypt ah a tai uhi; azieh pen amate in Chaldea-te a giing uhi.","ref":"Jer 43:5-7"},"27":{"text":"Judah kumpi Jehoiachin a thongkieh zaw kum sawmthum le sagi a cin kum, hla sawm le hla nina, tua hla ni sawmni le ni sagi a cin ni, Babylon kumpipa Evil-merodach a maan kumin ama in a hepi ziehin thong panin Jehoiakhin hla hi.","title":"Thong pan Jehoiachin Kihla (Jer 52:31-34)"},"28":{"text":"Ama in kamdam tawh ama hopi a, Babylon gama a ompi kumpi dangte’ topha sangin a sangzaw munah ama a tosah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jehoiachin in a thong puonte a sutdawh hi. Ama’ hin sungin ama in kumpipa’ mai-ah nisielin an ne-in tui a dawn hi."},"30":{"text":"A hin sungin kumpipa in a zahtawm ding sih den a, nisielin ama tanh a pie den hi."}}}}},"13":{"info":{"name":"1 Khang Tangthu","shortname":"1khg","abbr":[],"desc":"Khang tangthu masa laibu (the first book of chronicles)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adam, Seth, Enosh;","title":"Adam pan Abraham Dong (Pien 5:1-32 ; 10:1-32 ; 11:10-26 ; Luk 3:34-38)"},"2":{"text":"Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;"},"3":{"text":"Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;"},"4":{"text":"Noah, Shem, Ham, le Japheth."},"5":{"text":"Japheth’ suonlehlahte: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, le Tiras."},"6":{"text":"Gomer’ suonlehlahte: Ashkenaz, Diphath, le Togarmah."},"7":{"text":"Javan suonlehlahte: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, le Rodanim."},"8":{"text":"Ham’ suonlehlahte: Cush, Egypt, Put, le Canaan."},"9":{"text":"Cush’ suonlehlahte: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, le Sabteca. Raamah’ suonlehlahte: Sheba, le Dedan."},"10":{"text":"Cush pen Nimrod’ pa ahi hi; ama pen leitungah mihat masa pen ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Egypt pen Lud-te, Anam-te, Lehab-te, Naphtuh-te,"},"12":{"text":"Pathrus-te, Casluh-te, le Caphtor-te’ pa ahi a, ama sung panin Philistia-te a pieng hi."},"13":{"text":"Canaan pen a tacil Sidon le Heth,"},"14":{"text":"le Jebus-te, Amor-te, Girgash-te,"},"15":{"text":"Hiv-te, Ark-te, Sin-te,"},"16":{"text":"Arvad-te, Zemar-te le Hamath-te’ pa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Shem’ suonlehlahte: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, le Meshech."},"18":{"text":"Arpachshad pen Shelah’ pa; Shelah pen Eber’ pa ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Eber sung panin in tapa ni pieng hi: Khat pa’ min Peleg hi a, (a zieh pen ama hunin leitung kikhen hi) a sanggampa’ min Joktan ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Jokton pen Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"21":{"text":"Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,"},"22":{"text":"Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,"},"23":{"text":"Ophir, Havilah, le Jobab-te’ pa ahi hi; tam teng zosie pen Jokton’ suonlehlahte ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah;"},"25":{"text":"Eber, Peleg, Reu;"},"26":{"text":"Serug, Nahor, le Terah;"},"27":{"text":"Abraham a kici Abram ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Abraham’ tapate: Isaac le Ishmael ahi uhi.","title":"Abraham pan Jacob"},"29":{"text":"Tam teng a khangsimna uh ahi hi: Ishmael’ tacil Nebaioth; tuale Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,"},"30":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,"},"31":{"text":"Jetur, Naphish, le Kedemah. Tam teng pen Ishmael’ tapate ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Abraham’ a meinu Keturah’ tapate: Ama in Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, le Shuah. Jokshan’ tapate: Sheba le Dedan."},"33":{"text":"Midian’ tapate: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, le Eldaah-te ahi uhi. Tam teng zosie Keturah’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Abraham pen Isaac’ pa ahi hi. Isaac’ tapate: Esau le Israel."},"35":{"text":"Esau’ tapate: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, le Korah."},"36":{"text":"Eliphaz’ tapate: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, le Amalek."},"37":{"text":"Reuel’ tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, le Mizzah."},"38":{"text":"Seir’ tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, le Dishan."},"39":{"text":"Lotan’ tapate: Hori le Homam; Lotan’ sanggamnu pen Timna ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Shobal’ tapate: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, le Onam. Zibeon’ tapate: Aiah le Anah."},"41":{"text":"Anah’ tapa: Dishon. Dishon’ tapate: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, le Cheran."},"42":{"text":"Ezer’ tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan, le Jaakan. Dishan’ tapate: Uz le Aran."},"43":{"text":"Israel-te tungah koima kumpi in a uh masangin Edom gam sunga a uh kumpite: Beor’ tapa Bela ahi a, ama khuopi min pen Dinhabah ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Bela a si ciengin Bozrah-te Zerah’ tapa Jobab in ama’ za luo hi."},"45":{"text":"Jobab a si ciengin Teman-te’ gammi Husham in ama’ za luo hi."},"46":{"text":"Husham a si ciengin Moab gama Midian-te a zo pa, Bedad’ tapa Hadad in ama’ za luo hi; a khuopi min pen Avith ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Hadad a si ciengin Masrekah-te Samlah in ama’ za luo hi."},"48":{"text":"Samlah a si ciengin Euphrates gun gei-a om Rehoboth-te Shaul in ama’ za luo hi."},"49":{"text":"Shaul a si ciengin Achbor’ tapa Baal-hanan in ama’ za luo hi."},"50":{"text":"Baal-hanan a si ciengin Hadad in ama’ za luo hi; ama’ khuopi min pen Pai ahi a, a zi’ min pen Mehetabel hi a, Me-zahab’ tunu, Matred’ tanu ahi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tuale Hadad a si hi. Edom’ bete: Bete Timnah, Aliah, Jetheth,"},"52":{"text":"Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,"},"53":{"text":"Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,"},"54":{"text":"Magdiel, le Iram ahi uhi. Tam teng pen Edom’ bete ahi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Israel’ tapate ahi uhi: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,","title":"Israel’ Tapate le Judah’ Suonlehlahte (Pien 29:23–30:24 ; 35:16-18 ; 46:8-25 ; Ruth 4:18-22 ; Mat 1:2-6 ; Luk 3:1-33)"},"2":{"text":"Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, le Asher."},"3":{"text":"Judah’ tapate: Er, Onan, le Shelah; tam teng thum pen Canaan numei Bath-shua tawh a nei ahi hi. Tu-in Topa muna-ah Judah’ tacil Er pen siet gamtat a, ama in tua pa that hi."},"4":{"text":"A monu Tamar in zong Perez le Zerah nei hi. Judah in a unpi-in tapa nga nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Perez’ tapate: Hezron le Hamul."},"6":{"text":"Zerah’ tapate: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, le Dara, a unpi-un nga pha uhi."},"7":{"text":"Carmi’ tapate: Israel a subuoi, sil ki-apte vai-a a khiel, Israel Achar;","ref":"Josh 7:1"},"8":{"text":"le Ethan’ tapa pen Azariah ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama sung pana a suoh Hezron’ tapate: Jerahmeel, Ram, le Chelubai."},"10":{"text":"Ram pen Amminadab’ pa ahi a, Amminadab pen Judah tapate sung pan ulien Nahshon’ pa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Nashon pen Salma’ pa, Salma pen Boaz’ pa,"},"12":{"text":"Boaz pen Obed’ pa, Obed pen Jessi’ pa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Jessi pen a tacil Eliab, a nina Abinadab, a thumna Shimea,"},"14":{"text":"a lina Nethanel, a ngana Raddai,"},"15":{"text":"a guhna Ozem, a sagina David’ pa ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amau’ sanggam numeite pen Zeruiah le Abigail ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Abigail in Amasa nei a, Amasa’ pa pen Ishmael-te Jether ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hezron’ tapa Caleb in a zi Azubah le Jerioth tawh ta nei hi; tam teng a tapate ahi uhi: Jesher, Shobab, le Ardon."},"19":{"text":"Azubah a si ciengin Caleb in Ephrath tenpi a, tua nu in ama tawh Hur nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Hur pen Uri’ pa hi a, Uri pen Bezalel’ pa ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama kum sawmguh a cin zaw ciengin Hezron in a tenpi Gilead’ pa Machir’ tanu a luppi hi; tuale ama in tua nu tawh Segub nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Segub pen Jair’ pa ahi a, ama in Gilead gam sungah khuopi sawmni le thum nei hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Geshur le Aram in amate tung panin Havvoth-jair, Kenath le a khuotate khuopi sawmguh a la hi."},"24":{"text":"Hezron a si zaw ciengin Caleb-ephrathah ah Caleb in Hezron’ zi Abijah tawh Tekoa’ pa Ashhur nei hi."},"25":{"text":"Hezron’ tacil Jerahmeel’ tapate: A tacil Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, le Ahijah."},"26":{"text":"Jerahmeel in zi dang khat zong nei a, a min Atarah ahi hi; tua nu Onam’ nu ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerahmeel’ tacil Ram’ tapate: Maaz, Jamin, le Eker."},"28":{"text":"Onam’ tapate: Shammai le Jada. Shammai’ tapate: Nadab le Abishur."},"29":{"text":"Abishur’ zi min Abihail ahi a, ama in ama tawh Ahban le Molid nei hi."},"30":{"text":"Nadab’ tapate: Seled le Appaim ahi hi; ta nei loin Seled a si hi."},"31":{"text":"Appaim’ tapa: Ishi. Ishi’ tapa: Sheshan. Sheshan’ tapa: Ahlai."},"32":{"text":"Shammai’ sanggampa Jada’ tapate: Jether le Jonathan. Ta nei loin Jether a si hi."},"33":{"text":"Jonathan’ tapate: Peleth le Zaza. Tam teng Jerahmeel’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tu-in Shesan in tapa nei loin tanute beh nei hi; ahi vangin Sheshan in Egypt mi sila khat nei a, a min Jarha ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n Sheshan in a silapa Jarha tawh a tanu kinungsah hi; tua nu in ama tawh Attai nei hi."},"36":{"text":"Attai pen Nathan’ pa hi a, Nathan pen Zabad’ pa ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Zabad pen Ephlal’ pa hi a, Ephlal pen Obed’ pa ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Obed pen Jehu’ pa hi a, Jehu pen Azariah’ pa ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Azariah pen Helez’ pa hi a, Helez pen Eleasah’ pa ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Eleash pen Sismai’ pa hi a, Sismai pen Shallum’ pa ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Shallum pen Jekamiah’ pa hi a, tuale Jekamaih pen Elishama’ pa ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Jerahmeel’ sanggampa Caleb’ tapate: A tacil Mesha hi a, ama Ziph’ pa ahi hi. Mareshah’ tapa Hebron ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Hebron’ tapate: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, le Shema."},"44":{"text":"Shema pen Raham’ pa ahi a, Raham pen Jorkeam’ pa ahi hi; tuale Rekem pen Shammai’ pa ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Shammai’ tapate: Maon. Moan pen Beth-zur’ pa ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Caleb’ meinu Ephah in zong Haran, Moza, le Gezez-te nei hi; tuale Haran pen Gazez’ pa ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Jahdai’ tapate: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, le Shaaph."},"48":{"text":"Caleb’ meinu Maacah in Sheber le Tirhanah nei hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua nu in Madmannah’ pa Shaaph, Macbenah’ pa Sheva, le Gibea zong nei hi; tuale Caleb’ tanu pen Achsah ahi hi."},"50":{"text":"Tam teng pen Caleb’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi. Ephrathah’ tacil Hur’ tapate: Kiriath-jearim’ pa Shobal,"},"51":{"text":"Bethlehem’ pa Salma le Beth-gader’ pa Hareph."},"52":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim’ pa Shobal in tapa dangte nei hi: Haroeh, Menuhoth-te a langkhat."},"53":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim innkuonte: Ithri-te, Puth-te, Shumath-te, le Mishrai-te; tam teng sung panin Zorah-te le Eshtaol-te pieng hi."},"54":{"text":"Salma’ tapate: Bethlehem, Netophah-te, Atroth-bethjoab-te, le Zor-te ahi Manahath minam ni sung pan alang."},"55":{"text":"Jabez-a teng laithei innkuonte: Tirath-te, Shimeath-te, le Sucath-te. Tam teng pen Hamath pana pei Rechab innkuonte’ pa Ken-te ahi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Hebron-a suoh David’ tapate ahi uhi: A tacil pen Jezreel-te Ahinoam tawh a nei Amnon; a nina Carmel-te Abigail tawh a nei Daniel;","title":"David le Solomon’ Suonlehlahte (Mat 1:6-12)"},"2":{"text":"a thumna Geshur Kumpipa Talmai’ tanu Maacah tawh a nei Absalom; a lina Haggith’ tapa Adonijah;"},"3":{"text":"a ngana Abital tawh a nei Shephatiah, a guhna a zi Eglah tawh a nei Ithream;"},"4":{"text":"Hebron ah kum sagi le hla guh a maan sungin ama sung panin guh suoh hi. Tuale Jerusalem ah ama kum sawmthum le kum thum sung maang hi.","ref":"2Sam 5:4-5; 1Kum 2:11; 1Khg 29:27"},"5":{"text":"Tam teng pen ama sung pan Jerusalem-a a suohte ahi uhi: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, le Solomon, tam teng li pen Ammiel’ tanu Bath-shua tawh a nei ahi hi;","ref":"2Sam 11:3"},"6":{"text":"tua ciengin Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,"},"7":{"text":"Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,"},"8":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada, le Eliphelet, kuo pha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam teng zosie a meite’ tapate a kisim lo David’ tapate ahi uhi. Tamar pen a sanggamnu uh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Solomon’ suonlehlahte: Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam, a tapa Ahijah, a tapa Asa, a tapa Jehoshaphat,"},"11":{"text":"a tapa Joram, a tapa Ahaziah, a tapa Joash,"},"12":{"text":"a tapa Amaziah, a tapa Azariah, a tapa Jotham,"},"13":{"text":"a tapa Ahaz, a tapa Hezekiah, a tapa Manasseh,"},"14":{"text":"a tapa Amon, a tapa Josiah-te ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Josiah’ tapate: A tacil Johanan, a nina Jehoiakim, a thumna Zedekiah, a lina Shallum-te ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jehoiakim’ suonlehlahte: A tapa Jeconiah le Zedekiah ahi uhi;"},"17":{"text":"tuale sala kiman Jeconiah’ tapate: a tapa Shealtiel,"},"18":{"text":"Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, le Nedabiah ahi uhi;"},"19":{"text":"Pedaiah’ tapate: Zerubbabel le Shimei ahi uhi; tuale Zerubbabel’ tapate: Meshullum le Hananiah hi a, Shelomith pen a sanggam nu uh ahi hi;"},"20":{"text":"tuale Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, le Jushab-hesed, nga nei hi."},"21":{"text":"Hananiah’ tapate: Pelatiah le Jeshaiah hi a, Jeshaiah’ tapa Rephaiah, a tapa Arnan, a tapa Obadiah, a tapa Shecaniah-te ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Shecaniah’ tapa: Shemaih ahi hi. Shemaih’ tapate: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, le Shaphat, guh pha uhi."},"23":{"text":"Neariah’ tapate: Elioenai, Hizkiah, le Azrikam, thum pha uhi."},"24":{"text":"Elioenai’ tapate: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, le Anani, sagi pha uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah’ tapate: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, le Shobal.","title":"Judah’ Suonlehlahte"},"2":{"text":"Shobal’ tapa Reaiah pen Jahath’ pa hi a, Jahath pen Ahumai le Lahad’ pa ahi hi. Tam teng pen Zorath-te’ innkuonte ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tam teng pen Etam’ tapate ahi uhi: Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash; tuale a sanggamnu uh’ min pen Hazzelelponi ahi hi,"},"4":{"text":"tuale Penuel pen Gedor’ pa hi a, Ezer pen Hushah’ pa ahi hi. Tam teng pen Ephrathah’ tacil, Bethlehem’ pa Hur’ tapate ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tekoa’ pa Ashhur in zi ni, Helah le Naarah nei hi;"},"6":{"text":"Naarah in ama tawh Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, le Haahashtari nei hi. Tam teng pen Naarah’ tapate ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Helah’ tapate: Zereth, Izhar, le Ethnan."},"8":{"text":"Koz pen Anub, Zobebah’ Harum’ tapa pen Aharhel’ innkuonte’ pa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Jabez pen a sanggamte sangin a zatah huoi zaw hi; tuale a nu in, “Gimpi-a ama ka nei ahi ziehin,” ci-in a min Jabez a phuoh hi."},"10":{"text":"Jabez in Israel Pasien kungah thungen a, “Aw, keima thupha ei pie inlen, ka gamgi ei kehpieh in, na khut tawh ei ompi inlen, gimna le sietna panin ei kem in!” a ci hi. Tuale Pasien in ama’ ngetna a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Shuhah’ sanggampa Chelub pen Mehir’ pa hi a, Mehir pen Eshton’ pa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Eshton pen Beth-rapha, Paseah-te’ pa hi a, Tehinnah pen Ir-nahash’ pa ahi hi. Tam teng Recah-te ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kenaz’ tapate: Othniel le Seraiah. Othniel’ tapate: Hathath le Meonothai."},"14":{"text":"Meonothai pen Ophrah’ pa ahi hi; tuale Seraiah pen Joab’ pa hi a, Joab pen Ge-harashim’ pa ahi hi. Amate pen khutsiem mite ahi ziehun tua bang kici ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb’ tapate: Iru, Elah, le Naam. Elah’ tapa: Kenaz."},"16":{"text":"Jehallelel’ tapate: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, le Asarel."},"17":{"text":"“Ezrah’ tapate: Jether, Mered, Epher, le Jalon. Tam teng pen Mered tawh kiteng Pharaoh’ tanu Bithiah’ tapate ahi uhi. Ama gai-in Miriam, Shammai, le Eshtemeo’ pa pen Ishbah nei hi."},"18":{"text":"A Judea zi in Gedor’ pa Jered, Soco’ pa Heber, le Zanoah’ pa Jekuthiel nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Naham’ sanggamnu Hodiah’ zi tapate pen Garm-te Keilah le Maacath-te Eshtemoa’ pa ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Shimon’ tapate: Amnon, Rinn ah, Ben-hanan, Tilon. Ishi’ tapate: Zoheth le Ben-zoheth."},"21":{"text":"Judah’ tapa Shelah’ tapate: Lecah’ pa Er le Mareshah’ pa Laadah le Beth-ashbea-a saihadiel puon a gan innkuonte;"},"22":{"text":"tuale Jokim, le Cozeba mite, Moab numeite a kinunpi Joash le Saraph te ahi vua, ahi vangin Lehem ah kilekia uhi. (Tam pen tangtawng lai-a ciemtena ahi hi.)"},"23":{"text":"Tam teng pen beelkhengte ahi uhi; Netaim le Gederah-a tengte ahi uhi; ama na sem dingin khum munah kumpipa tawh amate a teng uhi."},"24":{"text":"Simeon’ tapate: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul.","title":"Simeon’ Suonlehlahte (Pien 46:10)"},"25":{"text":"Shallum pen Shaul’ tapa hi a, a tapa Mibsam, a tapa Mishma ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mishma’ tapate: Hamuel pen a tapa ahi a, Zaccur a tapa hi-in Shimei a tapa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Shimei in tapa sawm le guh le tanu guh nei hi; hinanle a sanggamte in ta tampi a nei sih vua, amau’ innkuon pen Judea-te bangin a pung sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate Beer-sheba, Moladah, Hazarshual"},"29":{"text":"Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,"},"30":{"text":"Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,"},"31":{"text":"Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, le Shaaraim ah a teng uhi. Tam teng pen David kumpi a suo masanga a khuopite uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuale a khuoneute uh Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, le Ashan, khuopi ngate le,"},"33":{"text":"Baal cieng dong tam khuopite kimvela om khuoneute zosie tawh ahi hi. Tam teng pen amau’ tenna hi a, amate in khangsimna laibu a kem uhi.","ref":"Josh 19:2-8"},"34":{"text":"Meshobab, Jamlech, Amaziah’ tapa Joshash,"},"35":{"text":"Joel, Asiel’ tapa Seriah, a tapa Joshibiah, a tapa Jehu,"},"36":{"text":"Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,"},"37":{"text":"Shemaiah’ tapa Shimri, a tapa Jedaiah, a tapa Allon, a tapa Shiphi’ tapa Ziza ahi uhi,"},"38":{"text":"a min tawh kilo tam mite pen amau’ innkuon cietah makaite ahi vua, amau’ be pen nahpitahin a khang uhi."},"39":{"text":"A ganhonte uh’ neh ding lonona sui-in nisuona kuom panglam, Gedor lutna-ah khuol a zin vua,"},"40":{"text":"amate in tua munah lei hoi, lonona mun a mu vua, tua leitang pen gam tanzau, gamsip, le kilemna mun a hi hi; azieh pen khum sunga a teng masate pen Ham-te ahi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Judah kumpi Hezekiah’ hun sungin a min a kiciemte tam mite pei-in, amate in tua sunga a mu uh Meunim mite le amau’ puonbuhte simin tuni dongin amate a cigamsah vua, tua munah a tuuhonte uh neh ding lonona om ahi ziehin amau’ munah a teng uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kimkhat, Simeon-te mi zanga, Seir Muolah a pei vua, tuale amate in Ishi’ tapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, le Uzziel makai-in a nei uhi;"},"43":{"text":"amate in a suohta Amalek-te a omlai teng a susie vua, khum munah tuni dongin a teng uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel’ tacil pen Reuben’ tapate ahi a, (Ama tacil ahi a, ahi vangin a pa’ lupna a buasah ziehin Israel’ tapa Joseph tungah ama’ innluoza kipie hi.
