Tuaci’n khangsimna ah innluoza tawh kizui-in ama kikhum lo hi;","title":"Reuben’ Suonlehlahte (Pien 46:8-9)","ref":"Pien 35:22; 49:3-4"},"2":{"text":"a sanggamte lahah Judah mi thupi suoh a, ama sung panin uhpa khat a pien vangin innluoza pen Joseph-a’ ahi hi.)","ref":"Pien 35:22; 49:3-4"},"3":{"text":"Israel’ tacil Reuben’ tapate: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, le Carmi."},"4":{"text":"Joel’ tapate: A tapa Shemaiah, a tapa Gog, a tapa Shimei,"},"5":{"text":"a tapa Micah, a tapa Reaiah, a tapa Baal,"},"6":{"text":"le a tapa Beerah, Assyria kumpi Tilgath-pilneser in sala a peipi pa ahi hi; ama pen Reuben minamte lahah uhpi khat ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 15:29"},"7":{"text":"Tuale khanggui zui-in amau’ khangsutna a kisim ciengin a innkuonkhuon vua a tanaute: Uhpi Jeiel le Zechariah,"},"8":{"text":"Aroer-a teng Joel’ tapa Shema, a tapa Azaz, a tapa Bela. Nebo le Baalmeon cieng dongah amahaw a teng uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama nisuona lamah Euphrates talam pang senel gam kipatna mun dong ciengah zong a teng hi. Azieh pen Gilead gam sungah a gantate uh a pung mama hi."},"10":{"text":"Saul hun lai-in amate in Hagri-te simin a zo uhi; tuale Gilead nisuona gam teng zosie-ah a puonbuhte sung vuah amate a teng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bashan gam sung Salecah donga a gei vua a teng Gad’ tapate:","title":"Gad’ Suonlehlahte"},"12":{"text":"Bashan gamah uhpi Joel, a zom Shapham, Janai le Shaphat."},"13":{"text":"Tuale amau’ be dung zui-a a tanaute uh: Michael, Meshullum, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, le Eber, sagi pha uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng pen Buz’ tapa Jahdo, a tapa Jeshishai, a tapa Michael, a tapa Gilead, a tapa Jaroah, a tapa Huri’ tapa Abihail’ tapate ahi uhi;"},"15":{"text":"Guni’ tapa, Abdiel’ tapa Ahi pen amau’ be sungah uhpi ahi hi;"},"16":{"text":"amate Gilead gamsung, Bashan gamsung le a khuopite sung, le Sharon gam lo nona mun zosie le tua gam a kiten theina cieng dongah a teng uhi."},"17":{"text":"Judah kumpi Jotham hun sung, le Israel kumpi Jeroboam hun sung khangsimna-ah tam teng zosie kiciemte hi."},"18":{"text":"Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alang in galhang mihat, lum le namsau a kuo, thalkap siem, galdo siem, mi tul sawmli le tulli le zasagi le sawmguh gal sim dingin a baisa-in nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate Hagri-te, Jetur-te, Naphish-te, le Nodab-te tawh kido uhi;"},"20":{"text":"amate do nadingin panpina a nga ciengun Hagri-te le a kung vua om teng zosie, amau’ khut sungah kipie hi; azieh pen gal kidona sungah a Pasien kungah amate a kiko vua, ama a muon ziehin ama in amau’ ngetna a pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in a gantate matpieh uhi: A kalaoh uh tul sawmnga, tuu tul zani le tul sawmnga, laa tul ni, le mi tul zakhat hingmat uhi."},"22":{"text":"Gal kidona pen Pasien-a’ ahi ziehin mi tampi tah kithatin a pua uhi. A sal suo dongun Hagri-te’ gam sungah a teng uhi."},"23":{"text":"Gam sungah Manasseh minam alang a teng uhi; Bashan panin Baal-hermon, Senir, le Hermon Muol tungah amate tengin tampi a pha uhi.","title":"Manasseh Minam Alangte"},"24":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ be lutangte ahi uhi: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, le Jahdiel, a thahat galhangte, mi minthangte, amau’ be lutangte ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a pu a pate uh Pasien’ thu palsatin Pasien in a mai vua a suhsiet minamte’ pasiente lahah a kizua uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel Pasien in Assyria kumpi Pul’ lungsim le Assyria kumpi Tilgath-pilneser’ lungsim tawhnawi a, Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte Halah, Habor, Hara le Gozan gunah a peipi a, tuni dongin a teng uhi.","ref":"2Kum 15:19, 29; 2Kum 17:6"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi’ tapate: Gershom, Kohath, le Merari.","title":"Levi’ Suonlehlahte (Pien 46:11)"},"2":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzzel."},"3":{"text":"Amram’ tate: Aaron, Moses, le Miriam. Aaron’ tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar."},"4":{"text":"Phinehas’ pa Eleazar, Abishua’ pa Pinehas,"},"5":{"text":"Bukki’ pa Abishua, Uzzi’ pa Bukki,"},"6":{"text":"Zerahiah’ pa Uzzi, Meraioth’ pa Zerahiah,"},"7":{"text":"a Amariah’ pa Meraioth, Ahitub’ pa Amariah,"},"8":{"text":"Zadok’ pa Ahitub, Ahimaaz’ pa Zadok,"},"9":{"text":"Azariah’ pa Ahimaaz, Johanan’ pa Azariah,"},"10":{"text":"le Azariah’ pa Johanan (Jerusalem-a Solomon in a lam inn sunga siempu sempa) ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Amariah’ pa Azariah, Ahitub’ pa Amariah,"},"12":{"text":"Zadok’ pa Ahitub, Shallum’ pa Zadok,"},"13":{"text":"Hilkiah’ pa Shallum, Azariah’ pa Hilkiah,"},"14":{"text":"Seraiah’ pa Azariah, Jehozadak’ pa Seraih ahi hi;"},"15":{"text":"tuale Topa in Nebuchadnezzar’ khut tawh Judah le Jerusalem sala a mat ciengin Jehozadak zong salin a pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Levi’ tapate: Gershom, Kohath, le Merari."},"17":{"text":"Tam teng pen Gershom’ tapate ahi uhi: Libni le Shimei."},"18":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel."},"19":{"text":"Merari’ tapate: Mahli le Mushi. Tam teng pen amau’ pu a pate dung zui-in Levi’ bete ahi uhi.","ref":"Pei 6:16-19"},"20":{"text":"Gershom’ suonte: A tapa Libni, a tapa Jahath, a tapa Zimmah,"},"21":{"text":"a tapa Joah, a tapa Iddo, a tapa Zerah, a tapa Jeatherai."},"22":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate: A tapa Amminadab, a tapa Korah, a tapa Assir,"},"23":{"text":"a tapa Elkanah, a tapa Ebiasaph, a tapa Assir,"},"24":{"text":"a tapa Tahath, a tapa Uriel, a tapa Uzziah, le a tapa Shaul."},"25":{"text":"Elkanah’ tapate: Amasai le Ahimoth,"},"26":{"text":"a tapa Elkanah, a tapa, Zophai, a tapa Nahath,"},"27":{"text":"a tapa Eliab, a tapa Jeroham, a tapa Elkanah, a tapa Samuel."},"28":{"text":"Samuel’ tapate: A tacil Joel, a nina Abijah."},"29":{"text":"Merari’ tapate: Mahli, a tapa Libni, a tapa Shimei, a tapa Uzza,"},"30":{"text":"a tapa Shimea, a tapa Haggiah, le a tapa Asaiah."},"31":{"text":"Tam teng pen Topa’ biehinn sunga thuciemna singkuong a tawlngah zaw cienga tua sungah Topa ’ biehinn sungah lasah nasepna uh dinga David in a koite ahi uhi.","title":"David in Tumging Siemte Se"},"32":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem-ah Topa’ biehinn a lam zo masangsie-in amate in kikhopna puonbuh ahi biehbuh mai-ah lasahna tawh na a sem ahi uhi; tuale amate in a sep ding uh hun a kisesa bangin a banbanin a sem uhi."},"33":{"text":"A tapate utawh na semton mite tam teng ahi uhi: Kohath-te sung pan: Lasa pa Heman khu Joel’ tapa, Samuel’ tapa,"},"34":{"text":"Elkanah’ tapa, Jehoram’ tapa, Eliel’ tapa, Toah’ tapa,"},"35":{"text":"Zuph’ tapa, Elkanah’ tapa, Mahath’ tapa, Amasai’ tapa,"},"36":{"text":"Elkanah’ tapa, Joel’ tapa, Azariah’ tapa, Zephaniah’ tapa,"},"37":{"text":"Tahath’ tapa, Assir’ tapa, Ebiasaph’ tapa, Korah’ tapa,"},"38":{"text":"Izhar’ tapa, Kohath’ tapa, Levi’ tapa, Israe’ tapa."},"39":{"text":"Tuale ama’ ziet lama ding a sanggampa Asaph pen Berechiah’ tapa, Shimea’ tapa,"},"40":{"text":"Michael’ tapa, Baaseiah’ tapa, Machijah’ tapa,"},"41":{"text":"Ethni’ tapa, Zerah’ tapa, Adaiah’ tapa,"},"42":{"text":"Ethan’ tapa, Zimmah’ tapa, Shimei’ tapa,"},"43":{"text":"Jahath’ tapa, Gershom’ tapa, Levi’ tapa."},"44":{"text":"A vei lamah a tanau Merari’ tapate panin: Ethan pen Kishi’ tapa, Abdi’ tapa, Malluch’ tapa,"},"45":{"text":"Hashabiah’ tapa, Amaziah’ tapa, Hilkiah’ tapa,"},"46":{"text":"Amzi’ tapa, Bani’ tapa, Shemer’ tapa,"},"47":{"text":"Mahli’ tapa, Mushi’ tapa, Levi’ tapa;"},"48":{"text":"a sanggamte uh ahi Levi-te pen Topa’ inn biehbuh sunga nasepna zosie sem dinga kisete ahi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Ahi vangin Aaron le a tapate in Pasien’ nasem Moses’ thupieh zosie tawh kizui-in siengtho pen mun nasepna zosie le Israel dinga thoidamna a bawl dingin, meihal biehna maitam tung le gimnamtui maitam tungah biehna a bawl uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tam teng pen Aaron’ tapate ahi uhi: A tapa Eleazar, a tapa Phinehas, a tapa Abishua,"},"51":{"text":"a tapa Bukki, a tapa Uzzi, a tapa Zerahiah,"},"52":{"text":"a tapa Meraioth, a tapa Amariah, a tapa Ahitub,"},"53":{"text":"a tapa Zadok, a tapa Ahimaaz."},"54":{"text":"Amate tungah aisanna a kieh masah ziehin Aaron’ tapate, Kohath-te’ innkuon in a gamgi net sung vuah amau’ khuom khawna tawh kizui-in a ten nading vua kipie munte tam teng ahi hi:","title":"Levi-te’ Tenna Munte (Josh 21:1-42)"},"55":{"text":"Judah gam sunga Hebron le a kimvela om lononate amate tungah a pie vua,"},"56":{"text":"ahi vangin Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah khuopi-a lote le a khuotate a pie uhi."},"57":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate tungah a pieh uh kibuhna khuopite: Hebron, Libnah le a lonona gamte tawh, Jattir, Eshtemoa le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"58":{"text":"Hilen le a lonona gamte tawh, Debir le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"59":{"text":"Ashan le a lonona gamte tawh, le Bethshemesh le a lonona gamte tawh"},"60":{"text":"Benjamin minam panin Geba le a lonona gamte tawh, Alemeth le a lonona gamte tawh, le Anathoth le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi. Amau’ innkuon sung panin a khuopi zosie uh a unpi-in sawm le thum pha hi."},"61":{"text":"Kohath-te a omlai teng tungah aisanna tawh Manasseh minam alangte’ gam sung panin khuopi sawm kipie hi."},"62":{"text":"Gershom tate kungah a innkuon zui-in Issachar-te’ gam, Asher-te’ gam, Naphtali-te’ gam, le Bashan-a om Manasseh-te’ gam sung panin khuopi sawm le thum kipie hi."},"63":{"text":"Merari-te tungah a innkuon zui-in Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Zebulun-te sung panin khuopi sawm le ni kipie hi."},"64":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel mite in Levi-te tungah khuopite le a lonona gam tawh a pie uhi."},"65":{"text":"Amate in Judah-te’ gam, Simeon-te’ gam, le Benjamin-te’ gam sung panin zong a min tawh kilo tami khuopite amate tungah a pie uhi."},"66":{"text":"Kohath tapate’ innkuonte pawlkhat in Ephraim minamte’ gam sung panin khuopite a nei uhi."},"67":{"text":"Amate tunga kipie kibuhna khuopite: Ephraim muoltung gam sunga om Shechem le a lonona gamte tawh, Gezer le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"68":{"text":"Jokmeam le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"69":{"text":"Aijalon le a lonona gamte tawh;"},"70":{"text":"le Manasseh minam alangte’ gam sung pan Aner le a lonona gamte tawh, le Bileam le a lonona gamte tawh ahi a, tam pen Kohath innkuon a omlaite ading ahi hi."},"71":{"text":"Manasseh minam alangte’ gam sung panin Gershom-te tunga kipiete: Bashan gama Golan le a lonona gamte tawh le Ashtaroth le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi."},"72":{"text":"Issachar-te’ gam sung pan: Kedesh le a lonona gamte tawh, Daberath le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"73":{"text":"Ramoth le a lonona gamte tawh, le Anem le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi;"},"74":{"text":"Asher-te’ gam sung panin: Mashal le a lonona gamte tawh, Abdon le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"75":{"text":"Hukok le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi;"},"76":{"text":"Naphtali-te’ gam sung pan: Galilee gam sunga om Kedesh le a lonona gamte tawh, Hammon le a lonona gamte tawh, le Kiriathaim le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi."},"77":{"text":"Merari-te a omlai teng tunga Zebulun-te’ gam sung pana kipiete: Rimmono le a lonona gamte tawh, Tabor le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"78":{"text":"Reuben minamte gam sung panin Jordan nisuona lam, Jericho kung Jordan luigal langkhat sung panin: Pawn a om Bezer le a lonona tawh, Jahzah le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"79":{"text":"Kedemoth le a lonona gamte tawh, le Mephaath le a lonona gamte tawh;"},"80":{"text":"tuale Gad-te sung pan: Gilead gama om Ramoth le a lonona gamte tawh, Mahanaim le a lonona gamte tawh,"},"81":{"text":"Heshbon le a lonona gamte tawh, le Jazer le a lonona gamte tawh ahi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Isaachar’ tapate: Tola, Puah, Jashub le Shimmon, li pha uhi.","title":"Isaachar’ Suonlehlahte"},"2":{"text":"Tola’ tapate: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, le Shemuel-te hi a, amau’ pupa innkuon sungah be lutangte ahi vua, Tola-te be pen amau’ khanggui-in mihat galhangte ahi uhi. David’ hun lai-in mihing tul sawmni le zaguh a pha uhi."},"3":{"text":"Uzzi’ tapa Izrahiah ahi hi. Izrahiah’ tapate: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, le Isshiah, mi nga ahi a, a unpi-un uhpite ahi uhi;"},"4":{"text":"amate tawh, a khanggui le a be a phung utawh kizui-in gal sim thei galkap hon mi tul sawmthum le tul guh a om hi. Azieh pen amate in zi tampi nei-in tapa tampi zong a nei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Issachar minam sunga om, khangsimna sunga kikhum, amau’ be galhang mi thahat a unpi-in tul sawmgiet le tul sagi pha hi."},"6":{"text":"Benjamin tapate: Bela, Becher, le Jediael, thum pha uhi.","title":"Benjamin’ Suonlehlahte"},"7":{"text":"Bela’ tapate: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, le Iri, nga a pha vua, pupa innkuon lutangte, a thahat galhangte ahi uhi; amau’ khangsimna sunga a kikhumna-ah tul sawmni le tulni le sawmthum le li pha uhi."},"8":{"text":"Becher’ tapate: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, le Alemeth ahi uhi. Tam teng zosie pen Becher’ tapate ahi uhi;"},"9":{"text":"tuale amau’ khanggui zui-in a khangsimna sunga a kikhumna-ah pupa innkuon lutangte, a thahat galhang mi tul sawmni le zani a pha hi."},"10":{"text":"Jediael’ tapa Bilhan ahi hi. Bilhan’ tapate: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, le Ahishahar ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tam teng a unpi-un Jediael’ tapate ahi vua, pupa innkuon lutangte a hina uh dung zui-in mihat galhang, gal sim dinga a baisa-a om mi tul sawm le tulsagi le zani pha hi."},"12":{"text":"Shuppim le Huppim pen Ir’ tapate ahi vua, Hushim pen Aher’ tapa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Naphtali’ tapate: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, le Shallum ahi a, Bilhah’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi.","title":"Naphtali’ Suonlehlahte"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh’ tapate: A meinu Aram tawh a nei Asriel le Machir ahi hi; ama nu in Gilead’ pa Machir nei hi.","title":"Manasseh’ Suonlehlahte"},"15":{"text":"Tuale Machir in Huppim le Shuppim ading zi a lahpieh hi. A sanggamnu a min Maacah ahi hi. A nina nu’ min Zelophehad ahi hi; tuale Zelophehad in tanute nei hi."},"16":{"text":"Machir’ zi Maacah in ta khat nei a, ama in a min Peresh hisah hi; a sanggampa’ min Sheresh hi a, a tapate’ min Ulam le Rakem ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ulam’ tapa Bedan ahi hi. Tam teng pen Manasseh’ tapa Machir’ tapa Gilead’ tapate ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"A sanggamnu Hammolecheth in Ishhod, Abiezer, le Mahlah nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Shemida’ tapate Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, le Aniam ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ephraim’ tapate: A tapa Shuthelah, a tapa Bered, a tapa Tahath, a tapa Eleadah, a tapa Tahath,","title":"Ephraim’ Suonlehlahte"},"21":{"text":"a tapa Zabad, a tapa Shuthelah, le a tapa Ezer le Elead ahi uhi. Amate kuonsuhin a gante uh a lahpieh ziehun, gam sunga a suoh Gad mite in amate na that uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale amau’ pa Ephraim ni tampi sung kap a, ama henem dingin a sanggamte a pei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ephraim in a zi luppi a, ama gai-in tapa khat a nei hi; a inn sungah gimna a tun ziehin ama in a min Beriah a hisah hi."},"24":{"text":"A tanu Sheerah ahi a, Beth-horon neinung tungnung le Uzzen-sheerah khuo a lam hi."},"25":{"text":"Rephah a kici tapa khat nei a, ama suonlehlahte: Reseph, a tapa Telah, a tapa Tahan,"},"26":{"text":"a tapa Ladan, a tapa Ammihud, a tapa Elishama,"},"27":{"text":"a tapa Nun, a tapa Joshua ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"A neite ule a tenna uh Bethel le khuopite, le nisuona lamah Naaran, le nitumna lamah Gezer le a khuopite, Shechem le a khuopite, le Azzah le a khuopite ahi hi;"},"29":{"text":"Manasseh’ mite gamgi duong teng, Beth-shean le a khuopite, Taanach le a khuopite, Megiddo le a khuopite, Dor le a khuopite zong ahi uhi. Tam khuopite sungah Israel’ tapa Joseph’ tapate a teng uhi."},"30":{"text":"Asher’ tapate: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, le a sanggamnu uh Serah ahi hi.","title":"Asher’ Suonlehlahte"},"31":{"text":"Beriah’ tapate: Heber le Malchiel ahi a, Malchiel pen Birzaith’ pa ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Heber pen Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, le a sanggamnu uh Shua’ pa ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Japhlet’ tapate: Pasach, Bimhal, le Ashvath ahi uhi. Tam teng Japhlet’ tapate ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Shemer’ tapate: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, le Aram ahi uhi."},"35":{"text":"A sanggampa Helem’ tapate: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, le Amal ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Zophah’ tapate: Suoh, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,"},"37":{"text":"Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, le Beera ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Jether’ tapate: Jephunneh, Pispa, le Ara ahi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Ulla’ tapate: Arah, Hanniel, le Rizia ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tam teng zosie a unpi-un Asher’ sungkuon mite ahi vua, pupa innkuon lutangte, a kituomteel mihat galhangte, milien milalte ahi uhi. Gal sim dinga khangsimna sunga kikhum mihing tul sawmni le tulguh ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin pen a tacil Bela, a nina Ashbel, a thumna Aharah,","title":"Benjamin’ Suonlehlahte (Pien 46:21)"},"2":{"text":"a lina Nohah, le a ngana Rapha ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Bela’ tapate: Addar, Gera, Abihud,"},"4":{"text":"Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,"},"5":{"text":"Gera, Shephuphan, le Huram."},"6":{"text":"Ehud’ tapate (amate pen Geba-a teng pupa innkuon lutangte ahi vua, amate Manahath ah salin kipuoh hi):"},"7":{"text":"Naaman, Ahijah, le Uzza le Ahihud’ pa Heglam kici Gera ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Shaharaim in a zite Hushim le Baara a sawlmang zaw ciengin Moab gam sungah tapate nei hi."},"9":{"text":"A zi Hodesh tawh a nei tapate: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,"},"10":{"text":"Jeuz, Sachia, le Mirmah. Tam teng a tapate ahi a, pupa innkuon lutangte ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in Hushim tawh zong a nei uh tapate: Ahitub le Elpaal."},"12":{"text":"Elpaal’ tapate: Eber, Misham, le Ono le Lod le a khuopite tawh a sat Shemed,"},"13":{"text":"le Beriah le Shema (Gath khuo mite a taisah Aijalon-a teng pupa lutangte;"},"14":{"text":"le Ahio, Shashak, le Jeremoth ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,"},"16":{"text":"Michael, Ishpah, le Joha-te pen Beriah’ tapate ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Zebadiah, Meshallum, Hizki, Heber,"},"18":{"text":"Ishmerai, Izliah, le Jobab tam teng pen Elpaal’ tapate ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,"},"20":{"text":"Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,"},"21":{"text":"Adaiah, Beraiah, le Shimrath-te pen Shimei’ tapate ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,"},"23":{"text":"Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,"},"24":{"text":"Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,"},"25":{"text":"Iphdeiah, le Penuel-te, tam teng Shashak’ tapate ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,"},"27":{"text":"Jaareshiah, Elijah, le Zichri-te pen Jeroham’ tapate ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tam teng pen a khanggui zui-a pupa innkuon lutangte, uhpite ahi vua, Jerusalem ah a teng uhi."},"29":{"text":"Gibeon’ pa Jeiel pen Gibeon ah teng a, a zi’ min Maacah ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"A tapa tapen Abdon, tua ciengin Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,"},"31":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,"},"32":{"text":"le Shimeah’ pa Mikloth ahi uhi. Tu-in a sanggamte zong Jerusalem-a a sanggamte galkhatah amau’ sanggamte ma tawh a teng uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ner pen Kish’ pa, Kish pen Saul’ pa ahi a, Saul Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, le Esh-baal’ pa ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Jonathan’ tapa pen Meribbaal ahi hi; tuale Meribal pen Micah’ pa ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Micah’ tapate: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, le Ahaz ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahaz pen Jehoaddah’ pa ahi hi; tuale Jehoaddah pen Alemeth, Azmaveth, le Zimri’ pa ahi hi; Zimri pen Moza’ pa ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Moza pen Binea’ pa ahi hi; Binea’ tapa Raphah, a tapa Eleasah, a tapa Azel ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Azel in tapa guh nei a, a min uh pen: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, le Hanan; tam teng zosie pen Azel’ tapate ahi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Azel’ sanggampa Eshek’ tapate: A tacil Ulam, a nina Jeush, le a thumna Elipheleti."},"40":{"text":"Ulam’ tapate mihat galhangte, thal tawite, tu le ta tampi neite ahi vua, mi za le sawmnga pha uhi. A unpi-un Benjamin minamte ahi uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n khangsimnate sungah Israel mi zosie kiciemte hi; tuale Israel Kumpite’ Laibu sungah tam teng kigiel hi. Amau’ thuman lona ziehin Babylon ah Judah salin kipeipi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tu-in ahile amau’ neisa amau’ khuopite sunga a tengkia masate pen Israel-te, siempute, Levi-te, le biehinnpi nasemte ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, le Manasseh mi pawlkhat Jerusalem ah a teng uhi:","title":"Saltan Zaw Jerusalem-a Tengte","ref":"Ezr 2:27; Neh 7:73"},"4":{"text":"Judah tapa Perez’ tapate lah panin Bani’ tapa Imri, a tapa Omri, a tapa Ammihud, a tapa Uthai ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Shilon-te lah panin: A tacil Asaiah le a tapate."},"6":{"text":"Zerah’ tapate lah panin: Jeuel le a unaute zaguh le sawmkuo."},"7":{"text":"Benjamin-te lah panin: Hassenuah’ tapa Hodaviah, a tapa Meshullam, a tapa Sallu."},"8":{"text":"Jeroham’ tapa Ibneiah, Machri’ tapa Uzzi, a tapa Elah, le Ibnijah’ tapa Reuel, a tapa Shephatiah, a tapa Meshullam."},"9":{"text":"A khanggui uh dung zui-in a sanggamte uh zakuo le sawmnga le guh pha hi. Tam teng pen pupa innkuon lutangte ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Siempute lah panin: Jedaih, Jehoiarib, Jachin,","title":"Siempu Innkuonte"},"11":{"text":"le Ahitub’ tapa Meraioth, a tapa Zadok, a tapa meshullam, a tapa Hilkiah’ tapa Azariah, Pasien’ biehinn uhpipa ahi hi;"},"12":{"text":"Malchijah’ tapa Pashhur, a tapa Jeroham, a tapa Adaiah, le Immer’ tapa Meshilemith, a tapa Meshullam, a tapa Jahzerah, a tapa Adiel, a tapa Maasai."},"13":{"text":"Amau’ unaute banah a pupa innkuon lutangte, Pasien’ biehinn sunga nasem siem mi tulkhat le zasagi le sawmguh ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Levi-te lah panin: Merari’ tapate sung pan Hashabiah, a tapa Azrikam, a tapa Hasshub, a tapa Shemaiah;"},"15":{"text":"Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, le Asaph’ tapa Zikri, a tapa Mica, a tapa Mattaniah;"},"16":{"text":"Jeduthun’ tapa Galal, a tapa Shemaiah, a tapa Obadiah, Netophath khuotate-a teng, Elkanah’ tapa Asa, a tapa Berechiah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kulpi tunkot cingte: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, le Ahiman ahi hi; tuale a sanggampa uh Shallum pen amau’ uhpi hi a,"},"18":{"text":"amate pen nidangin kumpipa’ tunkot nisuona pang ngahin a om uhi. Tam teng pen Levi-te giephuola kotcingte ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amau’ pu le pate pen biehbuh lutna mun a cing, Topa’ phuol uhte a na hi ma bangun, Korah’ tapa Ebiasaph, a tapa Kore, a tapa Shallum le ama’ pupa innkuonte’ sanggamte pen biehna nasepna a uh, puonbuh sangkil cingte ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Eleazar’ tapa phinehas pen a tawpsa hunin amahaw’ uhpipa hi a, Topa in ama a ompi hi."},"21":{"text":"Meshelemaiah’ tapa Zechariah pen kikhopna puonbuh lutna kotcing pa ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Kotcing dinga kiteel tam mite zosie a unpi-un zani le sawm le ni pha uhi. Amate ahile a khuota vua khangsimna-ah kisim uhi. David le thumu pa Samuel in tam panmun muonhuoite-ah amate na sudet uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate le a suonlehlahte pen Topa’ biehinn kotte a uh le puonbuhte cingin a pang uhi."},"24":{"text":"Kotpi cingte ahile a ningli tengah, nisuona, nitumna, leilu, le leitaw lamah a pang uhi."},"25":{"text":"Khuota sunga om a sanggamte uh ni sagi sielin amate tawh kiguol hlahin kotcing dingin a pei uh kul hi;"},"26":{"text":"bangzieh ahei Levi mi kotpi cing uhpi li teng pen innkhante le Pasien’ inn gougil koinate uh ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuale Pasien’ inn gei-ah amate a zan gie uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate tungah zingmawng sielin vil ding nasep le kot hon ding nasep kiguon hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi kimkhat in nasepna-a kizang umlebeel vai sai uhi. Azieh pen tuate a kilah cieng le a kikoikia ciengin a phaza a sim ding uh a kisam ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate lahah adang pawlkhatte pen topha sabuoite, vanzah siengthote, annelte, lenggazute, sathaute, gimnamtuite, le a namtui nate vil dingin kise hi."},"30":{"text":"Siempute’ ta adangte in panamtui dingin gimnamtuite a hal ding vua,"},"31":{"text":"Levi-te lahah Korah-te Shallum’ tacil Mattithiah in mohpheng bawlte a van hi."},"32":{"text":"Kohath sanggamte pawlkhat in zong sabbath simin Ompina Anlum guolte a bawl uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng pen lasate, Levi-te’ pupa innkuon lutangte, nasep dangte panin pengin biehinnpi innkhante sunga a tengte ahi uhi, azieh pen amate in sun le zanin na a sem uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tam teng pen amau’ khanggui zui-a makaite, Levi-te’ pupa innkuon lutangte ahi uhi; Jerusalem ah amate a teng uhi."},"35":{"text":"Gibeon-ah Gibeon’ pa Jeiel teng a, ama zi’ min Maacah ahi hi.","title":"Kumpi Saul’ Innkuonte"},"36":{"text":"A tacil Abdon hi a, tua ciengin Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,"},"37":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, le Mikloth ahi hi;"},"38":{"text":"tuale Mikloth pen Shimeam’ pa ahi hi; tam teng zong a tanaute tawh Jerusalem ah kimaingatin a teng uhi."},"39":{"text":"Ner pen Kish’ pa, Kish pen Saul’ pa ahi hi. Saul pen Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, le Eshbaal’ pa ahi hi;"},"40":{"text":"tuale Jonathan’ tapa Meribbaal hi a, Meribal pen Micah’ pa ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Micah’ tapate: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, le Ahaz;"},"42":{"text":"tuale Ahaz pen Jarah’ pa hi a, Jarah pen Alemeth, Azmaveth, le Zimri’ pa ahi hi; tuale Zimri pen Moza’ pa ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Moza pen Binea’ pa ahi hi; tuale a tapa Rephaiah, a tapa Eleasah, a tapa Azel ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Azel in tapa guh nei a, tuate’ min: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, le Hanan ahi uhi; tam teng Azel’ tapate ahi uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistia-te in Israel a sim uhi; tuale Philistia-te mai-ah Israel mite tai-in Gilboa Muol tungah pua-in a si uhi.","title":"Saul le A Tapate’ Sina (1Sam 31:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Philistia-te in Saul le a tapate a pha uhi; tuale amate in Saul’ tapate ahi Jonathan, Abinadab le Malchishua te a that uhi."},"3":{"text":"Saul in gal kidona nanha a sa mama hi. Tuale thal kapte in ama mu-in a kapliem uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Saul in a galvan puopa kungah, “Tam tep kitan lo mite hing pei-in ei apmaipi lo nadingun na namsau dawh inlen ei dawtlia in,” a ci hi. Hizongle a galvan puopa a zau ziehin a bawl nuom sih hi. Tuaci’n Saul in a namsau la-in tua tungah pua-in a si hi."},"5":{"text":"A galvan puopa in Saul si a mu bepin ama zong a namsau tungah pua-in a si hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin Saul a si hi; ama le a tapa thumte le a innkuon zosie a siton uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kuom sunga om Israel mi zosie in galkapte taimangin Saul le a tapate a sina uh a mu ciengun khuopite nuasie-in a taimang uhi. Philistia-te pei-in tua khuopi teng a luo uhi."},"8":{"text":"A zing cieng, a kithat mite’ puon hawhkhie dingin Philistia-te a pei uh ciengin Gilboa Muol tungah Saul le a tapate a sina a mu uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in ama’ nate hawh dawhin a lutang le a galhiem a la vua, a milimte ule mite kungah tua lungdam thu a tangko dingin Philistia-te’ gam sung zosie-ah kamtaite a sawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a pasiente uh’ biehinn sungah ama’ galhiem koi-in Dagon biehinn sungah a lutang a suong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Philistia-te in Saul tunga a bawldan uh Jabesh-gilead mi zosie in a zah ciengun,"},"12":{"text":"a thahat galhangte kithawi-in Saul le a tapate’ luonghawm la-in Jabesh ah a puo uhi. Tua ciengin Jabesh-a gangpi sing nei-ah amau’ gute a vui vua, ni sagi sung an a tang uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n a thuman lona ziehin Saul a si hi. A thupieh a zui lona ziehin Topa tungah ama a thuman lo a hi hi. Tua tham loin ama in dawilawm nei khat thu dong a,","ref":"Siem 19:31; 20:6; 1Sam 13:8-14; 15:1-24; 28:7-8"},"14":{"text":"Topa kung panin lamlahna sui lo hi. Tua ahi ziehin Topa ! in ama that a, Jessi’ tapa David tungah kumpi gam a pie hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel zosie Hebron-a David kungah a kikhawm vua, “En in, kote na gu le na tel ka hi uhi.","title":"Israel-te Zosie’ Kumpi-in David Sathau Kinu (2Sam 5:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile masang lai-in, Saul kumpi ahi sung nangawnin Israel galkapte thu a pie nangma na hi hi. Topa na Pasien in nangma kungah tam bangin gen hi: Nang pen ka mi Israel-te a cingpa na hi ding a, ka mi Israel tungah a uhpa na hi ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel upa zosie Hebron-a kumpipa kungah pei-in David in Hebron-a Topa mai-ah amate tawh thuciemna khat a bawl hi. Samuel tungtawnin Topa’ thugen bangin amate in Israel kumpi dingin David sathau a nu uhi."},"4":{"text":"Gam sung mi ahi Jebus-te tenna, Jebus a kici Jerusalem ah David le Israel mi zosie a kuon uhi.","title":"Jerusalem Kila (2Sam 5:6-10)","ref":"Josh 15:63; Thkn 1:21"},"5":{"text":"Jebus-a tengte in David kungah, “Tam sungah nang pei sih ding hi,” a ci uhi. Hizongle David in tu-a David’ khuopi Zion mun muonhuoi a la hi."},"6":{"text":"David in, “Jebus-te a sim masa popo uhpi le galkapmangpa hi ding hi,” a ci hi. Zeruiah’ tapa Joab kuonto masa a, ama galkapmang a suoh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mun muonhuoi sungah David a teng hi; tua ahi ziehin tua khuo pen David’ khuopi kici hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Milo panin a kimvelah a kuolin khuopi lam hi. Joab in khuopi sunga a omlai mun teng a puokia hi."},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Pasien in ama ompi ahi ziehin David thupi semsem hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng pen Israel tawh kisai-in Topa’ thugen bangin ama kumpi a suo thei nadingin, Israel zosie tawh ama’ kumpi gam sungah ama nahpitaha a panpi David’ galhangte’ uhpite ahi uhi.","title":"David’ Mi Thahatte le Amau’ Hanciemna (2Sam 23:8-39)"},"11":{"text":"Tam teng pen David’ mi thahat galhangte kiciemtena ahi hi: Hachmoni’ tapa Jashobeam pen mi thumte lahah a lamkai pa ahi hi; ama in a teipi lehin mi zathum do a, thakhatin a unin that sieng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuale mi thahat thumte lahah ama’ zomah Ahoh mi Dodo’ tapa Eleazar ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Philistia-te galbawl dingin tua munah a kikhop ciengun Pasdammim ah David tawh ama omton hi. Tua sungah mangbuham a dima pona leitang khat a om hi. Tu-in Philistia-te kung panin mite a taimang vua,"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin ama le David in tua leitang laikim tahah panmun la-in hu a, Philistia-te that hi; tuale Topa in guolzawna lienpi tawh amate hunkhie hi."},"15":{"text":"Rephraim kuomah Philistia-te’ galkapte giephuol satin a op laitahun Adullam leihawm a David kungah uhpi sawmthumte lah panin mihing thum a kumsuh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua laitahin mun muonhuoi sungah David a om hi; tuale Betleham khuo-ah Philistia khuocingte a om uhi."},"17":{"text":"David in lunggulna tawh, “Aw, Bethlehem tunkot gei-a tuikhuh panin ka dawn ding tui mi khat in ei pie thei leh ci tei ing e!” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Thumte in Philistia-te’ giephuol a phukeh vua, Bethlehem tunkot gei-a tui tawi-in David kungah a peipi uhi. Ahi vangin David in tua tui a dawn sih hi; ama in Topa adingin tua tui sungsuh a,"},"19":{"text":"ama in, “Tami tui ka dawn poma sih ding hi. Tam mite’ sisan ka dawn thei mawh ding amah? Bang ding ahei cile a luong uh khamin tami tui ang tawi uh ahi bo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ziehin ama in tua tui a dawn sih hi. Tua Thumte in tam bang teng a bawl uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Joab’ sanggampa Abishai pen Sawmthumte lahah a uhpi ahi hi. Ama in a teipi tawh mihing zathum do-in amate that a, tuaci’n mi Thumte banah min khat a ngabe hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing Sawmthumte lahah ama a minthang pen hi a, tuaci’n amau’ lamkaipa a suoh hi. Ahi vangin ama in mi Thumte pha zo lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah pen Kabzeel khuomi galhang, sil thupite a bawlpa ahi hi; ama in Moab mi galhang ni that hi. Ama in vua kieh ni khatin leihawm sunga om humpi khat zong that hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale ama in a thagol, tong nga a sang Egypt-te khat that hi. Tua Egypt mipa in a khutah siemgante’ siem lawngpi cie bang a pha teipi khat nei hi; ahi vangin ama do dingin ama kungah ciengkhut khat tawh Benaiah pei a, Egypt mipa’ khut panin a teipi lahpiehin ama’ teipi ma tawh ama that hi."},"24":{"text":"Tam silte Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah’ bawl ahi a, tua galhang thumte banah min khat ngabe hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama mihing Sawmthumte lahah a min kidawh a, ahih vangin mihing Thumte pha zo lo hi. David in ama cingte’ uhpa-in ama koi hi."},"26":{"text":"Galkapte lah panin mi thahatte pen Joab’ sanggampa Asahel, Bethlehem-te Dodo’ tapa Elhanan,"},"27":{"text":"Harod-te Shammoth, Pelon-te Helez,"},"28":{"text":"Tekoa-te Ikkesh’ tapa Ira, Anathoth-te Abiezer,"},"29":{"text":"Hushah-te Sibbekai, Ahoh-te Ilai,"},"30":{"text":"Netophah-te Maharai, Netophah-te Baanah’ tapa Heled,"},"31":{"text":"Benjamin-te sung panin Gibeah-te Ribai’ tapa Ithai, Pirathon-te Benaiah,"},"32":{"text":"Gaash luidung-te Hurai, Arbath-te Abiel,"},"33":{"text":"Bahurim-te Azmaveth,"},"34":{"text":"Gizon-te Hashem, Harar-te Shagee’ tapa Jonathan,"},"35":{"text":"Harar-te Sachar’ tapa Ahiam, Ur’ tapa Eliphal,"},"36":{"text":"Mecherath-te Hepher, Pelon-te Ahijah,"},"37":{"text":"Carmel-te Hezro, Ezbai’ tapa Naarai,"},"38":{"text":"Nathan’ sanggampa Joel, Hagri’ tapa Mibhar,"},"39":{"text":"Ammon-te Zelek, Zeruiah’ tapa Joab’ galhiem puopa Beeroth-te Naharai,"},"40":{"text":"Ithri-te Ira le Gareb,"},"41":{"text":"Hit-te Uriah, Ahlai’ tapa Zabad,"},"42":{"text":"Reuben-te’ makai khat ahi, Reuben-te Shiza’ tapa Adina, le ama tawh mihing sawmthum,"},"43":{"text":"Maacah’ tapa Hanan, Mithni-te Joshaphat,"},"44":{"text":"Ashterath-te Uzzia, Aroer-te Hotham’ tapate Shama le Jeiel,"},"45":{"text":"Tiz-te Shimri’ tapa Jediael le a sanggampa Joha,"},"46":{"text":"Mahavah-te Eliel, Elnaam’ tapate Jeribai le Joshaviah, Moab-te Ithmah,"},"47":{"text":"Mezoba-te Eliel, Obed, le Jaasiel ahi uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kish’ tapa Saul ziehin David a nop bangin a tat thei lo laitahin Ziklah ah ama kunga a hawte tam teng ahi uhi; tam teng pen gal sungah ama a panpi mihat galhangte lahah mite ahi uhi.","title":"Gamlahah David’ Nuazuite (1Sam 22:1-2)"},"2":{"text":"Amate pen thalkap siem, le a khut zietlam le veilamah thaltang kap thei le suong sep theite ahi uhi; amate pen Saul’ sanggam Benjamin-te ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahiezer pen a uhpi ahi a, tua ciengin Joash ahi hi; a ni gelin Gibeah-te Shemaah’ tapate ahi uhi. Azmaveth’ tapate Jeiel le Pelet zong; Anathoth-te Berakah le Jehu,"},"4":{"text":"Gibeon-te Ishmaiah, mihing sawmthumte lahah galhangpa le mihing sawmthumte makaipa; Gederah-te Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, le Jozabad;"},"5":{"text":"Haruph-te Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, le Shephataiah;"},"6":{"text":"Korah-te Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, le Jashobeam;"},"7":{"text":"le Gedor-te Jeroham’ tapate Joelah le Zebadiah-te ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Gad-te lah panin gamlah mun muonhuoi sunga David kungah a thahat a siem galhangte, lum le teikhaw a siem, a maitang uh humpi maitang tawh a kibang, le muoltung sakhi bangin a mallanga a peite:"},"9":{"text":"A uhpi Ezer, a nina Obadiah, a thumna Eliab,"},"10":{"text":"a lina Mishmannah, a ngana Jeremiah,"},"11":{"text":"a guhna Attai, a sagina Eliel,"},"12":{"text":"a gietna Johanan, a kuona Elzabad,"},"13":{"text":"a sawmna Jeremiah, a sawm le khatna Macbannai-te ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam Gad-te pen galkap uliente ahi vua, a neupen in galkap zakhat, a lienpen in galkap tulkhat uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam teng pen a hla masa sungin Jordan gunpieu zosie tui a let laitahin Jordan galkai-in kuom sunga om mite nisuona lam le nitumna lama a taisah mite ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mun muonhuoi sunga David kung ah Benjamin-te le Judah-te pawlkhat a pei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate tawh a kimu dingin David kuonin amate kungah, “Lawmta hina tawh kei ei panpi dinga ang pei na hi uleh note tawh ka lungsim a kihuolton ding hi. Ahi vangin keima in bangma a sie bawl lo napi ka galte tungah kei ei leheh dinga ang pei na hi uleh, i pu i pate’ Pasien in hing mu hinlen, note thu hing khen taheh,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi sawmthumte a uhpipa Amasai tungah hlagau tung a, ama in, David aw, ko nangma-’a ka hi uhi. Jessi’ tapa aw, nangma’ pawl hi ung! Nang tungah nopna om hinlen, nang ang panpite tungah zong nopna om taheh! Bang zieh ahei cile na Pasien in nang ang panpi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin David in amate a sang a, ama’ galkap uliente a suohsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Philistia-te tawh Saul sim dinga David a kuon laitahin Manasseh-te pawlkhat tai-in David a zop uhi. (Ahi vangin David in Philistia-te panpi lo hi; azieh pen Philistia a uhte kikumin, “A pupa Saul kungah ei taisan ding a, eima’ lu tungah ang tu ding hi,” a ci ziehun ama a sawldoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ziklak ah a pei laitahin tam Manasseh sung panin tai-in ama a belte: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, le Zillethai hi a, Manasseh sungah mi a tulin a uhte ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in misuomte a do David a panpi uhi. Azieh pen amate galhang mite ahi vua, galkap sungah galkap bute ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pasien’ galkap bangin galkap hon tampi a phah dongin a panpi dingin David kungah a ni ni-in mite a lut bebe uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tam teng pen Topa’ thugen tawh kizui-in Saul kumpipa’ gam David tungah a ap dingin Hebron-a ama kunga a pei galkap a khente’ phaza ahi uhi:","title":"Hebron-a David’ Galkapte"},"24":{"text":"Judah mite sung panin lum le tei tawi galkap tulguh le zagiet ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Simeon-te sung panin a thahat galhang mihing tulsagi le zakhat ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Levi-te sung panin mi tul li le zaguh ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Aaron’ innkuon sung panin makai Jehoiada, le ama tawh mi tulthum le zasagi ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Galhang tangval Zadok, le ama’ pupa innkuon sung panin galkapmang sawmni le nite ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Saul’ sanggamte ahi Benjamin-te tulthum ahi a, tuate lahah a tamzaw Saul’ innkuon lamah a pang na lai uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ephraim-te sung panin a thahat galhang, a pupa uh’ innkuon sungah mi minthang, a madawh mi tul sawmni le zagiet ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Manasseh minam alangte sung panin David kumpi a suohsah dinga a pei a min kilo mihing tul sawm le tulgiet ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Issachar-te sung panin hun pei zie a theitel, Israel in bang sem leh kilawm ding ahei ci-a a thei uhpi zani le amau’ uhna nei-a om a sanggam zosie ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Zebulun-te sung panin David panpi dinga lungkhat a khai galsim siemsa galkapte, galsim nading galvan zosie tawh a kivon galsim thei mi tul sawmnga ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Naphtali-te sung panin galkapmang tulkhat le amate tawh a om lum le tei a tawi mi tul sawmthum le tulsagi ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Dan-te sung panin gal sim dinga kiguong mi tul sawmni le tulgiet le zaguh ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Asher-te sung panin gal sim dinga a baisa-a om galsim a siemsa galkap tul sawmli ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Jordan galkhat a om Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alang panin galhiem namkim tawh a kivon mi tul zakhat le tul sawmni ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tam teng zosie gal sim dinga kithawi galhangte ahi vua, Israel zosie tungah David kumpi-a a koi ding ngaisutna tahpi tawh Hebron ah a pei uhi; tua ma bangin a omlai Israel zosie zong David kumpi hisah ding a ngaisutna uh kikhat hi."},"39":{"text":"A sanggamte in amau adingin a na vaihawm ziehun amate tua munah David tawh ni thum sung anne tui dawnin a om uhi."},"40":{"text":"Israel gam sungah kipahna thu a op ziehin a kim a pamte ahi Issachar, Zebulun le Naphtali dong panin zong pei-in laate, kalaohte, le laa-sakolte le bawngtangte, an tampitah, thei mohte, lengga kiphogaw bawhte, le lenggazu le sathau, bawngtangte le tuute a puoh uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in a tul-a uhte, a za-a uhte le a makai zosie tawh thu kikupna nei hi.","title":"Kiriath-jearim Panin Singkuong Kipuo (2Sam 6:1-11)"},"2":{"text":"David in Israel a kikhawm zosie kungah, “Note in hoi na sah vua Topa i Pasien’ deina ahile eite kungah amate ang peiton thei nadingin Israel gam sung zosie-ah a omlai i sanggamte le lonona gam a nei khuopi sunga om siempute le Levi mite hlan dingin mi sawl vai."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin eima kungah i Pasien’ singkuong lakia vai; azieh pen Saul hun lai-in i don kha sih hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi zosie in tua thu hoi sa uh ahi ziehin a kikhawm mi zosie in tua banga bawl dingin a thukim uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in Kiriath-jearim panin Pasien’ singkuong puo dingin Egypt-a Shihor panin Lebo-hamath cieng dong Israel mi zosie a khawm hi.","ref":"1Sam 7:1-2"},"6":{"text":"Khum panin cherub-te’ tunga a to, ama’ min tawh a kilo Pasien’ singkuong a peipito dingin David le Israel mi zosie, Judah-a’ ahi Kiriath-jearim a kici Balaah ah a kuonto uhi.","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"7":{"text":"Abinadab’ inn panin leeng tha khat tungah Pasien’ singkuong puo-in Uzza le Ahio in tua leeng tha a hawl uhi."},"8":{"text":"David le Israel mi zosie in late, lyre lasahna, harp lasahna, tawmte, daltuote, le pengkulte tumin a tha nei za utawh Pasien mai-ah a lam uhi."},"9":{"text":"Chidon’ ancilna phuol a tun ciengun bawngtangte in singkuong lawthing ahi ziehin a khut zahin Uzza in tua singkuong a tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Uzziah tungah Topa a sin a so hi; ama in a khut tawh singkuong a thamkhah ziehin Topa in ama vatin tua mun Pasien mai-ah ama a si hi."},"11":{"text":"Uzza tungah Topa’ thangpaina a pawh zah ziehin David a lungthah hi; tuaci’n tuni dongin khum mun Perez-uzzah kici hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni-in David in Pasien a giing hi; ama in, “Keima’ kep dingin Pasien’ singkuong bangci puoh thei ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in ama’ kep dingin David khuopi-ah tua singkuong a la sih hi. Ama in tua tangin Obed-edom’ inn ah Git-te a tut hi."},"14":{"text":"Obed-edom innkuon tawh Pasien’ singkuong hla thum sung om a, Topa in Obed-edom’ innkuon le a nei zosie thupha a pie hi.","ref":"1Khg 26:4-5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tyre kumpipa Hiram in David ading inn khat lampieh dingin ama kungah kamtaite sawlin taamtah singluongte, leilesuong innlam siemte le khutsiemte a puoh hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah David Zungkip (2Sam 5:11-16)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Israel tunga kumpi dingin ama a kipsah lam le a mi Israel a khuolna ziehin, David in ama’ kumpi gam a kitawisang lam David in thei hi."},"3":{"text":"David in Jerusalem ah zi nei be a, ama in tapate le tanute a nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jerusalem-a a nei a tate’ min ahi hi: Shammua, Shobab, le Nathan, Solomon,"},"5":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, le Elpelet,"},"6":{"text":"Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;"},"7":{"text":"Elishama, Beeliada, le Eliphelet ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi zosie tungah kumpi dingin David sathau a kinu lamtah Philistia-te in a zah ciengun David sui dingin Philistia mi zosie a kuonto uhi; tuale David in tua thu za-in amate sim dingin a kuon hi.","title":"Philistia-te Kizawna (2Sam 5:17-25)"},"9":{"text":"Tu-in Philistia-te pei-in Rephaim kuom sung a bulu uhi."},"10":{"text":"David in Pasien dong a, “Philistia-te do dingin ka kuonto diei mah? Ka khut sungah amate nei pie diei mah?” a ci hi. Topa in ama kungah, “Kuonto in, na khut sungah amate kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Baal-perazim ah David kuonto-in khum tahah amate a zo hi. David in, “Tuikhang in a phuhkhe bangin Pasien in keima’ khut tawh ka galte a phukhe ta hi,” a ci hi. Tua ziehin khum mun pen Baal-perazim kici hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in khum munah a pasien-te uh nuasie-in David’ thupiehna tawh tuate kihal hi."},"13":{"text":"Philistia-te kuonin kuom sung khatvei a bulukia uhi."},"14":{"text":"David in Pasien dongkia a, Pasien in ama kungah, “Amau’ nua-ah na kuonto sih ding hi; kuolpei inlen lungli kungte’ galkhat lam pan amate sim in."},"15":{"text":"Lungli kungte dawnah kalsuon huging na zah ciengin gal sim dingin pei in; azieh pen Philistia galkapte vatmai dingin na mai-ah Pasien a kuon zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasien’ thupieh bangin David gamta a, Gibeon panin Gezer cieng dong Philistia galkapte a vatmai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Gam zosie-ah David’ minthanna kizel a, Topa in minam zosie tungah ama giinna a tungsah hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in ama adingin David’ khuopi sungah innte lam a, ama in Pasien’ singkuong adingin mun khat siemin puonbuh khat a lampieh hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Singkuong Kipuo (2Sam 6:12-16)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in amate, “ Topa’ singkuong a puo ding le kum tawna ama’ na a sem dingin a teelsa ahi ziehin Levi-te simlo koima in Topa’ singkuong puo thei lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:8"},"3":{"text":"Ama in a bawlsa ama om nading munah Topa’ singkuong a puoto dingin David in Jerusalem-a om Israel mi zosie khawmtuo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Aaron le Levi suonlehlah a khopte:"},"5":{"text":"Kohath tapate sung pan uhpi Uriel, a sanggamte mi za le sawmni tawh;"},"6":{"text":"Merari tapate sung pan uhpi Asaiah, a sanggamte mi zani le sawmni tawh;"},"7":{"text":"Gershom tapate sung pan uhpi Joel, a sanggamte mi za le sawmthum tawh;"},"8":{"text":"Elizaphan tapate sung pan uhpi Shemaiah, a sanggamte mi zani tawh;"},"9":{"text":"Hebron tapate sung pan uhpi Eliel, a sanggamte mi sawmgiet tawh;"},"10":{"text":"Uzziel tapate sung pan uhpi Amminadab, a sanggamte mi za le sawm le ni tawh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"David in siempute Zadok le Abiathar, le Levi-te ahi Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, le Amminadab hlanin"},"12":{"text":"amate kungah, “No pen Levi-te’ be lutangte na hi uhi; ama adinga ka bawlsa munah Topa’ singkuong na puohto thei nadingun noma le na sanggamte kisiensuo tawm un."},"13":{"text":"Note in a masa lai-in na puoh lo ziehun Topa i Pasien uh’ lungthahna i tung vuah a pawhzah hi. Azieh pen eite in hoitahin i don sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel Pasien, Topa’ singkuong a puoto dingin siempute le Levi-te a kisiensuo tawm uhi."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ kammal tawh kizui-in Moses thupiehsa bangin Levi-te in a liengko vuah a zawlte tawh Topa’ singkuong a puo uhi.","ref":"Pei 25:14"},"16":{"text":"David in kipahna aw a gin thei nadingin lasahna vanzahte, harp lasahna le lyre lasahnate le a daltuote tumin la sa dingin Levi uhpite kungah amau’ sanggamte a se nadingin thu a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Levi-te in Joel’ tapa Heman a se uhi; tuale a sanggamte sung panin Berechiah’ tapa Asaph, Merari minam sung sung panin a sanggamte uh Kushaiah’ tapa Ethan,"},"18":{"text":"tuale amate tawh a pawl nina-in Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, le Mikneiah, le kotcingte Obed-edom le Jeiel-te a se uhi."},"19":{"text":"Lasate ahi Heman, Asaph, le Ethan-te in sumngo daltuote a tum ding uhi;"},"20":{"text":"Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, le Benaiah-te in a peisuoh aw-in harp lasahna a tum ding uhi;"},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeil, le Azaziah -te in lyre lasahnate aw-un tawh makai ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Levi-te sung panin la makaipa Chenaniah pen lasah a siem ziehin la hilin a pang hi."},"23":{"text":"Berechiah le Elkanah-te pen singkuong adingin kotcingte ahi ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, le Eliezar-te pen siempute ahi vua, amate in Pasien’ singkuong mai-ah pengkulte a tum ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Obed-edom’ inn panin lungdamna tawh Topa’ singkuong a puoto dingin David le Israel upate, le a tul uhte a pei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puo Levi-te pen Pasien in a panpi ziehin amate in bawngtang sagi le tuutang sagi tawh biehpiehna a pie uhi."},"27":{"text":"David in puontuolpi hoi khat sil a , tua ma bangin singkuong a puo Levi-te zosie, lasate, le lasate makai Chenaniah-te in zong a sil uhi; tuale David in siempu puon khat sil hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel mi zosie in saki, pengkulte, le daltuo gingte tawh kituohin awngin Topa’ Thuciemna Singkuong peipi to-in harp lasahnate le lyre lasahnate tawh nahpitahin la a sa uhi."},"29":{"text":"David khuopi sungah Topa’ Thuciemna Singkuong a tun laitahin, tawlet panin Saul’ tanu Michal a khuodah leh Kumpi David lamin diengin a op lam mu hi; tuale ama in a lungsim sungah ama a nau-et hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ singkuong a sung tumpi vua, David in ama adinga a lam puonbuh sungah a koi uhi; tuale amate in Pasien mai-ah meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate a pie uhi.","title":"Puonbuh ah Singkuong Kikoi (2Sam 6:17-19)"},"2":{"text":"David in meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate a pieh zaw ciengin Topa’ min tawh mite thupha a pie hi;"},"3":{"text":"tuale ama in Israel mi zosie tungah numei le pasal a kibangin, anlum khat, sa tanh khat, le lenggagaw khat ciet a hawm hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ singkuong mai-ah na a sem ding, thu a ngen ding, lungdam a ko ding, le Israel Pasien, Topa a pawh dingin Levi-te pawlkhat se hi."},"5":{"text":"A makaipi Asaph, a nina-ah harp lasahnate le lyre lasahnate a tum ding pen Zachariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, le Jeiel-te ahi uhi; Asaph in daltuote tum ding a,"},"6":{"text":"tuale siempute ahi Benaiah le Jehaziel in a hunhunin Pasien’ thuciemna singkuong mai-ah pengkul mut ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in khum ni-in Topa tunga lungdamna la sa dingin Asaph le a sanggamte nasep a guon masa hi.","title":"David’ Lungdamkona La (Late 96:1-13 ; 105:1-15 ; 106:1 , 47-48)"},"8":{"text":"Topa kungah nuom thu tut un, ama’ min lo unlen, ama’ nasep teng mite lahah kitheisah un."},"9":{"text":"Ama kungah la sa un, ama pawhna la sa unlen, a lamdang a sepnate zosie mite kungah gen un."},"10":{"text":"A min siengtho sungah kisathei unlen; Topa a suite’ lungsim nuom taheh."},"11":{"text":"Topa le a thahatna sui unlen, ama’ ompina sui zing un."},"12":{"text":"Ama’ sepsa a lamdangte, ama’ na lamdang bawlte le a genkhiet a thukhennate phawh un."},"13":{"text":"A nasem Israel’ suonte, a teeltuom Jacob’ tate aw phawh gige un."},"14":{"text":"Ama pen eite’ Topa Pasien ahi a, leitung muncin tengah a thukhennate a dim hi."},"15":{"text":"“Keima in gouluo-a na tanh dingin Canaan gam kang pie ding hi,” ci-in, Abraham tawh a bawl a thuciemna, Isaac tungah kiciemin a kam khap, Jacob tungah thukham bang le Israel tungah tawntung thuciemna banga a suhkip, khang tulkhat dong adinga a thupieh a kammalte phawh zing un. Amate tawmno khat ahi vua, khum gam sungah a kisim tham lo khuolmi ahi lai-un,","merge":"16"},"20":{"text":"gam khat pan gam khat, kumpi gam khat pan adang khatah a vavaih lai-un,"},"21":{"text":"amate koima’ gawt ding phal loin amate vangin kumpite hosie a,"},"22":{"text":"“Ka sathau nusa mite khoikha sih unlen, ka kamsangte zong bangma law sih un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 20:3-7"},"23":{"text":"Leisiet mi zosie aw, Topa tungah la sa un. Ni khat zaw ni khat ama’ hutdamna thu sutsut un."},"24":{"text":"Minamte lahah ama’ minthanna gen unlen, a lamdang ama’ nasepte mi zosie lahah gen un."},"25":{"text":"Bang zieh ahei cile Topa lien mama a, ama nahpi taha pawh ding ahi hi; ama pen pasien-te zosie sangin zatah zawh ding ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Bang zieh ahei cile mite’ pasien-te ahile milim kikheng ahi bo a, hizongle Topa in vantungte a bawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama’ masangah patawina le thupina om a; thahatna le kipahna in ama’ munah a om hi."},"28":{"text":"Minamte innkuonte aw, Topa tungah minthanna le thahatna pie un."},"29":{"text":"A nga ding kilawm minthanna Topa tungah pie un; biehna peipi unlen, ama mai-ah pei un. Puon siengtho silin Topa bie un;"},"30":{"text":"leitung mi zosie aw, ama mai-ah citun un. Leitung kisukip a, kikhin ngai lo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Vantungte lungdam hinlen, leitung zong kipah taheh. Amate in minamte lahah, “ Topa kumpi hi!” ci ta uheh."},"32":{"text":"Tuipi le a sunga om teng hawh vapo uh hinlen; gamlah le a sunga om zosie lungdam kipah ta uheh."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin gamlah singte kipahin Topa’ mai-ah la sa ding uhi. Azieh pen leitung thukhen dingin ama a pei hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdam ko un; azieh pen ama hoi hi; bang zieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"35":{"text":"“Ka hundampa uh Pasien aw, kote ei hundam inlen, minamte lah panin ei kaikhawmin ei hunkhie in. Na min siengtho tungah lungdam kang ko thei nading ule, nangma phatna-ah ka kisah thei nadingun kote ei hundam in."},"36":{"text":"Israel Pasien Topa in a tawntung panin a tawntung dongin thupha nga taheh, zong ci un,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin mi zosie in “Amen!” ci-in Topa a phat uhi."},"37":{"text":"David in a kisam bangin singkuong mai-ah nisiela na sem dingin Topa’ thuciemna singkuong mai-ah Asaph le a unaute nuasie a,","title":"Biehpiehna Kizang Suoh"},"38":{"text":"Obed-edom le ama’ unau mi sawmguh le giet zong nuasie hi. Jeduthun’ tapa Obed-edom le Hosah-te pen kotcing dingte ahi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ thukham sunga kigiel zosie bangin Israel a thupiehsa tawh kizui-in, zingmawng nitahin meihal biehna maitam tungah Topa adinga meihal biehnate a pie den dingin Gibeon-a om munsang ahi Topa’ biehbuh mai-ah siempu Zadok le a sanggam siempute a nuasie hi.","merge":"40"},"41":{"text":"Amate tawh Heman le Jeduthun zong om a, ama’ itna kip kumtawnin a op ziehin Topa kungah kipahna thu tut dinga kiteel, a min tawh a kilo midangte omlai hi."},"42":{"text":"Heman le Jeduthun in la-aw dingin pengkulte le daltuote a nei vua, la siengtho sah nading lasahna vanzahte zong a nei uhi. Jeduthun’ tapate tunkot cing dingin kise hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi zosie a inn lam ciet vuah pei-in a kikhen vua, David zong a innkuonpite thupha pie dingin a inn lamah a pei hi.","ref":"2Sam 6:19-20"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in David a inn ah a ten cieng in ama in kamsang Nathan kungah, “Taamtah inn sungah kei ka teng a, hinanle Topa’ Thuciemna Singkuong puonbuh nei-ah a om hi,” a ci hi.","title":"David tawh Pasien’ Thuciemna (2Sam 7:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Nathan in David kungah, “Pasien in nang hing ompi ahi ziehin na lungsim sunga om zosie bawl in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua zan ma-in Nathan kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"4":{"text":"Pei inlen, ka nasempa David kungah tam bangin gen in: Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Nangma in keima’ ten nading biehinn na lam sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel ka peipi ni-a kipanin tuni dong biehinn sungah ka teng sih a, hinanle puonbuh sung le biehbuh sungah ka teng hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi zosie lahah ka kikhinna popo-ah ka mite a cing dinga thu ka pieh Israel thukhente khatpo kungah, “Bang dingin taamtah biehinn khat keima dingin ei lampieh lo na hei?” ci-in kam khat beh ka gen ngai ta amah?’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in ka nasempa David kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tuuhonte na zuina panin ka mi Israel tunga uhpa ahi dingin lonona panin nangma kang la hi;"},"8":{"text":"tuale na peina popo-ah nang kang ompi zo ta a, na mai-ah na galte zosie ka sumaimang hi. Tuale leitunga miliente khat min bangin nang adingin min khat kang bawlpieh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mi Israel adingin mun khat ka se ding a, a mun ciet vuah a ten thei nadingun amate ka phut ding hi; tuale nidang lai-a migilote bawl bangin bawl nawn loin,"},"10":{"text":"ka mi Israel tungah thukhente ka koi huna kipanin amate a thanemsah nawn sih ding uhi; keima in na gal zosie uh ka zogawp ding hi. Tua tham loin Topa in na inn ding ang lampieh ding hi, ci-in nang tungah kang pulah hi."},"11":{"text":"Na hinkhuo tawpin na pu na pate tawh na opton ciengin keima in nangma’ nua-ah na tapate khat ka khangsah ding a, na kumpi gam ka sudet ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in keima adingin biehinn khat ei lampieh ding a, keima in a kumpi topha ka phut den ding hi"},"13":{"text":"Kei ama’ pa ka hi ding a, ama keima’ tapa ahi ding hi. Nangma masanga a sempa kung panin ka itna kip ka lahdawh bangin ama kung panin ka ladawh nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"2Cor 6:18; Heb 1:5"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka inn sung le ka kumpi gam sungah ama ka sukip ding a, a kum tawnin a kumpi topha kip den ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tami kammal zosie le tami kihilna zosie dung zui-in Nathan in David kungah a gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi David sungtumin Topa mai-ah to a, “ Topa Pasien aw, nang in tam cieng donga nei tunpi dingin kei koi ka hi a, ka innkuonte bang ahi ahei?","title":"David’ Thungetna (2Sam 7:18-29)"},"17":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma’ muna-ah tami khu thu neuno khat ahi lel bo hi; nangma in hun sawtpi khat cienga ang tung ding na nasempa’ innsung thu tawh kisai zong na gen zo ta hi. Nangma in keima mi thupi khat bangin nei ngaisun hi, Topa Pasien aw!"},"18":{"text":"Na nasempa na patawina ziehin David in nang tungah bang ang gen be thei lai ding ahei? Na nasempa nangma in na thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasempa na khuolna le nangma’ lungsim bangin tam nasep lienpi zosie na bawl zo ta a, tam na lienpite zosie na kitheisah zo ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka bil utawh ka zah uh dung zui-in, Topa aw, nangma tawh a kibang koima a om sih a, nangma simlo Pasien dang a om sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt pana na tatkhiet na mite mai-ah minamte notmangin nangma adingin a lien a zauhuoi min khat na bawlna, Pasien pei-in ama’ mi dinga a tatkhiet na mi Israel tawh a kibang leitungah minam dang koi om ahei?"},"22":{"text":"Na mi Israel-te kumtawna nangma’ mi ahi dingin na bawl hi; tuale Topa aw, nang pen amau’ Pasien na suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tuale tu-in, Topa aw, na nasempa le a innsung tungtang thu na gensa thu khantawnin kip hinlen, na khapsa bangin hing bawl ta’n."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangin, ‘Israel Pasien, Vanglien Topa khu Israel-te’ Pasien hi,’ ci-in khantawnin na min kisuhkipin kiliensah zing ding hi; tuale nangma mai-ah na nasempa David’ innkuonte kisukip ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma ka Pasien in na nasempa adingin biehinn khat na lampieh ding ama tungah na lah zo ta hi. Tua ahi ziehin na nasempa in nangma mai-ah thu nget thei dingin ang mu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuale tu-in Topa aw, nang Pasien na hi a, na nasempa kungah tami sil hoi na kamciem zo hi;"},"27":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin nangma mai-ah na nasempa’ innkuonte kumtawnin a om zing thei nadingin thupha na pieh ding hing lungkim in. Azieh pen Topa aw, na thupha piehte kumtawna thupha nga ahi uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun phabep khat zaw ciengin David in Philistia-te simin amate a zo hi; ama in Philistia-te kung panin Gath le a khuoneute a la hi.","title":"David in A Kumpi Gam Keh (2Sam 8:1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Moab-te zo a, Moab-te David’ nasem suohin sieh le kaih a pie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Euphrates gunah gamgi phut dingin Hamath lam manaw-in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer a pei ciengin David in ama na do-in a zo hi."},"4":{"text":"David in ama kung panin leeng galkap tulkhat, sakol galkap tulsagi, le lei galkap tul sawmni a la hi. David in leengkai sakolte zosie’ kapzahui a atsanpieh a, hinanle leeng zakhat kai khop ding a hen hi."},"5":{"text":"Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer a panpi dingin Damascus-ah Aram-te a pei ciengin David in Aram-te tul sawmni le tulni that hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Aram gam Damascus ah khuocingte koi hi; tuale Aram-te pen David’ nasem suohin sieh le kaih a puoh uhi. Topa in David a peina popo-ah guolzawna a pie hi."},"7":{"text":"David in Hadadezer’ nasemte in a puoh kham lumte la-in Jerusalem ah peipi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hadadezer’ khuopite ahi Tibhath le Cun panin David in sumngo tampi tah la hi; Solomon in tuate tawh sumngo tuikuongpi, khuompite, le sumngo umlebeelte a bawl hi.","ref":"1Kum 7:40-47; 2Khg 4:11-18"},"9":{"text":"David in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer’ galkap buppi a zawna thu Hamath kumpipa Tou in a zah ciengin,"},"10":{"text":"ama in Hadadezer simin a zaw ziehin ama a hopi ding le a kipahpi dingin Kumpi David kungah a tapa Hadoram a sawl hi. Tu-in Hadadezer le Tou gal kido thei zel uhi. Ama in kham, ngun, le sumngo tawh a kibawl na namkim puoh a,"},"11":{"text":"kumpi David in Edom, Moab, Ammon-te, Philistia-te, le Amalek, minam zosie kung panin a puoh ngun le khamte tawh Topa kungah tam teng zong a apton hi."},"12":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Abishai in Ci Kuompi ah Edom-te tul sawm le tulgiet that hi.","ref":"1Kum 7:40-47; 2Khg 4:11-18"},"13":{"text":"Ama in Edom ah khuocingte koi hi; tuale Edom-te zosie David’ nasem a suoh uhi. Topa in a peina popo-ah David guolzawna a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel mi zosie tungah David a maang hi; tuale ama in ama’ mi zosie tungah thuman le thutang tawh vai a hawm hi.","title":"David’ Vaihawmna (2Sam 8:15-18)"},"15":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Joab pen galkap makai ahi hi; Ahilud’ tapa Jehoshaphat pen thuciemte pa ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahitub’ tapa Zadok le Abiathar’ tapa Ahimelech pen siempute ahi vua, Shavsha pen thuvanpi pa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah pen Chereth-te le Peleth-te tunga a uh ahi uhi; tuale David’ tapate pen kumpipa’ nasepna ah ulien pente ahi uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun phabep zaw ciengin Ammon- te’ Kumpipa Nahash si a, a tapa in ama’ za luo hi.","title":"Ammon-te le Aram-te Kizawna (2Sam 10:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"David in, “Ka tunga a pa ang thuman gamtat ziehin Nahash’ tapa Hanun tungah thumanin ka gamta ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n David in a pa vai tawh kisai-in ama a henem dingin kamtaite a sawl hi. David’ nasemte ama henem dingin Ammon-te’ gam Hanun kungah a pei ciengun,"},"3":{"text":"Ammon-te’ uliente in Hanun kungah, “David in na kungah mi henemte ang sawl ziehin na pa a patawi hi, ci-in na ngaisun amah? Gam sung a phetlet ding, a lumlet ding le a endap dinga nangma kunga a nasemte ang pei hi lel lo uh amah?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hanun in David’ nasemte man a, a khamul uh heukieupiehin a pheizum laikim cieng vuah a puon uh tansanin amate a sawlmang hi;"},"5":{"text":"tuale amate a pei uhi. David kungah tam mite thu a kigen ciengin ama in amate kungah kamtaite a sawl hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tua mite nahpitahin maizum uhi. Kumpipa in, “Na khamul uh a saukia masang Jericho ah hing om phot tadi unlen, tua ciengin hing kilekia un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"David’ muda thei dinga Ammon-te a kibawltawmna uh amau le amau a kimu ciengun Mesopotamia, Aram-maacah, le Zobah-te panin leeng galkapte guoi nadingin Hanun le Ammon-te in ngun talent tulkhat a hlah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in leeng galkap tul sawmthum le tulni le a galkapte tawh Maacah kumpipa a ciel vua, amate pei-in Medeba khuo mai-ah giephuol a sat uhi. A khuopi panun Ammon-te kikhawmin gal sim dingin a kuon uhi."},"8":{"text":"David in tua thu a zah ciengin Joab le galkap galhang zosie a sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Ammon-te pusuohin khuopi lutna-ah gal do dingin a kiguol vua, tuaci’n a kuon kumpite in gamlahah panmun a la uhi."},"10":{"text":"Joab in ama sim dinga a mai le a nua-a a kiguol galte a mu ciengin ama in zong Israel mi teltuom pawlkhat teel a, Aram-te sim dingin a kiguolsah hi;"},"11":{"text":"ama in a omlai a galkapte a sanggampa Abishai in uhsah a, Ammon-te do dingin a kiguol uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei adinga Aram-te a hat seng uleh nang in kei nei hu ding a, hizongle nang adinga Ammon-te a hat seng uleh ke’n nang kang hu ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kihatsah inlen, i mite ading le i Pasien’ khuopite adingin hangsan vai; Topa in hoi a sah bangin hing bawl taheh,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Joab le ama kunga om galkapte in gal kido dingin Aram-te lam a nai uhi; tuale amate zong ama mai-ah a taimang uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aram-te a taimang uh Ammon-te in a mu ciengun, tua bang ma-in amate Joab’ sanggampa Abishai mai-ah a tai vua, khuopi sung a lut uhi. Tua ciengin Jerusalem ah Joab a pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle Aram-te in Israel-te a lel lam a kithei ciengun amate in zong kamtaite sawlin Euphrates galkhat a om Aram-te a peipi vua, amau’ makai dingin Hadadezer’ galkapmangpa Shophach a koi uhi."},"17":{"text":"David kungah tami thu a kigen ciengin ama in Israel zosie kaikhawmin Jordan galkai a, a kung vuah pei-in amate tawh kisi dingin a galkapte a khawm hi. Aram-te do dingin David in amate kiguolsah a, amate in ama a do uhi."},"18":{"text":"Israel mai-ah Aram-te a taimang uhi; tuiale David in Aram’ leenghawl galkap mi tulsagi, le lei galkap tul sawmli that a, a galkapmangpa Shophak zong that hi."},"19":{"text":"Hadadezer’ nasemte in Israel a lel lam uh a kithei ciengun, David tawh kilemna bawlin a khut nei mi a suoh uhi. Tuaci’n Aram-te in Ammon-te a hu nuom nawn sih uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum kum khuokhal sungin gal sim dingin kumpite a kuon hunin Joab in galkapte pui-in Ammon-te’ gam a susie vua, tuale pei-in Rabbah a imtawm uhi. Hinanle Jerusalem ah David a om hi. Joab in Rabbah simin a thalpai hi.","title":"Rabbah Simna le Lahna (2Sam 11:1 ; 12:26-31)","ref":"2Sam 11:1"},"2":{"text":"David in ama’ lu tung panin Milcom’ kumpi lukhu a lahpieh hi; tua lukhu pen kham talent khat gih a, a sungah suong manpha khat a op lam ama in thei hi; tuale ama in tua lukhu David a khusah hi. Ama in khuopi sunga van kinuasie tampite zong peipi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in tua sunga om mite a peipi a, sing-atte, tuzumte, le heite tawh na sem dingin amate koi hi. Ammon-te’ khuopi zosie-ah tua bangin David in a bawl hi. Tua ciengin David le mi zosie Jerusalem ah a kilekia uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin Gezer ah Philistia-te tawh gal dona om hi; tua ciengin Hushath-te Sibbecai in migolte’ suonlehlahte khat ahi Sippai that hi; tuale ama in a khut nei-ah Philistia-te koi hi.","title":"Philistia-te Dona (2Sam 21:15-22)"},"5":{"text":"Philistia-te tawh khatvei kidona omkia hi; tuale Jair’ tapa Elhanan in a teipi kung siemgante’ siemlawngpi cie a pha Git-te Goliath’ sanggampa Lahmi that hi.","ref":"1Sam 17:4-7"},"6":{"text":"A khut lang tuohah khutme guh le a keng lang tuohah kengme guh, a unpi-a sawmni le li a nei, mi thagol khat a opna Gath ah gal a omkia hi; ama zong mi thagolte’ hlahlesuon khat ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Israel a tawh ciengin David’ sanggampa Shimea’ tapa Jonathan in ama that hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam teng Gath-a mi thagolte’ suonlehlahte ahi uhi; amate pen David le a nasemte’ khutlum tawh a si sieng uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te do dingin Satan ding a, tuale Israel mi phaza sim dingin David hantawh hi.","title":"Misimna le Pulnatna (2Sam 24:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in Joab le galkapmang teng kungah, “Pei un, Beer-sheba pan Dan cieng dong Israel-te va sim ta unlen, bangza pha uh ahei ci ka thei nadingin ka kungah ei zasah un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joab in, “ Topa in a mite a za zakhatin khangsah taheh! Ka pu kumpipa aw, amate a unpi-un ka pu’ nasemte hi lo uh amah? Tua ahile bang dinga ka pu in tami kisam na sah ahei? Bang dingin Israel tungah mawna tun ding na hi ahei?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa thugen in Joab a zothaw zaw hi. Tuaci’n Joab dingin Israel gamsung zosie tuon suohin pei a, Jerusalem ah a kilekia hi."},"5":{"text":"Joab in mipi kisimna phaza a unpi-in David kungah a pie hi. Israel buppi sungah namsau tawi mi awn khat le sang khat om a, Judah sungah namsau tawi mi tul zali le tul sawmsagi om hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Joab in a mi simna ah Levi le Benjamin halkha lo hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama in kumpipa’ thupieh pen kidahhuoi a sa hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin tami thu-ah Pasien lungkim lo a, ama in Israel a vatgawp hi."},"8":{"text":"David in Pasien kungah, “Tami ka bawlna-ah ka khiel seng ta hi. Ahi vangin nangma kungah tu-in kang tau hi, na nasempa’ mawnate lamang ta’n; azieh pen mothuoitahin ka gamta zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in David’ thumu pa Gad kungah thu gen a,"},"10":{"text":"“Pei inlen David kungah, ‘ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Nangma tungah thu thum kang pie hi. Nangma tunga ka bawl ding tuate lahah khat teel in, ci hi,’ va ci tan,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n David kungah Gad haw a, ama kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi, ‘Na dei pen teel in:"},"12":{"text":"Kum thum sung kielpi ang tun nading; ahi sihle na galte’ namsau in ang nuaphah laitahin na galte in hla thum sung ang suhsiet nading; ahi sihle gam sungah pul natna ang tun nading, Topa’ vantungmi in Israel gam sung teng zosie-ah ni thum sung ang suhsiet nading Topa’ namsau,’ ci hi. Keima ei sawlpa kungah bangci dawnkia ding ka hei, tu-in khensat in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in Gad kungah, “Ka lung a nah gim mama hi; a hepina lien mama ahi ziehin Topa’ khut sungah ei puasah in; ahi vangin mihing’ khut sungah ei puasah sin,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Israel tungah pul natna tungsah a, Israel mi tul sawmsagi a si hi."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem a susie dingin Pasien in vantungmi khat sawl hi; ahi vangin a suhsiet kuon ciengin Topa in phawhkha a, tua tuosietna tawh kisai-in a lungsim khiem hi; ama in a susie vantungmi kungah, “Pha zo ta! Na khut ladawh ta’n,” a ci hi. Tua laitahin Jebus-te Ornan’ ancilna gei-ah Topa’ vantungmi a ding hi."},"16":{"text":"David a khuodah leh leitung le vantung kikalah Topa’ vantungmi ding a, ama’ khut sungah namsau khat dawhsa-in Jerusalem tung lamah a khut zam a mu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale David in Pasien kungah, “Mite sim dinga thu a pie pa keima hi lo ka mah? Mawna bawlin a gitlo gamtat mama pa khu keima ka hi hi; ahi vangin tami tuute in bang bawlkhiel nei uh ahei? Topa ka Pasien aw, kang thum hi, keima le ka innkuonte ei gawt zaw inlen, na mite tungah pul natna hing tungsah sin!” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi in Gad kungah David va peito hinlen Jebus-te Ornan’ ancilna phuolah Topa ading maitam khat lampieh heh ci-in a gen dingin a sawl hi.","title":"David’ Maitam le Biehpiehna (2Sam 24:18-25)"},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ min tawh a gen Gad’ thuhilna bang zui-in David a kuonto hi."},"20":{"text":"Ornan a kinua hei leh tua vantungmi mu hi; tuale ama tawh a omton a tapa lite a kiphuol vua, Ornan in a ancil maban a zom hi."},"21":{"text":"Ornan kungah David a tun ciengin Ornan khuodah a, tuale David a mu hi; a ancilna panin ama pusuohin a mai tuolkunin David tungah zatahna a pie hi."},"22":{"text":"David in Ornan kungah, “Mite sung panin pul natna a ven thei nadingin Topa adingin maitam khat ka lam nadingin na ancilna mun ei pie in. A manza a kimtahin la inlen ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ornan in David kungah, “Kilah in; ka pu kumpipa in hoi na sah bangin bawl in; en in, keima in meihal biehnate-a zah ding bawngtangte, a sing ding ancilna singte, le an tawh biehna dingin mangbute a unpi-in kang pie hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Kumpi David in Ornan kungah, “Hi lo hi, a manza a kimin pie-in kang lei ding ahi bo hi. Topa adingin nangma-a’ ka la sih ding a, keima sum tawp loin meihal biehnate zong ka pie sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n David in a mun lei nadingin Ornan tungah kham shekel zaguh a gih a pie hi."},"26":{"text":"David in khum munah Topa adingin maitam khat lam a, meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate a pie hi. Ama in Topa kungah thu ngen a, vantung panin meihal biehna maitam tungah mei tawh ama a dawng hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in vantungmi thupie a, a pai sungah a namsau a sietkia hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua hunin Jebus-te Ornan’ ancilna phuolah Topa in ama’ thungetna a dawn lam David in a mu ciengin ama in zong tua munah biehpiehna a bawl hi.","title":"Biehinn Mun Ding Kiteel"},"29":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile gamlahah Moses in a na bawlsa Topa’ biehbuh le meihal biehna maitam pen khum hunin Gibeon muol vumah a om hi;"},"30":{"text":"hizongle Topa’ vantungmi’ namsau giing ahi ziehin Pasien dong dingin tua munah David pei ngam lo hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in, “Tam munah Topa Pasien’ biehinn om ding a, tam munah Israel mite’ meihal biehna maitam om ding hi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"David in Israel gam sunga om gamdang mite a kikaikhop nadingun thu pie a, Pasien’ biehinn lam nading a kikhengsa suongte bawl dingin suongkhengte a koi hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Lam Nading David Kigingkhol"},"3":{"text":"David in tunkot kotkhah-a zah dingin siatuhkil le a kil nading sia tampi koi-in, a kite zo lo sumngo tampi zong a pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Taamtah singte a phaza simzawh hi lo hi; azieh pen Sidon-te le Tyre-te in David kungah taamtah tampi tah a puoh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile David in, “Ka tapa Solomon pen naupang lai-in bangma a thei nai sih a, Topa adinga kilam ding biehinn pen lah thupi-in gamcin tengah minthangin a vangnei ding ahi hi; tua ahi ziehin tuami adingin keima ka kigingkhol ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n David a si masangin na tampitah a koikhol hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a tapa Solomon hlan a, Israel Pasien, Topa adingin biehinn khat lam nading thu a pie hi.","title":"Solomon le Makaite’ Kunga David’ Kam Vaihlah"},"7":{"text":"David in Solomon kungah, “Ka ta aw, Topa ka Pasien’ min dingin biehinn khat lam ding ka gel zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung a, ‘Nangma in sisan na tam luonsah zo ta a, gal lienpi na do zo hi; nang in ka min dingin biehinn na lam sih ding hi, azieh pen keima muna leitungah sisan tampi na luongsah zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"En in, nangma sung panin tapa khat ang pieng ding hi; ama pen kilemna mi hi ding hi. Keima in a kimvela a om galte sung panin ama kilemna ka pie ding hi; azieh pen ama’ min Solomon hi ding a, ama’ hun sungin Israel tungah kilemna le daina ka pie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in ka min dingin biehinn khat a lam ding hi. Ama ka tapa hi ding a, kei ama’ pa ka hi ding hi; Israel sungah ama’ kumpi topha ka kipsah peisuoh ding hi,’ ei ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-16; 1Khg 17:1-14"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ka ta aw, ama in nang tawh kisai a gensa bangin Topa na Pasien’ biehinn lamna-ah na lawcin thei nadingin Topa in nangma hing ompi taheh."},"12":{"text":"Ama in Israel tungah thuneina ang pieh ciengin Topa na Pasien’ thukham na zui thei nadingin Topa in nangma tungah thukhen siemna pilna le thu theitelna hing pie taheh."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel adinga Topa in Moses kungah a pieh thukhamte le biehna ngaina kipte na zui siem nah leh na maa a vang ding hi. Thakhauh inlen hang in. Zau malmal sinlen lungkie sin.","ref":"Josh 1:6-9"},"14":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn dinga keima in gim le tawl thuohin kham talent tul zakhat, ngun talent awn khat, le a kite zo lo sumngo le siate ka koi zo hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tuate khu a tam mama a, keima in note single suongte zong kang pie zo hi; nangma in tam teng na belap ding ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma in nasem mi tampi na nei hi: Suongkhengte, leilesuong innlam siemte, khutsiemte, le sim zawh lo siemna nam zosie a nei,"},"16":{"text":"kham, ngun, sumngo, le sia nasep siemte na nei ding hi. Tu-in na sep kipan in. Topa in hing ompi taheh,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"David in a tapa Solomon a panpi dingin Israel makai zosie thu pie a,"},"18":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasien uh note tawh hing om hi lo amah? Ama in na kimvel zosie vuah kilemna hing pie hi lo amah? Azieh pen keima’ khut sungah gam sunga teng mite ei pie zo hi; tuale Topa le a mite mai-ah tua gam kizo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in Topa na Pasien uh a sui dingin na lungsim ule na lungtang uh kipsah un. Topa’ min dinga kilam biehinn sungah Topa’ thuciemna singkuong le Pasien’ vanzah siengthote a kipeipi thei nadingin pei unlen Topa Pasien’ biehinn lam un,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David vuoi-in kum tampi a phah ciengin Israel tungah kumpi dingin a tapa Solomon koi hi.","title":"Levi Innkuonte le Amau’ Nasepte","ref":"1Kum 1:1-40"},"2":{"text":"David in Israel makai zosie le siempute le Levi-te a kikhawmsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Levi-te kum sawmthum pan a tungsie teng kisim a, a kigawm mi tul sawmthum le tulgiet pha hi."},"4":{"text":"David in, “Tam teng sung panin tul sawmni le tul li in Topa’ biehinn sung nasep uh ding a, tulguhte pen uliente le thukhente ahi ding vua,"},"5":{"text":"tul li pen kotcingte hi-in, tul li in ama phat nadinga ka bawlsa tumtheite tawh Topa tungah phatna pie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"David in Levi tapate tawh kituohin amate tam bangin a pawlpawlin khen hi: Tuate pen Gershon pawl, Kohath pawl, le Merari pawl ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Gershon’ tapate pen Ladan le Shimei ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ladan’ tapate: A uhpi Jehiel, le Zetham, le Joel, thum pha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Shimei’ tapate: Shelomoth, Haziel, le Haran, thum pha uhi. Tam teng pen Ladan innkuonte’ lutangte ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Shimei’ tapate: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, le Beriah. Tam mihing li teng pen Shimei’ tapate ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Zahatha pen uhpi ahi a, Zizah a nina ahi hi; ahi vangin Jeush le Beriah in tapa tampi a nei sih vua, tuaci’n amate innkuon khat bangin kisim hi."},"12":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel, li pha uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amram’ tapate: Aaron le Moses ahi uhi. Ama le a tapate in Topa mai-ah khan tawnin biehna pie-in ama’ na semin, ama’ min tawh thupha a pieh zing thei nadingin a siengpen nate a ap dingin Aaron kituomkoi hi;","ref":"Pei 28:1"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin Pasien’ mipa Moses’ tapate, Levi minam lahah kisim ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses’ tapate: Gershom le Eliezer ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Gershom’ tapate lahah Shebuel a uhpi ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Eliezer’ tapate: Rehabiah a uhpi ahi hi; Eliezer in tapa dang nei lo a, hinanle Rehabiah’ tapate pen a tam mama uhi."},"18":{"text":"Izhar’ tapate: Shelomith a uhpi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hebron’ tapate: Jeriah a uhpi, Amariah a nina, Jahaziel a thumna, le Jekameam a lina ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Uzziel’ tapate: Micah a uhpi, le Isshiah a nina ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Merari’ tapate: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Mahli’ tapate: Eleazar le Kish ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Eleazar tapa nei loin si a, ahi vangin tanu beh a nei hi; amau’ tanau ahi Kish’ tapate in amate a tenpi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mushi’ tapate: Mahli, Eder, le Jeremoth, thum pha uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tam teng pen Topa’ biehinn lam nasepna-ah a sem ding, kum sawmni pan a tungsie, a mimalin a mina mi phaza tawh kituohin a pupa uh’ innkuon zui-a kiciemte Levi’ suonte ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen David in, “Israel Pasien, Topa in a mite tungah tawlngahna pie zo hi; tuale Jerusalem ah ama a om zing hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n Levi-te in biehbuh hile biehna nasep nadingin vanzah dingte hile puoh ngai nawn lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:8"},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen David’ kam nukhia pen dung zui-in tam teng kum sawmni pan a tungsie Levi mi phaza hi a,"},"28":{"text":"“Hinanle amau’ nasep ding pen Topa’ biehinn nasepna-ah Aaron’ suon le hlahte a hu ding vua, biehinn tuolte le biehinn khante kemin, a siengtho ahi nate zosie sawp sieng ding, le Pasien’ biehinn nasepna-ah sep ding khat popo a sem ding uh ahi hi;"},"29":{"text":"anlum guolte, an tawh biehna ding annel, tol saw lo anpheng, a ki-em silpieh, sathau tawh a kihal silpieh, le a phaza ahi sihle a golna tena nasep zosie hu ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in zingmawng sielin dingin lungdam ko-in, Topa a phat ding vua, nitah lamin tua bang ma-in bawlin,"},"31":{"text":"Topa kungah a kul le a poimaw dung zui-in sabbath nite, hladet nite, le pawi nite-ah meihal biehna a kipieh popo ciengin Topa mai-ah om zing ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bangin amate in kikhopna puonbuh le mun siengtho kemin, Topa’ biehinn nasepna ah a tanaute uh ahi Aaron’ suonte a hu ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 3:5-9"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Aaron’ suonle hlahte kisekhen dan ahi hi. Aaron’ tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar.","title":"Siempute Kisekhenna"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin amau’ pa a si masangin Nadab le Abihu a si a, tapate a nei sih uhi; tuaci’n Eleazar le Ithamar-te siempu a suoh uhi.","ref":"Siem 10:1-2"},"3":{"text":"David in a nasepna vuah mawpuohna a kisena dung zui-in amate a se-in khen a, Eleazar’ tapate ahi Zadok le Ithamar’ tapate ahi Ahimelech-te tawh a koi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ithamar’ tapate lah sangin Eleazar’ tapate lahah uhpi a tam zawh ziehin Eleazar’ tapate lahah pupa innkuon lutang sawm le guh koi-in, Ithamar’ tapate sungah giet koi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Eleazar’ tapate le Ithamar’ tapate sungah munsiengtho ulien le Pasien’ ulien om tuoh uh ahi ziehin, amate unpi-in a kibangin aisanna tawh amate a koi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Levi-te Nethanel’ tapa laithei Shemaiah in kumpipa, uliente, siempu Zadok, Abiathar’ tapa Ahimelech, siempute le Levi-te’ pupa innkuon lutangte mai-ah amate ciemte hi;
