Eleazar’ dingin pupa innkuon khat, Ithamar dingin zong pupa innkuon khat ma kiteel hi."},"7":{"text":"Jehoiarib tungah aisanna masa pen, Jedaiah tungah a ni na,"},"8":{"text":"Harim tungah a thumna, Seorim tungah a lina,"},"9":{"text":"Malchijah tungah a ngana, Mijamin tungah a guhna,"},"10":{"text":"Hakkoz tungah a sagina, Abijah tungah a gietna,"},"11":{"text":"Jeshua tungah a kuona, Shecaniah tungah a sawmna,"},"12":{"text":"Eliashib tungah a sawm le khatna, Jakim tungah a sawm le nina,"},"13":{"text":"Huppah tungah a sawm le thumna, Jeshebeab tungah a sawm le lina,"},"14":{"text":"Bilgah tungah a sawm le ngana, Immer tungah a sawm le guhna,"},"15":{"text":"Hezir tungah a sawm le sagina, Happizzez tungah a sawm le gietna,"},"16":{"text":"Pethahiah tungah a sawm le kuona, Jehezkel tungah a sawm nina,"},"17":{"text":"Jachin tungah a sawmni le khatna, Gamul tungah a sawmni le nina,"},"18":{"text":"Delaiah tungah a sawmni le thumna, Maaziah tungah a sawmni le lina tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel Pasien Topa in ama a thupieh bangin a pupi uh Aaron in amate dinga a kipsahsa ngaina dung zui-in Topa’ biehinn sunga a lut dingin tam teng in amau’ nasep dinga kise nasep a nei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Levi’ tapa a omlai teng lahah: Amram’ tapate sung panin Shubael; Shubael’ tapate sung panin Jedeiah.","title":"Adang Levi-te"},"21":{"text":"Rehabiah-te sung panin: uhpi Isshiah."},"22":{"text":"Izhar’ tapate sung panin Shelomoth; Shelomoth’ tapate sung panin Jahath ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hebron’ tapate lahah: Jeriah a uhpi, Amariah a nina, Jahaziel a thumna, Jekameam a lina."},"24":{"text":"Uzziel’ tapate lahah Micah; Micah’ tapate lahah Shamir ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Micah’ sanggampa Isshiah; Isshiah’ tapate sung panin Zechariah ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Merari’ tapate lahah: Mahli, Mushi, le Jaaziah. Jaaziah’ tapate lahah: Beno."},"27":{"text":"Merari’ tapate lahah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, le Ibri."},"28":{"text":"Mahli’ sung panin Eleazar hi a, ama in tapa nei lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Kish lahah: Kish’ tapate Jerahmeel."},"30":{"text":"Mushi’ tapate lahah: Mahli, Eder, le Jerimoth. Tam teng pen amau’ pupa innkuon dung zui-in Levi’ tapate ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in zong a tanaute uh Aaron’ suonlehlahte ma bangin Kumpi David, Zadok, Ahimelech, le siempute le Levi-te’ pupa innkuon lutangte le a uhpipa le a sanggam a neu pen mai-ah ai a san uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David le galkap uliente in zong biehpiehna adingin lyre-te, harp-te, le daltuote tawh kam a sang ding Asaph, Heman, le Jeduthun-te’ tapate a tuomkoi uhi. Na semte le amau’ nasepte tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Biehbuh Tumging Tumsiemte"},"2":{"text":"Asaph’ tapate lah panin: Kumpipa’ lamkaina nei-a Pasien thu a gen Asaph’ makaina nei-ah Asaph’ tapate Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, le Asharelah."},"3":{"text":"Jeduthun’ lahah Jeduthun’ tapate: Lungdam kona le Topa phatna dinga lyre lasahna tawh thu a gen, a pa uh Jeduthun’ makaina nei-ah Gedalaih, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, le Mattithiah, mi guh pha uhi."},"4":{"text":"Heman lah panin Heman’ tapate: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, le Mehazioth."},"5":{"text":"Tam teng zosie Pasien thuciemna bangin ama a tawisang ding ahi kumpipa’ thumu pa Heman’ tapate ahi uhi; azieh pen Pasien in Heman tungah tapa sawm le li le tanu thum a pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate zosie pen a unpi-un Topa’ biehinn sungah daltuote, harp-te, le lyre tawh a pa uh’ makaina nei-ah tumging tumte ahi uhi. Asaph, Jeduthun, le Heman-te pen kumpipa’ thupiehna nei-ah a om uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate le a tanaute uh, Topa dinga lasahna lam a kisin, a unpi-un a siemsa mi zani le sawmgiet le giet a pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale a neu a lien, sie le a sinte a kibangin amau’ nasep ding ai a san uhi."},"9":{"text":"Asaph dingin ai masa pen Joseph tungah tu hi; a nina Geladiah, le a sanggamte, le a tapate sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"10":{"text":"a thumna Zaccur, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"11":{"text":"a lina Izri, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"12":{"text":"a ngana Nethaniah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"13":{"text":"a guhna Bukkiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"14":{"text":"a sagina Jesarelah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"15":{"text":"a gietna Jeshaiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"16":{"text":"a kuona Mattaniah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"17":{"text":"a sawmna Shimei, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"18":{"text":"a sawm le khatna Azarel, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"19":{"text":"a sawm le nina Hashabiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"20":{"text":"a sawm le thumna Shubael, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"21":{"text":"a sawm le lina Mattithiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"22":{"text":"a sawm le ngana Jeremoth, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"23":{"text":"a sawm le guhna Hananiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"24":{"text":"a sawm le sagina Joshbekashah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"25":{"text":"a sawm le gietna Hanani, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"26":{"text":"a sawm le kuona Mallothi, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"27":{"text":"a sawmnina Eliathah, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"28":{"text":"A sawmni le khatna Hothir, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"29":{"text":"a sawmni le nina Giddalti, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"30":{"text":"A sawmni le thumna Mahazioth, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"},"31":{"text":"a sawm ni le lina Romamtiezer, a tapate, le a sanggamte sawm le ni tungah tu hi;"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kotcingte kisekhenna ahile: Korah-te, Asaph’ tapate lah panin Kore’ tapa Meshelemiah.","title":"Kotcingte"},"2":{"text":"Meshelemiah in tapate nei hi: A tacil Zechariah, a nina Jediael, a thumna Zebadiah, a lina Jathniel,"},"3":{"text":"a ngana Elam, a guhna Jehohanan, a sagina Eliehoenai."},"4":{"text":"Obed-edom in tapate nei hi: A tacil Shemaiah, a nina Jehozabad, a thumna Joah, a lina Sachar, a ngana Nethanel,"},"5":{"text":"a guhna Ammiel, a sagina Issachar, a gietna Peullethai ahi hi; azieh pen Pasien in ama thupha a pie hi.","ref":"2Sam 6:11; 1Khg 13:14"},"6":{"text":"A tapa Shemaiah sung panin zong a pupate’ innkuon sungah thunei vaihawm tapate a pieng hi, azieh pen amate siemna lien nei mite ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Shemaiah’ tapate: Othni, Rephael, Obed, le Elzabad-te ahi vua, siemna nei a sanggamte uh Elihu le Semachiah ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam teng zosie a unpi-in Obed-edom’ tapate le a sanggamte utawh, nasep nadinga siemna a nei mi picingte ahi uhi; Obed-edom sung panin mi sawmguh le ni pha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Meshelemaiah in siemna a nei tapate le sanggamte, sawm le giet nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Merari’ tapate sung panin Hosah in tapate nei hi; Shimri a uhpi ahi a, (ama tacil ahi sih vangin a pa in a uhpi-in ama a bawl hi)"},"11":{"text":"Hilkiah a nina, Tebaliah a thumna, Zechariah a lina ahi hi. Hosah’ tapate le a sanggamte zosie sawm le thum pha uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tam kotcing kihawmkhente in amau’ makaite tawh kituohin a sanggamte uh’ sep bang lienin Topa’ biehinn sungah nasep ding tavuon nei uhi;"},"13":{"text":"tuale amate in a neu a lien a kibangin a pupa innkuon zui-in kotpi cin ding ai a san uhi."},"14":{"text":"Nisuona lam ading ai, Shelemaiah tungah tu hi. A tapa, a pilvang thu kikuppipa Zechariah adingin zong ai a san vua, leilu adingin ai pha hi."},"15":{"text":"Obed-edom adingin leilu lamah suoh a, a tapate tungah vankoina innkhan kipie hi."},"16":{"text":"Shuppim le Hosah dingin nitumna lam, katona lamlien Shallecheth tunkotah kie hi. Galvilte a kimaituo uhi."},"17":{"text":"Nisielin nisuona lamah Levi-te guh, nisielin leilu lamah li, nisielin leitaw lamah li, le vankholna inn ah ni ni-in a om uhi;"},"18":{"text":"tuale nitumna lama lampi inn adingin a lampi-ah li omin a lampi inn ah ni a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Tam teng Korah-te le Merari’ tapate lahah kotcing sekhennate ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Levi-te lahah Ahijah in Pasien’ biehinn goukholnate le a ki-ap letsong koinate uh hi.","title":"Vankemte, Uliente, le Thukhente"},"21":{"text":"Ladan, Geshon’ tapate lahah khat, innkuon tampi pienna mi khat hi a, Jehiel innkuonte pen ama sung pana pieng ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Jehiel’ tapa Zetham le a sanggampa Joel in Topa’ biehinn vanmanpha koinate a uh uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amram-te, Izhar-te, Hebron-te, le Uzziel-te sung panin:"},"24":{"text":"Moses’ tapa Gershom, a tapa Shebuel pen vanmanpha koina-ah a uhpipa ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"A sanggamte, Eliezer sung panin a tapa Rehabiah, a tapa Jeshaiah, a tapa Joram, a tapa Zichri, le a tapa Shelemoth ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tam Shelamoth le a sanggamte in Kumpi David le innkuon lutangte, le a tul a za uh uliente, le galkapmangte in a apsa uh a ki-ap letsong kikoina mun zosie a uh uhi."},"27":{"text":"Gal sunga a lah uh vante panin Topa’ biehinn puo nadinga a ki-ap letsongte amate a pie uhi."},"28":{"text":"Shelomoth le a sanggamte in thumu pa Samuel, Kish’ tapa Saul, Ner’ tapa Abner, le Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in a apsa zosie le a ki-ap letsong zosie a kem uhi."},"29":{"text":"Izhar-te sung panin Chenaniah le a tapate pen Israel adingin uliente le thukhen-te ahi vua, a pulam nasepnate-ah vaihawmin kise hi."},"30":{"text":"Hebron-te sung panin Hashabiah le a sanggamte, siemna a nei mi tulkhat le za sagi in Jordan nitumna lam Israel tungah Topa’ nasepna vannuoi le kumpipa’ nasepna-te a van uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hebron-te sung panin Jerijah pen Hebron-te’ uhpipa ahi hi. (David’ uh a kum sawm lina kumin khangthu ahi sihle innkuon thu kantelna kibawl a, Gilead gam sung Jazer ah amate sung panin siemna lien a nei mite kimukhie hi.)"},"32":{"text":"Kumpi David in ama le a sanggamte, siemna nei mi tulni le zasagi, innkuon lutangte ahite pen Pasien tawh kisai na zosie le kumpipa vaite-ah Reuben-te, Gad-te, le Manasseh minam alangte tungah a vil dingin kise hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam pen Israel mi, innkuon lutangte, a tul le a za-a a uhte, le khen khatah mi tul sawmni le tulli ta a pha, kum khat sung tawntung hla khat zaw hla khat vaitung le vaikuon dinga kise a khente tawh kisai-in na zosie-ah kumpipa’ na a sem a uliente uh’ min kikhumna ahi hi:","title":"Galkap Khente"},"2":{"text":"A hla masa sungin Zabdiel’ tapa Jashobeam pen a khen masa a uhpa ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama Perez’ suonlehlah ahi a, a hla masa sungin galkapmangte zosie’ a uhpipa ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahoh-te Dodai pen a hla nina sunga a khen a uhpa ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"5":{"text":"A hla thumna-a a khen thumna uhpa pen siempu Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam pen mi Sawmthumte sung panin a thahat, mi Sawmthumte a uh Benanaih ahi hi; a tapa Ammizabad pen ama’ khen uhpa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A hla lina-a a lina pa pen Joab sanggampa Asahel ahi a, ama zaw ciengin a tapa Zebadiah ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"8":{"text":"A hla ngana-a a ngana pa pen Izhar-te Shamhuth ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"9":{"text":"A hla guhna-a a guhna pa pen Teko-te Ikkesh’ tapa Ira ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"10":{"text":"A hla sagina-a a sagina pa pen Ephraim-te sung panin Pelon-te Helez ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"11":{"text":"A hla gietna-a a gietna pa pen Zerah-te sung panin Hushah-te Sibbecai ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"12":{"text":"A hla kuona- a a kuona pa pen Benjamin-te sung panin Anathoth-te Abiezer ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"13":{"text":"A hla sawmna-a a sawmna pa pen Zerah-te sung panin Netophah-te Maharai ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"14":{"text":"A hla sawm le khatna-a a sawm le khatna pa pen Ephraim-te sung panin Pirathon-te Benaiah ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"15":{"text":"A hla sawm le nina-a sawm le nina pa pen Othniel-te sung panin Natophah-te Heldai ahi hi; ama’ khen sungah mi tul sawmni le tulli a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel minamte tungah Reuben-te adingin Zichri’ tapa Eliezer pen uhpi pa ahi hi; Simeon-te adingin Maacah’ tapa Shephatiah ahi hi;","title":"Minam Makaite"},"17":{"text":"Levi adingin Kemuel’ tapa Hashabiah ahi hi; Aaron adingin Zadok ahi hi;"},"18":{"text":"Judah adingin David’ sanggamte sung panin Elihu ahi hi;"},"19":{"text":"Zebulun adingin Obadiah’ tapa Ishmaiah ahi hi;"},"20":{"text":"Ephraim-te adingin Azariah’ tapa Hoshea ahi hi; Manasseh minam alangte adingin Pedaiah’ tapa Joel ahi hi;"},"21":{"text":"Gilead gam sunga Manasseh minam alangte adingin Zechariah’ tapa Iddo ahi hi; Benjamin adingin Abner’ tapa Jaasiel ahi hi;"},"22":{"text":"Dan adingin Jehoram’ tapa Azarel ahi hi; tam teng pen Israel minam makaite ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in vana aasi za-a a tam dingin Israel a khapsa ahi ziehin David in kum sawmni le a neisie mite sim lo hi.","ref":"Pien 15:5; 22:17; 26:4"},"24":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in amate a phaza sim ding kipan a, hizongle ama man sieng zo lo hi; hizongle tam thu ziehin Israel tungah lungthahna tung a, Kumpi David’ khang tangthu sungah tua a kisim mite a phaza kikhum lo hi.","ref":"2Sam 24:15; 1Khg 21:1-14"},"25":{"text":"Adiel’ tapa Azmaveth in kumpipa’ vanmanpha koina-ah vai a hawm hi. Gam sung, khuopite, khuoneute, le tausangte sunga vanmanpha koinate tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Uzziah’ tapa Jonathan ahi hi.","title":"Adang Taangpi Uliente"},"26":{"text":"Lo nasem, lohlote tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Chelub’ tapa Ezri ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Lengga lote-a vaihawm ding pa pen Ramah-te Shimei ahi hi. Lengga lo pana a pieng lenggazu koinate tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Shiphmoth-te Zabdi ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Shephelah gam sunga a om olive le theitheh kungte tunga vaihawm ding pa khu Gederah-te Baal-hanan ahi hi. Sathau koinate tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Joash ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Sharon gam sunga a gamta ganhonte tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Adlai’ tapa Shaphat ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Kalaohte tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Ishmael-te Obil ahi hi. Laa a nute tunga vaihawm ding pa pen Meronoth-te Jehdeiah ahi hi. Tuuhonte tunga vaihawm ding pen Hagri-te Jaziz ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam teng zosie Kumpipa David’ neisa kemte ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"David’ pano Jonathan pen thu theitel mi le laithei mi ahi ziehin thu kuppipa ahi hi; Hachmoni’ tapa Jehiel in kumpipa’ tapate a cing hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahithophel pen kumpipa’ thu kuppipa ahi a, Archi-te Hushai pen kumpipa’ zawlpa ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahithophel’ nua ciengin Benaiah’ tapa Jehoiada le Abiathar in ama laih a, Joab pen kumpipa’ galkapmangpa ahi hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel uliente, minam uliente, kumpipa’ na a sem a khen khena uliente, a tul uh galkap uliente, a za uh galkap uliente, neisa zosie le kumpipa’ ganhonte le a tapate a kemte, kumpi inn sung uliente, mi thahat galhangte, le galhang zosie tawh Jerusalem ah a unpi-un a kikhawmsah hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Lam Ding Solomon Kihilh"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin a keng tawh Kumpi David dingto a, “Ka sanggamte le ka mite aw, ka thu gen za un. Keima in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong ading le i Pasien’ keng ngah nading tawlngahna biehinn khat lam dingin ka gel zo ta hi; tua biehinn adingin ka kigingkhol zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle Pasien in keima kungah, ‘Nang galhang khat na hi a, sisan luongsah zo na hi ziehin keima’ min dingin biehinn na lam sih ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel Topa Pasien in ka pu innkuonte zosie sung panin Israel tungah kumpi a sem zing dingin keima ei teel hi; bangzieh ahei cile ama in makai dingin Judah teel a, Judah innkuon sung panin ka pa’ innkuon, ka pa’ tapate sung panin Israel zosie tunga kumpi sem dingin keima ei lungkimpi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in tapa tampi ei pie ahi ziehin keima’ tapate zosie sung panin Israel tung, Topa’ kumpi topha tunga a to dingin ama in ka tapa Solomon a teel zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, ‘Ka biehinn le ka inntuolte a lam ding pa khu nangma’ tapa Solomon ahi hi. Azieh pen keima in ka tapa dingin ama ka teel zo a, keima ama’ pa ka hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in ka thupiehnate le ka biehna ngaina kipte tuni-a ma bangin zui dinga a ngaisut peisuoh nah leh keima in a kumpi gam ka kipsah den ding hi,’ ei ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-16; 1Khg 17:1-14"},"8":{"text":"Tua ziehin tu-in tami gam hoi tangin na nua vua na tate uh tungah gamh-in na nuasie tawntung thei nadingun Topa mai-a kikhopna ahi Israel zosie’ muna le i Pasien’ zahna-ah na Topa Pasien thupiehna zosie zui-in sui un."},"9":{"text":"“Nang, ka tapa Solomon aw, na pa’ Pasien thei inlen, lungsim khat le lawpna lungtang tawh ama’ na sem in; azieh pen Topa in lungsim zosie sui a, gelna le ngaisutna zosie thei hi. Nang in ama na sui leh ama in nang ang mu ding a, ama na elngat leh ama in zong a tawntungin nang ang nuasie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Munsiengtho adingin biehinn khat a lam dingin Topa in nang ang teel zo ziehin tu-in kingaisun in; thahat inlen sem in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in a tapa Solomon kungah biehinn talaap, a innte, a vanmanpha koinate, a khan tungnungte, a khan sungtate, le hepina topha dinga a innkhan gelna;"},"12":{"text":"tuale Topa’ biehinn tuolte adinga a lungsim sunga a ngaisut zosie, a kimvela innkhan zosie, Pasien’ biehinn sung vanmanpha koinate, le a ki-ap letsongte adingin vanmanpha koina’ innlimte pie a,"},"13":{"text":"siempute, Levi a kisekhente le Topa’ biehinn sunga nasepna zosie ading; Topa’ biehinn sunga nasepna ding vanzah zosie ading,"},"14":{"text":"na sepna khat sima zah ding kham tawh kibawl vanzah zosie a gihna, nasepna sima zah ding ngun tawh kibawl vanzahte a gihna,"},"15":{"text":"kham meivah khuom le a meivahte a gihna, meivah khuom khat ciet a gihna le a meivahte gihna, ngun meivah khuom ding le nasepna-ah a poimaw dung zui-a zah dingin meivah teng gihna zong a unin tesa-in a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Ompina Anlum adingin sabuoi kham a gihna ciet, ngun sabuoite ading ngun a gihna,"},"17":{"text":"le tawkeukate, kuongte, le haite adingin kham citah a gihna; kham haipite le a gihna ciet, ngun haipite le a gihna ciet;"},"18":{"text":"a kisiengsah kham tawh a kibawl gimnamtui halna maitam ding le a gihna za ding gelna; a hlate uh zahin Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a khu cherub-te’ khamleeng ding a gelna zong a pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa’ lamlahna tawh a kigiel nasepna gelna tamteng zosie ama in a unin keima ei theiciensah hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"David in a tapa Solomon kungah, “Hattah le hangsan tahin om inlen sem in. Zau sinlen lungkie sin; azieh pen Topa Pasien, keima’ Pasien in nangma ang ompi hi. Topa’ biehinn nasepna zosie a kizaw sieng masangsie ama in nangma ang tamasah sih ding a, zong ang nuasie sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn nasep zosie a sem dingin siempute le Levi mi kisekhente om a, nasepna khat popo-ah siemna a nei a kipumpieh zosie in a nasepna vannuoi vuah nangma tawh ang om ding uhi. Uliente le mi zosie zong nang’ thupiehna bangbangin a gamta ding uhi,” ci-in a gen hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi David in a kikhawm mipite kungah, “Pasien in ama beh a teelsa ka tapa Solomon lah khangno lai-in bangma a thei nai sih a, nasep ding lah a lien mama hi; azieh pen biehinn lah mihing ading hi loin Topa ading ahi bo hi.","title":"Biehinn Lamna ding Biehnate"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien’ biehinn dingin keima in ka hi thei za cieng, phu dingin onyx suong, suongpa, suong pawl, suong kang, le suong manpha nam zosie, le suongzol tampite banah kham zahna dingah kham, ngun zahna dingah ngun, le sumngo zahna dingah sumngo, sia zahna dingah sia, sing zahna dingah sing ka khol zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tham loin a siengtho biehinn adingin ka pieh teng zosie banah keima’ gou ahi ngun le kham zong om a, ka Pasien’ biehinn adingin ka kipumpieh ziehin keima in ka Pasien’ biehinn-a ka piehte:"},"4":{"text":"Biehinn kawm zut nadingin Ophir gam kham talent tulthum, le a kisiengsahsa ngun talent tul sagi,"},"5":{"text":"le mi khutsiemte in a bawl ding nasepna zosie adingin kham zahna dingah kham, ngun zahna dingah ngun ahi hi. Tuni-in Topa kungah no le no kisiensuo-in kiphal taha a kipumpieh koi teng a om vuoi?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin pupa innkuon lutangte in amau’ nopthu-in piehkhietna a bawl vua, minam makaite, a tul le a za a uhte, le kumpipa’ nasepna a uh uliente in zong a bawl uhi."},"7":{"text":"Pasien’ biehinn nasepna dingin kham talent tulnga le kham darics tul sawm, ngun talent tul sawm, sumngo talent tul sawm le tul giet, le sia talent tul zakhat a pie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Suong manpha a nei poma in zong Topa’ biehinn sunga van manpha kikoina munah Gershon-te Jehiel’ kep dingin a pie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin tam mite in phalna tawh a pieh ziehun mite kipah mama hi. Bangzieh ahei cile lung khat suongin Topa kungah suohta tahin a pie uhi; Kumpi David zong nahpi tahin a lungdam hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in a kikhawm mipi zosie’ opna-ah Topa phat hi; David in, “ Topa , ka pu ka pa uh Israel Pasien aw, nang in kum tawnin thupha nga ta in.","title":"David in Pasien Phat"},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, lietna, vanglietna, minthanna, guolzawna, le thupina nangma-a’ ahi hi. Azieh pen vantung le leitunga om zosie nangma-a’ ahi hi; Topa aw, kumpi gam nangma-a’ ahi a, tuate zosie tungah nangma a lutangin ang kitawisang hi.","ref":"Mat 6:13"},"12":{"text":"Nangma kung panin haunate le pahtawinate ang pei a, nangma in na zosie na uh hi. Nangma’ khut sungah vanglietna le hatna a om hi; tuale nangma’ khut sungah mi zosie lietsah nading le thakhausah nading a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Kote’ Pasien aw, tu-in nangma kungah kipah thu kang tut vua, a minthang nangma’ min ka phat uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Ahi vangin tam bang nop thu-a biehna ka bawl thei nadingun kei koi ka hi a, ka mite koi ka hi uh ahei? Azieh pen na zosie nangma kung pana ang pei ahi a, nangma kungah nangma-a’ ma kang pieh uh ahi bo hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen ka pu ka pate zosie uh ma bangin nangma mai-ah kote khuolmi le pemta ka hi lel uhi; leitungah ka hunte uh nihlim bang ahi a, lamet ding a om sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa kohaw’ Pasien aw, na min siengtho adingin biehinn khat lam nadinga ka kholsa uh tami sil tampi zosie a unpi-in nangma khut sung pana ang pei ahi a, a unpi-in nangma-a’ ma ahi bo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, lungtang na sui a, thutangah na lungkim lam ka thei hi; ka lungsim dihna tawh tam sil zosie kang pie zo hi. Tu-in keima in nangma tungah suohta tah le kipahtaha ang pie, tam sunga om na mite ka mu zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasien, Topa aw, na mite’ lungsim sungah tua bang ngimnate le ngaisutnate omsah zing inlen, nangma lamah amau’ lungsim kai in."},"19":{"text":"Ama in na thupiehnate, na thu khensatte, le na thukhamte zosie zui-in tuate zosie a sem a, keima in ama ka piehsa biehinn a lam thei nadingin ka tapa Solomon tungah lawpna lungsim guon in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin David in a kikhawm mipi zosie kungah, “ Topa na Pasien uh thupha pie un,” a ci hi. A kikhawm mipi zosie in a pu a pate uh’ Pasien Topa thupha pie-in a lukun vua, Topa le kumpipa mai-ah a khupbawh uhi."},"21":{"text":"A zing ni ciengin amate in Topa tungah biehpiehnate a pie vua, Topa tungah meihal biehna dingin bawngtang tulkhat, tuutang tulkhat, le tuuno tulkhat, dawnthei a biehna utawh, le Israel mi zosie adingin biehpiehna tampi a pie uhi;"},"22":{"text":"tuale Topa mai-ah tua ni-in kipahna lienpi tawh an ne tui dawnin a om uhi. Amate in David’ tapa Solomon a niveina kumpi-in a bawl uhi; amate in Topa mai-ah ulien dingin ama sathau nu-in siempu dingin Zadok sathau a nu uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in a pa David’ kumpi za luo-in Topa’ kumpi topha tungah a to hi. Ama a dau pei a, Israel mi zosie in a thu a mang uhi.","title":"Solomon Kumpi-in Sathau Kinu","ref":"1Kum 2:12"},"24":{"text":"Makai zosie le mihat galhangte, le Kumpi David’ tapa zosie in zong Kumpi Solomon’ thu a mang dingin a kiciem uhi."},"25":{"text":"Israel mi zosie muna-ah Topa in nahpi tahin Solomon domsang a, Israel sungah ama masangin kumpi khat popo tungah a kipie ngai nai lo kumpi thupina ama tungah a pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Jessi’ tapa David in Israel zosie tungah a uh hi.","title":"David’ Uhna Tomkim"},"27":{"text":"Ama Israel tunga a maan hun pen kum sawmli sung ahi hi; tuale ama Hebron ah kum sagi sung, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le thum sung a maang hi.","ref":"2Sam 5:4-5; 1Khg 3:4"},"28":{"text":"Ama vuoi-in a ni a hun cingin hauna le minthanna tawh a si hi; tuale a tapa Solomon in ama’ za luo hi."},"29":{"text":"Tu-in Kumpi David’ nasep teng a bul panin a tawp tanin thumu pa Samuel Khang Sutna sung, kamsang Nathan’ Khang Sutna sung, le thumu pa Gad’ Khang Sutna sungah,"},"30":{"text":"ama uhna le a thahatna zosie le ama tung, Israel tung, le leitung kumpi gam zosie tunga a tung thute ciemtenate tawh kigiel ton hi."}}}}},"14":{"info":{"name":"2 Khang Tangthu","shortname":"2khg","abbr":[],"desc":"Khang tangthu nina laibu (the second book of chronicles)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kumpi gam sungah David’ tapa Solomon ama le ama kiptahin om hi; Topa a Pasien in ama ompi a, a lien mama-in ama a bawl hi.","title":"Solomon in Pilna Ngen (1Kum 3:1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Israel mi zosie, a tul uhte le a za uhte, thukhente, Israel makaite zosie, le innkuon lutangte hlan hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon le ama tawh a om mi buppi, Gibeon-a munsangah a pei uhi; bangzieh ahei cile gamlahah Topa’ nasem Moses in a na lamsa ahi Pasien’ kikhopna puonbuh khu tuanah a om hi."},"4":{"text":"(Ahi vangin David in Kiriath-jearim panin ama dinga a bawlpieh nasa munah Pasien’ thuciemna singkuong puoto zo hi; bangzieh ahei cile ama in Jerusalem-ah tua adingin puonbuh khat lampieh zo hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Hur’ tapa Uri, a tapa Bezalel in a na bawlsa sumngo maitam zong Topa’ biehbuh mai tua munah a om hi. Tua munah Solomon le a kikhawm mite in thu a dong uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kikhopna puonbuh-a om Topa’ mai-a sumngo maitam ah Solomon peito-in tua tungah meihal biehna tulkhat a pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuami zanin Solomon tungah Pasien kilah a, ama kungah, “Kang pieh ding pen ngen in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Solomon in Pasien kungah, “Ka pa David tungah a lien le a kip itna na lah zo a, keima kumpi-in ama’ za nei luosah zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Pasien aw, leitungah leivui za banga a tam mite lahah kumpi dingin nei koi zo tah ziehin ka pa David kunga na thuciemna tu-in hing tangtungsah in."},"10":{"text":"Tam mite mai-a ka sungtum ka pusuo thei nadingin tu-in pilna le theina ei pie in, azieh pen hiza taha a tam na mite koi in uh zo ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in Solomon dawng a, “Tam thu na lungsim sungah om a, nangma in nei le lamte, hauna, patawina, ahi sihle nang ang mudate’ si nading, le khansauna na ngen sih a, amate tungah kumpi-a kang koina ka mite na uh thei nadingin nang adingin pilna le theina nang nget zawh ziehin,"},"12":{"text":"na tungah pilna le theina ang kipie hi. Keima in nangma tungah na masanga kumpite koima in a nei ngai lo le na nua-ate koima in zong tua bang a nei ngai nawn lo ding haunate, nei le lamte, le patawinate zong kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Gibeon-a om munsang kikhopna puonbuh mai panin Jerusalem ah Solomon a pei hi. Tuale ama in Israel tungah a uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Solomon in leengte le sakolte kaikhawm hi; ama in leeng tulkhat le zali le sakol tul sawm le tulni nei a, tuate leeng khuopite le Jerusalem ah kumpipa tawh koi hi.","title":"Solomon’ Galkapte le A Sumbawl Nasepna (1Kum 10:26-29 ; 2Khg 9:25-28)","ref":"1Kum 4:26"},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jerusalem ah suongpem tam bangin ngun tamsah a, taamtah sing zong Shephelah theitheh sing vau bangin vausah hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:17; 1Kum 10:27"},"16":{"text":"Solomon sakolte zong Egypt gam le Kue gam pana kila ahi hi; kumpipa’ sumbawlte in a man ding pie-in Kue panin tuate a nga uhi.","ref":"Thkna 17:16"},"17":{"text":"Egypt gam panin leeng khat ngun shekel zaguh, sakol khat shekel za le sawmnga-in a la uhi; tuaci’n amate tung panin Hit kumpite zosie le Aram kumpite tungah tuate kizuasawnkia hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Topa’ min dingin biehinn khat le ama adingin kumpi inn khat lam ding a khensat hi.","title":"Biehinn Lam Nading Kiginkholna"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in na sem ding mi tul sawmsagi le muoltung gama suong to ding mi tul sawmgiet, le tuate a van dingin mi tulthum le zaguh se hi."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Tyre Kumpi Huram kungah thu vaihlah a, “Hun khat lai-in ten nading inn khat a lam nadingin ka pa David tungah taamtah sing na puoh ma bangin kei tungah zong ei puoh in.","title":"Tyre-te Huram tawh Kipawlna (1Kum 5:1-18)"},"4":{"text":"Israel adingin khantawn zah dinga a kise bangin, ama mai-ah gim namtuite ahi panamtui hal nading, le anlum guolte pieh thei zing nading, le sabbath nite, hladet nite, le Topa kohaw’ Pasien dinga a kisesa pawi nite-ah zing le nitahin meihal biehnate pieh thei nadingin Topa ka Pasien’ minin tu-in biehinn khat lamin ama tunga ap ding ka hi ta hi"},"5":{"text":"Kote’ Pasien pen pasien dangte sanga a lietzawh ziehin ka biehinn lam ding zong a gol ding ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin vantung, a sang pen vantung nangawnin ama dawl lo ahi ziehin koi in ama adingin biehinn lam zo ding ahei? Ama mai-ah biehnate koi nading mun ci longal ama dinga biehinn lampieh dingin kei koi ka hei?","ref":"1Kum 8:27; 2Khg 6:18"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in ka pa David in a na zahsa, Judah le Jerusalem-a ka ompi khutsiem mite tawh kithuo dingin kham, ngun, sumngo, le sia khensiem, le puon a ausan, a dupsan, puondum a gat siem mi khat ka kungah hing sawl in."},"8":{"text":"Taamtah, taasing, le cingsing zong Lebanon panin keima kungah ei puoh in, azieh pen na nasemte, Lebanon sing phua a siem lam uh ka thei hi. Ka nasemte in na nasemte tawh a semton ding vua,"},"9":{"text":"kei adingin sing tampitah a khol ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile ka lam ding biehinn pen golin lamdang mama ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in na nasem sing phuate adingin a kisuvui mangbu cor tul sawmni, mangbuham cor tul sawmni, lenggazu bath tul sawmni, le sathau bath tul sawmni kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tyre kumpipa Huram in Solomon lai hlah a, “ Topa in a mite a it ziehin amate tungah nang kumpi-in ang koi hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Huram in zong, “ Topa ading biehinn khat le ama ading kumpi inn khat a lam ding, thu ngaisut theina le thu theitelna a nei, Kumpi David’ tungah tapa pil a pie, van le lei a bawl Israel Topa Pasien in thupha nga taheh."},"13":{"text":"“Keima in mi khutsiem mama le thuteina tawh a kidim Huram-abi kang sawl zo hi,"},"14":{"text":"ama pen Dan-te numei khat’ tapa hi a, a pa Tyre-te ahi hi; ama pen kham, ngun, sumngo, sia, suong, le sing, le puon ausan, puondum, le puon sandupte, le saihadiel puon, le suong zepdan namkim a sem ding le keima’ pu na pa David’ mi khutsiemte tawh a kithuo dingin ama tunga kipie nasep khat popo a sem dingin siemna neisa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in ka pu in a gensa mangbu le mangbuham, sathau le lenggazute, na nasemte tungah hing puoh in."},"16":{"text":"Kote in na kisap sing poma Lebanon panin kang phua ding vua, tuaci’n phawng bawlin na kungah tui lam tawh Joppa dong kang puoh ding uhi; Jerusalem ah tua teng na puohto ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa David in mi phaza a sim zo-in Solomon in zong Israel gam sunga teng gamdang mi phaza zosie sim a, mi tul zakhat le tul sawmnga le tulthum le zaguh pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in tua teng lahah na sem dingin mi tul sawm sagi, muoltung gama suong to dingin mi tul sawmgiet, le mite’ nasep a van dingin mi tulthum le zaguh se hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem khuopi sunga Moriah Muol tung, a pa David kungah Topa a na kihilna mun, David in a na senasa mun, Jebus-te Ornan’ ancilna phuolah Topa’ biehinn lam kipan hi.","title":"Solomon in Biehinn Lam (1Kum 6:1-22)","ref":"Pien 22:2"},"2":{"text":"Ama a maan zaw a kum lina, a hla nina, a ni nina sungin lam ding a kipan hi."},"3":{"text":"Tam teng pen Pasien’ biehinn lamna dinga Solomon’ tena ahi hi: sil tena lui tawh a kite leh adung tong sawmguh, avai tong sawmni ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Biehinn laikim mai-a om talaap pen biehinn vailam tawh kikimin tong sawmni sau a, a sanna tong za le sawmni pha hi; ama in a sunglam teng kham citah tawh zut hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in taasing tawh biehinn laikim teng dapin tuate kham hoi tawh tuom a, tua tungah tumsing le khainieng lim a kheng hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in suongmanpha guolte tawh a inn zem hi. A khamte pen Parvaim pana kham ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a inn, a innkam, a sangkilte, a kawmte, le a kotkhahte kham tawh dap hi; tuale ama in a kawmte tungah cherub-te a kheng hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in siengtho pen mun bawl hi; adung pen a inn vailam tawh a kibangin tong sawm ni hi a, avai pen tong sawmni ma ahi hi; ama in tua pen kham hoi talent zaguh tawh zut hi.","ref":"Pei 26:33-34"},"9":{"text":"A kilnate a gihna kham shekel sawmnga ahi hi. Ama in kham tawh innkhan tungnungte zut hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in siengtho pen mun sungah a kikheng cherub ni bawlin kham tawh tuate a zut hi."},"11":{"text":"Cherub gel’ hla a kizah ciengin tong sawmni sau hi: a khat’ hla langkhat tong nga ahi a, tua in inn kawm ban a, a hla langkhat zong tong nga ma ahi a, tua in adang cherub’ hla langkhat ban hi."},"12":{"text":"A cherub dang khat’ hla langkhat tong nga sau a, tua in inn kawm banin tong nga ma a sau a hla langkhat pen a cherub masa’ hla tawh kimat hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam cherub-te’ hla in tong sawmni huom a, tua cherub-te a kephang utawh dingin innpi sunglam a kinga uhi.","ref":"Pei 25:18-20"},"14":{"text":"Solomon in puon a dum, a ausan, a sandup, le saihadiel puon tawh dalna puon bawl a, tua tungah cherub-te a bawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in inn mai-ah tong sawmthum le tong nga a sang, a dawn tuohah tong nga a pha khuom luzepna a nei khuompi ni a bawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in khigui bangin khainieng bawlin khuomte dawnah tuate khai hi; tuale ama in mang kawlsing lim zakhat bawlin khainiengte tungah tuate koi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in biehinnpi mai-ah tua khuompite, khat a veilam, a khat a zietlamah phut hi; ama in ziet lama pen Jachin ci a, vei lama pen Boaz ci-in minvaw hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in sumngo maitam, adung tong sawmni, avai tong sawmni, a sanna tong sawm a pha khat a bawl hi.","title":"Biehinnpi’ Vanzahte (1Kum 6:23-38 ; 7:13-51)","ref":"Pei 27:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kisung tuikuongpi khat bawl hi; tua khu a bem ahi a, a gei khat pan a gei khat dong tong sawm pha-in, tong nga sang a, a kimvel tong sawmthum pha hi."},"3":{"text":"A geiviel nei lamah tuikuongpi kimvelin tong sawm ciet a pha a khawhte a om hi; a khawhte guol ni pha a, tua khu tuikuongpi kisun lai-a kisuntha pai ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Bawngtang sawm le nite tungah tuikuong kikhang a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuona lam nga hi; tuate tungah tuikuongpi kikhang hi. Bawngtangte’ nua lam pen a sung lamah a om hi."},"5":{"text":"A tuikuong pen khutphang cie-in sa hi; a geiviel pen unoh pa tawh kibang hai geiviel bangin kibawl hi; tua sungah tui bath tulthum bang ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a sungah kisil nading tuikuong sawm zong bawl a, zietlam pangah nga, veilam pangah nga koi hi. Amate in meihal biehna dinga a kizangte tam sungah sil sieng ding uhi. Tuikuong pen siempute kisil nading ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 30:17-21"},"7":{"text":"Ama in a kigielsa bangin kham meivah tunna sawm khat bawl a, tuate biehinn sung leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga koi hi.","ref":"Pei 25:31-40"},"8":{"text":"Ama in sabuoi sawm zong bawl a, biehinn sung zietlam pangah nga, veilam pangah nga koi hi. Tuale ama in kham kuong zakhat a bawl hi.","ref":"Pei 25:23-30"},"9":{"text":"Ama in siempute’ leituol, le leituol golpi, le leituol kotkhahte bawl a, a kotkhahte sumngo tawh a zut hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in innhlang nisuona lam ningah tuikuongpi koi hi."},"11":{"text":"Huram in beelte, kawbiate, le kuongte zong bawl hi. Huram in tam bangin Kumpi Solomon ading Pasien’ biehinn bawl nasep a zawsa teng:"},"12":{"text":"Khuompi nite, kuongkumte, khuompite dawna a lubawh nite; khuompite dawn a kuong tawh kibang a lubawh nite tuom nading lenta banga kiphan nite;"},"13":{"text":"lenta banga a kiphan nite ading mang kawlsing ga zali, khuompite dawn a kuong tawh kibang a lubawh nite tuom nadingin lenta banga a kiphan khat ading mang kawlsing ga guol ni ta ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a tunnate le tua a tunnate tungah kuongpite bawl a,"},"15":{"text":"tui kuongpi khat, tua nei-a a om bawngtang sawm le nite ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon adingin Topa’ biehinn-a zah ding beelte, kawbiate, tawkeukate, le khutzah zosie pen Humara-abi in a paa silsel sumngo tawh a bawl ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam a kisiem na zosie pen kumpipa in Jordan zanglei Succoth le Zeredah kikal beel lei-a a na sun ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Solomon in tami nate zosie tampi bawlsah a, tuaci’n a kizang sumngote a gihza kite zo lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Solomon in Pasien’ biehinn sunga na zosie a bawlsahte: Kham maitam, Ompina Anlum ading sabuoite,"},"20":{"text":"a kigielsa ma bangin biehinn sungnung mai-a kivah ding kham citah meivah tunnate le a meivahte;"},"21":{"text":"kham hoi pen tawh a kibawl papete, meivahte, le a tenate;"},"22":{"text":"kham citah tawh a kibawl taitete, kuongte, tawkeute, le vutluonate ahi hi. Biehinnpi lutna kotbieng tawh kisai-in: Siengtho pen mun pei nading kotkhahte le biehinn laikim kotkhah-a kizang dingte pen kham tawh kibawl ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Solomon in Topa’ biehinn ading nasep zosie a man sieng hi. A pa David in a apsa nate Solomon in peipi-in, ngun, kham, le vanzah zosie Pasien’ biehinn sung vanmanpha koinate sungah koi hi.","ref":"2Sam 8:11; 1Khg 18:11"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in Zion a kici David’ khuopi panin Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a puoto dingin Jerusalem ah Israel upate, minam lutangte, le Israel minam pupa innkuon makai zosie a kikhawmsah hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Sungah Singkuong Kipeipi (1Kum 8:1-11)","ref":"2Sam 6:12-15; 1Khg 15:25-28"},"3":{"text":"Hla sagina sunga pawi bawl hunin Israel-te zosie kumpipa mai-ah a kikhawm uhi."},"4":{"text":"Israel upa zosie pei-in Levi-te in tua singkuong a puo uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in singkuong, kikhopna puonbuh, le puonbuh sunga vanzah siengtho zosie a puoto uhi; siempute le Levi-te in tuate a puoto uhi."},"6":{"text":"Singkuong mai-ah kumpi Solomon le a mai-a kikhawm Israel zosie in biehpiehna-in tuu le bawngtangte tam pieh seng uh ahi ziehin tuate a phaza kisim zo lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin cherub-te’ hla nei, biehinn sungnung mun siengtho penah siempute in Topa’ thuciemna singkuong a peipi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Cherub-te in singkuong tungah a hlate uh a zah ziehin tua cherub-te pen singkuong le a zawlte tunga a khuna khat a suoh hi."},"9":{"text":"A zawlte sau mama a, mun siengtho sungnung mai panin zawl mongte kimu thei hi; hizongle a pulam panin kimu thei lo hi; tuni dongin tua munah tuate a omlai hi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt panin a peikhiet zaw uh Topa in Israel mite tawh thuciemna a bawlna mun Horeb ah Moses in suongpeh ni a koi ci simlo, singkuong sungah bangma dang om lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:5"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in a siengtho mun panin siem-pute pusuohin (azieh pen amau’ pawlte ci om tuon loin tua taha om siempute zosie a unpi-un a kisiensuo vua),"},"12":{"text":"Levi lasate Asaph, Hemen, le Jeduthun, a tapate ule a tanaute uh, saihadiel puon tawh kivonin, daltuote, harp te, le lyre lasahnate tawi-in pengkul tum siempute za le sawmni tawh maitam nisuona lamah a ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa tungah aw kikhatin phatna le lungdam ko ding pen pengkul tumte le lasate’ mawpuoh ahi hi. Pengkulte, daltuote, le adang lasahnate tawh Topa phat nadingin, “Azieh pen Topa hoi a, ama’ itna kip tawntung hi,” ci-in la kisa a, tuaci’n Topa’ biehinn sung meii tawh kidim a,","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"14":{"text":"meii a kai ziehin siempute in na a sem zo sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ minthanna a vangtang Pasien’ biehinn sung a dim hi.","ref":"Pei 40:34-35"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in, “ Topa in khuomiel tawkhal lahah ka teng ding hi, ci hi.","title":"Biehinn Apna (1Kum 8:12-21)"},"2":{"text":"Keima in na ten zing nadingin a thupi biehinn khat nang adingin ka lam zo hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa kinua hei-in, a kikhawm Israel mi zosie a din laitahun ama in a kikhawm Israel mi zosie thupha a pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a ciemsa a khut tawh a tangtungsah Israel Pasien in minthanna nga ta hinlen,"},"5":{"text":"‘Egypt gam pan ka mite ka peipi ni-a kipanin tua sungah ka min a op thei nadinga a sunga biehinn lam nadingin Israel minamte khat popo panin khuopi khatpo ka teel sih a, ka mi Israel tunga uhpa dingin koima khat zong ka teel sih hi;"},"6":{"text":"hizongle keima in khum sungah ka min a op thei nadingin Jerusalem ka teel zo ta a, ka mi Israel tunga uhpa dingin David ka teel zo ta hi,’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel Pasien Topa’ min dingin biehinn khat lam ding ka pa David’ lungsim sungah a om hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in ka pa David kungah, “Keima’ min dingin biehinn khat lam dinga na ngaisut pen hoi mama hi;"},"9":{"text":"hinanle nang in biehinn na lam sih ding a, na sung pana ang pieng ding na tapa in ka min dingin biehinn a lamzaw ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tu-in Topa in a bawlsa ama’ thuciemna a tangtungsah zo hi; azieh pen Topa’ thuciem bangin ka pa David za luo-in Israel kumpi topha tungah ka to a, Israel Pasien, Topa’ min dingin biehinn ka lam zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel mite tawh a bawl Topa’ thuciemna singkuong tua munah ka koi zo hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm Israel mi zosie’ opna Topa’ maitam mai-ah Solomon dingin a khut a zah hi.","title":"Solomon’ Apna Thungetna (1Kum 8:22-53)"},"13":{"text":"Solomon in adung tong nga, avai tong nga, a sanna tong thum a pha thugenna sumngo tau khat bawlin leituolah koi zo hi; tuale ama tua tungah a ding hi. Tua ciengin a kikhawm Israel mi vannuoi muna-ah khupdinin a khut gel van lamah a zah hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “Israel Pasien, Topa aw, thuciemna zui-in a lungsim zosie utawh nangma’ thu ang mang na nasemte tungah itna kip a lah nang bang Pasien dang vantungah hile, leitungah hile a om sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Na nasempa ka pa David tunga na khapsa a tungsah pa na hi hi. Na kam tawh thu na gen a, na khut tawh tuni-in na tangtungsah tahtah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel Pasien Topa aw, ama tungah thu ciemin, ‘Nang in ka thu na man bangin na suonlehlahte in ka thukham sungah kalsuon in a gamtat a kidop nah uleh ka mai-a Israel kumpi topha tungah a to ding mi khat zong na kitasam sih ding hi,’ na cisa bangin na nasempa ka pa David tunga na thuciemsa hing sudet in."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel Pasien Topa aw, na nasempa David tunga na ciemsa kammal hing kipsah in."},"18":{"text":"“Ahi vangin leitungah mihing tawh Pasien ang tengton tahtah ding amah? Vantung le a sangpen vantung nangawnin nang ang dawl sih hi. Tami keima lamsa biehinn bang a ci neu ta zang diei!","ref":"2Khg 2:6"},"19":{"text":"Na nasempa’ thumna le tauna thudon inlen, Topa ka Pasien aw, nangma mai-a nasempa ang kikona le ang thungetna ngaipieh in."},"20":{"text":"Na nasempa in tami mun lam nga-in ang thumna na zah thei nadingin na min a opna dinga na ciemsa mun tami biehinn lam sun le zanin ei en in.","ref":"Thkna 12:11"},"21":{"text":"Amate in tami mun lam nga-in thu ang nget ciengun na nasempa le na mi Israel’ ang thumna ngai in; na tenna van panin ei za inlen, na zah ciengin ei ngaidam in."},"22":{"text":"“Mi khat a vengte tungah a maw ziehin a kiciem ding a poimaw a, ama pei-in tami biehinn sung na maitam mai-ah ang kiciem leh,"},"23":{"text":"nangma in van panin hing za-in hing sem inlen, nangma’ nasemte thukhenin a khielte a gamtatna bangun amau’ luzang ma-ah tusahin hing thuh inlen, a thumante zong amau’ thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman piehna tawh kilangsah pai in."},"24":{"text":"“Nangma tungah na mi Israel ang maw ziehin a galte mai-ah guol lelin, ahi vangin amate na kungah hing kihei kia-in, na min hing phawhin tami biehinn sungah thumna le tauna ang nei ciengun,"},"25":{"text":"nangma in van panin za inlen, na mi Israel’ mawna ngaidamin, amate le a pu a pate na piehsa leitangah amate peipikia in."},"26":{"text":"“Na tungah ang maw ziehun vantung kikha cipin guo a zuh lo hun, amate na gawt hun ciengin tami mun lam nga-in thu ngenin, na min hing phawhin a mawna uh panin a kihei uleh,"},"27":{"text":"amau’ zui ding lampi hoi na hil ciengin van panin za-in na nasem, na mi Israel’ mawna ngaidam in; tuale na mite tungah gou-a na piehsa na gam sungah guo zusah in."},"28":{"text":"“Gam sungah kiel ang tun a, pul natna, ankung natna, ankung maibuoh na, kauphe ahi sihle pangangte ang omin; a galte un a tenna khuopi uh khat penpenah imtawmin, bangbang gimna, bangbang natna ang tun leh;"},"29":{"text":"mimal khat in ahi a, na mi Israel zosie in ahi zongin a natna ule a dana ciet uh thei-in tami biehinn lamah a khut uh zahin bangbang thungetna ahi a, bangbang thumna ahi zongin ang bawl uleh;"},"30":{"text":"na tenna van panin za-in ngaidam inlen, amau’ gamtatna tawh kizui-in nangma in a lungsim uh na thei bangin bawlpieh in, azieh pen nangma beh in mihing’ lungsim na thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam bang hileh amate in ka pu ka pate uh tunga na piehsa leitang tungah a ten sung tungtawnun nangma hing zatahin na thu ang zui ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"“Tua ma bangin mun gamlapi panin na mi Israel ahi lo gamdang mite hing pei-in, a lien mama na min, na khut thahat le a kizah na ban ziehin tami biehinn lam nga-in thu ang nget ciengun,"},"33":{"text":"nangma in na tenna van panin hing za-in na kungah tua gamdang mite in ang nget popo bawlpieh in. Tua hile na mi Israel ma bangin leitung mi zosie in na min thei-in ang ging ding vua, amate in keima lamsa tami biehinn zong nangma’ min tawh kilo ahina ang thei ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"“Galte sim dingin na mite kuon khie-in, bang lam bang lamah sawl ta lateh, nangma teelsa tami khuopi, le na min tawh ka lamsa tami biehinn lam nga-in amate in thu ang nget uleh,"},"35":{"text":"van panin amau’ thungetna le thumna za-in amau’ vai panpi in."},"36":{"text":"“Mihing a maw lo koima a op lo ziehin, amate na tungah ang maw vua, amate tungah nang lungthahin galte khut sungah amate pie-in, a gamla-ah hile a nai-ah hile amate galmatin kikai-in;"},"37":{"text":"tua ciengin a kimatna gam sungah kisiakia a, ‘Kote maw-in ka gamta khiel zo ta uhi; ka gitlo tat ta uhi,’ ci-in na kungah ang thum uleh;"},"38":{"text":"amate in galmat-a a opna uh leitangah a lungsim zosie ule a tahsa zosie utawh kisiakia-in, na teelsa khuopi le na min tawh ka lamsa biehinn, nangma in a pu a pate uh tunga na piehsa ahi a leitang lam uh nga-in thu ang nget uleh,"},"39":{"text":"na tenna van panin amau’ thungetna le ang thumnate uh za inlen, a vai uzong panpi-in na tunga ang maw na mite ngaidam in."},"40":{"text":"“Ka Pasien aw, tu-in na mit hahsah inlen, tami mun pana thungetna na bil ei ngat in."},"41":{"text":"“Tu-in dingto-in, Topa Pasien aw, na khawlna ding munah nang le na thahatna singkuong tawh pei in. Topa Pasien aw, na siempute hutdamna puon tawh kivon uh hinlen, na hoina-ah na thuman mite kipah uheh."},"42":{"text":"Topa Pasien aw, na sathau nu pa nuol sin. Na nasempa David tunga na itna kip khu phawh gige in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 132:8-10"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon a thunget a man ciengin vantung panin meikuong peisuhin meihal biehna le biehpiehnate katum hi; tuale biehinnpi sungah Topa’ minthanna vang a dim hi.","title":"Solomon in Biehinnpi Ap (1Kum 8:62-66)","ref":"Siem 9:23-24"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sungah Topa’ minthanna a dim ziehin Topa’ biehinn sungah siempute a lut thei sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mite zosie in meikuong ang kumsuh le Topa’ minthanna biehinn tung sontah ah a op a mu ciengun suongpha tungah lei lam nga-in a kunsuh vua, tuaci’n Pasien bie-in Topa tungah lungdam a ko vua, “Ama hoi hi, azieh pen ama itna kip tawntung hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa mai-ah kumpipa le mi zosie in biehpiehna a pie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in biehpiehna dingin bawngtang tul sawmni le tulni, le tuu tul zakhat le tul sawmni a pie hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa le mi zosie in Pasien’ biehinn a ap uhi."},"6":{"text":"Siempute amau’ mun cietah a ding uhi; Levi-te zong, Kumpi David in Topa tungah lungdam ko nadinga a bawl Topa tunga tum thei vante tawh a ding uhi. Azieh pen ama’ itna kip tawntung hi. David in amau’ nasepnate tawh phatnate a pieh sielin tua bangin a bawl uhi. Amate tawh kigalsai-in siempute in pengkul a mut uhi; tuale Israel mi zosie a ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Solomon in Topa’ biehinn mai-a om leituol laikim siensuo hi; bang ding ahei cile Solomon in a bawl sumngo maitam ah meihal biehna, le an tawh biehna le a thau pawlkhat ta lo ahi ziehin tua munah ama in meihal biehnate le thunuom biehna thaute a pie hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Solomon in ni sagi sung pawi bawl a, Israel zosie ama tawh om tonin, a kikhawm mihon tampite, Lebo-hamath panin Egypt Lui cieng dong a dim uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in a ni giet ni-in kikhopna thupi khat a nei uhi; azieh pen amate in maitam apna ni sagi sung a zang vua, pawi ni sagi sung a bawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"A hla sagina a ni sawmni le thumna ni-in, Topa in David le Solomon, le ama’ mi Israel tungah a hoina a lah ziehin, ama in lungdamna le kipahna tawh mipite a peisah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bangin Solomon in Topa’ biehinn le kumpi inn lam man sieng hi; Solomon in Topa’ biehinn sung le ama’ inn sungah sep dinga a gel zosie lawcing tahin a man sieng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin zan lai-in Solomon kungah Topa kilah a, ama kungah, “Na thungetna ka za zo ta a, keima’ biehpiehna inn dingin tami mun ka teel zo hi.","title":"Solomon Tungah Pasien Nivei A Kilahna"},"13":{"text":"Keima in guo a zuh lo nadingin van kot ka kha cieng hile leitang netum dinga kauphe thu ka pieh cieng hile ka mite lahah natna ka tunsah cieng hile,"},"14":{"text":"keima’ min tawh a kilo ka mite, amahaw mama ang kiniemkhiehin, thu ngenin ka mai ang sui vua, a gitlo gamtatnate panun ang kihei uleh, keima in vantung panin za-in a mawna uh maisahin a gam uh ka damsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in mit hahin tam muna kingen thungetna ka bil ka ngat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tu-in khum munah a tawntungin ka min a op thei nadingin tami biehinn teelin ka siensuo zo ta hi; khum munah ka mit le ka lungsim a om zing ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang adingin ahile na pa David gamtat bangin keima mai-ah na gamtat a, kang sawl zosie bangin semin, ka thukhamte le ka biehna ngaina kipte na zui leh,"},"18":{"text":"na pa David tawh kiciemin, ‘Israel a uh ding mi na kitasam ngai sih ding hi,’ ka na ci ma bangin na kumpi topha kang kipsah ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 2:4"},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin note kihei-in na mai-a ka koi ka thukhamte le ka thupiehnate nuasie-in, note pei-in pasien dangte’ na semin tuate na bieh uleh,"},"20":{"text":"keima in note kang piehsa leitang panin note kang botzuon ding hi; tuale ka min dinga ka siensuosa tami biehinn zong ka muna panin sepmangin mi zosie lahah paunah le thugentena ka suohsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-a a kitawisang tami biehinn tawh kisai-in, a gei a nawhkha poma in lamdangsa-in, ‘Bang dinga Topa in tam gam le tam biehinn a ci bawl a ta diei?’ ci ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, ‘Bangzieh ahei cile amate in Egypt gam pana a peipi a pu a pate uh’ Pasien Topa a nuasie vua, pasien dangte pomin, tuate bie-in a na a sem uhi; tua ahi ziehin ama in amate tungah tam sietna zosie a tungsah hi,’ ci ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Topa’ biehinn le ama’ inn a lam zaw kum sawmni a cin ciengin,","title":"Solomon’ Nasepna Tuomtuomte (1Kum 9:10-28)"},"2":{"text":"Huram in ama tunga a pieh khuopite Solomon in lamkia a, tuate sungah Israel mite tengsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Hamath-zobah ah Solomon pei-in tua gam a la hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in senel gam sungah Tadmor khuo sat a, Hamath gam sungah vankholna khuopi zosie a lam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in kul tawh ki-im khuopite, tunkotte, le kotgolte a nei Beth-horon Tungnung le Beth-horon Neinung zong lam a,"},"6":{"text":"Baalath le Solomon’ vankholna khuopi zosie zong, a leengte koina khuopi zosie, a sakol galkapte ading khuopite, le Solomon in Jerusalem, Lebanon, le ama uhna gam sung zosie-ah a lam nop zosie a lam hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel ahi lo Hit-te, Amor-te, Periz-te, Hiv-te, le Jebus-te sung pan a omlai teng,"},"8":{"text":"Israel mite in a suhsiet nai lo amau’ suonlehlahte sung panin tua gam sunga a omlai teng- tam teng pen Solomon in thona-aana sem dinga a khon mite ahi vua, tua bangin amate tuni dongin a om uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanle Solomon in a nasepna-ah Israel mite salin bawl lo hi; amate pen galkapte, le ama nei-a uliente, a leeng galkap makaite, le a sakol galkap makaite ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tam teng pen mite tunga aana a zang Kumpi Solomon’ ulien zani le sawmnga-te ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in David’ khuopi panin ama adinga a lam inn ah Pharaoh’ tanu peipi hi, azieh pen ama in, “ Topa’ singkuong a tunnasa munte a siengtho ahi ziehin Israel Kumpi David’ inn sungah ka zi teng thei lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in talaap mai-a a lam Topa’ maitam tungah Solomon in Topa tungah meihal biehnate a pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in sabbath nite, hladet nite, kum sima kibawl pawi thumte- tol kisaw lo anlum pawi, nipikal pawi, buh pawite le nisima a kisam bangin Topa tungah biehpiehnate a pie hi.","ref":"Pei 23:14-17; 34:22-23; Gam 28:9-15; 28:16–29:39; Thkna 16:16"},"14":{"text":"Ama in a pa David’ biehna ngaina kip tawh kizui-in amau’ sep nading munah siempute a pawlpawlin se a, nisim nasepna-ah a kisam bangin Levi-te phatna lasah nasep le a tuonvai nasep a sem dingin siempute tawh kithuosah a, ama in kotpi tuomtuomte dingin kotcingte amau’ pawl kikhenna cietah se hi; azieh pen tua bangin David in Pasien’ mipa thu a pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Levi-te le siempute in thu khat popo le vanmanphate koina tawh kisai-in kumpipa thupiehna panin a lam piel sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin Topa’ biehinn bulpi a kiphu ni-a kipanin Topa’ biehinnpi a kiman sieng dongin Solomon’ nasep ding zosie kiman sieng hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Solomon in Edom gam sung tuipi gei-a om Ezion-geber le Eloth-te a va pha ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Huram in ama kungah a tembawte le tuipi thu a thei a nasemte a sawl hi. Solomon’ nasemte tawh Ophir ah amate a zawhton vua, khum panin kham talent zali le sawmnga puo-in Kumpi Solomon kung a tunpi uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon’ minthan na a zah ciengin thudawhna hamsate tawh Solomon zelah dingin Jerusalem ah haw a, ama in nuazui honpi le a namtui nate, kham tampi le suongmanpha a puo kalaohte a keng hi. Solomon kungah ama nu a tun ciengin a lungsim sunga om zosie ama tawh a kikum hi.","title":"Sheba Kumpinu Hawna (1Kum 10:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in tua nu thudawh zosie a dawng hi; tua nu kungah Solomon in a gencien thei lo hahsa luo a sah thu bangma om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon’ pilna, a lamsa a inn a lo,"},"4":{"text":"a sabuoi-a kilui neh le tahte, vaihawm uliente’ tona, le a nasemte’ kep le khoi dan, a puonsil a nihtente uh, a an piete, le Topa’ inn sunga a meihal biehnate a mu ciengin, tua nu ciza lia-in a hla tawh zong a teng nawn va-ia sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua nu in kumpipa kungah, “Ka gam sung pana ka zah na sepnate le na pilna ang kigente a man vive ahi a,"},"6":{"text":"ahi vangin keima hing pei-in ka mit in a mu masangsie a kigen thute ka tahsang sih hi. Na pilna a lietzie alang nangawn zong ka kungah ang kigen nai sih hi; ka thuzahte sangin na thupizaw tham hi."},"7":{"text":"Na mite mi nuomsa ahi uhi! Nang ang khoi zing a, na pilna thu a za zing na nasemte zong mi nuomsa ahi uhi!"},"8":{"text":"Na tungah lungkimin, Topa na Pasien adingin kumpi dinga ama’ kumpi topha tunga ang tosah Topa na Pasien in thupha nga taheh! Na Pasien in Israel it a, a tawntungin amate kipsah ding ahi ziehin, thutang le thuman na sep thei nadingin ama in amate tungah nang kumpi ang suohsah hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu in kumpipa tungah kham talent za le sawmni, le gimnamtui tampitah le suong manphate a pie hi: Solomon kumpipa tunga Sheba kumpinu in a pieh tua banga a gimnamtui om ngai nai lo hi.","ref":"Mat 12:42; Luk 11:31"},"10":{"text":"Tua tham loin Ophir panin kham a puo Huram’ nasemte le Solomon’ nasemte in cingsing le suong manphate zong a puo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn le kumpi inn kaleite bawl nadingin kumpipa in cingsingte zang a, lasate ading lyre-te le harp-te bawl nadingin zong zang hi; tua hun masangin Judah gam sungah tua bangte kimu ngai lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Khum hun sungin Sheba kumpinu’ dei nget zosie Kumpi Solomon in pie a, kumpipa kunga a pieh za sanga a tamzaw a pie hi. Tua ciengin a nasemte tawh a gamah tua nu a pei hi."},"13":{"text":"Kum khat sungin Solomon tunga kipuoh kham a gihna talent zaguh le sawmguh le guh pha a,","title":"Solomon’ Hauna (1Kum 10:14-29 ; 2Khg 1:14-17)"},"14":{"text":"tuate banah sumbawlte le sumbuhte’ puohte kisim nai lo hi; tuale Arabia kumpite le gam uhpate zosie in Solomon tungah kham le ngunte a puoh uhi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in a kikheng kham tawh lum a gol zani bawl hi; lum a gol khat bawl nadingin kham shekel zaguh tawp hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a kikheng kham lum zathum bawl hi; lum khat ciengin kham shekel zathum ta tawp hi; tuale kumpipa in Lebanon Tulah Inn sungah tua lumte koi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in saiha tawh kumpi topha golpi khat zong bawl a, kham citah tawh a zut hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi topha in kalei ciel guh le kham tawh a kibawl kengngapna khat nei-in, tuate pen Kumpi topha tawh kimat a, a tona pang tuohah ban ngapnate le a ban ngahnate pangah humpi ni ding a,"},"19":{"text":"kalei ciel guh mong cietah khat ciet, humpi sawm le ni ding hi. Kumpi gam khatpo-ah tua tawh a kibang kibawl ngai lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon’ tuidawnna hai zosie a unpi-in kham citah tawh kibawl hi a, tuale Lebanon Tulah Inn sunga vanzah zosie a unpi-in kham citah tawh kibawl vive ahi hi; Solomon hun lai-in ngun bangma-in a kisim sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen kumpipa’ tembawte Huram’ nasemte tawh Tarshish ah a pei uhi; kum thum sielin Tarshish tembawte khatvei tungin kham, ngun, saiha, zawngkute, le utongte puoh zel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua bangin kumpi Solomon in a hauna le a pilna tawh leitung kumpi zosie sangin a tungtuongzaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasien in a lungsim sunga a guot ama’ pilna ngai dingin leitung mi zosie in Solomon’ opna a leisui uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama kunga a haw zosie in letsong, ngun le kham tawh a kibawl nate, puonsilte, galvante, gimnamtuite, sakolte, laa-sakolte, kum sielin tampi a puoh uhi."},"25":{"text":"Solomon in sakolte le leengte koina buh tulli, le sakol tul sawm le tulni nei a, tuate leeng khuopite sungah koi a, Jerusalem khuo-a ama kungah zong koi hi.","ref":"1Kum 4:26"},"26":{"text":"Ama in Euphrates panin Philistia gam cieng dong, le Egypt gamgi cieng dong kumpi zosie uh hi.","ref":"Pien 15:18; 1Kum 4:21"},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jerusalem ah suongpem bangin ngun tamsah a, tuale Shephelah theitheh sing bangin taamtah sing zong a vausah hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:27"},"28":{"text":"Solomon adingin Egypt gam le gam zosie panin sakolte kila hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:16"},"29":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon gamtatna a omlai teng, a patna panin a tawpna dong, Kamsang Nathan’ Tangthu sung, le Shiloh-te Ahijah’ Thugen Kholna sung, le Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam thu tawh kisai-in Thumu pa Iddo’ Mangmuna sungah kigiel hi lo amah?","title":"Solomon Sina (1Kum 11:41-43)"},"30":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem ah Israel zosie kum sawmli sung uh hi."},"31":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Solomon lumton a, a pa David’ khuopi sungah kivui hi; tuale a tapa Rehoboam in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shechem ah Rehoboam a pei hi, azieh pen ama kumpi suohsah dingin Israel zosie a pei uhi.","title":"Rehoboam Kiledona (1Kum 12:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam in tua thu a zah ciengin (azieh pen Kumpi Solomon kung pan a taina Egypt ah ama omlai hi), Egypt panin Jeroboam a kilekia hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in mi sawlin ama a hlansah uhi; tuale Jeroboam le Israel zosie pei-in Rehoboam kungah,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa in ka hahkol uh a gihsah hi. Tua ahi ziehin tu-in na pa’ nasep hamsate le ko tunga ei suon a hahkol gihte hing zangsah in, tua hile kote in nangma’ na ka sem ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Ni thum sungin keima kungah hing peikia un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n mite a pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Rehoboam in zong a pa Solomon hin lai-a ama a kem khanghamte thu kuppi a, “Tam mite ka dawnna ding ngaisutna ei bangci pieh ding na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Nang in tam mite khuotuo-in amate lungkimsahin kam hoi gen po lacin, a tawntungin na nasemte ang hi zing ta ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle ama in khangham upate pieh ngaisutna nuol a, ama tawh a khangton, tulaitaha ama a kem khangnote thu a kuppi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “’Na pa in ko tunga ang suon hahkol zangsah in,’ ei ci mite i dawn thei nadingin bang ngaisutna ei pie ding na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama tawh a khangton tangvalte in ama kungah, “Nangma kungah, ‘Na pa in ka hahkol uh gihsah hi, ahi vangin nang in ko adingin tua hahkol hing zangsah in,’ ang ci mite kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi, ‘Ka pa’ kawng sangin ka khutme a sazaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in keima in ka pa ang suon vangih kang belap lai ding hi. Ka pa in khauhuol tawh ang sat vua, ahi vangin keima in cieng lingneite tawh kang sat ding hi,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in, “Ni thum ni-in ka kungah hing peikia un,” a ci ma bangin Rehoboam kungah Jeroboam le mi zosie a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa in amate na khauh dawn mama hi. Kumpi Rehoboam in khanghamte’ ngaisutna a nuol hi;"},"14":{"text":"ama in khangnote’ ngaisutna bangin amate kungah thu gen a, “Ka pa in no tunga vangih ang suon pen kang belap zaw lai ding hi; ka pa in khauhuol tawh note thu ang hil hi, ahi vangin keima in cieng lingneite tawh thu kang hil ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in mite’ thu a ngai sih hi. Azieh pen tami khu Topa in Shiloh-te Ahijah tungtawnin Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam tungah a gensa thu a tangtun nadinga Topa piensah thukawng kiheina ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa in amau’ thu ngai lo hi, ci Israel mi zosie in a mu bepun, mite in kumpipa dawngin, David sungah kote in bang tanh ka nei uh ahei? Jessi tapa sungah gouluo ka nei sih uhi. Israel aw, na puonbuh cietah pei un! a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Israel zosie in a puonbuh ciet a zuon uhi.","ref":"2Sam 20:1"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Judah gam khuopite sunga a teng Israel mite tungah Rehoboam a maang hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi Rehoboam in Israel mite kungah thona-aana nasepna a uhpa Hadoram a sawl ciengin, amate in ama suong tawh na seplia uhi. Jerusalem-a tai dingin a leeng tungah Kumpipa Rehoboam a naw tuon hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel in tuni dongin David’ innsung mite a ledo uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Rehoboam a tun ciengin ama in Rehoboam’ kumpi gam a ngakia nadingin Israel sim dingin Judah minam le Benjamin minam teeltuom galkap mi tul zakhat le tul sawmgiet kaikhawm hi.","title":"Judah le Benjamin Kulin Ki-im (1Kum 12:20-24)"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ mi Shemaiah tungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"3":{"text":"Judah kumpi Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam, le Judah le Benjamin gam sunga om Israel mi zosie kungah gen in,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: “Note na kuonto sih ding vua, na sanggamte na sim sih ding uhi. Mi zosie a inn lam ciet vuah kilekia ta uheh. Bang ding ahei cile tam thu khu keima kung pan ahi hi. Tuaci’n Topa’ thu mangin Jeroboam do nading panin amate a kilekia uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Rehoboam teng a, kidal nadingin ama in Judah gam sungah khuopite a lam hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,"},"7":{"text":"Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,"},"8":{"text":"Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,"},"9":{"text":"Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,"},"10":{"text":"Zorah, Aijalon, le Hebron, Judah le Benjamin gam sunga om kulnei khuopite a lam hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in gal kulpite dettahin bawl a, tuate sungah galkapmangte koi-in an, sathau le lenggazu a koi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in khuopi zosie-ah lum le tei golte koi a, tua khuopite a muonhuoi-in a bawl hi. Tuaci’n ama in Judah gam le Benjamin gam kem hi."},"13":{"text":"Amau’ tenna ciet panin Israel gam sung zosie-a om siempute le Levi-te ama kungah a kila uhi.","title":"Siempute le Levi-te in Rehoboam Panpi (1Kum 14:21-24)"},"14":{"text":"Levi-te in a taang gamte ule a neisate uh nuasie siengin Judah le Jerusalem ah a pei uhi. Azieh pen Jeroboam le a tapate in Topa’ siempu hina panin amate khawlsah a,"},"15":{"text":"munsangte, kel-dawite, le a bawlsa bawngno milimte adingin ama’ siempute koi hi.","ref":"1Kum 12:31"},"16":{"text":"Israel Topa Pasien sui ding a lunglut mite in a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa tungah biehpiehna pie dingin Israel minam zosie sung panin a nua uh zui-in Jerusalem ah a pei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Judah kumpi gam a thahatsah vua, Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam kum thum sung bihtahin a omsah uhi. Azieh pen amate in David le Solomon’ lampi kum thum sung a tawn uhi."},"18":{"text":"Rehoboam in David’ tapa Jerimoth’ tanu Mahalath zi-in la a, a nu Jessi’ tapa Eliab’ tanu Abihail ahi hi.","title":"Rehoboam’ Zineina"},"19":{"text":"Tua nu in ama tawh tapate, Jeush, Shemariah, le Zaham nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua nu zaw ciengin ama in Absalom’ tanu Maacah la a, ama tawh Abijah, Attai, Ziza, le Shelomith nei hi."},"21":{"text":"Rehoboam in a zi dangte zosie le a mei teng sangin Absalom’ tanu Maacah a itzaw hi. (ama in zi sawm le giet le mei sawmguh nei a, tapa sawmni le giet le tanu sawmguh’ pa a suoh hi)."},"22":{"text":"Rehoboam in kumpi-in ama a koi sawm ziehin a sanggamte lahah Maacah’ tapa Abijah ulien penin koi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pilvang tahin ama vaihawm a, Judah le Benjamin gam sung teng zosie, kulpi nei khuopi zosie sungah a tapa kimkhat a hawmkhen hi; ama in an neh ding tampitah pie a, amate adingin zi zong a suipieh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam’ uhna kipin ama a thahat ciengin, ama le a ompi Israel zosie in Topa’ thukham a nuasie uhi.","title":"Egypt in Judah Sim (1Kum 14:25-28)"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah amate a citah lo ziehun Kumpi Rehoboam’ a kum ngana kumin Jerusalem sim dingin Egypt Kumpi Shishak,"},"3":{"text":"leeng galkap tul le zani, le sakol galkap tul sawmguh tawh a kuonto hi. Egypt pana ama tawh a kuonton galkapte ahile a tam dan uh kisim zo lo hi- amate pen Libya-te, Sukki-te, le Ethiopia-te ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Judah gama kulnei khuopite la-in Jerusalem cieng dong a tung hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shishak ziehin Jerusalem-a a kikhawm Rehoboam le Judah uliente kungah kamsang Shemaiah pei-in amate kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Note in kei nei nuasie uhi. Tuaci’n ken zong Shishak’ khut sungah note kang nuasie ta hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel uliente le kumpipa a kiniemkhieh vua, tuaci’n amate in, “ Topa a thuman hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in amau’ kiniemkhieh lam a mu bepin Shemaih kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi: “Amate a kiniemkhieh zo ta uhi; hizongle amate susie loin ka hunkhie lieiliei tei ding a, Shishak’ khut tungtawnin Jerusalem tungah ka lungthahna kisungsuh lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in keima’ nasepna le gamdang kumpi gamte’ nasepna a kilamdanna a theithei nadingun amate pen ama’ nasemte a suoh ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalem sim dingin Egypt Kumpipa Shishak a kuonto hi; ama in Topa’ biehinn sunga goute le kumpipa’ inn sunga goute a kipan na zosie a lamang sieng hi; ama in Solomon’ bawlsa kham lumte zong a lamang sieng hi;","ref":"1Kum 10:16-17; 2Khg 9:15-16"},"10":{"text":"hinanle Kumpi Rehoboam in tuate tangin sumngo lum bawl a, kumpipa’ kotcing ahi inncing uliente’ khut sungah tuate ap hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sungah kumpipa a lut sielin a cingte pei-in tuate puo-in a cingte’ innkhan sungah a koikia uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama a kiniemkhieh ziehin amate a suhsiet cip lo nadingin ama kung panin Topa’ lungthahna a kiheimang hi; tua tham loin, Judah gam sungah thu peizie zong hoi pai hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpi Jerusalem ah Rehoboam amama kisukipin a maang hi. Rehoboam a maan kipatin kum sawmni le khat pha hi; Israel minamte sung panin Topa in ama’ min koi nadinga a teel Jerusalem ah ama kum sawm le sagi sung maang hi. Ama’ min pen Naamah hi a, Ammon-te ahi hi.","title":"Rehoboam’ Sina (1Kum 14:21-22 , 29-31)"},"14":{"text":"Ama in Topa sui ding a lungsim sungah a koi lo ziehin a sie-in a gamta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Rehoboam’ gamtatna teng, a kipatna pan a tawpna dong, Kamsang Shemaiah le Thumu pa Iddo’ Khang Tangthu sungah kigiel hi lo amah? Rehoboam le Jeroboam kikalah kidona om den hi."},"16":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Rehoboam lumton a, David’ khuopi sungah kivui hi; tuale a tapa Abijah in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Jeroboam a maan kum sawm le gietna kumin Judah tungah Abijah maan ding a kipan hi.","title":"Abijah in Judah ah Uh (1Kum 15:1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Jerusalem ah kum thum sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min Micaiah hi a, Gibeah-te Uriel’ tanu ahi hi. Tu-in Abijah le Jeroboam kilalah kidona a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Gal sim dingin Abijah kuon a, a kituomteel mi zali a pha, a thahat galhang galkap hon a nei hi. A kituomteel a thahat galhang tul zagiet tawh Abijah do dingin Jeroboam a pang hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ephraim muoltung gama om Zemaraim Muol tungah Abijah ding a, “Jeroboam le Israel zosie aw, ka thu ngai un!"},"5":{"text":"Israel Pasien Topa in ci tawh kibawl thuciemna tawh Israel tunga kumpi sem den dingin David le a tapate tungah a pieh lam thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Hizongle David’ tapa Solomon’ nasempa, Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam kipanin a pu a ledo hi;"},"7":{"text":"tuale Rehoboam pen khangno lai a, thukhentat thei nai loin amate a nan zo lo hun laitahin, a kimvelah kimanna a nei lo mi ginalo honkhat kikhawmin Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam a dem bawl uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Note in mi tampi na hi zieh ule Jeroboam in na pasien ding vua ang bawlpieh kham bawngnote na nei ziehun, tu-in David tapate’ khut sunga om Topa’ kumpi gam do na sawm uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aaron’ suonte ahi Topa’ siempute, le Levi-te delmangin gamdang mite bawl bang ma-in noma dingin siempute bawltawm hi lo na hi uh amah? Bawngtangno khat ahi sihle tuutang sagi tawh a kisiensuo dinga a pei popo pasien ahi lote’ siempu suoh paipai hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin kote adingin ahile, Topa pen ka Pasien uh ahi a, ama ka nuasie sih uhi. Topa’ na a sem Aaron’ suon siempute le amau’ nasep a hu dingin Levi-te ka nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in zingmawng le nitah sielin Topa tungah meihal biehnate le a gim namtuite a pie vua, kham citah tawh a kibawl sabuoi tungah anlum guolte lui-in, nitah sielin a meivahte a kuon siem nadingin kham meivah tunna a kem hoi uhi; bangzieh ahei cile kote in Topa ka Pasien’ ei sawlna ka zui vua, ahi vangin note in ama na nuasie uhi."},"12":{"text":"En un, ka makai dingun kote tawh Topa ang omton a, note do dinga gal hlatna pengkul tum dingin ama’ siempute in galkap pengkulte a nei uhi. Israel-te aw, na pu na pate uh’ Pasien, Topa do sih un; azieh pen na zo vawt sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Jeroboam in a nua lam panun a buhdap dingte a sawl hi; tua bangin Judah masangah a galkapte om a, a nua lam vuah a buhdapte a om hi."},"14":{"text":"Judah a kihei ciengin ama in a galte a nua a ma-ah a op lam a mu hi. Topa kungah amate a kiko vua, siempute in pengkul a mut uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah mite in zong galdona aw a kiko uhi. Judah mite a kiko ciengun Abijah le Judah mai-ah Pasien in Jeroboam le Israel mi zosie a zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Judah mai-ah Israel-te a taimang vua, Pasien in a khut sung vuah amate a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Abijah le a galkapte in amate zogawpin mi tampi a that uhi; a kituomteel Israel mi tul zanga kithat hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua bangin a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa tungah amate a kingap ziehun Judah mite a guol zo vua, Israel-te in tua hunin gal a lel uhi."},"19":{"text":"Abijah in Jeroboam nuadel a, ama kung panin khuopite, Bethel a khuoneute tawh, Jeshanah a khuoneute le Ephron a khuoneute tawh a la hi."},"20":{"text":"Jeroboam in Abijah’ hun sungin vang nei zo nawn lo hi; Topa in ama vatin ama a si hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Abijah a thahat tehteh hi. Ama in zi sawm le li la a, tapa sawmni le ni le tanu sawm le guh’ pa a suoh hi."},"22":{"text":"Abijah’ gamtatna a omlai teng, ama ziete le a thugente, Kamsang Iddo’ Tangthu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abijah si-in a pu a pate tawh lumton a, amate in David’ khuopi-ah ama a vui uhi. A tapa Asa in ama’ zaluo hi. Ama’ uh sungin a gam sungah kum sawm sung gal a veng hi.","title":"Asa in Uh (1Kum 15:9-15)"},"2":{"text":"Asa in Topa a Pasien’ muna-ah a hoi le a manin na sem hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in gamdang maitamte, munsangte, le biehna songte satpua-in khuom siengthote phua a,"},"4":{"text":"a pu a pate’ Pasien, Topa sui-in thukham le thupiehnate a zui nadingun Judah thu a pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Judah khuopi zosie panin munsangte le gimnamtui maitamte zong hemkhie hi. Tuale ama’ khut nei-ah kumpi gam sung gal a veng hi."},"6":{"text":"A gam sungah gal a dai hun sungin ama in Judah gam sungah kulpi nei khuopite a lam hi. Topa in ama tungah kilemna hun a pieh ziehin khum hun sungin ama in gal a nei kha sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Judah kungah, “Tam khuopite lamin kulpite le tausangte, kul kotpite le zawlte tawh im vai. Topa i Pasien i sui ziehun leitang pen eite’ gam ahi lai hi; eite in ama i sui vua, ama in zong i kim zosie-ah kilemna ei pie hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in zong khuopi lamin a khangto uhi."},"8":{"text":"Asa in Judah gam sung panin lum gol le teipi tawh kivon galkap tul zathum, le lum le thal a tawi Benjamin galkap hon tul zani le tul sawmgiet nei hi; tam teng zosie pen a thahat galhangte ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate a sim dingin galkap awn khat le leeng galkap zathum tawh Ethiopia-te Zerah kuonin Mareshah cieng dong tung hi.","title":"Ethiopia-te’ Busimna Kiledo"},"10":{"text":"Ama tawh kimu dingin Asa kuonkhie a, Marashah-a Zephathah guom-ah gal kido dingin amate in panmun a la uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa a Pasien’ tungah Asa kiko a, “ Topa aw, a thahat le a thanemte kikalah na panpi ding pen nang adingin a kilamdanna a om sih hi. Kote ei hu in, Topa kohaw’ Pasien aw. Nangma kang muon ziehun nangma’ minin tam mihonpi a do dingin kang pei zo ta uhi. Topa aw, nang, kohaw’ Pasien na hi hi; mihing in kizosah vawt sin,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Asa le Judah mite mai-ah Ethiopia-te zo a, Ethiopia-te a taimang uhi."},"13":{"text":"Asa le ama tawh a omton galkapte in Gerar cieng dongah amate a nuadel vua, Ethiopia-te koima a hing om loin a puamat sieng uhi; azieh pen Topa le a galkapte mai-ah amate kisusie hi. Judah mite in van kinuasie tampitah a puo uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate tungah Topa zatahna a tun ziehin Gerar kimvela om khuopi zosie a zo uhi. Amate in khuopi teng a bulu uhi; azieh pen tua khuopite sungah van kinuasie tampitah om hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in ganhon neite’ puonbuhte zong simin tuu le keel, le kalaoh tampi a peipi uhi. Tua ciengin Jerusalem ah a kilekia uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Obed’ tapa Azariah tungah Pasien’ hlagau a tung hi."},"2":{"text":"Asa tawh kimu dingin ama pusuohin ama kungah, “Asa, Judah le Benjamin-te zosie aw, ka thugen ngai un. Ama tawh na om laisie uh note tawh Topa ang om hi. Ama na sui uleh ama na mu ding vua, ahi vangin ama na nuasie uleh ama in zong note ang nuasie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Hun sawtveipi sung Israel-te, Pasien man tawh om lo, thuhil siempu tawh om loin, thukham tawh zong omlo uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate a lungkham ciengun Israel Pasien, Topa lamah kihei-in ama a sui vua, tuaci’n ama a mu uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in amate a zinsuh a zinto na vuah lungmuonna a om sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile gamcin tenga a teng mi zosie tungah buoina lienpi a tung hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien in lungkhamna namcin tawh a buoisah ziehin minam khat le minam khat, khuopi khat le khuopi khat a kido vua, a nengnengin a kikhenthang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanle nang na hi leh hang in! Na nasepna thaman ang kipie ding ahi ziehin na khut zawsah sin,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Asa in Oded’ tapa Azariah’ genkhol na ahi tam thute a zah ciengin ama hangsanin, Judah gam zosie le Benjamin le Ephraim muoltung gam pana a lahsa khuopite panin a kidahhuoi milimte paimang a, Topa’ biehinn talaap mai-a Topa’ maitam a puopha hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Judah le Benjamin-te zosie, le Ephraim, Manasseh, le Simeon sung panin amate kunga a peem gamdang mite a kaikhawm hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa a Pasien in ama tawh a opna thu a mu ciengun Israel panin ama kungah mi tampi a tai uhi."},"10":{"text":"Asa’ uh kum sawm le ngana a hla thumna sungin Jerusalem ah amate a kikhawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ni-in gal sunga a puoh uh nate sung panin Topa tungah bawngtang zasagi le tuu tulsagi tawh biehpiehna a pie uhi."},"12":{"text":"A lungsim zosie ule a hinna zosie utawh a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa a sui nadingun kiciemna khat a bawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Israel Pasien, Topa a sui lo poma, a khang hile, a teh hile, pasal hile, numei hile kithat ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Awsangpi tawh a kiko kawmun amate in pengkul le sakite tumin Topa tungah kiciemna a bawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua kiciemna-ah Judah mi zosie a kipah uhi; bangzieh ahei cile a lungsim zosie utawh amate kiciemin a deina zosie utawh ama a sui vua, amate in ama mu-in, Topa in zong a kimvel vuah galvenna a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"A nu Maacah in Asherah adingin a kidahhuoi milim khat a bawl ziehin kumpi Asa in a nu nangawn kumpipa’ nu hina za panin a hemkhie hi. Asa in a nu’ milim sattanin suguoi a, Kidron Lui-ah a haltum hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel panin munsangte a kilakhietuon sih hi.
