Hizongle a uh hun sung tungtawnin Asa’ lungsim a thuman hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in pieh dinga a pa in a na ciemsa letsongte le ama’ na ciemsa letsongte - ngun le kham, le vanzahte, Pasien’ biehinn sungah a peipi hi."},"19":{"text":"Asa in a uh kum sawmthum le ngana cieng dong galkidona om nawn lo hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asa a maan kum sawmthum le guhna kumin Judah sim dingin Israel Kumpipa Baasha kuonto a, Judah Kumpipa Asa’ gam sungah koima a pusuoh a sungtum a op thei lo nadingin ama in Ramah khuo a sat hi.","title":"Aram tawh Kizopna Kimawsah (1Kum 15:16-22)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Asa in Topa’ inn le kumpipa’ inn sunga goute sung panin ngun le khamte la-in, Damascus-a teng Aram Kumpipa Ben-hadad kungah tuate hlah a,"},"3":{"text":"“Na pa le ka pa a kizop ma bangin nang le kei kikalah kizopna khat omsah vai. Ngun le kham kang hlah hi; kei kung panin ama a nuakin nadingin va pei ta’nlen Israel Kumpipa Baasha tawh na kizopna va phel ta’n,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ben-hadad in Kumpi Asa thugen mangin Israel khuopite sim dingin a galkapmangte sawl a, amate in Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, le Naphtali vankholna khuopite a zo uhi."},"5":{"text":"Baasha in tua thu a zah ciengin Ramah khuopi a lam khawl a, a nasep a tawpsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Asa in Judah mi zosie khawm a, amate in Baasha in Ramah lamna-a a zah suongte le a singte puo-in tuate tawh Geba le Mizpah a lam uhi."},"7":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Judah Kumpi Asa kungah thumu pa Hanani pei-in ama kungah, “Nangma in Aram kumpipa suongin Topa na Pasien suong lo na hi ziehin Aram kumpipa’ galkapte in nang ang suohtasah hi."},"8":{"text":"Ethiopia-te le Libya-te zong khu leeng tampi le sakol galkap tampitah tawh a om galkap tampi hi lo amah? Ahi vangin Topa suong na hi ziehin ama in nangma’ khut sungah amate ang pie hi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama tungah a lungsim a man mite thahatsah dingin Topa’ mit in leitung zosie a en kawikawi hi. Tami thu-ah na mot tat zo ta hi; azieh pen tu-a kipanin gal na nei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin thumu pa tungah Asa lungthah a, ama kolbulin thong sungah a khum hi, azieh pen tam thu ziehin ama tungah a lungthah mama hi. Tuale khum hun sung ma-in Asa in mi kimkhat tungah gimna hamsapite a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Asa’ gamtatnate, a patna panin a tawpna dong, Judah le Israel Kumpite’ Tangthu sungah kigiel hi.","title":"Asa’ Natna le A Sina (1Kum 15:23-24)"},"12":{"text":"Ama a maan a kum sawmthum le kuona kumin Asa in a kengah natna nei a, a natna nasie mama hi; hinanle a nat hun sung nangawnin ama in Topa a sui sih a, zato siemte’ panpina a suizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pu a pate tawh Asa lumton a, ama a maan zaw a kum sawmli le khatna kumin a si hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in David khuopi ah ama dinga a kibawlsa hankhuh sungah ama a vui uhi. Amate in panamtui bawl siem mite’ bawl a namtui tuomtuomte tawh a kidim hankuong sungah ama a siel uhi; tuale amate in ama zatahna-in tumphuol golpi khat a taw uhi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama’ tapa Jehoshaphat in a za luo a, Israel sim dingin amama a kithakhausah hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat’ Uhna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Judah gama kulpi nei khuopi zosie-ah galkapte koi a, Judah gam sung le a pa Asa in a lahsa Ephraim khuopite sungah khuopi cingte koi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a pa’ gamtat masate a zui ziehin Topa in Jehoshaphat a ompi hi; ama in Baal pasien-te bie loin,"},"4":{"text":"Israel-te’ tawndan bangin tawn a, a pa’ bieh Pasien sui-in a thupiehnate a zuizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in ama’ khut sungah kumpi gam a kipsah hi. Judah zosie in Jehoshaphat kungah sieh le kaihte a puoh vua, ama in neisa tampi le patawina nga hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa’ lampite ah a ama’ lungsim a hangsan hi; tua tham loin ama in Judah gam panin munsangte le khuom siengthote a hemkhie hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama’ uh a kum thumna kumin ama in Judah gam khuopite sunga thuhil dingin a uliente Benhail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, le Micaiah-te a sawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate tawh Levi mite Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, le Tob-adonijah a peiton uhi; tuale siempu Elishama le Jehoram zong tami Levi-te tawh a peiton uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ thukham laibu kengin Judah gam sungah amate in thu a hil uhi; Judah khuopi zosie-ah amate pei kawikawi-in mite lahah thu a hil uhi."},"10":{"text":"Judah gam kimvela om kumpi gam zosie tungah Topa zatahna tung a, tuale amate in Jehoshaphat a do nawn sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Philistia-te pawlkhat in Jehoshaphat kungah letsongte, le sie le kaih dingin ngun a puoh uhi; tuale Arab-te in zong ama tungah tuutang tulsagi le zasagi, le keeltang tulsagi le zasagi a puoh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Damdamin Jehoshaphat vanglien semsem hi. Ama in Judah gam sungah kulpite le vankholna khuopite a lam hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in Judah khuopite sungah nasep lienpite sem hi. Ama in Jerusalem-ah galkapte, a thahat galhangte a nei hi."},"14":{"text":"A pupate innkuon tawh kizui-in amate a phaza tam bang ahi hi. Judah sung pan a tula a uhte: Adah pen a uhpa ahi a, a thahat galhang mi tul zathum tawh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama’ zomah a uhpa Jehohanan ahi a, mi tul zani le tul sawmgiet tawh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama’ zomah Topa’ nasepna dinga kipumpieh Zichri’ tapa Amasiah ahi a, a thahat a galhang mi tul zani tawh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Benjamin sung panin: A thahat a galhang Eliada ahi a, thal le lum a tawi mi tul zani tawh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama’ zomah Jehozabad ahi a, galdo dinga hiem tawi mi tul zakhat le tul sawmgiet tawh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tam teng pen kumpipa in Judah gam sung zosie-ah kul nei khuopite-a a koite banah kumpipa’ na a semte ahi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoshaphat in hauna le minthanna nei hi; tuale ama in Ahab tawh kitenna zieha kizopna khat a bawl hi.","title":"Micaiah in Guollel nading Genkhol (1Kum 22:1-28)"},"2":{"text":"Kum tawmvei zaw ciengin Samaria-a Ahab kunga haw dingin a kuonsuh hi. Ahab in ama ading le a zawpite adingin tuu tampi le bawngtang tampi gaw a, Ramoth-gilead simto dingin ama a zawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah Kumpipa Jehoshaphat kungah, “Keima tawh Ramoth-gilead ah nang kuon diei mah?” ci hi. Ama in dawngin, “Nangma tawh a omton ka hi a, ka mite nangma’ mite ahi hi. Galsimna-ah nangma tawh kang kuon ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jehoshaphat in zong Israel kumpipa kungah, “ Topa’ thu dong masa in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in kamsangte zali kaikhawm a, tuale amate kungah, “Ramoth-gilead sim dingin ka kuonto diei, tua ahi sihle ka pel lel diei mah?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Kuonto in; azieh pen Pasien in kumpipa’ khut sungah ang pie ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jehoshaphat in, “Tam sungah thu i dawh thei ding Topa’ kamsang adang a om ta sih amah?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Thu i dawh thei ding Imlah’ tapa Micaiah a kici mi dangkhat omlai hi; ahi vangin ama in kei thu a hoi lamin a gen ngai sih a, gimna nading ngentang a gen ziehin ama ka muda hi,” a ci hi. Jehoshaphat in, “Kumpipa in tua bang mawh ci sin,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in a ulien khat hlan a, “Imlah’ tapa Micaiah mallangtahin hing peipi in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat a kumpi topha tung vuah to-in puontuolpi silin a kizem uhi; tuale Samaria tunkot lutna mun ancilna phuol-ah amate a to uhi; tuale kamsang zosie in a mai vuah kam a sang uhi."},"10":{"text":"Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekiah in sia sakite bawlin ama in, “ Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Amate a kisuhsiet masangsie tam teng tawh Aram-te na sun ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsang zosie in zong tua ma bangin kam a sang vua, “Ramoth-gilead ah kuonto inlen va zo ta’n; Topa in kumpipa’ khut sungah ang pie ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Micaiah hlan dinga a kuon kamtaipa in ama kungah, “En in, kithukhatin kamsangte’ gen khu kumpipa dinga a hoilam ahi hi; na thu gen zong amau’ gen tawh kibangsah inlen, a hoilamin gen in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Micaiah in, “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin ka Pasien’ gen popo ka gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah ama a tun ciengin kumpipa in ama kungah, “Micaiah aw, Ramoth-gilead ah galsim dingin ka kuonto diei, tua ahi sihle ka pel lel diei mah?” a ci hi. Ama in dawng a, “Kuonto inlen va zo ta’n; na khut sungah amate ang kipie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle kumpipa in ama kungah, “ Topa’ min tawh keima tungah thuman ci longal bangma dang nang gen lo nadingin bang zavei hing kiciemsah ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Micaiah in, “Tuucing om lo tuute bangin muolte tungah Israel mi zosie a kithethang ka mu hi. Tuale Topa in, ‘Tam mite in pu a nei sih uhi; a inn lam ciet vuah lungmuongin kilesah un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 27:17; Ezk 34:5; Mat 9:36; Mrk 6:34"},"17":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ama in kei thu a hoi lamin khat zong gen ngai loin gimna ding beh ang gen ding hi, ci-in na kungah kang gen tamal sih amah?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Micaiah in, “Tua ahi ziehin Topa’ thugen ngai vawi un: Topa a kumpi topha tungah to-in a ziet le a vei-ah van mihonpite a ding ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, ‘Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa Ahab kuonto-in a si nadingin koi pen in ama va zawl ta ding ahei?’ a ci hi. Tua ciengin"},"20":{"text":"hlagau khat madawhin Topa mai-ah ding a, ‘Keima in ama va zawl ta vang,’ a ci masangsie, khat in thu khat gen a, adang khat in thu tuom khat a gen hi. Topa in ama kungah, ‘Bang na ci zawl diei?’ a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in dawngin, ‘Kei va pei-in a kamsang zosie’ kam sungah hlagau zuou khat ka va suoh ta ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ciengin Topa in, ‘Nangma in ama na va zawl ta ding a, na zo ding hi; pei inlen va sem in,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n en in, Topa in tami na kamsangte’ kam sungah hlagau zuou khat koi zo ta hi; Topa in nang adingin na thuoh ding gimna khensat zo hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekiah in zuon phei-a Micaiah pheta behin, “Nang tunga thu gen dingin Topa’ hlagau in bang lampi panin ei kalsan thei ahei?” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Micaiah in dawngin, “A kibu dingin innkhan sungnungah na pei ni ciengin na thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel kumpipa in thupie a, “Micaiah man unlen, khuopi uhpa Amon kung le kumpipa’ tapa kungah zawpikia un;"},"26":{"text":"tuale ama in, ‘Kumpipa in tam bangci hi: Tam mipa thong sungah khum unlen, lungnuom taha kang kilekia masangsie an le tui na gieutausah un, ci hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuale Micaiah in, “Lungnuom taha nang kilekia poma leh kei tungtawn a Topa thu gen lo hi taven,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “No mite aw, na unpi-un ka thugen za un!” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Remoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa le Judah Kumpipa Jehoshaphat a kuonto uhi.","title":"Ahab’ Galelna le Sina (1Kum 22:29-40)"},"29":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Kei mituom hing kipangin gal sungah hing kuon vangin, hizongle nang in na puontuolpi hing silh in,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Israel kumpipa mituom kipang a, gal sungah ama gel a kuon uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tu-in Aram kumpipa in a leeng makaite thupie-in, “Milien mineu koima tawh kido sih unlen, Israel kumpipa beh tawh kido un,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Leeng makaite in Jehoshaphat a mu ciengun, “Khumpa Israel kumpipa hi ve aw,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n ama sim dingin a kihei uhi; tuale Jehoshaphat zong kikozah pai a, Topa in ama a panpi hi. Ama kung panin Pasien in amate a kaikhie hi;"},"32":{"text":"azieh pen Israel kumpipa ahi lo lam leeng makaite in a thei bepun, ama a delna panin a kilekia uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in a thaltang a mawh kap leh, a galdal thep le a awmdal kikalah lutin Israel kumpipa a kha hi; tuaci’n ama in a leeng hawlpa kungah, “Kei liem zo ka hi ziehin kilekia inlen, galphuol panin ei puodawh ta’n,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ni-in gal kidona nasie mama a, nitah a si dongin Aram-te lam nga-in a leeng tungah kumpipa a kingam hi; tua ciengin nitum laitahin ama a si hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat dam le bihin Jerusalem a inn ah a kilekia hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama dawn dingin Hanani’ tapa, thumu pa Jehu pusuoh a, Kumpi Jehoshaphat kungah, “Mi gilote panpi-in Topa a muda mite it ding na hi amah? Tami thu ziehin nang ang do dingin Topa kung panin ama’ lungthahna a pusuoh zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle na sungah hoina pawlkhat kimu hi. Azieh pen nangma in gam sung panin khuom siengthote na susie a, na lungsim sungah na Pasien sui ding na ngaisun hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Jehoshaphat a teng hi; tua ciengin Beer-sheba panin Ephraim muoltung gam cieng dong mite lahah zinkia a, a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa kungah amate tunpikia hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat’ Puophatnate"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Judah gam sunga kul a nei khuopite zosie, a khuopi a khuopi-ah thukhente koi a,"},"6":{"text":"tuami thukhente kungah, “Mihingte tanga thukhen na hi sih vua, Topa tanga thu khen na hi zawh ziehun na nasep uh limtahin ngaisun un; ama in na thukhenna vuah note ang ompi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in na tung vuah Topa zatahna om taheh; na sepna vuah pilvang un, azieh pen Topa i Pasien tawh thutang leheina, mi deidanna, guhgol lahnate a omton thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua banah Topa adinga thukhenna pie ding le thukineite a khenpieh dingin Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem ah Levi-te pawlkhat, siempute pawlkhat, le Israel innkuon lutang pawlkhat a se hi. Amate in Jerusalem ah panmun a nei ciet uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in tam bangin amate thu hil hi: Topa zatahna, citahna, le na lungsim zosie utawh na sem ding uhi;"},"10":{"text":"amau’ khuopi sunga teng na sanggamte uh tung panin sisan kisuona, thukham ahi sihle thupiehna, upadi ahi sihle biehna ngaina kipte tawh kisai-in na tung vuah thu khat popo ang tun ciengin Topa mai-ah mawna a piensah lo nading ule note tung le na sanggamte tungah lungthahna a tun lo nadingin amate thu na hil ding uhi. Tam bangin bawl un, tua hile mawna na piengsah sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"En un, Topa’ thu tawh kisai thu zosie-ah note tunga vaihawm dingin siempupi pa Amariah om hi; tuale Judah Kumpipa tawh kisai thu zosie-ah Judah innkuon uhpa Ishmael’ tapa Zebadiah om hi; tuale Levi-te in note tungah ulien sem ding uhi. Hang tahin gamta in, mi hoite tawh Topa ang omton taheh!” a ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thu zaw ciengin Moab-te le Ammon-te, Meunim-te pawlkhat tawh, Jehoshaphat sim dingin a kuon uhi.","title":"Nisuona Pana Busimna"},"2":{"text":"Kamtaite pei-in Jehoshaphat kungah, “Nang ang sim dingin tuipi galkhat, Edom gam panin mihon tampite ang kuon uhi; Hazazon-tamar (En-gedi a kici) ah amate kigingsa-in a om uhi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoshaphat a zau hi; amama-in Topa sui ding lunggulin Judah gam muncin tengah an tan nading thu a tangko hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa tung panin huna sui dingin Judah in mi kaikhawm hi; Topa sui dingin Judah khuopi zosie panin amate a kuon uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sung, leituol tha’ mai, Judah le Jerusalem-te’ kikhopna sungah Jehoshaphat ding a,","title":"Jehoshaphat’ Thungetna le Guolzawna"},"6":{"text":"tuale, “Ka pu ka pate uh’ Pasien Topa aw, nangma, van Pasien na hi sih amah? Nam cinte’ kumpi gam zosie tungah nangma a vaihawm na hi sih amah? Nangma’ khut sungah vanglietna le thahatna om a, koima in nang ang nang zo sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Kote’ Pasien aw, nangma in na mi Israel mai-ah tam gama teng mite na delmang a, nangma’ guolpa ahi Abraham’ suonlehlahte tungah kumtawn adingin pie hi lo na mah?","ref":"Isa 41:8; Jas 2:23"},"8":{"text":"Tua munah amate tengin tua sungah nangma’ min dingin biehinn khat a lam vua, amate in,"},"9":{"text":"‘Ko tungah gimna, namsau, thukhenna, ahi sihle natna, ahi sihle kielpi ang tun leh, tami biehinn sungah na min a op ziehin tami biehinn mai le na mai-ah dingin na kungah ka lungkhamna uh kang ko ding vua, tuale nangma in ei za-in nei hun ding hi,’ a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in en in, Egypt gam pan a peikhiet lai-un Israel-te in na simsah lo, amate in pelin a suhsiet lo uh- Ammon, Moab le Sier Muol mite,","ref":"Thkna 2:4-19"},"11":{"text":"ka luo ding vua kote nei piehsa na neisa panin ei hawlkhietna utawh amate in thaman ei pie zawsop uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kote’ Pasien aw, amate tungah thu khen lo ding na mah? Bangzieh ahei cile kote sim dinga ang kuon tam mihonpite tawh kisi dingin tha ka nei sih uhi. Ci nading mel thei loin nangma beh kang mitsuon uhi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua laitahin Topa mai-ah Judah zosie a zite, a tasente, le a naupangte utawh a ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm mipi laikimah, Levi-te Asaph’ suonte sung panin Mattaniah, a tapa Jeiel, a tapa Benaiah, a tapa Zechariah, a tapa Jahaziel-te tungah Topa’ hlagau a tung hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Judah gam zosie, Jerusalem-a teng teng zosie, le Kumpi Jehoshaphat aw, ngai un. Topa in note tungah tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Zau sih unlen tam mi honpite ziehin lungkie sih un; azieh pen galdona khu nomau-a’ hi loin Pasien-a’ ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Zing ciengin amate sim dingin kuonsuh un; Ziz katona lampi zui-in amate ang kuonto ding uhi; Jeruel gamlah mai-a om kuom mongah amate na mu ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tami gal pen note’ sim ding hi lo hi; Judah le Jerusalem mite aw, na panmun uh la-in pia malmal loin ding unlen, no tangin Topa’ guolzawna mu un,’ a ci hi. Zau sih unlen lungkie sih un; amate sim dingin zing ciengin kuon un. Topa in ang ompi ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 20:1-4"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mai tuol ngatin Jehoshaphat kun a, Topa mai-ah Judah zosie le Jerusalem-a teng mi zosie pua-in Topa a bie uhi."},"19":{"text":"Awsangpi tawh Israel Pasien, Topa a phat dingin Levi-te sung panin Kohath-te le Korah-te a dingto uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate zingmawngin a thobai vua, Tekoa senel gamah a pei uhi. Amate a pei laitahun Jehoshaphat dingin, “Judah le Jerusalem khuo-a tengte aw, ka thugen na ngai un! Topa na Pasien uh um un, tua hile na kip ding uhi; a kamsangte zong muong un,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in mite tawh thu kikupna a nei zaw ciengin, Topa mai-ah la sa ding le a thupi a sienthona a phat ding mite se a, a pei kawmun amate in galkapte mai-ah, “ “ Topa tungah lungdamna ko un. Bang zieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in phatna la a sah laitahun, Judah sim dinga a pei Ammon-te, Moab-te, le Seir Muol mite buhdap dingin Topa in mi koi a, tuaci’n amate kizo hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen Ammon-te le Moab-te in Sier Muola tengte simin a susie sieng uhi; tuale Seir-a tengte a suhsiet zaw ciengun amate khatlekhat a kisusie uhi."},"24":{"text":"Senel gam galvilna tausangah Judah-te a tun ciengun amate in mihonpi lam a en uhi; amate pen tuol lahah a puamat misi luong vive ahi uhi; amate a suohta khat beh om lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate kung panin gal vanlahte khawm dingin Jehoshaphat le a mite a pei ciengun ganhingte, vante, puonsilte, le na manpha tampi tah a mu vua, tuale amate dinga a puohzawh nawn lo cieng dong uh a la uhi. Galvanlahte tam seng ahi ziehin van khawmin ni thum sung a thapaai uhi."},"26":{"text":"A ni li ni-in Beracah kuomah a kikhawm uhi, azieh pen amate in tua munah Topa a phat uhi; tua ziehin tuni dongin khum mun pen Beracah Kuom kici hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jehoshaphat’ makaina tawh Judah mite le Jerusalem-te zosie kipahin Jerusalem ah a kilekia uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in a galte tungah amate a lungdamsah hi."},"28":{"text":"Harp-te, lyre-te, le pengkulte tawh Jerusalem-a Topa’ biehinn ah amate a tung uhi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Israel’ galte a simpiehna thu a zah ciengun kumpi gam zosie tungah Pasien zatahna a tung hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale Jehoshaphat’ uhna gam sungah gal a veng hi. Azieh pen a Pasien in ama kimvelah galvenna a pie hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judah tungah Jehoshaphat a maang hi. A maan a kipatin ama kum sawmthum le nga pha hi; Jerusalem ah ama kum sawmni le nga sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min Azubah ahi a, Shilhi’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat’ Uhna Tawpna (1Kum 22:41-50)"},"32":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in a pa Asa’ lampi bang zui-in ama tua panin a piel vawt sih a, Topa muna-ah thuman vive a sem hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin munsangte kipaimang tuon lo hi; mite in a pu a pate uh’ Pasien tungah a lungsim uh a nga nai sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoshaphat’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a patna panin a tawp dongin, Israel Kumpite’ Tangthu sunga a kiciemte, Hanani’ Tapa Jehu’ Khang Tangthu sungah kigiel hi."},"35":{"text":"Tami zaw ciengin a gitlo gamtat Israel kumpipa Ahaziah tawh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kizom hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in Tarshish lama pei ding tembawte bawlna-ah ama tawh kipawlin Ezion-geber ah tembawte a bawl uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mareshah-te Dodavahu’ tapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat langpangin thu a gen a, “Nang in Ahaziah tawh na kipawl ziehin na bawlsa nate Topa in susie ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale tembawte kisie a, Tarshish ah pei thei lo uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Jehoshaphat lumton a, David’ khuopi ah a pu a pate tawh ama kivui hi; a tapa Jehoram in ama’ za luo hi.","title":"Jehoram’ Uhna (1Kum 22:50 ; 2Kum 8:16-19)"},"2":{"text":"Jehoshaphat’ tapa Jehoram’ sanggamte: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, le Shephatiah ahi uhi; tam teng zosie, Judah kumpi Jehoshaphat’ tapate ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A pa un amate letsong, ngun, kham, le a manpha neisate tampitah pie a, Judah gama kulnei khuopite tawh a piehtha hi; hizongle ama pen a ta masa pen ahi ziehin ama in Jehoram tungah kumpi gam a pie hi."},"4":{"text":"A pa’ kumpi topha tungah Jehoram ka-in a dinkip ciengin a sanggam pasal zosie namsau tawh thatin Israel uliente kimkhat zong that hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama a maan patin Jehoram kum sawmthum le ni pha hi; Jerusalem ah ama kum giet sung a maang hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahab’ tanu pen ama’ zi ahi ziehin ama in Ahab innkuon ma bangin Israel kumpite’ lampi a zui hi. Topa muna-ah ama a sie lamin a gamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle Topa in David le a sunlehlahte tungah meivah khat pieh zing dingin kamciem a, David tawh thuciemna bawl zo ahi ziehin ama in David innkuon a susie sih hi.","ref":"1Kum 11:36"},"8":{"text":"Ama’ hun sungin Edom in Judah’ uhna ledo a, amau’ kumpi tuom a koi uhi.","title":"Edom’ Ledona (2Kum 8:20-22)","ref":"Pien 27:40"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a galkapmangte le a leeng zosie tawh Jehoram galkai a, zanlai-in kuonin ama in ama le a leeng lamkaite a kuikhum Edom-te a sim hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuni dongin Edom-te in Judah’ uhna a ledo uhi. Ama in a pu a pate’ Pasien, Topa a taisan ziehin khum hun laitahin Libnah in zong ama’ uhna a ledo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua tham loin, ama in Judah muoltung gamah munsangte bawl a, citah lona lamah Jerusalem-a tengte pui-in, Judah lam a pielsah hi.","title":"Elijah’ Laihlah"},"12":{"text":"Kamsang Elijah kung panin ama tungah laihlah khat tung a, “Na pu David’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Azieh pen na pa Jehoshaphat’ lampi le Judah kumpi Asa’ lampi na tawn sih a,"},"13":{"text":"nang in Israel kumpite’ lampi na zuizaw a, Ahab innkuon in citah lona lamah Israel a pui bangin Judah le Jerusalem-a tengte citah lona lamah na pui a, na pa’ inn sung panin nangma sanga a hoizaw na sanggamte zong na tha sieng zo ziehin,"},"14":{"text":"en in, Topa in na mite, na tate, na zite, le na neisa zosie tungah gimna lienpi khat ang tungsah ding a,"},"15":{"text":"nangmama in tam natna ziehin a ni ni-in na gilzam a lawt dongin gil natna nasie khat na vei ding hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ethiopia-te’ gei-a om Philistia-te le Arab-te, Jehoram tunga a thangpai thei nadingun Topa in a kuontaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah sim dingin amate kuonto-in a bulu vua, kumpipa’ inn-a om neisa zosie, a tapate le a zite tawh tommang siengin, a tapa tumpen Jehoahaz ci simlo a tapate a kinuasie om lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tami thu zosie zaw ciengin Topa in a dam thei lo natna khat tawh a gil a nasah hi.","title":"Jehoram Natna le A Sina (2Kum 8:23-24)"},"19":{"text":"A hun a cin, kum ni tawp ciengin a natna ziehin a gil lawt a, nahpi-in na sa-in a si hi. A pu a pate adinga tumphuol a tawpieh bangun a mite in ama zatahna-in tumphuol a tawpieh sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"A uh ding a kipatin kum sawmthum le kum ni a pha hi; ama in Jerusalem-ah kum giet sung uh a, koima’ hlenla vawt loin a si hi. David’ khuopi sungah ama a vui vua, hizongle kumpite’ han sungah kivui lo hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem-a tengte in ama’ za luo dingin a tapa tumpen Ahaziah kumpi-in a koi uhi; azieh pen Arab-te tawh giephuola a pei galkapte in tapa tazaw zosiete a that sieng uhi. Tuaci’n Judah kumpi Jehoram’ tapa Ahaziah kumpi-in a maang hi.","title":"Ahaziah’ Maanna (2Kum 8:25-29 ; 9:14-16 , 27-29)"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmli le ni pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum khat sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min Athaliah ahi a, Omri’ tunu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A sie lam bawlna-ah a nu khu ama’ thu kuppi ahi ziehin ama in zong Ahab’ innkuon’ lampi a zui hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahab innkuonpite ma bangin Topa muna-ah ama a sie-in gamta hi; bangzieh ahei cile a pa a si zaw ciengin ama’ siet nadinga a thu kikuppite pen Ahab’ innkuonte ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in amau’ thuhil nangawn zui a, Aram kumpipa Hazael tawh kido dingin Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa Ahab’ tapa Jehoram tawh a kuonton hi. Aram-te in Joram a liemsah vua,"},"6":{"text":"tuale Ramah ah Aram kumpipa Hazael tawh a kidona pana a nga liemmate a dam nadingin Jezreel ah kilekia hi. Jezreel ah Ahab’ tapa Joram a cinat ziehin a ve dingin Judah kumpi Jehoram’ tapa Ahaziah a kuonsuh hi."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle Joram ve dingin ama a hawna ziehin Ahaziah’ zakieh nading pen Pasien’ laitansa ahi hi. Azieh pen ama khum munah a tun ciengin Ahab’ innkuon susie dinga Topa in sathau a nusa Nimshi’ tapa Jehu tawh kimu dingin Jehoram a pusuoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehu in Ahab’ innkuonte tungah thukhenna a sep laitahin Judah uliente le Ahaziah’ na a sem Ahaziah’ sanggam pasalte’ tapate tawh a kituoh a, ama in amate a that hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Ahaziah sui a, Samaria ah a kibuh laitahin ama kiman a, Jehu kungah kizawpi-in kithat hi. Amate in ama a vui uhi, azieh pen amate in, “Ama pen a lungsim zosie tawh Topa a sui Jehoshaphat’ tupa ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Tuale ciengin Ahaziah’ suonlehlahte in kumpi gam a uh zo ding mi khat zong a nei nawn sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahaziah’ nu Athaliah in tu-in a tapa a si lam a thei ciengin ama kipanin Judah inn sunga kumpi innkuon zosie that hi.","title":"Athaliah in Kumpi Tokhom Sut (2Kum 11:1-8)"},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa’ tanu Jehoshabeath in Ahaziah’ tapa Joash la a, tha dinga kikoi kumpipa’ tapate lah panin ama a gudap hi; ama nu in lupna tung khatah ama le a cingnu a koi hi. Ama pen Ahaziah’ sanggamnu ahi ziehin Kumpi Jehoram’ tanu, le siempu Jehoiada’ zi Jehoshabeath in tua bangin Athalia’ kung panin ama na phuol a, tua nu in ama that kha lo hi;"},"12":{"text":"Athaliah gam sungah a maan laitahin Pasien’ biehinn sungah ama kum guh sung kiphuol hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kum sagina kumin Jehoiada kihansuo-in galkap a za-a a uhte, Jeroham’ tapa Azariah, Jehonanan’ tapa Ishmael, Obed’ tapa Azariah, Adaiah’ tapa Maaseiah, Zichri’ tapa Elishaphat tawh kithukimna khat a nei uhi."},"2":{"text":"Judah gam muncin tengah amate zin kawikawi-in Judah khuopi zosie panin Levi-te, le Israel innkuonte’ lutang teng khawmin Jerusalem-ah a pei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm buppi in Pasien’ biehinnpi sungah kumpipa’ tapa Joash tawh thuciemna khat a bawl uhi. Jehoiada in amate kungah, “Kumpipa’ tapa! David’ suonte tawh kisai-in Topa’ ciemsa bangin ama kumpi-in maangsah un.","ref":"2Sam 7:12"},"4":{"text":"Tami khu note’ sep ding ahi hi: Sabbath ni-a nasep a lut ding no siempute le Levi-te sung pan sethum-suoh-sekhat tunkotcing na hi ding vua,"},"5":{"text":"a sekhat kumpipa’ inn-ah omin, a sekhat Tunkot Phungpi-ah na om ding uhi; tuale Topa’ biehinn leituolah mi zosie a om ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Siempute le tuonvai sem ahi Levi-te ci longal koima Topa’ biehinn sungah lutsah sih un; a siengtho ahi ziehun amate lut thei ding a, hinanle adang mi zosiete in Topa’ thuhilna na zui ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Levi-te in a khut sung vuah a galhiem ciet uh tawi-in kumpipa kimvelah a om ding uhi; tuale biehinn sunga a lut poma kithat ding hi. A sungtumna le a pusuona-ah kumpipa tawh om un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Levi-te le Judah zosie in siempu Jehoiada’ thupieh teng zosie bangin a gamta uhi; siempu Jehoiada in a kisekhente phiet lo ahi ziehin amau’ mi ciet sabbath ni-a nasem lote tawh sabbath ni-a nasemte peipi uhi.","title":"Joash Kumpi Lukhu Kikhusah (2Kum 11:9-12)"},"9":{"text":"Siempu Jehoiada in galkap bute tungah Topa’ biehinn sunga kikoi David-a’ ahi ngai teipite le lum gol le lum neute a pie hi;"},"10":{"text":"tuale ama in mi zosie a galhiem ciet utawh kumpipa cing dingin biehinn leitaw lam panin leilu lam pang dong, maitam kimkot le biehinn kimkotah pangsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in kumpipa’ tapa peipi-in a lu tungah kumpi lukhu khusah a, ama tungah thuciemna a pie hi; amate in ama kumpi a hina thu taang a tawh vua, Jehoiada le a tapate in ama sathau nu-in, “Kumpipa dam sawt heh!” ci-in a awng uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mite tai-in kumpipa a a lungdampina uh gamlumna Athaliah in a zah ciengin, Topa’ biehinn sunga mite kungah a lut hi;","title":"Athaliah Kithat (2Kum 11:13-20)"},"13":{"text":"tuale ama nu in a en leh biehinn lutna khuompi gei-ah kumpipa ding a, kumpipa gei-ah galkap bute le pengkul tumte omin, gam sunga mi zosie kipahin pengkulte a mut uhi, tuale tuami pawi bawlna-ah lasate in a tumtheite utawh a makai uhi. Athaliah in a puon ehmalin, “Kumpi suon sawm! Kumpi suon sawm!” ci-in a awng hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu Jehoiada in galkapte uh dinga kikoi galkap bute hlanin amate kungah, “Galkap guolte kikalah tua nu peipi un; ama a zui poma namsau tawh kithat ding hi,” a ci hi. Bangzieh ahei cile siempu pa in, “ Topa’ biehinn sungah tua nu that sih un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in ama a man uhi; kumpipa’ inn Sakol Tunkot vangah ama lutin khum munah ama a that uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ mi ahi nading uh Jehoiada in ama le mi zosie le kumpipa kikalah thuciemna khat a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Baal’ inn sungah mi zosie lutin a inn a phelpieh uhi; ama’ maitamte le a milimte satcimin tua maitamte mai-ah Baal siempu Mattan a that uhi."},"18":{"text":"Moses thukham sunga kigiel bangin David’ thupieh dung zui-in lungdamna le lasahna tawh Topa tungah meihal biehnate a kipieh nadingin David in a na sesa bangin Topa’ biehinn en dingin Jehoiada in Levi siempute tungah mawpuohna a pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Lam khat popo tawh a bua mi khat a lut lo nadingin ama in Topa’ biehinn tunkotte-ah tunkot cingte a koi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in galkap bute, uliente, mipite a uhte le gam sung mi zosie a zawpi a, tuale amate in Topa’ biehinn panin tunkot tungnung zui-in kumpipa a peipisuh uhi. Amate in kumpi topha tungah kumpipa a tosah uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n namsau tawh Athaliah a kitha zaw ciengin gam sung mi zosie a kipah vua, khuopi sung a dai pai hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joash a maan ding a kipatin kum sagi pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawmli sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min pen Zibiah ahi a, Beer-sheba-te ahi hi.","title":"Josiah in Biehinnpi Puopha (2Kum 11:21–12:16)"},"2":{"text":"Siempu Jehoiada’ hun sung teng zosie Topa muna-ah Joash a manin gamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoiada in ama ading zi ni suipieh a, tanu tapate’ pa a suoh hi."},"4":{"text":"Hun phabep khat zaw ciengin Joash in Topa’ biehinn puophat dingin a khensat hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in siempute le Levi-te khawmin amate kungah, “Pasien’ biehinn puophat nadingin Judah khuopite-ah pei unlen, a kum kumin Israel zosie tung panin sum va khon ta un; tam thu na naw sep ding uh ahi ci thei un,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Levi-te in a naw sep tuon sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in uhpipa Jehoiada hlanin ama kungah, “Bang dingin Topa’ nasem Moses in thuciemna puonbuh adingin a kikhawm Israel mihonte tung pana sieh kikhon pen Judah le Jerusalem-te tung pan Levi-te khonsah lo na hei?” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 30:11-16"},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua numei gilo Athaliah’ tapate in Pasien’ biehinn susie-in Topa’ biehinn sunga a ki-apsa na zosie nangawn Baal-te adingin a zang zo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in thupie a, amate in singkuong khat bawlin Topa’ biehinn tunkot pulamah a koi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Senel gam sungah Pasien’ nasem Moses a op lai-un Israel tungah a ngetsa sieh Topa adinga a puoh nadingun Judah le Jerusalem sung zosie-ah tangtawhna khat kibawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Makai zosie le mi zosie lungdamin a sieh uh peipi-in singkuong sungah a dim masangsie a khie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Levi-te in kumpipa’ uliente kungah tua singkuong a peipi sielun amate in tua sungah sum tampi a op lam a mu ciengun, kumpipa’ thuvanpi pa le siempupi pa’ ulien pa pei-in singkuong bungdawhin sumte a la vua, a opna ngai-ah tua singkuong a koikia uhi. Tuaci’n a ni ni-in amate in a bawl vua, sum tampitah a khawm uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa le Jehoiada in Topa’ biehinn nasep uhte kungah tua sumte a pie vua, tua Topa’ biehinn a ngaingai a bangsahkia dingin amate in leilesuong nasep a siemte le khutsiemte, le Topa’ biehinn a puokia dingin sia le sumngo nasep a siemte zong a ciel uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n nasem dinga a kicielte in na nahpi-in a sem vua, amau’ khut sungah puokiana nasep in mai nawt a, amate in a ngaingai bangin Topa’ biehinn a bawlkia vua, a kipsah uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in a zaw ciengun kumpipa le Jehoiada kungah a sumval teng uh tawi-in tua teng tawh Topa’ biehinn nasep nading le meihal biehnate dinga vanzahte, tawkeute, khamte, le ngun beelte a bawl uhi. Jehoiada’ hin sung tungtawnin Topa’ biehinn sungah meihal biehnate a kizomin a pie uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hizongle Jehoiada vuoi mama ta a, a kum a cin ciengin ama a si hi; a si-in ama kum za le kum sawmthum pha hi.","title":"Joash’ Upkhielna"},"16":{"text":"Ama in Israel sungah Pasien le a biehinn adingin na hoi sem ahi ziehin amate in David’ khuopi sunga kumpite lahah ama a vui uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoiada a si zaw ciengin kumpipa kungah Judah uliente pei-in zatahna a pie uhi; tua ciengin kumpipa in amau’ thu a ngai hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa’ biehinn a taisan vua, khuom siengthote le milimte’ na a sem uhi. Amau’ khielna ziehin Judah le Jerusalem tungah lungthahna a tung hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa kungah amate a peipikia thei nadingin ama in amate lahah kamsangte a sawl hi; tamte in a langkhat vuah teci pang a, ahi vangin amate in a ngai tuom sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ hlagau in siempu Jehoiada’ tapa Zechariah man hi; mite tung lamah ama dingin amate kungah, “Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Na mavan thei lo nadingun bang dingin Topa’ thupiehnate palsat na hi uh ahei? Note in Topa na taisan ziehun ama in note ang taisan hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in ama sawmdapin kumpipa thupiehna tawh Topa’ biehinn leituol zangah suong tawh a seplia uhi.","ref":"Mat 23:35; Luk 11:51"},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa Joash in ama tungah Zechariah’ pa Jehoiada in a na lah migitna phawh kha nawn loin a tapa a thapieh mawh hi. Ama in a si kuonin, “ Topa in mu hinlen phu la taheh!” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Kum tawp lam ciengin Joash sim dingin Aram galkapte a kuonto uhi. Judah le Jerusalem ah amate a tung vua, tua teng lah panin mite’ uliente zosie a that vua, a vanlahte zosie uh Damascus kumpipa kungah a puoh uhi.","title":"Joash’ Sina (2Kum 12:19-21)"},"24":{"text":"Aram galkapte mi tawmno a kuon vangun, amate in a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa a nuasie ziehun Topa in a khut sung vuah galkap tampi a pie hi. Amate in Joash tungah tua bangin thukhenna a bawl uhi."},"25":{"text":"Nahpi taha a liemsa-in ama nuasie-in, amate a nuakin zaw ciengun, siempu Jehoiada tapa’ sisan ziehin a nasemte in ama tha dingin a sawmdap vua, amate in a lupna tungah ama a that uhi. Tuaci’n ama si a, amate in David’ khuopi sungah ama a vui vua, hinanle amate in kumpite hanah ama a vui sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama a sawmdap pen Ammon-te Shimeath’ tapa Zabad, le Moab-te Shimrith’ tapa Jehozabad ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama’ tapate’ thute, ama a kigensietna thute, le Pasian’ biehinn a kilamkiana thute, Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi. Tuale a tapa Amaziah in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaziah maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha hi; ama in Jerusalem ah kum sawmni le kuo sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min pen Jerusalem-te Jehoaddan ahi hi.","title":"Amaziah’ Uhna (2Kum 14:1-6)"},"2":{"text":"Topa muna-ah a manin gamta a, ahi vangin a lungsim mantah tawh hi nai lo hi."},"3":{"text":"A khut sungah kumpi thuneina a op zaw behin ama in a pa kumpipa a that ama’ nasemte that hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ thupieh Moses’ laibu sungah, “Tate ziehin pate kithat lo ding a, pate ziehin zong tate kithat lo ding hi; ahi vangin mi zosie amau’ mawna hang tawh a si ding uhi,” ci-in a na kigiel ma bangin ama in a tate a that sih hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"5":{"text":"Amaziah in Judah mite khawm a, ama in amau’ pupa innkuon tawh kizui-in Judah mi zosie le Benjamin mi zosiete, a tul a uhte le a za a uhte’ khut nei-ah koi hi. Ama in kum sawmni le a tungsie mite khawm a, gal sim thei, tei le lum a zang thei, le a kituomteel galkap tul zathum a pha hi.","title":"Edom-te A Kithana (2Kum 14:7)"},"6":{"text":"Ama in Israel sung panin ngun talent zakhat tawh a thahat galhang mi tul zakhat zong a ciel hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama kungah Pasien’ mi khat pei-in, “Kumpipa aw, nangma tawh Israel galkap peitonsah sin. Azieh pen Topa in Israel- tam Ephraim mi zosie- ompi lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma mama kuonzaw inlen sem in. Galdona-ah thahat in, tua hi sihle Pasien in galte mai-ah ang thalpai ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in huna ding ahi a, thalpaina ding ahi zongin vanglietna a nei hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaziah in Pasien’ mipa kungah, “Hizongle Israel galkapte guoi nadinga ka piehsa talent zakhat bang ka law ta diei?” a ci hi. Pasien’ mipa in dawng a, “ Topa in tam sangin a tamzaw zong ang piehbe thei hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amaziah in Ephraim panin ama kunga a pei galkapte, inna peikia dingin a sawl hi. Ahi vangin amate Judah tungah a lungthah mama vua, lungsosa-in inn lam a kilekia uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaziah kihangsahin a mite peipi hi; ama Ci Kuom lamah pei-in Seir mite tulsawm that hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah mite in adang mi tulsawm hingmatin Sela muolvumah a peipi vua, tuale a unpi-a guoicim dingin Sela muolvum panin amate a sepsuh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle ama tawh gal kuon ding a phal lo, a sawlkia galkapte in Samaria panin Beth-horon dongah Judah khuopite a na sim uhi; amate in tuate sungah mi tulthum a that vua, van tampitah a la uhi."},"14":{"text":"Edom-te a thana panin Amaziah a pei zaw ciengin Seir-te’ pasien-te peipi-in ama’ pasien dingin tuate koi a, tuate bie-in tuate tungah biehnate a pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaziah tungah Topa lungthahin ama kungah kamsang khat sawl a, tua pa in, “Bang dingin na khut panin ama’ mite a hunkhie zo lo, mite’ pasien-te po bel talawm na hei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in thu a gen laitahin kumpipa in ama kungah, “Kumpipa’ thu kuppi pa dingin nang kang koi uh amah? Khawl in! Bang dinga nang hing kithat ding ahei?” a ci hi. Tuaci’n kamsangpa zong khawl a, hinanle ama in, “Nangma tam bang gamta-in kang thu kuppina na ngai lo ziehin Pasien in nangma ang suhsiet ding a lungsim sungah a khensatna ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah kumpi Amaziah in mi tawh a kikup zaw ciengin Israel kumpi, Jehu’ tapa Jehoahaz, a tapa Joash kungah mi sawlin, “Hing pei in; khatlekhat kisi vai,” cisah hi.","title":"Israel in Judah Lel (2Kum 14:8-14)"},"18":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpi Amaziah kungah thu puohin, “Lebanon-a thangling kung khat in Lebanon-a taamtah kung khat kungah thu zasah a, ‘Ka tapa’ zi dingin na tanu ei pie in,’ a ci hi; ahi vangin gamsa khat suohin tua thangling a tuoncil hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma in, ‘En in, Edom-te ka zo zo hi,’ na ci a, na lungsim kiliensah gawp hi. Tu-in inn ah om khinkhian in; nangma le Judah na puaton nadingin bang dinga buoina na piensah ahei?” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Amaziah in a thu mang lo hi; azieh pen amate in Edom pasien-te a bieh ziehun, Pasien in a galte uh’ khut sungah amate a pieh thei nadinga tua khu Pasien’ nasepna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel kumpipa Joash kuonto hi; ama le Judah kumpipa Amaziah, Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah khatlekhat gal sungah a kisi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Israel in Judah a zo hi; mi zosie a inn ciet vuah a tai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Beth-shemesh ah Ahaziah’ tapa Joash, a tapa Judah kumpipa Amaziah manin Jerusalem ah peipi a, Ephraim Tunkot panin Tunkot Ninglam cieng dong tong zali sung Jerusalem kulpi a satguoi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa’ inn sunga om kham le ngun zosie, le Topa’ biehinn sunga kimu vanzah zosie tawh Obed-edom manton hi; ama in kumpipa’ inn sunga gou kikhol teng tomgamin a mite zong manin Samaria ah a peikia hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel kumpi, Jehoahaz’ tapa Joash a si zaw Judah kumpi Joash’ tapa Amaziah kum sawm le nga sung hing lai hi.","title":"Amaziah’ Sina (2Kum 14:17-20)"},"26":{"text":"Tu-in Amaziah’ nasep a omlaite, a patna panin a tawpna dong, Judah le Israel Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa kung pana Amaziah a kiheimang a kipanin amate in Jerusalem ah ama sawmdapna khat a nei ciengun Lachish ah ama a tai hi. Ahi vangin amate in Lachish ah ama a nuadelsah vua, tua munah ama a that uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in sakol tawh ama’ luong a puo uhi; David’ khuopi sungah a pu a pate tawh ama kivui hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah mi zosie in kum sawm le guh a pha Uzziah a la vua, a pa Amaziah’ za luo dingin ama kumpi-in a koi uhi.","title":"Uzziah’ Uhna (2Kum 14:21-22 ; 15:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa si-in a pu a pate tawh a lupton zaw ciengin ama in Eloth lamkia-in Judah adingin a ngakia hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi sep a kipatin Uzziah kum sawm le guh pha a, ama in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnga le ni sung uh hi. Ama nu’ min Jecoliah hi a, Jerusalem-te ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A pa Amaziah’ gamtat bang lienin Topa muna-ah ama a manin a gamta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in ama tunga Pasien zatah ding a hil Zechariah hun sungin Pasien sui hi; tuale Topa a sui laisie Pasien in ama lawcingsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama kuonin Philistia-te sim a, Gath kulpi, Jabneh kulpi, Ashdod kulpite satguoi hi; ama in Ashdod gam sung le Philistia-te’ gam sung mundang tengah khuopite a lam hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Philistia-te, Gur-baal a teng Arab-te, le Meunim-te a simna-ah Pasien in ama panpi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ammon-te in Uzziah tungah sieh le kaih a puoh vua, ama a thahat mama khat a suo ziehin ama’ minthanna in Egypt gamgi cieng dong nangawn zel hi."},"9":{"text":"Tham loin Uzziah in Jerusalem-a Kulning Tunkot, Kuom Tunkot, le Kiukawi-ah tausangte daw a, tuate kul tawh a im hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in gamlahah tausangte daw a, Shephelah le zanglei-ah ganhon a hau ziehin tuikhuh tampi to a, lei nasep a uh ziehin muoltung le leihoina gamte-ah lohlote le lenggui leibawlte a nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua tham loin kumpipa’ galkapmangte khat ahi Hananiah’ uhna nei-a om thuvanpi pa Jeiel le galkap bupa Maaseiah in min khumna laibu sunga mi phaza a sim uh dung zui-in, Uzziah in a pawl pawlin galsim thei galkap tampi tah nei hi."},"12":{"text":"A pu a pate uh’ innkuon lutang mi thahat galhangte a phaza a unpi-in tulni le zaguh ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A uhna nei vuah kumpipa panpi ding le thahatna tawh gal do thei ding galkap tul zathum le tul sagi le zanga om hi."},"14":{"text":"Uzziah in galkapte zosie dingin lumte, teipite, sia lukhute, sia-songkholte, thalte, se ding suongtangte guon hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Jerusalem-a tausangte tung le innkiute tungah thal kap nading le suong golte se nadingin khutsiem nasemte’ bawl sette a koi hi. A thahat dongin lamdang tahin ama a kipanpi ziehin gamlapi-ah a minthanna kizel hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama a thahat zaw ciengin a manthai na gau dingin a kiphatsahna a khang hi. Bang ding ahei cile Topa a Pasien tungah ama tawnkhiel a, namtui maitam tungah biehna pie dingin Topa’ biehinn sungah ama a lut hi.","title":"Kilietsahna le Upkhielna (2Kum 15:4-7)"},"17":{"text":"Hinanle siempu Azariah, a thahat Topa’ siempu sawmgiet tawh ama’ nua a zui uhi;"},"18":{"text":"amate in kumpipa Uzziah a deh bawl vua, tuale ama kungah, “Uzziah aw, Topa tunga biehna pieh ding pen nang pieh ding hi lo hi. Biehna pie dinga ki-apsa Aaron’ suon siempute pieh ding ahi bo hi. Mun siengtho sung panin pusuoh in; azieh pen na gamta khiel zo a, tua in Topa Pasien tung pan nang tungah patawina ang tun sih ding hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Pei 30:7-8; Gam 3:10"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Uzziah a lung a thah hi. Tu-in ama in a khutah gimnamtui beel khat tawi a, siempute tungah a lungthah laitahin gimnamtui maitam gei Topa’ biehinn sungah siempute’ musietin a talpangah phahnatna khat puoh hi."},"20":{"text":"Siempupi pa Azariah le siempu zosie in ama a et ciengun a talpangah phahnatna a vei hi. A mallang tahin a pulamah ama a peisah vua, Topa in ama gawt zo ahi ziehin ama a pusuoh hi."},"21":{"text":"A si dongin Kumpi Uzziah phah a, ama miphah ahi ziehin inn tuom khatah a teng hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ biehinn panin ama kipuse hi. Ama’ tapa Jotham in kumpi’ inn sung vai puo-in, tua gam mite tungah zong vai a hawm hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in Uzziah’ gamtatna a omlai teng, a patna panin a tawpna dong, Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isaiah in giel hi."},"23":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Uzziah lumton hi; amate in a pu a pate kunga kumpite’ neisa lopang lah hanah ama a vui uhi, azieh pen, “Ama a phah ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Ama’ tapa Jotham in ama’ za luo hi.","ref":"Isa 6:1"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jotham a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le guh sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min Jerushah ahi a, Zadok’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Jotham’ Uhna (2Kum 15:32-38)"},"2":{"text":"A pa Uzziah’ sepsa bang lienin Topa muna-ah a manin ama gamta a- Topa’ biehinnpi sung behah ama lut lo hi. Hinanle mite in a sie gamtatnate zom lai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ tunkot tungnung lam a, Ophel kul tungah zong inn tampi a lambe hi."},"4":{"text":"Tham loin ama in Judah muoltung gamah khuopite, le sing tamna muoltang tengah kulte ciengin tausangte a lam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ammon-te’ kumpipa tawh kido-in amate a zo hi. Khum kumin Ammon-te in ngun talent zakhat, mangbu cor tulsawm le mangbuham cor tulsawm ama a pie uhi. Ammon-te in a kum nina le a kum thumna kumin tua za ma a pie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jotham in Topa a Pasien mai-ah a gamtatna bawlpha ahi ziehin ama a thahat hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in Jotham’ gamtatna a omlai teng, le a galsimna zosiete, le a om dante, Israel le Judah Kumpite’ Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le guh sung a maang hi."},"9":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh lumton a, David’ khuopi sungah ama a vui uhi; tuale a tapa Ahaz in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahaz maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le guh sung maang hi. A pu David’ sepsa bangin Topa muna-ah a manin gamta loin","title":"Ahaz’ Uhna (2Kum 16:1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Israel kumpite’ lampite zuizaw hi. Ama in Baal adingin a kisung milimte nangawn bawl hi;"},"3":{"text":"tuale Hinnom tapa’ kuomah biehnate pie-in Topa in Israel mite mai-a a nawmangsa minamte’ zah a kidahhuoi gamtatnate zui-in mei tawh a tapate a hal hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama kithoi-in munsangte tung, muoltangte tung le singlim nei zosie-ah biehnate a pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a Topa Pasien in Aram kumpipa’ khut sungah ama pie a, Damascus ah a mite tampitah salin a peipi hi. Mi tampi thatin ama a zo Israel kumpipa’ khut sungah zong ama kipie hi.","title":"Aram le Israel in Judah Zo (2Kum 16:5-6 ; Isa 7:1)"},"6":{"text":"Amate in a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa a nuasie ziehun Remailiah’ tapa Pekah in nikhat thu-in Judah sungah mi tul zakhat le tul sawmni that a, amate pen a unpi-in mi thahat galhangte ahi uhi.","ref":"2Kum 16:5; Isa 7:1"},"7":{"text":"Ephraim-te a thahat galhang Zichri in kumpipa’ tapa Maaseiah, kumpi innpi a uh Azrikam, le kumpi zomah thunei pen ahi Elkanah-te that hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mite in amau’ tanaute sung panin numeite, tapate, le tanute, mi tul zani a man vua, amate kung panin van tampitah zong a la uhi; amate in Samaria ah tua vante a peipi uhi.","title":"Oded’ Suhbuoina"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua munah Topa’ kamsang khat om a. ama’ min pen Oded ahi hi; Samaria ah ang tung galkapte dawn dingin ama pusuohin amate kungah, “Judah tungah na pu na pate uh’ Pasien, Topa lungthah ahi ziehin ama in na khut sung vuah amate ang pie a, ahi vangin thangpaina tawh amate na that vua, tua khu vantung dong a tung hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in note in Judah mite le Jerusalem mite, pasal le numeite nuoinetin salin na bawl sawm uhi. Ahi vangin Topa na Pasien uh tungah mawna nei hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ka thugen ngai unlen, na tanaute uh sung panin gala na mat zosie uh puohkia un, azieh pen na tung vuah Topa’ lungthahna lienpi a tung hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Ephraim-te’ uhpite pawlkhat, Johanan’ tapa Azariah, Meshellemoth’ tapa Berechiah, Shallum’ tapa Jehizkiah, le Hadlai’ tapa Amasa-te, galsimna pana ang tung mite langkhatah a pang vua,"},"13":{"text":"amate kungah, “Tulaitaha ka mawnate ule ka khielnate ban vuah Topa langpanna zieha mawnate ka tung vuah ei tut sawm na hi ziehun, tam munah galmatte nang tut sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile ka khielna uh a lien seng ta a, Israel tungah Topa’ lungthahna lienpi a om hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n galhangte in galmatte le a lah uh vante miliente le a kikhawm mi zosie’ mai-ah a nuasie uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin a min tawh kihlante dingto-in galmatte a peipi vua, tuale amate lahah a guohtanga omte zosie puon a silsah uhi; amate puon a silsah vua, kedapte pie-in an le tui zong va-in sathau a nu uhi; tuale a thazawngkhal teng laa tungah tuongsahin lutu kung khuopi ahi Jericho-a a tanaute uh kungah a zawpi uhi. Tua ciengin Samaria ah a kilekia uhi."},"16":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Kumpi Ahaz in Assyria kumpipa kungah huna ngen dingin mi a sawl hi.","title":"Assyria in Judah Hu ding Niel (2Kum 16:7-9)"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen Edom-te in gal bawlkia-in Judah simin a zo vua, a mite galmatin a kaimang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Philistia-te in Shephelah le Judah-te’ Negeb gama khuopite a bulu vua, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco-a khuoneute tawh, Timnah-a khuoneute tawh, le Gimzo-a khuoneute tawh a la uhi; tua munah amate a teng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Ahaz in Judah sungah kidehna om loin phengtat a, Topa tungah a na citah lo ziehin Topa in Judah a niemkhieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama kungah Assyria Kumpipa Tiglath-pileser a pei vangin, koi’ thakhausah tah zawh sangin ama a gawtbawl zawsop hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Ahaz in Topa’ biehinn, kumpipa’ inn, le uliente’ inn sunga van kikoi zosie la-in Assyria kumpipa kungah sieh le kaihte a puoh hi; hinanle tua in ama a hu zo tuon sih hi."},"22":{"text":"A genthei hun ciengin Topa tungah tami Kumpi Ahaz pen ma citah lo zeh lai hi.","title":"Ahaz’ Upkhielna le A Sina (2Kum 16:12-20)"},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen ama a zo Damascus’ pasien-te kungah ama kithoi a, “Aram kumpite’ pasien-te in amate a panpi ziehin amate in kei zong ei panpi thei nadingun amate tungah kithoina ka bawl ding hi,” ci hi. Hizongle tuate pen ama le Israel zosie’ kisietna ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahaz in Pasien’ biehinn sunga vanzahte khawmin satguoi a, ama in Topa’ biehinn kotte khahcipin Jerusalem ningkiu cintengah maitam a bawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in pasien dangte tungah biehna a pieh thei nadingin Judah khuopi zosie-ah munsangte bawlin, a pu le pate’ Pasien, Topa a lungthahsah hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in ama gamtatna a omlaite le a omzie vannuoi, a patna panin a tawpna dong, Judah le Israel Kumpite’ Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi."},"27":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Ahaz lumton a, tuale amate in Jerusalem khuopi sungah ama a vui uhi; hinanle amate in Israel kumpite’ hanah ama a puo sih uhi. A tapa Hezekiah in ama’ za luo hi.","ref":"Isa 14:28"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawmni le kuo sung maang hi. Ama nu’ min Abijah ahi a, Zechariah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Uhna (2Kum 18:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"A pu David’ na bawlsa bang lienin Topa muna-ah a manin a gamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama a maan a kum khatna, a hla masa sungin ama in Topa’ biehinn kotte hongin tua teng a puopha hi.","title":"Biehinn Kipuosieng"},"4":{"text":"Ama in siempute le Levi-te peipi a, nisuona lam mun awngah amate a khawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Levi-te aw, ka thugen ei ngai un! No le no kisiensuo unlen, na pu na pate uh’ Pasien, Topa’ biehinn siengthosahin mun siengtho panin a niehte nawnkhie un."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen i pu i pate na citah loin Topa i Pasien’ muna-ah na siet gamtat uhi; amate in ama na taisanin Topa’ tenna panin a mai uh hei-in na nuangat uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in talaap kotte zong khahin meivahte a sumit vua, Israel Pasien kung a siengtho munah gimnamtui hal loin meihal biehna a pie sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Judah le Jerusalem tungah Topa’ lungthahna tung a, na mit vua na mu bangun ama in cimulthaw huoi, cizathuoi, le ehnehhuoi-in amate a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin i pu i pate namsau-in a si zo ta vua, i tapate, i tanute, le i zite salin a om zo ta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in eite kung panin a giinhuoi a lungthahnate a kiheimang thei nadingin ka lungsim sungah Topa tawh thuciem khat bawl ding a om hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tate aw, Topa in ama’ na semin ama opna-ah a ding ding, le ama kungah biehnate a pie dingin note ang teel zo tah ziehin tu-in tami thu nelsie bawl sih un,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Levi-te, Kohath’ suonte sung panin Amasiah’ tapa Mahath, le Azariah’ tapa Joel; Merari’ suonte sung panin Abdi’ tapa Kish, le Jehallelel’ tapa Azariah; Gershon’ suonte sung panin Zimmah’ tapa Joah, le Joah’ tapa Eden;"},"13":{"text":"le Elizaphan’ suonte sung panin Shimri le Jeuel; Asaph’ suonte sung panin Zechariah le Mattaniah;"},"14":{"text":"Heman’ suonte sung panin Jehiel le Shimei; Jeduthun’ suonte sung panin Shemaiah le Uzziel-te a kipan uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in a sanggamte uh khawmin a kisiensuotawm vua, Topa’ kammal tawh kumpipa thupieh bangin Topa’ biehinn puosieng dingin a lut uhi."},"16":{"text":"A puosieng dingin Topa’ biehinn sungtawngah siempute a lut vua, Topa’ biehinnpi sunga a mu uh a nieh teng zosie Topa’ biehinn tuolah peipi uhi; tuale Levi-te in tuate la-in Kidron Lui-ah a buo uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in a hla masa a ni masa ni-in siensuo ding kipanin tua hla a ni giet ni-in Topa’ talaap-ah a pei uhi; tua ciengin amate in ni giet sung Topa’ biehinn a siensuo vua, a hla masa a ni sawm le guh ni-in a zo sieng uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Hezekiah kungah tumin, “ Topa’ biehinn zosie, mei halna maitam le vanzah zosie, le anlum guolte koina sabuoi le vanzah zosie ka puosieng zo uhi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpi Ahaz in kumpi a sep lai-in a citah lona ziehin ama in a na paimang vanzah zosie siensuo-in a baisa-in ka bawl zo uhi; en in, Topa’ mai-ah tuate a om hi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Hezekiah thobai a, khuopi-a uliente khawmin, Topa’ biehinn ah a peito uhi.","title":"Biehpiehna Kibawlphakia"},"21":{"text":"Amate in kumpi gam, mun siengtho mun le Judah gam adingin mawna zieha biehna dingin bawngtang sagi, tuutang sagi, tuuno sagi, le keel sagi a kai uhi. Ama in Topa’ maitam tungah tuate a pie dingin Aaron’ suon siempute thu a pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n bawngtangte a go vua, siempute in a si la-in maitam tungah a the uhi; amate in tuutangte a go vua, a si tawh maitam a the uhi; amate in tuunote zong go-in a si tawh maitam a the uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin mawna zieha biehna dingin kumpipa le a kikhawmte kungah keeltang sagi kikai hi; amate in tuate tungah a khut a ngam uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale Israel zosie ading thoidamna bawl nadingin, siempute in tuate a go vua, tuate’ sisan tawh maitam tungah mawna zieha biehna a pie uhi. Bang ding ahei cile Israel zosie adingin meihal biehna le mawna zieha biehna a bawl ding uh kumpipa in thu a pie hi."},"25":{"text":"David le kumpipa’ thumu pa Gad le kamsang Nathan’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in Topa’ biehinn sungah ama in daltuote, harp-te, le lyre-te tum dingin Levi-te koi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tuami thupiehna pen a kamsangte tungtawnin Topa tung pana ang pei ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"David’ tumgingte tawh Levi-te a ding vua, tuale pengkulte tawh siempute a ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah in maitam tungah meihal biehna a kipieh nadingin thu a pie hi. Meihal biehna a kipat ciengin Topa tungah lasahna zong kipan pai a, Israel kumpi David’ lasahnate in pengkulte a zawp hi."},"28":{"text":"A kikhawm mi buppi in Pasien a bie vua, lasate in la sa-in, pengkul tumte in a tum uhi; meihal biehna a man masangsie tam teng zosie a kizomin a bawl uhi."},"29":{"text":"Biehnate a man zaw ciengin kumpipa le ama kunga a om zosie kunin Pasien a bie uhi."},"30":{"text":"David’ thugente le thumu pa Asaph’ thugente tawh Topa tungah phatna la a sah nadingun Hezekiah kumpipa le uliente in Levi-te thu a pie uhi. Lungdamna tawh amate in phatna late a sa vua, amate kunin Pasien a bie uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah in, “Tu-in Topa tungah noma ma na kisiensuo zo uhi; keima ei nai unlen Topa’ biehinn-ah biehpiehnate le lungdamkona biehnate hing peipi un,” a ci hi. A kikhawmte in zong biehpiehnate le lungdamko biehnate a peipi uhi; tuale piehnopna lungsim a nei zosie in meihal biehnate a peipi uhi."},"32":{"text":"A kikhawmte in a peipi meihal biehna phaza pen bawngtang sawm sagi, tuutang zakhat, le tuuno zani ahi a, tamte zosie pen Topa tunga meihal biehna ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"A kisiensuo biehnate bawngtang zaguh le tuu tulthum ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanle siempute a tawm ziehun meihal biehna zosie a vun a hawh sieng zo sih vua, tuaci’n siempu dangte a kisiensuo masang sung teng, nasep a kizaw masangin a sanggamte uh Levi-te in amate hu uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile amau le amau a kisiensuona vuah siempute sangin Levi-te a lungsim uh dihzaw hi."},"35":{"text":"Meihal biehna tampite banah thunuom biehna thaute, le meihal biehnate adingin dawn thei biehnate a om hi. Tua bangin Topa’ biehinn sungah nasepna ki-omsahkia hi."},"36":{"text":"Mite adinga Pasien in a bawlpieh thute ziehin Hezekiah le mi zosie a kipah uhi; azieh pen tua thu thakhata a piengvat ahi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah in Israel mi zosie le Judah tungah Jerusalem-a Topa’ biehinn ah Israel Pasien, Topa’ peisan pawi a bawl dinga a pei nadingun amate vaihlah a, Ephraim le Manasseh tungah zong laihlahte giel hi.","title":"Peisan Pawi Lienpi"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen kumpipa le a uliente le Jerusalem-a om a kikhawm zosie in a hla nina sungin peisan pawi bawl ding a kikum zo uhi."},"3":{"text":"(Azieh pen siempute mi a kicingza ding kisiensuo zo nai loin Jerusalem ah mite kikhawm nai lo ahi ziehin amate in a hun lienin pawi a bawl thei sih uhi.)","ref":"Gam 9:9-11"},"4":{"text":"Tua gelna pen kumpipa le a kikhawm zosie adingin man le kilawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite pei-in Israel Pasien, Topa adingin peisan pawi a bawl nadingun Beer-sheba panin Dan cieng dong Israel gam buppi ah tangtawhna khat nei dingin a khensat uhi; azieh pen amate in bawl dinga a kigen bangin a bawl lo uh sawtveipi ahi ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa thupiehsa bangin laitaite in kumpipa le a uliente tung pana laihlahte tawh Israel le Judah gam zosie-ah pei kawikawi-in, “Israel mite aw, Assyria kumpite’ khut sung panin a omlai a suohta sun teng kungah ama a kiheikia thei nadingin, Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasien, Topa lamah kilekia un."},"7":{"text":"Na mu uh bangin Topa Pasien tungah a pu le pate uh a citah lona ziehun sietna a tunsah na pu na pate ule na sanggamte uh bang sih un."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in na pu na pate bangin ngawngkhau sih unlen, no kung panin a zauhuoi ama’ lungthahna a kiheidawh thei nadingin Topa tungah no le no kipumpieh zaw unlen, kumtawn adinga a siensuosa ama’ mun siengtho-ah pei-in Topa na Pasien uh’ na sem un."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa lamah na kilekia uleh, na sanggamte ule na tate un amate sala a man mite tung panin khuotuona mu-in, tami gamah ang peikia ding uhi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien ukhu mi khuotuo siempa le mi hepi siempa ahi a, ama kungah na kilekia uleh ama in note a mai ang heisan sih ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ephraim le Manasseh gam sung khuopi khat pan khuopi khat, Zebulun cieng dong laitaite a pei uhi; ahi vangin amate in na nuisanin na zapi a, zong na simmawbawl uhi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Asher, Manasseh, le Zebulun mi halkhat beh kiniemkhiehin a pei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa’ thupiehna bangin kumpipa le uliente’ sawlna sem dingin Pasien in Judah tungah lungsim kihuolna guon hi."},"13":{"text":"A hla nina sungin tol saw lo anlum pawi bawl dingin Jerusalem ah mi tampi a kikhawm vua, tuaci’n a kikhawm mihon a tam mama hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate nasep a kipan vua, Jerusalem-a maitamte hemdawhin gimnamtui halna maitam zosie zong a ladawh vua, Kidron Lui-ah a paimang uhi."},"15":{"text":"A hla nina a ni sawm le li ni-in peisan pawi tuuno a go uhi. Siempute le Levi-te a maizum vua, amate kisiensuo-in Topa’ biehinn sungah meihal biehnate a peipi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ mipa Moses thukham tawh kizui-in a panmun ngai teng uh a la uhi; siempute in Levi-te’ khut tung pana a nga uh sisan a the uhi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen a kisiensuo lo mi tampi a om uhi; tua ahi ziehin Topa tungah amate a siengtho-a a kibawl nadingin, a siengtho lo mi zosie adingin Levi-te in peisan tuuno a gaw ding uh kisam hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, le Zebulun mihon tampite sung pan mi tampitah a kisiensuo sih vangun a ngaina lopi-in peisan pawi an a ne uhi. Ahi vangin Hezekiah in amate thu a ngetpieh a, “A hoi Topa aw,"},"19":{"text":"mun siengtho siensuona ngaina tawh a kituo sih vangin lungsimtahpi tawh a pu a pate uh’ Pasien Topa a sui mite’ mawna ngaidam in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Hezekiah’ thungetna za-in mite a damsah hi."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem-a om Israel mite in lungdamna lienpi tawh ni sagi sung tol saw lo anlum pawi a bawl uhi; tuale Levi-te le siempute in Topa adingin a ngaih mama tumtheite tawh kopin a ni ni-in Topa a phat uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah in Topa’ nasepna-ah a siemna uh a lah thei Levi-te zosie tungah hanthotna thu a gen hi. Tuaci’n mite in ni sagi sung pawi an ne-in thunuom biehpiehnate a pie vua, a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa tungah lungdam a ko uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm buppi in adang ni sagi sung ma pawi bawlbe dingin a kihotawh uhi; tuaci’n adang ni sagi sung ma lungdam tahin a bawlbe uhi."},"24":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kikhawmte tungah Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah in biehna dingin bawngtang tulkhat le tuu tul sagi a pie hi. Siempute tampitah amau le amau a kisiensuo uhi."},"25":{"text":"Judah mi a kikhawm buppi, siempute le Levi-te, le Israel gam pana a pei a kikhawm buppi, Israel gam pana a pei pemtate, le Judah gam sunga a teng pemtate lungdam uhi."},"26":{"text":"Jerusalem khuopi sungah Israel kumpi David’ tapa Solomon huna kipanin tam bang om ngai nai lo ahi ziehin Jerusalem-ah lungdamna lienpi a om hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempute le Levi-te dingto-in mite thupha a pie vua, tuale amau’ awging a kiza hi; A thungetna un vantunga a siengtho ama’ tenna a tung hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in tam teng zosie a kiman zaw ciengin tua muna a om Israel zosie Judah khuopite-ah kuonin biehna songte satkehin khuom siengthote a phua vua, Judah le Benjamin gam sung zosie, Ephraim le Manasseh sunga om munsangte le maitamte a suhsiet zaw masangsie uh phelkeh gawp uhi. Tua amau’ neisa khuopi cietah Israel mite zosie a kilekia uhi.","title":"Lawki Biehbuhno-te Kisusie (2Kum 18:4)"},"2":{"text":"Heziekiah in siempute le Levi-te amau’ nasep ciet tawh kizui-in a khenkhenin se a, meihal biehnate le thunuom biehnate adingin Topa’ giephuol tunkot tenga na a sem ding, lungdam a ko ding le phatna a pie dingin siempute le Levi-te a se hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama’ neisa sung pana a silpiehte pen meihal biehna ding ahi hi: Topa’ thukham laibu sunga a kigiel bangin zing le nitah a meihal biehnate, sabbath nite, hladet nite, le a kise pawite dinga meihal biehnate ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 28:1–29:39"},"4":{"text":"Siempute le Levi-te in Topa’ thukham sungah a kipumpieh thei nadingun, Jerusalem-a teng mite in amau’ nga dinga a kilawm a tanh uh a pieh nadingun ama in thu a pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua thu a kithezah behin Israel mite in anpalte, lenggazu, sathau, khuoizu, le lo-a pieng zosie tampitah a pie vua, na zosie panin sawm-ah-khat a kicing tahin a peipi uhi.","ref":"Gam 18:12-13, 21"},"6":{"text":"Judah khuopite sunga teng Israel mite in bawnghonte le tuute panin sawm-ah-khat le Topa a Pasien uh tunga kisiensuosa a sil ki-apte sung panin sawm-ah-khat te zong peipi-in a lom lomin a koi uhi."},"7":{"text":"A hla thumna sungin amate in tua a lomte cien ding a kipan vua, a hla sagina sungin a man uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah le uliente pei-in tua a lomte a mu ciengun amate in Topa le a mi Israel-te thupha a pie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hezekiah in tua a lomte’ thu, siempute le Levi-te a dong hi."},"10":{"text":"Zadok innkuon pana siempupi pa Azariah in ama dawng a, “Amate in Topa’ biehinn sungah a silpiehte uh ang peipi vua kipanin kote in neh ding a kiningcing tahin ka nei vua, khol ding tampitah zong ka nei uhi; azieh pen Topa in a mite thupha ei pie a, tuaci’n tam bangin nehval tampi ka nei uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Topa’ biehinn sungah vankoina inndante a bawl nadingun Hezekiah in thu a pie hi; tuale amate in a bawl uhi.","title":"Siempute le Levi-te Siemphatna"},"12":{"text":"Amate in silpiehte, sawm-ah-khat le a ki-ap nate muonhuoitahin a puoh uhi. Tuate a van ulien pen pa Levi-te Conaniah ahi a, a nina pen a sanggampa Shimei ahi hi;"},"13":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah le Pasien’ biehinn makaipi pa Azariah’ sena tawh Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, le Benaiah-te pen Conaniah le a sanggampa Shimei a hu makaite ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Nisuona lam tunkot cing pa, Levi-te Imnah’ tapa Kore pen Pasien tungah nop thu-a a kipie silpiehte a vanpi pa ahi a, ama pen Topa adinga a kikoicing piehkhietnate le siengtho pen biehnate sekhen ding ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, le Shecaniah-te in siempute’ khuopi sungah a vuoi a khang a kibangin a khen khenin, a sanggamte uh tungah satanh hawmpieh dingin muonhuoitahin ama a hu vua,"},"16":{"text":"khang ciemtena sungah a min a kikhum kum thum le a tungsie pasalte, nisim kisapna dung zui-in a khen khenin a panmun utawh kituohin Topa’ biehinn sunga a lut mi zosie tanh a pie uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amau’ pupa innkuon zui-in siempute kisim hi; kum sawmni le a tungsie Levi-te a khenkhenin a panmun utawh kituohin kisim hi."},"18":{"text":"Siempute a tasen zosie, a zite, a tapate, le a tanute utawh a mihon bupin kisimtha hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate pen a siengtho-a a kikepna vuah a muonhuoi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amau’ khuopite-a’ ahi taang gam lozaute lahah teng Aaron’ suon siempute ading ahile, a kiciemte siempute lah le Levi-te lahah pasal zosie tungah a khuo khuo-ah amau’ nga ding ciet a hawm dingin mite a min tawh kise hi."},"20":{"text":"Hezekiah in Judah gam buppi-ah tam bangin a bawl hi; ama in Topa a Pasien mai-ah a hoi a man le a muonhuoi-in sem hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ biehinn nasepna zosie le thukham le thupiehnate tawh kizui-in a sepna-ah ama’ Pasien sui-in, a lungsim zosie tawh a sem hi; tuale a maa a vang hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thute le a muonhuoi tam nasepnate a sep zaw ciengin Judah sim dingin Assyria Kumpipa Sennacherib pei-in Judah busimin kula ki-im khuopite langkhatah phuol sat a, ama adingin tuate zaw a sawm hi.","title":"Sennacherib’ Busimna (2Kum 18:13–19:34 ; Isa 36:2-22)"},"2":{"text":"Sennacherib pei-in Jerusalem sim a sawm lam Hezekiah in a thei ciengin,"},"3":{"text":"a uliente le a galhangte tawh khuopi pulama luong tuinahte khahtan a sawm uhi; tuale amate in ama a hu uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi tampi kikhawmin gam sunga luong tuinahte le lui zosie a khahtan vua, “Bang dingin Assyria kumpite hing pei-in tui tampi mu ding uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na sem dingin lungkip tahin Hezekiah kipan a, a cimsa kulpi kawm zosie cieng pha-in tua tungah tausang daw a, tuami pulamah kul dang khat a cieng hi; ama in David’ khuopi sunga a om Millo kulpi zong detsah a, galhiemte le lumte tampi a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in mipite tunga a uh dingin galkapmangte koi a, khuopi tunkot tuol-awnga ama kungah amate khawmin amate tungah hanthotna thu genin,"},"7":{"text":"“Thakhauh unlen hang un. Assyria kumpipa le ama tawh a om mihon zosie mai-ah zau sih unlen, zong lungkie sih un; bangzieh ahei cile ama tawh a omte sangin eite tawh a om pa lienzaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama tawh tahsa galhiem beh om hi; ahi vangin eite ei panpi-in i galte ei dopi dingin eite tawh Topa i Pasien a om hi,” a ci hi. Judah kumpipa Hezekiah’ genna panin mite a lungmuong uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tami thu zaw ciengin Lachish ah a galkap zosie tawh Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib a op laitahin, Jerusalem-a Judah kumpipa Hezekiah le Jerualem-a om Judah kumpipa Hezekiah le Jerusalem-a om Judah mite zosie kungah a nasemte sawl a,"},"10":{"text":"“Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib in tam bangin gen hi: Note in Jerusalem ki-imtawmna na nan nading uh bang pen muong na hi uh ahei?"},"11":{"text":"Hezekiah in note kungah, “Assyria kumpipa’ khut sung panin Topa i Pasien in ei hundam ding hi,” ang ci ciengin gilkiel dangta-a na si nadingun note ang puikhiel hi lo amah?"},"12":{"text":"Tam Hezekiah ma in a munsangte le a maitamte ladawhin Judah le Jerusalem kungah, “Maitam khat mai-ah na bie ding vua, tua tungah na biehnate na lui ding uhi,” ci-in thu pie hi lo amah?"},"13":{"text":"Keima le ka pu ka pate in gamdang mite zosie tunga ka bawlsate uh na thei sih uh amah? Tua gam minamte’ pasien-te in keima’ khut sung panin amau’ gam a hundam zo mawng uh amah?"},"14":{"text":"Note’ Pasien in keima’ khut sung panin ang hutdam thei nadingin, ka pu ka pate un a na suhmangsa tua minamte’ pasien zosie lah panin koi pen in a mite a hundam zo ngel ei?"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Hezekiah in tam bang danin kisolsah sih unlen, zong kipuikhielsah sih un. Ama um sih un. Azieh pen keima khut sung pan hile, ka pu ka pate khut sung pan hile a mite a hundam zo minam khatpo ahi sihle kumpi gam khatpo’ pasien koima a om sih hi. Ka khut sung panin na Pasien un bangza-in note hing hundam zo lo zaw kan ding ahei!” ci un,” a cisah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama’ nasemte in Topa Pasien le a nasempa Hezekiah langpangin thu tamzaw gen lai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in Israel Pasien Topa simmaw zakona le langpanna laihlahte zong giel a, “Adang gam sunga minamte’ pasien-te in ka khut sung panin a mite a hutkhiet zo lo uh ma bangin Hezekiah’ Pasien in zong a mite hunkhie zo tuom lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua khuopi a lah thei nadingun amate zau-in a linglawn thei nadingun kulpi dawna a om Jerusalem mite kungah Judah ham tawh nahpitahin a awng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mihingte’ khut tawh kibawl leitung mite’ pasien-te a gen bang lelun Jerusalem Pasien a gen uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah le Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in tam thu ziehin thu ngenin vantung lamah a kiko uhi.","title":"Sennacherib’ Guollelna le A Sina (2Kum 19:35-37)"},"21":{"text":"Tuale Topa in Assyria kumpipa’ giephuolah mi thahat galhangte le uliente zosie a thatgam vantungmi khat a sawl hi. Tuaci’n ama maizum tahin a gam lamah a kilekia hi. A pasien’ inn sungah a lut ciengin, a tapate pawlkhat in namsau tawh ama na satlia uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib’ khut le a gal zosie’ khut sung panin Hezekiah le Jerusalem-a tengte a hundam hi; ama in mun cinteng panin amate tawlngahna a pie hi."},"23":{"text":"Khum hun zaw langsie minam zosie’ muna-ah ama a kitawisang thei nadingin mi tampite in Jerusalem-a Topa kungah letsongte a tawi vua, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kungah zong van manphate a tawi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Hezekiah a cina-in si dihtah hi. Ama in Topa kungah thu ngen a, ama in a ngetna dawngin ama tungah lim khat a pie hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Natna (2Kum 20:1-11 ; Isa 38:1-8)"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama a lungsim a kilietsah ziehin a tunga kibawl phattuomna tawh kituohin Hezekiah in a thuhkia nuom sih hi. Tua ahi ziehin ama le Judah gam le Jerusalem tungah lungthahna a tung hi."},"26":{"text":"Hezekiah in ama’ lungsim kilietsahna ziehin ama le Jerusalem-a tengte a kiniemkhieh vua, tuaci’n Hezekiah’ hun sungin amate tungah Topa’ lungthahna tung lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah in minthanna le neisa tampi tah nei hi; tuale ama in ama dingin ngun, kham, suong manphate, gimnamtuite, lumte, le van manpha namkim koi nadingin goukholna innte a bawl hi;","title":"Hezekiah’ Hauna le A Sepkhiette (2Kum 20:12-21 ; Isa 39:1-8)"},"28":{"text":"an, lenggazu, le sathau koi nadingin vankholna innte, ganhon namkim khum nadingin ganbuhte, le tuubuhte zong a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua bang ma-in ama adingin khuopite bawl a, tuuhonte le gan honte tampitah khol hi; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in ama neisa tampi a pie hi."},"30":{"text":"Tami Hezekiah ma-in Gihon tuinah tungnung khahtanin David’ khuopi nitumna lampangah a zawlsuh hi. A nasepna zosie-ah Hezekiah a maa vang hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n gam sunga kibawl lim lamdang kan dinga ama kunga kisawl Babylon uliente’ palaite vai-ah, ama’ lungsim sunga om zosie a thei nadingin Pasien in ama thu-in ama a omsah hi."},"32":{"text":"Tu-in Hezekiah’ gamtatna a omlaite, le ama nasep hoite, Judah le Israel Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sung, le Amoz’ Tapa, Kamsang Isaiah’ Mangmuna sungah kigiel hi."},"33":{"text":"A pu a pate tawh Hezekiah lumton a, amate in David’ suonte’ han katona munah ama a vui uhi; ama a si lai-in Judah gam le Jerusalem-a teng zosie in zatahna a pie uhi. A tapa Manasseh in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh a maan ding a kipatin kum sawm le ni pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga le nga sung maang hi.","title":"Manasseh’ Uhna (2Kum 21:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite’ mai-ah Topa in a nawmang minamte in a zah a kidahhuoi gamtatnate ma bangin, Topa muna-ah ama a siet gamtat hi.","ref":"Jer 15:4"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen a pa Hezekiah’ na suhsietsa ahi munsangte lamkia-in, Baal-te adingin maitamte phut a, khuom siengthote bawlin, vantung na zosie bie a, tuate’ na a sem hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem-ah ka min om zing ding hi,” a cina Topa’ biehinn sungah ama in maitamte a lam hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:13; 2Khg 6:6"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ biehinn tuol nite-ah vantung na zosie adingin maitamte a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Hinnom tapa’ kuomah mei tawh a tapa hal a, mailam thugenkholna, khutlametna-te zang a, mi bum theite, dawilawm neite, le bumtawite thu a dong hi. Topa muna-ah ama in sietna tampi bawlin ama a lungthahsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasien in David le a tapa Solomon kungah, “Israel minamte zosie sung panin ka teelsa tam biehinn sung le Jerusalem sungah keima’ min ka koi zing ding hi, a cina mun Pasien’ biehinn sungah ama in a khensa milim koi hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in amate ka thupieh zosie, thukham zosie, thupiehte, le Moses tungtawna a kipie biehna ngaina kipte limtaha a zui uleh, na pu na pate vua dinga ka sesa gam panin Israel-te’ keng ka khin ngai nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:3-5; 2Khg 7:12-18"},"9":{"text":"Amate in Israel mite mai-ah Topa in a na suhsietsa minamte sangin sietna a tam bawl zawh nadingun Manasseh in Judah le Jerusalem-a tengte a lelamin a pui hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Manasseh le ama’ mite kungah thu gen a, ahi vangin amate in a thuse sih uhi.","title":"A Kisiazaw-in Manasseh a Ngai Bangkia"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate sim dingin Topa in Assyria galkapmangte puoh a, amate in hatkilih tawh Manasseh manin siakhau tawh kanbawmin Babylon ah a peipi uhi."},"12":{"text":"A lungkham laitahin Topa a Pasien’ angvanna a sui a, a pu a pate’ Pasien mai-ah nahpi-in a kiniemkhieh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in Pasien kungah thum a, tuale ama in ama’ kutna sangin a ngetna za a, Jerusalem ah a kumpi gam a piekia hi. Tua bepin Topa pen Pasien tahtah ahi lam Manasseh in a thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin kuom sung, Gihon nitumna lam, Nga Tunkot lutna dong David khuopi adingin ama in kulbang pulam khat a cieng hi; ama in Ophel kimkotah kul sang mama khat cieng to hi. Ama in Judah gam sung kulnei khuopi zosie-ah zong galkapmangte koi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ biehinn panin gamdang pasien-te le a milim, le Topa’ biehinn muol tung le Jerusalem-a ama’ na lamsa maitam zosie ladawhin khuo pulamah tuate a paaimang hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in Topa’ maitam zong a ngai bangin koikia a, tua tungah thunuoma biehpiehna le lungdamkona a pie hi; tuale ama in Israel Pasien Topa’ na a sep nadingun Judah thu a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle munsangte-ah mite in biehpiehna a pie lai vua, ahi vangin Topa a Pasien uh kung beh ma-a a pieh uh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Manasseh’ gamtatna a omlaite, le a Pasien’ tunga a thungetna, le Israel Pasien, Topa’ min tawh ama tunga thu a gen thumute’ thugente, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu sungah a om hi.","title":"Manasseh’ Sina (2Kum 21:17-18)"},"19":{"text":"Pasien in ama’ thungetna, le ama’ thumna a sanna, le ama’ mawna le a muonhuoi lona zosie, le ama a kiniemkhieh masangin munsangte bawlin khuom siengthote a koina munte thu, Thumute ’ Khang Tangthu sungah kigiel hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pu a pate tawh Manasseh lumton a, amate in a inn sungah ama a vui uhi. A tapa Amon in ama’ za luo hi."},"21":{"text":"Amon a maan ding kipatin kum sawmni le ni pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum ni sung maang hi.","title":"Amon’ Uhna le A Sina (2Kum 21:19-26)"},"22":{"text":"A pa Manasseh’ gamtatsa bangin Topa muna-ah a siet gamtat hi. Amon in a pa Manasseh’ bawlsa milim zosie tungah biehpiehnate pie-in tuate’ na a sem hi."},"23":{"text":"A pa Manasseh bangin Topa’ mai-ah ama le ama a kiniemkhieh sih a, tam Amon in khielna tampi a piengsah semsem zawsop hi."},"24":{"text":"A nasemte in tha dingin ama a sawmdap vua, a inn sungah a that uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua gam mite in Kumpi Amon a sawmdap mi zosie that leuleu uhi; tuale gam mite in ama’ za a luo dingin a tapa Josiah kumpi-in koi uhi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah maan ding a kipatin kum giet pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le khat sung maang hi.","title":"Josiah’ Uhna (2Kum 22:1-2)","ref":"Jer 3:6"},"2":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama a manin gamta hi; ama in a pu David’ gamtat teng zui-in ziet le vei-ah piel lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ uh a kum gietna, naupangno ahi lai-in ama in a pu David’ Pasien sui ding a kipan hi.
