Kum sawm le nina kumin ama in Judah le Jerusalem panin munsangte, khuom siengthote, le a kikheng le a kisung milimte suhmang ding a kipan hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in ama muna-ah Baal-te’ maitamte a sawnpua uhi; ama in tuate tunga a om gimnamtui maitamte phelmang a, khuom siengthote, le a kikheng le a kisung milimte satkehin a gawivui hi; ama in tuate tunga kithoi mite’ han tungah a vuite a the hi.","ref":"2Kum 21:3; 2Khg 33:3"},"5":{"text":"Ama in a maitamte uh tunga siempute’ gute zong hal a, Judah le Jerusalem a siensuo hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:2"},"6":{"text":"Manasseh, Ephraim, le Simeon khuopite sung le Naphtali khuopi cieng dong, le tua teng zosie’ kimvela a siesate dongin,"},"7":{"text":"maitamte satkehin khuom siengthote satguoi a, Israel gam sung zosie-ah gimnamtui maitamte a satcim hi. Tua ciengin Jerusalem ah ama a kilekia hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama a maan a kum sawm le gietna kumin gam sung teng le biehinn a siensuo zaw ciengin, Topa a Pasien’ biehinn a puopha dingin ama in Azariah’ tapa Shaphan, le khuopi uhpa Maaseiah, le thuciemte pa Joahaz’ tapa Joah a sawl hi.","title":"Thukham Laibu Kimukia (2Kum 22:3-20)"},"9":{"text":"Siempu lien pa Hilkiah kungah amate a pei vua, kotcing Levi-te in Manasseh, Ephraim, Israel a omlai teng, Judah le Benjamin zosie, le Jerusalem-a tengte kung pana a don uh Pasien’ biehinn sunga a kitawi sumte a pie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in Topa’ biehinn a van nasemte tungah tua sumte a pie uhi. Topa’ biehinn a van nasemte in biehinn puo nading le biehinn a ngai bahsahkia nadingin a pie uhi."},"11":{"text":"A kito suongte lei nading, le kumpite suhsiet inn kisiete kil nading singte le inn lamna a zah ding innkamte lei nadingin khutsiemte le innlamte tungah a sumte a pie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mite in muonhuoi tahin na a sem uhi. Amate a van dingin Levi-te Merari suonte sung panin Jahath le Obadiah, le Kohath’ suonte sung panin Zechariah le Meshullam-te kikoi hi. Tumgingte tawh lasah siem adang Levi-te in"},"13":{"text":"vangih puote le nasep namcin a semte zosie a makai uhi; tuale Levi-te pawlkhat pen laigielte, uliente le kotcingte ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in Topa’ biehinn sunga a kipuohsa sumte a lah laitahun siempu Hilkiah in Moses tungtawna a kipie Topa’ thukham laibu a mu hi."},"15":{"text":"Hilkiah in thuvanpi pa Shaphan kungah, “ Topa’ biehinn sungah thukham laibu ka mu hi,” ci hi; tuale Hilkiah in Shaphan kungah tua laibu a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Shaphan in kumpipa kungah tua laibu peipi-in ama kungah, “Na nasemte tunga a ki-ap zosie a sep laitah un"},"17":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sunga kimu sum teng a la sieng vua, nasep makaite le nasemte tungah a pie uhi,” ci-in a gen be lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Thuvanpi pa Shaphan in kumpipa kungah, “Siempu Hilkiah in keima tungah laibu khat ei pie hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Shaphan in kumpipa mai-ah a gingin tua laibu a sim hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in thukham kammalte a zah ciengin a puon a ehmal hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Hilkiah, Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, Micah’ tapa Abdon, thuvanpi pa Shaphan, le kumpipa’ nasempa Asaiah thu pie a,"},"21":{"text":"“Pei unlen, tua a kimu laibu sunga kammalte tawh kisai-in keima ading le Israel le Judah gama a kinuasie mite adingin Topa thu va dong ta un; azieh pen i pu i pate in tam laibu sunga a kigiel zosie banga sep ding, Topa’ kammal na zui lo uh ahi ziehin eite tunga ang kibuo Topa’ lungthahna lien hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hilkiah le kumpipa in a sawl mite, Hasrah, a tapa Tokhath, a tapa Shallum, biehinn puon kempa’ zi kamsangnu Huldah kungah pei-in (tua nu Jerusalem sung Veng Nina munah a teng hi) tua thu tawh kisai ama kungah a gen uhi.","title":"Kamsangnu Huldah Thu Kikum"},"23":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Ka kunga ang sawlpa kungah gen un,"},"24":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Keima in tam mun le a tunga teng mite tungah Judah kumpipa mai-a a kisim laibu sunga a kigiel samsietna zosie ahi gimnate ka tungsah ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A nasepte utawh ei lungthahsah nadingun, amate in kei ei nuasie-in pasien dangte tungah biehna a pieh ziehun tami munah ka lungthahna kibuo-in a kiphelmit zo sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa thu dong dinga ang sawl Judah kumpipa kungah tam bangin na gen ding uhi: Israel Pasien, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Na zahsa thute tawh kisai-in,"},"27":{"text":"tam mun le a tunga a teng mite tungah ama langpanna kammalte na zah ciengin na lungsim kisia-in, Pasien mai-ah nangmama kiniemkhieh na hi zieh le ka mai-ah nangma kiniemkhiehin, na puonte ehmalin ka mai-ah kap na hi ziehin, na thugen ka za zo ta hi, Topa in ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Na pu na pate kungah kang khawm ding a, lungnuomtahin na han-ah ang kikhawm ding hi. Nangma in tam mun le a sunga tengte tunga ka tunsah ding gimna zosie na mit in a mu sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Amate in kumpipa kungah thu a puohkia uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in thu vaihlahin Judah le Jerusalem upa zosie kikhawmsah hi.","title":"Thuciemna Kithasuosah (2Kum 23:1-20)"},"30":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn ah kumpipa, Judah mite zosie, Jerusalem-a teng mite zosie, siempute le Levi-te, le mite zosie a lien a neu tawh peito uhi; ama in Topa’ biehinn sunga a kimu thuciemna laibu sunga thu zosie amau’ zahin a sim hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama munah kumpipa dingin tam laibu sunga a kigiel thuciemna thute a sem dingin a lungsim zosie le a hinna zosie tawh, Topa’ nua a zui nading le ama’ thupiehnate, ama’ thukipte, le ama’ thukhamte a zui nadingin Topa mai-ah thuciemna khat a bawl hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Jerusalem le Benjamin sunga a om mi zosie in tua thu a zui dingin a kiciem uhi. Amau’ pu pate’ Pasien ahi Pasien’ thuciemna dung zui-in Jerusalem-a tengte a gamta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Josiah in Israel mite’ neisa gam zosie panin a kidahhuoi zosie ladawhin Israel sunga a om mi zosie in Topa a Pasien uh a biesah hi. Ama’ hin sung tungtawnin a pu le pate uh’ Pasien, Topa a zuina panun amate a kihei sih uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in Jerusalem ah Topa adingin peisan pawi a bawl hi; amate in a hla masa a ni sawm le lina ni-in peisan pawi tuuno a go uhi.","title":"Peisan Pawi Bawlna (2Kum 23:21-23)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in siempute amau’ nasepna munah se a, Topa’ biehinn sunga nasepna-ah amate hanthawn hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Israel zosie thu a hil, Topa tunga a siengtho Levi-te kungah, “Israel kumpipa David’ tapa Solomon in a lam biehinn sungah a siengtho singkuong koi un. Na liengko tung vua na puoh ding uh a kisam nawn sih hi. Tu-in Topa na Pasien ule a mi Israel-te’ na sem un."},"4":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh’ innkuon sungah a khenkhenin na opna uh tawh kizui-in kithawi unlen, lai tawh kigiel Israel kumpi David’ lamlahnate le lai tawh a kigiel a tapa Solomon’ lamlahnate zui un.","ref":"2Khg 8:14"},"5":{"text":"Na mipi na tanaute uh a pupa innkuon sungah a pawlpawlin a kikhenna tawh kizui-in siengtho munah panmun la unlen, pupa’ innkuon khenkhat cietah Levi-te kihalsah kim un."},"6":{"text":"Peisan tuuno go-in noma ma kisiensuo unlen, Moses tunga Topa’ thugen tawh kizui-in a sem dingin na tanaute uh tangin kithawi un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Josiah in a om mite zosie adingin peisan pawi biehna-in ganhon panin tuunote le keelnote tul sawmthum, le bawngtang tulthum a pie hi; tam teng pen kumpipa’ neisa pana kipie ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama’ uliente in mite tung, siempute tung, le Levi-te tungah kiphaltahin a pie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Levi-te’ a uhpite, Conaniah, le a sanggamte Shemaiah le Nethanel, le Hashabiah, Jeiel le Jozabad-te in peisan pawi biehna-in Levi-te tungah tuuno le keelno tulnga, le bawngtang zanga a pie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Nasep nading a kithawi zaw ciengun, a mun vuah siempute a ding vua, tuale kumpipa’ thupieh tawh kizui-in amau’ khente sungah Levi-te a om uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in peisan tuuno a go vua, tuale Levi-te in a vun a hawh laitahun siempute in amate tung pana a nga uh sisan a the uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in Moses laibu sunga kigiel bangin, Topa tunga pieh dingin a pawlpawlin a pu pate uh’ innkuon sungah a kikhenna uh tawh kizui-in, amate tungah a hawm thei nadingun tua meihal biehnate a tuomkoi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Biehna ngaina kip tawh kizui-in amate in mei-ah peisan tuuno a hang uhi; tuale beelte, taubeelpi-te, le khangbeelte sungah a siengtho biehnate huonin mi zosie tungah tuate mallang tahin a puoh uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:8-9"},"14":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin amate in amau-a’ mama ding le siempute adingin a bawl uhi. Azieh pen Aaron’ suon siempute in meihal biehnate le a thau teng la-in zan dongin a kitahla uhi; tuaci’n Levi-te in amate ding le Aaron’ suon siempute adingin a bawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"David’ thupieh bangin Asaph’ suonte ahi lasate, Asaph, Heman, le kumpipa’ thumu pa Jeduthun-te a mun vuah a om uhi; amau’ mun cietah tunkot cingte a om vua, a tanau uh Levi-te in amate ading a bawlpieh ziehun amate in amau’ nasepna a nawngkaisah uh kul lo hi.","ref":"1Khg 25:1"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpi Josiah’ thupieh dung zui-in peisan pawi bawl ding le Topa’ maitam tungah meihal biehnate pieh nadingin Topa’ nasepna ding zosie khum ni-in a kithawi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khum muna om Israel mite in khum hunin peisan pawi, le tol saw lo anlum pawi ni sagi sung a bawl uhi.","ref":"Pei 12:1-20"},"18":{"text":"Kamsangpa Samuel hun lai-a kipanin Israel sungah tua bang peisan pawi kibawl ngai nai lo hi; Josiah, le siempute le Levi-te, le khumtaha a om Judah le Israel mi zosie, le Jerusalem-a teng mite in a bawl peisan pawi tawh a kibang, Israel kumpite koima in bawl ngai nai lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Josiah in a uh zaw kum sawm le gietna kumin tam peisan pawi kibawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam teng zosiepi nuasang, Josiah in biehinnpi a ngai a bahsah zaw ciengin, Euphrates gun gei Carchemish ah gal sim dingin Egypt kumpi Neco kuonto a, tuale ama do dingin Josiah a kuon hi.","title":"Pharaoh Neco’ Zawna le Josiah’ Sina (2Kum 23:28-30)"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Neco in palai sawl a, “Judah kumpipa aw, kei le nang bang kisai i hei? Tuni-in nang sim dinga ang kuon ka hi sih a, ka galte’ innkuon a sim dinga ang kuon ka hibo hi. Ka kinaw nadingin Pasien in keima thu ei pie zo hi. Ama in nang ang suhsiet lo nadingin keima kunga a om Pasien na langpanna khawl in,” cisah hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama kung panin Josiah a kilekia nuom sih a, hizongle ama tawh a kido thei nadingin a mel a sel hi. Ama in Neco’ kam sung panin Pasien’ thugente a ngai sih a, Megiddo zanglei-a gal kidona-ah ama na pang hi."},"23":{"text":"Thaltawite in Kumpi Josiah a kap uhi; tuale kumpipa in a nasemte kungah, “Nah liem seng ta ka hi ziehin ei puomang dawh ta un,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n leeng tung panin a nasemte in ama ladawhin a leeng nina tungah puo-in Jerusalem a tut uhi. Khum munah ama si a, a pu a pate’ hanah kivui hi. Judah le Jerusalem khuomi zosie in ama a kaa uhi."},"25":{"text":"Jeremiah in zong Josiah adingin kaa-teng a lo hi. Tuale numei lasate le pasal lasa zosie in tuni dongin kaa-tengin Josiah’ min a lo uhi. Amate in Israel sungah tam thute ngaina-in a bawl uhi; kaa-la sungah tuate kikhum hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in Josiah’ gamtatna a omlaite, le Topa’ thukham sunga a kigiel bangin a nasep hoite,"},"27":{"text":"le a gamtatna, a masa le a nukhia-te, Israel le Judah Kumpite’ Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua gam mite in Josiah’ tapa Jehoahaz kicipa Jerusalem ah a pa’ zaluo-in kumpi-in a koi uhi.","title":"Jehoahaz’ Maanna (2Kum 23:31-35)"},"2":{"text":"Jehoahaz a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le thum pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah hla thum sung maang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Egypt kumpipa in Jerusalem ah ama zakiesah a, ngun talent zakhat le kham talent khat, tua gam sieh le kaihin kipiesah hi."},"4":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in Judah le Jerusalem tungah kumpi-in a sanggampa Eliakim koi a, ama’ min pen Jehoiakim-in a kheelpieh hi; ahi vangin Neco in a sanggampa Jehoahaz manin Egypt gamah a peipi hi.","ref":"Jer 22:11-12"},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le nga pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat sung maang hi. Topa a Pasien’ muna-ah ama a sie-in a gamta hi.","title":"Jehoiakim’ Uhna le Saltanna (2Kum 23:36–24:7)","ref":"Jer 22:18-19; 26:1-6; 35:1-19"},"6":{"text":"Ama a sim dingin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kuonto a, Babylon-a peipi dingin ama siakol bul hi.","ref":"Jer 25:1-38; 36:1-32; 45:1-5; Dan 1:1-2"},"7":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Topa’ biehinn sunga vanzahte pawlkhat zong Babylon ah puo a, Babylon-a ama kumpi inn sungah tuate koi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoiakim’ gamtatna a omlaite, le ama bawl a kidahhuoite, le ama a hoi lona a kimute, Israel le Judah Kumpite’ Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi; tuale a tapa Jehoiakhin in ama’ za luo hi."},"9":{"text":"Jehoiachin a maan ding a kipatin kum giet pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah hla thum le ni sawm sung maang hi. Topa muna-ah ama a sie-in gamta hi.","title":"Jehoiachin’ Uhna le Saltanna (2Kum 24:8-17)"},"10":{"text":"Tua kum khuokhal sungin Nebuchadnezzar Kumpipa in mi sawlin, Topa’ biehinn sunga vanzah mantam teng tawh Babylon ah ama vaihlah a, tuale ama’ sanggampa Zedekiah kumpi-in koi hi.","ref":"Jer 22:24-30; 24:1-10; 29:1-2; 37:1; Jer 37:1; Ezk 17:12-13"},"11":{"text":"Zedekiah a maan ding a kipatin kum sawmni le khat pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat sung maang hi.","title":"Zedekiah’ Uhna (2Kum 24:18-20 ; Jer 52:1-3)","ref":"Jer 27:1-22; 28:1-17"},"12":{"text":"Topa a Pasien’ muna-ah ama siet gamtat hi. Topa’ kammal gensawn ahi kamsang Jeremiah mai-ah ama a kiniemkhieh sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien tawh ama a kiciemsah Nebuchadnezzar zong a ledo hi; ama in a ngawng khauhsahin a lungtang zong khausah a, Israel Pasien Topa lamah a kihei nuom sih hi.","ref":"Ezk 17:15"},"14":{"text":"Siempu makai teng le mipi zosie in zong minamte’ kidahhuoi nate zosie a zui vua, a muonhuoi sih uhi; tuale ama in Jerusalem-a a siensuosa Topa’ biehinn pen amate in a buasah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a mite le a tenna mun tungah lainatna a nei ziehin a pu a pate uh’ Pasien, Topa in amate kungah a kamtaite a sawlkia ngitnget hi;","title":"Jerusalem a Kisietna (2Kum 25:1-21 ; Jer 52:3-30)"},"16":{"text":"hizongle mite tungah Topa’ lungthahna tungin a kidamsah zo lo ding za dongin Pasien’ kamtaite nuisatin, amau’ kammalte a na simmaw vua, amate in kamsangte zong a na zapi den uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate sim dingin Topa in amau’ biehinn munsiengtho sunga namsau tawh a tangvalte a that, le ngahnu tangval, khanghamte le a zawngkhal mite tungah lainatna a nei lo Chaldea-te’ kumpipa a puoh hi; ama in a unpi-in ama’ khut sungah amate a pie hi.","ref":"Jer 21:1-10; 34:1-5"},"18":{"text":"Ama in Pasien’ inn sunga vanzah a gol a neu, Topa’ inn sunga goute le kumpipa le a uliente’ gou zosie a unpi-in Babylon ah a puo hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ inn a haltum vua, Jerusalem kulpi kawm satkehin, mei tawh kumpipa’ inn zosie a haltum vua, vanzah manpha zosie a susie uhi.","ref":"1Kum 9:8"},"20":{"text":"Ama in Babylon ah namsau pana a suohta mite salin kai a, Persia kumpi gam a kiphu ni cieng dongin amate, ama le a tapate’ sal a suoh uhi."},"21":{"text":"A sabbath-te adingin tua leitang a kibawl dong cieng, Jeremiah kam tungtawnin Topa’ thugen a tangtun nading ahi hi. Kum sawm sagi a cin nadingin leitang a kinuasie hun sung teng zosie leitang in sabbath a tang hi.","ref":"Jer 25:11; 29:10"},"22":{"text":"Persia kumpipa Cyrus’ kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah’ kam pana Topa’ thu a tangtun thei nadingin, Persia kumpipa Cyrus in tangko khat sawl a, lai-a kigiel kumpi thupieh zong ama’ kumpi gam zosie-ah a tangko nadingin Topa in Persia kumpipa Cyrus’ lungsim a thampieh hi:","title":"Cyrus in Gambelte ading Suotahna Tangko (Ezr 1:1-4)"},"23":{"text":"“Persia kumpipa Cyrus in tam bangin a gen hi: Vantung Pasien, Topa in leitung kumpi gam zosie ei pie zo a, Judah gam sunga Jerusalem ah ama ading biehinn khat a lampieh dingin keima ei sawl zo hi. Note lahah ama’ mi a om poma, Topa a Pasien in ompi taheh! Ama kuontosah heh,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 44:28"}}}}},"15":{"info":{"name":"Ezra","shortname":"Ezr","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezra laibu (the book of ezra)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia Kumpi Cyrus’ a maan kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah kam sung panin Topa’ thugen a tangtun thei nadingin ama’ gam sung zosie-ah Persia kumpipa Cyrus in tangko khat sawl a, a kumpi gam zosie-ah lai tawh a kigiel kumpipa thupieh tam banga a tangtawh nadingin Persia kumpi Cyrus’ lungsim Topa in a tham hi:","title":"Babylon-te Saltan a Tawpna (2Khg 36:22-23)","ref":"Jer 25:11; 29:10"},"2":{"text":"“Persia kumpipa Cyrus in tam bangin gen hi: Vantung Pasien, Topa in leitung kumpi gam zosie kei ei pie zo ta a, Judah gama Jerusalem ah ama adingin biehinn khat a lampieh dingin kei ei sawl zo hi.","ref":"Isa 44:28"},"3":{"text":"Note lahah ama’ mi poma - a Pasien in amate ompi taheh! - tu-in Judah gam sunga Jerusalem ah peito-in Topa’ biehinn lamkia uheh- ama pen Jerusalem-a om Pasien ahi hi;"},"4":{"text":"a hingsun teng, heisung munah a teng zongun, a tenna mun vua mite in Jerusalem-a Pasien’ biehinn adingin nopthu-a biehnate banah, ngun le kham, nate le ganhingte tawh panpi ciet uheh,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Judah le Benjamin sunga innkuon lutangte, siempute le Levi-te Pasien’ hlagau in a lungsim uh a thamkhah mi zosie- Jerusalem khuo-a om Topa’ biehinn lamkia dingin kisa-in a kuonto uhi."},"6":{"text":"A veng a pamte zosie in a amau’ kizaw zaza a pieh ban vuah ngun tawh kibawl vanzahte, kham, nate, ganhing, le letsong manphate tawh amate a hu uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem pana a na puohdawh, a pasien-te’ inn sunga a na koi ahi Topa’ biehinn vanzahte zong kumpi Cyrus in a lakhie hi."},"8":{"text":"Persia Kumpipa Cyrus in tuate pusuo-in sumkempa Mithredath khut sungah ap a, Methredath in a sum phaza simin Judah uhpa Sheshbazzar’ khut sungah ap hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam teng pen van sazien ahi hi: Kham kuong sawmthum, ngun kuong tulkhat, nam sawmni le kuo;"},"10":{"text":"kham kuongkum sawmthum; adang ngun kuongkum zali le sawmkhat; vanzah adang tulkhat ahi hi;"},"11":{"text":"kham le ngun tawh a kibawl vanzah zosie a unpi-in tulnga zali sawmguh le kuo pha hi. Salte, Babylon panin Jerusalame ah a kipeipito ciengin Sheshbazzar in tuate zosie a peitopi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in mi tam teng pen Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in a zawna gam panin Babylon ah sala a lahte sung panin Jerusalem le Judah gama peikiate ahi uhi; amate pen Jerusalem le Judah sung, amau’ khuopi cietah a kilekia ahi uhi.","title":"Sal Kilekiate Sazien (Neh 7:5-73)"},"2":{"text":"Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, le Baanah-te tawh amate a zawhton uhi. Israel mite a phaza:"},"3":{"text":"Parosh suonte, mi tulni le zakhat sawmsagi le ni ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Shephatiah suonte, zathum sawmsagi le ni ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Arah suonte, zasagi sawmsagi le nga ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pahath-moab be sung panin Jeshua le Joab’ suonte, tulni zagiet sawm le ni ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Elam suonte, tulkhat zani sawmnga le li ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Zattu suonte, zakuo sawmli le nga ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Zaccai suonte, zasagi sawmguh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Bani suonte, zaguh sawmli le ni ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Bebai suonte, zaguh sawmni le thum ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Azgad suonte, tulkhat zani sawmni le ni ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Adonikam suonte, zaguh sawmguh le guh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Bigvai suonte, tulni sawmnga le guh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Adin suonte, zali sawmnga le li ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ater a kici Hezekiah suonte, sawmkuo le giet ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Bezai suonte, zathum sawmni le thum ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Jorah suonte, zakhat sawm le ni ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hashum suonte, zani sawmni le thum ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Gibbar suonte, sawmkuo le nga ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Bethlehem mite, zakhat sawmni le thum ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Netophah-te, sawmnga le guh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Anathoth-te, zakhat sawmni le giet ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Azmaveth-te, sawmli le ni ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Kiriatharim, Chephirah, Beeroth-te, zasagi sawmli le thum ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Ramah le Geba-te, zaguh sawmni le khat ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Michmash-te, zakhat sawmni le ni ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Bethel le Ai-te, zani sawmni le thum ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Nebo suonte, sawmnga le ni ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Magbish-te, zakhat sawmnga le guh ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Adang Elam suonte, tulkhat zani sawmnga le li ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Harim-te, zathum sawmni ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Lod, Hadid, le Ono-te, zasagi sawmni le nga ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Jericho-te, zathum sawmli le nga ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Senaah-te, tulthum zaguh sawmthum ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Siempute: Jeshua-te be panin Jedaiah suonte, zakuo sawmsagi le thum ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Immer suonte, tulkhat sawmnga le ni ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Pashhur suonte, tulkhat zani sawmli le sagi ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Harim suonte, tulkhat sawm le sagi ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Levi-te sung panin: Hodaviah-te be panin Jeshua suonte le Kadmiel suonte, sawmsagi le li ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Lasate: Asaph suonte, zakhat sawmni le giet ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Kotcingte nam sung panin Shallum suonte, Ater suonte, Talmon suonte, Akkub suonte, a unpi-un zakhat sawmthum le kuo ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Biehinnpi nasamte: Ziga suonte, Hasupa suonte, Tabbaoth suonte,"},"44":{"text":"Keros suonte, Siaha suonte, Padon suonte,"},"45":{"text":"Lebanah suonte, Hagabah suonte, Akkub suonte,"},"46":{"text":"Hagab suonte, Shamlai suonte, Hanan suonte,"},"47":{"text":"Giddel suonte, Gahar suonte, Reaiah suonte,"},"48":{"text":"Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam,"},"49":{"text":"Uzza, Peseah, Besai,"},"50":{"text":"Asnah suonte, Meunim suonte, Nephisim suonte,"},"51":{"text":"Babuk suonte, Hakupha suonte, Harhur suonte,"},"52":{"text":"Bazluth suonte, Mehida suonte, Harsha suonte,"},"53":{"text":"Barkos suonte, Sisera suonte, Temah suonte,"},"54":{"text":"Neziah suonte, le Hatipha suonte ahi uhi."},"55":{"text":"Solomon’ nasemte suonlehlahte sung pan: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda,"},"56":{"text":"Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel,"},"57":{"text":"Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth-hazzebaim, le Ami-te ahi uhi."},"58":{"text":"Biehinnpi nasemte zosie le Solomon’ nasemte’ suonlehlahte zosie a unpi-in zathum sawmkuo le ni pha uhi."},"59":{"text":"Tam a nei-a teng in a phung a tang uh kan thei loin, Israel mi ahile ahi lo uh theicien nawn sih nan ule, Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, le Immer-te pana ang peito mite:"},"60":{"text":"Delaiah suonte, Tobiah suonte, le Nekoda suonte, mi zaguh sawmnga le ni ahi uhi."},"61":{"text":"Siempute sung panin zong: Habaiah suonte, Hakkoz suonte, le Barzillai suonte (ama in Gilead mi Barzillai tanute khat zi-a a lah ziehin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uhi."},"62":{"text":"Tam mite in khang ciemtena laibu sungah a min uh a sui vangun a min uh a kimu sih a, tua ahi ziehin amate a sieng loin kiciemte a, siempu nasep kisemsah lo hi;"},"63":{"text":"Urim le Thummim tawh ai san ding siempu khat a om masangsie amate in an siengtho pen a neh lo nading uh gam uhpa in a gen hi.","ref":"Gam 27:21"},"64":{"text":"A kikhawm buppi, tul sawmli le tulni le zathum a pha vua,"},"65":{"text":"amau’ nasem numei le pasal, mihing tulsagi le zathum sawmthum le sagite kisim lo hi; tuale amate in lasa numei le pasal zani a nei uhi."},"66":{"text":"Amate in sakol, zasagi sawmthum le guh, laa-sakol, zani sawmli le nga,"},"67":{"text":"kalaoh, zali sawmthum le nga, le"},"68":{"text":"laa, tulguh zasagi le sawmni a nei uhi."},"69":{"text":"Amate in a neiza utawh kituohin biehinn lam nadingin kham darics tul sawmguh le tulkhat, ngun mina tulnga, le siempu puontuol zakhat a pie uhi."},"70":{"text":"Siempute, Levi-te, le mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem le a kim nai-ah a teng uhi; tuale lasate, kotcingte, biehinn nasemte, le Israel mi zosie a khuopi ciet vuah a teng uhi.","ref":"1Khg 9:2; Neh 11:3"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hla sagina a tun ciengin a khuopi te vuah Israel-te a teng vua, mite Jerusalem ah a kisutuo uhi;","title":"Jerusalem ah Biehpiehna Kibawlkia"},"2":{"text":"tua ciengin Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua le a siempu seppite, Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le a sanggamte kipanin Pasien’ mi Moses’ thukham sunga a kigiel bangin meihal biehna dingin Israel Pasien’ maitam a bawl uhi.","ref":"Pei 27:1"},"3":{"text":"A veng vua teng mite a giin ziehun amate in a khuombul ma-ah maitam phutin zingmawng le nitahin Topa tungah meihal biehna a pie uhi.","ref":"Gam 28:1-8"},"4":{"text":"Amate in a kigielsa bangin buh pawi a bawl vua, ngaina kip a om dung zui-in nisima a kisam za bangin meihal biehnate nisimin a pie vua,","ref":"Gam 29:12-38"},"5":{"text":"tuale tatsat lo meihal biehnate a bawl zaw ciengun, amate in hla tha siela biehnate, le a siengtho Topa’ pawi zosiete le Topa tungah amau’ nopthu tawh a pie mi zosie’ biehnate a pie uhi.","ref":"Gam 28:11–29:39"},"6":{"text":"Amate in a hla sagina a ni masa ni panin Topa tungah meihal biehna ding a kipan uhi. Ahi vangin Topa’ biehinnpi adingin khuombul a kiphut nai sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in suongkhengte le khutsiemte tungah sum pie-in Persia Kumpipa Cyrus tung pan a sum nga dan uh tawh kizui-in Lebanon panin tuipi gei Joppa ah taamtah singte a puohsuh nadingun Sidon-te le Tyre-te tungah anneh tuidawn le sathau a pie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem-a Pasien’ biehinn ah a tun zaw uh a kum nina, tua kum a hla nina sungin Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua in a omlai amau’ mite, siempute, Levi-te, le saltanna pan Jerusalem a peikia-te zosie tawh nasep a kipan uhi. Amate in Levi-te, kum sawmni pan a tunglam sie poma Topa’ biehinn lam nasep van dingin a se uhi.","title":"Biehinnpi’ Khuombul Kiphum"},"9":{"text":"Tuale Jeshua a tapate le a tanaute tawh, Hodaviah-te’ sanggamte Kadmiel le a tapate, Binnui le Henadad a tapate tawh, Levi-te a tapate le a tanaute tawh kithuo-in Pasien’ biehinn nasemte vanton uhi."},"10":{"text":"Innlamte in Topa’ biehinnpi khuom bul a phu ciengun, Israel kumpipa David’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in Topa patawi dingin siempute in a puon uh silin pengkul tawh, Asaph’ tapa Levi-te daltuo tawh a panmun ding vuah a pang uhi;","ref":"1Khg 25:1"},"11":{"text":"Topa phatna le lungdamkona a kidawngin a sa vua, “Bangzieh ahei cile Topa hoi a, Israel-te a itna kip tawntung hi,” a ci uhi. Topa’ biehinn khuombul kiphut zo ta ahi ziehin amate in Topa a phat ciengun mi zosie in a aw neiza utawh dawngin a phat uhi.","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"12":{"text":"Mi tampite kipahin a kiko vangun a biehinn masa uh a mu ngai siempu tampite, Levi-te, le innkuon lutangte, tehsiete in tam biehinn a mu ciengun a gingin a kap uhi;"},"13":{"text":"tuaci’n mite in lungdamna awging le kaana awging a khen thei sih uhi, bangzieh ahei cile a gingin mite a awng vua, a gamla panin tua awging a kiza hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saltanna pana a kilekia-te in Israel Pasien Topa’ biehinnpi lam uhi, ci thu Judah le Benjamin’ galte in a zah ciengun,","title":"Biehinnpi Lamkia Nading Langpanna"},"2":{"text":"Zerubbabel, Jeshua, le innkuon lutangte va nai-in amate kungah, “Kote tawh lamton bo vai, bangzieh ahei cile ko zong noma banga na Pasien uh a bie ka hi vua, tami muna ei peipi Assyria kumpipa Esar-haddon huna kipan ama kunga biehpiehna a pie ka ta bo uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"2Kum 17:24-41"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Zerubbabel, Jeshua, le Israel sunga innkuon lutang a omlai teng in amate kungah, “Kote Pasien adingin biehinn ka lamna vuah note ei lamhu ding kisam lo hi; Persia Kumpipa Cyrus in ei thupieh bangin Israel Pasien Topa adingin ko guohin ka lam lel ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin a gam mite in Judah mite a lungkiesah vua, a inn lam ding uh a zausisah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale amate in zong a gelnate uh a subuoi dingin uliente guhgol pie-in, Persia Kumpipa Cyrus hun sung tungtawn le Kumpi Darius hun dongin a subuoi den uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahasueras in kumpi a sep a kipat cil lai-in amate in Judah le Jerusalem-a tengte mawsahna lai khat a giel uhi.","title":"Jerusalem Lamkiana Kilangpan","ref":"Est 1:1"},"7":{"text":"Tuale Persia Kumpi Artaxerxes hun sungin, Mishlam le Mithredath, Tabeel, le a omlai a kithuopi teng in Persia Kumpipa Artaxerxes tungah lai a hlah uhi; tua laihlah pen Aram lai tawh kigiel a, Aram ham ma tawh kilet hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa’ khut nei-a om ulien Rehum le laigiel pa Shimshai in Kumpi Artaxerxes tungah Jerusalem a langpanna uh lai khat a nei-a bangin a giel uhi."},"9":{"text":"(tua ciengin kumpipa’ khut nei-a om ulien Rehum, laigiel Shimshai, le a kithuopi teng zosie, thukhente, palaite, uliente, Persia-te, Erech-te le Babylon-te, Elam-te a kici Susa mite,"},"10":{"text":"a lien mama le a zahtahhuoi Osnappar in a na nawkhiet, Samaria gama khuopite le Gungal gamkhen-a a tensah adangte in tua lai a giel vua - tuale tu-in,"},"11":{"text":"tami pen amau’ laihlah a kiteisawn ahi hi): “Artaxerxes Kumpipa tungah: Gungal gamkhen-a om na nasemte in kang hopi uhi. Tuale tu-in"},"12":{"text":"nangma kung panin Jerusalem-a ko kunga ang pei Jews-te a pei zo ta uhi; amate in a gilo, mi ledo thei khuopi lamkia uhi. Amate in kulpi bawl a man kuon ta vua, khuo bulpite a puophat laitah uh ahi ci thei in."},"13":{"text":"Tua khu kilamkia-in a kulpite hing kimansieng leh amate in sieh le kaih, vanlah man, le losapte ang pie nawn sih ding vua, kumpi phiengsie ang tawm tuom ding ci thu zong thei in."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in kote ka hi uleh kumpi innpi sunga an nengkie tawh a kivah ka hi bo ziehun, kumpipa’ vangta lam a mu dingin zong ka kilawm valia sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin na pu na pate’ thuciemtena laibute a kisuikia thei nadingin kumpipa kungah mi sawlin kang zasah uhi. Tua thuciemtena laibute en lacin tam khuopi pen tanglai panin a ledo khuopi, kumpite le gamkhente a gimsah, a khuo sunga kumpi do dingin a kikuontawna thu na mu ding hi. Tam khuopi a kisuhsietna zong tam thu hang ma ahi hi.","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Tam khuopi hing kilamkia hinlen a kulpite ang kizo sieng mawh leh Gungal gamkhen teng pen nangma’ tanh ahi nawn lo nading thu, kumpipa kungah kang theisah uhi,” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in tam bangin lai thuhkia hi: “Kumpipa khut nei-a om ulien Rehum, laigiel Shimshai le Samaria gama tengte le Gungal gamkhen tenga a teng na kithuopite zosie tungah kang hopi uhi. Tu-in"},"18":{"text":"kei tunga nei laihlah uh pen kiletin ka mai-ah kicientahin kisim zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in thupieh khat bawlin mi pawlkhat ka kansah a, tami khuopi pen tanglai-a kipanin kumpite langpangin, tami khuo sungah ledona le kumpi dona a om zing lamtah kimu hi."},"20":{"text":"Jerusalem in a thahat kumpite a na nei ngai vua, Gungal gamkhen buppi tungah na vaihawmin, amate tungah sieh le kaih, vanlah man, le losapte na kipie hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tam mite a nasep a khawl nadingun thupieh khat na bawl un. Keima in thupieh khat kang bawlkia masangsie tami khuopi kilamkia lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua tham loin, tami tungtang nasep ding don loin na mawh om lo nadingun kidawm un; bang dingin kumpipa sup nadingin sietna khang ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa khut nei-a om ulien Rehum, laigiel Shimshai, le a kithuopi teng mai-a a kiteisawn Kumpi Artaxerxes’ laihlah a kisim ciengin, Jerusalem-a Jews-te kungah va nawpei-in thagum hatna le thuneina suongin a nasep uh a khawlsah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum huna kipanin Jerusalem-a Pasien’ biehinn lam nasep khawl a, Persia Kumpipa Darius’ maan a kum nina dongin innlam nasep kizom nawn lo hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in kamsangpa Haggai le Iddo’ tapa Zechariah-te in Judah le Jerusalem-a om Jews-te tungah Israel Pasien’ minin kam a sang uhi.","title":"A Ngai Bangkia Dingin Biehinnpi Lam Kizom (Hag 1:1 ; Zech 1:1)","ref":"Hag 1:1; Zech 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubabbel le Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua in Jerusalem ah Pasien’ biehinn lamkia ding a kipan uhi; tuale amate tawh Pasien’ kamsangte a omton vua, amate a hu uhi.","ref":"Hag 1:12; Zech 4:6-9"},"3":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin amate kungah Gungal gamkhen uhpa Tattenai, Shethar-bozenai, le ama’ kithuopite pei-in amate kungah, “Tami biehinn na lam nading ule a khuom a zawlte hlungin na man sieng nading uh koi hing thupieh ahiei?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in amate kungah, “Tami inn lamte’ min koi teng ahei?” ci zong a dong uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanle a Pasien uh’ mit in Jews upate vil gige a, Darius kungah tam thu va tungin ama kung pan lai tawh thuhkiana a kilekia masangsie, amate in a nasep uh a khawlsah sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gungal gamkhen uhpa Tattenai, Shethar-bozenai, le Gungal gamkhente-a a om ama’ kithuopi palai teng in Kumpi Darius tungah a kiteisawn laihlah khat a hlah uhi;"},"7":{"text":"amate in a hlah uh thuzahsahna lai tam banga kigiel ahi hi: “Darius kumpipa tungah thupha namcin hing tung taheh!"},"8":{"text":"Judah gama a lien mama Pasien’ biehinn-a ka va hawna uh kumpipa kungah kang theisah uhi. Tami biehinn pen suong kikhengzolsa tawh kilam ahi a, a kawmte sing tawh kibawl ahi hi. Amau’ khut sungah tami nasep limtahin a kisem a, masot toto uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin upate tawh ka kiho vua, amate kungah, ‘Note in tami biehinn na lam nading ule tami a khuom a zawlte hlungin na man sieng nading uh koi hing thu pieh ahiei?’ ci-in ka dong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na thei dingin a minte uzong ka dong vua, a makaite’ min zong ka giel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amau’ ei dawnna tam bang teng ahi hi: ‘Ko pen van le lei Pasien’ nasemte ka hi vua, kum sawtpi lai-a Israel’ kumpi lien khat in a na lamsa a lamkia ka hi bo uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle ka pu ka pate un vantung Pasien a lungthahsah ziehun Babylon Kumpipa, Chaldea-te Nebuchadnezzar’ khut sungah amate a na pieh lai-in, tami biehinn zong a na suhsiet ahi a, a mite zong Babylon gama a na peipi ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:8-12; 2Khg 36:17-20; Jer 52:12-15"},"13":{"text":"Hinanle Babylon Kumpipa Cyrus in a uh a kum khatna kumin tami Pasien’ biehinn lamkia nading thu a pie hi.","ref":"Ezr 1:2-11"},"14":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem biehinnpi sung pana a na lah, Babylon biehinnpi sunga a na koi ahi Pasien’ biehinn sunga a om ngaisa kham le ngun tawh a kibawl vanzah teng Kumpi Cyrus in Babylon biehinnpi panin la-in ama in tua teng pen gam uhpa dinga a koi Sheshbazzar a kici mipa kungah ap hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama kungah, “Tami vanzah teng peipi inlen, Jerusalem biehinnpi sungah va koikia ta’n. Ama’ mun ngai ma-ah Pasien’ biehinnpi lamsahkia in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Sheshbazzar pei-in Jerusalem ah Pasien’ biehinn bulpite a phut hi; tuale khum huna kipanin tudong kilamin kizo nai lo hi,’ a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale tu-in kumpipa in pha na sah leh, Jerusalem biehinn lamkia nading thu kumpipa Cyrus in thu a pie tahpi amah, pie lo ahei ci thu tawh kisai-in Babylon khuo sunga kikoi kumpite’ thuciemtena laibu sungah suisah in. Kumpipa in tam thu tawh kisai-in na lunglam bang ahi ei mah ci ei zasahkia in,” a ci uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Darius in khensatna thukip khat bawl a, amate in Babylon khuo sunga kumpi lai thupite kikoina innte a sui uhi.","title":"Darius’ Khensat Thukip"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Media gamkhen kumpi khuopi Ekbatana ah laiziel khat kimu a, tua sungah tam bangin kigiel hi: “A kiciemtena."},"3":{"text":"A kumpi sep a kum khatna kumin Kumpipa Cyrus in tam bangin thukip lai khat na hawm hi: Jerusalem-a Pasien’ biehinn tawh kisai-in biehpiehnate a kibawlna le meihal biehnate a kipeipina munah biehinn lamsahkia unlen, a sanna tong sawmguh, avai tong sawmguh ma hi ding a,"},"4":{"text":"a kawm pen a kikhengzol suongtum guol thum le sing guol khat tawh kicieng ding hi; sum a tawp zaza kumpi sumkholna panin kipie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua banah Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem biehinnpi pana a lah, Babylon khuo-a a peipi Pasien’ biehinn sunga a om kham le ngun tawh kibawl vanzahte lasahkia unlen, Jerusalem biehinnpi sungah kipiekia ding a, amau’ om ngaina cietah tuate kikoikia ding hi; note in Pasien’ inn sungah tuate na koiding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tu-in Gungal gamkhen a uhpa Tattenai, Shethar-bozenai le nang, amau’ kithuopi Gungal gam palaite na hemkhie unlen,"},"7":{"text":"tami Pasien’ biehinn lam nasep ama le ama omsah lel un; Jews-te gam uhpa le a upate in a mun lui ma-ah tami Pasien’ biehinn lamsahkia un."},"8":{"text":"Tua tham loin tami Pasien’ biehinnpi a kilamkia thei nadingin note in tami Judah upate adingin bang bawlpieh ding na hi uh hei ci thu tawh kisai-in keima in tam bangin thukip khat ka bawl hi. A tawp zosie Gungal gamkhen pana kinga sieh le kaihte ahi kumpi phiengsieh kikhonte panin zekai loin a cingtahin kipie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A kisam poma-van Pasien tungah meihal biehna-a pieh dingin bawngtang a note, tuutangte, ahi sihle tuunote na pie ding vua, Jerusalem-a siempute’ ang ngetna bangin amate tungah nisielin mangbu, ci, lenggazu, ahi sihle sathaute na piesah ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in van Pasien tungah lungdamna biehpiehnate bawlin kumpipa le a tapate’ hinkhuo adingin thumpieh thei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua banah mi khatpo in tami thupiehna a khel leh tua a khiel mi pa’ inn panin zawlpi khat kibot ding a, tua ciengin tua zawl tungah ama kikhai-in kisunlia ding a, ama’ inn pen bawng-eeh kholna-in kinei ding hi, ci-in thukip ka bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Tami ka thupieh a khel nuom, ahi sihle Jerusalem-a Pasien’ biehinn a susie nuom kumpi khatpo ahi a, mi khatpo ahi zongin a op leh, ama’ min om na dinga tua mun a bawl Pasien in tua mipa thalpai taheh. Keima Darius in thukip kang pie hi; tua khu kukaltaha sep ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Darius in a vaihlah kammal tawh kizui-in Gungal gamkhen uhpa Tattenai, Shethar-bonezai, le amau’ kithuopite in kukal tahin Kumpi Darius’ thupieh a sem pai uhi.","title":"Biehinnpi Lam Manna le Apna"},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n kamsangpa Haggai le Iddo’ tapa Zechariah-te’ kamsanna tungtawnin Jews upate in biehinn lamin a masot mama uhi. Amate in Israel Pasien’ thupiehna le Cyrus, Darius le Kumpi Artaxerxes-te’ thupiehna tawh biehinn lam a zo sieng uhi;","ref":"Hag 1:1; Zech 1:1"},"15":{"text":"tuale Kumpi Darius in kumpi a sep zaw a kum guhna, Adar hla a ni thum ni-in tami biehinn lam nasep kiman hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel mite, siempute, Levi-te, le ang kinuale saltang a omlai teng in lungdam tahin tami Pasien’ biehinn apna pawi a bawl uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tami Pasien’ biehinnpi apna-ah bawngtang zakhat, tuutang zani, le tuuno zali biehna-in a go vua, a minam phaza tawh kizui-in Israel zosie’ mawna zieha biehna adingin keeltang sawm le ni a pie uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Moses’ laibu sunga kigielsa bangin Jerusalem-a nasem dingin siempute le Levi-te a khen khenin a koi uhi."},"19":{"text":"A hla masa a ni sawm le li ni-in saltanna pana ang kinuale mite in peisan pawi a bawl uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Pawi Kibawl (Thkna 16:1-8)","ref":"Pei 12:1-20"},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen siempute le Levi-te kisiensuo ton uhi; amate a unpi-un a siengtho a hi ta uhi. Tuaci’n saltang ang kilekia zosie ading, a siempu septonpite ading, le amate adingin peisan tuuno a go uhi."},"21":{"text":"Saltanna pana ang kilekia Israel mite le Israel Pasien Topa bie dingin tua gam sung minamte le a buana pan vua a kikhenkhie, amate ang pawl mi zosie in tua an a ne uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in lungdam kipahin ni sagi sung tol saw lo anlum pawi a bawl uhi; azieh pen Topa in amate lungnuomsah a, tuale Assyria kumpipa’ lungsim amate lamah a kiheisah hi, tuaci’n ama in Israel Pasien’ biehinn a lamna vuah amate a panpi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin Persia Kumpipa Artaxerxes a maan hun sungin Seraiah’ tapa Ezra, Azariah’ tapa Seraiah, Hilkiah’ tapa Azaraiah,","title":"Ezra Tunna le a Nasep"},"2":{"text":"Shalum’ tapa Hilkiah, Zadok’ tapa Shallum, Ahitub’ tapa Zadok,"},"3":{"text":"Amariah’ tapa Ahitub, Azariah’ tapa Amariah, Meraioth’ tapa Azariah,"},"4":{"text":"Zerahiah’ Meraioth, Uzzi’ tapa Zerahiah, Bukki’ tapa Uzzi,"},"5":{"text":"Abishua’ tapa Bukki, Phinehas’ tapa Abishua, Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas, siempupi pa Aaron-"},"6":{"text":"tami Ezra pen Babylon pana ang tungto ahi hi. Ama pen Israel Pasien Topa in a piehsa Moses’ thukham a siem laithei mi khat ahi hi; tuale ama tungah Topa a Pasien khut a op ziehin a nget zosie kumpipa in a pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Artaxerxes in a uh zaw a kum sagina kumin Israel mi pawlkhat, le siempute, Levi-te, lasate, kotcingte, le biehinn nasemte pawlkhat zong, Jerusalem ah a peito uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in a uh kum sagi a cin kum, a hla ngana sungin Jerusalem ah amate a tung uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama tunga a hepi siem a Pasien’ khut a op ziehin, a hla masa a ni khat ni-in Babylon panin khuolzin kipan a, a hla ngana a ni khat ni-in Jerusalem ah a tung hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Ezra in a lungtang sungah Topa’ thukham kanin tuate zui ding le Israel gam sungah thukhamte le ngaina kipte hil a sawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami pen Kumpi Artaxerxes in siempu, laithei pa, Israel adinga Topa’ thupiehnate le a thukham a siem ahi mipil Ezra tunga a pieh a kiteisawn laihlah ahi hi:","title":"Ezra Tunga Artaxerxes’ Laihlah"},"12":{"text":"“Kumpite’ kumpipa Artaxerxes tung panin van Pasien’ thukham a siem, siempu laithei Ezra tungah a kigiel khu tam bang ahi hi: Kilemna. Tuale tu-in"},"13":{"text":"keima in ka gam sunga a om Israel mite khatpo ahi a, a siempute ahi a, Levi-te ahi zongin, Jerusalem-a pei nuom a op leh nang tawh zawhton dingin thukhentatna a kip ka bawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na khut sunga a om na Pasien’ thukham dung zui-in Judah le Jerusalem thu a kan dingin kumpipa le a thu kuppi mihing sagite in nang ang sawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Note pen a tenna uh Jerusalem ahi kumpipa le a thu kikuppite in Israel Pasien tungah kiphal taha a piehsa uh ngun le khamte,"},"16":{"text":"Babylon gam bup-a na mu ding uh ngun le kham zosie, mite le a siempute in Jerusalem ah a Pasien uh’ biehinn dinga lungkimtaha a pieh uh amau’ nop thu-a a kipie biehnate tawh zong a va puohton ding na hi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin tami sum tawh pilvang tahin bawngtangte, tuutangte, tuunote, an tawh a biehnate ule dawnthei a biehnate na lei ding vua, Jerusalem-a na Pasien uh’ biehinn sunga maitam tungah tuate na pie ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ngun le kham a val teng na Pasien uh’ deina tawh kituohin na guolhaw tawh hoi na sah bangun na zang thei ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na Pasien uh’ biehinn sunga zah dinga ang kipie vanzahte, Jerusalem Pasien mai-ah na tut ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nang in pieh dinga mawpuohna na nei na Pasien biehinn dinga a kisam adang khat popo, kumpipa’ sumkholna panin na pie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Keima, Kumpi Artaxerxes in Gungal gam sunga om sumkem zosie kungah tam bangin thu ka pie hi: Vantung Pasien Pa’ thukham lam a siem laithei, siempu Ezra in na tung vua ang nget poma,"},"22":{"text":"ngun talent zakhat, mangbu cor zakhat, lenggazu bath zakhat, sathau bath zakhat, le ci a dei zaza na pie ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Vantung Pasien’ thupieh popo, vantung Pasien’ biehinn adingin pawnthaw tahin kibawl ding hi. Tua ahi sihle kumpipa gamsung le a tapate tungah lungthahna ang tung ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Siempute, Levi-te, lasate, kotcingte, biehinn nasemte, ahi sihle tami Pasien’ biehinn sunga nasemte khat popo tung panin sieh le kaih ahi a, vanlah man ahi a, losap ahi zongin lah ding thu na nei lona uzong kang zasah hi, ka ci hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tua hi a, nang Ezra in na nei dinga ang kipie Pasien’ pilna tawh kizui-in, Gungal gam sunga a om na Pasien’ thukhamte a thei mi zosie tunga thu khen dingin ulien vaihawmte le thukhente koi in. Nang in Pasien’ thukham a thei lote na hil ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na Pasien’ thukham le kumpipa’ thukham a mang lo poma, sina ahi a, hawlkhietna ahi a, a neisate uh lahpiehna ahi a, thongkhiehna ahi zongin, khautahin thu kikhen ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem-a om Topa’ biehinn a thupi suo thei nadinga kumpipa’ lungtang sungah tam banga nate a guonpieh pa,"},"28":{"text":"kumpipa le a thu kuppite, le kumpipa’ mi thahat uliente mai-a itna kip tawh ei it, i pu i pate’ Pasien, Topa in thupha nga taheh. Keima tungah Topa ka Pasien’ khut ang op ziehin tha ka nga a, kei tawh a peito dingin Israel panin makaite ka khawm hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Artaxerxes a maan hun sungin Babylon pana ka peitopi innkuon lutangte le a khangsimna uh tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Ezra tawh A Kilekia Innkuon Lutangte"},"2":{"text":"Phinehas suonte pan Gershom ahi hi. Ithamar suonte pan Daniel ahi hi. David suonte pan Hattush,"},"3":{"text":"Shecaniah suonte pan Parosh-te Zechariah le ama tawh pasal zakhat le sawmnga a min kikhum hi."},"4":{"text":"Pahath-moab suonte pan Zerahiah’ tapa Elihoenai le ama tawh pasal zani ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Zattu suonte pan Jahaziel’ tapa Shecaniah, le ama tawh pasal zathum ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Adin suonte pan Jonathan’ tapa Ebed, le ama tawh pasal sawmnga ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Elam-te suon pan Athaliah’ tapa Jeshaiah, ama tawh pasal sawm sagi ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Shephatiah suonte pan Michael’ tapa Zebadaih, le ama tawh pasal sawmgiet ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Joab suonte pan Jehiel’ tapa Obadiah, le ama tawh pasal zani le sawm le giet ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Bani suonte pan Josiphiah’ tapa Shelomit, le ama tawh pasal za le sawmguh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Bebai suonte pan Bebai’ tapa Zechariah, le ama tawh pasal sawmni le giet ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Azgad suonte pan Hakkatan’ tapa Johanan, le ama tawh pasal za le sawmkhat ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Adonikam suonte pan ang nuapeite, a min uh Eliphelet, Jeuel, le Shemaiah le ama tawh pasal sawmguh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Bigvai suonte Uthai le Zaccur amate tawh pasal sawm sagi ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in Ahava gam lama a luong lui gei khatah amate ka khawmtuo a, khum sungah ni thum sung phuol ka sat uhi. Mite le siempute ka etphat ciengin tua munah Levi’ suonte khat zong ka mu sih hi.","title":"Biehinn ading Nasemte"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, le Meshullam-te, le mipil Joiarib le Elnathan-te ka hlansah a,"},"17":{"text":"Casiphia a kici muna a makaipa Iddo kungah amate va pei-in Iddo kung le Casiphia-a a septonpi uh biehinn nasemte kungah i Pasien uh’ biehinn sungah nasem ding mi ang puoh nadingun a gen dingin amate ka sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Hepina a nei i Pasien in ei ompi ahi ziehin Levi-te Mahli suonte panin thu ngaisut a siem Sherebiah, a tate le a hieng a sante tawh pasal sawm le giet;"},"19":{"text":"le Merari suonte pan Jesaiah, a hieng a sante le a tate mi sawm le ni le Hashabiah tawh zong;"},"20":{"text":"tua banah David le ama’ uliente in Levi-te’ na sem dinga a tuomkoi uh biehinn nasem zani le sawmni ang puoh uhi. Amate a unpi-un a min ciet utawh kihlan hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin eite’ Pasien mai-ah ko le ko kingielin, ko le ka naupangte ule ka neisa zosie uh dam le bitin ama tungah khuolzinna khat ka nei thei nading vua ka nget thei nadingun keima in Ahava lui-ah antan nading thu ka tangko hi.","title":"Kidal Nadingin Antanna le Thungetna"},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kumpipa kungah ka Pasien un ama a suite zosie hepi a, a hi vangin ama a nuasie zosiete tungah a zauhuoi a lungthahna tungsah hi, ka na cisa uh ahi ziehin lampi-ah kote ei hun dingin galkapte le sakol galkapte ama kunga ka nget ding ka mai a zum hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka Pasien uh tungah tami adingin antangin ka ngen vua, ama in ka thum ka tauna uh ei ngaipieh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin a makai siempute sawm le ni ka tuomkoi hi: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, le amate tawh a hieng a san uh mi sawm ahi uhi.","title":"Biehinn ading Letsongte"},"25":{"text":"Tuale keima in i Pasien uh’ inn dinga kumpipa le a thu kuppite, a tote ule tua muna om Israel mi zosie in a pieh ngun le kham le vanzahte, amate adingin ka tepieh hi;"},"26":{"text":"keima in a khut sung vuah ngun talent zaguh le sawmnga, le ngun tawh kibawl vanzahte zakhat man ... talent-te, le kham talent zakhat,"},"27":{"text":"darics tulkhat man kham kuongkum sawmni, le kham banga a manpha a kitaival sumsan hoi tawh kibawl beel ni ka tepieh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuale keima in amate kungah, “Note Topa adingin na siengtho vua, vanzahte zong a siengtho hi; tuale ngun le khamte khu na pu na pate uh’ Pasien ahi Topa tunga kipie nopthu-a biehna ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Jerusalem-a om Topa’ biehinn dan sunga siempu liente, Levi-te, le Israel innkuon lutangte mai-ah na tepieh masangsie uh tuate vilin kemcing un,” ka ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempute le Levi-te in Jerusalem-a om i Pasien’ biehinn sunga puoh dinga a kitesa ngun le kham le vanzahte a sang uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerusalem zuon dingin hla masa a ni sawm le ni ni-in Ahava gun panin ka dingkhie uhi; ka Pasien un ei na panpi a, lam kalah galte le ei na buhdap a tuomtuomte’ khut sung panin ei na hunkhie hi.","title":"Jerusalem-ah Kilekiana"},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem-ah ka tung vua, tua munah ni thum sung ka taam uhi."},"33":{"text":"A ni li ni-in ka Pasien uh’ inn sunga Uriah’ tapa siempu Meremoth khut sungah ngun le kham, le vanzahte kite a, tuale ama tawh Phinehas’ tapa Eleazar a om vua, ama gel tawh Levi-te Jeshua’ tapa Jozabad le Binnui’ tapa Noadiah zong a om uhi."},"34":{"text":"A unpi-in kisimin kite a, tua na zosie’ a gihna kiciemte hi."},"35":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin saltanna pana ang kilekiate in Israel zosie ading Israel’ Pasien tungah meihal biehna dingin bawngtang sawm le ni, tuutang sawmkuo le guh, tuuno sawmsagi le sagi, le mawna zieha biehna dingin keeltang sawm le ni a pie uhi; tam teng zosie pen Topa kunga kipie meihal biehna ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in Gungal gam a uhte le kumpipa’ khut nei-a thunei vaihawmte tungah kumpipa sawlnate a gen uhi; tuale amate in mite le Pasien’ biehinn lam nasep a hu uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thu teng a kisep zaw ciengin uliente in keima kungah ei nai vua, “Israel mite, siempute, le Levi-te in khum gama mipi kidah ahi Canaan-te, Hit-te, Perez-te, Jebus-te, Ammon-te, Moab-te, Egypt-te, le Amor-te kung panin amau le amau a kituomkoih sih uhi.","title":"Namdangte tawh Kinunna Kimawsah"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen amahaw’ tanute pawlkhat amate ding le a tapate vua dingin zi-in a la vua, tua bangin a siengtho cihlahte pen tua gam sung mite tawh a kisisawhal ta vua, tami citah lona-ah uliente le lamkaite makai ahi hi,” ei ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tami thu ka zah bepin ka puonte balkehin ka sam le ka khamul ka bot a, ci ding mel thei loin ka mawh to hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin saltang kilekiate’ citah lona ziehin Israel Pasien’ thugen a zau-in a citun zosie keima kungah ang kikhawm vua, nitah biehpiehna hun dongin ci nading mel thei loin ka mawh to hi."},"5":{"text":"Nitah biehpieh hunin ka antanna pana ka sil ka puontuol kibalkeh kawm pi-in tho-in ka khupdin a, Topa Pasien lamah ka khut ka zah a,","title":"Ezra’ Thungetna"},"6":{"text":"tuale, “Ka Pasien aw, ka khielnate uh ka lu uh sangin sang zaw a, ka mawnate un vantung dong banto ta ahi ziehin ka zum sengin kang mai ngat ngam sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh’ khanga patin tuni dong ka khielna uh lien mama hi. Ka khielnate ziehun gamdang kumpite’ khut sungah kote, ka kumpite ule ka siempute uh kipie-in, namsau tawh sina, saltanna, neisa kisutna, le maizumna ci bangin ka na thuoh vua, tu dongin ka tuaci lai uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu bano khat sungin Topa ka Pasien un kote ei angvan a, a suohta pawlkhat ei omsahin ama in ka mit uh ei vahsah a, ka saltanna vuah husanna themno khat ei pieh thei nadingin a mun siengtho sungah pansia det khat ei pie zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen kote sila ka hi vua, hinanle ka saltanna vuah ka Pasien un ei nuasie loin ka Pasien uh’ biehinn a dinkia nading, a kisie teng a kipuophat nading, Judah le Jerusalem ah kulpite ei pieh thei nading, le hinkhuo tha ei pieh thei nadingin ama in Persia kumpite’ mai-ah a itna kip ei pie zo hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tuale tu-in kote’ Pasien aw, tam zaw ciengin bang gen nawn ding uh ka hei? Bangzieh ahei cile na thupiehnate ka taisan ta vua,"},"11":{"text":"na nasem kamsangte tungtawnin kote kungah, ‘Na luo ding vua na va lut nading uh gam pen a gam mite in a kidahhuoi amau’ gamtatna tawh a buasah uh a sieng lo gam ahi hi. A gam sung uh mong khat pan mong khat dongin amau’ sientho lona tawh a kidimsah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a tanute ule na tapate uh kinungsah sih unlen, na tapate’ uh zi dingin a tanute la sih un. A nopsahna ding uh hile, a maavan nading uh hile hasui pieh sih un. Tua bang hi leh thahatin tua gam sunga a piengte na ne ding vua, kum tawna na tate uh’ luo dingin tua gam na nuasie pieh thei ding uhi,’ ci-a nei thupiehnate ka zui sih uhi.","ref":"Pei 34:11-16; Thkna 7:1-5"},"13":{"text":"Ka sil hoilo bawlte ule a lien mama ka khielnate uh ziehin tam bang gimna zosie ka tung vua ang tun zaw ciengin, ka Pasien un ka thuoh ding vua a kilawm kohaw’ mawna paat sanga a tawmzaw gimna nei thuohsah a, a suohta le a omlai teng tam bangin themkhatin nei koi hi;"},"14":{"text":"na thupiehnate kote in palsatkia-in, tami a kidahhuoi nate a bawl mite tawh kiteng kipikia ding ka hi uh amah? A omlai le a suohta koima a op nawn lo dongin ka tung vuah nang hing lungthahin ei susie lo ding na mah?"},"15":{"text":"Israel Pasien, Topa aw, nang khu na thutang a, ahi vangin tu-a bangin a suohta a omlai dingin kote nei bawl hi. Tami ziehin koima in nang ang maingat ngam lo vangin na mai-ah ka khielna pi ma utawh kang ding uhi,” ci-in thu ka ngen hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ezra in Pasien’ biehinn mai-ah thu ngen a, a mawna pulahin kap le mau-in tuolah a kilawmlia laitahin, ama kungah Israel panin numei, pasal, naupang tampitah a kikhawm vua, nahpitahin mite a kap uhi.","title":"Mite’ Dawnkiana"},"2":{"text":"Elam suonte panin Jehiel’ tapa Shecaniah kungah, “Eite in i Pasien uh i um nawn sih vua, gam sunga a teng gamdang numeite tawh i kinung zo uhi. Hinanle tu nangawnin Israel adingin kinepna a om lai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n tu-in, ka pu uh nangma’ ngaisutna le i Pasien’ thupiehna a zatah mite’ ngaisutna bangin tami zite le a tate uh i peisah nadingin i Pasien utawh thuciemna khat bawl va vui; tuale thukham tawh kituohin sem va vui."},"4":{"text":"Kipan pai in, bangzieh ahei cile tam pen nang nasep ahi hi, nang kang ompi ding uhi; hang inlen sem in,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ezra dingin a kigensa banga a gamtat nadingun siempu makaite, Levi-te, le Israel zosie a sawl hi. Tuaci’n amate a kiciem uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ biehinn mai panin Ezra kihemkhie a, tuale Eliashib’ tapa Jehohanan inndan sungah pei-in a gieh hi. Saltangte’ tahtai lona ziehin an ne lo tui dawn loin da le mau-in a om hi.","title":"Gamdang Zite Le a Tate Kinuol"},"7":{"text":"Amate in a kinuale saltangte zosie Jerusalem ah a kikhop thei nadingun Judah le Jerusalem mun zosie-ah tangtawhna khat a bawl vua,"},"8":{"text":"ni thum sunga a tung lo khatpo a op leh uliente le upate’ thupieh dung zui-in a neisa zosie uh kiman ding a, amate mama in saltang mihonte lah panin hawlkhie ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah le Benjamin mi zosie ni thum sungin Jerusalem ah a kituo uhi; tua khu a hla kuona a ni sawmni ni ahi hi. Guo a hazuh seng zieh le tami thu ziehin mi zosie citunin Pasien’ biehinn mai leituolah a to uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu Ezra dingto-in amate kungah, “Note na tawnkhiel vua, gamdang numeite zi-in la-in Israel’ khielna na khangsah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh’ Pasien ahi Topa tungah tu-in na mawnate uh pulah unlen, ama’ dei bangin bawl un; tam gama a teng gamdang mite le gamdang mi ahi na zite utawh kikhenin tuom om ta un,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm mi zosie kiko-in a dawng vua, “A hima hi; na gen bangin ka bawl ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi tampi i hi vua, guo tam hun zong ahi hi; kote a pulamah ka ding zo nawn sih uhi. Tami thu-ah eite tampi na tawnkhiel zo i hi ziehin tami nasep pen ni khat, ahi sihle ni ni sunga kizo thei ding thu ahi sih hi."},"14":{"text":"A kikhawm mihon bup ai-in ka uliente uh semsah in. Tami thu ziehin eite tung panin Pasien’ lungthahna a kihei dawh masangsie, i khuopi zosie-a om gamdang numeite tawh a kinung mi zosie in a khuo sung upate le thukhente ciet tawh a kise hunin i makaite kungah va pei ta uheh,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Asahiel’ tapa Jonathan le Tikvah’ tapa Jahzeiah beh in tami thu nielin Meshullam le Levi-te Shabbethai in panpi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin saltang a kilekiate in a kigensa bangin a bawl uhi. Siempu Ezra in a innkuon utawh kizui-in a innkuon lutangte uh sung panin pasalte a teng vua, amau’ min ciet tawh kiciemte hi. A hla sawmna a ni khat ni-in tua thu a kantel dingin amate a to uhi."},"17":{"text":"A hla masa a ni khat ni-in gamdang zi nei pasal zosie’ thu a kan uh a zo sieng uhi."},"18":{"text":"Siempute suon panin Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua suonte le a sanggamte’ suonte sung panin gamdang numeite tawh a kinung tam teng kimu hi: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, le Gedaliah-te ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"A zite uh khul dingin amau le amau a kikamciem vua, a khielna zieh vua biehna dingin tuuhon lahah tuutang khat a peipi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Immer suonte sung panin Hanani le Zebadiah ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Harim suonte sung panin Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, le Uzziah-te ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pashhur suonte sung panin Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad le Elasah-te ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Levi-te sung panin Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (Kelita a kici), Pethahiah, Judah, le Eliezer-te ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Lasate sung panin Eliashib ahi uhi. Kotcingte sung panin Shallum, Telem, le Uri-te ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Israel-te sung Parosh suonte panin Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, le Benaiah-te ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Elam suonte panin Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, le Elijah-te ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Zattu suonte sung panin Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, le Aziza-te ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Bebai suonte sung panin Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, le Athlai-te ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Bani suonte panin Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, le Jeremoth-te ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Pahath-moab suonte sung panin Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, le Manasseh-te ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Harim suonte panin Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,"},"32":{"text":"Benjamnin, Malluch, le Shemariah-te ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hashum suonte panin Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, le Shimei-te ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Bani suonte sung panin Maadai, Amtam, Uel,"},"35":{"text":"Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,"},"36":{"text":"Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,"},"37":{"text":"Mattaniah, Mattenai, le Jaasu-te ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Binnui suonte sung panin Shimei,"},"39":{"text":"Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,"},"40":{"text":"Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,"},"41":{"text":"Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,"},"42":{"text":"Shallum, Amariah, le Joseph-te ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Nebo suonte sung panin Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, le Benaiah-te ahi uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tam teng zosie gamdang zi nei ahi vua, tuaci’n amate in a zite uh a tate utawh a khultha uhi."}}}}},"16":{"info":{"name":"Nehemiah","shortname":"Neh","abbr":[],"desc":"Nehemiah laibu (the book of nehemiah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hacaliah’ tapa Nehemiah’ thugen tam bang ahi hi. A kum sawmnina Chislev hla sungin kumpi khuopi Susa-a ka op lai tahin,","title":"A Mite Adingin Nehemiah in Thungen"},"2":{"text":"Judah pana pasal pawlkhat tawh ka sanggamte khat ahi Hananiah ang tung a, tuale keima in amate kungah sala kiman lo a hinglai Judah mite thu le Jerusalem thu ka dong hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in, “Sala kiman lo tua gam sunga a omsuohte in gentheina lienpi le maizumna a thuoh uhi; Jerusalem kulpi kicim gawp a, a tunkotte zong mei in katum zo hi, “ci-in ang gen uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua thu ka zah ciengin tosuhin ka kap a, ni tampi sung kap le mau-in vantung Pasien kungah antangin thu ka ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in, “Aw Topa , Vantung Pasien, nang ang it a, na thupiehnate a zui mite tungah thuciemna limtaha a zui, a lien le a giinhuoi Pasien aw;"},"6":{"text":"sun le zanin na nasem Israel mite adinga kang thungetna a ngai dingin na bil ei ngat inlen, na mit hing hahsah in. Keima le ka innkuonpite-a kipan ko Israel mite in na tunga kang bawlsa uh mawnate kang pulah hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma tungah nahpitahin kang khiel kha ta vua, na nasempa Moses tunga na thupiehnate, thukhamte, le ngaina kipte ka zui ta sih uhi"},"8":{"text":"Na nasempa Moses tungah, ‘Nohaw na muonhuoi sih uleh mite lahah kang thezah ding hi;","ref":"Siem 26:33"},"9":{"text":"hizongle ka kunga nang kilekia vua, ka thupiehnate na zui uleh, a gamla pen leimong dongah nawdawhin om nan locin, keima in khum panin kang kaikhawmkia ding a, ka min om nadinga ka teelsa munah note kang zawpi ding hi,’ ci-a na thugen hing phawhkia bo in.","ref":"Thkna 30:1-5"},"10":{"text":"Amate pen nangma’ vanglietna le a thahat nangma’ khut tawh na tatkhietsa nangma’ nasemte le nangma’ mite ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasempa’ ang thumna le na min a zatah nuom na nasemte’ thumna na bil hing daw in. Tuni-in na nasempa tungah guolzawna ei pie inlen, tam mipa muna-ah hepina ei pie bo in!” ci-in thu ka ngen hi. Khum hunin kei pen kumpipa’ hai tawipa ka hi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Artaxerxes in a uh zaw a kum sawmnina Nisan hla-in, lenggazu pieh ding hun ciengin lenggazu tawi-in kumpipa ka pie hi. Ni dangin ama mai-ah damai-in ka om ngai sih hi.","title":"Judah ah Nehemiah Kisawl"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in keima kungah, “A cina lah hi lo bang dinga damai na hei? Na dana khat om hi ngel ding hi,” ei ci hi. Tua ciengin zau citahin ka zau hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa hing denden in! Ka pu ka pate kivuina han opna mun ahi khuopi kisie-in a tunkotte zong mei in katum sieng ta ahi ziehin damai lo-in bangci op thei ding ka hei?” ka ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:8-10; 2Khg 36:19; Jer 52:12-14"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in keima kungah, “Bang ngen nuom na hei?” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n keima in vantung Pasien kungah thu ka ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa na lung a kim a, na nasempa in na maipha ka mu khah leh, ka pu ka pate’ han opna khuopi ka va lamkia thei nadingin Judah gamah ei hawsah in,” ci-in ka ngen hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa in (kumpinu zong a gei-ah a to hi) keima kungah, “Pei lacin bang tanvei va tham ding a, bang huna hing kilekia ding na hei?” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n kumpipa in ka pei ding ei lungkimpi a, kei zong hun khat ka se hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa na thukim leh, Judah gam ka tun masangsie amate in ei peisah thei nadingun Gungal gamkhen a uhte ka pieh ding laihlahte ei puosah in;"},"8":{"text":"tuale kumpipa’ gammang tulah kempa Asaph in biehinn kulpi tunkot zawlte, khuopi kul le keima’ inn lam nading sing ei pieh nadingin thupiehna lai zong ei puosah in,” ka ci hi. Keima tungah hepi siem ka Pasien’ khut om ahi ziehin kumpipa in ka nget teng ei pie hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gungal gamkhen a uhte kungah ka tung a, keima in kumpipa’ laihlahte amate ka pie hi. Kumpipa in galkapmangte le sakol galkapte kei ei hlasah hi."},"10":{"text":"Horon-te le Sanballat le Ammon milien Tobiah-te in Israel mite’ phattuomna sem dingin mi khat ang pei hi, ci thu a zah ciengun nahpitahin lungkim lo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalam ah ka tung a, ni thum sung ka tam hi.","title":"Nehemiah in Kulte Vaan"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin zanin keima le ka zawpi mi tawmno khatte tawh ka tho hi; Jerusalem adinga ka bawlpieh ding ka Pasien in ka lungsim sunga ei guot thute koima kungah ka gen vawt sih hi. Keima tuonna ganhing sim lo ganhing dang ka zawpi sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Zanin Kuom Tunkot panin pusuohin Gulpi Tuikhuh le Buathah Tunkot lamah ka pei a, a kicimsa Jerusalem kulpi teng le mei in a kahtumsa a tunkotte ka va en ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tuinah Tunkot le Kumpipa’ Buol dong ka peisuoh hi; ahi vangin ka tuonna ganhing pei thei nading mun a om sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n kuom lampi tawnin zan lai-in khuopi kul ka vel hi. Tua ciengin ka kinuahei a, Kuom Tunkot ah lutin ka kilekia hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei hei-ah pei-in bang teng bawl ka hei, ci uliente in ei thei sih uhi; keima in na sem dingte ahi Jews-te, siempute, mi thupite, uliente le adangte kungah ka vai ka gen nai sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah, “Tam mun a i lungkhamna thu na thei uhi. Jerusalem a kisusie ta a, a tunkotte zong mei in a katum ta hi. Hing pei un, zakona i thuoh nawn lo nadingin Jerusalem kulpi ciengpha kia vai,” ka ci hi.","title":"Kulpi Cienkia nading Thukhensatna"},"18":{"text":"Keima in ka tunga ka Pasien in ang bawl hepina le kumpipa in ka tunga ang gen thute amate kungah ka gen hi. Tua ciengin amate in, “Nasep kipan pai vai!” ei ci uhi. Tuaci’n amate zong tangpi phattuomna dingin a kipumpieh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hizongle Horon-te Sanballat, Ammon milien Tobiah, le Arab-te Geshem in tua thu a zah ciengun amate in, “Tami na sil bawl uh bang ahei? Kumpipa ledo sawm na hi uh amah?” ci-in simmawna tawh ei ehneh ho uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in amate kungah, “Lawcinna ei guon ding pen vantung Pasien ahi a, tuale ko ama’ nasemte in nasep ka kipan ta ding uhi; hinanle note in Jerusalem ah tanh ahi a, nget ding ahi a, tangthu lam panin ahi zongin nga ding hamphatna bangma na nei sih uhi,” ci-in ka dawngkia hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa Eliashib in a siempu seppite tawh Tuu Tunkot a bawlpha uhi. Amate in siensuo-in a kotkhahte a bul vua, Zakhat Tausang cieng dong le Hananel Tausang cieng dong a siensuo uhi.","title":"Nasepna Ding Geelna"},"2":{"text":"Tuale ama’ zomah Jericho mite in lam uhi. Amate zaw ciengin Imri’ tapa Zaccur in lam hi."},"3":{"text":"Hassenaah’ tapate in Nga Tunkot a lam uhi; amate in a zawlte a hlung vua, tuale a kotkhahte, a kotgolhte a siatunte a bul uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ zomah Hakkoz’ tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in puo hi. Amate zaw ciengin Meshezabel, a tapa Meshullam in puo hi. Amate zaw ciengin Banna’ tapa Zadok in puo hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate zomah Tekoa-te in a puo uhi; ahi vangin a Topa uh’ nasepna-ah a miliente uh a hapan nuom sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tunkot Lui pen Paseah’ tapa Joiada, le Besodeiah’ tapa Meshullam in a puo uhi; amate in a zawlte a hlung vua, a kotkhahte, a kotgolhte, le a siatunte a bul uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate zomah Gibeon-te Melatiah le Meronoth-te Jadon in Gungal gamkhen a uhpa’ thuneina sunga a om Gibeon-te le Mizpah-te tawh a puo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate zomah khamkhengte khat ahi Harhaiah’ tapa Uzziel in puo hi. Ama zomah sathau namtui bawlte khat ahi Hananiah in puo hi; tuale amate in Kulpi Lien dongin Jerusalem a ngai a bangsah kia uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amahaw zomah Jerusalem gam phalkhat a uh Hur’ tapa Rephaiah in puo hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate zomah Harumaph’ tapa Jedaiah in ama’ inn tawh kimaingat son teng puo hi; tuale ama zomah Hashabneiah’ tapa Hattush in puo hi."},"11":{"text":"Harim’ tapa Malchijah le Pahath-moab’ tapa Hasshub in Meikhuh Tausang le khawh dang khat puo uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama zomah Jerusalem phalkhat a uh Hallohesh’ tapa Shallum le a tanute in puo uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hanun le Zanoah-a tengte in Kuom Tunkot a puo uhi; amahawn a zawlte a hlung vua, a kotkhahte, a kotgolhte, le a siatunte a bul uhi, tuale kulpi tong tulkhat sung Buathah Tunkot dong a puo uhi."},"14":{"text":"Beth-haccherem gam phalkhat a uh Rechab’ tapa Malchijah in Buathah Tunkot puo hi; ama in a kotkhahte, a kotgolhte, le a siatunte a bawlphakia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale Mizpah gam a uh Col-hozeh’ tapa Shallum in Tuinah Tunkot puo hi; ama in tua tunkot bawlpha a, a tung khu-in a kotkhahte, a kotgolhte, le a siatunte bul hi; tuale ama in kumpipa’ um sunga om Shelah buol kulpi zong David’ khuopi pana kidawsuh kalei dongin bawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama zomah Beth-zur gam phal langkhat a uh Azbuk’ tapa Nehemiah in David’ han tawh a kimaingat mun panin a kisiemthu tuikhuh le galhangte’ inn dong a puo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama zomah a puo Levi mite: Bani’ tapa Rehum; ama zomah Keilah gam phal langkhat a uh Hashabiah in ama’ gam tangin a puo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama zomah a puo a unaute: Keilah gam phal langkhat a uh Henadad’ tapa Binnui;"},"19":{"text":"ama zomah Mizpah uhpa Jeshua’ tapa Ezer in Kulning-a galvan kikoina katona tawh a kimaingat khawh dang khat puo uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama zomah Zabbai’ tapa Baruch in Kulning panin siempu lien pa Eliashib’ inn kotkhah dong puo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama zomah Hakkoz’ tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in Eliashib’ inn kotkhah panin innmong dong puo hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama zomah a kim a pam-a om siempute in puo uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amate zaw ciengin Benjamin le Hasshub in ama gel’ inn tawh a kimaingat teng puo uhi. Ama gel zaw ciengin Ananiah’ tapa Masseiah, a tapa Azariah in a inn tawh a kimaingat teng a puo hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin Henadad’ tapa Binnui in mun tuomdang khat, Azariah’ inn panin Kulning dong puo hi."},"25":{"text":"Uzai’ tapa Palal in Kulning tawh a kigalsaina mun teng le kumpipa’ inn pana a dawhkhie, zumcingte’ opna tausang tungnung teng puo hi. Ama zomah Parosh’ tapa Pedaiah in puo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ophel tunga a teng biehinn nasemte in ni suona lam, Tui Tunkot tawh a kimaingat teng le tausang dawh puo uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ama banah Tekoa-te in tausang dawhpi tawh a kimaingat teng le Ophel kulpi dong puo uhi."},"28":{"text":"Sakol Tunkot tung son teng ahile siempute in a inn ciet utawh a kimaingat teng a puo uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amahaw zomah Immer’ tapa Zadok in ama’ inn tawh a kimaingat son teng puo hi. Ama zomah Shecaniah’ tapa, Nisuona Kotcingpa Shemaiah in a puo hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama zomah Shelemiah’ tapa Hannaniah, Zalaph’ tapa guhna Hanun in khawh dang khat a puo uhi. Ama zomah Berechiah’ tapa Meshullam in ama’ lupna khan tawh a kimaingat son teng puo hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama zaw ciengin khamkhengte khat ahi Machijah in biehinn nasemte’ inn le sumbawlte’ inn cieng, le Kikhopna Tunkot tawh a kimaingat son teng, le Kulning inndan tungnung cieng dong puo hi."},"32":{"text":"Kulning inndan tungnung le Tuu Tunkot kikal pen khamkhengte le sumbawlte in puo uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in ka kulpi cien lam uh Sanballat in a zah ciengin lungthah mama a, ama in Jews-te a zako gawp hi.","title":"Galte’ Sawmdapna Kikhahtan"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ama’ kithuopite le Samaria galkapte mai-ah, “Tua Jew miginalote bang bawl uh ahei? Amate in nate a puophat sawm uh amah? Biehpiehna bawl ding ahi uh amah? Ni khat thu-in a man zo ding uh amah? Buathah lom lah panin a kavamsa suongte la-in puokia ding ahi uh amah?” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ gei-a om Ammon-te Tobiah in, “A cien uh suongte tungah ngie khatpo kato leh cimsuh pai lel ven!” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote’ Pasien aw, ei ngai in; azieh pen kote ei kisimmaw hi; amau’ ei kosietna teng amau’ lutung ma-ah tusah inlen, saltanna gam khatah mite’ tomgam dingin amate piedawh ta’n."},"5":{"text":"Amau’ khielna khupieh sinlen, na muna panin amau’ mawna phietmang sin; bangzieh ahei cile amate in kulciengte mai-ah kote ei zako uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n kote in kulpi ka ciengpha kia vua, tuale kulpi buppi’ a sanna alang cieng kizo hi; azieh pen mite in kinna lungsim a nei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Sanballat, Tobiah, le Arab-te, Ammon-te, le Ashdod-te in Jerusalem kulpite cienphatna nasep kizom suohin, kulvang teng huhbih ding kipan zo hi, ci a zah ciengun a lungthah mama uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un a kuon vua, tuale Jerusalem simin a sungah a buoisah sawm uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n kohawn zong ka Pasien uh kungah thu ka ngen vua, amate a dal dingin sun le zanin galvil ka koi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Judah in, “Van puo mite a tha uh a zaw gawp ta hi, buathah lah a tam ta mama a, tuaci’n kote in kulpi ka cieng zo nawn sih uhi,” ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale ka galte un, “A thei lo kalun ei mu masangun amate kungah va pei-in i va that ta ding a, a nasep uh i dinkhawlsah ding hi,” ei ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amau’ gei-a teng Jew mite ang pei ciengun amate in ko kungah, “Kote ei sim dingin a tenna uh mun zosie panin ang kuonto ding uhi,” ci-in sawmvei vilvel ei gen uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in kulpi nualam mun ngiem penna mun-awng tengah a namsau uh, a teipi ule a thal utawh a innkuon kuonun ka pangsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng ka van zaw ciengin mi thupite, uliente le a omlai mite kungah, “Amahaw giing sih un. Na sanggamte, na tapate, na tanute, na zite ule na innte uh adinga ang do pieh, a lien le a giinhuoi Topa phawh un,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka galte’ ei sawmna teng kote in ka thei lam ule Pasien in amau’ gelna teng a susiet zo lam amate in a zah ciengun, ka unpi-un ka nasepna uh kulpi cietah ka kuonkia uhi."},"16":{"text":"Khum ni-a kipanin ka nasemte alang in na semin, alang in teipite, lumte, thalpite, le awmdalte a tawi uhi; tuale Judah innkuon buppi’ nua-ah makaite a pang uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kulpi-a cien ding van a nawn mite in a khut langkhat utawh a van puoh uh tu-in a khut langkhat utawh galhiem a tawi vua, tua bangin na a sem uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale innlamte in a nasep pumun a kawng vuah namsau a kuo uhi. Ka gei-ah pengkul mut pa a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale keima in mi thupite, uliente, le adang mite kungah, “Nasepna lienin zaipi tah a huom a, kulpi tungah eite khatlekhat kikhenin gamlapi i kihal uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n pengkul aw na zah ciengun ka kungah hing kikhawm un. I Pasien in eihaw adingin gal ei dopieh ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n na ka sem vua, amate alang in phalvah panin aasi suo dongin teipi a tawi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Khum hunin keima in zong mite kungah, “Zanin galvilin sunin na a sep thei nadingun mi zosie a nasemte ciet utawh Jerusalem ah hing gieh ta un,” ka ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima hileng, ka sanggamte hile, ka nasemte hile, ka nua ei zuite keima ei cingte in hile, ka puon uh ka suo man ngai sih uhi; mi khat cietin a khut ziet lamah a galhiem a tawi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in mite le a zite un a unau uh Judah mite tungah lungkim lona lienpi khat a gingsah uhi.","title":"Nehemiah in Kibawlsietna Vaan"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen mi pawlkhat in, “Ka tanute ule ka tapate utawh ka kunta mama uhi; kote in an ne-in ka hin thei nadingun an ka sui uh kul hi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Pawlkhat in zong, “Kote in kiel hun sungin an lei nadingin ka lote uh, ka lengga umte ule ka innte uh vankhapin ka pieh uh kul ding hi,” ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale mi pawlkhatte in, “Kumpipa’ sieh pieh dingin ka lote ule ka lengga umte uh khamin sum ka palah uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ko pen ka unaute utawh si khat sa khat ka hi uhi; ka tate uzong amau’ tate ma bang ahi uhi; hinanle ka tapate ule ka tanute uh nuom lopipi-in sal dingin ka pausawl mawh vua, tuale ka tanute uh pawlkhat ei na kisuhthangpieh zo ta hi; ka lote ule ka lengga umte uh midangte’ neisa suoh ta ahi ziehin tuate tat nading bangma ka bawl zo sih uhi,” ei ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in a kikona ule tam bang phunnate ka zah ciengin ka lung thah mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in tam thu tungtang ka lungngai zaw ciengin, mi thupite le uliente ka mawsah hi; tuale keima in amate kungah, “Nohaw zosie in na unaute uh tungah sum met na la uhi,” ka ci hi. Tua thu teng kaituo nadingin keima in kikhopna thupi khat ka hlan a,","ref":"Pei 22:25; Siem 25:35-37; Thkna 23:19-20"},"8":{"text":"tuale amate kungah, “Minam dangte’ khut sungah sala kizuasa Judah i unaute i hi zawhna za utawh i tankia vua, hizongle tu-in note in na zua uh na mipite i tatkia lo uh a phamaw ahi hi!” ka ci hi. Gen ding thei loin amate a sip dide uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in, “Na sil bawl uh pen a hoi vawt sih hi. Eite in i galte ahi minam dangte’ zakona i thuoh lo nadingin i Pasien zatahna tawh na gamtat ding uh kilawm hi lo amah?"},"10":{"text":"Tua tham loin, keima le ka sanggamte, le ka nasemte in amate sum le an ka palahsah uhi. Tami a met lahna mawngmawng khawlsah va vui."},"11":{"text":"Tuni mama-in amate kung pana na lahpiehsa teng uh: a lo, a lengga um, olive um, a innte ule a met tawh na lah uh sum, an, lenggazu, le sathaute amate tungah piekia un,” ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Tua teng zosie ka piekia ding vua, amate kung panin bangma dang ka ngen nawn sih ding uhi. Na gen bangin ka gamta ding uhi,” ei ci uhi. Keima in siempute hlanin a ciemsa bangun a gamtat nadingun ka kiciemsah hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in zong ka puonte thingin, “Tam kamciem a pel poma a inn le a neisa panin Pasien in thingkhie taheh. Tua bangin amate kithingkhie dawh hinlen hawmsuoh taheh!” ka ci hi. A kikhawm zosie in, “Hi taheh,” ci-in Topa a phat uhi. Tuale a kamciemsa uh bangin mite a gamta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua tham loin Judah gam uhpa dinga ei kise hun a kipan, Kumpi Artaxerxes a maan a kum sawmnina panin sawmthum le nina dong, kum sawm le kum ni sung, keima le ka sanggamte in gam uhte’ nga ding ante ka ne sih uhi.","title":"Nehemiah’ Kiphalna"},"15":{"text":"Kei mai-a gam uhte’ na semte in mite tungah vangih a na suon vua, tuale ngun shekel sawmli banah amate tung panin an le lenggazu a na la uhi. Amau’ nasemte nangawn in mi tungah thu nei nuom lai vaset uhi. Hizongle keima in Pasien giing ka hi ziehin tua bangin ka gamta sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tami kulcienna-ah kei mama in ka sem a, leitang bangma ka la vawt sih hi; tuale na sem dingin ka nasemte zosie tua munah a kisutuo uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua tham loin kim le pam minamte kung pana ang peite sim lo, ka sabuoi-ah an a ne, Jew-te le uliente lahah mi za le sawmnga pha den hi."},"18":{"text":"Ni khat neh dingin bawngtang luong khat, a kituomteel tuu luong guh kigo hi; keima adingin aa-te zong kigo a, ni sawm a cin sielin savun um tampi dimin lenggazu kibawl hi; tua za-in tawp tama nanle keima in gam uhte’ nga ding anneh ka kal sih hi; azieh pen mipite genthei luo uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, keima in tam mite dinga ka bawlsa zosie keima dingin a hoi lamin ei phawh in."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in keima in kulpi ka cien zona thu le a vang khat zong a op nawn lona thu, Sanballat, Tobiah le Arab-te Geshem le ka galdangte zosie kungah a kigen ciengin, (khum hun laitahin tunkot tengah kotkhahte ka bul nai lo vangin)","title":"Galte’ Dapsawmna Kisusie"},"2":{"text":"Sanballat le Geshem in, “Hing pei inlen Ono zanglei-a khuoneu khatah kimutuo vai,” ci-in ei thuta uhi. Ahi vangin amate pen keima tunga sietna bawl sawm ahi bo uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate kungah kamtaite ka sawl a, “Nasep golpi ka sep laitah ahi ziehin kang peisuh thei sih hi. Note kunga kang peisuh kalin bang dingin nasep nuasie-in kikhawl ding ahei?” ka ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bangin li vei tah ei thuta vua, a masa bang ma-in ka dawngkia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin a ngaveina-ah Sanballat in keima kungah a nasempa hing sawlin ama’ khutah a kihongsa laihlah khat ang tawisah hi."},"6":{"text":"A laihlah sungah, “Minamte lahah a kigen- Geshem in zong ei gen thu in- nangma le Jew-te in nei ledo sawm uhi; tua ahi ziehin note in kulpi na cieng uhi; tuale tami thu a kigenna danah nangma zong amau’ kumpi sem nuom dan na hi mel hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma in, ‘Judah gamah kumpi khat om zo ta!’ ci-in nangma tawh kisai thu tangko dingin kamsangte zong na koi zo ta mel hi. Tuale tami kammalte dung zui-in kumpipa kunga thu kipuoh ding ahi ta hi.
