Tua ahi ziehin hing pei inlen kikumton vai,” ci-in kigiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in ama kungah, “Na gen bangin tua thute kibawl lo hi; tuate pen na lungsim sunga na mawh phuotawm ahi bo hi,” ci-in ka gensahkia hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen amate zosie in ei galgih nuom vua, “A nasep ban uh hing tuolkhieh va-un, sep loin hing om na va,” ci-in ngaituo uhi. Ahi vangin tu-in Pasien aw, ka khutte hing thahatsah in."},"10":{"text":"Ni khat, ama’ inn sunga a kulcip Mehetabel’ tapa Delaiah, a tapa Shemaiah kungah ka va haw ta leh ama in, “Pasien’ biehinnpi-a biehbuh sungah kikhawm tonin biehbuh kotte khah vai, azieh pen nangma that dingin amate ang pei ding uhi; nang ang that dingin tuzanin amate ang pei valon ding uhi,” ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in, “Mi kei bangte tai va nei ci tamawng amah? A hinna humbit dingin mi kei bangte biehinn sungah lut talawm va nei ci amah? Lut buong lo e!” ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuapa pen Pasien sawl na hi vawt loin, Sanballat le Tobiah-te in a thap zieh vua, keima lang khatah tua bang teng ang gen ahi lam ka mukhie hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in ei zausahin tam bangin gamta-in mawna ka bawl thei nading ngimna le, tuaci’n amate in keima ei galgih thei nadingun minsiet puomsiet ei tansah nop zieh vua ama na kiciel ahi bo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, amate in tam thu teng a bawl uh dung zui-in Tobiah le Sanballat, kamsang numei Noadiah le keima ei zausah nuom adang kamsangte na thei gige in,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Elul hla ni sawmni le ni nga ni-in kulpi bawl kizo a, ni sawmnga le ni ni sawt hi.","title":"Kulcien Kiman"},"16":{"text":"Ka galte zosie in tua thu a zah ciengun ka kimvel vua a om minamte zosie a zau vua, zong mai nei a kisa nawn sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile tami nasep pen ka Pasien uh’ panpina tawh a kimuolsuo ahi lam amate in a thei ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua banah khum hun lai-in Judah mithupite in Tobiah kungah lai tampi a na hlah vua, Tobiah’ laihlahte zong a na nga uhi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama pen Arah’ tapa Shecaniah’ mahpa hi a, Berechiah’ tapa Meshullam’ tanu tawh a tapa Jehohanan a kinun ziehin ama tawh Judah gama mi tampite kiciemin a kipawl uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in a silbawl hoite zong ka mai-ah ang gen vua, keima gen teng zong ama kungah a na tut uhi. Tuale Tobiah in ka zau theithei nadingin keima tungah lai tampi ei hlah hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in kulcien kiman siengin kotkhahte ka bul zo ta a, tunkotcingte, lasate, le Levi-te nasep a kiguot zaw ciengin"},"2":{"text":"keima in Jerusalem a kem dingin ka sanggampa Hanani tawh kulpi a uhpa Hananiah ka seton hi, azieh pen ama midang tampite sanga a muonhuoizaw le Pasien a giingzaw khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale keima in ama gel kungah, “Ni a sat laisie Jerusalem tunkotte kihong lo ding hi; tunkot cingte in a cin laitahin tuate khahsah inlen, kotte golhsah un. Jerusalem-a tengte lah panin galvil ding se unlen, pawlkhat a galvilna mun vuah, pawlkhatte amau’ inn mai cietah pangsah un,” ci-in ka gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuopi golin zai a, ahi vangin a sunga teng mi tawmin innte kilam nai lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin khanggui ciemtena bangin mithupite, uliente le mite kaikhawmin a min uh khum ding Pasien in ka lungsim sungah ang suohsah hi. Tuale keima in ang kilekia masate’ khanggui ciemtena laibu ka mu a, khum sunga na kigiel ka mute tam bang teng ahi hi:","title":"A Kilekia Saltangte Sazien (Ezr 2:1-70)"},"6":{"text":"Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in suoh le sal-a a peipina mun panin gam sunga hing peito mite tam teng ahi uhi; amate in Jerusalem le Judah gam sung a khuo ciet zuonin a kilekia uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah-te tawh peiton uhi. Israel-te a mi phaza pen:"},"8":{"text":"Parosh suonte, mi tulni zakhat le sawm sagi le ni ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Shephatiah suonte, mi zathum sawmsagi le ni ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Arah suonte, mi zaguh sawmnga le ni ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pahath-moab suonte sung panin, Jeshua le Joab suonte, mi tulni zagiet le sawm le giet ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Elam suonte, mi tulkhat zani sawmnga le li ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Zattu suonte, mi zagiet sawmli le nga ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Zaccai suonte, mi zasagi sawmguh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Binnui suonte, mi zaguh sawmli le giet ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Bebai suonte, mi zaguh sawmni le giet ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Azgad suonte, mi tulni zathum sawmni le ni ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Adonikam suonte, mi zaguh sawmguh le sagi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Bigvai suonte, mi tulni sawmguh le sagi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Adin suonte, mi zaguh sawmnga le nga ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ater a kici Hezekiah’ suonte, mi sawmkuo le giet ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hashum suonte, mi zathum sawmni le giet ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Bezai suonte, mi zathum sawmni le li ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Hariph suonte, mi zakhat sawm le ni ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Gibeon suonte, mi sawmkuo le nga ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Bethlehem le Netophah-te, mi zakhat sawmgiet le giet ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Anathoth-te, mi zakhat sawmni le giet ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Beth-azmaveth-te, mi sawmli le ni ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, le Beeroth-te, mi zasagi sawmli le thum ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ramah le Gaba-te, mi zaguh sawmni le khat ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Michmash-te, mi zakhat sawmni le ni ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Bethel le Ai-te, mi zakhat sawmni le thum ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Nebo adang khat-te, mi sawmnga le ni ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Elam adang khat-te, mi tulkhat zani sawmnga le li ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Harim-te, mi zathum le sawmni ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Jericho-te, mi zathum sawmli le nga ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Lod, Hadid, le Ono-te, mi zasagi sawmni le khat ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Shenaah-te, mi tulthum zakuo sawmthum ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Siempute sung panin: Jeshua-te innkuon pan Jedaih suonte, mi zakuo sawm sagi le thum ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Immer suonte, mi tulkhat sawmnga le ni ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Pashur suonte, mi tulkhat zani sawmli le sagi ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Harim suonte, mi tulkhat sawm le sagi ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Levi-te sung panin: Jeshua suonte, Hodevah suon Kadmiel a kicite, mi sawmsagi le li ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Lasate sung panin Asaph suonte, mi zakhat sawmli le giet ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Kotcingte nam sung panin Shallum suonte, Ater suonte, Talmon suonte, Akkub suonte, Hatita suonte, le Shobai suonte, mi zakhat sawmthum le giet ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Biehinn tuonvaite sung panin: Ziha suonte, Hasupha suonte, Tabbaoth suonte"},"47":{"text":"Keros suonte, Sia suonte, Padon suonte,"},"48":{"text":"Lebana suonte, Hagaba suonte, Shalmai suonte,"},"49":{"text":"Hanan suonte, Giddel suonte, Gahar suonte,"},"50":{"text":"Reaiah suonte, Rezin suonte, Nekoda suonte,"},"51":{"text":"Gazzam suonte, Uzza suonte, Paseah suonte,"},"52":{"text":"Besai suonte, Meunim suonte, Nephushesim suonte,"},"53":{"text":"Bakbuk suonte, Hakupha suonte, Harhur suonte,"},"54":{"text":"Bazlith suonte, Mehida suonte, Harsha suonte,"},"55":{"text":"Barkos suonte, Sisera suonte, Tamah suonte,"},"56":{"text":"Neziah suonte, Hatipha suonte,"},"57":{"text":"Solomon nasemte’ suonte, Sotai suonte, Sophereth suonte, Perida suonte,"},"58":{"text":"Jaala suonte, Darkon suonte, Giddel suonte,"},"59":{"text":"Shephatiah suonte, Hattil suonte, Pochereth-hazzebaim suonte, le Amon suonte ahi uhi."},"60":{"text":"Biehinn tuonvaite le Solomon nasemte’ suonte a unpi-in zathum sawmkuo le ni pha uhi."},"61":{"text":"Tam teng pen Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, le Immer-te pana ang peito mite ahi uhi, ahi vangin amate in a pupate uh’ innkuon ahi sihle amau’ pienna khanggui a sut thei sih vua, Israel mi ahile ahi lo lam zong a kitel sih uhi:"},"62":{"text":"Delaiah suonte, Tobiah suonte, Nekoda suonte, mi zaguh sawmli le ni pha uhi."},"63":{"text":"Siempute sungah zong: Habaiah suonte, Koz suonte, Barzillai suonte (Gilead-te Barzillai’ tanute khat tawh ama kinungin tua min tawh kilo pah ahi hi) ahi uhi."},"64":{"text":"Tam mite in khanggui ciemtena laibu sunga a kiciemte mite lahah a min uh a sui vangun a mu zo sih vua, tuaci’n amate pen a bua-in kikoi-in a siempu hina panun kikhawlsah hi;"},"65":{"text":"Urim le Thummim aisanna tawh a siensuo dingin siempu khat a tun masangsie an siengtho pente a neh lo nading uh gam uhpa in amate kungah a gen hi.","ref":"Pei 28:30; Thkna 33:8"},"66":{"text":"Mi buppi tul sawmli le tulni le za thum sawmguh pha a,"},"67":{"text":"amau’ nasem numei le pasal tulsagi zathum sawmthum le sagite kisim lo hi; tuale amate in lasa numei le pasal zani sawmli nga nei uhi."},"68":{"text":"Amate in sakolte zasagi sawmthum le guh, laa-sakol zani sawmli le nga,"},"69":{"text":"kalaoh zali sawmthum nga, le laavai tulguh le zasagi sawmni nei uhi."},"70":{"text":"Tu-in nasep nadingin pupa innkuon lutang pawlkhatte a kipie uhi. Gam uhpa in sumkholna-ah kham darics tulkhat, kuongkum sawmnga, le siempu puon zanga sawmthum a pie hi."},"71":{"text":"Tuale pupa innkuon lutang pawlkhat in sumkholna-ah kham darics tul sawmni le ngun mina tulni zani a pie uhi."},"72":{"text":"Midangte’ pieh pen kham darics tul sawmni, ngun mina tulni, le siempu puon sil sawmguh le sagi ahi hi."},"73":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempute, Levi-te, tunkot cingte, lasate, mi pawlkhatte, biehinn tuonvaite, le Israel zosie a khuopi ciet vuah a teng uhi. A hla sagina ciengin amau’ khuopi cietah -Israel mite a teng uhi-","ref":"1Khg 9:2; Neh 11:3"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"mi zosie Tui Tunkot mai tuolpi-ah a kisutuo uhi. Topa in Israel tunga a pieh Moses thukham laibu ang tawi nadingin amate in laithei pa Ezra kungah a gen uhi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ma bangin a hla sagina, a ni masa ni-in siempu Ezra in theitelna tawh a za thei ding numei pasal a kikhawmte mai-ah thukham laibu a tawi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tui Tunkot mai tuol-awnga numei pasal le a thei dingte opna mun lam kinga a, ama in zingmawng tung panin sunkim dong, tua laibu sung pana thute a sim hi; tuale mi zosie in thukham sunga om thute lunglutin a bildaw ngiam uhi."},"4":{"text":"Thugenna dinga singpeh tawh a kibawl dawsang tungah laithei pa Ezra ding a, Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah le Maaseiah-te a ziet lamah, Pedaih, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash-baddanah, Zechariah le Meshullum-te a vei lamah a ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale mi zosie sangin a sangzaw munah Ezra a din ziehin mi zosie muna-ah laibu a phen hi; tuale ama in tua laibu a phen ciengin mi zosie a ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ezra in a lien Pasien, Topa thupha pie a, mipite in a khut uh lamto-in, “Hi taheh,” ci-in a dawng uhi. Tua ciengin amate lukunin Topa a bie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amau’ opna cietah mite a op sungun mite in thukham a tel thei nadingun Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, le Levi-te in zong a panpi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Pasien’ thukham laibu sung panin a khietna gen kawmin a sim vua, tua a kisim thute a tel nadingun a hil uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale gam uhpa Nehemiah, laithei pa le siempu Ezra, le mite thu a hil Levi-te in mi zosie kungah, “Tuni pen Topa na Pasien uh dinga ni siengtho ahi hi; a kap a mau om sih un,” a ci hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate in thukham kammalte a zah ciengun mi zosie a kap uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in amate kungah, “Na lapi sung vuah pei-in a thaute ne-in zu a hlum nono dawn unlen, bangma a kibawlpieh lote zong va thah ta un, bangzieh ahei cile i Topa adingin tuni pen ni siengtho ahi hi; da sih un, azieh pen Topa’ kipahna khu note’ hatna ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Levi-te in, “Sip dide un; azieh pen tuni khu ni siengtho ni ahi hi; da sih un,” ci-in mi zosie a sipsah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuale mi zosie in amate kunga kigen thute a tel thei ziehun anne tui dawnin a om vua, midangte an thah ding le a guolnuom dingin a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"A ni ni ni-in pupa innkuon lutangte zosie, siempute le Levi-te tawh thukham sin dingin laithei pa Ezra kungah a kikhawm uhi.","title":"Buh Pawi Kibawl"},"14":{"text":"Tuale a hla sagina pawi hun sungin buhte sungah Israel mite a ten nading thu,"},"15":{"text":"le a khuopi zosie ule Jerusalem khuopi-ah amate tangko-in, “A kigielsa bangin buhte lam nadingin muol tungah pei unlen, olive bate, gam olive bate, mui singbate, lutu bate, le a napha singte va la ta un,” ci-in Moses tungtawnin a gen ding uh, Topa thupiehna pen thukham laibu sunga a kigiel lam a mu uhi.","ref":"Siem 23:33-36, 39-43; Thkna 16:13-15"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite pei-in singnate a la vua, amau’ innkhum tung ciet, a leituolte ciet uh, le Pasien’ biehinn leituol, Tui Tunkot tuol, le Ephraim Tunkot tuol tengah buhte a lam uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale saltanna pana a kilekia mi zosie in buhte a lam uhi. Azieh pen Nun’ tapa Joshua’ huna kipan khum ni dongin Israel mite in tua bangin a bawl ngai sih uhi. Tuale lungdamna nahpi tahin a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale ama in ni masa ni-a kipanin a ni tawp dong, nisielin Pasien’ thukham laibu a simkhie hi. Amate in ni sagi sung pawi a bawl uhi; tuale ngaina om bangin a ni giet ni-in kikhopna thupi khat a om hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hla ni sawmni le ni li ni-in Israel mite in antangin la-ip puon silin a kikhawm vua, a lu tung vuah leivui a kibuoh uhi.","title":"Minam Mawna Pulahna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin gamdang mi zosie sung panin Israel cihlah teng a tuomin a om vua, dinsa-in amau’ mawnate le a pu a pate uh’ khielnate pulahin a thum uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amau’ opna mun cietah dingin, Topa a Pasien uh’ thukham laibu ni khat’ seli-suo-sekhat sung a sim vua, adang seli-suo-sekhat pen mawna pulahna-in nei-in, Topa a Pasien a bie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Levi-te’ kalei tungah Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani le Chenani dingin Topa a Pasien kung vuah nahpi tahin a kiko uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Levi-te Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, le Pethahiah-te in, “Dingto unlen, tawntung panin tawntung dongin Topa na Pasien uh patawi un. Thupha namcin le patawina teng tungah a kitawisang vanglien na min in thupha nga taheh,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale Ezra in, “Nang beh Topa na hi hi; nang in a sang pen vantung le vantungte-a om zosie, leitung le a tunga a om zosie, tuipi le a sunga a om zosie na siem hi. Nang in tua teng zosie tungah hinna na pie a, van mihonpite in nang ang bie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nang in Abram teelin Chaldea-te’ Ur pan peipi-in Abraham min a phuo pa Topa Pasien na hi hi;","ref":"Pien 11:31; 12:1; 17:5"},"8":{"text":"tuale na mai-ah ama’ lungsim a muonhuoi lam na mu a, Canaan-te gam, Hit-te gam, Amor-te gam, Perez-te gam, Jebus-te gam, le Girgash-te gam teng, ama le a suonlehlahte tungah pieh dingin ama tawh thuciem khat na bawl hi; nang in na kamciem na tungsah hi, azieh pen nang na thuman hi.","ref":"Pien 15:18-21"},"9":{"text":"“Tuale nang in Egypt gam sunga ka pu ka pate uh’ gentheina na mu a, San Tuipi -a amau’ kikona na za hi.","ref":"Pei 3:7; 14:10-12"},"10":{"text":"Amate in kihisahna tawh ka pu ka pate uh a bawl gawpna uh thei na hi ziehin, Pharaoh le ama’ nasemte zosie, le a gam sunga mi zosie’ langkhatah lim le na lamdangte na bawl hi. Nangma ading min khat na bawl a, tua khu tuni dongin a omlai hi.","ref":"Pei 7:8–12:32"},"11":{"text":"Tuale amate in leigaw tunga tuipi a kantan thei nadingun nangma in a masang vuah gunpi phalni na suo a, ahi vangin nangma in amahaw a nuadelte tuihuol sunga suongse bangin tuithuh sung sena-in na nei hi.","ref":"Pei 14:21-29; 15:4-5"},"12":{"text":"Tua tham loin, nangma in amate a pei thei nadingun a lampi uh a salvah dingin sunin meii khuom, zanin mei khuom tawh na zawpi hi.","ref":"Pei 13:21-22"},"13":{"text":"Nangma zong Sinai muol tungah kumsuhin vantung panin amate na hopi a, tuale amate thukhenna a man, thukham tahtah, ngaina hoite le thupiehnate na pie a,"},"14":{"text":"nangma in na nasempa Moses tungtawnin amate na sabbath siengtho na theisah a, thupiehnate, ngainate, le thukhamte na pie hi.","ref":"Pei 19:18–23:33"},"15":{"text":"A gilkiel ciengun amate vantung panin moh na pie hi, a dangta ciengun zong amate adingin suongpi panin tui na pulsah a, amate pieh dinga na ciemsa gamah pei-in a luo nadingun amate kungah na gen hi.","ref":"Pei 16:4-15; 17:1-7; Thkna 1:21"},"16":{"text":"“Ahi vangin amate le ka pu ka pate kihisahin a ngawngkhauh vua, na thupiehnate a mang sih uhi;"},"17":{"text":"amate in thu mang nuom loin, amate lahah na bawlsa na lamdangte ngaisutin zong a nei sih uhi; amate in a ngawng uh a khausah vua, a saltanna uh Egypt gamah kilekia ding a khentat uhi. Ahi vangin nangma na hi leh maw maisah dinga a kiging, mi lungsiet le mi hepi siem, lungduoina le itna kip tawh a kidim Pasien na hi a, nangma in amate na nuasie sih hi.","ref":"Gam 14:1-4; Thkna 1:26-33; Pei 34:6; Gam 14:18"},"18":{"text":"Amate in a kisung bawngno lim khat amahaw dingin a bawl vua, “Tami pen Egypt pana note ang peipi na pasien uh ahi hi,” ci-in nahpi-in note ang gensiet lai nangawnun,","ref":"Pei 32:1-4"},"19":{"text":"nangma in a lien mama hepina na nei ziehin gamlahah amate na nuasie tuom sih a, sunin lam hil meii khuom in amate nuasie loin, zanin zong a pei nading uh lampi a vahsah ding mei khuom in amate nuasie lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma in amate thu a hil dingin a hoi na hlagau na pie a, amau’ kam sung panin na manna an zong lakia loin, a dangta uh a phat nadingin tui na pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangma zamtawng khat zong tasam loin nangma in amate kum sawmli sung na va a, a puonsilte uh sie loin a kengte uzong a pawm vawt sih hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:2-4"},"22":{"text":"Nangma in amate tungah kumpi gamte le mite na pie a, amate tungah leimong ningkiu zosie na pie a, tuaci’n amate in Heshbon Kumpipa Sihon’ gam le Bashan Kumpipa Og’ gam a luo uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35"},"23":{"text":"Nangma in a suon a hlahte uh vana aasi za-in na pungsah a, a pu a pate lutin a luo ding vua na gensa gam sungah amate na peipi hi.","ref":"Pien 15:5; 22:17; Josh 3:14-17"},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n a suonlehlahte lutin khum gam a luo vua, amate mai-ah khum gama teng Canaan-te zogawpin, a nop bangbang vua a bawl dingun a khut sung vuah kumpite le a gam mite na pie hi.","ref":"Josh 11:23"},"25":{"text":"Tuale amate in kulpi tawh a ki-im khuopite, le leitang hoite la-in nei le lam namcin tawh a kidim innte a bulu vua, a kitosa tuikhuhte, lengga umte, olive umte, le neh thei singga tampitahte a luo uhi. Tuaci’n amate in tuate ne-in gilva-in a thau milmel vua, na hoina lienpi ziehin Topa’ hepina sungah a nuomsa mama uhi.","ref":"Thkna 6:10-11"},"26":{"text":"“Hinanle amate in thu a mang sih vua, nang hing ledo-in na thukham a nuangat vua, nangma lam ang kinualekia nadingun amate thu a hil na kamsangte a that vua, tuaci’n mi gensietna lienpi a bawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nangma in a galte uh’ khut sungah amate na pie a, a galte in amate a gimsah uhi. Tua ciengin a genthei hun ciengun nangma kungah ang kiko-in, nangma in vantung panin na za a, na khuotuona lienpi zalin a galte khut sung panin amate a hundam ding mite na pie hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin a toidam zaw ciengun na mai-ah mawna a bawlkia vua, amate tungah thunei vaihawm dingin a galte khut sungah amate na nuasie hi. Ahi vangin nangma kungah amate hing kihei-in ang tau ciengun nangma in vantung panin na za a, na hepina ziehin amate tamveipi na hunkhie hi.","ref":"Thkn 2:11-16"},"29":{"text":"Tuale na thukham lamah amate ang kinuale thei nadingun thu na hil hi. Hinanle kiphasah tahin amate a gamta vua, na thupiehnate mang loin a zui mi khat a nungtasah thei ahi nangma’ ngaina kipte tungah a khiel zawsop uhi. Amate lungkhauhin a liengko a lehei vua, a ngawng uh vaipuohin thu a mang sih uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:5"},"30":{"text":"Kum tampi sung amate na thuoh kenkon a, na kamsangte tungtawnin nangma’ hlagau tawh amahaw thu na hil hi; hizongle amate in a ngai nuom sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin nangma in amate khum gam mite’ khut sungah na piedawh ta hi.","ref":"2Kum 17:13-18; 2Khg 36:15-16"},"31":{"text":"Hizongnanle na hepina lien tawh amate na pum suhsiet sih a, zong na nuasie sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile nang pen hepina le khuotuona a nei Pasien na hi hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin tu-in a vanglien, a thahat le a giinhuoi, thuciemna le itna kip a tudet kohaw’ Pasien aw, nangma in Assyria kumpite huna kipan tuni dongin ka kumpite uh, ka uliente uh, ka siempute uh, ka kamsangte uh, ka pu ka pate ule na mi zosiete tunga ang tung gimna zosie ei zangkhai ngaisutpieh malmal sin.","ref":"2Kum 15:19, 29; 17:3-6; Ezr 4:2, 10"},"33":{"text":"Kote tunga ang tungsa thu zosie-ah nang na thutang hi, bangzieh ahei cile nangma in muonhuoi tahin sil na bawl zo a, kote gilo tahin ka gamta uhi;"},"34":{"text":"kote’ kumpipa, ka uliente uh, ka siempute uh, ka pu ka pate un na thukham zui loin na thupiehnate le na galgihnate a don sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Nang na hoi mama zieha amate tunga na piehsa gam tanzau le gamhoi-ah amate omin, a kumpi gam sung vua a op laitah na ngawnun amate in nangma’ na sem loin a gitlo gamtatna panun a kinuale sih uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tu-in kote sal ka hi ta uhi, ka pu ka pate un a sunga pieng a gate le na hoite a neh thei dingun na piehsa gam sungah sal ka suoh ta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ka mawna uh ziehin kote tungah ei uh dinga na koi kumpite tungah tua gam’ hauna teng a tung ta hi; amate in koma tung le ka ganhonte uh tungah a dei bang banga bawl theina thu a nei vua, nahpi tahin ka lung uh a kham hi,” a ci uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuami thu teng zosie ziehin thukimna det khat bawlin lai ka giel vua, ka uliente uh, ka Levi-te ule ka siempute un tua lai tungah suoi a kai uhi.","title":"Thuciemna Suoikaite"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua lai tunga suoikaite’ min pen tam teng ahi uhi; Hilkiah’ tapa gam uhpa Nehemiah le Zedekiah,"},"2":{"text":"Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,"},"3":{"text":"Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,"},"4":{"text":"Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,"},"5":{"text":"Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,"},"6":{"text":"Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,"},"7":{"text":"Meshallum, Abijah, Mijamin,"},"8":{"text":"Maaziah, Bilgal, le Shemaiah-te; tam teng pen siempute ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale Levi-te: Azaniah’ tapa Jeshua, Henadad’ tate Binui le Kadmiel;"},"10":{"text":"a kithuopite Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,"},"11":{"text":"Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,"},"12":{"text":"Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,"},"13":{"text":"Hodiah, Bani, le Baninu ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mipi makaite: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,"},"15":{"text":"Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,"},"16":{"text":"Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,"},"17":{"text":"Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,"},"18":{"text":"Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,"},"19":{"text":"Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,"},"20":{"text":"Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,"},"21":{"text":"Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,"},"22":{"text":"Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,"},"23":{"text":"Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,"},"24":{"text":"Halohesh, Pilha, Shobek,"},"25":{"text":"Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah"},"26":{"text":"Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,"},"27":{"text":"Malluch, Harim, Baanah-te ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"A om lai mite, siempute, Levi-te, tunkot cingte, lasate, biehinn tuonvaite, Pasien thukham zui dinga tua gam mite tawh a kikhenkhie mi zosie’ a zite, a tate, a tanute, pilna le theitelna a nei zosie in,","title":"Thuciemna Tomkim"},"29":{"text":"a sanggamte zopin a uliente a zui vua, Pasien’ nasem Moses in a pieh Pasien’ thukham zui-in, eite’ Topa ahi Topa thupiehnate zosie, le a ngainate le a thukhamte a zui nadingun kiciemna a bawl uhi."},"30":{"text":"Gamdang mite kungah ka tanute ka mo hlah sih ding vua, ka tapate’ zi dingin zong amau’ tanute ka la sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 34:16; Thkna 7:3"},"31":{"text":"Tua gam mite in Sabbath ni-in van hile, an hile zua dinga ang tawi uleh, Sabbath ni le ni siengtho ni khat popo-in amate tung panin ka lei sih ding uhi; tuale kote in a kum sagina-ah lo bawl loin, leibate zong ka pau nget sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 23:10-11; Siem 25:1-7; Thkna 15:1-2"},"32":{"text":"I Pasien uh’ biehinn sunga nasep nadingin shekel khat’ sethum-suo-sekhat pieh ding ka mawpuoh uh ahi hi, ci-in ka kiciem uhi:","ref":"Pei 30:11-16"},"33":{"text":"Tua khu a kiguol anlumte, manmana kipie an tawh biehnate, manman a kipie meihal biehnate, sabbath-te, hladet nite, a kisesa pawite, a siengtho silpiehte, le Israel-te thoidam nading, mawna zieha biehnate le i Pasien uh’ inn sunga nasep nading ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Thukham laibu sungah a kigiel ma bangin a kise hunin a kumkumin Topa i Pasien uh’ maitam tunga taw dingin a pupa uh’ innkuon zui-in Pasien’ biehinn sungah sing silpieh zong ka tut nadingun, siempute, Levi-te, le mipite in ai ka san uhi."},"35":{"text":"Ka leitang pan vua a pieng anpalte, singkung zosie uh panin ga masate, a kumkumin Topa’ biehinn sunga tawi dingin ka kiciem uhi;","ref":"Pei 23:19; 34:26; Thkna 26:2"},"36":{"text":"thukham laibu sungah a kigiel ma bangin a suoh masa tapate le a suoh masa gantate zong Pasien’ biehinn sunga a nasem siempute kunga peipi ding,","ref":"Pei 13:2"},"37":{"text":"le Pasien’ biehinn dan sunga a om siempute kungah annel kilommeh masa pente, silpiehte, singga zosie, sathau le lenggazu-te peipi ding, le khuoneute zosie-ah sesawm-suo- sekhat a khonte pen Levi-te ahi ziehin lo-a a pieng se sawm-suo-sekhatte zong Levi-te tunga puoh dingin ka vaihawm uhi.","ref":"Gam 18:21"},"38":{"text":"Tuale Levi-te in se sawm-suo-sekhat a san ciengun, Levi-te tawh Aaron’ suon siempute a omton ding uhi; tuale Levi-te in se sawm-suo-sekhat sung panin se sawm-suo-sekhat ma khensawnin Pasien’ biehinnpi sung vankholna tapkuong sungah a peipi ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 18:26"},"39":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel mite le Levi’ suonte in mun siengtho vanzahte koina, siempute tuonvai sepna, le tunkot cingte le lasate opna mun vankholna-ah lenggazu, le sathau kipiete a peipi ding uhi. Topa i Pasien uh’ biehinn don loin i om sih ding uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Jerusalem ah mipi makai teng a teng uhi; tuale a omlai mite sawm-ah-khat in khuopi siengtho Jerusalem-a teng dingin ai a san vua, sawm-ah-kuote khuopi dangte-ah a teng uhi.","title":"Khuopi Mimal Phaza Khang"},"2":{"text":"Tuale mite in Jerusalem-a a teng dingin kiphal taha kipumpiehte a pahta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jerusalem-a teng gamkhen uhpite ahi uhi; ahi vangin Judah khuopite-ah Israel-te, siempute, Levi-te, biehinnpi sunga tuonvaite, le Solomon nasemte’ suon le hlahte a teng vua, a khuopite ciet vuah amau’ neisa ciet tawh a teng uhi:"},"4":{"text":"Judah-te le Benjamin-te sung panin Jerusalem ah mi pawlkhat a teng uhi. Judah-te sung panin: Perez’ suon Mahalalel’ tapa, Shephatiah’ tapa, Amariah’ tapa, Zechariah’ tapa, Uzziah’ tapa, Athaiah;","ref":"Neh 7:73"},"5":{"text":"le Shilon’ suon Zechariah’ tapa, Joiarib’ tapa, Adaiah’ tapa, Hazaiah’ tapa, Kolhozeh’ tapa, Baruch’ tapa, Maaseiah ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem-a Perez’ suonte zosie mihat galhang zali sawmguh le giet pha uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tam teng pen Benjamin suonte ahi uhi: Jesaih’ tapa, Ithiel’ tapa, Maaseiah’ tapa, Kolaiah’ tapa, Pedaih’ tapa, Joed’ tapa, Mashullum’ tapa Sallu ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"A sanggamte Gabbai, Sallai ahi vua, mi zakuo sawmni le giet pha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zichri’ tapa Joel pen amau’ makai pa ahi hi. Hassenuah’ tapa Judah pen khuopi uh a nina ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Siempute sung panin: Jedaiah, Joiarib’ tapa, Jachin,"},"11":{"text":"Pasien’ biehinn vaisai pa Ahitub’ tapa, Meraioth’ tapa, Zadok’ tapa , Meshullam’ tapa, Hilkiah tapa, Seraiah’ tapa,"},"12":{"text":"le biehinn nasem amau’ kithuopite tawh mi zagiet sawmni le ni pha uhi; tuale Malchijah’ tapa, Pashur’ tapa, Zechariah’ tapa, Amzi’ tapa, Pelaliah’ tapa, Jeroham’ tapa, Adaiah’ tapa,"},"13":{"text":"le a kithuopite, pupa innkuon lutangte tawh mi zani sawmli ni pha uhi; tuale Immer’ tapa, Meshillemoth’ tapa, Ahzai’ tapa, Azarel’ tapa, Amashai’ tapa,"},"14":{"text":"le amau’ kithuopi a thahat galhangte tawh mi zakhat sawmni le giet pha uhi; amau’ makai pen Haggedolim’ tapa Zabdiel ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale Levi-te sung panin: Bunni’ tapa, Hashabiah’ tapa, Azrikim’ tapa, Hasshub’ tapa, Shemaiah’ tapa;"},"16":{"text":"le Pasien’ biehinn pulam nasem vaisai Levi-te’ makaite ahi Shabbethai le Jozabad;"},"17":{"text":"le lungdamko thungetna a pan dinga a makai Asaph’ tapa, Zabdi’ tapa, Mica’ tapa, Mattaniah’ tapa, le ama’ kithuopite lahah a nina pa Bakbukiah, le Jeduthun’ tapa; le Galal’ tapa, Shammua’ tapa, Abda ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Khuopi siengtho-a om Levi-te a unpi-in zani sawmgiet le li pha uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tunkot cingte sung panin: Akkub, Talmon, le amau’ kithuopite tawh mi zakhat sawmsagi ni pha uhi."},"20":{"text":"A omlai Israel-te, siempute, le Levi-te pen Judah gam khuopi zosie-a amau’ luo leitang cietah a teng uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin biehinnpi tuonvaite ahile Ophel muolbo-ah a teng uhi; tuale Ziha le Gishpa in biehinn tuonvaite a uh uhi."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem-a Levi-te a uhpa Mica’ tapa, Mattaniah’ tapa, Hashbiah’ tapa, Bani’ tapa, Uzzi pen Asaph’ suon lasate ahi a, ama pen Pasien’ biehinn nasepna-ah vaisai khat ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate tawh kisai-in kumpipa thupieh khat om ahi ziehin, lasate adingin nisielin neh le dawn a kisam banga pieh ding ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Judah’ tapa Zerah’ suonte khat, Meshezabel’ tapa Pethahiah pen mipite tawh kisai-a kumpipa’ khut nei-ah thu zosie a saipa ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuale khuoneute le a lote tawh kisai-in, Judah mite pawlkhat Kiriath-arba le a khuoneute, Dibon le a khuoneute, Jekabzeel le a khuoneute,","title":"Jerusalem Pulama Khuoneute"},"26":{"text":"Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-pelet,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba le a khuoneute"},"28":{"text":"Ziklag, Meconah le a khuoneute,"},"29":{"text":"En-rimmon, Zorah le Jarmut,"},"30":{"text":"Zanoah, Adullam le a khuoneute, Lachish le a lote, Azekah le a khuoneute-ah a teng uhi. Tuaci’n Beer-sheba panin Hinnom Kuom dongah phuol a sat uhi."},"31":{"text":"Benjamin mite in zong Geba lam panin, Michmash, Aija, Bethel le a khuoneute,"},"32":{"text":"Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,"},"33":{"text":"Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,"},"34":{"text":"Hadid, Zeboiim, Neballat,"},"35":{"text":"Lod, le Ono, le khutsiemte kuomah a teng uhi."},"36":{"text":"Levi pawlkhen kimkhatte Benjamin gamah kigawm uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le Jeshua tawh a peito siempute le Levi-te tam teng ahi hi: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,","title":"Siempute le Levi-te Min Sazien"},"2":{"text":"Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,"},"3":{"text":"Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,"},"4":{"text":"Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,"},"5":{"text":"Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,"},"6":{"text":"Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,"},"7":{"text":"Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah-te ahi uhi. Tam teng pen Jeshua khan sunga siempute le a kithuopite lahah a lamkaite ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Levi-te: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, le Mattaniah ahi a, a kithuopite tawh lungdamkona la makaite ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Biehpiehna sungah amate tawh Bakbukiah, Unno le a kithuopite kigalsai-in a ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jeshua pen Joiakim’ pa, Joiakim pen Eliashib’ pa, Eliashib pen Joiada’ pa,"},"11":{"text":"Joiada pen Jonathan’ pa, Jonathan pen Jaddua’ pa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Joiakim hun sunga pupa innkuon lutang ahi siempute: Seraiah suon panin Meraiah, Jeremiah suon panin Hananiah;"},"13":{"text":"Ezra suon panin Meshullam; Amariah suon panin Jehohanan;"},"14":{"text":"Malluchi suon panin Jonathan, Shebaniah suon panin Joseph;"},"15":{"text":"Harim suon panin Adna; Meraioth suon panin Helkai,"},"16":{"text":"Iddo suon panin Zechariah, Ginnethon suon panin Meshullam;"},"17":{"text":"Abijah suon panin Zichri, Miniamin suonte, Moadiah suon panin Piltai;"},"18":{"text":"Bilgah suon panin Shammua; Shemaiah suon panin Jehonathan,"},"19":{"text":"Joiarib suon panin Mattenai; Jedaiah suon panin Uzzi;"},"20":{"text":"Sallai suon panin Kallai;"},"21":{"text":"Amok suon panin Eber; Hilkiah suon panin Hashabiah; Jedaiah suon panin Nethanel ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, le Jaddua-te’ khan sungin Levi-te pen pupa innkuon lutangin na kiciemte hi; Persia-te Darius’ uh hun cieng dongin zong siempute a na hi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Pupa innkuonte’ lutang Levi-te pen Eliashib’ tapa Johanan hun dongin Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kiciemte hi."},"24":{"text":"Levi makaite: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, le Kadmiel’ tapa Jeshua-te le a kithuopite tawh ahi vua, Pasien mi David’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in a kidawnga phatna la sa ding le lungdamko dingin a pawl pawlin a kikhel uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub-te pen vankoina tunkotte a cing tunkot cingte ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua, a tapa Joiakim hun sung le gam uhpa Nehemiah, siempu pa le laithei pa Ezra hun sunga nasemte ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem kulpi apna-ah daltuote, harp, le lyre-te tawh lungdamko-in la a sa vua, lungdam kipahna tawh apna a bawl dingin Jerusalem ah Levi-te a peipi thei nadingun a opna uh muncin tengah amate a sui uhi.","title":"Khuopi Kulpi Apna"},"28":{"text":"Jerusalem kim le Netophah-te’ khuoneute panin lasa honpite a kikhawm uhi;"},"29":{"text":"Beth-gilgal pan le Geba gam le Azmaveth gam panin zong a kikhawm uhi; azieh pen lasate in Jerusalem kimvelah amate dingin khuoneute a lam uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale siempute le Levi-te kisiensuo-in amate in mite, tunkotte le kulpite a siensuo uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in kulpi tungah Judah makaite ka zawpi a, lampei kawmin phatna la sa dingin mi honpi khen ni-in ka se hi. Honkhat pen ziet lam manaw-in Buathah Tunkot kulzangah a pei uhi;"},"32":{"text":"tuale amate nua-ah Hoshaiah le Judah uliente alang,"},"33":{"text":"Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,"},"34":{"text":"Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,"},"35":{"text":"le pengkulte a tawi a khangdawng siempu pawlkhat: Asaph, a tapa Zaccur, a tapa Micaiah, a tapa Mattaniah, a tapa Shemaih, a tapa Jonathan, a tapa Zechariah;"},"36":{"text":"ama’ tanau Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, le Hanani-te, Pasien’ mizah ahi David’ tumthei lasahnate tawh zui-in, amau’ mai-ah laithei pa Ezra a pei hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate masang Tuinah Tunkot panin kulpi katona David’ khuopi kalei-ah a peito vua, David’ innpi tunglam nisuona lam Tui Tunkot lam zuonin a pei uhi."},"38":{"text":"Vei lamah lungdamko adang pawlte a pei vua, keima in mipi pawlkhat tawh kul tungah amate ka zui hi. Meikhuh Tausang panin Kulpi Tanzau-ah"},"39":{"text":"khum panin Ephraim Tunkot, tua ciengin Tunkot Lui, tua ciengin Nga Tunkot, tua ciengin Hananel Tausang, tua ciengin Zakhat Tausang, tua ciengin Tuu Tunkot-ah a pei uhi; tuale Thong Tunkot-ah amate a khawl uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien’ biehinn sungah lungdamko la pawl nite le uliente alang tawh ka ding a,"},"41":{"text":"siempu Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Mikaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, le Hananiah-te in a pengkul uh a tawi uhi;"},"42":{"text":"Tuale Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, Ezer-te zong a om uhi. Lasate in Jezrahiah makai-in la a sa uhi."},"43":{"text":"Nahpi taha a lungdam dingin Pasien in amate a bawl ziehin amate in zong khum ni-in biehpiehna lienpi bawlin a lungdam vua, numei le naupangte zong a lungdam uhi. A gamlapi panin Jerusalem’ guolnopna kiza hi."},"44":{"text":"Khum ni-in thukham sunga a om bangin siempute le Levi-te tanh dinga khuopite neisa lote pan kaikhop dinga a kipie nate, anpalte, le sawm-a-khatte kikholna ahi inndeite tunga vaihawm ding mi kise hi; azieh pen na sem siempute le Levi-te tungah Judah a lungdam hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Mawpuohnate"},"45":{"text":"David le a tapa Solomon’ thupiehna tawh kizui-in lasate le tunkot cingte ma bangin amate in a Pasien uh’ nasepna le siensuo nasepnate a sem uhi.","ref":"1Khg 25:1-8; 26:12"},"46":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile hun sawtveipi lai David le Asaph-te hun sungin lasate ading, Pasien tunga lungdamkona le phatna lasate adingin makai khat a om hi."},"47":{"text":"Zerubbabel le Nehemiah hun lai-in Israel mi zosie in lasate le tunkot cingte adingin a nisim tanh uh a pie uhi. Amate in Levi-te ading a tuomkoi uhi. Levi-te in Aaron’ suonte adingin a tuomkoi sawn uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum ni-in amate in mipite’ zahin Moses’ thukham laibu a sim uhi; tuale Pasien’ mite kikhopna sungah Ammon-te le Moab-te a lut thei ngai lo nading uh a kigiel lai kimu hi,","title":"Israel-te Kung Panin Gamdang Mite Kituomkoi"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen amate in an le tui tawh Israel-te na lamdot loin amate a gausam dingin Balaam na ciel zawsop uhi. Ahi vangin kohaw’ Pasien in tua awsie teng thupha-in ei heipieh hi.","ref":"Thkna 23:3-5; Gam 22:1-6"},"3":{"text":"Mipite in tua thukham a zah ciengun Israel sung panin gamdang suon zosie a tuomkhen uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum hun masangin eite’ Pasien’ innpi sunga vankholna inndeite uh dinga kise Tobiah tawh a kithei siempu Eliashib in,","title":"Nehemiah’ Puophatnate"},"5":{"text":"tu masang lai-in Levi-te, lasate le tunkot cingte tunga a thupieh tawh kizui-a kipie ding ahi an tawh biehna, gimnamtui, vanzahte, sawm-ah-khat a kipie an, lenggazu, sathau, le siempute dinga a kipie nate koina dinga kizang innkhan golpi khat, Tobiah adingin na bawlpieh hi."},"6":{"text":"Babylon Kumpi Artaxerxes in a uh zaw a kum sawmthum le nina kumin ama kunga ka hawziehin tam thu a pien hunin Jerusalem ah kei ka om kha sih hi. Keima in bakhat zaw ciengin kumpipa tung panin phalna ka ngen a,"},"7":{"text":"tuale Jerusalem ah ka peikia hi. Tua ciengin keima in Tobiah adingin Pasien biehinn huong sungah Elishiab in inndei khat a na bawlpiehna thu, a sil hoi lo bawlte ka va mukhie ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale ka lung a thah mama a, inndei sung panin Tobiah’ van zosie ka paimang sieng hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in thu pie-in, amate in inndeite a siensuo vua, tua sungah Pasien’ biehinn vanzahte, an tawh biehna le gimnamtuite ka koikia hi."},"10":{"text":"Levi-te’ tanh dinga kisete amate tungah kipie lo ahi ziehin a lo ciet vuah Levi-te le lasate a kuonkia ta uhi, ci thu zong keima in ka va thei kha ta hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:19"},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n uliente tungah ka lung a kim sih a, “Bang dinga Pasien’ innpi kinuasie dawh ta ahei?” ka ci hi. Tuale keima in amate ka kaikhawm a, a mun ciet vuah ka koikia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah zosie in antang, lenggazu le sathau sung panin sawm-ah-khat hing peipi-in vankoina innte-ah ang tut uhi.","ref":"Mal 3:10"},"13":{"text":"Tuale keima in vankoina innte a kem dingin siempu Shelemiah, laithei Zadok, le Levi-te Pedaih, le amate a hu dingin Mattaniah’ tapa Zaccur, a tapa Hanan-te ka se hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate pen mi muonhuoite-in kingaisun hi; tuale amau’ sep ding tavuon pen a kithuopite tungah neh le dawn hawmpieh ding ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Aw, ka Pasien, tami thu tawh kisai-in keima ei phawh inlen, ka Pasien’ innpi le ama’ nasepna dinga ka bawl na hoite ei suhmangpieh sin."},"15":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in keima in Judah mite sungah sabbath ni-in lenggazu suhin, buphaite khawmin, laa tunga a van guon ule sabbath ni-in laa tungah lenggazu, lengga, theiba gate, le van namcin zong guongin Jerusalem-a ang puoh uh zong ka mu hi; tuale khum ni-in a anzua uh a hoi lona thu amate tungah ka gen hi.","title":"Sabbath Puophatna","ref":"Pei 20:8-10; Thkna 5:12-14; Jer 17:21-22"},"16":{"text":"Khuopi sunga teng Tyre-te in zong ngasa le van namkim ang puo vua, sabbath ni-in tuate Judah mite tung le Jerusalem-ah a zua uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah mi thupite tungah ka lung a kim sih a, amate kungah, “Sabbath ni buasah a, tami sil hoi lo na bawlte uh bang ahiei?"},"18":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh tam banga a na gamtat ziehun i Pasien in eite tung le tam khuopi tungah tam bang gimna zosie ang tunsah hi lo amah? Tua hi napi-in note in sabbath buasahna tawh Israel tungah lungthahna na tut be uhi,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Sabbath masang, Jerusalem tunkotte-ah khuo mut patin kotpite a kikhah nadingin ka sawl a, sabbath tawp zaw masangsie a kihon lo nadingin thu ka pie hi. Keima in sabbath ni-a ang kipuo van poma a lut thei lo nadinga a khaam dingin tunkot tengah ka nasemte pawlkhat ka pangsah hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin sumbawlte le van namkim zuate khatvei ni vei Jerusalem pulamah a gieh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in amate ka phawhsie a, a kung vuah, “Bang dinga kulpi mai-a gieh na hi uh ahei? Nang giekia poma uleh kang dopbawl vawt sih ding hi,” ka ci hi. Tua huna kipan sabbath ni-in amate ang pei nawn sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Siengtho tahin tua sabbath a kitan thei nadingin a kisiensuosa-in amate pei-in tunkot teng a cin nadingun Levi-te thu ka pie hi. Ka Pasien aw, tam thu-ah zong nangma in nei angvanna tawh keima ei phawh inlen, a lien mama na itna kip dung zui-in kei ei pengsah in."},"23":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in keima in zong Ashdod, Ammon, le Moab numeite tawh a kinung Jew mite ka mu hi;","title":"Namdangte tawh Kinunna Kimawsah (Ezr 9:1-4)"},"24":{"text":"tuale a tate uh alang in Ashdod ham a zang vua, tuale amate in Judah ham zang thei loin minam tuomtuomte’ ham a zangzaw uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amate phawhsie-in ka samsie a, pawlkhat vuo-in, pawlkhat a sambung vuah ka luoi gawp hi; tuale keima in Pasien’ min tawh amate ka kiciemsah a, “Na tanute uh a tapate uh’ zi dingin na pie sih ding vua, a tanute uzong noma le na tapate’ zi dingin na la poma sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 34:11-16; Thkna 7:1-5"},"26":{"text":"Tua bang numeite ziehin Israel Kumpipa Solomon khiel hi lo amah? Minam tampite lahah ama tawh a kibang kumpi khat zong om loin, a Pasien in ama it a, Israel zosie tungah kumpi dingin Pasien in ama koi hi; ahi vangin gamdang numeite in ama nangawn a khielsah uhi.","ref":"2Sam 12:24-25; 1Kum 11:1-8"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahile gamdang numeite tenpina ziehin tami sietna lienpite zosie bawlin ka Pasien tung vua a zuoutat dingin kote in na thu ngai ding ka hi uh amah?” ka cisah hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuale siempu lien pa Eliashib’ tapa Jehoiada’ tapate khat pen Horon-te Sanballat’ mahpa na hi hi; keima in ka kung panin ama ka delmang hi.","ref":"Neh 4:1"},"29":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, amate in siempu nasepna le siempute le Levi-te’ thuciemna a buasah ziehun amate na thei ta’n."},"30":{"text":"Tua bangin gamdang tawh a kizom nate zosie panin amate ka siensuo a, siempute le Levi-te a nasep ngai ma vuah ka semsahkia hi;"},"31":{"text":"tuale a kise hun cienga vah ding sing tawh biehna le anpal tawh biehna ding zong ka vaihawmpieh hi. Ka Pasien aw, a hoi lamin ei phawh bo in."}}}}},"17":{"info":{"name":"Esther","shortname":"Est","abbr":[],"desc":"Esther laibu (the book of esther)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami lai-a kigiel thupieng teng pen India gam pan Ethiopia gam dong, gamkhen zakhat sawmni le sagi a uh Ahasuerus’ hun lai-a pieng thu ahi hi.","title":"Kumpi Ahasuerus in Kumpinu Hina Panin Vashti Khawlsah","ref":"Ezr 4:6"},"2":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in kumpi khuo ahi Susa khuopi sunga kumpi topha tungah Kumpipa Ahasuerus a to laitah,"},"3":{"text":"ama a maan a kum thumna kumin a milien zosie le a nasemte adingin ankuong luina khat a siem hi. Persia le Media galkapmangte, mithupite le gamkhen uhte a om laitahin,"},"4":{"text":"a kumpi gam hauna, a thupinate, le a lietnate ni tampi sung, ni za le sawmgiet sung tah a lah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tami nite a tawp ciengin kumpipa in kumpi khuo Susa khuopi sunga om milien mineu zosie adingin kumpi huong sungah ni sagi sung ankuong luina khat a siem hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua huong sungah suongkang khuomte kiphut a, khau malneu le khau dupsan tawh ngun kuolte ah kikhi-in a kikhai dalna puonkangte kihlungin, suong manpha a san, a dum, a kang, le a vom, a nam tuomtuomte kizang a, a kizem suongpha tungah kham le ngun tawh kibawl lupnate kikoi hi."},"7":{"text":"Kham hai nam tuomtuom tawh dawn dingte kihawm a, kumpipa’ hauna dung zui-in zucia dei zaza-in kizang hi."},"8":{"text":"Zu pen hai golpi tawh kidawn ahi a, kiha tulh ci bang om lo hi; azieh pen mi zosie in amau’ du za beh a dawnsah nading uh kumpipa in kumpi inn sunga vaihawm miliente thu a piehsa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua banah Kumpinu Vashti in zong numeite adingin Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ innsung ma-ah ankuong luina khat a siem hi."},"10":{"text":"A ni sagi ni-in zu dawnin a lungnop ciengin kumpipa in ama’ na a sem numete a uh cilgesa pasal sagite ahi Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, le Carkas-te thupie a,"},"11":{"text":"mite le miliente mai-ah a melhoina a lah thei nadingin a kumpi lukhu khusa-in ama kungah Kumpinu Vashti a peipi nadingin amate a sawl hi; azieh pen tua nu a mel hoi a, vel nuomnuom huoi vawt khat ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Kumpinu Vashti in numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte’ thupuoh ahi kumpipa hlatna nielin a pei nuom sih hi. Tam thu-ah kumpipa thangpai-in a sin a so hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in upadi siem mipilte thu dong hi. (azieh pen upadi le ngaina lam thutheite thudawh pen kumpipa’ zah ngai dan ahi hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuale ama’ zoma a to mite ahile Persia le Media gam milien sagite ahi Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, le Memucan-te ahi vua, amate pen kumpipa kunga a haw thei, kumpi gam sunga a to ulien masa pente ahi uhi):"},"15":{"text":"“Numei uh cilgesa pasalte tungtawnin Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ thupieh bangin Kumpinu Vashti gamta lo ahi ziehin upadi tawh kituohin bang kilaw ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Memucan in kumpipa le miliente mai-ah, “Kumpinu Vashti pen Kumpipa tung beha khiel ahi khop sih a, Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ gamkhen zosie sunga a teng mi zosie tunga zong a khiel ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile tami Kumpinu gamtatna pen numei zosie in ang thei ding vua, a pasalte uh simmawna-in hing nei-in amate in, ‘Kumpi Ahasuerus in ama kunga haw dingin Kumpinu Vashti thuta a, ama a pei sih hi,’ ang ci ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpinu gamtatna a za Persia le Media gam numei thupite in tuni mama-in zong kumpipa nei-a uliente ang ledo ding vua, lungthahna le kisimmawna a veng nawn sih ding hi!"},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in hoi na sah leh, kumpi thupiehna khat peisah inlen, Kumpipa Ahasuerus mai-ah Vashti ang peikia ngai nawn lo nading, Persia-te le Media-te’ upadi sungah a kikhel thei nawn lo dingin gielsah in; tuale kumpipa in ama sanga a kilawm zaw numei dang khat in tua nu’ kumpinu hina za luosah in."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa’ bawl thukhenna kumpi gam muncin tengah a kizah ciengin numei zosie in a neu a lien a kibangin a pasal ciet uh ang zatah ta ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa le milien teng in tam ngaisutna pen hoi a sa pai vua, Memucan’ gen bangin kumpipa in a bawl hi;"},"22":{"text":"ama in pasal zosie ama’ innsung uhpa ahi thei nading le ama’ minam ham a kizui kim thei nadingin, kumpipa’ uhna gamkhen zosie-ah amau’ lai ciet le, mi zosie tungah amau’ ham cietin laihlahte kigiel hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thu teng a pien zaw, Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ lungthahna a ven ciengin ama in Vashti phawhin, tua nu gamtatna le ama tunga a thukhennate a phawhkia hi.","title":"Esther Kumpinu Suoh"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama a cing kumpipa’ nasemte in, “Kumpipa adingin ngahnu melhoi khangdawngte suisah in."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi khuo ahi Susa khuopi-a numeite’ inn ah a melhoi ngahnu khangdawng zosie a khawm dingin kumpi gamkhen zosie-ah uliente koi in. Numeite a uh kumpipa’ cilgesa pasal Hegai in numeite cingsah in; a melhoi theithei nadingun amate kizemsah in."},"4":{"text":"Tuale kumpipa a lungkimsah numei khu Vashti tangin kumpinu suoh heh,” a ci uhi. Kumpipa in tam thu pen pha a sa a, ama in tua bangin a bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua laitahin kumpi khuo Susa ah Benjamin-te Kish, a tapa Shimei, a tapa Jair, a tapa Mordecai a kici Jew-te khat a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Kish pen Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem panin Judah Kumpipa Jeconiah tawh sala a matte lahah a kihal khat ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:10-16; 2Khg 36:10"},"7":{"text":"Mordecai in a pano’ tanu Hadassah, Esther a kici mi khat kem hi, azieh pen ama in nu le a pa nei lo hi; tua numei nu a melhoi le a duongcing khat ahi a, a nu le a pa a si ciengin Mordecai in ama’ tanu dinga a kep ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa’ thupiehna le a thusuo a kizah ciengin kumpi khuo Susa-a Hegai kici pa’ kep dingin ngahnu tampite a kipeipi ciengin, Esther zong kumpi inn sunga numeite a cingpa Hegai kungah kizawpi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua numei in ama’ lunglam sukha a, a maipha a nga ziehin a kisiemna dingte le a an satanh a nawpieh pai a, kumpipa’ inn sung panin a kituomteel nasem numei sagi zong guonin, ama le a nasem numeite tungah numeite’ inn a hoipen mun a pie pai hi."},"10":{"text":"Esther in a mite tungah hile, a sanggamte tungah hile a theisah sih hi, azieh pen Mordecai in a gen vawt lo dingin ama thupie hi."},"11":{"text":"Esther bangci op a, ama in bang thu teng a tuoh diei ci thei nuomin numeite’ inn leituol ah nisielin Mordecai a vah kawikawi hi."},"12":{"text":"Numeite’ kisiem dan ding ngainate a om bangin hla sawm le ni a cin zaw ciengin Kumpi Ahasuerus kungah a banbanin numei zosie a kilah ding hun a tung hi. Amau’ kisiem dan tam bang ahi hi: Sathau le Myrrh panamtui tawh hla guh sung kipuo-in, panamtui tuomtuomte le kipuona dangte tawh hla guh sung ma kipuokia uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah numeite a pei ciengun numeite’ inn pan kumpipa’ inn ah amau’ dei popo kikengsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Nitah lamin tua nu pei a, zingmawng ciengin a nina numeite’ inn ah a kilekia phot vua, kumpipa’ numeite a uh cilgesa ameite a cing pasal Shaashgaz in amate kem hi. Kumpipa’ lunglam a suhkhah sih a, a min tawh a kihlatkia sih leh tua nu pen kumpipa kungah peikia nawn lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Mordecai in a tanu dinga a kep a pano Abihail’ tanu Esther hun tung a, kumpipa kungah a pei ciengin ama in numeite a cingpa, kumpipa’ numeite a uh cilgesa pasal Hegai’ gen teng simlo bangma a ngetbe sih hi. Tu-in ama a mu zosie in Esther a pahta ciet uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a uh zaw a kum sagina a hla sawmna ahi Tebeth hla sungin kumpi’ inn sunga Kumpi Ahasuerus kungah Esther a kipeipi ciengin,"},"17":{"text":"numei dangte zosie sangin kumpipa in Esther a itzaw hi; ama in ngahnu zosie sangin a maipha le lunglutna nga kha a, ama in tua nu lutungah kumpi lukhu khusah a, Vashti tangin kumpinu a suohsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in a uliente le a vaihawmpite adingin “Esther Pawi” a kici pawi thupi khat a bawlpieh hi. Ama in a gamkhen teng tungah zong zumkhah ni khat pie a, kumpipa’ min tawh a kilawm a kituoh letsongte zong a hawm hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngahnu siengthote a kisuhtuo ciengun kumpipa’ tunkotah Mordecai a to hi.","title":"Kisawmdapna Thu Mordecai in Mukhie"},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Mordecai in a hilsa bangin Esther in a sanggamte tungah hile, a minamte tungah hile pulah lo hi; azieh pen ama in a kep lai-in ama’ thu a man ma bangin tu-in zong Mordecai’ thu a mang hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa’ tunkotah Mordecai a to laitahin, kumpipa’ lupna tunkotcing Bigthan le Teresh a kici kumpipa’ numeite a uh cilgesa pasal nite lungthahin Kumpi Ahasuerus tha a sawm uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Mordecai in tua thu thei-in Kumpinu Esther kungah gen a, tuale Esther in Mordecai’ min tawh kumpipa kungah a gen hi."},"23":{"text":"A thu kikanin a kigen bangma ahi hi, ci-in a kithei ciengin ama gel sing tungah a kikhailia hi. Tami thupieng teng kumpipa muna-ah Kumpi Gam Tangthu Laibu sungah kiciemte hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thu teng zaw ciengin Kumpi Ahasuerus in Agag-te Hammedatha’ tapa Haman a za khangsah a, a naseppi miliente zosie sangin a lienzaw-in a koi hi.","title":"Haman in Jew-te Suhsiet Sawm"},"2":{"text":"Tuale kumpipa’ tunkota a suoh kha kumpipa’ nasemte zosie in Haman zatah bawlin a mai-ah a kun vangiam uhi; azieh pen ama tam banga kibawl ding ahi hi, ci-in kumpipa in thu a piehsa ahi hi. Hizongle ama’ mai-ah Mordecai kun loin zatahna zong pie lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa’ tunkota om kumpipa’ nasemte in Mordecai kungah, “Bang dinga kumpipa’ thupieh mang lo na hei?” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in ni khat zaw ni khat ama kungah a gen vua, ama in amau’ thugen a man nop lo ciengin, Mordecai’ thugente a kimang ding ma ahi amah ci a thei nadingun Haman kungah a khie uhi; bangzieh ahei cile ama pen Jew-te a hina thu amate kungah a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama mai-ah Mordecai kun loin zatahna a pieh lo lam a mu ciengin Haman thangpai mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanle ama in Mordecai khat guoh tunga a khut hlan ding pen bawltah a sa sih a, tuaci’n ama kungah Mordecai’ mite a kigenna bangin, Haman in Ahasuerus’ kumpi gam sung muncin tenga a om Mordecai’ mite ahi Jew zosie suhsiet a sawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Ahasuerus’ uh a kum sawm le nina, a hla masa pen ahi Nisan hla panin a ni ni, a hla hla-in Pur a kici aisanna tawh Haman mai-ah ai kisan a, a hla sawm le nina Adar hla a ni sawm le thum ni-in a aisan a pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Haman in Kumpipa Ahasuerus kungah, “Nangma’ kumpi gam sung gamkhen tenga mite lahah kithezahin a tuom om mi pawlkhat a om hi; amahaw’ ngainate pen adang mi zosie-a’ tawh kibang lo a, kumpipa’ thukhamte a zui sih uhi, tuaci’n kumpipa in bangma law loin amate na hici tanghla ding kilawm lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa in hoi na sah leh, amate a kisuhsiet nadingin thukhenna bawl inlen, kumpipa’ sumkholna sunga koi dingin kumpipa’ nasepna vaisaite khut sungah ngun talent tul sawm ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in ama’ khuta om a suoikaina khutsip a sutdawh a, Jew-te’ gal ahi Agag-te Hammedatha’ tapa Haman a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in Haman kungah, “Na sum gente le na mi gente zong nangma tungah ang kipie zo a, na dei bangin amate tungah kibawl ta’n,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin a hla masa a ni sawm le thum ni-in kumpipa’ thuvanpite zosie kihlan a, tuale Haman’ thupieh zosie tawh kizui-in kumpipa vaisaite, gamkhen zosie a uhte, minam zosie lahah miliente tungah lai kigiel hi, gamkhen zosie-ah amau’ lai ciet, mi zosie tungah amau’ ham cietin kigiel hi; kumpi Ahasuerus’ min tawh tami lai kigiel a, kumpipa’ khutsip tawh kitum hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi gamkhente zosie-ah laitaite lai kipiesah a, a hla sawm le nina, a ni sawm le thum ni, ni khat sungin Jew-te zosie a teh a khang, numei naupang susie-in thatin a suhmang nading ule amau’ neisa teng a tomgam nadingun thu kipie hi."},"14":{"text":"Khum ni-in mi zosie a baisa-in a op nadingun a kiteisawn thukhenna laidal khat ciet gamkhen mun zosie-ah kipuohin a kizasah kim ding ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupiehna tawh a mallangin laitaite pei-in kumpi khuopi Susa panin thukhenna lai kihawm hi. Kumpipa le Haman zu dawnin a toton uhi; ahi vangin Susa khuopi sung a buoi mama hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mordecai in tam thu kibawl teng zosie a thei ciengin a puon botkehin la-ip puon silin vut kibuoh a, nahpitahin a kaa kawmin khuo sungah a vah kawikawi hi;","title":"Jew-te Panpi dingin Esther Thukim"},"2":{"text":"kumpipa’ tunkotah ama peito hi, azieh pen kumpipa tunkot ah la-ip puon silte koima khat beh kilutsah lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupiehna le a thukhenna a tunna gamkhen zosie-a Jew-te lahah dana le kaana nasietahin omin, antangin kap le mau-in a om vua, a tamzawte in la-ip puon silin vut lahah a lum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Esther’ nasem numeite le numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte pei-in ama kungah a gen ciengun, kumpinu a da mama hi; ala-ip puon a sut nadingin ama in Mordecai adingin puonsilte a hlah hi; hinanle ama in tuate sang lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esther in kumpipa’ numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte lahah ama cing dinga kise ahi Hathach hlan a, bang zieha tam thu teng pieng ahei, ci Mordecai kunga kan dingin a sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa’ tunkot mai khuopi tuolzanga om Mordecai kungah Hathach pei a,"},"7":{"text":"tuale Mordecai in ama tunga a pieng thu zosie le Jew-te a kitha nadingin Haman in kumpipa’ sumkholna-ah pieh dinga a sum ciemza thu zosie ama kungah a gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Mordecai in zong amate suhsiet nading Susa khuopi-a kihawm thukhenna lai a kiteisawn khat ama pie a, ama in tua lai Esther lahin a thu a na gencien nading le, ama nu zong kumpipa kungah na pei pai a, a mite adingin ama kunga a va thumpieh dingin a sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Hathach pei-in Esther kungah Mordecai’ thugen teng a gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esther in Hathach hopi-in Mordecai tungah thu zasah a,"},"11":{"text":"“Kumpipa’ nasemte le kumpipa gamkhen sunga mite zosie in numei hile, pasal hile, hlat lopi-in kumpipa’ opna inn sungah a va mawh lut leh upadi khat beh om a, tua khu mi zosie a kibanga tha ding ahi hi. Kumpipa in a kham ciengkhut ama langah a na le leh beh tua mipa suohta ding a hina thu a theisa uh ahi hi. Keimama zong kumpipa kunga haw dinga ei kihlat lo zaw ni sawmthum bang pha ta hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Mordecai kungah Esther’ thugen teng a gen ciengun,"},"13":{"text":"Mordecai in amate kungah Esther a thuhkiana gen a, “Kumpipa’ inn sunga na op mawh vangin adang Jew-te zosie a kitha leh nang a suohta tuon dingin kingaisun sin."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tam bang hunin bangma gen loin na sip dide leh mundang khat panin Jew-te’ noptuom nading le hutkhiet na ding thu ang pieng veve ding a, ahi vangin nang le na pa’ innkuonte na si ding uhi. Tam bang hun ding ma-a kumpinu suoh na hi mel zong koi in thei ahei?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esther in amate kungah Mordecai a dawnna gen a,"},"16":{"text":"“Pei inlen, Susa khuopi-a Jew-te na mu zosie khawmin, kei tangin an na tang unlen, ni thum sung an ne lo tui dawn loin sun le zanin na om un. Keima le ka nasemte in note’ tan bangin ka na tang ding uhi. Tua zaw ciengin upadi tawh kituoh sih nanleh kumpipa kungah ka va haw ta ding hi; ka si le zong a si ka hi mai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mordecai pei-in Esther’ sawl bangin na zosie a bawl hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in a kumpi puon tawh Esther kisiemin, kumpipa’ kikhopna innkhan tawh a kigalsai kumpi’ inn leituol sung lamah a ding hi. Kumpi inn lutna tawh a kigalsai kumpi’ inn sunga kumpi topha tungah kumpipa a to hi.","title":"Esther’ Ankuong Luina"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa in inntuola a ding Kumpinu Esther a mu behin tua nu in ama’ maipha nga a, Esther lamah a khuta a tawi a kham ciengkhut a zah phei hi. Tua bepin Esther in ama nai a, kumpipa ciengkhut dawn a tham hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua nu kungah, “Kumpinu Esther aw, bang thu ahei? Na nget nop bang pen ahei? Nang tungah kumpi gam a phalkhat cieng nangawn ang kipie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esther in, “Kumpipa na lung lam ahile, kumpipa dinga ka bawl ka ankuonglui ne dingin tuni-in Haman tawh hing pei ta un,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in, “Eite in Esther’ dei banga i sep thei nadingin mallangin Haman vah lan ta un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Esther’ siemsa ankuong im dingin kumpipa le Haman a pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in zu a neh laitahun kumpipa in Esther kungah, “Na nget nop bang ahei? Ang kipie ding hi. Bang ahei na thum ding? Ka gam phalkhat cieng dong nangawn ang kipie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua bepin Esther in, “Nang tunga kang nget nop le kang thum nop pen tami ahi hi:"},"8":{"text":"Keima in kumpipa’ maipha ka nga a, kumpipa in ka ngetna le ka thumnate nei pieh nuom dinga ahile, keima in noma gel dinga ka bawl ka ankuonglui ne dingin zing ciengin kumpipa le Haman hing pei un. Tua ciengin keima in kumpipa’ gen bangin kang dawng ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum ni-in Haman lungdam kipahin a pei hi. Ahi vangin kumpi tunkot gei-a om Modecai in a mai-ah na ding beh lo a, zatahna lim a na lah lo a mu ciengin, Mordecai tungah ama lungthah mama hi;","title":"Haman in Mordecai Thasawm"},"10":{"text":"hizongle ama le ama ki-ip kenkonin inn-ah Haman a pei hi. Tua ciengin a guolte le a zi Zeresh hlan a,"},"11":{"text":"a hauna thupi dante, a tapa nei teng, kumpipa in pahta-in a za a khansahna teng, kumpipa’ uliente le vaihawmte sangin a lienzaw-in ama a koina thu zosie amate kungah a gen hi."},"12":{"text":"Haman in genbe lai a, “Kumpinu Esther nangawn in a bawlsa ankuong luina-ah kumpipa tawh ankuong im dingin kei ci simlo midang koima peisah lo hi. Zing ciengin zong kumpipa tawh ankuong imton dingin ama in ei hlan lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa’ tunkot ah a to Jew-te Mordecai ka mu laisie tam teng zosie a mawhna suoh zel hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin a zi Zeresh le a guolte zosie in ama kungah, “Tong sawmnga a sang khuom phutsah inlen, tua tungah Modecai a kikhailia nadingin zing ciengin kumpipa kungah gen in; tua ciengin ankuong im dingin kumpipa tawh lung nuomtahin pei in,” a ci uhi. Haman in tam thu hoi sa a, tuaci’n a gui-awh nading khuom ama a phutsah hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuami zanin kumpipa kimu thei lo a, thupieng teng ciemtena laibu lasahin a mai-ah tuate kisim hi.","title":"Kumpipa in Mordecai Patawi"},"2":{"text":"Tua banga a kisim ciengin, kotcing, kumpipa’ numeite a uh cilgesa pasal Bigthan le Teresh in kumpipa Ahasuerus tha a sawmdapna uh Mordecai in a genkhiet, thu ciemtena sunga kigiel kimu hi.","ref":"Est 2:21-22"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in, “Tami thu ziehin Mordecai tungah patawina ahi sihle minphatna bang a kipie zo ta ahei?” a ci hi. Ama a cing kumpipa’ nasemte in, “Ama ading bangma khat beh kibawlpieh lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Inn tuolah koi a om ei?” a ci hi. Tua laitahin Haman in Mordecai khailia nadinga a bawl khuom tungah ama a kikhailia nading thu a gen dingin kumpipa’ inntuol pulamah a lut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa’ nasemte in ama kungah, “Khum sungah Haman om hi; inn tuolah ding hi,” a ci uhi. Kumpipa in, “Ama hing lutsah un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Haman lut a, kumpipa in ama kungah, “Kumpipa in a patawi nuom mipa tungah bang kibawlpieh leh hoi na sa ei?” a ci hi. Haman in a lungsim sungah ngaisun a, “Kumpipa in keima kana a patawi nop zawh ding koi om tuon ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Haman in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa in na patawi nop mipa adingin,"},"8":{"text":"kumpipa’ silsa ahi kumpi puonte, kumpipa tuonna sakol a kumpi lukhu tawh lasah in."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa’ milien pen khat kungah tua kumpi puonte le sakol piesah in; ama in kumpipa patawi nop mipa kumpi puon silsah hinlen, ama in sakol tungah tua mipa tuongsahin khuopi gawlzing lampi tengah kaisah kawikawi inlen, ama mai-ah, ‘Kumpipa’ patawi nop mipa tungah tam bangin kibawl ding hi,’ ci-in tangtawhsah in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Haman kungah, “Na gensa bangin mallangin kumpi’ puonte le sakol va la ta’nlen, kumpipa’ tunkota a to Mordecai tungah va bawl ta’n. Na gensa khat beh hen nei sin,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Haman in kumpi puonte le sakol la-in Mordecai silsah a, khuopi gawlzing lampi tengah tuongsahin, “Kumpipa in a patawi nop mipa tungah tam bangin kibawl ding hi,” ci-in tang a tawh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa’ tunkotah Mordecai peikia a, ahi vangin Haman ahile puon kilukhu-in a kaa pumin a inn ah a nawpei ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Haman in ama tunga thupieng teng zosie a zi Zeresh le a guolte kungah a gen ciengin, a zi Zeresh le a thumop mite in ama kungah, “Na lel ngai pa Mordecai khu Jew-te ahi poma leh ama na zo sih ding a, ama’ masangah a pua valon ding na hi hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate a kiho laitahun kumpipa’ numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte a tung vua, Esther ankuong luina-a pei dingin Haman a naw zawpi uhi.","title":"Haman’ Lelna le Mordecai Kitawisangna"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpinu Esther tawh ankuong im dingin kumpipa le Haman a pei uhi."},"2":{"text":"A ni ni ni, amate in zu a dawn laitahun kumpipa in Esther kungah, “Kumpinu Esther aw, na thum nop pen bang ahei? Ang kipie ding hi. Na nget nop pen bang ahei? Ka gam phalkhat cieng nangawn ang kipie ding hi,” a cikia hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esther in dawng a, “Kumpipa aw, keima in na maipha nga-in, tuami in kumpipa ang lungkimsah leh, keima ei hingkhawi in - tua khu kang thum nop pen ahi a - ka mite zong hing hingkhawi in- tua khu kang nget nop pen ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima le ka mite suhsiet ding, thagam ding, le suhmaimang dinga ei kizua ahi ta hi. Ko numei le pasal teng pen sal maimai dinga ei kizua ding hi leh bangma ka gen sih ding hi; ahi vangin koima galte in kumpipa tunga a tung tami sietna a lokia zo sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpipa Ahasuerus in Kumpinu Esther kungah, “Tami a bawl ngam ding koi hi a, ama hei sunga om ahei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Esther in, “Keima ei langpang le ka galpa ahi tami migilo Haman a khu!” a ci hi. Tua ciengin kumpipa le kumpinu mai-ah Haman zau-in a citun hi."},"7":{"text":"A lungthah sengin ankuong panin kumpipa dingdawh a, kumpi um sungah a vah kawikawi hi, hizongle kumpinu tungah a suohta nading ngenin Haman a om den hi, azieh pen ama in kumpipa in ama suhsiet a sawm lam a thei hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpite’ um panin a ankuong imna innpi-ah a kilekia ciengin, kumpipa in Esther kingapna topha tunga a pua Haman a mu hi. Tuale kumpipa in, “Ka inn sung ka muna nangawnah tam mipa in kumpinu buon sawm ahi amah?” a ci hi. Kumpipa in tua bang a gen behin amate in zong puon tawh Haman’ mai a khu pai uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa’ nasem numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte lahah Harbona kici pa in, “En in, ama’ kammal tawh kumpipa a na suohta sah ngai ahi Mordecai a khailia nadingin Haman in tong sawmnga a sang khuom a bawl pen Haman inn ah kiphut lai hi,” a ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Tua tungah Haman khailia un,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Mordecai khailia nadinga a na bawl khuom tungah Haman a khailia uhi. Tua ciengin kumpipa’ lungthahna a veng hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum ni-in Kumpipa Ahasuerus in Kumpinu Esther tungah Jew-te’ galpa Haman’ neisa zosie a pie hi; tuale Esther in Mordecai koi ahei ci kumpipa kungah a gensa ahi ziehin kumpipa mai-ah Mordecai a pei hi.","title":"Esther in Jew-te Hunkhie"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Haman kung pana a lah ahi suoikaina khutsip sutin Moredecai a pie hi. Tuaci’n Esther in Haman’ inn sunga a vaihawm dingin Mordecai a koi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Esther in kumpipa a hopikia hi; a keng bulah a kaa kawmin tua nu khupbawh a, Agag-te Haman’ gitlo vaihawmna le Jew-te kitha nadinga a sawmdapna thute a kidawkia nadingin a thum hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in Esther lamah a kham ciengkhut a zamsah phei a,"},"5":{"text":"tuale Esther tho-in kumpipa mai-ah a ding hi. Ama nu in, “Kumpipa’ lung lam su kha-in, a maipha ka nga a, kumpipa mai-ah thuman ahi a, ama’ lungkimna ka nga leh, kumpi gamkhen zosie-a om Jew-te kitha nading a sawm Agag-te Hammedatha’ tapa Haman’ thupiehna lai kihawmte a kidawkia thei nadingin thupiehna lai khat gielsahkia in."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in ka mite tunga a tung tuosietna ka mu ding bangci thuoh ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpipa Ahasuerus in Kumpinu Esther le Jew-te Mordecai kungah, “En vawi, Haman’ neisa zosie Esther ka pie zo a, amate in sing tungah ama khailia zo uhi, azieh pen ama in Jew-te tha a sawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa’ min tawh a kigiel thukip lai, kumpipa’ suoikaina khutsip tawh a kitumsa lai pen kidawh thei ta lo ahi ziehin, Jew-te tawh kisai-in hoi na sah bangin kumpipa’ min tawh lai giel inlen, kumpipa’ suoikaina khutsip tawh tum in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Sivan hla a kici a hla thumna a ni sawmni le thum ni-in kumpipa’ thuvanpite kihlan a, Mordecai’ thupieh zosie tawh kituohin Jew-te le India panin Ethiopia dong gam zakhat le sawmni le sagi a uh kumpipa’ vaisaite, gamkhen uhte, le miliente tungah lai kihawmkia a, a gamkhen cietah amau’ lai le amau’ minam cietah amau’ ham ciet tawh kigiel a, Jew-te tungah zong amau’ lai le amau’ ham ma tawh kigiel hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ min tawh laite gielin kumpipa’ suoikaina khutsip tawh tuate tum a, kumpipa adinga a kikhawi kumpi sakol buh sunga sakol hatte tungah amate tuongsahin lai kitaisah hi."},"11":{"text":"Hla sawm le nina ahi Adar hla a ni sawm le thumna ni khat sungin Kumpi Ahasuerus’ uhna gamkhen sung khuo zosie-a om Jew-te kikhawmin a hinna uh a kihundawh nading, minam khat’ galkapte ahi sihle gamkhen a sim dingte pen a numei a naupangin susie a, thatgamin a suhmang nading ule a neisate a tomgam nadingun tami laihawmna tawh kumpipa in Jew-te tungah bawl theina thu a pie hi.","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Gamkhen zosie-ah a kiteisawn thukhenna lai khat ciet kihawmin mi zosie kitheisah a, Jew-te ahile tua ni-in a galte tungah phu la dinga kigingkhol ding uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa’ sakol hatte tungah laitaite tuongin kumpipa’ thupieh bangin a nawtai uhi. Kumpi khuo ahi Susa khuopi sungah tua thukhenna lai kihawm hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mordecai in kumpi puon a dum le a kang silin kham tawh a kibawl kumpi lukhu golpi khat khu a, saihadiel puonnel le puon sandup silsa-in kumpipa opna panin pusuoh a, tua laitahin Susa khuopi sunga om mi zosie lungdam kipahin a awng uhi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Jew-te adingin lungdamna, kipahna le patawina a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thukhenna le a thupieh a tunna gamkhen zosie le khuopi zosie sunga a om Jew-te lahah lungdamna le kipahna, pawite le zumkha ni a om hi. Tua banah khum gama mi tampite in Jew-te a giin ziehun Jew mi ka hi hi, a kici uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupieh le a thukhenna a kisep ding kuon laitah, amate tungah Jew-te’ galte guol zo dinga a kinep ni uh, hizongle thu kikhelin Jew-te in a galte tunga a guolzaw ni ding uh, a hla sawm le nina Adar hla a ni sawm le thum ni-in,","title":"Jew-te’ Galte Kisuhsietna"},"2":{"text":"a siet nading uh a suite a susie dingin Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ uhna gamkhen zosie-a om amau’ khuopite-ah Jew-te a kikhawm uhi. Mi zosie in Jew-te a giin ziehun koima in amate nang zo lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in Mordecai a giin ziehun gamkhen zosie sunga miliente, kumpipa’ vaisaite, le gamkhen uhte in Jew-te a panpi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Mordecai in kumpi’ inn sungah thu nei mama a, a thuneina khang semsem ahi ziehin gamkhen zosie-ah a minthanna kizel hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jew-te in namsau tawh a galte zosie uh that a, amate a mudate tungah dei bangin a bawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpi khuo Susa khuopi sungah Jew-te in mi zanga thatin susie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,"},"8":{"text":"Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,"},"9":{"text":"Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, Vaizatha,"},"10":{"text":"Jew-te’ gal ahi Hammedatha’ tapa Haman’ tapa sawmte that uhi; ahi vangin amate in ama’ vante a thamkha sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khum ni mama-in kumpipa tungah kumpi khuo Susa khuopi sunga a kithat mi phaza kizasah hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa in Kumpinu Esther kungah, “Kumpi khuo Susa khuopi sungah Jew-te in mi zanga a that zo ta vua, Haman’ tapa sawmte zong that zo uhi. Kumpipa’ uhna adang gamkhen tengah bang teng khat a bawl ta ding vuoi? Tu-in bang na ngen nuom lai ei? Na nget popo ang kipie ding hi. Bang nget be nuom lai na hei? Na nget popo ang kipie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Esther in, “Kumpipa in hoi na sah leh, tuni-a thukhenna tawh kizui-in zing ciengin zong Susa khupi sunga om Jew-te tungah bawl thei nading phalna pie inlen, Haman’ tapa sawmte sing khuom tungah khailiasah in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in tua banga a kibawl nadingin thu pie a, Susa khuopi sungah thukhenna kibawlin Haman’ tapa sawmte a kikhailia sieng hi."},"15":{"text":"Adar hla a ni sawm le li ni-in Susa khuopi sunga om Jew-te a kikhawmkia vua, Susa khuopi sungah mi zathum that uhi. Hizongle amate in van a thamkha sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in a hinna uh hu dingin kumpipa’ uhna gamkhen teng sunga om Jew-te zong kikhawmin a galte’ khut sung panin suotahna a nga vua, amate a muda mihing tul sawmsagi le tulnga that uhi. Ahi vangin amate in vante tungah a khut a ngam sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam banga a bawlna uh pen Adar hla a ni sawm le thum ni hi a, a ni sawm le li ni-in a tawlnga vua, khum ni pen pawi bawlni le lungdam ni a hisah uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin ni sawm le thum ni le ni sawm le li ni-in Susa khuopi sunga om Jew-te kikhawmin, ni sawm le ngana ni-in a tawlnga vua, khum ni pen pawi bawl ni le lungdam ni ahisah uhi.","title":"Purim Pawi Kibawl"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khuoneute le kulpi a nei lo khuopite sunga a teng Jew-te in Adar hla a ni sawm le li ni pen pawi bawlna le khatlekhat an kithahna ni-in a zang uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mordecai in tam thu teng lai-in ciemte a, Kumpipa Ahasueras’ uhna a nai a gamla-a om gamkhen zosie sunga Jew-te zosie tungah lai a hlah hi."},"21":{"text":"A kumkumin Adar hla ni sawm le li ni le sawm le nga ni pen amate in a tan nadingun thu pie a,"},"22":{"text":"tua nite-in amau’ galte panin Jew-te a suotah ni uh ahi a, tua hla pen amate dingin dana panin lungdamna, tauna le thumna panin tawlngah ni khatin a kikhelna hla ahi sah hi. Tuaci’n amate in khum ni tegel pawibawl ni le lungdam ni a suohsah vua, amate in khatlekhat an kithahna ni le mizawngte tunga letsong pieh ni-in a nei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Mordecai in amate kunga lai a na giel bangin amate in a na patsa uh tam banga a bawlnate uh Jew-te in ngaina khatin a zang uhi."},"24":{"text":"Jew-te zosie’ galpa ahi Hammeda-tha’ tapa, Agag-te Haman in Jew-te suhmang ding na sawm a, ama in amate gawtin a suhmang nadingin Pur kici ai a san hi.","ref":"Est 3:7"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa’ mai-ah Esther a tun ciengin, Jew-te suhsiet nadinga a gitlo sawmna teng pen ama’ lu tungah a tuh nading, le sing khuom tungah ama le a tate a kikhailia nadingin kumpipa in lai gielin thu a pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tam nite Pur kammal panin Purim na kici ahi hi. Tua ahi ciengin amate in tami laihlah sunga kigiel thute zosie, le tam thute a mit utawh mu-in a pumpi utawh a tuona uh ziehin,"},"27":{"text":"Jew-te in amate, a suon a hlahte ule amate a pawm mite in tam ni nite gel pen ngaina khatin sangin, lai sunga kigiel bangin kumsiela a kise hunin a pel loin a tan nadingun a kipsah uhi."},"28":{"text":"A khangkhangin innkuon sim, gamkhen sim, khuopi simah tam nite kiphawhin kitang ding hi; tuale Jew-te lahah tami Purim nite pen tan lo thei lo hi ding a, a suonlehlahte uh lahah tam nite phawna pawi a bawl zing ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Abigail’ tanu Kumpinu Esther in Jew-te Mordecai tawh a bukim thuneina tawh a giel uh tami Purim tungtang thu a niveina laihlah pen a kipsah uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ahasuerus’ kumpi gama gamkhen za le sawmni le sagi sunga om Jew-te zosie tungah kilemna le lungmuonna a op nading deisahna laite kihlah a,"},"31":{"text":"Jew-te Mordecai le Kumpinu Esther in Jew-te tunga a kipsah uh ma bangin a kisesa amau’ hunin tami Purim nite a kitan nadingin thu kipie hi. Tua ma bangin amate le a suon a hlahte adingin antan nading le thumna nei nading tawh kisai ngainate a giel uhi."},"32":{"text":"Kumpinu Esther’ thupiehna in tam Purim tawh kisai zui ding ngainate kipsah a, tam thute lai sungah kiciemte hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahasuerus in a uhna gam sung le tuipi tunga om tuikul gamte tungah sieh kai hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama’ vanglietna le a sepnate zosie, le Mordecai tunga a pieh minphatnate, Media le Persia Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigiel hi lo amah?"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Kumpipa Ahasuerus’ zomah Mordecai a zalien pen ahi a, tuale ama in a mite’ hoi nading sui a, a suonlehlahte zosie’ nopsah nading a thumpieh ziehin Jew-te lahah ama in thu nei a, a unaute lahah zong a minthang hi."}}}}},"18":{"info":{"name":"Job","shortname":"Job","abbr":[],"desc":"Job laibu (the book of job)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uz gamah Job kici mi khat a om hi. Tua mipa nuol baang lo, a thutang, Pasien a giing le sietna lam a pel mi khat ahi hi.","title":"Job le A Innkuonte"},"2":{"text":"Ama in tapa sagi le tanu thum nei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in tuu tulsagi, kalaoh tulthum, bawngtang kap zanga, laa pi zanga le nasem tampi nei hi; tuaci’n tam mipa pen nisuona gama mi zosie sungah a haupen ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’ tapate an kikumin inn khat pan inn khatah a ban banin pei kawikawi uhi; tuale amate in a nehpi a dawnpi dingun amau’ sanggam numei thum a ciel let uhi."},"5":{"text":"A pawi bawl uh viel khat a kihlit zaw ciengin Job in amate hlanin siensuo a, zingmawngin ama thobai-in a tapate zosie adingin a phaza tawh kizui-in meihal biehnate a pie hi; azieh pen Job in, “Ka tapate tawnkhielin a lungsim vuah Pasien na samsie kha thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni khat Topa mai-a kilah dingin van mite a pei vua, amate lahah Satan zong kihal hi.","title":"Job’ Hoina Kido","ref":"Pien 6:2"},"7":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Nang hei pana hing pei na hei?” a ci hi. Satan in Topa kungah, “Leitungah ka vah kawikawi a, tunglam le neilam ka kawmna pana ang pei ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Ka nasem Job na phawh kha ngai ei mah? Nuol a baang lo, a thutang, Pasien giingin sietna a pel ama tawh a kibang leitungah om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua bepin Satan in Topa dawng a, “Job in Pasien ang mawh giin ahi amah?"},"10":{"text":"Ama le a inn le a neisa zosie kimvelah dai kai hi lo na mah? Nang in a sepna zosie thupha na buoh a, gam sungah ama’ neisa a pung hi."},"11":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in na khut zahin a neisa zosie lahpieh lacin na maitang mama-ah hing gausam pai ta va,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 12:10"},"12":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Hoi pai e, a neisa zosie nangma’ thu hi taheh; a tung behah na khut hlang sih po lacin!” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Topa kung panin Satan a pusuoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni khat a sanggam pasal a tapen pa uh’ inn ah a tapate le a tanute an ne-in zu dawnin a op laitahun,","title":"Job in Neilelam le Tate Taan"},"14":{"text":"kamtai khat tungin Job kungah, “Bawngtangte in lo kai-in tuate gei-ah laate a gamtat laitahin"},"15":{"text":"Sebea-te in ei simin tuate a kaimang ta vua, namsau tawh nasemte a that sieng ta uhi; nang kunga gen dinga kei beh ang suohta ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A thugen a hlit masangin adang khat tung leuleu a, “Vantung panin Pasien’ meikuong khat ang kiesuh a, tuute le a nasemte a katum sieng ta hi; nang kunga gen dinga kei beh ang suohta ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A thu gen a hlit masang ma-in adang khat tung leuleu a, “Chaldea-te pawl thum kisuo-in kalaohte ang bulu vua, a kaimang sieng ta uhi. Nasemte zong namsau tawh a that sieng ta uhi; nang kunga gen dinga kei beh ang suohta ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"A thu gen a hlit masangin adang khat tungkia a, “Na tapate le na tanute in a sanggam pasal tapen pa’ inn ah an ne zu dawnin a op laitahun,"},"19":{"text":"thakhatthu-in senel gam panin huipi hat mama khat ang lang a, inn ningli teng semmangin, nungah tangvalte tungah kiesuh a, amate a si sieng uhi; nang kunga gen dinga kei beh ang suohta ka hi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job dingin a puon balkeh a, a sam heukieu-in lei-ah bohsuhin Pasien a bie hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka nu sung pan guohtangin ka suoh a, guohtang ma-in ka kilekia ding hi; Topa in ei pie a, Topa ma in a kilahkia ta hi; Topa’ min phatin om taheh” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam thu zosie-ah Job maw loin Pasien zong mawsah lo hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Topa kungah van mite a kilah dingin a tung vua, Topa mai-a kilah dingin Satan zong amate lahah a pei hi.","title":"Ama’ Cidamna Tungah Job Kisim"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Nang hei pana hing pei na hiei?” a ci hi. Satan in Topa kungah, “Leitungah ka vah kawikawi a, tunglam le neilam ka kawmna pana ang pei ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Ka nasem Job na phawh kha ngai ei mah? A nuol baang lo, a thutang, Pasien giingin sietna a pel ama tawh a kibang leitungah koima om lo hi,” a ci hi. A hang om lo pi-in ama suhsiet dinga kei nei hantawh vangin ama in a citahna a hlasuo nai deh sih hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Satan in Topa dawng a, “Vun tangin vun!
