Mite in amau’ hinna a hutdam nadingin a neisa zosie uh a pie ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in na khut zah inlen, a gu le a telte va khoipieh lacin na maitang mama-ah hing gausam pai ta va” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Hoi pai lien e, ama nangma thu thu ahi ta hi; a hinna khat beh khawipieh in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa kung panin Satan pusuoh a, Job a ketaw pan a luvum dongin a kidahhuoi hima a veisah hi."},"8":{"text":"Job in a kikhuot nading beelkeh khat la a, vut lahah a to hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a zi in ama kungah, “Na citahna tudet tentun lai ding na mah? Pasien gausam inlen kisi ta ven,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a zi kungah, “Numei mawte kamham bangin na ham hi. Pasien kung panin a hoi sang hi vei, a sie zong i sang sih ding amah?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in Job’ khanguol thum, Teman-te Eliphaz, Shuh mi Bildad, le Naamah mi Zophar-te in ama tunga a tung tam gimnate zosie a zah ciengun, a inn ciet panun ama hlai ding le henem dingin a kuon uhi.","title":"Job’ Khanguol Thumte"},"12":{"text":"Amate in a gamla panin ama a galmu ciengun a thei pah ta sih vua, tuale amate in a aw uh sangsahin a gingin a kap uhi; amate in a puon uh a botkeh vua, a lu tung vua tukia dingin van lamah leivui a septo uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in sun sagi le zan sagi sung tuol puongah ama a topi vua, tuale koima in ama kam khat beh a hopi ngam sih uhi, azieh pen ama’ thuohna a natsiet lamtah amate in a mu uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin Job in a kam kah a, a pien ni a gausam hi.","title":"Job in A Suoni Gausam"},"2":{"text":"Job in gen hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Ka suo ni le ‘Nausen pasal khat gai hi,’ a kici zan mangthai taheh."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni khu khimzin ni suoh taheh! Tung Pasien in tua khu sui da se hinlen, ahi sihle tua tungah khuovah zong tang da kon heh."},"5":{"text":"Khuoniim le mielkiing in lie taheh. Meiipi in a tungah tuom hinlen; sun mielking in zausah taheh."},"6":{"text":"Khummi zan khu khuomiel sapi in mancip taheh! Kum khat sunga nidangte tawh kisimtha da hinlen; hla min kisimte lahah zong kihal da mai taheh."},"7":{"text":"Ou e, khum zanin nau pieng sih taheh; tua sungah nopna kikona aw kizah da kon heh."},"8":{"text":"Leviathan a phin theite, mi samsie theite in tua Tuipi khu samsie taheh."},"9":{"text":"Phalvah huna zingsol aasite miel taheh; tua in khuovah lamen hinlen, hinanle khat zong mukha sih heh; zingkal phalvah zong mu kha da taheh."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen tua in ka nu sunga naubu kotte a na khah lo ziehin, ka muna panin lungkhamna a na phuolmang sih hi."},"11":{"text":"“Bang dingin a sisa-in na suoh kon lo a, bang dingin ka nu sunga ka suo behin na si pai lo ka hei?"},"12":{"text":"Bang dingin ei tawi ding khup om a, ka tawp ding nawi na om kha kawi adiei?"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in ahile hanah lumin ka sip dide ta ding hi; ka kimu hit hiet ta ding a; tua ciengin ka tawlnga ta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate dinga khuopi sie a lamkia leitunga kumpite le a thu kuppite tawh,"},"15":{"text":"ahi sihle a inn uh kham le ngun tawh a kidim uliente tawh nuomtahin ka khawl ta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi sihle bang dinga a hla cing lo-a suohte le, khuovah mu ngai nai lo-a a si nausen khat bangin, ei na kivui kha lo adiei?"},"17":{"text":"Khumnah migilote in buoisah nawn loin, khumnah a basamte a tawlnga uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khumnah thongkiete in nuom saton ding uhi. Amate in nasem uhpa’ husa a za kha nawn sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Khumnah a lien a neu omton valiei a, silate nasan a pupa kung pan suohta uhi.","ref":"Jer 20:14-18"},"20":{"text":"“Bang dingin mi genthei pa khuovah kimusah a, hin genthei-a hing pa zong hinna kipie ahei?"},"21":{"text":"Si ding a ngahla vangut mite tungah sina a tung thei vawt sih a, a kiphuol gougil taw sangin kithuhtawzaw hi.","ref":"Kln 9:6"},"22":{"text":"Amate in hankhuh a mu ciengun, kipahin a lungdam ngel sih uh amah?"},"23":{"text":"A lampi a mu vawt lo mipa, Pasien in dai a kaipieh mipa tungah bang dingin khuovah kipie ahei?"},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen ka khuisahna ka an tawh kibang a, ka mauna khu tui kibua tawh a kibang hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka giingiin thu ka tungah ang tung tahtah a, ka zauzau thu ka tungah ang tung ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Lungnuomin ka om sih a, sip dide-in zong ka om sih hi; tawlngah hun ka nei sih a; hinanle gimna ang tung hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Teman-te Eliphaz in tam bangin a dawng hi:","title":"Eliphaz in Gen: Job Maw Zo"},"2":{"text":"“Mi khat in kam khat hing genpi leh na lungthah diei mah? Ahi vangin, koi ahei ham lo phun lo-a om ding?"},"3":{"text":"En vawi, nang in mi tampi na hil zo ta a, khutkham bankhamte zong na hatsah zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Na kammal in a kipalpuate phongto zo a, a khupzaw mite na ding detsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in na tungah tua khu ang tung ta a, nang in thuohha na sa hi; tuami in nang ang sukha a, nang na lung a tawp hi."},"6":{"text":"Na Pasien giinna khu na muonna ahi a, na thumanna lampi na hlasuo lona khu na kinepna hi lo amah?"},"7":{"text":"“Tu-in ngaisun vawi le, mawna nei lopi-in koi a kisusie ngai ta ahei? Ahi sihle a thutang mite hei-ah a mangthai ta ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Lo bangin gitlona kai a, buoina a tu mipa in a gamtat bangin a ga a at lam keima in ka mu zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien’ husan tawh amate a kisie vua, a lungthahna hui in amate a katum hi."},"10":{"text":"Humpinelkai’ hawhna, a giinhuoi humpi awging a dai ta a, tuale humpi note’ hate zong tawng sieng zo ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Sa mat ding a nei lo humpi khu a mangthai a, humpi note a kithezah uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Tu-in kei kungah thu khat ang kidap gen a, ka bil in tua ang kidapgen thu a za hi."},"13":{"text":"Zan mang sungah lunggel zosie a kilah laitah, mite a ihsip laitahin,","ref":"Job 33:15"},"14":{"text":"ka tungah zauna ang tung a, ka citunin ka gu ka tang zosie a kithingsah gawp hi."},"15":{"text":"Hlagau khat in ka mai ang zapsuh a; ka cimul ang tho hi."},"16":{"text":"Khumi khu a ding den a, hizongle a mel puoh ka khen thei sih hi. Ka mithla-ah a guong khat ang kisung hi; a sip khian a, tua zaw-in awging khat ka za hi:"},"17":{"text":"Pasien mai-amihingte a thuman zo ding uh amah? A siem pa mai-ah mihingte a siengtho zo ding uh amah?"},"18":{"text":"A nasemte lah bawnah tahsanna nei loin a vantung mite mawsah lai ahile;"},"19":{"text":"tungman inn sunga tengte, a inn khuombul lei lah ahi, nget banga kituoncilte khu bang a ci tahsan sih kan lai diei?"},"20":{"text":"Zingkal nitah kalin amate kisusie hi; koima’ khawhsah loin amate a si den ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate sungah a puonbuh khau uh a kibot dawh a, tuale amate pilna tasamin a silaw ding uhi,’ ei ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tu-in hlan vawi ta, ang dawng ding koi a om ei? A siengtho koi pen kunga kinuahei sawm na hei?","title":"Pasien in Job Thuhil"},"2":{"text":"A tahtahin mimawpa in a lungthahna silaw a, thangsietna in mimawlte sisah hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in mimawte zunghlah dan ka mu a, ahi vangin a tenna uh awsie ka law zuai ta hi."},"4":{"text":"A tate uh ahile bihna tawh a kigam la vua, khuopi tunkotah amate kituonciin, amate a hum ding koima om lo hi."},"5":{"text":"A gilkiel mite in a anlahte uh a ne vua, amate in lingte lah pan nangawnin a la uhi; Tuale a dangtate in zong amau’ nei le lamte a lunggul uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen lunggimna khu lei lah panin ang pei sih a, buoina zong khu tuolgum pana ang pei ahi kan sih hi;"},"7":{"text":"ahi vangin meisite a tung lamah a lento bang lienin, mihingte zong khu a gim dinga suoh uh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Kei ka hi leh Pasien ka sui ding a, Pasien tungah ka vaite ka ap ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in na lienpite le sui zawh lo nate, sim zawh lo na lamdangte a bawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in lei tungah guo zusah a, lolai-ah tui a luongsah hi;"},"11":{"text":"ama in a nei lut mite domsang a, a kap a maute bihna ah a lamto hi."},"12":{"text":"A khelpilte a lawcin lo nadingin, ama in a gelnate uh a suhsietpieh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in mipilte pen amau’ khelpilna ma tawh man a, ama in mi lungkawite’ ngimna zong a naw khawlsah hi.","ref":"1Cor 3:19"},"14":{"text":"Amate in sun lai-in khuomiel a tuoh kha vua, zanlai bangin a kimaimaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle ama in a kam sung vua namsau pan le mi thahatte panin tasamte hunkhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n mizawngte in kinepna a nei vua, thuman lo mite in a kam a hum uhi."},"17":{"text":"“Pasien’ phawsiet mite khu mi nuomsa ahi uhi; tua ziehin Vanglienpa’ khalna khu thudon loin om sin.","ref":"Pau 3:11-12; Heb 12:5-6"},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in liemsah a, ahi vangin ama in a tunpieh vanuh hi. Ama in a vuo a, a khut in a damsah zel hi.","ref":"Hos 6:1"},"19":{"text":"Ama in buoina nam guh panin nangma ang hunkhie ding a, a sagi veina-ah sietna in ang sukha ta sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in kielpi sunga sina pan le galpi sunga namsau panin nangma ang tankhie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Gensietna panin ang kiphuol ding a, kisietna ang tun ciengin na zau sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nang in suhsiet ding le kiel tun dingte na nuisan lel ding a, nangma in leitung gamsate na giing sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen lo-a suongte tawh na kipawl ding a, gamsate tawh na kilem ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Nangma in na buh a muonhuoi lam na thei ding a, na tuubuh na van ciengin bangma pelem lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na suonlehlahte tampi pha-in, nangma sunga piengte zong leitung lopa za pha ding hi, ci thu nangma in na thei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A hun ciengin ancilna phuolah bulom a tun ma bangin vuoisi-in han na zuon ding hi."},"27":{"text":"En vawi, kote in tam teng ka na kantel vua, tua khu a thuman ma a na hi hi. Ngai inlen, na hoi nadingin kithei siem ta’n,” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in a dawng hi:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Ka Phunna Man hi, Ci"},"2":{"text":"“Ka lungbuoina khu te thei hi hinlen, ka tuosietna teng kitawite thei le izaw!"},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua khu tuipi senel sangin a gihzaw ding hi; tua ahi ziehin ka kamhamte a khauh kha ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Vanglienpa’ thaltang ka sungah om a; keima sungah a gu kidie hi; Pasien’ zauhuoinate in kei ei do dingin a kiguol uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gam laate in lopa a neh ciengun hamin, ahi sihle bawngtang in butu a neh ciengin a awng amah?"},"6":{"text":"Ci saw loin antui lote kine thei a, aatui lamte sungah a tuina a om amah?"},"7":{"text":"Tuate dugaw-in ka ciem nuom sih a; tuate pen a luohsuohuoi an tawh kibang lel hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ka ngetna khu kinga hinlen, Pasien in ka lunggul ei pie ding hi le maw."},"9":{"text":"Pasien in keima ei mehcip nuom hinlen, ama in a khut hing hlasuhin ei that mai le izaw!"},"10":{"text":"Tami khu ka kihenepna ahi ding a; ka thuohna nangawnah nuomin ka kipah ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile keima in Siengtho Pa’ thu ka niel sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in ka nga thaw nadingin ka thahatna khu bang ahei? Ka lungduoi zawh nadingin a tawpna-a ka nga ding khu bang ahiei?"},"12":{"text":"Ka thahatna khu suong’ thahatna ahi a, ka tahsa khu sumngo thahatna ahi amah?"},"13":{"text":"A mantahin keima sungah huna ka nei sih a, panpi nget nading mi koima om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"“A khanguol pa a khuotuo lote in Vanglienpa giin dan a thei sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Luitui khang bangin ka guolte a zuoutat vua, a kangkia hawhtui luong bang le,"},"16":{"text":"tuikhal in a khahcip luitui le buon in a khucip vuakhal tui suoh bangin, amate a zuoutat uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khuo lum hun ciengin tuate a zungmang sieng uhi; nisa in a kah ciengin a opna vuah a gawkang sieng zieu uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amau’ lampi panin khuolzinte a piel vua; gamdai-ah amate peito-in a kisie uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tema khuolzinte in tui a sui vua, Sheba khuolzinte a na kinem uhi."},"20":{"text":"A kimuon ziehun a lungkie vua; amate kungah tungin a cimaw uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in kei adingin nohaw tua bang lel na hi vua, ka tuosietna mu-in na zau uhi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in, ‘Letsong khat nei pie ding vuoi?’ ahi sihle ‘Na neisa panun guhgol nei pie ding vuoi?’"},"23":{"text":"ahi sihle, ‘Ka langpa’ khut sung panin nei hundam ding vuoi?’ ahi sihle, ‘Mi bawlsiete’ khut sung panin nei tan ding vuoi?’ kang ci ngai amah?"},"24":{"text":"“Ei hil inlen ka sip dide ding hi; bangci tatkhiel ka hei ci ei theisah in."},"25":{"text":"A thuman kammalte bangza tahin vanglien ahei! Ahi vangin nei phawsietna in bang a phatuomsah ngel ei?"},"26":{"text":"Mi mawsietna kammalte tawh thu hil thei-a kingaisun na mah, a cimawte thu gen pen huipi lang bang hi lel lo amah?"},"27":{"text":"Pa nei lote tung nangawnah ai na san vua, na khanguol pa zong na dehkang uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Hinanle tu-in kang thum hi, keima ei en un; bangzieh ahei cile na maitang vuah kei ka zuou vawt sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Kilekia un, kang thum hi, khielna kibawl da taheh. Tu-in hing kihei vawi un, ka dihna a zauhuoi dinmun a tung hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka hamkhiel bang om ahei? Ke’n ciemin tuosietna khen thei lo ding ka mah?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Leitungah mihingte in na hamsa a sem vua, tuale amahaw’ nite zong khu a kiciel nasem pa-a’ bang hi lel lo amah?","title":"Job: Ka Thuohna Veng Thei Sih"},"2":{"text":"Ni hlim lunggul sila khat tawh kibang a, lawman san ding kal a ngahla nasemte tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n a mawhna-in hla tampi ka om a, zan tampi lunggimna khu keima’ tanh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lup ciengin keima in, ‘Bang hunin ka tho diei?’ ka ci hi. Ahi vangin zan khuo a sawt a, zing khuovah dongin ka kilumlele hi."},"5":{"text":"Thanlom le buonnawi in ka citung a tuom hi; ka vun naikulin hima naite zong a pawtkhie hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka nite khu siemgante’ siemphei sangin gangzaw a, lametna om loin a mong tung paipai hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka hinkhuo pen husankhat beh ahi lam ei phawh in; Ka mit in sil hoi kici a mukia ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ei na mukha ngai mit in ei mukia nawn lo ding hi; na mit tawh nei et laitahin kei ka mangthai ta ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Meiilum kaite thengin a manthai bangin, Misikhuo-a peisuhte a katokia sih uhi;"},"10":{"text":"a inn vuah amate a kilekia ta sih vua, a munte un amate a thei kha nawn sih hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tua ziehin ka kam ka ki-ip sih ding hi; ka lungkham ziehin ka ham ding a, ka genthei ziehin ka phun ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang in ei cing ding na koi nadingin kei, tuipi ganhing ahi sihle gulhiempi ka hi amah?"},"13":{"text":"“Lum leng nuom dawm vanin, kimu leng phatuom va,’ ka ci leh,"},"14":{"text":"mangsie nei mansah a, mangmunate mu-in nei zausisah hi,"},"15":{"text":"tuaci’n ka pumpi in a hici thuoh sangin ei kilawlmehin si leng ka nuomzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka hinkhuo ka cimtah ta a; kumtawna hing ding lah ka hi sih hi. Ka hinkhuo husan khat ahi bo ziehin ei hici opsah ta mai un."},"17":{"text":"Tam za taha na thupi se ding le na lungsim sungah a gieh valia ding,"},"18":{"text":"zingmawng sielin vilin, a hun sima na ze-et dingin, mihingte bang hi lel ahei?","ref":"Late 8:4; 144:3"},"19":{"text":"Bakhat sung beh mit tuhna-in ei nei loin, ka cilval zaw dong beh ei hici opsah phot lo ding na mah?"},"20":{"text":"Nang, mihingte encih pa aw, a khiel ka hi lezong nangma tungah bang pen gamta khiel ka hei? Bang dingin na muiciem dingin ei bawlin, bang dingin na vangih suoh laizang ka hei?"},"21":{"text":"Bang dingin ka tawnkhielna ei ngaidam loin, ka khielna ei lahpieh lo na hei? Tu-in lei lahah ka lum ding a, nei sui vangun ka om sih ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shuh mi Bildad in dawng a:","title":"Bildad in Gen: Job A Kisia Kul"},"2":{"text":"“Bang tanvei tam thute gengen ding na hi a, bang tanvei na kama na thu gente huipi lang bang ding ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Pasien in thutang a lehei amah? Ahi sihle Vanglienpa in thudih a lepei amah?"},"4":{"text":"Ama’ langkhatah na tate in mawna a bawl uleh, ama in a khielna vanglietna sung vuah amate a pie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasien sui-in Vanglienpa tunga na thum a,"},"6":{"text":"siengtho-in na thudih po leh, ama in ang en valon ding a, ama in nangma’ mun ngai ma-ah ang koikia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na kipatna khu thupi sih nanle, mailam-ah na thupi mama ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“A tawpsa hunlui thute kantel inlen, a pu a pate uh’ na mukhiet thute ngaisun in;"},"9":{"text":"eite pen zani mi i hi bo ziehun bangma i thei sih uhi, bangzieh ahei cile i leitung hinkhuo khu ni hlim bang bep ahi bo hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in nang hing hilin, a thu hing genin, amau’ theitelna sung pana ang gen ding uh ahi sih amah?"},"11":{"text":"“Cianawng a op lona-ah pumpeng kung po thei ding amah? Tui op lona-ah pumpeng pung thei ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Tuate a paa laitahin a kivat sih zongin adang kungte sangin vul baizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien mangngilte’ lampi tua bang ahi hi; Pasien a thei lo mite’ kinepna tawpin mangthai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amau’ kimuonna khu vauzam ahi bo a, amau’ kingapna zong khu momthang ahi bo hi."},"15":{"text":"A inn tungah mi khat kingam leh, tua inn in puo zo lo ding hi; a khut tawh mi khat in tu paupau leh tua pen kip zo lo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mi gilote nisa lahah a luhing thei vua, umlai-ah a bamengte a zam hi."},"17":{"text":"Suong kiciengte kimvelah a huite kiviel a, suongkawmte lahah tuate a teng uhi."},"18":{"text":"A mun panun amate kisusie leh, amate in a niel ding vua, ‘Ke’n nang kang mu ngai sih hi,’ ci ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"En vawi, tamte khu amau’ nopsahna lampi ahi a, tuale adangte zong lei lah panin ang podawh lai ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“En in, Pasien in bangma cihin genbaang lo mipa nuol ngai lo ding a, gitlona a bawlte panpi lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in na kam dimdimin ang nuisah ding a, na kam tawh kipahin na awng vapo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma ang mudate maizumna puon kisilsah ding a, migilote’ puonbuh om nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Palai Om Lo"},"2":{"text":"“Tua bang hi, ci ka thei tahtah ta hi; hinanle Pasien mai-ah mihing bangci dih thei ding ahei?","ref":"Job 4:17"},"3":{"text":"Mi khat ama tawh a kisel nop leh, tua pa in tulkhat ah khatvei zong ama dawng thei lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama pen a lungtang pil a, a tha zong a hat hi. Koi pen in ama do-in a guolzo ngel ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Muolte a khin pa ama pen amate in a thei vateh sih uhi, ama a lungthah ciengin amate a khup a thalin a tusah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in ama’ opna panin leitung lawh a, a khuomte a kithingsah hi;"},"7":{"text":"ama in ni thupie a, tuale ni suoh lo hi; ama in aasite zong a humcip hi;"},"8":{"text":"ama beh in vanpi zah a, Tuipi tuihuolte a tuoncil hi;"},"9":{"text":"ama pen Ngambawm, Zawlzawng Bawmluoi, le leitaw lam aasite a bawlpa ahi hi;","ref":"Job 38:31; Amos 5:8"},"10":{"text":"ama in koima’ theitel zawh lo na lienpite bawl a, koima’ sim sieng zawh lo na lamdangte a bawl hi."},"11":{"text":"En in, ka kungah ang suoh a, ken ama ka mu sih hi; ama pei kawikawi a, hinanle ama ka thei thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in tawmang ta hi; koi in khahtan thei ding ahei? Ama kungah, ‘Bang bawl na hiei?’ koi in ci ding ahei?"},"13":{"text":"“Pasien in a lungthahna dawhkia lo ding hi; ama’ nei-ah Rahab panpite a kun uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahile ama bangci dawn thei-in, ama tawh ka kiho nadingin ka kammal bangci teel ding ka hei?"},"15":{"text":"Maw peng hinan leng ama ka dawng thei sih hi; keima ei mawsah pa kungah hepi ding ka nget kul hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama hlanin ei dawng nanle ka aw ei ngaipieh dingin ka um sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in huipi in ei mutpaisah a, ama in a thu omlo pi-in ka liemna khangsah hi;"},"18":{"text":"ama in ei naasah man sih ding a, lungkhamna tawh kei ei kidimsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Thatanghat kidemna ding hi leh, ama a thahat ahi bo hi! Thutang kitu ding hi lei zong zumah koi in ama va hlan zo ta ding ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Kei a mawpeng hinan leng, ka kam in ei mawsah put ding hi; maw baang lo hinan leng zong, a letat ei hisah veve ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei genbaang lo ka hi hi; kei le kei ka kithei sih a; ka hinkhuo ka kidah hi."},"22":{"text":"A unpi-in khat ahi hi; tua ahi ziehin ama in, genbaang lote le a gilote a nipi-in a susie hi, ka ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuosietna in thakhatin sina ang piensah ciengin, ama in a genbaang lote’ tuosietna nuisan zieu lel hi."},"24":{"text":"Migilote’ khut sungah leitung kipie hi; ama in ama’ thukhente’ mit a humpieh hi. Tua khu ama ahi sihle a koi dang hi ding ahei?"},"25":{"text":"“A tai mipa sangin ka nite gangzaw hi; tuate in na hoi mu loin a lengmang uhi."},"26":{"text":"Pumpeng gunkuong bangin a nawpei vua, muvanlai sa bawh tawh a kibang uhi."},"27":{"text":"‘Ka phunna ka mangngil ding hi; ka damai khelin kimaitaisah vang,’ ci zong nanleng,"},"28":{"text":"ka gentheina teng giin citahin ka giing hi. Azieh pen nang in lah midihin nei bawl lo ding lam ka thei hi."},"29":{"text":"A maw tang ding veve ka hi hi; tuale bang dinga gimna ka ci thuoh laizang adiei?"},"30":{"text":"Savan tawh kisilin tang-al tui tawh ka khut sawp sieng hi leng,"},"31":{"text":"nangma in ehdum sungah nei phum suh veve ding a, ka puonsil mama in zong keima ei kidah ta ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen ama ka dawnkia thei nadingin ama kei bangin mihing ahi sih a, zumkong mang konga kihehpi thei ahi sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Koma gel tungah khut hlang ding mi a om sih a, koma gel kikalah phit-mut ding mi koima a om sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in kei kung panin ama’ ciengpum hing ladawh a, ama in ei lunghimaw sah nawn loin, ei zausah nawn sih leh,"},"35":{"text":"tuaci’n kei zau loin ama ka hopi thei ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile ka kingaisut bang ka hi lo lam ka kithei ding hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka hinkhuo ka cimtah hi; ka nopnopin ka phun ding hi; keima in aicim-tangkha tawh a kibang ka hinna ka sutsut ding hi.","title":"Job: Ka Hinkhuo Ka Cimtah hi"},"2":{"text":"Keima in Pasien kungah, ‘Kei ei mawsah da in; bang dinga ei do bawl na hei, ei theisah in,” ka ci ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima ei kigawt bawl a, na khut tawh na sepsate kisimmaw-in, migilote’ nasepna angvan ding khu nangma’ hoi sah ma amah?"},"4":{"text":"Cilesa’ mit na nei amah? Mihingte mu bangin na mu amah?"},"5":{"text":"Na nite, mihingte’ ni tawh kibang amah, ahi sihle na kumte zong mihing’ kum ma tawh kibang ahi amah?"},"6":{"text":"Nang in ka khielna nei sulzui a, ka mawna na kantel hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang in kei ka khiel lo lam na thei mawh vangin na khut sung pana ei hunkhie ding koima a om sih amah?"},"8":{"text":"Na khut tawh keima ei lomin nei bawl hi; tu-in kihei-in keima nei susie hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei tungman tawh nei bawlna hing phawhkia in; nangma in kei leivui ei suohsah sawmkia na hi amah?"},"10":{"text":"Bawngnawi suh bangin keima ei suhin, bawngnawi khal bangin ei khalsah hi lo na mah?"},"11":{"text":"Vun le satel tawh nei tuom a, gute le thahuite na kimatsah hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma in hinkhuo le itna kip nei pie a, nangma’ ei kepna in ka hinkhuo a humbih hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle na lungsim sungah tam silte na im lai hi; tam pen na lungtup ahi lam keima in ka thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima ka maw leh nei kaihlit a, ka khielna nei maisah sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka gitlo leh gimna ka thuoh hi! Ka thuman leh ka lu ka pongsah thei sih hi, azieh pen ka gentheina ka et ciengin, mindaina tawh ka kidim hi."},"16":{"text":"Humpi bangin kei nei vai hi; nang in kei langkhatah a zauhuoi nate na bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima ei mawmat dingin tecite a tha na khel a, kei lamah nangma’ lungthahna a khang semsem hi; nangma in kei ei do dingin galkap a tha tha nang puoh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Bang dingin ka nu sung panin ei na piengsah poma na hei? Koima’ ei na mu masangin na kisi dawh ta ve leng,"},"19":{"text":"tuale ka nu sung panin hankhuh ei na kitut pai hinlen, a na kipieng kha lo hi tamai le izaw."},"20":{"text":"Ka nite tomkal khat sung hi lo amah? Keima in themno khat lungnopna ka mu thei nadingin,"},"21":{"text":"kang kinuale nawn lo nading gam le lungzinna le khuomiel gam ka zot masang,"},"22":{"text":"khuovah khuomiel tawh a kibahna, lungzinna le buoina gamah ka pei masangin, keima ngentangin ei omsah un,” a ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Naamath mi Zophar in dawng a:","title":"Zophar in Gen: Job A Khielna Danthuoh dingin Kilawm"},"2":{"text":"“Kamham tamza pi dawn loin hing kikoi-in, mi kamtam pa dih kitang sah ding amah?"},"3":{"text":"Na thumot gengente in midangte sipsahin, tuale mi na simmaw ciengin koima in ei maizumsah sih va na ci amah?"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen, ‘Ka gamtat dan a siengtho a, Pasien muna-ah ka siengtho hi,’ na ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanle na kungah tua Pasien in a kamkahin hing hopi hinlen,"},"6":{"text":"pilna thusimte hing hil leh nuom man vang e izaw! Bangzieh ahei cile pilna pen nam tampi ahi hi. Tua ciengin Pasien in na khielna za sangin a tawmzaw ang thuh ahi lam thei in."},"7":{"text":"“Pasien’ thuthuhte mu sieng thei ding na mah? Vanglienpa’ sep theina tan mu zo ding na mah?"},"8":{"text":"Tua khu vantung sanga sangzaw ahi a, nang in bang law thei na hei? Misikhuo sangin thuhzaw hi, nang in bang thei zo ding na hei?"},"9":{"text":"A tena pen leitung sangin sauzaw a, tuipi sangin zong zaizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in hing nawh kha-in thong sungah hing khum hinlen, tuale thu khen dingin hing kaikhawm leh, koi in ama khahtan zo ding ahei?"},"11":{"text":"Bang zieh ahei cile ama in kimanna nei lo mite thei hi; ama in mawna a mu ciengin ngaisun loin om ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Hinanle gam laate mihing a suo ciengin mimawte in theitelna nga pan ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Na lungsim mansah lacin ama lamah na khutte na zah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na khutah khielna a op khah leh paidawh inlen, na puonbuhte sungah gitlona tengsah sin."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin nuolna om loin na khuodah ngam tahtah ding a; lung muongin omin na zau ta sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nang in gimna na mangngil ding a; tua khu a luongsa tui bangin na phawh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na hinna khu sun sangin vahzaw ding a; a khuomielte, zingmawng bang ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Lametna a op ziehin kimuonna na nei ding hi; nang ang kipanpi ding a, bihtahin na tawlnga ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang na lum ding a, koima in ang zausah sih ding hi; mi tampi in nangma’ maipha ang sui ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanle migilote’ mit thazaw ding a; amate adingin suotahna lampi zosie tawp ding hi. Tuale amau’ kinepna khu si ding beh ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Mi Nuisat Ka Hi Hi."},"2":{"text":"“Noma beh mi kisa na hi vua, noma tawh pilna a si ding lam upla nading om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle no bangin theitelna ka nei hi; note nei-ah ka om sih hi. Tam bang thute koi in thei lo ding ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Ka guolte nuisatin ka om ta hi; Pasien ka hlan a, ama in ei dawng hi, a dih le paubaang lo mipa, mite’ nuisatin ka om ta hi."},"5":{"text":"A nop a thei-a om mite in hamsiet tuohte a ciemmui bawl uhi, hinanle a keng vua dingkip thei lote a pua ding uh a baisa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Gutate’ puonbuhte a om hit hiet a, Pasien a lungthahsah mite bihtahin a om uhi, amate in a khut sung vuah a pasien uh’ lim a tawi uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Ahi vangin gamsate dong un, amate in note ang hil ding uhi; vana leng vate dong un, amate in no kungah ang gen ding uhi;"},"8":{"text":"leitung singkungte dong un, amate in ang hil ding uhi; tuipi sunga ngate dong un, amate in ang gen ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ khut in tami a bawl lam tamte zosie lahah a thei lo koi ahei?"},"10":{"text":"A khut sungah ganhing zosie’ hinna le mihing zosie’ hinna a om hi."},"11":{"text":"Lei in an a ciep bangin bil in thu kantel hi lo amah?"},"12":{"text":"Khanghamte in pilna a nei vua, a sawt hinte in theitelna nei hi lo amah?"},"13":{"text":"“Pasien in pilna le hatna nei hi; ama in thukuppina le theitelna nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a phelkhe nah leh koima in lamkia zo lo hi; ama in thongah mi a khum nah leh koima in lakhie zo lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in tuinahte khacip leh leitang gaw-in tuite kang sieng hi; ama in tuite a hla ciengin tua tui in gamsung hlummang hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in hatna le pilna nei hi; misolte le sol thuohte ama-a’ ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in thudawhpite a guohtangin puimang a, thukhente mimaw suohsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in kumpite’ kawnggah khau sutpieh a, dielkai tawh a kawng uh a khipieh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in siempute a guohtangin puimang a, mi hatte zong a khule thop hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in mite’ muonte a ham thei loin koi a, khanghamte’ thu khinkhai theina a lamang hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in miliente simmaw bawl a, mi hatte’ kawnggah sutpieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in khuomiel panin thuthuhte pholah a, ama in khuomiel thuhpi khuovah a suohsah hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in minamte liensah a, tua ciengin tuate a susie hi; ama in minamte liensah a, tua ciengin a puimangkia hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in leitung makaite panin theitelna lamang a, lampi oplona gamkhing ah amate a vahvaisah hi."},"25":{"text":"Khuovah omlo khuomiel lahah amate a kimaimaw vua, zukhamte bangin amate a hawilensah hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“En vawi, ka mit in tamte zosie mu zo a, ka bil in za-in thei zo hi."},"2":{"text":"No thei teng ken zong ka thei hi; no sangin ka niemzaw tuom sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in Vanglienpa kungah ka gen ding a, Pasien tawh ka vai ka kiniel nuom hi."},"4":{"text":"Note in ahile zuouthu tawh na melh uhi; na unpi-un kimanna a nei lo zatote na hi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ham lo phun loin om locin, tua khu na pilna uh hizaw ding hi!"},"6":{"text":"Tu-in ka thu ngaisutnate za unlen, ka kam tawh ka thusunte ngai un."},"7":{"text":"Pasien ading a dih loin genin, ama adingin zuou le nalin gen ding na hi uh amah?"},"8":{"text":"Note in ama angvanin Pasien tangin thu phu ding na hi uh amah?"},"9":{"text":"Ama in note hing encien leh hoi na vang na kici ding uh amah? Ahi sihle mi khat in adang khat a sol bangin ama sol zo vang na ci uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Angvanna na zah dap uleh ama in note ang phawhsie valon ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama’ thupina in note ang zausi sah ding a, na tung vuah ama giinna hing tung ding hi lo amah?"},"12":{"text":"Na khanglui thupomte uh vutvai bang bep ahi a, na mi nielnate uzong tungman kidalna bang bep ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Sip dide unlen, kei thu ei gensah un, keima tunga a pieng popo a pieng hi taheh."},"14":{"text":"Ka ha tawh ka tahsa petin ka tawdawh ding a, ka khut sungah ka hinna ka koi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"En vawi, ama in kei ei that ding hi; keima in kinepna ka nei sih hi; ahi vangin ama’ maitangah ka kihunna thu ka gen veve ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam pen ka hutdamna hi ding a, ama mai-ah migilote ang pei sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka thugente limtahin ngai unlen, na bil vuah ka thu pulahte lutsah un."},"18":{"text":"Ka thu a gen dingin a baisa-in ka om zo hi; ka thu ka zaw ding lamtah ka thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Khumnah kei tawh a kihau ding koi ahei? A op leh sip tahin omin ka kisi ta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka tungah thu ni beh ei pie inlen, tua ciengin na mai panin ka kiphuol sih ding hi:","title":"Job’ Lungkham Thungetna"},"21":{"text":"Keima kung panin a gamla-ah na khut dawhkia inlen, zauna ei thuohsah sin."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin ei hlan in, kang dawng ding hi; ahi sihle kei ei gensah inlen, keima ei na dawng in."},"23":{"text":"Ka mawna le ka khielna bangza pha ahei? Ka khielnate le ka mawna ei theisah in."},"24":{"text":"Bang dinga na mai na phuol a, na gal banga nei ngaisut ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Nang in hui in a mutmang singna zausahin, butu gaw nuadel ding na mah?"},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen keima’ langkhatah ka thu a siehuoi-in na giel a, ka khangno lai-a ka khielnate a ga nei atsah hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka keng siakol ei bulpiehin ka lampi zosie nei kaihlit a, ka kephang dong nei melci hi.","ref":"Job 33:11"},"28":{"text":"Tua ziehin a muot na khat le nget in a neh puon bangin ka ngamguoi ta hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Numei sung pana suoh mihing pen ni tawmno sung ma hing a, lungkhamna tawh a kidim hi,"},"2":{"text":"ama pen paape bangin pah a, a vulgawp kia pai hi, nihlim’ pei tawh a kibang a, sawtveipi a hing sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bang bep mi khatpo mittuhna-in na nei amah? Thukhenna a thuoh dingin na kungah nei peipi amah?"},"4":{"text":"A siengtho lo nate lah panin a siengtho a tun thei ding koi ahei? Koima ta a om sih hi."},"5":{"text":"A hinkhuo nite uh laitansa ahi a, tuale hla bangza hing ding ci na thei hi, amate in a kansan thei lo dingun a nite uh na ciengtanpieh zo hi,"},"6":{"text":"amate in a kiciel nasemte bangin a hinkhuo nite uh nuom a sah nadingun, amate kimumaw bawl inlen pelh in."},"7":{"text":"“Azieh pen singkung khat adingin kinepna om buong sam a, tua khu kiphua nanle mengkia-in tua a bamengte a si sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Lei sungah a zung muotin a bulsum si den zong nanle,"},"9":{"text":"guo a zuh ciengin nokia ding a, singtuoi bangin a bate mengkia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin mihingte si-in a maimang ta uhi; mihingte a hinna uh tawp a, tuale amate hei-ah a om uh ahei?"},"11":{"text":"Dim sunga vei tui a kan gaw bangin guntui luonglai zong kiemin a kang hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuaci’n mihingte si-in a thokia ta sih uhi; vanpi a bei masangsie a khanglo ta sih ding vua, ahi sihle a kimutna uh panin amate a khanglo sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Misikhuo-ah keima ei phuol mai ven, na thangpaina a ven masangsie ei phuoldap inlen, kei adingin hun khat se-in ei phawhkia bo in!"},"14":{"text":"Mihingte si leh a hingkia ding vuoi mah? Kei ei kihla hun a tun masangsie ka nasepna ni cinteng khu ka ngah kenkon ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei nei hlan ding a, kang dawng ding hi; na khut tawh na nasepna na lunggul ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen tua ciengin nang in ka kalsuonte na sim sih ding a, nang in ka mawna zong nei encih nawn sih ding hi;"},"17":{"text":"ka thupalsatna teng ip khat sungah kiguong ding a, nang in ka khielna teng nei khupieh ta ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ahi vangin muolte cimin guoicim a, a opna panin suong kikhin hi;"},"19":{"text":"tui in suongte nemang a; tuisan in leithau tawmang sieng hi; tuaci’n mihingte’ kinepna na suhsiet pieh hi."},"20":{"text":"A tawntungin amate na zo a, tuale amate a si uhi; a maisuo uh na khelpieh a, amate na sawlmang sieng hi."},"21":{"text":"A patawi dingin a tate a pei vua, tuale ama in a thei sih hi; amate kingiem koih a, ama in a na phawh ta sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in a pum tung vua om natna beh a phawh vua, tuale amate ading behin a kap uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Teman mi Eliphaz in dawng a:","title":"Eliphaz in Gen: Job in Biehna Susie"},"2":{"text":"“Mipil khat in hui tawh a kibang a kimang lo kamhamte dawngin, nisuona lam hui hawpin a kigil vasah ding amah?"},"3":{"text":"Phattuomna a om lo thute tawh kiselin, ahi sihle a sil hoi bawl thei lote uh a mawh gengen ding uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang in Pasien zatahna na sumaimang a, Pasien’ mai-a thu lungngaina na khahtan hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen na khielna in na kam thu hil a, mi pilkhelte’ kam na teelzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma’ kam in nang ang mawsah a, kei ka hi sih hi; na kam in nangma langkhatah teci a pang hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mihingte lahah a pieng masa pen na hi amah? Muolte a op masanga pieng na hi amah?"},"8":{"text":"Pasien’ thu kikupna na ngai kha amah? Nangma ding beha pilna na ciengtan amah?"},"9":{"text":"Kote thei lo bang thu na thei tuom ahei? Kote telcien lo bang thu na theisiem tuom ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Kote lamah puteh samkangte a om vua, amate na pa sanga a tazaw vive ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in ang henepnate ahi sihle awnem no tawh ang hopina te nang adingin thuneu na sa amah?"},"12":{"text":"Bang dingin na lungsim in ang puimang a, bang dingin na mit sat liplap na hei?"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n na lungsim in Pasien a langpan a, na kam panin tua bang kammalte pusuohsah na hei?"},"14":{"text":"Mihingte bang hi tuon a, amate siengtho thei ding uh ahei? Ahi sihle numei pana pieng mite khu a thuman thei ding uh amah?"},"15":{"text":"Ama’ misiengthote nangawn Pasien in muong loin, ama muna-ah vantungte zong siengtho sa lo ahile,"},"16":{"text":"a kidahhuoi, a siehuoi, khielna tui banga a dawn mipa khu bang a ci muonla kan lai diei!","ref":"Job 25:4-6"},"17":{"text":"“Keima’ thu ngai in; kang lah ding hi; ka musate kang pholah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mipilte in gen pena a nei ule a pu a pate un zong a na im lo uh khu,"},"19":{"text":"amate tung behah gam na kipie a, amate lahah khuol mite a vahkha sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Migilote in a khan tungtawnun natna thuohin a kipumpeh vua, mi gawgamte adingin tuate a khan tungtawnun a kikoipieh hi."},"21":{"text":"A bil sung vuah patauna aw ging a; a cithei hunun zong amate tungah mi susie pa pei-in amate a bulu ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Miel pana a kilekia ding uh lametna a om sih a, amate, namsau tawh si dinga laitansa ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Neh ding sui-in mun zosie-ah vah kawikawi-in, amate in, ‘An neh ding hei-ah a om diei?’ a ci uhi. Amate in khuomiel hun ang nai lam a thei uhi;"},"24":{"text":"lungdonna le lungzinna in amate zausisah a, gal bawl dinga kithawi kumpi khat bangin amate a zogawp uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in Pasien langkhatah a khut uh zahin Vanglienpa a pumtawh ziehun,"},"26":{"text":"ama langkhatah lum sapi khat tawh lungkhauhtahin a tai hi;"},"27":{"text":"azieh pen amau’ thaute in a mai uh tuom a, a phua vuah a thaute uh kikhol hi,"},"28":{"text":"a daidam khuopite ah a teng ding vua, koima’ ten lona innte, le buathah lom suoh dinga kisesa innte sungah amate a teng ding uhi;"},"29":{"text":"amate a hau sih ding vua, a neisate uh zong kip loin, lei nei-ah zong amate a zunghla sih ding uhi;"},"30":{"text":"miel panin amate a suohta sih ding vua, a bamengte mei in hulvamin, hui in amau’ paate tawmang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amau le amau kisolin a hawmpi muong sih uheh; azieh pen amau’ lemlaw khu a hawmpi ahi bo hi."},"32":{"text":"A hun a tun masang gawp sieng ding a, a bate a na a nokia nawn sih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in lenggui bangin a ga puomte a thingdawh ding vua, tuale olive kung bangin a paate a pulsah ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien a thei lo honte in suonlehlah a nei sih vua, guhgol tawh kilam puonbuhte mei in a katum sieng hi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in sil hoilo paai-in sietna a piengsah uhi. Mi sol ding behbehin amau’ lungtang a kithawi uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in A Mawlona Kipsahkia"},"2":{"text":"“Tua bang thute ka zaza zo hi; na unpi-un mi gimsah bep mi henemte na hi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hui tawh a kibang kammalte in ciengtan nei lo amah? Ahi sihle bang in ang tawhthaw a, tuaci mawh hamham na hei?"},"4":{"text":"Kei munah note om locin, note’ gen bangin ke’n zong ka gen thei ding hi; note’ langkhatah thu tampi ka gen thei a, ka lu zong kang peisan thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka kamgum tawh kang henem thei a, ka lei in na natna uh ang nuomtuomsah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Thu gen leng lah ka natna a nuomtuom tuon sih a, keima ki-ip kenkon leng bang za-in a nuomtuom diei?"},"7":{"text":"Tu-in Pasien in ei gimsah tahtah a, ama in ka innkuonpi zosie susie siengzo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale ama in ka maivun a tunsah zo a, tua in ka tungah teci-in a pang hi; keima langkhatah ka gawnna ding to a, ka maitangah teci-in a pang hi."},"9":{"text":"A lungthah ziehin ei bottel a, keima ei muda hi; ama in a ha ei gawisan a, ka langpa in keima ei en vapom hi."},"10":{"text":"Kei ei zako dingin amate a kamkah vua, simmawna tawh ka phe ei beng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in migilote’ khut sungah ei na pie a, Pasien thei lote’ khut sungah ei na ap hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka nuom op laitahin ama in tun ni ei suo a; ama in ka ngawngah ei manin ei guoicimsah hi; ama in kei muiciemna-in ei nei a;"},"13":{"text":"a thalkapte in kei ei kimkot uhi. Ama in kei ei hepi vawt loin ka kalte ei kapvang a; ama in ka sinkha tui lei lahah a sung hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in ei liemsah thuothuo a; galhangpa bangin ei del vapual hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka vun tungah la-ip puon ka khui a, leivui lahah ka thahatna ka sielsuh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka kaa kaana-in ka mai san gawp a, ka mitkhu tungah tumde a kikap den vawt hi,"},"17":{"text":"ka khut sungah tatsietna om nanle keima’ thungetna a siengtho hi."},"18":{"text":"“Leisiet aw, ka sisan khucip sin; keima’ kikona in khawlmun musah sin."},"19":{"text":"Tu nangawnin van ah ka teci pa om a, a sangna munah ei panpi ding ama a om hi.","ref":"Job 19:25"},"20":{"text":"Ka guolte in kei ei zako vua, Pasien kungah ka hlitui a luong hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khat in a guolpa ading a thumpieh bangin Pasien kungah ei thumpieh ding mi khat ka dei hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kum tawmno zaw ciengin kang kilekia nawn lo nading lampi-ah ka pei ta ding hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lungsim kitamzan a, ka nite tawp zo hi, kei adingin hankhuh a baisa-in a om hi.","title":"A Noptuom nading Job in Thungen"},"2":{"text":"Mi zakote keima’ kimvelah om tahtah a, ei phinnate uh mit hla loin ka en ding hi."},"3":{"text":"“Kei adingin nangma vankhapin hing kipie in; tuanah kei dinga ang kikham ding koi ahi ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Nang in a theitelna lungsim uh na khapieh hi, tua ahi ziehin nang in amate na guolzosah sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Thaman a dei ziehin a guol a leheh mite- a tate uh’ mit in khuo mu lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Ama in kei pen mite’ thusie gentena ei suohsah a, mite in a mai vua a cilphit pa ukhu keima ka hi ta mawh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka dana lamin ka mit mang a, ka khut ka kengte niliep a bang ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Thutang mite in tam thu ziehin lamdang a sa vua, Pasien thei lote tungah mawpengte a lungso uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hizongle thumante in amau’ lampi a tukip vua, tuale khut siengtho nei amate a thahat tehteh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin note na unpi-un tu-in hing peikia un, keima in note lahah mipil khat zong ka mu sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka nite lah a tawp zo ta a, ka gelnate zong maimangin, ka lungsim sunga ka lunggulte thelthang sieng zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in zan pen sun a suohsah vua; amate in, ‘Khuovah in miel neh ta,’ a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka inn bangin Misikhuo ka lamet a, miel lahah ka lupna pha leng,"},"14":{"text":"keima in Hankhuh kungah, ‘Nang ka pa na hi hi,’ ci-in, thante kungah, ‘Nang ka nu na hi hi,’ ahi sihle, ‘Ka sanggamnu na hi hi,’ va ci ta leng,"},"15":{"text":"ka kinepna hei-ah a om ta diei? Koi in ka kinepna a mu ta diei?"},"16":{"text":"Tami khu Misikhuo’ kotgolte-ah a kumsuh ding amah? Leivui lahah i peisuh ton diei mah?” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shuh mi Bildad in dawng a:","title":"Bildad in Gen: Pasien in Migilote’ Dan Pie Ding"},"2":{"text":"“Na gen ding thute bang tanvei sui ding na hei? Khuongai inlen, kang gen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang dinga ganhing banga nei ngaisut ahei? Bang dinga na mai-a mimaw suoh uh ka hei?"},"4":{"text":"Na lungthah zieha nang le nang ki-ehtel pa, nang ziehin leitung kitaisanin ahi sihle suongtum a mun panin kikhin va na ci amah?"},"5":{"text":"“Migilote’ khuovah kisumit tahtahin, a mei kuonglai uh a vah nawn sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A puonbuh sung vua khuovah miel a, amate tunga meivah mit hi.","ref":"Job 21:17"},"7":{"text":"A kal sausuonte uh a tomsuon ta vua, a thugelte uh amate in a pualaw ta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in lenthang sungah a keng a heng kha vua, kuokhuh tungah a vah kawikawi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Thang in amate a ketul-ah man a; thangkhau in amate a khibawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuolah amate kisiena thangkhau kiphuol a, amate adingin lampi ah thang kisie hi."},"11":{"text":"A kim a pam vuah patauna in amate zausisah a, a kalsuonna cinteng vuah a sulzui hi."},"12":{"text":"A gilkiel ziehun a tha uh tawp a, a pua nadingun tuosietna a baisa-in a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Natna in a vun uh netum a, Sina’ tacil in a khut le a keng uh a netum hi."},"14":{"text":"A muon uh ahi puonbuh panin amate ki-ehmal a, patauna kumpipa kungah amate kitut hi."},"15":{"text":"A puonbuh sung vuah bangma om lo a, a tenna uh munte tungah kat suong kithezah hi."},"16":{"text":"A nei lamah a huite uh gawta a, a bate uh zong a gawptum hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung panin a kiphawna uh kisie a, amate in lampi-ah min a nei sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khuovah panin khuomiel sungah amate kisawnpua a, leitung panin amate kinotmang hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in a mite lah vuah cihlah ahi a, suonlehlah ahi zongin a nei sih vua, a tenna ngai mun vuah koima khat beh a hing nawn sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nitumna lama teng amate in amau’ thuohna a cizatlia vua, nisuona lam mite zong a linglawng uhi."},"21":{"text":"A tah tahin Pasien zatah lote’ tenna tua teng bang ahi a, Pasien thei lote’ mun zong tua bang ma ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Ei Tanpa a Hin Lam Ka Thei Hi"},"2":{"text":"“Note in bang tanvei ei bawlsie-in na kamteng utawh ei genpaat ding na hi uh ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Note in sawmvei tah nei hosie zo uhi; kei tunga na khielna uh na zum sih uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"A khiel tahpi ka hi leh zong ka khielna ka kipuoh ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei ei langpangin no le no na kitawisang vua, ka zalatna khu ka mawna zieh hi na ci uleh,"},"6":{"text":"Pasien in a khiel dinga ei sesa ahi lam le ka kimvelah a len tawh ei khu ahi lam thei un."},"7":{"text":"‘Tatsietna,’ ci-in ka kiko cieng nangawnin ei kidawng sih a, ka hlat vapo vangin thuman-a thukhen mi om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in nawtsuoh thei lo nadingin ka lampi a khah bing a, ka lampi khuo a mielsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in ka vang ei hawkhieh pieh a, ka lu panin kumpi lukhu ei lahpieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in a munmun panin ei satguoi a, kei ka mangthai ta hi, ama in sing phungkal bangin ka kinepna a phungkal sieng hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in kei tungah a lungthahna kuontaw a, a galpa tawh a kibangin kei ei simtha hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei ei sim dingin a galkapte ang kuon uhi; kei ei nan nadingin kulh a cieng vua, ka buh kimvelah galphuol a sat uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Ama in ka innpite tawh ei kigamlasah a, ama in ka meltheite zin a tangsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka hieng ka sante le ka guolte in ei taisan sieng ta uhi;"},"15":{"text":"ka inna ang tung ngai ka zinte in ei mangngil bawl ta uhi. Ka tengta numeite in zong zin bangin ei ngaisun vua; amahaw’ muna-ah khuolmi khat ka suoh ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka nasempa ka hlan a, ahi vangin ama in ei dawng lo hi; ama ka zol kul ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka zinu in ka husan namsie sa a; ka innpite adingin ka kidahhuoi hi."},"18":{"text":"Naupangnote nangawn in kei ei simmaw ta uhi; ka din popo ciengin amate in ei gensie vangiam uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ka guol ngaite in ei huo vua, ei na it ngaite in zong ei langbawl ta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka satel le ka gute ka vunah a beh ta a, a hing lemlem ka hi tabo hi."},"21":{"text":"No ka guolte aw, kei ei khuotuo un, kei ei khuotuo un, azieh pen Pasien’ khut in kei ei tham zieh ahi bo hi!"},"22":{"text":"Pasien’ ei bawlsiet banga bang dinga nei genthei bawl vua, ka tahsa thuohna khu na lungkim nai vaset sih uh amah?"},"23":{"text":"“Ka thugente lai-in kigiel hinlen, laibu khat sungah kigiel leh nuom sam vang e!"},"24":{"text":"Hanawh peh tungah tua teng sekhu tawh kikhen hinlen, a om den dingin suong tungah kigiel leh ci sam ing e!"},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in kei ei Tanpa a hing ahi lam ka thei a, ama in ni tawp ni ciengin leitung ah keima ei dinpi ding hi, ci zong ka thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua bangin ka vun a kisiet zaw ciengin, ka tahsa-in Pasien ka mu ta ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka gei-a Pasien khu ka mu ding a, ka mit in midang en loin ama ka en ding hi. Tuami khu ka ngahla sengin lung tawp dihdehin ka om hi!"},"28":{"text":"Note in, ‘Ama bangci bawlsiet ding,’ na ci vua, ‘A thuzungpi ama kungah kimu hi,’ na ci uleh,"},"29":{"text":"thangpaina in namsau tawh danpiehna hing tun ding ahi ziehin, tua namsau giing bo un. Tuaci’n thukhenna a op lamtah note in na thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Naamath mi Zophar in dawng hi:","title":"Zophar in Gen: Gitlona in Thuhkiana Dih Nga ding"},"2":{"text":"“Na ngai vawi! Keima sungah ka lungtang a kitom ziehin ka ngaisutnate in ka dawnkia nadingin ei hantawh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kizumsuona le mawmatna vive ka za a, ka dawnkia nadingin ka theina in a ban zo sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitungah mihing a kipiensah a patin migilote’ nopsahna khu"},"5":{"text":"tomno kal sung beh ahi lam tanga tuona kipanin na thei sih uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Amau’ duong sanna in vanpi holin a lutang uh meiilum tawh kidong nan ule,"},"7":{"text":"leivui kimutmang bangin kumtawnin a mangthai ding vua, amate a mungaisate in, ‘Hei sunga om uh ahei?’ a ci ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Zan mang bangin amate lengmang ding a, mukhahin a om nawn sih ding uhi. Zanlai mumang bangin delmangin a om ta ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate a mukhasate in zong a nuamu kia nawn sih ding vua, a tenna mun un zong amate a mu nawn sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A tate un mizawngte a mai-et ding vua, a khut utawh amau’ neisate a piekia ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"A pumpi uh moisuo nanleh, amate tawh leivui a suohton ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"“A kam sung vuah gitlona hlum a, tua khu a lei vuah a phuoldap vua,"},"13":{"text":"a set dawh ding uh pamaisa-in, a kam sung vuah muommuom nan uleh,"},"14":{"text":"a gilpi sung vuah a annehte uh ang kikhule kia ding a, a sung vuah gulgu pha bangin ang pieng ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in haunate a pumval vua, tua teng a lawkhekia uhi; Pasien in a gil sung panun tua teng a lahpieh kia hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in gulgu a tawp ding vua, muoltan tuhin a si ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in khuoizu le bawngnawi a luonna luidung le gunte mukha lo ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"A nasep thaman zosie uzong a piekia sieng ding vua, amate in a haunate uh a zang man sih ding uh."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in mizawngte gawtin a pampai vua, a lam lo uh innte pi a mawh lahpieh uhi."},"20":{"text":"“A huoihamna un pha ta a ci ngai sih a, a huoiham ziehun bangma khat beh a hen sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in a neh zaw ciengun bangma a valsah sih uhi; tua ahi ziehin amau’ lawcinna a kuitung vawt sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A cithei pen hun laitahin lungkhamna a tuoh ding vua, hamsiet huoisiet cinteng amate tungah tung ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A du a dei kineh mai uheh. Pasien in a lungsona hladawhin amate tung le amau’ an tungah guo bangin zusah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Sia galhiem mai-ah amate a tai ding vua, sumngo thaltang in amate a kap pailet ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thaltang a kidaw ciengin a pumpi uh pailetin a pei hi; a te lihleh thaltang mua in a sinkha uh a pailet a, amate tungah zauna a tung hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate adingin khuomu tawkhal kholsa-in om a, koima in a sem lo mei kuong in amate katum ding hi; A kinuasie a puonbuhte uh a ka sieng ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Vantungte in amau’ mawna pholah ding a, amate a do dingin leitung dingto ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien’ lungthahna tuikhang in a inn ule a neisate uh a tawmang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami khu Pasien tung pana migilote satanh ahi a, amau’ gouluo dinga Pasien’ thukhenna ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Danpieh Loin Migilote Kikoi theizel"},"2":{"text":"“Ka thugente limtahin ngai unlen, tami khu kei nei henepna hisah un."},"3":{"text":"Kei ei thuohpi unlen, tuale kang gen ding hi; kang gen zaw ciengin ei nuisan mai un."},"4":{"text":"Mihingte tunga phun nei sa uh amah? Bang dinga lungtom lo ding ka hei?"},"5":{"text":"Ei en unlen, tuale lamdangsa un, na khut utawh na kam uh hum un."},"6":{"text":"Tam thu ka ngaisut khah ciengin lungdongin zau-in ka ci a tun hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang dingin migilote hinghing thei-in, a khankum uh sau zawsop a, hau zawsop uh ahei?"},"8":{"text":"A hin sungun a tate a suong thei vua, a mitmu-un a hlah a suonte a cithei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zauna panin a innte uh suohta a, a tung vuah Pasien’ moltum a tu kha sih hi."},"10":{"text":"A bawngtangte uh lan mama a, cihlah a nei den uhi; a bawngpite uh zong no a nei vua, a tatol ci bang a om sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuuhon bangin a naupangte a vahsah vua, tuale a tate kipah tahin a lam uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in tawmneu le lyre tumin la a sa vua, theile aw tawh nuom a sa uhi."},"13":{"text":"A hinkhuote uh citheina-in a zang vua, lungmuong tahin Misikhuo a zuonsuh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in Pasien kungah, ‘Koma guoh ei omsah un! Na tawndan lampi uzong thei ka sawm sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama’ na ka sep nadingun Vanglienpa khu bang ahi ahei? Ama kungah va thum uleng bang phattuompi ding ka hi uh ahei?’ a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amau’ citheina khu a guolzawna uh hi lo amah? Migilote’ lunggelnate ka dei vawt sih hi."},"17":{"text":"“Migilote’ meivah bang zavei a kisumit ta ahei? Amate tungah tuosietna bang zavei a tung ta ahei? Pasien in a lungthah sulin a tung vuah bang zavei natna a tungsah ta ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Hui in butute a mut bangin bang zavei a om ta uh ahei? Ansi bangin huipi in bang zavei a taw ta uh ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Nang in, ‘Pasien in a tate adingin a gitlonate uh a kholpieh hi,’ na ci hi. Amate in a thei nadingun a tung vuah kithuh taheh."},"20":{"text":"Amau’ mit in a kisietna uh mu hinlen, amate in Vanglienpa’ lungthahna tui bangin dawn uheh."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amau’ ni le hlate a tawp ciengin, a nuasie uh amau’ innkuonpite bang a awlmaw ding uh ahei?"},"22":{"text":"Ama in mun sanga omte thu a khen lam a theisa pi-in mi khatpo in Pasien thu a hil ding amah?"},"23":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte a cithei laitahin a si vua, lungmuong le bihtahin a om uhi,"},"24":{"text":"a anneh a tuidawn kiningcingin a cintuigute kang nai lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte ahile genthei liengvai-in a si vua, amate in a hoi kici khat beh a ciemkha vawt sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Amate a kibangin leivui lahah lumin, a pumpi tahsa tung teng vuah thanlompi a kihia valuh hi."},"27":{"text":"“Aw, na ngaisutnate ka thei a, nei bawlsiet nadinga na gelnate ka thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang in ‘Sietna a bawl ulien pa’ inn hei sung ahei? Migilote’ tenna puonbuh ‘Hei sung ahei?’ na ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Khuolzinte thu dong ngai loin amau’ thugen na pom sih uh amah?"},"30":{"text":"Hamsiet hunin migilote kihingkhawi a, Pasien’ lungthah ni-in zong amate a suohta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amau’ maitangah koi in a gamtatna uh genkhie ngam ding a, a silbawlte uh dung zui-in koi in thuh ngam ding ahei?"},"32":{"text":"Hankhuh ah amate a kizawn ciengin mite in a han uh kicingsah hi."},"33":{"text":"Amahaw adingin kuom sunga leisaite tui a, hlum a, mi zosie in a zui ding vua, tuale ama’ mai-a a peite kisim zo lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuale note in bangma lote tawh bang ei ci henep ding na hi uh ahei? Nei dawnnate uh bangma lo ahi a, zuou bulom pi ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Teman mi Eliphaz in dawng a:","title":"Eliphaz in Gen: Job’ Gitlona Lien Luo"},"2":{"text":"“Mi khat Pasien adingin a kizang thei amah? A pil pente nangawn in ama’ na a sem thei uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Nang mi thuman na hi leh Vanglienpa adingin lungkimna om a, ahi sihle na lampite paubaang lo-a na koi leh, ama adingin phattuomna a om diei mah?","ref":"Job 35:6-8"},"4":{"text":"Pasien na zatah ziehin ama in hing thuhilin, na tungtang thu ang khen ding ma amah?"},"5":{"text":"Na gitlona lien luo hi lo amah? Na khielnate in tawp hun a nei sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen thuman lo pi-in na innkuon kung panin khapnate na la a, a nih a puonte uh hawhkhie-in, puon sil loin a guohtangin na omsah hi."},"7":{"text":"A basamte dawn ding tui pie loin, gilkielte neh ding an na pie sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Thuneite in leitang a nga vua, tua tungah amau’ angvante a teng uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nang in meigongte a khuthawm in na notmang a, pa neilote’ ban na hliehtawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na kimvelah thang kikam a, zaunate in thakhatin ang nuoicip hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi sihle na khuo mu lo nadingin khuomiel ang om a, tuikhang in nangma ang taimang ta hi."},"12":{"text":"“Vansang pen dawnah Pasien om hi lo amah? En vawi, aasi sang pente khu sang va-ia kia sam e!"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nang in, ‘Pasien in bang ahei a thei, meiilum mielpi lah panin thu a khen thei diei?’ na ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a mu thei lo nadingin meiilum sapi in ama khucip a, van mongah a vah kawikawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilote’ lamhlahna lampi lui zui sawm lai na hi amah?"},"16":{"text":"A si hun uh a tun masangin lahmangin a om ta vua, amate tenna innmun zungpite zong tuikhang in taimang ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Pasien kungah, ‘Ko ngentang ei omsah in; Vanglienpa in kote tungah bang ei bawlpieh thei ding ahei,’ a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle ama in a innsung teng uh sil hoi tawh a kidimsah hi. Ahi vangin migilote’ lunggel khu ka nahsah vawt sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi thumante in a na mu vua, lungdamin a kipah uhi. Mawnei lote in amate a hosie vua, a nuisan uhi."},"20":{"text":"‘Na langte suhmai-in a om tahtah ta vua, a nuasie teng uzong mei in katum sieng hi,’ a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Pasien tawh kithutuoh inlen, ama tawh kilem in. Tua hile sil hoite in nangma ang zuon ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama’ kamsuo thuhilnate pom inlen, na lungsim sungah khol in."},"23":{"text":"Vanglienpa kungah kilekia-in, na puonbuh sung panin thuman lona teng na hepmang leh, na pongtokia ta ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na kham neite leivui bangin ngaisunin, na Ophir khamte gun tawdop-a om suongpemte bangin bawlin,"},"25":{"text":"Vanglienpa khu nangma’ ngun le kham ang hi po leh,"},"26":{"text":"tuaci’n Vanglienpa kungah nuom na sa ding a, Pasien’ mai-ah na mai na phongsang ngam ta ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama kungah thu na ngen ding a, ama in na ngetna ang za ding hi. Nangma in na kamciemte na tangtungsah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Thu khensat khatpo na bawl ding a, tua khu hing kisuhkip piehin, na lampi tengah khuovah ang tang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Midangte a kisimmaw ciengin a kilietsah zieh uh, na ci ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile ama in a neilut mite a hundam hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in khielna a nei mite nangawn tankhie ding a, na khut siengthote ziehin amate hutdamin a om ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Ka Phunna Nasie mama hi."},"2":{"text":"“Tuni-a ka phunnate nasie mama a; ka tautau vangin ama’ khut a gih veve hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama ka sui dan ding thei-in ama opna tung thei leng nuom sam vang e!"},"4":{"text":"Ama mai-ah ka thu ka sung ding a, ka kam dimdimin ka niel ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’ ei dawn dan dingte ka mukhie ding a, ka kunga ei gen ding teng zong ka thei siem ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a vanglien pi tawh kei ei do ding amah? Hi lo hi; ama in ka thu ngai zaw lai ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi thuman khat ama tawh holim thei ding a, ka thukhen pa in ka thu ei zosah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mailam ka nawh leh khumnah ama a om sih a; ka nuatawn le lah ama ka mu tuom sih hi;"},"9":{"text":"veilamah ama kiphuol a, ka mu thei sih hi; zietlamah ka kiheikia a, hinanle ama ka mu thei tuom sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in ka zawi teng ei thei hi; ama in kei ei zelah ciengin kham bangin ka pawtkhie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka keng in ama’ ketot nua a zui lenlon a; a lampi zui-in ka piel vawt sih hi."},"12":{"text":"A kam tawh ei thupiehna panin ka piel sih a, ka awp sungah a kam tawh a thugente ka vom hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama a tuomin ding a, koi in ama zawl zo ding ahei? Ama in a dei teng a kibawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen kei dinga a sesate ama in ang bukimsah ding a, ama’ lungsim sungah tua bang tampi a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama mai-ah ka zau mama a; ka ngaisut khah ciengin ama ka giintha a suoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasien in keima’ lungsim zawmsah a, Vanglienpa in ei patausah hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuomiel lahah mangthai thei-in miel sapi in ka mai hing khu dawh leh nuom sam vang e!"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Vanglienpa in bang dingin hunte zui loin, ama a thei mite in bang dingin migilote tunga a thukhen ni mu kha lo uh ahei?","title":"Leitunga Tatsietna Ziehin Job Phun"},"2":{"text":"Migilote in gamgi ciemtenate a khin uhi; amate in tuuhonte manin an a vah uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in tagate’ laa a delmang uhi; amate in meigongnu’ bawngtang zong vankhapin a la uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in lam gei-ah tasamte a sawnpua uhi; leitunga mizawngte zosie a kiphuol dap sieng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Senel gam laate bangin neh sui-in a vah kawikawi uhi; a note neh ding an sui-in gam lahah a kizawt uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amau-a’ ahi lo lo lai-ah an a la vua, migilote’ lengga lo-ah a sangh a khon uhi."},"7":{"text":"Zan tungtawnin amate guohtangin a lum vua, tuale khuodam cienga kihui nading puon a nei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Muoltung guotuite in amate a pah tehlopsah a, a kibuh nadingun suongpi pang a bel uhi."},"9":{"text":"“A nu’ kang sung panin taga nausen a gu mite om a, mizawngte’ nausente zong vankhapin a la uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate puon nei loin guohtangin a kawiva vua, gilkielin lainem nan ule amate in buphaite a puo uhi."},"11":{"text":"A leicielte uh kikalah amate in sathau a suh uhi; amate in lengga tui a suh vangun, a dangta uh a pha tuom sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuopi panin a laitat mite a tau vua, panpi ngai-in a liem a baite a kiko uhi; hinanle Pasien in a thumna uh donin a nei tuom sih hi."},"13":{"text":"“Khuovah a langpang, tua khuovah lampite a thei lo, tua lampite zong a zui lo, mi pawlkhat a om hi."},"14":{"text":"Mizawng mi tasamte that dingin phalvahin tuolthat pa tho a, zan khuomiel hun sungin guta bulu-in a pang hi."},"15":{"text":"Angkawmpa’ mit in khuomut ding kal a ngahla a, ‘Koima’n ei mu sih va,’ a ci hi; tuale ama in a maitang a sel hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in khuomiel lahah inn a lu uhi; sun lai-in amate kot a kikhalu uhi; amate in khuovah a thei sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen amate adingin miel thuhpi pen zingmawng tawh kibang a, khuomiel zauhuoina tawh amate a kilawmta uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Tui maitang tungah amate malgang mama uhi; gam sunga amau’ satanh in samsietna ahi hi; a lengga lo vuah koima kuon nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Guotui kan hun le nisat hun in vua tuite hupkang hi; Tua bangin Misikhuo in maw neite a bawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Naubu in amate a mangngil a; thanlomte in amate tuituoh a sa uhi; amate a kiphawh kha nawn sih hi; tuaci’n singkung bangin migilote a tawngsan uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Amate in ta nei lo numei a bawlsie vua, meigongte tungah na hoi a sem sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanle Pasien in ama’ vanglietna tawh mi thahatte’ hinkhuo sausah a; a hinkhuo a lunghimaw ciengun ang tho theikia na lai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in amate bihna pie a, amate huoi-in panpi hi; ama’ mit in a lampi uh a kaihlit den hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate bakhat kisangtawi a, tua ciengin a mangthai uhi; amate paape bangin a vulmang vua; buvui ki-at bangin amate ki-attan hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua bang hi sihle mizuou ci-in koi in ei gen ngam ding a, ka thugen zosie bangma hi sih, ci-in koi in ei lah ngam ding ahei?” a ci hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shuh mi Bildad in dawng a:","title":"Bidad in Gen: Pasien Mai-ah Mihing Bangci Thuman Zo Ding Ahei?"},"2":{"text":"“Pasien kungah uhna le zatahna om a, a sangna mun ama’ vantungah ama in kilemna a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"A galkapte a phaza koi in sim zo ding ahei? Koi tungah a khuovah tang lo ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien mai-ah mihing bangci dih thei ding ahei? Numei sunga pieng mihing bangci sientho thei ding ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Ama muna-ah hlapi nangawn tang sa zo lo a, aasite nangawn siengtho sa zo lo ahile,"},"6":{"text":"than bang lel mihing, le talteng bang lel mihing, bangza-in a thupi sih zawkan lai diei!” a ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job in Dawngkia: Pasien’ Thupina Suizawh ding Hi Lo"},"2":{"text":"“Hatna nei lo mipa bang na ci panpi ahei! Ban thahat lo mipa bang na ci hu ahei!"},"3":{"text":"Pilna nei lo mipa thu bang na ci mop a, thu hoi bang na ci genpi thei ahei!"},"4":{"text":"Na thugente koi’ huna tawh na gen ahi a, koi’ lungsim pana hing pei ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Lei nei-a misi hlate le tui le a sunga omte zau-in citun uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien mai-ah Misikhuo a guohtangin om a, Sietna in zong asin a nei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Awnghawmpi tungah ama in Zaphon pha a, ama in bangma lo tungah leitung kikhaisah hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a meiisapi sungah tuite tun a, tuate ziehin meiilum pawhkeh lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Hlalia’ maitang khupieh a, tua tungah a meiilum kaisah hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in khuovah le khuomiel kikalah a kigi bawlpieh a, ama in tuipi tungah kuolviel khat omsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a hosiet ciengin vanpi kidona ahi khuompite zau-in a kithing hi."},"12":{"text":"A vanglietna tawh Tuipi daisah a, a siemna tawh Rahab satlia hi."},"13":{"text":"A hui tawh vantungte mut sieng a, a khut tawh gulpi tailai sun pailet hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng khu ama’ nasep a mongno khat ahi na bo a, ama’ thu i zahte khu a hemlam beh ahi na bo hi! Hinanle vanto ging tawh a kibang a vanglietna koi in thei zo ding ahei?” a ci hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job in a thugen zomto a:","title":"Job in a Citahna Tukip"},"2":{"text":"“Ka dihna ei lahpieh, genthei liengvai ei sinsah Vanglienpa a hing ahi ma bangin,"},"3":{"text":"ka sungah ka naahu a om a, ka nahkuo-ah Pasien’ hu a op laisie,"},"4":{"text":"ka kam in zuouthu kici gen loin, ka lei in mi solna kam a gen sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thuman uhi, kang ci vawt sih ding a; ka si dongin ka citahna ka hlasuo sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka thumanna ka tukip lenlon a, ka hlasuo sih ding hi; ka hin sungin ka lungsim in ei mawsah lo hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka galpa, migilote bang hinlen, ka langpa, mi thuman lote bang taheh."},"8":{"text":"Pasien in a hinna uh lahpiehin, amate a suh maimang ciengin Pasien thei lote’ kinepna khu bang pen ahi bep diei?"},"9":{"text":"Amate tungah buoina a tun ciengin, Pasien in a kikona uh a za diei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Vanglienpa sungah amate in nuom a sa uh amah? Amate in hun bangkimah Pasien a ko ding vuoi mah?"},"11":{"text":"Keima in Pasien’ sil bawltheina tawh kisai thu kang hil ding hi; Vanglienpa tawh a omte ka im sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na unpi-un na mu zo ta uhi; tua ahile bang dinga a mawhna suoh na hi uh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"“Tam pen migilote in Pasien kung pana a nga uh satanh le, mi bawlsiete in Vanglienpa kung pana a nga uh gouluo ahi hi:"},"14":{"text":"A tate a pun vua ahi lezong namsau-a lo ding a hibo vua, tuale a suon a hlahte un khamkhop ding an a nei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"A hinglaite pulnatna in vui ding a, a meigong numeite in amate a kaa sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in leivui bangin ngunte sungvumin, buon bangin puonsil cieng nan ule,"},"17":{"text":"amate in sungvum kha thei ding a, hinanle thuman mite in tuate a sil ding vua, maw nei lote in tua ngunte hawm lel ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in vabu bangin inn a lam vua, lo ngaite in a lam uh buhte tawh a kibang bep bo hi."},"19":{"text":"Hauna tawh lupna a zuon vua, ahi vangin a zop zo nawn sih ding uhi; amate khanglo-in a hah uleh tuate na om nawn lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Zauna in tuikhang bangin amate pha a; zanin huipi in amate a semmang hi."},"21":{"text":"Nisuona huipi in amate domto-in a mangthai uhi. Tua hui in a opna uh panin amate a tawmang hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate khuotuo loin a lehmang a, hui hat lah panin ahi thei za-in a tai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua in amate khut behsanin, a opna panin a nuisan hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngun kitawna khuh om a, kham kisiensahna mun om hi.","title":"Kallah Thu: Hei-ah Pilna Mu ding?"},"2":{"text":"Lei sung panin sia kito a, suong panin sumsan kihuontui hi."},"3":{"text":"Suongtote in khuomiel tawpsahin, a gamla pen mun dong, mielking le miel thuhpi sungah suongte a sui uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in mi’ tenna panin a gamla kuom sungah lei sung tovang uhi; amate pen khuolzinte in a mangngil bawl vua, mite tawh kigamlatna munah khauhuol tawh amate kikhai linglengin a kivei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Leisiet panin neh ding ang pieng hi; hizongnanle lei nei lam pen mei-a kihal bangin sa mama hi."},"6":{"text":"A suongte panin Sapphire pieng a, a leivui lahah kham a om hi."},"7":{"text":"“Sasielne vate in tua lampi a thei sih vua, langta’ mit in tua mun mu lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Gamsa kisatheite in tuon ngai lo a, humpi zong pei ngai lo hi."},"9":{"text":"“Meituh suong tungah a khut a ngam vua, muol bulte lumletin a cimsah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in suong a vutvang vua, a mit un sil manpha namcin a mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in gunnah zosie a sui vua, lei sunga kiphuol nate a pholah uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Hinanle hei sungah pilna kimu thei ding ahei? Thu theitelna mun hei sunga om ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Mihingte in tua lampi a thei zo sih vua, tua khu a hingte gamah a kimu sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tui thuhpi in, ‘Ka sungah om sih,’ ci a, tuipi in zong, ‘Kohaw tawh omton sih,’ ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilna pen kham tawh kilei thei lo a, a man za ngun tawh kite thei lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Ophir kham tawh a man kite thei lo a, a manpha onyx ahi sihle sapphire tawh zong kite thei lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Kham le limlang in dem zo lo a, kham hoi-a kibawl nate tawh hlen thei hi lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Coral le suongvalte gentham vet lo a, tuikep sangin pilna manphazaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Ethiopia gama a pieng chrysolite suongmanpha tawh tekah thei ahi sih a, kham citah tawh zong a man kitekah thei lo hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ahile pilna hei pana hing pei ahei? Theitelna mun hei sunga om ahei?"},"21":{"text":"Tua khu hinna nei mi zosie’ mit-ah a kiphuol a, tuale hui lahah a leng vate muna panin zong kiselcip hi."},"22":{"text":"Sietna le Sina in, ‘Kam baleng tawh thu kigen khu ka bil utawh ka za zo uhi,’ a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Pasien in pilna lampi thei a, ama in a opna mun thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in lei mong dong en a, vansin nei-a sil om zosie mu sieng hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in hui’ gihna bawlin, tuite a phaza ding te hi;"},"26":{"text":"guozuh nading thukip bawlin, keh kieh nading lampi a bawl lai-in,"},"27":{"text":"ama in pilna mu-in phuongzah a, tua khu kipsahin a sui hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in mihingte kungah, Topa zatahna khu pilna ahi a, sietna pana kihepkhietna khu thu theitelna ahi hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 111:10; Pau 1:7; 9:10"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job in a thugen zomkia a:","title":"Job Thusun Man"},"2":{"text":"“Nidang hun Pasien ei cin lai bangin ka hinkhuo zilkia thei leng nuom sam vang e;"},"3":{"text":"ka lu tunga meivah a tan lai, khuomiel sunga ama’ khuovah tawh ka va lai;"},"4":{"text":"ka tangval thahat lai le ka buh sunga Pasien tawh ka kikhawl lai;"},"5":{"text":"Vanglienpa kei tawh ang omton lai, ka kimvelah ka tate a op lai;"},"6":{"text":"bawngnawi-a ka keng ka sil lai-in, suongpi in kei adingin sathau tui bangin a pulsah hi!"},"7":{"text":"Khuopi tunkotah pei-in mihon opna munah ka to ciengin,"},"8":{"text":"ei mu khangnote in tona ei awn vua, khanghamte zong a na ding uhi;"},"9":{"text":"mi thupite a holim uh a khawl vua, a khut utawh a kam a hum uhi;"},"10":{"text":"miliente a sip dide vua, a dangtawng vuah a lei a behsah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mite in a zah ciengun ei phat vua, ei mu ciengun ei thukimpi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mizawngte le panpi nei lo tagate a kiko ciengin ka hunkhie hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima tungah mi lungkhamte’ thupha ang tung a, keima in meigongte lungnuomin la ka sasah hi."},"14":{"text":"Puon bangin dihna ka sil a; ka thutanna pen puontuol le dielkhim tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"Mittawte adingin a mit uh ka hi a, khelbaite adingin a keng uh ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tasamte adingin a pa uh ka hi a, melmahte’ vai zong ka dinpi hi."},"17":{"text":"Thuman lote’ ha ka suhtawngpieh a, a ha uh panin a sa neh uh ka khiehpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin, ‘Ka bu sunga a si dingin ka kingaisun a, ka nite zong senel banga a tam dingin ka ngaisun hi;"},"19":{"text":"tui sungah ka huite zam a, zan tawn tungin ka bate tungah daitui a taa hi;"},"20":{"text":"ka sungah ka vanglietna thasuo zing a, ka khuta thal zong a tha zing hi,’ ka ci hi."},"21":{"text":"“Amate in ka thugen ngai-in ei ngah vua, sip dide-in ka thuhilna a ngai uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ka ham zaw ciengin a hamkia sih vua, ka thugente daitui bangin amate tungah taasuh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in guotui nga bangin ei ngah vua; guo masa ngah bangin a kam a golkah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Lungmuonna a nei lo ciengun amate ka nuimai a; amate in ka maitaina a sumang sam sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Uhpipa bangin ka to a, a lampi uh ka teelpieh hi, tuale a galkapte lahah kumpi bangin ka teng a, kei pen a date a henem khat tawh ka kibang hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ahi vangin tu-in kei sanga nauzaw, a pate uh ka tuucing uite za-a ka neumute in kei ei ciemmui bawl uhi."},"2":{"text":"A khut thahatna uh panin bang nga thei ding ka hei? A thahatna zosie uh a tawp ahi ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tasap zieh le gilkiel seng ziehin amate in gamgaw lahah singhuite a ngiet uhi,"},"4":{"text":"amate in muolheu paa loin singnate a hlieh vua, munphie zungte tawh a kisanglum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mipite tenna panin amate kidelmang a, guta khat a kidel bangin mite in amate a awhsan uhi."},"6":{"text":"Lui gawta-a hawhlam kuoh lah le leihawm suonghawm lahah a ten uh kul hi."},"7":{"text":"Sawlkawm lahah a peng vagua vua; a lomtangin lahkhai kawm lahah a kisengnawp valuoi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate pen kimanna a nei lo migina lo hon ahi vua, gam sung panin amate kinotmang hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tu-in simmawna la ei phuo vua; amau’ thusie gentena ka hi ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in ei kidah vua, ka kung panin a kikangkoi uhi; amate in ka maitang cilphi ding pen a kiheh vawt sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in ka thalgui ei sattanpieh zieh le a neilut dinga ei koi ziehin, ka mitmu-in a nop bangun ei bawl uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ka zietlamah khangno tatsiete a ding vua; amate in ei gamdelin ka siet nading lam a siel uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amahawn ka lampi susie-in ka tuosietna a khangsah uhi; amate a kham ding koima om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Lei hawmvang gol zui-in amate a lut vua, a sie nate lahah amate ang kilawmlia uhi."},"15":{"text":"Keima tungah zauna ang tung hi; hui in ka thupina a tawmang bangin ka citheina teng zosie zong meii bangin a theng hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tu-in ka sungah ka hlagau tui bangin kisung hi; gentheina nite in ei pha ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Zanin ka gu ka tangte in ei ngiet a, tua ei ngiet natnate in khawl hun a nei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Pauhat thu-in ka puon-ah ei man a; ka puon ngawngah ei gahcip hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in buonnawi lah ei denna a, vut le vai ka suoh hi."},"20":{"text":"Na kungah kang kiko a, nang in nei dawng sih hi; keima ka dingto a, nang in nei hem-et bep hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tungah nang gilo mama a; na banhat tawh nei bawlsie hi."},"22":{"text":"Hui lahah nei domto a, tua tungah nei tuongsah hi, nang in huipi ging lahah nei suhle nei tole hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang in sina zuon a nei zawpi ding ahi lam le mihing zosie dinga kisesa inn zuon a nei zawpi ding ahi lam ka thei hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tuosiet hunin panpina ngenin a kiko ciengun koima in tua tasamte a khia sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Hin gentheite adingin kaa kituhte hi lo ka mah? Mizawng gentheite zong lung gimpi hi lo ka mah?"},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin sil hoi ka kinep ciengin silsie ang tung zawsop a, khuovah ka lunggul ciengin khuomiel ang letun hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka sungkuo teng a kikhule gawp a, ka om ngim thei sih hi; nisim sielin gentheina nite ka tungah ang tung hi."},"28":{"text":"Ni mu loin miel lahah ka vah a; mihonpi lahah dingin huna ngenin ka kiko hi."},"29":{"text":"Si-alte’ sanggam ka hi ta a, va-kalaohte’ lawmpa ka hi ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka vun dupin a hawtol a, ka gute zong mei-kamsa a bang ta hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka lyre awging khu dana suoh a, ka theile zong si-uopte’ awging a suoh ta hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka mit tawh thuciemna ka bawl zo ta hi; ngahnuno khat bangci et thei ding ka hei?"},"2":{"text":"Tung Pasien kung panin ka tanh ding bang hi a, a sanga a om Vanglienpa kung panin ka gouluo ding bang ahei?"},"3":{"text":"A thuman lote tungah tuosietna tungin, khielna a bawlte tungah gimna tung hi lo amah?"},"4":{"text":"Ama in ka lampite thei-in, ka kalsuona zosie sim hi lo amah?"},"5":{"text":"“A khiel lamin ka kalsuon a, zuou phuo dingin ka naw kalsuon leh-"},"6":{"text":"tawikhaina man tawh ei kite hinlen, Pasien in ka citahna ei thei taheh!"},"7":{"text":"Lampi man panin ka piel a, ka lungsim in ka mitmu teng zui-in, ka khutah a nieh khatpo a ban leh;"},"8":{"text":"midangte in ka vawsa ne hinlen, keima dinga kicingte kiphungkal taheh."},"9":{"text":"“Numei khat in ka lungsim a zawl zo a, ka vengpa’ kot gei-a ka buhdap leh;"},"10":{"text":"ka zi in midangte’ an suhpieh hinlen, midangte in ama luppi taheh."},"11":{"text":"Tua khu a siehuoi gitlona ahi ziehin, thukhenna a thuoh ding khielna ahi hi;"},"12":{"text":"azieh pen tua khu Sietna dong a katum thei mei hi ding a, tua meikuong in ka anlah ding teng halvam ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ka sila numei in ahi a, ka sila pasal in ahi zongin kei ei hehin thu ang bawl ciengin, amau’ thu ka niel leh;"},"14":{"text":"tuaci’n Pasien ang dinto ciengin bang bawl ding ka hei? Ama in thu ang kan ciengin bang tawh dawng ding ka hei?"},"15":{"text":"Naubu sunga kei ei siempa in amate zong siem hi lo amah? Tuale naubu sungah eite pen khat’ ei siem hi lo amah?"},"16":{"text":"“Mizawngte’ deigaw na khatpo ka hlaw a, meigongte a mitmang dinga ka bawl leh,"},"17":{"text":"ahi sihle keima guohin an ka neh a, pa nei lote in an ka ngawlsah leh,"},"18":{"text":"a neu lai panin a pa bangin taga pa va-in, a nu sung pana kipanin meigongnu ka pui sihleh,"},"19":{"text":"Puonsil nei lo zieha mi a si khat, kihui nading a nei lo mizawng khat ka mu leh,"},"20":{"text":"a lungsimin thupha ei pieh sih a, ka tuumul tawh ka huilum sih leh;"},"21":{"text":"tunkotah ei panpi ding ka nei zieha tagate tungah ka khut ka lap leh;"},"22":{"text":"ka liengko a bulah kihlong hinlen, ka ban a bulah tawngsan taheh."},"23":{"text":"Keima in Pasien tung panin gimna ka giin ziehin, ama’ thupina tawh ka kisi ngam sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka muon pen kham ka hisah a, ka ngam pen kham hoite hi, ka ci leh,"},"25":{"text":"ka hau seng zieh le ka khut in tampi a lam zieha kipah ka hi leh;"},"26":{"text":"ni a tan ciengin ka et a, thupi taha a tawn hlapi ka et leh,"},"27":{"text":"ka lungsim ei dap zol ahi ta a, ka kam in ka khut ei daptawp ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam zong thukhente in dan a pieh ding khielna ahi a, tua ahi ziehin tung Pasien a niel ka suoh ta ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Kei ei mudate kisietna ziehin ka kipah a, sil hoi lo in amate a phah cienga ka thangphat leh-"},"30":{"text":"A si nadingun awsie suona tawh ka kam ka buasah ngai sih hi-"},"31":{"text":"Ka puonbuh sunga omte in, ‘Luohsuoh vawtin a sa kineh lei izaw!’ a ci uhi."},"32":{"text":"Lam dungah mikhuolte gieh ngai lo a, khuolzinte adingin ka kotte ka hong hi."},"33":{"text":"Midangte in a bawl bangin ka khielnate imcipin, ka lungsim sungah ka mawna ka seldap a,"},"34":{"text":"mipi ka giin seng ziehin, innkuonpite phawsiet ding ka zau ziehin, sip dide-in, kot kal loin ka om hi-"},"35":{"text":"Ka thugen a za ding mi khat om le maw! (Tanah ka min thuna om hi! Vanglienpa in ei dawng heh!).
