Ka langpa in ei hehna lai gielsa’n nei leh izaw!"},"36":{"text":"A tahtahin tua lai ka liengko-ah ka puo ding a, mang lukhu bangin ka lu tungah ka khu ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama kungah ka kalsuonna zosie ka sut ding a, milien bangin ama kung ka nai ding hi."},"38":{"text":"“Keima langah ka leitang kiko a, a tuma kuohte khu ang kaaton uleh,"},"39":{"text":"sum pie loin a gate ka neh a, tua lo neite ka pulsisah leh,"},"40":{"text":"mangbu tangin ling po hinlen, mangbuham tangin lopa po taheh,” a ci hi. Job’ thugente tawp ta hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama kimuna-ah thuman kisa ahi ziehin tam mihing thumte in Job a dawng nawn sih uhi.","title":"Elihu in Job’ Guolte Phawhsie"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ram innsung mi Buz-te Barachel’ tapa Elihu lungthah hi. Ama Job tungah lungthah hi, azieh pen Pasien sangin ama a kidihsahzaw hi;"},"3":{"text":"Job’ guolte thum tungah zong a lung thah hi; azieh pen amate in Job khiel hi, ci-in a pholah vangun a dawn nading a thei tuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama sangin amate a tazaw ahi ziehun tu-in Elihu in Job tawh kiho ding a ngahngah hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam mi thumte in a dawn thei lo lam Elihu in a mu bepin ama lungthah hi."},"6":{"text":"Buz mi Barachel’ tapa Elihu in dawng a: “Kei ka khangno lai-in, note khangham na hi ta uhi; tua ahi ziehin na kung vuah ka ngaisutnate kang pulah ding ka zum a, zong ka zau hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in, ‘Tehsie lamte in thu gen hinlen, kum tam lamte in pilna hil uheh,’ ka ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle a mantahin mi sunga om hla khu Vanglienpa’ hu ahi a, tua in theitelna a piengsah hi."},"9":{"text":"A khanghamte a pil ahi sih a, thuman theite zong khanghamte ahi tuon sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, ‘Ngai un; kei zong ka ngaisutna ei gensah un,’ ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"“En un, na thugen uh ngai dingin ka na ngah a, gen ding na sui kawi lai-un, na pilkam gente uh ka ngai hi."},"12":{"text":"Limtahin ka na ngai a, hinanle koima’n Job a niel zo sih a, note lahah a thugente a dawng thei koima a om sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin, ‘Pilna mu zo ta ung; ama a dawng ding pen Pasien ahi a, mihing ahi sih hi,’ ci sih un."},"14":{"text":"Kei ei kap nadingin thu a gen ngai sih a, note’ thugente tawh ama ka dawng sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Amate a ciza vua, bangma a dawng sih uhi; amate in gen ding kam khat zong a nei sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"A ham lo ziehun ke’n amate ngahin, khuna a din ziehun dawng nawn lo ding ka mah?"},"17":{"text":"Kei zong kang dawng ding a, ka ngaitsutna zong ka pholah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen gen ding a dimin ka nei hi; ka lungsim a ki-ip zo sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka lungsim pen pawtna ding nei lo a kibilcip lenggazu tawh kibang hi; lenggazu thawlthate bangin a pawhkhe dihtah ka bang hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka thuoh zawh nadingin thu ka gen kul hi; ka kam kahin ka dawn kul hi."},"21":{"text":"Koima guptuom le paituom ka nei sih ding a, koima ka maitangphat sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen mi pawh dan ka thei sih a, pawh leng zong ei Siempa in ei sumang pai ding hi!"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ahi zongin Job aw, tu-in ka thugen za inlen, ka gen zosie ngai in.","title":"Elihu in Job Phawhsie"},"2":{"text":"En in, keima in ka kam ka kah a, ka kam sunga ka lei in thu a gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka thugente in ka lungsim dihna a pulah a, amate in lungsim tahpi tawh a gen lam ka kam in a thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasien’ hlagau in keima ei siem a, Vanglienpa’ hu in hinna ei pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Nei dawn thei leh ei dawng in; na thugen dingte ka mai-ah guol in; ka mai-ah ding in."},"6":{"text":"En in, Pasien mai-ah kei zong nangma bang ka hi hi; kei zong tungman lom tawh ei na kisiem ka hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei nei giin nading a om sih hi; na tungah ka khut kang gihsah sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“A tahtahin keima’ zahna ah na gen zo ta a, tuale keima in na thugen gingte ka za zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang in, ‘Kei ka sieng a, ka khiel sih hi; kei ka siengtho a, ka sungah mawna a om sih hi."},"10":{"text":"En in, ama in kei ei suh nading paulap sui-in mu a, kei pen a galpa-in ei ngaisun hi;"},"11":{"text":"ama in ka kengah kol ei bul a, ka lampi zosie ei vil hi,’ na ci hi."},"12":{"text":"“Hizongle tam thu-ah nang na thuman sih hi. Keima in kang dawng ding hi: Mihing sangin Pasien lienzaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang dingin ama tawh kisel na hei? ‘Ka thugente khat beh ei dawng sih va,’ a ci na hi amah?"},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien in lam khat, lam ni-in thu gen nanle mite in a thei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Zanlai a lupna tung vua a haituh laitah uh, mite a ihsip laitahin mang le mangmuna sungah,"},"16":{"text":"a bil uh a honpieh a, hilkholna tawh amate zausahin,"},"17":{"text":"a gamtatnate panun kiheisah a, kilietsahna pan kidawmsahin,"},"18":{"text":"Hankhuh panin amau’ hlagau le Gunpi kantanna panin amau’ hinna a hunkhie hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate zong lupna tungah natna tawh thuhil a, khawl loin a gu a tangte uh a na sah hi,"},"20":{"text":"tuaci’n a hinkhuo un an a kidah a, antuipen zong a lunggul ta sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"A ci a sa uh kiemin a kimu thei ta sih uhi; tuale a kimu ngai lo a gu a tang teng uh kidawh sieng hi."},"22":{"text":"A hlagau uh Hankhuh neh ahi ta a, a hinkhuo uzong sina lam zuon ding ahi ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi khat thuman hi, ci-in a tangko ding, vantungmi palai ding khat, tul ah khat bang om hinlen,"},"24":{"text":"ama in tua mipa hepi-in ama kungah, ‘Hankhuh lam pei ding ama hunkhie in; ama tat nading sum keima’n ka nei hi;"},"25":{"text":"khangno-a’ bangin a ci a sa nosuokia a, a khangno thahat lai nite bangkia taheh,’ a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Pasien kungah thu a ngen a, ama in a thungetna a sang a, lungdamin a mai-ah a pei hi, tuale ama a thuman ziehin Pasien in ama thuhkia hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua pa in mi mai-ah la sa a, ‘Kei ka maw zo a, thuman ka lehei ta hi, keima tungah ei kithuhkia sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in Hankhuh sunga pei ding ka hlagau ei tan zo a, ka hinna in khuovah a mu ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“Pasien in mihingte tungah tam nate zosie nivei, thumvei bang a bawl ahi a,"},"30":{"text":"hinna khuovah a mu nadingun, Hankhuh panin amau’ hlagau a lahpieh ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Job aw, ka thugen limtahin ngai in; sip dide inlen thu kang gen ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Gen ding na nei leh ei dawng in; gen in, azieh pen nang dih kang tangsah nuom hi."},"33":{"text":"Na nei sih leh ka thugen ngai in; ham nawn sin, keima in ka pilna thu kang hil ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elihu in a genban zom a:","title":"Elihu in Pasien’ Thutanna Tangko"},"2":{"text":"“No mipilte aw, ka thugente za unlen, no thutheite aw, na bil uh na daw un;"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen dangso in an a ciep ma bangin bil in zong kammalte a sittel hi.","ref":"Job 12:11"},"4":{"text":"Thuman bang ahei ci teel vai; eite lahah a hoi bang ahei ciemte vai."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Job in, ‘Mawpeng ka hi a, Pasien in ka dihna a lamang hi;"},"6":{"text":"kei a thuman ka hi vangin mizuou-in ei kisim hi; suhkhiel nei lo hinan leng zong ka hima kidamsah zo nawn lo hi,’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Zakona tui dawn banga a dawn Job bang mi koi om ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Sil hoilo bawlte tawh kipawlin migilote tawh zawhton koi ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in, ‘Mi in Pasien sunga a nopsah ziehin a met bangma nga lo hi,’ a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin no thu ngaisun theite in ka thugen za un. Pasien in gitlona bawl lo ding a, Vanglienpa in a man loin sem lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen a sepna utawh kituohin ama in thuhkia ding a, a gamtatna utawh kituohin amate kungah a tungsah ding hi.","ref":"Late 62:12"},"12":{"text":"A tahtahin Pasien in sil hoi lo sem lo ding a, Vanglienpa in thutang lehei lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Leitung a uh dingin ama koi in ngansie a, koi in leitung buppi vai ama tungah nga ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Ama in a hlagau lakia hinlen, a hinna hu ama kungah hing khawm leh,"},"15":{"text":"mihing zosie si sieng ding a, mi zosie leivui-ah a peikia ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Theitelna na nei leh tam thu za inlen, ka thugen ngai in."},"17":{"text":"Thutang muda mipa in uh ding amah? Thuman le a thahat pa mawpaih ding na mah?"},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah koi in, ‘Nang miginalo pa! ci ding a, uliente kungah koi in, ‘Migilote,’ ci ding ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Koi in mithupite tungah maipha pie tuon loin, mizawngte sangin mihaute thupi ngaisutzaw tuon lo ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile amate a unpi-un ama’ khut tawh a siemsa hi lo uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"Amate bakhat sungin a si uhi; zankim laitahin mite lingin a si uhi. tuale mihing khut tawh loin a thahat mite kikaimang hi."},"21":{"text":"“Azieh pen a mit in mihingte’ lampi kaihlit zing a, a kalsuonna zosie uh mu sieng hi."},"22":{"text":"Silsie bawlte kiphuol thei nading khuozing ahi sihle miel thuhpi om lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in thukhenna thuoh a, Pasien’ mai-a pei ding hun koima adingin se tuon lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in a thu kan loin mi thahatte gawtguoi a, amate munah midangte koi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua bangin amau’ nasepte thei ahi ziehin, zanlai-in amate lumletin tuoncil hi."},"26":{"text":"Adangte in a et laitahin ama in a gitlona ziehun amate tehpuong hi,"},"27":{"text":"azieh pen ama a zuina panun a kihei vua, amate in a lampite a thupise sih uhi;"},"28":{"text":"tuaci’n amate in ama kungah mizawngte’ kikona tungsah a, mi gentheite’ kikona a za hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama a ham lo ciengin koi in mawsah thei ding ahei? Ama in a mai a phuol ciengin, minam khat in hile, mi khatguoh in hile koi in ama mu thei ding ahei?"},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien a thei lo mite, ahi sihle mi thangsiete in vai a hawm sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"“Azieh pen mi khatpo in Pasien kungah, ‘Dan ka thuoh zo ta hi; ka khiel nawn sih ding hi;"},"32":{"text":"ka mu lote ei hil inlen, mawna ka bawl leh ka bawl nawn sih ding hi,’ koi in ci ahei?"},"33":{"text":"Ama na niel ziehin ei lethuh kia va ci-a na ngaisut amah? Azieh pen nangma teel ding ahi a, kei teel ding hi lo hi. Tua ahi ziehin nangma in na thei thu hing pulah in."},"34":{"text":"Thu ngaisun theite in keima kungah ang gen ding vua, ka thugen a za mipilte in,"},"35":{"text":"‘Job in a thei lopi-in thu gen a, a thugente khietna a nei sih hi,’ ei ci ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Migilote bangin a dawnkia ziehin Job tungah a tawpna dongin thu kikhen leh ka nuom hi."},"37":{"text":"Azieh pen a mawna banah ledo lai a, ama in eite lahah a khut bengin, Pasien langpanna kammal tampitah a genbe lai hi,” a ci hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Elihu in a thugen zom a:","title":"Elihu in Kidihsahna Mawsah"},"2":{"text":"“Tam thu thutang hi, ci-in na ngaisun amah? Nang in, ‘Pasien’ mai-ah ka dih hi,’ na ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang in, ‘Ke’n bang phattuomna nga ka hei? Maw leng bangci hoi zawh ding ka hei, ci-a na dawh leh,"},"4":{"text":"nangma le na guolte kungah kang dawng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Vante en unlen mu un; no sanga a sangzaw meiilumte en un."},"6":{"text":"A maw zo na hi leh ama bang sukha na hei? Na khielna a tam mama leh, tuate in ama bang a ci suhkhah ahei?"},"7":{"text":"A thuman na hi leh ama tungah bang na pie a; ahi sihle ama in na khut tung panin bang teng sang ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Na gitlona in nang tawh a kibang midangte sukha a, na thumanna in nang tawh a kibang adang mihingte ma a sukha hi.","ref":"Job 22:2-3"},"9":{"text":"“Bawlsietna tampite ziehin mihonpi a kiko uhi; mihatpa banhat ziehin amate in huna ngen uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin koima in, ‘Zan khang lai-a ei thakhausah, keima ei siempa ka Pasien hei-a om ahei?’ a ci sih vua,"},"11":{"text":"leitung ganhingte sangin thu ei tam hilzaw a, hui lahah a leng vate sanga a pil zaw-a ei bawl ahi hi,’ zong a ci sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khumnah amate a kiko vua, hinanle silsie bawlte a kilietsah ziehin ama in dawng lo hi."},"13":{"text":"A tahtahin Pasien in kikona hawmpite a za sih a, Vanglienpa in amau’ kikona a thudon sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama ka mu sih a, ka thu ama mai-ah a tung hi, ama ngah ka hi hi, na ci ciengin ama in na thu bang ang ci tawm zahpieh zaw lai diei!"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in ama’ lungthahna in dan a pieh lo ziehin ama in khielna bawl ding pen a thupi ngaisut seng sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Job kam kahin thu mawh gen a, a thei lopi-in thu tampi gen hi,” a ci hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elihu in a thugen zom a:","title":"Elihu in Pasien’ Hoina Tawisang"},"2":{"text":"“Tawmvei sung ei thuoh lai un, keima in note kang lah ding hi, azieh pen Pasien’ tangin gen ding kimkhat ka nei lai hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamlapi panin ka theina kang keng ding a, thumanna pen kei ei Siempa-a’ ka hisah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ka thugente a khiel sih hi; nang tawh theina bukim nei pa a omton hi."},"5":{"text":"“A tahtahin Pasien thahat a, koima simmaw lo hi; ama pen theitelna’ thakhauhna sungah thahat hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in migilote a hinkhawi sih a, hinanle gimthuohte tungah dihtahin na sem hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in mi thumante limtahin en a, hinanle kumpite, kumpi topha tungah kum tawn adingin tosah a, amahaw kitawisang hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate kolah kibulin gentheina khau-a a awkhah uleh,"},"9":{"text":"amau’ kiphatsah gamtatnate ziehin ama in amate tungah a sepna ule a khielnate uh a pulah hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in thuhilna ngai dingin a bil uh honpieh a, mawna pan a kilekia nadingun thu a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Thu ngai-in ama’ na a sep uleh, a nite uh hauna-in a mang ding vua, a kumte uh nopsahna-in a zang ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle amate in a ngai sih uleh, namsau tawh a si ding vua, a theilona ziehun a sigam ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Lungsim sunga Pasien nei lote in lungthahna a vom uhi; ama in amate a hen ciengin huna ngenin a kiko sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate khansi-in a hinna uh zumhuoi tahin a tawpsah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a gentheina panun mi gentheite hunkhie a, hahsatna panin a bil uh a honpieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in zong lungkhamna panin uhcipna om lo mun tanzau-ah nang ang zawl a, na sabuoi tunga an kiluite zong khu a tui a al vive ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hinanle migilote vai-ah nuom na sa a, thukhenna le thutang in nang ang mancip hi."},"18":{"text":"Thangpaina in simmawna-ah ang zawl lo nadingin kidawm inlen, guhgol sum tampi ziehin lam kipielsah sin."},"19":{"text":"Na kikona le na thahatna zosie in na gentheina panin ang hu zo ding amah?"},"20":{"text":"Amau’ munah mite a kisuhmang hun ding, zan hun ang tun ding kal ngahla sin."},"21":{"text":"Kidawm in! Sietna lamah kihei sin; tuami zieha gentheina tawh ang kize-et ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"En in, a vanglietna sungah Pasien kitawisang hi; ama tawh kibang sie koi om ahei?"},"23":{"text":"A pei nading lampi koi in lah a, ahi sihle, ‘Nang na khiel hi,’ koi in ci thei ding ahei?"},"24":{"text":"“Mite in la-a a phat uh ama’ nasepte nahpitaha na patawi ding lam phawh in.","title":"Elihu in Pasien’ Thupina Tangko"},"25":{"text":"Mi zosie in a nasepna mu zo uhi; a gamla panin mi zosie in a gal et uhi."},"26":{"text":"A tahtahin Pasien lien a, ama i thei zo sih uhi; ama’ kumte kan zawh ding hi lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in tuimalte lato a, tuikhute khaihin guo-in a zusah hi,"},"28":{"text":"vante in guotuite sungsuh a, mite tungah niengtahin zusah hi."},"29":{"text":"Koi in meiite a kithezah dan le a inn-a awging thei zo ding ahei?"},"30":{"text":"En in, ama in a kimkotah tun phesah a, tuipi thuh sung teng a khucip hi."},"31":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in tam teng tawh mite uh a, nehletah cingtahin a pie hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in a khut tawh kehtang tawi a, a dawina tah a kha dingin sep hi."},"33":{"text":"A awging in ama thu a gen a, khielna tungah lungthahna tawh ama a haza hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tami thu-ah ka lungtang kisai a, ka lung vana khai a bang hi."},"2":{"text":"Ngai un, vanto tawh kibang ama’ awging le a kam pana pusuoh awging ngai vawi un."},"3":{"text":"Ama in vansin nei zosie-ah tunphe hla a, lei mong dong a tangsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin ama’ aw ging a, a thupina awging tawh van thawnsahin, a awging a kizah ciengin tunphete khawlsah tuon lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasien in a aw tawh lamdang tahin van tosah a, ama in i thei zawh lo na lienpite a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in vua kungah, ‘Leitungah kiesuh in,’ ci hi; tuale a gih mama a guomal pen"},"7":{"text":"a piensah zosie in ama a thei nadingin mi zosie’ khutah lim khatin kizang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ganhingte a kuo sungah lut a, a kuo sung ciet vuah a om uhi."},"9":{"text":"Leitaw panin pumpei kihia a, leilu panin huivot a lang hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien’ husan in tuikhal piengsah a, tui maitang tengah a khalkhalin om hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in meii sapi lahah tuikhu guong a, meiilumte in a tunphe a kithezahsah hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi tenna lei maitang tungah ama in a bawl ding vua a sawl zosie a kiman sieng nadingin ama’ puina bangin amate kihei kawikawi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in danpiehna ding ahi a, ahi sihle gam ading ahi a, ahi sihle itna lahna-in ahi zongin tuate a piengsah hi."},"14":{"text":"“Job aw, tam khu za in; khawl inlen Pasien’ na lamdang bawlte ngaisun in."},"15":{"text":"Pasien in amate tungah thu bangci pieh a, meii panin tunphe a taansah theina na thei amah?"},"16":{"text":"A kileh kimin meiilumte a zam theina, a bukim theina a nei Pasien’ bawl a na lamdangte na thei ei mah?"},"17":{"text":"Leitaw lam huipi ziehin leitung a vot ciengin, na puonsilte bang dinga lum thei ahei, ci na thei ei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Limlang banga a sah vantungte ama’ zeh bangin na zeh thei amah?"},"19":{"text":"Ama kungah ka gen ding uh ei hil in; khuomiel ziehin ka thu uh ka gel thei sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka gen nuom thute ama kunga kigen phot ding amah? Mi khatpo in ama’ siet nadingin thu gen nuom ngai ding amah?"},"21":{"text":"Tu-in vantungah khuovah a tan laitah, hui langin tuate a mut sieng ciengin, koima in khuovah a en thei sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Leilu lam panin kham melpuo khuovah tang a, Pasien kimkotah a giinhuoi thupina a om hi."},"23":{"text":"Eite in Vanglienpa, i mu thei sih hi; ama vanglien mama-in zong thutang a, a lien mama a thumanna ziehin ama in mi gawt lo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mite in ama a zatah vua, ama in a kipilsahte a thusim sih hi,” a ci hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin pumpei lah panin Topa in Job dawng a:","title":"in Job Dawngkia"},"2":{"text":"“Theina om lopi-in thu gen a, ka thuhilna a mielsah koi ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Kipasalsah inlen na kawng gah in, thu kang dong ding a, nei dawng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Leitung bulpi ka phu lai-in nang hei-a om na hei? Theitelna na nei leh ei gen in."},"5":{"text":"Bang cie phasah ding ci koi pen’ se ahei?-thei mama vateh! Ahi sihle a tunga tena khau hlungpa khu koi ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Bang pen tungah a khuomte kiphut a, a ninga suong khu koi’ phum ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Zingsol aasite in la a sahton cieng ule vantung mite zosie kipahin a awng uh amah?"},"8":{"text":"“Ahi sihle a kam panin tuipi a let ciengin, tuipi kotte koi in khah ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Meiilum puonin bawlin, khuomiel sapi naupuon-a ka bawl lai,"},"10":{"text":"a gamgi ciemte-in kotpite le kotgolhte ka bawl lai-in,"},"11":{"text":"‘Tam cieng pei-inlen a ban kal sin, na kiphatsahpi tuihuolte tana khawl ding hi ta, kang ci ngel sih amah?’ ka ci hi.","ref":"Jer 5:22"},"12":{"text":"Na pien ni-a kipanin zingmawng thu pie-in, phalvah zong ama’ mun ding theisahin,"},"13":{"text":"tuaci’n leimong dong a salvah nading le tua panin migilote a thinmang nadingin nang in thu na pie ngai ta amah?"},"14":{"text":"Seal kitum tungman bangin leitung kikhel a, zatui tawh a kibum puon tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilote’ meivah kimitsah a, amau’ ban thahat kisattan pieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuipi sunga tuinah-ah lut kha ngai-in tuipi thuhpen nei-ah na pei ngai ta amah?"},"17":{"text":"Na kungah sina tunkotte ang kilah ngai-in, miel thuhpi’ tunkotte na mu ngai ta amah?"},"18":{"text":"Leitung bangcie pha ci na thei ei mah? Ta teng zosie na thei leh hing pulah in."},"19":{"text":"“Khuovah a opna lampi hei sung hi a, khuomiel a opna mun hei sung ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n a gamgi dong na puoh thei ding a, a inn zotna lampite na thei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum hunin nang suoh zo na hi ziehin na kum tam lam zong thei mama vateh!"},"22":{"text":"“Vua kikholna inn ah lut kha ngai-in, ahi sihle gieltang kholna inn na mu ngai ta amah?"},"23":{"text":"Tuate, lunggim hun le gal kido hun cieng dinga ka hen ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Khuovah kizelna lampi bang hi a, leitungah suolam hui a kizelsuohna mun hei tah ahei?"},"25":{"text":"“Guotui luon nading hawhlam to a, keh kieh nading lampi sielpiehin,"},"26":{"text":"koima’ ten lona gam, mihing op lona senel tungah guo zusahin,"},"27":{"text":"a tulsa gamkhingte a lungkim nadingin koi in lopa posah ahei?"},"28":{"text":"“Guotui in pa a nei amah?, daicimte koi’ piensah ahei?"},"29":{"text":"Koi’ naubu panin tuikhal pieng a, koi in vantunga vuakhalte piengsah ahei?"},"30":{"text":"Tuite suong bangin sah a, tuipi thuh maitangte khalgawp hi."},"31":{"text":"“Vana Bawmluoite khiton thei-in, Zawlzawng kihenna khau na phel thei amah?","ref":"Job 9:9; Amos 5:8"},"32":{"text":"Amau’ hun zui-a a pei aasite pui thei-in, Ngambawm le a tate lampi na lah thei amah?"},"33":{"text":"Vantung nate’ thukipte na thei amah? Leitungah amahaw’ ngaina dante na bawl thei amah?"},"34":{"text":"“Tuilet in ang hlup thei nadingin meiilom tungah na kiko to thei diei mah?"},"35":{"text":"Tunphete na sawl thei nadingin na kungah hing pei-in, ‘Tanah om ung,’ ang ci ding amah?"},"36":{"text":"Koi in pumpi sung lamah pilna koi a, koi in lungsim sungah theitelna pie ahei?"},"37":{"text":"Koi in meiite sim thei ahei? Ahi sihle leivuite a khalin kilomin leithemte a kimat ciengin, koi in vantunga tuibeemte buosuh thei ahei?","merge":"38"},"39":{"text":"“Humpite sa matpieh thei-in, a kuo sung ahi sihle gamlahah sa a buh ciengun, nang in humpi a note na taisah zo amah?","merge":"40"},"41":{"text":"Pasien tungah va-ah’ note kiko-in neh ding nei loin a len kawikawi ciengun, koi in amate an sih ahei?"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Muol tunga sakelte suo hun na thei amah? Sakhi a no nei hun na vil amah?"},"2":{"text":"Hla bangza sung gai uh ahei ci sim thei-in, a suo hun ding uh na thei amah?"},"3":{"text":"A no suoh dingin lei-ah amate bawh a, a no nei lam uh na thei amah?"},"4":{"text":"A note a thakhauh vua, gamlahah khanglien uhi; amate a pusuoh vua, a pite kungah a kilekia nawn sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Gam-laate koi in hla ahei? A kikhina khau koi in sut a,"},"6":{"text":"a inn ding uh gamgaw lah hisahin, a tenna uh citui gam hisah hi lo ka mah?"},"7":{"text":"Khuopi gamlumna a nuisan zieu lel vua, sakol leeng hawipa’ kikona awging a za sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Muoltangte tungah an a mai vua, hampa lohing zosie a sui kawikawi uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Gam-bawngtang in nangma’ na a sem nuom amah? Zanlai-in na gankuong gei-ah a gieh ding amah?"},"10":{"text":"Tumakuoh ah khau tawh na khi thei amah? Ahi sihle na nua-a kuomte hlo ding amah?"},"11":{"text":"A thahat ziehin ama tungah kingamin, ama tungah na nasep ap ding na hi amah?"},"12":{"text":"Na ancilna ah na ante hing puo-in ang kilekia dingin na um amah?"},"13":{"text":"“A hlakui-ah a mul om sih nanle va-kalaohte in a hla hazapin a zap uhi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen a tuite lei lahah nuasie a, leitungah tuate a lumsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Keng khatpo in tuonkeh kha va ci a phawh sih a, gamsa khat in tuon kha va ci zong a phawh sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama-a’ ahi lo bang danin a note a huot bawl a, a tui a thah ziehin gimnate a mawhna suoh nanle a thuse sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in pilna nei loin ama bawl a, tuale theitelna zong ama a kipie sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a lengto dingin a hla a zah ciengin sakol le a tunga tuongpa a nuisan zieu lel hi."},"19":{"text":"“Nang in sakol na hatsah amah? Nang in sakol’ ngawngmul na posah amah?"},"20":{"text":"Kauphe bangin na kitomsah amah? Ama’ nahsem ging pen zauhuoi mama hi."},"21":{"text":"A cin tawh nahpi-in lei khuotin, nasietahin lungdam kipah a, galte tawh kimu dingin a kuon hi."},"22":{"text":"Zauna kici nuisanin a lungkie sih a, namsau panin a kinuale sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama tunga om thalbawm khu kilawhin a ging a, teipi le teikhawte a te lihleh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in lungthahna le zauhuoina tawh lei valtum a, pengkul a kitum ciengin ama a omngim thei sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Pengkul a gin ciengin, Haha! ci-in a ham hi. A gamla panin gal gimnam za a, galkap bute’ husa le awgingte kiza hi."},"26":{"text":"“Na pilna ziehin mupi sanglenin, leitaw lamah a hla a zap amah?"},"27":{"text":"Nang thupiehna tawh muvanlai sanglenin, a sangpi-ah bu a tom amah?"},"28":{"text":"Suongpi tungah ama teng a, suong kuohawm lahah bu a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Khum panin a sa mat dingte buh a, a gamlapi panin a mit in a galmu hi."},"30":{"text":"A note in sisan a hup vua, gansi opna po-ah ama a om hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 24:28; Luk 17:37"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale Topa in Job kungah gen a:"},"2":{"text":"“Mawna mu thei pa in Vanglienpa kiselpi ding amah? Pasien tawh kiniel poma in ei thuhkia taheh,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in Topa a dawng hi:","title":"Pasien Kungah Job’ Dawnna"},"4":{"text":"“En in, kei bangma ka hi sih hi; bangci dawn ding ka hei? Ka khutin ka kam ka hum hi."},"5":{"text":"Khatvei ka ham zo a, ka dawng sih ding hi; nivei ka gen zo a, ahi vangin ka genbe nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin pumpei lah panin Topa in Job dawng a:","title":"Pasien in Job a Tawhna"},"7":{"text":"“Kipasalsah inlen, na kawng gah in; thu kang dong ding a, nei gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nang in kei nangawn ei khielsah ding na mah? Na dih thei nadingin kei ei mawsah ding na mah?"},"9":{"text":"Pasien bangin ban nei-in, a awging tawh van na tosah thei amah?"},"10":{"text":"“Thupina le vangneina tawh kivon in; minthanna le pikuonna puon bangin sil in."},"11":{"text":"A letkhe na lungthahna teng bungsuh inlen, mi kiphasah zosie en inlen nuoicip in."},"12":{"text":"Mi kiphasah zosie en inlen khiesuh in. Migilote amau’ dinna munah tuoncil in."},"13":{"text":"Amahaw zosie lei ah phuolton in; a maitangte uh leinei-ah khicip in."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin kei in zong na zietlam khut tawh ama guolzawna na pieh ka tahsang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Nang bang lien-a ka bawl Behemoth en in; ama in bawngtang bangin lopa a ne hi."},"16":{"text":"A kawngah a hatna om a, a gil sagolh lahah a thahatna om hi."},"17":{"text":"A mei, taamtah singzang bangin ka bawl a, a phei sagolhte a huolhuolin ka omsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama’ gute sumngo lawng bang a, ama’ khut le kengte siazawl bang hi."},"19":{"text":"“Pasien’ nasep liente lahah a masa pen ahi a, ama a Bawlpa beh in namsau tawh ama neh thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile muolsangte in a neh ding lopa posah a, gamsa zosie a ki-apmai uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tui-unoh singkungte nei-ah ama lum a, nawng sunga pumpeng lahah kiphuol hi."},"22":{"text":"A hlim dingin tui-unoh singkungte in ama lie a, luidunga gielheh kungte in ama kimkot hi."},"23":{"text":"Gunte nangawn let nanle a zau sih a, Jordan gun a kam tan dong gei-in khang nanle lungmuongin a om hi."},"24":{"text":"Koi in siakawi tawh man zo ding a, koi in thangsie-in a nah pheh zo ding ahei?"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngakuoi tawh Leviathan kai zo-in, khau tawh a lei na sawntum zo ngel ei mah?","ref":"Late 74:14; 104:26; Isa 27:1"},"2":{"text":"A nah sungah khau thun thei-in, siakawi tawh a khadang na vut pailet zo diei mah?"},"3":{"text":"Na kungah tamveipi ang thum ding amah? Kamdam tawh ang hopi ding amah?"},"4":{"text":"A khantawna na sila-a lah dingin nang tawh thuciemna bawl ding amah?"},"5":{"text":"Vate bangin ama tawh ki-apmai-in, na sila numeite adingin khau na khi diei mah?"},"6":{"text":"Sumbawlte in a man deh ding uh amah? Sumbawlte lahah a hawm ding uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"A vunte siazum tawh na sun thei diei mah? Nga khawna teipi tawh a lu na khawlet zo diei mah?"},"8":{"text":"A tungah na khut va ngam ta’n; kidopi dingin ngaisun in; kipankia vawt sih vateh!"},"9":{"text":"Ama mat ding lametna khu lungkiehna ahi bep hi; a muna-ah pasien-te nangawn kizothaw hi lo amah?"},"10":{"text":"Ama phin ngam ding za-in a hangsan koima a om sih hi. Ama mai-a a ding ngam ding koi ahei?"},"11":{"text":"Ama tawh kisi a, a suohta koi ahei? - Vansin nei zosie-ah a koi pen ahei?"},"12":{"text":"“Keima in ama’ gute tawh kisai, a thahatnate le a duong kilawmnate gen loin ka om sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Koi in ama’ puonsil tungnung hawhpieh zo ahei? Koi in ama’ sia puonpi sun pailet zo ahei?"},"14":{"text":"A maitanga kotte koi in hong zo ahei? Ama’ ha kimkotah sil zauhuoi a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama’ elzang pen a kiguol ditdet lumte tawh kibawl a, seal kitum bangin a kicimat cihteh hi."},"16":{"text":"Khatlekhat a kimat ditdet ziehin a kikal vuah hui a pit sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuate khatlekhat a kizom ditdet hi; tuate kimat dimdemin phel zawh ding hi lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in hatthi a law ciengin khuovah kikhaw a, zingmawng nisuo bangin a mitte a taang hi."},"19":{"text":"A kam panin meikuongte ang pawtdawh a, meisite a leng vapual hi."},"20":{"text":"Mei kitaw pumpeng le tuibeel so bangin ama’ nah sung panin meikhu pusuoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ husan in mei tawkuong a, ama’ kam panin meikuong pusuoh hi."},"22":{"text":"A ngawngah a hatna om a, ama’ mai-ah zauna a laam hi."},"23":{"text":"A tahsa kihlipte kimat suoh a, phen thei loin dettahin a om hi."},"24":{"text":"A lungtang suong bangin sah a, an gawina suong neipha bangin sah bihbeh hi."},"25":{"text":"A thawto ciengin pasien-te a zau uhi; a ging a zah ciengun zau-in a nuakin uhi."},"26":{"text":"Namsau tawh a kisut vangin a bun zo sih a, teipi, thaltang, teikhaw tawh kisun nanle bun zo tuon lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Siate butu bangin ngaisun a, sumngo zong sing muot bangin ngaisun zieu lel hi."},"28":{"text":"Thal in ama taisah zo lo a, ama dingin suongsaili zong buvai tawh kibang lel hi."},"29":{"text":"Moltumte buvai bangin ngaisun a, teipi ging a nuisat vazuau hi."},"30":{"text":"A neilang pen belpho keh tawh kibang a, buon tunga busatna om bangin kipha hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuithuhte beel sunga tuiso bangsah a, tuipi zong sathau bung bangin a bawl hi."},"32":{"text":"A peina nua lampite tangsah a; mite in tuithuh pen khu a samkangin a ngaisun uhi."},"33":{"text":"Leitungah a kikimpi koima a om sih a, giin kici a nei lo ganhing khat ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"A kisangsah zosie kan kawikawi a, ama pen a kiliensah zosie tunga kumpi ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Job in Topa dawng a:","title":"Job Neilutin Kilungkimsah"},"2":{"text":"“Bangkim na bawl thei lam le na siltupte koima in a khaam thei lo lam ka thei hi."},"3":{"text":"‘Theina loin koi in tam thuhilna phuoldap ahei? Tua ziehin ka theitel lo thute, ka thei lo le kei dinga a lamdang mama thute ka gen zo hi.","ref":"Job 38:2"},"4":{"text":"‘Za in, kang gen ding hi; nang kang dong ding a, kei kungah nei gen ding hi,’ nei ci hi.","ref":"Job 38:3"},"5":{"text":"Na thugente ka bilin ka na za ngai a, hinanle tu-in ka mit in ang mu ta hi;"},"6":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin kei le kei ka kisimmaw a, leivui le vut kinu-in ka kisia ta hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in tam thu zosie Job kungah a gen zaw ciengin, Topa in Teman mi Eliphaz kungah: “Nang le na guol gel tungah ka lungthahna a kuong hi; azieh pen kei thu a manin na gen sih hi.","title":"Job’ Guolte Kizumsah"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin tu-in bawngtang sagi le tuutang sagi kai-in ka nasempa Job kungah peipi unlen, noma dingin meihal biehna bawl un; tuale ka nasempa Job in note adingin ang thumpieh ding hi; azieh pen keima in note’ motna tawh kizui-in kang bawl sih ding hi; ama’ thungetna ka sang ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile note in Job’ gen bangin keima’ thu a manin na gen sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n Teman mi Eliphaz le Shuh mi Bildad le Naamath mi Zophar pei-in Topa in amate kunga a gen bangin a gamta vua, tuale Topa in zong Job’ thungetna a sanpieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Job in a guol thum teng adingin thu a ngetpieh zaw ciengin Topa in Job citheisah kia hi; tuale Job tungah Topa in nidanga a neisa a zani-in a piekia hi.","title":"Job’ Hauna a Zani-in Kipiekia","ref":"Job 1:1-3"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah a sanggam numei pasal zosie le nidang lai-a a melthei teng zosie a haw vua, inn sungah ama tawh an a neton uhi; Topa in ama tunga a tunsah sil hoi lo zosie ziehin ama hlasietpi-in a henem uhi; tuale amate in sum pawlkhat le kham khutsip khat ciet a pie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in a masa lam sangin a hun nukhia lamah Job thupha piezaw a, ama in tuu tulsawm le tulli, kalaoh tulguh, bawngtang kap tulkhat, le laa api tulkhat nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tapa sagi le tanu thum nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a tanu masa pen’ min Jemimah phuoh a, a nina pen Keziah hisahin a thumna nu’ min pen Keren-happuch phuoh hi."},"15":{"text":"A gam sung zosie vuah Job’ tanute banga melhoi a om sih a, a sanggam pasalte tawh kibangin a pa un amate gamh a luosah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Job kum za le kum sawmli sung hing lai a, khangli cieng dong a ta, a tute le a tusawnte mu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale Job a khan hlinin a vuoisi hi."}}}}},"19":{"info":{"name":"Lapite","shortname":"Late","abbr":[],"desc":"Late bu the book of psalms)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi nuomsa i ci in migilote’ zolna a zui lo mi, mawneite’ lampi-ah a ding lo mi, mi thusim lote tawh a toton lo mi;","title":"BU KHATNA (Late 1–41) Lampi Nite"},"2":{"text":"amau’ lungnopna in Topa’ thu sung beh ma hi-in, sun le zanin ama’ thu a lungngaingai mite ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate pen luitui luong gei-a kisuon, ama’ hunin ga a, a te a vul ngai lo singkungte tawh a kibang uhi. A sepna uh bangkimah amate a dau uh a pei hi.","ref":"Jer 17:8"},"4":{"text":"Migilote ahile tua bang ahi sih a, hui in a semmang ansi tawh a kibang uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin migilote in thukhenna a thuoh zo sih vua, maw neite zong khu mi thumante lahah a ta zo sih ding uhi;"},"6":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Topa in thuman mite’ lampi cing a, ahi vangin migilote’ lampi kisiemang ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bang dingin minamte kipawl dapin, mite in a mawhnapi sawmdap uh ahei?","title":"A Sathaunu pa Tunga Pasien’ Kamciem"},"2":{"text":"Topa le a sathau nu pa langkhatah leitung kumpite a pangton vua,"},"3":{"text":"“Amau’ ei khina khaute bottanin, eite kung panin a khaute uh i paimang ding hi, a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Vantunga a to pa nui a; Topa in amate zako hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a lungthahna tawh amate hopi ding a, ama in lungsona tawh amate zausahin,"},"6":{"text":"“Ka muol siengtho Zion tungah ka kumpipa ka tosah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in Topa’ thukip ka tangko ding hi: Ama in keima kungah, “Nang ka tapa na hi hi; tuni-in nang kang piengsah zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima kungah hing ngen in, na luo dingin minamte ka bawl ding a, leimong dongin na neisa ka suohsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Sia cieng khat tawh amate na satkeh ding a, beelkheng pa in leibeel a denguoi bangin, nangma in amate na dengguoi ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ziehin kumpite aw, tu-in pil ta un; leitung a uh mite aw, thuhilna thei un."},"11":{"text":"Zauna tawh Topa’ na semin, linna tawh"},"12":{"text":"ama’ keng nam unlen, tua ahi sihle ama ang lungthah ding a, lamkalah na sigam ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile ama’ lungthahna khu mallang tahin a kikuontaw hi. Ama a bel mi zosie mi nuomsa ahi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka galte tam sam e! Kei ei langpang ding mi tam mama hi;","title":"Hamsatna Sungah Pasien Muonna"},"2":{"text":"mi tampite in keima kungah, “Nang adingin Pasien sungah huna om lo hi,” ei ci uhi. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nangma khu ka kimvela ka kidalna lum na hi a, ka vang le ka lu ei phongto pa na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa tungah nahpi-in ka kiko a, ama in a muol siengtho panin keima ei dawng hi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Keima lumin ka kimu hi; Topa in ei kep ziehin ka khanglo kia hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka kimkotah keima ei langpang mi tul sawm tampite ka giing sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw tho in! Kei ei hunkhie in, ka Pasien aw! Bangzieh ahei cile nang in ka galte na pangbeh gawp a, migilote’ ha na sutawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Hutkhietna khu Topa -a’ ahi hi; na mite tungah na thupha tung taheh! Selah"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dih ei tangsah Pasien aw, kang hlat ciengin ei dawng in! Nangma in ka lungkham ciengin nopsahna nei pie hi. Keima ei hepi inlen, ka thungetna ei za in.","title":"Galte kungpan Suotah nading Muonna tawh Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"No, mite aw, ka minphatna in bang tanvei zumna thuoh ding ahei? Bang tanvei thumawhnate dei-in zuouthu sui lai ding na hi uh ahei? Selah"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in ama adingin mi muonhuoite a tuomkoi lam thei un."},"4":{"text":"Na lungbuoi ciengun maw sih un; na lupna tung vuah ngaisun unlen, dai tahin om un. Selah","ref":"Eph 4:26"},"5":{"text":"A man biehpiehnate pie unlen, Topa muong un."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampite in, “Sil hoi kimkhat mu thei uleng maw! Kote tungah na maipha khuovah hing tangsah in, Topa aw!” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"An le lenggazu a hau cieng vua amate a lungnop uh sangin nangma in a lienzaw lungnopna ka lung sungah nei guon hi."},"8":{"text":"Nuomtahin lumin ka kimu ta ding hi; azieh pen Topa aw, nangma beh in bihtahin keima nei lumsah hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thugente na bil daw in; ka khuisahnate ei don in.","title":"Galte pana Suotah nading Muonna tawh Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka Kumpi le ka Pasien aw, na kunga thu ngen ka hi ziehin ka kikona ei ngai in."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, zingmawngin ka aw na za hi; zingmawngin na kungah ka thu hing tutin kang ngah hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen gitlona nuom a sa Pasien na hi sih hi; nangma tawh sietna omton thei lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi kisatheite na mai-ah ding lo ding hi; nangma in sietna bawlte na muda hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma in zuouthu gente na susie a, Topa in sisan suote le mi sol theite a huo hi."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle a kicing na itna kip ziehin na inn sungah kang lut ding a, na biehinn siengtho lamah zatahna tawh kang kunsuh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, ka galte ziehin na thumanna-ah kei ei pui in; ka mai-ah na lampi tangsah in."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kam sung vuah thuman om lo hi; a lungtangte uh zong sietna ding vive ahi hi; a lawl uh pen hankhuh kihongsa ahi a; a kampi utawh mi a mot pawh uhi.","ref":"Rom 3:13"},"10":{"text":"Pasien aw, a khielna uh amate ma puosah inlen; amau’ ngaisutna ma tawh amate puasah in; a khielna uh tampite ziehin amate notmang in, bangzieh ahei cile amate in nang ang ledo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle nang ang beel mi zosie kipahsah in; amate in lungdamin la sasah den ta’n. Nangma sungah na min a it mite a kipah thei nadingin amate tungah na dalna puon zah in."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa aw, nangma in thumante thupha na pie hi; nangma in angvanna tawh amate lum bangin na sung hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na lungthah ciengin ei phawhsie sinlen, na thangpai ciengin zong thu ei hil sin.","title":"A Siehuoi Natna pana Damkia nading Thungetna","ref":"Late 38:1"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, gimin ka tha nem ziehin ei hepi in; Topa aw, zau-in ka gu ka tangte a kilin ziehin kei ei damsah in."},"3":{"text":"Ka hlagau zong zau-in genthei mama hi. Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt ding na hei?"},"4":{"text":"Topa aw hing kihei inlen, ka hinna ei hun in. Na itna kip ziehin keima ei hunkhie in."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sina sungah nang ang kiphaw nading om lo hi. Misikhuo-ah koi in nang ang phat thei ding ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Ka tautauna-in ka gim a, zan sielin ka hlitui in ka lupna a hlummang hi. Ka kaakaa na lamin ka lupna a tehlop dildel hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka dana ziehin ka mit miel a, ka gal zosiete ei bawlin ka mit a thazawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Sietna a bawl mi zosie ka kung panin kihemkhie un, azieh pen Topa in ka kaana aw za zo hi.","ref":"Mat 7:23; Luk 13:27"},"9":{"text":"Topa in ka thumna ei za zo hi; Topa in ka thungetna ei sang zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka galte zosie zau-in a maizum ding uhi; amate a kilekia ding vua, thakhatin maizumna a thuoh ding uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, nangma kang bel hi; kei ei del zosiete kung panin ei hundam inlen ei hunkhie in,","title":"Mi bawlsiete Langpan ding Huna Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"tua hi sihle amate in humpi bangin ei ehmal ding uhi; amate in ei kaiphitin ei hun ding koima om lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, keima in tam bang ka sep khah a, ka khut in sep khiel a nei leh,"},"4":{"text":"sietna tawh ka guolte ka thuhkia a, a hang om lopi-in ka galte ka bulu leh,"},"5":{"text":"galte in kei ei delin ei pha hinlen, lei lahah ka hinna tuoncilin, leivui lahah ka hlagau siel ta uheh. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, a lungthahsa-in hing tho in; ka galte lungsona langah hing dingto in. Ka Pasien aw, hing tho in; nang in thukhenna ding na se zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na opna kimah mite kikhawmsah inlen, amate tung a sangna mun topha tungah to in."},"8":{"text":"Topa in mite tungah thu a khen hi; Topa aw, ka thumanna le ka sunga om citahna tawh kizui-in thu ei khen in."},"9":{"text":"Lungsim le lungtang a sittel a thuman Pasien aw, migilote’ gitlona tawpsah inlen, mi thumante sukip in.","ref":"Kln 2:23"},"10":{"text":"Pasien khu ka kidalna lum ahi a, lungsim dih mite a hundam pa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien khu a thuman thukhen mangpa ahi a, nisiela a lungthah Pasien ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi khat a kisiakia sih leh, Pasien in a namsau tat hiem ding hi; ama in a thalpi kuoi-in a dawi zo ta hi;"},"13":{"text":"ama in si theina galhiemte a baisa-in koi zo a, ama in a thaltang meisi leng bangsah hi."},"14":{"text":"En in, amate in gitlona gai-in nau bangin ngaisut hoi lona a pai vua, nau a suo bangin zuouthu a suohsah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in dum bawlin a to vua, a bawlsa dum sung ma-ah a kie uhi."},"16":{"text":"A ngaisut hoi lote uh pen a luzang vuah tukia a, a tatsietna uzong a luzang ma vuah a tukia hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama’ thumanna ziehin Topa tungah lungdam ka ko ding a, Sangpen Pa Topa’ min phatna la ka sa ding hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thunei pen kohaw’ Topa aw, leitung zosie-ah na min bangza-in thupi ahei! Vante tungah na minthanna na koi zo hi.","title":"Pasien’ Thupina le Mihing’ Vang"},"2":{"text":"Na galte ziehin galte le phula pa na daisah nadingin, nausente le naupangte’ kam sung panin munkip na phupieh zo hi.","ref":"Mat 21:16"},"3":{"text":"Na khutmete tawh na bawl vantungte ka en a, na phukipsa hlapi le aasite ka et ciengin,"},"4":{"text":"na ngaisut tham dingin mihingte bang hi a, na thudon tham dingin mihingte bang hi lel ahei?","ref":"Job 7:17-18; Late 144:3; Heb 2:6-8"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien sangin amate a neuzaw hiau-in na bawl a, minthanna le patawina lukhu na khusah hi."},"6":{"text":"Na khuta na bawlsate tungah uhna za amate na pie hi; nangma in a keng nei vuah sil bangkim,","ref":"1Cor 15:27; Eph 1:22; Heb 2:8"},"7":{"text":"tuu le bawngtang zosie le gam lahah gamsa zosie zong,"},"8":{"text":"hui lahah a leng vate le tuipi sunga om ngate, tuipi sunga lamhla kici poma, na koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thunei pen kohaw’ Topa aw, leitung zosie-ah na min bangza-in thupi ahei!"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lungsim zosie tawh Topa tungah lungdamna kang ko ding hi; a lamdang na nasepna zosie a unpi-in ka gen ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Vanglietna le Thutanna"},"2":{"text":"Nangma sungah lungdamin ka kipah ding hi; Sangpen Pa aw, keima in na min phatna la ka sa ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka galte a nuakia ciengin, na mai-ah amate pua-in kisie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nangma in ka thu a tangin na lenkip hi; topha tungah nang na to a, a manin thu na khen hi."},"5":{"text":"Minamte na phawhsie a, migilote na susie hi; kumtawnin a maimang dingin a min uh na phietmang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tawntung sietna sungah galte a mangthai uhi; a khuopite uh na phungkal hi; a kiphawna mama uh kisie hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa khu kumpi-in a to zing a, ama in thukhenna dingin a topha phutdet zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in thuman tawh leitung mite thu khen a, a kilawm a kituohin mite thu a khen hi."},"9":{"text":"A kibawlsie mite adingin Topa khu mun muonhuoi ahi a, hamsat hun ciengin kibuhna munkip ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa aw, nang ang suite na nuasie lo ziehin, nangma’ min a theite in nang ang muong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Zion-a teng Topa phatna la sa un. Mite lahah ama’ nasepnate pulah un."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen sisan phula pa in amate a phawh kha hi; ama in gimna a thuoh mite’ kikona a mangngil sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, keima ei hepi inlen, kei ei muda mite tung pana ka thuoh gimna ei mu in; nangma khu sina tunkot pana keima ei domto pa na hi a,"},"14":{"text":"tuaci’n keima in Zion tanu’ kotpite-ah ang kiphatna la kisa zosie phawhkia-in, nangma’ hotkhietna sungah ka lung a dam ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amau’ bawl dum sungah minamte a kiesuh vua, a lenthang siena vuah amau’ keng ma a awh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa amama ang kipulah a, ama in thu a khen hi; amau’ khut tawh a sepna sung vuah migilote a awh uhi. [Higgaion. Selah]"},"17":{"text":"Misikhuo-ah Pasien a mangngil minam zosie le migilote a pei ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tasamte kimangngil zing lo ding a, mizawngte’ kinepna zong a kisie zing sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hing thoto in, Topa aw! Mihingte kizosah sin; nangma mai-ah minamte thu kikhen taheh."},"20":{"text":"Topa aw, amate zausah inlen, mihing maimai a hina uh minamte theisah in. Selah"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, bang dinga gamla din na hei? Hahsat hunin bang dinga kiphuol ta vanuh na hei?","title":"Galte Pana Suotah nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Migilote in kiphatsahna tawh mizawngte a bawlsie uhi, amau’ gelsa ngaisutna ma-ah amate awhsah in."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile migilote in a lungsim sung vua om a lunggulna uh a kisahtheipi vua, mi huoihamte in nga nopna tawh Topa gausamin a taisan uhi."},"4":{"text":"Migilote in kiphatsah maisuo tawh, “ Topa in hing kan sih va” a ci uhi; amate in a ngaisutna zosie vuah, “Pasien om sih,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"A tatna zosie vuah a maa uh vang zing a, na thukhennate sang luo ahi ziehin amate in a mu ban sih uhi; amate in na galte zosie a simmaw bawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in a lungsim sung vuah, “Ei kilawh zo sih va; khan tawntungin gimna tuoh sih vai,” ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"7":{"text":"A kamte uh awsie, zuouna, le bawlsietna tawh kidim hi; amau’ kam sungah a hoi lo ngaisutna le tawnkhielna vive a om hi.","ref":"Rom 3:14"},"8":{"text":"Mi buhdap dingin khuo sungah amate a to uhi; amate in a kiphuolna uh munte-ah mawnei lote a that uhi. A mit un a cimawte dap et a,"},"9":{"text":"humpi in gamlahah a buhdap bangin buhin, mizawngte mat sawmin a pangdap vua, amate in amahaw’ len-ah mizawngte kai-in a man uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate kunin a nenthop vua, amate in a hatna utawh mi cimawte a puasah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in a lungsim sung vuah, Pasien in tuate mangngil ta, ama in a mai sel zo ta, mu nawn sih va,” ci-in ngaisun uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, thoto in; Pasien aw, na khut lamto in; a kibawlsie mite mangngil sin."},"13":{"text":"Migilote in bang dingin Pasien taisanin, amau’ lungsim sungah, “Nang in thu ei sit sih vateh,” ci uh ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Hinanle nang in na mu hi! Na khuta na lah thei na dingin nangma in buoina le gimna thuohte na melci hi. Na kungah mi cimawte ang ki-ap uhi; nang tagate panpi pa na hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilote le sietna a bawl mite’ khut kuoitan pieh in; amau’ gitlona khat zong na mu lo za dongin sui in."},"16":{"text":"Topa khu kumtawn kumpi hi a, ama’ gam panin minamte kisie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, nang in mi nunnemte’ deina na za ding hi; a lungsim uh na hatsah ding a, na bil na ngat ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in leitung panin zauna a tuo nawn lo nadingin, tagate le a kibawlsie mite adingin thutangin kikhen ta ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in Topa ka beel hi; bangci bangin keima kungah, “Va bangin muol tungah tai in;","title":"Pasien Muonna La"},"2":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile en in, miel lahah migilote in lungsim thumante kap dingin a thalkhau sung vuah thaltang a guong vua, a thal uh a kuoi uhi."},"3":{"text":"A bulpite kisie po leh, mi thumante in bang ei law zo ding ahei?” na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"A biehinn siengtho sungah Topa om a, Topa’ topha vantungah a om hi. Ama in mihingte encien a, a mit in amate sittel hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in thuman mite le migilote zelah a, a kheltat nuom mite ama’ hlagau in muda hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in migilote tungah mei-am le kaat zusah ding a, amau’ nga ding hai pen ahile khuopi huisa pialpual hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa a thuman hi; ama in a dih gamtatnate dei hi; thuman mite in ama’ mai a en ding uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw ei panpi in, azieh pen Pasien zatah koima om nawn lo hi; mihingte lah panin mi muonhuoite a maimang sieng ta hi.","title":"Hun Siet Sung Hut ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat a kisol uhi; amate in phatsolna kamzol le lungsim nam ni tawh thu a gen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in maitang phatna nephu zosie le kiphatsahna a piengsah leiite atsan hinlen,"},"4":{"text":"tuate in, “I leii tawh i guolzo ding hi; i nephute eimahaw’ neisa hi lel, i pu uh koi ahiei?” a ci viel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mizawngte’ na kilah pieh a, mi cimawte a tau ziehin, tu-in ka dingto ding hi, Topa in ci hi; “A lunggul uh ahi bihna munah amate ka koi ding hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa’ kamciemte pen a siengtho kamciemte ahi a, meikhuh sungah sagivei a kisiengsah ngun tawh kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, nang in kote nei dal ding hi; tami khang mite lah panin kote nei kem zing ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mite lahah a gina lote a kipatawi ziehin, migilote muncin ah a vah kawikawi uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt lai ding ahei? Kei ei mangngil suoh ding na ta amah? Ka kung panin bang tanvei na maitang sel lai ding na hei?","title":"Galte pana Suotah nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungsim sungah bang tanvei gimna thuohin sunthapai-in ka lungsim da lai ding ahei? Bang tanvei kei tungah ka galpa kitawisang lai ding ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Ngaisun inlen ei dawng in, Topa ka Pasien aw! Ka mitte hing vahsah in, tua hi sihle sina kimutna sungah ka kimu ta ding a,"},"4":{"text":"tuale ka galpa in, “Ama ka zo ta hi,” ei ci kha ding hi; keima ka citun ahi ziehin ka galte lungdam ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hizongle keima in na itna kip ka muong hi; nangma’ ei hutdamna sungah ka hlagau a kipah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang in kei nei limbawl ziehin Topa tungah la ka sa ding hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mimawte in a lungsim sung vuah, Pasien om lo hi,” ci uhi. Amate a kisie vua, a kidahhuoite a sem uhi; sil hoi sem koima om lo hi.","title":"Pasien Zatah lona Mawsahna"},"2":{"text":"Pasien a sui, mipil khat beh a om ei mah, ci a thei nadingin, Topa in vantung panin mihingte ei ensuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un a lampiel sieng vua, a kibangin a letat sieng uhi; sil hoi a sem mi koima om lo a, khat zong a om sih hi.","ref":"Rom 3:10-12"},"4":{"text":"An neh bangin ka mite netumin, Topa tunga thu a ngen lo, sietna a bawl mi zosie in theina nei talawm lo uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Khumnah amate zau tahin a om ding uhi, azieh pen Topa in thuman mihonte ompi hi."},"6":{"text":"Note in mizawngte’ gelna na subuoi ding vua, ahi vangin Topa pen a kibuhna uh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Zion panin Israel-te’ kihotkhietna hing tung dawh ta leh izaw! Topa in ama’ mite vangphatna a piehkia ciengin, Jacob a lungdam ding hi; Israel zong kipah mama ding hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na puonbuh sungah koi om thei ding ahei? Na muol siengtho tungah koi teng thei ding ahei?","title":"Pasien’ Mun Siengtho Sungah Koite Teng ding"},"2":{"text":"Gen baang loin kalsuon a, thuman tawh gamta-in, a lungsim sung vuah thuman a gen mite;"},"3":{"text":"a leii utawh mi a daisah lo mite, a lawm a guol tungah sietna a bawl lo mite, a vengte a mawsah lo mite;"},"4":{"text":"a mit in migilote simmaw-in, hinanle Topa a zatah mite; amau’ nat nading nangawnah a ciem pel lo mite;"},"5":{"text":"summet nga nadinga mi sum a palahsah lote, mawnei lote langkhatah guhgol a ne lote a teng ding uhi. Tam banga gamtate ahile a kilawh ngai sih ding uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, na kunga kang kibuh ziehin keima ei dal in.","title":"Pasien Sunga Bihna le Muonna La"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah, “Nang, ka Topa na hi hi; nang tawh loin hoina ka nei sih hi,” na ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Gam sunga mi siengthote ahi ule, mi thupite ahi vua, ka lungkimna kici zosie amau’ sungah a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Adang Pasien a teel mite in amau’ dan a khangsah hi. Keima in amau’ sithe biehnate ka bawlpieh sih ding a, keima in ka nephu tawh amau’ min ka lo sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa khu keima’ teelsa ka tanh le ka hai ahi hi; nang in keima’ nga ding na tawi hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei adingin mun nuom tengah gamgi ang tu hi; keima in gamluo hoi ka nei hi."},"7":{"text":"Thu ei kuppi Topa ka phat hi; ama in zanin zong ka lungsim in thu ei hil hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima mai-ah Topa ka omsah hi; ka zietlamah ama a op ziehin kei ka kilawh sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ziehin ka lung a dam a, ka hlagau zong a kipah hi; ka pumpi zong lungmuongin a tawlnga ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen Misikhuo ah keima nei paimang sih a, na mi muonhuoi pa zong Leihawm na musah sih hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:35"},"11":{"text":"Nang in hinna lampi nei lah hi. Nangma opna-ah lungdamna bukim a om hi; nangma’ zietlamah kumtawn nopsahnate a om hi.","ref":"Sawl 2:25-28"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw thutang kang ngetna ei za inlen, ka kikona ngai in; a zuou lo ka nephu tawh kang thungetna na bil na daw in.","title":"A Bawlsiete pan Suotahna ding Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Na kung panin ka dihtanna hing peisah in; na mit in thuman musah in."},"3":{"text":"Ka lungtang sittel inlen, zanin ka kungah hing haw-in, ei ze-et lacin ka sungah gitlona na mu sih ding hi; ka kam in zong bangma a genkhiel sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Midangte’ gamtatna tawh kisai-in ahile, na nephu pana kammal ziehin mi tatsiete’ lampite ka pelh zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lampite-ah kip tahin ka kalsuon hi; ka keng a kitawnkhaw sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma kang hlan hi, azieh pen nang in nei dawng ding hi; na bil ei ngat inlen, ka thugente ei za in."},"7":{"text":"A galte uh kung panin na zietlam khutah kibuhna a suite hundam pa aw, lamdang tahin na itna kip hing lah in."},"8":{"text":"Na mitnauta bangin kei ei kem in; na hla hlim nei-ah ei phuol inlen,"},"9":{"text":"ei bawlsie migilote le ei imtawm a giinhuoi ka galte kung panin keima ei phuol in."},"10":{"text":"Amau’ lungtang in hepina a nei sih uhi; a kam utawh amate a kiphatsah ham uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in ei sulzui uhi; tu-in amate in ei kui-im uhi; amate in tuol den nadingin mittuhna-in ei nei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate ahile a elmal nuom humpi tawh a kibang vua, humpi khanglai sabuh tawh a kibang uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, hing tho in, amate tawh kimaituo inlen thalpai in! Hinanle na namsau tawh migilote kung panin ka hinna ei hunkhie in,"},"14":{"text":"Topa aw, mihingte lah panin- na khut tawh- tam leitunga a hinkhuo vuah tanh a nei mite kung panin ei hunkhie in. Amate dinga na kholpieh nate tawh a gilpi uh kidim taheh. A tate un khamval nei ta uheh; amate in a nausente vua dingin kimkhat nuasie uheh."},"15":{"text":"Kei ka hi leh dihna tawh na maitang ka en ding hi; ka khahlaw ciengin nang tawh ka kisutna mu-in ka lung a kim ding hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka thahatna Topa aw, nangma kang it hi.","title":"Guolzawna Zieha Kumpipa Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Topa pen ka suongpi, ka kulpi le keima ei hunkhie pa ahi a, ka Pasien, ka kibuhna ka suongpi, ka lum, ka kihutdama ki, le ka munkip ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A phattah Topa ka hlan a, tuaci’n ka galte khut sung panin ei kihundam ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Sina khauhuolte in kei ei vielcip hi; sietna tuihuolte in keima ei nawh hi;"},"5":{"text":"Misikhuo khauhuolte in keima ei kanbawm hi; sina thangte in zong kei ei dawntuo uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ka lungdon hunin Topa ka hlan a; huna ngenin ka Pasien kungah ka kiko hi. Ama in biehinnpi panin ka aw ei za a, ama kunga ka kikona in ama’ bil a va banto ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama a lungthah ziehin leitung kipumpei-in kivei hi; muol zung teng zong kinuhin a kiling gawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama’ nahvang panin meikhu pusuoh to a, a kam panin a hulvam thei mei a pusuoh hi; ama tung panin mei-am kuongte pusuoh hi."},"9":{"text":"Vante niemsahin ama ang kumsuh hi; a keng nei-ah miel sapi a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Cherub khat tungah ama tuongin a leng hi; hui hlate tungah ama mallang tahin a leng hi."},"11":{"text":"A kituom nadingin ama in a kimkotah khuomiel bawl a, a tungkhu dingin tui le meiivom sapite a bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"A mai-a khuovah sung panin gielpite le mei-amte a kileh vapual a, meiilum a phukeh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in zong vante-ah vantosah a, tuale Sangpen Pa a awng vapo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in thaltangte kapin amate a thezah hi; ama in tun phesah a, amate a khenkhe hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa aw, na hosietna le na nahkuo vang panin na husan in a semmang ziehin tuipi tawdopte kimu siengin, leitung bulpite kidawh sieng hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a sangna panin ei zamsuhin ei la hi; ama in tui thuhpi sung panin keima ei kaidawh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a thahat ka galpa kung pan le ei mudate kung panin keima ei hunkhie hi; azieh pen kei adingin amate a hat seng uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in ka tuosiet hunin kei ei dawntuo uhi; hizongle Topa pen kei ei panpi pa ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in mun tanzauna ah keima ei peipi hi; kei tungah ama lungkim ahi ziehin ama in kei ei hunkhie hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima’ dihna dung zui-in Topa in thaman ei pie hi; ka khut siengthona dung zui-in ama in kei ei dinkia hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in Topa’ lampite ka zui zo ta a, ka Pasien kung panin gitlona tawh ka piel sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen ama’ thukip zosie keima mai-ah om a, ama’ thupiehte keima kung panin ka paimang sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama mai-ah kawh ka baang sih a, khielna panin ka kikem hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in ka dihna le ama’ muna-ah ka khutte a sienthona tawh kizui-in keima ei dinkia zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Thuman mite tungah thuman na lah a, kaw baanglote tungah na kaw baanlona na lah hi.","ref":"2Sam 22:26"},"26":{"text":"A siengthote tungah na siengthona na lah hi; a lungkawite tungah na letatna na lah hi."},"27":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang in a neilut mite na hunkhie a, hinanle nangma in mi kiphasahte na niemkhieh hi."},"28":{"text":"Keima’ meivah ei tanpieh khu nangma na hi hi; Topa ka Pasien in ka khuomiel a vahsah hi."},"29":{"text":"Nangma hang tawh keima in galkap honpi ka nuoimat a, ka Pasien hang tawh keima in khuopi kul ka kan zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tami Pasien- ama’ lampi bukim a, Topa’ kamciem a manna kilang hi. Ama a beel zosie adingin ama kidalna lum ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa cilo, Pasien koi ahei? I Pasien simlo suongpi koi ahei?"},"32":{"text":"Thahatna tawh ka kawng ei gapieh a, ka lampi ei humbih pieh pa khu Pasien ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in ka kengte, sazuhpi’ keng bangsah a, ama in a sangna munah keima bihtahin eikoi hi.","ref":"Hab 3:19"},"34":{"text":"Galdo dan dingin ka khutte ei sinpieh a, tuaci’n ka bante in sumngo thal kuoi zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Na hutdamna lum kei nei pie zo a, na zietlam khut in kei nei panpi zo hi; nei panpina in kei ei thupisah hi."},"36":{"text":"Nangma in ka nei-ah ka kalsuon nading mun tanzau nei pie a, tuale ka keng a kitawnkhaw sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Keima in ka galte delin amate ka nuaphah hi; amate sigam masangin ka nuakia sih hi."},"38":{"text":"A thawkia zawh lo nadingun keima in amate ka satlia a, ka keng nei-ah a pua uhi."},"39":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma in gal sim nadingin thahatna tawh ka kawng nei gapieh a, ka nei-ah kei ei dote na siel hi."},"40":{"text":"Nangma in ka galte na letaisah a, keima ei mudate ka susie hi."},"41":{"text":"Panpina ngenin a kiko vangun, amate a hundam ding koima a om sih hi; Topa tungah a kiko vangun, ama in amate a dawng sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Huipi mai-a leivui bangin amate ka satvui a, gawldunga buon bangin amate ka paimang hi."},"43":{"text":"Nang in mite tawh ka kihauna pan keima nei hunkhie hi; nangma in minamte’ lutangin keima nei bawl hi; ka thei ngai lo mite in keima’ na a sem uhi."},"44":{"text":"Amate in ka thu a zah behun ka thu a mang pai uhi; gamdang mite hing pei-in keima ei maivil uhi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang mite a lungkie vua, tuale mun muonhuoite panin a citunsa-in ang pei uhi."},"46":{"text":"Topa hing hi! Ka suongpi in thupha nga hinlen, ka hutdamna Pasien tawisangin om taheh,"},"47":{"text":"ama pen phu ei lahpieh pa le ka nei-ah minamte ei koipieh Pasien ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Ka galte kung panin kei ei hunkhie pa ahi hi; nangma in ka langte tungah kei nei tawisang tahpi hi; nang in mi tatsiete kung panin keima nei hunkhie hi."},"49":{"text":"Topa aw, tam thu ziehin minamte lahah kang phat ding a, na min phatna la ka sa ding hi.","ref":"Rom 15:9"},"50":{"text":"Ama in a kumpipa tungah guolzawna lienpite pie-in, a sathau nu pa David le ama’ suonlehlahte tungah kumtawnin a itna kip a lah hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantungte in Pasien’ minthanna gengen a; vanpi in zong a khuta a nasepnate a tangkoko hi.","title":"Nate Kisiemna le Thukham Sungah Pasien’ Minthanna"},"2":{"text":"A nini-in thu a gen vua, a zanzanin theina a pulah uhi."},"3":{"text":"Thugenna om loin, kammal zong om lo hi; a aw uzong kiza lo hi;"},"4":{"text":"hinanle a aw uh leitung muncin tengah kizel a, a kammal uh leimong dongah a tung hi. Ama in ni adingin vante-ah puonbuh khat lam a,","ref":"Rom 10:18"},"5":{"text":"mopina innsung panin ang pusuoh mopa le, a taina lampi-ah lawptaha a tai mi thahat pa tawh kibang hi."},"6":{"text":"Vanmongte panin ang suoh a, a mong khat dong kimvel hi; ama’ satna panin a kiphuol thei bangma a om sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ thukham bukim a, hlagau a thasuosah hi; Topa’ thukhennate a man hi a, mimawte pilsah hi;"},"8":{"text":"Topa’ ngainakipte sieng a, lungsim nuomsah hi; Topa’ thupiehte siengtho a, mitte vahsah hi;"},"9":{"text":"Topa zatahna pen sieng a, kumtawnin kip suoh hi; Topa’ ngaina kipte man a, a ni-in dih tuoh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kham le kham hoi tampite nangawn sangin tuate deihuoizaw hi; khuoizu le khuoibal zu a hlita dildel sangin hlumzaw lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tham loin tuate ziehin na nasempa in thuhilna ka thuoh hi; tua thute zuina-ah thaman thupi a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle a khielna uh koi in mukhie thei ahei? Phuolsel khielnate panin keima ei siengsah in."},"13":{"text":"Mawnop teiteina panin na nasempa ei kem inlen, ka tungah tuate in ei uhsah sin. Tua ciengin kaw baang nawn loin, khielna lienpi panin ka sieng ta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa ka suongpi le ka tanpa aw, ka kama ka thugente le nang adingin ka lungsim ngaisutnate a sanhuoi suohsah ta in."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gimna ni ciengin Topa in nang hing dawng hinlen! Jacob Pasien’ min in nangma hing dal taheh!","title":"Guolzaw nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in mun siengtho panin huna hing puoh hinlen, Zion panin nangma panpina hing pie taheh."},"3":{"text":"Ama in na biehna zosiete hing phawh hinlen, maipha tawh na meihal biehpiehnate hing sanpieh taheh. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Na lunggulnate hing pie hinlen, na gelna zosie hing tangtungsah taheh."},"5":{"text":"Na guolzawna-ah kote kipah tahin awngin, ka Pasien uh’ min tawh kote zawna diel ei khaisah in. Topa in na ngetna zosie hing tangtun taheh."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a sathau nu pa a panpi ding tu-in ka thei ta hi; ama in a zietlam khutah guolzawna lienpite tawh a vantung siengtho panin ama a dawng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in lengte kisahtheipi-in, pawlkhat in sakolte a kisahtheipi vua, hinanle eite’ kisahtheipi pen ahile Topa i Pasien uh’ min ahi bo hi."},"8":{"text":"A nawmsawmin amate a puamat ding vua, hizongle eite i hi leh thoto-in i dingtang ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, kumpipa tungah guolzawna pie in; kote in kang hlat ciengun nangma in ei dawng in."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na hatna sungah kumpipa lungdam a, na panpina sungah nahpi-in a nuom hi!","title":"Guolzawna Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Ama’ lunggulte na pie zo a, a kama ang ngetnate na khia sih hi. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen thupha tampi tawh ama na dawntuo hi; nangma in ama’ lu tungah kham kumpi lukhu na khusah hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in na kungah hinna ang ngen hi; nangma in ama tungah kumtawn hinna na pie hi"},"5":{"text":"Nangma’ panpina ziehin ama’ minthanna lien hi; nangma in ama tungah etlawmna le thupina na pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma in ama tungah thuphate na pie zing hi; na ompina lungnopna tawh ama na lungdamsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen kumpipa in Topa muong a, Sangpen Pa itna kip ziehin ama a kilawh sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma’ khut in ka galte zosie mu ding a, nangma’ zietlam khut in ang mudate a mu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma nang kilah ciengin meiphuol kuong bangin amate na bawl ding hi. A thangpaina tawh Topa in amate nawmval ding a, mei in amate katum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma in leitung panin amau’ suon le hlahte, mihingte lah panin amau’ tate na susie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in nangma tungah gitlo sawmin, a hoi lote ang bawl sawm uleh a lawcing sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma in amate na zausisah ding hi; nangma in na thaltang tawh amau’ maitang na dawi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, na hatna sungah nang hing kitawisang heh! Kote in na vanglietna la sa-in kang phat ding uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasien, ka Pasien, bang dinga kei nei nuasie ahei? Nei hu nadinga kang tauna panin bang dinga gamla om dawh na hei?","title":"Gentheina le Kilangneina pan Suotah nading Thumna","ref":"Mat 27:46; Mrk 15:34"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, sunin kang kiko vangin nei dawng sih a, zanin kang kiko vangin tawldamna ka mu tuon sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi napi nang na siengtho a, Israel-te’ patawina tungah na to hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate in nang ang muong uhi; amate in nang ang muong vua, nang in amate na honkhie hi."},"5":{"text":"Na kungah amate ang kiko vua, amate hutdam ahi ta uhi; . Amate in nang ang muong vua, amate a maizum sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanle kei lungpuh ka hi lel a, mihing ka hi sih hi; kei pen midangte’ hosiet le mite’ simmaw ka hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ei mu zosie in kei ei zako uhi; amate in keima ei nephenin ei lulawsan uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:39; Mrk 15:29; Luk 23:35"},"8":{"text":"“Na vaite Topa ap in; ama kihunkhiesah in, Ama in a lungkimna pa hunkhie taheh!” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:43"},"9":{"text":"Hizongle nu gil sung pana ei ladawh nang na hi hi; ka nu ang sung nawitui tawh bihtahin nei na kem hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka suo-a kipan nang tungah kang kingam a, ka nu in ei pai lai-a kipanin ka Pasien na hi ta bo hi."},"11":{"text":"Hahsatna ang nai-in ei hu ding koima a op lo ziehin, keima tawh a kigamla-in om sin."},"12":{"text":"Bawngtang tampi in kei ei imtawm vua, Bashan bawngtang hatte in kei ei kimkot uhi;"},"13":{"text":"a samat a ne nuom humpi hawh bangin, amate in a golpi-in a kam ei kahsan uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tui bangin ei kibuosuh a, ka gute kilawimang hi; ka lungtang pen khuoinun tawh kibang hi; ka awp sungah a zulmang hi;"},"15":{"text":"beelphokeh bangin ka kam a gawta a, ka khagu-ah ka leiite a beh den vawt ta hi; nangma in sina leivui lahah keima nei siel hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen uite in ei kimkot a, sietna bawl mi honkhat in kei ei kui-im uhi. Ka khut le ka kengte kizieltum sieng zo hi;"},"17":{"text":"ka gu zosie ka sim thei hi. Amate in ei dugaw et uhi;"},"18":{"text":"amate in ka puonte a hawm vua, ka puonsilte hawm nadingin amate in ai a san uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:35; Mrk 15:24; Luk 23:34; Jhn 19:24"},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, hing gamla op sin! Kei ei hupa aw, ei hu dingin hing mallang ta’n!"},"20":{"text":"Namsau panin ka hlagau ei hunkhie inlen, uite’ thahatna panin ka hinna ei hunkhie in!"},"21":{"text":"Humpi kam panin keima ei hon in!"},"22":{"text":"Ka sanggam numei le pasalte tungah na min ka gen ding hi; mi honpite kikhopna laikimah nangma kang phat ding hi.","ref":"Heb 2:12"},"23":{"text":"Topa a zatah mite aw, ama phat un! Jacob’ suon mi zosie aw, ama minthangsah un. Israel’ tate zosie aw, ama zatah un!"},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in a migenthei pa’ gentheina simmaw bawl loin, zong a huo vawt sih hi. ama in keima kung panin a mai a phuol sih a, ama kunga ka kiko ciengin ama in keima ei za hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihonpi lahah kang phatna khu nang kung pana ang pei ahi hi; ama a zatah mite mai-ah ka thuciemna ka bawl ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Mizawngte in an ne-in a lungkim ding uhi; ama a suite in Topa phat ding uhi. Na lungtangte uh hing den taheh!"},"27":{"text":"Leimong zosie in phawhin Topa kungah a kile ding uhi; minam innkuonte zosie in ama mai-ah a bie ding uhi!"},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen uhna khu Topa -a’ hi a, ama in minamte tungah vai a hawm hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi hi, leitunga a kimu mi zosie in ama mai-ah a kun ding uhi. Kei ka hi leh ama adingin ka hing ding a, leivui lahah a peite zosie ama mai-ah a kun ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Suonlehlahte in ama’ na a sem ding uhi; khangsawnte tungah Topa’ thu kigen ding a,"},"31":{"text":"a suoh nai lote tungah ama’ sepsa hotkhietna thu tangko ding uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa khu ka tuucingpa ahi a, bangma ka kisam sih ding hi.","title":"Pasien Tuucingpa"},"2":{"text":"Lo dawnna munah ei lumsah a; tuidam gei-ah ei pui hi;","ref":"Kln 7:17"},"3":{"text":"ka hla tha ei dimkia a, ama’ min adingin thuman lampi ah ei pui hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuomiel kuomthuh pen tawnin ka pei zongin sietna ka giing sih hi. Azieh pen nang in kei nei ompi a, na phawhbul le na ciengkhut in kei ei hlamuong sah hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka galte opna mun ka mai-ah an nei lui hi; ka lu sathau nei nupieh a; ka hai a dimlet hi."},"6":{"text":"Hoina le khuotuona in ka khantawnin ei zui valon ding a, Topa’ inn sungah kumtawnin ka teng ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung le a sunga om zosie hile, leitung le a tunga tengte hile, Topa -a’ ahi hi;","title":"Biehinnpi Sunga Lutna","ref":"1Cor 10:26"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen ama in tuipite tungah leitung phut a, gunte tungah kipsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ muol tungah koi kato ding ahei? A mun siengtho-ah koi ding ding ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Khut siengtho le lungsim siengtho nei a, a manlo thu-ah a hinna uh piekhie loin, solna tawh a kiciem lo mite ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 5:8"},"5":{"text":"Topa tung panin amate in thupha a nga ding vua, a hutdamna a Pasien uh tung panin dihtanna a nga ding uhi"},"6":{"text":"Tua bang mite pen ama a sui, Jacob Pasien’ maitang a sui mihonte ahi hi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Tunkotte aw, na lu pongsah un! Tanglai kotte aw, minthang Kumpipa ang lut thei nadingin, kidomkang un!"},"8":{"text":"Minthang Kumpi koi ahei? A thahat le a vanglien Topa hi a, galsimna-ah a thahat Topa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tunkotte aw, na lu pongsah un! Tanglai kotte aw, minthang Kumpipa ang lut nadingin, kidomkang un!"},"10":{"text":"A minthang tami Kumpipa koi ahei? Vanglien Topa , minthang Kumpipa ahi hi. Selah"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na tungah ka hlagau kang lamto hi.","title":"Lamlah ding le Hotkhiet ding Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, nang kang muong hi; zumna ei thuohsah sin; ka tungah ka galte guolzo-in lungdamsah sin."},"3":{"text":"Nangma ang lamente maizumsah sin; a thu om lopi-a zuouthu gente maizumsah in."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, na lampi a thei dingin ei bawl in; na lampite ei hil in."},"5":{"text":"Na thuman ah ei pui inlen ei hil in, azieh pen nang khu ka hutdamna Pasien na hi hi; sun thapai-in nangma kang lamen hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip le na khuotuona hing phawhkia bo in, azieh pen tanglai-a kipanin tuate a omsa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, ka khangno lai-a ka mawnate le ka khielnate ciemte sin; nangma’ itna kip tawh kizui-in na hoina vang tawh ei phawhkia in!"},"8":{"text":"Topa hoi-in thutang hi; tua ahi ziehin ama in maw nei mite lam hil hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a nei lut mite thuman lamah pui a, a nei lut mite ama’ lampi hil hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama’ thuciemna le a thupiehte a zuite adingin, Topa’ lampi zosie pen itna kip le citahna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, ka khielna a gol seng ziehin, na min na khuolna tawh ka khielna ei maisah in."},"12":{"text":"Topa a zatah amate koi ahi uh ahei? Ama in a teel ding uh lampi amate a hil ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate nuomsa-in a teng ding vua, a tate un leitang a nei ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa tawh kilawmtatna pen ama a zatah mite ading ahi a, ama in amate tungah a thuciemna a theisah hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa lam ka mitsuon zing hi, azieh pen ama in lenthang panin ka kengte ei sutpieh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei lamah hing kihei inlen keima ei hepi in, azieh pen ka lung a zuong a, gimna ka thuoh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka lunggimna hing damsah inlen, ka gentheinate panin ei ladawh ta’n."},"18":{"text":"Ka gentheina le ka buoinate ei ngaisutpieh inlen, ka mawna zosie ei maisah in."},"19":{"text":"Ka galte bangza pha a, amate in ei mudana uh a natsiet lam ngaisun in."},"20":{"text":"Aw, ka hinna ei cing inlen, ei hunkhie in; nangma kang bel ziehin ei maizumsah sin."},"21":{"text":"Nangma kang lamet ziehin citahna le thumanna in kei ei kem taheh."},"22":{"text":"Pasien aw, a hamsatna zosie panin Israel tankhie ta in."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka dihna ei talang in, azieh pen citah tahin ka kalsuon a, lungkaa loin Topa ka muong hi.","title":"Thutanna ding Thumna le Thumanna ding Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, ei ze-et inlen ei sin in. Ka lungtang le ka lungsim ei sittel in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen ka masangah na itna kip om a, nangma tungah muonhuoi tahin ka gamta hi."},"4":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lote tawh toton loin, thusim neite tawh ka kithuo sih hi;"},"5":{"text":"sietna bawl mihonte ka muda a, migilote tawh ka toton sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, maw nei lona ka lahna-in ka khut ka sil a, na maitam kimvelah pei-in,"},"7":{"text":"lungdamkona la a gingin ka sa a, a silbawl lamdangte ka gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, na tenna innpi le nangma’ minthanna a opna mun ka ngai hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka hinna khu maw neite, sisan suohsahte le"},"10":{"text":"a zietlam khuta guhgol kidimte tawh ei phiettha vawt sin."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka hi leh, citahna tawh ka kalsuon hi; ei tankhie inlen, hepi in."},"12":{"text":"Leizangtam tungah ka ding hi; keima in mihon tampite lahah Topa ka phat ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa khu ka khuovah le ka hutdamna ahi hi; koi pen giing ding ka hei? Topa khu ka hinkhuo adingin ka mun muonhuoi ahi hi; koi pen giing ding ka hei?","title":"Guolzaw Lungmuonna La"},"2":{"text":"Ka langte le ka galte ahi, sietna a bawl mite in ka sa netum nuomin ei galbawl ciengun, amate kisukha-in a pua sieng ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Galkap honkhat in phuol satin ei do nan ule ka lungsim a zau sih hi; kei ei langpangin gal a pien vangin ka lungmuong veve ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa kungah na khat ka ngen zo hi, tua ngenin ka sui ding khu: ka hin sung tungtawnin Topa’ inn sungah tengin, Topa’ hoina velvel a, ama’ biehinnpi sunga thu ka dawh ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in hahsat hunin a buh sungah ei phuol ding hi; ama in a puonbuh khuna nei-ah kei ei humbih ding hi; ama in suongpi khat tungah keima ei sangkoi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in ka kimvela om ka galte tungah ka lutang kidomsang ding a, ama in lungdamin kikona tawh ama’ puonbuh sungah biehpiehnate ka pie ding hi; keima in Topa tungah la ngaite ka sa ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, ka kinah ko ciengin ei za in, ei hepi inlen ei dawng in!"},"8":{"text":"Ka lungtang in, “Hing pei in, “A mai sui vai!” ei ci hi. Topa aw, na mai ka sui hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka kung panin na mai phuol sin. Na lungthah ziehin na nasempa ei nuangat sin, nang ei panpi pa na hi hi. Kei ei paimang loin ei nuasie sin, ka hutdamna Pasien aw!"},"10":{"text":"Ka nu ka pa in ei nuasie leh, Topa in kei ei pom ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, na lampi ei hil inlen, ka galte ziehin lam phei-ah ei peipi in."},"12":{"text":"Ka langte’ deina-ah ei ap sin, bangzieh ahei cile ka langkhatah teci zuoute a pang ding vua, tatsietna hu a sang uhi."},"13":{"text":"A hingte gam sungah Topa’ hoina a mu dingin kei ka ki-um hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa lamen in; thahat inlen, na lungsim hangsah in, Topa lamen in!"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang kang hlan hi; ka suongpi aw, ei za loin om sin, azieh pen kei tungah hing sip dide mawh lacin, Leihawm-a peisuhte tawh ka kibang ta ding hi.","title":"Panpi ding Thungetna le Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Na mun Siengtho pen lamah ka khutte lamto-in, panpina ngenin na kungah kang kiko ciengin ka thumna ei za in."},"3":{"text":"Migilote le sietna a bawl mite tawh, ei kaikhie ton sin, amate in a vengte tawh kilemna thu a gen vangun, a lungtang sung vuah mi huotna vive a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ sepna le amau’ gamtat sietna dung zui-in amate thuhkia in; a khuta a sepna utawh kituohin amate thuhkia in; a nga ding vua kilawm thaman amate ngasah in.","ref":"Kln 22:12"},"5":{"text":"Topa’ nasepna le ama’ khut tawh a sil bawlte a thupi ngaisut lo ziehun, ama in amate susie ding a, a lamkia nawn sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in ka thumna ei zah zo ziehin Topa in thupha nga taheh."},"7":{"text":"Topa khu ka hatna le ka lum ahi a, ka lungsim in ama a muong hi; tuaci’n keima ei kihu-in ka lung nuom mama a, ka lasahna tawh ama tungah lungdamna ka ko hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa khu a mite’ thahatna ahi hi; ama pen a sathau nu pa dingin a bih kibuhna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw, na mite hundam inlen, na gouluote thupha pie in; amate a cingpa hi inlen, kumtawnin amate pui zing in."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Van mite aw, Topa -a’ ci un, minthanna le thahatna khu Topa -a’ ci un.","title":"Huipi Sungah Pasien’ Awging"},"2":{"text":"Ama ’ min thupina khu Topa -a’ ci unlen, a siengtho kizepna tawh Topa bie un.","ref":"Late 96:7-9"},"3":{"text":"Tuipite tungah Topa’ awging a om hi; minthang Pasien khu vanto bang a, tui hatte tungah Topa a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ awging khu a vanglien ahi hi; Topa’ awging khu thupina tawh a kidim ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ awging in taamtah singte a kuoitan hi; Topa’ in Lebanon taamtah singte zong a kuoitan hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Lebanon le Sirion-te, bawngno le gamsielno bangin kitomsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ awging meikuong bangin a taang hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ awging in gamlah a lawhthing hi; Topa’ awging in Kadesh gamlah zong a lawhthing hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ awging in gangpi singte a vingvei a, gammang tulah hawhkhie-in pawn gawta suohsah hi; a biehinn sunga om zosie in, “Minthanna!” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuikhang tungah Topa a to hi; tawntung kumpi-in Topa a to hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in a mite tungah thahatna pie taheh! Topa in a mite nopna thupha pie taheh!"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma kang patawi ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile nang in keima nei phongto a, keima tungah ka galte na lungdamsah sih hi.","title":"Natna Huoisie pan Damna Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, na kungah panpi ngenin kang kiko a, tuale nangma in kei nei damsah zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, Misikhuo panin ka hlagau na peipito a, Leihawm -a peisuhsate lah panin nei hingsah kia hi."},"4":{"text":"No a misiengthote aw, Topa tungah phatna la sa unlen, ama’ min siengtho tungah lungdamna ko un."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen ama’ lungthahna khu bano khat sung beh ahi bo hi; ama’ angvanna ahile khantawn muon ding ahi hi.
