Zanlai-in dana ang gieh pah kha thei ding a, ahi vangin zingmawng tawh nopna ang tung hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima ka hi leh, ka cithei lai-in, “Ka kiling ngai sih ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, nei angvanna tawh a kip muol bangin keima nei phutdet hi; nang in na mai na phuol a, kei ka lung a mang hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, na tungah kang kiko a, Topa tungah thumna kang nei hi:"},"9":{"text":"“Leihawm sungah peisuh leng, keima’ sina ah bang metna om ahei? Leivui in nang ang phat diei mah? Na muonhuoina a gen ding amah”"},"10":{"text":"Topa aw, ei za inlen, keima ei hepi in! Topa aw, keima ei hupa hing hi ta’n!"},"11":{"text":"Nangma in ka da ka kaanate lamna-in nei heipieh zo hi; nangma in ka la-ip puonpi nei sutpieh zo ta a, lungdamna puon nei silsah hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuaci’n ka hlagau dai op loin, nangma ang patawi ding hi. Keima’ Pasien Topa aw, lungdamna kang ko zing ding hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang kang bel hi; kei ei maizumsah ngai sin; nangma’ dihna sungah kei ei hunkhie in.","title":"Galte kung pan Hutkhiet nading Ngetna le Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Na bil kei lam ei ngat in; mallangin ei hunkhie in. Kei adingin ka kibuhna suongpi le ei hun ding kulpi det khat hing hi ta’n."},"3":{"text":"Nangma ka suongpi le ka kulpi tahtah na hi hi; na min na khuolna tawh ei pui inlen lam ei lah in,"},"4":{"text":"nangma ka kibuhna na hi ziehin ei kisiena lenthang pan ei sut in."},"5":{"text":"Nangma’ khut sungah ka hlagau kang ap hi; a muonhuoi Topa Pasien aw, nangma in kei nei tankhie zo hi.","ref":"Luk 23:46"},"6":{"text":"Nangma in bangma a manlo milim a thupi ngaisut mite na muda a, ahi vangin keima in Topa ka muong hi."},"7":{"text":"Na itna kip sungah lungdamin ka kipah ding hi, azieh pen nangma in ka gentheina nei mu zo hi; ka hahsatnate-ah zong nei don a,"},"8":{"text":"ka galte’ khut sungah keima nei pie sih hi; nangma in mun tanzauna-ah ka kengte nei koipieh zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, kei ei hepi in, azieh pen ka genthei seng ta hi. Dana ziehin ka mit a miel a, ka lungsim le ka pumpi a gim mama ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in dana tawh hinkhuo ka mang a, khuisahna tawh ka kumte ka zang hi; ka gentheina ziehin ka tha a kiem a, ka gu ka tang teng a ngam gawp ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka galte’ simmaw le ka innvengte cizatin ka om a, ka meltheite’ gimnei mi ka hi ta hi; lampi a ei mute ka kung panin a taimang uhi."},"12":{"text":"A si mi khat bangin ei kiphawh ta sih hi; kei pen beelkeh khat tawh ka kibang ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in mi tampite’ kidaphona ka za a, ka kimvel zosie-ah zauna vive a om hi! Ka langkhatah amate in thu vaihawmin ka hinna a lah sawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongnanle Topa aw, keima in nang kang muong hi; keima in, “Nang ka Pasien na hi hi,” kang ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Na khut sungah ka nite a om hi; ka galte le kei ei bawlsiete’ khut panin ei hun in."},"16":{"text":"Na nasempa tungah na mai hing tangsah in; na itna kip sungah keima ei hundam in."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, ei maizumsah sin, azieh pen keima in nang kang hlan hi; migilote maizumsah in; gen ding thei loin Misikhuo ah amate peisah in."},"18":{"text":"Kiphatsahna le mi simmawna tawh ki-uongsahin midihte a gensie, zuou phuo kam le muate sipsah in."},"19":{"text":"Nangma ang zatah mite dinga na kholpieh na hoite, nangma ang beel mite dinga mi zosie muna-ah na seppiehsa nate kicing valua sam ei!"},"20":{"text":"Mite’ sawmsimna panin nangma in na hlim nei-ah amate na phuol hi; nangma in kiselna leiite panin na opna innhlim ah amate bih tahin na kem hi."},"21":{"text":"Galte in khuopi a im bangin keima ei ki-im hun lai-in, ama in lamdang tahin kei tungah a itna kip ei lah zo ahi ziehin, Topa in thupha nga taheh."},"22":{"text":"Keima in patauna tawh, “Nangma’ muna panin a gamlapi-ah kei ei kinotmang hi,” ka ci zo ta hi. Ahi vangin nangma kungah panpi ngenin kang kiko ciengin, nangma in ka thumnate nei zahpieh hi."},"23":{"text":"No misiengthote aw, Topa it un. Topa in mi muonhuoite kem a, hinanle kiliensah taha gamtate nahpitahin thuhkia hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa a lamen mite aw, kithahatsah unlen, na lungsim uh hangsah un."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A khielna kimaisah a, a mawna kiselpieh mite mi hampha ahi hi.","title":"Maw Maisah Lungnopna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in mawna a khuhsah lo mite, a lungsim sungah solna a om lo mite khu mi hampha ahi uhi.","ref":"Rom 4:7-8"},"3":{"text":"Ka mawna pulah loin ka dai op sungin, sunthapai ka tautauna lamin ka pumpi a thanem gawp hi."},"4":{"text":"Sun le zanin kei tungah na khut a gih ziehin, khal nisa in ei kah bangin ka tha ka zung teng gawta sieng vawt hi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n nangma kungah ka mawna kang pulah a, ka khielna ka im sih hi; “ Topa kungah ka khielnate ka pulah ding hi,” ka ci a, tuale nangma in ka maw ka khielna teng nei maisah hi. Selah","ref":"2Sam 12:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua ziehin thuman mi zosiete in lungkham hun sungin na kungah thu ngen uheh; tua hile tuikhang liente in amate a ban sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang pen kei adingin ka kibuhna mun na hi hi; nang in buoina panin kei nei kem hi; hutkhiet lungdamna kikonate tawh kei nei kimkot hi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Keima in thu kang hil ding a, na pei nading lampi kang hil ding hi; ka mit tawh hing enin kang kikuppi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Theitelna nei lo sakol le laa bangin om sin, tuate a zuol nadingin kamkaih vaw kul a, tua hi sihle na gei-ah ang om lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote in gimna tampi a thuoh vua, ahi vangin Topa a muong mite ahile itna kip in amate a kuikip hi."},"11":{"text":"Midihte aw, Topa sungah kipahin lungdam unlen, lungsim man mi zosie aw, lungdamin awng un."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No mi dihte aw, Topa sungah lungdam un. Phatna pen a thutang mite bawl dinga kilawm ahi hi.","title":"Pasien’ Lietna le a Hoina"},"2":{"text":"Lyre khausai lasahna tawh Topa phat un; harp zam sawm tumna tawh ama tungah la ngai sa un."},"3":{"text":"Ama tungah la tha sa un; siem tahin khausaite tum unlen, nahpitahin awng un."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ kammal man a, ama’ silbawl zosie muonhuoi taha kibawl ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in thuman le thutang dei hi; Topa’ itna kip tawh leitung kidim hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa’ kammal tawh vantungte kibawl a, a kam pana a naahu tawh vantung nate kibawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in tuipi tuite thawl sunga thun bangin mun khatah gawm a, tui thuhpite a kholna munah koi hi."},"8":{"text":"Leitung zosie in Topa zatah uheh; leitunga teng zosie in ama zatahin ding uheh."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama ham a, a pieng pai hi; ama in thupie a, tua khu kipsuoh pai hi."},"10":{"text":"Minamte’ thukuppinate, Topa in bangma lo a suohsah hi; ama in mite’ lungtupte zong kisungpelsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ thukuppina khu kumtawnin a kip a, a lungsim ngaisutnate zong khang tawntungin kip hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa pen Pasien-a a nei minam, ama in ama’ gouluo dinga a teel mite thupha nga ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in vantung panin ei ensuh hi; ama in mihing zosie ei mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a kumpi tona panin leitunga teng mite zosie vil hi,"},"15":{"text":"amau’ lungtang zosie a bawlpa in a gamtatnate uh en gige hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpi khat a galkap tampite in suohtasah zo lo hi; ama’ thahatna tawh galhang pa kihunkhie zo tuom lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Galzaw nadinga sakol galkapte muonna pen a mawhna hi a, amau’ hatna tawh a hon zo sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ mit in ama a zatahte le a itna kip a lamen mite mitsuon gige a,"},"19":{"text":"ama in sina panin amau’ hlagau hunkhie-in, kielpi hun sungin amate a hinsuo hi."},"20":{"text":"I hlagau in Topa a lamen hi; ama pen ei hupa le i lum ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"A min siengtho i muon ziehin ama sungah i kipah hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa aw, na tungah ka kinep ma bangun, nangma in kote tungah na itna kip hing omsah in."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in hun zosie-ah Topa ka phat ding hi; keima in ka kam tawh ama phatna ka gengen ding hi.","title":"Gentheina pan Hutkhietna Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Topa sungah ka hlagau a kisa thei hi; a kiniemkhieh mite in za-in lungdam uheh."},"3":{"text":"Keima tawh Topa liensah un, eite in ama’ min tawisang ton va vui."},"4":{"text":"Keima in Topa ka sui hi, ama in ei dawng a, ka zau na zosie panin kei ei hunkhie hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama en unlen, na mai tangsah un; tuaci’n na mai uh a zum ngai sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam mi hepihuoi pa kiko a, tuale Topa in a za hi, a gentheina zosie panin ama a hundam hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama a zatah mite’ kimvelah Topa’ vantungmi in giephuol satin amate a hunkhie hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ hoina ciem unlen, thei ta un; ama a beel mite thupha nga ahi hi.","ref":"1Pet 2:3"},"9":{"text":"No mi siengthote aw, Topa zatah un, azieh pen ama a zatahte in tasapna a nei sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Humpi khanglaite in tasap le gilkiel thuoh nan uleh, Topa a sui mite ahile sil hoi bangma a kitasam sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tate aw, hing pei unlen, hing ngai un; keima in note Topa zatahna kang hil ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Sil hoite mu thei nadingin, koi pen in hinna dei-in, koi pen in damsawtna lunggul ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Sietna panin na leii kemcing unlen, zuouthu genna panin na nephu kemcing un."},"14":{"text":"Sietna panin kihem unlen, sil hoi sem un; kilemna sui unlen, na phah dongun del un."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ mit in midihte en a, a kikona lam vuah a bil ngat hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitung pan a kiphawna uh a phietmai dingin, Topa’ maitang in sietna a bawl mite langpang hi.","ref":"1Pet 3:10-12"},"17":{"text":"Panpina ngen dingin midihte a kiko ciengin Topa in za a, a gentheina zosie uh panin amate hunkhie hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungsim kitamzante kungah Topa nai om a, ama in lungsim kitamzante a hundam hi."},"19":{"text":"Midihte’ thuohna a tam vangin, tua teng zosie panin Topa in amate hunkhie hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in amau’ gu zosie kem hi; tuate khat beh zong a tawng sih hi.","ref":"Jhn 19:36"},"21":{"text":"Sietna in migilote sina tun a, mi dihte a mudate kimawsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in a nasemte’ hinna tanh ding a, ama a beel mite koima kimawsah lo ding hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, kei ei demte, nang zong dem in; ka langa kei ei dote nang in zong do in!","title":"Galte Kung pan Hunkhiet ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Lum le phaw tawi-in ei hu dingin hing thoto in!"},"3":{"text":"Teipi le teikhaw dawh inlen, kei ei delte lam ngat in; nang in ka hlagau kungah, “Kei na hutdamna ka hi hi,” hing ci in."},"4":{"text":"Tha dinga kei ei suite maizumsah inlen mindaisah in. Keima siet nading a sawmte nuakiasah inlen, lungdong sah in."},"5":{"text":"Hui in a tawmang ansite tawh kibang uh hinlen, Topa’ vangtungmi in amate delmang taheh."},"6":{"text":"A lampi uh mielin nalsah inlen, Topa’ vantungmi in amate delsah in."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in thu om lopi-in a lenthang utawh kei ei sie uhi; a thu om lopi-in amate in ka si nading dum a to uhi."},"8":{"text":"A thei lo kalun a tung vuah sietna tungsah in. Amau’ siedap lenthang ma-ah amate awhsah in; a kisiet nadingun tua sungah amate puasah in."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa sungah ka hlagau a kipah ding a, ama’ hutkhietna sungah nuom a sa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka gu ka tang teng zosie in, “ Topa aw, nang tawh a kibang koi a om ahei? Nang in amate dinga a thahat mite kung panin mi thanemte na hunkhie a, nang in amate a bawlsie mite panin a thanem le a tasamte na hunkhie hi,” a ci ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Zuouthu gen tecite ang khang hi; amate in ka thei lo thute ei dong uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in ka hoinate sietna tawh ei thuhkia hi; ka hlagau genthei mama hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka hi leh, a cinat ciengun la-ip puon ka sil hi; an tanna tawh kei le kei ka kigenthei bawl hi. Ka kangtung-ah lu kunin thu ka ngen a,"},"14":{"text":"ka lawm ka guol le ka sanggam khat a da bangin ka da hi; a nu zieha a kap mipa bangin kap kawmin ka vah kawi a, da le mau-in ka kunsuh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka pua ziehin amate nuomin a kikhawm uhi; kei ei langpang dingin amate a kikhawm uhi; ka thei ngai lo mi tatsiete in khawl hun nei loin ei gensiesie uhi;"},"16":{"text":"amate in Pasien zatah loin ei koko vua, a ha uh ei gawisan uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei ei gum et ding na hi ahei? Ei suhgawpna panun ei hunkhie inlen, humpite kung panin ka hinna ei hun in!"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin mihon tampite lahah lungdamna kang ko ding hi; keima in mihonpite lahah nangma kang phat ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka tungah a thuman lo ka galte lungdamsah sin len, thu om lopi-a ei mudate, a mit-heh utawh kihosah sin.","ref":"Late 69:4; Jhn 15:25"},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in kilemna a gen tahzawh sangun, gam sunga a om muongte tungah zuouthu gen ding beh a sawm uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in kei ei langpangin a kam a golkeh uhi; amate in, “Ha, ha, i mit tawh mu zo tai ei,” a cisan uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa aw, nang, mu zo ta teh; dai op mawh sin! Topa aw, ka kung panin gamla op sin!"},"23":{"text":"Ka Topa ka Pasien aw, ka thu le ka kidalna dingin hing khanglo inlen, hing kisatsuo tawm in!"},"24":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, na thumanna tawh kituohin kei dih ei tangsah inlen, kei tungah amate lungdamsah sin."},"25":{"text":"Amau le amau kiho-in, “Aha, i lungtup tung ei,” kicisah sin. Amate in, “Tam pa nawmval zo tai,” cisah sin."},"26":{"text":"Keima’ tuosietna-ah a lungdam mite zosie, maizumsah inlen, amkhamsah gawp in; nangma in kei tunga a kiliensahte zumna le mindaina silsah in."},"27":{"text":"Ka dihtanna a talang nuomte lungdam kipahin awng uh hinlen, “A nasempa’ citheina-ah a lungkim Topa lien hi, cicisah in."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin sunthapai-in ka kam in na dihna le nangma phatna a gengen ding hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khielna in a lungsim tawng vuah thu a gen hi; a maitang vuah Pasien zatahna mawngmawng a om vet sih hi.","title":"Mihing” Gitlona le Pasien’ Hoina","ref":"Rom 3:18"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen a khielna uh kimu loin, ei kimuda sih va, ci-in a ngaisun vua, tuaci’n amau le amau a kimawhphat tawm uhi."},"3":{"text":"A kam vua a thugente uh pen sietna le mi solna vive ahi hi; pil gamtat ding le sil hoi sep ding amate a khawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"Lupna tunga a lup kawmun sietna bawl ding a sawm uhi; hoi lona lamah amate kibultawm uhi; amate in sietna a niel sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip in vantung dong ban a, na muonhuoina in meiipite dong ban hi."},"6":{"text":"Na dihna muolpite tawh kibang a, na thukhennate tuithuhpi tawh kibang hi; nang in mihingte le ganhingte na hundam hi, Topa aw."},"7":{"text":"Pasien aw, na itna kip bangza-in manpha ahei! Nangma’ hla hlim nei-ah mi zosie a kibu ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma’ inn sungah amate in kiningcing tahin pawi a bawl vua, na nopsahna gun panin amate dawn ding na pie hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma tawh hinna tuinah a omton hi; kote in na khuovah sungah khuovah ka mu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Nang ang thei mite tungah na itna kip zomsuoh inlen, lungsim man mite tungah na hutdamna hing zom in!"},"11":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte’ keng in ei tuonsah sinlen, migilote’ khut in ei notmangsah sin."},"12":{"text":"Khumnah sietna a bawlte cimaw-in a kun uhi; amate tuolsena-in kinei-in a tho zo nawn sih uhi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilote ziehin kilunggimsah sin; a man lo-a a gamtate eng vawt sin,","title":"Thuohzawhna le Muonna nei ding Hanthotna"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen amate lopa bangin vul pai ding a, lohingte bangin vulnang ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Topa muong inlen, sil hoi sem in; tua hile gam sungah tengin, bihtahin na om ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa sungah lungkim in, tua hile ama in na lunggul teng ang pie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa tungah na vai teng ap in; ama muong in, tua hile ama in ang sem ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in khuovah bangin na dihna tangsah ding a, nangma’ thutanna sun nitang bangsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa mai-ah dai dide inlen, lungduoitahin ngah in; a sepna a daupeite tung le sietna bawlte tungah kilunggimsah sin."},"8":{"text":"Lungthahna ki-ip inlen, thangpaina nuasie in. Kilunggimsah sin- tua in sietna behah ang pui ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen migilote kisumaimang ding a, hizongle Topa a lamen mite in gam a luo ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle bano khat sungin migilote om nawn lo ding hi; a opna mun uh na suisui vangin tuanah a om nawn sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hionanle a lungnemte in gam a luo ding vua, a kicing hauna sungah amate a nuomsa ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 5:5"},"12":{"text":"Migilote in midihte tungah sietna bawl sawmin a ha gawi uhi;"},"13":{"text":"ahi vangin Topa in amau’ ni a tun ding a mu ziehin amate nuisan lel hi."},"14":{"text":"Mizawngte le mi tasamte a nuoinet ding le a mantaha gamtate a that dingin migilote in namsau dawhin a thal uh a kuoi uhi;"},"15":{"text":"a namsau in amau’ lungtang ma sun ding a, amau’ thalte zong kihliehtawng ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilote hau-in tampi a nei sangun midihte in halno khat beh a nei uh hoizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen migilote’ baan kihliehtawng ding a, hinanle Topa in midihte a panpi hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in kaw baang lote’ nite thei a, kumtawnin a gamh uh kip den hi;"},"19":{"text":"hun siet ciengin amate kimaizumsah lo ding a, kiel hun ciengin zong amate in kicingtahin a nei ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanle migilote kisie a, Topa’ galte ahile lohing etlawm tawh kibangin, meikhu bangin a mangthai uhi."},"21":{"text":"Migilote in leitawi a la vua, a sangkia sih uhi, hizongle midihte ahile a kiphal vua, a pie den uhi;"},"22":{"text":"azieh pen Topa’ thupha piehte in gam a luo ding vua, ahi vangin ama’ samsiet mite ahile kisumaimang ding hi."},"23":{"text":"I gamtatna ah Topa a lungkim ciengin i kalsuonnate ama in kipsah hi;"},"24":{"text":"eite i pua kha zongin i bungbutuh sih ding uhi, azieh pen Topa in eite i khutin ei tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Naupang ka hi ngai a, tu-in a vuoi ka hi ta hi, hinanle midihte kinuasie-in, a tate khutdaw ngen ci bang ka mu ngai nai sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in kiphal tahin a pie ngitnget vua, mite zong a leitawisah uhi, tuale a tate thupha nga a suoh uhi."},"27":{"text":"Sietna panin kihem unlen, sil pha bawl un; tuaci’n kumtawnin note na teng suoh ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in thutang dei hi; ama in a muon mite a nuasie sih ding hi. Midihte kikemcing zing ding a, hinanle migilote kihemkhie ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Midihte in gam luo ding a, kumtawnin tua sungah a teng ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Midihte’ kam in pilna thu gen a, a leii un thutang a gen hi."},"31":{"text":"A lungsim sung vuah Pasien’ thukham a om hi; amau’ kengte ahile a kitawnkhaw sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Migilote in midihte encihin, amate tha dingin a sui uhi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in a vanglietna sung vuah amate nuasie lo ding a, thu sit dingin a kipeipi ciengin amate mawna thuohsah lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa lamen inlen, ama’ lampi zui in, tua hile ama in gam luo dingin nangma ang tawisang ding hi; nangma in migilote’ sietna na en ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Lebanon taamtah sing banga a sang mama, mi bawlsie migilote keima in ka mu hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate kungah ka va suohkia leh amate na om nawn lo hi; amate ka suisui vangin a kimu zo nawn sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Kaw baang lote ciemte in, mi thumante en in, azieh pen kilemna a deite adingin suonlehlah a om ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanle thupalsat mite, kisusie ton ding hi; migilote’ suonlehlahte kihemkhie ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Midihte’ hutdamna khu Topa tung pan ahi hi; ama pen hahsat hun cienga amau’ kibuhna ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Topa in amate panpi-in a suohtasah a, amate in Topa a bel ziehun ama in migilote kung panin amate hunkhie-in a suohtasah hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, a lungthahsa-in kei thu ei hil sinlen, na thangpai cieng zong thu ei hil sin.","title":"Gimna Thuoh a Kisiakiapa Thumna"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen ka sungah na thaltangte ang tum a, ka tungah na khutte ang tu zo ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lungthah ziehin ka ci ka sa a dam thei sih hi; ka mawna ziehin ka gu ka tangte a khau thei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen keima’ khielnate in ka luzang ei vuanelh ta hi; keima adingin tuate pen a gih mama van tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka motlawm ziehin ka liemnate naikulin uithan hi;"},"6":{"text":"nahpitahin ei kikun sahin, ei kikhupbawh sah hi; da le kapin sunthapai-in ka vah kawikawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen ka kawng zang teng meikah tawh kidim sieng a, ka ci ka sa sungah damna kici a om sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Nahpitahin ei kizo gawpin ka tha a tawpmang ta hi; ka lung a gim ziehin thumin ka tautau hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, nang in ka dei zosie na thei hi; ka khuisahnate ahile na kung pan phuolsel ahi sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka lungtang a kisai a, ka thahatna tawp zo hi; ka mit in zong khuo a mu thei ta sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka genthei thuohna ziehin ka lawm ka guolte a kidangkoi vua, ka innvengte zong gamlapi-ah a om uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kei ei tha sawmte in thang ei sie uhi; ka nat nading a suite in siet nading thu beh genin, sunthapai-in mi sol ding beh lungngai-in a nei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle kei ka hi leh bilbing ka bang a, khuo ka za sih hi; a ham thei lote bangin ham loin ka om hi."},"14":{"text":"A tahtahin ci lei kei pen bil khuo za lo le, a kam pana a thuhkia ngai lo mipa tawh ka kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, keima in nang kang ngah hi; Topa ka Pasien aw, kei ei dawng pa nang na hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Ka kitawnkhaw ciengin, kei tunga thangpha mite, kei ziehin lungdamsah sin,” ci thu beh kang ngen hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kei a pua ding ka hi ta a, ka natna a kam thei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima in ka khielna ka pulah hi; ka mawna ziehin ka da mama hi."},"19":{"text":"A thu om lopi-in ka galte a thahat mama vua, a man lopi-a ei mudate a tam mama uhi."},"20":{"text":"A hoi gamta ka hi ziehin hoina pen sietna tawh ei thuhte ka galte ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa aw, kei ei nuasie sin; ka Pasien aw, ka kung panin gamla op vawt sin;"},"22":{"text":"ka hutdamna Topa aw, ei hu dingin hing kinaw ta’n."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka leii tawh ka maw lo nadingin ka gamtatnate ka kikem ding hi; keima’ opna munah migilote a om laise kamtuomna tawh ka kam ka hum ding hi,” ka ci hi.","title":"Pil nading le Mawmai nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ham loin ka om khinkhian hi; ka dai opna khu a mawhna a suoh hi; ka lungkhamna khang semsem a,"},"3":{"text":"a sungah ka lungtang sa vapom hi. Ka ngaisutsut ciengin ka lung a so hi; tuaci’n keima in ka kam tawh ka gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, ka hinkhuo tawp hun ding, a kise za ka hun ka nite ei theisah in; ka hinkhuo a tawp pah ding ahi lam zong ei theisah in."},"5":{"text":"Nang in ka hinkhuo khutphang cie behin na bawl a, nangma’ muna-ah ka khankum bangma tan ahi vawt sih hi. A tahtahin mihing vannuoi naahu bang beh ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"A tahtahin mi zosie hlim banga a vah kawikawi ahi hi. A tahtahin amate bangma lo adingin a buoi uhi; koi pen’ nga ding ci thei lopi-in nei le lam a kholvum uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Tuale tu-in, Topa aw, kei bang pen ngah ka hei? Nangma sungah ka lametna a om hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima’ khielna zosie panin ei hunkhie in. Mi mawte’ simmaw dingin kei ei bawl sin."},"9":{"text":"Tam banga ei bawl nang na hi ziehin, kam keh loin ka dai op hi,"},"10":{"text":"Keima tung panin nei vuohna ladawh in; na khuttum tawh nei tup ziehin ka tha a tawp hi."},"11":{"text":"“Mihingte a mawna ziehun dan pie-in thu na hil a, nang in amau’ thupisah nate nget’ neh bangin na netum hi; a tahtahin mihing zosie pen naahu khat beh hi lel uhi. Selah"},"12":{"text":"“ Topa aw, ka thungetna ei za inlen, ka kikona na bil ei daw in; ka hlitui luonna ei thudon in. Azieh pen ka pu ka pate bangin, kei zong bakhat sung zin le pemta bang ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima si-in ka op nawn lo masang, ka nuikia thei nadingin keima kung panin na mai heimang in,” ka ci hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungduoitahin Topa ka ngah hi; kei lam hing kinga-in ka kikona ei za hi.","title":"Hutkhietna le Panpina Ngetna Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Ama in sietna dum sung le buonnawi lah panin ei kaidawhin, suongpi tungah ka keng ei koipieh a, ka kalsuonnate kipsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in ka kam sungah i Pasien phatna la tha khat ei koipieh hi. Mi tampi in mu-in a zatah ding vua, amate in Topa a muong ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"A muonna uh Topa hisah a, mi kiphasahte lamah kihei loin, pasien man lote lamah a piel lote thupha nga ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, na sepna lamdangte le kote dinga na ngaisutnate tampitah na phasah zo hi; nang pen koima dang tawh tekah thei ding na hi sih hi. Tam thute tangko-in gen ding hileng sim zawh loin a tam hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang in biehpiehna le silpieh na lunggul sih a, ahi vangin nang in ka bil nei honpieh zo hi. Nang in meihal biehna le mawna zieha biehna na kal sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Tanah ka om hi; laiziel bupi sungah ka thu kigiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in na deina banga sep ding nuom ka sa hi, ka Pasien aw; ka lungtang sungah na thukham a om hi,” ka ci hi.","ref":"Heb 10:5-7"},"9":{"text":"Keima in mihon tampite lahah hutkhiet lungdamna thu ka gen zo ta hi; en in, Topa aw, na thei bangin keima in ka nephute ka kham zo sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Na hutdamna dinga nei panpina keima in ka lungtang sungah ka phuolsel sih a, keima in na muonhuoina le na hutdamna thu ka genkhie zo hi; Mihonpi panin na itna kip le na muonhuoina ka imcip sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, ka kung panin na khuotuona humcip sin; na itna kip le na muonhuoina in keima ei kembih den taheh."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen sim zawh lo sietnate in keima ei kimkot hi; khuo ka mu thei lo ding za dongin ka khielnate in kei ei nuaphah zo hi; ka samzam sangin a tamzaw vua, ka lungsim a tawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, nei hut ding hing lungkim in; Topa aw, kei ei hu meng in."},"14":{"text":"Tha dinga kei ei sui kawikawi zosie maizumsah inlen, buoisah in; ka siet nading a dei mite nuakia sah inlen minsiesah in."},"15":{"text":"Keima tungah, “Aha, Aha!,” ei cite maizumin cizalia sah in."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang ang sui zosie, nang sungah lungdam kipah hinlen; na hutdamna a dei mite in, Topa lien hi!” ciden ta uheh!"},"17":{"text":"Kei ka hi leh zawngin ka cimaw a, hinanle Topa in kei ei phawh den hi. Nang ei panpi pa le ei hunkhie pa na hi hi; hing kiheh sin, ka Pasien aw."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mizawng a khuolte thupha nga mi ahi hi; lungkham hun ciengin Topa in amate hunkhie hi.","title":"Pasien’ Panpina tunga Hlamuonna le Cidam nading Thumna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in amate dalin a hingsah ding hi; amate pen gam sungah thupha nga mi kici ding hi. Nang in a galte deina bangin amate na pie sih hi."},"3":{"text":"A cinatna a lup muntung vuah Topa in amate khoi ding hi; nangma in amau’ cinat hun sungin a damlona zosie uh na damsah zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei dingin hi leh, “ Topa aw, ei hepi inlen, ei damsah in; bangzieh ahei cile nang tungah kang mawzo hi,” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei bang hun ciengin si-in, ka min a mangthai diei, ci thu thangsietna tawh ka galte in a ngaisun uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kei ei en dinga ang pei ciengun, thu mawhna vive a gen vua, a lungsim sung vuah sietna kaikhawmin, a peikhiet ciengun tuate a genthaang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kei ei muda zosiete in keima’ thu a kihodap uhi; amate in kei adingin a sie penpen ngaisun uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ka lupna pana thokia zo lo dingin si theina natna in ei mancip hi, ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka muon ka lawm it pa, keima’ an a ne pa nangawnin a aaketul tawh keima ei peh kawi viel hi.","ref":"Mat 26:23; Mrk 14:18, 20; Luk 22:21; Jhn 13:18"},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, amate ka thuh thei nadingin, keima ei hepi inlen, ei phongto in."},"11":{"text":"Ka galpa in kei ei zaw lo ziehin, kei tungah nang lungkim lam tami thu tawh ka thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka citah ziehin nang in kei nei panpi a, nangma’ opna munah kumtawna om dingin nei koi zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel Pasien Topa in kumtawn pan kumtawn dongin thupha nga taheh. Amen, Amen.","ref":"Late 106:48"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sakhi in luitui luong silsel a lunggul bangin ka hlagau in nang ang lunggul hi, Pasien aw.","title":"BU NINA (Late 42–72) Lungkham Hunin Pasien le ama’ Panpi ding Lunggulna"},"2":{"text":"Ka hlagau in tuidu dangta bangin a hingzing Pasien ang hlangai hi. Bangcih cieng hing pei-in Pasien’ maitang mu ding ka hei?"},"3":{"text":"Mite in ka kungah, “Na Pasien hei-a om ahei,” ei ci den ciengun, sun le zanin ka hlitui an-in ka nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in ka lungsim ka sungkhie a, mi honpi tawh zawh tonin, kipahin awngin nopna late a sa pawibawl mihonpite tawh Pasien’ inn ah amate ka pui zie teng ka phawhkia hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, bang zieha lungkham a, bang zieha ka sunga buoi na hei? Pasien sungah lametna nei in; azieh pen keima in ei panpi"},"6":{"text":"le ka Pasien ahi, ama ka phatkia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuithuhpi in na tuizeu hawh sungah tui thuhpi hlan hi; na tuihuolte le tuihuolpite in kei ei vuamang zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Sunin Topa in a itna kip sawl a, zanin a la tawh ei ompi hi, ka hinna Pasien tungah thu ka ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka suongpi ka Pasien kungah, “Bang dingin kei ei mangngil na hei? Ka galte in ei gawt ziehin bang dingin da le kapin vah kawikawi ding ka hei?” ka ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka pumpi tungah sina ding liemna nei bangin, ka galte in ei tawhin ka kungah, “Na Pasien hei-a om ahei?” ei ci den hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, bang dinga lungkham a, bang dinga ka sunga buoi na hei? Pasien tungah lametna nei in; bangzieh ahei cile keima in ei panpi ka Pasien ka phatkia ding hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka dihna hing kilangsah inlen, Pasien zatah lote tawh ka thu-ah keima ei panpi in; mi solte le mi thuman lote kung panin kei ei hunkhie in!","title":"Lungkham Huna Pasien Kunga Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang ka kibuhna Pasien na hi hi; nang in bang dinga kei nei taisan dawh ahei? Galte bawlsietna ziehin bang dingin kap kawmin vah ding ka hei?"},"3":{"text":"Aw, na khuovah le na thuman hing sawl in; tuate in ei puisah in; tuate in na muol siengtho le na tenna munah ei peipisah in."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ maitam ahi a, nop ka sah mamana Pasien kungah ahi zongin ka pei ding hi; keima in harp lasahna tawh nangma kang phat ding hi, aw, Pasien, ka Pasien aw."},"5":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, bang dingin kilungkhamsahin, ka sungah bang dingin buoi den mielmuol na hei? Pasien sungah lametna nei in; bangzieh ahei cile keima in ei panpi ka Pasien ka phatkia ding hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, tanglai amahaw’ hin lai-a na silbawlsate, ka pu ka pate in ei gen vua, ka bil utawh ka za zo uhi:","title":"Minam Kaana le Panpi nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Nangma in na khut tawh minamte na notmang a, hizongle nangma in amate na tengsah hi; Nang in mite na bawlsie a, hinanle amate na suohtasah hi;"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen a namsau beh utawh amate in gam a lah uh ahi sih a, a baan thahat beh un zong amate guolzawna pie lo hi; na zietlam khut, le na baan le na maitang khuovah hang hizaw hi, bang ding ahei cile amate sungah nang na lungkim hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang ka Kumpipa le ka Pasien na hi hi; nang in a guolzaw nadingin Jacob thu na pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma ziehin ka galte ka sawnpua uhi; nangma’ min ziehin ei do mite ka tuoncil uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen ka thalpi ka muong sih a, ka namsau in zong ei hun zo lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka galte panin nang in nei hun a, ko ei muda mite na amtawngsah gawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien sung ah ka ki-angtangsah zing uhi, kumtawnin kote in na min ka phat den ding uhi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Hinanle nang in ko ei nuolin nei thusim ta sih a, ka galkap honte tawh zong na kuonton sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka galte kung panin nei nuakiasah a, ka galte un ka neisate a la ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Nang in a kigo ding tuu bangin kei nei bawl a, minam dangte lahah nei thethaang zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang in tawmno khat tawh na mite na zua zo a, nang in amau’ man ding na sang nget sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Nang in ka vengte’ zako, ka kim ka pamte’ simmaw le nuisat dingin nei bawl zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Minamte lahah a sie lam thugentena, mite lahah nuizat nopna-in kote nei bawl zo ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Sunthapai-in ka mai-ah mindaina om a, kei ei tawhte le ei hosie mite’ thugen ziehin, ka galte le phula mite’ mai-ah zumna in ka maitang a tuom mang ta hi.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Ka tung vuah tam thu zosie hing tung nanle kote in nang kang mangngil sih vua, na thuciemna ka palsat sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ka lungsim uh kinua hei loin, ka kalsuonna uzong nangma’ lampi panin a piel tuon sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle nangma in ngie-te opna munah nei balnen a, khuomiel thuhpi tawh kei nei tuommang hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka Pasien uh’ min mangngilin pasien dang tungah ka khutte uh a zah zo hi mawh uleng,"},"21":{"text":"Pasien in tam thu mu loin a om mawh ding amah? Bangzieh ahei cile ama in lungsima phuolselte a thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma ziehin sunthapai-in kote ei kithat a, a kigo ding tuu bangin ei kingaisun hi.","ref":"Rom 8:36"},"23":{"text":"Topa aw, bang dinga kimu na hei? Hing tho in, khanglo inlen, keima ei nuasie zing sin!"},"24":{"text":"Bang dinga na mai na phuol ahei? Bang dinga ka gentheina ule ei kibawlsietnate na mangngil ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile leivui lahah ka pua uhi; ka pumpi uh tuol ah a lum hi."},"26":{"text":"Hing thoto inlen kote ei hu in. Nangma’ itna kip na khuolna tawh kote ei tankhie in."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuhoi khat tawh ka lungtang ang dimlet hi; kumpipa kungah ka latengte ka va sut ta hi; ka leii lai-at siempa laikung tawh kibang hi.","title":"Kumpi Mopina Pawi La"},"2":{"text":"Mite lahah nang na hoi pen hi; na nephu tungah hepina kibuosuh hi; tua ahi ziehin Pasien in kumtawnin nang thupha ang pie zo hi."},"3":{"text":"A thahat mipa aw, na phei ah a vangnei le a thupi na namsau kuo in."},"4":{"text":"Thutah ading le thuman humbih nadingin na thupina tawh guolzo tahin tuong in; na zietlam khut in a dipkuot huoi nasepte kihilsah in."},"5":{"text":"Na thaltangte hiem mama a, tua khu kumpipa galte’ lungtangah tu-in, na nei-ah mite a pua hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien aw, kumtawnin na kumpi topha kip den hi. Na kumpi ciengkhut zong thumanna ciengkhut ahi hi;"},"7":{"text":"nang in thudih na dei a, gitlona na muda hi. Tua ziehin Pasien ahi, na Pasien in lungdamna sathau hing nu-in, na khanguolte tungah ang sangkhan zo ta hi;","ref":"Heb 1:8-9"},"8":{"text":"na puontuolpite myrrh, aloe le thalsing namtuite’ gim a nam hi. Saiha tawh kibawl kumpi innpi panin khausai lasahnate in nangma ang kipahsah hi;"},"9":{"text":"na numei thupite lahah kumpite’ tanute a om uhi; nangma’ zietlamah Ophir kham tawh a kizem kumpi nu a ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tanu aw, za in, ngai sunin na bil ei ngat in; na mite le na pa’ inn mangngil inlen,"},"11":{"text":"nang melhoi na hi ziehin kumpipa in ang deigaw ding hi. ama na topa ahi ziehin ama mai-ah kun in."},"12":{"text":"Mihau pente ahi Tyre mite in"},"13":{"text":"nei le lam namcin tawh letsongte tawi-in na maipha ang sui ding uhi. Ama’ innkhan sungah kham tawh kigan puontuolte tawh kumpipa’ tanu kizem hi;"},"14":{"text":"mel tuomtuom a nei puontuolpi silin kumpi kungah tua nu kipeipi hi; ama’ nua-ah ngahnu siengthote le a lawm a guolte in a zui uhi."},"15":{"text":"Kipahna le lungdamna tawh amate kizawpi a, kumpipa’ inn sungah a lut uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, na pu na pate’ tangin tapate na nei ding hi; nang in leitung mun zosie-ah amate, gam-uhte na suohsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima in a khang khangin na min ka kiphawhsah zing ding hi; tua ahi ziehin mite in a tawntungin nangma ang phat den ding uhi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien pen i kibuhna le i thahatna hi a, lungkham hun a ei hu paipai pa ahi hi.","title":"Pasien in a Khuopi le a Mite a Dalna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ziehin leitung kikhelin tuipi laikimah muolte kilawh hi;"},"3":{"text":"a tuite hawh vapo-in phuon valuh a, a tuihuol ziehin muolte kiling nanleh, i zau sih ding uhi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Gunpi khat om a, a luituite in Pasien’ khuopi ahi Sangpen Pa’ tenna khuopi siengtho a lungdamsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khuopi laikimah Pasien a om hi; tua khu a kilawh sih ding hi. Pasien in zingmawng phalvahin ama a panpi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Minamte so gawpin kumpi gamte kiling hi; ama in a aw gingsah a, leitung tui a suoh hi."},"7":{"text":"Vanglien Topa eite tawh ang omton hi; Jacob Pasien khu eite’ kibuhna ahi hi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Hing pei unlen, Topa’ sepnate hing en un; ama in leitung zosie gamkhing a suosahna hing en un."},"9":{"text":"Ama in leimong dongah gal a vengsah hi; ama in thalpi kuoitanin teipi a susie hi; ama in kidalna lumte mei tawh a haltum hi."},"10":{"text":"“Om hihiet unlen, Pasien ka hi lam thei un! Minamte lahah keima ei kitawisang a, leitungah zong keima ei kitawisang hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Vanglien Topa eite tawh ang omton hi; Jacob Pasien khu i kibuhna uh ahi hi. Selah"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No mi zosiete aw, na khut uh beng unlen, Pasien tungah a gingtahin kipahna late sa-in awng un.","title":"Minamte Tunga Pasien’ Uhna"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen Sangpen Pa Topa giinhuoi mama a, leitung buppi a uh kumpi lien khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in i nei-ah mite ei koipieh a, i keng nei-ah minamte ei zosah hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in eite ading gouluo ei teelpieh a, ama in a it Jacob’ angtanpi zong ama’ guot ahi hi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Awhna tawh Pasien peito a, pengkul aw tawh Topa peito hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien tungah phatna late sa un, phatna late sa un; i Kumpipa tungah phatna late sa un, phatna late sa un."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien khu leitung buppi’ kumpi ahi hi; late tawh phatna la sa un."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen minamte tungah Pasien khu kumpi ahi hi; ama’ kumpi topha siengtho tungah Pasien a to hi."},"9":{"text":"Abraham Pasien’ mite bangin mite’ uliente zong a kisutuo uhi. Azieh pen leitung lumte khu Pasien-a’ ahi hi; a sangpi-in ama kipatawi hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa lien a, i Pasien’ khuopi sungah nahpitaha phat ding ahi hi. Ama’ muol siengtho pen","title":"Zion’ Minthanna le a Thahatna"},"2":{"text":"sangin etlawm a, tua khu Kumpi lien’ khuopi, leilu lama om Zion Muol ahi a, leitung buppi’ lungdam kipahna ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 5:35"},"3":{"text":"Ama’ kulpi sungah Pasien om a, a muonhuoi hunpa ahi lam ama le ama a kilah zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpite a kikhawm vua, amate a kuonto uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in tuami a mu behun lamdang a sa mama uhi; amate patau dipkuo-in a taimang sieng uhi;"},"6":{"text":"nau suoh dinga kisa takei natna in a tut numei bangin, khum sungah amate citunin a om vua,"},"7":{"text":"Tarshish tembawte a susie nisuona lam huipi bang uhi."},"8":{"text":"I zahsa bangin eite in, Vanglien Topa’ khuopi, Pasien in kumtawna a phukipsa Pasien khuopi sungah i mu ta uhi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Pasien aw, kote in na biehinnpi laikim ah na itna kip ka lungngai uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien aw, na min in leimong a zel bangin, nang ang kiphatna in zong a zel hi. Na zietlam khut guolzawna tawh a kidim hi."},"11":{"text":"Na thukhennate ziehin Zion Muol lungdam hinlen, Judah khuopite zong kipah uheh."},"12":{"text":"Zion kimkotah pei unlen, a tausang phaza va sim ta un,"},"13":{"text":"a kulpite hoitahin ngaisun un; a khuopi kulte va nawh ta un, tua hile khangsawnte kungah"},"14":{"text":"tami Pasien ahi a, kumtawn eite’ Pasien ahi hi, ci-in na gen thei ta ding uhi. Ama pen a tawntungin eite’ lam lahpa hi ding hi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi zosie in tam thu za un; leitunga milien","title":"Hauna Muon ding a Mothuoina"},"2":{"text":"mineu, mihau le mizawng zosie aw, ngai un."},"3":{"text":"Ka kam in pilna thu a gen ding hi; Ka lungsim sunga ka thungaisut thu in ei theitelsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Paunah khat ka bil ka ngat ding hi; Harp lasahna tawh ka thu hahsate ka gencien ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Hahsat hun, ei bawlsiete’ khielna in ei kimkot hun ciengin bang dinga zau ding ka hei?"},"6":{"text":"A neisa uh muongin a hauvumna uh kisahtheipi uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"A tahtahin koima in a hinna sum tawh tan zo lo a, Pasien kungah a hinna man ding a pie zo koima om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile hinna tatna ding man tam mama a, tua in hankhuh mu ngai loin hin denden nadingin kicing zo lo hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Mipilte i et ciengin, amate zong a si uhi; mimawte le mingolte zong a si ton vua, amate in a neisa zosie uh midangte a nuasie pieh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in leitangte amau’ min a puohsah vangun, a hankhuh uh pen a tenna uh mun hi den ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nopsahna-ah mihingte kip suoh thei lo hi; amate pen a mangthai ganhingte tawh a kibang ahi lel bo uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bang pen a mottat mite’ tuokhah ding thu ahi a, amau’ ngasa tawh a lungkimte’ tawpna khu tam bang ahi hi. Selah"},"14":{"text":"Misikhuo adingin tuu bangin amate kise zo hi; Sina pen amate a cingpa hi ding hi; amate hankhuh-ah a kumsuh suoh uhi; amate a meel uh siemang ding a, Misikhuo a inn uh hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle Misikhuo vanglietna panin Pasien in ka hlagau ei tanh ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama in keima ei sang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi kimkhat hau-in a inn sung vuah a nei le lamte uh a pun ciengin zau sin."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen amate a si ciengun bangma a keng sih ding uhi; a hauna un amate a nuazui sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate a hin sungin a nuomsa-in kingaisunin, nangma adingin na na hoi sep ciengin ang kiphat vangin,"},"19":{"text":"khuovah a mu ngai nawn lo dingin a pu a pate kung ma-ah amate a pei ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amau’ nopsahna ah mihingte kip suoh thei lo hi; amate pen a mangthai ganhingte tawh a kibang lel uhi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien in nisuo-a kipanin nitum dongin leitung zosie khawmin thu a gen hi.","title":"A Santah Biehpiehna"},"2":{"text":"Hoina kicinna Zion panin Pasien ang taang hi."},"3":{"text":"I Pasien uh ang pei a, a sip dide sih hi, ama mai-ah mi halvam thei meikuong om a, ama kimvelah hui husiepi a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a mite thu a khen thei nadingin tunglam vante le leitung hlan hi:"},"5":{"text":"“Biehpiehna tawh kei tunga thuciemna a bawl, ka kungah ka mi citahte hing khawm un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien mama thukhenpa ahi ziehin, vantung in ama’ dihna a pholah hi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Ka mite aw, za un, keima in thu kang gen ding hi, Israel aw, na langkhatah keima teci ka pang ding hi. Kei pen Pasien ka hi a, noma’ Pasien ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kang phawsietna uh pen na biehpiehna zieh ahi sih hi; na meihal biehna zong ka mai-ah a om den hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in na inn panin bawngtang ahi a, na ganbuh panin keelte ahi zongin ka sang sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile gamlah a ganhingte zosie keima-a’ ahi a, muol tul tampite tunga a om ganhingte zong keima-a’ ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hui lahah vate zosie ka thei a, gamlaha a gamta zosie keima-a’ ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ka gil a kiel leh nang kang gen sih ding hi, azieh pen leitung le a sunga om zosie keima-a’ ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in bawngtang sa ne-in, keelte’ sisan ka dawn amah?"},"14":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko biehpiehna pie un, tuale Sangpen Pa tungah na kiciemna tangtun un."},"15":{"text":"Hahsat hun ciengin keima ei hlan un; keima in kang hunkhie ding a, nangma in kei nei minthangsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in migilote tungah thu gen a: “Ka thukhamte na gen nading ule na nephu utawh ka thuciemna na gen nadingun, note in thuneina bang nei na hi uh ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in khalna na mu da vua, na nua lam vuah khalna na paimang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Guta khat na mu ciengun lawm le guolin na bawl pai vua, a pahtat mite tawh na kigop uhi."},"19":{"text":"Sietna lamah na kam na pie vua, na leii un zuouthu a bawl hi."},"20":{"text":"To-in na sanggampa langpangin thu na gen uhi; note in na nu sungkuon na laizomte mama’ minsiet nading na gen uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tam tengpi na bawl zo ta vua, bangma ka ham sih hi; kei pen noma tawh a kibangin nei ngaisun uhi. Hinanle tu-in kang phawhsie vua, tuale keima in na mai vuah na mawna uh kang lui hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tua ciengin Pasien a mangngil note aw, tami thu na ciemte ta un. Tua hi sihle keima in note kang bottel ding a, ang hunkhie ding koima a om sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Biehpieh nadinga lungdamkona ang peipi mi in kei ei patawi ahi hi; keima in dihna lampi a zuite tungah Pasien’ hutdamna ka lah ding hi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, na itna kip dung zui-in keima ei lainat in; a kicing na lainatna dung zui-in ka khielnate ei phietpieh in;","title":"Kisiensuona le Mawmai nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"ka khielna panin ei silsieng kilkel inlen, ka mawna panin ei siengsah in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen ka khielnate ka thei a, ka mai-ah ka mawna a om zing hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang, nang tung behah kang maw zo ta a, nangma’ muna-ah a sie ka gamta zo ta hi, tuaci’n na thukhenna ah nang na dih a, thu na khen ciengin gen na baang sih hi.","ref":"Rom 3:4"},"5":{"text":"A tahtahin kei a khielsa-in ka suoh a, ka nu in ei pai cil a kipanin mawnei ka hi tabo hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sunglam mi ah thuman na dei hi; tua ziehin ka lungsim tawngah pilna ei hil in."},"7":{"text":"Hyssop tawh ei nawt sieng lacin kei ka sieng ta ding hi; ei sil sieng lacin vua sangin ka ngozaw ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungdamna le kipahna thu ei zasah in; na hlietawngsa gu le tangte hing lungdamsah in."},"9":{"text":"Ka mawnate panin na mai hing phuol inlen, ka khielnate zosie ei phietmangpieh in."},"10":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka sungah lungsim siengtho hing siem inlen, keima sungah lungsim tha le lungsim dih ei guon in."},"11":{"text":"Nangma’ opna panin kei ei paimang sinlen, keima kung panin na hlagau siengtho ladawh sin."},"12":{"text":"Na hutdamna ziehin lungnopna ei piekia inlen, lungsim thanopna tawh keima ei panpi in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in mikhielte na lampi ka hil ding a, nang lamah mawneite ang kiheikia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Pasien, keima’ hundampa Pasien aw, sisan suo nading panin keima ei hunkhie in, tua hile ka leii in ngaitahin nei hutdamna la a sa ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa aw, ka nephu ei kah pieh in, tua hile ka kam in nangma phatna a pholah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile biehpiehna-ah na lungkim sih a, meihal biehna hing pie leng zong na lungdam tuom sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien’ san thei biehpiehna pen a kitamzan lungsim ahi hi; Pasien aw, nangma in a kitamzan le a kisiakia lungsim na simmaw sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hoi na sah bangin Zion tungah a pha bawl in; Jerusalem kulpite lamkia in,"},"19":{"text":"tuaci’n a man biehpiehnate ahi, meihal biehnate le meihal biehna bup ah na lung a kim ding hi; tua ciengin na maitam tungah bawngtangte ang kipie ding hi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi thahatpa aw, Pasien’ mite suhsietna ah bang dingin kisiel na hei? Sunthapai-in","title":"Mizuoute Tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"nang in siet nading na ngaisunsun hi. Zuou nasempa aw, na leii zong mulmetna namhiem bang hi."},"3":{"text":"Hoina sangin sietna na deizaw a, thuman gen ding sangin zuouthu gen nuom na sazaw hi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"A zuou thei leii aw, nang in mi valtum thei ding kammal zosie na dei hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in kumtawnin nangma ang satguoi ding hi; ama in na buh panin hing zamin ang ehmal ding hi; ama in a hingte’ gam panin ang phungbaw ding hi. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Midihte in nang hing mu-in a zau ding vua, sietna a bawl mite nuisanin,"},"7":{"text":"“Pasien a bel lo, a kicing a haunate a muong, nei le lamte a bel mipa en vawi un,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka hi leh Pasien’ inn sungah olive singkung hing silsel tawh ka kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Na bawlsa nate ziehin lungdam kang ko zing ding hi. Tam pen thuhoi ahi ziehin thuman mite opna-ah nangma’ min ka pholah ding hi."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mimawte in a lungsim sung vuah Pasien om sih,” a ci uhi. Amate a kisie gawp vua, sil kidahhuoite a sem uhi; a hoi-a a gamta mawng koima a om sih hi.","title":"Pasien Zatahlona Kimawsah"},"2":{"text":"A pil le Pasien sui mi khat beh a om ei ci a mu dingin, Pasien in vantung panin mihingte ei ensuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate a unpi-in a puamang vua, a kibangin a letat kim uhi; sil hoi a bawl koima a om sih a, khat beh om lo hi.","ref":"Rom 3:10-12"},"4":{"text":"Pasien tunga thu a ngen lo, an neh banga ka mite a netum, sietna a bawl mite in theitelna a nei sih uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Bangma cih huna tua bang zauna a om ngai lo, zauna lienpi sungah amate a om ding uhi. Azieh pen Pasien mi lote’ gu le tangte Pasien in a thethang ding hi; Pasien in amate nuol zo ahi ziehin amate maizumin kikoi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Zion panin Israel-te ading hutkhietna hing tung taleh izaw! Pasien in ama’ mite nopsahna a piehkia ciengin Jacob a lungdam ding hi; Israel zong a kipah ding hi."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, na min tawh ei hundam inlen, na thahatna tawh ka dihna talang in.","title":"Dihtan nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka thungetna ei za in; ka kama ka thugente ei ngaipieh in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen kei ei do dingin mi kiphasahte ang kipan vua, mi hepi thei lote in tha dingin ei sui uhi; amate in a masang vuah Pasien a koi sih uhi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien pen ei panpi pa tahtah ahi a, Topa ka hinna a tudet pa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a gitlona uh ziehin ka galte a thuhkia ding hi. Na thumanna sungah amate sumaimang in."},"6":{"text":"Nopthu-a biehna tawh na tungah biehpiehna kang lui ding hi; Topa aw, na min ka phat ding hi, azieh pen tua khu a hoi ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in hahsatna zosie panin ei hunkhie a, ka mit in guolzawna tawh ka galte a en hi."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka thungetna ei ngai in; kang thumna panin kiphuol sin.","title":"A Guolpa’ Solna Tunga Mawsahna"},"2":{"text":"Ei ngaipieh inlen,ei dawng in; ka mi mawsahna ziehin ka buoi mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Galte’ awging le migilote’ ei gentheisahna ziehin ka buoi hi. Azieh pen amate in kei tungah buoina ang tun vua, lungthahna tawh ei gal bawl ding amate in nuom a sa uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka sungah ka lungtang a na a, ka tungah si ding zaunate ang tung zo ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka tungah zauna le linna ang tung a, zausina in ei vuanelh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Vakhu bangin hla nei leng maw! Ka kilen dawh ding a, ka kikhawl hit hiet ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"gamlapi-ah ka vahthap tahtah ding hi; gampalah-ah ka kigie ding hi; Selah"},"8":{"text":"Keima in hui husiepi pan le pingpeite panin ka kibuh nading ka naw sui ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, a kamham uh buoisah inlen, tawhnawi in; azieh pen khuopi sungah kheltatna le kiselna ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"A sun a zanin kulpite tungah amate a kuolva kawikawi vua, tua sungah tatkhielna le buoina a om hi;"},"11":{"text":"tua khuopi laikimah zong sietna a om hi; a vanzuana mun panin bawlsietna le solnate kihemkhie lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei ei tawhte khu ka galte ahi sih a, hi leh ka thuoh zo ding hi; kiphatsahna tawh ei bawlsie pen ka galte ahi sih hi- Hi leh amate kung panin ka kiphuol thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle ka kikimpi, ka kigoppi, ka melthei mama ka guolpa, nangma na hi a,"},"14":{"text":"nangma tawh nuomtahin i kipawl ngai a, Pasien’ inn sungah mihonpi tawh i peiton ngai hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate tungah sina tungsah in; amate, Misikhuo-ah a hingin peisah suh in; azieh pen a inn sung ule a lungtang vuah sietna a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle keima in Topa ka hlan a, Topa in ei hundam ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nitah, zingmawng, le sunlai-in ka buoina thu genin ka tau vangut a, tuale ama in ka aw ei za ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in ka galdona panin liemna nei loin ei tankhie ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile kei ei do dinga a kiguol mi a tam mama hi."},"19":{"text":"Tangtawng pana kumpi-a kikoi Pasien in, Selah za ding a, tuale amate a sunem ding hi, azieh pen amate kikhel loin, Pasien a giing sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka kithuopi pa in a guolpa tungah ama’ khut ngam a, ama in keima tawh a bawl thuciemna a palsat hi."},"21":{"text":"Thawbat sangin kamham nalzaw a, ahi vangin a lungtang ah gal bawlna a om hi; a kamham pen sathau sangin zolzaw a, hinanle tuate pen namsau dawhsa bang ahi bo hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa tungah na vangih suon in, ama in ang puohpi ding hi; ama in midihte kilingsah ngai lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanle Pasien aw, nang in dumthuh pen sungah amate na sepsuh ding hi; sisan luongsahte le mi solte ahile amau’ hin ding za alang zong a hing sih ding uhi. Ahi vangin keima in nang kang muong ding hi."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, mite in ei totcil ziehin kei ei hepi in; sunthapai-in amate in kei ei genthei bawl uhi;","title":"Bawlsietna Sungah Pasien Muong in"},"2":{"text":"mi tampi in ei do ziehin sunthapai-in ka galte in ei tuoncil uhi. Sangpen Pa aw,"},"3":{"text":"kei ka zau ciengin, nangma kang muong hi,"},"4":{"text":"keima in a thu ka phat Pasien muongin ka zau sih hi; mihingte in kei bang ei law thei ding ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Sunthapai-in amate in ka nat nading a sui uhi; a ngaisutna zosie uh ka siet nading vive ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in kisel nading thu bawlin ei buhdap uhi; amate in ka kalsuonnate ei encih uhi. Ka hinna a lah ding a kinep bangun,"},"7":{"text":"tuaci’n a khielna ziehun amate thuh in; thangpaina tawh tua mite paimang dawh ta’n Pasien aw!"},"8":{"text":"Nang in ka da ka kaanate na ciemte zo ta a, nangma in na thawl sungah ka hlituite na thun hi. Na ciemtena laibu sungah tuate om hi lo amah?"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin, keima kang kiko ni ciengin ka galte a nuakia ding uhi. Pasien keima-a’ ahi lam keima in ka thei hi."},"10":{"text":"A thu ka phat Pasien sungah, a thu ka phat Topa sungah,"},"11":{"text":"Pasien ka muong hi; kei ka zau sih hi. Mi maimai in kei bang ei law thei ding ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma tunga ka kiciemnate ka zui kul hi; keima in na tungah lungdamko biehnate kang pie ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen nang in sina panin ka hlagau na hunkhie zo a, Pasien’ mai hinna khuovah sungah keima ka pei thei nadingin ka kitawnkhaw nading panin kei nei hunkhie zo hi."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei ei khuotuo in Pasien aw, ka hlagau in nang ang belh ziehin kei ei khuotuo in; sietna huipi a ven dongin, na hla lim nei kang bel ding hi.","title":"Bawlsietna Huna Phatna le Hlamuonna"},"2":{"text":"Sangpen Pasien tungah, kei adinga a tupna a tangtungsah Pasien tungah ka kiko hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in van panin hing sawlin keima ei hundam ding a, keima ei tuoncil mite maizumsah ding hi. Selah Pasien in a itna kip le a muonhuoina ang sawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Huoihamna tawh mi sa a ne humpite lahah ka lum hit hiet a, a ha uh tei le thaltang tawh kibang a, a leii uh zong namsau hiemte tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasien aw, vante tungah kitawisang in. Leitung zosie tungah na minthangsah in."},"6":{"text":"Amate in ka ketot ah thang a sie uhi; ka hlagau a kunsuh hi. Amate in ka lampi-ah dum a to vua, hinanle tuami sungah amate ma a kie uhi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Ka lung a kip hi, Pasien aw, ka lung a kip hi. La ka sa ding a, ka gingsah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka hla aw, khanglo in! Harp le lyre aw khanglo un! Keima in phalvah ka phong ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw mite lahah nang lungdam kang ko ding hi; minamte lahah nangma phatna la ka sa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen na itna kip vantung za-in a sang hi; nangma’ muonhuoina in meiilumte a banto hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien aw, vante tungah kitawisang in. Leitung mun zosie-ah na minthangsah in."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No pasien-te aw, a manin vai na hawm uh amah? Note in mite tungah a dihin thu na khen uh amah?","title":"Thuhkia ding Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Na khen sih uhi, na lungtang vuah gitlona bawl ding na sawm uhi; na khutte un leitunga tatsietna teng a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Migilote pen a nu gil sung panin a lampiel zo tham uhi; amate in a suo cil vua kipan khielna a bawl vua, zuouthu a gen uhi."},"4":{"text":"Gul bangin gu a nei vua, amate in gulsum bilbing bangin a bil a hum uhi,"},"5":{"text":"tuaci’n amate in a hlimte’ aw ahi a, a zolsiemte’ aw ahi zongin a za sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien aw, a kam sung vua om a hate uh sutawng in; humpi khanglai’ hapa bawpieh in, Topa aw!"},"7":{"text":"Tuiluong bangin amate maimangsah in; lopa bangin amate kituoncilin gawtasah in."},"8":{"text":"Amate a nai lahah a zulmang tawhtol le, a hun cing lo-a a suoh, ni mu nai ngai lo nausen bangsah in."},"9":{"text":"Na beelsuonte in tua lingkung kuong sa a sah masang, ama in a kuonglai ahi a, a hing lai ahi zongin, a mallangzaw-in phietmang taheh!"},"10":{"text":"Phulahna a mu ciengun midihte lungdam ding uhi; amate in migilote’ sisan sungah a keng a sil ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mite in, “Midihte adingin thaman om tahtah hi; leitungah thu a khen Pasien om tahtah hi,” ci ding uhi."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, ka galte kung panin ei hunkhie in; ka langa dingte kung panin keima ei dal in.","title":"Galte pan Hunkhiet ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Sietna a bawl mite panin keima ei hunkhie in; sisan luongsah nuom mite panin keima ei hundam in."},"3":{"text":"Tu nangawnin amate in tha dingin ei buhdap uhi; keima langkhatah mi thahatte in kisel nading a kuontaw uhi. Azieh pen Topa aw, ka tawnkhielna le ka mawna zieh hi lo,"},"4":{"text":"ka khielna zieh zong hi lopi-in, amate tai-in a va kithawi ta uhi. Kei ei hu dingin hing tho in!"},"5":{"text":"Nang, Vanglien Topa Pasien, Israel’ Pasien na hi hi. Minam zosiete dan pie dingin hing tho in; solna tawh sietna bawl sawm mite koima hingkhawi sin. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Nitah sielin amate a kilekia vua, ui bangin hamin, khuo sung tengah vahdap vakhuan uhi."},"7":{"text":"A kam utawh tuanah nahpi tahin a hawh vua, amate in a nephu utawh kamkhel nono a gen uhi. Azieh pen, “Koi in ei za ahei?” ci-in amate in a ngaisun uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nang in amate na nuisan lel hi; nang in minamte zosie na zapi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka thahatna aw, nang kang ngah ding hi; azieh pen Pasien aw, nangma ka kulpi na hi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka Pasien in ama’ itna kip tawh keima ei na dawn ding hi; ka Pasien in guolzawna tawh ka galte ei ensah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate that sin, na tha leh ka mite in mangngil kha ding uhi; nangma in na thahatna tawh amate vahvaisah inlen, amate niemsah in, ka lum uh ahi, Topa aw."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kam utawh a mawna uh, a nephu utawh a hamna ziehun, a kisahtheina sung vuah amate awhsah in. Azieh pen amau’ gen samsietna le zuouthu ziehin,"},"13":{"text":"thangpaina tawh amate netum inlen, a tawp sieng dongun amate netum in. Tuaci’n Pasien in Jacob tunga a uhna thu leimong dongah kithei ding hi. Selah"},"14":{"text":"Nitah sielin amate kilekia-in ui bangin a ham vua, khuo sung tengah vahdap vakhuan uhi."},"15":{"text":"An sui-in a vah kawikawi vua, kham a nga zo sih uleh mi teng a ngih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle keima in na thahatna la-in ka sa ding a, zingmawngin na itna kip phatna la ngai tahin ka sa ding hi. Azieh pen kei adingin nang kulpi na hi a, ka genthei cienga ka kibuhna na hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka thahatna aw, nangma phatna late ka sa ding hi, azieh pen Pasien aw, ka kulpi na hi a, itna kip ei lah Pasien na hi hi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, kote nei nuol zo a, ka kidalnate uh na satguoi zo hi; nang na lungthah zo ta hi; tu-in ka ngaingai uh ei bangsahkia in!","title":"Guollel Zaw-a Minam ading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Nangma in gam sung na kilingsah hi; nangma in leitang na pawhkehsah hi; kiling gawp ta ahi ziehin a keena munte hing matkia in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma in na mite hahsatna na thuohsah zo a, nang in ei hawilensah lenggazu kote nei pie zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Thalkapna panin kihem a, amate a kikaikhop nadingun nang ang zatah mite adingin nang in diellap khat na khai zo hi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Na it mite a suotah thei nadingin, na khut zietlam tawh guolzawna pie inlen, kohaw’ ang ngetna ei dawng in."},"6":{"text":"Ama’ mun siengtho sungah Pasien in a kamciem zo hi: “Lungdam kipahna tawh Shechem ka phalsuo ding a, Succoth kuom ka sekhen ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Gilead gam keima-a’ hi a, tuale Manasseh zong keima-a’ ma ahi hi. Ephraim gam pen ka sia lukhu hi a, Judah gam pen ka kumpi ciengkhut ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Moab gam pen ka kisilna kuong ahi hi; keima in Edom tungah ka kedap ka vih phei hi; Philistia gam tungah guolzo-in ka awng hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Koi in kulpi tawh a ki-im khuopi-ah ei peipi ding ahei? Koi in Edom gamah kote ei pui ding ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma in kote ei nuol ta hi lo na mah? Pasien aw, ka galkapte tawh nang kuonkhie sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Aw, gal ka do nadingun huna ei pie in. Azieh pen mihing huna khu a mawhna ahi bo hi."},"12":{"text":"Eite in Pasien tawh hangsan tahin i sem ding uhi; i galte ei totcilpieh ding pa khu ama ahi hi."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka kikona ei za in; ka thungetna ei ngaipieh in.","title":"Pasien’ Ei Hutna Zieha Hlamuonna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lung a gim ciengin leimong panin nang kang hlan hi. Kei sanga a sangzaw suongpi kungah kei ei pui in;"},"3":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile nang, ka kibuhna na hi a, galte langkhatah a muonhuoi tausang na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na puonbuh sungah kumtawnin ei tengsah inlen, na hlate’ hutna hlim nei-ah kibuhna ei musah in. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien aw, nang in ka thuciemte na za zo hi; nangma’ min ang zatah mite’ luo ding gougil kei nei pie zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa hing khansausah in; ama’ khankum zong khang zosie adingin kip zing taheh!"},"7":{"text":"Ama Pasien’ mai-ah kumtawn kumpi hi taheh; itna kip le muonhuoina in ama kembih taheh!"},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n nisimin ka thuciemna kang pieh ma bangin, a tawntungin na min phatna late ka sasa ding hi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Azieh pen ka hlagau in dai dide-in Pasien beh ngah hi; ama kung panin ka hutdamna ang pei hi.","title":"Pasien Sung Beh a Muonna La"},"2":{"text":"Ama beh ka suongpi, ei kihutdamna le ka kulpi ahi hi; kei ka kilawh ngai sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Note zosie in mi khat bang tanvei do-in, palpua le thaw-awn tawh a kibang no ang lel mi khat bang tanvei susie ding na hi uh ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Amau’ gelna ahile, mi thupi khat khiehsuh ding beh ahi hi. amate in zuouthu gen nuom a sa uhi. Amate in a kampi utawh mi a phat vangun, a sungtawng vuah mi a samsie uhi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka hlagau in dai dide-in Pasien beh a ngah hi, azieh pen ka lametna ama kung pan ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama beh ka suongpi le ka hutdamna, ka kulpi ahi hi; kei ka kilawh sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasien tungah ka hutkhietna le ka minphatna a kinga hi; ama pen ka suongpi muonhuoi, ka kibuhna Pasien ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Mite aw, ama muong zing un; na lungtang uh ama mai-ah sung un. Pasien pen eite adinga i kibuhna ahi hi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Dinmun niem mite ahile husan khat beh ahi vua, dinmun sangte zong khu kisolna ahi bo hi; tawi a kikhai ciengin a lep zo sih uhi; a kigawmun naahu khat sangin amate a zangzaw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pauhat thu tawh ngana pen muonin nei sih unlen, guhtatna-ah zong kimot muon sih un; Na hauna uh a khan leh tuate tungah na lungtang koi sih un."},"11":{"text":"Khatvei Pasien in gen zo hi: tami pen nivei ka zahna ahi hi: vanglietna pen Pasien-a’ ahi hi,"},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, itna kip nangma-a’ ahi hi. Azieh pen nangma in a sepna utawh kituohin amate na thuhkia hi.","ref":"Job 34:11; Jer 17:10; Mat 16:27; Rom 2:6; Kln 2:23"}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, nang ka Pasien na hi hi, ke’n nangma kang sui a, ka hlagau in ang hlangai hi; tui op lona gamgawta le gimna gam sunga om bangin, ka tahsa in nangma ang ngai vangut hi.","title":"Pasien’ Opna ah Hlamuonna le Henepna"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n na vanglietna le na minthanna a mu dingin keima in mun siengtho sungah nangma kang en zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinna sangin na itna kip a hoi zawh ziehin, ka nephute in nangma ang phat ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka hin sung tungtawnin nang kang phat ding a, keima in ka khutte lamto-in nangma kang hlan ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka lupna tungah nang kang ngaisun a, zanthapai-in ka lung ngaingai ciengin pawi antui pente bangin ka hlagau a lungtai a, ka kam in kipahna nephute tawh nangma ang phat hi.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen kei ei panpi nangma na hi ziehin, keima in na hla hlim nei-ah kipah tahin la ka sa hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka hlagau in nang ang bel a, na zietlam khut in ei tudet hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanle ka hinna susie dinga ei suite, lei thuhpi sungah peisuh ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Namsau’ hatna sungah amate kipie ding a, ngiete’ an a suoh ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle Pasien sungah kumpipa lungdam ding a, ama tawh a kiciem zosie lungdam kipah ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile zuou gen kamte kihubing ding hi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka phunna aw ei za in; galte zauna panin ka hinna ei kem in.","title":"Galte Kungpan Hut ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Migilote’ sawmdapnate, sietna bawlte’ vaihawmna,"},"3":{"text":"namsau tat banga a leii uh a tat mite, thaltang banga thu hoilo tawh mi a dawite,"},"4":{"text":"a buhdapna panun genbaang lo mi kapte panin keima ei lie in; amate in zau vawt loin thakhatin a kap uhi."},"5":{"text":"A thusie ngaisutnate uh amate in a tudet uhi; a thang dapsie ding thu a gen vua, “Koi in eite ei mu ding ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Eite’ mawna koi in kantel zo ding ahei? Kupil tahin i dapgel zo uhi,” ci-in a ngaisun uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile mihing lungtang le lungsim thuh mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanle Pasien in amate a thaltang tawh a kap ding hi; amate thakhatin liem gawp ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"A leii ziehun ama in amahaw sietna thuohsah ding hi; amahaw a mu kha zosie in zau-in ling ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi zosie a zau ding uhi; amate in Pasien’ piensah thute a gen ding vua, ama’ sepsa thute a ngaisunsun ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Midihte in Topa sungah lungdamin ama bel ta uheh. Lungsim mante zosie in ama phat taheh."}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, Zion ah nangma phat ding a kilawm hi; na kungah kiciemnate ang kibawl ding hi,","title":"Leitung Hoina Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"nang, thungetna a dawng pa aw! Na kungah mi zosie ang pei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamtatkhielnate in ei thuzaw ciengin, nang in ka khielnate uh nei maisah hi."},"4":{"text":"Na huong sungah tengin, na kung ang nai dinga na teelsa mite thupha nga ahi uhi. Na biehinn siengtho, na inn sunga hoina tawh kote ka lungkim ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kote kihutdamna Pasien aw, na sil lamdang sepnate le nangma’ hutkhietna tawh kote nei dawng hi; nang pen tuipi a gamla pente le leimong dongah mi zosie’ kinepna na hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma’ thahatna tawh muolpite na phutdet hi; nangma in vanglietna tawh na kawng na gah hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang in tuipi gingte, tuihuol gingte le mipi gamlumnate na daisah hi."},"8":{"text":"Leimong pen-a teng mite in na sepna limte a giing uhi; nangma in nisuona le nitumna kikala om mite lungdam kipahin na awngsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang in leitung vilin tui na buoh a, leitung nahpitahin a hoina na belap hi; Pasien’ gunpi zong tui tawh a kidim hi; nangma in mite an na sih a, nang in tua bang dinga na bawlkhol ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"A tangkuongte ah tui niengtahin na buoh a, leivumte na zalhmai a, guotui tawh tuate nipsahin, ankungte thupha na pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma’ hauna tawh cithei kum na hisah hi; na leeng peina tengah sathau a taah hi."},"12":{"text":"Senel gam gan cinna munte lonona tawh kidimin, muoltang teng zong lungdamna tawh na tuom a,"},"13":{"text":"lonona munte zong tuuhon tawh kizemin, kuomte zong an tawh kidim hi, amate lungdamin awngin la a sa ton uhi."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung mi zosie aw, Pasien tungah kipahna aw gingsah un;","title":"Israel Tunga Pasien’ Hoina Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"ama’ minthanna la-in sa un; ama tungah patawina thupitah pie un."},"3":{"text":"Pasien kungah, “Na silbawlte zauhuoi-in lamdang sam e! Na vang lien mama ahi ziehin, na mai-ah na galte a meikhup uhi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung mi zosie in nangma ang bie uhi; amate in nangma phatna la a sa vua, na min phatna la a sa uhi,” ci un. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Hing pei unlen, Pasien’ sepsate hing en un: Mite lahah a nasepnate lamdang mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in tuipi pen leigaw a suohsah hi; amate a keng utawh tua tuipi na galkai uhi. Khumtah ama sungah eihaw i kipah vua,","ref":"Pei 14:21; Josh 3:14-17"},"7":{"text":"ama in a thahatna tawh kumtawnin uh a, ama in mit tawh minamte a vil zing hi, a ledo mite ahi uleh kitawisang da ta uheh. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Mite aw, i Pasien phat un, ama phatna ging kizasah un,"},"9":{"text":"ama in a hingte lahah eite ei kem a tuale i kengte uh a kitawnkhaw sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien aw, nang in kote nei sittel hi; mei tawh ngun a kisit bangin kote nei encien zo ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Lenthang sungah kote nei peipi hi; nangma in ka elzang vuah vangih nei suon hi;"},"12":{"text":"ka lutung vuah mite na tuongsah hi; kote in mei le tui ka nawh uhi; hizongle nang in mun tanzau ah kote nei peipi zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Meihal biehna tawh na inn sungah kang pei ding hi; nangma tungah ka kiciemnate kang pie ding hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuate pen ka lungkham cienga, ka nephu tawh ka thugente le ka kam tawh ka kamciem thute ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in nangma tungah ganhing thau tawh meihal biehnate, tuutang biehpiehna khute tawh biehna ka lui ding hi; Keima in bawngtangte le keelte tawh biehpiehna ka bawl ding hi. Selah"},"16":{"text":"Pasien a zatah zosie aw, hing pei unlen ei za un, ama in keima dinga a silbawlte kang gen ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama kungah nahpi tahin ka kiko a, tuale keima in ka leii tawh ama ka patawi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka lungtang sungah gitlona a kem hi leng, Topa in ka thugen ei ngaipieh sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hizongle Pasien in ka thugen ei ngaipieh tahpi hi; ka thungetna kammalte ama in ei zahpieh zo ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka thungetna ei nuol loin, keima kung panin a itna kip hemkhie lo ahi ziehin, Pasien in thupha nga taheh."}}},"67":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien in eite ei hepi-in thupha ei pie hinlen, tuale ama in eite tungah a mai hing tangsah taheh. Selah","title":"Pasien Phat dingin Minamte Kihlan"},"2":{"text":"Tua hile, leitungah na lampi kithei ding a, minam zosie lahah a vanglien na hutdamna kithei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasien aw, mite in nangma hing phat hinlen, mi zosiete in nangma hing patawi ta uheh."},"4":{"text":"Minamte in lungdam kipahin la sa uheh, azieh pen nang in dihtahin mite thu na khenpieh a, tuale nangma in leitungah minamte lam na lah hi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Pasien aw, mite in nangma hing phat taheh; mi zosie in nangma hing patawi taheh."},"6":{"text":"Leitang in ga tampi pie zo hi; Pasien, eite’ Pasien in thupha ei pie zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasien in eite thupha ei pie suoh taheh; leimong donga mi zosie in ama zatah uheh."}}},"68":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien hing tho hinlen, a galte kithethangsah taheh; a masangah ama muda mite taimang ta uheh.","title":"Phatna le Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Meikhu a kimutmang bangin tua bangin amate mutmang ta’n; mei mai-ah khuoinun a zun bangin migilote zong Pasien mai-ah mangthai ta uheh."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin midihte lungdam ta uheh; Pasien mai-ah amate lungdamin kitom vazawh uheh; amate in lungdam kipahna tawh pawi bawl uheh."},"4":{"text":"Pasien tungah la sa un, ama’ min phatna la sa un; meiite tunga tuong pa la khat tap un, ama’ min Topa ahi hi, ama mai-ah lungdamin kitom un."},"5":{"text":"Pa nei lote’ pa le meigongte a huoi pa ama’ tenna siengtho-a om Pasien ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien in a cimaw mite ten nading inn le lo guon hi; ama in thongkie mite nopsahna munah a pui hi, ahi vangin mi ledote ahile pawn gawta-ah a teng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Pasien aw, na mite’ mai-a na kuonkhiet cieng, senel gam nawhin na pei ciengin, Selah"},"8":{"text":"Sinai Pasien ahi Pasien’ opna, Israel Pasien ahi Pasien’ opna munah, leitung kiling gawp a, vantungte in guo a zusah hi.","ref":"Pei 19:18"},"9":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma in a kicingin guo na zusah a, nangma in gamcin teng na tapnom hi; na gouluo mite basamin a vulgawp uh ciengin nangma in amate na nosuosah kia hi;"},"10":{"text":"na tuunote in tua munah a ten nading a mu uhi; Pasien aw, na hoina tawh mi cimawte’ kisapna na sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in thu pie hi; lungdamna thu puoh mihonte a tam mama hi:"},"12":{"text":"“Galkapte’ kumpite, amate tai uhi, amate tai uhi!” a ci uhi. Inn a om numeite in galvan kilate a hawm vua,"},"13":{"text":"amate tuukui lah po-ah teng nan ule tua vante pen- ngun tawh kizut vakhu hlakuite ahi a, a hlamulte kham citah tawh kizut ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Vanglienpa in kumpite, khumtah ah a thezah ciengin, Zalmon muol tungah vua a kie hi."},"15":{"text":"Muol lienpi, Bashan muol aw; dawnzum tampi a nei muol, Bashan muol aw!"},"16":{"text":"Dawnzum tampitah a nei muol aw, Pasien in a tenna dinga a deigaw muolpi, Topa ten den nading mun, bang dingin note in thangsietna tawh na et uh ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Sakol leeng muonhuoi tul sawmni, galkap a tultulte tawh Sinai muol pan siengtho munah Topa ang pei hi."},"18":{"text":"Muolsang tungah na kato a, na galmatte na zawpi diudeu a, nang in mite tung le tua munah Topa a ten thei nading a ledo mite tung nangawn panin letsongte na sang hi.","ref":"Eph 4:8"},"19":{"text":"Nisiel a i vangih uh ei puohpi Topa in minthanna nga taheh; Pasien pen i kihutdamna ahi hi. Selah"},"20":{"text":"Eihaw’ Pasien pen hutdamna Pasien ahi a, sina pan suohtahna pen Topa Pasien-a’ ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in a galte’ lutangte, a khielna uh lam a zui samsau mite’ lukhute a suguoi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in amate, “Bashan panin ka peipi kia ding a, amate tuipi thuhte panin ka peipikia ding hi,"},"23":{"text":"tuaci’n note in sisan sungah na keng na sil ding uhi, tua khu galte’ tung panin na uite un lie ding a nei thei nading uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasien aw, kingtaha nang hon pei uh kimu a, a siengtho mun-ah ka Kumpipa, ka Pasien kingtaha nang pei uh kimu hi,"},"25":{"text":"lasate a mai-ah, tumging tumte a nua lamah, a laikimah numei tawmtumte in:"},"26":{"text":"“Mihon kikhopna sungah Pasien phat unlen, no Israel suonte aw, Topa patawi un!” a ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amate lahah mi citawm pen ahi Benjamin-te makai-in, amate zomah Judah uliente, Jebulun uliente, Naphtali uliente le a mipite ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien aw, na vanglietna hlan in; kote dinga na bawlsa bangin, na thahatna hing lah in, Pasien aw."},"29":{"text":"Jerusalem-a om na biehinnpi ziehin kumpite in na kungah letsongte ang puoh uhi."},"30":{"text":"Pumpeng lahah a teng gamsate, bawngtang honte le mipite’ bawngnote phawhsie gawp in. Sieh le kaih a lunggulte tuoncil in; galsim nuom a sa mite kithezah sah in."},"31":{"text":"Egypt panin sumngo kipuohsah in; Pasien tungah Ethiopia in a khutte zahsah meng in."},"32":{"text":"Leitung kumpi gamte aw, Pasien tungah la sa un; Topa tungah phatna la sa un. Selah"},"33":{"text":"Vantungte, tanglai vantungte a tuongpa aw, ngai in, ama in vanglien tahin ama’ aw, a ngai mama ama’ aw gingsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasien tungah vanglietna pie un, Israel tungah ama’ thupina om hi; ama’ vanglietna pen vantungah a om hi."},"35":{"text":"A siengtho muna om Pasien, Israel’ Pasien zatahhuoi mama hi; ama in a mite tungah thahatna le vanglietna a pie hi. Pasien in thupha nga taheh!"}}},"69":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, ei hundam in, bangzieh ahei cile tuite in ka ngawng cieng ang ban ta hi.","title":"Bawlsietna Pan Hutkhiet nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Keng hlah nading om lona mun buonnawi lahah ka tumsuh hi; buonnawi thuh sungah ka tumsuh a, pansie ding a om vawt sih hi; tuithuh sungah ka tumsuh a, tuikhang in kei ei vuanel hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka kikona-in ka gim gawp hi; ka dang zong a gawta hi. Keima in Pasien ka ngangana-in ka mitte a miel ta hi."},"4":{"text":"A hang om lopi-a ei mudate, ka lu tunga samzamte sangin a tamzaw uhi; kei ei susie ding mi tam mama a, ka galte in zuouthu tawh kei ei mawsah uhi. Keima in ka guh lopi tu-in piekia ding ka mah?","ref":"Late 35:19; Jhn 15:25"},"5":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma in ka motna na thei a, nangma kung panin ka tatkhielnate kisel lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, keima ziehin nangma ang lamen mite, maizumna thuohsah sin; Israel Pasien aw, keima ziehin nangma ang sui mite mindaisah vawt sin."},"7":{"text":"Nangma ziehin keima in zakona ka thuoh a, maizumna in ka mai a tuom hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka sanggamte lahah gelta ka suoh ta vanuh a, ka nu sunga ka suopite lahah zong khuolmi ka suoh ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Na inn ka deiluotna in keima ei netum hi; nang ang hosiete’ hosietna teng keima tungah ang tu ta hi.","ref":"Jhn 2:17; Rom 15:3"},"10":{"text":"Keima in an tangin lungsim ka kiniemkhieh ciengin, tua banga ka bawl ziehin amate in keima ei zako uhi."},"11":{"text":"Puon bangin la-ip ka sil ciengin a thusie gentena uh ka suoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei pen tunkot gei-a a to mite’ gensiet lel bepin ka om a, zukhamte in keima’ thu la-in a sa uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, na kungah thu kang ngen hi. A kiningcing na itna kip tawh a kisan thei hunin ei dawng in, Pasien aw. A muonhuoi na panpina tawh"},"14":{"text":"buonnawi lahah ka tumsuh nading panin keima ei suohtasah in. Tuithuhte le ka galte kung panin keima ei hunkhie in."},"15":{"text":"Tuikhang in keima ei vuanelsah sinlen, buonnawi thuhpi in zong ei valtumsah sin, ahi sihle keima tungah Leihawm in a kam ei khanelsah sin."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip a hoi ziehin keima ei dawng in; a kiningcing nangma’ khuotuona dung zui-in kei lam hing kinga in."},"17":{"text":"Na nasempa kung panin na mai phuol sinlen, cimaw zo ta ka hi ziehin, keima ei dawng meng in."},"18":{"text":"Kei lam ei neh inlen, ei tankhie in, ka galte kung panin ei suohtasah in."},"19":{"text":"Ka thuoh gensietna, maizumna, le mindaina na thei hi; nangma in ka galte zosie na thei zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Kigensietnate in ka lungsim tamzan sah a, tuaci’n ka lung kie dihdeh hi. Ei khuotuo ding mi ka sui a, ahi vangin koima a om sih hi; ei henem ding mi ka sui a, ahi vangin koima ka mu sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in an tangin gu ei pie vua, ka dangta ciengin dawn ding tuithua ei pie uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:48; Mrk 15:36; Luk 23:36; Jhn 19:28-29"},"22":{"text":"Amahaw adingin a sabuoi uh thang suohsah inlen, a kipawlpite adingin piel suohsah in."},"23":{"text":"Amate in a mu thei lo dingin a mit uh mielsah inlen, a tawntungin a kawng uh kithingsah in.","ref":"Rom 11:9-10"},"24":{"text":"Amate tungah na lungthahna sungsuh inlen, tuale nangma’ sinsona in amate bansah in."},"25":{"text":"Amau’ giephuol gamkhing suohsah in; a puonbuh sung vuah koima tengsah sin.","ref":"Sawl 1:20"},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in na satgawp mite a bawlsie vua, tuale na liemsah mite zong a sim sawnsawn uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amau’ khielna tungah khielna belap in; amate in nang kung panin suotahna nga sih ta uheh."},"28":{"text":"A hingte’ laibu sung panin amate kiphietmang taheh; midihte lahah a min uh kikhum sih heh.","ref":"Pei 32:32; Kln 3:5; 13:8; 17:8"},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima ei kiniem bawl a, na ka sa hi; Pasien aw, na hutdamna in keima ei dalsah in."},"30":{"text":"Keima in la tawh Pasien’ min ka phat ding hi; keima in lungdamkona tawh ama ka liensah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tami in bawngtang khat, ahi sihle ki le kecin tawh bawngtang khat sangin Topa lungdamsah zaw ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawlsietna a thuoh mite in tam thu mu-in kipah ta uheh;
