no Pasien a sui mite aw, na lungsim nosuosah kia un."},"33":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in mi cimawte’ aw za a, hentat kolbul a thuoh a mite don loin a om sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Vantung le leitung, tuipi le tuate sunga a gamta thei zosiete in ama phat ta uheh."},"35":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien in Zion a hundam a, tuale Judah khuopite a lamkia ding hi; tua sungah a nasemte tengin a luo ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"A nasemte’ tate in tua khu a luo ding vua, tua sungah ama’ min a it mite a teng ding uhi."}}},"70":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, nei hutkhiet ding hing lungkim mai in. Topa aw, keima ei panpi meng in!","title":"Galte Pana Hutkhiet nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Tha dinga ka hinna a suite maizumin buoimang sah in. Ka siet nading a dei mite nuakinin mindaisah in."},"3":{"text":"“Ha, Ha!” a ci mite a maizumna ziehun kilesah in."},"4":{"text":"Nang ang suite zosie nangma sungah lungdamin kipah uheh. Na hutdamna a it mite in, “Pasien lien hi!” ci den ta uheh."},"5":{"text":"Hinanle kei zawngin ka cimaw hi; Pasien aw, hing kinaw ta’n! Nang keima ei hupa le ei hunkhie pa na hi hi; Topa aw, hing kiheh vawt sin!"}}},"71":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang kang bel hi; kei ei maizumsah ngai sin.","title":"Khantan Hutkhietna le Panpi ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Na dihna sungah ei hun inlen ei suohtasah in; na bil kei lam ei ngat inlen, ei hundam in."},"3":{"text":"Kei adingin ka buhna suongpi, ka kulpi muonhuoi hing hi inlen, ei hundam in, azieh pen ka suongpi le ka kulpi na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, migilote’ khut sung pan le mi thuman lote le mi gawgamte’ matna panin ei hunkhie in."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa aw, ka kinepna nang na hi a, ka khangno lai-a kipanin ka kimuonna nang na hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka suo cil a kipanin na tungah kang kingam hi; ka nu gil sung panin keima ei ladawh pa na hi hi. Nangma kang phat ngitnget hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei pen mi tampite adingin a siehil bang ka hi a, hinanle nang a muonhuoi ka kibuhna na hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma phatna tawh ka kam kidim a, sunthapai-in nangma’ minthanna tawh a kidim hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka vuoi ciengin kei ei paidawh sin; ka tha a kieh ciengin kei ei nuasie sin."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen ka galte in keima’ thu a gen vua, ei thatnuomin ei vil mite a kikumkum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in, “Pasien in a nuasiesa tua mipa del unlen, man un, azieh pen ama hunkhie ding koima a om sih hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Pasien aw, keima kung panin gamla op sin; ka Pasien aw, kei ei hu dingin hing mallang in!"},"13":{"text":"Kei ei mawsahte maizumsah inlen, kisiesah in; keima’ siet nading a suite, simmawna le mindaina in tuomcip taheh."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle keima in nang kang lamen den ding a, nangma kang phat semsem lai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na dih gamtatnate le na hutdamna nasepnate, ka thei zawh lo za dongin tam tama nan leh, sunthapai-in ka kam in a gengen ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa Pasien’ a thupi nasepte a phat dingin kang pei ding a, keima in na dihna thu beh genin ka nei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien aw, nang in ka khangno lai-a kipanin thu nei hil zo a, keima in na nasepna lamdangte ka gengen lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien aw, keima in ang khang lai ding khangtha zosie kungah na hatna ka pholah masangin, kei vuoi-in ka sam a kan cieng nangawnin ei nuasie vawt sin. Pasien aw, na vanglietna"},"19":{"text":"le na dihna in van sangpite tung dong banto hi. Na lienpite a sem zo Pasien aw, nang tawh kibang koi om ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Gimna le tuosietna tampi ei musah nang in kei nei hingsahkia ding hi; nangma in lei thuhpite sung panin keima nei lakhie to ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima ei kizatahna na khangsah ding a, tuale nangma in khatvei keima nei henemkia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, na thumanna ziehin harp lasahna tawh nangma kang phat ding hi; Israel-te’ Siengpen Pa aw, keima in lyre lasahna tawh na min kang phat ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Nangma phatna ka sah ciengin lungdamin ka nephute awng ding hi; na hutkhietsa ka hlagau zong lungdamin a awng ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka siet nadinga a hanciemte kimaizumsahin a kiminsietsah zo ziehin, ka leii in sunthapai-in nangma in dihna tawh nei huna a gengen ding hi."}}},"72":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma’ thutang, kumpipa pie inlen, nangma’ thumanna kumpipa’ tapa tungah pie in.","title":"Lamlahna le Kumpipa Panpi nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in dihna tawh na mite thukhen hinlen, na mizawngte, thutang tawh thukhen heh."},"3":{"text":"Muol le tangte in thudih tawh mite adingin citheina piengsah taheh."},"4":{"text":"Ama in mite lahah mizawngte vai panpi hinlen, mi cimawte hutkhietna pie-in, mi bawlsie pa tuoncil taheh."},"5":{"text":"Ni le hla a op laisie khang tawntungin ama hing taheh."},"6":{"text":"Ama lopa vatsa tunga a kie, lei a tapnom guotui bang taheh."},"7":{"text":"Ama’ hun sungin dihna pung hinlen, hlapi a om nawn lo dongin nopna om taheh."},"8":{"text":"Ama in tuipi khat pan tuipi khat, Gunpi panin leimong dongin uhna nei taheh.","ref":"Zech 9:10"},"9":{"text":"Ama mai-ah a galte lukun uh hinlen, a galte in leivui lieh ta uheh."},"10":{"text":"Tarshish kumpite le tuikul neu-a kumpite in ama tungah sieh le kaihte pie uh hinlen, Sheba le Seba kumpite in letsongte puoh ta uheh."},"11":{"text":"A mai-ah kumpite zosie khupboh uh hinlen, minam zosie in ama’ na sem ta uheh."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen mi tasamte in a hlat ciengin ama in hunkhie a, a hu ding nei lo mizawngte hunkhie hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in thanem le a tasamte hepi a, mi tasamte’ hinna hundam hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama muna-ah amau’ sisan manphasa ahi ziehin, bawlsietna le tatsietna panin ama in a hinna uh tankhie hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama khansau taheh! Ama tungah Sheba khamte kipie taheh. Ama adingin thu kingetpieh zing hinlen, ama dingin sunthapai-in thupha kingetpieh zing taheh."},"16":{"text":"Tua gam sungah an tampi pieng taheh; muol sangte dawnah ante kivihin, a gate zong Lebanon gam sunga bangin hoi thei taheh; tuale gamlah lopate bangin khuopi sung mite khanpha uheh."},"17":{"text":"Ama’ min kip zing ta hinlen, ni a om laisie-in ama’ minthanna om suoh den taheh. Ama’ sungah minam zosie in thupha nga ta uheh; amate in ama thupha nga pa, ci ta uheh."},"18":{"text":"Na lamdang bawl pa ama beh, Israel Pasien Topa in thupha nga taheh."},"19":{"text":"A minthang ama’ min in kumtawnin thupha nga taheh; ama’ minthanna tawh leitung buppi kidim taheh."},"20":{"text":"Jessi’ tapa David’ thungetnate a tawp ahi ta hi."}}},"73":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungsim siengtho-in a thumante tungah Topa hoi tahpi hi.","title":"BU THUMNA (Late 73–89) Mi Bawlsiete Kungpan Noptuom nading Thumna"},"2":{"text":"Hizongle kei ka hi leh ka keng a kisuipua dihtah hi; ka keng zong a kitawnkhaw dihtah hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in migilote daupeina ka mu a; keima in mi kiliensahte ka eng hi;"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in natna kici nei loin, a pumpite uh cidamin a zol sipsep uhi."},"5":{"text":"Midangte bangin amate in hahsatna a thuoh sih uhi; amate in mite bangin gimna a thuoh sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amau’ khi pen kiphatsahna ahi hi; tatsietna in puon bangin amate a tuom hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate ahile a thau sengin a mitkhu uh puoh a, a lungtangte uzong motna tawh a dimlet hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in mi thusim loin, kimudana kam a ham uhi; amate in kihisahna tawh bawlsiet dingin mi a galgih uhi."},"9":{"text":"A kamte un vantung gensie a, a leiite un leitung bup tuomcip hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mite kihei-in amate a phat vua, amate sungah mawna kici a mu sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in, “Pasien in bang a ci thei ding ahei? Sangpen Pa in theina a nei beh diei mah?” a ci uhi"},"12":{"text":"Migilote tam bang ahi uhi; a nop a thei-in a om vua, hauna lamah amate a khang semsem uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka lungtang ka siensahna, le genbang lona-a khut ka silna teng a unpi-in amawhna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in sunthapai-in gimna ka thuoh a, tuale zingmawng sielin dan ei kituohsah hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tam bangin gen vang,” ci leng, na tate tungah a thutah lo ka suoh ta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam thu bangci theitel ding ka hei ci-in ka ngaisut ciengin, keima’ gim nading bep khat hi tuoh ka sa lel a,"},"17":{"text":"Pasien’ mun siengtho sung dongah ka va lut cieng behin, amau’ manthaina ding thu ka tel pan na bo hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangma in a nalna munah amahaw na koi tahpi hi; nang in kisie-a a pua dingin amahaw na bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate bangci kisuhsiet a, zauna in amahaw a bangci tawmang dawh a ta diei!"},"20":{"text":"Amahaw pen zan mangmat tawh a kibang lel uhi; ang thawkia ciengun nang in a mangmat uh na thupisim ta sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka lungkhamin ka lungtang ei kisun bangin a nat ciengin,"},"22":{"text":"ka maw dawh ta a, bangma ka thei sih hi; na tungah kei pen gamsa gilo tawh ka kibang hi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle kei pen nang tawh ka omton ngitnget hi; nang in ka zietlam khut nei tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Nang in thuhilna tawh nei pui a, a nua ciengin patawina tawh nei sangkia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Nang simlo vantungah koi ka nei ahei? Nang sanga ka lunggul zawh ding leitungah bangma om lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka tahsa le ka lungtang zawngkhal mai thei a, hizongle Pasien pen ka lungsim hatna le keima’ satanh ahi zing hi."},"27":{"text":"Nang tawh kigamla mite kisie tahtah ding uhi; nang in na tunga ang khielte na mangthaisah sieng hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanle kei adingin ahile Pasien tawh ka kinai a hoi hi; nangma’ nasepna zosie ka gen thei nadingin Topa Pasien pen ka kibuhna-in ka bawl zo hi."}}},"74":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, bang dinga kote ei paimang zing ta na hei? Lonona muna na tuute tungah bang dingin meikhu bangin na lungthahna omsah na hei?","title":"Minam Maizum Hun Cienga Panpi Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Tanglai-a na neisa na mihonte, nangma’ gouluo minam dinga na tatkhietsate phawh in. Nangma’ ten nading Zion muol khu hing phawh bo in."},"3":{"text":"Kumtawn sietna-ah hing kalsuon in; galte in mun siengtho sunga na zosie susie zo ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Na mun siengtho sungah na galte hawh vapuoh hi; amate in khum sungah a melcina uh limte a khai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in tunglam lutna-a kidaw singlangte heipi tawh a phua uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kizem na zosie heipi le sehta tawh a satguoi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in na mun siengtho mei tawh a hal uhi; amate in lei dongin na min kisuonna mun zosie a buasah sieng ta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in, “Tuate i zo mang ding uhi,” a kici uhi; amate in gam sunga kikhopna mun zosie a halmang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kote in melcinate ka mu sih uhi; kamsang khat zong om nawn loin, bang tanvei sawt ding, ci-a a thei kote lahah koima a om sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien aw, galte in bang tanvei ciemmuina-in ei nei ding uh ahei? Na galte in kumtawnin na min a gensiet ding uh a ta amah?"},"11":{"text":"Bang dingin na khut dawhkia-in; bang dingin na kang sungah na khut koi na hei?"},"12":{"text":"Hizongle tanglai-a kipanin Pasien pen leitungah hutdamna na a sem ka Kumpipa ahi ta bo hi."},"13":{"text":"Nang in vanglietna tawh tuipi na phalsuo hi; nang in tuite tunga gulpi’ lutangte na satguoi hi.","ref":"Pei 14:21"},"14":{"text":"Nang in Leviathan’ lutangte na satguoipieh hi; senel gam ganhingte’ an dingin ama na pie hi.","ref":"Job 41:1; Late 104:26; Isa 27:1"},"15":{"text":"Nangma in tuisam le tuinahte na phulsah hi; nangma in luitui luonglaite na kangsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Sun khu nang-a’ ahi a, zan zong khu nang-a’ ma ahi hi; a tang thei nate le ni zong nangma’ phusa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma in leitung gamgi zosie na hlung zo hi; nangma in phalbi hun le khal hun na bawl zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa aw, galte ang nuisat dan le Pasien zatah lo mite in na min ang gensietna uh hing phawh ta’n."},"19":{"text":"Na vakhu’ hinna khu gamsate lahah pie sin; na mizawngte’ hinkhuo hing mangngil zing sin."},"20":{"text":"Na thuciemna hing thupisim in, bangzieh ahei cile leitunga a mielna munte, mi tatsiete’ zuolna mun suoh ta hi."},"21":{"text":"A kituoncil mite maizumsah sin; mizawng le mi cimawte in na min phatsah in."},"22":{"text":"Pasien aw, hing thoto inlen, na thu a dihin hing khen in; Pasien zatah lote in sunthapai-in ang gensietna uh phawh in."},"23":{"text":"Na galte kikona aw mangngil sinlen, ang langpante’ husa ging ang kato zing hi."}}},"75":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, na tungah nuomthu kang tut uhi; na min ang nai ahi ziehin nuomthu kang tut uhi. Mite in nangma’ silbawl lamdangte a gen uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Silbawl Lamdangte zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Ka sesa hun ang tun ciengin keima in a manin thu ka khen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitung le a tunga tengte zosie a kithin ciengin, a khuompite a tudet pa khu keima ka hi hi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte tungah, “Kiphasah sih un,” ka ci a, tuale migilote kungah, “Kidomsang sih un;"},"5":{"text":"na ki uh domsang sih unlen, ahi sihle ngawng vaipuohsa-in ham sih un,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile lapsangna pen nisuona lam pan ahi a, nitumna lam pan ahi a, gamlah pan ahi zongin ang pei ahi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin thukhen pa pen Pasien ahi bo a, ama in mi khat niemkhiehin, adang khat a lamsang hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa’ khut sungah hoitah a kisawpawisa a phuon dildel lenggazu hai khat a om hi; ama in tua sung panin ang bungsuh ding a, tuale leitung migilo zosie in a dopkheng dongin a dawn ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hizongle kei ka kipah zing ding hi; keima in Jacob Pasien kungah phatna late ka sa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in migilote’ hatna zosie ka tansanpieh ding a, hinanle midihte’ hatna kidomsang ding hi."}}},"76":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah gam sungah Pasien kithei a, Israel gam sungah ama’ min lien hi.","title":"Israel’ Pasien-Leitung Zosie’ Thukhenpa"},"2":{"text":"Salem khuo-ah ama’ om nading kilam a, Zion khuopi sungah ama’ tenna mun a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in tua tahah a te lihleh thaltang lengte, lum, namsau, le galhiemte a hliehtawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Na min thang mama a, kumtawna om muolte sangin nang na thupizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihangsante’ vante kilahpieh hi; amate a kimutsuoh gawp uhi; galkapte koima khat beh in a khut uh a lam zo ta sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Jacob Pasien aw, nangma’ hosietna ziehin sakol le a tunga tuong tegel in khuo a phawh tuoh ta sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang na hi leh na zatahhuoi tahtah hi! Nang na lungthah nah leh na mai-ah koi ding ngam ding ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Vantung panin thukhenna na genkhie hi; leitunga bawlsietna a thuoh mi zosiete hundam dinga thukhen dingin na din ciengin leitung zau-in sip dide hi. Selah","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Mihing’ thangpaina pen nangma phatna-in kizang ding a, na lungthahna dangte pen na kawnga na kiga ding ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasien tungah kiciemnate bawl unlen, tuate tangtun un; ama’ kimvela a om mi zosie in a zatahhuoi mipa tungah letsongte puoh ta uheh!"},"12":{"text":"ama in gam-uhte’ lungsim suniem a, leitung kumpite sungah zauna a guon hi."}}},"77":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien kungah keima a gingin ka kiko a, ama in ei zah nadingin a gingin ka kiko hi.","title":"Pasien’ Nasep Liente Phawna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungkham hunin Topa ka sui hi; keima in zanlai-in gim vawt loin ka khut ka zah hi; ka hlagau a kihenem zo sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasien ka ngaisun a, tuale ka maumau hi; thu ka lungngaingai ciengin ka lung a gim mama hi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Nangma in a mit sing dingin keima nei koi sih hi; ka lung a kham sengin ka ham thei va-ia sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Hun luite ka ngaisun a, nidang lai hunte ka phawh hi."},"6":{"text":"Zanthapai-in ka lungsimah ka kihoho a, lung gelgelin ka lungsim ka kankan hi:"},"7":{"text":"“ Topa in ei nuol peisuohin, maipha ei piekia ngai nawn lo ding amah?"},"8":{"text":"Ama’ itna kip a tawp suoh ta amah? Ama’ thuciemte zong a maimang suoh ta amah?"},"9":{"text":"Mi lungsiet ding Pasien in a mangngil ta amah? Ama lungthahin a lainatna a khahtan ta amah?” ka ci hi. Selah"},"10":{"text":"Keima in, “Sangpen Pa’ zietlam khut a kikhelna khu keima’ gimna ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka lungsim sungah Topa’ silbawlte ka phawh ding hi; hun lui lai-a na bawl sil lamdangte ka phawh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na nasepna zosie ka lungngaingai ding a, tuale a lien na silbawlte ka ngaisunsun ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien aw, na lampi a siengtho hi. Eite Pasien za-a a lien bang pasien om ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Nang na lamdangte a bawl Pasien na hi hi; nang in mite lahah na vanglietna na lah zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang in na banhat tawh Jacob le Joseph’ suon na mite na tankhie zo hi. Selah"},"16":{"text":"Pasien aw, tuite in nangma ang mu ciengun, tuite in ang mu ciengun a zau uhi; tui thuhpi zong a ling hi."},"17":{"text":"Meiite in tui buosuh hi; vante zong to hi; nangma’ thaltangte zong muncin tengah a leng hi."},"18":{"text":"Pumpei sungah na vanto gingpi a om hi; na tunphete in leitung tanvah hi; leitung kilawhin a ling hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuipi tung tawnin lam na hla a, nangma’ lampi pen tuihuolpite tung ahi hi; hinanle na ketotte kimu lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma in tuuhonte bangin Moses le Aaron’ khut tawh na mite na pui hi."}}},"78":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka mite aw, kang thuhilna ngai un; ka kam tawh ka gen thute na bil ei ngat un.","title":"Pasien’ Hoina le Israel’ Lungdam Thei lona"},"2":{"text":"Keima in thugentena zangin ka kam ka kah ding hi;","ref":"Mat 13:35"},"3":{"text":"i pu i pate in ei gensa, eite in zong i zah i theisa uh, tanglai-a a kigen thuthuhte kang genkhie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Eite in a tate kungah tua thute i im sih ding hi; eite in ang pieng lai ding khang thate tungah Topa’ minthan nasepnate, ama’ vanglietna le a sepsa sil lamdangte i gen ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Jacob’ suonte tungah thupiehna khat bawl a, Israel mite tungah thukham khat koi hi;"},"6":{"text":"tua khu amau’ zaw-a ang khangte le ang suoh nai lo naupangte in thei a, amate in a tate tunga a gensawn thei nading uh ahi hi,"},"7":{"text":"tuaci’n amate in a muonna uh Pasien sungah a nga ding uhi; tuale Pasien’ nasepnate mangngil loin, ama’ thupiehte a zui ding uhi;"},"8":{"text":"amate, a lungkhau a ledo khang mite, Pasien tunga lungsim kip nei lo, lungsim muonhuoi lo khang mite ahi, a pu a pate utawh a kibang sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ephraim-te in thalpi a tawi vua, gal kido ni-in amate a nuakia sieng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ thuciemna a zui sih vua, ama’ thukham tawh kituohin amate a gamta nuom sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in a bawlsa le amate tunga a lahsa na lamdangte a mangngil uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a pu a pate’ mu-in Egypt gam sung Zoan munte-ah sil lamdangte a bawl hi.","ref":"Pei 7:8–12:32"},"13":{"text":"Ama in tuipi kikhen sahin, amate a kantansah a, tuite a lompi-in a dingsah hi.","ref":"Pei 14:21-22"},"14":{"text":"Ama in sun hunin meiipi khat tawh ahi a, zanthapai-in meikuong khat tawh ahi zongin amate a pui hi.","ref":"Pei 13:21-22"},"15":{"text":"Ama in senel gama suongpite pawhkeh sah a, ama in tuili thuh pana tui luong bangin, amau’ dawn dingin tui tampitah a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in suongpi panin luituite luongsah a, tuale guntui luong bangin tuite a luongsah hi.","ref":"Pei 17:1-7; Gam 20:2-13"},"17":{"text":"Hinanle ama tungah amate a maw lai veve vua, senel gam sungah Sangpen Pa a ledo uhi."},"18":{"text":"A du mama uh an a ngen vua, a lungsim sung vuah Pasien a zelah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in Pasien a gensie vua, “Pasien in senel gam sungah sabuoi a pha thei amah?"},"20":{"text":"Tui a phul thei nadingin ama in suongpite satin luituite a luonsah mawh vangin, a mite adingin an zong pie-in sa zong a sih zo ngap ding amah,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tua thu a zah ciengin, a nah lungthah mama hi; Jacob tungah mei kitaw a, Israel tungah ama lungthah semsem hi,"},"22":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile amate in Pasien a um sih vua, ama’ hutdamna vanglietna a muong sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in tung lama om vante thu pie-in ama in van kotte a hong hi;"},"24":{"text":"amau’ neh dingin guo bangin manna zusah a, vantung an a pie hi.","ref":"Jhn 6:31"},"25":{"text":"Mihingte in vantung mite’ an a ne uhi; ama in amate an tampitah a puoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in vantungah nisuona hui langsah a, ama’ vanglietna tawh leitaw lam hui a peikhietpi hi;"},"27":{"text":"Ama in amate tungah leivui za-a a tam sa guo bangin zusah a, tuipi senel za-a a tam a leng thei vate guo bangin zusah hi;"},"28":{"text":"ama in amau’ giephuol sung, amau’ tenna kim zosie-ah tuate a kiesah hi;"},"29":{"text":"ama in a dugaw pen uh pie zo ahi ziehin, amate in ne-in a gilva uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hizongle amau’ du pen a kham masang uh, a kam sung vuah tua an a op laitahin,"},"31":{"text":"amate tungah Pasien’ lungthahna tung a, tuale ama in amate sung panin a thahat pen teng that a, paapal tawh a kibang Israel muon le suon teng a vatmai hi.","ref":"Pei 16:2-15; Gam 11:4-23, 31-35"},"32":{"text":"Tam bangin pieng hi tama le amate a maw lailai uhi; amate in ama’ silbawl lamdangte a um tuon sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a nite uh husan khat bangin a mangthai dingin bawl a, a khankumte uzong zauna tawh a mangthai dingin a bawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in amate a tha ciengin, amate in ama a sui pan na bo uhi; amate a kisiekia vua, lunglut tahin Pasien a sui uhi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in Pasien pen amau’ suongpi, a tankhie Sangpen Pasien ahi lam a phawh uhi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanle amate in a kampi utawh ama a phat uhi; amate in a leii utawh ama tungah zuouthu a gen uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ama tungah a lungsim uh a kip sih hi; ama’ thuciemna-ah amate a tahtai sih uhi.","ref":"Sawl 8:21"},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in lainatna lungsim a nei ziehin, amau’ khielnate a maisah a, amate a susie sih hi; ama in khat veivei a lungthahna ip zelzel a, a thangpaina zosie a phong sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate mihing hi lel a, ang peikia nawn lo huilang bang ahina uh ama in a phawh hi."},"40":{"text":"Amate in gamlahah bang zavei khat ama ledo-in, senel gam sungah lunggimsah uh ahei!"},"41":{"text":"Amate in Pasien a zelah thithe vua, Israel’ Siengtho Pa a phinphin uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in ama’ vanglietna hile, ahi sihle ama in a galte panin amate a tatkhietna ni hile, a phawh kha vawt sih uhi;"},"43":{"text":"ama in Egypt gam sunga a lah a sil lamdangte hile, Zoan gam sunga a bawl a na lamdangte hile a phawh kha vawt sih uhi."},"44":{"text":"Amate in a luituite uh a dawn thei lo nadingun, ama in a guntuite uh sisan a suohsah hi.","ref":"Pei 7:17-21"},"45":{"text":"Ama in amate lahah a pet thei tho honpite, a susie thei uphawhte, amate lahah a sawl hi.","ref":"Pei 8:1-6, 20-24"},"46":{"text":"Khuombai neh dingin ama in amau’ ante a pie a, amau’ sepsa gate zong kauphe neh dingin a pie hi.","ref":"Pei 10:12-15"},"47":{"text":"Ama in a lengguite uh gielpi tawh susie-in, a theithehte uh vuakhal tawh a suhsietpieh hi."},"48":{"text":"Ama in a bawngte uh gielpi in khiehlia sah a, a tuuhonte uzong keh in a khiehlia sah hi.","ref":"Pei 9:22-25"},"49":{"text":"Amate tungah a zauhuoi a lungthahna, a thangpaina, a lungkimlona, a lunggimna, le a susie thei vantung mite honkhat ama in hla hi."},"50":{"text":"Ama in a lungthah nading lampi khat a bawl hi; ama in sina panin amate hinkhawi loin, pul natna-ah amate a pie sieng hi."},"51":{"text":"Ama in Egypt tacil zosie le Ham’ puonbuhte sunga amau’ hatna tawh a pieng ta masa teng a vatmai hi.","ref":"Pei 12:29"},"52":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a mite tuu bangin peipi a, tuuhon bangin senel gamah amate lam a pui hi.","ref":"Pei 13:17-22"},"53":{"text":"Ama in muonhuoina munah amate a pui ziehin a zau sih uhi; ahi vangin tuipi in a galte a hlummang hi.","ref":"Pei 14:26-28"},"54":{"text":"Tuale a zietlam khut tawh a zawsa muol ahi, ama’ muol siengtho tungah amate a peipi hi.","ref":"Pei 15:17; Josh 3:14-17"},"55":{"text":"Ama in amau mai-ah minamte a notmang hi; ama in amate luo dingin neisate a hawmpieh a, a puonbuh sung vuah Israel minamte a tengsah hi.","ref":"Josh 11:16-23"},"56":{"text":"Hinanle amate in Sangpen Pasien zelahin ledo uhi. Amate in ama’ thupieh a zui sih vua,","ref":"Thkn 2:11-15"},"57":{"text":"a pu a pate uh ma bangun kihei-in a thuman sih uhi; a lelama a leng thaltang bangin amate a lampiel uhi."},"58":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a munsangte utawh amate in ama a lungthahsah uhi; amate in a milimte utawh ama’ hazat nadingin a phongkang uhi."},"59":{"text":"Pasien in a zah ciengin, ama thangpai mama a, tuale ama in Israel mite a pumnuol kiukeu hi."},"60":{"text":"Ama in mihingte lahah ama’ opna puonbuh ahi, Shiloh-a ama’ tenna nuasie-in","ref":"Josh 18:1; Jer 7:12-14; 26:6"},"61":{"text":"tuale ama in ama’ vanglietna pen sal suoh dingin a pie a, ama’ minthanna zong galte’ khut sungah a pie ta hi.","ref":"1Sam 4:4-22"},"62":{"text":"Ama in a mite namsau pie a, tuale gamhluo pa tungah a lungthahna a gen hi."},"63":{"text":"Mei in a tangvalte katum a, tuale a numeite un mopawi-a sah ding la a nei sih uhi."},"64":{"text":"A siempute uh, namsau in puasah a, a meigong numeite un zong kaateng a lo sih uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tua ciengin kimutna panin Topa khanglo a, galhang zukham pa bangin a awng vapo hi."},"66":{"text":"Ama in a galte a zo gawp hi; ama in a maizum zing dingin amate koi hi."},"67":{"text":"Ama in Joseph’ puonbuh nuol a, Ephraim minamte a teel sih hi."},"68":{"text":"Hizongle ama in a it Zion Muol, Judah minamte a teel hi."},"69":{"text":"Ama in a kip den dingin a phusa leitung bang le, a sang vantungte bangin a mun siengtho a lam hi."},"70":{"text":"Ama in a nasem David teel a, tuuhuongte panin ama a la hi."},"71":{"text":"Ama’ mi Jacob, ama’ gouluo Israel-te tungah tuu banga a cing dingin ama in tuupi tasen neite a cinna panin ama a la hi.","ref":"1Sam 16:11-12; 2Sam 7:8; 1Khg 17:7"},"72":{"text":"Ama in thuman lungsim tawh amate a cing a, a khutsiemna tawh amate lam a pui hi."}}},"79":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, na gouluo gam sungah minamte ang lut hi; amate in na biehinn siengtho a buasah gawp uhi; amate in Jerusalem khuopi a kisiesah gawp uhi.","title":"Jerusalem Hepi nading Thumna","ref":"2Kum 25:8-10; 2Khg 36:17-19; Jer 52:12-14"},"2":{"text":"Amate in hui lahah a leng vate neh dingin, na nasemte’ luonghawmte a pie vua, na mi muonhuoite’ sate zong leitung gamsate a pie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in Jerusalem kimkotah sisan tui bangin a buo vua, tuale amate a vui ding koima a om sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote zong khu ka vengte uh’ zako, ka kim vua om mite’ simmaw le nuisat ka hi ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt lai ding na hei? A lungthah den ding na hi amah? Na hazat thangpaina mei banga kuong ding ahi amah?"},"6":{"text":"Nangma ang thei lo minamte tung le na min ang hlan lo kumpi gamte tungah nangma’ lungthahna sungsuh in."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in Jacob a valtum vua, ama’ tenna mun a susie gawp uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh’ mawnate, kote tungah ei phul sin; kote kang kiniemkhieh ziehun na lainatna hing tungsah meng in."},"9":{"text":"Ka hutdamna uh Pasien aw, nangma’ minthanna dingin kote ei hu in; na min na khuolna-in ei hunkhie inlen, ka mawnate uh zong ei ngaidam in."},"10":{"text":"Minamte in bang dingin, “A Pasien uh hei-ah a om ta ahei?” ci thei poma ding uh ahei? Na nasemte’ sisan phu na lahna, minam dangte lah, koma’ muna-ah kitheisah in."},"11":{"text":"Nangma mai-ah thongkiete’ tauna hing tung hinlen, na vanglietna tawh kizui-in, a si dinga kikoi mite suohtasah in."},"12":{"text":"Amate in nang ang zakona ma utawh ka vengte’ kang sungah a za sagi-in thuh in, Topa aw!"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ko nangma’ mite, na lonona sunga tuute in na tungah lungdam kang ko zing ding uhi; kote in a khang khangin nangma phatnate ka simkiakia ding uhi."}}},"80":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuuhonte banga Joseph a pui, Israel a cingpa aw, ngai in! Cherub-te tunga a to nang pa aw,","title":"Israel a Ngaingai a Bahkia ding Thungetna","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"2":{"text":"Ephraim, Benjamin le Manasseh mai-ah hing tangkhie in. Na tha san inlen ei hun dingin hing pei in!"},"3":{"text":"Ka ngaingai uh ei bangsah kia in, Pasien aw; hutdam ka hi thei nadingun na mai hing tangsah in."},"4":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, na mite thungetna-ah nang bang tanvei lungthah ding na hei?"},"5":{"text":"Nangma in amate hlitui an tawh na vah zo a, amate dawn dingin hlitui a dimin na pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma in ka vengte’ simmaw dingin kote nei bawl hi; ka galte un amahaw lahah kohaw nuizat nopna-in ei nei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ngaingai uh ei bangsah kia in, Vanglien Pasien aw; hutdam ka hi thei nadingun na mai hing tangsah in."},"8":{"text":"Nangma in Egypt panin lenggui khat nang puo hi; nang in minamte na notdawh a, tua khu na suon hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma in tuami adingin leitang na paw sieng hi; tuami in zung thuh hing hla-in gam sung teng a dim hi."},"10":{"text":"A hlim in muolte a khu a, a bazaute in zong taamtah singkung golte a khu hi;"},"11":{"text":"tuipi lamah a bate zam a, a dawnngehte in Gunpi lam zuon hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin lampi-a pei mi zosie in ama’ ga a law thei nadingin, bang dingin a daithawte na suhsietpieh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Gamlahah a om ngal in tua khu a susie gawp a, gam sunga om ganhing zosie in kivana-in a nei uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hing kilekia in, Vanglien Pasien aw; vantung panin ei ensuh inlen ei mu in; tami lenggui don in,"},"15":{"text":"tua khu nangma’ zietlam khut tawh na suonsa ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in mei tawh halin, a phuamat sieng uhi; nangma’ thangpai etna ziehin amate kisiesah in."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle nang dinga na hatsah, na zietlam a om mipa tungah na khut ngam in."},"18":{"text":"Tua hile na kung panin ka kiheikia nawn sih ding uhi; kote hinna ei pie in, tua hile nangma’ min kang hlan ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, ka ngaingai uh ei bangsahkia in; hutdam ka hi thei nadingun na mai hing tangsah in."}}},"81":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I thahatna ahi Pasien tungah nahpitahin la sa un; Jacob’ Pasien tungah lungdamin awng un.","title":"A Lungkhau Israel Tunga Pasien’ Kutna"},"2":{"text":"La sa-in tawm tum unlen, a ngaih lyre lasahna le harp tum un."},"3":{"text":"Hla tha ni, hlalia ni, i pawi ni-in pengkul tum un.","ref":"Gam 10:10"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen tami khu Israel adingin thukham ahi a, Jacob Pasien’ biehna ngaina a kip khat ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gam sunga a pei lai-in ama in Joseph tungah thupiehna khat a bawl hi. Keima in ka thei ngai lo aw khat ka za hi:"},"6":{"text":"“Keima in a liengko vua vangih ka zangsah hi; na khutte un zong law a dom nawn sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lungkham uh ciengin keima nei hlan vua, keima in note kang hunkhie hi; a kilang lo vanto sung panin note kang dawng hi; keima in Meribah tuite ah note kang zelah hi. Selah","ref":"Pei 17:7; Gam 20:13"},"8":{"text":"Ka mite aw, kang thuhil laitahin za un; Israel-te aw, keima’ thu ngai locin ci tei ing e!"},"9":{"text":"Note lahah pasien dang a om sih ding hi; gamdang pasien mai-ah na kun sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:2-3; Thkna 5:6-7"},"10":{"text":"Kei pen Egypt gam panin note ang peipi to, na Topa Pasien uh ka hi hi. Na kam uh golkah un, keima in kang dim ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Hinanle ka mite in ka thugen a ngai sih uhi; keima tungah Israel-te ang kipha sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nop banga gamta dingin a lungkhauna sung vuah amate ka ap ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite in ka thu ei ngai hinlen, Israel-te in ka lampi zui uleh izaw!"},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in a galte uh mallangin ka zawpi ding a, a galte uh’ langkhatah ka khuttum ka ziel ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa a mudate in ama mai-ah a thum ding vua, amau’ gimthuohna zong a kip peisuoh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangbu tuituoh pen tawh note kang vah ding a, suongpi pana khuoizu tawh kang lungtaisah ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"82":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantung thu kikupna sungah Pasien in a panmun a la hi; pasien-te laikimah ama in thu a khen hi:","title":"Thutan nading Kutna"},"2":{"text":"“Note in bang tanvei a man lopi-in thukhenin, migilote tungah angvanna lah ding na hi uh ahei? Selah"},"3":{"text":"Mi thanemte le pa nei lote tungah a dihin thu khen un; mizawngte le tasamte’ nga ding hamphatna kepcingpieh un."},"4":{"text":"Mi thanemte le tasamte suohtasah un; migilote khut sung panin amate hunkhie un,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in theina hile, theitelna hile a nei sih vua, tuate khuomiel sungah a gamtat ziehun leitung bulpite zosie a kilinglawng hi."},"6":{"text":"Ke’n, “Note pasien-te na hi vua, na unpi-un Sangpen Pa’ tate na hi uhi;","ref":"Jhn 10:34"},"7":{"text":"hizongle mite bangin na si ding vua, ulien khatpo bangin na pua ding uhi,” kang ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien aw, hing thoto inlen, leitung thukhen in; azieh pen minam zosie nangma-a’ ahi hi!"}}},"83":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, dai dide-in om sin; lungnuomin sip dide sin, Pasien aw!","title":"Israel’ Galte Tunga Thukhen ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Tu nangawnin na galte in buoina a bawl uhi; nang ang mudate in a lu a pongsah uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ngienkawi tawh na mite a lebawl uhi; amate in na kepcing mite langpangin a kikum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in, “Hing pei un, amate, minam khat hina panin phietmang vai; Israel’ min kici mawngmawng kiphawhsah nawn sih vai,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate kithu khatin a kihosim uhi; nang hing langpangin thuciemna khat a bawl uhi,"},"6":{"text":"Edom’ puonbuhte le Ishmael-te, Moab-te le Hagri-te,"},"7":{"text":"Gebal le Ammon, le Amalek-te, Philistia-te le Tyre-a mite tawh ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Assyria-te in zong amate a pawlpi uhi; Lot’ suonlehlahte adingin pawl muonhuoite ahi uhi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Midian-te tung, le Kishon Lui-a Sisera le Jabin-te tunga na bawl bangin amate tungah zong bawl in,","ref":"Thkn 4:6-22; 7:1-23"},"10":{"text":"amate En-dor-ah kisusie a, amate leilahah eh a suoh uhi."},"11":{"text":"A miliente uh Oreb le Zeeb bangsah inlen, a lamkaite zosie uh Zebah le Zalmunna bangsah in.","ref":"Thkn 7:25; 8:12"},"12":{"text":"“Pasien’ lonona gam teng i tan dingun kilah vai,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka Pasien aw, amate pumpei sunga a leng buathah le hui in a tawmang ansi leng bangsah in."},"14":{"text":"Mei in gampalah a kahtum bang le, meikuong in muolpite a kuonsah vapual bangin,"},"15":{"text":"na pumpei tawh amate nuadel inlen, na khuopi hui tawh amate zausisah in."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, amate in na min ang sui thei nadingun, a maitangte uh zumna tawh kidimsah in."},"17":{"text":"Amate maizumin lungkiesah den in; amate mindaisah inlen, mangthaisah sieng in."},"18":{"text":"Topa a kici min nei nangma beh na hi hi, leitung mun zosie-ah Sangpen Pa na hi lam amate theisah in."}}},"84":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vanglien Topa aw, na tenna mun bangza-in etlawm ahei!","title":"Biehinnpi Sunga Biehpieh a Nopcitdan"},"2":{"text":"Ka hlagau in Topa’ huongte a hlangaih seng ziehin a tha a zawm vawt va-ia hi; ka lungsim le ka pumpi in hingzing Pasien tungah lungdam kipahin la a sa hi."},"3":{"text":"Vanglien Topa, ka Kumpipa le ka Pasien aw, na biehna maitam tungah vato nangawn in a inn ding a mu a, sielpaleng in zong ama op nading, a note a koi nading bu a mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma’ inn sungah tengin, nangma phatna la a sa zing mite thupha nga ahi uhi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Nangma sungah a thahatna uh omin, a lungtang vuah Zion zotna lampi a zui nuom mite thupha nga ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Baca kuom kantanin amate a pei laitahun, amate in tuami kuom pen ciatui phulna mun a suohsah uhi; tua mun pen guotui masate in zong buoltuite tawh a kidimsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a pei kawmun a tha uh hat semsem hi; Zion-ah pasien-te’ Pasien kimu ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, ka thungetna ei za in; Jacob Pasien aw, ka thungetna ei ngai in! Selah"},"9":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka kidalna uh lum ei etpieh in; na sathau nu pa’ maitang zong hing en vawi in."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mun danga ni tulkhat ka op sangin na huong sunga ni khat lenlon ka op a hoizaw hi. Gitlona inn sunga ka ten sangin ka Pasien’ inn sunga kotcing pa ka hi nuomzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa Pasien pen tungsun ni le kidalna lum ahi hi; ama in maipha le patawina ei pie hi. Thumanin a gamta mite tung panin Topa in na hoi bangma hen a nei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Vanglien Topa aw, nangma ang muong mi zosie thupha nga ahi uhi."}}},"85":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma in na gam maipha na pie hi; nangma in Jacob’ hamphatnate a ngaingai na bangsahkia hi.","title":"Pasien’ Maipha Ngakia nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Na mite’ khielna na maisah a, a mawna zosie uh na ngaidam hi. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Na thangpaina zosie na lamang hi; na sinsona panin na kihei hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote’ ki hutdamna Pasien aw, ka ngaingai uh ei bangsah kia inlen, ka tung vua na lungkim lona ei paimang pieh in."},"5":{"text":"Ka tung vuah nang a lungthah den ding na mah? A khangkhangte zosie tungah lungthah peisuoh ding na mah?"},"6":{"text":"Na mite in nangma sungah nuom a sah thei nadingin, ei hingsahkia lo ding na mah?"},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, ka tung vuah na itna kip ei lah inlen, na hutdamna ei pie in."},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasien’ thugen ding ei zasah un; azieh pen ama in a mite, a mi muonhuoite, le ama lama lungsim a kihei mite tungah kilemna thu a gen ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama’ minthanna i gam sungah a ten thei nadingin, ama a zatahte adingin ama’ hutdamna a nai om tahpi hi."},"10":{"text":"Itna kip le citahna kimutuo ding hi; dihna le kilemna zong khatlekhat a kitawp ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Leilah panin citahna ang po ding a, dihna in van panin a ensuh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in eite tungah sil hoite ei pie ding a, i leitang in zong an tampi a piengsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A mai-ah dihna pei ding a, ama’ kalsuon nading lampi bawlpieh ding hi."}}},"86":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na bil ei ngat inlen, keima ei dawng in, bangzieh ahei cile kei zawngin ka cimaw hi.","title":"Galte Nanzawh nading Hungetna"},"2":{"text":"Keima’ hinna ei kem in, azieh pen na tungah kang ki-ap hi; nangma ang muong na nasempa ei hun in. Nangma ka Pasien na hi hi;"},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, kei ei hepi in; azieh pen sunthapai-in na kungah keima kang kiko hi."},"4":{"text":"Na nasempa’ hlagau hing lungdamsah in, azieh pen nangma tungah ka hlagau kang lamto hi, Topa aw,"},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa aw, nang hoi-in mawna na maisah a, nang ang hlan mi zosie tungah a kicing itna kip na nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna na bil ei ngat in; nangma tungah thumin kang kikona ei ngai in."},"7":{"text":"Keima ei dawng ding na hi ziehin, ka hahsat ni-in keima in nang kang hlan hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, pasien-te lahah nang tawh a kibang koima om lo a, nangma’ sepsa tawh a kibang nasep khat zong om lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, na bawlsa minam zosie ang pei-in na mai-ah ang kun ding vua, amate in nangma’ min ang phat ding uhi.","ref":"Kln 15:4"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen nang na lien a, na lamdangte na bawl hi; nang beh Pasien na hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, na thutah-ah ka kalsuon thei nadingin nangma’ lampi ei hil inlen, na min ka zatah thei nadingin, a kaakawm lo lungtang keima ei guon in."},"12":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, ka lungsim zosie tawh na tungah lungdam kang ko a, tuale keima in na min ka thangsah zing ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima nei itna kip lien mama a, Misikhuo thuhpite sung panin ka hlagau nei hunkhie hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasien aw, mi kihisahte, kei ei langpangin ang kipan hi; thu-helhawt pawlkhat in kei tha ei sawm vua, amate in nangma ang thudon sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nang a khuotuo thei le a hepi siem Pasien na hi a, lungthah bai vawt loin, nang itna kip le muonhuoina tawh na kidim hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei lamah hing kihei inlen, keima ei hepi in. Na nasempa thahatsah inlen, na nasem numei nu’ tapa hing hundam in."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma in kei ei hu-in ei henem zo na hi ziehin, kei ei mudate in tua thu mu-in a maizum nadingun, nei angvanna lim khat keima ei lah in."}}},"87":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Muol siengtho tungah ama’ phusa khuopi a om hi;","title":"Zion-a Ten a Nopna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Jacob’ tenna zosie sangin Zion’ tunkotte a itzaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasien’ khuopi aw, na minthanna teng kigengen hi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Keima ei thei mite lahah Rahab le Babylon ka lo hi; Philistia-te, Tyre-te le Ethiopia-te zong ka lo hi, amate in, “Tampa khu Zion-a suoh ahi hi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"5":{"text":"Zion tawh kisai-in, “Tampa le khumpa tua khuopi sunga suoh ahi hi,” kici ding hi; azieh pen Sangpen Pa mama in tua khuopi a phutdet ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in mi sazien a lah ciengin “Tampa tua muna suoh ahi hi,” ci-in ciemte hi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"La siemte le lam siem pawlte in, “Ka lungdamna zosie nangma sungah a om hi” a ci tuoh uhi."}}},"88":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima’ kihutdamna Topa ka Pasien aw, zanin na opna munah kang kiko ciengin,","title":"Lamet Tawp Huna Hungetna"},"2":{"text":"ka thungetna na mai-ah hing tung hinlen, ka kikona na bil ei ngat in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen ka hlagau gentheina tawh a kidim a, keima’ hikhuo in zong Misikhuo a nai ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Leihawm sunga a peisuhte lahah ei kisimton hi; kei ka hi leh panpi ding nei lo mite tawh ka kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Misite lahah a kinuasie, a kithatlia, han sunga kisiel, na phawkhah nawn lo mite tawh ka kibang hi, azieh pen na khut sung panin amate a kisattan ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Miel thuhpi munte sung, Leihawm thuh sungah kei nei koi zo ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima tungah na thangpaina gih mama a, na tuihuolte zosie tawh nei vuamang ta hi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Ka kithuopite’ pelh dingin kei nei na bawl hi; amate dinga a muthada huoi khat bangin kei nei bawl zo hi. A pit thei lo dingin kei ei kikhum hi;"},"9":{"text":"ka da seng ziehin ka mit a miel ta hi. Topa aw, nisimin nangma kang hlan a, nangma lamah ka khut kang zah hi."},"10":{"text":"Misite adingin na lamdangte a bawl na hi amah? Nangma ang phat dingin misi hlate a thoto uh amah? Selah"},"11":{"text":"Han sungah ahi a, Sietna sungah ahi zongin na itna kip le na muonhuoina a kigen mawng amah?"},"12":{"text":"Khuomiel sung le mangngilna gam sungah, na silbawl lamdangte le na hutdam panpina a kithei amah?"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nangma tungah kang kiko a, zingmawng tenga ka thungetna, nangma mai-ah ang tung hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa aw, bang dinga nei paimang dawh ta ahei? Bang dingin ka kung panin na maitang na phuol dawh ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Ka neu lai-a kipanin hamsietna ka thuoh a, ka si dihtah hi; nei zausahnate ka na thuoh a, ka cimaw mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Na thangpaina in kei ei nawh gawp zo hi; a zauhuoi mama nei busimna in kei ei susie gawp hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in tuikhang bangin sunthapai-in kei ei kui-im uhi; amate in ka kim ka vel panin kei ei khumcip uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ka guolte le ka vengte in kei nei pelhsah zo ta hi; khuomiel sungah ka kithuopite a om uhi."}}},"89":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip a tawntungin la-in ka sa ding hi; khangsawnsawnte tungah ka kam tawh na citahna ka phuongzah zing ding hi.","title":"David tawh Pasien’ Thuciemna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in na itna kip kumtawn adingin kiphutdet hi, ci-in ka pholah hi; na citahna zong khu vantungte bangin kip hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma in, “Ka teelpa tawh thuciemna ka bawl zo a, ka nasempa David tungah ka kiciem zo hi."},"4":{"text":"‘Keima in na suon na hlahte ka kipsah zing ding a, khangsawnsawn zosiete adingin na kumpi topha ka lam ding hi,’” na ci hi. Selah","ref":"2Sam 7:12-16; 1Khg 17:11-14; Late 132:11; Sawl 2:30"},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, vante in na na lamdangte patawi hinlen, mi siengthote kikhopna sungah na citahna kipatawi taheh."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen vante lahah Topa tawh tekah thei ding koi om ahei? Van mite lahah Topa tawh kibang koi om a,"},"7":{"text":"mi siengthote kikhopna sungah a kizatah Pasien, a kimkota omte zosie tungah lienin a giinhuoi koi om ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, nang banga vanglien koi om ahei? Nangma’ citahna in nangma ang kimkot hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma in a husie tuipi na uh hi; a tuihuolte a kato ciengin na daisah hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang in luonghawm khat bangin Rahab na suguoi hi; nang in na banhat tawh na galte na thezah gawp hi."},"11":{"text":"Vante nang-a’ ahi a, leitung zong nang-a’ ma ahi hi; leitung le a sunga om na zosie, nangma’ phusa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Leilu lam le leitaw lam, nangma’ piensah ahi hi; Tabor le Hermon muolte in kipahtahin na min a phat uhi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma in a hat mama ban khat na nei hi; na khut zong a thahat a, na zietlam khut a sang hi."},"14":{"text":"Thuman le thutang khu na kumpi topha’ zungpi ahi hi; nangma masangah itna kip le muonhuoina a pei hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa aw, na maipha khuovah sungah kalsuon a, pawibawlna awging a thei mite thupha nga ahi uhi;"},"16":{"text":"amate in sunthapai-in na min a patawi vua, na dihna a phat uhi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen amau’ hatna le minthanna khu nangma na hi hi; nangma’ angvanna tawh ka kite uh kitawisang hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa khu kote’ kidalna lum hi a, kote’ kumpipa khu Israel’ Siengtho Pa ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n nangma in na mi muonhuoite tungah mukholna tawh thu na gen a: “Keima in a vanglien mi khat tungah kumpi lukhu ka koi zo a, keima in mite lah panin a kiteel mi khat ka lamsang zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima in ka nasempa David ka mu zo hi; keima in ka sathau siengtho tawh ama ka nu zo hi.","ref":"1Sam 13:14; Sawl 13:22; 1Sam 16:12"},"21":{"text":"Keima’ khut in ama ompi zing ding hi; ka ban in zong ama a thahatsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Galte in ama sol zo lo ding a, migilote in nuoisie zo lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama mai-ah a galte ka suguoi ding a, keima in ama a mudate ka satlia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka muonhuoina le ka itna kip in ama a ompi ding hi; keima’ min sungah ama’ ki kitawisang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima in tuipi tungah a khut ka koi ding a, gunte tungah ama’ zietlam khut ka koi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in kei kungah, ‘Nangma ka pa, ka Pasien le ka kihutdamna Suongpi na hi hi!’ ei ci ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in ama tapa ta pen ka hisah ding a, leitunga a sangpen kumpipa ka hisah ding hi.","ref":"Kln 1:5"},"28":{"text":"Ama adingin ka itna kip ka kemcing zing ding a, tuale ama tawh ka bawl ka thuciemna a kipden ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama’ suon le hlahte ka kipsah den ding a, vante a kip laisie ama’ topha zong ka kipsah ding hi."},"30":{"text":"A tate un keima’ thukham nuasie-in, ka biehna ngainakip bangin amate a gamtat sih vua,"},"31":{"text":"ka thukhamte palsatin, ka thupiehte a zui sih uleh,"},"32":{"text":"a thupalsatna tung vuah, ciengpum tawh dan ka pie ding a, amate tawnkhielna zong satna tawh ka gimsah ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanle ama kung panin ka itna kip ka la sih ding a, keima’ muonhuoina ka kidangsah tuom sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka thuciemna palsat loin, ka kam pana pusuoh sa thute ka khel sih ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Ka siengthona tawh a kimang zing dingin khatvei ka kiciem zo hi; David tungah ka zuou sih ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama’ suon le hlahte kizom peisuoh ding a, ka mai-ah vantunga ni bangin a kumpi topha kip den ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Vante tungah a kipden teci ahi hlapi bangin kip den ding hi,” na ci hi. Selah"},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin nangma in tu-in ama nawlkhinin na nuol zo hi; na sathau nu pa tungah na thangpai mama hi."},"39":{"text":"Nang in na nasempa tawh na bawl thuciemna na phel a, nang in leivui lahah a kumpi lukhu na niehsah hi."},"40":{"text":"Nang in ama’ kulpi zosie na sukhepieh hi; nang in ama’ mun kipte a siesa-in na koipieh hi."},"41":{"text":"A nawh kha zosie in a nate a sutgawp uhi; ama pen a vengte’ simmaw nuoisie a suoh ta hi."},"42":{"text":"Nang in a galte’ zietlam khut na domsang zo a, a galte zosie na lungdamsah zo hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua tham loin nang in a namsau dawn na leheipieh hi; Galdona phuol-ah ama na panpi sih hi."},"44":{"text":"Nang in ama’ khut panin kumpi ciengkhut na lahpieh a, a kumpi topha zong tuol denna-in na nei hi."},"45":{"text":"A khangno hun na tomsah a, maizumna tawh ama na tuom hi. Selah"},"46":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt ding na hei? Nang a kiphuol zing ding na hi ta amah? Meikuong bangin bang tanvei na lungthahna kuong ding ahei?"},"47":{"text":"Ka hinkhuo a tom lam keima ei phawh in, azieh pen nang in a si thei mihingte a mawhna dinga na bawl ahi amah!"},"48":{"text":"Sina mu loin a hingzing koi om ahei? Misikhuo’ vanglietna panin koi suohta zo ahei? Selah"},"49":{"text":"Topa aw, na thumanna tawh David tunga na thuciemna, hun lui lai-a nangma’ itna kip hei sungah a om ta ahei?"},"50":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasempa ei kisimmaw zie, mite’ simmawna ka thuohna ziete ei phawh inlen,"},"51":{"text":"tua ma tawh na galte in keima ei simmaw vua, amate in na sathau nu pa’ kalsuonna a simmaw uhi."},"52":{"text":"Topa in thupha nga zing taheh. Amen, Amen."}}},"90":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, khan tawntungin kote’ tenna mun na hi hi.","title":"BU LINA (Late 90–106) Kumtawn Pasien le a Khantom Mihing"},"2":{"text":"Muolte a kipiensah masang, lei le leitung na bawl masang, tawntung pan tawntung dongin nangma Pasien na hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Kohaw leivui nei suohsahkia a, “No mihingte aw, kilekia un,” nei ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma’ muna-ah kum tulkhat a tawp ciengin zani tawh kibang a, ahi sihle zanvil hun khat tawh a kibang bep lel hi.","ref":"2Pet 3:8"},"5":{"text":"Nangma in amate na sumaimang sieng hi; amate zanlai mang tawh a kibang vua, zingmawnga a dawngkia lopa tawh a kibang uhi;"},"6":{"text":"zingmawngin palin thasuoh a, nitah ciengin vulin a gawptum hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nangma’ lungthahna in kote ei netum hi; nangma’ thangpaina in kote ei vuanel hi."},"8":{"text":"Nang in ka khielnate uh nangma mai-ah na koi a, ka seldap uh mawnate zong na mai khuovah-ah na koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka ni zosie uh nangma’ thangpaina nei-ah a tawp sieng hi; ka kumte uzong husan khat bangin a tawp lel hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka hinkhuo nite uh ahile kum sawmsagi ahi bo a, ahi sihle thahat lai uleng, kum sawmgiet bang hi thei hi; tua kikal nangawn zong gimna le hahsatna vive ahi hi; tua teng mallangin a tawp a, tuaci’n ka mangthai pai uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na lungthahna vanglietna zie koi in thei ding ahei? Na thangpaina zong khu na zatahhuoina za-in lien hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n kote in pilna lungsim ka nga thei nadingun ka hinkhuo nite uh ka sim dan ding uh ei hil in."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, hing kilekia in! Bang tanvei sawt lai ding na hei? Nangma in nasemte tungah lainatna ei nei in!"},"14":{"text":"Ka hin sung tung tawn uh lungdamin ka kipah thei nadingun, zingmawngin na itna kip tawh kote ei lungkimsah in."},"15":{"text":"Kote nei gimsah ni zaza, sietna ka tuo uh kum zaza ma kote ei kipahsah in."},"16":{"text":"Na nasemte tungah na nasepna, a tate uh tungah a minthang na vanglietna hing kilangsah in."},"17":{"text":"Topa i Pasien uh’ ang vanna eite tungah hing tung hinlen, i khut vua i septe uh eite dingin lawcing taheh. Aw, ka khut utawh ka septe uh hing lawcingsah in!"}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sangpen Pa’ liena sungah tengin, Vanglienpa’ hlim a bel nangma in,","title":"Pasien’ Dalna Zieha Hlamuonna"},"2":{"text":"Topa kungah, “Ka kibuhna le ka kulpi; ka muon ka Pasien na hi hi,” na ci ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in thangsie pa’ thang pan le a zauhuoi pul natna panin nang ang hunkhie ding hi;"},"4":{"text":"ama in a hlakuite tawh nangma ang hui ding a, ama’ hla nei-ah kibuhna na mu ding hi; ama’ muonhuoina khu lum le kawngga ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Zan lai-a zauhuoina hile, sun lai-a a leng thaltang hile,"},"6":{"text":"miel lahah a vahdap pul natna hile, suntang lai-a sietnate hile, na giing sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na gei-ah mi tulkhat pua-in, na ziet lamah mi tulsawm pua zong nan uleh tuate in nang ang neh kha sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na mit tawh na en lel beh ding a, migilote kithuhkiana na mu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma in Topa na kibuhna dingin bawlin, Sangpen Pa na tenna mun dingin bawl zo na hi ziehin,"},"10":{"text":"nang tungah sietna ang tung sih ding a, na puonbuh gei-ah zong gimna ang tung sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in na lampi cin tengah nang ang cing dingin a vantung mite thu a pie ding hi.","ref":"Mat 4:6; Luk 4:10"},"12":{"text":"Na kengte in suong a suikhah lo nadingin, amate in a khut utawh nang ang dom ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 4:6; Luk 4:11"},"13":{"text":"Humpi le gulsum na tuon ding a, humpi khanglai le gulpi zong na tuoncil ding hi.","ref":"Luk 10:19"},"14":{"text":"Ei it mite ka hunkhie ding a; ka min a thei mite ka dal ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei ei hlat ciengun amate ka dawng ding hi; keima in hahsat hun ciengin amate ka ompi ding a, amate hunkhie-in ka patawi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima in khansauna tawh amate ka lungkimsah ding a, tuale ka hutdamna amate ka lah ding hi."}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko ding le na min phatna lasah ding hoi hi, Sangpen Pa aw;","title":"Dihtansahna Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"zingmawngin na itna kip, zanlai-in na muonhuoina,"},"3":{"text":"theile le harp tumgingte le lyre gin ngaite tawh tangko dinga a kilawm ahi hi,"},"4":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Topa aw, nangma’ nasepna tawh nei lungdamsah hi; keima in na khut a na sepnate ziehin lungdamin la ka sa hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasepnate bangza-in lien ahei! Na ngaisutnate zong bangza-in thuh ahei!"},"6":{"text":"Mi lungmawlte in a thei zawh lo uh, mimawte in a tel zawh lo uh thu tami ahi hi:"},"7":{"text":"Lopa bangin migilote mengin, sietna bawlte a pun vangun, amate kumtawn sietna thuoh dinga kisesa ahi a,"},"8":{"text":"ahi vangin Topa aw, nang pen mun sanga om zing na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa aw, na galte a mangthai ding hi; sietna bawl mi vannuoi zong a kithethang ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin zangsiel’ ki bangin keima’ ki nei lamsang a, nang in keima’ tungah sathau siengtho nei buohsuh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka mit in ka galte’ puana a mu zo ta uhi; ka bil in zong keima ei do migilote’ manthaina za zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Midihte lutu kung bangin khanpha ding a, Lebanon gam sunga taamtah kung bangin khang ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ inn sungah amate kisuon hi; i Pasien’ huong sungah amate a khanpha uhi."},"14":{"text":"A vuoi ciengun zong ga a ga lai uhi; amate dum kihkiahin a nosuoh silsel den vua,"},"15":{"text":"tua in Topa pen thuman hi, ci lah hi; ama ka suongpi zong ahi a, ama sungah thuman lona a om sih hi."}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pen kumpi hi a, thupina puon ama kisilsah hi; Topa kumpi puon kisilsah a, thahatna tawh a kawng kigah hi. Ama in leitung phutdet hi; tua khu a kilawh ngai nawn sih ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Uhna a Thupina"},"2":{"text":"Tanglai-a kipanin na kumpi topha kiphut hi; nang kumtawn-a om na hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, gunte hing khangin, tua gunte in a aw uh a sangsah uhi; gunte a hawh vapuoh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuipi liente hawh sanga a hatzaw, tuipihuolte sanga a hatzaw, a sangna muna om a thupi Topa khu nang na hi hi!"},"5":{"text":"Na thupiehte man mama hi; Topa aw, siengthona pen a tawntungin na inn tawh a kilawm ahi hi."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Phu la Pasien, phu la Topa Pasien aw, hing tho in!","title":"Mi Thumante ading Phula Pasien"},"2":{"text":"Leitung thukhen pa aw, hing thoto in; mi kiphasahte tungah amahaw’ nga dinga kilawmte pie in!"},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei migilote lungdamin, bang tanvei migilote nuomin kipah ding uh ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Amate in kihisahna kammalte a suo vapual uhi; sietna a bawl mite zosie a kiphasah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, amate in na mite a suguoi vua, na gouluote a gimsah uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in meigongte le khuol mite thatin, pa nei lote zong a that uhi;"},"7":{"text":"tuale amate in, “ Topa in mu sih; Jacob’ Pasien in thei kha sih,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mite sung panin a lungmawl pente aw, tel ta un; mimawte aw, bang huna pil tabep ding na hi uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Bil bawlpa in khuo a za sih amah? Mit bawlpa in khuo a mu sih amah?"},"10":{"text":"Minamte khalna pie-in, mihingte tungah thu theitelna a hil pa in thu sam lo ding amah?"},"11":{"text":"I ngaisutnate uh i dih hui hawmpi tawh kibang ahina Topa in thei hi.","ref":"1Cor 3:20"},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, migilote adingin dum khat a kitaw masang, buoina nite panin amate a kipel thei nadingin, na thukham na hil mi, thu na sap mite thupha nga ahi uhi.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in ama’ mite a nuasie sih hi; ama in a gouluote a taisan sih ding hi;"},"15":{"text":"azieh pen midihte kungah thutang ang kilekia ding a, lungsim sunga thutang a kuo zosie in a zui ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kei adinga migilote do dingin, koi pang ngam ahei? Kei dinga sietna bawlte do dingin koi pang ngam ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Topa khu ei hupa hi sihle, gamkhing sungah ka hlagau a tung zo ta ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Kitawnkhaw tang e,” ci-a ka ngaisut ciengin, Topa aw, na itna kip in keima ei kaito hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka lunghimawna a tam ciengin, na henepna in keima nei lungnuomsah hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi sol nading thukham a bawl, a gilo gam-uhte, nang tawh a kipawl thei ding uh amah?"},"21":{"text":"Midihte’ hinna a do dingin amate a kikhawm vua, tuale amate in maw nei lote tha dingin thu a khen uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa khu keima’ mun muonhuoi hi a, tuale ka Pasien zong ka bel suongpi suoh zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in a khielna uh ziehin amate a thuhkia ding a, a gitlona uh ziehin ama in amate a maimangsah ding hi."}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hing pei un, Topa phat vai; ei kihutdamna suongpi tungah lungdamin kiko vai!","title":"Biehna ding le Thuman nading Kutna"},"2":{"text":"Ama’ opna munah lungdamkona tawh pei-in, ama tungah phatna late tawh lungdamin kiko vai!"},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa a lien Pasien hi a, pasien zosiete tungah Kumpi lienpa ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’ khut sungah leitung thuhpite a om hi; muol sangte zong khu ama-a’ ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi ama’ bawlsa ahi ziehin ama-a’ ahi a, tuale a khuta a bawlsa leigawte zong ama-a’ ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hing pei un, ama bie-in kun vai, ei Siem Topa mai-ah khupdin va vui!"},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama pen eite’ Pasien ahi a, eite a gankhawh sunga om mite le ama’ khut sunga a om a tuute i hi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Meribah munah na lungkhau bang ule Senel gam Massah munah na pu na pate in kei ei zelah lai-in, amate in ka nasepna mu zo napi gamtatna tawh lah ding hun ei kal hun lai uh bangin, na lungsim khausah sih un.","merge":"9","ref":"Pei 17:1-7; Gam 20:2-13"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen tua khang mite kum sawmli sung ka na kidah a, “Amate pen lungsim lepeisate le ka lampi a thuse lote ahi uhi,” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka thangpai kawmin ka kiciem a, “Ka tawlngahna sungah amate a lut sih ding uhi,” ka ci hi.","ref":"Heb 3:7-11"}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung mi zosie aw, Topa tungah la tha khat sa un; Topa tungah phatna la sa un.","title":"Thukhen dinga ang Pei ding Pasien Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah lasa unlen, ama’ min phat un; ni khat zaw ni khat ama’ ei hutdamna thu gen un."},"3":{"text":"Minamte lahah ama’ minthanna tangko unlen, mi zosiete lahah a sil lamdang bawlte tangko un."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa lienin, nahpitah a phat ding ahi hi; ama pen pasien zosiete sanga zatah zawh ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mihingte’ pasien zosie milimte hi lel a, ahi vangin Topa in vantungte a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama mai-ah patawina le thupina a om hi; ama’ mun siengtho sungah thahatna le hoina a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Minamte’ innkuonte aw, Topa ahi ding bangin hisah unlen, Topa tungah a minthanna le a hatna bangin hisah un."},"8":{"text":"Topa tungah ama’ min zieha a nga dinga kilawm minthanna pie un; biehpiehnate tawi-in ama’ huong sungah hing lut un."},"9":{"text":"Puon siengtho tawh kizemin Topa bie un; leitung mi zosie aw, ama mai-ah citun un.","ref":"Late 29:1-2"},"10":{"text":"Minamte lahah, “ Topa kumpi ahi hi! Leitung kiptahin kiphut zo hi; tua khu a kilawh ngai nawn sih ding hi. Ama in deidan nei loin mite thu khen ding hi,” ci-in gen un."},"11":{"text":"Vantungte kipah uh hinlen, leitung lungdam heh; tuipi le a sunga om zosie awng vapo uheh;"},"12":{"text":"lo le a sunga om zosie nuomin kitom uheh. Tua ciengin gamlahah a po singkung zosie in"},"13":{"text":"Topa mai-ah lungdamin la sa ding uhi; azieh pen leitung thukhen dingin ama ang pei ta hi. Ama in dihna tawh leitung thu khen ding a, ama in a thuman tawh mite thu a khen ding hi."}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa kumpi ahi hi! Leitung lungdam heh; tuikul neu tampite zong kipah uheh!","title":"Pasien’ Maanna le a Vanglietna"},"2":{"text":"Meiipite le miel sapite in ama a kimvel uhi; ama’ kumpi topha bulpi pen dihna le thutang ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama mai-ah meikuong pei a, a kimvela om galte a katum hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’ tunphete in leitung tanvah hi; leitung in mu-in a kithing hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa mai, leitung mi zosie’ Topa mai-ah khuoinun bangin muolte zungmang hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantungte in ama’ thumanna a gen hi; mi zosie in ama’ minthanna a mu uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lo milimte a kisahtheipi, milimte a bie mi zosiete kimaizumsah ding hi; pasien zosiete zong ama mai-ah a kun uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien aw, Zion in za-in nuom a, na thukhennate ziehin Judah khuopite a lungdam uhi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa aw, leitung zosie tungah nangma a sangpen na hi hi; pasien zosiete tung pehah nang ang kitawisang hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in sietna a muda mite a it hi; ama in mi muonhuoite’ hinna a kepcing pieh hi; ama in migilote khut sung panin amate hunkhie hi."},"11":{"text":"Midihte adingin khuo ang vah a, lungsim mante adingin kipahna ang tung hi."},"12":{"text":"No midihte aw, Topa sungah lungdam unlen, ama’ min siengtho phat un!"}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah la tha khat sa un, azieh pen ama in sil lamdangte a bawl zo hi. A zietlam khut le a ban siengtho in ama a guolzosah hi.","title":"Leitung Thukhenpa Phat un"},"2":{"text":"Topa in ama’ guolzawna a kitheisah zo ta hi; ama in minamte muna-ah a thumanna lah zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Israel innkuonte tungah a itna kip le a muonhuoina a phawhkia zo hi. Leimongte zosie in i Pasien’ guolzawna mu sieng zo uhi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung mi zosie aw, Topa tungah lungdamna aw gingsah un; lungdamin awngin phatna la sa un."},"5":{"text":"Lyre lasahna tawh phatna la sa unlen, lyre tumin aw ngaih tawh phat un."},"6":{"text":"Pengkulte le saki aw tawh Topa, Kumpipa’ mai-ah lungdamna aw gingsah un."},"7":{"text":"Tuipi le a sunga om zosie le leitung le a tunga teng zosie awng uheh."},"8":{"text":"Tuikhangte in khut beng uheh; Topa’ opna munah muoltangte in lungdamin la sa ton uheh. Azieh pen leitung thukhen dingin ama ang pei ta hi. Ama in dihna tawh leitung thu khen ding a, guptuom paituom nei loin mite thu a khen ding hi.","merge":"9"}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa kumpi ahi hi; mite citun uheh! Cherub-te tungah ama a to hi; leitung kiling taheh!","title":"Siengtho Pasien Phatna","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"2":{"text":"Zion ah Topa lien a, mite zosie tungah kitawisang hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in a lien le a zatahhuoi na min phat ta uheh. Ama a Siengtho ahi h!"},"4":{"text":"Thutang a it Vanglien Kumpipa aw, nang in deidan op lona na kipsah a, nangma in Jacob sungah thutang le thudih tawh na na sem zo hi."},"5":{"text":"I Topa Pasien phat un; a keng zungah bie un. Ama a Siengtho ahi hi!"},"6":{"text":"Ama’ siempute lahah Moses le Samuel kihal a, a min-a a kilote lahah Samuel zong kihal hi. Topa kungah amate a kiko vua, ama in a dawng hi."},"7":{"text":"Meii khuompi sung panin ama in amate hopi hi; amate in ama’ thupiehte le ama in amate a pieh thukhamte a zui uhi.","ref":"Pei 33:9"},"8":{"text":"Kote’ Topa Pasien aw, nangma in amate na dawng hi; amate tungah maw a maisah Pasien na hi a, hinanle nang na hi leh a gamtat khielna uh tungah phu la pa na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"I Topa Pasien phat unlen, a muol siengtho-ah bie un; azieh pen eite’ Topa Pasien siengtho hi."}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung mi zosie aw, Topa tungah lungdamna aw gingsah un.","title":"Pasien Phat dingin Gam Zosie Kihlan"},"2":{"text":"Lungdamna tawh Topa bie un; ama’ opna munah la sa kawmin hing pei un."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien ahi lam thei un. Ei bawlpa ama ahi a, eite ama-a’ i hi hi; eite ama’ mite i hi vua, a gancinna sunga om a tuute i hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Lungdamkona tawh ama’ kotpite-ah lut unlen, phatna tawh ama’ huong sungah tum un. Ama tungah lungdam ko unlen, ama’ min phat un."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa hoi hi; tuale ama’ itna kip tawntung hi. Tuale ama’ muonhuoina zong a khang khangin kip hi.","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in thumanna le thutanna la ka sa ding hi. Topa aw, na tungah la kang sa ding hi.","title":"Citah nading le Thutan nading Thunei pen Pa Khat’ Kiciemna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in nuol baang lo lampi ka sin ding hi. Tua khu bang hunin nga ding ka hei? Lungsim citahna tawh ka inn sungah ka kalsuon ding hi;"},"3":{"text":"keima in kimanna nei lo na khat popo ka mitsuon sih ding hi. Lamkhielte’ nasepna ka muda hi; tua khu ka tungah a beh sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A lungsim kawi mi kei tawh a kigamla ding hi; keima in sietna kici bangma ka thei sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in a vengpa a dap gensiet mipa ka susie ding hi. Kiphatsahna, kihisahna lungsim a nei mi ka thuoh zo sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Gam sunga thuman mite kei tawh a ten thei nadingin, maipha ka pie ding hi; nuol baang loin a gamta poma in keima’ na a sem ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Solna a zang mi poma ka inn sungah a om thei sih ding hi; zuouthu a gen poma ka opna-ah a om thei sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in zingmawng sielin gam sunga migilote zosie ka susie ding a, Topa’ khuopi panin sietna a bawl mite zosie, ka sumaimang ding hi."}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna ei za in; nangma tungah ka kikona hing tung taheh.","title":"Tawntung Kumpipa’ Panpi ding Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lunggim hun ciengin ka kung panin na mai phuol sin. Nangma in na bil ei ngat in; kang hlat ciengin mallangin ei dawng in."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka nite meikhu bangin tawp a, ka gu ka tangte zong meikhuh bangin kavam hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lung a kham a, lopa bangin a vul hi; ka tha a zawmgawp a, an zong ka ne zo ta sih hi."},"5":{"text":"A gingin ka tautauna ziehin ka gu guohin ka om ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Senel gam sunga om simbu le ngalgawta lahah a om keising tawh ka kibang ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka lup lai-in ka hah hi; innkhum dawna a tuomtuon va tawh ka kibang hi."},"8":{"text":"Sunthapai-in ka galte in keima ei tawh uhi; kei ei simmawte in ka min samsietna-in zang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in an-in vut ka ne a, na lungthahna le na thangpaina ziehin, ka tuidawnte hlitui tawh kihal hi; azieh pen nangma in nei domto a, nei paimang hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Ka hinkhuo nite ahile nitah lama a om nihlim tawh kibang a, lopa bangin ka vul hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nang pen tawntung kumpi na hi hi; a khang khangin na min a kip peisuoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma tho-in Zion na hepi ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile nang in ama maipha na pieh ding hun ang tung ta ding hi; a kisesa hun ang tung ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen na nasemte in tua suongtumte a it uhi; tuale a leivuite tungah zong khuotuona a nei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte in Topa’ min a zatah ding vua, leitung kumpi zosie in na minthanna a zatah ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in Zion khuopi a lam ding hi; tuale a minthanna tawh ama ang kilang ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in mi cimawte’ thungetna thupisim ding a, a thungetna uh a simmaw sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A suoh nai lo mite in Topa a phat thei nadingun, ang pieng lai ding khang mite adingin tam thu kiciemte taheh."},"19":{"text":"Topa a bie dingin mite le kumpi gamte a kaikhop ciengin, Zion ah Topa’ min, Jerusalem ah ama phatna a pulah thei nadingun, thongkiete’ tauna a za ding le a si dinga kisate a hla dingin, Topa in a siengtho ama’ mun sang panin ei ensuh a, vantung panin ama in leitung a ensuh hi.","merge":"20"},"23":{"text":"Ama in ka khan a kimsuhin ka thahatna ei suhtanpieh hi; ama in ka hinkhuo nite zong ei tomsahpieh ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Keima in, “Khang tawntunga a kip ka Pasien aw, ka nuntah kimtanin kei ei la sin” ka ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tanglai hunin nang in leitung bulpi na phut a, tuale vantungte na khut tawh na bawlsa ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate mangthai ding a, hinanle nang na kip den hi; amate ahi ule puon bangin a siepaat ding uhi. Nangma in amate puon bangin na kheel a, amate a mangthai uhi;"},"27":{"text":"ahi vangin nang na kibang den a, na kumte in mong a nei sih hi.","ref":"Heb 1:10-12"},"28":{"text":"Na nasemte’ tate lungmuongin a teng ding uhi; nangma’ opna munah a suon a hlahte uh kisukip ding hi."}}},"103":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, Topa phat in, ka sunga om zosiete aw, ama’ min siengtho phat un.","title":"Pasien’ Hoina Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, Topa phat inlen, ama’ zieha phattuomnate mangngil sin."},"3":{"text":"Ama in na khielna zosie maisahin, na natna zosie damsah a,"},"4":{"text":"ama in Leihawm panin na hinna tankhie a, itna le khuotuona ang khusah hi."},"5":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin na khangno lai hun ang thasuo theikia nadingin, na khan sung tungtawnin hoina tawh nangma ang lungkimsah hi."},"6":{"text":"A kibawlsie mite adingin Topa in thumanin na a sem hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a lampite Moses tung le a sepnate Israel mite tungah theisah hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa pen mi khuotuo siem le mi hepi siem pa ahi a, lungthah bai loin, a kiningcing itna kip a nei pa ahi hi.","ref":"Jas 5:11"},"9":{"text":"Ama in mi a mawsah den sih ding a, zong a lungthah den sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Eite’ mawna tawh kituohin ama in eite tungah ei bawl sih a, eite’ khielnate tawh kituohin ama in eite ei thuhkia lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen leitung panin vantungte a san ma bangin, ama a zatah mite tungah ama’ itna kip lien mama hi;"},"12":{"text":"nitumna panin nisuona a gamlat ma bangin, ama in i khielnate uh i kung panun gamlapi-ah a hem dawh hi."},"13":{"text":"Pa in tate a khuotuo bangin, Topa in ama a zatah mite a khuotuo hi."},"14":{"text":"A zieh pen ama in eite ei kipiensah dan a thei a, ama in eite leivui i hi lam uzong a phawh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihingte adingin ahile a hinkhuo uh lopa bang ahi hi; amate pen gamlah pape tawh kibang ahi lel bo hi;"},"16":{"text":"bang zieh ahei cile hui in ama semin mangthai a, khumi mun in ama a thei kha nawn sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle ama a zatahte tungah a tawntung pan a tawntung dongin Topa’ itna kip om ngitnget a, ama’ thumanna zong"},"18":{"text":"a thuciemna a zuite le ama’ thupiehte zui ding a phawh mite tungah a tu a ta khang dongin a kip peisuoh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in vantung ah ama’ topha phut zo a, ama’ kumpi gam in mun vannuoi a uh hi."},"20":{"text":"No, ama’ vantung mite aw, Topa phat un, ama’ sawlna bang a sem no a thahat mite aw, ama’ gensa thu mang un."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ dei lam a bawl, a nasemte, ama’ mihon zosie aw, Topa phat un."},"22":{"text":"Ama’ uhna mun zosie-a om ama’ bawlsa zosie aw, Topa phat un. Ka hlagau aw, Topa phat in."}}},"104":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, Topa phat in. Topa ka Pasien aw, nang na lien mama hi. Nangma in patawina le thupina na sil a,","title":"A Siempa le a Sihpa Pasien"},"2":{"text":"puon tawh tuom bangin khuovah sungah na kituom hi. Nangma in puonbuh bangin vantungte na zah a,"},"3":{"text":"nangma in tuite tungah na innkhan zawlte hlungin, na sakol leeng adingin meiipite na bawl a, huipi’ hlate tungah nangma na tuong hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma’ kamtai dingin huite na bawl a, nangma in mei le meikuongte na nasemte na hisah hi.","ref":"Heb 1:7"},"5":{"text":"Leitung a kilawh ngai nawn lo dingin a bulpite tungah na phut hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang in puon tawh tuom bangin tui thuhpi tawh leitung na tuom hi; tuite in muolte a hlumto hi."},"7":{"text":"Na hosiet ziehin tua tuite a tai uhi; vanto ging ziehin a taimang uhi."},"8":{"text":"Muol tung dongah letto-in, muolkuom tengah luong a, amate adinga a kisesa mun-ah a luong uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua tuite in leitung tuomkia loin, a kantan lo nadingin gamgi na phupieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma in muolkuomte sungah tuisamte na pulsah hi; muol le muol kikalah tua tuite luong a,"},"11":{"text":"gamsate’ dawn ding tui na pie hi; gamlah sakolte in zong tua khu dangta phatna-in a nei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua luitui gei-ah huilah vate a busa uhi; amate in singbate lahah zeila a awi uhi."},"13":{"text":"A sangna mun na opna panin nangma in muolte tui na buoh hi; nangma’ nasepna ga tawh leitung a nuomsa hi."},"14":{"text":"Ganhingte’ neh ding le mihingte’ zah dingin lopa le ankungte na posah a, leitung panin an na piengsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing’ lungsim a nuomsah dingin zu, mai a zolsah ding sathau le mihing’ lungsim a hatsah dingin an na piengsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ singkungte, ama in Lebanon-a a suon taamtah singkungte in tui a kham mama uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuami singkungte tungah vate in bu a bawl uhi; gun vapi in taasingte lahah ama ading bu a nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Muolsangte ahile gam sakelte ading ahi a, suongtumte zong khu bilpite adingin kibuhna ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuohun ciemte nadingin hlapi na bawl hi; ni in a tum hun ding thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang in khuomiel na bawl a, tua khu zan hun kici a, tua hun ciengin gamsa zosie pusuohin a gamta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Sa man dingin humpi khanglaite a hawh uhi; amate in Pasien kung panin a an ding a sui uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ni a suo ciengin amate a gelmang vua, a kuo sung vuah a lum uhi."},"23":{"text":"Na sem dingin mite a kuon vua, tuale nitah dongin na a sem uhi."},"24":{"text":"Topa aw, na silbawlte tam sam e izaw! Na pilna tawh tua zosie na bawl hi; na siemsa ganhingte leitung a dim hi."},"25":{"text":"A gal lama tuipi pen lienin zai a, tua sungah a bawhva hinna a nei ganhingte a lien a neu sim zawh loin a tam hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua tuipi tungah tembawte pei a, tua sunga guolnuom dingin na bawlsa Awle a om hi.","ref":"Job 41:1; Late 74:14; Isa 27:1"},"27":{"text":"A hun ciengin an na pieh ding ngahin tam teng zosie in nangma ang en uhi."},"28":{"text":"An na pieh ciengin amate in ang khawm uhi; na khut na zah ciengin, na hoinate tawh a kidim uhi."},"29":{"text":"Na maitang na phuol ciengin, amate a lungkie uhi; nang in a naahu uh na lah ciengin amate si-in leivui ah a peikia uhi."},"30":{"text":"Na hlagau nang sawl ciengin, amate kipiengsah hi; nang in leitung maitang na siemthakia hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa’ minthanna kumtawnin kip den hinlen; ama’ nasepnate ah Topa lungdam taheh."},"32":{"text":"Ama in leitung a et ciengin tua leitung kiling a, muolte a tham ciengin meikhu a pusuoh hi."},"33":{"text":"Keima ka hin laisie Topa tungah la ka sa ding hi; ka hin sungin ka Pasien tungah phatna la ka sa ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa sungah ka lungdam ziehin ka thu ngaituonate in ama lungkimsah taheh."},"35":{"text":"Leitung panin mawnei mite mangthai sieng hinlen, migilote om nawn sih heh. Ka hlagau aw, Topa phat in. Topa phat in!"}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko-in, ama’ min hlan unlen, ama’ silbawlte mite lahah theisah un.","title":"Israel’ tunga Pasien’ Muonhuoina"},"2":{"text":"Ama tungah la sa un, ama tungah phatna la sa un; ama’ silbawl lamdang zosie genkhie un."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ min siengtho sungah kisathei unlen, Topa a sui mite lungdam ta uheh."},"4":{"text":"Topa le a thahatna sui un; a tawntungin ama’ ompina sui un."},"5":{"text":"A bawl a lamdang nate, ama’ na lamdangte, ama in a genkhiet thukhennate,"},"6":{"text":"a nasem Abraham’ suonlehlahte, a teeltuom Jacob’ tate in phawh un."},"7":{"text":"Ama pen eite’ Topa Pasien ahi hi; leitung mun zosie-ah ama’ thukhenna a om hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in, “Na luo dingin Canaan gam kang pie ding hi,” ci-a Abraham tawh a bawl thuciemna, Isaac tungah kiciem-a a pieh kamciem, Israel tungah kumtawn a thuciemna, Jacob tunga a kipsahsa thukhamte ahi, a thuciemnate khang tulkhat dongin phawh den hi.","merge":"9","ref":"Pien 12:7; 17:8; 26:3; Pien 28:13"},"12":{"text":"Amate mi tawmno khat ahi lai ule bangma gentham nai loin, tua munah khuolmi ahi lai-un,"},"13":{"text":"minam khat pan minam khat, kumpi gam khat pan gam khatah amate a va kawi lai-un,"},"14":{"text":"ama in koima’ nuoisie ding a phal sih a, ama in amau’ ziehin kumpite hosie-in,"},"15":{"text":"“Ka sathau nusa mite sukha sih un; ka kamsangte zong bawlsie sih un,” ci hi.","ref":"Pien 20:3-7"},"16":{"text":"Ama in tua gam a susie dingin kielpi hlanin, ama in an namcin a sietsah ciengin,"},"17":{"text":"sila banga a kizua Joseph kici mi khat, a masang vuah a sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"A kengah kengkol kibulin, siakol sungah a ngawng kikoi hi."},"19":{"text":"A gensa thu a tangtun masangin, Topa’ kammal in ama ze-et den hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumpipa in mi sawlin ama a hlakhie hi; mipi uhpa in ama a suohtasah hi."},"21":{"text":"Joseph in a lungkim bangin ama’ uliente lamlah ding, a upate pilna a hil dingin innkuon vaihawm pa le ama’ neisa zosie uhpa-in ama a koi hi.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Egypt ah Israel a va pei ta hi; Ham-te’ gamah pemta-in Jacob a va teng ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in a mite pungsahin, a galte sangin hatzawsah a,"},"25":{"text":"ama’ mite a muda ding le ama’ nasemte ngian tawh a vat dingin amau’ lungsim a heipieh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a nasempa Moses le a teel pa Aaron a sawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate in amahaw lahah ama’ limte a lah vua, Ham’ gam sungah na lamdangte a bawl uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in khuomiel sawlin, gam sung khim a zingsah hi; amate in ama’ thugente a langpang uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in a tuite uh sisan a suohsah a, a ngate uh a sisah hi."},"30":{"text":"A gam sung uh uphawh tawh kidim a, a kumpite’ inn sung nangawnah a dim hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama ham a, gam sung zosie-ah thohonpi le thokangte a dim hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in guo tangin amate gielpi pie a, amate, a gam sung zosie uh a tanvah tunphe a pie hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in a lengguite ule a theikungte uh vattan a, a gam sung vua singkungte a hliehtawng hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama ham a, tuale kauphete le kauphe note, sim zawh loin a tung hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuate in a gam sung vua singte le lohing zosie netum a, a leitang pan vua a pieng ga zosie khawng sieng hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in a gam sung vua tacil zosie le a thagui vua a pieng masa zosie a satlia hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ngun le kham tawh Israel-te peipi a, a minamte lah vuah a kipalpua koima a om sih hi."},"38":{"text":"A giinhuoina uh amate tungah a tun ziehin, amate a pei dawh bepin Egypt-te a nuom mama uhi."},"39":{"text":"Amate a lie dingin meiipi kaisah a, zan ciengin khuovah a pie dingin mei a tangsah hi."},"40":{"text":"Amate in a ngen vua, ama in vamimte puohin, vantung panin a kicingin amate an a pie hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in suongpi hong a, tuale tui a phulkhie hi; tua khu senel gam sungah gun bangin a luong hi."},"42":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in a siengtho a thuciemna le a nasem pa Abraham a phawh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in ama’ mite lungdamna tawh peipi a, la sa kawmin a teeltuom mite a peikhietpi hi."},"44":{"text":"Minamte’ gamte amate pie a, amate in ama’ thukipte zui-in, a thukhamte a tan thei nadingun, tua mite’ hauna teng a tang uhi. Topa phat un!","merge":"45"}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Topa tungah lungdam ko un; azieh pen ama hoi a, ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","title":"Israel’ Mawna Pulahna","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ nasepna lienpite koi in gen thei ding a, ama’ phatna zosie koi in pulah thei ding ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Thutangin na semin, huncin tengah dihna tawh a gamta zingte khu thupha
