nga ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, na teelsa mite’ hauna ka mu thei nading, na minamte’ kipahna sungah keima ka lungkim thei nading, nangma gouluo sungah ka kisahthei nadingin, na mite maipha na pieh ni ciengin keima ei phawh inlen, amate na hutkhiet ciengin kei zong ei hu in.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate ule kote ka ni-un ka maw zo ta uhi; khielna ka bawl zo ta vua, ka gitlo gamtat ta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Egypt ah ka pu ka pate a op lai-un, amate in na nasepna lamdangte a ngaisun kha sih uhi; amate in a kicing na itna kip a na phawh kha sih vua, tuale mahin San Tuipi ah Sangpen Pa a na langpan uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle a lien mama ama’ vanglietna a kitheisah nadingin, ama’ min a khuolna tawh amate na hunkhie hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in San Tuipi hosie a, tuale a kanggaw pai hi; senel gam kantan bangin ama in tuithuh kantanin amate a peipi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a langte’ khut sung panin amate hundam a, a galte’ khut sung panin zong amate hunkhie hi."},"11":{"text":"A langte uh tui in hlummang a, a suohta khat zong om lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in ama’ thugen a um uhi; amate in ama phatna la sa uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in ama’ nasepte a mangngil pai uhi; amate in thukuppi dingin ama a ngah tuom sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle amate in gamlahah a dugawna uh ki-ip zo loin, senel gam sungah Pasien a ze-et uhi;"},"15":{"text":"ama in amau’ nget pen pie a, ahi vangin amate lahah gawngtam natna a tungsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in giephuol-a om Moses le Topa’ mi siengtho Aaron a haza uhi."},"17":{"text":"Lei kihongin Dathan valtum a, tuale Abiram pawlte zong lei in a vuamang hi."},"18":{"text":"Amau’ pawl sungah mei zong kuong a, tua meikuong in migilote a katum hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in Horeb ah bawngno lim khat bawlin, a kisung tua milim a bie uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ minthanna pen lopa a ne bawngtang lim tawh a khel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in Egypt gam sungah na lienpi a bawl, Ham gam sungah na lienpi a sem, San Tuipi ah a giinhuoi nate a bawl, a hundampa uh Pasien a mangngil ta uhi.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama in amate susie ding a, a susie ding ahi ama’ lungthahna panin a heikhie dingin a mai-ah ama’ teelpa Moses ding lo hi leh, amate ka susie ding hi, a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in tua gamnuom a simmaw vua, ama’ kamciemna a um sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"A puonbuh sung vuah amahaw a phuncieh vua, Topa’ thugen a mang sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ziehin ama in a khut lamto-in, gamlahah amate a pua nadingun amate tungah kiciem a,"},"27":{"text":"tuale minamte lahah a suonlehlahte uh kithezahin, leitung gam zosie-ah amate a thethang hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Peor-a Baal pasien a bel vua, misite dinga kithoina-a kipie sate a ne uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amahaw’ gamtatna tawh Topa a lungthah sah vua, tuale amate lahah pul natna a tung hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Phinehas dingin a thum pieh a, tuale pul natna a veng hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua thu pen a khang khangin ama’ dihna-in kiciemte zing hi."},"32":{"text":"Meribah tui gei-ah amate in Topa a lungthahsah vua, amate ziehin Moses in hahsatna a na thuohlaw hi;"},"33":{"text":"amate in a hlagau a lungthahsah ziehun, ama in kamkhauh a na suo dawh ta hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa’ thupieh bangin, amate in mite a that sih vua,"},"35":{"text":"hinanle minamte tawh amate kisawhalin, amau’ gamtat banga gamtat ding a kisin uhi."},"36":{"text":"Amate adinga thang ahi, a milimte uh’ na a sem uhi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in dawite biehna-in a tapate ule a tanute uh a nei uhi."},"38":{"text":"Amate in Canaan gam milimte biehna-in mawna a nei lo a tanute ule a tapate uh’ sisan a luongsah vua, sisan tawh gam sung a buasah uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tua bang a sepnate un amate buasah a, a gamtatnate sung vuah amau le amau a kizua a suoh uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mite tungah Topa’ lungthahna kikuontaw a, tuale ama in a gouluo a kidah hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate a muda mite in amate a uh thei nadingin, ama in minamte’ khut sungah amate a pie hi."},"42":{"text":"A galte un amate a bawlsie vua, tuale a khut nei vuah amate koi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in tam veipi amate hunkhie a, ahi vangin amate in ledona lungsim a vom uhi, tuale amau’ khielna ziehin amate a kiniemkoi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua bang hinanle zong amau’ kikona a zah ciengin, ama in a cimawna uh a don hi."},"45":{"text":"Amau’ vang tawh ama in a thuciemna a phawhkia a, a kicing ama’ itna kip dung zui-in khuotuona a lah hi."},"46":{"text":"Amate sala a man mi zosie in a hlasietpi za dong dingin ama in a piengsah hi."},"47":{"text":"Topa aw, kote ei hun inlen, kote in na min siengtho tungah lungdam ka ko thei nading ule kote in na minthanna ka phat thei nadingun, minamte kung panin kote ei kaikhawm in."},"48":{"text":"Topa Israel Pasien in a tawntung pan a tawntung dongin thupha nga taheh. Mi zosie in, “Amen” ci ta uheh. Topa phat un!"}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdam ko un; azieh pen ama hoi a, ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","title":"BU NGANA (Late 107–150) Hamsatna pan Suotahna Zieha Lungdamkona","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Nisuona le nitumna lam, leilu lam le leitaw lam, gam teng pana a kaikhop, hahsatna pana a tatkhiet Topa’ tatsa mite in tu-a teng ci kiakia uheh.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Pawlkhatte ahile senel gamdai-ah a vahvai vua, a tenna ding uh khuopi tunna lampi a mu zo sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gilkiel dangta-in a om vua, a sung vuah a hlagau uh a balia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin lungkhamin Topa kungah a kiko vua, ama in a lungkhamna uh panin amate a hunkhie hi."},"7":{"text":"A tenna ding khuopi a tun dongun ama in lampi manah amate a pui hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama’ itna kip le mihingte tunga a lamdang ama’ nasepte ziehin, Topa tungah amate in lungdam ko ta uheh,"},"9":{"text":"azieh pen ama in a dangtate taisah a, tuale ama in a gilkielte, na hoite tawh a dim hi."},"10":{"text":"Pawlkhatte khuomu lah, mielking sungah a to vua, thongkiete in gentheina le siakol bulna a thuoh uhi,"},"11":{"text":"azieh pen amate in Pasien’ thugente a ledo vua, Sangpen Pa’ lamlahnate a niel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Na ham sepna tawh amate a lungkie uhi; amate a puasuh vua, a panpi ding koima om lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a lung uh khamin Topa kungah a kiko vua, ama in a lungkhamna panun amate a hunkhie hi;"},"14":{"text":"ama in khuomielna le lungzinna panin amate a peipi a, a kikhina uh botsan hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama’ itna kip le mihingte tunga a lamdang a nasepnate ziehin Topa tungah lungdamko ta uheh."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in sumngo kotpite sukeh a, sia zawlte tun ni a suo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pawlkhatte a gitlo gamtat ziehun a ci uh na a, amau’ khielna ziehin gentheina a thuoh uhi;"},"18":{"text":"amate in an kici mawngmawng du loin a luoh uh suoh a, sina dawngkot tawh amate a nai ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate lungkhamin Topa kungah a kiko vua, tuale a lungkhamna uh panin amate a hunkhie hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in thu vaihlahin amate damsah a, suhsietna panin amate suohtasah hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ itna kip le mihingte tunga a lamdang a nasepnate ziehin Topa tungah amate in lungdamko ta uheh."},"22":{"text":"Amate in lungdamko biehpiehnate pie uh hinlen, lungdam lasahna tawh ama’ nasepnate gen uheh."},"23":{"text":"Pawlkhatte tembaw tawh tuipi tungah a pei vua, tuipi liente tungah sumbawl nasep a sem uhi;"},"24":{"text":"Topa’ nasepnate, tuili thuhpi sunga ama’ nasep lamdangte amate in a a mu uhi."},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in thu pie a, huipite langin, tuipi huolte sangtahin a kato hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate vanlam sena-in a kinei vua, a thuhna lamah a kiesuh uhi. Amau’ tuosietna sungah a hanna uh a tuisuoh mang hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate zukham bangin a hawilen kawikawi vua, ci nading mel a thei sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate lungkhamin Topa kungah a kiko vua, ama in a lungkhamna uh panin amate a hunkhie hi;"},"29":{"text":"ama in huipi daisah a, tuipi huolte a sip dide hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuate a khawl zo tah ziehin amate a lungdam vua, tuale ama in a lunggulna mun vuah amate a peipi hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama’ itna kip le mihingte tungah a lamdang a nasepte ziehin, Topa tungah lungdamko ta uheh."},"32":{"text":"Mihon kikhopna sungah amate in ama patawi-in, upate kikhopna munah ama phat ta uheh."},"33":{"text":"Ama in guntuite senel gam suohsahin, ciatuite leigaw suohsah a, tua gam sunga a teng mihingte’ gitlona ziehin,"},"34":{"text":"an tampi pienna gam pen cilei gawta a suohsah ta hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in senel gam buoltui suohsah a, ngal gawta ciatui a suohsah hi."},"36":{"text":"Khum munah ama in a gilkielte tengsah a, amate in a tenna ding uh khuopi a sat uhi;"},"37":{"text":"amate in lo-ah khaici tu-in, lenggui a suon vua, an tampitah a la uhi."},"38":{"text":"Ama’ thupha tawh ante nahpi-in pung a, ama in a bawngte uzong a kiemsah sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Bawlsietna, buoina, le dana ziehin amate kiemsuhin, a kiniemkoi suh ciengin,"},"40":{"text":"ama in a bawlsiete tungah a lungkim lona sungsuhin, lam op lona gamlahah kivielesah kawikawi a,"},"41":{"text":"hinanle a gentheina uh panin ama in tasamte lamto a, tuuhon bangin a innkuonpite a pungsah hi."},"42":{"text":"Thuman mite in tua khu mu-in a kipah vua, tuale gitlona zosie in a kam uh a sipsah hi."},"43":{"text":"A pilte in tamte thupi sanin, Topa’ itna kip lungngai ta uheh."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien aw, ka lungsim kip hi, ka lungsim kip hi; keima in ngaitahin la ka sa ding hi. Ka hlagau aw, khanglo in!","title":"Phatna le Guolzaw nading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Harp le lyre lasahna aw, khanglo un! Zingmawng phalvah ka phong ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, mite lahah nangma tungah lungdam kang ko ding a, minamte lahah nangma tungah phatna la ka sa ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen vantungte sangin na itna kip sangzaw a, nangma’ thumanna in meiipite dong banto hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasien aw, vantungte tungah kidomsang to inlen, leitung mun vannuoi-ah na minthanna om taheh."},"6":{"text":"Na it mite a suotah thei nadingun, na zietlam khut tawh guolzawna ei pie inlen, keima ei dawng in."},"7":{"text":"Pasien in a mun siengtho sungah thu a ciem zo hi: “Guolzaw lungdamna tawh Shechem ka phalsuo ding a, Succoth Kuom ka sekhen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead khu keima-a’ ahi hi; Manasseh zong khu keima-a’ ma ahi hi. Ephraim ka sia lukhu ahi hi; Judah pen keima’ ciengkhut ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Moab ka kisilna kuong ahi hi; Edom tungah ka kedap ka sep ding hi; Philistia gam tungah guolzawna tawh ka awng hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Koi in kulpi nei khuopi-ah keima ei peipi ding ahei? Koi in Edom gamah keima ei pui ding ahei?"},"11":{"text":"Pasien aw, nang in ko ei nuol zo ta hi lo na mah? Pasien aw, ka galkapte utawh na kuonkhie ton sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Aw, ka galdona vuah kote ei panpi in, azieh pen mihing’ panpina a mawhna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien tawh hangtahin i do ding uhi; i galte tuoncil ding ama ahi hi."}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kang phat Pasien aw, dai op mawh sin.","title":"Dihtansah nading le Thuhkia ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka langkhatah migilote le zuouthu gente a kamkah vua, amate in ka langkhatah zuou genna leii tawh thu a gen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in mudana kammalte tawh kei ei imtawm vua, thu om lopi-in ei do uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka itna ei thuhna-un amate adinga thungetna ka nei laitah nangawnin, keima ei mawsah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in kei tungah hoina sietna tawh, itna mudana tawh ei thuhkia uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in, “Ama do dingin migilo khat koi un; ama’ ziet lamah a mawsah ding mi khat dingsah un."},"7":{"text":"Ama thu a kisit ciengin, thu lelin kimu heh; ama’ thungetna zong mawna-in kisimpieh heh."},"8":{"text":"A khan kumte tom hinlen; midang khat in ama’ za luo taheh.","ref":"Sawl 1:20"},"9":{"text":"Ama’ tate pa nei loin om hinlen, ama’ zi zong meigong hi taheh."},"10":{"text":"A tate khutdaw ngenin vah kawikawi heh; a kisie amau’ tenna panin kinotmang ta uheh."},"11":{"text":"A leibatna pa in a neisa zosie kilah dawh taheh; khuolmite in ama’ sepsa gate tomgam pieh ta uheh."},"12":{"text":"Ama tungah a migi koima khat zong om loin, pa nei lo ama’ tate khuotuo ding koima om sih heh."},"13":{"text":"Ama’ suonlehlahte mangthai taheh; khang nina ciengin ama’ min kiphietmang taheh."},"14":{"text":"Topa mai-ah a pa’ khielna kiphawhkia hinlen, a nu’ mawna kiphiet mang sih taheh."},"15":{"text":"Topa mai-ah tuate omsah suoh unlen, leitung panin ama’ kiphawna om ta sih heh."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in migitna lah ding phawh kha loin, mizawng mi cimawte le lungsim kitamzan mite a si dongin a gamdel zawsop hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in mi samsiet nuom a sa hi; ama tungah samsietna tung taheh. Ama in thupha a dei sih hi; ama le thupha kigamla taheh."},"18":{"text":"Ama in samsietna puon tungsil bangin sil a, ama’ pumpi sungah tui bangin, a gu a tangte sungah sathau bangin, tuate lutin kizel taheh."},"19":{"text":"Tua samsietna khu ama’ kituomna puontuol bang hinlen, nisima a kigahna khu kawnggah bang taheh,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua khu keima ei mawsahte tung, ka hinkhuo ei gensiete tungah, Topa kung pana ang pei a thaman uh hi taheh."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa ka Pasien aw, na min na khuolna tawh keima tangin hing pang in; na itna kip hoi ahi ziehin keima ei hunkhie in."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kei zawngin ka cimaw a, keima sungah ka lungtang kisun pailet hi."},"23":{"text":"Nitah nihlim bangin ka tum ta hi; kauphe bangin ei kithingkhe hi."},"24":{"text":"Antanna ziehin ka khupte a zaw hi; ka pumpi gawngtam zo ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima ei mawsah mite’ nuisatin ka om ta hi; amate in kei ei mu ciengin a lu ei peisan uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:39; Mrk 15:29"},"26":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien aw, keima ei hu in! Na itna kip dung zui-in keima ei hundam in."},"27":{"text":"Tami nangma’ khut tawh kibawl ahi lam amate theisah in; Topa aw, nangma in tuate na bawl zo ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in ei samsah in, hizongle nang in thupha nei pie ding hi. Ka langte maizumsah in; na nasempa ei lungdamsah in."},"29":{"text":"Keima ei mawsah mite mindaina silsah inlen, puontuolpi sil bangin a maizumna sung vuah kituomcip ta uheh."},"30":{"text":"Ka kam tawh nahpitahin Topa tungah lungdam ka ko ding hi; keima in mihonte lahah ama ka phat ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a sina ding dong uh a mawsah thukhenna a pie dingte kung panin, amate a hundam dingin mi cimawte’ ziet lamah ama a ding hi."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in ka pu pa kungah, “Na galte na keng ngahna ka hisah masangsie, ka ziet lamah to in,” a ci hi.","title":"Pasien’ Siempu-Kumpi ading Guolzaw Hlamuonna","ref":"Mat 22:24; Mrk 12:36; Luk 20:42-43; Sawl 2:34-35; 1Cor 15:25; Eph 1:20-22; Col 3:1; Heb 1:13; 8:1; 10:12-13"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Zion panin a vanglien na kumpi ciengkhut ang sawl hi. Na galte lahah vaihawm in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma’ galkapte Muol siengthote tungah na pui ni ciengin, na mite lungsim lawptahin amau le amau ang kipie ding uhi. Na tangvalte uh zong zingmawng naubu sung pana ang suoh daitui bangin na kungah ang pei ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa kiciem zo ta a, a lungsim a khel sih ding hi. “Melchizedek siempu gui zui-in kumtawn siempu na hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 5:6; 6:20; 7:17, 21"},"5":{"text":"Na ziet lamah Topa om hi; ama’ thangpai ni-in ama in kumpite a suzan ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in mite lahah thukhen ding a, tua munte siluong tawh a kidimsah ding hi; ama in a zai mama leitungah lutangte a tansan ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in lam gei-a tui a dawn ding hi; tua ahi ziehin ama in a lu a phongto ding hi."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Mi thumante kipawlna, mihon kikhopna sungah ka lungsim zosie tawh Topa tungah lungdam ka ko ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Na Lamdang Sepnate Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ nasepnate lien a, nuom a sa zosie in tuate a kan uhi."},"3":{"text":"A nasepna pen patawina le thupina tawh kidim a, a thumanna kip tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a na lamdang sepnate thei zing dingin a bawl hi; Topa pen migi-in mi khuotuo siem pa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in ama a zatahte an a pie hi; ama in a thuciemna a phawh zing hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a mite tungah minamte’ gouluo piehna tawh a vanglien ama’ nasepnate a lah zo hi."},"7":{"text":"A khut tawh a nasepnate muonhuoi-in thutang hi; a thuhilnate zosie zong muontah mama hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate a tawntunga a kipden ahi a, muonhuoina le thutang tawh a kisem ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a mite tungah tatkhietna a sawl hi; ama in kumtawn man dingin a thuciemna a bawl zo hi. Ama’ min siengtho giinhuoi mama hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa zatahna in pilna kipatna ahi hi; tua pilna a zuite zosie in theitelna hoi a nei uhi. Ama phatna kumtawnin kip hi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Pau 1:7; 9:10"}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Topa zatah a, ama’ thupiehte nuom a sa mite thupha nga ahi uhi.","title":"Midihte’ Nga ding Thuphate"},"2":{"text":"Amau’ suon le hlahte leitungah mi thahat ahi ding uhi; thuman mite’ khanggui thupha kipie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A inn sung vuah neilelam le haunate om ding a, tuale a thumanna uzong kumtawnin a kip hi."},"4":{"text":"Thuman mite adingin khuomiel sungah amate khuovah bangin a tang uhi; amate pen a migi, mi hepi siem, le midihte ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kiphal tahin mi sum palahsah a, thutang tawh vaihawmin a gamta mite tungah thu a hoi hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile midihte kiling ngai lo ding hi; kumtawnin amate a kiphawh zing ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in thusie kithangte a giing sih uhi; Topa’ sungah a lungsim uh kipin a kho hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate a lungmuong hit hiet vua, amate a zau vawt sih ding uhi; a tawpna-ah amate in guolzawna tawh a galte a en ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"A hlawnna-in a hawm vua, mizawngte tungah a pie uhi; amau’ dihna kip tawntung hi; amau’ ki kitawisang hi.","ref":"2Cor 9:9"},"10":{"text":"migilote in mu-in a lungthah uhi; A ha uh gawi-in amate a mangthah ta uhi; migilote’ lungtup bangma lo a suoh hi."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Topa’ nasemte aw, phat un; Topa’ min phat un.","title":"Pasien, Micimawte Hupa"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ min in tu huna kipanin kumtawnin thupha nga taheh."},"3":{"text":"Nisuo-a kipan nitum dongin Topa’ min phat ding ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Minam zosie tungah Topa kitawisang a, vantungte sangin ama’ minthanna a sangzaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A sangna muna a to pa, i Topa Pasien tawh kibang koi om a,"},"6":{"text":"a gamla pana vante le leitung a ensuh koi om ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Ama in leivui panin mizawngte lamto a, ninphuol panin mi cimawte domto hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in uliente tawh amate toton sah a, ama’ mite’ uliente tawh zong amate a totonsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a ciing nupi nu ten nading inn pie a, ama pen tate a tawi nu kipah a suohsah hi. Topa phat un!"}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te, Egypt panin a pusuoh vua, kam lamdang a zang mite kung pan Jacob innkuon a peidawh ciengun,","title":"Peikhietna-ah Pasien’ Na Lamdangte","ref":"Pei 12:51"},"2":{"text":"Judah, Pasien’ mun siengtho suoh a, Israel, a uhna gam a suoh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuipi in enin taimang hi; Jordan gun a nuakia hi.","ref":"Pei 14:21; Josh 3:16"},"4":{"text":"Muolte tuutangte bangin kitom a, muoltangte tuunote bangin a kitom uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi aw, nang bang dinga taimang dawh na hei? Jordan aw, nang bang dinga nuakia dawh na hei?"},"6":{"text":"Muolte aw, bang dingin tuutang bangin kitomin, muoltangte aw, bang dingin tuuno bangin kitom na hi uh ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Leitung aw, suongpi buoltui suohsahin, thausuong ciatui a suohsah pa, Jacob Pasien’ opna ahi, Topa’ opna-ah citunin om in.","merge":"8","ref":"Pei 17:1-7; Gam 20:2-13"}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ko tungah hi loin, Topa aw, ko tungah hi loin, na itna kip le na thumanna hangin na min in minthanna nga taheh.","title":"Bangma lo Milimte le Pasien’ Itna"},"2":{"text":"Bang dingin minamte in, “A Pasien uh hei-a om ahei?” ci laizang ding uh ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Vantungah i Pasien uh om hi; ama in a dei popo a sem hi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ milimte pen kham le ngun hi lel a, tuate mihingte’ khut tawh kibawl ahi bo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuate in kam a nei vangun a ham thei sih uhi; mit a nei vangun khuo a mu thei sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in bil a nei vangun khuo a za thei sih uhi; nahkuo a nei vangun a gimnam a thei sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in khut a nei vangun a tham thei sih uhi; amate in keng a nei vangun, lam a pei thei sih uhi; a lawlhawm un zong aw a gingsah thei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate a bawlte le tuate a muong zosiete, tuate ma tawh kibang ahi uhi.","ref":"Late 135:15-18; Kln 9:20"},"9":{"text":"Israel aw, Topa muong in! Ama pen amau’ hupa le amau’ kidalna lum ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Aaron innkuonte aw, Topa muong un! Ama pen amau’ hupa le amau’ kidalna lum ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"No Topa a zatah mite aw, Topa muong un! Ama pen amau’ hupa le amau’ kidalna lum ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in eite ei phawh hi; ama in eite thupha ei pie ding hi; ama in Israel innkuon thupha a pie ding hi; ama in Aaron innkuonte thupha pie ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"ama in Topa a zatahte a lien a neu-in thupha pie ding hi.","ref":"Kln 11:18; 19:5"},"14":{"text":"Topa in noma le na tate na nipi-un hing pungsah taheh."},"15":{"text":"Vantung le leitung a bawl Topa in note thupha hing pie taheh."},"16":{"text":"Vantungte ahile Topa’ vantungte ahi a, ahi vangin ama in mihingte tungah leitung a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Misite in ahi a, gamdaina sunga a peisuh poma in ahi zongin Topa a phat sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuhun a kipanin Topa i phat zing ding uhi. Topa phat un!"}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ka it hi, azieh pen ama in ka aw le ka thumnate ei za zo hi.","title":"Natna pana Damkiana Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Kei lamah a bil ei ngat ziehin, ka hin laisie-in ama ka hlan ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sina thangte in kei ei kimkot hi; Misikhuo natnate in kei ei tucip hi; keima in lungkham mangbahnate ka thuoh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in Topa’ min ka hlan a: “ Topa aw, ka hinna ei hun in,” ci-in thu ka ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa pen hepi siemin thuman hi; i Pasien in mi a khuotuo hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in thu thei lote kem hi; ei kinetniem ciengin ama in keima ei hunkhie hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka hlagau aw, Topa in nangma tungah a kicingin hing bawl zo ahi ziehin na toidamna munah hing kilekia in."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nangma in sina panin ka hlagau na hunkhie a, hlituite panin ka mit hunkhie-in, kipaina panin ka keng na hunkhie zo hi."},"9":{"text":"A hingte’ gam sung Topa mai-ah kei ka vah kawikawi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Keima in nahpi-in gimna ka thuoh hi,” ka ci hun nangawnin keima in ka upna ma ka tu lenlon hi.","ref":"2Cor 4:13"},"11":{"text":"Ka cimaw ziehin, “Mi zosie zuou gen vive hi,” ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima tunga ama’ hoina zosie ziehin Topa tungah bang tawh thuhkia ding ka hei?"},"13":{"text":"Keima in hutdamna hai ka domsang ding a, Topa’ min ka hlan ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A mite zosie’ opna mai-ah Topa tungah ka thuciemna, ka pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa muna-ah ama’ thuman mite sina pen manpha mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, keima na nasempa ka hi hi; nangma’ nasem ka hi a, na nasem nu’ ta ka hi hi. Nangma in kei ei kikhinate nei sutpieh zo ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima in nangma tungah lungdamko biehpiehna lui-in, Topa’ min ka hlan ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, ama’ mite zosie mai, Topa’ inn huong sung, nangma’ laizangah Topa tunga ka kiciemnate ka pie ding hi. Topa phat un!","merge":"19"}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minam zosiete aw, Topa phat un! Mi zosiete aw, ama phat un!","title":"Mi Vannuoi ading Biehna","ref":"Rom 15:11"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite tungah ama’ itna kip lien mama a, Topa’ muonhuoina kip tawntung hi. Topa phat un!"}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdam ko un, azieh pen ama hoi hi; ama’ itna kip tawntung hi!","title":"Guolzawna La","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te in, “Ama’ itna kip tawntung hi,” ci ta uheh."},"3":{"text":"Aaron innkuonte in, “Ama’ itna kip tawntung hi,” ci ta uheh."},"4":{"text":"Topa a zatah mite in, “Ama’ itna kip tawntung hi,” ci ta uheh."},"5":{"text":"Ka lungkhamna panin Topa ka hlan hi; Topa in ei dawngin, mun tanzau-ah ei koi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka gei-ah Topa ang om a, kei ka zau sih hi. Mihingte in kei bang ei law zo ding ahei?","ref":"Heb 13:6"},"7":{"text":"Keima ei panpi dingin kei lamah Topa a om hi; keima in ei muda mite guolzawna tawh ka en ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi i muon sangin Topa bel ding hoizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Uliente i muon sangin Topa bel ding hoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Minam zosie in ei imtawm uhi; Topa’ min tawh amate ka vatmai hi!"},"11":{"text":"Amate in ei kimkot vua, ka kimvelah ei imtawm uhi; keima in Topa’ min tawh amate ka vatmai hi!"},"12":{"text":"Amate in khuoi bangin kei ei imtawm uhi; amate ahi uleh lingkung kuong bang uhi; keima in Topa’ min tawh amate ka vatmai hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka pua nadingin nahpitahin ei kisawn a, ahi vangin Topa in keima ei panpi hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa pen ka hatna le ka vanglietna ahi hi; ama pen keima ei kihutdamna a suoh hi.","ref":"Pei 15:2; Isa 12:2"},"15":{"text":"Midihte’ puonbuh sungah guolzawna la kisa hi;"},"16":{"text":"“ Topa’ zietlam khut kilamto hi; Topa’ zietlam khut in hangtahin na sem hi,” kici hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei si loin ka hingzaw ding a, Topa’ nasepte ka gengen ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in nasie tahin kei thu ei hil zo a, hinanle ama in sina cieng ei thuohsah sam lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdam ko-in ka lut thei nadingin, thumanna kotpite kei ei hon in."},"20":{"text":"Tami Topa’ kotpi ahi hi; tua panin midihte a lut ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Nangma in kei ei dawngin, ka hutdamna na hi ziehin nangma tungah ka lungdam hi."},"22":{"text":"Innlamte in a nuolsa suongpi pen innkiu suongpi a suoh zo hi.","ref":"Luk 20:17; Sawl 4:11; 1Pet 2:7"},"23":{"text":"Tami Topa’ nasep ahi hi; tam pen eite’ mitah lamdang hi.","ref":"Mat 21:42; Mrk 12:10-11"},"24":{"text":"Tuni pen Topa’ bawlsa ni ahi hi; tami ni-ah nuomin kipah va vui."},"25":{"text":"Topa aw, kote ei hun in, nangma tungah kang thum uhi!","ref":"Mat 21:9; Mrk 11:9; Jhn 12:13"},"26":{"text":"Topa’ min tawh ang pei pa in thupha nga taheh. Kote in Topa’ inn panin thupha kang pie uhi.","ref":"Mat 21:9; 23:39; Mrk 11:9; Luk 13:35; 19:38; Jhn 12:13"},"27":{"text":"Topa pen Pasien ahi a, ama in eite khuovah ei pie zo hi. Singnate tawi-in maitam sakite dongah guol nuomin kizawt un."},"28":{"text":"Nang ka Pasien na hi a, na tungah lungdam kang ko ding hi; nang ka Pasien na hi a, nangma kang phat ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdam ko un, azieh pen ama hoi a, ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thukham zui-in kalsuon a, a gamtatna vua a genbang lote thupha nga ahi hi.","title":"Pasien’ Thukham a Thupina"},"2":{"text":"Ama’ thupiehte zui-in lungsim tahpi tawh ama a suite thupha nga ahi a,"},"3":{"text":"khielna zong bawl loin ama’ lampi a zuite thupha nga ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma’ thuhilte limtaha a kizui nadingin thu na pie zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thukipte ka zuina ah ka lampite suhkipin om taheh!"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin na thupiehte zosie mit tuhna’n ka nei ziehin, ei kimaizumsah lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A dih na ngaina kipte ka sin ciengin keima in lungsim man tawh kang phat ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na thukhamte ka zui ding hi; kei ei nuasie malmal sin."},"9":{"text":"Tangvalte in amau’ gamtatna a sientho nadingin bangci kep ding uh ahei? Na kammal banga zuina tawh siengthosah thei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka lungsim zosie tawh nang kang sui hi; na thupiehte panin kei ei pielsah sin."},"11":{"text":"Na tunga kang maw lo nadingin ka lungsim sungah na thu ka khol hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, thupha nga ta in; na thukhamte kei ei hil in."},"13":{"text":"Na kam pana ang pusuoh na ngaina kipte zosie ka nephu tawh ka pulah hi."},"14":{"text":"Hauna zosie a nga tawh kibangin na thukipte zui nuom ka sa hi."},"15":{"text":"Na thuhilnate lungngai-in na lampite mit tuhna’n ka nei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na thukham sungah nuom ka sa ding hi; na thu ka mangngil sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nungta-in nangma’ thu ka zui thei nadingin na nasempa keima ei lawcingsah in."},"18":{"text":"Na thukham sung pan a lamdang nate ka mu thei nadingin ka mit ei honpieh in."},"19":{"text":"Kei pen tam leitungah pemta bangin ka teng hi; keima kung panin na thupiehte phuol sin."},"20":{"text":"Na ngaina kipte a tawntungin ka lunggul ziehin ka hlagau a haisam hi."},"21":{"text":"Na thupiehte pana a vahmang, a kisamsie, a kiphasahte na phawhsie hi;"},"22":{"text":"na thukipte zui ka hi ziehin ka kung panin amau’ ei nuisatna le ei simmawnate la dawh ta’n."},"23":{"text":"Miliente in kei ei langpan nading thu a dap vaihawm vangun, na nasempa in na thupiehte a lung ngaingai ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na thukipte keima’ nopsahna ahi a, tuate ka thukuppite ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ka hlagau leivui lahah a kipawi hi; na thu om bangin ei hingsahkia in."},"26":{"text":"Ka gamtatnate kang gen ciengin nangma in keima nei dawng hi; na thukhamte ei hil in."},"27":{"text":"Na thuhilna dante ei telsah inlen, na bawl nalamdangte ka lung ngaingai ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Dana ziehin ka hlagau a zungmang dawh ta hi; na thu om bangin keima ei thahatsah in."},"29":{"text":"A man lo lampite tawh ei kigamlasah in; hepina tawh na thukham ei hil in."},"30":{"text":"Thuman lampi ka tel zo hi; ka mai-ah na ngaina kipte ka koi hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa aw, na thukipte ka pom hi; kei ei maizumsah sin."},"32":{"text":"Ka theitelna na khansah ziehin na thupiehte bangin ka zui hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa aw, na thukham lampite ei hil in. tua hi leh a tawpna dongin ka zui ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Na thukhamte kemin ka lungsim zosie tawh ka zui thei nadingin thutelna ei pie in."},"35":{"text":"Na thupieh lampite ah keima ei pui in, bangzieh ahei cile tuate ah nuom ka sa hi."},"36":{"text":"Ka lungsim pen angsung khuolna lam hi loin, na thukip lamah ei heipieh in."},"37":{"text":"Bangma lote ka etna panin ka mit ei heipieh in; na lampite ah hinna ei pie in."},"38":{"text":"Ang zatah mite dinga na kamciem, na nasempa tungah hing kipsah in."},"39":{"text":"Na ngaina kipte hoi ahi ziehin ka kung panin ka giin mama mindaina ei heimangpieh in."},"40":{"text":"En in, keima in na thuhilnate ka lunggul hi; Na thumanna sungah hinna ei pie in."},"41":{"text":"Topa aw, na kamciem bangin itna kip, na hutdamna kei tungah hing tungsah in."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciengin na thu muong ka hi ziehin ei zako mite ka dawn nading ka nei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Na ngaina kipte lamen ka hi ziehin, ka kam panin thutah kammalte la dawh malmal sin."},"44":{"text":"A tawntungin tatsat loin na thukhamte ka zui ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Na thuhilnate ka sui ziehin suohta tahin ka vah ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Kumpite mai-ah zong nangma’ thukipte ka gen ding a, maizumna ka thuoh sih ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Keima in tuate ka dei ziehin tua na thupiehte sungah keima’ nopsahna ka mu hi."},"48":{"text":"Keima’ dei ahi na thupiehte ka zatah a, nangma’ thukhamte ka lung ngaingai ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Keima nei lametsah ahi na nasempa tunga na kammal phawh in."},"50":{"text":"Tam khu ka lunggim hun cienga ka kihenepna ahi a, tua na kamciem in keima hinna ei pie hi."},"51":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte in kei ei zako vua, hinanle na thukham panin kei ka piel sih hi."},"52":{"text":"Topa aw, hun lui lai-a kipanin nangma’ ngaina kipte ka ngaisut khah ciengin, ka lung a nuom hi."},"53":{"text":"Na thukham a nuasie migilote ziehin ka sin a so hi."},"54":{"text":"Ka opna inn popo ah na thukhamte la-in ka sa hi."},"55":{"text":"Topa aw, zanin na min ka phawh a, na thukham ka zui hi."},"56":{"text":"Na thuhilnate ka zui ziehin keima tungah tam thuphate ang tung hi."},"57":{"text":"Topa keima’ satanh ahi hi; na thute zui ding ka kiciem hi."},"58":{"text":"Ka lungsim zosie tawh na maipha kang ngen hi; na thuciem a omsa bangin keima ei hepi in."},"59":{"text":"Na lampite ka ngaisut ciengin, na thukipte lamah kang kalsuon hi;"},"60":{"text":"na thupiehte zui ding ka kinaw a, ka kiheh sih hi."},"61":{"text":"Migilote’ thangkhau tawh ei kisie nanleh keima in na thukham ka mangngil sih hi."},"62":{"text":"A dih na ngaina kipte ziehin nang ang phat dingin zankim laitahin ka tho hi."},"63":{"text":"Kei, nang ang zatah mite le nangma’ thuhilnate a zui mi zosiete’ kigoppi a guolpa uh ka hi hi."},"64":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip tawh leitung a kidim hi; na thukhamte kei ei hil in."},"65":{"text":"Topa aw, na thu om bangin na nasempa na limbawl hi."},"66":{"text":"Na thupiehte um ka hi ziehin thu khentel siemna le thu theina ei hil in."},"67":{"text":"Ei kigenthei bawl masangin kei lam ka piel a, ahi vangin tu-in nangma’ thu ka zui hi."},"68":{"text":"Nang na hoi a, sil hoi na bawl hi. Na thukhamte kei ei hil in."},"69":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte in kei zuouthu tawh ei mindaisah vua, hinanle ka lungsim zosie tawh na thuhilnate ka zui hi."},"70":{"text":"A lungsim uh sathau bangin khalh a, ahi vangin keima in nangma’ thu nuom ka sa hi."},"71":{"text":"Na thukhamte ka sin thei nadingin ei kibawlsiet pen kei adingin hoi hi."},"72":{"text":"Na kam pana ang pusuoh na thukham khu kei adingin kham le ngun tul tampite sangin hoizaw hi."},"73":{"text":"Nangma in khut tawh kei ei bawlin nei na zem hi; na thupiehte ka sin thei nadingin theitelna kei ei pie in."},"74":{"text":"Na thu sungah lametna ka nei ziehin nangma ang zatahte in kei ei mu-in a lungdam ding uhi."},"75":{"text":"Topa aw, na thukhennate man hi, ci-in ka thei a, tua na thumanna sungah nei gentheibawl hi."},"76":{"text":"Na nasempa tunga na kamciem a om bangin nangma’ itna kip pen ka kihenepna hi taheh."},"77":{"text":"Nangma’ thukham in ka nopsahna ahi ziehin, ka hin thei nadingin kei tungah na lungsietna hing tungsah in."},"78":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte in solna tawh ei lebawl ahi ziehin, amate maizumsah in. Kei ka hi leh na thuhilnate ka lungngaingai ding hi."},"79":{"text":"Na thukipte a thei nadingun nangma ang zahtahte kei lamah hing kiheisah in."},"80":{"text":"Maizumna ka thuoh lo nadingin nangma’ thukhamte ah ka lungsim paubang loin om taheh."},"81":{"text":"Na hutdamna lunggulin ka hlagau a vulnang hi; keima in na thu sungah kinepna ka nei hi."},"82":{"text":"Na kamciemte ka etetna-in ka mitte a kham ta hi; keima in, “Bang hun ciengin ei henem ding na hei? ci-in ka dong hi."},"83":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile kei pen meikhu lahah a om savun-um ka bang a, hizongle na thukhamte ka mangngil tuon sih hi."},"84":{"text":"Na nasempa in bang tanvei thuoh lai ding ahei? Keima ei bawlsiete bang hun ciengin thukhen ding na hei?"},"85":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte in ka kieh nading dum a to uhi; amate in na thukham a mang sih uhi."},"86":{"text":"Nangma’ thupiehte zosie a tawntungin kip hi; a thu om loin kei ei kibawlsie hi; keima ei hu in!"},"87":{"text":"Amate in leitungah keima ei that zo dihtah uhi; ahi vangin keima in na thuhilnate ka taisan tuon vawt sih hi."},"88":{"text":"Nangma’ kam pana na thukipte ka zui thei nadingin na itna kip sungah keima nei hinkhawi lai hi."},"89":{"text":"Topa a om zing a, vantungah na thu kip tahin kikoi hi."},"90":{"text":"Na muonhuoina khang tawntungin kip hi; nangma in leitung na phut a, tua khu kiptahin a ding hi."},"91":{"text":"Nangma’ sena bangin tuni dongin tuate a kip uhi, bangzieh ahei cile na zosie nangma’ nasem ahi uhi."},"92":{"text":"Na thukham nuom a sa lo hi leng, ka hamsat hunin ka kisie zo ding hi."},"93":{"text":"Keima in na thuhilnate ka mangngil ngai sih ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tuate tawh kei hinna nei pie hi."},"94":{"text":"Kei nangma-a’ ka hi hi; na thuhilnate ka sui ziehin, keima ei hundam in."},"95":{"text":"Kei ei susie dingin migilote in ei buhdap uhi, ahi vangin keima in na thukipte ka ngaisun hi."},"96":{"text":"Kicinna vannuoi in ciengtan a nei lam ka mu zo a, ahi vangin na thupiehte ahile nahpi tahin a zai hi."},"97":{"text":"Aw, bangza tahin na thukham it ka hei! Sun tungtawn a ka lungngaingai khu tuami ahi hi."},"98":{"text":"Na thupieh in ka galte zosie sangin a pilzaw-in ei bawl hi, Bang ding ahei cile tua khu keima tawh a omton zing hi."},"99":{"text":"Keima in ka siete zosie sangin thutelna ka neizaw hi, azieh pen na thukipte khu ka lungngaingaite ahi hi."},"100":{"text":"Khanghamte sangin thu ka telzaw hi, azieh pen na thuhilnate ka zui hi."},"101":{"text":"Na thu ka zui thei nadingin sietna lampi zosie panin ka keng ka nuatuh hi."},"102":{"text":"Nangma in ei hil zo na hi ziehin na ngaina kipte panin ka piel sih hi."},"103":{"text":"Na thute a hlum ta mama a, ka kamah khuoizu sangin hlumzaw hi."},"104":{"text":"Na thuhilnate tung panin theitelna ka nga hi; tua ahi ziehin keima in a man lo lampi zosie ka muda hi."},"105":{"text":"Na thu in ka keng adingin meivah ahi a, ka lampi-ah khuovah ahi hi."},"106":{"text":"A thuman na ngaina kipte zui dingin ka kiciem a, ka kipsah zo hi."},"107":{"text":"Nahpi tahin gimna ka thuoh hi; Topa aw, na thu a om bangin keima hinna ei pie in."},"108":{"text":"Topa aw, ka phatna biehnate ei sang inlen, na ngaina kipte ei hil in."},"109":{"text":"Ka khut sungah ka hinna humin ka kem zing a, hizongle nangma’ thukham ka mangngil tuon sih hi."},"110":{"text":"Migilote in thang ei sie nan ule, na thuhilnate panin ka piel tuon sih hi."},"111":{"text":"Nangma’ thukipte khu tawntung ka gouluo ding ahi a, tuate keima’ lungdamna ahi hi."},"112":{"text":"Na thukhamte a tawp donga a zui zing dingin ka lungsim ka khensat hi."},"113":{"text":"Keima in a lungkaa mite ka muda a, ahi vangin na thukham ka it hi."},"114":{"text":"Nang pen ka kibuhna mun le ka kidalna lum na hi hi; na thu sungah lametna ka nei hi."},"115":{"text":"No, sietna a bawl mite aw, Pasien’ thupiehte ka zui thei nadingin keima kung panin peidawh ta un."},"116":{"text":"Keima ka hin thei nadingin na kamciem a omsa bangin ei panpi inlen, keima’ lametna-ah ei maizumsah sin."},"117":{"text":"Keima ka bih nading le na thukhamte ka thusim den nadingin keima ei tudet in."},"118":{"text":"Nangma in thukhamte panin a lampiel mite na hosie hi; bangzieh ahei cile amau’ khelpilnate a mawhna ahi hi."},"119":{"text":"Nang in leitunga migilote zosie sia-eh bangin na ngaisun hi; tua ahi ziehin keima in na thukipte ka it hi."},"120":{"text":"Kang giin ziehin ka citun a, na thukhennate zong ka giing hi."},"121":{"text":"Thutang le thuman tawh ka gamta zo hi; kei ei bawlsiete kungah ei nuasie sin."},"122":{"text":"Na nasempa a nopsah nadingin nangma hing kikham inlen, Pasien thei lo mite in kei ei gawtsah sin."},"123":{"text":"Nangma’ hutdamna le a man na kamciem ang tangtun ding ka etna-in ka mitte a gim ta hi."},"124":{"text":"Nangma’ itna kip tawh kituohin na nasempa tungah ei bawl inlen, na thukhamte ei hil in."},"125":{"text":"Keima na nasempa ka hi hi; na thukipte ka thei nadingin theitelna ei guon in."},"126":{"text":"Topa aw, na thukham kipalsat zo ahi ziehin na sepkhiet hun ahi ta hi."},"127":{"text":"A mantahin kham le kham citahte sangin nangma’ thupiehte ka itzaw hi."},"128":{"text":"Na thuhilnate zosie tawh kituohin a mantahin ka kalsuon a, a man lo lampi popo ka muda hi."},"129":{"text":"Na thukipte a lamdang hi; tua ahi ziehin ka hlagau in tuate a zui hi."},"130":{"text":"Na thute telgenna in khuo a vahsah hi; thu thei lote tungah theitelna guon hi."},"131":{"text":"Na thupiehte ka lunggul ziehin ka kam kahin ka haisam hi."},"132":{"text":"Nangma’ min a itte tunga na bawl ngai bangin kei lamah hing kihei-in keima ei hepi in."},"133":{"text":"Nei kamciemsa bangin ei kalsuonsah inlen, keima tungah khielna in thu hing vaihawmsah sin."},"134":{"text":"Keima in nangma’ thuhilnate ka zui thei nadingin mihingte’ ei bawlsietna panin keima eitan dawh in."},"135":{"text":"Na nasempa tungah na maipha hing tangsah inlen, na thukhamte ei hil in."},"136":{"text":"Na thukham a kizui lo ziehin ka hlitui hawh luon bangin a luong hi."},"137":{"text":"Topa aw, nang na dih a, na thukhennate a man hi."},"138":{"text":"Na koisa na thukipte man a, a unpi-in muontah hi."},"139":{"text":"Ka galte in na thute a mangngil tah ziehun ka deiluotna in kei ei katum hi."},"140":{"text":"Na kamciem kicien mama a, na nasempa in a dei mama hi."},"141":{"text":"Kei ka neu a, ei kisimmaw hi, ahi vangin na thuhilnate ka mangngil sih hi."},"142":{"text":"Na thumanna khu tawntung thumanna ahi hi; na thukhamte zong thuman ahi hi."},"143":{"text":"Buoina le lungkhamna keima tungah ang tung a, ahi vangin na thupiehte ahile keima’ lungkimna ahi hi."},"144":{"text":"Na thukipte a tawntungin a man hi; keima ka hin thei nadingin theitelna ei pie in."},"145":{"text":"Ka lungsim zosie tawh kang kiko hi; ei dawng in Topa aw! Na thukhamte ka zui ding hi."},"146":{"text":"Nangma kungah kang kiko hi; na thukipte ka zui thei nadingin keima ei hun in."},"147":{"text":"Phalvah masangin ka tho a, huna ngenin kang kiko hi; na thu ah ka lametna ka koi hi."},"148":{"text":"Na kamciemte ka lungngai thei nadingin, zan vilte hun masangin ka mit a hahhah hi."},"149":{"text":"Na itna kip sungah keima’ aw za inlen, nangma’ thutang sungah ka hinna ei kem in, Topa aw."},"150":{"text":"Gitlona ngimna tawh kei ei bawlsiete in kei ei neh uhi; na thukham tawh amate a kigamla mama uhi."},"151":{"text":"Hinanle Topa aw, nangma na nai om a, na thupiehte zosie zong ahi tahtah vive ahi hi."},"152":{"text":"Tuate a tawntunga a kip dingin na phukip ahi lam, nangma’ thukipte panin sawtveipi-in ka thei hi."},"153":{"text":"Na thukham ka mangngil lo ziehin keima ei hunkhie in."},"154":{"text":"Ka thu ei panpi inlen, keima ei tankhie in. Nangma’ kamciem tawh kizui-in hinna ei pie in."},"155":{"text":"Amate in na thukhamte a sui lo ziehun, migilote kung panin hutdamna a gamla om hi."},"156":{"text":"Topa aw, na khuotuona lien hi; na thutanna tawh kituohin ka hinna kei nei pie hi."},"157":{"text":"Keima ei bawlsie ka galte tampi om a, hinanle na thukipte panin kei ka piel tuon sih hi."},"158":{"text":"Amate in na thupieh a zui lo ziehun, kidahna tawh Pasien nei lote ka en hi."},"159":{"text":"Na thuhilnate bangza tahin dei ka hei ci ngaisun in. Nangma’ itna kip tawh kituohin nangma in ka hinna nei keppieh hi."},"160":{"text":"Na thugente a unpi-in thuman ahi a, a man na ngaina kipte zosie a tawntungin kip peisuoh hi."},"161":{"text":"Uliente in a thu om lopi-in ei bawlsie uhi. Ahi vangin ka lungsim in na thute a giing hi."},"162":{"text":"Van kinuasie tampi nga pa bangin nangma’ thu sungah ka kipah hi."},"163":{"text":"Zuouthu muda-in ka huo a, hinanle na thukhamte ka it hi."},"164":{"text":"A dih na ngaina kipte ziehin ni khatin sagivei nangma kang phat hi."},"165":{"text":"Nangma’ thukham a itte in lungnopna lienpi a nei uhi; amate bangma in a puasah zo sih ding hi."},"166":{"text":"Topa aw, na hutdamna ka lamen a, na thupiehte ka sem hi."},"167":{"text":"Ka hlagau in na thukipte a zui hi; keima in tuate ka nah it mama hi."},"168":{"text":"Keima in na thuhilnate le na thupiehte ka zui hi, azieh pen ka lampi zosie na masangah a om hi."},"169":{"text":"Topa aw, kang kikona na mai-ah hing tung hinlen, nangma’ thu omsa tawh kizui-in theitelna kei ei guon in."},"170":{"text":"Keima’ ang thumna na mai-ah hing tung hinlen, na kamciem omsa tawh kizui-in kei ei hunkhie in."},"171":{"text":"Na thukhamte nei hil ziehin ka nephu pan phatna ka luongsah ding hi."},"172":{"text":"Na thupiehte zosie man ahi ziehin ka leii in na kamciemna la-in a sa ding hi."},"173":{"text":"Na thuhilnate ka teel zo tah ziehin keima ei hu dingin na khutte kithawisa-in omsah in."},"174":{"text":"Topa aw, na hutdamna ngahla-in ka om a, na thukhamte ka kipahna ahi hi."},"175":{"text":"Nangma kang phat thei nadingin keima ei hingsah inlen, na ngaina kipte in kei ei husah in."},"176":{"text":"Tuu mang bangin lam ka piel zo ta hi; na thupiehte ka mangngil lo ziehin na nasempa ei sui in."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in ei dawn thei nadingin ka genthei ciengin Topa tungah ka kiko hi:","title":"Mi Daisahte Kung Pan Suohta nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa aw, zuouthu genna leii pan le mi solte kam panin kei ei hun in,” ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang zuouthu gen leii aw, na tungah bang hing kipie ding a, na tungah bang hing kiseppieh lai ding ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Galhang pa’ thaltang hiemte le luonglau meikam sa du na hi amah!"},"5":{"text":"Meshech gam sunga pemta ka hina le Kedar buhte lahah ka ten khah pen mi hamsie ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Kilemna a dei lo mite lahah sauveipi ka na teng kha ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei kilem nading dei ka hi hi; hizongle tua thu ka gen ciengin amate in galin ei bawl uhi."}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Muoltung lam enin ka dahto hi, keima ei kihuna hei pana ang pei ding ahei?","title":"Pasien’ Ei Dalna Hlamuonna"},"2":{"text":"Vantung le leitung a bawl Topa kung panin ei kihuna ang pei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in na keng a piasah sih ding hi; nang ang kem pa zong a lusu sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel a kem pa lusu lo ding a, zong kimu lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa pen nangma ang cingpa ahi hi; Topa pen na ziet lama om na kibuhna sing hlim ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Sunin ni in ang ka sih ding a, zanin hla in ang gimsah sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Sietna vannuoi panin Topa in nangma ang hu ding hi; ama in na hinna ang keppieh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in tu huna kipan a tawntungin na sungtum na pusuona-ah nangma ang kem ding hi."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate in keima kungah, “ Topa’ inn-ah pei vai!” ei ci uh ciengin ka kipah hi.","title":"Phatna La le Jerusalem ading Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, na tunkotte sungah ka keng utawh ka ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Khuopi khat a kilam Jerusalem khu dettah a kilam ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel ading thukip a omsa bangin Topa’ min tawh lungdamna ko dingin tua sungah Topa’ minamte a peito uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thukhenna tophate, David innkuon’ tophate khum munah kikoi hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem kilem nading thungen un: “Nangma ang it amate a dau uh pei taheh."},"7":{"text":"Na kulpite sungah kilemna om hinlen, na tausangte sungah zong bihna om taheh,” ci-in ngen un."},"8":{"text":"Ka sanggamte le ka guolte vang tawh, keima in, “Nangma sungah kilemna om taheh,” ka ci ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa i Pasien uh’ inn ka khuolna-in nangma’ hoi nading ka sui ding hi."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantungte-a mang topha tunga a to pa aw, nangma kang ento hi!","title":"Khuotuo ding Thumna"},"2":{"text":"Nasem pasalte in a mangpate’ khut a mitsuon bang le nasem numeite in a pi nute’ khut a mitsuon bangin, ama in eite tungah lainatna ei nei masangin, eite in Topa i Pasien i mitsuon lenlon uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kote ei khuotuo in, Topa aw, kote ei khuotuo in. Bangzieh ahei cile kote in ka thuoh zawh lo uh simmawna ka thuoh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Keima’ hlagau in a nopnop-a gamta mite’ hosietna, a kiphasah mite’ simmawna, a thuoh ding za sangin a tamzaw a thuoh hi."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Eite lamah Topa ang pang lo hi leh, Israel-te in ci ta uheh.","title":"Israel-te’ Suotahna Zieha Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"I galte in ei do ciengin eite lamah Topa ang pang lo hi leh,"},"3":{"text":"eite lamah a lungthahna uh a kikuontaw ciengin, amate in eite a hingin ei nawmval zo ta ding uhi;"},"4":{"text":"tua ciengin tuikhang in eite ei taimang ta ding a, tuihuol in zong eite ei hlummang ta ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"tua ciengin eite tungah tuipi husiepi a luong den ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amau’ ha tawh eite ei petzansah lo Topa in thupha nga taheh."},"7":{"text":"Thangsiete’ thang pana a suohta vasa bangin, thangmung kikuoitanin eite i suohta zo ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Van le lei a bawl Topa’ min sungah eite huna a om hi."}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa a muong mite pen a kilawh zo lo, a kip tawntung Zion muol tawh kibang hi.","title":"Pasien Mite’ Bihna"},"2":{"text":"Muolte in Jerusalem a kimkot bangin, tu-a kipanin Topa in a mite a kimkot tawntung ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Midihte in khielna a bawl dingin a khutte a zah lo nadingin, midihte tunga kipie gamah migilote’ kumpi ciengkhut a om sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, mi hoite tung le lungsim thuman mite tungah na hoi hing sem in."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin lampi kawi a a piel mite ahile Topa in sietna bawl mite tawh a pui ton ding hi. Israel tungah kilemna om taheh!"}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Zion’ vangphatna ang piehkia ciengin, i mang tawh a kibang va-ia hi.","title":"Anlah Pawi Lungdamna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin i kam uh nuina tawh a kidim a, i leii zong lungdam lasahna tawh a kidim hi. Tua ciengin minamte lahah, “ Topa in amahaw dingin na lienpite a bawl zo ta hi,” kici hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in eite adingin na lienpite bawl zo a, tuaci’n eite i kipah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, Negeb-a luite bangin ka vangphatna uh ei piekia in."},"5":{"text":"Hlitui tawh khaici a tute in lungdamin kikona tawh an kilah ta uheh."},"6":{"text":"Kap kawmin kuonin a tu ding khaici a puo mi in lungdamin kikona tawh bulomte puo-in ang kilekia ding uhi."}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in inn lam sih leh, a lamte’ gimna a mawhna ahi hi. Topa in khuopi cing sih leh, a cingte’ cinna a mawhna ahi hi.","title":"Inn Sunga Pasien’ Thuphate"},"2":{"text":"Zingmawng thobai-in zanlai-in na lup ha a, - nangma’ thalawsa an gim le tawl a na neh zong a mawhna ahi hi; azieh pen ama in a it mite tungah kimut hun a pie hi."},"3":{"text":"A tahtahin tate pen Topa tung pan gougil ahi a, gil sung pana pieng a ga zong khu ama’ ei pieh thaman ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khat in a khangdawn lai-a a nei tate pen galhang pa’ khut sunga om thaltangte tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"A thallawng dima thaltang a nei mipa khu thupha nga ahi hi. Kulkotpi-ah a galte tawh a kiholim ciengin ama a kimaizumsah sih ding hi."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa zatahin ama’ lampite a zui mi zosie thupha nga ahi uhi.","title":"A Lungdam Mi Thuman Innkuon"},"2":{"text":"Nangma in na khuta nasep gimna ga na ne ding hi; nang na lungdam ding a, tuaci’n nuomsa-in na daupei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na zinu pen na inn sungah a bawhpha lenggui bang ding hi; na tate pen na sabuoi kimvela olive singno dawng ngihngehte a bang ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa a zatah mipa tua bangin thupha kipie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Zion panin nang thupha hing pie taheh. Na nuntah sung tungtawnin Jerusalem’ nopsahna mu ta in."},"6":{"text":"Na tusawnte mu inlen, Israel tungah lemna om taheh!"}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate in ka neu lai-a patin tamveipi ei sim uhi,” tu-in Israel in ci heh.","title":"Israel’ Galte Pua nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka neu lai-a patin amate in tamveipi ei simmaw vangun, amate in ei zo sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Lokaite in keima’ elzangah lo a kai uhi; amate in a tuma-kuohte uh a sausah uhi,” ci ta uheh."},"4":{"text":"Topa a thuman a, migilote’ khaute a sattan zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Zion a muda mite zosie maizumin kinuale sahkia in."},"6":{"text":"Amate a khan hlit masanga a vul, innkhum vuma lopa bangsah inlen,"},"7":{"text":"tuate pen anlate in a sip dim zong a nga lo, buphai ia-te in lom khat zong a nga lo,"},"8":{"text":"lama peite in zong, “Na tungah Topa thupha om taheh! Topa’ min tawh thupha kang pie uhi,” a ci lo mite tawh kibangsah in."}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, a thuhna panin nangma kungah kang kiko hi.","title":"Pasien’ Tatkhiet ding Ngah"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, ka aw ei za in! Kang thumna awgingte na bil ei ngat inlen, limtahin ngai in!"},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma in khielnate ciemte lacin, Topa aw, koi in thuoh zo ding ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Hinanle ang kizatah thei nadingin mawmaisahna nang tawh a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa ka ngah hi, ka hlagau in zong a ngah hi, ama’ thu sungah lametna ka nei hi;"},"6":{"text":"galvilte in zingmawng a ngahla sang, galvilte in zingmawng a ngahla sangin, ka hlagau in Topa a ngahla zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel aw, Topa sungah kinem in! Azieh pen Topa tawh itna kip a om a, ama tawh a lien mama tatkhiet nading a om hi."},"8":{"text":"A khielnate zosie panun Israel tankhie ding pa khu ama ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 1:21; Titu 2:14"}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka lungsim kihisah loin, ka mitte a sangda sih hi; kei dinga a thupi sengte le a lamdang sengte ka buoipi sih hi.","title":"Sip Dide-a Muonna La"},"2":{"text":"Hizongle a nu’ nawi a tang nausen bangin siptah le daitahin ka hlagu ka omsah zo hi; ka hlagau pen keima tawh a omton nawi tang nausen tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel aw, tu-a patin a tawntungin Topa sungah kinepna nei in."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, David’ maipha tawh ama’ thuoh hahsatna zosie phawh in;","title":"Zion-a Pasien’ Kumtawn a Tenna"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah ama kiciemin, Jacob’ Vanglien Pa tungah kamciem pie a,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka inn sungah lut loin ka lupna-ah ka lum sih ding hi;"},"4":{"text":"Topa ading mun khat, Jacob’ Vanglien Pa’ ten nading mun khat ka mu masangin, kimu-in ka mit ka sing sih ding a, ka mitkhu ka khupsah sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Eite in Ephathah gam sungah tua thu i za vua, Jaar gamlah ah i mu uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Ama’ tenna munah va pei ta vai; ama’ kengngahna-ah va bie ta vai,” ka ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, tho inlen, nangma’ tawlngahna munah nangma le na hatna singkuong tawh pei in."},"9":{"text":"Na siempute in dihna puon bangin silin, na mi muonhuoite zong lungdamin awng ta uheh."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen na nasempa David’ vang tawh na sathau nu pa’ maitang heimangpieh sin.","ref":"2Khg 6:41-42"},"11":{"text":"Topa in David tungah a thawn lo kiciemna khat bawl a, tua panin ama a kiheikia sih ding hi: “Keima in na kumpi topha tungah nangma sung panin a pieng na tapate khat ka koi ding hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12-16; 1Khg 17:11-14; Late 89:3-4; Sawl 2:30"},"12":{"text":"Na tapate in ka thuciemna le amate ka hil ding ka thukipte a zui nah po uleh, na kumpi topha tungah a tapate uh zong kumtawnin a to ding uhi,” na ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in Zion a teel zo hi; ama in khum mun pen ama’ ten nadingin dei hi:"},"14":{"text":"“Tami mun pen kumtawn a ka tawlngahna mun ahi hi; tami mun dei ka hi ziehin tam sungah ka teng ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in a an nehte uh niengtahin thupha ka pie ding hi; a mizawngte uzong an tawh ka lungkimsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A siempute hutdamna puon ka silsah ding a, ama’ mi muonhuoite lungdamin a awng ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua munah David adingin ki khat ka mengsah ding hi; keima in ka sathau nu pa adingin meivah khat ka bawlpieh zo hi.","ref":"1Kum 11:36"},"18":{"text":"Ama’ galte mindaina puon ka silsah ding a, hinanle ama tungah a kumpi lukhu a val lihleh ding hi,” na ci hi."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute pumkhat suohin a ten ton valiei ciengun bangza tahin hoi-in etlawm ahei!","title":"Kipumkhatna’ Thuphate"},"2":{"text":"Tua khu Aaron’ luzang panin a khamul kai a zuisuh, a puontuol ngawng donga a taasuh sathau manpha tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua pen Zion muolte tunga a kie, Hermon daitui tawh kibang hi. Bang ding ahei cile Topa in hin dendenna ama’ thupha tua munah a pie hi."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ inn sungah zan lai-a a cing, no, Topa’ nasemte aw, hing pei unlen Topa phat un!","title":"Zan Huna Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Mun siengtho lamah na khut uh lamto-in Topa phat un."},"3":{"text":"Van le lei a bawl Topa in Zion panin thupha hing pie taheh."}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! I Pasien’ inn huong sung, Topa’ inn sunga a ding, Topa’ nasemte aw, Topa’ min phat un.","title":"Pasien’ Hoina le Hatna Zieha Phatna","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Topa phat un, azieh pen Topa hoi hi; ama’ min phatna la sa un, azieh pen ama in mi hepi hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in ama dingin Jacob teel zo a, ama’ neisa dingin Israel teel zo ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in Topa lien hi, ci ka thei hi; i Topa uh pen pasien-te zosie sangin lienzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantung le leitung, tuipite le a thuhna zosiete sungah Topa in a dei bangin na sem hi."},"7":{"text":"Leimong panin meiilumte a kaisah pa ama ahi hi; ama in guo a zuh nadingin tunphesah a, tuale a kholna panin hui pusuohsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah mihing le ganhing tacil zosie a vatmai pa ama ahi hi;"},"9":{"text":"Egypt aw, Pharaoh le a nasem zosie a do nadingin ama in nangma sungah lim le na lamdangte a sawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in minam tampi vatmai-in kumpi thahatte that hi."},"11":{"text":"Amor-te’ kumpipa Sihon, Bashan kumpipa Og, Canaan kumpite zosie that a,"},"12":{"text":"amau’ leitang, ama’ mi Israel-te, gouluo dingin a pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, na min kumtawnin kip a, Topa aw, na minthanna khang tawntungin kip hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in ama’ mite tungah thukhen a, ama’ nasemte tungah lainatna nei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte’ milimte pen mihingte’ khut tawh kibawl, ngun le khamte ahi bo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuate in kam a nei vangun a ham thei sih uhi; tuate in mit a nei vangun khuo a mu thei sih uhi;"},"17":{"text":"tuate in bil a nei vangun khuo a za thei sih vua, tuate’ kam sungah naahu a om sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuate a bawl mite, tuate a muong mite zosie pen tuate ma tawh kibang ding uhi.","ref":"Late 115:4-8; Kln 9:20"},"19":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, Topa phat un! Aaron innkuonte aw, Topa phat un!"},"20":{"text":"Levi innkuonte aw, Topa phat un! Topa a zatahte aw, Topa phat un!"},"21":{"text":"Zion panin Jerusalem-a a teng Topa in thupha nga taheh. Topa phat un!"}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama hoi ahi ziehin Topa tungah lungdam ko un, bang ding ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","title":"Piensahna le Tangthu Sunga Pasien’ Nasepna","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Aw, pasien-te’ Pasien tungah lungdam ko un, azieh pen ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw, topate’ Topa tungah lungdam ko un, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Nalamdang lienpite a bawl pa khu ama beh ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"5":{"text":"Theitelna tawh vante a bawl pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pien 1:1"},"6":{"text":"Tuite tunga leitung a pha pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pien 1:2"},"7":{"text":"Khuovah liente a bawl pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"8":{"text":"Sun hun a uh dinga ni a siem pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"9":{"text":"Zan hun a uh dinga hlapi a siem pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pien 1:16"},"10":{"text":"Egypt gam sung tenga tacilte a vatmai pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pei 12:29"},"11":{"text":"Amate lah panin Israel a peipi pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pei 12:51"},"12":{"text":"A baan zahin a khut thahat tawh a pui pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"13":{"text":"San Tuipi phalni a suo pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"A laikima Israel-te a kantansah pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle Pharaoh le a galkapte San Tuipi sunga a thalpai pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pei 14:21-29"},"16":{"text":"A mite senel gam pana a peipi pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpi liente a satlia pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi minthangte a that pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"19":{"text":"Amor-te’ kumpipa Sihon a that pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-30"},"20":{"text":"Bashan kumpipa Og a that pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Gam 21:31-35"},"21":{"text":"Amau’ leitang gouluo dinga a pie pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama’ nasem Israel-te gouluo a pie pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"23":{"text":"I nam dinmun uh a niem laitaha ei phawh pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"24":{"text":"I galte kung pana ei hunkhie pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi zosie tungah an a pie pa khu ama ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."},"26":{"text":"Vantung Pasien tungah lungdam ko un, bangzieh ahei cile ama’ itna kip tawntung hi."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion khuopi i ngaituo khah ciengin, Babylon gunte gei-ah tosuhin i kapkap hi.","title":"Jerusalem Kisietna Zieha Kaala"},"2":{"text":"Khum taha gielheh kungte tungah i lyre lasahnate i khai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen tua munah sala ei mante le ei bawlsiete in guolnop thei nadingin la i sah ding ei dei vua, amate in, “Zion late ei sahpieh un,” ei ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Gamdangah Topa’ la bangci sah thei ding uh ka hei?"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem khuopi aw, nang kang mangngil tah leh, ka zietlam khut buisum taheh!"},"6":{"text":"Nangma kang phaw khah sih a, ka lungdamna a sang pena Jerusalem kang koi sih tah leh, ka dangtawngah ka leii beh den taheh."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, Jerusalem a pua ni-in Edom mite in, “A zung dongin guoicimsah un! guoicimsah un!” a ci khu phawh in."},"8":{"text":"Mi a guoicimsah nang Babylon tanu aw, kote tunga nei bawl bangin nangma tunga ang thuhkia mite lungdam ding uhi!","ref":"Kln 18:6"},"9":{"text":"Na taneute hing lahpieh a, suongtum denna-a ang neipieh mite a lungdam ding uhi!"}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka lungsim zosie tawh nangma tungah lungdam kang ko hi; keima in pasien-te mai-ah nangma phatna la-in ka sa hi;","title":"Lungdamkona le Phatna"},"2":{"text":"na biehinn siengtho lam nga-in ka kun a, tuale nangma’ itna kip le na muonhuoina ziehin, na min kang phat hi; azieh pen nang in sil bangkim na min le na thu na tawisang zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kang hlat ni-in nei dawng a, ka hlagau thahatna na khangsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, leitung kumpi zosie in nangma ang phat ding uhi, azieh pen amate in na kam tawh na thugente a za zo uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ minthanna lien mama ahi ziehin amate in Topa’ nasepna ziete la-in a sa ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa a sangpi hinanle, ama in tuolngiem mite don a, gamlapi panin a kiphasah mite a mu veve hi."},"7":{"text":"Hahsatna kawmkalah ka pei vangin ka galte’ lungthahna panin nei kem hi; Nangma in na khut na zah a, na zietlam khut in ei hunkhie hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in kei dinga a tupna a tangtun ding hi; Topa aw, na itna kip tawntung hi. Na khuta na sepsate nuasie sin."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang in kei nei kan a, nei thei zo ta hi.","title":"A Kipel Theilo Pasien"},"2":{"text":"Nang in ka suh ka to na thei hi; ka ngaisutnate nang in gamlapi panin na thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka lampi le ka lupna na long dawh a, ka gamtatna zosie na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, ka kam panin thu khat ka gen masang nangawnin, nangma in ka thugen ding teng a unpi-in na thei zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma in ka nua ka ma-ah nei dal a, keima tungah na khut na ngam hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam banga nei theina pen kei adingin lamdang mama hi; tua khu a san seng ziehin ka thei ban zo sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma’ hlagau kung panin kei hei-ah pei ding ka hei? Nangma’ opna mun panin kei hei-ah tai ding ka hei?"},"8":{"text":"Vantungah kato leng lah tua sungah nang na om hi; Misikhuo lupna-in nei nan leng zong tua sungah nang na om veve hi."},"9":{"text":"Zingmawng’ hlate tungah tuongin tuipi mong dongah teng zong nan leng,"},"10":{"text":"nangma’ khut in tua mun nangawnah ei peipi a, nangma’ zietlam khut in keima ei tudet ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in, “Khuomiel in ei tuom valon hinlen, ka kima om khuovah zan khuomiel suoh heh,” ci ta leng zong,"},"12":{"text":"nangma adingin tua khuomiel nangawn a miel tuon sih hi; tuami zan pen sun nitang tawh kibang hi, azieh pen nang adingin tua khuomiel khuovah bang hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen ka pumpi sunglam nate a siem nangma na hi hi; nangma in ka nu’ gil sungah keima nei phan ditdet hi."},"14":{"text":"Nang in a giinhuoi le a lamdanga kei nei bawl ziehin nangma kang phat hi. Nangma’ nasepnate lamdang mama hi; tua khu ka thei siem mama hi."},"15":{"text":"A thuhna leisiet mun simtham ah ei kiguonggatin ei kisiem laitahin, nangma kung panin ka gu ka tangte a kisel sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma in a kipiengsah nai lo ka pumpi nate na mit in a mu hi. Tuate khat beh a op masang, ka ni za ding zosie a kise lai-in, nangma’ laibu sungah tua thu teng zosie kigiel zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien aw, na ngaisutnate kei dingin bangza-in manpha ahei! Tuate zosie a kigawmna bangza-in zai ahei!"},"18":{"text":"Tua tengpi ka sim sawm ciengin, senel sangin a tamzaw hi; a sim ka man zo ta hi, nang tawh ka omton lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasien aw, migilote that lacin, keima kung panin sisan a luongsah mite a kihem pan bep ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Gitlo lungsim tawh nangma’ thu a gen mite in nangma’ siet nadingin na langkhatah a pang uhi!"},"21":{"text":"Topa aw, nang ang mudate ke’n zong muda hi lo ka mah? Nangma langpanga a ding mite ke’n kidah hi lo ka mah?"},"22":{"text":"Ke’n amate ka tah muda hi; amate galte bangin ka tuot hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasien aw, keima ei kancien inlen, ka lungsim ei thei in; keima ei sittel inlen, ka ngaisutnate ei thei in."},"24":{"text":"Ka sungah gitlona lampi khatpo a om kha amah ei en inlen, tawntung lampi-ah ei pui in."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, sietna bawlte kung pan kei ei hunkhie in; mi tatsiete kung panin keima ei dal in.","title":"Galte’ Khut pana Hutkhiet ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"A lungsim sung vuah amate in thusie a gel vua, gal a phuong mielmuol uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in gulpi’ leii bangin a leii a hiemsah vua, a leii dangnei vuah muoltan’ gu a om hi. Selah","ref":"Rom 3:13"},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, migilote khut panin keima ei cing in; ka pua nading a gel mi tatsiete kung panin keima ei dal in."},"5":{"text":"Mi kiphasahte in thang ei siedap vua, amate in lenthang zahin lamdung ah ei sie uhi. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Keima in Topa kungah, “Nang ka Pasien na hi hi; keima’ ang thumna aw ei ngai in, Topa aw,” ka ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa , keima’ Topa , a thahat ei hunkhie pa aw, gal kido hun ciengin nangma in keima’ lu nei tuompieh zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, nang in migilote’ deina pie vawt sin; a gitlo sawmnate uh maban sotsah sin. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Ei kimkot mite in a lu a domsang uhi; a zuouthu gente uh amau’ lu tungah tu taheh!"},"10":{"text":"Amate tungah mei-am kiesuh taheh! A thawkia zo nawn lo nadingun dum sungah amate kiesuh ta uheh!"},"11":{"text":"Gam sungah mi gensiete kikipsah sih heh; sietna in mi tatsiete mallang tahin sulzui taheh!"},"12":{"text":"Topa in mi cimawte’ thu a vaihawmpieh a, ama in mizawngte adingin tangtaha a khen lam ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Thu man mite in nangma’ min ang phat valon ding uhi; nangma’ opna munah mi thumante a teng ding uhi."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang kang hlan hi; keima kungah hing pei meng in; nang kang hlat ciengin ka aw ei ngai in.","title":"Sietna pana Kep ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thungetna na mai-ah panamtui bangin ei simpieh inlen, ka khut kang laptona zong khu nitah biehpiehna bangin ei simpieh in.","ref":"Kln 5:8"},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, ka kam a cing ding khat ei koipieh inlen, ka nephu kotkhahte a vil ding khat ei koipieh in."},"4":{"text":"Khielna a bawl mite tawh kipawlin gitlo nasepnate-ah kitahla loin, sietna khatpo bawl ding lamah ka lungsim hing kiheisah sin; amau’ an tuituohte zong ei nesah sin."},"5":{"text":"Thuman mite in ei vuosah in; mi muonhuoite in ei thu hilsah in. Ka lu tungah migilote’ sathau kinu ngai vawt sih heh, azieh pen ka thungetna in a gitlo gamtatnate uh a langpang den hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate a mawsah ding mite tungah a ki-ap ciengun, ka thugente man hi, ci thu amate in a thei pan ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khat in suongpi satkehin lei tungah a thethang bangin, Misikhuo’ kam sungah amahaw’ gute kithezah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa ka Pasien aw, nangma lam kang mitsuon hi; keima in nangma kang beel hi; kep lo huoi loin kei ei nuasie sin."},"9":{"text":"Kei dinga a sie uh thang pan le migilote’ thang panin kei ei kem in."},"10":{"text":"Keima beh ka suotah laitahin migilote a thang vuah awh ta uheh."}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah ka aw tawh ka kiko hi; Topa tungah ka aw tawh thumna ka nei hi.","title":"Mi Bawlsiete pan Suotah ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in ama mai-ah ka lungkim lona teng ka sung hi; keima in ama mai-ah ka buoina teng ka gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka hlagau basamin a op ciengin nangma in ka lampi na thei hi. Amate in ka peina lampi-ah keima thang ei siedap uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka zietlam ka en a, ka mu hi, ei phawh kha koima om lo hi; ka kibuh nading mun a om ta sih hi; koima in kei ei don lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, nang tungah kang kiko hi; keima in, “Nang ka kibuhna na hi a, a hinglai mite’ leitangah keima’ tanh na hi hi,” kang ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kang kikona ei ngaipieh in, azieh pen a niem mama-in kei ei kikoi hi. Kei ei bawlsiete kung panin ei hundam in, azieh pen kei adingin amate a hat seng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in nangma’ min tawh lungdam kang ko thei nadingin, thong sung panin ei la dawh in. Nangma in nei limbawl ding ziehin midihte in ei kimkot ding uhi."}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna ei za inlen, na muonhuoina sungah kang thumnate na bil ei daw in; na dihna sungah keima ei dawng in.","title":"Galte kung pan Suotah ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Na nasempa kei tungah thu hing khen sin, azieh pen nangma mai-ah mihing a thuman koima om lo hi.","ref":"Rom 3:20; Gal 2:16"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen gal in kei ei delin, ka hinna tuoldenna-in nei a, hun sawtpi lai-a a site bangin khuomiel lahah ei tosah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka sunga ka hlagau a tha zawm gawp hi; ka sunga ka lungtang zong zau-in a citun hi."},"5":{"text":"Hun luite phawhkia-in, na silbawlte zosie ka ngaisun a, na khut tawh na sepsate ka lungngaingai hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in na tungah ka khut kang zah hi; gam gawta in tui a du bangin ka hlagau in nang ang hlangai hi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, kei ei dawng meng in; ka hlagau a cimaw ta hi. Keima kung panin na mai phuol sin, tua ahi sihle kei pen Leihawm sunga a pei mite ka bang ta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nang kang muon ziehin zingmawngin na itna kip ei zasah in. Nangma tungah ka hlagau kang lapto ziehin ka pei nading lampi ei hil in."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, ka galte kung panin keima ei hun in. Nangma beel dingin na kungah kang tai hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang ka Pasien na hi ziehin na deilam ka sep thei nadingin keima ei hil in. A hoi nangma’ hlagau in lamphei-ah ei pui taheh."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, na min na khuolna-in ka hinna ei keppieh in. Buoina kawmkal panin na dihna sungah ei peipi in."},"12":{"text":"Na nasempa ka hi ziehin ka galte le ka langte zosie nangma’ itna kip sungah sumang in."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka khutte galdo zie ding le ka khutmete galkap zie ding ei zilsah pa ka suongpi, Topa in thupha nga taheh;","title":"Minam Suotah nading le Bih nading Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"ama ka suongpi le ka kulpi, ka munkip muonhuoi le ei hunkhie pa, ka kidalna lum le ka bel pa ahi a, ka nei-a mite a zo pa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, na phaw tham dingin mihingte bang hi a, na ngaisut tham dingin mihingte bang hi lel ahei?","ref":"Job 7:17-18; Late 8:4"},"4":{"text":"Amate husan khat tawh kibang hi; a hinkhuo uzong ei liepsan nihlim bang ahi lel bo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, na vanpite kuoikun inlen, hing kumsuh in; amate meikhu a suo nadingin muolsangte tham in."},"6":{"text":"Tun phesah inlen, amate kithezah sah in; na thaltangte kap inlen, amate susie gawp in."},"7":{"text":"A sangna mun panin na khut hing zah in; a thahat tuithuhte le gamdang mite’ khut sung panin keima ei hunkhie inlen, ei suohtasah in."},"8":{"text":"A kamte un zuouthu vive gen a, a zietlam khut uh a zuoutat hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien aw, nangma tungah la tha kang sa ding hi; harp zamsawm lasahna tumin nangma la kang tap ding hi,"},"10":{"text":"nang pen kumpite guolzawna a pie pa, si theina namsau pana na nasem David a hunkhie pa na hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Si theina namsau panin keima ei hunkhie inlen, a kam utawh zuouthu genin, a zietlam khut utawh a zuoutat, gamdang mite’ khut sung panin kei ei hunkhie in."},"12":{"text":"Ka tapate uh a tangval lai-un hoitaha a khang singkungte bang hinlen, ka tanute uh a ngahnut lai-un kumpi inn lam nadinga a kisui inn ninga kiphut khuompite bang ta uheh."},"13":{"text":"Ka ansalte uh zong an namcin tawh kidim taheh; ka tuute uh gamlahah a tultul a thenthenin pungin,"},"14":{"text":"ka bawng ka lawite uzong a note tawh kiphamat taheh. Kulpi a vang kici om sih hinlen, sala kikai zong om loin, ka khuolai vuah lunggim kikona awging om sih taheh."},"15":{"text":"Tam bang thupha a tunna mite thupha nga ahi uhi; Topa pen amau’ Pasien ahi mite thupha nga ahi hi."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasien le ka Kumpipa aw, nangma kang patawi ding a, a tawntungin na min ka phat ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Lietna le Hoina"},"2":{"text":"Nisimin thupha kang pie ding a, a tawntungin na min ka phat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa lien hi, nahpitaha phat ding ahi hi; ama’ lietna pen kan zawh ding hi lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Khang khat in adang khang khat tungah na nasepnate phat ding a, a vanglien nangma’ silbawlte phuongzah ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"A minthang na thupina le a lamdang na silbawlte tungah ka lungngaingai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A lien a lamdang na silbawlte kitangko ding a, keima in nangma’ lietna ka pulah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in minthang a kicing na hoina a gengen ding vua, amate in nangma’ dihna nahpitahin a sa ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa pen mi hepina le mi lungsiet siempa ahi a, lungthah bai vawt loin a kicing itna kip nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi zosie tungah Topa hoi a, ama in a bawlsa zosie tungah lainatna nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa aw, na bawlsa na zosie in nangma tungah lungdam ang ko ding vua, na mi muonhuoi zosie in zong thupha ang pie ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in na kumpi gam’ a minthanna thu genin, na vanglietna a sut ding vua,"},"12":{"text":"a vanglien nangma’ sepnate le nangma’ kumpi gam a hoina, a minthannate mi zosie tungah a theisah ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na manggam pen tawntung manggam ahi a, nangma’ uhna zong khu khang tawntungin a kip hi. A thugenna zosie-ah Topa muonhuoi a, ama in a gamtatna zosie-ah mi hepina nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in a pua mizosie tukip a, ama in a kiniemkhieh mite a domsang hi."},"15":{"text":"Mit zosie in kinepna tawh nangma ang en vua, nangma in a hun a tun ciengin a an ding uh na pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma in na khut na zah a, hinna a nei zosie’ deina pie-in na lungkimsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama’ lampite vannuoi-ah Topa thutang a, ama’ gamtatna vannuoi-ah mi a khuotuo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama a hlan mi zosie, thutaha a hlan mi zosie kungah Topa a nai op hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama a zatah mi zosie’ deina ama in tangtungsah hi; ama in amau’ kikona zong za-in, amate a hundam hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in ama a it zosie cing a, ahi vangin ama in migilote zosie susie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka kam in Topa’ phatna a gen ding a, mi zosie in kumtawnin ama’ min siengtho a phat ding uhi."}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Ka hlagau aw, Topa phat in!","title":"Pasien’ Huna Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in ka hin laisie Topa ka phat ding hi; ka hin sung tungtawnin Topa phatna late ka sa ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ei panpi thei lo uliente le mihingte muong sin."},"4":{"text":"A husan uh a tawp ciengin amate lei lahah a kilekia uhi; khum ni ma-in amau’ gelnate a mangthai sieng hi."},"5":{"text":"A panpi dinga Jacob Pasien a nei, amau’ Topa Pasien sunga kinepna a nei mite thupha nga ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in van le lei, tuipi le a sunga om zosie a bawl hi; a tawntungin ama in upna kemcing den hi;","ref":"Sawl 4:24; 14:15"},"7":{"text":"ama in a kibawlsie mite adingin thu a tangin khen hi; a gilkielte an a pie hi. Topa in thongkiete a suohtasah hi;"},"8":{"text":"Topa in mittawte khuo a musah hi. Topa in a kiniemkhiehte a domsang hi; Topa in midihte a it hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in pemtate kem hi; ama in pa nei lote le meigongte panpi a, ahi vangin migilote’ gamtatna suhsietpieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Zion aw, khang tawntungin Topa na Pasien a maang den ding hi. Topa phat un!"}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! I Pasien tungah phatna late i sah ding hoi hi; azieh pen hepina tawh ama kidim a, phatna la i sah ding a kilawm ahi hi.","title":"Pasien in Jerusalem a Kepna Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khuopi khu Topa’ lam ahi hi; ama in a kipampaih Israel mite kaikhawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in lungsim kitamzante damsah a, amau’ liemnate zong a tuompieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in aasite a pha za ding se hi; tuate zosie a min uh phuo hi."},"5":{"text":"I Topa uh lien a, a kicing vanglietna nei hi; ama’ theitelna pen tezawh ding ahi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a kituoncilte lamto hi; ama in migilote tuoldenna-in nei hi."},"7":{"text":"Lungdamkona tawh Topa tungah lasa un; lyre lasahna tawh i Pasien uh tungah la ngaih sa un."},"8":{"text":"Ama in meiilum tawh vante tuom a, leitung ading guotui bawlin, muoltangte tungah lopa posah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in ganhingte le va-ah note a ham uh ciengin an a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama’ lungkimna khu sakol thahatna ahi sih a, ama’ nopsahna khu a tai mipa’ kalhatna zong ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle ama a zatah mite le ama’ itna kip sunga kinepna a nei mite tungah Topa a lungkim hi."},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem khuopi aw, Topa phat in! Zion aw, na Pasien phat in!"},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in na tunkot zawlte tosah a, na sunga a om na tate thupha a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in na gamgi zui-ah lemna ang pie hi; mangbu hoi pente tawh nangma ang gilvasah hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a thupiehna leitungah a sawl hi; a thu mallangtahin a tungsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in tuumul bangin vuakhal ei pie hi; ama in vut bangin daitui a thezah hi."},"17":{"text":"Annengkie bangin ama in gieltang a khiesuh hi. Koi in thuoh zo ding ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Ama in thupie a, tuate tui a suoh hi; ama in a hui langsah a, tuite zong a luong pai hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in Jacob tungah ama’ thu gen a, Israel tungah a thukhamte le a ngaina kipte a gen hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bangin ama in minam dang khat popo tungah a bawl ngai sih hi; amate in a ngaina kipte a thei sih uhi. Topa phat un!"}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un!
