Vantungte panin Topa phat un; a sangnate-ah ama phat un!","title":"Leitungbup-ah a Vanglietna zieha Pasien Phatna"},"2":{"text":"A vantungmi zosie aw, ama phat un; A mihon zosie aw, ama phat un!"},"3":{"text":"Ni le hlapi aw, ama phat un; no a tang aasite aw, ama phat un!"},"4":{"text":"No, van sangpente le no, vantungte-a om tuite aw, ama phat un!"},"5":{"text":"Topa’ min amate phatsah un, azieh pen ama in thupie a, tuate kipieng sah hi."},"6":{"text":"A tawntunga om dingin ama in tuate kipsah hi; kantan thei lo dingin ama in a gamgi uh a bawlpieh hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitung panin Topa phat un, no, tuipi ganhing golte le a thuhna zosie,"},"8":{"text":"mei le giel, vuakhal le daitui, a thupiehna a mang khuopi hui!"},"9":{"text":"Muol le tang zosie, ga nei singkungte le taamtah sing zosie!"},"10":{"text":"Gamsa le innsa vannuoi, a bawhva ganhing le a leng vate zosie!"},"11":{"text":"Leitung kumpite le mite zosie, uliente le leitung a uhte zosie!"},"12":{"text":"Ngahnute le tangvalte, a vuoi le khangnote in Topa phat ton un!"},"13":{"text":"Amate Topa’ min phatsah un, azieh pen ama’ min beh kitawisang hi; ama’ minthanna pen leitung le vantung sangin sangzaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in ama’ mite adingin ki khat tawisang zo a, tua khu ama tawh kinai-a a om a muonhuoi Israel mi zosie’ phatna ahi hi."}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Topa tungah la tha sa unlen, thuman mite kikhopna sungah ama phatna la sa un.","title":"Pasien’ Hoina Zieha Israel Tunga Phatna"},"2":{"text":"A Bawlpa tungah Israel lungdam heh; amau’ Kumpipa tungah Zion’ tate kipah uheh."},"3":{"text":"Amate in lamna tawh ama’ min phatsah unlen, tawm le lyre lasahna tawh ama tungah la ngaih sa un."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ama’ mite tungah Topa lungdam hi; ama in a neilut mite guolzawna tawh zem hi."},"5":{"text":"A guolzawna vuah mi muonhuoite lungdamin kitom uheh; amate in a lupna tung vuah lungdamin la sa uheh."},"6":{"text":"Minamte tungah phu la-in, mite tunga dan a pie ding, a kumpite uh siakhau tawh khi-in, a uliente uh sia kengkol a bul ding, a kigielsa thukhenna bangin amate tunga a semkhie dingin, a khut vuah langni a hiem namsau tawi-in lawl pawhkeh khielin awngin, Pasien phat ta uheh! Tam khu a mi muonhuoi zosie’ guolzawna ahi hi. Topa phat un!","merge":"7"}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un! Ama’ mun siengtho sungah Pasien phat un; ama’ vanglietna mun vantungah ama phat un!","title":"Tepi Om Lo Pasien’ Lietna Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"A vanglien ama’ sepnate ziehin ama phat un; tepi om lo a lietna tawh kituohin ama phat un!"},"3":{"text":"Pengkul aw tawh ama phat unlen, theile le harp lasahna tawh ama phat un."},"4":{"text":"Tawm le lamna tawh ama phat un; khausai lasahna le theile tawh ama phat un!"},"5":{"text":"Daltuote tawh ama phat un; a gin ngaih daltuote tawh ama phat un!"},"6":{"text":"A naa thei zosie in Topa phat heh! Topa phat un!"}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Paunah","shortname":"Pau","abbr":[],"desc":"Paunahte laibu (proverbs)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpi, David’ tapa Solomon Paunahte:","ref":"1Kum 4:32"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen mite in pilna le kithuhilna-te a sin thei nading, a khietna thuh a nei kammalte a theitel nading,","title":"Thuhonna"},"3":{"text":"pilvang tahin gamta a, thuman le thutang tawh a kilawm a kituoha a gamtat thei nading;"},"4":{"text":"mimawte tungah pilvanna thute hilin, khangnote tungah theina le thu khinkhai theina hil nading,"},"5":{"text":"mipilte in zong tami thu za-in a theina uh belap hinlen, thu ngaisut siemna a nga thei nading,"},"6":{"text":"Paunahte, le gentenate, mipilte’ thugente le a telha kamthuhte a theitel nading ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa zatahna in theina kipatna ahi hi; mimawte in pilna le kithuhilna a thusim sih uhi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Late 111:10; Pau 9:10"},"8":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na pa ang thuhilna za inlen, na nu ang thumopte niel sin;","title":"Kithuopi Gilote Tunga Thuhilkholna"},"9":{"text":"azieh pen tuate khu na lutunga paakuol kilawm le na ngawnga na awh khiba tawh kibang ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka ta aw, mawneite in ang zawl uleh, nuom malmal sin."},"11":{"text":"Amate in, “Ko ei zui inlen, sisan luon nading va sui ta vai; huoiham tahin maw nei lo om muong khat va buh ta vai;"},"12":{"text":"Hankhuh-a peisuhte bang le Misikhuo bangin cidamin a hinglai pi ma-un amate va valtum ta vai."},"13":{"text":"Na manpha namkim i mu ding vua, i vanlahte utawh i inn i dim ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Kote ei pawl inlen, i unpi-un i sum i paite kitan ciet vai,” ang ci uleh,"},"15":{"text":"ka ta aw, a lampi vuah amate tawh zawhton sinlen, a lampi panun kihemkhie in;"},"16":{"text":"azieh pen amate in sietna lamah a kal uh a nawsuon mama vua, sisan suo nading thu ah a kinaw mama uhi."},"17":{"text":"Va in ei et laitahin a siena lenthang i zah pan pen a mawkna ahi hi;"},"18":{"text":"hinanle tua pen a si ding uh ngah a, bawh khinkhian uh hi lel hi! tuale a hinna uh a bei nadinga zong, amahaw kibuhdap ahi lel uhi!"},"19":{"text":"Huoihamna tawh a nga sawm zosiete’ lam tawpna pen tam bang ahi hi; tua banga a nga mite in a hinna utawh a lo uhi."},"20":{"text":"Gawldung tengah pilna kiko-in, khuolai tuol-awng tengah aw ngai tahin kiko hi.","title":"Pilna Kihlatna"},"21":{"text":"Mihon kikhopna-ah ama kiko hi; ama in khuopi lutna tunkotte ah thu a gen hi:","ref":"Pau 8:1-3"},"22":{"text":"“No mimawte aw, bang tanvei mawlawm lai ding na hi uh ahei? Misimmawte in zong bang tanvei simmaw na lai-in, mimawte in theina bang tanvei huo lai ding na hi uh ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Kang phawsietna thupise un; note tungah ka ngaisutnate kang sung ding hi; ka thute kang theisah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen ke’n kang hlat vangun note in nei niel vua, ka khut kang zapzap vangun koima’n nei thudon sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Kang thumopte zosie thusim loin, kang phawna khat beh na zui lo ziehun,"},"26":{"text":"ke’n zong na tuosietna uh kang nuisan zieu lel ding hi; zauhuoina in ang nawh uh ciengin kang simmawbawl lel ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Zauhuoina in huipi bangin hing nawh gawpin, na tung vuah pumpei bangin vangsietna hing tung a, na tung vuah lungkhamna le khuisahna ang tun ciengin zong, kang thudon sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in keima ei hlan ding vua, ahi vangin keima in ka dawng sih ding hi; amate in kintahin ei sui ding vua, ahi vangin ei mu sih ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in theina muda-in, Topa zatah ding a teel sih vua,"},"30":{"text":"ka thumopte khat zong zui loin, ka phawna zosie a thusim sih vua,"},"31":{"text":"tua ziehin amate in a gamtatna ga a ne ding vua, amau’ gelnate ma in amate a gimsah ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen mimawlte in amau’ mottatna a silaw vua, mimawte in amau’ thudon lona a sietlaw uhi;"},"33":{"text":"hinanle ka thugen a ngai mite a lung uh muong ding a, a siehuoi tuosietna nei loin nuomtahin om hit hiet ding uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thugente pomin ka thupiehte na sunga na khol leh,","title":"Pilna’ Manphatna"},"2":{"text":"pilna lamah lunglut tahin bil daw-in, thutelna lamah na lungtang na ngat a,"},"3":{"text":"thuthuh thei nuomin kiko tahpi-in thutelna nei nuomin na kiko a;"},"4":{"text":"dangka sui bangin sui-in, a kisel gou bangin na sui leh,"},"5":{"text":"tuaci’n nangma in Topa zatahna na thei ding a, Pasien theina na mu ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in pilna ei pie a, ama’ kam panin theina le theitelna ang pei hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in thuman mite adingin pilna laigil kholpieh hi; kawbaang lo-a kalsuon mite adingin ama pen kidalna lum ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in thutangte’ lampi cingin, ama tunga muonhuoi mite’ lampi kem hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hileh thumanna le thutanna, a kilawm le lampi hoi poma na thei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen na lungsim sungah pilna ang lut ding a, theina in na hlagau a lungnuomsah ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"thu khinkhai theina in nang ang cing ding a, theitelna in ang kem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuami in gitlona lampi panin nangma ang hunkhie ding a, thulegen mite kung pan le"},"13":{"text":"khuomiel lampi a zawt nadingun thuman lampi a nuasie mite,"},"14":{"text":"a sie-a gamtat nuom a sa, gitlo letatna-a a lungkim mite,"},"15":{"text":"a lampi uh kawi-in a gamtat sawi mite panin ang kem ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A thangtat numei pan le kamhlum no tawh angkawm numeite pan,"},"17":{"text":"a sen lawm ngaih nuasie a, Pasien tawh a kiciemna a mangngil nu kung panin kang hunkhie ding hi;"},"18":{"text":"azieh pen tua nu lampi in sina dongah ang pui a, ama’ peina lampi in sina hlim lam ang tun hi;"},"19":{"text":"tua nu kunga a pei mite ang kilekia ngai nawn sih vua, amate in hinna lampite zong a ngakia nawn sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi hoite’ lampi tawn inlen, a thutang mite’ lampi zui in."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen gam sungah thuman mite a teng ding vua, tua sungah mawpeng mite a teng suoh ding uhi;"},"22":{"text":"ahi vangin tua gam panin migilote kisumang ding a, tua gam panin misol hatte kiphungkal mang ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, kang thuhilte mangngil sinlen, kang thupiehte na lungtang sungah kem in;","title":"Pasien Muon ding le Patawi ding Hanthotna"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen tuate in na khankum le na hinkhuo nite ang sausah ding a, nopsahna kicing ang pie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Citahna le muonhuoina in kinuasiesah vawt sin; na ngawng kimvelah tuate vielin, na lungtang suongpeh tungah giel in."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien le mite muna-ah maipha le minphatna na nga ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lungsim zosie tawh Topa muong inlen, nang theina beh suong sin."},"6":{"text":"Na vai zosie-ah ama phawh in, tua hile ama in na lampite ang zangsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma’ kimuna-ah a pilin kingaisuntawm sin; Pasien zatahin gitlona panin kihemkhie in."},"8":{"text":"Tua khu na ci na sa adingin damna zatui hi ding a, na pumpi adingin thasuona hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na neisa le na nasep ga masate tawh Topa zatah in;"},"10":{"text":"tua hile na ansalte an tampi tawh ang kidim ding a na beelte zong lenggazu ang dimlet ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ta aw, Topa ang khalna simmaw sinlen, ama’ ang phawna cimtah sin,","ref":"Job 5:17"},"12":{"text":"azieh pen a pa in a patat a tapa a thuhil bangin, Topa in a it mite thu a hil hi.","ref":"Heb 12:5-6; Kln 3:19"},"13":{"text":"Pilna mu a, theitelna a nga mite mi nuomsa ahi hi,","title":"Hauna Maan"},"14":{"text":"azieh pen dangka sangin pilna tawh sum bawlna hoizaw a, a met zong kham sangin hoizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Suong manpha sangin pilna manphazaw a, na deina khat popo tawh tekah thei ding ahi sih hi."},"16":{"text":"A ziet lamah khansauna a om hi; a vei lamah hauna le patawina a om hi."},"17":{"text":"A lampite nopsahna lampi hi a, a lampi zosie kilemna ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama a man khate adingin hinna singkung ahi hi; ama a pomdet mite mi nuomsa kici hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in pilna tawh leitung na phut hi; ama in theitelna tawh vantungte na bawl hi;","title":"Piensahna-ah Pasien’ Pilna"},"20":{"text":"a theina tawh a thuhna sunga om tuite na luongkhiesah a, meiite in daitui a na kiesah hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka ta aw, nangma kung panin tam teng pitmangsah sin; pilna gil le thu khinkhai theina kemcing bo in.","title":"Bihna Maan"},"22":{"text":"Tuate pen na hlagau adingin hinna ang hi ding a, na ngawng adingin kizepna ang suoh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin lungmuongin lam na zawt ding a, na keng na suikha sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na to leh zong na zau sih ding hi; na lup ciengin zong na kimut a nuom ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Migilote tunga a tung huipi le pataunate ang ditun ciengin zong zau malmal sin;"},"26":{"text":"azieh pen Topa khu na lungmuonna ang hi ding a, ang kimat nading panin na keng ang kemcing ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Na bawl zawh ding ahi nah leh panpi dinga a kilawmte tungah sil hoi sep ding kidiem sin."},"28":{"text":"Na nei nahpi na vengpa kungah, “Va pei phot inlen, hing peikia in, zing cieng nang pie vang,” ci sin."},"29":{"text":"Nang ang muonga nangma’ pang ang bel na vengpa tungah a gim nga nading bangma vaihawm sin."},"30":{"text":"Na tungah sietna bangma ang kibawl sih leh a thu om lo pi-in koima tawh kihau sin."},"31":{"text":"Mi tatsiete eng sinlen, a gamtatnate uh teel sin;"},"32":{"text":"azieh pen a letat mite Topa in kidah a, ahi vangin ama in midihte a muong hi."},"33":{"text":"Migilote’ inn sungah Topa’ samsietna tung a, hizongle ama in midihte’ tenna thupha a pie hi."},"34":{"text":"Mi simmawte ama in simmaw a, a neilut mite maipha a pie hi.","ref":"Jas 4:6; 1Pet 5:5"},"35":{"text":"Mipilte in patawina a luo ding vua, hizongle a lungkhau mi mawte in mindaina a nga ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tate aw, na pa uh’ ang thuhilna ngai unlen, thuthuh theina na nga nadingun limtahin ciemte un;","title":"Nu le Pate’ Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen keima in zui ding thuhoite nang kang pie hi. Kang thuhilte mangngil sin."},"3":{"text":"Ka pa tawh ka khangmoi lai, ka nu’ angvan tapa khat ka hi lai-in,"},"4":{"text":"ama in thu ei hil a, ka kungah, “Na lungsim in ka thugente tukipsah in; kang thupiehte zui-in hing in."},"5":{"text":"Pilna sin in; thuthuh zong sin in: Mangngil sinlen, ka kam pana a pusuoh thute panin pielmang sin."},"6":{"text":"Pilna taisan sin, tua hile ama in nang ang kem ding hi; pilna it in, tua hile ama in nang ang cing ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Pilna kipatna tam ahi hi: Pilna sui in, adang na nga thei poma sui in, thutel theina kisui in."},"8":{"text":"Pilna thupisah mama in, tua hile ama in ang lamsang ding hi; ama pom lacin ama in nang ang patawi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in na lutungah a etlawm paakuol ang khusah ding hi; ama in na tungah a kilawm kumpi lukhu ang khusa ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na khan kumte a sau nadingin ka thugente ngai inlen sang in.","title":"Lampi Maan Zui ding Hilna"},"11":{"text":"Pilna lampi kang hil zo hi; thumanna lampi-ah kang pui zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Lam na pei ciengin na kalsuonna ang nawngkaisah sih ding hi; Na tai leh zong na kipai sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ang kithuhilnate tukip in; tuate hlasuo vawt sin; na hin nading ahi ziehin tua khu kepsiem in."},"14":{"text":"Migilote’ lampi ah pei sinlen, sietna bawlte lampi ah zong pei sin."},"15":{"text":"Tua khu pel in; tuanah pei sin. Tua pan kihei-in kansan in."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen sietna a bawl sih uleh amate a kimuthei sih uhi; mi khat’ pua nading a bawl masangsie a kimu ngim thei sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in gitlona an ne-in, kheltatna zu a dawn uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanle thuman mite’ lampi ahile sunkim donga a tang semsem, zingmawng khuovah pan tawh kibang hi."},"19":{"text":"Migilote’ lampi pen khuomiel thuhpi tawh kibang a, a palkhahna sontah uzong amate in a thei sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thugente lunglut tahin ngai in; ka thugente na bil ei ngat in."},"21":{"text":"Nangma’ mun panin amate pitsah sin; na lungsim sungah kemcing in."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen a mute dingin tuate in hinna ahi a, a pumpi zosie vua dingin damna zatui ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pilvangin na lungtang kem in, azieh pen tua panin hinna tuisam a pul hi."},"24":{"text":"Thukawi genna pai dawh inlen, thulegenna gamla pelh in."},"25":{"text":"Na masang lam en inlen, na mailam tangtahin mitsuon in."},"26":{"text":"Na zawt lampi tangsah in, tua hile na khuoheina ang kicien ding hi.","ref":"Heb 12:13"},"27":{"text":"Ziet le vei-ah piel vawt sin; sietna panin na keng hei in."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka pilna thu ah lunglut in; ka theitelna na bil ei ngat in.","title":"Thangtat lo nading le Zulzau lo nading Hilkholna"},"2":{"text":"Thu khinkhai theina tukip in, tua hile na kam in theina a kem thei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen a thangtat numei’ nephu pen khuoizu-a kidiesa bang a, a kamham sathau sangin zolzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle a tawpna-ah ama gamsai bangin kha a, a langni-a a kitathiem namsau tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"A keng sina lamah peisuh a, Misikhuo lampi zui-in kalsuon hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinna lampi-ah a ma a tang pei sih hi; a lampi-ah vahvai-in, a vahvai lam zong a thei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ta aw, tu-in ka thugen ngai inlen, ka kam pana a pusuoh thute panin piel sin."},"8":{"text":"Ama gamlapi panin pel inlen, ama’ inn kotbieng va nai sin;"},"9":{"text":"tua hi sihle na minphatna uh midangte tungah na pie kha ding vua, noma’ hin kumte hepina a nei lo mite tungah na pie kha ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amau’ tai nading bepin khuolmite in na neisa teng uh a zang ding vua, nasep gimna teng uh midangte’ inn ah a tung ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"na hinna a tawp kuon lam, na tel na vo ang tawp ciengin, guitamin na tau ding a,"},"12":{"text":"tuale nangma in, “Aw, bangci-in kithuhilna muda-in, ka lungsim in zong phawsietna a thusim lo mawh a ta diei!"},"13":{"text":"Ei hil siete’ thugen ka mang nuom sih a, ei hilnate uh ka na thudon kha sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in mipi kikhopna lahah a siecip tahtah hi ta’ng e,” na ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Na tuibem pana tuite le na tuikhuh pana tuite dawn in."},"16":{"text":"Na tuinah letmangin lamdung tengah luitui-in luongsah mawh ding na mah?"},"17":{"text":"Tuate nang ding beh hisah inlen, midang tawh kitang sin."},"18":{"text":"Nangma’ tuikhuh in thupha nga-in, na senzi tawh nuomsa inlen,"},"19":{"text":"tua pen a it huoi sazuhpi le a deihuoi sazuhtang bang heh. A nawite tawh tai den inlen, a itna in na lai kuoi den taheh."},"20":{"text":"Ka ta aw, bang dinga numei dang khat na lunggul a, angkawm numei khat’ kanglum na va kawi tah ahei?"},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in mihingte’ gamtatna teng mu a, a lampite uh zosie a sittel hi."},"22":{"text":"Migilote’ a gamtatna sietna in amate thangsie a, a mawna thangkhaute vuah amate a awh uhi."},"23":{"text":"Khalna a op lo ziehin a si vua, a mot seng ziehun a mangthai uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na vengpa’ leiba lopieh ding kamciemna pie-in, midang khat adingin kiciemna na nei khah leh,","title":"Thuhilna Kicien"},"2":{"text":"na nephu pana na thugente tawh thang kisie na hi a, na kamham in nangma ang mat ahi ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka ta aw, tua bang na hi khah leh nang le nang kihunkhie in, azieh pen na vengpa’ thuneina sunga lut kha na hi tah ziehin, mallangtahin pei inlen na vengpa kungah va thum ta’n."},"4":{"text":"Na mit pelsah inlen, na kimut suohsah sin;"},"5":{"text":"sabeng pa kung pana a suohta sakhi bang le thangsie pa khut sung pana a suohta va bangin nang le nang kihunkhie in."},"6":{"text":"Mi thadapa aw, mesi kungah pei in; amau’ gamtat zie ngaisun inlen, tua khu pilna-in nei in."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a uh ding le a makai ding vaihawm nei lo napi uh,"},"8":{"text":"khuokhal hun sungin an a khol vua, anlah hun sungin an a kaikhawm uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mi thadapa aw, bang tanvei lumlum lai-in, bangcih ciengin na kimutna pan thokia ding na hei?"},"10":{"text":"Bano khat sung na kimut kal, bano khat sung na haituh kal, bano khat sung khut zepin na khawl kalin,"},"11":{"text":"mi suompa bangin na kungah zawnna ang tung ding a, galhangpa bangin na kungah kitasapna ang tung ding hi.","ref":"Pau 24:33-34"},"12":{"text":"Thu ningkawi genin miginalo pa le mimaw pa a kawiva vua,"},"13":{"text":"mit-hem tawh mi en kawi-in, a keng utawh a sui vua, a khutme utawh mi a kawh kawikawi uhi."},"14":{"text":"A lungsim uh zulzau-in sietna behbeh a gel vua, kimatmaw nading behbeh a bawl ngitnget uhi;"},"15":{"text":"tua bang mite tungah tuosietna thakhatin tung ding hi; mitphet kalin bawlphat thei nawn lo kisietna a tung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in a huot mama na guh om a, ama in kidahhuoi a sah mama na sagi a om hi:"},"17":{"text":"Kiphatsahna mit, zuouthu genna leii, mawnei lote’ sisan a luongsah khut,"},"18":{"text":"thusie a bawl sawm lungtang, sietna bawl ding a kinaw keng,"},"19":{"text":"a man lo-a zuouthu teci pangte le innkuon sunga kilem lona khaici vawte ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na pa ang thupiehte zui inlen, na nu ang thumopte taisan vawt sin."},"21":{"text":"Na lungtangah tuate khi zing in; na ngawngah tuate aw zing in."},"22":{"text":"Na kalsuonna-ah tuate in nangma lam ang pui ding hi; na lup ciengin zong tuate in nangma ang vil ding hi; na khahlaw ciengin tuate in nangma ang hopi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen thupiehna in meivah ahi a, thuhilna in khuovah ahi hi. Kiphawsietna le kikhalna in hinna lampi ahi a,"},"24":{"text":"mi dangte’ zi pan le numei pahtatte’ kamzol panin nangma ang kem ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na lungtangah tua nu’ mel hoina ipla kha sinlen, ama’ ang zawlmit hana hlengla kha vawt sin;"},"26":{"text":"azieh pen numei pahtat khat’ guoiman anlum khat beh ahi a, ahi vangin numei zummaw in pasal khat’ hinna buppi siesah hi."},"27":{"text":"A puon ka loin mi khat in a kangah meikuong a puo thei amah?"},"28":{"text":"Ahi sihle a keng ka loin mei-am lahah mi khat a pei thei amah?"},"29":{"text":"A vengpa’ zi tawh a lumton mipa in tua bang a thuoh ding hi; tua nu a tham kha popo dan thuoh loin om lo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Gutate in a gilkiel ciengun a gilkiel phat nading beha mi van a guh uh ciengin, amate kisimmaw lo hi."},"31":{"text":"Hizongle amate a kimat khah leh, a za sagi-in lo ding uhi; amate in a inn sung vua om neisa zosie tan ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanle angkawm pa pen ngaisutna nei lo mi ahi a, tua banga a gamta mipa ama le ama kisusie ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in liemna le minsietna thuoh ding a, ama’ mindaina kiphietmang lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen thangsietna in pasal thangpaisah a, ama in phu a lah ciengin koima a diem vawt sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in khiel man sang lo ding a, bangza-in guhgol a tam zongin sang lo ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thugente zui inlen, kang thupiehte na sungah khol in;","title":"Angkawmna’ Hoilona"},"2":{"text":"ka thupiehte zui-in hinpi inlen, na mit nauta na kepcing bangin ka thuhilnate kemcing in;"},"3":{"text":"na khutme-ah tuate viel inlen, na lungtang suongpeh tungah zong giel in."},"4":{"text":"Pilna kungah, “Ka nau nu na hi hi,” ci inlen, thuthuh theina kungah ka lawm it pen na hi hi, ci-in."},"5":{"text":"Tua hile tua thute in numei thangtatte le kamzol a zang numei pahtatte’ kamsiemna panin ang kem ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen ka opna inn tawlet-a vathangah ka khuodah a,"},"7":{"text":"mimawlte lah le tangvalnote lahah thukhen tel thei lo tangval khat ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in tua nu innkiu lampi nawtsuoh a, ama’ opna inn lam manaw-in a pei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hun pen nitah nitum zaw zan hun le khuomiel kuon ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n numei pahtat banga kizem a lungpheng numei khat ama lam zuonin a pei hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama kamtamin lungkhau hi; a innah a om ngim thei sih hi;"},"12":{"text":"khatvei le lamdungah, khatvei le tuol-awng teng le, mi inn ningkawi tengah mi buhdapin a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua nu in ama manin tawp a, tuale maitai tahin tua pa kungah:"},"14":{"text":"“Tuni-in biehpiehna ka bawl a, kiciemna zong ka bawl hi;"},"15":{"text":"tuaci’n tu-in nang dawn dinga ang kuon ka hi hi, nangma sui citahin kang sui a, tu-in kang mu ta hi!"},"16":{"text":"Egypt puongiel hoite tawh ka lupna, a tuomnate ka zem zo hi;"},"17":{"text":"myrrh panamtui, aloes panamtui le cinnamon panamtuite tawh ka lupna ka namtuisah zo ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Hing pei in, zingmawng dongin lungcim tahin ki-itna bawl vai; itna tawh eima gel nuomsa vai."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen inn ah ka pasal om lo hi; khuol gamlapi zinin a kuon zo ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in sum-ip khat keng a, hlalia masangin inn ang tung sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"A kamsiem tawh tua nu in ama zawl vangut hi; a kamhlum tawh a gen ziehin a nua a zuipausah ta hi."},"22":{"text":"A kigaw nading mun lam a zuon bawngtang bang le, a awh nading thang zuona a kitom sazuh bangin,"},"23":{"text":"thaltang in a gilsung a pailet dongin ama in thakhatin tua nu a zui pai hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in, ka ta aw, ka thugen ngai inlen, ka kam pana pusuoh ka thugente limtahin ngai in."},"25":{"text":"Tua nu’ lampite-ah na lungsim hei kha sin; tua nu’ lampi-ah piel poma sin."},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen ama nu in mi tampi puasah a, ama nu ziehin mi tampite in a silaw uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua nu’ inn pen Misikhuo zotna lampi hi a, sina innkhan peisuhna ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna in hing hlanin theitelna hing kiko hi lo amah?","title":"Pilna Letsongte"},"2":{"text":"Munsangte tung, lampi gei, lamkabawm teng ah a ding hi;"},"3":{"text":"khuopi mai-a tunkot gei, inn lutna kot gei-ah a kiko hi:","ref":"Pau 1:20-21"},"4":{"text":"“Mite aw, no ang hlan ka hi a, ka kikona, mihingte zosie a hlan ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"No mimawlawmte aw, thu khinkhai theina sin un; tuami kisamte in lungsim pilna sin un."},"6":{"text":"Ngai un, azieh pen thu manphate kang gen ding a, ka kam sung panin thuman vive ang pusuoh ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"azieh pen ka kam in thuman thutah a gen ding hi; gitlona pen ka nephute adingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka kam pana ka gen zosie thuman vive ahi hi; tuate sungah thu kuolgen le thukawilieng bangma om lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Thu theitel mite adingin ka thugente tang a, theina a neisate adingin thuman ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngun tangin kang thuhilna kilahzaw unlen, kham tangin thu theina kiteelzaw un;"},"11":{"text":"azieh pen suong manpha sangin pilna hoizaw a, na dei na zosiete tawh zong tekah thei ding ahi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Pilna ahi keima pen thu khinkhai theina tawh ka tengton a, theina le a kilawm ngaisut theina ka nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa zatahna in gitlona mudana ahi hi. Kiphatsahna, kihisahna, gitlo gamtatna le thu legennate ka huo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngaisut hoi le pilna gil ka nei hi; thuthuh theina, le hatna ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima ziehin kumpite maang a, gam-uhte in thutangin thu a khen uhi;"},"16":{"text":"gam-uhte le milien zosiete in kei ziehin a manin a uh uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kei ei itte ka it a, kintaha ei suite in ei mu uhi."},"18":{"text":"Keima in haunate le patawina, hauna kip le nopsahna ka nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima’ ga pen kham sangin, kham citah nangawn sangin hoizaw hi. Keima’ gasuo zong pen ngun hoipen sangin hoizaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima in dihna lampi ka zui a, thutang lampi dung tawnin,"},"21":{"text":"ei it mite hauna ka pie a, a gougil koina uh ka dim hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in ama’ na a sep cilin keima ei na siem a, tangtawnga ama’ septe sung panin keima a masa pen ka hi hi.","title":"Siemcilna-ah Pilna Kihalna","ref":"Kln 3:14"},"23":{"text":"Tanglai peh panin ei kisiem zo a, lei pien masanga ei kibawl masa pen ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tui thuhpite le tui tampi luonna tuinahte a om nai lo lai-in ka pieng zo ta bo hi."},"25":{"text":"Muolsangte a kisiem masang, muoltangte mai-ah, ei piengsah zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Leitung le gamlah a bawl masang, leitung’ amasa pen lei themte a bawl masangin zong kei ka pieng zo ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in vante a munah a koi lai, tuipi maitanga a kuol a bawl lai,"},"28":{"text":"tung lama vante bawlin a kipsah lai, tuipi tuinahte a bawl lai,"},"29":{"text":"tuipi in ama’ thupiehte a palsat lo nadingin leitung kiphuna zungpite a ciemte lai-in kei ka pieng zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n nasem uhte bangin, ama’ gei-ah ka om hi; nisim sielin ama’ lungkimna keima ka hi a, ama’ mai-ah lungdamin nuomsa zingin,"},"31":{"text":"ama’ tenna leisiet tungah kei ka kipah a, mihingte lahah nuom ka sa hi."},"32":{"text":"“Ka tate aw, tu-in ka thugen ei ngai un; ka gamtat dan a zuite mi nuomsa ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Kithuhilna za-in pil unlen, thudon loin mawh op sih un."},"34":{"text":"Ka thugen ngai-in, ka tunkotah nisimin ei cing ei vilin, ka kotpite gei-a ei ngah lenlon mipa khu mi nuomsa ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Azieh pen kei ei mu poma in hinna a mu vua, Topa tung panin zong maipha a nga uhi;"},"36":{"text":"hizongle keima ei mu lo mite, amau le amau a kiliemsuo ahi hi; keima ei muda mi zosie a si nuom ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna in a inn lam zo ta a, khuompi sagi sui zo hi.","title":"Pilna’ Pawikhamna"},"2":{"text":"A gante go zo-in a zu a pawi a, an neh nading sabuoi zong a pha hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in khuo sung munsang pente panin mi hlan dingin a nasem numeite sawl a,"},"4":{"text":"“No, thu thei lote aw, tanah hing pei un!” ci-in hlanin, thu khentel thei lote kungah,"},"5":{"text":"“Hing pei unlen, ka an ne-in ka zupawisa hing dawn ta un."},"6":{"text":"Picinlona taisanin nungta unlen, thuthuh theina lampi tawn un,” cisah hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi simmaw khat thu a hil poma in maizumna nga hi; migilote a phawh poma in liemna nga hi.","title":"Thuciin Tuomtuomte"},"8":{"text":"A kiphawhsie mi simmaw pa in ang muda bep lel ding hi; mipilte na phawsiet ciengin ang it ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mipilte thuhil in, tua hile amate ang pil semsem ding uhi; midihte thuhil in, tua hile a theina uh ang kibelap ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa zatahna in pilna kipatna ahi a, Siengtho Pa theina in thuthuh theina ahi hi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Late 111:10; Pau 1:7"},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima ziehin na hinkhuo nite ang khang ding a, na khankumte ang kibelap ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang na pil leh nangma dinga a pil na hi hi; pilna na thuse sih leh nang beh in na thuoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Numei mawte a nah ham hi; ama mawlawmin bangma a thei sih hi.","title":"Mimawte’ Hlatna le Kamciem"},"14":{"text":"Ama’ inn kot zungah to a, khuopi bosang munte tunga a topha tungah to-in,"},"15":{"text":"amau’ lampi cieta a pei, tua mun a nawh kha mite hlan a,"},"16":{"text":"“No, thu thei lote aw, tanah hing pei un!” ci-in hlanin, thu khentel thei lote kungah,"},"17":{"text":"“A kigudap tui hlum deu a, a kidapneh an tui deu hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanle amate in tua munah misite a op lam le a thuhna Misikhuo-ah tua nu’ lenglate a op lam a thei sih uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon’ paunahte. Tapa pil in a pa lungdamsah a, tapa maw in a nu dasah hi.","title":"Solomon’ Gen Thupilte"},"2":{"text":"Gitlona tawh a kinga goute in phattuomna a nei sih a, sina panin dihna in ei hunkhie hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in thuman mite a gilkielin a koi sih a, ama in migilote a du uh a ngawlsah hi."},"4":{"text":"A thasie khut in mi zawngsah a, a thanuom khut in mi hausah hi."},"5":{"text":"Khal lai-a an khol pa pen tapa pilvang ahi a, anlah huna a kimu tapa in maizumna piengsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Midihte’ lutungah thupha om a, migilote’ kam in kheltatna selcip hi."},"7":{"text":"Midihte kiphawna pen thupha ahi a, migilote’ min muotmang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mipilte’ lungtang in thupiehte thudon ding a, a mot ham mimaw pa in sietna a tut ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Citahna lampi a zui poma lungnuomin kalsuon ding a, gitlona lampi a zui poma kiphawhkhie veve ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A mit-hem tawh mi a en poma in buoina piengsah a, hangsantaha mi a phawsieh pa in kilemna piengsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Midihte’ kamham in hinna tuinah ahi a, migilote’ kamham in tatsietna a selcip hi."},"12":{"text":"Mudana in kihauna piengsah a, itna in khielna teng khucip hi.","ref":"Jas 5:20; 1Pet 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Thutelna nei pa’ kam sungah pilna kimu a, pilna a nei lote’ elzang ah ciengpum a om hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilte in theina a khol vua, mimawte’ mot hamna in sietna tungsah bai hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihaute’ hauna in amau’ kulpi ahi hi; mizawngte’ zawnna in amau’ kisietna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Thumante’ thaman in hinna lamah pui a, migilote’ nga phattuomna in mawna lamah a pui hi."},"17":{"text":"Kithuhilna a thudon poma hinna lampi tunga om ahi a, phawsietna a nuol poma a lam pielmang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Zuou kam in mudana selcip a, mi gensie poma mimaw ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Thu a kitam gen ciengin khielna zong a om pai a, mi pilvangte ham a ki-ip uhi."},"20":{"text":"Midihte leii in nguntang hoipen ahi a, migilote’ lungsim bangma a man sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Midihte’ nephu in mi tampi vah a, mimawte in a motna a sipi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa’ thupha in hauna piengsah a, ama in tua tawh dana kici a belap sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Khielna bawl ding pen mimawte adingin apmaina bang lel a, theitelna a nei mi in pil gamtat nuom a sa hi."},"24":{"text":"Migilote tungah amau’ giinpen tung ding a, thuman mite ahi uleh a dei bang uh kipie ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Huipi in a nawh ciengin migilote a om nawn sih vua, midihte ahi uleh kumtawnin kip ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Lengga tuithua in ha zasah a, meikhu in mit a sipsah bangin, mi thadate in nasep a ciel a pute gentheisah uhi."},"27":{"text":"Topa zatahna in khan sausah a, migilote’ khankum a tom ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Midihte’ kinepna khu lungdamna-ah a tawp a, migilote’ kinepna bangma lo a suoh hi."},"29":{"text":"Mi thumante adingin Topa’ lampi in munkip muonhuoi ahi a, sietna a bawl mite adingin kisuhsietna ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Midihte a opna panun kisuonkhie lo ding a, migilote ahi uleh gam sungah a omsuoh sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Midihte’ kam panin pilna pusuoh a, thusie a gen leii ki-atsan ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Midihte’ nephu kam in mite’ san thei ding thu thei a, migilote kam ahile thusie vive ahi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in a man lo tawikhaina muda a, tawisuong man in ama’ lungkimna ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Kiphatsahna a op ciengin minsietna tung pai hi; pilna pen a kiniemkhieh mite tawh a omton hi."},"3":{"text":"Midihte a citahna in makai a, mi zuou theite ahile a lungsim kawina un amate a susie hi."},"4":{"text":"Thangpai ni ciengin haunate in phattuomna ei pie sih a, dihtatna in sina panin ei hunkhie hi."},"5":{"text":"Genbang lo mite’ dihtatna in a lampi uh tangtahin zui a, migilote ahile amau’ gitlona tawh a pua uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi thumante’ dihtatna in amate hundam a, mi zuou theite pen amau’ gelna sungah a awh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote a si ciengin amau’ kinepna mangthai a, Pasien nei lote’ kinepna zong bangma lo a suoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungkhamna panin midihte kihunkhie a, khum munah migilote a lut zawsop uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien nei lote in a kam utawh a vengte susie a, midihte ahi uleh theina tawh a suohta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Midihte a dau uh a pei ciengin khuopite lungdam uhi; migilote a manthai ciengin lungdam kikona om hi."},"11":{"text":"Mithumante’ thupha ziehin khuopi khat kitawisang a, migilote’ thugen ziehin tua khuopi kithalpai hi."},"12":{"text":"Midang khat a neubawl poma pilna nei lo ahi a, mipil pa ham loin sip dide hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi gensie pa in a thusim teng genin vah kawikawi a, mi muonhuoi pa in thu im khinkhian hi."},"14":{"text":"Kimakaina a op lona munah minam pua a, thukuppi ding a kicinna munah lungmuonna a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Theilo mi khat’ leiba lopieh dinga na kikhamna in gimna ang tun ding a, tua banga bawl ding nielna-ah lungmuonna omzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi hepi thei numei in patawina nga a, hoina a muda nu ahile maizumna tawh a kituom hi. Mi meipuote in bangma nei lo a, a hakat mi in hauna nga hi."},"17":{"text":"A migite ahile amau le amau thaman kipie ahi vua, a gilo mite pen amate a kiliemsuo ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Migilote in hamphatna tahtah nga lo a, dihna khaici a tute in thaman mantah a nga uhi."},"19":{"text":"Dihna sunga a kukal poma a nungta ding vua, sietna a sulzui mi poma a si ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Lungsim kawite pen Topa adingin kidahhuoi a, genbanglo mite lampi in ama’ lungkimna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Migilote dan tuoh loin om lo ding hi, ci thu telcien in, ahi vangin midihte a suohta ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Thu hoi a ngaisun thei lo a melhoi numei pen vohpi nephu dawna kham kuol kibasah tawh kibang ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Midihte’ lunggul pen a hoi lam behbeh ah a tawp hi; migilote’ kinepna pen lungthahna behbeh a suoh hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in pie ziehzieh napi a hau semsem uhi; adangte in a pieh ding uh hendap napi, cimaw gentheina beh a thuoh uhi."},"25":{"text":"A phal mipa hau semsem ding a, tui a pie pa in tui ma a ngakia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Antang zua nuom lote mipite in a gausam vua, a zua mite tungah thupha kipie hi."},"27":{"text":"Hanciem taha thuhoi a suite in maipha a nga vua, sietna a sui mite tungah sietna ma a tung hi."},"28":{"text":"A hauna uh a muong mite a vulmang ding vua, midihte, singna dawng bangin a khanpha ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"A innkuon sung a buoisah mite a hawmsuoh ding vua, mimawte pen mipilte’ sila a suoh ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Midihte’ ga in hinna singkung ahi a, mi kheltatte in mi tampi a that uhi."},"31":{"text":"Leitungah midihte a kithuhkia pai hi leh, migilote le mawneite bangza-in a kithuhkia zaw kan lai diei!","ref":"1Pet 4:18"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kithuhilna a deite in theina a dei vua, kiphawsietna a zadate mimaw ahi uhi."},"2":{"text":"Mi hoite in Topa tung pan maipha nga a, ama in sietna a bawl sawm mite a mawsiet hi."},"3":{"text":"Gitlona tawh koima in lungmuonna a mu sih a, midihte’ zungpi kilawh ngai lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Zi hoi pen a pasal’ mang lukhu hi a, mi a zumsuo numei pen a pasal’ gunatna tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Midihte’ ngaisutna pen thutang ahi hi; migilote’ gelna pen mi solna vive ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Migilote’ thugen pen mi that dinga buhdapna hi a, thumante’ thugen in amate hunkhie hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote kithalpai-in a om ta sih vua, midihte’ inn a kip zawsop hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat a ngaisut hoina hang tawh ama kigenpha a, lungsim letat mite kisimmaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Neh ding nei lopi-a mi thupi banga op sangin simmaw thuohin nasem khat nei ding hoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Midihte in a ganhingte’ kisapna thei a, migilote’ khuotuona in tatsietna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Amau’ lo a hlote in an hau ding a, kimanna nei lo nate a del kawikawite thu ngaisun thei lote ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Migilote in gitlona pana a nga uh nate deigaw a, midihte’ zungpi in ga a ga hi."},"13":{"text":"Migilote a hamna panun a khielnate utawh a awh vua, midihte ahi uleh buoina panin suohta uhi."},"14":{"text":"A kamsiemna panin mi khat na hoite tawh kidim a, thatang tawh nasepna in a thaman a nga hi."},"15":{"text":"Mimawte in a gamtatna uh a manin ngaisun a, mipilte in ahile mite’ thukuppina a ngai uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mimawte in a lungthahna uh thakhatin a kilangsah vua, mi pilvangte in zakona a awlmaw sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Thuman thutah a gen poma in thuman teci pang ahi a, a man lo teci in zuouthu beh a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngaisutna nei lo-a hamna in namsau bangin mi sun a, mipilte’ kamham in damna a piengsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Thuman a gen nephu kipden a, zuouthu gen leii ahile bakhat beh kimang hi."},"20":{"text":"Sietna a gelte’ lungsim sungah solna beh om a, kilemna ding vaihawmte a lungdam uhi."},"21":{"text":"Midihte tungah sietna tung lo a, migilote buoina tawh kidim hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in zuouthu a gen nephu kidah a, muonhuoi taha a gamtate ama’ lungkimna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mipil pa in a theina im khinkhian a, mimaw pa’ lungsim in a motna pholahlah hi."},"24":{"text":"Na sem dingin mi thadate a kipausawl laitahin, mi thanuomte’ khut in a uh ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Lunghimawna in mi lungkiesah a, a hoi kamham in mi lungdamsah hi."},"26":{"text":"Midihte in a guolte ngaisutna hoi pie a, migilote’ gamtatna in lam a pielsah hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi thadate in a samatte uh a hang sih vua, mi thanuomte in a manpha haunate a nga uhi."},"28":{"text":"Midihte’ lampi-ah hinna om a, tua lampi zuina-ah sina a om sih hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tapa pil in thuhilna dei a, mi simmawte in phawsietna a ngai nuom sih uhi."},"2":{"text":"Mi hoite in a thugenna ga panun na hoite a ne ding vua, mi zuoute’ deina pen sietna bawl ding ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A kam a kem zo mite pen a hinna uh kembih ahi pai uhi; a kam a golkahte ahile a kisie ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thanuomte’ deina a kiphungvua laitahin, mi thadate in deigaw napi bangma a nga sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Midihte in zuouthu muda a, migilote zumhuoi tah le mindaihuoi tahin a gamta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Dihtatna in thutanga a gamta mipa cing a, mawna in migilote a thalpai hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi kimkhat bangma nei lopi kihausah a, adang kimkhatte hau napi kizawngsah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hauna pen mi khat’ hinna takhietna ahi a, mizawng pa in galgihna kam a za sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Midihte’ khuovah lungdam a, migilote’ meivah a mit hi."},"10":{"text":"Hil ding a nuom lo kihisahna in kihauna piengsah a, mi thukuppite tawh pilna a omton hi."},"11":{"text":"A kinaw nga hauna kiemsuh pai ding a, a themthem-a khol mite’ sum khangkhang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A tungpah lo lametna in lungtang nasah a, lungtup tunna in hinna singkung ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuhilna simmawte in amate tunga sietna tut ahi vua, thupieh a zatah mite ahile thaman kipie ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilte’ thuhilna in hinna tuinah ahi a, tua pen sina thang tawh mi khat a kipelna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thu ngaisut siemna in maipha ngana ahi a, upna nei lote’ lampi in amau’ kisietna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi pilvangte in na zosie pilna tawh a sem vua, mimawte in a motna uh a pholahlah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kamtai hoi lo in mi buoisah a, palai muonhuoi in mi damsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Zawnna le mindaina pen thuhilna a thusim lote ading ahi a, phawsietna a thudon pa a kipatawi hi."},"19":{"text":"Deina tangtunna in hlagau adingin hlum vangut a, sietna bawl nading pana kiheina in mimawte dingin muthada huoi hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipilte tawh kigop mite mipil a suoh pai vua, mimawte tawh kigopte in gimna a thuoh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hamsietna in mawneite sulzui a, cithei nopsahna in midihte thaman a pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi hoite in a tu a tate’ luo ding gouluo nuasiepieh a, mawneite’ neisate pen midihte dinga kikhol hi lel hi."},"23":{"text":"Mizawngte’ lo-ah an tampi pieng thei a, thutang a op lo ziehin tuate maimang hi."},"24":{"text":"Ciengpum zang nuom lote a tate muda ahi a, amate a it mite in limtahin amate a thuhil hi."},"25":{"text":"Midihte in a khamkhop uh a nei vua, migilote’ gilpi ahile a hawmsuoh hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numei pil in a inn lam a, numei maw in a khut tawh phel hi."},"2":{"text":"Thuman-a kalsuonte in Topa a zatah vua, thuman lo-a gamta mi in ama a simmaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Mimawte’ ham in a elduong vua dingin ciengpum ahi a, mipilte’ nephu in amate kemcing hi."},"4":{"text":"Bawngtang op lona ah an a om sih hi; bawngtang’ hatna tawh an tampi kila hi."},"5":{"text":"Teci muonhuoi in zuouthu gen lo a, a man lo teci in zuouthu a gen hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi simmaw pa in a mawhna-in pilna sui a, thu theitel mite adingin pilna ol mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Mimawte’ opna pelh in, azieh pen nang in tuanah thu theina na mu sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi teite’ pilna in a pei nading uh lampi theitelna ahi a, mimawte’ motna in lam khielsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Mimawte in khielna ziehin biehna a simmaw vua, mi thumante in Pasien’ maipha nga-in nuom a sa uhi."},"10":{"text":"Lungtang in ama’ gentheina thei a, midangte in a lungnoppi thei sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilote’ inn kisusie a, thuman mite’ puonbuh gina semsem hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi khat dinga a man tawh a kibang lampi pen a tawpna ah sina lampi hi theizaw hi.","ref":"Pau 16:25"},"13":{"text":"Nui pum nangawnin lungtang na a, nopna a ven ciengin lunggimna om hi."},"14":{"text":"A letat mite in a gamtatna utawh kituohin a nga vua, mi hoite in a sepna utawh kituohin a nga uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mimawte in thu zosie um pai a, mi teite in a kalsuon nading ngaisun hi."},"16":{"text":"Mipilte kidawmin sietna panin a kihem vua, mimawte ahile kihisahin a kidawm sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"A lungtom mite mottat a, thugel mite kimuda hi."},"18":{"text":"Mimawte motna tawh kizem a, mi teite theina lukhu kikhusah hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihoite mai-ah misiete kun a, thumante’ tunkotah migilote a kun uhi."},"20":{"text":"A vengte nangawn in mizawngte ngai lo a, mihaute in lawm le guol tampi a nei uhi."},"21":{"text":"A vengte’ simmaw mite mawnei hi a, mizawng a hepite mi nuomsa ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Gitlo a sawmte a khiel hi lo uh amah? Thuhoi gelte in mite’ zatahna le muonna nga uhi."},"23":{"text":"Gimpipi-a nasepna zosie-ah phattuomna om a, kamkumna lel pen in zawnna-ah ei tut hi."},"24":{"text":"Mipilte’ mang lukhu in a pilna uh ahi a, mimawte’ paakuol in a motna uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Thutah a gen teci in mihingte’ hinna hundam a, zuouthu gen pa mi leheh ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa zatahna sungah mi khat in muonna kip nei a, a tate in kibuhna a nei ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Topa zatahna in hinna tuinah ahi a, tua khu mi khat in sina thang a pel thei nading ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Gammi tamna in kumpipa’ minthanna hi a, gam mite op lona-ah gam-uhte kisie hi."},"29":{"text":"A lungduoi mi poma theitelna lienpi nei hi a, a lungthah bai mipa in motna a tawisang hi."},"30":{"text":"Lungnopna in tahsa adingin hinna hi a, thangpaina in guletang muotsah hi."},"31":{"text":"Mizawngte a bawlsiete pen a Bawlpa simmaw ahi a, tasamte a hepi mite in ama a zatah uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amau’ gamtat sietna in migilote thalpai a, midihte in a citahna sung vuah kibuhna a mu uhi."},"33":{"text":"Theitelna a nei mite’ lungsim sungah pilna teng a, mimawte’ lungtangah tua pilna kithei kha lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Dihtatna in minam tawisang a, mawna in mi khatpo adingin mindaina ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Pilvang taha a gamta nasempa in kumpipa’ maipha nga a, zumhuoi taha gamta pa tungah ama’ thangpaina tung hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kamnem a dawnna in thangpaina damsah a, kamkhauh in lungthahna a sosah hi."},"2":{"text":"Mipilte’ kam in theina gen a, mimawte’ kam in motna phulsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ mit in mun zosie mu a, misie le mipha encien zing hi."},"4":{"text":"Kamnem in hinna singkung ahi a, kam gilo in lungsim suzan hi."},"5":{"text":"Mimawte in nu le pate’ thuhilna simmaw bawl a, thuhilna a thupisim mipa pen mi pilvang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi thumante’ inn sungah gougil tampi om a, migilote’ hauna in buoina piengsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Mipilte’ kam in theina thezah hi; mimawte’ lungsim sungah tua bang om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Migilote’ biehpiehna in Topa adingin kidahhuoi a, midihte’ thungetna in ama’ lungkimna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in migilote’ gamtatna kidahhuoi sa a, ama in dihna lam a del mipa a it hi."},"10":{"text":"Lamkhiel mite adingin thuhilna khauh om a, phawsietna a mudate a si ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa mai-ah Misikhuo le Sietna kipholahin a om hi, tua ahile mihingte’ lungsim bangza-in a kipholah zaw kan lai diei!"},"12":{"text":"Mi simmawte in a kiphawsiet ding a dei sih vua, mipilte kungah amate a pei sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Lungsim nopna in maitaisah a, lungsim gimna in lungsim suzan hi."},"14":{"text":"Theitelna a nei mipa’ lungsim in pilna sui a, mimawte in motna tawh a kam uh a va uhi."},"15":{"text":"A hin sung tungtawnun mizawngte in hahsatna thuohin, a lungdam mite in a tawntungin pawi a bawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Gougil tampi nei-a tua tawh lungkham sangin Topa zatahna tawh themkhat beh nei-a i op hoizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Kimudana tawh bawngthau’ sa nehna sangin ki-itna a opna munah ante me neh hoizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"A lungtom mite in kihauna piengsah a, a lungduoi mite in kihauna daisah hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi thadate’ lampi lingkungte tawh kidim a, midihte’ lampi pen a phei lam lienpi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tapil in a pa lungdamsah a, tamawte in a nute simmaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngaisutna a nei lo mite in motna kipahpi a, thu theitel mipa pen tangtahin gamta hi."},"22":{"text":"Kikupna om lo gelnate kikhiel a, thukuppi tampite tawh a maa a tun uhi."},"23":{"text":"A kilawma dawn theina in koipo lungdamsah a, a kilawm huna thugen bangza tahin hoi ahei!"},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen mipilte’ hinna lampi in a tunglam peipi to a, tua khu a nei lama om Misikhuo a pel thei nading uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in mi kiphasahte’ inn phelkhepieh a, ama in meigongte’ gamgi keppieh hi."},"26":{"text":"Gelna hoi lote Topa adingin kidahhuoi ahi a, hizongle ama muna-ah kamsiemna zong a siengtho ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"A manlopi-a nga nopna ziehin huoihamna in amau’ inn sung buoina piengsah a, hinanle guhgol mudate a hing ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Midihte’ lungsim in bangci dawn ding ci thu lungngai phot a, migilote’ kam in thusie a suokhie hi."},"29":{"text":"Migilote kung panin Topa gamla op a, ama in midihte’ thungetna a za hi."},"30":{"text":"Maitaina in lungsim kipahsah a, thutha hoi in pumpi tha thosah hi."},"31":{"text":"Kithuhilna laigil a thudonte mipilte lahah a teng ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Thuhilna awlmaw lote amau le amau a kisimmaw ahi a, kithuhilna a thupisimte in thu theitelna nga uhi."},"33":{"text":"Topa zatahna pen pilna sungah kithuhilna hi pai a, patawina masangin kiniemkhiehna a pei hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungsima gelnate pen mihing-a’ hi a, kam tawh dawnna ahile Topa kung pan ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing in gamtatna zosie ama’ muna-ah man sa a, hinanle Topa in amau’ lungsim na tawite hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa tungah na vaite ap in, tua hile na gelnate tangtung ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in na zosie tupna nei cietin bawl a, migilote nangawn zong buoina ni-in sietna thuoh dinga a bawl ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A kiphasah mite zosie Topa in kidahhuoi sa a, amate dan tuoh loin om lo ding hi, ci thu telcien in."},"6":{"text":"Citahna le muonhuoina tawh mawmaina kinga a, Topa zatahna tawh mi khat in gitlona pel thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Mite’ gamtatna in Topa a lungdamsah ciengin, ama in a galte uh nangawn amate tawh kilemsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Thutang lo tawh tampitah i nei sangin thumanna tawh tawmno khat i nei hoizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing lungsim in sep ding gel a, hinanle Topa in kalsuonnate lamlah hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa’ nephu in thuneina tawh a khensat hi; ama in thu a khen ciengin a khiel ngai sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tawikhaina man le tawisuongte Topa -a’ hi a, ip sunga om a gihte zosie ama’ bawlsa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Dihna in kumpi topha a kipsah ziehin, a sie-a gamtat ding pen kumpite adingin kidah a huoi hi."},"13":{"text":"A thudih nephute pen kumpipa’ lungkimna ahi a, ama in thuman gente a it hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thangpaina pen sina kamtaipa hi a, mipil khat poma in ama lungdamsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa’ maitaina ah hinna om a, ama’ maipha pen guo zusah meiite tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Kham sangin pilna nga ding bangza-in hoizaw ahei! Ngun sangin thu theitelna teelhuoi zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Midihte’ lampi in sietna pel hi; amau’ lampi a kemcingte in amau’ hinna zong a kem hi pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Sietna a tun masangin kihisahna om a, puana a tun masangin kiphatsahna lungsim a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi kisatheite tawh vanlah i hawm sangin lungsim kineimkhieh mizawngte lahah i op hoizaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Thuhilna a thupisim mite daupei ding a, Topa a muong mite mi nuomsa ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Lungsim pilte pen thu theisiem kici a, kamsiem in mihuoi theina khangsah hi."},"22":{"text":"Pilnna pen a nei mite adingin hinna tuinah hi a, mottatna in mimawte kidantatna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mipilte’ lungsim in a kamham uh pilvang tahin hamsah a, amau’ nephu-ah mi zawl theina kibelapsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Kamsiem pen khuoibal tawh kibang a, hlagau adingin hlumin pumpi adingin cidamna ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Khatveivei man i sah lampi khat pen a tawpna-ah sina lampi na hizaw thei hi.","ref":"Pau 14:12"},"26":{"text":"Nasemte in an a du ziehun na a sem vua, amau’ gilkielna in nasem dingin amate a sawlsawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lote in mi siet nading a ngaisun vua, a kamhamte uh ahile a katum thei meikuong bang hi."},"28":{"text":"A letat mite in kihauna a thezah vua, mi gensiete in lawmta ki-it lai a khenkham uhi."},"29":{"text":"Mi tatsiete in a vengte zawlin, a hoilo lampi-ah a pui uhi."},"30":{"text":"A mit-hem tawh mi hopite in sil hoi lo a gel vua, a nephu ei lesan pa in thusie tut hi."},"31":{"text":"Samkanna pen minthanna lukhu ahi hi; tua khu dihna hinkhuo tawh kinga ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Thagum hatna sangin lungduoina hoizaw a, khuopi khat a zo pa sangin a lungsim a zo pa hoizaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Puontuol tungah ai kisan nanleh Topa beh in khensatna pie hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kihauna tawh innsung dima pawi an nehna sangin lungnopna tawh an gumgaw halno khat nehna hoizaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Pilvang tahin a gamta sila khat in zumhuoi tahin a gamta tapa uh a, innkuon sung mite khat bangin ama in gamh a tang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sia a kihuontuina-ah ngun kihalin, meikhuh sungah kham kisittel a, ahi vangin Topa in mihing lungtang sittel hi."},"4":{"text":"Sietna a bawl mite in kamham gilo a ngai vua, zuouthu gen mipa in thu ginalo kigente a thupisim hi."},"5":{"text":"Mizawngte a thusim lote in amau a Bawlpa simmaw ahi uhi; midangte’ tuosietna-ah a thangphate pen dan thuoh loin a om sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuute pen tehsiete’ mang lukhu ahi a, nu le pate pen tate’ angtanna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Thuhoi genna pen mimawte adingin kilawm lo hi; zuouthu genna pen gam-uhte adingin kilawm lo kan lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Guhgol pen a piete’ muna-ah suong-ai tawh kibang a, a kihei napo vuah a daupei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mi’ khielna a maisah pa in lawm le guol hau a, mi tawh a kisel den pa in lawm le guol a tan ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mimaw khat zavei i sat sangin thu khinkhai thei khat khatvei i phawsietna pen thuh bunzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilote in ledona ding behbeh a sui vua, hinanle amate do dingin kamtai gilo khat kisawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A mottat mimaw khat tawh i kisih sangin a tano kilah pieh vompi tawh kituo ding hoizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuhoi sietna tawh a thuhkia mipa’ inn sung panin sietna veng ngai lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kihauna kipatna pen tuikuong ke pana a luong tui tawh kibang hi, tua hi a, kihau masanga khawl pai khian ding ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilote dih a tangsah pa le midihte maw a tangsah pa pen Topa dingin a ni-in kidahhuoi tuoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Sin nopna lungsim a nei lo mimawte’ khut sungah, pilna sin nadingin bang hangin sum ki-ap ding ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Lawm le guolte in ei it den a, sanggamte ahile hahsat huna ei thuohpi dinga ang pieng ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A vengpa ’ leiba a lopieh dingin kikhamin, kamciem piehna pen thu theimaw vai ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Gamtat khielna a dei pa kihauna dei ahi a, a sangkil a sang lamte pen gu tawn nading sui ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Lungsim kawite nuomsa ngai lo a, zuouthu a gente in hamsietna tuoh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tapa maw a neite in lunggimpi a, tapa maw a nei nu le pate lung nuom lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Lungtaina in zatui hoi khat ahi a, lungkiehna in gu le tangte gawtasah hi."},"23":{"text":"Thutang lampi heimang nadingin migilote in guhgol a daplah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Thu khinkhai thei pa in pilna en a, mimawte’ mit in leimong dong a en kawikawi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ta mawte a pate’ lunggimna ahi a, a hing nu adingin sinkhamna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Maw nei lo pa tungah lieu tuosah pen hoi lo a, a citahna uh ziehin mi thupite sat huoi lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Thugen ki-ip mipa in pilna nei ahi hi; a sip khinkhian mipa zong theitelna nei ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"A sip dide mimawte nangawn a pil dingin kingaisun hi; kamkeh loin a op ciengun, thu thei dingin kingaisun hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama guoha a tolten pa pen a nop banga om pa ahi a, mantaha kikhensa thu a thusim lona lah hi."},"2":{"text":"Mimaw khat in theitelna lamah nuom a sa sih a, ama’ mimal ngaisutna beh a gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Gitlona a tun ciengin simmawna zong tung a, mindaina a tun ciengin mindaina in zui pai hi."},"4":{"text":"Kam tawh thukigente tui thuhpi tawh kibang hi; pilna tuinah ahile luitui pulkhie bang hi."},"5":{"text":"Mawneite deisahin tuomhuom hoi lo a, midihte thukhenna tut ding hoi lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Mimaw khat’ kamham in kihauna piengsah a, mimaw khat’ kamham in tepuong ding ngen ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mimawte’ kamham in amau’ kisietna hi a, amate adingin a nephute uh pen thang ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Migensiete’ kamham pen antui tawh kibang a, tua khu pumpi sung lamah a tumsuh pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Nasep thada mipa pen sil susiepa tawh sanggamta ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ min pen a muonhuoi tausang ahi hi; tua sungah midihte tai-in hlamuong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mihaute’ neilelam in a kip a khuopite uh ahi hi; a ngaisutna vuah tua pen a sang kulpi tawh kibang hi."},"12":{"text":"Kisietna a tun masangin mi lungsim kiliensah a, patawina masangah kiniemkhiehna a pei hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi khat in a zahcien masanga thu khat a dawn leh, tua pen a mothuoi le a zumhuoi ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing’ lungsim in natna thuohzo napi, a kitamzan lungsim koi in thuoh zo ding ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Thu ngaisun thei khat in theina khol a, mipilte’ bil in theina sui hi."},"16":{"text":"Letsong in kotte hong a, tua in miliente tawh kimusah thei hi."},"17":{"text":"Midang khat pei-in a dawhcien masang sie-in thu gen masa pen pa-a’ a man tawh a kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Aisanna in kiselna vengsah a, mi thahat thu kitute kikalah thu khenpieh hi."},"19":{"text":"Sanggam kisietna pen khuopi khat lut sangin hamsa zaw a, tua banga kihauna pen khuopi tunkot golhte tawh kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"A kamhamna panin mi gilva a, a nephu-a a genna in a taisah hi."},"21":{"text":"Leii’ thuneina sungah sina le hinna om a, a leii a it mite in a ga a ne ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Zi mu zo pa pen sil hoi mu ahi a, Topa tung pana maipha nga ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mizawngte a ham ciengin thumna kam a zang vua, mihaute in khautahin a dawng uhi."},"24":{"text":"Lawm hoi kipang kimkhat om a, hinanle lawm hoi tahtah pen sanggamte sangin hoizaw hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zuouthu gen mimaw pa sangin citahna tawh kalsuon mizawng pa hoizaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Theina kici nei lopi-a lunggulna pen hoi lo a, a nawpei mi pa in lam a khiel hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khat’ mottatna in sietna tun a, Topa tungah a lungthah hi."},"4":{"text":"Hauna in lawm le guol tampi neisah a, mizawngte, lawm le guol nei loin kinuasie hi."},"5":{"text":"Zuou teci pang pa dan thuoh loin om lo ding a, zuou gen mipa suohta lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampi in uliente’ maipha a sui vua, letsong pie pa pen mi zosie’ lawm ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mizawngte pen a tanaute nangawn in muda ahile, a lawm a guolte in bangza-in pel zaw kan lai ding ahei! Amate hlanin a del ciengin tua sungah amate a om nawn sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Pilna suipa ahile ama le ama ki-it ahi a, thutelna nei ding pen daupei nading ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Zuou teci a pang pa dan thuoh loin om lo ding a, zuouthu gente zong kisie ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mimawte a noptat ding uh kilawm lo a, sila khat in uliente a uh ding kilawm lozaw lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Thu ngaisun siemte a lung uh duoi a, khielna khat kimumaw bawl pen vangneina ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa’ lungthahna pen humpinelkai’ hawh tawh kibang a, ahi vangin ama’ maipha ahile lopa tunga a kie daitui tawh kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"Tapa maw pen a pa adingin kisietna hi a, mi tawh a kihauhat zi pen a theu thei lo guomal kie tawh kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Inn le neisate pen nu le pa tung pana kiluo hi a, zi pil ahile Topa tung pan ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thasietna in kimut dusah a, a thada mipa a gilkiel ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Thupieh a zuite a hing ding uhi; a lampi uh a thusim lote si ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mizawngte tunga a thusiem poma Topa a leitawisah ahi a, a kiningcingin kisangsahkia ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Lamet a op hun sungin na tate thuhil in; amau’ kisiet nading lamah na lungsim koi sin."},"19":{"text":"A lungtom mi tatsie pa in mawna dan thuoh ding hi; va hunkhie ta lacin na hutkhiet kiakia kul ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mailam hun ciengin pilna na nga nadingin thukuppina ngai inlen, thuhilna mang in."},"21":{"text":"Mihing lungsim in gelna tampi nei a, ahizongin Topa’ ngaisutna beh kip ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi khat tungah a deihuoi thu in tahtaina hi a, zuougen mi khat hi ding sangin mizawng khat hi ding hoizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa zatahna in hinna tahtah ahi hi; tua tawh a kidim mipa nuomtahin khawlin, gimna a thuoh sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi thasiepa in a khut tawh ankuong sawhsuh a, a kam sunga a an tutkia ding nangawn a nuom sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi simmawte sat in; tua hile thuthei lo mipa in theina a nga ding hi. Thuthei mipa phawhsie in, tua hile amate in theina a nga ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"A pate tungah tatsie-in a nu a delmangte pen maizumna a piengsah le mindaina a tut tate ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ka ta aw, thuhilna na zah thei nadingin thu theinate panin na piel ding khawl in."},"28":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lo teci in thutang pen ciemmuina-in nei a, migilote’ kam in khielna valtum hi."},"29":{"text":"Mi thusim lote adingin mawsahna a baisa-in om a, satna pen mimawte’ elzang ading ahi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zu in mi zawnkhaw vagiap-in, zucia in mi kihausah a, zu in a puisiet mi poma mipil ahi sih hi."},"2":{"text":"A zauhuoi kumpipa’ lungthahna in a hawh vapom humpi tawh a kibang hi; ama a lungthahsah poma in a silaw vagiap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kiselna lah pana a kihemdawh pa kipahta a, hizongle mimaw poma a kihau paipai uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thasiepa in a hunin lo a hlo sih a, anlah hun ciengin a lah ding bangma a om pai sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihingte’ lungtup pen tuili bangin thuh a, hinanle thutel siem mite in tuate a sawh sieng ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampite amau le amau mi citahin a kigen vua, ahi vangin a muontah mi koi in mu zo ding ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Midihte citahna tawh a kalsuon vua, amate nua a zui tate mi nuomsa ahi uhi!"},"8":{"text":"Thukhenna topha tunga a to kumpipa in ama’ mit tawh sietna zosie pum zap bangin zap sieng hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ka lungsim ka siengsah hi; ka mawna panin ka sieng hi,” koi in ci thei ding ahei?"},"10":{"text":"A gihna kibang lo le tena kibang lote a ni-in Topa adingin a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Naupangte nangawn in a silbawlte a siengtho le a man ahi lam amau’ sepkhietna tawh a kitheisah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khuo zahna bil le khuo muna mit, tuate gel a nipi-in Topa’ bawl ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Kimut du vawt sin, tua hile na zawnlaw kha ding hi; na mit hahsah lenlon in, tua hile an le tui na nieng ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Van leipa in, “Hoi sih, hoi sih,” cici napi, a peizaw ciengin a kisahtheipi veve hi."},"15":{"text":"Kham le suong manpha tampi om a, hinanle theina a nei pa’ thugente pen suong manpha ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khat in gelta pa’ leiba lopieh nadinga a pieh a khapna puon la inlen, gamdang mite tungah pieh dinga a kamciemsa tua khapna van matpieh in."},"17":{"text":"Solna tawh kinga an tui vangut a, hinanle tua zaw ciengin kam sungah suongtang a dim ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Thukuppina ziehin gelnate kip hi; pilna tawh lamkaina zui-in gal kisim hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi gensietna in thusim teng pholah hi; tua ahi ziehin a mot-ham mite tawh kigop sin."},"20":{"text":"Na nu le na pa na samsiet leh mielking lahah na meivah kisumit ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A patna lama kinga dihauna pen a tawpna-ah thupha hi lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Sietna ka thuhkia ding hi,” ci sin; Topa ngah in, ama in ang hu ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A gihna kikim lote Topa adingin kidahhuoi a, tawisuong man lote hoi lo hi."},"24":{"text":"I kalsuonna zosie uh Topa’ sesa ahi hi; tua ahi mawh leh i gamtatnate i bangci thei ding uh ahei”"},"25":{"text":"Mi khat mot-ham pahin, “Tami a siengtho hi na,” ci-a a gen paina le kamciem a piehzaw cienga a nua ngaisut pan pen ama thang kisie ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"A pil kumpi in migilote tengkhie a, a tung vuah lengkang tawh a huol hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing lungsim pen Topa’ meivah hi a, i sungtawng dongin a sui hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa in citahna le muonhuoina kemcing a, dihtatna tawh a topha a tukip hi."},"29":{"text":"Khangnote’ thupina pen a thahatna uh ahi a, khanghamte’ melhoina pen a samkanna uh ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Vuohna zieha liemna in gitlona sawp sieng a, kisatna in a sungtawng dongin siengsah hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa’ lungtang pen luitui luong tawh kibang a, Topa’ khut sungah a om hi; ama in ama’ deideina po-ah a hei kawikawi lel hi."},"2":{"text":"A sempa’ muna-ah sepna zosie man a, hizongle Topa in mite’ lungtang a tawikhai hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in biehpiehna sangin thuman le thutang sep ding deizaw hi."},"4":{"text":"A kihisah mittang le a kiphasah lungtang- migilote’ meivah- khu mawna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nasep thanuomte’ gelna in kiningcinna ei tun valon a, hinanle a dihau nuom poma kitasam ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Zuou genna tawh a kinga nei le lamte pen a lengmang tuikhu le sina thang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote a manin a gamtat nuom lo ziehun, a tatsietna un amate kaiphit ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mikhielte’ lampi kawilieng a, mi siengthote’ gamtatna a man hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi tawh a kihau hat zi tawh inn sung khat ah i tenton sangin innkhum zang kiu khatah ten ding hoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote’ lungsim in sietna dei a, amau’ muna-ah a vengte in hepina mu kha lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Misimmaw khat dan a kipieh ciengin thu thei lote in pil law a, mipilte thu a kihil ciengin a thu theina uh khang semsem hi."},"12":{"text":"Midih Pa in migilote’ inn kantel a, ama in a kisie dingin migilote a sawnpua hi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawngte kikona na bil na hum leh nangma na kiko ding a, ang kidawng lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Letsong kidappieh in lungthahna daisah hi; kang sunga kipie phuolsel guhgol in sinsona damsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Thutanga na a kisep ciengin midihte adingin kipahna ahi a, ahi vangin sietna a bawlte adingin lungkiehna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Thutelna lampi pana vahmang mite pen misite kikhopna-ah a khawl ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"A noptat nuom poma tasam ding a, zu le sathau hai poma hau lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilote pen midihte adingin kitatna hi a, upna a nei lote pen mi thumante adingin kitatna ma ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"A phunhat le a hangsan zi tawh tenton sangin senel gamgaw-ah teng hit hiet leih hoizaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipilte’ inn sungah gou manpha omsuoh a, mimawte in tuate a netum pai uhi."},"21":{"text":"Dihtatna le migitna a del poma in hinna le patawina a mu ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Galhangte tenna khuopi sim dingin mipil khat kuonto a, amau’ muon mama khuo kulpi a satguoipieh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kam le leii kep siemna in buoina tawh ei kipelsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi kiphasah, mi kihisah pa pen “Misimmaw pa” kici a, ki-uongsahna tawh a gamta hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi thadate’ khut in na sem nuom lo ahi ziehin mi thada pa’ deigawna in sina a piengsah hi."},"26":{"text":"Migilote in sunthapai-in a deigaw mielmuol vua, midihte ahi uleh hen kici nei loin a pie uhi."},"27":{"text":"Migilote’ biehpiehna kidah a huoi hi; ngimna hoi lo tawh a tawi ciengun kidahhuoi zaw lai hi."},"28":{"text":"Zuouthu tecipang pa kisie ding a, thungai siem pa in guolzo tahin teci pang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Migilote in hansan mel a puo a, mi thumante in a pei nading ngaisun uhi."},"30":{"text":"Topa langkhatah pilna, thutheina, kithumopnate kimanna nei lo hi."},"31":{"text":"Galsim ni-a zah dingin sakol a baisa-in kikoi a, hizongle galzawna pen Topa hang ahi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Haunate sangin minphatna teelhuoi zaw a, ngun le kham sangin mi ei thupimuna hoizaw hi."},"2":{"text":"A zawng le a hau in tami nei tuoh uhi: Amahaw zosie a bawlpa, Topa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mipilte in zauhuoina mu-in kiphuol pai hi; mimawte peisuohin gimna a thuoh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Neilutna le Topa zatahna thaman in hauna, patawina le hinna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Migilote’ lampi-ah thang le so kisie hi; a kikem siemte in gamlapi panin tuate a pel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Lampi manah naupangte cil in, tua hile a vuoi dongun lampiel nawn lo ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mihaute in mizawngte uh a, sum leitawi pa pen leitawi a pie pa’ sila a suoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thudih lo a vaw poma in hamsietna a at ding vua, ama lungthahna ciengpum a kisusie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A phal mite in thupha nga ding hi, azieh pen amate in mizawngte an a hawm uhi."},"10":{"text":"Misimmaw pa notmang dawh in, tua hile kiselna dai pai ding hi; kihauna le kisimmawnate zong a veng pai ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Lungsim siengtho a dei mipa le kamsiema thugen mipa in kumpipa lawmin a nei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa’ mit in theina neite vil a, upna nei lote’ thugente a thalpai hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi thadapa in, “A pulamah humpi khat om! lampi-ah ei kithat kha va!” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"A thangtat numei khat’ kam pen dum thuhpi khat ahi hi; tua dum sungah Topa' lungthahna a tuhna mipa a kiesuh hi."},"15":{"text":"Naupangte pen a mot gamtat ngaina hi a, ahi vangin thuhilna ciengpum in gamlapi-ah a notmang hi."},"16":{"text":"A hau nuom ziehin mizawngte bawlsie-in, mihaute a piete in supna beh nga ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mipilte’ thugente: Na bil ei ngatin ka thugente za inlen, na lungsim sungah kang thuhilte lutsah in;","title":"Mipilte’ Thugente"},"18":{"text":"azieh pen tua thute na lungsim sungah vomin, tuate zosie a gen sieng dingin kithawi lacin nuom na sa ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa na muon thei nadingin tuni-in na kungah tua thute kang theisah zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang adingin kithuhilna le pilna thu nam sawm thum hing gielpiehin,"},"21":{"text":"a mantaha na dawnkia thei nadingin ang sawlpa tungah hing genpieh hi lo ka mah?"},"22":{"text":"A zawn ziehin mizawngte neisa lahpieh sinlen, mi gentheite tunkotah nuoithop sin;"},"23":{"text":"azieh pen amau’ vai-ah Topa pang a, amate a bulute’ hinna a bulu ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"A thangpai bai mite tawh kilawmta sinlen, a lungtom mite tawh zong kigop sin."},"25":{"text":"Tua hile amau’ gamtatnate zui-in thangah noma zong na awh ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Midangte’ leiba a lopieh dingin kikhamin kamciem a motpieh mite lahah kihal kha sin."},"27":{"text":"Leiba lo nading bangma na nei sih leh, bang zieha nangma’ nei-a lupna hing kilahpieh ding ahei?"},"28":{"text":"Na pu na pate’ na phusa kigi suong khin sin."},"29":{"text":"A nasepna vuah a siem mi na mu ei mah? Amate in kumpite’ na a sem ding vua, mi nautangte’ na a sem sih ding uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gam-uhte tawh an ne dinga na toton ciengin na mai-ah bang om ci hoitahin en inlen,"},"2":{"text":"anhai mi na hi leh na lawl-ah namta khat koi in."},"3":{"text":"Kisolna an ahi ziehin gam-uhpa’ antuite dugaw sin."},"4":{"text":"Hau nop manin gimpipi-in nasem sin; pilvangin khawl hun thei in."},"5":{"text":"Na mit mu sungin tuate tawpmang thei lel hi; azieh pen tua in thakhatin muvanlai bangin, a hla zapin vantung lamah a lengto ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi cilpawngte’ an nehpieh sin; a an tuite uzong dugawpieh sin;"},"7":{"text":"azieh pen tuate khu na dangtawng ang sun samzamte tawh kibang ahi hi. Amate in na kungah, “An ne inlen tui dawn in!” ang ci vangun, a lungsim tahpi uh hi lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Halkhat na neh sunsun na luokia ding a, na kamsiem gen teng maimang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mimaw pa’ zahna-ah thugen sin, na pil thugen teng ang simmawpieh lel ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tanglai kigi suongte khin sinlen, pa nei lote’ logam kehpieh sin."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen amau’ tanpa thahat a, na langkhat vuah amate panpi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kithuhilna-ah na lungsim ngat inlen, theina thu lamah na bil daw in."},"13":{"text":"Na tate thuhil ding kidiem sin; ciengduoi tawh sat nan lacin si lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate ciengduoi tawh sat lacin, Misikhuo panin a hinna uh na hunkhie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na lungsim a pil leh ka lungdam mama ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na kam in thuman a gen ciengin ka hlagau a kipah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na lungtang in mawneite engsah sinlen, Topa zatahna zom peisuoh in."},"18":{"text":"Mai lam hun khat pel lo-in om tahpi a, na kinepna a mawhna-in maimang lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thugen za-in pil inlen, tua lampi-ah na lungsim hei in."},"20":{"text":"Zuhaite lahah om sinlen, sahaite lahah zong om sin."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen zukhamte le anhaite zawng ding a, a kimutdu ziehun puonsie beh sil ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Na pienna na pa thu’ ngai inlen, na nu a vuoi ciengin simmaw sin."},"23":{"text":"Thuman thutah lei inlen zua sin; pilna, kithuhilna, le thu theitelna lei in."},"24":{"text":"Midihte’ pa a lungdam mama ding hi; tapa pil a nei pa zong a tapa tungah lungdam ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na nu le na pa lungdamsah in; na pienna na nu kipahsah in."},"26":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na lungtang ei pie inlen, ka lampite mitsuon gige in."},"27":{"text":"Numei pahtat khat pen dum thuh tawh kibang hi; angkawm numei khat pen a kuocih tuikhuh tawh kibang hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in misuom pa bangin buhdap a, upna a nei lo mi pungsah hi."},"29":{"text":"Koi in gimna thuoh ahei? Koi in dan thuoh ahei? Koi kisel ahei? Koi phunphun ahei? A thu om lopi-in koi liem ahei? Koi a mit san giagua ahei?"},"30":{"text":"Zu ne-a a tokhote, zucia a ciem nuomte ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hai sunga a phuon lihleh, lawl sunga a tumsuh vahiau, a san pimpem lengga zu etin zong nei vet sin."},"32":{"text":"Tua in a tawpna-ah gul bangin mi tu a, gul gunei in mi a tuh bang ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Na mit in na lamdangte na mu ding a, na lungsim in letatna thu vive a gen ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuipi laizanga a lum mi tawh na kibang ding a, tembaw khuom dawna a lum mi tawh na kibang ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“Ei vuoh vangun ka liem sih hi; ei sat vangun ka phawh kha sih hi. Bang hun ciengin ka khanglo diei? ka dawn ding zu suikia vang,” na ci ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilote eng sinlen, amate tawh kigop ding lunggul sin;"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen a lungsim un tatsiet ding ngaisun a, a kam un mi buoisah ding beh genin nei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna tawh inn kilam a, theitelna tawh tua inn kip hi;"},"4":{"text":"lunggel siemna tawh innkhan sung teng na manpha le na hoi zosiete tawh kidim hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi thahatte sangin mipil galhangte hatzaw a, thagum hatte sangin thu theina a neite hatzaw hi;"},"6":{"text":"azieh pen makai siemna tawh gal kizo a, thukuppi a tamna-ah guolzawna om hi."},"7":{"text":"Mimawte adingin pilna pen sang luo hi; amate in tunkot-ah kam a keh sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Sietna bawl ding a sawm poma buoina bawlpa kici ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Thu mot ngaisutna pen mawna hi a, mi simmawte pen mi zosie dinga a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hamsat hun ciengin na lungkieh leh a thazawngkhal na hi hi;"},"11":{"text":"sina lam zuona kipeipi mite le gaw dinga kikai mite hunkhie in;"},"12":{"text":"note in, “En in, tami theikha sih vung,” na ci uleh, lungsim a tawikhai pa in thei lo ding amah? Na hlagau a kemcing pa in zong thei lo ding amah? Amau’ gamtatna tawh kituohin ama in mi zosie thuhkia lo ding amah?"},"13":{"text":"Ka ta aw, khuoizu a tui ziehin ne inlen, khuoibal pana a luongte na kamah hlum mama hi."},"14":{"text":"Pilna zong na hlagau adingin tua bang ahi lam thei in; pilna na mu leh, na mailam na mu ding a, na kinepna a kikhahtan sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilote bangin thuman mite’ inn buhdap sinlen, thuman mite’ tenna munah va tatsie ta sin."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate sagivei a pua vangun a thokia ding uhi; ahi vangin migilote ahile tuosietna in a thalpai hi."},"17":{"text":"Na galte a pua ciengin lungdam sinlen, a kipalkhah ciengin zong thangpha sin."},"18":{"text":"Tua bang na bawl le Topa in mu-in a lungkim sih ding a, amate kung panin a lungthahna heimang ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Sietna bawlte ziehin lunghimaw sin. Migilote eng vawt sin;"},"20":{"text":"azieh pen migilote in mailam a nei sih uhi; migilote’ meivah a mit ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka ta aw, Topa le kumpipa zatah inlen, tua tegel’ thu mang loin om sin;"},"22":{"text":"azieh pen ama gel kung panin tuosietna thakhatin ang pei a, tua tegel’ tunsah thei ding sietna koi in thei ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Tamte zong mipilte’ thugente ahi hi: Thukhenna-ah deidan nei hoi lo hi.","title":"Mipilte’ Genbelai Thute"},"24":{"text":"Migilote kungah, “Mawna nei sih teh,” a ci poma mipite in samsie-in minamte in muda ding hi;"},"25":{"text":"hinanle migilote a samsiete a lung uh kim ding a, amate tungah thupha hoi tung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A mana a dawng mipa pen a nephu tawh mi tawp ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"A pulam nasep ding bawlkhol inlen, na lo-a nasep ding a baisa-in koi in; tua zaw ciengin na inn lam in."},"28":{"text":"Thu om lopi-in na innvengpa langkhatah teci pang sinlen, na kam panin zuouthu gen sin."},"29":{"text":"“Amate in kei tunga ang bawl bangin midangte tungah ka bawl ding hi; amau’ ei bawl bangin ken zong amate ka thuhkia ding hi,” ci sin."},"30":{"text":"Mi thasiepa’ lo lai ka nawhkha a, mimaw pa’ lengga lo ka zawtkha hi;"},"31":{"text":"ka et ciengin mun zosie-ah lingkung po hi; lahkhai in a leitang khumang a, daithaw suong teng cimguoi sieng hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bang teng ka mu ciengin ka lungsan hi; tua pen ka en a, thuhilna khat ka nga hi."},"33":{"text":"Bakhat sung kimutna, haituh pahna le a khawl dingin bakhat sung khupzepin na op kalin,"},"34":{"text":"nang tungah misuom pa bangin zawnna le galhiem a tawi galhangpa bangin tasapna ang tung ding hi.","ref":"Pau 6:10-11"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah’ uliente in a teikhiet Solomon’ paunahte ahi hi.","title":"Solomon’ Thupil Genbete"},"2":{"text":"Thu ipna pen Pasien’ minthanna hi a, thu kankhiet pen kumpite’ minthanna ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Vantungte sangin leitung a thuh zaw ma bangin kumpite’ lungsim zong thuhin kikan zo lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngun panin a eh la dawh leih ngunkheng pa adingin vanzah khat suoh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa’ mai panin migilote la dawh leih dihna sungah a kumpi topha kip ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa mai-ah kithupisah sinlen, miliente’ dinna munah ding kha sin;"},"7":{"text":"azieh pen mithupi khat’ mai-a ei kiniemkoi sangin, “Tanah hing to ta’n,” ei kici ding hoizaw hi. Na mit in a mu popo","ref":"Luk 14:8-10"},"8":{"text":"thukhen zum tut paipai sin; azieh pen na vengte in hing maizumsah leh a tawpna-ah nang in bang na law ta diei?"},"9":{"text":"Na vengpa beh ma tawh thu kisel inlen, midangte’ thusim pholah sin;"},"10":{"text":"tua hile ang zuidap khat in ang maizumsah ding a, na minsietna a tawp ngai sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A kilawm hunin kamteng khat genkhiet pen ngunpeh tunga kham apple kisuong tawh kibang hi."},"12":{"text":"A sang thei mipa adingin pilna tawh mi phawsietna pen kham bilba ahi sihle kham kizepna tawh kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"Kamtai muonhuoite pen a sawlte adingin anlah hun cienga vuakhal vot tawh kibang a, tuate in a pute’ lungsim thasuosah hi;"},"14":{"text":"letsong a pieh ngai lopi a kisielpipa pen guo a zusah lo meiite le huipite tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"Lungduoina tawh gam-uhpa kithuzaw thei a, kam nem in guletangte hliehtawng zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Khuoizu na mu leh na khamkhop za beh ne in, tua hi sihle na tam neh sengin na luo kha ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na vengpa’ inn ah haw mun seng sin, na haw mun leh na vengpa in hing cimtahin hing muda ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A vengpa’ langkhatah a man lo teci a pang pa pen phawhbul, namsau, ahi sihle thal hiemte tawh kibang hi."},"19":{"text":"Hahsat hunin a zuoutat mi khat i muon khah pen hana khat, ahi sihle khelbai khat tawh kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi lunggim khat kunga lasa pa pen liemma tunga lengga tuithua sunsuh tawh kibang hi. Puonsil lahah a om nget bang ahi sihle sing lahah a om lungpuh tawh kibang a, dana in mihingte’ lungtang hlaiguoi hi."},"21":{"text":"Na galte a gilkiel leh a neh ding an pie inlen, a dangta uleh a dawn ding tui pie in;"},"22":{"text":"azieh pen tua bang bawl lacin amau’ lu tungah meikamsa a sungsuh na hi ta ding a, Topa in thaman ang pie ding hi.","ref":"Rom 12:20"},"23":{"text":"Leilu lam hui in guo zusah a, mi sutuo thei leii in lungthah mel puo hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi tawh kihau hat zi tawh inn khat sunga tenton sangin innkhum vum kiu khata ten hoizaw hi."},"25":{"text":"Khuol gamlapi pana thuhoi zahna pen a dangta mi khat in tuivot tui a sah tawh kibang hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi thumante in migilote a zuikhah pen tuinah buon le tuikhuh nieh tawh kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"Khuoizu tam
