neh seng ding hoi lo a, mi ei patawi ding hasui zong hoi lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama le ama a ki-uh zo lo mipa pen kulpi nei lo, a kulpi a cimzan khuopi tawh kibang hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khal lai-a vuakie le anlah huna guozuh bangin mimawte adingin patawina kilawm lo hi."},"2":{"text":"A thu om lopi-a samsietna pen tupna a nei lo gitta hon leng bang le a leng kawikawi sielpaleng tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakol sat nadingin khaupum kisamin, laa adingin kamkaih kisam a, mimawte elduong sat nadingin ciengduoi kisam hi."},"4":{"text":"Mimawte a motna tawh kizui-in dawng sin, na dawn leh nang zong a maw na hi ta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mimawte a motna tawh kizui-in dawng in, tua hi sihle amau’ mit-ah a pil kisa thei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mimaw khat kamtai-a sawlna pen ama’ keng a sattan, tatsietna tui dawn pa tawh kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Khelbai pa’ keng a kimawh khai bangin mimawte’ kama paunah kigen pen kimanna nei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Mimawte patawi pen saili kuong sunga sailungtang khicip tawh kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Mimaw khat’ kam pana paunah thuhilna pen zukham pa’ khuta a gieh den ling tawh kibang hi."},"10":{"text":"Mimaw a tuokhah khatpo, ahi sihle zukham khatpo tha a ciel pa pen mi zosie a ban liemsah thalkap pa tawh kibang hi."},"11":{"text":"Ui in a luoh a nehkia bangin mimaw pa zong a mottat kia zel hi.","ref":"2Pet 2:22"},"12":{"text":"A muna vuah pil a kisa mi na mu ei mah? Amate sangin mimawte adingin lametna omzaw lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi thasiepa in, “Lampi-ah humpi om! Gawldung teng ah humpi om!” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"A kikhaina kawmpeh tungah kotpi a kihei bangin, mi thasiepa a lupna tungah kihei kawikawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi thasiepa in ama’ khut tawh ankuong sawhsuhin, a kam sunga a tutkia ding pen gim a kisa mama hi."},"16":{"text":"A kilawm a kituoha thu a dawng thei mi sagi sangin mimaw khat ama’ kimuna-ah pil kisazaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Midangte’ kihauna-ah a kikumthaw pa pen ui vahmuong khat a bila a kai kawikawi mi pawlkhat tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Si theina singkhuo-am le thaltang mot kap mimawpa le"},"19":{"text":"a vengpa solin, “Ka ciemmuina hi bo!” a ci pa a kibang giap hi."},"20":{"text":"Singkhuo a op sih leh mei mit a, mi gensietna a op lona munah kihauna veng hi."},"21":{"text":"Meihol in mei amsahin singkhuo in mei a kuonsah bangin mi tawh, kihauhat pa in kiselna kuontaw hi."},"22":{"text":"Gensietna kamteng pen antui mama tawh kibang a, mihing’ pumpi sungtawngah tuate a tumsuh pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Lungsim gilo napi a kamzol dihdehte pen cim kizut leibeel tawh kibang hi."},"24":{"text":"Galte in lungsim tah gen loin amau’ sungah mi sol nopna beh a om hi;"},"25":{"text":"a lungsim sungah a huothuoi thu sagi tah kiphuol ahi ziehin, galpa khat in kam nem tawh ang hopi ciengin um malmal sin;"},"26":{"text":"a ngianku tawh mudana phuol nanle mi hon lahah galpa’ gitlona kipholah veve ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Dum to poma tua sung ma-ah kiesuh ding a, suongtum lia poma ama tung ma-ah tua suongtum a tukia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Zuouthu genna leii in a solsa mite muda a, mipawhna kam in sietna piengsah hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zing cieng hun adingin kimasiel sin, azieh pen ni khat in bang hing piengsah ding ci na thei sih hi.","ref":"Jas 4:13-16"},"2":{"text":"Nangma’ kam tawh kiphattawm sinlen, midang in kiphatsah zaw in. Nangma’ kam tawh hi loin thei lo mi khat in hing genphazaw heh."},"3":{"text":"Suongtum gih a, senel zong gih hi, hizongle tua tegel sangin mimawte’ lungthahna gihzaw lai hi."},"4":{"text":"Thangpaina pen siehuoi a, lungthahna in mi valtum thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Phuolsel itna sangin langtang phawsietna hoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"I guolte’ ei liemsahna pen ei deisahna uh ahi a, galte khat’ ei biengtawp pen ei lebawlna ahi bo hi."},"7":{"text":"A gilva seng mipa in khuoizu du nawn lo a, a gilkiel mipa in a kha nangawn hlumsa hi."},"8":{"text":"Inn pana a vahmang mipa pen a bu sung pana a lengmang va tawh kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Sathau namtui le panamtui in lungsim nuomsah a, lungkham buoinate in mihing' lungsim kehkhesah hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma’ lawm le na pa’ lawm le guolte taisan sin; na tuosiet ni ciengin na sanggamte’ inn ah haw sin. A gamla-a om sanggamte sangin a nai-a om innveng khat hoizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ta aw, pil inlen ei simmaw poma ka dawn thei nadingin ei lung nuomsah in."},"12":{"text":"Mipilte in a zauhuoina mu-in a kiphuol pai uhi; mimawte ahile a peisuoh vua, gimna a thuoh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mi khat in gelta pa’ leiba lopieh nadinga a pieh a khapna puon la inlen, gamdang mite tungah pieh dinga a kamciemsa tua khapna van matpieh in."},"14":{"text":"Koipo in zingmawng thobai-in awging tawh a innvengpa thupha a pieh pen samsietna-in kingaisun ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi tawh a kihau hat zi pen tualai-a a theu thei lo guociin tawh kibang hi;"},"16":{"text":"tua nu kham ding pen hui i kham tawh kibang a, ahi sihle zietlam khuta sathau i ham tawh kibang ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Sia in sia ma tat hiem thei a, mi khat in midang khat pilsah thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Theikung a cingte in a ga ne ding a, a pupa kem poma kipatawi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tui in maitang a lensawn bangin mihing khat’ lungsim in midang khat a lengsawnkia hi."},"20":{"text":"Misikhuo le Sietna lungkim ngai lo a, mihing’ mittang zong lungkim ngai lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Sia kihuontuina-ah ngun zong kihalin, meikhuh sungah kham kize-et a, phatna tawh mihing khat kisittel hi."},"22":{"text":"Mimaw khat pen antang tawh sum sungah suh tawh gawitha nan lacin, a motna theu tuon lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tuuhonte’ opdan thei siem inlen, na bawnghonte limtahin kem in;"},"24":{"text":"azieh pen hauna a kip zing sih a, kumpi lukhu zong khang tawntungin kip lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Lopate a ki-at ciengin a tha ang suongkia a, muoltunga lohingte ki-atin a kikhol ciengin,"},"26":{"text":"tuute in na puon ding hing sihin, na keelte in lo cing khat’ man ang pie ding hi;"},"27":{"text":"nangma’ neh ding, na innkuonpite neh ding le na nasem numeite na vah nadingin, keel nawite a kicingin ang om ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koima’ del lopi-in migilote taimang a, midihte ahile humpi bangin hangsan uhi."},"2":{"text":"Gam sung mite a tawnkhiel ciengin, gam-uh ding mi tampi a nei uhi; ahi vangin mipil gam-uh khat’ vang tawh vaihawmna kip den hi."},"3":{"text":"Mizawngte a bawlsie gam-uh pa khat pen ankungte hen nei loin a satpai guo tawh kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham a taisan mite in migilote a pahta vua, thukham zui mite ahile amate tawh kilem lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi tatsiete in thutang a thei sih vua, Topa a suite in tua thu a cingin a thei uhi."},"6":{"text":"A lungsim kawi mihau khat i hi ding sangin a citah mizawng khat i hi ding hoizaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Thukham zui mite pen ta pil ahi vua, a gongsan mite tawh kigopte in nu le pa a maizumsah hi."},"8":{"text":"A neisa belap nadinga a met tampi a la pa pen mizawng a khuotuo midang khat dinga sum kholpieh hi lel hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khat in thukham a zui nuom lo ciengin ama’ thungetnate nangawn a huothuoi ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi thuman khat pen sietna lampi-a puikhielte amau’ tawsa dum sungah kie ding a, genbanglo mite in ahile gamh hoi a luo ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amau’ kimuna-ah mihaute pil kisa mama a, a zawng mipil pa in a opdan panun thei pai lel hi."},"12":{"text":"Midihte a vangliet ciengin lungdamna lienpi om a, migilote a guolzaw ciengin mite kiphuolmang hi."},"13":{"text":"A khielna imcipte koima daupei lo ding a, mawna pulahin tuate a nuasie mipa in hepina nga ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A zau ngai lo mipa pen mi nuomsa ahi a, a lungtang khaute in tuosietna thuoh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mizawngte a uh migilopa pen humpi hawh vapuoh le mi a del vapual vompi tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Thu teltheina a nei lo gam uhpa pen a gilo mi bawlsie pa ahi hi; a man lo-a ngana a muda pa a khankum sawt ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khat in midang khat thatin sisan a suo leh, tua mithatpa pen a si dongin khuotai hi taheh; koima in ama huna pie sih heh."},"18":{"text":"Citahna tawh a kalsuonte kihun ding a, lampi kawi a zui poma Guom sungah kiesuh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Lo a hlo tapo neh le tah nieng ding a, kimanna nei loin a taapva pa a zawng puong ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi muonhuoite in thupha tampi nga ding a, a haubai nuom mipa pen dan thuoh loin om lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Huptuom le paituom neina pen hoi lo hi, hinanle neh ding an halkhat ziehin mi khiel thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi huoiham le mi cilpawngte in amate kunga a tung ding supna thei lopi-in a nawhau nuom uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kam tawh miphatpa sangin mi phawhsie pa in a nua ciengin maipha ngazaw ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A nu a pa’ neisa teng lahpiehin, “Tami khielna hi sih,” a ci mipa pen mi siesahpa tawh kipawl ma hi veve hi."},"25":{"text":"A huoiham mi in kihauna kuontaw a, Topa a muong mite a hau ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"A pilna a suongte mimaw ahi uhi; pilna tawh kalsuonte in lungmuonna nga ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Mizawngte tungah sil a pie poma in bangma kisapna nei lo ding a, mizawngte a kimumaw-bawl poma in samsietna tampi nga ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Migilote a guolzaw ciengin mite kiphuolmang hi; amate ang kisiet ciengin midihte a pung hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kiphawhphawh nanle a lungkhau paupaute damsah zawh lo za dongin kisie ding uhi."},"2":{"text":"Midihte a vaihawm ciengin mipite lungdam hi; migilote a vaihawm ciengin mipite genthei-in tau uhi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna a dei tapa in a nu le a pa lungdamsah a, numei pahtatte tawh a kigop mipa in a neisa teng mawhmai sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in thutang tawh a gam kipsah a, sum don hat kumpipa in a gam susie hi."},"5":{"text":"A vengpa a maitang phat poma a vengpa, ama' kengah a awh thei nadinga a thangsiena ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"A tatkhielna ziehun migilote thangah awh a, midihte in ahile lungdamin la sa uhi."},"7":{"text":"Midihte in mizawngte’ nga ding lawm teng a thei uhi; migilote in tua bang theitelna a nei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mi simmawte in khuopi khat a haltum vua, mipilte in thangpaina a daisah uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mipil khat le mimaw khat zumah a kiheh leh kihosietna le kiselphona veng thei lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Sisan a suo mite in genbanglo mite muda a, amate in midihte tha dingin a sui uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mimaw pa in a lungthahna pulah sieng a, mipil pa dai tahin ki-ip hi."},"12":{"text":"Gam-uh pa khat in zuouthu po a tahsan leh, ama’ uliente zosie zong a gilo pai ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawng pa le mi bawlsie pa a kibahna tami ahi hi: Topa in a ni gelin a mit uh a vahsah tuoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in mizawngte tungah mantahin thu a khen leh, ama’ kumpi topha kip tawntung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ciengduoi le kiphaw kisapna in pilna ei pie a, bangma awlmaw lo naupang in a nu maizumsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilote in thu a nei ciengin tawnkhielna khang semsem a, midihte in amau’ pua dan a en ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na tate thuhilin sam in, tua hile amate in toidamna ang pie ding hi; amate in na lung zong ang nuomsah ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Mukholna a op lona munah mipite thangtat a, thukham a zuite pen mi nuomsa ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Nasemte, kam maimai tawh kibawlpha thei lo hi, azieh pen amate in thu tel nan ule a thupisim sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"A phengham mi na mu ngai ei mah? Tua pa sangin mimaw khat ading lametna omzaw lai hi."},"21":{"text":"A neu lai pana a kihawmthaw bawl sila pa in a tawpna lamah sietna a tut ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A lungthah mi khat in kihauna piengsah a, mi lungtom khat in khielna tampi piengsah hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi khat’ kihisahna in ama niemkhieh ding a, lungsim kiniemkhieh mi in patawina nga ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Guta tawh kigop pa pen a hinna muda ahi a, ama in mite’ samsietna a zah vangin bangma gen lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Midangte giinna in thang a kam a, Topa a muong mipa a lungmuong hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi tampite in gam-uhpa’ maipha sui a, hinanle Topa kung panin mi khat in thutang nga hi."},"27":{"text":"Midihlote in midihte huo a, migilote in zong mi thumante a huo uhi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakeh’ thusuo kammalte ahi hi. Mipa in tam bangin gen hi: Pasien aw, kei ka gim a, Pasien aw, ka gim hi. Bangci zaw thei ding ka hei?","title":"Agur’ Thugente"},"2":{"text":"Mihing buong dingin ka nah mot mama hi; mihing thutel theina ka nei vawt sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna ka na sin kha sih a, siengtho pa thu zong ka na thei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantungah koi ka to-in kumsuhkia ahei? A khutkuoh sunga hui a hum thei koi ahei? A puonkulah tuipi a tun thei koi ahei? Leitung mong zosie a phutkip koi ahei? Tua pa’ min bang ahei? Tua pa’ tapa a min bang ahei? Nang na thei valon hi!"},"5":{"text":"Pasien’ thugen zosie in a manna lahtel hi; ama a belte adingin kidalna lum ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’ kammalte belap sin, na belap leh ama in ang phawhsie ding a, mizuou na hi lam ang kimu ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma kungah thu ni kang ngen hi; ka si masangin tua tegel ei niel sin:"},"8":{"text":"Zuou genna le mi solna panin a gamlapi-ah ei hemkhie in; ei hausah seng sinlen, lah ei zawngsah seng sin; ka kisap za lien an tawh ei vah in."},"9":{"text":"Hau seng leng nangma kang niel ding a, “ Topa kici koi ahei? kang ci kha ding hi; zawng seng leng lah mi’ na guhpiehin ka Pasien’ min kang daisah kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A pupa kungah nasem khat mindaisah sin, na gensiet leh a nasempa in nang hing samsie-in ang kimawsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A pate samsie-in a nute thupha a pie lo mi a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate siengtho loin bua mama napi amau’ muna-ah sieng a kisa mi a om hi."},"13":{"text":"A kithupisah sengin van lamah sangda to-in a mitkhu mul a tozut mi a om hi!"},"14":{"text":"A ha uh namsau tawh a kibang, gam sunga mizawngte a netum ding le, mihingte lahah micimawte a valtum dingin, a ha uh namta tawh a kibang mi a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Vot in tanu ni nei a; “Ei pie in, ei pie in, ci-in a kiko uhi. A lungkim thei lo sil thum om hi; sil lite in, “Pha ta” a ci ngai sih uhi:"},"16":{"text":"Misikhuo, a ciing naubu, a dangta zing leitang, le “Pha ta” a ci ngai lo meikuong ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"A pa simmaw bawlin a mitte phen a, a nu thu mang loin a motbawl mipa pen kuom sunga va-ahte in a mittang kheipieh ding a, langtate in a sa a ne ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Lamdang ka sah mama sil thum a om hi; ka thei lo sil li a om hi:"},"19":{"text":"Vanlai zawlah muvanlai lenna lampi, suong tunga gul peina lampi, tuipi vumte tunga tembaw peina lampi, le nungah tangvalte peina lampite ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Angkawmnu’ gamtat zie tami ahi hi: Tua nu in angkawmin kisil sieng a, ama in, “Khielna bangma ka bawl sih hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Leitung kilingsah sil thum om a, tua in a thuoh zo lo sil li om hi. Tuate in:"},"22":{"text":"Sila khat kumpi a suo cieng, mimaw khat in an a kham cieng;"},"23":{"text":"koima’ dei lo numei khat in pasal a nei cieng, nasem numei khat in a pinu’ za a suon cieng, ci teng ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Leitungah neu mama napi a pil mama sil li a om hi:"},"25":{"text":"Mesite a tha uh hat lo napi khal sungin a neh ding an a khol uhi;"},"26":{"text":"Ngalvangte zong hat lo napi suongkawmah a kuo ding bawl uhi;"},"27":{"text":"kauphete in kumpi nei lo napi a honhonin a unpi-un a pei valiei uhi."},"28":{"text":"Innlawite khut tawh kiman zo lel napi kumpite’ inn sungah a kimu thei giap hi."},"29":{"text":"A kalsuondan uh a pikuon thum om a, a kalsuondan uh a thupi suo li a om hi:"},"30":{"text":"Gamsate lahah a thahat pen, koima’ mai-ah a nuakin lo humpi;"},"31":{"text":"A kihisah pei aahlui, le keeltang, a mite’ mai-ah a uongpie kumpipa ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Na mot ziehin nang le nang kitawisangin, ahi sihle thusie bawl ding na sawm ngai leh, na khut tawh na kam hum in."},"33":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile bawngnawi lawhlawh leih bawngnawi khal hing suoh a, i nahkuo nah nuoi leih a si a suo ma bangin, i lungthah ciengin kihauna a pieng hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nu in Kumpi Lemuel tunga a thugente ahi hi:","title":"Kumpi Lemuel’ Nu Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"Hi lo hi, ka tapa aw! Hi lo hi, ka sunga pieng ka tapa aw! Hi lo hi, ka kiciemna ka tapa aw!"},"3":{"text":"Numeite tungah na thatang teng zang sinlen, na lampi-ah kumpite a susie mite lutsah sin."},"4":{"text":"Lemuel aw, kumpite pen zu dawn ding ahi sih a, gam-uhte zong zucia-te dugaw ding ahi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hi mawh leh zu dawnin a thu khensate uh a mangngil ta ding vua, migentheite mite nga dinga kilawmte a leheipieh ta ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"A mangthai ding mipa zucia pie inlen, a lungkham mama mite zu pie in."},"7":{"text":"Amate zu dawnsahin a zawn lam mangngilsah in, a lungkhamna uh phawhsah nawn sin."},"8":{"text":"Thu a gen thei lote tangin genpieh inlen, micimawte’ hamphat nadingin genpieh in."},"9":{"text":"Amate ading thu genin mantahin thukhen inlen, a zawng micimawte hamphatna ngasah in."},"10":{"text":"Koi in zi hoi mu zo ding ahei? Suongmanpha sangin manhamzaw tham hi.","title":"Zi Hoi Patawina"},"11":{"text":"A pasal in ama muong mama a, ama’ vangin a pasal a tasam ngai sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in khan tawntungin a pasal tungah sil hoi bawl a, a siet nading bawl lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in samul le khau sui a, thanuom tahin a khut tawh na sem hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in sumbawlte’ tembaw bangin gamlapi panin a an ding a tut hi."},"15":{"text":"Khuomiel lahpi-ah tho-in a innkuonpite neh ding an a bawlpieh a, a nasem numeite’ sep dingte a vaihawmpieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in logam khat lei sawmin a lei pai hi; ama in a thalawsa sum tawh lengga lo khat a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in nasep hakatin a nih singten a, a ban tegel a khausah hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a sumbawlna a met lam thei a, zankim zankhangin a meivah mit ngai lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a khut tawh muizom a, a khut tawh siem gan hi."},"20":{"text":"Mizawngte tungah a khut zah a, a khut tawh tasam mite a zam phei hi."},"21":{"text":"A innkuonpi zosie puonlum a guon zo ziehin vua a kieh vangin a innkuonpite dingin lunghimaw lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in a lupna tuom dingte bawl a, a puon pen saihadiel puon le puon ausante ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Khuopi tunkota om upa vaihawmte lahah a pasal a to ciengin mite in ama a theikim uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in saihadiel puon khui-in tuate a zua hi; ama in kawnggate bawlin sumbawlte a puoh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama’ kivonna puon pen hatna le zatahhuoina ahi a, ama in ang tung ding hunte a nuisan zieu lel hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in pilna tawh a kam kah a, ama in a leii panin khuotuo thuhilna dan a gen hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in a innsung vaite hoitahin van a, thadana an a ne sih hi."},"28":{"text":"A tate tho-in ama pen mi nuomsa nu a ci vua, a pasal in zong ama nu a pahta mama a:"},"29":{"text":"“Numei tampite in hoitahin semzo tama leh, nang in amahaw zosie na leh zo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngaibanna pen kisolna hi lel a, meihoina zong a mawhnapi hi lel hi. Hinanle Topa a zatah numei pen a phattah ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"A khut tawh a sepna ga’ satanh pie unlen, mite in a nasepnate ziehin khuopi tunkotah phat ta uheh."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thuhilna","shortname":"Thna","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuhilna laibu (ecclesiastes)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem-a kumpi a sem David’ tapa Siepa’ thugente.","title":"Kumpi’ Thu Lunggelpa Ngaisutna"},"2":{"text":"Siepa in, a mawhnapi, a mawhnapi, na zosie a mawhnapi, ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Mite in sun nisa nei-ah gim le tawlin na a sep ziehin bang teng lemlaw nei uh ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Khang khat tawpin khang khat tung a, hinanle leitung a ngaingai bang den hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni suohin ni tum a, a suona munah kilekia pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Leitaw lamah hui lang a, leilu lam kimvel hi; a kimvelin hui lang kawikawi a, a lanna ngai ma-ah a lang zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Luite zosie tuipi sungah luongsuh a, hizongle tuipi a dim tuom sih hi; luite a luonna mun ma ah a luongkia zel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Sil zosie lunggimhuoi a, mi gen zawh ding hi lo hi; mit in a mucim thei lo a, bil in a zah cim thei lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ang pieng dingte pen a piengsate ma hi a, a kisemkia dingte zong a kisemsate ma ahi hi; sun nisa nei-ah a tha bangma om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"“En in, tami a tha hi,’ ci-a gen thei ding na khat beh a om amah? Tamte eihaw masang kum tampi lai-a na omsa ahi ta bo hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi masate kiphawh kha nawn lo a, ang pieng lai ding mite zong amate nua-a khangkia dingte in a phawh kha nawn sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Keima, Siepa in Jerusalem ah Israel kumpipa ka hi lai-in,","title":"Pilna Suina A Mawhnapi"},"13":{"text":"leitunga sil kibawl vannuoi pilna tawh sui ding le kantel dingin ka ngaisun hi; Pasien in mihingte tungah tua bang po tawh a kitahla dinga nasep ei guot pen a nuom lo nasep khat ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Sun nisa nei-a sil kibawl vannuoi ka na mu hi; tuale en in, tuate zosie a mawhnapi a na hi a, huipi nuadel tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"A kawisate kizezang thei lo a, a om lopi kimawh sim thei lo hi."},"16":{"text":"“Pilna sangpi ka nei a, keima’ mai-a Jerusalem vaihawmte zosie sangin ka pilzaw hi; pilna le theina tampi ka sin zo hi,” kei le kei ka kici hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale pilna, motna le ngolnate ka thei nadingin ka lungsim ka zang a, ahi vangin tam zong khu huipi nuadel bang lel ma ahina ka theikhie hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen pilna a tam leh buoina tam a, theina a khan leh dana zong khang hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei le kei ka kiho a, “Tu-in hing pei in, guolnopna kici hing sin vawng; na nop bangin om vawi,” ka kici hi. Ahi vangin tam zong a mawhnapi ahi bo hi.","title":"Nop Banga Gamtatna a Mawhnapi"},"2":{"text":"Nuina tawh kisai-in, “Tua khu motna ahi hi,” ka ci a, guolnopna tawh kisai-in, “Tua khu banga kimang ahei?” ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitungah mihing’ hinkhuo tomkal khat sungin bang sem leh a hoi diei ci ka mu thei cieng dong, ka lungsim in pilna tawh ei makai kawmpi ma-in, zu dawnna tawh ka pumpi nopsah nading sui-in motna ka na pom hi."},"4":{"text":"Nasep lienpite ka na sem hi; keima dingin inn tampitah ka lam a, lengga umte ka bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei mama in umte le khawl munte ka bawl a, tuate sungah singga kung namcin ka suon hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum panin gamlah singkungte tui buoh nadingin tuikhuhte ka bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Numei silate le pasal silate ka na lei a, ka inn sunga pieng silate zong ka nei hi; kei masang Jerusalem khuopi-a na om ngai khatpo sangin tuuhon le bawnghonte ka hauzaw hi.","ref":"1Kum 4:23"},"8":{"text":"Ngun le kham, kumpipa’ gou le gamkhente’ gou teng zong keima adingin ka na khol hi; lasiem numei le pasalte zong ka nei a, tahsa lungkim nadingin zineu tampitah zong ka la hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:23-27; 2Khg 9:22-27; 1Kum 10:10, 14-22"},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei ka lien a, ka masanga Jerusalem-a teng zosie ka lehzo hi; ka pil ngai-in zong ka pil hi.","ref":"1Khg 29:25"},"10":{"text":"Ka mit’ lunggul popo panin ka kikoicing sih hi; nopsahna lam panin ka lungsim ka kemcing sih hi, azieh pen ka nasepna zosie-ah ka lung nuom a, tuale tam khu ka nasep gimna zosie zieha ka nga ka thaman ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka khut tawh ka sepsa na zosie le tua teng ka sepna zieha ka gimnate ka lungngai a, na zosie a mawhnapi le huipi nuadel ma hi veve a, leitungah bangma lemlaw ding a om tuom vawt sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n kihei-in pilna, motna le ngolna cite ka lungngai hi; bangzieh ahei cile kumpipa nua-a kumpi sem mipa in bang sem thei ahei? A kisemsa teng ma a sem thei bep bo hi.","title":"Pasien Lungdamsah Mite’ tungah Pilna le Lungnopna Kipie"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuomiel sangin khuovah a hoizawh ma bangin motna sangin pilna hoizaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilte in a lutang vuah mit a nei vua, ahi vangin mimawte miel lahah lam a pei uhi. Hizongle amate zosie in a kibanga a tuokhah ding uh thu ka thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima le keima ka kiho a, “Mimawte tuokhah teng ma kei zong a tuohkha ding ka hi hi; tua ahile bang dinga kei hici pil gumsan ka diei?” ka kici hi. Tuale keima le keima ka kiho a, tami zong khu a mawhnapi ma ahi bo hi, ka ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile mipilte ading hile, mimawte ading hile, sawtveipi a kikhom kiphawna om tuon lo a, mailam hunah sil bangkim a kimangngil ding ahi lel bo hi. Mimawte bangin mipilte bangci si thei uh ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei adingin leitunga sil kibawlte lungkhamna vive ahi ziehin hinna ka muda hi; azieh pen na zosie a mawhnapi hi a, huipi nuadel tawh kibang lel hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka nua-a ang pieng ding mite tungah ka nuasie valon ding ahi lam ka thei ziehin leitunga ka nasep gimnate zosie ka huot tha a suoh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale amate a pil ding ule a mot ding uh koi in thei ahei? Hizongle amate pen ka pilna zangin leitunga ka gimlaw sil zosie tungah thu vaihawm hi ding uhi. Tam zong khu a mawhnapi ahi bo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka kihei a, leitunga ka sep gimna zosie tungtang thu-ah lungkie-in ka cil a tam hi,"},"21":{"text":"azieh pen khat veivei leh pilna, theina, le siemna tawh gimpipi-a na a sem mipa in a sem lo midang khat’ nopsah nadingin tuate zosie ama tungah a nuasie valon ding ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Leitungah mihingte in tha sanin gimpipi-a a nasepna zosie vuah bang lemlaw a nei uh ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a hinkhuo nite uh lunggimna tawh kidim a, a nasepte uzong lungbuoina vive ahi hi; zan nangawnin a lungsim uh a tawlnga sih hi. Tam zong khu a mawhnapi ma ahi bo hi.","ref":"Job 5:7; 14:1"},"24":{"text":"Mihingte adingin an ne tui dawnin amau’ sep gimna tunga lungnopna a mu uh vala a hoi bangma om lo hi. Tam zong Pasien khut pana ang pei ahi lam ka mukhie hi,","ref":"Thna 3:13; 5:18; 9:7; Isa 56:12; Luk 12:19; 1Cor 15:32"},"25":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ama tawh loin koi in an ne thei ding a, koi in guolnopna nei thei ding ahei?"},"26":{"text":"Ama a lungdamsahte tungah Pasien in pilna, theina, le lungnopna a pie hi; hizongle mawnei pa tungah Pasien a lungdamsahte tunga kipie ding neisa kaikhopna le kholna nasep beh a pie hi. Tam zong a mawhnapi ma ahi bo a, huipi nuadel ma tawh kibang lel hi.","ref":"Job 32:8; Pau 2:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na vannuoi adingin hun om ciet a, leitunga a pieng thu zosie in hun a nei ciet hi.","title":"Na Vannuoi in Hun Nei"},"2":{"text":"Suo hun om a, si hun om hi; suon hun om a, suonsate a bawkhiet hun om hi;"},"3":{"text":"tha hun om a, damsah hun om hi; phel hun om a, lamkia hun om hi;"},"4":{"text":"kaa hun om a, nui hun om hi; da hun om a, laam hun om hi;"},"5":{"text":"suongte a kipaimang hun om a, a kikhopkia hun om hi; kikawi hun om a, kihla hun om hi;"},"6":{"text":"kisui hun om a, kimansuo hun om hi; kep hun om a, paimang hun om hi;"},"7":{"text":"bawkeh hun om a, khui hun om hi; sip hun om a, ham hun om hi;"},"8":{"text":"ki-it hun om a, kimuda hun om hi; kido hun om a, kilem hun om hi."},"9":{"text":"Nasemte in a gimna uh panin bang lemlaw uh ahei?","title":"Pasien’ Pieh Nasep"},"10":{"text":"Pasien in mi zosie tungah a manlapi khop ding uh nasep a guot lam ka mu zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in amau’ hun tawh kituoh dingin na vannuoi a bawl zo hi; tua tham loin ama in a lungsim sung vuah a tawpsa hun le mailam thu theinopna lungsim guon a, hinanle amate in Pasien’ sepsate a kipatna panin a tawp tanpha-in a thei zo sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate adingin a hin sungun lungdam kipah taha a op ding uh vala a hoi bangma dang a op lo lam ka thei hi;"},"13":{"text":"tua banah mi zosie in an ne tui dawnin a nasepna zosie vuah nuom a sah ding uh pen Pasien’ letsong ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasien’ sep popo kip tawntung ding hi, ci ka thei hi, bangma a kibelap thei sih ding a, bangma lahdawh thei zong ahi sih ding hi; mi zosie in ama mai-ah a zatah thei nadinga Pasien in tami a bawl ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua a omte a na omsate ma ahi hi; ang omkia dingte zong a omsate ma ahi hi; tuale Pasien in a piengngaisate a suikia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua tham loin leitungah thutang munah gitlona om a, dihna munah gitlona a op lam zong ka mu hi.","title":"Thukhenna le Mailam Hun Pasien-a’ ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka lungsim sungah, Pasien in midihte le migilote thu khen ding hi, azieh pen ama in sil bangkim le nasep silbawl vannuoi adingin a hun sekhol zo hi, ka ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihingte tawh kisai-in ka lungsim sungah, Pasien in ganhing bang lel ahina uh a lahtel nadinga amate a zelah ahi hi, ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mihingte tuo ding le ganhingte’ tuo ding a kibang ahi hi; khat a si bangin a khat zong a si hi. Amate in a unpi-un husan a kibang nei a, mihing pen ganhing sangin thupizaw tuon lo hi; azieh pen na zosie a mawhnapi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"A unpi-in mun khatah a pei uhi; a unpi-in leivui panin piengin a unpi-in leivui ma a zuonkia uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing hlagau tung lamah kato a, ganhing hlagau nei lamah a peisuh lam koi in thei ahei?"},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi zosie in a nasep ciet uh nuomsa-a a op ding uh vala a hoi bangma ka mu sih hi; azieh pen tua khu amau’ tanh ahi hi. Amate nua-ah bang pieng ding ci a en dingin koi in amate peipi ding ahei?"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitunga kibawlsietna zosie khatvei ka mukia hi. A kibawlsie mite’ hlitui en in, amate a henem ding koima om lo hi! Amate a bawlsie mite in thu nei mama a, a henem ding koima a om sih hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuale a sisa mite thu ka ngaisun a, a hinglai mihingte sangin a sisa mite hampha ka sazaw hi;"},"3":{"text":"ahi vangin tua tegel sangin mihinga a pieng nai lote le leitunga gitlona teng a mu nai lote hoizaw lai hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin gimpipi-a nasepna zosie le siemna zosie, mite khatlekhat a ki-enna uh pana ang pieng ahi hi, ci thu ka mu hi. Tam zong a mawhnapi ahi a, huipi nuadel ma tawh kibang lel hi."},"5":{"text":"Mimawte in a khut a zep vua, amau’ tahsa a netum uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gimpi-a nasepna le huipi nuadelna tawh a kinga khutdim ni sangin, lungnopna tawh a kinga khutdim khat hoizaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitungah a mawhnapi khat ka mukia hi:"},"8":{"text":"Tapate hile, sanggamte tanute hile a nei lo, a tolten mite ka mu hi; hizongle gimpi-a a nasep uh khawl hun nei loin hauna tawh lungkim hun zong a nei thei ngai sih uhi. “Keima in nopsahna teng taanin koi adinga gimpi-a na ka sep mawh ahei?” ci-in amate a kidong uhi. Tam zong a mawhnapi hi a, a dahuoi nasep khat ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Khat sangin ni hoizaw hi, azieh pen ama gel in a nasep gimna ziehun thaman hoitah a nga uhi.","title":"Lawm le Guol Manphatna"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen ama gel a pua uleh, khat in a khat phongto ding hi; ahi vangin ama tanga ompa pen mi hamsie ahi a, ama a pua khah leh a panpi ding midang a nei sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi ni lumton leh a khuo uh lum hi; mi khatguoh bangci bangin a khuo lum thei ding ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat in adang khat zo kha phiel nanle, mi ni in mi khat pen zo hamtang ding hi. Zam thum a kihuol khauhuol tat bai pah lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuhilna a sang nuom nawn lo, vuoi le mot a thuo kumpipa sangin mizawng khangno khat manphazaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpi gam sungah a zawngsa-a suoh hi zongnanle thong sung panin suohta-in kumpi suoh thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitunga a vah kawikawi hinna a nei zosie in kumpipa zalaih ding ahi tua khangno pa’ nua a zui uh ka mu hi;"},"16":{"text":"ama’ puisa tua mi zosiete sim tal loin a tam uhi. Hinanle ama nua-a a khang mite in ama tungah a lungdam tuon sih ding uhi. Tam zong khu a mawhnapi le huipi nuadel ma tawh kibang hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ biehinn sungah na pei ciengin na kalsuon kidawm in; mimawte’ biehpiehna sangin thu ngai dinga ama kunga va naina khu a hoizaw ahi hi; azieh pen amate in sil hoi lo bawlna panin bangci kihep ding ci a thei sih uhi.","title":"Zatahna, Neilutna, le Lungkimna"},"2":{"text":"Thu ngaisun masa lopi-in mot ham sinlen, Pasien’ mai-a thu gen dingin na lungsim kinawsah sin, azieh pen Pasien vantungah om a, nang leitungah na om hi; tua ahi ziehin na kam tawmsah in."},"3":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile lunghimawna a tam ciengin mang kiman a, mimaw pa in thu tampi a gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasien kunga na kiciem ciengin a tangtunsah ding kiheh sin; azieh pen mimawte tungah ama lungpal lo hi. Na kiciemna tangtungsah in.","ref":"Late 66:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Na kiciemna na tangtunsah lo sangin na kiciem lo hoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Mawna sungah na kam in kipuisah sinlen, ka khiel kha ta hi, ci-in Pasien’ siempupa kungah gen sin; bang dingin na thugente ziehin Pasien lungthahsahin, na khuta na sepsate hing susie ding ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Mang tam matna le thu tampi genna-ah a mawhna tam pai hi; ahi vangin Pasien zatah in."},"8":{"text":"Gam sungah mizawngte kibawlsietna le thuman le thutang palsatna na mu leh, tua thu-ah lamdang sa sin; bangzieh ahei cile ulien khat pen ama sanga a lienzaw khat in en a, ama gel tungah a lienzawte omlai hi."},"9":{"text":"Hizongle leitanga pieng zosie mikim ading ahi hi; kumpipa zong lo-a piengte tawh kivah ahi bo hi."},"10":{"text":"Sum deigawte sum tawh lungkim ngai lo ding hi; hauna deigawte a ngaza tawh lungkim ngai lo ding hi. Tam zong khu a mawhnapi ma ahi bo hi."},"11":{"text":"Neisa a khan ciengin a ne ding mite zong khang pai hi; a neipa in a mit gela a et ci simlo bang phattuomna nga ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Nasemte in tawm a ne a, tam a ne zongin a kimut uh nuom lel hi; ahi vangin a valkai-a hauna in mihaute kimusah thei lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Leitungah a siehuoi na khat ka mu hi: Sum haute in a sietna ding bepun hauna a khol vua,"},"14":{"text":"tuale tuosietna khat ziehin a neisa teng a suplaw uhi; amate ahile tate’ nu le pate ahi vangun a khut sung vuah bangma a nei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"A nute gil sung panin guohtanga ang pei bangun a guohtang ma-un a peikia ding uhi; amate in a gimna uh pana a nga uh nate bangma khat zong a khut vuah tawi-in a peipi thei sih ding uhi.","ref":"Job 1:21; Late 49:17; 1Tim 6:7"},"16":{"text":"Tam zong khu a siehuoi na khat ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua teng banah amate in a hin sungun lunggimin an a ne vua, lung buoina, natna le lunghamna tampi tawh hunte a mang uhi."},"18":{"text":"A hoi ding ka mu thu khat tami ahi hi: Pasien in leitungah bakhat hinkhuo ei pieh sungin mi khat in a sep gimna thaman ne-in dawnin guolnopna a sui ding pen a kilawm ahi hi; azieh pen tam khu eite’ tanh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Pasien in hauna le nei le lamte pie-in tuate a zang thei mi zosie in a tanh dingte uh sang a, a nasep gimna sung vuah lungnopna a sui ding uh ahi hi, tam pen Pasien’ letsong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasien in lungdamin a opsah ziehin amate in a hinkhuo nite uh ngaisutin a nei kha sih ding uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitungah gitlona khat ka mu a, tua khu mite tungah gih mama hi:","title":"A Buoihuoi Lunggulna"},"2":{"text":"Pasien in amate tungah a deigaw zosie uh bangma a kitasam lo dingin hauna, nei le lam, le patawinate pie napi, Pasien in tua nate zangsah loin, midang khat in nopsahlaw zawsop hi. Tam khu a mawhnapi ahi a, a siehuoi na khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal khat in ta zakhat nei-in kum tampi zong hing thei kha ding hi; hinanle a khan kum bangza tahin a tam ta zongin a hin sungin nopsahnate a nga sih a, ahi sihle a si ciengin limtaha a kivui sih leh, ama sangin a sisa-a a suoh nausen hoizaw lai hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ama a mawhna-a suoh hi a, khuomiel sungah lutin khuomiel sungah ama’ min a kiliemang ta hi;"},"5":{"text":"tham loin ama in ni mukha loin bangma zong thei lo hi; hinanle tua pa sangin tawlngahna muzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama kum tulkhat’ a zani-in hing ta nanle a hoi lamin a zang thei sih hi, a unpi-un mun khata pei hi lo uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"Mihing zosie’ gimpi pen a kam sung ading hi napi, a ankam tuina un pha ta ci ngai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahile mimawte sangin mipilte in bang hamphatna nei uh ahei? Mihingte mai-a gamtat dan ding a thei mizawng pa in bang phattuomna nei ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Na khat i deigawna sangin i nei bang tawh lungkimna khu a hoizaw ahi hi. Tam zong a mawhnapi le huipi nuadel ma tawh kibang hi."},"10":{"text":"Na a omsa poma min kiphuosa vive ahi a, mihingte bang ahei ci le, amate sanga a vanglienzaw mite a niel zawh lam uh zong kithei hi."},"11":{"text":"Thu tam leh a mawhnapi zong tam pai a, tuaci’n mikhat adingin bangci phattuom ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a mawhnapi ahi nihlim banga a tawn zinzian mihing hinkhuo tomkal khat sungin mihingte adingin bang pen hoi ding ci koi in thei ahei? Azieh pen amate nua ciengin leitungah bang thu pieng ding ci koi in gen thei ahei?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sathau manpha sangin minphatna hoizaw a, suo ni sangin si ni hoizaw hi.","title":"A lungkiehhuoi Hinkhuo Tawh Kisai Muna","ref":"Pau 22:1"},"2":{"text":"Pawibawlna inn-a haw sangin dana inna haw hoizaw hi; azieh pen mi zosie dingin a tawpna hi a, tua khu a hing laite’ lungsimah teng den ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nuina sangin dana hoizaw hi; azieh pen da mel puohna in lungsim kipahna piengsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Dana inn ah mipilte’ lungsim om hi; guolnopna inn ah mimawte’ lungsim om hi."},"5":{"text":"Mimawte lasah i ngai sangin mipilte ei phawsietna ngai ding hoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile beeltaw nei- a lingkung kihal ging bangin mimawte nuina ging vapuoh hi; tam zong khu a mawhnapi ahi bo hi."},"7":{"text":"Bawlsietna in mipilte mawsah a, guhgol nehna in mi lungsim susie hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khat a kipatna lam sangin a tawpna lam hoizaw hi; kiphatsahna sangin lungduoina hoizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Na lung thahsah bai sin, azieh pen mimawte’ awp sungah lungthahna a gieh hi.","ref":"Jas 1:19"},"10":{"text":"“Bang dingin tuhun sangin hunlui hoizaw ahei?” ci sin. Azieh pen tam na thudawh khu pilna pana ang pei ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Pilna pen gouluo za-in hoi a, nisa a mute adingin hamphatna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen pilna tawh kidalna khu sum tawh kidalna bang ahi a, pilna nei a phattuom zawhna pen pilna in ama a neipa hinna pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien’ nasepna lungngai in; ama in a kawisahte koi in zangsah thei ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Cithei hunin kipah inlen, hahsat hunin kingaituo in; mihing in ama’ nua-a a pieng ding thute a thei zo lo nadingin Pasien in citheina le hahsatna tungsah kawikawi hi."},"15":{"text":"A mawhnapi-a ka hin sungin na vannuoi ka mu zo hi; midihte a dihna utawh a na si vua, migilote, a gitlo gamtatna utawh a khan uh na sau hi.","title":"Hinkhuo Thuhahsate"},"16":{"text":"Kidihsah seng sinlen, zong kipilsah seng sin; bang dinga nang le nang kisusie ding na hei?"},"17":{"text":"Gilo seng sinlen kimawsah seng sin; bang dingin na hun a tun masangin si ding na hei?"},"18":{"text":"Adang khat hlasuo tuon loin a khat zong na tuhdet ding hoi hi; azieh pen Pasien zatah mipa ahile a nipi-in lawcing ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuopi khat sunga om vaihawm mi sawm sangin mipilpa a pilna in hatsahzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"A tahtahin leitungah a hoi-a a gamta, a maw ngai vawt lo midih khat zong om lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi thugen popo thudon paipai sin, tua hi sihle na nasempa ang gausamna na za kha ding hi;"},"22":{"text":"nang mama in na lungsim sungah midangte tamveipi na samsietna na thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam teng zosie pilna tawh ka zelah hi; keima in, “Pil ta vang,” ka ci a, hinanle tua khu kei bat zawh ding ahi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua pen gamla mama a, zong a thuh, a thuh mama ahi hi; koi in tua khu mu zo ding ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Keima in pilna le na vannuoi kigawmna thei-in kantelin a sui dingin ka lungsim ka hei a, tua gitlona ka thei sawmna khu motna ahi a, tua motna zong khu ngolna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Keima in sina sanga a siehuoizaw numei khat ka mu a, tua nu pen thang kamsa bang ahi a, ama’ lungsim pen piel le lenthang kisie bang a, ama’ khut gelah siakhau a om hi; Pasien’ lungsim a sukhate tua nu kung panin suohta a, ahi vangin a thangah maw neite a awh uhi."},"27":{"text":"Siepa in, en in, ka sil mu khu tam ahi hi, a kigawmna ka mu nadingin na khat tungah adang khat ka gawm a,"},"28":{"text":"ka lungsimin tua khu ka suisui a, hinanle ka mu zo sih hi. Ka kimupi pasal tulkhat lahah khat bang ka mu a, hizongle tuate zosie lahah numei khat beh ka mu zo sih hi."},"29":{"text":"En in, kei mu tam beh ahi hi, Pasien in mihingte a thutang dingin ei bawl a, ahi vangin amate in gelna tampi a nei uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipilpa tawh kibang koi ahei? Na khat’ a khietna koi in let thei ahei? Pilna in mite maitaisah a, ama’ melpuoh hoimaw a kikhelsah hi.","title":"Kumpipa’ Thu Mang inlen, Kilungnuomsah in."},"2":{"text":"Pasien tungah kiciem zo na hi ziehin kumpipa’ thupieh zui in."},"3":{"text":"Zau poma sin; ama in a nop bangin na sem ahi ziehin, thu a hoi khol lo ciengin ama kung panin uoikai loin peikhie in."},"4":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile kumpipa’ kammal in vangnei a, ama kungah, “Bang bawl na hei?” ci-in koi in ci thei ding ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Ama’ thupieh a mang poma in sietna tuohkha lo ding a, mipilte’ lungsim in a hun le a lampi a thei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen amate tungah mihingte’ lungkhamna gihtahin a kikhan vangin, na vannuoi in a hun le a lampi nei hi."},"7":{"text":"A tahtahin amate in bang hing pieng ding ci a thei sih vua, tua ziehin bang ang ci pien ding ahei ci amate kungah koi in gen thei ding ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Hui tungah koima in thunei-in tua hui tucip thei lo a, si ni ding tungah zong koima in thu nei thei lo hi; gal kikap sungin a kitawpsah koima a om sih a, gitlona in migilote a hunkhie thei sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in leitunga kibawl zosie ka lungsim sungah ka ngaisun a, mi khat in adang khat’ siet nadingin a thuneina a zahna teng zosie ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi gilote si-in a kivui ka mu hi; mun siengtho panin amate sungtumin a pusuoh zel vua, tua bang a gamtatna ziehun khuopi sungah phatna a nga uhi. Tam zong a mawhnapi ahi hi.","title":"Pasien’ Lampi Kithei Zo Lo"},"11":{"text":"Gitlo gamtatna tungah mallang taha thukhenna a kibawl lo ziehin mihing lungsim in sietna bawl ding ngen tang a sawm hi."},"12":{"text":"Mawneite in za vei dong sietna bawlin a hinkhuo uh sawt nanle, Pasien a giing mite adingin thu zosie nuom ding hi, ci ka thei hi; azieh pen amate in Pasien a giing uhi,"},"13":{"text":"ahi vangin migilote adingin thu nuom lo ding a, a hinkhuote uh nihlim bangin a sausah thei sih ding uhi; azieh pen amate in Pasien a giing sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Leitunga a pieng a mawhnapi khat om a, tua khu mi dihte in migilote’ gamtatna a thuohlaw vua, migilote in mi dihte’ gamtatna a hamphatlaw uhi. Tami zong khu a mawhnapi hi, ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitungah mihingte in an ne tui dawnin amau le amau a guolnop ding vala a hoi om lo ahi ziehin a guolnop ding uh pha ka sa mai hi, azieh pen Pasien in leitungah a hin sungun amate a pieh a nasep gimna uh sung panin a nga thei ding uh tam beh a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Pilna nga thei nading le leitunga na kisemte theithei nadingin sun le zanin mite bangci kimutmaw va-ia uh ahei ci ka lung gelgel ciengin,"},"17":{"text":"leitunga a pieng Pasien’ nasepna zosie koima in a theizawh lona ka mukhie hi. Amate in tuami suina-in a gimlaw vangun a mu zo sih ding uhi; mipilte in thei a kisah vangun a thei sieng zo sih uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in tamte zosie ka ngaisun a, Pasien’ khut sungah midihte, mipilte, le amau’ septe bangci op ci ka mukhie hi; itna zieh amah, ahi sihle muda zieh ahei ci koima in thei lo hi. Amate tawh a kisikha vannuoi","title":"A Pieng Bangin Nungta in."},"2":{"text":"a mawhnapi ahi hi, azieh pen midihte le migilote, mihoite le mihoi lote, mi siengthote le mi siengtho lote, biehpiehna a neite le biehpiehna a nei lote zosie tungah a kibang laitanna a tung hi. Mihoite tunga a tun bangin mawneite tungah a tung hi; a kiciemte zong a kiciem lo pa tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitunga thupieng zosie lahah a siehuoi khat pen tami ahi hi, tua khu mi vannuoi tungah laitanna a kibangin a tung hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a hinglai zosie tawh a kizom poma in kinepna a nei hi, azieh pen a sisa humpi sangin a hinglai ui khat hoizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A hinglaite in a si ding uh thei a, ahi vangin a sisate in bangma a thei nawn sih uhi; amate in thaman a nei nawn sih vua, koima in zong amate a phawhkha nawn sih hi."},"6":{"text":"A itna uh, a mudana ule a thangsietna uh mangthai sieng a, amate in leitunga pieng na zosie tungah satanh kici himhim a neikia ngai ta sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Pei in, lungdamna tawh na an ne inlen, lungnopna tawh na zu dawn in; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in na sepnate a sawtvei laipi-a ang na pompiehsa ahi ta bo hi."},"8":{"text":"Na puonsilte a kang vive hisah in; na lu zong sathau tawh kita sah sin."},"9":{"text":"Pasien in leitunga ang pieh a mawhnapi ahi na hinkhuo nite, na it mama na zi tawh nuomtahin zang in, azieh pen tam leisiet na hinkhuo-a na sep gimnate ziehin na lemlaw khu tua beh ma ahi bo hi."},"10":{"text":"Na khut in sep ding a mu popo na tha neiza tawh sem in; azieh pen Misikhuo ah nasepna, thu ngaisutna, theina, le pilna cite a om sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Leitungah ka mukia thu khat in tai kidemna ah mi malgangte in zo kim lo a, mi thahatte in zong gal zo kim loin, mipilte in an kham kim lo a, miteite hau kim tuon loin, misiemte in zong maipha nga kim tuon lo hi; hizongle hun le ni kiheina dung zui-a amate tunga na pieng ahi bo hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen koima in a vangsiet hun ding a genkhol thei sih hi. Nga len tawh a kimante le va thanga a awhte bangin, amate tungah tua bang vangsietnate thakhatin a tun ciengin, mihingte zong a awh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Leitungah tami pilna gentena zong ka mu a, tua khu kei adingin a thupi mama hi.","title":"Motna Sangin Pilna Hoizaw"},"14":{"text":"Mi tawmno khat’ tenna khuoneu khat a om hi. Tua khuo sim dingin a thahat kumpi khat kuonin galkap tampi tawh tua khuo a kui-im hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khuo sungah a pil mizawng khat om a, tuale ama in a pilna tawh tua khuo hunkhie hi. Hizongle tua mizawngpa koima in a phawhkha sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in, “Thagum hatna sangin pilna hoizaw hi; hizongle tua mizawngpa’ pilna kithusim pieh lo a, ama’ thugente kingai pieh lo hi,” ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Mimawte lahah uhpa khat’ kikona i ngai sangin oldam taha mipilte’ ham thupisim huoizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Kidona galhiemte sangin pilna manphazaw a, ahi vangin khielna khat in na hoi tampi susie thei hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tho sisate in panamtui bawlpa’ sathau namsiesah hi; tuaci’n motna neuno khat in pilna le patawina susie thei hi.","title":"Thukantelna Tuomtuomte"},"2":{"text":"Mipilte’ lungsim ziet lamah awn a, mimawte’ lungsim vei lamah awn hi."},"3":{"text":"Lam pei kawm nangawnin mimawte in ngaisutna a nei sih vua, amate in a mot lam uh mi vannuoi tungah a lah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ang uhpa na tunga a lungthah leh, na nasep za nuasie sin, azieh pen sip didena in khielna lienpite a damsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam leitungah gam uhpa’ pana khielna lienpi ziehin a pieng sietna hoi lo ka mu khat khu:"},"6":{"text":"panmun sangpite-ah mimawte kikoi a, panmun niem-ah mihaute a to uhi."},"7":{"text":"Sakol tungah silate tuong a, sila bangin a keng tawh miliente a pei ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Dumto poma dum sung ma-ah kie ding hi; kul tovang poma gul in tu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Suongto poma suong tawh liem ding hi; singlete poma zong sing ma tawh a liem ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hei a bol a, a kitat hiem sih leh thatang san den kul hi; ahi vangin mi khat a lawcin thei nadingin pilna in panpi hi.","ref":"Late 7:15; Pau 26:27"},"11":{"text":"A kihlim masangin gul in ei tuh leh, a hlimpa adingin kimanna om lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipilte’ thugen in amate maipha ngasah a, ahi vangin mimawte’ ham in amate netum hi."},"13":{"text":"A kamhamte uh motna tawh a pan vua, a thugen tawpna uh pen mot gitlona tawh a khum uhi;"},"14":{"text":"hinanle mimawte in thu mot gengen a, a pieng ding thu koima in thei lo hi, mai lama thu pieng ding koi in gen thei ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Mimawte’ nasep in amate a gimsah hi, azieh pen amate in khuopi zotna lampi a thei sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Nasem khat kumpi-in nei-in, zingmawnga pawi bawl ulien a nei gam aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi!"},"17":{"text":"Nampite khat kumpi-in nei a, a hun huna pawi a bawl, kham nading ahi lo, hat nadinga zu a ne ulien nei gam aw, mi nuomsa na hi hi!"},"18":{"text":"Thasiet ziehin innkhum vang a, thada ziehin inn guo ke hi."},"19":{"text":"Nui nadinga pawi kibawl ahi hi; zu in hinkhuo nuomsah a, sum in kisapna zosie kicingsah hi."},"20":{"text":"Na lungsim nangawnah kumpipa gausam sinlen, na lupna tung nangawnah mihaute gausam sin; azieh pen hui lahah a leng vata khat in na thugen teng puoh thei ding a, hla nei ganhing kimkhat in na thugen teng na gensawn thei ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuite tungah na anlum pai lacin, ni tampizaw ciengin na ngakia ding hi.","title":"Hanciemna’ Manphatna"},"2":{"text":"Na neisate lampi sagi ah hile, lampi gietah hile khen kawikawi in, azieh pen leitungah bang sietna pieng ding ci na thei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Meiite sungah guotui a dim ciengin leitungah guo-in zusuh hi; sing khat leitaw lam ahi sihle leilu lama a pua leh, a puana munah a luongin tua sing lum den ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hui lan a melci poma in khai a tu sih ding hi; meiilum a en poma in zong an a la sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A nu’ gil sunga gu le tangte lahah husan bang ang ci pien ahei ci na thei lo ma bangin, sil bangkim a siem Pasien’ nasepte na thei zo sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingmawngin na khaici tu inlen, nitah ciengin na khut mawh opsah sin; bang ding ahei cile ang hoi ding pen tami amah, khumi ahei, ahi sihle a nipi-a ang hoi ding ma ahei, ci thu na thei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuovah hoi mama a, mit in ni a mu ciengin a nuom mama hi.","title":"Khangno le Khanghamna"},"8":{"text":"Kum tampitah a hingte nangawn in tuate zosie nuomtahin zang ta uheh; hizongle khuomiel nite ang tam ding hi, ci phawh ta uheh. Ang tung zosie a mawhnapi ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Khangnopa aw, na khangdawn lai-in lungdam inlen, na khangno hun sungin na lungnop bangbangin om in. Na lunglam le na mit in hoi a sahna lam zui in, ahi vangin tamte zosie ziehin Pasien in na tungah thu ang khen ding ahi ci thu thei in."},"10":{"text":"Na lungsim sung panin patauna tawpsah inlen, na tahsa natna zosie paimang in; azieh pen khangdawnna le hinkhuo kipatcil lam pen a mawhnapi ahi bo hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungkham hun ang tun masang, “Hinkhuo nuomsa sing,” na ci ding kum in ang phah masang;"},"2":{"text":"nitang khuovah le hlapi le aasite mielin, guo tawh meiilumte a kilekia masang na khangdawn lai-in nang ang siempa phawh in;"},"3":{"text":"khum hun sungin inncingte citunin, mi thahatte a kawng uh kon a, numei ansute a tawm ziehin a khawl cieng, tawlet-a khuodahte a mit uh a miel cieng;"},"4":{"text":"gawldung kotpite kikhacipin an gawina ging nawn loin vata ham khat in ang phawn a, nungah lasate’ aw a gin nawn lo cieng;"},"5":{"text":"mi khat in khosangte giingin gawldung ah patauna ang op cieng; kawlthualu kung ang paa-in khuombaite zong kipuola-in lunggulna ang tawp cieng dong ahi hi; azieh pen mi zosie in a tawntung inn uh a zot kul a, a kap amate in gawldung lam a zuon ta ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ngun khauhuol kitanin kham kuongkumte keh ding a, tuinah-a tuibelte kitawkehin tuikhuh sunga tuikhaina lengpeite kitan ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin leivui in a kisiemna lei zuonkia-in, husan in ama a pie pa Pasien kung zuonkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A mawhnapi, na vannuoi a mawhnapi ahi hi, ci-in Siepa in a gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Siepa a pil banah, theina, thu khinkhai theina, sinna le paunahte guoldan zong mite hil hi.","title":"Thukhupna"},"10":{"text":"Siepa in a zahnophuoi kamtengte a mu thei nadingin sui a, ama in thuman siengtahin na giel hi."},"11":{"text":"Mipilte’ thugente cienghiem tawh a kibang a, kammal ahile a kikhawmte pen tuucing khat in a pieh, kiptaha a kikhen siakilte tawh kibang hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, tam teng banah kidawm in. Laibu tampi bawlna in tawp hun a nei sih a, lai tampi simna zong tahsa gimna bep ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Thu khupna-ah thu zosie kiza sieng zo hi; Pasien zatah inlen a thupiehte zui in; bang ding ahei cile tua khu mi vannuoi’ sep ding nasep ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen a sie hile a pha hile a kiguhsep na zosie nangawn tungah Pasien in thu ang khen ding hi."}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Solomon La","shortname":"Sol","abbr":[],"desc":"Solomon la (the song of solomon)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Late lahah a ngaih pen, Solomon’ la:","ref":"1Kum 4:32"},"2":{"text":"A mi tawpna a phune tawh keima ei tawp valeh le ci’ng! Azieh pen in vang nei ngaina ningzu sangin hlumcia zaw sa’ng.","title":"Monu le a Guolte’ Holimna"},"3":{"text":"Na nu sathau tumtai bangin namtui sang e, na sahmin khu gimsi namtui kibuo bang e; tua ahi ziehin lienute in mu banga ang ngai ding ma hi cie."},"4":{"text":"Na banzalin ei kai inlen, kinaw tanaw’n kitai ta vai. Ama’ zalna laikhun tungah vaimang in ma lobang ei tut. Selung tai-in na sieng nenah limnga bangin hing lam va ung; vang nei ngaina ningzu hlum sang’ hing pawhzaw vang; na senngaihte’n mu banga ang ngai tahtah hi mel teh."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem lienute aw, ka sahmel puoh vom nanle zong Solomon in a Kedar limbuh sunga a khaipuonte bangin etin lawm ing."},"6":{"text":"Tungsun ni in ei kadupin, ka sahmel puoh a vom manin, nuisiemin hong lel lo aw ngaih. Ka tun vontawi tang laizomte’n keima’ kungtung sinlung sit uh; ei zunsah uh lengga huonlei, keima’ lenghuon ham bang huoi la’ng!"},"7":{"text":"Tong lel ve aw, duongzen ngaihno, khawi le vulte koi kuom sawl bang heisah na hiam? Sunkim tangni a ham lai-in koi kuom sam bang zalsah na hiam? Tuucing na tangguolte lai-ah zezum lienu zil ding ka hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Zatam lienute za lai-ah duong kikhai pen ningniang nu aw, sinlung lai-a na thei sih leh, tuuhonte’ zawi sul bang zui-in, tuucingte’ limbuh pang no-ah na tuunote siel bang’ cing in."},"9":{"text":"Ka ngaino aw, Pharaoh’ lengkai kolsa-laa khat’ pien zil hing sa’ng.","title":"Mopa, a Guolte le Monu Holimna"},"10":{"text":"Na bienga kai duong zepna le na ngawnga viel awkhi nunsan etin lawm sa’ng."},"11":{"text":"Na duongsuo zepna khamgui awkhi hing bawl va ung, ngun khainiengin hing zem va ung."},"12":{"text":"Zalkhun tungah vaimang sam bang’ a zal laitah, ka duong zunna nard gimsi hing leng kuom teng zel e."},"13":{"text":"Ka sannem no, anglai nunkhum nigel kalah, myrrh thawl khai dung zil sa’ng e."},"14":{"text":"Ka sannem no ka kung tungah En-gedi lenggui huona a po henna pape dung no zil e."},"15":{"text":"Ah, ka sen ngaino, sahduong kikhai dingdiang ma cie; ah, sahduong kikhai dingdiang ma cie; na maimit in khuva maimit pien dung zil sa’ng."},"16":{"text":"Ah, ka sen ngaino sahduong kikhai dingdiang ma cie, ka duong eizen keima’ laikuoi tahtah hi cie. I laikhun zong khawlo bangin dum dieldiel e;"},"17":{"text":"Saunuom i innkamte aw e; taamtah gilsing san singseng aw. Saunuom i innsunte aw e, taah san gil singa kibawl aw."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sharon lingpaa keima hi’ng e, muolkuom unoh paape hi’ng e."},"2":{"text":"Lingsie kawma unoh paa bang, a guol lai-ah ka sen ngaino khum bang hi ei."},"3":{"text":"Tangguol lai-ah ka sannem no, gammang tulsing a zalai-ah tulsing apple po dung zil sa’ng. Sinlung tai-in tangpa hlimah tutvum khawl ing. A tulsing ga kei adingin, ning zu bangin hlum vangut e."},"4":{"text":"Nunnop bawlna sau hlim nenah ma bang ei pui, tangpa lailung a gelna teng lienu mu bang ei ngaina hi ei."},"5":{"text":"Duongzen sawl bang ka vul ziehin, lenggagaw le apple ga tawh ka zeitha tawl ei damsah ven."},"6":{"text":"Banzal veilam ei khamsahin, banzal zietin ei kawi leh ci’ng!"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem lienute aw, vang kingaina kam mei banga a kuon masie, va bang phawngin thel bang thosah sih va ung ci’n, khisa no le zuhsiel minin ka sieng nenah tong hing ciem un!"},"8":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa tongdam za ing! Maimit suon ven, ma cieng hing suon, a muoltang tawn sangsa no bang, macieng suonin tawndien valeh.","title":"Khallai Lungzuon Laphuo"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa zuhsa no le khisatalno dung zil hi e. Maimit suon ven, kawmpal hemah ka ngaino ding, tawlet panin gal ei don ei, vathang kawm pan maimit ei suon."},"10":{"text":"Ka senngai no’n ka sieng nenah tongdam hing lel: “Ka ngai duongsuo melhoi no aw, zuong hing tho-in ka sieng sul bang ei zui in ci."},"11":{"text":"Biphal daidam meii bang theng ta, tuoiguo lenmuol hemlam kai ta."},"12":{"text":"Simlei paape a pallun ta; nopna zeila awi hun tung ta, i gam lei-ah huiva nu’ tong luon no kiza."},"13":{"text":"Khangthei kungte’n a ga suong ta, lengga pallun gimsi lang ta; duongsuo etlawm, ka sen ngaino, zuong hing tho-in ka sieng sul bang ei zui bo ven."},"14":{"text":"Kawlpang lum suong kawma kibu, khuva no aw, na langmai suo ei musah in, na tongnem no ei luon taven; na tongdam no ningzu bang hlum, na langmai zong ngaibang hiuhiau."},"15":{"text":"I huon lenggui ang pallun ta, gam siegul bang i leng kungte a susie ding si-alte le si-al note henkol bul in,” ci’n tong ei lel uh."},"16":{"text":"Ka ngai kei-a’, kei ama-a’ hi’ng; Unoh paapete zalai-ah khawi le vulte ham bangin huoi."},"17":{"text":"Zingdam vulkhi a lan masang, khimzing zanmiel a ven masang, duongkuoi ka sen ngaino aw e, khisa no le zuhsa no bang, a muoltang tawn sul hing hei ta’n."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A zankhuo sawt laikhun tungah lunga ka gul ka lai kuoi pa sa bang vai ing; sa bang ka vai zu bang maimaw’ng; mal bang ko ing tong dawng lo e.","title":"Itna’ Lungtup"},"2":{"text":"“Tu’n zuong tho-in vang khuo lai-ah pheiphung suonin laileng vangin, tuonglam dung le tuolzang tengah sulhei kawi vang; laikuoi ngaihno sa bang vai vang,” ci’n lung gel ing. Sa bang ka vai zu bang maimaw’ng."},"3":{"text":"Tuonglam lai-ah dawn bang kituo, vangkhuo vil ding macieng suonte. “Mu bang ka ngai ka sannem no koi kuom sawl bang a hei tai,” ci’n tongin dong ing."},"4":{"text":"Nungsie’n sul bang’n kei ka hei leh ka sen ngaihno mel khu mu ing. Ka sen ngaihno nau bang kawi-ing, mim bang pienna tunnu sauhlim laikhun tung tuong ka tut masang, sam bang khen ding lungin gel maw’ng."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem lienute aw, vang kingaina kammei banga a kuon masie, va bang phawngin thel bang thosah sih va ung ci’n, khisa no le zuhsiel minin ka sieng nenah tong hing ciem un!"},"6":{"text":"Panamtui le myrrh kopin, sesum bawlte’n gimsi namcin kaitui bang gawm, kam mei-ah hal, senel gam pan meikhu vaivut bang kitungsah, macieng ang suon singta vontawi koi pen ahiei?","title":"Mopa le a Pawlte’n Vanai"},"7":{"text":"Maimit suon vawi, Solomon’ taal! A kimvelah sawm guh a sim, tang ngalliem Israel-te’n lum bang sung uh,"},"8":{"text":"zankhang lai-a patau kona, a mi zatamte’n namtem kuo, dogal siemte’n a kawng ciet vuah namtem khai uh."},"9":{"text":"Vaimang Solomon taalbuh aw e, Lebanon tulsing gil tawh zun e."},"10":{"text":"Ngun tawh kizut a luoikhuomte, a nualam teng khamin kizem, a mang topha silpuon sandupin kivon e. A sunglam teng itna silpuonin khu mel uh. Jerusalem liepalte aw,"},"11":{"text":"na pheiphung uh hing suon ve vuo. Jerusalem lienute aw, vaimang Solomon khu, a angkawi tawh kaitui banga a kigawm ni, a tunnu in a tuhlu-ah a lal lukhu pi a khusah ni galin don un, ama dingin a sin lailung a dam ni hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka sen ngaino duongsuo kilawm, na duong melhoi kikhai dingdiang! Na khudiel tawh na maimit gel khuva maimit dung no zil e. Na basam zong Gilead tanga lengkel honte tuolkum zil e.","title":"Monu’ Melhoina Kiphat"},"2":{"text":"Na tuhha pa silselte’n zong besam kimet damtui-a buol pheiphung suonto tuuhon dung zil, a unsiengin a kopin pieng, mal a tuom kai ci om lo e."},"3":{"text":"Sam khau san bang’ na muh kilawm, na tongsuo zong ningzu bang khum. Langmai khuna dielvang kawm pan na bieng gel no, mang kawlsing ga phalsuo zil e, san pimpem uh."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng zang khu tang ngalliemte’n tulkhat a sim a lum khaina, a guola cien David’ dawsang dung no zil e."},"5":{"text":"Na anglai-a nunkhum ni gel unoh papete zalai-ah sawl a hei khawm, zuhsa pengkop khisa no ni duong zil hi e."},"6":{"text":"Zingdam vulkhi a lan masang, zingdam taikhuo a val masang, myrrh muol le gimsi namtui a muoltangah muol khup zuai vang."},"7":{"text":"Ka sen ngaihno, duong kikhaikim zo ma cie maw; na kung tung teng kawbang sih teh."},"8":{"text":"Keima’ angkawi ding nu aw e, Lebanon pan kei tawh zawh vai. Lebanon pan kei tawh zawh vai. Sangsa limlien humpi zalna kuo le sangsa kamkei sawl bang heina a lenmuolte, lenmuol Amana aw, Amana kuivum lenmuol Senir, Hermon-te khu nungsie inlen macieng suon in."},"9":{"text":"Ka angkawi ding ka sannem no, ka sin lunglai ei kuoi luo teh, na ngawng awkhi suongmanpha tawh khatvei hemlam maimit nei paih, ka sin lunglai ei kuoi luo teh."},"10":{"text":"Ka angkawi ding ka sannem no, vang nei ngaina ningzu bang khum! Vang nei ngaina ningzu sang zong hlum cia zaw lai, na nu sathau tumtai sang zong namtui zaw sa’ng!"},"11":{"text":"Angkawi ding nu, na phune pan paazu hlumno dai bang taasuh, na dangtawngah ningkhuoizu le sebawng nunkhum li bang kicing. Lebanon gam gimsi bangin na silpuonte namtui sa ing."},"12":{"text":"Angkawi ding nu ka sannem no, deizun huonlei imtuom no aw, deizun huonlei imtuom no aw, a samtui nah imtuom no aw."},"13":{"text":"Na huonlei ah tulsing namcin, gathei minlun mang kawlsing le, henna le nard tulsingte tawh ci bang deiteel gathei minlunte tawh poton."},"14":{"text":"Namtui tulsing li bang cinna nard le saffron, calamus le cinnamon-te, myrrh, aloes gimsi namtui, kaitui banga gawmna hi cie."},"15":{"text":"Khanghuon samtui, hinna tuikhuh no zong hi cie, Lebanon tang tawn a luong damtui no zong hi cie."},"16":{"text":"Zuong hing tho in, mal vulkhi aw, hing langto ven sim vulkhi aw! Ka khanghuon teng hing sem inlen, namtui gimsi’n muncin zel heh. Ka sen ngaino’n a khanghuon ah, pheiphung suonin, ci bang deiteel gathei minlun hing ciemsah un."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ang kawi ding ka sen ngaino, ka khanghuon-ah tuong hing tung ta’ng; ka myrrh le gimsi namtui, ham bang huoi ing, ka khuoibal le ka ningkhuoizu ka kime a, ka ningzu le sebawng nunkhum kimeton ing. Guolngai teng aw, ne-in dawn un, vang kingaina ningzu bangin kitekham un."},"2":{"text":"Laikhun tungah saam bangin kei zal zong nanleng, khangthei lo ing, maimit sing maw’ng. Ngaidi vawi ven! ka senngai in dawngkot ei kiu. “Dawngkot hong in, duongkuoi lienu, ka sannem no, keima’ khuva lel banglo nu. Ka sumlu teng zing daitui in nomsah sieng ta, ka zangsam-ah zan daitui taa, tehlop sieng ta’ng,” ci-in tong lel.","title":"Sunmang adang khat"},"3":{"text":"Ka silpuonte hawhmang zo ta’ng; bangci kivonkia ding ka diei? Ka pheiphungte sil sieng zo ta’ng; bangci niehsah kia ding ka hei?"},"4":{"text":"Ka sannem in awngvang panin banzal ei hlah, lie sinlung lai kulthuh dongah ei zen ma cie."},"5":{"text":"Dawngkot hon ding zuong tho ing e, ka sen ngaino. Ka banzal zong myrrh gimsi namsah ing e. Ka khutme-a myrrh gimsi’n kotgol tung dongin zelsah e."},"6":{"text":"Ka ngaino ding dawngkot hong ing, nungsie sul bang, ka sen ngaino na hei zo ta. Ka ngaino in tong a lel cieng ka sinlung lai pat puon bang nem. Sa bang ka vai, zu bang maimaw’ng; a min mal bang koko zong leng, ka sen ngaino’n tong dawng lo e."},"7":{"text":"Vangkhuo vila vahkawite tawh ka heina-ah dawn bang kituo. Vangkhuo vila vahkawite in mel ei mu uh; a banzal un kei ei satin, ei liemsah uh. Kawmpal dawn a galvilte in lie kei silpuon tuolhawh ta uh."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem lienute aw, ka ngai mela na mu uleh duongzen umlai a veina-in sawl bang vul ta, ci’n na lel un."},"9":{"text":"Zatam lienute kawmkalah duong kikhai pen ka lienu aw, na sen ngaino a guol lai-ah duong kikhaituom dieh a hiam aw? Hi zata tong lel nadingin a guol lai-ah duong kikhaituom dieh ahiam aw?","title":"A Guolte le Monu Holimna"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngai melhoi vang tang silsel, dam mel puo-in san sipsep e, tang guol tulsawmte zalai-ah ka ngaino ma piendang pen sa’ng."},"11":{"text":"A sumlu zong kham citah pen dung zil hi e, zangsam kawisiem, aahva bangin vom siem sang e."},"12":{"text":"A maimit zong khuva maimit no khu bang a, sikhuh pieu nen nunkhum a buol , khuvanote dung zil hi e."},"13":{"text":"A biengte’n zong namtui tulsing li bang cinna huonlei dung zil. A phune khu myrrh gimsi sunga kidie unoh paapete dung zil e."},"14":{"text":"A banzal khu khamkuol kiviel, mantam suongzep dung zil san’g e. A duongsuo khu vuisai halep zunnel tunga sapphires suong tawh kizem bang sa’ng."},"15":{"text":"A pheiphungte kham khuom bul a, suongngo khuom tun no khu bang e. A langmai zong lenmuol Lebanon taamtah tulsing hoipen dung zil."},"16":{"text":"A tongdam khu ningzu bang khum, sil bang kimah ngaibang luo sa’ng. Jerusalem lienute aw, kei ka senngai ama hi e, ka sen lawmpa zong khu hi ei."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zatam lienute zalai-ah duong kikhai pen nu no aw e, na sen ngaino koi kuom macieng suon ahiei maw? Koi kuom sawl bang hei a hiam maw? Na san nemno nang tawh sa bang vai ton nuom ing."},"2":{"text":"Gimnam tulsing li bang cinna a khanghuon-ah, ka sannem no vailo kuon e. A khanghuon-ah a tuuhonte ham bang huoi ding, unoh paapete khawm dingin ka sen ngaino vailo kuon ta."},"3":{"text":"Ka ngai kei-a’, kei ama-a’, Unoh pal huon a zalai-ah a tuuhonte khing-an tul e."},"4":{"text":"Duongsuo melhoi, ka sen ngaino, Tirzah vangkhuo dung zil hi cie, Jerusalem vangkhuo bangin etin lawm teh. Khaidielte tawh lal ma a nawh galkap hon bang giinhuoi ma cie.","title":"Tepi Omlo Melhoi Monu"},"5":{"text":"Na maimitin ei suon nawn si’n, ka sin lunglai ei zen luo teh! Na besam in lengkel honte Gilead tang tawn tuolkum zil e."},"6":{"text":"Na tuhha pa silselte in besam kimet damtui-a buol pheiphung suonto tuuhon dung zil. A unsiengin a kopin pieng, mal a tuom kai ci om lo e."},"7":{"text":"Langmai khuna dielvang kawm pan na bieng no gel, mang kawlsing ga phalsuo zilin san pimpem uh."},"8":{"text":"Vaimang angkawi sawmguhte le, a meite zong a sawmgiet-a sim, zatam lienute ahile sim zawh hi sih."},"9":{"text":"Duong kikhaikim, ka khuva no ka sinlai kuoi nang beh hi teh. Tunnu vontawi deituom hi e, pienna tunnu ding’ nuol bei sa’ng. Lie zatamte’n mel a mu cieng, nunnuom nga bang lamnu ci uh. Vaimang angkawi le a meite’n ka ngai lienu lam bang pah uh."},"10":{"text":"“Zingdam taikhuo val dung zilin, tung solkha tang banga etlawm, sunni vangtang dung no zilin, lal nawh dinga khaidiel teng tawh pal bang kicieng galkap hon bang, a giinhuoi khu koi ta ahiei?” ci’n tong lel uh."},"11":{"text":"Kuom thuh a po tulsing pate gathang banga a vil ding le lengguite in dawn a suong tai, mang kawlsingte a pal lun tai cia, maimit suon ding tulsing huon-ah vailo kuon ing."},"12":{"text":"Ka sin lung a ka thei masang, ka lailungin vaimang nen a kolleng tungah kei va to ing."},"13":{"text":"Aw Shulam lienu! Sul hing hei ven, sul hing vei ven, nangma’ duongsuo ka maimitin ka suon nading, sul hing hei in, sul hing hei in. Galkap guolni ciente’ mai-a lamvui et bang, a bang dingin Shulam lie-te na mai mitun suon na hi vuoi?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lengnu melpuo lanu no aw, na pheiphung le na kedapte etin lawm e! Na pheizum gel banzal siemte suong manpha zun no khu bang e.","title":"Phatna Pulahna"},"2":{"text":"Na laimu khu kuong bangin kuoh, ningzu lawi lo ningbel no bang. Ngai na gil zong unoh pal um, mangbu sunvum dung zil sang e."},"3":{"text":"Na anglai-a nunkhum ni gel zuhsa ni le khisa pengkop no khu bang e."},"4":{"text":"Ngaino na ngawng vuisai halep dawsang dung zil. Na maimit zong Bath-rabbim dawngkot nen a Heshbon dimtui dung no zil e. Na nahkuo khu vangkhuo Damascus-a pieng Lebanon dawsang no dung zil e."},"5":{"text":"Na sumlu-a na khuhlu khu Carmel lenmuol vum no sun sang, na besam a kaisuhte khu silpuon sandup no khu bang e. A sambawh khu etin lawm e, vaimang’ henkol bul law na hi."},"6":{"text":"Kang it vatuh, lungdei lanu! na duongsuo khu etin lawm sa’ng, ka lungtaina nangma hi teh."},"7":{"text":"Na duong kikhai lutu mam bang, na anglai-a nunkhum nigel a ga lunlaite khu bang e."},"8":{"text":"A gam tulsing lutu dawnah baah bangin kei va kai vangin, ka banzal tawh a bazamte mawng bang va kawi tavang ci-in, tong hing lel ing. Na ang lai-a nunkhum nigel lengga bangin bawh pha hinlen, nangma’ husan gimnamte’n zong tulta apple gim zil taheh."},"9":{"text":"Keima nei tawpnate zong khu haning kawm le kam sung zui-a a hing luong suh, ningzu hlumpen dung zil taheh."},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaino-a’ khu ka hi hi, a lungdei pen keima ka hi."},"11":{"text":"Hing leng vawi ven ka sen ngaino, gam tulta-ah va lai lengin vangkhuo tengah zankhuo sawtin sam bang zal vai."},"12":{"text":"Lengguite zong tangna bangin a dawn suong tai, lengkungte zong a pa huomin mang kawlsingte a pallun tai, taikhuo val cieng maimit suon ding, laikhun tung pan zuongtho vai-in, lengga huon-ah vai lo kuon vai. Na vang mu bang ka ngaina teng nang pie sieng vang."},"13":{"text":"Zawl-ai gimsi no hing lang ta, lungdei gasing namcin teng zong dawng kotbiengah li bang kicing. Gathei lui le gathei thate nang koipieh ing, ka sen ngai aw."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tang laizom, tunnu anglai nunkhum luoipi hi lacin maw! Tuonglam lai-ah dawn bang tuo-in kang tawptawp zong singtate’n zong nuisiemin ei lel sih va uh."},"2":{"text":"Mim bang pienna tunnu saunuom, laikhun tungah hing pui nuom ing. Ningzu khum le mang kawlsing tui hing tultul vang."},"3":{"text":"Banzal veilam ei khamsahin, banzal zietlamin ei kawi le ci’ng!"},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem lienute aw, vang kingaina kam mei bangin a kuon masie, va bang phawngin thel bang thosah sih va ung ci’n ka sieng nenah tong hing ciem un!"},"5":{"text":"Senel gam pan pheiphung ang suon, a ngai tunga kingam nu khu kuo ta lie vontawi ahi maw? Na tunnu in umlai veilaw mim bang pienna tulsing apple hlim nei no-ah tang lo bangin ke’n hing phong ing.","title":"Innlam Peina"},"6":{"text":"Na banzal khu melcina khat a kitup bang, na sinlungah melcina khat ei tuppieh in; vang kingaina sikuong bang hat, lung gulna zong hankhuh bangin huoisie vengvong. Kam meisi bang kithezahin kam meikuong bang sa vapom e."},"7":{"text":"Vang kingaina situi tampi’n sumit zo sih, tuikhang in zong taimang zo sih. Gou le gamh tawh vang kingaina lei sawm hi lei, nuisiem lelna’n ei kinei va."},"8":{"text":"Anglai nunkhum a baw nai lo tuoi lienu khat nei na lai ui. Singta’n tongdam hing lel uleh i tuoi lienu bang i law diei?"},"9":{"text":"I laizom nu kawmpal hi leh ngun a kibawl dawsa bangin gie bang zunin, i laizom nu dawngkot hi leh, tulsing taamtah peh tawh zun vei."},"10":{"text":"Keima kawmpal kicieng hi’ng e, ka nunkhum gel dawsang bang e. Ka sen ngaino’ maimit sungah lemna a puoh nu khu bang ing."},"11":{"text":"A gam min law Baal-hamon ah Solomon in leng huon khat nei. Tua lenghuon khu a hlo dingin losapte siengah ap ta ei. Ham bang a huoi losapte kung, singga manh ding ngun tulkhat kai."},"12":{"text":"Ka lengga lei, keima’ aituom, keima-a’ hi. Solomon aw, tulkhat tang in; losapte in a lawman dingin zani tang heh!"},"13":{"text":"Khanghuon a buol ka ngaino aw, khawlpi ka guol ngaino teng in na tongdam nemno khu ngai uh, keima zong khu ei zasah ven."},"14":{"text":"Tumtai gimsi namcin pona lenmuol sang tung, zuhsano le khisano bang, ka sieng laituol ang leng dingin, sen ngaino aw, hing kinaw ta’n!"}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isaiah","shortname":"Isa","abbr":[],"desc":"Isaiah laibu (the book of isaiah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Judah kumpi ahi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah-te’ hun sunga Judah gam le Jerusalem tawh kisai ama’ mangmunate tam bang ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 15:1-7; 15:32–16:20; 18:1–20:21; 2Khg 26:1–32:33"},"2":{"text":"Vantung aw, za in, leitung aw, ngai in; bangzieh ahei cile Topa in gen zo hi: “Ka tate khoi-in ka khangliensah a, ahi vangin amate in keima ei ledo uhi.","title":"Judah’ Gitlona"},"3":{"text":"Bawngtang in ama a nei pa thei a, laa in zong a pu’ anpiehna thei buong sam hi. Ahi vangin Israel in a thei sih a, ka mite in a thei sih hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ah, mawnei minam, khielna netcip mite, sietna a bawlte’ suonlehlahte, a gamtatsie tapate, amate in Topa a nuasie ta vua, Israel Siengtho Pa simmaw-in, a elngat kilkel uhi!"},"5":{"text":"Bang dingin siet nading suibe lai na hi uh ahei? Bang dingin ledo lailai na hi uh ahei? Lutang buppi a ci na a, lungsim vannuoi a gim hi."},"6":{"text":"Ketaw panin zangsip dongin a damna mun om lo a, hinanle liemma, sidup, liemna sisan naisante a om hi. Tuate a nai kisen lo a, kitun loin, sathau zong kinu lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na gam uh a kilawi ta a, na khuopite uh mei in katum ta hi; namdangte in na mit mu-un na gam a netum ta uhi; gamdang mite in a suhsiet ziehun gamdai gamkhing a suoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Lengga huona hlampheng bang, tangmai lo-a buh bang le a ki-imtawm khuopi bangin Zion’ tanu kinuasie hi."},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in themkhat ei na hinkhawi lo hi leh, Sodom i bang zo ta ding vua, Gomorrah i bang zo ta ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 19:24; Rom 9:29"},"10":{"text":"No, Sodom uliente aw, Topa’ thu za un! Gomorrah mite aw, Topa’ thuhilh ngai un!"},"11":{"text":"“Tua zata-a a tam na biehpiehnate uh kei adingin bang hi leltah ahei?” Topa in ci hi; tuutang meihal biehnate le a kivathau ganhingte’ thau ka kham zo ta hi; bawngtangte, tuunote le keel site tawh ka lung a kim sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka mai-ah a kilah dinga nang pei ciengun, na khut sung panun koi in tamte ang ngen ahei? Keima inntuol tuoncil nawn sih un;"},"13":{"text":"bangma-a kimang lo biehpiehnate hing peipi nawn sih un; kei adingin tuate pen gimnamtui kidahhuoi ahi hi. Hladet ni, sabbath ni, le khawmpi hlatnate, khielna tawh a kidim kikhopna thupite ka thuoh zo nawn sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Na hla thate ule a kise na pawite uh ka muda hi; kei adingin tuate vangih khat suoh a, tuate ka puohna-in ka gimsi hi.","ref":"Amos 5:21-22"},"15":{"text":"Na khut uh nang zah ciengin keima in ka mit ka sing ding a, thu tampi ngen nan locin kang ngaipieh sih ding hi; na khut uh sisan a dim hi."},"16":{"text":"No le no kisil tawm unlen, kisiengthosah un. Ka muna-ah na gitlo gamtatnate uh paimang un; gitlo nasep khawl unlen,"},"17":{"text":"sil hoi bawl kisin un; thutang sui unlen, a kibawlsie mite hunkhie un, pa nei lote panpi unlen, meigongte thu vaihawmpi un."},"18":{"text":"Topa in ci hi: Tu-in hing pei un, thu kikumton vai. Na mawnate uh puon ausan bang tama le vua bangin ang paa ding hi; na mawnate uh puon sandup bang tama le tuumul bangin ang ngo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Note na lungkim vua thu na man uleh, leitang pana a pieng ga hoite na ne ding uhi;"},"20":{"text":"hinanle nielin nei ledo uleh, namsau in note ang vatmai ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa in genzo hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangci dan-a a muonhuoi khuopi numei pahtat suoh ta vanuh adiei! Ama thutang tawh kidim ngai-in tua sungah dihtatna om ngai napi- tu-in mi thatte a om ta veleh!","title":"A Gamtatsie Khuopi"},"22":{"text":"Na ngun sam-eh kai zo a, na zu tui tawh kihal zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Na miliente khu mi ledote ahi vua, gutate tawh kigopte ahi uhi. Mi zosie in guhgol a dei vua, letsong a sui uhi. Amate in pa nei lote panpi loin, a kung vuah meigongte’ thu zong tung lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ziehin Thunei pen Topa , Israel-te’ Vanglien Pa in tam bangin ci hi: “Ah, ka galte tungah ka lungthahna ka sungsuh ding a, kei mama in ka langte tungah phu ka la ding hi!"},"25":{"text":"Note langkhatah ka khut ka hla ding a, na sam-eh teng uh tuisuoh sahin, na siagawm zosie uh ka lamang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A masa lai bangin na thukhente uh ka koikia ding a, tuale a kipatcil hun bangin na thu kuppite uh ka koikia ding hi. Tua zaw ciengin a dih khuopi, a thuman khuopi, a muonhuoi khuopi ang kici ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Thutang tawh Zion kitankhie ding a, ama sungah a kisiakia mite dihna tawh kitankhie ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hizongle mi ledote le mawneite kisuhsiet tha ding a, Topa taisante ahile kimangthaisah ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile note in na kipahpi uh gangpi singte na maizumpi ding uhi; na deiteel uh umte ziehin na maisan ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note pen a te a vul gangpi sing le tui a nga lo um khat tawh na kibang ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Patlom bangin mihatpa a nem ding a, amau’ nasep khu meisi leng bang ding hi; amate le amau’ nasep katum ding a, a phel ding koima a om sih ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Judah gam le Jerusalem tawh kisai-in tam bangin mu hi:","title":"Mailam Pasien’ Biehinnpi (Mic 4:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Ang tung ding nite ah Topa’ biehinn muol pen muol golte lahah a sang penin kikipsah ding a, tuale muoltangte tungah a kitawisang ding hi; minam zosie in tua mun a zuon valuoi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mi tampite a haw ding vua, “Hing pei un, Jacob’ Pasien’ biehinn, Topa’ muol tungah va kato ta vai; tuaci’n eite in ama’ ketot i zui thei nadingin, ama in eite tungah a lampite ei hil ding hi,” a ci ding uhi. Azieh pen Zion panin thuhilna pusuoh ding a, Jerusalem panin Topa’ kammal pusuoh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in minamte kikalah thukhen ding a, mi tampite adingin kiselna vengsah ding hi; amate in a namsaute uh kangkui-in a kheng ding vua, a teipite singba heuna namkawi-in kheng ding uhi; minam khat in minam khat tungah namsau leh nawn lo ding a, amate in galdo dan zong a sin nawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Joel 3:10"},"5":{"text":"Jacob’ innkuonte aw, hing pei unlen, Topa ’ khuovah sungah kalsuon va vui!","title":"Kiphatsahna tungah Thukhenna Kitangko"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen no Jacob’ innkuonte aw, note in na mite’ lampite na taisan zo uhi. Amate nisuona lam pana aisante tawh a kidim vua, Philistia-te banga thu mavang gente ahi uhi. Gamdang mite tawh amate khutbeng tonin a om uhi."},"7":{"text":"A gam uh ngun le kham tawh kidim a, amau’ goute in tawp hun ci nei lo hi; a gam uh sakol tawh kidim a, a lengte un zong tawp hun nei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"A gam uh milimte tawh kidim hi; a khut vua a bawlsate’ mai, a khutme vua a bawlsate’ mai-ah amate a kun uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale mite a neilut vua, mi zosie kiniemkoi suh hi, amau’ mawna maisah sin!"},"10":{"text":"Topa’ giinhuoina pan le a thupi a vanglietna panin suongpi-ah lut unlen, leivui lahah kiphuol un.","ref":"Kln 6:15; 2Thes 1:9"},"11":{"text":"Mite’ kilietsahna mitte kiniemkoi ding a, mi zosie’ kiphatsahna kiniemkhieh ding hi; khum ni ciengin Topa beh kitawisang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa in a kiphasah le a kiliensah zosie, a kitawisangte le a kidomsang zosie;"},"13":{"text":"a kidawh sang, a kilamto, Lebanon muol taamtah kung zosie; Bashan gam sunga gangpi sing zosie;"},"14":{"text":"muol sang zosie le muoltang sang zosie;"},"15":{"text":"inn dawsang zosie le kulpi muonhuoi zosie;"},"16":{"text":"Tarshish tembaw zosie le khut siema kibawl a etlawm na zosie tungah, ama in ngiemkoi hun ding ni khat a nei hi."},"17":{"text":"Mite’ kilietsahna kiniemkhieh ding a, mite’ kiphatsahna kiniemkoi ding hi; khum ni ciengin Topa beh kitawisang ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Milimte zosie mangthai sieng ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitung zausah dinga ama ang kipat ciengin, Topa’ giinhuoina le ama’ a thupi a vanglietnate panin, a vanglien ama’ thupina panin suonghawm sung le leihawm sungah mite lutin a kiphuol ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mite in bieh dinga a bawltawm uh kham le ngun milimte, bahte le buite tungah a paimang ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Leitung zausah dinga ama ang kipat ciengin, Topa’ giinhuoina pan le a lien a minthanna panin suonghawm sung le kenkawm sungah amate a lut ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"A nahvanga a husang beh ahi mihingte panin kihei un.
