Amate leltah banga simtah ahei?"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Azieh pen tu-in Thunei pen pa, Vanglien Topa in Jerusalem le Judah gam panin nuntahna le luhinna, nuntahna an zosie, nuntahna tui zosie a lamang hi."},"2":{"text":"Galhang pa le galkap pa, thukhen pa le kamsang pa, aisan pa le upa pa,"},"3":{"text":"mi sawmnga a uhpa le mi zalien pa, thu kuppipa le mitphiel siempa, le bum siemte a lamang hi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ ulien dingin naupangte ka bawl ding a, naungehte in amate a uh ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mite khatlekhat, mi zosie in a guolte ciet, mi zosie in a vengte ciet, a bawlsie ding uhi; khangnote in khanghamte nuoisie ding a, mi ginalote in a zatah huoi mite a nuoisie ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi kimkhat in a be sunga a sanggampa nangawn manin, “Nang in puon na nei hi; nang, kohaw’ makai pa nang hi ding a, tami a sielomtang teng pen nangma khut sung hi ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanle khum ni-in adang khat in, “Kei mi cidamsah pa ka hi sih ding hi; ka inn sungah an le puon a om sih hi; mite makai dingin nei bawl sih ding uhi,” ci-in a gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kamsuo ule a sepnate un Topa langpangin ama’ vanglietna opna a simmaw ziehun, Jerusalem kipalpua-in Judah gam a pua zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Amau’ maisuo in amate langah teci a pang hi; Sodom bangin amate in a mawna uh a phuongzah vua, amate in a phuol sih uhi. Amate in gimna nga ta uheh! Bangzieh ahei cile amate in amau’ tungma ah sietna a kitut uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a nasep gate ne ding uh ahi ziehin, bangza-in amate hampha ci thu mawpeng mite kungah gen un."},"11":{"text":"Mawnei mite in gimna nga taheh! Amate bangza-in hamsie uh ahei, bangzieh ahei cile amau’ khuta a sepna utawh kizui-in, a tung vuah kibawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima’ mite, naupangte pen amate a bawlsiete ahi vua, numeite in amate a uh uhi. Ka mite aw, na makaite un note ang puikhiel vua, amate in na lampi zui uh ang buoisah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mi mawsah dingin Topa kipan a, a mite thukhen dingin a ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Upate le ama’ mi uliente tawh thukhen dingin Topa lut hi. “Lenggui lo a netumte khu noma na hi vua, na inn sung vuah mizawngte’ van na sutte uh a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Note in ka mite na suhguoina ule mizawngte’ maitang na gawizanna uh bang na deina uh ahei?” Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Zion tanute kiliensahin ngawng vaipuohin lam a pei vua, kiphatsahna tawh mittol pimpemin mi a en vua, a ketot uh ginsie-in a kal uh a nawsuon liplap uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Zion tanute’ lu tungah hima dimsah ding a, Topa in amau’ guohtang hina a hawmangpieh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Topa in kebuh hoite, lutuomte le hlade lim tawh a kibang kizepnate;"},"19":{"text":"bilbate, tauciente, ngawngvielte;"},"20":{"text":"lukhute, banbulte, kawngtente, gimnamtui bungte, le ai-a a kibawl puonte;"},"21":{"text":"suoikaina khutsip le nahbate;"},"22":{"text":"pawi puontuolte, songkhol tuolte, puonpite le khutkhai ipte;"},"23":{"text":"puonzal neu vang sitsiatte, tangciin puon sungsilte, dielkhimte, le puon lukhute a lakhie ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Gimnamtui tangin a ui a muot, kawnggah tangin khauhuol, sam kipot hoi tangin lutolna, puontuol hoi tangin la-ip puon hampi, melhoina tangin maizumna a om ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na mite namsau tawh pua ding a, na galhangte gal sungah si ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Khuopi kotpite kapin mau ding uhi; tua nu kisusie gawpin tuolah a to cimit ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin numei sagi in papi khat pummatin, “Ka an ciet ne-in ka puon ciet ka sil ding uhi; nangma’ minin kote ei kihlansah beh inlen, ka minsietna uh ei lahpieh ta’n,” ci ding uhi."},"2":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Topa’ bameng pen a melhoi-in minthang ding a, tuale leitang pana pieng gate pen a suohta lai Israel-te adingin a kisahtheipi ule a thupina uh hi ding hi.","title":"Zion Sunga a Suohta Mite’ Mailam Minthanna"},"3":{"text":"Zion khuo-a kinuasie mi poma le Jerusalem-a a omlai teng, Jerusalem ah khang tungtawn a om dingin a kiciemtesa mi zosie a siengtho kici ding a,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in Zion numeite’ kidahhuoina teng a sawpsieng ciengin, Jerusalem khuolai panin thukhenna hlagau le meikuong hlagau in sisan baang teng a siengthosah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Zion Muol tunga om mun vannuoi le a kikhopna uh munte-ah sunin meikhu le zanin meikuong a omsah ding hi. Topa’ thupina vang in khuopi a khu ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua khu mandat bangin sunlai nisat cienga a hlim ding le huipi guopi pana kibuhna le bel ding ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lawm it pa tangin a lenggui lo tungtang ka zawlla sa vang: Ka lawm it pa in lei hoi mama na muol tung khatah lengga lo khat nei hi.","title":"A Ga lo Lenggui Huon’ La"},"2":{"text":"Ama in lei to-in suongte paidawh a, a deiteel lengguite a suon hi; a laikimah dawsang khat lam a, tua sungah lengga tui hlawhna khuh khat to hi; lengga hoi a ga dingin ama kinem a, hinanle gam lengga a ga mawh hi.","ref":"Mat 21:33; Mrk 12:1; Luk 20:9"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Jerusalem-a tengte le Judah mite aw, keima le ka lengga huon kikalah thu khen vawi un."},"4":{"text":"Ka lengga huon sungah ka bawl nai lo tuami adingin ka bawl ding bang omlai ahei? Lengga hoi ga ding ka kinep laitahin bang dinga gam lengga po ga zawsop ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Tu-in na kungah ka lengga huon tunga ka bawl dan ding kang gen ding hi. A daithaw ka ladawh ding a, tua khu a kinemang ding hi; a pal ka phelkhe ding a, tua khu kituoncil ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in lotul ka suohsah ding hi; tua khu hui lo tuh loin om ding a, tua lo sungah ling le khaute khangin a depmang ding hi; Keima in a tungah guo a zuh lo nadingin meiilumte thu ka pie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa’ lenggui huon khu Israel innkuonte ahi vua, Judah mite pen ahile lungkima a suon kungte ahi uhi; ama in thutang a lamen a, hizongle sisan luonna a mu hi; ama in thutang a lamen a, ahi vangin kaana a za hi!"},"8":{"text":"Gam laizangah noma guoh a teng ding dan khatin, noma ding ci simlo midangte dinga mun bei vawt za dongin inn a lei bebe mite le lo keh bebete khu mi hamsie ahi hi!","title":"Taangpi Tunga Thumanlona Kimawsah"},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Topa khu ka zahna-ah a kiciem zo hi: Inn tampi hawmsuoh valon ding a, inn gol le inn hoite sungah koima teng lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen lengga huon eka sawm in bath khat maimai ga ding a, khaici homer khat in an ephah khat maimai a piengsah ding hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Zingmawng thobai-in khamtheizu delin, lenggazu in amate a satsah vapual masangsie, zankhang a a tokho mite in gimna a thuoh ding uhi!"},"12":{"text":"Amau’ pawi sungah lyre lasahna le harp, tawm, theile le zu ciate kihal a, ahi vangin amate in Topa’ sepnate a thusim sih vua, ama in a khuta a bawlte zong amate in a mu sih uhi!"},"13":{"text":"Tua hi a, thei lona ziehin ka mite salin kikai ta hi; a miliente uh a kielsi vua, amau’ mihonte ahile a dangta-in a kihulvam uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Misikhuo dugawna khangsahin bangma tawh a kite thei lo za-in, a kam a kah piehpuoh hi. Jerusalem’ thupina le a mipite, ama’ sunga a nuomsa a mihonpite a sungah a lutsuh sieng uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mite kilukunsahin mi zosie kingiem koi a, mi kiliensahte a mitkhup sa-in ki-omsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle Vanglien Topa ahile a thutang sep ziehin kitawisang a, a Siengtho Pasien in dihtatna tawh a sienthona a lah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin a tatna uh lodawng mun bangin tua khuo sungah tuunote in lopa mai ding a, gan kivathaute le tuunote in a siesa khuopite lahah gamta ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Zuouna khaute tawh khielna kai a, leng khauhuol tawh mawna a kai note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Ei mu thei nadingin ama kinawsahin, ama’ nasep mallangsah vai. Eite in i theithei nadingin, Israel Siengtho pa’ gelna a tangtun thei nading kinawsah vai!” na ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"A hoi lote a hoi ci a, a hoite hoi lo ci-in, khuovah tangin khuomiel koi a, khuomiel tangin khuovah koi-in, a hlum tangin a kha koi a, a kha tangin a hlum a koi note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi!"},"21":{"text":"Noma’ mitah pil kisa-in noma’ muna-ah siem a kisate in gimna na thuoh ding uhi!"},"22":{"text":"Zudawn lama a kipasalsahte, le za tawh a kihal khamthei zudawn hatte,"},"23":{"text":"mawnei mite guhgol tawh hla a, mawpengte’ nga dingte a lahpieh note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi!"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin meikuong in bukungte katum a, mei sungah lopa gawte a kahtum bangin a zungte muotmang ding a, leivui bangin a pavuite a lengto ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in Vanglien Topa’ thuhilna a niel vua, Israel Siengtho pa’ kammal a simmaw uhi.","title":"Gamdangte’ Busimna Kigenkhol"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a mite tungah Topa ’ lungthahna kikuontaw-in, amate langkhatah a khut lamin amate a vatmai hi; muolte kithing a, lampi dung tengah a luonghawmte uh, buathah bangin a om hi. Azieh pen tam teng zosie ziehin a lungthahna kiheimang tuom lo a, ama’ khut a kizah lai hi."},"26":{"text":"A gamlapi-a a om minam khat adingin ama in lim khat khaito ding a, leimonga omte adingin khutkawi tumin, mallangtah le gangtahin amate a pei pai uhi!"},"27":{"text":"Amate a gim om koima loin, koima a kipai sih uhi. Koima lusu loin, koima kimu lo uhi. Kawnggah puonte kol loin, kedap khau khat zong tat lo hi;"},"28":{"text":"a thaltangte uh hiem thei mama a, a thalpite uh kuoisa-in a om hi. A sakol kecinte uzong khu meituh suong bang a, tuale a lengpeite uzong pumpei tawh kibang hi."},"29":{"text":"Amau’ hawh vapuoh khu humpi hawh tawh kibang a, a hawh vapuoh a khangdawng humpi tawh a kibang uhi; amate in ngih kawmin a neh ding uh sa man a, amate in tua khu a kipuoh dawh vua, koima in a hun zo sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin tuipi ging bangin amate tungah ging ding a, tuale mite in gam sung a et ciengun khuomiel le lungzinna beh a om hi; meii in khuovah a mielsah hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Uzziah a si kumin keima in a sang mama le a lien mama kumpi topha tunga a to Topa ka mu hi; tuale ama’ kumpi puon pen biehinn sung teng dim hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Sunga Pasien’ Mangmuna","ref":"2Kum 15:7; 2Khg 26:23"},"2":{"text":"Ama tungah seraph-te a om hi; tuate in hla guh ciet a nei uhi: Amate in a hla ni tawh a mai a khu vua, ni tawh a keng khu-in, ni tawh a leng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale amate khatlekhat kihlanin: “Vanglien Topa Siengtho, siengtho, siengtho; a vanglietna leitung buppi kidim hi, a kici uhi.","ref":"Kln 4:8"},"4":{"text":"A kihlatna awging in kotkhah mungte kilawhsah a, tuale inn sung teng meikhu tawh a kidim hi.","ref":"Kln 15:8"},"5":{"text":"Tuale keima in: “Gim nga pa hi tang ei! Mi mangthai ka hi ta hi, azieh pen kei kam siengtho lo pa ka hi a, kam siengtho lo mite lahah ka teng hi; hinanle Vanglien Topa Kumpipa ka mu zo ta hi!” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Seraph-te lahah khat, maitam panin taite tawh mei-am khat tepin ka kungah ang leng hi."},"7":{"text":"Seraph in tua tawh ka kam ang khoi a, “Tu-in tami in na nephute khoi zo ta hi; na khielna a kilamang ta a, na mawna zong kiphietmang zo ta hi,” ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Koi ahiei ka sawl ding, koi ahiei ei tanga va pei ta ding?” a cina aw ka za hi. Tuale keima in, “Tanah om ing! Keima ei sawl in,” ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Pei inlen tam mite kungah gen in: ‘Zaza napi na telthei sih uhi; mumu napi na theithei sih uhi,’ vaci ta’n."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a mit utawh a et lo nading uh, a bil utawh a zah lo nading uh, a lungsim utawh a thei cien lo nading ule, amate kihei-in damna a nga lo nadingun, tam mite’ lungsim mawlsah inlen, a bil uh bingsahin a mit uh singsah in,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Mat 13:14-15; Mrk 4:12; Luk 8:10; Jhn 12:40; Sawl 28:26-27"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “ Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt ding ahei?” ka ci hi. Tuale ama in a gen hi: “Khuopi zosie tenna loin hawmsuoh a, innte-ah mi teng loin leitang gamkhing suoh a,"},"12":{"text":"Topa in mi zosie a gamlapi-ah sawldawhin, gam sungah a kinuasie mun tampi a op dong cieng, hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua sungah mi sawm-ah-khat a oplai tei vangin, taa kung ahi sihle gangpi singte a kiphua zaw ciengin, a kungbul a omlaite mei tawh a kihalkia bangin amate kihalkia ding hi,” ei ci hi. Tua a kungbul khu khaici siengtho ahi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uzziah’ tapa Jotham, Jotham’ tapa Judah kumpipa Ahaz hun lai-in Jerusalem sim dingin Aram kumpipa Rezin le Remaliah’ tapa Pekah a kuonto vua, hinanle ama gel in a zo sih uhi.","title":"Isaiah in Kumpi Ahaz Hlamuongsahkia","ref":"2Kum 16:5; 2Khg 28:5-6"},"2":{"text":"Ephraim-te tawh Aram-te kipawlton hi, ci thu David’ innkuonte in a zah ciengin, huipi in a sem gamlah singkungte bangin Ahaz le a mipite’ lungsim a kiling hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in Isaiah kungah, “Puonsawppa Lo lampi-a buol tungnung tuilahna monga a om Ahaz tawh kimu dingin na tapa Shear-jashub tawh pei unlen"},"4":{"text":"ama kungah, “Kidawm in, sip dide inlen, zau vateh sin. A khu lemlem singkhuo tawng ni tawh a kibang lel Aram kumpipa Rezin le Remaliah’ tapa’ lungthahna ziehin kilunggimsah sin."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Remaliah’ tapa tawh Aram pangtonin na tungah sietna a bawl sawm vua,"},"6":{"text":"“Judah gam sim dingin va kuonto ta vai-in, tuale Jerusalem sumaimangin eimahaw dingin va zo thop ta vai; tua gam sungah kumpi dingin Tabeel’ tapa koi vai,” a ci uhi;"},"7":{"text":"tua ahi tah ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: Tua thu kip lo ding a, zong tangtung lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Aram’ lutang khu Damascus ahi a, Damascus’ lutang khu Rezin ahi hi. (Kum sawmguh le kum nga sungin minam khat ahi thei nawn lo ding za-in Ephraim kivatmai ding hi.)"},"9":{"text":"Ephraim’ lutang khu Samaria ahi a, Samaria’ lutang khu Remaliah’ tapa ahi hi. Upna sungah na dinkip sih leh na kip vawt sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Ahaz hopikia a,","title":"Isaiah in Ahaz Immanuel’ Lim Pie"},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasien’ lim khat ngen in; tua lim pen Misikhuo bangin thuh hinlen ahi sihle vantung bangin sang heh, a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle Ahaz in, “Ka ngen sih ding hi; Topa ka zelah sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaiah in, “David’ innkuonte aw, ngai un! Mi na gimsah uh pen no adingin thuneuno khatin na ngaisun vua, ka Pasien zong gimsah lai ding na hi uh amah?"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa mama in note tungah lim khat ang pie ding hi. En un, ngahnu khat gai-in tapa khat nei ding a, a min Immanuel kici ding hi.","ref":"Mat 1:23"},"15":{"text":"Ama in sil hoi lo nuolin sil hoi a teel thei hun ciengin bawngnawi thaukhal le khuoizu ne ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen naupang in sil hoi lote nuolin sil hoite bangci teel ding ci thu a thei masangin na giin uh kumpi nite’ gam a kinuasie ta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah panin Ephraim-te a peikhiet ni-a kipanin Topa in ni danga a pieng ngai nai lo tua bang nite, nangma, na mite, le na pupa’ innkuon tungah a tungsah ding hi- tua khu Assyria kumpipa tung pan hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in tua ni ciengin Egypt tuinahte-a om thote le Assyria gam sunga om khuoite a saisip tumin a hlan ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale amate zong a unpi-in hing pei-in kenkawm lah, suongpi kehte kikal lah, ling le khau lah cinteng le ganhing tatna muncin tengah a tu ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Topa in Gungal pana kikawm mulmetna nam ahi- Assyria kumpipa tawh- lu le kengmulte heulieu-in tua ma tawh khamulte zong a heu ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mi khat in bawnglaa khat le tuu ni bang beh suotahpi zo ding a,"},"22":{"text":"tuate in nawitui kicing tahin a pieh zo ziehin ama in bawngnawi thaukhal a ne zo ding h; azieh pen tua gama a omlaite zosie in bawngnawi thaukhal le khuoizu a ne ciet ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin ngun shekel tulkhat a man lenggui tulkhat a op ngaina mun zosie ling lah khau lah a suoh ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Gam zosie khaugui le lingbawhte tawh kidim ta ding ahi ziehin, mite thal le thaltang tawh gam a vah ding uhi;"},"25":{"text":"tuale nangma in ling le khaute na giin ziehin tupeh tawh a kihlo ngai muoltangte-ah na pei ngam sih ding hi; hizongle tuate bawng hlana le tuute’ gamtatna mun a suoh ta ding uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah, “Suongpheng gol khat la inlen, tua tungah mikim in a thei dingin laiteng tawh, ‘Maher-shalal-hash-baz ading,’ ci-in giel in,” a ci a,","title":"Isaiah’ Tapa, Assyria-te’ Busimna Lim"},"2":{"text":"tuale keima adinga teci a pang dingin a muonhuoi tecite, siempu Uriah le Jeberechiah’ tapa Zechariah tegel hisah in."},"3":{"text":"Tuale kamsang nu tawh ka lumton a, ama gai-in tapa khat nei hi. Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah, “A min dingin Maher-shalal-hash-baz phuo in,” ei ci hi;"},"4":{"text":"azieh pen nausen in, ‘Ka nu ahi sihle ka Pa,’ a ci thei masangin Damascus’ hauna le Samaria van kila zosie Assyria kumpipa in puomang ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in keima ei hopikia-in:"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen tam mite in damtaha a luong dildiel Shiloah tuite nuolin Rezin le Remaliah’ tapa mai-ah zau-in a citun uhi;"},"7":{"text":"tua ziehin Topa in amate a langpang dingin a thahat Gun tuikhangte ahi Assyria kumpipa le ama’ vanglietna zosie a puohto ding hi; a tuilam zosie ah tua tui dimletin a lui pieu zosie hlummang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah gam sung dong nawhsuhin tui dimletin peisuoh ding a, ngawng tan a gei dongin hlumsuoh ding hi; tuale a hla kizah tegel in na gam a vailam teng khusuh ding hi, Immanuel aw."},"9":{"text":"No mite aw, kikhawm unlen, lungkham un; Gamlapi-a a om no gam zosiete aw, ngai un. Na kawng gah unlen, lungkham un; na kawng gah unlen lung kham un!"},"10":{"text":"Thu kikumton un, hinanle bangma a matlap a om sih ding hi. Thu gen un, ahi vangin a kip tuom sih ding hi. Azieh pen kote tawh Pasien a omton hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in keima tungah a thahat ama’ khut ngamin tua bangin ei hopi-in, tam mite’ lampi ka zui lo nadingin ei na hilkhol a:"},"12":{"text":"Tam mite in sawmdapna a ci vannuoi uh zong sawmdapna ci pai sih unlen, amau’ giinte giing seng sih unlen, zong zau pai sih un."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Vanglien Topa pen a siengtho-in na ngaisun ding uhi; ama khu na zatahpa uh hisah unlen, na giinpa uh hisah un.","ref":"1Pet 3:14-15"},"14":{"text":"Ama pen mun siengtho khat suohin mite’ sat suongtum khat a suoh ding hi; azieh pen Israel innkuon ni gel adingin pua thei nading suongtum- Jerusalem-a tengte adingin piel le thangkam a suoh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate lahah mi tampi a pua ding uhi; amate pua-in guoicim ding uhi; amate thangah awhin kiman ding hi.","ref":"1Pet 2:8"},"16":{"text":"Tua teci panna tun inlen, ka nuazuite lahah thuhilna khahcip dawh in.","title":"Isaiah’ Nuazuite"},"17":{"text":"Jacob’ innkuonte panin a mai a phuol Topa ka ngah ding a, ama sungah ka kinem ding hi.","ref":"Heb 2:13"},"18":{"text":"En un, Topa ei pieh tate le keima pen Zion Muol tunga a teng Vanglien Topa tung panin Israel sunga ei pieh limte le hilkholnate ka hi uhi.","ref":"Heb 2:13"},"19":{"text":"Tu-in mite in nangma kungah, “Phui samsama dawi thu gengen dawi aisan siemte le mi bumsiemte kungah thu dong un; mite in a pasien-te uh kungah thu a dawh ding uh kilawm lo a, thuhilna le theisahna dingin a hingte tangin"},"20":{"text":"misite dawh ding kilawmzaw hi lo amah?” ang ci uleh, a tahtahin tam banga thu gente in khuovah a nei vawt sih ding uhi!"},"21":{"text":"Amate pen nahpitahin lungkham le gilkielin gam sungah a vah kawikawi ding uhi; a gil uh a kiel ciengin lunghamin a kumpipa ule a pasien uh a samsie ding uhi. Vantung lamah amate a dahto ding vua,"},"22":{"text":"ahi sihle tuol ensuhin a kun ding uhi, ahi vangin amate in mangbahna, mielna, lungzin lunggimna beh a mu ding uhi; tuale mielking lahah amate a kisawn nawp ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanle lunggim mite adingin lungzinna a om sih ding hi. Nidang lai-in ama in Zebulun le Naphtali gamte simmaw etsatna a thuohsah a, hizongle hun nukhia lamah ama in tuipi peina lampi, Jordan gungal gam, le minamte’ tenna Galilee gam a thupisah kia ding hi.","title":"Thudih tawh a maang ding Kumpipa’","ref":"Mat 4:15"},"2":{"text":"Khuomiel sunga a pei mite in khuovah lienpi mu zo uhi; khuomiel thuhna gam sunga a teng mite tungah khuovah a tang zo hi.","ref":"Mat 4:16; Luk 1:79"},"3":{"text":"Nang in minam na pungsah zo a, a lungdamna uh na khangsah zo hi. Anlah huna a lungdam bang ule galvanlah a hawm hunin mite kipahin a lungdam bangun, na mai-ah amate a lungdam uhi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Midian-te a kizaw ni-a bangin nangma in amau’ vangih puohna hahkol le a liengko vua kikham singzawl, amate a bawlsie mite’ ciengpum na sattawngpieh ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen galhangte’ kedap zosie le sisan baang puon zosie mei in sing a kahtum bangin kihaltum ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen eite adingin nausen khat ang suoh a, eite tungah tapa khat ei kipie hi; ama’ liengko tungah thuneina a om hi; ama pen, Lamdang Thu Kuppipa, Vanglien Pasien, Tawntung Pa, Kilemna Kumpipa, ci-in kiphuo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama’ thuneina khang semsem ding a, David’ kumpi topha le a kumpi gam adingin kilemna in tawp hun nei lo ding hi. Ama in tu huna kipan a tawntungin, thudih le thutang tawh gam phutin a tukip ding hi. Vanglien Topa’ deiluotna in tami a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Luk 1:32-33"},"8":{"text":"Topa in Jacob langah thu khat puoh a, Israel tungah tua thu a tung hi;","title":"Kihisahna le Kigawtna Tunga Thukhenna"},"9":{"text":"mi zosiete-Ephraim le Samaria-a tengte zosie- in tua thu a thei uhi. Ahi vangin kiphatsahna le lungsim kilietsahna tawh amate in tam bangin a gen uhi:"},"10":{"text":"“Tehleite a cimzan zo ta a, hinanle a kikhengzol suongte tawh i lamkia ding uhi; theitheh singte kiphua sieng zo a, hizongle tuate munah eite in taamtah sing i zang ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in amate do dingin a langte khangsahin a galte uh a hantawh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Nisuona lama Aram-te le nitumna lama Philistia-te in a kam uh kahin Israel a nawmval uhi. Tam thute zosie ziehin a lungthahna kihei lo hi; ama’ khut a kizahlai hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate a satpa lamah mite a kihei sih vua, ahi sihle Vanglien Topa a sui sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ni khat sungin Topa in Israel sung panin a lu le a mei, le lutu ba le pumpeng a vatmai hi."},"15":{"text":"Upate le a zatahhuoi mite a lutang lam ahi vua, zuouthu hil kamsangte a mei lam ahi uhi;"},"16":{"text":"azieh pen tam mite a puite in amate lamkhielsah a, amate in a pui uh mite lungbuoisah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin Topa in a tangvalte uh tungah khuotuona nei loin, a tagate uh’ tung le a meigongte uh tungah lainatna a nei sih hi; azieh pen amate a unpi-un Pasien nei lo le sil hoilo bawlte ahi vua, kamham zosie in motna thu vive a gen hi. Tam thute zosie ziehin a lungthahna kihem loin, ama’ khut kizahlai hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen gitlona mei bangin kuong a, ling le khaute a katum hi; tua in gamlah hamphul kuongsah a, a tung lamah meikhu lompi a kizielto vapual hi."},"19":{"text":"Vanglien Topa’ lungthahna ziehin gam sung a katum sieng a, mite pen mei sunga kivang ding sing tawh kibang a, mi koima in a midangte a za tuon sih hi."},"20":{"text":"A zietlama omte a ne vua, hinanle a kham zo sih uhi; amate in a veilama a om a tanaute’ sa zong a ne uhi;"},"21":{"text":"Manasseh in Ephraim, Ephraim in Manasseh ne-in, tuale a ni tuohun Judah langpanton uhi. Tam thute zosie ziehin a lungthahna kihem loin, ama’ khut a kizahlai hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A dih lo thukhensatte bawlin mi gawtna thukhamte a giel, a dih thukhenna panin mi tasamte heimangin, ka mi zawngte’ nga ding hamphatnate guhpieh a, meigong numeite gal vanlah a suo thei nading ule, no pa nei lote, nehtum dinga bawlte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi!","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Danpieh ni ang tun cieng le a gamla pana tuosiet ni ang tun ciengin, bang law ding na hi uh ahei? Huna ngenin koi kungah tai-in, na neisa uh hei sungah nuasie ding na hi uh ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Tongkiete lahah kunin ahi sihle a kithat mite lahah a si ding hi lel lo na hi uh amah? Tam thute zosie ziehin a lungthahna a dam zo nai sih a, ama’ khut kizahlai hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka lungthahna moltum- amau’ khut sunga a om keima’ thangpaina ciengkhut ahi, Assyria in gimna a thuoh ding hi!","title":"A Kihisah Assyria in Thukhenna Thuoh"},"6":{"text":"Keima in Pasien a nei lo minamte a va sim ding le ei thangpaisah mite va sim dingin ama thu ka pie a, amate in bulu gawpin a tomgam ding vua, lampi-a buonnawite bangin a tuoncil gawp ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin tami ama’ siltup ahi sih a, a lungsim sungah zong ngaisutin nei lo hi; ahi vangin a lungsim sungah suhsiet ding le a tawm tham ahi vawt lo minamte suhmai ding a sawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in, “Ka galkapmangte a unin kumpi hi lo amah?"},"9":{"text":"Calno khuo khu Carchemish khuo tawh a kibang ahi sih amah? Hamath khuo khu Arpad tawh a kibang ahi sih amah? Samaria khuopi khu Damascus khuopi tawh a kibang ahi sih amah?"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem le Samaria milimte sangin a thupizaw milimte a nei milim kumpi gamte ka khut in banzo ahi ziehin,"},"11":{"text":"Samaria le a milimte tunga ka bawl bangin Jerusalem le a milimte tungah ka bawl sih ding amah?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Zion Muol tung le Jerusalem tunga a nasep zosie a man zaw ciengin ama in a kihisah luotna le a ki-uongsahnate ziehin Assyria kumpipa dan a pie ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in: “Theitelna ka nei ziehin, ka khut hatna le ka pilna tawh ka bawl zo ta hi; mite’ gamgi ka khinpieh a, a gou uh ka tomgam hi; keima in bawngtang bangin kumpi topha tunga tote ka khiesuh zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka khut in vabu a mu bangin mite’ hauna ka mu hi; mite in a kinuasie vatui a lah bangin leitung zosie ka khawm zo hi; a hla a piasah lo, a kam kah loin a ham koima om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Moltum in a dom pa a ledop bang le ciengkhut in sing ahi lo mi khat a ledop bangin, a zang pa tungah heitang kiphasah thei ding amah? Ahi sihle a zang pa tungah sing-at nam a kiliensah thei ding amah?"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Thunei pen pa, Vanglien Topa in a galhang mithaute lahah a gawngsah thei natna a tungsah ding a, a vanglietna nei-ah meikuong bangin a kuong khat a om ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel’ khuovah mei suohin, ama’ Siengtho Pa zong meikuong a suoh ding hi; khumi in ni khat sungin a ling khaute katum ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in gamlah’ thupina le an pienna a leitang pen hinna le pumpi gawmin a nipi-in susie ding a, mi dammaw khat bangin ama a tha zawngkhal ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A gamlah singkung omsun teng a tawm seng ziehin, naupang khat in a phaza lai tawh gielin sim thei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Israel a omlaite le Jacob’ innkuon sung panin a suohta laite in amahaw a satgawpte tungah kingam nawn loin, Topa Israel Siengtho Pa tungah thudih tawh a kingam zaw ta ding uhi.","title":"A Kisie Israel Omlai e"},"21":{"text":"A thahat Pasien kungah Jacob innkuon a omlaite a kilekia ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen tuipieu-a senel za bangin na mi Israel-te tam nanle a omlai teng beh ang kilekia ding uhi. Dihna tawh a dimlet suhsietna a tun nading kikhensat zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen a thu khensatsa bangin Vanglien Topa Pasien in leitung mun zosie-ah manthaina tungsah ding hi.","ref":"Rom 9:27"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Vanglien Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: “Zion-a teng ka mite aw, Egypt-te na bawl bangin Assyria-te in a ciengtawn utawh hing satin a ciengkhut uh hing lamto nan leh amate giing sih un."},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen tomkal khat sungin keima’ thangpaina dai ding a, amau’ manthai nading lamah ka lungthahna kihei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in Oreb suongpi-ah Midian-te a satlia lai bangin khauhuol tawi-in amate a sat ding hi; tuipi tungah ama’ ciengkhut om ding a, ama in Egypt gama a bawl bangin tua a ciengkhut a domto ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin na liengko panun ama’ vangih kiladawhin na ngawng panun ama’ hahkol kisusie ding hi. Rimmon panin ama peito a,"},"28":{"text":"Aiath khuo a tung hi; ama in Migron khuo kantanin Michmash khuo-ah a van a khol hi;"},"29":{"text":"amate in ciengkot a kantan vua, Geba khuo-ah a gieh uhi; Ramah khuomite zau-in a citun vua, Saul’ tenna Gibeah-te a taimang uhi."},"30":{"text":"Gallim khuo tanute aw, nahpitahin kiko un! Laishah khuo aw, ngai in! Anathoth khuo aw, ama dawng in!"},"31":{"text":"Madmenah a taimang a, Gebim-a tengte zong suotahna sui-in a tai uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuni mama-in Nob khuo-ah ama khawl ding a, Zion tanu’ Muol Jerusalem muoltang tungah a khuttum a ziel ding hi."},"33":{"text":"En un, Thunei pen pa, Vanglien Topa in a giinhuoi a vanglienpi tawh singbate a heuh ding hi; singkung sang pente kiphua ding a, a sangtuomte kiniemsah ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in gammang singte hei khat tawh phua ding a, singkung thupite tawh Lebanon a puaton ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:24-27; Nah 1:1–3:19; Zeph 2:13-15"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jessi’ phung panin a ba khat ang meng ding a, a zungte panin a ba khat ang khang ding hi.","title":"Kilemna Kumpi Gam","ref":"Kln 5:5; 22:16"},"2":{"text":"Ama tungah Topa’ hlagau ahi, pilna hlagau le theitelna hlagau, ngaisut theina hlagau le thahatna hlagau, theina hlagau le Topa zatahna hlagau a om ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Topa zatahna khu nuom a sa ding hi. Ama in a mita a mu bangin thu khen loin, a bila a zah bangin zong khensat lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in dihna tawh mizawngte’ thu khenpiehin, leitunga a nunnem mite adingin khentuom nei loin, thu a khensat ding hi. Ama in a kama ciengzawl tawh leitung sat ding a, ama’ nephu husan in migilote a that ding hi.","ref":"2Thes 2:8"},"5":{"text":"Ama in dihna kawnggahin nei ding a, a muonhuoina a taigahna-in nei ding hi.","ref":"Eph 6:14"},"6":{"text":"Keivom le tuuno omtonin, kamkei le keelno lumton ding hi; bawngno, humpi, le ganhing thaute lumtonin, naupangno khat in tuate a hawi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bawngpi le vompi in an maitonin a note zong lumton ding uhi; bawngtang bangin humpi in bukungte a ne ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gul guneite’ kuo vangah nausen nawitawp laite apmai ding a, nawitang nausente in a khut utawh gulsie’ kuo a sawh ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka muol siengthote tungah khatlekhat kiliemsah loin, zong a kisusie sih ding uhi. Azieh pen tuite in tuipi a tuommang bangin Topa theina tawh leitung kidim ding hi.","ref":"Isa 65:25; Hab 2:14"},"10":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin mite tungah Jessi’ zung khu lim khatin ding ding hi; minamte in ama sui-in ama’ opna mun a thupi ding hi.","title":"A Omlai Israel le Judah Kilekiana","ref":"Rom 15:12"},"11":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Topa in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, le tuipi gei-a gamte panin ama’ mi a kinuasie a omlaite a ngakia thei nadingin a niveina a khut a zahkia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in minamte adingin lim khat khai ding a, a kinotmang Israel-te kaikhawmin, ama in lei kiuli panin a kithezah Judah a khawmtuo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ephraim’ thangsietna peimang ta ding a, Judah a kigalbawlna teng a kisumaimang ta ding hi; Ephraim in Judah a thangsie sih ding a, Judah in Ephraim a galbawl sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle nitumna lama Philistia-te’ elzangah bawhsuhin a tuong ding vua, nisuona lama mite a bulu ton ding uhi. Edom le Moab tungah a khut uh a hla ding vua, Ammon-te in amau’ thu a mang ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in nahpi-in Egypt tuipi’ lei khu a susie ding a, Gun tungah huisa tawh khut a zah ding hi. Tua khu luidung sagi-in kikhenzahin, ama in keng tawh galkai nading lampi a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Kln 16:12"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Egypt gam pan a peito lai vua Israel adinga lamlien a op bangin, a omlai a kinuasiete adingin Assyria gam panin lam lienpi khat om ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma in khum ni ciengin tam bangin na gen ding hi: “ Topa aw, na kungah lungdam kang ko ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile kei tungah nang na lungthah vangin na lungthahna a dam zo ta a, nangma in kei nei henem hi.","title":"Lungdamkona le Phatna"},"2":{"text":"A tahtahin Pasien khu keima’ kihutdamna ahi hi; keima in ama ka muong ding a, ka zau vawt sih ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien khu ka thahatna le ka vanglietna ahi hi; ama ka kihutdamna a suoh hi.","ref":"Pei 15:2; Late 118:14"},"3":{"text":"Note in hutdamna tuikhuhte panin lungdam kipahin tui na tawi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin tam bangin na gen ding uhi: Topa tungah lungdam ko-in ama’ min lo un; minamte lahah ama’ nasepnate phuongzah un; ama’ min kitawisang hi, ci-in phuongzah un."},"5":{"text":"Ama in thupitahin a sep zo ziehin Topa tungah phatna la sa un; leitung mun zosie-ah tami thu kitheisah un."},"6":{"text":"Kumpi nam Zion aw, a gingin awng inlen, kipahin zeila awi in. Azieh pen na laikim vuah Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa thupi tahin a om hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Babylon tawh kisai-in thuphuon mu hi.","title":"Babylon Langah Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Muol gawta tungah lim khat khai unlen, amate tungah aw ngai tahin kiko un. Miliente’ kotpi-ah a lut nadingun amate khutzap un."},"3":{"text":"Kei mama in ka sienthosah mite thu ka pie zo a, ka lungthahna a suokhie dingin kihisahna tawh a kisangkoi ka galhangte ka hlan zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, mi honpi tampite husa ging banga muoltung tenga awging valuhpi khu! Ngai un, namcin’ kumpi gamte kikhawma awging valuhpi khu! Vanglien Topa in gal sim dingin galkapte a kaikhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Leitung buppi susie dingin a gamla vanmong panin Topa le a lungthahna galhiemte ang kuon uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa’ ni ang nai ta ahi ziehin mau-in kap un. Vanglienpa’ kung pan ang pei bangin suhsietna ang tung ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ziehin khut zosie thazaw sieng ding a, mi zosie’ lungtang tuisuohin,"},"8":{"text":"tuale amate a lungkie ding uhi. Natna le lunggimna in amate tukon ding hi; numei nausuoh ding bangin na a sa ding uhi. Lamdangsa-in amate khatlekhat a ki-en ding uhi; meikuong bangin amate a mit a mai uh a san ding hi."},"9":{"text":"En un, leitung gamdai suohsah ding le, a tung pan mawneite a susie dingin, a gilo, a zauhuoi lungthahna le thangpaina tawh Topa’ ni ang tung ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen vantung aasite le aasi honpite in amau’ khuovah a tangsah nawn sih ding uhi; ni ang suo ciengin miel pai ding a, hla in zong khuovah tangsah lo ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 32:7; Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Kln 6:12-13; 8:12"},"11":{"text":"A gitlona ziehin leitung ka gawt ding a, a mawna ziehun migilote ka gawt ding hi; mi kihisahte’ kiphatsahna ka tawpsah ding a, mi khansie le mi gawgamte ka niemkhieh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima in mite kham hoite sanga a cieuzaw le mihingte, Ophir khamte sanga a cieu zaw-in ka bawl ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin vante ka kilingsah ding a, Vanglien Topa a thangpai ziehin a giinhuoi a lungthah ni ciengin ama’ mun panin leitung a kithing ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A kivai sakhi ahi sihle a cing om lo tuu bangin, a unpi-un mipite lamah kihei-in a gam ciet vuah a taimang ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"A kimu mi popo tei tawh kidawtlia ding a, mi a kiman popo namsau tawh si ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amahaw’ mitmu-in a nausente uh kiguoicimsah ding hi. A innte uh kibulu-in a zite zong kibuon gawp ding hi."},"17":{"text":"En un, amate sim dingin ngun a thuse lo pa le kham tawh a lungkim lo Media-te ka hantawh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A thaltangte un tangvalte that ding hi; amate in naubu pana a pieng nausente a hepi sih ding uhi. A mit un zong nausente a khuotuo sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpi gam zosie’ vanglietna, Chaldea-te’ thupina le a kisahtheipi Babylon khu Pasien in Sodom le Gomorrah a sietsah lai hun ang bang ding hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24"},"20":{"text":"Bangma cih hunin mi teng nawn lo ding hi; khang tawntungin zong koima a teng nawn sih ding hi; khum munah Arab-te in a puonbuh uh lam lo ding a, khum munah tuucingte in a gante uh lumsah lo ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua munah gamsate lumin, amau’ inn pen a hawh ganhingte tawh kidim ding hi. Tua munah va kalaoh-te teng ding a, tua munah keel-dawite a lam ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 34:14; Zeph 2:14; Kln 18:2"},"22":{"text":"A tausangte sungah ngie-te le kumpi inn nuomte sungah si-alte ham ding hi. Gawt nading hun tungkhiel ta a, a nite kisawtsah nawn lo ding hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in Jacob tungah lainatna nei a, Israel teelkia-in a gam sung vuah amahaw a koikia ding hi; tuale gamdang mite in amate pawlin tuaci’n amate in Jacob innkuon a bel ding uhi.","title":"Judah a Ngaingai Bangkia"},"2":{"text":"Mite in amate manin a gam vuah zawpi ding a, Israel innkuon in Topa’ gam sungah minamte sila pasal le sila numei-in a nei ding uhi; amate in sala a man ngai mite salin a lemat mat ding vua, amate a bawlsie mite tungah vai a hawm ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na lungkhamna, na buoina, nasep hamsapi sepna panin Topa in note toidamna ang pieh ciengin,","title":"Babylon Kumpipa Kiehna"},"4":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa tungah tam ehneh hona kam na zang ding uhi: Mi bawlsie pa khu bangci manthai a ta e! Mi simmaw hatpa khu bangci manthai a ta e!"},"5":{"text":"Khawl loin mite satna-a kizang, lungthahna tawh minamte tungah vai a hawm, nahpitaha a bawlsie, migilote’ ciengkhut le gam uhte’ ciengkhut khu Topa in sattanpieh zo hi.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Leitung mi buppi tawlnga-in a sip dide uhi; amate in la sa-in a kiko uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na tungah taasingte a lungdam vua, Lebanon gam sunga taamtah singkungte in, “Nang ang kiniemkoi-a kipanin kote ei phua dingin koima ang pei ta sih hi,” ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Na vaitun a dawn dingin leinei-a misite a kiling uhi; nang ang dawntuo dingin leitung makai zosie’ hlimte kithosah hi; leitung kumpi a sem ngai zosie a kumpi topha ciet uh panin a thosah hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un nang hing hopi-in, “Nang zong kote ma bangin thazawm ta teh! kote ma bang ta teh!” ang ci ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Misikhuo-ah na kithupisahna le na harp lasahna awte kipeipisuh ta hi; thante na netpha ahi ta a, zangh-ehte zong khu na kihuina puon ahi ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Phalvah’ tapa Zingsol aw, vantung pan nang a bangci kieh na hiei! Minamte a niem koi pa ahi nangma, leilah dongah ang bangci kisattan dawh ahiei?"},"13":{"text":"Nang in na lungsim sungah, “Van tungah kato vang; Pasien’ aasite tungah ka kumpi topha sangkhan vang; Zaphon munsangte tung, kikhopna muol tungah kato vang;"},"14":{"text":"meiilumte dawnah kato vangin, kei le kei Sangpen Pa bangin kibawl vang,” na ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Hizongle nang pen Misikhuo, a thuh pente muna Hankhuh sung dongah ang kipeipi suh ahi ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Nang ang mute in ang encien ding vua, amate in nangma’ thu a lungngai dedu ding uhi: “Leitung a kilingsah pa, kumpi gamte a lawhthing pa,"},"17":{"text":"senel gam bangin leitung bawlin, a khuopite a lumlet pa, thongkiete inn-a a peisah lo pa khu tam pa hi lo amah?” a ci ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Minamte’ kumpi zosie a hankhuh ciet vuah thupi tahin a lum uhi;"},"19":{"text":"ahi vangin nang pen na han panin a kidahhuoi misi uite bangin ang kipaimang a, namsau in a sut pailet, Hankhuh suongte sunga a kumsuh, keng tawh kituoncil misite bangin, luonghawmte in nang ang khucip hi."},"20":{"text":"Na gam susie-in na mite that zo na hi ziehin, nang pen amate tawh ang kivuiton sih ding hi. Sietna bawlte’ a suon a hlahte’ min kilo ngai nawn sih taheh!"},"21":{"text":"A pate uh’ khielna ziehin a tate thalia nading mun bawlkhol un. Amate leitang luo dingin thosah ngai nawn sih unlen, ahi sihle khuopite in leitung maitang tuomsah sih un."},"22":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in a cina-ah, “A langkhat vuah ka pang ding a, Babylon’ min le a omlaite’ tate le suonlehlahte ka sumaimang ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale keima in sakute busah nadingin tua khuopi bawlin buoltui ka veisah ding hi; tua khu keima in suhsietna munphie tawh ka phiet sieng ding hi,” Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Vanglien Topa kiciemzo hi: Ka tupnasa bangin a pieng ding hi; tuale ka gelsa bangin a tung ding hi:","title":"Assyria Tawh Kisai Thuphuon"},"25":{"text":"Ka gam sungah Assyria-te ka susie ding a, ka muolte tungah ama ka tuoncil ding hi; amate kung panin a hahkol kisut ding a, a liengko panun a vangih uh kisut ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tami in leitung bup tawh kisai-a a kingim gelna ahi hi; tam khut pen minam zosie tunga kizah khut ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Vanglien Topa’ gelsa ahi ziehin koi in sumit zo ding ahei? Ama’ khut kizah zo ta hi, koi in dawhkia ding ahei?"},"28":{"text":"Kumpi Ahaz a si kumin tami thuphuon a tung hi:","title":"Philistia tawh Kisai Thuphuon","ref":"2Kum 16:20; 2Khg 28:27"},"29":{"text":"Philistia-te zosie aw, note ang kisatna cieng a tawn ziehin lungdam sih un, azieh pen gul gui panin gul gunei a pien bangin, a suonlehlahte a leng thei gulpi a suoh ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Mizawngte’ tacilte in an a ne ding vua, tasamte bihtahin lum hit-hiet ding uhi; na zungpi ka kielsisah ding a, a omlai nangma’ mite ka that ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Kotpi aw, kap vapo in; khuopi aw, awng vapuoh in; no Philistia-te aw, na unpi-un zau-in tuisuohmang un! Azieh pen leilu lam panin meikhu kitungto a, amate a guolguolin a tangtat koima om lo hi.","ref":"Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zeph 2:4-7; Zech 9:5-7"},"32":{"text":"Mi khatpo in minam kamtaite bangci dawn thei ding ahei? “ Topa in Zion phutkip zo a, tuale amate lahah a tasamte in ama sungah kibuhna a mu uhi,” ci-in dawng ding uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab tawh kisai thuphuon ahi hi. Zan khat sungin Ar a kisuhsiet ziehin Moab gam kisie hi; zan khat sungin Kir a kisuhsiet ziehin Moab gam kisie hi.","title":"Moab Tawh Kisai Thuphuon"},"2":{"text":"Biehinnpi-ah Dibon peito a, a kap dingin munsangte ah a kato hi; Nebo le Medeba ziehin Moab nahpi-in kap hi. Luzang zosie kimettol a, khamul zosie kimetkieu hi;"},"3":{"text":"khuopi lampite-ah la-ip puon a sil uhi; innkhum tungte le tuol-awngte ah mi zosie kapin hlitui luong hi."},"4":{"text":"Heshbon le Elealeh a kap vapo vua, Jahaz dongah a awgingte uh kiza hi; tua ahi ziehin Moab’ kawngte kiling hi; ama a citun hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka lungtangah Moab adingin ka kap hi; galtai a mite Zoar le Eglath-shelishiyah ah tai uhi. Azieh pen Luhith katona lampi-ah a kaa kawmun amate a peito uhi. Horonaim zotna lampi-ah manthaina awging tawh a kap uhi;"},"6":{"text":"Nimrim tuite kang zo hi; hampate gawta sieng a, a dawntha suong ding om nawn loin, lohing khat beh om nawn lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate in a sui a zon uh a nei a lamte ule a kholsa uh na tampite, Gielheh Lui galah a puo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Moab gam kimvelah kaana aw khat ging hi; kaa le mau in Eglaim le Beer-elim dong ban hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen Dibon luituite sisan tawh kidim a, hinanle Dibon tungah a tamzaw ka tungsah lai ding hi, Moab a suohtate ading le gam sunga a omlaite adingin keima in humpi khat ka langsah ding hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Senel gam zotna lampi Sela panin Zion tanu’ muolsang ah gam-uhte adingin tuunote puoh un."},"2":{"text":"A bu kithezahpieh vate bang le a hla zapin a leng kawikawi vate bangin, Arnon tanmunte-ah Moab’ tanute, tua bangin a om uhi."},"3":{"text":"“Thu ei kikuppi unlen, thutang tawh thu ei khenpieh un; sunkim laitahin na hlim zanlai bangsah in. A kipampaite phuol inlen, a galtaite leheh sin;"},"4":{"text":"note lahah a kipampai Moab-te tengsah in; mi susiete lah panin a kibuhna uh na hi ta in,” ci hi. Mi bawlsie pa a op nawn lo ciengin suhsietna zong veng a, gam sung pan misuomte a manthai ciengin,"},"5":{"text":"itna kip sungah kumpi topha khat kiphut ding a, thutang sui-in thuman sep ding a kinaw uhpa khat, David’ buh sunga tua topha tungah muonhuoi tahin a to ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Eite in Moab’ kiphatsahna i za zo ta hi. Kinah phatsah sam ei! A kihisahna, a kiphatsahna, a kilietsahna, a kisielnate zuoupi ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Moab kap hinlen, Moab adingin mi zosie kap uheh. Kir-hareseth khuo-a lenggagaw mohte adingin lungsie-in kap un."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Heshbon lote lah tul ta a, Sibmah lengguite zong vul sieng zo hi. Hun khat lai-in tua lengga bawhte in minam uliente na tekham ngai a, tuate in Jazer dong banin senel gamah a zamsuoh hi. Gamlapi-ah a bate zam a, tuipi kantanin a zam hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Sibmah’ lengguite adingin, Jazer-te’ kaa bangin keima ka kap hi; Heshbon le Elealeh aw, ka hlitui tawh kang tehlopsah hi. Bangzieh ahei cile na singga lah ule na anlahte tungah kikona sip zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Lei hoina lolai-ah kipahna lungnopna kilamang zo ta hi. Lengga huonte-ah la kisa nawn lo a, kikona zong a om nawn sih hi. Lengga cilna-ah koima’n lengga tui suh nawn lo a, lengga a kilaw cienga kikona aw zong a sip ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hi a, Moab adingin harp bangin ka lungtang kisat a, Kir-hares adingin zong kei mama ka kisat hi."},"12":{"text":"Moab, amama a kilah cieng, munsang tungah lung gimin a pei cieng, a mun siengtho-ah thungen dinga a pei ciengin a lawcing sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in tu masangin Moab tawh kisai-in tam thu a na gensa ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in Topa in, “A kiciel nasempa’ kum simdan banga a kisim kum thum sungin, ama’ mipite tam tamale Moab’ vanglietna in simmawna thuoh ding hi; tuale a omlaite zong a tawm sengin thanem ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Ezk 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zeph 2:8-11"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Damascus tawh kisai thuphuon ahi hi. En un, a khuopi hina panin Damascus khawl ding a, a kisie buathah lomtang a suoh ding hi.","title":"Damascus Tawh Kisai Thuphuon"},"2":{"text":"A khuopite kinuasie peisuoh ding hi; tuate ganhonte tatna mun suoh ding a, ganhonte lum hit hietin, koima in amate a zausah sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ephraim panin kulpi mangthai ding a, Damascus panin zong kumpi gam mangthai ding hi; tuale a omlai Aram-te pen Israel mite’ vanglietna bang ding uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 49:23-27; Amos 1:3-5; Zech 9:1"},"4":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Jacob’ vanglietna kiniemsah ding a, a tahsa tunga a thauna pen gawngtam ta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Anlate in ankung po lai kaikhawmin, anvuite khut tawh a at bang le, mi khat in Rephaim Kuomah buvuite a khon bang hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Olive kung a kilawthing ciengin, a bameng sangpen dawna a ga ni ahiei thum ahiei, theikung bamengte tunga li ahiei, nga ahiei a op bangin ansanghte kinuasie ding hi, Israel-te’ Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mite in amate a Bawlpa thupisimin a mit un Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa a en ding uhi;"},"8":{"text":"amate in a khut utawh a bawlsa uh maitamte thudon loin, a khutme tawh a bawlsa uh khuom siengthote hitale maitamte hitale etin zong a nei nawn sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin a khuopi muonhuoite uh pen Hiv-te le Amor-te in Israel mite’ zieha a nuasie uh munte tawh kibang ding a, tua mun gamdai a suoh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen na hundampa uh Pasien na mangngil ta vua, na kibuhna uh Suongpi na phawhkha ta sih uhi; tua ahi ziehin kung hoite suon nan locin, gamdang pasien na bieh nading vua, na suon uh ahi bo a,"},"11":{"text":"note in na suon ni ma-un tuate khangsahin, na vaw ni uh a zingmawngin tuate paasah thei nan locin, gimna le damsah thei lo natna ang tun ni-in, anlah ding teng a maimang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ah, mi tampite’ husa ging, a husa ging ukhu tuipi lien huging tawh kibang ei! Ah, mi tampite awhna khu tuihatte’ gin vapual tawh kibang ei!"},"13":{"text":"Tui tampite a hawh vapuoh bangin, minamte a hawh vapuoh vua, hinanle ama in amate phawhsie ding a, gamlapi-ah amate a taimang ding uhi. Muol tunga hui mai-a a leng ansi bang le, huipi mai-a a lengmang leivui bangin amate kidelmang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"En in, nitah ciengin zauna a om ding hi! Zingmawng masangin tuate om nawn lo hi. Tamte pen ei susiete’ tuo ding thu le, ei bulute’ tanh ding thu ahi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ethiopia gunte gal khat a, a hlazap ging ziezuo,","title":"Ethiopia tawh Kisai Thuphuon"},"2":{"text":"Nile gun tawnin tuite tungah pumpeng gunkuong tawh palaite a kisawlna gam khu gimna thuoh ding ahi hi! No kamtai tangzangte aw, a tun a sang a cizol sepsop, a nai a gamla-a kizatah, a thahat le galzo minam, a gam uh gun in a khenkhe mite kungah va pei ta un."},"3":{"text":"No leitunga teng mi zosie le leitung tunga om mi zosiete aw, muol dawnah lim khat a kikhai ciengin en un! Pengkul a kimut ciengin ngai un!"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in kei kungah tam bangci hi: Nitang sunga a lum hiuhiau bang le, anlah nisat lai-a meizun bangin, ka tenna mun panin sip dide-in ka en ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen anlah hun masang, a paa teng a pul zaw, a paa teng lengga min a suo ciengin, ama in singba heuna namkawi tawh a bameng teng attan ding a, a bazaam teng heu sieng ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua teng zosie, muol tunga vate le leitunga gamsate’ an dingin kinuasie ding hi. Tuale khuokhal lai-in vate in ne ding a, phalbi lai-in leitunga gamsate in a ne ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hun ciengin, a gam uh gunpi in a khenkhap, a thahat le galzo minam, a nai le a gamla-a a kizatah minam, a tunsang le a cizol sepsop mite kung panin Vanglien Topa’ min opna Zion muol tungah letsongte kipuoh ding hi.","ref":"Zeph 2:12"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt tawh kisai thuphuon ahi hi. En in, a gang mama meii tungah Topa a tuong a, Egypt gamah a pei hi; ama mai-ah Egypt milimte zau-in citun ding a, a sung vuah Egypt-te’ lungtang tuisuoh ding hi.","title":"Egypt Tawh Kisai Thuphuon"},"2":{"text":"Egypt-te le Egypt-te a kihau dingin ka tawh ding a, amate khatlekhat, veng khatlekhat, khuopi khatlekhat, gam khatlekhat a kisim ding uhi;"},"3":{"text":"amate sungah Egypt-te’ lungsim hawmsuoh ding a, keima in amau’ gelna ka suhsietpieh ding hi; amate in milimte le misi hlate, dawi siemte le mibum theite thu a kuppi ding uhi;"},"4":{"text":"keima in a khansie pupa khat’ khut sungah Egypt-te ka pie ding hi; amate tungah a giinhuoi kumpi khat in vai a hawm ding hi, Thunei pen pa, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Nile guntuite kanggaw ding a, guntui kangin gawta ding hi;"},"6":{"text":"luinah tui kilate namsie ding a, Egypt gama Nile gun mengte kiemin gawta ding a, pumpeng le phaipheng phungte a muot sieng ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nile lui gei le Nile luipieu-a munte pawnkieu ding a, Nile lui gei-a kitu khaici zosie gawta-in hui in taw nawn lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngabengte da-in a kap ding uhi; Nile gun sunga ngathang siete zosie kapin mau-in, tui sunga len khu ngai mite a thanem sieng ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Anthul khau a ciing nasemte lungkie-in, patpuon gante lungkham ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Puon gante zauthawngin, sumlaw-a nasem zosie da ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Zoan uliente mot citahin a maw uhi; Pharaoh’ thu kikuppi mipilte in mot thu vive a hil uhi. Bangci-in Pharaoh kungah, “Kei mipil khat ka hi a, tanglai kumpite’ a suon a hlahte khat ka hi hi,” ci thei ding na hei?"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in na mipilte uh hei-a om uh ahei? Vanglien Topa in Egypt sim dinga a gelsa thute, bang ahei ci amate in na kungah gensah inlen, kitheisah in."},"13":{"text":"Zion uliente mimaw a suoh sieng ta vua, Memphis uliente zong mite’ solin a om ta uhi; a minam ding vua innkiu suonga a kineite in Egypt a puikhiel ta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in amate sungah kituhkalna hlagau buohsuh zo hi; a luoh lahah zukham pa a hawipua bangin, amate in Egypt-te’ sepna zosie-ah khielsahin a hawisah ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt-te adingin a lutang in ahi a, a mei in ahi a, lutu ba in ahi a, pumpeng in ahi zongin, bangma a bawlpieh thei sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Egypt-te numei bangin om ding a, amate a sim dinga a khut a zah Vanglien Topa mai-ah zau-in citun ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale Judah gam pen Egypt-te’ giin khat suoh ding a, Vanglien Topa in amate sim dingin a gelna ziehin tami thu kigenna mi zosiete a zau ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Egypt gam sungah Canaan-te’ ham a zang khuopi nga in Vanglien Topa’ thu mang dingin a kiciem ding uhi. Tuate lahah khat pen Ni Khuopi kici ding hi.","title":"Egypt, Assyria, le Israel Thupha Kipie"},"19":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Egypt gam laizangah Topa adingin maitam khat, a gamgi-ah Topa adingin khuom khat om ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua pen Vanglien Topa adingin Egypt gam sungah lim le teci hi ding hi; amate a bawlsie mite ziehin Topa kungah a kiko ciengun, ama in amate kungah a hundam ding mi khat sawlin amate panpi-in hunkhie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt-te kungah Topa amama kipholah ding hi; khum ni ciengin Egypt-te in Topa ang thei ta ding a, tuale biehpiehna le meihal biehna tawh Pasien a bie ding vua, Topa tungah amate in thuciemnate bawlin, tuate a sem ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Egypt-te sat ding a, a satna damsahkia ding hi; Topa kungah amate kilekia ding a, ama in a thumna uh ngai-in a damsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Egypt gam panin Assyria gamah lamlien khat kisiel ding a, tuale Assyria-te Egypt gamah haw-in, Egypt-te zong Assyria gamah haw ding a, Egypt-te in Assyria-te tawh Pasien a bieton ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Israel-te pen Egypt-te le Assyria-te banah a thumna hi ding a, leitung zosie adingin thupha ahi ding vua,"},"25":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in, “Ka mi Egypt-te, ka khutsuoh Assyria-te, le keima’ gouluo Israel-te in thupha nga taheh,” ci-in thupha a pieh mite ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Jer 46:2-26; Ezk 29:1–32:32"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ashdod ah Assyria Kumpipa Sargon in a sawl a galkapmang lienpenpa pei a, tua khuo simin a lah kum-","title":"Isaiah in Egypt le Ethiopia Zaw nading Vaigel"},"2":{"text":"khum hun laitahin Topa in Amoz’ tapa Isaiah hopi a, “Pei in, na kawnga la-ip puon suodawh inlen na kedap sutdawh in,” a ci a, tua bang ma-in ama gamta-in guohtang le kengguoh tawh lam a pei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Ka nasempa Isaiah in Egypt-te le Ethiopia-te langkhatah lim le hilkholna lim dingin a guohtang le kengguoh tawh kum thum sung lam a pei ma bangin,"},"4":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa in Egypt-te’ maizum nadingin Egypt a kimante le saltang Ethiopia-te a vuoi a khangin, guohtang le kengguoh tawh tawbo dawhsa-in a puimang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale amate pen a kinepna uh Ethiopia le a kisahtheipi uh Egypt ziehin lungkie le lamet bei-in a om ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin tam tuipi gei-a teng mite in, ‘En un, eite’ kinepna, Assyria kumpipa kung pan ei hu ding le ei hunkhie dinga i taina uh mite tungah tam bang thu pieng tamawh ei! Tuale eite bangci suotah ding i hi ta uh ahei?’ ci ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a senel gam tawh kisai thuphuon ahi hi. Negeb gam sungah pumpei a kipei bangin, tua khu senel gam pan le a zauhuoi gam panin ang pei hi.","title":"Babylon, Edom, le Arabia Tawh Kisai Thuphuonte"},"2":{"text":"Ka kungah a zauhuoi mangmuna khat ang kigen hi; a leheh mipa in leheh a, a susie mipa in susie hi. Elam aw, kuonto in. Media aw, imtawm in; ama’ piensah khuisahna zosie ka vengsah sieng zo ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ziehin kawng natna tawh ka kidim hi; numei nausuoh nat bangin natna in ei man hi; ka zah thei lo nadingin ka kunsuh a, ka mu thei lo nadingin lungkie-in ka om hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lung vai-in zauna in ei lingsah hi; ka hlangai zan khuomiel kei adingin citutna suoh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in sabuoi pha-in, tuonga kipha puonte a pha vua, an ne tui dawnin a om uhi. Galkap mangte aw, tho unlen, lumte sathau nu un!"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in kei kungah tam bangin gen hi: “Pei-in galvil khat koi inlen, ama in a mu mite gensah in."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a kopkopin sakol tung tuongte, laa tunga tuongte, kalaoh tunga tuongte a mu ciengin limtah phatahin ama ngaisah in,” ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin galvil pa a kiko hi: “ Topa aw, tausang tungah sun tungtawnin ka ding a, ka vilna munah zan khuovah ka om hi."},"9":{"text":"En in, sakol tunga tuongte a kopkopin hing pei!” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Babylon cim ta, cim ta; a milim pasien-te zosie lei lahah kisatpua sieng ta,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Kln 14:8; 18:2"},"10":{"text":"A kicilsa, a kizapsa ka mite aw, Israel-te’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa tung panin note tunga ka zahsa thu teng keima in kang tangko hi."},"11":{"text":"Dumah tawh kisai thuphuon tam bang ahi hi. Seir panin khat in ei hlan a, tuzanin galvil pa bang a ci ei? Galvil pa, tuzan bang a ci ei?” ei ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Galvil pa in, “Zingmawng ang tung a, zan zong ang tung hi. Nang thukan ding na hi leh kan in; hing pei inlen hing kan in,” ka ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Senel zanglei tawh kisai thuphuon tam bang ahi hi. Dedan mi khuolzin honte aw, Arabia gamlahah na gieh ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tema gama teng mite aw, a dangtate tui puoh unlen, galtaite an tawh dawn un."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate, namsau, a kidawhsa namsau, a kikuoi thal le gal hanna mun pana ang tai uh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa in keima kungah tam bangin gen hi: “A kiciel nasempa khat in a sim kumte dung zui-in Kedar’ vang zosie kum khat sungin tawp ding hi;"},"17":{"text":"tuale a omlai Kedar’ galhangte zong tawp sieng ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa Israel-te’ Pasien in tam thu a genzo hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangmuna kuom tawh kisai thuphuon tami ahi hi. Note na unpi vua innkhum tunga na kato uh bang na deina uh ahei?","title":"Jerusalem a Kisiet nading Hilkholna"},"2":{"text":"kikona husa a dim, a gamlum khuopi, lungdam a kipah khuopi aw, na sunga kithatte khu namsau tawh kithat ahi sih a, gal sunga si zong ahi sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Na ulien vaihawmte zosie a taiton ta uhi; thal zah kul loin amate kiman sieng hi. Gamlapi-ah taimang nan locin ang kimu note zosie ang kiman hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in ka ci hi: “Kei ei en sih unlen, hlitui naptui luongin ei kapkap sah un; ka it ka mite sina ziehin kei henep ding hing hanciem da ta un."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa Pasien in mangmuna kuom sungah buoina le kitotcilna, kitawhnawina, kulpite suhsietna le muolte kungah panpi ding ngenin kikona ding ni khat a nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Sakol leeng le sakol tunga tuongte tawh Elam-te in thallawng a puo vua, Kir mite in a lumte uh a hawhmang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na kuom dei pente uh sakol leeng tawh kidim a, sakol tunga tuongte kul kotpite-ah a pang uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Judah’ kidalna lamang zo ta hi. Tua ni ciengin nangma in Gammang Inn sunga kikoi galhiemte na en a,"},"9":{"text":"tuale nang in David khuopi sungah mun tampitah a kisietna na mu a, tuale nang in buol nuoinung tuite na cing hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang in Jerusalem innte na sim a, a kisie kulbangte puophat nadingin innte na phel hi."},"11":{"text":"Kulpi ni kikalah buol lui-a tuikhol nadingin nangma in tuibem khat na bawl hi. Ahi vangin nang in tam a bawlpa etin zong na nei sih a, sawtpi lai-a a gelpa na thuse sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Vanglien Topa in a kap a mau ding, lu heukieu ding le la-ip puon sil dingin keima ei hlan hi;"},"13":{"text":"hinanle kipahna le guolnopna, bawngtang le tuute gawna, sa nehna le zu nehna a om zawsop a, “Zing cieng si ding i hi ziehin ne vai-in dawn vai,” na ci zawsop uhi.","ref":"1Cor 15:32"},"14":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in ka bilkawm-ah thu ang gen hi: Na si masangun tam mawna hing kimaisah het lo ding hi,” Vanglien Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Hing pei in, tam inn sung vaipuo neisa kempa Shebna kungah pei inlen ama kungah tam bangin gen in:","title":"Amau’ Noptuomna Sui Uliente Mawsahna"},"16":{"text":"Tami sungah nang dinga hankhuh a to, a sangna munah hankhuh a bawl, na op nading suong a lem mipa aw, nang in tami munah bang thu na nei a, na sanggamte koi teng ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Ka mihing pa aw, Topa in nang ang paimang gawp ding hi. Ama in nang hing pummatin zong hing tudetin,"},"18":{"text":"ang pingpei ding a, mun tanzau-ah bawlung a kise bangin ang sep ding hi; na pu’ innkuon dinga muolphona ahi nang pa aw, nang tua munah si-in, na kisahtheipi na sakollengte lahah na pua ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na nasep panin hing kisuon ding a, na dinmun panin zong hing kikaisuh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Hilkiah’ tapa, ka nasempa Eliakim ka hlan ding a,"},"21":{"text":"na puontuol ama silsahin, na kawnggah tawh ka gah ding hi. Ama’ khut sungah na thuneina ka pie ding a, tuale Jerusalem-a a tengte ading le Judah innkuonte adingin ama pen pa khat ahi ta ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in ama’ liengko-ah David innkuon’ tawhtang ka koi ding hi; ama in hong ding a, koima in khah zo lo ding hi; ama in khah ding a, koima in hong zo lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 3:7"},"23":{"text":"Keima in munkip khatah van khaina bangin ama ka khendet ding a, a pupa innkuon dingin ama pen a zatahhuoi kumpi topha hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale a pupa innkuon’ vang teng zosie ama tungah khai-in, ama’ cihlahte le a ta a naute, vanzah a neu teng zosie, haite-a kipanin thawlte dongin vankhaina-ah a kikhai bangin ama tungah kikhai ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin mundet khata kikil vankhaina in a lel ding hi; Topa’ gensa ahi ziehin ama tawngsanin kiesuh ding a, a tunga vangih kikhaite kisie ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tyre tawh kisai thuphuon. Tarshish tembawte aw, kapin mau un, azieh pen na kulpi uh kisusie zo hi. Cyprus panin ang pei lai-un amate in tam thu a za uhi.","title":"Tyre Tawh Kisai Thuphuon"},"2":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a tengte aw, sip dide un, Sidon sumbuhte aw, na kamtaite un tuipi a kantan vua,"},"3":{"text":"tuale tui hatte tungah amate a om uhi; nang dinga phiengsieh kidongte pen Shihor gama pieng ante le Nile guna an kilate ahi hi. Note pen minamte’ sum bawlna na hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Sidon aw, maizum in, azieh pen tuipi in genzo hi, tuipi kulpi in tam bangin a gen hi: “Nausuoh natna ka vei ngai sih a, nau zong ka nei ngai sih hi, tangvalte ka khoi ngai sih a, nungahte zong ka khansuo ngai sih hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gamah tami thusuoh a kizah ciengin, Tyre thusuoh tungah amate lungkham ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a teng mite aw, Tarshish kantanin kap un!"},"7":{"text":"A kipatna tangtawng pan ahi, a gamlapi-a teng dinga a keng tawh a peipi, tam khuopi khu noma’ lungdamna khuopi ma ahi amah?"},"8":{"text":"Kumpi lukhu a khusah pa, a sumbuhte ulien vive hi-in, a sumbawlte uh leitunga a kizatah vive ahi, tami Tyre khuo sim dinga a gel khu koi ahei? A sumbuh bawlte lah uliente vive hi a, a vanleite uzong lah leitunga a kipahtate a hi sih uh amah?"},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien in minthanna zieha kiphatsahna zosie tawpsah nading le leitunga a kipahtawite zosie zumsuo ding a gelzo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tarshish tembawte aw, noma’ gamah galkai un; tembaw khawlmun om nawn lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in tuipi tungah a khut zah a, kumpi gamte kilingsah hi. A kulpite a susie dingin Canaan tawh kisai-in Topa in thu a pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in tam bangin a gen hi: A kibawlsie Sidon’ tanu ngahnu siengtho aw, nang na lungdam ngai ta sih ding hi; tho inlen Cyprus-ah galkai in. Tua sung nangawnah toidamna na mu sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Chaldea-te’ gam en un! Tami namte khu Assyria-te ahi sih hi; amate in Tyre khu gamsate kuol nadinga a sesa ahi hi. Amate in khuopi buluna ding tausangte a daw vua, kumpi innte phelkhie-in a kisiet nadingin a bawl uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tarshish tembawte aw, kap vangut un, azieh pen na kulpite uh kisie zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Khum ni-a kipanin kumpipa khat’ khankum tan khat ahi kum sawmsagi sung Tyre kimangngil ding hi. Kum sawmsagi a tawp ciengin, numei pahtat khat tungtang la-a a na kitap bang teng Tyre tungah tung ding hi:"},"16":{"text":"“Nang, phawkhah lo numei pahtat nu aw, harp lasahna la inlen, khuopi sungah vah kawikawi in! Ang kiphawkia thei nadingin la ngai nono phuoh inlen, la tampi sa in."},"17":{"text":"Kum sawmsagi a cin ciengin Tyre ah Topa haw ding a, tuale ama nu in a nasep ngai semkia-in, lei tunga kumpi gam zosie lahah kizua-in a om ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa kungah ama nu’ sumbuh vante le a lawmante ki-ap ding hi; a summet ngate kikhol loin kituomkoi lo ding a, hizongle ama nu’ sumbuh vante pen Topa’ opna munah a tengte adingin kicing taha a neh ding ule puonhoite leina-a a zah ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Ezk 26:1–28:19; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:1-4; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Topa in leitung hawmsuoh sahin gamkhing suohsah ding a, lei maitang lumlet gawpin, a tunga tengte thezah ding hi.","title":"Leitungah a Sawtlo-a tung ding Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Siempute le mipite, silate le a mangpate, sila numeite le a pite, a leite le a zuate, a leitawisahte le a leibate, summet nete le leibate, kibang ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Leitung kihawmsuoh sahin kisiecip ding hi; azieh pen Topa in tam thu genzo hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung vulin gawta a, leitung thanemin vulgawp hi; vantungte le leitung a ni tuohin a thanem uhi."},"5":{"text":"A tunga teng mite in leitung niehsah uhi. azieh pen amate in thukham a sukhiel vua, ngaina kipte zui loin, tawntung thuciemna a palsat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin samsietna in leitung nawmval a, a khielna ziehun a tunga tengte a thuoh vua, tua ahi ziehin leitunga teng mite kiemsuhin themkhat beh a om tabo hi."},"7":{"text":"Lenggazu cieu mama-in lengguite vulgawp a, a lungdam mi zosie khuisa uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tawm gin ngai teng a dai ta a, kipahna awgingte sip didie-in, lyre lasahna gin ngaite a dai dide hi."},"9":{"text":"La sah kawmin lenggazu a dawn nawn sih uhi; khamthei zu dawnte zong a zu dawn uh a khalawng ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Buoina khuopi cimzan a, koima’ lut thei lo nadingin inn zosie kikhahcip hi."},"11":{"text":"Lenggazu a kitasap ziehin lamdungah mite a kiko uhi. Kipahna zosie a tawpna tung ta a, leitung lungdamna a mangthai ahi ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuopi a daidamin kinuasie a, tunkotte kisattanin kisie sieng hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen olive kung a kisat zaw cieng bang le, lengga kilo zo-in a sanghte a kinuasie bangin, leitung le minamte lahah tua bangin a tung ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in a aw uh sangsahin kipahin la a sa ding uhi; Topa’ thupina ziehin nitumna panin a kiko uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ziehin nisuona lamah Topa min phat un; tuipi gei-a a teng mite in Topa Israel-te’ Pasien’ min phat un."},"16":{"text":"Eite in leimongte panin a Midih Pa tungah minthanna om taheh, ci-a phatna la kisa i za uhi. Hinanle keima in, “Ka lunggim mama, ka lunggim mama, gimnga pa hi tang e! Mi muonhuoi lote in muonhuoi lo tahin na a sep ziehun, mi muonhuoi lote in muonhuoi lo semsemin na a sem uhi,” ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitunga teng mite aw, na tung vuah zauna, dum le thangte a om hi!"},"18":{"text":"Zauna aw za-in a tai poma dum sungah a kie ding hi; dum sung pana a kato poma thangah a awh ding hi. Azieh pen vantung tawlette kihongin, leitung bulpi kiling hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitung pawhkeh gawpin a themthem kisuo a, nasietahin kilawh hi."},"20":{"text":"Zukhamte bangin leitung hawilen a, buh bangin kivei hi; ama’ khielna a tungah om a, ama pua-in thokia nawn lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in khum ni ciengin vantunga mihonpite le leitunga kumpite dan a pie ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Dum sunga thongkie-te bangin amate kikhawmtuo ding uhi; thong sungah kot a kikhalu ding vua, ni tampi zaw ciengin amate dan kipie ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin hlapi zala ding a, ni a mai a zum ding hi; azieh pen Zion Muol tung le Jerusalem-ah Vanglien Topa maang ding a, a upate’ mai-ah a minthanna a kilangsah ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka Pasien na hi hi; nangma kang domsang ding a, na min kang phat ding hi; azieh pen nangma in na lamdangte na bawl zo a, tangtawnga na gelnate muonhuoi-in thawn ngai lo hi.","title":"Bawlsietna pan Hutkhietna Zieha Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile khuopi buathah lomtang na suo a, kulpi a nei khuopi a siesa-in na koi ta hi; gamdang mite’ kumpi inn khu khuo a bang nawn sih a, bangma cih hunin kilamkia nawn lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mi thahatte in na min ang phat ding uhi; a gawgam minamte’ khuopite in nangma ang zatah ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang pen mizawngte ading in kibuhna, amau’ lung kham hunin tasamte adingin kibuhna, khuopi hui lan cienga kidalna le nisat cienga nihlim na hi hi. Mi gawgamte’ bawlsietna pen phalbi huipi tawh kibang a,"},"5":{"text":"gamdang mite’ husa pen mun gawta-a nisa tawh kibang hi. Meiilum a kai ziehin nang in nisa na thuoh zo hi; mi gawgamte’ lasahna khu a kisipsah dide hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam muol tungah mi zosie adingin Vanglien Topa in antui pen pawi le lengga zului pawi, gungeh tawh a kidim antui pen pawi le, a kitat zuningcia pente tawh pawi a bawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale ama in tam muol tungah mi zosie tunga kikhu misi puon le minam zosie tunga a kizah puonzalte susie ding hi; ama in a tawntungin sina a valtum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa Pasien in maitang zosie panin hlituite siapieh ding a, leitung mun zosie panin a mite’ mindaina a lahmangpieh ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa in a genzo hi.","ref":"1Cor 15:54; Kln 7:17; 21:4"},"9":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin, “En un, tami eite’ Pasien ahi hi; eite ei hutdam nadingin ama i ngah uhi. Tami khu i nganga uh Topa ahi hi; a hutdamna sungah lungdamin kipah vai."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami muol tungah Topa’ khut kinga ding hi. Ehdum sungah bukung a kisiacil bangin, a opna vuah Moab-te kisiacil ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuingapte in tui ngapin a khut a zah bangun, amate in tua gam laizangah khutzah nan ule, a khut uh’ hanciemna om tama nanleh, a kiphatsahna uh kiniemkoi veve ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama’ kulpi bangsangte kikhiesuhin kiniemkoi ding a, leivui lah nangawnah kipaisuh ding hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1–16:14; Jer 48:1-47; Ezk 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zeph 2:8-11"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin Judah gamah tami la kisa ding hi: Eite in khuopi kip khat i nei uhi; kulpite le munkipte bangin ama in guolzawna phut hi.","title":"Judah’ Guolzawna La"},"2":{"text":"Upna lama a kip a dih minamte a lut thei nadingin kulpi tunkotte hong un."},"3":{"text":"Nang ang muon ziehin na tunga lungsim nga zing mite nangma in lungnopna na pie hi."},"4":{"text":"A tawntungin Topa muong un; azieh pen nangma in Topa Pasien sungah kumtawn suongpi khat na nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a sanga tengte a niemkhiehsuh hi; ama in khuopi sangpi a niemkhiehsuh hi. Ama in tuolah khiesuh a, leivui lahah paimang hi."},"6":{"text":"Mizawngte’ keng le tasamte ketot in tua khuopi a tuoncil uhi."},"7":{"text":"Midihte’ lampi a zang dide hi; Midih Pa aw, nang in midihte’ lampi na nelsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, na thukhenna lampi-ah nangma kang ngah uhi; ka hlagau’ lunggul khu ahile na min le na minthanna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Zanin ka lungsim in nangma ang hlagul a, ka sunga om ka hlagau in lawptahin nangma ang sui hi. Bangzieh ahei cile nangma in leitungah thu na khen ciengin leitunga a teng mite in thudih kici a mu thei uhi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote tungah angvanna a kilah leh, amate in dihna a theithei sih uhi; thuman mite’ gam sungah a lelamin amate a gamta vua, Topa’ thupina a mu sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, na khut kilamto a, hizongle amate in a mu sih uhi. Na mite dinga na deiluotna amate musahin maizumsah inlen, ang langpangte mei in katumsah in.","ref":"Heb 10:27"},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma in ko adingin kilemna nei bawlpieh ding hi, azieh pen kote sepna zosie nangma ei seppieh ahi bo hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa kohaw’ Pasien aw, nang ahi lo topa dangte in ko tungah thu ang vaihawm vua, ahi vangin kote in nangma’ min beh ka pom uhi."},"14":{"text":"Misite hing nawn lo hi; a hlimte zong tho hi, azieh pen amate dan pie-in na susie zo ta a, amate kiphawkhahna zosie na phietmang ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nang in minamte na pungsah zo hi; nangma patawi-in na om ta hi; nangma in gam sunga gamgi zosie keima nei golkehpieh zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, amate in lungkham hunin nang ang sui vua, nangma in amate na gawt ciengin thungetna sungin ang tau uhi."},"17":{"text":"Numei naupai khat a suo kuon ciengin na sa-in kipeh a, a awh vapuoh bangin, Topa aw, nangma ziehin kote zong tua bang ka hi uhi;"},"18":{"text":"kote nau pai-in na sa-in ka kipehpeh vua, hizongle hui beh nau-in ka suoh uhi. Kote in leitungah guolzawna ka nga sih vua, leitunga a teng dingin zong koima a suoh sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Na misite uh hingin amau’ luonghawm a tho ding hi. Leivui lahah a tengte aw, khangloin kipahna la sa un! Azieh pen na daitui uh pen a vam lihleh daitui ahi a, leitung in sawtpi lai-a a sisate hingsah kia ding hi.","ref":"Dan 12:2"},"20":{"text":"Ka mite aw, hing pei-in na innkhan sungah lut unlen, kot kikhalu un; lungthahna a ven masangin bakhat sung kiphuol phot un."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amau’ khielna ziehin leitunga tengte dan a pie dingin, a opna panin Topa ang kuon hi; leitung in a tunga sisan a luongsahte pholah ding a, a thasa mite zong selcip nawn lo ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khumi ni ciengin Topa in a hiem mama, a gol mama le a hat mama namsau tawh, Leviathan gulpi tailai le a kikuolviel gulpi dan pie ding a, tuale ama in tuipi sunga om gulhiempi that ding hi.","title":"Israel’ Kitatkhietna","ref":"Job 41:1; Late 74:14; 104:26"},"2":{"text":"Khumi ni ciengin: A deihuoi lengga lo thu la-in sa un!"},"3":{"text":"Keima, Topa khu tua lo a cing pa ka hi hi; keima in a hun hunin tui ka buoh hi. Koima in a suhsiet lo nadingin sun le zanin ka ngai zing hi;"},"4":{"text":"Keima in lungthahna ka nei sih hi. Tua sungah ling le khaute a op leh a sattan dingin ka kuon ding hi. Keima in ka haltum ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi sihle a kidal nadingun kei ei pom uh hinlen, keima tawh kilemna bawl uheh, keima tawh kilemna bawl uheh."},"6":{"text":"Ang tung ding hunah Jacob ang zung hla ding a, Israel zong dawn suongin ang pallun ding a, a ga in leitung zosie ang dim ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in ama a satte a satkia bangin ama in amate a sat sam amah? Ahi sihle amate a thatte a kitha bangin amate zong a kithat sam amah?"},"8":{"text":"Hawlkhietna, sal tansahna tawh, nang in amate do ding na hanciem hi; nisuona huipi a lan ni ciengin ama in hui hat tawh amate a tawmang hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ziehin tam tawh Jacob’ khielna kimaisah ding a, tuale tam pen a mawna kilahmangna ga bukim hi ding hi: Ama in suong tawh a kibawl maitam suongte suongkang kisatvui a bahsah ciengin, khuom siengthote, ahi sihle gimnamtui maitamte a dinglai om nawn lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen kul tawh ki-im khuopi a guohtangin a om ta a, a kitaisan le a kinuasie mite’ tenna gamlah a bang ta hi; khumnah bawngnote gamta-in lum a, khumnah amate in singbate a kheuh uhi."},"11":{"text":"A bate a gaw ciengin, tuate a tawngsan sieng hi; numeite pei-in mei-a taw dingin sing a tom uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tam mite pen theitelna nei lo mite ahi uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate a bawl pa in a tung vuah lainatna nei lo ding a, amate a siempa in amate angvan lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel mite aw, tua ni ciengin Topa in Euphrates tuilam panin Egypt Lui dongin note ang zoi ding a, tuale ama in khat khatin ang kaikhawm ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin pengkul golpi khat kimut ding a, Assyria gama a mangthaite le Egypt gama a kinotmang mite pei-in Jerusalem muol siengtho tungah Topa a bie ding uhi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim-a zukhamte’ kisahtheipi paakuol le antui ne-in a gil buol le zu in a zawgawpte’ lutunga kikhusah ahi a vul thei, a vanglien, le a etlawm paape in gimna a thuoh ding hi!","title":"A Kisie Gam-uhte, Siempute, le Kamsangte’ tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"En un, Topa in a vanglien a thahat pa khat nei hi; huipi gielpi le a mutsie thei huipi bang le, a thahat huipi le a let valuh tuikhang bangin, ama in a khut tawh lei lahah amate a sawnpua ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Keng tawh kituoncil ding pen khu Ephraim zukhamte’ kisahtheipi paakuol hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Antui ne-in a gil buol mite’ lutunga kikhusah a vanglien a etlawm, le a vulthei paape pen khallai masanga a min masapen theiga tawh kibang ding a, khatpo in a mu behin loin, a nehtum pai tawh kibang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuami ni ciengin Vanglien Topa pen a vanglien paakuol hi ding a, a omlai ama’ mite adingin a etlawm kumpi lukhu hi ding hi;"},"6":{"text":"thukhenna-a a to mite tungah thutang lungsim guon ding a, kulpi tunkotah gal a notdawhte dingin thahatna hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tam mite zong zu khamin a kilialawm vua, khamtheizu tawh a hawipua valuoi uhi; siempute le kamsangte zong khamtheizu tawh a kilawmlia uhi, tuale zu khamin amate a amtawng vua, khamtheizu tawh amate hawipua valuoi uhi; amate in a man lo mangmuna a mu vua, a thukhen dingte in zong thu a khen thei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Sabuoi tung zosie luoh tawh kidim a, mun siengtho kici zong a om ta sih hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ama in koi pen khu theina hil ding a, koi tungah thu hilcien ding ahei? Kang sung pana a kiladawh, nawi tawh a kikhente tungah amah?"},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thukham tungah thukham, thukham tungah thukham, a guol tungah a guol, a guol tungah a guol, tanah halkhat, khunah halkhat,” ei ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"A mantahin, ama in a telha mama kamham le namdangte’ ham tawh tam mite hopi ding a,"},"12":{"text":"ama in a kung vuah, “Tam pen tawlngahna ahi hi; a gimte tawlngasah un; tami lungnopna ahi hi,” ci hi; hizongle amate in a ngai sih uhi.","ref":"1Cor 14:21"},"13":{"text":"Tua ziehin amate pei-in a thalpua nading ule amate liemin thangah awh a, sala a kikai nadingun, amate tungah Topa kammal, “Thukham tungah thukham, thukham tungah thukham, a guol tungah a guol, a guol tungah a guol, tanah halkhat, khunah halkhat,” ci danin a suoh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin no mi simmawte aw, Jerusalem-a tam mite tunga a uhte aw, Topa’ thu za un."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen note in, “Sina tawh thuciem khat i bawl zo ta vua, Misikhuo tawh thukimna khat i nei zo ta uhi; sietna tuihuol in ei nawkhah ciengin ei ban loding hi; azieh pen eite in i bel dingin zuouthu i bawl vua, zuouna le nalna sungah i kibu uhi,” na ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi, “En un, keima in Zion ah a kize-etsa innbul suong, innbul suong kiptah le a manpha innkiu suong khat ka phut hi: “Ama a muong mi poma a zau sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 118:22-23; Rom 9:33; 10:11; 1Pet 2:6"},"17":{"text":"Tuale keima in thutang pen tena pikhau le thudih pen tena suongkhai bangin ka bawl ding hi; gielpi in zuou kibuhna sempal ding a, tuite in tua kibuhna a hlummang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin sina tawh kibawl na thuciemna uh kiphel ding a, Misikhuo tawh na bawl uh thukimna uh kip lo ding hi; sietna tuihuol in ang nawh ciengin tua in note ang dengguoi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Note ang nawh khah sielin ang ban ding hi; azieh pen zingmawng khat zaw zingmawng khat, a sun a zanin note ang nawh kha ding hi; tuale thupieng puoh theina in patauna bihbeh hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keng hluon nadingin lupna tom luo a, kihui nadingin zong puonzal neu seng luo hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama’ silbawl-a lamdang a silbawl! ama’ nasep-a tuompien a nasep! a sem dingin, Perazim Muol tunga a sep bangin Topa kuonto ding a, Gibeon kuom-a a thangpai bangin ang thangpai ding hi.","ref":"Josh 10:10-12; 2Sam 5:20; 1Khg 14:11"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in mi simmaw sih un, tua ahi sihle note ang kikhina a khauzaw-in ang kibawl ding hi; azieh pen gam buppi tunga om Vanglien Topa Pasien kung panin kisiet nading thukhenna ka za zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ngai unlen, ka aw za un; limtah ngai unlen ka thugen za un."},"24":{"text":"Lokai pa in khaici the nadingin lo a kaikai amah?
