Amate in lei kalhin lo gitgit uh amah?"},"25":{"text":"Amate in lei a zeltam zaw uh ciengin, lengmusel tang vaw-in cummin tang a tu vua, mangbute a guolguolin suonin, a op nading munah mangbuham a tu uhi, tua mangbuhamte a geizui-ah tu uh hi lo amah?"},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen amate kilim hil mama hi; a Pasien un amate hil hi."},"27":{"text":"Lengmuselte khetbuh tawh a kisat sih a, cummin tangte tungah sakol lengpei kihuol lo hi; hinanle lengmusel pen ciengkang tawh kisat a, cummin pen moltum tawh kisat hi."},"28":{"text":"Moh bawl nadingin antang kisuguoi a, ahi vangin mite in a cil zing sih uhi; tua tungah mi khat in sakol lengkang le sakol a hawl vangin a guoicim sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami zong Vanglien Topa kung pana ang pei ahi hi; thu kuppina lamah ama lamdang a, pilna lamah guol tungtuong hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ah, Ariel, David’ phuolsatna khuopi Ariel in gimna thuoh ding hi! A kumkumin belap unlen, pawite bantai sah un.","title":"Jerusalem a Kikui-imna"},"2":{"text":"Hinanle Keima in Ariel lunggimsahin, tua munah kaana le mauna om ding a, Keima adingin Jerusalem khu Ariel tawh a kibang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in David bangin kang do nadingin giephuol ka sat ding hi; keima in tausangte tawh kang im ding a, nang do nadingin kanh ka to ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin leithuh sung panin nangma in thu na gen ding a, leivui lah a ngiemna panin na thugente pusuoh ding hi. Sihla khat’ aw bangin lei panin nangma’ aw a pusuoh ding a, leivui lah panin na thugen ang dap ham ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin na gal honpite leivui nel a bang ding vua, a khansie mihonpite zong ansi leng bang ding uhi. Bakhat sung thakhatthu-in,"},"6":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien in vanto, zilling le a ging vapuoh, pumpei le huipi le, mi a halvam thei meikuong tawh dan a pie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ariel sim dingin gam zosie panin mihonpite, a khuopi le ama’ mun muonhuoi a sim zosie le a lungkhamsah zosie pen mangmatna le zan lai-a mangmuna tawh kibang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A gilkiel mipa in a mang ah an ne-in, a khahlaw ciengin gilkiel veve a, a mangah a dangta mipa in tui dawn a, a dangta pha tuom loin, basamin a khahlaw ma bangin, Zion Muol a sim minam honpi zosie zong tua bang ahi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"No le no ki-amtum sah unlen, a amtumsa-in om un. No le no kimittaw sah unlen, a mittaw-in om un! Zu dawn lopi-in zukham unlen, zucia dawn lopi-in hawilen un!"},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in note tungah kimut duna hlagau a buosuh a, ama in no kamsangte’ mit ang sinpieh a, ama in no thumute’ lutang ang khumangpieh ta hi.","ref":"Rom 11:8"},"11":{"text":"Note adingin tam teng zosie pen mangmuna sunga a kizielcip laibu sunga thu om tawh kibang ahi hi. Lai a sim theite kungah, “Tami lai sim un,” ci-a a kipieh ciengin amate in, “A kizielcip ziehin ka sim thei sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuale lai a sim thei lote kungah, “Tami lai sim un,” ci-a a kipieh ciengin amate in, “Ka sim thei sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in a gen hi: “Tam mite in a kam utawh keima kung ei nai vua, a nephu beh utawh keima ei patawi uhi, hizongle a lungtang uh pen keima tawh a kigamla hi. Keima ei biehna uzong mihing’ thupieh a zuina uh ahi lel bo hi;","ref":"Rom 11:8"},"14":{"text":"tuaci’n keima in tam mite tawh a lamdang nate le a cizathuoi le a lamdang nate ka bawlkia ding hi. A mipilte uh’ pilna kisie ding a, thu khinkhai theite’ thu khinkhaina kiselcip ding hi.","ref":"1Cor 1:19"},"15":{"text":"Topa thei lo dinga gelna thuhpi a selcip, khuomiel sunga a gamta, “Koi ahei ei mu ding? Koi ahiei ei thei ding?” a ci note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi!"},"16":{"text":"Note in nate lumlet sieng ta uteh! Belkheng pa khu tungman bangin a kingaisun ding amah? A kibawlsa na in a bawlpa kungah, “Ama in ei bawl sih,” ci-in, ahi sihle a kisiemsa na in a siempa kungah, “Ama in theitelna nei sih,” a ci ding amah?","ref":"Isa 45:9"},"17":{"text":"Lebanon muol pen leihoi mun suohsahin, leihoi mun gampalah a suo nading bakhat sung beh hi lo amah?","title":"Mailam Kinepna"},"18":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin bilbingte in laibu kiziel sunga thute a za ding vua, lungzinna le khuomiel sung panin mittawte’ mit in khuo mu ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mi neilutte in Topa sungah a tha lungdam kipahna nga ding a, a tasam pente in zong Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa sungah lungdamin a kipah ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi khansiete mangthai ding a, mi simmawte, sietna bawl ding a ngahlate om nawn lo ding hi;"},"21":{"text":"thukhenna zuma mi thu lelsah, khuopi tutkota thukhenpa a thangsie, thu omlo pi-a midihpa tungah a tanga thu khen nuom lote, kisumang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ziehin Abraham a hunpa Topa in Jacob’ innkuon tawh kisai tam bangin a gen hi: “Jacob maizum nawn loin a mai zong kangdang nawn lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate lahah ka khutsuoh ahi a tate a mu ciengun ka min a siengthosah ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hlagau lama a khiel mite in theitelna a nei ding vua, a phunsie mite in thuhilna a sang ding uhi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ledo tate in gimna a thuoh ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Amate in keima-a’ hi lopi-in gelna a nei vua, amate in keima’ deina om lopi-in kipawlna bawlin mawna bawl bebe uhi;","title":"Egypt Muonna a Guohsuona"},"2":{"text":"amate in thu ei kuppi lopi-in, Egypt ah a peisuh vua, Pharaoh’ humbihna sung belin, Egypt hlim nei-ah buhna a sui uhi;"},"3":{"text":"tua ziehin Pharaoh’ humbihna pen na maizumna uh hi ding a, Egypt’ liena sunga na buhna uh pen na maidaina uh hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ama’ uliente Zoan khuo-ah a om vua, ama’ palaite in Hanes khuo a vaphah vangun,"},"5":{"text":"amate a phatuomsah zo lo mite tungtawnin, mi zosie tungah maizumna tung a, huna le phattuomna ahi lo maizumna le zakona a nga ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Negeb ganhingte tawh kisai thu phuon. Amate in humpi a nu le a hawh humpi a pa, muoltan le gulpi lengtheite a opna, buoina le lungkhamna nawhin, a haunate uh laa tungah, a goute uh kalaoh tungah puo-in, amate phattuomna a pie thei lo mite tungah a puoh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt’ panpina pen bangma man lo a hawmpi ahi a, tua ahi ziehin ama, “Pia loin a to hit hiet Rahab,” ci-in a min ka phuoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in pei-in ang tung ding hunte-ah khantawn teci dingin a mai vua suongpeh tungah giel inlen, laibu khat sungah khum in.","title":"A Ledo Mite"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen amate a ledo mite, upna a nei lo mite, Topa’ thuhilna a ngai nuom lote ahi uhi;"},"10":{"text":"amate in thumute kungah, “Mu sih un,” a ci uhi; kamsangte kungah, “Thuphuon a man ei gen sih un; thunuom lam le kisolna mangmuna po ei genzaw un,"},"11":{"text":"lampi nuasie unlen, lamzin panin piel un. Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa’ thu ei zasah nawn sih un,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ziehin Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa in a gen hi: Azieh pen note in tam thu na nuol vua, bawlsietna le kisolna suongin tuate na muong uhi;"},"13":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin tami mawna pen note adingin a kihiel kulsangpi khat lawtkhe-in a cim dihtah, thakhat thu-a a kiesuh ding tawh kibang ding hi;"},"14":{"text":"tua a cipna pen a kitawkeh beelkheng pa’ beel tawh kibang ding a, nahpi tahin a kisuhguoi ziehin a themnengte lahah meikhuh-a mei lah nading hile, tuikhuh sunga tui saw nading hile, a themkeh khat zong a kimu lo tawh kibang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa, Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Note kinuale-in tawlngahna tawh hutdamna na nga ding uhi; sip dide-a opna le muonna khu na thahatna uh ahi ding hi. Ahi vangin note na nuom sih vua,"},"16":{"text":"“Hilo e! sakol tung tuongin i tai ding hi,” na ci vua, tua ahi ziehin na taimang ding uhi! Tuale, “Sakol taihatte tungah i tuong ding hi,” na ci vua, tua ahi ziehin no ang delte in mallang tahin ang nuadel ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Muolvuma dielkhuom kiphut le muol tunga lim kikhai bangin, ang kinuasie masangin mi khat’ galgihna tawh mi tulkhat tai ding a, mi nga’ galgihna tawh note na gamtai ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ziehin keima in note hing hepi nuomin Topa in note ang ngah hi; tua ahi ziehin note tungah hepina a lah dingin a dingto ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa pen a thutang Pasien ahi hi; ama a ngah mi zosie thupha nga ahi uhi.","title":"Zion Tunga Pasien’ Kamciem"},"19":{"text":"Aman tahin, Jerusalem-a teng Zion mite aw, note na kap nawn sih ding uhi. Na kaana aw ziehun ama in note ang hepi tahtah ding hi; ama in a zah ciengin note ang dawng ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in note tungah hahsatna an le gentheina tui hing pie nanle na Siepa uh kiphuol nawn lo ding a, na mit un na Siepa uh a mu ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ziet lama na kihei cieng uh hile, vei lama na kihei cieng uh hile, na nua panin na bil un, “Tami lampi ahi hi, tami zui un,” a ci a za ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin note in ngun tawh a kizut na milimte ule kham tawh a kizem na milim sunte uh na buasah ding uhi. Tua teng pen a nieh puonsiete bangin kithezah ding hi; note in amate kungah, “Peimang dawh un,” na ci ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in lei-a na tu uh khaici adingin guo ang zusah ding a, lei-a pieng ante zong hoi-in pung ding hi. Khum ni ciengin na ganhingte un ganhing hlana mun zapi-ah lopa a mai ding uhi;"},"24":{"text":"lokai bawngtangte le laate in kawbia le kangkui tawh a kisawhalsa lopa hing a ne ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mi tampi a kitha ni, galvilna tausangte a cip ni ciengin, muol sang cinteng tung le muoltang cinteng tungah luitui a luong ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tham loin, Topa in a mite’ liemnate tuompieh a, a satna liemmate a damsah ni ciengin, hlatang pen nitang bang ding a, nitang pen ni sagi sunga tangza bangin a za sagi-in tang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"En un, a gamla panin Topa’ min ang pei hi. Ama’ lungthahna mei kuong a, tua meikhu kitung valuh hi; a kamte uh lunghanna tawh kidim a, a leite uh mi val thei meikuong tawh kibang hi;","title":"Assyria Tunga Thukhenna"},"28":{"text":"ama pen husan ngawng cieng a pha luitui let tawh kibang hi. ama in lawpi tawh minamte’ kisietna zoih a, mite’ khagu tungah amate lam a pielsah thei kamkai a vaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Note in pawi siengtho kikham ni zan-a bangin la sa-in theile na tum ding uhi; tuale Israel-te’ Suongpi, Topa’ muol lamah a kuonkhiete bangin na lungdam ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale Topa in sinsona le mi a kavam thei meikuong sung panin vanging, huipi, le gielpi tawh, a minthanna aw kizasah ding a, a khut a vihsuhna zong kimusah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in a ciengkhut tawh a sat ciengin Topa’ awging ziehin Assyria-te zau mama ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuale Topa in ama tunga a tuhsah moltum tawh a satna zosie tawmneute le lyre gingte tawh kibang ding hi; ama in a khut vihin amate a do ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Azieh pen hun sawtpi lai panin mei tawh a kihal nading mun khat bawlsa-in om zo hi; a tahtahin tua pen kumpipa dinga a baisa-a kibawl hi a, a kihalna zong thuhpitah le a kam a golin kibawl a, mei le sing zong kicing tahin om hi; kat tui luong bangin Topa’ husa in tua mei a tawkuong hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Huna ngen dinga Egypt ah a peisuhte, sakolte suong a, sakol leeng a tam zieh le sakol tunga tuongte a hat ziehun tuate muongin, Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa a suong lo, Topa thu a dong lote in gimna a thuoh ding uhi!","title":"Egypt tawh Kipawlna Kimanna Nei Lo"},"2":{"text":"Hinanle ama pilin gimna a tungsah hi; a gensa thute dawhkia loin, sietna a bawl innkuonte le khielna a bawl mite a panpite a do dingin amau’ langkhatah ama a ding ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt-te mihing ahi bo a, Pasien ahi sih uhi; a sakolte uh zong tahsa ahi a, hlagau ahi sih hi. Topa in a khut a zah ciengin a panpi pa kipalpua-in a kihu pa zong pua ding a, amate zosie a siton ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in keima kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Humpi ahi sihle humpi khanglai in a sa neh ding a ngih lai tahin, humpi a sim dingin tuucing honkhat a kihlat ciengin, amau’ kikona ziehin zau tuom loin amau’ husa a awlmaw lo bangin, Vanglien Topa zong Zion Muol le muoltangte tungah gal sim dingin a kuonsuh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A bu tunga a leng vate bangin, Vanglien Topa in Jerusalem a humbih ding hi; ama in humbihin hlakhie ding a, zong hinkhawi-in hunkhie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel mite aw, note in nahpi taha na leheh pa uh kungah kilekia un."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile khum ni ciengin, note in noma dinga na khut vua na bawlsa uh, note ang mawsah na ngun milimte ule na kham milimte uh na paimang ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua ciengin mihing’ namsau ahi lo, namsau khat tawh a Assyria-te pua ding uhi; tuale mihing’ namsau ahi lo namsau khat in amate a valtum ding hi; namsau panin ama taimang ding a, tuale a tangvalte thona-aana kisemsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A zau ziehin suongpi mangthai ding a, a uliente zong a zau ziehun a dielkhai a taisan ding uhi,” a meikuong Zion-a om, tuale a meikhuh Jerusalem-a om Topa in ci hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, dihna tawh kumpi khat maang ding a, tuale uliente in zong thutang tawh uh ding uhi.","title":"A Thutang Kumpi ding Kigenkhol"},"2":{"text":"Amate pen huipi pana kibuhna le khuopi hui pana kiselna ahi ding vua, amate pen gam gawta muna a luong luitui a bang ding vua, a tul gam sunga a om suongpi’ hlim bang ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuo mu thei mite’ mit kisiing lo ding a, khuoza theite’ bil in thu a ngai ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"A thoptat mite’ lungsim in thu a khinkhai thei ding vua, ham-awhte ahi uleh baitah le kicien tahin a ham ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mimawte mi thupi kici nawn lo ding a, migilote mi zatah huoi kici nawn lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien zatah lona a kisin ding le Topa tawh kisai khielna thu a gen ding, a gilkielte’ an duna pha nai lopi-a a kinuasie nading le, a dangtate in dawn ding tui a nei lo nadingin, amate in mimawte in motna thu a gen vua, a lungsim un khielna bawl ding sawm uhi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote’ gitlona a siehuoi mama hi; zuouna kam tawh mizawngte suhsiet nading le mi tasamte in thuman a gen cieng nangawnun a siesah dingin amate in sil hoi lo bawl a sawm uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle mi thupite in na thupite a gel vua, tua na thupite-ah amate a dingkip uhi."},"9":{"text":"No nuomtaha om numeite aw, tho unlen, ka aw za un; noma’ tumtaha a lungkim tanute aw, ka thugen ngai un.","title":"A Nuom Op Numeite’ Tunga Gimna Tun ding Genkholna"},"10":{"text":"Noma’ tumtaha a lungkim numeite aw, kum khat a val zep zaw ciengin na citun ding uhi; azieh pen lengga ang ga lo ding a, singga law hun ang tung lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"No nuom taha a om numeite aw, ci tun un, noma’ tumtaha a lungkim numeite aw, linglawng un; na puon uh sutin guohtangin om unlen, na kawng vuah la-ip puon teng un."},"12":{"text":"A deihuoi lote le lenggui ga hoite ziehin na awm uh beng un,"},"13":{"text":"azieh pen ka mite’ leitangah ling le khaute po sieng zo hi; hi hi, kipahna khuopi le lungdamna inn zosie dim siengzo hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen kumpi inn kinuasie-in, mi tampi tenna khuopi kilawi ding hi; muol le galvilna tausangte lei kawhawm suoh den ding a, gam-laate gamtatna le tuuhonte an maina mun suoh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A sangna panin eite tungah hlagau ang kibuoh masang, senel gam, logam hoi a suo masang le logam hoite gammang banga a kiciemte masangin tua bangin a om ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin gammang lahah thutang a om ding a, leihoi lote-ah thumanna a om ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Dihna ziehin nopna om ding a, dihna ziehin daina le muonna om den ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Kilem taha tenna mun, hlamuong taha opna mun le, dai taha khawlna munah ka mite a teng ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Gammang tulah mangthai kiukeu ding a, lei-ah khuopi lien matcipsuh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Luipang cinteng ah khaici vaw-in bawngtangte le laate a nop nopna-a a tasah note pen mi nuomsa na hi uhi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ang kisusie nai lo, mi a susie pa aw; koima’ lebawl ngai nai lo, mi lebawl pa aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Suhsiet ding na khawl ciengin nangma ang kisusie ding hi; tuale na lebawl nawn lo ciengin nang ang kilebawl ding hi.","title":"Galte Khut Pana Hutkhiet nading Kamsanna"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, kote ei hepi in; nang kang lamen uhi. Zingmawng sielin ka baantha-un hing pang inlen, ka lungkham hun ciengun ka kihutdamna uh hing hi ta’n."},"3":{"text":"Mihonpi husa ziehin mite taimang hi; na thupina mai-ah minamte kithezah hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungpuh in na a khop bangin galvanlahte kikhawm hi; kauphenote a kitom bangin a tungah amate a kitom uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa kitawisang a, a sangna munah ama a teng hi; ama in thutang le thudih tawh Zion kidimsah hi;"},"6":{"text":"na khan sungin ama khu dinkipna, hutdamna, pilna le theina hi ding a, Topa giinna khu Zion’ gou ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngai un! lamdungah galhangte a kiko uhi; kilemna palai semte nahpi tahin a kap uhi."},"8":{"text":"Lam lienpite zui loin om a, khuolzinte zin nawn lo hi. Thukimnate kisusie-in, kiciemnate kithusim lo a, mawpuohnate zong khawh kisa ta lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamsung zong kapin a thanem hi; Lebanon buoi-in a vulgawp hi; Sharon, senel gam tawh kibang hi; Bashan le Carmel muol in a singte a thing dawh uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tu-in ka ding ding hi,” Topa in ci hi, “Tu-in kei le kei ka kidomsang ding hi; tu-in kei le kei ka kitawisang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ansi nau-in na paai vua, butu nau-in na suoh uhi; na husan uh pen no ang katum ding mei ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mite pen suongkang kihalvam le lingkung kisattan mei-a kihaltum bang hi ding hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"No gamlapi-a om mite aw, ka silbawlte za un; no a nai-a omte aw, ka hatna ei theipi un."},"14":{"text":"Zion ah mawneite a zau uhi; Pasien thei lote a citun uhi: “Eite lahah koi ahiei, ei katum thei mei tawh a tengton zo ding? Eite lahah koi ahiei, kumtawn meikuong tawh a tengton zo zing ding?” a ci uhi. Eite lahah koi ahiei, kumtawn meikuong tawh a teng zing zo ding?” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Dihtah le mantaha kalsuon, le thu a gen, bawlsietna tawh a kinga vante te thusim loin, guhgol sang nuom lo a, a khut a thing vazawh mite, sisansuona thu za nuom loin a bil a humte le, gitlona en nuom loin a mit a siingte,"},"16":{"text":"a sangna-ah a teng ding uhi; a kibuhna uh pen suong kulpite hi ding hi; a neh ding uh an kisih ding a, a dawn ding uh tui kitasam lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na mit un kumpipa’ hoina na mu ding uhi; zaipi taha kipha gam zong na gal-et ding uhi.","title":"A Thupi Kumpi Gam"},"18":{"text":"Na lungsim un patauna thu a ngaisun ding hi: “Mi phaza a simpa hei-ah om ahei? Sieh kikhonte a te mipa hei-ah om ahei? galvilna tausang a sim pa hei-ah om ahei? na ci ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Note in a ham na theithei lo uh, a kitel lo kamham a zang, na thei lo uh kam a ham bielbuol mi kihisahte na mu nawn sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"I pawi bawlna uh khuopi Zion en vawi un! Daitaha a tenna mun, puonbuh a kikhin lona, a khetphimte a kidaw ngai nawn lona, a kaina khauhuol a kitan lona, Jerusalem khuopi khu na mit un a mu ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanle tuatah ah vanglien Topa’ thupina khu eihaw-a’ hi ding a, gun golpite le luitate luonna mun ahi ding hi. Tua tuite tungah ei do gal gunkuong kihot nawn loin, gal tembawte zong a pei thei sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen eite thu ei khen pa Topa ahi a, eite uhpa zong hi hi. Topa pen eite’ kumpipa ahi hi; ama in eite ei hundam ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tembaw khina khaute kol hi; tua in gunkuong puon khuom tukip zo lo a, gunkuong puon kizah thei lo hi. Tua ciengin neh ding le gal vanlah tampite kihawm ding hi; khelbaite nangawn in van a nga ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua khuo sunga tengte in, “Kei ka ci na,” a ci sih ding uhi; tua sunga teng mite’ khielna kimaisah ding hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minamte aw, thu za dingin ei nai un; no mite aw, ngai un! Leitung le a sunga om zosie, lei pumpi le a sunga pieng zosie in za ta uheh!","title":"Minamte Tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen minam zosie langkhatah Topa lungthah a, a mihonpite’ langkhatah ama a lung a hang hi; ama in a mangthai dingin amate koi-in, amate tha dingin a pie zo ta hi."},"3":{"text":"A kithat a mite uh kipaimang ding a, a siluongte zong uito valuh ding hi; muoltungte ah amau’ sisan a luong ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantunga om zosie muotmang ding a, laiziel bangin vantungte kiziel ding hi. Lenggui tunga a nate a vul bang le theikung tunga a ga a vul bangin, vantung na zosie vul ding hi.","ref":"Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:25; Luk 21:26; Kln 6:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Ka namsau in vantungte ah a khamtahin a dawn zo a, en un, Edom-te tung le suhmang dinga ka sesa mite tungah thukhen dingin ang kumsuh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in namsau khat nei hi; tua khu sisan kinoinat hi a, tuuno si le kel si, tuutangte’ a kal thau tawh kizutzol hi. Azieh pen Topa in Bozrah ah biehpiehna khat nei a, Edom gam sungah kithana lienpi om hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate tawh gam bawngtangte puaton ding a, bawngtangno gesate le bawngtang hatte a puaton ding uhi. A gamsung uh sisan tawh kipawi-in sathau in a leitang uh a zolsah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in phulah nading ni khat, Zion’ vai-ah a dihna a pholah nading kum khat nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Edom lui tuite tanai suoh ding a, ama’ leitang kat a suoh ding hi; a gam uzong a kuong vapuoh tanai a suoh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua pen sun le zanin mit lo ding a, a khu kato zing ding hi. Khang khat pan khang khat, tenna giena-in kinei nawn lo ding hi; kumtawnin koima in nawh ngai nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 14:11; 19:3"},"11":{"text":"Hinanle mupi le saku in tua gam a luo ding uhi; tua sungah simbu le va-ahte a teng ding uhi. Ama in tua tungah kitawhnawina khau hlung ding a, a uliente tungah buoina suongkhai hlung ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in khum gam pen Kumpi om lo Gam, ci-in minvaw ding a, a uliente zosie zong a mawhna ahi ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"A mun muonhuoite tungah lingkung po ding a, a kulte uh sungah lahkhai le lingkungte a po ding hi. Si-alte tuolbuolna mun le va-kalaohte tenna mun hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Sanga le ngiete a kigop ding vua, keldawite khatlekhat kihlan ding uhi; tuanah Thadamte kumsuhin tawlngahna mun khat mu ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Simbu in tua munah bu bawlin, tuale a tui tha-in nokeu ding a, a hlim nei-ah a note a huoi ding hi; tua sungah mute zong kikhawmin, a nupa cietin a om ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa laibu pan sui unlen sim un: Tuate lahah khat zong a kimansuo sih ding hi; amate lawm nei lo koima a om sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in a kam tawh thupie zo a, ama’ hlagau in amate a khawmzo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in amate ai sanpieh a, a khut in tena khau tawh leitang hawmpieh hi; amate in kumtawnin tua leitang tang ding a, amate in khang khat panin khang khat dongin tua sungah teng ding uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gamdai le gamgawta kipah ding a, senel gam lungdamin pallun ding hi; muoldum pa bangin","title":"Tatsate Zion ah Kilekia"},"2":{"text":"tampi tahin pallun ding a, tuale lungdam kipahin la sa ding hi. Lebanon’ minthanna, Carmel le Sharon muol’ a thupina tua tungah kipie ding hi. Amate in Topa’ vanglietna, eite’ Pasien’ thupina a mu ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Khut hatlote khausah unlen, khup zawte kipsah un.","ref":"Heb 12:12"},"4":{"text":"Lungsim meipuote kungah, “Thakhau unlen, zau sih un! Tanah na Pasien uh a om hi. Phulahna le a zauhuoi danpiehna tawh ama ang pei ding hi. Ama hing pei-in note ang hundam ding hi,” ci un."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin mittawte in khuo mu-in, bilbingte in khuo a za ding uhi;"},"6":{"text":"tua ciengin khelbaite sakhi bangin tawn dien ding a, a ham theilo mite in kipahin la sa ding uhi. Azieh pen gamlah ah tui ang pul ding a, senel gam sungah luitui ang luong ding hi;","ref":"Mat 11:5; Luk 7:22"},"7":{"text":"a sa mama senelte buoltui suoh ding a, leigaw lahah tuisam ang pul ding hi; si-alte tatna mun nawnglah suoh ding a, hampate, pumpeng le gulphit a suoh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khumnah lamlienpi om ding a, tua pen Lamlien Siengtho kici ding hi; a sieng lote in tua lampi zawt lo ding a, ahi vangin tua khu Pasien’ mite ading ahi hi; tua lampi-ah khuolzinte, mimawte nangawn a gammang sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua munah humpi om lo ding a, sasielne gamsa gilkiel khat beh pei lo ding hi. Hizongle tatsa mite khum munah ang pei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ tatsa mite kilekia-in, lasa kawmin Zion a zuon ding vua, amau’ lutungah kumtawn kipahna a om ding hi. Amate in kipahna le nopna a nga ding vua, dana le khuisahna a veng ta ding hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah a uh kum sawm le kum li a cin kumin Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib in Judah gam sunga a om khuopi kulpi nei zosie sim dingin kuonto-in a la hi.","title":"Sennacherib in Jerusalem Galgih (2Kum 18:13-37 ; 2Khg 32:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa in Lachish khuo panin Jerusalem khuo-a kumpi Hezekiah kungah galkap honpi tawh Rabshakeh a sawl hi. Puonsawppa’ Lo zotna lam lienpi buol tungnung tuilahna gei-ah ama a ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale ama tawh kimu dingin Hilkiah’ tapa kumpi innsung vaipuo pa Eliakim, thuvanpi pa Shebna, le Asaph’ tapa thuciemte pa Joah a pusuoh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Rabshakeh in amate kungah, “Hezekiah kungah tam bangin gen un: Kumpi lien Assyria kumpipa in tam bangin ci hi: Tami na kimuonna uh bang bulphu na hi uh ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Kamham maimaite po galdo nadinga vaihawmna le thahatna dan a na ngaisut amah? Tu-in kei nei ledo nadingun koi pen muong na hi uh ahei?"},"6":{"text":"En un, ama tunga a kingam mi khatpo’ khut a sun ding, pumpeng ciengkhut tawngsansa tawh a kibang ahi Egypt muong na hi lel bo uhi. Ama a muongte tungah Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh tua bang ahi lel hi.","ref":"Ezk 29:6-7"},"7":{"text":"Hizongle note in keima kungah, “ Topa ka Pasien uh muong ka hi uhi,” a ci na hi uleh Hezekiah in a munsangte le a maitamte phelpiehin Judah le Jerusalem kungah, “Tam maitam mai-ah na bie ding uhi,” a ci pa hi lo amah?"},"8":{"text":"Tu-in hing pei unlen ka pupa Assyria kumpipa tawh kikhapna khat bawl un: No lam panin a tunga tuong ding mi na mu ngap po uleh sakol tulni kang pie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt-te’ leengte le sakol galkapte muonna tawh ka pu’ nasemte a neupen lahah galkapmang khat nangawn bangci nan zo ding na hi uh ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Tham loin tami gam a susie ding le a do dingin Topa lo tawh ang kuonto ka hi amah? Topa in keima kungah, “Tami gam sim dingin kuonto inlen susie in,” ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Eliakim, Shebna, le Joah in Rabshakeh kungah, “Kote in tel thei sam ka hi ziehun na nasemte Aram ham tawh ei hopi in; kulpi tunga om mite’ zahna-ah Judah ham tawh nei hopi lo nadingin kang thum hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Rabshakeh in, “Ka pupa in tami thu pen na pupa ule note kung beha gen dinga ei sawl ahi sih a, a eh uh ne a, a zun uh dawnin note tawh a mangthaitha ding ahi kulpi tunga a to mite kunga gen dinga ei sawl hizaw lo amah?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rabshakeh dingto-in Judah hamin nahpi tahin tangtawh a, “A lien mama kumpi, Assyria kumpipa’ thugente ngai un!"},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in tam bangci hi: ‘Hezekiah kisolsah sih un, azieh pen ama in note ang hunkhie zo vawt sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in ei hunkhie valon ding a, Assyria kumpipa’ khut sungah tami khuo kipie lo ding hi,’ ci-in Hezekiah in a gen ziehin na Topa uh muong kha sih un."},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah’ thu ngai sih un; bangzieh ahei cile Assyria kumpipa in tam bangci hi: ‘Keima tawh kilemna hing bawl unlen ka kungah hing pei un, tua ciengin a koima po in amau’ lenggui, amau’ theikung ciet panin ne-in amau’ tuikhuh ciet panin a dawn ding vua,"},"17":{"text":"keima hing pei-in, noma’ gam banga an le lenggazu a opna gam, moh le lengga huon a opna gamah kang peipi masangin a tua ci phot ding ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in eite ei hundam ding hi, ci-a Hezekiah’ ang genna po tawh ama kipuikhiel sah sih un. Minamte’ pasien-te khatpo in Assyria kumpipa’ khut sung panin a gam uh a hunkhie zo ngai mal amah?"},"19":{"text":"Hamath le Arpad-te’ pasien-te hei-a om ahi ta uh ahei? Sepharvaim gam pasien-te hei-ah a om vuoi? Amate in ka khut sung panin Samaria gam a hunkhie ta uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"Topa in keima’ khut sung panin Jerusalem a hutdam thei nadingin, tami gamte-a om pasien-te zosie lahah a koi pen in ka khut sung panin a gam uh hunkhie zo ding ahei?’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa in, “Ama dawng sih un,” ci-in thupie ahi ziehin a sip dide vua, kam khat beh a dawng sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hilkiah’ tapa, kumpi innsung vaipuo pa Eliakim, thuvanpi pa Shebna le Asaph’ tapa, thuciemte pa Joah in a puon uh balkehin Hezekiah kungah a haw vua, Rabshakeh’ thugen teng kumpipa kungah a genkia uhi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in tam thu a zah bepin a puonsil botkeh a, la-ip puon silin Topa’ inn sungah a lut hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Isaiah Thukuppi (2Kum 19:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Tuale ama in kumpi innsung vaipuo pa Eliakim, thuvanpi pa Shebna, le siempu khangham teng la-ip puon a kikhu kawmun Amoz’ tapa kamsangpa Isaiah kungah a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Hezekiah in, ‘Tuni pen lungdon ni, kihosiet ni, le mindai ni ahi hi; nausuo hun tung napi a suo zawh nading tha a nei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"A hing Pasien zako dinga a pupa Assyria kumpipa in a sawl Rabshakeh’ thugen teng, Topa na Pasien un za zo kha ta ding a, tuale a zah thute ziehin Topa na Pasien un a hosie ding hi; tua ahi ziehin a kinuasie a omlaite adingin na thungetna uh sang khan un,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Isaiah kungah Kumpi Hezekiah’ nasemte a tun ciengin,"},"6":{"text":"Isaiah in amate kungah, “Na pupa uh kungah, ‘ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Assyria kumpipa’ nasemte in kei ei gensietna na zah uh thute ziehin zau sih un."},"7":{"text":"Ama in kam baleng khat za-in a gamah a kilekia nadingin ama sungah hlagau khat ka koi ding hi; keima in a gam sungah namsau tawh ama ka puasah ding hi,’ ci-in gen un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Rabshakeh kinuale a, tuale Assyria kumpipa in Libnah a sim a mu hi; azieh pen kumpipa in Lachish khuo nuasie zo ci thu ama in za zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in Ethiopia Kumpi Tirhakah tungtang thu kumpipa in za a, “Nang ang do dingin ama ang kuon hi,” a ci hi. Ama in tua thu a zah ciengin Hezekiah kungah kamtaite sawl a,"},"10":{"text":"“Judah Kumpi Hezekiah kungah tam bangin na gen ding uhi: Assyria kumpipa’ khut sungah Jerusalem kipie lo ding hi, ci-a ang kamciemna tawh na kingahna Pasien kisolsah sin."},"11":{"text":"En in, Assyria kumpite in gam zosie susie siengin amate tunga a silbawl teng uh na za zo hi. Nang ang kihunkhie tuom ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate un a na suhmaimang uh ahi minamte, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, le Telassar-a om Eden mite’ pasien-te in a hunkhie zo ngai uh amah?"},"13":{"text":"Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim khuopi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa ahi sihle Ivvah kumpipate hei-a om sieng uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah in kamtaite khut tung panin tua laihlah sangin a sim hi; tua ciengin Topa’ biehinn sungah Hezekiah kato a, tuale ama in Topa mai-ah tua lai kihlah a zah hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Thungetna (2Kum 19:14-34)"},"15":{"text":"Tuale Topa kungah Hezekiah in thungen a,"},"16":{"text":"“Vanglien Topa , Israel-te’ Pasien, Cherub-te tunga a to pa aw, leitung gam zosie tungah nangma beh Pasien na hi a, nang in vantung le leitung na siem zo hi.","ref":"Pei 25:22"},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, na bil ei ngat inlen ei za in; Topa aw, na mit hah inlen ei mu in; Sennacherib in a hing Pasien a zakona, ang hlah thute zosie za in."},"18":{"text":"A tahtahin Topa aw, Assyria kumpite in minam zosie le a gam uh a susie sieng vua,"},"19":{"text":"tuale a pasien-te uh mei sungah a paimang uhi. Tuate pasien-te ahi sih a, mihing khut tawh a kisiem singlesuongte ahi bo hi, tua ziehin tuate suhsietin a om ta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Topa kote’ Pasien aw, nang beh Topa na hina thu leitung kumpi gam zosie in a thei nadingin tu-in ama’ khut sung panin kote ei hundam in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amoz’ tapa Isaiah kungah mi sawl a, “Israel-te’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: “Nang in kei kungah Assyria Kumpipa Sennacherib tawh kisai thu nang gen zo tah ziehin,"},"22":{"text":"ama’ tungtang Topa’ thugen tam bang ahi hi: ‘Zion’ tanu ngahnu siengtho nu in nang ang simmaw a, ang zako hi; Jerusalem’ tanu in na nua sangah a lu ang peisan lel hi."},"23":{"text":"‘Nang in koi zako-in koi simmaw na hi ahei? Koi langah na aw sangsahin, kiliensahin na mit lehto na hei? Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa langah amah!"},"24":{"text":"Nang in nasemte zangin Topa na zako zo ta a, “Ka leeng tampite tawh muolsang dawn tengah ka kato zo a, Lebanon muoldawn kui dongah ka kato zo ta hi; tamtaah sing a sang pente, taasing hoipente ka phua zo hi. A sangpen mun, gammang pen zong ka tung zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima int tuikhuh to-in tui ka dawn a, Ka ketaw tawh Egypt luitui zosie ka kangsah hi,” na ci hi."},"26":{"text":"‘Tua khu tanglai peh panin ka kipsahsa ahi lam na zakha sih amah? Khuopi kulpi neite susie-in buathahlom na suosah nadingin tu-a ka tunsah thute tangmaleh lai pana ka gelsa ahi hi,"},"27":{"text":"a sunga tengte thahat loin lungkia-in a zala uhi; amate pen lolai-a om hampa kehte, lopa ngehte le innkhum zanga a po, a khan masanga a gawta lopate tawh kibang hi."},"28":{"text":"‘Na dintona le na tosuhna, na pusuo na sungtumna le ka tunga na thangpainate ka thei hi."},"29":{"text":"Kei tunga na lungthah zieh le na uongtatna thu ka bilin ka zah ziehin, na nahkuo ah siakawi hing bulin, na kamah kamkai hing vaw-in, nang kuonna lampi ma-ah kang kilesahkia ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tuale note adingin tam khu lim ang hi ding hi: Tu kumin anli pote ne unlen, khuovei ciengin tua anlite ma ne un; a kum thumna ciengin khai tu-in an la unlen, lenggui suonin a ga ne un."},"31":{"text":"Judah innkuonte lahah a suohta a omlai teng in lei-ah a huite hlasuh ding a, a tung lamah a ga a om ding hi;"},"32":{"text":"azieh pen Jerusalem panin a omlai teng, Zion Muol panin a suohta sun teng peidawh ding uhi. Vanglien Topa’ deiluotna in tami ang bawl ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin Assyria kumpipa tawh kisai Topa in tam bangci hi: Tam khuopi sungah ama ang lut lo ding a, khum munah thaltang zong kap lo ding hi. Tuami mai-ah lum tawh ang pei lo ding a, gal nanna ding leicien zong ang bawl sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ang kuonna lampi-ah ama kilekia ding hi; tami khuopi sung ang lut sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Azieh pen keima le ka nasempa David ka khuolna-in tami khuopi a suotah nadingin ka hung ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi kuonin Assyria-te’ giephuol ah mihing tul za le sawmgiet le tulnga that hi; zingmawng khuovah ciengin amate a unpi-in misi luong vive na hi uhi.","title":"Sennacherib’ Gallelna le a Sina (2Kum 19:35-37)"},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib pei a, innlam zuonin Nineveh ah a teng hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in a pasien Nisroch’ inn ah bie-in a op laitahin, ama’ tate ahi Adrammelech le Sharezer in namsau tawh ama thatin Ararat gamah a taimang uhi. A tapa Esar-haddon in ama’ za luo hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Hezekiah a ci na-in si dihtah hi. Ama kungah Amoz’ tapa Isaiah haw a, “ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na innsung vai ding hawm in, azieh pen nang na si ding hi; na damkia nawn sih ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.","title":"Hezekiah Cinatna (2Kum 20:1-11 ; 2Khg 32:24-26)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah in a mai kawm lam ngatin Topa kungah thu ngen hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Nangma mai-ah thumaanna le lungsim zosie tawh gamta-in nangma muna-ah sil hoi ka bawl lam tu-in ei phawh in, kang thum hi, Topa aw,” a ci hi. Tuale Hezekiah nahpi tahin kap hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"5":{"text":"“Pei inlen Hezekiah kungah gen in, na pu David’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Na thungetna ka za zo a, na hlitui luongte ka mu zo hi; na hinkhuo kum sawm le kum nga kang belap ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in Assyria kumpipa’ khut sung panin nangma le tami khuopi kang hunkhie ding a, tami khuopi ka humbih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ama in ang ciemsa thu Topa in ang sep nadingin tam pen Topa kung panin nangma ading lim ahi hi:"},"8":{"text":"En in, keima in Ahaz kumpipa’ ni-nai tungah nitum kuona a liepsuh nihlim pen kal sawm ka nuatawn sah ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n ni-nai tungah a liepsa ni kal sawm a nuatawn hi."},"9":{"text":"Judah kumpi Hezekiah a ci na-in, a natna pan a dam zaw ciengin ama laigiel tami ahi hi:"},"10":{"text":"Ka khan kimsuh laitahin a muolliem ding ka hi ta hi; ka hun omlai teng zong khu Misikhuo tunkot zuon dinga ei kise ahi ta hi, ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"A hingte’ gam sungah Topa ka mu sih ding a, leitunga teng mite lahah mihing ka en nawn sih ding hi, ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuucingpa’ puonbuh bangin keima kung panin ka tenna kiphelmangin kikhin ta hi; siemgan pa puon ziel bangin ka hinkhuo ka ziel zo ta hi; ama in siembu panin ei attan hi; nang in sun le zanin ka hinkhuo na tawpsah hi;"},"13":{"text":"zingmawng dongin huna ngenin ka kap hi; humpi bangin ka gu ka tang zosie na tawngsansah a, sun panin zan dongin ka hinkhuo na tawpsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Sielpaleng bang le vakang bangin ka hamham a, vahui bangin zong ka maumau hi. Tunglam ka et-etna lamin ka mit khamzo ta hi. Topa aw, kei ei kibawlsie hi; ka lungmuonna nangma hing hi ta’n!"},"15":{"text":"Hizongle ken bang gen thei ding ka hei? Azieh pen ama in tua thu ei gen zo a, amama in tam thu a bawl zo hi. Ka lunggim ziehin ka kimuthei sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, tam bang silte ziehin mite a nungta ahi vua, tamte zosie ka hlagau hinna ahi hi. Aw, keima ei damsah inlen, ei hingsah bo in!"},"17":{"text":"Hahsatna lienpi ka thuohna khu keima hoi nading tahtah ahi hi; hinanle nang in sietna dum sung panin keima’ hinkhuo nei nuatuh hi, azieh pen nang in ka mawna zosie na nualamah nei paimangpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen Misikhuo in lungdam ang ko thei sih a, sina in zong nang ang phat thei sih hi; Hankhuh sunga a kumsuhte in na muonhuoina a lamen thei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuni-a ka bawl bangin a hing mite, a hing mite beh in nangma kungah lungdam ang ko uhi; pate in a tate uh tungah nangma’ muonhuoina a theisah uhi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in keima ei hundam ding a, tuale eite in Topa’ inn sungah i hin sung tungtawnin khausai tumgingte tawh la i sa ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in Isaiah in, “Amate theiga lomkhat lasah inlen, a himate uh a damkia thei nadingin nupieh in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah in zong, “ Topa’ inn sungah ka peito nading bang lim hi ding ahei?” ci-in a dong hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Baladan’ tapa Babylon kumpipa Merodach-baladan in Hezekiah a cinat le a damkiana thu a zah ziehin ama kungah laihlahte le letsongte tawh palaite a sawl hi.","title":"Babylon Palaite Kimuoh (2Kum 20:12-19 ; 2Khg 32:27-31)"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah in amate na muoh a, a gou kholna inn sunga neisa zosie, ngun, kham, panamtui, sathau manpha, a galvan zah zosie, a vankoina sunga a kimu thei zosie a unpi-in amate a lah hi. A innsung hile, a gam sunga om zosie hile, Hezekiah in amate a lah lo bangma khat beh om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Hezekiah kungah kamsang Isaiah pei a, “Tam mite in bang ang gen uh ahei? Hei sung pana nang kunga ang pei uh ahei?” a ci leh Hezekiah in, “Amate pen a gamlapi, Babylon gam panin keima kunga ang pei ahi uhi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in, “Na na inn sungah bang teng a mu vuoi?” a ci hi. Hezekiah in, “Amate in ka inn sunga a om na zosie a unpi-in a mu sieng uhi. Ka vankoina innte sunga nate amate ka lah lo khat beh a om sih hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaiah in Hezekiah kungah, “Vanglien Topa’ thu ngai in:"},"6":{"text":"Na inn sunga om na zosie le na pu na pate in tuni donga a kholsate, Babylon gamah a kipuohmang ding ni ang tung ding hi; bangma kinuasie lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma sung pana a pieng na tapate kimkhat kilamang ding hi; Babylon kumpi inn sungah amate cilge-in a om ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Dan 1:1-7; 2Kum 24:10-16; 2Khg 36:10"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hezekiah in Isaiah kungah, “Nei gensa Topa’ thu pen a hoi ahi hi,” a ci hi. Azieh pen ama in, “Ka hin sungin kilemna le lungmuonna om ding hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw, ka mite henem un, henem un, na Pasien un ci hi.","title":"Pasien’ Mite Kihenem (Luk 3:4-6)"},"2":{"text":"Awnem no tawh Jerusalem hopi unlen, a thuoh ding hun ciengtan cing zo a, a mawna thaman kipie zo hi. A mawna zosie ziehin Topa’ khut tung panin a zani-in ama in thuoh zo hi, ci-in ama kungah kiko un."},"3":{"text":"A kiko awging khat in: “Gampalah ah Topa pei nading lampi siel unlen, senel gam sungah i Pasien adingin lam lienpi na tangsah un."},"4":{"text":"Guom zosie kisangsah ding a, muol le tang teng zosie kiniemsah ding hi; lei kituoh lote kitotam ding a, leiphom munte zanglei suoh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vang ang kitalang ding a, Topa’ kam in a gensa ahi ziehin, mi zosie in a muton ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Awging khat in, “Kiko in!” ei ci hi. Tuale keima in, “Bang thu kiko ding ka hei?” ka ci hi. Mi zosie lopa bang ahi a, a bulkip dan uh pen gamlah paape tawh kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ hu in a mut ciengin, lopate vulin paapete a muol hi; a tahtahin mihingte lopa bang lel ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Lopate vul a, paapete a muol hi; ahi vangin i Pasien uh’ kammal ahile a kip tawntung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Lungdamna thu a puoh Zion aw, muolsang dawnah kato in; lungdamna thu a puoh Jerusalem aw, na tha nei za-in awng in, na aw sangsah inlen zau sin; Judah khuopite kungah, “Tanah na Pasien uh a om hi!” ci un."},"10":{"text":"En un, thahatna tawh Topa Pasien ang pei a, ama in ama adingin a khut tawh vai a hawm hi. Ama’ sep thamante ang puo a, a lokiana ding ang masot hi.","ref":"Isa 62:11; Kln 22:12"},"11":{"text":"Ama in tuucingpa bangin a tuute an a va ding hi; ama in a banah tuunote huoi-in, a kangah tuate pom ding a, a nosen neite zong damtahin a peipi ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 34:15; Jhn 10:11"},"12":{"text":"Koi in a khutkuoh tawh tuite te-in, a khap tawh vante ciemte a, koi in a tena sungah leitung leivui guongin, muolte pongkhaina tawh khai a, koi in muoltangte tawitena tawh te ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Koi in Topa’ hlagau lamlah a, ama’ thu kuppipa in ama a hil bangin koi in ama thu hil ahei?","ref":"Rom 11:34; 1Cor 2:16"},"14":{"text":"Thu a thei nadingin ama in koi dong a, koi in ama thutang lampi hil ahei? Koi in ama theina hil a, koi in ama theitelna hil ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Minamte nangawn phelkhai khat pana tuimal hlitaa tawh kibang lel a, tawitena tunga leivui baang bangin kingaisun lel hi; en un, ama in leivui them bangin tuikulte a domto lel hi."},"16":{"text":"Meitaw nadingin Lebanon sing in sih zo lo ding a, a ganhingte zong kicing lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama mai-ah minam zosie bangma hi lo hi; ama in bangma lo le a hawmguoh sanga a tawmzaw-in amate a ngaisun hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahile note in Pasien koi tawh tekah ding a, ama tawh tekah dingin a kisutpi bang pen ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Milim khat po amah? -tua pen milim bawlpa khat in sung a, tuale khamkheng pa khat in kham tawh zutzol a, tuami adingin ama in ngun khainiengte sunpieh hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:29"},"20":{"text":"Letsong dingin mite in a muot lo ding nailung sing a teel uhi, tua ciengin a pua lo ding milim khat a phut dingin amate in khutsiem mi khat a sui uhi."},"21":{"text":"Note in na thei nai sih uh amah? za nai lo na hi uh amah? A cila patin note kungah hing kigen zo hi lo amah? Note in leitung piencila kipanin, thei zo ta hi lo uh na mah?"},"22":{"text":"Leitung vielkuol tunga a to pa ama ahi a, a sunga tengte pen kauphe tawh kibang hi; ama in puonkhai bangin vante zah a, ten nading puonbuh bangin tuate a zah hi;"},"23":{"text":"ama in uliente amawhna suohsah a, leitung a uhte bangma lo suohsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate a gina-in kisuon lo a, amate a gina-in kivaw lo hi. A huite uh lei-ah zung hla loin ama in a mut ciengin a vul vua , huipi in butu bangin amate a tawmang hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahile kei koi tawh ei tekah ding na hi uh ahei? Ahi sihle ka kikimpi koi pen ahei? Siengtho Pa in ci hi."},"26":{"text":"A sangna lam ento unlen mu un: Koi in tam teng siem ahei? Ama in a honpite pui-in a phaza simin a min cietin hlan hi; ama thahatin a vangliet ziehin a pelem khat beh a om sih hi."},"27":{"text":"“ Topa kung panin ka lampi kiselmang a, ka Pasien in ka thumanna ei thudon lo hi,” Jacob aw, bang dingin ci-a, Israel aw, bang dingin tuaci ham na hei?"},"28":{"text":"Na thei nai sih uh amah? Na za nai sih uh amah? Topa khu kumtawn Pasien ahi a, leimongte a siempa ahi hi. Ama basam lo a, zong gim lo hi; ama’ theitelna ahile sui zawh vet ding ahi sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in a bate tungah thahatna pie a, thahatna nei lote a tha hatsah hi."},"30":{"text":"Khangnote nangawn ba-in gim ding a, tuoilaite a husam ding uhi;"},"31":{"text":"hinanle Topa a lamen mite ahile a tha uh dimkia ding a, muvanlai bangin a hla tawh lengto-in, amate tai napi a gim sih ding vua, amate lam pei napi a ba sih ding uhi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a om gamte aw, daitahin ka thu ngai un; mite a tha dimkiasah un; amate a nai-ah hing peisah unlen, tua ciengin amate hing gensah un; thu kinei dingin i kinai ciet ding uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Panpi ding Israel-te’ Lungmuonna"},"2":{"text":"Nisuona pana ang pei a guolzo mipa, koi in nasem dingin ama hantawhin, koi in ama hlan ahei? Ama in a sungah minamte pie a, ama in a keng tawh kumpite tuoncil hi; ama in a namsau tawh amate leivui bangin bawl a, a thalpi tawh bukung huimut leng bangsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a kenga a pei ngai lona lampi ah amate nuadelin nuomtahin a peisuoh hi."},"4":{"text":"A kipat cil a kipanin a khangkhangin mite a hlan, tami nasep sem a, a bawl koi ahei? Keima, Topa khu a masa pen ka hi a, tuale a nukhia pen tawh ka omton ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a om gamte in mu-in a zau vua, leimonga teng mite a citun uhi; amate in nai-in a pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khatlekhat a kipanpi vua, khatlekhat “hangsan in,” a kici uhi."},"7":{"text":"Khutsiem pa in khamseh pa hanthawn a, sehta tawh milim a suizol pa in lungthang tunga a sat pa hanthawn a, a sumtui luonna uh, “Hoi hi,” a ci uhi. Amate in a kilawh thei lo dingin tua milim siakil tawh a khendet uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle nang ka nasem pa Israel, kang teelsa Jacob, ka guolpa Abraham’ hlahlesuon;","ref":"2Khg 20:7; Jas 2:23"},"9":{"text":"leimong pana kang lah dawh, gammong a gamla pen pana kang hlat, “Nang ka nasem pa na hi a, nangma kang teel zo ta a, nang kang nuol sih hi,” kang ci pa aw;"},"10":{"text":"nang kang ompi ziehin zau sin, na Pasien ka hi ziehin patau sin; keima in nang hing thakhausahin kang panpi ding a, ka galzawna zietlam khutin kang tu lenlon ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi hi, nang tunga a lungthah zosie maizumin a zala ding uhi; nang ang demte bangma suohin, a mangthai ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Na kihaupite na sui vangin, amate na mu sih ding hi; nangma ang dote bangma a suoh vawt sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien in nangma’ zietlam khut ka tu hi; “Zau sin, kang panpi ding hi,” ci-a na kunga ang ci pa keima ka hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Lungno bang lel Jacob, no a neu Israel-te aw, zau sih un! Keima in note kang hu ding hi, Topa in ci hi; note ang Tankhie Pa pen Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in note pen a hiem, a tha le ha a nei bucilna bangin kang bawl ding hi; note in muol golte cilin na gawtvui ding vua, muoltangte zong ansi bangin na bawl ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Note in ansite na khap ding vua, hui in tuate tawmang ding a, huipi in tuate a thezah ding hi. Tua ciengin Topa sungah na lungdam ding uhi; Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa sungah note na kisiel ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mizawngte le mi tasamte in tui a sui ciengun bangma om lo a, tuidu-in a lei uh a gaw a, keima Topa in amate ka dawng ding a, keima Israel-te’ Pasien in amate ka nuasie sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Muolsang pawn tungah guntui ka luongsah ding a, kuomte laikimah tuisam ka pulsah ding hi; senel gam pen buoltui ka suohsah ding a, gam gawta pen ciatui ka suohsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Senel gam sungah taamtah sing, gising, muising, le olive kungte ka posah ding hi; senel gamah taasing, hiengpa sing, meigit singte ka suonton ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa’ khut in tami bawl a, Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa in tami piengsah hi, ci-in thei-in a mu thei nading, mi zosie in lung ngai-in a theisiem nading uh ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Na thu uh sung un, Topa in ci hi; na cienlah nuom teng uh hing puoh un, Jacob’ Kumpipa in ci hi.","title":"Milimte a Mawhnapi Ahina"},"22":{"text":"Amate in tuate puoh uh hinlen, a pieng ding thu gen uheh. Kote in tuate khu ngaisunin a pieng ding thu ka thei nadingun a piengsa thute bang teng ahei ei gen uheh; ahi sihle ang pieng ding thute ei gen ta uheh."},"23":{"text":"Note pasien-te na hi lam uh keima in kang thei nadingun, tu zaw cienga ang pieng ding thute kote kungah ei gen uheh; kote patau-in ka zau nadingun a pha ahi a, a sie ahi zongin hing bawl un."},"24":{"text":"A tahtahin note bangma na hi sih vua, na nasepnate uh bangma ahi sih hi; note ang teel pa a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Leilu lam pan mi khat ka hantawh a, ama ang kuon zo hi, ama in nisuona lam panin ka minin ei hlan ding hi. Beelkheng pa in buon a cil bang, sum sunga kisuguoi bangin, ama in gam uhte a tuoncil gawp ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka thei nadingun a cil panin koi in ei gen a, “Ama thuman hi,” ka ci thei nadingun, koi in ei magen ahei? Koima in genkhie loin pulah lo a, koima in na gen uh za lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in Zion kungah tam thu ka pulah masa a, Jerusalem tungah lungdamna thu gen tangko khat ka pie hi."},"28":{"text":"Ka et mawh vangin koima om lo hi. Thu ka dawh ciengin ei dawng ding, thu ka kikuppi ding amate lahah koima om lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi lo hi, tuate a unpi-in a zuou bulompi ahi hi; a nasepte uh bangma hi lo a, a milimte uzong hui hawmpi ahi bo hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam sungah ka tuhdet, ka teeldawh, ka lungkimna ka nasem pa a om hi; ama tungah ka hlagau ka koi zo ta a, ama in minamte tungah thutang a puoh ding hi.","title":"Minamte Tunga Khuovah Nasempa","ref":"Mat 3:17; 17:5; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; 9:35"},"2":{"text":"Ama kap lo ding a, a aw sangsah loin, gawlzing lahah a awging kizasah lo ding hi;"},"3":{"text":"ama in kisatguoisa pumpeng hliehtawng loin, a tang lingleng meivah khau semmit lo ding hi; ama in muonhuoi tahin thutang a puoh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in leitungah thutang a phudet masangin basam loin lungkie lo ding hi; tuipi gei-a gamte in ama thuhilna a lamen uhi.","ref":"Mat 12:18-21"},"5":{"text":"Vantungte siem a, tuate a zah pa, leitung pha a, a sunga om zosie a siem pa, leitunga mihingte’ naahu a guon Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi:","ref":"Sawl 17:24-25"},"6":{"text":"Keima Topa ka hi a, keima in dihna tawh nang kang hlan zo a, ka khut tawh kang tu zo a, nangma kang kem zo hi; mite tungah thuciemna ahi ding, minamte tungah khuovah ahi ding,","ref":"Isa 49:6; Luk 2:32; Sawl 13:47; 26:23"},"7":{"text":"mittawte mit a vahsah ding, leinei thong hawmpi sung panin thongkiete a hlakhie ding le miel lahah a to mite thong sung panin a hlakhie dingin nang kang pie zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima Topa ka hi a, tua khu keima’ min ahi hi; midang koima tungah ka vanglietna ka pie sih a, keima in milimte tungah ei kiphatna ka pie sih hi."},"9":{"text":"En un, amasa nate pieng zo ta a, tu-in a tha nate kang pulah hi; tuate a pien masangin na kung vuah tuate kang mahilh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa tungah la tha khat sa unlen, leimong panin ama phatna la sa un! Tuipi le a sunga omte zosie, tuipi gei-a gamte le amate tunga a tengte hawhsah vapuoh un.","title":"Phatna La Khat"},"11":{"text":"Senel gam le a khuopite, Kedar-te tenna-a teng khuotate in a aw uh sangkhai uheh. Sela gama tengte in zong kipahin la sa uh hinlen, muol dawn teng panin zong kiko uheh."},"12":{"text":"Amate in Topa kungah vanglietna pie uh hinlen, tuipi gei-a gamte ah ama phatna tangko uheh."},"13":{"text":"Galkap khat bangin Topa kuon a, galhang khat bangin a lung a sosah hi; ama kiko-in nahpi-in awng a, a galte do-in a hatna lah hi."},"14":{"text":"Sawtveipi sung bangma ka gen sih a, kei le kei kidehin dai dide-in ka om hi; tu-in numei nausuoh ding bangin ka peng vagua ding a, husamin ka nawnaa ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Muol le tangte ka susie ding a, lopa hing zosie ka gawsah ding hi; gunte tuikul ka suohsah ding a, buolte ka gawkang sah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amau’ thei lo lampi-ah mittawte ka peipi ding a, amau’ thei ngai lo sul zuipi-in amate ka hla ding hi. Amate masangah khuomiel khuovah ka suohsah ding a, a phomna munte zong zangtam ka suohsah ding hi. Tamte keima bawl ding ahi a, keima in amate ka nuasie sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A kisui milim muong a, milim kikheng kungah, “Ka pasien-te na hi uhi,” a ci mite kinua delin a maizumin kikoi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Bilbingte aw, ngai un; mittawte dahto unlen mu un!"},"19":{"text":"Ka nasem pa longal koi a mit taw a, ka sawl ka kamtai pa bangin koi bil bing ahei? A kipumpieh mite bangin koi a mit taw a, Topa’ nasem pa bangin koi a mit a taw ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Ama in na tampi a mu vangin tuate encien lo hi; ama a bil a van vangin khuo za lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ dihna a khuolna-in ama’ thuhilna liensah a, a thupisah ding khu Topa’ lungkimna ahi hi.","title":"Israel-te’ Thumaanlona"},"22":{"text":"Hinanle tam mite pen a kisuom le a kibulu gawpte ahi vua, amate pen a unpi-in leihawm sunga a kie mite le thong sunga kikhumte ahi uhi; amate pen a hun ding a om lo, neh dinga kiman ganhing a suoh sieng vua, koima in, “Ei piekia un!” a ci vawt lo gal vanlah a suoh sieng ta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Note lahah koi in tam thu ngai ding a, mailam-ah koi in thusimin ngai ding ahei?"},"24":{"text":"Koi in galvantom pa kungah Jacob pie-in, a bulugawpte tungah Israel pie ahei? A tunga i mawna pa uh, amate in ama’ lampi a zui lo pa uh, a thukham zong a man lo pa uh Topa hi lo amah?"},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama tungah a lungthahna meisa le a siehuoi galkidona a sungsuh hi; a kimvel zosie-ah a lungsona kuong a, ahi vangin ama in a thei sih hi; tua in ama hulvam a, ahi vangin ama in ngaisutin nei lo hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in Jacob aw, nangma ang siempa, Israel aw, nangma ang bawlpa, Topa in tu-in tam bangin ci hi: Nang kang tat zo tah ziehin zau sin; na minin kang hlan zo ta a, nang pen keima-a’ na hi hi.","title":"A Ngai Bahkia nading le a Kihut nading Kikamciem"},"2":{"text":"Tuite na kansan ciengin nangma tawh kang om ding hi; gunte na kansan ciengin nang ang tai sih ding hi; meikuong lai-a na pei ciengin ang hulvam sih ding a, tuale meikuong in nang ang katum sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen keima Topa na Pasien uh, Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa, na hundampa ka hi hi. Nangma tat nadingin Egypt ka pie a, nang tawh kihleng dingin Ethiopia le Seba ka pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima’ mit ah nang na manpha a, zatahhuoi-in, hing it ka hi ziehin nangma tangin mite ka pie a, na hinna hlen nadingin minamte ka pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang kang ompi ziehin zau sin; nisuona lam panin na suonlehlahte kang puoh ding a, nitumna lam panin kang kaikhawm ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in leilu lam kungah, “Amate piedawh ta’n,” ci-in, leitaw lam kungah, “Tukon sin,” ka ci ding hi. Gamlapi panin ka tapate, leimong panin ka tanute,"},"7":{"text":"ka minthan nadinga ka piensahte, le ka suhtuo le ka bawlte, ka mina kilo poma hing peipi un,” ka ci ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mit nei napi a mittawte, bil nei napi a bilbingte hing peipi un!"},"9":{"text":"Minam zosie kituosah unlen, mite kikhawmsah un. Amate lah panin koi in tam thu pulahin, koi in a tawpsa huna nate eite tungah ei genkhol ahei? Amate in dih a tan thei nadingun a tecite uh hing peipisah unlen, amate zasahin, “Tam khu thu man ahi hi,” cisah un."},"10":{"text":"Nohaw pen keima’ tecite na hi uhi, Topa in ci a, tuale kei pen ama ka hi lam, note in ei thei-in, tuaci’n keima nei up nading ule nei theitel nadingun note pen kang teelsa ka nasem na hi uhi. Kei masangin pasien om lo a, kei’ nua ciengin zong om lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei, keima khu Topa ka hi a, tuale kei simlo hundampa dang om lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Note lahah pasien dang a op lo lai-in, keima in pulahin hundamin, ka tangko hi. Tuale Topa in note pen keima’ tecite na hi uhi, ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima Pasien ka hi a, tu huna kipanin zong kei Ama ka hi hi; ka khut sung panin a tankhie zo koima om lo hi; keima in na ka sem a, koi in ei khahtan zo ding ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa, note ang Tanpa Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Note ziehin Babylon ah ka sawl ding a, amate in khuopi kotgol zosie a kuoitanin tuale Chaldea-te’ kikona awging pen kaana kisuohsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima Topa , na Siengtho Pa uh, Israel a piengsah pa, note’ Kumpi ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuipi sunga lampi a siel pa, tuihat sunga lam a bawlpa,"},"17":{"text":"leeng le sakolte, galkapte le galhangte a peipi pa; a tho zo lo dingin amate lumcipsah a, meivah khau a kisuhmit banga a mitsah pa Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"18":{"text":"Nidang lai-a nate phawh nawn sih unlen, a lui nate zong ngaisun nawn sih un."},"19":{"text":"Keima a tha na khat ka bawl ta ding hi; tu-in ang pieng ta hi; na thei sih uh amah? Gamlahah lam lienpi khat ka siel ding a, senel gam sungah gunte ka luongsah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Gamsate, ngiete le va-kalaohte in keima ei patawi ding uhi; azieh pen keima in senel gamah tui pie-in, senel gamah gunte ka pie a, ka teelsa mite’ dawn dingin tui zong ka pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima dinga ka piensah mite in keima phatna a tangko ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanle Jacob aw, nang in kei nei hlan sih a, Israel aw, nang in kei nei cimtah ta hi!"},"23":{"text":"Meihal biehna dingin kei kungah na tuute nang peipi sih a, na biehpiehnate tawh kei nei patawi sih hi. Keima in biehnate tawh vangih kang suon sih a, gimnamtui tawh zong kang gimsah sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Kei adingin a hlum mama phaite sum tawh nei leipieh sih a, na biehpiehna ganthau tawh kei nei taisah sih hi. Ahi vangin na mawnate tawh vangih nei suon a, na khielnate tawh kei nei gimsah zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima ka kikhuolna-in na khielnate ang phietpieh pa kei, keima khu Ama ka hi a, keima in na mawnate ka ciemte sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Kei ei mawsah un, thukhen zumah pei vai. Dih na tan thei nadingin na thu hing sung in."},"27":{"text":"Na pu na pa masate a na maw vua, na kamphente uzong kei tungah a tawnkhiel uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in mun siengtho-a om uliente ka buasah ding a, keima in Jacob sietna-ah ka pie ta a, hosiet dingin Israel ka pie ta hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka nasem pa Jacob aw, ka teelsa Israel aw, tu-in za in!","title":"Israel Tunga Pasien’ Thupha"},"2":{"text":"Nangma ang siem pa, naubu sunga ang piengsah le nang ang hu ding Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ka nasem pa Jacob aw, kang teelsa Jeshurun aw, zau sin."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in a dangta leitang tungah tui ka sung ding a, leigaw tungah luitui ka luongsah ding hi; na suonlehlahte tungah ka hlagau ka sung ding a, na tu na tate tungah ka thupha ka sung ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate tui lahah lopa dawng bangin po ding a, luitui luong gei-a po gielheh kungte bang ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khat in, “Kei pen Topa -a’ ka hi hi,” ci-in, adang khat Jacob’ min tawh kihlan ding a, hinanle midang khat in a khut tungah “ Topa -a’,” ci-in giel ding a, tuale Israel’ minin kivaw ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa , Israel Kumpipa le ama a Tanpa, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Keima a masa pen le a nukhia pen ka hi hi; kei simlo pasien dang om lo hi.","ref":"Isa 48:12; Kln 1:17; 22:13"},"7":{"text":"Keima tawh kibang koi ahei? Amate tangkosah inlen, keima mai-ah amate in pulahin gensah in. Koi in ang tung ding nate tangtawng panin tangko ahei? Amate in ang tung lai ding thute eite tungah gensah un."},"8":{"text":"Zau sih unlen ging sih un; tanglai panin na kung vuah hing genin hing pulah zo hi lo ka mah? Note pen keima teci na hi uhi! Kei simlo pasien dang om amah? Suongpi dang om lo a, khat zong ka thei sih hi."},"9":{"text":"A kisiemthu milimte zosie bangma ahi sih a, amau’ patat tua nate in phattuomna piengsah lo hi; a tecite un mu loin zong a thei sih uhi. Tuale amate in maizumna a thuoh ding uhi.","title":"Milim Bieh a Nuizathuoina"},"10":{"text":"Phattuomna a pie lo pasien koi in bawl a, koi in milim kheng ahei?"},"11":{"text":"En un, ama a bie mi zosie in maizumna a thuoh ding uhi; khutsiem zosie zong mihing ahi bo hi. A unpi-in kikhawmsahin amate dingsah un; amate zausi-in a unpi-un maizumna a thuoh ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Siakheng pa in tua pen a lim khengin meihol tungah em a, sehta tawh lim le guong nei-in khengin a ban hat tawh a sat hi; ama gilkielin gim a, tui dawn loin a balia hi."},"13":{"text":"Sing nasep khutsiempa in khau kai-in laikung tawh melci a, singnawtna tawh nawtin siem hoi-in compass tawh melci hi; tua pen biehbuhno sunga kitung dingin a duongcing mihing le a melhoi mihing bangin a bawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in taamtah singte phua a, ahi sihle sesing khat ahi a, gangpi sing khat ahi zongin teel a, gamlah singte lahah tuate khangliensahin a golsah hi. Ama in taamtah sing khat suon a, tua khu guotui in a khangsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khu singa vah dingin kizang hi. Ama in tua sing themkhat la-in mei awi a, meitaw-in mo a em hi. Tua ciengin ama in pasien khat bawlin bie a, milim khat bawltawmin tua milim mai-ah a kun hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a phalkhat tawh mei a taw hi; ama in tami alang tungah sa a em a, tua sa ne-in a tai mama hi. Ama le ama kisanglum a, “Ah, ka khuolum ta, meisa nuom sam ei!” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in amawh teng a pasien’ milim khatin bawl a, a milim mai-ah bie hi; ama in tua milim tungah thungen a, “Ei hundam in, nang ka pasien na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in bangma thei loin bangma a khentel thei sih uhi; azieh pen amate in khuo a mu thei lo nadingun a mit uh kihumpieh a, thu a thei lo nadingun a lungsim uh kikhacip hi."},"19":{"text":"“Sing a phalkhat tawh mei ka taw hi; a mei-am tungah mo zong ka em a, sa zong emin ka ne zo ta hi. Tu-in amawh teng a kidahhuoi-in ka bawl sam ding amah? Singtun khat mai-ah kun talawm sam ding ka mah?” a ci dingin thu ngaituo mi a om sih a, theina ahi a, thu khinkhai theina ahi zongin a nei koima khat beh a om sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama vut tawh kiva ahi hi; a lungsim motna in ama puikhiel zo a, ama le ama kihun thei loin, ahi sihle, “Ka zietlam khut sungah zuouthu om hi lo amah? ci-in a gen thei sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel aw, ka nasem pa na hi ziehin, Jacob aw, tam nate ciemte in; nang kang siem a, nang ka nasem na hi hi; Israel aw, nang kang mangngil sih ding hi.","title":"Israel Kimangngil Lo"},"22":{"text":"Na thupalsatnate meiilum bang a, na mawnate khuovui bangin ka sumaimang ta hi. Nang kang tat zo tah ziehin kei kungah hing kilekia in."},"23":{"text":"Vante aw, Topa in tua thu sem zo ahi ziehin la sa un; lei a thuhnate aw, nahpi-in awng un; Muolte aw, la sa-in kiko un. gampalah le a sunga om singkung zosie aw, awng un! Azieh pen Topa in Jacob tan zo ta a, Israel sungah ama kiminthangsah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Naubu sung panin nangma ang siempa, nangma ang Tanpa, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in na vannuoi siemin, kei matangin vante zahin, koima’ hu vawt loin leitung ka zah hi;"},"25":{"text":"zuothu gente’ hilkholna limte a susie pa, aisan siemte mimaw a suohsah pa; mipilte lehei kia-in, a theina uh motna a suohsah pa;","ref":"1Cor 1:20"},"26":{"text":"a nasem pa’ thu kipsahin, a kamtaite’ thugente a tangtun pa; Jerusalem kungah, “Mi ang teng ding hi,” ci-in, Judah khuopite kungah, “Amahaw kilam ta ding hi,” a ci pa, tua a kisiesate ka dingsah ding hi,’ a ci pa;"},"27":{"text":"tuithuhpi kungah, ‘Kanggaw ta’n, na gunte ka kangsah ding hi,’ a ci pa;"},"28":{"text":"Cyrus kungah, “Ama ka tuucingpa hi a, ka tupna tangtungsah ding hi,” a ci pa; Jerusalem kungah, ‘Ama kilamkia ding hi,’ a ci pa le biehinnpi kungah, “Na khuombul kiphutkia ding hi,” a ci pa khu keima Topa ka hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Khg 36:23; Ezr 1:2"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama mai-ah minamte a zogawp ding le kumpite’ puontuolte hawhpieh ding, khuopi tunkotte a kikha lo nadinga a mai-a kotpite a hong ding, a zietlam khut ka tuhpieh, a sathau nu pa Cyrus kungah Topa in tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Pasien’ Vanzah Cyrus"},"2":{"text":"Na mai-ah pei-in muolte ka zezang ding a, sumngo kotpite susie-in, sia zawlte sattanin,"},"3":{"text":"nangma’ min tawh ang hlanpa khu Israel Pasien Topa keima ka hi lam na thei nadingin, khuomiel sunga kikoi goute le mun simtham sunga a kidap koi haunate kang pie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka nasempa Jacob zieh le ka teeltuom Israel ziehin keima in na min tawh kang hlan a, nang in kei nei thei lo vangin keima in patawina za nang kang pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima Topa ka hi a, koima dang om lo hi; Keima simlo pasien dang om lo hi. note in kei ei thei sih nan locin, keima in note galhiem kang guon hi."},"6":{"text":"Nisuona lam le nitumna lam panin keima simlo koima dang a op lo lam amate in a thei nadingun, Topa khu keima ka hi a, koima dang a om sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in khuovah ka bawl a, khuomiel zong ka siem hi; keima in nopsahna ka siem a, lungkhamna zong ka siem hi; tam nate zosie a unpi-a a siem pa khu keima Topa ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Vantungte aw, tung lam panin zusah un, vantungte in dihna gua bangin zusah un; hutdamna a phulto thei nadingin leitung kihongsah unlen, tua in dihna zong a posah thei nadingin, keima Topa in tua khu ka siem zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma ang Bawlpa tawh a kihau mi pa, beelkheng pa tawh a kiledo leibeel in gimna nga taheh! Tungman in a khengpa kungah, “Bang bawl na hei, ahi sihle, “Na sil bawl in a tuhna nei lo hi,” ci-in a gen amah?","ref":"Rom 9:20"},"10":{"text":"A pa kungah, “Nang in koi na piengsah ei?” a cipa hi tale, numei kungah, “Nang in nausuoh dingin bang pen gimpi na hei?” a cipa in gimna thuoh taheh!"},"11":{"text":"Ama a Bawlpa, Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: “Nang in keima’ tate thu ei dong a, ahi sihle ka khut tawh ka silbawl tawh kisai thu ei pie ding na mah?"},"12":{"text":"Keima in leitung ka bawl a, tua tungah mi ka siem hi; vantungte a zah khu ka khutte ahi a, keima in vantung na honpite zosie thu ka pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Dihna lamah Cyrus ka cil a, keima in ama’ lampi zosie ka tangsah ding hi; ama in nasep manh ding ahi sihle thaman a dei zieh hi loin, ka khuopi lam ding a, saltang ka mite hla ding hi,” Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Egypt’ hauna le Ethiopia sumbuh vante le na kungah a tunsang Seba mite hing pei-in, nangma-a’ ang hi ding vua, nangma’ nua ang zui ding uhi; siakol bulsa-in amate ang pei-in na mai-ah ang kun ding uhi. Amate in nangma kungah thumna ang nei ding vua, “Nangma beh tawh Pasien omton a, koima dang a om sih hi; ama simlo pasien dang om lo hi,” ang ci ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"A mantahin, Israel-te’ Pasien, hundampa aw, nangma a kiphuol Pasien na hi a,"},"16":{"text":"amate a unpi-un zumin a zala gawp vua, milim bawlte zong amtawngin a peiton uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in kumtawn hutdamna tawh Israel a hundam hi; note in maizum thuoh loin, kumtawnin zong na zala sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile vantungte a siempa (ama Pasien ahi hi!) leitung a siem pa le a bawl pa (tua khu a kipsah pa; ama in tua khu buoi nadingin siem loin, ten nadinga a bawl pa!) Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Keima Topa ka hi a, koima dang om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in khuomielna gam sungah thu ka dapgen sih hi; Jacob’ suonlehlahte kungah, “Buoina lahah kei ei sui in,” zong ka ci sih hi. Keima Topa in thuman ka gen a, thudih ka tangko hi."},"20":{"text":"Minamte lahah a suohtate aw, kikhawmin peiton unlen, ei nai un! A sing milimte uh a puo kawikawi-te in theina a nei sih vua, a hundam thei lo pasien kungah thu a ngenngen uhi.","title":"Milimte in Babylon Hun Zo Lo"},"21":{"text":"Pholah unlen, na thu uh sung un; amate kikumtonsah un! Sawtveipi lai-in tami koi gen ahei? Tanglai-in koi in a gen ahei? Keima Topa hi lo ka mah? Keima simlo pasien dang om lo a, a dih Pasien le Hundampa khat a om hi; keima simlo pasien dang om lo a, keima sim koima dang om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Leimong a om mi zosie aw, keima lam hing kihei unlen hutdamin om un! Azieh pen keima Pasien ka hi a, koima dang om lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei le kei ka kiciem zo a, dihna ziehin ka kam panin ang kinuale lo ding le ang pusuoh ding thu in: “Keima kungah mi zosie ang khupdin ding a, lei zosie ang kiciem ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 14:11; Phil 2:10-11"},"24":{"text":"Topa sung behah dihna le thahatna om hi, ei kici ding hi; ama tunga a lungthah zosie ama kungah ang pei ding a, amate kimaizumsah ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa sungah Israel’ suonlehlahte zosie guolzo-in a kisiel ding uhi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bel pasien khupbawhin Nebo pasien kunsuh a, a milimte uh vangih a puo ganhingte in a puo hi. Note’ puoh tami vante pen ganhing a gimte tungah vangih bangin kisuon hi."},"2":{"text":"Amate kunin a khupbawh ton uhi; amate in a vangih puoh uh pengsah thei lo a, amate mama galmatin a pei zawsop uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na suo-a kipan kang tawi, naubu sung pana kang puoh, Jacob innkuon, Israel innkuon panin a omlai zosiete aw, ka thu ngai un;"},"4":{"text":"na vuoi dong nangawnun keima khu ama ka hi a, na sam uh a kan dong nangawnun keima in note kang puo ding hi; keima in kang bawl zo a, keima in kang puo ding hi; keima in kang tawi ding a, kang hundam ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Note in kei, koi tawh ei kisunsahin koi tawh ei kikimsah ding a, ka kibahpi dingin koi tawh ei tekah ding na hi uh ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Sum-ip pana kham a nopzah mite in tawitena tawh ngun te-in, khamseh pa a ciel vua, amate in tua nate pasien-in a bawlpieh hi; tua ciengin khupbawhin tua milim a bie uhi!"},"7":{"text":"A liengko vuah tua pasien khangin a puo vua, a opna munah koi-in tua munah kitung hi; a opna panin khum mun panin kikhin thei lo hi; ama tungah mi khatpo a kiko vangin ama in a dawng sih a, ama in lungkhamna panin zong koima a hunkhie thei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"No thupalsat mite aw, tami thu phawhin ngaisun unlen, lungngai pha unlen,"},"9":{"text":"hun lui thute phawh un; azieh pen kei Pasien ka hi a, adang koima om lo hi. Kei Pasien ka hi a, keima bang koima om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"A kipat cil panin a tawp tanpha-in ka gen a, tangtawng lai panin a pieng nai lo nate genin, “Ka lungtup kip ding a, ka ngaisutna ka tangtun ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Nisuona panin sasiel a ne va khat ka hlan a, ka lungtup a sem dingin mun gamla panin mi khat ka hlan hi. Ka gensa ahi ta a, ka tangtun ding hi; ka gelsa ahi ta a, ka sem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"No a lungtang khau mite le hutkhietna tawh a kigamla mite aw, ka thu gen ngai un;"},"13":{"text":"ka hutkhietna a nai-ah kang peipi a, a gamla sih hi. Tuale keima’ hutdamna khu a kiheh sih ding hi; keima’ minthanna ahi Israel adingin Zion ah ka hutdamna ka koi ding hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngahnu siengtho Babylon tanu aw, kumsuh inlen leivui lahah to in! Chaldea tanu aw, kumpi topha a op lona lei lahah tosuh in! Bangzieh ahei cile nang a khangmoi, a ngeh dihdeh ang kici nawn sih ding hi.","title":"Babylon’ Maizumna"},"2":{"text":"An gawina suongte la-in an gawi inlen, na kikhuna puon ladawh in. Na puontuol sutin, na keng dawhsah inlen, gunte kantan in."},"3":{"text":"Guohtang na hina khu loin a om ding a, na zumhuoina teng kimu ding hi. Keima in phu ka la ding a, koima ka hinkhawi sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Eite’ Tanpa, ama’ min pen Vanglien Topa , Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Chaldea’ tanu aw, dai tahin to inlen, khuomu lahah pei in! Bangzieh ahei cile nang pen kumpi gamte’ kumpinu ang kici nawn sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite tungah ka lungthah a, ka gouluo ka buasah hi; na khut sungah amate kang pie a, amate tungah hepina na lah sih hi; khanghamte tungah a gih mama dingin na hahkol na bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang in, “Kumpi nu hi zing na vang,” na kici a, tuaci’n tam thute ngaisun loin a thumong zong na phawhkha sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in nang a noptat, lungmuong taha a to hit hiet, na lungsim sungah, “Keima ka hi hi, keima lo koima om lo hi; meigongin to sih vangin, tate zong sisuo sih vang,” a ci nu in tam thu ngai in."},"9":{"text":"Bakhat, ni khat sungin na tungah tamte gel ang tung ding hi: Aisan siemna le mibum siemnate nasie tahin nei nan lacin nang tungah ta le naute sina le meigonna ang tung veve ding hi.","ref":"Kln 18:7-8"},"10":{"text":"Na gitlona-ah na lungmuong hi; “Koima in kei ei mu sih,” na ci hi. Na pilna le na theina in nang ang puikhiel ta a, tuale na lungsim sungah, “Keima ka hi, kei simlo midang om sih,” na ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Hizongle na damsah thei lo sietna na tungah ang tung ding a, na mansah thei lo gimna na tungah ang tung ding hi; na tungah na theikhah lo manthaina thakhatthu-in ang tung ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na neulai pana na sep na mibumna le na aisannate ah kiptahin om in; nang in na muolsuo kha thei ding a, mite na zausah kha thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na thu kikuppi mi tampite ziehin na lung a gim mama hi; vantung nate kanin aasi zong enin, hladet siela nangma tungah bang thu pieng ding ci thu ang magen mite dingsah inlen, kihundamsah in."},"14":{"text":"En in, amate bukung tawh kibang a, mei in amate a katum sieng hi; meikuong’ hatna panin amau le amau a kihun thei sih uhi. Tam pen khuolum nading mei-am hi lo a, a mai-ah to-in awi ding mei zong hi lo hi!"},"15":{"text":"Na neu lai pana na sum suipi, na septonpi mite in nang tungah ang sep hu thei tam bang teng ahi hi; amate a lampi cietah a vahthap vua, nang ang hundam ding koima om lo hi.","ref":"Isa 13:1–14:23; Jer 50:1–51:64"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel min tawh a kilo, Judah laigui pana a pieng; Topa’ min tawh kiciem napi thuman thutah tawh Israel Pasien kunga thu a ngen lo Judah innkuon aw, tam thu ngai un.","title":"A Siempa Pasien le a Tanpa"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen khuopi siengtho min tawh amau le amau a kihlan vua, Israel Pasien tungah a kingam uhi; Ama’ min Vanglien Topa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Sawtpi lai-in amasa nate kang gen zo a, ka kam panin tuate pusuohin, ka kitheithangsah hi; tua ciengin tuate thakhatin ka bawl a, a pieng hi."},"4":{"text":"Note na lungkhau vua, na ngawng uh sia thagui tawh kibang a, na talpang uh sumngo tawh a kibah lam ka thei ziehin,"},"5":{"text":"note in, “Ka milim un tamte bawl a, a kisui ka milim ule a kisung ka milim un amate thu a pie hi,” na ci thei lo nadingun note tungah sawtpi lai panin thu kang gen zo a, tuate a pien masangin na tung vuah kang zasah zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Na za zo ta uhi; tu-in tamte zosie en un; nang in tua khu na pulah sih ding amah? Tu-a kipanin a tha nate, na thei nai lo uh, a ki-imcip nate note kang zasah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate kipiengsah a, sawt nai lo hi; note in “Tuate thei zo ta ung,” na ci thei lo nadingun, a tawpsa hunin note in tua thute na za ngai nai sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Note in za ngai nai loin, zong na theikha nai sih vua, tanglai-a panin na bil uh a kihong nai sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile nangma in zuouthu tawh na na sem a, na suo-a kipanin mi ledo pa ang kici ding lamtah ka thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in ka min ka khuolna-in ka lungthahna ka die a, keima in ei kipawhna ka khuolna-in note kang thagam lo nadingin ka ki-ip hi."},"10":{"text":"En un, note kang siensuo zo a, ahi vangin ngun na bang sih uhi; keima in gimna meikhuh sungah note kang zelah zo ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima ka kikhuolna, keima ka kingaisutna-in tami ka bawl hi, azieh pen bang dingin ka min kigensiesah ding ka hei? Keima in mi khat tungah ka minthanna ka pie sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kang hlatsa Israel le Jacob aw, ka thu ngai un: Kei Ama ka hi hi; kei amasa pen ka hi a, a nukhia pen zong ka hi hi.","ref":"Isa 44:6; Kln 1:17; 22:13"},"13":{"text":"Ka khut in leitung khuombul phut a, ka zietlam khut in vantungte a zah hi; keima in amate ka hlat ciengin amate ang ding to pai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na unpi-un hing kikhawm unlen za un! Amate lahah tam thute koi in gen ding ahei? Topa in ama a it hi; Babylon tungah a lungtup sem ding a, Chaldea-te lang khatah zong ama’ banhat a pang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei, keima nangawn in thu ka gen a, ama ka hlan hi. Keima in ama ka peipi zo ta a, a sepna a dau pei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei kung ei nai unlen, tam thu hing za un! A cila kipanin thu ka dap gen ngai sih a, tua thu a piena kipanin khum munah ka om zo hi. Tuale tu-in Topa Pasien in keima le ama’ hlagau ei sawl zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma’ Tanpa, Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Nangma’ hoi nadinga thu ang hil, na zui dinga kilawm lampi-ah ang pui, keima khu Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Aw ka thupiehte na thuse hi lacin! Na nopsahna gunpi bang ding a, na guolzawna zong tuipi a tuihuol bang kha ngel ding hi;"},"19":{"text":"na cihlahte senel za pha-in na suonlehlahte zong senel tang za a pha ding hi; keima mai-ah amau’ min kisumaimang ngai loin, zong kisusie lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Babylon panin peikhie unlen, Chaldea panin tai un. Kipahna awging tawh tam thu genin pulah unlen, leimong dongin puoh un. “ Topa in a nasem Jacob tankhie zo hi!” ci-in gen kawikawi un.","ref":"Kln 18:4"},"21":{"text":"Ama in senel gam kantanin amate a pui ciengin a dang uh taa lo hi. Ama in amate adingin suongpi panin tui pulsah a, ama in suongpi satkehin tui a luongsah hi."},"22":{"text":"“Migilote adingin kilemna om lo hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 57:21"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a om gamte aw, ka thu ngai unlen, no a gamlapi-a omte aw, na bil hing daw un! Topa in ka suo masangin keima ei na hlan zo a, ka nu sunga ka op lai-in ka min ei na phuo zo hi.","title":"Nasempa’ Nasep","ref":"Jer 1:5"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ka kam, namsau tat hiemsa bangsah a, ama’ khut hlim sungah keima ei phuol hi. Ama in a kinawt ngil thaltang bangin keima ei bawl a, ama’ thaltang lawng sungah keima ei phuol hi.","ref":"Heb 4:12; Kln 1:16"},"3":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Ka nasem Israel na hi hi; nangma ziehin ka minthang ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in, “Amawhna-in na ka sem a, bangma lo le amawhna-in ka thatang ka zang hi; hinanle pel loin ka vai teng Topa kungah om a, ka thaman zong ka Pasien kungah om hi,” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama kungah Jacob kipeipi kia-in, ama kungah Israel-te a kisuhtuo thei nadingin Topa muna-ah ei kipatawi a, Pasien pen ka thahatna suohin, ama nasem dingin ka nu sungah keima ei piengsah Topa in tu-in thu a gen hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in, “Jacob minamte a lamto ding le Israel a suohtate a ngai bangsahkia dingin, ka nasem pa na hina pen a bailam no khat ahi hi. ka hutdamna in leimong dong a phah thei nadingin minamte tunga khuovah ahi dingin nang kang pie ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel a Tanpa le ama’ Siengtho Pa ahi Topa in nahpi taha a kisimmaw, minamte’ huot bawl, gam uhte’ nasempa tungah, “Nangma ang teel a muonhuoi Topa , Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa ziehin, mite na hutdamna thu kumpite in ang mu ciengun ang dingto ding vua, uliente amau le amau ang khupbawh ding uhi,” ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Ang angvan hunin keima in nang kang dawng zo a, hutdamna ni-in nang kang panpi zo hi; keima in note kang kem a, mite dinga thuciemna banga kang pieh na hi a, nang in gam na phu nading le a kinuasiesa goute na hawmpieh nadingin,","title":"Zion’ Tate Innah Kipeipi ding"},"9":{"text":"thongkiate kungah, “Hing pusuoh un,” ci-in, miel lahah a om mite kungah, “No le no hing kilah un,” ka cisah ding hi.
