Amate in lampi dungah an a ne ding vua, muolvum pawn zosie a an maina uh hi ding hi;"},"10":{"text":"amate gilkiel loin, a dangta sih ding vua, huisa le nisa zong a thuoh sih ding uhi, azieh pen amate a khuotuo pa in amate mapui ding a, ama in tuinah pulna munah amate a peipi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka muol teng zosie lampi ka suohsah ding a, ka lam lienpite ka sangsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"En un, a gamlapi panin tamte ang pei ding vua, en un, tamte leilu lam le nitumna panin ang pei-in, Syene gam panin tamte ang pei ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Vantungte aw, kipahin la sa unlen, leitung aw, lungdamin dieng in; muolte aw, awngin la sa un! Azieh pen Topa in mite hlamuon zo a, gentheina a thuohte tungah lainatna nei ta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle Zion in, “ Topa in kei ei nuasie zo a, ka Topa in kei ei mangngil zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Numei in nawitep lai a ta mangngil thei-in, a sunga pieng a tapa khuotuo loin a om thei ding amah? Tamte nangawn in mangngil kha thei ding a, hinanle ken note kang mangngil sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"En un, ka khutphang gel sungah nangma kang giel zo ta a, na kulpi bangte zong ka mai-ah a om zing hi."},"17":{"text":"Ang lam mite ang susiete sangin hatzaw a, ang susiete in ang peisan ta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na kimvelah khuodahin en in; amate a unpi-un a kikhawmin na kung ang zuon uhi. Topa in a genna ah, keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin, kizepna bangin tuate na sil ding a, motha bangin tuate na sil ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A kilawisa le a daidamsa na munte le a kisiecip nangma’ gamte- na sunga a tengte adingin tu-in ahile ang kuocih valon ding a, nangma ang valtumte gamlapi-ah a om ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na da hun sung vua a pieng na tate in na zahna vuah, “Kei adingin mun kawcih luo hi; ka ten nading uh mun ei bawlpieh in,” ang ci ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin na lungsim sungah, “Tam mite koi’ hinsah ahiei? Da le mau-in ka ciing a, salin ei kikaimang hi. Tuaci’n tamte koi’ kep adiei? Kei guohin ei kinuasie a, tam mite hei sung pana ang pei uh ahi diei?” na ci ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: A sawt loin minamte tungah ka khut ka lamto ding a, mite adingin ka lim ka khai ding hi; amate in a kang sung vuah na tapate uh tawi-in ang puoh ding vua, amate in na tanute uh a liengko vuah puo-in ang puoh ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpite pen note ang kem na pate suoh ding a, kumpinute zong note ang khoi na nute suoh ding uhi. Amate in a mai uh tuol lam ngatin nang kungah a khupbawh ding vua, amate in na kephanga leivui baangte ang liepieh ding uhi. Tua ciengin note in Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi. Keima ei ngahte in zumna a thuoh sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Mihat pa kung panin amau’ samat kilahpieh zo a, mi zothaw pa in sala a mat mite a kihunkhie zo amah?"},"25":{"text":"Hizongnanle Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Mihatpa’ mat salte nangawn kiladawh ding a, mi zothaw pa’ samat zong kihunkhie ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile nangma ang dem mite keima tawh ka kidem ding a, na tate ka hundam ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Nang bawlsie mite in amau’ sa ka nesah ding a, zukham bangin amau’ si ma dawnin a kham ding uhi. Tua ciengin kei pen Jacob’ Vanglien Pa, nang ang Tankhie pa, nang ang hunpa Topa ka hi lam mi zosie in ei thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Ama a nua-a ka peisahna, na nu uh a kikhulna lai hei sungah om ahei? Ahi sihle nang kang zuana ka leibatnate koi ahei? Hi lo hi, na mawna zieh vua note ang kizua uh ahi a, na tawnkhiel zieh vua na nu uh kikhul ahi bo hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua munah kang pei lai-in bang zieha mi koima om lo ahei? Kang hlat lai-in bang zieha ei dawng ding koima om lo ahei? A tankhie zo lo dingin ka khut a tom talawm amah? Ahi sihle a hlakhie dingin thahatna ka nei sih amah? Ka phawsietna tawh tuipi ka gawsah a, gunte zong senel gam ka suohsah hi. Tui a op lo ziehin a ngate uh ui than sieng a, dangta-in a si uhi."},"3":{"text":"Vantungte puonvom ka silsah a, la-ip puon tawh ka khu hi."},"4":{"text":"Kammal khat tawh a gim mite ka thahatsah thei nadingin, Topa Pasien in keima siepa khat’ lei ei na guon a, ama in thu kihil mite banga thu ka ngai thei nadingin zingmawng sielin ei phong a, ka bil a khanglosah hi.","title":"Nasempa Kisimmawna le Dihtansahna"},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasien in ka bil ei honpieh zo a, ama langpang nawn loin, ka nuangat nawn sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei ei vuote ka elzang ka daw a, ka khamul a botkieute ka bieng ka daw hi; zakona le cilphitna panin ka maitang ka phuol sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa Pasien in kei ei hu a, tua ahi ziehin ka muolpho sih hi; tua ziehin meituh suong bangin ka maitang ka daw a, ei kimaizumsah lo ding hi, ci-in keima in ka thei hi;"},"8":{"text":"keima’ thumanna a langsah pa khu keima kungah a om hi. Keima ei dem ding koi ahiei? Eite dingto ciet va vui. Ka kidopi koi teng ahei? Ei kimaituosah un."},"9":{"text":"Kei ei panpi pen khu Topa Pasien ahi hi. Koi ahiei keima ei mawsiet ding? Amate zosie puon bangin paatin nget in amate a netum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa giing a, a nasem pa’ thu a mang, khuomiel sungah lam pei-in, khuovah a nei lo, hinanle Topa’ min muongin Pasien tunga kingam note lahah koi pen ahiei?"},"11":{"text":"Hinanle na unpi-un mei a tawkuongte le meisel a dete na hi uhi. Na meikuong sung ule na tawsa uh meiselte lahah vah kawikawi un! Note in keima’ khut pana na nei ding uh tami ahi hi: Note in bawlsietna thuohin na lumsuh ding uhi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa sui a, dihna lam a zuite aw, ka thugen ngai un. Note ang kilemna suongpi le note ang kitawna suongkhuh en un.","title":"Pasien’ Mite adingin Thupha Kikhol (Pien 12:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Na pa uh Abraham le note ang hing Sarah en un; azieh pen khat tang ahi lai-in ama ka hlan a, ama thupha pie-in tampi ka phasah hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in Zion henem ding a, ama in a daidamsa ama’ mun zosie henemin, a gamlah zong Eden bangsah ding a, a senel gam zong Topa’ um bangsah ding hi; ama sungah lungnopna kipahna, lungdamkona le lasahna awging kiza ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mite aw, ka thu ngai unlen, ka minamte aw, na bil daw un; azieh pen ka kung panin thuhilna khat pusuoh ding a, ka thutanna in minamte tungah khuovah hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na kung vuah ka hutkhietna kang naw peisah ding hi, ka hutdamna peikhie zo a, ka banhat in mite a uh ding hi. Tuipi gei-a gamte in ei lamen vua, keima’ banhat khu a kinepna uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantung lamah dahto unlen, nei lama om leitung ensuh un; azieh pen meikhu bangin vante mangthai-in, leitung puonsil bangin tonci ta ding a, a tunga teng teng zong thovai bangin a sigam ta ding uhi; hizongle kumtawnin ka hutkhietna om ding a, a tatkhietna in zong tawp hun nei lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Thumanna thei a, na lungsim sung vuah ka thuhil a vom mite aw, kang thugen ngai un; mihingte’ gensietna zau sih unlen, ang hosiet ciengun lungkie sih un."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen puonsil bangin amate nget in netum ding a, samul puon bangin lungno in amate netum ding hi; hizongle ka hutkhietna kumtawnin om ding a, ka hutdamna zong khantanin a om ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Khanglo in, khang lo in, thahatna puon sil in, Topa’ banhat aw! Hun lui lai, khanghun sawtpi lai-a bangin khanglo in! Rahab a semnen pa, gulhiempi sunpailet pa nang hi lo na mah?"},"10":{"text":"Tuipi, tui thuhpite a gawsah pa zong nangma na hi a; hutdamsate a galkai nadinga tuipi thuh tunga lam sielpa zong nangma hi lo na mah?"},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ tatsate kilekia ding a, la a sah kawmun Zion zuon ding uhi; a lutung vuah kumtawn nopna om ding a; amate in kipahna le nopna nga-in, dana le kaanate a taimang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei, keima khu note ang henempa ka hi hi; tua leh bang dingin lopa banga a muol thei, a si valon ding mi maimai khat na hici giin uh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Note in vante zahin leitung khuombul phut pa, note ang siem Topa na mangngil ta uhi. Note hing suhsiet sawmin mi bawlsie pa’ sinsona ziehin sunthapai-in na zau zing uhi. Hinanle mi bawlsie pa’ sinsona hei sungah om ahei?"},"14":{"text":"A kibawlsie mite mallangin kihla ding hi; amate si loin Leihawm sungah a peisuh sih ding vua, anneh tuidawn zong a kitasam sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kei pen tuihuolte a mau nadinga tuipi a lawhgawp pa note’ Topa ka hi a, ama’ min pen Vanglien Topa ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma’ kam sungah ka thute ka guong zo a, keima’ khut lim nei-ah nangma kang sel hi. Keima in vantungte zahin lei bulpi ka phut a, Zion kungah zong, ‘Nang keima’ mi na hi hi,” ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hing tho in, nang mama hing tho in! Topa’ khut sung panin a thangpaina hai a dawn zo, a dopnieh dongin hawipuana haipi a dawnkham zo Jerusalem aw, hing ding dawh in.","ref":"Kln 14:10; 16:19"},"18":{"text":"A hinsa a tapate lahah ama lam a lah ding koima om lo hi; ama in a kepsa a tapate lahah ama a khut tawh a kai ding koima om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang tungah tami thu nite a tung zo hi. Kisietna le manthaina, kielpi le namsau ahi hi. Koi pen in nang ang henem ta diei?"},"20":{"text":"Na tapate a balia ta vua, ngen thanga a awh sanang bangin khuolai lamlien bul zosie-ah amate a lum uhi. Topa’ thangpaina, na Pasien uh’ hosietna tawh amate a kidim uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a liem, zu ne lopi zukham a bang note in tam thu za un."},"22":{"text":"Ama’ mite adinga a thumpieh na Pasien uh, Thunei pen Topa na Pasien un tam bangin gen hi: En un, na khut sung panun hawipuana hai ka la zo hi; note in ka thangpaina haipi na dawnkia nawn sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Note kungah, “Na tung vua lam ka hlah thei nadingun na khupbawh un,’ ang ci, no ang bawlsie mite’ khut sung panin tua haipi ka koi ding hi,” a ci hi. Na ngumzang uh leilah bangin bawlin, khuolai lampi bangin amau’ lam hlah nading na bawl zo ta uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion aw, khanglo in, khang lo in, thahatna puon sil in! Khuopi siengtho Jerusalem aw, na puon hoite sil in; azieh pen nangma sungah tep tan lote le a bua mite ang lut nawn lo ding hi.","title":"Zion Kipah Heh","ref":"Kln 21:2, 27"},"2":{"text":"A kiman Jerusalem aw, leivui panin kithing inlen ding in. A kiman Zion tanu aw, na ngawnga ang kikhina khaute sut in!"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Bangma loin ang kizua a, sum pieh loin ang kitan ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien in tam bangci hi: Hun sawtpi lai-in Egypt ah pemta-in ka mite a na peisuh uhi; Assyria-te in a thu om lo pi-in amate na bawlsie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ka mite a thu om lo pi-in kikaimang ta ahi ziehin tami munah bang bawl ding ka hei? Topa in ci hi. A makaite uh a awng vapuoh vua, sunthapai-in ka min kigensie den hi.","ref":"Rom 2:24"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka mite in keima’ min thei ding uhi; tua ziehin thu gen pa keima ka hi a, khum ni ciengin tam muna ka op lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kilemna thu a phuongzah, lungdamna thu a puoh, hutdamna thu a tangko, Zion tungah, “Na Pasien maang hi,” ci-a muolte tungah thu a gen, kamtaipa’ keng khu bangza tahin etlawm ahei.","ref":"Nah 1:15; Rom 10:15; Eph 6:15"},"8":{"text":"Ngai un! na galvilte un a aw uh sangsah a, lungdam tahin amate in la a saton uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Zion ah Topa a kilekiana amate in a mit utawh a mu uhi."},"9":{"text":"A kisie no Jerusalem munte aw, la sa-in kiko ton un; azieh pen Topa in a mite henem zo a, ama in Jerusalem tankhie zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Minam zosie’ muna-ah Topa in a ban siengtho lah zo a, leimongte zosie in i Pasien’ hutdamna a mu ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Kihem un, kihem un. Khum mun panin pei dawh ta un! Topa’ umlebeel a puote aw, a sieng lo nate khoi sih un; khum mun panin pei dawh unlen, no le no kisiensuo tawm un.","ref":"2Cor 6:17"},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na mai vuah Topa ang pei-in, Israel’ Pasien pen note’ nuadal ding ahi ziehin, a kinawsa-in pei loin, lauthawngsa-in zong na pei sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"En un, ka nasempa a daupei ding hi; ama kitawi sangin kidomto ding a, a sang mama ding hi.","title":"Bawlsietna Thuoh Nasempa"},"14":{"text":"Ama lamdang a sa mi tampi a op ma bangin, a meelpuoh dan pen mi zong sun nawn loin a meel kisiegawp a, mihing bang nawn loin a guong zong kisie hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in minam tampite a dipkuosah ding hi; ama ziehin kumpite in a kam a hum ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in a kigen ngai lo nate a mu ding vua, a zah ngai nai lo uh nate a lungngai ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 15:21"}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I zah uh thute koi in um ahei? Topa’ banhat khu koi tungah kilang ahei?"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen ama singno dawng khat bang le lei gaw lahah hui a hla singzung bangin ama mai-ah ang khangdawh hi; eite’ et dingin ama in guong kilawm le thupina nei lo a, eite’ ipla thei dingin zong ama in melhoina bangma nei lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Midangte in ama simmaw-in a nuol uhi; gimna a thuoh mipa le natna tawh kilawi lo pa ahi hi; tuale mite in mu nuom loin midangte in a mai uh a humsan mipa bangin ama kisimmaw a, eite in zong bangma-in i sim sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in eite’ gimna teng thuoh a, eite’ natna teng a puo tahtah hi; hinanle Pasien in ama sat a, gimsah hi, ci-in eite in i ngaisun hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite’ tatsietna ziehin ama in liemna thuoh a, eite’ khielna ziehin ama kitehpuong hi; eite in nopna i nga thei nadingin ama in dan thuoh a, ama’ liemmate ziehin eite in damna i nga uhi."},"6":{"text":"I unpi-un tuu bangin lam i khiel sieng ta uhi; i unpi-un i lampi cietah i kipei ta vua, tuale Topa in eite’ khielna zosie, ama tungah a nga ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama kibawlsie-in gimna kithuohsah nanle a kam a kah vawt sih hi. Gaw dinga kipeipi tuuno le a mulheute’ mai-a kipeipi a ham lo tuu bangin ama in a kam a keh sih hi.","ref":"Kln 5:6"},"8":{"text":"A man lo thukhenna tawh ama a kikaimang hi. Koi in ama’ mailam ding ngaituo pieh thei ding ahei? Azieh pen a hingte’ gam panin ama kisumaimangin, ka mite’ thupalsatna ziehin ama in gimna a thuoh hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:32-33"},"9":{"text":"Ama tatsie loin a kamah zuou thu om sih nanle, amate in migilote tawh hankhuh a kibang, mihaute tawh a kibangin han a bawlpieh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama gimna tawh a kitepuong ding pen Topa’ deina ahi hi. Mawna zieha biehna-in ama’ hinna na pieh ciengin, ama in a suonlehlahte mu ding a, tuale ama a damsawt ding hi; ama tungtawnin Topa’ deina a lawcing ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in lungkhamna panin khuovah a mu ding hi; a theina tungtawnin ama in lungkimna mu ding hi. Midih ka nasempa in mi tampi dihsah ding a, amau’ khielnate ama in puo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin miliente tawh ama tanh ka hawmpieh ding a, ama in a thahat mite tawh galvan lahte a hawm ding hi; azieh pen ama in sina sungah a hinna sungsuh a, mi tawnkhielte tawh kisimtha hi; hinanle ama in mi tampite’ mawna puohpieh a, mi tawnkhielte adingin a thumpieh hi."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ta a nei lo, a ciing nu aw, la sa in; nausuoh natna a thuoh ngai lo nu aw, la sa-in awng vapo in! Azieh pen pasal nei numei’ tate sangin a kinuasie numei’ tate tamzaw ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Tawntung Kilemna Thuciemna","ref":"Gal 4:27"},"2":{"text":"Na buhmun khan inlen, na tenna puonbuhte kizalsah in.; na khaute nua ziel sin; na khaute sausah inlen, na khuomte phutdet in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen veilam le ziet lamah na kithezah ding vua, na suonlehlahte in minamte’ gou luo-in, a kilawi khuopite-ah a teng ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Zau sin, azieh pen maizumna na thuoh sih ding hi; lungkie sin, azieh pen zakona na thuoh sih ding hi; bang ding ahei cile na khangno lai-a na maizumna na mangngil ding a, meigong na hi zieha ang kizakona na phawh kha nawn sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen ang siempa na pasal ahi a, ama’ min Vanglien Topa ahi hi; nangma ang tankhie pa pen Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa ahi a, ama pen leitung buppi’ Pasien kici hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kidon lo, a lungkham vangut, tangval’ zi ahisa, a kikhul zi a kihlatkia bangin Topa in nangma ang hlankia hi, na Pasien in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Bakhat sung kang nuasie zuai a, ahi vangin lainatna lienpi tawh kang khawmkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tui banga a let ka lungthahna ziehin na kung panin bakhat sung ka mai ka phuol a, ahi vangin kumtawn itna tawh na tungah lainatna kang nei ding hi, nang ang Tanpa Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam pen kei adingin Noah’ hun lai bang ahi hi: Leitungah Noah’ tuite ang peikia nawn lo ding, ci-a ka kiciem ma bangin na tungah lungthah nawn loin, kang phawhsie nawn sih ding hi, ci-in ka kiciem zo hi.","ref":"Pien 9:8-17"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen muol sangte kihemin, muol neute kikhin thei hi, ahi vangin nangma kung panin ka itna kip kihem lo ding a, ka kilemna thuciem kikhin lo ding hi, nang tunga lainatna a nei Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Gimna a thuoh, huipi’ sema a awnsa, ang kihenem lo khuopi aw, keima in suongkang vuite tawh na suongte ka lam ding a, na inn khuombulte zong sappphire suong tawh ka phut ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na inn khumvumte ruby suongte tawh, na kul kotpite, jewel suonghoite tawh, na kulpi bangte zong suong manphate tawh ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Kln 21:18-21"},"13":{"text":"Na tapate uh a unpi-in Topa in hil ding a, na tapate uh a hau mama ding uhi.","ref":"Jhn 6:45"},"14":{"text":"Dihna sungah nang ang kikipsah ding hi; nang na zau lo ziehin bawlsietna tawh na kigamla ding hi, nang na zau sih ding a, dipkuotna tawh na kigamla ding hi; azieh pen na kungah tuate ang tung lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi khatpo in kitawhmawna a bawl leh tua pen keima kung pan hi lo hi. Note tawh kitawhmawna a bawl poma note ziehin a pua ding hi."},"16":{"text":"En un, ama’ nasep nadingin pum zapin, hiem a bawl siekhengpa khu keima’ piensah ahi hi; keima in a susie dingin a susie pa zong ka piengsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang do nadinga kibawl hiem poma mavang lo ding a, thukhenna sungah na langa a pang leii poma na thalpaih ding hi. Tam pen Topa’ nasemte’ gouluo le kei kung pan amau’ dihna kilahna ahi hi, Topa in ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A dangta mi zosie aw, tuikhuh hing zuon un; sum nei lote zong hing pei unlen hing ne un! Hing pei un, sum pieh kul lo man nei loin, lenggazu le bawngnawi hing ne un.","title":"A Kiningcing Hinkhuo Mang Dinga Cielna","ref":"Kln 21:6; 22:17"},"2":{"text":"An ahi lo nate lei nadingin bang dingin na sum uh zangin, gilva nading ahi lo pi-in bang dingin na sem na hi uh ahei? Ka thugen limtahin ngai-in an tuituoh ne unlen, antuite ah nuomsa-in om un."},"3":{"text":"Na bil daw unlen, ka kungah hing pei un; na hin thei nadingun ka thu gen ngai un. Note tawh tawntung thuciemna khat ka bawl ding a, David adingin a tul thei lo keima’ itna kip a om hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:34"},"4":{"text":"En un, ama pen mite tungah teci ka suohsah a, mite adingin makai le a uhpa dingin ka koi hi."},"5":{"text":"En un, na thei ngai lo uh minamte na hlan ding vua, ama in note hing thupisah zo ahi ziehin, Topa na Pasien uh, Israel’ Siengtho Pa ziehin na kung vuah ang thei ngai lo minamte ang tai ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"A kimu thei petin Topa sui unlen, a nai op petin ama hlan un;"},"7":{"text":"migilote in a lampi uh nuasie hinlen, midih lote in a ngaisutnate uh nuasie uheh; amate tungah ama in hepina a nei thei nadingin Topa i Pasien uh kungah amate kilesahkia un, azieh pen ama in kicingtahin a mawna uh a maisah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei ngaisutnate no ngaisutna ahi lo ziehin, na lampite uzong ka lampite ahi sih hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitung sangin vante a sanzawh ma bangin, ka lampite zong no lampi sangin sangzaw a, tua ma bangin ka ngaisutnate zong no ngaisutna sangin sangzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen vantung panin guotui le vua ang kie-in, amate in leitung a nomsah masangsie kinuale kia loin, kungnote mengin dawngsah a, khaici vawpa kungah khaici pie-in a ne pa kungah an a pieh ma bangin,","ref":"2Cor 9:10"},"11":{"text":"ka kam sung pan a pusuoh ka thu zong tua ma bang ding hi; keima kungah a hawmpi-in ang kile lo ding a, ama in ka lungtup tangtung sahin, ama ka sawlna thu a muolsuo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen kipah tahin na pei ding vua, lungnuom tahin ang kipeipi kia ding hi; na mai vuah muol le tangte in la sa-in awng ding a, gam sunga sing zosie in khut beng ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Lingkung tangin taasing po ding hi; theimi ling tangin mui kung po ding hi; Topa mai-ah tua khu phawna hi ding a, a kisattan lo ding kumtawn lim khat hi ding hi."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: thutang zang unlen, thumanin gamta un, azieh pen ka hutdamna ang tungbai ta ding a, ka hutkhietna ang kilang ta ding hi.","title":"A Zui Zosie Tungah Thuciemna Kizom"},"2":{"text":"Tam banga a gamta mite, tami thu a tukip mite, sabbath buasah loin tangin, sietna khatpo bawl nading panin a kideh zo mite pen mi nuomsa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa a bel gamdang mipa in, “ Topa in a mite panin kei ei khenkhie tahtah ding hi,” ci sih heh; Cilgesa pasal in, “Kei pen singgaw khat ka hi lel hi,” ci sih heh."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ka sabbath nite tangin ei lungdamsah thei nate teel a, ka thuciemna a tukip a kiget mite tungah,"},"5":{"text":"ka innsung le ka kulpi sunga tanu le tapate sanga a hoizaw phawna le min ka pie ding a, amate tungah suhmaimang nawn lo ding, a kip tawntung min ka pie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’ na a sem ding, Topa’ min a it ding, ama’ nasem a suoh dingin Topa a bel gamdang mite, sabbath ni tangin a buasah lo, ka thuciemna a tukip mi zosie"},"7":{"text":"ka muol siengtho-ah peipi-in ka thungetna inn sungah ka lungdamsah ding hi; keima in ka maitam tungah a meihal biehna ule a biehpiehnate uh kisang ding hi; azieh pen ka inn in mi namcin’ thungetna inn kici ding hi.","ref":"Mat 21:13; Mrk 11:17; Luk 19:46"},"8":{"text":"A kipampaih Israel a kaikhawm Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi. A kikaikhawmsa mite banah amate kungah midangte ka kaikhawm ding hi, a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"No gamsa zosie, gamlaha gamsa zosie, a valtum dingin hing pei un!","title":"Israel a Uhte’ Kisietna"},"10":{"text":"Israel’ galvilte a mit uh taw a, a unpi-un theina a nei sih uhi. Amate a unpi-un mi a kawh thei lo ui tawh a kibang vua, a lup kawmun mang a nei vua, kimut a du mama uhi."},"11":{"text":"Uite in zong an a hai vua, kham hun a nei ngai sih uhi; tuucingte in theitelna nei loin, a unpi-un a lampi ciet vuah a kihei uhi; amate in a unpi-un a phattuom nading beh uh a sui uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in, “Hing pei un, eite in zu sui vai; eite in khamtahin zucia dawn vai. Zing cieng zong tuni ang bang ding a, nuomzaw lai ding hi,” a ci uhi."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi thuman pa mangthai a, koima in ngaisutin nei lo hi; koima’ thei lo kalin a thutah mite kilamang hi. Azieh pen tuosietna panin midihte kilakhie a,","title":"Kimanna Neilo Israel’ Milim Biehna"},"2":{"text":"amate nopsahna sungah lut uhi; thutanga kalsuonte ahi uleh amau’ lupna tungah a tawlnga ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle no aisan numeite’ tate, angkawmte le a pahtatte’ suonlehlahte aw, tam sungah hing pei un."},"4":{"text":"Na simmaw uh koi hi a, koi langah na kam uh golkahin na leii uh phen na hi uh ahei? Note mi tawnkhielte’ tate, zuouphuohte’ suonlehlahte hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Gangpi sing lah le singna dum nei lahah a huasante’ kuom sung teng le suongpikawm tengah na tate uh a thatte hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Kuom sunga suong zolte lahah na tanh uh om a, tuate khu note’ tanh ahi hi; note in tuate tungah dawnthei biehna sungin an tawh biehna na tawi uhi. Tam silte ziehin kei ka lung a kim ding amah?"},"7":{"text":"Muolsang tungah na lupna na koi vua, a kithoi dingin tua munah na kato uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kotpi le kotpi khuom nua lamah na dawi biehna lim na suong uhi; azieh pen nang in kei ei nuasie-in na lupna na hawhkhie a, nangma tua tungah kato-in na lupna a golpi-in na hong hi; amate tawh thukimna bawlin, nang in a lupna uh na lunggul a, a guohtanga a om amate na kaihlit hi."},"9":{"text":"Sathau kengin Molech kungah na haw a, na panamtuite na tamsah semsem hi; gamlapi-ah na palaite na sawl a, Misikhuo nangawnah na sawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Na khuolzinna a tam ziehin nang na gim mama a, ahi vangin nang in, “Kimanna nei sih,” na ci sih hi. A kikuontawkia na lunggulna na mu a, nang na thazawm ta sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Koi na giin ziehin zuouthu genin kei ei phawh kha lo na hei? Ahi sihle na lungsim sungah ei ngaisun ta lo na mah? Ka mit singin ka dai dide zieha kei nei giin tah lo amah?"},"12":{"text":"Na dihna le na sepnate kang genpieh ding a, ahi vangin tamte in nang ang hu zo sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na kiko ciengin na milim kholte kihunsah in! Ahui in amate mutmangin husan khat in tuate semmang ding hi. Hinanle kei ei bel tapo in leitang nei ding a, ka muol siengtho zong a luo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Zih un, zih un, lampi bawl un; ka mite’ lampi a khahtan thei ding na zosie hemdawh un,” kici ding hi.","title":"Panpi nading le Damsah nading Kamciemna"},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen a sang le a kitawisang, tawntung muna a teng pa, ama’ min Siengtho a kici pa in tam bangin ci hi: Mun sang le mun siengtho-ah ka teng a, a kiniemkhieh mite’ lungsim le a kisiakia mite’ lungsim a thakhausah dingin kisiakiana lungsim le kiniemkhiehna lungsim neite tawh keima ka omton hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen amate ka mawsiet zing sih ding a, zong ka lungthah zing sih ding hi; azieh pen ka mai-ah mihing lungsim gim ding a, keima siemsa hinna nangawn a gim ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A gitlo huoihamna ziehin ka lung a thah hi; amate vuo-in ka kiphuol a, ka thang a pai hi; hinanle a lunglam ciet vuah a kihei lai veve uhi."},"18":{"text":"A lampite uh ka mu zo a, hinanle ka damsah ding hi; Keima in amate pui-in henepna tawh ka thuhkia ding a, a kapte adingin a kam gimman uh ka siempieh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Nopsahna, nopsahna, a gamla le a nai mite tungah om taheh; keima in amate ka damsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Eph 2:17"},"20":{"text":"Hinanle migilote pen a khawl thei lo tuipi tawh kibang a, a tuite in buon le buathahte a lamto uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ka Pasien in migilote adingin lungnopna om lo hi, ci hi.","ref":"Isa 48:22"}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Awng in, na aw nei za sit sin! Pengkul gin bangin na aw gingsah in! Ka mite kungah amau’ ledona le Jacob innkuon kungah amau’ mawna phuongzah in.","title":"A Zuou le a Man Biehna"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate pen a diha a gamta, a Pasien uh’ thupieh a nuasie lo, minam bang danin nisimin keima ei sui vua, ka lampite a thei nuom bang danin a om uhi; amate in ka kung panin a dih thukhenna ang ngen vua, amate in Pasien kung ang nai nuom uhi."},"3":{"text":"“Bang dingin nang mu lopi-in kote in an tang uh ka hei? Bang dingin nang phawkhah lopi-in kote kiniemkhieh uh ka hei?” En un, na antan ni-un noma’ deina na sui vua, na nasemte zosie na gawt uhi."},"4":{"text":"En un, a kisel ding, a kihau ding, gitlona khuttum tawh a kitum ding bepin note in an na tang uhi. Tuni-a na bawl uh tua bang antanna in a sangna lamah na aw uh a kizah thei nadingin ang bawlpieh sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima’ dei antanna in mi khat ama le ama ni khat sung bang beh kiniemkhieh ding amah? Pumpeng bangin a lu tuolkun suhin, la-ip puon le vut lahah lum ding amah? Note in tam pen antanna le Topa dinga san thei ni khat hi, na ci thei ding uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Keima’ dei antanna in: a thutang lo kikhinate phel nading, hahkol khaute sut nading, a kibawlsie mite hla nading, hahkol khaute suhtan nading hi lo amah?"},"7":{"text":"Tua khu a gilkielte na an uh hawm a, na inn vuah mizawng inn nei lote peipi-in, a guohtanga omte na mu ciengun amate puonse-in, na mite kung pana na kiphuol lona uh hi lo amah?","ref":"Mat 25:35-36"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin phalvah bangin na khuovah uh ang suoh ding a, na damsahna uzong tuisam bangin mallangtahin ang phul ding hi; nangma mai-ah dih ang tangsah pa pei ding a, Topa’ minthanna pen note’ nuadal hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin na hlan ding vua, Topa in ang dawng ding hi; panpina dei-in na kiko ding vua, Topa in, “Tanah ka om hi,” ang ci ding hi. Note lah panin hahkol, khutme tawh mi kawhte, thusie gente sumangin,"},"10":{"text":"gilkielte an pie-in, mi gentheite na taisah uleh, khuomiel lahah na khuovah uh ang suoh ding a, na khuomiel uzong sunlai ang bang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in note ang lampui zing ding a, ama in mun gawta-ah hing taisahin, na gu na tang uh a khausah ding hi; tui kibuoh zing um na bang ding vua, a tuite a kang ngai lo tuisam pulna na bang ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tanglai-a kisie na khuopite uh kilamkia ding hi; note in khang tampi sunga kisie bulkipte na dingsah kia ding uhi; note na hi uleh a cimsa kul a phawkiate, ten nading lampi a puophate ang kici ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Sabbath thuse lona pan le keima’ ni siengtho ni-a note’ deilam na sepnate panun na kikoicing zo vua, sabbath ni dei huoi sa-in, Topa’ ni siengtho pen note in patawi huoi na ci vua, noma’ lampi ciet zui loin, noma’ phattuom nading beh sem loin, noma’ vai beh na sep sih vua, na patawi uleh,"},"14":{"text":"tua ciengin Topa sungah na kipah ding vua, leitung munsangte-ah hing tuongsahin, na pu uh Jacob’ gouluo tawh note kang va ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ kam in a genzo hi."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, a hundam zo lo dingin Topa’ khut tom seng lo a, khuo a za thei lo dingin a bil zong bing lo hi.","title":"Thutanglo le Bawlsietna Dan Kipie"},"2":{"text":"Hinanle na khielna uh pen noma le na Pasien uh kikalah kikhenna suoh a, ama in a zah lo nadingin na mawnate un ama’ maitang a lie hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen sisan in na khut uh buasah a, na khutmete uzong khielna tawh bua hi; na kam un zuou thu gen a, na leii un gitlona thu a gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Thutang tawh koima in mi heh ngai lo a, citah tahin koima thukhen zumah pei lo hi; amate, bangma lo thusunnate tungah kinga-in zuouthu a gen vua, amate in nau bangin hahsatna paai-in mawna a suoh khie hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in gul guneite opin a keusah vua, mom khau puonin a gan uhi; a tui a nekha poma si a, a kitawkeh a tui panin muoltan no khat a keu hi."},"6":{"text":"A momkhaute uh puonin kizang thei lo hi; silbawlte utawh a kikhu thei sih uhi. A nasep uh pen gitlo nasep hi a, a khut sung vuah tatsietna om hi."},"7":{"text":"Sietna lamah a keng uh tai a, mawpeng mite sisan suo ding kinaw mama uhi; a ngaisutnate uh gitlo ngaisutna hi a, a lamlienpite vuah sietna le manthaina om hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungmuonna lampi a thei sih vua, a lampite vuah thutang om lo hi. Amate in a lampite uh a kawi-in a bawl uhi; tua sunga peite koima in lungmuonna mu lo hi.","ref":"Rom 3:15-17"},"9":{"text":"Tua ziehin eite tawh thutang kigamla a, thudih in eite ei ban lo hi; eite in khuovah i ngah vua, ngai un! khuomiel a om hi; eite in a vah i ngah vua, hizongle miel lam i zawt uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mittaw bangin kawm i zawt a, mit nei lote bangin i kimaitawm uhi; khuomut pat lam pei bangin suntang lai-in i kipai vua, mi hatte lahah misi i bang uhi."},"11":{"text":"I unpi-un vompi bangin i hawh uhi; vahuite bangin i maumau uhi. Thutang i lamen vua, khat beh a om sih hi; hutdamna i lamen vua, eite tawh a kigamla hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen na masangah ka tatkhielna uh tam a, ka mawnate un ka lang khat vuah teci a pang hi. I tatkhielna uh eite tawh om a, eite in i mawnate i thei tahtah uhi:"},"13":{"text":"Eite tatkhielin Topa i nuol a, Pasien i zuina uh pan i kiheimang ta uhi. Bawlsietna le ledona thu i gen vua, zuouthu vive ngaisunin i lungsim panun i gen uhi."},"14":{"text":"Thutang kinuale a, thudih zong khu gamlapi-ah a ding ta hi; mipi kikhopna munah thutah a op lo ziehin thuman zong a tum thei ta sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Thuman a kitasam a, sietna a pel mi poma kisuom gam hi. Topa in tam thu mu a, thutang a op lo ziehin ama a lungkim sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in koima a op lo lam mu a, tuale a tang vua a ngetpieh ding koima a mu lo ciengin ama in lamdang a sa hi; tuaci’n ama’ khut in ama guolzawna ngasah a, ama’ dihna in ama a tukip hi.","ref":"Isa 63:5"},"17":{"text":"Ama in dihna khu awmdal bangin sil a, a lu tungah hutdamna sia lukhu khu hi. Ama in phulahna puonte songkholin sil a, puontuol sunga kituom bangin, lunghanna sungah ama kituom hi.","ref":"Eph 6:14, 17; 1Thes 5:8"},"18":{"text":"A sepna utawh kituohin ama in thuhkia ding a, ama a langpang mite tungah a lungthahna tungsah ding hi; a galte tungah lethuh ding a, tuipi panga omte zong thuhkia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n nitumna lama mite in Topa’ min a zatah ding vua, nisuona lama mite in zong ama’ vanglietna a zatah ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ hui in a semmang tuikhang bangin ama ang pei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale a khielna panun ang kilekia Jacob-te kungah Tanpa dingin Zion ah ang pei ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Rom 11:26"},"21":{"text":"Keima adingin tam pen amate tawh ka thuciemna ahi hi, Topa in ci hi: Note’ tunga a om ka hlagau le na kam sung vua ka guonsa ka kammalte, na kam utawh kikhen lo ding a, ahi sihle na tate’ kam, a suonlehlahte’ kam tawh tu le kumtawnin kikhen lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tho inlen tang in; azieh pen na khuovah ang tung ta a, nangma tungah Topa’ vang ang suoh zo hi.","title":"A Kithezahte Kikaikhawmkia"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen khuomiel in leitung tuom ding a, khuomu tawkhalpi in mite tuom ding hi; hizongle nang tungah Topa ang suoh ding a, nang tungah ama’ vang ang kilang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na khuovah sungah minamte ang pei ding a, na phalvah tang sungah kumpite ang pei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuodah inlen, na kimvel en in; a unpi-un kikhawmin na kungah ang pei uhi; a gamlapi panin na tapate uh ang pei ding a, naucingte in na tanute a kang vuah pomin puo ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin nang in mu-in na mai a taang ding hi; na lungtang kisai-in na lung a dam ding hi. Azieh pen tuipi’ kicinna teng na kungah ang kipuoh ding a, minamte’ hauna teng zong na kungah ang tung ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Midian-te le Ephah-te’ Kalaoh-note, kalaoh honpite in nang tuom ding uhi; Sheba gam sunga om zosie ang pei ding uhi. Amate in kham le panamtui ang puo ding vua, Topa phatna a tangko ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na kungah Kedar ganhon zosie ang kikhawm ding a, Nebaioth-a tuutang teng in nangma’ na sem ding uhi; ka maitam tungah biehna-in tua teng kisang ding a, keima in a minthang ka biehinn ka minthangsah semsem ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Meiilum banga a leng kawikawite koi hi a, vakhu banga a tawlet vua a lengkhiete koi ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Topa na Pasien uh’ min le Israel’ Siengtho Pa ziehin na tapate, a ngun a khamte utawh gamlapi panin a puoh dingin, tuikul gam mite in kei ei ngah ding a, Tarshish tembawte a masa ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama in nang ang minthangsah zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdang mite in na kulte cieng ding a, a kumpite un nangma’ na sem ding uhi; azieh pen ka lungthah zieha nang kang sat mawh vangin, kang angvanna ziehin na tungah khuotuona kang nei zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Minamte in a hauna uh ang puoh thei nadingin, a kumpite uh makai-in a guolguola ang lut nadingun na kotpite honsa-in om den ding a, sun le zanin tuate kikha lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 21:25-26"},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen na na a sem lo minam le kumpi gamte mangthai ding a, tua minamte kisie maimang ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mun siengtho zep nadingin Lebanon thupina ahi taasan sing, hiengpa sing, taasingte, na kungah ang tung ding a, keima in ka keng ngahna mun ka minthangsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na mai-ah nang ang bawlsie mite’ suonlehlahte a kun kawmun hing pei-in, nangma ang simmawte zosie nangma’ kephang ang bawh ding uhi. Amate in nang pen Topa’ khuopi, Israel-te’ Siengtho Pa’ Zion, ang ci ding uhi.","ref":"Kln 3:9"},"15":{"text":"Nang ang kinuasie, ang kimuda, koima nawh lo-a ang kikoisa na hi a, keima in a thupi zing dingin kang bawl ding a, a khang khanga kipahna dingin kang bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nang in minamte’ nawi na tawp ding a, kumpite nawi zong na tawp ding hi; Keima Topa , na Hundampa le na Tanpa, Jacob’ Vanglien Pa ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Sumngo tangin kham kang puoh ding a, sia tangin ngun kang peipi ding hi; sing tangin sumngo, suong tangin sia kang puoh ding hi. Na mangliente Kilemna ka hisah ding a, na nasem uhte Dihna ka hisah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na gam sungah tatsietna kiza nawn lo ding a, na gamgi sungah sietna le suhsietna om nawn lo ding hi; nangma in na kulpite Hutdamna, na kotpite Phatna, na ci ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Sun hunin ni pen na khuovah hi nawn lo ding a, zan hunin hlapi vang in ang tan nawn sih ding hi; ahi vangin Topa khu kumtawn na khuovah ahi a, tuale na Pasien zong khu na minthanna ahi ding hi.","title":"Zion’ Minthanna Pasien","ref":"Kln 21:23; 22:5"},"20":{"text":"Na ni tum nawn loin, na hlapi a mang nawn sih ding hi; azieh pen Topa khu kumtawn na khuovah hi ding a, na dana kaana nite a tawp ta ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na mite a unpi-un midih hi ding a, amate in kumtawnin tua gam luo ding uhi. Amate pen ka minthan nadinga ka suon, a zung meng ka khutsuoh ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mi tawmpen khat zong be khat ang hi ding a, a neupen khat zong minam thahat khat ang hi ding uhi; Keima Topa ka hi hi; a hun a tun ciengin mallang tahin tam thu ka tangtun ding hi."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasien’ hlagau keima tungah a om hi, azieh pen Topa in kei sathau ei nu zo ta hi; ama in a kibawlsie mite kungah lungdamna thu puoh ding, lungsim tamkhamte a khuipieh ding, saltang mite kungah suotahna thu a tangko ding le thongkie mite a hlakhie ding;","title":"Hutkhietna Lungdamna Thu","ref":"Mat 11:5; Luk 7:22"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ angvan kum le i Pasien’ phulah ni a tangko ding;","ref":"Luk 4:18-19; Mat 5:4"},"3":{"text":"a date adingin Zion ah, vut tangin paakuol, dana tangin nopna sathau, lungkiehna tangin phatna puon a pie dingin keima ei sawl zo hi. Amate pen dihna gangpi sing kici ding a, ama’ thupina a kilah nadingin Topa’ suon singkung kici ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in tanglai-a a siesate lamphakia ding a, nidang lai-a a maimangsate dingsahkia ding uhi; amate in a kisiesa khuopite, khang tampi sung a maimangsate a puophakia ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khuol mite hing dingin na ganhonte uh an a vah ding vua, gamdang mite in na lo uh hlo-in na lengguite uh paw ding uhi;"},"6":{"text":"ahi vangin note pen Topa’ siempute ang kici ding hi; mite in note pen i Pasien’ nasemte ang ci ding uhi; minamte’ hauna teng kivana-in na nei ding vua, note in amau’ hauna teng na kisahtheipi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen amau’ maizumna a za ni ahi a, amau’ tanh dingin maidaina kitangko hi, tua ahi ziehin amate in tanh a zani a luo ding uhi; tawntung lungdamna khu amau-a’ ahi ta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen keima Topa in thutang dei-in, misuomna le khielna ka muda hi; a thaman uh thuman tahin ka pie ding a, amate tawh kumtawn thuciemna ka bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Minamte lahah a suon a hlahte uh kithei ding a, mite lahah a cihlahte uh zong kithei ding hi; amate a mu zosie-in Topa’ thupha piehsa minam ahi lam thei-in a pom ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Topa sungah nahpi-in ka lungdam ding a, ka Pasien sungah ka hinna zosie tawh ka kipah ding hi; azieh pen zinei pa paakuol tawh a kizep bang le a suong manphate tawh motha nu a kisiem bangin, ama in hutdamna puonte keima ei silsah zo a, ama in dihna puontuolpi tawh keima ei tuom zo hi.","ref":"Kln 21:2"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen leitung in a dawn mengsahin, um in zong a sunga kitute a posah ma bangin, Topa Pasien in minam zosie mai-ah dihna le phatna a posah ding hi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama’ dihtanna thu phalvah bangin tangin, ama’ hutdamna thu meivah kuong a bah masangsie, Zion ka khuolna-in ka dai om sih ding a, Jerusalem ka khuolna-in ka mawh op sih ding hi.","title":"Zion’ Dihtanna le Hutdamna"},"2":{"text":"Minamte in na dihtanna a mu ding vua, kumpi zosie in zong na vanglietna a mu ding uhi; Topa in ama’ kam tawh ang phuo ding min tha tawh nang ang kihlan ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang pen Topa’ khut sungah a melhoi lukhu na hi ding a, na Pasien’ khut sungah kumpi lukhu na hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang pen a Kinuasiesa, ang kici nawn sih ding a, na gam zong Gamkhing, ang kici nawn sih ding hi; nang pen Ama Tunga Ka Lungkimna, ang kici ding a, na gam zong a Kitenpi, ang kici ding hi; azieh pen nang tungah Topa lungkim a, na leitang zong mite in a kitenpi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen tangval khat in ngahnu khat a kitenpi bangin note ang lampa in zi-in ang nei ding a, monu tungah mopa a lungdam ma bangin nangma tungah zong na Pasien a lungdam ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, na kulpite tungah galvilte ka koi zo ta hi; sun le zanin amate a sip ngai sih ding uhi. Topa a phawhsahkia note zong mawh khawl sih unlen,"},"7":{"text":"ama in Jerusalem sukipin leitung muncin tengah a minthan nadinga a bawl masangin, ama mawh khawlsah sih un."},"8":{"text":"A zietlam khut le a banhat tawh Topa kiciem zo hi: Na galte’ an dingin na ante ka piekia nawn sih ding a, hanciem a na bawl lenggazu zong gamdang mite in a dawn sih ding uhi;"},"9":{"text":"ahi vangin an kholte in ne-in Topa a phat ding vua, a kaikhawm mite in zong a siengtho ka huong sungah a dawn ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pusuoh un, kotpite panin pusuoh un. mite adingin lampi siel un; zih un, lamlienpi zih un, suongte paidawh unlen, mite tungah lim khat khaito un."},"11":{"text":"Leimong dongah Topa tangko zo hi: Zion’ tanu kungah, “En in, na hutdamna ang tung ta hi; ama in a thaman ang keng a, a mai-ah leiba sanna ding om hi,” ci un.","ref":"Isa 40:10; Kln 22:12"},"12":{"text":"Amate pen, “A Siengtho Mite, Topa’ tatsa mite kici ding a, nang pen, “A Kimusa, A Kinuasie lo Khuopi, ang kici ding hi."}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Edom gam Bozrah panin puon sandup silin ang pei, tua banga puon tawh thupitah a kivon, a thahatna tawh ang kal suon mipa koi ahei?” “A hundam dinga a thahat, dih tansahna a genkhie keima ka hi hi.”","title":"Edom Tunga Phulahna"},"2":{"text":"“Bang ziehin na puontuolte sanin na puonsilte lengga cilte-a’ tawh kibang ahei?”"},"3":{"text":"“Keima tangin lengga ka cil a, mite lah panin koima in kei ei ompi lo hi; lungthahsa-in ka cilgawp a, a thangpaisa-in ka tuoncil hi; ka puonsil tungah a tuite kithezah a, ka puon teng tungah a baang hi.","ref":"Kln 14:20; 19:13, 15"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ka lungsim sungah phulah ding ni om a, ka tatkhiet nasep ding kum ang tung zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka khuoda vangin ei panpi ding mi om lo hi; ka etcien vangin tha ei pie ding koima om lo hi; tuaci’n keima’ banhat tawh ka guolzo a, ka thangpaina in keima ei kipsah hi.","ref":"Isa 59:16"},"6":{"text":"Ka lungthah ziehin mite tuoncilin, ka thangpai ziehin amate ka siaguoi a, keima in amau’ hinna sisan lei lahah ka sungsuh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"7":{"text":"Ama’ ei hepina dung zui le a kicing ei itna kip dung zui-in, Topa in eite dinga ei seppieh sil bangkim le Israel innkuon tunga a angvanna lienpite ziehin, Topa in a lungsietna zieha a silbawlte le a patah huoi Topa ’ nasepte ka sutsut ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Hepina Kiphawh"},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in, “Amate pen ka mi tahtah ahi vua, zuouthu tawh na sem lo ding tapate ahi uhi,” a ci hi; ama pen"},"9":{"text":"a gentheina zosie vuah a hundampa uh a suoh hi. Kamtaipa ahi sihle vantung mi’ hutdam ahi sih hi; ama’ ompina in amate a hunkhie hi; ama in a itna le a khuotuona tawh amate tankhie a, tanglai hunte zosie-ah amate lamto-in a peipi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle amate in a ledo vua, a hlagau siengtho a dasah uhi; tua ahi ziehin ama pen a gal uh a suoh hi; ama ma in amate a do hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in tanglai hun, ama’ nasem Moses’ hun a phawh uhi. Tuuhonte le tuucingpa tawh tuipi sung pan a peipi pa hei sungah a om ta e? Amate sungah ama’ hlagau siengtho a koi pa,"},"12":{"text":"Moses’ zietlam khut tawh ama’ banhat a kizawtsah pa, a min a kithei zing nadingin amate mai-ah tuite khenzahin,","ref":"Pei 14:21"},"13":{"text":"tuipi thuh tung tawn a, a peipi pa koi ahiei? Senel lahah sakol pei bangin amate a pua sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Kuom sung a zuonsuh ganhingte bangin Topa’ hlagau in amate toidamna a pie hi. Tua bangin nangma’ minthanna dingin nangma in na mite na makai hi."},"15":{"text":"Vantung panin ei ensuh inlen, a siengtho le a thupi na tenna panin ei mu in. Na deiluotna le na hatna hei sungah om a, nei lunggulna le nei lainatna hei sunga om ahei? Keima kung panin tuate a kiladawh ta hi.","title":"Kisiakia Thungetna"},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen nang ka pa uh na hi a, Abraham in kote ei thei loin, Israel in ei phawh sih nanle; Topa , aw, nang kohaw’ pa na hi hi; na min pen tangtawng pana kohaw’ Tanpa ahi ta bo hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, kote in nangma kang giin lo nadingun, bang dingin na lampite panin kote ei pielsah a, kohaw’ lungtang na khausah ahei? Na nasemte, na gouluo minamte nei khuolna-in ang kilekia in."},"18":{"text":"A siengtho na mite in bakhat sung na mun siengtho a luo uhi; ahi vangin tu-in ka kidopite in na mun siengtho a tuoncil uhi."},"19":{"text":"Kote pen nangma in nei uh khah lo mite, na min tawh a kihlan kha lo mite ka bang ta uhi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Van phukehin hing kumsuh lacin, na mai-ah muolsangte kiling ding uhi-"},"2":{"text":"Mei in selgaw kuongsah a, tui a sosah bangin, na langte tungah na min kitheisah in. Tuaci’n nangma mai-ah minamte a citun ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kote in ka lamet khah lo uh a cizat huoi nate na bawl lai-in nangma nang kumsuh a, nangma mai-ah muolte kiling hi."},"4":{"text":"Tang lai panin ama a lamente adingin na a seppieh pasien dang koima in za ngai loin, koima in thei ngai lo a, koima’ mit in mu ngai lo hi.","ref":"1Cor 2:9"},"5":{"text":"Nangma in lungdamtahin thuman na a semte, na lampi zui-in ang phawh mite, na kimupi hi. Ahi vangin kote tungah na lungthah a, hinanle kote ka maw ta uhi; kote in na thu ka palsat ziehun nangma in na mai na phuol hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka unpi-un a sieng lo mipa tawh ka kibang ta vua, thuman taha ka sepsa zosie uzong puon nieh tawh kibang lel hi. Singna bangin ka vul sieng vua, ka khielnate un hui sem bangin ei semmang hi."},"7":{"text":"Na min tawh ang hlan mi koima a om sih a, ang pom dinga a hanciem zong koima a om sih hi; azieh pen ka kung panun na mai na phuol a, ka khielna uh sungah kote nei pie zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle nang pen Topa aw, kohaw’ Pa na hi hi; kote pen tungman ka hi vua, nang ka beelkheng pa uh na hi hi; kote pen ka unpi-un na khut tawh nei bawlsa ka hi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, lungthah seng sinlen, a tawntungin zong khielna ciemte zing sin. Kote zosie nangma mi ka hina uh tu-in ei ngaisun in."},"10":{"text":"Nangma’ khuopi siengthote senel gam suoh sieng a, Zion zong senel gam suohin, Jerusalem gamkhing a suoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate un nangma ang phatna uh mun, a siengtho le a etlawm biehinn khu mei in a katum zo ta a, ka mun nuom zosie uh zong a kisusie sieng zo ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, tam thu-ah na ki-ip thei ding amah? Nangma sip dide-in omin nahpitahin kote dan ei thuohsah ding na mah?"}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei ei kan lote sui dingin a baisa-in ka om a, kei ei sui lote mu dingin a baisa-in ka om hi. Ka min tawh ei hlan kha lo minam khat kungah, “Kei tanah om ing, kei tanah om ing,” ka ci hi.","title":"Pasien’ Thukhenna a Thumanna","ref":"Rom 10:20"},"2":{"text":"Amau’ dei bang zui-a lampi hoi lo a zuite le a ledo mite tungah sun tungtawnin ka khut ka zah hi.","ref":"Rom 10:21"},"3":{"text":"Ka maitangah a tawntunga kei ei phin zing mite, um sungah kithoina bawlin, tehlei tungah panamtui a hal hi;"},"4":{"text":"hankhuh sungah to-in munsip tenga a gieh mite; vohsa ne a, a beel sungah a kidahhuoi sa metui a koite;"},"5":{"text":"“Nang adingin siengtho luo ka hi ziehin, nangma tangin om in, ka kung ei nai sin,” a ci mite ahi uhi. Tua bang mite pen ka nahkuo vanga meikhu le sun tawntunga a kuong den mei tawh a kibang uhi."},"6":{"text":"En in, ka mai-ah gielsa-in om hi: Ka dai op sih ding a, ka thuhkia ding hi; a kicing tahin ka thuhkia valon ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A kang sung vuah amau’ khielnate le amau’ pu le pate khielnate ka thuhton tahtah ding hi, Topa in ci hi; azieh pen amate in muol tungah panamtui a hal vua, muol tang teng tungah zong keima ei gensie uhi. Amau’ gamtatna ziehin amau’ sepsa thaman a cingin a kang sung vuah te-in ka thuh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: A bawh pan lenggazu kinga a, amate in, “Tuate sungah thupha om ahi ziehin susie vawt sih un,’ a ci ma bangun, ke’n zong ka nasemte khuolna-in tam bangin ka bawl ding a, a unpi-un ka susie sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in Jacob panin suonlehlahte ka piengsah ding a, Judah panin ka muol a luo dingte ka piengsah ding hi; ka teeltuomte in tuate a luo ding vua, tua munah ka nasemte a teng ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Keima ei sui ka mite dingin Sharon pen tuuhonte gamtatna mun suoh ding a, Akhor Kuom zong bawnghonte kuolna mun a suoh ding hi.","ref":"Josh 7:24-26"},"11":{"text":"Hinanle Topa a taisan mite, ka muol siengtho a mangngil mite, Kam-etna-in sabuoi pha a, Sekholna adinga zu a kihalsa hai sunga a sung note pen,"},"12":{"text":"namsau tawh a si dingin kang sekhol ding a, ang that dingte mai-ah na unpi-un na kun sieng ding uhi; azieh pen kang hlat lai-in nei dawng nuom sih vua, kang hopi lai-in na ngai nuom sih uhi. Ka muna-ah note in a sie bawlin ka dei lo nate na teel uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Ka nasemte in a ne ding vua, hizongle note na gilkiel ding uhi; ka nasemte in a dawn ding vua, hizongle note na dangta ding uhi; ka nasemte a kipah ding vua, hizongle note na maizum ding uhi;"},"14":{"text":"ka nasemte in lungdamin la sa ding a, hinanle lungtang na-in na kap ding vua, na lungsim uh a gim ziehin na tau vangut ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Awsie lawna-a zah dingin ka teeltuom mite tungah na min uh na nuasie ding vua, Topa Pasien in note ang that ding hi; hinanle ama in a nasemte tungah min dang khat a phuopieh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin leitunga thupha a pie poma in a thuman Pasien suongin thupha pie ding a, gam sunga kiciemna nei poma in a thuman Pasien suongin kiciem ding hi; Azieh pen nidang lai-a buoinate kimangngil zo ta a, keima muna-ah kiphuolmang zo ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in vantha le leitha ka siem ta ding hi; nidang lai thute kiciemte nawn loin, zong kiphawhkha nawn lo ding hi.","title":"A Minthang Siemthana","ref":"Isa 66:22; 2Pet 3:13; Kln 21:1"},"18":{"text":"Hinanle ka siemsate sungah lungdam kipahin om zing un; azieh pen keima in kipah nadingin Jerusalem ka siem ding a, lungnop nadingin ama’ mite ka siem ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem sungah ka kipah ding a, ka mite sungah ka lungdam ding hi; tua sungah kaana awging le lunggimna awging kiza nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 21:4"},"20":{"text":"Tua sungah nausen a ngehsi a om nawn sih ding a, a vuoisi lo ding upa zong a om sih ding hi; azieh pen kum zakhat a a si mite a khansi-in kingaisun ding a, kum za cing lo-a a si mite samsiet thuohin kingaisun ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in inn a lam ding vua, a sungah a teng ding uhi; amate in lengga um a bawl ding vua, a ga a ne ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Midangte ten nadingin inn a lampieh sih ding uhi; midangte neh dingin lengga um a bawl sih ding uhi; azieh pen singkung khat’ hintan ma ka mite a hing ding vua, ka teeltuom mite in a khut utawh a sepsate nuomtahin sawtpi a ne ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"A mawhna-in na sem loin, lungkhamna dingin zong tate a nei sih ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ thupha pieh tate ahi ding vua, amau’ suonlehlahte zong tua bang ma ahi ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in ei hlat masangun keima in ka dawng ding a, amate in thu a gen laitahun ka bilin ka za ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngie le tuuno in an neton ding a, bawngtang bangin humpi in bukung a ne ding hi; ahi vangin leivui pen gulpi’ an hi ding hi! Ka muol siengthote tungah amate kiliemsah lo ding a, zong kisusie lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:6-9"}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Vantung ka topha ahi a, leitung ka keng ngahna ahi hi; kei adingin bang inn ei lampiehin, ka tenna ding bang mun pen ahei?","title":"Pasien’ Ei Kalh Biehpiehna","ref":"Mat 5:34-35; 23:22"},"2":{"text":"Tam nate zosie ka khuta ka bawlsa ahi a, tam nate zosie keima-a’ ahi hi, Topa in ci hi. Ahi vangin ka et ding mi pen a kiniemkhieh le a lungsim kisia, ka thu a zah cienga zau-a a citun mipa ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:49-50"},"3":{"text":"Bawngtang a go poma mihing a that tawh kibang hi; tuuno-a biehpiehna a bawl poma pen ui’ ngawng tan mipa tawh kibang hi; an tawh biehna a pie poma pen voh’ si a pie mipa tawh kibang hi; panamtui tawh phawna biehna pie poma pen milim thupha a pie pa tawh a kibang hi. Tam mite in a lampi ciet uh a teel vua, amau’ kidahhuoi a gamtatnate ah nuom a sa uhi;"},"4":{"text":"keima in amate a simmaw bawl ding mi ka teelpieh ding a, amate tungah zauna ka tungsah ding hi; azieh pen ka hlat ciengin koima in ei dawng loin, ka hopi ciengin zong a ngai sih uhi; ahi vangin ka muna-ah amate a gitlo gamtat vua, ka deilo nate a teel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’ thugen za-a a citunte aw, Topa thugen za un: Keima’ min zieha ang muda le ang pampaih na unaute in, “Na lungdamna uh ka mu thei nadingin Topa kiminthangsah heh,” a ci uhi. Hinanle a kimaizumsah ding pen amate ahi bo uhi.","title":"in Zion Dihtangsah"},"6":{"text":"Ngai un, khuopi pana husapi khat khu! Biehinnpi pana awging khat khu! Topa’ awging hi a, a galte a dan piehna a awging ahi hi!"},"7":{"text":"A nausuo nat masang in ama nu a suoh zo ta hi; a nausuo natna in a phah masangin ama nu in tapa khat a nei hi.","ref":"Kln 12:5"},"8":{"text":"Tua bang thute koi in na za ngai uh ahei? Tua bang thute koi in na mu ngai uh ahei? Ni khat sungin gam khat a pieng thei amah? Bakhat sungin minam khat a pieng thei amah? Hizongle Zion in nausuo natna a thuoh behin tate a suoh pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Naubu hong vanuhin suohsah lo ding ka mah? Topa in ci hi; nau a suohsah keima in naubu ka khah ding amah? na Pasien un ci hi."},"10":{"text":"No Jerusalem a it zosiete aw, ama tawh lungdam unlen, ama ziehin kipah un; ama zieha a kap note aw, ama tawh lungdamton un."},"11":{"text":"Tua hile ama’ henepna nawi tawpin na gilva ding vua, a etlawm a kang sung panin lungnopna tawh na dawn sieng thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Gunpi bangin nopsahna le luitui let bangin ama tungah minamte’ hauna ka tungsah ding hi; tuale note in a nawi tawpin ama’ kangah ang puo ding a, ama’ khup tungah na dieng vazawh ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"A nu in a tasen a henep bangin keima in note kang henem ding hi; note in Jerusalem khuopi sungah henepna na a nga ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Note in na mu ding vua, na lung uh a dam ding uhi; lopa bangin na pumpite uzong ang nosuoh ding hi. Topa’ khut in a nasemte tawh omton a, ama’ lungthahna in a galte a dona lam a kithei ding hi.","title":"A Kumpi Sep le Pasien’ Lungthahna"},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sinsona tawh a lungthahna a thuhkia ding le meikuong tawh thu a hil dingin, meikuong lahah Topa ang pei ding a, ama’ leengte pingpei tawh a kibang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in mi zosie tungah mei le namsau tawh thukhen ding a, Topa in a thasa mite tam mama ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Um sunga pei dingin kisiensuo-in a kisiengthosah, a laikima om pen a zuite, vohsa le a kidahhuoi nate le zusa a ne mite mangthah ton ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen amau’ nasepnate le a lunggelte uh ka thei a, minam zosie le kamham zosie a khawmtuo dingin keima kang pei ding hi; tuale amate ang pei-in ka thupina a mu ding vua,"},"19":{"text":"tuale keima in amate lahah lim khat ka koi ding hi. Amate sung panin Tarshish mite kung, Put le thalpi kap a siem Lud-te kung, Tubal le Javan mite kung, le ka minthanna a za ngai lo le ka thupina a mu ngai lo tuipi gei gamlapi-a om mite kungah a suohta lai mite ka sawl ding hi; tuale amate in minamte lahah ka thupina a pulah ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Israel-te in Topa’ inn sungah kuong siengtho tawh an tawh biehna a tawi bangun, amate in Topa tunga biehna dingin minam zosie lah panin na sanggam zosie uh, sakolte, leengte, laangte, laate, le kalaoh-te tungah ang puo-in ka muol siengtho Jerusalem ah ang peipi ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale amate kimkhat zong siempu ding le Levi dingin ka la ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka bawl ding vantha le lei tha pen ka mai-ah a om zing ding hi, Topa in ci hi; tua ma bangin na suonlehlahte ule na min uh a om zing ding hi.","ref":"Isa 65:17; 2Pet 3:13; Kln 21:1"},"23":{"text":"Hla tha khat pan hla tha khat, sabbath khat pan sabbath khat, ka mai-ah ei bie dingin mi zosie ang pei ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate pusuohin kei ei ledo mite’ siluong a en ding uhi; azieh pen a thante uh si loin a mei uh mit lo ding a, amate pen mi zosie’ kidah ahi ta ding uhi.","ref":"Mrk 9:48"}}}}},"24":{"info":{"name":"Jeremiah","shortname":"Jer","abbr":[],"desc":"Jeremiah laibu (the book of jeremiah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin gam Anathoth khuo-a siempute lahah khat ahi Hilkiah’ tapa Jeremiah’ thugente tam bang ahi a,"},"2":{"text":"Kumpi Amon’ tapa Josiah, Judah gamah a maan zaw kum sawm le thum a cin kumin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ kammal a tung hi.","ref":"2Kum 22:3–23:27; 2Khg 34:8–35:19"},"3":{"text":"Judah Kumpi Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim’ uh hun le Judah kumpi Josiah’ tapa Kumpi Zedekiah’ uh kum sawm le khatna a tawp dong cieng, Jerusalem mite sal tang dinga a kipeipi a hla ngana dong ciengin zong a tung hi.","ref":"2Kum 23:36–24:7; 24:18–25:21; 2Khg 36:5-8, 11-21"},"4":{"text":"Tu-in keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung a,","title":"Jeremiah’ Kihlatna le a Nasep"},"5":{"text":"“Na nu gil sunga tuisih a na vei masangin kang thei zo a, na suo masangin zong kang siengthosah zo hi; minamte tungah kamsang dingin nang kang koi zo hi,” ei ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Ah, Topa Pasien! Ka thugen dan ding zong mantahin ka thei sih hi, azieh pen kei naupang khat ka hi bo hi,” ka ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in kei kungah, “’Naupang khat ka hi bo hi,’ ci sin; azieh pen kang sawlna mi zosie kungah na pei ding a, nang kang sawl popo na gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate giing sin, azieh pen nangma ang hunkhie dingin kang ompi hi, Topa in kang ci hi,” ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in a khut hing zampheisahin ka kam ei thampieh hi; tuale Topa in kei kungah, “Tu-in na kam sungah ka thute ka koi zo hi."},"10":{"text":"En in, minamte le kumpi gamte tungah a botkhie ding le a phelkhie ding, a susie ding le a paimang ding, a lam ding le a phut dingin nangma kang koi zo hi,” ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung a, “Jeremiah, bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Keima in, “Almond singba khat ka mu hi,” ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ka kungah, “Na hoi mu hi; azieh pen ka thu a tangtun nadinga a ngah gige ka hi hi,” ei ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka kungah Topa’ thu ang tung leuleu a, “Bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Tuale keima in, “Leilu a kinga tui a so beel khat ka mu hi,” ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah, leilu lam gam panin gam sunga a teng zosie tungah gimna ang tung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen tu-in leilu lam kumpi gam sunga om minam zosie ka hlan ding hi; amate a unpi-in ang pei-in Jerusalem lutna tunkot teng, a kulpi baang kimvel zosie le Judah khuopi zosie-ah a kumpi tophate uh ang phut ciet ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale a gitlona ziehun keima ei taisanna uh, pasien dangte tunga biehna a lui zieh ule a khut utawh a bawlsa uh milimte a bieh ziehun amate tungah ka thukhenna ka gen ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle na kawng gah in; dingto inlen, kang thupieh zosie amate kungah va gen ta’n. A mai vuah zau sin; na zau leh amai vuah kang zausisah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-in gambuppi- Judah kumpite, a uliente, a siempute le a gammite langah a pang dingin kulh tawh a ki-im khuopi khat, sia khuompi khat le sumngo kulpi khat bangin kang bawl zo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in nang ang do ding uhi; hinanle ang zo sih ding uhi, azieh pen nang ang hunkhie dingin kang ompi ding hi, Topa in ci hi,” ei ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tungah Topa’ kammal ang tung a, tam bangin gen hi:","title":"Israel a Kisia nading Pasien in Thum"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem’ zah dingin pei-in va tangko in, Topa in ci hi: Na khangno lai-a na kipieh dan, motha banga kei nei itna, a kihlo nai lo gam lahah nei zui lai ka phawh hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa adingin Israel siengtho a, ama’ anlahna ah ga masa pen ahi hi. Tuami a ne zosie a maw suoh a, a tung vuah gimna a tung hi, Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jacob’ innkuon le Israel innkuon zosie aw, Topa’ thu za un."},"5":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Na pu na pate un ka sungah bang khielna mu a, ka kung panin gamlapi ah peimangin, kimanna a nei lo nate nua zui-in, bangma lo suoh uh ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Amate in, “Egypt gam panin eite ei peipi to-in gammang lahah ei na pui a, senel gam le dumte lah, leigaw gam mielking lah, tui a oplona gam, koima pei ngai lona gam le koima ten lona gam sungah ei peipi pa “ Topa hei-ah om ahei,” a ci sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"A gate le a hoi nate na neh thei nadingun an vauna gamah note kang tunpi hi. Ahi vangin na lut ciengun ka gam na buasah vua, ka gouluo leitang kidah na huoisah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Siempute in, “ Topa hei-ah om ahei” ci loin, thukham zangte in zong ei thei sih vua, Keima tungah makaite in khielna a bawl vua, kamsangte in Baal min tawh thu genin, amate in phattuomna a pie lo nate’ nua a zui uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in note khatvei kang mawsah hi, Topa in ci hi. Keima in na tate uh’ tate tungah kang mawsah lai hi."},"10":{"text":"Cyprus tuipi gei kan unlen va en ta un. Kedar ah mi sawl unlen va lim-et ta un; tam bang nate a pieng ngai amah, en un."},"11":{"text":"Pasien tahtah ahi sih vangin minam khat in a pasien-te a hleng ngai uh amah? Ahi vangin ka mite in a minthanna uh pen phattuomna a pie lo nate tawh a hleng uhi."},"12":{"text":"Vantungte aw, tami thu-ah ciza unlen, zauthawngin sip dide un, Topa in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen ka mite in sietna nam ni a bawl uhi: Amate in hinna tuinah ahi keima ei taisan zo ta vua, amate adingin tui a vei thei lo, a kehsa tuikhuh a to uhi."},"14":{"text":"Israel sila ahi amah? Inn sunga pieng sila ahi amah? Tua ahile bang dinga ama kisuom gam ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Humpite in ama hawhsan a, amate nahpitahin a hawh uhi. Amate in ama’ gam gamkhing a suohsah vua, a khuopite vuah koima teng loin a kisie gawp hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua tham loin Memphis le Tahpanhes mite in nangma’ lu tunga kumpi lukhu a satkeh zo ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa na Pasien un lampi-ah note ang pui laitahin, ama na nuasie ziehun, na tung vua tam bang ang tung hi lo amah?"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahile Nile tuite dawn dingin Egypt gamah na pei ziehun bang na phattuompi uh ahei? Ahi sihle Euphrates tuite dawn dingin Assyria gam na pei ziehun bang na phattuompi uh ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Na gitlona un dan ang tuohsah ding a, na nuatolna un ang mawsah ding hi. Topa na Pasien uh taisanin, na sung vuah keima nei giin nawn lo ciengun, tua khu a hoi lo a khalawng ahi lam mu-in thei ta un, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Hun sawtpi lai panin na hahkol na hliehtawng ta mel a, ang kikhina khaute zong bottanin, “Na na ka sem sih ding hi!” na ci hi. Muolsang tung teng le singna hing nei cin tengah lumin na pahtat hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanle nang pen a ci hoi pen pana deiteel lenggui banga kang na tu na hi hi. Tua ahile nang bangci kisiet a, gam lenggui na suoh ta vanuh na hei?"},"22":{"text":"Tang-al tui tawh kisilin savan tampi zang nan lacin ka mai-ah na mawna nieh om lai veve hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangci bangin, “Kei ka bua sih a, Baal pasien-te nua ka zui sih hi,” ci thei na hei?” Kuom sunga na lampi en in; na bawlsate thei in. Nang pen a kawi taitai kalaoh laa hua na bang hi."},"24":{"text":"Gamlah nuom a sa, a hua senga hui dih vapiel gam sakol koi in khaam zo ding ahei? A suite in gim pipi-in sui kul loin a hua hunin mu lel ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na keng guohin lam pei sinlen, na dang zong tasah sin. Ahi vangin, “Lamet om sih, azieh pen khuol mite ka ngai hi, amau’ nua zui vang,” na ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Guta khat a kimat ciengin a maizum bangin, Israel innkuonte- amate, a kumpite uh, a uliente uh, a siempute ule a kamsangte uh a maizum ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amate in singkung khat kungah, “Nang ka pa na hi hi,” a ci vua, suongtum khat kungah, “Ei piengsah pa na hi hi,” a ci uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate in kei ei maingat loin, ei nuangat uhi. Ahi vangin hamsat a tuo uh ciengin, “Hing pei inlen ei hun in!” ei ci veve uhi."},"28":{"text":"Hizongle noma dinga na bawl uh na pasien-te uh hei-ah a om ta ahei? Amate in na hamsat hun vua ang hun thei uh ahile kihunsah un. Bangzieh ahei cile Judah aw, note in na khuopi zaza uh pasien-te na nei valia uhi."},"29":{"text":"Bang dinga nei mawsah uh ahei? Na unpi-un kei nei ledo zo uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"30":{"text":"A thu om lo pi-in na tate uh dan ka pie hi; amate in sapna a sang tuon sih uhi. A gilkiel humpi bangin na namsau un na kamsangte uh thatgam zo hi."},"31":{"text":"No khang mite aw, Topa’ kammal ngai un! Israel adingin kei senel gam tawh ka kibang ngai ta a, ahi sihle a miel keikui gam ka bang ngai ta amah? Tua ahile ka mite in, “Kote ka suohta ta vua, nang kungah kang pei nawn sih ding uhi,” bang dingin ci thei uh ahei?"},"32":{"text":"Ngahnu khat in a kizepnate mangngilin, motha khat in a motha puonte a mangngil thei amah? Hizongle ka mite in sim zawh lo ni tampi sung kei ei mangngil uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na lawmngai ding a sui dan siem ta lawm ma cie! Numei gilote tung nangawn-ah zong na zie na tongte na hil tabo hi."},"34":{"text":"A inn uh lu-in na mat sih vangin, na puon mongah mawnei lo mizawngte’ sisan baang kimu hi. Tam teng zosie gamta napi"},"35":{"text":"nangma in, “Kei ka maw sih hi, a mantahin kei tungah ama lungthah nawn lo hi,” na ci hi. “Kei ka maw sih hi,” na ci ziehin tu-in nang tungah thu kang khen ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Na opdante khel zieuzieu-in nop len sam cie izaw! Assyria in nang ang maizumsah bangin Egypt-te in zong ang maizumsah ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Topa in na mi muonte a nuol tah ziehin nang zong luhum kawmin tua gam panin nang pei ding hi; amate tungtawnin bangma na nga sih ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasal khat in a zi khul hinlen ama kung panin tua nu pei-in midang khat’ zi va hi taleh, ama tua nu kungah a peikia diei mah? Khum gam nahpi tahin bua ta lo ding amah? Kingaipi tampite tawh na pahtat zaw ciengin ka kung nang kilekia diei mah, Topa in ci hi.","title":"A Thumaanlo Israel"},"2":{"text":"Muolpawn sangte lamah dahto inlen en in! Mi tawh na lupton lona mun hei-ah om ahei? Lam gei-ah to-in na lawmngaite na ngah a, senel gam sunga a zin kawikawite na bang hi. Na gitlona le na pahtatna in gam sung na buasah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin guotui kikangsah zo a, khal guo a zu nawn sih hi; hinanle numei pahtatte’ mel na puo a, na zum thei vawt sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu mama-in keima nei hlan a, “Ka Pa aw, nang pen ka khangno lai-a kipanin ka lawmpa na hi hi."},"5":{"text":"A tawp dongin ama lungthah denin, a lungham den sam ding amah? Nangma tam bang danin na ham a, hinanle na bawl thei sietna zosie na bawl zo hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpi Josiah in a uh lai-in Topa in keima kungah tam bangin a gen hi: A zulzau Israel, muolsang cinteng le singna hing nei cinteng ah kato-in khum mun tenga a gamtat dan le a pahtat dante na mu zo tai mah?","title":"Kisiekia nading Hlatna","ref":"2Kum 22:1–23:30; 2Khg 34:1–35:27"},"7":{"text":"Tuale keima in, “Tam teng zosiepi a gamtat zaw ciengin ka kungah ama ang kinualekia na va,” ci-in ka ngaisun hi; hizongle ama ang kinuale sih a, numei ginalo a sanggamnu Judah in ama’ gamtatna a mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a angkawmna teng zosie zieha khulna lai tawh ka sawlmang a zulzau Israel zong a mu hi; hizongle numei ginalo Judah a zau vawt sih a, tuale mahin ama nu zong va pei-in a va pahtat zawsop hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in ama’ pahtatna a bai ngaisut lel ziehin suongtum le singkungte tawh mawna bawlin gam sung a buasah hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle tam teng zosiepi ziehin a zulzau, a sanggamnu Judah pen lungsim tahpi tawh ang kilekia ahi sih a, ang kilekia kipang ahi bo hi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ka kungah ang gen hi: A ginalo Judah sangin a zulzau Israel pen khielna a tawmzaw nei bang danin a kitalang zawsop hi."},"12":{"text":"Pei inlen tami kammalte leilu lamah va tangko in: A zulzau Israel aw, hing kilekia in, Topa in ci hi. Kei mi khuotuo thei pa ka hi ziehin lungthahna tawh kang en sih ding a, zong ka lung a thah zing sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasien na langpanna, singna hing nei cin tenga zinte lahah na angvanna na thezahna, keima’ thu nei man lonate beh pulah in, Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"A zulzau ka tate aw, hing kilekia un, azieh pen kei nohaw’ pupa ka hi hi, Topa in ci hi; keima in khuopi khat pan mi khat, innkuon khat pan mi ni kang la ding a, Zion ah kang peipi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka lungsim banga pilna le theitelna tawh note ang va dingin ka tuucingte kang pie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuami ni ciengin gam sungah note pungin na khan ciengun, amate in “ Topa’ thuciemna Singkuong,” thu a gen nawn sih ding uhi. Tua pen kingaisun kha nawn loin, kiphawkhah nawn lo ding a, zong kigoi beh lo ding hi; adang khat zong kibawl lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin Jerusalem khuopi pen Topa’ topha kici ding a, Topa’ opna Jerusalem ah minam zosie kikhawmin, amate in a gitlo lungsim uh a pauzui nawn sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuami ni ciengin Judah innkuonte in Israel innkuonte a pawl ding vua, leilu lam panin na pu na pate’ gouluo dinga ka na piehsa gamah a peiton ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Minam zosie’ gouluo lahah a hoipen le a nop tuoh gam khat hing pie-in, ka tapate lahah bang hing ci koi ding ka hei, ci-in ka ngaisun hi. Keima nei zuina panin nuakia loin ka Pa aw, ei ci va uteh, ci-in ka ngaisun hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale mahin a zulzau zi in a pasal a nuasie bangin, tuaci’n ka tungah na zulzau uhi, Israel innkuonte aw, Topa in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Muolpawn sangte tungah awging khat kiza a, tua khu Israel’ tate kaana le mauna ahi hi, azieh pen lampi panin amate a piel vua, Topa a Pasien uh a mangngil uhi."},"22":{"text":"A zulzau ka tate aw, hing kilekia un, keima in na zulzauna uh kang damsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Muol tungte le a tunga om guolnopna le muoltangte khu zuoupi tahtah ahi hi. A mantahin Israel’ hutdamna pen Topa i Pasien uh sungah a om hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ahi vangin a zumhuoi nate in i khangdawn lai vua kipanin i pu i pate sep gimna zosie, a tuuhon le a ganhonte uh, a tanu a tapate uh valtum sieng zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Maizumin lumin mindaina in kituomsah vai. Azieh pen i khangdawn lai-a kipan tuni dongin Topa i Pasien tungah eihaw le i pu i pate i maw zo ta vua, Topa i Pasien uh’ thu i na mang ta sih uhi,” a ci uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel aw, na kinuale leh, kei kungah hing kinuale in, Topa in ci hi. Ka opna panin na kidahhuoinate hemmang dawhin, na vathap nawn sih a,"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin!” ci-in ka minin thuman thutang le thudih tawh na kiciem leh, ama ziehin minamte in thupha nga ding a, ama’ vang tawh amate a kisathei ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in Judah mite le Jerusalem-a tengte kungah tam bangin ci hi: Na lo uh kal unlen, ling lahah khaici vaw sih un.","ref":"Hos 10:12"},"4":{"text":"Judah mite le Jerusalem-a tengte aw, Topa adingin no le no tep kitan unlen, na lungsim tepte tan un. Na khuci bawl sih uleh na gitlo gamtatnate uh ziehin koima in a phel zawh lo ka lungthahna mei bangin ang kuong ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Judah gamah genzah unlen, Jerusalem ah tangko un: Gam sung cintengah pengkul mut un; nahpi-in awng unlen, “Hing kikhawm un, kul tawh ki-im khuopite sungah pei-in lut va vui!” va ci ta un.","title":"A Kibusimna le Judah a Kisiet nading Kigalgih"},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile leilu lam panin gitlona le sietna lienpi kang puoh ziehin, Zion lam nga-in dielkhai khat khai-in na suotah nadingun tai unlen, khuomuong sih un."},"7":{"text":"A kibuhna hamphul lah panin humpi khat ang pusuoh zo a, minamte a susie ding pa ang kipanzo ta hi; na gam uh gamdai a suohsah ding le mi ten thei lo a suo nadinga na khuopite uh a susie dingin a opna panin ama ang kuon zo ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin la-ip puon kikhu-in kapin mau un: “Eite kung panin a zauhuoi mama Pasien’ lungthahna a kinuale nai sih hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin kumpite le uliente lungkie ding uhi; siempute ciza-in kamsangte in lamdang a sa ding uhi, Topa in a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Kadei, Topa Pasien, ka lawl vua namsau a kiphu laitah na ngawnin, ‘Nohaw adingin ang hoi na ding hi,’ ci-in tam mite le Jerusalem-te sol citahin na sol hi!” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun ciengin tam mite le Jerusalem-te kungah tam bang kici ding hi: Senel gam sunga muolpawn sangte lah panin ka mite lamah huisa khat ang lang ding a, tua hui pen ansi zap ding le a mut siengtho ding hi lo hi,"},"12":{"text":"tua bang adingin tua hui hat luo ding hi. Tu-in amate kungah thukhen ding a genpa keima ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"En un! meii bangin ama ang zamto a, a sakol leengte pumpei tawh kibang hi; muvanlai sangin a sakolte gangzaw hi. Eite in gimna i thuoh ding uhi, azieh pen a kisie i hi ta uhi!"},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, ang kihutdam nadingin na lungsim gitlonate sawp sieng in. Na sungah na gitlo lungsim bang tanvei vom ding na hei?"},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen Dan panin aw khat ang ging a, Ephraim Muol panin gimna kiphuongzah hi."},"16":{"text":"Minamte kungah, “Amate tanah om!” ci-in gen un. Jerusalem langkhatah phuongzah un. “Gamlapi panin a imtawm dingte ang kuon uhi; Judah khuopite langkhatah amate a awng uhi."},"17":{"text":"Lohungte bangin ama a imtawm uhi, azieh pen ama in keima ei ledo hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Na opdante ule na silbawlte un note tunga tam thu ang tut ahi hi. Tam khu na manthaina ahi ta hi; tua khu bang a ci khat ta diei! Tuami in na lungtang ang sun hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka sintang na, ka sintang na! A na sengin ka kilumlet va-ia hi! Aw ka lungsim gim sam e! Ka lungtang a kisai vapial hi; ka om muong thei sih hi; azieh pen keima in pengkul mutna aw, gal sim pataukona aw ka za hi.","title":"A Kisie Minam ading Dana"},"20":{"text":"Gimna khat zaw gimna khat tung a, gam buppi a kisie zo hi. Thakhatin ka buhte kisie a, bakhat sungin ka puonkhaite kisie hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang tanvei kidona dielkhai mu-in bang tanvei pengkul aw za ding ka hei?"},"22":{"text":"“Ka mite a mot ziehun theitelna ei nei sih uhi. Amate naupang maw a bang vua, theitelna a nei sih uhi. A sie bawl lam a siem vua, hinanle a hoi sep dan ding a thei sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Leitung ka en a, tua in lim le mel nei loin a awngthawlpi ahi hi; vantungte zong ka en a, khuovah a nei sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Muolte ka en leh, a kiling valuh vua, muoltangte zong khu a kivei kawikawi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuale keima in ka en a, koima a om vawt sih hi. Vana leng vate zosie zong a lengmang sieng uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka en leh, logam hoi teng senel gam suoh sieng a, Topa mai le ama’ lungthahna mai-ah a khuopi zosie uh a kisie sieng hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa in tam bangci hi: Gam buppi kisie ding hi; hizongle ka susie sieng sam sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin leitang kap ding a, vantung zong a miel ding hi; azieh pen keima in ka gensa ahi a, keima in ka khensatsa ahi hi; ka lungsim ka khelkia ta sih ding a, zong ka dawhkia ta sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Sakol tunga tuongte le thal tawite’ aw a kizah ciengin khuopi zosie a taimang sieng uhi; amate hamphul lahah lutin suong lahah a kato uhi. Khuopi zosie kinuasie-in a sungah koima teng lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang a kisiesa pa aw, puon ausan silin, kham tawh kizemin, na mit za na nu khu bang na deina ahei? Nang le nang a kimawhzep na hi a, na lawm ngaite in ang nuasie ta uhi; amate in na hinna a lah sawm uhi."},"31":{"text":"Azieh pen numei nausuoh kuon a kiko bang khat ka za a, a tacil suoh dinga a tau bang khat, husam liengin Zion’ tanu kiko a, a khutte zah vazawhin, “Gimna thuoh lah ka hi ta’n! Ei that dingte mai-ah ka tha nem sam e!” a ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem gawlzing lahah suhtai totai unlen, en kawikawi-in ciemte un! A tuol-awng teng sui-in en unlen, a dih gamtat le thuman a sui mi khat na mu vua ahile keima in Jerusalem mawna ka maisah ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Mite Kisietcipna"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa’ minin a kiciem vangun amate pen zuouthu tawh a kiciem ahi bo uhi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma’ mit in thuman sui hi lo amah? Nang in amate na vuoh vangin amate in na a sa sih uhi; nang in amate na sat vangin a kibawlpha nuom tuon sih uhi. A maitang uh suongtum sanga a sahzaw-in a bawl uhi; amate a kisia nuom vawt sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Tam mite mizawng ahi a, thu ngaisutna a nei sih uhi; azieh pen amate in Topa’ lampi le a Pasien uh’ thukham a thei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaute kungah va pei ta vangin amate va hopi ta vang; amate in Topa’ lampi a thei vua, a Pasien uh’ thukham zong a thei tahpi uhi,” ka ci hi. Hinanle amate in a unpi-un hahkol hliehtawngin, a kikhina khaute a botsat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ziehin gamlahah humpi in amate that ding a, senel gam sunga ngie in amate a susie ding hi. Kamkei in amau’ khuopite buh dap ding hi; tuate pana a pusuoh poma ehmal ding hi, azieh pen amau’ tatkhielna tam a, amau’ nuatolnate nasie luo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na mawnate uh kang bangci maisah thei ding ahei? Na tate un keima ei nuasie zo a, pasien ahi lopite po tawh kiciem zo uhi. Gilva tahin an ka va ciengin amate in ang a kawm vua, numei pahtatte’ inn-ah a honpei valuoi uhi."},"8":{"text":"A gilva sakoltang lante bangin a vengpa’ zi lunggulin a tau vahut uhi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in tam teng ziehin amate dan thuohsah lo ding ka mah? Topa in ci hi. Hici bang minam tungah phu la loin om ding ka hi amah?"},"10":{"text":"A lenggui guol lahah peito-in vasusie ta’nlen, hizongle a unpi-in suhmangpieh sieng sin; abate heusiengpieh in; azieh pen tuate Topa - a’ ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel innkuon le Judah innkuon-te kei tungah a muonhuoi vawt sih hi, Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in Topa thu-ah zuouthu a gen vua, “Ama’n bangma bawl sam sih va. Eite tungah sietna tung loin, gal le sa le kiel le ta zong i tuoh sih ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kamsangte lah hui a bang leltah uhi, azieh pen amau’ sungah thu a om sih hi. Amau’ thugen bangin a tung vuah kibawl ding hi!"},"14":{"text":"Tua ziehin Vanglien Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: Amate in tam thu gen zo uh ahi ziehin na kam sung vuah ka thute meikuong ka bangsah ding a, sing tawh a kibang tam mite meikuong in a katum ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, a gamlapi panin na kung vuah minam khat kang puoh ding hi, Topa in ci hi.
