Tua khu a thahat minam, tangmaleh lai-a a om ta bo, a ham na thei lo uh, a thugen zong na thei lo uh minam khat ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"A thal-um uh pen a kihongsa han tawh kibang a, amate a unpi-un galhang thahat vive ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in na anlahsate ule na ante uh ang khawnpieh ding a, na tanu na tapate uh zong ang thagampieh ding hi; amate in na tuuhon, na bawnghonte uh ang khawnpieh ding hi; na lengguite ule na theikungte uzong ang nehmangpieh ding hi; amate in kul tawh a ki-im na muon mama uh noma’ khuopite namsau tawh ang suhsietpieh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in tua ni cieng nangawnin zong note kang cigamsah sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Na mite in, “Bang dinga Topa i Pasien in tam teng zosiepi eite tunga ang bawl a ta diei?” ang ci ciengun nangma in amate kungah, “Kei ei nuasie-in, na gam sung vuah gamdang pasien-te’ na na sep bangun, na gam uh ahi lo gam khatah gamdang mite’ na na sem ding uhi,” na ci ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Jacob innkuon sungah tami thu genzah unlen, Judah sungah zong tami thu phuongzah un:"},"21":{"text":"No mimaw thu ngaisun thei lo mite, mit nei napi khuomu lote, bil nei napi khuo za lo mite aw, tami thu khu za un.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10; Ezk 12:2; Mrk 8:18"},"22":{"text":"Kei nei giing sih uh amah, Topa in ci hi. Ka mai-ah na citun sih uh amah? Keima in tuipi gamgi dingin senel ka koi a, tua khu kantan zawh lo dinga a dalna-a zah zing ding ahi hi; tuihuolte a kile valuh vangin amate in a zo zo sih vua, a gin vapual vangin a kantan zo tuom sih uhi.","ref":"Job 38:8-11"},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam mite a lungtang uh khauhin, ledo nopna lungtang a nei vua, kilehei-in a peimang uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in a lungsim sung vuah, a huna guote ang zusah, tua guo le khal guo ei pie le eite dinga anlah hun ei sepieh pa, “ Topa i Pasien zatah vai,” a ci vawt sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na khielnate un tami na hoite a khahtan ta a, na mawnate un tua na hoite ang taansah ta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen ka mite lahah mi ginalote kimu hi; amate in midangte’ neisate a lahpieh uhi. Amate in vathangsie bangin thang sie-in mite a man uhi."},"27":{"text":"Va khumna bawng ah vate a dim ma bangin solna tawh a nga uh van teng tawh a inn uh kidim hi; tua ahi ziehin amate hau-in ang vanglien ta vua,"},"28":{"text":"ang thau milmelin ang zol sipsep ta uhi. Amate in gitlo gamtatna lamah tawp hun kici a thei sih uhi; pa nei lote nopsah nadingin a thu uh thutangin khenpieh loin, tasamte nga ding thute-ah a panpi sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tam teng ziehin amate dan tuohsah lo ding ka mah, Topa in ci hi. Tam bang minam khat tungah phu la lo ding ka mah?"},"30":{"text":"A dipkuothuoi, a zauhuoi thu khat gam sungah pieng zo hi:"},"31":{"text":"Kamsangte in zuouthu a gen vua, kamsangte’ thupieh bangin siempute vaihawm hi. Ka mite in tua bang dante a dei lai vaset vua, hinanle a tawpna ang tun ciengin bang na bawl ta ding vuoi?"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin’ suonte aw, na suotah nadingun Jerusalem laikim panin tai un. Tekeo- ah pengkul mut unlen, Beth-haccherem ah lim khat khai un. Bangzieh ahei cile leilu lam panin gimna le sietna lienpi ang tung hi.","title":"Hun Ang Naina le a Zauhuoi Gal Kisimna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in Zion tanu khu a deihuoi pen lonona gam tawh ka tekah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuucingte a tuuhon utawh ama sim dingin a kuon ding vua, a kimvel vuah a puonbuhte uh lamin a unpi-un a mun ciet vuah ganhonte a vah ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua nu tawh kido dingin kithawi un. Tho un, sunlai-in sim va vui!” a ci uhi. “A da i hi ta uhi, azieh pen ni lah kiemsuhsuh ta, nitah lam a hlimliep zong ang sau tehteh ta!” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Tho un, zan ciengin simin, a kumpi innte uh susie vai!” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: A singte phua sieng unlen, Jerusalem sim nadingin leicien cieng un. Daan tuoh valon ding khu tami khuopi ahi hi. A sungah bawlsietna ci simlo bangma dang om lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuikhuh sungah tuiciim a vei kihkiah bangin ama in a gitlona tuiciim bangin a khol hi. A sungah tatsietna le kisuhsietna kiza den a, ka masangah natna le liem le bai om zing hi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, kidawm in, na kidop sih leh nang hing kidahin kang nua heisan ding a, gamkhing le koima ten lona gam kang suohsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Lengga kungah a sangh teng a kikhon sieng bangin Israel a omlai teng zong khon sieng vet in. Lengga khon pa bangin a bate tungah na khut zamsah kia in."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a zah thei nadingin koi hopi-in koi galgih ding ka hei? En vawi, a bil uh bing a, khuo a za thei sih uhi. Amate dingin Topa’ kammal khu simmawna-a kizang ahi a, tua sungah nuom a sa sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima pen Topa’ thangpaina tawh ka kidim a, ka sunga ka khol ding zong ka cimtah ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate, a inn uh, a lote ule a zite utawh midang kungah kipieton ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile khum gama tengte langah ka khut ka zah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a neupen pan a lienpen dongin thumaan lo sum ngana lamah a koimapo a duhop uhi; kamsangte a kipan siempute dongin koimapo in zuou a phuoh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in ka mite’ liemma a thop bawlpieh vua, kilemna om vawt lopi, “Kilemna, kilemna,” a ci mawhmawh uhi.","ref":"Ezk 13:10"},"15":{"text":"Zumhuoi tahin gamta-in a kidahhuoi nate a bawl vua, hinanle amate maizum loin, kisuonna dan zong a thei sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin a puate lahah amate zong a pua ding uhi. Amate dan ka pieh hun ciengin a kilawnkhie ding uhi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 8:10-12"},"16":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Lamka bawm-ah ding inlen khuodah un. Lam hoi ahi lampi luite dong unlen, tua lampi khu zui un. Tua hile note in toidamna na mu ding uhi. Ahi vangin amate in, “Ka zui sih ding uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 11:29"},"17":{"text":"Note dingin galvil ding mite ka koi hi: Keima in “Pengkul gin ngai un!” ka ci hi. Ahi vangin , “Ngai sih va ung,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin minamte aw, za un. Mihonpite aw, amate kunga tung ding thu thei un."},"19":{"text":"Leitung aw, za in. Amate in ka thute khawhsa loin ka thuhilte a nuol ziehun tam mite tungah a gelna ga uh ahi, gimna ka tungsah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Sheba pana ang pei panamtui hile, gamlapi pana ang pei sing namtuite hile, ken bangin mang ding ka hei? Na meihal biehnate uh kisang thei lo a, na biehpiehnate un ei lungdamsah lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen hi: En un, amate a pua nadingin keima in tam mite mai-ah a kipal thei ding uh nate ka koi ding a, pate le tate, innvengte le lawm le guolte tawh a kisie ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: En un, leilu lam gam panin minam khat ang pei ding a, leimong a gamla pen panin minam lien khat gal sim dingin a kithawithawi ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in thal le teipi a tawi vua, gilo-in hepina a nei sih vua, a huging uzong tuipi hawh ging tawh kibang hi. Zion tanu aw, nang ang sim dingin sakol tungah a tuong vua, galkuon dinga a kisa galhang khat bangin a kivon uhi!"},"24":{"text":"“Amau’ thute i za zo ta vua, i khutte uh a zaw sieng ta hi. Lungkhamna in ei tukon a, numei nausuoh bangin na i sa hi."},"25":{"text":"Galte in namsau a tawi vua, i kimvel zosie a zauhuoi ziehin, gam lahah pei sih unlen, lampi-ah zong pei sih un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka mite aw, la-ip puon sil unlen, vut lahah kilawmlia un. Tapa tang khat a kikaa bangin mau-in nahpi tahin kap vapo un. Azieh pen ei susie ding pa thakhatin eite tungah ang tung ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Amau’ lampite thei-in note in na ze-et thei nadingin, ka mite lahah a ze-et pa le a siengsah pa dingin nang kang bawlzo hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate ahile a unpi-un a lungkhau mi ledote ahi vua, mi daisahin vah kawikawi uhi. Sumngo le siatang bangin a sah vua, a unpi-un a sie lamin a gamta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Pum hazapin kizap a, mei in hanawh tang a tuisah sieng hi. Tua puma a kizapzap khu a mawhnapi ahi bo hi. Bangzieh ahei cile migilote a kizap sieng zo sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate “a kinuol ngun” kici ding hi. Azieh pen Topa in amate nuol zo hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeremiah kunga a tung Topa’ kammal tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Jeremiah in Minam Tunga Pasien’ Thukhen ding Phuongzah"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn kotpi-ah ding inlen, tua munah tami thu phuongzah in: Topa a bie dinga kotpi sunga ang lut no Judah mite zosie aw, Topa’ kammal ngai un."},"3":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Israel’ Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na lampite ule na gamtatnate uh puopha unlen, tam munah note tawh ei tengtonsah un."},"4":{"text":"Tam bang zuouthute tahsang sih un: “Tami Topa’ biehinn ahi hi, Topa’ biehinn ahi hi, Topa’ biehinn ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in na lampi ule na gamtatnate uh na puophat tahtah vua, khatlekhat tungah thutanga thu na vaihawm tahtah uleh,"},"6":{"text":"pemtate, pa nei lote, le meigongte gawt loin, ahi sihle tam munah midihte sisan luongsah loin na siet nadingun pasien dangte nua na zui sih uleh,"},"7":{"text":"tanglai-a na pu na pate uh tungah a nei zing ding vua ka pieh tam gam sungah note tawh kang tengton ding hi."},"8":{"text":"En un, kimanna a nei lo zuouthu kigente na tahsang talawm uhi."},"9":{"text":"Note guta-in tuol thatin, ang kawmin, a manlopi-in kiciemin, Baal kungah biehna pie-in na thei ngai lo uh pasien dangte nuazui-in,"},"10":{"text":"tua ciengin hing pei-in ka min tawh kilo tami biehinn sunga ka mai-ah dingin, “Kote suohta ta ung!” na cizaw ciengun a kidahhuoi tami nate zosie pi ma bawlkia zel ding na hi uh amah?"},"11":{"text":"Ka min tawh a kilo tami biehinn nohaw’ muna-ah misuomte’ kibuhna mun a suoh ta amah?","ref":"Mat 21:13; Mrk 11:17; Luk 19:46"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in a cila ka min ka tensahna Shiloh-a keima’ munah va pei ta unlen, ka mi Israel-te gitlona zieha ka silbawl va en ta un."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in zong tam silte zosie na bawl vua, na kung vuah kang gengen vangin ngai tuon loin kang hlat hlat vangin ei dawng lo na hi ziehun"},"14":{"text":"ka mina a kilo, na muon uh tami biehinn le note tung le na pu na pate uh tunga kang pieh tami mun khu Shiloh-a ka bawl bangin ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Josh 18:1; Late 78:60; Jer 26:6"},"15":{"text":"Keima in na sanggamte uh Ephraim’ suonlehlah zosie ka nawmang bangin keima’ mun panin note zong kang notmang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam mite adingin thu ngetpieh sin, amate adingin kap sinlen, zong thumpieh sin. Bangzieh ahei cile keima in na thungetna kang ngaipieh sih ding hi.","title":"Mite’ Thumanlona"},"17":{"text":"Judah gam sunga khuopite sung le Jerusalem gawlzingte lahah a silbawl uh mu lo na hi uh amah?"},"18":{"text":"Naupangte in sing tomin pate in mei a taw vua, nupite in vantung kumpinu’ moh bawl nadingin annel pawi-in ka thangpai thei nadingin pasien dangte kungah dawn thei biehnate a sung uhi.","ref":"Jer 44:17-19"},"19":{"text":"Amau’ thangpaisah pen kei ka hi amah?” Topa in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Tam mun, mihingte le ganhingte tung, lolai-a singkungte le lei lah singgate tungah ka lungthahna le ka thangpaina ka sung ding a, tua khu kuongin kiphel zo lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Vanglien Topa , Israel’ Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na biehpiehnate vuah na meihal biehnate uh gawmin a sa ne un."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt gam panin na pu na pate uh ka peipi lai-in meihal biehnate le biehpiehnate tawh kisai-in amate ka hopi sih a, thu zong ka pie sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle amate tungah, “Ka thu mang un, tua hile keima note’ Pasien ka hi ding a, note zong keima’ mite na hi ding uhi; note na nopsah thei nadingun kang thupieh lampi beh zui un,” ci-in thu ka pie hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in ka thu ei mang loin a bil uh ei ngat sih uhi. Amate in a lungtang gitlona uh khausahin amau’ deina lam zui-in a gamta zawsop vua, mainawt loin a nuatawn uhi."},"25":{"text":"Egypt gam panin na pu na pate uh a pei ni-a kipanin tuni cieng dong, amate kungah ka nasem kamsangte ni khat zaw ni khat ka sawl zing hi;"},"26":{"text":"hizongle amate in ka thu ei ngai loin zong ei thuse sih vua, a ngawng uh a khausah zawsop uhi. A pu a pate uh sangin a siezaw-in a gamta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n tam thute zosie amate kungah na gen ding a, ahi vangin amate in na thu a ngai sih ding uhi. Amate na hlan ding a, ahi vangin ang dawng sih ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Nangma in amate kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Tam minamte pen Topa a Pasien uh’ thu a mang lo minam ahi vua, thuhilna a sang nuom sih uhi; thuman thutah kisie zo hi; amau’ kam panin zong a kisattan ta hi."},"29":{"text":"Na sam uh met unlen paimang un; muolpawn sangte tungah kaala awi in, bangzieh ahei cile Topa in ama a thangpaisah khang mite nuolin nuasie zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Judah mite in ka muna-ah sil hoi lo bawl zo uhi, ci-in Topa in a gen hi. Amate in ka min tawh a kilo ka inn sungah a kidahhuoi nate koi-in a buasah uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ka lungsim sunga ka gel ngai lo, zong thu ka pieh ngai lopi-in amate in a tapate ule a tanute uh mei-a a haltum nadingin Hinom tapa’ Kuom sungah Topheth a kici munsang a lam uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:21; 2Kum 23:10; Jer 32:35"},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in kang ci-in, tua mun pen Topheth a kici nawn lo ni le Hinnom tapa’ Kuom a kici nawn lo ding ni ang tung valon ding a, Kigawna kuom kicizaw ta ding hi; azieh pen Topheth ah misi vui nading mun a op nawn lo dongin a vui ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tam misi luongte vana leng vate le lei-a om gamsate’ an suoh ding a, koima in tuate a heumang zo sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuale Judah khuopite le Jerusalem gawlzingte-ah kipah thanop awging le motha nu le zi neipa’ awging ka tawpsah ding hi; azieh pen tua gam kinuasie ta ding hi.","ref":"Jer 16:9; 25:10; Kln 18:23"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin Judah kumpite’ gu le tangte, uliente’ gu le tangte, siempute’ gu le tangte, kamsangte’ gu le tangte, le Jerusalem-a a teng mite’ gu le tangte a hankhuh uh panin kiladawh ding hi;"},"2":{"text":"tuale amate in a it uh, a na a seppieh uh, a nua a zui uh, a sui ule a bieh uh nipi le hlapi le vana om na zosie’ mai-ah a kithezah ding hi; tua gu le tangte kikhawm loin zong kivui lo ding hi; amate pen lei lahah a kinuasie eh tawh a kibang lel ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate ka delmangna mun zosie-ah tam a gilo innkuonte zosie sung panin a omlai teng in nuntatna sangin sina a teelzaw ding uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin a gen hi, ci-in amate kungah va gen ta’n: Mite a pua ciengin thokia sam uh hi lo amah? Mite lam a piel uleh kinualekia sam hi lo amah?","title":"Minam Buppi’ Peikhielna"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahile bang dinga tam mite kiheimangin, nuatol zing ta uh ahei? Amate in solna a tudet vua, a kinuale nuom ta sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in hoi tahin ka ngaipieh a, ahi vangin dihtahin a gen sih uhi; a gitlona uh panin koima kisia lo a, “Bang ahei ka bawl?” ci lel uhi. Galsim dinga a tai sakol bangin a unpi-un a lampi ciet a zui uhi."},"7":{"text":"Vana a leng gun vapi nangawn in a lal hun ding thei buong sam hi; vakhu, sielpaleng, le tui vatawtte in zong a tun hun ding uh thei sam uhi; ahi vangin ka mite in Topa’ thupiehte a thei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Bangci bangin note in, “Ko ka pil vua, kote tawh Topa’ thukham a om hi,” ci thei na hi uh ahei? A zuouthei laitheite’ laikung in bang hunin tua thukham khu zuouthu suohsah ta uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Mipilte kizumsah ding a, amate lungkie-in kiman ding hi. Amate in Topa’ thu a nuol ta uhi. Amate in bang pilna nei uh ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a zite uh midangte ka pie ding a, a logamte uzong galzote ka pie ding hi. Azieh pen mi zosie a neupen pan a lienpen dongin thuman lo-a sum ngana lamah a duhop ciet uhi. Kamsangte a kipan siempute dongin mi zosie zuouthu-in a gamta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in ka mite’ liemma a thop bawlpieh vua, kilemna om vawt lopi, “Kilemna, kilemna,” a mawh ci uhi.","ref":"Ezk 13:10"},"12":{"text":"Amate zumhuoi tahin gamta-in a kidahhuoi nate a bawl vua, hizongle maizum vawt loin kisuonna dan zong a thei sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin a puate lahah amate zong a pua ding vua, amate dan ka pieh hun ciengin a kilawnkhie ding uhi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 6:12-15"},"13":{"text":"Tuate ka khop nuom ciengin, lenggui-ah lengga a om sih a, thei kungah zong a ga om loin a nate nasan vul sieng a, amate ka piehte amate kung panin peimang ta hi, Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang dinga toto lai i hi uh ahei? Kikhawm vai-in, kulpi tawh a ki-im khuopi sungah lutin, tua munah va si ta beh vai. Azieh pen Topa’ tunga i khiel ziehin Topa i Pasien un a mangthai dingin ei na se zo a, eite’ dawn dingin gutui ei pie zo ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Kilemna i sui vangun sil hoi i mu sih uhi. Cidamna ding hun i sui vangun zauna i tuoh zawsop uhi."},"16":{"text":"Dan khuo panin a sakolte uh’ nahging kiza a, a sakol lante uh’ ham ging in gam buppi kilingsah hi. Amate pei-in tua gam le a sunga om zosie, khuopi le a sunga teng zosie, a valtum sieng uhi."},"17":{"text":"En un, na lah vuah gulte le a kihlimzo lo gulsiete kang hla ding a, tuate in note ang tu ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka kipahna tawpin ka tungah dana om a, ka lungsim a na hi.","title":"Mite adingin Kamsangpa Kap"},"19":{"text":"Ngai vawi, gam sung cin tenga ka mite kikona awging khu: “Zion ah Topa om lo ahi amah? A sungah a kumpipa om lo ahi amah?” a ci uhi. (“Bang dinga a milimte ule a gamdang milimte utawh kei ei thangpaisah uh ahei?” a ci hi.)"},"20":{"text":"“An lah hun in ei hleng ta a, khuokhal hun zong tawp zo ta hi, eite lah ei kihundam nai lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ka mite’ liemma khu keima liemma zong ahi a, ka kapkap a, lunggimna in ei kanbawm hi."},"22":{"text":"Gilead ah zatui om lo amah? Tua munah zato siem om lo amah? Bang dinga ka mite dam thei lo uh ahei?"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw, a kithat ka mite ziehin a sun a zana ka kaa thei nadingin ka lu khu ciatui hi hinlen, ka mitte khu hlitui’ nah hi le izaw!"},"2":{"text":"Aw, ka mite nuasie-in amate kung panin ka taimang thei nadingin, senel gamah zintun buh ding mun khat nei leng izaw! Azieh pen amate angkawm le mi leheh honte ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in zuouthu gen nadingin a lei uh thalpi bangin a kuoi uhi; amate in thutah ahi lo zuouthu beh tawh gam sungah thunei-in a pang uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in sietna khatzaw khat a manaw tehteh vua, keima ei thei ta sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Na innvengte uh kidawm unlen, na sanggamte khatpo zong muong sih un; azieh pen na sanggamte zosie zuou phuoh ahi bo vua, innvengte zosie zong mi daisahte bangin a kawiva uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate zosie in a innvengte a sol ciet vua, thuman gen koima a om sih hi; amate in zuouthu gen dingin a lei uh a cil uhi; amate in khielna a bawl ziehun kisia ding gimhuoi a sa uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bawlsietna khat zaw gawtna khat, zuouna khat zaw zuouna khat a bawl bebe vua, kei ei thei nuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ziehin Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tu-in amate siengthosahin ka encien ding a, mawnei ka mite adingin bang dang bawl thei ding ka hei?"},"8":{"text":"A lei uh si theina thaltang ahi hi; a kam panun zuouthu a gen uhi. Amate a unpi-un a vengte tungah a thusiem hiuhiau vangun, a lungsim tawng vuah a si nading uh a dap gel veve uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam teng ziehin keima in amate dan pie lo ding ka mah? Topa in ci hi. Tam bang minam khat tungah phu la lo ding ka mah?"},"10":{"text":"Muolte adingin kapin tau unlen, senel gam lonona munte adingin kaala awi un, bangzieh ahei cile tuate katum sieng a, koima in nawh kha nawn loin, bawnghon ham zong a kiza nawn sih a, vana a leng vate le gamsate a taimang sieng ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem buathah kholna le si-alte’ tenna ka suohsah ding a, Judah gam khuopite zong mi ten lona gamkhing ka suohsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tam thu a theisiem ding mipil koi om ahei? Amate in tam thu a pulah thei nadingun koi kungah Topa in thu gen ahei? Koima in a nawh thei lo nadingin bang ziehin tam gam kisie-in senel gam bangin katum ta ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Azieh pen amate in a mai vua ka koi ka thukham nuasie-in ka thu ngai loin tua thukham bangin a gamta sih vua,"},"14":{"text":"tuale mahin a lungsim deina uh zui tentunin a pu a pate uh hilna bangin Baal pasien-te’ nua a zui sieng ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Vanglien Topa , Israel’ Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Tam mite gamsai tawh ka va ding a, a dawn dingun gutui ka pie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate le a pu a pate’ thei khah lo minamte lahah ka thezah ding a, amate ka tha sieng dongin namsau in ka nuadelsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ngaisun un, numei a kapte ang pei nadingin hlan unlen, kaa a siem numeite ang pei nadingin va ciel ta un.","title":"Thukhenna-ah Mite Kap"},"18":{"text":"Ka mit vuah hlitui luongin ka mitkhu vuah tui banga a pul nadingin amate in kote adingin kaala khat mallang tahin sa uheh."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Zion panin tauna aw khat kiza hi: “Eite bangci kisiet i ta diei! Zum citahin i zum uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in i tenna ei suhsietpiehin eite in zong i gam i nuasie zieh uh ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Numeite aw, Topa’ kammal za unlen, a kam pana ang ging thu na bil vuah lutsah un. Na tanute kaala hil unlen, na vengte ciet uh kaa dan ding hil un."},"21":{"text":"“I tawlet vangah sina ang kato a, gawldung-a naupangte le mipi tuol-awngte om tangvalte a sumaimang dingin kumpi’ inn sungah ang lut zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Gen in! Topa in tam bangin ci hi: “Gamlahah misi luongte eh bangin kinuasie ding a, bu-at pa in bulom a nuasie bangin koima in khawmkia nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Mipilte in a pilna uh kisahtheipi sih uh hinlen, mi hatte in a hatna uh kisahtheipi loin mihaute in zong a hauna uh kisahtheipi sih uheh;"},"24":{"text":"a kisatheite in keima, Topa leitungah itna kip, thutang, le thuman a zang ka hina ei theitelna vuah kisathei zaw uheh, azieh pen tamte ah kipahin ka lung a kim hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"1Cor 1:31; 2Cor 10:17"},"25":{"text":"Topa in a vuntep beha kitante zosie ka gawt ni ang tung valon ding hi, a ci hi:"},"26":{"text":"Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, le a sam a heukieu senel gama tengte zosie ka gawt ding hi. Azieh pen tam minam zosie in tep tan loin, Israel innkuonte zosie zong lungsim tep kitan lo ahi uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, na kung vua Topa ang thugen khu ngai vawi un:","title":"Milim Biehna in Israel-te tungah Sietna tungsah"},"2":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Minamte’ omdan sin sih unlen, vana limte ziehin lungkie sih un; azieh pen minamte in tuate a lungkiehpi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tam mite’ tawndante khu zuouthu ahi bo hi: Gamlahah sing khat kiphua a, tuale singsiem pa in hei khat tawh a suizol hi;"},"4":{"text":"mite in tua khu kham le ngun tawh a zem uhi; a kilah dawh thei lo nadingin siakil le sehta tawh a khencip uhi."},"5":{"text":"A milimte uh, tangmai lei-a lo hunna milimte tawh kibangin a ham thei sih a, lam zong a pei thei lo ziehin puoh kawikawi a kul hi; Tuate giing sih un; bangzieh ahei cile tuate in sietna bawl thei loin, tuate sungah a hoi bawl thei nading zong om lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, nang tawh a kibang koima a om sih hi; nang na lien a, na min vanglienin a thahat hi."},"7":{"text":"Minamte kumpipa aw, koi in nang hing giing lo ding ahei? Azieh pen tua khu nang’ tanh ahi hi; azieh pen namcin mipil zosiete lah le a kumpi gam sung zosie vuah nang bang koima om lo hi.","ref":"Kln 15:4"},"8":{"text":"Amate mimaw le mingol ahi uhi; tua milimte thuhil zong sing sangin hoizaw tuon lo hi!"},"9":{"text":"Tarshish panin ngun kikhengsa kipuo a, Uphaz panin kham kipuo hi. Tuate khu khutsiemte le kham khengte’ khutsuo ahi hi; a puonsil uh pen a dum le a ausan ahi hi; tuate a unpi-in khutsiemte’ khutsuo ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle Topa pen a man Pasien ahi hi; ama ahing Pasien le tawntung kumpipa ahi hi. A lungthah ciengin leitung kilawh a, minamte in ama’ lungthahna a thuoh zo sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate kungah, “Vantung le leitung a siem lo pasien-te pen leitung pan le vanneite panin a mangthai ding uhi,” ci-in na gen ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A vanglietna tawh leitung a siem pa, a pilna tawh leitung a phutdet pa ama ahi a, ama in a theitelna tawh vante a zah hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama a ham ciengin vantunga tuite ging vapuoh a, leimong tengah meiilumte a zamtosah hi. Ama in guo a zuh nadingin tun phesah a, a vankoinate panin hui langsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi zosie a mawlawm vua, theina a nei sih uhi; milimte ziehin kham khengte zosie a maizum uhi; bangzieh ahei cile a milimte uh zuou ahi bo a, amau’ sungah naahu a om sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuate pen kimanna a nei lo, kipumsolna hi lel a, dan a kipieh ni ciengin tuate a kisie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Jacob’ tanh Topa pen tamte bang ahi sih hi, azieh pen na zosie a siem pa ama ahi a, Israel pen ama’ gouluo minam ahi hi; ama’ min pen Vanglien Topa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Galte’ imtawm a thuoh mite aw, lei-a na puonlom uh ziel un!","title":"Ang Tung Ding Saltanna"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tu petpetin tam gam sunga tengte ka lawnmang ding a, amate in a thei nadingun a tung vuah lunggimna ka tungsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka kisuhkhah ziehin gim nga lah ka hi ta’n! Ka liemma a nasie mama hi. Hinanle, “Tami ka thuoh valon ding danpiehna hi a, tuale ka thuoh kul ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka puonbuh kisie ta a, a khau teng tatsan zo hi; keima kung panin ka tate taimang siengin a om nawn sih uhi. Ka puonbuh ei lampiehkia ding le ka dalna puonte ei khaipieh ding koima a om ta sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen tuucingte a mawlawm vua, Topa a dong sih uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate mazang loin a tuuhonte uh a kithethang hi."},"22":{"text":"Za vawi, awging khat khu! Ngai vawi, Judah khuopite gamkhing a suo nading le si-alte busah nadingin leilu lam panin husa ging vapuoh khat ang pei hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa aw, mihingte’ hinkhuo pen amau’ thu ahi lo lam ka thei a, mihingte lam a pei uh ciengin a kalsuon nading uh a gel thei sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Topa aw, a hoi bepno khatin ei puopha in; hing thangpai mawh lacin bangma lo nei suo ta ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ang thei lo minamte le na min ang lo ngai lo mite tungah na lungthahna sungsuh in; azieh pen amate in Jacob a netum uhi; amate in ama netumin a that vua, tuale a tenna gam a susie sieng uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeremiah kungah a tung Topa’ thu tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Israel le Judah in Thuciemna Palsat"},"2":{"text":"“Tami thuciemna thute za inlen, Judah mite le Jerusalem-a tengte kungah gen in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma in amate kungah, Israel’ Pasien Topa in tam bangci hi, ci-in gen in: Tami thuciemna a mang lo poma samsiet nga taheh."},"4":{"text":"Tami thuciemna pen na pu na pate uh, sia haltuina meikhuh ahi Egypt gam panin ka peipi lai-a ka thupieh ahi ta bo hi. Ka thu ngai unlen kang thupieh zosie sem un, ci-in gen in. Tuaci’n note pen keima’ mi hi-in kei pen note’ Pasien ka hi ding a,"},"5":{"text":"tuni-a a om bangin bawngnawi le khuoizu luonna gam kang pie ding hi, ci-a na pu na pate uh kungah ka kamciemna ka tangtunsah nading ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin, “Hi taheh, Topa ,” ci-in ka dawng hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah tam bangin ei gen hi: Tam thu zosie Judah khuopite le Jerusalem gawlzing lahah va phuongzah ta’n: Tam thuciemna kammalte za unlen tuate bangin sem un."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Egypt gam panin ka peipi lai-in na pu na pate uh nasietahin ka na hugiih a, tuni cieng nangawnin ka thu mang un, ci-in ka hugiih ngitnget hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle amate in ka thu ei mang loin a bil uzong ei ngat sih vua, mi zosie in a gitlona lungsim khaupi ma uh a zui tentun zawsop uhi. Tuaci’n keima in a zui dingun tam thuciemna ka pieh vangin amate in a zui lo ziehun tua sunga thute a unpi-in amate tungah ka tungsah ta hi,” ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale Topa in keima kungah, “Judah mite le Jerusalem-a tengte lahah sawmdapna a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in ka thu gente don loin tang lai-a a pu a pate uh’ khielna lamah a kinuahei kia uhi; amate in a nasem dingin pasien dangte’ nua a zui sieng uhi; Israel innkuonte le Judah innkuonte in a pu a pate utawh ka thuciem bawl a palsat zo ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen a, amate tungah a pel thei lo uh gimna ka tungsah valon ding hi; keima kungah amate ang tau vangun ka dawng sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah khuopite le Jerusalem khuo-a tengte in biehpiehna a bawlna uh a pasien-te uh kungah pei-in a va kap ta ding vua, ahi vangin a genthei hun ciengun tua pasien-te in amate a hundam thei ngai sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen Judah aw, nang in khuopi na nei zaza pasien-te na nei va-ia hi; tuale note in maizum nading bepin Jerusalem khuo-a gawlzing om zaza ma, Baal pasien kungah biehna pieh nadingin maitamte na lam zo ta mel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Nang na hi leh tam mite adingin thu ngetpieh sinlen, ahi sihle amau’ tangin zong kap loin zong thumpieh sin, azieh pen amate in gimna thuohin ei hlat uh ciengin ka dawng sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka it mite in na hoi lo a bawl zaw ciengun ka inn sungah bang thu nei thei ding uh ahei? Kiciemnate le biehpiehna sate in na kisietna ding uh ang kipelsah thei ding amah? Tua ciengin lungdamin na kipah thei ding uh amah?"},"16":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in Topa in nang pen, “A hing dildel ga hoi a ga olive singkung,” ang na ci ngai a, ahi vangin ama in huipi ging bangin tua khu mei tawh hal ding a, a bate a katum sieng ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel innkuon le Judah innkuon in gitlona bawlin Baal kungah biehnate a piehna utawh keima ei lungthahsah uh ahi ziehin, nang ang suon pa Vanglien Topa in na tungah sietna a tunna ding a genzo hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima ei theisah khu Topa ahi a, keima in zong ka thei ta a, tua ciengin nang in amau’ gamtat hoi lote nei musah ta hi.","title":"Jeremiah’ Hinkhuo Kigalgih"},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei pen tha dinga a kipeipi a nunnem tuuno tawh ka kibang hi. Amate in, “Singkung a ga pumin phua dawh vai-in, a min a kiphaw nawn lo nadingin ama that dawh ta vai,” ci-a ka tunga a hoilo gelna a nei lam uh ka thei kha sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin thu mantaha a khen, mihing’ lungsim le ngaisutna a encien Vanglien Topa aw, amate na thuhkiana ei musah in, bangzieh ahei cile ka vai zosie nangma kang ap zo ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tha dinga ang sui, “ Topa min tawh thu hil sin, na hil leh kote’ khut lum tawh na si ding hi,” ang ci Anathoth mite tawh kisai-in, Topa in tam bangin a gen hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Amate dan ka pie ding hi; tangvalte namsau tawh si ding uhi; a tanute le a tapate uh zong kielpi tawh a si ding uhi;"},"23":{"text":"tuale a omlai teng nangawn a suohta sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile ka dan pieh kum ciengin keima in Anathoth mite tungah gimna ka tungsah ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, kang mawsah ciengin nang a dih na hi ding hi; ahi vangin nangma kungah ka thu ei tutsah in. Bang ziehin migilote dau pei-in, upna nei lote nuomsa uh ahei?","title":"Jeremiah in Pasien Mawsah"},"2":{"text":"Nangma in amate na suon a, amate zunghla uhi; tuale amate khangin ga ang ga uhi; a kam vuah nang na nai om a, hinanle amau’ lungsim tawh na kigamla hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nang in kei nei thei hi; nang in kei nei mu a, nei ze-et hi, nang tawh ka lungsim a om hi. Amate, gaw dinga a kikoi tuu bangin kai dawh inlen, a kigaw ni ding uh ngahin a tuomin koi in."},"4":{"text":"Gam sung bang tanvei kapin, lolai cin tenga lopate vul ding ahei? A sunga tengte’ gitlona ziehin gamsate le vate mangthai sieng uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile mite in, “I gamtatnate Pasien in ei mu sih,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kenga a peite tawh tai kidemin ang gimsah zo uleh, nang in sakol bangci demzawh ding na hei? Gam nuom bawn-a na pua leh Jordan hamphul lahah bang na suoh ta diei?","title":"Pasien in Jeremiah Dawngkia"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen na sanggamte le na innkuonpite nangawn in ang leheh uhi; amate in nahpi-in ang awhsan uhi; na tungah kam siem nan ule amahaw tahsang malmal sin."},"7":{"text":"Ka inn ka lo ka nuasie ta a, ka gouluo zong ka nuasie ta hi. Ka lungsim sunga ka it pen khu a galte khutah ka pie ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka gouluo ding pen kei adingin gamlaha humpi tawh kibang hi; ama in ka lang khatah pangin ei hawhsan hi, tua ahi ziehin ama ka muda hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka thupiehna tawh gam-ui in ka gouluo a dugaw amah? Sasiel ne vate in ama kimvelah bawmin a tu valuoi uh amah? Pei unlen gamsa zosie va khawm ta un; ama a netum dingin tuate hing zawpi un."},"10":{"text":"Tuucing tampite in ka lengga lo a susie zo vua, amate in keima’ tanh a tuoncil gawp uhi. Amate in a deihuoi keima’ tanh pen pawnlah le gamlah a suo ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in tua pen pawnlah a suo zo uhi; gamdai suohin kei kungah da-in a kap uhi. Gam sung zosie pawnlah suoh zo ta a, hinanle koima’n a thudon sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Senel gam sunga a om muolpawn sang zosie tungah mi sumang dingte ang pei ta uhi; gammong khat pan gammong khat dongin Topa’ namsau in a vatmai ziehin koima a suohta a om sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in mangbu a tu vua, lingkung a at uhi. A thagim mama vangun bangma lemlaw a nei sih uhi. A giinhuoi Topa’ lungthahna ziehin amau’ anlah a zumpi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mi Israel-te luo dinga ka piehsa gouluo a khoipieh a gilo ka innvengte tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: A gam uh panin amate ka botzuon ding a, amate lah panin Judah innkuonte ka hunkhie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka baw zuon zaw ciengin amate tungah lainatna ka neikia ding a, a gouluo gam ciet vuah ka peipikia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Baal’ min tawh a kiciem dingin ka mite a sinsah ma bangun, amate in “ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,” ci-in keima’ min tawh a kiciem dingin ka mite’ omdante kintahin a sin uleh, ka mite lahah amate kiptahin a om ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin minam khat popo in ka thu a ngai nuom sih uleh, keima in tua minam phungkalin ka sumaimang ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah, “Pei-in puon kawngten khat va lei ta’nlen, tua khu na kawngah gah in, hinanle tui sungah phum sin,” ei ci hi.","title":"Puon Kawngten"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei zong Topa’ kammal dung zui-in puon kawngten khat ka lei a, ka teng hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale Topa’ thu ka kungah a ni veina ang tungkia a,"},"4":{"text":"“Na kawnga na ten, na puon kawngten lei pen la inlen, tu mama-in Euphrates gunah pei-in tua sunga suongpi pawhkeh kawmah vaphuol ta’n,” ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei zong pei-in, Topa ei thupieh bangin Euphrates gun gei-ah ka phuol hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale ni tampi zaw ciengin Topa in keima kungah, “Tu-in Euphrates gunah va pei ta’nlen, tua sunga puon kawngten kang phuolsah pen va lakia ta’n,” ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin kei zong Euphrates gunah pei-in puon kawngten ka phuolna mun khuotin ka lakia hi. Hizongle tua puon kawngten na sepat gawp ta hi; bangma-in kizang thei nawn lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung a,"},"9":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: tua bang lien ma-in keima in Judah’ kiphatsahna le Jerusalem’ ki-engphatsahna ka susie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka thu ei ngai nuom lo, a deina bang beh vua a gamta nuom tentun, le pasien dangte’ na a sem ding le a bie dinga a nuadel tam migilote pen kimanna a nei vawt lo, tami puon kawngten tawh kibang ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mite’ kawngah tua puon kawngten a beh cihteh bangin, keima’ mi ding, keima’ minthanna ding, keima ei kiphat nading, le keima’ thupi nadingin keima tungah Israel innkuon bup le Judah innkuon buppi ka behsah cihteh ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Ahi vangin amate in ka thu a ngai sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate kungah tam thu na gen ding hi: Israel’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Zubeel poma zu na dim ding hi. Amate in nangma kungah, ‘Zubeel zosie zu dip ding a thei lo-a nei tuot amah?” ang ci ding uhi.","title":"Zubeel Etsahna"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah na gen ding hi: Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in tam gam sunga teng zosie, David’ kumpi topha tunga a to kumpite, siempute, kamsangte, le Jerusalem-a a teng zosie, zu tawh kidimsahin ka khamsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuale amate khatlekhat, pate le tate ka kisusah ding hi, Topa in ei ci hi. Amate ka suhsiet ciengin khuotuo, hinkhawi, le lainat cite ka nei sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ngai-in na bil daw unlen, ki-uongsah sih un. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in thu gen zo hi.","title":"Saltangte Kigalgih"},"16":{"text":"Ama in khuo ang mielsah masang, khuomulah muol tungah na keng suikha-in na pua masangun, Topa na Pasien uh’ min thangsah un. Khuovah na sui laitahun khuomu king dingin hing heipiehin, miel thuhpi a suohsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle ka thu na ngai nuom sih uleh na kilietsahna ziehin ka dapkaa ding a, hlitui luongin nahpi tahin ka kap ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ tuuhonte salin kikaimang zo hi."},"18":{"text":"“Kumpipa le kumpinu kungah, “Topha niem ah to un. Bangzieh ahei cile a etlawm na kumpi lukhu uh na lutung uh panin kiesuh zo hi,” va ci ta’n:"},"19":{"text":"Negeb gam khuopite kikha a, a hong ding koima a om sih hi. Judah zosie salin kiman a, a unpi-un sal a suoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khuodah inlen leilu lam pana hing peite en in. Nangma ang kipie a hoi mama na tuuhonte hei-ah om ahei?"},"21":{"text":"Na pawl dinga na pantah mite in na tungah thu ang nei ciengun nang in bang na gen diei? Numei naukei natna thuoh bangin natna in ang man gawp sih ding amah?"},"22":{"text":"“Bang zieha ka tunga tam thute hing tung a ta diei?” ci-a na ngaisut leh tua khu na mawna a lietseng zieh ahi hi. Tua thu ziehin na nih hing kilemto piehin, ang kibuon gawp ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ethiopia-te in a vun uh khel thei-in, kamkei in a giel a khel thei amah? A khel thei uleh sietna bawl ding a zongsang note in zong a hoi na bawl thei ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Senel pana ang lang hui in buvai a tawmang bangin keima in note kang thethang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tam pen nang dinga ka tesa satanh, nangma’ tanh ahi hi, Topa in ci hi. Azieh pen kei nei mangngil ta a, zuouthute na um ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Kei mama-in na maitang dongin na nih ka lemto ding a, na zumsel a kimu ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in gamlah muoltangte tunga na angkawmna, na huatau vahutnate, zumzie thei lo-a na pahtatnate ahi, a kidahhuoi na silbawlte ka mu zo hi. Jerusalem aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Ang kisiensah nadingin bang tanvei sawt ding ahei?"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Guotui kan ding tawh kisai Jeremiah kunga a tung Topa’ thu tam bang ahi hi:","title":"A Nasie Guotui Kanna"},"2":{"text":"Judah kap a, a kul tunkotte maimang kuon ta hi; lungzuong khuongai-in amate tuolah a bawh vua, a tung lamah Jerusalem-te’ kaana awging kato hi."},"3":{"text":"A uliente in tui tawi dingin a nasemte a sawl uhi; tuikhuh ah pei-in amate in tui a mu sih uhi. A beelhawm utawh a kilekia vua, amate maizumin cimaw-in puon a kilukhu uhi."},"4":{"text":"azieh pen gam sungah guo zu loin leitang a gawta ziehin, lohlote cimaw-in puon a kilukhu uhi."},"5":{"text":"Lopa om ta lo ahi ziehin, sazuh pi nangawnin a tasen a nuasie ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Muolpawn sangte tungah gam sakolte a ding vua, si-alte bangin hui dihin a naw na uhi; Lopa om lo ahi ziehin a mit uh a hah zo sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ka khielnate un kote langah teci hing pang nanle, na min zalin na hing sem in, Topa aw. Ka nuatolnate uh a tam seng ta a, na tungah kang khiel zo ta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Israel’ kinepna, hahsat hun cienga amau’ hundam pa aw, bang dingin ka gam sung vuah gamdang mi bangin hing omin, khuolzin zan khat beh a taam bangin hing om na hei?"},"9":{"text":"Bang dingin mi lungbuoi bangin omin, a hun zo lo galhang thahat pa bangin om na hei? Hizongle Topa aw, kohaw lahah nang na om a, na mina ei kilote ka hi uhi; kote ei nuasie malmal sin!"},"10":{"text":"Tam mite tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bang ci hi: amate a vahthap nuom vua, a kengte a tu zo sih uhi; tua ziehin Topa in amate a pom sih a, tu-in a tawnkhielnate uh phawhin a khielnate ziehun dan a pie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei kungah tam bangin ci hi: tam mite nopsah nadingin thu hing ngen sin."},"12":{"text":"Amate in an a tan vangun amau’ thumna ka zahpieh sih a, amate in meihal biehna le an tawh biehna ang tawi vangun zong tuate ka sanpieh tuon sih hi; tuale mahin keima in namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna tawh amate ka sisah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Ah, Topa Pasien! Kamsangte in amate kungah, ‘Namsau mu kha loin kielpi zong na thuoh kha sih ding vua, tam munah lungnopna tahtah note kang pie ding hi,’ a ci uhi,” ka ci hi.","title":"Zuouthei Kamsangte Mawsahna"},"14":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah tam bang ci hi: kamsangte in keima’ min suongin zuouthu a gen uhi; amate ka sawl kha sih a, thu zong pie loin zong ka hopi kha sih hi. Amate in note tungah a manlo mangmuna, kimanna a nei lo aisanna, le a ngaisuttawm uh zuouthute ang gen uh ahi bo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka sawl lopi-a, “Tam gam sungah namsau le kielpi hing tung sih va,” ci-in ka min suonga thugen kamsangte tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Tua kamsangte namsau le kielin a sigam ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amau’ thugenna mite zong namsau le kiel thuohin Jerusalem gawlzingah kipaithang ding hi. Amate le a zite, a tate, le a tanute a vui ding koima a om sih ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile keima in amate tungah a gitlona uh ka sungsuh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate kungah tam thu na gen ding hi: A sun a zanin ka hlitui luong den hinlen, kan hun nei sih heh. Azieh pen keima’ mite, ka tanu ngahnu siengtho nu nahpi-in kisat gawp a, a liemma sie huoi mama hi."},"18":{"text":"Gam lahah pei leng, en vawi namsau a kithat mite! Khuopi sungah lut leng, en vawi, kielpi zieha a cinate! Gam sung muncin tengah siempute le kamsangte summet bawlin a vahkawikawi vua, theina a nei sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Judah khu na pum nuol ahi ta amah? Zion khu kidahhuoi na sa amah? Damsah thei lo ding lienga bang dinga nang in kote nei liemsah ahei? Kote in lungnopna ka lamen uhi; hinanle sil hoi kici ka mu sih vua, dam ding hun ka lamet vangun zauhuoina vive ka mu uhi.","title":"Mipite in Hepina Ngen"},"20":{"text":"Topa aw, ka gitlona ule ka pu ka pate uh’ gitlonate kang pulah uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile na tungah kote kang khiel zo ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Na min na khuolna-in kote ei nol sin; a minthang na kumpi topha mindaisah vawt sin; kote tawh na thuciemna hing phawh inlen, ciem hing pel sin."},"22":{"text":"Minamte’ milimte lahah guo zusah thei khat beh a om amah? Ahi sihle vante in guo a zusah thei uh amah? Topa kote’ Pasien aw, tua khu nangma hi lo na mah? Tami sil zosie nangma’ bawl ahi ziehin kote in nangma tungah kinepna ka nei uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Ka mai-ah Moses le Samuel hing ding nan uleh tam mite lamah ka lungtang a kihei tuom sih ding hi. Ka muna panin amate del dawh unlen peimangsah ta un!","title":"Dan Piehlo Phamaw"},"2":{"text":"Tuale amate in nang kungah, “Hei-a pei ding ka hi uh ahei,” ang ci ciengun amate kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Pul natna tawh si dinga kisesate pulnatna tawh si ding a, namsau tawh si dinga kisesate namsau tawh si ding uhi; kiel tawh a pulsi dingte kiel tawh pulsi ding a, saltang dinga kisesate zong salin kikai ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale keima in amate tungah mi susie thei nam li ka tungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi: A kitha nading uh namsau, a bottel ding ui, a valtum ding le a susie ding huilah vate le leitunga gamsate ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Judah kumpi Hezekiah’ tapa Manasseh in Jerusalem-a a bawl thute ziehin leitunga kumpi gam zosie in mulkin huoi a sah dingun tuate ka bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, koi in nang hing khuotuo ding a, koi in nang hing hlasietpi ding ahei? Dam le dam lo a dong dingin koi hing lambaang ding ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Nang in kei nei nuol zo ta a, nei elngatsan ta hi, Topa in ci hi. Tuaci’n ka khut zahin nang kang susie hi. Ka lungthahna ka ip na lamin ka cimgawp ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Gam sung tunkot tengah ansi zapna ciengkaa tawh amate ka zap zo hi; amate ta nei loin ka koi a, ka mite ka susie zo hi; a lampi panun amate ang kinuahei tuom sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"A nupi meigongte uh tuipi-a senel sangin a tamzaw uhi; sunkim lai-in tangvalte’ nute sim dingin a susie thei pa ka peipi hi; ama tungah lungkhamna le zauna thakhatin ka tungsah zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ta sagi a nei numei nu hlalam vei-in a sibup hi; sunkim lai ahi vangin ama’ ni a tum zo hi. Ama in zum le mindai teng a thuoh hi. A omlai teng namsau tawh tha dingin a galte khut sungah ka pie ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka nu aw, kei gim nga ka hi ta hi. Gambup-a om micin teng tawh kihau kisel dinga nei hin ka hi sese izaw! Mi sum leitawisah loin mi sum zong palah lo napi, a unpi-un kei ei sampawm lai veve uhi.","title":"Jeremiah’ Mawsahna le a Kihansuokiana"},"11":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Nangma hoi nadingin na hinkhuo ah kang kisungthaw valon ding a, hahsat hun le lungdon hunin na galte in nangma kungah kang thumsah valon ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Sia le sumngo in leilu lama sia a hliehtawng zo amah?"},"13":{"text":"Na gam sung uh muncing tenga na bawl uh mawna zosiete ziehin note in na hauna ule na goute uh man nga loin galvan lahin ka pie ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na thei khah lo uh gam khatah na galte uh’ na kang semsah ding hi, azieh pen ka lungthahna mei bangin kitawkuong a, mit ngai nawn lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa aw, nang na thei hi; kei ei phawh inlen ei ve bo in. Kei ei bawlsiete tungah phu ei lahpieh inlen, na thuohzawhna ziehin kei ei sisah sin; nangma zieha hosietna thuoh ka hilam ei thei in."},"16":{"text":"Na thute kimu a, keima in tuate ka ne hi, kei adingin na thute kipahna le lungdamna ahi hi; azieh pen Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, nangma’ min tawh ei kihlan ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Guolnop bawlte lahah ka to sih a, ka guolnuom ton sih hi; lungthahna tawh nei dimsah ziehin a gih na khut nei-ah kei guohin ka to hi."},"18":{"text":"Adam nuom lote bangin bang dingin ka natna dai thei lo a, ka liemma dam thei lo ahei? A tahtahin nang pen kei adingin tui a kangzel luidung le misol thei tui tawh na kibang hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Nang kilekia leh kang lakia ding a, ka na na semkia ding hi. Kimanna nei lo thute gen loin thu manphate na gen leh, ka kamsang na hi ding hi. Na kunga ang pei ding pen amate ahi vua, amate kunga a pei ding pen nang na hi sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam mite adingin sumngo kulpi-in kang bawl ding hi; amate in ang do vangun ang zo sih ding uhi. Azieh pen ang hundam ding le ang hunkhie dingin keima in nangma kang ompi hi, Topa in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Migilote’ khut sung panin kang hunkhie ding a, mi gawgamte khut sung panin kang tankhie ding hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima tungah Topa’ thu ang tung hi:","title":"Jeremiah’ Zi Neilona le a Thugen"},"2":{"text":"Tam munah zi la sinlen, tanu tapa zong nei sin."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami muna pieng tanu tapate le tami gama a nu a pate uh tungtangah Topa in tam bangin gen hi:"},"4":{"text":"Si natna vei-in a si ding vua, koima’ kaa lo le koima’ vui loin a om ding uhi; amate pen lei lahah a kitha eh a bang bep lel ding uhi. Namsau le kielin a si ding vua, a luonghawmte uh hui lahah a leng vate le leitunga gamsate’ an hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Misi inn ah lut sinlen, a kaa dingin zong pei sin, zong hlasietpi da in; azieh pen tam mite kung panin ka lungnopna, ka itna kip, le ka hepinate ka la zo hi, Topa in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam gamah milien mineu a si ciet ding uhi; amate kivui loin koima in zong kaa lo ding hi; amate ziehin koima kikuiliem loin a sam uzong a heukieu sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Misite ziehin a kapte hlai nadingin koima in khomun phalsuo loin koima in a nu ahi sihle a pa dawn dingin henepna hai tul lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pawi bawlna inn ah na pei sih ding a, amate tawh neton dawnton dingin na to sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa , Israel’ Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Note’ mu tehtehin, na hin sung ma-un tam mun panin guolnopna awgingte, lungdamna awgingte, le zinei pa le monu’ awgingte kisipsah ding hi.","ref":"Jer 7:34; 25:10; Kln 18:23"},"10":{"text":"Tam mite kungah tam thute zosie na gen ciengin amate in, “Bang ziehin Topa in eite tungah tam gimna lienpi ang tunsah tah lawm ahei? I khielna uh bang ahei? Topa i Pasien uh tungah bang mawna i bawl uh ahei?” ang ci uleh,"},"11":{"text":"nangma in amate kungah tam bang na ci ding hi: Na pu na pate un keima ei taisanin, pasien dangte nuadelin a na a sem vua, keima ei nuasie-in ka thukhamte a zui lo zieh uh leh;"},"12":{"text":"note, na pu na pate uh sangin a siezaw-in na gamta vua, na unpi-un na gitlo lungtang uh zui tentunin ka thu na man nuom lo zieh uh ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tam gam panin note le na pu na pate un a thei ngai lona gam khatah kang notmang ding a, tua munah a sun a zanin pasien dangte’ na na sem ding uhi, azieh pen keima in note kang angvan ta sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mite in, “Egypt gam panin Israel mite a peipi Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,” ci-in keima’ minin a kiciem nawn lo uh hun ang tung valon ding hi,” Topa in ci hi.","title":"Pasien in Israel a Ngai Bangsahkia"},"15":{"text":"“Leilu lam gam pan le amate a hawlkhietna gam zosie panin Israel mite ang peipi Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,” kicizaw ta ding hi. Azieh pen keima in a pu a pate uh ka na piehsa a gam vuah amate ka peipikia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in a cina ah, keima in tu-in ngabeng mi tampi sawlin amate ka mansah ding hi; tua zaw ciengin keima in sabeng mi tampi sawlin amate in muol le tang le suonghawmte lahah sa a beng ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in a peina uh lampi zosie ka en hi; ka kung panin amate a kibu thei sih vua, a gitlonate uzong ka muna-ah a kisel thei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale keima in amau’ khielna le amau’ mawna a za ni-in ka thuhkia ding hi. Azieh pen a muthadahuoi siluong hawmte tawh a kibang milimte tawh ka gam a buasah zo ta vua, a sil kidahhuoite utawh ka gouluo a kidimsah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aw Topa , ka hatna le ka kulpi, lungkham hun cienga ka kibuhna pa aw, leimong panin na kungah minamte hing pei-in tam bangin gen ding uhi: Ka pu ka pate un zuouthu le bangma-a kimang lo, phattuomna ei pie thei lo milimte cilo, bangma dang a na luo sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mihingte in amau adingin pasien-te a bawltawm thei amah? Khumte pasien ahi sih hi!"},"21":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin keima in amate thu ka hil valon ding hi. Tutungin ka vanglietna le ka hatna ka theisah ding a, tuaci’n amate in keima’ min Topa ahi lam ei thei ta ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sia laikung tawh Judah’ mawna kigiel hi; a lungtang peh tung ule maitam kite tungah suong manpha dawnhiem tawh zihin kigiel a,","title":"Judah’ Mawna le Dan Thuohna"},"2":{"text":"a tate un singna dawng gei cinteng le muolsangte tunga om a maitamte ule a khuom siengthote a phawh veve vua,"},"3":{"text":"gam-awng lai-a muolsang teng tungah zong a phawh veve uhi. Na gam sung zosie vua na bawl uh mawna manh dingin na neisa ule na gou zosie uh galvan lahin ka pie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Noma’ bawlin kang piehsa na gouluo na tan ding vua, tuale keima in na thei ngai lo uh gam khatah na galte uh’ na semin kang koi ding hi, azieh pen keima’ lungthahna khu mei bangin kikuontaw-in a kuong zing ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Mi maimaite muongin cilesa hatna maimai suong a, Topa kung pana a lungsim kiheite pen samsiet thuoh ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate senel gama a po sawlbawh a bang ding vua, panpina ang pei ciengin a mu kha sih ding uhi. Koima’ ten lona ci gam ahi senel gam gawta ah a teng ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa sunga muonna a neite, a muonna uh Topa ahi sahte thupha nga ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate pen tui gei-a kisuon, lui gei-a zunghla singkung a bang ding uhi. Amate pen khuo a lum ciengin zau loin, a nate a hing zing ding hi; guo a zuh lo kumin zong amate in khawh sa loin ga a ga zing uhi.","ref":"Late 1:3"},"9":{"text":"Adang na zosiete lahah lungsim khu a kawi pen ahi hi; kinahsiet mama hi - tua khu koi in thei zo ding ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Keima Topa in amau’ gamtatna le amau’ sep thaman zui-a a pie dingin lungsim ka sittel a, lungtang zong ka sui hi.","ref":"Late 62:12; Kln 2:23"},"11":{"text":"Thuman lopi tawh hauna a sui mi zosie pen ama’ tui hi lopi a keuhsah dinga a op valaa tawh kibang hi; a khan kimtan ciengin a neisa teng taan ding a, a tawpkhahna ah a mot lam uh a kipholah ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"A cila panin a kitawisang, a minthang mang topha khu i mun siengtho sung vua om biehbuhno ahi hi!"},"13":{"text":"Aw Topa ! Israel’ kinepna pa aw! nangma kung panin a tai mite zosie a maizum ding uhi; na kung pana a kihei poma leinei gamah a min uh kikhum ding hi, azieh pen amate in hinna ciatui ahi Topa a taisan zo ta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa aw, ei damsah in, tua hile kei ka dam ding hi; ei hundam in, tua hile kei hutdamin ka om ta ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile kang phat pa khu nangma na hi hi.","title":"Dihtansahna ding Jeremiah in Thungen"},"15":{"text":"Amate in keima kungah, “ Topa’ thu hei-a om ahei? Tua khu hing tung taheh!” ci-in ei bangci gen uh ci ei thei in."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle na nasepna ah tuucing hina panin ka taimang sih a, sietna ni ang tun ding zong lah ka dei tuom sih hi. Ka nephu panin bang pusuoh ci na thei hi; tua khu na mai-ah a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka dipkuot nadingin hing om sin; gimna hun cienga ka kibuhna na hi hi;"},"18":{"text":"ei bawlsiete maizumsah inlen, ahi vangin kei ei maizumsah sin; amate lungkiesah inlen, ahi vangin kei ei lungkiesah sin; amate tungah gimna ni tungsah in; a za ni kisietna tawh amate susie in!"},"19":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah tam bang ci hi: Pei-in, Judah kumpite’ sungtumna le a pusuona uh ahi Mite’ Tunkot le Jerusalem khuo-a tunkotte zosie ah va ding ta’nlen,","title":"Sabbath Ni Siengthosah"},"20":{"text":"tuale amate kungah tam bangin gen in: Tami tunkot sunga ang lut no Judah kumpite, Judah mi zosie, le Jerusalem-a a tengte zosie aw, Topa’ kammal za un."},"21":{"text":"Topa in tam bang ci hi: Na hin nadingun Sabbath ni-in van na puoh lo nading ule Jerusalem tunkotte ah tuate na lutpi lo nadingun kidawm un.","ref":"Neh 13:15-22"},"22":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in na inn panun van khatpopo puo loin, na khatpopo zong sem sih unlen, keima in na pu na pate thu ka piehsa bangin Sabbath ni siengthosah un.","ref":"Pei 20:8-10; Thkna 5:12-14"},"23":{"text":"Hizongle amate in ngai nuom loin a bil ei daw sih uhi; amate in a ngawng uh a khausah vua, thuhilna ngai nuom loin zong a sang nuom sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka thu na ngai vua, Sabbath ni-in tam khuopi tunkotte ah bangma van puo loin, Sabbath ni na sienthosah vua, khum ni-in na na sep sih uleh,"},"25":{"text":"David’ mang topha tunga a to ahi kumpite, amate le a uliente, Judah mite le Jerusalem-a tengte in sakol leeng le sakol tungah tuongin tam khuopi tunkotte ah ang lut ding uhi; tuale tam khuopi sungah mi a teng zing ta ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Judah khuopite le Jerusalem kimvel panin hi tale, Benjamin gam, Shephelah gam, muoltung gam, le Negeb gam panin hi tale Topa’ biehinn ah mite ang pei-in, meihal biehnate le biehpiehnate, an tawh biehnate le panamtuite, le lungdamko biehnate ang peipi ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin Sabbath ni sienthosah ding le Sabbath ni-in Jerusalem tunkotte ah van puo-in lutpi lo ding hi, ci thute ah ka thu na man sih uleh keima in a tunkotte ah mei ka tawkuong ding hi; tua mei in Jerusalem kumpi innte katumin kiphel zo nawn lo ding hi, Topa in ei ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeremiah kunga a tung Topa’ kammal tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Beelkhengpa le Tungman"},"2":{"text":"“Hing pei in, beelkhengpa’ inn ah peisuh inlen tua munah ka thu kang theisah ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n beelkheng pa’ inn ah ka peisuh a, tuale a beel khen laitah ka va tuohkha ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’ khut sungah tungman tawh a bawl a beel kisie a, tuale ama in hoi a sah bangin beel dang khatin a kheng phakia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung hi:"},"6":{"text":"Israel innkuon aw, tam beelkheng pa bawl bangin no zong hing bawl thei hi lo ka mah? Topa in ci hi. Israel innkuon aw, beelkheng pa’ khut sunga a om tungman bangin note zong keima’ khut sungah na om uhi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in hun khat lai-in minam khat ahi sihle kumpi gam khat botzuonin, phelkhie-in ka suhsiet ding tawh kisai-in ka na pulah kha mai thei ding a,"},"8":{"text":"hizongle ama’ tungtang thu ka pholah ziehin a gitlona panin tua minam ang kihei leh, ka lungsim khelkia-in ama tunga tunsah dinga ka gelsa gimna ka tungsah nawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale keima in adang hun khat lai-in minam khat ahi sihle gam khat’ tungtangthu ah lam ding le suon dingin ka na pulah mai thei ding a,"},"10":{"text":"hizongle tua minam in ka thu ei ngai nuom loin, ka muna-ah sil hoi lo a bawl leh, ka lungsim khelkia-in ama tunga sil hoi bawl dinga ka gelsa pen khu ka bawl nawn sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Judah mite le Jerusalem-a tengte kungah tam bangin gen in: Topa in tam bangin ci hi: En un, kei pen note tunga sietna tunsah ding gelna a nei beelkheng pa ka hi hi. Tu-in na unpi-un na gitlona panun kiheikia unlen, na omdan ule na gamtatnate uh bawlpha un."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in, “Khum khu a mawhna hi bo! Koma’ gelna bangin om lel va ung, koma khat ciet in ka gitlo lungsim khauna uh ma bangin gamta lel va ung,” a ci uhi.","title":"A Lungkhau Israel’ Milim Biehna"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Minamte lahah dong un: Koi in tam bang thu za kha ahei? Ngahnu siengtho Israel in a mulkinhuoi pen na khat bawl zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Lebanon vuakhal in Sirion kentawng a nuasie ngai amah? Muol tung pana ang luong luitui vot kihkiahte a kang ngai amah?"},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka mite in kei ei mangngil zo ta vua, amate in kisolna tungah meihal biehnate a hal uhi; tanglai lampite ahi amau’ lampite ah a kipalpua vua, a lamlienpi uh zui nawn loin lampelte a zui uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in a gam uh a cizat huoi le mite’ ehneh ho zing dingin a bawl uhi. Khum gam a kantan mi zosie ciza-in a lu a pei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Nisuona lam huipi bangin galte mai-ah amate ka thethang ding hi. A tuosiet ni ciengun amate ka elngat ding a, ka maingat sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Hing pei un, Jeremiah sawmsim va vui, azieh pen thu ei hil ding siempu, i thu dawh ding mipil le Pasien’ kammal ei gen ding kamsang i kitasam sih ding uhi. Hing pei un, ama mawsiet vai-in a thugen khat mama zong mang sih vai,” ei ci uhi.","title":"Jeremiah Kisawmsimna"},"19":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thugen ei ngai inlen, ka galte’ thugente zong ngai in!"},"20":{"text":"Sil hoi pen sil hoi lo tawh thuh ding ma amah? Hizongle amate in ka si nadingin dum a to uhi. Amate kung panin na lungthahna na heimang nading le amate dinga thuhoi a gen dingin na mai-a ka din khu ei phawh in."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kiel tawh a tate uh pulsisah inlen, namsau-in sisah sieng in. A zite uh ta nei loin meigongsah in. A pasalte uh pul natna tawh si uh hinlen, a tangvalte uh gal sungah namsau tawh si uheh."},"22":{"text":"Amate tungah thakhatin mi susiete na sawl ciengin, amau’ inn panin kaana awging kizasah in! Azieh pen kei ei mat nadingun dum a to vua, ka kenga ka aw nadingin thang a sie uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanle Topa aw, kei tha ei sawmnate uh na thei hi. Amau’ khielnate maisah sinlen, na muna panin amau’ mawna phietmang sin. Na mai-ah amate puasah sieng in; na lungthah laitah ma-in amate thuohsah pai in."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Pei inlen beelkheng pa’ leibeel khat va lei ta’n. Mite lahah upa pawlkhat le khangham siempu pawlkhat zawpi inlen,","title":"Leibeel Keh"},"2":{"text":"beelkeh Tunkot lutna-a om Hinnom tapa’ kuomah pei inlen, kang thu gente khumnah va tangko ta’n.","ref":"2Kum 23:10; Jer 7:30-32; 32:34-35"},"3":{"text":"Nangma in tam bangin na gen ding hi: Judah kumpite le Jerusalem-a tengte aw, Topa’ kammal za un. Vanglien Topa , Israel’ Pasien in tam bang ci hi: Keima in tua thu a za mi zosie’ bil a khen giap dingin tam munah tam bang gimna ka tungsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mite in keima ei nuasie zo a, amate, a pu a pate ule Judah kumpite in a thei ngai lo uh pasien dangte kungah biehnate pie-in tam mun a buasah ta uhi; azieh pen amate in mawna a nei lo mite’ sisan tawh tam mun a kidimsah zo ta vua,"},"5":{"text":"tuale ka thupieh ahi vawt lo, ka lungsim sunga zong a om ngai vawt lo, Baal kungah meihal biehna dinga a pieh ding uh ahi a tapate uh hal nadingin amate in Baal munsangte a banbanin a lam uhi.","ref":"Siem 18:21"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in a cina-ah, tam mun pen Topheth ahi a, Hinnom tapa’ Kuom ahi zongin a kici nawn lo hun ang tung valon ding a, Kithana kuom kicizaw ta ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in tam munah Judah le Jerusalem’ gelnate a mawhna ka suohsah ding a, a galte uh mai-ah namsau tawh puasahin tha dinga a suite’ khutlum tawh amate ka sisah ding hi. A luong hawmte uh hui lahah vate le leitunga gamsate’ an dingin ka pie ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam khuopi pen a cimulthaw huoi, a ehneh hohuoi-in ka bawl ding a, a suoh kha mi zosie in ama’ gimna zosiete ziehin cimultho-in tua khuopi a ehneh ho ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"A galte le amate a tha sawm mite in imtawmin a lungkhamsah ciengin keima in a tanute ule a tapate uh’ sa ka nesah ding a, a unpi-un a innvengte’ sa a ne ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin na zawpite muna-ah na beel na sukeh ding a,"},"11":{"text":"amate kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Mite in beelkheng pa’ beel sukehin bawlphat thei a op lo bang ma-in keima in tam mite le tam khuopi ka sukeh ding hi. Si vui nading mun a om nawn lo za dongin amate in Topheth ah si a vui ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tam mun le a sunga tengte tungah tu-a bangin ka bawl ding a, tam khuopi pen Topheth ka bangsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem innte le Judah kumpite’ innte, innkhum zanga vantung nate zosie tungah biehna-a a kipiehna inn zosie le pasien dangte tungah dawn thei biehna a kibuohna innte zosie a unpi-in Topheth mun bangin kibuasah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in thu gen dinga a sawlna Topheth panin Jeremiah a pei ciengin, Topa’ biehinn leituol ah ama dingin mi zosie tungah tam bangin a gen hi:"},"15":{"text":"Vanglien Topa , Israel’ Pasien in tam bang ci hi: Tam khuopi le a khuoneute tungah ka gensa gimna zosie ka tungsah ding hi, azieh pen amate in a lungsim uh khausahin ka thu gente a ngai sih uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Jeremiah in a gen tami thute, Topa’ biehinn uhpi pa ahi Immer’ tapa, siempu Pashhur in a za hi.","title":"Pashhur in Jeremiah Bawlsie"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pashhur in kamsang Jeremiah sat gawp a, Topa’ biehinn sunga Benjamin Tunkot tungnung ah kol a bul hi."},"3":{"text":"A zing ciengin Pashhur in Jeremiah a kol a sutpieh ciengin ama kungah Topa in na min pen Pashhur ci-in na phuo loin, “Muncin tengah Zauna” ci-in na phuozaw hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in nang le na guol teng zosie’ zauna ahi dingin nang kang bawl ding hi; tuale nang in na et lai tahin a galte uh’ namsau tawh amate a pua ding uhi. Tuale keima in Babylon kumpipa khut sungah Judah gam zosie ka pie ding hi; ama in sal dingin Babylon ah amate peipi-in namsau tawh a that sieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in tam khuopi’ hauna zosie, a sui a lam teng zosie, a na manpha zosie le Judah kumpite’ gou teng zosie amate a bulu a galte uh’ khut sungah ka pie ding a, amate in sutin manin Babylon ah a peipi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale nang, Pashhur le na inn sunga omte zosie Babylon khuo-ah salin na pei ding uhi; khum munah note na si ding vua, zuou kamsanna tawh thu na hil na guol teng zosie tawh khum munah ang kivuiton ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, nang in kei nei sol a, tuaci’n solin ka om ta hi; kei sangin nang na hatzaw a, tuaci’n kei nei zo ta hi. Sun tungtawnin nuizat nopna-in ei kinei hi; mi zosie in ei zako uhi.","title":"Jeremiah in Ama a Bawlsiete Mawsah"},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka thugen simin kiko-in, “Tatsietna le kisietna!” ci-in ka awng vapuoh ding hi,” a ci hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ kammal ka gen ziehin sun tungtawnin simmawna le zapina ka thuohlaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in, “A min ka gen sih ding a, ama’ min ka lo nawn sih ding hi,” ci nanleng zong, ka lungsim sungah meikuong bangin a om a, ka gu sung ei zen hi; ka ki-ip na lamin ka gim a, lah ka ki-ip zo tuom sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mite’ kidap hona tampi ka za a, “Muncin teng zauhuoi hi! Ama heh un! Ama heh va vui,” a ci uhi. Ka lawm itte zosie in ka pua ding ei buh vua, “Ama kizawl zo kha na va, eite in ama zo na va vui, tuaci’n eite in ama tungah phu la zo na vai,” a kici uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin galhang pa bangin kei tawh Topa ang om hi; tua ziehin ei bawlsiete a kipai ding vua, ei zo sih ding uhi. Amate in a muolsuo zawh lo ding ziehun nahpi tahin maizum ding uhi. Kumtawnin a mindaina uh kimangngil ngai lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Vanglien Topa aw, nangma in midihte na sittel a, nangma in mihing’ lungtang le a lungsim na mu hi; nangma in amate tunga na thuhkiana ei musah in, azieh pen nangma tungah ka vaite kang ap zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa tungah la sa un; Topa phat un! Azieh pen ama in migilote’ khut sung panin mi cimawte’ hinna a hunkhie hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka suo ni samsietin om taheh! Ka nu in keima ei suosah ni in thupha nga sih taheh!"},"15":{"text":"Ka pa kungah, “Tapa na nei ta hi,” ci-in thu va ko-in, ama a lungdamsah pa khu samsietin om taheh."},"16":{"text":"Tua mipa pen Topa in a khuotuo vawt lo, a lumlet khuopite bang taheh; ama in zingmawngin kaana awging za hinlen, sunkim ciengin zong patauna awging za taheh."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in naubu sungah ei na that sih hi; ei na that hi leh ka nu khu ka hankhuh hi pai ngel ding a, a gil in kumtawnin ei paai den mai ding hiven."},"18":{"text":"Gimna tawlna le dana teng sin ding le zalat muolphona tawh hinkhuo mang ding bep a, bang dinga naubu sung pana na suoh kha khelkhel ka hei?","ref":"Job 3:1-19"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah Malchiah’ tapa Pashhur le Maaseiah’ tapa siempu Zephaniah a sawl ciengin ama kunga a tung Topa’ kammal tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Nebuchadnezzar’ Khut Sungah Jerusalem Tung"},"2":{"text":"“Hepina tawh Topa kungah kote tangin thu ei dawh pieh in, azieh pen Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in kote ei sim hi; ama in a sepsa bangin ko adingin Topa in na lamdang khat hing bawlin ko kung panin ama hing kilesahkia thei kha ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:1-11; 2Khg 36:17-21"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in amate kungah tam bangin ci hi:"},"4":{"text":"Zedekiah kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Israel’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Kulpi pulamah note ang imtawm Babylon kumpipa le Chaldea-te na dona uh ahi, na khut sung vua om galvante nualam sena-in ka nei ding hi; tuale keima in tam khuopi laikimah amate ka kaikhawm ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei mama in lungthahna, lungsona le thangpaina lienpi tawh ka khut zahin ka banhat tawh note kang do ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale keima in tam khuopi sunga tengte a mi a sa pumin ka satlia ding a, pulnatna lienpi tawh amate a si sieng ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Topa in kang ci-in, keima in Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah, ama’ nasemte, le tam khuopi sunga teng mite- pul natna, namsau, le kielpi pana a suohta lai teng tawh a hinna uh tha dinga a sui Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ khut sung le a galte khut sungah ka pie ding hi. Ama in a hiem namsau tawh amate a satlia ding hi; ama in amate khuotuo loin zong hinkhawi lo ding a, lainatna kici zong nei lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale nang in tam mite kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: En un, keima in na mai vuah sina lampi le hinna lampi ka koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam khuo sunga om mi poma namsau, kiel, le pulnatna tawh a si ding uhi; ahi vangin pusuoh dawhin note ang imtawm Chaldea-te kunga a lut poma gal vanlah bangin a hinna a suotatpi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in tam khuopi hoi nading hi lo, a sietna dingin ka mai ka ngat zo ta hi: Tua khu Babylon kumpipa’ khut sungah ka pie ding a, ama in mei tawh a hal ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Judah kumpite’ innkuon tungah tam bangin gen in: Topa’ kammal za un,","title":"David’ Innkuon tungah Thu Kipuoh"},"12":{"text":"David’ innkuon aw! Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Zingmawngin thutangin khen unlen, mi bawlsiepa’ khut sung panin a kisuompa hlakhie un. Ahi sihle na bawl sietnate ziehin ka thangpaina mei bangin ang kuongin koima in phel zo lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"En un, kuom zanga a teng le zanglei tunga om suongtum aw, nangma kang langpang hi, Topa in ci hi; nang in “Koi ahiei eite ei do-a ang kumsuh zo ding, koi ahiei eite kibuhna muna ang lut zo ding?” na ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Na sepna ga tawh kituohin dan kang pie ding hi, Topa in ci hi; ama’ gamlahah mei ka hal ding a, a kimvel zosie ka sieng ding hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Judah kumpipa’ inn ah va peisuh inlen, tam thu khumnah","title":"Kisiakia nading Hanthotna"},"2":{"text":"tam bangin va gen ta’n: David topha tunga a to Judah kumpipa aw, nang, na nasemte le tam tunkotte-a ang lut na mite in Topa’ kammal za un."},"3":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Thutang le thudih tawh gamta unlen, mi bawlsie pa’ khut sung panin a kisuom khat popo hlakhie un. Pemtate, pa nei lote le meigongte tungah khielna bawl loin tatsietna zong zang sih unlen, ahi sihle mawna a nei lo mite’ sisan tam munah luongsah sih un."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in tam thute na man tahtah uleh, David’ topha tunga a to kumpite in sakol leengte le sakolte tungah tuongin amate, a nasemte le a mite tawh tami inn tunkotte tawnin ang lut ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam thute na thuse sih uleh tami inn pen gamdai a suoh dingin kei mama ka kiciem hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Mat 23:28; Luk 13:35"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Judah kumpipa’ inn tungtangah Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Nang pen kei adingin Gilead le Lebanon muolvum bang na hi hi; hinanle keima in nang pen mi ten lona khuopi senel gam ang suosah dingin ka kiciem hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang langkhatah a galvan teng tawh ang susie ding mite ka kithawisah ding hi; amate in na taamtah sing hoipente hing phuapiehin mei-ah pai ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale minam tampite in tam khuo nawhin a unpi-un, “ Topa in bang dinga tami khuopi lien a hici bawl ta adiei,” ci-in khatlekhat kiho ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale amate in, “A Pasien uh Topa’ thuciemna a taisan vua, pasien dangte bie-in a na a sep zieh uh ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"A sisa mipa kaa sih unlen, zong hlasietpi sih un; A kipeipi pa kaazaw un, bangzieh ahei cile a pienna gam a mu dingin ama ang kilekia nawn sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen a pa Josiah’ za a luo, tam mun pana a peidawh Judah Kumpi Josiah’ tapa Shallum tungtang thu Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Tam sungah ama ang kinuale nawn sih ding a,","title":"Josiah Tapate’ Tunga Thupuoh","ref":"2Kum 23:31-34; 2Khg 36:1-4"},"12":{"text":"sal tang dinga a kikaina munah si-in tam gam a mukia nawn sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Dihtat lona tawh a inn a lam, thutang lo tawh a inndan tungnung a lam pa; a mawhna-in a innvengte na a semsah, a thaman a pie lo pa in gimna thuoh ding hi;"},"14":{"text":"“Inn golpi khat lam vangin innkhan tungnung tampi neisah vang,” ci-in tawlet vangte bawlin, taamtah sing thuopsawn a, zasan tawh a zut mi in gimna thuoh ding hi!"},"15":{"text":"Taamtah sing tawh inn na lam ziehin kumpi kisa na hi amah? Na pa in an ne tui dawnin thutang le thudih tawh na sem hi lo amah? Tua ciengin ama a dau a pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in mizawngte le mi cimawte’ vai thutang tawh a khenpieh hi; tuaci’n ama a khutlam a zang hi. Tam khu kei nei thei nading uh hi lo amah, Topa in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle a manlo-a nga nading, maw nei lote’ sisan luonsah nading le, bawlsietna le ngongtatna dingin na mit ule na lungsim uh na zang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Judah Kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim tungtang thu Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Amate in ama adingin, “Kadei, ka sanggam pa! Kadei, sanggam nu!” ci-in a kaa sih ding uhi. Amate in ama adingin, “Kadei, ka pupa! Kadei, a thupina!,”ci-in zong a kaa sih ding uhi.","ref":"2Kum 23:36–24:6; 2Khg 36:5-7"},"19":{"text":"Ama pen laa si a kivui khat bang lelin kivui ding a, Jerusalem tunkot pulamah kikai phitin kipai ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Lebanon ah kato-in awng unlen, Bashan ah na aw sangsah un; Abarim panin awngzah un, azieh pen na guolngaite zosie kisu maimang zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Na dau uh a pei laitahin kang hopi a, ahi vangin, “Na thu ngai sih vang,” nei ci hi. Na neu lai-a kipanin a tuaci den na hi hi. Azieh pen nang in ka thu na mang sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Hui in na tuucingte zosie uh lenmang sieng ding a, na guolngai teng uzong salin kiman ding hi; tua ciengin na gitlona zosie uh ziehin mai zumin na lungkie ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Lebanon ah tengin taamtah sing lahah bu a bawlte aw, note tungah gimna ang tun ciengin numei nausuoh nat bangin bang na ci tau vagua ding vuoi!"},"24":{"text":"Topa in, keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, nang Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim’ tapa Coniah pen ka zietlam khuta kang but ka suoikaina khutsip na hi phiel ta zongin tua panin kang sutdawh ding a,","title":"Coniah tunga Thukhenna (Jehoiachin)","ref":"2Kum 24:8-15; 2Khg 36:9-10"},"25":{"text":"nang ang thasawm na giin mama Babylon Kumpipa le Chaldea-te’ khut sungah kang pie ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na suona mun ahi lo gamdang khatah nang le na pienna na nu kang paidawh ding a, khumnah na si ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin a kilekia nopna uh gamah amate kilekia nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam pa, koima in a dei lo, a kisimmaw beelkehsa, Coniah hi lo amah?"},"29":{"text":"Ka gam, ka gam, ka gam aw, Topa’ kammal ngai ven!"},"30":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tam mipa, ta nei lo pa, a khan tawntunga khuosuoh ngai lo ding pa, ci-in ciemte in; azieh pen ama’ suonlehlah khat beh David’ topha tungah to lo ding a, Judah gam zong uhkia lo ding hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka gantatna munah tuuhonte a susie, a kithezahsah tuucingte in gimna thuoh ding uhi! Topa in ci hi.","title":"Saltan Nua-in a ngaingai Bangkia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa , Israel’ Pasien in ka mite a kem tuucingte tungtang thu tam bangin gen hi: Note in ka tuuhonte thezahin na delmang vua, amate na cing sih uhi. Tuaci’n na gitlo gamtatnate ziehun keima in note kang cing ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kei mama in amate ka delmangna gam zosie panin a omlai ka tuuhon teng ka kaikhawm ding a, a huong sung vuah amate peipikia-in amate pungin a khang ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate a cing dingin tuucingte ka koi ding a, zau nawn lo, lungkham nawn loin khat beh zong mang nawn lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in kang ci-in, keima in David adingin a thudih a bazam khat ka tundawh ding hun ang tung valon ding a, ama kumpi bangin maang ding a, pilvang tahin vai hawmin gam sungah thudih thutang tawh thu a khen ding hi.","title":"A Thudih David’ Bazam"},"6":{"text":"Ama’ hun sungin Judah kihundam ding a, Israel lungmuong tahin a teng ding hi. Ama a kihlat nading min in: “ Topa eite’ Dihtanna,” ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 33:14-16"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in kang ci-in, “Egypt gam pana Israel mite a peipi Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,” ci-in kiciem nawn loin,"},"8":{"text":"“Ama in a delmangna leilu lam gam le gam zosie panin Israel innkuon’ suonte a mapui Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,” ci-in a kiciemzaw ta ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin a gam ciet vuah amate a teng ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kamsangte tawh kisai-in: Topa zieh le a kammal siengthote ziehin keima sungah ka lungsim zanciim a, ka gu ka tang zosie a kithing hi; kei pen zu in a zawgawp zu kham pa tawh ka kibang hi.","title":"Zuouthei Kamsangte Kimawsah"},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile gam sungah angkawmte a dim hi; samsietna ziehin gam sung kap a, gamlah lonona munte gawta sieng hi. Amau’ lampi a hoi sih a, amau’ thahatna zong maan lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsangte le siempute in a ni gelin Pasien a zatah sih uhi; ka biehinn sung nangawnah a gitlona uh ka mu hi, Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ziehin amau’ lampi pen khuomiel lamnal bang hi ding a, khumnah kidelmangin amate a pua ding uhi; azieh pen amau’ gimthuoh ding hun a tun ciengin amate tungah gimna ka tungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Samaria kamsangte lahah a muthadahuoi khat ka mu hi: Amate in Baal minin thu a hil vua, ka mi Israel-te a puikhiel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle Jerusalem kamsangte sungah a mulkinhuoizaw lai na khat ka mu zo hi: Amate in angkawmin zuouthu a gen uhi; a gitlona uh panin koima a kilekia lo nadingin amate in na hoi lo a bawl mite’ khut a khausah uhi. Kei adingin amate a unpi-un Sodom a bang sieng ta vua, a sunga teng mi zosie zong Gomorrah a bang ta uhi.","ref":"Pien 18:20; Ezk 16:46"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kamsangte tawh kisai-in Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: “Keima in amate gamsai ka nesah ding a, keima in a dawn dingun gutui ka pie ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile Jerusalem kamsangte panin gamsung muncin tengah Pasien zatah lona kizel zo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Na kung vuah thu hing genin note ang sol kamsangte’ thugente ngai sih un; amate in a lungsim sung vua a geltawm uh thute ang gen uh ahi bo a, Topa’ kam sung pan hi lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Topa’ kammal a simmawte kungah, “Note adingin hing hoi na va,” a ci den mielmuol uhi; amau’ lungtang khauna banga khau taha a zui mi zosie kungah amate in, “Note tungah tuosietna ang tung sih ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa’ kikhopna ah koi ding ngai a, a thugente va thei ngai, va za ngai ahi ahei?"},"19":{"text":"En un, Topa’ huipi khu! A thangpaina pumpei kihiapi ang pusuoh zo hi; migilo pa’ lutung a mutgawp ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A lungtup teng semin a tangtunsah masangsie, Topa’ lungthahna a kilekia sih ding hi. Ang tung ding nite ah note in kicien tahin na thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ka sawl lopi-in kamsangte a tai uhi; amate kungah ka gen lopi thu a songen uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanle amate ka kikhopna ah ang to uh hi leh, amate in ka mite kungah ka kammalte a tangko thei ding vua, a lampi hoi lote ule a gamtat hoi lote uh panin amate kinuahei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kei pen a naina muna a om Pasien ka hi amah? A gamlapi-a zong a om Pasien hi lo ka mah? Topa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka mu thei lo nadingin koi in phuolsel munah amate phuol thei ding ahei? Topa in ci hi. Vantung le leitung dim hi lo ka mah? Topa in ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima in, “Mang man zo ing, mang man zo ing!” ci-in keima’ min tawh zuouthu a gen kamsangte’ thugente ka za zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Zuouthute hilin a lungsim sung vua a suoh misolna po a gen kamsangte ang kiheikia nading bang tanvei sawt ding ahei?"},"27":{"text":"A pu a pate un Baal a bieh ziehun ka min a mangngil bangun khatlekhat a mang uh kigenin ka mite keima’ min a mangngilsah sawm uhi."},"28":{"text":"Mang man kamsangpa in a mangmat gen hinlen, hizongle ka kammal a nei pa in muonhuoi tahin ka kammal gen taheh.
