Butu le butang bangci kibah thei ding ahei, Topa in ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka kammal mei tawh kibang a, suongte a satguoi thei sehta tawh zong kibang hi lo amah, Topa in ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin en un, khatlekhat keima’ kammal a kiguhpieh kamsangte ka langpang hi, Topa in ci hi."},"31":{"text":"En un, a phuotawm uh thu gen hi napi, “ Topa in ci hi,” a ci kamsangte ka langpang hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"32":{"text":"En un, Topa in kang ci-in, ka sawl lopi le thu ka pieh lopi-in zuou mang genin amate thu hil a, a zuouna ule khawhsah ci a nei lona uh ziehin ka mite lam a puikhiel kamsangte ka langpang hi; tuaci’n tam mite in amate a phattuompi vawt sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tam mite, ahi sihle kamsang khat, ahi sihle siempu khat in, “ Topa’ vangih bang ahei?” ci-in nang ang dawh uh ciengin nang in amate kungah, “Tua vangih nangma na hi a, nang kang paimang ding hi, Topa in ci hi,” na ci ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Kamsang, siempu, ahi sihle ka mite khatpo in, “ Topa’ vangih,” a ci leh ama le a innkuonpite gim ka pie ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Note lahah, “ Topa in bangin ang dawng ei? “ahi sihle, “ Topa in bang ang gen ei?” khatlekhat na kici ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi vangin, “ Topa’ vangih,” ci-in na gen nawn poma sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ vangih na ci uh pen note’ thugen ahi bo a, tuaci’n note in eite’ Pasien ahi a hing zing Pasien, Vanglien Topa’ kammalte na leheipieh ta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Note in kamsangpa kungah, “ Topa in bangin ang dawng ei?” ahi sihle, “ Topa in bang ang gen ei?” ci-in tua bangin na dong ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin, “ Topa’ vangih” na ci uleh Topa in tam bangin ci hi: “ Topa’ vangih,” na ci sih ding uhi, ci-in kang sawl vangin note in “ Topa’ vangih,” ci kammalte gen zo ta na hi ziehun,"},"39":{"text":"tuaci’n note hing domto-in note le na pu na pate uh tunga ka piehsa khuopi pen ka opna panin ka paimang valon ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Kumtawn simmawna le maizumna kang thuohsah ding vua, tua khu bangma cih hunin a kimangngil ngai nawn sih ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ biehinnpi mai-a a kikoi theiga lawdim ni Topa in ei musah a, tam pen Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzer in Jerusalem panin Judah Kumpi Jehoiakim’ tapa Kumpi Jeconiah le Judah uliente, khutsiemte le siakheng siemte tawh manin Babylon ah sal dinga a peipi zaw ahi hi.","title":"Theiga a Hoi le a Hoilo","ref":"2Kum 24:12-16; 2Khg 36:10"},"2":{"text":"Law khatah a min masate tawh a kibang theiga hoite om a, ahi vangin adang law khatah neh thei lo ding za donga a hoi lo theigate a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah, “Jeremiah aw, bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Kei zong, “Theiga ka mu hi, a hoite hoi mama a, a hoi lote lah a hoimaw sengin kine thei lo hi,” ka ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima kungah Topa’ kammal ang tung hi:"},"5":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Tam mun panin Chaldea-te gama ka sawldawh Judah gam pana saltangte pen tam theiga hoite bangin ka ngaisun ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate a hoi nadingun keima in mit tuhna-in ka nei ding a, tam gamah ka peipikia ding hi. Keima in amate ka lam ding a, ka phelmang sih ding hi; amate ka phut ding a, amate ka botzuon sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima Topa ka hi lam theitheina lungsim amate ka pie ding hi; ka kungah a lungtang zosie utawh ang kilekia ding uh ahi ziehin amate keima’ mi ahi ding vua, kei zong amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah, a uliente, tam gama a om den Jerusalem-a a omlai teng le Egypt gama a tengte pen a hoimaw senga a kine thei lo theiga bangin ka bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitung kumpi gam zosie adingin a mulkinhuoi le a siehuoi-in amate ka bawl ding a, ka delmang nading muncin tengah mite’ simmawna, thusie gentena, zakona le awsie lawna ka thuohsah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate le a pu a pate uh ka piehsa gam panin ka suhmaimang masangsie amate lahah namsau, kielpi le pul natna ka tungsah ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suozaw a kum li cin kumin Judah mite zosie tawh kisai-in Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi. (Tua hun pen Babylon ah Nebuchadnezzar kumpi a suo a kum khatna kum ahi hi.)","title":"Babylon Saltan ding Kigenkhol","ref":"2Kum 24:1; 2Khg 36:5-7; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Kamsang Jeremiah in Judah mi zosie le Jerusalem-a a teng zosie kunga a gen ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"Judah kumpi Amon’ tapa Kumpi Josiah a kumpi suo zaw a kum sawm le thum pan tuni dongin kum sawmni le kum thum sung vilvel Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung a, na kung vuah kang gengen vangin na ngai nuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in na kung vuah a nasem kamsangte zosie ang sawl den vangin note in ngai loin na bil zong na daw sih vua,"},"5":{"text":"tuale amate in, “Tu-in na unpi-un na gitlona ule na gamtat sietna panun na kihei uleh Topa in note le tanglai-a na pu na pate uh tungah kumtawn nei dinga ang pieh gam sungah na om suoh ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"A na sem ding le a bie dingin pasien dangte’ nua zui sih unlen, na khut utawh na bawl uh milimte ziehin kei ei lungthahsah sih un. Tua hile ke’n zong note bangma kang law sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in ka thu na ngai sih vua, na gim nga nadingun na khut utawh milim bawlin nei lungthahsah uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Note in ka thu na man nuom lo ziehun"},"9":{"text":"leilu lam gama om minam zosie le ka nasempa Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar nangawn ka thuta ding a, tam gam le a sunga teng mi zosie le tam kimvela om minam zosie a do dingin ka kuonsah ding hi; keima in amate ka sumaimang ding a, a cimulthawhuoi, a ehneh hohuoi le kumtawnin mite’ simmaw-in amate ka bawl ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate kung panin kipah thanopna awging, motha nu le zi nei pa’ awgingte ka tawpsah ding a, an gawina gingte le meivah tangte ka sumit ding hi.","ref":"Jer 7:34; 16:9; Kln 18:22-23"},"11":{"text":"Tam gambup kisie-in koima’ ten lona gamkhing suoh ding a, tua minamte in kum sawmsagi sung Babylon kumpipa’ na a sem ding uhi.","ref":"2Khg 36:21; Jer 29:10; Dan 9:2"},"12":{"text":"Kum sawmsagi a cinzaw ciengin amau’ khielna ziehin keima in Babylon kumpipa le a gam dan ka pie ding a, a gam uh kumtawn gamdai ka suohsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate tungah tua gam ka dona ka thu gensa zosie, Jeremiah in minam zosie a dona a genkholsa zosie, le tami laibu sunga kigielsa zosie ka tungsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile minam tampite le kumpi liente in zong amate salin a nei ding uhi; keima in amau’ gamtatsate le a khut utawh a bawlsa uh nasepna dung zui-in amate tungah ka thuhkia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel’ Pasien Topa in kei kungah tam bangin gen hi: Ka khut tung panin tam lungthahna zuhai la inlen, kang sawlna minam zosie dawnsah in.","title":"Pasien’ Lungthahna Hai"},"16":{"text":"Amate in dawn ding a, keima in amate lahah ka sawl ding namsau ziehin amate hawi vadoi-in a motlaw ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Topa’ khut panin tua hai ka la a, Topa ei sawlna minam zosie ka dawnsah hi:"},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem le Judah khuopite, a kumpite ule a uliente uh pen tuni-a ma bangin mi ten lona gamkhing suoh a, a ehnehhuoi le samsiethuoi ahi ta uhi;"},"19":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh le a nasemte, a uliente le a mite zosie;"},"20":{"text":"nam kisawhal mite zosie; Uz gam sunga kumpi zosie; Philistia gam sunga kumpi zosie - Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, le Ashdod-a a omlai teng;"},"21":{"text":"Edom, Moab, le Amon-te;"},"22":{"text":"Tyre kumpite zosie, Sidon kumpite zosie, le tuipi panga om kumpi zosie;"},"23":{"text":"Dedan, Tema, Buz khuopite le a sam a heukieu zosiete;"},"24":{"text":"Arabia kumpite zosie le senel gam sunga teng nam kisawhal mite’ kumpite zosie;"},"25":{"text":"Zimri kumpite zosie, Elam kumpite zosie le Media kumpite zosie;"},"26":{"text":"a nai a gamla-a om leilu lam kumpite zosie le lei maitanga a om leitung kumpi gam zosie khat zaw khat keima in ka dawnsah hi. Tuale amate zaw ciengin Sheshach kumpipa in dawn ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel’ Pasien Vanglien Topa in amate kungah tam bangin a gen hi, na ci ding hi: Dawn un, kham unlen luo un. Note lahah namsau hing sawl ding ka hi ziehin pua unlen thokia nawn sih un."},"28":{"text":"Tuale amate in na khut tung panin dawn ding hai a lah nuom sih uleh amate kungah tam bangin ci in: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Na dawn teitei ding uh ahi hi!"},"29":{"text":"En in, keima’ min tawh a kilo khuopi sungah gimna tunsah ka kipan ta ding hi, tua ahile dan thuohna tawh note bangci kipel thei ding na uh ahei? Keima in leitunga teng mi zosie langkhatah namsau khat sawl ding ka hi ziehin dan thuoh loin na om sih ding uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, nang in amate ka langpanna tam thute zosie hil inlen, amate kungah tam bangin gen in: A sangna mun panin Topa ang hawh ding a, a siengtho ama’ tenna panin ama ang ham ding hi; a mite langkhatah ama nahpi tahin hawh ding a, lengga cil mite bangin leitung mi zosie langpangin a awng ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa in minamte tungah thu phul ding ahi ziehin, ama’ awging in leimong dong a thawn ding hi. Ama in mi zosie thu sit ding a, namsau tawh mawneite that ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: En un, gam khat pan gam khatah gimna a kizel ta a, leitung a gamla pen mun panin huipi lien khat in nuoigawp ta hi!"},"33":{"text":"Tua ni-a Topa in a thalia mite leimong khat panin mong khat dongah kithezah ding uhi. Koima in amate ki kaa loin a luong uh kikhawm lo ding a, zong kivui lo ding hi; lei lahah amate eh nuasie-in kinuasie lel ding hi."},"34":{"text":"No tuucingte aw, kap unlen mau un; no tuuhon lamkaite aw, vut lahah kilawmlia un, azieh pen ang kithalia ni ding ule note ang kithethang ni ding ang tung zo a, a kituomteel beel bangin note na pua ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuucingte adingin tai nading mun om lo ding a, tuuhon lamkaite adingin suotah thei nading om lo ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ngai vawi un! tuucingte kaana aw, le tuuhon lamkaite mauna aw khu! Azieh pen Topa in amau’ lonona mun suhsietpieh zo a, a giinhuoi mama Topa’ lungthahna ziehin"},"37":{"text":"a galmuonna uh gam kisiecip hi."},"38":{"text":"Migilo pa’ a thahat namsau le a giinhuoi a lungthahna ziehin humpi in a kibuhna mun a nuasie bangin amau’ gam pen gamkhing a suoh zo hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suo cil lai-in Topa kung panin tam thu a tung hi:","title":"Biehinnpi-ah Jeremiah’ Kamsanna","ref":"2Kum 23:36–24:6; 2Khg 36:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Topa’ biehinn huong sungah va ding ta’nlen Topa’ biehinn sungah a bie dinga ang pei Judah khuopite zosie va hopi in; gen dinga kang sawl zosie amate tungah gen in; kam khat zong hen nei sin."},"3":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un na thugen ngai-in a gitlona panun ang kihei thei kha ding uhi. Tua hile amau’ bawl gitlonate ziehin amate tunga ka tunsah sawm gimna ka khelkia thei kha ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma in amate kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi: Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Note in ka thu ngai loin na mai-vua kang koipiehsa ka thukham bangin na gamtat sih vua,"},"5":{"text":"note kungah kin taha kang sawl - a thu na ngai lo vangun - ka nasem ka kamsangte’ thugen na ngai sih uleh,"},"6":{"text":"tam biehinnpi pen Shiloh bangin ka bawl ding a, tam khuopi pen leitunga minam zosie’ kisamsietna-in ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Josh 18:1; Late 78:60; Jer 7:12-14"},"7":{"text":"Siempute, kamsangte, le mi zosie in Topa’ biehinn sunga Jeremiah in a gen tam thute a za uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mi zosie tungah Topa in gen dinga a sawl zosie Jeremiah in a gen zaw ciengin siempute, kamsangte, le mi zosie in ama manin, “Nang na si ding hi!"},"9":{"text":"Bang dingin, ‘Tam biehinn pen Shiloh tawh kibang ding a, tam khuopi ah a teng koima om loin gamdai a suoh ding hi,’ ci-in Topa’ min tawh thu hil na hei?” a ci uhi. Tuale Topa’ biehinn sunga a om mi zosie in Jeremiah a imtawm uhi."},"10":{"text":"Judah uliente in tam thute a zah ciengun kumpipa’ inn sung panin Topa’ biehinn sungah peito-in Topa’ biehinn lutna Tunkot Tha ah a to uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempute le kamsangte in uliente le mi zosie kungah, “Tam mipa in sina a thuoh ding kilawm hi, azieh pen na bil ciet utawh na zahsa ma bangun ama in tami khuopi lang pangin thu a gen zo hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in ulien zosie le mi zosie kungah, “Note in na zahsa uh tam biehinn le tam khuopi lang khatah thu gen dinga ei sawl pa pen Topa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in na omdan ule na gamtatnate uh puopha unlen, Topa na Pasien uh’ thu mang un. Tua hile Topa in note tungah tunsah dinga a gelsa gimna a khelkia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle kei ka hi leh tam mun na khut sung vua om ka hi hi. Hoi na sah uleh dih na sah bangun kei tungah ei bawl un."},"15":{"text":"Kei nei tha vua ahile, note in no mama tung, tam khuopi, le a sunga teng zosie tungah maw nei lo sisan a tungsah ding na hi lam uh kitelcien beh ta un, bangzieh ahei cile note in na bil mama utawh na zah dingun tam thute mantaha a gen dinga Topa in keima ei sawl ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin uliente le mi zosie in siempute le kamsangte kungah, “Tam pa in Topa i Pasien’ min tawh eite kunga thu ang gen ahi bo ziehin sina a thuoh ding kilawm lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Gam sung upa pawlkhat zong dingin a kikhawm mipite kungah,"},"18":{"text":"“Judah Kumpi Hezekiah’ uh hun sungin Moreshheth-a Micah in Judah mi zosie kungah tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Lo dingin Zion kihlo ding hi; Jerusalem pen buathahlom suoh ding a, tuale biehinn muol pen gamlah munsang a suoh ding hi, Topa in ci hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Mic 3:12"},"19":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah le Judah zosie in ama a that tahtah sam uh amah? Ama in Topa zatahin, Topa maipha ngen a, tuale Topa in zong amate tungah gimna tunsah ding a gensa pen khelkia zaw hi lo amah? Ahi vangin eite in eima’ tungah gimna lienpi i tungsah dihtah uhi!” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim panin Topa’ min tawh thu a hil Shemaiah’ tapa Uriah a kici midang khat zong a om hi. Jeremiah’ gen bangma-in ama in tam khuopi le tam gam lang khatah thu a gen hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale Kumpi Jehoiakim, a galhang zosie le ulien zosie in ama’ thugen a zah ciengun kumpipa in ama tha dingin a sui hi; hizongle Uriah in tua thu a zah ciengin zau-in Egypt gamah a tai hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Jehoiakim in Egypt gamah Achbor’ tapa Elnathan le a mite sawl a,"},"23":{"text":"tuale amate in Egypt gam panin Uriah manin Kumpi Jehoiakim kungah a puoh vua, ama in namsau tawh tua pa satlia-in mi maimaite’ kivuina munah a luonghawm a pai hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam in Jeremiah a panpi ziehin tha dingin mite’ khut sungah kipie lo hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Josiah’ tapa Zedekiah kumpi a suo cilin Topa kung panin Jeremiah kungah tami thu a tung hi.","title":"Hahkol Lim","ref":"2Kum 24:18-20; 2Khg 36:11-13"},"2":{"text":"Keima kungah Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Khau kivaw hahkol khat bawl inlen na ngawngah bul in."},"3":{"text":"Judah kumpi Zedekiah tawh kimu dinga Jerusalem khuo-a a haw palaite khut tung panin Edom kumpipa, Amon kumpipa, Tyre kumpipa, le Sidon kumpipa kungah thu zasah in."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ pute adingin tam thu gen in: Israel Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Na pute kunga na gen ding uh thu tami ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Keima in ka vanglienpi le a kizah ka khut tawh leitung le a mite le leitunga om ganhingte ka bawl a, ka pieh nuom khatpo tungah ka pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in keima’ nasempa Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ khut sungah tam gamte zosie ka pie zo a, ama’ na sem dingin a gamsate nangawn ka pie zo ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama’ gam a kisiet ding hun a tun masangin minam zosie in ama le a tapa le a tupa’ na a sem ding uhi; tua ciengin minam tampite le kumpi liente in ama salin a neikia ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin minam khat ahi sihle kumpi gam khatpo in tam Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ na sem nuom loin Babylon kumpipa’ hahkol a ngawnga a puoh nop sih leh ama’ khut tawh ama’ kisuhsietna ka mansiengsah masangsie namsau tawh, kielpi tawh, pul natna tawh tua minam dan ka pie ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ziehin na kung vuah, “ Babylon kumpipa’ na na sem sih ding uhi,” ci-a ang gen na kamsangte uh, na aisante uh, na mangman theite uh, na sihla ho theite ule na bum aitawite uh’ thugente na um sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in na kungah zuouthu a gen vua, tua ziehin na gam panun a gamlapi ah ang kihem dawh ding uhi. Keima in note kang notdawh ding a, tuaci’n na mangthai ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle minam khat in a ngawngah Babylon kumpipa’ hahkol puo-in ama’ na a sep leh, lo hlo-in a ten thei nadingin ama’ gam sung ma ah ka omsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kungah tua bang ma-in ka gen hi: Babylon kumpipa’ hahkol puo-in ama le a mite’ na semin hing in."},"13":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa’ na a sem lo ding minam poma tawh kisai-in Topa in a gensa ma bangin bang dingin namsau, kielpi, le pul natna tawh nangma le na mite si ding na hi uh ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa’ na na sem sih un, ci-a na kung vua thu ang gen kamsangte’ thugen ngai sih un, bangzieh ahei cile amate pen na kung vua zuothu gen ahi bo uhi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in amate ka sawl kha sih hi; hizongle keima’ min tawh a man lopi-in thu a hil vua, tua ziehin keima in note le na kung vua thu ang hil kamsangte kang notmang ding a, na mangthai ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempute le mi zosiete kungah Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: “Babylon panin Topa’ biehinn sunga beelte kilakia bai ta ding hi,” ci-a na kung vua thu ang hil na kamsangte uh’ thugente ngai sih un, bangzieh ahei cile amate pen na kung vua zuouthu gen ahi bo uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amau’ thugen ngai sih un; Babylon kumpipa’ na sem inlen hing un. Bang dingin tami khuopi gamdai suoh laizang ding ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Amate pen kamsangte ahi vua, amate kungah Topa kammal a op tahtah leh Topa’ biehinnpi sung, Judah kumpipa’ innpi sung, le Jerusalem khuopi sunga a kinuasie lai beelte, Babylon khuo-a a kipuohkia nawn lo nadingin Vanglien Topa kungah thum uheh."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim’ tapa Jeconiah le Judah gam le Jerusalem khuo sunga uliente zosie, Jerusalem panin Babylon ah sala a peipi laitahin ama in a nuasie lai khuompite, tuikuongpite, a ngahnate, le adang beelte tawh kisai-in ahi a,","merge":"20"},"21":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sung, le Jerusalem khuo sunga a kinuasie lai beelte tawh kisai-in Vanglien Topa Israel Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi:"},"22":{"text":"Babylon ah tuate kipuokia ding a, ka kankia masangsie tuatahah a omsuoh ding hi. Tua ciengin keima in tuate ka lakia ding a, tam munah ka koikia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum kum sung ma-in, Judah Kumpi Zedekiah kumpi-a a maan zaw kum li le hla nga a cin kumin, Gibeon panin Azzur’ tapa kamsang Hananiah in Topa’ biehinn sunga siempute le mi zosie mai-ah keima ei hopi a,","title":"Hananiah in Jeremiah Langpangin Si","ref":"2Kum 24:18-20; 2Khg 36:11-13"},"2":{"text":"“Vanglien Topa Israel’ Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: Keima in Babylon kumpipa’ hahkol ka tawngsansah ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in kum ni sungin Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in tam mun pana a lah Babylon khuo-a a peipi, Topa’ biehinn sunga vanzah zosie tam munah ka tutkia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in Judah kumpi Jehoiakim’ tapa Kumpi Jeconiah le Judah gam pana Babylon ah sala a peite zosie tam munah ka peipi kia ding hi, Topa in ei ci hi. Azieh pen Babylon kumpipa’ hahkol ka tawngsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ biehinn sunga a ding siempute le mi zosie mai-ah kamsang Jeremiah in kamsang Hananiah hopi a,"},"6":{"text":"kamsang Jeremiah in, “Amen! Topa in khum bangin hing bawl taheh. Topa in na thugenkholna bangin hing tungsah ta hinlen, Babylon panin Topa’ biehinn sunga vanzahte le sala kiman zosie tam munah hing tutkia tapo heh."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in nang le mi zosie’ zaha kang gen tam thu na ngai ta un."},"8":{"text":"Kei le nang masanga tanglai kamsangte in gam tampi le kumpi gam liente’ tungah gal, kielpi le pulnatnate ang tung ding hi, ci-in na genkhol zo uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kilemna om ding hi, ci-in a gen kamsangpa ahile Topa in ang sawl kamsang tahtah ma amah, ci pen tua kamsangpa’ thugen ang tangtun ciengin kithei pan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsang Hananiah in kamsang Jeremiah’ ngawng panin a hahkol sutpiehin a kuoitan hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale Hananiah in mi zosie mai-ah thu gen a, “ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tu-a bangin kum ni sungin minam zosie’ ngawng panin Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar’ hahkol ka tawngsansah ding hi,” a ci hi. Khuci’n kamsangpa Jeremiah a pei ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Kamsangpa Hananiah in kamsangpa Jeremiah ngawng panin hahkol a sattanpieh zaw hun phabep khat ciengin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"13":{"text":"Pei inlen Hananiah kungah, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Nangma in sing hahkolte na tawngsah ta a, khumte tangin sia hahkol ka bawl zo ta hi!"},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel’ Pasien Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar’ na a sep thei nadingun minam zosie’ ngawng ah sia hahkol ka puosah zo a, amate in ama’ na a sem tahtah ding uhi; keima in ama tungah gamsate nangawn ka pie zo hi, a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Kamsang Jeremiah in kamsang Hananiah kungah, “Ngai vawi, Hananiah, Topa in nang ang sawl lopi, tam mite zuouthu na umsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in lei maitang panin kang hemmang ding hi. Nang in Topa langpanna thu na gen zo tah ziehin kum ni sungin na si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Khumi kum ma a hla sagi hla-in kamsangpa Hananiah a si mintah hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen Jerusalem panin Babylon ah Nebuchadnezzar in sala a peipite lahah a omlai upate, siempute, kamsangte, le mi zosie tungah Jerusalem pana Jeremiah’ laihlah ahi hi.","title":"Babylon Saltangte tunga Jeremiah’ Laihlah"},"2":{"text":"Tami lai a hlah hun pen Kumpi Jeconiah le kumpipa’ nu, kumpi innsung uliente, Judah le Jerusalem makaite, khutsiemte le siakhengte, Jerusalem pana a pei nua uh ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:12-16; 2Khg 36:10"},"3":{"text":"Tua laihlah pen Judah Kumpi Zedekiah in Babylon gam ah Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kunga a sawl ahi Shaphan’ tapa Elasah le Hilkiah’ tapa Gemariah-te’ khut tung pana kihlah sawn ahi hi. Tua sungah tam bang kici hi:"},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem panin Babylon ah sala ka puoh zosie tungah Israel’ Pasien Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"5":{"text":"Inn lam unlen a sungah teng un; umte bawl unlen na um sunga gate kineh un."},"6":{"text":"Zi nei unlen tanu le tapate tawi un; tanu tapa tampi a tawi thei nadingun na tapate a zi ding uh suipieh unlen, na tanute uh mohlah un; khum munah kiem loin pung semsem un."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin note sala kang koina khuopi’ phattuomna ding sui unlen, tua khuopi adingin Topa kungah thu ngetpieh un, azieh pen tua khuopi in phattuomna a nga ziehin note in zong phattuomna na mu ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Note lahah a om kamsangte le aisan theite kisolsah sih unlen, mangmat ang gente uzong ngaipieh sih un,"},"9":{"text":"azieh pen ka min tawh na kung vua ang gen uh thute zuouthu ahi bo a, amate ken ka sawl kha sih hi, Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Babylon hun sung kum sawmsagi a cin cieng behin keima in note kang ve ding a, na kung vua ka thuciemsa tangtungsahin tam munah kang peipikia ding hi.","ref":"2Khg 36:21; Jer 25:11; Dan 9:2"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in mai lamah note lametna kang pieh nading, note’ sietna ding hi lo, na phattuomna dingun gelna ka neite teltahin ka thei hi, Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin note in keima ei hlanin keima kungah hing pei-in thu nang nget ciengun, keima in na thungetna uh kang ngaipieh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Note in keima nei sui ciengun, na lungsim zosie utawh nei sui uleh nei mu ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 4:29"},"14":{"text":"Note’ mu-in ka om ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Tuale na gam uh kang piekia ding a, note kang delmangna gam zosie le mun zosie panin kang kaikhawm kia ding a, sala kang matsahna mun ma-ah kang tutkia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"“ Topa in eite dingin Babylon ah kamsangte ei koipieh zo hi,” note in ci na hi ziehun"},"16":{"text":"David kumpi topha tunga a to kumpipa tawh kisai thu le tami khuopi sunga teng mi zosie le saltang dinga note tawh a zawhton lo na sanggamte utawh kisai-in, Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"17":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi. Amate tungah namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna ka hla ding a, amate pen a kine thei lo theiga muot ka bangsah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Namsau, kielpi, le pulnatnate tawh amate ka nuadel ding a, leitung kumpi gam zosie lahah a cimulthaw huoi-in bawlin, ka delmangna minam zosie lahah amate kisamsie, kilipkhap, ki-ehneh ho-in kizako ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in ka thu thupisim lo uh ahi ziehin amate kungah ka nasemte ka sawl ngitnget vangin amate in a ngai nuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jerusalem panin Babylon khuo-a kang sawl no saltang zosie aw, tu-in Topa’ thu ngai un:"},"21":{"text":"Keima’ min tawh note kunga zuouthu ang hil Kolaiah’ tapa Ahab le Maaseiah’ tapa Zedekiah-te tawh kisai-in Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar’ khutah amate ka pie ding a, ama in na muna vuah amate that ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale amate ziehin Judah panin Babylon-a saltang mi zosie in: “Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in mei tawh a hangaw Zedekiah le Ahab-te bangin Topa in nang hing bawl taheh,” ci-in kisamsietna-in a zang ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel gamah amate a mot gamtat vua, a innvengte’ zite mawpi-in thu ka pieh lopi ka min tawh zuouthu a gen uhi; keima a thei pa le tecipang pa ka hi hi, Topa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Nehelam khuomite Shemaiah kungah tam bangin na gen ding hi:","title":"Shemaiah’ Laihlah"},"25":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Israel’ Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Nangma in na min tawh Jerusalem-a om mi zosie, Maaseiah’ tapa siempu Zephaniah le siempute zosie tungah lai na hlah a,"},"26":{"text":"Topa’ mama in kamsanga kinei mimaw kici poma kol bulin thong sunga a khum ding uliente a koi dingin Topa mama in siempu Jehoiada tangin nang siempui-in ang koi zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hi a, bang dingin note tunga kamsanga ang kinei Anathoth-te ahi Jeremiah khu na phawhsiet lo ahei?"},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in Babylon gama kote tungah lai ang hlah a, “Sawt veipi saltang lai ding na hi uhi; inn lamin a sungah teng ulen, um zong bawlin a sunga piengte ne un,” ei ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Siempu Zephaniah in kamsangpa Jeremiah’ zahin tami laihlah a sim hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah tungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"31":{"text":"Saltang zosie kungah Nehelam khuomi Shemaiah tawh kisai-in Topa’ thugenna tam bangin zasah in: Ka sawl vawt lopi Shemaiah in note kungah thu hing hilin zuouthu ang upsah ziehin,"},"32":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Nehelam khuomi Shemaiah le a suonlehlahte dan ka pie ding hi; ama in Topa langpanna thu gen zo ahi ziehin tam mite lahah a hinglai mi khat beh in ka mite tunga ka sil hoi bawl dingte a mu sih ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa kung panin Jeremiah kungah thu ang tung pen khu tami ahi hi:","title":"A ngaingai Bahkia nading Israel le Judah Kikamciem"},"2":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na kunga kang gensa thute zosie laibu khat sungah khum in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in a genna-ah, ka mite ahi Israel le Judah tungah a gam uh ka piehkia nading nite ang tung valon ding a, tuale a pu a pate uh kunga ka piehsa gamah amate peipikia-in tua gam a luo ding uhi, a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam teng pen Israel le Judah tawh kisai-in Topa in a gen thute ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Eite in zauna, le patauna aw i za zo vua, lungnopna aw ahi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in kan unlen encien vawi un. Pasal in nau a pai thei amah? Tua ahile bang ziehin pasal zosie in numei nausuoh nat banga a khut utawh a tai uh a hum mu ka hei? Bang dingin a maite uh kangdang ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Ka nu ei! Khum ni pen a nasie sengin tua bang ni a om ngai sih hi; tam pen Jacob adingin lungkham hun hi ding a, hinanle khum panin ama kihunkhie veve ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in ama’ ngawnga hahkol kuoitawngin, ama’ kihenna khaute ka bottan ding a, tuale ama pen namdangte in salin khawi nawn lo ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Topa a Pasien uh’ na le a kumpi uh David’ na a sem ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle ka nasempa Jacob aw, nang na hi leh zau vawt sin, Israel aw, lungkham sin, Topa in ci hi. bangzieh ahei cile a gamlapi panin note kang hundam ding a, keima in a saltanna uh panin na suonlehlahte ka hundam ding hi. Jacob’ suonte ang kilekia ding a, amate sip dide le nuomtahin omin, koima in a zausah nawn sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen kang hutdam thei nadingin nang tawh kang omton hi, Topa in ci hi; amate lahah nang kang thethangna minam zosie ka susie ding a, ahi vangin keima in nangma kang susie sih ding hi. A kituoh bep khatin thu kang hil ding a, dan pieh loin lah kang mawh koi sih ding hi.","ref":"Jer 46:27-28"},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na liemna dam thei lo a, na hima nasie mama hi."},"13":{"text":"Na vai puo ding koima a om sih a, na hima adingin zatui om loin, na dam nading zong bangma a om sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Na lawm it zosie in ang mangngil sieng a, amate in nang ang don nuom ta sih uhi; azieh pen na khielna lien luo-in na mawna tam luo ahi ziehin, khuotuona a nei lo galte khat dan ka pieh bang le galte khat satin ka liemsah bangin, nang kang bawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Na liemna ziehin bang dingin kapkap na hi ahei? Nang natna pen damsah thei ahi sih hi. Na khielna lien luo-in na mawna a tam seng ziehin, keima in na tungah tam teng kang bawl ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ziehin nangma ang valte ken zong kivaltum ding a, na galte zosie a unpi-un salin kipeipi ding hi. Nang ang bulute kibulu ding a, galmata nangma ang mante galmatin kiman ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in mi kipampai hing ci-in “Koima’ don lo Zion na hi hi,” ang ci ziehun na tungah damna kang piekia ding a, na liemmate ka damsah kia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Jacob suonte’ buhte a ngaingai ka bangsah kia ding a, amau’ tenna mun tungah lainatna ka nei ding hi. A muol tungah khuopi kilamkia ding a, a om ngaina mun ma-ah kumpi inn omkia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khumte sung panin lungdamkona la sahna le guolnopna awging ang pusuoh ding hi. Amate ka pungsah ding a, a tawmtham ahi sih ding uhi; mi zatah dingin amate ka bawl ding a, amate a kineu-et sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A tate uh pen hun lui lai bang ding a, a mihonpite uh ka mai-ah kiphutdet ding hi. Amate a gawt mi zosie dan ka pie ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A kumpi ding uh pen amate khat ma hi ding a, a vaihawm lamkai ding uh amate sung pan ma-in ang pieng ding hi; Keima in a nai ah ama ka kai ding a, ama in ka kung ei zuon ding hi. Tua hi sihle koi in ka kung ei zuon ngam ding ahei, Topa in ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale note ka mite na hi ding vua, kei na Pasien uh ka hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"En un, Topa’ khuopi huipi khu! Thangpaina ang pusuoh ta a, pumpei kihiapi in migilo pa’ lutung mutgawp ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama’ lungtup teng semin, a tangtun masangsie, a giinhuoi Topa’ lungthahna a kilekia sih ding hi. Ang tung ding nite-ah note in tami na telsiem ding uhi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin Israel innkuonte zosie’ Pasien ka hi ding a, amate ka mi ahi ding uhi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Lungdama a Kilekia Saltangte"},"2":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Namsau-a suohtate in senel gamah hepina mu uhi. Israel in toidamna a sui ciengin,"},"3":{"text":"ama kungah a gamlapi panin Topa kilang hi. Keima in a tul thei lo itna tawh nangma kang it hi; tua ahi ziehin keima in na tungah kang thumanna ka zomsuoh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngahnu siengtho Israel! Keima in kang lamkia ding a, nang na kilampha ding hi. Nangma in na tawmte na la ding a, a guolnuomte’ lamna-ah na va pei ta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria muoltung tengah lenggui na suonkia ding a, um bawlte in suonin, a ga ne-in a nuomsa ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Ephraim muoltung panin galvilte in, “Hing pei un, Topa i Pasien uh kung Zion ah peito vai,” ci-in a hlat nading uh ni khat ang tung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Jacob ading kipahna tawh a gingin la sa unlen, minamte lahah a lienpente adingin kiko-in awng un; “A omlai na mi Israel-te hundam in, Topa aw,” ci-in kiko-in phat un."},"8":{"text":"En un, leilu lam gam panin amate ka peipi ding a, leitung a gamla pen mun panin ka kaikhawm ding hi. Amate lahah mittaw, khelbai, numei gaite le nausuoh natna a nei numeite, mihon tampite tawh a kilekia ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"A kaa kawmun amate ang pei ding a, keima in henepna tawh amate ka puikia ding hi. Tui a opna lui gei-ah amate peisahin lamzang ka zawtpi ding a, a pua sih ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile kei pen Israel’ pa ka hi a, Ephraim, ka tapa ta pen ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Minamte aw, Topa’ thu ngai un. A gamla tuipi panglamah va gen ta un. “Israel a thezah pa in ama kaikhawm ding a, tuucingpa in a tuute a cin bangin ama a cing ding hi,” va ci ta un."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in Jacob tan zo a, ama dinga a hat mama khutte panin ama hunkhie zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate ang pei ding vua, Zion muolsang tungah nahpi-in la sa-in, Topa’ hoina ahi, an, lenggazu, sathau, tuuno honte le ganta note ziehin a mai uh a tang ding hi. A hinkhuo uh tui kibuoh um bang ding a, a lunggim nawn sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ngahnute lamin a kipah ding vua, tangvalte le papite zong guolnuom ding uhi. Keima in a kaanate uh kipahna-in ka heipieh ding a, amate henemin a danate uh lungdamna ka suohsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Antui pen tawh siempute niengtahin ka va ding a, keima’ hauna ziehin ka mite lungtai ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ramah ah nahpi kaana le mauna awging kiza hi. Rachel, a tate adingin kap hi; amate a op tah lo ziehin kihlai zo lo hi.","ref":"Pien 35:16-19; Mat 2:18"},"16":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Kapkap nawn sin len, na hlitui sia dawh in; azieh pen na sepna ziehin thaman na nga hi, Topa in ci hi. A galte uh’ gam panin amate ang peikia ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na mailam adingin lametna a om hi. Topa in ci hi: Ama in na tate zong amau’ gam ma-ah ang peikia ding uhi,"},"18":{"text":"Ephraim’ thumna ka za tahtah ta a: “A kisin lo bawngno thu nei hil a, nei thuhilna ka mang hi. Ei puikia inlen ei peisahkia in. Azieh pen nang Topa ka Pasien na hi hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile ka peizaw ciengin ka kisiakia hi; keima ka kitheitel zaw ciengin ka phei ka beng hi; ka neu lai-a ka minsietna teng ka puoh den ziehin maizumin ka lung amgawp hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ephraim, ka it mama ka tapa ahi amah? Ama keima’ lungkimna tapa ahi amah? Ama langpangin thu ka gen sielin ama ka phawh lai veve hi. Tua ziehin ka lungsim sungah ama teng den hi; ama ka hepi tahtah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Lampi ciemtenate phut unlen, lamlahnate bawl un; na peina uh lamlienpi limtahin ngaisun un, ngahnu siengtho Israel aw, hing kilekia unlen, tam na khuopite vuah hing kilekia un."},"22":{"text":"A muonhuoi lo ka tanu aw, bang tanvei lungkaa ding na hei? Azieh pen leitungah Topa in a tha na khat a bawl hi: Numei in pasal a kimvel hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in a gam uh ka piehkia ciengin Judah gam sung le a khuopite uh sungah amate in, “A dih tenna aw, muol siengtho aw! Topa in thupha hing pie taheh,” ci-in tam kammalte khatvei a zangkia ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Judah gam le a khuopite uh sungah lohlote le a tuuhonte utawh a vah kawikawite a tengton ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Keima in a gimte ka tawldamsah ding a, a baate’ tha ka dimkia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin khangloin ka khuodah leh kei adingin ka kimut a nuom mama hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in Israel innkuonte le Judah innkuonte tungah mihing cihlah le ganhing’ cihlah ka tu ding ni ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Mimal Dan Thuohna"},"28":{"text":"Tuale amate botdawhin phelkhie a, paimangin suhsiet ding le sietna tunsah dingin ka buh ma bangin, a lamkia ding le a phutkia dingin amate ka vil ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin amate in: “Pate in lengga thua a ne vua, a tate uh’ ha a za hi,” a ci nawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Ezk 18:2"},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin a mawnate uh ziehin mi zosie si ding uhi; lengga thua a nete zosie a ha uh za ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Keima in Israel innkuonte le Judah innkuonte tawh thuciemna tha khat ka bawl ding ni ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Thuciemna Tha","ref":"Mat 26:28; Mrk 14:24; Luk 22:20; 1Cor 11:25; 2Cor 3:6"},"32":{"text":"Tua pen Egypt gam panin ka peipi thei nadingin amau’ khut tawh ka kaih hun lai-a a pu a pate utawh ka na bawl thuciemna tawh kibang nawn lo ding hi. Kei amau’ pasal ka hi vangin amate in tua thuciemna a palsat uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Khum hun zaw cienga Israel innkuonte tawh ka bawl ding thuciemna tami hi zaw ta ding hi, Topa in ci hi: Amate sungah ka thukham ka koi ding a, amau’ lungtang tungah ka giel ding hi; tuale kei amau’ Pasien ka hi ding a, amate keima’ mite ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Heb 10:16"},"34":{"text":"Koima in, “ Topa thei in,” ci-in amate khatlekhat kihil nawn loin, khatlekhat zong kigen nawn lo ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in a neupen panin a golpen dongin a unpi-un keima ei thei ding uhi, Topa in ci hi. Azieh pen keima in amau’ khielna ka maisah ding a, a mawna uzong phawkhahin ka nei nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Heb 8:8-12; Heb 10:17"},"35":{"text":"Tam bangin Topa in a gen hi, sun a vahsah dingin ni ei pie a, zan a vahsah dingin hlapi le aasite’ ngaina kipte ei gelpiehin, tuihuolte a gin valuh nadingin tuipi a lawh pa - ama’ min pen Vanglien Topa ahi hi, a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tami ngaina kipte ka mai-a a manthai leh, Israel’ suonlehlahte zong ka mai panin minam khat ahina uh mangthai pan beh ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tung lama vante kite thei hinlen, leinei-a leitung kitunna zungpi mudawh thei-a a op leh, Israel’ suonlehlahte zosie, amau’ gamtatnasate ziehin ka nuol pan beh ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Hananel tausang panin Kiu Tunkot dongin Topa adingin khuopi a kibawlphat ding hun ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Jerusalem Kigolkeh Ding"},"39":{"text":"A tena khau pen Gareb muol dongin tangtahin kikai ding a, Goah lamah kihei ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Misi luongte le vut buohna kuom bup le Kidron Lui cieng donga a om lo teng zosie, nisuona lama Sakol Tunkot cieng dong, Topa adingin mun siengtho a suoh ding hi. Bangma cih hunin tua khuopi kiphungkal loin zong kipaimang ngai nawn lo ding hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar kumpi a suo zaw kum sawm le kum gietna kum, Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah kumpi a suo zaw a kum sawmna kumin Topa kung panin Jeremiah kungah thu tung hi.","title":"Galte’ Imtawm Laitahin Jeremiah in Lo Khat Lei","ref":"2Kum 25:1-7"},"2":{"text":"Khum hunin Babylon kumpipa’ galkapte in Jerusalem a imtawm laitah uh ahi a, kamsangpa Jeremiah zong Judah kumpipa’ inn huong sunga thong sungah a kikhumcip laitah ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama pen Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in tua muna a na khum cimit ahi hi. Zedekiah in, “Bang dingin nang in kamsangin: Topa in tam bangci hi: Keima in Babylon kumpipa’ khut sungah tam khuopi ka pie ding a, ama in a la ding hi;"},"4":{"text":"Chaldea-te’ khut sung panin Judah kumpipa Zedekiah suohta lo ding a, ahi vangin Babylon kumpipa’ khutah kipie tahtah ding a, tuale ama tawh kimaituo-in kiholimin a mit utawh a ki-entuoh ding uhi;"},"5":{"text":"tuale ama in Babylon ah Zedekiah peipi ding a, keima in ama ka ve masangsie khum munnah omden ding hi, Topa in ci hi; Chaldea-te do nan locin na zo sih ding uhi, ci-a thu na hil mawh ahei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Jeremiah in, “Keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung hi:"},"7":{"text":"Nangma kungah na pano Shallum’ tapa Hanamel ang pei ding a, ama in, “Anathoth khuo-a ka lo kilei in, azieh pen sum tawh lei-in tatkiatheina thu nei khu nangma na hi hi,” ang ci ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ ang gen dung zui-in inn huong sunga ka opna thong sungah ka innlah sanggampa ang pei-in, “Benjamin gam Anathoth khuo-a ka lo lei in, bang ding ahei cile gam neina le tatkiatheina thu na nei hi; nangma adingin kilei in,” ei ci hi. Tua ciengin keima in tam pen Topa’ thu ahi lam ka thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale keima in ka pano Hanamel kung panin Anathoth khuo-a lo ka lei a, ama adingin ngun shekel sawm le sagi ka tekhie hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in thukimna lai tungah min ka thu a, gip tawh matin teci ding hlanin tawi khaina-ah sum ka te hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka thukimna ule a thu teng a kigielna, gip tawh a kimat ka kileina uh lai le gip tawh a kimat lo laite ka la a,"},"12":{"text":"ka innlah sanggampa Hanamel, ka kileina uh lai tunga minthu tecite, le thong huong sunga a to Judah mi zosie’ mai-ah Mahseiah’ tapa Neriah, a tapa Baruch kungah tua lai ka pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in amate mai-ah tam bangin Baruch thu ka pie a,"},"14":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tami kileina laite, gip tawh a kimat le gip tawh a kimat lolai tegel la inlen, kisie loin sawt veipi a op thei nadingin leibeel sung khatah koi in."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tami gam sunga innte, lote le lengga lote ang kileikia ding hi, ci-in ka gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Neriah’ tapa Baruch kungah kileina lai ka pieh zaw ciengin Topa kungah thu ka ngen hi:","title":"Jeremiah in Theitel nading Thungen"},"17":{"text":"Kasai, Topa Pasien! Na khut zahin na vanglienpi tawh vanpi le leipi a bawl pa nangma na hi hi! Nang adingin a hamsa bangma khat beh om lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangma in a khang tul khatna dongin na itna kip na lah a, hinanle pate’ khielna amau’ nua-a tate tungah na thuh hi. Vanglien Topa a kici a lien mama le a thahat mama Pasien aw,"},"19":{"text":"na thugelte hoi mama a, na sepnate thupi mama hi; nang in mihingte’ opdan zosie na musuoh a, a opdante ule a sepna gate uh dung zui-in mi zosie tungah thaman na pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma in Egypt gamah lim le na lamdangte na lah a, tuni dongin zong Israel gam le mi zosie tungah lahin, tuni cieng dongin na min a thangsah peisuoh pa na hi hi."},"21":{"text":"Nangma in na mi Israel-te Egypt gam panin lim le na lamdangte tawh ahi a, a kizah nangma’ banhat tawh ahi a, mulkin huoitah tawh ahi zongin na ladawh hi;"},"22":{"text":"a pu a pate uh kungah pieh dinga na ciemsa, bawngnawi le khuoizu a luonna tami gam amate na pie hi;"},"23":{"text":"tuale amate lutin tam gam a luo uhi. Ahi vangin amate in na thu mang loin na thukham zong zui loin, bawl dinga na thupiehte zosie a bawl sih uhi. Tua ahi ziehin nangma in amate tungah tam gimna zosie na tungsah hi."},"24":{"text":"En un, khuopi a kilah nadingin leiciente kicieng zo a, namsau, kielpi, le pulnatnate a thuohna ziehin amate a do Chaldea-te’ khut sungah tua khuopi a kipie ta hi. Na gensa bangin ang pieng zo hi, ci nang mama-in na mitin na mu thei ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi mawh vangin Topa Pasien aw, tam khuopi pen Chaldea-te’ khut sungah kipie zo nanle nang in kei kungah, “Na teci ding mi ciel inlen tua lo sum tawh lei in,” nei ci zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:","title":"Mite Kilekia Ding Pasien’ Hlamuonna"},"27":{"text":"En in, kei pen mi zosie’ Pasien, Topa ka hi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Chaldea-te’ khut sung le Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ khut sungah tam khuopi ka pie ding a, ama in a la ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:1-11; 2Khg 36:17-21"},"29":{"text":"Tam khuopi a sim Chaldea-te pei-in mei tawh khuopi a hal ding vua, ka lungthah nadingin innkhum tung tengah Baal ading biehnate lui zo-in, pasien dangte adingin dawn thei biehnate zong a sung zo uhi."},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel mite le Judah mite in a neu lai vua kipanin ka muna-ah bangma bawl loin a sie beh a gamta uhi; Israel mite in bangma dang bawl loin, a khut utawh a bawlte uh ziehin keima ei lungthahsah uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam khuopi in a kisat cila kipanin tuni cieng dongin keima ei lungthahsahin ei thangpaisah ahi ziehin ka muna panin ka hemmang ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel mite le Judah mite - amate, a kumpite ule a uliente uh, a siempute ule a kamsangte uh, Judah mite le Jerusalem khuo-a a teng mite in a bawl uh sietna zosiete ziehin keima ei lungthahsah uhi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in kei ei maingat loin ei nuangat uhi; amate thu hilhil nanleng ngai nuom loin thuhilna a sang nuom sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in ka min kilawna biehinn sungah a kidahhuoite koi-in a buasah uhi.","ref":"2Kum 23:10; Jer 7:30-31; 19:1-6"},"35":{"text":"Amate in Molech tungah a tanute, a tapate uh a pieh nadingun Hinnom’ tapa kuomah Baal biehna munsangte a bawl uhi. Keima in Judah mite a khielsah tami a kidahhuoi a bawl dingin amate thu ka pie ngai sih a, zong ka ngaisun kha beh sih hi.","ref":"Siem 18:21; 2Kum 23:10; Jer 7:31"},"36":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in, “Namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna ziehin Babylon kumpipa’ khut sunga kipie ahi ta hi,” na ci uh tam khuopi tawh kisai-in Israel’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"37":{"text":"En vawi, ka lunghangin ka lungso a, ka nah thangpai seng ziehin ka delmangna gam zosie panin amate ka khawmtuo kia ding a, tam munah tutkia-in amate lungmuong tahin ka omsah ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Amate keima’ mi hi ding a, kei zong amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate hoi nading, a nua cieng vua a tate uh’ hoi nading le a lungtang vuah kum tawnin ei giin thei nadingun lungtang khat le tawndan khat amate ka pie ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Amate tungah sil hoi bawlna ka khawl ngai lo nadingin amate tawh tawntung thuciemna khat ka bawl ding hi. Keima kung panin a kiheimang lo nadingun amau’ lungtang sungah keima giinna ka guon ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate tungah na hoi ka bawl ziehin ka kipah ding a, ka lungtang zosie le ka hinna zosie tawh thuman tahin tam gamah amate ka phutdet ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tam mite tungah tam gimna zosie ka tunsah ma bangin, amate tungah tu-a ka ciem na hoi zosie ka tungsah ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Tami gam pen mihingte le ganhingte a ten lona gamkhing hi a, Chaldea-te’ khut sungah kipie zo ta hi, note in na ci uh tami gamah lote kileikia ta ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin gam sung, Jerusalem kimvela munte, le Judah gam sunga khuopite, muoltung gam sunga khuopite, Shephelah gam sunga khuopite, le Negeb gam sunga khuopite ah lote sum tawh kilei ding a, tecite tawh thukimna lai tungah letmat thu-in gip tawh kimat ding hi; azieh pen keima in a gam uh ka piekia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thong huong sungah a kikhumcip laitahin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a ni veina a tung hi:","title":"Danpiehna zaw cienga Damsahna"},"2":{"text":"Leitung bawlin a kipsah Topa, a min Topa a kici Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"3":{"text":"Keima ei hlan un, kang dawng ding a, na thei ngai lo uh phuolsel thulienpite kang gen ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen galte’ leicien cienna zieh le gal dona ziehin namsau mai-ah a kisusie ding ahi tami khuopi sunga innte le Judah kumpite’ innte tawh kisai-in, Israel-te’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"5":{"text":"Ka lungthahna le ka thangpaina ziehin keima in ka thalia ding misi luongte tawh a kidimsah dingin gal sim dingin Chaldea-te ang pei ding hi, azieh pen a gitlona zosiete ziehin tami khuopi panin ka mai ka phuol zo ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tami khuopi tungah noptuomna le cidamna tungsahin amate ka damsah ding a, amate tungah a kicing hauna le lungmuonna ka lah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in a saltanna panun Judah le Israel ka lakia ding a, a op masah lai bangun ka omsah kia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima tunga ang bawl uh a mawna uh zosie panin amate ka siengsah ding a, ka tunga ang mawnate ule ei langpanna zosiete uh ka maisah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale keima in tami khuopi pen amate adinga ka bawl na hoi zosie a za ding ahi leitung minam zosie’ mai-ah lungdamna, patawina, le vanglietna hi ding hi; ama adinga ka pieh hoina le nopsahna zosie ziehin amate zau-in a citun ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Note in, “Tam munah mi lah om lo, ganhing lah om lo, a hawmpi-a om hi bo, na ci ma bangun, Judah khuopite le Jerusalem gawlzingte hawmsuoh a, mihing ganhing koima teng ta sih, ci-a na genna mun vuah awging ang kizakia ding a,"},"11":{"text":"kipah thanopna awging, zinei pa le motha nu’ awging le Topa’ biehinn sunga lungdamko biehna awging ahi, Vanglien Topa tungah lungdamna ko un, azieh pen Topa hoi a, ama’ itna kip tawntung hi!” ci-a lasahna awgingte a kizakia ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile keima in a masa lai bangin a gam uh hamphatna ka piekia ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"1Khg 16:34; 2Khg 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; Late 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1"},"12":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Mihing le ganhing om lo a hawmsuoh ahi tami mun le a khuopi zosie ah tuucingte ading lonona mun le a tuuhonte toi om nading mun omkia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Muoltung khuopite, Shephalah khuopite le Negeb gam khuopite, Benjamin gam, Jerusalem khuo kimvel munte le Judah gam khuopite ah tuuhon phaza a sim pa’ khut sungah tuuhonte a vah kawi kawi ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel innkuonte le Judah innkuonte kungah ka kamciem ka tangtunsah ding ni ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"A Dihtat Bazam le David tawh Thuciemna"},"15":{"text":"Khum ni le khum hun ciengin David adingin a dihtat Bazam khat ka zamsah ding a, ama in gam sungah thutang le thudih tawh thu a khen ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Judah khu a kihundam ta ding a, Jerusalem lungmuong tahin a teng ding hi. Tuale ama a kihlat nading a min: “ Topa, Eite’ Dihtatna,” kici ding hi.","ref":"Jer 23:5-6"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam bangin ci hi: David’ suon sung panin Israel innkuonte’ kumpi topha tungah a to ding mi kitasam ngai lo ding hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12-16; 1Kum 2:4; 1Khg 17:11-14"},"18":{"text":"Levi siempute zong ka mai-a meihal biehna a lui ding, an tawh biehna a tawi ding, le biehpiehnate a bawl zing ding mi a kitasam ngai sih ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 3:5-10"},"19":{"text":"Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"20":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Note khatpo in a hun kiciengtan banga sun le zan a tun lo nadingin sun tawh ka thuciemna le zan tawh ka thuciemna na phel thei vua ahile,"},"21":{"text":"tua cieng behin ka nasempa David tawh ka thuciemna a kisie hi pan ding a, tuaci’n David in ama’ kumpi topha tungah a to ding tapa nei loin, ka nasem Levi mite tawh ka thuciemna zong a kisie ahi pan ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Van mihonte a kisim zo lo le tuipi gei-a senelte a kite zo lo bangin keima in ka nasempa David’ suonte le ka nasem Levi-te ka pungsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"24":{"text":"Tam mite in, “ Topa in a teelsa innkuon nite nuol zo ta hi, ci-in a gen uh na phawh kha ta sih amah? Tuale amate in ka mite tua bangin simmaw-in minam khat a zong a sim tah lo uh amah?"},"25":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Sun le zan tawh ka thuciemna kipsah nai loin, van le lei tawh ngaina kipte a bawl zo nai lo khat hi poma leng,"},"26":{"text":"Jacob’ suonte le ka nasempa David’ suonte ka nuol ding a, Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob’ suonte tungah a uh dingin ama’ suonlehlahte lahah khat zong ka teel sih ding hi. Azieh pen tu-in tua bang hi loin a gam uh ka piekia ding a, amate tungah hepina ka nei ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a galkap zosie, leitunga kumpi gam zosie le ama’ uh sunga a om mi zosie tawh Jerusalem le a khuopi zosie a sim laitahin Topa kung panin Jeremiah kungah thu a tung hi:","title":"Saltanna-ah Zedekiah’ Si Ding Kigenkhol"},"2":{"text":"“Israel’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Pei-in Judah kumpipa Zedekiah hopi inlen ama kungah tam bangin gen in: Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Babylon kumpipa’ khut sungah tam khuopi ka pie ding a, ama in mei tawh a hal ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale nang mama zong ama’ khut sung panin suohta loin ang kiman ding a, ama’ khut sungah ang kipie tahtah ding hi; na mit tawh Babylon kumpipa mu-in ama tawh kimaituo-in na kiho ding uhi; tuale nang Babylon ah na pei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah aw, Topa’ thu ngai phot tadi’n! Nangma tawh kisai-in Topa thugen tam bang ahi hi: Namsau tawh na si sih ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"lungmuongin na si ding hi. Tuale na mai-ah kumpi a sem na pu na pate adingin panamtui a kihal bangin nang adingin zong panamtuite kihal ding a, ‘Kadei aw, pu aw!’ ci-in ang kikaa ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile keima in kang gen zo ta hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in Jerusalem-a a om Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kungah tam thu zosie a gen hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum hun pen Babylon kumpipa in Jerusalem le a omlai Judah khuopite ahi Lachish le Azekah a sim laitah uh ahi hi; bangzieh ahei cile Judah khuopite lahah kulpi a nei khuopi tam gel beh om ta bo hi."},"8":{"text":"Zedekiah Kumpipa in amate tungah Jerusalem-a mi zosie tawh suotahna thu a tangko nading thuciemna a bawl zaw ciengun, Topa kung panin Jeremiah tungah thu tung a,","title":"Salte’ Tunga Zuoutatna"},"9":{"text":"mi zosie in a Hebrew silate uh, numei le pasal, hlakhie ding a, koima in Judea-te salin a hen nawn sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale mi zosie in a salte uh numei hile pasal hile hlakhie-in salin kikhawikia thei nawn lo ding hi, ci-a thuciemna a nei ulien zosie-a kipan mi zosie in a mang pai uhi; amate in thu a mang vua, amate a hla sieng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin khum zaw ciengin a lungsim uh kikhelin a hlasa uh pasal le numei salte mankia-in a khut sung vuah salin a khawikia uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa kung panin Jeremiah kungah thu a tung hi:"},"13":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Kei mama in saltanna Egypt gam panin na pu na pate uh ka peipi lai-in amate tawh thuciemna khat ka bawl a,"},"14":{"text":"“No kunga ang kizua, na na uh kum guh sung a semsa Hebrew mi kici poma kum sagina a cin sielin na hla ding uhi; noma’ na a sepna uh panin amate na hla valon ding uhi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin na pu na pate un ka thu ngai loin a bil ei daw sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"A sawt loin noma mama na kisiakia vua, noma khatlekhat tungah suotahna thu tangko-in ka muna-ah na hoi bawlin ka min kilawna biehinn sunga keima mai-ah thuciemna na bawl zo uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in na lungsim uh khelkia-in ka min na daisah vua, amau’ deina banga na hlasa uh sila numei le pasalte mankia-in na khut sung vuah na semsahin sal bangin a na koikia uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Note in na innvengte ule na guolte uh suotahna pie un, ci-a kang thugen nei mang sih uhi; keima in note tungah suotahna kang pie ding a, tua khu namsau, pul natna le kielpi tawh si dinga suotahna hi ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Keima in leitung kumpi gam zosie’ cizat dingin note kang bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale ka thuciemna palsatin, ka mai-a a bawl uh thuciemna sunga om thute a zui lote pen keima in bawngno phal ni suo-in a kikala a peina uh bawngno bangin ka bawl ding hi:"},"19":{"text":"Bawngno phalsuo-in tua bawngno kikala a peisa Judah uliente, Jerusalem uliente, numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte, siempute le bawngno phal kikala a peisa gam sung mi zosie,"},"20":{"text":"a galte ule amate a thasawm mite’ khut sungah ka pie ding hi. A luonghawmte uh vana vate le leitunga gamsate’ an a suoh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah le a uliente ahi uleh, a galte uh’ khut sung, amate a thasawm mite khut sung, le note kung pana ang kilekia Babylon kumpipa galkapte’ khut sungah ka pie ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in thu ka pie ding a, tam khuopi ah amate ka peisahkia ding hi; tuale amate in tua khuopi simin tuale la-in mei tawh a hal ding uhi. Judah khuopite koima’ ten lona gamdai ka suohsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Kumpi Jehoiakim hun sungin Topa kung panin Jeremiah kungah thu a tung hi:","title":"Rechab-te Kipahta","ref":"2Kum 23:36–24:6; 2Khg 36:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Rechab-te’ inn ah pei-in va hopi ta’nlen, Topa’ biehinn sunga innkhan khatah amate zawpi in; tua ciengin a dawn dingun zu pie in."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Habazziniah’ tapa Jeremiah, a tapa Jaazaniah le a sanggamte, a tapate zosie le Rechab’ innkuon zosie ka zawpi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn sung, kotpi cing pa Shallum’ tapa Maaseiah’ innkhan tung lam, uliente’ innkhan nai-a om Pasien’ mi ahi Igdaliah’ tapa, Hanan tapate’ innkhan sungah amate ka zawpi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Rechab-te’ mai-ah lenggazu a dima kikoi beelte le haite ka lui a, keima in amate kungah, “Lenggazu dawn un,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in, “Lenggazu dawn malmal sih va ung; bang ding ahei cile Rechab’ tapa ka pu uh Jonadab in thu ei pie a, ‘Note na hi vua, na tapate uh ahi zongin lenggazu na dawn ngai poma sih ding vua, noma le na suonte un zong a dawn ngai poma sih ding uhi;"},"7":{"text":"note in inn zong lam loin khai zong na tu sih ding uhi; lengga lo zong bawl loin khat na ngawn na nei sih ding uhi; ahi vangin na tenna uh gam sungah kum sawt na hin thei nadingun na khan tungtawnun puonbuh sungah na teng ding uhi,’ ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Kote in Rachab’ tapa ka pu uh Jonadab’ ei thupieh zosie ka mang zo ta vua, ka hin sungun kote le ka zite, ka tate ule ka tanute un lenggazu dawn loin,"},"9":{"text":"ten nading inn zong ka lam sih uhi. Kote in lengga um ahi a, lo ahi a, khaici ahi zongin bangma ka nei sih uhi;"},"10":{"text":"kote ka hi ule puon buhte ah ka tengzaw vua, ka pu uh Jonadab’ ei sawl bangbang mangin ka gamta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam gam sim dingin Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar ang peito ciengin, ‘Hing pei un, Chaldea galkapte le Syria galkapte giing i hi ziehun Jerusalem ah pei vai,’ ka kici uhi. Tua ahi ziehin Jerusalem khuo-a na teng ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"13":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Pei inlen Judah mite kung le Jerusalem-a tengte kungah, “Ka thu mangin thuhilna khat sin lo ding na hi uh amah?” Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Rechab’ tapa Jonadab in a suonlehlahte kungah lenggazu a dawn lo ding uh a thupiehna kizui hi; tuni dongin amate in bangma a dawn sih uhi, azieh pen amate in a pu uh’ thupieh a mang uhi. Ke’n na kung vuah kang gengen vangin ka thu na mang sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ka nasem ka kamsang zosie na kung vuah kang sawl ngitnget a, ‘Tu-in na gitlona uh panin mi vannuoi kihei unlen, na gamtatnate uh kipuopha un. Amau’ na sem dingin pasien dangte nua zui sih un, tua hile noma le na pu na pate uh ka piehsa gamah note na teng ding uhi,’ a ci hi. Ahi vangin na bil nei daw sih vua, ka thu na ngai sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Rechab’ tapa Jonadab’ suonlehlahte in a pu uh’ thupieh a zui vangun tam mite in ka thu a mang sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Vanglien Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Judah gam le Jerusalem khuo-a teng mi zosie tungah amate kunga tunsah dinga ka gensa gimna zosie ka tungsah ding hi; bang zieh ahei cile amate kungah ka gen zo ta a, amate in a ngai nuom sih vua, amate ka hlan zo a, amate in ei dawng nuom sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin Rechab’ innkuonte kungah Jeremiah in tam bangin gen hi: Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na pu uh Jonadab’ ang thupieh mangin ang thuhilnate zui-in, ang sawlna zosie na sem zo ta uhi,"},"19":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Rechab’ tapa Jonadab in ka mai-a a ding zing ding suonlehlah a kitasam sih ding hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suo zaw a kum lina kumin tami Topa’ thu Jeremiah kungah a tung hi:","title":"Biehinnpi Sungah Laiziel Kisim","ref":"2Kum 24:1; 2Khg 36:5-7; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Laiziel khat la inlen, tua sungah Josiah’ kumpi sep hun sung, nang kang hopi ni-a kipanin tuni cieng dong Israel gam, Judah gam le minam zosie langkhatah na kunga kang gen zosie giel in."},"3":{"text":"Judah innkuonte in amate tunga ka tunsah sawm gimna zosie a zah ciengun amate a unpi-un a gitlona uh panin a kihei kha ding vua, keima in zong amau’ khielna le amau’ mawna ka maisah thei kha ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in Neriah’ tapa Baruch hlan a, Topa in ama kunga a gensa thu zosie Baruch in Jeremiah’ sit bang lienin a unpi-in laiziel sungah giel hi."},"5":{"text":"Jeremiah in Baruch thupie a, “ Topa’ biehinnpi sungah kei ei kilutsah nawn lo hi;"},"6":{"text":"tua ahi ciengin nang mama va pei ta’nlen, antan ni khatin Topa’ biehinn sunga a om mi zosie’ zah dingin kang sit bangin laiziel sunga na gielsa Topa’ kammalte na va sim ta ding hi. Nangma in a khuopi uh pana ang peito Judah mi zosie’ zah dingin na sim ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hile a tauna uh Topa mai-ah tungin, tuaci’n a unpi-un a gitlona uh panin a kihei thei kha ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam mite tungah a tunsah dinga a gensa a lungthahna le a lungsona na sie mama hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Kamsangpa Jeremiah in laiziel sunga Topa’ kammal sim dingin a sawl bangin Neriah’ tapa Baruch in Topa’ biehinn sungah a sim hi."},"9":{"text":"Josiah’ tapa Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim in kumpi a sep zaw a kum ngana, a hla kuona hla-in Jerusalem-a a om mi zosie le Judah gam khuopite panin Jerusalem-a ang pei mi zosie in Topa mai-ah an tan nading a phuongzah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ biehinn Tunkot Tha lutna, Topa’ biehinn sung, huong tungnunga om thuvanpi pa Shaphan’ tapa Gemariah’ innkhan sungah mi zosie’ zahin Baruch in laiziel sung panin Jeremiah’ thugente a simkhie hi."},"11":{"text":"Gemariah’ tapa, Shaphan’ tapa Micaiah in laiziel sung panin Topa’ kammalte a zah ciengin,","title":"Kumpi Innah Laiziel Kisim"},"12":{"text":"kumpipa’ inn sunga thuvanpi pa’ innkhan ah a peisuh hi; tuale khumtahah thuvanpi pa Elishama, Shemaiah’ tapa Delaiah, Achbor’ tapa Elnathan, Shaphan’ tapa Gemariah, le Hananiah’ tapa Zedekiah-te a kipan uliente a unpi-un a na to uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale Micaiah in, mi zosie’ zahin Baruch in laiziel panin a simkhiet a zahsa thu zosie amate kungah a gen hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ulien zosie in Baruch kungah Cushi’ tapa Shelemiah, a tapa Nethaniah, a tapa Jehudi a sawl vua, “Mite’ zahin na sim laiziel tawi-in hing pei in,” ci-in a hlansah uhi. Tuaci’n Neriah’ tapa Baruch in zong a khut sunga laiziel la-in amate kungah a pei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale amate in ama kungah, “To inlen hing sim in,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n Baruch in amate kungah a simkhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in tua kammal zosie a zah ciengun patauna tawh khatlekhat kihei-in a ki-en ciet vua, Baruch kungah, “Tami thute kumpipa kungah ka ko lo uh phamaw hi,” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Baruch kungah, “Tami thu teng bang na ci giel ahei? Jeremiah’ ang sit banga na giel amah, ei gen in,” ci-in a dong uhi."},"18":{"text":"Baruch in amate kungah, “Ama in tam thu zosie ei sit a, tua teng laitui tawh laiziel tunga ka giel ahi hi,” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin uliente in Baruch kungah, “Nang le Jeremiah pei-in kiphuol unlen, na opna uh koima theisah sih un,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in thuvanpi pa Elishama’ innkhan sungah laiziel nuasie-in kumpipa’ huong sungah lutin tua thu zosie kumpipa kungah a gen uhi.","title":"Jehoiakim in Laiziel Haltum"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in tua laiziel a la dingin Jehudi sawl a, ama in zong thuvanpi pa Elishama’ innkhan panin a la hi; tuale Jehudi in kumpipa le ama’ gei-a a ding ulien teng mai-ah a sim hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua laitahin kumpipa a phalbi inn sungah to a, (a hla kuona ahi hi) a mai-a meibung ah mei a kuong hi."},"23":{"text":"Jehudi in khawh thum khawh li bang a sim zaw ciengin kumpipa in namta khat tawh tuate atsanin meibung sunga mei-ah hal a, tua laiziel buppi a kahvam dongin meikhuh sungah a paipai hi."},"24":{"text":"Hizongle kumpipa ahi a, tam kammal a za a nasemte ahi zongin koima khat beh patau tuon loin a puon uzong a balkeh beh sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Laiziel a hal lo nadingin Elnathan, Delaiah, le Gemariah-te nangawn in kumpipa a hlo vua, ama in a mang sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuale kumpipa in thuvanpi pa Baruch le Jeremiah-te man dingin kumpipa’ tapa Jerameel, Azriel’ tapa Seraiah le Abdeel’ tapa Shelemiah-te thu a pie hi. Ahi vangin Topa in ama gel a phuol hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Jeremiah’ kamgen bangin Baruch in a giel tua laiziel, a kammalte tawh a haltum zaw ciengin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:","title":"Jeremiah in adang Khat Sitkia"},"28":{"text":"Laiziel adang khat la inlen tua tungah Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim haltumsa laiziel masa sunga thu zosie atkia in."},"29":{"text":"Tuale Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim tawh kisai-in tam bangin na gen ding hi: Tuale Topa in a genna ah, Babylon kumpipa ang pei tahtah ding a, tami gam susie-in mihing le ganhingte sumaimang ding hi, ci-in tami lai sungah bang ziehin giel na hei? ci-in na gen a, tua laiziel na haltum ngam giap hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Kumpipa Jehoiakim tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ama in David’ topha tungah a to ding mi koima khat beh a nei sih ding a, ama luonghawm sun lai-in nisa lah le zan lai-in vuasan lahah kipaimang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Keima in amau’ khielna ziehin ama le a suonlehlahte le a nasemte dan ka pie ding hi; keima in amate tung, Jerusalem-a tengte tung, le Judah mite tungah tunsah dinga ka galgih gimnate ka tungsah ding a, ahi vangin amate in ka thu a mang sih ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in adang laiziel khat la a, Neriah’ tapa thuvanpi pa Baruch tungah Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim in meikhuh sunga a haltumsa laiziel sunga Jeremiah’ sitsa banga a giel pen a pie hi; tuate sungah a kibang kammal tampi kiguonbe hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Jehoiakim’ tapa Coniah’ zalaih dingin Judah gamah Josiah’ tapa Zedekiah kumpi semsah hi.","title":"Zedekiah’ Kimot Lametna","ref":"2Kum 24:17; 2Khg 36:10"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama ahi a, a nasemte ahi a, gam sung mite ahi zongin, kamsangpa Jeremiah tung tawna Topa’ thugente a ngai sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi Zedekiah in kamsangpa Jeremiah kungah Shelemiah’ tapa Jehucal le Maaseiah’ tapa siempu Zephaniah sawl a, “Kote adingin Topa ka Pasien uh kungah hepina tawh thu ei ngetpieh in,” cisah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hunin Jeremiah thongkia nai lo ahi ziehin mite lahah sungtum pusuoh thei lai hi."},"5":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Egypt panin Pharaoh’ galkapte kuonto zo uhi; tuale Jerusalem a busim Chaldea-te in amau’ thu a zah ciengun Jerusalem panin a kinuale uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsangpa Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu tung hi:"},"7":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Kei kunga thu ang dongsah Judah kumpipa kungah, nang ang hu dinga ang pei Pharaoh’ galkapte amau’ gam Egypt ah a kilekia ding uhi, ci-in na ni gelin na va gen ta ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale Chaldea-te kilekia-in tam khuopi ang sim ding vua, tuaci’n amate in khuopi la-in mei tawh a hal ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: “Eite kung panin Chaldea-te a taimang tahtah ding uhi,” ci-in noma le noma kisol sih un, azieh pen amate a taimang sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Note in ang sim Chaldea galkap bup zo siengin, a buh sung vua a liem teng beh suohtasah kha phiel nan locin, amate hing tho-in tam khuopi mei tawh ang halpieh veve ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pharaoh’ gakapte in a neh ziehin Jerusalem panin Chaldea’ galkapte a nuakin uh ciengin,","title":"Jeremiah Thongah Kikhum"},"12":{"text":"Benjamin gama mipite lahah ama’ neisa a tanh ding teng a la dingin Jerusalem panin Jeremiah a pei hi."},"13":{"text":"Benjamin’ Tunkot a tun ciengin Hananiah’ tapa Shelemiah, a tapa Irijah a kici tua sunga kot cingpa in kamsangpa Jeremiah na manin ama kungah, “Nang Chaldea-te lamah a taidap ding na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Jeremiah in, “Tua pen zuouthu ahi hi; Chaldea-te kungah ka taidap sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Irijah in a thu gen ngai loin Jeremiah man a, uliente kungah a zawpi hi."},"15":{"text":"Jeremiah tungah uliente a lungthah mama vua, tuale ama satin thuvanpi pa Jonathan’ inn sungah a khum uhi, a zieh pen khumi inn thonga kizang ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin tuikhuh inn sunga leinei dan sungah Jeremiah kikoi a, tua munah ni tampitah a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi Zedekiah in ama hlansahin ama a kimupi hi. Kumpipa in a inn sungah thu dongdap a, tuale ama in, “ Topa tung panin thu khatpo a om ei mah?” ci hi. Jeremiah in, “ Om ma ei!” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Nang pen Babylon kumpipa’ khut sungah ang kipie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Jeremiah in zong kumpi Zedekiah kungah, “Kei thong nei khieh thei nadingin nang tung ahi a, na nasemte tung le tam mite tungah ahi zongin bang khielna ka bawl ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Note tungah, ‘Nang le tam gam sim dingin Babylon kumpipa ang kuon sih ding hi,’ ci-a thu ang gen na kamsangte uh hei-ah om uh ahei?’ a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka pu kumpipa, hepina tawh tu-in ka thugen ei ngaipieh in: Ka thum ka tauna ei ngaipieh dingin keima tungah hing hoi inlen, khum sunga a si dingin thuvanpi pa Jonathan’ inn ah ei puohkia malmal sin,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpipa Zedekiah in thupie a, amate in kumpi’ thong sungah Jeremiah a khum uhi; tuale khuopi sunga moh zosie a tawp masangin gawlzinga moh-emte tung panin ni sielin mo lumkhat ta ama kipie hi. Tuaci’n kumpi’ thong sungah Jeremiah a om suoh hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Mattan’ tapa Shephatiah, Pashhur’ tapa Gedalaiah, Shelemiah’ tapa Jehucal, le Malchiah’ tapa Pashhur-te in Jeremiah in mi zosie tunga a gen thute a za vua,","title":"Tuikhuh Sungah Jeremiah"},"2":{"text":"Topa in a genna ah, tami khuopi sunga tengte namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna tawh a si ding uhi; hizongle Chaldea-te kunga a peite a hing ding uhi; amate in galvan lah bangin a nuntahna uh suotatpi-in a hing ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in a genna ah, tami khuopi pen Babylon kumpipa’ galkapte khut sungah kipie valon ding a, kila ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin uliente in kumpipa kungah, “Tam mipa tha dingin kilawm hi, azieh pen tam thute a gen ziehin ama in tami khuopi sunga a omlai galkapte le mi zosie a lungkiesah hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tam pa in tami mite’ phattuom nading sui loin a gim nga nading uh sui ahi zaw hi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Zedekiah in, “Tanah ama a om hi; ama note’ khut sungah ama a om hi; azieh pen kumpipa in note ang langpang zo sih hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Jeremiah manin thong huong sunga om kumpipa’ tapa Malchiah’ tuikhuh sungah a paimang vua, khau huol tawh Jeremiah a khiesuh uhi. Tua tuikhuh sungah tui na om loin buon beh na om a, tuale buon lahah Jeremiah a tumsuh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in tuikhuh sungah Jeremiah a koi lam uh kumpipa’ inn sunga a om numeite a uh cilgesa pasal Ethiopia-te Ebed-melech in a za hi. Benjamin’ Tunkot ah kumpipa na to kha citciet hi.","title":"Ebed-melech in Jeremiah Hunkhie"},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa’ inn panin Ebed-melech pei-in kumpipa hopi a,"},"9":{"text":"“Ka pu kumpipa aw, tam mite khuo sungah moh a op tah lo ziehin tuikhuh sungah a kielsi dingin kamsangpa Jeremiah khiesuhin ama tungah gitlona tawh a gamtatnate zosie uh pen a khiel uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Ethiopia-te Ebed-melech sawl a, “Tam sung panin mi thum zawpi inlen, kamsangpa Jeremiah a si masangin tuikhuh sung panin va kaito ta un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ebed-melech in a mite zawpi a, kumpipa’ inn ah pei-in vankholna inn sunga puon koina ah lutin tua sung panin puonah a ehsate le puon luite la-in Jeremiah’ opna tuikhuh sungah khau tawh a khiesuh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ethiopia-te Ebed-melech in Jeremiah kungah, “Na zapbanei le khauhuolte kikalah puonsiete le puon-ah luite dap in,” a ci hi. Jeremiah in khum bangin a bawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in tuikhuh panin khauhuol tawh Jeremiah a kaito uhi. Tuale thong huong sungah Jeremiah a omsuoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa Zedekiah in kamsangpa Jeremiah thuta a, Topa’ biehinn sung lutna a thumna ah ama a kimupi hi. Kumpipa in Jeremiah kungah, “Thu khat kang dong ding hi; bangma ei im malmal sin,” a ci hi.","title":"Zedekiah in Jeremiah Thu Dongkia"},"15":{"text":"Jeremiah in Zedekiah kungah, “Hing gen leng ei that lo ding na mah? Ngaisutna hing pie leng lah ngai ngap sih vateh,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah, “Eite hinna ei pie Topa a hing ahi ma bangin keima in nang kang that sih ding a, nang ang thasawm tam mite’ khut sungah zong kang pie sih ding hi,” ci-in a kiciemdap hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in Zedekiah kungah, “Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in ang genna-ah, Babylon kumpipa’ uliente kunga na lut leh beh ang kihinkhawi ding a, tam khuopi mei tawh kihal loin nangma le na innkuonpite na hing ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin Babylon uliente kunga na lut sih leh Chalde-te’ khut sungah tam khuopi kipie ding a, amate in mei tawh halin nang zong amau’ khut sung panin na suohta sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpi Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah, “Chaldea-te kunga a tai Judah-te ka giing hi, azieh pen a khut sung vuah ei kipie thei kha ding a, tuale amate in ei bawlsie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Jeremiah in, “Tua bang pieng lo ding hi. Nangma kunga kang gen Topa’ thu mang phot lel in, tua hile nang adingin hoi ding a, ang kihinkhawi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin na lut nop vawt sih leh Topa in kei kunga ei lah mangmuna tami ahi hi:"},"22":{"text":"Judah kumpipa’ inn sunga a kinuasie numei zosie Babylon kumpipa’ uliente kungah kipeipi-in tua numeite in, ‘Na lawm muonte in nang ang sol ta vua, ang zo ta uhi; tu-in buon lahah na keng tum ahi ziehin amate in ang taisan ta uhi,’ a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Chaldea-te tungah na zite ule na tate zosie uh kipeipi ding a, amau’ khut sung panin nang mama zong na suohta sih ding hi. Babylon kumpipa in ang man ding hi; tuale tami khuopi mei tawh kihal ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah, “Tami i kiholimna koima dang theisah vawt sin, na theisah leh na si ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Uliente in nang kang hopi lam a zah khah vua, amate hing pei-in na kungah, ‘Kumpipa kunga na thugente hing gen in; bangma ei im sin, nei im leh kang that ding uhi. Kumpipa in nang kungah bang teng ang gen ei?’ ang ci uleh"},"26":{"text":"amate kungah, ‘Jonathan inn ah a si den dinga ei sawlkia lo nadingin kumpipa kungah thumna lai a va pie ka hi bo hi,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Uliente zosie Jerusalem ah pei-in ama thu a dong uhi; tuale ama in kumpipa’ thuhil bang lien ma-in amate a dawng hi. Tuaci’n ka holimna uh a dapzah koima a op lo ziehun ei thudawh a khawl ta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuale Jerusalem a kilah ni tan dongin Jeremiah thong huong sungah a omsuoh hi.","ref":"Ezk 33:21"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah a kumpi suo zaw kum kuona a hla sawmna hla-in, Jerusalem sim dingin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar le a galkap zosie kuonin Jerusalem a imtawm uhi.","title":"Jerusalem a Kilahna"},"2":{"text":"Zedekiah kumpi a suo zaw kum sawm le kum khat, a hla lina, a ni kuo ni-in khuopi’ kulpi kitovang hi."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khuopi a kilah ciengin Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Rabsaris a kici Sarsechim, Rabmag a kici Nergal-sharezer-te a kipan Babylon kumpipa’ uliente zosie pei-in tunkot laita penah a to uhi."},"4":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah le galkap zosie in amate a mu ciengun a taimang vua, zan lai-in kumpipa’ um peina lampi zui-in kul tegel kikala tunkot kantanin khuopi panin a pusuoh uhi; tuale amate Arabah lamah a pei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Chaldea galkapte in amate a nuadel vua, Jericho zang lei-ah Zedekiah a pha uhi; tuale amate in ama a mat zaw ciengun Hamath gam sung Riblah khuo-a om Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kungah a peipi uhi; tuale ama tungah ama in thu a khen hi."},"6":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in Riblah khuo ah Zedekiah’ mitmu-in a tapate that hi; Babylon kumpipa in zong Judah uliente zosie that hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Zedekiah’ mittang kheipieh a, Babylon-a zawpi dingin siakhau tawh ama a hen hi."},"8":{"text":"Chaldea-te in kumpipa’ inn le mite’ inn a hal vua, Jerusalem kulpi a susie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in khuopi sunga a kinuasie lai mite le ama bela a tai mite tawh, Babylon ah sal dingin a kai hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in Judah gam sungah bangma a nei lo mizawng pawlkhat nuasie a, ama in lengga um le lote amate a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Jeremiah tawh kisai-in kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan tungtawnin thu pie a,","title":"Jeremiah Kihla, Ebed-melech Phawh"},"12":{"text":"“Ama ladawh inlen, hoitahin kemin genthei bawl sin, na kunga ang nget bangin na bawl in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan, Rabsaris a kici Nebushazban, Rabmag a kici Nerga-lsharezer te le Babylon kumpipa’ uliente zosie in mi sawlin"},"14":{"text":"thong huong sung panin Jeremiah a ladawh uhi. Amate in inn lama puohkia dingin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah a ap uhi. Tuaci’n a mipite tawh ama a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Thong huong sungah a kikhum laitahin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"16":{"text":"Pei inlen Ethiopia-te Ebed-melech kungah tam bangin va gen ta’n: Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tam khuopi hoi nading ahi lo, a siet nadinga ka gensa thute ka tungsah ding a, khumi ni ciengin na mai-ah tua thute ang tangtung ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin khumi ni ciengin keima in nang kang hundam ding a, na giin mite tungah ang kipie sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang kang hundam valon ding a, namsau tawh si loin galvan lah bangin na hinna na suotahpi ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon gamah saltang dingin Jerusalem le Judah gam sunga saltang zosiete tawh kol kibulin kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in Ramah panin ama a peisah zaw ciengin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi.","title":"Gam Uhpa Gedaliah tawh Jeremiah Omton"},"2":{"text":"Kumpi cing galkapmangpa in Jeremiah hlanin ama kungah, “ Topa na Pasien in tam munah tam gimna tunsah dingin ei galgih zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in a thu mang loin Topa tungah maw zo na hi ziehun, Topa in tam thute tungsahin a gensa banga a bawl ahi hi. Tua ahi ziehin note tungah tam bang thu ang tung ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in en in, na khuta ang kihenna siakhaute panin tuni-in nang kang hla zo ta hi. Babylon ah kei tawh nang pei nop leh hing pei in, tua hile keima in limtahin kang kem ding hi; ahi vangin Babylon ah keima tawh nang peiton nop sih leh lah hing pei da in.
