En in, gam zosie na mai-ah om hi; na pei nopna popo ah pei in."},"5":{"text":"Na op den dinga ahile Babylon kumpipa in Judah gam khuopi zosie ah a uhte dinga a koi Shaphan’ tapa, Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah kungah kilekia inlen, ama tawh mite lahah teng in.; na ten nop sih leh lah na pei nopna popo ah kipei lel in."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah’ opna Mizpah ah Jeremiah pei a, ama tawh gam sunga kinuasie mite lahah a teng hi."},"7":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in gam uhpa dingin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah a koi thu le Babylon ah sala kipeipi lo pasalte, numeite, le gam sunga mizawng pente ama’ khutah a piehna thu, gam lahah a om galkapmangte le a galkap zosie in a zah ciengun,"},"8":{"text":"Mizpah-a Gedaliah kungah amate a pei vua- Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael, Kareah’ tapa Johanan, Tanhumeth’ tapa Seraiah, Netophah-te ahi Ephai’ tate ahi Maacath-te’ tapa Jezaniah-te le a galkapte a pei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah in amate le a galkapte kungah kiciem a, “Chaldea-te’ na na sep ding uh pen zau tuon sih un. Gam sungah teng unlen, Babylon kumpipa’ na sem un, tua hile no adingin ang hoi ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:22-24"},"10":{"text":"Kei ka hi leh eite kunga ang pei ding Chaldea-te mai-ah note tanga a ding dingin Mizpah ah ka om ding hi; ahi vangin note na hi uleh lenggazu, khal singgate le sathaute khawmin na beel sung vuah koi unlen, na lahsa uh khuote ah teng un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Moab gama a teng Judah mi zosie, Ammon mite lahah a tengte, Edom gama a tengte, le gam danga a omte in, Babylon kumpipa in Judah gamah a omlai mi pawlkhat nuasie a, tuate tungah gam uhpa dingin Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah koi zo hi, ci thu a zah ciengun,"},"12":{"text":"Judah-te zosie a kithezahna uh gamcin teng panin Judah gam ah a kilekia vua, Judah gam, Mizpah-a Gedaliah kungah a pei uhi; tuale amate in lenggazu le khal singga kicing tahin a laton uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in Kareah’ tapa Johanan le gam lahah galkapbute zosie Mizpah-a om Gedaliah kungah a pei vua,"},"14":{"text":"ama kungah, “Ammon kumpipa Baalis in nangma that dinga Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael ang sawl lam a thei kha vawt lo na hi amah?” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah in amate a tahsang sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kareah’ tapa Johanan in Mizpah-a om Gedaliah hopi dap a, “Nei hepina tawh ei peisah inlen, Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael ei thatsah in, koima in thei lo ding hi. Nangma ang bel na kimvela om Judah mite zosie kithezahin a omlai Judah mi themkhatte zong a cigam nadingin bang dinga ama in nang ang tha laizang ding ahei?” ci-in a dap hopi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah in Kareah’ tapa Johanan kungah, “Tua bang silte bawl vet sin; bang ding ahei cile Ishmael tungtang zuouthu na gen hi,” a ci hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hla sagina hla-in kumpi sungkuon, kumpi vaisai a lienpen khat ahi, Elishama’ tapa Nethaniah, a tapa Ishmael in mi sawm tawh Mizpah khuo-a Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah kungah a haw uhi. Amate in Mizpah ah an a nehton laitahun,","title":"Gedaliah a Kilangpanna"},"2":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in tua gam sungah ama gam uhpa-in a koi ziehin Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael le tua mi sawmte a dingto vua, Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah-te namsau tawh satpua-in a that uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ishmael in Mizpah ah Gedaliah tawh a omton Judah mi zosie le tua sunga a om Chaldea galkapte zong that hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:25"},"4":{"text":"Gedaliah a kitha zaw a zing ni, koima in a thei masangin,"},"5":{"text":"Shechem, Shiloh le Samaria khuote panin mi sawmgiet, khamul heukieusa, puon ehkehsa le a pumpi uh kikui liemsa-in an tawh biehnate le panamtuite tawi-in Topa’ biehinn sungah biehna pie dingin a tung uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate lamdot dingin Mizpah panin a kap kawmin Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael a pei hi. Ama in amate a mu ciengin a kung vuah, “Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah kungah hing pei un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuopi laikimtah a tun ciengun Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael le a optonpi mite in amate thatin tuikhuh sung khatah amate a paai uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate lahah mi sawm in Ishmael kungah, “Ei that sih un, azieh pen lozau lahah ka na kholsa uh mangbu, mangbuham, sathau le khuoizu tampi ka nei uhi,” a ci uhi. Tuaci’n ama zong ki-ipin a guol honpi tawh amate that nawn lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ishmael in a thasa misi luonghawm zosie a paina tua tuikhuh pen a gol khat ahi a, tua khu Kumpipa Asa in Israel kumpipa Basha a nan nadinga a na bawl ahi hi; Nethaliah’ tapa Ishmael in a mithate tawh tua tuikhuh a dimsah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ishmael in kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzradan in Ahakim’ tapa Gedaliah tungah a piehsa kumpipa’ tanute le Mizpah khuo-a a kinuasie mi zosie salin a man hi. Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in sal dingin Ammon gam lam zuonin amate a peipi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hizongle Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in a bawl a mawna huoisie teng Kareah’ tapa Johanan le a optonpi galkapmang zosie in a zah bepun"},"12":{"text":"a mite zosie zawpi-in Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael sim dingin a kuon uhi. Amate in Gibeon muna tuikhuh golpi ah a pha uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ishmael kunga om mi zosie in Kareah’ tapa Johanan le galkapmang zosie a mu ciengun a nuom mama uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ishmael in Mizpah panin sal dinga a mat mi zosie kinuahei-in Kareah’ tapa Johanan kungah a peikia uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Johanan kung panin Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael le mihing giet suohta-in Ammon-te kungah a pei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le a optonpi galkapmang zosie in, Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah a na tha zaw ciengin Mizpah panin sal dinga a kaisa mite lahah amawh teng zosie - galkapte, nupite, naupangte, le numeite a uh cilgesa pasalte a unpi-in Gibeon panin a peipikia uhi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt gam lam pei sawmin amate a dingkhie vua, Bethlehem khuo gei-a Geruth Chimham kici munah a khawl uhi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in gam uhpa dinga Babylon kumpipa in a koi Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah a tha ziehin amate in Chaldea-te a giing mama uhi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkapmangte zosie, Kareah’ tapa Johanan, Hoshaiah’ tapa Azariah, le a neupen pan a golpen dongin mi zosie in ama lam a neh vua,","title":"Jeremiah in a Khuolal lo nadingun a Suohta Mite Ngaisutna Pie"},"2":{"text":"kamsangpa Jeremiah kungah, “Hepina tawh kote thumna ei ngai inlen, ko a omlaite adingin Topa na Pasien kungah thu ei ngetpieh in. Bangzieh ahei cile na mit tawh nei mu bangin mi tampi lah panin themno khat beh ei kinuasie ta bo hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa na Pasien in ka pei nading uh hileh ka bawl ding uh hileh ei lahsah in,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kamsangpa Jeremiah in amate kungah, “Hoi mama hi: Na nget bangun Topa na Pasien uh kungah thu ka ngen ding a, note tungah Topa ei dawnna bangbang kang gen ding hi; bangma kang im malmal sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in a banbanin Jeremiah kungah, “ Topa na Pasien in na kungah ko dinga ang gen thu zosie bangin ka gamtat sih tah ma uleh kote langkhatah a man le a muontah teci-in Topa hing pang taheh."},"6":{"text":"Topa i Pasieh uh thugen ka man ciengun kote ka hoi thei nadingun, nang kang sawlna uh Topa i Pasien uh’ thugen bangbang hoi taleh sie taleh ka mang ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ni sawm zaw ciengin Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Kareah’ tapa Johanan le ama kunga om galkapmang teng zosie, le mi zosie a neupen panin a golpen dongin hlan a,"},"9":{"text":"amate kungah, “Ama mai-ah na deina uh thumpieh dinga nei sawlna pa uh Israel’ Pasien Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"10":{"text":"Tam gama na op suoh uleh beh note hing phelkhie loin kang lam ding hi; keima in note kang phutdet ding a, kang botzuon sih ding hi; azieh pen note tungah gimna kang tunsah ziehin ka kisia hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni dang na giin bangun Babylon kumpipa giing ta sih un; Topa in a cina-ah, ama giing sih un, azieh pen ama’ khut sung panin ang hundam ding le ang hunkhie dingin note tawh kang omton hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima in note kang hepi ding a, ama in note tungah hepina nei-in na pienna uh na gam ma vuah ang tengsahkia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in tam bangin Topa na Pasien uh’ thu mang loin, ‘Tami gamah teng sih va ung,’ na ci suoh vua,"},"14":{"text":"‘Hi lo hi, gal a op lona, pengkul gin a kizah lona, an du gilkiel lona Egypt gamah pei-in tua munah ka teng ding uhi,’ na ci uleh,"},"15":{"text":"Judah a omlai teng aw, Topa’ kammal ngai un. Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Egypt gamah pei-in tua sunga ten ding na sawm paupau uleh,"},"16":{"text":"na giin uh namsau in Egypt gamah note ang pha ding a, na giin uh kielpi in Egypt gamah note ang nuadel ding hi; tua munah note na si ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt gamah a teng dinga a pei sawm paupau mi zosie a unpi-un namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna tawh si ding uhi; amate tunga ka tunsah ding gimna panin a omlai mite ahi sihle a suohta mite koima a om sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Bangzieh ahei cile Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Jerusalem khuo-a a teng mite tungah ka lungthahna le ka lunghanna ka sun bangin Egypt gamah na pei uleh ka lungthahna na tung vuah hing kisung ding hi. Note pen mite’ lipkhap le kidah, hamsiet le zako-in na om ding uhi. Note in tam mun na mukia nawn sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Judah a omlai teng aw, Topa in note kungah, Egypt gamah pei sih un, ci-in ang gen zo hi. Tuni-a na tung vua kang hil thute teltahin kithei ta un."},"20":{"text":"Note in a siehuoi khielna na bawl zo ta uhi. Azieh pen Topa na Pasien uh kungah nei sawl vua, ‘ Topa i Pasien uh kungah thu ei ngetpieh inlen, Topa ka Pasien un ang gen popo ko kungah ei gen inlen, kote in ka sem ding uhi,’ nei ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuni-in na kung vuah kang gen zo ta hi, ahi vangin Topa na Pasien un na kung vua gen dinga ei sawl thu khat beh na mang sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin note in teltahin kithei ta un, na ten nopna mun vuah namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna tawh na si ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa a Pasien un amate kungah gen dinga a sawl Topa a Pasien uh’ thute zosie Jeremiah in mi zosie tungah a gen zaw ciengin,","title":"Egypt-ah Kipeipi, Jeremiah in Thukhenna ding Genkhol"},"2":{"text":"Hoshaiah’ tapa Azariah le Kareah’ tapa Johanan a kipan mi kiphasah dangte zosie in Jeremiah kungah, “Na zuou zuoupi na gen ahi bo hi. Topa i Pasien in, ‘Egypt gama a teng dingin pei sih un,’ ci-in a gen dingin nang ang sawl kha sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle Neriah’ tapa Baruch in Chaldea mite kungah kote ei pie-in, amate in kote ei thatin, ahi sihle Babylon gamah sala ei kai thei nadingin kote langpang dinga nang ang hantawh ahi bo hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kareah’ tapa Johanan le galkapmang zosie a kipan mi zosie in Judah gama op suoh ding Topa’ thugen a mang sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le galkapmang zosie in a kidelmangna uh gam zosie panin Judah gama teng dinga a kilekia Judah a omlai teng zosie a peipi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Papi, nupi, naupang, kumpipa’ tanute, le kumpi cing galkapmang Nebuzaradan in Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah tawh a na nuasie mi zosie le kamsangpa Jeremiah le Neriah’ tapa Baruch-te zong a peipi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ thu a man lo ziehun Egypt gamah pei-in Tahpanhes a tung uhi.","ref":"2Kum 25:26"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tahpanhes-a om Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"9":{"text":"Na khut tawh suongtum golte la inlen, Tahpanhes-a Pharaoh kumpi inn lutna tungman suongpha nei-ah phum in. Na phum lam Judah mite musah inlen,"},"10":{"text":"amate kungah, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in mi sawlin ka nasempa Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar kang peipi ding a, ama in tam ka suongphumte tungah a kumpi topha daw-in tuate tungah a kumpi puonbuh a zah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama kuonin Egypt gam sim ding a, pul natna tawh si dinga sesate pul natna tawh sisah ding a, sala mat dinga sesate salin kikai sahin, namsau tawh si dinga sesate zong namsau tawh a si ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in Egypt pasien-te kibiehna biehinnte sungah mei taw-in, tua teng hal tumin salin a peipi ding hi; tuale tuucingpa in a puon tunga khate a sot sieng bangin ama in Egypt gam sung a siengsah ding hi; tuale lungmuong tahin tua panin ama a pei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in Egypt gam Heliopolis khuo-a suong milim khuomte phelmang ding a, Egypt pasien-te’ biehinnte haltum ding hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gam sunga Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis, le Pathros gam sunga teng Judea-te zosie tawh kisai-in Jeremiah kungah thu tung a,","title":"Milim Paubieh Kimawsahna"},"2":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: No mama in Jerusalem le Judah khuo zosie tunga ka tunsah gimna na mu zo ta uhi. Amate en un; tuni-in tua khuote ah koima teng loin gamdai a suoh ta hi,"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen amate in ahi a, note in na hi vua, na pu na pate un ahi zongin a thei ngai lo uh pasien-te’ na semin a kung vuah biehnate tawi-in gitlona a bawl ziehun keima ei thangpaisah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle keima in ka nasem kamsang zosie na kung vuah kang sawl a, “Ka huot tami a kidahhuoi nate bawl nawn sih un!” ci-in kang thumsah ngitnget hi."},"5":{"text":"Hizongle amate in ka thu ngai nuom loin a bil uh ei daw sih vua, a gitlona uh panin kiheikia nuom loin pasien dangte kungah biehnate a tawi veve uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Judah khuopite le Jerusalem gawldung tengah ka thangpaina le ka lungthahna kibuosuhin a kuong hi; tuale tuni-a om bangin tuate kinuasie-in gamdai a suoh ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale tu-in Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin a gen hi: Bang dinga numei, pasal, naupang le nausente dongin, a omlai om nawn loin Judah laikim panin suhmaimang nading za-in na tung vuah sietna lienpi kitun na hi uh ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Bang dinga na ten nading vua na zot uh Egypt gamah na khut utawh na bawlsa uh pasien dangte kungah biehnate tawi-in ei lungthahsah na hi uh ahei? Note kisumaimangin leitunga minamte lahah simmaw le samsiet suoh ding na hi uh amah?"},"9":{"text":"Judah gam le Jerusalem gawldung lahah na pu na pa te uh’ gitlona, Judah kumpite’ gitlona, amau’ zite gitlona, noma’ gitlona, le noma’ zite gitlonate na mangngil ta uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Tuni dongin amate in kisiakiana lungtang ahi a, zauna lungtang ahi zongin nei loin, note le na pu na pate uh mai-a kang pieh ka thukham le ka ngainate a zui sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Judah gam zosie ka suhmaimang thei nadingin note tunga gimna tunsah ding ka khensat hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima in Egypt gamah pei-in ten ding a sawm Judah a omlai teng manin a unpi-un a si sieng ding uhi; amate Egypt gamah namsau tawh pua-in kielpi tawh a si ding uhi; amate a neupen panin a golpen dongin namsau le kielpi tawh a si sieng ding vua, mite’ lipkhap le kidah, hamsiet le zako-in a om ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in Jerusalem dan ka pieh bangin Egypt gama a tengte zong namsau, kielpi, le pul natna tawh dan ka pie ding a,"},"14":{"text":"Egypt gama a tengsa Judah mi a omlai teng Judah gama a nuapei kia dingin khat zong a hingin a suohta sih ding uhi. Amate tuanah kilekia-in a ten nopkia vangun galtai pawlkhat simlo a kinuale nawn sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin a zite un pasien dangte kungah biehnate a tawi lam uh a thei papi zosie, khum sunga a ding nupi zosie, mipi honkhat, Egypt gam Pathros-a a teng mi zosie in Jeremiah a dawngkia vua:"},"16":{"text":"“ Topa’ min tawh ka kung vua nang gen thute kote in kang ngaipieh sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kote in bawl dinga ka ciemsa uh sil bangkim ka bawl ding vua, Judah gam khuopite le Jerusalem lampi tengah koma le ka pu ka pate uh, ka kumpite ule ka uliente un a na bawl ngai uh bangin vantung kumpinu kungah biehnate tawi-in dawn thei biehnate ka sung zaw ding uhi. Kote in a kinincing neh le tah nei-in ka nuomsa vua, hamsietna zong ka tuoh sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin vantung kumpinu kungah biehnate le dawn thei biehnate sunna ka bawl lo vua kipanin bangkim ka kitasam vua, namsau le kielpi-in ka sigam ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale nupite in zong, “Kote in vantung kumpinu tungah biehnate tawina le dawn thei biehna sunna ka bawl suoh ding uhi; kote in ama nu’ lim sun dingin moh bawlin a kungah dawn thei biehna ka sun uh ciengin ka pasalte uh kihal loin a bawl nei sa uh amah?” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jeremiah in khum banga a dawngkia papi, nupi a kipanin mi zosie kungah tam bangin a gen hi:"},"21":{"text":"“Judah khuopite le Jerusalem gawldung lahah note le na pu na pate uh, na kumpite uh, na uliente vua kipanin gam sung mi zosie in biehna na bawlte uh Topa in a phawh kha lo ahi amah?"},"22":{"text":"Na sil hoi lo bawlte ule na sil kidahhuoi bawlte uh Topa in thuoh zo nawn lo hi; tua ahi ziehin tuni-a bangin na gam uh koima teng loin gamdai suoh zo ta a, mite’ hamsiet thuohin a kinuasie ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Note in biehnate halin, Topa’ tungah maw-in, Topa’ thu mang loin ama’ thukhamte le a ngainate na zui lo ziehun, tuni donga a om bangin note tungah tam gimnate ang tung ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Jeremiah in mi zosie le numeite kungah, “Egypt gama a om no Judah mi zosiete aw, Topa’ kammal ngai un."},"25":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: ‘Vantung kumpinu kungah biehnate a tawi ding le dawn thei biehnate a sung dinga ka kiciemnate uh ka bawl teitei ding uhi,’ ci-a na gen uh pen noma le na zite un kam tawh a na gen bangun sepna tawh na muolsuo zo ta uhi. Na kiciemna uh kipsah unlen na dawn thei biehnate uzong sung phot un!"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Egypt gama a teng no Judah mi zosiete aw, Topa’ kammal ngai un: En un, ‘ Topa in kang cina-ah, Egypt gam mun zosie-a a teng Judah mi khat beh in a kam uh panin, ‘ Topa a hing ahi ma bangin,’ ci-in ka min a law nawn lo nadingun ka min lienpi tawh ka kiciem hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in amate hoi nading ahi lo, a siet nadingun ka buh gige hi; Egypt gama a teng Judah mi zosie a cigam masangsie namsau le kielpi tawh kisusie ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Namsau pana a suohta mi themno khatte Egypt gam panin Judah gamah kilekia ding uhi; tuale Egypt gama a teng dinga a pei Judah mi a omlai teng in keima’ thugen le amau’ thugen koi kip zaw, ahei ci a thei ding uhi!"},"29":{"text":"Tami munah note dan hing pie-in note siet nading ka gensa thute ang tangtung valon ding a hina thu na thei nadingun Topa in a genna-ah, tami khu note tungah lim ahi ding hi:"},"30":{"text":"Topa in a cina-ah, keima in ama a thasawm a galte’ khut sungah Judah kumpipa Zedekiah ka pieh bangin Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh Hophra, ama a thasawm a galpa Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar’ khut sungah ka pie ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:1-7"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suo zaw a kum lina kumin, kamsangpa Jeremiah in Neriah’ tapa Baruch hopi a, tuale ama in Jeremiah’ sit bangbanga laiziel sunga a na giel kammalte tam bang teng ahi hi:","title":"Baruch’ Kunga Henepna Kammal","ref":"2Kum 24:1; 2Khg 36:5-7; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Baruch aw, Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in nangma kungah tam bangin ci hi:"},"3":{"text":"Nangma in, “Gim nga hi tang e! Topa in ka natna banah dana ei belap pieh hi; ka tautauna-in ka vulgawp ta a, toidamna ka mu zo sih hi,” na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nangma in ama kunga na gen ding ah, “ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in ka lamsate phelkia-in ka phusate ka botmang kia ding hi- tua khu gam buppi ka cina ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma dinga na lienpi sui na hi amah? Tuate sui da in; bangzieh ahei cile keima in mi zosie tungah gimna ka tungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi; hizongle nang pen na peina muncin tengah galvan lah bangin na hinna kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minamte tawh kisai-in kamsangpa Jeremiah kunga a tung Topa’ kammal tami ahi hi.","title":"Egypt Tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim in kumpi a sep zaw a kum lina kumin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a na zawsa, Euphrates gun gei Carchemish khuo-a om Egypt kumpi Pharaoh Neco’ galkapte tawh kisai tam bang ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"Phaw le lumte tawh kithawi unlen, gal sim dingin kuon un!"},"4":{"text":"Sakol phaw guong unlen, tuong dawh ta un! Na sia lukhute uh khu unlen, panmun la un. Na teipi uh tat hiem unlen, na sia puonte sil un!"},"5":{"text":"Bang a cile a zausa-a amate ka va mu tah mawh ahei? Amate a kilekia ta uhi; a galhangte uh kisatlia a, a naw taimang ta uhi. Amate a kinuahei sih uhi. Muncin tengah zauna behbeh! Topa in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A mallangte zong a taiman sih vua, galhangte a suohta tuom sih uhi; sahlam Euphrates gun gei-ah amate kipalin a pua uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nile gun banga ang khang, guntui khanglien bang khu koi ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Nile gun bangin Egypt khang a, guntui phulto bang hi. Ama in, kei ei khangsah inlen, leitung zosie ei tuomsah in. Khuopite le a sunga tengte zosie ei susiesah in, a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Sakolte aw, mai nawt un, sakol leengte aw, kikhaw vapo un! Galhangte ahi: Ethiopia le Put mi lum tawite, thal kamsa-a om Ludim mite kuonsah un."},"10":{"text":"Khum ni pen Vanglien Topa’ ni ahi a, phu a kilahkia ni, a galte tung panin dih tanna a nga ni ahi hi. Namsau in amate valtum ding a, a du ta sih ding hi. A kham dongin a si uh a dawn ding hi. Bang ding ahei cile Vanglien Topa in Euphrates gun gei sah lamah kithoina khat a nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Egypt ngahnu siengtho aw, Gilead ah peito inlen, damna zatui va la ta’n! A mawhna-in zatui tampi na zang zo hi; nang adingin damna om tuon lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Minamte in na zumhuoina uh a za vua, leitungah na kaana aw uh a kidim hi; azieh pen galhang le galhang kiphukha-in, a ni gelin a puaton uhi."},"13":{"text":"Egypt gam sim dingin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar peina tawh kisai-in Topa in Jeremiah kunga a gen thu tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Babylon in Egypt Sim Ding","ref":"Jer 43:10-13"},"14":{"text":"Egypt gamah genzah inlen, Migdol khuo ah phuongzah in; Memphis khuo le Tahpanhes khuo ah tangko in; “Na kimvel vua om mite namsau in valh ahi ziehin, na panmun uh la unlen a kigingsa-in om un,” va ci ta’n."},"15":{"text":"Bang dingin Apis taimang ahei? Na bawngtang pasien uh bang dinga ding lo ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in ama a sawnpua hi."},"16":{"text":"Na mihonpite uh kipalin a pua sieng vua, “Ei susie namsau ziehin, hing pei un, i mipite kung le i pienna gamah kinualekia vai,” khatlekhat a kici uhi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa, Pharaoh khu “Mi kam tam, a hun hoi teng a tan pa,” ci-in min pie un."},"18":{"text":"A min Vanglien Topa kici, Kumpipa in a genna-ah, keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin, muolte lahah Tabor muol bang le tuipi gei-a Carmel muol bangin mi khat ang pei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A nop khan Egypt tanu aw, sal tang dingin na puonlomte zielsa-in koi in! Azieh pen Memphis kinuasie ding a, a teng om loin kisie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Egypt gam khu bawngla melhoi bang a, leilu lam gam panin cippi khat ama tungah a tu hi."},"21":{"text":"A galkap guoite nangawn zong bawngno thaute bang uhi; amate tungah tuosietna ni le dan piehna hunte a tun ziehin amate in a sim tentun sih vua, kihei-in a taiton uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sing phuate bangin tua nu sim dingin hei tawh a galte a honpi-in a kuon ziehin tua nu in gul kithol ging bangin a aw a gingsah hi."},"23":{"text":"Gam a pha sengin kiphu zo sih zong le a gam mangte uh a phua ding uhi, Topa in ci hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate kauphe sangin a tamzaw vua, sim zawh ding ahi sih hi, Topa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Egypt’ tanu kimaizumsah ding hi; leilu lam pana ang peite’ khut sungah tua nu kipie ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: En in, keima in Thebes khuo-a Amon pasien le Pharaoh, Egypt le a pasien-te ule a kumpite uh, Pharaoh tung le ama tunga kinga teng tungah gimna ka tungsah ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate a tha sawm Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar le a uliente’ khut sungah amate ka pie ding hi. Tua zaw ciengin tanglai hun ma bangin Egypt gamah mi tengkia ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 19:1-25; Ezk 29:1–32:32"},"27":{"text":"Hinanle ka nasempa Jacob aw, zau malmal sin, Israel aw, lungkie malmal sin; azieh pen a gamlapi panin kang hundam ding a, na suonlehlahte uh a saltanna gam panin ka hundam ding hi. Jacob kilekia-in siptah le nuomtahin om ding a, koima in ama a zausah nawn sih ding hi.","title":"Pasien in Israel Hundam Ding"},"28":{"text":"Ka nasempa Jacob aw, zau malmal sin. azieh pen keima in nang kang ompi hi. Amate lahah kang nawdawhna gam zosie ka sumang ding a, ahi vangin nang kang sumaimang sih ding hi! A kituoh bep khatin thu kang hil ding a, dan pieh loin lah kang mawh koi sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 30:10-11"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pharaoh in Gaza khuo a sim masangin Philistia-te tawh kisai kamsangpa Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:","title":"Philistia-te tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: En un, leilu lam panin tui ang khang a, ang letin ang luong ding hi; amate in gam sung le a sunga om zosie hlummang ding a, khuopi le a sunga tengte zosie zong hlummang ding hi. Mite a kap ding vua, gam sunga teng zosie a mau ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ sakol ketot gingte, ama’ sakol leeng gingte le ama’ lengkang kigawi gingte ziehin, a khutte uh zawgawpin nu le pate in a tate uh a donzo ta sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua Philistia mi zosie a kisuhgam ding ni ang tun ding zieh le, Tyre le Sidon khuo-a om mi hu thei zosie suhmaimang nading ni ang tun zieh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Gaza khuo in a lu met tol a, Ashkelon khuo mangthai zo hi. A omlai amau’ vanglietna aw, bang tanvei noma le noma kisuliem ding na hi uh ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Kadei, Topa’ namsau! Nang bang tanvei sip ding na hei? Na pai sungah kihengkia inlen, khawl inlen sip dide in!"},"7":{"text":"Topa in thu a pieh ciengin tua khu bangci sip thei ding ahei? Ashkelon khuo le tuipi gei teng sim dingin ama in a sesa ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zeph 2:4-7; Zech 9:5-7"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab Tungtang Thu. Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Nebo khuo khu da huoi sam e. A hawmkieu-a kikoi hi ta! Kiriathaim khuo kizumsah a, kilamang zo ta hi; khuo kulpi kizumsi sahin, suhsiet ahi zo ta hi;","title":"Moab Tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Moab gam’ minthanna a om ta sih hi. Heshbon khuo ah amate in a siet nading a lunggel uhi: “Hing pei un, minam khat a hina uh suhmang pieh vawi!” a ci uhi. Madmen khuo aw, nang zong suhdai na hi ta ding hi; namsau in nang ang nuadel ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngawi vawi un! Horonaim khuo pana kikona aw, “Gawgamna le sietna lienpi!” kici hi."},"4":{"text":"“Moab gam kisusie zo a, a naupangte a kap uhi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Luhith muol katona lampi-ah a peito kawmun amate nahpi-in a kap uhi. Azieh pen Honaraim khuo zotsuhna lampi-ah amate in manthai kikona aw a za uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tai un! No le no kihundam un! Senel gam sunga gam- laa tai bangin taimang ta un!"},"7":{"text":"A tahtahin na mun muonhuoite le na goute na suon ziehin, nang zong ang kikaimang ding hi; a siempute le a tuonvaite tawh saltang dingin Chemosh a pei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khuopi zosie-ah mi sumang pa ang pei ding a, khuopi khat zong suohta lo ding hi; Topa gensa bangin muolkuomte mangthai ding a, zangleite kisusie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Moab adingin ci tuomkoi pieh un, azieh pen ama a kisie valon ding ahi hi; a khuopite hawmsuoh ding a, a sungah koima teng lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Thasie kawma Topa’ na a sempa in samsiet thuoh taheh; sisan suohsah lo a, a namsau a nuakoi kia pa in samsiet thuoh taheh."},"11":{"text":"Moab a neu lai panin nuom khan a, zutee tunga a om zuning bangin a om hit hiet hi; zubeel khat panin zubeel khatah kihlei loin, salin zong kikai lo hi; tua ahi ziehin a tui ngai-in tui a, a gimnam zong a theng thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in a ci na-ah, Moab mite zubeel sunga sun bangin a sung ding mi kang sawl hun ang tung valon ding a, amate in ama’ beelte hawmsahin ama’ tuibeelte a tawkeh ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel innkuonte in a kinepna uh Bethel a zumpi bangun Moab in Chemosh zumpi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Ko galhangte le galsim hatte ka hi uhi,” bang dinga note in na ci thei uh ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Moab-a khuopite susie ding pa ang peito ta hi, a tangval deiteel tuomte uh gawlup dingin pei zo ta uhi, Vanglien Topa a kici, Kumpipa in gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Moab’ tuosietna ding nai zo ta a, a kisietna in mallangin a zuon hi."},"17":{"text":"No a innveng zosie le a min a thei zosie in ama kaa pipi tave un; “ Vanglien kumpi ciengkhut le minthang ciengkhut bang dinga tawng ta mawh a!” ci un."},"18":{"text":"Dibon khuo-a teng a tanu aw, na vanglietna pan kumsuh inlen, tuolgum ah to in! Azieh pen nang ang do dingin Moab susie pa peito ta hi; na kulpite zong susie zo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"No Aroer-a tengte aw, lam gei-ah dingin na en un! A taimang pasal le a suohta numei nu dong un; “Bang thu a om ei?” ci-in dong un."},"20":{"text":"Moab kimaizumsah hi, azieh pen ama kisusie zo hi; kapin mau-in om un! Moab a kisuhsietna thu Arnon gun dungah va gen ta un."},"21":{"text":"Muoltung zanglei gam teng le Holon, Jahzah, Mephaath,"},"22":{"text":"Dibon, Nebo, Beth-diblathaim,"},"23":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, Beth-meon,"},"24":{"text":"Kerioth, Bozrah, le Moab gam sunga a gamla a nai-a om khuopi zosie tungah thukhenna a tung zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Moab’ ki kisattawng a, a bante zong kitawngsah ta hi, Topa in ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Moab zu khamsah un, bang ding ahei cile Topa langpangin ama le ama kiliensah hi; a luoh lahah kibuolsah un; ama zong mite’ nuisatin a om ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Gutate lahah a kimat khah sih vangin nang adingin Israel khu nuizathuoi khat a suoh hi; ama na hopi sielin na lu na peisansan mawh hi!"},"28":{"text":"Moab gama tengte aw, khuopite nuasie unlen, suong lahah teng un! Keen kawm lahah a om vakhu butom bang un."},"29":{"text":"Moab’ kiphatsahna ka za zo ta vua, ama a kinah phatsah mama hi. Ama’ kilietsahna, a kiphatsahna, a kihisahna, a lungkula a kisahthei dan teng ka za zo ta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ama’ thangpaina kei mama in ka thei a, a kisielnate zuoupi ahi a, a sil bawlte zong zuoupi ma ahi hi, Topa in ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ziehin Moab adingin ka mau ding hi; Moab-te zosie adingin ka kap ding hi; Kir-heres khuo adingin ka kap ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Sibmah lenggui aw, Jazar ading sangin nangma adingin ka nah kaazaw hi. Na bamengte tuipi kansanin zam suoh a, Jazar tuipi dongin a zam hi; na khal singgate le na lenggate tungah a susie pa ang tungta hi."},"33":{"text":"Moab leihoi gam panin nuomna le kipahna kilamang zo ta hi; keima in lengga cilna panin lenggatui ka kangsah dawh ta hi; koima in kipahna awging tawh a cilkia ta sih vua, tua awging khu kipahna awging ahi sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Heshbon khuo le Elealeh khuote kap a, Jahaz cieng dong, le Zoar panin Horonaim le Eglath-shelishiah dongah amau’ kaana aw a ging hi. Azieh pen Nimrim tui nangawn a kang zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuale keima in Moab gam muol sang tungah kithoina nei a, a pasien-te kungah biehnate a tawi mite ka khawlsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Moab adingin theile kitum bangin ka lungsim a mau a, Kir-heres mite adingin theile kimut bangin ka lungsim a mau hi; azieh pen a nei a lamte uh mangthai zo ta hi."},"37":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile lu zosie kimettol a, khamul zosie kimetmai hi; khut zosie atliem ahi ta a, kawngte ah la-ip puon a om hi."},"38":{"text":"Moab gam innkhum zosie le khuolai tuol-awng zosie ah kaana simlo bangma dang om lo hi; azieh pen keima in koima’ dei lo beel khat ka suhkeh bangin Moab gam ka sukeh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Moab gam a kisie lah ahi ta’n! Amate nah kaa sam uh e! A maizumin Moab in ei elngat vawt ta khu la! Tuaci’n Moab khu a innveng zosie’ nuisat le lipkhap ahi ta hi."},"40":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: En in, ama in muvanlai bangin a hla zahin, Moab bawhsuh ding hi;"},"41":{"text":"a khuopite kila-in a mun muonhuoite ki-imtawm hi. Khum ni ciengin nupi nau suoh bangin Moab galhangte’ lungsim in na a sa ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Ama in Topa langpangin ama le ama kiliensah ahi ziehin, Moab kisusie ding a, minam khatin a dingkia zo nawn sih ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Moab gama tengte aw, na masang vuah zauna, dum le thangte om hi! Topa in ci hi."},"44":{"text":"A zau-a taite poma dum sungah kiesuh ding a, dum sung pana a katote poma thangah a awh ding uhi. Bang ding ahei cile a dan thuoh ding uh kumin Moab tungah tam thute ka tungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Heshbon hlim ah a basam galtaite a khawl uhi; azieh pen Heshbon panin mei khat ang kuong a, Sihon inn panin meikuong khat ang pusuoh to hi; tuami in Moab’ talpang le a gamlum mite’ luvunte a katum hi."},"46":{"text":"Moab aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Chemosh mite kisusie zo ta hi, azieh pen na tapate uh salin kiman zo a, na tanute uh salin kipeipi zo hi."},"47":{"text":"Hinanle ni nukhia ciengin Moab a gam ka piekia ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Moab tunga thukhenna tam cieng ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1–16:14; 25:10-12; Ezk 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zeph 2:8-11"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ammon-te Tungtang thu. Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Israel in tapate nei lo amah? Ama in innluo ding nei lo amah? Tua ahile bang dingin Milcom in Gad gam la-in, a khuopite sungah a mite teng uh ahei?","title":"Ammon-te tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Ammon-te’ khuopi Rabbah sim nading galdo patauna aw ka ginsah hun ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi; tua khuopi a kisie muol gawta suohin, a khuotate mei tawh kihaltum ding hi; tua ciengin Israel in a gam a suon mite ama in a suonkia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Hesbon khuo aw, da-in mau in, a zieh pen Ai suhsietin om ta! Rabbah tanute aw, kap un! La-ip puon silin kap unlen, ciengpum tawh kisunliem un! Azieh pen a siempute le a tuonvaite tawh Milcom salin kipeipi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang dingin na hatna uh kisahtheipi na hi uh ahei? Na hatna uh a kiemsuh ding ahi hi. Upna nei lo tanu aw, nang in na haunate suongin, “Koi in kei ei sim ding ahei?” na ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in na veng zosie tung panin na tungah zauna kang tungsah ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Note kithezah gawpin na tuotuona vuah na tai ding vua, galtaite a kaikhawm ding koima a om sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin khum nua ciengin Ammon-te a gam uh ka piekia ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Ezk 21:28-32; 25:1-7; Amos 1:13-15; Zeph 2:8-11"},"7":{"text":"Edom Tungtang Thu. Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Teman gamah pilna a om nawn sih amah? Mi pilvangte kung panin thukupna a tawp ta amah? Amau’ pilna a maimang sieng ta amah?","title":"Edom tunga Thukhenna"},"8":{"text":"Dedan gama tengte aw, kinuahei-in tai unlen, a thuhna munah kumsuh un! Bangzieh ahei cile, ama dan ka pieh hun ciengin Esau tungah tuosietna ka tungsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Lengga khawmte na kungah hing pei uleh amate in a sanghte nuasie lo ding uh amah? Zan lai-in gutate hing pei uleh amate nangawn in a dei teng beh la ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei in ka hile Esau a puon hawhdawhin a guohtangin ka omsah a, a kiphuolna munte ka phele a, ama a kiphuol thei ta sih hi. A tate, a sanggamte le a innvengte kisusie a, ama om nawn lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tagate uh nuasie un, keima in kemin ka hinsuo ding hi; na meigongte un zong keima ei muong uheh."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Dan tuoh dinga kilawm lote in dantawhna hai a dawn lo uh phamaw lai ding ahile, nang zong dan tuoh loin na om thei ding amah? Dan tuoh loin na om sih ding a, tua hai na dawn lo phamaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile kei le kei ka kiciem a, Bozrah pen mite’ lipkhap le zapi ding, nuasie ding le samsietna-a zah ding hi ding a, a khuopi zosie uzong hawmsuoh zing ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa kung panin thupha ka za a, minamte lahah kamtai khat kisawl zo hi: “No le no kikaikhawmin ama sim dingin hing pei unlen, gal sim dingin kisa un! a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen minamte lahah a neu penin kang bawl ding a, mite in kang simmaw sah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Suong keen kawmah tengin muolsang dawnah a busa pa aw, mi’ giin dinga na opna le na kisahtheina in nang ang sol lawm ta hi. Muvanlai bangin a sangpi ah bu bawl nan lacin tua panin kang khiesuh veve ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Edom gam pen a cimulthaw huoi khat suoh ding a, ama kunga pei zosie a cimul uh tho-in, a gimna teng uh ziehin a ehneh ho ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Sodom, Gomorrah le a kimvela khuote a kisuhsiet lai bangin tua munah koima teng loin, a sungah koima in khuomkhaw lo ding hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24-25"},"19":{"text":"Lonona munah a om tuute ka delmang ding a, Jordan hamphul lah pana ang kuonto humpi bangin, a gam panin thakhatin Edom ka delmang ding hi; tuale keima in a gam sunga vaihawm dingin ka dei popo ka se ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile kei tawh a kibang koi om ahei? Koi in kei ei hlan thei ding ahei? Ka mai-a ding ngam ding tuucing koi ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in Edom tunga a tunsah ding a gelnasa, le Teman gama tengte tunga tunsah a sawmte za in: Ganhing a note kitawmang tahtah ding hi; gan khumna in zong a tuokhah thute ziehin a dipkuo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A puana uh a ging ngai seng ahi ziehin leitung kithingsah hi; San Tuipi dongah amau’ kaana kiza ding hi."},"22":{"text":"En in, muvanlai bangin ama lengto-in Bozrah tungah a hla zahin bawhsuh ding a, tua ni ciengin Edom galhangte’ lungsim, numei nausuoh dingte’ lungsim tawh kibang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"23":{"text":"Damascus Tungtang Thu. Hamath le Arpad a lungmang uhi, azieh pen amate in thu hoi lo a za uhi; amate zau-in a lungkie vua, tuipi dai thei lo bangin a buoi uhi.","title":"Damascus tunga Thukhenna"},"24":{"text":"Damascus thazawmin a taimang dingin kihei hi, patauna in ama mancip a, lungkhamna, le dana in ama tukon hi; numei nausuoh ding bangin a om hi."},"25":{"text":"Bang a cile a minthang khuopi, kipahna khuopi khu a kinuasie ta adiei!"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khum ni ciengin a tangvalte le a galkap zosie a khuolai tuol-awngah a pua ding uhi, Vanglien, Topa in ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in Damascus kulpi ah mei ka tawkuong ding a, tuami in Benhadad’ mun muonhuoi a katum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 17:1-3; Amos 1:3-5; Zech 9:1"},"28":{"text":"Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a zawsa Kedar le Hazor kumpi gamte tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Ding unlen, Kedar sim dingin mainawt un! Nisuona lama om mite thatgam un!","title":"Kedar le Hazor tunga Thukhenna"},"29":{"text":"A puonbuhte ule a ganhonte uh, a buh kotkhai puonte ule a van zosie uh ladawh un; amau’ adingin kalaohte kipeipi ding a, tam bang kikona aw khat kato ding hi: “Muncin tengah zauna behbeh!”"},"30":{"text":"Hazor khuo-a tengte aw, taimang unlen gamlapi ah vahmang un! A thuhna munte sungah kiphuol un, Topa in ci hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in nang langpan nading gelna le tupna nei zo ta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tho inlen, kulpi tunkot ahi a, a khana ahi zongin a nei vateh lo, muongtah le bihtaha a om hit hiet gam khat va sim ta’n, Topa in ci hi."},"32":{"text":"A kalaoh-te uh kimawh lahpieh ding a, a bawnghonte uh kitomgam pieh ding hi. A sam uh a heukieute muncin tengah ka thezah ding a, muncin teng panin amate tungah tuosietna ka tungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Hazar khuo khu si-alte’ buolna suoh ding a, tua munah koima teng loin koima in a sungah khuom khaw lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kumpi a suo pat lamin Elam tungtang thu tawh kisai-in Jeremiah kungah Topa’ thu tung hi.","title":"Elam tunga Thukhenna"},"35":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangci hi: Elam gam’ hatna bulpi ahi a thalpi ka kuoitawng ding hi;"},"36":{"text":"tuale keima in Edom tungah van ning li panin hui nam li ka langsah ding hi; tua huite lahah amate kithethangin Elam panin ka delmang mite tun lona gam khat beh a om sih ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate a thasawm, a galte uh mai-ah Elam mite ka zausisah ding hi; keima in amate tungah gimna le a giinhuoi ka lungthahna ka tungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Amate ka thagam masangsie namsau in ka nuadelsah ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Elam gamah a kumpipa ule a vaihawm uliente thatin ka kumpi topha ka phut ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin ni nukhia ni ciengin Elam a gam ka piekia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon le Chaldea-te tawh kisai-in kamsangpa Jeremiah tung panin Topa’ thu gen tami ahi hi:","title":"Babylon tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Minamte lahah genin phuongzah unlen, phuoldap sih unlen zawna dielkhai khai-in phuongzah un: Babylon kila ta hi. Bel pasien kimaizumsah a, Merodach pasien lungkie ta hi. Tua nu’ milimte kimaizumsah a, a pasien’ limte lungkie ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile leilu lam panin tua nu a sim dingin minam khat ang kuonto zo hi; ama in tua nu’ gam pen gamkhing suohsahin a sungah koima teng lo ding a, mihing le ganhingte taimang sieng ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum nite le khum hun ciengin Israel mite, Judah mite tawh ang peiton ding uhi; a kaa kawmun amate hing pei-in Topa a Pasien uh a sui ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in Zion lam nga-in tua khuopi zotna lampi a dong ding vua, a kimangngil ngai nawn lo ding tawntung thuciemna tawh Topa kung zuonin ang kipawl ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite a mangthai tuu ahi ta vua, a tuucingte in muol tung tengah lamkhielin a gammanpi ta uhi; muol khat panin muol khatah a vah kawikawi vua, a giena mun uh a thei ta sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"A mu tapo in amate a nawmval vua, a galte in, “Eite i khiel sih uhi, azieh pen amate in a thuman lonona ahi, Topa tung le a pu a pate kinepna ahi, Topa tungah a khiel zieh uh ahi bo hi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Babylon panin taimangin Chaldea gam panin pei dawh ta unlen, keelhonte a makai keeltang bangin om un.","ref":"Kln 18:4"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in leilu lam gam panin gam thupi honkhat hantawhin Babylon ka simsah ding hi; tua khuo a sim dingin amate ang kiguol ding uhi; tua panin khuopi kila ding hi. A thalpite uzong galhang thalkap siem pa’ thaltang kap tawh kibang ding a, a hawmpeikia sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Chaldea gam kibulu ding hi; ama a bulu zosie in a khamtahin a ne ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka gouluo a bulute aw, note kipahin lungdam nan locin, lopa lahah a tai kawikawi bawnglaa le sakoltang bangin ham nan locin,"},"12":{"text":"na nu uh Babylon nahpi-in maizum ding a, ang hing na nu uzong a mindai ding hi. En un, minamte lahah ama a nukhia pen hi ding a, gamlah, gam gawta le senel gam a suoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ lungthahna ziehin a sungah koima teng lo ding a, gamlah suoh ding hi; Babylon a nawh kha mi zosiete in lamdang a sa ding vua, a liemma zosiete ziehin a ehneh ho ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"No thal tawi zosiete aw, Babylon kimvelah panmun la unlen, thaltang khat zong hen loin ama kap un. Bang ding ahei cile Topa tungah ama a khiel zo hi."},"15":{"text":"A pang zosie panin ama’ langkhatah awng un, “Ama in gal a lel ta hi; a munkipte cimmang zo a, a kulbangte pua zo ta hi,” ci-in kiko un. Azieh pen tami khu Topa’ phulah ni ahi hi: Ama tungah phu la inlen, ama in a bawl bangin ama tungah bawl un."},"16":{"text":"Anlah hunin Babylon panin khaitute le phieukawi tawite khawlsah un. A susie ding namsau ziehin amate a unpi-un a mipite lahah a kilekia ding vua, a unpi-un a gam ma vuah a taikia ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Israel ahile humpite in mat dinga a delmang tuu tawh kibang hi. Amasa-in Assyria kumpipa in ama netum a, tu-in a tawpkhahna ah Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a gute a tepguoi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Assyria kumpipa dan ka tuosah bangin Babylon kumpipa le a gam dan ka tuohsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A gantatna lohing lahah Israel ka koikia ding a, tuale Carmel le Bashan ah gamta ding a, Ephraim le Gilead muolte tungah a dei teng kim ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Khum ni le khum hun ciengin Israel’ khielna kisui ding a, bangma khat zong kimu lo ding hi; Judah’ khielna kisui ding a, a kimu tuom sih ding hi; azieh pen keima in ka hinkhawi teng’ mawna ka maisah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Merathaim gam a sim dingin peito unlen, Pekod a teng mite do un; a tawp dongin amate su maimangin kang sawl zosie bawl un, Topa in ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Gam sungah gal husa le sietna lienpi om hi!"},"23":{"text":"Leitung buppi’ sehpi-a kizang pa bangci dan a kisatkeh gawp ta adiei! Minamte lahah Babylon bangci dan a cizat huoi suoh ta adiei!"},"24":{"text":"Babylon aw, nang kang thangsie a, a thei loin na awh ta hi; Topa na tawh ziehin ang kimu-in ang kiman hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in a galhiem koina hongin a lungthahna galhiemte a la hi, bangzieh ahei cile Chaldea gam sungah Vanglien Topa Pasien in bawl ding khat a nei hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama sim dingin muncin teng panin hing pei un; a ansalte honpieh un; anhum lom kholvum bangin ama koi-in sumaimang unlen, bangma nuasie sih un."},"27":{"text":"A bawngtang zosie that unlen, a go dingte kungah peisuhsah un; amate adingin hun le nite ang tung zo hi, ama’ gimna thuoh ding hun ang tung zo ta hi!"},"28":{"text":"Ngai vawi un! Eite Topa’ phulahna, a biehinnpi ading phulahna thu Zion ah a phuongzah dingin Babylon gam panin galtaite le gambelte ang pei uhi."},"29":{"text":"Babylon a sim dingin thal kamsa-a a tawi thalkap siemte thuta un. A khuopi kimvelah giephuol sat un; koima suohtasah sih un. Ama in a bawl bangin dinkia un; ama in ang bawlna tawh kituohin ama tungah zong bawl un, bangzieh ahei cile ama in kiliensah tahin Israel’ Siengtho Topa a simmaw hi.","ref":"Kln 18:6"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a khuolai tengah a tangvalte pua-in, khum ni ciengin a galkap zosie zong kisusie ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Mi kiliensah pa aw, nang kang langpan hi, Vanglien Topa Pasien in ci hi; azieh pen nang dan kang pieh ding hun le ni ang tung ta hi."},"32":{"text":"Mi kiliensah pa kipal kha-in pua ding a, a phongto ding koima a om sih ding hi, tuale a khuopite mei tawh ka hal ding a, a kimvela sil om zosie katum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Israel mite kibawlsie a, Judah mite zong tua ma bang ahi hi; sala a man mi zosie in amate tudetin a peisah nuom ta sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amau’ Tanpa hat mama hi; ama’ min Vanglien Topa ahi hi. Ama in lei tungah toidamna a pieh thei nadingin amau’ vai pel loin ngaisutpi ding a, ahi vangin Babylon-a tengte adingin toi opna ahi sih ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Chaldea-te, Babylon-a tengte, a uliente le a mipilte lang khatah namsau a pang hi, Topa in ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate mimaw a suo thei nadingin a aisante uh lang khatah namsau khat a pang hi! Amate a kisuhsiet nadingin namsau khat in a galhangte lang khatah a pang hi!"},"37":{"text":"Numei tawh a kibah nadingun tua nu’ sakolte, tua nu’ sakol leengte le amate lahah gamdang galkap zosie’ langkhatah namsau khat a pang hi! Amate a kitomgam nadingin a gougil zosie lang khatah namsau khat a pang hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama’ tuite a kan sieng nadingin guotui pei nawn lo hi! Azieh pen milim biehna gam ahi a, amate in milimte a motlaw uhi"},"39":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Babylon ah gamsate le si-alte tengton ding a, va-kalaohte a teng ding uhi; a khuopi ah mi tengkia ngai nawn loin a khang khangin tenna-in kinei nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 18:2"},"40":{"text":"Pasien in Sodom, Gomorrah le a kimvela khuopite a suhsiet lai bangin khum munah koima teng lo ding a, a sungah koima in khuom khaw lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24-25"},"41":{"text":"En in, leilu lam panin minam khat ang pei hi; gam thahat khat le kumpi tampi leimong a gamla pen panin thatho tahin ang kuon uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in thalpi le teipi a tawi vua, gilo mama-in hepina kici a nei sih uhi. Amau’ huging pen tuipi ging bang hi; amate sakol tungah a tuong uhi. Babylon tanu aw, gal do dinga a kithawi galhang pa bangin amate ang kuon uhi!"},"43":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in amau’ thu za-in a khut a zaw hi. Lunggimna in ama gahcip a, numei takeih bangin na a sa hi."},"44":{"text":"Lonona muna om tuute a delmang dingin Jordan hamphul lah pana ang kuonto humpi bangin, ama kung panin amate thakhatin ka delmang ding hi; keima in a gam sunga vaihawm dingin ka dei popo ka teel ding hi. Azieh pen kei bang mi koi om ahei? Koi in kei ei hlan thei ding ahei? Ka mai-a ding ngam ding tuucing khu koi ahei?"},"45":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in Babylon tunga tunsah dinga a gelsate le Chaldea-te’ gam sunga tunsah a sawmte za in: Ganhing note kitawmang tahtah ding hi; a tuokhah uh thute ziehin amau’ gan khumna a dipkuo ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Babylon a kimatna husa ging ziehin leitung kiling ding a, gamcin tengah ama’ kaana awging kiza ding hi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Babylon langkhat le Leb-qamai -a tengte langkhatah a susie thei hui ka langsah ding hi;"},"2":{"text":"keima in a zap ding mite Babylon ah ka sawl ding a, amate in tua gam a zap sieng ding uhi. Gimna ni a tun ciengin ama a langpan dingin muncin teng panin amate a kuon uh ciengin, amate in gam sung teng a hawmin koi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Thaltawi pa in a thal kuoi sih hinlen, a sia songkhol zong sil sih heh. A tangvalte uh hinkhawi sih un; a galkap honte zosie that sieng un."},"4":{"text":"Chaldea gam sungah amate kithatin a pua ding vua, khuopi gawldung tengah a liemgawp ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Israel’ Siengtho Pa mai-ah khielna tawh a gam uh kidim nanle, Vanglien Topa a Pasien un Israel le Judah taisan lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Babylon panin tai unlen, na hinna uh taipi ciet un! Ama’ khielnate sipi sih un. Bang ding ahei cile tam pen Topa’ phulah hun ahi a, a mawna tawh kituohin ama in a thuh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Babylon pen leitung zosie a khamsah thei, Topa’ khut sunga khamhai ahi hi; minamte in ama’ zu a dawn vua, tuaci’n minamte mimaw a suoh uhi.","ref":"Kln 17:2-4; 18:3"},"8":{"text":"Thakhatin Babylon pua a, a guoicim sieng hi; ama adingin kapin mau un! Ama’ liemma nu ding zatui la un, ama dam thei lai kha ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Babylon a cidam ding i hanciem vangun ama kidamsah thei lo hi. Ama taisan ta unlen, i gam ciet zuonin pei va vui; azieh pen a tunga thukhenna in vantung dongah tung a, vantungte dong nangawnah kikhangto zo ta hi.","ref":"Kln 18:5"},"10":{"text":"Topa in eite ei dihsahna a talang zo ta hi; hing pei un, Topa eite’ Pasien nasepnate Zion ah va gen ta vai."},"11":{"text":"Thaltangte hiem un! Thalbawm thaltang tawh dim un! Topa in Babylon suhsiet sawm ahi ziehin Media kumpite a hantawh hi, azieh pen khumi khu Topa’ phulahna ahi a, a biehinn ading phulahna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Babylon kulte langkhatah diel khat khai unlen, galvilte hatsah un; a cing ding mi zong koi un; a buhdap dingin kithawi un; azieh pen Babylon-a tengte tawh kisai-in, Topa in a gensa teng gel zo-in sem zo ta hi."},"13":{"text":"No tui tamna gei-a teng gougil haute aw, na hun uh tawp zo ta a, na hinna khau uh tat zo hi.","ref":"Kln 17:1"},"14":{"text":"Vanglien Topa ama le ama kiciem hi: Na tungah kauphe honpi bangin galkapte kang dimsah ding a, amate in na tungah guolzo-in awng ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"A vanglietna tawh leitung bawl a, a pilna tawh leitung phutin, a theitelna tawh vantungte a kizahsah pa khu ama ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a aw a ginsah ciengin vante-a om tuite ging valuh a, ama in leimongte panin tuikhu a katosah hi. Ama in guo a zuh nadingin tun phesah a, a vankholna inn panin hui langsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi zosie a mawlawm vua, bangma a thei sih uhi. Amau’ milimte ziehin khamkhengte a unpi-un a maizum uhi; azih pen a milim uh zuou ahi bo a, tuate sungah naahu om lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Khumte kimanna a nei lo, kisolna nasep ahi bo hi; dan a kipieh hun ciengin amate mangthai ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jacob’ tanh Topa khu tamte bang ahi sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ama na vannuoi a bawlpa ahi hi. Israel ama’ gouluo minam ahi a, ama’ min Vanglien Topa ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang ka khetbuh le ka galvan na hi hi: nang tawh minamte ka sat guoi a, nang tawh kumpi gamte ka susie hi;","title":"Israel a Siempa’ Vanzah"},"21":{"text":"nang tawh sakol le a tunga tuongpa ka sat guoi hi; nang tawh sakol leeng le a tunga tuongpa ka sat guoi hi;"},"22":{"text":"nang tawh numei le pasal ka sat guoi hi; nang tawh khangham le khangnote ka sat guoi hi; nang tawh tangvalte le ngahnute ka sat guoi hi;"},"23":{"text":"nang tawh tuucingpa le a tuuhonte ka sat guoi hi; nang tawh lo nei pa le a pawlte ka sat guoi hi; nang tawh gam uhte le a khut nei-a uliente ka sat guoi hi."},"24":{"text":"Babylon le Chaldea gama tengte zosie in Zion ah sietna a bawl zosiete uh ziehin nangma’ muna-ah amate ka thuh ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Babylon Kisietna"},"25":{"text":"A susie muolpi aw, leitung buppi a susie pa aw, nang kang langpan hi, Topa in ci hi; nang langkhatah ka khut ka zah ding a, keen kawm panin kang liasuh ding a, a katum muol kang suohsah ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Innkiu suong ding le inn khuombul dingin nang tung panin bangma suong kila lo ding hi. hinanle nang gamkhing na suoh zing ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Khum gamah diel khai unlen, minamte lahah pengkul mut un; tua nu sim dingin minamte kithawisah unlen, ama sim dingin kumpi gamte, Ararat, Minni, le Ashkenaz gamte hlan un; ama sim dingin galkapmang khat se unlen, kauphe hon kitom bangin sakolte kai un."},"28":{"text":"Ama sim dingin minamte kithawisah un. Media kumpite, a uhpite le a khut nei-a uliente tawh amau’ uhna sunga gam zosie kithawisah un."},"29":{"text":"Khum gam citunin kin gawp hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in Babylon sim ding a gelna a tangtung hi. Ama in Babylon gamkhing suohsahin, koima’ ten lona suohsah hi."},"30":{"text":"Babylon galhangte gal kido khawlin, a mun muonhuoi sung vuah a om ta uhi; a thahatna uh tawp sieng a, numei tawh a kibang uhi; a innte uh mei tawh kihal a, khuopi tunkotgol sietawnte a tawngsan sieng hi."},"31":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa kungah muncin teng panin khuopi kila zo hi, ci thu a ko dingin patong khatlekhat, kamtai khatlekhat a kimu dingin a tai kawikawi uhi:"},"32":{"text":"Tanmunte kila zo a, zang phaite kihaltumin, galkapte a patau uhi."},"33":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Babylon’ tanu a kisiacil ciengin ama ancilna mun tawh kibang hi; hinanle bano khat sungin ama anlah banga a kilah hun ang tung ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in ei valtumin ei suguoi hi; beelhawm bangin ei koi a, gulpi bangin ei nawmval hi; ama ka sa tuilai teng tawh kivakham a, tuaci’n keima ei luokhie kia hi."},"35":{"text":"Babylon tungah a kisemnen ka tahsa kithuh taheh,” Zion-a tengte in ci ding uhi. “Chaldea-a tengte tungah ka sisan kithuh taheh,” Jerusalem in ci ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na vai kang seppieh ding a, phu kang lahpieh ding hi. A tuipi ka gawtasah ding a, a ciatui ka kangsah ding hi;"},"37":{"text":"tuale Babylon pen van kisie lompi, le si-alte kuo suohin, a lipkhap huoi, a ehheh huoi le koima’ ten lona mun a suoh ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Humpite bangin a hawh vapuoh ding uhi; amate in humpi note bangin mi a ngih ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"A du mama laitahun a dawn ding uh zu ka pie ding a, a guolnop dong uh amate zu khamsahin, tuaci’n amate khanglo nawn loin a lum den ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Gaw dinga a kipeipi tuunote bang ahi a, tuutang le keelte bangin ahi zongin, amate ka peipisuh ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Bangci danin Sheshach kila a, leitung buppi’ kisah theina kila dawh a ta diei! Bang a cile minamte lahah Babylon cizat huoi suoh a ta diei!"},"42":{"text":"Babylon ah tuipi letto a, tuihuol zauhuoite in ama hlummang hi."},"43":{"text":"A khuopite cizat huoi suoh a, leigaw senel gam suoh sieng hi. Khum gam sungah koima teng loin, koima in nawhkha lo hi."},"44":{"text":"Babylon ah Bel ka gawt ding a, a valsate ka luokhesah ding hi. Ama kungah minamte a honhonin pei nawn lo ding hi; Jerusalem kulpi cim zo hi."},"45":{"text":"Ka mite aw, ama sung panin pusuoh un! A zauhuoi Topa’ lungthahna panin mi zosie kisuotah ciet un!"},"46":{"text":"Gam sunga kam baleng kigente ziehin lungkie loin zong zau sih un. Kum khatin kam baleng khat kigenin a kumkia ciengin adang khat kigen hi. Gam sungah tatsietna le kumpi khat le kumpi khat kidona kam balengte a ging hi."},"47":{"text":"Babylon milimte dan ka pieh ni ding ang tung valon ding hi; a gambuppi kimaizumsah ding a, a mi kithatte khuo lai-ah a pua ding uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantung, leitung le a sunga om na zosie in Babylon ziehin kipahin la a sa ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate do dingin leilu lam panin mi susie dingte ang pei ding uhi, Topa in a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 18:20"},"49":{"text":"Babylon ziehin leitung zosie-ah mi kithatte a pua bangin, Israel a thagam ziehin Babylon pua valon ding hi.","ref":"Kln 18:24"},"50":{"text":"No namsau pana a suohta teng aw, pei pai unlen lung uoikai nawn sih un! A gamlapi panin Topa phawh zing unlen, Jerusalem lunggul zing un:"},"51":{"text":"Gensietna ka zah ziehun mitzum maizum teng ka tuoh vua, minsietna in ka mai uh a tuom ta hi. Bang ding ahei cile Topa’ biehinn mun siengthote sungah gamdang mite a lut ta uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a milimte ka gawt ding hun ang tung valon ding a, a gam sung muncin tengah a milimte a tau ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Vantung dongah Babylon kato nanle, a sangpi-in a kulpi get zong nanle, keima kung panin mi susie dingte ama tungah tung veve ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"54":{"text":"Ngai un! Babylon pana kaana khu! Chaldea pana suhsietna gingpi khu!"},"55":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in Babylon a hawmguohin koi a, a husa a daisah ta hi. A tuihuolte tuipi kilawh ging bangin hawh vapuoh a, a husa in gamcin teng thawn hi;"},"56":{"text":"azieh pen Babylon tungah a susie dingte a kuon zo tah ziehun, a galhangte uh kiman zo a, a thaltangte uh tawng sieng zo hi; azieh pen Topa khu a thuhkia thei Pasien ahi a, ama in a kimin thuhkia ding hi."},"57":{"text":"A uliente uh, a mipilte uh zu ka tekham ding a, a gam uhte, a khut nei-a uliente le a galhangte zu tekhamin, amate pong lo kei-in lum den ding uhi, a min Vanglien Topa a kici, Kumpipa in ci hi."},"58":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: A sa mama Babylon kul khu lei ah cimsuh ding a, a khuo kul sangpite mei tawh kihaltum ding hi. Mite bangma lo a balia vua, mite in mei tawh hal ding bepin a gimpi uhi."},"59":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah a kumpi sep zaw a kum lina kum, kamsang Jeremiah in Babylon gama a na zawpi lai-a, Mahseiah’ tapa, Neriah’ tapa Seraiah thu a na pieh khu tam bang ahi hi. Seraiah pen galkap vansai pa ahi hi.","title":"Seriah Kunga Jeremiah’ Thupieh"},"60":{"text":"Jeremiah in Babylon tawh kisai-in Babylon-a tung ding gimna zosie laiziel khatah giel hi."},"61":{"text":"Jeremiah in Seraiah kungah tam bangin ci hi: “Babylon na tun ciengin tam thu zosie na sim ding a,"},"62":{"text":"‘ Topa aw, nang in mihing le ganhingte teng loin, kumtawna a kinuasie dingin tam mun suhsiet ding na galgih hi,’ ci-in gen in."},"63":{"text":"Tam laiziel na sim zaw ciengin suong khat tawh khi inlen, Euphrates gun lai-ah paimangin,"},"64":{"text":"tuale ‘Ama tunga ka tunsah gimnate ziehin Babylon tam bangin tumsuhin dawhto kia nawn lo ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi. Jeremiah’ thugenna tu-a cieng ahi hi.","ref":"Kln 18:21"}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah kumpi a suo-in kum sawmni le khat pha hi; ama Jerusalem ah kum sawm le kum khat sung maang hi. A nu’ min Hamutal ahi a, Libnah-a teng Jeremiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Jerusalem Kisietna Etkiana (2Kum 24:18-20 ; 2Khg 36:11-16)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Jehoiakim gamtat bangin Topa muna-ah sil hoi lo a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bangin Jerusalem le Judah in Topa a lungthahsah ziehun ama kung panin amate a notmang hi. Zedekiah in Babylon kumpipa langpang hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale ama kumpi-a a maan zaw a kum kuo kum, a hla sawmna, a ni sawm ni-in Jerusalem sim dingin a galkap zosie tawh Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kuonin khuopi imtawm uhi; amate in tuami kimvelah galdalna a bawl uhi.","ref":"Ezk 24:2"},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Kumpi Zedekiah in a uh zaw kum sawm le kum khat a cin dongin khuopi ki-imtawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua kum a hla lina, a ni kuo ni-in khuopi sungah kiel a natsiet seng ziehin gam mite ading an om nawn lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuopi kulpi kitovang hi; tuale khuopi kimvelah Chaldea-te om zong le zan laitahin kumpipa’ um gei-a kulpi tegel kikala tunkot lam tawnin galkap zosie taimangin Arabah gam lam a manaw uhi.","ref":"Ezk 33:21"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Chaldea galkapte in kumpipa a nuadel vua, tuale Jericho zang lei-ah a pha uhi; tuale a galkap zosie kithezahin ama a taisan uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kumpipa manin Hamath gam Riblah khuo-a om Babylon kumpipa kungah peipi-in, tuale ama tungah thu a khen hi."},"10":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in Zedekiah muna-ah a tate that a, Riblah khuo ah Judah kumpi ulien zosie zong that hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in Zedekiah’ mittangte kheipieh a, tuale ama siakhau tawh khi-in a si dongin thong sungah a khum hi.","ref":"Ezk 12:13"},"12":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in kumpi a sep zaw a kum sawm le kum kuo a cin kum, a hla ngana, a ni sawm ni-in Jerusalem ah Babylon kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan lut a,"},"13":{"text":"Topa’ biehinnpi a kipan kumpipa’ inn le Jerusalem-a inn zosie haltum sieng hi; inn gol kici zosie zong haltum hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:8"},"14":{"text":"Kumpi cing galkapmangpa tawh a omton Chaldea galkap zosie in Jerusalem kimvela kulpi zosie a satcim uhi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in mipite lahah a zawngpen pawlkhat, khuopi sunga a kinuasie mite, Babylon kumpi langa a tai mite, le khutsiem mi a omlai teng, sal dingin a zawpi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in lengga um bawl ding le lo hlo dingin gam sunga a zawng pente kimkhat nuasie lai hi."},"17":{"text":"Chaldea-te in Topa’ biehinnpi sunga om sumngo khuomte, sumngo tuikuong le a tunnate satguoi-in sumngo zosie Babylon ah a puo uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale amate in beelte, vutluonate, taite-te, hengkuongte, siakeute, le biehinnpi kikhopna sunga vanzah zosie zong a la uhi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpi cing galkapmangpa in ngun le kham tawh a kibawl hengkuong neute, meikam luona kuongdaite, kuongte, beelte, meivah khuomte, siakeute, le tuibuohna kizang kuongte zong a puo hi."},"20":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa in Topa’ biehinn dinga a bawlsa khuompi ni, tuikuongpi khat, tua nei-ah sumngo bawngtang lim sawm le ni le a tunnate , sumngo tawh a kibawl tua vanzah teng zosie pen ahile tawi te zawh vet ding ahi sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Khuompi nite ahile, khuompi khat a sanna tong sawm le tong giet, a kimkot tong sawm le ni pha hi; tua pen a sunghawm ahi a, a san pen zung li zung li ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuami tungah sumngo khuomlu zepna om hi; khuomlu zepna khat pen tong nga sang hi; khuomlu zepna kimvel pen lenta banga kiphante le mang kawlsing limin kizem a, a unpi-in sumngo-a kibawl ahi hi. Tuale a khuompi nina zong tua bang ma-in mang kawlsing lim-a kizem ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"A pang tengah mang kawlsing ga sawmkuo le guh om hi; a kimvelah a kizepna mang kawlsing zosie a unpi-in zakhat ahi hi.","ref":"1Kum 7:15-47"},"24":{"text":"Kumpi cing galkapmangpa in siempupi pa Seraiah, siempu lien a nina Zephaniah, le kotpi cing thumte a kaimang hi;"},"25":{"text":"tuale ama in khuopi panin galkapte a uh galkapmang khat le khuo sunga a kimu kumpipa’ vaihawmpi mi sagi, gam mite a hanthawn galkap thuvanpi khat le khuopi sunga a tuokhah uh mi sawmguh, khuo sung panin a peipi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in amate manin Riblah khuo-a Babylon kumpipa kungah peipi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuale Babylon kumpipa in Hamath gam sunga Riblah khuo ah amate tehpuongin a thatgam sieng hi. Tuaci’n sal tang dingin a gam pulamah Judah a pei hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam pen Nebuchadnezzar in sal dinga a zawpi mi phaza ahi hi: A kum sagina kumin Judah mi tulthum le sawmni thum,"},"29":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar a kumpi suo zaw a kum sawm le giet kumin mi zagiet sawmthum ni sal dingin peipi hi;"},"30":{"text":"Nebuchadrezzar a kumpi suo zaw a kum sawmni le thum kumin kumpi cing galkapmangpa Nebuzaradan in a sal dingin zasagi sawmli nga peipi hi; a unpi-in mi tulli le zaguh pha hi."},"31":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoiachin a saltan zaw kum sawmthum le kum sagina, hla sawm le nina, ni sawmni le ni nga ni-in Evil-merodach Babylon kumpi-in maang a, kumpi-a a maan kipat kumin Judah Kumpipa Jehoiachin maipha pie-in thong sung pan a ladawh hi;","title":"Jehoiachin a Saltanna-ah Maipha Nga (2Kum 25:27-30)"},"32":{"text":"ama hoitahin hopi a, Babylon gama a ompi kumpi dangte sangin a sang zaw tona a pie hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jehoiachin in a thong puonte suodawh a, nisimin a hin sung teng kumpipa’ sabuoi-ah an a ne zing hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama a hin sung tungtawn a si tanpha-in Babylon kumpipa in nisielin a neh ding an manmanin a pie hi."}}}}},"25":{"info":{"name":"Kaa La","shortname":"Kaa","abbr":[],"desc":"Kaa late laibu (lamentations)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun khat lai-a mi a dimna khuopi daidam talawm sam e izaw! Minamte lahah a liensa kimlai, bang dinga meigong bang ta adiei! Gamkhente lahah kumpinu hi sa kimlai, tu-in mi sila a suoh ta hi.","title":"A Kinuasie Khuopi"},"2":{"text":"Zan khuovahin kap a, a hlitui a bieng gelah a luong hi; a guolngai zosie lahah ama henem ding khat beh om lo hi; ama tungah a guolte zosie muonhuoi loin a gamta vua, amate pen ama’ gal le sa a suoh sieng ta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Judah mite, bawlsietna le na hamsa a sem sawltahpi dingin salin kikai mang zo hi; tu-in ama’ minamte lahah ama teng a, khawl nading mun a mu sih hi; a lungdon hun laitahin a delte in ama a nuaphah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Zion zotna lampite a mau vangut uhi, azieh pen pawi sim dingin koima a pei ta sih hi; A kotpi zosie kitawn nawn loin a siempute uh tau vangut uhi; a ngahnute a lunggim vua, ama’ tanh khu mudana ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A galte pen a pute suohin, a galte a dau uh a pei hi. Azieh pen a suhkhiel a tam seng ziehin Topa in ama gimna thuohsah hi; galte mai-ah a tate galmatin kikaimang sieng hi."},"6":{"text":"Zion’ tanu thupina zosie maimang sieng zo ta hi. A makaite, neh ding lohing a mu zo lo sazuh tawh kibang hi; a delte mai-ah amate thazawmin a taimang sieng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem in a genthei ni le a vaiva ni-in tanglai-in ama-a’ ahi sil manpha zosie a phawhkia hi. Galte khut sungah a mite a pua lai-in, koima in ama panpi lo a, a galte in ama’ kiehsuhna enin a nuisan lel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem, nahpitahin maw a, tuaci’n mite’ simmaw a thuoh hi. Ama zahtah zosie in a guohtanga a op a mu ziehun ama a thuse ta sih uhi; ama le ama a tau vangut a, ama in a mai a lehei hi."},"9":{"text":"A nih ah ama’ sientho lona a baang hi; ama in a mailam ding ngaisun lo hi; a kiehsuhna nasie mama a, a henem ding khat zong nei lo hi. “ Topa aw, ka gentheina ei en in, azieh pen galte in ei zo gawp hi!” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amau’ van manphate tungah galte in a khut a zah uhi; kikhopna sunga lut dinga na kham lawkite nangawn a biehinn sungah a lut uh ama in a mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Neh ding a sui kawmun ama’ mi zosie tau vangut uhi; amate a thahatkia nadingun a goute uh an tawh a khel uhi. Topa aw, bangma ka mat lona ei en inlen ei mu in."},"12":{"text":"Ei nawhkha zosie aw, no dingin bangma ahi sih amah? Ei en unlen ei mu un. Topa a thangpai mama ni-in ka tunga a tunsah gimna tawh a kibang gimna a om amah?"},"13":{"text":"Tunglam panin meikuong ang sawl a, ka gu ka tang teng ei zen hi; ka tot ding lenthang ei sie a, ama in ei kinualesah hi; sun nitumin khuo phawh lo, thazawngkhalin ei nuasie hi."},"14":{"text":"Hahkol ah ka khielnate kikanbawm a, tuate ama’ khut tawh ei khitha hi; ka ngawngah tuate ei khaipieh uhi; katha kazung teng a hup sieng hi; ka nan zawh lo galte’ khut sungah Topa in keima ei pie ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in keima kunga om ka galhang zosie ei nuolpieh ta hi; ama in kei ei sim nading, ka tangvalte a suhguoi nading hun khat phuongzah hi. Topa in lengga cil bangin Judah’ tanu ngahnu siengtho a tuoncil ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei ei henem ding le ei hanthawn ding mi tawh ka kigamla hi; tam teng ziehin ka kapkap a, ka hlitui in ei hlummang hi; galte in a zawgawp ziehun ka tate a cimaw uhi."},"17":{"text":"Zion in a khutte a zah vangin a henem ding koima om lo hi; a innvengte a gal a suo thei nadingin Topa in Jacob sim dingin thu a pie zo hi; amate lahah Jerusalem a sieng lo na a suoh hi."},"18":{"text":"A thugen langpangin ka ledo vangin Topa pen a man ahi bo hi; ahi vangin no mi zosie in ngai unlen ka thuohna en un; ka tangvalte le ka ngahnute salin kikaimang ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka guolngaite ka hlan a, hinanle amate in kei ei sol uhi; ka siempute ule ka upate in a thahatkia nadingun an a sui kawmun khuopi sungah a si uhi."},"20":{"text":"Topa aw, ka genthei dan ei en ven; kang nah langpan ziehin ka gil sung a kihotnawi a, ka sungah ka lungtang a kipingpei hi. Gawldungah namtem in tuol luong lumsah hi; inn sungah zong sina ma a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Ei henem ding koima om loin amate in ka tauna a za uhi. Ka galte in ka gimna a za uhi; tam banga nei bawl a thangpha uhi. Na gensa ni hing tungsah inlen, amate keima tawh kibangsah in."},"22":{"text":"Na mai-ah a gitlona zosie uh hing tung taheh; ka bawlkhielnate ziehin kei tungah na bawl bangin amate tungah zong bawl in; azieh pen ka khuisahna a tam seng ziehin, ka lungsim a gim hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangci dan a Topa a lungthah zieha Zion’ tanu khu hici kisimmaw adiei! Ama in vantung panin Israel’ thupina leitungah paisuh zo hi; a lungthah ni-in ama in a keng ngahna phawh kha nawn lo hi.","title":"Pasien’ Genkholte Tangtung"},"2":{"text":"Topa in hepina nei loin, Jacob’ tenna mun zosie susie zo hi; a lungthah ziehin ama in Judah tanu’ mun muonhuoi phelmang hi; ama in kumpi gam le a vaihawmte tuol sena-in nei-in muolphosah hi."},"3":{"text":"A lungthah seng ziehin Israel’ thahatna zosie suguoi a, ama in galte mai-ah a khut zietlam dawh hi; ama in Jacob sungah meikuong bangin hal a, a kimvel zosie katum hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in gal bangin a thalpi kuoi a, alang pa bangin a zietlam khut tawh pang hi; ama in Zion tanu’ puonbuh sunga i kisahtheipi zosie that sieng hi; ama in meikuong bangin a lungsona a buosuh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa pen gal bangin om a, Israel a susie hi; ama in a kumpi’ innte susie-in a kulpite zong a susie a, Judah tanute lai-ah kaa le mau a khangsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in um bangin a buh guoicimsah a, a biehbuh a susie hi; ama in Zion ah pawi le sabbath nite tawpsah a, a lungthah seng ziehin kumpi le siempute a ginase sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in a maitam thuse loin a mun siengtho a nuasie hi; ama in a galte’ khut sungah kumpi inn kulbangte a pie zo hi; pawi ni-in a kiko bangun Topa’ inn sungah amate a kiko valuoi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Zion tanu’ kulpi cipzan ding pen Topa in a sesa ahi hi; ama in ciemtena gamgi hawt a, a suhmang nadingin zong a khut a nuakai sih hi; ama in a kap a mau dingin leicien le kulpite siem a, amate khuisa-in a om uhi."},"9":{"text":"Lei-ah a tunkotte tum sieng hi; ama in tunkotgol sattanin susie hi; a kumpipa le a miliente uh salin a om vua, lamlahna om nawn loin, a kamsangte in zong Topa kung panin mangmuna a nga nawn sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Zion tanu’ putehte ham loin tuol ah a to uhi; a lu zang vuah leivui a kibuoh vua, la-ip puon sil uhi; Jerusalem ngahnute zong a tuolkun sieng ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ka kaa na lamin ka mit khamgawp a, ka gilsung a kikhuleh hi; ka mite a kisuhgam ziehin ka sinkha lei-ah a kibuohla ta hi, bangzieh ahei cile khuolai gawldung tengah naupangte le nausente husamin a balia uhi."},"12":{"text":"A nute kungah, “An le tui hei-a om ahei?” ci-in a kapkap uhi. a liem a baite bangin khuopi gawldung lahah basamin a om vua, a nute uh’ kang sungah a hinna uh sunghla-in a si uhi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem tanu aw, nang adingin bang ka gen thei ding a, koi pen tawh kang tekah ding ahei? Zion tanu ngahnu siengtho aw, kang henem thei nadingin koi pen tawh hing te ding ka hei? Na sietna tuipi za-in a gol ziehin koi in hing damsah zo ding ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Nang adingin na kamsangte in a man lo, zuou mangmunate mu zo uhi; na hamphatna na ngakia thei nadingin amate in na khielna hing pholah loin, a man lo le ang puikhiel thei thuphuonte nangma adingin mu zawsop uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lampi dunga a peisunte in a khut uh a behsan hi; Jerusalem tanu ehneh ho-in a lu a peisan lel uhi; “Hoina bukim nei khuopi, leitung vannuoi’ kipahna khuopi kici tami amah?” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na galte in nang langkhatah a kam uh kahin ang hawhsan uhi; amate in hing ehneh ho-in a ha a gawi vua, “Tam khuopi i susie ta ukhu! Kadei, i nganga uh tam ni a khula, a tawpna-ah i mu ta ukhu!” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in a lungtup bawl zo a, a galgihna sem zo ta hi; sawtveipi lai-a a gelsa bangin ama in khuotuo loin a susie hi; ama in na tungah na galpa a kipahsah a, na galpa’ thahatna a tawisang hi."},"18":{"text":"Zion tanu’ kulpi aw, Topa tungah nahpi-in kiko in! Sun le zanin na hlituite luitui luongsuh bang taheh! Nang le nang tawlnga sinlen, na mit zong sing da in!"},"19":{"text":"Khuocingte a kipat ciengin tho inlen kizanko ven! Topa mai-ah na lungsim tui bangin sungsuh in. Gawldung mong cintengah kielsi-in a basam na tate a hin thei nadingun ama lamah na khutte lamto in."},"20":{"text":"Topa aw, en inlen ngaisun in! Koi tungah tam bangin na bawl ngel ahei? Nupite in a hinsa uh a tate’ sa a ne talawm ding uh amah? Topa’ mun siengtho ah siempute le kamsangte a kithat ding amah?"},"21":{"text":"Khangdawngte le khanghamte gawldung leilahah si-in a lum den uhi; ka ngahnute ule ka tangvalte uh, namsau tawh a puamat sieng uhi; na lungthah ni-in amate na that a, hepina om loin na that sieng hi."},"22":{"text":"Pawi ni-in mi a kihlat bangin nang in ka kimvela om ka galte na hlan hi; Topa’ lungthah ni-in koima suohta loin, a hing zong om lo hi; ka galpa in kakawi kapom lai le kava kata laite ei thapieh sieng zo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ lungthahna ciengpum nei-ah gentheina a thei pa ka hi hi;","title":"A Tul Lo Pasien’ Itna Kip"},"2":{"text":"ama in ei delmangin khuovah a op lona khuomiel lahah ei peipi hi;"},"3":{"text":"sun tawntungin kei tung behah a khut a hlang den mielmuol hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in ka tel ka vo a vuoigawpsah a, ka gu ka tang a tawngsansah hi;"},"5":{"text":"ama in hin genthei le lunggimna tawh ei imtawmin ei tuomcip hi;"},"6":{"text":"sawtpi lai-a a sisa mite bangin khuomiel lahah ei tosah hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka suotah thei lo nadingin kul tawh ei imtawm hi; ama in a gih siakhau tawh ei khi hi;"},"8":{"text":"panpina ngenin ka kiko vangin ka thumna ei khahtanpieh hi;"},"9":{"text":"ama in a kikhengsa suongtumte tawh ka lampi ei khahtan a, ka lampite a kawisah hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama pen kei ei buhdap vompi le a kiphuol humpi tawh kibang hi;"},"11":{"text":"ama in lam ei pielpi a, ei ehtelin ei nuasie hi;"},"12":{"text":"ama in a thalpi kuoi-in a thaltang tuh nading dawimunin ei nei hi."},"13":{"text":"A thalbawm sunga thaltangte tawh ei kap a, ama in ka sin ka lungah tumsah hi;"},"14":{"text":"amate in sun tungtawnin ehnehna la ei awi awi vua, ka mipite’ nuizat ka hi ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in zatui kha ei dawnsah a, du lopi-in gamsai kha ei nesah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in ka hate suongtang hlaisah a, vutvam ei buoh hi;"},"17":{"text":"Ka hla in lungmuonna nei lo a, lungdamna kici bang ahei ka mangngil ta hi;"},"18":{"text":"tuaci’n keima in, “Ka vang bei zo a, Topa kung panin ka kinepna zosie tawp sieng zo hi,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka gentheina le ka inn nei lonate ka lungngaina khu gamsai le tuikha ahi hi!"},"20":{"text":"Keima in tuate ka sielsiel a, ka lungsim a genthei giap hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam thu ka phawh a, tua ziehin kinepna ka nei hi:"},"22":{"text":"Topa’ itna thawn ngai loin, ama’ hepinate tawp ngai lo hi;"},"23":{"text":"tuate zingmawng sielin ang thasuo zing hi; nangma’ thumanna lien hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka hlagau in, “ Topa pen keima’ tanh ahi a, “Tua ahi ziehin ama sungah ka kinem ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama a ngah mite ading le ama a sui hlagau adingin Topa hoi hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa’ hutdamna khu daitaha nga khinkhian ding hoi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi khat in a khangno lai-in hahkol a puoh ding hoi hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah hahkol a ngah ciengin ama guohin sip dide-a a to ding hoi hi."},"29":{"text":"Leivui lahah a kam koi leh hoi hi. (tua hile kinepna om kha thei lai ding hi),"},"30":{"text":"a beng pa lamah a pheta daw-in, gensietna tawh a kidim ding hoi hi."},"31":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa in ei nuol den lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in ei lungkhamsah nanle ama’ ei itna kip dung zui-in lainatna ei nei ding hi;"},"33":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ama in koima gentheisah nuom loin, zong lungkhamsah nuom lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Gam sunga thongkie zosie keng tawh a kitotcil cieng,"},"35":{"text":"Sangpen Pa’ masangah mihing’ hamphatna a kileheipieh cieng,"},"36":{"text":"mi khat’ thu a manin a kikhen lo cieng, Topa in mu lo ahi amah?"},"37":{"text":"Topa in a gelkhol sih leh koi thupieh tawh pieng ding ahei?"},"38":{"text":"A sie a pha pen Sangpen Pa’ kam pana ang pusuoh hi lo amah?"},"39":{"text":"A mawna dan uh a thuoh ciengun bang dingin phunphun ding uh ahei?"},"40":{"text":"I gamtatnate kisittelin Topa kungah kinuale va vui."},"41":{"text":"Vantunga Pasien kungah i lungsimte ule i khutte uh lamto va vui."},"42":{"text":"Kote tawnkhielin kang ledo ta vua, nang in ka mawna uh nei maisah sih hi."},"43":{"text":"Nang le nang lungthahna tawh kituomin nei nuadel a, khuotuona nei loin nei that hi;"},"44":{"text":"kote’ thungetna na kung ang tun thei lo nadingin nangma le nangma meiilum na kikhu hi."},"45":{"text":"Nang in mite lahah kote buathah le ninthem bangin nei bawl hi."},"46":{"text":"Ka galte zosie a kam kah vua, kei langpanna thu a gengen uhi;"},"47":{"text":"kote tungah patauna le dumthuhpi ang tung a, a hawmkieu ding le a mangthai ding ka hi ta uhi."},"48":{"text":"Ka mite a kisiet ziehin ka hlitui guntui luong bang hi."},"49":{"text":"Ka hlitui kang thei lo ding a, mit sing man loin ka om ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Topa in van pan ang etsuh a, a mu masangsie-in,"},"51":{"text":"ka khuopi ngahnu zosie ziehin ka mit in ei lungkhamsah hi."},"52":{"text":"Ka galte in thu om lopi-in va bangin keima ei vei uhi."},"53":{"text":"Leihawm sungah ka hingtangin ei paimang vua, suongtum tawh ei sincip uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tui in ka lu ei hlum a, “A mangthai hi tang,” ka ci hi."},"55":{"text":"Topa aw, kuokhuh tawdop panin na min kang hlan hi;"},"56":{"text":"“Panpi dinga ka tauna na bil na hu sinlen, ei lungnuomsah in,” ci-in kang ngetna nei za hi."},"57":{"text":"Kang hlat ciengin keima nei neh a, “Zau sin,” nei ci hi."},"58":{"text":"Topa aw ka vai nei genpieh zo ta a, ka hinkhuo nei tankhie zo hi."},"59":{"text":"Aw Topa , ka tunga na hoi kibawlte na mu zo ta hi, ka vai ei hawmpieh in."},"60":{"text":"Ka galte ei huotna le ei lebawlnate uh na mu zo ta hi."},"61":{"text":"Topa aw, amau’ ei tawhnate le ei lebawlnate na za zo ta hi."},"62":{"text":"Sun tungtawnin kei ei langpangte in kei do nading kihodap-in ei gensiesie uhi."},"63":{"text":"A to ule a din uh en vawi, ehnehna la ei sahlu uhi."},"64":{"text":"Topa aw, a gamtatna bang ule amau’ khuta a sepna utawh kituohin amate thuhkia in!"},"65":{"text":"Amate lungkhamna lungtang pie inlen, amate tungah na samsietna tusah in!"},"66":{"text":"Na thangpaina ziehin Topa’ vante nei panin amate delmang inlen, thatgam sieng
