in."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bang dingin kham muol dawh ta a, bang dingin kham citah a mel kilamdang ta adiei! Gawldung lamsuom tengah mun siengtho suongte kithezah sieng zo hi.","title":"Zion Dan a Kipiehna"},"2":{"text":"Kham hoipen banga a manpha, Zion’ tapate khu bang dinga belkhengte khuta kikheng leibeelte tawh kibang dawh ta adiei!"},"3":{"text":"Si-alte nangawn in zong a note nawi pie-in a tawpsah buong sam vua, hinanle zong ka mite pen a note tunga a gilo, gamlahah a om kalaoh vate tawh kibang uhi."},"4":{"text":"A dangta ziehin a dangtawngah nausen’ lei a beh hi; naupangte in neh ding an a ngen vua, hinanle koima in bangma pie lo hi."},"5":{"text":"An tuipen a ne ngaite zong lampi tengah a kielsi sieng vua, a nuomsa-a khangkhiete zong leivui lahah a lum ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Sodom danthuohna sangin ka mite kigawtna nasie zaw a, tua tungah khut kinga kha loin mitphet kala kisusie ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24"},"7":{"text":"A milien milalte uh vua sangin sieng zaw a, bawngnawi sangin kangzaw uhi; suongsan mantam sangin amau’ pumpi sanzaw a, amau’ samte zong sapphire suongte tawh kibang hi."},"8":{"text":"Amau’ mai innking sangin vomzaw a, tu-in gawldung lahah amate a kithei kha sih hi. A gute uh tungah a vunte uh behcip a, singkung gawta tawh a kibang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Lo sungah galete a pien lo ziehin neh ding nei loin gawngtamin a kielsi mite sangin, namsau-a a si mite hamphazaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka mite kisuhsiet hun sungin mi lainat thei nupite’ khut in a tate’ sa huonin an-in a ne uhi.","ref":"Thkna 28:57; Ezk 5:10"},"11":{"text":"Topa in a lungthahna husuo zosie a hlakhie zo ta hi; ama in a lunghanna buosuhin Zion ah mei taw a, a khuombulte katum hi."},"12":{"text":"Leitung kumpite le leitung mi zosie in Jerusalem tunkotte ah gal le sa a lut zo dingin a um sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem khuo lai-ah mi thumante’ sisan a luongsah kamsangte’ mawna le siempute’ khielna zieha tam thu ang pieng ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mittaw bangin amate gawldung lahah a vahvai vua, a puonte uh koima’ tham ngam lo dingin sisan a bang netnut hi."},"15":{"text":"“Pei dawh ta un! Mi sieng lote aw!” “Pei dawh ta un! Pei dawh ta un! Ei tham kha sih un!” ci-in mite a kiko uhi. Tuaci’n amate mi galtai le mi vahvaite a suoh ta uhi. Minamte lahah mite in, “Amate tanah om thei sih va uh,” ci san lel uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in amate thezah zo a, amate a awlmaw nawn sih ding hi; siempute tungah zatahna a kilah ta sih a, makaite tungah zong deisahna a om ta sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Panpi ngenin i khuo dahdah vua, matlap om loin i mit uh a kham bep lel hi; ei hundam zo ngap lo ding minam khat tungah lawptahin eite in i ngahngah uhi."},"18":{"text":"I khuolai vuah i va thei lo nadingin amate in ei sulzui uhi; i si nading uh ang nai ta a, i nite uh ang cing ta hi; Bangzieh ahei cile i si hun uh ang tung ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Eihaw ei delte ahi ule van lai-a leng mukel sangin a gangzaw uhi; amate in muol tungah ei del vua, gamlahah zong ei buhdap uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Minamte lahah ama’ hlim belin i nungta ding uhi,” ci-in ka gen uh, ka nasuh ka natona uh ahi, Topa sathau nusa mipa, amate in a dum sung vuah ei matpieh ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Uz gama teng Edom’ tanu aw, lungdamin kipah in; ahi vangin nang tungah zong tua hai ang tung ding hi; tua hai khamin na puon hawh dawhin na guohtangin na om ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Zion’ tanu aw, na mawna zieha dan ang kipiehna manzo ta a, ama in nang saltang dingin ang kaisah nawn sih ding hi; hinanle Edom’ tanu aw, ama in na mawna dan hing pie-in, na khielna zosie ang pholah ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, kote tunga ang tung bang ahei ei phawh in; kote ei en inlen, ka zalatna uh ei mu in!","title":"Hepi Ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Melmahte tungah ka gouluote uh kipie ta a, ka inn ka lote uzong pemtate tungah kipie ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Kote pen tagate le pa nei lote ka hi ta uhi; ka nute uzong meigong ahi ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka dawn ding uh tuisih zong lei kul hi; ka vah ding uh sing zong lei kul hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka ngawng vuah hahkol ei kivaw-in ei kinawmang gawp hi; kote ka balia ta vua, tawlngah hun ka nga sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kote in hin theina khop anneh mu nadingin Egypt-te le Assyria-te tawh thukimna ka bawl zo uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh a maw uhi; amate a om nawn sih vua, tuaci’n amau’ khielna paat kote in ka puo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Silate in kote tungah zingvai a hawm ta uhi; amau’ khut sung panin ei hunkhie ding koima om lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamlahah namsau ziehin luong khamin neh le tah ka sui uhi."},"10":{"text":"Gilkiel husapi ziehin lungthu bangin ka vunte uh a vomking hi."},"11":{"text":"Zion ah numeite le Judah khuopite ah ngahnute ei kibuonpieh hi."},"12":{"text":"A khut utawh milien milalte a khailia vua, upate a kizatah nawn sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tangvalte an kipausuhsah a, naupangte sing kipuosh a, a puo zo loin a hawilenpi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tehsiete in khuopi tunkot a nuasie ta vua, khangnote in tumgingte a tum nawn sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ka lungsim vua kipahna teng a tawp sieng kiukeu ta hi; nunnuoma ka lamkaina uh dana suoh ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka lutung panun kumpi lukhu a kiesuh ta hi; kote ka tawnkhiel ziehun gimna thuoh ka hi ta uhi!"},"17":{"text":"Tam ziehin ka lungsim uh na a, tam thute ziehin ka mit uh a miel hi."},"18":{"text":"Zion Muol a daidam tah ziehin tua tungah si-alte vah kawikawi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa aw, nang kumtawnin na maang a, a khangkhangin na kumpi topha a kip den hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang dinga kote nei ci pum mangngil ahei? Bang dinga kote ni tampi sung nei taisan ahei?"},"21":{"text":"Topa aw, kote kang kilekia thei nadingun nangma kungah ei peipi in; Masang lai-a bangin ka hinkhuo uh ei siemphat pieh in."},"22":{"text":"Ahi sihle nang in kote ei pumnuol na ta amah? Kote tunga na lungthahna ciengtan nei lo a hi ta amah?"}}}}},"26":{"info":{"name":"Ezekiel","shortname":"Ezk","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezekiel laibu (the book of ezekiel)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm thumna, a hla lina, a ni nga ni-in Chebar gun gei-a saltangte lahah ka op laitahin vante ang kihongin Pasien’ kilahnate ka mu hi.","title":"Sakol leeng Mangmuna","ref":"Kln 19:11"},"2":{"text":"Tua hla a ni ngana (tua ni pen Kumpi Jehoiachin saltan a kum ngana ahi hi),","ref":"2Kum 24:10-16; 2Khg 36:9-10"},"3":{"text":"Chaldea gam Chebar gun gei-a om Buzi’ tapa siempu Ezekiel tungah Topa’ thu tung hi; tuale ama tungah Topa’ khut khumtahah a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka khuodah leh leilu lam panin huipi khat ang lang hi: meiilumpi khat ang kai-in a kimvel teng vah pempom a, khawl loin tun phe zing a, tuale meikuong laikim pen sumngo tang pimpem tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua meikuong laikim ah ganhing tawh a kibang li a om hi. Amate melpuoh zie tam bang dan ahi hi: amate in mihing mel puo uhi.","ref":"Kln 4:6"},"6":{"text":"Maitang li le hla li ciet nei uhi."},"7":{"text":"A kengte uh zang zitzet a, a ketawte uh bawngno’ ketaw bangin sumngo kinawtvam bangin te lihleh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in hla a nei vua, a pang lite tungah mihing khut tawh a kibang a nei uhi. Tua lite in maitang le hlate tam bangin a nei uhi:"},"9":{"text":"A hlate uh khatlekhat kimat dimdiem hi; a pei uh ciengin a mailam ciet a manaw vua, a kituomhei om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"A maisuo dan uh tam bang ahi hi: tua lite in mihing maitang a nei vua, zietlam pangah humpinelkai’ mai, veilam pangah bawngtang’ mai, le mu vanlai’ mai a nei ciet uhi.","ref":"Ezk 10:14; Kln 4:7"},"11":{"text":"A hlate uh a tunglamah a zahto uhi; ganhingte in hla ni ciet a nei vua, a hlate uh khatlekhat kimatin a hla nite in a pumpi uh a tuom hi."},"12":{"text":"A mailam ciet manaw-in tangtahin a pei uhi; hlagau puina mun munah a mailam uh nawhin kihei loin a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ganhingte laikim ah meihol kuonglai tawh a kibang khat om a, tua ganhingte lahah meikuong kide bangin pei kawikawi hi; tua mei taang mama a, tua in tun a phesah hi.","ref":"Kln 4:5"},"14":{"text":"Tua ganhingte tunphe bangin suhpei topei kawikawi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ganhingte ka en leh amate panga lei lahah lengkang khat ka mu a, a li-un lengkang khat ciet a nei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua lengkangte’ lim le mel le a kibawl dan tam bang ahi hi: a hoi dan pen suongmanpha bangin val lihleh hi; a li-in a mel uh kibang ciet a, a kibawl dan ahile lengpei khat sunga lengpei khat kibul tawh kibang hi."},"17":{"text":"A pei uh ciengin kihei tawm loin a ngatna lite uh mun khat popo-ah a pei thei uhi."},"18":{"text":"A lengkang kuolte uh pen sangin cizat a huoi hi, azieh pen tua lengkang kuol lite a unpi-un mittang vive tawh a kidim hi.","ref":"Kln 4:8"},"19":{"text":"Ganhing lite a pia uh ciengin a panga lengkangte zong kilia pai hi; tuale lei lah panin tua ganhingte a kato ciengin tua lengkangte zong kato pai uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hlagau peina popo ah amate zong pei a, tuale tuate tawh a lengkangte a kikhinton valiai uhi; azieh pen tua lengkangte sungah ganhingte’ hlagau a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ganhingte a pia uh ciengin amate zong pia pai uhi; tua ganhingte a khawl uh ciengin tuate zong khawl pai uhi; tuale lei lah panin ganhingte a kikhanto nah po leh a lengkangte zong amate tawh kikhangto pai lien hi; azieh pen tua lengkangte sungah ganhingte’ hlagau a om hi.","ref":"Ezk 10:9-13"},"22":{"text":"Tua ganhingte’ lutungah limlang banga a te lihleh le a kuoh kimkiam bang khat om a, amau’ luvumah kizahto suoh hi.","ref":"Kln 4:6"},"23":{"text":"Tua a kuoh kimkiam nei-ah a hlate khatlekhat kizomin tangtahin a zah vua, ganhing khat in hla ni ciet nei-in tua pen a pumpi uh tuomna-in a nei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ganhingte a pia uh ciengin a hlaging uh pen tui tampi husa ging, Vanglienpa in van a thinna ging, le galkap honpi’ husa ging tawh a kibang hi; a khawl ciengun amate in a hla a khup uhi.","ref":"Kln 1:15; 19:6"},"25":{"text":"Tuale a lutung son vua om a kuoh kimkiam tung panin aw khat ang ging hi; a khawl ciengun amate in a hla a khup uhi."},"26":{"text":"Amau’ lutung son taha a om a kuoh kimkiam tungah sapphire suongmanpha tawh a melpuoh a kisun kumpi topha bang khat a om hi; tua kumpi topha tawh a kisun tungah mihing lim tawh a kibang khat a to hi.","ref":"Ezk 10:1; Kln 4:2-3"},"27":{"text":"A kawng tungsie tawh a kibang teng pen sumngo mei-a kihal a san pimpem bangin ka mu a, meikuong tawh kibang khat in a kimvelah a tuom hi; a kawng neilam tawh a kibang teng pen meikuong bangin ka mu a, a kimvel teng tang pimpem hi.","ref":"Ezk 8:2"},"28":{"text":"Guo a zuh ni ciengin meiilum lahah ang kai sakhi-guihlung mel bang puo-in a kimvelah tang piehpuah hi. Tam pen Topa’ minthanna vang tawh a kisun mel kilahna khat ahi hi. Khum khu ka mu ciengin khupbawhin ka kunsuh a, tuale mi khat’ thugen ka za hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, na keng tawh dingto inlen, na kungah thu kang gen ding hi,” ei ci hi.","title":"Laiziel Mangmuna"},"2":{"text":"Tuale ama in keima kungah thu ang gen ciengin ka sungah hlagau khat ang lutin ka keng tawh ei dingtosah hi; tuale ama’ ei hopina ka za hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, keima in a ledo minam, kei ei langpangin ei ledo Israel mite kunga pei dingin nang kang sawl hi; amate le a pu a pate un tuni cieng dongin keima ei langpangin a gamta khiel uhi."},"4":{"text":"A suonlehlahte uh zum mel thei loin a lung khau uhi. Amate kungah kang sawl a, nangma in amate kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi,” na ci ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in a ngai vua a ngai sih zongun, (azieh pen amate mi ledo innkuon ahi uhi) amate in note lahah kamsang khat a op zo lamtah a thei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale nang, mihing aw, ling le khau in hing kimkotin mom-ai lahah teng nan lacin amate giing sinlen a thugente ziehun zau malmal sin; amau’ thugente ziehin zau sinlen, ang dugaw-et vangun zong lungkie beh sin, azieh pen amate pen a ledo innkuon ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a ngai vua, a ngai sih zongun ka thugente amate tungah na gen ding hi, azieh pen amate pen a ledo innkuon ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang, mihing aw, nang tunga kang gen thu khu ngai in; tua a ledo innkuonte bangin ledo sin; na kam kah inlen kang pieh khu ne in."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka en leh, ka kungah khut ang zamphei khat ka mu a, tua khut sungah laiziel khat a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka mai-ah ama in ang zah a, kaa le mau, thum le tau thu vive a nua le a mai-ah kigiel hi.","ref":"Kln 5:1"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah mihing aw, nang kang pieh khu ne in; tami laiziel ne inlen pei-in Israel innkuonte kungah va gen in."},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka kam ka kah a, ama in ka neh dingin tua laiziel ei pie hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, nang kang pieh tami laiziel ne inlen na gil vasah in. Tua ciengin ka ne hi; tua pen ka kamah khuoizu bangin a hlum hi.","ref":"Kln 10:9-10"},"4":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, Israel innkuonte kungah pei inlen, amate kungah ka thute va gen ta’n."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen a ham a kitel lo le ham hahsa a zang mite kunga ang kisawl ahi sih a, Israel innkuonte kunga ang kisawl ahi bo hi."},"6":{"text":"A ham na tel thei lo, ham kitel lo le ham hahsa a zang mi tampite kunga ang kisawl hi lo hi. Amate kunga ang sawl hi leng, amate in na thugen ang ngai tahtah ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel innkuonte in ka thugen a ngai nuom lo ziehun nang thugen zong a ngai nuom tuom sih ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Israel innkuon zosie in a sah talpang le a khau lungtang a nei uhi."},"8":{"text":"En in, amate mai langkhatah na mai ka khausah zo ta a, na talpang zong ka khausah zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in na talpang suongsah khu meituh suong sanga a sahzaw-in ka bawlzo hi; amate a ledo innkuon ahi ziehun amate giing sinlen lungkiehna-in zong nei sin."},"10":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah a gen hi: Mihing aw, keima in na kunga kang thugen ding zosie na lungsimin sang inlen na bilin za in;"},"11":{"text":"tua ciengin saltang na mite kungah pei inlen amate kungah va gen in. Amate in a ngai a, a ngai nuom sih zongvun a kung vuah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi,” va ci tan."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin hlagau in kei ei domto a, ama’ opna mun panin Topa’ minthanna vang ang kato laitahin, a nualamah a ging ngai mama khat ka za hi;","title":"Chebar Guna Om Ezekiel"},"13":{"text":"tua pen ganhingte’ hla khatlekhat a kizapkhah gin le a panga lengkangte’ gin a na hi a, tuate a gin ngai mama hi."},"14":{"text":"Hlagau in keima ei domsangin ei puomang hi; keima tungah Topa’ khut a hat seng ziehin lungthah le hlasie-in ka pei hi."},"15":{"text":"Chebar gunpi gei Telabib-a teng saltang mite kungah ka tung a, amate lahah ni sagi sung amkham gawpin ka om hi."},"16":{"text":"Ni sagi a cin ciengin ka tungah Topa’ thu tam bangin ang tung hi:"},"17":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel innkuonte’ galvil pa dingin nang kang koi zo hi; ka kam sung panin thu na zah sielin amate tungah ka thuhilkholnate na gensawn ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima in migilote kungah, “Na si valon ding uhi,” ka ci-a, tuale nang in amate na hilkhol sih a, ahi sihle a hinna uh a kihumbih thei nadingin a gitlona lampi panun amate a kikhel thei nadingin thu na hilkhol sih leh, amau’ khielna ziehin tua migilote si ding uhi; hinanle keima in amau’ sisan nang kungah kang phul ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang in migilote hilkhol napi a gitlona uh khawl tuom loin, ahi sihle amau’ gitlona lampi panin a kihei nop kan sih uleh, amau’ khielna tawh amate si ding hi; hizongle nang in na hinna na hundam ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua banah mi thudihte, amau’ dihna panin kihei-in khielna a bawl vua, keima in amate mai-ah kipalpuana ding ka koi-a ahile, amate a si ding uhi; azieh pen nang in amate na sam sih a, amau’ mawna tawh amate a si ding vua, amau’ a dih gamtatnate kiphawh kha nawn lo ding a, keima in nang tungah amau’ sisan kang phul ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi dihte a maw lo nadingun na hilkhol a, mawna a bawl sih uleh, na thusapna a sansiem ziehun a hing valon ding uhi. Tuale nang in na nuntahna na hundam ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin khum munah Topa’ khut ka tungah ang om hi; tuale ama in ka kungah, “ Tho inlen kuom sungah va pei ta’n. Khum sungah kang hopi ding hi,” ei ci hi.","title":"Ezekial Kituomkoi, Kisipsah"},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei zong tho-in kuom sungah ka pei hi; keima in Chebar gun gei-ah a minthanna vang ka mu ma bangin khum munah zong Topa’ minthanna vang a na ding hi; tuale kei zong lei lahah ka bawhsuh pai hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka sungah hlagau ang lutin ka keng tawh ei dingsah hi; tuale ama in kei ei hopi-in ka kungah, “Pei inlen na inn sungah kot kikhalu in."},"25":{"text":"Mihing aw, na tungah khauhuol ang kikoi ding a, na mite lahah na pei thei lo nadingin tua khauhuolte tawh ang kikanbawm ding hi;"},"26":{"text":"tuale amate na phawsiet thei lo nadingin na dangtawngah na lei kang behsah ding a, a ham thei loin kang koi ding hi; azieh pen amate, a ledo innkuonte ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hizongle nang kang hopi ciengin na kam ka hong ding a, amate kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin ci hi,” na ci ding hi; a za nuomte in za hinlen, a za nuom lote in zah da uheh; azieh pen amate a ledo innkuon ahi uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale nang, “Mihing aw, tehlei khat la-in na mai-ah koi in. A tungah Jerusalem khuopi lim suoi in;","title":"Jerusalem Ki-imtawmna Kilah"},"2":{"text":"tuale a sim nadingin kui-imnate koi inlen, tuami sim nadingin gal nanna kul bawlin leicien cieng in; tua khuopi do nadingin galphuolte bawl inlen, a kimvelah kulpi suhkhap nading phawhbulte phut in."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin sia pheng khat la inlen nang le khuopi kikalah sia kulpi bangin tung in; na mai tua lam ngat inlen, tua khuopi a ki-imtawm danin omsah inlen sawn citahin sawn in. Tam pen Israel innkuonte dinga lim khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin na veilam netpha-in lum inlen, tua tungah Israel innkuon dan kipiehna koi in; khum sunga na lup ni tantan amate dan kipiehna teng na puo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen nang tungah amate dan kipiehna ding kum phaza tawh a kikim, ni zathum le ni sawmkuo kang pie hi. Tuaci’n nang in Israel innkuonte dan kipiehna na puo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam teng na man zaw ciengin a ni veina na zietlam netpha-in na lumkia ding a, Judah innkuonte’ dan kipiehna na puo ding hi. Ni sawmli sung kang sepieh a, ni khat pen kum khat tang bang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A ki-imtawm Jerusalem lam na mai ngat ding a, na puonah ban zielin tua khuopi in a tuo ding thu mavang na gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"En in, na khuopi imtawmna hun a man masangsie langkhat panin langkhatah na kihei thei lo nadingin khauhuol tawh kang kanbawm ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale mangbu, mangbuham, belawi le besan, tang le tangman la in; kuong sung khatah tuate koi inlen, nangma adingin moh bawl in. Na sih lup hun ahi ni zathum le ni sawmkuo sung tua moh na ne ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na neh ding an pen ni khatin shekel sawmni gih hi ding hi; a kise hunin tua an na ne ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale na tui dawn ding zong kite ding a, hin khat’ seguh-suo-sekhat hi ding hi; a kise hunin na dawn ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang in mihing’ eh tunga a ki-em moh pen a muna vuah mangbuham-moh bangin na ne ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel mite in amate ka delmang nading minamte lahah tam bangin a sieng lo moh a ne ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Ah Topa Pasien! Bangma cihin kei le kei ka kibuasah ngai sih hi; ka neu lai panin tu dongin ama thu-a a si ahi a, gamsate in a tha sa ahi zongin ka ne ngai sih a, ka kam sungah sa uithante zong tum kha ngai nai lo hi,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “En in, mihing-eh tangin bawng-eh kang hisah ding a, tua tungah na moh na em ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, Jerusalem ah an le tui ka tawpsah ding hi; amate in a zau kawmun a kitesa an le tui a ne ding uhi; amate in a lunggim kawmun a kitesa tui a dawn ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"An le tui a kitasap ziehin a lunggim kawmun amate khatlekhat ki-enin, gimna dan a thuoh ziehun a gawngtam ding uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale nang, “Mihing aw, namsau hiem mama khat la in; na sam le na khamul heu nadingin samheute’ samheuna nam bangin zang in; tua ciengin a te nading tawikhaina la inlen, na sam a lomlomin khen in.","title":"Jerusalem Langkhatah Namsau Khat"},"2":{"text":"Imtawmna hun a cin ciengin tua na sam sethum-suo-sekhat khuopi sungah na hal ding hi; nangma in sethum-suo-sekhat na la ding a, khuopi kimkot ah namsau tawh na sattan ding hi; tuale sethum-suo-sekhat pen hui lahah na thethang ding a, tuale keima in namsau a pai panin dawhin tuate ka del ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin tamte lah panin themkhat na la ding a, na puontuol mong ah na khi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate lah panin kimkhat na lakia ding a, mei sungah tuate pai-in na haltum ding hi; khum sung panin Israel innkuonte do nading mei a kuong ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Tami khu Jerusalem ahi hi; minamte laikimah ama ka koi zo a, a kimvel zosie-ah gamte in ka kimkotsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in ka thukhamte le ka ngaina kipte ledo-in a kimvela om minamte le gam zosie sangin a gilozaw suoh a, ka ngaina kipte nielin ka thukhamte a zui sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Na kimvela om minam zosie sangin na buoihuoi zaw vua, tuale ka thukhamte zui loin, ahi sihle ka ngaina kipte na kemcing sih vua, note kimvela a om minamte’ ngaina tawh kituohin na gamta zawsop uhi;"},"8":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Kei mama nang langkhatah kang pang ding a, note lahah a om minamte muna-ah thu ka khen ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale na kidahhuoinate ziehin ka bawl ngai nai vawt lo, zong ka nuabawl kia ngai nawn lo ding thu na tungah ka bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Note lahah pate in tate’ sa ne-in, tate in zong pate’ sa a ne tahtah ding uhi; keima in na tungah thu kang khen ding a, note lahah a suohta sunte muncin tengah kang thethang ding hi.","ref":"Kaa 4:10"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in a genna-ah, keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, a huothuoi nate le a kidahhuoi zosie tawh ka biehinn na buasah ziehun note kang suhmang sih tah ma leh, ci-in ka kiciem hi, tua ahi ziehin keima in note kang sumaimang ding hi; ka mit in mu loin ang koi sih ding a, zong kang khuotuo sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Note lahah pulnatna le kielin sethum-suo-sekhat na si ding uhi; na kimvel vuah sethum-suo- sekhat pen namsau tawh na si ding uhi; tuale sethum- suo-sekhat pen mun cintengah ka thethang ding a, namsau a pai pana dawsa-in amate ka nuadel ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka lungthahna ka tungsah ding a, amate tungah ka lunghanna buosuhin kei le kei ka kilungkimsah ding hi; amate tungah ka lunghanna ka tunsah ciengin keima, Topa in ka thangsietna tawh thugen ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua banah noma kunga ang suohkha zosiete muna-ah na kimvel vua minamte lahah a hawmkieu le simmaw etsatin kang bawl ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Note tungah lunghamna le lungthahna tawh a nasie mama gimna dante kang pieh a, thu kang khen ciengin na kimvel vua minamte adingin note pen simmawna le nuizatnopna, galgihna le zauhuoina-in na om ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Note suhsiet nadingin keima’ suhsietna thaltang le kielna thaltang kang kap ciengin note kang khasah ding a, note tungah kiel hing tunsahbe-in na an na tui ngana uh kang khahtanpieh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Note ang do dingin kielpi le gamsate kang sawl ding a, amate in na tate uh kang guhpiehsah ding hi; pulnatna le sisan luonna in note ang nawh kha ding uhi; tuale keima in note tungah namsau kang tusah ding hi. Keima, Topa in kang gen zo hi.","ref":"Kln 6:8"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Milimbie Israel tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel muolte lam na maingatin amau langah thu phuong inlen,"},"3":{"text":"tuale gen in. No Israel muolte aw, Topa Pasien thugen ngai un! Topa Pasien in muol le tangte, kuomte le guomte tungah tam bangin a gen hi: Kei mama in na tung vuah namsau kang tusah ding a, na munsangte uh ka susie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na maitamte uh hawmsuoh ding a, na gimnamtui halna taute uh kitawkeh ding hi; tuale keima in na milimte uh mai-ah a kithat mite ka sepsuh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in a milimte uh mai-ah Israel misi luongte ka siel ding hi; tuale na maitam kimvel vuah na gu na tang teng uh ka thezah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na tenna mun popo vuah na khuopite uh hawmsuohin na munsangte uzong kisusie ding a, na maitamte uh hawmsuohin kisusie-in, na milimte uh kitawkehin kisusie ding a, na gimnamtui halna taute uh kisattawngin nasepna teng uh maimang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na laikim vuah a kithatte a pua ding uhi; tua ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in mi kimkhat ka suohtasah ding hi. Minamte lahah kimkhat namsau panin suohta-in gamcin tengah na kithethang ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Saltang dinga a kipeipina munah a om minamte lah panin a suohta sunte in a kideh zo lo a lungsim ziehun keima kung panin vahmang nan ule a kideh zo lo a mit ziehun a milimte uh’ nua a zuina uh ziehin, ka lungsim a kitapzan lamtah amate in thei siemin keima ei phawh ding uhi. Tua ciengin a kidahhuoi gitlona a bawlte zosie uh ziehin amahaw mama a huothuoi-in kimu ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale amate in kei pen amate tungah tami gimna a tungsah dinga a mawh galgih Topa ka hi lo lam ei thei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Israel innkuonte’ gitlona le a kidahhuoi a gamtatnate uh ziehin na khut bengin na kengin tuol sia inlen, “Aw kadei,” ci-in! Bangzieh ahei cile amahaw, namsau, kielpi, le pulnatna tawh a si ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Gamlapi-a omte pul natna tawh a si ding uhi; a nai-a omte namsau tawh a si ding uhi; tuale a kihingkhawi a kinuasiete zong kielin a si ding uhi. Tam bangin amate tungah ka lungthahna ka tungsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale a maitam kimvel vua a milimte lah uh, muolsang tung zosie, muoldawn tung zosie, singna dum nei zosie, a na pha gangpi sing nei zosie, le muncin tenga a milimte uh mai, le gimnamtui biehna a luina uh mun tengah a mi kithatte uh’ luong a kisiel ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate langkhatah ka khut ka zah ding a, amau’ tenna mun zosie, senel gam pan Riblah khuo dong gamkhing le a hawmsuohin ka bawl ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Ang Tung Ding Gimna"},"2":{"text":"Nang mihing aw, Israel gam adingin Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: A tawpna! Gam ningli ah a tawpna ang tung ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in nang tungah a tawpna ang tung a, keima in nang tungah ka lungthahna kang hla ding hi; na gamtatna dung zui-in thu kang khen ding a, na kidahhuoina zosie ziehin dan kang pie ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mit in mu loin kang koi sih ding a, zong kang khuotuo sih ding hi. Note lahah kidahhuoi nate a op laitahin, na gamtatna utawh kizui-in dan kang pie ding hi. Tua ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Gimna khat zaw gimna khat! En in, ang tung zo ta hi."},"6":{"text":"A tawpna khat ang tung a, a tawpna ang tung ta hi. Nang tawh kido dingin ang khanglo ta hi; en in, ang tung ta!"},"7":{"text":"Gam sunga teng mite aw, na manthai hun ding uh ang tung ta hi. A ni ang nai a, a hun ang tung ta hi, muol tung guolnopna hi loin, kisuhbuoina ni ang nai ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in a sawt loin na tungah ka lungthahna kang buosuh ding hi; nang langkhatah ka lungthahna ka zang ding hi. Na gamtatna zui-in na tungah thu ka khen ding a, na kidahhuoina zosie ziehin dan kang pie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mit in ang mu loin na om sih ding hi; zong kang khuotuo sih ding hi. Kidahhuoina tawh na op laitahin, na gamtatna dung zui-in dan kang pie ding hi. Tua ciengin note in keima pen mi a vuo Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"En vawi, a ni khu! En vawi, ang tung ta! Na manthaina ang tung ta hi. Paape bangin ciengpum paa a, paape bangin kiphatsahna a meng hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngongtatna pen gitlona ciengpum suohin khanglien hi. Amau’ kicinna, amau’ hauna, amau’ thupinate, khat zong a kip sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A hun ang tung ta a, a ni ang nai ta hi; van leite kipah sih uh hinlen, vanzuate lungdam sih heh. Mihonpite tungah lungthahna a tun ziehin, a leite kipah da uh hinlen, a zuate zong da tuon sih heh."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a neisa zuate in a hin sungun amate kungah a zuasa uh vante ang kinuale lo ding hi. Azieh pen tami mangmuna pen mihonpi tawh kisai ahi hi; tua pen kidawhkia thei nawn lo ding hi. Amau’ khielna ziehin amau’ hinna a humbih zo sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in pengkul mutin na zosie a baisa-in omsah zo uhi; hinanle gal do dingin koima kuon lo hi, azieh pen mipi zosie tungah a lungthahna a tung hi."},"15":{"text":"A pulamah namsau, a sunglamah pulnatna le kielpi; gam sunga omte namsau-in a si vua, khuopi sunga omte ahile kielpi le pul natna in a nawmval hi."},"16":{"text":"A hinga suohta khatpo a op leh, a mawna uh ziehin muol dawnah a om ding vua, kuom sunga vakhu omte bangin amate kap le mau-in a om ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khut zosie zaw ding a, khup zosie tui suoh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in la-ip puon a sil ding vua, zauna in amate tuomcip ding hi. Maitang zosie in zummai puo ding a, a lu uh kimettol ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Lam dungah a ngunte uh a paithang ding vua, a khamte uh zong a sieng loin kingaisun ding hi. Topa’ lungthah ni ciengin a ngun ule a khamte un amate a hundam thei sih hi. Amate in tuate tawh a gilkiel uh phasah thei loin, a gil uzong a vasah thei sih uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tua pen a khielna uh zieha a kipalna uh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"A kiphatsahpi uh ahi a etlawm a kizepnate uh panin amate in a mudahuoi le a kidahhuoi milimte a bawl uhi; tua ahi ziehin keima in amate adingin tuate a niehin ka bawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Gamdang mite’ khut sungah tuate galvanlahin ka pie ding a, migilote tungah vanlah-in ka pie ding hi; amate in tua khu a buasah ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in ka munsieng a buasah thei nadingun keima in ka mai ka lengat ding hi; a sungah mi bulute lutin a buasah ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hatkilih khat kibawl un! Azieh pen gam sungah sisansuo mawna dim hi; khuopi sungah tatsietna a dim hi."},"24":{"text":"Amau’ innte suon dingin nam gilo pente kang peipi ding hi. Mi thahatte kilietsahna ka tawpsah ding a, amau’ mun siengthote ka buasah ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in lungkhamna ang tun ciengin hlamuonna a sui ding vua, ahi vangin a mu sih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Gimna khat zaw gimna khat tungin, kam baleng khat zaw khat kiza hi; kamsangte tung panin mangmuna a suisui ding uhi; siempute tung panin thuhilna mangthai ding a, upate kung panin thumopna mangthai ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa da-in kap ding a, uliente in lunggimna puon silin, gam mite’ khut kiling ding hi. Amau’ gamtat dan dung zui-in amate tungah ka sem ding a, amau’ thukhen dan dung zui-in amate tungah ka khen ding hi. Tuaci’n amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum guhna kum, a hla guhna, a ni nga ni-in ka inn sungah ka to laitahin ka mai-ah Judah uliente ang to vua, tuale khum mun ka tungah Topa Pasien’ khut ang tu hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Sunga a Mudahuoite"},"2":{"text":"Keima in ka en a, mihing’ lim tawh a kibang dan khat a om hi; a kawng neisie mei tawh kibang a, a kawng tungsie sumngo tang pimpem tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:27"},"3":{"text":"Ama in khut tawh a kibang khat ang zahsuh a, tuale ka humsam ah ei man hi; tuale hlagau in lei le van kikalah ei khaito a, Pasien’ mangmunate sungah ama in Jerusalem leilu lam biehinn tuol sungnung lutna tunkot-a thangsietna a piengsah milim kitunna mun ei tun hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale khum tahah Israel Pasien’ minthanna na om a, tua pen kuom sunga ka musa mangmuna tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:28"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, leilu lam nga-in dahto in,” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n leilu lam nga-in ka dahto leh khumtah maitam tunkot leilu lam lutna munah tami thangsietna milim na om hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, amate in keima’ munsiengtho panin a gamlapi ah ei nawmang thei nadingun tam munah Israel innkuonte in a kidahhuoi gamtatnate a bawl uh na mu ei mah? ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale ama in inntuol lutna-ah ei peipi hi; keima in ka en leh kulvang mun khat na om hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, tua kul to vawi,” ei ci hi; ka to pai leh khum munah kot khat ka mu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in kei kungah, “A sungah tum inlen, a mudahuoi a gamtatnate uh va en ta’n,” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei zong pei-in ka va en ta hi; khumtah kawm tung tengah a bawhva ganhing namcin’ lim, a kidahhuoi gamsa lim, le Israel innkuonte’ bieh ganhing namcin lim na kisuoi hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate mai-ah Israel innkuon’ upa sawmsagite a na ding a, tuate lahah Shaphan’ tapa Jaazaniah zong na ding hi. Amate in gimnamtui kuong khat ciet a tawi vua, tuale van lamah gimnamtui halna meikhu a kato valuh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, miel lahah Israel innkuon upate in a milim inndan sung ciet vua a bawl uh na mu zo tai mah? Azieh pen amate in, ‘ Topa in eite ei mu lo hi, Topa in tam gam nuasie ta hi,’ ci uhi,” ei ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Tam teng sanga a mudahuoi zaw a bawlte uh na mu lai ding hi,” zong ei ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Topa’ biehinn sung lutna leilu lam tunkot ah ei tut a, khumnah Tammuz a kici pasien kaa-in numeite a to uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, tami na mu tai mah? Tam teng sanga a mudahuoi zaw na mu lai ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale ama in Topa’ leituol sungnungah ei peipi hi; khumtah, Topa’ biehinnpi lutna innhlap le maitam kikalah mi sawmni le nga tang ding khat na om a, Topa’ biehinn nua ngatin nisuona lam a nga vua, nisuona lam nga-in ni bie-in a na khupbawh uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, tami na mu zo tai mah? Tami sunga Judah innkuonte in a bawl uh a mudahuoi a gamtatnate uh a siehuoi seng sih amah? Amate in tatsietna tawh gamsung kidimsahin, ka lungthah zawh lai nadingin ei phin ding uh a kul ma amah? En in, a nahkuo vuah singba a siet uh khula!"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin lungthahna tawh amate tungah ka gamta ding hi; ka mit in amate mu loin ka koi sih ding a, zong ka khuotuo sih ding hi; tuale keima’ zahna ah awging tahin ang kiko vangun a thungetna uh ka ngaipieh sih ding hi,” ei ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima’ zahin nahpi tahin ama ang kiko a, “No khuopi a that mite aw, ei nai unlen, na khut vuah suhsiet nading na hiem uh hing tawi ciet un,” a ci hi.","title":"Milim Biete Kithana"},"2":{"text":"Tuale leilu lam kinga kotpi tungnung lam panin mi guh hing pei-in a khut vuah mi thana hiem khat ciet a tawi uhi; amate lahah pasal puonkang sil khat om a, a pangah laitui bung khat a tawi hi. Amate ang tumin sumngo maitam gei-ah ang ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Khum laitahin a om ngaina Cherub panin Israel Pasien’ minthanna vang ang peito a, biehinn kotbieng ah ang khawl hi. Topa in puonkang a sil, a panga laitui bung nei pa ang hlan hi;"},"4":{"text":"tuale ama kungah, “Jerusalem khuopi sung zosie ah vah kawikawi inlen, tua sunga sil mudahuoi kibawl zosie ziehin khuisa-in a tau mite’ talpangah melicina va bawl ta’n,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 7:3; 9:4; 14:1"},"5":{"text":"Ama in midangte kungah, “Khuopi sung zosie-ah ama nua zui unlen mi va that ta un; na mit un mu lo a nei sih ding a, koima zong na khuotuo sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Puteh, tangval, ngahnu, numei, naupangte that sieng unlen, ahi vangin ciemtena nei poma khoikha sih un. Tuale ka biehinn ah pan pai un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in biehinn mai-a om upate lahah a pan pai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kung vuah, “Biehinn buasah unlen, a leituol tengah misi luong dimsah un. Kuon ta un!” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate kuonin khuopi sungah mi a thatgam uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in mi a tha laitahun kei guoh ei nuasie vua, tuale kei zong tuol kunin ka bawhsuh a, “Kadei Topa Pasien! Jerusalem tunga na lungthahna na sunhlah ziehin Israel a omsun teng zong na thagam sieng ding ahi ta amah?” ci-in ka kiko hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Israel innkuonte le Judah innkuonte’ khielna nah gol seng luo hi; gam sung teng sisan tawh kidim a, khuo sung teng letatna tawh kidim hi; azieh pen amate in, ‘Gam sung, Topa in taisan zo a, Topa in mu nawn lo hi,’ ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kei ka hi leh ka mit in mu lo nei loin khuotuona zong ka nei sih ding a, a gamtatnate uh amate tungah ka tusah ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin puonkang a sil, a panga laitui bung tawi pa in thu ang nua tutkia a, “Nei sawl bangin ka sem zo hi,” ei ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka en leh, cherub-te lu tungson a kuoh kimkiam tungah sapphire tawh a kibawl kumpi topha bang pien khat ang kilang hi.","title":"Pasien’ Minthanna in Jerusalem Nuasie","ref":"Ezk 1:26; Kln 4:2"},"2":{"text":"Ama in puonkang silpa kungah, “Cherub-te nei-a a om lengkang kipeite kawmah lut in; cherub-te lahah mei-am na khutdim ham inlen khuopi tungah thezah in,” a ci hi. Keima in ka en leh a sungah ama a lut hi.","ref":"Kln 8:5"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in mipa ang lut ciengin cherub-te biehinn leitaw lam pangah na ding uhi; tuale meiilum khat in biehinn tuol sungnung teng ang khu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin cherub tung panin Topa’ minthanna vang ang kato-in biehinn sangkil ah ang om hi. Biehinnpi meiilum tawh kidimin a tuol teng Topa’ minthanna vang in a tanvah hi."},"5":{"text":"Vanglienpa a ham ciengin a awging bangin biehinn inntuol pulam dongah Cherub-te’ hlazap ging kiza hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in puonkang silpa kungah, “Cherub-te lahah a om lengkang kipeite lah panin mei la in,” ci-in a sawl ciengin ama lutin lengkang gei khatah a ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale cherub khat in cherub-te lah panin cherub-te lahah a om mei-am lamah a khut zahin mei-am pawlkhat la a, puonkang silpa’ khut sungah tua mei-am a koi hi. Tua pa in zong mei la-in a pei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua cherub-te in a hla nei vuah mihing khut tawh a kibang a nei ciet uhi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in ka en leh, cherub-te gei-ah lengkang li om a, cherub khat’ pangah lengkang khat ciet om hi; tuale lengkangte beryl suong bangin a tee dimdiem hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuate’ melpuoh dan ahile a li-un a kibang ciet vua, lengkang khat sunga lengkang dang khat a om a bang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate a pei cieng ule kihei tawm loin amau’ ngatna lite khat popo ah a pei thei uhi; a pei masa pen kingatna lam lamah a zui vua, a kihei vateh sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua lengkang lite in-a vielkuolte le a kamnate, a hlate le a lengkangte ah- amau’ pumpi zosie teng dimin mit a nei uhi.","ref":"Kln 4:8"},"13":{"text":"A lengkangte pen ka zahna-ah “lengkang kipeite” kici hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:15-21"},"14":{"text":"Amate in maitang li ciet nei uhi: a masa pen cherub maitang, a nina mihing maitang, a thumna humpi maitang, le a lina muvanlai maitang ahi hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:10; Kln 4:7"},"15":{"text":"Cherub-te ang kato uhi. Tamte pen Chebar gun gei-a ka mu ganhing lite ma ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Cherub-te a kin ciengun a lengkangte zong amate tawh a kinton hi; tuale cherub-te in lei panin a lengto dinga a hla uh a zah ciengin amate lampang pana a om lengkangte a piel sih hi."},"17":{"text":"A khawl uh ciengin adangte zong khawl a, a kato uh ciengin a dangte zong amate tawh kato hi; azieh pen amate sungah ganhingte’ hlagau a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinn sangkil panin Topa ang pusuohin cherub-te tungson ah ang khawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Cherub-te in ka muna-ah a hla uh ang zahto vua, lei panin a kung vua om lengkangte tawh a kato uhi. Topa’ biehinn lutna nisuona lam tunkot ah amate a khawl uhi; tuale amate tungah Israel Pasien’ minthanna vang a om hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam teng pen keima in Chebar gun gei-a Israel Pasien nei sontahah ka na musa ganhingte ahi uhi; amate pen cherub-te ahi lam zong ka thei hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in maitang li ciet, hla li ciet le a hla nei vuah mihing khut bang a nei ciet uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amau’ maitang pen Chebar gun gei-a ka musa maitangte ma bang a, a pei ciengun a mailam ciet ma-ah tangtahin a pei uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hlagau in keima ei domto a, nisuona lam a kinga Topa’ biehinn nisuona lam tunkot ah ei peipi hi. Khum mun tunkot lutna ah mihing sawmni le nga a om hi; khumte lahah mipi makai Azzur’ tapa Jaazaniah, Benaiah’ tapa Petlatiah-te na om uhi.","title":"Thukuppi Gilote tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, tam pasal teng pen khuopi sunga sietna a bawlsawmte le thu gilo a mopte ahi uhi;"},"3":{"text":"amate in, ‘Inn lam nading hun nai lo hi; tam khuopi pen beel ahi a, eite pen sa i hi uhi,’ a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate langkhatah thu va gen ta’n; mihing aw, thu va gen ta’n,” ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka tungah Topa’ hlagau ang tu a, ama in keima kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi, ci-in gen in: Israel innkuonte aw, na ngaisutna uh tami ahi hi; na lungsim sung vua na ngaisutnate uh ka thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tami khuopi sungah mi tampi na that zo ta vua, na mithasate utawh a lampi teng na dimsah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen hi: khuopi sunga na thasa uh misite pen sa ahi vua, tami khuopi pen a huonna beel ahi hi; ahi vangin tua khuopi sung panin note ang kiladawh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Note pen namsau giingte na hi uhi; na tung vuah namsau kang tusah ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in tua sung panin note hing ladawhin gamdang mite’ khut sungah kang pie ding a, note tungah thu kang khen ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Namsau tawh na si ding uhi; keima in Israel gamgi-ah thu kang khen ding hi. Tuale note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tami khuopi pen na beel uh hi loin no zong a sunga sa na hi sih ding uhi; keima in Israel gamgi-ah note thu kang khen ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama’ thukhamte le a ngaina kipte zui loin, na kimvel vua minamte’ ngaina dan banga a gamta note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi,” ei ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin thuphuon ka gen laitahin Benaiah’ tapa Pelatiah a si hi. Tua ciengin khupbawhin ka kap vapo a, “Kadei Topa ! Israel a omlai teng a that sieng ding na hi ta amah?” ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ thu keima kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Pasien in Israel a Ngaingai Hisahkia ding"},"15":{"text":"Mihing aw, Jerusalem-a teng mite in na tanaute, na sanggamte, na saltanpite, Israel innkuon buppi’ thu a gen vua, “ Topa kung panin amate a gamla pei zo ta uhi; eite’ luo dingin tami gam ei kipie zo hi,” ci-a a na gente khu a unpi-un tam mite ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, “ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: minamte lahah amate gamlapi-ah hemdawhin, gam tuomtuomte lahah amate ka thezah vangin, gam tuomtuom a tunna mun zosie vuah bakhat sung amau’ mun siengtho-in ka om hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin gen in: Topa in tam bangin gen in, a ci hi: mite sung panin note kang khawmtuo ding a, na kithezahna uh gam tuomtuomte panin hing sutuo-in Israel gam kang pie ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Khumnah amate a tun ciengun, a kidahhuoi na zosie le a mudahuoi na zosie a paikhie ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in amate lungtang khat pie-in, amate sungah hlagau tha khat ka guong ding hi; keima in a satah panun suong lungtang lahpiehin satah lungtang ka guon ding a,"},"20":{"text":"tuaci’n amate in ka thukhamte a zui ding vua, ka ngaina kipte kemcingin a mang ding uhi. Tua ciengin amate keima’ mi hi ding a, kei amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 36:26-28"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin amau’ lungtang in amau’ sil kidahhuoite le amau’ sil mudahuoite a lunggul vua ahile, keima in amau’ lu tungah a gamtatnate uh ka tusah ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin cherub-te in a kung vua om lengkangte tawh a hla a zahto vua, a tung vuah Israel Pasien’ minthanna vang a om hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale khuopi laikim panin Topa’ minthanna vang kato a, khuopi nisuona lam muol tungah a khawl hi.","ref":"Ezk 43:2-5"},"24":{"text":"Hlagau in Pasien’ mangmunate sungah keima ei domto-in Chaldea gam saltangte kungah ei peipi hi. Tua ciengin ka mangmuna in keima ei nuasie ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuale Topa in ei musah zosie saltangte kungah ka gen hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Judah’ Saltanna Kilah"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, mu nading mit nei napi khuo a mu lo, nang pen zah nading bil nei napi khuo a za lo, a ledo innkuon lahah a teng na hi hi;","ref":"Isa 6:9-10; Jer 5:21; Mrk 8:18"},"3":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile amate pen a ledo innkuon ahi uhi. Tua ahi ziehin, mihing aw, galtai dingin puonlom ziel inlen suntangpi-in amate muna-ah galtai dingin pei in; na opna mun panin mundang khatah galtai ding bangin amau’ muna-ah na pei ding hi. A ledo innkuon ahi vangun a thu thei kha sam ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Galtai dingte bangin sunlai-in amate muna-ah na puonlom na puo ding hi; galtai dingte bangin nitahin zong amate muna-ah na puo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate muna-ah kul tovang inlen khum panin na puonlomte puo in."},"6":{"text":"Amate mitmu-in tua puonlomte na liengko-ah na khang ding a, miel lahah na puo ding hi; leitang na mu lo nadingin na maitang na tuom ding hi; azieh pen Israel innkuonte adingin lim khatin nang kang bawlzo hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei zong thu ei kipieh bangin ka bawl hi. Galtai dingte bangin sun lai-in ka puonlom guongin nitahin ka khut tawh kul ka tovang hi; khuomiel ciengin ka vante ka la a, a mitmu-un tuate ka liengko-ah ka puo hi."},"8":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:"},"9":{"text":"Mihing aw, a ledo innkuon ahi Israel innkuon in na kungah, “Bang bawl na hei,” ang ci sih uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Amate kungah, “ Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: Tami thuphuon pen Jerusalem khuo-a ulienpa le tua sunga om Israel innkuon vannuoi tawh kisai ahi hi,” ci in."},"11":{"text":"“Note adingin kei lim khat ka hi hi: keima in ka bawlsa bangin amate tungah kibawl ding hi; amate galtai le saltangin a pei ding uhi,” ci in."},"12":{"text":"Tuale amate lahah ulienpa khat, miel lahah a puonlom a liengko tungah khangin a peikhie ding hi; ama in kul tovangin khum panin a puo ding hi; ama in a mit tawh leitang a mu lo nadingin a mai tuom ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama tungah ka ngenthang ka zah ding a, ka thangah ama a awh ding hi; tuale Chaldea gam Babylon ah ama ka zawpi ding a, hinanle tua khuopi a mu sih ding hi; tuale ama tua munah a si ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:7; Jer 52:11"},"14":{"text":"Keima in ama panpi dinga ama’ kimvela om zosie, a galkap zosie, muncin tengah ka thezah ding hi; tuale keima in namsau dawsa-in amate ka nuadel ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale minamte lahah amate thethangin gam tuomtuom ah ka thezah ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin minamte lahah a pei peina vuah a mudahuoi a gamtatna zosie uh a gen thei nadingun namsau, kielpi le natpi panin amate tawmno khat ka suohtasah ding hi; tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Thukhenna Kikhinto Lo"},"18":{"text":"Mihing aw, a citun pumin na an ne inlen, zauna le linna tawh na tui dawn in;"},"19":{"text":"tuale gam sung mite kungah thu gen inlen, Israel gam sunga om Jerusalem-a tengte tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Amate in zauna tawh an a ne ding vua, lungkham kawmin tui a dawn ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile khum sunga tengte zosie’ tatsietna ziehin a gam sunga om mi zosie kitomgam ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi tenna khuopite hawmsuohin a gam uh gamkhing a suoh ding hi; tuale amate in kei pen Topa ka hi lam ei thei ta ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"22":{"text":"Mihing aw, “Hun le nite kisawtsah-sah, mangmuna zosie lah bangma hi sih,” ci-a Israel gam sunga na zah uh paunah pen bang hi mawh ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Tam paunah ka tawpsah ta ding a, amate in Israel gam sungah paunahin a zang nawn sih ding uhi,” ci-in gen in. Ahi vangin amate kungah, “Hun le nite ang nai ta a, mangmuna zosie a tangtun nading zong ang nai ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen Israel innkuon sungah mangmuna zuou ahi sihle aisanna zuou om nawn lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima Topa in ka thugen ding ka gen ding a, kiheh nawn loin ang tangtung ding hi; ahi vangin no a ledo innkuonte aw, keima in ka thugente na hin sungun kang tangtungsah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"27":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel innkuonte in, “A mangmuna uh mailam kum tampi ading hi a, a thu genkholte uzong hun sawtpi ading ahi hi,” ci uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate kungah, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Ka thugen khat zong a kihehsah nawn sih ding a, ka thugente a tangtung ding hi, Topa Pasien in ei ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Kamsang Zuoute Kimawsah"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel kamsangte langkhatah thu phuong in; amau’ ngaisutna banga thuphuon mawh gente kungah tam bangin gen in: “ Topa’ thugen ngai un!” ci in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: Bangma mu kei lopi amau’ lungsim banga a mot gamtat kamsangte in gimna a thuoh ding uhi!"},"4":{"text":"Israel aw, na kamsangte uh pen inn kisie lahah a om si-alte a bang sieng ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ ni-a gal kisimna-ah Israel innkuonte in a nan zawh nadingun, amate adingin kulpi vangte ah na kato sih vua, kul zong na bawlpha sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in zuou mang mu-in zuou ai a san vua, Topa in a sawl lo vangin, “ Topa in gen hi,” ci-in a thugente uh a tangtung ding bang kehin a ngah kenkon uhi!"},"7":{"text":"Note in ka gen khah lo mawh vangin, “ Topa in gen hi,” na ci ciengun zuou mang mu-in zuou aisan hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: A manlo-a na thugente ule na zuou mangmunate uh ziehin note kang langpang hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka khut in mangmuna zuou a mu le aisanna zuou a gen kamsangte ka langpang ding hi; ka mite thu vaihawmna-ah amate kihal lo ding a, Israel innkuon laibu sungah zong a min uh kikhum loin, Israel gamah a lut thei sih ding uhi; tuale note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"A tahtahin kilemna om lopi amate in, “Kilemna om hi,” ci-in ka mite a puikhiel uhi; azieh pen mipi in kulpi a cien ciengun tam kamsangte in a tungah leikang a zutpieh uhi.","ref":"Jer 6:14; 8:11"},"11":{"text":"A tunga leikang zutte kungah kulbang cim ding hi, ci-in gen in. Um le beela buoh bangin guo ang zu ding a, gielpite ang kie-in huipi in a mutmang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kulpi a cip ciengin, “A tunga na zut uh leikangte hei-ah a om sieng ta e?” ang kici lo ding amah?"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Ka thangpaina tawh huipi ka langsah ding a, ka lungthahna ziehin guopi zusahin ka thangpaina ziehin gielpi in tua kulpi ka susiesah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A khuombul a daw sieng nadingin note in leikang tawh na zut uh tua kulpi tuolah ka matsah ding hi; tua kul ang cip ciengin a sungah na sigam ding uhi; tuale note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ta ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua bangin kulpi tung le leikang zutte tungah ka thangpaina ka tungsah ding hi; tuale keima in amate kungah kulpi om nawn lo a, a zutte zong om nawn lo hi, ka ci ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Jerusalem tawh kisai thu phuongin kilemna om lopi kilemna om hi, ci-a mang a mu Israel kamsangte om nawn lo hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing aw, nang na hi leh amau’ ngaisutna banga thu a phuong na mite’ tanute lam nga in; amate langkhatah thu phuong inlen"},"18":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi, ci in: Mihingte’ hinna a mat nadingun a khuttawng vua a bul ding uh dawi-ai a khuipieh, mihingte zosie’ lutunga a khip ding uh lukhu a bawlpieh numeite in gimna a thuoh ding uhi! Note in ka mite’ hinna thapiehin noma’ hinna hu ding na hi uh amah?"},"19":{"text":"Zuouthu a um ka mite, mangbuham le moh themkhat nga thei nadingin na zuouthu utawh a si lawm lote sisahin a hing lawm lote na hinsah ziehun note in ka mite lahah nei minsiesah uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Na mihingte matna uh ahi na dawi-aite uh ka langpang hi; na ban panun tuate ka botsat ding a, vasa banga na mat uh mihingte ka suohtasah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na lukhu khuite uzong ka botkeh ding a, na khut sung panun ka mite ka hundam ding hi; note’ khut sungah gamsa kiman bangin amate a om nawn sih ding uhi; tuale keima Topa ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in amate ka lungkiehsah sih vangin note in a manlopi-in mi dihte na lungkiesah vua, migilote a gitlo gamtatna panun kihei loin a hinna uh a hutdam lo nadingun na hantawh zawsop uhi;"},"23":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin note in mangmuna zuou na mu nawn sih ding vua, aisanna zong na bawl nawn sih ding uhi; keima in na khut sung panun ka mite ka hundam ding hi. Tua ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima kungah Israel upa pawlkhat ang pei-in ka mai-ah ang to uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Thukhenna a Manna Kigen"},"2":{"text":"Tuale Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:"},"3":{"text":"Mihing aw, tam mite in a lungsim sung vuah a milimte a bie ta vua, a kipal nadingun a masang vuah amau’ khielna a koi uhi; amate thu ka kimopsah talawm ding amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nang in amate hopi inlen, Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi, ci-in amate kungah gen in: A lungsim vuah milimte bie-in a mai vuah a kipalpua nadingun amau’ khielna a koi vua, ahi vangin a milim honpite utawh kamsangpa kunga ang pei Israel innkuonte lahah a koimapo keima Topa in ka dawng ding a,"},"5":{"text":"a milimte uh ziehin kei tawh a kigamla Israel innkuonte’ lungsim a unpi-in ka mat zawh nadingin ka bawl ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi, ci-in Israel innkuonte tungah gen in: Kisia unlen, na milimte ule na sil kidahhuoi zosie uh hing nua ngat unlen hing kihei un."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel-te ahi sihle Israel-te lahah a teng pemta khatpo kei tawh a kikhenkhiet nop a, a lungtang ah a milimte bie-in a mai-ah kipal nading gitlona a koi a, tuaci’n kei thu dong dinga kamsangpa kunga a pei leh, Topa ahi kei mama in amate ka dawng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate ka lang-et ding a, lim le thu gentena-in bawlin ka mite lah panin amate ka hemkhie ding hi; tuale keima Topa ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kamsang khat kisolin zuouthu kamteng khat a gen leh keima Topa in tua kamsangpa ka na solsa ahi a, keima in ama langkhatah ka khut zahin ka mi Israel-te lah panin ama ka susie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale amate tunga dan kipiehna amate ma in a thuoh ding vua, thudong pa’ dan thuohna le kamsangpa’ dan thuohna kibang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka kung panin Israel innkuonte a vahmang nawn sih ding vua, a khielna vannuoi utawh amau le amau a kibuasah nawn sih ding uhi. Tua ciengin amate keima’ mi ahi ding vua, keima amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:"},"13":{"text":"Mihing aw, gam khat in keima langkhatah thuman lo tahin ka tungah mawna ang bawl ciengin keima in ama langkhatah ka khut ka zah a, tuale a an pienna uh sutanin a tung vuah kielpi tungsahin tua gam panin mihing le ganhing ka thatgam a,"},"14":{"text":"amate sungah Noah, Daniel, le Jacob tam mihing thumte nangawn om nan uleh amau’ dihna tawh amau’ hinna beh a hu zo ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Gamkhing a suo nadingin gamsung tengah a susie ding gamsate hla leng, gamsate ziehin tua gam nawhin koima a pei sih ding hi;"},"16":{"text":"keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin, tam mihing thumte nangawn tua gamah a om bang uh hileh zong, amate in a tanute ule a tapate uh a hundam zo tuon sih ding uhi; amate beh a kihundam zo ding vua, ahi vangin khum gam pen koima ten lona gamkhing suoh veve ding hi, ci-in a hing zing Topa Pasien ka kiciem hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi sihle keima in tua gam sungah namsau sawlin, “Gam sung tengah namsau pei kawikawi heh,” ci-in tua gam sung panin mihingte le ganhingte ka suhmang leh;"},"18":{"text":"keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin tam mihing thumte tua gam sungah om zong nan uleh amate in a tanute le a tapate uh a hun zo tuom sih ding vua, hizongle amate beh ma a kihundam zo ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi sihle tua gam sungah pul natna tungsahin ka thangpai ziehin amate tungah sisan luongsahin, tua gam sung panin mihing le ganhingte sumaimangin,"},"20":{"text":"keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin Noah, Daniel le Job-te a sungah a om uh hinan lezong, a tanute le a tapate uh a hundam zo tuom sih ding vua, amau’ dihna tawh amau’ hinna beh ma a hundam zo beh ding uhi, ci-in a hing zing Topa Pasien ka kiciem hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in mihing te le ganhingte a sumaimang dingin Jerusalem tungah a zauhuoi thukhen nasepna nam lite ahi namsau, kielpi, gamsate, le pulnatna ka tunsah ciengin tua sangin hamsa zaw lai ding hi!","ref":"Kln 6:8"},"22":{"text":"Hizongle tanute le tapate peipi dingin a suohta pawlkhat tua khuo sungah kinuasie ding hi; na kung vuah amate ang pei ding uhi. Amau’ gamtat luheh na mu ciengin Jerusalem tunga a sie ka tunsah zosie ziehin na lung a dam mai ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amau’ gamtat luheh na mu ciengin amate in nang ang henem ding uhi; tuale nangma in khuopi sunga ka sil bawl zosie a mawhna ka bawl ahi lo lam na thei ding hi, Topa Pasien in ei ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Kimanna Nei lo Lenggui"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, gammang singte lahah lenggui ba le lenggui sing in sing dangte zosie bang a ci phah zo ding ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Bang khat popo bawl nadingin a sing a kila ngai amah? Mi khat in vankhaina-a zah ding singzum khet dingin a la uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tua pen meitawna dinga kikoi ahi a, mei in a mong tuoh a kahvam ciengin a laikim meihol a suoh hi. Tua khu bangin a kimang ahei?"},"5":{"text":"A kah masangin zong bangma-in a kizang thei sih hi; mei in katum a, meihol a suo ciengin a zahna bangza-in tawmzaw lai ding a, banga kimang thei bep ding ahei!"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Meitawna sing dinga ka pieh gammang singkungte lahah lenggui singte bangin, Jerusalem-a tengte zong tuaci’n ka pie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in amate ka lang-et ding hi; meikuong panin suohta nan ule mei in a katum veve ding uhi; tuale amate ka lang-et ciengin keima Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Muonhuoi lo tahin amate a gamtat ziehun, tua gam koima’ ten lona gamkhing ka suohsah ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"A Muonhuoi lo Pasien’ Monu"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Jerusalem tungah a mudahuoi a gamtatna teng theisah inlen,"},"3":{"text":"tuale Topa Pasien in Jerusalem tungah tam bangin gen hi, ci-in: Na kipatna le na pienna Canaan-te’ gam ahi hi; na pa Amor-te ahi a, na nu Hit-te ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na piendan ahile na suo ni-in na laigui ki-attan loin tui tawh ang kisil sieng sih a, ci tawh zong ang kizut loin puon tawh zong ang kitun sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Koima’ mit in ang khuotuo sih a, lainatna tam teng ang bawlpieh ding koima a om sih hi; ahi vangin gamlaha ang kipaithang hi, azieh pen na suo ni panin mite in ang nang ang kidah hi."},"6":{"text":"Na kungah kang suoh kha a, sisan naisan lahah na kipehpeh kang mu hi. Sisan naisan lahah na kipawi kang mu ziehin na kungah, “Hing in!"},"7":{"text":"Lozau-a sing bangin khang in ,” kang ci leh nangma nang khanglien a, na tun ang sangin ngahnu picing khat nang hi ta hi; na nawite ang baw a, na mul zong ang po ta hi; hinanle puon sil loin na guoh tangin na om hi."},"8":{"text":"Na kungah hing suohkia-in nang ma kang en hi; zawl dei-in lawm ngai na cing ta hi. Keima in ka puon mong zahin na zumsel teng kang khupieh hi. Keima in nangma kang kamciem a, nangma tawh thuciemna khat bawlin, tuale nang pen keima-a’ na hi ta hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kang pumsil a, na tunga a baang site sawp siengin sathau kang nu hi."},"10":{"text":"A kiphan puon hoite kang silsah a, savun hoi tawh a kibawl kedap kang bunsah hi; pat puon hoite tawh kang khu a, puon kigan hoite tawh kang tuom hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in kizepna manphate tawh nang kang zem hi: na banah tau hing bunsah a, na ngawngah khi kang awsah hi,"},"12":{"text":"na nahkuo-ah nahba kang vawpieh a, na bil ah bilbate hing basahin na lu ah a etlawm kumpi lukhu kang khusah hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngun le kham tawh ang kizem a, na puonsilte pat puon hoite, puon kigan hoite le puon kiphan hoite vive ahi hi. Na neh ding zong annel tuipen, khuoizu le sathau ahi hi. Na mel ang hoi mama a, kumpinu dingin zong nang kilawm ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Na mel hoina ziehin minam cinteng lahah na minthanna a kizel hi, azieh pen nangma tunga kang pieh keima’ thupina in na mel hoina a bukimsah hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang in na mel hoina na muong a, na minthanna ziehin numei pahtat bangin na om ta hi. Na kunga ang vahle khat popo tawh kiphaltahin na lumton hi."},"16":{"text":"Na puon pawlkhat na ladawh a, nangma adingin a hoi mama biehbuhnote bawlin tuate tungah khatvei zong a pieng ngai nai lo mai lamah zong a pieng ngai nawn lo ding ahi pahtatna na gamta hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma kang piehsa ka ngun le ka kham tawh a kibawl kizepnate la-in, nangma adingin pasal limin na bawl a, tuate tawh na lumton hi;"},"18":{"text":"tuate khu nadingin a kiphan na puonte na la a, a mai vuah ka sathau le ka gimnamtuite na koi hi."},"19":{"text":"Na an dinga kang pieh- annel tuipen, sathau le khuoizute zong - tuate mai-ah gimnamtui biehna-in na lui hi; tua bang dan teng ahi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima tawh na hinsa na tanute le na tapate na ladawh a, tua milimte nehtum dingin kithoina-in tuate na nei hi. Na pahtatnate kicing sa nai lo bangin na om hi!"},"21":{"text":"Ka tate na that a, amate tungah biehna dingin na pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale a mudahuoi na gamtatna zosie le na pahtatnate ziehin, na neu lai-a na sisan lahah na kipawina le puon sil loin na guohtanga na op lai na phawh kha nawn sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Na gitlona zosie teng zaw ciengin (gimna, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Topa Pasien in ci a,)"},"24":{"text":"nangma adingin dawsang khat na lam a, mun-awng cintengah nangma adingin bosang khat na bawl hi;"},"25":{"text":"lamkabawm cintengah munsang lamin na mel hoina pahtatna-in na nei a, mi vahle zosie tungah na pumpi pie-in na pahtatna na khangsah semsem hi."},"26":{"text":"A huasan na innveng Egypt-te tawh na pahtat a, na pahtatna na khansah semsem ziehin kei nei lungthahsah hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nangma langkhatah ka khut zahin na an satanh ka khiem ding a, na thanghuoi gamtatna ang zumpi Philistia-te’ tanute ahi na galte’ dei bang bangin kang piedawh ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Na lungkim zo nai lo ziehin Assyria-te tawh zong na pahtat hi; amate tawh na pahtat a, na lungkim nai tuom sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Sumbawl Chaldea-te tawh tamveipi na pahtat a, tuate nangawn tawh zong na lungkim nai vaset sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Zum zie thei lo-a na pahtatnate ziehin tam teng zosiepi na bawl khu na lungsim gina maw sam e izaw, Topa Pasien in ci hi;"},"31":{"text":"lamkabawm cintengah na dawsang na lam a, mun-awng cintengah na bosang ding na bawl hi! Hinanle numei pahtat tawh na kibang sih hi, azieh pen nang in pahtat man sum na sang sih hi."},"32":{"text":"A pasal tanga khuolmite lamdawn numei angkawm nu!"},"33":{"text":"Numei pahtatte zosie tungah letsongte kipie hi; hinanle na kingaipi mi zosie tungah na letsongte na pie a, na luppi dingin mun cinteng panin amate ang pei nadingun guhgol na pie zawsop hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaci’n na pahtat dante numei dangte tawh na kibang sih hi: Koima in a pahtat dingin ang zawl sih a, sum tawh zong ang kiguoi loin nangma in sum na lepieh hi; nang pen mi tuompi khat na hi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mi pahtat nu aw, Topa’ thugen ngai in:"},"36":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Na huasan seng ziehin na kingaipite tawh lumtonin guohtanga na opna puon na khu lo zieh le, a mudahuoi na milim zosie le amate tunga na pieh na tate’ sisan ziehin,"},"37":{"text":"keima in na kingai-a na nopsahpi zosie, na itte le na mudate zosie a unpi-in ka kaikhawm ding hi; nangma ang do dingin na kimvel panin amate kaikhawmin, a mai vuah na puonte kang suopieh ding a, tuaci’n na guohtanga na opna amate in ang mu ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Keima in numei angkawmte le tuol thatte bangin thu kang khen ding a, nangma tungah thangpaina le thangsietna sisan ka tungsah ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Amau’ khut sungah kang pie ding a, amate in dawsang phelkhe-in na bosangte a susie ding uhi; amate in na puonsil hing sutpiehin na van hoite ang lahpieh ding vua, puon sil loin na guohtangin ang nuasie ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Amate in note do dingin mi honpi hing zawpi-in suong tawh ang sep ding vua, namsau tawh ang semnen ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Na innte mei tawh halin numei tampi’ mitmu-in na tungah thu a khen ding uhi; keima in na pahtatna kang tawpsah ding a, sum tawh mi na guoi nawn sih ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in na tungah ka sinsona ka damsah ding a, ka thangsietna na kung panin a kihei ding hi; ham loin ka om ta ding a, ka lungthah nawn sih ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Na neu lai hunte na phaw nawn lo ziehin tam bang zosie teng tawh kei nei lungthahsah hi; tua ahi ziehin na gamtatna teng kang lukhuhsahkia hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi. A mudahuoi na gamtatnate banah a thanghuoi-in gamta hi lo na mah?"},"44":{"text":"En in, paunah zang mi zosie in nang tungtang ah “A tanu in a nu sun,” ci paunah a zang ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"A pasal le a tate a muda nu’ tanu na hi a, a pasalte ule a tate a muda sanggam numeite’ sanggam nu na hi hi; na nu Hit-te ahi a, na pa Amor-te ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Na unu pen Samaria ahi a, na opna leilu lamah a tanute tawh a teng hi; tuale na naunu pen Sodom ahi a, na opna leitaw lamah a tanute tawh a teng hi."},"47":{"text":"Amau’ opdan bang beh na zui sih a, amau’ gamtat mudahuoite bangin na gamta hi; bakhat sungin na opdan zosie vuah amate sangin na gamtat siezaw hi."},"48":{"text":"Nang le na tanute bawl bangin na sanggam nu Sodom le a tanute in a bawl sih uhi, keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Na sanggam nu Sodom’ khielna tami ahi hi: Ama le a tanute a kiphasah vua, amate in an khamval nei-in nuomsa tahin a om uhi, ahi vangin mizawng le mi cimawte a panpi sih uhi."},"50":{"text":"Amate a kihisah mama vua, ka mai-ah a mudahuoi nate a bawl uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate ka mu ciengin ka hemkhie hi."},"51":{"text":"Samaria in nang mawna alang zong a bawl sih hi; nang in amate sangin sil mudahuoite na bawlzaw a, tua na sil mudahuoi bawl teng zosie in na sanggam numeite midih danin kimusah hi."},"52":{"text":"Nang in zong na sanggam numeite a dih bangsah na hi ziehin mindaina kithuoh ta’n; amate sangin a mudahuoi zaw-in na gamtat ziehin nang sangin amate a dih tazaw uhi. Tuaci’n nang zong maizum inlen, na mindaina kipuoh in, azieh pen nangma in na sanggam numeite a dih danin na kimusah hi."},"53":{"text":"Zakona na thuohzawh nading le na sepsa zosie tungah maizumin amate adingin henepna na hi nadingin keima in Sodom le a tanute, Samaria le a tanute vangphatna ka piekia ding a, amau-a’ bangin nang zong vangphatna kang piekia ding hi.","merge":"54"},"55":{"text":"Na sanggam numeite, Sodom le a tanute ahi ule a op ngai bangun a omkia ding vua, nangma le na tanute zong na op ngai bangun na omkia ding uhi."},"56":{"text":"Na gitlona ang kipholah masang, na kiphatsah hun lai-in na sanggam nu Sodom na kam tawh thusie gentena-in nei hi lo na mah? Tu-in nang pen Aram’ tanute le a innveng zosie ule Philistia-te’ tanute, le na kimvela a om ang muda mi zosie’ simmaw ehnehin na om ta hi.","merge":"57"},"58":{"text":"Na thangtatna le na mudahuoi gamtatna teng ziehin gawtna na thuoh kul hi, Topa in ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Ahi hi, Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Kiciemna thuse loin thuciemna palsat zo na hi ziehin na gamtat bangin na tungah ka gamta ding hi;","title":"Kumtawn ading Thuciemna"},"60":{"text":"hinanle na neu lai-a nang tawh i thuciemna ka ciemte ding a, nang tawh kumtawn adingin thuciemna ka bawl ding hi."},"61":{"text":"Tua ciengin na gamtat dante nang phawhkia ding a, nangma tawh ka bawl keima’ thuciem zieh hi loin, keima in na sanggam numeite, na unu le na nau nu a nipi-in ladawhin na tanute ahi dingin na kungah kang pieh hun ciengin na mai a zum ding hi."},"62":{"text":"Nangma tawh thuciemna ka bawl ding a, nangma in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding hi."},"63":{"text":"Na sil bawl zosie kang ngaidam ciengin na gamtatnasate na phawh ding a, ci nading mel thei loin omin na mai a zum sengin na kam na kehkia ngai nawn sih ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Muvanlai Nite le Lenggui"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel innkuonte tungah thu hahsa khat phuong inlen, thugentena khat gen in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangci hi, ci-in gen in: A hla a gol dedu, a hlakui a sau petput, a mul zong a pawl bielbuol muvanlai golpi khat, Lebanon ah va tu ta hi. Ama in taamtah dawn khat taw-in,"},"4":{"text":"a dawnngeh khat hliehtawng hi. Sum bawlna gamah puo a, sumbawlte’ khuopi khat sungah va koi ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua gam panin khaici la-in tua khaici leihoina-ah a koi hi; ama in gielheh bameng bangin tui tamna munah singkung khat a suon hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum singkung ang khanglienin lenggui bazam niem khat ang suoh hi; a bate ama lam nga-in zamsuh a, a zungte a opna-ah om den hi. Tuaci’n lenggui khat ang suoh hi; a bate ang mengin a nate ang om hi."},"7":{"text":"A pum a gol, a hla a gol le a mul a pha mama muvanlai adang khat ang om hi. Tuale en vawi! Ama zieha tui a nga thei nadingin, ama lamah zunghla-in a bate a zamsah hi;"},"8":{"text":"A ba tampi mengin a gate ga a, lenggui hoi khat a suo nadingin, tui nienna mun leihoina ah lenggui kisuon phakia hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Tua lenggui a khang zo ding amah? A gawptum nadingin phungbaw-in, muvanlai in a gate muotsahin gawptumsah ding a, a bameng thate zong vulsah lo ding amah? Tua lenggui phungbaw nadingin mi banhat ahi sihle galkap thahat kisam lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A kisuon phat ciengin a hing zo ding amah? Nisuolam huipi in ang mut gawp ciengin a unpi-in vulnang gawpin, a pona le ang khandawhna ah vulnang gawp lo ding amah?"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in a ledo innkuonte kungah gen in: Tamte bang a cina ahei ci na thei sih uh amah? Amate kungah gen in: Babylon kumpipa Jerusalem ah ang pei-in, a kumpipa le a kumpi uliente manin, Babylon-a ama kungah a peipikia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in kumpi’ suonlehlahte khat zawpi a, ama tawh thuciemna khat bawlin a kiciemsah hi. (ama in gamsung uliente a kaimang sieng hi.)"},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n a kumpi gam kikhesuhin ama thu-in pongzo nawn lo a, tua khu ama’ thuciemna zuina tawh a hin zawh nading uh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in sakolte le galkap tampite a pieh thei nadingin Egypt gamah palai sawlin ama a ledo hi. Ama a lawcing diei mah? Tua banga a sem mi pa a suohta zo diei mah? Thuciemna palsat napi suohta veve ding amah?","ref":"2Kum 24:15-20; 2Khg 36:10-13"},"16":{"text":"Keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin ama kumpi suohsah a, a kiciemna thusim loin, kumpipa tenna munah ama tawh a bawl thuciemna a palsat pa opna Babylon ah ama a si valon ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Mitampi’ hinna a kisuhmang nadingin phung kiciengin kulpi a kibawl ciengin a thahat Pharaoh’ galkapte le mihonpite in gal sungah ama a huzo sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen ama ciempelin thuciemna palsat a, a khut hlangin tam teng zosie sem ahi ziehin suohta vawt lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin, a thuse lo ka kiciemna le a palsat ka thuciemna ama ka lukhuhsah valon ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima in ama tungah ka ngenthang ka khu ding a, ka thangah ama a awh ding hi; Babylon ah ama ka zawpi ding a, khum munah keima ei langpan ziehin ama tawh thukhenna ah ka lut ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A kiteel a galkap zosie namsau tawh a si ding vua, a suohta sun teng zong muncin tengah a kithethang ding uhi; tuale note in keima Topa in ka gensate na thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in taamtah sangpi panin a dawnngeh khat ka la ding hi; keima in tua khu ka suon ding hi. Keima in a dawnsang panin a ngumngeh khat ka hlieh ding hi; keimama in muolsang dawn khatah ka suon ding hi.","title":"A Tawpna-ah Israel Kitawisang"},"23":{"text":"Ang bazamin a gate ang ga a, taamtah picing khat ang suo thei nadingin, Israel muolsang dawnah ka suon ding hi. Tua sing nei-ah va namcin a om ding uhi; a ba hlim nei-ah va namcinte in bu a tom ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Gamlahah a po singkung zosie in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi. Keima in sing sangte niemsahin a niemte ka sangsah hi; a na hingte ka gawsah a, a gawte ka hingsah hi. Keima Topa in ka gensa ahi a, ka muolsuo ding hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Mimal Mawpuohna"},"2":{"text":"“Nu le pate lengga thua neh, a tate ha a za hi,” ci-in Israel gam tawh kisai-in tami paunah na gengen pen uh bang na cinopna uh ahei?”","ref":"Jer 31:29"},"3":{"text":"Keima a nungta ka hi ma bangin, Israel gamah tami paunah na zang ngai nawn poma sih ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinna zosie keima-’a hi, ci thei in; a pa’ hinna bangma in a ta’ hinna zong keima-a’ ahi hi: a maw mipa beh si ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khat a dih a, thuman le thutang tawh a gamtat a,"},"6":{"text":"muol tung tengah an ne loin ahi sihle Israel innkuonte’ milimte enin a khuoda sih a, a vengpa’ zi suthang loin ahi sihle numei khat a nin nei laitahin a va luppi sih a,"},"7":{"text":"mi koima khat zong gawt loin leibate kungah a vankhapte uh a piehkia a, mi suom loin a gilkielte an a pieh a, puon nei lote puon se-in"},"8":{"text":"khamkholna sum a lah sih a, ahi sihle a met dingin sum leitawi pie loin khielna bawlna panin a khut a tuhzo a, thu kitu mite kikalah thumanin vaihawmin"},"9":{"text":"ka thukhamte a zui a, ka ngaina kipte limtahin tangin muonhuoi tahin a gamtat leh, tua bang mi pen midih ahi hi; ama pen a hing valon ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Siem 18:5"},"10":{"text":"Ama in a ngongtat, sisansuo tapa khat nei-in"},"11":{"text":"tam teng khat penpen a bawl a, (a pa in tuate khat beh a sep lo vangin) muoltung tengah an ne-in a vengpa’ zi a suhthang a,"},"12":{"text":"mizawng le mi tasamte gawtin mi suom a, vankhapte piekia loin milimte enin a khuoda a, mudahuoi-in gamta-in,"},"13":{"text":"khamkholna sum a lah a, a met dingin sum a leitawisah leh, ama a hing ding amah? A hing sih ding hi. Ama in tam sil mudahuoi zosie a bawl zo ta hi; ama pen si valon ding a, a sisan ama luzang ma-ah tu ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam mipa in a pa bawl khielna zosie a mu tapa khat nei-in, ang lungngai-in tua bang ma-in ang bawl sih a,"},"15":{"text":"muoltung tengah an ne loin ahi sihle Israel innkuon’ milimte enin a khuoda sih a, a vengpa’ zi zong suthang loin"},"16":{"text":"koima tungah khielna a bawl sih a, vankhap la loin mi suom lo a, ahi vangin gilkielte an pie-in puon nei lote puon tawh a hui a,"},"17":{"text":"khielna panin a khut tuzo-in khamkholna van a lah sih a, ahi sihle a met dingin sum leitawi pie loin ka thuciem kipte a tan a, ka thukhamte a zui leh, a pa’ mawna ziehin ama si lo ding a, a hing valon ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A pa ahile mi neisa paulah piehin, a sanggampa suom a, a mite lahah sil hoi lo a bawl ziehin ama in a khielna a silaw ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanle nang in, “A pa khielna ziehin bang dingin a tapa in gimna thuoh lo ahei?” na ci hi. Thuman le thutahin a tapa gamta-in, ka thukham zosie pilvang tahin a zui ciengin ama pen a hing valon ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A maw mipa a si ding hi. Nu le pa’ khielna a tapa in silaw lo ding a, a tapa’ khielna zong nu le pa in silaw lo ding hi; midih pa’ dihtatna pen ama-a’ hi ding a, migilo pa’ gitlona zong ama-a’ ma hi ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin migilote in a mawna bawl zosie uh panin ang kihei-in, ka thukhamte ang zui vua, thuman thutangin ang gamtat uleh, amate a hing valon ding uhi; amate a si vawt sih ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amau’ suhkhiel teng khat mama zong kiciemte nawn lo ding hi; amau’ bawl dihtatna ziehin amate a hing ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Migilote sina ziehin ka lungdam sangin a gamtat hoi lona panun ang kihei-in hinna a nei na vuah lungdamzaw lo ding ka mah? Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi dihte in a dihtatna panun ang piel vua, khielna bawlin migilote bang ma-in sil mudahuoite ang bawl uh ciengin, amate a hing thei ding uh amah? Amau’ dihtatna zosie khat zong a kiphawpieh sih ding hi; azieh pen a thuman lo ziehun maw a tanna ule a bawlsa uh mawnate ziehin amate a si ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanle note in, “ Topa silbawl zie a dih sih hi,” na ci uhi. Israel innkuonte aw, za un: Ka sil bawlzie a dih sih amah? A dih lo pen noma’ silbawl hizaw lo amah?"},"26":{"text":"Midihte in a amau’ dihtatna pan kihei-in khielna a bawl ciengin tua ziehin amate a si ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Migilote a gitlona panun kihei-in thuman thutangin a gamtat ciengun, amate in amau’ hinna a hundam ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate ang lungngai-in a bawlsa uh khielnate panin ang kiheikia ziehun amate a hing valon ding vua, a si sih ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanle Israel innkuonte in, “ Topa silbawl zie a dih sih hi,” a ci uhi. Israel innkuonte aw, ka silbawl zie a dih lo ma amah? A dih lo pen noma’ silbawlte hizaw lo amah?"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, Israel innkuonte aw, na unpi-un na gamtatna utawh kizui-in na tung vuah thu kang khen ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi. Kisia unlen na khielna zosie uh panin hing kinuale un; tua ahi sihle khielna ziehin na kisietlaw ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Keima nei dona vua sil suhkhiel na nei zosie uh a unpi-in paimang unlen, lungsim tha le lungtang tha puo un! No Israel innkuonte aw, bang zieha si ding na hi uh ahei?"},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen koima a si ding ka nuom sih hi, hing kilekia unlen hing un, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma na hile Israel uliente adingin","title":"Israel’ Vang Kiem"},"2":{"text":"kaateng lo in: Humpite lahah humpi pi khu na nu ahi mawh veleh!
