Humpite lahah kuolin ama in a note a kem hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a note lahah khat a va khang hi; ama humpi khanglai khat suoh a, tuale ama in sa mat dan ding a sin hi; ama in misa ang ne hi."},"4":{"text":"Minamte in ama do dingin patauna aw a gingsah uhi; amau’ dum sungah ama a awh hi. tuale amate in siakawi tawh kai-in Egypt gamah a tunpi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua nu in a dong hi ta’ng ci mu-in, a kinepna a bei lam a thei bepin, a no dang khat la leuleu a, humpi khanglai khat suohsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama pen humpi khanglai khat ang suoh ta a, tuale humpite lahah ama a vah kawikawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a mun muonhuoite uh balkehin a khuopite uh ten lona a suohsah hi; a hawh vapuoh ziehin a gam le a gam sunga omte a unpi-un a citun uhi."},"8":{"text":"A kimvel mun tuomtuom panin ama do dingin mi namcin ang kuon uhi; amate in a tungah ngenthang a khu uhi; amau’ dum sungah ama kiman hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in siakawi tawh a kai vua, bawng sung khatah khumin, Babylon kumpipa kungah ama a peipi uhi; Israel muoltung tengah a hawh a kizah nawn lo nadingin amate in thong sungah ama khum uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na nu, lui gei-a kisuon tha lengga um sunga lenggui bang a, tui kicinna gamah a ba tampi zamin ga tampitah ga hi."},"11":{"text":"A kung khau pen gam uhpa’ ciengkhutin a kizang a, a bazam tampite lahah ama a kitungto zehzawh a, a bazam teng tawh a san peupo ziehin a kidawh velvol hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin lungsona ziehin kibotdawh a, tuolah kipai hi; nisuona lam hui in ama semgaw hi; a gate kizutheu sieng hi. A kung khau pen gawpdawh a, mei in a katum dawh ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in gamgaw lah le tui tawmna gammang lahah a kisuontha kia hi."},"14":{"text":"A kung panin mei in kato a, a bate le a gate katum sieng hi, tuaci’n a kung khau om lo a, gam uhna ding ciengkhut om lo hi. Tam pen kaala khat ahi a, kaala-a kizang khat ahi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sagi a cinna, a hla ngana, a ni sawm ni-in Topa thu dong dingin Israel makai pawlkhat hing pei-in ka mai-ah ang to uhi.","title":"Israel-te’ Ledo Zingna"},"2":{"text":"Tuale keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung hi:"},"3":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel upate hopi inlen amate kungah, “ Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Bang dinga hing pei na hi uh ahei? Thu ei dong ding na hi uh amah? Keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, note thudawhin ka om sih ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate tungah thu khen ding na mah? Mihing aw, amate tungah thu khen ding na mah? Tua ciengin a pu a pate uh’ na bawlsa sil mudahuoite amate theisah inlen,"},"5":{"text":"amate tungah tam bangin gen in: Israel ka teel ni-in, Jacob innkuon’ suonlehlahte tungah kiciemin Egypt gam sunga a om amate ka kitheisah a, amate tungah keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi, ci-in ka kiciem hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni-in Egypt gam panin amate peipi-in, amate dinga ka suipiehsa khuoizu le bawngnawi luonna gam, gam zosie lahah a hoipen munah amate tunpi dingin ka kiciem hi.","ref":"Pei 6:2-8"},"7":{"text":"Tuale amate kungah ka genna-ah, mit hla vawt loin na et uh sil kidahhuoite paidawh unlen, Egypt milimte tawh noma le noma kibuasah sih un; keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi, ka ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in kei ei ledo-in ka thu a ngai sih uhi; mit tuhna a nei uh sil kidahhuoite amate in paai tuon loin Egypt milimte zong a nuasie sih uhi. Tua ciengin ka thangpaina amate tungah buosuhin, amate dona-in ka lungthahna teng Egypt gamah tungsah vang, ci-in ka ngaisun hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin amau’ tenpi minamte mai-ah ka min a kigensiet lo nadingin ka min ka khuolna tawh na ka sem a, amate muna-ah kei mama kipholahin Egypt gam panin amate ka peipi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Egypt panin amate ka pui a, gamlah ka tunpi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka thukhamte amate pie-in, ka ngaina kipte ka lah a, tua teng a zui poma a hing ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua banah keima le amate kikalah lim khat ahi dingin ka sabbath-te zong amate ka pie hi.","ref":"Pei 31:13-17"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel innkuonte in gamlahah kei ei ledo uhi; a zui tapo a hin nading uh ahi ka thukhamte amate in zui loin ka ngaina kipte a nuol uhi; amate in ka sabbath-te a buasah gawp uhi. Tua ciengin gamlahah amate ka thagam nadingin a tung vuah ka lungthahna tungsah vang, ci-in ka ngaisun hi.","ref":"Siem 18:5"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate ka peikhietpi ei mu minamte mai-ah ka min a kigensiet lo nadingin ka min ka khuolna tawh amate bangma ka law sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua banah amate ka piehsa gam, khuoizu le bawngnawi luonna gam, gam zosie lahah a hoipen munah peipi nawn sih vang ci-in gamlah amate tungah ka kiciem hi.","ref":"Gam 14:26-35"},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in ka ngaina kipte nuolin ka thukhamte a zui sih vua, ka sabbath-te zong a buasah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle amate ka hepi a, keima in gamlahah amate susie loin, zong ka thatgam sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima in gamlahah a tate uh kung ah, “Na pu na pate uh’ thukhamte zui loin a ngaina kipte uh zong zui sih unlen, a milimte utawh noma le noma kibuasah sih un,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi; keima’ thukhamte zui unlen, ka ngaina kipte limtahin tang un."},"20":{"text":"tuale keima le note kikalah lim dingin ka sabbath-te siengthosah un, tuaci’n note in keima Topa na Pasien uh ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin a tate un keima ei ledo uhi; amate in ka thukhamte a zui sih vua, a zui tapo hinlaw nading ahi ka ngaina kipte limtahin tang loin ka sabbath-te a buasah uhi. Tua ciengin keima in amate tungah ka thangpaina sungsuhin, amate dona-in ka lungthahna teng gamlahah tungsah vang, ci-in ka ngaisun hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate ka peikhietpi ei mu minamte mai-ah ka min a kigensiet lo nadingin, ka min ka khuolna tawh ka khut ka nualahkia hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua banah gamcin teng le minam cinteng tungah amate ka thezah ding hi, ci-in gamlah amate tungah ka kiciem hi,","ref":"Siem 26:33"},"24":{"text":"azieh pen amate in ka ngaina kipte a zui sih vua, ka thukhamte nuolin ka sabbath-te a buasah vua, tuale a pu a pate uh’ milimte a mitsuon lenlon uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua tham loin keima in amate tungah thukham hoi lote le a hin zawh lo nading uh ngaina kipte ka pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei nading ule a cimul thaw thei nadingun a tapa tapen zosie utawh a pieh uh amau’ letsongte tungtawnin amate ka buasah hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mihing aw, Israel innkuonte hopi inlen amate kungah, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Tam sungah na pu na pate un kei tungah muonhuoi lo tahin a gam ta vua, ei gensiesie uhi."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen pieh dinga ka ciemsa gam sungah amate ka lutpi ciengin muolsang khatpo ahi sihle singna pha khatpo a mu uleh tua munah biehpiehnate a bawl vua, ei lungthahsah thei biehna a pie uhi; amate in khum munah gim namtuite a the vua, dawn thei biehnate zong a sung uhi."},"29":{"text":"(Keima in amate kungah, “Khum munsang na peina uh khu bang ahiei? ka ci hi. Tuaci’n tuni dongin khumi mun Bamah kici hi.)"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel innkuonte kungah, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in:"},"31":{"text":"Note in na letsongte uh pie-in na tapate uh mei-ah na hal uh ciengin, tuni dongin na milim zosie utawh no le no a kibuasah na hi uhi. Tuale Israel innkuonte aw, kei note’ thudawhin ka om ding amah? Keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, note’ thudawhin ka om sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Na lungsim sung vua na ngaisutnate uh tung ngai lo ding hi. Na ngaisutna vuah, “Minamte le gamtuom mite bangin eite in zong sing le suong bie vai,” na ci uhi."},"33":{"text":"Keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, note tungah a hat ka khut, a kizah ka banhat le a kisungsuh ka thangpaina tawh pel loin kumpi ka sem ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","title":"Pasien in Israel a Ngaingai Bangsahkia"},"34":{"text":"Keima in a hat khut, a kizah banhat, le a kisungsuh thangpaina tawh minamte le na kithethangna uh gamte panin note kang khawmtuo ding hi;"},"35":{"text":"tuale keima in gamlah mite kungah kang puoh ding a, tuale khum munah note tawh keima kimaituo-in thu kang khen ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Keima in Egypt gam sung senel gamah na pu na pate uh tungah thu ka khen bangin, note tungah zong thu kang khen ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka ciengkhut nei-ah kang peisah ding a, thuciemna khaukhina sungah kang peipi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Note lahah a ledo mite le ka tunga a khiel mite ka hemkhie ding hi; keima in pemta a hina uh gam panin amate ka peipi ding a, ahi vangin Israel gam sungah a lut sih ding uhi. Tua ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Note a koimapo in tu leh mailamah ka thu na ngai sih ding vua ahile pei-in na milimte’ na sem un; ahi vangin na letsongte ule na milimte utawh note in ka min siengtho na buasah nawn sih ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Azieh pen khum gam sunga ka muol siengtho tung, Israel muolsang dawnah Israel innkuon zosie in a unpi-un keima’ na a sem ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi; keima in khum sungah amate ka sang ding a, tuale na biehnate uh, na letsong hoi pente ule noma’ a siengtho nate zosie, khum munah kang ngen ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Na kithezahna uh gam tuomtuom panin hing kaikhawmin minamte lah panin kang lahdawh ciengin gimnamtui bangin kang sang ding a, note lahah minamte mai-ah ka sienthona kang kilangsah ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh tungah pieh dinga ka ciemsa gam ahi Israel gamah note kang tunpi ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Khum sungah ang buasah na om dante ule na gamtatna uh zosie na phawh ding vua, sil hoi lo na bawl zosie ziehun no le no na kikidah ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, na gitlona ule na gamtatnate uh dung zui-in ka min ka khuolna tawh note tungah kang bawl ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Negeb Do nading Kigenkhol"},"46":{"text":"Mihing aw, leitaw lam mai ngat inlen, leitaw lam le Negeb gama gammang lah langkhatah thu gen in."},"47":{"text":"Negeb gammang kungah, “ Topa’ thu ngai in: Na sungah mei ka hal ding a, na sunga sing hing zosie le sing gaw zosie a unpi-in katum ding hi; tua meikuong kiphel zo lo ding a, leilu le leitaw maitang zosie tua mei in a hulvam ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Mihing zosie in keima Topa’ hal ahi lam a mu ding vua, koima in a phel zo sih ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Ah Topa Pasien! Amate in, ‘Ama thu gentena bawlpa hi lo amah,’ ei ci uhi,” ka ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"A Kidawhsa Pasien’ Namsau"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Jerusalem lam nga inlen mun siengthote langkhatah thu gen in; Israel gam langkhatah thu phuong inlen,"},"3":{"text":"Israel gam tungah Topa in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Nangma langpang dingin kang pei hi, tuale keima in ka namsau a pai panin ka dawh ding a, nangma kung panin migilo le mi thumante a ni-in ka sumaimang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen midihte le migilote nang kung panin a ni-in a sumang ding ka hi a, tua ziehin leitaw lam panin leilu dongin mi zosie langkhatah a pai panin ka namsau ka dawh ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"tuale keima Topa in ka namsau a pai panin ka dawkhiet lam mi zosie in a thei ding vua, a pai-ah a kisietkia sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mihing aw, khuisa inlen amate musietin lungsim tamkham le lung gimin khuisa in."},"7":{"text":"Tuale amate in na kungah, “Bang dinga khuisa na hei?” ang ci ciengun nang in, “Ang tung thuthang zieh ahi hi. Lungtang zosie zungmangin khut zosie zaw ding a, hanna lungsim bei-in khup zosie tui suoh ding hi. En in, khum khu ang pei-in ang tung ding hi,” Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"9":{"text":"Mihing aw, thu va phuong ta’nlen, Topa in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Namsau khat, namsau khat kitat hiem a, tua namsau kizutmam hi;"},"10":{"text":"mi tha nadingin kitat hiem a, tunphe bangin a tee lihleh hi! Bangci bangin eite kipah thanuom thei ding i hei? Nang in ciengkhut le thuhilna zosie na thuse sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Khuta tawi thei dingin namsau khat kizutmam hi; mi thatpa’ khut sunga koi dingin tua namsau kitat hiemin kizutval hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing aw, tami khu ka mite dona dinga kibawl ahi ziehin kap inlen mau in; Israel gam uh zosie dona kibawl ahi hi; amate pen ka mite tawh namsau thuoh dingin amate a kipiehtha ahi ta hi. Ah! na phei beng in!"},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen ngai sun in: Bang ahiei! Ciengkhut na thuse sih leh tamte pieng loin om ding amah? Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Nang mihing aw, phuongzah in; na khut beng inlen tua namsau nivei ahiei, thumvei ahiei kiesuhsah in. Khum khu mi thana namsau ahi hi; mi tampi kithana namsau- amate a imtawm namsau ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin lungtangte zungmang a, mi tampitah a puamat uhi. Amau’ tunkot zosie ah namsau a hiem lam ka pangsah hi. Ah! mi tha nadingin kinawtval a, tunphe bangin teelihleh hi."},"16":{"text":"Na ziet na vei ah vatgawp in! A hiem lam ngatna popo ah vat in."},"17":{"text":"Ke’n zong ka khut ka beng ding a, ka thangpaina dam ding hi; keima Topa in ka genzo hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"19":{"text":"Mihing aw, Babylon kumpipa’ namsau ang pei nadingin lampi ni ciemte in; tua lampi nite gel pen gam khat pana ang pei ding ahi hi. Tuale khuopi zotna lamkabawm ah melci nading khuom khat phut in;"},"20":{"text":"Amor-te’ khuo Rabbah, ahi sihle kul tawh ki-im namsau ang pei nadingin Judah le Jerusalem ah lampi melci in."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen ai san dingin lampi ni kisuhtuona lamkabawm-ah Babylon kumpipa a ding hi; ama in a thaltangte a lawhlawh a, teraphim dawi thu dongin sa sin sa lung a vel hi."},"22":{"text":"Kulpi suhkeh nadinga phawhbulte bawl nading, mi tha nadinga thupieh nading, gal sim dinga a kiko nading, tunkot suhkeh nadinga phawhbul bawl nading, lei sunvum nading le khuopi imtawm nadinga tausangte daw nadingin, Jerusalem ading a khut ziet lamah ai sanna tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate adingin aisanna zuoupi tawh a kibang ding hi; amate in kiciemna thupitah a bawl uhi; ahi vangin amate sala a kimat nadingun a khielna uh a phawsahna ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Note in na khielna na kitheisah ziehun tua sungah noma’ khielnate kipholah a, tuaci’n na gamtatna zosie vuah na mawnate uh kilang hi, note in na mawna na thei ziehun mi khut sungah na tung ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"A khansie, a gilo Israel gam uh pa aw, dan piehna ni nukhia pen ang tung ta a,"},"26":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na dielkhip le na kumpi lukhu ladawh in; nate a om ngai bangin om den lo ding hi. a niemte tawisang inlen, a sangte niemsah in."},"27":{"text":"Ama tunga uhna ka pieh ding pa ang tun masangsie, a kisie, a kisie - ka kisiesah gawp ding hi! (tua bang pieng ngai lo hi.)"},"28":{"text":"Mihing aw, thu phuong inlen Ammon-te tawh kisai thu, le amate a kisimmawna thu tawh kisai-in Topa in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Namsau khat, namsau khat! Mi tha nadingin dawsa-in om a, vatmai nadingin tunphe bangin a tee lihleh dingin kinawtval hi."},"29":{"text":"A ni a hun ang tung a, a nukhia pen dan piehna a thuoh ding mi khansie, migilote’ ngawngah nang ang koi na dingun, nang adingin mangmuna zuou ang mupieh vua, aisanna zuou ang neipieh uhi."},"30":{"text":"Namsau a pai-ah sietkia un! Nang ang kipiensahna mun, na suona gam sungah keima in thu kang khen ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka lungthahna na tungah ka tungsah ding a, ka thangpaina mei bangin na tungah ka mut ding hi. Keima in mi tha dan a siem, migilote’ khut sungah nang kang pie ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Nang pen meitawna sing na hi ding a, lei sungah na sisan a tum ding hi; nang ang phawhkha ta sih ding hi, azieh pen keima Topa in ka gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 49:1-6; Ezk 25:1-7; Amos 1:13-15; Zeph 2:8-11"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Sisan Luonna Khuopi"},"2":{"text":"Nang mihing aw, sisan luonna khuopi tungah thu khen ding na mah, thu khen ding na mah? Tua ciengin tua khuopi kungah sil mudahuoi a bawl zosie pulah in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in na gen ding hi: Khuopi khat! Ama sungah sisan suohsahin milimte bawl a, tuate tawh ama le ama a kibuasah khuopi, a ni ang tung ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Sisan na suosah ziehin mi mawpa na tang ta a, na milim bawlte tawh na kibuasah hi; na nite na naisah tehteh a, a kisesa na kumte ang tung ta hi. Tua ahi ziehin minamte’ simmaw bawl, gam zosie’ ciemmui nopna kang hisah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A nai, a gamla-a a om mite in ciemmui nopna-in ang nei ding vua, nang pen a minsie le buoina tawh a kidim na hi ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sunga om Israel uliente in amau’ thuneina bang cietin sisan suosah ding beh tupin a nei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma sungah pate le nute kisimmaw bawl hi; na sunga teng pemtate’ sum kimawhlahpieh a, na sunga a teng tagate le meigongte kibawlsie hi.","ref":"Pei 20:12; 22:21-22; Thkna 5:16; 24:17"},"8":{"text":"Ka na siengthote na thuse sih a, ka sabbath-te na buasah hi.","ref":"Siem 19:30; 26:2"},"9":{"text":"Nangma sungah sisan suosah nadinga miholtuo pawl, muol tunga an ne pawl, le na laizang vuah a huasan mama mi pawl zong a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang sungah amate in a pate uh’ zi a mawpi uhi; nangma sungah amate in numeite a nin nei laitahin a buon uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khat pa in a vengpa’ zi tawh sil mudahuoi a bawl hi; adang khat in a mo zumhuoipi-in buasah a, adang khat in a pa’ tanu, a sanggamnu a buasah hi.","ref":"Siem 18:7-20"},"12":{"text":"Na sungah amate in sisan suosah nadingin guhgol a la uhi; khamkholna sum le a met tawh sum na leitawisah a, na innvengte sum mawhlahpiehin na haulaw hi; tuale nang in kei nei mangngil ta hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Pei 22:25; 23:8; Siem 25:36-37; Thkna 16:19; 23:19"},"13":{"text":"En in, na sungah thuman lo-a na nga hauna le na sisan suosahna ziehin ka khuttum ka ziel hi."},"14":{"text":"Nangma tunga kang thuh ding ni ciengin na hanna in thuoh zo-in, ahi sihle na khut tegel khau den zo ding amah? Keima Topa in ka gensa ahi a, ka sem ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte lahah hing thezahin gam cintengah kang thethang ding a, note lahah na sientho lona uh ka hemkhie ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale minamte muna-ah note ziehin keima ei kibuasah ding hi; tuale kei pen Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"18":{"text":"Mihing aw, kei adingin Israel innkuonte sia-eh a suoh ta uhi; amate a unpi-un sia haltuina meikhuh sunga a om ngun, sumngo, langva, sia, hangeh kihal ahi a, sia-eh a suoh sieng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Note na unpi-un sia-eh suoh sieng ta na hi ziehun, Jerusalem laikimah note kang khawmtuo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khat in ngun, sumngo, sia, hangeh, le langvate haltui dingin sia haltuina meikhuh sungah kholin a zunmang nadingin a tungah meikuong tawh a zap bangin, keima in ka lungthahna le ka thangpaina tawh note kang khawmtuo ding a, khuopi sungah hing koi-in kang haltui ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Note hing khawmtuo-in na tung vuah ka thangpaina meikuong kang sem ding a, khuopi sungah na zungmang ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sia haltuina meikhuh sungah ngun a zunmang bangin, tua khuopi sungah note na zungmang sieng ding uhi; tuale na tung vuah keima Topa in ka thangpaina kang sunsuh lam note in na thei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"24":{"text":"Mihing aw, ama kungah gen in: Nang pen ka thangpai ni-a ama tungah guo a zu lo, a sieng lo gam na hi hi."},"25":{"text":"A sunga a uliente uh pen a samat a ehbal humpi hawh tawh a kibang uhi; amate in mihing’ hinna a that zo uhi; amate in a goute ule a van manphate uh lahpiehin a sungah mi tampi a meigongsah uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka thuhilna tungah a siempute uh ngongtatin ka sil siengthote buasah uhi; amate in sil sieng le sil maimai khen loin, sil sieng le sil sieng lo a kilamdanna zong a hil sih uhi. Ka sabbath-te a thudon sih vua, tuaci’n amate lahah ei buasah uhi.","ref":"Siem 10:10"},"27":{"text":"A sunga om a kumpi uliente uh pen a sa matsa a ehbal ngiehon tawh a kibang vua, sisan luongsahin thuman lo-a sum nga thei nadingin mihing hinna a that uhi."},"28":{"text":"A kamsangte un amate tangin kulpi leikang vui zut bangin thu a imcip vua, amate adingin a dih lo mangmuna le zuou aisannate bawlin, Topa gen lo pi-in, “ Topa in tam bangin gen hi,” a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Gam sung mite in mite’ na mawh lahpiehin mi’ na a gu uhi; amate in mizawngte le tasam mite bawlsie-in bangma lokia loin pemtate’ na a mawh lahpieh uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale keima in tua gam ka suhsiet lo nadingin kulpi bawlpha ding le tua gam tangin kulpi hawm sungah ka mai-ah a ding ding mi ka sui kawikawi hi; ahi vangin mi khat zong ka mu sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate tungah ka thangpaina ka sungsuh hi; keima in ka thangpaina meikuong tawh amate ka haltum hi; amau’ gamtatna teng a luzang vuah ka tusahkia hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Oholah le Oholibah"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, nu khat sunga a pieng unau numei ni a om hi;"},"3":{"text":"ama gel in Egypt ah pahtatna a bawl uhi; a ngahnut lai-un ama gel a pahtat uhi; khum munah a nawi uh kimehpiehin ngahnu siengtho ahina uh kithampieh hi."},"4":{"text":"A unu’ min Oholah ahi a, a naunu’ min Oholibah ahi hi. Ama gel kei-a’ ahi a, ama gel in tanu le tapate a nei uhi. A min uh ahile, Oholah pen Samaria a cinopna ahi a, Oholibah pen Jerusalem a cinopna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei-a’ ahi laipi ma-in Oholah na pahtat a, ama in a kingaipi ahi Assyria-te a na lunggul mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate ahile puondum a sil galhangte, gam uhte le galkapmangte ahi vua, a unpi-un tangval melhoi sakol tung tuon siem vive ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate tungah tua nu a na kipumpieh a, amate a unpi-un Assyria mi kituomtelte ahi uhi; tuale ama in a lunggul mi zosie’ milimte tawh ama le ama kibuasah hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt gama a oplai-a kipanin a na gamtatnasa ahi a pahtatna ama nu in a khie tuom sih hi; azieh pen a ngahnut cil lai-in pasalte in ama na luppi-in a nawi a na mepieh vua, ama nu tungah amau’ huana zosie a na bunghla uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in a kingaipi a lunggul Assyria-te’ khut sungah ama nu ka pie ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mite in ama nu’ puon a hawmang pieh uhi; amate in a tanu le a tapate a man uhi; tuale amate in namsau tawh tua nu a that uhi. Tua nu tungah thu kikhen a, numeite lahah thu gentena khat a suoh hi."},"11":{"text":"A naunu Oholibah in tua khu mu napi, ama sangin a huasanna le a pahtatnate siezaw a, a unu sangin a khawhzaw sem lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama nu in Assyria-te, gam uhte, galkapmangte, lum le phaw tawh a kivon galhangte, sakol galkapte, sakol tuon a siemte nah lunggul mama a, amate pen a unpi-un tangval melhoi vive ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale keima in tua nu a bua lam ka mu hi; ama gel in lampi kibang a zui tuoh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle tua nu in a pahtatnate zomsuoh lai a, kawm tunga pasal lim kisuoite le a san tawh a kizem Chaldea-te’ limte,"},"15":{"text":"a kawnga kawnggah gahsa, a lu pan vua a diel mong uh a kaisuh, a unpi-vua uliente tawh a kibang- a pienna gam uh Chaldea ahi Babylon mite’ milim a mu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama nu in tuate a mu bepin lunggul pailien a, Chaldea gama amate kungah kamtai a sawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama kunga a om ki-itna lupna tungah Babylon mite a pei vua, amau’ huasanna ziehin tua nu a buasah uhi; tuale amate tawh a kibuasah zaw ciengin tua nu in amate kidahin amate kung panin a kilekia hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua nu in a pahtatna langtang tahin zom suoh a, a guohtanga a opna ang pholah ciengin ken zong a unu kidahin ka kiheisan bangin tua nu zong kidahin ka kiheisan hi."},"19":{"text":"Hizongnanle tua nu in a ngahnut lai-in Egypt gamah a pahtat laite ang phawhkia a, a pahtatnate a uongsah semsem a,"},"20":{"text":"tuale ama nu in a neihtah uh laa-a’ cie a pha, a bawtui uh sakoltang lante-a’ za a pha khum sunga a kingaipite a nah lunggul mama hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hi a, nang in na neu lai-a na huasanna, Egypt-te in na awm hing tham piehin a bawcil na nawi ang kimepiehnate na hlagul lai hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Oholibah aw, Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Na kidah zieha na kiheisan na lawm ngaite nang ang do dingin ka hantawh ding a, amate hing zawpi-in muncin teng panin nang ang do ding uhi:"},"23":{"text":"Tuate pen Babylon-te le Chaldea-te zosie, Pekod-te, Shoa-te, Koa-te le Assyria-te zosie tawh, tangval melhoite, gam uhte le galkapmang zosie, uliente le galhangte le sakol tuon a siemte zosie ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in sakol leengte, vanpuo leengte le mihon tampite tawh nang ang do dingin leilu lam panin ang kuon ding uhi; nang ang do dingin muncin tengah lum le phaw le sia lukhute khusa-in amate in panmun a la ding uhi; tuale keima in amate tungah thukhenna ka ap ding a, amate in a ngaina utawh kituohin nang tungah thu ang khen ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Keima in nang tungah ka lungthahna ka tungsah ding a, amate in lungso tahin ang bawl ding uhi. Amate in na nahkuo le na bilte ang tansan ding vua, a hingsun teng zong namsau tawh a si ding uhi. Amate in na tanu na tapate uh manin a hingsun na mi teng zong mei in a katum ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in na puonte hing sutpiehin a manpha na kizepnate ang lahpieh ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Egypt pana na ken na huasanna le na pahtatnate ka tawpsah ding hi; nangma in tuate hlangai nawn loin, Egypt zong na phawhkha ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in na muda na kiheisan mite’ khut sungah nangma kang pie ding hi;"},"29":{"text":"tuale amate in mudana tawh hing huotbawlin, na thalawsa na zosie ang lahpieh ding vua, na guohtangin puonsil loin ang nuasie ding vua, mi tawh na luptonna na tahsa pumguoh ang kipholah ding hi. Na huasanna le na pahtatnate in"},"30":{"text":"na tungah tam bang ang tunsah ahi hi, azieh pen minamte tawh na pahtat a, amau’ milimte tawh na kibuasah hi."},"31":{"text":"Na sanggam nu’ lampi ma na tawn hi, tua ahi ziehin keima in na khut sungah ama’ hai kang pie ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: A gol le a thuh na sanggam nu’ hai nangma in na dawn ding hi; ang kisimmaw-in ang kinuisan ding a, tua in tampitah taa hi."},"33":{"text":"Zu khamin dana tawh na kidim ding hi. Zauna le manthaina hai pen na sanggam nu Samaria’ hai ahi hi;"},"34":{"text":"tua hai dawnin na tawpkang ding a, hai themkehte haizanin na nawite na kuikeh ding hi. Azieh pen ka gensa ahi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Bangzieh ahei cile kei ei mangngilin nei nua ngatsan ziehin na huasanna le na pahtatnate a paat thuoh na hi hi."},"36":{"text":"Topa in ka kungah thu ang gen hi: Mihing aw, Oholah le Oholibah tungah thu na khen diei mah? Tua ciengin nangma in ama gel kungah a mudahuoi a gamtatnate uh gen in."},"37":{"text":"Azieh pen ama gel in angkawmin a khut gelah sisan a baang hi; a milimte utawh angkawmin keima tawh a nei a tate nangawn uh milim pasien-te neh dingin a pie uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua tham loin ka tungah tam teng a bawl uhi: ama gel in tua ni ma-in ka biehinn buasahin ka sabbath-te a niehsah uhi."},"39":{"text":"Azieh pen ama gel in a milimte adingin a tate a gaw ciengun tua ni ma-in ka biehinn ah ama gel hing pei-in a buasah uhi. Ka biehinn sungah a gamtatna uh tam bang ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama gel in a gamlapi panin pasalte ang pei nadingin kamtai nangawn a sawl vua, tuale amate ang pei uhi. Amate adingin nang le nang na kipumsil a, mitmul za kinu-in, kizepna manphate tawh na kizem hi;"},"41":{"text":"lupna hoitah tungah a to vua, tua lupna mai-ah ka gimnamtui le ka sathau kikoina sabuoi kipha hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua nu kimvelah mihonpi gamlum valuoi a, gamlah panin zukham mi mawhmawh tampi kipeipi hi; amate in numei gel’ khutah tau bunsahin a lutang vuah kumpi lukhu a khusah uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Kadei, a angkawmkawmna-in tua nu a paatgawp ahi ta hi, hinanle amate in a mawpi lai veve uhi."},"44":{"text":"Azieh pen numei pahtat khat kungah mite a pei bangin tua nu kungah amate a pei uhi. Tua bangin numei huasan Oholah le Oholibah kungah amate a pei uhi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi vangin a dih thukhente in angkawmna le sisan suosahna tawh ama gel tungah thu a khen ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile ama gel angkawm ahi a, a khut vuah sisan a baang hi."},"46":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Ama gel a do dingin mihonpi kuonsah in, zausisah inlen ama gel’ na lahpiehsah in."},"47":{"text":"Mihonpi in ama gel suong tawh sepin, a namsau utawh vatgawp ding uhi; amate in a tanu le a tapte uh thatin a innte uh haltum ding uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tam bangin gam sungah huana le lanna ka kamsah ding hi, tua khu numei zosie in thuhilkholna-in sangin nang gamtat bangin amate a huasan nawn sih ding uhi."},"49":{"text":"Na huasanna uh dan na thuoh kia ding gel a, na mawna uh ahi na milim biehna uh ziehin note in dan na thuoh ding uhi; tuale note in keima Topa Pasien ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum kuona, a hla sawmna, a nisawmna ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi.","title":"A So Anbeel (Jer 1:13-19)"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, tuni mama-in, tuni’ min ciemte in. Babylon kumpipa in tuni mama-in Jerusalem imtawm zo hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:1; Jer 52:4"},"3":{"text":"Tuale a ledo innkuonte kungah thugentena khat gen inlen, amate kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Beel khat suong in, beel suong inlen, a sungah tui zong sung in;"},"4":{"text":"tua beel sungah sabate, a pheisa le a liengsa, saba tuituoh zosie bua inlen, a gu tuituohte a dimin bua in."},"5":{"text":"Ganhonte lahah a tuituoh pen la inlen, beel nei-ah sing bop in; a satelte huon inlen, a sungah a gute huonmin in."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi: Sisan a luongsah khuopi, a sunga sam-eh kaisa, a sam-ehte a kawh lo beel in gimna a thuoh ding hi! Saba teeltuom nei loin bakhat zaw ba khatin beel panin thua in."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen tua sungah ama nu’ luonsah sisan om hi; leivui in tua sisan a vua nadingin lei lahah a sung sih a, suong tungah a sung hi."},"8":{"text":"Phu ka lah thei nadingin ka lung a thah nadingin, tua sisan a kivuamang lo nadingin, keima in suong tungah ka koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Sisan a luongsah khuopi in gimna a thuoh ding hi! Keima in sing ka tawbe ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Singtun bopin mei phat un; sa hoitahin huonso unlen, beel sungah a namtuite hlah unlen, a gute kagepsah un."},"11":{"text":"Meikam tungah beel hawm suong un. Tuaci’n beel ang sa ding a, a sumsante hing kuongin a nieh teng ang zungmang ding a, sam-ehte ang nemang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Phattuomna om loin kei le kei ka kigimsuo hi; a sam-eh sasopi teng kawh zo loin, sam-ehte mei in kawhsah zo lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Na huasanna a nieh teng kang sawpsieng vangin, na niehna panin na sieng thei tuom sih hi; na tungah ka thangpaina ka daisah masangsie nang na siengthokia sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima Topa in ka gensa ahi hi; a hun ang tung ta a, ka sem ta ding hi. Ka onton sih ding a, hen zong nei loin ka lungsim ka khiem sih ding hi. Na gamtatna le na sepnate dung zui-in na tungah thu ka khen ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Ezekiel’ Dana"},"16":{"text":"Mihing aw, na et nop penpen mi khat na kung pan khatvei satin ka lamang ding hi; hinanle kap le mau-in na om sih ding a, na hlitui zong na luongsah sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuisa inlen, ahi vangin gingsah sin. Tua misi ziehin tau sin. Na diel khim inlen na kengah kedap bun in; na nephu tunglam khu sinlen a kapte’ an zong nehpieh sin."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in zingmawngin mipite kungah thu ka gen a, a nitah ciengin ka zi a si hi. Tuale keima in a zingni zingmawngin ei kithupieh bangin ka bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin mipite in keima kungah, “Na hici gamtat pen ko adinga bang na deina ahei, ei gen lo ding na mah?” ei ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah ka gen hi. Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:"},"21":{"text":"Israel innkuonte kungah Topa in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Na lungsim vua na hlangai uh, na mit vua na et nuom uh, na kilietsahpi na hatna uh ahi ka biehinn ka buasah ding hi; tuale note in na nuasie uh na tanu le na tapate uh namsau-in a si ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in ka bawlsa bangin note in zong na bawl ding uhi; note in na nephu uh a tunglam khu loin, a kapte’ an zong na ne sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Na lu tung vuah na dielkhim uh om ding a, na keng vuah na kedap uh om ding hi; note kap le mau-in na om sih ding vua, hizongle na na khielnate uh ziehin na hingkiem ding vua, khatlekhat na kitaupi ciet ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangin Ezekiel pen note adingin lim khat ahi ding hi; ama’ bawl bangin no zong na bawl ding uhi. Tami thu ang tun ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Nang, mihing aw, keima in a mun muonhuoite uh, a kipahna ule a minthanna uh, a mit vua a etcim lo uh, a lungsim vua a hlagul uh a tanu a tapate uzong amate kung panin ka lah ni cieng,"},"26":{"text":"tuami ni-in a suohta mi khat na kungah hing pei-in thu ang puoh ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin na kam kihongin a suohta mipa tawh na kiho ding a, na kamsip ngai nawn sih ding hi. Tuaci’n nang pen amate adingin lim khat na hi ding hi; tuale amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Ammon Langkhatah Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Ammon-te lam kinga inlen amate langkhatah thu gen in."},"3":{"text":"Ammon-te kungah, Topa Pasien’ thugen za un, ci-in gen in: Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Note in ka mun siengtho kibuasahin Israel gam ten thei lona-in kikoi a, sal dingin Judah innkuonte a pei uh ciengin, “Awi sam ing ei!” na ci se uhi;"},"4":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin keima in nisuona gam mite tungah note kang pie ding hi. Amate in note lahah giephuol satin na laikim vuah puonbuh a lam ding uhi; amate in na singga uh ne-in na bawngnawi uh zong a dawn ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in Rabbah khuo pen kalaohte’ an maina mun ka suohsah ding a, Ammon, tuukhumna mun ka suohsah ding hi. Tua ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Note in Israel gam langbawlin na khut na keng utawh tuol sia-in, na sung vuah thangsietna zosiepi teng tawh kipahin na dieng uhi,"},"7":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin note langkhatah ka khut zahin minamte’ tomgam dingin note kang pie ding hi. Keima in minamte sung panin note kang sumaimang ding a, gam tuomtuomte panin kang susie ding hi. Tua ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi.","ref":"Jer 49:1-6; Ezk 21:28-32; Amos 1:13-15; Zeph 2:8-11"},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Azieh pen Moab-te in Judah innkuonte pen minam dangte tawh kibang uhi, a ci vua,","title":"Moab Langkhatah Tangkona"},"9":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Moab muolpang, a gamgi dunga khuopite panin a gam a kisahtheipi munte ahi Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, le Kiriathaim-te ka hawhkhie ding a, a awngin ka omsah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nisuona lam mite’ tan dingin Ammon-te tawh ka pie ding hi. Tua bangin minamte lahah Ammon-te kiphawhkha nawn lo ding a,"},"11":{"text":"tuale Moab-te tungah keima in thukhenna ka bawl ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 15:1–16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Amos 2:1-3; Zeph 2:8-11"},"12":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Edom in Judah innkuon tungah nasie tahin phu la a, amate tunga a phulahna ziehin nah khiel mama hi,","title":"Edom Langkhatah Tangkona"},"13":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangci hi: Edom langkhatah ka khut ka zah ding a, a mite le a ganhingte sumaimangin gamkhing suohsahin Teman khuo panin Dedan khuo cieng dong nangawnin namsau tawh amate a si ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Edom tungah ka mi Israel-te zangin phu ka la ding a, ka lungthahna le ka thangpaina tawh kituohin amate in Edom gamah a bawl ding uhi; amate in ka phulahna ahi lam a thei ding uhi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"15":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Azieh pen a tawp thei lo kigalneina ziehin Philistia-te in phu la-in thangsietna lungsim ziehin suhsiet nading phu a la uhi;","title":"Philistia Langkhatah Tangkona"},"16":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Philistia-te langkhatah ka khut ka zah ding a, Kereth-te sumaimangin tuipi panga a omlaite ka susie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima in thangpaina tawh a kidim danpiehna tawh amate tungah nahpi tahin phu ka la ding hi. Amate tungah phu ka lah ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zeph 2:4-7; Zech 9:5-7"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sawm le kum khat kum, tua hla a ni masa ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Tyre Langkhatah Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Tyre in Jerusalem tawh kisai-in, “Aha, mite tunkot tawngsan ta hi; kei adingin golpi tahin kihong zo hi; tu-in tua khuopi kisiegawp ta a, kei kungah mi a dimin ang teng ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: En in, Tyre aw, nang kang langpang hi! Tuipi in tuihuolte a naw bangin nang ang langpang dingin minamte kang not ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Tyre kulpi susie-in a tausangte satcim ding uhi. A gam panin leitang khuot dawhin suongtum beh ka dawhsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khuopi pen tuipi laikima om len phona mun a suoh ding hi. Keima in ka gen zo hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi. Tua khu minamte’ tomgam khuopi suoh ding a,"},"6":{"text":"namsau tawh a gam sunga a khuotate kithat ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Tyre khuopi sim dingin leilu lam panin kumpite’ kumpi ahi Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar, a sakolte, a sakol leengte, a lei galkapte, le a thahat galkap honpite tawh kang kuonsah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in gam sunga na khuotate namsau tawh that ding hi. Ama in nang langkhatah kulpi bawlin leicien a cieng ding hi. Ama in nang langkhatah innkhum bangin lum a cieng ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a moltum tawh na kulte satcim ding a, a heite tawh na tausangte phuamat ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A sakolte a tam sengin a tuol totna uh leivui in tuomcip ding hi. A kiphuvang khuopi kulpi sungah mi a lut vapual bangin, na tunkotah ama ang lut ciengin sakol galkap, lengkangte, le sakol leengte’ huging ziehin na kulte a kiling ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a sakol kecinte tawh na gawldung zosie uh a tuoncil ding hi. Namsau tawh na mite a satlia ding vua, a khau mama na khuomte uzong tuolah puamat ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in na neisate uh a tomgam ding vua, na sumbuh vante uzong a lamang ding uhi. Amate in na kulte uh a satkeh ding vua, na innhoite a susie ding uhi. Amate in tui sungah na suongte, na inn singte le na leisiette a pai ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in a lasahna uh ahi tumgingte ka sipsah ding hi; na lyre gingte uzong kiza nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 18:22"},"14":{"text":"Keima in nang suong gawta kang suohsah ding hi; nang pen len phona mun na hi ta ding hi. Keima Topa in ka gensa ahi ziehin nang ang kilamkia nawn lo ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa Pasien in Tyre khuopi tungah tam bangin gen hi: Nang sungah kithana kizom suohin a liem a baite tau vangutin, amate in na puana awging a zah uh ciengin tuikul gamte kiling lo ding uh amah?"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuipi sunga gam uhte zosie a kumpi topha tung uh panin a kumsuh ding uhi; amate in a puontuolte uh sutdawhin a kizem a puonsilte uh a hawhdawh ding uhi. Amate zau-in a kithin kawmun puon a sil ding vua, tuolah a to ding uhi; a peisuh a peitona vuah nang ziehin amate a citun ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in nang tungah kaateng loin tam bangin ang gen ding uhi: Aw khuopi minthang, nang le na sunga tengte, tuipi tunga a hatpen ahi ngaisa khuopi, gam thupi zosie tungah nangma’ giinhuoina a tungsah khuopi, bang a cile tuipite pana hici manthai va-ia na diei!"},"18":{"text":"Nang na pua ni-in tuikul gam teng a citun uhi; nang na manthaina ziehin tuikul gam teng lungkie uhi.","ref":"Kln 18:9-10"},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Ten lo gie lona khuopite bangin a daidam khuopi kang suohsah ding a, na tungah tui thuhpi hing sawlin tui huolpite in ang tuom ciengin,"},"20":{"text":"nidanglai-in Hankhuh sunga a kumsuh mite tawh kang sawnhla suh ding a, tangtawnga sietna a thuoh Hankhuh sunga a kumsuh mite kung leinei-ah kang tengsah ding hi. Tuaci’n mihingte tenna leitangah ang kitengsah sih ding a, tenna ding mun zong na nga sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A lipkhap huoi-in kang maimangsah ding a, na om nawn sih ding hi; ang kisui vangin ang kimukia ngai ta sih ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Kln 18:21"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Tyre Tunga Kaala"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in nang mihing aw, Tyre tungah kaateng lo inlen,"},"3":{"text":"tuipi lutna lamkot a om, tuikul gam mun tampi pana sumbawl mite kisuhtuona muna a teng Tyre tungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Tyre khuopi aw, nang in “Hoina ah ka bucing hi,” ci-in na gen zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Na gamgi teng tuipite laikimah a om uhi; nang ang lamte in na hoina bukimsah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in na singpeh zosie Senir taasingte tawh a bawl uhi; amate in na dielkhaina khuom dingin Lebanon taamtah sing a la uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in Bashan gangpi singte panin nangma ang kihawna ding a bawl uhi; Cyprus gam tuikulte pana a kila taasante tawh na tuong a pha vua, saihapah tawh a zem uhi."},"7":{"text":"Egypt pana puon hoi kizem khu na puonkhai ahi a, tua khu na landiel dingin kizang hi; Elisha tuikulte pana a kinga a dum le a dupsan puonte pen na tungkhu ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Sidon le Arvad gama tengte khu nangma ang hotte ahi vua, nangma sunga a teng Zemer khut siemte khu nangma ang hawlte ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Na sungah Gebal gam upate le a khut siemte in na tembaw vangte a phawbih uhi. Na vante a lei dingin tuipi tunga a om tembaw zosie, tembaw nasemte tawh nangma sungah a om uhi."},"10":{"text":"Paras, Lud le Put-te in na galkap na a sem vua, na galhangte ahi uhi; amate in na sungah lum le sia lukhu khai-in nang ang thupise uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na kul kimvelah Arvad le Helech-te a om uhi; na tausang vuah Gamad mite a om uhi. Amate in na kul kimvelah a thalbawmte a khai uhi; amate in na hoina a bukimsah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Na neisa van a tam ziehin Tarshish-te in nang tawh summet a bawlton uhi; amate in na vante, ngun, sia, langva, le hangehte tawh a hleng uhi."},"13":{"text":"Javan, Tubal, le Meshech mite in nang tawh summet a bawlton vua, mihingte le sumngno beelte tawh na sumbuh vante a hleng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Beth-togarmah gam mite in na vanzuate sakol, sakol galkapte, le laate tawh a hleng uhi."},"15":{"text":"Rhod mite in nang tawh summet a bawlton uhi; tuikul gam tampite nangma’ aituom vanzuana ahi uhi; amate in na lei dingin saiha le ning singte ang puo uhi."},"16":{"text":"Nang in van na hau ziehin Edom-te in nang tawh summet a bawlton uhi; amate in na vanzuate turquoise suong manpha, puon dupsan, puon kizem, saihadiel puonhoite, suongkhiba le ruby suongmanpha-te tawh a hleng uhi."},"17":{"text":"Judah le Israel gamte in nang tawh summet a bawlton uhi; Minnith pana a pieng mangbu, taang, khuoizu, sathau, le zatuite tawh na sumbuh vante a hleng uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nang in na tampi na nei zieh le hauna namkim-Helbon pana zu le tuumul kang namkimte- na nei ziehin Damascus in nang tawh summet a bawlton hi."},"19":{"text":"Uzal khuo panin Vedan gam le Javan gam mite in na vanzuate tawh summet a bawlton uhi; amate in na sumbuh vante sia huonsa, thahsing le phaite tawh a hleng uhi."},"20":{"text":"Dedan mite in tuon nading sakol topha puonte nang tawh sumbawlna-in a nei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Arabia gam le Kedar ulien zosie pen tuuno, tuutang, le keelte tawh summet na bawlpi a na patah mama mite ahi uhi; tamte tawh amate in nang tawh sum a bawlton uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sheba le Raamah sumbuhte in nang tawh sum bawlton uhi; amate in na vanzuate a hoi penpen sing namtui nam zosie, suong manpha zosie, le kham tawh a hleng uhi."},"23":{"text":"Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba sumbuhte, Asshur, le Chilmad-te in nang tawh sum a bawlton uhi."},"24":{"text":"A kituomteel puonsilte, a dum le a kizem hoi puonsilte, inn sunga a kipha a kizem a pawlte, le lim taha kiheh khauhuolte ahi a, tam bang teng in nang tawh sum a bawl uhi."},"25":{"text":"Nangma dinga summet bawl dingin Tarshish tembawte khuol a zin uhi. Tuaci’n nang pen tuipi laikimah vangihpi tawh na kidim hi."},"26":{"text":"Ang hotte in tuipi thuh sungah ang tut vua, tuipi laikimah nisuona lam hui in ang tummangsah ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Nang na kisiet ni ciengin na haunate, na vanzuate, na sumbuh vante, na tembaw nasemte le na tembaw hawlte, na tembaw phawbihte le na sumbuh van leite, na kisiet ni ciengin na optonpi na galhang zosie, na unpi-un tuipi laizangah na tummang ta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Na tembaw hawlte kikona awging in gamcin teng kithingsah a,"},"29":{"text":"a hotte zosie a unpi-un a tembaw panin a kumsuh uhi. Tembaw nasemte le tembaw hawl zosie, tuipi pieu ah a ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Nang ziehin amate a gingin mau-in lainatna tawh a awng uhi. A lutung vuah leivui a kibuoh vua, vutvai lahah a kilawmlia uhi;"},"31":{"text":"nang ziehin a lu uh heukieu-in la-ip puon a sil uhi. Lungsim na sa luo-in ang kaa vua, nahpi tahin a thum uhi."},"32":{"text":"A hlasiet ziehun nang adingin kaateng loin, tam bangin ang kaa uhi: “Tyre khuopi banga tuipi laizangah a kisusie koi a om ngai ta ahei?"},"33":{"text":"Na vanzuate tuipi tung pan ang tun ciengin mi tampi na lungkimsah hi; na hau sengna le na sumbuh vante in leitung kumpite na hausah hi."},"34":{"text":"Tu-in tuipi sungah kisie gawpin tuipi thuh sungah na om ta hi; na sumbuh vante le na nasem zosie nang tawh tuipi sungah a tummang ta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuikul gama teng mi zosie in cimulthaw huoi a sa uhi; a kumpite uh a zau sengun a mai uh a kikhuleh sieng hi."},"36":{"text":"Mipite lahah sum bawlte in ang ehneh ho uhi; zauhuoi tahin na mangthai ta a, na omkia nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 18:11-19"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Tyre Kumpipa Langkhatah Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Tyre kumpipa kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Na lungsim a kilietsah ziehin, “Kei pasien ka hi hi; pasien-te’ tona tuipi laikimah ka to hi,” na ci hi. Hinanle nangma’ lungsim le pasien’ lungsim na tekah vangin, nang pen pasien na hi sih a, mi maimai na hi bo hi."},"3":{"text":"Daniel sangin na pilzaw sam a, nang kung panin phuolsel kici bangma om lo hi;"},"4":{"text":"na pilna le na theitelna tawh neisa na kikhol a, na sum koina ah kham le ngun na kholvum hi."},"5":{"text":"Summet bawl na siem ziehin na neisa na pungsah a, tua na neisate ziehin na lungsim a kiliensah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Nang in na lungsim le Pasien’ lungsim na tekah ziehin,"},"7":{"text":"minamte lahah nang ang do dingin a giinhuoi pen gamdang mite kang sawl ding hi; amate in a etlawm na pilna do dingin namsau a dawh ding vua, na thupina a suthang ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in Hankhuh sungah ang sawnsuh ding vua, note, tuipite laikimah sisie-in na si ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang ang sat liemte’ khut sungah nang pen pasien hi loin mi maimai khat na hi vangin, “Kei pasien ka hi hi,” na ci lai lai diei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Nang pen gamdang mite’ khut tawh tep kitan lote si bangin na si ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile keima Topa Pasien in ka gensa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua banah Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Tyre Kumpipa a Kikaana"},"12":{"text":"Mihing aw, Tyre kumpipa adingin kaateng lo inlen Topa Pasien in tam bang ci hi, ci-in ama kungah gen in: Nang a bucing suoikaina khutsip na hi a, pilna tawh na kidim a, na hoina a bucing hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien’ Eden um ah nang na om a, carnelian, chrysolite, suongkang, beryl, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, le emerald suongmanpha namcin teng khu nangma kituomna ahi hi; na kizepna le na kikhuohnate kham tawh kibawl ahi a, tuate khu nang ang kipiensah ni-a kisiemkhol ahi ta bo hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in nang ang cing dingin sathau kinusa cherub ka koi hi. Pasien’ muol siengtho tungah na om a, meisuongte lahah na vah kawikawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ang kipiensah ni-a kipanin na sungah khielna a kimu cieng dong, na gamtatna paubanna om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Na sumbawl a tam ziehin tatsietna tawh na kidim a, mawna na bawl hi; tuaci’n a bua na khat bangin Pasien’ muol panin kang paimang ta a, tuale nang ang cing cherub in meisuongte lah panin ang notdawh ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Na mel a hoi ziehin na lungsim a kiliensah hi; na minthan ding na deina lamin na pilna na susie gawp hi. Keima in tuol sena-in kang nei a, kumpite in munop ang sah dingun a mai vuah kang pholah hi."},"18":{"text":"A thuman lo sum na bawlna ziehin, na khielna a tam seng ta a, nangma in munsieng zosie na buasah ta hi. Tuaci’n na sung panin mei ka kuongsah hi; tua mei in nang hing katumin ang mu mi zosie mai lei lahah vut kang suohsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Mite lahah nang ang thei mite a ciza sieng gawp ding uhi; a zauhuoi-in na mangthai ta a, na omkia ngai nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:1-4; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"20":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Sidon Langkhatah Tangkona"},"21":{"text":"Mihing aw, Sidon lam kinga-in ama langkhatah thu phuong inlen,"},"22":{"text":"Topa in tam bangci hi, ci-in gen in: Sidon khuopi aw, nang kang langpan ding a, keima in note lahah minthanna ka nga ding hi. Ama sungah ka siengthona lahin a sungah thu ka khen ciengin, keima Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi;"},"23":{"text":"azieh pen a sungah pul natna ka tungsah ding a, a lampi tengah sisan ka luongsah ding hi; muncin tengah namsau tawh ang kido-in, na khuo laizangah mite pua-in a si ding uhi. Tuale amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Israel innkuonte in a innvengte lahah amate a simmaw bawl, ling le khau banga a sun thei koima a mu nawn sih ding uhi. Tuale amate in keima Topa Pasien ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Minamte lahah a kithetangna panun Israel innkuonte ka kaikhop ciengin minamte muna ah ka siengthona ka talang ding hi, tua ciengin ka nasem Jacob tunga ka piehsa amau’ leitangah a teng ding uhi.","title":"Israel ading Mailam Thupha"},"26":{"text":"Tua sungah amate lungmuong tahin a teng ding vua, amate in inn lamin lengga umte a bawl ding uhi. Amate a simmaw bawl a vengte zosie tungah thu ka khen ciengin amate lungmuong tahin a teng ding vua, keima Topa a Pasien uh ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi.","ref":"Joel 3:4-8; Zech 9:1-2; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawmna, a hla sawmna, a ni sawm le ni ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Egypt Langkhatah Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh lam nga inlen, ama le Egypt-te zosie langkhatah thu phuong in."},"3":{"text":"Ama hopi inlen Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh aw, gun laikima a kuol gulhiempi na hi a, nangma kang langpang hi. Nang in, “Nile gunpi kei-a’ ahi hi; kei dinga ka bawl ahi hi,” na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Na khadangah ngakuoi sietin, na gun sunga nga zosie na lip kahah ka behsah ding hi. Na lip kahah a beh nga zosie, na gun sunga nga zosie tawh kang kaito sieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang le na gun sunga nga zosie, gamlahah kang pai ding hi; Lopang lahah na kie ding a, khop lo le vui loin na om ding uhi. Leitunga gamsate le vana vate’ an dinga kang piehsa na hi ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Egypt-a teng zosie in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi. Israel innkuonte adingin nang pen pumpeng ciengkhut na hi hi;","ref":"Isa 36:6"},"7":{"text":"a khut utawh ang tuh ciengun na kuoi tawng a, amau’ liengko gu zosie na kilawisah hi; nangma tungah ang kingap ciengun nang in na kuoi tawng a, a keng uh na hehsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na tungah namsau kang lengsah ding a, na kung panin ganhingte le na mihingte ka sumaimang ding hi;"},"9":{"text":"tuale Egypt pen a kinuasie gamkhing a suoh ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi. Nang in, “Nile gunpi kei-a’ ahi a, keima bawlsa ahi hi,” na ci ziehin"},"10":{"text":"keima in nangma le na gunte ka langpang hi. Egypt gam sung, Migdol panin Syene cieng dong le Ethiopia gamgi dongin, a kinuasie gamkhing ka suohsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihingte le ganhingte in lamhlahna-in tua gam a nei sih ding uhi; kum sawmli sung koima a teng sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Gamkhingte lahah Egypt gam pen gamkhing khat ka suohsah ding ahi; tuale a khuopite uzong a kinuasiesa khuopite lahah kum sawmli sung gamkhing a suoh ding uhi. Keima in minamte lahah Egypt mite ka thethang ding a, gam tuomtuomte lahah ka thezah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banah Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in kum sawmli a cin zaw ciengin a kithethangna uh minamte lah panin Egypt mite ka kaikhawmkia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in Egypt’ vangphatnate ka piekia ding a, a pienna gam uh Pathros gamah amate ka peipikia ding hi; khum munah kumpi gam ginalo khatin amate a om ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi gamte lahah a ginalo pen a suoh ding vua, minamte tungah a kikhai zo ngai nawn sih ding uhi; minamte tungah vai a hawm zo ngai nawn lo dingin amate ka neukhen ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate pen Egypt mite, Israel innkuonte’ muon le suon ahi ngai ta sih ding uhi; amate in panpina ngenin amate lam a kihei uh ciengin a khielnate uh a phawhkia ding uhi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa Pasien ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kum sawmni le kum sagi kum, a hla masa, a ni masa ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Babylon-te in Egypt Tomgam ding"},"18":{"text":"Mihing aw, Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Tyre do nadingin a galkapte nahpi-in hanciemsah hi; mi zosie a samte uh pulmangin a liengkote uh a paat sieng hi; hinanle ama in ahi a, a galkapte in ahi zongin Tyre dona-a a kizang a gim thaman uh bangma a lemlaw sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Babylon Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar tungah Egypt gam ka pie ding hi; tuale ama in a neisate uh puomang ding a, a gam uh susie-in a tomgam ding hi; tua khu a galkapte’ hlasum ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A nasep a thaman dingin Egypt gam ama ka pie hi, azieh pen amate in keima adingin a sem uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in Israel innkuonte adingin kii khat ka momsah ding a, amate lahah na kam ka hong ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Egypt ading Kaala"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, thu phuong inlen, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: “Alah, khum ni khu!” ci-in kapin mau in."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen a ni nai ta a, Topa’ ni nai ta hi; khum ni khu meiikai ni hi ding a, minamte manthai hun hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Egypt tungah namsau khat tu ding a, Ethiopia ah lunggimna om ding hi. Egypt ah a kithatte pua-in a si ciengin a neisate uh kipuomang ding a, a bulpite uh kiphuapai ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ethiopia, Put, Lud, Arabia, Libya, le a kipawlpi gam mite namsau tawh puaton ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Egypt panpite a pua ding vua, a kisahtheipi uh a hatna uzong kiemsuh ta ding hi. Migdol pan Syene dongin tua gam sunga mite namsau tawh si ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Gamkhingte lahah amate gamkhing khat a suoh ding vua, khuopi kisiete lahah a khuopite uh kihal ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in Egypt haltumin ama a panpi zosie a kisuhgam ciengin, keima Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin bangma awlmaw a nei lo Ethiopia mite a zausisah dingin ka kung panin tembaw tawh ka kamtaite a pei ding uhi; Egypt a manthai ni-in amate tungah lunggimna a tung ding hi; azieh pen khum hun ang tung ta hi!"},"10":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar’ khut tawh Egypt mihonpite ka sumaimang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum gam a susie dingin ama le a omtonpi a mite ahi, minamte lahah a giinhuoi pente kikuonsah ding hi; amate in Egypt gam langkhatah a namsau a dawh ding vua, gam sung teng misi tawh kidim ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Guntuite ka kangsah ding a, migilote’ khutah khum gam ka zuamang ding hi. Khum gam le a sunga om zosie gamdang mite’ khut tawh ka mangthaisah ding hi, keima Topa in ka genzo hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Memphis khuopi-a om milimte ka maimangsah ding hi; Egypt gamah a uh ding koima om nawn lo ding hi; tuaci’n keima in Egypt gamah zauna ka tungsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathros gam khu gamkhing suohsahin, Zoan khuopi mei-in ka hal ding a, keima in Thebes khuopi tungah thu ka khen ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt mun muonhuoi, Pelusium khuopi tungah ka thangpaina ka tungsah ding a, Thebes mihonpite ka sumaimang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima in mei tawh Egypt ka hal ding hi; Pelsium khuopi in gim genthei a thuoh ding hi. Thebes kulpi kehgawp ding a, suntang lai-in a galte tawh Memphis a kimu ding hi."},"17":{"text":"On khuo le Pibeseth khuo tangvalte, namsau tawh a si ding vua, a khuopite uh amau le amau saltangin a pei ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khum munah Egypt’ uhna ka suhsiet ciengin, sun lai-in Tehaphnehes ah mutzin tung ding a, a kilietsahna mang ding hi; meeilum in Khuopi khu ding a, amau’ khuotate saltangin pei ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Egypt tungah thu ka khen ding a, tua ciengin Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"A kum sawm le khatna, a hla masa, tua hla a ni sagina ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Pharaoh Langkhatah Tangkona"},"21":{"text":"Mihing aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh’ ban ka tawngsah ta hi; ama a thahatin namsau a lap zokia nading, a dam sieng nadingin kitunpieh lo a, zong kituompieh lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh ka langpang hi. A banhat pen le a tawngsa pen tawh a ni-in ka hliehtawng ding hi; tuale a khut panin namsau ka kiesah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Minamte lahah Egypt-te ka thethang ding a, gamcin tengah ka thezah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa’ bantha ka khausah ding a, ama khutah ka namsau ka koi ding hi; ahi vangin Pharaoh’ ban ka hliehtawng ding a, a liem a si ding mite tau bangin Babylon kumpipa mai-ah a tau ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa’ bante ka khausah ding a, ahi vangin Pharaoh’ bante a kiesuh ding hi. Keima in Babylon kumpipa’ khutah ka namsau ka koi ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi. Ama in Egypt gam langkhatah namsau leh ding a,"},"26":{"text":"minamte lahah Egypt-te thethangin gamcin tengah zong ka thezah ding hi. Tua ciengin keima Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm le khatna, a hla thumna, a ni masa ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"A Sang Taamtah Kung (Ezk 17:22-24)"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh le a mihonte kungah tam bangin gen in: Na liet dan koi pen tawh na kibang bep ei?"},"3":{"text":"Assyria ngaisun in, ama pen a bazam hoi-in, a hlim in gamsung teng dielsah a, a kung sang mama-in meiilum lahah a dawn a kidawh to, Lebanon taamtah sing ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tui in ama tapnom dildel a, a thuhna sunga om tui in ama a sangsah hi. A pona mun kimvelah a guntui kiluongsah a, gamlah singkung zosie ah a luituite a luongsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n gamlah sing zosie sangin tua khu ang sangzaw a, a phungzungah tui a tam ziehin a bate ang golin ang sau hi."},"6":{"text":"Vana leng vate in a ba lahah bu tomin a bazam nei-ah gamsate a nosang vua, ama’ hlim nei-ah minam lien zosie a teng uhi."},"7":{"text":"A huite in tui tamna munah zung hlasuh ahi ziehin a kung golin bazau a, a etlawm mama hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien’ um sunga tamtaahte in ama demzo loin, taasingte in zong ama a demzo sih hi. A bate tawh tekah dingin thei kungte bangma ahi sih hi; Pasien’ um sunga singpote tawh zong a hoina a kibang sih hi.","ref":"Pien 2:9"},"9":{"text":"A bazam tampitah tawh a melhoi dinga ka bawl ahi a, Pasien’ um sung, Eden-a singpo zosie in tua khu a eng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Tua pen sang tahin kitungdawh a, a dawn in meiilum banto-in, a sanna ziehin a lungsim zong ang kiliensah pai hi."},"11":{"text":"Minamte’ uhpa khut sungah ama ka pie hi; tua pa in a gitlona tawh kituohin a bawlsie hi. Ama pen ka paimangsa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Gamdang mi, minamte lahah a giinhuoi pente in tua sing phua-in a nuasie uhi. Muoltung teng le kuomcin tengah a bate kie a, gam sunga tui pulna cintengah a nabawh teng a tawngsa-in a kiemang hi; tuale leitung mi zosie in a hlim nei panin hing pei-in a peisan ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua a pua sing tungah vana leng va zosie tuong a, tua a ba kawmte lahah gamsa namcin a gieh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam teng zosie pen tui gei-a a po singkungte khat beh in khanpha-in tua tanin a san lo nading, ahi sihle a dawnte in meilum a bat zo lo nading, le tui a kham singkung khat beh tuate tana a san lo nading ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate, a unpi-un mihingte zosie tawh, leinei gam le Hankhuh sunga kumsuhte tawh a kipieton ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Misikhuo ah a kumsuh ni-in, ama tunga a om tua a thuhna mun pen khahin ka tuom hi; keima in a guntuite luongsah nawn loin a tuihuolte ka khahtan hi. Khuomiel in Lebanon gam ka khusah a, tua ziehin gamlahah a po sing zosie a vul sieng hi."},"16":{"text":"Hankhuh sunga a peisuhte tawh ama Misikhuo ah ka khiehsuh ciengin, ama’ puana ging ziehin keima in minamte ka kilingsah hi; Eden-a a po sing zosie, Lebanon-a a hoipen kiteelte, tui a kicing taha a nga zosiete leinei ah nuomtahin a om ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Minamte lahah ama’ hlim nei-a a teng a kipawlpite namsau-a a kithatte tawh Misikhuo ah a kumsuh uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na thupi dan le na liet dan Eden um sunga singkungte lahah bang singkung tawh na kisun ei? Tu-in nang pen Eden singkungte tawh leinei ah ang kikhiesuh ding hi; nang pen namsau tawh a kithat tep kitan lo mite lahah na lum ding hi. Tam pen Pharaoh le ama’ mihonte ahi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm le nina, a hla sawm le ni, a ni masa ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Pharaoh le Egypt tunga Kaala"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh tungah kaateng lo inlen tam bangin ci in: Minamte lahah nang le nang humpi-in na kingaisun a, ahi vangin nang pen tuipite sunga gulhiempi tawh na kibang lel hi; nang in na luidung teng na tawhnawi a, na keng tawh tui lawhgawpin luidung teng na niehsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Mihon tampite tawh na tungah ka len ka khu ding hi; keima in ka len sungah nangma kang kainal ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in nang tuol sena-in hing nei-in, gamlahah kang pai ding a, na tungah vana leng vate hing khawlsahin, leitunga gamsa zosie in a kham tahun kang nesah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Muoltung tengah na sa ka thethang ding a, kuom sung teng na siluong tawh ka kidimsah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in na sisan luongte tawh gamlah le muoltung dong ka pahsah ding a, tui pulna teng zong na sisan tawh kidim ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang kang phietmai cieng in vante lia-in aasite ka mielsah ding hi; meii in ni ka liesah ding a, hla zong tang lo ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:10; Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Kln 6:12-13; 8:12"},"8":{"text":"Vantunga khuovah tang zosie na tungah ka mielsah ding a, na gam sungah mutzin ka tungsah ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Na thei ngai nai lo gama minamte lahah sal dinga kang kai ciengin, mi tampite’ lungsim ka buoisah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma ziehin mi tampi in lamdang ka sasah ding hi; amate mai-ah ka namsau ka vih ciengin nang ziehin kumpite zau-in citun ding uhi. Nang na pua ni ciengin a hin nading uh ngaisunin, a tatna popo vuah amate zau-in a citun ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Nangma ang do dingin Babylon kumpipa’ namsau ang kuon hi."},"12":{"text":"Minamte lahah amate zosie in a giin pen uh ahi mi thahatte’ namsau tawh na mihonte ka thatsah ding hi. Egypt’ kisahtheipi teng amate in a kisiesah ding vua, a mihon zosie uzong a sigam sieng ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in tui nienna gei-a om a ganhonte uh ka susie ding a, mihing’ keng le ganhing’ kecin in tua tui a niehsah ngai ta sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin amau’ tui ka cimsah ding a, sathau bangin a luidungte uh ka luongsah ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in Egypt gam khu gamkhing ka suohsah ding a, a sunga om zosie hawhkhie-in tua sunga teng zosie ka thagam ciengin, amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tami khu kaala ahi a, kaateng a kilo ding ahi hi. Minamte’ numeite in kaatengin a lo ding uhi. Egypt tung le a mihonte tungah tam bangin kaateng kilo ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A kum sawm le nina, a hla masa , a ni sawm le nga ni-in Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Egypt Tunga Sina La"},"18":{"text":"Mihing aw, Egypt mihonte adingin kap inlen, Hankhuh sunga a peisuh Egypt mite le minam thupite’ tanute tawh leinei gamah amate sawlsuh ta’n."},"19":{"text":"“Melhoina lamah koi na khupzo uh ahei? Kumsuh un! Tep kitan lote tawh kivui ton ta un!” ci in."},"20":{"text":"Namsau-a kithatte lahah amate a si ding uhi. Namsau-a si dingin Egypt kipie zo hi; ama le a mihonte a ni-un kaiphit un."},"21":{"text":"Misikhuo laikim panin a thahat uliente in a kithuopi teng utawh amate thu a gen ding uhi: “Amate ang peisuh zo ta vua, namsau-a kithat tep kitan lote tawh a lumton lai uhi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Namsau-a kithat misi zosie a opna khum munah Assyria le a kithuopi zosie a om vua, a kimvel vuah a hankhuhte uzong a om hi."},"23":{"text":"A hante uh Leihawm thuhpi sungah a om hi. A han kimvel vuah a kithuopite uh a om a, amate a unpi-un namsau-a kisatlia ahi uhi. Amate in gam sunga a hinglaite a patausah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum mun a han kimvela a om mihon zosie tawh Elam a om hi; amate a unpi-un namsau-a site ahi vua, tep zong kitan loin leinei gamah peisuhin gam sunga a hinglaite a patausah uhi. Leihawm sunga peisuhte tawh amate a maizum ton uhi."},"25":{"text":"A mihon zosie utawh a kithat tonte lahah amate in Elam ading lupna khat a bawl vua, a kimvel vuah a amau’ hante omin, amate pen a unpi-un tep tan lo namsau-a a site ahi uhi; azieh pen amate in a hingte’ gamah patauna omsahin Leihawm sunga a peisuhte tawh zumna a thuohton uhi; a kithat mite lahah amate kikoi hi."},"26":{"text":"Khum munah Meshech, Tubal, le a mihonte a om vua, a kimvel vuah a hankhuhte uh omin, amate a unpi-un tep tan lo namsau-a kithatte vive ahi uhi; azieh pen amate in a hingte’ gam a patausah uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amate pen Misikhuo ah a galvante utawh a peisa, a namsau uh a kitangkhapsah, a gute uh tunga a lumte uh a kikoipieh, tanglai-a a sisa galhangte tawh a kivui ton sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n nang ang kisat guoi ding a, tep kitan lote le namsau-a kithatte lahah ang kivui ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Edom zong a thahat ziehin namsau-a kithat a kumpite le a gam uhte tawh khum munah kivui ton a, Leihawm sunga a peisa tep kitan lote tawh a lumton uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua sungah leilu lam ulien zosie le Sidon mite zosie a om vua, a kithatte tawh maizum thuohin a peiton uhi, azieh pen a thahat ziehun amate in tam bang patauna zosie a piengsah uhi; tep kitan lo namsau-a kithatte tawh amate kivui tonin Leihawm sunga a peisuhte tawh zumna a thuoh ton uhi."},"31":{"text":"Pharaoh in amate a mu ciengin ama le a mihonte- Pharaoh le a galkap zosie- a kihenem zo tuom ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a hingte gamah patauna a piengsah hi; tua ahi ziehin Pharaoh le a mihon zosie, namsau-a kithatte tawh tep kitan lo mite lahah kivui ton ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 19:1-25; Jer 46:2-26"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Israel’ Galvil pa Ezekiel (Ezk 3:16-21)"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, na mite hopi inlen amate kungah tam bangin gen in. Keima in gam khatah namsau ka kuonsah a, tua gam mite in amate lah panin a galvil dingun mi khat se uhi;"},"3":{"text":"tuale galvil pa in gam sunga ang tung namsau mu-in pengkul mutin mite kungah a hilkhol a;"},"4":{"text":"tua ciengin mi khatpo in pengkul ging za napi-in hilkholna a thudon sih a, tuale namsau hing kuonin amate a thagam sieng leh, amau’ sisan amau’ lu tungah tu ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in pengkul ging za napi-in tua hilkholna a thudon sih uhi; amau’ sisan amate tungah a tu ding hi. Ahi vangin amate in tua hilkholna a thudon vua ahile a hinna uh a hundam zo ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin galvil pa in namsau ang kuon mu napi pengkul mut loin mite a hilkhol sih a, tuale namsau hing kuonin amate lahah mi khatpo a tha leh, amau’ khielna zieha si ahi vua, hizongle keima in galvil pa tungah amau’ sisan ka phul ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihing aw, keima in Israel innkuonte’ galvil pa dingin nang kang koi zo hi; ka kam sung panin thu na zah popo ciengin, kei kung pana pataukonate amate na hilsawn ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in migilote kungah, “Migilote aw, na si valon ding uhi,” ka ci a, tuale a lampi panun migilote ang kihei nadingin amate na galgih sih leh, amau’ khielna sungah migilote si ding a, ahi vangin nang kungah amau’ sisan kang phul ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang in a lampi panun migilote ang kiheikia nadingin na hilkhol a, tuale a lampi panun amate ang kihei nop sih uleh, a khielna sung vuah migilote si ding a, ahi vangin nang na hileh na hinna na hundam zo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing aw, tu-in Israel innkuonte kungah note in tam bangin na genzo uhi, ci-in gen in: “Eite in i tatkhielnate ule i mawnate uh i puola vua, amate ziehin i tha zawngkhal uhi; tua ahile eite bang i ci hinzo ding uh ahei?” na ci uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Thutanna le Hepina"},"11":{"text":"Amate kungah tam bangin gen in, Topa Pasien in ci hi. Kei a hing ka hi ma bangin, migilote’ sina ah ka kipah sih hi, tua sangin a gitlona panun migilote hing kinuale-in a hin ding uh ka deizaw hi; na gitlonate panun hing kinuale un, hing kinuale un; Israel innkuonte aw, bang dinga si ding na hi uh ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Tuale nang mihing aw, na mite kungah tam bangin gen in: Midihte in khielna a bawl uleh amau’ dihna in amate hundam lo ding hi; migilote a gitlona panun a kinuale uleh amau’ gitlona in amate puasah lo ding hi; tuale midihte a maw ciengin zong a amau’ dihna in amate a hingsah sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Midihte kungah pel loin na hing ding uhi, ka ci vangin amate in a dihna uh muongin khielna a bawl uleh a dih amau’ gamtatna khat zong kiphawpieh lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua banah keima in migilote kungah, “Note na si valon ding uhi,” ka ci vangin a mawna uh panin kinuale-in thuman thutangin a gamtat vua,"},"15":{"text":"migilote in vankhap lekia-in, a guhsa uh vante piekia-in hinna a pie thukhamte a zui vua, khielna a bawl nawn sih uleh, amate a hing valon ding a, a si sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate’ bawlsa mawnate khat zong amau’ siet nadingin kiphawkhah pieh nawn lo ding hi; amate thuman thutang tawh a gamta ahi vua, amate a hing valon ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle na mite in amau’ gamtat dan a man lo ciengin, “ Topa’ gamtat dan man lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Midihte amau’ dihna panin kinuale-in khielna a bawl uleh, khumi ziehin amate a si ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Migilote in a gitlona panun kinuale-in thuman le thutanga a gamtat uleh, khumi ziehin amate a hing ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hizongle note in, “ Topa gamtat dan a man sih hi,” na ci uhi. Israel innkuonte aw, note zosie tungah na gamtatna uh tawh kituohin thu kang khen ding hi!"},"21":{"text":"Ka saltan sung uh kum sawm le ni kum, a hla sawmna, a ni nga ni-in Jerusalem pana ang suohta mi khat ka kungah ang pei a, “Khuopi pua ta,” ei ci hi.","title":"Jerusalem Puana","ref":"2Kum 25:3-10; Jer 39:2-8; 52:4-14"},"22":{"text":"Tua galtai pa ang tun masang a nitahin ka tungah Topa’ khut ang om hi; hinanle zingmawngin ka kungah tua galtai pa ang tun hun tahin ama in ka kam ei honpieh zo ta hi; tuaci’n ka kam ang kihongin ham thei loin ka om nawn sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Judah Gama a Suohtate"},"24":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel gam sunga tenna lo-a a kinuasie tam mun tenga a teng mite in, “Abraham mi khat beh hi napi-in ama in tam gambup na luo hi; eite tampi i hizaw vua, tami gam i luo ding vua ei kipie tahtah ahi hi,” a ci den uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Note in a si pumin sa na ne vua, na milimte uh ento-in sisan na luongsah uhi; tua ahile tam bangpi ma tawh gam na luo thei ding uh amah?"},"26":{"text":"Note in na namsaute uh na suong vua, micin in na innvengte ciet uh’ zi na buasah uhi; tua ahile tam bangpi-in gam luo thei ding na hi uh amah?"},"27":{"text":"Amate kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in tami thu gen in: Keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, koima’ tenna lo-a a kinuasie mun tenga om mite namsau-in a si valon ding uhi; tuale gamlahah a omte gamsate neh dingin ka pie ding a, mun muonhuoite le suonghawm sunga omte pen pulnatna tawh a si ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua gam pen a kinuasie gamkhing ka suohsah ding a, ama’ kisahtheipi a thahatna a tawp sieng ding hi; Israel muolte gamdai luo ahi ziehin koima in a nawh kha nawn sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in a gam uh tenna lo gamkhing ka suosah ciengin a sil mudahuoi bawl zosie ziehun amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Mihing aw, kawm gei le inn kotkhah tengah nang tungtang thu na gam mite khatlekhat a kiholim vua, a innvengte ciet uh kungah, “Hing pei unlen, Topa kung pana ang tung thu ngai va vui,” a kici uhi."},"31":{"text":"Mite pei bangin amate zong ang pei-in ka mite bangin na mai-ah ang to uhi. Tuale na thute a ngai vua, ahi vangin amate in a mang sih ding uhi. Azieh pen a kampi utawh mi a pawh vua, ahi vangin a lungsim sung vuah amau’ nga nading beh a ngaisun uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate dingin nang pen a awngai mama, tumging khat hoitahin tumin zawllate a mau hiuhiau mipa khat tawh na kibang hi; amate in na thugente a zah bangun a zui tuom sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tami thu ang tangtun ciengin- tuale ang tangtung ding hi! -tuaci’n amate in note lahah kamsang khat a om zo ahi lam ang thei ding uhi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"A Zuouthei Israel’ Tuucingte"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel’ tuucingte langkhatah thu phuong in: Thu phuong inlen amate kungah-tuucingte kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Noma le noma a kivah Israel tuucingte aw, gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Tuucingte in a tuute uh a vah ding hizaw lo amah?"},"3":{"text":"Note in a thaute na ne vua, tuumul puonte silin a no thaute na go uhi; ahi vangin note in tuute lah na vah tuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Note in a thahat lote na hatsah sih vua, a cinate zong damsah loin, a liemte’ hima puonin na tunpieh sih vua, a lampielte hawikia loin, a mangte na sui sih vua, pauhat thawthu le thagum hatna tawh na uh zawsop uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuucing a op lo ziehin amate a kithethang sieng uhi; tuale a kithetang vua, gamsa zosiete’ an a suoh ta uhi.","ref":"Gam 27:17; 1Kum 22:17; 2Khg 18:16; Mat 9:36; Mrk 6:34"},"6":{"text":"Ka tuute a kithethang sieng vua, muol le tangcin tengah a vahthap uhi; lei maitang mun zosie ah ka tuute kithethangin amate a sui ding le a hawi ding koima a om sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin no tuucingte aw, Topa’ thugen za un:"},"8":{"text":"Keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, ka tuucingte in ka tuute a sui tah zawh sangin ka tuucingte amau le amau a kiva vua, ka tuute a va lo ziehun tuucing a om ta sih hi; tua ahi ziehin gamsate in ka tuute manin gamsa zosie’ an a suoh ta uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin no tuucingte aw, Topa’ kammal za un:"},"10":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Keima tuucingte langkhatah ka pang ding hi; ka tuute amau’ khut sung panin ngenin a tuu a vahna uh panin amate ka khawlsah ding hi; tuucingte amau le amau a kivah nawn sih ding vua, amau’ an a suo lo nadingin a kam sung panun ka tuute ka hunkhie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Kei mama in ka tuute ka sui ding a, amate ka mukhie ding hi.","title":"Pasien, a Man Tuucingpa"},"12":{"text":"Tuucingte in a kithethang tuute lahah a tuuhonte a sui uh bangin, keima in ka tuute ka sui ding hi. Meiilum kai ni le khuomiel ni ciengin a kithezahna uh mun zosie panin amate ka hunkhie ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mite lah panin amate ka ladawh ding a, gam tuomtuomte panin kaikhawmin amau’ gamah ka puoh ding hi. Keima in Israel muoltung, tui pulna gei le amau’ gam sunga mi tenna mun zosie ah amate ka vah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Lohing hoite tawh amate ka vah ding a, Israel muolsang cinteng pen amau’ an maina mun ahi ding hi; an maina mun hoi khatah amate lum ding a, Israel muolsang cinteng lohing tamna munah an a mai ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Kei mama ka tuute a cing pa ka hi ding a, amate ka lumsah ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima in a mangte sui-in lampielte ka nuakai ding a, a liemte a hima ka tunpieh ding hi; keima in a thahat lote ka thahatsah ding a, ahi vangin a thaute le a thahatte ka susie ding hi. Keima in thutang tawh amate ka vah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"No ka tuute aw, Topa Pasien in note tawh kisai-in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in tuu le tuu kikal, tuutang le keeltangte kikalah thu ka khen ding hi:"},"18":{"text":"Note lohing hoite tawh ang kiva a, hizongle a omlai na lohingte uh na keng utawh na totcil uh pen no adingin pha zo ta hi lo amah? Tuiciim na dawn uh ciengin a omlai teng na keng utawh niehsah hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"19":{"text":"Ka tuute in na keng utawh na totcilsate uh ne-in na keng utawh na totniehsa uh tuite dawn ding uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in amate kungah tam bangin gen hi: Kei mama in ka tuu thaute le ka tuu gawngte kikalah thu ka khen ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in na pang ule na liengko utawh a hatmaw ganta teng zosie sawnnawpin muncin tengah na thethang sieng masangun na ki utawh na pih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in ka tuute ka hundam ding a, amate kibawlsie nawn lo ding hi.
