Keima in tuu le tuu kikalah thu ka khen ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate tungah a uh dingin tuucing khat, ka nasem pa David ka koi ding a, ama in amate a vah ding hi: Ama in amate vah ding a, amau’ tuucing pa hi ding hi.","ref":"Kln 7:17"},"24":{"text":"Keima Topa pen amau’ Pasien ka hi ding a, ka nasem pa David pen amate lahah a uhpa hi ding hi, keima, Topa in ka gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Ezk 37:24"},"25":{"text":"Sing nei gam muolah amate tengin lungmuong taha a lup thei nadingun amate tawh kilemna thuciemna khat ka bawl ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate le ka muol kimvela muoltung gam teng thupha ngana ka hisah ding hi; tuale keima in a hun zui-in guotui ka zusah ding a, tuate pen thupha guotui hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Lozau-a singkungte a ga a ga ding a, leitang in an tampitah piengsahin leitang tungah amate lungmuong tahin a om ding uhi. Keima in a kolnamte uh ka sattawng ding a, sala a khawite khut sung panin amate ka hutdam ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate pen minamte in tomgamin amate a om nawn sih ding vua, tua gama ganhingte in amate a ne nawn sih ding hi; amate koima in zausah nawn loin hlamuong tahin a teng ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"A gam sung vuah amate a kielsi nawn lo nadingun amate adingin keima in um thupi khat ka bawlpieh ding a, minamte’ simmaw a thuoh nawn sih ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in keima Topa a Pasien uh, amate tawh a omton ka hi lam ei thei ding vua, Israel innkuonte keima’ mi ahi uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"31":{"text":"No ka tuute, ka lonona-a ka tuute na hi vua, kei pen na Pasien uh ka hi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Sier Muoltunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Sier Muol lam nga inlen ama langkhatah thu phuong in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in ama kungah gen in: Sier Muol aw, nang kang langpang hi; a kinuasie gamkhing na suo nadingin nang langkhatah ka khut ka zah hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in na khuopite ka siesah ding hi; nang gamkhing na suoh ding a, tuale nangma in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nang in tanglai kigalneina na pom a, Israel mite in a nukhia pen dan a thuoh hun ule a tuosiet hun lai-un a thahat namsau-a tha dingin amate na pie hi;"},"6":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in a cina-ah, keima a hing ka hi ma bangin na sisan ka luongsah ding a, tua sisan in nang ang sulzui ding hi; nang in sisan luonsahna na muda lo ziehin sisan luonna in nang ang sulzui ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in Seir Muol pen a kinuasie gamkhing ka suohsah ding a, khum sunga vaitung vaikuon zosie ka sumaimang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in a muoltung teng misi luong tawh ka dimsah ding hi; na muol na kuom le na tui pulna cintengah namsau-a kithatte a puamat ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nang pen gamkhingin kang bawl peisuoh ding a, na khuopite ah mi teng ngai nawn lo ding hi. Tua ciengin keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile khum munah Topa a op nangawnin nang in, “Tami minam ni le tami gam ni tegel kei ading ahi a, tuate i luo dingin i la ding hi,” na ci a,"},"11":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin keima a hing ka hi ma bangin, amate langkhatah na muda zieha na lah lungthahna le hazatna tawh kituohin keima in nangma tungah kang bawl ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi. Keima in na tungah thu kang khen ciengin note lahah kei le kei kang kitheisah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma in, “Amate gamkhing a suoh ta vua, i nawmval dinga ei kipie ahi ta hi,” ci-in Israel muolte langkhatah simmawna kammal na gen zosiete, keima Topa in ka zah zo lam na thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma in keima langkhatah na kammalte na khan semsem a, keima langkhatah na thu na pop gen semsem hi; keima in tuate ka za zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Leitung bup a kipah ziehun keima in nang gamkhing kang suohsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel innkuon’ gouluo gamkhing a kisuosahna tungah na lungdam ziehin, tua bangma-in nang tungah kang bawl ding hi; nangma le Seir Muol le Edom gam zosie na unpi-un gamkhing na suoh ding uhi. Tua ciengin keima Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang mihing aw, Israel muol teng kungah thu phuong inlen tam bangin gen in: Israel muolte aw, Topa’ kammal za un.","title":"Israel tunga Thupha"},"2":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na galte un note tungah, “Hiei lah! “Tanglai-a munsangte khu eite luo ding hi ta hi,” a ci vua,"},"3":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin thu phuong inlen tam bangin gen in: Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: A omlai minamte’ neisa na suo thei nadingun amate in note gamkhing ang suohsah vua, na ziet na vei vuah ang netcip ziehun, minamte lahah holim nopna le gensietin na om ta uhi;"},"4":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin Israel muolte aw, Topa Pasien’ thugen za un: Topa Pasien in muol le tangte, tui pulnate le hawhguomte, a kinuasie gamkhingte, na kimvela minam omlai teng in bulu-in ciemmui nopna-a a neite uh tungah tam bangin a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: A lohing ziehin ka gam bulu-in kipah lungdamna le nahpi tahin simmawna tawh amau’ luo dingin a lah ziehun, keima in ka thangsiet luotna tawh a omlai minamte le Edom-te zosie tungah langpanna thu ka gen hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel gam tawh kisai-in thu phuong inlen, muol le tangte, tui pulnate le hawhguomte kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Minamte’ hosiet thuoh zo na hi ziehun engsiet thangpaina tawh thu ka gen hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na kimvel zosie vua om minamte in amau le amau in zakona a thuoh ding uhi, ci-in ka kiciem hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel muolte aw, no ka mi Israel adingin na bate uh zamin na ga ding uhi; azieh pen amate in inn ang zuon bai ta ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in en un, no lamah kei ka pang hi; mite in nang pen loin kang hlosah ding a, khaici tuna-in kang neisah ding hi;"},"10":{"text":"tuale na mimal phaza uh kang pungsah ding a, Israel innkuon buppi a unpi-un ka pungsah ding hi; khuopite ah mi teng ding a, a kinuasiesa mun teng zong kilamkia ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"tuale note sungah a mihing a ganhingin kang pungsah ding hi. Amate pungin a cipha ding uhi; nidang lai bangma-in mi ten thei nadingin kang bawl ding a, na tung vuah nidang sangin sil hoi kang bawlzaw lai ding hi. Tua ciengin keima Topa ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Note tungah ka mi Israel-te ka vahsah ding a, amate in note hing nei-in amau’ gou na hi ding uhi. Ta le nau nei loin amate na omsah nawn sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: A zieh pen amate in na kungah, “Mite na nekhawng a, na mite ta le nau nei loin na koi ta hi,” ang ci vua,"},"14":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin mi na nekhawng nawn sih ding a, na mite zong ta le nau nei loin na koi nawn sih ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte’ hosietnate kang zasah nawn sih ding a, mite’ simmaw nuoisie hing thuohsah loin na mite ka puasah nawn sih ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi.","title":"Israel’ Thasuona"},"17":{"text":"Mihing aw, amau’ leitanga a ten lai-un Israel innkuonte in a gamtat a silbawlte utawh a gam uh a buasah uhi; keima muna-ah amau’ gamtatna pen a nin nei huna numei khat’ sientho lona tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in gam sungah sisan a luonsahna ule milimte tawh a gam uh a buasah ziehun amate tungah ka thangpaina ka sunghla ding hi"},"19":{"text":"Minamte lahah amate ka thethang ding a, gamcin tengah a kithezah ding uhi; amau’ gamtatna le a silbawlte utawh kituohin amate tungah thu ka khen hi."},"20":{"text":"Hizongle amate, minamte kungah a pei ciengun a peina popo vuah ka min siengtho a buasah vua, “Tamte Topa’ mite ahi vua, hinanle ama gam panin amate a peikhie uhi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanle Israel innkuonte in a tunna uh minamte lahah a buasah uh ka min siengtho ka lunghimawpi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel innkuonte kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Israel innkuonte aw, ka sil bawl ding pen note zieh hi loin, minamte kunga nang pei cieng vua na buasah uh ka min siengtho zieh ahi zaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima in minamte lahah na buasahsa uh a lien ka min ka siensuo ding a, note tungtawnin amate mai-ah ka sienthona ka lah ciengin, minamte in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Keima in minamte lahah note hing ladawhin gamcin teng panin kang kaikhawm ding a, na gam vuah kang peipi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note tungah tuisieng kang the ding a, na buanate uh, na sientho lona zosie ule na milim zosie uh panin note na siengtho ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Keima in note lungtang tha kang pie ding a, note sungah hlagau tha kang guong ding hi; keima in na pum tung panun suong lungtang ladawhin tahsa lungtang kang pie ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Note sungah ka hlagau ka guong ding a, ka thukhamte hing zuisahin ka ngaina kipte pilvang tahin kang tangsah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin na pu na pate uh kunga ka piehsa gam sungah na teng ding uhi; tuale note keima’ mi na hi ding vua, keima zong noma’ Pasien ka hi ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 11:19-20"},"29":{"text":"Keima in na buana zosie uh panin hing hunin an le tuite thuta-in a kiningcingin kang omsah ding a, na tung vuah kiel ka tungsah sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Minamte lahah gilkiel mindaina na thuoh nawn lo nadingun singkungte ka gasah ding a, na lo vuah an ka niengsah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin note in na gamtat hoi lote ule na silbawl uh a hoi lote na phawhkia ding uhi; tuale na khielna ule na sil mudahuoi bawlnate uh ziehin no le no na kikidah ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tami ka bawlna pen note zieh ahi lo lam kithei ta un, Topa Pasien in ci hi. Israel innkuonte aw, na gamtatnate ziehun maizum unlen patau un."},"33":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Na khielna zosie uh panin kang siensuo ni ciengin na khuopite vuah mi tengkia-in a kinuasiesa munte kilampha ding hi."},"34":{"text":"A nawhkha mi zosie’ muna-ah gamkhing ahi ngai vangin tua gamkhing loin kihlo ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in, “Tami gamkhing Eden um tawh kibang ta hi; tu-in a kinuasiesa gamkhing le a kisiesa khuopite tenna-in kinei-in kulpite tawh ki-im ta hi,” ci ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin na kimvel vua a kinuasie minamte in, keima Topa in a kisiesa khuopi lamphakia-in gamkhingte a hlosahkia pa ka hi lam a thei ding uhi. Keima, Topa in ka gensa ahi a, ka sem ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: A mimal uh tuuhon banga a pun nadingin, amate adinga tami zong ka bawlpieh nadingin Israel innkuonte in keima kungah ka ngensah ding hi."},"38":{"text":"A kisiesa khuopite ahile biehpiehna dinga a kitawi tuuhonte bang le a kisesa pawi hun cienga Jerusalem-a a kipie tuuhonte bangin mihonpi tawh kidim ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ khut ka tungah ang om a, Topa’ hlagau tawh ama in ei peipi-in kuom laikimah ei tutsuh hi; tua kuom pen misi gute tawh kidim hi.","title":"Gugawta Opna Kuompi"},"2":{"text":"Ama in tua kimvel tengah ei peipi kawikawi hi; tua kuom sungah gu le tang tampitah om leulo a, tua gute gawta thei mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, tami gute a hing thei diei mah? ei ci hi. Keima in, “ Topa Pasien aw, nangma in na thei hi,” ci-in ka dawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “Tami gute tungah thu phuong inlen amate kungah, “A gawta gute aw, Topa’ kammal za un."},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tami gute kungah tam bangin a gen hi: Note sungah naahu hing lutsahin note na hing ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Note tungah thagui koi-in na tung vuah tel le vo kang omsah ding a, vun in kang tuomsah ding hi. Note sungah naahu koi-in na hing ding uhi; tuaci’n keima Topa ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi,” ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei in zong ei kisawl bangin thu ka phuong hi; ka thu phuon ka gen hun sungin sil kigawi valuoi ging khat ka za a, tuale husa khat thakhatin ang omin, tuale gute in amau’ gu ciet ang zuon uhi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in ka en leh amate tungah thagui ang om a, satel ang omkia-in vun in tuate ang tuom hi; hizongle amau’ sungah naahu om nai lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, naahu tungah thu phuong in, thu phuong inlen naahu kungah tam bangin gen in: Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Naahu aw, hui ningli panin hing pei-inlen amate a hin thei nadingin tam mi kithatte tungah na hu sang in,” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama’ ei sawl bangin thu ka phuong a, amate sungah naahu lutin ang hing vua, a keng utawh ang din ciengun a hon tampitah ang pha uhi.","ref":"Kln 11:11"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, tami gute pen Israel innkuon buppi ahi uhi. Amate in, ‘Ka gute uh a gawta sieng ta a, ka kinepna uh om nawn loin ei kisumaimang ta hi,’ a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nang in thu phuong inlen, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in amate kungah gen in: Ka mite aw, na hankhuhte uh hongin na hankhuh panun note kang lakhie to ding hi; tuale keima in note Israel gamah kang peipikia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite aw, na hankhuhte uh hongin na hankhuhte panun note kang lahkhiet to ciengin note in keima Topa ka hi lam nei thei ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Note sungah ka hlagau guongin na hing ding vua, keima in na leitang vuah note kang koikia ding hi; tua ciengin ka gensa ahi a, ka bawl ding hi, a ci keima Topa ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi,” Topa in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Ciengkang Ni"},"16":{"text":"Mihing aw, cieng khat la inlen tua tungah, “Judah le a kipawlpi Israel-te ading,” ci-in giel in; tua ciengin cieng adang khat la leuleu inlen tua tungah, “Joseph (Ephraim’ cieng) le a kipawlpi Israel innkuon zosie ading,” ci-in giel in;"},"17":{"text":"na khut sungah tua tegel cieng khat a suo thei nadingin cieng khat tungah a khat zom in."},"18":{"text":"Tuale na mite in na kungah, “Tamte bang na cinopna ahei, kote ei gen lo ding na mah?” ang ci ciengun,"},"19":{"text":"nangma in amate kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Keima in Joseph’ cieng (Ephraim khut sunga om) le a kipawlpi Israel minamte’ cieng ka la ding a, ka khut sungah ama gel khat a suo thei nadingin tua tungah Judah cieng ka koi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate muna-ah a tunga lai na giel ciengte na khut sungah ang op ciengin,"},"21":{"text":"amate kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Keima in amate peina minamte lahah Israel mite ladawhin ka peipi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in gamsung Israel muoltung tengah amate minam khatin ka bawl ding hi; tuale amate zosie tungah kumpi khat in a uh ding hi. Amate minam ni ahi ngai nawn sih ding vua, kumpi gam ni-in zong a kikhen ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"A milimte ule a sil mudahuoite utawh ahi a, a tatkhielnate utawh ahi zongin amate kibuasah ngai nawn lo ding hi. Amate a nuatolna ziehun amau’ puana panin keima in hundamin ka siensuo ding hi. Tua ciengin amate keima’ mite hi ding a, kei, amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate tungah ka nasempa David in kumpi sem ding hi; tuale amate in a unpi-un tuucing khat nei ding uhi. Amate in ka ngaina kipte zui-in ka thukhamte zong limtahin a tang ding uhi.","ref":"Ezk 34:24"},"25":{"text":"Keima in ka nasempa Jacob ka piehsa na pu na pate uh’ tenna gamah amate a teng ding uhi; khum munah amate le a tate ule a tute uh a teng zing ta ding uhi; tuale ka nasempa David in amate a uh zing ta ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Keima in amate tawh kilemna thuciemna ka bawl ding hi; tua pen amate tawh ka bawl kumtawn thuciemna hi ding hi. Keima in amate thupha pie-in ka pungsah ding a, amate lahah kumtawnin ka mun siengtho ka koi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate tawh ka tenna mun a omton ding hi; kei amau’ Pasien ka hi ding a, amate keima’ mi ahi ding uhi.","ref":"2Cor 6:16; Kln 21:3"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate lahah kumtawnin ka mun siengtho a op ciengin keima Israel a siensuo Topa ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka kungah ang tung hi:","title":"Gog’ Busimna"},"2":{"text":"Mihing aw, Magog gam sunga Meshech le Tubal uhpipa Gog lam nga inlen ama langkhatah thu phuong in.","ref":"Kln 20:8"},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Meshech le Tubal’ uhpipa Gog aw, nang kang langpang hi;"},"4":{"text":"keima in na khagu ah siakawi bulin kang lehei ding a, a unpi-un galvan a sil na galkapte zosie, na sakolte, sakol tung tuong siemte, a unpi-un lum le phaw le namsau tawi mi honpite tawh kang peipi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate tawh Persia, Ethiopia, le Put-te a kipawl vua, a unpi-un lum le phaw tawh ahi uhi;"},"6":{"text":"Gomer le a galkap zosie, a gamla pen leilu lama a om Beth-togarmah le a galkapte zosiete tawh mi tampite in nang ang pawl uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma le na kimvela ang ki khawm mihonpi zosie, kiging unlen a baisa-in om unlen amate cingin pang in."},"8":{"text":"Ni tampi zaw ciengin note ang kikhawmkia ding hi; sawt veipi lai-a gamkhing a suohsa, Israel muolte tunga om minamte pana kikaikhawm, gal sunga a suohtate’ gam khat kum tampi zaw ciengin na va sim ta ding hi; a mite pen minamte pana kipeipi ahi a, tu-in amate a unpi-un lungmuong tahin a teng uhi."},"9":{"text":"Huipi lang bangin na kuon ding a, nangma le na galkap zosie, le nangma tawh a omton mi tampite, gam sung a tuom meii tawh na kibang ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Khum ni ciengin na lungsim ah ngaisutna khat ang suoh ding a, a hoi lo gelna khat na sawm ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma in, “Kulpi a nei lo khuote opna gam khat sim dingin ka kuonto ding hi; lungmuong taha a om hit hiet, a unpi-un kulpi, tunkotgol le tunkot a nei lo mite tungah ka tusuh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A nei a lamte uh tomgamin ka puomang ding hi; tu-in mite tenna ahi a kinuasiesa munte, le minam tuomtuomte tung pan kaikhawmin ganhing le neisa a hau leitung laikimah a tengte ka sim ding hi,” na ci ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Sheba, Dedan, Tarshish sumbawlte le tangval galhangte zosie in nangma kungah, “Van lahpieh dinga ang kuon na hi uh amah? Vante puo ding le ngun le kham puomang ding, ganhonte le vante puo ding, van a tampitah tomgam dingin na mihonte na khawmtuo zo ta amah?” ang ci ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mihing aw, thu phuong inlen Gog kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Khum ni ciengin ka mi Israel-te lungmuong tahin a ten ciengun nang le nang na kisatsuo ding a,"},"15":{"text":"leilu lam a gamla pen na opna mun panin nang le mi tampite, a unpi-un sakol tunga tuong a thahat galkap hon tampite tawh na kuon ding hi;"},"16":{"text":"tuale meiipi in leitung a tuom bangin ka mi Israel-te sim dingin nang kuonto ding hi. Hun nukhia lam ciengin ka gamsung sim dingin kang peipi ding a, tuaci’n Gog aw, minamte in nang tungtawnin kei ei thei uh ciengin amate muna-ah ka sienthona ka lah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi. Nidang lai pana ka nasem Israel kamsangte kungah ka gensa, amate do dingin kang sawl ding hi, ci-in nidang lai kum tampi sung ka na phuongzahsah pa khu nang na hi amah?","title":"Gog tunga Thukhenna"},"18":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Israel gam sim dingin Gog ang kuon ciengin ka thangpaina a kuong ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen ka thangsiet zieh le ka sin a so ziehin tam bangin ka genzah ding hi: Khum ni ciengin Israel gam sungah zil nahpi tahin ling ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"tuipi sunga ngate, vana leng vate, gamlaha ganhingte, tuola a kithol ganhingte, le leitunga a om mi zosie ka mai-ah a citun ding vua, muol sangte pua-in kentawngte cim ding a, kul zosie tuol ah a puamat ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in muolsang zosie sungah Gog tawh a kido dingin namsau ka ko ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi; tuale mi zosie’ namsau in amau’ kithuopite a do ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in pulnatna le sisan luonna tawh ama tungah thukhenna ka nei ding hi; ama le a galkapte tung le ama tawh a omton mi tampite tungah guopi gielpite le kaat le meikuongte ka zusah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in ka lietna le ka sienthona ka lah ding a, minam tampite’ mitmu-in keima le keima ka kilah ding hi. Tua ciengin amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale mihing aw, Gog langkhat ah thu phuong inlen, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Meshech le Tubal’ uhpipa Gog aw, nang kang langpan hi!","title":"Gog’ Galkapte Kisusie"},"2":{"text":"Keima in nang hing kiheisahin mailam nawhin kang notmang ding a, leilu lam gammong pen panin hing peipito-in Israel muolte do dingin kang pui ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na veilam khuta na tawi na thalpi kang behpieh ding a, na zietlam khuta na tawi na thaltangte ka kiesah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel muoltung tengah nangma le na galkapte zosie le nangma tawh ang omton na mite a puamat sieng ding uhi; keima in sasiel ne va namcin le gamsate nehtum dingin nang kang pie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Gamlahah note na puamat ding uhi; azieh pen ka gensa ahi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in Magog le tuipi gei-a lungmuong taha a tengte tungah meikuong ka sawl ding a, tuaci’n amate in keima Topa ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Keima’ mi Israel-te lahah ka min siengtho ka kitheisah ding a, ka min siengtho ka buasah ngai nawn sih ding hi; tuale minamte in Israel sunga a Siengtho Topa , ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun ang tung ta hi! Tua hun ang pieng ta hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi. Ka gensa khu tami ni ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Israel khuopite sunga a tengte kuonkhie ding a, a galvante uh- lum le phawte, thal le thaltangte, cienghiemte le teipite - kum sagi sung mei-ah vangin a haltum ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Gamlah ah singtom kul loin gammang lahah sing phua ding zong a kisam sih ding uhi, azieh pen amate in a galvante uh mei-in a taw ding uhi; amate a susiete susie-in, amau’ na a lahpiehte’ na a lahpieh ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Israel gam sung tuipi nisuona lama Khuolzinte Kuom a kici munah Gog a kivui nading mun ka pie ding hi; tua in khuolzinte lampi khahtan ding hi, azieh pen khumnah Gog le a mihonte zosie kivui ding hi; khum mun pen Hamon-gog Kuom kici ding hi.","title":"Gog a Kivuina"},"12":{"text":"Israel innkuonte in a gamsung uh a siensuo nadingun hla sagi sung amate vui ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Gam sunga a om mi zosie in amate vui ding uhi; keima in ka minthanna ka lah ni ciengin amate in tua ziehin patawina a nga ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in gamsung tenga a vah kawikawi ding mi a tuomkoi ding vua, gamsung a siengtho nadingin leitang tunga a omlai gamkeh mite’ luong khat popo a vui ding uhi; amate in hla sagi sung a sui ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Misuite a gam sungah vah kawikawi-in khat penpen in misi gu khat a mu leh mi sivuite in Hamon-gog Kuomah a vui masangin a gei-ah ciemtena khat a phut ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"(Khum munah Hamonah khuopi zong a om hi.) Khum bangin amate in a gam sung uh a siensuo ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing aw, nangma tawh kisai-in Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Va namcin le gamsa zosie kungah tam bangin gen in: Hing kikhawm unlen hing pei un. Israel muolte tungah note adinga ka bawl biehpiehna pawi lienpi sim dingin na kimvel zosie panun ang kisutuo-in note in a sa ne-in a si na dawn ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Note in mi thahatte’ sa na ne ding vua, leitung gam uhte’ sisan- tuutangte, tuunote, keelte le bawngtangte’ sisan na dawn ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Note dinga kang bawlpieh kithoina pawi ah na gilva dongun a thaute na ne ding vua, na kham masangsie-un sisante na dawn ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale note in ka sabuoi tungah sakolte le sakol tung tuong siemte, galhangte le galkap namcinte tawh khamtahin na ne ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Kln 19:17-18"},"21":{"text":"Keima in minamte lahah ka vang lietna ka kilangsah ding hi; minamte zosie in amate tungah ka khut ngamin ka thukhenna a mu ding uhi.","title":"Israel Gam Kipiekia"},"22":{"text":"Khum ni-a kipanin Israel innkuonte in keima Topa Pasien ka hi lam ei thei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Israel innkuonte in keima tungah muonhuoi lo tahin ei bawl zieh ule amau’ khielna ziehin minamte in amate sala kikai ahi lam a thei ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Keima in amau’ sientho lona le a khielnate utawh kituohin amate ka thuohsah a, amate kung panin ka mai ka phuol hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Tu-in keima in Jacob’ vangphatnate ka piekia ding a, Israel innkuon zosie hepi-in ka min siengtho adingin ka laina ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A gam sung vuah lungmuong tahin tengin koima in amate a zausah nawn lo hun ciengin keima ei do nadinga amau’ gamtatnate ahi keima ei lebawlna zosie ule amau’ maizumnate a mangngil ta ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Minamte lah panin amate ka peipikia a, a galte uh’ gam panin ka kaikhop lai-in keima in amau’ tungtawnin minam tampite mai-ah ka sienthona ka kilangsah zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin minamte lahah saltang dingin amate ka sawl zieh le, tua ciengin amau’ gamah ka khoptuokia ziehin keima Topa Pasien ka hi lam amate in ei thei ding uhi. Keima in amate khat beh ka nuasie sih ding hi;"},"29":{"text":"tuale keima in Israel innkuon tungah ka hlagau ka buohsuh ciengin amate kung panin ka mai ka phuol ngai nawn sih ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khuopi a kisuhsiet zaw a kum sawm le lina kum, ka saltan zaw uh a kum sawmni le ngana kum kipat cil tua hla a ni sawmni, khum ni lien ma-in keima tungah Topa’ khut ang om a, ama in khum sungah keima ei peipi hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Tha Mangmuna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Pasien’ mangmuna ziehin Israel gam ei tutin muolsang mama tung khatah ei koi hi. Khum muolsang’ leitaw lamah khuopi tawh kibang khat a om hi.","ref":"Kln 21:10"},"3":{"text":"Ama in khum sungah ei tut ciengin a mel puohdan sumngo-a kisiem tawh a kibang pasal khat na om a, ama in a khut sungah pikhau khat le picieng khat a tawi hi; tuale tunkot lutna lampi-ah ama na ding hi.","ref":"Kln 11:1; 21:15"},"4":{"text":"Tua pa in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, hoi tahin enin limtahin ngai inlen, keima in kang lah ding zosie na lungsim sungah koi in, azieh pen tami thu nangma kunga kang lah thei nadinga tam sunga kang peipi ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Biehinnpi huong a pulam kimvel zosie ah kulpi a om hi. Tua mi pa’ khuta a tawi picieng pen tong guh sau a, a tena khat ta pen tong khat le zabeh sau hi; tuaci’n ama in kulpi te a, kulpi a sana picieng tan khat pha a, picieng khat ma sang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin nisuona lam a kinga tunkot lutna lampi ah lutin a kaleite ah kato a, tunkot lutna a te leh picieng tan khat a pha hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuanah inndante om a, inndan khat a vailam picieng khat cie pha a, a dunglam zong picieng khat cie ma pha hi; inndante kikal tong nga kihal hi; tuale a sungtawng talaap gei-a a om tunkot vang pen picieng khat cie pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tunkot lutna talaap a sung lam a te leh tong khat pha hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tunkot lutna talaap te a, tong giet pha-in a khuomte tong ni sa hi; tuale tunkot talaap pen a sung tawng lamah a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Nisuona lam tunkot pang tuohah inndan thum tuoh om hi; a thumin a golna kikimin a kikala khuomte zong a golna kibang ciet hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin lutna tunkot a vang laitah a te leh tong sawm pha hi; tuale tunkot vailam pen tong sawm le thum pha hi."},"12":{"text":"Inndante’ mai ah thaw kikai a, alang ni-in tong khat tuoh ahi hi; alangni-a inndante zong tong guh ciet pha hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in inndan nualam panin adang inndan nualam dongin tunkot a te leh a kawm khat panin a kawm khat dong a golna tong sawmni le nga pha hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in talaap zong te a, tong sawmni a pha hi; tuale ama in inntuol pang zosie-a om tunkot khuompi bana tunkot zong a te hi."},"15":{"text":"Tunkot lutna mai panin a sunglam tunkot talaap sungnung dong tong sawmnga ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Inndante le a khuomte in tawlette nei a, tunkot lutna lampi in a sung lam kimvelah a vang neute nei hi; tuale talaapte in zong a sunglam kimvel zosie ah tawlette nei a, khuomte tungah lutu kung lim kizem hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leituol pulam ah ei peipi hi; tua sungah inndante le leituol kimvelah suongpha na om hi; tuale inndan sawmthumte in tua suongpha tung lam a kinga uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua suongpha pen tunkot pang tengah tunkot dung tantan a kipha ahi a, tam pen suongpha neinung pen ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin tunkot neinung a sunglam mai panin leituol sungnung pulam mai dong a gamlatna a te leh tong zakhat a pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leilu lam kinga a pulam leituol peina tunkot adung avai te hi."},"21":{"text":"A pang tuohah inndan thum tuoh om a, a khuomte le a talaap a gol dan pen amasa tunkot tawh kikim hi; adung tong sawmnga pha a, avai tong sawmni le nga pha hi."},"22":{"text":"A tawlette, a talaap, le a lutu kungte a gol dan pen nisuona lam kinga tunkotte tawh kikim hi. Tua tunkot kato nadingin ciel sagi a nei kalei khat kidaw a, a sungah a talaap a om hi."},"23":{"text":"Nisuona lama ma bangin, leilu lama tunkot tawh kigalsai-ah leituol sungnung lutna tunkot a om hi; ama in tunkot khatlekhat kikal a te leh tong zakhat pha hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leitaw lam manaw-in ei peipi a, leitaw lamah tunkot khat na om hi; ama in a khuomte le a talaap a te leh a gol dan pen tunkot dangte tawh kikim hi."},"25":{"text":"Adangte ah tawlet a op ma bangin a sung kimvel le a talaap sung lamah tawlette om hi; adung tong sawmnga pha a, avai tong sawmni le nga pha hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua tunkot kato nadingin ciel sagi a nei kalei khat kidaw a, a sungah a talaap a om hi. A langkhat tuohah lutu kunga kizem khuom khat tuoh a om hi."},"27":{"text":"Leituol sungnung leitaw lamah tunkot khat om hi; tunkotte kikal a te leh tong zakhat pha hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leitaw lam tunkot gei-a om leituol sungnung lamah ei peipi a, leitaw lam tunkot a te hi; a gol dan pen adangte ma tawh kikim hi."},"29":{"text":"A inndante, a khuomte, le a talaapte pen adangte tawh a golna kikim hi; tuale a sung kimvel le a talaap sungah tawlette a om hi; adung tong sawmnga pha a, avai tong sawmni le nga pha hi."},"30":{"text":"A kimvelah talaapte om a, adung tong sawmni le nga pha a, avai tong nga pha hi."},"31":{"text":"A talaap pen leituol pulam kinga a, a khuomte tungah lutu kungte omin a kalei in ciel giet nei hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in nisuona lam panga a om leituol sungnung lamah ei peipi a, tunkot a te hi; a gol dan pen adangte ma tawh kikim hi."},"33":{"text":"A inndante, a khuomte, le a talaapte a gol dan a dangte ma bang ahi hi; a sung kimvel le a talaap sungah tawlette a om hi; adung tong sawmnga pha a, avai tong sawmni le nga pha hi."},"34":{"text":"A talaap pen leituol pulam kinga a, alang tuoha a om khuom khat tuohah lutu kung tawh kizem a, a kalei in ciel giet nei hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leilu lam tunkotah ei peipi a, tuale ama in te hi; a gol dan pen adangte tawh kikim hi."},"36":{"text":"A inndante, a khuomte, le a talaap pen a gol dan adangte ma tawh kikim hi; a kimvelah tawlette om hi. Adung tong sawmnga hi a, avai tong sawmni le nga ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"A talaap pen tunkot pulam kinga a, alang tuohah khuom khat tuoh om hi; tuate lutu kung limin kizem hi. A kalei in ciel giet nei hi."},"38":{"text":"Tunkot talaap ah kot nei inndan khat om a, khum mun pen meihal biehnate a kisawpsiengna mun ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tunkot talaap sunga a pang tuohah sabuoi ni tuoh om a, tuate tungah meihal biehna, mawna zieha biehna, le khielna zieha biehna ding ganhingte kigo hi."},"40":{"text":"Leilu lam tunkot lutna talaap pulamah sabuoi ni om hi; talaap tunkot langkhatah zong sabuoi ni ma om hi."},"41":{"text":"Tunkot sung lamah sabuoi li om a, tunkot pang a pulamah zong sabuoi li ma omin a unpi-in giet ahi a, tamte tungah biehpiehna dingte kigo hi."},"42":{"text":"Meihal biehna lui nadingin suong kisui sabuoi li om a, tuate adung avai tong khat le alang tuoh ahi a, a sanna tong khat ahi hi. Khumte tungah meihal biehna le biehpiehnate a kigaw cienga zah ding vanzahte kikoi hi."},"43":{"text":"A sung kimvel zosie-ah zabeh cie a sau siakawite kibul a, sabuoite tungah biehna ding sa kikoi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tunkot sunglam lutna lampi tung leituol sungnungah lasate ading inndante om a, khat pen leitaw lam kinga leilu lam tunkot pangah om a, adang khat pen leilu lam kinga nisuona lam tunkot pangah a om hi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Leitaw lam kinga tami inndan pen biehinn sunga nasem siempute ading ahi a,"},"46":{"text":"tuale leilu lam kinga inndan pen maitam tunga na a sem siempute ading ahi hi; tam teng pen Zadok’ suonlehlahte ahi vua, Levi suonlehlahte lahah amate beh in ama’ na a sem dingin Topa kung a nai thei uhi,” ei ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Ama in leituol te a, adung tong zakhat pha a, avai zong tong zakhat ma pha a, a kikim ningli a nei hi; tuale biehinnpi mai lamah maitam a om hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in biehinnpi talaap lamah ei peipi a, talaap’ khuom te a te leh a pang tuoh tong nga pha a, tunkot avai tong sawm le li hi a, tunkot pang tuoha kawm kigette a lang ni-in tong thum tuoh pha hi.","title":"Biehinnpi (1Kum 7:14-22)"},"49":{"text":"Talaap adung tong sawmni pha a, avai tong sawm le ni pha hi; tua tunga kato nadingin kalei ciel sawm kidaw hi; a pang tuoha tunkot khuomte kikalah khuomte kiphut hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in biehinn laikimah ei peipi a, a khuomte a te hi; a pang tuoh gela khuomte a vailam tong guh tuoh a pha hi."},"2":{"text":"A lutna avai tong sawm ahi hi; a lutna pang tuoha om kawmte tong nga ahi hi. Ama in biehinn laikim a te leh adung tong sawmli pha a, avai tong sawmni pha hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin inndan sungnungah ama lutin a lutna khuomte te a, tong ni pha hi; tuale a lutna avai tong sagi pha hi; tuale a pang tuoha om kawmte tong sagi a pha hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a inndan te a, biehinn laikim teng kihal loin, adung avai tong sawmni tuoh a pha hi. Tuale ama in keima kungah tami siengtho pen mun ahi hi, ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in biehinnpi kawm te a, tong guh sa hi; tuale biehinnpi kimvela om a panga inndante avai tong li pha hi."},"6":{"text":"A panga innkhante dawl thum pha a, khat tungah khat kikhangin dawl khatah innkhan neu sawmthum om hi. Biehinnpi kawm ah tua inndante a kingap lo nadingin biehinnpi kawm kimvel tengah a nanna zawlte om hi."},"7":{"text":"A panga inndan peina lampi pen dawl khat zaw dawl khat zai tehteh hi; bangzieh ahei cile tua inn pen biehinnpi kimvel tengah kalei kidawpieh ahi hi. Tami zieha dawl khat zaw dawl khat gol tehteh ahi hi. A dawl neinung pen panin a dawl tungnung pen dongah a laita pen dawl panin kikato hi."},"8":{"text":"Biehinnpi in a kimvel tengah mun kidawsang a nei ka mu hi; a panga inndante’ zungpi a te leh tong guh a sau cieng tan khat a pha hi."},"9":{"text":"A panga inndan kawm a sana tong nga pha hi; tuale inndante a pulam kawm pen tong nga sa hi; tuale biehinnpi’ inndante kikal mun-awng om a,"},"10":{"text":"tuale biehinnpi kimvela a pang zosie-a om leituol inndante kikala a om mun-awng pen avai tong sawmni a pha hi."},"11":{"text":"A panga inndante adingin mun-awng a tung zawnah peina lampi kihong a, khat leilu lam, khat leitaw lam kinga hi; a kimvela mun-awng teng avai tong nga pha hi."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna lam panga biehinnpi huong lam a kinga innpi pen avai tong sawm sagi pha hi; tua innpi kimvela innpi kawm tong nga sa a, adung tong sawmkuo sau hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in biehinnpi a te leh tong zakhat sau a, a innpi kawm pumin a innhuong sung tong zakhat ma sau hi;"},"14":{"text":"nisuona lam panga biehinnpi le a huong zong avai tong zakhat a pha hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in nitumna lama tuol lam a kinga innpi pen adung lam te a, a pang tuoha a lamneu pumin tong zakhat pha hi. Biehinnpi laikim inndan sungnung le talaap pulam teng"},"16":{"text":"singpeh tawh kidap a, a kimvelah tawlet neu thum a om hi. Sangkil lam mai ngatin biehinnpi kimvelin tuong panin tawlet dongin (tu-in tawlette a kituom ahi hi) singpeh tawh kidap a,"},"17":{"text":"kotpi tunga mun-awng dong, inndan sungnung le a pulam dong nangawnin kidap hi. Tuale inndan sung kimvela kawm zosie tung le tua sunga biehinn laikimte zong kizem ciet hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua pen Cherub-te le lutu kung lim tawh kikheng a, cherub khatlekhat kikalah lutu kung khat ki-omsah hi. Cherub khat in maitang ni nei hi:"},"19":{"text":"Lang khat a mihing’ maitang pen lutu kung lam kinga a, alang khatah humpi a no’ maitang pen lutu kung lam ma kinga hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuong tung panin a kot tungnung munte dongin kawm tungah cherub-te le lutu kungte kikheng suoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Biehinn laikima a om kotkhuomte in ning li nei uhi. Mun siengtho mai-ah"},"22":{"text":"sing maitam tawh a kibang pien khat om a, a sanna tong thum, adung tong ni, avai tong ni pha hi. A ningte, a tunnate, le a kawmte sing tawh kibawl hi. Ama in keima kungah, “Tam pen Topa mai-a kipha sabuoi ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Biehinn laikim teng le mun siengtho in kotkhah thuop ni tuoh nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Kotpite singpeh ni kisutuo hi a, kotpi khatah a kivei thei singpeh ni ta kithuo hi."},"25":{"text":"Kawm tung tengah cherub-te le lutu kungte a kikhuoh bangin a kawmte tungah zong kikhuoh hi; tuale a pulam talaap mai-ah sing tawh a kibawl a tungkhu khat a om hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuale talaap kawmpangte tungah tawlet neute le lutu kungte a om hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leilu lam zuonin leituol pulamah ei pui a, biehinnpi tuol le leilu lam panga a om inn tawh a kigalsai inndante sungah ei peipi hi.","title":"Inndan Siengthote le a Pulam Kawm"},"2":{"text":"Leilu lam pang innpi adung pen tong zakhat hi a, avai tong sawmnga ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Leituol a sungnung pen tong sawmni pha a, a pulam leituol pen suongpha lam kinga hi. Lamneu khat tunga lamneu khatah inndante kitawito-in dawl thum a pha hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua inndante mai-ah innsung lam zotna lampi khat om a, tong sawm golin tong zakhat thuh a, a lutnate leilu lamah om hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in inndan tungnungte kuocih zawdeu hi, azieh pen lamneute in inn sungah inndan neita le inndan laita-te sangin mun tam lazaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tuate dawl thum tah ahi a, leituol pulam khuomte bangin khuom a nei sih uhi; tam ziehin a inndan tungta pen, inndan neita pen, le inndan laita pen sangin tuol panin kikhawzang zawdeu hi."},"7":{"text":"Inndante tawh kitangin leituol pulam kinga a, inndante tawh a kigalsai a pulam kawm khat om a, tong sawmnga sau hi."},"8":{"text":"Leituol pulama inndante tong sawmnga sau a, biehinnpi tawh a kigalsaite tong zakhat sau hi."},"9":{"text":"Leituol pulam panin tami inndante nei-a nisuona lamah mihing lut nadingin lutna khat a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Khum lampi avai pen leituol’ kawm sana zaza ahi hi. Leitaw lamah zong mun-awng teng le innpi tawh a kigalsai-in inndante om a,"},"11":{"text":"a mai-ah lampi khat om hi; tuate leilu lama inndante tawh kibang a, adung avai kikim cietin pusuonate, a kiguoldante le a kotpite zong kibang ciet hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n leitaw lam inndeite pen kotkhahte tawh kibang hi. Pusuona lampi bulah nisuona lam pang kawm pei pen tawh a kibangin kotkhah khat om a, tua panin inndeite ah kilut hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in ka kungah, “Mun-awng tawh a kigalsai leilu lam inndante le leitaw lam inndante pen inndan siengtho ahi a, tua sungah Topa kung a nai siempute in a siengtho pen biehnate ne ding uhi; amate in tua sungah an tawh biehnate, mawna zieha biehnate, le khielna zieha biehnate a khol ding uhi, azieh pen tua mun a siengtho hi."},"14":{"text":"Siengtho munah siempute a lut ciengun a nasep puonsilte uh koi loin leituol pulamah pusuoh lo ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile a puonsilte uh sieng tho hi; mipite op nading munah a pei masangun amate in puon adang sil ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in biehinnpi sunglam teng a te zaw ciengin nisuona lam a kinga tunkotah ei peipi a, biehinnpi a kimvel zosie a te hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in nisuona lam pang a te leh piciengin tong zanga pha hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin kihei-in leitaw lam pang a te leh piciengin tong zanga ma a pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin kihei-in leitaw lam a te leh piciengin tong zanga ma a pha hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin kihei-in nitumna a te leh piciengin tong zanga a pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in a pang li teng te hi. A kimvelin kawm kiget a, adunglam tong zanga pha a, avai lam tong zanga ma a pha hi. Tam kawm in mun siengtho le mipi opna a tuomin a khen hi.","ref":"1Kum 6:1-38; 2Khg 3:1-9"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in nisuona lam a kinga tunkot ah ei peipi hi.","title":"Pasien’ Minthanna Biehinnpi ah Kilekia"},"2":{"text":"Khum munah nisuona lam panin Israel Pasien’ minthanna vang ang pei hi; a awging pen tuipi ging tawh kibang a, leitung zong ama’ minthanna vang in a tanvah hi.","ref":"Ezk 10:3-4, 18-19; 11:22-23; Kln 1:15"},"3":{"text":"Ka mu mangmuna pen ama khuopi susie dinga ang pei lai-a ka musa mangmuna tawh kibang a, tuale Chebar gun gei-a ka mu mangmuna tawh kibang hi; kei zong ka khupbawhsuh pai hi."},"4":{"text":"Nisuona lam a kinga tunkot lam tawnin Topa’ minthanna vang ang lut ciengin"},"5":{"text":"hlagau in kei ei domto a, tuale leituol sungnungah ei peipi hi; tuale Topa’ minthanna vang biehinnpi sung a dim hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka gei-ah tua mipa ang din laitahin biehinnpi panin mi khat in keima ei hopina ka za hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, tami ka kumpi tona mun le ka ketaw ngahna mun ahi hi. Tam mun pen Israel mite lahah ka ten den nading mun ahi hi. Israel innkuonte, amate le a kumpite’ pahtatnate le a sisa a kumpite’ luonghawmte in ka min siengtho a buasah nawn sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in ka sangkil gei-ah amau’ sangkil a koi vua, amau’ kotpi khuomte keima’ kotpi khuom gei-ah phutin keima le amate kikalah kawm khat beh in ei hal a, amate in sil mudahuoi a bawlte uh ziehin ka min siengtho a buasah uhi; tua ahi ziehin ka lungthahna tawh amate ka susie hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in amate in a milim biehnate uh paimang uh hinlen, a kumpite uh’ luonghawmte kei tawh kigamlasah uheh, tua hile amate lahah kumtawnin ka teng ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing aw, Israel innkuonte kung ah biehinnpi thu gen in, biehinnpi lim tesah in; tuale a khielnate uh ziehin amate maizumsah in."},"11":{"text":"A gamtatna zosie uh ziehin amate a maizum ciengun, biehinnpi a kigel dan, a kiguol dan, lutna le pusuona, a piendan zosie, a ngaina kip zosie, gelna zosie le a thukhamte zosie, amate theisah in."},"12":{"text":"Tami pen biehinnpi tawh kisai thukham ahi hi: Muoltung kimvel zosie-a gam buppi khu a siengtho pen hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tamte pen tong tawh a kite maitam’ golna ahi hi: (a tena tong pen tong khat le zabeh ahi hi). A tunna pen tong khat sangin tong khat gol ding hi. A gei kimvelah khap khat a pha geiviel khat om ding hi. Tam pen maitam’ sanna hi ding hi:","title":"Maitam"},"14":{"text":"A kitunna tuol panin maitam kidaw a neita pen dong tong ni hi a, avai tong khat ahi hi; maitam kidaw a neuzaw panin maitam kidaw a golzaw pen tong li hi a, avai tong khat ahi hi;"},"15":{"text":"tuale maitam tap tung teng a sanna tong li ahi hi; maitam tap tung panin ki li poto hi."},"16":{"text":"Maitam tap tung pen a kikim ning li nei hi ding a, adung le avai tong sawm le ni ta hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Maitam kidawte zong a kikim ning li nei hi ding a, adung avai tong sawm le li ta hi ding hi. A geiviel kimvel pen avai tong lang hi a, a kitunna a kimvel tong khat hi ding hi. A kalei nisuo lam kinga ding hi.","ref":"Pei 27:1-2; 2Khg 4:1"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah tam bangin ei gen hi: Mihing aw, Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Tam teng pen maitam ading ngaina kip ahi hi: Meihal biehna lui nading le sisan the nadinga tua maitam a kidaw ni ciengin,"},"19":{"text":"ka nasem dinga ka kung ei nai Zadok’ suonlehlah Levi siempute kungah mawna zieha biehna adingin bawngtang khat na pie ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale a si themkhat na la ding a, maitam ki lite tung, maitam kidaw ning lite le a kimvela geivielte tung zosie-ah na nu ding hi; tua bangin maitam siensuo-in tua adingin thoidamna na bawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna bawngtang zong na la ding a, mun siengtho pulam biehinnpi huong sunga tuami bawl nadinga a kisesa munah na hal ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A ni ni ni ciengin mawna zieha biehna adingin nuol baang lo keeltang khat na pie ding hi. Bawngtang tawh a kisiensuo ma bangin maitam kisiensuo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na siensuo zaw ciengin nuol baang lo bawngtang khat le ganhon lah pana nuol baang lo tuutang khat na pie ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua teng pen Topa mai-ah na pie ding a, siempute in a tungah ci the-in Topa tungah meihal biehna-in a pie ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mawna zieha biehna dingin ni sagi sung nisielin keel khat na pie ding hi; ganhonte lah panin bawngtang khat le tuutang khat zong na pie ding vua, a ni-in nuol baanglo hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in maitam adingin ni sagi sung thoidamna a bawl ding vua, tua maitam siensuo-in a ap ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua nite a cin zaw ciengin, a ni giet ni-a kipanin siempute in na meihal biehnate ule thunuoma na biehnate uh maitam tungah pie ding uhi; tuale keima in note kang sang ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Pei 29:35-37"}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in nisuona lam a kinga mun siengtho’ tunkot pulamah ei peipikia hi; tuale tua tunkot na kikhah hi.","title":"A Kikhah Tunkot"},"2":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah tam bangin gen hi: Tam tunkot kikhah peisuoh ding hi; tua khu kihong lo ding a, tua panin zong koima lut lo ding hi; azieh pen tua panin Israel’ Topa Pasien a lut zo hi; tua ahi ziehin tua tunkot kikhah peisuoh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama pen gam uhpa ahi ziehin Topa mai-ah gam uhpa beh an ne dingin to thei ding hi; ama tunkot talaap tawnin ding a, tua lampi ma-ah pusuoh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leilu lam tunkot tawnin biehinnpi mai-ah ei peipi hi; ka khuodah leh, en vawi! Topa’ biehinnpi sungah Topa’ minthanna vang a dim hi; tuale kei zong tuolah ka bawhsuh pai hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Sung Lutna"},"5":{"text":"Topa in ka kungah tam bangin ei gen hi: Mihing aw, Topa’ biehinnpi tawh kisai-in kang gen ding ngaina kip zosie le a thukhamte zosie hoitahin melci-in limtahin en inlen, hoitahin ngai in; tuale biehinnpi sunga lut thei dingte le mun siengtho pana kipuse dingte zosie hoitahin melci in."},"6":{"text":"A ledo innkuon, Israel innkuonte kungah Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Israel innkuonte aw,"},"7":{"text":"note in keima kungah ka neh ding ka an, sathau le sisan nei pieh ciengun, ka mun siengtho-a om dingin lungtang le tahsa tep a kitan lo gamdang mite na lutsahna uh tua a mudahuoi na gamtatnate zosie uh tawpsan un. Note in na sil mudahuoite utawh ka thuciemna na palsat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ka biehna siengthote na kepcing ta sih uhi; na kepcing tah zawh sangun na sep ding tang teng uh ka mun siengtho sungah gamdang mite na semsah zawsop uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Ka mun siengtho sungah Israel mite lahah a om lungtang le tahsa tep a kitan lo gamdang mite koima a lut sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel mite in a pasien’ limte uh nua zui-in keima kung pana a pielmang lai-un keima kung panin gamlapi a vahthap Levi-te in zong dan a thuoh ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate ka mun siengtho sunga nasemte ahi vua, biehinnpi tunkotte a van ding le biehinnpi sunga nasem ding ahi uhi; amate in meihal biehna ding le mipite biehpiehna ding gante a go ding vua, amate zenin a na uh a seppieh ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in a pasien milimte uh mai-ah a na uh semin khielna sungah Israel innkuonte a puasah uhi, tua ahi ziehin amate in amau’ mawna paat a puo ding uhi, ci-in amate tawh kisai-in ka kiciem zo hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Siempu nasem dingin ka nai-ah amate ang pei thei sih ding vua, ka biehna siengthote, sil siengtho pente nai-ah zong ang pei thei sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin biehinnpi sunga sep ding a kisam zosie a sem dingin amate ka koi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima kung panin Israel mite a na pielmang hun sung tengun ka mun siengtho ei na kepcing pieh ahi Zadok’ suonlehlah Levi siempute in ka na sem dingin keima nai-ah ang pei thei ding vua, keima ei zenin sathau le sisante ei pie ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","title":"Levi Siempute"},"16":{"text":"Ka mun siengtho sungah a tum thei ding pen amate ahi vua, ka sabuoi lam nehin ka na semin ei kemcing ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Leituol sungnung tunkotah amate a lut ciengun amate in saihadiel puon a sil ding uhi; leituol sungnung tunkotte le biehinn sungah na a sep laitahun amate tungah samul puon om lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in a lu tung vuah saihadiel puon khimin a kawng vuah saihadiel bawngbi sungten a teng ding uhi; khuosa a kaisah thei ding bangma tawh amate a kigah sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pei 28:39-43; Siem 16:4"},"19":{"text":"Mipite opna leituol pulamah amate a peikhiet ciengun a naseppi uh puonte suodawhin inndan siengtho sungah tuate a koi ding uhi; tuale amate in amau’ puonsilte tawh mite a siensuo thei lo nadingun puondang a sil ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 21:5"},"20":{"text":"Amate in a sam uh heukieu loin a zangsam uzong sausah seng lo ding hi; amate in a lutung vua a samte a theu beh ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 21:5"},"21":{"text":"Leituol sungnungah a lut ciengun siempu koima in zu dawn thei lo ding hi.","ref":"Siem 10:9"},"22":{"text":"Amate in meigong khat ahi a, numei kikhulsa khat popo ahi zongin a kinunpi thei sih ding vua, ahi vangin Israel innkuonte’ cihlah ahi ngahnu siengthote beh, ahi sihle siempu khat’ zi ahisa meigongte beh kinunpi thei ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 21:7, 13-14"},"23":{"text":"Amate in a siengtho le a siengtho lo nate kilamdanna ka mite hilin, a bua le a sieng bangci khen ding ci thu amate a lah ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 10:10"},"24":{"text":"Thu kiselna sungah amate in thukhen pa-in pangin keima khen dan bangin a khen ding uhi. Amate in a kisesa keima’ pawi zosie tawh kisai-in ka thukhamte le ka thukipte zui-in ka sabbath-te zong a siengtho-in a tang ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Misi luong gei-ah pei-in amau le amau a kibuasah sih ding uhi; azieh pen a nu, a pa, a tanu, a tapa, a sanggam pa, pasal nei lo a sanggamnu uh ahile kibuasah thei hi.","ref":"Siem 21:1-4"},"26":{"text":"Ama a sientho zaw ciengin amate in ama adingin ni sagi sung sim ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Mun siengtho sunga na sem dingin leituol sungnung mun siengtho sungah a lut ni-in ama in mawna zieha biehna a pie ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tami khu amau’ gouluo hi ding hi: Kei amau’ gouluo ding ka hi hi; Israel gam sungah amate neisa na pie sih ding hi; kei amau’ neisa ka hi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:20"},"29":{"text":"Amate in an tawh biehna, mawna zieha biehna, khielna zieha biehna sate a ne ding uhi; tuale Israel gam sunga a ki-ap zosie amate ading ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ga masa zosie lahah ga masa pen le na biehna uh zosie lahah biehna zosie pen siempute ading ahi hi; na innsung vuah thupha a tun thei nadingin siempute tungah na moh em masah pen uh na pie ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 18:8-19"},"31":{"text":"Siempute in va ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin, ama thu-a a si, ahi sihle gamsate’ thasa khat popo a ne sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 22:8"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note in gou dingin leitang na hawmkhen ciengun, Topa adingin adung tong tul sawmni le tul nga, avai tong tul sawmni a pha leitang se khat gamkhen siengtho-in na tuomkhen ding uhi; tuami huom sung teng zosie a siengtho hi ding hi.","title":"A Siengtho Gamkhen"},"2":{"text":"Tam sung panin adung tong zanga, avai tong zanga a pha ning li a nei leitang pen mun siengtho hi ding a, a kimvelah mun-awng tong sawmnga hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamkhen siengtho sungah adung tong tul sawmni le nga le avai tong tulsawm a pha khawh khat na te ding a, tua sungah a siengtho pen mun ahi mun siengtho a om ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mun pen gam sungah a siengtho leitang se khat hi ding hi; tua pen a na sem dinga Topa kung a neh, mun siengtho sunga na sem siempute ading hi ding hi; tami mun pen a inn ding ule mun siengtho adingin a siengtho mun hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Khawh dang khat adung tong tul sawmni le nga, avai tong tul sawm pen biehinnpi sunga na sem Levi-te ten nading le a luo ding uh khuopite’ mun hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A siengtho gamkhen dinga na tuomkhen khawh zomah khuopi mun dingin avai tong tulnga, adung tong tul sawmni le nga a pha gam khat na se ding hi; tua pen Israel innkuonte’ tanh hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A siengtho gamkhen le khuopi mun pang tuoh tunga a om leitang, a siengtho gamkhen le khuopi mun tawh kizompe a, nisuona lam le nitumna lamah omsuohin, Israel minam khat’ tanh gam tawh adung a kibang, nitumna lam panin nisuo lama kihlungsuoh gam teng pen gam-uh ulien pa’ tanh hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam pen Israel gam sungah ama gam hi ding hi. Tuale ka gam-uhte in ka mite a gawt nawn sih ding uhi; tuale mahin a minam zui-in Israel innkuonte gam a neisah ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Israel gam-uhte aw, kicing ta! Tatsietna le bawlsietna khawlsan unlen, thuman thutangin gamta un. Ka mite na hawlkhietnate uh khawl un, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in tawisuong a man, ephah a man, le bath a man na nei ding uhi.","title":"A Gihnate le a Tenate","ref":"Siem 19:36"},"11":{"text":"Ephah le bath pen a tena kibangin na zang ding vua, bath khatah homer khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat ta a, ephah khatah homer khat’ sesawm-suo-sekhat ta hi. Tena dih pen Homer hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Shekel khat in gerah sawmni khai ding hi. Shekel sawmni, shekel sawmni le nga, le shekel sawm le nga pen nang adingin mina khat hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tamte pen na biehna pieh dingte uh ahi hi: Mangbu homer khat lah panin ephah seguh suo se khat, mangbuham homer khat lah pan ephah seguh suo se khat hi ding a,","title":"Biehnate"},"14":{"text":"sathau pieh dinga kisesa pen cor khat lah pan bath sesawm-suo-sekhat hi ding hi. (Cor kici pen homer tawh kikimin bath sawm ta hi)."},"15":{"text":"Israel-te’ lohing lah panin tuuhon zani lahah tuu khat hi ding hi. Tam pen an tawh biehna, meihal biehna, thunuoma biehnate ahi a, amate adingin thoidamna bawl nading ahi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Gam sunga mi zosie in Israel gam-uhpa pawlin tami biehna a pie ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin pawibawl nite, hladet nite, sabbath nite le a kisesa Israel innkuonte pawi zosie-ah meihal biehnate, an tawh biehnate, le dawn thei biehnate tawh kisai teng a bawl ding pen gam-uhpa mawpuoh hi ding hi: Israel innkuonte’ thoidamna bawl nadingin ama in mawna zieha biehnate, an tawh biehnate, meihal biehnate, le thunuoma biehnate sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: A hla masa a ni masa ni-in nuol baang lo bawngtang guol khat na kai ding a, mun siengtho na siensuo ding hi.","title":"Pawite (Pei 12:1-20 ; Siem 23:33-43)"},"19":{"text":"Siempu pa in mawna zieha biehna gan si themkhat khat la ding a, biehinnpi khuomte, maitam kidaw ning lite le leituol sungta pen’ tunkot khuomte tungah nu ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khatpo in a bawlkhiel zieh le a thei lo ziehin a maw khah leh khumi hla a ni sagi ni-in khum bang ma-in na bawlkia ding uhi; tuaci’n note in biehinnpi adingin thoidamna na bawl ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"A hla masa a ni sawm le li ni-in peisan pawi na bawl ding vua, tuale ni sagi sung tol kisaw lo an kine ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Khum ni-in gam-uhpa in mawna zieha biehna dingin bawngtang guol khat ama ading le gam sunga mi zosie adingin sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A pawi bawl uh ni sagi sungin ama in Topa tungah nisielin meihal biehna dingin nuol baang lo bawngtang guol sagi le tuutang sagi sih ding hi; tuale mawna zieha biehna dingin keeltang sagi zong sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in bawngtang khatah an tawh biehna dingin ephah khat le tuutang khatah ephah khat ma, ephah khat ciengin sathau hin khat ta sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A hla sagi a ni sawm le nga ni-in ni sagi sung pawi a bawlna dingin mawna zieha biehnate, meihal biehnate, an tawh biehnate le sathau adingin nidanga a sih za ma a pie ding hi.","ref":"Siem 23:33-36; Gam 29:12-38"}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Nisuona lam a kinga leituol sungnung tunkot pen nasep ni guh sung kikhah ding hi; ahi vangin sabbath ni le hladet ni-in kihong ding hi.","title":"Zuiding Ngaina Tuomtuomte"},"2":{"text":"A pulam panin talaap tunkot zui-in gam-uhpa lut ding a, tunkot khuom gei-ah a ding ding hi. Siempute in ama’ meihal biehnate le thunuoma biehnate pie-in tunkot lutna ah a lukun ding uhi. Tua ciengin ama pei ding a, ahi vangin nitah dongin tunkot kikhah lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sabbath-te le hladet ni ciengin tunkot lutna Topa mai-ah gam sung mite a kun ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in gam-uh pa in Topa tunga a pieh meihal biehna pen nuol baanglo tuuno guh le tuutang khat hi ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"tuale tuutang tawh a kipieton ding an tawh biehna pen ephah khat hi ding a, tuuno tawh a kipieton ding an tawh biehna pen ama pieh nuom zaza hi ding hi, ephah khat simin sathau hin khat tawh pieton ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hladet ni ciengin ama in nuol baang lo bawngtang guol khat, tuuno guh le tuutang khat pie ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"ama in bawngtang khat tawh an tawh biehna dingin ephah khat pie ding a, tuutang tawh ephah khat ma pie-in, tuuno tawh ama pieh nuom zaza pie ding hi, ephah khat simin sathau hin khat ta tawh pieton ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gam-uhpa a lut ciengin talaap tunkot zui-in lut ding a, tua lampi ma zui-in pusuoh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A kisesa pawite ah Topa mai-ah gam mite a pei ciengun Pasien bie dinga leilu lam tunkota a lut poma leitaw lam tunkotah pusuoh ding uhi; leitaw lam tunkota a lut poma leilu lam tunkotah pusuoh ding uh: a lutna uh tunkot zui-in amate pusuoh lo ding a, hinanle a mailam-ah tangtahin a pusuoh ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate a lut ciengun, gam-uhpa zong amate tawh lut ding a, amate a pusuo ciengin ama zong pusuoh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A pawite ule a hun zui-a a kisesa pawite ah an tawh biehna dingin bawngtang khat le ephah khat hi ding a, tuutang tawh ephah khat ma kipie-in, tuuno tawh a piete in amate pieh nuom zaza pie ding a, ephah khat simin sathau hin khat ta tawh a pieton ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa tungah gam-uhpa in nop thu-a biehna dingin meihal biehna ahi a, lungnuoma biehna ahi zongin a pieh ciengin, ama adingin nisuona lam a kinga tunkot kihonpieh ding hi; tuale ama in meihal biehna ahi a, thunuoma biehnate ahi zongin a pieh ciengin sabbath ni-a bangin pie ding hi. Tua ciengin ama pusuoh ding a, ama a pusuo zaw ciengin tunkot kikhah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in Topa tungah meihal biehna dingin nisimin nuol baanglo kum khat a pha tuuno khat pie ding hi; ama in zingmawng sielin pie ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuale ama in tuate tawh an tawh biehna ephah khat seguh suo se khat le anneel a tap suoh zo dingin sathau hin khat sethum-suo-sekhat zingmawng sielin pie zing ding hi; tam pen ngaina kipin kizang zing ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua bangin tuuno, an tawh biehna le sathaute pen meihal biehna dingin zingmawng sielin kipie zing ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Gam-uhpa in a gouluo panin a tapate lahah khat penpen tungah letsong a pieh leh a tate in tuate a tang ding vua, amate adingin a gouluo uh hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin a gouluo lah panin a nasemte khat penpen tungah letsong a pieh leh, suotah kum dong cieng ama-a’ hi ding a, tua zaw ciengin gam-uhpa kungah tungkia ding hi; a tapate beh in tua letsong pen a gou dingun a kem peisuoh thei ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 25:10"},"18":{"text":"Gam-uhpa in mite’ gou khat popo lahpieh lo ding a, a neisa uh leitang panin zong amate notmang lo ding hi; ka mite khat mama zong amau’ neisa leitang a kilahpieh lo nadingin gam-uhpa in ama’ neisa leitang panin a tapate tungah amau’ gouluo a pie ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tunkot panga om lutna lampi zui-in, sah lama siempute dinga inndei siengtho kiguolte sungah ei peipi hi; tuale khum sung nitumna lam a mongta penah mun khat ka mu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Tam mun pen siempute in khielna zieha biehna le mawna zieha biehnate a huon nading uh mun le an tawh biehnate a em nading uh mun ahi a, tam pen leituol pulamah tuate peipi loin a siengtho nate tawh mite a lawsah khah lo nading uh ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in leituol pulam ah ei peipisuoh a, tuale leituol ning li tengah ei zawpi hi; leituol ning li cietah leituol khat ciet a na om hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua leituol ning lite sungah leituol neute om a, adung tong sawmli avai tong sawmthum ahi hi; a li-un a golna uh kikim hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua leituol neu lite sunglam kimvel cietah suong kikhengzol guol khat ciet om a, tua suong kiguolte’ a tawguol kimvelah meikhuhte kibawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “Tamte pen biehinnpi sunga nasemte in mite’ biehpiehna sa a huon nading uh anhuon buh ahi hi,” ei ci hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in biehinnpi lutna ah ei peipi hi; khum munah biehinnpi kotpi sangkil nei panin nisuona lam manaw-in tui a luong hi (biehinnpi pen nisuona lam a kingat zieh ahi hi); tuale maitam leitaw lam, biehinnpi kotpi sangkil leitaw lam tawpna a nei panin tua tui luongsuh hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Pana Luong Tui","ref":"Zech 14:8; Jhn 7:38; Kln 22:1"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin leilu lam tunkot tawnin ei peipi a, a pulam kimvel tengah ei pui-in, nisuona lam a kinga tunkot pulam dong ei vapi kawikawi hi; tuale leitaw lam panin tui ang luong hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua pa in a khuta a tawi khau khat tawh nisuona lam manaw-in pei a, tong tulkhat dong te-in, tua ciengin tui ei tansah hi; tuami tui pen sietmit ciengah a gei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in tong tulkhat ma te leuleu a, tui ei tanpi hi; tua tui khup ciengah a gei hi. Ama in tong tulkhat te be leuleu a, tui eitanpi hi; tua tui kawng ciengah a gei hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in tong tulkhat te be leuleu a, tuale tua tui pen gunpi khat na hi a, tua tui a khan ziehin ka galkai zo ta sih hi; tua gun a thuh sengin ngap zawh ding le galkai zawh ding gun ahi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in ka kungah, “Mihing aw, tam na mu zo tai mah?” ei ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in gun pangah ei peipikia hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka peikia ciengin gun pang tuoha a po singkung gol tampitah ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Tam tui pen nisuona gam lam manaw-in luong a, Arabah gamah a lutsuh hi; a vei den tuipi sungah ang lutsuh ciengin tua tui ang cim ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua gun luonna mun poma-ah ganhing namcin a teng ding vua, tuale khum munah tami tuite ang tun ciengin nga tampi a om ding hi. Tua pen tuicim a suoh ding hi; tua gun a luonna popo-ah ganhing vannuoi a hing ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuipi gei En-gedi panin En-eglaim dong mite dingin nga a beng ding uhi; tua mun pen len khuna mun hi ding hi; tua ngate Tuipi Lien sunga ngate bangin a nam tampitah hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin nawnglah le buon tuite a cim thei tuom sih ding hi; tuate pen ci suoh dinga kinuasie ding ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Gunpi pang tuohah neh thei singkung namcin a po ding hi. A nate vul loin a ga zong hut lo ding a, mun siengtho panin amate adingin tui ang luon ziehin hlasielin ga a tha ga ding uhi. A gate an-in kinei ding a, a nate damna zatui-in kizang ding hi.","ref":"Kln 22:2"},"13":{"text":"Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Tamte pen Israel minam sawm le nite lahah amau’ gouluo dinga na hawmpieh gamgite ahi hi. Joseph in tanh ni nga ding hi.","title":"Gamgi Thate (Gam 34:1-12)"},"14":{"text":"Note in a kikimin na hawm ding uhi; na pu na pate uh tungah tuate pieh dinga ka kiciemsa ahi a, na gouluo dingun tam leitang na luo ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tam pen leitang kigi hi ding hi: Leilu lam pangah Tuipi Lien panin Hethlon lampi zui-in Lebo-hamath ah Zedad dong,"},"16":{"text":"Berothah, Sibraim (tua pen Damascus le Hamth gamgi kikalah om), Hauran gamgi-a a om Hazer-hatticon dong ban ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuipi panin Damascus leilu lam gamgi-a om Hazar-enon dongah kihlungin leilu lama om Hamath tawh kigamgi ahi hi. Tam pen leilu lam pang hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Nisuona lam pangah Hauran le Damascus kikal hi ding hi; Jordan gun dung zuisuhin Gilead le Israel gam kikalah suoh ding hi; nisuona tuipi ah Tamar dongin kihlung ding hi. Tam pen nisuona lam pang hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitaw lam pangah Tamar panin Meribath-kadesh tuite dongah kihlung ding a, khum panin Tuipi Lien dongin Egypt Lui zui ding hi. Tam pen leitaw lam pang hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ni tumna lam pangah Tuipi Lien gamgi hi pai-in Lebo-hamath tawh kigalsai cieng lien hi ding hi. Tam pen ni tumna lam pang hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n Israel minam zui-in note lahah tam gam teng na hawmkhen ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua gam pen noma’ gouluo ding le note lahah ang teng ta le nau a neisa namdangte adingin na hawm ding uhi. Note adingin amate pen Israel mi a suoh ding uhi; amate pen note tawh Israel minamte lahah gou kihawmpieh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Koikoi nam sungah tua gamdangte om tanan ule zong, khum munah a gouluo ding uh na pie ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam teng pen minamte’ min ahi hi: Leilu lam gamgi pan kipanin Hethlon lampi, Lebo-hamath panin Hazar-enon dong ah (tua pen Damascus gamgi tungah om a, leilu lamah Hamath tawh kigamgi hi) kihlung suoh hi. Tuale nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lamah kihlung suohin Dan in tanh khat a tang hi.","title":"Minamte’ Tanh dingte"},"2":{"text":"Dan gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Asher in tanh khat a tang hi."},"3":{"text":"Asher gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Naphtali in tanh khat a tang hi."},"4":{"text":"Naphtali gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Manasseh in tanh khat a tang hi."},"5":{"text":"Manasseh gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Ephraim in tanh khat a tang hi."},"6":{"text":"Ephraim gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Reuben in tanh khat a tang hi."},"7":{"text":"Reuben gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Judah in tanh khat a tang hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong se khat pen na tuomkoi ding vua, avai tong tul sawmni le nga le adung nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong minam khat’ tanh za tawh kikim ding a, tua gam laikim tahah mun siengtho om ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa adinga na tuomkhen tanh khat pen adung tong tul sawmni le nga, avai tong tul sawmni hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte pen a kihawm ding tanh siengthote ahi hi: Siempute in tanh khat a nei ding vua, a golna pen leilu lam pangah tong tul sawmni nga pha ding a, nitumna lam pangah avai tong tul sawm pha-in, nisuona lam pangah avai tong tul sawm ma pha ding a, leitaw lam pangah tong tul sawmni le nga pha-in tua gam laikim tahah Topa’ mun siengtho om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam mun pen Israel mite a vahmang hun lai vua Levi-te banga a vahmang lo, ka na a sem Zadok’ suonlehlahte ahi a kisiensuosa siempute ading ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Gam sung leitang siengthote lah panin Levi-te tawh a kigamgi siengtho pen mun khat, amau’ aituom tanh hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Siempute’ gamgi zomah Levi-te in adung tong tul sawmni le nga, avai tong tul sawmni a pha tanh khat nei ding uhi. Adung a unpi-in tong tul sawmni le nga hi ding a, avai tong tul sawmni hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in tuate zua thei loin na khatpo tawh zong hleh thei lo ding hi. Amate in a kituomteel tam gam’ tanh pen koima tungah piesawn thei lo ding hi, azieh pen tua khu Topa adingin a siengtho hi."},"15":{"text":"A omlai leitang, avai tong tulnga le adung tong tul sawmni le nga pen khuopi adingin dei bang banga zah ding hi a, ten nading le mun-awnga om ding ahi hi. Khum laikimah khuopi a om ding hi;"},"16":{"text":"tuale khuopi a zaina tam bang dan hi ding hi: Leilu lam pang tong tul li le zanga, leitaw lam pang tong tul li le zanga, nisuona lam pang tong tul li le zanga, nitumna lam pang tong tul li le zanga pha kim ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuopi in gam-awng nei ding hi: Leilu lamah tong zani le sawmnga, leitaw lamah tong zani le sawmnga, nisuona lamah tong zani le sawmnga, nitumna lamah tong zani le sawmnga pha kim ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mun siengtho tanh zomah a omlai teng a dung nisuona lamah tong tul sawm, nitumna lamah tong tul sawm ma hi ding a, mun siengtho tanh tawh kizom ding hi. Tam gama a piengte pen khuopi sunga nasemte’ kivana an ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel minam zosie lah panin khuopi sunga nasemte in tua leitang a hlo ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na tuomkoi ding tanh buppi pen ning li kikim tong tul sawmni le nga hi ding a, khum pen khuopi neisa tawh a kisimtha a siengtho tanh ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"A siengtho tanh le khuopi neisa pang tuohah a omlai teng pen gam-uhpa ading ahi hi. Gam siengtho tanh panin nisuona lamah tong tul sawmni le nga, le nitumna lamah tong tul sawmni nga dong a kihlungsuh, minamte’ tanh tawh a kitang teng pen gam-uhpa ading ahi hi. Tuami laikimah a siengtho tanh le biehinnpi’ mun siengtho a om ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Levi-te neisa le khuopi pen gam-uhpa’ tanh ding gam laikimah a om ding hi. Gam-uhpa’ tanh pen ahile Judah le Benjamin gamgi kikal teng hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Minamdang a omlaite ading pen: Nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Benjamin in tanh khat a tang hi."},"24":{"text":"Benjamin gamgi tawh a kimat, nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Simeon in tanh khat a tang hi."},"25":{"text":"Simeon gamgi tawh a kimat, nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Issachar in tanh khat a tang hi."},"26":{"text":"Issachar gamgi tawh a kimat, nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Zebulun in tanh khat a tang hi."},"27":{"text":"Zebulun gamgi tawh a kimat nisuona lam pang panin nitumna lam pang dong Gad in tanh khat a tang hi."},"28":{"text":"Gad gamgi tawh a kimat leitaw lam gam teng pen Tamar panin Meribath-kadesh tuite dongin kihlungsuh ding a, khum mun panin Egypt Lui zuisuhin Tuipi Lien dong hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam pen Israel minamte lahah gouluo dinga na hawm ding uh gam hi a, tamte amau’ tanh dingte ahi hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Khuopi pan pusuona ding tam teng hi ding hi: A kitena-ah leilu lam pangah tong tul li le zanga a pha"},"31":{"text":"tunkot thum om ding a, Reuben tunkot, Judah tunkot, le Levi tunkotte ahi a, tua khuopi tunkotte pen Israel minamte’ min kitap ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Nisuona lam pangah tong tul li le zanga a pha tunkot thum om ding a, Joseph tunkot, Benjamin tunkot, le Dan tunkotte ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"A kitena-ah leitaw lam pangah tong tul li le zanga a pha tunkot thum om ding a, Simeon tunkot, Issachar tunkot, le Zebulun tunkotte ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Nitumna lam pangah tong tul li le zanga a pha tunkot thum om ding a, Gad tunkot, Asher tunkot, le Naphtali tunkotte ahi hi.","ref":"Kln 21:12-13"},"35":{"text":"Khuopi a kimvelin tong tul sawm le giet hi ding hi. Khum huna kipanin khuopi min pen, ‘ Topa Khumnah a om hi,’ kici ding hi,” ei ci hi."}}}}},"27":{"info":{"name":"Daniel","shortname":"Dan","abbr":[],"desc":"Daniel laibu (the book of daniel)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim kumpi a suo zaw a kum thumna kumin Babylon Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar pei-in Jerusalem a imtawm hi.","title":"Babylon Kumpi Innsunga Israel Tangval Lite (2Kum 24:10-17)","ref":"2Kum 24:1; 2Khg 36:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim a kipan Pasien’ inn sunga om vante pawlkhat zong ama’ thuneina sungah omsah a, ama in Shinar gamah tuate puo-in a pasien-te’ goukholna inn sungah koi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in a kumpi innsung mangpa Ashpenaz kungah kumpi innkuon sung pan le milien namte lah panin"},"4":{"text":"a khangdawng a pumpi tunga poina a nei lo, a melhoi, pilna siemna namcin a kiva, theina le mi navah, le kumpi inn sunga na a sem thei ding Israel mi pawlkhat hing sawl in, ci-in thu a pie hi; amate pen Chaldea lai le ham sin ding ahi uhi.","ref":"2Kum 20:17-18; 24:10-16; 2Khg 36:10; Isa 39:7-8"},"5":{"text":"Nisielin kumpipa tanh bangbang an le lenggazu tawh vah dingin kumpipa in amate thu a pie hi. Amate pen kum thum sung pilna kisinsah ding a, tua zaw ciengin kumpi thukhen zumpi ah nasem thei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate lahah Judah minam panin Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah-te kihal uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi innsung mangpa in amate mindang phuopieh hi: Daniel’ min dingin Belteshazzar, Hananiah’ min dingin Shadrach, Mishael’ min dingin Meshach, Azariah’ min dingin Abednego ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Daniel in kumpipa an le zu tawh ama le ama a kibuasah lo nadingin a khensat hi; tuaci’n ama in ama le ama a kibuasah lo nadingin kumpi innsung mangpa kungah phalna ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien in Daniel pen kumpi innsung mangpa tung panin angvanna le lainatna a ngasah hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpi innsung mangpa in Daniel kungah, “Ka pu kumpipa ka giing hi; na an neh ding le na dawn dingte ama in sesa-in nei zo hi. Ama in na khanguol khangdawng dangte sangin na tahsa uh a gawngzaw-in hing mukha leh note ziehin kumpipa in kei ei ngawngtan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi innsung mangpa in Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah-te cing dinga a koi mipa kungah Daniel in tam bangin a thum hi:"},"12":{"text":"“Hepina tawh na nasemte ni sawm sung ei en phot in. Ka neh ding uh ante lohing le ka dawn ding uh tuisih beh ei piesah in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa’ an a ne khangdawngte melpuoh dan le ka melpuoh dan uh nei tekah thei ding a, tuaci’n nangma’ ei muna bang bangin na nasemte ei bawl ta’n,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in tam ngetna thukimin ni sawm sung amate a encih phot hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni sawm a cin zaw ciengin kumpipa’ an a ne khangdawng zosie sangin a maisuo uh hoizaw a, zong thauzaw uhi, ci kimukhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n a cingpa in a kumpi an ule a dawn ding uh zute hemdawhin amate ante lohing beh a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien in tam khangdawng lite tungah lailam le pilna vannuoi ah theina le siemna a pie hi; Daniel in mangmuna zosie le mangkhiet siemna zong nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa in amate a kipeipi nadinga a sesa hun a cin ciengin kumpi innsung mangpa in Nebuchadnezzar mai-ah amate peipi a,"},"19":{"text":"tuale kumpipa in amate a hopi hi. Tuale amate zosie lahah Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah-te tawh tekah thei ding koima kimu lo hi; tua ahi ziehin kumpi inn sunga na sem dingin amate kikoi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pilna le theitelna tawh kisai-in a thudawh vannuoi ah a gambup sunga om mitphiel siemte le aisan thei zosie sangin a za sawmin a siem zawh lam uh kumpipa in mukhie hi."},"21":{"text":"Daniel in Kumpipa Cyrus kumpi a suo zaw a kum khatna dongin khum sungah a nasep a zomsuoh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar kumpi-a a maan zaw a kum nina kumin Nebuchadnezzar in mang pawlkhat man a, tuate ziehin lunggimin kimu thei lo hi.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar’ Mang"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpipa in a mangmatte a gen dingin mitphiel siemte, aisan theite, mibum theite le Chaldea-te hlansah hi. Amate zong tungin kumpipa mai ah a din ciengun,","ref":"Pien 41:8"},"3":{"text":"kumpipa in amate kungah, “Tam bang mang khat ka man a, tua ka mang a khietna ka thei nuom ziehin ka lung a gim hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Chaldea-te in kumpipa kungah (Aram ham tawh), “Kumpipa aw, dam sawt in! Na nasemte na mang ei gen in, a khietna kang gen ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in Chaldea-te dawng a, “Tam pen mipi zaha ka thukhensat ahi hi: Mang le a khietna nei gen thei sih uleh na khut na keng uh kisemnen ding a, na innte uh kisusie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hizongle ka mangmat le a khietna nei gen thei uleh keima tung panin letsongte, thamante le patawina lienpi na nga ding uhi. Tua ahi ziehin ka mangmat le a khietna ei gen un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a ni veina dawngkia-in, “Kumpipa in na nasemte kungah na mang ei gen masa phot in, tua ciengin a khietna kang gen thei pan ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Kiptahin ka khensatsa teng na thei ziehun hun a sawt theithei nadinga hanciem na hi lamtah uh cientahin ka thei hi:"},"9":{"text":"Ka mangmat nei hilcien thei sih uleh note adingin thukhenna khat beh om hi. No teng pen ka lungsim ka khel masangsie keima kungah zuouthu le kam nainiehte gengen dinga kithukimsa na hi uhi. Tua ahi ziehin ka mangmat ei gen phot un, tua hile a khietna nang gen thei ding lam uh ka thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Chaldea-te in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa thei nop thu a gen thei ding leitungah koima om sih va! A tahtahin bang za-in thupi-in vanglien tamale koima’ kumpi in mitphiel siemte, aisan theite, le Chaldea-te khat popo kungah tam bang thu dong ngai lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa thudawh pen hamsa luo a, mihingte tawh a tengton lo pasien-te longal koima in kumpipa kungah tuate pholah thei lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin kumpipa lungthah mama a, Babylon gam sunga mipil zosie thalup dingin thu a pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Mipilte thalup nading thupiehna lai kihawm a, tuale mipilte thalup ding ahi ta hi; tuale amate in Daniel le a guol teng zong thalup dingin a sui uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Daniel in Babylon gama mipilte that dinga a kuon kumpipa’ mithat makaipa Arioch kungah pilvangtah le kidawm tahin a dawngkia hi;"},"15":{"text":"ama in kumpi innsung ulien Arioch kungah, “Bang dinga kumpipa’ thupieh hici kinaw sengseng ahei?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciengin Arioch in a thu teng Daniel a theisah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Daniel lut a, tua mang a khietna gen ding hun a pieh nadingin kumpipa kungah ngen hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Daniel a inn ah pei a, tuale ama in a guolte Hananiah, Mishael, le Azariah-te theisah hi.","title":"Pasien in Nebuchadnezzar’ Mang Pholah"},"18":{"text":"Ama in tam thuthuh tawh kisai-in Daniel le a guolte Babylon gam sunga mipil dangte tawh a siton lo nadingin vantung Pasien tung panin hepina ngen dingin amate kungah a gen hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin zanlai a mang sungah tua thuthuh Daniel tungah kilah a, tuale Daniel in vantung Pasien’ min a phat hi."},"20":{"text":"Daniel in: “Kumtawnin Pasien’ min phatin om taheh, azieh pen pilna le vanglietna ama-a’ ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in hun le khuohunte khel a, kumpite khiesuhin kumpite koi hi; ama in mipilte tungah pilna pie a, theitelna a neite tungah pilna a pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in thuthuhpi le phuolsel nate phuong dawh a, khuomiel sunga omte thei-in ama tawh khuovah a omton hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate’ Pasien aw, nang tungah ka lungdam a, nang kang phat hi. Pilna le vanglietna nei pieh ziehin nang kunga kang nget uh pen kei tungah nei pholah zo hi.
