Azieh pen kumpipa thupieh kote tungah nei theisah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Babylon gamah mipilte that dinga kumpipa in a sesa Arioch kungah Daniel pei a, ama in tuapa kungah, “Babylon mipilte that sin; kumpipa mai-ah ei peipi in, kumpipa mang ka khiehpieh ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Daniel in Mang Khietna Gen"},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Arioch in kumpipa mai-ah Daniel mallang tahin peipi-in ama kungah tam bangin a gen hi: “Judah salte lah panin kumpipa mang ang khiehpieh thei ding mi khat ka mu hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa in Belteshazzar a kici Daniel kungah, “Ka mangmat le a khietna keima kungah nei gen thei diei mah?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Daniel in kumpipa kungah, “Mipil, aisan siem, mitphiel siem ahi sihle bumtawi siemte koima in kumpipa nget thuthuhpi ama tungah pholah thei lo ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanle a kisel thusimte a pholah thei vantungah Pasien khat om a, ama in Nebuchadnezzar Kumpipa kungah mailam huna a pieng ding thute a pholah zo hi. Na mang le lupna tunga na lup laitaha na lungsim sungah na mangmute tam teng ahi hi:"},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, lupna tunga na lup laitahin mailam ang pieng ding thute na ngaisun a, tuale a kisel thusimte a pholah pa in nang tungah ang pieng ding thute ang pholah hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka hile hinna a nei midangte sanga ka pil zawh zieha tam thusimte kei tunga ei kipholah hi loin, kumpipa in mang a khietna na thei nading le na lungsim sunga na ngaisutnate na thei nadinga ei kipholah hizaw hi."},"31":{"text":"“Kumpipa aw, nangma in na en leh, ka nu vawi! na mai ah milim golpi khat a om hi. Tam milim gol mama a, a tan dan tuomdang mama hi; na mai ah tua milim ding a, a melpuoh dan zong giinhuoi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua milim lutang kham citah hi a, a awm le a bante ngun hi-in, a gil le a pheite sumngo ahi a,"},"33":{"text":"a kengte sia hi-in, a kephangte a phal sia, a phal tungman ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Na etto laitahin mihing khuta a kisuizol ahi lo suongtum khat in sia le tungman kisawhal tua milim kephang dengmatin a guoicim ta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin sia, tungman, sumngo, ngun, le khamte a unpi-in guoicim sieng a, khuokhal lai ancilna-a ansi leng tawh kibang hi; tuale a themneng zong a kimu nawn lo nadingin hui in tua teng tawmang sieng hi. Ahi vangin tua milim a dengguoi suongtum pen muol golpi khat suohin leitung bup a dim hi."},"36":{"text":"“Na mang tami ahi hi; tu-in a khietna kumpipa kungah kang gen ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, nang pen kumpite’ kumpipa na hi a, vantung Pasien in nangma tungah kumpi gam, vanglietna, thahatna, le minthanna ang pie zo a,"},"38":{"text":"ama in na khut sungah mun cintenga a teng mihingte, gamlaha a om gamsate, vana a leng vate ang pie zo hi; tuale amate tungah a uh dingin nangma ang koi zo ta hi, tua kham lutang khu nangma na hi hi."},"39":{"text":"Nangma zaw ciengin nangma sanga a gina lo zaw kumpi gam adang khat ang khang ding a, hinanle a thumna sumngo kumpi gam in leitung buppi uh ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuale sia banga a thahat a lina kumpi gam khat ang khang ding hi; sia in na vannuoi satguoi-in a vatmai bangin tam teng zosie gawi-in a zancimsah ding hi."},"41":{"text":"A kephang le a kemete a phal belkhengpa’ tungman le a phal sia kihal na mu bangin tua kumpi gam kikhenzah ding hi; hizongle tungman le sia a kihal na mu bangin a sungah sia bangin hatna kimkhat om ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A kephanga a kemete a phal sia, a phal tungman ahi ma bangin kumpi gam a phal thahatin a phal zawngkhal ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Sia le tungman kihal na mu bangin amate khatlekhat kiteng kipi-in a kisawhal ding vua, hinanle sia le tungman a kicimat thei lo bangin amate zong a kigawm thei tuom sih ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tua kumpite khan sungin vantung Pasien in a kisusie ngai nawn lo ding kumpi gam khat phut ding a, tam kumpi gam pen midang khat’ khut sungah kinuasie lo ding hi. Tua in tami kumpi gam teng zosie satguoi-in maimangsah ding a, tua gam a kip tawntung ding hi;"},"45":{"text":"muol tung panin mihing khuta kisui lo suongtum khat ang lengkhie-in sia, sumngo, tungman, ngun, le khamte a satguoina na mu bang lienin a lien Pasien in mailam thu pieng dingte kumpipa kunga ang theisah ahi hi. Na mang pen mangpi ahi a, a khietna zong muontah ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar a mai leilahah kunsuhin Daniel bie a, ama adingin an tawh biehna le gimnamtui biehnate lui dingin thu a pie hi.","title":"Daniel le a Guolte Kitawisang"},"47":{"text":"Kumpipa in Daniel kungah, “A tahtahin na Pasien pen pasien-te’ Pasien le kumpite’ Topa ahi a, thusimte a pholah pa zong ahi hi, azieh pen nang in tami thusim na pholah thei ta hi!” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Daniel tawisangin letsong thupi tampitah pie a, Babylon gam buppi uhsahin, Babylon mipil zosie tungah uhpi pa dingin koi hi."},"49":{"text":"Daniel in kumpipa kungah ngen a, Babylon gamkhen tenga vaihawm dingin Shadrach, meshach, le Abednego-te koi hi. Ahi vangin kumpipa inn sungah Daniel a om suoh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in a tun tong sawmguh a sang, avai tong guh a gol kham milim khat a bawl hi; ama in tua pen Babylon gamsung Dura zanglei ah phut hi.","title":"Kham Milim"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin gamkaih uhpite, gamkaih uhpi hute, mangpite, thu kuppite, sumkem mangte, thukhente, thukhen mangte, le a gamkaihte sunga uliente zosie kikhawmin Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ phusa milim apna pawi sim dingin Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in amate hlansah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in a phusa milim apna pawi sim dingin gam uhte, gam uhpi hute, mangpite, thu kuppite, sumkem mangte, thukhente, thukhen mangte, le a gamkhente sunga uliente zosie a kikhawm uhi. Nebuchadnezzar in a phusa milim mai-ah amate a din laitahun,"},"4":{"text":"tangko pa in nahpi-in tangtawh a, “Mipite, minamte, le ham nam tuomtuomte aw,"},"5":{"text":"note in sielki gin, theile gin, lyre gin, trigon gin, harp gin, tawm gin, le tumging namcin’ gin na zah ciengun Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ phusa kham milim mai-ah bawhsuhin na bieh nadingun thu ang kipie hi."},"6":{"text":"Bawhsuhin a bie lo poma thakhatin meilipi sungah kisep ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mipi zosie in sielkii gin, theile gin, lyre gin, trigon gin, harp gin, tawm gin, le tumging namcin’ gin a zah behun mipite, minamte, le ham nam zosie bawhsuhin Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ phusa tua kham milim a bie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua bang ahi ziehin Chaldea mi pawlkhat khum hunin pei-in Jew mite a mawpai uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar kungah, “Kumpipa aw, dam sawt in!"},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, nangma in sielkii gin, theile gin, lyre gin, trigon gin, harp gin, tawm gin, le tumging namcin’ gin a za poma bawhsuhin kham milim bie ding a,"},"11":{"text":"bawhsuhin a bie lo poma meilipi sungah kisep ding hi, ci-in thupieh khat na bawl zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua sungah Babylon gamkhen uh dinga na koi: Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego a kici Jew mi pawlkhat a om uhi. Kumpipa aw, tam teng in nangma ang thusim sih uhi. Amate in na pasien-te’ na sem loin na phusa kham milim zong a bie nuom sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Nebuchadnezzar thangpai mama ahi ziehin ama kungah Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te a kipeipi nadingin thu a pie hi; tuaci’n amate in kumpipa mai-ah tua mi teng a peipi uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te aw, note in ka pasien-te’ na sem loin keima’ phusa kham milim na bieh lo uh a man ma amah?"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in a baisa-a na op uleh sielkii gin, theile gin, lyre gin, trigon gin, harp gin, tawm gin, le tumging namcin’ gin na zah ciengun bawhsuhin ka bawlsa milim na bieh uleh a hoi a pha ahi hi. Ahi vangin na bieh nop sih uleh meilipi sungah hing kisep ding hi, tua hile ka khut sung panin note ang hunkhie zo ding koi pasien om ahei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te in kumpipa kungah, “Nebuchadnezzar aw, tam thu tawh kisai-in nangma kungah ka kihut ding uh kisam ka sa sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, a na ka sep uh kote’ Pasien in meilipi pan le na khut sung panin ei hutkhiet zo leh kote ei hunkhie taheh."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin kumpipa aw, ei hutkhiet zo sih leh zong na pasien-te’ na ka sem tuom sih ding vua, na phusa kham milim zong ka bie tuom sih ding uhi, ci thu kithei ta’n,” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te tungah Nebuchadnezzar thangpai-in a mit a mai a kikhuleh hi. Ama in meilipi a sat ngaina za sangin a za sagivei a sazaw-in tawkuong dingin thu pie a,","title":"A Sa Mama Meilipi"},"20":{"text":"tuale Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te a kanbawm ding le meilipi sungah a sepsuh dingin a galkapte lahah a thahatpen pawlkhat thu a pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n a puontuol uh , a bawngbi uh, a lukhu ule adang a puonsilte uh a sil laipi ma-un tua mite a kanbawm vua, meilipi sungah a sepsuh uhi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa thupieh kinaw-in meilipi lah a sat seng ziehin meilipi sungah Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te a sepsuh mite meikuong in a hulvam hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego pasal thumte a kikanbawmsa-in meili lai-ah a kiesuh uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in lamdangsa-in a nawdin hi. Ama in a thu kuppite kungah, “Khumte khu a kikanbawmsa-a meilipi lai-ah a kisepsuh mihing thumte hi lo uh amah?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Hima hi, kumpipa aw,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in, “Ahi vangin keima in a kikanbawm loin mihing li meili lai-ah a vah kawikawi ka mu a, zong a liem beh sih uhi; tua a lina pa in pasien khat’ melpuoh dan a nei hi,” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin meilipi kotkhah lam nehin Nebuchadnezzar pei a, ama in, “Sangpen Pa Pasien’ nasem Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te aw, hing pusuoh un! Tanah hing pei un!” a ci hi. Tuaci’n Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te meili panin a pusuoh uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuale gam uhte, gam uhpi hute, mangpite, le kumpipa’ thu kuppite a kikhawm vua, tua mihing lite citungah mei in bangma a law thei lo lam a mukhie uhi; amau’ luzanga a samte mei in a hulgawp lo banah a puonsilte uzong bangma ci loin meikhu gim zong nam beh lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in, “Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te’ Pasien, a vantungmi sawlin ama a muong a nasemte a hunkhie pa in thupha nga taheh. Amate in a Pasien uh longal pasien dangte khatpo’ na semin a bieh ding uh sangin kumpipa thupiehna mang loin a pumpi uh a si ngamzaw uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in tam bang thupieh khat ka bawl hi: Koi mi, koi nam, koi hamin ham zongle Sharach, Meshach, le Abednego-te’ Pasien a gensie tapo a khut a keng ki-ehmal ding a, a innte uh kisusie ding hi; azieh pen tam banga mi hunkhie thei pasien dang om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in Babylon gamkhen sungah Shadrach, Meshach, le Abednego-te a za uh a khangsah hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in leitung muncin tenga a teng mi zosie, nam zosie, le ham zosie tungah gen hi: Note in a kiningcing nopsahna thupha nei ta un!","title":"Nebuchadnezzar’ Mangmat a Niveina"},"2":{"text":"Sangpen Pa Pasien in kei dinga a bawlsa lim le nalamdangte kang gensawn nuom hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ limte bangza-in lienin, a na lamdang bawlte bangza-in thahat ahei! A kumpi gam pen kumtawn kumpi gam hi a, a khang khangin ama’ thuneina a om ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima Nebuchadnezzar lungnuomin ka inn ah ka teng a, ka kumpi inn sungah nuomsa-in ka om hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka mangmat khat in ei zausisah a, ka lupna tunga ka lungsan teng le ka mangmuna teng in ei dipkuosah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in ka mangmat a khietna gen dingin Babylon gam sunga mipil zosie ka mai-ah ang puoh nadingun thu ka pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin mitphiel siemte, aisan theite, Chaldea-te, le mibum theite ang lut vua, amate kungah ka mangmat ka gen hi. Ahi vangin amate in a khietna ei gen thei lo uhi."},"8":{"text":"A tawpna ah ka mai-ah Daniel ang pei a, ama pen ka pasien’ min kitapin Belshazzar a kici pa ahi a, a siengtho pasien-te’ hlagau khat tawh a kidim hi. Tuale ama kungah ka mangmat ka sut hi:"},"9":{"text":"“Mitphiel dawi siempen Belteshazzar aw, a siengtho pasien-te’ hlagau khat tawh na kidim a, nang adingin a hamsa seng thuthuh om lo ci ka thei hi. Ka mangmat za inlen a khietna ei gen in."},"10":{"text":"Ka lupna tunga ka mang mu tami ahi hi; leitung laikimah singkung khat po a, tua singkung sang mama hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua singkung khangin gol semsem a, a dawn in van holto hi. Leimong teng panin tua singkung kimu thei hi."},"12":{"text":"A nate hoi a, a ga zong tamin, mi vannuoi an a sih hi. Gamlahah gamsate in a hlim a bel vua, vana a leng vate in a ba tung lahah bu bawlin hinna nei zosie tua tawh a kivah uhi."},"13":{"text":"A banah ka enkia leh lupna tunga ka lup laitahin ka mangmuna sungah vantung panin a cing misiengtho khat ang kumsuh ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Awng vapuohin ama in tam bangin a gen hi: ‘Tua singkung phua-in a ba teng tansan unlen, a na teng heu siengin a ga teng zong thezah un. A hlim bel ganhingte le a ba tunga a tuong vate heudawh un."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin a bul le a zungte lei sungah omsah unlen, gamlah lopate lahah sumngo le siakhau-in hen un. Van daituite in tapnom hinlen, ama’ tanh ding pen gamsate-a’ tawh kibang taheh."},"16":{"text":"A lungsim, mihing lungsim panin kikhel hinlen ganhing lungsim puo taheh. A za sagi-in ama tungah tung taheh."},"17":{"text":"Sangpen Pa in mihingte’ kumpi gamah thu nei pen hi, ci thu hinna nei zosie in a thei nadingin, thukhenna pen a cingte khensatna bangin kisem a, thukhenna pen mi siengthote’ thupiehna tawh kisem ahi hi; ama in a pieh nuomte tungah kumpi gam pie a, mi tuolniem pente tungah kumpi gam a pie hi,’ a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ mang mat tami ahi hi. Belteshazzar aw, ka kumpi gam sunga om mipil zosie in a khietna ei gen thei lo ziehun nangma in tu-in a khietna ei gen in. Hizongle nang a siengtho pasien-te’ hlagau tawh na kidim ziehin a khietna nei gen thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Belteshazzar min nei Daniel bakhat sung nahpitahin a lung a kham hi. A ngaisutnate in ama a patausah hi. Kumpipa in, “Belteshazzar aw, na mangmat le a khietna ziehin kizausah laizang sin,” a ci hi. Belteshazzar in, “Ka pu aw, na mangmat pen nangma ang mudate-a’ hizaw hinlen, a khietna zong na galte-a’ hizaw taheh!","title":"Daniel in a Niveina Mang Khie"},"20":{"text":"Na singkung mu pen ang khang a, ang golin van ang holto a, leimong dongin kimu thei hi."},"21":{"text":"A nate hoi-in a ga zong tamin mi zosie an a sih hi. Tuale gamsate in a hlim a bel vua, a bate tungah vana vate in bu a bawl uhi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, tua khu nangma na hi hi! Nang na khanglien a, na thahat hi. Na vanglietna khang semsemin van na holto a, na thuneina in leimong dong a huop hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale kumpipa in na et laitahin vantung panin a cing mi siengtho khat na mu a, ‘Tua singkung phuadawh unlen susie un, ahi vangin a bul le a zungte lei sungah omsah unlen, gamlah lohingte lahah siakhau le sumngo-in henin vantung daitui in ama a tehlopsah a, tuaci’n ama tungah a za sagivei a tun dongin gamsate tawh tengtonsah un,’"},"24":{"text":"a ci pen kumpipa aw, a khietna tam bang ahi a, Sangpen Pa in ka pu kumpipa tunga ang tunsah a thukhenna ahi hi:"},"25":{"text":"Mihingte lah panin ang kinotmang ding a, gamsate tawh na tengton ding hi. Bawngtang bangin lopa ang kinesah ding a, vantung daitui in hing tehlopsahin Sangpen Pa in mihingte’ kumpi gam sungah thunei penin pang a, kumpi gam a pieh nuomte tungah a pie hi, ci na thei masangsie na tungah sagivei a tung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Singbul le a zungte lei sunga nuasie ding thu a kipieh bangin Vantung in thunei hi, ci na thei huna kipanin nang adingin na kumpi gam ang kiphupieh kia ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kumpipa aw, nang tunga kang thuhilna ei sanpieh in: Na mawnate adingin dihna tawh mawsut inlen, na nopsahna sawtvei na khom nadingin a kibawlsie mite tungah hepina tawh na khielnate sut in. Tua hile na nopsahna sawtvei na khom ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar tungah tam zosie a tung hi.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar’ Maizum Thuohna"},"29":{"text":"Hla sawm le hla ni zaw ciengin Babylon kumpi innkhum zangah ama vah kawikawi a,"},"30":{"text":"tuale kumpipa in, “Tami a thupi Babylon, kumpi khuopi ding le keima’ minthan thupi nadinga a thahat ka vanglietna tawh ka lamsa hi lo amah?” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Kumpipa’ kam sungah tua kammalte a pusuo laitahin vantung panin aw khat ang ging hi: “Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar aw, nang dinga tami thu ang kigen ahi hi: Nang tung panin kumpi gam a peikhie zo hi!"},"32":{"text":"Mihingte lah panin ang kinotmang ding a, gamlahah gamsate tawh na tengton ding hi. Bawngtang bangin lopa ang kinesah ding a, Sangpen Pa in mihingte’ kumpi gamah thunei penin pangin tua kumpi gam a pieh nuomte tungah a pie hi, ci na thei masangsie nang tungah sagivei ang tung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar tungah thakhatin thukhenna a tangtung pai hi. Mihingte lah panin ama kinotmangin bawngtang bangin lopa ne a, a samte muvanlai’ multe bang le a cinte va kecin banga a sau dongin van daitui in a citung teng a tehlopsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Khum hun ang tawp ciengin keima Nebuchadnezzar in van lam ka ento leh khuo ka phawhkia hi. Sangpen Pa ka phat a, a hing zing pa phatin ka patawi hi. Azieh pen a thuneina in kumtawn thuneina hi a, ama’ kumpi gam zong a khangkhangin a om hi.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar in Pasien Phat"},"35":{"text":"Leitunga teng mi zosie bangma-in kisim lo a, ama in vantung nate le leitunga teng mite tungah a dei bangin na sem hi. Koima in ama’ khut tu zo lo a, ama kungah koima in “Bang bawl na hei?” ci lo hi."},"36":{"text":"Khum hunin keima in khuo ka phawhkia hi; tuale ka kumpi gam minthan nadingin ka vanglietna le ka thupina keima tungah ei kipiekia hi. Ka thu kuppite le ka uliente in keima ei sui vua, ka kumpi gam sungah kumpi-in ei kikoi kia-in ka tungah vanglietna a golzaw ei kipiehbe lai hi."},"37":{"text":"Tu-in keima Nebuchadnezzar in vantung Kumpipa phatin tawisangin zatahna ka pie hi. Azieh pen a nasep zosie thuman ahi a, a lampi zosie thutang ahi hi; ama in kilietsahna tawh a gamta mite a niemkhieh thei hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Belshazzar in a ulien tulkhat adingin pawi lienpi khat bawl a, mi tulkhat mai-ah zu a dawn hi.","title":"Belshazzar’ Pawi"},"2":{"text":"Belshazzar in a zu lungnop kawmin kumpipa le a uliente, a zite le a meite zu dawn nadingin amate in Jerusalem biehinnpi pana a pa Nebuchadnezzar in a na lah kham hai le ngun haite a lah nadingun thu a pie hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Jerusalem Pasien’ biehinnpi pana a kila kham hai le ngun haite peipi-in kumpipa le a uliente, a zite le a meite in tuate tawh zu a dawn uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in zu dawnin ngun le kham, sumngo, sia, sing le suong pasien-te’ min a phat uhi."},"5":{"text":"Thakhatin mihing’ khut khat kilang a, meivah tunna gei, za a kizut kumpi inn kawm tungah lai giel ang kipan pai hi. Tua khut in lai a giel laitahin kumpipa in a en khinkhian hi.","title":"Kawm Tunga Kigiel Lai"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa mai daang gawpin a ngaisutna in ama zausisah a, a khut a kengte zawmangin a khup tegel a tun dildel hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa in aisan theite, Chaldea-te, le bumtawite va hlan ta un, ci-in kiko hi; tuale Kumpipa in Babylon mipilte kungah, “Tami lai kigiel sim thei-in a khietna ei gen thei tapo puon sandup kisilsah ding a, a ngawngah kham khi ki-awsahin kumpi gam sungah a zalien a thumna-in kikoi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa’ mipil zosie a lut vua, ahi vangin amate in tua lai kigiel sim thei loin, kumpipa kungah a khietna zong a gen thei sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua bepin Kumpi Belshazzar nahpi-in zausi-in a mai kangdang a, a uliente a lung uh a buoi hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpinu in kumpipa le a uliente thu kikup a zah ciengin pawi khaamna inn sungah a lut hi. Kumpinu in, “Kumpipa aw, na khan sawt taheh! Na ngaisutna ziehin kizausisah sinlen, na mai dangsah sin."},"11":{"text":"Na kumpi gam sungah a siengtho pasien-te’ hlagau a nei mi khat a om hi. Na pa hun lai-in tua mipa in pasien-te’ pilna tawh a kibang thuthuh theina, thu theitelna le pilna a nei hi. Na pa Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in mitphiel siemte, aisan theite, Chaldea-te, le mibum theite’ uhpi-in ama na koi ngai hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen kumpipa in a min Belshazzar a phuopieh Daniel sungah mang khieh theina, thu hahsate dawn theina, le thubuoite vensah theina ahi koima in a bat zawh lo pilna, theina, thu theitelnate kimu hi. Tu-in Daniel hlansah in, tua hile ama in a khietna ang gen thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa mai-ah Daniel kipeipi hi. Kumpipa in Daniel kungah, “Nang pen Daniel a kici pa, Judah gam sung pana ka pa kumpipa in ang mat Judah mite lahah sila khat hi lo na mah?","title":"Kawm Tunga Lai Kigiel a Khietna Kigen"},"14":{"text":"Nang sungah pasien-te’ hlagau a op lam ka na za zo a, thuthuh theina, thu theitelna, le koima in a bat zawh lo pilna na sungah a op lam kimu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in tam lai kigiel a sim ding le a khietna ei gen dingin mipilte, aisan theite ka mai-ah ang kipeipi zo ta a, ahi vangin amate in tua thu a khietna a gen thei sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin nangma in a khietna na gen thei a, thubuoite zong na vengsah thei hi, ci-in ka na za zo hi. Tu-in tua lai kigiel na sim thei a, a khietna nei gen thei leh, puon sandup ang kisilsahin na ngawngah kham khi ang ki-awsah ding a, kumpi gam sungah a za lien a thumna-in ang kikoi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Daniel in kumpipa mai-ah dawng a, “Na letsongte nangma adingin koi in. Ahi sihle na nuommante midang khat pie in! Hizongle kumpipa adingin tua lai kigiel kang simpieh ding a, a khietna kang theisah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, Sangpen Pa Pasien in kumpi-in na pa Nebuchadnezzar koi a, zalietna, vang le thupina a pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale ama tunga a pieh zalietna ziehin ama mai-ah mi zosie, minam zosie, le ham zosie citun uhi. Ama in a tha nuomte thatin a hinkhawi nuomte hinkhawi a, a patawi nuomte patawi-in, a daisah nuomte daisah hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lungsim kisangsahin kisathei tahin a gamtat nadingin a lung a khau ciengin a kumpi topha panin kiladawh a, ama kung panin a vang kihawhmang hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte lah panin kinotmang a, a lungsim zong ganhing lungsim nei dingin kibawl hi. Gam sakolte tawh tengtonin bawngtang bangin lopa kinesah a, Sangpen Pa Pasien in mihingte’ kumpi gamah thunei a, kumpi gam a pieh nuom pa tungah pie hi, ci thu a thei masangsie van daitui in a pumpi tehlopsah den hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale a tapa nang Belshazzar in tam thu zosie na thei sieng vangin na lungsim na niemkhieh tuom sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang in Vantung’ Topa na do a, nang le nang na kitawisang hi! Ama’ biehinn sunga haite nangma kungah ang kitawi zo a, nang le na uliente, na zite le na meite un tuate tawh zu dawn zo ta uhi. Khuo a mu lo, khuo a za lo, a theithei lo, ngun le kham, sumngo, sia, sing le suong pasien-te’ min na phat uhi; ahi vangin a vanglietna sungah na hinna hu uh omin na gamtatna zosie uh ang saipieh Pasien na zatah sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Tuaci’n a opna panin tua khut ang kisawlin tam lai ang kigielsah ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"A kigiel lai tam bang ahi hi: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, le PARSIN."},"26":{"text":"Tua thu a khietna tam bang ahi hi: MENE, Pasien in na kumpi gam vaihawmna hunte sim zo a, tawpsah zo hi."},"27":{"text":"TEKEL, nang ang kitawikhai zo a, na leh zo sih hi."},"28":{"text":"PERES, na kumpi gam kikhen khamin Media le Persia-te kipie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Daniel puon dupsan silsah dingin Belshazzar in thu pie a, a ngawngah kham khi awsahin a kumpi gam sungah a za lien a thumna dingin tangtawhna kinei hi.","ref":"Pien 41:42"},"30":{"text":"Khum zan mama-in Chaldea-te’ kumpipa Belshazzar kithat pai hi."},"31":{"text":"Kum sawmguh le kum ni a phah kumin Mede mi Darius in kumpi gam nga hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius in kumpi gam buppi vai sai dingin gamkhen uhpi za le sawmni koi dingin pha a sa a,","title":"Daniel Kithasawm"},"2":{"text":"tuale amate tungah vaisaipi mi thum koi-in, tuate lahah Daniel zong khatin kihal hi; kumpipa in sup le bai a tuo lo nadingin tua gamkhen uhpite in tam teng tungah thu a puoh uhi."},"3":{"text":"Daniel in koima’ bat zawh lo pilna a nei ziehin adang vaisaipite le gamkhen uhpite lahah kituom khai a, kumpipa in gam buppi vaihawm dingin koi sawm hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n vaisaipite le gamkhen uhte in kumpi gam tawh kisai-in Daniel tungah mawmat nading hamlap a tangsui uhi. Ahi vangin ama thumanin a thoptat sih a, ama tungah sietna a kimu zo lo ziehin amate in mawmat nading hamlap ahi a, sietna ahi zongin a muzo sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mite in, “A Pasien’ thukham tawh kisai-in i mu lo buong uleh tami Daniel tungah i mawmat nading uh hamlap dang i mu zo sih ding uhi,” a kici uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n vaisaipite le gamkhen uhpite kidap kupin kumpipa kungah a pei vua, “Kumpipa Darius aw, na khan sau taheh!"},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, ni sawmthum sung nangma kung simlo mi khatpo kung ahi sihle pasien khatpo kunga thungen poma humpi kuo sungah kikhie ding hi, ci-in thupiehna lai le khamna lai khat bawl lacin hoi ding hi, ci-in kumpi gam sunga vaisaipite, gamkaih uhpi hute, gamkaih uhpite, thu kuppite, le mangpite zosie ka kithukim uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, tu-in Medes-te le Persia-te upadi a kikhel lo bangin a kikhel lo nadingin tua lai tungah na suoi kai in,” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Kumpi Darius in thupiehna lai le khamna lai tungah suoi a kai hi."},"10":{"text":"Daniel in tua thupiehna lai suoi kikai zo ci a thei vangin Jerusalem lam nga-in tawlet honsa-a om a inndan tungnungah pei-in nidanga a bawl ngai bangin ni khatin thumvei khupdinin a Pasien tungah thu ngenin ama a phat hi.","title":"Humpi Kuo Sungah Daniel"},"11":{"text":"A sawmdapte a pei ule Pasien mai-ah Daniel in hepina a nget laitah a tuoh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kumpipa kung a neh vua, tuale thupiehna lai tawh kisai-in, “Kumpipa aw! Ni sawmthum sungin nang kung longal pasien ahi sihle mihing tunga thu ngen poma humpi kuo sungah kikhie ding hi, ci-in thupiehna lai tungah suoi kai zo hi lo na mah?” a ci uhi. Kumpipa in, “ Medes-te le Persia-te upadi a kiphel thei lo ma bangin tam thu pen thukip ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kumpipa a dawngkia vua, “Kumpipa aw, Judah gam panin na salte lahah khat ahi Daniel in nang le na suoikaina khamna lai a thuse sih a, tuale mahin ni khatin thumvei thu a ngen zawsop hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua mawsahna thu a zah ciengin lung gim mama hi. Ama in Daniel hunkhie nuom a, ni tum dongin ama a hutkhiet nading hanciem thei tawpin a sem hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa kungah a sawmdapte pei-in ama kungah, “Kumpipa aw, thei in. Medes le Persia-te’ upadi banga kumpipa in a bawlsa khamna lai ahi sihle thupiehna lai pen kikhel thei lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in thu pie-in Daniel a zawpi vua, humpi kuo sungah a khiesuh uhi. Kumpipa in Daniel kungah, “Thuman taha a na naseppieh na Pasien in hing hunkhie taheh,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Suongtum khat kila-in humpi kuo vangah kikoi a, tuale Daniel tawh kisai-in thu a kikhel khah nawn lo nadingin kumpipa in ama’ seal tupna khutsip le a uliente’ seal tupna khutsip tawh a ciemte hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kumpi inn sungah kumpipa pei-in ama in zan tawntungin an a ngawl hi; ama kungah bangma an kipuoh lo a, zong kimu thei lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuo a vah lien tahin kumpipa tho-in humpi kuo lamah mallangin a pei hi.","title":"Humpi Lahah Daniel Kihunkhie"},"20":{"text":"Daniel opna humpi kuo gei a tun ciengin Daniel kungah patau tahin kiko a, “Daniel aw, a hing zing Pasien’ nasempa, thuman taha a na nasep pieh na Pasien in humpi panin ang hunkhie zo ei mah?” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Daniel in kumpipa kungah, “Kumpipa aw, na khan sau taheh!"},"22":{"text":"Ama mai-ah kei nuol baang loin ei kimu ziehin keima ei liemsah lo nadingun ka Pasien in a vantung mite sawlin humpite’ kam a humpieh hi; tuale kumpipa aw, keima in na mai-ah zong bangma khielna ka bawl sih hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bepin nahpitahin kumpipa lungdam a, humpi kuo sung panin Daniel a lahdawh nadingun thu a pie hi. Tuaci’n humpi kuo sung panin Daniel kiladawh a, ama in a Pasien a muon ziehin a ci tungah liemma khat beh kimu lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Daniel a leheh teng- amate, a tate ule a zite utawh- kizawpi-in humpi kuo sunga khieh dingin kumpipa in thu a pie hi. Humpi kuo tawdop a tun masangun humpite in amate na zothaw-in a gu a tangin a tepguoi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kumpi Darius in leitung muncin tenga a om mi zosie, nam zosie le ham zosiete tungah tam bangin lai a hlah hi: “Note in a kicing nopsahna thupha nga ta un!"},"26":{"text":"Keima in thupieh khat ka bawl a, ka uhna kumpi gam sunga om mi zosie in Daniel’ Pasien mai-ah zatahin citun ding uhi: Azieh pen ama a hing zing Pasien hi a, kumtawnin ama a om zing hi. A kumpi gam kisusie ngai lo ding a, a vaihawmna tawp ngai lo ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in suotasahin hunkhie a, ama in vantung le leitungah lim le nalamdangte a bawl hi; azieh pen humpi thahatna panin Daniel a hunkhie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n tami Daniel pen Darius uh sung le Persia mi Cyrus uh sungin a daupei mama hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Belshazzar, Babylon kumpi a suo zaw a kum masa kumin Daniel in mang khat man a, a lupna tungah a lup laitahin a lungsim sungah mangmunate nei hi. Tua ciengin ama in lai tawh a mangmat tam bangin giel hi:","title":"Mangmuna Sunga Gamsa Lite"},"2":{"text":"Keima Daniel in zan lai-in ka mangmuna sungah tuipi lien a lawhling van ning lite ka mu a,"},"3":{"text":"tuipi panin gamsa gol li ang pusuohto a, tuate khatlekhat kibang lo hi.","ref":"Kln 13:1; 17:8"},"4":{"text":"Amasa pen humpi tawh kibangin muvanlai hla nei hi. Tua ciengin keima in ka et laitahin a hlate kibotin lei lah panin kidomsang a, mihing bangin a keng tegel tawh kidingsahin ama tungah mihing lungsim kiguon hi."},"5":{"text":"A nina gamsa adang khat ang kilang a tua pen vompi tawh kibang hi. A pang lang khatin dingto-in a kam sunga a hate kikalah a hapate thum om a, “Tho inlen luong tampi ne in!” kici hi."},"6":{"text":"Tami zaw ciengin keima in ka en leh gamsa adang khat ang kilangkia a, tua pen lutnu tawh kibang hi. Tua gamsa in a elzangah va hla li nei a, lutang li nei hi; tuale ama tungah uhna aana kipie hi.","ref":"Kln 13:2"},"7":{"text":"Tami zaw ciengin zanlai ka mangmuna ah a giinhuoi, a cimulthaw huoi, le a thahat mama a lina gamsa khat ka mu hi. Tua in siaha gol khat nei a, ama in nawmvalin ehmal a, a omlai teng a keng tawh tuoncil hi. Ama pen a masanga gamsate tawh kibang loin ki sawm nei hi.","ref":"Kln 12:3; 13:1"},"8":{"text":"Keima in tua a kite ka ngaisut laitahin tuate lah panin adang a ki neu khat ang po a, tuami op nadingin a masanga a ki thumte a zung panin kibotkhie hi. Tami a ki tungah mihing mittang tawh a kibang mittangte om a, kiliensah tahin a ham hi.","ref":"Kln 13:5-6"},"9":{"text":"Ka et laitahin kumpi tophate kipha a, a kumpi topha tungah Khanglui Mipa a to hi. A puonsil vua bangin ngo a, a luzanga a samte zong tuumul bangin a siengtho hi; a kumpi topha mei-am hi a, a topha lengkangte meikuong ahi hi.","title":"Khanglui Mipa Mai-ah Thukhenna","ref":"Kln 20:4; 1:14"},"10":{"text":"Meikuong lomkhat a pusuoh a, a mai panin tui luonin a luong hi. Mi tul za tampi in ama’ na a sem vua, ama a khoi dingin tul za sawm tampi a ding uhi. Thukhen dingin zumah kito a, laibute kiphen hi.","ref":"Kln 5:11; 20:12"},"11":{"text":"Tuami ki in kiphatsahna kam a ham ziehin ka en khinkhian hi. Tuale keima in ka et laitahin tua gamsa kithatin a pumpi kisusie a, mei tawh hal dingin kipie hi."},"12":{"text":"A omlai gamsate pen amau’ uhna aana kilahpieh a, ahi vangin a nuntahna uh a kiciengtan hun khat sung kikhanpieh hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in zan ka mangmuna-ah ka en a, mihing tawh a kibang khat vana meii tung tuongin ang pei ka mu hi. Khanglui Mipa kungah ama pei a, ama mai-ah kizawpi hi.","ref":"Mat 24:30; 26:64; Mrk 13:26; 14:62; Luk 21:27; Kln 1:7, 13; 14:14"},"14":{"text":"Ama tungah uhna aana, vang le kumpi za kipie a, mi zosie, nam zosie, le ham zosie in a na sem ding uhi. Ama’ uhna aana pen kumtawn uhna aana hi a, tua uhna tawp ngai loin a kumpi gam zong kisusie ngai lo ding hi.","ref":"Kln 11:15"},"15":{"text":"Keima Daniel ka hile ka sung tawngah ka buoi mama a, ka mangmunate in ka lungsim ei patausah hi.","title":"Daniel Mangmuna Kikhiehpieh"},"16":{"text":"Tami thu zosie tawh kisai-in thuman dong dingin a cingte lahah khat ka va nai ta hi. Tuaci’n ama in tua thu a khietna kang hil ding hi, ei ci hi:"},"17":{"text":"“Tami gamsa lite pen kumpi gam li ahi a, leitung panin kumpi li ang khang ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle Sangpen Pa’ misiengte in kumpi gam a tang ding vua, tua kumpi gam kumtawnin a nei zing ding uhi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Kln 22:5"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in a omlai teng zosie tawh a kilamdang, nahpi taha a giinhuoi, siaha le sumngo kecin a nei, ehmalin a nawmval, a omlai teng a keng tawh a tuoncil gamsa lina tungtang thu,"},"20":{"text":"le a lutunga po a ki sawmte le, tuate lahah thum kiladawhin mittangte nei-in kiliensah tahin a kam pau, tua adangte sanga a goltuohzaw, tua adang ang poto ki tungtang thu ka thei nuom hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in ka et laitahin tami ki in misiengte tawh gal kido a, tua","ref":"Kln 13:7"},"22":{"text":"Khanglui Mipa ang pei masangin amate a zo gawp hi; tua ciengin Sangpen Pa’ misiengte tungah thukhen theina kipie a, misiengte in kumpi gam a nga nading uh hun a tung hi.","ref":"Kln 20:4"},"23":{"text":"Ama gen khu tami ahi hi: “Gamsa lina pen, leitunga ang pieng ding kumpi gam lina hi a, kumpi gamdang zosie tawh kibang lo ding hi. Tua in leitung buppi valtum ding a, tuoncilin ehmal ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ki sawmte tawh kisai pen, tam kumpi gam sung panin kumpi sawm ang khang ding a, amate nua-ah adang khat ang khangkhie ding hi. Tam pen a omsate tawh kibang loin kumpi thumte a nuoinet ding hi.","ref":"Kln 17:12"},"25":{"text":"Ama in Sangpen Pa langpanna kam pau-in, Sangpen Pa’ misiengte genthei bawl ding a, a siengtho pawibawl hunte le thukhamte khel ding hanciemin, ama’ khut sungah hun khat, hun ni, le hun lang sung amate a om ding uhi.","ref":"Kln 12:14; 13:5-6"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukhenin kito ding a, ama’ uhna aana kilah piehin kisumaimang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpi za, uhna aana, le vansin nei buppi sunga Sangpen Pa’ misiengte tungah a kumpi gam thupina teng kipie ding hi. Amau’ kumpi gam pen kumtawn kumpi gam hi ding a, vaihawm zosie in amau’ na semin a thu mang ding uhi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Kln 20:4; 22:5"},"28":{"text":"Tam sungah tangthu a kihiel ahi ta hi. Keima Daniel ka hile ka lungsim ngaisutna in ei zausahin ka mai a engdang vawt hi; ahi vangin tami thu ka lungsim sungah ka koi khinkhian hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima kungah mangmuna khat ang kilah masah zaw, Belshazzar kumpi suo a kum thumna kumin keima Daniel kungah mangmuna khat ang kilang hi.","title":"Tuutang Khat le Keeltang Khat Mangmuna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in tua mangmuna sungah ka et laitahin Elam gamkhen Susa khuopi sunga a omin kei le kei ka kimu a, Ulai gun gei-ah ka ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka dahto leh gun gei-a a ding tuutang khat ka mu hi. Ama in ki ni nei hi. A ki tegel sau tuoh a, ahi vangin khat pen adang khat sangin sauzaw hi. Tua a sauzaw pen a po nukhia zaw ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua tuutang in a ki tawh nitumna lam, sahlam, le hlanglam a suh kawikawi ka mu hi. Gamsa zosie in ama nangzo loin ama’ thahatna panin koima in hunkhie zo lo hi; ama’ dei bangin gamta-in a thahat semsem hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in ka et laitahin nitumna lam panin keeltang khat ang kilang a, lei tuon loin leitung buppi a kansan hi. Tua keel in a mit tegel kikalah ki khat nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Ki ni a nei gun gei-a ding ka musa tuutang kung zuonin a thanei za tawh ama a tai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua keeltang in tuutang lam a nai ka mu hi. A lungthah sengin tua tuutang a ki tawh su a, a ki ni a tawngsan hi. Tuutang in ama a nan zawh nading hatna nei lo hi; ama in tua tuutang tuolsena-in nei-in tuoncil a, ama’ hatna panin tuutang a hunkhie zo koima om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua keeltang nahpi tahin ang vanglien hi; ahi vangin a thahat pen laitahin a ki golpi tawngsan a, khum munah leimong li lam kinga-in a lamdang ki li a momkia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuate lahah khat tungah a neu ki adang khat mom a, leitaw lam, nisuona lam, gam hoi lam nga-in nahpi tahin vanglien hi."},"10":{"text":"Vantung galkap honte bangin a thahatna khangto a, ama in vantung galkap honkhat le aasi honkhat leitungah khiesuhin a tuoncil hi.","ref":"Kln 12:4"},"11":{"text":"Ama kiliensahin van galkap lamkaipa nangawn a do hi; ama in a kibawl zing meihal biehna lahpiehin ama’ mun siengtho zong a lemangpieh hi."},"12":{"text":"Gitlona ziehin tuami ki tungah nisim meihal biehna le galkap honpite kipie a, tua ki in tualah thuman a paisuh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a siengtho pa khat thugen ka za a, adang a siengthopa khat in tua thugenpa kungah, “Nisima meihal biehna, nate a hawmmangsah suhkhielna, le mun siengtho le vantung galkapte totcil dinga a kipieh nading tawh kisai tami mangmuna bang tanvei sawt ding ahei” a kici uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in dawng a, “Zingmawng le nitah tulni le zathum sawt ding hi; tua ciengin ama mun ngai ma ah mun siengtho kikoikia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima Daniel in mangmuna ka mu zaw ciengin tuami khietna ka thei nadingin ka hanciem hi. Tua ciengin mihing melpuo khat ka mai-ah ang ding a,","title":"Gabriel in Mangmuna Khiehpieh"},"16":{"text":"tuale Ulai panin mihing’ aw khat ka za a, “Gabriel aw, tam mipa mangmuna theisah in,” ci-in hlan hi.","ref":"Luk 1:19, 26"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in ka dinna gei ang nai a, ang tun ciengin ka zau seng ziehin ka bawhsuh hi. Ahi vangin ama in keima kungah, “Mihing aw, mangmuna pen hun tawp cieng ading ahi lam thei in,” ei ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in keima ei hopi laitahin khuophawh nawn loin tuolah ka pua hi; tua bepin ama in kei ei thamin ka kengin ei dingsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Ngai vawi, lungthah hun tawp cienga ang pieng ding thute ang gen ding ka hi hi; azieh pen tua khu a kisesa hun tawpna ding genna ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ki ni a nei tuutang na mu pen Media le Persia kumpite a cina ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Keeltang pen Greek kumpipa hi a, a mit tegel kikala a po a ki gol pen khu kumpi masapen ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A ki a tawngsan, tua munah adang ki li a pote ahi uleh, ama’ gam sung panin kumpi gam li khang ding cina hi a, ahi vangin kumpi gam masa pen bangin hat zo lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amau’ uhna tawpin, khielnate ang bukim ciengin, zuouphuo siem le hansan mel a puo kumpi khat ang khang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama thahatin ang vanglien ding a, ama in a zauhuoi sietna piengsahin, a sepna-ah lawcing ding hi. Ama in mi thahatte le misiengte a susie ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A khelpilna tawh a khut in zuou bawlin cithei ding a, a lungsim zong kiliensah ding hi. Hilkhol loin mi tampi thatin, kumpite’ Kumpipa nangawn langpan ding a, hizongle mihing khut tawh hi loin ama kisusie ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Zingmawng le nitaha mangmuna kigen pen a man ahi hi. Nang na hileh tua mangmuna imcip phot in, azieh pen tua khu tu-a kipanin ang tung ding hun sawtpi ading ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima Daniel, thazaw gawpin ni phabep khat sung ka ci a na hi; tua ciengin ka tho a, kumpipa nasep sem dingin ka kuon hi. Ahi vangin ka mangmuna in ei zauthawngsah a, tua khu ka theitel zo sih hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mede minam Ahasuerus’ tapa Darius in Chaldea-te gam sunga kumpi a suo masah kum,","title":"Mite ading Daniel Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"a kumpi sep a masa pen kumin keima Daniel in a kum phaza ding Lai Siengtho sungah Topa in kamsang Jeremiah kunga a na gen dung zui-in Jerusalem a kisuhsiet hun ang tung valon ding a, tua khu kum sawm sagi sung hi ding hi, ci-in ka cien thei hi.","ref":"Jer 25:11; 29:10"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka thungetna le ka thumna ei dawn nadingin keima in an ngawlin la-ip puon silin vut ka kibuoh a, Topa lam ka kinga hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka Topa Pasien kungah thungenin mawna ka pulah a, “A lien le a giinhuoi Pasien, nang ang it mite le na thupieh a zui mite tungah thuciemna pel loin itna kip a nei Topa aw,"},"5":{"text":"kote maw-in khielna ka bawl vua, gitlo gamtatin kang ledo vade vua, na thupiehte le na ngaina kipte panin ka kihei zel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ka kumpite uh, ka vaihawmte uh, ka pu ka pate ule gam sunga mi zosie kungah na min tawh thugen na nasem kamsangte’ thu ka ngai sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"“ Topa aw, nang lamah dihna om a, ahi vangin nangma tungah amate a thuman lo ziehun gam zosie-ah na nawmangsa Judah mite, Jerusalem-a tengte, a nai a gamla-a om Israel-te zosie ahi kote tungah tuni-a bangin maizumna ang tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma tunga kang khiel ziehun ka kumpite uh, ka vaihawmte uh, ka pu ka pate ule koma tungah maizumna ang tung hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien uh kungah hepina le mawmaisahna a om hi, azieh pen kote in ama ka ledo vua,"},"10":{"text":"tuale a nasem kamsangte tungtawnin ka mai vua a koi a thukhamte zui loin Topa ka Pasien uh thugen ka mang sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Israel zosie in na thukham palsatin a kilehei vua, na aw zong a ngai sih uhi. Tuaci’n nangma tungah ka maw zo tah ziehun Pasien’ nasem Moses thukham sunga a kigiel samsietna le awsiete kote tungah ang kibuosuh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in kote langkhat le ka vaihawmte langkhatah a gensa thute kipsah a, kote tungah tuosietna lienpi tungsah zo a, tua Jerusalem-a a tunsah gimna bang pen vansin nei buppi-ah khatvei beh zong tung ngai nai lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses’ thukham sunga a kigiel bang lienin tam tuosietna teng zosie kote tungah ang tungzo ta hi. Kote in ka khielnate uh taisanin, ama’ thumanna ka lungngai thei nadingun Topa ka Pasien uh kungah hepina ka ngen sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa in kote tunga a tunsah masangsie tam tuosietna a koicing hi. Topa i Pasien uh pen a sepna zosie-ah a dih tahtah ahi hi; bangzieh ahei cile kote in ama thu ka mang sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Khut thahat khat tawh Egypt panin na mite peipi-in tuni cieng dong nangawnin na min a thangsah kote’ Topa Pasien aw, tu-in kote ka maw vua, ka gitlo gamtat ta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, thudih tawh na gamtatna zosie ziehin na muol siengtho, na khuopi Jerusalem panin na lungthahna le na thangpaina heimang dawh ta’n; ka mawna ule ka pu ka pate uh’ khielna ziehin ka veng ka pam zosie lahah Jerusalem le na mite mi simmaw-in ka om ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa aw, na nasempa thungetna le thumna ei ngai inlen, tu-in nangma adinga kinuasiesa na mun siengtho tungah na mai hing tangsah in."},"18":{"text":"Ka Topa Pasien aw, na bil ei ngat inlen ei za in. Na mit hahsah inlen kote le nangma’ min a puo khuopi sietna en in. Ka dihna uh zieh hi loin, na khuotuona lienpi ziehin na mai-ah thumna ang nei ka hizaw uhi."},"19":{"text":"Topa aw, ei za in; Topa aw, ei maisah in; Topa aw, ei ngai-in ei bawlpieh inlen kiheh ta sin! Azieh pen na khuopi le na mite nangma’ min puo ahi uhi, ka Topa Pasien aw!” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima in ka mawna le ka mi Israel’ mawna ka pulah kawmin hamin thu ka nget laitah le ka Pasien’ muol siengtho tangin Topa ka Pasien mai-ah thumna ka nei laitah,","title":"Nipikal Sawmsagite"},"21":{"text":"thu ka ngetnget laitah, nitah biehpiehna hun pawlin ka mangmu masah lai-a ka musa Gabriel kici mipa ka kungah mallang tahin ang leng hi.","ref":"Luk 1:19, 26"},"22":{"text":"Ama ang pei a, keima kungah, “Daniel, tu-in pilna le theitelna pie dinga ang pei ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Thumna na nei pat tahin thu khat ang pusuoh a, tua thu gen dinga ang pei ka hi hi, azieh pen nahpitahin nang ang ki-it hi. Tuaci’n khum thu ngaisun inlen mangmuna theitel in:"},"24":{"text":"“Na mite le khuopi siengtho in khielna a tawpsan nading, mawna suhmang nading, le khielna zieha mawsut nading, kumtawn dihna a tun nading, kamsanna le mangmuna khahcip nading, le siengtho pen mun sathau nu nadingin nipikal sawmsagi sung kise zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin thei inlen telcien in: Jerusalem a kilamkia nading thu a kipieh huna kipanin sathau kinu pa hun dong nipikal sagi sung hi ding hi; tuale nipikal sawmguh le ni sungin gawlzin lampite le tuikulte kibawlkia ding a, ahi vangin lungkham hun sung hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Nipikal sawmguh le ni a tawp zaw ciengin sathau kinu mipa khat kisumaimang ding a, bangma a nei sih ding hi. Tuale ang pei ding ulienpa’ galkapte in tua khuopi le mun siengtho a susie ding uhi. Ama’ manthaina pen tuizin tun bang hi ding a, a tawp dongin gal kidona om ding hi. Suhsiet dinga thukip kibawlsa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in mi tampite tawh nipikal khat sung thuciem khau khat bawl ding a, ama in tua nipikal alang sungin biehpiehna le biehnate khawlsah ding hi; tuale a susie pa tungah a tawpna thukip a kibuohsuh dongin tuate munah a susie kidahhuoi na khat kikoi ding hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Dan 11:31; 12:11; Mat 24:15; Mrk 13:14"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia kumpipa Cyrus kumpi a suo zaw a kum thumna kumin Belshazzar kici Daniel kungah thu khat kihil hi. Tua thu thuman hi a, kidona lienpi khat tawh kisai ahi hi. Ama in tua thu thei a, mangmuna sunga a mu zong theitel hi.","title":"Minamte Kidona le Vantung Vanglietnate"},"2":{"text":"Khum hunin keima Daniel, nipikal thum sung ka kap hi."},"3":{"text":"Nipikal thum vilvel an le tui bangma ne loin ka kam in zu le sa a ciem sih a, sathau zong ka kinu sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Hla masa ni sawmni le li ni-in gun golpi gei-ah (tua pen Tigris gun ahi hi) ka din laitahin,"},"5":{"text":"ka dahto leh saihadiel puon silin, a kawng kimvela Uphaz gam pieng kham kawnggah a gah mi khat ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"A tahsa pen beryl suongmanpha bangin vam lihleh a, a maitang tunphe bangin tangin, a mittangte meikuong tawh kibang a, a bante le a kengte sumngo nawtngilsa bangin tee lihlehin, a awging pen mihonpi aa-ul husa tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Kln 1:13-15; 2:18; 19:12"},"7":{"text":"Keima Daniel beh in tua mangmuna ka mu hi; keima tawh a omtonte nahpi tahin a zau vangun tua mangmuna a mu sih vua, tuale amate taimangin a kiphuol uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n a thupi tami mangmuna mu dingin keima tangin ei kinuasie hi. Ka tha ka zung teng tawpin ka ci ka sa kangdang a, tha le zung kici ka nei ta sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a awging ka za hi; tuale khuophawh nawn loin tuolah ka puasuh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin khut khat in ei thamin ka khut le ka khupin ei phongto hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Daniel, nang ang ki-it mama hi, nang kunga kang gen ding thute thudon in. Nang kungah kei ei kisawlzo ahi ziehin dingtang in,” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in kei kungah tam thu ang gen laitahin a citun pumin ka dingto hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Daniel aw, zau sin, azieh pen theitel nopna lungsim le nang le nang Pasien mai-ah kiniemkhieh nopna lungsim nei na sawm masah pen ni-a kipanin na thugente a kiza zo ta a, tua na thugente zieha ang pei ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Persia kumpi gam uhpa in ni sawmni le ni khat sung keima ei nang hi. Tuaci’n keima ei panpi dingin gam uhpite lahah khat ahi Michael ang kuonin ei panpi a, Persia kumpi gam uhpa tawh tua munah ama ka nuasie hi."},"14":{"text":"Hun nukhia ni ciengin na mite tungah bang thu ang pieng ding ahei ci na theitel nadingin ang panpi dinga ang pei ka hi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile tami pen ang tung lai nite adinga mangmuna ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in tam thu teng a gen laitahin ka mai tuolkunin ka ham thei sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin mihing melpuo khat in ka nephu ei thampieh a, thu gen dingin ka kam kahin ka mai-a ding pa kungah, “Ka pu aw, ka mangmu ziehin ka tungah tam bang natnate ang tungzo ahi ziehin tha zong ka nei ta sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka pu nasempa in ka pu tawh bang i ci kiho thei diei? Azieh pen citun dildelin tha ka nei ta sih a, naahu zong ka nei ta sih hi,” ka ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing melpuo khat in keima ei thamkia leuleu a, ei thakhausah hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Ang ki-it mama pa aw, zau sin, nang adingin lungmuon a om hi. Na tha khausah inlen hangsan in!” ei ci hi. Ama in kei ei hopi ciengin ka tha ang hat pai a, “Ka pu aw thu gen in, azieh pen nang in kei nei thakhausah ta hi,” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Nang kungah bang dinga hing pei ka hei ci na thei ei mah? Tu-in Persia gam uhpa sim dingin ka kilekia lo phamaw a, ama ka zaw ciengin Greek uhpa ang pei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin thuman laibu sungah bang kigiel ci kang gen ding hi. Na gam uhpa uh Michael ci simlo tam gam uhte ei dopi thei ding ka kungah koima om lo hi.","ref":"Kln 12:7"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei ka hile Mede mi Darius a kum khatna kumin ama panpi dingin ka ding a, ama ka thakhausah hi."},"2":{"text":"“Tu-in nangma kungah thuman kang tangko ding hi. Persia gamah kumpi thum khang lai ding hi. A lina pen tuate zosie sangin hauzaw ding a, a hauna huvangin a thahat ciengin ama in Greek kumpi gam langpang dingin mi zosie a holtuo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin galhang kumpi khat khang ding a, ama in thuneina aana tawh uhin a nop bangbangin gamta ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama a vangliet laitahin a kumpi gam kehin leimong li lam manaw-in kikhenkhe ding a, ahi vangin ama’ suonlehlahte in vai a hawm nawn sih ding a, aana tawh a vaihawm lai a bang nawn sih ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile a kumpi gam kiphungkal ding a, tam mite simlo midangte kipie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tua ciengin leitaw lam kumpipa thahat ding a, ahi vangin a uliente lahah khat pen ama sangin thahatzaw-in ama’ gam sanga a golzaw gam khat a uh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kum phabep khat zaw ciengin amate in kipawltonna a bawl ding vua, leilu lam kumpipa kungah thukimna bawl dingin leitaw lam kumpipa’ tanu a pei ding hi. Ahi vangin tua nu in a aana a tusuoh zo sih ding a, a suonlehlahte zong a kip sih ding hi. A cingte, a tapa le a panpite tawh tua nu kithat ding hi. “Khum hun sung tengin"},"7":{"text":"tua pa munah tua nu’ gui panin a ba khat a khang ding hi. Galkapte sim dingin ama kuon ding a, leilu lam kumpipa’ kulpi-ah lutin amate simin a zo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a pasien-te uh nangawn, a milimte uh, ngun le kham tawh a kibawl a vanzah manpha teng utawh, Egypt gamah puomang ding a, ama in bakhat sung leilu lam kumpipa a do ding a ki-ip ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin leilu lam kumpipa in leitaw lam kumpipa’ gam sim ding a, ahi vangin ama’ gamah a kilekia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“A tate in gal a bawl ding vua, galkap tampitah kaikhawmin tuikhang bangin kuonin a kansan ding vua, a kulpi dongah gal kidona a om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Leitaw lam kumpipa a lungthahsa-in kuonin leilu lam kumpipa a sim ding hi. Leilu lam kumpipa in galkap tampi a khop vangin leitaw lam kumpipa’ galkapte in a zo ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Galkap honpite a kipeipi ciengin a lungsim kiliensahin tulsawm tulza simin thatgam ding a, ahi vangin a zo tuom sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile leilu lam kumpipa in a masa sanga a tamzaw galkap honpi khonkia-in kum phabep khat zaw ciengin neh le tah kicingin galkap tampi tawh a kuonsuh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Khum hun ciengin mi tampi in leitaw lam kumpipa a sim ding uhi. Na mite lahah a mottat mite in tua mangmuna a tangtun nadingin a sim ding vua, ahi vangin amate in gal a lel ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin leilu lam kumpipa kuonin khuopi imtawmna lei sungvum ding a, kul tawh ki-im khuopi a la ding hi. Leitaw lam galkapte in a nang zo sih ding vua, a teeltuom a galkapte nangawn in zong a nang zo sih ding uhi, azieh pen amate in nan zawh nading tha a nei sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama sim dinga a kuon pa in a dei bangin bawl ding a, koima in ama nang zo lo ding hi. Ama in gam nuom-ah panmun la ding a, tua gam teng zosie ama’ thuneina sungah om ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"A kumpi gambup’ tha tawh ama kuon ding a, kilem nading thute puo-in tuate sep sawm ding hi. Tua kumpi gam a suhsiet thei nadingin numei khat tawh ama kinungsah ding hi; ahi vangin a gelna muolsuo zo loin a phattuompi sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin ama tuipi pang gam tengah kihei-in gam tampitah a zo ding hi. Ahi vangin galkapmang khat in a mi thusimlona teng maimangsah ding hi; a tahtahin mi thusim lona teng ama tungah a tusahkia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama a gam sunga kulpite lam manaw-in kilekia ding a, ahi vangin ama kipalpua-in a kimu zo nawn sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ciengin ama’ munah mi khat khangin tua pa in a kumpi gam thupi nadingin ulien khat a sawl ding hi; ahi vangin ni tomkal sungin lungthahna le gal kidona zieh hi loin ama kisugam ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ munah kumpi thupina a kipie lo, a simmawhuoi mipa khat khang ding hi; genkhol loin ama kuonin zuouthu tawh kumpi gam a tang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama mai-ah galkapte kisumaimang ding a, thuciemna bawl ulienpa zong kisugam ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale ama tawh kipawltonna a bawl zaw ciengin ama zuoutatin mi themno khat tawh a thahat ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Genkhol loin gam sunga leihoi pen munah pei-in a pu a pate in a na bawl ngai nai lo silte bawl ding a, galvanlahte, van kitomgamte, le haunate vautahin amate a hawmpieh ding hi. Ama in mun muonhuoite sim sawm ding a, ahi vangin bakhat sung beh hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in leitaw lam kumpipa sim dingin galkap tampi tawh a hatna le a khensatna satsuo ding a, leitaw lam kumpipa in a tamzaw le a hatzaw galkap tawh na do ding hi. Hinanle ama in a zo sih ding hi, azieh pen kumpi’ an a ne mite in"},"26":{"text":"ama do ding a sawmdap ding uhi. Amate in ama sugamin ama’ galkapte zong kisumaimang ding a, mi tampitah a si ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpi tegel in a lungsim vuah gitlo ding beh a sawm vua, sabuoi khatah to tonin zuouthu a gen tuoh ding uhi. Ahi vangin a lawcing sih ding hi, azieh pen a kisesa tawpna ding hun tung lai ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama’ gamah nei le lam tampi tawh kilekia ding a, ahi vangin ama in a lungsimin a siengtho thuciemna langpan ding hi. A nop a thei-in ama gamta-in a gamah kilekia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“A kisesa hun a cin ciengin ama kilekia-in leitaw lamah kuonsuh ding a, hizongle tam hun pen a masalaite tawh kibang lo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen ama sim dingin Kittim tembawte pei ding a, tuale ama lungkie-in a kilekia ding hi. Ama kithangpaisah ding a, tuaci’n thuciemna siengtho a lang bawl ding hi. Ama kilekia-in tua thuciemna siengtho a taisante a thupi bawl ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama’ sawl galkapte in biehinnpi le kulpi la-in a buasah ding uhi. Amate in nisim meihal biehna a khawlsah ding vua, a susie ding sil kidahuoi a koi ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 9:27; 12:11; Mat 24:15; Mrk 13:14"},"32":{"text":"Ama in zuouthu tawh thuciemna palsatte a zawl ding hi; hinanle a pasien uh tunga thuman mite in dingkipin a do ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Mite lahah mipilte in mi tampi tungah theitelna a neisah ding uhi; ahi vangin ni tomkal sungin meikuong le namsau tawh amate a si ding vua, sal dingin kipeipi-in kitomgam ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in tua banga a thuoh uh ciengin panpina themkhat beh a nga sam ding vua, mi tampite in lungsim tahtah hi lopi-in amate a pawl ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tawpna hun a tun masangin amate kisusiengin kisiensuo a, a kisawpsieng thei nadingin mipil kim khat kithat ding hi, azieh pen a kisesa hun a tun masangin a kikalah hun khat a omlai hi."},"36":{"text":"“Tua kumpipa a nop bangbangin a gamta ding hi. Ama le ama kitawisangin ama le ama pasien khat popo sangin a lienzaw-in kingaisun ding a, tuaci’n pasien-te’ Pasien langkhatah cizat huoi kam a ham ding hi. Lungthahna hun a bukim masangsie ama a cithei ding hi, azieh pen a kisesa bangin kisem ding hi.","ref":"2Thes 2:3-4; Kln 13:5-6"},"37":{"text":"Ama in a pu a pate’ pasien-te ahi sihle numeite’ deite zatah lo ding hi; ama in pasien dang khat popo zong a zatah sih ding hi, azieh pen tuate zosie sangin ama le ama a lienzaw-in a kingaisun hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in tam teng tangin kulpi cing pasien-te zatahzaw ding a, ngun le kham, suong manphate le letsong mantamte tawh a pu a pate’ na theikhah lo pasien a patawi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Ama in gamdang pasien khat’ panpina tawh kulpidet pente a sim ding hi. Ama in ama a pom mite hausah semsemin mi tampite tungah vaihawmin koi ding a, a man tawh kizui-in leitangte a hawmpieh ding hi."},"40":{"text":"“Hun tawp ni ciengin leitaw lam kumpipa in ama a sim ding hi. Ahi vangin leilu lam kumpipa in sakol leengte, sakol galkapte, le tembaw tampi tawh pumpei bangin a simgawp ding hi. Gamcin teng do dingin ama kuon ding a, tuikhang bangin a nawtsuoh ding hi.","title":"A Tawpna Hun"},"41":{"text":"Gamnuom sungah ama lutin mi tul tampi tahin sina thuoh ding a, ahi vangin ama’ khut sung panin Edom, Moab, le Ammon gam thupi mun teng suohta ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Ama in a khut zahin tua gamte sim ding a, Egypt gam a suohta sih ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Kham le ngun ahi goute le Egypt hauna zosie tungah ama vaihawmin pang ding hi; tuale Libya le Ethiopia mite in ama nua a zui ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Ahi vangin nisuona lam le leilu lam pana thu kipuohte in ama patausah ding a, mi tampitah a susie ding le a sumaimang dingin thangpaina tawh ama a kuon ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in a etlawm muol siengtho le tuipi kikalah a kumpi puonbuhte a sung ding hi. Hinanle koima’ panpi loin ama si ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Khum hunin na mite a cing ulienpipa Michael ang khang ding hi. Minamte piencil a kipanin a pieng ngai nai lo lungkhamna hun ang tung ding hi. Hizongnanle khum hun ciengin laibu sunga a kigiel a min kimukhie zosie kihunkhie ding hi.","title":"Misite Thawkiana","ref":"Mat 24:21; Mrk 13:19; Kln 7:14; 12:7"},"2":{"text":"Leitung leivui lahah a kimu mi tampite tho ding a, pawl khatte kumtawn hinna, pawl khatte maizumna le kumtawn simmawna nga dingin a tho ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 26:19; Mat 25:46; Jhn 5:29"},"3":{"text":"A pilte ahi uleh vantung khuovah bangin a tang ding vua, dihna lamah mi tampi a puite pen aasi bangin a tang tawntung ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle Daniel aw, tawpna hun a tun masangin tam thute genzah sinlen laibu khahcip phot in. Mi tampi a suhtai a totai ding vua, sietna a khang ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima Daniel in ka en leh, adang mi ni ang kilang a, khat pen tami lui pang lamah, a khat pen khumi lui pang lamah a ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate lahah saihadiel puon a sil luinah lama a ding mipa in, “Tam sil lamdangte a tawp nading bang tanvei sawt ding ahei?” ci-in dong hi."},"7":{"text":"Luinah lama a ding saihadiel puon a sil tua mipa in a khut zietlam le veilam vantung lamah a lamto hi. Tuale khum hun pen hun khat, hun ni, le hun lang hi ding a, mi siengthote’ vanglietna a kisiet hun ciengin tam sil zosie kimuolsuo ding hi,” ci-in a hing zing pa’ minin a kiciem ka za hi.","ref":"Kln 10:5; 12:14"},"8":{"text":"Ka zah vangin ka telcien sih hi; tuaci’n keima in, “Ka pu aw, tam teng pi bang hingci pien ding ahei?” ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Daniel aw, pei ta’n, azieh pen tawpna hun a tun masangin tua thute selcip imcip ahi ding hi"},"10":{"text":"Mi tampi kisiensuo kinawt zolin kinawt ngo ding hi, hinanle migilote ahile a gitlo gamtat uh a zomsuoh ding uhi. Migilote khat beh in a theisiem sih ding vua, ahi vangin mipilte in a theisiem ding uhi.","ref":"Kln 22:11"},"11":{"text":"Nisima kibawl meihal biehna kikhawlsahin a susie sil kidahhuoi a kikoi huna kipanin ni tulkhat zani le sawmkuo sung sawt ding hi.","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; Mat 24:15; Mrk 13:14"},"12":{"text":"Ni tulkhat zathum sawmthum le nga sung a thuoh zo kenkonte in thupha a nga ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang na hi leh na lampi ah pei inlen tawlnga in; hun tawp ni ciengin na thaman sang dingin na tho ding hi,” ei ci hi."}}}}},"28":{"info":{"name":"Hosea","shortname":"Hos","abbr":[],"desc":"Hosea laibu (the book of hosea)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpite Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, le Israel kumpi Joash’ tapa Kumpi Jeroboam hun lai-in Beeri’ tapa Hosea tungah Topa’ thu a tung hi.","ref":"2Kum 14:23–15:7; 15:32–16:20; 18:1–20:21; 2Khg 26:1–27:8; 28:1–32:33"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Hosea tungtawnin thu a gen masah lai-in, Topa in Hosea kungah, “Pei-in numei pahtat khat na zi-in la inlen, tua nu tawh ta nei in, azieh pen gamsung mite in Topa taisanin pahtatna lienpi bawl uhi,” a ci hi.","title":"Hosea’ Innkuon"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama pei-in Diblaim’ tanu Gomer a zi-in la a, tua nu gai-in ama tawh tapa khat nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “A min Jezreel phuoh in; azieh pen a sawt loin Jezreel’ sisan ziehin keima in Jehu’ innkuonte dan ka pie ding a, Israel innkuonte’ uhna gam ka tawpsah ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 10:11"},"5":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Jezreel kuomah Israel’ thaltang ka hliehtawng ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua nu gaikia a, tanu khat nei hi. Tua ciengin Topa in ama kungah, “A min Lo-ruhamah phuoh in, azieh pen Israel innkuonte ka khuotuo nawn sih ding a, a mawna uh ka maisah nawn sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Judah innkuonte ka khuotuo ding a, thal le namsau, gal simna, sakol le sakol tungtuongte vang tawh hi loin a Topa Pasien uh’ vang tawh amate ka hundam ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Lo-ruhamah in nawi a tansah zaw ciengin tua nu gai-in tapa khat nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Ama’ min Lo-ammi phuoh in, azieh pen note keima’ mite na hi nawn sih vua, kei zong note adingin KEIMA ka hi nawn sih hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle Israel mite pen tezawh lo, simzawh lo za dongin tuipi senel bangin a tam ding vua, “Ka mite hi lo,” ka cisa amate, “A hingzing Pasien’ tate,” kici ta ding hi.","title":"Israel Angaingai Bangkia","ref":"Rom 9:26"},"11":{"text":"Judah mite le Israel mite a kigawmkia ding vua, a makai ding uh khat a se ding uhi; tuale amate in gamh a luo ding vua, tua Jezreel hun pen hun thupi mama hi ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na sanggampa ‘ka mite’ ci inlen, na sanggamnu’ a kikhuotuo’ ci in."},"2":{"text":"Na nu uh kuppi-in thuhil un. azieh pen ama ka zi hi nawn loin a pasal zong ka hi nawn sih hi. A pahtat melsuo khel hinlen, a angkawm nopna lungsim paikhie heh.","title":"Israel’ Pahtatna, Dan piehna, le a Kitatkhietna"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi sihle a puonte hawhin a guohtangin ka omsah ding a, a suo ni-a bangin mi musietin ka koi ding hi. Senel gam gawta bangin ka bawl ding a, a dangta-in ka sisah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A tate tungah zong khuotuona ka nei sih ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate numei pahtat’ tate ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"A nu uh a pahtat ziehin amate a pai ama pen zumhuoi tahin a gamta ahi hi. Azieh pen ama in, “Ka lawm ngaite kungah ka pei ding hi. Amate in kei adingin an le tui, samul puon le saihadiel puon, olive thau, le ka dawn ding ei pie uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama lampi-ah lingthaw ka get ding hi; ama in a lampi a mu thei lo nadingin kul ka cienlu ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a lawm ngaite nuadel ding a, hinanle amate a pha sih ding hi. Ama in amate sui ding a, hinanle mu lo ding hi. Tua ciengin ama in, “Ka pei ding a, ka pasal masa pen kungah ka kinuale kia ding hi. Azieh pen tu sangin ama tawh ka opton lai nuom zaw tham lai hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in an, zu, le sathau a pie pa kei ka hi lam le, Baal biehna dinga a nop a thei-a a zah ngun le kham a pie pa keima ka hi lam a thei sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin anlah huna ka ante le lenggazu lah huna ka lenggazute ka nualah kia ding hi. A guohtang hina a sena samul puon le saihadiel puonte ka lakia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in a lawm ngaite muna-ah a puonte ka lempieh ding a, ka khut sung panin koima in ama a hunkhie sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in ama’ guolnopna zosie, a pawite, a hla thate, a sabbath nite le a kisesa a pawi bawlte uh ka khawlsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tamte khu ka lawm ngaite ei thapna ahi hi,” ci-a a gen a lenggui lote le a theikungte ka susie ding hi. Tuate gamlah suohsahin gamsate in tuate netum ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Baal-te pawi bawl ni ciengin amate kungah gimnamtui a hal zieh le, khutsip le suongmanphate tawh a kizep ciengin keima ei mangngilin a lawm ngaite a nuadel ziehin, ama dan ka pie ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in ama zawlin senel gamah ka zawpi ding a, damtahin ama ka hopi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in khum mun panin a lengga lote ka pie ding a, Achor Kuompi pen lametna kotpi ka suohsah ding hi.","ref":"Josh 7:24-26"},"16":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin, “Ka pasal,” ci-in nei hlan ding a, “Ka Baal,” ci-in nei hlan nawn sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen a kam panin Baal pasien-te’ min ka ladawh ding a, amate a min kilo kha nawn lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in note adingin gamsate, vana a leng vate, le leitunga a bawhva ganhingte tawh thuciemna khat ka bawl ding hi; tuale keima in leitung panin thal, namsau, gal kidonate ka phietmang ding a, lungmuong tahin note kang omsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in kumtawn zi dingin nang kang la ding a, thudih le thutang, itna kip le hepina tawh ka zi dingin kang la ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima in citahna tawh ka zi dingin kang la ding hi; tuale nang in Topa na thei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin kang dawng ding hi, Topa in ci a, keima in vante’ thugen ka dawng ding a, amate in leitung’ thugente a dawng ding uhi;"},"22":{"text":"tuale leitung in an, lenggazu, le sathau-te’ thugente dawng ding a, amate in Jezreel’ thugente a dawng ding uhi;"},"23":{"text":"tuale keima adingin gam sungah khaici bangin ama ka tu ding hi. Keima in a kikhuotuo lote ka khuotuo ding a, ka mi ahi lote kungah, “Ka mite na hi uhi,” ka ci ding hi. Ama in, “Nang ka Pasien na hi hi,” ei ci ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 9:25; 1Pet 2:10"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in keima kungah thu ang genkia a, “Peikia inlen lawm ngaisa le angkawmsa numei khat va ngai in. Israel mite, pasien dangte lamah kihei-in amate in milim biehna-in lengga gaw mohte tawi nan ule Topa in amate a it veve ma bangin tua numei va it in,” ei ci hi.","title":"Pasien’ Tatkhiet Itna tawh Kihlamuongsahkia"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in ngun shekel sawm le nga le mangbuham homer khat le alang tawh tua nu ka lei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale keima in tua nu kungah, “ Ka zi bangin ni tampitah omin na pahtat nawn sih ding a, midangte tawh lumton loin kei tawh zong i lumton sih ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen hun sawtveipi sung kumpi le ulien, biehpiehna, biehna song, siempu puon le teraphim nei loin Israel-te a om ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Israel-te kihei-in Topa a Pasien ule a kumpipa uh David a sui ding uhi; hun nukhia ciengin amate in zatahna lienpi tawh Topa le ama’ hoina a zuon ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite aw, Topa’ thugen ngai un; azieh pen Topa in gam sunga a tengte mawmatna khat nei hi. Gam sungah citahna, dihna le Pasien theina om lo hi.","title":"Pasien in Israel Mawsah"},"2":{"text":"Kiciemna, kisolna, tuolthana, guhtatna le angkawmnate om a, sisan luonnate khat zaw khat a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin leitang tau-in a sunga teng zosie a mau uhi; vana a leng vate, gamsate le tuipi ngasate nangawn tawh a maimangtha ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle koima kisel da hinlen, koima kimawsah sih heh. Azieh pen siempu pa aw, ka kiselpi pa nangma na hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Sun lai-in na kipal ding a, zan lai-in nang tawh kamsangpa a puaton ding hi. Tuale keima in na nu ka sumaimang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Theina a kitasap ziehin ka mite a kisie uhi; nang in theina na nual ziehin ka siempu dingin nang kang nuol hi. Note in na Pasien uh’ thukham na mangngil ziehun, keima in zong na tate uh ka mangngil ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate tam semsem leh, kei tunga a mawna uh a tam semsem hi; amate in a minthanna uh maizumna tawh a khel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in ka mite’ mawna kivana’n a nei uhi; ka mite a khiel semsem ding a dei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mite tunga a tun bangin siempute tungah zong tung ding hi; amau’ tot lampi bangin amate dan pie-in, amau’ gamtat bangin ka thuhkia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in nene napi a taizo sih ding uhi; patatna tawh kidim napi a pung sih ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in pahtatna nuadelin Topa a taisan uhi."},"11":{"text":"Lenggazu lui le lenggazu a tha in theitelna a lahmang pieh hi.","title":"Israel’ Milim Biehna"},"12":{"text":"Ka mite in sing milim po thu a kuppi vua, a ciengkhut un amate tungah thuphuon a gen hi. Bangzieh ahei cile pahtat nopna lungsim in amate lam khielsah a, Pasien taisanin numei pahtat bangin amate a gamta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in muolsang dawn tengah kithoina nei-in, muol tunga gangpi kung, popler kung le terebinth kungte nei-ah biehnate a pie uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tua sing hlimte nuom mama hi. Tua ahi ziehin na tanute in pahtatna a bawl vua, na monute un zong ang a kawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na tanute a pahtat cieng ule, na monute in ang a kawm ciengun, dan ka pie sih ding hi; azieh pen pasalte mama a pahtatte tawh kithuo-in, biehinnpi-a numei pahtatte tawh biehpiehna a bawlton uhi. Tam bangin theitelna nei lo mite a kisie ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Israel aw, na pahtat vangin Judah in khielna bawlsah sin. Gilgal ah lut sin len, Beth-aven ah peito sin. “ Topa a nungta ahi ma bangin,” ci-in zong kiciem sin."},"16":{"text":"Bawnglaa lungkhau bangin Israel zong a lungkhau hi; Topa in lonona gam lienpi ah a tuunote a vah bangin ama in amate a vah zo ding amah?"},"17":{"text":"Milimte tawh Ephraim kizom hi, ama guohin om taheh."},"18":{"text":"A zu dawn zaw ciengun nu le pa mawna bawlin amate a thangtat vua, a vangphatna ding uh sangin zumhuoina lam a deizaw uhi."},"19":{"text":"Huipi in amate a hlakui-in zielmang a, amau’ maitamte ziehin a maizum ding uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siempute aw, tam thu za un! Israel innkuonte aw, tami thu ngai un! Kumpi innkuonte aw, ngai un! Azieh pen note tawh kisai-in thu kikhen ahi hi. Mizpah ah note in thang sie-in, Tabor ah ngen na hlung vua,","title":"Israel le Judah Tungah a Tung ding Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Shittim ah dum thuh na to uhi; ahi vangin tuate zosie dan ka pie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in Ephraim ka thei a, keima kung panin Israel kiphuol lo hi; azieh pen Ephraim aw, tu-in ahile nang na pahtat zo hi; Israel zong a thanghuoi hi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ gamtatna in a Pasien kung uh a kilesah thei sih hi. Azieh pen a lungsim sung vuah pahtat nopna lungsim om a, Topa a thei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Israel’ kilietsahna in ama langkhatah teci pang hi; ama’ mawna sungah Ephraim kipalpua ding hi; Judah zong amate tawh a kipalpua ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A tuuhon ule a bawnghonte tawh Topa sui-in amate a pei ding vua, ahi vangin amate in ama a mu sih ding uhi; amate kung panin ama a nuakia zo ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in Topa tungah muonna nei loin a gamta uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in zawlta tampi a nei uhi. Tu-in hla tha in a lote utawh amate a valtum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gibeah ah sakii tum unlen, Ramah ah pengkul mut un. Beth-aven ah pataukona gingsah un. Benjamin aw, na nua en in!"},"9":{"text":"Dan piehna ni ang tun ciengin Ephraim hawmsuoh ding a, Israel minamte lahah a tung tahtah ding thu ka gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Judah uliente, gamgi suong a khin mite tawh kibang uhi; amate tungah ka thangpaina tui bangin ka sungsuh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim kibawlsie a, thukhenna ah guol lel hi. Azieh pen ama in a kimang lo nate’ nua zui ding a hanciem mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ziehin Ephraim adingin a pet thei lung tawh ka kibang a, Judah innkuonte adingin a muotsah thei na tawh ka kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"Ephraim in a natna mu-in Judah in a hima a mu ciengin, Assyria gamah Ephraim pei-in kumpi lienpa kungah mi a sawl hi. Ahi vangin ama in na natna damsah thei lo a, na hima zong damsah thei lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Ephraim tungah humpi ka bang ding a, Judah innkuonte tungah humpi khangdawng ka bang ding hi. Kei mama in ka ehmal ding a, ka peisan ding hi. Keima in ka kaiphit ding a, koima in hunkhie zo lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in a mawna uh pulahin ka mai ei sui masangun, ka opna munah ka kilekia ding hi. Amate a lungkham ciengun ka maipha ang sui ding uhi:"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hing pei un, Topa kungah kilekia vai; azieh pen ama ei ehmal pa hi a, ama in eite ei damsahkia ding hi; ama in ei tehpuong a, i liemmate ei tunpieh kia ding hi.","title":"A Kisiakia Dinga Hlatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ni ni zaw ciengin ei thakhausah ding hi; ni thum ni ciengin eite ei thosah ding a, tua ciengin ama mai-ah eite i nungta thei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Eite in thei vai, Topa i thei zawh nading hanciem vai; ama ang pei ding pen zing nisuo valon bang ahi hi; leitunga a zu khuopi guo bang le guomalte bangin eite tungah ang zu ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ephraim aw, bang hing law ding ka hei? Judah aw, bang hing law ding ka hei? Nei itna pen zing meiilum kai bang a, tomkal khat sunga a kang pai daitui tawh kibang hi.","title":"Israel le Judah Kisiakia Nuom Lo"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in kamsangte zangin amate ka tenbuong a, ka kam pana a pusuoh kammalte tawh keima in amate ka that hi. Khuovah bangin ka thukhenna a kikhaw suoh hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen itna kip ka dei a, biehpiehna ka dei sih hi. Meihal biehpiehnate sangin Pasien theina ka deizaw hi.","ref":"Mat 9:13; 12:7"},"7":{"text":"Hizongle amate in Adam bangin thuciemna a palsat vua, khum muna keima tungah tahtai lo tahin gamta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead pen migilote’ khuopi hi a, sisan ketot tawh kidim hi."},"9":{"text":"Gutate in mi suom ding a buhdap uh bangin, siempute a honhonin kikhawm uh a amate in Shechem lampi ah tuol a that vua, amate in a mudahuoi mawna a bawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in Israel inn sungah a cimulthaw huoina khat ka mu hi; khum munah Ephraim-te a pahtat vua, Israel-te a thanghuoi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Judah aw, nang ading zong anlah hun khat kise zo hi. Ka mite hamphatna ka piehkia a,"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te ka damsah ciengin, Ephraim-te’ sietna le Samaria-te’ gitlo gamtatna teng ang kilang hi; azieh pen amate in zuou le nal tawh na a sem vua, gutate in inn lu-in misuomte in a pulamah mi’ na a lahpieh uhi."},"2":{"text":"Hinanle amate in a gitlona zosie uh ka ciemte lam a ngaisun kha ngai sih uhi. Tu-in amau’ nasepnate in amate kimkot a, ka mai-ah tuate a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Amau’ gitlona in kumpipa lungdamsah a, amau’ misolna in miliente lungdamsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un angkawmte ahi vua, a annel pawi a pawm cieng dong moh-empa’ mei sem ding kul a sa lo lungthu sa tawh a kibang uhi."},"5":{"text":"I kumpipa pawi bawl ni-in uliente in zu a khammat vua, mi simmawte tawh kumpipa kikhut tuh hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate mei bangin kikuontaw a, amau’ sungah a lungtang uh mei bangin kuong vapom hi; zan tungtawnin amau’ lungthahna mei bangin khu valuoi a, zingmawng ciengin mei bangin a kuong hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un lungthu bangin a sa vua, amate in a uliente uh a thatlia uhi; a kumpite uh a puamat vua, koima khat beh in ei ko lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim, minamte tawh kicisaw lo hi; Ephraim, a kikhuleh lo moh tawh kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamdangte in ama’ hatna valtum a, hinanle ama in tua thu theikha lo hi; a lu tungah samkang vaupa bang a, hinanle ama in thei kha lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel’ kilietsahna in ama langkhatah teci a pang hi. Hinanle Topa a Pasien uh kungah amate a kilekia tuom sih vua, tam teng zosie ziehin zong ama a sui tuom sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim pen a lungmawl vakhu banga ngaisutna nei lo ahi hi; amate in Egypt mite a hlan vua, Assyria gamah a pei uhi.","title":"Amawhna-a Minamte Muonna"},"12":{"text":"Amate a pei ciengin amate tungah ka len ka khu ding hi; vana a leng vate bangin amate ka kaikhie suh ding hi; amau’ kikhopna -a thu ka zah dung zui-in amate thu ka hil ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei kung panin a kihei ziehun gimna a thuoh ding uhi! Kei ei ledo ziehun sietna tuoh ta uheh! Amate ka hunkhie nuom mama a, hinanle amate in kei langkhatah zuouthu a gen uhi."},"14":{"text":"A lupna tung vuah a tau vangun, kei kungah lungsim tahtah tawh ang kiko sih uhi; neh le dawn nga thei nadingin amau le amau kikuikehin ei ledo uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amate a cil a, a bantha uh a khausah pa khu keima ka hi a, hinanle keima langkhatah gitlo a sawm veve uhi."},"16":{"text":"Phattuomna a pie thei lo nate lamah amate a kihei uhi; amate pen a muitang lo thaltang tawh a bang uhi. Amate a kiphatsah ham ziehun a uliente namsau-in a si ding vua, Egypt gam sungah amate mi nuisatin a om ding uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na pengkul na nephu tawh tuo in! Langta tawh a kibang khat Topa’ inn tungah a om hi, azieh pen amate in ka thuciemna a susie zo ta vua, ka thukham a palsat zo ta uhi.","title":"Israel’ Peikhielna"},"2":{"text":"Ka kungah Israel-te ang kiko vua, “Ka Pasien aw, - koma Israel- in nang kang thei uhi!” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Israel in na hoite pai zo hi; galte in ama a del ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in kei tungtawn loin kumpite koi uhi; amate in kei thei loin uliente zong a koi uhi. Amau’ siet nadingin a ngun le a kham utawh milimte a bawl uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria aw, na bawngno kinuol hi. Amate tungah ka sin a so hi. Amate bang tanvei maw nei loin om thei ding uh ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen tua bawngno khu Israel sung panin khut siem khat’ bawl hi a, Pasien ahi sih hi. Samaria bawngno pen a phalphalin keh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen hui khaici a vaw ziehun amate in pumpei a at ding uhi. Bukungte in vui nei lo a, buvuite in neh ding piengsah lo ding hi; piengsah ma nanleh gamdang mite in netum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel a kipumval ahi ta hi; tu-in kimanna a nei lo beel bangin minamte lahah ama a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Gam-laa a tang tat bangin Assyria ah amate a peito uhi; Ephraim in a lawm ngaite tawh a thaman ding kiho uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in minamte tawh a guoi man ding kiho nan ule, keima in amate tu-in ka kaikhawm ding hi. Kumpite le uliente’ suon vangih nei-ah amate a kilawmlia ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim in maw mai nadingin maitam a tam bawl ciengin, tua maitam te ama adingin mawna maitam a suoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama adingin keima in thuhilna tampi giel nanleng, tuate pen sil lamdang khat bangin kingaisun lel hi."},"13":{"text":"Deiteel biehpiehnate lui-in sa a neh vangun, Topa in amate sang lo hi. Tu-in ama in amau’ khielna ciemte ding a, a mawnate uh dan a pie ding hi; amate Egypt ah kilekia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Israel in a Bawlpa mangngilin kumpi innte a lam bebe hi. Judah in kul a nei khuopite a lam bebe hi. Ahi vangin a khuopite tungah mei ka sawl ding a, tua mei in ama’ mun muonhuoite a katum ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel aw, lungdam sin! Minamte bangin lungdamin kipah sin; azieh pen na Pasien kung pan tai-in numei pahtat bangin na gamta hi. Ancilna phuol teng zosie ah na pahtat thaman na lunggul hi.","title":"Mawna Zieha Israel Dan a Kipiehna"},"2":{"text":"Ancilna phuol le lengga suhna in amate a va sih ding a, amate deiza-in lenggazu tha a pieng sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ gam sungah amate a om den sih ding vua, ahi vangin Egypt gamah Ephraim kilekia-in, amate in Assyria gam sungah an sieng lo a ne ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Topa tungah dawn thei lenggazu tawh biehna a sung sih ding vua, amau’ biehpiehnate in ama a lungkimsah zo sih ding hi.
