Tua bang biehpiehnate pen kuosa hangtang tawh kibang lel ding hi; tua kuosa hangtang an a nete zosie a bua ahi ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amau’ neh an pen gilkiel phatna maimai ding ahi bo a, Topa’ inn sungah tua an kitut lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A kisesa pawi ni le Topa’ pawi ni ciengin bang bawl ding na hi uh ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen sietna panin amate nangawn a suotah uleh, Egypt in amate khawmtuo ding a, Memphis in amate a vui ding hi. Lahkhai in ngun tawh kizem a vanmanphate uh khumang ding a, lingkungte in a puonbuhte uh a khumang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Dan pieh hun tung zo ta a, thuhkiana hun tung zo ta hi; Israel kiko-in, “Kamsang pa mimaw hi a, hla mipa a lungsim kicing lo hi,” a ci hi. Na mawna uh a gol seng ziehin kigal neina zong a gol hi.","ref":"Luk 21:22"},"8":{"text":"Ka Pasien adingin kamsangpa pen Ephraim tungah galvil pa hi a, hizongle a lampi teng zosie ah thangsie pa in a thang kamin, a Pasien’ inn sungah kigal neina a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Gibeah hun lai ma bangin amau le amau nahpi tahin kisie uhi. Ama in amau’ khielna phawh ding a, a mawnate uh ziehin amate dan a pie ding hi.","ref":"Thkn 19:1-30"},"10":{"text":"Senel gam sunga lenggate bangin, keima in Israel ka mu hi. Kum kihei masah pen huna theikung a ga masa pente bangin keima in na pu na pate uh ka mu hi. Ahi vangin Baal-peor ah amate tungin tua a zumhuoi nate tungah a ki-ap vua, a it a ngai uh nate ma bangin amate a kidahhuoi ta uhi.","ref":"Gam 25:1-5"},"11":{"text":"Va bangin Ephraim-te’ vang lengmang ta a, ta suoh, nupi gai, nau pai ci bangte a om nawn sih hi!"},"12":{"text":"Amate in tate hing nan ule, khat beh a hinsuo lo uh za dongin ka kap ka mausah ding hi. Amate ka taisan ciengin, gimna a thuoh tahtah ding uhi!"},"13":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in Ephraim pen a deihuoi lohing lahah a kisuon lutu kungno bangin ka mu a, ahi vangin tu-in Ephraim in tha dingin a tate a peipi kul ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa aw, amate pie in, Amate bang pie ding na hei? Amate tatolh sulbu le a suoh lo nawitui pie in."},"15":{"text":"A mawna teng zosie uh Gigal ah kipan a, amate ka mudana pen tua muntah ahi hi. Amau’ gitlo gamtatnate ziehin ka inn panin amate ka notmang ding hi. Amate ka it nawn sih ding hi. A uliente zosie mi ledote ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ephraim in gimna thuoh a, a huite gaw siengin ga a ga sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in ama thugen a ngai nuom lo ziehun, ka pa Pasien in amate a nuol ding hi. Amate pen minamte lahah mi vahvaite a suoh ding uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel pen lenggui phung pha ahi a, ama in ga tampi a ga hi. A lengga ga semsem a, ama in maitam lam semsem hi; a gam khantona tawh kizui-in biehna songte bawl bebe hi.","title":"Israel’ Mawna le Saltanna"},"2":{"text":"A lungtang uh a man sih hi; tu-in amau’ khielna paat a puo ding uhi. Topa in a maitam uh satguoi-in a biehna songte uh a susie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen tu-in amate in, “ Topa ka zatah lo ziehun kumpi zong ka nei ta sih uhi, ama in kote adingin bang ei seppieh thei ding ahei?” a ci ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in thu ginalo po a gen vua, a kampi utawh kiciemin thuciemnate a bawl uhi; Tuaci’n lolai tuma kuohte lahah a po a gunei lopate bangin kiheh kibalna dim hi."},"5":{"text":"Beth-aven khuo-a bawngno lim ziehin Samaria-a tengte zau-in a citun uhi. Tami ziehin a mite a kap ding vua, tami thu ziehin milim a bie siempute thumin tau ding uhi. Amate in tua pana a kilamang ama’ vang a kaapi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Assyria kumpi lienpa kungah sieh le kaih a pieh dingin tuami kipuo ding hi. Ephraim kimaizumsah ding a, a milim ziehin Israel maizum ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tui maitanga a lam tuiphuon bangin Samaria kumpipa a kisie ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel’ mawna ahi Aven munsangte kisusie ding a, a maitamte uh tungah ling le khaute a po ding hi. Amate in muolsangte kungah, kote ei khusuh un, a ci ding vua, muolte kungah, kote tungah hing kiesuh ta un, a ci ding uhi.","ref":"Luk 23:30; Kln 6:16"},"9":{"text":"Israel aw, Gibeah hun peh panin nang na maw zo ta bo hi; amate in khum munah mawna a bawl lai uhi. Gal in Gibeah ah amate nuaphah lo ding amah?","ref":"Thkn 19:1-30"},"10":{"text":"Thu manglo mite langkhatah dan pie dingin kang pei ding a, khielna nam ni a bawl ziehun amate dan ka pieh ciengin, amate langkhatah minamte ang kikhawm ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim pen hoitaha a kisin ancil ding a thanuom bawnglaa ahi a, keima in a zol sipsep a ngawng ah kol ka na bul sih hi; Hinanle Ephraim pen lei ka kalsah ding hi. Judah in lo a kaih lo phamaw ding a, Jacob in ama adingin lo a hlo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Noma adingin dihna khaici tu un; itna kip at unlen a kihlo nai lo lote kalkang un. Azieh pen ama ang pei-in note tungah thumana guo ang zuhsah thei nadingin Topa sui hun ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 4:3"},"13":{"text":"Note in lo kaih bangin gitlona lo na kai vua, bu at bangin thutang lo na at zo uhi; note in zuou phuona ga zong na ne zo ta uhi. Azieh pen note in thahatna na suong vua, na galhang honpite na ngam seng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin gal a kido ni-in Shalman in Beth-arbel a suhsiet bangin, a tate utawh nute tuol dena-a a kinei hun lai-a bangin, na mite langkhatah gal dona husa om ding a, na kulpi zosie uh a kisusie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bethel aw, na gitlona a gol ziehin nang tungah tua bangin ang kibawl ding hi. Khuovah ciengin Israel’ kumpipa kisumaimang ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A khangmoi lai-in Israel ka it a, Egypt panin ka tapa ka hlan hi.","title":"Israel Lungdam thei Sih Nanle Pasien’ Khuotuona","ref":"Pei 4:22; Mat 2:15"},"2":{"text":"Keima in hlan semsem leng, kei kung pan gamla pei semsem hi; amate in Baal-te kungah kithoina a nei den vua, milimte kungah gimnamtui a hal den uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle Ephraim lam pei a kisinsah pa keima ka hi a, ka khut tawh amate ka tu hi; ahi vangin ka damsah lam amate in a thei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Migitna le itna khau tawh amate ka pui hi. Keima in a khagu tunga hahkol sutpiehin awnsuhin amate an ka pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gamah amate a kilekia ding vua, Assyria-te pen amau’ kumpi hi ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ka kungah amate ang kilekia nuom sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"A khuopite sung vuah namsau kileh ding a, tua in thuphuon nga siempute vatmai-in, a gelnate ma un amate valtum ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka mite in kei kung panin kihei ding a sawm teitei uhi. A sangna munah amate a kiko vangun amate kilamto tuon lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim aw, bangci danin nang hing tan thei ding ka hei? Israel aw, bangci danin midang hing pie thei ding ka hei? Bangci bangin Admah bangin nang hing bawl thei ding ka hei? Bangci bangin Zeboiim bangin hing bawl thei ding ka hei? Ka sungah ka lungtang kilumletlet hi; ka lainatna a khang hi.","ref":"Thkna 29:23"},"9":{"text":"A zauhuoi ka lungthahna ka tungsah sih ding hi; Ephraim ka susiekia nawn sih ding hi; azieh pen keima Pasien ka hi a, note lahah a om mihing ka hi sih hi. Siengtho Pa ka hi ziehin a thangpaisa-in kang pei sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in humpi banga a hawh Topa a zui ding uhi; ama a hawh ciengin nitumna panin citun kawmin a tate ang pei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Vate bangin Egypt gam panin citun kawmin ang leng ding vua, Assyria gam panin vakhu bangin ang leng ding uhi; Keima in a inn ciet vuah ka peisahkia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ephraim in zuouthu tawh ei kuikhum a, Israel innkuon in solna tawh eite ei kuikhum hi; ahi vangin Judah tawh Pasien zawhton lai a, Siengtho Pa tungah ama muon huoi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim in ganhon bangin huipi cing a, sunthapai-in nisuona huipi nuadel hi; amate in zuouthu le tatsietna khangsah uhi; amate in Assyria tawh thukimna bawlin, tuale Egypt ah sathau kipuoh hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa in Judah tungah mawsahna ding thu nei a, a gamtatna tawh kituohin ama in Jacob dan pie a, a sepna tawh kituohin ama a thuhkia ding hi.","title":"Langpanna Tangthu Guicing (Pien 25–32)"},"3":{"text":"A nu gil sungah ama in a sanggampa’ ketul man a, a khangham ciengin Pasien tawh ama kibuon hi.","ref":"Pien 25:26"},"4":{"text":"Vantungmi tawh ama kibuonin zo a, kapin ama’ maipha a sui hi; ama in Bethel ah ama mu a, khum munah ama a hopi hi.","ref":"Pien 32:24-26; Pien 28:10-22"},"5":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien, ama’ min khu Topa ahi hi!"},"6":{"text":"Hinanle note na hi ule Pasien lamah kinuale un, itna le thutang tukip unlen, na Pasien uh muong zing un."},"7":{"text":"A khutah tawitena man lo a tawi, sumbawl ama in mi gawt nuomsa hi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim in, “Kasai, kei ka hau ta a, keima dingin neisa a kicing zo ta hi; ka hauna zosiete ziehin ka sungah maw thei nading khielna kimu lo hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei pen Egypt gam panin note’ Topa Pasien ka hi hi; keima in a kisesa na pawi nite uh ma bangin, puonbuhah note kang tengsahkia ding hi.","ref":"Siem 23:42-43"},"10":{"text":"Kamsangte kungah thu ka gen hi; mangmunate a khangsah pa kei ka hi a, kamsangte tungtawnin kisietna ka tungsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Gilead ah khielna om a, amate bangma lo a suoh valon ding uhi. Amate in Gilgal ah bawngtangte tawh biehpiehna a bawl vua, a maitamte uh lolai tuma kuohte tunga suong kicieng tawh kibang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Aram gamah Jacob tai a, Israel in a zi thalawna-in khum munah na semin, a zi thalawna-in tuu a cing hi.","ref":"Pien 29:1-20"},"13":{"text":"Topa in Egypt panin kamsang khat zangin Israel peipi a, ama in kamsang khat zangin ama a kemcing hi.","ref":"Pei 12:50-51"},"14":{"text":"Ephraim in gitlona nasietahin bawl a, tuaci’n Topa in ama tungah a mawna teng tungsah ding a, a mi simmawna teng zong ama tungah thuhkia ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim in thu a gen ciengin mite zau-in a citun uhi; Israel sungah ama a kipatawi hi; ahi vangin Baal tungtawnin khielna bawlin ama a si hi.","title":"A Kikhiem Theilo Israel tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in amate in mawna a bawl bebe vua, amate adingin a kisung milim bawlin, amau’ theitelna tawh kituohin ngun milim a bawl vua, tuate pen a unsiengin khutsiemte bawl ahi hi. Amate in, “Tamte tungah kithoi un,” a ci uhi. Mite in bawngno limte a nam uhi!"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate pen zingmawnga a kai khuovui, a kang pai daitu, ancilna pana hui in a mutmang ansi le tawlet pana a pusuoh meikhu tawh a kibang ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle Egypt gama kipanin kei pen Topa na Pasien uh ka hi hi; note in keima longal Pasien dang na thei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Senel gam gawta ah an tawh ang vah pa keima ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate ka va ciengin a gil uh a va hi; a gilva ciengun lah a kiphasah zel uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate in keima ei mangngil uhi.","ref":"Thkna 8:11-17"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate adingin humpi ka bang ding a, kamkei bangin lampi gei-ah amate ka buhdap ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A no kilahpieh vompi bangin amate ka bawh ding a, keima in amau’ lutang tuom a paante ka balkehpieh ding hi. Humpi bangin tua sungah amate ka nawmval ding a, gamsate bangin amate ka ehmal gawp ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel aw, nang kang susie ding hi; koi in nang ang panpi ta diei?"},"10":{"text":"Ama in ang hutdam thei nadingin tu-in na kumpipa hei-a om ahei? Na khuopi zosie-a makaite, nang in, “Kumpi khat le makaite ei pie in,” na cite hei-ah a om ta uh e?","ref":"1Sam 8:5-6"},"11":{"text":"Ka lungthah ziehin keima in kumpi khat kang pie a, ka thangpai ziehin keima in ama ka la dawhkia ta hi.","ref":"1Sam 10:17-24; 15:26"},"12":{"text":"Ephraim’ khielna a kitunpieh hi; ama’ mawna kikoicing hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama adingin nausuoh natna tung a, hinanle ama pen tapa mawlawm ahi hi; bangzieh ahei cile a suo hun a tun ciengin naubu gong panin ama le ama ang pusuoh sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Misikhuo khut sung pan amate tan ding ka hi amah? Sina panin amate hunkhie ding ka mah? Sina aw, na gu hei-ah om a, Misikhuo aw, na suhsietna hei-ah om ahei? Ka mit panin lainatna a kiphuolmang ta hi.","ref":"1Cor 15:55"},"15":{"text":"Pumpengte lahah ama khanpha mama nanle senel gam panin Topa’ nisuona huipi ang lang ding hi; tuale a tuinah kangin a tuikhuh a gawta ding hi. Tua in a gou koina sunga om van manpha zosie a semmang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Samaria in ama’ khielna kipuoh ding hi, azieh pen ama in a Pasien a ledo hi; namsau tawh amate si ding a, a nausente uh a kituoncilin, a numei gaite uh’ gil kikuikeh pieh ding hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel aw, Topa na Pasien kungah hing kilekia in. Azieh pen na khielna ziehin nang na kipalpua ta hi.","title":"Kisiakia nading Thumna"},"2":{"text":"Na thugen ding hing keng inlen, Topa kungah hing kilekia in; ama kungah, “Khielna zosie lamang in; a hoi thute pom in, tuale kote in ka kam uh’ a ga kang pie ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Assyria in ei hundam lo ding hi; sakolte tungah ka tuong sih ding uhi; ka khut utawh ka bawlsate uh kungah, ‘Kote’ Pasien,’ ka ci nawn sih ding uhi. Nangma sungah tagate in hepina a mu uhi,” ci un."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ thumanlona ka damsah ding hi; amate suohta tahin ka it ding hi, azieh pen amate kung panin ka lungthahna kihei zo hi.","title":"Mawmai Hlamuonna"},"5":{"text":"Israel tungah daitui ka bang ding hi; unoh paape bangin ama paa ding a, Lebanon gamlah bangin amate zung hla ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’ dawnmeng teng bazau ta ding hi; ama’ hoi dan pen olive kung bang ding a, ama’ namtui dan pen Lebanon tawh kibang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima’ hlim nei-ah amate ang tengkia ding vua, huon lei bangin amate khanpha mama ding uhi; lenggui bangin amate a paa ding vua, a gimnamtui dan pen Lebanon lenggazu a bang ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim aw, milimte tawh kei bang kisai ka hei? Nang ang dawng pa le nang ang don pa keima ka hi hi. Kei pen na a dawng taasing tawh ka kibang hi; na thumanna pen keima kung pana ang pei ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mipilte in tam thute a theitel uhi; thu khinkhai theite in tuate a thei uhi. Azieh pen Topa’ lampi man a, thutang mite in tua lampi zui uhi, ahi vangin thupalsat mite ahi ule tuate sungah a kipalpuo uhi."}}}}},"29":{"info":{"name":"Joel","shortname":"Joel","abbr":[],"desc":"Joel laibu (the book of joel)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pethuel’ tapa Joel tungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:"},"2":{"text":"No upate aw, tami ngai unlen, gam sunga tengte zosie in zong na bil uh daw un! Noma le na pu na pate khangin tam bang thu a pieng ngai amah?","title":"Gamsung Kisietna Zieha Kaana (Pei 10:1-20)"},"3":{"text":"Tam thu na tate hil unlen, na tate un amau’ tate hilsawn hinlen, a khang a khangin kihil sawn uheh."},"4":{"text":"A pettan kauphete’ nehmawh teng, kauphe honte in netum a, kauphe honte’ nehmawh teng, a kitom kauphete in ne-in, a kitom kauphe’ nehmawh teng, a susie kauphe in a netum hi."},"5":{"text":"No zukhamte aw, tho unlen kap un; no lenggazu dawn zosiete aw, thumin tau un, azieh pen na kam sung panun zutuite kikhahtan zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen a thahat, a kisim zo lo minam a tampi khat in ka gam ang sim hi; amau’ ha pen humpi’ ha tawh kibang a, humpi nute’ ha bangin hiem mama hi.","ref":"Kln 9:8"},"7":{"text":"Ka lengguite ei suhsiet pieh vua, ka theikungte zong a sattan uhi; a hawte hawh dawhin a paimang vua, a bate zong khu a kangdang sieng ta hi."},"8":{"text":"La-ip puon silin a sen lawmpa a kaa nungah nu bangin kap un."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ biehinn panin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehna om nawn lo hi. Topa’ nasem ahi siempute thumin a tau uhi."},"10":{"text":"Lozaute a kisie sieng ta a, leitangte a kap vangut ta hi; azieh pen ankungte kisusie a, lenggazute gawkangin sathaute tawp sieng ta hi."},"11":{"text":"No lohlote aw, da un. No lenggui cingte aw, mangbu le mangbuhamte adingin thumin kap un; bangzieh ahei cile lolai ante kisie ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Lengguite gawpmang sieng a, theikungte tuolah kunsuh ta hi. Mang kawlsingte, lutu kungte le apple kungte a kipan, lolai-a singkung zosie gawta sieng zo hi; a tahtahin ci leih mite lahah lungnopna kici om nawn lo hi."},"13":{"text":"No siempute aw, la-ip puon silin kap un; no maitam nasemte aw, thum unlen tau un. No ka Pasien’ nasemte aw, hing pei unlen zan khuovahin la-ip puon silin kap un! Topa’ inn panin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate kipie nawn lo hi.","title":"Kisiakia ding le Thungen Dinga Hlatna"},"14":{"text":"A siengtho antanna khat bawl unlen, kikhopna thupi khat hlan un. Na Topa Pasien uh’ biehinn sungah upate le gam sunga tengte zosie, kaikhawm unlen Topa kungah kiko-in thungen un."},"15":{"text":"Kadeisei, tuami ni khu! Bangzieh ahei cile Topa’ ni ang nai ta a, Vanglienpa kung pana ang pei sietna bangin ang tung ta hi.","ref":"Isa 13:6"},"16":{"text":"Eima’ mitmu-in an neh ding le i Pasien’ biehinn sung panin kipahna le thanopnate kilamang ta hi lo amah?"},"17":{"text":"Leikhal nei-ah khaicite gaw sieng a, an kholna innte hawmsuoh ta hi; bu a tun lo ziehin ansalte zong kisie gawp ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Ganhingte cimaw-in tautau uhi! bawng honte a vahthap uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate adingin lohing om lo hi; tuuhonte nangawn zong cimaw-in a lungdong uhi."},"19":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma kungah kang kiko hi. Bangzieh ahei cile gamlah lohing zosie mei in hulvam ta a, meikuong in lolai-a singkung zosie a katum sieng ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Gamlah lohingte mei in a kahtum sieng ziehin, luidungte kanggaw sieng ta a, gamsate nangawn zong nangma kungah ang kiko uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion ah pengkul mut unlen, ka muol siengtho tungah patauna aw gingsah un! Topa’ ni tung ta ahi ziehin gam sunga tengte zosie zau-in citun sieng uheh."},"2":{"text":"Khuomiel ni le lungzin ni, meiikai ni le khuozin ni nai mama ta hi! Muoltung tengah meivom a kai bangin, a thahat le a tam mama galkapte ang kuon uhi; tangtawng panin tua bangte a om ngai nai sih a, a khangkhangin zong tuate a om ngai ta sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate mai-ah mei in hulvam a, a nua lam vuah meikuong kileh vapual hi. Amate masanga gam pen Eden um tawh kibang a, ahi vangin a nua lama gam pen senel gam gawta hi a, bangma in amate a suohta sah thei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"A melpuoh uh sakol tawh kibang a, gal-sakolte bangin a tai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Sakol leeng ging bangin amate muol tung tengah a kopdien vua, mei in a kahtum butu ging le gal sim dinga a kithawi, a thahat mama galkap honte tawh a kibang uhi.","ref":"Kln 9:7-9"},"6":{"text":"Amate mai-ah mite lungkhamin, maitang zosie a kangdang sieng hi."},"7":{"text":"Galhangte bangin gal a sim vua, galkapte bangin kul tungah a ka uhi. A lampi ciet uh a zui vua, a lampi panun a piel sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat kiphukha loin, a lampi son ciet uh a zui uhi; amate in galhiemte a phugawp vua, khawl vawt loin ma a nawt uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khuopi sungah a kopdien vua, kul tung tengah a tai kawikawi uhi; inn sung tengah a kato vua, guta bangin tawlette panin a lut uhi."},"10":{"text":"A mai vuah leitung kilawhin vante kiling gawp hi. Ni le hlate zong miel a, aasite tang nawn lo hi.","ref":"Kln 8:12"},"11":{"text":"A galkapte mai-ah Topa in thu a gen hi; a galkap honte nah tam sam e! Ama’ thupieh a mang mite simzawh ding hi lo hi. A tahtahin Topa’ ni pen thupi mama hi; zong zau huoi mama hi, koi in thuohzo ding ahei?","ref":"Kln 6:17"},"12":{"text":"Hizongle tu nangawnin zong lungsim tahtah tawh kisia-in antanna, kaana le mauna tawh ka kungah hing kinualekia un, Topa in ci hi;"},"13":{"text":"na puonsilte uh botkeh zaw loin, na lungtangte uh botkeh zaw un. Topa na Pasien uh kungah hing kinualekia un, azieh pen ama migi-in mi hepi a, lungduoi-in itna kip tawh kidimin mi dan a pie nuom sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Note in Topa na Pasien vua dingin an tawh biehna le dawn thei biehnate na pieh thei nadingun, ama ang kihei-in a lungsim hing khiem a, a thupha ang nuasiepieh ding le ang nuasiepieh lo ding koi in thei ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Zion ah pengkul mut un; a siengtho antanna khat bawl un; kikhopna thupi khat hlan un;"},"16":{"text":"mihonpi kaikhawm un. mihonte siensuo un; khanghamte kaikhawm un; khanghamte le naupangte, nawi ne lai nausente nangawn kaikhawm un. Zinei pa in a lupna nuasie hinlen, monu in a lupna dalna nuasie taheh."},"17":{"text":"Maitam le talaap kikalah Topa’ nasem siempute kap uheh. Amate in, “ Topa aw, na mite suohta sah inlen, nangma’ gouluote, minamte lahah simmaw le thu gentena-in ei kineisah poma sin. Bang dingin mite lahah, ‘A Pasien uh hei-a om ahei?’ ei kici ding ahei, cisah un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ama’ leitang hing lainatin, ama’ mite ang khuotuo hi.","title":"Pasien’ Dawnkiana le a Kamciem"},"19":{"text":"Topa in a mite dawngkia a: An, zu, le sathau kang pie ding hi, tua hile na lungkim ding uhi; keima in note pen minamte lahah mi simmaw-in kang koi nawn sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na kung panun gamlapi- ah sahlam galkapte hemkhie-in, senel gamgaw munah amate ka notmang ding a, a masate nisuona tuipi sungah, a nukhiate nitumna tuipi sungah ka notmang ding hi; a gimnam le a ui a than uh kikhawto ding hi. Ama in na golpite a bawl tahtah zo hi!"},"21":{"text":"Leisiet aw, zau sin; lungdamin kipah in, azieh pen Topa in na lienpite sem zo ta hi!"},"22":{"text":"Gamlah gamsate aw, zau sih un, azieh pen gam sunga lopate dawng zo hi; singkungte ga-in lengguite le theikung tampitah a ga uhi."},"23":{"text":"Zion tate aw, lungdam unlen, Topa na Pasien uh sungah kipah un; azieh pen ama in na dihna uh a kilah nadingin guo masa zusah zo a, note adingin guotui tampitah ang buohsuh zo ta hi. Guo masa le guo nukhia zong nidang lai bangin a zusah hi."},"24":{"text":"Ancilna phuol an tawh kidim ding a, lenggazu le sathau zong umlebeel a dim ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note sim dinga kang sawl kauphe honpi, a kitom, a susie, le a petsan kauphete ahi, ka galkap honte in ang nehpieh kum sunga a piengte, kang lokia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Note in tampi ne-in na lung uh kim ding a, lamdang taha ang bawlpieh na Topa Pasien uh’ min na phat ding uhi. Tuale ka mite in maizumna a thuohkia ngai ta sih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Israel laikimah ka op lam le kei, na Topa Pasien uh ka hi a, kei simlo koima dang a op lo lam note in nei thei ding uhi. Tuaci’n ka mite ahile kimaizumsah ngai nawn lo ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin mi zosie tungah ka hlagau ka buo ding hi; na tapate ule na tanute un thu a hil ding vua, na khanghamte un mangte manin, na khangnote un mang a mu ding uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Hlagau Kibuo"},"29":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin sila numeite le sila pasalte tung nangawnah ka hlagau ka buo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima in leitung le vante ah hilkholna limte ahi sisan le meikhu lompi ka lah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"A thupi le a zauhuoi Topa’ ni a tun masangin ni khuomiel suohin hla sisan a suoh ding hi.","ref":"Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Kln 6:12-13"},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ min tawh a kiko poma in hutdamna nga ding hi; azieh pen Topa in a gensa bangin Zion Muol le Jerusalem khuo sungah a suohta lai mi a om ding hi. Topa in a hlat mite a suohta ding uhi.","ref":"Sawl 2:17-21; Rom 10:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum ni le khum hun ciengin Judah le Jerusalem, a nidang hun ka bahsah ciengin,"},"2":{"text":"keima in minam zosie kaikhawmin Jehoshaphat kuomah ka peipisuh ding a, khum munah ka mite le ka gouluo Israel ziehin amate tungah thu ka khen ding hi, azieh pen amate in minamte lahah Israel a kithezah sah uhi. Amate in ka gam a hawm vua,"},"3":{"text":"ka mite adingin aisanin a pahtat numeite lei nadingin naupangte, zu lei nadingin nungahte a zua vua, tuale a khamtahun zu a dawn uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tyre, Sidon, le Philistia gam zosie aw, keima tungah bang bawl sawm na hi uh ahei? Bang khat po zieha ei thuh sawm na hi uh amah? Note in ei thuhkia na hi uleh, ke’n zong na luzang vuah na na sepsate uh kinawtah le gangtahin kang tusahkia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in ka ngun le ka kham teng nei lahpieh ta vua, na biehinnpi vuah ka gougil teng na puo sieng ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Note in Judah mite, Jerusalem mite, le Greek mite tungah na zua vua, a gamgi panun a gamlapi-ah na hemmang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in na zuana uh mun ciet panin amate ka hantawh ding a, na luzang vuah na sepsa teng uh ka tungsahkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in Judah mite khut sungah na tanute ule na tapate uh ka zua ding a, amate in a gamlapi-a om gam khat ahi Sebea-te tungah zuasawn ding uhi; bang ding ahei cile Topa in a gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; 23:1-18; Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15–28:26; Amos 1:6-10; Zeph 2:4-7; Zech 9:1-7; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"9":{"text":"Minamte tungah tam thu phuongzah un: Galdo dingin kithawi unlen, galhangte hantawh un. Galkapte zosie in naisah unlen, amate hing kuonsah un.","title":"Jehoshaphat Kuom Sunga Thukhenna (Isa 2:4 ; Mic 4:3)"},"10":{"text":"Lokaina na tute uh namsau-in kheng unlen, singba heuhna na namkawite uh teipi-in kheng un; a zawngkhal pa in zong, Kei galhang ka hi hi,” ci taheh.","ref":"Isa 2:4; Mic 4:3"},"11":{"text":"No a kimvela om minam zosie aw, mallangin hing pei unlen, khum munnah hing kikhawm un. Topa aw, na galhangte hing peipisuh in."},"12":{"text":"Minamte, amau le amau hing kihantawh uh hinlen, Jehoshaphat kuomah hing peito ta uheh; bangzieh ahei cile na kimvel vua om minam zosie thu khen dingin khum munah keima ka to ding hi."},"13":{"text":"An lah hun ta ahi ziehin na phieukawi uh tawi un. Lengga cilna kuong dimin, lenggatui dawna zong dimlet ta ahi ziehin, hing pei unlen hing cil un, bangzieh ahei cile a gitlona uh lien mama hi.","ref":"Kln 14:14-16, 19-20; 19:15"},"14":{"text":"Thukhenna kuom sungah mihon tampitah a om hi! Azieh pen thukenna kuom sungah Topa a nai zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Nipi le hlapi miel zo a, aasite tang nawn lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Zion panin Topa hawhin, Jerusalem panin awng vapuoh a, vanpi le leipi a kilawh hi. Hinanle mite adingin Topa pen kibuhna hi a, Israel mite adingin mun muonhuoi ahi hi.","ref":"Amos 1:2"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in keima, ka muol siengtho Zion-a teng Topa na Pasien uh ka hi lam na thei ta ding uhi. Jerusalem siengtho ding a, minamte in ama sungah lam a hla ngai nawn sih ding uhi.","title":"Judah’ Mailam Minthanna"},"18":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin muolsangte panin zuningte ang taasuh ding a, muoltangte ah bawngnawite luongin, Judah gam luidung zosie ah tui luong ding hi; Topa’ inn panin tuisam khat pul ding a, tua in Shittim kuom teng a nomsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Judah mite tungah a tatsiet zieh ule, a gam sung vuah maw nei lote’ sisan a luonsah ziehun, Egypt gam, ten lona gam suohin Edom gam, senel gam a suoh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Judah gam pen kumtawn tenna-in kinei ding a, Jerusalem pen a khangkhangin tenna-in kinei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in amau’ sisan phu la-in, a khielnate uh ka maisah sih ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile Zion ah Topa a teng hi."}}}}},"30":{"info":{"name":"Amos","shortname":"Amos","abbr":[],"desc":"Amos laibu (the book of amos)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Uzziah le Israel Kumpipa Joash’ tapa Kumpi Jeroboam khan sung, zillin masang kum ni hun lai-in Israel tawh kisai Tekoa tuucingte lahah Amos thugen tam bang ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 15:1-7; 2Khg 26:1-23; 2Kum 14:23-29"},"2":{"text":"Ama in tam bangin ci hi: Zion panin Topa hawhsuh a, Jerusalem khuopi panin ang awng vapuoh hi; tuucingte’ lohingte vulnangin, Carmel muolvum gausan sieng hi.","title":"Israel’ Gamvengte tunga Thukhenna","ref":"Joel 3:16"},"3":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Damascus’ khielna thum le li ziehin, ka danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen amate in sia-ha a nei an gawina tawh Gilead a gawt guoi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hazael inn sungah meikuong ka hla ding a, tua in Ben-hadad mun muonhuoite a katum sieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Damascus khuopi tunkot zawlte ka hliehtawng ding a, Aven Kuoma a teng mite le Beth-eden pana kumpi ciengkhut a tawipa ka sumaimang ding hi; keima in Kir ah Aram-te salin kipeipi ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 17:1-3; Jer 49:23-27; Zech 9:1"},"6":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Gaza thupalsatna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen amate in Edom tunga ap dingin minambup salin a kai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Gaza kulbangah meikuong ka hla ding a, tua meikuong in a mun muonhuoite a katum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ashdod-a tengte le Ashkelon panin kumpi ciengkhut a tawi pa ka sumaimang ding hi; Ekron khuopi langkhatah ka khut ka hlang ding a, Philistia-te a omlai teng a sigam ding uhi, Topa Pasien in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Zeph 2:4-7; Zech 9:5-7"},"9":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tyre’ khielna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen amate in Edom-te tungah minambup a ap vua, unau hina dinga thuciemna a phawh kha ta sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in Tyre kulbangah meikuong ka hla ding a, tua meikuong in a mun muonhuoite a katum sieng ding hi.","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Ezk 26:1–28:19; Joel 3:4-8; Zech 9:1-4; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"11":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Edom-te khielna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen ama in namsau tawh a sanggampa del a, khuotuona lungsim nei lo hi; a tawntungin ama lungthah a, a thangpaina a kem zing hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n Teman ah meikuong ka hla ding a, tua in Bozrah mun muonhuoite a katum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"13":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ammon-te khielna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen a gam uh a golkeh nadingun, Gilead-a numei gaite’ gil a kuikehpieh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n Rabbah kul tungah mei ka tawkuong ding a, gal kido ni-a kikona le pumpei kipei ni-a huipi tawh tua meikuong in a mun muonhuoite uh katum ding hi;"},"15":{"text":"tua ciengin a uliente le a kumpipa uh salin a pei ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Moab-te khielna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen ama in Edom kumpipa’ gute suongkang bangin a haltum hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Moab tungah meikuong hla-in tua in Kerioth mun muonhuoite katum ding a, gamlumna awging le pengkul ginte lahah Moab-te si ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuate laizangah gam uhpa ka sumaimang ding a, ama tawh uliente zosie ka that ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1–16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Ezk 25:8-11; Zeph 2:8-11"},"4":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Judah khielna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen amate in Topa’ thukham a nuol zo vua, a thu kipte zui loin, hinanle amate in a pu a pate’ na zuisa zuouphuonate tawh, amate lam khielsah zo hi.","title":"Judah tunga Thukhenna"},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judah tungah meikuong ka hla ding a, tua in Jerusalem mun munhuoite a katum ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Israel khielna thum le li ziehin, danpiehna ka dawhkia sih ding hi; azieh pen amate in ngun tawh midihte a zua vua, amate in kedap kop tawh mi tasamte a zua uhi.","title":"Israel tunga Thukhenna"},"7":{"text":"Amate in mizawngte’ lutang leivui lahah a tuoncil vua, lampi panin mi gentheite a sawnnawp uhi; ka min siengtho a buasah dingin, nungah khat kungah a pa le a tapa a pei uhi;"},"8":{"text":"maitam cinteng tungah a lum vua, vankhap a kila puonte a netpha uhi; amate in a Pasien uh’ inn sungah a mi gapna uh zu a dawn uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanle keima in a mai vuah taamtah sing banga a sang le gangpi sing banga a sah Amor-te ka suhsiet pieh hi; keima in a tunga a ga le a nei-a a huite ka susie hi.","ref":"Thkna 3:8-11"},"10":{"text":"Note zong Egypt gam pan kang peipi to a, Amor-te leitang a luo dingin kum sawmli sung senel gamah kang pui hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tapate uh pawlkhat kamsangin ka pangsah a, na khangnote uh pawlkhat nazir mi ka hisah hi. Tam bang ma hi lo amah, Israel mite aw, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Gam 6:1-8"},"12":{"text":"Hinanle note in nazir mite zu na dawnsah vua, kamsangte thu pie-in, “Thu phuong sih un,” na ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n bulomte a dim ciengin bawngleng a netsuh bangin, keima in na opna mun vuah note kang nensuh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tai hatte a suohta sih ding vua, a tha hatte in a hatna uh a zang man sih ding uhi;"},"15":{"text":"thaltawite in a do zo sih ding vua, a malgangte amau le amau kihunzo tuom loin, sakol tunga tuongte in a hinna uh a humbih zo sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mihatte lahah a hangsan pente zong a guohtangin taimang ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite aw, Egypt gam pana kang peipi innkuonte zosie, note langkhatah Topa thugen za un:","title":"Israel’ Khielna le Danpiehna"},"2":{"text":"Leitung innkuon zosie lahah no beh kang thei ahi bo hi; tua ahi ziehin keima in na khielna zosie ziehun dan kang pie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Kiciemkholna om loin mi ni a zawhton thei amah?"},"4":{"text":"A samat ding a nei lo ciengin gamlah ah humpi a mawh hawh amah? Samat bangma a nei lo ciengin a kuo sungah humpi khanglai a mawh ham amah?"},"5":{"text":"Thang-anta a op sih le lei lahah a kisie thangah vata a mawh aw amah? Bangma awh lopi-in leilah panin thang a kimawh sai amah?"},"6":{"text":"Khuopi sungah pengkul a kimut ciengin mite a zau sih uh amah? Topa’ tunsah lo pi-in khuopi sungah gimna a tung amah?"},"7":{"text":"A tahtahin Topa in ama’ nasem kamsangte tungah a thusim gen lopi-in na sem lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Humpi hawh zo hi; koi ahiei a giing lo ding? Topa in gen zo hi; koi ahiei a thu phuong ding?"},"9":{"text":"Ashod mun muonhuoite le Egypt gama mun muonhuoite-ah phuongzah inlen, “Samaria Muol ah kikhawm unlen, a sunga buoina lienpite en un. Tua khuopi laikima a om bawlsietnate hing en un,” ci un."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a mana gamtat ding a thei sih vua, mun muonhuoite sungah tatsietna le guhtatna a khol uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa Pasien in tam bangin gen hi: Galte in tua gam kuikhumin, na kihunna uh a la ding uhi; na mun muonhuoite uzong kibulu ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tuucing pa in humpi kamhawm panin tuu keng ni, ahi sihle a bil themkhat a hunkhiet ma bangin topha nip ningkiu khat le lupna themkhat tunga a to Samaria khuo sunga a teng Israel mite kihunkhie ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Vanglien Pasien ahi, Topa Pasien in ci hi: Za unlen Jacob innkuonte langah teci pang un."},"14":{"text":"A khielna ziehin Israel dan ka pieh ni-in, Bethel maitam dan ka pie ding a, maitam kite tawngsanin tuolah a kiesuh ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 23:15"},"15":{"text":"Phalbi inn le khal inn ka phel ding a, saiha innte kisie-in inn thupite tawpmang ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mizawngte nengniemin mi tasamte gawt a, a pasalte kungah, “Ka dawn ding bangkhat ei pie vawi!” ci-in a gen, Samaria Muoltunga a om no Bashan bawngpite aw,” tami thu ngai un."},"2":{"text":"A siengthona tawh Topa Pasien kiciem zo hi: Amate in note siakawi tawh ang kaidawh ding hun ang tung valon ding a, a nukhia pente nangawn ngakuoi tawh ang kai ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kulvang zui-in na pitdawh ding vua, a mailam vuah mi zosie tangtahin pei ding uhi; Harmon muolah na kisengnawp ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Bethel ah hing pei unlen khielna bawl un; Gilgal ah hing pei unlen, khielna khangsah un; zingmawng sielin na kithoinate uh tawi unlen, nithum sielin na sawm-a-khatte uh tawi un;"},"5":{"text":"tol kisaw lungdamna biehna tawi unlen, na dei dan uh biehnate phuongzahin tuate gen un; bangzieh ahei cile tam banga bawl ding pen na dei dan uh ahi hi, Israel mite aw! Topa Pasien in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Na khuopi zosie vuah ha sienthona kang pie a, na tenna mun zosie vuah neh tasamin kang koi a, hinanle ka kungah nang kilekia tuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Israel in Kithuhilna Nuol"},"7":{"text":"Ka anlah hun ding hla thum a sap laitahin, note tungah guo a zuh ding ka kham hi; khuopi khatah guo zusahin, adang khatah ka zusah sih hi; lo khat tungah guo zu a, guo zuh lona lo a gawta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n tui sui dingin khuopi ni le thuma mite khuopi khatah a vah kawikawi vua, a tai zo sih uhi; hinanle kei kungah nang kilekia tuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Huisapi le maibuoh natna tawh kang sugawp hi; na umte ule na lenggui lote a hawmguohin ka koi hi; kauphe in na theikungte ule na olive kungte uh a netum sieng hi; hinanle ka kungah nang kilekia tuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt gama ka tunsah dan bangin note lahah pul natna kang tungsah hi; na tangvalte uh namsau tawh ka satlia hi; na sakolte uh kang kaimangpieh hi; na nahhawm sung vuah na giephuol vua sil uite ka lut tosah hi; hinanle kei kungah nang kilekia tuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in Sodom le Gomorah a lumle bangin mi pawlkhat ka lumlet ding a, meikuong lai-a a kiladawh singthem tawh na kibang ding uhi; hinanle ka kungah nang kilekia tuom sih uhi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Israel aw, nang tungah tam bangin kang bawl ding hi: Na tungah tami hing bawl ding ka hi ziehin, Israel aw! na Pasien tawh a kimu dingin kisakhol in."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile en in, muolte bawlin huite a siem pa, a ngaisutna mi kunga a pulah pa, zingmawng khuomiel suohsahin leitung munsang teng a tuoncil pa, a min Vanglien Pasien, Topa ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, kaateng lo kawmin na kung vuah kang gen tam thu khu ngai un:","title":"Israel’ Mawna Zieha Kaala"},"2":{"text":"Israel ngahnu pua a, a thokia nawn sih hi; a gam sungah kipampai a, a phongto ding koima om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Mi tulkhat a kuonsah khuopi ah mi zakhat hing lai ding a, mi zakhat a kuonsah khuopi ah mi sawm hing lai ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa in Israel innkuon tungah tam bang ci hi: Keima ei sui unlen hing un;"},"5":{"text":"hinanle Bethel sui sih unlen, Gilgal ah lut loin, Beer-sheba ah zong galkai sih un; azieh pen salin Gilgal pei valon ding a, Bethel zong bangma lo a suoh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa sui un, tua hile na hing ding uhi. na sui sih uleh Joseph innkuon tungah mei bangin ang kuong ding a, tua mei in Bethel katumin koima in a phel zo sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Thutang lumletin aicim kha suohsah a, thudih tuol denna a nei note in gimna thuoh man va uciei!"},"8":{"text":"Bawmluoi le Zawlzawng a bawl, khuomiel zingmawng a suohsah, sunlai zan banga a mielsah, tuipi panin tuite hlanin lei maitanga tua tuite a sungsuh pa, ama’ min Topa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 9:9; 38:31"},"9":{"text":"Mihatte suhsiet nadingin mallang mama a, tuaci’n kulpi tungah sietna a tungsah hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in tunkota thuhil pa a muda vua, amate in thuman gente a huo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi zehin mizawngte tuoncilin, amau kung panin ankaihte na lah ziehun, suong kilem innte lam nan locin a sungah na tengkha sih ding uhi; a dei huoi lengga lote bawl nan locin lenggazu na dawn kha sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na khielna za ule na mawnate uh a liet lam ka thei a, midihte genthei bawlin guhgol na la vua, khuopi tunkot ah mi tasamte na sawnpua uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tam bang hun ciengin, mi pilvangte a sip khinkhian ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile tua hun pen hunsie ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Na hin thei nadingun hoina sui un, gitlona sui sih un; na gensa bangun Vanglien Topa Pasien in note ang ompi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Gitlona muda-in thu hoi dei unlen, khuopi tunkot ah thutang sukip un; Joseph minam a omlai teng, Topa , Vanglien Pasien in ang lainat kha thei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa , Vanglien Pasien in tam bangin ci hi: Khuolai mun-awng zosie ah kaa le mau om ding hi; amate in lamdung zosie ah, “Kadeisei! kadeisei!” a ci ding uhi. Amate in a kap dingin lohlote a ciel ding vua, a thum a mau dingin kaateng law siemte a ciel ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na laikim vuah kang kansan ding ziehin, lengga lo zosie ah kaana le mauna om ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa’ ni ang tun ding a lunggul note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Topa’ ni bang dinga na lunggul uh ahei? Tua ni pen khuomiel hi a, khuovah hi lo hi;","title":"Khuomiel Ni khat ahi Ni"},"19":{"text":"Humpi kung pana a tai, vompi khat tawh kituoh mi khat tawh kibang ding hi; ahi sihle a inn sungah lutin kawma khut a ngap ciengin gul in a tuh mipa tawh kibang ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa’ ni pen khuovah hi loin khuomiel ni hi a, a sungah a tang a om lo khuomiel ni hi lo amah?"},"21":{"text":"Na biehna pawite uh ka muda a, ka thupisim sih hi, na khawmpi bawlte un ka lung a kimsah sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Keima kungah na meihal biehnate ule an tawh biehnate nang tawi vangun, tuate ka sang sih ding hi; thunuom biehna dinga nang peipi uh na ganthaute uzong etin ka nei vet sih ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:11-14"},"23":{"text":"Na lasah gamlumnate uh khawl un; na harp lasahna tumgingte uh ka ngai vawt sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Thutang, tui bangin luongsah unlen, dihna, a kang ngai lo luitui bangin luongsah un."},"25":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, senel gamah kum sawmli na op sungun keima kungah biehpiehnate le biehnate nang tawi uh amah?"},"26":{"text":"Note in noma dinga na bawltawm uh na kumpipa uh Sakkuth le na aasi-pasien uh ahi na milimte uh na puo ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Damascus galkhatah sal dingin kang kai ding hi, ama’ min Vanglien Pasien Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:42-43"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion ah nuomtaha a tengte, Samaria Muol tungah lungmuonga a omte, minamte’ ulien pente, Israel innkuonte’ muon le suonte, gimna thuoh man va uciei!","title":"Minuomsate Dan Kipie ding"},"2":{"text":"Calneh ah galkai-in va en ta un; khum panin khuopi lien Hamath ah va pei un; tua ciengin Philistia gam Gath ah peisuh un. Tua kumpi gamte sangin note na hoizaw uh amah? Ahi sihle note’ leitang sangin amau’ leitang a hoizaw amah?"},"3":{"text":"Sietna ni ang tun ding gamlapi-a a khinto note aw, tatsietna ang tun ding hun na naisah uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Saiha lupna tunga a lum, a lupna tung vua a lum hit hiette, tuuhon lahah tuuno sa le bawnghon lahah bawngno sa deih zaza a ne mite;"},"5":{"text":"David bangin tumging tumin, harp tawh langui a sa mite;"},"6":{"text":"nohai golpite tawh zu dawn a, sathau hoipente tawh amau le amau kinoi-in, hizongle Joseph’ kisietna thu-ah a dapi lo note in gimna thuoh man va uciei!"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-in amate khu sala pei masa pente ahi ding vua, a thada mite’ guolnopna a tawpmang ta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasien ama le ama kiciem zo hi, (Topa , Vanglien Pasien in tam bangin ci hi): Keima in Jacob’ kiphatsahna ka huo a, a mun muonhuoite ka muda hi; tua khuopi le a sunga om zosie mi khut sungah ka pie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Inn khat sungah mi sawm a op lai uleh amate a si ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale misi a hal a sanggam pa khat in inn sung panin tua siluong ladawhin puo ding a, inn dan sungta pena a om pa khat kungah, “Na oppi uh midang a om lai ei?” ci ding a, “Om sih,” ci-in kidawng ding hi. Tua ciengin tua a sanggam pa in, “Ham sih vawi! Eite in Topa’ min lo kha vawt sih vai,” a ci ding hi."},"11":{"text":"En un, Topa in thu pie a, inn golpi kisatguoi-in inn neute kisatzan ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Suong tungah sakolte a tai ngel amah? Mi khat in bawngtangte tawh tuipi a hlo amah? Hinanle note in thutang, gu na suohsah ta vua, dihna, gamsai na suohsah ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Lo-debar khuo ah guolnuomin, “Eite in eima adingin i thahatna utawh Karnaim i lah uh hi lo amah?” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, ang do dingin minam khat ka khangsah valon ding hi, Vanglien Pasien, Topa in ci hi. Amate in Lebo-hamath panin Arabah Lui dongin note ang gawt ding uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasien in keima ei lah khu tam ahi hi: Lopa a dawng nukhia ding pen a dawn pat laitahin ama in kauphete omsah a, (tua khu kumpipa’ lopa a ki-at zaw lopa a dawn nukhia hun tah ahi hi).","title":"Kauphe, Meikuong, le Khaukhai"},"2":{"text":"Amate in khum gama lopate a khawn sieng zaw ciengun keima in, Topa Pasien aw, ei maisah in, hing thum ingh! Jacob in bangci thuoh zo ding ahei? Ama neu seng luo hi,” ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in tam tawh kisai-in a lungsim a khel hi; “Tam thu pieng nawn lo ding hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa Pasien in keima ei lah pen tami ahi hi: Topa Pasien in meikuong hlanin, tua meikuong in tui thuhpite katum a, gamsung teng a haltum hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, Topa Pasien aw, khawl in, hing thum ingh! Jacob in bangci thuoh zo ding ahei? Ama neu seng luo hi!” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in tam tawh kisai-in a lungsim a khel hi; “Tam thu pieng nawn lo ding hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa Pasien keima ei lah khu tami ahi hi: Khaukhai tawh a kilam kawm khat’ gei-ah a khut sungah khaukhai khat tawi-in Topa a ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale Topa in keima kungah, “Amos, bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Keima in, “Khaukhai khat,” ka ci hi. Tua ciengin Topa in, En vawi, ka mi Israel laikim ah khaukhai khat ka koi hi. Amate dan pieh ka sawm khu ka khel ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Isaac’ munsang teng gamkhing kisuohsah ding a, Israel’ munsiengtho teng a hawmguohin kikoi ding hi. Jeroboam innkuon do dingin namsau tawh ka kuon ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Bethel siempu Amaziah in Israel Kumpi Jeroboam kungah mi sawl a, “Amos in Israel innkuon laikim ah nangma ang do sawm hi; gamsung mite in ama’ thugen a nang zo nawn sih uhi.","title":"Amaziah in Kumpipa Kungah Mawsahna Gen"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen Amos in tam bangin thu gen hi, ‘Namsau tawh Jeroboam si ding a, ama’ gam panin a gamlapi munah Israel salin a pei ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuale Amaziah in Amos kungah, “Thumu pa aw, pei-in Judah gamah taimang inlen, khum sungah na neh ding va kisui ta’nlen, khum sungah thu va hil ta’n;"},"13":{"text":"Bethel ah thu hing gen nawn poma sin, bangzieh ahei cile tami mun pen kumpite’ mun siengtho ahi a, kumpi gam biehinnpi ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Amos in Amaziah kungah, “Kei kamsang ka hi sih a, kamsangpa’ tapa zong ka hi sih hi; tuucing le theiba um a puo mipa khat ka hi lel bo hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in tuute ka cinna panin keima ei la a, Topa in, keima kungah, ‘Pei inlen ka mi Israel-te kungah thu va gen ta’n,’ ei ci hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin tu-in Topa thu gen za in. ‘Israel langkhatah thu gen sinlen, Isaac innkuon langkhatah zong thu gen sin,’ nei ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin ci hi: ‘Na zi pen khuopi sungah na numei pahtat suoh ding a, na tanu le na tapate pen namsau tawh pua-in, khau tawh na gam kite ding a, a kihawmthang ding hi; a siengtho gam sungah nang mama na si ding a, ama’ gam panin Israel salin a pei valon ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasien in keima ei lah khu tami ahi hi. Khal singga bawng khat ahi hi.","title":"Singga Koina Bawng"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “Amos aw, bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Keima in, “Khal singga bawng khat,” ka ci hi. Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah, “Ka mi Israel-te tungah tawpna hun a tung zo hi; amate dan ka pieh ding ka khelkia ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ni-in biehinn sunga la kisate kaala a suoh ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi; “Misi luong tam ding a, mun zosie-ah kipaithang ding hi. Gamdai un!” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tasamte tuoncilin gam sung mizawngte a suhsiet sawmte aw,"},"5":{"text":"“I an uh i zua thei nadingin bang hun ciengin hla tha tawp ding a; i mangbu uh i zua thei nadingin bang hun ciengin sabbath tawp ding ahei? Antena ephah neusahin, shekel i golsah ding uhi. A man lo tawisuong tawh i zuou gamtat ding vua,"},"6":{"text":"ngun tawh mizawngte lei-in kedap bukhat tawh tasam liengvaite i lei ding a, a kisu lo mangbu site i zua ding uhi,” a ci note aw, tam thu za vawi un."},"7":{"text":"Jacob’ kiphatsahna tawh Topa a kiciem hi: A tahtahin amau’ nasepte ka mangngil ngai sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tami ziehin lei kiling loin a sunga a teng zosie kapin, tuate a unpi-un Nile gun bangin khang a, tui tungah lam kawikawi-in, Egypt gama Nile gun bangin kiemsuhkia lo ding uh amah?"},"9":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in sunkim laipi-in ni ka tumsah ding a, sunkim laipi ma-in khuo ka mielsah ding hi. Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Na biehna pawite uh dana ka suohsah ding a, na lasahte zosie uzong kaana ka suohsah ding hi; mi zosie in a kawng vuah la-ip puon gahsahin, lutang a kici zosie ka heukieusah ding hi; tapa khat neisun a si zieha kikaana ka bangsah ding a, a tawpna khu genthei ni ka hisah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Gam sungah kielpi ka tunsah ding hun ang tung valon ding hi, Topa Pasien in ci hi; tua khu an le tui dugawna kielpi hi loin, Topa’ thu zahnopna kielpi hizaw ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuipi khat pan tuipi khat, leilu panin nisuona dong amate a vah kawikawi ding uhi; ahi vangin amate in a mu zo sih ding uhi. Topa’ thu kanin a tai kawikawi ding vua, ahi vangin amate in a mu sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin ngahnu melhoite le tangvalte dangta-in a husam ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Samaria’ pasien Ashimah minin kiciem a, “Dan aw, na pasien pen a hing zing ahi ma bangin,” a cite le “Beer-sheba lampi a hing zing ahi ma bangin,” a ci amate a pua ding vua, a thokia nawn sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in maitam gei-a a ding Topa ka mu a, ama in: Biehinn bulpite a kilin dongin khuompiluzang zepnate satcim inlen, mizosie’ lutungah tuate tusah in; Keima in a suohta teng namsau tawh ka that ding hi; koima khat beh tai mang loin, koima khat beh suohta lo ding hi.","title":"Israel’ Kisietna"},"2":{"text":"Misikhuo sungah lei to nan ule, khum panin ka khut tawh ka ladawh veve ding hi; vantung dongah kato nan ule, khum panin ka khiesuh veve ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Carmel muolvum ah kiphuol nan ule, khum panin sui-in ka ladawh veve ding hi; ka muna panin tuipi tawngah kiphuol nan ule, khum sungah tuipi-gulpi thu ka pie ding a, tua gul in ka tusah veve ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A galte uh mai-ah salin pei nan ule, khum sungah namsau thu ka pie ding a, amate ka thatsah veve ding hi; amau’ hoi nading hi loin, a siet nadingun amate mittuhna-in ka nei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Pasien in leitung a tham ciengin tui suohin, leitunga a teng zosiete a kap amau vua, a unpi-un Nile gun bangin khang vapualin, Egypt gama Nile gun bangin a kiemsuhkia uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in vantungah inndan tungnung lam a, leitang tung lamah vanthamzawl phut hi; tuipi panin tuite hlan a, lei maitanga tuate a sungsuh pa, tam banga a bawl pa’ ama’ min Topa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite aw, kei adingin Ethiopia mite tawh a kibang hi lo na hi uh amah? Topa in ci hi. Keima in Israel-te, Egypt pan, Philistia-te, Caphtor pan le Aram-te, Kir panin peipi to hi lo ka mah?"},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasien in mawna a nei kumpi gamte mittuhna-in nei ding a, lei maitang panin Jacob innkuonte simlo, ka sumaimang ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in thu ka pie ding a, nam zosie lahah Israel innkuonte, gawdal-a ki zoi bangin ka zoi ding a, ahi vangin suongtang khat zong tuolah a kie sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Sietna in eite ei pha sih va,” a ci ka mi mawneite zosie, namsau-in a si ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin a puasa David’ buh phongto-in a vang teng ka phawbih ding a, a kisie teng zong phongto-in tanglai huna bangin ka lamphakia ding hi;","title":"David’ Kumpigam A ngai Bangkia"},"12":{"text":"tua khu amate in Edom a omlai teng le ka mina a kihlan minam zosie a luo thei nading uh ahi hi, tami a bawl Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 15:16-18"},"13":{"text":"Lokai pa in bu-at pa a makhel ding hun, lengga cilpa in a khaici tupa a makhel ding hun ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Muolsangte panin lenggazu hlum taasuh ding a, muoltang zosie panin lenggazu luong ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Agam vuah ka mi Israel-te ka tutkia ding a, amate in a kisiesa khuopite lamphakia-in a tang ding uhi. Amate in lenggui suonin a zute a dawn ding vua, um bawlin a gate a ne ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ka piehsa leitang panin amate ka phungkal ngai ta sih ding a, a leitang tung vuah amate ka suon ding hi, Topa na Pasien un ci hi."}}}}},"31":{"info":{"name":"Obadiah","shortname":"Oba","abbr":[],"desc":"Obadiah laibu (the book of obadiah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Obadiah’ Mangmuna. Topa Pasien in Edom tawh kisai tam bangin ci hi: Kote in Topa kung pan thupuoh ka za zo ta vua, minamte lahah kamtai khat kisawl zo ta hi: “Tho un! Ama do dingin kuon va vui!” a ci hi.","title":"A Kiphasah Edom Kisuniem ding"},"2":{"text":"Minamte lahah a neu penin kang bawl valon ding hi; nang pen nahpitahin ang kisimmaw ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A pawhkeh suongpi kawm lahah tengin, munsang lahah a teng pa aw, na lungsim kiphatsahna in nang ang solgawp ta hi. Nangma in na lungsim sungah, “Koi in lei-ah ei khiesuh ding ahei?” na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin a sangna munah lengto-in, aasite lahah bu na bawl zongin, khum panin kang khiesuh veve ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Zan lai-in na kungah gutate le misuomte hing pei uleh, ang bangci kisuhsiet ta diei! Amate in a deite beh uh ang guhpieh sih ding uh amah? Lengga khawmte na kungah hing pei uleh, a sangh teng a nuasie sam sih ding uh amah?","title":"Kibuluna le Kithana tawh Edom’ Gitlona Kithuhkia ding"},"6":{"text":"Esau bangci kibulu ahi a, a guogil teng a kilonpieh sieng ta khula!"},"7":{"text":"Na kipawlpi teng in ang solmang vua, gamgi dongin ang notmang uhi; amate in nang ang pawlbawlte zong a thazaw gawp ta uhi; na an a nete in zong ang thang siet ta vua, nang in lah na theitel zo sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in Edom sung panin mipilte le, Esau’ Muol tung panin theitelna ka sumang ding hi, Topa in a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Teman khuo aw, na galhangte a lungkie ding vua, tuaci’n Esau Muol panin mi zosie kisumai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang in sanggampa Jacob tungah kithana le tatsietna na zah ziehin, zumna in nangma ang khu ding a, khantanin ang kisumang ding hi.","title":"Edom in a Sanggampa Limbawl Lo"},"11":{"text":"Melmahte in a neisate a puohmang ni, a tunkotah gamdang mite a lut ni, Jerusalem luo nadingin ai a kisan ni, nang a gei-a na din ni-in nang zong amate khat tawh a kibang na hi ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ vangsiet ni-in, na sanggampa tungah na thangphat ding kilawm lo hi. Amau’ kisiet ni-in Judah mite tungah na kipah ding kilawm lo hi. Amau’ genthei ni-in na kisahthei ding kilawm lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite a tuosiet ni-in a tutkot vuah na lut ding kilawm lo hi; ama’ tuosiet ni-in Judah’ gimna tungah na thangphat ding kilawm lo hi; ama’ tuosiet ni-in a neisate na lahpieh ding kilawm lo hi."},"14":{"text":"A suohtate khah tan dingin lamsuom tenga na din ding kilawm lo hi; lungkham ni-in a hinglaite na pieh ding kilawm lo hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Mal 1:2-5"},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen minamte do nading Topa’ ni ang nai ta hi. Na bawl bangin nang tungah ang kibawl ding hi; nasepnate na luzang ma-ah ang tukia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen ka muol siengtho tunga na dawn bang lienun, na kimvel vua minam zosie in a dawn suoh ding uhi; amate in dawnin a nawmval ding vua, a pieng ngailote tawh kibang ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Zion Muol tungah a suohtate a om ding vua, khum mun pen mun siengtho ahi ding hi; tuale Jacob innkuonte in mi kilahpieh leitang luo ding uhi.","title":"Israel’ a Tawpna Guolzawna"},"18":{"text":"Jacob innkuonte pen mei tawh a kibang ding vua, Joseph innkuonte zong meikuong tawh kibang ding uhi; Esau innkuonte ahi ule butu tawh a kibang ding uhi; amate in tuate halin tuate a katum ding hi. Esau innkuon sungah a suohta om lo ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa gensa ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Negeb gama a tengte in Esau Muol a luo ding vua, Shephelah a tengte in Philistia gam a luo ding uhi; amate in Ephraim gam le Samaria gam luo-in, Benjamin in Gilead gam a luo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Halah gama a om saltang Israel-te in Phoenicia gam Zarephath dong a luo ding uhi; tuale Sepharad khuo-a om Jerusalem saltangte in Negeb gama khuopite a luo ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Esau’ Muol a uh dingin Zion Muolah hutdamsa mite, a kato ding uhi; tuale khum kumpi gam pen Topa -a’ ahi ding hi."}}}}},"32":{"info":{"name":"Jonah","shortname":"Jon","abbr":[],"desc":"Jonah laibu (the book of jonah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Amittai’ tapa Jonah kungah Topa’ thu tung a,","title":"Pasien Kung Panin Jonah Taisawm","ref":"2Kum 14:25"},"2":{"text":"“A lien mama Nineveh khuopi ah tu mama-in va pei ta’nlen, tua khuopi langkhatah va tangko in; azieh pen ka mai-ah a gitlona uh ang tungto ta hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa opna panin Tarshish lamah a taimang dingin Jonah a dingkhie hi. Joppa lamah ama peisuh a, Tarshish a zuon ding tembaw khat mu hi; tuaci’n ama in tembaw sap pie-in a tungah kato a, Topa kung panin a taimang dingin amate tawh Tarshish khuo ah a pei hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in tuipi tungah huipi hat mama khat langsah a, tua a gimnei huipi in tuipi a nawh ziehin tembaw a sie dingin a kisa hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin tembaw nasemte zau-in a pasien kung ciet vuah a kiko uhi. Amate in tembaw a zan tuom nadingin tembaw sunga a om vante tuipi sungah a pai uhi. Khum hun laitahin tembaw sung inndan neita penah Jonah kumsuh a, tuale na lumin na kimu hit hiet hi."},"6":{"text":"Tembaw uhpa pei-in ama kungah, “Bangci banga hici kimut ziuzieu thei na hei? Tho inlen, na pasien kungah thu ngen ven! Tua pasien in eite si loin i suotah thei nadingin ei ngaisutpieh maw lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tembaw nasemte in, “Hing pei un, koi zieha tami tuosietna hing tung ahei, ci i thei nadingin ai san vai,” ci-in khatlekhat kiho uhi. Tuaci’n amate in ai a san ule Jonah tung a tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in a kungah, “Bang zieha tam bang tuosietna eite tunga hing tung ahei, ei gen in. Nang bang sem na hei? Hei pana hing pei na hei? Na gam bang ahei? Nang koi minam na hei?” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei Hebrew mi ka hi a, tuipi le leigaw a bawl vantung’ Pasien ahi Topa ka bie hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua mite a zau zawkan lai vua, ama kungah, “Ta na bawl khu bang ahei!?” a ci uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Topa opna pana a tai ahi lam a gensa ahi ziehin amate in a thei zo ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in ama kungah, “Eite ading tuipi a dai thei nadingin bang kang law ding vuoi?” a ci uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tuipi ah huipi hat semsem hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Ei domto unlen tuipi sungah ei pai un; tua ciengin note adingin tuipi ang dai pai ding hi; azieh pen note tungah tami huipi gimnei ang lanna pen keima zieh ahi, ci ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua mite in lei lamah tembaw a kinuale thei nadingin nahpitahin a hot paupau uhi, hizongle amate langkhatah tuihuol hat semsem ahi ziehin a hotzo sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate Topa kungah kiko-in, “ Topa aw, kang thum uhi, tam mipa sina ziehin kote ei mangthaisah sin, ci-in kang thum uhi. Maw nei lo mi khat’ sisan luonna ziehin mawna ei puosah sin; azieh pen Topa aw, na lungkimna banga na bawl ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Jonah domto-in tuipi sungah a khiesuh uhi; tuale tuipi kilawh vapualpi a dai pai lien hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin mite in Topa a giing zawkan lai vua, Topa tungah biehnate pie-in kiciemna a nei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jonah valtum dingin Topa in nga golpi khat a pie hi; tuale ngapi gil sungah Jonah ni thum le zan thum sung a om hi.","ref":"Mat 12:40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jonah in ngapi gil sung panin Topa a Pasien kungah thu ngen a,","title":"Lungdamkona Lapi"},"2":{"text":"ama in “Ka cimawna panin Topa ka hlan a, ama in kei ei dawng hi; Misikhuo’ gilpi sung panin ka kiko a, ama in ka aw ei za hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuipi thuh a laikim tahah kei nei sepdawh a, tuikhang in kei ei kimkot hi; na tuihuol zosiete le na tui kilawhte in ka tungah ei viel hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, ‘Na opna panin ei kinotmang hi; na biehinn siengtho kang bangci nua-etkia thei ding ahei?’ ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka tungah tui in ei tuomcip hi; tuili thuh in ei imtawm hi; ka lu kimvelah tuipi lopate in kei ei vielcip ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Muolsang bulte ah ka kumsuh a, kumtawnin kot ei khalu thei kotgolh a nei gam sungah ka va kumsuh ta hi; hizongle Topa ka Pasien aw, tua Leihawmpi sung panin nang in ka hinna nei hunkhie hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka lung a kieh ciengin Topa ka phawh hi; tuale na biehinn siengtho sung nangma kungah ka thungetna ang tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lo milim biete in amau’ dihtatna a nuasie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima lungdam kona tawh nangma kungah biehpiehnate ka pie ding hi; ka kiciemnasa ka tangtun ding hi. Tatkhietna Topa -a’ ahi hi!” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ngapi hopi a, tuale ama in leigaw tungah Jonah a luokhie hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jonah kungah a niveina Topa’ thu tung a,","title":"Nineveh a Kikhelna"},"2":{"text":"“Tho inlen khuopi lien Nineveh ah pei-in, tua khuopi ah na kunga kang gensa thu va tangko in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ kammal dung zui-in Jonah kuonin Nineveh khuopi ah a pei hi. Nineveh khuo pen khuopi lien mama khat hi a, keng tawh ni thum sung kikantan khop hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuopi sunga lut dingin Jonah kipan a, ni khat sung lam a pei hi. Tuale ama in, “Ni sawmli zaw ciengin Nineveh khuopi kisusie ding hi,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale Nineveh khuomite in Pasien a um uhi; amate in antan ding thu tangko-in, mi zosie, a neu a lienin la-ip puon a sil uhi.","ref":"Mat 12:41; Luk 11:32"},"6":{"text":"Nineveh khuo kumpipa in tua thu a zah ciengin a kumpi topha panin dingin a puontuol sutdawh a, ama le ama in la-ip puon silin vut lahah a to hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Nineveh khuopi sungah tangtawhna khat a bawl hi: “Kumpipa le a miliente thukhenna dung zui-in: Mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin, bawnghon ahi a, tuuhon ahi zongin, koima in bangma kici khat zong ciem thei lo ding hi. Amate in an ne loin tui zong a dawn sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mihingte le ganhingte in la-ip puon silin Pasien kungah nahpi-in a kiko ding uhi. A gitlo gamtatnate ule a khut utawh a bawl uh tatsietnate panin mi zosie a kihei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Eite i manthai lo nadingin Pasien in a lungsim khelin a lungsona panin a kihei sih ding hi, ci koi in thei ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amau’ sepnate le a gitlo gamtatnate uh panin a kiheina uh Pasien in a mu bepin, amate tungah a tung dinga a gensa sietna tunsah lo dingin a lungsim a khelkia hi; tuale ama in tua sietna a tungsah nawn sih hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam thu in Jonah lungkimsah lo a, ama a lungthah hi.","title":"Jonah’ Lungthahna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Topa kungah thungen a, “Aw Topa! Ka gama ka oplai-a ka thugen tami hi lo amah? A kipat cil panin Tarshish khuopi-a ka taisimna zong tami zieh ma ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile nang pen mi hepi thei le mi khuotuo siem, a lungduoi, le itna kip tawh a kidim, dan pieh lo nading lungsim khelin a baisa-a a om Pasien na hi, ci kang thei hi.","ref":"Pei 34:6"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in, “ Topa aw, keima kung panin ka hinna ei la ta’n, azieh pen ka hin sangin si leng kei adingin a phazaw hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:4"},"4":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, “Na lungthah khu man na sah ma amah?” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuopi pulamah Jonah pusuohin ama adingin tua munah buhno khat a lam hi. Tua khuopi bang ang ci mawngmawng ei mah, ci-in a en dingin tua buh hlim nei-ah ama to-in a ngah hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa Pasien in sawlbawh khat bawl a, a lutunga a hlim ding, a lungkhamna a damsah dingin tua sawlbawh in Jonah lutung a khusah hi; tuaci’n khumi sawlbawh ziehin Jonah a lungdam mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin zingmawng khuo a vah ciengin Pasien in tua sawlbawh a vulgawp nadingin lungno khat in a susiesah hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni a suo ciengin Pasien in nisuona lam huisa langsah a, ni in Jonah’ luzang a kapsuh ziehin basamin si ding a ngen hi. Ama in, “Ka hin sangin si leng kei adingin pha tazaw va,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in Jonah kungah, “Sawlbawh tungtang na lungthah khu man na sa amah?” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Man sa na’ng, si nading khopin ka lungthah hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jonah Kiphawhsie"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in, “Na gimpi vawt lo le na khansah thei vawt lo, zankhat thu-a ang po, zan khat thu ma-a a mangthaikia tua sawlbawh khat pamai nasa hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale keima in a sunga a zietlam le a veilam zong a khen thei lo mi tulza le tul sawmni val a opna le ganhing tampite a opna Nineveh khuopi lien khu pamaisa loin ka om ding amah?” a ci hi."}}}}},"33":{"info":{"name":"Micah","shortname":"Mic","abbr":[],"desc":"Micah laibu (the book of micah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah gam kumpite ahi Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah-te’ hun laitahin Moresheth mi Micah tungah Topa thu tung a, Samaria le Jerusalem tawh kisai a mangmuna tam bang ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 15:32–16:20; 18:1–20:21; 2Khg 27:1-7; 2Khg 28:1–32:33"},"2":{"text":"No mipi zosiete aw, za un; leitung le a sunga teng zosie aw, ngai un; Topa Pasien in a biehinn siengtho panin note langkhatah teci pang taheh.","title":"Samaria Langkhatah Thukhenna Kipie"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen en un, a tenna mun panin Topa ang pei ding a, ama in leitung mun sangte tuoncilin ang kumsuh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin mei gei-a khuoinun zung bang le, kentawng pana tui kisung bangin, a keng nei-ah muolte zungmangin kuomte a pawhkeh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam thu zosie Jacob’ khielna le Israel innkuonte’ mawna zieh ahi hi. Jacob’ khielna bang ahiei? Samaria hi lo amah? Judah munsang bang ahei? Jerusalem hi lo amah?"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in Samaria khuopi, gamlah buathah kholna suohsahin, lenggui ciinna mun ka suohsah ding hi. Kuom sungah ama’ suongte ka sungsuh ding a, khuombulte ka laidawh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A milimte zosie kisatguoi ding a, a thaman zosie zong mei tawh kihal ding hi. Tuale keima in a milimte zosie ka susie ding hi; ama in numei pahtatte’ thamante a khop ziehin, numei pahtatte’ thaman ding ma-in tuate kizangkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin kapin ka mau ding hi. Puonsil loin ka kengguohin lam ka pei ding hi; si-alte bangin ka ham ding a, va-kalaohte bangin ka tau ding hi.","title":"Judah Khuopite Kisietna"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen a kidamsah thei lo ama’ liemma in Judah gam dong law hi; tuami in Jerusalem khuo-a ka mite’ tunkot tung zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Gath ah tua thu gen sih unlen, zong kap sih un; Beth-leaphrah khuo sunga leivui lahah kilawmlia un."},"11":{"text":"Shaphir-a teng mite aw, guohtang le maizumin na lampi vuah peisuoh un. Zaanan-a a teng mite aw, pusuoh sih un; Beth-ezel kapin mau-in om a, na kung panun a kihuna kilakhie ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen Maroth-a teng mite in sil hoi ang tun ding kal a ngahla mama vua, ahi vangin Topa kung panin Jerusalem tunkot ah gimna a peisuh zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Lachish-a teng mite aw, sakolte a leeng ah bul un; note pen Zion tanute’ mawna kipatna na hi uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile note sungah Israel’ khielna kimu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ziehin Moreseth-gath tungah mangpha paina letsong na pie ding uhi; Israel kumpite adingin Achzip innkuonte pen kisolna ahi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mareshah-a teng mite aw, note tungah guolzo pa khat kang puohkia ding hi; Adullam khuo ah Israel’ minthanna a tung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na kipahpi uh na tate adingin na sam heu unlen, na lu kieusah un; langta bangin na lu kieusah un, bangzieh ahei cile na kung panun amate suoh le salin kikai zo hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gitlona le gamtat hoilo a gelte in gimna a thuoh ding uhi! Zingmawng khuo vah ciengin amate in a bawl pai uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in bawl theina thu a nei uhi.","title":"Tangpi Gitlonate Kimawsah"},"2":{"text":"Lo a deigaw uleh tuate a matpieh vazieu uhi; inn a deigaw ule tuate a lahpieh vazieu uhi; amate in innsuongpa le innte, mite le a goute a bawlsie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Tu-in tam innkuon tungah sietna tunsah ka sawm a, note in khum panin na ngawng uh na pongsah zo sih ding uhi; tua khu hun sie ahi ziehin, na kiphatsah pei nawn sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin amate in note ang tawhna uh la khat sa-in, a hlasiet huoi kaala tawh amate a kap ding vua, “Eite i kisie dihdeh uhi; Topa in ka mite’ gouluo ei khelpieh hi; tua khu ka kung panin bang a ci lahdawh adiei! Sala ei mante tungah i logamte hawm sieng ta,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa’ mite kikhopna ah aisanin khau tawh a te ding koima na nei sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Thu hil sih un,” ci-in tam bangin thu hil uhi. “Mi khat in tam bang thute gen dingin kilawm lo hi; mindaina in ei nuaphah zo sih va,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jacob innkuonte aw, Topa’ thuohzawhna a tawp sieng ta amah? Tamte ama bawl ma amah? ci-in tam thute kigen ding amah? Thuman taha gamtate tungah ka kammalte in na hoi bawl hi lo amah?"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka mite, gal banga do dingin na kuonto uhi; lungmuonga a omte, a puontuol hawhin, gal thu ngaisuta zong a nei lo lungmuonga a peite kung panin, a puontuolte uh na sut uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amau’ innnuom panin ka mite’ numeite na notmang uhi; a tasente uh tung panin kumtawnin ka minthanna na lamang uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tho unlen pei un; kisietna a nasie mama tawh a susie sientho lona om ahi ziehin, tam mun tawlngahna ding mun hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Zuouthu hawmpi genin mi khat pei kawikawi a, keima in “Lenggazu le khamtheizu thu kang hil ding hi,” ci-in thu ang gen leh, tua bang mipa pen tam mite adingin a thuhil pa uh ahi ding hi!"},"12":{"text":"Jacob aw, na unpi-un kang kaikhawm valon ding hi, Israel a omlai teng zong kang kaikhawm ding hi; tuubuh sunga tuu khum bang le lonona muna tuuhon bangin amate ka koiton ding hi; khum mun pen mi husa tawh a kidimkia ding hi.","title":"A Omlai Israel ading Kamciem"},"13":{"text":"A masang vuah a honpieh pa a pei ding hi; tunkot phukehin a kantan ding vua, tua tunkot panin a pusuoh ding uhi. A mai vuah a kumpipa uh a pei ding a, Topa pen amau’ lutang hi ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in tam bangin ka gen hi: No Jacob lutangte le Israel innkuon sunga a uhte aw, ngai vawi un! Note in thutang na thei ding uh kilawm hi lo amah?","title":"Gam-uh Gilote le Kamsangte"},"2":{"text":"No, a hoi nate muda-in a hoi lo nate a dei mite, ka mite’ vun lempiehin, a gu tung vua tel le vo a kheupiehte aw,"},"3":{"text":"note in ka mite’ sa na ne vua, beela kihuon ding sa le khangbeela kikang ding sa bangin na semnen uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa kungah a kiko vua, hizongle ama in a dawng sih ding hi; a siet gamtat ziehun, khum hun ciengin ama in a kung panun a maitang a phuol ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Neh ding themkhat a nei ciengun, “Lungmuon om” ci-in kiko-in, a kam sung vuah neh ding a koipieh lo mite tungah gal bawng ding thu a gen, ka mite lam a pielsah kamsangte tawh kisai-in, Topa in tam bangin gen hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note tungah mangmuna om loin zan ang tung ding a, note tungah kihilna om loin khuomiel ang tung ding hi. Kamsangte tungah ni tum ding a, amate tungah sun zong a miel ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"thumute a muolpho ding vua, aisante maizum ding uhi; Pasien tung panin dawnna a op lo ziehin, amate in a unpi-un a kam a hum ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka hileh, Jacob’ khielna le Israel’ mawna a pulah dingin, vanglietna, Topa’ hlagau, thutang le hatna tawh ka kidim hi."},"9":{"text":"No Jacob innkuon a uhte, thutang huo-in thuman a leheite aw, tam thu khu za un."},"10":{"text":"Sisan luonsahna tawh Zion na lam vua, khielna tawh Jerusalem na lam uhi!"},"11":{"text":"A khuopi uh a uhte in guhgol tawh thukhenin, thaman nga nadingin a siempute in thu a hil vua, a kamsangte in sum nga nadingin thuphuon a gen uhi; hinanle Topa tungah a kingam bangin a om vua, “A tahtahin eite tawh Topa ang om hi! Eite tungah gimna kici hing tung sih va,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hi a, note ziehin lo bangin Zion kihlo ding hi; Jerusalem, buathah kholna suoh ding a, biehinn muol, gammang suoh ding hi.","ref":"Jer 26:18"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ang tung ding hunah Topa’ biehinn opna muol pen muolte lahah a sangpenin kikoi ding a, muoltangte tungah kisangkhan ding hi. Khum munah mite a pei ding vua,","title":"Thumanna Zieha Kilemna le Bihna (Isa 2:2-4)"},"2":{"text":"minam tampite zong ang pei in: “Hing pei un, ama in a lampi ei hilin, a lampite i zui thei nadingin, Topa’ muol tung, Jacob Pasien’ biehinn ah va kato va vui,” a ci ding uhi. Azieh pen Zion panin thuhilna ang pei ding a, Jerusalem panin Topa’ kammal ang pei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in mi tampite kikalah thu khen ding a, gamlapi-a om minam thahatte kikal kihaunate vengsah ding hi; a namsaute uh lo kaina tuzumin a kheng ding vua, a teipite uh singba heuna namkawi-in a kheng ding uhi; minam khatlekhat kidona-in namsau lam nawn loin, gal simdan ding zong a sin nawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Joel 3:10"},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lenggui hlim nei ule a theikung hlimte uh nei-ah a unpi-un a to ziuzieu ding vua, koima in a zausah sih ding hi; azieh pen Vanglien Topa Pasien in a kam tawh a na gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Zech 3:10"},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen minam zosie amau’ pasien min ciet tawh a kalsuon uhi, eite i hi leh a tawntungin Topa i Pasien’ minin i kalsuon zing ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in khelbaite ka khawm ding a, a kidelmang mite le ka bawlsiet mite ka kaikhawm ding hi.","title":"Saltan Zaw Angai Bahkia ding Kikamciem"},"7":{"text":"Khelbaite, a omlai minamin ka bawl ding a, a kidelmang mite, a thakhau minam khatin ka bawl ding hi; tuale Zion Muola amate tungah tu le a tawntungin Topa a maang den ta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuuhon cinna tausang, Zion’ tanu opna muol aw, nangma tungah ang tung ding hi. Nangma kungah nidanga kumpi thuneina ang tung ding a, Jerusalem tanu’ kumpi gam ang tung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang dinga kap vapuoh na hei? Na sungah kumpi om lo amah? Na thu kuppi pa mangthai-in, nausuoh natna in a tut numei bangin natna in ang tun ta amah?"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem tanu aw, numei nausuoh bangin kipeh inlen tau in; azieh pen khuopi panin nang na pusuoh ding a, gamlah ah giephuol satin Babylon khuopi lam na zuon ding hi; khum munah na suohta ding a, khum munah Topa in na galte khut sung panin ang tan ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nang ang sim dingin minam tampi a kikhawm vua, “Ama buasah vai-in, i mit-in Zion kaihlit vai,” a kici uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Topa’ ngaisutnate a thei sih uhi. Ancilna phuola bulomte a kikaikhop bangin kaikhop dinga a gel lam amate in a thei sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Zion tanu aw, tho-in cil in, azieh pen na ki sia-in ahi a, na kephang sumngo-in ahi zongin ka bawl ding hi; mi tampite tuoncilin, Topa tungah amau’ neisate na pie ding a, leitung buppi a uh Topa tungah amau’ hauna teng na pie ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in na kimvelah kul tawh ang ki-im hi; i langkhatah sim dingin ei kikuikhum hi; amate in ciengpum tawh Israel gam uhpa’ pheta a sat uhi."},"2":{"text":"Bethlehem Ephrathah aw, Judah bete lahah a neu pen na hi vangin, nang sung panin Israel a uh ding mipa khat ang pieng ding a, ama ang kipatna pen tangtawng ni masa lai ahi tabo hi.","title":"Bethlehem Pan Uhpa","ref":"Mat 2:6; Jhn 7:42"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tua nu in nausuo natna thuohin, a suo hun a tun masangsie, amate don loin koi phot ding hi; tua ciengin Israel mite kungah a unau omsun teng ang kilekia ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ hatna le Topa a Pasien’ min thupi sungah ama ding ding a, a tuuhonte a vah ding hi. Tuale amate bihtahin a teng ding uhi, azieh pen leimong dongah ama mi thupi hi ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"Tuale ama pen kilemna khat ahi ding hi. I gam sungah Assyria-te ang pei-in, i leitang ang tot uleh, amate do dingin tuucing sagi dingsahin, makai giet i koi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"A namsau utawh Assyria gam a uh ding vua, namsau dawsa-in Nimrod’ gam a uh ding uhi; i gamah amate ang lutin i gamgi sung ang tot uleh, Assyria-te kung panin amate in eite ei hunkhie ding hi.","ref":"Pien 10:8-11"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi tampite in a imtawm, Jacob suon a omlai teng pen mihingte tunga kingam lo, mi koima tunga lametna a nei lo, Topa kung pana ang pei daitui le lopa tunga a kie guomal tawh a kibang ding uhi.","title":"Mailam a Omlaite Dinmun"},"8":{"text":"Mi tampi in a imtawm, minamte lahah a om Jacob suon a omlai teng pen gamlah gamsa lahah a om humpi tawh a kibang ding vua, tuuhonte lahah a om humpi khanglaite tawh a kibang ding uhi. Tuute a tuokhah ciengin tuoncilin ehmal a, a hun ding koima om lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Na kidopite tungah na khut na lamto ding a, na galte a unpi-un kisumaimang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in a cina ah, khum ni ciengin na kung panin na sakolte sumaimangin, na sakol leengte ka susie ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"na gam sunga khuopite sumaimangin, na mun muonhuoi zosie uh ka phelmang ding hi;"},"12":{"text":"na khut panin mibum theite sumaimangin, aisan theite na nei nawn sih ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"note lah panin na milimte sumaimangin, na biehna songte uzong ka sumaimang ding a, khut tawh na bawlsa uh nate mai-ah na kun nawn sih ding uhi;"},"14":{"text":"note lahah a om na khuom siengthote uh phungkalin, na khuopite uh ka susie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka thu a mang lo minamte tungah lungthahna le thangpaina tawh phu ka la ding hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa thu gen bang ahei ngai in: Dingin muolsangte mai-ah na thu sung inlen, na aw muoltangte zasah in.","title":"Pasien in Israel a Tawhna"},"2":{"text":"No muolsangte le a kip leitung bulpite aw, Topa in mi a nielna ngai vawi un; azieh pen a mite tawh Topa thu kiniel a, Israel-te tawh thu kisel ding hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ka mite aw, note bang kang law ahei? kang bangci lungkhamsah ahei? ei dawng vawi un!"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Egypt gam panin kang peipi to a, saltanna inn panin kang tankhie hi; na mai vuah Moses, Aaron, le Miriam-te kang sawl hi.","ref":"Pei 4:10-16; 12:50-51; 15:20"},"5":{"text":"Ka mite aw, Moab Kumpipa Balak in bang teng na gel a, Beor’ tapa Balaam in bang na ci dawnkia-in, Topa’ hutdamna nasepte na thei nadingun, Shittim panin Gilgal dongah bang thu na pieng ahei, ci tu-in phawhkia un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 22:2–24:25; Josh 3:1–4:19"},"6":{"text":"“ Topa mai-ah bang tawh va pei-in, a sangpen Pasien mai-ah bang tawh va kun ding ka hei? Meihal biehnate le kumkhat a pha bawngno tawh a mai-ah va pei ding ka mah?","title":"Pasien in Bang Kalh (Amos 5:24)"},"7":{"text":"Tuutang tulkhat, gun tulsawm dim sathau tawh Topa lungkim ding amah? Ka tatkhielna ziehin ka tapa tapen le, ka hla’ mawna ga ziehin ka hinsa ka ta pie ding ka mah?” ka ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing aw, ama in bang pen hoi ahei, ci ang genzo ta hi; tuale thu tanga khen ding le migit ding deigaw-in, kiniemkhiehin na Pasien tawh na zawton ding ci simlo nang tungah Topa in bang ang kalh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Khuopi sungah Topa’ kiko a, (na min zatahna pen pilna tahtah ahi hi): Minam le khuopi sunga ang kikhawmte aw , za vawi un!","title":"Guhtatna le Tatsietna Dan Kipie ding"},"10":{"text":"Migilote’ inn sunga om gitlona tawh a kinga goute le a kisamsie tawitena themkhatte mangngil thei ding ka mah?"},"11":{"text":"A gihna man lo tawikhainate le a tena a man lo ip a zangte ka mawh koi ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Na mihaute uh tatsietna tawh kidim hi; na khuosung mite in zuouthu vive a gen vua, a kam sung vua a leite uzong zuouthu tawh a kidim hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ziehin na mawnate ziehun hing sat gawpin, a hawmkieu- a kang opsah ding uh ka kipan ta hi."},"14":{"text":"An na neh mawh vangun na kham sih ding vua, na sung vuah na gil uh a kiel zing ding hi; khol zong nan locin na kemcing sih ding vua, na kepsunte uzong namsau tungah ka pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na tu mawh vangun na at sih ding uhi; Olive ga na cil mawh vangun, sathau na si sih ding uhi; lengga na cil mawh vangun, na dawnkha sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen Omri’ ngaina kip teng le Ahab innkuon’ gamtat zosie na kemcing vua, a thumop zosie na zui uhi.
