Tua ahi ziehin a hawmkieu-in hing koi-in, na sunga a teng mite’ ehneh ho-in ka bawl ding hi; tuaci’n ka mite’ kisimmawna na thuoh ding uhi.","ref":"1Kum 16:23-34; 21:25-26"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gim ngapa hi tang e! Bangzieh ahei cile, khal lai-a singga a kilaw zaw le, lengga sangh a kikhop zaw ka bang ta a, ka neh ding lengga bawh ka mu ta sih hi; ka dugaw thei min masa zong a om ta sih hi.","title":"Mite Kisietsiengna"},"2":{"text":"Gam sung panin mi citahte a mangthai ta vua, mi thuman koima a om nawn sih hi; sisan suo nadingin mi a buh kawikawi vua, khatlekhat lenthang a kisie uhi."},"3":{"text":"A sie bawl ding pen a khut siem thei mama uhi; uliente le thukhente in guhgol a ngen vua, thuneite in amau’ dei teng a kigen vazieu uhi; tua ci bangin amate in thutang a lehei vazieu uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mihoi pena kineite ling tawh kibang a, thuman pena kineite daithaw-imna ling tawh kibang hi. Amau’ galvilte ni, amau’ dan thuoh ding ni, ang tung zo hi; tu-in amau’ buoizah hun ang nai mama ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Na guolpa muong sinlen, na itte zong muong sin; na angkawi na zi tung panin na kam kotkhahte kemcing in;"},"6":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile tapa in a pa simmaw bawlin, tanu in a nu langpan a, a monu in a innpi nu a langpan hi; na innkuonpi teng ma na gal a suoh hi.","ref":"Mat 10:35-36; Luk 12:53"},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin kei ka hile Topa ka en ding a, ka hutdamna Pasien ka lamen lenlon ding hi; ka Pasien in kei ei za ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka galpa aw, kei tungah kipah sin; ka pua ciengin ka thokia lel ding hi; khuomiel ah ka to ciengin, Topa pen khuovah ahi ding hi.","title":"Kisiakiana le Pasien Muonna"},"9":{"text":"Ama tungah ka maw zo ziehin kei lamah ama hing pangin, ama in kei adingin thu a khen masangsie, Topa’ lungthahna ka thuoh kul ding hi. Ama in kei khuovah ah ei peipi ding hi; ama in dih ei tansahna ka mu ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka galte in mu-in, ka kungah, “Na Pasien hei-a om ahei?” ci-a ei dong nu maizumna in khucip ding hi. Ka mit in ama’ puana mu ding hi; lamdunga buonnawi a kitotcil bangin tu-in ama kituoncil ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na kulbang a kicienkia ni ang tung ta hi! Khum ni ciengin gamgi kigolkeh mama ding hi.","title":"Angai Bahkia nading Kamsanna"},"12":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Assyria gam panin Egypt gam dong, Egypt gam panin Gunpi dong, tuipi khat pan tuipi khat dong, muolsang khat pan muolsang khat dongin, nangma kungah amate ang pei ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin a tunga teng mite le amau’ sepna ga ziehin, leitung gamkhing le gamdai suoh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na ciengkhut tawh na mite tuu bangin cing in, nangma-a’ ahi na tuuhonte, um lei laikim gamlahah a guohtangun teng uhi. Tanglai hun ma bangin Bashan le Gilead ah amate an maisah in."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gam pan nang peito lai bangin, na lamdangte ko ei lah in."},"16":{"text":"Minamte in a mu ding vua, amau’ thahatna zosie a zumpi ding uhi; a kam sung vuah a khut uh koi-in, a bil uh a bing ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Gul bangin leivui a lieh ding vua, leitunga a bawhva teng tawh kibang ding uhi; a kulpite panun citun kawmin ang pusuoh ding uhi; a zau seng ziehun Topa i Pasien lam ang kihei ding vua, amate in note zong ang giing ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nangma’ neisa a omlai teng’ khielna maisahin, amau’ thupalsatnate a maisah thei nang bang Pasien a om amah? Hepina lah ding ama dei lam ahi ziehin, kumtawnin ama a lungthah zing sih hi.","title":"Pasien’ Lainatna le a Itna Kip"},"19":{"text":"Ama in eite tungah lainatna ei neikia ding hi; i mawnate uzong a keng nei-ah tuoncil ding hi. Kote’ mawna zosie, tuipi thuh sungah na sepmang ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tangtawng panin ka pu ka pate tunga na ciem bangin, Jacob tungah thumanna le Abraham tungah a kip citahna na lah ding hi."}}}}},"34":{"info":{"name":"Nahum","shortname":"Nah","abbr":[],"desc":"Nahum laibu (the book of nahum)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam pen Nineveh tawh kisai thuphuon hi a, Elkosh khuomi Nahum’ mangmuna laibu ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa pen a thangsie le phulah hat Pasien ahi a, Topa in phula a, a lungthah mama hi; ama a langpangte tungah Topa in phu la a, a galte tungah ama a thangpai hi.","title":"A Nasie Pasien’ Lungthahna"},"3":{"text":"Topa lungthah bai loin, ahi vangin vanglien mama a, tuale Topa in a khielte dan pieh loin mawh hla lo ding hi. A lampi pen pingpei lah le huipi lah ahi a, meiilumte pen a ketot leivui ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in tuipi hosie-in kanggawsah a, gun zosie a kanggawsah hi; Bashan le Carmel muolte gawta a, Lebanon paape vulnang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama mai-ah muolte kiling a, muoltangte a tuisuoh hi; ama mai-ah leitang, leitung le a sunga a teng zosie a kilawh uhi."},"6":{"text":"A thangpaina mai-ah koi ding zo ding ahei? A lungthahna koi in thuoh zo ding ahei? Meikuong bangin a thangpaina kisung a, ama ziehin suongpite a pawhkeh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa hoi a, lungkham hunin kibuhna mun muonhuoi ahi hi; ama sunga a kibu mite ama in a humbih a,"},"8":{"text":"tuikhang sung nangawnah a langte mangthaisah ding a, khuomiel lahah a galte a delmang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang dinga Topa na do sawm ahei? Ama in maimangsah ding a, a langte koima nivei dingkia zo lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate ling bangin kikanbawmin, lenggazu khamte bangin a om vua, butu gawta bangin a katum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Nang kung panin Topa a langpan dingin, thusie bawl sawm mi khat pusuoh zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin ci hi, “Amate bangci hatin hatin tam zong nan ule, amate kisusie-in a mangthai veve ding uhi. Keima in kang bawlsiet ngai vangin, kang bawlsie nawn sih ding hi.","title":"Judah ading Lungdamna Thu"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in na tung panin ama’ hahkol ka hliehtawng ding a, ang kikhina khaute ka botsan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in nang tawh kisai thupie zo hi: “Na min kizom suoh nawn lo ding hi; na pasien-te’ inn panin a bawltawm milim le a kisung milim ka sumaimang ding hi. Kimanna nei lo na hi ziehin na hankhuh ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Muolte tungah lungdamna thu a puoh, kilemna a phuongzah mipa’ keng en un! Judah aw, na pawite bawl inlen, na kiciemnate uh tangtungsah in, azieh pen migilote in ang sim ngai nawn sih ding hi; amate kisumaimang zo hi.","ref":"Isa 52:7"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang ang sim dingin a susie ding pa khat ang kuonto zo ta hi. Na kul cing inlen, lampi zong vil in; a kawng gah inlen, na tha nei zosie san in.","title":"A Gilo Khuopi Kisuhsietna"},"2":{"text":"(Azieh pen a susie mite in amate susie-in amau’ baate a suhsiet vangun, Topa in Israel’ thupina bangin Jacob’ thupina zong a ngai bangsahkia ding hi.)"},"3":{"text":"A galhangte’ lumte khu a san ahi hi; a galkapte in puonsan a sil uhi, Gal sim dingin amate a kiguolsah ni-in sakol leengte tunga siate te lihleh hi; gal sakolte in gal sim ding ngahla-in a keng uh a sai vapial uhi."},"4":{"text":"Gawldung cin tengah sakol leengte a mot tai vua, tuol-awng tengah amate suhtai totai kawikawi uhi; a melpuoh uh meisel kuong tawh kibang a, tunphe bangin a phe leplep uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a uliente hlan hi; mailamah a pei ciengun kipalpua uhi; kulpi a kidenna vua, a lum utawh a kidal uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gun tunkotte kihong a, kumpi innpi kiling hi."},"7":{"text":"Sala pei dingin khuopi thukip kipie a, a sila numeite kikaimangin, vahui bangin mau-in a awm a beng uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nineveh khuopi pen a tuite a kang sieng buol tawh kibang hi. “Khawl un! Khawl un!” a kici vangin koima kinuahei lo hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ngunte lahpieh unlen, khamte lahpieh un! A goute un tawp hun nei lo hi! Van manpha cinteng tam valuh sam e!” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Suhsietna, hawmsuona, le kisietna! Lung tawpin khupte tun a, kawng zosie kilingin, maitang zosie a muolmang hi!"},"11":{"text":"Koima in nawngkaisah loin, humpite le humpi note a va kawikawina mun khu hei sungah om a, humpite kuo le humpi khanglaite’ leihawm bang suoh a ta ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Humpi in a note adingin a khamkhop ding uh sa ehmal a, humpi anute adingin a samat a lawlmeh pieh hi; leihawm sungah sa dimsah a, a ki-ehmal satelte tawh a kuo sung kidimsah hi."},"13":{"text":"En in, nang kang langpang hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Keima in na sakol leengte haltumin meikhu kitung ding a, namsau tawh na humpi khanglaite ka vatmai ding hi; leitung panin na kiva nading sate ka sumaimang ding a, tuale na kamtaite’ awging kiza ngai nawn lo ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sisan luonna khuopi, zuouna le van lahpiehna tawh a kidim, misuomte a ven lona khuopi aw! gimna na thuoh ding hi!","title":"A Kipel Theilo Sietna tungbai ding"},"2":{"text":"Sakol kisat ging le lengkang kigawt ging, sakol koptaite ketot ging le sakol leeng kitomte ging khu!"},"3":{"text":"Sakol galkapte in a phe valeh namsau le a tee lihleh teipite tawh gal a do vua, a kiseng misi lomtang teng, tuolluong lum misi teng, misi luongte a tawp thei sih a, siluongte tungah a kipai uhi!"},"4":{"text":"Tamte zosie simzawh lo, numei pahtat nu’ a thanghuoi gamtatna zieha pieng hi a, ama etlawmin ngaibang a, mibum siemnu zong ahi a, mi thangtatnate’ tungtawn le a mi bumna tungtawnin ama in minamte salin a bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang kang langpan hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi, na maitangah na nih ka lemto ding hi; tua hile minamte in guohtanga na opna le kumpi gamte in na zumhuoina kang ensah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A kidahhuoi buathah tawh kang sep ding a, hing simmaw bawlin, mite’ et dingin kang bawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ang mu zosie nuakinin, “Nineveh khuopi kisie ta hi; koi in ama a kaa ta ding ahei? Ang henem ding mi hei-ah sui ding ka hei?” ci ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nile gun gei-ah om a, tui in a kimkot, a leicien tuipi le a kulpi tui ahi, Thebes sangin nang a thupizaw na hi amah?"},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia le Egypt zong ciengtan nei lo ama’ thahatna ahi hi; Put mite le Libya mite pen ama a panpite ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle ama gambel a suoh a, saltang dingin a pei hi; gawlzin bul cintengah a tasente nangawn a ki-ehmal hi; a miliente adingin ai kisan a, a mithupi zosie siakol kibul hi."},"11":{"text":"Nang zong zu khamin a kiphuol dingin na pei ding a, galte kung panin kibuhna na sui ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na kulpite zosie a ga a min masa pen theikung bang ding a, a kithin leh a ne ding pa’ kam sungah tuate a kiesuh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na galkapte en in: Na mai-ah amate numei ahi uhi. Na galte adingin na gam tunkotte a kigol hon mama hi; na tunkotgolh zawlte mei in a katum ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Ei ki-im hun sung teng adingin tui tawi-in na kulpite detsah in; tehlei khen nadingin buon pawi inlen, tehlei kisehna kuong a baisa-in koi in!"},"15":{"text":"Khum munah mei in hing katumin, namsau in nang ang bansan ding hi. tua in kauphe bangin ang netum ding hi. Kauphe bangin na khang a, khuombai bangin na pung hi!"},"16":{"text":"Na sumbuhte vana aasi sanga a tamzaw dingin na khangsah hi. Kauphe in a vun khelin a lengmang ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang ang cingte ahile, khuombai tawh a kibang vua, na laitheite, khuodam ni-a daithaw tunga a tu, nisuo cienga a lengmang kauphe hon tawh kibang uhi; amau’ tunna le banna mun koima in thei lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa aw, na tuucingte a kimu uhi; na mi thupite a lusu uhi. Muol tungah na mite a kithezah vua, a khawmtuo ding koima om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Na liemna a nuom tuomsah ding mi a om sih a, na hima pen a dam thei lo nam ahi hi. Na thu a za mi zosie in a khut a beng ding uhi. Azieh pen a tawp thei lo na gitlona panin koi suohta ngai ahei?","ref":"Isa 10:5-34; 14:24-27; Zeph 2:13-15"}}}}},"35":{"info":{"name":"Habakkuk","shortname":"Hab","abbr":[],"desc":"Habakkuk laibu (the book of habakkuk)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kamsang Habakkuk in a mu thuphuon."},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei huna hing ngenin, ei ngai loin om ding na hei? Na kungah, “Tatsietna!” ci-in kang kiko ciengin, ei hun lo ding na hi amah?","title":"Kamsang pa’ Phunna"},"3":{"text":"Bang dingin gamtat khielnate le gimnate, ei musah na hei? Ka mai-ah kisietna le tatsietnate om a, kihauna le kiselnate a pieng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n thukham thanem a, thutang in guolzo ngai lo hi. Migilote in mi thumante imtawm uhi; tua ziehin thukhenna kilehei hi."},"5":{"text":"Minamte enin mu vawi un! Lamdang sa un! Amtum un! Bangzieh ahei cile na kung vuah hing kigen nanle, na up lo ding uh nasep khat no hun sungin ka sem hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:41"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in a hangsan le a nawtat ahi Chaldea-te ka vangliensah ding a, amau-a’ ahi lo tenna munte a la dingin, leitung muncin tengah a pei uhi.","ref":"2Kum 24:2"},"7":{"text":"Amate zatah huoi-in giinhuoi mama uhi; amate kung panin a thudihna ule a kithupisahna uh a pusuoh hi."},"8":{"text":"A sakolte uh kamkei sangin gangzaw a, khuomiel kuona gam-uite sangin giinhuoizaw hi; a sakolte un thakhahtin a sim uhi. Gamlapi panin a sakol galkapte ang pei uhi; sa man dinga ang nawlen muvanlai tawh kibang uhi."},"9":{"text":"A tatsie dingin a unpi-un ang pei vua, mai lam nawtin ang kuon uhi; amate in senel bangin gal kimante a khawm uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpite a ciemmui bawl vua, gam-uhte apmaina-in a nei uhi. Amate in kulpi zosie a nuisan lel vua, kulpi lah nadingin lei a sungvum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in huipi lang bangin a nawtsuoh uhi; amate in a palsat vua, khielna neite a suoh uhi; amau’ thahatna pen amau’ pasien ahi hi!"},"12":{"text":"Topa ka Pasien, keima’ Siengtho Pa aw, nang tangtawng pan hi lo na hi amah? Nang na si sih ding hi. Topa aw, thukhenna thuoh dingin, amate na melci zo ta hi; suongpi aw, dan thuoh dingin, amate na se zo ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Gitlona et nadingin na mitcim mama a, khielna na en thei sih hi; bang dingin a zuoutatte na et thei vanuh a, migilote in amate sanga thuman zawte a pumval ciengun zong, a ham loin om na hi ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Nangma in tuipi sungah nga bangin mite na bawl a, amate pen uhpa a nei lo a awma kithol ganhingte tawh a kibang uhi."},"15":{"text":"A galpa in amate a unpi-in ngakuoi tawh a kai hi; ama in a len tawh khu-in tuate kaidawh a, a ngawilen sungah ama in tuate a khol hi; tuaci’n ama kipahin a lungdam mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama in a len kungah siem thoi a, a ngawilen kungah ama in biehnate a pie hi; azieh pen amate ziehin a tanh kicing a, a an a tui hi."},"17":{"text":"Hepina nei loin ama in minamte susie-in, a lente hawmsuoh sah ding amah?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka galvilna tausang tungah dingin, leicien tungah ka pang ding hi; ama in keima kungah bang ei gen ding a, ama in ka phunna tungtang bang ei ci dawnkia ding ahei, ci ka en ding hi.","title":"Pasien in Kamsangpa Phunna Dawngkia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in kei ei dawng hi: A tai mipa khat’ sim thei dingin suongpehte tungah a kicienin, tua mangmuna giel in;"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen a kise hun adingin mangmuna khat om lai hi; tua in hun tawp ding thu gen ding a, zuou lo ding hi. A kiheh tuoh lezong ngah in; ang tung valon ding a, ang kiheh sih ding hi.","ref":"Heb 10:37"},"4":{"text":"Mi kisatheite en vawi! A lungsim puoh uh a man sih hi, ahi vangin midihte ahi uleh amau’ upna ziehin a hing ding uhi.","ref":"Rom 1:17; Gal 3:11; Heb 10:38"},"5":{"text":"Tua banah hauna a zuou thei hi; mi kiliensahte kip lo hi. Misikhuo bangin a lawlte uh gol hi; amate in Sina ma bangin pha zo, ci hun a nei ngai sih uhi. Amate adingin minam zosie a khawmtuo vua, amau-a’ bangin minam zosie a kaikhawm uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi zosie in tua bang mite pen simmawna kam ahi thu hahsate tawh a tawh vua, “Amau-a’ ahi lopi nei le lam a vum a vala kholte in gimna a thuoh ding hi!” ci-in amate thu gen lo ding uh amah? Ang kipong vante tawh bang tanvei no le no hau sawm na hi uh ahei?","title":"Migilote’ Gimna"},"7":{"text":"Na sum ang leitawite thakhatin ang kuonin, hing phongin, hing citunsah lo ding uh amah? Tua ciengin amau’ tomgam van na suoh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Minam tampite bulu zo na hi ziehin, a hinglai mi zosie in nang ang bulu ding hi. Leitunga khuopite le a sunga teng zosie tungah tatsietna tawh na bawl zieh le mi sisan na suosah ziehin, nang ang kibulu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na innsung adingin a man lo tawh sum a nga, sietna in ang bat lo nadingin a sangna muna bu a tom nang in gimna na thuoh ding hi!” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampi suhsietna tawh na innsung maizum nading gelin na hinna na tanlaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Kul panin suongte kiko ding a, innsingte panin a kizut za in dawngkia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Sisan suona tawh khuopi a lam le khielna tawh khuopi a sat nang in gimna na thuoh ding hi!” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Mei kahvam ding bepin mite in na a sem vua, minamte in kimanna a nei lo, gim nading bepa a sep uh pen, Vanglien Topa kung pana ang pei hi lo amah?"},"14":{"text":"Hinanle tuite in tuipi a tuom bangin, Topa’ minthanna theitheina tawh leitung a kidim ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:9"},"15":{"text":"“A guohtanga a op uh na et nop ziehin na innvengte zu tekhamin, a kham masangsie uh na lungthahna a buohsuh nang in gimna na thuoh ding hi!” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Minthanna tangin simmawna tawh nang na kilungkimsah ding hi. Nang le nang in dawn inlen zukhamin hawipua in! Topa’ ziet lama hai na tungah ang tung ding a, na minthanna tungah maizumna ang tung ding hi!"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen leitunga khuopite le a sunga tengte zosie, tatsietna tawh a kibawl zieh le mihing sisan a kisuo ziehin, Lebanon tunga a kibawl tatsietna in ang nuoicip ding a, ganhingte kisuhsietna in nang ang zausah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hunkhat lai-in a bawlpa in a lem milim khu bangin kimang a, a kikhengtawm zuou milimte le zuou thuhil siete bangin kimang ahei? Azieh pen a bawlpa in a piensah na pen a ham thei lo milim khat ahi lel vangin, a bawlsa na tungah ama in muonna a nei hi!"},"19":{"text":"Sing kungah, “Khanglo ven!” ci-in, a ham theilo suong kungah, “Tho ven!” a ci pa in gimna a thuoh ding hi! Tua in a hil thei ding amah? En in, tua khu ngun le kham tawh kizut ahi a, a sungah hinna hu a om sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin a inn sungah Topa om a, ama mai-ah leitung zosie sip dide-in om ta uheh!"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shigionoth in a genna dung zui-a kamsang Habakkuk thungetna."},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, na minthanna ka za zo a, Topa aw, na silbawlte lamdang ka sa mama hi. Ko hunin hing thasuosah inlen, ko hunin hing kitheisah in; na thangpai ciengin na hepina phawh in.","title":"Kamsangpa’ Thungetna"},"3":{"text":"Teman pan Pasien ang pei a, Paran Muol panin Siengtho Pa ang pei hi. Selah A minthanna in vante tuom a, ama kiphatna leitung a dim hi."},"4":{"text":"A vangtang ni tawh kibang hi; a khut panin nizangte kikhaw a, khum munah a vanglietna a kiphuol hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama mai-ah gimna pei a, pulnatna in a zui hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama khawlin leitung lawh hi; ama in en a, minamte citunsah hi. Tangtawng muolte a pawhkeh hi; ama’ tanglai lampi dung tengah kumtawn muoltangte tumsuh hi."},"7":{"text":"Cush-te’ puonbuhte sungah gimna ka mu hi; Midian gam puonbuh dalnate kithing hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, gunte tungah na lung thah amah? Ahi sihle na sakolte tungah tuongin na sakol leengte in gal a zaw ciengin, gunte tungah lungthahin tuipi tungah na thang a pai amah?"},"9":{"text":"Na thallawng hawm na vih a, na thupiehna tawh thaltangte tamin na dei nawn sih hi. Selah leitung gunte tawh na khenkhie hi."},"10":{"text":"Muolte in nang hing mu-in kizieltum uhi; tuikhang a kihot valuh hi; tui thuhpite a hawh vapuoh uhi. Ni in a sangna lamah a khutte lamto hi."},"11":{"text":"A kikhaw na thaltang kap le a tee lingleng na teipi ziehin, a thupi mama a opna-ah hlapi a dinkhawl hi."},"12":{"text":"A sinsosa-in leitungah na pei a, lungthahsa-in minamte na tuoncil hi."},"13":{"text":"Na mite hundam dingin na pei a, na sathau kinoite hundam dingin na kuon hi. A gilo inn sunga a makai pa na guoicimsah a, a khuombul panin a innkhum dongin na hawhmang hi. Selah"},"14":{"text":"Kote ei thethang dinga huipi banga ang kuon a galhangte’ lutang khu ama’ thaltangte ma tawh na sun pailet a, a kiphuol mizawngte netum dinga a baisa-a om bangin na lung a dam hi."},"15":{"text":"Na sakolte tawh tuipi na tuoncil a, tui lienpite kilawh gawp hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima in za-in ka sung a tun hi; tua a ging in ka nephu a tunsah hi. Ka gu ka tang teng a muot ding bang a, ka keng neilam tun dildel hi, keima in ei dote tunga a tung ding gentheina ni ka ngah khinkhian hi."},"17":{"text":"Theigate hut siengin, lenggate ga sih nanleh; olive kungte ga loin, lo-ah an pieng sih nanleh; tuubuh sunga tuute si siengin, ganbuh sunga gante om sih nanleh;","title":"Lungkhamna Kawmkalah Muonna le Kipahna"},"18":{"text":"Topa sungah ka kipah veve ding a, ka hundampa ka Pasien tungah ka lungdam veve ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa Pasien pen ka thahatna ahi hi; Ama in ka kengte sazuhpi keng bangsah a, mun sangte ei tuonsah hi. La makai pa kungah: A gui nei tumgingte tawh.","ref":"2Sam 22:34; Late 18:33"}}}}},"36":{"info":{"name":"Zephaniah","shortname":"Zeph","abbr":[],"desc":"Zephaniah laibu (the book of zephaniah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Amon’ tapa Josiah Kumpipa hun laitahin Hezekiah’ tapa Amariah, Amariah’ tapa Gedaliah, Gedaliah’ tapa Cushi, Cushi’ tapa Zephaniah kungah Topa’ kammal a tung hi.","ref":"2Kum 22:1–23:30; 2Khg 34:1–35:27"},"2":{"text":"Lei maitang panin na vannuoi ka phietmai ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"Judah kunga a tung ding Thukhenna"},"3":{"text":"Mihingte le ganhingte ka phietmai ding hi; vana leng vate le tuipi sunga ngate ka phietmai ding a, migilote ka kipaisah ding hi. Lei maitang panin mihingte ka sumaimang ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Judah langkhatah ka khut zahin, Jerusalem-a teng zosie langkhatah ka khut ka zah ding hi. Tam mun panin Baal a omlai zosie le milim biehna siempute’ min,"},"5":{"text":"inn khumvum tungah tuongin vantung na zosie bie-in a kunte, Topa tungah kiciem napi Milcom pasien tunga zong a kiciem mite,"},"6":{"text":"Topa zuina panin kinua hei-in Topa a sui lote, ahi sihle ama thu a dong lote, ka sumaimang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa Pasien mai-ah sip khinkhian un; bang ding ahei cile Topa’ ni ang nai ta hi. Topa in biehpiehna siem zo a, ama in a zinte siensuo zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ biehpieh ni-in kumpi uliente, kumpi’ tapate le, gamdang puon tawh a kizem zosie dan ka tuohsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin sangkil kan zosie, tatsietna le zuouthu tawh a pu pa’ innsung a kidimsah zosie, dan ka tuohsah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Nga Tunkot panin kaana awging, Veng Nina panin mauna le muoltangte panin sil kisukha a ging vapuoh kiza ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Mortar Venga tengte aw, kap unlen mau un. Bangzieh ahei cile sumbawlte a kisie sieng ta vua, ngun tawi a te mite zosie kisumaimang zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin Jerusalem, meivah tawh ka long ding a, amate in a te uh ahi ngunte tungah nuomtaha a om hit hiet mite, a lungsim sung vuah, “ Topa in na hoi sem loin, sietna zong sem lo ding hi,” a cite dan ka pie ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amau’ neisate kisutmang ding a, a innte uzong kisie gawp ding hi. Amate in innte lam nan ule a sungah a teng sih ding uhi; amate in lenggui suon nan ule a zu a dawnkha sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa’ ni thupi ni ang nai ta a, ang nai a, ang kinaw mama hi. Topa’ ni husa gin awging khu a thuoh hamsa mama a, khum munah galhangte a awng vapuoh uhi.","title":"Ni Thupi Ni (Amos 5:18-20)"},"15":{"text":"Khum ni pen thangpai ni, lungkham sinkham ni, manthai ni le kisiet ni, khuo miel ni le lungzin ni, meiipite kai-in khuo a miel keikui ni,"},"16":{"text":"kulpi nei khuopite le a thupi gal panna munte sim nadinga pengkul kimut ni le, gal kikap kikona ni ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima in mite tungah tua bang lungkhamna ka tungsah ding a, amate pen mittaw lam pei tawh a kibang ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile Topa tungah a khiel zo uhi. Leivui bangin amau’ sisan kisungsuh ding a, tuale a tahsate uh pen eh tawh kibang ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ thangpai ni ciengin, a ngun le a khamte un hunkhie zo lo ding a, a thangpaina meikuong sungah leitung bup katum ding hi; ama in leitunga teng mi zosie tungah a zauhuoi manthaina a tungsah ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A maizum thei lo minamte aw, kikhawmtuo unlen,","title":"Israel’ Galte tunga Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"ansi a kisep mang bangin ang kisemang masang, Topa’ lungthahna le Topa’ thangpaina ni, na tung vuah ang tun masangin, kikhawm un."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ thupieh bang semin a kiniemkhieh gammi zosie aw, Topa sui un. Dihna sui unlen, nunnemna zong sui un; Topa’ thangpai ni ciengin ang kiphuol zo thei kha ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Gaza kitaisan ding a, Ashkelon hawmsuoh ding hi; suntang laipi-in Ashdod-te kidelmangin, Ekron kiphungkal ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a a teng no Chereth-te in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Philistia-te gam Canaan aw, Topa’ kammal in na langkhatah thu a gen hi; a teng ding koima khat zong a kinuasie lo dongin, nangma kang susie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a gam aw, nang pen gan cinna mun, tuucingte adingin lonona mun le tuuhuong na hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Judah innkuon a omlaite in tuipi gei-a om gam a tang ding vua, amate in khum munah gante cingin nitah lam ciengin Ashkelon-a a innte sung vuah amate a lum ding uhi. Azieh pen Topa a Pasien un amate ve ding a, a nei a lam teng uh a ngai bangin a kipiekia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zech 9:5-7"},"8":{"text":"Moab-te’ zakona, Ammon-te’ mi gensietna, ka mite a zakona ule, amau’ gam sim dinga a kisah thei hamte uh ka za zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima a nungta Israel’ Pasien, Vanglien Topa ka hi ma bangin, Moab-te khu Sodom bang ding a, Ammon-te, Gomorrah bangin, lahkhaite le cikhuhte in a gam sung uh luo ding a, kumtawna a kinuasie mun a suoh den ta ding hi. Ka mi a omlai teng in amau’ neisate a lahpieh ding vua, ka minam a hing laite in amau’ gam a luo ding uhi.","ref":"Pien 19:24"},"10":{"text":"Vanglien Topa’ mite simmaw-in a kilietsah ziehun, amau’ kiletsahna zieha a thuoh ding uh gimna tami hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate adingin Topa pen giinhuoi mama ding hi; leitung pasien-te zosie kizieltumsah ding a, minamte’ tuipi gam le tuikul gam zosie in a mun ciet uh panin ama a bie ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 15:1–16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1–49:6; Ezk 21:28-32; 25:1-11; Amos 1:13-15"},"12":{"text":"Ethiopia-te aw, note zong ka namsau tawh ang kithat ding hi.","ref":"Isa 18:1-7"},"13":{"text":"Tuale ama in leilu lam langkhatah a khut zahin, Assyria susie ding hi. Nineveh gamkhing suohsah ding a, senel gam bangin a gawta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A sungah ganhonte le gamsa vannuoi a lum ding uhi. Senel gam simbu le a hamging simbute in innkhuom dawnte giena-in a nei ding uhi. Tawlet ah simbu ham ding a, sangkilah va-ah ham ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Keima sim lo adang koi om ahei?” ama le ama kici-in, lungmuong taha a teng, lungdama a kipah khuopi hi lo amah? Bang dingin gamlah suohin, gamsate kuolna ahi ta vanuh adiei! Khum mun a zawt kha poma in ehneh ho-in khut a lelu uhi.","ref":"Isa 10:5-34; 14:24-27; Nah 1:1–3:19"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi a niehsah, a kidahhuoi, mi a bawlsie khuopi in gimna a thuoh ding hi!","title":"Jerusalem’ Gitlona"},"2":{"text":"Tua khuopi in koima aw a ngai sih hi; thuhilna zong a sang sih hi. Ama in Topa muong loin, a Pasien kung a nai sih hi."},"3":{"text":"A sunga uliente ahile a hawh vapuoh humpite ahi vua, a thukhente ahi ule zingmawng donga bangma hen a nei lo, a zanva ngiete ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"A kamsangte uzong ngaisutna le upna nei lote ahi uhi; a siempute in a siengtho nate buasahin, thukham tungah a tatsie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khuopi sungah Topa a dih hi; ama in khielna kici a bawl sih hi. Zingmawng sielin a thukhen nasep sem a, phalvah sielin a sem valon hi; ahi vangin mi thuman lote in maizum zie a thei sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in minamte ka sumang zo a, a galpanna munte uh kisie sieng zo hi; a sungah koima a pei thei lo nadingin, a khuolai lampite uh ka susie zo hi; a khuopite vuah a teng ding mi om lo a, a hawmkieu-in kikoi hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in, “Tua khuopi in ei giing valon ding a, tua khuopi in thuhilna a mang ding hi; a tunga ka tunsah na zosie a mangngil sih ding hi,” ka ci hi. Ahi vangin a sepna zosie vuah a sie lam sep ding thalawp zaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ziehin teci-a ka din ni dongin keima ei ngah in, Topa in ci hi, azieh pen amate tungah ka thangpaina le ka sinsona zosie, ka sunsuh thei nadingin, minamte kaikhawmin kumpi gamte ka khoptuo ding pen keima’ thu khensat ahi hi. Azieh pen ka lungthahna meikuong sungah leitung zosie katum ding hi.","title":"Minamte Danpiehna le Kikhelna (Pien 11:1-9 ; Sawl 2:1-11)"},"9":{"text":"Tuami hun ciengin amate zosie in Topa’ min loin, lung kihuol a ama’ na a sep thei nadingun, keima in minamte’ kamham, ham siengtho tawh ka khelpieh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima kunga thu a ngente, a kithethang ka mite in Ethiopia gungal panin ka biehna ang puoh ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khumi ni ciengin nei ledona na sepna zosie ziehin kang maizumsah sih ding hi; bang ding ahei cile tua ciengin kiphatsahna nuom a sa mite, na kung panin ka hemkhie ding a, ka muol siengtho tungah na kiliensah nawn sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na laikimah mi nunnem le mi neilutte ka nuasie ding hi. Amate in Topa’ min tawh kibuhna a sui ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Israel a omlai teng in khielna bawl nawn loin, zuouthu a gen nawn sih ding vua, a kam sung vuah zuouthu a gen lei a kimu nawn sih ding hi. Tua ciengin an ne-in a lum hit hiet ding vua, koima in amate a zausah nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Kln 14:5"},"14":{"text":"Zion tanu aw, nahpi tahin la sa in; Israel aw, awng vapo in! Jerusalem tanu aw, na lungsim neiza tawh lungdamin kipah in!","title":"Lungnopna La"},"15":{"text":"Topa in na tunga thukhennate lamang zo a, na galte a nawmang zo hi. Na laizangah Israel kumpi Topa a om hi; nang in gimna na giing nawn sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Jerusalem kungah tam bang kici ding hi: Zion aw, zau sin; na khut thazawsah sin."},"17":{"text":"Topa na Pasien, na laizangah a om hi, ama galhang pa ahi a, guolzawna ang pie ding hi; na tungah ama kipahin lungdam ding a, ama’ itna sungah nang ang siemtha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pawi bawl ni bangin nahpitah lasahna tawh, nangma tungah ama a lungdam ding hi. Ama ziehin maw na puoh lo nadingin, na kung panin gimna ka ladawh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin ang bawlsiete zosie dan ka pie ding hi. Khelbaite hundamin, a kipampaite ka khawm ding a, a maizumna uh phatna tawh khelpiehin, leitung muncin tengah minthang ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khum huna kang khop ciengin, inn ah kang peipi ding hi; azieh pen a ngai bangin nangma muna-ah hamphatnate kang piehkia ciengin, keima in leitung mi zosie lahah na min ka thangsah ding a, mite in kang patawisah ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}}}},"37":{"info":{"name":"Haggai","shortname":"Hag","abbr":[],"desc":"Haggai laibu (the book of haggai)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Darius in kumpi a sep kum ni a cin kum, a hla guhna, a ni masa ni-in kamsang Haggai tungtawnin Judah gam uhpa, Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le siempu lien pa Jehozadak’ tapa Joshua kungah Topa’ thu tam bangin a tung hi:","title":"Biehinnpi Lam ding Thupiehna","ref":"Ezr 4:24–5:2; 6:14"},"2":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tam mite in Topa’ inn lamkia ding hun nai lo hi, a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsang Haggai tungah Topa’ thu tungin tam bangin a gen hi:"},"4":{"text":"Tam innpi kisie gawpin a op laitahin inn hoipipi sungah na ten ding hun ma uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Tua ziehin tu-in Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na opdan uh kingaisun un."},"6":{"text":"Khaici tampi na tu vua, an tawmno khat beh na la uhi; an na neh vangun na gil uh a va ngai sih hi; na dawn vangun na khamin na dawn ngai sih uhi; puonsil ding na nei vangun koima in lum na sa sih uhi; tuale sum thalaw pa in sum-ip tawvang khat sungah a koi dinga a thalaw ahi lel bo hi."},"7":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Na opdan uh kingaisun pha un."},"8":{"text":"Tua sungah keima nuomtahin tengin ei kipatawi thei nadingin muol tungah kato-in sing va sui ta unlen, inn lam un, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Note in tampitah na lamet vangun halno khat beh a pha hi; tuale innah tuate na tut uh ciengin kang semmang pieh ding hi. Vanglien Topa in bang ding in lah? ci hi. Keima’ inn a kisiet gawp ziehin na inn ciet uh na nawdel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note tunga vantungte in daitui kangsah a, leitang in ga gasah lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in gam le muolte tung, ankung tung, lenggazu tha tung, sathau tung, leitang pana a piengte tung, mihing ganhing le amau’ nasepna zosie tungah guotui ka kangsah zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Sheatiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le siempu lien pa Jehozadak’ tapa Joshua in mi a omlai teng zosie tawh Topa a Pasien uh’ thugente le Topa a Pasien uh’ sawl ahi kamsang Haggai’ thugente a mang uhi; tuale mipite in Topa a giing uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ kamtai Haggai in mite tungah Topa’ thugente gen a, note kang ompi hi, Topa in ci hi, ci-in a gen hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Sheatiel’ tapa Zerubbabel’ lungsim, Judah gam uhpa’ lungsim, siempu lien pa Jehozadak’ tapa Joshua’ lungsim le mi a omlai teng’ lungsim a thosah hi; tuale amate pei-in Vanglien Topa a Pasien uh’ inn ah na a sem uhi."},"15":{"text":"Khum ni pen Kumpi Darius in kumpi a sep zaw a kum nina kum, a hla guhna a ni sawmni le ni li ni ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"a hla sagina, a ni sawmni le khat ni-in Haggai tungtawnin Topa’ thu tam bangin tung a:","title":"Mailam Biehinnpi’ Minthanna"},"2":{"text":"Judah gam a uhpa Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le siempu lien pa Jehozadak’ tapa Joshua, le mi a omlai teng tu-in hopi in. Note lahah"},"3":{"text":"nidang lai-a tam biehinnpi a minthanna a mu kha ngai koi teng na omlai vuoi mah? Tu-in tami bangci na sa vuoi? Na muna vuah bangma lo bang ta hi lo amah?","ref":"Ezr 3:12"},"4":{"text":"Hizongle Jerubbabel aw, tu-in kihangsah in, Topa in ci hi; siempu lien pa Jehozadak’ tapa Joshua aw, hangsan in; no gamsung mipi zosie aw, kihangsah un, Topa in ci hi; note kang ompi ziehin na sem un, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gam panin nang pei lai-un note kang thuciem dung zui-in note lahah ka hlagau a teng hi; zau sih un.","ref":"Pei 29:45-46"},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Keima in a sawt loin vanpi leipi, tuipi, le leigawte ka lawhthing kia ding hi.","ref":"Heb 12:26"},"7":{"text":"Minam zosie’ gou teng ang tun thei nadingin keima in minam zosie ka lawhthing ding a, minthanna tawh tami biehinn a kidim ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngun le kham keima-a’ ahi hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"A kilam nukhia inn pen a kilam masa sangin thupizaw ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi; keima tami munah note cithei nopsahna kang pie ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpi Darius a kumpi sep a kum nina, a hla sagi na, a ni sawmni le khat ni-in kamsang Haggai tung panin Topa’ thu tung a:","title":"Phawsietna le Kamciem"},"11":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi:"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat in a puon kihlip kawmah sa siengtho puo hinlen, tua puon kihlip tawh anlum khat popo ahi a, zu ahi a, a kihuon an khat popo ahi zongin a thamkhah leh, tua khu an siengtho suoh thei ding amah? Siempupa in, “An siengtho suoh thei lo ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Haggai in, “Misi luong khat a suhkhah ziehin a sieng lo mi khat in tamte khat popo a suhkhah leh, tua a suhkhahte a bua a suoh diei mah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 19:11-22"},"14":{"text":"Haggai in, keima mai-ah tam minam le tam gam tua tawh kibang hi, Topa in ci hi; tuale a khut utawh a sep zosie uzong tua bang hi ding hi; tua sunga a piehte uh a bua hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin tami ni-a kipanin bang ang tung diei, ci tu-in ngaisun un. Topa’ biehinnpi sungah suong khat tungah suong khat a kikoi masangin,"},"16":{"text":"na omdan kingaisun un. An tena sawmni a opna munah mi khat a pei ciengin tena sawmkhat beh a na pha hi; lenggazu tena beelpi sawmnga a opna ah mi khat a pei ciengin tena sawmni beh a na pha hi."},"17":{"text":"Huisapi, maaibuoh natna, le gielpi tawh note kang vatmai vangin keima lamah note nang kihei sih uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"A hla kuona, a ni sawmni le lini ahi, tuni-a kipanin ngaisun un. Khum ni khu Topa’ biehinn khuombul a kiphu ni ahi ziehin ngaisun un:"},"19":{"text":"Ansal sungah anci a kinuasie lai ei mah? Lenggui, theikung, mang kawlsing, le olive kungte khat beh a ga nai sih amah? Keima in tu ni-a kipanin note thupha kang pie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuami hla ni sawmni le ni li ni-in Haggai tungah tam bangin Topa’ thu a niveina a tung hi:","title":"Zerubbabel tunga Pasien’ Kamciem"},"21":{"text":"Judah gam uhpa Zerubbabel hopi-inlen ama kungah gen in, keima in vanpi le leipi thingkhe-in,"},"22":{"text":"kumpi gamte’ mang tophate ka khuleh ding a, namcin kumpi gamte’ hatna susie-in a sakol leengte le a hawlte ka khuleh ding hi; sakolte le a hawlte koipo a guolpa’ namsau tawh a si ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Khumi ni-in Vanglien Topa in a cina-ah, ka nasempa Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel aw, nangma kang la ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Tuale seal tupna khutsip bangin kang bawl ding hi; azieh pen keima in nangma kang teel zo hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."}}}}},"38":{"info":{"name":"Zechariah","shortname":"Zech","abbr":[],"desc":"Zechariah laibu (the book of zechariah)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius in kumpi a sep a kum nina, a hla giet hla-in, Iddo’ tapa Berechiah, a tapa kamsang Zechariah tungah Topa’ thu a tung hi:","title":"A Kisiakia dingin Israel Kihanthawn","ref":"Ezr 4:24–5:1; 6:14"},"2":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh tungah Topa a lungthah mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate kungah tam bangin gen in, Vanglien Topa in ci hi: Vanglien Topa in a genna-ah, keima kungah hing kilekia un, tua hile kei zong na kung vuah kang kilekia ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Nidanga kamsangte in, “Na gitlona lampite ule na gitlo gamtatnate uh panin kilekia un,” ci-a a genna uh na pu na pate bang sih un. Ahi vangin amate in ka thugen za loin thusim lo uhi, Topa in ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh hei-a om uh ahei? Tua kamsangte a hing zing uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in ka nasem kamsangte tunga ka thupieh ahi, ka kammalte le ka thukhamte in na pu na pate uh’ hun lap hi lo amah? Tuaci’n amate kisiakia-in, “ Topa in bawl dinga a gelsa bangin i gamtat dan ule i silbawl utawh kituohin eite tunga ang bawl ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Darius in kumpi a sep a kum nina, a hla sawm le khatna, Shebat hla a ni sawmni le li ni-in Iddo’ tapa Berechiah, a tapa kamsang Zechariah tungah Topa’ thu a tung hi; tuale Zechariah in,","title":"Mangmuna Khatna: Sakol Tunga Tuongte"},"8":{"text":"zan lai-in sakol san khat tunga a tuong pasal khat ka mu hi! Guom thuhpi sunga om mui singkungte lahah ama a ding hi; tuale ama nua lamah sakol a san, a buong, le a kangte a om hi.","ref":"Kln 6:2-8"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Ka pu aw, tam teng bang ahei?” ka ci hi. Kei ei hopi vantungmi in kei kungah, “Amate bang ahei ci kang lah ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n mui singkung lahah a ding mipa in, “Amate pen leitung a vil kawikawi dinga Topa in a sawl mite ahi uhi,” ci-in ei dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin mui singkung lahah a ding Topa’ vantungmi tawh amate a holim vua, “Leitung ka vil zo ta vua, en in, leitung buppi nuomtahin toi om uhi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi in, “Vanglien Topa aw, tam kum sawm sagi sung na lungthahna ziehin Jerusalem le Judah khuopite tungah bang tanvei hepi loin om ding na hei?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in kamsiem le henepna tawh ka kihopi vantungmi a dawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka kiholimpi vantungmi in ka kungah, tami thu tam bangin phuongzah in: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi; Jerusalem le Zion adingin ka laina mama hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale a nuom op hit hiet minam tungah ka lung a thah mama hi; bangzieh ahei cile ka lungthahna tawmkhat beh ahi lai-in amate in gimna a nasiesah semsem uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa in tam bangin gen hi, kei Jerusalem ah lainatna tawh ka kilekia zo hi; tua sungah ka inn kilam ding a, Jerusalem tungah tena khau kihlung ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Phuongzah lai in: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Nopsahna tawh ka khuopite a kidimlet ding uhi; Topa in Zion henemkia ding a, Jerusalem a teelkia ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka khuodah leh saki li ka mu hi.","title":"Mangmuna Nina: Kite le a Khengte"},"19":{"text":"Ka kihopi vantungmi kungah, “Tamte bang ahiei?” ci-in ka dong hi. Tuale ama in, “Tamte pen a kithethangsa ahi Judah, Israel, le Jerusalem sakite ahi uhi,” ci-in ei dawng hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in siakheng mi li ei lah hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale keima in, “Amate bang bawl ding uh ahei?” ci-in ka dong hi. Ama in, “Koima in a lu a phawh thei lo nadinga Judah a thethang sakite ahi hi; hizongle tamte ahi uleh amate a zausah ding, Judah a thethang ding le a kite uh Judah gam langkhatah a sangkhan minamte’ kite a sattan dinga ang pei uh ahi hi,” ci-in ei dawng hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ento leh a khut sungah tena khau a tawi mi khat ka mu hi.","title":"Mangmuna Thumna: Tena Khautawi Mi Khat"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, “Hei-a pei ding na hei?” ci-in ka dong hi. Ama in, “Jerusalem khuopi adung avai bangtan a pha ei ci-a ka thei nadinga a te ding ka hi hi,” ci-in ei dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ei hopi vantungmi pen a malam nawtin pei a, tuale vantung midang khat ma in a malam nawtin na dawntuo hi,"},"4":{"text":"tuale ama kungah, “Tai inlen tua tangvalpa kungah, “A sungah mihonpite le gangingte tampi a op ziehin kulpi a nei lo khuotate bangin Jerusalem ah mi kiteng ta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama kimvelah meikuong kulpi-in ka om ding a, a sungah ama’ minthanna ka hi ding hi, Topa in ci hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Khaile! khaile! Leilu lam gam panin taimang in, Topa in ci hi; azieh pen keima in van ningli-a huipi leng bangin gamdangah note kang thezah sieng ta hi, Topa in ci hi.","title":"A Kikal Hun-awng: Saltangte Tunga Thumna"},"7":{"text":"Khaile! No Babylon tanu tawh a tengtonte aw, na suohtah nadingun Zion ah tai un."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Vanglien Topa in (a minthanna in kei ei sawl zaw ciengin) note ang bulu minamte tawh kisai-in tam bangin gen hi: A mantahin no ang khoikha pa in keima’ mit nauta a khoikha ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in en un, keima in amate langkhatah ka khut ka lamto ding a, amate pen a silate uh’ tomgam van a suoh ding uhi. Tua ciengin Vanglien Topa in kei ei sawl lam note in na thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem tanu aw, kipahin la sa in! Azieh pen en in, keima hing pei-in na lah vuah kang teng ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin minam tampite in Topa a pawlpi ding vua, amate pen keima’ mi ahi ding uhi; na lah vuah kang teng ding a, Vanglien Topa in keima ei sawl lam note in na thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in gam siengtho sungah ama’ tanh dingin Judah gam luo ding a, Jerusalem a teelkia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi zosie aw, Topa mai-ah sip dide un; azieh pen a tenna mun siengtho panin ama ding khie zo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Topa’ vantungmi mai-a a ding siempu lien pa Joshua ei lah a, tuale ama mawsah dingin a ziet lamah Satan a ding hi.","title":"Mangmuna Lina: Joshua le Satan","ref":"Ezr 5:2; Kln 12:10"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Satan kungah, “Satan aw, Topa in nang ang phawhsie hi! Jerusalem a teel Topa in nang ang phawhsie hi! Tam mipa pen mei kuolai pana kiladawh singba hi lo amah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Jude 9"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Joshua in puon nieh mama silin vantungmi mai-ah a ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantungmi in ama mai-ah a ding mite kungah, “A puon nieh sutpieh un,” a ci hi. Tuale ama kungah, “En in, nangma kung panin na khielna ka ladawh ta hi, tuale puon hoite kang silsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale keima in, “Amate in a lu tungah diel siengtho khat khimsah uheh,” ka ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in a lu tungah diel siengtho khat khimsahin puon a silsah uhi; tuale ama kungah Topa’ vantungmi a ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi in Joshua hlamuon a,"},"7":{"text":"“Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Ka lampite tawnin ka deinate na zui leh, ka inn uhin ka huong sung teng na sai ding a, tam sunga a ding mite lahah sungtum pusuo theina thu na nei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Siempu lien pa Joshua aw, tu-in nangma le na mai-ah a to na guolte in ngai un! Bangzieh ahei cile amate pen mailam thuhoi nading lim ahi uhi: Keima in Singba a kici ka nasempa kang peisah ding hi.","ref":"Jer 23:5; 33:15; Zech 6:12"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen Joshua mai-ah, mai sagi a nei suong khat ka phut zo a, tua suong tungah lai ka giel ding a, ni khat sungin tami gam’ khielna ka lamang ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin na lenggui ule na theikung uh nei-ah a pei dingin khatlekhat na kiciel ding uhi,” Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Mic 4:4"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei ei hopi vantungmi ang kilekia a, mi khat a kimutna pana a kiphawn bangin ei phong hi.","title":"Mangmuna Ngana: Meivah Tunna le Olive Kungte"},"2":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Tuale keima in, “A tunga hai khat a nei, kham tawh a kibawl meivah tunna khat ka mu hi; tuami tungah meivah sagi om a, a dawnah kam sagi ciet a nei meivah sagi a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuami gei-ah olive kung ni om a, khat pen hai ziet lamah, adang khat pen hai vei lamah a om hi,” ka ci hi.","ref":"Kln 11:4"},"4":{"text":"Keima ei hopi vantungmi kungah, “Ka pu aw, tamte bang ahiei?” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima ei hopi vantungmi in, “Tamte na thei sih amah?” ci-in ei dawng hi. Keima in, “Thei sing, ka pu aw,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Tami pen Zerubbabel kunga a tung Topa’ kammal ahi hi: Thagumhatna hang hi lo, vanglietna hang zong hi lo, keima’ hlagau hang beh tawh ahi hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Ezr 5:2"},"7":{"text":"Muol golpi aw, nang bang na hei? Zerubbabel mai-ah zangtam na suoh ding hi; mite in, ‘Hepina, ama tungah hepina!’ ci-in a awh kawmin ama in inntung khupna suong puokhie ding hi,’ ci-in,” ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua banah keima kungah Topa’ thu ang tung a,"},"9":{"text":"“Zerubbabel’ khut in tam inn khuombul phut zo hi.; ama’ khut tawh a zo sieng ding hi. Tua ciengin Vanglien Topa in na kung vua keima ei sawl ahi lam note in na thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thuneu’ bawl ni a simmaw mi poma a lungdam ding vua, Zerubbabel khut sunga a om tena suongkhai a mu ding uhi. “Tami sagite pen leitung buppi a encih Topa’ mittangte ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 5:6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah, “Meivah tunna ziet lam le vei lama a om tami olive kungte bang ahiei?” ka ci hi.","ref":"Kln 11:4"},"12":{"text":"Tuale a ni veina ama kungah, “Kham penglawng ni tegel tawh sathau kisunna tami olive singba ni tegel bang ahiei?” ka ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in kei kungah, “Tamte bang ahei ci na thei sih amah?” ei ci hi. Keima in, “Thei sing, ka pu aw,” ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Tam tegel pen leitung buppi a uh Topa kunga a ding sathau a kinusa mi nite ahi uhi,” ei ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka enkia leh a leng laiziel khat ka mu hi.","title":"Mangmuna Guhna: Laiziel Leeng"},"2":{"text":"Tuale ama in kei kungah, “Bang na mu ei?” ei ci hi. Keima in, “A leng laiziel khat ka mu hi; adung tong sawmni, avai tong sawm pha hi,” ci-in ka dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in kei kungah, “Tam pen leitung maitang buppi-ah a vah kawikawi samsietna ahi hi; azieh pen laidal lang khata a kigiel bangin guta zosie kisumaimang ding a, a dal lang khata a kigiel bangin a manlopi-a a kiciem zosie kisumaimang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in a genna-ah, keima in tua laidal ka sawl zo ta a, gutate’ inn sung le a man lopi-a ka min tawh a kiciem mite’ inn sungah a lut ding hi; tua inn sungah teng den ding a, a sing a suong pumin tua inn a susie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin kei lamah ei hopi vantungmi ang pei-in keima kungah, “Khuodah inlen tua ang pusuoh pen bang ahei en in,” ei ci hi.","title":"Mangmuna Sagina: Law Sunga Numei"},"6":{"text":"Keima in, “Tuami bang ahiei?” ka ci hi. Ama in, “Tua ang pusuoh pen law ahi hi,” ei ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Tam pen gam sung zosie-a amau’ khielna ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin hanawh tawh kibawl a husin ang kidomto leh tua law sungah numei khat na to hi!"},"8":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Tam pen Gitlona ahi hi,” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n ama in law sungah tua numei sawnsuhkia-in tua law’ kam tungah hanawh gihna tawh a nensuh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka khuodah leh kei lamah numei ni ang pei ka mu hi. Ama gel’ hlate sungah hui a om hi; ama gel in gun vapi’ hla tawh a kibang hla a nei vua, van le lei kikalah tua law a lenpito uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima ei hopi vantungmi kungah, “Tua law hei lama a lenpi to uh ahiei?” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Tuami ading inn khat lampieh dinga Shinar gama a lenpi uh ahi hi,” ei ci hi. Tua inn a kizaw ciengin amate in a kitunna ding munah tua law a tung ding uhi,” ei ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale khatvei ka khuodah leh sumngo muol ni kikal panin leeng li ang pusuoh ka mu hi.","title":"Mangmuna Gietna: Leeng Lite"},"2":{"text":"A leeng amasa pen sakol sante in kai a, a nina sakol vomte,","ref":"Kln 6:4, 5"},"3":{"text":"a thumna sakol kangte, le a lina sakol pawlte in kai uhi.","ref":"Kln 6:2"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ei hopi vantungmi kungah, “Ka pu aw, tamte bang ahiei?” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Vantungmi in keima kungah, “Tamte pen leitung buppi a uh Topa mai-ah a kilaa zaw cieng vua ang pusuoh vantung huipi lite ahi hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Kln 7:1"},"6":{"text":"Sakol vomte’ kaih leeng in leilu lam gam manaw-in pei a, sakol kangte’ kaih leeng in nitumna lam gam zuonin pei-in, sakol pawlte’ kaih leeng in leitaw lam manaw-in a pei hi,” ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"A thahat sakolte ang pei ciengun leitung a vil kawikawi ding uh a ngahla mama uhi. Tuale ama in, “Pei-in leitung va vil un,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in leitung a vil uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in kei ei awhsan a, “En in, leilu lam gama peite in leilu lam gamah keima’ hlagau a tawlngasah uhi,” ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ thu ka tungah ang tung hi:","title":"Kumpi Lukhu Singba Kikhusah"},"10":{"text":"Babylon pana ang tung saltangte-Hedai, Tobijah, le Jedaiah-tung panin ngun le khamte khawm in; khum ni ma-in Zephaniah’ tapa Josiah’ inn ah pei in."},"11":{"text":"Nang in ngun le khamte la-in kumpi lukhu khat bawl inlen, Jehozadak’ tapa siempu lien pa Joshua khusah in."},"12":{"text":"Ama kungah tam bangin gen in: Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tami sungah a min Singba a kici mipa khat a om hi: azieh pen ama’ munah ba mengin Topa’ biehinnpi a lam ding hi.","ref":"Jer 23:5; 33:15; Zech 3:8"},"13":{"text":"Topa’ biehinnpi lam ding pa khu ama ahi hi; ama in kumpite’ nga zatahna nga ding a, a kumpi topha tungah to-in a uh ding hi. A kumpi topha gei-ah siempu khat om ding a, ama ni kikalah lungmuongin kitheitelna a om ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua kumpi lukhu pen Topa’ biehinnpi sungah phawna-in Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, le Zephaniah’ tapa Josiah-te kep dingin ki-ap ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A gamla panin mite hing pei-in Topa’ biehinnpi a lam hu ding uhi; tuale Topa in note kunga keima ei sawl lam na thei ding uhi. Topa na Pasien uh’ thu na man nah po uleh tam thu ang pieng ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Darius in a uh a kum lina, Chislev a kici a hla kuo na, a ni li ni-in, Zechariah tungah Topa’ thu tung hi.","title":"A Kineitawm Antanna Kimawsah"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in Bethel mite in Sharezer le Regem-melech, a mite utawh Topa’ tungah a thum dingin a sawl vua,"},"3":{"text":"Vanglien Topa’ inn sunga siempute le kamsangte kungah, “Kum tampi sung ka bawlsa bangin a hla ngana sung kapin antang lai ding ka hi uh amah?” ci-in a dongsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka kungah Topa’ thu ang tung hi:"},"5":{"text":"Gam sung mi zosie le siempute kungah tam bangin gen in: Tam kum sawm sagi sung a hla ngana le a hla sagina sungin an tangin na kaa uh ciengin tua khu kei adinga antang na hi uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Note in na neh na dawn uh ciengin noma dinga an ne tui dawn hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem ah mite tengin a kimvela khuote tawh a nopsah lai le Negeb le Shephelah ah mite a ten lai-in kamsangte tungtawnin Topa thugente tam thute ma hi lo amah?"},"8":{"text":"Zechariah tungah Topa’ thu tungin tam bangin ci hi:","title":"Pasien’ Kalhte Nielna Zieha Dan Thuohna"},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: A manin thukhen unlen khatlekhat tungah migitna le hepina kilah un."},"10":{"text":"Meigong, taga, pemta, ahi sihle mizawngte gawt sih un; na lungsim sung vuah khatlekhat kisietsah nading gel sih un."},"11":{"text":"Hizongle amate in ngai nuom loin lungkhau tahin a liengko uh a heisan vua, a zah lo nadingun a bil a hum uhi."},"12":{"text":"Thukham le Vanglien Topa in kamsang masate tungtawnin ama’ hlagau tawh a gen thute a zah lo nadingun amate in a lungsim a khausah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in amate ka hlat ciengin a zah lo uh bang lienin amate in keima ei hlat ciengun ken zong ka za sih ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuale keima in a thei ngai nai vawt lo uh minamte lahah amate pumpei tawh ka thezah ding hi. Tua bangin a nuasie uh leitang gamkhing suoh a, tuaci’n gam nuom kimlai koima’ suhva tova nawn lona gamdai a suohsah uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vanglien Topa’ thu ka tungah tam bangin ang tung hi:","title":"Zion tunga Pasien’ Kamciem"},"2":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: It luotna lienpi tawh Zion ka lainat a, thangpaina lienpi tawh ama ka lainat hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Zion ah ka kilekia ding a, Jerusalem laikimah ka teng ding hi; Jerusalem pen a muonhuoi khuopi kici ding a, Vanglien Topa’ muol pen muol siengtho kici ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: A kum a tam seng ziehun puvuoite le pivuoite in a khut ciet vuah ciengkhut a tawi ding vua, Jerusalem lampi tengah a tokia ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuale khuopi sunga gawlzing lampi tengah a ki-apmai naupangte le numeite a dim ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Tu hun ciengin a omlai tam mite adingin tam thu pen a hi thei lo ding tawh a kibah vangin, keima adingin ahi thei lo ding tawh a kibang ding amah?"},"7":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Keima in nisuona lam gam le nitumna lam gam panin ka mite ka hundam ding hi;"},"8":{"text":"tuale Jerusalem-a teng dingin amate ka puoh ding hi. Amate pen munhuoina sung le dihna keima’ mi ahi ding vua, tuale keima zong amau’ Pasien ka hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bang ci hi: Vanglien Topa’ inn ahi biehinnpi a kilamkia nadingin khuombulpi a kiphu hun lai-in a na om kamsangte’ kam sung panin a gen uh thute tu nai-a tua thu a za note in na khut uh khausah un."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile khum hun masangin mihing ganhing thaman a om sih a, a sungtum le a pusuoh mite adingin galte panin lungmuonna khat zong om loin, amate khatlekhat ka kidosah hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in nidanglai huna ka bawl bangin a omlai tam mite tungah ka bawl nawn sih ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile lungmuongin khai kitu ding hi; lenggui in a ga ga ding a, leitang in ga piengsahin vantungte in daitui pie ding uhi; tuale tami nate zosie pen tam mipi a oplai teng in ka ngasah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Judah innkuon le Israel innkuonte aw, minamte lahah hamsietin na om ngai ma bangun note hing hundamin mite thupha ngana na hi ding uhi. Zau sih unlen na khutte khausah un."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen Vanglien Topa in tam bangin gen hi: Na pu na pate un ei thangpaisah lai-un amate tungah gimna tunsah ding sawmin ka lungsim ka khep vawt lo bangin,"},"15":{"text":"tuhun ciengin Jerusalem le Judah innkuon adingin na hoi sep ding ka sawmkia ta hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi; zau vawt sih un."},"16":{"text":"Na sep ding uh tam teng ahi hi: Note khatlekhat thuman thutahin kihopi unlen, na khuopi tunkot vua thukhennate ah thuman le kilemna dingin thu khen un.","ref":"Eph 4:25"},"17":{"text":"Na lungsim sung vuah khat in khat tungah sil hoi lo bawl sawm sih un; azieh pen tamte zosie ka muda hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Vanglien Topa thu keima kungah ang tung a:","title":"Lungdam Antanna"},"19":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Antan a hla lina, antan a hla ngana, antan a sagina, le antan a hla sawmna teng pen kipahna le lungdamna pawi bawlna hun hi ding a, Judah innkuonte adingin thanopna pawite hi ding hi: tua ahi ziehin thuman thutah le kilemna na dei un."},"20":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Mite le khuopi tampi-a tengte ang pei lai ding uhi;","title":"Jerusalem ah Mi Tampite Kikai"},"21":{"text":"khuopi khat a tengte adang khatah a pei ding vua, “Hing pei un, eite pei-in Topa tungah hepina ngenin Vanglien Topa zong i sui ding uhi; kei mama ka pei ding hi,” a ci ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Vanglien Topa a sui ding le Topa tungah hepina a ngen dingin mi tampite le minam thahatte a pei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Khum hun ciengin mi namcin lah panin ham tuomtuom a zang pasal sawm khat in Jew mi khat manin a puon tu kawmin, “Nang tawh zawhton vai, bangzieh ahei cile nang tawh Pasien a op lam ka za zo ta uhi,” ci ding uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuphuon Khat. Hadrach gam langkhatah Topa’ thu tung a, Damascus tungah tu ding hi. Aram khuopi pen Topa -a’ ahi ziehin Israel minam zosie zong ama-a’ ma ahi hi;","title":"Israel’ Galte Tunga Thukhenna","ref":"Isa 17:1-3; Jer 49:23-27; Amos 1:3-5"},"2":{"text":"tua tawh a kigamgi Hamath zong ama-a’ ahi a, amate a pil vangun Tyre le Sidon zong ama-a’ ma ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tyre in ama adingin leicien bawl a, ama in leivui sunvum bangin ngun sungvum a, lam dunga buathah bangin khamte a sungvum hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in a neisate Topa in lahpieh ding a, a haunate tuipi sungah paipiehin mei in a katum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Ezk 26:1–28:26; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Ashkelon in tua mu-in a zau ding hi; Gaza zong a lungkhamin kintawm ding hi; a kinepna teng a tawp ziehin Ekron zong tua bang ma hi ding hi. Gaza pan kumpipa mangthai ding a, Ashekelon ah koima teng lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ashdod khuopi ah nam kisawhalte a teng ding vua, keima in Philistia-te’ kiletsahna ka tawpsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in a kam panin sisan le a haning kawm panin sil kidahhuoite ka ladawh ding hi; a omlai teng zong i Pasien adinga a omlai ahi ding uhi; ama pen Judah gam sungah be khat bangin om ding a, Ekron zong Jebus-te bang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zeph 2:4-7"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin koima a sungtum a pusuoh a op lo nadingin, ka inn ah giephuol satin a cingin ka om ding hi; mi bawlsie koima in amate a tuoncil nawn sih ding hi, azieh pen tu-in keima in ka mit tawh ka mu zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Zion’ tanu aw, nahpi tahin kipah in! Jerusalem tanu aw, a gingin awng in! En in, thumanna le hutdamna ahi na kumpipa kiniemkhieh tahin laa tungah laapi’ ta laano tung tuongin na kungah ang pei hi.","title":"Pasien’ Mite Kumpi ding","ref":"Mat 21:5; Jhn 12:15"},"10":{"text":"Ama in Ephraim panin leengte le, Jerusalem panin galsimna sakolte a sumaimang ding hi; galsim nadinga kizang thaltangte kisumaimang ding a, ama in minamte tungah kilem nading thu pie ding hi; ama uhna tuipi khat pan tuipi khat, Gunpi panin leimong dong hi ding hi.","ref":"Late 72:8"},"11":{"text":"Nang adingin zong ahile, nang tawh i thuciemna sisan ziehin, tui op lona leihawm panin na thongkiete ka hla ding hi.","ref":"Pei 24:8"},"12":{"text":"Lametna a om thongkiete aw, na mun muonhuoi vuah kilekia un; tuni-in nang tungah a zani-a kang pieh ding thu kang gen hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen ka thal bangin Judah ka kuoi zo ta hi; keima in Ephraim pen a thaltangin ka bawl zo hi. Zion aw, a do dingin na tapate ka hantawh ding a, Greece aw, amate in na tapate a do ding uhi. Galhangpa’ namsau bangin nangma kang tawi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah Topa kilah ding a, tunphe bangin a thaltang lengkhie ding hi; pengkul tumin leitaw lam pumpei lahah Topa Pasien ang pei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Vanglien Topa in amate dal ding a, amate in suongsepte pumvalin a tuoncil ding uhi; zu bangin a sisan uh a dawn ding vua, tua khu kuong bangin dimin, maitam kiute bangin tehlop ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Topa a Pasien un ama’ mite tuuhon bangin hundam ding hi; kumpi lukhu-a suongmanpha bangin amate tee dimdiem ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama bang za-in hoi-in, ama bangza-in a etlawm diei izaw! An le zu tha in tangvalte le ngahnute a khanphasah ding hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Guo nukhia hun ciengin Topa kung pan guotui ngen un. Huipi meiipite a bawl Topa ahi a, ama in note tungah guotui ang pie a, a koimapo adingin lozau-ah ankung a posah hi.","title":"Judah le Israel Angai Bangkia"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile teraphim in kimanna a nei lo thu gen a, aisante in zuouthu mu uhi; mangsante in a man lo mangte genin, henepna a hawmpi a pie uhi. Tua ahi ziehin tuu bangin mipite a vahmang sieng vua, tuucing a op lo ziehin gentheina a thuoh uhi.","ref":"Mat 9:36; Mrk 6:34"},"3":{"text":"Ka tuucingte tungah keima ka lung a so a, keima in makaite tungah dan ka pie ding hi; azieh pen Vanglien Topa in a ganhon, Judah innkuonte kem ding a, a kiphatsahpi gal sakolte bangin amate a bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate sung pan innkiu suong, amate sung pan puonbuh khetphim, amate sung pan galdona thalpi, amate sung pan galkapmang zosie, ang pieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un gawlzin buon lahah galte a tuoncil galhangte a bang ding uhi; amate tawh Topa a opton ziehin amate in gal a do ding vua, sakol tung tuongte a mai zumsah ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Judah innkuonte ka thakhausah ding a, Joseph innkuonte ka hundam ding hi. amate tungah lainatna ka nei ziehin, amate ka peipikia ding a, tuale amate pen ka nuol ngai lote tawh a kibang ding uhi; Topa a Pasien uh ka hi ziehin, amate ka dawng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Ephraim mite galhangte tawh a kibang ding vua, zu lungnop bangin a lung nuom ding uhi. A tate in mu-in a kipah ding vua, Topa sungah amate lungdamin a kipah ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amate tankhie zo ka hi ziehin, amate khutvanin ka kaikhawm ding a, nidang lai bangin amate tampi a pha ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Minamte lahah amate ka thezah vangin gamlapi-a om gamte panin amate in ei phawh ding vua, tanu tapate nei-in amate ang peikia ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt gam panin inn ah ka peipi ding a, Assyria gam panin ka kaikhawm ding hi; mun in amate a dawl la masangsie Gilead gam le Lebanon ah ka peipi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in lunggimna tuipi a kansan ding vua, tuipi tuihuolte kivatmai-in, Nile tuithuhte a kanggaw ding hi. Assyria-te’ kiphatsahna kiniemkhieh ding a, Egypt-te’ kumpi ciengkhut a peimang ta ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa sungah ka thakhausah ding a, ama’ minin a kalsuon ding uhi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lebanon aw, na taamtah singte mei in a kahtum nadingin, na kotte hong in!"},"2":{"text":"Taasing aw, taamtah sing a pua zo ziehin kap in, bangzieh ahei cile singkung minthangte kisie zo hi! Bashan gangpi sing aw, kap in, azieh pen gammang tulah teng kiphua sieng zo hi!"},"3":{"text":"Ngai un, a vangtaa ziehun tuucingte a kap uhi! Ngai un, Jordan hamphulte a kisuhsiet ziehin humpite a hawh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka Topa Pasien in tam bang ci hi: Gaw dinga kikoi tuuhonte va cing ta’n.","title":"Tuucing Nam Ni"},"5":{"text":"A leite in tuute a go vua, dan a thuoh sih uhi; a zuate in, “Ka haulaw ziehun Topa in thupha nga taheh,” a ci uhi; a tuucingte mama in amate tungah khuotuona a nei sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khumi gam sunga a teng zosie ka khuotuo nawn sih ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Mi zosie a unpi-in a innvengpa’ khut sung le kumpipa’ khut sungah ka puasah ciet ding hi; amate in tua gam a susiecip ding vua, keima in a khut sung panun koima ka hunkhie sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei pen tuu metbawlte’ gaw dingin tuuhonte a cing pa ka suoh hi. Keima in ciengkhut ni ka la hi; khat pen Angvanna ci-in a min ka phuo a, a khat pen Kipumkhatna ci-in min phuo-in tuute ka cing hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate tungah hla khat sungin tuucingte thum ka hemkhie hi, bangzieh ahei amate tungah ka lung a duoi zo nawn sih a, amate in zong kei ei huo uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in, “Note kang cing nawn sih ding hi. A si nuom si unlen a sie nuom sie un; a omlai sun teng zong khatlekhat kivaltum un!” ka ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Angvanna a kici ka ciengkhut la-in ka hliehtawng a, mi zosie tawh ka bawlsa ka thuciemna ka phel hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum ni-in kiphel a, kei ei vilvil tuu metbawlte in tam pen Topa’ thu ahi lam a thei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in amate kungah, “Tami thu man na sah uleh ka thaman ei pie un; man na sah sih uleh tang un,” ka ci hi. Tuaci’n amate in ka thaman dingin ngun shekel sawmthum a te uhi.","ref":"Mat 26:15"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah, “Tuate sumkholna sungah koi in,” ei ci hi. Amate in tua pen keima a pu uh’ man dinga kituoh a sah uh ahi hi. Tuaci’n keima in ngun shekel sawmthum la-in Topa’ inn sung sumkholna ah tuate ka koi hi.","ref":"Mat 27:9-10"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Kipumkhatna a kici ka ciengkhut a nina pen ka hliehtawng a, Judah le Israel kikala innkuon kikhaukhina ka phel hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in keima kungah tam bangin gen hi: Kimanna a nei lo tuucingpa’ vanzahte khatvei lakia un."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in gam sungah a mangthaite a don lo, a vahthapte a sui lo, a liemte dam nadinga a kem lo, a cidamte an a vah lo, ahi vangin a thaute netumin a kecin nangawna a pumval tuucingte ka khangsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuuhonte a nuasie, kimanna a nei lo ka tuucingpa in samsietna nga taheh! Ka namsau in a ban le a mit zietlam sat taheh! A ban zawcip ta hinlen, a mit zietlam taw taheh!"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuphuon Khat. Israel tawh kisai-in Topa’ thugen tam bang ahi hi: Vante zahin leitung bulpi phut a, mihingte sungah hlagau a guon Topa in tam bangin ci hi:","title":"Jerusalem Guolzawna"},"2":{"text":"En in, Jerusalem khu a kimvela om mite in khamin a hawipua thei nading uh zuhai-in ka bawl ding hi; Jerusalem sung a ki-imtawm ciengin Judah zong ki-imtawm ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mi zosie adingin Jerusalem suongtum gih mama khatin ka bawl ding hi; tua suongpi a dom mi zosie amau le amau kinah liemsuo mama ding uhi. Ama a do dingin leitunga minam zosie a peiton ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in sakol zosie ka patausah ding a, a sakol tung tuongte ka mawsah ding hi. Ahi vangin keima in mi zosie’ sakol mit ka tawtsah ciengin mitphe loin Judah innkuonte ka en ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah bete amau le amau in, “Jerusalem-a tengte in Vanglien Topa , a Pasien uh tungtawnin thahatna a nga uhi,” ci ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in Judah bete, singkhuo tunga beel kisuong a so pielpual le butu lahah meila kuong ka bangsah ding hi; tuale amate in a kimvel a ziet a vei-a om mi zosie a valtum ding vua, Jerusalem-a ama’ mun ma-ah mite a tengkia ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Judah tungah David innkuon’ vang le Jerusalem-a tengte’ vang a kitawisang lo nadingin Topa in Judah puonbuhte tungah guolzawna pie masa ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Topa in Jerusalem-a tengte dal ding ahi ziehin, tuaci’n amate lahah a thanem pente Judah bang ding a, David innkuonte Pasien tawh kibangin amate mai-ah Topa’ vantungmi bang ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin keima in Jerusalem a sim minam zosie suhsiet dingin ka sui ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in David innkuon le Jerusalem-a tengte tungah lainatna le thungetna lungsim ka sungsuh ding a, tuaci’n a sutpailetsa uh mipa khat enin a tapa neisun kaa bangin a kap ding vua, a tapa masapen kaa bangin nasie tahin a kaa ding uhi.","title":"A Sutpailetpa Uh’ Dinga Kaana","ref":"Jhn 19:37; Kln 1:7"},"11":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Megiddo zanglei-a Hadad-rimmon kaana za ma-in Jerusalem-a kaana lien mama ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua gam kap ding a, David innkuonte a tuomin, a zite a tuomin, Nathan innkuonte a tuomin, a zite a tuomin,"},"13":{"text":"Levi innkuonte a tuomin, a zite a tuomin, Shimei innkuonte a tuomin, a zite a tuomin,"},"14":{"text":"a omlai a kinuasie innkuonte a tuomin, a zite a tuomin a kap ciet ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 24:30; Kln 1:7"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin David innkuon le Jerusalem-a tengte’ mawna le a sientho lonate uh a sawp sieng dingin tuinah khat kipulsah ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin amate a kiphaw nawn lo nadingin keima in gam sung panin milimte’ min teng ka sumaimang ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi; gam sung panin kamsangte le hla buate zong ka sumaimang ding hi.","title":"Milim Biehna Kisumaimang"},"3":{"text":"Kamsang khat po ang pienkia leh a pienna a nu le a pa in amate kungah, “Topa’ minin zuouthu gen na hi ziehin na hing sih ding hi,” ci ding uhi; tuale amate in mailam thu a gen ciengun a pienna a nu le a pa in amate dawtlia ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin kamsang poma in mailam thu a gen ciengun a mangmuna ziehun maizum ding uhi; mi sol nadingin amate in a kamsang samul puonhampi a sil sih ding vua,"},"5":{"text":"ahi vangin amate khat ciet in, “Kei kamsang ka hi sih a, lohlo mi khat ka hi bo hi; azieh pen ka neu lai-a kipanin tam leitang keima’ neisa ahi hi,” ci ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi khatpo in, “Na awm-a tam liemmate bang ahiei?” ci-in amate a dawh leh, “Ka guolpa inna ka liemna ahi hi,” ci-in dawng ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Namsau aw, ka tuucingpa le ka naseppi pa sat dingin tho in,” Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Tuute a kithethang nadingin tuucingpa sat in; keima in tuunote langkhatah ka khut ka vih ding hi.","title":"Tuucingpa Kisat, Tuuhonte Kithethang","ref":"Mat 26:31; Mrk 14:27"},"8":{"text":"“Gam bup ah sethum-suo- seni kisumangin a mangthai ding vua, sethum-suo-sekhat pen a hingin kinuasie ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam sethum pen meikuolai-ah koi-in, mi khat in ngun a siensah bangin ka siengsah ding a, kham a kize-et bangin tuate ka ze-et ding hi. Amate in ka min ei lo ding vua, amate ka dawng ding hi. “Amate pen ka mite ahi uhi,” ka ci ding hi. Amate in, “ Topa in eite’ Pasien ahi hi,” a ci ding uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En in, Topa’ ni ang tun ciengin na kung pana van kilate note lahah kihawm ding hi.","title":"Mailam Galsimna le Guolzawna a Tawpna (Ezk 38–39 ; Mrk 13 ; Kln 20–22)"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem sim dingin minam zosie ka khawm ding a, khuopi kila-in innte kibulu ding a, numeite kibuon gawp ding hi; khuopi alang salin kikai ding a, ahi vangin khuopi sunga a omlai teng kisumaimang lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa kuonin gal kido huna kido bangin tua minamte a do ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Jerusalem nisuona lama a om Olive Muol tungah a keng tawh ama a ding ding hi; nisuona lam pan nitumna lam dong Olive Muol phal ni kisuo ding hi; tuaci’n Muol alang khat leilu lamah kikhinin, alang khat leitaw lamah kikhin ding a, kuompi gol mama khat pieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Note na hi uleh, Topa’ muol kuom tawnin na tai ding uhi, azieh pen muol tegel kikala om tua kuom in Azal dong ban ding hi; tuale Judah Kumpi Uzziah hunin zil lingin na taimang bangun na taimang ding uhi. Tua ciengin Topa ka Pasien hing pei-in a misiengthote zosie ang zawpi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin khuodam ahi a, vuokieh ahi zongin a om sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A kizom ni om ding a, (tua pen Topa in a thei ni khat hi ding a) sun hun, zan hun ci om lo ding hi, azieh pen nitah hun ciengin khuovah om ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin Jerusalem panin hinna tui luongkhie ding a, alang pen nisuona lam tuipi ah, alang khat pen nitumna lam tuipi ah luong ding hi; phalbi lai bangin khuokhal lai-in zong luong den ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 47:1; Jhn 7:38; Kln 22:1"},"9":{"text":"Leitung zosie ah Topa , pen kumpi a suoh ding hi; khum ni ciengin Topa khat beh hi ding a, a min zong khat beh hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Geba panin Jerusalem leitaw lam Rimmon dongin gam buppi zanglei suoh ding hi. Ahi vangin Jerusalem pen Benjamin’ Tunkot panin tunkot masa le Kiu Tunkot dong, le Hananel Tausang panin kumpipa’ lenggazu suhna dongin a tuomin a opna ngai-ah om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua khuopi ah kiteng ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile tua khuopi kisusiekia ngai nawn lo ding hi; Jerusalem lungmuongtahin a om ta ding hi.","ref":"Kln 22:3"},"12":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem tunga gal bawl mite zosie tami pul natna tawh vatmai ding hi: A keng utawh a ding laipima-in a sa uh muottop ding hi; A mitbu sung vuah a mittangte uh muotin, a kam sung vuah a lei uh a muottop ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Topa tung panin amate tungah patauna lienpi khat tung ding a, tuaci’n mi khat ciet in a vengpa khut man ding a, mi khat in adang khat dona-in a khut uh a lam ciet ding uhi;"},"14":{"text":"Judah minamte nangawn in Jerusalem ah a do ding uhi. Amau’ kimvela a om minamte’ hauna zosie-kham, ngun, le puonsilte tampi tah kikhop siengpieh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam pul natna tawh a kibang pul natna pen sakolte, kalaohte, laate tung, le giephuolte sunga om ganhing zosie kungah tung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerusalem a sim minamte lah panin a suohta lai zosie in Vanglien Topa bie ding le buh pawi sim dingin kumsimin Jerusalem ah kato ding uhi.","ref":"Siem 23:39-43"},"17":{"text":"Vanglien Topa Kumpipa bie dingin leitunga om innkuonte a koimapo Jerusalem ah a kuonto sih uleh, amate tungah guo a zu sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Egypt innkuonte kuonto loin amate mama a va op sih uleh, Topa in buh pawi sim dinga a kuonto lo minamte tunga a tunsah pul natna, amate tungah a tung ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua bang pen buh pawi sim dinga a kuonto lo minamte zosie le Egypt-te’ thuoh ding dan hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin sakol lawngte tungah, “ Topa dingin a Siengtho,” ci-in kigiel ding hi. Topa’ inn sunga an beelte, maitam mai-a kuongkumte bangin siengtho ding hi;"},"21":{"text":"tuale biehpiehna pie mi zosie pei-in biehna sa huon nadingin tuate a zah thei nadingun Jerusalem khuo sung le Judah gam sunga anbeel zosie Vanglien Topa adingin a siengtho ding hi. Khum hun ciengin Vanglien Topa’ inn sungah sumbawlte om nawn lo ding hi."}}}}},"39":{"info":{"name":"Malakhi","shortname":"Mal","abbr":[],"desc":"Malachi laibu (the book of malachi)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuphuon khat. Israel tunga Malachi in a gen Topa’ thu."},"2":{"text":"Note kang it hi, Topa in ci hi. Ahi vangin note in, “Kote bang nei ci it ei?” na ci uhi. Jacob’ sanggampa Esau hi lo amah? Topa in ci hi. Hizongle Jacob ka it a,","title":"Israel in Edom Deizaw"},"3":{"text":"ahi vangin Esau ka muda hi; keima in a muoltung gam teng gamkhing suohsahin ama’ luona teng si-alte tenna senel gam ka suohsah zo hi.","ref":"Rom 9:13"},"4":{"text":"Edom in, “Eite ei kivatmai vangin a kisie teng i lamkia ding uhi,” a ci leh Vanglien Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Amate in lam thei ding uhi, ahi vangin amate pen gam gilo, Topa lungthah denna minam a kici dongin ka susie veve ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na mit mama utawh tam thupieng na mu ding vua, “Israel gamgi hlen dongah Topa lien hi!” na ci ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14"},"6":{"text":"Tate in a pa a patawi vua, nasemte in a pupa a patawi uhi. Kei pa khat ka hi leh hei-ah ei kipatawina om ahei? Kei a pu khat ka hi leh hei-ah ei kizatahna om ahei? Keima’ min a simmaw siempute aw, ci-in note tungah Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Note in, “Na min bang kang ci simmaw uh ahei?” na ci uhi.","title":"Siempute Kisietna"},"7":{"text":"Ka maitam tungah a sieng lo an tawh biehna na lui uhi. Tuale note in, “Bang ka ci buasah uh ahei?” na ci uhi. Tua pen Topa’ sabuoi kisimmaw thei hi, ci-a na ngaisutna utawh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Biehpiehna dinga a mittaw ganhingte nang pieh uh ciengin tua khu khielna hi lo amah? A khelbai, a cinate nei pieh ciengun tua khu khielna hi lo amah? Na gam uhpa kungah tuate va puoh ta vawi un; na tung vuah ama lungkimin ang pahta ngel diei mah? Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 15:21"},"9":{"text":"Pasien in hing lungsietin ang angvan thei nadingin tu-in thum un. Tua khu noma’ khielna ahi hi. Ama in note khatpo tungah a patatna ang lah ding amah? Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka maitam tungah a mawhna-in mei na taw lo nadingun note lahah mi pawlkhat in biehinnpi kotkhahte khah uleh maw! Na tung vuah ka lung a kim sih a, na khut sung panun biehna ka sang sih ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen nisuo-a kipan nitum dongin minamte lahah ka min lienin, muncin tengah ka minin gimnamtui le biehna siengtho kipie ding hi; azieh pen minamte lahah ka min lien hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ sabuoi bua zo ta hi, na ci ciengun tua sabuoi a buasah noma na hi vua, tua an zong na simmaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tami khu cimtah huoi sam ei,” na ci vua, kei nei napnit san lel uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Na biehna dingun tatsietna tawh a kila ganhing ahi a, a liem a bai, ahi sihle a cina khatpo ahi zongin nang peipi uhi! Na khut sung panun tuate kang sang ding amah? Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"A tuuhonte lahah tuu apa khat pieh dingin kamciem napi, Topa tungah kawbaang biehpiehnate a pie mipa in samsiet nga taheh; azieh pen kei Kumpi lien ka hi a, minamte lahah ka min kizatah hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale tu-in siempute aw, tam thupieh pen note ading ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Note in thu ngai loin na lungsim sung vuah ka min than nading na vom sih uleh, na tung vuah samsietna kang tungsah ding a, na thuphate uh ka samsie ding hi; a tahtahin ci leih, note in na lungsim vuah na vom lo ziehun tuate ka samsie zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Na suonlehlahte uh phawhsie-in na maitang vuah na biehna ganhingte uh’ eh ka the ding a, ka opna panin note kang lamang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Levi tawh ka thuciemna a kip nadingin note tungah tam thupieh kang lah ahi lam thei un.","ref":"Gam 3:11-13"},"5":{"text":"Ama tawh ka kiciemna, ama ka pieh pen nuntah nading le nopsah nading thuciem ahi hi; tuami in zatah ding dei a, ama in kei ei giingin ka min a zatah mama hi.","ref":"Gam 25:12"},"6":{"text":"A kam sungah thuhilna man om a, a lei-ah bangma khielna kimu lo hi. Ama pen citahna le thutangin kei tawh kalsuon a, khielna panin mi tampi kiheisah hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile siempu pa’ kam in theina a kep kul a, Vanglien Topa’ kamtaipa ahi ziehin mite in ama’ kam panin thuhilna a sui ding uh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin lampi panin note na piel ta uhi; na thuhilna utawh mi tampi na kipalpua sah uhi; note in Levi thuciemna na siesah uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka lampi zui loin na thuhilna ah mi deidan na hi ziehin mi zosie mai-ah simmawna le maizumna kang thuohsah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"I unpi-in pa khat nei hi lo i mah? Eite pen Pasien khat beh in ei piensah hi lo i mah?
