Tua ahile bang dinga eite khatlekhat kimuong loin i pu i pate’ thuciemna i buasah uh ahei?","title":"Judah in Thuciemna Niehsah"},"11":{"text":"Judah a muonhuoi sih a, Israel le Jerusalem ah a kidahhuoi nate kisem zo hi; azieh pen Topa in a it mama a mun siengtho Judah in buasah zo a, a zi-in gamdang pasien khat nei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tam banga a gamta mi poma koikoi hitale a theisah pa ahi a, a dawng pa ahi sihle Vanglien Topa kunga biehna lui pa ahi zongin, Jacob’ puonbuh panin kisumaimang ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Note in tam zong na sem uhi: Ama in note khut sung panin na biehnate uh lungkim tahin hing sang loin, zong hing thudon nawn lo ahi ziehin note in kaana le tauna hlitui tawh Topa’ maitam na khucip uhi."},"14":{"text":"Note in, “Bang dinga ei san lo ahei?” ci-in na dong uhi. Azieh pen thuciemna tawh na lah le na kithuopi hi napi, ama tungah na muontah lona pen na senzi le nangma kikalah Topa teci ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nu Pasien khat beh’ siem hi lo amah? Tahsa le hla a nipi-in ama-a’ ahi hi. Tuale khat beh a siemna pen Pasien bang dei ahi diei? Pasien’ suonlehlahte a pien nading ahi hi. Tuaci’n noma le noma ki-en unlen, a senzi tungah koima muontah loin omsah sih un."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Israel Pasien Topa in, keima in zi khulna ka muda hi, a ci a, tuale tatsietna tawh a zi tunga a gamtatna a selcip mite ka muda hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Note in na thugennate utawh na Topa uh na gimsah uhi. Hinanle note in, “Bangci gimsah ka hi uh ahei?” na ci uhi. “ Topa muna-ah gitlona a bawl zosie mi hoi ahi vua, ama in tuate a kipahpi hi,” ahi sihle, “Thutang Pasien hei-ah a om ahei?” cina tawh na gimsah uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, ka lampi siel dingin ka mai-ah ka kamtaipa ka sawl ding a, note in na suisui uh Topa a biehinnpi ah thakhatin ang pei ding hi. Note in na hlagul uh thuciemna kamtaipa ang pei ding hi,” Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","title":"Ang Pei Ding Kamtaipa","ref":"Mat 11:10; Mrk 1:2; Luk 1:76; 7:27"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama ang pei ni ciengin koi in thuoh zo ding a, ama ang kilah ciengin koi in nang zo ding ahei? Azieh pen ama sia siensahna mei le puonsawpte’ savan tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Joel 2:11; Kln 6:17"},"3":{"text":"Ngun haltui-in a siengsahpa bangin ama to ding a, amate in Topa tungah thuman biehnate a pieh masangsie uh ngun le kham bangin ama in Levi’ suonlehlahte siengsahin haltui ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah le Jerusalem in a pieh uh biehnate, nidang lai bangin Topa adingin lungkimhuoi ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukhen dingin note kungah kang pei ding hi; keima in aitawite, angkawmte, a manlopi-a kiciemte, a kiguoi nasemte’ thaman pie loin a gawt mite, meigong le tagate, pemtate a pampaihte, le keima ei giing lote zosie langkhatah teci pangin mallangin thu ka khen ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima Topa ka kikhel sih hi; tua ahi ziehin no Jacob’ tapate aw, na mangthai sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh’ hun lai-a ki panin ka thukhamte panin pielin tuate na zui sih uhi. Kei kungah hing kilekia un, tua hile kei zong na kung vuah kang kilekia ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Ahi vangin note in, “Bang hing ci kilekia ding ka hi uh ahei?” na ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat in Pasien’ na a guhpieh ding amah? Hizongle note in keima’ na nei guhpieh uhi! Ahi vangin note in, “Bangci dan a kang guhpieh uh ahei? na ci uhi. Na sawm-ah-khatte ule na biehnate vuah nei guhpieh uhi!","title":"Pasien’ Na Guhpieh Sin"},"9":{"text":"Note in keima’ na nei guhpieh ziehun na minam buppi-un awsie tawh note ang kisamsie hi!"},"10":{"text":"Ka inn sungah an a op thei nadingin sawm-ah-khat a kimin hing peipi unlen, keima ei zelah un, Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Keima in note adingin vantung tawlette hongin thupha a dimletin kang buohsuh ei, kang buosuh sih ei, ei en un.","ref":"Siem 27:30; Gam 18:21-24; Thkna 12:6; 14:22-29; Neh 13:12"},"11":{"text":"Keima in na leitang pieng na ante uh, kauphe in a suhsiet lo nadingin ka hosie ding hi; lolai-a na lenggui uh ga loin a om sih ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin na gam uh kipah thanopna gam ahi tah ziehin minam zosie in note a nuomsa minamin ang ngaisun ding uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Note in keima langkhatah kam khauh na ham zo ta uhi, Topa in ci hi. Hinanle note in, “Nangma langkhatah bangci ham ka hi uh ahei?” na ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Note in, “Pasien’ na i sep pen a mawhnapi ahi hi. Eite in a thupieh i zuina uh ahi a, Vanglien Topa mai-ah a kapte banga i va kawikawina uh ahi zongin, bang i phattuompi uh ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in eite in a kiphasahte mi nuomsa i ci uhi; sietna bawlte a cithei beh hi loin, amate in Pasien a zelah uh ciengin a suohta uhi,” na ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa a zatah mite khatlekhat a kiho uhi. Topa in amate thudonin a thu uh a ngaipieh a, Topa a zatah mite le a min a lungngai mite adingin ama mai-ah phawna laibu khat kigiel hi.","title":"Mi Muonhuoite’ Thaman"},"17":{"text":"Amate keima-a’ hi ding a, na ka sep ni ciengin amate keima’ neituomte ahi ding uhi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi. Nu le pate in amau’ na a sem a tate a hinkhawi bangin ken zong amate ka hinkhawi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin midihte, migilote, Pasien’ na a sem mite le a sem lo mite kikalah a kilamdanna uh note in khatvei na mukia ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, mi kiphasahte zosie le migilote zosie, lungthu sunga meikuong bangin katumin hampa gaw a suo ding hun ang tung ding hi; tua ang tung ding ni ciengin a zung a ba ci nuasie nei loin amate kihaltum sieng ding hi, Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","title":"A Thupi Ni"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka min a zatah note adingin a hlate tungah damna a puo dihna ni ang suoh ding hi. Bawngbuh pana a kihla bawngnote bangin pusuohin na tawndien ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in na kang sep ni ciengin note in migilote na tuoncil ding uhi, azieh pen amate ka ketaw nei-a leivui tawh a kibang ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Israel zosie adingin Horeb ah ama ka thupieh, ka nasempa Moses’ thuhilnate ahi thukhamte le biehna ngaina kipte phawh un."},"5":{"text":"En un, keima in a zauhuoi le a thupi Topa’ ni ang tun masangin note kungah kamsang Elijah kang sawl ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in samsietna tawh gam sung a vatmai lo nadingin nu le pate’ lungtang tate tung le, tate’ lungtang nu le pate tungah ka kiheisah ding hi.","ref":"Mat 11:14; 17:10-13; Mrk 9:11-13; Luk 1:17; Jhn 1:21"}}}}},"40":{"info":{"name":"Matthew","shortname":"Mat","abbr":[],"desc":"Matthew gen lungdamna thu (the gospel according to matthew)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham’ ta David, David’ suon Messiah Jesu’ khang ciemtena tam bang ahi hi.","title":"Messiah Jesu’ Khanggui Simna (Luk 3:23-38)"},"2":{"text":"Abraham’ ta Isaac, Isaac’ ta Jacob; Jacob’ ta Judah le a sanggam pasalte,"},"3":{"text":"a zi Tamar tawh a nei Judah’ ta Perez le Zerah, Perez’ ta Hezron, Hezron’ ta Aram,"},"4":{"text":"Aram’ ta Aminadab, Aminadab’ ta Nahshon, Nahshon’ ta Salmon,"},"5":{"text":"a zi Rahab tawh a nei Salmon’ ta Boaz, a zi Ruth tawh a nei Boaz’ ta Obed, Obed’ ta Jessi,"},"6":{"text":"le Jessi’ ta Kumpi David ahi hi. Uriah’ zi Bathsheba tawh a nei David’ ta Solomon,"},"7":{"text":"Solomon’ ta Rehoboam, Rehoboam’ ta Abijah, Abijah’ ta Asaph,"},"8":{"text":"Asaph’ ta Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat’ ta Joram, Joram’ ta Uzziah,"},"9":{"text":"Uzziah’ ta Jotham, Jotham’ ta Ahaz, Ahaz’ ta Hezekiah,"},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah’ ta Manasseh, Manasseh’ ta Amos, Amos’ ta Josiah,"},"11":{"text":"Josiah’ ta Jechoniah le a sanggamte ahi a, Babylon ah sala a kipeipi hun pawla suoh ahi uhi.","ref":"2Kum 24:14-15; 2Khg 36:10; Jer 27:20"},"12":{"text":"Babylon ah sala a kipeipi zaw ciengin: Jechoniah’ ta Salathiel, Salathiel’ ta Zerubbabel,"},"13":{"text":"Zerubbabel’ ta Abiud, Abiud’ ta Eliakim, Eliakim’ ta Azor,"},"14":{"text":"Azor’ ta Zadok, Zadok’ ta Achim, Achim’ ta Eliud,"},"15":{"text":"Eliud’ ta Eleazar, Eleazer’ ta Matthan, Matthan’ ta Jacob,"},"16":{"text":"Jacob’ ta pen Mary’ pasal Joseph ahi a, tua Mary panin Messiah a kici Jesu a suoh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Abraham pan David dong khang sawm le khang li hi a, David panin Babylon-a saltan dong khang sawm le khang li ma pha a, Babylon pan sala a kipeipi-a kipan Messiah suo hun cieng dong khang sawm le khang li ma a pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Messiah Jesu Khris ang suo dan tam bang ahi hi. A nu Mary pen Joseph tawh a kikham laitah ahi a, hinanle a lupton masangun Hlagau Siengtho in Mary a gaisah hi.","title":"Messiah Jesu’ Suona (Luk 2:1-7)","ref":"Luk 1:27"},"19":{"text":"A pasal Joseph pen mi thuman khat ahi ziehin mipi lahah ama daisah nuom loin khuldap ding a sawm hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanle tam banga bawl dingin a ngaisut laitahin, ama kungah Topa’ vantungmi khat kihil a, “David’ tapa Joseph aw, Mary na zi dingin la ngam la sin, azieh pen ama sunga a gai nau pen Hlagau Siengtho in a gaisah ahi bo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in tapa khat nei ding a, tuapa in ama’ mite a mawna panun hunkhie ding ahi ziehin a min Jesu na phuo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 1:31"},"22":{"text":"Topa in kamsangpa tungtawnin a gensa thute a tangtun nadingin tam thute a pieng ahi hi:"},"23":{"text":"En un! Ngahnu khat gai-in tapa khat nei ding a, ama’ min dingin Emmanuel a phuoh ding uhi. A khietna in, “Eite tawh Pasien omton” cina ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 7:14"},"24":{"text":"A kimutna panin Joseph a khahlaw ciengin Topa in ama a sawl bangin bawl pai a, tua nu a zi dingin a la hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua tapa a suo masangsie tua nu a luppi sih a, tuale ama in a min Jesu a vaw hi.","ref":"Luk 2:21"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Herod hun sungin Judea gam Bethlehem khuo ah Jesu a suo zaw ciengin nisuona lam panin Jerusalem ah mipilte a tung vua,","title":"Nisuona Lam Mipilte’ Hawna"},"2":{"text":"Jew mite kumpi ding ahi ang suoh nausen hei-a om ahei” ci-in dong uhi. Azieh pen ama’ aasi ang suoh ka mu zo ta vua, ama zatahna pie dinga ang pei ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Herod in tam thu a zah ciengin ama le Jerusalem-a mi zosie a zau mama uhi;"},"4":{"text":"tuale siempu liente le thukham hil sie zosie kaikhawm a, ama in Messiah suo nading mun amate dong hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in, “Judea gam Bethlehem ah a suoh ding hi; azieh pen kamsang pa in hici bangin na giel hi:"},"6":{"text":"‘Judea gama om nang Bethlehem khuo aw, Judah gam-uhte lahah a neu pen na hi vawt sih hi; bangzieh ahei cile ka mi Israel-te a cing dingin nang sung panin uhpa khat pieng ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mic 5:2"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Herod in mipilte hlandapin amate tung panin aasi a kilah hun cientahin dong hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Bethlehem ah amate sawl a, “Pei unlen tua nausen limtahin hing sui un; ama na mu ciengun kei zong pei-in ama zatahna ka pieh thei nadingin thu ei zasahkia un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in kumpipa thu vaihlah a zah zaw ciengun vai a ding uhi; tuale amate in a mu ngaisa uh ang suoh aasi, nausen opna tung sontahah a khawl masang, khumtah amau’ mai-ah na peipei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua aasi a khawl a mu ciengun a lungdam mama uhi."},"11":{"text":"Inn sungah amate lut a, a nu Mary le nausen a mu uhi; tuale amate in khupdinin ama zatahna a pie uhi. Tua ciengin a gou bawmte uh a suo vua, kham, panamtui, le myrrh panamtuite letsongin a pie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Herod kunga a kilekia lo nadingun a mang sung vuah a kihilkhol ziehin lam tuom zui-in a gam vuah a kilekia ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate a pei zaw ciengun Joseph’ mang sungah Topa’ vantungmi khat kihil a, “Tho inlen nausen le a nu, Egypt gamah taipi inlen, kang genkia masangsie tuanah va om ta’n; azieh pen Herod in tua nausen tha dingin a sui hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Egypt Gama Taina"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph tho pai a, khum zan ma-in nausen le a nu zawpi-in Egypt gamah a tai vua,"},"15":{"text":"Herod a si masangsie khum sungah a om uhi. Tam thu pen kamsangte tungtawnin Topa in a na gensa, “Egypt panin ka tapa ka hlan ta hi,” a ci thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.","ref":"Hos 11:1"},"16":{"text":"Mipilte in a sol lamtah Herod in a thei ciengin lungthah mama a, tuale ama in zong mi sawlin aasi lam mipilte tung pana a theisa hun tawh kituohin Bethlehem khuo le a kimvela om kum ni le a neisie nausen zosie a thatsah hi.","title":"Nausente Kihonthana"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsangpa Jeremiah’ genkholna:"},"18":{"text":"“Rama khuo ah nahpi tah kaana le mauna kiza a, Rachel in a tate kaa a, a tate a op tah lo ziehin koima in ama hlai zo lo hi,” a ci thu a tangtunna ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 31:15"},"19":{"text":"Herod a si zaw ciengin Egypt gama om Joseph kungah Topa’ vantungmi khat a mang sungah kihil a,","title":"Egypt Pan Kilekiana"},"20":{"text":"“Nausen tha dinga a suite si zo ahi ziehin tho-in nausen le a nu zawpi inlen Israel gamah pei in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph tho-in nausen le a nu zawpi a, Israel gamah a pei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Archelaus in a pa Herod tangin Judea gam a uh lam a zah bepin tua munah a pei ngam ta sih hi. Tuale a mang sunga a kihil zaw ciengin ama Galilee gamah a pei hi."},"23":{"text":"Nazareth a kici khuo khatah tengin, “Ama Nazareth khuomi kici ding hi,” ci-a kamsangte’ genna a tangtun thei nading ahi hi.","ref":"Mrk 1:24; Luk 2:39; Jhn 1:45"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Judea gamlah ah Baptize-pa John kilahin","title":"Baptize-pa John’ Tangkona (Mrk 1:1-8 ; Luk 3:1-18 ; Jhn 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"“Kisiakia un, azieh pen vantung gam ang tung kuon ta hi,” ci-in a tangko hi.","ref":"Mat 4:17; Mrk 1:15"},"3":{"text":"Kamsang Isaiah in, “Gamlahah a kiko pa’ aw in: ‘ Topa pei nading lampi siel unlen, a lampi na tangsah un,’ ci hi,” ci-in a na gen lai-in tampa thu gen ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 40:3"},"4":{"text":"Tu-in John in kala-oh mul kigan puon silin savun tawh a kawng gah a, a an pen khuombai le gamkhuoizu ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 1:8"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah Jerusalem, Judea gam sung zosie le Jordan kuol sunga om mi zosie pei-in,"},"6":{"text":"a mawnate uh pulahin ama in Jordan gunah amate a baptize hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in Pharisee-te le Sadducees-te a tampi khat a ki-baptize dinga ang pei a mu ciengin amate kungah, “No muoltan suonte! Ang tung ding thangpaina pan na tai nadingun koi in ang hil ahei?","ref":"Mat 12:34; 22:33"},"8":{"text":"Kisiakiana tawh a kilawm ga na ga un."},"9":{"text":"‘Abraham pen ka pupi uh hi lel,’ ci-in mawh ngaisut sih un; azieh pen ken kang cina ah, Pasien in tami suongte panin Abraham’ suonlehlahte piengsah thei lel hi.","ref":"Jhn 8:33"},"10":{"text":"Tu nangawnin zong singzung cin tengah hei kikoi zo hi; a, ga hoi a ga lo singkung vannuoi kiphua-in mei sungah kipai hi.","ref":"Mat 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Kisiakia nadingin tui sungah note kang baptize a, hizongle ka nua-a ang pei ding pa pen kei sanga a vanglienzaw ahi hi; ama’ kedap tawi dingin zong ka kilawm sih hi. Ama in Hlagau Siengtho le mei tawh note ang baptize ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a khut sungah lawpi tawi-in a buphuol zap sieng ding a, a tah teng bem sungah khol ding hi; a si teng pen a mit ngai lo meikuong sungah haltum ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin John a ki-baptize sah dingin Galilee panin Jordan gunah Jesu a pei hi.","title":"Jesu ki Baptize-na (Mrk 1:9-11 ; Luk 3:21-22)"},"14":{"text":"John in, “Nang in kei nei baptize ding hizaw bo a, bang dinga kei kunga hing pei zawsop na hei?” ci-in a na kham sawm hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in, “Tu-in ei mang phot in; azieh pen thudih zosie i tangtunsah ding a kilawm ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua bepin ama a thukim hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu a ki-baptize zaw tui sung panin a pusuoto lien tahin thakhatin van kihong a, vakhu bangin Pasien’ Hlagau kumsuhin ama tungah tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale vantung panin awging khat in, “Tam pa pen kei ei lungkimsah ka it mama ka tapa ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 22:2; Late 2:7; Isa 42:1; Mat 12:18; 17:5; Mrk 1:11; Luk 9:35"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin dawimangpa’ ze-etna thuoh dingin Hlagau in gamlahah Jesu a peipi hi.","title":"Jesu Kize-etna (Mrk 1:12-13 ; Luk 4:1-13)","ref":"Heb 2:18; 4:15"},"2":{"text":"Sun sawmli le zan sawmli an a tan zaw ciengin a gilkiel mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama kungah a ze-et ding pa pei-in, “Pasien’ Tapa na hi leh tami suongte thupie inlen khomun suohsah in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in dawng a, ‘Mihingte an beh tawh hing ahi sih a, Pasien’ kam pana a pusuoh thu zosie tawh a hing ahi zaw hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi, a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:3"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin dawimangpa in muol siengtho tungah ama peipi-in biehinnpi khumvum ah koi a,"},"6":{"text":"ama kungah, “Pasien’ Tapa na hi leh nang le nang kumsuh in; azieh pen ‘Ama in nang adingin a vantung mite thupie ding a, ‘Na keng in suong a siakhah lo nadingin a khut utawh ang dom ding uhi,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 91:11-12"},"7":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Na Topa Pasien na ze-et sin,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:16"},"8":{"text":"Dawimangpa in muolsang mama khat tungah ama peipi leuleu a, leitung kumpi gam teng le a thupina zosie lah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Khupbawhin kei nei bieh leh tam teng zosie nangma kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Satan aw, kihemkhie in! Azieh pen Topa na Pasien bie inlen, ama’ na beh sem in,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:13"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin dawimangpa in ama a peisan a, tuale thakhatin vantung mite pei-in ama an a vah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in John a kimat zo lam Jesu in a zah ciengin Galilee gamah a kilekia hi.","title":"Jesu Galilee ah Nasep Kipan (Mrk 1:14-15 ; Luk 4:14-15)","ref":"Mat 14:3; Mrk 6:17; Luk 3:19-20"},"13":{"text":"Ama in Nazareth nuasie-in tuipi gei-a om Capernaum khuo ah a teng hi.","ref":"Jhn 2:12"},"14":{"text":"Tua khu kamsang Isaiah’ thugen a tangtun nading ahi hi:"},"15":{"text":"“Zebulun le Napthali gam, tuipi gei-a lampi, Jordan gungal, Gentile-te opna Galilee gam sung,"},"16":{"text":"khuomiel sunga om mite in khuovah lienpi a mu zo vua, sina hlim sunga om mite tungah khuovah ang tang ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 9:1-2"},"17":{"text":"Khum huna kipan Jesu thuhil kipan a, “Vantung gam ang tung kuon ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:2"},"18":{"text":"Galilee Tuipi gei-ah Jesu a pei laitahin ama in unau pasal ni, Peter a kici Simon le a sanggampa Andrew-te tuipi-ah lenpai-a om a mu hi, azieh pen amate ngabeng ahi uhi.","title":"Jesu in Nuazui Masate a Hlatna (Mrk 1:16-20 ; Luk 5:1-11)"},"19":{"text":"Tuale amate kungah, “Keima ei zui un, mi mante kang suohsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in thakhatin a lente uh nuasie-in ama a zui pai uhi."},"21":{"text":"Khum mun pan a pei zaw ciengin unau adang pasal ni, Zebedee’ tapa James le John-te unau, a pa uh Zebedee tawh gunkuong tungah len phaw-a om mu a, ama gel zong a hlan hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama gel in zong thakhatin gunkuong le a pa uh nuasie-in ama a zui pai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Galilee gam sung tengah Jesu vah kawikawi a, amau’ kikhopna inn ah thuhilin Pasien’ manggam lungdamna thu tangko a, mipi lahah cina luna zosie a damsah hi.","title":"Jesu in Mihonpi tungah Na Sem (Luk 6:17-19)","ref":"Mat 9:3; Mrk 1:39"},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n Syria gam sung zosie-ah a minthanna kizel a, mi cina zosie, natna le dammawna tuomtuom a thuohte, dawi’ matte, a sibupte, khut le keng zawte, ama kungah a peipi vua, ama in tuate a damsah sieng hi."},"25":{"text":"Galilee gam, Decapolis gam le Jerusalem khuopi-a kipan Judea gam, Jordan gungal khat panin mihonpi in ama a zui uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in mihonpite a mu ciengin ama muol tungah a kato hi; tuale a to zaw ciengin ama kungah a nuazuite a pei uhi.","title":"Muoltung Thuhilna (Mat 5–7)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate thuhil dingin kipan a:"},"3":{"text":"“Hlagau lamah a zawngkhal mite thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile vantung gam amau-a’ ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"“A kap a maute thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate a kihenem ding hi.","ref":"Isa 61:2"},"5":{"text":"“Lungnem mite thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in leitung luo ding uhi.","ref":"Late 37:11"},"6":{"text":"“Dihna zieha gilkiel dangtate thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate a lungtai ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 55:1-2"},"7":{"text":"Mi hepi theite thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in hepina nga ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Lungsim siengthote thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in Pasien a mu ding uhi.","ref":"Late 24:3-4"},"9":{"text":"Kilemna bawlte thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile amate Pasien’ tate kici ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Dihna zieha bawlsietna a thuoh mite thupha nga ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile vantung gam amau-a’ ahi hi.","ref":"1Pet 3:14"},"11":{"text":"Keima ziehin mite in hing hosie-in ang bawlsiet vua, a man lopi-a sietna namcin tawh ang mawsah uh ciengin thupha nga na hi uhi.","ref":"1Pet 4:14"},"12":{"text":"Vantungah na thaman uh lien ahi ziehin lungdamin kipah un. Azieh pen no masanga kamsangte zong tua ma bangin na kibawlsie ngai hi.","ref":"2Khg 36:16; Sawl 7:52"},"13":{"text":"“Note leitung ci na hi uhi; hinanle ci a alna mang leh bangci ki-alsahkia ding ahei? Paimangin keng tawh totcil ding longal a kimanna ding a om nawn sih hi.","title":"Ci le Khuovah (Mrk 9:50 ; Luk 14:34-35)","ref":"Mrk 9:50; Luk 14:34-35"},"14":{"text":"“Note leitung khuovah na hi uhi. Muol tunga kilam khuo kisel thei lo hi.","ref":"Jhn 8:12; 9:5"},"15":{"text":"Meivah a vah zaw ciengin koima in law khu loin meivah tunna tungah koizaw a, tua in inn sung zosie tanvah hi.","ref":"Mrk 4:21; Luk 8:16; 11:33"},"16":{"text":"Tua ma bangin amate in na silpha bawl uh a mu ciengun vantunga om na Pa uh’ min a phat thei nadingun mite mai-ah na khuovah uh na tangsah un.","ref":"1Pet 2:12"},"17":{"text":"“Thukham ahi sihle kamsangte’ thuhilna a phietmang dinga ang pei-in ei ngaisun sih un; a phietmang dinga ang pei ka hi sih a, a kicingsah dinga ang pei ka hizaw hi.","title":"Thukham le Kamsangte"},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen a tahtah a kang ci-in, van le lei a mangthai zongin na zosie a tangtun masangsie thukham laimal cindawncie zong mangthai lo ding hi.","ref":"Luk 16:17"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tami thukhamte lah panin a neupen khat zong palsatin khum bangma-a bawl dinga midangte a hil poma vantung gam sungah a neupen kici ding hi; ahi vangin tami thukhamte zui-in, a zui nading vua thu a hil poma vantung gam sungah milien kici ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ke’n kang ci-in, note’ dihna in Pharisee-te le thukham hil siete’ dihna a khup zawh sih leh vantung gam sungah na lut thei poma sih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Tanglai mite kungah, ‘Tuol na that sih ding uhi; tuol that poma thukhenna thuoh ding hi,’ a kici thu na zahsa uh ahi hi.","title":"Lungthahna Tawh Kisai Thute (Luk 12:57-59)","ref":"Pei 20:13; Thkna 5:17"},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, na sanggampa ahi sihle na sanggamnu tunga na lungthah uleh thukhenna na thuoh ding uhi; tuale note in na sanggampa ahi sihle na sanggamnu na hosiet uleh upate’ thukhenna zumah thusitna na thuoh ding uhi; tuale note in, ‘Nang mimaw pa’ na ci uleh hell meili sungah thukhenna na thuoh ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin maitam ah biehna na pieh laitahin nang tungah na sanggampa ahi sihle na sanggamnu khat a lungkim lo lam na phaw khah leh,"},"24":{"text":"tua maitam mai-ah na biehna nuasie phot inlen pei-in; na sanggampa ahi sihle na sanggamnu tawh va kilem masa phot ta’n, tua zaw ciengin hing pei-in na biehna piekia in."},"25":{"text":"Na langpa tawh thukhenna zumah a kikhie dinga lampi-ah na zawton laitahin ama tawh kilem nading bawl pai in, tua ahi sihle na langpa in thukhente tungah hing ap ding a, thukhente in mimante tungah hing pie-in thong sungah ang khum theikha ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, lieusum na khieh zo masangsie na suohta ngai sih ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“ ‘Ang na kawm sih ding hi,’ a kici thu na zahsa uh ahi hi.","title":"Angkawmna tawh Kisai Thute","ref":"Pei 20:14; Thkna 5:18"},"28":{"text":"Hizongle ke’n kang ci-in, lunggulna tawh numei khat a en mi zosie a lungsimin angkawm zo ahi ta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Na zietlam mit in ang mawsah leh kheidawh inlen paimang in; na pumpi buppi hell khuh sunga ang kipai sangin na tahsa behkhat a pelem ding nang adingin hoizaw hi."},"30":{"text":"Na zietlam khut in ang mawsah leh sattan inlen paimang in; na pumpi buppi hell khuh sunga a pei sangin na tahsa behkhat a pelem ding hoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat 18:8; Mrk 9:43"},"31":{"text":"‘A zi a khul poma in khulna lai pie taheh,’ zong kici hi.","title":"Zikhulna tawh Kisai Thute (Mat 19:9 ; Mrk 10:11-12 ; Luk 16:18)","ref":"Thkna 21:1-4; Mat 19:7; Mrk 10:4"},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, khielna khat zieh simlo a zi khul poma in ama nu pen angkawmsah a suoh hi; a kikhulsa numei a kinunpi poma zong angkawm a suoh hi.","ref":"Mat 19:9; Mrk 10:11-12; Luk 16:18; 1Cor 7:10-11"},"33":{"text":"“Tanglai mite kungah, ‘Zuouthu tawh kiciem loin Topa tawh na kiciemna uh na tangtunzaw ding uhi,’ a kici thu na zahsa uh ahi hi.","title":"Kiciemna Tawh Kisai Thute","ref":"Siem 19:12; Gam 30:2; Thkna 23:21"},"34":{"text":"Hizongle ke’n kang ci-in, vantung tawh na kiciem vawt sih un, azieh pen tua khu Pasien’ topha ahi bo a,","ref":"Jas 5:12; Isa 66:1; Mat 23:22"},"35":{"text":"leitung tawh zong kiciem vawt sih un, azieh pen tua khu a keng ngahna ahi bo hi. Jerusalem tawh na kiciem sih un, a zieh pen tua khu Kumpi Lien pa’ khuopi ahi bo hi.","ref":"Isa 66:1; Late 48:2"},"36":{"text":"Na lutang tawh kiciem sih un, azieh pen na samzam khat beh na kangsah thei sih vua, zong na vomsah thei sih uhi."},"37":{"text":"Na thugente a hite, ‘Hi’ ci unlen, ahi lote, ‘Hisih’ ci lel un; tua bansie poma gilopa kung pana ang pei ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"“’Mittang’ tangin mittang, ha’ tangin ha,’ a kici thu na zahsa uh ahi hi.","title":"Thuhkiana Tawh Kisai Thute","ref":"Pei 21:24; Siem 24:20; Thkna 19:21"},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, sietna bawlpa ledo sih un. Mi khatpo in na pang zietlam ang beh leh a lang khat zong na dawlai zaw in;"},"40":{"text":"mi khatpo in na puon tungsil la nuomin thu ang bawl leh na puontuol zong na pie lai in."},"41":{"text":"Mi khatpo in zawthaw thu tawh tai khat ang peisah leh tai ni dong na pei in."},"42":{"text":"Na kunga ang ngente zosie na pie inlen, na kunga ang leitawi nuom poma na khia sin."},"43":{"text":"“’Na vengpa na it ding a, na galte na muda ding hi,’ a kici thu na zahsa uh ahi hi.","title":"Galte Itna (Luk 6:27-28 , 32-36)","ref":"Siem 19:18"},"44":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, na galte it unlen ang bawlsiete adingin thunget pieh un."},"45":{"text":"Tuaci’n note pen vantunga om na Pa uh’ tate na hi ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile ama in migilote tung le mihoite tungah ni tangsah a, midihte tung le midih lote tungah guo zusah hi."},"46":{"text":"Azieh pen no ang itte beh na it uleh bang thaman nga ding na hi uh ahei? Siehdongte nangawn in zong tua bangma-a a bawl uh hi lo amah?"},"47":{"text":"Na sanggamte beh na muoh vua ahile midangte sanga na tam sep tuonna uh bang hi ta ding ahei? Gentile-te nangawn in zong tua bang ma-in bawl uh hi lo amah?"},"48":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin vantunga om na pa uh a cingtah ahi ma bangin no zong na cingtah un.","ref":"Siem 19:2; Thkna 18:13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Biehna tawh kisai na sil bawlte uh midangte’ mu dinga na bawl lo nadingun pilvang un; bangzieh ahei cile tua banga na gamtat uleh vantunga om na Pa uh kung panin thaman na nga sih ding uhi.","title":"Silpieh tawh Kisai","ref":"Mat 23:5"},"2":{"text":"“Tuaci’n note in silpieh na pieh sielun mihoi kipangte in midangte phat ding a dei ziehun kikhopna inn sung le lamdung tengah pengkul a mutsah bangin na pie sih un. A tahtah a kang ci-in, amate in a thaman uh a nga zo ta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in silpieh na pieh uh ciengin na zietlam khut’ bawl na veilam khut in theisah da un."},"4":{"text":"Tua hileh na silpieh uh pen dappieh ahi ding hi; tua hile a dapmu na Pa un thaman ang pie ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Thu na nget sielun mihoi kipangte na bang sih un; azieh pen amate in midangte’ mu theithei dingin kikhopna inn sung le lamkabawm lahpo-ah dinsa-in thu a ngen nuom sese uhi.","title":"Thungetna tawh Kisai (Luk 11:2-4)","ref":"Luk 18:10-14"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin thu na nget sielun na innkhan sung vuah lutin kot khah unlen, mu thei lona muna om na Pa uh kungah ngen un; tua hile ang dapmu na Pa un note thaman ang pie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Thu na nget ciengun Gentile mite bangin kimanna nei lo kam tampi mawh sutsut sih un; azieh pen amate in tampi a nget ziehun a kiza deu ding a sa kha uhi."},"8":{"text":"Thu na nget masangun na Pa un na kisap teng uh thei zo ahi ziehin amate na bang sih un."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ahi ciengin tam bangin thu na ngen un: Vantunga om kohaw’ Pa aw, na min kizatah hinlen,"},"10":{"text":"na gam hing tung taheh. Na deina vanah a kizui bangin leitung ah zong kizui taheh."},"11":{"text":"Nisim ka nehkhop ding uh an ei pie in."},"12":{"text":"Ko tunga ang mawte ka maisah ma bangun ka mawnate uzong ei maisah in."},"13":{"text":"Solna ei thuohsah sinlen, gilopa kung pan ei hunkhie in. Uh zawhna, vanglietna, minthanna nei tawntung ta in, Amen."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen midangte’ khielna na maisah uleh vantunga om na Pa un zong note’ khielna ang maisah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin midangte’ khielna na maisah sih uleh na Pa un zong note’ khielna ang maisah sih ding hi.","ref":"Mrk 11:25-26"},"16":{"text":"“An na tan sielun mihoi kipangte bangin damai puo sih un, azieh pen amate in a antan uh midangte a lah nop ziehun a maisuo uh a siesah uhi. A tahtah a kang ci-in, amate in thaman a nga zo uhi.","title":"Antanna tawh Kisai"},"17":{"text":"An na tan uh ciengin na lu uh sathau si unlen, na mai uh phiet siengzaw un,"},"18":{"text":"tuaci’n midangte in na an tan lam uh a mu sih vangun a simtham-a a om na Pa un ang mu veve ding hi; tua hile ang mudap na Pa un note thaman ang pie ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Nget in ne-in sam-eh a kai theina, gutate in lu-in a guh theina leitungah na goute uh khol sih un;","title":"Gougil tawh Kisai (Luk 12:33-34)","ref":"Jas 5:2-3"},"20":{"text":"nget in a neh thei lona, sam-eh a kai thei lona, gutate in lu-in a guh thei lona mun vantungah na goute uh kholzaw un."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen na gou opna mun vuah na lungsim uzong a om ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mittang pen pumpi adingin khuovah ahi hi. Tuaci’n na mit uh a cim leh na pumpi tung zosie a vah ding hi;","title":"A Cidam Mittang (Luk 11:34-36)"},"23":{"text":"ahi vangin na mit uh a cim sih leh na pumpi tung zosie uh a miel ding hi. Na sung vua a om khuovah pen khuomiel ahile bangza tahin a miel mawh ta diei!"},"24":{"text":"“Koima in to ni’ na sem zo lo hi; azieh pen sila pa in khat muda-in a khat it ding a, ahi sihle a khat belin adang khat simmaw ding hi. Note in Pasien’ na le leitung hauna’ na na semton zo sih ding uhi.","title":"To Ni’ Nasepna (Luk 16:13)"},"25":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin ke’n kang ci-in, bang ne-in bang ka dawn diei, ci-in na hinkhuo ading uh lunghimaw sih unlen, bang ka sil diei, ci-in zong na pumpi vua dingin lunghimaw sih un. Nehledawn sangin hinkhuo thupizaw a, silleten sangin pumpi thupizaw hi lo amah?","title":"Lunghimaw Sih un"},"26":{"text":"Vana a leng vate en un; amate in khai a tu ngai sih vua, an la-in bem sungah a khol vateh sih uhi, hizongle vantunga om na Pa un tuate an a vah hi. Tuate sangin na manphazaw sam sih ding uh amah?"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahile na lunghimaw ziehun note lahah na hinkhuo uh nai khat sung a sotto thei koi om na hi uh ahei?"},"28":{"text":"Bang dinga silleten ading lunghimaw na hi uh ahei? Gamlahah unoh paate khandan ngaisun vawi un; amate in na lah a sem sih vua, vau zong a zom ngai vateh sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hizongle ke’n kang ci-in, Solomon nangawn a thupina zosie tawh a kizep ciengin tua paapete lahah khat zong a ban zo nai sih hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:4-7; 2Khg 9:3-6"},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuni-in hing a, zing cienga meikhuh sungah a kipai lel ding gamlah lopate bawn Pasien in puon silsah ahileh no upna neu mite aw, ama in note puon ang silsah zawkan sih ding amah?"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, ‘Bang ka ne diei?’ ahi sihle, ‘Bang ka dawn diei’ ahi sihle, ‘Bang ka sil diei’ ci-in lunghimaw sih un."},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen tam teng zosie adingin Gentile mite a hanciem uhi; tam teng zosie na kisap lam uh vantunga om na Pa un thei zo hi."},"33":{"text":"Pasien’ manggam le ama’ dihna sui masa un, tua hile tam teng zosie zong ang kipiehbe ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Tua ahi manin zing cieng ading lunghimaw sih un, azieh pen zingcieng in ama adingin a lungkham na ding hi. Tuni’ buoina tuni adingin kicing gawp ta hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note tunga thu ang kikhen lo nadingin midangte tungah thu khen sih un.","title":"Midangte tunga Thukhenna (Luk 6:37-38 , 41-42)"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen midangte tungah thu na khen ma bangin note tungah thu ang kikhen ding a, midangte na pieh zaza ma uh na ngakia ding uhi.","ref":"Mrk 4:24"},"3":{"text":"Nangma’ mit sunga singluong om thei lopi-in na vengpa’ mit sunga buathah om bang dinga na muthaw sese ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Ahi sihle nangma’ mit sunga singluong om kimlai na vengpa kungah, ‘Na mit sunga buathah nang lahpieh vang,’ bangci ci thei ding na hei?"},"5":{"text":"No mi kineitawmte aw, na mit sung vua singluong la masa phot un, tua zaw ciengin na vengpa’ mit sunga na lah ding uh buathah cientahin na mu thei pan ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“A siengtho nate ui pie sih un; vohte mai-ah kep manphate pai sih un, na pai uleh a keng utawh sia gawpin, kihei-in ang hapkia lel ding hi.","title":"A Siengtho Nate Buasahna"},"7":{"text":"“ Ngen un, ang kipie ding hi; sui un, na mu ding uhi; kiu un, kot ang kihon ding hi.","title":"Ngen, Sui, Kiu (Luk 11:9-13 ; 6:31)"},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen a ngen zosie in nga a, a sui zosie in mu-in, a kiu zosie kot kihon ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Note lahah a tapa in anlum ngen leh suong pie ding koi na om uh ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Ahi sihle a tapa in nga ngen leh gul pie ding koi na om uh ahei?"},"11":{"text":"No migilote bawn in na tate uh tungah sil hoi pieh dan ding thei na hi uleh, vantunga om na Pa un ama kunga a ngente tungah sil hoi tampitah pie zaw kan lai lo ding amah!"},"12":{"text":"“Na tung vua ang kibawl ding na dei bangun midangte tungah bawl un; azieh pen tami khu Moses’ thukham le kamsangte thugen bulpi ahi hi.","title":"A Thupi Sep Dingte","ref":"Luk 6:31"},"13":{"text":"“Kot kawcih ah lut un; sietna mun zotna kot golin a lampi a bai ziehin mi tampi in a zui uhi.","title":"Kot Kawcih (Luk 13:24)"},"14":{"text":"Hinna tun nading kot kawcihin a lampi a hamsat ziehin mi tawmno khat beh in a mu uhi."},"15":{"text":"“A sungtawng ah ngie gongsan bang napi, tuu vun silin na kung vua ang pei zuouthei kamsangte lahah na pilvang un.","title":"Singkung le a Ga (Luk 6:43-44)"},"16":{"text":"Amate a ga tawh na thei pai lien ding uhi. Lingkung panin lengga kilo ngai-in thangling kung panin theiga a kilo ngai amah?"},"17":{"text":"Tua ma bangin singkung hoi zosie in ga hoi ga a, ahi vangin singkung hoi lo zosie in ga hoi lo ga uhi."},"18":{"text":"Singkung hoi ah ga hoi lo a ga thei sih a, singkung hoi lo ah zong ga hoi a ga thei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Ga hoi a ga lo singkung zosie kiphua-in mei sungah kipai ding hi.","ref":"Mat 3:10; Luk 3:9"},"20":{"text":"Tua bangin amate a ga panun na thei pai ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 12:33"},"21":{"text":"“Keima kungah, ‘ Topa , Topa , ei ci zosie vantung gam sungah a lut kim sih ding a, vantunga om ka Pa’ deina banga a gamtate beh a lut ding uhi.","title":"Ei le Ei Kisolna tawh Kisai (Luk 13:25-27)"},"22":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mi tampi in keima kungah, ‘ Topa , Topa , na min tawh thu ka hil vua, na min tawh dawite hawlkhie-in, na min ma tawh sil thupi tampitah bawl hi lo uh ka mah?’ ei ci ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in amate kungah, ‘Note kang thei ngai vawt sih hi; sietna a bawl mite aw, ka kung panin pei dawh ta un,’ ka ci ding hi.","ref":"Late 6:8"},"24":{"text":"“Tua ciengin tam ka thugente za-in a zui zosiete suong tunga inn lam mipil pa tawh kibang ding hi.","title":"A Zate le a Semte (Luk 6:47-49)"},"25":{"text":"Guo zu-in tui khang a, hui langin tua inn a nawh gawp vangin suong tunga kilam ahi ziehin a pua sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuale ka thugente za napi a zui nuom lo zosiete pen senel tunga inn lam mimaw pa tawh a kibang ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Guo zu-in tui khang a, hui langin tua inn a nawh gawp ciengin, senel tunga kilam ahi ziehin tua inn a pua ta hi, tua inn pua nasie sam e izaw!” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu-in Jesu in tam thute a gen zaw ciengin mipite in ama’ thuhilna lamdang a sa uhi."},"29":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in thukham hil siete bangin thuhil loin aana nei khat bangin amate thu a hil hi.","ref":"Mrk 1:22; Luk 4:32"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Muol tung panin Jesu a kumsuh zaw ciengin mihon tampite in ama a zui uhi;","title":"Jesu in Miphah Khat Damsah (Mrk 1:40-45 ; Luk 5:12-16)"},"2":{"text":"tuale miphah khat ama kungah pei-in a mai-ah khupdin a, Topa aw, nei damsah nop leh nei damsah thei hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a khut zahin ama tham a, “Kang damsah nuom hi. Na siengtho ta in!” a ci hi. Thakhatthu-in a phah natna a dam pai lien hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Koima kungah gen malmal sin; ahi vangin siempu pa kungah va kilah ta’nlen amate kungah teci dingin Moses’ thupieh bangin biehna va pie ta’n,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 14:1-32"},"5":{"text":"Capernaum khuo ah a lut ciengin ama kungah mi zakhat a uh galkapbu khat pei-in,","title":"Jesu in Galkap Mangpa’ Nasem Khat Damsah (Luk 7:1-10)"},"6":{"text":"“ Topa aw, ka nasempa zaw gawpin inn ah lum a, a natna thuohla mama hi,” ci-in ama kungah a thum hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale ama in khumpa kungah, “Hing pei-in ama ka damsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Galkapmangpa in dawng a, “ Topa aw, ka inn sungah nangpipi ang lutsah dingin kilawm malmal sing; kamteng khat gen zieu lacin ka nasempa dam lel va."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen kei zong thuneite khut sunga om ka hi a, ka khut nei-ah galkapte a om hi; tuale khat kungah, ‘Pei in,’ ka cileh pei a, adang khat kung ma-ah, ‘Hing pei in,’ ka cileh ang pei hi. Ka nasempa kungah, ‘Tami bawl in,’ ka cileh nasempa in a bawl pai hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in a thugen a zah ciengin lamdangsa a, tuale ama a zuite kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, Israel-te sungah tam bang upna a nei koima ka mu sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, nisuona pan le ni tumna panin mi tampi ang pei-in vantung gam sungah Abraham, Isaac le Jacob-te tawh an a neton ding uhi,","ref":"Luk 13:29"},"12":{"text":"kumpi gam luo mite ahi uleh kaana le hagawina mun a pulam khuomiel lahah kipai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 22:13; 25:30; Luk 13:28"},"13":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in galkapmangpa kungah, “Pei in; na upna bangin na tungah kibawl taheh,” a ci hi. Tua hun ma-in a nasempa a dam pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Pater’ inn ah Jesu a lut leh ama in cithuo natna tawh lupna tunga a lum a sungnu a mu hi.","title":"Jesu in Peter’ Innah Mi Tampi Damsah (Mrk 1:29-31 ; Luk 4:38-39)"},"15":{"text":"Ama in tua nu’ khut a thampieh leh a cithuo natna dam a, ama zong tho-in zindo a kipan pai hi."},"16":{"text":"Khumi nitahin amate in dawivei mi tampitah ama kungah a peipi uhi; tuale ama in kamteng khat tawh dawite hawlkhie-in cinate zosie a damsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam pen, “Ama in i zawngkhalnate ladawh a, i natnate a puo hi,” ci-in kamsang Isaiah tungtawn a na kigensa thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 53:4"},"18":{"text":"Jesu in a kimvelah mihon tampite a mu ciengin, ama in galkhat lama pei dingin thu a pie hi.","title":"Jesu’ Nuazui dingte (Luk 9:57-62)"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham hil siepa khat a va pei ta a, “Siepa aw, na peina popo-ah kang zui ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in ama kungah, “Ngiete in kuo nei a, vana leng vate in bu a nei uhi; ahi vangin Mihing Tapa in a lu ngah nading mun a nei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"A nuazui dangte khat in ama kungah, “ Topa aw, va pei-in ka pa ei vuisah masa phot in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in ama kungah, “Keima ei zui in, misite in a misite uh vuisah lel in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Gunkuong sungah ama a tuon ciengin a nuazuite in a zui uhi.","title":"Jesu in Huipi Daisah (Mrk 4:35-41 ; Luk 8:22-25)"},"24":{"text":"Tuipi tungah huipi nahpi-in langin tuihuolte in gunkuong a hlummang dihdih hi; ahi vangin ama a kimu ziuzieu hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuale amate pei-in Jesu a phong vua, “ Topa aw, kote ei hun ven! A simang ding ka hi ta uhi!” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Upna neu mite aw, bang dinga zau na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama tho-in huipi le tuipite a phawhsie leh a dai dide pai hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate in lamdang a sa mama vua, “Huite le tuipi nangawn in a thu a man va-ia uh tampa bangci mi ahi diei?” a kici uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuipi galkhat, Gadara mite’ gam a tun ciengin han panin dawivei mi ni pusuohin ama na dawntuo uhi. Ama gel a hansan seng ziehun tua lam a pei ngam koima om lo hi.","title":"Jesu in Gadara Khuomi Dawiveite Damsah (Mrk 5:1-20 ; Luk 8:26-39)"},"29":{"text":"Ama gel thakhatthu-in a kiko vua, “Pasien’ Tapa aw, ko tawh bang kisai laizang na hei? A hun tun masanga ko ei bawlsie dinga ang pei na hi amah?” a ci uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amate kung pan a gamla seng lo mun khatah voh hon tampi kikhawi a om hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuale dawite in ama kungah, “Ko nawdawh nei sawm leh voh honpi lahah ei lutsah in,” ci-in a thum uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuale ama in amate kungah, “Pei un!” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate pusuohin voh honte sungah a lut uhi. Tua bepin voh honte luibang ken panin thakhatin kumsuhin tui sungah a si sieng uhi."},"33":{"text":"Voh cingte tai-in khuopi sungah a lut vua, amate in a thu omdan zosie le dawiveite tunga thupieng teng a gen uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu dawn dingin khuozangin a pusuoh vua, ama a mu ciengun a gam panun a peidawh nadingin a thum uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gunkuong tungah tuongin tuipi galkai a, ama’ khuo-ah a tung hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua zaw lien ciengin mi pawlkhat in lupna tunga a lum phalsi khat a zawng uhi. Jesu in a upna uh a mu bepin ama in a pumzawpa kungah, “Ka ta aw; lungmuongin om in, na mawna mai zo hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu in Phalsi Khat Damsah (Mrk 2:1-12 ; Luk 5:17-26)"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham hil siete pawlkhat in, “Tampa in Pasien a gensie hi,” a kici uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanle Jesu in a ngaisutna uh thei a, “Bang dingin gitlo lungsim ngaisun na hi uh ahei? a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen, ‘Na mawnate kimaisah zo hi,’ ci ding le, ‘Tho inlen pei in,’ ci ding koi baizaw ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawmaisah thei nading thu nei hi, ci note in na thei nadingun,” a ci zaw ciengin ama in phal si mipa kungah, “Tho in, na lupna puo inlen na inn ah pei in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale tua pa tho-in a inn ah a pei hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihonpite in tam thu a mu uh ciengin lamdang a sa mama vua, amate in mihingte tunga tam bang thu neina a pie Pasien a phat uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khum mun panin Jesu a pei laitahin siehdonna zum sunga a to Matthew a kici mi khat mu hi; ama kungah, “Ei zui in,” a ci hi. Tuale ama dingto-in a zui pai hi.","title":"Matthew Kihlatna (Mrk 12:13-17 ; Luk 5:27-32)"},"10":{"text":"Inn sungah nitah an ne-in a to laitahin siehdongte le mawneite tampi pei-in ama le a nuazuite tawh a toton uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pharisee-te in tam thu a mu ciengun amate in a nuazuite kungah, “Bang dinga na siepa un siehdongte le mawneite tawh an neton ahei?” a ci uhi.","ref":"Luk 15:1-2"},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in tam thu a zah ciengin, “Sievuon a tulmaw pen cidamte hi loin cinate ahi zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Pei unlen, ‘Keima lunggul pen biehpiehna hi loin lainatna hizaw hi,’ a kici khu bang a cinopna ahei, va kan ta un. Azieh pen midihte hlan dinga ang pei ka hi sih a, mawneite hlan dinga ang pei ka hizaw hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 12:7; Hos 6:6"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah John’ nuazuite pei a, “Bang dinga kote le Pharisee-te in an tang zelzel napi, na nuazuite in tang lo uh ahei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Antanna Thudawhna (Mrk 2:18-22 ; Luk 5:33-39)"},"15":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Zineipa tawh a omton laisie-un mopawi simte a da thei ding uh amah? Amate kung panin zineipa a kilah hun ang tung ding a, tua hun ciengin amate in an a tang ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Koima in puonbeh tha tawh puonlui phaw ngai lo hi, azieh pen a kiphawna puonbeh in puonlui kai-eh ding a, a ehbe zaw ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Koima in savun um lui sungah lenggazu tha thal ngai lo hi; a thal khah leh tua lenggazu in savun um phukehin kibuo ding a, savun um zong kisie ding hi; savun um tha sungah lenggazu tha kithalzaw a, tuaci’n a ni-in kisawtkoi thei hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in tam thute amate kungah a gen laitahin thakhatthu-in kikhopna inn uhpa khat va pei-in ama mai ah khupdin a, “Ka tanu tu mama-in si ta; hinanle hing pei inlen a tungah na khut hing nga lacin a hingkia ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Numeino Khat Kihingsah, Nupi khat Kidamsah (Mrk 5:21-43 ; Luk 8:40-56)"},"19":{"text":"Jesu zong ding pai-in a nuazuite tawh ama a zui hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin thakhatthu-in kum sawm le kum ni sung siluong natna vei numei khat a nua lamah pei-in a puontuol mongtep a tham hi."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen a puontuol beh va khoi kha ta leng ka dam ta ding hi,” ci-in a ngaisun hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu zong kinuahei-in tua nu a mu ciengin ama in, “Ka tanu aw, lungmuongin om in; na upna in ang damsah zo ta hi,” a ci hi. Tuale thakhatthu-in numei nu a dam pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Ulienpa’ inn ah Jesu a tun ciengin theile tum mite le mihonpi gamlum pialpual a mu ciengin"},"24":{"text":"ama in, “Kipei ta un; azieh pen numeino a si ahi sih a, a kimu ahi bo hi,” a ci hi. Tuale mihonpite in ama a nuisan uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pulamah mihonpite a kipusuosah zaw ciengin a sungah ama tum a, a khut tawh a kai leh tua numeino a thoto hi."},"26":{"text":"Tam thu kigen pen tua gamkuom tengah kizelmang hi."},"27":{"text":"Khum panin Jesu a peidawh ciengin mittaw ni in a nua-ah zui-in, “David’ Tapa aw, kote ei khuotuo bo ven!” ci-in nahpi-in a kiko uhi.","title":"Jesu in Mittaw Ni Damsah"},"28":{"text":"Inn sungah a lut ciengin ama kungah mittaw tegel a pei uhi; tuale Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Tami bawl thei dingin nei um vuoi mah? a ci hi. Ama gel in ama kungah, “Ingheh, Topa ” a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a mit uh thampieh a, “Na upna uh dung zui-in na tung vuah pieng taheh,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale a mit un khuo a mu pai lien hi. Tua ciengin Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Tam thu koima theisah sih gel in,” ci-in khautahin thu a pie hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama gel pei-in tua gamkuom tengah ama’ thu a thezah uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ama gel a pei zaw ciengun dawivei a ham thei lo mi khat ama kungah kipeipi hi.","title":"Jesu in a Ham theilo Mi Khat Damsah"},"33":{"text":"Dawi a kinawmang zaw ciengin a ham thei lo mipa a ham thei pai hi; tuale mihonpite in lamdang a sa mama vua, “Israel gam sungah tam bang thu a pieng ngai nai sih hi,” a ci uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharisee-te in, “Dawimangpa’ vang tawh dawite kinotmang hi bo,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:25; 12:24; Mrk 3:22; Luk 11:15"},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuopite le khuotate zosie-ah Jesu pei kawikawi a, a kikhopna uh innte ah thuhilin, vantung gam tawh kisai lungdamna thute tangko-in natna satna namkim a damsah hi.","title":"Anlah ding Tam, Nasem ding Tawm","ref":"Mat 4:23; Mrk 1:39; Luk 4:44"},"36":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite a mu ciengin a cing om lo tuute bangin cimaw le gimthuohin a om ziehun hepihuoi a sa mama hi.","ref":"Gam 27:17; 1Kum 22:17; 2Khg 18:16; Ezk 34:5; Zech 10:2; Mrk 6:34"},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Anlah ding tam mama a, ahi vangin nasem ding mi tawm mama hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama’ an a la dingin an nei Topa in nasemte ang sawl nadingin thu ngen un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 10:2"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a nuazui sawm le nite hlan a, hlabuate a nawmang thei nading ule natna satna namkim a damsah thei nadingun amate tungah thuneina a pie hi.","title":"Sawltahpi Sawm le Nite (Mrk 3:13-19 ; Luk 6:12-16)"},"2":{"text":"Tam teng pen sawltahpi sawm le nite’ min ahi hi: A masa penin, Peter zong a kici pa Simon, a sanggampa Andrew; Zebedee’ tapa James, le a sanggampa John;"},"3":{"text":"Philip le Bartholomew; Thomas le siehdongpa Matthew; Alphaeus’ tapa James, le Thaddaeus;"},"4":{"text":"Canaan-te Simon, le ama a leheh Judas Iscariot-te ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu in tami mi sawm le nite tam bang thupiehna tawh a sawl hi: Gentile-te lah heima sungah pei loin Samaria-te khuo ah zong lut sih unlen,","title":"Sawm le Nite a Kisawlna (Mat 6:7-13 ; Luk 9:1-6)"},"6":{"text":"Israel innkuon a mangthai tuute kungah peizaw un."},"7":{"text":"Na pei kawmun, ‘Vantung gam ang tung bai ta ding hi’ ci-in lungdamna thu tangko un."},"8":{"text":"Cinate damsahin misite thosah unlen, miphahte damsahin dawite notmang un. Man pie loin na nga uhi; man ngen loin na pie un."},"9":{"text":"Na kawnggah sung vuah kham ahi a, ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin vom sih unlen,"},"10":{"text":"na khuolzinna vuah thung-ip hile, songkhol ni hile, kedap hile, ciengkhut hile keng sih un; bang ding ahei cile nasemte pen neh mu dinga kilawm mawng ahi bo uhi.","ref":"1Cor 9:14; 1Tim 5:18"},"11":{"text":"Khuopi ahi a, khuota ahi zongin na lut ciengun na tunna ding uh a kilawm kan unlen, na pei masangsie uh khumnah om den un."},"12":{"text":"Inn sung na lut ciengun hopi masa un."},"13":{"text":"Tua inn tunna lawm ahileh amate tungah na thupha uh tung taheh; tunna lawm lo ahileh na thupha uh noma’ tungah kilekia taheh."},"14":{"text":"Koima khat beh in ang tunsah nop sih a, na thugente uh a ngai nop sih leh, tua inn ahi sihle tua khuo na nuasie ciengun na keng vua leivuite thingkhie un.","ref":"Sawl 13:51"},"15":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, thukhen ni ciengin tua khuomite sangin Sodom le Gomorrah khuomite’ thuohna thuoh nuomzaw tham ding hi.","ref":"Mat 11:24; Pien 19:24-28; Luk 10:4-12"},"16":{"text":"En un, ngiehon lahah tuu kihla bangin note kang sawl hi; tuaci’n gul bangin pilvang unlen vakhu bangin nunnem un.","title":"Ang tung ding Bawlsietnate (Mrk 13:9-13 ; Luk 21:12-17)","ref":"Luk 10:3"},"17":{"text":"Thukhenna zumah note hing tutin a kikhopna uh inn sungah hing satgawp ding ahi ziehin amate na kidawm un;"},"18":{"text":"tuale keima ziehin gam-uhte le kumpite mai-ah thusit dingin ang kikai ding a, amate mai le Gentile-te mai-ah teci na hi ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Thusitna thuoh dingin ang kipeipi ciengin bangci genin bang gen ding ka hei ci lunghimaw sih un; azieh pen khum hun ciengin note tungah na gen ding uh ang kihil ding hi,"},"20":{"text":"bangzieh ahei a gen ding no hi loin no tungtawnin na Pa uh’ Hlagau in ang gen ding ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Mrk 13:9-11; Luk 12:11-12; 21:12-15"},"21":{"text":"Unau le unau, a pa le a ta, thalup ding za dongin a kileheh ding vua, tate in zong nu le pate thalup dingin a langpan ding uhi.","ref":"Mrk 13:12; Luk 21:16"},"22":{"text":"Keima’ min ziehin mi zosie in ang muda ding uhi. Ahi vangin a tawpna donga a thuoh zote kihundam ding hi.","ref":"Mat 24:9, 13; Mrk 13:13; Luk 21:17"},"23":{"text":"Khuo khatah ang bawlsiet uleh khuodang khatah tai un; azieh pen a tahtah a kang ci-in, Mihing Tapa ang pei masangin Israel khuote na tuonkim zo sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Nuazui khat pen a siepa tungah om lo a, nasem khat zong a pupa tungah om lo hi.","ref":"Luk 6:40; Jhn 13:16; 15:20"},"25":{"text":"Nuazui khat pen a siepa tawh a kibah a, nasem khat zong a pupa tawh a kibah leh pha zo hi. Inntehpa bawn Beelzabul a ci uleh a innkuonpite tua sangin a min a siesah zaw sih ding uh amah!","ref":"Mat 9:34; 12:24; Mrk 3:22; Luk 11:15"},"26":{"text":"“Tuaci’n amate giing sih un; azieh pen a kilang lo dinga a kiphuol bangma om lo a, a kithei lo dinga a ki-im zong bangma om lo hi.","title":"Koi Ahei Giin ding (Luk 12:2-7)","ref":"Mrk 4:22; Luk 8:17"},"27":{"text":"Khuomiel sunga ka thugente khuovah ah gen un; na bil kawm vua ang kidapgen na thuzahte uh, innkhumvum panin tangko un."},"28":{"text":"Tahsa a tha thei vangin hlagau a that thei lote na giing sih unlen, hell sunga tahsa le hla a ni-a a susie thei pa na giingzaw un."},"29":{"text":"Vato ni ciengin paisa khat tawh kizua lel hi lo amah? Hinanle na Pa uh’ deina a op sih leh tuate lahah khat beh tuolah kiesuh lo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Na lu tung vua samzamte nangawn kisim sieng zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin zau sih un; vato tampi sangin na manphazaw uhi."},"32":{"text":"“Tua ahi ziehin midangte mai-a ei hum mi zosie, vantung ka Pa mai-ah ken zong ka hum ding hi;"},"33":{"text":"ahi vangin midangte mai-a ei nuol poma ken zong vantung ka Pa mai-ah ka nuol ding hi.","ref":"2Tim 2:12"},"34":{"text":"“Leitung ah kilemna puoh dinga ang pei hi, ci-in ei ngaisun sih un; kilemna puoh dinga ang pei ka hi sih a, namsau leh dinga ang pei ka hizaw hi.","title":"Kilemna hi lo, Namsau (Luk 12:51-53 ; 14:26-27)"},"35":{"text":"Azieh pen tapa le a pa, tanu le a nu, mo le innpinu a kidosah dinga ang pei ka hi hi."},"36":{"text":"Mi khat’ gal pen a innkuonpi sung pan hi ding hi.","ref":"Mic 7:6"},"37":{"text":"Kei sanga a nu a pa a itzaw poma kei tawh kilawm lo hi; kei sanga a tapa a tanu a it zaw poma zong kei tawh kilawm lo hi;"},"38":{"text":"tuale a singlamte puo-a ka nua ei zui lo poma kei tawh kilawm lo hi.","ref":"Mat 16:24; Mrk 8:34; Luk 9:23"},"39":{"text":"A hinna uh a mute in a tanlaw ding vua, keima zieha a hinna uh a tanlawte in a mu ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 16:25; Mrk 8:35; Luk 9:24; 17:33; Jhn 12:25"},"40":{"text":"“No ang sang poma kei ei sang hi pai a, kei ei sang poma in kei ei sawlpa zong a sang pai ahi hi.","title":"Thaman (Mrk 9:41)","ref":"Luk 10:16; Jhn 13:20; Mrk 9:37; Luk 9:48"},"41":{"text":"Kamsang pa khat kamsang ahi zieha a sang poma in kamsangpa’ thaman nga ding a, midih khat a dih zieha a sang poma in midihte’ thaman a nga ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, tami naupangnote lahah khat popo keima’ nuazui ahina ziehin tuivot hai khat nangawn a pie poma in a thaman uh nga loin a om sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in a nuazui sawm le nite thu a hil zaw ciengin tua mun panin a khuopite vuah thuhil ding le thugen dingin a pei hi."},"2":{"text":"Messiah’ silbawlte John in thong sung pan a zah ciengin ama’ nuazuite sawlin","title":"Baptize-pa John’ Kamtaite (Luk 7:18-35)"},"3":{"text":"ama kungah, “Ang pei ding kicipa nang na mah, awleh adang khat ka na kinem lai ding vuoi?” cisah hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Va pei unlen John kungah na zahsa ule na musa uh thu teng va gen ta un:"},"5":{"text":"Mittawte in khuo mu a, khelbaite lam pei-in miphahte kidamsah a, bilbingte in khuoza-in misite kithosah a, mizawngte in lungdamna thu a za uhi.","ref":"Isa 35:5-6; 61:1"},"6":{"text":"Keima tunga a lungkie lo poma thupha nga ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a pei laitahun John’ thu gen dingin Jesu a kipan hi: Bang en dinga gamlaha pei na hi vuoi? Hui’ sem a, a zam kawikawi pumpeng amah?","title":"Jesu in Baptize-pa John Phat"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi sihle bang en dinga pusuoh na hi uh ahei? Puon hoi sil mi pawlkhat en nuom na hi uh amah? En un, puon hoi silte kumpipa inn sungah om uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahile bang pen en dinga pusuoh na hi vuoi? Kamsangpa khat amah? Hi hi, ke’n kang ci-in, kamsangpa sangin lienzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"‘En in, na masangah ka kamtaipa ka sawl ding a, ama in na mai-ah na pei nading lampi a na sielkhol ding hi,’ ci-a kigiel pa khu tampa ahi hi.","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"11":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, numeite sung panin a suohte lahah Baptize-pa John sanga a lienzaw koima a om sih hi; hizongle vantung gam sungah a neu pen nangawn ama sangin lienzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Baptize-pa John hun a kipan tuni dongin vantung gam in zawthaw bawlna na thuoh a, tua mi zothawte in thagum hatna a suong uhi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile John hun dongin kamsangte zosie le thukham in a na magen zo ta hi;","ref":"Mal 4:5; Luk 16:16"},"14":{"text":"tam thu na san nuom uleh ama pen ang pei ding Elijah ahi hi.","ref":"Mal 4:5; Mat 17:10-13; Mrk 9:11-13"},"15":{"text":"Zah nading bil nei tapo in za taheh!"},"16":{"text":"“Tam khang mite bang tawh gente bep ding ka hei?"},"17":{"text":"Vanzuana munah amate to a, ‘Theile ka tum vangun na lam nuom sih uhi; kaa la ka sah vangun na kap nuom tuon sih uhi,’ ci-a khatlekhat a kigal hlat naupangte tawh a kibang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen bangma ne lo dawn loin John ang pei-in amate in, “Dawi lawmnei pa hi,’ a ci uhi;"},"19":{"text":"Mihing Tapa ang pei ciengin ne-in dawn a, ‘En un, anhai zuhai pa, siehdongte le mawneite’ guolpa,’ ci zel uhi. Ahi vangin pilna pen a sepnate in a man ahina lah hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin na lamdang a bawlna khuopite a kisiakia lo ziehun Jesu in tua khuomite a hosie hi.","title":"A Kisia Lo Khuopite Thuoh Ding Gimna (Luk 10:13-15)"},"21":{"text":"“Chorazin khuopi aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Bethsaida khuopi aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Bangzieh ahei cile na sung vua kibawl vanglietna nasepnate, Tyre le Sidon khuo-a kibawl hi poma leh sawtlaipi-in la-ip puon silin vut kibuohin a kisiakia zo ta ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Ezk 26:1–28:26; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:2-4"},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, thukhen ni ciengin no thuoh ding sangin Tyre le Sidon khuote thuohna nuomzaw lai ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale nang, Capernaum aw, vantung dongin ang kitawisang ding amah? Hi lo hi, Misikhuo dongah ang kikhiesuh ding hi. Azieh pen nang tunga ang kibawl na lamdangte, Sodom khuo-a kibawl hi poma leh tuni dongin tua khuopi om lai ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:13-15; Pien 19:24-28"},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, thukhen ni ciengin no thuoh ding sangin Sodom thuohna nuomzaw lai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:15; Luk 10:12"},"25":{"text":"Khum hunin Jesu in, “Lei le van Topa ka Pa aw, tam thute mipilte le misiemte na im a, naupangte tungah tam thute na lah ziehin nangma tungah nuomthu kang tut hi;","title":"Jesu in a Pa tungah Lungdamko"},"26":{"text":"hi hi, ka Pa, tam bang pen na hepina zala nangma’ deina ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka Pa in keima tungah na vannuoi ei ap zo ta hi; tuale pa simlo Tapa a thei koima om lo a, Tapa le ama a lah thei nadinga Tapa in a teel mite simlo Pa a thei koima om lo hi.","ref":"Jhn 3:35; 1:18; 10:15"},"28":{"text":"“Vangih puo a, a gim mi zosie aw, ka kungah hing pei un, toidamna kang pie ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka hahkol puo unlen keima kungah hing kisin un; azieh pen kei khu mi nunnem le mi kiniemkhieh pa ka hi a, note in na hlagau adingin toidamna na nga ding uhi.","ref":"Jer 6:16"},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen ka hahkol a puohnop a, ka van zong a zang hi,” a ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Jesu in sabbath ni-in mangbu lei nawhin a pei hi; a nuazuite a gil uh kiel a, amate in a neh dingun buvui a zut uhi .","title":"Sabbath Ni-in Buvui Zutna (Mrk 2:23-28 ; Luk 6:1-5)","ref":"Thkna 23:25"},"2":{"text":"Pharisee-te in a mu bepun ama kungah, “En in, sabbath ni-in thukham tawh kituoh loin na nuazuite a gamta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “David le a guolte a gilkiel laitahun a gamtatna uh na sim ngai sih uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Pasien’ biehinn sungah lutin ama le a guolte neh dinga kilawm lo, siempute beh neh thei ahi Ompina anlum a ne uhi.","ref":"1Sam 21:1-6; Siem 24:9"},"5":{"text":"Ahi sihle biehinn sunga om siempute in sabbath a tan lo vangun khiel a tang tuom sih uhi, ci thu thukham sungah na sim ngai sih uh amah?","ref":"Gam 28:9-10"},"6":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, tam munah biehinnpi sanga a lienzaw khat a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin, ‘Biehpiehna ka dei sih a, khuotuona ka deizaw hi,’ ci thu a khietna thei locin khielna nei lote na mawmat sih ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 9:13; Hos 6:6"},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Mihing Tapa khu sabbath ni uhpa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum mun pan pei-in a kikhopna inn vuah a lut hi;","title":"A Khutzaw Mi Khat (Mrk 3:1-6 ; Luk 6:6-11)"},"10":{"text":"tua tahah a khutzaw mi khat om a, amate in a mawsah thei nadingun ama kungah, “Sabbath ni-in cina damsah ding a kilawm ma amah? ci-in a dong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Note lahah mi khat in tuu khat nei hinlen, sabbath ni-in dum sungah kie leh; tua tuu va kai-in na lakhie sih ding uh amah?","ref":"Luk 14:5"},"12":{"text":"Tuu sangin mihing bangza tahin manphaw zaw ahei! Tuaci’n sabbath ni-in sil hoi sep ding kilawm hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin khutzaw pa kungah, “Na khut zah vawi,” a ci hi. Ama in a khut a zah leh alang khat bangin dam sieng pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharisee-te peikhie-in ama tha nading a geldap uhi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu in tam thu a thei bepin kihemkhie hi. Mi tampite in ama a zui uhi, tuale ama in a natna zosie uh damsah a,","title":"Pasien’ Teel Nasempa"},"16":{"text":"koima kungah ama’ thu a gen lo nadingun thu a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam pen kamsangpa Isaiah tungtawna kigen:"},"18":{"text":"“Ka it mama, ei lungdamsah, ka teelsa ka nasempa tanah om hi. Ama tungah ka hlagau ka koi ding a, ama in Gentile-te tungah thutang a tangko ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi tawh kisel loin awsang tawh kiko lo ding a, gawl dung lahah zong a aw kiza lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in thutang a guolzawsah masangsie, a zamsa pumpeng hliehtawng lo ding a, a kuong pimpem meivah detna gui zong mitsah lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’ minin Gentile mite a kinem ding uhi, ci thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 42:1-4"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in mittawt le ham thei lo a thuo dawivei mi khat ama kungah a peipi uhi; tuale ham thei-in khuo a mu thei nadingin ama in tua mipa a damsah hi.","title":"Jesu le Beelzebul (Mrk 3:20-30 ; Luk 11:14-23)"},"23":{"text":"Mihonpite zosie in lamdang a sa vua, “Tampa David’ Tapa ahi thei kha diei izaw?” a ci uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hizongle Pharisee-te in tam thu a zah ciengun, “Dawimangpa Beelzebul suongin dawigilote a hawlkhiet ahi bo hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 9:34; 10:25"},"25":{"text":"Ama in a ngaisutna uh thei a, amate kungah, “Amau le amau kido-in a kikhenthang gam zosie mangthai ding a, khuopi ahi a, innkuon khat ahi zongin ama le ama kido-in a kikhenthang leh a kip zo sih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Satan in Satan notmang leh ama le ama a kikhenthang ahi hi; tua hile ama’ gam bangci kip thei ding ahei?"},"27":{"text":"Beelzebul suongin dawite a notmang ka hi leh na nawmang uh dawite in koi suongin tuate notmang uh ahei? Tua ahi ziehin amate pen note tungah thukhente a suoh ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ Hlagau tawh dawigilote a notmang ka hi leh note tungah Pasien’ manggam ang tung ahi ta hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi sihle koi in mi thahatpa lep-ia masa lopi-in a inn bulu-in a neisate lahpieh thei ding ahei? A lep-ia zaw ciengin a inn sung bulu thei pan ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Kei lama pang lo poma kei ei langpang ahi a, kei ei kaikhoppi lo poma a thethang ahi hi.","ref":"Mrk 9:40"},"31":{"text":"Tua ziehin ke’n kang ci-in, mi mawna vannuoi le Pasien a gensietnate uh kimaisah ding a, hizongle Hlagau langpangin a gensiete kimaisah lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Mihing Tapa langpanga thugente kimaisah ding a, ahi vangin Hlagau Siengtho langpanga thugen poma tu khangah ahi a, ang tung ding khangah ahi zongin kimaisah lo ding hi.","ref":"Luk 12:10"},"33":{"text":"“A kung a hoi leh a ga hoi hi, na ci unlen a kung a hoi sih leh a ga zong hoi lo hi, na ci un; azieh pen singkung a ga tawh kithei thei hi.","title":"Singkung le a Ga (Luk 6:43-45)","ref":"Mat 7:20; Luk 6:44"},"34":{"text":"No muoltan suonte aw! Migilo na hi ciengun sil hoi bang na ci gen thei ding uh ahei? Azieh pen lungsim sunga a dimlet thute kam tawh a genkhiet ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 3:7; 23:33; Luk 3:7; Mat 15:18; Luk 6:45"},"35":{"text":"Mihoi pa in sil hoi kholna panin a hoite suokhie a, migilo pa in sil hoi lo kholna panin a hoi lote a suokhie hi."},"36":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, note in na thu motgente zosie uh ziehin thukhen ni ciengin thusitna na thuoh ding uhi;"},"37":{"text":"azieh pen na thugente ziehin dih na tang ding a, na thugente zieh ma-in mawsahna na thuoh ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham hil sie pawlkhat le Pharisee-te in ama kungah, “Siepa aw, “Nang tung panin lim lamdang khat ka mu nuom uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Jonah’ Lim (Mrk 8:11-12 ; Luk 11:29-32)","ref":"Mat 16:1; Mrk 8:11; Luk 11:16"},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in amate kungah, “A gilo le angkawm hat khang mite in lim lamdang sui a, ahi vangin amate tungah kamsang Jonah’ lim losie bangma lim kipie lo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 16:4; Mrk 8:12"},"40":{"text":"Azieh pen ngapi gil sungah Jonah sun thum le zan thum a op ma bangin Mihing Tapa zong lei sungah sun thum le zan thum a om ding hi.","ref":"Jon 1:17"},"41":{"text":"Thukhen ni ciengin tami khangmite langah Nineveh mite dingin a mawsah ding uhi, azieh pen Jonah’ thuhilna ziehin amate a kisiakia uhi, tuale en un, tam tahah Jonah sanga a lienzaw khat a om hi!","ref":"Jhn 3:5"},"42":{"text":"Thukhen ni ciengin tam khang mite langah Leitaw lam gam kumpinu dingin a mawsah ding hi, azieh pen tua nu in Solomon’ pilna thu ngai dingin leimong khat panin a pei hi, tuale en un, tam tahah Solomon sanga a lienzaw khat a om hi!","ref":"1Kum 10:1-10; 2Khg 9:1-12"},"43":{"text":"“Mi khat sung panin hlabua a pusuo zaw ciengin khawl nading mun sui-in tui op lona munah vah kawikawi a, ahi vangin khat beh a mu sih hi.","title":"Hlabua Lutkiana (Luk 11:24-26)"},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, ‘Ka puokhietna inn ma-ah kilekia bo vang,’ a ci hi. Ama a tun leh tua inn na awng a, kiphiet sieng sinsenin hoitaha om a mu hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin kilekia-in ama sanga a gilozaw hla dang sagi zawpi a, amate lutin tua sungah a teng uhi; tua mipa’ opdan nukhia pen a masa hun lai sangin a siezaw hi. Tami a gilo khangmite zong tua ma bangin a om ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Mihonpite tawh a kiho laitahin a nu le a sanggamte ama hopi nuomin a pulamah a ding uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Sanggam Tahtahte (Mrk 3:31-35 ; Luk 8:19-21)"},"47":{"text":"Mi khat in ama kungah, “En in, na nu le na sanggamte, ang hopi nuomin a pulamah ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in ama kunga tam thu a genpa kungah, “Ka nu koi hi a, ka sanggamte koi ahi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Ama in a nuazuite kawhin, “Tamte khu ka nu le ka sanggamte ahi hi!"},"50":{"text":"Azieh pen vantunga om ka Pa’ deina banga a gamta mi poma ka sanggam pasal, ka sanggam numei le ka nu ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in tua inn panin Jesu peikhie-in tuili gei-ah a to hi.","title":"Khaici Vawpa Thugentena (Mrk 4:1-9 ; Luk 8:4-8)"},"2":{"text":"A kimkot ah mihonpite a tam seng ziehin gunkuong sungah pei-in to a, mihonpite ahile tuili gei-ah a ding uhi.","ref":"Luk 5:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Tuale ama in amate kungah gentena tawh thu tampi a gen hi: Ngai un! Khaici vawpa khaici vaw dingin a kuon hi."},"4":{"text":"Khaici a vaw ciengin kimkhat lam lai-ah kie a, vate lengin a netum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khaici dangte suong tamna lei lahah kie a, leitang a thuh lo ziehin a popah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin ni a suo ciengin nisa kahin gawpmang hi; zung hla lo uh ahi ziehin vulnang sieng hi."},"7":{"text":"Khaici dangte ahile lingkawm lahah kie a, tua lingkungte khangin a depgawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Khaici dangte lei hoina munah kie a, pawlkhatte a za zakhat, pawlkhatte a za sawmguh, pawlkhatte a za sawmthumin ga hi."},"9":{"text":"Zah nading bil nei tapo in za ta uheh!” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nuazuite pei-in ama kungah, “Amate tungah bang dinga thugentena tawh thu na gen ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi.","title":"Thugentena’ Deina (Mrk 4:10-12 ; Luk 8:9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Note tungah Vantung gam thusimte theitheina ang kipieh vangin amate tungah kipie lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a neite kipiehbe ding a, tampitah nei ding hi; ahi vangin bangma nei lote kung panin a nei sun nangawn kilahpieh ding hi.","ref":"Mat 25:29; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18; 19:26"},"13":{"text":"Amate tungah thugentena tawh ka genna a hang pen, ‘Amate in enen napi mu thei loin, ngaingai napi a za thei sih vua, zong a tel thei sih uhi,’ a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Kamsang Isaiah a genkhol thute amate tungah a tung tahtah hi: ‘Na zaza ding vua, ahi vangin na thei zo sih ding uhi. ‘Na enen ding vua, ahi vangin na mu sih ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in a mit utawh en loin a bil utawh a za sih vua, a lungtang utawh thei siem loin kei lamah ang kihei lo nadingun, tam mite’ lungsim mawl mama a, a bilte un khuo za loin a mit a sing uhi,’ a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin na mit un mu-in na bil un a zah ziehin thupha nga na hi uhi."},"17":{"text":"A tahtahin kang ci-in, kamsangte le midih tampite in na sil mute uh mu nuom mama napi mu loin, na thuzahte uh za nuom mama napi a za sih uhi.","ref":"Luk 10:23-24"},"18":{"text":"“Tua ciengin khaici vawpa thugentena ngai un.","title":"Khaici Vawpa Thugentena Hilcienna (Mrk 4:13-20 ; Luk 8:11-15)"},"19":{"text":"Mi khatpo in Pasien gam thu za napi a theisiem sih leh, gilopa pei-in a lungtang sunga a kivawsate a lahpieh hi; tam bangte pen lampi dunga kitute ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Suong lahah kitute ahile mi pawlkhat in thu a zah behun lungdamin a pompai uhi;"},"21":{"text":"hinanle tua mipa zung thuh hla lo ahi ziehin bakhat sung beh hing a, tuami thu ziehin gimna ahi sihle bawlsietna a tun ciengin thakhatin a puakia pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Ling lahah kitute ahile thu za napi leitung lunghimawnate le hau nopnate in tua thute depgawp ahi ziehin a ga lote ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin lei hoina muna kitute ahile thu a zah ciengun a theitel pai mite ahi a, tuate a ga ga pai a, khatvei a za zakhat, khatvei a za sawmguh, khatvei a za sawmthum a ga mite ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah thugentena dang khat gen a: “Vantung gam pen ama’ lo lai-a khaici hoi a vaw mi khatpo tawh kigente thei hi;","title":"Mangbu Lahah Tamom tawh Gentena"},"25":{"text":"ahi vangin mi zosie a kimut kalin galpa khat pei-in mangbu lahah tamom vaw a, tua ciengin a pei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n ankungte khangin a ga ang ga a, tua zaw ciengin tamomte ang kidawh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuale inntehpa’ silate pei-in ama kungah, ‘Pu aw, na lo lai-ah khaici hoi vaw hi lo na mah? Tua ahile tam tamomte hei pana ang pei ahei?’ a ci uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Tua pen galpa khat’ bawl ahi hi,’ ci-in a dawng hi. Silate in ama kungah, “Tua ahile pei-in ka va bawmang ding uh nei awi ei mah’ a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in dawngkia a, ‘Bot sih un; azieh pen tamomte bot locin bu tawh na botton kha ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Anlah hun masangsie a nipi-in khangton tadi heh; anlah hun ciengin anlate kungah, ‘Tamomte khawm unlen haltum dingin lomhen un, ahi vangin bute khawmin ka ansal sungah khol un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah thugentena dang khat gen a: “Vantung gam pen mi khat in la-in a lo lai-a a vaw ankam tang tawh kibang hi.","title":"Ankamtang Thugentena (Mrk 4:30-32 ; Luk 13:18-19)"},"32":{"text":"Tua pen khaici zosie lahah a neu pen ahi vangin ang gol ciengin ankungte lahah golpen a, singkung ang suoh hi, tuaci’n vana leng vate in a bazamte tungah bu a tom uhi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah thugentena dang khat gen a: “Vantung gam pen numei khat in tol la-in bunel hai thum tawh sawhalin, a unpi-in a zel sieng masangsie-a a saw tol tawh kibang hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Tol Thugentena (Luk 13:20-21)"},"34":{"text":"Jesu in tam thute zosie thugentena tawh mipite kungah a gen hi; thugentena zang loin amate kungah bangma gen lo hi.","title":"Thugentenate a Zahna (Mrk 4:33-34)"},"35":{"text":"Tam pen kamsangpa tungtawna kigen: Thugentena tawh ka kam kahin thu ka gen ding hi; leitung piencila kipanin a ki-imcip thute ka genkhie ding hi,” ci thu a tangtunna ahi hi.","ref":"Late 78:2"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in mihonpite nuasie-in inn sungah a lut hi. Tuale a nuazuite in ama nehin, “Lo lai-a tamom thugentena ei hilcien in,” a ci uhi.","title":"Jesu in Tamom Thugentena Hilcien"},"37":{"text":"Ama in, “Khaici hoi vawpa pen Mihing Tapa ahi hi;"},"38":{"text":"lo lai pen leitung hi-in, khaici hoi pen kumpi gam sung tate ahi uhi; tamomte ahile gilopa’ tate ahi vua,"},"39":{"text":"tuate a vaw galpa pen dawimangpa ahi hi; anlah hun pen leitung hun tawp hun ahi a, anlate ahile vantung mite ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tamomte kibotin mei tawh a kihaltum ma bangin, leitung tawp hun ciengin tua bangin a pieng ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Mihing Tapa in a vantung mite sawl ding a, gam sungah mawna a piengsah mi zosie le sietna a bawl mite zosie a gam sung panin nil dawhin,"},"42":{"text":"amate in meikhuhpi sungah sep ding a, khum tahah kaana le hagawina a om ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin midihte ahile a Pa uh’ gam sungah ni bangin a tang ding uhi. Zah nading bil nei teng in za ta uheh!"},"44":{"text":"“Vantung gam pen lo lai-a a kiphuol gou tawh kibang a, mi khat in tua gou a mu ciengin phuoldap hi; tua ciengin lungdamin pei-in a neisa zosie zua-in tua lo a lei hi.","title":"Thugentena Thumte"},"45":{"text":"“Khat leuleu ah vantung gam pen kep manpha a sui sumbawlpa tawh kibang hi;"},"46":{"text":"a tam man mama kep khat a mu ciengin ama pei-in a neisa zosie zua-in tua kep a lei hi."},"47":{"text":"“Khat leuleu ah vantung gam pen tuipi sunga a kipai, nga namcin a awhna len tawh kibang hi;"},"48":{"text":"tua len a dim ciengin amate in pieu gei-ah kaikhie-in a tosuh vua, a hoi teng paai sungah guongin a hoi lo teng a paimang uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaci’n hun tawp ni ciengin tua bangin a pieng ding hi. Vantung mite hing pei-in midihte lah panin migilote khenkhie-in,"},"50":{"text":"meikhuhpi sungah amate sepsuh ding a, tua tahah kaana le hagawina om ding hi."},"51":{"text":"“Tam thute zosie na theikim ta vuoi mah?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Ingheh,” ci-in a dawng uhi.","title":"Gou Tha le Gou Lui"},"52":{"text":"Tuale ama in a kung vuah, “Tua ahi ziehin vantung gam adinga a kisinsa laitheite ahi ule a gou pana a tha le a lui a suokhie inntehpa tawh kibang hi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Jesu in tami thugentenate a gen zaw ciengin khum mun panin a peikhie hi."},"54":{"text":"Ama’ khuo a tun ciengin a kikhopna uh inn sungah mite thuhil kipan a, tuaci’n amate in lamdang sa-in, “Tam mipa in tam bang pilna le sil thupi bawl theinate hei sung pana a nga viel adiei?","title":"Nazareth ah Jesu a Kinuolna (Mrk 6:1-6 ; Luk 4:16-30)"},"55":{"text":"Khutsiempa’ tapa hi lel lo amah? A nu zong Mary kici nu hi lo amah? A sanggamte zong khu James, Joseph, Simon le Judas ahi sih uh amah?"},"56":{"text":"A sanggam numeite zosie zong eite tawh omton ahi sih uh amah? Tua ahile tam mipa in tam teng zosie hei pana a nga ahei?” a ci uhi."},"57":{"text":"Tuale amate in ama a nuol uhi. Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah, “Kamsangte amau’ gam le amau’ inn sung longal-ah zatahna nga loin a om sih uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 4:44"},"58":{"text":"Ama in a up lona uh ziehin khum sungah na lamdang tampi bawl lo hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hunin gam-uhpa Herod in Jesu’ thu a kigenna a za hi;","title":"Tuiphumpa John Sina (Mrk 6:14-29 ; Luk 9:7-9)"},"2":{"text":"tuale ama in a nasemte kungah, “Tam pa, baptize-pa John ahi hi; sina pana ang thokia hi ngel ding hi, tua ziehin na lamdang bawl theina vang nei hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Herod in a naupa Philip’ zi Herodias ziehin John man a, khau tawh henin thong sungah a khum hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum pen John in Herod kungah, “Tua nu na kinunpi kilawm lo hi,” a ci zieh ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 3:19-20; Siem 18:16; 20:21"},"5":{"text":"Herod in ama a tha nop vangin ama in mihonpite a giing hi, azieh pen amate in ama kamsang khatin ngaisun uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Herod’ suopawi ni a tun ciengin mipite mai-ah Herodias’ tanu a lam ziehin tua nu in Herod lungkimsah a,"},"7":{"text":"tuaci’n ama kiciemin tua nu nget popo pieh dingin kamciem hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua nu in a nu hil bangin, “Kuongdai khat sungah Baptize-pa John’ lutang tamtahah ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa da mama a, ahi vangin a kiciemnasa ahina zieh le a lenglate’ maitang a zatahna ziehin pieh dingin thu a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in mi sawlin thong sungah John’ lutang a tansah hi."},"11":{"text":"A lutang kuong tawh hing kitawi-in tua numeino kipie a, tua nu in a nu a piesawn hi."},"12":{"text":"A nuazuite pei-in a luong la-in a vui uhi; tua ciengin amate pei-in Jesu kungah a gen uhi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu in tam thu a zah ciengin gunkuong khatah tuongin tua mun panin gamdaina munah a kihemkhie hi. Ahi vangin mipite in tam thu a zah ciengun khuopite panin keng tawh pei-in a nua a zui uhi.","title":"Tul Nga Vahna (Mrk 6:30-44 ; Luk 9:10-17 ; Jhn 6:1-14)"},"14":{"text":"Tuipieu ah a tun ciengin ama in mihon tampi mu hi; tuale ama in amate khuotuo-in a cinate a damsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Khuomiel kuon ciengin ama kungah nuazuite pei-in, “Tam mun pen gamlah ahi a, i vaikai ta uhi; a neh ding uh lei dingin mihonte khuo sungah sawl dawh ta’n,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “A pei ding uh kisam sih; a neh ding uh bang po khat pie lel un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in, “Anlum nga le nga tawn ni simlo tanah bangma dang nei sih ung,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Tua teng tanah hing la ta vawi uh,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in mipite lopa tunga to dingin thu a pie hi. Ama in anlum nga le nga tawn ni la-in vantung lam ento-in lungdam ko a, anlumte phalsuo-in nuazuite a pie hi, tuale nuazuite in mipite a piesawn uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mi zosie in ne-in a gilva mama uhi; tuale a khawnla teng uh a neng a themin a khawmkia vua, seu sawm le seu ni a dim hi."},"21":{"text":"An ne mi pen numei le naupang simlo pasal cingteng mi tulnga bang pha hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite a peisah laitahin a nuazuite thakhatin gun kuong tungah tuongsah a, galkhat lamah a peisah masa hi.","title":"Jesu, Tui tungah Pei (Mrk 6:45-52 ; Jhn 6:16-21)"},"23":{"text":"Mihonpite a peisah zaw ciengin thungen dingin muol tungah ama tangin a peito hi. Khuo a miel ciengin tua tahah ama tangin a om hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin khumi hunin gunkuong pen lei panin gamlapi tung ta a, hui in amate a lemut ziehin tuihuolte in gunkuong a satsat hi."},"25":{"text":"Zingmawng phalvah hunin amate lam zuonin tui tungah ama a pei hi."},"26":{"text":"Hizongle a nuazuite in tui tunga a pei ama a mu ciengun, “Thadam a khula!” ci-in zausi-in a awng uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanle Jesu in thakhatin amate hopi a, “Na lungsim hangsah un, keima ka hi bo hi; zau sih un,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Peter in, “ Topa aw, tua khu nang na hi ngel leh kei zong na kung zuonin tui tunga kang pei nading thu ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in, “Hing pei in,” a ci hi.
