Tuaci’n gunkuong tung panin Peter kumin Jesu lam zuonin tui tungah a pei hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin hui husiepi a mu ciengin zau-in tui sungah tumsuh dihtah a, tua bepin ama in, “ Topa aw, ei hun ven!” ci-in a kiko hi."},"31":{"text":"Jesu in thakhatin a khut tawh zamin man phei pai a, ama kungah, “Upna neu mipa aw, bang dinga lunghimaw na hei?” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Gunkuong tung a kato ciengun tua hui a theu pai hi."},"33":{"text":"Gunkuong sunga om teng in, “Pasien’ Tapa tahtah na hi hi,” ci-in ama a bie uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amate a galkai zaw ciengun Gennesaret gamah a tung uhi.","title":"Jesu in Gennesaret ah Cinate Damsah (Mrk 6:53-56)"},"35":{"text":"Khum muna mite in ama a theitel zaw ciengun amate in tua gam mun cintengah thu zasahin cina zosie ama kungah a peipi vua,"},"36":{"text":"tuale amate in ama’ puontuol tep nangawn a tham thei nadingun ama kungah a thum uhi; a thamkha zosie in damna a nga uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharisee-te le thukham hil siete, Jesu kungah a va pei ta vua,","title":"Tanglai Pu le Pate’ Ngaina (Mrk 7:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"“Na nuazuite in bang dinga tanglai upate’ ngaina a palsat uh ahei? Azieh pen an a neh ciengun a khut a sil masa sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Note in zong na tang ngaina uh na zui nop na lam vua bang dinga Pasien’ thupieh na palsat uh ahei?"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien in, ‘Na nu le na pa zatah in,’ ci-a, tuale, ‘A nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin a gensie poma a si valon ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:12; 21:17; Siem 20:9; Thkna 5:16"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in mi khatpo in a nu le a pa kungah, ‘Kei tung pana na nga ding uh huna poma Pasien tunga kipie ahi hi, a ci nah leh, tua pa in a pa a patawi ding kul nawn lo hi,’ na ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n tang ngaina na zui ziehun note in Pasien’ thu na phietmang uhi."},"7":{"text":"No mihoi kipangte! Isaiah in note tawh kisai-in thu a na genkholna khu:"},"8":{"text":"“Tam mite in a kampi utawh kei ei zatah bawl vua, ahi vangin a lungtang uh kei tawh a kigamla hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in mihingte’ bawltawm ngainate, zui ding ngaina bangin a hil vua, a mawhna-in kei ei bie uhi,’ a ci pen a man ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 29:13"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in mihonpite ama kungah hlan a, “Ngai unlen theisiem un:","title":"Mi Buasahthei Nate (Mrk 7:14-23)"},"11":{"text":"Kam sunga a tumsuh nate in mi buasah lo a, kam sung pana a pusuoh nate in mi buasah zaw hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin nuazuite in ama nehin a kungah, “Pharisee-te in na thugen a zah ciengun a lungkim lo lam uh na thei ei mah?” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “ Vantunga om ka Pa in a suon lo singkung kici poma kibotmang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate donin zong nei da un; mittaw le mittaw lam kihilte ahi uhi. Mittaw khat in mittaw dang khat lam hil leh, a ni gelin guom sungah kie ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 6:39"},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter in ama kungah, “Tami thugentena ko ei hilcien in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Note in zong theitel nai lo na hi uh amah?"},"17":{"text":"Kam sunga a tumsuh poma gilpi sungah tumsuh a, khum panin a pusuo lam na thei sih uh amah?"},"18":{"text":"Kam sung pana a pusuohte lungtang pana ang pieng hi a, tuami in mi buasah hi.","ref":"Mat 12:34"},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen lungtang panin ngaisutna hoi lote, tuol thana, numei-pasal pahtatna, angkawmna, guhtatna, zuou teci panna le mi gensietna- te ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tamte mi buasah thei nate hi a, ahi vangin khut sil lo-a an nehna in mi buasah lo hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in khum mun nuasie-in Tyre le Sidon gam sung tengah a pei hi.","title":"Canaan Numei’ Upna (Mrk 7:24-30)"},"22":{"text":"Tua zaw behin khum gam panin numei khat a va pei ta a, “David’ tapa, Topa aw, ei hepi in; dawi gilo khat in ka tanu bawlsie hi,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in tua nu a dawng vawt sih hi. Tuale a nuazuite pei-in, “Tua nu in i nua ei zui-in a kikoko ziehin ama peisah dawh ta’n,” ci-in a hanthawn uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in, “Israel innkuon a mangthai tuute kung beha ei kisawl ahi bo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua nu pei-in a mai-ah khupdin a, Topa aw, ei hu bo ven,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in, “Tate’ neh ding an lahpiehin uite pieh ding kilawm lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Hi ma hi, Topa aw, ahi vangin uite nangawn in a pute’ sabuoi pana a kie annengte a ne uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua bepin tua nu kungah, “Numei aw, na upna lien mama ei! Na deina bangin nang adingin pieng taheh,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tuale thakhatthu-in a tanu a dam pai hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu in khum mun a nuasie zaw ciengin Galilee Tuipi dung kantanin pei a, tuale muol tungah kato-in a to hi.","title":"Jesu in Mi Tampi Damsah"},"30":{"text":"Ama kungah mihon tampi tah pei-in khelbaite, a poite, mittawte, a ham thei lote, le adang tampi tah a peipi uhi. Amate in ama’ keng phungah tuate a koi vua, ama in tuate a damsah hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n a ham thei lote hamin, a poite dam sieng a, khelbaite lam pei-in, mittawte in khuo a mukia theina thu mihonpite in a mu uh ciengin lamdang a sa uhi. Tuale amate in Israel Pasien a phat uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah a nuazuite hlan a, “Mihonpite ka khuotuo hi, azieh pen ka kunga a om zaw uh tu-in ni thum pha ta a, a neh ding uh bangma a nei sih uhi; tuale lamkalah basam kha thei ding uh ahi ziehin gilkielsa-in amate ka peisah nuom sih hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Tul Li Vahna (Mrk 8:1-10)"},"33":{"text":"Nuazuite in ama kungah, “Tam bang gamlahah mihon tam zapi vah nading a kicing an hei pana i nga ding ahei?” a ci uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Anlum bangza na nei vuoi?” ci-in dong hi. Amate in, “Lum sagi le nga neu halkhat om hi,” a ci uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in lei lahah mihonpite a to nadingun thu a pie hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuale ama in anlum sagi le nga la-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin phalsuo-in nuazuite kungah pie a, tuale nuazuite in zong mihonpite tungah a piesawn uhi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un ne-in a gil uh a va mama hi; tuale a khawnla teng uh a neng a themin a khawm uleh seu sagi a dim hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua an nete numei le naupang simlo mi tul li pha hi."},"39":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite a pei dinga a sawl zaw ciengin gunkuong tungah kato-in Magadan gamah a pei hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu ze-et dingin Pharisee-te le Sadducee-te pei-in van panin amate lim khat a lah nadingin ama kungah a ngen uhi.","title":"Lim Khat Kalhna (Mrk 8:11-13 ; Luk 12:54-56)","ref":"Mat 12:38; Luk 11:16"},"2":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Nitah ciengin, ‘Meiisan suoh ahi ziehin khuo ko ding hi,’ na ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin, ‘Meiisan suohin meii a niim ziehin tuni-in huipi lang ding hi,’ na ci uhi. Note in van omzie na gen thei vangun hun lahna limte na theithei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"A gilo le angkawm khang mite in lim lamdang ngen uhi, ahi vangin amate tungah Jonah’ lim longal bangma lim kipie lo ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin amate nuasie-in a peikhie hi.","ref":"Mat 12:39; Luk 11:29"},"5":{"text":"Nuazuite a galkhatah a tun ciengun an puoh ding a mangngil uhi.","title":"Pharisee-te le Sadducee-te’ Tol (Mrk 8:14-21)"},"6":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Pharisee-te le Sadducee-te’ tol panin kikem unlen pilvang un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 12:1"},"7":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat, “Anlum i puoh lo zieh hi va,” a kici uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu in tua thu a thei ciengin, “No upna neu mite aw, bang dinga anlum na nei lona thu uh kikum na hi uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Na phawh thei nai lai sih uh amah? Mi tul nga in anlum nga a khamval seu bangza na luoh vuoi?","ref":"Mat 14:17-21"},"10":{"text":"Ahi sihle mi tul li in anlum sagi a khamval seu bangza na luoh vuoi?","ref":"Mat 15:34-38"},"11":{"text":"Bangci-a an thu ka gen lo lam phawh thei talawm lo na hi uh ahei? Pharisee-te le Sadducee-te’ tol panin na kikem un!” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin anlum kisaw tol gen hi loin Pharisee-te le Sadducee-te’ thuhilna gen ahi zawh lam a phawh pan na bo uhi."},"13":{"text":"Caesarea Philippi gam sungah Jesu a tun ciengin, ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Mite in Mihing Tapa koi hi, ei ci vuoi?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu’ Thu a Pulahna (Mrk 8:27-30 ; Luk 9:18-21)"},"14":{"text":"Tuale, “Pawlkhat in Baptize-pa John hi, ang ci uhi; pawlkhat in Elijah hi, ang ci uhi; adang pawlkhatte leuleu in Jeremiah ahi sihle kamsang khat popo hi va, ang ci uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 14:1-2; Mrk 6:14-15; Luk 9:7-8"},"15":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Tua ahile note in kei koi hi, nei ci vuoi?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Simon Peter in, “Nang a hing zing Pasien Tapa Messiah na hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 6:68-69"},"17":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in ama kungah, “Jonah’ tapa Simon aw, thupha nga na hi hi! Azieh pen tam thu tahsa le sisan in ang theisah ahi sih a, vantunga a om ka Pa in nangma tunga ang theisah ahi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, nang Peter na hi a, tami suongpi tungah ka hlattuom pawlpi ka lam ding hi, Misi khuo kotpite in tua hlattuom pawlpi a zo sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Vantung gam tawhtangte nang kang pie ding a, leitunga na hen poma vantungah zong kihen ding a, leitunga na sut poma vantungah zong kisut ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 18:18; Jhn 20:23"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama Messiah ahi lamtah koima kungah a gen lo nadingun khautahin nuazuite thu a pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Jesu pei-in ama in upate, siempu liente, thukham hil siete khut sungah gimna lienpi thuoh valon ding a, tuale ama kithatin a ni thum ni-in kithosah ding hi, ci thute khum hun a kipanin a nuazuite a theisah hi.","title":"Jesu in a Si ding le a Thawkia ding Genkhol (Mrk 8:31–9:1 ; Luk 9:22-27)"},"22":{"text":"Tuale Peter in ama tuom peipi-in phawhsie a, “ Topa , Pasien in tam thu piengsah vawt sih heh! Nang tungah tam thu pieng ngai poma lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu kihei-in Peter kungah, “Satan, ka nua lamah kihem vawi! Pasien’ nate tungah na lungsim na koi sih a, mihing’ nate tungah na koi zawh ziehin kei adingin kipalpuana na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a nuazuite kungah, “Mi khatpo ka nuazui a suo nop leh, a deina nuolin a singlamte puo-in ei zui ta heh.","title":"Singlamte le Kidehtawmna","ref":"Mat 10:38; Luk 14:27"},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen amau’ hinna a hundam nuomte in a hinna uh tan ding a, keima zieha a hinna a taante in a hinna uh a mu ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; Luk 17:33; Jhn 12:25"},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in leitung buppi a nga vangin a hinna uh suplaw uleh bang phattuomna nga ding uh ahei? Ahi sihle a hinna uh bang tawh hleng theikia ding uh ahei?"},"27":{"text":"“Azieh pen a Pa’ minthanna vang le a vantung mite tawh Mihing Tapa ang pei ding a, tua ciengin ama in a sepna utawh kizui-in mi zosie a thuhkia ding hi.","ref":"Mat 25:31; Late 62:12; Rom 2:6"},"28":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, tam sunga a ding mi pawlkhat in a kumpi gam tawh Mihing Tapa ang pei a mu masangun sina a ciemkha sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni guh zaw ciengin Jesu in Peter, James le a nau John-te zawpi-in muol sang tung khatah a katopi hi.","title":"Mel Kikhelna (Mrk 9:2-13 ; Luk 9:28-36)"},"2":{"text":"Tuale amate mai-ah a mel kikhelin a mai ni bangin tang a, a puonsilte zong vam lihleh hi."},"3":{"text":"Khum tahah Moses le Elijah thakhatin kilang a, ama tawh a kiho uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in Jesu kungah, “ Topa aw, tam sunga i op ding uh a hoi hi; nei awi leh keima in tanah tenna ding buh thum, nang ading khat, Moses ading khat, Elijah ading khat kang lampieh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua banga thu a gen laitahin meiingo khat in amate tuommang a, tua meii lah panin, “Tam pa ka it mama ka Tapa ahi hi; ama tungah ka lung a kim hi; ama’ thu na ngai un!” ci-in aw khat a ging hi.","ref":"Pien 22:2; Late 2:7; Isa 42:1; Mat 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; Thkna 18:15; 2Pet 1:17-18"},"6":{"text":"Nuazuite in tami awging a zah ciengun zausi-in tuolah a khupbawh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu pei-in amate tham a, tho un, zau sih un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate a khuoda ciengun Jesu longal koima a mu sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Muol tung pan a kumsuh laitahun Jesu in amate kungah, “Sina panin Mihing Tapa a thawkia masangsie, na sil mute uh koima kungah gen sih un,” ci-in thu a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Nuazuite in ama kungah, “Tua ahile bang dinga thukham hil siete in Elijah ang pei masa ding hi, a ci uh ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi.","ref":"Mal 4:5"},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Elijah ang pei tahpi-in na zosie a bawlpha ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin note kunga kang ci-in, Elijah ang pei zo napi amate in a thei lo ziehun ama tungah a dei bangun a na bawl uhi. Tua ma bangin Mihing Tapa in zong amau’ khut sungah gimna a thuoh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 11:14"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Baptize-pa John’ thu a gen ahi lamtah nuazuite in a theitel pan uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mihonte kungah amate a tun ciengun ama kungah pasal khat pei-in a mai-ah khupdin a,","title":"Dawivei Naupang Khat Damsahna (Mrk 9:14-29 ; Luk 9:37-43)"},"15":{"text":"“ Topa aw, ka tapa hing khuotuo in; azieh pen ama bupsi-in a gim mama hi; meikhuh sung le tui sungah a pua zelzel hi."},"16":{"text":"Na nuazuite kungah ka peipi vangin amate in a damsah zo sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu in, “No upna nei lo a letat khangmite aw, note tawh bang tanve hing om ding ka hei? Bang tanvei note hing thuohpi ding ka hei? Ka kungah ama hing peipi un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Jesu in dawi a hosiet ciengin a kung panin ama pusuoh a, thakhatin naupang pa dam pai hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu kungah nuazuite pei dapin, “Bang dinga tua dawi ka hawlkhiet zo lo uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Na upna uh a neu zieh ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile a tahtah a kang ci-in, ankam tang cie upna na nei nah uleh tami muolpi kungah, ‘Tam panin khum tahah kikhin in,’ ci locin a kikhin ding hi; note adingin a pieng thei lo bangma a om sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat 21:21; Mrk 11:23; 1Cor 13:2"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in thungetna le antanna longal tawh tam bang namte kihawlkhie zo lo hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Galilee gamah a kikhop laitahun Jesu in amate kungah, “Mihingte khut sungah Mihing Tapa kileheh ding a,","title":"Jesu in a Si ding le a Thawkia ding Genkhol (Mrk 9:30-32 ; Luk 9:43-45)"},"23":{"text":"amate in ama thatin ni thum ni-in a thokia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tuale amate a da mama uhi."},"24":{"text":"Capernaum khuo ah amate a tun ciengun Peter kungah biehinnpi’ sieh dongte pei-in, “Na siepa un biehinn sieh a khie sih amah?” a ci uhi.","title":"Jesu le Biehinnpi Sieh Piehna","ref":"Pei 30:13; 38:26"},"25":{"text":"Ama in, “Ingheh, pie ma,” a ci hi. Innah ama a pei ciengin Jesu in na hopi masa a, “Simon aw, nang in bang na ci ngaisut ei? Leitung kumpite in koite tung panin sieh le kaih a dong vuoi? A tate tung pan ahi sihle midangte tung pan a dong vuoi?” ci-in a dong hi."},"26":{"text":"Peter in, “Midangte tung pan,” a ci leh Jesu in ama kungah, “Tua ahile tate a peng ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hizongle amate i lungkhamsuo lo nadingin tuilipi-ah va pei ta’nlen tenng va khai ta’n; ang awh masa pen manin a kam phen lacin dangka peh khat na mu ding hi; tua khu la inlen nangma ading le kei adingin amate tungah pie in,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Jesu kungah nuazuite pei-in, “Vantung gamah koi lien pen ahei?” ci-in dong uhi.","title":"Lietna Tahtah (Mrk 9:33-37 ; Luk 9:46-48)","ref":"Luk 22:24"},"2":{"text":"Ama in naupang khat hlanin amahaw lahah omsah a,"},"3":{"text":"“A tahtah a kang ci-in, na kikhel vua naupangte tawh na kibah sih uleh vantung gam sungah na lut ngai sih ding uhi.","ref":"Mrk 10:15; Luk 18:17"},"4":{"text":"Tami naupangno banga a kiniemkhieh poma vantung gam sungah a lien pen hi pai hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka min tawh tam bang naupangno khat a limbawl poma kei ei limbawl ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Note lahah mi khatpo in keima ei um tami naupangnote khatpo a puasah leh, a ngawng kimvelah an gawina suong golpi khat khi-in tuili thuhpi sungah tummang dawh leh ama adingin hoizaw ding hi.","title":"Mawna ding Ze-etna (Mrk 9:42-48 ; Luk 17:1-2)"},"7":{"text":"Pua nading thute ziehin leitung mite a hamsie ahi uhi! Pua nading hunte ang tung valon ding a, ahi vangin puana a piengsah pa pen mi hamsie ahi hi!"},"8":{"text":"“Na khut ahi sihle na keng in ang puasah leh tansan inlen paimang in; khut kim keng kima tawntung meili sunga ang kipaih sangin khut sam keng samin hinna sunga na lut ding nang adingin hoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat 5:30"},"9":{"text":"Tuale na mit in ang puasah leh khei dawh inlen paimang in; mittang kimin hell meili sunga ang kipaih sangin mit langkhat beh tawh hinna sunga na lut ding nang adingin hoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat 5:29"},"10":{"text":"“Tami naupangnote khatpo na simmaw khah lo nadingun kidawm un; azieh pen ke’n kang ci-in, vantunga om amau’ vantung mite in vantunga ka Pa’ maitang a mu zing uhi.","title":"Tuumang Thugentena (Luk 15:3-7)"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen a mangthaite hundam dinga Mihing Tapa ang pei ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 19:10"},"12":{"text":"Bang na ci ngaisut vuoi? Tuucingpa khat in tuu zakhat nei hinlen tuate lahah khat gammang leh, sawmkuo le kuote muol tungah nuasie-in tua a gammang tuu sui dingin a pei sih ding amah?"},"13":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, a mukia ciengin a gammang lo tuu sawmkuo le kuote sangin tua tuu khat ziehin a lungdamzaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n tami naupangnote lahah khat zong a manthai ding pen vantunga om na Pa uh’ deina ahi sih hi."},"15":{"text":"“Pawlpi midang khat na tunga ang maw leh, pei inlen noma gel beh na om uh ciengin na khielna uh kigen un. Na thu ang man leh, tua mipa a ngakia na hi hi.","title":"Mawna Bawl Midangte Thuhilna (Luk 17:3)","ref":"Luk 17:3"},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin na thu ang man nop sih leh teci ni ahiei thum ahiei a op ciengin thu zosie thukip suoh ahi ziehin mi khat ahiei ni ahiei zawpi in.","ref":"Thkna 19:15"},"17":{"text":"Tua pa in amate thu a man nop sih leh pawlpi tungah ko in; tuale pawlpi thu nangawn a man nop lailai sih leh Gentile mi le siehdong bangin na ngaisun un."},"18":{"text":"Ken a mantaha kang ci-in, leitunga na hen zosie vantungah kihen ding a, leitunga na sut zosie vantungah kisut ding hi.","ref":"Mat 16:19; Jhn 20:23"},"19":{"text":"Khatvei kang cikia-in, leitungah note ni kilungtuoh a na nget popo uh vantunga om ka Pa in ang pie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen mi ni ahi a, thum ahi zongin keima’ min suonga a kikhop uleh amate lahah keima ka om hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter pei-in ama kungah, “ Topa aw, pawlpi midang khat ka tunga ang maw leh, bangza vei cieng ka maisah diei? Sagi vei dong cieng ka maisah diei mah?” a ci hi.","title":"Mawmaisahna"},"22":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Sagi vei cieng beh hi lo, sawm sagi mun sagi vei cieng dong maisah in kang ci hi.","ref":"Luk 17:3-4; Pien 4:24"},"23":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin vantung gam pen a silate’ sum sazien a en nuom kumpipa tawh kibang hi.","title":"Mawmaisah Lo Nasempa Thugentena"},"24":{"text":"Sazien sit a kipat ciengin a sum talent tul sawm a ba mipa khat ama kungah kipeipi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in a leiba pie zo lo ahi ziehin ama-a kipan a zi a tate le a neisa zosie zua-in leiba a lo nadingin a pupa in thu a pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n a mai-ah a silapa khupdinin, ‘Ei thuoh kenkon lai in, a unpi-in kang sang na ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua silapa’ pupa in ama khuotuo ahi ziehin a leiba teng maisahin hlakhie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua silapa a peikhiet ciengin ama tunga denari zakhat a ba a silapite khat tawh kituoh a, tuale ama in tua pa a lawl ah manin, ‘Na leiba ei lo in,’ a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin a silapi pa zong a mai-ah bawhin thum a, ‘Ei thuoh kenkon lai in, kang lo na ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in niel hi; tua ciengin ama pei-in a leiba a lo zawh masangsie tua pa thong sungah a khum hi."},"31":{"text":"A silapite in tam thupieng a mu ciengun a cizalia vua, tuale amate pei-in a pupa kungah thupieng zosie a ko uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bepin a pupa in ama hlanin a kungah, ‘A gilo silapa! Kei kungah nang thum zieha na leiba zosie kang maisah ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ken kang hepi ma bangin nang in zong na silapipa na hepi ding kilawm hi lo amah?’ a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuale a pupa zong lungthah a, a leiba zosie a lo zawh masangsie-in gawtna thuoh dingin ama a ap hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in zong na lungsim sung vuah na sanggampa ahi sihle na sanggamnu’ mawna na maisah sih uleh, vantunga om ka Pa in tua ma bangin note tungah ang bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in tam teng a gen zaw ciengin Galilee gam nuasie-in Jordan galkhatah a om Judea gamah a pei hi.","title":"Zi Khulna Tungtang Thuhilna (Mrk 10:1-12 ; Luk 16:18)"},"2":{"text":"Mihon tampi in ama a zui vua, tuale ama in khum tahah amate a damsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama a ze-et dingin a kungah Pharisee-te pawlkhat pei-in amate in, “Mi khat in thu khat popo ziehin a zi a khul ding thukham tawh a kituoh ei mah?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in, “A cil a kipan a siempa in numei le pasal a siem hi,’ a ci le","ref":"Pien 1:27; 5:2"},"5":{"text":"‘Tam thu ziehin pasal in a nu a pa nuasie-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a, ama gel sa khat a suoh ding uhi,’ ci-a kigiel na sim ngai sih uh amah?’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 2:24"},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama gel pen ni hi nawn loin khat ahi ta uhi. Tua ahi ziehin Pasien in a gawmsate koima in khen sih heh,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Tua ahile Moses in bang dinga khulna lai pie-a zi khul nading thu ei pieh vanuh ahei,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Thkna 24:1-4; Mat 5:31"},"8":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Moses in na lungtang uh a khau seng zieha na zi khul ding uh ang phal ahi bo hi, ahi vangin a cil a kipan tam bang ahi ngai sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Note kunga kang ci-in, midang khat tawh mawna khat simlo a zi khul a, numei dang a kinunpi poma angkawm ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 5:32; 1Cor 7:10-11"},"10":{"text":"A nuazuite in ama kungah, “Zi tungtanga pasalte tam bang ding ahi mawh leh zi nei lo ding hoizaw hi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a kung vuah, “Amate tungah a kipiesate simlo mi zosie in tami thuhilna a sang zo sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen mi pawlkhat gesa banga suoh om a, pawlkhatte ahile midangte bawla kiget om a, pawlkhatte pen vantung gam thu ziehin amau le amau a kiget bangin a om uhi. Tam thu a sang thei tapo in sang taheh,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a tung vuah khut nga-in thu a ngetpieh thei nadingin ama kungah naupangnote kipeipi hi. Nuazuite in amahaw a peipi mite nahpi tahin a na hosie uhi;","title":"Jesu in Naupangnote Thupha Pie (Mrk 10:13-16 ; Luk 18:15-17)"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin Jesu in, “Tua naupangte ka kungah hing peisah un, amate kham sih un; bangzieh ahei cile vantung gam pen tua bang mite ading ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a tung vuah khut nga a, khum mun panin ama a dingdawh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu kungah mi khat pei a, “Siepa aw, kumtawn hinna ka nga thei nadingin sil hoi bang ka bawl diei?” a ci hi.","title":"Tangval Mihaupa (Mrk 10:17-31 ; Luk 18:18-30)"},"17":{"text":"Tuale ama in tuapa kungah, “Bang dinga sil hoi bang ahei ci-a nei dawh ahei? Mi hoi khat beh a om hi. Hinna sunga na lut nop leh thupiehte zui in,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Bang pen ahei?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in, “Tuol that sin; ang kawm sin; mi na gu sin; zuou teci pang sin;","ref":"Pei 20:13-16; Thkna 5:17-20"},"19":{"text":"na nu na pa zatah in; nangma na ki-it bangin na vengte zong it in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:12; Thkna 5:16; Siem 19:18"},"20":{"text":"Tangvalpa in ama kungah, “Tam teng zosie ka zui siengsa hi; bang kisam lai ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Mi cingtah na hi nop leh pei-in, na neisa zosie zua inlen mizawngte tungah na sumte va pie lacin vantungah gou na nei ding hi; tua ciengin hing pei inlen ka nua ei zui in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tangvalpa in tami thu a zah ciengin ama in neisa hau mama ahi ziehin lungsisa-in a peikhie ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a nuazuite kungah, “Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, mihau khat vangam a lut ding hamsa mama ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ke’n kang cikia-in, Pasien’ manggam sungah mihau khat a lut ding sangin hieu bilvang sungah kalaoh khat a lut ding bailam zaw hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Nuazuite in tami thu a zah uh ciengin lamdang a sa mama vua, “Tua ahi mawh leh koi ahiei hutdamna nga zo ding?” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate en a, “Mihingte adingin pieng thei lo ma hi, hinanle Pasien adingin na zosie pieng thei hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin, “En in, kote in na zosie nuasie-in nangma kang zui uhi. Tua ahile bang ka lemlaw ding vuoi?” a ci uhi."},"28":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, na zosie a kibawltha hun, a minthanna mang topha tungah Mihing Tapa ang to hun ciengin, keima ei zui note zong kumpi topha sawm le nite tungah to-in Israel minam sawm le nite tungah thu na khen ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 25:31; Luk 22:30"},"29":{"text":"Ka min zieha a inn a lo, a sanggam numei, a sanggam pasal, a nu a pa, a tate, a leitang a nuasie poma in a za zakhat nga-in kumtawn hinna a luo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin a masate nukhia ding a, a nukhiate masa ding hi.","ref":"Mat 20:16; Luk 13:30"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bangzieh ahei cile vantung gam pen lengga lei-a nasem dingte ciel dinga zing tunga a kuonkhie lo nei pa tawh kibang hi.","title":"Lengga Lei-a Nasemte"},"2":{"text":"Nasemte tawh a ngaina banga nitha pieh dingin a kithukim zaw ciengun a lengga lei-ah amate a kuonsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Nai kuo pawlin a pei leh sumbuh lahah bangma sem lo-a a mawh din midangte a mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate kungah, ‘No zong pei unlen lengga lei-ah va kuon ta un, a kilawmza khat kang pie ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate zong a kuon uhi."},"5":{"text":"Sunkim pawl le nai thum pawlin pei leuleu a, tua ma bangin a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale nai nga pawl ciengin a pusuoh leh a kimvela a ding midangte mu-in amate kungah, ‘Bang dingin sunthapai-in tam sungah bangma sem lo pi-in mawh din na hi uh ahei?’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a kungah, ‘Koima’n ei ciel lo zieh ahi hi,’ a ci uhi. Tuale amate kungah, ‘No zong lengga lei-ah va kuon ta un,’ a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Nitah ciengin lengga lei nei pa in nasem uhpa kungah, ‘Nasemte hlan inlen a kuon nukhia pen panin a kuon masa pen dongin a thaman uh hawmpieh in,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 19:13; Thkna 24:15"},"9":{"text":"Nai nga pawla kicielte a pei ciengun a nitha ngaina za ciet a nga uhi."},"10":{"text":"A kuon masate a pei ciengin a tam san deu dinga a kingaisut vangun a nitha ngaina za ciet ma a sang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale sum a san ciengun lo nei pa tungah a phun vua,"},"12":{"text":"‘Tami a nukhiate in nai khat sung beh na sem napi, sunthapai nisa thuoha nasem kote tawh nei kibangsah hi,’ a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate khat kungah, ‘Lawm aw, na tungah bangma khielna ka bawl sih hi; nitha ngaina ma thalaw dinga kithukimsa hi lo i mah?"},"14":{"text":"Nangma-a’ kilah inlen pei in; nangma kang piehza ma, tami a kiciel nukhiate ka pie nuom hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka neisate ka dei bangin bawl thei lo ding ka mah? Ahi sihle ka lungsim hoi zieha thangsie na mah?’ a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nukhiate masa ding a, a masate nukhia ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 19:30; Mrk 10:31; Luk 13:30"},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Jesu a peito laitahin lampi-ah nuazui sawm le nite tuom zawpi a, amate kungah,","title":"Jesu in a Si ding le a Thawkia ding Thumveina Genkhol (Mrk 10:32-34 ; Luk 18:31-34)"},"18":{"text":"“En un, Jerusalem ah peito-in siempu makaite le thukham hil siete tungah Mihing Tapa ki-ap ding a, tuale amate in ama mawsietin sina a thuohsah ding uhi:"},"19":{"text":"tua ciengin zako ding, sat ding le singlamte tunga khailia dingin Gentile-te tungah a ap ding uhi; tuale a ni thum ni-in ama kithosah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Zebedee tapate’ nu, a tapate tawh ama kungah pei-in a mai-ah khupdinin a angvan nadingin a ngen hi.","title":"James’ Nu le John’ Ngetna (Mrk 10:35-45)"},"21":{"text":"Tuale ama in tua nu kungah, “Bang dei na hei? a ci hi. Tua nu in ama kungah, “Na gam sungah tami ka tapa tegel khat na zietlamah, khat na veilamah a to nadingin thu pie in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in, “Na nget uh na theisiem sih uhi. Ka dawn ding hai na dawn zo ngel ding vuoi mah?” ci-in a dawh ciengin ama kungah, “Dawn zo na va ung,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale amate kungah, “Note in keima’ hai na dawn tahpi ding vua, ahi vangin ka zietlam le ka veilam a to ding pen kei ang pieh thei ahi sih hi, tua pen ka Pa in a bawlpiehsate ading hizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Sawmte in tam thu a zah ciengun sanggam ni tegel tungah a lungthah uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate hlan a, “Gam-uh Gentile-te in amate tungah a kiliensah vua, a uliente un zong thuneina tawh amate a uh lam na thei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Note lahah tua bang hi lo ding hi; note lahah milien a suoh nuom poma in note’ nasem hi ding a,","ref":"Luk 22:25-26"},"27":{"text":"note lahah a masa pen ahi nuom poma note’ sila hi ding hi;","ref":"Mat 23:11; Mrk 9:35; Luk 22:26"},"28":{"text":"Mihing Tapa pen midangte na semsah dinga ang pei ahi sih a, midangte’ na a sem ding le mi tampi tatkhiet nadingin a hinna pie dinga ang pei hizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate in Jericho a nuasie ciengun mi tampi in a nua a zui uhi.","title":"Jesu in Mittaw Mi Ni Damsah (Mrk 10:46-52 ; Luk 18:35-43)"},"30":{"text":"Lampi gei-ah a to mittaw ni in tua lampi nawhin Jesu ang pei hi, ci thu a zah ciengun, “David’ Tapa, Topa aw, kote ei hepi in!” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"31":{"text":"Mihonpi in a sip nadingun nahpi tahin a kham uhi; hizongle ama gel in, “David’ Tapa, Topa aw, kote ei hepi in! ci-in a kiko semsem uhi."},"32":{"text":"Jesu khawlin ama gel hlan a, “Bang hing bawlpieh leng na dei vuoi?” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama gel in ama kungah, “ Topa aw, ka mit uh khuo ei musah in,” a ci uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in ama gel a khuotuo a, a mit uh a thampieh leh thakhatin khuo mu theikia-in a nua a zui pai uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khuonai, Olive muol tunga a om Bethphage khuo a tun uh ciengin Jesu in a nuazui ni sawl a,","title":"Jerusalem ah Jesu Guolzo-a a Lutna (Mrk 11:1-11 ; Luk 9:28-40 ; Jhn 12:12-19)"},"2":{"text":"ama gel kungah, “Na mai vua khuo ah va pei ta unlen, a no tawh khau kikhisa laapi khat thakhatin na mu ding uhi; hing sut unlen ka kungah hing kai un."},"3":{"text":"Mi khatpo in bang khatpo ang gen leh, ‘ Topa in tulmaw hi,’ ci zieu locin ama in ang kaisah pailien ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam thu pen kamsangpa’ thugenna a tangtun nadinga pieng ahi a,"},"5":{"text":"“En in, Zion tanu aw, na kumpipa kiniemkhiehna tawh laapi’ ta laano tungah tuongin na kung vuah ang pei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Zech 9:9"},"6":{"text":"Nuazui tegel zong Jesu’ hil bangin a gamta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ama gel in laapi le a no kai-in a tungah puonte a pha vua, tuate tungah ama a tuong hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihon tampite in lampi-ah a puonte uh a pha vua, adangte in singbate satin lampi-ah a pha uhi."},"9":{"text":"A mai-a pei mihonte le a nua lama pei mihonte in, David’ Tapa tungah Hosanna! Topa’ min tawh ang pei pa in thupha nga taheh! Van a sangna munah hosanna!” ci-in a kiko uhi.","ref":"Late 118:25-26"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem ah ama a lut ciengin a khuozangun a buoi gawp vua, “Tam pa koi ahei,” ci-in a dong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mipite in, “Galilee gam Nazareth khuo pana kamsang Jesu ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinnpi sungah Jesu lutin biehinnpi sunga vanzua le vanlei mi zosie notmang a, sumkhelte’ tona sabuoite le vakhu zuate’ tonate zong a khulepieh gawp hi.","title":"Jesu in Biehinnpi Siensuo (Mrk 11:15-19 ; Luk 19:45-48 ; Jhn 2:13-22)"},"13":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, ‘Ka inn in thungetna inn kici ding hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi; hizongle note in misuomte’ kibuhna kuo na suo ta uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 56:7; Jer 7:11"},"14":{"text":"Biehinnpi sunga ama kungah mittawte le khelbaite a pei vua, tuale ama in amate a damsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin siempu liente le thukham hil siete in a na lamdang bawlte mu-in, naupangte in biehinnpi sungah, “David’ Tapa tungah Hosanna,” ci-in a kikona a zah uh ciengin a lung uh thah a,"},"16":{"text":"ama kungah, “Tamte in bang thu gen ci na za ei mah?” a ci uhi. Jesu in amate kungah, “Za ma ing; note in, ‘Naungehte le nawitep nausente’ kam panin nangma ang phatna dingun na bawlpieh zo ta hi,’ ci-a kigiel khu na sim ngai sih uh amah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 8:2"},"17":{"text":"Amate nuasie-in tua khuopi panin Bethany khuo ah ama pei a, tuanah a gieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Zingmawngin khuopi lamah a kilekia ciengin ama a gil a kiel hi.","title":"Jesu in Theikung Samsie"},"19":{"text":"Lam gei-ah theikung khat a mu ziehin a va pei taleh a nate simlo bangma a mu sih hi. Tua ciengin ama in tua theikung kungah, “Ga ngai nawn poma sin!” a ci leh tua theikung thakhatin a gawta pai hi."},"20":{"text":"Nuazuite in tua khu a mu uh ciengin lamdang a sa vua, “Bangci banga theikung tuaci gawta pailien adiei?” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, note in um la loin upna na nei po uleh, tam theikung tunga kibawlte na bawl thei khop sih ding vua, tami muolte tung nangawn ah, ‘Kikhin inlen tuipi lilai sena’n kinei in,’ ci locin zong na ci bangun a pieng ding hi.","ref":"Mat 17:20; 1Cor 13:2"},"22":{"text":"Note in upna tawh na nget popo uh na nga ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Biehinnpi sungah ama lutin thu a hil laitahin, ama kungah siempu liente le upate pei-in, “Bang thuneina tawh tamte na bawl a, tam thuneina koi ang pieh ahei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Thuneina Kidong (Mrk 11:27-33 ; Luk 20:1-8)"},"24":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Ke’n zong khat kang dong ding hi; note in nei dawn thei uleh ke’n zong bang thuneina tawh tam nate ka bawl ahei, ci thu kang gen ding hi."},"25":{"text":"John’ baptize-na pen vantung pana ang pei amah, ahi sihle mihing tung pana ang kipan ahei?”ci-in a dong hi. Amate zong khatlekhat a kisel vua, “Vantung pan hi,’ ci lei lah, ‘Tua ahile bang dinga ama na muon lo uh ahei?’ ei ci ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin, ‘Mihing kung pan hi,’ ci zel lei lah mi zosie in John pen kamsang khata a ngaisut uh ahi ziehin mipite i giing vanuh uhi,” a kici uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Jesu kungah, “Ka thei sih uhi,” a ci uhi. Tuale ama in a kung vuah, “Ke’n zong tamte bang thuneina tawh ka bawl ahei ci kang gen tuon sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"“Note in bang na ci ngaisut vuoi? Mi khat in tapa ni nei hi; a tazaw pa kungah pei a, ‘Ka ta aw, tuni-in lengga lei-ah kuonin na va sem ta’n,’ a ci hi.","title":"Tapa Nite Thugentena"},"29":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Kuon sih vang,’ ci napi a lungsim kikhelin a kuon hi."},"30":{"text":"A nauzaw pa kungah a pa pei-in tua ma bangin a va ci ta leh ama in, ‘Pa aw, va kuon ta vang,’ ci napi a kuon sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua nite koi zaw a pa’ deina bangin gamta ahei?” a ci hi. Amate in, “A tazaw pa in,” a ci uhi. Jesu in amate kungah, “Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, Pasien’ manggam sungah note sangin siehdongte le numei pahtatte a lut masazaw ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen note kungah dihna lampi tawh John ang pei napi ama na um sih vua, ahi vangin siehdongte le numei pahtatte in ama a um uhi; tua na mu zaw cieng nangawnun na lungsim uh na khel sih vua, zong na um sih uhi.","ref":"Luk 3:12; 7:29-30"},"33":{"text":"“Thugentena dang khat na ngai un. Lengga lei a bawl lo neipa khat om a, ama in a kimvelah dai kai-in a sungah lengga cil nading dum to-in tausang khat daw hi. Tua ciengin losapte kawmsahin gam dangah a zin hi.","title":"A Gilo Losappa Thugentena (Mrk 12:1-12 ; Luk 20:9-19)","ref":"Isa 5:1-2"},"34":{"text":"Anlah hun a tun ciengin ama nga ding za teng khon dingin losapte kungah a silate a sawl hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin losapte in a silate na manin khat na sat gawp vua, khat na thatin, khat suong tawh na seplia uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in a sawl masahte sanga a tamzaw sila dangte sawl leuleu a, amate in a masate ma bangin na bawl veve uhi."},"37":{"text":"A tawpna ah, ‘Ka tapa na zatah buong sam va uh,’ ci-in amate kungah a tapa a sawl hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin losapte in a tapa a mu ciengun, ‘Tam pa gamhluo ding pa ahi hi; hing pei un, ama that vai-in a gamh luo ding teng la vai,’ a kici uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama manin lengga lei panin notmangin that uhi."},"40":{"text":"Lengga lei nei pa a pei ciengin tua losapte bang a law ta diei?” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Ama in tua migilote si genthei-in sisah ding a, anlah hun cienga ama’ nga ding za a pie ding midang losapte tungah a lengga lei a kawmsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Lai Siengtho sungah: ‘Innlamte in a nilmang suong khu innkiu suongpi a suoh ta hi; tam pen ahileh Topa’ bawl ahi a, eite’ mit mu-in lamdang hi,’ a kici na sim ngai sih uh amah?","ref":"Late 118:22-23"},"43":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ke’n kang ci-in, note kung panin Pasien’ manggam kiladawh ding a, a manggam gate a gasah thei minam tungah kipie ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tami suong tunga a kie poma guoicim ding a, a tungah tami suong kie-in a denkhah popo a tepaal ding hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Siempu liente le Pharisee-te in a thugentena a zah ciengun amate a genna ahi lam a thei uhi."},"46":{"text":"Amate in ama mat a sawm vua, ahi vangin mipite in ama kamsang khata a ngaisut ziehun mipite a giing zel uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in thugentena tawh amate tungah thu genkia a:","title":"Mopawi Thugentena (Luk 14:15-24)"},"2":{"text":"“Vantung gam pen a tapa dinga mopawi bawl kumpipa tawh kigente thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in mopawi ankuong im dinga a kicielsate hlan dingin a silate a sawl vangin amate a pei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in sila dangte sawl leuleu a, ‘A kicielsate kungah tam bangin gen un: En un, ka nitah an min zo hi, ka bawngtangte le ka bawng thau tuituohte kigo zo a, na vannuoi a baisa-in om zo ta hi; mopawi an ne dingin hing pei ta un,’ ci-in a gensah hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in thudon loin pawlkhat in lo kuonsanin, adang pawlkhat in a nasepna vuah a peisan vua,"},"6":{"text":"a omlai teng in ama’ silate manin bawlsie-in na that uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa zong lungthahin a galkapte sawl a, tua mithatte susie-in a khuopite uh a haltum hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a silate kungah, ‘Mopawi a baisa-in om a, a kicielte an ne dingin a kilawm nawn sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin lamlienpi ah pei unlen mopawi an ne dingin na mu popo va ciel ta un,’ a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Silate zong lampite ah pei-in a mu zosie uh, hoi tale hoi tasih le a kaikhawm uhi; tuaci’n mopawi bawlna inn sungah pawisim mi a dim hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ahi vangin mopawi simte van dingin kumpipa a lut ciengin khum tahah mopuon sil lo pasal khat mu kha a,"},"12":{"text":"ama kungah, ‘Lawm aw, mopuon sil lopi-in tam sungah ang bangci lut na hei?’ a ci leh ama pa in a gen ding a thei ta sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in a nasemte kungah, ‘A khut a keng hen unlen, kaana le hagawina mun ahi pulam khuomiel lahah paimang ta un,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 8:12; 25:30; Luk 13:28"},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen mi tampi a kihlat vangin mi tawmkhat beh kiteel hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharisee-te pei-in a thugenna tawh ama a mawmat thei nadingun thang a sie sawm uhi.","title":"Sieh Piehna Thudawhna (Mrk 12:13-17 ; Luk 20:19-26)"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in ama kungah nuazuite le Herod mite a sawl vua, “Sie aw, nang na thutah a, thuman bangin koima zatah nei loin Pasien’ lampi na hil lam ka thei uhi; azieh pen nang in mi mai-et tuom na nei sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahile kumpipa tunga sieh pieh ding kilawm amah, kilawm lo ahei, ci thu na ngaisutna ei gen in,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi mawh vangin Jesu in a lungsim gitlona uh thei ahi ziehin, “No mihoi kipangte aw, bang dinga nei ze-et uh ahei?"},"19":{"text":"Sieh dinga kipie sumtang ei lah vawi uh,” a ci hi. Tuale amate in a kungah denarius khat a peipi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah, “Tami koi’ lim le koi’ min ahiei,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in kumpipa’ lim le min ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi. Tuale amate kungah, “Kumpipa’ nate kumpipa tungah na pie unlen, Pasien’ nate Pasien tungah na pie un,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tami thu a zah ciengun amate in lamdang a sa vua, ama nuasie-in a peisan uhi."},"23":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in ama kungah thawkiana om lo hi, a ci Sadducee-te pei-in thudawhna khat a dong vua,","title":"Thawkiana Tungtang Thudawhna (Mrk 12:18-27 ; Luk 20:27-40)","ref":"Sawl 23:8"},"24":{"text":"“Siepa aw, Moses in, ‘Mi khat ta nei loin a si leh, a sanggampa in tua meigongnu kinunpi-in a sanggam pa adingin ta hinpieh ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5"},"25":{"text":"Tu-in ko lahah sanggam pasal sagi om hi; a ta pen pa in zi nei napi ta nei loin si a, a zi pen a sanggampa in a ensah hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ma bangin a ni na, a thumna-a kipanin a sagina dongin ta nei loin a si uhi."},"27":{"text":"A tawpna ah tua numei zong a si hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahile amate in a unpi-un tua nu kinunpi kim uh ahi ziehin thawkia hun ciengin a koi pen’ zi ahi ta diei?” a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Jesus in amate dawng a, “Note in Lai Siengtho thu ahi a, Pasien’ vanglietna ahi zongin thei lo na hi ziehun na ngaisun khiel uhi."},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen thawkia hun ciengin vantung mite ma bangin kipi kitenna om lo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuale misite thawkiana tawh kisai-in note kunga a gen thute na sim ngai sih uh amah?"},"32":{"text":"‘Keima in Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien, le Jacob’ Pasien ka hi hi,’ a ci hi. Ama a site’ Pasien ahi sih a, a hingte’ Pasien hi zaw hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 3:6"},"33":{"text":"Mipite in tami thu a zah ciengun ama’ thuhilna ziehin lamdang a sa uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in Sadducee-te gen ding thei loin a sipsah lam Pharisee-te in a zah ciengun a kikaikhawm vua,","title":"Thupieh Lienpen (Mrk 12:28-34 ; Luk 10:25-28)"},"35":{"text":"amate lah panin thukhamsie khat in ama a ze-etna-in thu khat a dong hi."},"36":{"text":"Siepa aw, thukham sungah bang thupieh lienpen ahei?” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"“Ama in tua pa kungah, ‘Na Topa Pasien na lungtang zosie, na hinna zosie, le na lungsim zosie tawh na it ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:5"},"38":{"text":"Tami pen a masapen le a lienpen thupieh a hi hi."},"39":{"text":"A nina zong a masa tawh kibang hi: ‘Nangma na ki-it bangin na vengte na it ding hi,’ ci ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 19:18"},"40":{"text":"Thukham zosie le kamsangte’ thuhil zosie tami thupieh nite tunga kikhai ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 10:25-28"},"41":{"text":"Pharisee-te a kikhop laitahun Jesu in amate kungah tami thu dong hi:","title":"David’ Tapa Tungtang Thudotna (Mrk 12:35-37 ; Luk 20:41-44)"},"42":{"text":"Messiah bang na ci ngaisut vuoi? Ama koi’ tapa ahiei?” a ci hi. Amate in a kungah, “David’ tapa ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Tua ahile bangci bangin David in Hlagau sawlna tawh thugenin ama Topa ci-in,"},"44":{"text":"‘ Topa in keima’ Topa tungah thu gen a: “Na galte na keng nei-ah ka koi masangsie-in ka zietlamah na to in,” ci hi,’ ci thei ding ahei?","ref":"Late 110:1"},"45":{"text":"Tua bangin David in ama pen Topa ci ahile bangci bangin ama a tapa hi thei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Koima in dawng thei lo a, khum ni-a kipanin koima in ama bangma a dong ngam nawn sih uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in mipite le a nuazuite kungah,","title":"Jesu in Thukham Hil Siete le Pharisee-te Mawsah (Mrk 12:38-40 ; Luk 11:37-54 ; 20:45-47)"},"2":{"text":"“Moses’ topha tungah thukham hil siete le Pharisee-te a to uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amau’ ang hil zosie zui-in sem un; ahi vangin a thuhil uh bangin gamta lo uh ahi ziehin amau’ gamtat bangin gamta sih un."},"4":{"text":"Amate in puoh zawh lo ding vangihte guongin midangte’ liengko ah a pat uhi; ahi vangin amate in lah tuate khin nadingin a khutme nangawn uh a piasah nuom sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in a sepna zosie uh mite’ musiet dingin a sem sese uhi; azieh pen a thukham puohna uh ipte a golpipi-in bawlin a puonmongtep uzong a sau theithei-in a bawl uhi.","ref":"Mat 6:1; Gam 15:38; Thkna 6:8"},"6":{"text":"Pawi bawlna ah uliente’ tona ding munah a to nuom se vua, kikhopna inn sungah zong tona nuompen tungah a to nuom phadeu uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale vanzuana munah zatahna tawh kihopi-in, mite in siepa a ci ding a dei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Note na hi ule sie kici dingte na hi sih uhi, azieh pen note in sie khat na nei vua, na unpi-un sangnaupangte na hi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Vantungah Pa khat beh nei na hi ziehun leitungah koima pa ci sih un."},"10":{"text":"Note in Messiah ahi sie khat nei na ahi ziehun koima in siete kicisah sih un."},"11":{"text":"Note lahah a lienpen pa in note’ nasem ahi ding hi.","ref":"Mat 20:26-27; Mrk 9:35; 10:43-44; Luk 22:26"},"12":{"text":"Amau le amau a kitawisangte kiniemkhieh ding a, amau le amau a kiniemkhiehte kitawisang ding hi.","ref":"Luk 14:11; 18:14"},"13":{"text":"“Ahi vangin no thukham hil siete le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in vantung gam sungah mite a lut thei lo nadingin kot na khah vua, noma lah lut tuon loin adang a lut nuomte lah na khahtan vanuh uhi."},"14":{"text":"No thukham hil siete, Pharisee-te, le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in meigongte’ inn na valtum vua, a kilimlawm dingin thu na sau nget giap uhi. Tua ahi ziehin note in mawsahna a golzaw na thuoh ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"No thukham hil siete, Pharisee-te, le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in mi a kikhel khat lenlon na nga nadingun tuipi le leitung kantanin na zin kawikawi vua, na ngasa uh mi kikhel thate lah note sangin a zani-in hell khuh tapa dingin na bawl zel uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Munsiengtho tawh a kiciem poma bangma a sawng sih a, hizongle munsiengtho sunga om kham tawh a kiciemte poma a kiciemna a sawng uhi,” a ci no mittaw lampuite in gimna na thuoh ding uhi!"},"17":{"text":"No mittawte le mimawte aw! Tua kham a thupizaw amah, ahi sihle tua kham a siengthosah munsiengtho thupizaw ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Note in, ‘Maitam tawh a kiciem poma a sawng sih a, hizongle maitam tunga silpieh tawh a kiciem poma a kiciemna a sawng hi,’ na ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na mit uh taw sam e izaw! Azieh pen silpieh a thupizaw amah, ahi sihle tua silpieh a siengthosah maitam thupizaw ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n maitam tawh kiciem poma maitam le a tunga om na zosie tawh zong a kiciem ahi hi;"},"21":{"text":"tuale munsiengtho tawh a kiciem poma zong tua munsiengtho le a sunga a tengpa tawh a kiciem ahi hi;"},"22":{"text":"tuale vantung tawh a kiciem poma Pasien’ kumpi topha le tua tunga a to mipa tawh zong a kiciem ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 66:1; Mat 5:34"},"23":{"text":"No thukham hil siete, Pharisee-te, le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in masala, lengmusel, le cummin sing namtuite sawm-ah-khat na pie phuat vua, thukham sunga a thupizaw ahi: thutang, khuotuona, le upnate lah na don vanuh sih uhi. Adangte nelsie tuom loin tamte na bawl zawh ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 27:30"},"24":{"text":"No mittaw lampuite aw! Note in thovai seda kinei-in tui na hli vua, hizongle kala-oh na pumval vanuh uhi!"},"25":{"text":"“No thukham hil siete, Pharisee-te, le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen hai le kuongte a pulam na nawtsieng zemzom vua, hizongle a sung lamah zawthaw bawlna le huoihamna tawh kidim hi."},"26":{"text":"No mittaw Pharisee-te aw! A pulam zong a siengtho a suo thei nadingin tua hai a sunglam nawtsieng masa un."},"27":{"text":"No thukham hil siete, Pharisee-te, le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note na hi ule a pulamah etlawm napi, a sungah misi gute le a kidahhuoi namcin tawh a kidim hankhuh kizutngo tawh na kibang uhi.","ref":"Sawl 23:3"},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n note zong midangte mai-ah na pudaang lam uh midihte na sun hiauhuau vua, hizongle na sungtawng lam uh pen a kineitawmna le gitlonate tawh kidim hi."},"29":{"text":"No thukham hil siete, Pharisee-te, le mihoi kipangte in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in kamsangte’ hante na lampieh vua, mi midihte’ phawna dinga kibawl muolsuongte na zem uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuale note in, ‘I pu i pate khan lai-in eite a om hi leih, kamsangte’ sisan a suo amate lahah kihal talawm sam sih vai,’ na ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tam bangin kamsangte a that mite’ suonlehlah na hina uh noma le noma teci pang na hi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na pu na pate uh’ gamtatna za na phah nadingun zomto vet un."},"33":{"text":"No gulte, muoltan suonte aw! Note in hell khuh tun nading thukhenna bang na ci pel thei ding uh ahei?","ref":"Mat 3:7; 12:34; Luk 3:7"},"34":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note kungah kamsangte, mipilte, le thukham hil siete kang sawl hi. Note in kimkhat thatin singlamte tungah khailia-in, kimkhatte na kikhopna uh inn sungah satin khuo khat pan khuo khatah na del kawikawi ding vua,"},"35":{"text":"tuaci’n note tungah midih Abel’ sisan a kipanin munsiengtho sung le maitam kikala na tha uh, Barachiah’ tapa Zechariah’ sisan dongin, leitunga a kibuo midihte’ sisan teng zosie ang tung ding hi.","ref":"Pien 4:8; 2Khg 24:20-21"},"36":{"text":"Keima in a tahtah a kang ci-in, tami khangte tungah tam teng zosie ang tung ding hi."},"37":{"text":"“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, kamsangte thatin na kunga ang kisawl kamsangte suong tawh a seplia khuopi! Aapi in a note a hla nei-ah a huoi bangin na tate sawtveipi ka huoi nuom a, nang na nuom sih hi!","title":"Jerusalem ading Kaana (Luk 13:34-35)"},"38":{"text":"En in, na innpi uh a hawmin kitaisan ta hi.","ref":"Jer 22:5"},"39":{"text":"Azieh pen ke’n kang ci-in, ‘ Topa’ min tawh ang pei mipa in thupha nga taheh,’ na ci masangsie kei nei mukia sih ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 118:26"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biehinnpi panin Jesu a peikhiet laitahin tua biehinnpi’ innte ensah dingin ama kungah a nuazuite a pei uhi.","title":"Biehinnpi Siet ding Kimagen (Mrk 13:1-2 ; Luk 21:5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah, “Tam teng zosie mu hi lo uh na mah? A tahtah a kang ci-in, tam sunga suongte khat tungah adang khat a kiciengin kinuasie lo ding hi; a unpi-in kicimzansah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Olive Muol tungah Jesu a to laitahin a nuazuite in a a tuom hopi vua, “Tami thute bang cih ciengin hing pieng ding a, nang peikia nading hun le hun tawp nading limte bang hi ding ahei, ei gen in,” a ci uhi.","title":"Hun Tawp Ni ding Limte (Mrk 13:3-13 ; Luk 21:7-19)"},"4":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Koima in na kipuikhiel sah lo nadingun kidawm un."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen mi tampi in, ‘Keima Messiah ka hi hi!’ ci-in keima’ min suongin ang pei ding vua, tuale amate in mitampi a puikhiel ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Note in gal kidonate le galdona thuthangte na za ding uhi; tamte ang pieng ding ma hi a, ahi vangin a tawpna ding hi nai lo ahi ziehin patau sih un."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen minam khat le minam khat, gam khat le gam khat ang kido ding a, mun tuomtuomte ah kielpite tungin zil ang ling ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam teng zosie pen gimna kipatna ahi na bo hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ciengin amate in bawlsiet ding le tha dingin note ang pie ding vua, tuale keima’ min ziehin minam zosie in ang muda ding uhi.","title":"Bawlsietna Kimagen","ref":"Mat 10:22"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi tampite a pua ding vua, amate khatlekhat kilebawlin khatlekhat kimuda ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsang zuou tampitah ang khangin mi tampi lam a khielsah ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Gitlona pung ding ahi ziehin mi tampite’ ki-itna kiem ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin a tawp donga a thuohzo pa kihundam ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:22"},"14":{"text":"Minam zosie tungah teci ahi dingin leitung buppi-ah tami manggam lungdamna thu kiphuongzah ding hi; tua zaw ciengin tawpna ang tung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tuaci’n kamsang Daniel in a gen bangin a siengtho mun sungah a susie thei kidahhuoina ang din na mu uh ciengin (laisimte in thei ta uheh),","title":"A Susie thei a Kidahhuoina (Mrk 13:14-23 ; Luk 21:20-24)","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; 12:11"},"16":{"text":"tua ciengin Judea gama omte muolte tungah tai uheh;"},"17":{"text":"innkhum tunga omte inn sunga van la dingin kumsuh sih heh;"},"18":{"text":"lo lai-a om mipa zong a puon la dingin peikia sih heh.","ref":"Luk 17:31"},"19":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin numei gaite le nausen neite mi hamsie ahi uhi!"},"20":{"text":"Na galtai ding hun uh pen phalbi le sabbath ni ahi lo nadingin thu ngen un."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen leitung piencil a kipanin tuni cieng dong a pieng ngai nai lo, nidang cienga zong a pieng ngai nawn lo ding gimna lienpi tua hun ciengin ang pieng ding hi.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Kln 7:14"},"22":{"text":"Tua nite a kitomsah sih leh koima a suohta sih ding hi; ahi vangin a teelsate adingin tua nite kitomsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi khatpo in na kung vuah, ‘En un! Tanah Messiah om! ahi sihle, ‘Ama khunah om! ang ci uleh um sih un."},"24":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile messiah zuoute le kamsang zuoute ang pieng ding a, ahi thei leh a tatsate nangawn lampielsah dingin lim le na lamdang lienpite ang bawl ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ciemte in, kang gen masah ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in na kung vuah, ‘En un! Gamlahah a om hi,’ ang ci uleh va pei ta sih un. Amate in, ‘En un! Innkhan sungah ama om hi,’ ang ci uleh zong tahsang sih un."},"27":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tunphe in nisuona panin nitumna dong a tansah bangin, Mihing Tapa ang pei ding zong tua bang ma hi ding hi.","ref":"Luk 17:23-24"},"28":{"text":"Siluong opna popo-ah langtate a kikhawm ding uhi.","ref":"Luk 17:37"},"29":{"text":"“Tua gimna nite zaw ciengin thakhatthu-in ni kimielsah ding a, hlapi zong tang nawn lo ding hi; van panin aasite kiesuh ding a, vana om vanglietnate kiling ding hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa ang Peina (Mrk 13:24-27 ; Luk 21:25-28)","ref":"Isa 13:10; 34:4; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:10, 31; 3:15; Kln 6:12-13"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungah Mihing Tapa’ lim ang kilang ding hi; tua ciengin leitung minam zosie kap ding a, amate in vanglietna le minthanna lienpi tawh vana meiilumte tungah tuonga ang pei Mihing Tapa a mu ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Zech 12:10-14; Kln 1:7"},"31":{"text":"Ama in a gin ngaih mama pengkul mutna tawh a vantung mite ang sawl ding a, van mong khat pan mong khat dong, lei kiu li panin a teelsa mite a kaikhawm ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Theikung panin thusinna nei un: Theikung a bate hing mengin a na ang dawn ciengin khuokhal hun nai ta hi, ci-in na thei uhi.","title":"Theikung Thuhilna (Mrk 13:28-31 ; Luk 21:29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Tua ma bangin tam thute zosie na mu ciengun kotbieng dongin ama ang nai ta hi, ci-in thei ta un."},"34":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, tam thute zosie ang tun sieng masangin tam khang mite a si sih ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Van le lei maimang ding a, hizongle ka thute maimang lo ding hi."},"36":{"text":"“Ahi vangin a ni le a hun koima in thei lo hi, vantunga om vantung mite in ahi a, Tapa in ahi zongin thei lo a, Pa khat beh in thei hi.","title":"Pilvanna tawh Ngah ding a Kisapna (Mrk 13:32-37 ; Luk 17:26-30 , 34-36)"},"37":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Mihing Tapa ang peikia ding hun pen Noah hun lai ma tawh kibang ding hi.","ref":"Pien 6:5-8"},"38":{"text":"Azieh pen tuizin a tun masanga kipan tembaw sungah Noah a lut dongin mite in an ne tui dawnin numei pasal kipi kitengin a om vua,"},"39":{"text":"tuale tuizin tungin a unpi-un a lahmang hun dongin bangma thei loin a op ma bangun, Mihing Tapa ang pei ciengin zong tua bang ma hi ding hi.","ref":"Pien 6:5-8"},"40":{"text":"Tua ciengin lo lai-a om mi ni; khat kila-in khat kinuasie ding hi."},"41":{"text":"An neh suton numei ni; khat kila-in khat kinuasie ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na Topa uh ang pei ni ding thei lo na hi ziehun kigalging un."},"43":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam thu thei un: Inn neipa in zan lai-in guta pa pei ding hun theikhol leh na kigalging ding a, a inn lusah lo ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na upmaw lo laitahun Mihing Tapa ang pei ding ahi ziehin note zong a kigingsa-in om un.","ref":"Luk 12:39-40"},"45":{"text":"“Tua ahile a pupa in ama’ innkuon sunga vaihawm ding le a hunhuna nasem dangte nga ding za ciet an pie dinga a koi a muonhuoi le a pil silapa koi ahei?","title":"A Muonhuoi le a Muonhuoi lo Sila (Luk 12:41-48)"},"46":{"text":"A pupa ang tun ciengin tua bangin nasemin a om sila a mu pa pen mi hampha ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, a pupa in ama’ neisa zosie tungah a vaihawm dingin tua pa a koi ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua sila gilopa in a lungsim sungah, ‘Ka pupa hing kiheh lel va,’ ci-in,"},"49":{"text":"a seppi silate satgawp hinlen, zukhamte tawh an ne zu dawnin na om leh,"},"50":{"text":"a upmaw lo kal le a thei lo kalin tua silapa’ pupa ang tung ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Ama in tua silapa semnenin mihoi kipangte tawh kaana le hagawina munah a koiton ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua ciengin vantung gam pen zinei pa dawn dingin meivah keng a, a kuonkhie mopawi sim ngahnu sawmte tawh kibang hi.","title":"Mopawi Sim Ngahnu Sawmte","ref":"Luk 12:35"},"2":{"text":"Amate lahah mi nga maw-in mi nga pil hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua a mawte in a meivah uh keng napi meitui a keng sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"A pilte in ahileh meitui kithalsa thawlte a keng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Zinei pa a kiheh ziehin a unpi-un lusu-in a kimu uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin zankim ciengin, ‘En un! Zinei pa tanah hing tung ta! Ama dawn dingin hing pei un,’ ci-in kitangko hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin mopawi sim ngahnu sawmte tho-in a meivah uh a puo ciet uhi."},"8":{"text":"A mawte in a pilte kungah, ‘Ka meivah uh a mit ding hi ta, na meitui uh themkhat ei hawm un,’ ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pilte in, ‘Hi thei sih! No ading le ko ading kicing sih va; pei unlen meitui zuate kungah noma ading lei zaw un,’ ci-in a dawng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in meitui a lei laitahun zinei pa tungin a kigingsa teng tawh mopawi ah a lut ton uhi; tuale kot a kikha pai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin adang mopawi sim ngahnute zong tungin, ‘ Topa , Topa aw, kot ei hon in,’ a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, ‘A tahtaha kang ci-in, note kang thei kha sih hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 13:25"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a ni a nai thei lo na hi ziehun ngah lenlon un."},"14":{"text":"“Tami pen a nasemte hlanin a neisa teng amate a ap zaw ciengin khuol zin mi khat tawh kibang hi.","title":"Talent Thugentena (Luk 19:11-27)"},"15":{"text":"Amau’ siemna tawh kizui-in khat tungah talent nga, adang khat tungah ni, adang khat tungah khat ci bangin a pie ciet hi. Tua ciengin ama a peikhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Talent nga a nga pa pei-in tua teng tawh sum bawl a, adang talent nga a mu be hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ma bangin talent ni a nga pa in talent ni ma a mube hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin talent khat a nga pa pei-in leisung to-in a pu’ sum a phuol hi."},"19":{"text":"Hun sawtpi zaw ciengin silate’ pu pei-in amate tawh sum sazien laibu a en hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin talent nga a nga pa in a mube talent nga tawi-in a mai-ah pei a, ‘Pu aw, kei tungah talent nga nei ap hi; en in, talent nga ka na mube hi,’ a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"A pu in ama kungah, ‘Hoi sep cie, a hoi le a muonhuoi silapa; sil themno khat tungah na muonhuoi hi, a tampi tungah zong vaihawmin kang koi ding hi; na pu tawh nuomsa ton in,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Talent ni a nga pa zong a mai-ah pei-in, ‘Pu aw, kei tungah talent ni nei ap hi; en in, talent ni ka na mube hi,’ a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"A pu in ama kungah, ‘Hoi sep cie, a hoi le a muonhuoi silapa; sil themno khat tungah na muonhuoi hi, a tampi tungah zong vaihawmin kang koi ding hi; na pu tawh nuomsa ton in,’ a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin talent khat a nga pa a mai-ah pei-in, ‘Pu aw, nang mi genha pi khat na hi hi, na vaw lona munah khaici na at a, na the lona munah a ga na khop lam ka thei hi;"},"25":{"text":"tuaci’n kei ka zau a, tuale pei-in lei sungah ka talent ka phuol hi. Tanah nang-a’ teng ma a om hi,’ a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pu in, ‘Nang migilo mi thada silapa! Ka vaw lona munah atin ka the lona munah ka khop lam na thei amah?"},"27":{"text":"Sumkholna ah ka sumte na koi lacin hoi ngel ding hiven, tua hile kang kilekia ciengin ka sum a met tawh ka nga theikia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahile ama kung panin tua talent la unlen, talent sawm nei mipa pie un."},"29":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a nei poma kipiehbe ding a, amate in tampi neibe ding uhi; ahi vangin bangma a nei lote kung panin a neisun nangawn uh kilahpieh ding hi.","ref":"Mat 13:12; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18"},"30":{"text":"Kaana le hagawina mun a pulam khuomiel lahah bangma-a kimang lo tami silapa pai dawh ta un,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 8:12; 22:13; Luk 13:28; Luk 19:11-27"},"31":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa in ama’ minthanna silin vantung mite zosie tawh ang pei ciengin a minthanna kumpi topha tungah ang to ding hi.","title":"Minamte Thukhenna","ref":"Mat 16:27; 19:28"},"32":{"text":"Ama mai-ah minam zosie kikhawm ding a, tuucing pa in tuu le keel a tuom khen ma bangin ama in mite a tuomin khen ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in tuute a zietlamah koi-in, keelte a veilamah koi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa in a zietlam a omte kungah, ‘Ka pa in thupha a piehsa mite aw, hing pei unlen, leitung kisiemcil a kipanin note dinga a kibawlsa gam luo un;"},"35":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ka gilkiel laitahin ka neh ding an nei pie vua, ka dangta laitahin ka dawn ding tui nei pie uhi. Khuolmi ka hi laitahin zin nei do vua,"},"36":{"text":"sil ding puon ka nei lo laitahin puon nei pie uhi. Ka cinat laitahin nei kem vua, thong sunga ka op laitahin nei ve uhi,’ a ci ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin midihte in, ‘ Topa aw, bang cihin na gilkiel hing mu-in an kang pie vua, bang cihin na dangta hing mu-in tui kang pie ngai uh ahei?"},"38":{"text":"Bang cihin khuolmi na hi lam hing mu-in zin kang do vua, bang cihin na puon nei lo lam hing mu-in puon hing pie ka hi uh ahei?"},"39":{"text":"Bang cihin na cinat hing mu-in kang kem ta vua, bang cihin na thongkieh lam hing mu-in kang ve ta uh ahei,’ ci ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Kumpipa in amate kungah, ‘A tahtaha kang ci-in, tami ka innkuonpite lahah a neupen khat tunga na bawlte uh kei tunga a bawl na hi uhi,’ a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a veilam a omte kungah, ‘No samsiet mite aw, dawimangpa le a vantung mite dinga kibawlsa tawntung meikuong sungah pei ta un;"},"42":{"text":"azieh pen ka gilkiel laitahin an nei pie sih vua, ka dangta laitahin tui nei pie sih uhi."},"43":{"text":"Khuolmi ka hi laitahin zin nei do sih vua, puon ka nei lo laitahin puon nei pie sih uhi. Ka cinat laitahin nei kem sih vua, ka thong kieh laitahin nei ve sih uhi,’ a ci ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in zong, ‘ Topa aw, bang cihin gilkielin na dangta a, zin tungin puon nei loin na op lam le, cina-in thong sunga na op lam hing mu-in hing kem lo uh ka hei?’ ci-in a dawng ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, ‘A tahtaha kang ci-in, tam mite a neupen khat tunga na bawlte uh kei tunga a bawl na hi uhi,’ ci-in amate a dawng hi."},"46":{"text":"Amate kumtawn gawtna munah a pei ding vua, midihte ahile kumtawn hinna sungah a lut ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Dan 12:2"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in tami thu teng zosie a gen zaw ciengin a nuazuite kungah,","title":"Jesu Tha ding Kisawm (Mrk 14:1-2 ; Luk 22:1-2 ; Jhn 11:45-57)"},"2":{"text":"“Tuzaw ni ni ciengin Peisan Pawi ang tung ding a, singlamte tungah khailia dingin Mihing Tapa kipie ding hi, ci na thei uhi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Caiaphas a kici siempu lienpen pa’ innpi ah siempu lien pa le mipi upate a kikhawm vua,"},"4":{"text":"tuale amate in Jesu guh matin tha ding a kikum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in, “Mipite lahah buoina ang om kha thei ding ahi ziehin pawi sungin bawl sih vai,” a kici uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bethany khuo-a miphah Simon inn ah Jesu a op laitahin","title":"Bethany Khuo-ah Sathau Kinu (Mrk 14:3-9 ; Jhn 12:1-8)"},"7":{"text":"a manpha mama alabaster sathau namtui thawl khat tawi-in numei khat ama kungah pei a, sabuoi tungah a to laitahin tua sathau namtui a lu tungah a sungsuh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin nuazuite in a mu ciengun a lung uh thah a, “Bang dinga tam sathau a hici mawh zah adiei?"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen tami sathau kizua leh sum tampi tah kikhawng ding a, tua sum teng mizawngte hawmpieh zaw velei” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in tami thu thei ahi ziehin amate kungah, “Bang dinga tami numei nu na suhbuoi uh ahei? Ama nu in kei tungah sil hoi khat sem zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen note tawh mizawngte ang om zing ding ahi a, ahi vangin note tawh kei kang om zing sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka pum tunga tami sathau ei buohna pen ka kivui cienga a bawldan ding a mazil ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, leitung buppi-ah tami lungdamna thu a kigenna muncin tengah tami nu phawna-in a silbawlte kigengen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu liente kungah sawm le nite lahah khat ahi Judah Iscariot a kici mipa pei a,","title":"Jesu Leheh ding Judah Thukim (Mrk 14:10-11 ; Luk 22:3-6)"},"15":{"text":"“Ke’n ama hing lebawlin no kungah hing pie leng bang nei pie ding vuoi?” a ci hi. Amate in dangka sawmthum ama a pie uhi."},"16":{"text":"Khum hun a kipanin ama a lebawl thei nadingin hun lemtang sui a kipan pai hi."},"17":{"text":"Tolsawlo Anlum Pawi ni masa pen ni-in Jesu kungah nuazuite a pei vua, “Peisan Pawi ankuong lui nading hei sungah nang bawlpieh uleng na nuom ei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Nuazuite tawh Peisan Pawi An Ne (Mrk 14:12-21 ; Luk 22:7-14 , 21-23 ; Jhn 13:21-30)"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Khuopi sunga mi khat kungah pei unlen ama kungah, ‘Siepa in ka hun hing nai ta, na inn ah ka nuazuite tawh Peisan Pawi kang bawl ding hi, ci hi,’ va ci ta un,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu’ gen bangin nuazuite a gamta vua, Peisan Pawi an ding a siem uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nitah ciengin ama in sawm le nite tawh ankuong a imton hi;"},"21":{"text":"tuale an a neh laitahun ama in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, note lahah khat in kei ei leheh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale amate a da mama vua, ama kungah a banbanin, “ Topa , kei hi sam sih vang izaw?” a ci ciet uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in, “Keima tawh kuong sunga a khut tawh a sawhpa in ei leheh ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama tungtang thu a kigielsa ma bangin Mihing Tapa pen a pei ding ma hi a, hizongle Mihing Tapa a leheh pa in gimna a thuoh ding hi! Tua mipa ang pieng vet lo hi leh ama adingin hoizaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama a leheh Judah in, “Siepa kei ka hi amah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Na ci bang ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in an a neh laitahun Jesu in khomun lum khat la-in phalsuo-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin nuazuite pie a, “La unlen ne un; tam pen ka pumpi ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Vumkhawl Pienna (Mrk 14:22-26 ; Luk 22:15-20 ; 1Cor 11:23-26)"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in hai zong la-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin amate pie a, “Na unpi-un dawn un;"},"28":{"text":"azieh pen tami in mi tampi’ mawna a kimaisah nadinga a kibuokhie thuciemna tawh kisai ka sisan ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, ka Pa’ gam sungah note tawh lenggazu tha ka dawn masangin tam lenggazu ka dawn ngai nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in phatna la a sah zaw uh ciengin Olive Muol tungah a pei uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Note in tu zanin keima ziehin na unpi-un nei taisan ding uhi. Azieh pen, ‘Tuucingpa ka satlia ding a, tuuhonte a kithethang ding hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi.","title":"Peter’ Niel ding Kimagen (Mrk 14:27-31 ; Luk 22:31-34 ; Jhn 13:36-38)","ref":"Zech 13:7"},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin ei kithawsah zaw ciengin no masangah Galilee gam ka na pei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 28:16"},"33":{"text":"Peter in ama kungah, “Nangma ziehin mi zosie taimang sieng nanle ke’n nang kang taisan ngai vawt sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, tu zan mama aah a khuon masangin thumvei tah nei niel ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Peter in ama kungah, “Nangma tawh siton nading hinanle nang kang niel sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Nuazui zosiete in zong tua ma bangin a ci uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu a nuazuite tawh Gethsemane a kici munah a pei hi; tuale ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Khunah pei-in thu ka nget kalin tanah na to un,” a ci hi.","title":"Gethsemane ah Jesu in Thungen (Mrk 14:32-42 ; Luk 22:39-46)"},"37":{"text":"Ama in Peter le Zebedee’ tapa ni zawpi a, da le lungkham hun ding a kipan hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kung vuah, “Si nading za dong nangawnin ka lung a kham hi; tanah na om unlen ei na ngah un,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuale bakhat pei lai-in tuolah kiphengpha a, “Ka Pa aw, a pien thei ding leh tami hai tawh ei kipelsah ta’n; ahi vangin kei deina bang hi sih hinlen nangma’ deina bang hizaw heh,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nuazuite kungah a pei leh amate kimu-a om a mu hi; tuale ama in Peter kungah, “Nai khat sung nangawn ei ngah zo lo na hi uh amah?"},"41":{"text":"Gimna hun sungah na lut lo nadingun ngahin thungen un; lungsim a lawp vangin tahsa thanem hi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"A niveina va peikia-in thu ngen a, “Ka Pa aw, tami hai kei dawn lo-a phamaw ahi vawt leh lah nangma’ deina bang hi taheh,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama khatvei a peikia leh a mit uh hah zo nawn lo ahi ziehin amate a kimusa ma-in a mu leuleu hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate nuasie kia-in a nget ngai teng ma a thumveina a ngen hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin nuazuite kungah ama pei-in a kung vuah, “Kimu-in a khawl hit hiet lai na hi uh amah? En un, Mihing Tapa kilehehin mawnei mite’ khut sungah a kipieh ding hun ang nai ta hi."},"46":{"text":"Tho un, pei vai. En un, kei ei leheh ding pa ang nai ta hi,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Ama in thu a gen kim laitahin sawm le nite sung panin Judas a tung hi; siempu liente le mipi upate’ sawl ahi namsau le phohbul a tawi mihonpi tawh ama zawhton hi.","title":"Jesu Kilehehna le Kimatna (Mrk 14:43-50 ; Luk 22:47-53 ; Jhn 18:1-11)"},"48":{"text":"Tuale a leheh pa in amate kungah lim khat pie a, “Kang nap ding pa khu tua pa ahi hi; ama man pai un,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Thakhatin Jesu kungah pei a, “Na dam ei, Siepa!” ci-in ama a nam hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Lawm aw, tana na sep ding teng sem meng in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin amate pei-in Jesu tungah a khut utawh tu-in a man uhi."},"51":{"text":"Jesu tawh a omton mite lahah khat in thakhatin a khut tawh a namsau zamin dawh a, siempu lien pa’ silapa a sat leh a bil a bansan hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Na namsau a pai-ah sietkia in; azieh pen namsau tawite namsau ma tawh si ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Ka pa kungah a ngen thei lo nei sa uh amah? A ngen hi leng keima kungah vantung mite legion sawm le ni val, thakhatin ang sawl zieu ding ahi hi."},"54":{"text":"Tua bang hi mawh leh Lai Siengtho in tu-a banga a pien nading a gen pen bangci tangtun thei ta ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"55":{"text":"Khum hunin Jesu in mipite kungah, “Guta bulu khat mat banga kei ei man dinga namsau le phohbul tawh hing kuon na hi uh amah? Nisimin biehinnpi sungah to-in thu ka hil laitahin lah nei man zel sih uhi.","ref":"Luk 19:47; 21:37"},"56":{"text":"Hinanle kamsangte’ Lai Siengtho a tangtun nadinga tam bang teng zosie ang pieng ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin nuazuite zosie in ama nuasie-in a taimang uhi."},"57":{"text":"Jesu a mante in thukham hil siete le upate kikhopna inn, siempu lien pa Caiaphas kungah a peipi uhi.","title":"Siempu Lien Pa Mai-ah Jesu (Mrk 14:53-65 ; Luk 22:54-55 , 63-71 ; Jhn 18:12-14 , 19-24)"},"58":{"text":"Peter in siempu lien pa’ inntuol dong a gamla seng lo panin ama a zui hi; ama in a thu tawpna a thei nadingin a sungah lutin a cingte tawh a toton hi."},"59":{"text":"Siempu liente le vaihawmte in Jesu a tha thei nadingun ama langkhatah zuou teci a sui vua,"},"60":{"text":"zuou teci tampi tah a mai-ah a pei vangun amate in a mawna a mu sih uhi. A tawpna ah mi ni a mai-ah a pei vua,"},"61":{"text":"“Tam mipa in, ‘Pasien’ biehinnpi ka susie zo ding a, ni thum sungin ka lamkia ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Jhn 2:19"},"62":{"text":"Siempu lien pa dingin, “Dawn nading na nei sih amah” Na lang khatah a tecipanna uh bang teng ahei?” a ci hi."},"63":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu ham loin a om hi. Tua ciengin siempu lien pa in ama kungah, “A hingzing Pasien’ mai-ah kang ciemsah hi, Pasien Tapa Messiah na mah, ei gen in” a ci hi."},"64":{"text":"Jesu in tua pa kungah, “Na cisa ma bang ahi hi. Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, Tu-a kipanin vanglietna zietlamah Mihing Tapa to-in, vana meiilum tung tuongin ang pei na mu ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13-14"},"65":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa in a puonsilte balkehin, “Pasien tungah a hamkhiel ta hi! Teci dang a kisam nawn amah? En un, tu-in a hamkhielna na za zo uhi."},"66":{"text":"Na thukhenna uh bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Amate in, “A si dingin kilawm hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Siem 24:16"},"67":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in a maitang cil phi-in a vuo uhi; tuale kimkhatte in a phebeh vua,","ref":"Isa 50:6"},"68":{"text":"“Nang Messiah aw, ei gen vawi, nang ang vuo koi ahiei?” a ci uhi."},"69":{"text":"Tua laitahin inntuol ah Peter a na to hi. Numei nasem khat ama kungah pei a, “Nang zong Galilee mi Jesu tawh kipawl ngel vete aw,” a ci hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu a Nielna (Mrk 14:66-72 ; Luk 22:56-62 ; Jhn 18:15-18 , 25-27)"},"70":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “Na thugen theikha vawt sing,” ci-in amate zosie mai-ah kilepin a niel hi."},"71":{"text":"Innhlap lam zuonin a pusuo ciengin adang numei nasem khat ma in mu a, a gei-a dingte kungah, “Tam pa Nazareth mi Jesu tawh kipawl ngai ngel ve aw,” a ci hi."},"72":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua pa thei ngai vawt sing!” ci-in kitomlaw-in a nielkia hi."},"73":{"text":"Tua zaw a sawt loin a gei-a dingte pei-in Peter kungah, “Nang zong amate lahah khat hi lenlon teh, na awsuo-in zong ang kithei ngengngong khu,” a ci uhi."},"74":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama le ama kisamsie-in, “Tua pa thei kha kilkel sing!” ci-in a kitomlaw hi."},"75":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in, “Aa a khuon masangin thumvei nei niel ding hi,” ci-a Jesu thugen a phawhkia hi. Tuale ama pusuohin nahpi tahin a kap hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin siempu liente zosie le mipi upate pei-in Jesu thalup thei nading thu a kikum uhi.","title":"Pilat Mai-ah Jesu Kipuoh (Mrk 15:1 ; Luk 23:1-2 ; Jhn 18:28-32)"},"2":{"text":"Amate in lep-ia sa-in a zawpi vua, gam uhpa Pilat khut sungah a ap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama a leheh pa Judas in Jesu a kimawsah a thei ciengin kisiakia-in siempute le upate kungah dangka sawmthum a piekia hi.","title":"Juda Ama le Ama Kithat (Sawl 1:18-19)"},"4":{"text":"Ama in, “Maw nei lo sisan ka lebawl ziehin ka khiel zo hi,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin amate in, “Tuami ko tawh bang kisai ahei? Na law theithei kilaw ta’n,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a sum teng biehinnpi sungah sepsuhin a peisan hi; tuale ama pei-in ama le ama a gui-awh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin siempu liente in tua dangkate a la vua, “Tamte sisan man ahi ziehin biehinn sumkholna-a koi dingin kilawm lo hi,” a ci uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a kikup zaw ciengun tua sum teng gamdang mite vui nadingin beelkheng pa’ lo a lei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tua mun pen tuni dongin Sisan Leitang kici hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:18-19"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamsang Jeremiah tungtawnin, “Israel mite pawlkhat in ama’ man dinga a sesa uh tua dangka sawmthum a la vua,"},"10":{"text":"Topa in kei ei thupieh bangin beelkheng pa’ lo lei nadingin a pie uhi,” ci-a kigensa thu a tangtung hi.","ref":"Zech 11:12-13"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in gam uhpa mai-ah Jesu a ding hi; tuale gam uhpa in, “Nang Juda kumpi na hi amah?” ci-in a dong hi. Jesu in, “Na ci bangin ka hi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Pilat in Jesu Thu Dong (Mrk 15:2-5 ; Luk 23:3-5 ; Jhn 18:33-38)"},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin siempu liente le upate in a mawmat uh ciengin ama in dawng lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in ama kungah, “Amate in nang lang khatah ang mawmatna uh tampite za lo na hi amah?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a kimawsahna khat beh nangawn zong a dawnkia lo ziehin gam uhpa in lamdang sa mama hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in pawi a kibawl ciengin gam uhpa in mihonpite’ dei thongkie mi khat popo a hla zel ngaina ahi hi.","title":"Barabbas ahi sihle Jesu (Mrk 15:6-15 ; Luk 23:13-25 ; Jhn 18:39–19:16)"},"16":{"text":"Khum hunin amate in Jesu Barabbas a kici a gilo-a minthang thongkie khat a nei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n a kikhop zaw ciengun Pilat in amate kungah, “Jesu Barabbas le Messiah kici Jesu koizaw ka hla ding na dei vuoi?"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in hazatna tawh ama tungah a ap uh ahi lamtah a thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Thukhenna topha tungah a to laitahin a zinu in ama kungah kam vaihlah a, “Tuzan ka mangah ama ziehin nahpi tahin gimna thuoh ka hi ziehin mawna nei lo tua mipa bangma na law sin,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Barabbas hla-in Jesu tha dinga a nget nadingun siempu liente le upate in mihonpite a zawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gam uhpa in amate kungah, “Koi zaw ka hla ding na dei vuoi?” ci-in a dongkia hi. Tuale amate in, “Barabbas” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pilat in amate kungah, “Tua ahile Messiah a kici Jesu bang ka law diei?” a ci hi. Amate in a unpi-un, “Singlamte tungah khailumsah in,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Bang ziehin lah, ama in bang sietna bawl ahei?” ci-in a dong hi. Hinanle amate in, “Singlamte tung ah ama khailumsah in!” ci-in a awng semsem uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pilat in bangma a law thei ta sih a, buoina kipatna hizaw bep va ci a thei ciengin, ama in tui themkhat la-in mipite mai-ah a khut silsieng a, “Tam mipa’ sisan tungah ka sieng hi; na law theithei kilaw ta un,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu Khailup Dingin Pilat in Pie","ref":"Thkna 21:6-9"},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin mipi zosie in, “Ama’ sisan kote tung le ka suonlehlahte uh tungah tu taheh!” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in amate adingin Barabbas a hlakhie hi; Jesu ahile a sat zaw ciengin singlamte tunga khailup dingin a pie hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin gam uhpa’ galkapte phuolpi ah Jesu a peipi vua, a kimvelah galkap honpi zosie a kikhawmsah hi.","title":"Galkapte in Jesu Zako (Mrk 15:16-20 ; Jhn 19:2-3)"},"28":{"text":"Amate in a puonsilte hawhkhiet piehin ama tungah puontuol dupsan khat a silsah vua,"},"29":{"text":"tuale amate in ling tawh kibawl kumpi lukhu khat phanin ama’ lu tungah a khusah uhi. Amate in a zietlamah pumpeng khat tawisahin a mai-ah a khupdin vua, “Judah Kumpipa aw, na khan sawt taheh!” ci-in a zako uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ama a cilphit vua, tuale a pumpeng la-in a lutang a sat uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ama a zako zaw ciengun a puontuol hawhkhieh piehin a puonte ma a silsahkia uhi.
