Tua ciengin amate in khailup dingin ama a zawpi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate a pei laitahun Simon kici Cyrene pana mi khat tawh a kituoh kha uhi; amate in ama’ singlamte puo dingin tua pa a pausawl uhi.","title":"Jesu Kikhaina (Mrk 15:21-32 ; Luk 23:26-43 ; Jhn 19:17-27)"},"33":{"text":"Tuale Golgotha (Lugu Mun a ci nopna) kici munah a tun ciengun amate in a dawn dingin"},"34":{"text":"tuikha kihal lenggazu a pie uhi; hizongle ama in ciem a, a dawn nuom sih hi.","ref":"Late 69:21"},"35":{"text":"Singlamte tungah Jesu a khailia zaw ciengun amate in aisanna tawh a puonte a hawm uhi.","ref":"Late 22:18"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin khumnah amate to-in ama a en uhi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in Jesu’ lu tung son tahah, “Tam pa pen Judah Kumpipa Jesu ahi hi,” ci-a kigiel mawmatna lai a suong uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tawh misuomte ni, khat a zietlamah, khat a veilamah kikhai hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua mun a nawhkha mite in a lu uh vihin,","ref":"Late 22:7; 109:25"},"40":{"text":"“Biehinnpi susie-in ni thum sunga a lamkia ding pa aw, nang le nang kihunkhie vawi! Pasien’ tapa na hi leh singlamte tung panin hing kumsuh in,” ci-in a elho uhi.","ref":"Mat 26:61; Jhn 2:19"},"41":{"text":"Tua ma bangin siempu liente in zong thukham hil siete le upate tawh ama a zako vua,"},"42":{"text":"“Ama in midangte hunkhie thei napi ama le ama lah a kihunkhie thei vanuh sih hi; ama Israel-te’ Kumpipa ahi hi; tu-in a singlamte tung panin hing kumsuh leh i um pan ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in Pasien muong hi; tu-in Pasien in pha a sah leh ama hunkhie taheh; azieh pen ama in, “Kei Pasien’ tapa ka hi hi,’ ci hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Late 22:8"},"44":{"text":"Ama tawh a kikhaiton misuomte in zong tua bang ma-in a tawh uhi."},"45":{"text":"Sunkim a kipanin nitah nai thum dongin tua gam sung zosie-ah mutzin a tung hi.","title":"Jesu’ Sina (Mrk 15:33-41 ; Luk 23:44-49 ; Jhn 19:28-30)"},"46":{"text":"Nai thum hun pawlin Jesu in, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” ci-in nahpi tahin kiko a, tua pen ka Pasien, ka Pasien, bang zieha nei nuasie ahei?” a cina ahi hi.","ref":"Late 22:1"},"47":{"text":"A gei-a ding pawlkhat in a zah ciengun amate in, “Tam mipa in Elijah hlan hi,” a ci uhi."},"48":{"text":"Amate lahah khat tai pai a, tui hupna khat la-in lenggazu thua sungah die a, cieng dawnah koi-in a dawn dingin a pie hi.","ref":"Late 69:21"},"49":{"text":"Ahi vangin adangte in, “Ngah phot un, ama a hunkhie dingin Elijah ang pei ei mah en tadi vai,” a ci uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu nahpi tahin kikokia-in a naahu tawpin a si hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin biehinnpi kidatna puonkhai a tung panin a nei dongin phalni kisuo hi. Zil zong lingin suongtumpite a pawhkeh hi.","ref":"Pei 26:31-33"},"52":{"text":"Hankhuhte kihong a, a sisa mi siengthote’ luonghawm kithosah hi."},"53":{"text":"Ama a thawkia zo ciengin hankhuh panin amate a pusuoh vua, khuopi siengtho sungah lutin mi tampite tungah a kihil uhi."},"54":{"text":"Jesu a cing galkapmangpa le a ompite in zil kiling le tua thupiengte a mu ciengun a zausi vua, “Tampa, Pasien’ tapa lah ahi tahpi mawh in!” a ci uhi."},"55":{"text":"Khum munah gamlapi pana a gal et numei tampitah a om uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tuate lahah Mary Magdalene, James le Joseph’ nu Mary, le Zebedee’ tapa tegel’ nu zong a om hi.","ref":"Luk 8:2-3"},"57":{"text":"Nitah ciengin Arimathea khuo panin Jesu’ nuazui zong ahi Joseph a kici mihaupa khat,","title":"Jesu’ Kivuina (Mrk 15:42-47 ; Luk 23:50-56 ; Jhn 19:38-42)"},"58":{"text":"Pilat kungah pei-in Jesu’ luong ngen hi; tua ciengin Pilat in zong ama tunga pieh dingin thu a pie hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuaci’n a luong la-in dielpuon siengtho khat tawh a tun zaw ciengin,"},"60":{"text":"suong a tawkuohsa ama’ hantha sungah a siel hi."},"61":{"text":"Mary Magdala le adang Mary zong hankhuh maingatin a to uhi."},"62":{"text":"A zing cieng, Kiginni zaw ciengin Pilat mai-ah siempu liente le Pharisee-te a kikhawm vua,","title":"Hankhuh Cingte"},"63":{"text":"“Siepa aw, tua mi solpa in a hin lai-in, ‘Ni thum zaw ciengin ka thokia ding hi,’ a ci thu ka ciemte lai uhi.","ref":"Mat 16:21; 17:23; 20:19; Mrk 8:31; 9:31; 10:33-34; Luk 9:22; 18:31-33"},"64":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ni thum a cin masangsie han hoi taha a kicin nadingin thu pie in; tua bang ahi sihle a nuazuite na pei-in a luonghawm na gu-in mipite kungah, “Ama sina pan tho zo ta hi,’ ci-in gen thei kha mawh ding uhi. Tua hileh a mi sol masahna uh pen a misol nukhia uh sangin ang siehuoizaw lai kha ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"65":{"text":"Pilat in amate kungah, “A cing ding galkap na nei uhi; pei unlen, na hi thei za-un a muonhuoi thei pen dingin bawl un,” a ci hi."},"66":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate pei-in hankhuh sinna suong seal tumin a ciemte zaw ciengun a cing ding galkapte koi-in muonhuoi tahin hankhuh a bawl uhi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni zaw, nipi kal khat sunga ni masa pen ni, phalvah hunin Mary Magdalene le adang Mary-te han vil dingin a pei uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Thawkiana (Mrk 16:1-8 ; Luk 24:1-12 ; Jhn 20:1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Tuale thakhatthu-in zil nahpi-in a kiling hi; bangzieh ahei cile vantung panin Topa’ vantungmi khat kumsuh a, hankhuh suongpi liamang dawhin a tungah a to hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ mel pen tunphe tawh kibang a, a puonte vua bangin a ngo hi."},"4":{"text":"Han cingte in ama a giin ziehun citunin a sibup uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua vantungmi in numeite kungah, “Zau sih un; singlamte tunga kikhai Jesu a sui na hi lam uh ka thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam tahah ama om nawn lo hi; azieh pen a gensa bangin ama tho zo hi. Hing pei unlen ama a kisielna mun hing en un."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin mallang tahin pei unlen a nuazuite kungah, ‘Misite lah panin ama thokia zo a, Galilee gama na masang vuah a pei tahpi ding hi; tua munah ama na mu ding uhi,’ ci-in va gen ta un. Note dinga kang thupuoh tami ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in zau le thanuom kawmin thakhatin han nuasie-in a nuazuite kungah a gen dingin a tai pai uhi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu in thakhatin amate na lamdot a, “Na dam vuoi mah!”a ci hi. Tuale amate a kungah a pei vua, a keng kawipomin a bie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Zau sih un; pei unlen Galilee-a haw dingin ka sanggamte kungah va gen ta un; amate in khum munah kei ei mu ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate a pei laitahin khuopi sungah hancingte pawlkhat a pei vua, siempu liente kungah a thupieng zosie a gen uhi.","title":"Hancingte Thupuoh"},"12":{"text":"Siempu liente le upate a kisuhtuo zaw uh ciengin, galkapte sum tampi pieh dingin gelna khat a nei vua,"},"13":{"text":"“Amate kungah, ‘Zanlai ka kimut laitahun a nuazuite hing pei-in a luong a gudap ta uhi,’ ci-in gen un."},"14":{"text":"Gam uhpa in tam thu a za khah tah leh zong ama ka lungkimsah ding vua, no kang buoisah sih ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a sumte a sang vua, tuale a kisawl bangin amate a gamta uhi. Tami tangthu pen Judah mite lahah tuni dongin kigen lai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin nuazui sawm le khatte zong, Jesu in amate kunga a gensa bangin Galilee gam muol tungah a pei uhi.","title":"Nuazuite Sawlkhietna","ref":"Mat 26:32; Mrk 14:28"},"17":{"text":"Amate in ama a mu ciengun a bie uhi; ahi vangin pawlkhat a tahsang sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale Jesu pei-in amate kungah, “Vantung le leitunga thuneina zosie kei tungah ei kipie zo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note pei-in minam zosie ka nuazui suohsah unlen, Pa, Tapa, le Hlagau Siengtho’ min tawh na baptize un.","ref":"Sawl 1:8"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin kang thupieh zosie a zui nadingun amate na hil un. Tuale hun tawp dongin keima in note kang ompi zing ding ahi lam phawh un,” a ci hi."}}}}},"41":{"info":{"name":"Mark","shortname":"Mrk","abbr":[],"desc":"Mark gen lungdamna thu (the gospel according to mark)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien Tapa Jesu Khris’ lungdamna thu a kipatna tam bang ahi hi.","title":"Baptize-pa John Thugenna (Mat 3:1-12 ; Luk 3:1-20 ; Jhn 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Kamsang Isaiah Laibu sunga a kigiel bangin, “En in, na lampi a siel dingin na mai-ah ka kamtaipa ka sawl hi;","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"3":{"text":"gamlahah mi khat tam bangin kiko hi: ‘ Topa pei nading lampi siel unlen, ama’ lampi na tangsah un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 40:3"},"4":{"text":"Gamlahah baptize-pa John kihil a, mawna maisah nading kisiakiana tawh kisai baptize-na thu hil hi."},"5":{"text":"Judea gam buppi le Jerusalem-a mi zosie ama kungah pei-in a mawnate uh a pulah vua, tuaci’n Jordan gun sungah a ki-baptize uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in John in kala-oh mul tawh a kigan puon sil a, a kawngah savun kawnggah gahin kauphe le khuoizu-in a kiva hi.","ref":"2Kum 1:8"},"7":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka nua-a ang pei ding pa pen kei sangin vanglien zawtham a, kunin a kedap khaute sut ding nangawnin ka kilawm sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in tui tawh note kang baptize hi; hizongle ama in Hlagau Siengtho tawh note ang baptize ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum hun lai-in Galilee gam Nazareth khuo panin Jesu pei-in John in Jordan gunah a baptize hi.","title":"Jesu a Ki-Baptizena (Mat 3:13-17 ; Luk 3:21-22 ; Jhn 1:29-34)"},"10":{"text":"Tui sung panin a thawto laitahin vantung kiphalsuo a mu a, ama tungah vakhu bangin Hlagau Siengtho a kumsuh hi."},"11":{"text":"Vantung panin aw khat ging a, “Nang pen kang it mama ka Tapa na hi hi; nang tungah ka lungkim mama hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 22:2; Late 2:7; Isa 42:1; Mat 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 9:7; Luk 3:22"},"12":{"text":"Tuale thakhatthu-in Hlagau Siengtho in ama senel gamah a sawl pai hi.","title":"Jesu Kize-etna (Mat 4:1-11 ; Luk 4:1-13)"},"13":{"text":"Senel gam sungah ni sawmli sung om a, Satan in ama a ze-et hi; tuale gamsate tawh omton a, vantung mite in ama kem hi."},"14":{"text":"John a kimat zaw ciengin Galilee gamah Jesu pei-in Pasien lungdamna thutha tangko a,","title":"Galilee ah Nasep a Kipatna (Mat 4:12-17 ; Luk 4:14-15)"},"15":{"text":"tuale ama in, “A hun ang tung ta a, Pasien’ manggam ang nai ta hi; kisiakia unlen lungdamna thu tha um un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:2"},"16":{"text":"Galilee Tuipi dung zui-in Jesu a pei laitahin Simon le a naupa Andrew, tui sungah len a khu laitah uh a mu hi, azieh pen ama gel pen ngabengte ahi uhi.","title":"Jesu in Nuazui Masate a Hlatna (Mat 4:18-22 ; Luk 5:1-11)"},"17":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Keima ei zui un, tua hile mi mante kang suohsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama gel in zong thakhatin a len uh nuasie-in ama a zui pai uhi."},"19":{"text":"Bakhat a pei zaw ciengin ama in gunkuong sunga len phaw-a a om Zebedee’ tapa James le a sanggampa John a mu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in thakhatin ama gel hlan a, ama gel in zong a pa uh Zebedee le a thacielte uh gunkuong tawh nuasie-in ama a zui pai uhi."},"21":{"text":"Capernaum khuo ah amate a pei uhi; tuale sabbath ni a tun ciengin kikhopna inn sungah ama lutin thu a hil hi.","title":"Hlabua Vei Mipa (Luk 4:31-37)"},"22":{"text":"Amate in ama’ thuhilna lamdang a sa uhi, azieh pen ama in thukham hil siete bang hi loin thuneipa khat bangin thu hil hi.","ref":"Mat 7:28-29"},"23":{"text":"Tua laitahin a kikhopna inn vuah hlabua in a mat mi khat om a,"},"24":{"text":"“Nazareth mi Jesu aw, nang le ko bang kisai i hei? Ko ei susie dinga ang pei na hi amah? Pasien’ Mi Siengtho na hi lam ka thei hi,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in ama ngelawt a, “Ham sin, tampa sung panin pusuoh in,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hlabua in mipa kongkawsah a, a aw nei za tawh awngin ama sung panin a pusuoh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un lamdang a sa vua, “Tam thu bang hi poma ahei? Thuneina tawh a kigen thuhilna tha khat ahi hi! Ama in thu pie po leh hlabuate nangawn in mang na lai uhi,” ci-in khatlekhat a kidong uhi."},"28":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in Galilee gam kimvel zosie ah a minthanna a kizel pai hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate in kikhopna inn a nuasie behun Simon le Andrew-te inn ah James le John tawh a lut uhi.","title":"Simon’ Innah Jesu in Mi Tampi Damsah (Mat 8:14-15 ; Luk 4:38-41)"},"30":{"text":"Simon’ sungnu cithuo-in lupmun tung ngahin om a, tuale ama kungah tua nu thu thakhatin a gen pai uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ama pei-in a khut tawh tua nu kai-in a phongto hi. Tua ciengin a cithuo natna dam a, zindo a kipan pai hi."},"32":{"text":"Khumi nitah, nitum zaw ciengin amate in cina zosie le dawivei zosie ama kungah a peipi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuale a khuozangpi-un kotkhah gei-ah a kikhawm uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in natna tuomtuom a vei cina tampite damsah a, dawi tampitah a notmang hi; dawite in a thei ziehin ama in a ham ding uh a phal sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Zingmawng khuova masangin gamdaina munah ama pei-in tuanah thu a ngen hi.","title":"Galilee-ah Thugen dinga Khuolzinna (Luk 4:42-44)"},"36":{"text":"Simon le a guolte in ama a sui uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ama a mu ciengun amate in, “Mi zosie in ang sui uhi,” a ci uhi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in, “Tam khuoveng tengah pei vai, tuate lahah zong thu ka gen ding hi; azieh pen tami sem dinga ang pei ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Galilee gam muncin tengah ama zinin a kikhopna uh innte sungah thu genin dawite a notmang hi.","ref":"Mat 4:23; 9:35"},"40":{"text":"Miphah khat ama kungah pei-in khupdin a, “Nei damsah nop po leh nei damsah thei hi,” ci-in a thum hi.","title":"Jesu in Miphah Khat Damsah (Mat 8:1-4 ; Luk 5:12-16)"},"41":{"text":"Jesu in hepihuoisa-in a khut zahin tham a, ama kungah, “Kang damsah nuom hi. Dam pai in!” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Thakhatin a phahnatna in ama nuasie-in a dam pai hi."},"43":{"text":"Khautahin ama thu a hilkhol zaw ciengin thakhatin peisah pai a,"},"44":{"text":"ama kungah, “Tami thu koima kungah gen malmal sin; ahi vangin pei-in siempu pa kungah va kilah ta’nlen amate tungah teci ahi dingin Moses thupieh bangin na damna ziehin biehna pie in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 14:1-32"},"45":{"text":"Hizongle ama pei-in a genthang kawikawi hi. Tua ahi ziehin khuopi sungah Jesu a langtangin lut thei ta loin khuo pulam gamlahah a om hi; hizongle ama kungah mun zosie panin mite pei veve hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni bang za ahei zaw ciengin Capernaum khuo ah ama kilekia a, inn ah ama om hi, ci thu kiza hi.","title":"Jesu in Phalsi Khat Damsah (Mat 9:2-8 ; Luk 5:17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n kotkhah mai nangawnah mun om nawn lo za dongin mi tampi a kikhawm uhi; tuale ama in zong amate kungah thu a hil hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi pawlkhat pei-in mihing li in phalsi khat zawngin ama kungah a peipi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi a tam sengin Jesu kung a tut zo lo ziehun amate in Jesu’ opna sontah innkhum a phelkhe uhi; tuale amate in a vang khat a vu zaw ciengun a lupna pheh tawh phalsi mipa a khiesuh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu in amau’ upna a mu ciengin phalsi mipa kungah, “Ka tapa aw, na mawna teng ang kimaisah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum sunga a to thukham siete pawlkhat in a lungsim sung vuah,"},"7":{"text":"“Bang dinga tam mipa hici ham mawh ahei? Pasien gensie ahi hi! Pasien khat beh longal koi in mawna maisah thei ahei?” ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu in amau’ ngaisutnate thakhatin thei pai ahi ziehin amate kungah, “Bang zieha na lungsim vua tam thute na ngaisut uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Phalsi mipa kungah, ‘Na mawnate kimaisah zo hi,’ ci ding le, ‘Tho-in na lupna pheh puo inlen pei in,’ ci ding koi baizaw ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawnate maisah thei nading thu a nei lam note in na thei nadingun ama in phalsi mipa kungah,"},"11":{"text":"“Na kungah kang gen hi, tho-in na lupna pheh la inlen na inn ah pei in,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama tho-in thakhatin a pheh la a, amate zosie mai-ah a peikhie pai hi; tuaci’n amate zosie in lamdang a sa vua, Pasien phatin, “Tam bang dan poma i mu ngai nai vawt sih hi!” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khatvei tuipi gei-ah Jesu peikia hi; ama kimvelah mihonpi a kikhawm vua, tuale amate thu hil hi.","title":"Levi a Kihlatna (Mat 9:9-13 ; Luk 5:27-32)"},"14":{"text":"Ama a pei kawikawi laitahin siehdonna zumah a to Alphaeus’ tapa Levi mu a, ama kungah, “Ei zui in,” a ci a, ama tho-in a zui pai hi."},"15":{"text":"Levi’ inn ah Jesu le a nuazuite nitah an ne-in a to laitahin siehdongte le mawneite tampitah zong ama tawh a toton uhi, azieh pen ama a zui mi tam mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Thukham hil Pharisee-te in mawneite le siehdongte a toton a mu uh ciengin amate in a nuazuite kungah, “Bang dinga siehdongte le mawneite tawh an a neh ton uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu in tami thu a zah ciengin amate kungah, “Cidamte in sievuon tulmaw loin cinate beh in tulmaw hi; midihte hlan dinga ang pei ka hi sih a, mawneite hlan dinga ang pei ka hizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"John’ nuazuite le Pharisee-te in an a tang uhi; tuale mite pei-in ama kungah, “John’ nuazuite le Pharisee-te in an tang napi bang dinga na nuazuite in an tang lo uh ahei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Antanna Thudawhna (Mat 9:14-17 ; Luk 5:33-39)"},"19":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Zineipa tawh a opton laitahun mopawi simte in an bangci tan thei ding uh ahei? Zineipa tawh a opton laisie-un amate in an a tang thei sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amate kung panin zineipa a kilahdawh hun ang tung ding a, khum ni ciengin amate in an a tang ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Koima in puonbeh tha tawh puonlui phaw ngai lo hi; a phaw zenzen leh a kiphawna puonbeh in puonlui kai-ehin a ehbe zaw ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Koima in savun um lui sungah lenggatui tha thal ngai lo hi; a thal khah mawh leh lenggazu in savun um phukehin lenggazu kibuo ding a, savun um zong kisie ding hi; savun um tha sungah lenggazu tha kithalzaw a, tuaci’n a ni-in kikembih thei hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Sabbath ni khatin bulei nawhin ama pei a, tuale a peikawmun a nuazuite in buvui a zut uhi.","title":"Sabbath Thu Tangkona (Mat 12:1-8 ; Luk 6:1-5)","ref":"Thkna 23:25"},"24":{"text":"Pharisee-te in ama kungah, “En in, bang dinga amate in Sabbath ni-a bawl dinga kilawm lo nate bawl uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “David in a pawlte tawh gilkielin neh ding a kisap laitahin bang bawl ahei ci thu na sim ngai sih uh amah?"},"26":{"text":"Siempu lien pa Abiathar hun lai-in Pasien inn sungah ama lut a, siempute beh in a neh thei Ompina anlum ne-in a pawlte zong kimkhat a pie hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 24:9; 1Sam 21:1-6"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kung vuah, “Mihingte adinga Sabbath ni kibawl ahi a, sabbath ni dinga mihingte kibawl ahi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Mihing Tapa pen sabbath ni nangawn a uhpa ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kikhopna inn sungah ama lutkia a, khum sungah a khut langkhat si mi khat na om hi.","title":"Khut Langkhat Si Mipa (Mat 12:9-14 ; Luk 6:6-11)"},"2":{"text":"Amate in ama a mawmat thei nadingun sabbath ni-in tua pa ang damsah poma ei mah, ci-in a buhdap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale ama in a khut langkhat sipa kungah, “A mailamah hing pei in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in amate kungah, “Sabbath ni-in a pha bawl ding le a sie bawl ding, mihing hinna hutdam ding le mi tha ding koi pen thukham tawh a kituoh ei?” a ci hi. Ahi vangin amate a sip dide uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in lungthah mai tawh amate a en kawikawi hi; a lungtang uh a khauh ziehin ama da mama a, tua mipa kungah, “Na khut zah vawi,” a ci hi. Ama in a khut a zah leh a khut a dam pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Pharisee-te pei-in ama a tha thei nadingun Herod pawlte tawh thakhatin a kikum pai uhi."},"7":{"text":"A nuazuite tawh tuipi lamah Jesu a kihem dawh a, Galilee gam panin mihon tampite in ama a zui uhi;","title":"Tuipi Gei-a Mihonpite (Mat 12:15-21)"},"8":{"text":"ama’ nasepna zosie a zah ciengun Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, Jordan galkhat, le Tyre le Sidon kima gamte panin mihon tampitah in ama kungah a pei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mipite a tam seng ziehin a nawh gawp khah lo nadingin gunkuong khat a baisa-a a koi nadingun ama in a nuazuite kungah a gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in cina tampi damsah zo ahi ziehin natna nei zosie in ama a thamkhah thei nadingun ama lam a neh vapual uhi.","ref":"Mrk 4:1; Luk 5:1-3"},"11":{"text":"Hlagau buate in ama a mu popo ciengun a mai-ah khupbawhin, “Nang Pasien Tapa na hi hi!” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama koi ahei, ci mi a theisah lo nadingun khautahin amate thu a vaihlah hi."},"13":{"text":"Muoltungah ama kato a, ama in a dei teng a kungah hlanin, tuale amate in zong ama a zuon uhi.","title":"Jesu in Nuazui Sawm le Nite Teel (Mat 10:1-4 ; Luk 6:12-16)"},"14":{"text":"Tuale ama in a sawltahpite ci-in a minvaw, mi sawm le nite teel a, amate pen a kithuopi ding,"},"15":{"text":"le dawite hawlkhiet nading thuneina nei ding ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a teel mi sawm le nite: Simon (Peter ci-in a minvaw pa);"},"17":{"text":"Zebedee’ tapa James le a naupa John (Vanging Tapate a cinopna Boanerges ci-in a minvawte);"},"18":{"text":"Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, Alphaeus’ tapa James, Thaddaeus, Canaan mi Simon,"},"19":{"text":"le ama a lehehpa Judas Iscariot-te ahi uhi. Tua ciengin ama inn ah a pei hi;"},"20":{"text":"tuale mihonpite a kikhawmkia vua, tuaci’n amate in an nangawn a ne thei ta sih uhi.","title":"Jesu le Beelzebul (Mat 12:22-32 ; Luk 11:14-23 ; 12:10)"},"21":{"text":"Mite in, “Ama a maw ahi ta hi,” ci thu a innkuonpite in a zah ciengun ama a kham dingin a pei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem pana a peisuh thukham hil siete in, “Ama pen Beelzebul in a mat ahi a, dawite’ mangpa suonga dawite a deldawh hi bo,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 9:34; 10:25"},"23":{"text":"Tuale ama kungah amate hlan a, ama in thugentena zangin thuhil a, “Bangci bangin Satan in Satan deldawh thei ding ahei?"},"24":{"text":"Gam khat ama le ama kikhenthangin kido leh tua gam a kip zo sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Innkuon khat ama le ama kikhenthangin kido leh tua innkuon zong a kip zo sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Satan ama le ama kido-in kikhenthang leh kip zo lo ding a, a manthai hun a tung zo ahi ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanle mi thahatpa lep-ia masa lopi-in koima in mi thahtapa’ inn sungah lutin a neisa teng a lahpieh thei sih ding hi; tua cieng behin a inn sung a bulu thei pan ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“A tahtah a kang ci-in, mite’ mawna le Pasien a gensietna popo uh kimaisah ding hi;"},"29":{"text":"ahi vangin Hlagau Siengtho a gensie poma a mawna uh kimaisah zo lo ding a, kumtawnin maw nei ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 12:10"},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in, “Ama hlabua nei ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nu le a naute a tung uhi; amate inn pulamah dingin ama hlan ding mi a sawl uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Unau Tahtahte (Mat 12:46-50 ; Luk 8:19-21)"},"32":{"text":"Ama kimvelah mihonpi a to uhi; tuale amate in ama kungah, “Nang ang hlan dingin na nu, na sanggam pasalte le na sanggam numeite a pulamah ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka nu le ka sanggamte i ci koite ahiei?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuale ama kimvela a tote enin ama in, “Ka nu le ka sanggamte tanah a om uhi!"},"35":{"text":"Ka pa’ deina banga a gamta mi poma ka sanggam pasal, ka sanggam numei le ka nu ahi uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei-ah thuhil dingin ama a kipankia hi. Ama’ kimkotah mihon tampi tahte kikhawm uh ahi ziehin gunkuong tungah ama kato-in tuanah to a, tua laitahin tuipi gei-ah mihonpite a om uhi.","title":"Khaici Vawpa Thugentena (Mat 13:1-9 ; Luk 8:1-15)","ref":"Luk 5:1-3"},"2":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah thugentena tampi tawh tam bangin a gen hi:"},"3":{"text":"Ngai un! Khaici vawpa khat khaici vaw dingin a kuon hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuale ama in khaici a vaw ciengin kimkhat lam lai-ah kie a, vate lengin a netum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khaici adangte ahile lei tam lona, suong tamna munah kie a, lei sa seng lo ahi ziehin thakhatthu-in po pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale ni ang suoh a, nisa in a kaa gawp hi; zung thuh hla lo ahi ziehin a vulnang pai hi."},"7":{"text":"Adang khaicite lingkawm lahah kie a, tuale lingkungte hing khangin dep gawp ahi ziehin ga a ga zo sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Khaici dangte lei hoina munah kie-in a kungte po-in khanglien a, a za zakhat, a za sawmguh, a za sawmthumin a ga hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Zah nading bil nei poma in za taheh,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama tanga a op laitahin ama kimvela a omte le nuazui sawm le nite in tua a thugentenate a dong uhi.","title":"Thugentena’ Deina (Mat 13:10-17 ; Luk 8:9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Na tung vuah Pasien’ manggam thusimte theitheina ang kipieh vangin a pulama omte tungah na zosie thugentena tawh kigen hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen, ‘Amate in enen napi a mu thei lo nading, ngaingai napi a tel thei lo nading, amate kihei-in a mawna uh a kimaisah lo nading,’ ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"13":{"text":"Tuale ama in amate kungah, “Tami thugentena na thei sih uh amah? Tua ahile thugentena zosie bang na ci thei ta ding uh ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Khaici vawpa in thu a vaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Lamdunga kivawte tam bang mite ahi hi: Amate in a zah uh ciengin thakhathu-tin Satan pei-in amate sunga kivawsa tua thu a lahpieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale suong tamna lei lahah a kivawte tam bang mite ahi hi: Amate in thu a zah behun lungdam tahin a sang pai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate zung hla loin bakhat sung beh hing zo a, tua thu ziehin lungkhamna le bawlsietna a thuoh uh ciengin a puakia pai uhi."},"18":{"text":"Adang ling lahah a kivawte pen tam bang mite ahi hi:"},"19":{"text":"Leitung lunghimawnate le hau nopnate in tua thute depgawp ahi ziehin bangma ga a nei sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Lei hoina munah a kivawte tam bang mite ahi hi: Amate in thu a zah ciengun pom pai-in a za zakhat, a za sawmguh, a za sawmthum a ga mite ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Meivah a tunna-ah tung loin, lawkhu ding po ahi sihle lupna nei lah po a koi dinga ang kitawi amah?","title":"Law Kikhu Meivah (Luk 8:16-18)","ref":"Mat 5:15; Luk 11:33"},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen pholah dingte simlo phuoldap ding bangma a om sih a, theisah dingte simlo bangma thusim zong a om sih hi.","ref":"Mat 10:26; Luk 12:2"},"23":{"text":"Zah nading bil nei poma in za ta uheh!” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Na thu zahte uh limtahin ngaisun un; na pieh za ma uh na ngakia ding vua, a tamzaw ang kipiehbe lai ding hi.","ref":"Mat 7:2; Luk 6:38"},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a neite kipiehbe ding hi; bangma a nei lote tung panin a neisun nangawn uh kilahpieh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 13:12; 25:29; Luk 19:26"},"26":{"text":"Ama in, “Pasien’ manggam pen mi khat in lei lahah a the khaici tawh kibang hi.","title":"A Khang Khaici Thugentena"},"27":{"text":"Sun le zanin kimu zel tho zel a, tua a khaici po-in na khang a, ama in bangci khan ci thu a thei sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Leitang in ama thu-in ga a gasah a, a masa penin a kung, tua zaw ciengin a vui, tua zaw ciengin a vui sungah a tah a piengsah hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin bu a min ciengin anlah hun tung ta ahi ziehin ama in thakhatin a phieukawi tawh pei-in a at hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joel 3:13"},"30":{"text":"Ama in, “Pasien’ manggam pen bang tawh tekahin, bang thugentena zangin gen ding i hi ahei?","title":"Ankam Tang Thugentena (Mat 13:31-32 ; Luk 13:18-19)"},"31":{"text":"Tua pen ankam tang tawh kibang hi, lei lahah a kivaw laitahin leitunga om khaici lah panin a neupen ahi hi;"},"32":{"text":"hizongle a kivaw ciengin ang khanglien a, ankung zosie lahah a golpen ang suoh hi, tuale a ba golpite ang zam a, vate in a hlim nei-ah bu a bawl uhi,” ci-in a gen leuleu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in tam bang thugentena tampi tah zangin amate thuhil a, a ngai zaw za cieng uh thu a gen hi.","title":"Thugentena a Zahna"},"34":{"text":"Ama in thugentena lo tawh amate tungah thu gen lo a, hinanle a nuazuite kungah a tuomin thu zosie a hilcien hi."},"35":{"text":"Khumni nitah lam ciengin ama in amate kungah, “Tuipi kantanin galkhat lamah pei vai,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu in Huipi Daisah (Mat 8:23-27 ; Luk 8:22-25)"},"36":{"text":"Tuale amate in mihonpite nuasie-in ama’ na tuonnasa gunkuong tungah tuongtonin a peipi uhi. Ama tawh gunkuong dangte zong a om hi."},"37":{"text":"Huipi le guo kithuo nasie tahin lang a, tuihuol in gunkuong sat gawpin gunkuong sungah tui dimlet ta hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama ahile gunkuong nua lamah tangkham khamin a kimu hi; tuale amate in ama phongin, “Siepa aw, ka manthai ding uh khawh ei sa lo na mah?” a ci uhi."},"39":{"text":"Ama zong tho-in huipi kungah, “Lang nawn sin! ci-in hosie a, tuipi kungah, “Dai dide in!” a ci hi. Tua ciengin huilang khawlin a dai dide pai hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Bang dinga zau na hi uh ahei? Upna na nei nai sih uh amah?” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate in lamdang sa-in khatlekhat a kiho vua, “Huipi le tuipite nangawn in a thu a mang valongin, tua ahile tampa koi ahi diei?” a kici uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate, tuipi galkhat Gerasenes gam sungah a tung uhi.","title":"Jesu in Gerasene Khuomi Dawiveipa Damsah (Mat 8:28–9:1 ; Luk 8:26-39)"},"2":{"text":"Gun-kuong tung panin a kumsuh zaw behin hlabua veipa khat in ama na dawntuo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama pen hankhuh lah po-a teng ahi a, koima in siakhau nangawn tawh hen zo lo hi;"},"4":{"text":"azieh pen kengkol le siakhau tawh tamveipi kihen ngai zo a, ahi vangin ama in a kihenna siakhau bottanin a kengkol suguoi gawp a, koima in ama zo zo lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Sun le zanin hankhuhte lah le muoltung tengah vahin awng vapuoh den a, suongte po tawh ama le ama a kikuikeh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a gamla panin Jesu a gal mu ciengin del phei-in a mai-ah a kun hi;"},"7":{"text":"tuale ama in a aw nei za tawh, “Sangpen Pasien’ Tapa Jesu aw, kei bang ei law sawm na hei? Pasien’ min tawh kang thum hi, kei ei bawlsie sin,” ci-in awng hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam banga a cina pen ama in tuapa kungah, “Nang hlabua aw, ama kung panin hing pusuoh in!” a na ci zieh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “ Na min bang ahei? ci-in dong hi. Ama in, “Ka min Legion ahi hi; azieh pen a tampi ka hi uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua gam panin amate a nawdawh lo nadingin ama kungah a thum vangut uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua laitahin muolpangah vohhon tampi gamta-in a om uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuale hlabua pa in ama kungah, “Vohte kungah ei sawl inlen a sungah ei lutsah in,” ci-in a thum uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in amate a peisah hi. Tuale hlabuate pusuohin vohhon sungah a lut uhi; tul ni bang a pha tua voh honte, luibang kenah taisuh vapualin tuipi sungah a tummang sieng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Vohcingte tai-in khuo sung le gam sung tengah tam thu a gen uhi. Tua ciengin tua thupiengte bang thu ahei ci-in a en dingin mite a kuon uhi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu kung a tung uleh a lungsim pilin puon sila a na to hiuhiau dawi legion khat a vei mipa a mu ciengun a zau uhi."},"16":{"text":"Dawiveipa le vohhonte tunga thupieng teng a musa mite in midangte kungah a gensawn uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin a gam panun a pei dawh nadingin amate in Jesu kungah thum a kipan uhi."},"18":{"text":"Gunkuong tungah ama a kato laitahin dawivei ngai mipa in ama tawh a opton nading a ngen hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in nielin tua pa kungah, “Inn ah pei inlen Topa in nang tungah bangzatahin hing sem a, bang khuotuona teng hing lah ahei, ci thu na guolte kungah va gen ta’n,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale ama pei-in Decapolis gam sungah Jesu in ama dinga a sepnate gen a kipan a, mi zosie in lamdang a sa uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gunkuong tungah tuongin Jesu galkhat lam a kaikia zaw, tuipi gei-ah a op laitahin a kimvelah mihon tampite a kikhawm uhi.","title":"Ngahnu Khat Hingkia, Numei khat Kidamsah (Mat 9:18-26 ; Luk 8:40-56)"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin a min Jairus a kici kikhopna inn uhte khat va pei a, tua pa in ama a mu ciengin a keng phungah bawhin,"},"23":{"text":"ama kungah, “Ka tanu neuno a si ding ahi ta hi. Ama ang damkia-in a hin thei nadingin hing pei inlen a tungah na khut hing nga ta’n,” ci-in tamveipi tah a thum vangut hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua pa tawh ama a zawhton hi. Tuale mihon tampi in ama a zui vua, ama a nehcip gawp uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua laitahin kum sawm le kum ni sung siluong natna a vei numei khat a om hi."},"26":{"text":"Sievuon tampi in a na lawmawsa ahi ziehin gimna nahpi-in na thuoh a, a sum neisun a thawigawt vangin nuomtuom loin a gim semsem hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua nu in Jesu’ thu na za a, mipite kawmkal ama nualamah peidap vakhianin a puontep a va tham ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua nu in, “A puontep thamkha beh leng zong dam pai ta vang,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuale thakhatin a siluong khawl pai a, a natna a dam ahi lam a kithei hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu in ama sung panin a vanglietna a peikhiet lam thakhatin phawh ahi ziehin mihonpite lamah kihei-in, “Ka puontep ei thampieh khu koi ahiei?” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"A nuazuite in ama kungah, “Mihonpi in ang nehcip gawp lam na thei nahpi bang dinga, ‘Koi ahiei ka puontep ei thamkha,’ na ci thei mawng ahei?” a ci uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in tua banga ei thamkha koi poma ahei, ci-in a en kawikawi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin numei nu in ama tunga a pieng thute thei ahi ziehin zau le ling kawmin ama mai-ah khupbawhin thupieng zosie mantahin a gen hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang ang damsah zo hi; na natna pan dam inlen lungnuomtahin na pei ta’n,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in a hopi laitahin makai pa’ inn panin mi pawlkhat pei-in, “Na tanu si zo ta. Bang dinga siepa na buoisah nah lai ahei?” a ci uhi."},"36":{"text":"Amau’ kiho Jesu in a galzah ciengin kikhopna inn uhpa kungah, “Zau sin, um zieu lel in,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in Peter, James, le James’ sanggampa John simlo koima kinuazui sah lo hi."},"38":{"text":"Kikhopna inn uhpa’ inn ah a lut ciengun, ama in mite kapin mau-in a ul valuoi a mu hi."},"39":{"text":"Ama a lut ciengin amate kungah, “Bang dingin gamlumin kap na hi uh ahei? Naupang pa a si ahi sih hi, a kimu ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuale amate a nuiza mama uhi. Tua ciengin a unpi-in amate pusuohsah a, naupang’ nu le pa le a optonpi mite tawh naupang opna munah a pei uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in tua nu a khutah tu-in ama kungah, “Talitha cum,” a ci hi. A khietna pen, “Numeino aw, tho in!” a cinopna ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua numeino zong thakhatin tho a, lam pei a kipan pai hi. (ama pen kum sawm le kum ni cing ahi ta hi). Amate in tami thu lamdang a sa mama uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tami thu koima a theisah lo nadingun ama in khautahin thupie a, tua nu a neh ding bang khat pie un, ci-in amate kungah a gen hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in khum mun nuasie-in a pienna khuopi lam zuonin pei a, a nuazuite in ama a zui uhi.","title":"Nazareth ah Jesu a Kinielna (Mat 13:53-58 ; Luk 4:16-30)"},"2":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in kikhopna inn sungah thuhil kipan a, ama thuhil a za mi tampite in lamdang a sa uhi. Amate in, “Tam pa in tami thu zosie hei pana a lah a diei? Ama tunga kipie khu bang pilna ahi ta diei? A khut tawh na lamdangte a bangci bawl thei a diei!"},"3":{"text":"Ama pen khutsiempa Mary’ tapa hi lel lo amah? A sanggamte zong James, Joses, Judas le Simon-te hi lo uh amah? A nau numeite zong tanah eite tawh om hi lo uh amah?” a ci uhi. Tuale ama tungah a lungkim sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Kamsangte pen a khuo a tui, a tanaute lah le a inn sung vuah ci simlo zatahna nga loin a om sih uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 4:44"},"5":{"text":"Tua hi a, ama in khum sungah cina tawmno khatte tungah a khut nga-in a damsah ci longal na lamdang a bawl thei sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Amau’ up lona pen ama in lamdang a sa hi. Tua ciengin ama in khuotate lahah thuhilin a zin kawikawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in sawm le nite hlan a, amahaw nita-in sawlin hlabua neite tungah thuneina a pie hi.","title":"Sawm le Nite Kisawlna (Mat 10:5-15 ; Luk 9:1-6)"},"8":{"text":"Ama in a khuolzinna vuah ciengkhut khat ci simlo, bangma an, thungip, kawnggah sunga sum cite a vom lo nadingun thu a pie hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin kedap bul unlen, songkhol ni silthuo sih un."},"10":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Inn sung khatpo-ah na lut uh ciengin khum mun pan na peidawh masangun tua inn ma-ah om suoh un."},"11":{"text":"Mun khatpopo ah hing kisang loin, na thugen uh a kingai nuom sih leh, na pei ciengun amate langkhatah teci dingin na keng vua leivui bangte thingkhie un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:51; Luk 10:4-11"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate a peikhie vua, mi zosie a kisiakia nadingun thu a hil uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in dawi tampi a hawlkhie vua, cina mi tampi sathau nu-in a damsah uhi.","ref":"Jas 5:14"},"14":{"text":"Jesu’ min kithei sieng ta ahi ziehin Herod kumpipa in tua thu a za hi. Mi pawlkhat in, “Sina panin Baptize-pa John ang thokia ta hi; tami thu ziehin ama in tam bang vanglietnate a bawl thei ahi hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Baptize-pa John Sina (Mat 14:1-12 ; Luk 9:7-9)"},"15":{"text":"Hizongle adangte in, “Ama Elijah ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Adangte in, “Tanglai kamsangte ma banga kamsang khat ahi hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 16:14; Mrk 8:28; Luk 9:19"},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Herod in tua thu a zah ciengin, “A ngawng ka tansanpieh pa John ang thokia ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen Herod in a naupa Philip’ zi Herodias a kinunpi hangin Herod mama in mi sawlin John mansahin, tuale ama lep-ia a, thong sungah a khum hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile John in Herod kungah, “Na sanggampa’ zi na kinunpi pen ngaina om lo hi,” ci-in a na gengen zieh ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 3:19-20"},"19":{"text":"Tuale Herodias in ama huo-in that nuom hi. Ahi vangin ama nu in a that zo sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen John, midih le mi siengtho ahi hi, ci thu Herod in thei ahi ziehin ama zatahin a panpi hi. A thugen a zah ciengin ama lungbuoi mama hi; hinanle a thugen a ngai nuom veve hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ suopawi ni-in Herod in a uliente, a galkapmangte le Galilee gam sunga a om makaipite adingin anvana khat a nei ciengin khum ni-in ama ading hun lemtang khat a tung kha hi."},"22":{"text":"A tanu Herodias sungtumin a lam ciengin tua nu in Herod le a zinte a lungkimsah mama hi; tuale kumpipa in ngahnu nu kungah, “Na dei popo ngen in, kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua nu tungah ama nasie tahin kiciem a, “Na nget popo, ka gam phalkhat nangawn kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua nu pusuohin a nu kungah, “Bang ka ngen diei?” a ci hi. A nu in, “Baptize-pa’ John lutang ngen in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua nu zong thakhatin kumpipa kungah tai pai a, “Kuong khat sungah Baptize-pa John’ lutang ei pie pai lacin nuom vang,” ci-in a ngen hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa da mama hi; hizongle a kiciemnasate zieh le a zinte maitang a zatahna ziehin tua nu a khia nuom sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in John’ lutang ang peipi nadingun a cing galkap khat thupie-in a sawlpai hi. Ama pei-in thong sungah ama’ ngawngtan a,"},"28":{"text":"kuong khatah tawi-in tua nu kungah a pie hi. Tua ciengin ngahnu nu in a nu a piesawn hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama’ nuazuite in tua thu a zah uh ciengin pei-in a luonghawm la-in hankhuh khat sungah a vui uhi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu kimvelah sawltahpite kikhawmin ama kungah a sepna zosie ule a thuhilna zosie uh a gen uhi.","title":"Tul Nga Vana (Mat 14:13-21 ; Luk 9:10-17 ; Jhn 6:1-14)"},"31":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Gamdaina mun khatah pei unlen bakhat sung khawl phot tadi un,” a ci hi. Azieh pen a tung a kuon mi tampi kiphamatin a om vua, amate in anneh nading hun-awng nangawn a nei sih uhi."},"32":{"text":"Gunkuong tungah tuongin gamdaina mun khatah a pei uhi."},"33":{"text":"Mi tampi in a pei lam uh mu-in amate ahi lam zong a thei ziehun khuopi zosie panin leilam zui-in khum munah a na tai vua, a amate sangin a na tung masazaw uhi."},"34":{"text":"Lui pieu a gei laitahin ama in mihon tampi mu hi; ama in a cing om lo tuute tawh kibang sa ahi ziehin amate tungah lainatna a nei hi; tuale ama in amate thu tampi hil ding a kipan hi.","ref":"Gam 27:17; 1Kum 22:17; 2Khg 18:16; Ezk 34:5; Zech 10:2; Mat 9:36"},"35":{"text":"Khuomiel kuon ciengin ama kungah a nuazuite pei-in, “Tami mun pen gamdaina mun ahi a, khuo zong miel kuon ta hi."},"36":{"text":"I kimvela khuota tengah amate va pei-in a an neh ding uh a lei thei nadingun amate sawl in,” a ci uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a kung vuah, “A neh ding uh bangkhat popo pie un,” ci-in a dawng hi. Amate in ama kungah, “Sum denarii zani man tawh anlum lei-in a neh dingun ka va pie ta ding uh amah?” a ci uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuale ama in a kung vuah, “Anlum bangza na nei vuoi? Pei-in va en ta un,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in lohing tungah mi zosie a pawlpawlin a to nadingun thu a pie hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pawlpawlin zakhat, sawmnga ta ci bangin amate a to uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in anlum nga le nga tawn ni la-in vantung lam ento a, tuale lungdam a ko zaw ciengin tua anlumte balkehin mipite mai-a lui dingin a nuazuite a pie hi; tuale amate zosie lahah ama in tua nga tawn ni a hawm hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuale a unpi-un ne-in a gil uh a va mama hi;"},"43":{"text":"tuale amate in khomun le nga themneng teng a khawm vua, seu sawm le ni a dim hi."},"44":{"text":"Anlum a ne pasal tul nga a pha hi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite a peisah laitahin thakhatin a nuazuite zong gunkuong tungah tuongsah a, galkhatah a om Bethsaida khuo ah a mapeisah hi.","title":"Tui Tungah Jesu Lam Pei (Mat 14:22-33 ; Jhn 6:15-21)"},"46":{"text":"Amate mangpha a pai zaw ciengin, thungen dingin ama muol tungah kato hi."},"47":{"text":"Nitah lam ang hi ciengin tuipi laikimah gunkuong om a, ama pen leitungah ama tangin a om hi."},"48":{"text":"Hui a lelan ziehin hamsapi-in gunkuong a haw lam uh ama in a mu ciengin, zingmawng lamin amate lam zuonin tuipi tungah a pei hi."},"49":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in tuipi tunga a pei ama a mu ciengun sihla sa-in a kiko uhi;"},"50":{"text":"azieh pen a unpi-un ama a mu ciengun a zau mama uhi. Ahi vangin ama in thakhatin amate hopi a, “Kilungnuomsah un, keima ka hi bo hi; zau sih un,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate tawh gunkuong tungah ama kato a, huipi zong a dai pai hi. Tuale amate in lamdang a sa mama uhi."},"52":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in anlum tungtang thute a thei lo ziehun a lungkhau uhi."},"53":{"text":"Amate a galkai zaw ciengun Gennesaret gam tungin gunkuong khi-in a khawlsah uhi.","title":"Gennesaret ah Cina Kidamsah (Mat 14:34-36)"},"54":{"text":"Gunkuong tung panin a kumsuh ciengun mite in ama a na theipai vua,"},"55":{"text":"tua gam buppi sungah mite a tai kawikawi vua, ama om hi, ci-a a zahna mun popo vuah a lupna pheh utawh cinate a peipi uhi."},"56":{"text":"Amate in khuopite, khuotate, lozaute le vanzuana munte-a kipan ama’ peina mun zosie-ah cinate a na koi vua, ama’ puontuol mongtep nangawn a thamsah nadingin ama kungah a thum uhi; tuale a thamkha zosie in damna nga uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kimkotah Pharisee-te le Jerusalem pan a pei thukham hil siete a kikhawm vua,","title":"Upate’ Tang Ngaina (Mat 15:1-20)"},"2":{"text":"a nuazuite pawlkhat in khut sil lo a cinopna ahi, khutbua pi tawh an a neh lam uh amate in a mu kha uhi."},"3":{"text":"(Azieh pen Pharisee-te le Jew mite zosie in upate’ tang ngaina a zui ziehun khut silsieng kilkel loin an a ne sih vua,"},"4":{"text":"vanzuana panin a pei ciengun zong kisil masa loin an a ne sih uhi; tuale amate in haite, umlebelte, sumngo kuongdaite sawpsiengna-a kipan tang ngaina dang tampi tah zong a tang lai uhi)."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pharisee-te le thukham hil siete in ama kungah, “Na nuazuite in upate’ tang ngaina zui loin bang dingin khutbua pi tawh an ne uh ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “No mihoi kipangte thu Isaiah in a mantaha a na gensa tam banga a kigielna-ah, ‘Tam mite in a kam pi-un kei ei zatah vua, hinanle a lungsim uh kei tawh kigamla hi;"},"7":{"text":"amate in mihingte’ bawltawm ngainate, zui ding ngaina bangin a hil vua, a mawhna-in kei ei bie uhi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 29:13"},"8":{"text":"Note in Pasien’ thupiehte taisanin mihingte’ tang ngainate na tukip uhi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kung vuah, “Na tang ngainate na zui thei nadingun Pasien’ thupiehte pampai dan na siem ta mama uhi!"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen Moses in, “Na nu na pa na zatah un,’ ci hi; tuale, ‘A pa ahi sihle a nu a gensie poma si valon ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:12; 21:17; Siem 20:9; Thkna 5:16"},"11":{"text":"Hizongle mi khatpo in a nu ahi sihle a pa kungah, ‘Keima tung pana na nga thei ding hunate pen Corban (Pasien tunga kipiesa a cina) ahi ta hi,’ a ci nah po leh,"},"12":{"text":"a nu le a pate adingin bangma khat beh na semsah nawn sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin na luosuh uh na tang ngainate ziehun Pasien’ thu bangma lo na suo ta uhi. Tam bang danin note in na tampi na sem uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in mihonpite hlankia a, amate kungah, “Na unpi-un ngai unlen thei ta un:"},"15":{"text":"A pulam panin a sungah tumin mi a buasah thei bangma om lo hi, ahi vangin ang pusuoh nate in mi buasah theizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Zah nading bil neite in za taheh,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite a nuasie zaw ciengin inn sungah tum a, a nuazuite in tua thugentena thu a dong uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Tua ahile no zong a thei lo na hi bo uh amah? A pulam panin mihing sunga a tumsuh poma in mi buasah thei lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen lungtang sungah tum loin gilpi sunga a tumzawh ziehin khum panin a kithahkia thei lam thei lo na hi uh amah?” a ci hi. (Tua bangin ama in an zosie siengtho hi, ci-in a gen hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “A sung pana pusuohte in mihing buasah hi."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen mihing lungsim tawng panin tam bang a sie ngaisutnate ang pei ahi hi: Numei-pasal pahtatna, guhtatna, tuolthana,"},"22":{"text":"angkawmna, huoihamna, gitlona, solna, thangtatna, thangsietna, mi daisahna, kihisahna, mottatnate ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam gitlonate zosie a sung lam pana pusuoh hi a, tuate in mihing a buasah hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Khum panin ama dingkhie-in Tyre gam lamah a pei hi. Inn sungah ama lut a, tua sunga a op lam koima a theisah nuom sih hi. Hizongle mi thei lo dingin ama a kiphuol thei sih a,","title":"Syrophoenicia Numeinu’ Upna (Mat 15:21-28)"},"25":{"text":"ahi vangin a tanu hlabua nei numei khat in thakhatin ama thu za a, tuale ama pei-in a keng zungah a khupbawh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua nu pen Gentile-te hi a, Syria gam Phoenicia khuo pieng ahi hi. Tua nu in ama kungah a tanu sung panin dawite a hawlkhiet pieh nadingin a thum hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in tua nu kungah, “Naupangte an nesah masa vai, azieh pen naupangte neh ding lahpiehin uite pieh ding kilawm lo hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua nu in, “Sie aw, sabuoi nei-a om uite nangawn in naupangte’ khateneng teng a ne uhi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tua nu kungah, “Tua bang na ci ziehin na pei thei ta hi, na tanu sung panin dawi pusuoh zo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua nu inn ah pei-in, lupna tunga a lum a tanu mu a, tua dawi a na peikhie ta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tyre gam panin kilekia a, Decapolis gam sunga om Galilee Tuipi lam zuonin Sidon lampi zui-in a pei hi.","title":"Jesu in Bilbing Mipa Damsah (Mat 15:29-31)"},"32":{"text":"Amate in a bilbing a ham-awh mi khat ama kungah a peipi uhi; tuale ama pa tungah a khut a ngah nadingin a thum uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in mihonpi opna panin tua mipa a tuomin peipi a, a bil sungah a khutme guongin a cil nu-in a lei a thampieh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in van lam ento a, khuisa-in tua pa kungah, “Ephphatha,” a ci hi. Tua pen, “Kihong in,” a cina ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuale a bil thakhatin kihong pai a, a lei zong kihlamin nuomtahin a ham thei pailien hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in koima kungah a gen lo nadingin amate thu a pieh vangin, thu pie semsem le thanuom tahin a gen semsem uhi."},"37":{"text":"Gen thei lo za dongin amate in lamdang a sa vua, “Ama in na zosie a hoi-in bawl zo hi; bilbingte nangawn in khuo zasah a, a ham thei lote zong hamsah thei hi,” a ci uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin neh ding nei lo mihon tampi a kikhopkia ciengun ama in a nuazuite hlanin a kung vuah,","title":"Mi Tul Li Vana (Mat 15:32-39)"},"2":{"text":"“Keima kungah mipite ni thum sung tahpi ang om zo ta vua, neh ding bangma zamtawng nei lo uh ahi ziehin hepihuoi ka sa mama hi."},"3":{"text":"A gilkielin inn ah peisah mawh leng pawlkhatte a gamlapi pana ang pei uh ahi ziehin lamkalah lamba ta va uh,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’ nuazuite in, “Tami gamlahah mi tam zapi koi in bangci va zo ding ahei?” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Anlum bangza mawngmawng na nei vuoi?” ci-in dong hi. Amate in, “Sagi” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in mipite tuolah tosah a, anlum sagite la-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin phalsuo a, a hawm dingun a nuazuite a pie hi; tuale amate in mipite tungah tuate a hawmpieh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in nganeu themkhat zong a nei uhi; thupha a pieh zaw ciengin tua teng zong a hawmsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in ne-in a gil uh va mama hi; tuale a khamval teng uh a khawm vua, seu sagi a dim hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua sungah mi tul li bang pha uhi. Tuale ama in amate a peisah hi."},"10":{"text":"A nuazuite tawh thakhatin gunkuong tungah tuong a, Dalmanutha gamah a pei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pharisee-te pei-in ama tawh thu kiniel a kipan vua, vantung panin lim khat a ngen uhi.","title":"Lim Khat Ngetna (Mat 16:1-4)","ref":"Mat 12:38; Luk 11:16"},"12":{"text":"A lumgsim tawngah nahpi-in khuisa-in, “Bang dinga tam khang mite in lim a nget uh ahei? A tahtah a kang ci-in, tam khang mite tungah bangma lim a kipie poma sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 12:39; Luk 11:29"},"13":{"text":"Tuale amate nuasie-in gunkuong tungah katokia a, galkhat lamah a pei hi."},"14":{"text":"A nuazuite in anlum puoh ding a mangngil vua, gunkuong sungah anlum pum khat beh a nei tabo uhi.","title":"Pharisee-te le Herod’ Tol (Mat 16:5-12)"},"15":{"text":"Tuale ama in a kung vuah, “Pilvangun, Pharisee-te le Herod’ tol kidawm un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 12:1"},"16":{"text":"Amate in, “An i nei lo zieh hi ngel va,” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu in tua thu thei ahi ziehin amate kungah, “Bang dinga na an nei lo uh gen talawm na hi uh ahei? Na lungtang vuah lut loin theicien nai lo na hi uh amah? Na lungtang uh a khau seng amah?"},"18":{"text":"Mit nei napi a mu lo na hi uh amah? Bil nei napi a za lo na hi uh amah? Note in na phawhkha ta sih uh amah?","ref":"Jer 5:21; Ezk 12:2; Mrk 4:12"},"19":{"text":"Mi tulnga ading anlum nga ka phalsuo lai-in khamval seu dim bangza na luoh vuoi?” a ci hi. Amate in ama kungah, “Sawm le ni,” a ci uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Tuale mi tul lite ading sagi ka phalsuo lai-in a khamval uh seu bangza na luoh vuoi?” a ci hi. Amate in ama kungah, “Sagi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a kung vuah, “Na telthei nai sih uh amah?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Bethsaida ah a amate a pei uhi. Mi pawlkhat in ama kungah mittaw khat a peipi vua, ama a tham nadingin a thumpieh uhi.","title":"Jesu in Bethsaida-ah Mittaw Khat Damsah"},"23":{"text":"Ama in tua mittaw pa a khut tawh tu-in khuo pulamah a peipi hi; ama in tua pa’ mitah a cil a nu zo ciengin ama tungah a khut ngam a, “Na khat popo na mu thei ei mah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua mipa khuodah a, “Mite ka mu thei hi, hinanle amate pen singkung lampei tawh a kibang uhi” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a mit tungah a khut ngam leuleu hi; tuale ama in teltahin a et ciengin khuo mukia a, na zosie cientahin a mu thei ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin a inn ah ama peisah a, “Khuo sung nangawnah lut nawn sin,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Jesu le a nuazuite, Caesarea Philippi gam sung khuotate ah a zin dingin a pei uhi; tuale lam a pei laitahun a nuazuite kungah, “Mite in kei koi hi ei ci vuoi?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu’ Thu a Genna (Mat 16:13-20 ; Luk 9:18-21)"},"28":{"text":"Amate in, “Baptize-pa John; adangte in, Elijah; adangte leuleu in, kamsangte lahah khat,” ang ci uhi, ci-in a dawngkia uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Tua ahile note in kei koi hi nei ci vuoi? ci-in a dong hi. Peter in ama kungah, “Nang Messiah na hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 6:68-69"},"30":{"text":"Tuale ama’ tungtang thu koima tunga a gen lo nadingun khautahin thu a pie hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Mihing Tapa in nahpitahin bawlsietna thuoh ding a, upate, siempu liente, le thukham hil siete in ama nielin kithat ding a, nithum zaw ciengin thokia ding hi, ci-in amate thuhil a kipan hi.","title":"Jesu in a Si ding le a Thawkia ding Magen (Mat 16:21-28 ; Luk 9:22-27)"},"32":{"text":"Ama in kicien tahin tam thu a gen hi. Tuale Peter in ama tuom peipi-in phawsiet a kipan hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nuazuite a etkawmin ama kihei-in Peter phawhsie a, “Satan aw, ka nua lamah kihem in! Azieh pen nang in Pasien’ thu ngaisun loin mihing’ thu na ngaisunzaw hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in a nuazuite le mihonpite hlanin amate kungah, “Mi khatpo ka nuazui a suo nop leh, ama le ama kinielin a singlamte puo-in ei zui taheh.","ref":"Mat 10:38; Luk 14:27"},"35":{"text":"Azieh pen a hinna uh a hunkhie nuomte in a hinna uh tan ding a, keima zieh le lungdamna thu ziehin a hinna a taante in a hinna uh a hunkhie ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; Luk 17:33; Jhn 12:25"},"36":{"text":"Amate in leitung buppi a nga vangun a hinna uh suplaw uleh bang phatuom ding ahei?"},"37":{"text":"A tahtahin, amate in a hinna uh bang tawh hleh theikia ding uh ahei?"},"38":{"text":"Tami angkawm le mawna tawh a kidim khang mite lahah keima le ka thute ei maizumpi mite ahi ule, a Pa’ minthanna vang le a siengtho vantung mite tawh a minthangin Mihing Tapa ang peikia ciengin amate a zumpi ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale ama in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, tam sunga a ding mi kimkhat in vanglietna tawh Pasien’ manggam ang tun a mu masangun sina a ciemkha sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Ni guh zaw ciengin Jesu in Peter, James, John-te a tuomin muolsang tung khatah a zawpi hi. Tuale amate mai-ah a mel kikhelin","title":"Mel Kikhelna (Mat 17:1-13 ; Luk 9:28-36 ; 2Pet 1:16-18)"},"3":{"text":"a puonsilte tee lihlehin kang silsel a, leitungah puonsawp mi koima in a ngosah zawh lo ding za dongin a vam lihleh hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum sungah Moses le Elijah kilaa a, Jesu tawh a kiho uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in Jesu kungah, “Siepa aw, tam sunga i op ding uh a hoi hi; nang ading buh khat, Moses ading buh khat, le Elijah ading buh khat, buh thum ei lamsah in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate a nahzau seng ziehun ama in ci nading mel a thei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin meiingo khat in amate tuomin meii lah panin, “Tam pa pen ka it mama ka Tapa ahi hi; ama’ thu na ngai un!” ci-in aw khat a ging hi.","ref":"Mat 3:17; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; 2Pet 1:17-18"},"8":{"text":"Thakhatin a kimkot a et uleh Jesu khat losie koima dang a mu nawn sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Muol tung pan a kumsuh laitahun sina panin Mihing Tapa a thawkia masangsie, a sil mute uh koima kungah a gen lo nadingun ama in thu a pie hi.","title":"Elijah ang Peina (Mat 17:9-13)"},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n tami thu amate teng beh thei-in a koi vua, sina pana thawkiana a ci pen bang a cinopna ahei, ci-in khatlekhat a kidong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in ama kungah, “Bang dinga thukham hil siete in Elijah ang pei masa ding hi, a ci uh ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi.","ref":"Mal 4:5; Mat 11:14"},"12":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Na zosie a bawlpha dingin Elijah ang pei masa tahpi ding hi. Tua ahile Mihing Tapa in zong gimna tampi a thuohdan ding le a kisimmawbawl dan ding teng a na kigielsa hi lo amah?"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, Elijah ang pei zo a, ama’ thu a kigielsa bangin ama tungah a dei bangun a bawl zo ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"A nuazuite kungah a tun ciengun a kimkot vuah mihon tampite a mu vua, thukham hil siete pawlkhat tawh a na kisel uhi.","title":"Hlabua Nei Naupang Khat a Kidamsahna (Mat 17:14-21 ; Luk 9:37-43)"},"15":{"text":"Mihon buppi in ama a mu uh ciengin lamdang a sa vua, a hopi dingin a mailamah a tai uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Amate tawh bang thu kisel na hi uh ahei?”"},"17":{"text":"Mihon lah panin mi khat in ama dawng a, “Siepa aw, nangma kungah ka tapa kang peipi hi; ama dawi vei-in ham thei lo hi;"},"18":{"text":"tua dawi in ama a mat vanglah ciengin tuol satna-in nei a, a cilphuon buo-in a ha gawi-in a hui zong a kin zel hi; tuale na nuazuite kungah ei delmang pieh un, ci-in ka nget vangin a delmang zo sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “No upna nei lo khang mite aw, note lahah bang tanvei hing om nalai ding ka hei? Note bang tanvei hing thuoh zo lai ding ka hei? Ka kungah ama hing peipi un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale amate in ama kungah tua naupang a peipi uhi. Tua hlagau in Jesu a mu ciengin thakhatthu-in tua naupang kinlawmsah a, ama tuolah pua-in kikhuleh a, a kam panin a cilphuon a buo hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in a pa kungah, “A hici zaw bang tanvei a sawt tai?” ci-in a dong hi. Ama in, “A neu lai-a kipan hi ta bo."},"22":{"text":"Tua hlagau in tha sawmin meikhuh sung le tui sungah tamveipi sawnpua zo ta hi; ahi zongin na bawl thei ding khatpo a op leh ei hepi inlen ei panpi in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Na bawl thei leh na ci amah! A um mi adingin na zosie kibawl thei hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in naupang’ pa in, “Ka um ta hi; ka uplana ei panpi in!” ci-in a kiko hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu in a hontai valuoi mihonpite a mu ciengin tua hlabua kungah, “Tami naupangno a ham thei nading le khuo a zah thei nading a khahtan nang hlabua aw, ama kung panin pusuoh in, ci-in thu kang pie hi!” ci-in a hosie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hlagau pengzahin naupangno nahpi-in a kinlawmsah zaw ciengin pusuoh a, tuale naupang misi tawh kibang ahi ziehin mi a tamzawte in, “Ama si ta,” a ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in a khut tawh ama tu-in a phongto leh a ding thei pai hi."},"28":{"text":"Inn sungah ama a tum zaw ciengin a nuazuite in, “Kote in bang dinga ka delmang zawh lo uh ahei?” ci-in a dapdawh uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Tam bangte pawl pen antanna le thungetna beh tawh a kinotmang thei pan ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Khumtah panin amate dingkhie-in Galilee gam a nawh uhi. Ama in koima’ thei ding a nuom sih hi;","title":"Jesu in a Si ding le a Thawkia ding Magenkia (Mat 17:22-23 ; Luk 9:43-45)"},"31":{"text":"azieh pen ama in a nuazuite thuhil a, amate kungah, “Mihingte’ khut sungah Mihing Tapa kilehehin amate in that ding a, a kitha zaw a ni thum ciengin thokia ding hi,” ci thu a hil zieh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"A nuazuite in a thugen a tel sih vua, hinanle a dong ngam sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate Capernaum khuo-ah a tung vua, inn sungah a op laitahun ama in a kung vuah, “Lampi-a na kiselna uh bang thu ahei? ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Koi Lienpen Ahei? (Mat 18:1-5 ; Luk 9:46-48)"},"34":{"text":"Amate a sip khinkhian uhi. Azieh pen lampi-ah a lienpen koi ahei, ci-in khatlekhat a kisel zieh uh ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 22:24"},"35":{"text":"Ama to-in sawm le nite hlan a, amate kungah, “A masapen a suoh nuom poma in a nukhia pen le adang teng’ sila a suo phot kul hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 20:26-27; 23:11; Mrk 10:43-44; Luk 22:26"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin naupang khat kai-in amate lahah koi a, a kangah tawi-in amate kungah,"},"37":{"text":"“Keima zieha tam bang naupang khat a limbawl poma kei ei limbawl ahi a, kei ei limbawl poma in kei ei limbawl hi loin kei ei sawl pa limbawl ahi zaw hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Luk 10:16; Jhn 13:20"},"38":{"text":"John in ama kungah, “Siepa aw, na min tawh dawite a hawlkhie mi khat ka mu vua, ama in eite ei zui lo ziehin ka kham uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Adang Dawi Delmangpa (Mat 10:40-42 ; Luk 9:49-50)"},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in, “Ama kham sih un; azieh pen ka min tawh na lienpi a sem mi koima in ei nua gensiet thei pah sih ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Ei langdo lo poma i pawl ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 12:30; Luk 11:23"},"41":{"text":"Azieh pen a tahtah a kang ci-in, Khris’ min na puoh ziehun dawn ding tui hai khat ang pie popo thaman nga loin a om poma sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:42"},"42":{"text":"“Note khatpo in keima ei um tami naupangnote khat a puasah leh, a ngawng ah an gawina suong golpi khat khai-in tuipi sungah tummang dawh leh ama adingin hoizaw ding hi.","title":"Maw Nading Ze-etna (Mat 18:6-9 ; Luk 17:1-2)"},"43":{"text":"Na khut in ang puasah leh tansan in; khut kim keng kimin mei a mi thei lona hell sungah na pei sangin khut sam keng samin hinna sunga na lut ding pen nang adingin hoizaw tham lai hi.","ref":"Mat 5:30"},"45":{"text":"Na keng in ang puasah leh tansan in; keng kimin hell sunga ang kipai sangin keng langbai-a hinna sunga na lut ding nang adingin hoizaw tham lai hi."},"47":{"text":"Na mit in ang puasah leh khei dawh in; mittang kimin hell khuh sunga ang kipai sangin, mit langkhat beh tawh Pasien’ manggam sunga na lut ding nang adingin hoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat 5:29"},"48":{"text":"Tua sungah a than nangawn uh si ngai lo a, a mei uzong a mit ngai sih hi.","ref":"Isa 66:24"},"49":{"text":"“Azieh pen mi zosie cisaw bangin mei tawh a kisaw ding uhi."},"50":{"text":"Ci hoi hi; ahi vangin ci a alna mang leh bang na ci alsahkia thei ding ahei? Note zong ci bangin al unlen, khatlekhat na kilem un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 5:13; Luk 14:34-35"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in khum mun nuasie-in Judea gam le Jordan gungal tengah a pei hi. Tuale ama kimvelah mihonpi a kikhawmkia uhi; tuale, a bawl ngaisa ma bangin amate tungah thuhil a kipankia hi.","title":"Kikhulna Thuhilna (Mat 19:1-9 ; Luk 16:18)"},"2":{"text":"Pharisee-te pawlkhat pei-in a ze-etna-un ama kungah, “Pasal khat in a zi a khul ding a kilawm ma amah?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “Moses in bang thu ang pie vuoi?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in, Moses in ahile pasal in kikhenna lai pie-a khul thei dingin ei phal hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Thkna 24:1-4; Mat 5:31"},"5":{"text":"Hinanle Jesu in amate kungah, “Na lungtang khau seng zieh vua ama in tua bang thukham a giel ahi bo hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin lei kisiemcil a kipanin, ‘Pasien in numei le pasal a bawl hi.","ref":"Pien 1:27; 5:2"},"7":{"text":"‘Tami thu ziehin pasal in a nu a pa nuasie-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a,"},"8":{"text":"tua ni tegel sa khat a suoh ding uhi,’ na kici hi.Tuaci’n ama gel ni hi nawn loin sa khat ahi ta uhi.","ref":"Pien 2:24"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien’ gawmsate koima in khen sih taheh,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nuazuite in inn sungah tami thu ama a dongkia uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “A zi khul a, numei dang khat tawh a kinung poma a zi angkawmsan ahi hi;"},"12":{"text":"tuale numei in a pasal khulin pasal dang khat tawh a kinun leh zong angkawm ma ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 5:32; 1Cor 7:10-11"},"13":{"text":"Ama in naupangnote a tham thei nadingin mipite in ama kungah a peipi uhi; tuale nuazuite in khautahin amate a na hosie gawp uhi.","title":"Jesu in Naupangnote Thupha Pie (Mat 19:13-15 ; Luk 18:15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in tua thu a thei ciengin lungthah a, amate kungah, “Naupangte ka kungah hing peisah un; kham sih un; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ manggam pen tua bang mite ading ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, naupangno khat banga Pasien’ manggam a sang lo poma, tua sungah a lut ngai sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 18:3"},"16":{"text":"Ama in a kangah amate tawi a, a tung vuah a khut ngamin thupha a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"A khuolzinna zom dingin a pei laitahin ama kungah mi khat tai a, a mai-ah khupdinin, “Sie Hoipa aw, kumtawn hinna ka luo thei nadingin bang sem ding ka hei?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Mihau Pa (Mat 19:16-30 ; Luk 18:18-30)"},"18":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Bang dinga kei mihoi nei ci ahei? Pasien khat beh simlo koima a hoi om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang in: ‘Na that sih ding hi; ang na kawm sih ding hi; na gu sih ding hi; zuou teci na pang sih ding hi; mi neisa na lahpieh sih ding hi; na nu na pa na zatah ding hi,’ ci thupiehte na thei hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:12-16; Thkna 5:16-20"},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Siepa aw, tam teng zosie ka neu lai-a kipan ka na zui siengsa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in a et ciengin ama it a, “Na khat kisam lai teh; pei-in na neisa teng zua inlen tua sum teng mizawngte pie in, tua hile vantungah gou na nei ding hi; tua ciengin hing pei inlen ka nua ei zui in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in neilelam tampi a nei ziehin tua thu a zah bepin maipua-in a dasa-in a peikia ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a kim a pam en kawikawi a, a nuazuite kungah, “Mihaute dingin Pasien’ manggam lut nading bang zatahin a hamsa diei izaw!” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tami kammal ziehin a nuazuite in lamdang a sa mama uhi. Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah genkia a, “Tate aw, Pasien’ manggam lut nading bangza tahin hamsa ahei!"},"25":{"text":"Mihau khat, Pasien’ manggam sunga a lut ding sangin kala-oh khat hieumei hawm sunga a lut ding baizaw lai hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in lamdang a sa mama vua, “Tua ahile koi in hutdam a tang zo mawh ta diei?”ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"27":{"text":"Jesu in amate enin, “Tam pen mihingte adingin hi zo lo ma hi, ahi vangin Pasien adingin a himaw thu hi lo hi; azieh pen Pasien adingin na vannuoi hi thei hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Peter zong kipanin ama kungah, “En in, ko zong na zosie nuasie-in na nua kang zui uh,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, keima zieh le lungdamna thu ziehin a innte, a sanggam pasalte, a sanggam numeite, a nu a pa, a tate, le a lote a nuasie poma in,"},"30":{"text":"tu khang hunin a za zakhat innte, sanggam pasalte, sanggam numeite, nute, tate, lote nga ding a, ang tung ding hunah kumtawn hinna nga lai ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin a masate tampi ang nukhia ding a, a nukhiate ang masa ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 20:16; Luk 13:30"},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem zuonin a pei laitahun a masang vuah Jesu na ma pei hi; amate in lamdang a sa vua, a nua a zui mite zong a zau uhi. Ama in sawm le nite a tuomin peipikia-in ama tunga pieng ding thute gen a kipan a,","title":"Jesu in a Si ding le a Thawkia ding Thumvei Magen (Mat 20:17-19 ; Luk 18:31-34)"},"33":{"text":"“En un, Jerusalem dongah i pei ding a, siempu liente le thukham hil siete’ khut sungah Mihing Tapa ki-ap ding a, tuale amate in sina thuoh dingin ama a mawmat ding uhi; tua ciengin amate in Gentile-te khut sungah a ap ding uhi;"},"34":{"text":"amate in ama simmaw bawlin, cilphitin a that ding uhi; tuale ni thum zaw ciengin ama a thokia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama mai-ah Zebedee’ tapa James le John pei-in a kungah, “Siepa aw, kang nget popo uh nei bawlpieh dingin kang thum uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"James le John’ Ngetna (Mat 20:20-28)"},"36":{"text":"Ama in ama gel kungah, “Bang hing bawlpieh leng na dei gel ei?” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama gel in, “Na minthanna kumpi topha tungah na to ciengin khat na zietlamah, khat na veilamah ei tosah in,” a ci uhi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Na sil nget uh pen na thei siem sih gel hi. Ka dawn ding hai ahi sihle ka ki-bapize nading sungah na ki-baptze zo ding gel ei mah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 12:50"},"39":{"text":"Ama gel in, “Hi zo na gel vang,” a ci uhi. Tua ciengin Jesu in ama gel kungah, “No tegel in keima’ hai na dawn ding vua, keima ei ki-baptizena ma tawh na ki-baptize ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka zietlam le ka veilam a to ding pen kei pieh thei ahi sih a, a bawlpiehsa mite ading hizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Sawmte in tami thu a zah bepun James le John-te tungah a lungthah uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu in amate hlan a, “ Gentile-te lahah gam-uh dinga kiciemte mite in amate tungah kiliensahin, a uliente un zong thuneina tawh amate a uh lam na thei uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ahi vangin note lahah tua bang hi lo ding hi; note lahah milien a suoh nuom poma na nasem uh hizaw ding a,","ref":"Luk 22:25-26"},"44":{"text":"note lahah a masa pen ahi nuom poma mi zosie’ sila ahi zaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat 23:11; Mrk 9:35; Luk 22:26"},"45":{"text":"Mihing Tapa zong midangte ama’ na semsah dinga ang pei hi loin, midangte’ na a sem ding le mi tampi tatkhiet nading ama’ hinna a pie dinga ang pei ahi zaw hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Jericho ah amate a tung uhi. Ama in a nuazuite le mihonpite tawh Jericho a nuasie laitahin lampi gei-ah Timaeus’ tapa, Bartimaeus a kici mittaw khutdaw ngen khat na to hi.","title":"Mittaw Bartimaeus Kidamsahna (Mat 20:29-34 ; Luk 18:35-43)"},"47":{"text":"Nazareth khuomi Jesu ahi lam ama in a zah ciengin nahpi tahin kiko a, “David’ Tapa Jesu aw, ei hepi bo ven!” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"A sip khinkhian nadingun mi tampi in a kham vangun nahpi tahin ama awng semsem a, “David’ Tapa aw, ei hepi bo ven!” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Jesu khawlin, “Ama tanah hing hlan ta un,” a ci hi. Tuale amate in zong mittaw pa a hlan vua, ama kungah, “Kilungnuomsah in; ding in, ama in nang ang hlan hi,” a ci uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in zong a puon tungsil paimangin tawndienin Jesu kungah a pei hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Bang kang bawlpieh ding na dei ei?” a ci hi. Mittaw pa in ama kungah, “Ka siepa aw, khuo ei musahkia in,” a ci hi."},"52":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Pei in; na upna in ang damsah zo hi,” a ci hi. Thakhatin ama in khuo mu theikia-in lampi-ah Jesu nua a zui pai hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem tawh a kinai Oliv Muol gei-a om Bethphage le Bethany khuo a tun ciengun ama in a nuazuite ni sawlin,","title":"Guolzawna tawh Jerusalem ah Jesu a Lutna (Mat 21:1-11 ; Luk 19:28-40 ; Jhn 12:12-19)"},"2":{"text":"ama gel kungah, “Na mai-vua khuo ah pei unlen, na lut lien uleh koima’ tuon ngai nai lona laano khat khau kikhisa-a om na mu ding uhi; a khau sut unlen hing kai ta un."},"3":{"text":"Mi khatpo in, ‘Bang dinga tam banga na bawl uh ahei?’ ang ci leh, “ Topa in tulmaw hi, tamtah ma-ah hing koisahkia pai na va,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama gel zong peipai-in, tuale lampi pulam kotkhah gei khatah laano a kikhi khat a mu uhi. Tua laano a khau a sut laitahun"},"5":{"text":"a gei-a om mite in, “Bang dinga laano a khau na sut uh ahei,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama gel in zong Jesu’ kam vaihlah teng a gen uhi; tuale amate in kai ding a phal uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu kungah laano a tut vua, a tungah a puonte uh pha-in Jesu a tuong hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi tampite in lampi-ah a puonte uh a na pha vua, adang pawlkhatte in gamlaha a sat uh singna bawhphate a pha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mai-a pei mite le a nuazui mihonpite in, “Hosanna! Topa’ mina ang pei pa in thupha nga taheh!","ref":"Late 118:25-26"},"10":{"text":"Ang tung ding i pu David’ kumpi gam in thupha nga taheh! Van a sangpen munah Hosanna!” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerusalem khuo ah ama lutin biehinnpi sungah tum a, na zosie a et kawikawi zaw ciengin, ni kai ta ahi ziehin sawm le nite tawh Bethany ah a pei hi."},"12":{"text":"A zing ni, Bethany pan amate a peikia ciengun ama a gil a kiel hi.","title":"Jesu in Theikung Samsie (Mat 21:18-19)"},"13":{"text":"Theikung a na pha khat a galmu a, a ga khat beh ka mu khah leh ci-in a en dingin a va pei ta hi. A zang a tun ciengin a nate simlo bangma khat beh a mu sih hi. Azieh pen thei ga hun hi lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in theikung kungah, “Koima in na ga nekia ngai nawn sih heh,” a ci hi. Ama’ nuazuite in tua thu a za uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerusalem ah amate a tung uhi. Tuale biehinnpi sungah Jesu lut a, biehinnpi sunga om vanzuate le vanlei mite delmang dingin a kisa a, ama in sumkhelte’ tona sabuoite le paalva zuate’ tonate zong a khulepieh hi;","title":"Jesu in Biehinnpi Siensuo (Mat 21:12-17 ; Luk 19:45-48 ; Jhn 2:13-22)"},"16":{"text":"tuale ama in biehinnpi sungah van khatpo peipi ding koima a phal sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in thuhil a, ‘Ka inn in mi namcinte’ thungetna inn kici ding hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi lo amah? Ahi vangin note in misuomte’ kibuhna kuo na suo ta uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 56:7; Jer 7:11"},"18":{"text":"Siempu liente le thukham hil siete in tami thu a zah ciengun ama tha thei nading lampi a sui den uhi; azieh pen mihonpite in ama’ thuhilna lamdang sa mama uh ahi ziehin ama a giing uhi."},"19":{"text":"Nitah ciengin khuopi pulamah Jesu le a nuazuite a pei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Zingmawngin amate a pei laita hun tua theikung a hui dongin a gawta a mu uhi.","title":"Theikung Gawta Pan Thusinna (Mat 21:20-22)"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in phawhkia a, ama kungah, “Siepa aw, en vawi tah! Na samsiet theikung gawta ta,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Pasien um un."},"23":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, tami muol kungah, ‘Kihemkhie inlen tuipi lilai sena’n kinei in,’ ci-in lung hei nei loin, na ci bangun tangtung ding hi, ci-in na up nah po uleh note adingin ang kibawlpieh ding hi.","ref":"Mat 17:20; 1Cor 13:2"},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n note kungah kang ci-in, na nget popo uh ka nga zo hi, ci-a na up uleh na nga ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Thungen dinga na din sielun mi khatpo tungah lungkimlona khatpo na nei khah uleh maisah un; tua hile vantunga om na Pa un zong na gamtat khielnate uh ang maisah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"ref":"Mat 6:14-15"},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem ah amate a tungkia leuleu uhi. Biehinnpi sungah a pei laitahin ama kungah siempu liente, thukham hil siete, le upate pei-in,","title":"Jesu’ Thuneina Kidong (Mat 21:23-27 ; Luk 20:1-8)"},"28":{"text":"“Bang thuneina tawh tamte na bawl ahei? Tam teng bawl nadingin koi in thuneina ang pie ahei?” a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Thu khat kang dong ding hi; ei dawng un, tuale ke’n zong bang thuneina tawh tam teng ka bawl ahei ci, kang gen ding hi."},"30":{"text":"John’ kibaptize-na pen vantung pana ang pei ahi amah, ahi sihle mihing tung pana ang pei ahei? Ei dawng un,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat kikumin, ‘Vantung pan hi,’ ci leih, ‘Tua ahile bang dinga ama na up lo uh ahei,’ ei ci ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin, ‘Mihing tung pan hi,’ i ci ding uh amah,” a ci uleh mi zosie in John pen kamsang tahtah khatin ngaisun uh ahi ziehin mihonpite a giing vanuh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in, “Ka thei sih uhi,” ci-in Jesu a dawng uhi. Jesu in amate kungah, “Ke’n zong bang thuneina tawh tamte ka bawl ahei, ci kang gen sih ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah thugentena zangin thugen a kipan hi. “Mi khat in lengga lo bawl a, a kimvelah dai kai-in, a sungah lengga cil nading dum to a, tausang khat daw hi; tua ciengin losapte kawmsahin gam dangah a zin hi.","title":"Losapte Thugentena (Mat 21:33-46 ; Luk 20:9-18)","ref":"Isa 5:1-2"},"2":{"text":"An lah hun a tun ciengin amate kung panin lengga lo pana a pieng ama’ nga ding teng khon dingin losapte kungah a sila khat a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in na manin na sat gawpin na guoh peisah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate kungah sila dang khat sawlkia leuleu hi; tua pa zong a lu na satin na zako uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin adang khat sawlkia a, amate in tua pa zong na that uhi. Adang tampite zong tua bang ma-in a sawl uhi; amate in pawlkhat na satin adangte na that uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a it mama tapa khat nei lai hi. A tawpna ah, ‘Ka tapa na zatah buong sam va uh,’ ci-in amate kungah a sawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin losapte in, ‘Tampa gamhluo ding pa ahi hi; hing pei un, ama that vai-in a gamh luo ding teng la vai,’ ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama manin a that vua, lengga lo pulamah a paimang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahile lengga lo nei pa in bang a law diei? Ama pei-in losapte susie ding a, a lengga lo midangte a pie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tami Lai Siengtho sungah: ‘Innlamte in a nilmang suong pen innkiu suongpi a suoh zo hi;"},"11":{"text":"tami khu Topa’ bawl ahi a, i mit mu-in lamdang hi,’ ci-a kigiel khu na sim ngai sih uh amah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 118:22-23"},"12":{"text":"Tami thugentena pen amate a langgenna ahi lam a thei ciengun ama a man nuom vua, ahi vangin amate in mihonpite a giing uhi. Tuaci’n ama nuasie-in a pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in thugenna tawh ama mawmat dingin a kungah Pharisee-te pawlkhat le Herod mi pawlkhat a sawl uhi.","title":"Phiengsie Pieh ding Thudawhna (Mat 22:15-22 ; Luk 20:20-26)"},"14":{"text":"Tuale amate pei-in, “Siepa aw, nang na citah a, koima zatah na nei sih hi; azieh pen nang in mi mai-et tuom na nei sih hi; ahi vangin thuman thutah tawh kituohin Pasien’ lampi na hil lam zong ka thei uhi. Kumpipa tungah sieh pieh huoi amah, pieh huoi lo ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Pie ding ka hi uh amah, pie lo ding ka hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin amau’ kineitawmna a thei ziehin ama in a kung vuah, “Note in bang dinga kei nei ze-et uh ahei? Sum denarii khat hing la unlen ei velsah un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale amate in dangka tang khat peipi uhi. Tua ciengin amate kungah, “Tami koi’ lim le koi’ min ahiei,” a ci hi. Amate in kumpipa’ lim le min ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Kumpipa’ nate kumpipa tungah pie unlen, Pasien’ nate Pasien tungah pie un,” a ci hi. Tuale amate in lamdang a sa mama uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ama kungah thawkiana om lo hi, a ci Sadducee-te pawlkhat pei-in thu khat a dong vua,","title":"Thawkiana Tungtang Thudawhna (Mat 22:23-33 ; Luk 20:27-40)","ref":"Sawl 23:8"},"19":{"text":"“Siepa aw, Moses in, ‘Mi khat’ sanggampa in ta nei loin a zi a sisan leh, tua mipa in tua meigongnu kinunpi-in a sanggam pa adingin ta hinpieh ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5"},"20":{"text":"Sanggam pasal sagi om a, a tapen pa in zi nei a, ta nei loin a si hi;"},"21":{"text":"tuale a nina pa in tua nu ma kinupi-in ta nei loin si leuleu hi; a thumna pa zong tua ma bang ahi hi;"},"22":{"text":"a sagina dongin tua nu a kinunpi vua, ta nei lo vive ma-in a si sieng uhi. A tawpna ah tua numei nu mama zong a si hi."},"23":{"text":"Thawkia hun ciengin tua nu koi pen’ zi ahi diei? Azieh pen a sagipi-un tua nu a kinunpi kim uhi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Note in Lai Siengtho thu le Pasien’ vanglietna na thei lo ziehun na khielna uh tami hi lo amah?"},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen sina panin amate a thawkia ciengin vantung mite ma bangin kipi kitenna om nawn lo ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Misite thawkiana tawh kisai-in Moses’ laibu sunga theubawh tangthu sungah, Pasien in ama kungah, ‘Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien, le Jacob’ Pasien ka hi hi,’ a ci thu na sim ngai sih uh amah?’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 3:6"},"27":{"text":"Ama pen a site’ Pasien ahi sih a, a hingte’ Pasien ahi zaw hi; note na nahkhiel mama uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Thukham hil siete lahah khat in a kung va nai a, amate khatlekhat a kiselna uh a za hi. Jesu in amate hoitaha a dawn thei lam a mu ciengin ama in, “Thupieh zosiete lah panin bang amasa pen ahei?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Thupieh Masapen (Mat 22:34-40)"},"29":{"text":"Jesu in, “Amasa pen in, ‘Israel aw, za in: Topa i Pasien in Topa khat beh ahi hi;"},"30":{"text":"Topa na Pasien, na lungtang zosie, na hinna zosie, le na lungsim zosie tawh na it ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:4-5"},"31":{"text":"A nina in, ‘Nangma na ki-it bangin na vengte na it ding hi,’ ci ahi hi. Tamte sanga a thupizaw thupieh dang om lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 19:18"},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham hil siete in ama kungah, “Siepa aw, na thugen a man hi.; nang in, ‘Ama khat beh ahi a, ama simlo koima dang om lo hi,’ ci-in a mantahin na gen zo hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:35"},"33":{"text":"Tuale, ‘Na lungtang zosie, na theina zosie le na thahatna zosie tawh ama na it ding,’ le, ‘Nang le nang na ki-it banga na vengte na it ding,’ ci pen meihal biehna buppi le biehpiehnate sangin thupizaw tham hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Hos 6:6"},"34":{"text":"Ama in pilvang taha a dawn thei lam Jesu in a mu ciengin ama kungah, “Pasien’ manggam tawh na kigamla sih hi,” a ci hi.
