Tua zaw ciengin koima in ama thu a dong ngam nawn sih uhi.","ref":"Luk 10:25-28"},"35":{"text":"Biehinnpi sungah Jesu in thu a hil laitahin ama in, “Bang dinga thukham hil siete in Messiah pen David’ tapa a ci thei uh ahei?","title":"David’ Tapa Tungtang Thudawhna (Mat 22:41-46 ; Luk 20:41-44)"},"36":{"text":"David mama in, Hlagau Siengtho sawlna tawh thugen a, ‘ Topa in ka Topa tungah, “Na keng nei-ah na galte ka koi masangsie-in ka zietlamah na to in,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 110:1"},"37":{"text":"David mama in ama pen Topa ci hi; tua ahile bangci bangin Jesu pen a tapa hi thei ding ahei?” a ci hi. Tuale mipite in lunglut tahin a thugen a ngai uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua banga a hil kawmin Jesu in, “Puontuolpi sila a va kawikawi ding uh nuomsa-in vanzuanate lahah zatah hopi ding a dei thukham hil siete na kidawm un,","title":"Jesu in Thukhamhil Siete Mawsah (Mat 23:1-7 ; Luk 20:45-47)"},"39":{"text":"tuale kikhopna inn sunga om tona nuom pente tunga to ding a nuom vua, pawibawlna ah zong mun thupi pente a luo nuom uhi!"},"40":{"text":"Meigongte’ inn a pumval mang vua, a kilimlawm dingin sauveipi thu a ngen uhi. Amate in mawsahna a lienzaw a nga ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Sumkholna kuong tawh kimaingatin Jesu to a, sumkholna kuong sunga sumpi khie mihonte a en hi. Mihau tampite in sum tampipi a khie uhi.","title":"Meigongnu’ Silpieh (Luk 21:1-4)"},"42":{"text":"Mizawng meigong numei khat pei-in paisa khat man ahi sumsan tang ni khie hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in nuazuite hlanin amate kungah, “Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, sumkholna kuong sunga sumkhie zosie teng sangin tami mizawng meigongnu in a tamkhiehzaw hi."},"44":{"text":"Azieh pen amate zosie in a neival a lamval uh sung panin a khie vua, tam nu in a zawn a ngau kawmkalah a kiva nading nasan hen nei loin a nei sun teng zosie a khie sieng hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biehinnpi panin a pusuo laitahin a nuazuite khat in ama kungah, “En vawi, Siepa, tami suongtumte le tami biehinnpi golin thupi sam e izaw!” a ci hi.","title":"Biehinnpi Kisiet nading Kimagen (Mat 24:1-2 ; Luk 21:5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama dong a, “Tami biehinnpi na mu ei mah? Suong khat tungah suong khat zong a kiciengsa-in kinuasie lo ding a, a unpi-in cimzan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Biehinnpi galkhatah a om Olive Muol tungah ama a to laitahin, Peter, James, le Andrew-te in,"},"4":{"text":"“Tua thute bang huna hing pieng ding a, tua thute zosie ang pien kuon ding ciengin bang lim ang om ding ahei? ei gen in,” ci-in a dapdawh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah thugen kipan a, “Koima in ang puikhiel lo nadingin kidawm un."},"6":{"text":"Keima’ min suongin mi tampi ang pei ding a, ‘Kei ama ka hi hi!’ ci-in mi tampi a puikhiel ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Gal thute le galkidona thuthangte na zah uh ciengin patau sih un; tamte pen ang pieng valon ding ma ahi a, ahi vangin hun tawpna ahi nai sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile minam khat le minam khat, gam khat le gam khat ang kido ding hi; mun tuomtuomte-ah zil ang kiling ding hi; kielpite ang tung ding hi. Ahi vangin tam pen gimna kipatna ahi na bo hi."},"9":{"text":"“Noma na hi uleh na kikemsiem un; azieh pen amate in thukhenna zumah ang tut ding a, kikhopna inn sungah zong ang kisat ding uhi; keima ziehin gam-uhte le kumpite mai-ah teci-in na ding ding uhi.","title":"Bawlsiet nading Kimagen (Mat 24:9-14 ; Luk 21:12-19)"},"10":{"text":"Minam zosie tungah lungdamna thu kiphuongzah masa ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in thusitna thuoh dingin thukhen zumah ang peipi uh ciengin bang gen ding ka hei, ci-in lunghimaw masa sih un; khum hun ciengin gen dinga ang kihil popo na gen un, azieh pen a gen ding no hi loin Hlagau Siengtho ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Mat 10:17-20; Luk 12:11-12"},"12":{"text":"Unau khat le khat ahi a, a pa in a ta ahi zongin thalup dingin a kileheh ding vua, tate in zong nu le pate langpangin a thatsah ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Keima’ min ziehin mi zosie in ang muda ding uhi. Ahi vangin a tawpna donga a thuoh zote in hutdamna nga ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:22"},"14":{"text":"“Ahi vangin ama op nadinga a kilawm lo munah a susie thei kidahhuoina ang din na mu ciengun (laisimte in thei ta uheh), Judea gama omte, muolte tungah tai uheh;","title":"A Susie Thei Kidahhuoina (Mat 24:15-28 ; Luk 21:20-24)","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; 12:11"},"15":{"text":"innkhum tunga omte kumsuh sih uh hinlen, bang khatpo la dingin zong inn sungah lut da heh;"},"16":{"text":"lo lai-a om mipa zong a puon tungsil la dingin kilekia sih heh.","ref":"Luk 17:31"},"17":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin numei gaite le nausen neite mi hamsie ahi uhi!"},"18":{"text":"Tami hun, phalbi sung ahi lo nadingin thu ngen un."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien in leitung a siemcil a kipanin tuhun dong, tua banga a pieng ngai nai lo, a pieng ngai nawn lo ding gimna lienpi tua hun ciengin a pieng ding hi.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Kln 7:14"},"20":{"text":"Topa in tua nite a tomsah sih leh koima suohta zo lo ding hi; ahi vangin ama’ teeltuomte adingin ama in tua nite a tomsah zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum hun ciengin mi khatpo in, ‘En un! Tanah Messiah om! ahi sihle, ‘En un! Ama khunah om! ang ci uleh um sih un."},"22":{"text":"Zuou thei messiah-te le zuou thei kamsangte ang pieng ding a, ahi thei le a teelsate nangawn a lampielsah dingin lim le na lamdang lienpite ang bawl ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin kigingsa-in om un; na kung vuah thu zosie kang gen sieng zo ta hi."},"24":{"text":"“Hinanle tua hamsatna nite zaw ciengin, ni kimielsah ding a, hlapi tang nawn lo ding hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa ang Peina (Mat 24:29-31 ; Luk 21:25-28)","ref":"Isa 13:10; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:10, 31; 3:15; Kln 6:12"},"25":{"text":"Van panin aasite kiesuh ding a, vana om vanglietnate kiling ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:4; Joel 2:10; Kln 6:13"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mihing Tapa, vanglietna le minthanna tawh meii lahah ang peisuh amate in a mu ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Kln 1:7"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a vantung mite sawlin lei kiu li pan le leimongte panin vanmongte dongin ama’ teelsa mite a kaikhawm ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Theikung panin thu na sin un: Theikung a bate hing mengin a na ang dawn ciengin khuokhal hun nai ta hi, ci-in na thei uhi.","title":"Theikung Pan Thusinna (Mat 24:32-35 ; Luk 21:29-33)"},"29":{"text":"Tua ma bangin note in a pieng tami thute na mu ciengun kotbieng dongin ama ang nai ta hi, ci-in thei ta un."},"30":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, tami silte zosie ang tun sieng masangin tam khang mite a si sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Van le lei maimang ding a, ahi vangin ka thute a maimang sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Ahi vangin khum ni le khum hun ding pen koima in thei lo hi. Vantung mite in hile, Tapa in hile a thei sih a, Pa khat beh in thei hi.","title":"Pilvanna Kisapna (Mat 24:36-44 ; Luk 21:34-36)","ref":"Mat 24:36"},"33":{"text":"Bang hun a ang pei ding ci thei lo na hi ziehun pilvangin kigalgingsa-in om un."},"34":{"text":"Tua pen khuolzin mi khat tawh kibang hi, a zinkhiet ciengin ama in a silate khut sungah a inn ap a, a nasep ding ciet uh sepiehin, kotcingpa kungah zong limtaha a vilsiem nadingin a vaihlah hi.","ref":"Luk 12:36-38"},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin inntehpa ang tunkia ding hun pen nitah ahiei, zankim ahiei, aah-masa khuon ahiei, phal kisem kuon ahiei, ci thei lo na hi ziehun kigingsa-in om un."},"36":{"text":"Tua hi sihle ama thakhatin ang pei ciengin na kimut laitah uh ang tuohkha ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Na kung vua ka gen teng ma mi zosie kunga zong ka gen ahi hi: Kiging un,” a ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peisan Pawi le Tolsawlo Anlum Pawi a tun nading ni ni a sap ni-in siempu liente le thukham hil siete in Jesu mandapin tha thei nading lampi a sui uhi.","title":"Jesu Kithasawm (Mat 26:1-5 ; Luk 22:1-2 ; Jhn 11:45-57)","ref":"Pei 12:1-27"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in, “Mipite lahah buoina om thei ding ahi ziehin pawi hun sungin bawl sih vai, a kici uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bethany khuo ah miphah Simon’ inn sunga sabuoi tungah Jesu a to laitahin, a manpha mama nard sathau namtui suongngo thawl khat tawi-in numei khat ama kungah pei a, tua nu in a thawl sukehin ama’ lu tungah tua sathau namtui a sungsuh hi.","title":"Bethany-a Sathau Kinuna (Mat 26:6-13 ; Jhn 12:1-8)","ref":"Luk 7:37-38"},"4":{"text":"Hizongle khum sunga om mi pawlkhat a thangpai vua, “Bang dinga tami sathau namtui ang buohmang mawh ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami sathau namtui kizua leh denarii zathum sanga a tamzaw kikhawng ding hi a, tua sum tawh mizawngte kihu thei ding hi,” ci-in tua nu a mawsah uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanle Jesu in, “Ama nu tua ci opsah lel un; bang dinga na buoisah uh ahei? Ama nu in kei adingin nasep hoi mama sem zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile mizawngte ahile note tawh a omton zing ahi a, na nop hunhunun amate tungah na migitna uh na lah thei ding uh ahi hi; ahi vangin note tawh kei kang omton zing sih ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 15:11"},"8":{"text":"Ama nu in ahi thei za-in a bawl zo hi; ama nu in ka luong vui nading ka pumpi sathau siengtho ei manu zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, lungdamna thu kigenna leitung muncin tengah ama nu a kiphaw zing nadingin a silbawl teng kigengen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin sawm le nite sung panin Judas Iscariot in amate tungah Jesu a leheh thei nadingin siempu liente kungah a pei hi.","title":"Jesu Lehheh ding Judas Thukim (Mat 26:14-16 ; Luk 22:3-6)"},"11":{"text":"Amate in tami thu a zah ciengun a lung uh dam mama a, sum pieh dingin ama a kamciem uhi. Tuaci’n ama in Jesu a leheh thei nadingin hun lemtang sui a kipan hi."},"12":{"text":"Peisan tuuno a kigaw ni, Tolsaw lo Anlum Pawi a ni masa ni-in a nuazuite in ama kungah, “Peisan Pawi an na neh nading hei sungah pei-in va siemkhol uleng na dei ei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Nuazuite Tawh Peisan Pawi (Mat 26:17-25 ; Luk 22:7-13 ; Jhn 13:21-30)"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a nuazuite ni sawlin ama gel kungah, “Khuopi sungah pei locin tuibeel khat a puo pasal khat tawh na kituoh ding uhi; tuapa na zui unlen,"},"14":{"text":"a lutna inntehpa kungah, ‘Siepa in, ka nuazuite tawh Peisan Pawi an ka neh thei nading ka zintunna inndan hei sung ahei, ci-in ei dongsah hi,’ va ci ta un."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a baisa-a na kipuosa a inndan tungnung gol khat nang lah va-un, tuanah ei teng ading va siem ta un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n nuazui tegel dingkhie-in khuopi sung a lut uleh, ama gel kunga a gensa vannuoi bangin a mu uhi; tuale ama gel in zong Peisan Pawi an ding a siem pai uhi."},"17":{"text":"A nitah ciengin sawm le nite tawh Jesu a tung hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale amate in a mun ciet uh la-in an a neh laitahun Jesu in, “Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, note lahah ka ankuong impite khat in kei ei leheh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 41:9"},"19":{"text":"Amate a da mama vua, a banbanin, “ Topa , kei hi sam sih vang izaw?” a ci ciet uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Sawm le nite lahah kei tawh kuong sunga anlum diepa ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama’ thu a kigielsa ahi ma bangin Mihing Tapa pen a pei ding ahi a, ahi vangin Mihing Tapa leheh pa ahile gimna a thuoh ding hi! Tua mipa pieng da zaw leh ama adingin hoizaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"An a neh laitahun ama in khomun lumkhat la-in lungdamna a ko zaw ciengin phalsuo a, amate tungah pie-in, “La un, tami in ka pumpi ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Vumkhawl ang Pienna (Mat 26:26-30 ; Luk 22:14-23 ; 1Cor 11:23-26)"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin hai khat zong la-in lungdamna a ko zaw ciengin amate pie a, amate in tua hai panin a unpi-un a dawn ciet uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Tami in mi tampite adinga a kibuokhie thuciemna tawh kisai ka sisan ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 24:8; Jer 31:31-34"},"25":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, Pasien’ manggam sungah lenggazu tha ka dawnkia ni masangsie tami lenggazu ka dawnkia ngai nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in Pasien phatna la khat a sah zaw uh ciengin Olive Muol lamah a pei uhi.","title":"Peter’ Niel ding Kimagen (Mat 26:30-35 ; Luk 22:31-34 ; Jhn 13:36-38)"},"27":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Note in na unpi-un nei taisan ding uhi; azieh pen, ‘Keima in tuucingpa ka satlia ding a, tuute a kithethang ding hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Zech 13:7"},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka thawkia ciengin na masang vua Galilee gamah ka na pei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 28:16"},"29":{"text":"Peter in ama kungah, “Mi zosie in nang hing taisan nanle ken kang taisan sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, tuni, tuzan mama, aah nivei a khuon masangin thumvei nei niel ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in khautahin, “Nangma tawh a si ding hi nanleng kang niel sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Amate in a unpi-un tua bang ma-in a ci ciet uhi."},"32":{"text":"Gethsemane a kici mun khatah amate a pei vua, ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Ka thu nget kalin tanah na to un,” a ci hi.","title":"Gethsemane ah Jesu in Thungen (Mat 26:36-46 ; Luk 22:39-46)"},"33":{"text":"Ama in Peter, James le John-te zawpi a, nahpi lunggimna le buoina a kipan hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Sina ding za dongin ka lung a gim mama hi; tanah na om unlen ei na ngah un,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"A gamla sim khat ama pei-in lei lahah bawhsuh a, ahi thei ding leh tami hun tawh ei kipelsah ta’n, ci-in thu a ngen hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in “Abba , Pa aw, nang adingin bangkim hi thei hi; keima kung panin tami hai ladawh ta’n; hizongle keima’ deina bang hi loin nangma’ deina bang hizaw taheh,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama a pei leh amate a kimusa-a om a mu hi; ama in Peter kungah, “A kimu na mah? Nai khat sung zong ei ngah zo lo na mah?"},"38":{"text":"Gimna hun sungah note na lut lo nadingun ngahin thungen un; lungsim a lawp vangin tahsa a thanem hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Khatvei peikia-in a nget ngai teng ma a va ngenkia ta hi."},"40":{"text":"Khatvei ama a peikia leh a mit uh hah zo nawn lo ahi ziehin amate a kimusa ma-in a mu leuleu hi; amate in ama kungah gen ding a thei ta sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"A thumveina peikia-in amate kungah, “Note khawlin a kimu hit hiet lai na hi uh amah? Pha zo ta! A hun ang tung ta hi; maw nei mite’ khut sungah Mihing Tapa a kileheh ding ahi ta hi."},"42":{"text":"Tho un, pei vai. En un, ei leheh pa ang nai ta hi,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Jesu in thu a gen laitahin sawm le nite sung pan thakhatin Judas tung a, ama tawh siempu liente, thukham hil siete, le upate’ sawl, namsau le phohbul tawi mihonpi tawh a zawh hi.","title":"Jesu Kilehehna le Kimatna (Mat 26:47-56 ; Luk 22:47-53 ; Jhn 18:1-11)"},"44":{"text":"Tu-in a leheh pa in amate lim khat pie a, “Kang nap ding pa khu tua pa ahi hi; ama man unlen limtahin cingin peipi pai un,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama a tun ciengin thakhatin Jesu kungah pei a, “Siepa!” ci-in a nam hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama tungah a khut uh nga-in a man uhi."},"47":{"text":"Hizongle a gei-a dingte khat in a namsau dawhin siempu lien pa’ silapa a sat leh a bil a bantan hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Guta bulu khat man ding banga namsau le phohbul tawh ang kuon na hi uh amah?"},"49":{"text":"Nisielin note tawh omtonin biehinnpi sungah thu ka hil laitahin nei man sih uhi. Ahi vangin Lai Siengtho a tangtun nading hi taheh,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 19:47; 21:37"},"50":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-in ama a taisan uhi."},"51":{"text":"Diel puonzal khat beh a sil tangval khat in Jesu a zui leh amate in ama na man vua,"},"52":{"text":"ahi vangin ama in zong a diel puonzal nuasie-in a guohtangin a tai hi."},"53":{"text":"Amate in siempu lien pa kungah Jesu a peipi uhi; tuale siempu liente zosie, upate, le thukham hil siete a kikhawm uhi.","title":"Jesu, Vaihawmte Mai-ah (Mat 26:57-68 ; Luk 22:54-55 , 63-71 ; Jhn 18:12-14 , 19-24)"},"54":{"text":"Peter in siempu lien pa’ leituol dongah Jesu galzui a, a cingte tawh mei-awi-in a toton hi."},"55":{"text":"Siempu liente le vaihawm zosie-te in Jesu a tha thei nadingun teci a sui uhi; ahi vangin khat zong a mu sih uhi."},"56":{"text":"Azieh pen mi tampite in zuou teci a pang vua, ahi vangin a teci panna uh a kituoh sih hi."},"57":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat dingin ama langah zuou teci a pang vua,"},"58":{"text":"“Ama in, ‘Mihingte’ khut tawh a kilam tami biehinnpi ka susie ding a, nithum sungin adang khat ka lamkia ding hi,’ a ci ka za uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Jhn 2:19"},"59":{"text":"Tam cieng nangawnah a thugenna uh a kituoh nai vaset sih hi."},"60":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate mai-ah siempu lien pa dingin Jesu thu dong a, “Na dawng sih ding amah? Na langkhatah amau’ teci panna bang ahei?” a ci hi."},"61":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in dawng loin a sip dide hi. Siempu lien pa in, “ Thupha nga pa’ Tapa Messiah na hi amah?” ci-in khatvei dong leuleu hi."},"62":{"text":"Jesu in, “Ka hi hi, ci a, tuale ‘Note in Vanglietna zietlamah a to,’ le ‘Vantung meii tung tuonga ang kumsuh Mihing Tapa,’ na mu ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13"},"63":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa in a puon botkehin, “Bang dingin tecite kisam lai ding ahei?"},"64":{"text":"Note in Pasien a gensietna na za zo ta uhi! Na khensatna uh bang ahiei?” a ci hi. Amate zosie in ama pen a si dinga kilawm ahi hi, ci-in a mawsah uhi.","ref":"Siem 24:16"},"65":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in cilphitin a mai tunpiehin a beng gawp vua, “Hing gen vawi!” a ci uhi. A cingte in zong peipi-in ama a beng gawp uhi."},"66":{"text":"A nei-a leituolah Peter a na op laitahin siempu lien pa’ nasem numei khat a pei hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu Kilepsan (Mat 26:69-75 ; Luk 22:54-62 ; Jhn 18:15-18 , 25-27)"},"67":{"text":"Mei awi-a na om Peter a mu bepin encien pai a, “Nang zong Nazareth mi Jesu tawh kipawl ngel vete aw,” a ci hi."},"68":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama kilep a, “Na thugen theikha sing, zong telsiem vawt sing,” ci-in leituol pulamah a pusuoh hi. Tua ciengin aah a khuong hi."},"69":{"text":"Tua nasem numei nu ma in mukia a, a gei-a dingte kungah, “Tampa pen amate sunga mi khat hi ngel ve aw,” a cikia hi."},"70":{"text":"Hinanle ama kilepin a nielkia hi. Bakhat zaw ciengin a gei-a dingte in Peter kungah, “Nang zong Galilee mi khat na hi ciengin, tuate lahah khat hi valon vateh,” a cikia uhi."},"71":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama le ama kisamsie-in, “Na gen uh mipa thei kha malmal sing,” ci-in a kitomlaw kia hi."},"72":{"text":"Khum hun lientahin a niveina aah a khuong hi. Tua ciengin Peter in ama kungah, “Aah nivei a khuon masangin thumvei nei niel ding hi,” ci-in Jesu in ama kunga a gensa thute phawhkia-in ki-ip zo loin a kap hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingmawng tungin siempu liente in upate, thukham hil siete le vaihawm teng zosie tawh kikupna khat a nei uhi. Amate in Jesu henin a peipi vua, Pilat kungah a ap uhi.","title":"Pilat Mai-ah Jesu (Mat 27:1-2 , 11-14 ; Luk 23:1-5 , 13-16 ; Jhn 18:28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Pilat in ama kungah, “Judah mite’ Kumpipa na hi amah” ci-in a dong hi. Ama in, “Na ci bang ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu liente in thu tampitah tawh ama a mawsah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Pilat in ama dongkia a, “Na dawn nading a om sih amah? Thu tampitah tawh ang mawmatna uh en in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in a dawnbe tuon lo ciengin Pilat in lamdang a sa mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum hunlai pawi hun ciengin amate in a nget uh thongkie khatpopo Pilat in a hla thei zel ngaina ahi hi.","title":"Pilat in Khailia dingin Jesu Ap (Mat 27:15-26 ; Luk 23:18-25 ; Jhn 18:38–19:16)"},"7":{"text":"Khum laitahin kumpi langpan hun sunga mi that, kumpi a ledo mite tawh thong a kieton Barabbas a kici mi khat a om hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihonpite pei-in Pilat kungah a bawl ngai ma banga a bawl nadingin a ngen uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in amate kungah, “Judah Kumpipa hing hla leng na nuom vuoi?” ci-in a dong hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in hazatna tawh ama tungah a ap uh ahi lamtah a thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin Barabbas a hlapieh zawh nadinga a gen dingin siempu liente in mihonpite a hantawh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Pilat in amate kungah, “Tua ahile Judah Kumpipa na ci pa uh bang law leng na nuom vuoi?” ci-in a genkia hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in, “Singlamte tungah khailia ta’n,” ci-in a awhsan uhi."},"14":{"text":"Pilat in amate kungah, “Bang dingin lah, ama in bang sietna bawl ahei?” ci-in a dong hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihonpi a lungkimsah nop ziehin Pilat in Barabbas hla a, ama in Jesu a sat zaw ciengin singlamte tunga khailia dingin a pie ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkapte in kumpi inntuol ah (gam-uh pa’ phuolpi a kicina) ama a peipi uhi; tuale amate in galkap honpite a kikhawmsah uhi.","title":"Galkapte in Jesu Simmawbawl (Mat 27:27-31 ; Jhn 19:2-3)"},"17":{"text":"Tuale amate in puontuol dupsan khat a silsah uhi; tua zaw ciengin ling tawh kumpi lukhu khat a phan vua, a lu tungah a khusah uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale amate in, “Judah Kumpipa aw, na khan sawt taheh!” ci-in salam a piesol uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in a lu pumpeng tawh satin a cilphit vua, khupdinin zatahna a pie uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama a zako zaw ciengun a puontuol a hawkhietpieh vua, ama’ puonte ma a silsahkia uhi. Tua ciengin singlamte tunga khailia dingin ama a zawpi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in a singlamte puo dingin khuota pana ang zin a kituopi khah uh mi khat a pausawl uhi; ama pen Alexander le Rufus’ pa, Cyrene khuomi Simon ahi hi.","title":"Singlamte Tunga Jesu a Kikhaina (Mat 27:32-44 ; Luk 23:26-43 ; Jhn 19:16-27)","ref":"Rom 16:13"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Golgotha a kici munah (lugu mun a cinopna) Jesu a peipi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale amate in myrrh panamtui kha tawh kihal lenggazu a pie uhi; ahi vangin ama in a ne nuom sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in singlamte tungah ama khailia-in a puonsilte a hawm vua, a tan ciet ding uh a thei nadingun ai a san uhi.","ref":"Late 22:18"},"25":{"text":"Singlamte tungah ama a khai laitahun zinglam nai kuo a sat hi."},"26":{"text":"A mawmatna uh lai-ah, “Judah Kumpipa,” ci-in kigiel hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama tawh misuom guta ni, khat a zietlam, khat a veilamah kikhaiton hi."},"28":{"text":"Lai Siengtho sungah, “Thukham palsatte tawh a kisimtha hi,’ a ci thu a tung hi.","ref":"Isa 53:12"},"29":{"text":"Ama a nawhkha mite in lupei-in a zako gawp vua, “Huoi lah! Biehinnpi susie-in ni thum sunga a lamkia ding pa,","ref":"Late 22:7; 109:25; Mrk 14:58; Jhn 2:19"},"30":{"text":"singlamte tung panin hing kumsuh inlen nang le nang kihunkhie ven!” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ma bangin amate lahah siempu liente in zong thukham hil siete tawh ama a zako vua, “Mi dangte hunkhie thei napi ama le ama a kihun zo sih hi ."},"32":{"text":"Kote in mu a, ka up thei nadingun Israel Kumpipa Messiah aw, tu mama-in singlamte tung panin hing kumsah in,” a ci uhi. Singlamte tunga a kikhaipi tegel in zong ama a engho uhi."},"33":{"text":"Sunkim a kipan nitah nai thum dongin gam sung mun zosie-ah mutzin a tung hi.","title":"Jesu’ Sina (Mat 27:45-56 ; Luk 23:44-49 ; Jhn 19:28-30)"},"34":{"text":"Nai thum hunin Jesu in, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani,” ci-in nahpi tahin a kiko hi, tua pen ka Pasien, ka Pasien, bang zieha nei nuasie ahei?” a cinopna ahi hi.","ref":"Late 22:1"},"35":{"text":"A gei-a a ding mi pawlkhat in a zah ciengun amate in, “Ngai vawi un, Elijah hlan hi ve aw,” a ci uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuale mi khat tai-in lenggazu thua sungah tui hupna die-in cieng dawnah koi-in a dawn dingin pie a, “Ngah phot un, ama hunkhie dingin Elijah ang pei ei mah en vai,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Late 69:21"},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu nahpi tahin kiko-in a naahu tawpin a si hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuale biehinnpi kidatna puonkhai a tung pana nei dongin phalni kisuo hi.","ref":"Pei 26:31-33"},"39":{"text":"Ama mai-a a ding galkapmangpa in ama a naahu tawpin a si dante a mu ciengin, “Tampa, Pasien’ Tapa tahtah hi mawh ei!” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"A gal-et numei pawlkhat zong a om hi; tuate lahah Mary Magdalene, a nauzaw James le Joses’ nu Mary, le Salome-te a kihal hi."},"41":{"text":"Galilee gam sungah Jesu a op lai-in tam teng in ama zui-in a kisapnate a na sih ngitnget uhi; ama tawh Jerusalem dong a zawhton numei dang tampitah zong a om hi.","ref":"Luk 8:2-3"},"42":{"text":"Tua ni pen sabbath ni masang, Kigin ni ahi ziehin nitah lam ciengin,","title":"Jesu a Kivuina (Mat 27:57-61 ; Luk 23:50-56 ; Jhn 19:38-42)"},"43":{"text":"ulien vaihawmte lahah mi’ zatah mama, Pasien’ manggam zong lametna tawh a ngah lenlon, Arimathea khuomi Joseph, Pilat kungah hangtahin pei-in Jesu’ luong a ngen hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in a si zo lam a thei ciengin lamdang a sa hi; tuale ama in galkapmangpa khat hlansahin a si zaw a sawt tai mah, ci-in a dong hi."},"45":{"text":"A si zo lam galkapmangpa tung panin a thei bepin a luong Joseph a pie hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in diel puon khat tawi-in a luong a la dawh a, tua diel puon tawh tunin a kilemsa suong hankhuh sung khatah a siel hi. Tua ciengin ama in hankot-ah suongtum khat lia-in a koi hi."},"47":{"text":"Mary Magdalene le Joses’ nu Mary in a luong kisielna mun a mu uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni a tawp zaw ciengin Mary Magdalene, James’ nu Mary, le Salome-te in Jesu’ luong nu dingin panamtuite a lei uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Thawkiana (Mat 28:1-10 ; Luk 24:1-12 ; Jhn 20:1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Nipi kal khat sung ni masa pen zingmawng tung, ni suo patin hanah amate a pei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat kikumin, “Han kotvang huhna suongtumpi koi’ ei liapieh mawh ding adiei,” a kici uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate a dato ciengun a gol mama tua suongtumpi a kiliasa-in a mu uhi."},"5":{"text":"Han sungah a lut uleh a zietlam pang vua a to puontuol kang sil tangval khat mu-in a zausi gawp uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate kungah, “Zau sih un; singlamte tunga a kikhailia Nazareth mi Jesu sui hi ngel uteh. Ama a thokia zo ta hi; tam munah ama om nawn lo hi. Amate in ama a sielna mun uh en un."},"7":{"text":"Pei unlen, a nuazuite le Peter kungah Galilee lam zuonin na masang vuah pei hi, ci-in va gen ta un; ama in note ang gensa bang lienin khum munah na mu ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 26:32; Mrk 14:28"},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate zausi-in lamdang sa kawm uh ahi ziehin han pan pusuohin a tai uhi; amate a zau ziehun koima kungah a gen sih uhi. (Amate tunga thu kipiesa zosiete, Peter’ kim le pama a om mite kungah tomkimin a gen uhi. Tua zaw ciengin Jesu mama in amate tungtawnin nisuona panin nitumna dong, a siengtho le a kisie thei lo kumtawn hutdamna thu tangkona a sawlkhie hi.)","title":"MARK’ A HIELNA A TOMZAW MARK’ A HIELNA SAUZAW Mary Magdalene Kungah Jesu Kihil (Jhn 20:11-18)"},"9":{"text":"(Nipi kal khat sung ni masapen, a thawkia zaw zingmawng tungin dawi sagi a hawlkhietpieh nu Mary Magdalene kungah ama kilaa hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua nu pei-in Jesu’ kithuopi ngaite da le kapin a op laitahun tam thu a va gen ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in ama a hing ahi lam le tua nu in ama mu zo hi, ci thu a zah ciengun a um thei sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tami teng zaw ciengin khuota lam zuonin a pei laitahun ama ni tungah a mel tuom khatin a kilaa hi.","title":"Nuazui Nite tungah Jesu Kihil (Luk 24:13-35)"},"13":{"text":"Tam tegel zong kilekia-in a gen vangun amate in a um sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin sabuoi tungah a to laitahun sawm le khat-te mama tungah ama a kilaa hi; ama a thawkia zaw ciengin ama a mu mite’ thu gen tahsang loin a uplana ule a lungkhauna ziehun amate a hosie hi.","title":"Jesu in Nuazuite Sawl (Mat 28:16-20 ; Luk 24:36-49 ; Jhn 20:19-23)"},"15":{"text":"Amate kungah, “Leitung muncin tengah note pei unlen, a piensahsa zosiete tungah lungdamna thu phuongzah un.","ref":"Sawl 1:8"},"16":{"text":"Thu um a, a ki-baptize mite in hutdamna nga ding uhi; ahi vangin a um lote in mawsah thukhenna a thuoh ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tami limte in a um mite a nuazui ding hi: Amate in keima’ min suongin dawite a notmang ding uhi; kam thate tawh a ham ding uhi;"},"18":{"text":"a khut utawh gulte a man ding vua, si theina gu khatpo a dawn ule zong bangma a ci sih ding uhi; cinate tungah khut a nga ding vua, amate a dam ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa Jesu in amate kungah tua banga a gen zaw ciengin vantungah ama kilato a, Pasien’ zietlamah a to hi.","title":"Jesu’ Vankana (Luk 24:50-53 ; Sawl 1:9-11)","ref":"Sawl 1:9-11"},"20":{"text":"Tuale amate kuonin muncin tengah lungdamna thu a phuongzah uhi. Topa in amate tawh na semton a, a thugente uh a kipsahna-in lim lamdangte in a zuisah hi.)"}}}}},"42":{"info":{"name":"Luke","shortname":"Luk","abbr":[],"desc":"Luke giel lungdamna thu (the gospel according to luke)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Eite lahah a tangtungsa thu zosie mi tampi in na giel zo a,","title":"Theophilus tunga Apna"},"2":{"text":"tuate pen a cil a kipanin mit tawh a mu mite le tua thu a na gente in ei na hilsawn bang tehteh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A zatahhuoi Theophilus aw, keima in zong a kipatcil a kipanin na zosie limtaha ka na kan zaw ciengin a thu a kizom diudeu-in nang adingin hing gielpieh leng hoi va, ci-in ka khensat hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n nangma tunga ang kihilsa thute thuman thutah ahi lam na thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Judea gam Kumpi Herod hun lai-in Abijah’ suon siempu gui sung panin a min Zechariah a kici siempu khat a om hi. Ama’ zi pen Aaron’ suon hi a, a min Elizabeth ahi hi.","title":"Baptize-pa John Suo nading Kimagen","ref":"1Khg 24:10"},"6":{"text":"A ni gelin Pasien mai-ah midih ahi vua, Topa’ thupiehte le zui ding ngaina zosie genbaang loin a zui uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Elizabeth pen a ciing ahi ziehin ta nei lo a, a ni gelin a kum uh a tam mama ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Khatvei ama’ pawlte sep hun ding a tun ciengin Zechariah in Pasien mai-ah siempu nasep sem a,"},"9":{"text":"siempute’ bawl zel ngaina a om bangin Topa’ mun siengtho sungah lutin panamtui hal ding, ci-in ai a kisan ciengin ama kiteel kha hi."},"10":{"text":"Panamtui a kihal hun sungin a kikhawm mi buppi in a pulamah thu a ngen uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah Topa’ vantungmi khat kilang a, panamtui kihalna maitam zietlamah a ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Zechariah in ama a mu ciengin lamdangsa-in zausi-in a kongawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin vantungmi in ama kungah, “Zechariah aw, zau sin, bang ding ahei cile na thungetna ka za zo ta hi. Na zi Elizabeth in tapa khat nei ding a, a min John na phuo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Lungdamin na kipah ding a, ama ang pien ziehin mi tampi lungdam ding hi,"},"15":{"text":"azieh pen Topa muna-ah ama milien ahi ding hi. Ama in lenggazu ahi sihle khamthei poma a dawn ngai sih ding hi; a suo masang nangawnin Hlagau Siengtho tawh a kidim ding hi.","ref":"Gam 6:3"},"16":{"text":"Ama in Israel mi tampitah, Topa a Pasien uh kungah a kiheisah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nu le pate’ lungtang a tate uh lamah, thumang lo mite’ lungtang a dih pilna lamah a kiheisah ding, Topa adingin mite a baisa-a koikhol dingin Elijah’ hlagau le vanglietna tawh a mai-ah a pei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mal 4:5-6"},"18":{"text":"Zechariah in vantungmi kungah, “Tami thu bangci bangin theithei ding ka hei? Azieh pen kei lah vuoi ta’ng a, ka zi zong kum tam ta hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua vantungmi in, “Kei Pasien’ nasem Gabriel ka hi hi. Nangma ang hopi ding le nang kunga tami lungdamna thu puoh dinga ei kisawl ka hi hi.","ref":"Dan 8:16; 9:21"},"20":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in nang in a hun tun cienga ang tangtung ta valon ding ka thugente na up lo ziehin tami thute ang tangtun masangsie a ham thei loin na om ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun sung teng, mite in Zechariah a na ngah vua, biehinn sungah a kiheh ziehin lamdang a sa uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ama a pusuo ciengin amate a hopi thei ta sih a, tua bepin biehinn sunga mangmu ahi lam a thei uhi. Ama a ham thei loin om den a, a khut tawh amate a hopi hi."},"23":{"text":"A siempu nasep hun a man ciengin a inn ah ama a pei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tam teng zaw ciengin a zi Elizabeth gai a, hla nga sung innkui den hi. Ama in,"},"25":{"text":"“ Topa in kei dinga a sep tami ahi a, ka mite lahah ka thuoh maizumnate ei lah pieh a, maipha ei pie ta hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"A hla guhna ciengin, Pasien in Galilee gam Nazareth kici khuopi khatah,","title":"Jesu’ Suo ding Kimagen"},"27":{"text":"David’ suon Joseph min nei pasal khat tawh kinung dinga zuthawl kipiesa ngahnu siengtho khat kungah vantungmi Gabriel a sawl hi. Tua ngahnu siengtho’ min pen Mary ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 1:18"},"28":{"text":"Ama pei-in tua nu kungah, “Maipha nga nu aw, nang kang hopi hi! Topa in nang ang ompi hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Hizongle ama’ thugenna ziehin lungmang mama a, bangci kihopi dan ahi ta bep diei, ci-in a lungsan dedu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua vantungmi in ama kungah, “Mary aw, zau sin, azieh pen Pasien’ maipha na mu zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Tu-in nang gai-in tapa khat na nei ding a, a min Jesu na vaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat 1:21"},"32":{"text":"Ama milien hi ding a, Sang pen Pasien’ Tapa kici ding hi, Topa Pasien in a pa David’ kumpi topha ama a pie ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Jacob suonte tungah kumpi-in maang den ding a, a kumpi gam tawp hun ci om ngai lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12, 13, 16; Isa 9:7"},"34":{"text":"Mary in vantungmi kungah, “Kei lah ngahnu siengtho khat hi bo ing a, tam thu bangci pien thei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Vantungmi in, “Nangma tungah Hlagau Siengtho ang tung ding a, Sang pen Pasien’ vanglietna in nang ang lie ding hi; tua ahi zieh in ang suoh ding nausen pen siengtho ding a, Pasien’ Tapa kici ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Na tanau nu Elizabeth zong a teh a vuoi nua-in gai zo a, tu-in a ciing a kici nu a gai zaw a hla guhna ahi ta hi."},"37":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien ading in a pieng thei lo bangma om lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 18:14"},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mary in, “ Topa’ nasem nu keima tanah om ing; na gen bangin ka tungah pieng taheh,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin ama kung panin vantungmi a peikhie hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua hunin Mary kisa mengmengin Judah muoltung gam khuo khatah haw a,","title":"Elizabeth Kungah Mary Haw"},"40":{"text":"Zechariah inn ah ama lutin Elizabeth a hopi hi."},"41":{"text":"Elizabeth in Mary’ hopina a zah ciengin a gil sunga nausen kitom a, Elizabeth zong Hla siengtho tawh kidimin,"},"42":{"text":"awging pi tawh, “Numeite lahah thupha nga nu na hi a, na gil sunga na paai nausen zong thupha nga ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Topa’ nu ang haw nadingin bang dingin tami thu kei tunga hing tung adiei?"},"44":{"text":"Nei hopina awging ka bil tawh ka zah behin ka sunga nausen kipahin a kitom hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa in ama kunga a gensate a tangtung valon ding hi, ci-in a um tua numei khu thupha nga ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuale Mary in, “Ka lungsim in Topa phat a,","title":"Mary Phatna La"},"47":{"text":"ka hundam pa Pasien sungah ka hlagau a kipah hi."},"48":{"text":"A nasem nu’ tuolniemna ei enin maipha ei pei zo ahi ziehin, tu-a kipanin a khang a khanga mi zosie in thupha nga nu ei ci ding uhi;","ref":"1Sam 1:11"},"49":{"text":"azieh pen vanglien pa in kei adingin na lienpite bawl zo a, ama’ min pen siengtho ahi hi."},"50":{"text":"Ama a zatah mite tungah a khuotuona a khangkhangin a tung hi."},"51":{"text":"Ama in a ban tawh a thahatna lah a, kiphatsahna lungsim neite a thethang hi;"},"52":{"text":"kumpi vangliente a kumpi topha pan khiesuhin, mi tuolniemte a tawisang hi;","ref":"Job 5:11; 12:19"},"53":{"text":"a gilkiel mite na hoi tawh dim a, mihaute khutguohin a peisah hi."},"54":{"text":"A khuotuona a phaw zing nadingun ama in a nasem Israel-te panpi zo a,"},"55":{"text":"i pute i pate tunga a gensa ma bangin Abraham le a suonlehlahte a khuotuo zing ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 2:1-10; Pien 17:7"},"56":{"text":"Elizabeth kungah hla thum bang a tam zaw ciengin inn ah Mary a peikia hi."},"57":{"text":"Elizabeth a nausuo ding hun tung a, ta pasal khat nei hi.","title":"Baptize-pa John’ Suona"},"58":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah a khuotuona lah zo hi, ci thu a innvengte le a tanaute in thei-in Elizabeth tawh a lungdamton uhi."},"59":{"text":"Ni gietna ni-in nausen teptan dingin a pei vua, a min dingin a pa min Zechariah ma phuo a sawm uhi.","ref":"Siem 12:3"},"60":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nu in, “Hi lo ding hi; ama pen John kici ding hi bo,” a ci hi. Amate in Elizabeth kungah,"},"61":{"text":"“Na be sung vuoh tam bang min koima’n phuo ngai sih,” a ci uhi."},"62":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa kungah bang min na phuo nuom ei, ci-in khut lim tawh a dong uhi."},"63":{"text":"Ama in suonglai khat ngen a, “A min John ahi hi,” a ci leh amate a unpi-in a ciza uhi."},"64":{"text":"Tuale thakhatin a kam kihongin a leii kihlam a, ama hamin Pasien a phat hi."},"65":{"text":"A innvengte zau-in Judea gam muoltung tengah tami thu zosie a gengen uhi."},"66":{"text":"Tami thute a za mi zosie in, “Tua ahile tami nausen khu bangci nausen ang hi mawh diei?” ci-in a lungsan uhi. Azieh pen Topa’ khut in ama a ompi tahpi hi."},"67":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa Zechariah, Hlagau Siengtho tawh kidimin tam bangin thu a gen hi:","title":"Zechariah’ Thugen"},"68":{"text":"“Israel Topa Pasien in thupha nga taheh, azieh pen ama in a mite ve-in, a tankhie hi."},"69":{"text":"Ama in a nasempa David’ suon sung panin eite adingin a vanglien hundampa khat piengsah zo ta hi."},"70":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in tanglai-a kipan a siengtho a kamsangte tung panin a na gensa bangin,"},"71":{"text":"i galte le ei mudate zosie’ khut sung panin hutdam a i op thei nading uh ahi hi."},"72":{"text":"Tua bangin i pu i pate tunga a kamciemsa ahi, lungsietna a lah nading le, a siengtho ama’ thuciemna phawden nading ahi zongin,"},"73":{"text":"i pu Abraham tunga a ciemsa tua kiciemna,"},"74":{"text":"i galte khut sung pana ei hutkhiet nading, zau vawt lo-a ama’ na i sep thei nading,"},"75":{"text":"i hin sung teng ama mai-ah siengthona le dihna tawh ama’ na i sep thei nading uh ahi hi."},"76":{"text":"Tuale nang, nausen aw, Sangpen Pasien’ kamsang pa ang kici ding hi; azieh pen a lampi siel dingin Topa mai-ah na pei ding a,","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"77":{"text":"amau’ mawnate a maisahna tungtawnin a mite tungah hutdamna thu theitheina pieh thei nading ahi hi."},"78":{"text":"A nunnem i Pasien uh’ ei hepina ziehin a sangna panin eite tungah phalvah ang tang ding a,"},"79":{"text":"khuomiel lahah a to mite le sina hlim nei-a om mite tungah khuovah pie-in kilemna lampi-ah ei pui ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 9:2"},"80":{"text":"Nausen khanglienin hlagau lamah thahat a, Israel mihonpi lahah a kilaa masangsie gamlahah a om hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Kumpipa Caesar Augustus in leitung buppi mi phaza a kisim nadingin thu a pie hi.","title":"Jesu’ Suona (Mat 1:18-25)"},"2":{"text":"Tam pen Syria gam-uhpa Quirinius hun sunga kibawl mi phaza kisimna masa pen ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A khuo ciet vuah min pie dingin mi zosie a pei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Joseph zong David’ suon ahi ziehin Galilee gam Nazareth khuo panin Judea gam Bethlehem a kici David khuopi ah a pei hi."},"5":{"text":"Zuthawl a piehsa le a gaituon Mary tawh min pie dingin ama a pei hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate tuanah a tam sungun Mary a nausuo hun a tung hi."},"7":{"text":"A tacil ahi ta pasal khat suoh a, tua nu in puonbeh tawh ama tunin gan ankuong sungah a siel hi, azieh pen zintun inn ah amate ading mun om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Khum gamah zan lai-in tuuhonte gamlahah a vil tuucingte a om uhi.","title":"Tuucingte le Vantung Mite"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mai vuah Topa’ vantungmi khat dingin amau’ kimkotah Topa’ minthanna vang a tan ziehin a zau mama uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin vantungmi in amate kungah, “Zau sih un; en un, azieh pen mi zosie dinga kipahna lienpi ahi lungdamna thu note kungah kang puoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni-in David khuo-ah Messiah Topa ahi hundampa khat note adingin a suoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note adingin a lim tam bang hi ding hi: Note in puonbeh tawh a kitun nausen khat, gan ankuong sunga kisiel na mu ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in vantung mite le vantungmi honpite a om vua,"},"14":{"text":"“Van a sangpen munah Pasien’ minthang hinlen, leitunga a maipha pieh mite lahah lemna om taheh!” ci-in Pasien a phat uhi."},"15":{"text":"Vantung mite in amate nuasie-in vanah a ka zaw ciengun tuucingte in, “Tu-in Bethlehem khuo ah pei-in, Topa in ei theisah tami thupiengte va kan ta vai,” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate a naw pei mama vua Mary, Joseph le gan ankuong sunga kisiel nausen a mu uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua banga a mu tah ciengun a kung vua kigen nausen tawh kisai thute mi a theisah uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuucingte thugen a za zosie in lamdang a sa uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Mary in a zah thute lungngai-in a lungsim sungah a vom khinkhian hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuucingte zong kilekia-in amate kunga kigensa bangin a zahsa ule a musa uh thu zosie ziehin Pasien phatin a min a thangsah uhi."},"21":{"text":"Nausen tep a kitan nading hun a ni gietna ni-in, a gai masanga vantungmi in a piehsa ahi Jesu kici min a vaw uhi.","title":"Jesu Min Kivaw","ref":"Siem 12:3; Luk 1:31"},"22":{"text":"Moses’ thukham dung zui-in a kisiensuo ding uh hun a tun ciengin amate in Topa mai-a ap dingin Jerusalem ah ama a peipi vua,","title":"Biehinnpi Sungah Jesu Ki-ap"},"23":{"text":"(Topa’ thukham sungah, “Ta pasal masa poma Topa adingin a siengtho-in kiciemte ding hi,” ci-in a kigiel bangin,)","ref":"Pei 13:2, 12"},"24":{"text":"Topa’ thukham sunga a kigen dung zui-in biehpiehna-a pieh dingin, “Vakhu ni, ahi sihle paalva ni,” tawh a pei uhi.","ref":"Siem 12:6-8"},"25":{"text":"Khumin Jerusalem ah Simeon kici mi khat a om hi; ama pen midih le biehna lam pawnthaw khat le Israel-te’ kihenep ding hun zong a lamen mama pa khat ahi a, ama tungah Hlagau Siengtho a om hi."},"26":{"text":"Messiah Topa a mu masangsie a si lo ding thu zong ama tungah Hlagau Siengtho in a lahsa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hlagau lamlahna tawh biehinnpi sungah Simeon a pei hi; thukham sunga bawl ding ngaina teng a bawlpieh dingin nu le pate in biehinnpi sungah nausen a peipi ciengun,"},"28":{"text":"ama in a kang sungah nausen tawi-in Pasien min phat a,"},"29":{"text":"“Mangpa aw, na kammal bangin, na nasempa tu-in lungnuomin nei hlakhie ta hi;"},"30":{"text":"azieh pen ka mit in mi zosie dinga na bawlkholsa"},"31":{"text":"na hutdamna a mu zo ta a,"},"32":{"text":"Gentile-te tunga kihil nading khuovah le na mi Israel-te’ minthan nading ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 42:6; 49:6; 52:10"},"33":{"text":"Nausen’ nu le pa te in ama tawh kisai-a thu kigente a zah ciengun lamdang a sa uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Simeon in amate thupha pie a, tuale a nu Mary kungah, “Tami nausen pen Israel sungah mi tampi’ pua nading le a pohdawh nadinga kisesa ahi a,"},"35":{"text":"tuaci’n mi tampite’ lungsim ngaisutnate pholahin kilangpanna a piengsah lim dinga zong kisesa ahi a, namsau khat in na lungsim ang sun pailet ding hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Khumin Asher’ be sung panin Phanuel’ tanu Anna a kici kamsang numei khat a om hi. Ama pen a khangham mama khat ahi a, a pasal tawh kinungin kum sagi sung a opton zaw cieng gelin,"},"37":{"text":"kum sawmgiet le kum li a phah dongin meigong khatin a om hi. Ama in sun le zanin antanna le thungetna tawh Pasien bie-in biehinnpi lawi ngai vawt lo hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin ama pei-in Pasien kungah lungdam a ko a, Jerusalem kitatkhiet nading a lam-en mi zosie tungah tua nausen’ thu a gen hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate in Topa’ thukham in a kal zosie a bawl sieng zaw ciengun Galilee gam, a pienna uh khuo Nazareth ah a kilekia uhi.","title":"Nazareth-ah a Kilekiana","ref":"Mat 2:23"},"40":{"text":"Nausen khangin thahat a, pilna tawh kidimin ama tungah Pasien maipha a om hi."},"41":{"text":"Peisan pawi sim dingin kumsielin Jerusalem ah a nu a pate a pei uhi.","title":"Naupang Jesu Biehinnpi-ah","ref":"Pei 12:1-27; Thkna 16:1-8"},"42":{"text":"Jesu kum sawm le kum ni a phah ciengin a ngaina uh zui-in Jerusalem ah pawi sim dingin a peito uhi."},"43":{"text":"Pawi ven ciengin a kilekia dingin a nu a pate a kisa ule naupang Jesu pen amau’ nualam Jerusalem ah tam lai a, ahi vangin a nu a pate in a thei kha sih uhi."},"44":{"text":"Khuolzin honte tawh a zawhton a sa lel vua, ni khat lam a pei zo ta uhi. Tua ciengin a tanaute le a guolte lahah ama sui a kipan uhi."},"45":{"text":"Ama a mu lo ciengun Jerusalem ah kilekia-in a sui uhi."},"46":{"text":"Ni thum zaw ciengin biehinnpi sunga siete lahah to-in, a thugente uh ngai-in thu donga na om ama a mu uhi."},"47":{"text":"A thugen a za tapo in a thutelna le a dawnkianate lamdang a sa uhi."},"48":{"text":"A nu a pate in ama a mu ciengun, lamdang sa-in tuale a nu in, “Ka tano aw, bang dinga tam banga nei bawl ahei? En in, na pa tawh lunghimaw-in kang suisui uhi,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Ama in a nu le a pa kungah, “Bang dinga nei sui uh ahei? Ka pa inn sunga ka op ding lamtah thei lo na hi uh amah?” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Hinanle a nu a pate in a thugente a tel thei sih uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate tawh Nazareth ah peisuh a, amau’ thu a mang hi. A nu in tam thute zosie a lungsim sungah a ciemte hi."},"52":{"text":"Jesu a pilna le a pumpi khangin Pasien le mite mai-ah maipha a nga hi.","ref":"1Sam 2:26; Pau 3:4"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Caesar Tiberius a maan zaw kum sawm le kumnga a cin kumin Pontius Pilat pen Judah gam uhpipa hi a, Herod, Galilee gam uhpa hi-in, a naupa Philip pen Ituraea le Trachonitis gamte a uhpa le Lysanias pen Abilene gam uhpa ahi uhi.","title":"Baptize-pa John Tangkona"},"2":{"text":"Annas le Caiaphas in siempu lienpen a sep laitahin senel gama a om Zechariah’ tapa John tungah Pasien’ kammal a tung hi."},"3":{"text":"Jordan gun kimvela om gam sung teng zosie-ah ama vah kawikawi-in mawna maisah nadingin kisiakiana tawh kisai baptize-na thu a hil hi."},"4":{"text":"Kamsang Isaiah’ thugente a kigielna laibu sungah, “Gamlahah a kiko mi khat’ aw in: ‘ Topa pei nading lampi siel unlen, a lampite tangsah un."},"5":{"text":"Muolkuom cinteng kivuadim ding a, muol le tang zosie kito tamin, lamkawite kizezang ding a, lamphomte kimamsah ding hi;"},"6":{"text":"tuale mi zosie in Pasien’ hutdamna mu ding uhi,’ ci hi,” ci-a a kigiel bang ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 40:3-5"},"7":{"text":"A ki-baptize sah dinga ama kung a zuon mihonpite kungah John in, “No muoltan suonte! Ang tung ding lungthahna pan na taimang nading uh koi in ang hil ahei?","ref":"Mat 12:34; 23:33"},"8":{"text":"Kisiakiana tawh kilawm ga na ga un. No le no in, “Abraham i pa uh ahi hi,” ci-in mawh gen sih un; azieh pen ke’n kang ci-in, Pasien in tami suongte panin Abraham tate piengsah thei lel hi.","ref":"Jhn 8:33"},"9":{"text":"Tu nangawnin singzung cin tengah hei kikoi zo hi; ga hoi a ga lo singkung kici poma kiphua-in meikuong sungah kipai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 7:19"},"10":{"text":"Mihonpite in, “Tua ahile bang ka bawl ding vuoi?” ci-in a dong uhi. Ama in,"},"11":{"text":"“Puon tungsil ni a nei pa in a nei lo pa hawm hinlen, an nei pa in zong tua bang ma-in bawl taheh,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"A ki-baptize dingin siehdongte nangawn a pei vua, ama kungah, “Sie aw, bang ka bawl ding vuoi,” ci-in a dong uhi.","ref":"Luk 7:29"},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “Na don ding vua a kisesa kan valin dong sih un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Galkapte in zong, “Tuale kote in bang ka bawl ding vuoi?” ci-in a dong uhi. Ama in, “Zawthaw thu le a man lopi-a mawsahna tawh koima sum sut sih unlen, na thaman utawh lungkim un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Lametna tawh mite a kidim vua, ama Messiah ahi kha ta diei, ci-in John tawh kisai-in a unpi-un a lungsim sung vuoh a ngaisut laitahun,"},"16":{"text":"John in amate zosie kungah, “Keima in tui tawh note kang baptize hi; ahi vangin kei sanga a vanglien zaw khat ang pei ding hi; a kedap khau sut dingin zong ka kilawm sih hi. Ama in Hlagau Siengtho le mei tawh note ang baptize ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in buphuol zap sieng nadingin a khutah lawpi tawi a, butah teng sal sungah koi-in a siteng a mit ngai lo mei tawh a haltum ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n John in hantotna tampi tawh mite kungah lungdamna thu a gen hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin gam uhpa Herod’ gitlo gamtatna teng zosie le a naupa’ zi Herodias ziehin John in Herod a hosiet ciengin,"},"20":{"text":"Herod in tami thu teng zosie tawh belapin thong sungah John a khum hi.","ref":"Mat 14:3-4; Mrk 6:17-18"},"21":{"text":"Mi zosie a ki-baptize ciengin Jesu zong ki-baptize a, thu a nget laitahin van kihongin,","title":"Jesu’ Ki-baptizena"},"22":{"text":"tuale vakhu lim bangin ama tungah Hlagau Siengtho a kumsuh hi. Tuale van panin awging khat in, “Nang pen ka lung ei damsah ka it ka Tapa na hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 22:2; Late 2:7; Isa 42:1; Mat 3:17; Mrk 1:11; Luk 9:35"},"23":{"text":"Nasep a kipatin Jesu kum sawm thum bang pha a, ama pen (mite ngaituona-ah) Joseph’ tapa ahi a, Joseph pen Heli’ tapa,","title":"Jesu Khang Simna (Mat 1:1-17)"},"24":{"text":"Heli pen Matthat’ tapa, Matthat pen Levi’ tapa, Levi pen Melchi’ tapa, Melchi pen Jannai’ tapa, Jannai pen Joseph’ tapa,"},"25":{"text":"Joseph pen Mattathias’ tapa, Mattathias pen Amos’ tapa, Amos pen Nahum’ tapa, Nahum pen Esli tapa, Esli pen Naggai’ tapa,"},"26":{"text":"Naggai pen Maath’ tapa, Maath pen Mattathias’ tapa, Mattathias pen Semein’ tapa, Semein pen Josech’ tapa, Josech pen Joda’ tapa,"},"27":{"text":"Joda pen Joanan’ tapa, Joanan pen Rhesa’ tapa, Rhesa pen Zerubbabel’ tapa, Zerubbabel pen Shealtiel’ tapa, Shealtiel pen Neri’ tapa,"},"28":{"text":"Neri pen Melchi’ tapa, Melchi pen Addi’ tapa, Addi pen Cosam’ tapa, Cosam pen Elmadam’ tapa, Elmadam pen Er’ tapa,"},"29":{"text":"Er pen Joshua’ tapa, Joshua pen Eliezer’ tapa, Eliezer pen Jorim’ tapa, Jorim pen Matthat’ tapa, Matthat pen Levi’ tapa,"},"30":{"text":"Levi pen Simeon tapa, Simeon pen Judah’ tapa, Judah pen Joseph’ tapa, Joseph pen Jonam’ tapa, Jonam pen Eliakim’ tapa,"},"31":{"text":"Eliakim pen Melea’ tapa, Melea pen Menna’ tapa, Menna pen Mattatha’ tapa, Mattatha pen Nathan’ tapa, Nathan pen David’ tapa,"},"32":{"text":"David pen Jesse’ tapa, Jesse pen Obed’ tapa, Obed pen Boaz’ tapa, Boaz pen Sala’ tapa, Sala pen Nahshon’ tapa,"},"33":{"text":"Nahshon pen Amminadab’ tapa, Amminadab pen Admin’ tapa, Admin pen Arni’ tapa, Arni pen Hezron’ tapa, Hezron pen Pereg’ tapa, Pereg pen Judah’ tapa,"},"34":{"text":"Judah pen Jacob’ tapa, Jacob pen Isaac’ tapa, Isaac pen Abraham’ tapa, Abraham pen Terah’ tapa, Terah pen Nahor’ tapa,"},"35":{"text":"Nahor pen Serug’ tapa, Serug pen Reu’ tapa, Reu pen Peleg’ tapa, Peleg pen Eber’ tapa, Eber pen Shelah’ tapa,"},"36":{"text":"Shelah pen Cainan’ tapa, Cainan pen Arphaxad’ tapa, Arphaxad pen shem’ tapa, Shem pen Noah’ tapa, Noah pen Lamech’ tapa,"},"37":{"text":"Lamech pen Methuselah’ tapa, Methuselah pen Enoch’ tapa, Enoch pen Jared’ tapa, Jared pen Mahalaleel’ tapa, Mahalaleel pen Cainan’ tapa,"},"38":{"text":"Cainan pen Enos’ tapa, Enos pen Seth’ tapa, Seth pen Adam’ tapa hi a, Adam pen Pasien’ tapa ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hlagau Siengtho tawh kidimsa-in Jordan gun panin Jesu kinuale kia-in, Hlagau in ama gamlahah zawpi a,","title":"Jesu Kize-etna (Mat 4:1-11 ; Mrk 1:12-13)"},"2":{"text":"khum sungah dawimangpa in ni sawm li sung a ze-et hi. Ama in khum hun sung tungtawnin an bangma ne lo a, a ni a cin ciengin a gil kiel mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Dawimangpa in ama kungah, “Nang Pasien’ Tapa na hi leh tami suongte khomun a suo nadingin thu pie in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu in, ‘Mihingte khomun beh tawh a nungta hi lo hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:3"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin dawimangpa in muol dawnah Jesu peipi to a, leitung gam zosie bakhat sung lah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale dawimangpa in ama kungah, “Tam teng zosie keima tungah ei kipie zo ahi ziehin ka pieh nop popo ka pie thei hi; tami thuneina le thupina zosie nang tungah kang pie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin kei nei bieh leh tam teng zosie a unpi-in nang-a’ hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “’ Topa na Pasien bie inlen ama’ na beh sem in,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:13"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin dawimangpa in Jerusalem ah peipi a, biehinnpi khumvum ah koi-in ama kungah, “ Pasien’ Tapa na hi leh tam panin kumsuh in."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen, ‘Ama in nang ang cing dingin vantung mite thu pie ding a,"},"11":{"text":"na keng suong tawh na tawhkhah lo nadingin a khut utawh nang ang dom ding uhi,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 91:11-12"},"12":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in, “’ Topa na Pasien na ze-et sin,’ ci-in kigiel hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:16"},"13":{"text":"Dawimangpa in a ze-et nading zosie a man sieng zaw ciengin hun lemtang a nga masangsie ama a peisan phot hi."},"14":{"text":"Hlagau’ vanglietna tawh kidimin Galilee gamah Jesu kilekia a, a kimvela gam sung zosie-ah ama thu a kizel hi.","title":"Galilee ah Nasep Kipan"},"15":{"text":"A kikhopna uh innte ah thuhil kipan a, mi zosie in ama a phat uhi."},"16":{"text":"A khankhietna Nazareth ah ama tung a, a pei ngaina bangin Sabbath ni-in kikhopna inn sungah a lut hi. Lai Siengtho sim dingin dingto a, tuale","title":"Nazareth ah Jesu Kisang lo"},"17":{"text":"kamsang Isaiah laiziel khat kipie hi. Ama in tua laiziel a phen leh tam bang teng kigielna mun a mu hi:"},"18":{"text":"“Keima tungah Topa’ Hlagau ang om hi, azieh pen mizawngte kungah lungdamna thu a gen ding, sal tang mite kungah suotahna thu a phuongzah ding, mittawte in khuo mukia-in, gawtna a thuoh mite in suotahna a nga thei nading le"},"19":{"text":"Topa’ angvan hun a genkhie dingin ama in keima sathau ei nu zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 61:1-2"},"20":{"text":"Tuale ama in tua laiziel a khup dawh a, kikhopna inncingpa kungah pie-in a tosuh hi. Kikhopna inn sunga a om mi zosie in ama mittuhna-in a nei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah thugen ding kipan a, “Tuni-in na zahna vuah tami Lai Siengtho tangtung zo hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi zosie in ama a genpha vua, a kam pana a pusuoh a kilawm ama’ kammal hoite lamdang sa uh ahi ziehin, “Tam pa Joseph’ tapa hi lo amah?” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “’Sievuonpa aw, nang le nang kidamsah in! ci tami paunah pen keima tungah nang zang valon ding vua, ‘Tam na pienna khuo-ah zong Capernaum khuo-a na sil bawl ka zahte uh hing bawl in,’ nei ci ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, a pienna khuo-ah kamsang koima khat beh a kisang om lo hi.","ref":"Jhn 4:44"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin a tahtahin ci leih, Elijah hunin kum thum le alang sung van kikhah a, guo zu loin mun zosie-ah kielpi a tun lai-in, Israel-te sungah meigong numei tampi a om hi.","ref":"1Kum 17:1"},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Sidon gam Zarephath khuo meigong nu khat kungah ci simlo meigong koima dangte kungah Elijah kisawl lo hi.","ref":"1Kum 17:8-16"},"27":{"text":"Kamsang Elisha hun lai-in Israel-te sungah miphah tampi om a, ahi vangin Syria mi Naaman ci sim lo koima kidamsah lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 5:1-14"},"28":{"text":"Tami thu a zah ciengun kikhopna inn sunga a om mi zosie a lungthah mama uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amate dingto-in khuo pulamah ama a notmang vua, kensang dawn panin a bungbu lama a sawnthop thei nadingun a khuopi uh kilamna muoldawn kenah a peipi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amau’ laizang nawhin a peimang ta hi."},"31":{"text":"Galilee gam Capernaum khuo ah ama peisuhin Sabbath ni-in amate thu a hil hi.","title":"Hlabua Nei Mipa (Mrk 1:21-28)"},"32":{"text":"Amate in a thuhilna lamdang a sa uhi, azieh pen ama in thuneina tawh thu a gen giap hi.","ref":"Mat 7:28-29"},"33":{"text":"Khumin kikhopna inn sungah hlabua a nei pasal khat om a, ama nahpi-in kiko-in,"},"34":{"text":"“Nazareth mi Jesu aw, ko guoh ei omsah lel ven! Ko bang ei law nuom na hei? Ko ei susie dinga ang pei na hi amah? Pasien’ Misiengtho Pa na hi lam kang thei hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in “Ham sinlen ama kung panin pusuoh in!” ci-in a hosie hi. Tua dawi in amate mai-ah ama puasah a, bangma law loin a sung panin a pusuoh hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un lamdang a sa vua, “Tami thu bangci dan adiei? Azieh pen ama in thuneina le vanglietna tawh hlabuate thu a pieh ciengin a taimang uhi,” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuale tua kuom muncin tengah ama’ thu a kizel hi."},"38":{"text":"Kikhopna inn panin a pei zaw ciengin Simon inn ah ama a lut hi. Tua laitahin Simon’ sungnu cithuo-in gim mama a, Jesu kungah ama adingin huna a ngen uhi.","title":"Simon’ Inn Sunga Damsahna (Mat 8:14-15 ; Mrk 1:29-31)"},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua nu kungah ama ding phei a, a cithuo natna a hosiet ciengin ama a dam pai hi. Thakhatin tua nu thoto-in zindo a kipan pai hi."},"40":{"text":"Ni tum ciengin ama kungah natna tuomtuom a nei mi zosie a peipi vua, ama in a tung vuoh khut nga-in a damsah hi."},"41":{"text":"Mi tampi sung panin dawite zong a pusuoh vua, “Nang Pasien’ Tapa na hi hi!” ci-in a kiko uhi. Hinanle dawite in ama Messiah ahi lam a thei ziehun tuate phawhsie-in thu a gensah sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Khuo a vah ciengin khum mun panin mun sip khatah a peikhie hi. Tuale mihonpi in ama a sui uhi; ama a mu ciengun amate a nuasie lo nadingin a hlo uhi.","title":"Jesu in Kikhopna Innah Thuhil (Mrk 1:35-39)"},"43":{"text":"Hinanle Jesu in amate kungah, “Khuopi dangte ah zong Pasien’ manggam lungdamna thu ka tangko ding hi; azieh pen tami dinga ei kisawl ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judea gam sunga kikhopna innte ah ama in thu a hil suoh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei Genesaret buol gei-ah Jesu ding a, mipite in Pasien thu ngai dingin ama a nehgawp laitahin,","title":"Jesu in Nuazui Masate Hlan"},"2":{"text":"ama in buol gei-a om gunkuong ni a mu hi; tua gunkuongte sung panin ngabengte peikhie-in a lente a sawp sieng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua gunkuongte sung panin Simon’ gunkuong tungah ama tuong a, pieugei panin tawm khat a khin nadingin a sawl hi. Tua ciengin ama to-in gunkuong sung panin mihonpite thu a hil hi.","ref":"Mat 13:1-2; Mrk 3:9-10; 4:1"},"4":{"text":"A thugen a manzaw ciengin ama in Simon kungah, “Tui thuhna lamah na gunkuong hot inlen, na len tawh nga khu in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Simon in, “Mangpa, zanthapai-in ka na khu vangun bangma khat zong ka man sih uhi. Hizongle khu in nei cileh lah khu mawh ta veng,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Jhn 21:3"},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin len a khu uleh nga tam awh seng ahi ziehin a len uh a keh khiel vawt hi.","ref":"Jhn 21:6"},"7":{"text":"Gunkuong dang khat-a om a guolte pei a, a hu dingin a khutzap uhi. Tuale amate zong pei-in gunkuong tegel sungah nga a dimin a koi ziehun tui sungah a tum dihtah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Simon Peter in tua thu a mu bepin Jesu mai-ah khupdin a, Topa aw, mawnei mi khat ka hi ziehin kei kung panin peikhie in!” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen nga tuaza a mat thei uh ama le a pawlte zosie in lamdang a sa uhi;"},"10":{"text":"tua ma bangin Simon kipawlpi Zebedee’ tapate ahi James le John-te in zong lamdang a sa uhi. Tua ciengin Jesu in Simon kungah, “Zau sin; tu-a kipanin mihingte na man ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuipieu-ah a gunkuongte uh a khawlsah zaw ciengun amate in na zosie nuasie-in ama a zui uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khumin khatvei, khuopi sung khatah ama a op laitahin a pumtanga a phah mi khat pei a, Jesu a mu bepin tuolah khupbawh a, “ Topa aw, ei damsah nuom po lacin nei damsah thei hi,” ci-in a thum hi.","title":"Jesu in Miphah Damsah (Mat 8:1-4 ; Mrk 1:40-45)"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a khut zahin tham a, “Kang damsah nuom hi. Dam ta in,” a ci leh thakhatin a phah natna in ama a nuasie pailien hi."},"14":{"text":"Koima kungah gen sin, ci-in ama thu a pie hi. Ama in, “Pei inlen, siempu pa kungah va kilah tanlen, Moses’ thupieh dung zui-in amate tungah teci ahi dingin na sienna ziehin biehpiehna va bawl ta’n,” ci-in thu a pie hi.","ref":"Siem 14:1-32"},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin nidang sangin ama’ thu a kizel semsem hi; mi tampitahte a thungai ding le a natnate uh a dam nadingin a kikhawm uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin gamdai-ah ama kihem dawhin thu a ngen hi."},"17":{"text":"Nikhat Jesu in thu a hil laitahin ama gei-ah Galilee gam, Judea gam, le Jerusalem pana ang pei Pharisee-te le thukham hil siete a to uhi. Tuale natna damsah nading Topa’ vanglietna in ama tungah a om hi.","title":"Jesu in Phalsi Khat Damsah (Mat 9:1-8 ; Mrk 2:1-12)"},"18":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin mi pawlkhat pei-in phalsi mi khat a lupna tawh a zawng uhi. Amate in inn sungah ama tumpi-in Jesu mai-a siel dingin a hanciem uhi;"},"19":{"text":"ahi vangin mihonpi tam seng ahi ziehin a lutpi nading uh lampi a mu zo sih vua, tua bepin innkhumah kato-in a khumvang panin mipite laikim Jesu mai sontah ah a lupna pumin a khiesuh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in a upna uh a mu ciengin, “Lawm aw, na mawna teng kimaisah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham hil siete le Pharisee-te a kiho vua, “Pasien a gensie tam pa koi ahei? Pasien longal koi in mawna maisah thei ahei?” ci-in thudawh ding a kipan uhi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu in a thudawh uh a thei ciengin amate kungah, “Na lungsim sung vua bang dinga tua bang thute na dawh uh ahei?"},"23":{"text":"‘Na mawnate kimaisah zo hi’ ci ding le ‘Tho inlen lampei in,’ ci ding koi baizaw ahei?"},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawna maisah thei nading thuneina a nei lamtah na thei nadingun phalsi pa kungah, “Nang kungah kang ci-in, tho inlen na lupna puo-in na inn ah pei in,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua pa zong thakhatin amate mai-ah tho-in a lupna puo a, Pasien phat kawmin a inn ah a pei hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un lamdang a sa vua, a zau kawmun Pasien phatin, “Eite in tuni-in na lamdang i mu zo ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Jesu a pusuoh leh siehdonna zuma a to Levi kici siehdong khat mu a, ama in, “Ei zui in,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu in Levi Hlan (Mat 9:9-13 ; Mrk 12:13-17)"},"28":{"text":"Tuale ama in zong na zosie nuasie-in ama a zui hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Levi in a inn ah Jesu adingin anneh pawi khat a bawl hi; siehdong honpite le midangte in amate tawh ankuong a imton uhi."},"30":{"text":"Pharisee-te le thukham hil a siete un a nuazuite kungah, “Bang dinga siehdongte le mawneite tawh neton dawnton na hi uh ahei? ci-in a mawsiet uhi.","ref":"Luk 15:1-2"},"31":{"text":"Jesu in, “Sievuon a tulmaw pen cidamte hi loin cinate hizaw hi."},"32":{"text":"Midihte hlan dinga ang pei ka hi sih a, mawneite a kisiakia nadinga ang pei ka hizaw hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in ama kungah, “John’ nuazuite in Pharisee-te’ nuazuite bangin an tangin thu ngen zel napi, na nuazuite ahile an ne tui dawnin a om uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Antanna Thu Dohna (Mat 9:14-17 ; Mrk 2:18-22)"},"34":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Mopawi simte in zi nei ding pa tawh a om sungun an na tangsah thei ding uh amah?"},"35":{"text":"Amate kung panin zineipa a kilahdawh hun ang tung ding a, khum ni ciengin amate in an a tang ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah thugentena khat tawh thu a gen hi: “Koima in puon tha ehkehin puonsie phawna-in a zang sih hi; tua banga a bawl leh a puontha ehkeh ding a, puontha beh le a lui a kituoh thei sih ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Koima in savun umlui sungah lenggazu tha a thal sih hi; a tuaci bawl leh lenggazu tha in savun um pawhkeh sahin lenggazu phulmang ding a, savun um a kisie ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Lenggazu tha pen savun um tha sunga thal ding hizaw hi."},"39":{"text":"Koima in lenggazu lui a dawn zaw ciengin lenggazu tha a lunggul ta sih a, ‘Lenggazu lui ma tuizaw hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni khatin mangbu leite nawhin Jesu a pei laitahin a nuazuite in mangbuvui a zut vua, a khut utawh nuoi-in a ne uhi.","title":"Sabbath Ni Thudawhna (Mat 12:1-8 ; Mrk 2:23-28)","ref":"Thkna 23:25"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharisee-te pawlkhat in, “Sabbath ni-a bawl dinga kilawm lo nate bang dinga na bawl uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu in, “David in a pawlte tawh a gilkiel laitahun bang bawl ci na sim ngai sih uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Pasien biehinn sungah lutin siempute longal midangte’ neh dinga a kilawm lo Ompina Anlum la-in ne a, a pawlte zong pie lai hi lo amah?” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Siem 24:9; Siem 21:1-6"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah, “Mihing Tapa pen Sabbath’ uhpa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Sabbath ni dang khatin kikhopna inn sungah ama lutin thu hil a, tua munah a zietlam khut a zaw mi khat a om hi.","title":"Khut Langkhat Zaw Mipa (Mat 12:9-14 ; Mrk 3:1-6)"},"7":{"text":"Tuale thukham hil siete le Pharisee-te in ama a mawmat thei nadingun Sabbath ni-in mi ang damsah mawng ei mah, ci-in ama a kai-hlit uhi."},"8":{"text":"A ngaisutnate uh a thei vangin ama in khutzaw mipa kungah, “Hing pei inlen tanah hing ding ta’n,” a ci hi. Ama thoto-in tua munah a ding pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Note kang dong hi, sabbath ni-in a sie bawl ding le a pha bawl ding, hinna hutdam ding le suhsiet ding, koi pen thukham tawh a kituoh ei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate zosie a et kawikawi zaw ciengin Jesu in tua pa kungah, “Na khut zah vawi,” a ci hi. Ama in tua bangin a zah leh a khut a ngaingai a bangkia hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate a lungthah mama vua, Jesu bang i law thei diei, ci-in khatlekhat a kikum uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khum hunlai-in thugen dingin muoltungah Jesu kato a, zan thapai-in Pasien kungah thu ngen hi.","title":"Jesu in Sawltahpi Sawm le Nite Teel (Mat 10:1-4 ; Mrk 3:13-19)"},"13":{"text":"Khuo ang vah ciengin ama in a nuazuite hlanin mi sawm le ni teel a, tua teng sawltahpite ci-in minvaw hi:"},"14":{"text":"Peter ci-a min a vaw pa Simon le a sanggampa Andrew, James le John, Philip, Bartholomew,"},"15":{"text":"Matthew le Thomas, Alpheaus’ tapa James le Zealot kici Simon,"},"16":{"text":"James’ tapa Judas le a lehehpa Judas Iscariot-te ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a nuazui mihon tampite le Judea, Jerusalem, Tyre le Sidon tuipi dung pana a pei mi zosie tawh kumsuhin munzang khatah a ding uhi.","title":"Jesu in thuhil, Cina Damsah (Mat 4:23-25)"},"18":{"text":"Amate ahile a thugen ngai ding le a natna uh panin damna a nga nuom zieh vua pei uh ahi hi; tuale hlabua in a bawlsiet mite zong kidamsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale ama tung panin vanglietna pusuohin amate a unpi-un a damsah ziehin, mihonpi zosie in ama tham ding a hanciem uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a nuazuite ento a: “No mizawngte thupha nga na hi uhi, azieh pen Pasien’ manggam noma-a’ ahi hi.","title":"Thupha le Gimnate (Mat 5:1-12)"},"21":{"text":"Tulai taha a gilkielte thupha nga na hi uhi, azieh pen na gil uh a va ding hi. Tu-a a kap a maute thupha nga na hi uhi, azieh pen na nui ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa ziehin mite in hing muda-in ang puse vua, hing hosie-in ang gensiet ciengun mi hampha na hi uhi.","ref":"1Pet 4:14"},"23":{"text":"Vantunga na nga ding uh thaman lien mama ahi ziehin tua bang hun ciengin kipahin dieng un, azieh pen a pu a pate un zong kamsangte tungah tua bangin a bawl uhi.","ref":"2Khg 36:16; Sawl 7:52"},"24":{"text":"“Ahi vangin no mihaute in gimna na thuoh ding uhi, azieh pen note in henepna na nga zo uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tu hun a a gilva note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile note na gilkiel ding uhi. Tu hun a a nui note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile note kapin na mau ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Mi zosie in ang genphat ciengun gimna a thuoh ding na hi uhi, bangzieh ahei cile a pu a pate un zong kamsang zuoute tungah tua bangin a bawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"“Ahi vangin ka thugen a ngai note kungah kang ci-in, na galte na it unlen, ang mudate tungah a pha na bawl un,","title":"Galte It Nading (Mat 5:38-48 ; 7:12a)"},"28":{"text":"ang samsiete thupha na pie unlen ang bawlsiete adingin thu na ngetpieh un."},"29":{"text":"Mi khatpo in na pheta uh ang beh leh a langkhat zong na daw un; mi khatpo in na puon tungsil uh ang lahpieh leh na songkhol uh nangawn na piehbe un."},"30":{"text":"Na kung vua na ang ngen poma pie unlen, na van uh a late kungah ngenkia nawn sih un."},"31":{"text":"No tunga ang kibawl ding na dei bangun midangte tungah zong na bawl un.","ref":"Mat 7:12"},"32":{"text":"“No ang itte beh na it uleh na lemlaw uh bang ahei? Azieh pen mawneite nangawn in amate a itte a it uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na tung vua a pha bawlte tung behah a pha na bawl uleh, na lemlaw uh bang ahei? Azieh pen mawneite nangawn in zong tua bangin a bawl uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ngakia ding lametna tawh mi sum na leitawi uleh na lemlaw uh bang ahei? Mawnei mite nangawn in a leitawi zaza a ngakia nadingun mawnei dangte a leitawi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanle na galte it unlen a pha bawl un, ngakia ding bangma lamen loin leitawi pie un. Tua hileh na thaman uh lien ding a, Sangpen Pasien’ tate na hi ding uhi; azieh pen ama in lungdam dan thei lote le mi gilote tungah a migi hi."},"36":{"text":"Na Pa un mi a khuotuo ma bangin note in zong mi na khuotuo un."},"37":{"text":"Thu na khen sih un, tua hile no tungah zong thu ang kikhen sih ding hi; mi na mawsah sih un, tua hile no zong ang kimawsah sih ding hi. Mite’ maw maisah un, tua hile no zong ang kimaisah ding hi;","title":"Midangte tunga Thukhenna (Mat 5:38-48 ; 7:12a)"},"38":{"text":"pie un, ang kipie ding hi. A tena hoi, a kibetlawt, a kitawkhet, le a dimletin na kang sung vuah ang kisung ding hi; azieh pen na te zaza ma uh na ngakia ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"Ama in amate tungah thugentena khat zong a gen hi: “Mittaw khat in mittaw dang khat lam a hil thei ding amah? A ni gelin guom sungah a kieton ta sih ding uh amah?","ref":"Mat 15:14"},"40":{"text":"Nuazui khat a siepa sangin a lienzaw ngai sih hi, ahi vangin mi khatpo a picingsa ahi zaw ciengin a siepa tawh a kibang ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:24-25; Jhn 13:16; 15:20"},"41":{"text":"Bang dinga nangma’ mit a singluong kikham phawh kha lopi-in na vengpa’ mit a buathah them na muthaw ahei?"},"42":{"text":"Ahi sihle nangma’ mit a singluong kikham mu lopi-in bang dingin na vengpa kungah, ‘Lawm aw, na mit a buathah nang lahpieh vang’ na ci thei ahei? No, mihoi kipangte aw, na mit vua singluong lakhie masa phot unlen, tua zaw ciengin na vengpa’ mit a buathah hoitahin mu-in na lahpieh thei pan ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Singkung hoi in ga hoi lo ga ngai lo a, singkung hoi lo in ga hoi ga ngai lo hi;","title":"Singkung le a Ga"},"44":{"text":"azieh pen singkung zosie a ga tawh kitheithei hi. Lingkung panin theiga kilo ngai lo a, thangling kung panin zong lengga kilo ngai lo hi.","ref":"Mat 12:33"},"45":{"text":"Mihoi in a lungtanga a vom thuhoite a suokhie a, migilo in a lungtanga a vom gitlonate a suokhie hi; azieh pen lungtang sungah a dimlet ciengin kam tawh kisuokhie hi.","ref":"Mat 12:34"},"46":{"text":"“ Topa, Topa ei ci napi ucin, bang dinga ka thugente na man lo uh ahei?","title":"Khuombul Nite (Mat 7:24-27)"},"47":{"text":"Ka kungah hing pei-in ka thugen za a, ka gen banga a gamta zosiete bang tawh kibang ahei, ci thu kang lah ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua mipa pen lei a thuh taw zaw cienga suongpi tunga khuomkuo ding a phutkip inn lampa tawh kibang hi; tui khangin hawhtuite in tua inn a nawh vangin hoitaha kilam ahi ziehin a kilawh zo sih hi."},"49":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka thu za-a a mang lo mi in doppha a nei lo, leitang tunga innlam pa tawh kibang hi. Hawhtui in tua inn khautahin a nawh ciengin thakhatin pua pai a, tua inn pen a nahsiet mama hi,” a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in mite’ zahin a thugen ding zosie a man zaw ciengin Capernaum khuo ah a lut hi.","title":"Jesu in Galkapmangpa’ Nasem pa Damsah (Mat 8:5-13)"},"2":{"text":"Tua sungah galkapmangpa khat in a it mama sila khat nei a, tuapa cina-in si dihtah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Jesu’ thu a zah ciengin ama kungah Judah upa pawlkhat sawl a, ama pei-in a sila pa a damsah nadingin amate a thumsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu kungah a tun ciengun amate in nahpitahin a thum vua, “Ama tua banga na bawlpieh dinga kilawm ahi hi,"},"5":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ama in i minamte it a, i kikhopna inn zong ei lampieh hi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate tawh Jesu zawhton a, a inn tawh a kigamla lo mun khat a tun ciengin galkapmangpa in ama kungah a guolte sawlin, “ Topa aw, nang le nang gim kipie da in, azieh pen ka inn sunga nang kang lutsah ding kei adingin a kilawm sih hi;"},"7":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin kei zong nang kunga ang pei dingin kilawm ka kisa sih hi. Ahi vangin kamteng khat beh hing gen zieu inlen, ka silapa hing damsah ta’n."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kei zong uhna khut nei-a a om khat ka hi a, ka nei-ah galkap tampi a om hi; mi khat kungah, “Pei in,” ka ci leh a pei a, adang khat kungah ,“Hing pei vawi,” ka ci leh ang pei pai a, tuale ka silapa kungah, “Tami bawl in,” ka ci leh ka silapa in a bawl pai hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu in tami thu a zah ciengin lamdang sa a, ama a zui mipite lamah kihei-in, “Note kungah kang ci-in, Israel-te lah nangawnah zong tam bang upna ka mu ngai nai sih hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Innah a kisawlte a tun ciengin amate in silapa a cidamsa-in a mu uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zaw a sawt loin Nain kici khuo ah ama pei a, a nuazuite le mihonpi zong ama tawh a zawhton uhi.","title":"Jesu in Nain Khuo-a Meigongnu’ Tapa Hingsahkia"},"12":{"text":"Khuopi tunkot a tun kuon ciengun vui dingin mi sisa khat na kizawng hi. Ama pen a nu in tapa khat tanga a nei ahi mel a, ama zong meigong khat ahi hi; tua khuopi panin tua nu tawh mi honpite a om uhi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in tua nu a mu bepin a khuotuo nah mama a, ama kungah, “Kap sin,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mai lamah ama pei-in misi puohna lanng a tham leh a puote zong a dinkhawl vawt uhi. Tuale ama in, “Tangval pa, tho in kang ci hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Misipa thoto-in thugen a kipan pai a, tua bepin Jesu in a nu kungah tuapa a apkia hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un a zausi sieng vua, Pasien’ min phatin, “Eite lahah kamsang thupi khat ang pieng zo ta! Pasien in angvanna tawh a mite ei ve zo ta!” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Judea gam buppi le a kimvela gam zosie-ah ama’ thu a kizel sieng hi."},"18":{"text":"John’ nuazuite in ama kungah tam thu zosie a gen uhi. Tuaci’n John in a nuazuite ni hlan a,","title":"Baptize-pa John Kung Pan Kamtaite (Mat 11:2-19)"},"19":{"text":"Topa kungah, “Ang pei ding pa na hi amah, ahi sihle adang khat ka lamen lai ding vuoi mah?” ci-in a dong dingin ama gel a sawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesu kungah tua tegel a tun ciengun ama gel in, “Ang pei ding pa na hi amah, ahi sihle adang khat ka na lamen lai ding vuoi mah?” ci-a dong dingin Baptize-pa John in kogel ei sawl ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Jesu in natna tampi tah, pulnatna le hla gilo veite damsah a, mittaw tampitah zong khuo a musah hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in ama gel kungah, “Pei unlen, na zahsa thute ule na mu thute uh John kungah va gen ta un: Mittawte in khuo mu a, khelbaite lam pei thei-in, miphahte kidamsah a, bilbingte in khuo za-in, misite kithosah a, mizawngte tungah lungdamna thu kipuoh zo hi.","ref":"Isa 35:5-6; 61:1"},"23":{"text":"Keima zieha a lungkie lo poma mi hampha ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"John’ kamtaite a pei zaw ciengun mipite kungah John’ thu a gen dingin Jesu kipan a, “Gamlahah bang en dinga pei na hi vuoi? Hui’ mut a a zam kawikawi pumpeng amah?"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi sihle bang en dinga pusuoh na hi vuoi? Puon hoi sil mi pawlkhat en nuom na hi uh amah? En un, puon hoi silte kumpipa inn sungah a om uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahile bang en dinga pusuoh na hi vuoi? Kamsangpa khat amah? Hi hi, ke’n kang ci-in, kamsangpa sangin a lienzaw hi."},"27":{"text":"‘En in, na mai-ah ka kamtaipa ka sawl ding a, ama in na mai-ah na pei nading lampi a na sielkhol ding hi,’ ci-a kigiel pa khu tampa ahi hi.","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"28":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, numeite sunga a suohte lah panin Baptize-pa John sanga a lienzaw koima a om sih hi; hizongle Pasien’ manggam sungah a neu pen khat nangawn ama sangin a lienzaw hi."},"29":{"text":"(Siehdongte-a kipanin mi zosie in tami thu a zah uh ciengin Pasien pen thutang hi, ci-in a sang uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate John kunga na ki-baptze sa ahi uhi.","ref":"Mat 21:32; Luk 3:12"},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharisee-te le thukham hil siete in John’ baptize ding a niel ziehun amau’ phattuomna ding ahi Pasien gelna a nol uh ahi hi.)"},"31":{"text":"“Tua ahile tami khang mite bang tawh ka gente ding a, bang tawh kibang ci ding ka hei?"},"32":{"text":"Vanzuana munah amate to a, ‘Theile ka tum vangun na lam nuom sih vua, kaa-la ka sah vangun na kap nuom tuon sih uhi,’ ci-a khatlekhat a kigal hlat naupangte tawh a kibang uhi."},"33":{"text":"Azieh pen bangma ne lo dawn loin John ang pei-in note in, “Dawi lawmnei pa,’ na ci uhi."},"34":{"text":"Mihing Tapa ang pei ciengin an ne tuidawnin a om a, ‘En un, anhai zuhai pa, siehdongte le mawneite’ guolpa!’ na ci vanuh uhi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanle pilna pen a man a hina a tate zosie tung panin kilang veve hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"36":{"text":"Pharisee-te khat in ama tawh an ne dingin Jesu hlan a, tuale Pharisee pa inn ah pei-in an ne dingin sabuoi-ah a to hi.","title":"Mawnei Numei Khat Kimaisah"},"37":{"text":"Tuami khuo-a mawnei numei khat in Pharisee pa inn ah Jesu in an ne ding hi, ci a thei bepin sathau namtui suongngo thawl khat a tawi hi."},"38":{"text":"A nualam a keng phungah tua nu dingin kap a, a hlitui tawh a keng silpiehin, a sam tawh a nawtgumpieh hi. Tua ciengin a keng namin sathau a nupieh hi.","ref":"Mat 26:7; Mrk 14:3; Jhn 12:3"},"39":{"text":"Ama a hlan Pharisee mipa in a mu ciengin a lungsim sungah, “Tampa kamsang khat ahileh ama a tham nu koi hi a, bangci numei ahei, ci a thei ding hi; azieh pen ama mawnei ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Simon aw, kang gen nop khat om hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Siepa,” ci-in dawng a, “Gen in,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"“Sum palah mipa khat in leiba mi ni a nei hi; khat in denari za nga ba-in, adang khat in sawm nga ba hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua gel in a leiba uh a lo zawh lo ciengun, ama in a ni gelin a leiba uh a maisah hi. Tuale tua tegel koi pen in ama itzaw ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Simon in, “A leiba a tamzaw kimaisah pa hi va, ci-in ngaisun ing,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tuale Jesu in ama kungah, “Dihtahin na khen zo hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin numei nu lamah Jesu kihei-in, ama in Simon kungah, “Tami numei na mu ei mah? Na inn ah keima kang lut hi; ka keng sil nading tui nei pie sih a, hinanle ama in a hlitui tawh ka keng pah tehhopsah a, a sam tawh ei nawtgumpieh hi."},"45":{"text":"Nang in nei nam sih a, ahi vangin a inn sung ka lut a kipanin ama in ka keng a nam den hi."},"46":{"text":"Nang in ka lu sathau nei nupieh sih a, ahi vangin ama in ka keng sathau namtui ei nupieh hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ke’n kang ci-in, ama’ mawna tampitah kimaisah zo hi; tua ahi ciengin tua nu in itna lien a lah zo hi. Ahi vangin a kitawm maisahte in a tawm it pai uhi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tua nu kungah, “Na mawna teng kimaisah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Hinanle amate lahah Jesu tawh sabuoi-a an a imton mite in, “Mawnate nangawn a maisah vazuou tampa koi ahiei?” a ci uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in numei nu kungah, “Na upna in nang ang hundam zo hi; lungmuong tahin pei in,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw bakhat ciengin khuopi le khuotate-ah ama zin kawikawi a, Pasien’ manggam tawh kisai lungdamna thu puohin a tangko hi. Sawm le nite zong ama tawh a zawhton vua,","title":"Numei Pawlkhat in Jesu Zui"},"2":{"text":"hla gilote’ mat a kidamsahte le natna tuomtuom pana kidamsah numei pawlkhat in zong ama a zui uhi.
