Tuate pen: A sung pana dawi sagi a pusuona Magdalene kici Mary,"},"3":{"text":"tuale Herod inn sung vaihawmpa Chuza’ zi Joanna le Susanna-te a kipanin a neisa utawh amate a panpi numei dang tampite zong ahi uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:55-56; Mrk 15:40-41; Luk 23:49"},"4":{"text":"Khuo khat zaw khuo khat panin ama kungah ang pei vua, mi honpi ang kikhop uh ciengin ama in thugentena khat a gen hi:","title":"Khaici Tupa Thugentena (Mat 13:1-9 ; Mrk 4:1-9)"},"5":{"text":"“Khaici vawpa khat khaitu dingin kuon a, khai a tu leh pawlkhat lam dungah tu ahi ziehin mite in keng tawh tuonin, vana a leng vate in tungin a netum uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pawlkhatte suong tungah tu hi; tuale leinom a op lo ziehin a po vangin a gawpmang hi."},"7":{"text":"Pawlkhatte ling lahah tu a, ling tawh a khanton ziehin ling in a depgawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Pawlkhatte ahile lei hoina-ah tu-in khanglien a, a za zakhatin a pung hi,” a ci hi. Tami thu a gen zaw ciengin, “Zah nading bil a nei tapo in za taheh,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nuazuite in tam thugentena’ deina bang ahei, ci-in ama a dong uhi.","title":"Thugentena’ Deina (Mat 13:10-17 ; Mrk 4:10-12)"},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “A ki-im Pasien’ manggam thute na thei nadingun note tungah tuate ang kipie zo hi. Ahi vangin, ‘Amate in mu napi a mu cien lo nading, za napi a telcien lo nadingun, keima in amate tungah thu ka gen hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"11":{"text":"Thugentena’ khietna tam bang ahi hi: Khaici pen Pasien’ thu ahi hi.","title":"Khaici Tupa’ Thugentena Kitelgen (Mat 13:18-23 ; Mrk 4:13-20)"},"12":{"text":"Lamdunga kiete pen Pasien’ thu a zasate a cinopna ahi hi; tua ciengin amate in umin a kihutdam lo nadingin dawimangpa pei-in a lungtang panun Pasien’ thu a lahpieh hi."},"13":{"text":"Suong tunga a kiete pen Pasien’ thu a zah ciengun kipah tahin a sang uhi; ahi vangin zung hla loin bakhat sung beh umin, ze-etna hun a tun ciengin a puate ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ling lahah a kiete pen Pasien’ thu za napi leitung lunghimawna, hau nopna le nopsahnate in depgawpin a ga picing zo lote ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lei hoina munah a kiete ahile Pasien’ thu za-in citahna le lungsim pha tawh pomdetin thuohzawhna tawh a ga khiete ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Koima in meivah a tan zaw ciengin law a khu sih a, lupna nei lah po-ah zong koi loin, a lut mite in khuovah a mu thei nadingin meivah tunna tungah a koizaw uhi.","title":"Law Kikhu Meivah (Mat 5:14-15)","ref":"Mat 5:15; Luk 11:33"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen a kilang lo dinga a kiphuoldap bangma a om sih a, tua ma bangin khuovah in tan a, a kithei lo ding thusim bangma a om sih hi.","ref":"Mat 10:26; Luk 12:2"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin bangci bangin thu ka ngai ahei ci limtahin kingaisun un; azieh pen a neite kipiehbe hi; tuale a nei lote tung panin a neisa-a a ngaisutte nangawn uh kilahpieh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 25:29; Luk 19:26"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kungah a nu le a sanggamte a pei vua, mi a tam seng ziehin ama kung a tung zo sih uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Sanggam Tahtah (Mat 12:46-50 ; Mrk 3:31-35)"},"20":{"text":"Tua bepin, “Nang ang mu nuomin a pulamah na nu le na sanggamte a ding uhi,” ci-in ama kungah kigen hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah, “Pasien’ thu za a, a zui tapo ka nu le ka sanggamte ahi uhi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ni khat a nuazuite tawh gunkuong tungah tuong a, tuale amate kungah, “Tuili galkhatah galkai vai,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n amate a pei vua,","title":"Huipi Daisah (Mat 8:23-27 ; Mrk 4:35-41)"},"23":{"text":"gunkuong tawh a pei laitahun ama a kimu hi. Tuipi tungah hui le guo kithuo-in gunkuong sungah tui dim ahi ziehin a zauhuoi dinmunah a om uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ama kungah amate pei-in a phong vua, “Mangpa, Mangpa, a si sieng ding hi tai!,” ci-in a kiko uhi. Tuale ama zong tho-in huipi le tuihuolpite a hosie hi; tuate khawlin a dai dide pai hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Na upna uh hei-ah a om ta ahei?” a ci hi. Amate zau kawm le lamdangsa kawmin, “Tua ahile huipi le tuipite nangawn in a thu a man valia nadingin tampa koi hi mawh ahei?” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Galilee gam galkhat lama a om Gerasenes gam a tung uhi.","title":"Jesu in Gerasene ah Dawivei Khat Damsah (Mat 8:28-34 ; Mrk 5:1-20)"},"27":{"text":"Lei lahah ama a kumsuh laitahin tua khuo-a dawivei mi khat in na dawntuo pai hi. Tuapa in sawtveipi sung puon sil lo in, inn ah zong om loin han lah po-ah a teng hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in Jesu a mu bepin a mai-ah bawhsuhin, “Sangpen Pasien’ Tapa Jesu aw, kei bang ei law sawm na hei? Nei bawlsiet lo nadingin kang thum hi,” ci-in a aw nei za tawh a kiko hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam banga a kikona pen tua mipa sung panin hlabua a peikhiet nadingin Jesu in thu a pieh zieh ahi hi. (Azieh pen hlabua in tua mipa tamveipi tah man zo a, siakhau le siakol tawh kihenin a kicin vangin a kikhinate botsan a, tua dawi in ama gamlahah a delmang hi.)"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Na min bang ahei? ci-in dong hi. Ama in, “Tampi,” a ci hi; azieh pen ama sungah dawi tampi a lut zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Taw nei lo leihawm thuhpi sungah a peikia dingin amate thu a pieh lo nadingin ama kungah a thum uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua laitahin muolpang a kikhawi vohhon tampi a om hi; tuale vohte sungah a lut thei nadingun dawite in Jesu kungah a thum vua, ama in zong a phal hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuapa sung panin dawite pusuohin vohte sungah a lut uhi; tuale kentawng-ah vohte kumsuhin tuili sungah a kie sieng uhi."},"34":{"text":"Vohcingte in a thupieng teng a mu ciengun tai-in khuopi le tua gam sung tengah a gen uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin bang thu pieng ahei, ci-in a en dingin mite a pei vua, Jesu kung a tun ciengun Jesu keng phungah dawite taikhietna mipa na to a, ama in puon silin a lungsim a pilkia a mu ciengun a zau uhi."},"36":{"text":"A mu masate in amate kungah dawiveipa bangci bangin dam ahei ci thu a gen sawn uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gerasenes kimvela mi zosie a zau seng ziehun amate a peisan nadingin Jesu kungah a thum uhi; tuaci’n Jesu zong gunkuong tungah tuongin a kilekia hi."},"38":{"text":"Dawite a peikhietna pa in ama tawh a zawton nadingin a thum hi; ahi vangin Jesu in ama kungah,"},"39":{"text":"“Na inn ah kilekia zaw inlen, Pasien in nang dingin bangza tahin ang seppieh ahei, ci thute va gen ta’n,” ci-in a sawl hi. Tuaci’n ama pei a, khuopi sung tengah Jesu in bangza tahin ama adingin bawlpieh ahei, ci thute a phuongzah hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuale mihonpite in ama lamen uh ahi ziehin, Jesu a kilekia ciengin amate in a na dawn uhi.","title":"Ngahnuno Khat Hingkia, Numei Khat Kidamsah (Mat 9:18-26 ; Mrk 5:21-43)"},"41":{"text":"Tua laitahin Jairus a kici kikhopna inn uhpa khat tua munah pei a, Jesu’ keng phungah bawhin ama’ inn ah a haw nadingin a thum hi."},"42":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in kum sawm le kum ni bang a pha tanu khat beh nei a, tua nu cina-in si dihtah hi. Ama a pei laitahin a kimvelah mipite a kiphul valuh uhi."},"43":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin kum sawm le kum ni sung siluong natna a vei numei khat a om hi; tuale sievuonte cielna-in a neisa zosie a zah sieng vangin koima in ama damsah zo lo hi."},"44":{"text":"Jesu’ nua lamah ama nu pei-in a puonmongtep a tham ciengin thakhatthu-in a siluong natna a khawl pai hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Ei tham koi ahei?” ci-in dong a, amate in a unpi vua a niel ciengun Peter in, “Mangpa, na kimkotah mihonpi in ang neh valuh vua, ang phuhkhah uh hi lel bo va,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in, “Mi khat in ei tham hi; a zieh pen ka tung panin vanglietna a peikhiet lam ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua numei nu in a kisel zo lo ding lam a thei bepin zau-in a citunsa-in pei a, Jesu mai-ah bawhsuhin mipi zosiete mai-ah ama a thamna le a tham cienga thakhata a dampaina thu a gen hi."},"48":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang ang damsah zo ta hi; lungmuong tahin pei ta’n,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Ama in thu a gen laitahin makaipa inn panin mi khat pei a, “Na tanu si ta; siepa buoisah nawn da in,” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu in tam thu a zah ciengin, “Zau sinlen um beh lel in, ama nu ang hingkia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Inn sung a tun ciengin ama in Peter, John, James le naupang’ nu le pa simlo, ama tawh inn sunga tum ding koima dang a phal sih hi."},"52":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un kap le mau-in a na om uhi; ahi vangin ama in, “Kap sih un; azieh pen ama a si ahi sih a, a kimu ahi bo hi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Ama nu a si zo lam amate in a thei ziehun Jesu a nuisan uhi."},"54":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a khut tawh tua nu tu-in, “Numeino aw, tho vawi!” ci-in hlan hi."},"55":{"text":"Tua nu’ hlagau hingkia a, thakhatthu-in a thoto pai hi. Tua ciengin Jesu in a neh ding bangkhat pie un, ci-in a sawl hi."},"56":{"text":"A nu le a pa in lamdang a sa uhi; ahi vangin ama in a piengsa thute koima kunga a gen lo nadingun amate thu a pie hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a nuazui sawm le nite hlanin dawite zosie a hawlkhiet nading ule natnate a damsah thei nading uh thuneina le vanglietna pie a,","title":"Sawm le Nite Kisawlna (Mat 10:5-15 ; Mrk 6:7-13)"},"2":{"text":"Pasien’ manggam thu a tangko ding le cinate a damsah dingin amate a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Na khuolzinna vua na zah dingun ciengkhut, thung-ip, anphel, le sum cite keng sih unlen, puon-ah nangawn zong a valin kenbe sih un."},"4":{"text":"Na lutna uh inn khat popo-ah om peisuoh unlen tua inn pan ma-in dingkhie un."},"5":{"text":"Zin ang tungsah lo khuo khat popo panin na pei ding ciengun amate langah teci ahi dingin na keng vua leivuite thing dawh un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:51; Luk 10:4-11"},"6":{"text":"Amate zong kuonin khuo zosie-ah a pei vua, lungdamna thu tangko-in muncin tengah cinate a damsah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Gam uhpa Herod in thupieng zosie a zah ciengin a buoi mama hi, azieh pen mi pawlkhat in sina panin John thokia zo hi, a ci vua,","title":"Herod’ Lungmanna (Mat 10:5-15 ; Mrk 6:7-13)"},"8":{"text":"pawlkhat in Elijah ang kilang hi, ci-in, pawlkhat leuleu in tanglai kamsangte khat ang thokia hi, a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 16:14; Mrk 8:28; Luk 9:19"},"9":{"text":"Herod in, “John’ ngawng ka tansansa ahi hi; tam banga a thu ka zah pa koi ahei?” a ci hi. Tuale ama a mu nadingin a hanciem hi."},"10":{"text":"A khuolzinna uh panin a kile lamun sawltahpite in Jesu kungah a nasepna teng a gen uhi. Ama in amate zawpi-in Bethsaida kici khuo khatah a peidap uhi.","title":"Mi Tul Nga Vana (Mat 14:13-21 ; Mrk 6:30-44 ; Jhn 6:1-14)"},"11":{"text":"Mihonte in tam thu a thei ciengun ama a zui uhi; ama in zong amate na muoh a, amate kungah Pasien’ manggam thu genin cidam nading deite a damsah hi."},"12":{"text":"Ni a tum kuon ciengin sawm le nite pei-in ama kungah, “Gamsip-a om i hi ziehun gie nading le neh ding a sui dingin tam kim a khuotate le gamte-ah mipi peisah in,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “A neh ding uh bang khat popo pie un,” a ci hi. Amate in, “Tami mi zosie adingin an lei dinga pei ding ka hi ngal sih uleh anlum nga le nga tawn ni simlo bangma a val ka nei sih uhi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen khum munah pasal tul nga bang a om hi. Tuale ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Mi sawm nga ta-in a pawlpawlin tosah un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in tua ma bangin a unpi-un a tosah uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in anlum nga le ngasa tawn ni la a, vantung lam ento-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin phalsuo a, mihonpi mai-a lui dingin a nuazuite a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi zosie in ne-in a kham ciet uhi. Tuale khamval teng a khawm uleh seu sawm le seu ni a pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Khatvei, Jesu ama guoh thungenin a op laitahin a nuazuite zong a gei-ah a om uhi, tuale amate kungah, “Mihonpite in kei koi hi, ei ci vuoi?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Jesu’ Tungtang Peter in pulah (Mat 16:13-20 ; Mrk 8:27-30)"},"19":{"text":"Amate in, “Baptize-pa John hi; adang pawlkhat in, Elijah hi; pawlkhatte leuleu in tanglai kamsangte khat ang thokia hi, ang ci uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi.","ref":"Mat 14:1-2; Mrk 6:14-15; Luk 9:7-8"},"20":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Tua ahile note in lah kei koi hi, nei ci vuoi?” a ci hi. Peter in, “Nang pen Pasien’ Messiah na hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Jhn 6:68-69"},"21":{"text":"Ama in koima kungah a gen lo nadingun khautahin amate thupie a,","title":"Jesu in Si ding le Thawkia ding Magen (Mat 16:21-28 ; Mrk 8:31–9:1)"},"22":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa in gimna lienpi thuohin upate, siempu liente le thukham hil siete in a niel ding vua, tuale ama kithatin ni thum ni-in a thokia ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate zosie kungah, “Mi khatpo ka nuazui a suo nop leh ama le ama kinielin, nisimin a singlamte puo-in ka nua ei zui taheh.","ref":"Mat 10:38; Luk 14:27"},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen a hinna a hu nuom tapo in a tan ding vua, keima zieha a hinna a tan tapo in a hinna a hudawh ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; Luk 17:33; Jhn 12:25"},"25":{"text":"Mi khat in leitung buppi a nga vangin a hinna tanin suplaw leh bang phattuomna om ding ahei?"},"26":{"text":"Keima le ka thu ei zumpite, mihing Tapa in ama’ minthanna, a Pa’ minthanna le vantung misiengthote’ minthanna tawh ang pei ciengin tuapa a zumpi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin a tahtah a kang ci-in, tam sunga a ding mi pawlkhat in Pasien’ manggam a mu masangin sina a ciem sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam thu teng a gen zaw a ni gietna pawlin ama in Peter, John le James-te zawpi-in thungen dingin muol tungah a peito uhi.","title":"Mel Kikhelna (Mat 17:1-13 ; Mrk 9:2-13)"},"29":{"text":"Thu a nget laitahin a mel kikhel a, a puon zong a vam lihleh hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in thakhatthu-in mihing ni, Moses le Elijah, tawh ama a kiho a mu uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amate minthanna tawh a kilang vua, Jerusalem ah Jesu a si nading vai teng a tangtun zawh nading thu a kikum uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua laitahin Peter le a ompite kimut suohin a lusu uhi; ahi vangin amate a khahlaw ciengun ama’ minthanna le ama tawh a dington mihing ni a mu uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua mihing nite in ama a nuasie kuonun Peter in bang gen ka hei ci zong a thei lo pi-in Jesu kungah, “Mangpa, tami munah i om pen nuom mama hi; nangma ading buh khat, Moses ading buh khat le Elijah ading buh khat, buh thum ei lamsah in,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tami thu a gen laitahin meiilom khat kai-in amate a liemang hi; meiilum lahah a op ziehun amate a zau mama uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin meiilum lah panin aw khat in, “Tampa pen ka Teelsa ka Tapa ahi hi; ama’ thu na ngai un!” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 42:1; Mat 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; 2Pet 1:17-18"},"36":{"text":"Tua awging in thu a gen zaw ciengin Jesu ama guohin a om hi. Amate in tua sawng tengin a musa uh thute koima kungah gen lo-in a dai khipkhep uhi."},"37":{"text":"A zing ni, muoltung panin a kumsuh zaw ciengun, mihonpi in ama a na dawntuo uhi.","title":"Dawivei Naupang Khat Jesu in Damsah (Mat 17:14-21 ; Mrk 9:14-29)"},"38":{"text":"Tua zaw a sawt loin mihonpi lah panin pasal khat kiko a, “Siepa aw, ka tapa nei et pieh dingin kang thum hi; ama beh tapa-a ka nei ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Hlagau khat in ama man a, thakhatthu-in a peng vagua hi. Dawi in a kam sungah a cilphuon a kai dongin kongkaw sahin liemsah gawp a, a hla nuom zepzep sih hi."},"40":{"text":"Na nuazuite kungah tua dawi ei hawlkhietpieh nadingun ka thum vangin a hawlkhie zo sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Jesu in, “Upna nei lo, a letat khang mite aw, bang tanvei note hing ompi-in hing thuoh zo lai ding ka hei? Tam munah na tapa hing peipi in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"42":{"text":"Naupang pa a pei laitahin dawi in lei lahah lawmlia-in a kongkawsah gawp hi. Ahi vangin Jesu in tua hlabua hosie a, naupang damsahin a pa a apkia hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuaci’n a unpi-un Pasien’ vanglietna mu-in lamdang a sa mama uhi. Mi zosie in a sil bawl teng vannuoi lamdangsa-in a op laitahun ama in a nuazuite kungah,"},"44":{"text":"“Tam thute na bil vuah lutsah un: Mite khut sungah Mihing Tapa a ki-ap ding ahi ta hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu in Ama’ Si ding Magen (Mat 17:22-23 ; Mrk 9:30-32)"},"45":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in tami a kigen thu a tel siem sih uhi; amau’ thei lo dinga tam thu a ki-imdap ahi ziehin, amate in a khietna a tel thei sih vua, a kigen thu tawh kisai zong ama a dong ngam sih uhi."},"46":{"text":"Amate lahah koi lienpen ahei, ci thu tawh kisai-in kiselna a om hi.","title":"Lietna Tahtah (Mat 18:1-5 ; Mrk 9:33-37)","ref":"Luk 22:24"},"47":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in a lungsim vua a ngaisutna uh a thei ciengin naupang khat kai-in a gei-ah koi a,"},"48":{"text":"amate kungah, “Ka min tawh tami naupang a sang mi poma in kei ei sang ahi a, kei ei sang poma in kei ei sawlpa zong a sang ahi hi; azieh pen note lahah a neupen pa khu a lienpen pa ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Luk 10:16; Jhn 13:20"},"49":{"text":"John in, “Mangpa, nangma’ min tawh dawi a hawlkhie mi khat ka mu vua, ama in eite ei zui lo ahi ziehin ka kham uhi, ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Dawi Hawlkhie Midang Khat (Mrk 9:38-41)"},"50":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in ama kungah, “Ama kham sih un; azieh pen no ang langpan lo poma no lam a pang ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"A kilahto ding hun a nai ciengin ama in Jerusalem lam pei ding mitsuon in a nei hi.","title":"Samaria Khuo Khat in Jesu Sang Lo"},"52":{"text":"A masangah kamtaite sawl a, amate in lamkalah Jesu ading nate a baisa-a a koipieh dingin Samaria khuo khatah a lut uhi;"},"53":{"text":"ahi vangin Jesu in Jerusalem lam manaw sawm ahi ziehin amate in ama a na dawn sih uhi."},"54":{"text":"A nuazui James le John-te in a thei uh ciengin amate in, “ Topa aw, vantung panin meikuong kiesah suhin amate katumsah uleng nei awi ei mah?” a ci uhi.","ref":"2Kum 1:9-16"},"55":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu kihei-in amate a phawhsie hi."},"56":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuo dang khatah a peisuoh uhi."},"57":{"text":"Lampi-ah amate a pei laitahun mi khat in ama kungah, “Na peipei na-ah kang zui ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu’ Nuazui Dingte (Mat 8:18-22)"},"58":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in tuapa kungah, “Ngiete in kuo nei-in, vana leng vate in zong bu a nei vua, hizongle Mihing Tapa in a lu ngah nading mun nei lo hi,” a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Ama in adang khat kungah, “Ei zui in,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin tuapa in, “ Topa aw, pei-in ka pa va vui phot ta vang,” a ci hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in tua pa kungah, “Misite in a misite uh vuisah lel in; nang na hile va pei inlen Pasien’ manggam thu va tangko zaw ta’n,” a ci hi."},"61":{"text":"Midang khat in zong, “ Topa nang hing zui vang; ahi vangin ka inn-ate mangpha va pai phot ta vang,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:20"},"62":{"text":"Jesu in tuapa kungah, “A lokaina tu kawmin a nualam en pa pen Pasien’ manggam tawh kituoh lo hi,” a ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Topa in a pei nading khuo le khuopi zosie-ah mi nita-a a pei nadingin adang sawm sagite se a, ama mai-ah a mapeisah hi.","title":"Sawm Sagite Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Anlah ding tam mama a, hinanle nasem mi a tawm hi; tua ahi ziehin a lo lai-ah anla ding nasemte ang sawl nadingin an nei Topa kungah thungen un.","ref":"Mat 9:37-38"},"3":{"text":"Na lampi vuah pei unlen, ngiehon lahah tuunote a kihla bangin note kang sawl hi.","ref":"Mat 10:16"},"4":{"text":"Sum-ip, thung-ip le kedapte keng sih un; lampi-ah koima hopi sih un."},"5":{"text":"Inn khat popo-ah na lut ciengun, ‘Tami inn sungah lungmuonna om taheh!’ ci masa un."},"6":{"text":"Tua sungah lungmuonna dei a op leh, tua mipa tungah na pieh uh lungmuonna tung ding a, ahi vangin a dei mi a op sih leh na kung vuah ang kinuale kia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Inn khatah tamsuoh unlen amate ang pieh bangbang ne-in dawn un, azieh pen nasem mi in thaman a nga ding kilawm hi. Inn khat pan inn khat kituon kawikawi sih un.","ref":"1Cor 9:14; 1Tim 5:18"},"8":{"text":"Khuo khat po-ah na lut ciengun a mite in zin ang tunsah leh na mai vua ang kilui bangbang ne un;"},"9":{"text":"cinate damsah unlen amate kungah, ‘Note kungah Pasien’ manggam ang tung kuon ta hi,’ ci-in gen un."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuo khat popo-ah na lut uh ciengin zin ang tunsah sih leh a khuo sung lampite-ah pei unlen,"},"11":{"text":"‘Kang elsietna-un na khuo sung vua leivui, ka keng vua ang bangte nangawn zong ka thingkhie uhi. Hizongle tami thei un: Pasien’ manggam ang tung kuon ta hi,’ ci-in gen un.","ref":"Sawl 13:51; Mat 10:7-14; Mrk 6:8-11; Luk 9:3-5"},"12":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, khum ni ciengin Sodom khuopi’ thuoh ding sangin tua khuopi’ thuoh ding hahsazaw ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 19:24-28; Mat 10:15; 11:24"},"13":{"text":"“Chorazin aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Bethsaida aw, gimna na thuoh ding hi! Bangzieh ahei cile note gel tunga kibawl vanglien nasepnate, Tyre khuo le Sidon khuo sunga kibawl hi poma leh sawtpi lai-in a mawna uh kisiakia-in la-ip puon silin, vut kibuohin om zo tham ding uhi.","title":"A Kisiakia lo Khuopite ading Gimnate (Mat 11:20-24)","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Ezk 26:1–28:26; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:2-4"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin thukhen ni cienga na thuoh ding uh gimna sangin Tyre le Sidon-te’ thuohna nuomzaw tham ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang Capernaum aw, vantung dongin ang kitawisang ding amah? Hi lo hi, Misikhuo dongah ang kikhiesuh ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:13-15"},"16":{"text":"“Na thu uh a ngai poma kei thu ngai ahi a, no ang pampaih poma kei ei pampaih ahi hi; kei ei pampai poma kei ei sawlpa zong a pampai ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Mrk 9:37; Luk 9:48; Jhn 13:20"},"17":{"text":"Sawm sagite lungdamin a kilekia vua, “ Topa aw, na min ziehin dawite nangawn in ka thu uh mang hi!” a ci uhi.","title":"Sawm Sagite Kinualena"},"18":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Keima in vantung panin keh kie bangin Satan ang kiehsuh ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"En un, gulte, mom-aite na totcil nading ule na galpa’ vanglietna zosie na zaw nadingun note tungah thuneina kang pie zo hi; bangma in note ang liemsah sih ding hi.","ref":"Late 91:13"},"20":{"text":"Hizongle dawite in na thu uh a man ziehin lungdam sih unlen, tua sangin vantungah na min uh a kigiel ziehin lungdamzaw un,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Khum hun lien ma-in Hlagau Siengtho sungah Jesu lungdam a, “Vantung le leitung’ Topa ahi ka Pa aw, nangma in mipilte le misiemte kungah tam thute imcipin naupangte tungah na lah ziehin na tungah ka lung a dam hi; hima hi, Pa aw, tam pen a lungkimhuoi nangma’ deina ahi hi.","title":"Jesu Lungdam (Mat 11:25-27 ; 13:16-17)"},"22":{"text":"Ka pa in kei tungah na zosie ei ap zo a, Tapa koi ahei, ci Pa longal koima in thei lo a, Pa koi ahei, ci zong Tapa le Tapa in ama tunga a hil mi khatpo longal koima in thei lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 3:35; 10:15"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nuazuite lamah kihei-in amate kungah, “Na sil mute uh a mu na mit uh a hampha ahi hi!"},"24":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kamsang tampite le kumpi tampite in na sil mute uh a mu nop vangun a na mu sih vua, na zah uh thute a zah nop vangun a na za kha sih uhi,” ci-in a gendap hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zaw a sawt loin Jesu zelah dingin thukham hil siepa khat dingto a, “Siepa aw, kumtawn hinna ka nga thei nadingin bang bawl ding ka hei?” a ci hi.","title":"Samaria Mihoi pa"},"26":{"text":"Ama in tuapa kungah, “Thukham sungah bang a kigiel ei? Tua sungah bang pen na sim ei?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa na Pasien, na lungtang zosie, na hla zosie, na hatna zosie le na ngaisutna zosie-te tawh na it ding a, nang le nang na ki-it bangin na vengpa zong na it ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:5; Siem 19:18"},"28":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in, “Nei dawnna man hi; tam bangin gam ta in, tua hile na hing ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siem 18:5; Mat 22:35-40; Mrk 12:28-34"},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuapa ama le ama kidihsah nuom ahi ziehin Jesu kungah, “Ka vengpa koi ahei?” ci-in dong hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu in, “Jerusalem panin Jericho lamah mi khat a peisuh laitahin misuomte’ khut sung a tung kha hi. Amate in tua mipa’ puon a hawdawhpieh vua, ama sat gawpin a sikhielin a nuasie uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua laitahin upmaw lopi-in tua lampi zui-in siempu khat peisuh a, ama a mu ciengin lam gei-ah pielin a nawtsuoh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Levi mi khat tua munah a pei ciengin tuapa mu a, ama in zong lam gei-ah pielin a nawtsuoh leuleu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin Samaria-te khat a khuolzin laitahin tuapa gei-ah a tung hi; ama in tua mipa a mu ciengin khuotuo a,"},"34":{"text":"ama kungah pei-in a liemnate sathau le lenggazu a nu zaw ciengin a tunpieh hi. Tua ciengin a gan tungah tua pa tuongsah a, zintun inn khatah puohin kem hi.","ref":"2Khg 28:15"},"35":{"text":"A zing ciengin ama in zintun inn cingpa kungah sum denarii ni pie-in, ‘Tampa hoitahin na kem in; na zahbe a op leh kang kilekia ciengin kang lokia ding hi,’ ci-in a gen hi."},"36":{"text":"Tam teng thum sungah a kisuompa adingin koi pen a vengpa hi, ci-in na ngaisun ei?” ci-in dong hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua mipa tunga khuotuona lah pa hi ven,” a ci hi. Jesu in tuapa kungah, “Pei inlen tam bangin bawl in,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"A lampi vuah amate a pei laitahun khuo khatah Jesu baang a, tua munah Martha kici numei khat in a inn ah a tungsah hi.","title":"Martha le Mary Kungah Jesu Haw"},"39":{"text":"Tua nu in Mary kici nau numei khat nei a, Topa’ keng phungah ama to-in a thugente a ngai hi.","ref":"Jhn 11:1"},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin Martha pen nasep a kitahla mama hi. Tuaci’n Jesu kungah pei-in, “ Topa aw, ka naunu in nasep zosie kei matanga ei sepsah phamaw na sa sih amah? Kei ei hu nadingin gen in,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Jesu in Martha kungah, “Martha aw, nang in lunghimawna na hau a, na lungsim a buoi hi."},"42":{"text":"A kisam na khat beh a om hi. Mary in ama kung panin a kilahpieh lo ding a hoizaw pen a teel zo ta hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei ama in mun khatah thungen a, a man ciengin a nuazuite lahah khat in, “ Topa , John in a nuazuite thunget dan ding a hil bangin ko zong ei hil in,” a ci hi.","title":"Thungetna (Mat 6:5-15 ; 7:7-12)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Thu na nget ciengun tam bangin na ngen un: Pa aw, na min siengtho kizatat taheh. Na gam hing tung taheh."},"3":{"text":"Nisim ka neh ding uh an ei pie in."},"4":{"text":"Ko tunga ang mawte ka maisah bangun ka mawnate uh ei maisah in. Solna ei thuohsah sin,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in amate kungh, “Note lahah khat in lawm khat nei-in zankim laitahin ama kungah pei-in, ‘Lawm aw, anlum thum ei leitawi in;","title":"Thungetna ah Thuohzawhna"},"6":{"text":"azieh pen ka lawmpa khat a khuolzinna panin ang tung a, a mai-a lui ding bangma ka nei sih hi,’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n inn sung panin ama in, “Ei buoisah sin; kot ka khah zo ta vua, ka tate tawh ka lum zo ta uhi; kei hing tho-in bangma kang pie thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, tuapa a lawmpa ahi ziehin ama tho-in bangma khat nangawn a pieh lo vangin a nget paupau ziehin ama tho-in a kisap teng pie veve ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuaci’n ke’n kang ci-in, ngen un, ang kipie ding hi; sui un, na mu ding uhi; kiu un, kot ang kihon ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a ngen tapo in nga a, a sui tapo in mu-in, a kiu tapo kot kihon ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Note lahah na tapa un nga ngen leh tuami tangin gul a pie ding koi om na hi uh ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Ahi sihle na tapa un aatui ngen leh mom-ai na pie ding uh amah?"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahile no migilote in na tate uh na hoi pieh dan ding thei na hi uleh tua sangin vanah a om na Pa un ama kunga a ngen mite tungah Hlagau Siengtho a pie zaw kan sih ding amah!” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Khatvei Jesu in a ham thei lo dawi khat a deldawh hi; tua dawi a pusuo ciengin a ham thei lo mipa ham thei pai a, mihonpi in lamdang a sa mama uhi.","title":"Jesu le Beelzebul (Mat 12:22-32 ; Mrk 3:19-30)"},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate lahah mi pawlkhat in, “Dawite’ mangpa Beelzebul’ min tawh dawite a deldawh hi bo,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 9:34; 10:25"},"16":{"text":"Pawlkhatte leuleu in a ze-etna-un vantung panin lim khat a ngen uhi.","ref":"Mat 12:38; 16:1; Mrk 8:11"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in a ngaisutna uh thei a, amate kungh, “Ama le ama kido a, a kikhenkeh gam khat popo mangthai ding a, innkuon khat zong a sunga om mite a kikhenkeh leh a pua ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Satan zong ama le ama kido-in kikhenkeh leh a gam bangci kip thei ding ahei? Bang ding ahei cile note in Beelzebul suonga dawite a deldawh hi bo nei ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Beelzebul suonga dawite deldawh ka hi leh dawi hawlkhie theite in koi’ min suonga a deldawh uh ahei? Tua ahi ziehin amate pen na tung vua thukhente ahi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hizongle dawite ka hawlkhietna pen Pasien’ khutme hang tawh ahile note tungah Pasien’ manggam ang tung zo ahi ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi thahat khat in galhiem bukim tawh a inn a cin ciengin a neisate bihtahin a om hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama sanga a thahatzaw mi khat in ama bulu-in a zawgawp ciengin ama’ muon a galhiemte lahpiehin a vanlah teng a hawmthang hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei ei panpi lo poma kei ei do hi a, kei ei khoppi lo poma a thethang ahi hi.","ref":"Mrk 9:40"},"24":{"text":"“Mi khat sung panin hlabua a pusuo zaw ciengin, khawl nading mun sui dingin tui op lona gamte-ah vah kawikawi a, a mu zawh lo ciengin ama in, ‘Ka peikhietna inn ma-ah kilekia vang,’ a ci hi.","title":"Hlabua a Lutkiana (Mat 12:43-45)"},"25":{"text":"Ama a tun ciengin tua inn na kiphiet siengin a kipuo sinsenin a op a mu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama pei-in ama sanga a gilozaw hlagau dang sagi zawpi a, tua inn ah lutin a teng uhi; tua mipa pienzie pen a masa lai sangin siehuoizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in tami thu a gen laitahin mipi lahah numei khat kiko a, “Ang paai gil le na tawp nawi pen thupha nga ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"A tahtah Thupha Ngana"},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in, “Pasien’ thu za-a a zui mite hampha zaw uhi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Mihonte a tam semsem ciengin ama thugen kipan a, “Tam khang mite pen a gilo khang mite ahi uhi; amate in lim khat a ngen uhi, ahi vangin Jonah lim longal bangma lim kipie lo ding hi.","title":"Jonah’ Lim (Mat 12:38-42 ; Mrk 8:11-13)","ref":"Mat 16:4; Mrk 8:12"},"30":{"text":"Nineveh khuomite adingin Jonah pen lim khat ahi ma bangin mihing Tapa zong tami khang mite adingin lim khat hi ding hi.","ref":"Mat 16:4; Mrk 8:12"},"31":{"text":"Thukhen ni ciengin leitaw lam gam pana ang pei kumpinu in tami khang mite langkhatah dingin a mawsah ding hi, azieh pen Solomon pilna thu ngai dingin leimong khat panin ama a kuon hi, en in tam sungah Solomon sanga a lienzaw khat a om hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:1-10; 2Khg 9:1-12"},"32":{"text":"Thukhen ni ciengin tami khang mite langkhatah Nineveh khuomite dingin a mawsah ding uhi, azieh pen Jonah’ thugenna ziehin amate a kisiakia uhi, en in, tam sungah Jonah sanga a lienzaw mi khat a om hi, a ci hi.","ref":"Jhn 3:5"},"33":{"text":"“Koima in meivah a vah zaw ciengin mun kawmah koi loin a sunga lut mite in khuovah a mu thei nadingin meivah tunna tungah koizaw hi.","title":"Pumpi Khuovah (Mat 5:15 ; 6:22-23)","ref":"Mat 5:15; Mrk 4:21; Luk 8:16"},"34":{"text":"Na mit pen na pumpi adingin meivah ahi hi. Na mit uh a ciim leh na pumpi uh khuovah tawh kidim ding a, na mit uh a hoi sih leh na pumpi uzong khuomiel tawh kidim ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na sung vua om khuovah a miel lo nadingin pilvang un."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin na pumpi zosie uh khuovah tawh kidim a, a mielna mun khat zong a op sih leh, khuovah in note ang tanvah ma bangin na pumpi uh ang tangkim ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Thu a gen laitahin Pharisee-te khat in ama an nehpi dingin hlan a, tuaci’n ama zong pei-in an ne dingin sabuoi ah a to hi.","title":"Jesu in Pharisee-te le Thukham Hil Siete Mawsah (Mat 23:1-36 ; Mrk 12:38-40 ; Luk 20:45-47)"},"38":{"text":"Ama in khut sil masa loin an a neh lam Pharisee pa in a mu bepin lamdangsa mama hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ama kungah, “No Pharisee-te in hai le kuongte a pulam na nawt sieng zemzom vua, ahi vangin na sung lam uh huoihamna le gitlona tawh a kidim hi."},"40":{"text":"No mimaw lawmte! a pulam a bawlpa in a sunglam zong bawl hi lo amah?"},"41":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sung lama om nate mizawngte na pie un; tua hile note adingin na zosie a siengtho ding hi."},"42":{"text":"“No Pharisee-te in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in masala, lengmusel le ante lohing namkim tungah sawm-ah-khat na pie vua, ahi vangin thutang le Pasien itna na don vanuh sih uhi; adangte zong nelsie tuon loin tamte na bawl ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Siem 27:30"},"43":{"text":"No Pharisee-te in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Bangzieh ahei cile kikhopna inn sungah topha nuompen na dei vua, vanzuana munte-ah zatah hopi ding na dei uhi."},"44":{"text":"Note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen mite in a thei lo ziehun a tungah lamhlahna-a a nei uh, ciemtena a om lo hankhuhte tawh na kibang uhi."},"45":{"text":"Thukham hil siete lahah khat in, “Siepa, tam bang na gen ciengin ko zong ei gensie na hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “No thukham hil siete in zong gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen mi puoh zawh lo ding vangih na suon vua, tua van a puohpi dingin note in lah na khutme uzong na lamto nuom sih uhi."},"47":{"text":"Note in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen na pu na pate un a na tha kamsangte’ han na lampieh uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tuaci’n note na hi ule na pu na pate uh’ gamtatnate a thukimpi, a tecite na hi uhi; bangzieh ahei cile amate in kamsangte a na that vua, note in amau’ han na lampieh uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien’ pilna laibu in zong, ‘Amate kungah kamsangte le sawltahpite ka sawl ding a, amate in tua mite pawlkhat bawlsie-in that ding uhi,’ a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in leitung piencil a kipanin a na luonsah uh kamsang zosiete’ sisan,"},"51":{"text":"Abel’ sisan a kipanin maitam le mun siengtho kikala a na tha uh Zechariah’ sisan dong, tami khang mite tungah ka phulkia ding hi. Ahi hi, ke’n kang ci-in, tami khang mite tungah ka phulkia ding hi.","ref":"Pien 4:8; 2Khg 24:20-21"},"52":{"text":"No thukham hil siete in gimna na thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen note in theina tawhtang na ladawh vua, note lah lut loin a lut dingte lah na khahtan vanuh uhi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"A pulamah ama a pei ciengin thukham hil siete le Pharisee-te in langbawl kipanin thukhel tampitah a dong vua,"},"54":{"text":"a kamham tung panin mawmat ding sui-in a buhdap uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatlekhat a kituoncil za dongin mihon tul tampite kikhawmin a op laitahun ama in a nuazuite kungah thugen masa a, “Kineitawmna ahi Pharisee-te’ tol kidawm un.","title":"Kineitawmna Hilkholna","ref":"Mat 16:6; Mrk 8:15"},"2":{"text":"A kilang lo dinga a ki tuomcip bangma a om sih a, a kithei lo dinga a kiphuoldap bangma a om sih hi.","ref":"Mrk 4:22; Luk 8:17"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khuomiel lahah na gen popo uh khuovah sungah kiza ding a, inn sungtawnga na kidaphona popo uh inn khumvum ah kitangko ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lawmte aw, ke’n kang ci-in, pumpi a thazaw uh ciengin tua ban bangma a law thei lote na giing sih un.","title":"Zau Loin Mawna Pulah ding Hanthotna (Mat 10:26-31)"},"5":{"text":"Na giin ding uh koi ahei ci kang hil ding hi: Pumpi a tha zaw ciengin hell khuh sunga khieh thei nading thuneina a neipa giingzaw un. Ahi hi, ke’n kang ci-in, tua pa na giing un!"},"6":{"text":"Vato nga ciengin dangkasan peh ni tawh kizua lel hi lo amah? Hinanle Pasien mai-ah tuate khat nangawn kimangngil lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin na lu tung vua na samzamte nangawn uh a kisim siengsa ahi hi. Zau sih un; vato tampi sangin na manpha zaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Ke’n kang ci-in, midangte mai-a keima ei sang poma, mihing Tapa in zong Pasien vantung mite mai-ah a sang ding hi;","title":"Khris Kisanna le Kinuolna (Mat 10:32-33 ; 12:32 ; 10:19-20)"},"9":{"text":"ahi vangin mi dangte mai-a kei ei nuol poma, Pasien’ vantung mite mai-ah kinuol ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing Tapa langpangain thu gen poma kimaisah ding a, hizongle Hlagau Siengtho a gensie poma kimaisah lo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 12:32; Mrk 3:29"},"11":{"text":"Amate in kikhopna innte-ah hile, vaihawmte le thuneite mai-ah hile ang peipi ciengun bangci kihutin bang thu gen ding ka hei ci-in lunghimaw sih un."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen, tua hun ciengin Hlagau Siengtho in na gen ding uh ang hil ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:19-20; Mrk 13:11; Luk 21:14-15"},"13":{"text":"Mihonpi lah panin khat in ama kungah, “Siepa, ka sanggampa in gamh ei hop nading in ei genpieh in,” a ci hi.","title":"A hau Mimawpa Thugentena"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in tuapa kungah, “Lawm aw, nogel tunga thukhen ding le gamh hawmpieh dingin kei koi in ei se ahei? a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale ama in amate kungah, “Pilvang un! Huoihamna zosie panin na kikem un; azieh pen hau le dipna sungah mihing hinna om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in amate kungah thugentena khat a gen hi: “Mihaupa khat’ lo-ah an tampi a pieng hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale ama in, ‘Ka ankhol nading mun nei lo ka hi ziehin bang law ding ka hei,’ ci-in a lungsim sungah ngaisun hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, ‘Tam bangin ka bawl ding hi: Ka ansaal phelin a golzaw khat ka lam ding a, tua sungah ka antang le ka van teng ka khol ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale ka hlagau kungah, “Ka hlagau aw, kum tampi khom ding van tampi na khol zo hi; ne-in dawn inlen, guolnuomin om hit hiet in, ka ci ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in tuapa kungah, “Nang mimawpa! Tuzan mama-in na hinna kila ta ding hi. Tuale na kholsa nate koi-a’ ahi ta diei?’ a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n amau adinga gou a kholte pen Pasien lamah mihau ahi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Tua ahi ziehin ke’n kang ci-in, hinkhuo ading bang kine ding a, pumpi tungah bang kisil ding ahei, ci-in lunghimaw sih un.","title":"Lunghimaw Sih Un (Mat 6:25-34)"},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen an sangin hinna thupizaw a, puonsil sangin pumpi thupizaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Va-ahte ngaituo vawi un: Amate in vaw lah vaw lo, at lah at lo, an kholna inn le ansal zong a nei sih uhi, ahi vangin Pasien in amate a va hi. Vate sangin note nahpi tahin na manphazaw uhi!"},"25":{"text":"Note lahah a lunghimaw ziehin a khankum nai khat sung beh a belap thei koi om na hi uh ahei?"},"26":{"text":"Khum banga sil neuno khat zong bawl thei lo na hi uleh bang dinga adangte lunghimawpi na hi uh ahei?"},"27":{"text":"Unoh paate bangci khan ahei ngaisun un: Tuate in na sem loin vau zong a zom ngai sih uhi; hizongle ke’n kang ci-in, Solomon nangawn a minthanna teng tawh a kizep vangin tua unoh paate lahah khat zong a pha zo sih hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:4-7; 2Khg 9:3-6"},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in tuni-in hing a, zing cienga meikhuh sunga a kihaltum ding gamlah lopate puonsil guon ahile ama in bangza tahin note puonsil hing guonzaw sem ding ahei, no upna neute aw!"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na neh na dawn ding uh sui penin nei loin lunghimawpi den mielmuol sih un."},"30":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile leitung minam zosie in tami nate a sui vua, na Pa un tuate na kisap lam uh a thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuate sangin ama’ manggam suizaw un, tua hile note tungah tami nate ang kipiehbe ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tuuhon tawmnote aw, zau sih un, azieh pen note kang pieh ding kumpi’ gam khu na Pa uh’ lungkimna ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Na neisate uh zua unlen mizawngte pie un. Noma adingin a tul thei lo sum-ip bawl un, gutate in a nai thei lona, nget in zong a suhsiet thei lona mun vantungah a mang thei lo dingin na gougil uh kholzaw un."},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen na gougil opna munah na lungsim uh a om ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Na kawng uh gahin na meivahte uh tangsah un.","title":"A Kigingsa-a Om Nasemte","ref":"Mat 25:1-13"},"36":{"text":"Mopawi simna panin a kilekia a pu un kot a kiu ciengin thakhatin a hon thei pai dinga a ngah lenlon mite bangin om un.","ref":"Mrk 13:34-36"},"37":{"text":"A pupa uh a pei ciengin a kigingsa-a a mu nasemte mi hampha ahi uhi; a tahtah a kang ci-in, ama in a kawng gahin an ne dingin amate tosah ding a, tuale ama pei-in amate an a lui ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Zankim laitah hile, zingmawng khuovah kuon lam hile a pei hun sunga ama in a mu khah silate mi hampha ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"“Ahi vangin tami thu thei un: Inn neipa in gutate pei ding hun thei leh ama in inn bulusah lo ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Note zong a kigingsa-in om zing un, azieh pen na muonmaw lo laitahun Mihing Tapa ang pei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 24:43-44"},"41":{"text":"Peter in, “ Topa aw, tami thugentena ko dinga na gen amah, ahi sihle mi zosie ading ahei?” a ci hi.","title":"A Citah le a Citah lo Silapa (Mat 24:45-51)"},"42":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, “Tua ahile a silate uhin, a hunhuna amate an pie dinga a pupa in a koi, a muonhuoi le a pilvang inn sung vaisaipa koi ahei?"},"43":{"text":"A pupa a tun ciengin tua banga a sem a mu silapa mi hampha ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, ama in a neisa teng zosie a uh dingin tua mipa a koi ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua silapa in a lungsim sungah, “Ka pupa ang tungha lel ding hi,” ci-in sila numeite le pasalte sat gawpin, an ne tui dawnin zu na kham gawp leh,"},"46":{"text":"a muonmaw lo ni le a thei khah lo hun laitahin tua silapa’ pupa tung ding a, tuale ama semnenin mi thumanlote tawh a koiton ding hi."},"47":{"text":"A pupa’ dei dan thei napi-in, tua banga gamta nuom lo le a kigingkhol nuom lo tua silapa in satna nahpi-in a thuoh ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pupa’ deina a thei lo ziehin sat dinga kilawm mipa a kitawmsat zawdeu ding hi. Tampi a kipie pa tung panin tampi kikalh ding hi; tuale tampi a ki-ap pa tung panin a tamzaw kingenkia ding hi."},"49":{"text":"“Leitungah mei kuong hla dinga ang pei ka hi a, tua mei khu a kuong zo hi taleh ka nuom hi!","title":"Kikhenna a Piengsah Jesu (Mat 10:34-36)"},"50":{"text":"Ka ki-baptize nading baptize-na khat ka nei a, tuami a kicin masangsie ka lung a nuom thei sih ding hi!","ref":"Mrk 10:38"},"51":{"text":"Leitungah kilemna puoh dinga ang pei nei sa uh amah? Ka hi sih hi. Ke’n kang ci-in, kikhenna a piengsah dinga ang pei ka hizaw hi!"},"52":{"text":"Tu-a kipanin innkuon khat sungah mihing nga a phate, a langah thum, a langah ni-in a kido ding vua, thumte in nite do-in nite in thumte a langpang ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Amate pen: A tapa langah a pa, a pa langah a tapa, a tanu langah a nu, a nu langah a tanu, monu langah innpi nu, innpinu langah monu kilangpan cietin, amate a kikhenthang ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mic 7:6"},"54":{"text":"Ama in mihonpite kungah, “Nitumna lamah meii ang kai na mu ciengun, ‘Guo ang zu ding hi,’ na ci thei pai lien vua, tua bangin a pieng hi.","title":"Hun Theina (Mat 16:1-4 ; Mrk 8:11-13)"},"55":{"text":"Tua ma bangin leitaw lam hui ang lan ciengin, ‘Ni sa ding hi,’ na ci uhi; tua bangin a pieng pai hi."},"56":{"text":"No mihoi kipangte aw, leitung pienzie le vantung pienziete a deina khie-in gen thei napi ucin, bang dingin tuhun thute gen thei lo na hi uh ahei?"},"57":{"text":"“Tuale bang dingin thudihte khen thei lo na hi uh ahei?","title":"Na Langpa tawh Kilem in (Mat 5:25-26)"},"58":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin no ang hehpa tawh thukhenmangpa kungah na peiton laitahun na thu uh a mai thei nadingin lamkalah hanciem un, tua ahi sihle ama in thukhenmangpa kungah hing tutin, thukhen mangpa in vaihawm pa khutah ang tut ding a, vaihawm pa in thong sungah ang khum ding hi."},"59":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, na lieu ding uh sum dangkasan na pieh sieng masangsie-un thong sung panin na suohta thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin tua sunga om mi pawlkhat in, Pilat in Galilee-te’ sisan le amau’ biehpiehnate a halpiehna thu ama kungah a gen uhi.","title":"A Kisiakia Lote Kisie ding"},"2":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Tami Galilee-te in tam banga a thuoh ziehun Galilee midang zosie sangin a mawzaw hi dingin na ngaisun uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Hi lo hi, ke’n kang ci hi; note na kisiakia sih uleh no zong amate bangin na mangthai sieng ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi sihle Siloam tausang in a netlia mi sawm le giette, Jerusalem-a teng midang zosie sangin a gilozaw dingin na ngaisun uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Hi lo hi, ke’n kang ci hi; note zong na kisiakia sih uleh amate bangin na mangthai sieng ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tami thugentena a gen hi: “Mi khat in a lengga um sunga kisuon theikung khat nei hi; tua theiga lo dinga a pei ciengin a ga bangma a mu sih hi.","title":"A Ga lo Theikung Thugentena"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n um cingpa kungah, “En vawi! Tami kum thum sung theiga ka sui vangin khat beh ka mu sih hi. Phua dawh ta’n! Bang dingin leitang mawh nawngkaisah ding ahei?’ a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Siepa aw, a phung kimkot lei to-in ehlei ka sun masangsie kum khat sung tam bangin omsah phot lai in."},"9":{"text":"Maikum cienga ang ga leh a hoi hi ding a, ang ga sih leh phua bep in,’ ci-in a dawng hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in ama in kikhopna inn sungah thu a hil hi.","title":"Jesu in Apoi Numei khat Damsah"},"11":{"text":"Tua zaw lien ciengin khum munah hlabua in kum sawm le kum giet sung a poisah numei khat a om hi. Ama pen a cingbawngin a dingtang thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu a mu ciengin ama kungah hlanin, “Numei aw, na natna panin na dam ta hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tua nu tungah a khut a ngah ciengin ama dingtang thei pai lienin Pasien’ min a phat hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in Sabbath ni-in cina a damsah ziehin kikhopna inn uhpa lungthah a, mihonpite kungah, “Nasep hun ding ni guh tah a om hi; a kidamsah dingin tuami hun sungin hing pei unlen, sabbath ni-in hing pei sih un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:9-10; Thkna 5:13-14"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in dawngkia-in amate kungah, “No mihoi kipangte aw, sabbath ni-in a buh panin na bawngte uh ahi sihle na laate uh hla-in noma ciet in tui pie dingin na peipi sih uh amah?"},"16":{"text":"Satan in kum sawm le kum giet sung a na hencip Abraham’ tanu ahi tami numei nu khu sabbath ni-in a kihencipna panin sutdawh dingin kilawm hi lo amah? a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in tami thu a gen ciengin a langpangte zosie a maizum mama uhi; tuale a bawl na lamdang zosiete ziehin mipi zosie a lungdam uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama in, “Pasien’ manggam bang tawh kibang ahei? Bang tawh gente ding ka hei?","title":"Ankam Tang Thugentena (Mat 13:31-32 ; Mrk 4:30-32)"},"19":{"text":"Mi khat in um sunga a the ankam tang tawh a kibang hi; tua ankam tang khangin singkung golpi suoh a, vana leng vate in a bate tungah bu a bawl uhi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuale ama in a genkiana-ah, “Pasien’ manggam bang tawh gente ding ka hei?","title":"Tol Thugentena (Mat 13:33)"},"21":{"text":"Numei khat in vainel law thum a zelsuoh donga a saw tol tawh kibang hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Khuopi le khuotate khatzaw khat nawhin Jesu pei kawikawi a, thu a hil kawmin Jerusalem lam manaw-in a zin hi.","title":"Kot Kawcih (Mat 13:33)"},"23":{"text":"Mi khat in ama kungah, “ Topa aw, mi tawmno khat beh in hutdamna nga ding amah?” ci-in a dong hi. Ama in amate kungah,"},"24":{"text":"“Kot kawcih lam tawn a lut ding hakat un; azieh pen note kunga kang ci-in, mi tampi a lut sawm vua, ahi vangin a lut zo sih ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Khatvei inn neipa tho-in kot a khazaw ciengin note in zong a pulamah dingin kot na kiu ding vua, “ Topa aw, kot ei hon in,” na ci ding uhi. Tua ciengin ama in note kungah, ‘Hei pana hing pei ci kang thei sih uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin note in, ‘Nang tawh an ne-in tui i dawnton ngai zo a, ka gawldung teng vuah zong thu nei hil zo hi,” na ci ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in note kungah, “Ke’n kang ci-in, no hei pana ang pei ci ke’n kang thei sih hi; no, migilote zosie aw, ka kung panin peidawh ta un,” ang ci ding hi.","ref":"Late 6:8"},"28":{"text":"Pasien’ manggam sungah Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, le kamsangte zosie omin, note a pulamah ang kipaimang na mu uh ciengin kaana le hagawina a om ding hi.","ref":"Mat 22:13; 25:30"},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin nisuona, nitumna, leilu le leitaw lam panin mite pei-in Pasien’ manggam sungah an a ne ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 8:11-12"},"30":{"text":"A nukhia-te masa-in a masate nukhia tahpi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 19:30; 20:16; Mrk 10:31"},"31":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Pharisee-te pawlkhat pei-in ama kungah, “Tam panin kihemkhie ta’n, azieh pen Herod in ang tha sawm hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Jerusalem a Dapina"},"32":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Va pei ta unlen tua ngie kungah, ‘En in, tu ni le zing ciengin dawite notdawhin cinate ka damsah ding a, a ni thum ni-in ka nasep ka man sieng ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanle tuni, zing cieng le thai sung teng ka ma nawtsuohin ka pei ding hi, azieh pen Jerusalem pulamah kamsang khat a kitha ding pieng thei lo hi,’ a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Jerusalem, Jerusalem aw, kamsangte thatin, na kunga ang kisawlte suong tawh na seplia a, aapi in a hla kawmah a tate a huoi bangin na tate tamveipi ka huoi nuom vangin na nuom sih hi."},"35":{"text":"En in, na innte kinuasie zo hi. Ke’n kang ci-in, ‘ Topa’ min tawh ang pei pa in thupha nga taheh,’ na ci hun uh ang tun masangsie-in kei nei mu nawn sih ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 118:26"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni khatin Pharisee-te makaipa khat’ inn ah an ne dingin Jesu a pei ciengin amate in ama na encih uhi.","title":"Jesu in Cibaw Mi Khat Damsah"},"2":{"text":"Tua lien laitahin ama mai-ah cibaw natna a nei mi khat a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu in thukham theite le Pharisee-te kungah, “Sabbath ni-in cina damsah ding pen thukham tawh kituoh amah, kituoh lo ahei ? ci-in a dong hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate a sip dide uhi. Tuaci’n Jesu in tuapa hlan a, ama damsahin a peisah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in amate kungah, “Note lahah mi khat in sabbath ni-in a tapa ahi sihle a bawngtang khat tuikhuh sungah na kie leh, a lakhie pai lo ding koi om na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 12:11"},"6":{"text":"Amate in tami thu a dawngkia sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Lenglate in uliente to nading mun thupite a teel lam uh Jesu in a thei ciengin amate kungah thugentena khat a gen hi.","title":"Kiniemkhiehna le Zindo Siemna"},"8":{"text":"“Mi khat in mopawi sim dingin ang hlat ciengin mi thupite tona-ah to sih un, tua banga na to uleh mopawi sim dinga a kihlan mite lahah no sanga thupizaw mi om kha thei ding hi;"},"9":{"text":"tuale ang hlanpa hing pei-in na kung vuah, ‘Tampa tona awn in,’ ang ci thei ding a, tua ciengin maizum pipi-in a niem pen munah na to ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma ang kihlat ciengin pei-in a niem pen munah to zaw in, tuaci’n na kungah ang hlanpa ang pei ciengin, “Lawm aw, tona sangah to in,” ang ci ding a, tua ciengin sabuoi tunga na topi mi zosie muna-ah ang kizatah ding hi.","ref":"Pau 25:6-7"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen a kilamsangtawm mite kiniemkhieh ding a, a kiniemkhiehtawm mite kilamsang ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 23:12; Luk 18:14"},"12":{"text":"Ama a hlanpa kungah zong ama in, “Sun an nehna ah hile, nitah an nehna ah hile mi na hlat ciengin na lawm na guolte, na sanggamte, na tanaute ahi sihle mihau na vengte na hlan sin, tua hile amate in nang hing hlanin ang thuhkia thei ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin pawi na bawl ciengin mizawngte, mipoite, khelbaite, le mittawte na hlanzaw in."},"14":{"text":"Tua hileh amate in nang hing thuhkia zo lo ding ahi ziehin thupha na nga ding hi, azieh pen midihte a thawkia ni ciengin nang ang kithuhkia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Nitah an a nehpi lenglate khat in tam thu a zah ciengin ama kungah, “Pasien’ manggam sunga an ne ding poma hampha sam vuoi izaw!” a ci hi.","title":"Pawi Lienpi tawh Thugentena (Mat 22:1-10)"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Mi khat in pawi lienpi khat bawl a, mi tampitah hlan hi."},"17":{"text":"Pawi anneh hun ding ciengin ama in a mi hlatte kungah, “Hing pei un; azieh pen na zosie a baisa-in om zo ta hi,” ci-in a gen dingin a silapa a sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a kibangin hamlap a sui ciet uhi. Amasa pen pa in, ‘Lo khat ka lei a, keima pei-in ka va-et lo a poimaw hi; nei theisiem dingin kang thum hi,’ a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Adang khat in, “Bawngtang kap nga ka lei a, tuate ka va sin ta ding hi; nei theisiem dingin kang thum hi,’ a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Adang khat leuleu in, “Zi nei zo pan lien ka hi hi, tua ahi ziehin kang pei thei sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n silapa pei-in a pupa kungah tam thu teng a gen hi. Tua ciengin inn neipa lungthahin a silapa kungah, ‘Khuopi gawldung gawlvai tengah va naw pei ta’nlen, mizawngte, mipoite, mittawte, le khelbaite hing zawpi in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale silapa in, ‘Sie aw, nei sawl bangin ka sem zo ta a, mun awng lai veve hi,’ a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pupa in a silapa kungah, ‘Lamlien le lamneute-ah pei inlen ka inn ah mi a dim thei nadingin amate hing pau lutsah in."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen, ke’n note kang ci-in, a kihlante khat beh in ka pawi an a ciem kha sih ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama tawh mihon tampite khuol a zin vua, tuale kinua hei-in amate kungah,","title":"Nuazui Hina Man"},"26":{"text":"“Ka kunga ang pei mi poma in a nu le a pa, a zi le a tate, a sanggam pasalte le a sanggam numeite tham lo, ama’ hinna nangawn a muda sih leh keima’ nuazui a suoh thei sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:37"},"27":{"text":"Ama’ singlamte puo-a ei zui lo poma ka nuazui a suoh thei sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:38; 16:24; Mrk 8:34; Luk 9:23"},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi khatpo in tausang khat a lam sawm leh tua inn zaw sieng nadingin a sum a kicing diei, a kicing sih diei, ci-in to-in tuot masa phot lo ding amah?"},"29":{"text":"Tua bang hi sih mawh leh khuombul suong a phu zaw ciengin a ban zom zo ta sih leh, a mu mi zosie in zako ding a,"},"30":{"text":"‘Tampa inn lam kipan sam napi a zo thei ta sih hi,” a ci ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi sihle galkap tul sawm a nei kumpi khat in galkap tul sawmni tawh a sim dinga ang kuon kumpipa khat ka zo diei mah, ci-in to-in ngaisun masa phot lo ding amah?"},"32":{"text":"Ama in a zaw ngap sih leh tua adang kumpipa a gamlapi-a a op lai-in kilemna thu gen dingin ama kungah patong a sawl ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note lahah a neisa zosie a nuasie lo poma ka nuazui suoh thei lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Ci pen hoi hi; ahi vangin tua ci in a alna mansuo leh bangci ki-alsah theikia ding ahei?","title":"Ci Thu (Mat 5:13 ; Mrk 9:50)"},"35":{"text":"Leitang adingin lah a hoi sih a, ehlei dingin zong a hoi tuom sih hi; amate in tua khu a pulamah a paimang ta uhi. Zah nading bil nei tapo in za taheh!” a ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin a thugen ngai dingin siehdongte le mawneite in ama a nai uhi.","title":"Tuu Mang Thugentena (Mat 18:10-14)"},"2":{"text":"Tuale Pharisee-te le thukham hil siete in, “Tam mipa in mawneite ngai-in an a neton hi,” ci-in a phun uhi.","ref":"Luk 5:29-30"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in amate kungah tami thugentena a gen hi:"},"4":{"text":"Note lahah mi khat in tuu zakhat nei a, tua sung panin khat mansuo leh, gamlahah sawmkuo le kuote nuasie-in a mu masangsie-in tua a mang pen a sui lo ding koi na hi uh ahei?"},"5":{"text":"Ama in a mu ciengin lungdamin a liengko-ah a puo hi."},"6":{"text":"Inn a tun ciengin a lawmte le a vengte hlanin, ‘Ei lungdampi un, azieh pen a mangsa ka tuu ka mukia ta hi,’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ma bangin ke’n kang ci-in, vantung gamah kisiakia ding a kisam lo midih sawmkuo le kuote sangin a kisiakia mawnei mi khat tungah lungdamna lienzaw ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua ahi sihle numei khat in dangka tang sawm nei-in khat mansuo leh tua nu in meivah vahin innsung teng phietin a mu masang limtahin sui lo ding amah?","title":"Sum Mang Thugentena"},"9":{"text":"Tua sum a mu ciengin a lawmte le a vengte hlanin, ‘Ka sum mansuo ka mukia ziehin ei lungdampi un,’ a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, tua ma bangin a kisiakia mawnei mi khat ziehin Pasien’ vantung mite lungdam mama uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Mi khat in tapa ni nei hi.","title":"Tapa Taimangpa Thugentena"},"12":{"text":"A nauzaw pa in a pa kungah, ‘Pa aw, ka nga ding gou teng ei pie in,’ a ci hi. Tuaci’n a pa in a neisa teng a ta tegel a hawmpieh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni tawmkhat zaw ciengin a naupa in a neisa zosie khawmin a gamla mama gam khatah zin a, tua gamah a neisa teng a phengzah sieng ta hi."},"14":{"text":"A neisa teng a zah sieng zaw ciengin tuami gam buppi-ah kielpi tung a, ama zong neh ding a kitasam ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua gammite khat kungah sum thalaw dingin pei a, tuapa in a lo-a voh an pie dingin a sawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in vohte neh begapte a dugaw mama a, ahi vangin koima in bangma khat beh pie lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in thu a ngaisut theikia ciengin, ‘Ka pa guoisa nasemte in khawn tal loin an khamval tampi a nei ding vua, ahi vangin kei lah tam sungah gilkiela a si ding ka hi ta hi!"},"18":{"text":"Kei tho-in ka pa kungah ka pei ding a, “Pa aw, vantunga Pasien le nangma mai-ah ka khiel zo ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Na tapa ci dingin zong ka kilawm nawn sih hi; na guoisa na nasemte khat bangin kei ei bawl lel in,’ ka ci ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama tho-in a pa kungah a pei hi. Ahi vangin gamlapi mun khatah ama a gei laitahin a pa in na galmu a, khuotuohuoi a sa hi; tuale ama zong tai phei pai-in na ngawngkawi a, a na nam vatuh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin a tapa in a pa kungah, ‘Pa aw, Pasien le nangma mai-ah ka khiel zo a, tu-a kipanin na tapa ci dingin zong ka kilawm nawn sih hi,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pa in a silate kungah, ‘Mallangin puon hoipen khat hing la unlen ama silsah un; a khutah khutsip bunsah unlen a kengah kedap zong bunsah un."},"23":{"text":"Tuale bawngno thau khat manin go unlen, tua khu ne-in lungdamin pawi bawl vai;"},"24":{"text":"azieh pen tami ka tapa a sisa ahi a, ang hingkia ahi hi; ama pen a mangsa ahi a, tu-in a kimukia ahi hi!’ a ci hi. Tuale amate lungdamin pawi bawl a kipan uhi."},"25":{"text":"A tapa uzaw pen lo kuon hi a, vai pei-in inn a tun kuon ciengin tumging le lamnate a za hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in silate khat hlanin bang kibawl ahei, ci-in a dong hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuapa in, ‘Na naupa ang tungkia a, cidam ludamin ama ang tun ziehin na pa in bawngthau khat a gaw hi,’ a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama lungthah mama a, inn sungah a lut nuom ta sih hi. A pa pusuohin ama a va zawl ta hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a pa kungah, ‘En in! Tami kum tampi sungin silate khat bangin nangma adingin na ka sem a, na thu zong kang niel ngai sih hi; hizongle ka lawmte tawh ka guolnop thei nadingin keelno khat zong nei pie ngai nai sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in numei pahtatte tawh a neisa teng a netum tami na tapa ang tun ciengin bawngno kivathau na go hi!’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pa in ama kungah, “Ka ta aw, keima tawh nang na om den a, ka neisa zosie nangma-a’ ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin tami na naupa pen a sisa ahi a, ang hingkia ahi hi; ama a mangthapsa ahi a, a kimukia ahi tah ziehin kipahna le guolnopna bawl ding a kilawm ahi hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in a nuazuite kungah, “Mihau pa khat in neisa kem khat nei a, tua neisa kempa in a neisa teng phengzah gawp hi, ci-in kiheh hi.","title":"A Dihtat lo Neisa Kempa Thugentena"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in tuapa hlanin ama kungah, ‘Na tungtang thu ka zahte bang cidan ahei? Nang pen ka neisa kempa hi nawn lo ding na hi ziehin na sum zehna sazien teng ei ap in,’ a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin neisa kempa in a lungsim sungah, “Tu-in ka pupa in ka nasep panin ei tawpsah ahi tah leh bang ka ci ta diei? Lei lai dingin lah ka tha a hat sih a, khutdaw nget ding lah ka maizum hi."},"4":{"text":"Neisa kempa hina panin ei kitawpsah zaw ciengin mite in a inn vua zin ei tunsah thei nadingin ka sep ding teng ka khensat zo hi,’ a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pupa tunga leiba ba teng a banbanin hlan a, amasa pen pa kungah, “Nang in ka pu lei bangza na ba ei? ci-in a dong hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Sathau bung zakhat ka ba hi,’ a ci hi. Tua neisa kempa in ama kungah, ‘Leiba ciemtena laibu va lazuai ta’nlen tosuhin sawm nga-in giel in,’ a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin adang khat kungah, ‘Tuale nang in ka pu leiba bangza na nei ei?’ ci-in dong hi. Ama in, ‘Mangbu seu zakhat,’ a ci hi. Ama in tuapa kungah, ‘Na leiba ciemtena lai la inlen, to-in seu sawm gietin giel in,’ a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuale a dihtat lo neisa kempa pen pilvang tahin a gamtat ziehin a pupa in ama a pahta hi; azieh pen khuovah tate sangin leisiet mite a nasepna vuah a pilvangzaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in note tungah kang ci-in, tuate a tawp ciengin kumtawn inn sungah ang lamdot ding lawm suina-in tua a dih lo haunate na zang un."},"10":{"text":"Themno khat tunga a citah poma a tampi tungah citah a, themno khat tunga a citah lo poma a tampi tungah zong citah lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin a dih lo hauna tunga na citah sih uleh koi in note adingin hauna tahtah ang ap ngam ding uh ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Midang khat’ neisa tunga na citah sih uleh koi in noma adingin ang ap ngam mawh ding uh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Koima’ sila in pu ni’ na semton zo lo hi; bang ding ahei cile ama in khat muda-in adang khat it ding a, ahi sihle khat belin adang khat a simmaw ding hi. Pasien’ na le hauna’ na na semton thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 6:24"},"14":{"text":"Sum du Pharisee-te in tam thu zosie a zah ciengun ama a nuisan uhi.","title":"Thukham le Pasien’ Manggam"},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate kungah, “Mite mai-ah no le no na kidihsah vangun Pasien in na lungtang uh a thei hi; azieh pen mihingte in manpha a sah mama uh nate pen Pasien’ muna-ah a kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“John hun cieng dong thukham le kamsangte’ thu na kizang hi; tua zaw lang kalsie Pasien’ manggam lungdamna thu kihil a, tua gam sungah mi zosie in pau lut ding a hanciem uhi.","ref":"Mat 11:12-13"},"17":{"text":"Hinanle thukham laibu sunga om laimal cindawncie khat a manthai ding sangin van le lei a manthai ding baizaw lai hi.","ref":"Mat 5:18"},"18":{"text":"“Mi khatpo in a zi a khul a, midang khat tawh a kinun leh ama angkawm suoh a, a kikhulsa numei tawh a kinung mi zong angkawm ma ahi hi.","title":"Zi Khulna Thu Jesu’ Genna (Mat 19:1-12 ; Mrk 10:1-12)","ref":"Mat 5:32; 1Cor 7:10-11"},"19":{"text":"“Khumin mihaupa khat in puon ausan le saihadiel puon sil a, nisimin pawi bawlin nuomsa tahin a om hi.","title":"Mihaupa le Lazarus"},"20":{"text":"Tuale a tunkotah a pumtanga hima vei Lazarus a kici mizawng khat kikoi a,"},"21":{"text":"ama in a gilkiel phat nadingin mihaupa’ sabuoi panin a kie annengte a dugaw hi; uite nangawn pei-in a hima a liepieh zel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua mizawng pa si a, vantung mite in Abraham tawh omton dingin ama a puo uhi. Mihaupa zong si-in a kivui hi."},"23":{"text":"Misikhuo ah gawtna thuohin a op laitahin a khuodah leh a gamlapi mun khatah Abraham le a gei-a om Lazarus a galmu hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama kiko-in, “Pa Abraham aw, kei ei khuotuo inlen, tami meili lai-ah gimna nahpi tahin thuoh ka hi ziehin Lazarus in a khutme dawn tui die-in ka leii a votsah dingin hing sawl in,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Abraham in, “Ka ta aw, na hin sungin sil hoi teng na nga a, tua ma bangin Lazarus in sil hoi lo teng a nga lam phawh in; hizongle tu-in tam sungah ama nuomsa-in a om a, nang in gimna na thuoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tamte zosie banah i kikal vuah guom thuhpi khat om a, tam lam panin no lamah a galkai nuomte a galkai thei sih vua, tua lam panin ko lamah zong koima a galkai thei sih hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Tua ahileh Pa aw, ka pa inn ah ama ei sawlpieh in, kang thum hi."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in sanggam pasal nga ka nei a, tami bawlsietna munah amate ang tun lo nadingun ama in ei va hilpieh taheh,’ a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Abraham in, ‘Amate in Moses le kamsangte a nei uhi; amate’ thu na ngai ta uheh,’ a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Hi lo hi, Abraham aw, misite lah panin khat ka sanggamte kungah va pei leh amate kisiakia ding uhi,’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in tuapa kungah, ‘Amate in Moses le kamsangte’ thu a man nop sih uleh misite lah nangawn panin mi khat thokia nanle zong a tahsang tuom sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in a nuazuite kungah, “Puana a piengsah thei hun le nite ang tung valon ding hi, ahi vangin tuate a piengsah mi khatpo in gimna a thuoh ding hi!","title":"Jesu’ Thugen Pawlkhat (Mat 18:6-7 , 21-22 ; Mrk 9:42)"},"2":{"text":"Tami naupangte lahah khat a puasah sangin a ngawngah an gawina suongtum khat khai-in tuipi sungah kikhie leh ama dingin hoizaw lai ding hi."},"3":{"text":"No le no kikem siem un! Nuazuite adangkhat ang maw leh tua a maw mipa phawh unlen, a kisiakia leh a mawna maisah un.","ref":"Mat 18:15"},"4":{"text":"Na tungah mi khat in ni khat sungin mawna sagi vei ang bawl a, tuale nangma lamah hing kihei-in sagi vei ma, ‘Ka kisia ta hi,’ ang ci leh a khielna na maisah in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Sawltahpite in Topa kungah, “Ka upna uh hing khangsah in!” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in amate kungah, “Note in ankamtang cie upna na nei uleh tami nailung kung tungah, ‘Kiphungkal inlen, tuipi sungah va po in,’ na ci thei ding vua, na thu uh ang mang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Lokaina pan hile, lo lai-a a tuucinna panin hile na silapa uh vai ang tun ciengin note lahah koi in, ‘Hing pei inlen sabuoi-ah an ne pai in,’ ci ding ahei?","title":"Nasempa Mawpuohna"},"8":{"text":"‘Nitah an ei thua inlen, ne le dawnin ka op laitahin na nasep puon silin ka neh ding ei bawlpieh in; tua zaw ciengin ne pan lel in,’ a cizaw sih ding amah?"},"9":{"text":"Silapa in a kisawl teng a bawl ziehin ama tungah lungdam a ko ding uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in sep dinga ang kisawl zosie na sep zaw ciengun, ‘Kimanna a nei lo silate i hi uhi; i sep dinga kilawmte beh ma a sem i hi lel uhi,’ na ci uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem lam zuonin Jesu a pei laitahin Samaria gam le Galilee gam kikal tawnin a pei hi.","title":"Jesu in Miphah Sawm Damsah"},"12":{"text":"Khuo khat a lut leh miphah sawm in ama a nai phei uhi. Amate in a gamla sim khatah,"},"13":{"text":"“Jesu ka Mangpa aw, kote ei hepi in,” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"14":{"text":"Jesu in a mu ciengin amate kungah, “Pei unlen siempute va kivelsah ta un,” a ci hi. Amate a pei ciengun a dam pai ta uhi.","ref":"Siem 14:1-32"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate lahah khat in a dam lamtah a kithei ciengin kinuale-in awging tah tawh Pasien a phat hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu keng phungah khupbawhin ama kungah lungdam a ko hi. Tuapa pen Samaria mi khat ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Mi sawm tah kidamsah hi lo amah? Adang kuote hei sungah a om ta uh ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Tami gamdang mipa khat simlo, Pasien phat dinga ang kinuale koima om lo ahi amah?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tua mipa kungah, “Tho inlen pei in, na upna in nang ang damsah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Khatvei Pharisee-te in bang hun ciengin Pasien’ manggam hing tung ding ahei, ci-in a dong uleh ama in, “Pasien’ manggam pen mu thei dinga limte tawh ang tung ding ahi sih hi.","title":"Pasien’ Gam ang Tunna (Mat 24:23-28 , 36-41)"},"21":{"text":"Amate in, ‘En un, tam tahah om ei!’ ahi sihle, ‘Khumtah ah om ei!’ a ci thei sih ding uhi. Azieh pen a tahtahin note lahah Pasien’ manggam a om hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a nuazuite kungah, “Ni khat ni ciengin Mihing Tapa’ nite lahah ni khat beh na mu nop hun uh ang tung ding a, ahi vangin na mu sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in note kungah, ‘Khunah en vuo!’ ahi sihle, ‘Tanah en vuo!’ ang ci ding uhi. Pei sih unlen zong zui sih un."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen tunphe in van mong khat pan mong khat dong a tan ma bangin, Mihing Tapa’ ni ciengin zong tua bang ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in gimna tampi thuoh masa ding a, tulai khang mite in ama a niel ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Noah hun lai ma bangin Mihing Tapa’ ni ciengin zong a pieng ding hi.","ref":"Pei 6:5-8"},"27":{"text":"Tembaw sungah Noah lutin tuizin tung a, amate a unpi-in a suhsiet ni dongin an ne tuidawn, kipi kitengin a om uhi.","ref":"Pien 7:6-24"},"28":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Lot hun lai-in zong amate in ne-in dawnin, lei-in zua-in, suonin lamin a om vua,"},"29":{"text":"ahi vangin Lot in Sodom khuo a nuasie ni-in vantung panin kat le meikuong guo bangin zu a, amate a unpi-un a susie mang hi.","ref":"Pien 18:20–19:25"},"30":{"text":"Mihing Tapa ang kilah ni ciengin zong tua ma bangin a pieng ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin inn khum vuma om poma inn sunga kikoi vante la dingin kumsuh sih heh; tua ma bangin lolai-a omte zong inn ah nua peikia nawn sih heh.","ref":"Mat 24:17-18; Mrk 13:15-16"},"32":{"text":"Lot’ zi phawh gige un.","ref":"Pien 19:26"},"33":{"text":"A hinna uh humbit dinga a hanciemte in a hinna uh a tan ding vua, a hinna uh a tan mite in a hinna uh a humbit ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; 16:25; Mrk 8:35; Luk 9:24; Jhn 12:25"},"34":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, khum zan ciengin lupna tunga a lumton mi ni lahah khat kila-in khat kinuasie ding hi."},"35":{"text":"An suton numei ni lahah khat kila-in khat kinuasie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Lo lai-a om mi ni lahah khat kila-in khat kinuasie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “ Topa aw, tua thute hei sunga hing pieng ding ahei? ci-in a dong uhi. Ama in amate kungah, “Siluong opna popo-ah langtate a kikhawm ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in lungkie lo-a thu nget den ding a kisapna thu tawh kisai-in thugentena tawh thu a hil hi.","title":"Meigongnu le a Dih lo Thukhenpa Thugentena"},"2":{"text":"Khuopi khatah Pasien a zatah lo, mi zong a thusim lo thukhen mang khat a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua khuo sungah meigong numei khat om a, thukhen pa kungah pei den mielmuolin, ‘Ka langpa tungah thu a tangin ei khenpieh in,’ a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in bapikhat sung khenpieh nuom lo a, ahi vangin a nua ciengin, ‘Pasien zatah loin mihing zong ka thusim sih vangin,"},"5":{"text":"tami meigong numei in ei subuoi zing ahi ziehin, ama hing pei-in ei gimsah nawn lo nadingin a thu tangtahin ka khenpieh ta ding hi,’ ci-in ngaisun hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, “A dih lo thukhen mangpa thugen ngaisun un."},"7":{"text":"Sun le zanin ama kunga a kiko ama’ teelsa mite tungah Pasien in thu a tangin khenpieh lo ding amah? Amate panpi ding a kiheh ding amah?"},"8":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, ama in amate tungah thu a nawkhen ding hi. Hizongle Mihing Tapa ang pei ciengin leitungah upna a mu lai diei mah?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Amau le amau thuman kisa-in a kimuong vua, midangte a simmaw mite tungah zong tami thugentena a gen hi:","title":"Pharisee le Siehdong Thugentena"},"10":{"text":"“Thu ngen dingin biehinn ah mi ni a peito vua, khat pa pen Pharisee ahi a, adang khat pen siehdong pa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pharisee-pa dingin thu ngen a, ‘Pasien aw, kei pen midangte bangin misuomte, neisa lahpiehte, angkawmte, ahi sihle tami siehdong pa nangawn tawh zong ka kibah lo ziehin nangma tungah lungdam kang ko hi."},"12":{"text":"Nipi kal khat sungin an nivei ka tang a, ka nga zosie lah panin sawm-ah-khat zong ka pie hi,’ a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin siehdong pa pen a gamlapi ah ding a, van lam nangawn nga ngam loin a awm bengin, ‘Pasien aw, mawnei mi keima ei hepi in!’ ci-in thu a ngen hi."},"14":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in, a khat pa sangin dihtangsa-in inn ah tampa a pei hi; azieh pen ama le ama a kitawisang poma in niemkhiehna thuoh ding a, ama le ama a kiniemkhieh poma in tawisangna nga ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 23:12; Luk 14:11"},"15":{"text":"Jesu in a tham thei nadingin mite in ama kungah naupangte a peipi uhi; tuale a nuazuite in a mu ciengin amate a phawhsie uhi.","title":"Jesu in Naupangte Thupha Pie (Mat 19:13-15 ; Mrk 10:13-16)"},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in ama kungah naupangte hlanin, “Keima kungah naupangte hing peisah unlen kham sih un; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ manggam khu tua bang mite-a’ ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, naupang banga Pasien’ manggam a sang lo poma tua gam sungah lut ngai lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Uhpa khat in Jesu kungah, “Sie Hoipa aw, kumtawn hinna ka nga thei nadingin bang bawl ding ka hei? ci-in dong hi.","title":"A Hau Uhpa (Mat 19:16-30 ; Mrk 10:17-31)"},"19":{"text":"Jesu in tuapa kungah, “ Bang zieha kei mihoi nei ci ahei? Pasien khat longal koima a hoi a om sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang in thukham teng na theisa ahi hi: ‘Ang na kawm sih ding hi; tuol na that sih ding hi; mi neisa na gu sih ding hi; zuou teci na pang sih ding hi; na nu leh na pa zatah ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:12-16; Thkna 5:16-20"},"21":{"text":"Ama in, “Tam teng zosie ka neu lai-a kipanin ka zui siengsa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu in tam thu a zah ciengin tuapa kungah, “Na khat na kisam lai hi. Na neisa zosie zua inlen, mizawngte tungah na sumte hawm in, tua hile van gamah gou na nei ding hi; tua ciengin hing pei inlen ka nua ei zui in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama hau mama ahi ziehin tam thu a zah ciengin a da mama hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesu in ama en kawmin, “ Pasien’ manggam sungah mihaute a lut ding bang a ci hamsat diei izaw!"},"25":{"text":"Mihau khat, Pasien’ manggam sunga a lut ding sangin kala-oh khat, hieumei hawm sunga a lut ding baizaw lai hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tami thu a za mite in, “Tua bang ahileh koi in gupna nga zo mawh ding ahei?” a ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in, “Mihingte adinga ahi thei lote Pasien adingin hi thei hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in, “En in, ko zong ka inn ka lo uh nuasie-in nang kang zui uhi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, Pasien’ manggam ziehin a inn, a zi, a sanggamte, a nu a pa-a kipan a tate nuasie-in,"},"30":{"text":"tam khanghun ah a za tampi nga a, ang tung ding hunah zong kumtawn hinna a nga lo ding koima a om sih hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in sawm le nite hlanin amate kungah, “En un, Jerusalem ah i peito ding a, kamsangte in a na gielsa Mihing Tapa’ thu zosie a tangtung ding hi.","title":"Jesu in a Si ding a Thumveina Magen (Mat 20:17-19 ; Mrk 10:32-34)"},"32":{"text":"Azieh pen Gentile mite khut sungah ama ki-ap ding hi; tuale ama kisimmaw-in, kizako-in, kicilphit ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in ama a sat gawp zaw uh ciengin a that ding vua, tuale a nithum ni ciengin a thokia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nuazuite in tam thute zosie bangma a thei sih uhi; amate tungah ama’ thugente ki-im ahi ziehin a kigen thute a deina a man zo sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Jericho khuo ah Jesu a tun kuonin lam gei-ah mittaw khutdawngen khat na to hi.","title":"Jesu in Jericho Khuo gei-ah Mittaw Khutdawngen khat Damsah (Mat 20:29-34 ; Mrk 10:46-52)"},"36":{"text":"Tua mun nawhin mihonpite pei a zah bepin ama in bang thu ahei, ci-in dong hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in, “Nazareth mi Jesu ang pei ahi hi,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama kiko a, “David Tapa Jesu aw, kei ei hepi in!” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"A mai-a om mite in ama a sip khinkhian nadingin khautahin thu a pie uhi; ahi vangin ama in ,“David Tapa aw, ei hepi in,” ci-in a kinah ko semsem hi."},"40":{"text":"Jesu khawlin ama kungah ang peipi nadingun thu a pie hi; tuale a gei a tun ciengin Jesu in,"},"41":{"text":"“Bang hing bawlpieh leng na nuom ei?” ci-in dong hi. Ama in, “ Topa aw, khuo ei musahkia in,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Khuo mu ta in; na upna in nang ang damsah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in thakhatin khuo mu pai a, Pasien’ min phat kawmin a nua a zui pai hi; mi zosie in a mu ciengun Pasien a phat uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jericho khuo ah Jesu lutin a peisuoh hi.","title":"Jesu le Zacchaeus"},"2":{"text":"Tua sungah Zacchaeus kici siehdong uhpa khat om a, ama a hau mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuapa in Jesu mu nuom mama a, ahi vangin ama mi tuntom khat ahina zieh le mihon a tam seng ziehin a mu zo sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama na matai a, Jesu a mu thei nadingin lampi gei-a theitheh kung tungah na ka hi, azieh pen ama tua lampi zui ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Khumi munah Jesu a tun ciengin khuodah to-in ama kungah, “Zacchaeus aw, mallangin hing kumsuh in; azieh pen tuni-in na inn ah kang tung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Zacchaeus zong kumsuh pai bingbiengin kipahtahin a tungsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate zosie in tam thu a mu ciengun, “Mawnei khat’ inn ah zin tung dingin a pei hi,” ci-in ama a phunsan uhi."},"8":{"text":"Khum munah Zacchaeus dingto a, Topa kungah, “ Topa , en in, ka neisa alang mizawngte ka pie ding hi; solna tawh mi khatpo’ neisa ka lahpieh a op leh a za li-in ka lokia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Ama zong Abraham suonlehlahte khat ahi ziehin, tuni-in tami inn ah hutdamna a tung zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen a mangthai mite sui ding le a hundam dinga Mihing Tapa ang pei ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 18:11"},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Jesu a tung dihtah a, amate in Pasien’ manggam ang tung pai dingin ngaisun uh ahi ziehin, a thugente a na ngai laitahun ama in a ban zomin thugentena khat a gen hi.","title":"Sum Pound Sawm Thugentena (Mat 25:14-30)"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi thupi khat in kumpi thuneina a nga nadingin a gamlapi-a om gam khatah a pei zaw ciengin a kilekia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a silate mi sawm hlanin sumtang pound sawm pie-in amate kungah, “Kang tunkia masangsie tam teng tawh summet na bawl un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a gammite in ama a muda ziehun ama’ nua-ah kamtai khat a sawl vua, ‘Kote ei uh dingin tam mipa ka dei sih uhi,’ a cisah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi thuneina ngasa-in a kilekia ciengin, amate tungah a sum apsa silate in summet bangza nga uh ahei, ci a thei nadingin ama kungah a hlansah hi."},"16":{"text":"A masa pen pa a mai-ah pei-in, ‘ Topa aw, nei sum pieh pound khat in pound sawm metsah hi,’ a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Hoi sep cie, Sila hoi aw! Thu neuno khatah muonhuoi na hi ziehin khuopi sawm uh in,’ a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nina pa pei-in, ‘ Topa aw, nei sum pieh pound khat in pound nga metsah hi,’ a ci ciengin,"},"19":{"text":"Ama in tuapa kungah, ‘Tuale nang in khuopi nga uh in,’ a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin adang khat pei-in ama kungah, ‘ Topa aw, tam sungah na pound a om hi. Puonthem khat tawh tua sum ka tun hi,"},"21":{"text":"azieh pen nang mi genhapi khat na hi ziehin na khol lopi na la a, na tu lopi zong na at hi, tua ahi ziehin nang kang giing hi,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in tuapa kungah, ‘Nang a gilo silapa aw, na kamham ma tawh thu kang khen ding hi! Kei pen mi genha khat ka hi a, ka khol lona munah la-in ka tu lona-ah ka at lam nei thei amah?"},"23":{"text":"Tua banga ei thei na hi leh bang dingin sumkholna-ah tua sumte na koi lo na hei?
