Tua hileh kei kang peikia ciengin ka sumpi a met tawh ka nga ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in a gei-a dingte kungah, ‘Ama kung panin pound khat la unlen, pound sawm a neipa pie un,’ a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"(Tuale amate in tuapa kungah, ‘ Topa aw, ama in pound sawm nei zo ta!’ a ci uhi.)"},"26":{"text":"‘Ke’n kang ci-in, a neite kipiehbe ding a, ahi vangin bangma nei lote tung panin a neisun nangawn uh kilahpieh ding hi.","ref":"Mat 13:12; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18"},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate tungah kumpi sem dinga ei dei lo ka galte tawh kisai-in amate tam sungah hing peipi unlen, keima muna-ah amate that un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 25:14-30"},"28":{"text":"Ama in tam thu teng a gen zaw ciengin na mapei-in Jerusalem zuonin a peito hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Jesu Guolzawna tawh a Lutna (Mat 21:1-11 ; Mrk 11:1-11 ; Jhn 12:12-19)"},"29":{"text":"Olive a kici mun a om Bethphage le Bethany khuo a tun kuon ciengin ama in a nuazuite ni sawl a,"},"30":{"text":"“Na mai vua khuo ah pei unlen, khuo sung na lut ciengun koima’ tuon ngai nai lona laano khau-a kikhi khat na mu ding uhi. Hing sut unlen tanah hing kai ta un."},"31":{"text":"Mi khatpo in, ‘Bang dinga na sut uh ahei?,’ ci-a ang dawh uleh, ‘ Topa in tulmaw hi,’ ci-in dawng un,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci’n a mi sawlte pei-in a gen bangin a mu uhi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in laano khau a sut laitahun a neite in, “Bang dinga laano khau na sut uh ahei,” ci-in a dong uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in zong, “ Topa in tulmaw hi,” a ci uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu kungah laano a peipi uhi; tua laano tungah a puon uh a pha zaw ciengun Jesu a tuongsah uhi."},"36":{"text":"Laano tung tuongin lampi-ah Jesu a pei laitah in mite in lampi tungah a puonte a pha uhi."},"37":{"text":"Olive Muol panin kumsuhna mun a tun kuon ciengun, nuazui mihonpite in a mu ngaisa uh vanglietna nasep zosiete ziehin kipahtahin awging tawh Pasien phat ding a kipan vua,"},"38":{"text":"amate in, “ Topa’ min tawh ang pei kumpipa in thupha nga taheh! Vantungah kilemna om hinlen, a sang pen munah minthanna om taheh!” a ci uhi.","ref":"Late 118:26"},"39":{"text":"Mihonpite lahah Pharisee-te pawlkhat in Jesu kungah, “Siepa, na nuazuite khawlsah in,” a ci uhi."},"40":{"text":"Ama in, “Ke’n kang ci-in, tam mite ham lo-a a sip uleh suongte kiko ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"41":{"text":"Jerusalem a tun kuon, khuopi a mu ciengin ama in tua khuopi kaa a,","title":"Jerusalem ading Jesu Kap"},"42":{"text":"“Nang nangawnin tuni-in kilemna a piengsah theite thei lacin izaw! Ahi vangin tu-in na mu lo nadingun tuate kiselin a om hi."},"43":{"text":"Na kimkotah na galte in kul bawlin hing imtawmin, mun zosie panin ang bume ding hun ang tung ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Amate in nang le na kulpi sunga na tate tuoldenna-in ang nei ding vua, na sunga suong khat beh zong a kiciengsa-in a nuasie sih ding uhi; azieh pen note in Pasien kung pan ang kivilna hun na phawkhah lo zieh uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinnpi sungah Jesu lutin khum sunga om vanzuate a notmang hi.","title":"Jesu in Biehinnpi Siensuo (Mat 21:12-17 ; Mrk 11:15-19 ; Jhn 2:13-22)"},"46":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Ka inn in thungetna inn kici ding hi,” ci-in kigiel hi. Ahi vangin note in misuomte kibuhna phuolpi na suohsah ta uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 56:7; Jer 7:11"},"47":{"text":"Ama in nisielin biehinnpi sungah thu hil a, siempu liente, laihil siete le mipi makaite in tha dingin a sui den uhi.","ref":"Luk 21:37"},"48":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a thugente lunglut tahin a ngai ziehun bangma a law thei sih uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat, Jesu in biehinnpi sungah mite thuhilin lungdamna thu a gen laitahin siempu liente, thukham hil siete, le upate pei-in ama kungah,","title":"Jesu’ Thuneina Kidong (Mat 21:23-27 ; Mrk 11:27-33)"},"2":{"text":"“Bang thuneina tawh tamte na bawl ahei? Tami thuneina koi ang pieh ahei? Ei gen in,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Ke’n zong thu khat kang dong ding hi. Hing gen un:"},"4":{"text":"John’ ki-baptize na pen vantung pana ang pei amah, ahi sihle mihing tung pana ang kipan ahei?” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate khatlekhat kikumin, ‘Vantung pan hi,’ ci leih ama in, ‘Bang dinga ama na muon lo uh ahei?’ ei ci ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin, ‘Mihing kung pan ahi hi,’ ci lei lah John pen amate in kamsang khatin ngaisun uh ahi ziehin mi zosie in suong tawh ei seplia ding uhi,” a kici uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in hei sunga hing pei ahei ci ka thei sih uhi, ci-in a dawng uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Ke’n zong tamte bang thuneina tawh ka bawl ahei ci kang gen sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu in mipite kungah tami thugentena a gen hi: Mi khat in lengga lei khat bawl a, huonhlote kawmsahin gamdang khatah sawtveipi a zin hi.","title":"Lengga Lo le a Hlote Thugentena (Mat 21:33-46 ; Mrk 12:1-12)","ref":"Isa 5:1"},"10":{"text":"Lengga law hun a tun ciengin lengga lei pana pieng ama’ tanh ding teng a nga thei nadingin lohlote kungah nasem khat a sawl hi; ahi vangin lohlote in a nasempa na sat gawpin a khutguohin a peisah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in adang nasem khat sawl leuleu hi; amate in tuapa na sat gawpin a na zako vua, a khutguohin na peisah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a thumveina nasemte khat ma sawlkia leuleu hi; tuapa zong tua ma bangin liemsahin a notmang uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin lengga lei neipa in, “Bang law ding ka hei? Ka it ka tapa ka sawl ding hi; tua hile amate in na zatah kha sam ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin lohlote in ama a mu uh ciengin, “Tampa pen gamhluo ding pa ahi hi; a gamh teng i nga thei nadingin ama i that ding hi,” ci-in a kikup zaw ciengun,"},"15":{"text":"lengga lei pulamah notmangin a that uhi. Tua ahile lengga lei neipa in lohlote bang a law ta diei?"},"16":{"text":"Lengga lei neipa pei-in lengga huon lohlote that ding a, lo zong midangte a pie ding hi,” a ci hi. Amate in tam thu a zah ciengun, “Tam bangin pieng da taheh!” a ci uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate enin, “Tua ahile: “Innlamte’ nilkhiet suong pen innkiu suongpi a suoh zo hi,” ci-a a kigiel thu khu bang a cinopna adiei?","ref":"Late 118:22"},"18":{"text":"Tua suong tunga a pua mi poma guoicim ding a, tua suong in a khiehkhah poma a dengguoi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Jesu in tam thugentena a gen pen amate a cinopna ahi lam thukham hil siete le siempu liente in a thei uh ciengin, tua hun sung ma-in Jesu a man nuom vua, ahi vangin mipite a giing zel uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in gam-uhpa’ thuneina le vaihawmna sungah a ap thei nadingun, ama’ kam tawh ama thangsie dingin mihoi kipang thukante sawlin a endapsah uhi.","title":"Sieh Pieh ding Thudawhna (Mat 22:15-22 ; Mrk 12:13-17)"},"21":{"text":"Tua mite in, “Sie aw, na thugen le na thuhilte man mama a, mai-et tuom nei loin Pasien’ lampi mantahin na hil lam kang thei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Caesar kumpipa tungah sieh pieh ding pen thukham tawh a kituoh amah, a kituoh sih ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a ngian uh thei a, amate kungah,"},"24":{"text":"“Sum denarii khat ei lah un. Tami koi’ lim le koi’ min ahei,” a ci hi. Amate in, “Kumpipa’ lim le min ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Tua ahile kumpipa’ nate kumpipa tungah pie unlen, Pasien’ nate Pasien tungah pie un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in mipite mai-ah ama’ thugen tawh thangsie zo loin, a thudawnte zong lamdang a sa mama vua, ham lo phun loin a sip dide uhi."},"27":{"text":"Misite thawkiana om lo hi, a ci Sadducee-te pawlkhat ama kungah pei-in","title":"Thawkiana Thudawhna (Mat 22:23-33 ; Mrk 12:18-27)","ref":"Sawl 23:8"},"28":{"text":"thukhat a dong vua, “Sie aw, Moses in mi khat’ sanggampa in ta nei loin a zi a sisan leh, tua mipa in tua meigongnu kinunpi-in a sanggam pa adingin ta hinpieh ding hi, ci-in giel hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5"},"29":{"text":"Tu-in sanggam pasal sagi a om hi; a tapen pa in zi nei a, ta nei loin a si hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nina pa"},"31":{"text":"le a thumna pa in tua nu ma a kinunpi vua, tua ma bangin a sagi-un ta nei loin a si sieng uhi."},"32":{"text":"A tawpna ah tua nu zong a si hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin thawkia ni ciengin tua nu koi pen’ zi ahi diei? Azieh pen a sagi-un ama a kinunpi kim uhi,” a ci uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Tami khanghun a mite in mopi mohla-in a om uhi;"},"35":{"text":"ahi vangin sina panin thokia-in ang tung ding khang hun a mun nga dinga kilawm mite in mopi loin mo zong a hla sih ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"A tahtahin amate a si thei nawn sih ding uhi, azieh pen thawkiana’ tate ahi ziehun amate pen vantung mite le Pasien’ tate tawh kibang ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Misite a thawkiana thu pen Moses mama in theubawh tangthu sungah na lah a, tua sungah Abraham’ Pasien, Isaac’ Pasien, le Jacob’ Pasien, na ci hi.","ref":"Pei 3:6"},"38":{"text":"Tu-in ama pen misite’ Pasien hi loin a hingte’ Pasien ahi zaw hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham hil sie kimkhat in, “Sie aw, na thugen hoi mama hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"40":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in thu dangte a dong ngam nawn sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Bang dinga amate in Messiah pen David’ Tapa hi a ci thei uh ahei?","title":"David’ Suon tawh Kisai Thudawhna (Mat 22:41-46 ; Mrk 12:35-37)"},"42":{"text":"Azieh pen David mama in late sung ah, ‘ Topa in ka Topa tungah,"},"43":{"text":"na galte ka keng ngahna-a ka bawl masangin ka zietlamah to in,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 110:1"},"44":{"text":"Tua bangin David in ama pen Topa na ci hi; tuaci’n ama, a tapa bangci hi thei ding ahei,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Mi zosie’ zahin Jesu in a nuazuite kungah,","title":"Jesu in Thukham Hil Siete Mawsah (Mat 23:1-36 ; Mrk 12:38-40 ; Luk 11:37-54)"},"46":{"text":"“Thukham hil siete na kidawm un. Puontuol silin amate a vah kawikawi nuom vua, vanzuana mun lah po-ah zatah hopi ding dei-in, kikhopna inn sungah tona thupi pente-ah a to nuom se vua, pawi bawlna munte-ah zong uliente tona-ah a to nuom na lai uhi."},"47":{"text":"Amate in meigongte’ inn a valtum vua, a kilimlawm dingin thu a sawt nget giap uhi. Amate in mawsah thukhenna a lienzaw a thuoh ding uhi,” a ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu a khuodah leh mihaute in sumpi kuong sunga a sumpi khieh uh a mu a,","title":"Meigongnu Sumpi (Mrk 12:41-44)"},"2":{"text":"mizawng meigongnu khat in zong dangka san tang ni a khieh a mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, tami mizawng meigongnu in amate zosie sangin a tam khiehzaw hi;"},"4":{"text":"azieh pen amate zosie in a hauna uh panin a khieh uh ahi a, ahi vangin tua nu in a zawn kawmkal panin a kiva nading a neisun teng a khie sieng hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in biehinnpi pen suong hoi mamate tawh a kizep dan le Pasien tungah letsongte a kipieh dan teng a gen ciengun Jesu in,","title":"Biehinnpi Siet ding Kimagen (Mat 24:1-2 ; Mrk 13:1-2)"},"6":{"text":"“Na mu uh tami nate tawh kisai-in suong khat tungah adang suong khat beh kithuop loin a kicipzan hun ang tung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in, “Siepa, tam thute bang cih ciengin ang pieng ding a, tam thute ang pien kuon ciengin bang limte ang om ding ahei? ci-in a dong uhi.","title":"Lim le Bawlsietnate (Mat 24:3-14 ; Mrk 13:3-13)"},"8":{"text":"Jesu in, “Koima in ang puimang lo nadingun kidawm un; azieh pen keima’ min suongin mi tampi ang pei ding a, “Kei, ama ka hi hi! ‘A hun ang nai ta hi!’ ang ci ding uhi. Tua bang mite na zui sih un."},"9":{"text":"Gal kikapnate le kumpi ledona thute na zah ciengun zau sih un; azieh pen tam thute ang pieng masa ding ma ahi a, ahi vangin hun tawpna in ang zui pai nai sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Minam khat le minam khat, gam khat le gam khat ang kido ding hi;"},"11":{"text":"zil nahpi-in ang ling ding a, mun tuomtuom ah kielpi le pul natna ang tung ding hi; tuale van tung panin dipkuotna le lim lamdangte ang pieng ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ahi vangin tam thute ang tun masangin keima’ min ziehin amate in note hing manin ang bawlsie ding uhi; amate in kikhopna innte le thong sungah ang ap ding vua, keima’ min ziehin kumpite le gam-uhte mai-ah ang kipeipi ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tami in na teci pan nading uh hun lemtang ang pie ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in na lungsim sung vuah na kihut nading uh ngaisun masa sih un;"},"15":{"text":"azieh pen keima in na langte uh koima khat beh in nielin ang nan zo lo nadingun gen ding thute le pilna kang pie ding hi.","ref":"Luk 12:11-12"},"16":{"text":"Na nu na pate, na sanggamte, na hieng nasante ule na lawm na guolte nangawn un zong ang khie ding vua, pawlkhat in thana na thuoh ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Keima’ min ziehin mi zosie in ang muda ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin na samzam uh khat zong a mangthai sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Note in thuohzawhna tawh na hinna uh na hu zo ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Galkapte in Jerusalem khuopi a kui-im na mu uh ciengin tua khuopi a kisuhsiet nading ang nai zo hi, ci-in thei ta un.","title":"Jerusalem Siet ding Kimagen (Mat 24:3-14 ; Mrk 13:3-13)"},"21":{"text":"Tua hun ciengin Judea gam a omte muol tungah tai-in, khuopi sunga omte in khuopi nuasie-in, gam sunga omte in khuopi sung lut nawn sih uheh."},"22":{"text":"Bang zieh ahei cile tua hun pen a kigielsa thu zosie a tangtun nadinga phulah ni ahi hi.","ref":"Hos 9:7"},"23":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin naupaite le nausen nawi tepsah laite in gimna a thuoh ding uhi! Azieh pen leitungah gimna lienpi tung ding a, tam mite tungah lungthahna a tung ding hi;"},"24":{"text":"namsau tawh a si ding vua, minam zosiete lahah salin amate kikai ding hi; Gentile-te’ hun a tun masangsie, Gentile-te in Jerusalem khuopi a tuoncil ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Ni, hla le aasite tungah limte ang om ding a, tuipi le tuihuol gingte ziehin leitung minamte lahah hamsatna le buoina a om ding hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa ang Peina (Mat 24:29-31 ; Mrk 12:24-27)","ref":"Isa 13:10; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:31; Kln 6:12-13"},"26":{"text":"Leitunga ang pieng ding thute a ngaisutna ziehun mite zau-in sibup ding uhi, azieh pen vantunga om nate kiling ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Mihing Tapa in vanglietna le minthanna sang pen tawh meiilum lahah ang pei amate in a mu ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Kln 1:7"},"28":{"text":"Tu-in tam thute a pien ding ang kipat ciengin na kitatkhiet ding uh a hun ang nai ta ahi ziehin na lu uh phongin khuodah un,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in thugentena khat a gen hi: “Theikung le singkung zosie en un;","title":"Theikung Tawh Thuhilna (Mat 24:32-35 ; Mrk 13:28-31)"},"30":{"text":"a nate ang dawn ciengin khuokhal hun ang nai zo ta hi, ci-in na thei uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ma bangin tam thute ang pien na mu ciengun Pasien’ manggam ang nai ta hi, ci-in thei ta un."},"32":{"text":"Ke’n a tahtah a kang ci-in, tam thute zosie ang tun masangsie tami khang mite a mangthai sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Vanpi le leipi mangthai zong nanle ka thute mangthai lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Na pilvang bo un, na lungsim uh lalthangin zukhamna le hinkhuo ading lunghimawna in ang thazaw gawp ding a, na muonmaw lo laitahun thang kisai bangin note tungah tua ni ang tung ding hi.","title":"Vil ding Hanthawnna","merge":"35"},"36":{"text":"Ang tung ding tam thute zosie panin na suotah thei nadingun thahatna na nei nading ule Mihing Tapa mai-ah na din thei nadingun a tawntungin thu ngenin na pilvang un,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in biehinnpi sungah nisielin thu hil a, zan ciengin Olive muolah a gieh dingin a pei hi.","ref":"Luk 19:47"},"38":{"text":"Biehinnpi sunga a thuhilna ngai dingin zingmawngin mi zosie a thobai uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Peisan Pawi a kici Tolsawlo Anlum Pawi hun a nai ta hi.","title":"Jesu Tha a Kisawmna (Mat 26:1-5 , 14-16 ; Mrk 14:1-2 , 10-11 ; Jhn 11:45-57)","ref":"Pei 12:1-27"},"2":{"text":"Siempu liente le thukham hil siete in mihonpi a giin ziehun Jesu tha thei nading lampi a suidap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin sawm le nite lahah khat ahi Judas Iscariot kici pa sungah Satan a lut hi;"},"4":{"text":"ama pei-in siempu liente le biehinncing palihbute tawh Jesu leheh dan ding a kikum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate a nuom mama vua, sum pieh dingin a kithukim uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judas Iscariot zong thukim a, mipite’ op lo kalin amau’ khut sungah Jesu leheh thei nading hun lemtang a sui hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peisan tuuno tawh biehpiehna kibawl ni ahi Tolsawlo Anlum Pawi a tung hi.","title":"Peisan Pawi Ankuong Siemna (Mat 26:17-25 ; Mrk 14:12-21 ; Jhn 13:21-30)"},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu in Peter le John sawlin, “Pei ta unlen i neh ding Peisan Pawi ankuong va bawl ta un,” ci-in a gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama gel in, “Hei sungah va bawl ta gel leng na dei ei? ci-in ama a dong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Ngai gel in,” a ci a, “Khuopi sung na lut cieng gelin tui beel a tui puo pasal khat tawh na kituoh ding uhi; ama lutna inn ah ama zui gel inlen"},"11":{"text":"innteh pa kungah, ‘Siepa in ka nuazuite tawh Peisan Pawi an ka neh nading uh zin tunna innkhan hei sung ahei, ei dongsah hi,’ va ci ta un,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a kipuosa innkhan tungnung pen a khan gol khat ang lah ding hi. Eite adingin tua munah na bawl khol gel in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate pei-in a kung vua a gen bangin a mu mintah vua, tua munah Peisan Pawi an neh ding a siemkhol gel hi."},"14":{"text":"A hun a tun ciengin sawltahpite tawh sabuoi-ah Jesu a toton hi.","title":"Vumkhawl An Pienna (Mat 26:26-30 ; Mrk 14:22-26 ; 1Cor 11:23-26)"},"15":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Gimna ka thuoh masangin note tawh tami Peisan Pawi an nehton ding ka lunggul mama hi;"},"16":{"text":"azieh pen ke’n kang ci-in, Pasien’ manggam sungah tam thu a tangtun masangsie-in ka ne nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in hai la-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin, “Tami hai la unlen, note lahah hawm un;"},"18":{"text":"azieh pen ke’n kang ci-in, Pasien’ manggam ang tun masangsie tu-a kipanin lenggazu ka dawn nawn sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin khomun zong la-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin balkehin, “Tami in note dinga ang kipie ka pumpi ahi hi. Kei nei phaw nadingun tam bangin bawl un,” ci-in amate a pie hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ma bangin nitah an a neh zaw ciengun hai zong la-in, “Tami hai in note dinga ang luongkhie ka sisan tawh a kikipsah thuciemna tha ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31-34"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin en un, keima ei leheh pa’ khut in sabuoi tungah keima tawh a om hi.","ref":"Late 41:9"},"22":{"text":"A kisesa bangin Mihing Tapa pei ding a, ahi vangin ama a leheh pa in gimna a thuoh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin tam banga gamta ding koi pen hi ding ahei, ci-in khatlekhat a kidong uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amate lahah koi lienpen ding ahei, ci-in a nuazuite khatlekhat a kisel uhi.","title":"Koi Lienpen Ci Kiselna","ref":"Mat 18:1; Mrk 9:34; Luk 9:46"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah, “ Gentile kumpite in amate tungah uhna aana zang uhi; tuale amate tunga thunei mite pen thupha bawlte kici hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin no tua bang na hi sih ding uhi; note lahah a lienpen pa a neupen pa bangin om zaw ding a, makai pa nasem bangin om ding hi.","ref":"Mat 23:11; Mrk 9:35; Mat 20:25-27; Mrk 10:42-44"},"27":{"text":"Sabuoi tunga a to pa le an piepa koi lienzaw ahei? Sabuoi tunga a to pa ahi sih amah? Ahi vangin kei pen note lahah anpie pa bang ka hi hi.","ref":"Jhn 13:12-15"},"28":{"text":"Note pen gimna ka thuoh sunga ei thuohpite na hi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ka pa in keima tungah gam ei pieh ma bangin,"},"30":{"text":"tuaci’n note in zong ka gam sunga ka sabuoi-ah anne tuidawnin na om thei nading ule thukhenna topha tungah to-in Israel minam sawm le nite tungah thu na khen thei nading uh ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 19:28"},"31":{"text":"“Simon, Simon aw, ngai vawi! Satan in buhum zoi banga ang zoi thei nadingin ang ngen zo hi.","title":"Jesu in Peter Niel ding Magen (Mat 26:31-35 ; Mrk 14:27-31 ; Jhn 13:36-38)"},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin na upna na hlasuo lo nadingin thu kang ngetpieh zo hi; nang kiheikia ciengin na sanggamte na thakhausah in,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuale Simon in, “ Topa aw, thong le sina-ah nangma tawh peiton dingin a kigingsa-in ka om hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in, “Peter aw, ke’n kang ci-in, ‘Ama ka thei kha sih hi,’ ci-in tuni-in thumvei nei niel masangsie aah khuong lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Sum ip, thung-ip le khedapte keng lo-a kang sawl lai-in tasapna na nei uh amah? a ci hi. Amate in, “Bangma tasapna ka nei sih uhi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Sum-ip, Thung-ip le Namsau","ref":"Mat 10:9-10; Mrk 6:8-9; Luk 9:3; 10:4"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Ahi vangin tu-in sum-ip nei pa in keng hinlen, tua ma bangin thung-ip nei pa in zong keng heh. Namsau nei lo pa in a puon-ah zua-in lei heh."},"37":{"text":"Azieh pen ke’n kang ci-in, “Thukham palsatte lahah ama kisimtha hi,” ci-a a kigiel tami Lai Siengtho kei tungah ang tung valon ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 53:12"},"38":{"text":"Amate in, “ Topa aw, en in, tam sungah namsau ni a om hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Tua ahile pha zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Jesu a pei ngai bangin Olive Muol tungah pei a, a nuazuite in ama a zui uhi.","title":"Jesu in Olive Muolah Thu Ngen (Mat 26:36-46 ; Mrk 14:32-42)"},"40":{"text":"Khum munah ama a tun ciengin amate kungah, “Solna na thuoh lo nadingun thu ngen un,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kung panin suongse khat tan bang nuakin a, tuale khupdinin thu ngen a,"},"42":{"text":"“Pa aw, na deina a op leh keima kung panin tami hai hemkhie ta’n; hizongle keima’ dei bang hi sih hinlen nangma’ dei bang hi taheh,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"(Tua ciengin vantung panin ama kungah vantungmi khat kilang a, ama a thakhausah hi."},"44":{"text":"A lunggim ziehin ama in nahpi-in thu ngen a, a khuosa sisan mal golpi bangin lei-ah a taa hi.)"},"45":{"text":"A thungetna panin ama a dinto ciengin a nuazuite kungah a pei leh amate da luo kisa-in a kimut laitah uh a tuohkha hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in amate kungah, “Bang dinga kimu na hi uh ahei? Tho unlen solna na thuoh lo nadingun thu ngen un,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Ama in thu a gen laitahin sawm le nite lahah khat ahi Judas a kici mipa makai-in mihonpite a tung uhi. Ama in Jesu nam dingin a a kung a neh hi;","title":"Jesu Kilehehna le a Kimatna (Mat 26:47-56 ; Mrk 14:43-50 ; Jhn 18:1-11)"},"48":{"text":"ahi vangin Jesu in, “Judas aw, nang in khatvei napna tawh Mihing Tapa leheh ding na hi amah?” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"A kima om mite in a thupieng ding teng a mu ciengun Jesu kungah, “ Topa aw, namsau tawh ka sat ta ding vuoi mah? ci-in a dong uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate lahah khat in siempu lien pa’ sila khat a sat leh a zietlam bil a bantan hi."},"51":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in, “Tam kan bawl nawn sih un!” ci-in a bil thampiehin a damsah hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama man dinga a kuon siempu liente, biehinncing palihbute, le upate kungah, “Misuom khat a man ding bangin kei ei man dingin namsau le phohbul tawh ang kuon na hi uh amah?"},"53":{"text":"Biehinnpi sungah note tawh nisielin ka opton lai-in lah ka tungah khut na nga sih uhi. Ahi vangin tam pen na hun uh ahi a, khuomiel thunei hun ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 19:47; 21:37"},"54":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Jesu manin siempupa inn ah a peipi uhi. Ahi vangin Peter in a kihalin a zui hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu Niel (Mat 26:57-75 ; Mrk 14:53-72 ; Jhn 18:15-18 , 25-27)"},"55":{"text":"Leituol laikim ah meitaw-in amate a toton laitahun Peter zong amate lahah a to hi."},"56":{"text":"Tua ciengin nasem numei no khat in mei gei-a a to Peter a mu bepin encienin ama kungah, “Tampa zong ama tawh kigop khat ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama kilepin, “Numei aw, ama ka thei kha sih hi,” ci-in a niel hi."},"58":{"text":"Bakhat zaw ciengin midang khat in mu leuleu a, “Nang zong amate lahah khat hi ngel veteh aw,” a ci hi. Ahi vangin Peter in, “Hi sih veng aw, nang pa,” a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Tua ciengin nai khat bang a sawt ciengin midang khat ma in ama kungah, “Tam pa zong Jesu tawh kigop tahtah ahi hi; azieh pen ama Galilee mi khat ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter in, “Nang pa, na gen thu thei kha vawt sing!” a ci hi. Tua hun laitahin thakhatin aah a khuong hi."},"61":{"text":"Topa zong kihei-in Peter a en hi. Tua ciengin Peter in, “Tu ni aah khuon masangin thumvei nei niel ding hi,” ci-a Topa gensa thu a phawh hi."},"62":{"text":"Peter zong pusuohin nahpi tahin a kap hi."},"63":{"text":"Tu-in Jesu a mante in zako le vuoh a kipan uhi;","title":"Jesu Kisimmawna le Kivuohna (Mat 26:67-68 ; Mrk 14:65)"},"64":{"text":"puon tawh a mit a tuompieh zaw ciengun, “Ang sat koi ahiei? Gen vawi,” ci-in a dong mielmuol uhi."},"65":{"text":"Amate in ama tungah zakona kam tampi a zang uhi."},"66":{"text":"Khuo a vah ciengin tangpi upa vaihawmte, siempu liente le thukham hil siete kikhawmin thukhen uliente mai-ah Jesu a peipi uhi.","title":"Uliente Mai-ah Jesu (Mat 26:59-66 ; Mrk 14:55-64 ; Jhn 18:19-24)"},"67":{"text":"Amate in, “Nang Messiah na hi leh ei gen in,” a ci uhi. Ama in, “Ke’n hing gen leng note in na um sih ding uhi;"},"68":{"text":"hing dong leng zong nei dawng sih ding uhi."},"69":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-a kipanin Pasien’ vanglietna zietlamah Mihing Tapa a to ding hi,” a ci hi."},"70":{"text":"Amate zosie in, “Tua ahile nang Pasien’ Tapa na hiei mah? ci-in a dong uhi. Ama in amate kungah, “Na ci bangun ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"71":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un, “Adang teci bang kisam lai ahei? Ama kam tehteh panin i za zo ta uhi!” a ci uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kikhawm mipite dingin Pilat kungah Jesu a peipi uhi.","title":"Pilat Mai-ah Jesu (Mat 27:1-2 , 11-14 ; Mrk 15:1-5 ; Jhn 18:28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Amate in ama mawsah a kipan vua, “Tampa pen ka mipite lampielsah pa khatin ka mu vua, ama le ama Messiah ahi kumpi khat ka hi hi, a kici a, Caesar kumpipa tunga sieh ka pieh ding uh ei khah hi,” a ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in ama kungah, “Nang Judah-te’ kumpipa na hi amah? ci-in a dong hi. Ama in, “Na ci bangin ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in, “Tampa tungah khielna bangma ka mu sih hi,” ci-in siempu liente le mipite tungah a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a hanaw tasem vua, “Ama in a thuhilna tawh Judea gam sunga om mipite a tawhnawi a, Galilee pana kipanin tam mun dong cieng nangawn ang tung hi,” a ci tentun uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pilat in tam thu a zah ciengin tam pa Galilee mi amah, ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Jesu, Herod Mai-ah"},"7":{"text":"Herod uhna gam sunga om ahi lam ama a kithei bepin, tua laitahin Herod zong Jerusalem-a om ahi ziehin ama kungah a peisah hi."},"8":{"text":"Herod in Jesu a mu ciengin, a mu nopzaw sawt ta ahi ziehin a lungdam mama hi, azieh pen ama’ thu a zah ngaisa ahi a, a na lamdang bawlte khatpo zong a mu dingin a kilamen hi."},"9":{"text":"Herod in thu tampi dong a, ahi vangin Jesu in kam khat beh dawng lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Siempu liente le thukham hil siete ding to-in, nahpitahin Jesu a mawsah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Herod le a galkapte in simmaw bawlin a ko gawp vua, puontuol hoi mama khat a silsah zaw ciengun Pilat kungah a puohkia uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khum ni-a kipanin Herod le Pilat khatlekhat a kilawmta uhi; tua masangin ama ni pen kimuda-in a kigalbawl den uh ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in siempu liente, makaite le mipite hlanin","title":"Jesu Tha dingin Thu Kikhen (Mat 27:15-26 ; Mrk 15:6-15 ; Jhn 18:39–19:16)"},"14":{"text":"amate kungah, “Note in tam mipa pen mipite a pui khiel khat bangin ka kungah nang peipi uh; na mai vuah ama ka sittel ciengin na mawmatna uh thute khat behah a mawna ka mu sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Herod in zong a mu tuon lo ziehin eite kunga ang puohkia ahi hi. A tahtahin ama in si nading za dongin bangma a bawl sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama satin ka hla ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Pilat in pawi hun sielin amau’ dei thongkie khat a hla ding thu a om mal ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kiko-in, “Tampa that in! Barabbas ei hlapieh in!” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"(Tampa pen khuopi sunga buoina a bawl zieh le mi a tha zieha thongkie ahi hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Pilat in Jesu a hla nuom ziehin amate kungah khatvei thu genkia a,"},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin amate in, “Singlamte tungah ama that in, khailia in!” ci-in a awng teitei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate kungah a thumveina thu gen a, “Ama in bang sietna a bawl zieha ka khailia ding ahei? Sina ding za-in khielna ama sungah ka mu sih hi; tua ahi ziehin ama satin, tua zaw ciengin ka hla ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin nahpi tahin amate a kiko vua, ama a kikhailia nading a kal teitei ciengun amau’ kikona in a zozaw ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pilat in a ngetna uh banga pieh dingin thu a khen hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in amau’ nget ahi kumpi langpanna le mi thana zieha thongkia pa hla a, amau’ dei banga a bawl dingun Jesu a pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in ama a peikhietpi laitahun khuota pana ang pei Cyrene khuomi, Simon a kici pa khat a man vua, tuale singlamte patin Jesu’ nua lamah a puosah uhi.","title":"Jesu, Singlamte Tunga a Kikhaina (Mat 27:32-44 ; Mrk 15:21-32 ; Jhn 19:17-27)"},"27":{"text":"Mihon tampi in ama a zui vua, tuate lahah a awm uh bengin ama a kaa numei pawlkhat zong kihal hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu kinua hei-in amate kungah, “Jerusalem tanute aw, kei adingin kap sih unlen, noma ading le na tate adingin kapzaw un."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in, ‘A ciing, ta nei ngai lo naubu, le nausen in a tep ngai lo nawite hampha mama hi,’ a ci ding uh nite ang tung valon ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua hun ciengin amate in muol sangte kungah, ‘Ka tung vuah hing cim ta un,’ a ci ding vua, muoltangte kungah, ‘Ei vuacip ta un,’ a ci ding uhi.","ref":"Hos 10:8; Kln 6:16"},"31":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in singhing bawn hici bawl uh ahileh a gaw ciengin bang a law ta bep ding vuoi?” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Migi lo ahi adang mi ni zong Jesu tawh thaton dingin a peipi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Lugu a kicina munah a tun ciengun amate in khum sungah Jesu a khailia vua, migi lo ni tegel zong a zietlamah khat, a veilamah khat a khailia uhi. ("},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Pa aw, amate in bang bawl ci thei lo uh ahi ziehin a mawna uh na maisah in,” a ci hi.) Tuale amate in lai-ai sanin a puonte a hawm uhi.","ref":"Late 22:18"},"35":{"text":"Mipite dingin a en uhi; ahi vangin upate in a zako vua, “Ama in midangte hundam hi; Pasien’ Messiah le a teel pa tahtah ahile ama le ama kihundam taheh!” a ci uhi.","ref":"Late 22:7"},"36":{"text":"Galkapte in zong ama zako-in lengga tuithua a pie vua,"},"37":{"text":"“Judah-te’ Kumpipa na hi leh nang le nang kihun in!” a ci uhi."},"38":{"text":"A lutung son tahah, “Tampa Judah-te’ Kumpipa ahi hi,” ci-a kigiel lai khat kisuong hi."},"39":{"text":"Khum sunga a kikhai migilote lahah khat in, “Nang Messiah hi lo na mah? Nangma kihun inlen, ko zong ei hun in,” ci-in ama a simmaw ho hi.","title":"A Kisia Guta Pa"},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin adang khat in, “Ama tawh kibanga mawna thukhenna thuoh hi napi cin, Pasien na giing sih amah?"},"41":{"text":"Ei gel pen a man banga thu ei kikhen ahi a, i gamtatna tawh kituoha thaman nga i hi hi, ahi vangin tampa in khielna bangma bawl lo hi,” ci-in a phawhsie hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Jesu aw, na kumpi gam sunga nang pei ciengin kei ei mangngil sin,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Jesu in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, tuni-in keima tawh Paradise ah i omton ding hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua hunlaitah pen sunkim pawl hi a, nitah nai thum dongin gam buppi ah khuo a miel hi.","title":"Jesu Sina (Mat 27:45-56 ; Mrk 15:33-41 ; Jhn 19:28-30)"},"45":{"text":"Tua hun sungin khimzing a, biehinnpi dalna puon phal ni kisuo hi.","ref":"Pei 26:31-33"},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Pa aw, na khut sungah ka hlagau kang ap ta hi,” ci-in a aw neiza tawh a kiko hi. Tua bang a ci zaw ciengin a hu tawpna a sang hi.","ref":"Late 31:5"},"47":{"text":"Galkapmangpa in thupieng teng a mu ciengin Pasien’ min phatin, “Tam pa pen mawnei lo tahtah khat ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tam thute en dingin a kikhawm mipite in thupieng teng a mu ciengun awmbengsa-in inn ah a kilekia uhi."},"49":{"text":"Ahi vangin a melthei zosie le Galilee gam pana a zui numeite ding to-in thupieng teng a gal-et uhi.","ref":"Luk 8:2-3"},"50":{"text":"Khumin Joseph kici mi hoi le mi thuman khat om a, vaihawm upa khat ahi vangin,","title":"Jesu a Kivuina (Mat 27:57-61 ; Mrk 15:42-47 ; Jhn 19:38-42)"},"51":{"text":"vaihawm upate’ deina le a sil bawlte uh a thukimpi sih hi. Ama pen Jew mite’ khuo Arimathea pana ang pei ahi a, Pasien’ manggam lawptaha a ngah den mi khat ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Pilat kungah ama pei-in Jesu luong a ngen hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in a luong a khiesuh a, taangciin puon tawh tunin koima’ kivui ngai nai lona suong kilemsa han khatah a siel hi."},"54":{"text":"Khum ni pen kigin ni ahi a, sabbath kipan ding ahi ta hi."},"55":{"text":"Galilee panin a zawpi numeite in zong a zui vua, amate in han le a luong bangci kivui ci a mu uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kinuale kia-in panamtui le sathaute a baisa-in a koi uhi. Thukham dung zui-in sabbath ni-in amate a toi-om uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:10; Thkna 5:14"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipi kal khat sunga ni masa pen ni, zingmawng phal vah tungin amate in a bawlsa uh panamtuite tawi-in hanah a pei uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Thawkiana (Mat 28:1-10 ; Mrk 16:1-8 ; Jhn 20:1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Han a tun ciengun hankhuh sinna suongtumpi a kilia-a om a mu vua,"},"3":{"text":"ahi vangin a sungah a lut ciengun ama’ luong a mu sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tami thu ah lungmangin a op laitahun, a gei vuah puon telihleh a sil pasal ni thakhatin a ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Numeite zau-in tuolah a kunsuh vua, ahi vangin tua pasalte in, “Bang dingin misite lahah mihing sui na hi uh ahei? Ama tanah om lo hi, thokia zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Galilee gamah ama a op lai-in na kung vua ang gensa thute phawh un."},"7":{"text":"Mawnei mite’ khut sungah Mihing Tapa kipie ding a, singlamte tungah kikhai-in a ni thum ni-in thokia ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 16:21; 17:22-23; 20:18-19; Mrk 8:31; 9:31; 10:33-34; Luk 9:22; 18:31-33"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in a thugensa a phawhkia vua,"},"9":{"text":"tuale han panin amate a kilekia ciengun sawm le khatte le midang zosie kungah tam thu teng a unpi-in a gen sieng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Sawltahpite kungah tami thu a gen teng pen, Mary Magdalene, Joanna, James’ nu Mary, le amate tawh a omton numei dangte ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin thu kigente amate in tangmi bangin ngaisunin a tahsang sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter dingto-in han lamah tai a, tuale ama kunin han sung a en leh a kitunna taangciin beh a mu uhi; tua ciengin ama in thupieng teng lamdangsa-in inn lam a zuonkia hi."},"13":{"text":"Khum ni ma-in amate lahah Jerusalem panin tai sagi bang a gamla Emmaus kici khuo khat zuonin mi ni a pei vua,","title":"Emmaus Khuo Peina (Mrk 16:12-13)"},"14":{"text":"tuale a pei kawmun a thupiengsa thute khatlekhat a kiholim gel hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua banga holimin a kikup laitahun Jesu mama in va nehin ama gel tawh a zawhton hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama gel in Jesu ahi lam a thei lo nadingin a mit gel a kisinpieh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuale Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Na lampei kawm vua na kikup uh bang thu ahiei?” ci-in dong hi. Ama gel zong dinkhawlin a da tuoh mama gel hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama gel lahah Cleopas a kici pa in, “Jerusalem khuo-a a hawte lahah tu sawng tengin tua sunga thupieng a thei lo nang beh hi mal vateh” ci-in a dawng hi."},"19":{"text":"Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Bang thu ahei?” ci-in a dong hi. Ama gel in, “Nazareth mi Jesu tunga thupieng ahi a, nasepna le thugenna ah Pasien’ mai le mi zosie’ mai-ah a vangnei mama kamsang khat zong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Sina thukhenna a thuoh dingin ka siempu liente ule ka ulien vaihawmte un ama pie-in singlamte tungah kikhailia hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin kote in ama pen Israel tankhie ding pa hi, ci-in ka lamen uhi. Hi hi, tam teng zosie banah tam thu teng a pien zaw tu-in a ni thumna ahi ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Thamlo-in ko pawl sung panin numei pawlkhat in lamdang ei sasah mama uhi. Zingmawng khuovah behin hanah amate a va haw ta vua,"},"23":{"text":"khum sungah a luong a mu lo ciengun amate ang kilekia-in ama hingkia zo hi, ci-in a gen vantungmite’ kilahna a mu tahtahna uh kote tungah ang gen uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ka pawlte uh pawlkhat zong hanah a va pei ta vua, numeite gen bang lienin a om a mu uhi. Ahi vangin Jesu a mu sih uhi,” a ci gel hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama gel kungah, “Kamsangte thugen a tahsang thei lote le mimawte aw!"},"26":{"text":"A minthanna ah ama a lut thei nadingin Messiah in tam teng a thuoh ding a kisam ma hi lo amah?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in Moses le kamsang zosie tawh thu pan a, ama tawh kisai Lai Siengtho sunga kigen zosie ama gel kungah a hilcien hi."},"28":{"text":"A pei nading uh khuo a tun kuon ciengun Jesu a peisuoh dingin a kisa hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama gel in nahpi-in a hlo vua, “Ko gel kungah hing gieh ta’n. Nitah lam ahi ziehin khuo zong a miel kuon ta hi,” a ci gel hi. Tuaci’n Jesu zong ama gel kunga gieh dingin inn sungah a lut hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama gel tawh sabuoi-ah a to ciengun ama in khomun la a, lungdam a ko zaw ciengin phalsuo-in ama gel a pie hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin a mit gel kihongin Jesu ahi lam a theisiem uhi; tuale ama gel’ muna panin ama a mang ta hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama gel in, “Lampi-ah ei holimpi lai-a, Lai Siengtho ei hilcien lai-in zong i lungsim ei sukha tamal hi lo amah?” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"33":{"text":"Khum hun ma-in, ama gel ding dawhin Jerusalem ah a kilekia ta uhi; tuale a kikhawmton sawm le khatte le a pawlte a mu uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ama gel in, “ Topa thokia tahtah zo a, Simon kungah kilah zo hi,” a ci uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin lampi-a thupieng teng le khomun a phalsuo lai-a ama gel tungah ama a na kihilna dan teng a gen uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tam thute a gen laitahun amate lahah Jesu ding a, “Note tungah kilemna om taheh,” a ci hi.","title":"A Nuazuite Kungah Jesu Kilaa (Mat 28:16-20 ; Mrk 16:14-18 ; Jhn 20:19-23 ; Sawl 1:6-8)"},"37":{"text":"Sihla mu kisa uh ahi ziehin amate zau-in a ling uhi."},"38":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Bang ziehin zau-in, bang ziehin ei umla na hi uh ahei?"},"39":{"text":"Ka khut le ka kengte en un; keima ka hi lam thei un. Ei tham unlen thei un; azieh pen sihla in kei nei bangin tahsa guletang nei lo hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama in tam thu a genzaw ciengin a khut le a keng a lah leuleu hi."},"41":{"text":"Lungdam kipahin lamdangsa-in a up thei nai vaset lo laitahun Jesu in amate kungh, “Tam sungah neh ding khatpo na nei vuoi mah?” ci-in dong hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in nga kihanggawsa khat a pie vua,"},"43":{"text":"ama in tua khu la-in a muna vuah a ne hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Note tawh ka opton lai-a na kung vua kang gen, Moses’ thukham laibu sung, kamsangte laibu sung, le late laibu sunga kigiel keima’ thu zosie ang tangtung valon ding hi, ka ci pen tami thu ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Lai Siengtho thu a thei nadingun a lungsim uh honpiehin amate kungah,"},"46":{"text":"“Tua banga a kigiel ma bangin Messiah in sina thuohin a ni thum ni-in misite lah panin thokia ding a,"},"47":{"text":"Jerusalem-a kipan minam zosie kungah ama’ min tawh kisiakiana le mawmaina thu kihil ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Note zong tam thu-ah teci na hi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tuale en un, ka Pa in ei khapsa thu na kung vuah kang sawl ding hi; tuaci’n a sangna panin vanglietna ang kisilsah masangin tami khuopi sungah na om tadi un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:4"},"50":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in Bethany khuo dongin amate zawpi a, tuale ama in a khut lamto-in amate thupha a pie hi.","title":"Jesu’ Vankana (Mrk 16:19-20 ; Sawl 1:9-11)"},"51":{"text":"Thupha a pieh laitahin amate kung panin ama kihem dawhin vantungah a kilato ta hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:9-11"},"52":{"text":"Amate in ama bie-in lungdamna lienpi tawh Jerusalem ah a kilekia uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tuale biehinnpi ah amate pei-in Pasien min a phat zing uhi."}}}}},"43":{"info":{"name":"John","shortname":"Jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John giel lungdamna thu (the gospel according to john)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kipat cilin Thu na om a, tua Thu khu Pasien tawh na omton a, tua Thu, Pasien ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama pen a cil a kipanin Pasien tawh na omton hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama tungtawnin na zosie pieng a, ama lo tawh a kipiengsah na khat beh om lo hi. A kipiengsah na zosie in"},"4":{"text":"ama sungah hinna a nei vua, tua hinna khu mihingte’ khuovah ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Khuomiel lahah tua khuovah tang a, khuomiel in tua khuovah a zo zo sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien kung panin ang kisawl mi khat om a, a min John ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 3:1; Mrk 1:4; Luk 3:1-2"},"7":{"text":"Ama tungtawnin mi zosie in a up nadingin tua khuovah thu teci pang dinga ang pei ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amama pen khuovah ahi sih a, tua khuovah thu teci pang dinga ang pei hizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Mikim tunga ang tang ahi tua khuovah tahtah pen leitungah ang pei zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama leitungah om a, ama tungtawnin leitung kipiengsah hi; hizongle leitung in ama a thei kha sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama-a’ ahite kungah ama pei a, hinanle ama’ mite in ama na sang lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama sangin ama’ min a um zosiete tungah Pasien’ tate suo thei nading thuneina a pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banga a suoh mite pen silesa-a pieng hi loin mihing’ deidan banga pieng zong ahi sih a, Pasien’ deidan banga a pieng hizaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuale thu in mihing bangin pieng a, hepina le thuman thutah tawh kidimin eite lahah om a, Pa in a neisun Tapa khat’ minthanna bangin ama’ minthanna i mu zo ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"(Ama tawh kisai John in teci pang a, “Tampa pen kang gen mipa ahi a, ‘Ka nua-a ang pei ahi vangin kei masanga na om zo ahi ziehin kei sangin ama a lienzaw hi,’ ci-in a kiko hi,” a ci hi.)"},"16":{"text":"Ama’ kicinna panin eite in hepina thupha khatzaw khat i nga uhi."},"17":{"text":"Moses tungtawnin thukham na kipie hi; Jesu Khris tungtawnin hepina le thuman thutah ang pei hi."},"18":{"text":"Koima in Pasien a mu ngai sih hi. Pa’ lungtang tawh kinai-a om Tapa khat beh in ama ei theisah hi."},"19":{"text":"Jew mite in, “Nang koi na hei?,” ci-in John a dong dingin Jerusalem panin siempute le Levi-te a sawl lai-un, John’ teci panna tam bang ahi hi.","title":"Baptize-pa John Teci panna (Mat 3:1-12 ; Mrk 1:1-8 ; Luk 3:1-18)"},"20":{"text":"Ama ki-im loin kipulah a, “Kei Messiah ka hi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale amate in, “Tua ahile koi na hiei? Elijah na mah? ci-in a dong uhi. Ama in, “Ka hi sih hi,” a ci hi. “Kamsang na hi amah?” a cikia ule, “Hi sing,” ci-in dawngkia leuleu hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:15, 18; Mal 4:5"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah, “Nang koi na hiei? Ko ei sawlte kungah ka genkia thei nadingun ko kungah dawnna khat ei nei in. Nang le nang koi hi’ng na kici ei?” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"John in, “Kamsang Isaiah’ gen ma bangin, ‘ Topa pei nading lampi tangsah un,’ ci-in gamlah-ah a kiko aw ka hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 40:3"},"24":{"text":"Amate pen Pharisee-te sawl ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in a kungah, “Tua ahile nang, Messiah lah hi lo, Elijah zong hi lo, kamsangpa lah hi lo na hi leh bang zieha mi na baptize ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"26":{"text":"John in amate kungah, “Keima in tui tawh mi ka baptize hi. Note lahah na thei lo uh khat a ding khinkhian a,"},"27":{"text":"ama ka nua-a ang peipa ahi hi; kei pen a kedap khau sut dingin zong ka kilawm sih hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tami pen John in mite a baptize-na mun Jordan gungal Bethany khuo-a pieng thu ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"A zing ciengin John in ama lam zuon a a pei Jesu a mu ciengin, “Tanah leitung’ mawna a puo Pasien tuuno a om hi!","title":"Pasien’ Tuuno"},"30":{"text":"‘Ka nua-ah kei sanga a lienzaw khat ang pei ding hi, azieh pen kei ka pien masangin ama a na om zo tabo hi, ka cipa khu tampa ahi hi,’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Kei mama in ama ka thei ngai sih hi; ahi vangin tui tawh ama baptize dinga kang peina thu pen Israel-te tungah ama a kilah nading ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuale John teci pang a, “Vantung panin vakhu bangin Hlagau Siengtho hing kumsuh a, ama tunga khawl ka mu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ke’n ama ka thei khah lo vangin, tui tawh mite baptize dinga ei sawlpa in, ‘A tungah Hla kumsuhin a khawl na mu pa uh pen Hlagau Siengtho tawh mite a baptize ding pa ahi hi,’ ei ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Kei mama in ka mu zo ta a, tam mipa pen Pasien’ Tapa ahi hi, ci-in teci ka pang zo hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"A zing ciengin a nuazuite lahah ni tawh John a dinton laitahin","title":"Jesu’ Nuazui Masate"},"36":{"text":"ama in Jesu a pei mu a, “En un, tanah Pasien’ Tuuno a om hi!” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Nuazui ni tegel in tami a thugen a zah ciengin Jesu nua a zui uhi."},"38":{"text":"Jesu zong kihei-in a nua a zui lam gel a mu ciengin, “Bang sui na hi vuoi?” a ci hi. Ama gel in, “Rabbi (tua pen Siepa a ci nopna hi), hei-a om na hei?” a ci uhi."},"39":{"text":"Ama in, “Hing pei unlen hing en un,” a ci hi. Ama gel pei-in a opna mun a va mu ta vua, tua ni-in ama kungah a taam uhi. Khumi hun pen nitah nai li pawl a hi hi."},"40":{"text":"John thugen za-a Jesu nua a zui nite lahah khat pen Simon Peter’ sanggampa Andrew ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in a sanggampa Simon mu masa pen a, ama kungah, “Messiah (Sathau kinupa a ci nopna) ka mu ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Ama in Jesu kungah Simon peipi a, Jesu in ama enin, “Nang, John’ tapa Simon na hi hi. Cephas ang kici ta ding hi,” a ci hi. (Peter ci-in kilet hi)."},"43":{"text":"A zing ciengin Galilee ah Jesu pei a sawm hi. Ama in Philip a mu ciengin ama kungah, “Ei zui in,” a ci hi.","title":"Philip le Nathanael in Jesu Nua Zui"},"44":{"text":"Philip pen Andrew le Peter-te’ khuo Bethsaida pan ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Philip in Nathanael mu a, ama kungah, “Moses in thukham laibu sunga a giel, kamsangte in zong a na giel Nazareth khuomi Joseph’ tapa Jesu i mu ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Nathanael in ama kungah, “Nazareth khuo ah sil hoi a pieng thei ding amah?” a ci hi. Philip in ama kungah, “Hing pei inlen hing en in,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Jesu in ama kung zuon a a pei Nathanael a mu bepin, “A zuou ngai lo Israel mi tahtah khat tanah a om hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"48":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Kei hei-a nei thei ahei?” ci-in a dong hi. Jesu in, “Philip in ang hlat masang, theikung nei-ah na op lai-in kang mu zo tabo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"49":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Rabbi aw, nang Pasien’ Tapa na hi hi! Israel kumpipa zong na hi hi!” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu in, “Theikung nei-ah na op lai-in kang mu zo hi, kang ci zieha nei up amah? Tamte sanga a thupizaw nate na mu lai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, note in van kihong na mu ding vua, Mihing Tapa tungah Pasien’ vantung mite a kumsuh le a kato na mu ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 28:12"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Galilee gam Cana khuo ah mopawi khat om a, tuanah Jesu’ nu a om hi.","title":"Cana Khuo Mopawi"},"2":{"text":"Jesu le a nuazuite zong tua mopawi-ah kihlan hi."},"3":{"text":"Lenggazu a tawp ciengin a nu in Jesu kungah, “Lenggazu a nei nawn sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu in, “Numei aw, nang le kei bang kisai laizang i hei? Ka hun a tung nai sih hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"A nu in nasemte kungah, “Ang gen bangbangin na gamta un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua munah gallan sawm ni sawm thum bang a ta, Judah-te’ kisiensuona-a zah ding suong tuibeel guh a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Tuibeel ah tui dim un,” a ci hi. Amate in zong a dimletin a dim uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Tu-in themkhat sawh unlen pawi uhpa kungah va peipi ta un,” a ci hi. Amate in zong tua ma bangin a va peipi ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pawi uhpa in lenggazu a suoh tui a ciep ciengin, (tua tui a dim nasemte a thei vangin) hei pana pieng ahei, ci ama in a thei sih a, tuale pawi uhpa in zinei pa hlanin,"},"10":{"text":"“Mite in lengga zulawi a hawm masa a, lenglate in a kham zaw ciengin a daute a hawm pan uhi. Ahi vangin nang in tu dongin zulawi na hen lai hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu in Galilee gam Cana khuo ah a masa pen tami na lamdang bawlin, tuaci’n ama’ minthanna a kilangsah hi; tuale a nuazuite in zong ama a um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Capernaum khuo ah a nu, a sanggamte, le a nuazuite tawh pei-in khum tahah bakhat sung a taam uhi.","ref":"Mat 4:13"},"13":{"text":"Judah-te’ Peisan pawi ding ang nai ta ahi ziehin Jerusalem ah Jesu a peito hi.","title":"Jesu in Biehinnpi Siensuo (Mat 21:12-13 ; Mrk 11:15-17 ; Luk 19:45-46)","ref":"Pei 12:1-27"},"14":{"text":"Ama in biehinn sungah bawng, tuu, vakhu zuate le sumkhelna sabuoi tunga a to sumkhelte a mu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in mi sat nading khauhuolte bawlin biehinnpi panin tuute, bawngte a unpi-un a delmang hi. Sumkhelte’ dangkatang teng zong thezah pieh a, a sabuoite uzong a lumlepieh gawp hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in vakhu zuate kungah, “Tam teng zong tam panin lakhiemang ta un! Ka Pa’ inn vanzuana mun suohsah sih un!” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A nuazuite in, “Na inn dinga deiluotna in ei netum ding hi,” ci-a kigielsa thu a phawhkia uhi.","ref":"Late 69:9"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jew mite in ama kungah, “Tamte na bawl thei nadingin bang lim nei lah thei diei?” a ci uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Tami biehinnpi sisue locin ni thum sungin ka dingsah kia ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mat 26:61; 27:40; Mrk 14:58; 15:29"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jew mite in, “Tami biehinnpi kum sawm li le kum guh sung tah kilam ahi hi, nang in ni thum sungin na dingsah zo ngel diei mah?” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in a pumpi ahi biehinn gen ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Sina panin a thawkia zaw ciengin a nuazuite in ama gensa tam thu a phawhkia vua, tuaci’n amate in Lai Siengtho le Jesu’ gensa thute a um uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in Jerusalem khuo ah Peisan pawi hun sungin ama’ bawl limte a mu ziehun ama’ min a um uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama lam panin Jesu in amate a muong sih a,"},"25":{"text":"ama ma in mikim sungah bang om ahei, ci thei zo ta ahi ziehin, koima in ama kungah mi khatpo’ thu teci a kipan ding kisam sa lo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nicodemus a kici Judah makai khat om a, ama pen Pharisee-te khat ahi hi.","title":"Nicodemus Kungah Jesu Haw"},"2":{"text":"Zan lai-in Jesu kungah pei-in ama kungah, “Rabbi aw, nang pen Pasien kung pana ang pei siepa khat na hi lam kang thei uhi; azieh pen Pasien lo tawh na bawl tami limte koima in bawl thei lo hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, mi khatpo tunglam panin a suokia sih leh Pasien’ manggam a mu thei sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Nicodemus in, “Mi khat a khangham zaw ciengin bangci suokia thei ding ahei? A nu gil sungah lutkia-in a suohkia thei ding amah?” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, koipo tui le hlagau tawh a suokia sih leh Pasien’ manggam a lut thei sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tahsa-a suona in tahsa hi a, Hlagau-a suona in hlagau ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"‘Nang na hi leh tunglam panin na suohkia a ngai hi,’ kang ci ciengin lamdang sa sin."},"8":{"text":"Hui zong a nopna popo-ah lang a, a gin na zah vangin hei pana hing lang hi a, hei lam zuon ahei, ci na thei sih hi. Hlagau-a suoh tapo zong tua ma bang ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"9":{"text":"Nicodemus in ama kungah, “Tami thu a bangci pien thei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in ama dawng a, “Nang Israel-te’ sie khat lawmlawm in tam thute na tel sih amah?"},"11":{"text":"“A tahtah a kang ci-in, kote in ka theisa thute kang gen vua, ka musa thute beh teci kang pang uhi; ahi vangin nang in ka teci panna uh na sang zo sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Note kungah leitung thu tawh kisai kang gen ciengin na up sih uleh vantung thu hing gen leng bang na ci up thei ding uh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"Vantung pana ang kumsuh Mihing Tapa simlo vantungah a kato koima om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Moses in gamlahah gul a khai bangin Mihing Tapa kikhai ding a,","ref":"Gam 21:9"},"15":{"text":"tua khu ama a um tapo in kumtawn hinna a nga nading ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Pasien in leitung a it seng ziehin a tapa a um mi zosie in kisie loin kumtawn hinna a nei thei nadingin a tapa neisun a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"“A tahtahin Pasien in leitung mawsahna thukhen dingin a Tapa leitunga ang sawl ahi sih a, ama tungtawnin leitung in hutdamna a nga thei nading hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama a umte in mawsahna thukhenna a thuoh sih ding uhi; ahi vangin ama a um lote in Pasien’ Tapa neisun’ min a up lo ziehun mawsahna thukhenna a thuoh zo ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale thukhenna a thuohna uh a hang pen leitungah khuovah hing tung zo napi a gamtat uh a siet luot ziehin mihingte in khuovah sangin khuomiel deizaw uhi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sietna a bawl mi zosie in amau’ gamtatnate a kilah lo nadingin khuovah a muda vua, khuovah sungah a pei sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin thuman-a a gamtate in amau’ gamtatna pen Pasien sunga gamta ahina uh kicien tahin a kimu thei nadingin khuovah sungah a pei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Judah gamah Jesu le a nuazuite a pei vua, khum munah amate tawh bakhat sung hun zangin mite a baptize hi.","title":"Jesu le Baptize-pa John"},"23":{"text":"Salim khuo gei-a Aenon munah tui a tam ziehin John in zong tuanah mite a baptize hi; tuale mite a kiphamatin pei-in a ki-baptize uhi,"},"24":{"text":"thong sungah John a kikhum nai sih hi.","ref":"Mat 14:3; Mrk 6:17; Luk 3:19-20"},"25":{"text":"Tu-in kisiensuona tungtang thu tawh kisai-in John’ nuazuite le Jew mi khat kikalah thu kikupna khat a om hi."},"26":{"text":"John kungah amate pei-in, “Sie aw, Jordan gun galkhatah nang tawh a omton ngai, ama’ thu teci na panna pa pen tu-in tanah omin mite a baptize a, mi zosie in ama a zuon uhi,” a ci uhi."},"27":{"text":"John in, “Vantung panin a kipieh sih leh koima in bangma nga thei lo hi."},"28":{"text":"‘Kei, Messiah ka hi sih a, a masanga ei kisawl pa ka hi bo hi,’ ci-a ka gen khu nomate mama ka teci na hi uhi.","ref":"Jhn 1:20"},"29":{"text":"Monei pa pen zinei pa ahi hi. Zinei pa kungah dingin ama’ thu ngai-a om a guolpa in zinei pa’ aw a zah ziehin a kipah mama hi. Tua thu ziehin ka lungdamna a bukim ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in khanlam manaw ding a, kei ka hile kiemlam ka manaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tunglam pana ang peipa khu mi zosie tungah a om hi; lei pana piengpa pen lei-a’ ahi a, leitung thute a gen hi. Vantung pana ang peipa ahile mi zosie’ tungah a om hi.","title":"Vantung Pan ang Pei pa"},"32":{"text":"Ama in mu-in a zahsa thute teci pang a, hizongle koima in a teci panna a sang sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama’ teci panna a sang poma in Pasien pen a thuman hi, ci-in a kipsah uhi."},"34":{"text":"Pasien’ sawl mi in Pasien’ thu a gen hi, azieh pen ama in tua mipa tungah ciengtan om loin Hlagau a pie hi."},"35":{"text":"Pa in Tapa it a, ama’ khut sungah na zosie a koi zo hi.","ref":"Mat 11:27; Luk 10:22"},"36":{"text":"Tapa a um mi poma in kumtawn hinna a nei hi; Tapa’ thu a mang lo mi poma in hinna mu lo ding a, Pasien’ lungthahna a thuohzaw lai ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Jesu in John sangin nuazui tam suohsah zaw-in mi tam baptize zaw hi, ci thu Pharisee-te in a zah lam uh Jesu in a thei ciengin,","title":"Jesu le Samaria Numei"},"2":{"text":"- a baptize-pa pen Jesu ahi sih a, a nuazuite ahi zaw hi-"},"3":{"text":"ama in Judea gam nuasie-in Galilee ah a peikia hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in Samaria gam nawhin a pei lo phamaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jacob in a tapa Joseph a pieh leitang gei-ah Sychar a kici Samaria gam khuopi khatah a tung hi.","ref":"Pien 33:19; Josh 24:32"},"6":{"text":"Khum munah Jacob’ tuikhuh a om a, a khuolzin a gim ziehin tua tuikhuh gei-ah Jesu a to hi. Khum hun pen sunkim laitah ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tui tawi dingin Samaria numei khat pei a, Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Tui ei dawnsah vawi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"(Neh ding lei-in khuopi sungah a nuazuite a pei sieng ta uhi.)"},"9":{"text":"Samaria numei nu in ama kungah, “Nang Judah mi khat in bangci dan a kei Samaria numei khat kunga tui nei nget thei ahei?” a ci hi. (Jew mite le Samaria-te sil bangma a kitang sih uhi.)","ref":"Ezr 4:1-5; Neh 4:1-2"},"10":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Pasien’ letsong thei-in na kungah, ‘Tui ei dawnsah in,’ ang cipa khu a theicien hi lacin, ama kungah tui na ngenzaw ding a, ama in hinna tui ang pie ding hi,” ci in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Numei nu in ama kungah, “Sie aw, nang in tuikhai nading bangma na nei sih a, tuikhuh lah thuh mama hi. Tua hinna tui hei sunga na lah ding ahei?"},"12":{"text":"Tami tuikhuh pen ka pu uh Jacob ei pieh ahi a, ama le a tate-a kipanin a gan khawite in tami tuikhuh a na zah uh ahi hi, tua ahile nang khumpa sanga a lienzaw na hi amah?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu in, “Tami tui a dawn poma a dangta kia ding a,"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin amate ka pieh ding tui a dawn poma dangta ngai nawn lo ding hi. Ka pieh ding tui a dawnte sungah kumtawn hinna tuinahin a pul ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua numei nu in ama kungah, “Siepa, ka dang a ta nawn lo nading le tam sunga tui tawi-a ka pei nawn lo nadingin tua tui kei ei pie in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Va pei-in na pasal va hlan ta’nlen tanah hing peikia in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Numei nu in, “Ke’n pasal ka nei sih hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Jesu in, ‘Pasal nei sing,’ na ci a man hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen pasal nga na nei ngai a, tu-a na nei pen zong na pasal ahi sih hi. Na thugen man hi!” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Numei nu in, “Siepa aw, nang kamsang khat na hi lam ka thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate un tami muol tungah Pasien a na bie vua, ahi vangin note in lah Pasien bieh nading pen Jerusalem hi bo, na ci zel uhi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Numei aw, kei ei um in, tami muol tungah hitale Jerusalem khuo ah hitale Pa na bieh nawn lo ding uh hun ang tung ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Note in na thei lopi uh na bie uhi; kote in ka theite ka bie uhi, azieh pen hutdamna khu Jew mite tung pan ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien a bie tahtahte in lungsim le thuman thutah tawh a bieh ding uh hun ang tung ding a, tu-in tanah ang tung ta hi, azieh pen Pasien in tua banga a bie ding mite a sui hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasien pen Hlagau ahi a, ama a biete in lungsim le thuman thutah tawh a bie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Numei nu in ama kungah, “Messiah (Khris kici pa) ang pei ding ci thu ka thei hi. Ama ang pei ciengin na zosie ei lah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Nang ang hopi keima khu tuapa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua zaw lien ciengin a nuazuite a tung uhi. Numei khat tawh ama a kiho pen lamdang a sa mama vua, ahi vangin koima in, “Bang dei na hei?” ahi sihle “Bang dinga ama na hopi ahei?” a ci sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin a tuibel nuasie-in khuopi sungah numei nu peikia a,"},"29":{"text":"“Hing pei un, ka gamtatna zosie ei gen mipa hing en ta un! Ama Messiah ahi thei sih ding amah?” ci-in mite kungah a dong hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in a khuopi uh nuasie-in Jesu kung a zuon uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua kikalin a nuazuite in, “Siepa bangkhat ne in,” ci in a zawl uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah, “Na thei lo uh neh ding an ka nei hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci’n a nuazuite in, “Koi khatpo in an a puoh zo ahi ta diei izaw?” a kici uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Ei sawlpa’ deina banga ka sep ding le ama’ nasep ka man sieng ding pen ka an ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Hla li zaw ciengin anlah hun ang tung ding hi, ci hi lo uh na mah? Ahi vangin ke’n kang ci-in, na kim na pam en un, lo lai-ah ante minin lah hun ta hi, ci thei un."},"36":{"text":"Anla pa in thaman a nga zo ta a, ama in kumtawn hinna a nga thei nadingin an kaikhawm a, tuaci’n khaitu pa le anla pa a lungdamton ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Azieh pen, ’ Mi khat in vaw a, adang khat in bu a at hi,’ a na kici thu pen a man ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Keima in na hlaw lona mun vuah a at dingin note kang sawl hi. Mi dangte in a hlo vua, note na hi ule amate’ hlawna lo-a a lut na hi uhi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Numei nu in, “Ka gamtatna zosie ama in ei gen hi,” ci-a teci a pan ziehin tua khuo-a Samaria mi tampite in Jesu a um uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu kungah Samaria-te a tun uh ciengin amate kunga a tam dingin a zawl vua, tuanah ni ni sung Jesu a tam hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuale ama’ thugente ziehin thu um mi tampi a kibelap hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in numei nu kungah, “Na thugenna zieha a um ka hi nawn sih vua, ko mama in ka za vua, tampa pen leitung hundampa tahtah hi, ci-in ka thei uhi,” a ci uhi."},"43":{"text":"Ni ni zaw ciengin tua mun panin ama peikhie-in Galilee gam a zuon hi.","title":"Galilee ah Jesu Kilekia"},"44":{"text":"(bangzieh ahei cile Jesu mama in kamsang khat, ama’ gamah kipahta ngai lo hi, ci-in teci pang ngaisa ahi hi).","ref":"Mat 13:57; Mrk 6:4; Luk 4:24"},"45":{"text":"Galilee gamah ama a tun ciengin Galilee mite in a na lamdot uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate in Jerusalem pawi-ah a silbawl zosie a mu ngai vua, amate mama zong pawi simin a pei uhi.","ref":"Jhn 2:23"},"46":{"text":"Tuisih, lengga zu a suosahna mun Cana khuo ah Jesu a peikia hi. Tua laitahin Capernaum khuo ah milien khat’ tapa dam loin a lum hi.","title":"Jesu in Milien Khat’ Tapa Damsah","ref":"Jhn 2:1-11"},"47":{"text":"Tua mipa in Judea gam panin Galilee gamah Jesu a tun lam a zah ciengin peisuhin a tapa a damsah nadingin a thum hi, azieh pen a tapa a si dihtah ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama kungah, “Note in lim le na lamdangte na mu sih uleh na um sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Milien pa in ama kungah, “Siepa aw, ka tapa a si masangin hing hawsuh ta’n,” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Pei ta’n, na tapa dam ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua pa in Jesu’ thugen umin a pei hi."},"51":{"text":"Lampi-ah a peisuh laitahin a silate in a na dawn vua, “Na tapa hing ta,” ci-in a gen uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in a noptuom hun amate a dong leh, “Zani sun nai khat laitahin a cithuo a theu hi,” a ci uhi."},"53":{"text":"Khum hun pen, “Na tapa a dam ding hi,” ci-in Jesu in a na gen hun lien ahi lam a pa in a thei ciengin ama le a innkuonpi zosie in Jesu a um pai uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tam pen Jesu in Judea gam panin Galilee gam a tun zaw a na lamdang bawl a niveina ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Jew mite’ pawi khat om a, Jesu zong Jerusalem ah a peito hi.","title":"Sabbath Ni in Jesu in Cina Damsah"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khuo-a Tuu Tunkot gei-ah Hebrew hamin Beth-zatha a kici buol tuikhuh khat om a, tua buol in talap nga nei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua talapte sungah mittaw, khelbai, phalsi-a kipanin a dammaw mi tampitah in"},"4":{"text":"tui kilaw ding ngahin a lum uhi; bangzieh ahei cile buolah Topa’ vantungmi khat kumsuhin a hunhunin tua tui a lawh thei zel hi; tua tui a kilaw zaw ciengin a sunga a kumsuh masa penpen mipa in bangbang natna vei tale a dam pai lien hi."},"5":{"text":"Khum sungah kum sawm thum le kum giet sung a cina khat a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu in tua sunga a lum mipa a mu ciengin ama in a lup zaw a sawt zo lam thei a, tuale ama in tua pa kungah, “Na dam nuom ei mah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"7":{"text":"Cina pa in, “Siepa aw, tui a kilaw ciengin buol sungah ei koi ding mi koima ka nei sih hi; tuale ka pei ciengin ka masangah midang khat a na kumsuh paipai hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu in tuapa kungah, “Ding in, na lupna la inlen pei in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuapa zong thakhatin dam a, a lupna la-in a pei pai hi. Khum ni pen Sabbath ni ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jew mite in damna nga pa kungah, “Tuni pen Sabbath ni ahi hi; na lupna puoh pen thukham tawh kituoh lo hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Neh 13:19; Jer 17:21"},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in amate kungah, ‘Kei ei damsah pa in na lupna la inlen pei in,’ ei ci hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in, ‘Na lupna puo inlen pei-in,’ ang cipa koi ahei?” ci-in ama a dong uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua munah a om mihonte lahah Jesu peimang zieu ahi ziehin a kidamsah pa in a damsah pa koi ahei, ci a thei ta vanuh sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Jesu in biehinnpi sungah tua mipa mu a, ama kungah, “En in, na dam sieng ta hi! Na tungah a siezaw khat ang tun lo nadingin mawna bawl nawn sin,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Mipa pei-in ama a damsah pa Jesu ahi hi, ci-in Jew mite kungah a gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in Jesu in tam bang nate a sep ziehin Jew mite in ama bawlsiet ding a kipan uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah, “Ka Pa in tudong na sem lai a, ke’n zong ka sem lai hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tam bangin Jesu in sabbath ni a sietsah tham loin, Pasien pen a Pa hisah a, ama le Pasien pen a kikimin a koi ziehin Jew mite in ama tha dingin a sui semsem uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, Tapa in ama thu-in bangma bawl thei lo a, Pa’ bawl a mute beh a bawl hi; azieh pen Pa’ sep teng ma Tapa in zong sem hi.","title":"Tapa’ Thuneina"},"20":{"text":"Pa in Tapa it a, a silbawl zosie Tapa tungah lah hi; note in lamdang na sah dingun Pa in tamte sanga a lienzaw sep dingte Tapa tungah a lah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Pa in misite thosahin hinna a pieh ma bangin Tapa in zong a deisahte hinna a pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Pa in koima tungah thu a khen sih hi, ahi vangin ama in Tapa tungah thukhenna zosie a ap hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi zosie in Pa a zatah bangin Tapa zong a zatah nadingin Pa in koima tungah thu khen loin thukhen nading thu zosie Tapa a pie hi. Tapa a zatah lo mi poma in ama a sawlpa Pa zong a zatah lo ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, koipo in ka thu za-in keima ei sawlpa a up leh kumtawn hinna a nei zo ta a, thukhenna thuoh nawn loin sina pan peikhie-in hinna ah a tung zo hi."},"25":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, misite in Pasien Tapa’ aw a zah ding uh hun le a za tapo a hin nading uh hun ang tung ding a, tu-in zong ang tung zo ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen Pa in ama sungah hinna a nei ma bangin Tapa in zong ama sungah hinna a nei thei nading thu a pie hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama Mihing Tapa ahi ziehin Pa in ama tungah thukhen thei nading thuneina a pie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tami thu-ah lamdang sa sih un; azieh pen han sunga om zosie in ama’ aw za-in hansung panin ang pusuo ding uh hun ang tung ding a,"},"29":{"text":"tuale a hoi a gamtate in hinna nga dingin ang thokia ding a, sietna a bawl mite zong thukhenna thuoh dingin ang thokia ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 12:2"},"30":{"text":"Keima’ thu-in bangma ka bawl thei sih hi. Ka zah bangin thu ka khen hi; ka thukhenna a dih hi, azieh pen keima’ deina ka sui sih a, kei ei sawlpa’ deina ka suizaw hi.","title":"Jesu ading Tecite"},"31":{"text":"“Keima tawh kisai teci pang leng ka teci panna man lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Keima adingin teci a pang midang khat a om a, ama in keima dinga a teci panna pen dih hi, ci ka thei hi."},"33":{"text":"Note in John kungah mi na sawl vua, ama in thuman thutah thu teci a pang hi.","ref":"Jhn 1:19-27; 3:27-30"},"34":{"text":"Tua banga mihing’ teci pannate ka sang hi, ka cina hi loin note in hutdamna na nga thei nadingun tam thute ka gen ahi zaw hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama pen meivah bangin kuongin a tang pimpem a, note in ama’ khuovah sungah bakhat sung nopsah ding na nuom uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi vangin John’ teci panna sanga a lienzaw teci panna khat ka nei hi. Pa in ka man sieng dinga ei pieh nasepte le tu-a ka septe in Pa pen keima ei sawlpa ahi lam keima tanga teci a pang ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuale keima ei sawlpa ahi Pa mama in zong kei tangin teci a pang zo hi. Note in ama’ aw na za ngai sih vua, a lim a mel zong na mu ngai sih uhi.","ref":"Mat 3:17; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22"},"38":{"text":"Ama a sawlpa na up lo ziehun ama’ thu zong na sung vuah a teng sih hi."},"39":{"text":"“Lai Siengtho simna tawh tawntung hinna kinga thei ding na sah ziehun Lai Siengtho na lim-et mama uhi; tuate khu keima’ thu teci pang ahi bo hi."},"40":{"text":"Hizongle note in hinna na nei nadingun keima kungah nang pei nuom sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Keima in mihingte tung panin minthanna ka sang sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in Pasien’ itna lungsim na nei lo uh ka thei hi."},"43":{"text":"Ka Pa’ min suonga kang pei vangin nei sang sih uhi; ama’ min suongin midang khat ang pei hileh na sang ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Khatlekhat kiphatna sang napi ucin, Pasien khat beh tung pana ang pei phatna na sui lopi uh na bangci up thei ding uh ahei?"},"45":{"text":"Pa mai-ah note ang mawsah dingin ei ngaisun sih un; note ang mawsah pen na kinepna pa uh Moses ahi bo hi."},"46":{"text":"Moses um na hi uleh, kei zong nei up ding uh ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama in keima’ thu a giel hi."},"47":{"text":"Note in a laigielte na up sih uleh ka thugente na bangci up thei ding uh ahei?” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Tiberias Tuipi zong a kici Galilee Tuipi galkhatah Jesu a pei hi.","title":"Mi Tul Nga Vana (Mat 14:13-21 ; Mrk 6:30-44 ; Luk 9:10-17)"},"2":{"text":"Mi tampite in cinate tungah a bawl lim lamdangte a mu ziehun ama’ nua a zui uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu zong muol tungah ka to-in khum tahah a nuazuite tawh a toton hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in Judah-te’ Peisan pawi nai mama ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu a khuoda leh ama kung a zuon mihonpite mu a, tuaci’n ama in Philip kungah, “Tam mite neh ding an hei sungah i lei ding vuoi?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam pen Philip a zelahna-a a gen ahi bo hi, azieh pen amama in a bawl ding a theisa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Philip in, “Mikim in themkhat cietin a tan ding uh an lei nadingin hla guh thaman in zong cin lo ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"8":{"text":"A nuazuite lah panin Peter’ sanggampa Andrew in ama kungah,"},"9":{"text":"“Tamnah anlum pum nga le nga tawn ni a nei naupang khat om hi. Ahi vangin mihing tazapi lahah tam teng banga gei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in, “Mite tosah un,” a ci hi. Tua munah lopa tampi a po hi; tuaci’n amate a to vua, pasal tul nga bang a pha uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in zong anlum la-in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin a to mite lahah a hawm hi; tua ma bangin nga zong la-in amau’ deiza cietin a hawmpieh hi."},"12":{"text":"A kham zaw ciengun a nuazuite kungah, “A thelthang bangma a op lo nadingin khawnla nengkie teng luoh un,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in anlum nga sungah khawnla nengkie teng a luoh vua, seu sawm le seu ni a dim hi."},"14":{"text":"Mite in ama’ bawl lim lamdangte a mu uh ciengin, “Tampa pen leitunga ang pei ding kamsang tahtah khat hi ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mite pei-in kumpi dinga a paumat ding uh Jesu in a thei bepin ama guohin muol tungah a geldap hi."},"16":{"text":"Nitah ciengin tuipi-ah a nuazuite a peisuh vua,","title":"Jesu Tui Tunga a peina (Mat 14:22-23 ; Mrk 6:45-52)"},"17":{"text":"gunkuong khatah tuongin Capernaum zuon dingin tuipi a kantan uhi. Tua munah khuo miel ta a, Jesu lah amate kungah a tung nai sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Huipi a hat ziehin tui a kilawh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tai thum tai li bang gunkuong a haw zaw ciengun amate lam ang zuon, tui tunga ang pei Jesu a mu vua, a zau mama uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in amate kungah, “Keima ka hi hi; zau sih un,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in gunkuong tungah kipah tahin ama a tuongsah vua, tuale a gunkuong zong a tun nading mun vuah mallang tahin a tung hi."},"22":{"text":"A zing ciengin tuipi galkhatah a omlai mihonpite in tua sungah gunkuong khat beh om a, Jesu lah a nuazuite tawh tua gunkuong tungah tuongton loin amate guoh a pei a mu uhi.","title":"Vantung pan Khomun"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in lungdam a ko zaw ciengin khomun a nehna uh mun gei-ah Tiberius panin gunkuong pawlkhat a pei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n tuipi gei-ah mihonpite in Jesu le a nuazuite a op nawn lo lam a thei ciengun, Jesu sui dingin gunkuong tung tuongin Capernaum ah a pei uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in tuipi galkhatah ama a mu ciengun ama kungah, “Siepa, bang hun a tasung na tung na hei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Jesu, Hinna An"},"26":{"text":"Jesu in, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, na lamdangte na mu zieh vua kei ei sui hi loin, an kham taha na neh zieh vua ei sui na hi bo uhi."},"27":{"text":"A sie thei an nga nadingin hakat sih unlen, Mihing Tapa in ang pieh ding kumtawn hinna dinga a kimang thei an nga nadingin hakatzaw un. Azieh pen Pa Pasien in ama tungah a ciemtena seal a khen zo ta hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Pasien’ na ka sep thei nadingun bang bawl ding ka hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Ama in ang sawlpa na upna uh pen Pasien’ nasep ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in ama kungah, “Kote in zong mu-a kang up thei nadingun lim lamdang bang ei lah ding na hei? Bang teng bawl ding na hei?"},"31":{"text":"Lai Siengtho sungah, ‘Ama in vantung panin a neh ding uh khomun a pie hi,’ ci-in a kigiel ma bangin, i pu i pate in gamlahah manna a ne uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Pei 16:4, 15; Late 78:24"},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, Moses in vantung panin note khomun ang pie sih a, vantung panin khomun ang pie pa pen ka Pa ahi bo hi."},"33":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile vantung panin hing pei-in leitung mite hinna a piepa pen Pasien’ khomun ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “ Topa , tami khomun ko ei pie suoh ta’n,” a ci uhi."},"35":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungh, “Keima in hinna khomun ka hi hi. Kei kunga ang pei poma gilkiel ngai nawn lo ding a, kei ei um poma a dangta ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanle kei ei mu zo napi ucin nei um sih uhi, ci-in kang gen zo hi."},"37":{"text":"Pa in kei ei pieh mi zosie ka kungah ang pei ding vua, tuaci’n ka kunga ang pei poma ka notmang ngai sih ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima’ dei bang bawl dinga vantung pana ang kumsuh ka hi sih a, keima ei sawlpa’ dei bang bawl dinga ang kumsuh ka hizaw hi."},"39":{"text":"Keima ei sawlpa’ deina ahile, ama in ei piehsa zosie khat zong mansuo loin, ni tawp ni cienga ka thawsah ding ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tapa mu a, a um zosie in kumtawn hinna nei-in ni tawpni ciengin amate ka thawsah ding pen ka Pa’ deina tahtah ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Keima in vantung pana ang kumsuh khomun ka hi hi,” a ci ziehin ama tungah Jew mite a phun uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in, “Tampa a nu le a pa i thei hi a, ama Joseph’ tapa Jesu hi lel lo amah? Tu-in ama in, ‘Vantung pana ang kumsuh ka hi hi,’ bang dinga a ci thei ahei?” a ci uhi."},"43":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Khatlekhat kiphunsan sih un."},"44":{"text":"Keima ei sawlpa Pa in a huoi lote koima ka kungah ang pei thei sih ding hi; ni tawp ni ciengin keima in tua mipa ka thosah ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Kamsangte’ laibu sungah, ‘Pasien in amate a unpi-un a hil ding hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi. Pa tung panin thu ngai-in a kunga kisin poma kei kung pana ang pei ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 54:13"},"46":{"text":"Tam bang ka ci ciengin Pa kung pana ang pei mi khat simlo khatpo in Pa mu zo hi, a ci ka hi sih hi; ama in Pa a mu zo hi."},"47":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, a um mi in kumtawn hinna a nei hi."},"48":{"text":"Kei pen hinna khomun ka hi hi."},"49":{"text":"Na pu na pate un gamlahah manna ne-in a si uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tami pen vantung pana ang peisuh khomun ahi a, a ne mi poma a si sih ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Keima in vantung pana ang peisuh hinna khomun ka hi hi. Tami khomun a ne poma kumtawnin a hing den ding hi; leitung mite hinna dinga ka pieh ding khomun pen keima’ tahsa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jew mite in, “Tam pa in i neh dingin a tahsa bang ei ci pieh thei ding ahei?,” ci-in a kisel uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, note in Mihing Tapa’ sa na neh sih vua, a si na dawn sih uleh na sung vuah hinna na nei sih ding uhi."},"54":{"text":"Keima’ sa ne-a keima’ si a dawn mite in kumtawn hinna nei a, keima in nitawp ni ciengin amate ka thosah ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka sa pen neh ding an tahtah ahi a, ka si zong khu dawn ding tui tahtah ahi hi."},"56":{"text":"Ka sa ne a, ka si a dawn poma keima sungah teng a, kei zong ama sungah ka teng hi."},"57":{"text":"A hingzing Pa in keima ei sawlin Pa ziehin ka hin ma bangin, kei zieha a ne poma zong a hing ding hi."},"58":{"text":"Tami pen vantung pana ang kumsuh khomun ahi a, na pu na pate un ne-in a si veve utawh kibang lo hi. Ahi vangin tami khomun a ne poma a hing zing ding hi,” a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Ama in tam thu pen Capernaum khuo kikhopna inn sungah a thuhil lai-a a gen ahi hi."},"60":{"text":"A nuazui tampite in tua thu a zah ciengun, “Tami thuhilna hahsa mama hi. Koi in pom thei ding ahei?” a ci uhi.","title":"Kumtawn Hinna Thute"},"61":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nuazuite in tam thu zieha a phunphun uh Jesu in a thei ciengin amate kungah, “Tam thu in note ang lungkiesah amah?"},"62":{"text":"Tua ahile Mihing Tapa a opna ngai-ah a kato a mu hi locin bang na ci ding vuoi?"},"63":{"text":"Hinna a pie pen hlagau ahi a, tahsa in kimanna a nei sih hi; na kung vua kang gen thute hlagau thu ahi a, hinna zong ahi hi."},"64":{"text":"Ahi vangin note lahah a um lo pawlkhat a om hi,” a ci hi. Tua banga a ci theina pen Jesu in a cil a patin koite in um lo a, koite in ama lebawl ding ahei, ci thu a theisa ahi zieh ahi hi."},"65":{"text":"Tuale ama in, “Tami thu ziehin Pa phalna om loin ka kungah koima ang pei thei sih ding hi, ci-in kang gen zo hi,” a ci hi."},"66":{"text":"Tami thu a zah ziehun a nuazui tampite kinuale-in ama tawh a kithuo nawn sih uhi."},"67":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu in sawm le nite kungah, “No zong na peimang nuom vuoi mah?” ci-in dong a,"},"68":{"text":"Simon Peter in, “ Topa , ko koi kunga pei son ding ka hi uh ahei?"},"69":{"text":"Nangma in kumtawn hinna thu na nei a, kote in a Siengtho Pasien na hi lam kang um vua, zong kang thei uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mat 16:16; Mrk 8:29; Luk 9:20"},"70":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “No, sawm le nite, kang teel na hi sih uh amah? Hizongle note lahah khat pen dawimangpa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"71":{"text":"Tam pen sawm le nite lahah ama a leheh ding pa, Simon Iscariot tapa’ Judas a genna ahi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Galilee gam sungah Jesu a zin kawikawi hi. Ama tha nading Jew mite in hunlem a sui ziehun Judea gamah ama a zin nuom sih hi.","title":"Jesu’ Sanggamte’ Uplona"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in Judah-te’ Buh Pawi a nai mama hi.","ref":"Siem 23:34; Thkna 16:13"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sanggamte in ama kungah, “Na nuazuite in na nasepna a mu thei nadingun tam sung nuasie inlen Judea gamah pei in;"},"4":{"text":"azieh pen mipi thei ding a nuom poma in dapsep ngai lo hi. Tam thute na bawl leh leitung mite theisah vet in,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"(Azieh pen a sanggamte nangawn in ama a um sih uhi.)"},"6":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Ka hun tung nai lo hi, hizongle no hun ahile a lemtang zing hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitung in note ang muda thei sih vangin kei ei muda hi, azieh pen a silbawlte hoi lo hi, ci-a teci ka pan zieh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"No mama in tua pawi va sim ta un.
