Keima’ hun tungkim nai lo ahi ziehin tua pawi kang sim nai sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami thu a genzaw ciengin Galilee gamah a tamsuoh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin pawi sim dingin a sanggamte a pei zaw ciengin ama zong mipi thei loin a va hawdap ta hi.","title":"Buh Pawi-ah Jesu"},"11":{"text":"Pawi sungah Jew mite in, “Jesu hei-a om ahei?” ci-in dongin a sui uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihonpi lahah ama’ thu tawh kisai kimawsietna lienpi a om hi. Mi pawlkhatte in, “Ama mihoi khat ahi hi,” a ci vua, adangte in, “Hi lo hi, ama pen mipite sol ahi bo hi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Jew mite a giin ziehun koima in a langtangin a gen ngam sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Pawi bawl a kimsuhin biehinnpi sungah Jesu pei to-in thuhil ding a kipan hi."},"15":{"text":"Jew mite in, “Tami pa in sinna bangma a nei ngai lopi, tam bang theina a bangci nei thei son adiei?” ci-in lamdang a sa uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Ka thuhilte keima-a’ ahi sih a, keima ei sawlpa-a’ ahi zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasien’ deina bang sem dinga a khensat poma in tua thuhilna pen Pasien kung pan amah, ahi sihle keima’ thu beh gen ka hei, ci a thei ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amau’ thu a gente pen amau’ minthan nading beh sui ahi uhi; ahi vangin a sawlpa’ minthan nading a sui mite pen mi thuman ahi vua, amate sungah zuouthu om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Moses in note thukham hing pie zo hi lo amah? Hizongle khat mama in zong tua thukham na zui sih uhi. Bang dinga kei tha nading hun lemtang na sui uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihonpite in, “Nang dawivei na hi hi! Tha dinga ang sui koi ahiei?” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Na khat ka bawl a, na unpi-un lamdang na sa uhi."},"22":{"text":"Moses in teptan ding thu note ang pie a, (a tahtahin tam pen Moses’ pat hi loin pupite’ pat ahi zaw hi), note in sabbath ni-in mi khat’ tep na tanpieh uhi.","ref":"Pien 17:10; Siem 12:3"},"23":{"text":"Moses’ thukham a kipalsat lo nadingin sabbath ni-in mi khat’ tep kitan thei ahileh sabbath ni-in mi khat’ pumpi ka damsah ziehin bang dingin kei tungah lungthah na hi uh ahei?","ref":"Jhn 5:9"},"24":{"text":"A putham muna tawh thukhen sih unlen, a thukhenna man tawh thu na khen un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Jerusalem mi pawlkhat in, “Tha dinga a suisui pa uh tampa hi lo amah?","title":"Tam pa Khris Amah?"},"26":{"text":"Ama tanah om a, mipi zahin thu gen napi ama kungah bangma a gen ngam sih uhi! Tampa Messiah ahi hi, ci-in thunei vaihawmte in a thei tahtah ding vuoi mah?"},"27":{"text":"Hinanle eite in tam mipa hei pana ang kipan ahei, ci i thei uhi; ahi vangin Messiah ang pei ciengin ama hei pana hing pei ci koima in thei lo ding hi,” a ci uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinnpi sungah thu a hil kawmin Jesu kiko a, “Note in kei nei thei vua, kei hei pana hing pei ci zong na thei uhi. Keima thu tawh ang pei ka hi sih hi. Keima ei sawlpa thudih a, ahi vangin note in ama na thei sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in keima ei sawl a, ama kung pana ang pei ka hi ziehin ama ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama mat ding a hanciem vua, ahi vangin a hun a tun nai lo ziehin koima in ama tungah khut a nga sih uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanle mihon lahah mi tampite in ama a um vua, “Messiah ang pei ciengin tampa sangin na lamdang a tamzaw ang lah diei izaw?” a ci uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ama tungtang mipite phunna Pharisee-te in a za vua, tuale siempu liente le Pharisee-te in ama man dingin biehinncing palihte a sawl uhi.","title":"Jesu Man dingin Uliente Kisawl"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Note tawh bakhat sung beh ka om ding a, tua ciengin keima ei sawlpa kungah ka pei ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Keima nei suisui vangun nei mu sih ding uhi; ka opna ah nang pei thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Jew mite in, “Eite in ama i mu zawh lo nadingin hei sung pei sawm adiei? Greek-te lahah a Kithethangte kungah va pei-in Greek-te’ thu va hil sawm adiei?"},"36":{"text":"‘Note in nei sui ding vua, nei mu sih ding uhi,’ a ci thu le, ‘Ka opna ah nang pei thei sih ding uhi,’ a ci pen bang a ci nopna adiei?” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"37":{"text":"Pawi ven ni le a ni thupi ni-in, tua sungah Jesu a din laitahin ama kiko a, “A dangta khatpo ka kungah hing pei-in,","title":"Hinna Guntuite","ref":"Siem 23:36"},"38":{"text":"kei ei um poma in hing kidawn taheh. Lai Siengtho in a gen bangin, ‘Thu-um pa’ lungtang panin hinna guntui a luong ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Ezk 47:1; Zech 14:8"},"39":{"text":"Tu-in ama in tam bang a ci ciengin ama a um mite in a nga ding uh Hlagau thu gen ahi hi; azieh pen Jesu kipatawi nai lo ahi ziehin Hlagau a om nai sih hi."},"40":{"text":"Amate in tam thute a zah ciengun mipite lahah pawlkhat in, “Tampa pen kamsang tahtah ahi hi,” a ci uhi.","title":"Mipi Lahah Kikhenna"},"41":{"text":"Adangte in, “Tampa pen Messiah ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Hizongle pawlkhat in, “Galilee gam panin Messiah ang pieng tahtah mawh ding amah?"},"42":{"text":"Lai Siengtho in Messiah pen David’ suon ahi a, David’ tenna Bethlehem khuo pana ang pieng ahi hi, ci hi lo amah?” a ci uhi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12; Mic 5:2"},"43":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama ziehin mipite lahah kikhenna a om hi."},"44":{"text":"Amate lahah mi pawlkhat in ama a mat nuom vangun koima in ama tungah a khut uh a nga sih uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciengin, “Ama bang dinga nang mat lo uh ahei?” ci-in a na dong siempu liente le Pharisee-te kungah biehinncing palihte a kilekia uhi.","title":"Uliente’ Uplona"},"46":{"text":"Palihte in, “Tampa gen bangin koima in gen ngai nai lo hi!” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharisee-te in, “No zong ang kisol zo ta hi lo amah?"},"48":{"text":"Thunei vaihawmte ahi sihle Pharisee-te lahah ama a um mi khat beh a om ta amah?"},"49":{"text":"Thukham a thei lo tam mihonpite samsiet thuoh ahi uhi,” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Amate lahah Jesu kunga a haw ngai Nicodemus in,","ref":"Jhn 3:1-2"},"51":{"text":"“Amate in bang teng sem ci kan masa lopi-in i thukham in mite thu a khen ngai ngel amah?” a ci hi."},"52":{"text":"Amate in, “Nang zong Galilee mi hi lo na mah? Galilee panin kamsang koima pieng ngai lo hi, ci thu kan lacin na thei ding hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi. ["},"53":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate a unpi-un a inn ciet vuah a pei uhi.","title":"Angkawm Numei Kiman"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua laitahin Olive Muol tungah Jesu a pei to hi."},"2":{"text":"Zingmawng khuova patin biehinnpi ah ama a peikia hi. Ama kungah mi zosie a pei vua, tuale ama to-in thu hil a kipan hi."},"3":{"text":"Thukham theite le Pharisee-te in a angkawm laitaha a kiman numei khat peipi-in amate zosie mai-ah a dingsah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Jesu kungah, “Sie aw, tam numei nu a angkawm laitaha kiman ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Thukham laibu sungah Moses in tam bangte suong tawh selia dingin thu a pie hi. Nang in bang na gen diei?” a ci uhi.","ref":"Siem 20:10; Thkna 22:22-24"},"6":{"text":"Tami thu pen ama tungah mawmatna pawlkhat a nei thei nadingun ama zelah nadinga a gen uh ahi hi. Jesu zong kunsuhin a khutme tawh tuolah lai a giel hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a dawh teitei ciengun Jesu dingtang to-in amate kungah, “Note lahah maw nei lo khat pen in suong tawh ama sep masa heh,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama khatvei kunsuh kia-in a khutme tawh tuolah lai a gielkia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua thu a zah bepun a tapen panin khat khatin a gelmang uhi. Jesu le a mai-a ding numei nu beh a omlai hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu dingtang to-in ama kungah, “Numei aw, amate hei sieng ta uh ahei? Khat beh in ang mawmat sih amah?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Siepa, koima in ei mawmat sih,” a ci hi. Tuale Jesu in, “Ke’n zong kang mawmat sih hi. Pei inlen mawna bawlkia nawn sin,” a ci hi.]"},"12":{"text":"Khatvei Jesu in amate kungah, “Keima leitung khuovah ka hi hi. Ka nua ei zui poma khuomiel ah pei loin hinna khuovah a nei ding uhi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu, leitung Khuovah","ref":"Mat 5:14; Jhn 9:5"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharisee-te in ama kungah, “Nangma’ thu nangma in teci na pang hi; na teci panna man lo hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Jhn 5:31"},"14":{"text":"Jesu in, “Keima’ thu keima in teci ka pan vangin ka teci panna pen a man ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile kei hei panin hing pei-in hei lam zuon ding ka hei, ci ka thei a, ahi vangin note in kei hei pan hing pei-in hei lam zuon ding ka hei, ci na thei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Note in mihing dan tawh thu na khen uhi; ke’n koima thu ka khen sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Khen tama leng zong, ka thukhenna a man ahi hi; azieh pen thukhen kei beh hi loin keima le ei sawl Pa tawh ka hi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na thukham sung vuah mi ni’ teci panna a man ahi hi, ci-in kigiel hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima’ thu keima in teci ka pang a, keima ei sawlpa ahi Pa in zong keima tangin teci a pang hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Na Pa hei-a om ahei?” a ci uhi. Jesu in, “Note in kei nei thei sih vua, ka Pa zong na thei sih uhi. Note in kei ei thei hi locin ka Pa zong na thei ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam thu teng pen biehinnpi sumkholna innkhan sunga ama in thu a hil laitaha a gen ahi a, ahi vangin ama hun tung nai lo ahi ziehin koima in ama man lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in khatvei amate kungah, “Kei a peikhie ding ka hi ta a, note in kei nei sui ding vua, hizongle na mawna sung vuah na si ding uhi. Ka peina-ah note nang pei thei sih ding uhi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu in a Si ding Magen"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jew mite in, “Ka peina ah nang pei thei sih ding uhi, ci ahi ziehin ama le ama a kithat ding khat ahi ta diei?” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in a kung vuah, “Note pen nei lam pan na hi vua, kei pen tunglam pan ka hi hi; note pen tam leitung mi na hi vua, kei pen tam leitung pan ka hi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Ke’n kang ci-in na mawnate ziehun note na si ding uhi, azieh pen note in kei ama kici pa ka hi lam nei up sih uleh na mawnate uh ziehin na si ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Nang koi na hei?” a ci uhi. Jesu in amate kungah, “A cil a patin na kung vua kang gensa bang ka hi hi."},"26":{"text":"Note tungah gen ding thu le mawsah nading thu tampi ka nei hi; ahi vangin kei ei sawlpa thuman a, keima in ama tung panin ka zah tam thute beh leitungah kang gen hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in Pa’ thu a gengen ahi lamtah amate in a tel sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu in, “Mihing Tapa na khaito zaw ciengun kei ama ka hi lamtah nei thei ding vua, tuale keima in ka thu tawh bangma bawl loin Pa ei hil banga thugen ka hi lam note in nei thei ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Keima ei sawlpa keima tawh a om hi; ama in kei guoh ei nuasie ngai lo hi, azieh pen ama’ lungkimna bangin ka gamta zing hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in tua bangin a gen ciengin mi tampi in ama a um uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama a um Jew mite kungah, “Ka thute nei zui peisuoh uleh ka nuazui tahtah na hi uhi;","title":"Nuazui Tahtahte"},"32":{"text":"tuale note in thuman thutah zong na thei ding vua, tua thuman thutah in note ang suohtasah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in, “Kote Abraham suonlehlahte ka hi vua, koima sila-in ka om ngai sih uhi. ‘Note ang kisuohtasah ding hi,’ bang dinga na ci thei ahei?” a ci uhi.","ref":"Mat 3:9; Luk 3:8"},"34":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, mawna a bawl zosie mawna’ sila ahi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Sila in inn sungah munkip a nei sih hi; tapa in tua sungah kumtawn ading mun a nei hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaci’n Tapa in ang suotatsah leh suohta tahtahte na hi ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Keima in Abraham suonlehlahte na hi lam uh ka thei hi; hizongle ka thu in na sung vuah mun nga lo ahi ziehin note in kei tha nading hun lemtang na sui uhi."},"38":{"text":"Keima in Pa opna munah ka musate kang gen a, note in Pa kung pana na zahte uh na sep ding uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Abraham ka pa uh ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Jesu in, “Abraham’ tate na hi uleh Abraham’ septe na sem ding uhi.","title":"Jesu le Abraham"},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in Pasien kung pana ka zah thuman a gen pa kei lah nei tha sawm vanuh uhi. Tam pen Abraham bawl dan ahi sih hi."},"41":{"text":"Note na hi ule na pa uh’ sep banga a sem tahtah na hi uhi,” a ci hi. Amate in, “Ko zawlta ka hi sih uhi; kote in Pasien mama ahi Pa khat beh ka nei uhi,” a ci uhi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Pasien na Pa uh ahileh kei nei it ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile kei pen Pasien kung pana ang pei ka hi a, tu-in tanah ka om hi. Keima’ thu-a ang peitawm ka hi sih a, ama’ ei sawl ka hi bo hi."},"43":{"text":"Bang dinga ka thugen na tel thei lo uh ahei? Azieh pen ka thu na ngai nop lo zieh uh ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"No pen na pa uh dawimangpa kung pana ang pei na hi vua, na pa uh’ deina banga bawl ding na teel uhi. Ama pen a cil a patin mithat pa ahi a, ama sungah thuman thutah a op lo ziehin thuman thutah a tukip sih hi. Ama in zuouthu a gen ciengin ama’ pienzie tawh kituohin a gen hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama zuou gen pa le mizuou theite’ pa ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in thuman ka gen ziehin nei um sih uhi."},"46":{"text":"Note lahah koi in kei nei mawmat uh ahei? Thuman thutah gen ka hi leh bang dinga nei up lo uh ahei?"},"47":{"text":"Pasien kung pana pei poma in Pasien’ gente a za hi. Note in na zah lona uh a hang pen Pasien kung pan na hi lo zieh uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Jew mite in ama kungah, “Nang Samaria-te na hi a, dawivei na hi hi, kang ci uh a man hi lo amah?” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"49":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kei dawivei ka hi sih hi; keima in ka Pa ka zatah a, ahi vangin note in kei nei zatah sih uhi."},"50":{"text":"Hizongle keima guoh’ minthan nading ka sui sih hi; ka minthan nading a sui khat om a, tuapa khu thukhen ding pa ahi hi."},"51":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, “Mi khatpo in ka thu a zui leh sina a mu ngai sih ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"52":{"text":"Jew mite in ama kungah, “Nang dawivei na hi lamtah tu-in kang thei uhi. Abraham lah si zo a, tua ma bangin kamsang teng zong a si zo uhi; hizongle tu-in nang in, ‘Mi khatpo in ka thu a zui leh sina a ciem kha ngai sih ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuale a sisa ka pa uh Abraham sanga lienzaw-a kigen na hi amah? Kamsang teng zong si sieng zo uhi. Nang koi-a kigen na hiei?” a ci uhi."},"54":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kei le kei ka kiminthansah leh tua ka minthanna pen a mawhna a suoh ding hi. Keima ei minthangsah pa pen, ‘Ama ka Pasien ahi hi,’ na ci uh ka Pa ahi hi."},"55":{"text":"Note in ama na thei sih vua, ahi vangin ke’n ama ka thei hi; ama ka thei sih hi, ci leng note bangin mizuou ka hi ta ding hi. Ahi vangin ke’n ama ka thei a, a thu zong ka mang hi."},"56":{"text":"Na pa uh Abraham in keima’ hun a mu ding a kipah mama hi; tuale ama in mu-in a lungdam mama hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jew mite in ama kungah, “Kum sawm nga zong na phah nai lopi Abraham na mu ta ngel amah?” a ci uhi."},"58":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, Abraham pien masangin keima ka om zo ta hi,” a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a se nading uh suong a tung vua, ahi vangin Jesu kiphuolin biehinnpi panin a gelmang hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lampi-ah Jesu a pei laitahin a pienpi mittaw mipa khat a mu hi.","title":"Pienpi Mittaw Khat in Khuomukia"},"2":{"text":"A nuazuite in ama kungah, “Sie aw, tampa mittaw sa-a ang pienna pen koi pen’ mawna zieh ahi diei? Ama mawna zieh ahi diei? Ahi sihle a nu a pate’ mawna zieh a hizaw diei?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu in, “Ama’ mawhna zieh ahi sih a, a nu a pate’ mawna zieh zong ahi sih hi; ama tungah Pasien’ nasepna a kilah thei nadingin a suo-a kipanin a mittaw sa-a ang suoh ahi zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Ni a op sungin kei ei sawlpa’ na i sem ding hi; koima in na a sep thei lo zan hun ang tung ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Leitunga ka om laisie kei pen leitung khuovah ka hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 5:14; Jhn 8:12"},"6":{"text":"Tami thu a gen kawmin tuolah a cil sie a, cil tawh buon a meh zaw ciengin a mit buon nupiehin,"},"7":{"text":"“Pei inlen Siloam buolah na mai va phiet ta’n,” ci-in a sawl hi. (Siloam kici pen Sawl a cina ahi hi.) Tua ciengin ama pei-in a mai phiet a, khuo mu theisa-in a kinuale kia hi."},"8":{"text":"Nidang lai-in khudaw ngen banga a oplai a mu a vengte le ama a mungaite in, “Khutdaw ngen a na to let pa khu tampa hi lo amah?” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pawlkhat in, “Ama ahi hi,” a ci uhi. Adangte in, “Ama hi laizang sih, a kisutpi khat hi bo,” a ci uhi. Ama in, “Kei tuapa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in ama kungah, “Tua ahile na mit bang ang ci vah theikia ahiei” ci-in a dong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Jesu kici mi khat in buon mehin ka mit ang nu zaw ciengin Siloam buolah pei inlen na mai va phiet ta’n, ei ci bangin kei zong pei-in ka phiet leh khuo mu theikia ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Tua pa hei-a om ahiei?” a ci uhi. Ama in, “Thei sing,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in Pharisee-te kungah tua mittaw pa a peipi uhi.","title":"Pharisee-te in a Damna Thu Kan"},"14":{"text":"Jesu in ama buon nu-in a mit a vahsah ni pen Sabbath ni ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharisee-te in zong tua pa kungah a mit khuomu dan a dongkia uhi. Ama in, “Tua mipa in ka mit buon ei nupiehin ka mai ka phiet leh khuo mu theikia ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Pharisee-te pawlkhat in, “Tam mipa in Sabbath ni tang lo ahi ziehin Pasien kung pan hi lo ding hi,” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin adangte in, “Mawnei mi khat in tam bang lim lamdangte bangci bawl thei ding ahei?” a ci uhi. Tuale amate lahah kikhenna a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in mittaw pa kungah, “Tua pa in na mit hing vahsah ci lei nang in ama koi hi va na ci ei?” ci-in a dongkia uhi. Ama in, “Kamsang khat hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"18":{"text":"Jew mite in ama mittaw ngai-in khuo a mu thei lam mit khuomu pa’ nu le pate a hlat masangsie a tahsang thei sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuale amate kungah, “Pienpi mittaw na ci uh na tapa uh tam pa ma ahi amah? Tua ahile bangci dan a tu-a khuo a mu theikia ahei?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"20":{"text":"A nu le a pate in, “Tam pa pen ka tapa uh ahi a, kote in pienpi mittaw ahi lam ka thei uhi;"},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin bangci danin tu-in khuo mu thei a, koi in a mit a vahsah ahei, ci ka thei sih uhi. Ama kidawh un; ama zong mi khangcingsa ahi ziehin ama’ thu ama in ang gen na ding hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"22":{"text":"A nu a pate in Jew mite a giin ziehun tam banga a gen uh ahi hi; azieh pen mi khatpo Messiah danin a kigen leh Jew mite kikhopna inn panin kinotmang ding hi, ci-in thukimna a neisa uh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a nu le a pate in, “Ama a khangcingsa hi, ama kidawh un,” a na ci uh ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a niveina mittaw pa hlankia-in ama kungah, “Pasien phat in! Kote in tam pa pen mawnei mi khat ahi lam ka thei uhi,” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in, “Mawnei mi ahile ahi lo ka thei kha sih hi. Mittaw ka hi a, tu-in khuo ka mu ta hi, ci thu khat beh ka thei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in ama kungah, “Ama in nang tungah bang ang bawl ei? Na mit bang ang ci vahsah ei?” ci-in a dongkia uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in, “Kang gen zo ta a, note in na ngai nuom sih uhi. Bang dinga na zah nuom sawnsawn uh ahei? Note zong ama’ nuazui suoh nuom na hi ta uh amah?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in ama kungah, “Nang ama’ nuazui na hi a, ko ka hi ule Moses’ nuazuite ka hi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Pasien in Moses a hopi lam kote in ka thei vua, ahi vangin tam pa hei sung pana ang pei ahei, ci ka thei sih uhi,” ci-in a engho uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua mipa in, “Ama in ka mit ei vahsah ta ngiangua a, note in lah ama hei sung pana ang pei ci na thei lo uh lamdang sam ei izaw!"},"31":{"text":"Pasien in mawnei mite’ thu ngai loin, ama bie-in ama’ deina banga a gamta mite’ thu a ngaipieh hi, ci i thei uhi."},"32":{"text":"Lei piencil a kipanin pienpi mittaw a damsah koima kiza ngai nai lo hi."},"33":{"text":"Pasien kung pana ang pei hi sihle ama in bangma bawl thei lo ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in, “Mawna bulomtang lah pana suoh hi napicin bang dinga thu ei hil sawm meumo na hei?” a ci uhi. Tuale amate in tua pa a notmang uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua mittaw pa a nawmang dawh uh Jesu in za a, ama in tua pa a mu ciengin, “Mihing Tapa na um ei mah?” a ci hi.","title":"Hla Mittawtna"},"36":{"text":"Tua pa in, “ Siepa, ama koi ahiei? Ama ka up thei nadingin ei gen in,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Ama na mu zo hi; nang ang hopi pa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua pa in, “ Topa aw, ken ka um ta hi,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in tua pa a bie pai hi."},"39":{"text":"Jesu in, “Khuo mu thei lote in khuo a mu nading ule khuomu theite in a mu thei lo nadingun thukhen dinga leitunga ang pei ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama kunga a om Pharisee pawlkhat in tam thu a zah ciengun ama kungah, “Ko zong mittaw ka hi ta uh amah?” ci-in a dong uhi."},"41":{"text":"Jesu in, “Mittaw hi locin note in mawna na nei sih ding uhi. Ahi vangin tu-in note in, ‘Khuo ka mu uhi,’ na ci ziehun na mawna uh a omlai hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“A tahtah a kang ci-in, tuu khumna tunkot panin lut loin lampi tuom panin kato-in a lut poma guta le misuom ahi hi.","title":"Tuucing Hoipa Jesu"},"2":{"text":"Tunkot pana lut mipa ahile a tuute a cing pa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tunkot cingpa in ama kot honin tuute in ama’ aw a za uhi. Ama in tuute a min tawh hlanin a pusuopi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama-a’ zosie a pusuopi zaw ciengin a mai-ah pei-in tuute in ama’ nua a zui uhi, azieh pen tuute in ama’ aw a thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuute in a melmahte uh’ nua a zui sih ding vua, a melmahte uh’ aw a thei lo ziehun ama kung panin a gelmang ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu in amate tawh tam thugentena a zah vangin bang thu gen ahei, ci a thei sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu in amate kungah, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, kei pen tuute lutna tunkot ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka mai-a pei zosie guta le misuomte ahi uhi; ahi vangin tuute in a thu a mang sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kei tunkot ka hi hi. Keima tungtawnin a lut poma kihundam ding a, sungtum pusuohin lodawnna mun a mu ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Guta pen a gu ding, a that ding le a susie ding behin ang pei hi. Kei ka hile amate in hinna a nei thei nading ule hinna bukim a nga thei nading vua ang pei ka hi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Kei tuucing hoi ka hi hi. Tuucing hoi in a tuute adingin a hinna a pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuucing ahi lo, tuu zong a nei lo, a kiciel tuucing in ngie pei a mu ciengin a tuute nuasie-in taimang a, tua ngie in tuute manin a thezah hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama a kiciel ahi bo ziehin tuute don loin a taimang hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima tuucing hoi ka hi hi. Kei-ate ka thei a, kei-ate in zong kei ei thei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Pa in kei ei thei bangin ke’n zong Pa ka thei hi. Keima in tuute adingin ka hinna ka pie hi.","ref":"Mat 11:27; Luk 10:22"},"16":{"text":"Tami tuu khumna sunga a om lo tuu dang zong ka nei lai hi. Tuu khumna ah tuate kang peipi valon ding a, amate in ka aw a ngai ding uhi. Tuaci’n tuuhon khat, tuucing khat a om ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka hinna ka lahkia thei nadingin ka hinna ka pieh ziehin Pa in keima ei it hi."},"18":{"text":"Koima in keima tung panin ka hinna ei lahpieh lo a, keima thu-a ka pieh ahi zaw hi. Keima in pieh thei nading thu ka nei a, lahkia thei nading thu zong ka nei hi. Keima in tami thupieh pen ka Pa kung pana ka nga ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tami thute ziehin Jew mite a kikhen leuleu uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mi tampitah in, “Ama pen dawivei ahi a, a maw ahi bo hi. Bang dinga ama’ thu na ngai uh ahei?” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Adangte in, “Tam bangte pen dawivei khat’ thugen ahi sih hi. Dawivei khat in mittawte’ mit a vahsah thei ding amah?” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Khum hunin Jerusalem ah Ki-apna Pawi om a, tua pen phalbi hun sung ahi hi.","title":"Jew Mite in Jesu Niel"},"23":{"text":"Biehinn huong sunga Solomon talap ah Jesu a pei kawikawi laitahin,"},"24":{"text":"a kimkotah Jew mite kikhawmin ama kungah, “Nang in bang tanvei lung nawngkai-in kote ei koi ding na hei? Messiah na hi leh siengtahin ei gen pai ta’n” a ci uhi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu in, “Ke’n kang gen zo a, na tahsang paupau sih uhi. Ka Pa’ min tawh ka sep zosie in keima’ thu teci a pang hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka tuute na hi lo ziehun nei um sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ka tuute in ka aw a za uhi. Keima in amate ka thei a, amate in ka nua ei zui uhi."},"28":{"text":"Keima in kumtawn hinna amate ka pie a, amate a kisie ngai nawn sih ding uhi. Ka khut sung panin koima in ka tuute ei lahpieh zo sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka Pa ei piehsate adang zosie teng sangin lienzaw a, ka Pa’ khut sung panin koima in ei lahpieh zo lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka Pa le kei pumkhat ka hi uhi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"31":{"text":"Jew mite in ama a se nadingun suong a tung leuleu uhi."},"32":{"text":"Jesu in, “Pa kung panin nasep hoi tampi kang lah zo hi. Tuate lahah bang pen zieha suong tawh nei se sawm uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Jew mite in, “Nasep hoi zieha kang se sawm uh ahi sih a, nang mi maimai khat kimlai Pasien bangin nang kibawl a, ama na simmawbawl zieh ahi zaw hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi.","ref":"Siem 24:16"},"34":{"text":"Jesu in, “Na thukham bu sung vuah, ‘Keima in note pen pasien-te kang ci hi,’ ci in kigiel hi lo amah?","ref":"Late 82:6"},"35":{"text":"Pasien’ thu a tunna mite pen, ‘pasien-te’ kici ahile-Lai Siengtho lah kiphiet thei lo cileih-"},"36":{"text":"keima in, ‘Pasien’ Tapa ka hi hi,’ ka ci ziehin Pa in siensuo-in leitunga a sawl pa ahi keima kungah Pasien na simmawbawl hi, ei ci thei na hi uh amah?"},"37":{"text":"Ka Pa’ nasepte a sem lo ka hi leh ei up da mai un."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuate sem napi a, nei up nop phiel sih uleh zong tua a nasepte beh um un. Tuaci’n note in keima sungah Pa omin kei zong Pa sunga ka op lamtah thei-in na telsiem ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in ama mat ding a hanciemkia vua, ahi vangin amau’ khut sung panun ama a suohta hi."},"40":{"text":"Jordan gun kantanin ama peikia a, John in mite a baptize masahna munah tungin tuanah a om suoh hi.","ref":"Jhn 1:28"},"41":{"text":"Ama kungah mi tampi pei a, “John in lim lamdang a bawl lo vangin tam mipa tungtang John’ thu gen zosie man hi,” a ci uhi."},"42":{"text":"Mi tampi in khum munah ama a um uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mary le a sanggamnu Martha opna Bethany khuo-ah Lazarus kici mi khat a ci a na hi.","title":"Lazarus’ Sina","ref":"Luk 10:38-39"},"2":{"text":"Mary kici nu pen sathau namtui tawh Topa nu-in a sam tawh a keng nawtpieh nu ahi a, a sanggampa Lazarus dam loin a om hi.","ref":"Jhn 12:3"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n a sanggam numei gel in Jesu kungah thu a puoh vua, “ Topa aw, na it mipa a ci na hi,” a ci uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in tua thu a zah ciengin, “Tami natna pen si nading natna ahi sih hi; tua tungtawnin Pasien Tapa’ min a than thei nading le Pasien’ min a kithansah thei nading hizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu in Martha, Martha’ sanggamnu, le Lazarus te a it mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Lazarus dam lo a zah zaw ciengin a opna munah ni ni a tambe lai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin a nuazuite kungah, “Judea gamah peikia vai,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Nuazuite in, “Siepa aw, Jew mite in tu mama-in suong tawh selia ang sawm uhi, tua sunga peikia ding na mah?” a ci uhi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu in, “Sun khuovah hun nai sawm le nai ni sung hi lo amah? Sun hun sunga lam peite in leitung khuovah a mu ziehun a kipalkha sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin zan lai-a lam peite in khuovah a op lo ziehin a kipalkha uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in tam a cizaw ciengin amate kungah, “I lawmpa uh Lazarus a kimu ahi a, ahi vangin ama phong dingin ka pei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Nuazuite in, “ Topa aw, ama a kimu a hi bo leh ang nuom tuom na va,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in a sina thu gen hi napi, amate in a kimut ngaina maimai gen a sa lel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah sieng tahin gen a, “Lazarus si zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Note in na up thei nadingun tua sunga ka op lona pen note adingin ka kipah mama hi. Ahi vangin ama kungah pei vai,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A kopsuo a kici Thomas in a guol nuazuite kungah, “Ama tawh siton dingin va zui ta vai,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu a tun ciengin Lazarus han sunga a op zaw ni li bang pha zo ci a thei hi.","title":"Jesu, Thawkiana le Hinna"},"18":{"text":"Bethany pen Jerusalem tawh kinai-in tai ni bang kigamla a,"},"19":{"text":"a sanggampa uh a si ziehin ama gel hlai dingin Mary le Martha-te kungah Jew mite tampi a haw uhi."},"20":{"text":"Martha in Jesu ang haw hi, ci a zah ciengin ama dawn dingin pei a, tua laitahin Mary inn ah a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Martha in Jesu kungah, “ Topa , nang tana om hi poma lacin ka naupa a si vawt sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu nangawnin zong ama kunga na nget popo Pasien in ang pie ding hi, ci ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Na sanggampa thokia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Martha in ama kungah, “Ni tawp ni, thawkia ni ciengin ang thokia ding hi, ci ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Keima thawkiana le hinna ka hi hi. Kei ei umte a si vangin a hingkia ding a,"},"26":{"text":"a hing a keima ei um mi zosie a si ngai nawn sih ding uhi. Tami thu na um ei mah?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Martha in, “Ka um hi Topa aw, nang pen leitunga ang pei ding Pasien’ Tapa Messiah na hi hi, ci ka um hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam thu a gen zaw ciengin tua nu a kilekia a, a naunu Mary hlanin, “Siepa tanah om a, nang ang hlan hi,” ci-in a va dap hopi ta hi.","title":"Jesu Kap"},"29":{"text":"Mary in tam thu a zah ciengin thakhatin tho-in ama kungah a pei pai hi."},"30":{"text":"Khum hunin Jesu khuo sung lut nai loin Martha tawh a kimuna munah a om lai hi."},"31":{"text":"Inn sungah ama hlai-a a om Jew mite in kintaha a pusuoh Mary a mu uhi. Amate in hanah a kap dinga pei ding hi va, ci-in a ngaisut ziehun a nua a zui uhi."},"32":{"text":"Jesu opna munah Mary a tun ciengin ama mu a, a keng zungah khupbawhin, “ Topa aw, nang tana a om hi poma lacin ka sanggampa a si vawt sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Jesu in Mary le ama a zui Judah-te’ kaa a mu ciengin a nangeh na mama a, zong lunggim mama hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in, “Hei sunga na siel uh ahiei?” a ci hi. Amate in, “ Topa aw, hing pei inlen hing en in,” a ci uhi."},"35":{"text":"Jesu kaa a kipan hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jew mite in, “En un, nah it sam ei!” a ci uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate pawlkhat in, “Mittaw mit khuo musah thei pa in tampa zong a si lo nadingin bawl thei lo amah?” a ci uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu zong a lunggim kawmin han lam zuonin a pei hi. Tua han pen leihawm ahi a, suongtum khat tawh kisin ahi hi.","title":"Jesu in Lazarus Hingsahkia"},"39":{"text":"Jesu in, “Tua suongtum ladawh un,” a ci hi. Mi sipa’ sanggam nu Martha in ama kungah, “ Topa aw, a si zaw ni li pha ta ahi ziehin namsie ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Na up leh Pasien’ minthanna na mu ding hi, hing ci zo hi lo ka mah?” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in suongtum a ladawh uhi. Tuale Jesu dahto-in, “Pa aw, ka thumna nei ngai ziehin ka lungdam hi."},"42":{"text":"Ka thumnate nei ngai zing lam ka thei a, ahi vangin tam sunga a ding mihonte in, nangma’ ei sawl ahi lam ei up thei nadingun amate adingin thu ka ngen hi,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Tam thu a gen zaw ciengin, “Lazarus aw, hing pusuoh in!” ci-in nahpi-in a kiko hi."},"44":{"text":"A misi pa a khut le a keng diel tawh kituomin, a maitang puon tawh kitunsa-in a pusuoh hi. Jesu in amate kungah, “Phel unlen peisah un,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Mary kunga a haw Judah mi tampite in Jesu’ nasep a mu ziehun ama a um uhi.","title":"Pharisee-te in Jesu Tha Sawm (Mat 26:1-5 ; Mrk 14:1-2 ; Luk 22:1-2)"},"46":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharisee-te kungah pawlkhat pei-in ama’ nasepte a va gen uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempu liente le Pharisee-te in vaihawm uliente khawmin, “Bang i law ta bep ding vuoi? Tam pa in lim lamdang tampi a bawl hi."},"48":{"text":"Tam banga i opsahsah mawh leh mi zosie in ama hing um ding a, Rome-te hing pei-in i siengtho mun le i minam buppi ang susie ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"49":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate lahah tuami kum a siempu lien a sem Caiaphas a kici pa in amate kungah, “Bangma thei vawt sih uteh!"},"50":{"text":"Minam buppi khat a kisiet lo nadingin mi tampi tanga mi khat a si pen note adinga a hoizaw ahi lam na thei sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Tam thu pen ama’ nop thu-a a gen hi loin tuami kum a siempu lien sem ahi ziehin minamte adinga si ding ahina thu le"},"52":{"text":"minamte ding beh hi loin, a kithethang Pasien’ tate pawlkhat a gawmtuo thei nadingin a si ding ahina thu kamsangpa bangin ama in thu mavang a gen hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua ni-a kipanin amate in Jesu tha ding a sawm uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Jew mite lahah a langtangin Jesu a pei nawn sih a, tua mun panin gamlah tawh kinai Ephraim kici khuo ah pei-in a nuazuite tawh tua munah a om suoh hi."},"55":{"text":"Tu-in Judah-te’ Peisan Pawi nai ta a, pawi kipat masangin a kisiensuo dingin gam sung khuote panin Jerusalem ah mi tampi peito uhi."},"56":{"text":"Amate in Jesu sui kawikawi-in biehinn sungah a ding vua, “Bang na ci ngaisut vuoi? Pawi ang sim lo tahtah ding adiei?” ci-in khatlekhat a kidong uhi."},"57":{"text":"Azieh pen siempu liente le Pharisee-te in Jesu a mat thei nadingun Jesu’ opna a thei na op uleh ei hil ta un,’ ci-in thupiehna a nei zo uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peisan pawi kipat ding ni guh a sap ni-in, sina pana kithosah Lazarus’ opna Bethany khuo ah Jesu a tung hi.","title":"Mary in Jesu Sathau Nu (Mat 26:6-23 ; Mrk 14:3-9)"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah amate in ama nitah an a va uhi. Martha in an bawlin Lazarus pen ama tawh ankuong a imton pawlte lahah khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mary in a manpha mama nard kici sathau namtui bung khat la-in Jesu’ keng nupieh a, a sam tawh tuate a nawtpieh hi. Tua sathau namtui gim in innsung teng zelmang sieng hi.","ref":"Luk 7:37-38"},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a nuazuite lahah khat ahi Judas Iscariot (ama lezua ding pa) in,"},"5":{"text":"“Tami sathau namtui denarii za thum tawh zua-in bang dingin tua sum mizawngte kihawmpieh lo ahei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"(Tam bang a gen ciengin mizawngte a khuol zieh hi loin, ama mi guta khat ahi zieh ahi hi; ama in sum-ip kemin a sunga sum kikoite a la thei zel hi.)"},"7":{"text":"Jesu in, “Ama nu tuaci opsah lel un. Ama nu in ka kivui ni cienga zah dingin tuate lei-in a koi hi kha thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Note na hi ule mizawngte tawh na omton zing ding vua, kei ka hile note tawh ka omton zing sih ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 15:11"},"9":{"text":"Tua munah Jesu a op lamtah Judah mihon tampite in a thei ciengun Jesu zieh beh hi loin, sina panin ama in a thawsahkia Lazarus zong ve kawm dingin amate a pei uhi.","title":"Lazarua Kitha Sawm"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu liente in Lazarus zong tha a sawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama hangin Judah mi tampi in amate taisanin Jesu a um uhi."},"12":{"text":"A zing ciengin pawi sim mihon tampite in Jerusalem lamah Jesu pei ci a za uhi.","title":"Guolzawna tawh Jerusalem-a Jesu a Lutna (Mat 21:1-11 ; Mrk 11:1-11 ; Luk 19:28-40)"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in lutu baate tawi-in ama dawn dingin a kuon vua, “Hosanna! Topa’ min tawh ang pei Israel Kumpi pa in thupha nga taheh!” ci-in a kiko uhi.","ref":"Late 118:25-26"},"14":{"text":"Jesu in laano khat mu-in a tungah a tuong hi. Tami thu Lai Siengtho sungah:"},"15":{"text":"“Zion tanu aw, zau sin. En in, na kumpipa uh hing pei-in, laano tungah a tuong hi!” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Zech 9:9"},"16":{"text":"A nuazuite in tam thu a cilin a thei sih uhi; ahi vangin minthanna tawh Jesu a thawkia zaw bepin amate in Jesu’ thu tam bangin na kigiel a, ama tungah tam bangin na kibawl hi, ci-in a nua phaw pan na bo uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n han sung panin Lazarus hlan dawhin sina panin ama a thawsahna thute, khumlai-a ama kunga om mihonte in teci a pang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Jesu in tam bang lim lamdang a bawlna thu mihonte in a zah ziehun ama dawn dingin a pei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pharisee-te khatlekhat kiho-in, “Thei un, bangma na law zo ta sih uhi. En un, leitung mi zosie in ama a zui sieng ta uhi,” a kici uhi."},"20":{"text":"Pawi hun sungin Pasien bie dinga a peite lahah pawlkhat Greek mi ahi uhi.","title":"Greek Mi Pawlkhat in Jesu Sui"},"21":{"text":"Galilee gam Bethsaida khuomi Philip kungah amate haw-in, “Siepa aw, Jesu ka mu nuom uhi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Philip pei-in Andrew kungah a gen hi; tua ciengin Andrew le Philip zong pei-in Jesu kungah a gensawn uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in amate kungah, “Mihing Tapa a minthan ding hun a tung zo hi."},"24":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, lei-ah mangbuhum tang khat kie-in a si phot sih leh, tang khat beh ma om den ding hi; ahi vangin a si leh ga tampi a ga hi."},"25":{"text":"A hinna a it mite in mansuo ding a, tami leitunga a hinna a muda mite in kumtawn hinna a nei ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; 16:25; Mrk 8:35; Luk 9:24; 17:33"},"26":{"text":"Ka na a sem poma in ka nua ei zui kul a, ka opna ah ka nasempa zong a om ding hi. Ka na a sem poma Pa in a patawi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tu-in ka lungsim a gim mama hi. Tuale bang ka gen ta diei, ‘Pa aw, tam hun panin ei hunkhie in,’ ka ci ta ding amah? Hi lo hi, tam thu hang tawh tami hun a ang pei ka hi hi.","title":"Jesu In a Si Ding Gen"},"28":{"text":"Pa aw, na min thangsah ta’n,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin vantung panin aw khat ging a, “Ka thangsah zo a, khatvei ka thangsahkia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua munah a om mihonpite in za-in vanto ahi hi, a ci uhi. Adangte in, “Vantungmi khat in ama hopi hi,” a ci uhi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu in, “Tami awging pen kei ading ahi sih a, note dinga ang ging hizaw hi."},"31":{"text":"Tu-in tam leitung in thukhenna thuoh ding uhi; tu-in tami leitung uhpa kihawlkhie ta ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuale leitung panin ei kikhaito ciengin keima lamah mi zosie ka kai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in tam bang thu a gen ciengin a si cienga bangci dan a si ding ci a lah ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Mihonpi in, “Messiah pen a om zing ding ahi hi, ci thukham bu panin ka thei uhi. Nang in bang dinga Mihing Tapa kikhaito ding hi, na ci thei ahei? Tami Mihing Tapa koi ahei?” a ci uhi.","ref":"Late 110:4; Isa 9:7; Ezk 37:25; Dan 7:14"},"35":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Note tawh khuovah bakhat sung beh om lai ding hi. Khuomiel in note ang phah lo nadingin khuovah na nei petun pei un. Khuomiel sunga na pei uleh hei lam pei ci na thei sih uhi."},"36":{"text":"Khuovah’ tate na suo thei nadingun note in khuovah na nei petun tua khuovah um un,” a ci hi. Jesu in tam thu a gen zaw ciengin pei-in amate kung pan a kiphuol hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesu in amate muna-ah lim lamdang tampi lah nanle amate in ama a um tuom sih uhi.","title":"Mite’ Uplona"},"38":{"text":"Kamsang Isaiah in: “ Topa aw, ka thugen uh koi in um a, koi tungah Topa’ ban thahat kilang ahei?” ci-a a thugen a tangtun thei nading ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 53:1"},"39":{"text":"Tuale amate in a um zo sih uhi, azieh pen kamsang Isaiah in zong,"},"40":{"text":"“Amate in a mit utawh en loin, a lungtang utawh thei-a ang kihei lo nadingun, ama in a mit uh tawsahin, a lungtang uh a khausah hi. Tua hi sihle keima in amate ka damsah kha ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 6:10"},"41":{"text":"Isaiah in a minthanna mu ahi ziehin ama’ thu tam banga a gen ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi vangin vaihawm thuneite nangawn in ama a um uhi. Pharisee-te in kikhopna inn pan a nawmang ding a zau ziehun amate in a pulah ngam sih uhi."},"43":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in Pasien’ patah ding sangin mite’ patah ding a deizaw uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in, “Kei ei um poma in kei ei um hi loin kei ei sawlpa um hizaw hi.","title":"Jesu’ Thuhilna Tomkim"},"45":{"text":"Kei ei mu poma in kei ei sawlpa zong a mu hi."},"46":{"text":"Kei ei um poma in khuomiel sungah a op lo nadingin leitungah khuovah banga ang pei ka hi hi."},"47":{"text":"Ka thugente za-in a zui lo mi khatpo tungah keima in thu ka khen sih hi, azieh pen leitung thu khen dinga ang pei ka hi sih a, leitung hundam dinga ang pei ka hizaw hi."},"48":{"text":"Kei ei nielin ka thugen a sang lo mi pa in thukhenpa khat a nei hi; nitawp ni ciengin ka gensa thu teng pen thukhen pa-a ang pang ding ahi hi."},"49":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kei nop thu tawh a gen ka hi sih a, ei sawl Pa in bang genin bang sut ding ci-a ei thupieh teng a gen ka hi bo hi."},"50":{"text":"Ama’ thupiehte kumtawn hinna ahi, ci ka thei hi. Tua ahi ziehin ka gen thute ahile Pa in gen in, ei ci banga a gen ka hi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peisan pawi masangin Jesu in leitung panin a Pa kunga a pei ding hun tung ta hi, ci a thei hi. Ama in leitunga a it ama’ mite a tawp dongin a it hi.","title":"Jesu in Nuazuite’ Keng Silpieh"},"2":{"text":"Jesu a leheh dingin Simon Iscariot’ tapa Judas’ lungtangah dawimangpa in ngaisutna koi zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Pa in ama’ khut sungah na zosie pie-in ama pen Pasien kung pana ang pei hi a, Pasien kunga peikia ding ahi lam zong Jesu in thei ahi ziehin,"},"4":{"text":"sabuoi panin ama dingto a, a puontuol suo dawhin mainul khat tawh a kawng a gah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in kuong sung khatah tui sungin a nuazuite keng a silpieh a, a kawnga a viel mainul tawh nawtpieh ding a kipan hi."},"6":{"text":"“ Topa aw, ka keng ei silpieh laizang ding na hi amah?” a ci Simon Peter kungah ama a tung hi."},"7":{"text":"Jesu in, “Tu-in bang bawl ka hei, ci na thei sih a, ahi vangin a nua ciengin na thei ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Peter in ama kungah, “Ka keng na sil ngai poma sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Jesu in, “Na keng kang silpieh sih leh kei tawh a kipawl lo na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Simon Peter in ama kungah, “ Topa aw, ka keng guoh hi loin ka khut le ka lu zong ei silpieh vet in!” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “A kipumsilsa mi in a keng longal sil ding a kisam ta sih a, a pumpi zosie a siengsa ahi hi. Tuale note na unpi-un na sien vangun na sieng kim sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in a leheh ding pa a thei hi; tami thu ziehin ama in, “Na unpi-un na sieng kim sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a keng uh a silpieh zaw ciengin a puontuol sil a, anneh sabuoi lamah kilekia-in a kung vuah, “Note adinga ka septe na thei vuoi mah?"},"13":{"text":"Kei pen Siepa le Topa nei ci vua, tua pen a man ahi hi, azieh pen nei ci bangun ka hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci’n na Topa ule na Siepa uh ahi keima in na keng uh hing silpieh ka hi leh note in zong khatlekhat na kisilpieh ding uh a kilawm hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in na tung vua ka bawl banga note in zong na bawl thei nadingun ette dinga kang pieh ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 22:27"},"16":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, nasemte pen a pupa sangin lienzaw lo a, a kisawl pa zong a sawl pa sangin lienzaw lo hi.","ref":"Mat 10:24; Luk 6:40; Jhn 15:20"},"17":{"text":"Tam thute thei-in tuate na zui uleh mi hampha na hi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na unpi vua ang gen ka hi sih hi; keima in ka teelsa mite ka thei hi. Ahi vangin tami pen Lai Siengtho sungah, ‘Ka an a ne mipa in a aketul tawh ei peh hi,’ ci-a a kigen thu a tangtun thei nading ahi hi.","ref":"Late 41:9"},"19":{"text":"Tami thu a pien ciengin kei ama ka hi lam nei thei nadingun tu-in a pien masanga ang magen ka hi hi."},"20":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, ka sawl mi a sang poma in kei zong ei sang hi a, kei ei sang mi poma in kei ei sawl pa zong a sang ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Mrk 9:37; Luk 9:48; 10:16"},"21":{"text":"Jesu in tam thu a gen zaw ciengin a lungkham mama a, “A tahtah a kang ci-in, note lahah khat in kei ei leheh ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.","title":"Jesu in a Kileheh ding Magen (Mat 26:20-25 ; Mrk 14:17-21 ; Luk 22:21-23)"},"22":{"text":"Koi pen gen ahei, ci-in a nuazuite khatlekhat a ki-en uhi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu in a it a nuazuite lahah khat pa in Jesu nehin ama zomah a kingam phei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Simon Peter in a mit-heh tawh ama hopi a, “Koi a ci nopna adiei,” ci-in Jesu dong dingin a sawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jesu lamah ama a zamphei laitahin, “ Topa aw, koi ahei?” ci-in a dong hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kuong sungah khomun halkhat ka die zaw cienga ka pieh ding pa ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tuaci’n khomun halkhat a die zaw ciengin ama in Simon Iscariot’ tapa Judas a pie hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in khomun halkhat a san zaw ciengin a sungah Satan a lut pai hi. Jesu in ama kungah, “Na bawl dingte nawbawl ta’n,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Bang dingin ama kungah tam thu a gen adiei, ci thu sabuoi-a omte koima in thei lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in Judas pen taangpi sumkem ahi ziehin Jesu in ama kungah, “Pawi cienga i tulmaw ding vante va lei ta’n,” ci-a a sawl ahi sihle, mi zawngte bangkhat pie dinga a sawl hi ding hi, ci-in a ngaisun uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n khomun halkhat a san zaw ciengin thakhatin a pusuoh pai hi. Tua hun pen zanlai ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Judas a pusuo zaw ciengin Jesu in, “Tu-in Mihing Tapa kipatawi a, ama sungah Pasien a kipatawi hi.","title":"Thupieh Tha"},"32":{"text":"Ama sungah Pasien a kiminthansah leh Pasien in zong ama sungah Tapa’ min a thangsah ding a, thakhatin ama’ min kithangsah pai ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ka tanote aw, note tawh bakhat sung beh ka om ding hi. Note in kei nei sui ding uhi; tuale Jew mite kungah, ‘Ka peina munah nang pei thei sih ding uhi’ ci-a ka gen bangin tu-in zong note kungah kang gen hi.","ref":"Jhn 7:34"},"34":{"text":"Note khatlekhat na ki-it nadingun keima in note tungah thupieh tha khat kang pie hi. Keima in note kang it bangin note zong khatlekhat na ki-it un.","ref":"Jhn 15:12, 17; 1Jhn 3:23; 2Jhn 5"},"35":{"text":"Note khatlekhat na ki-it uleh tam thu ziehin mi zosie in ka nuazuite na hi lamtah uh ang thei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Simon Peter in ama kungah, “ Topa , hei-a pei ding na hei?” a ci hi. Jesu in, “Tu-in ka pei nading munah nei zui thei sih ding hi; ahi vangin nualam ciengin nei zui thei ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Jesu in Peter’ Niel ding Magen (Mat 26:31-35 ; Mrk 14:27-31 ; Luk 22:31-34)"},"37":{"text":"Peter in ama kungah, “ Topa , bang zieha kang zui thei lo ding ahei? Nang adingin ka hinna kang pie ding hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kei adingin na hinna nei pie ngam diei mah? A tahtah a kang ci-in, aah khuon masangin thumvei nei niel ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note kilungkhamsah sih un. Pasien um unlen kei zong ei um un.","title":"Jesu, Pa Kung Pei nading Lampi"},"2":{"text":"Ka pa inn sungah op nading mun tampi a om hi. A om lo hileh na op nading uh mun siem dingin ka va pei ta ding hi, ci-in kang gen ding amah?"},"3":{"text":"Kei pei-in note adingin opna ding mun ka va siem tah leh, ka opna munah no zong nang op thei nadingun no ang la dingin kang peikia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Note in ka pei nading mun na thei uhi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Thomas in, “ Topa , na pei nading ka thei sih uhi. Kote in lampi bangci thei ding ka hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Keima in lampi, thuman thutah, le hinna ka hi hi. Kei ei suong loin Pa kungah koima tung thei lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima nei thei uleh ka Pa zong na thei ding uhi. Tu-a kipanin ama thei-in, na mu zo ta uhi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Philip in, “ Topa aw, Pa ei lah in, tua hile ka lung a kim ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Philip aw, nang tawh tami hun sung zosie hing omton sam ing a, kei ei thei nai lo na hi amah? Kei ei mu poma in ka Pa a mu zo ta hi. Bang dingin, ‘Pa ei lah in,’ ci thei na hei?"},"10":{"text":"Pa sungah kei ka om a, kei sungah Pa a om hi, ci na um sih amah? Na kunga kang gen thute keima’ thu-a kang gen ahi sih hi; kei sunga a teng Pa in ama’ na a sem hizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Pa sungah kei ka om a, kei sungah Pa a om lamtah note in um un; na up sih uleh, ka sepsate ziehin um un."},"12":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, keima ei um mi in keima’ sep nate ma a sem ding a, kei Pa kungah pei ta ding ka hi ziehin tamte sangin a lienzaw nasepte a sem lai ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tapa sunga Pa a kipatawi nadingin keima’ min suonga na nget popo uh keima in kang bawlpieh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima’ min suongin note in kei kungah na khatpopo nang nget uleh kang pie ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Kei nei it uleh ka thuciemte na zui ding uhi.","title":"Hlagau Siengtho Kikham"},"16":{"text":"Keima in Pa kungah thu ka ngen ding a, ama in note ang ompi zing dingin adang Hupa khat ang pie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung mite in tua thuman Hlagau Siengtho pen mu thei lo, theithei lo uh ahi ziehin a sang zo sih uhi. Note tawh ama ang tenton ziehin ama na thei vua, tuale note sungah ama ang om ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Note a taga dingin kang nuasie sih ding hi; na kung vuah kang pei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitung in bakhat sung ei mu nawn lo ding a, ahi vangin note in nei mu ding uhi; kei ka hin ziehin no zong na hing ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin Pa sungah kei ka om a, kei sungah no omin, no sungah kei ka op lam note in na thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ka thupiehte nei-a, a zui mite pen keima ei it ahi uhi; kei ei itte in ka Pa zong it ding a, ke’n zong amate it-in amate tungah kei le kei ka kilah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Judas (Iscariot ahi lo) in, “ Topa aw, leitunga kilah lo pi-in, ko tungah nang le nang bang ang ci kilah thei ding na hei?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kei ei itte in ka thu zui-in ka Pa in amate it ding a, amate kungah kote pei-in ka tengton ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Kei ei it lo poma in ka thu a zui sih hi; tu-a na zah uh thute kei-a’ ahi sih a, kei ei sawl Pa-a’ ahi zaw hi."},"25":{"text":"“Note tawh ka opton lai-in na kung vuah tam thute kang gen zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pa in keima’ min tawh ang sawl ding Hupa Hlagau Siengtho in na zosie ang hil ding a, ama in na kung vua kang gensa thu zosie ang phawhsahkia ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima in note tungah lungnopna kang nuasie hi; note tungah ka lungnopna kang pie hi. Keima in leitung mite pieh bangin kang pie sih hi. Kilungmangsah sih unlen zong zau sih un."},"28":{"text":"‘Keima ka va pei ta ding a, na kung vuah kang peikia ding hi,’ ci ka gen thu na za zo uhi. Kei nei it uleh Pa kunga pei ding ka hi ziehin na kipah ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile kei sangin Pa a lienzaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam thu ang pien tahtah ciengin na up thei nadingun a pien masangin na kung vua kang magen ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tu-in leitung thu vaihawmpa ang pei zo tah ziehin note tungah thu tampi kang gen ta sih ding hi. Ama in keima tungah thuneina bangma a nei sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pa ka it lamtah leitung mite in a theithei nadingin Pa ei thupieh bangin ka sem hi. Ding un, tam panin pei ta vai."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Kei lengga gui tahtah ka hi a, ka Pa pen lengga lonei pa ahi hi.","title":"Jesu Lengga Gui Tahtah"},"2":{"text":"Ama in keima sunga a ga lo baa zosie a paimang ding hi. Ga nei a baate a ga semsem nadingin ama in heu-in a hasieng hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima in note kunga kang gen thute ziehin note ang siengthosah zo ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Note sunga ka op bangin note zong keima sungah om un. Lengga baa pen lenggui tawh a kizop sih leh a matanga a ga thei lo bangin, no zong kei tawh na kizop sih uleh ga na ga thei sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Keima lengga gui ka hi a, note a baa na hi uhi. Keima sungah tengin amate sunga kei ka ten leh amate in ga tampi a ga ding uhi, azieh pen kei loin note in bangma na bawl thei sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kei sunga a om lo poma a kipaimang a baate bangin a vulgawp hi; tua bang a baate kikhawm a, meikhuh sungah kipai-in a katum hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima sungah na op vua, note sungah ka thu a op leh na dei popo ngen locin note adingin ang kibawlpieh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ga tampi ga-in ka nuazui na suona ziehun note in ka Pa’ min na thangsah ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pa in kei ei it bangin ke’n zong note kang it hi; keima’ ang itna sungah om un."},"10":{"text":"Ka Pa thupiehte zui-a ama’ itna sunga ka op bangin, note in ka thupiehte na zui uleh keima’ itna sungah na om ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Note sungah ka kipahna a op thei nading le note’ kipahna a bukim thei nadingin na kung vuah tam thute kang gen zo hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tami pen ka thupieh ahi hi, keima in note kang it bangin note zong khatlekhat khat na ki-it un.","ref":"Jhn 13:34; 15:17; 1Jhn 3:23; 2Jhn 5"},"13":{"text":"A lawmte adinga a hinna a pie ngam itna sanga a lienzaw itna koima in nei lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Note in ka thupiehte na zui uleh ka lawmte na hi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Note pen nasemte kang ci nawn sih ding hi, azieh pen nasempa in a pupa’ sep bang ahei, ci a thei sih hi; keima in lawmte kang cizaw hi, azieh pen keima in ka Pa kunga ka thuzah zosie note kang theisah zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Note in kei nei teel sih vua, keima in note kang teelzaw hi. Tuale note pei-in a kimang zing ding gate a ga dingin kang se zo hi. Tuaci’n keima’ min suongin note in ama kunga na nget popo uh Pa in ang pie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Note khatlekhat na ki-it nadingun keima in tami thupieh kang pie hi."},"18":{"text":"“Leitung mite in note ang muda leh, note ang muda masangin kei ei muda zo hi, ci thu thei un.","title":"Leitung Mite’ Mudana"},"19":{"text":"Note pen leitung-a’ na hi uleh leitung in ama-a’ bangin ang it ding hi. Note pen leitung-a’ hi loin leitung pana kang teelsa na hi ziehun leitung in note ang muda hi."},"20":{"text":"Note kungah, ‘Nasemte pen a pupa sangin lienzaw lo hi,’ ci-a kang thugen phawh un. Amate in ei bawlsiet uleh no zong ang bawlsie ding uhi; amate in ka thugen a man uleh no-a’ zong a mang ding uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:24; Luk 6:40; Jhn 13:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima’ min ziehin amate in na tung vuah tamte zosie ang bawl ding uhi, azieh pen amate in kei ei sawlpa a thei sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Amate kungah pei-in thu gen lo hi leng amate a maw sih ding uhi; hinanle tu-in amate in a mawna tungtang vuah hamlap ding a nei ta sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kei ei muda poma in ka Pa zong a muda ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate lahah koima dang’ bawl ngai lo nate va bawl ta sih leng amate a maw sih ding uhi. Ahi vangin tu-in amate in ka sil bawlte a mu zo vua, kei le ka Pa ei muda ton uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"A thukham sung vuah, ‘Thu om lopi-in kei ei muda gumsan uhi,’ ci-a a kigiel thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.","ref":"Late 35:19; 69:4"},"26":{"text":"“Pa kung pana ang pei, thuman thutah Hlagau Siengtho ahi Pa kung panin na kung vua kang sawl ding Hupa ang pei ciengin kei tangin teci ang pang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A cil a kipanin kei tawh omton na hi ziehun note in zong keima tungtang teci na pang ding uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note na puakhah lo nadingun keima in na kung vuah tam thute kang gen zo hi."},"2":{"text":"Amate in kikhopna inn panin note ang nawmang ding uhi. A tahtahin, no ang thatte in tua banga a bawlna uh ziehin Pasien bie-a a kingaisut ding uh hun ang tung ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in Pa ahi a, kei ka hi zongin ei thei lo ziehun tam bang ang sem ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin a hun uh ang tun ciengin tam thute kang gensa ahi lam na phaw nading vua tu-a kang gen ahi hi. “A kipat cilin note tawh ka opton ziehin na kung vuah tam thute kang gen vateh sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in ei sawlpa kungah ka pei ta ding hi; koima khat beh in, “Hei-a pei ding na hei? ci-in nei dong vawt sih uhi.","title":"Hla Siengtho’ Nasepna"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam bang ka ci ziehin lah na da mama vanuh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin thuman thutah kang gen hi: Kei pei leng no adingin a hoizaw hi, azieh pen kei pei sih leng na kung vuah Hupa ang pei sih ding hi; kei ka pei leh na kung vuah ama kang sawl ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama ang tun ciengin leitung mite’ mawna, dihna le thukhennate kawhin leitung mite’ khielna teltahin ang lah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mawna thu-ah, amate in kei ei up lo ziehun a maw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Dihna thu tawh kisai-in, Pa kungah ka pei ding a, nei mu nawn sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Thukhenna thu-ah, tam leitung uhpa in mawsah thukhenna a thuoh zo ta hi."},"12":{"text":"“Na kung vua kang gen ding thu tampi om lai hi, hizongle tu-in na sang thei nai sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Thuman Hlagau Siengtho ang tun ciengin ama in thuman zosie-ah ang pui ding hi; azieh pen ama’ thu ang gen ding hi loin, a thu zah popo ang gen ding hizaw a, na kung vuah ang tung ding nate ang gen ding ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in kei-a’ teng la-in note kunga ang gen ding ahi ziehin ama in ka min a thangsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Pa neisa zosie kei-a’ ahi hi. Tami thu ziehin ama in kei-a’ teng la-in na kung vuah ang gen ding hi, a ci ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Bakhat sung kei nei mu nawn sih ding vua, bakhat zaw ciengin nei mukia ding uhi,” a ci hi.","title":"Dana, Lungdamna Suoh Ding"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nuazuite pawlkhat khatlekhat kiho-in, ‘Bakhat sung nei mu nawn sih ding vua, bakhat zaw ciengin nei mukia ding uh,’ a ci le, ‘A zieh pen ka Pa kungah ka pei ding hi,’ ci-a i kunga ang gen pen bang a cinopna ahi diei?” a kici uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in, ‘Bakhat sung a ci pen bang a ci na adiei? Ama bang gen ahei, ci i thei sih uhi,” a kici uhi."},"19":{"text":"A dot nop lam uh Jesu in a thei ciengin amate kungah, ‘Bakhat sung kei nei mu nawn sih ding vua, bakhat zaw ciengin nei mukia ding uhi,’ ka ci pen kidong na hi uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, note kapin na mau ding vua, ahi vangin leitung mite a lungdam ding hi; note na da ding vua, ahi vangin na danate uh lungdamna a suoh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Numei khat in a tasuo hun tung ahi ziehin a na a thuoh hi. Ahi vangin nau a suo ciengin leitungah nausen khat a pien ziehin lungdamin a gimthuoh teng a phawhkha nawn sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in tu-in gimna na thuoh uhi; hizongle keima in note kang mukia ding a, na kipah ding uhi, note kung panin koima in na kipahna uh ang lahpieh thei sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin note in bangma nei dong ta sih ding uhi. A tahtah a kang ci-in, keima’ min suongin Pa kunga na nget popo uh ama in ang pie ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka min tawh tu dongin bangma na ngen nai sih uhi. Na lungdamna uh a bukim thei nadingin ngen un, na nga ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Keima in note tungah thugentena tawh tam thute kang gen zo hi. Thugentena tawh ka gen nawn lo ding hun ang tung ding a, Pa tungtang thu cientahin kang genzaw ta ding hi.","title":"Nuazuite ading Lungnopna"},"26":{"text":"Tua ni ciengin note in keima’ min suongin na ngen ding uhi. Keima in note tangin Pa kungah hing ngetpieh vang a ci ka hi sih hi;"},"27":{"text":"azieh pen note in keima ei itin, Pa kung pana ang pei ka hi lam nei up ziehun, Pa mama in zong note ang it ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Pa kung pan hing pei-in leitungah kang tung zo hi; leitung nuasie-in Pa kungah khatvei ka peikia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"A nuazuite in, “Hi hi, tu-in thugen tena zang loin cientahin na gen hi!"},"30":{"text":"Tu-in na zosie na thei a, koima’ dawh kisam lo hi, ci ka thei tah ziehun, Pasien kung pana ang kipan na hi lam kang um ta uhi,” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Jesu in, “Tu-in nei um ta sam vuoi mah?"},"32":{"text":"Note kithethangin na inn ciet uh zuonin kei guoh nei nuasie ding uh hun ang tung ding a, tu-in ang tung tahtah ta hi. Ahi vangin Pa tawh omton ka hi ziehin kei matang ka hi sam sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Note in keima sungah lungnopna na nei thei nadingun na kung vua tami thu kang gen ahi hi. Note in leitungah gimna na thuoh ding uhi. Ahi vangin kihangsansah un; keima in leitung ka zozo hi!” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in tam thu teng a gen zaw ciengin vantung ento-in, “Pa aw, a hun ang tung ta hi; Tapa in na min ang thansah thei nadingin nang in na Tapa’ min hing thangsah in,","title":"Jesu in a Nuazuite ading Thungen"},"2":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ama na piehsa mi zosie tungah ama in nuntah tawntungna a pieh thei nadingin mi zosie tungah thuneina ama na pie zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale amate in nang beh Pasien man tahtah na hina le na sawlpa Jesu Khris a thei siemna uh pen kumtawn hinna ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in sep dinga nei pieh nasep ka mansiengna tawh leitungah na min ka thangsah zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pa aw, leitung pien masangin na kunga ka neisa minthanna tawh tu-in na omna munah ei minthangsah ta’n."},"6":{"text":"“Leitung mite sung panin nei piehsate tungah keima in na min ka kitheisah zo hi. Amate nangma-a’ hi a, nangma in kei tungah amate nei pie zo ta a, amate in na thu a mang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in ahile amate in kei nei pieh zosie nang kung pan ahi lam a thei ta uhi;"},"8":{"text":"azieh pen kei nei pieh thute ma amate ka pie a, amate in zong tua thute a sang vua, nangma kung panin thuman thutah sunga ang pei ka hina thu amate in a thei uhi; tuale amate in nangma’ ei sawl ka hi lam zong a um uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kema in amate tangin thu kang ngetpieh hi; leitung mite adingin thu ka ngen sih a, nei piehsa mite adingin thu ka ngenzaw hi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate nangma-a’ ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Keima’ neisa zosie nangma-a’ hi a, nangma’ neisa zosie zong keima-a’ ahi hi; tuate sungah keima ei kiminthangsah zo ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in leitungah ka om nawn sih hi, ahi vangin amate pen leitungah a omlai vua, kei ka hile nangma kungah kang pei ta ding hi. Siengtho Pa aw, ei gel pum khat i hi ma bangin amate zong pumkhat a suo thei nadingun, na min tawh keima nei piehsa amate dal in."},"12":{"text":"Amate tawh ka opton laitahin nei piehsa amate na min tawh ka kem zo hi. Amate ka dal a, Lai Siengtho a tangtun nadingin a mangthai dinga kilaitansa mipa khat simlo koima khat beh a pelem a om sih hi.","ref":"Late 41:9; Jhn 13:18"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in na kunga ang pei ding ka hi ta a, amate mama sungah ka lungdamna bucing a nei thei nadingun leitung ka op lai-in tami thute ka gen zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in amate tungah na thu ka pie zo hi, kei leitung-a’ ka hi lo ma bangin amate zong leitung-a’ ahi lo ziehun leitung in amate a muda hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitung panin amate na lahkhiet ding ang ngen ka hi sih a, gilopa kung panin na dal ding ang ngen ka hizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei pen leitung-a’ ka hi lo ma bangin amate zong leitung-a’ ahi sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Thuman thutah sungah amate na siensuo in; na thu in thuman ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Leitungah kei nei sawl ma bangin, kei zong amate leitungah ka sawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Thuman thutah sungah amate zong a kisiensuo thei nadingun, amate ka khuolna-in keima le keima ka kisiensuo hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tam mite ading beh ang ngen ka hi sih a, amau’ thugenna ziehin keima ei um ding mite adingin zong ang ngen ka hi hi."},"21":{"text":"Pa aw, kei nei sawl lam leitung mite in a up thei nading ule kei sungah nang na om a, nang sungah kei ka op bangin, amate zong eite sungah omin a unpi-un pumkhat a suo thei nadingun thu kang ngen hi."},"22":{"text":"Nang le kei pumkhat i suo bangin amate zong pumkhat a suo thei nadingin keima in nei pieh minthanna amate ka pie zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate pumkhat a suo sieng thei nadingun amate sungah kei ka om a, kei sungah nang na om hi, tuaci’n kei leitunga nei sawl ahi lam le kei nei it bangin amate zong na it lam leitung mite in a thei ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Pa aw, nei piehsate in zong leitung pien masanga kei nei it zieha nei piehsa ka minthanna a mu dingin ka opna ah kei tawh amate ang op ding uh ka lunggul hi."},"25":{"text":"“A thuman ka Pa aw, leitung mite in ang thei sih vangin keima in nang kang thei hi; tuale tamte in zong kei nei sawl lam a thei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Amate na min ka theisah zo ta a, amate sungah kei nei itna za itna a op thei nading le, amate sungah kei ka op thei nadingin keima in na min ka theisah lai ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in tam teng a gen zaw ciengin a nuazuite tawh Kidron kuom kantanin khum munah a om um khat sungah a nuazuite tawh a lut hi.","title":"Jesu, a Kilehehna le a Kimatna (Mat 26:47-56 ; Mrk 14:43-50 ; Luk 22:47-53)"},"2":{"text":"Khum mun pen Jesu in a nuazuite a kimupi zelna mun ahi ziehin a leheh pa Judas in zong a mun a thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n Judas in siempute le Pharisee-te kung panin galkap honkhat le palihte zawpi a, lalcin, meila, le galhiemte tawi-in a pei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jesu in ama tunga a pieng ding thu zosie a thei zo tah ziehin va pei-in amate kungah, “Koi sui na hi vuoi?” ci-in a dong hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in, “Nazareth mi Jesu,” ci-in a dawng uhi. Jesu in, “Kei, ama ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Ama leheh pa Judas zong amate tawh a dington hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Kei, ama ka hi hi,” ci-in a gen ciengin amate nuakinin tuolah a pua uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jesu in, “Koi pen sui na hi vuoi?” ci-in a dongkia hi. Amate in, “Nazareth mi Jesu sui ka hi uhi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kei, ama ka hi hi, ci-in kang gen zo ta hi. Tuaci’n kei ei sui na hi uleh tam mite peisah ta un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam pen, “Nangma in kei nei piehte khat beh ka mansuo sih hi,” ci-a a gensa thu a tangtun nading ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin Simon Peter in a namsau kuo dawhin siempu lienpen pa’ sila khat a sat leh a bil zietlam a bantan hi. Tua silapa’ min Malchus ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu in Peter kungah, “Na namsau a paai-ah sietkia in. Pa in ei piehsa hai dawn lo ding ka mah?” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 26:39; Mrk 14:36; Luk 22:42"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n galkapte, a galkap bupa, le Judah palihte in Jesu manin khau tawh a khi uhi.","title":"Siempu Lien Pa Mai-ah Jesu (Mat 26:57-58 ; Mrk 14:53-54 ; Luk 22:54)"},"13":{"text":"Tua kuma siempu lien a sem Caiaphas’ sungpa Annas kungah a peipi masa uhi."},"14":{"text":"Caiaphas kici pa pen mipite’ tangin mi khat a si ding hoizaw hi, ci-in Judah mite thumop pa ahi hi.","ref":"Jhn 11:49-50"},"15":{"text":"Simon Peter le a nuazui dang khat in Jesu a zui uhi. Siempu lien pa le nuazuipa a kimelthei ziehin siempu lien pa’ inn huong sungah Jesu tawh a lutton hi,","title":"Peter In Jesu Niel (Mat 26:69-70 ; Mrk 14:53-54 ; Luk 22:55-57)"},"16":{"text":"ahi vangin tunkot pulamah Peter a ding hi. Tuaci’n siempu lien pa tawh a kimelthei tua nuazui dang khat pusuohin kotcing numei nu hopi a, Peter zong a lutpi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua numei nu in Peter kungah, “Nang zong tam pa’ nuazuite lahah khat hi lo na mah?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Hi sing,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Dam a nat ziehin silate le palihte in meihol a taw vua, mei awi-in a kimkotah a ding uhi. Peter zong amate tawh dingin mei a awi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa in Jesu kungah a nuazuite thu le a thuhilna tawh kisai thute a dong hi.","title":"Siempu Lien Pa in Jesu Thudong (Mat 26:59-66 ; Mrk 14:55-64 ; Luk 22:66-71)"},"20":{"text":"Jesu in, “Keima in leitung mite mai-ah a langtangin ka gen zo hi; Jew mite zosie’ kisuhtuona ahi kikhopna innte le biehinnpi sungah thu ka hil zing a, bangma ka dapgen sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang dinga nei dawh ahei? Ka thugen a zasate kungah bang ka gen ahei, ci va kidawh ta’n. Amate in bang ka gen ci a thei uhi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in tam teng a genzaw ciengin a gei-a a ding palihte khat in Jesu phebeh a, “Siempu lien pa tam banga na dawn ding ma amah?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu in, “Ka genkhiel leh ka khielna ei lahtel in. Ahi vangin mantaha ka gen ahile bang dinga nei phebeh ahei?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin Annas in Jesu khaukhisa-in siempu lien pa Caiaphas kungah a puoh hi."},"25":{"text":"Mei awi-in Simon Peter a din laitahin amate in, “Nang zong ama’ nuazuite khat hi lo na mah?” ci-in a dong uhi. Ama in, “Hi malmal sing,” ci-in a niel hi.","title":"Peter In Jesu Nielkia"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa’ silate lahah Peter in a bil a satpieh pa’ sanggamte khat in, “Ama tawh um sungah hing mu hi lo ka mah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"27":{"text":"Peter zong kilepin nielkia leuleu a, tua hun lienin aah a khuong hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Caiaphas inn panin Pilat’ kumpi inn ah Jesu a peipi uhi. Tua hun pen zingmawng phalva pat ahi hi. Biehna ngaina tawh kisai bua bannate tawh kipelin Peisan pawi a neh thei nadingun kumpi inn sungah amate a lut sih uhi.","title":"Pilat Mai-ah Jesu (Mat 27:1-2 , 11-14 ; Mrk 15:1-5 ; Luk 23:1-5)"},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pilat pusuohin, “Tam pa na mawmat nopna uh bang ahei?” ci-in amate dong hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in, “Tam pa in sietna a bawl lo hi leh na kungah kang ap sih ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"31":{"text":"Pilat in, “Ama peipi ulen, noma’ thukham bangin ama tungah thu kikhen ta un,” a ci hi. Jew mite in, “Kote in mi tha thei nading thu ka nei sih uhi,” ci-in a dawngkia uhi."},"32":{"text":"(Tam pen bangci banga sina thuoh ding ci, Jesu in a gensa thute a tangtun nading ahi hi.)","ref":"Jhn 3:14; 12:32"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin a kumpi inn sungah Pilat tumkia-in Jesu hlansah a, “Nang, Judah-te’ Kumpi na hi amah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu in, “Nangma’ ngaisut tawm a nei dawh amah, ahi sihle midangte in na kunga kei thu ang gen ahei?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"35":{"text":"Pilat in, “Kei Judah mi ka mah? Na mite le siempu liente in ka kungah nang ei ap zo hi. Bang ahiei na bawl?” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"36":{"text":"Jesu in, “Ka kumpi gam pen tami leitung pan ahi sih hi. Ka kumpi gam tami leitung pan hileh Jew mite khut sunga ka tun lo nadingin ka nuazuite in a do ding uhi. Ahi vangin ka kumpi gam pen tam sung pan ahi sih hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Pilat in, “Tua ahile nang kumpipa na mah?” ci-in a dong hi. Jesu in, “Nei ci bangin kumpi ka hi hi. Tami thuman teci pang dingin ang suoh ka hi a, tami thu ziehin leitunga ang pei ka hi hi. Thuman thutah-a pang zosie in ka aw a ngai uhi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Pilat in, “Thuman thutah bang ahei?” ci-in a dong hi. Ama in tami thu a gen zaw ciengin Jew mite kungah pusuohkia-in, “Ama mawsah nading thu ka mu sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peisan pawi hun sungin note adingin mi khat ka hla thei nading ngaina khat na nei uhi. Judah kumpipa kang hlakhiet ding na nuom vuoi mah?” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu a Si dingin Thu Kikhen (Mat 27:15-31 ; Mrk 15:6-20 ; Luk 23:13-25)"},"40":{"text":"Amate in, “Tam pa hi lo, Barabbas hlazaw in!” ci-in nahpi tahin a kiko uhi. Barabbas pen misuom khat ahi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in Jesu kai-in a satsah hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuale galkapte in ling tawh kumpi lukhu khat phanin a lu tungah a khusah vua, puontuol ausan khat a silsah uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama kungah amate pei den mielmuolin, “Jew mite kumpipa na khan sau taheh,” ci-in a mai a beng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Pilat pusuoh kia-in amate kungah, “En un, ama mawsah thei nading bangma thu ka mu lo lam na thei nadingun na kung vuah ama kang peisah hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n ling lukhu khukawm le puontuol ausan silkawmin Jesu a pusuoh hi. Pilat in amate kungah, “En un, mipa tanah om hi!” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempu liente le palihte in ama a mu ciengun, “Singlamte tungah khailia un! Singlamte tungah khailia un!” ci-in a awng uhi. Pilat in amate kungah, “Noma ma in la unlen singlamte tungah kikhailia ta un; kei ka hile ama tungah mawmat ding ka mu sih hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Jew mite in ama kungah, “Kote in thukham khat ka nei vua, ama Pasien’ Tapa a kici ziehin thukham dung zui-in a si dinga kilawm ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pilat in tami thu a zah ciengin nidang sangin a zauzaw hi."},"9":{"text":"A kumpi inn ah ama lutkia-in Jesu kungah, “Nang hei pana hing pei na hiei?,” ci-in a dong hi. Hinanle Jesu in kam khat beh dawng lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pilat in ama kungah, “Kei ei hopi lo ding na hi amah? Nang hla thei nading le tha thei nading thu ka nei lam tah na thei sih amah?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Tunglam pana ang kipieh sih leh kei tungah thu na nei thei sih ding hi; tua ahi ziehin nang tunga kei ei piekhie pa in mawna lienzaw a bawl hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Khum hun a kipanin Pilat in ama hla thei nading sui a, ahi vangin Jew mite in, “Tam pa na hla poma leh Caesar’ lawm na hi sih hi. Ama le ama kumpi a kibawl popo Ceasar langpang ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"13":{"text":"Pilat in tam thute a zah ciengin a pulamah Jesu peipi a, Hebrew hamin Gabbatha a kici Suongpha muna a om thukhenna topha tungah a to hi."},"14":{"text":"Khum ni pen Peisan pawi dinga Kigin ni hi a, sunkim pawl ahi hi. Ama in Jew mite kungah, “Na kumpipa uh tanah om ei!” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in, “Ama that in! Ama that in! Singlamte tungah khailia in!” ci-in a kiko uhi. Pilat in amate kungah, “Na Kumpipa uh ka khailia ta diei mah?” ci-in a dong hi. Siempu liente in, “Caesar simlo kumpi dang ka nei sih uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pilat in khailia dingin amate khutah Jesu a pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Jesu peipi-in ama’ singlamte ding ama in puo a, Hebrew hamin Golgotha a kici Lutang Gu Mun-ah a pusuoh hi.","title":"Singlamte Tunga Jesu Kikhaina (Mat 27:32-44 ; Mrk 15:21-32 ; Luk 23:26-43)"},"18":{"text":"Amate in singlamte tungah Jesu le adang mi nite tua munah a khailia uhi. Ama langtuoh ah adang nite kikhai-in a lai-ah Jesu kikhai hi."},"19":{"text":"Pilat in zong lai khat gielsahin, “Nazareth khuomi Jesu, Judah Kumpipa,” cisah a, singlamte tungah a suongsah hi."},"20":{"text":"Jew mite tampitah in tua lai kigiel a sim uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile Jesu kikhaina mun pen khuopi tawh kinai hi; tuami lai pen Hebrew lai, Latin lai, le Greek laite tawh kigiel ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judah siempu lien pente in Pilat kungah, ‘Judah-te Kumpipa’, ci-in giel sinlen, “ Tam pa in kei Judah kumpipa ka hi hi,’ a ci hi, ci-in gielzaw in,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pilat in, “Ka gielsa, ka gielsa ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"23":{"text":"Singlamte tungah Jesu a khailia zaw ciengun galkapte in a puonsilte la-in phal li a suo vua, phal khat cietin a tang uhi. Amate in a puon tungsil zong a la uhi; tua pen a lu panin a taw donga khui lo-a kigan ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in, “Tami balkeh sih vai, koi pen in i nga ei aisan vai,” khatlekhat a kici uhi. Tam pen Lai Siengtho in, “Amate in ka puonte a hawm vua, ka puon-ah nga nadingin ai a san uhi,” a ci thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.","ref":"Late 22:18"},"25":{"text":"Galkapte in tam bangin a bawl uhi. Tua laitahin Jesu’ singlamte gei-ah a nu, a nu’ sanggamnu, Clopas’ zi Mary, le Mary Magdalene-te a ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Jesu in a nu panga a ding a it mama nuazuipa a mu ciengin ama in a nu kungah, “Numei aw, tanah na tapa om hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in nuazuipa kungah, “Tanah na nu om hi,” a ci hi. Khum hun a kipanin a nuazui pa in a inn ah ama a peipi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Jesu in vai zosie mansieng zo ci a thei ciengin (Lai Siengtho a tangtun nadingin), “Ka dang a ta hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu Sina (Mat 27:45-56 ; Mrk 15:33-41 ; Luk 23:44-49)","ref":"Late 69:21; 22:15"},"29":{"text":"Tua munah lenggazu thua a dim bel khat kitung hi. Tuaci’n amate in tua sungah tuihup a die vua, hyssop ba dawnah taa-in Jesu’ kam tawh a tuo uhi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu in tua lenggazu a dawn zaw ciengin, “Kizo zo hi,” ci-in lukunin a si hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ni pen Kigin ni ahi ziehin Jew mite in sabbath hun sungin singlamte tungah a luongte nuasie ding a dei sih uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile tua sabbath pen a diehdiehin a lipkhap huoi ni thupi ni ahi hi. Tuaci’n amate in a kikhailum pa’ kengte sattanin a luongte a hepkhiet thei nadingin Pilat kungah a ngen uhi.","title":"Jesu’ Pang Kidawt"},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkapte pei-in a masa pa’ keng sattan piehin ama tawh a kikhaiton adang khat pa-a’ zong a sattanpieh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu kung a tun ciengun ama a sisa-in a mu vua, a kengte a sattan pieh ta sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua tangin galkapte khat in teipi tawh a pang a sun leh thakhatin sisan le tui a luongkhie hi."},"35":{"text":"(Note in zong tam thu na up thei nadingun tami thu a mu pa in teci a pang hi. Ama’ teci panna thuman ahi a, ama thuman gen ahi lam a kithei hi.)"},"36":{"text":"Lai Siengtho in, “A gu khat zong kitawngsah lo ding hi,” ci-in a genna thu a tangtun thei nadinga tam thute ang pieng ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 12:46; Gam 9:12; Late 34:20"},"37":{"text":"Lai Siengtho mundang khat ah, “Amate in a sut pa uh a en ding uhi,” na ci lai hi.","ref":"Zech 12:10; Kln 1:7"},"38":{"text":"Tam thu teng zaw ciengin Jesu’ nuazui khat, Jew mite a giin ziehin a langtanga a zui ngam lo, Arimathea khuomi Joseph in Jesu’ luong a lah thei nadingin Pilat kungah ngen hi. Pilat in zong ama phalna a pie hi; tuaci’n ama pei-in Jesu’ luong a la hi.","title":"Jesu Kivuina (Mat 27:57-61 ; Mrk 15:33-41 ; Luk 23:44-49)"},"39":{"text":"Jesu kungah a zan haw ngai pa Nicodemus zong myrrh le aloes kihal pong za bang a gih ding panamtuite tawi-in a pei hi.","ref":"Jhn 3:1-2"},"40":{"text":"Amate in Jesu’ luong la-in Judah-te’ kivuina ngaina bangin diel sungah panamtui tawh a tun uhi."},"41":{"text":"Singlamte tungah a kikhailiana mun gei-ah um khat om a, tua um-ah koima a kivui ngai nai lona han tha khat a om hi."},"42":{"text":"Jew mite’ Kigin ni ahi zieh leh tua kima han nai pen ahi ziehin tua hanah Jesu a vui uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipi kal khat sunga ni masa pen ni zingmawng khuomiel laipi-in hanah Mary Magdalene a pei leh ama in hankot sinna suongtum a kiliamangsa a mu hi.","title":"Jesu Thawkiana (Mat 28:1-8 ; Mrk 16:1-8 ; Luk 24:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Simon Peter le Jesu in a it a nuazui dang khat kungah tua nu tai-in, “Amate in han panin Topa a ladawh ta vua, hei-a a siel uh ahei, ci ka thei sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter le adang nuazui pa dingkhie-in han lamah a pei uhi."},"4":{"text":"A ni tuohun ama gel a taiton vangun nuazui dang khat pa in Peter makhelin hanah a na matun hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama kunsuhin a etsuh leh tua munah a kitunna puon kipha a mu a, ahi vangin a sungah ama a lut sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama’ nua zui-in Simon Peter pei a, han a tun ciengin han sungah a lut hi. Ama in tua munah a kitunna puon kipha mu a,"},"7":{"text":"a lu tunna puon zong a luong tunna puon tawh na omton loin a tuomtuohin kizielin a om a mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin hanah a na tung masa adang nuazui pa zong a sungah lut a, tuale ama in mu-in a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in misite lah panin ama thokia ding hi, ci-a Lai Siengtho genna a theitel nai sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin nuazuite a inn ciet vuah a peikia uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin han pulamah Mary dingin a kap hi. A kaa kawmin hankhuh sung lam enin a kunsuh leh,","title":"Mary Magdalene Kungah Jesu Kilah (Mat 28:9-10 ; Mrk 16:9-11)"},"12":{"text":"tua nu in Jesu luong kisielna a lu lamah khat, a keng lamah khat, puonpah silin a to vantungmi ni a mu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama gel in tua nu kungah, “Numei aw, bang dinga kap na hei?” a ci uhi. Tua nu in ama gel kungah, “Amate in ka Topa a lamang ta vua, hei sunga a siel dawh uh ahei, ci ka thei ta sih hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua nu in tam thu a gen zaw ciengin a kinua hei leh khum sunga a ding Jesu mu a, ahi vangin Jesu ahi lam a thei sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Numei aw, bang dinga kap na hei? Koi ahiei na sui?” a ci hi. Tua nu in huon bawlpa sa a, “Sie aw, nang puohdawh ahile, na koina ei gen in, a luong ka la ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Mary!” a ci leh Mary zong kinua hei-in Hebrew hamin, Rabboni!” ci a, (tua khu Siepa a cinopna ahi hi)."},"17":{"text":"Jesu in tua nu kungah, “Ei tu sin, bangzieh ahei cile Pa kungah ka peito nai sih hi.
