Ahi vangin ka sanggamte kungah pei inlen, “Ka Pa le na Pa uh ahi, ka Pasien le na Pasien uh’ kungah ka kato ta ding hi,’ ci hi, ci-in va genzaw ta un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Mary Magdalene zong pei pai-in nuazuite kungah, “ Topa ka mu zo hi,” a ci hi; tua nu in tua pa thugen zosie amate kungah a gensawn hi."},"19":{"text":"Nipi kal khat sunga ni masa pen nitahin nuazuite in Judah mite a giin ziehun inn kotkhahte a khah vua, tuale a kikhopna vuah Jesu pei-in amate lahah ding a, “Nopna note tawh ang om taheh,” a ci hi.","title":"Nuazuite Kungah Jesu Kilah (Mat 28:16-20 ; Mrk 16:14-18 ; Luk 24:36-49)"},"20":{"text":"Ama in tam thu a gen zaw ciengin amate kungah a khutte le a pang zong a lah hi. Nuazuite in Topa a mu ciengun a nuom mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Note tawh nopna om taheh. Pa in kei ei sawl bangin note kang sawl hi,” a cikia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam a ci zaw ciengin amate tungah a hu sang a, “Hlagau Siengtho na sang un."},"23":{"text":"Note in mi khatpo’ mawnate na maisah uleh, tua mawnate kimaisah ding a, mi khatpo’ mawnate na opsah suoh uleh tua mawnate a om suoh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 16:19; 18:18"},"24":{"text":"Jesu a pei laitahin amate lahah sawm le nite lahah khat Thomas (a kopsuo kici pa) om lo hi.","title":"Jesu le Thomas"},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n nuazui dangte in tua pa kungah, “ Topa ka mu ta uhi,” a ci uhi. Ahi vangin ama in amate kungah, “A khut sunga siakil kikhetna pawn mu-in, siakil kikhetna ma vangah ka khutme ka va khum tehteh sih a, a pang zong ka khut tawh ka va tham tehteh sih leh ka um sih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zaw nipi kal khat ciengin inn sungah a nuazuite a na omkia vua, Thomas zong amate tawh a omton hi. Kotkhahte a kikha vangin Jesu pei-in amate lahah ding a, “Note tawh nopna om taheh,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Thomas kungah, “Na khutme tawh tamtah tham inlen ka khutte en in. Na khut zah inlen ka pang zong tham in. Umla sinlen muong lenlon in,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Thomas in, “Ka Topa le ka Pasien!” ci-in a dawng hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu in ama kungah, “Kei nei mu zieha ei um pan na hi bo amah? Kei ei mu lopi-a ei umte mi hampha ahi uhi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu in a nuazuite’ muna-ah tami laibu sunga a kigiel kha lo na lamdang tampitah zong a bawl hi.","title":"Tami Laibu’ Deina"},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in Messiah hi a, Pasien’ Tapa ahina thu na up thei nading ule tua banga na upna uh tungtawnin ama’ min tawh hinna na nei thei nading vua tam thute kigiel ahi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami thu teng zaw ciengin a nuazuite opna Tiberius tuipi gei-ah Jesu kilahkia hi. Ama tam bangin kilah hi.","title":"Nuazui Sagite tungah Jesu Kilah"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah a kisutuo teng pen Simon Peter, a kopsuo kici Thomas, Galilee gam Cana khuomi Nathanael, Zebedee’ tapate, le a nuazui dang nite ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Simon Peter in amate kungah, “Nga beng dingin va kuon ta vang,” a ci hi. Amate in, “Komate in zong nang zui va ung,” a ci uhi. Amate pei-in gunkuong tungah a tuong vua, hizongle tua zanin bangma a man sih uhi.","ref":"Luk 5:5"},"4":{"text":"Zingmawng khuovah patin gun gei-ah Jesu ding a, ahi vangin nuazuite in Jesu ahi lam a thei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Tate, nga khat beh na man sih uh amah?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Man sih ung,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in, “Gunkuong zietlam pangah na len uh pai locin pawlkhat na man ding uhi,” a ci hi. Tuaci’n len a pai uleh nga tampi awhin a len uh a kai zo ta sih uhi.","ref":"Luk 5:6"},"7":{"text":"Jesu in a it nuazui pa in Peter kungah, “ Topa lah ahin!” a ci hi. Simon Peter in Topa ahi lam a zah ciengin ama pen a ngentanga om ahi ziehin puon silin tui sungah a lengsuh hi."},"8":{"text":"Nuazui dangte zong gunkuong tawh pei-in a len utawh nga a dimletin a kai uhi. Tua mun le gungei pen kigamla lo a, kai za ni bang beh a kigamla hi."},"9":{"text":"Pieugei a tun ciengun meihol kitaw mei-am tungah nga le anlum kihang a mu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Na nga matte uh tawmkhat hing tawi un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n gunkuong tungah Simon Peter kato-in tuipieu-ah len kai dawh a, nga a gol vive za le sawm nga le thum a awh hi. Tua za-a a tam vangin len a ehkeh sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesu in amate kungah, “Hing pei unlen zing an ne un,” a ci hi. Amate in Topa ahi lam a thei ziehun a nuazuite khat beh in, “Nang koi na hei?” ci-in a dong ngam sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu pei a, tuale khomun la-in amate a pie hi. Tua ma bangin nga zong la-in a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Tami pen sina panin Jesu a thawto zaw a nuazuite kunga a kilah a thum veina ahi hi"},"15":{"text":"Zing an a neh zaw ciengun Jesu in Peter kungah, “John’ tapa Simon aw, tamte sangin kei nei it zaw ei mah?” a ci hi. Peter in ama kungah, “Kang itzaw hi Topa . Nang kang it lamtah na thei hi,” a ci hi. Jesu in ama kungah, “Ka tuunote na vah in,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesu le Peter"},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “John’ tapa Simon aw, kei nei it ei mah?” ci-in a niveina dong leuleu hi. Ama in, “Kang it hi, Topa aw, nang in kang it lamtah na thei hi,” a ci hi. Jesu in ama kungah, “Ka tuunote na cing in,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “John’ tapa Simon aw, kei nei it ei mah?” ci-in a thumveina dong leuleu hi. “Nang in kei nei it ei mah?” ci-in thumvei a dawh ziehin Peter da mama a, tua ahi ziehin, “ Topa , na zosie na thei a, ke’n nang kang it lam zong na thei hi,” a ci hi. Jesu in ama kungah, “Ka tuute na cing in."},"18":{"text":"A tahtah a kang ci-in, na khangno lai-in na kawng gahin na nopnopna-ah na pei thei hi. Ahi vangin na khangham ciengin na khutte zahin mi dangte in na kawng gah ding a, na pei nop lona-ah ang peipi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"(Ama in bangci bang sina tawh Pasien’ min a thansah nading a gen nopna ahi hi.) Tam thu a gen zaw ciengin Jesu in Peter kungah, “Ka nua ei zui-in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Peter a kihei leh Jesu in a it a nuazui pa in amate a zui a mu hi. ama pen nitah an a neh laitahun Jesu banah kingamin, “ Topa , nang ang leheh ding pa koi ahiei?” ci-a a dong pa ahi hi.","title":"Jesu Le a Nuazui Dang Khat","ref":"Jhn 13:25"},"21":{"text":"Peter in tua pa a mu ciengin Jesu kungah, “ Topa , ama bangci ding?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu in, “Kang peikia dong cieng ama a hing lai dinga ka dei nah leh nang tawh bang kisai ahei? Keima ei zui-in! a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n a khuopite lahah tami nuazuipa si lo ding hi, ci-in a thu kithang hi. Hinanle Jesu in tami nuazui pa si lo ding hi, ci-in a genkha sih a, “Kang peikia hun dong ama a hing dinga ka dei leh nang tawh bang kisai ahei?” a ci ahi zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Tam thu teng teci pang le a gielpa pen tami nuazui pa hi a, a teci panna pen thudih ahi hi, ci-in i thei uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu in a sep adang na tampite zong omlai hi. Tua teng zosiepi a kigiel sieng hileh leitung in tua a kigiel ding laibu teng kenin ka um va-ia sih hi."}}}}},"44":{"info":{"name":"Sawltahte","shortname":"Sawl","abbr":[],"desc":"Sawltah te’ nasep (acts of the apostles)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Theophilus aw, laibu masa sungah Jesu in a sep le a hilte zosie a kipatcil a kipan,","title":"Hlagau Siengtho Kikamciem","ref":"Luk 1:1-4"},"2":{"text":"a teelsa sawltahpite tungah Hlagau Siengtho tungtawnin a lah zaw ciengin vantunga a kilahto donga thute ka giel ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ thuoh gimna zaw ciengin ni sawmli sung sawltahpite kungah kilah a, teci tampite tawh a nungta tahtah ahina lahin Pasien’ manggam thu a hil hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate tawh a opton laitahin Jerusalem nuasie loin tua munah Pa’ kamciemna a nga nadingun ama in thu a pie hi. Ama in, “Tami thu keima kung pana na zahsa uh ahi hi,” a ci hi;","ref":"Luk 24:49"},"5":{"text":"azieh pen John in tui tawh mite baptize a, ahi vangin a sawt loin Hlagau Siengtho tawh note ang kibaptize ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:11; Mrk 1:8; Luk 3:16; Jhn 1:33"},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate a kikhop ciengun ama kungah, “ Topa aw, Israel-te tunga kumpi’ gam na piehkia ding tuhun a ta amah?” ci-in dong uhi.","title":"Jesu Van a Kana"},"7":{"text":"Ama in, “Pa in ama’ thuneina tawh a sesa hun le nite note thei ding thu ahi sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin na tung vuah Hlagau Siengtho ang tun ciengin vanglietna na nga ding vua, Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria le leimong dongin ka teci na hi ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 28:19; Mrk 16:15; Luk 24:47-48"},"9":{"text":"Tami thu a gen zaw, amate in a et laitahun ama kilato a, meiilom khat in a dopto dawh ziehin a kimu thei nawn sih hi.","ref":"Mrk 16:19; Luk 24:50-51"},"10":{"text":"Ama a kilahto amate in vantung lam a etto laitahun puontuol kang sil pasal ni thakhatin amate kungah a ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua tegel in, “Galilee mite aw, bang dinga vantung lam enin ding ngetngut na hi uh ahei? Na kungpan vua vantunga kilato tami Jesu khu vantunga a peito na mu ma bangun ang peikia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin Jerusalem tawh a kinai, Sabbath ni khat lam ahi Olivet a kici muol panin Jerusalem ah amate a kilekia uhi.","title":"Judas Zalaih ding Matthias Kiteel"},"13":{"text":"Khuopi sung a lut ciengun Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip le Thomas, Bartholomew le Matthew, Alphaeus’ tapa James, Simon Zealot le James’ tapa Judas-te tunna inndan tungah amate a kato uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:2-4; Mrk 3:16-19; Luk 6:14-16"},"14":{"text":"Amate zosie in numei pawlkhat, Jesu’ nu Marry, le a sanggam pasalte tawh lungsim kikhatin thungetna a nei zing uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua laitahin thu um mite lahah Peter dingto-in, (mihonpi za le sawm ni bang pha hi)"},"16":{"text":"“Sanggamte aw, Lai Siengtho sungah Jesu a mante’ makai pa Judas tungtang thu tawh kisai-in David’ genkholna a tangtun lo phamaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua Judas khu eite tawh kisimton mi khat ahi a, tam nasepna sunga zong a kihal khat ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"(Tu-in tua pa in a gitlona thaman tawh lo khat lei a, ama bungbu kiehin a gilpi pawhkeh a, a gilzam zosie lawtmang hi."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem-a teng zosie in tami thu a thei uhi. Tua logam pen amau’ hamin, ‘Akeldama’ a ci vua, ‘Sisan Lo’ a cinopna ahi hi.)","ref":"Mat 27:3-8"},"20":{"text":"“Bangzieh ahei cile Late laibu sungah, A tenna mun gamkhing suohin, khum munah koima teng sih hinlen, a cina le ‘A makai dinmun pen midang khat in luo taheh,’ ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Late 69:25; 109:8"},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n khum bang mi dingte pen, eite lahah sungtum pusuohin Topa Jesu a op hun sung zosie,"},"22":{"text":"John’ baptize-a kipanin vantungah Jesu a kilah dong, ama’ thawkiana thu-ah eite tawh teci a pangton mite lahah khat ahi kul hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:16; Mrk 1:9; 16:19; Luk 3:21; 24:51"},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in mi ni, Barsabbas le Justus zong a kici Joseph le Matthias a se uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in thu ngenin, “ Topa aw, nangma in mi zosie’ lungsim na thei hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama’ opna ding munah Judas pei-in a nuasie tami sawltahpi nasepna-ah panmun a la dingin tam mi nite lahah koi zaw teel na hei ei lah in,” a ci uhi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in lai-ai sanin Matthias tungah tu ahi ziehin sawltahpi sawm le khat lahah ama kigawmbe hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pentecost ni a tun ciengin mun khatah amate a unpi-un a omton uhi.","title":"Hlagau Siengtho ang Peina"},"2":{"text":"Tuale vantung panin thakhatin huipi lang tawh kibang aw khat ging a, a tona uh innsung teng zosie a dim hi.","ref":"Siem 23:15-21; Thkna 16:9-11"},"3":{"text":"Amate lahah meikuong kikhenkeh tawh a kibang leiite kilangin a tung ciet vuah a tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate a unpi-un Hlagau Siengtho tawh a kidim vua, tua Hlagau in a pieh siemna bangin kam tuomtuomte tawh a ham uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khum laitahin vansin nei-a om gam zosie panin Jerusalem ah Pasien a um Jew mite a teng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khumi awging ziehin mihonpi a kikhawm vua, thu kigente amau’ pienpi ham cietin a zah ziehun lamdang a sa uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in tam thu lamdang sa-in a lung uh mang a, “Tu-a thugen zosie Galilee mi ahi sih uh amah?"},"8":{"text":"Bangci dan a i pienpi ham ciet tawh i zah thei uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Parthia gam, Media gam, Elam gam, Mesopotamia gama tengte, Judea gam, Cappadocia gam, Pontus gam le Asia gam,"},"10":{"text":"Phrygia gam, Pamphylia gam, Egypt gam le Cyrene khuopi-a’ ahi Libya gamkhen sunga tengte le Rome pana a haw mite, Jew mite, le Judah biehna a zuite,"},"11":{"text":"Crete mite le Arab mite ahi, Pasien’ nasep lienpite i pienpi ham cietin i za uhi,” a ci uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mi zosie in lamdang sa-in a lungmang vua, “Tami bang a cinopna hi poma ding ahei?” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin pawlkhat in, “Lenggazu tha kham ahi uhi,” ci-in a ehneh ho uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin sawm le khatte tawh Peter dingto a, a aw sangsahin amate kungah, “Jew mite le Jerusalem khuo-a tengte aw, tami thu thei unlen ka thugen na ngai un.","title":"Peter in Mihonpi Thuhil"},"15":{"text":"Na upmaw bangun zukham ahi sih uhi, bang ding ahei cile tuhun pen zingmawng nai kuo ahi na bo hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi vawt lo hi, tam pen kamsangpa Joel tungtawnin tam bangin na kigen hi:"},"17":{"text":"‘Pasien in a genna ah ni tawp ni ciengin mi zosie tungah ka Hlagau ka buo ding a, na tapate ule na tanute un kamsangin, na tangvalte un mang mu ding a, na puvuoite un zong mang a man ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hi hi, khum ni ciengin ka sila pasalte le ka sila numeite tungah ka Hlagau ka buo ding a, amate in kam a sang ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tunglam vanah a lamdangte ka lah ding a, neilam leitungah limte, sisan, meikuong le meikhu sapite ka lah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A lien a thupi Topa’ ni a tun masangin ni ang miel ding a, hlapi sisan ang bang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ min tawh thu ngen zosie in hutdamna a nga ding uhi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Joel 2:28-32"},"22":{"text":"“No, Israel-te aw, ka thugen ngai un: Note in na theisa ma bangun Nazareth mi Jesu pen Pasien in note lahah ama tungtawna a bawl vanglietna le na lamdangte, le limte tawh Pasien in a kipsah mi ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasien in ama’ ngimna le a theikholna bangin note khut sungah tam pa ang piekhie a, note in singlamte tungah khai-in migilote’ khut tawh ama na that uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:35; Mrk 15:24; Luk 23:33; Jhn 19:18"},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin sina in ama tukip zo lo ahi ziehin Pasien in sina panin suohtasahin a thosah hi.","ref":"Mat 28:5-6; Mrk 16:6; Luk 24:5"},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama tawh kisai David in a genna-ah, ‘Ka masangah Topa a op den lam ka mu hi, azieh pen ei kilawthing thei lo na dingin ka zietlamah ama a om hi;"},"26":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin ka lungsim kipahin ka leii zong a lungdam hi; tua banah ka tahsa zong lametna sungah a hing ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen nang in Misikhuo ah ka hla na nuasie sih ding a, na Mi Siengtho pa zong muotna nei thuohsah sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Nangma in hinna lampi nei lah zo hi; nei ompina tawh kipahna bukim nei bawlpieh ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Late 16:8-11"},"29":{"text":"“Sanggam Israel-te aw, pupi David’ si-in kivui zo a, tuni dongin a han zong eite tawh om hi, ci kimuongtahin na kung vuah kang gen thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama kamsang khat ahi a, Pasien in a kumpi topha tungah a suonlehlahte khat ka tosah ding hi, ci-in a kiciem lam ama in a thei hi.","ref":"Late 16:8-11"},"31":{"text":"Tam thu a mukhol ziehin David in Messiah’ thawkiana thu a genna-ah, ‘Misikhuo ah ama kinuasie loin, a pumpi zong muot lo ding hi, a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Pasien in tua Jesu thosah zo a, tami thu-ah kote zosie teci ka hi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien’ zietlamah ama kilamsang zo a, note in Pa tung panin a kikamciemsa Hlagau Siengtho zong na sang zo ta vua, note in na mu uleh na zah uh ahi tami zong khu ama in ang buohsuh zo ta hi."},"34":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile vantungah David a kato sih a, ahi vangin ama in, “ Topa in ka Topa kungah,"},"35":{"text":"na keng ngahna munah na galte ka koi masangsie ka zietlamah to in,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi.","ref":"Late 110:1"},"36":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note in na khailia uh tua Jesu, Pasien in Topa le Messiah a suohsah zo ta hi, ci thu Israel innkuon buppi in teltahin thei ta uheh,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in tam thu a zah ciengun a lungsim uh sukha a, Peter le adang sawltahpite kungah, “Sanggamte aw, bang ka bawl ding vuoi?” a ci uhi.","title":"A Kikhel Masa Pente"},"38":{"text":"Peter in amate kungah, “Kisiakia unlen na mawnate uh a mai thei nadingin Jesu Khris’ min tawh ki-baptize un; tua hile note in Pasien’ letsong ahi Hlagau Siengtho na nga ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua kamciem pen note, na suonlehlahte ule Topa i Pasien in ama kunga a hlat gamlapi-a om mi zosie ading ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuale Peter in adang thu kiselna tampi tawh teci pangin, “Tami a gilo khang mite panin kihunkhie un,” ci-in amate a hanthawn hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuaci’n a thugenna a um mite a kibaptize vua, khum ni-in mi tul thum bang kibelap hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in sawltahpite’ thuhilna le kipawltonna ah a lunglut ciet vua, tuale khomun phalsuona le thungetna a neiton uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi zosie a zausi vua, sawltahpite in na lamdangte le lim tampi a bawl uhi.","title":"Thu um Mite Lahah Hindan"},"44":{"text":"Thu um zosie omtonin na vannuoi a neiton uhi;","ref":"Sawl 4:32-35"},"45":{"text":"amate in amau’ neisate le vante zua-in mi khatpo’ kisapna zui-in tua sumte a hawmpieh uhi."},"46":{"text":"Amate in biehinnpi sungah nisimin hun tampitah zangtonin, inn ah khomun a phalsuo vua, kipahna le kiphalna lungsim tawh an a ne uhi."},"47":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ min phatin mite’ maipha zong a nga uhi. Pasien in nisimin gupna nga mi a kibelapsah hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat, nitah lam nai thum thunget hunin biehinnpi ah Peter le John-te a peito uhi.","title":"Peter in Khutdawngen Khelbai Khat Damsah"},"2":{"text":"Tuale a pienpi khelbai khat na kipuo hi. Tua pa in biehinn kai mite tung panin sum a nget thei nadingin mite in Kotpi Hoi kici biehinn tunkot gei-ah nisielin ama a koi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Biehinnpi sungah Peter le John a lut kuonun tua pa in mu a, ama gel kungah sum a ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"John ma bangin Peter in zong tua pa encien a, “Ko gel ei en vawi” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua pa in zong bang khat nga ding ci kinepna tawh ama gel a lim-et mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter in, “Ngun le kham ka nei poma sih hi, hizongle ka nei pen kang pie hi; Nazareth mi Jesu Khris’ min tawh ding inlen lam pei in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in tua pa a zietlam khut tawh manin a kaito leh thakhatin a keng le a sietmitte a khaupai lien hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama kitomin dingto a, lam pei pai-in amate tawh biehinnpi sungah lut a, a lam pei kawmin dieng vazawhin Pasien min’ a phat hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi zosie in ama lam pei-in Pasien a phat a mu vua,"},"10":{"text":"tuale ama pen biehinnpi’ Kotpi Hoi gei-ah to-in sum ngenngen pa ahi lam amate in a thei uhi; tuale ama tunga a pieng thute ziehin amate in lamdang sa-in a lungmang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua mipa in Peter le John a tuhdet laitahin mi zosie in lamdang a sa vua, amau’ opna Solomon Talap a kici innhlim lamah tai-in a kikhawm uhi.","title":"Solomon Talap-ah Peter in Thugen"},"12":{"text":"Peter in a mu ciengin mipite kungah, “No Israel-te aw, tam mipa lam ka peisah theina uh pen ka vang ule ka hoina uh zieh sa-in bang dingin ei cien-et na hi uh ahei?"},"13":{"text":"I pupite ahi Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob-te’ Pasien in a nasempa Jesu a minthangsah zo hi. Tua pa pen Pilat in hla dingin a khensat vangin note in ama na niel vua, Pilat mai-ah tha dingin na pie ta uhi.","ref":"Pei 3:15"},"14":{"text":"Note in a Siengtho le Midih Pa na niel vua, mithat pa khat a hla nadingin na ngen zawsop uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:15-23; Mrk 15:6-14; Luk 23:13-23; Jhn 19:12-15"},"15":{"text":"Note in Hinna a piengsah pa na that vua, hizongle Pasien in misite lah panin ama a thosah hi. Tam thu-ah kote teci ka hi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama’ min upna hang tawh tua ama’ min mama in na mu ule na thei uh ahi tua pa a thakhausah zo hi. Jesu tung pana kinga upna in note zosie mai-ah dam siengthona ama a pie zo hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tu-in lawmte aw, na makaite un a na bawl bangin note in zong na thei lo ziehun na bawlkhah lam uh ka thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama’ Messiah in gimna thuoh ding hi, ci-in kamsangte zosie tung panin a na magensa thute Pasien in tam bangin a tangtungsah zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na mawnate uh a kiphietmai thei nadingin kisiakia-in Pasien lamah kihei un."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa kung panin tha tha ngana hun ang tung ding a, ama in note dinga a kisekholsa Messiah ahi Jesu ang sawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Pasien in a kamsang mi siengthote tungtawnin a tangko bangin na zosie a kibawlthakia hun masangsie vantungah Jesu a op kul ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Moses in, ‘ Topa na Pasien un na mite panin note adingin keima tawh kibang kamsang khat ang piengsah ding hi. Ama in na kung vua ang gen popo note in na man ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:15, 18"},"23":{"text":"Tua kamsangpa’ thugen a mang lo poma a mite lah panin kiphungkal ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:19"},"24":{"text":"Samuel a kipanin a nua-a ang pieng kamsang zosie in zong tuhun thupiengte a na genkhol tabo uhi."},"25":{"text":"Note pen kamsangte le Pasien in na pu na pate uh tunga a na pieh thuciemna’ suonlehlahte na hi vua, tuaci’n ama in Abraham kungah, ‘Na suon na hlahte sungah leitung innkuon zosie thupha kipie ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 22:18"},"26":{"text":"Pasien in a sila pa a thawsah ciengin na gitlona zosie panun kihei-in thupha ang pieh thei nadingin na kung vuah ama ang sawl masah ahi hi,” ci-in a gen hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipite tungah Peter le John in thu a gen laitahun ama gel kungah siempute, biehinn uhpa, le Sadducees-te a pei uhi.","title":"Biehna Uliente’ Mai-ah Peter le John"},"2":{"text":"Ama gel in Jesu sungah misite thawkiana om hi, ci-in a gen zieh gelin nawngkai a sa mama uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Peter le John a man vua, nitah lam hi ta ahi ziehin a zing cieng dong thong sungah a khum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin thungaite lahah mi tampi in a um vua, thu um mi tul nga bang a pha uhi."},"5":{"text":"A zing ciengin Jerusalem ah a gam-uhte uh, upate, le thukham hil siete a kikhawm uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua sungah siempu lien Annas, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, le siempu liente’ innkuonpi zosie zong a om uhi."},"7":{"text":"A laikim vuah thongkie tegel dingsahin, “No gel in bang thuneina le bang min tawh tami na bawl uh ahei,’ ci-in a dong uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hlagau Siengtho tawh Peter kidimin amate kungah, “Gam uhte le upate aw,"},"9":{"text":"tuni-in cina pa khat tunga sil hoi ka bawl ziehun tam pa bangci banga a natna dam thei ahei, ci-in ei dong na hi uleh,"},"10":{"text":"note zosie le Israel-te zosie in kithei ta un. A dam sienga na mai vua ang ding tam mipa pen singlamte tunga na khailia uh, Pasien in misite lah pan a thawsahkia pa Nazareth mi Jesu Khris’ min zieha dam ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami Jesu pen, ‘No innlamte in na nildawh uh suong, innkiu suong bulpi a suoh hi,’ kici pa ahi hi.","ref":"Late 118:22"},"12":{"text":"Midang koima khat beh sungah hutdamna a om sih hi, azieh pen vansin nei-a a om mihingte lahah i kihutdamna nadinga kipie min dang khat zong a om sih hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in amate in Peter le John pen sinna nei vawt lo mi maimai hi lel napi uh, amau’ hangsanna a mu ciengun lamdang a sa mama vua, Jesu tawh kithuo ngaite ahi lam uh zong a phawh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ama tegel’ gei-ah damna nga pa dingin a om a mu ciengun amate in langpan nading thu bangma a gen thei ta sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n khatlekhat tam thu a kikup sungun biehna uliente kung panin a peikhiet nadingun thu a pie uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in, “Tam mite bang law ding i hei? Bangzieh ahei cile amate tungtawnin a kilang mama lim khat a pieng zo hi, ci thu Jerusalem khuo-a tengte zosie in cientahin a thei ta vua, eite in zong tua thu i niel thei sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin mite lahah tam thute a kizelthang nawn lo nadingin, tulang kalsie koima kungah tami min tawh thu a gen nawn lo nadingun amate thu pie vai,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama gel hlanin Jesu’ min tawh thu genin thu a hil nawn lo nadingun thu a pie uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter le John in, “Note’ thu manzawh ding le Pasien’ thu manzawh ding, Pasien muna-ah koi manzaw ding ahei, ci noma ma in khensat un."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kote in ka musa ule ka zahsa uh thute gen loin ka om thei sih uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in mipite ziehin ama gel dan pieh nading lampi a mu lo ziehun a galgih zaw ciengin a hlakia uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile a pieng thute ziehin amate in a unpi-un Pasien a phat uhi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen tami damna lim lamdang a kibawlna mipa pen a khan kum sawm li val pha zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama gel a kihla zaw ciengin a guolte kungah pei-in siempu uhpite le upate in ama gel kunga a gen uh thu zosie a zasah uhi.","title":"Thu umte in Hangtahin Thu Ngen"},"24":{"text":"Amate in tua thu a zah ciengun a aw uh sangsahin Pasien kungah thu a ngenton vua, “Vanpi le leipi, tuipi, le tua teng sunga a om sil bangkim a siem Thunei pen Topa aw,","ref":"Pei 20:11; Neh 9:6; Late 146:6"},"25":{"text":"nang in na nasempa ka pu uh David tung panin Hlagau Siengtho tawh thu na gen a: ‘Bang dingin Gentile-te lungthahin, bang dingin mite in thu mawhnate ngaisun uh ahei?"},"26":{"text":"Topa le ama’ Messiah do dingin leitung kumpite in panmun la-in, gam uhte kikhawm zo uhi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Late 2:1-2"},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen Herod le Pontius Pilat in Gentile-te le Israel-te tawh na sathau nusa pa, a siengtho na nasem Jesu langpang dingin tam khuopi sungah amate a kikhawm uhi.","ref":"Luk 23:1, 7-11; Mat 27:1-2; Mrk 15:1; Jhn 18:28-29"},"28":{"text":"Nangma in na gelna bangin a pieng dinga na khut tawh na sekholsa popo amate in a sem ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Topa aw, tu-in amau’ ei galgihna ei theipi inlen, ko na nasemte hangsan tahin thu ei gensah in."},"30":{"text":"Cinate dam nadingin na khut zah inlen, a siengtho na nasempa Jesu’ minin lim le na lamdangte kibawl heh,” a ci uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in thu a nget zaw ciengun a kikhopna mun uh a kiling hi; amate zong a unpi-un Hlagau Siengtho tawh kidimin Pasien’ thu hangsan tahin a gen uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tu-in thu um mite a lungsim le a ngaisutna uh a kikhat vua, tuaci’n koima in a a neisa khat popo kei-a’ tuom ci loin neisa zosie a neiton uhi.","title":"Thu umte in Neisate Zangton","ref":"Sawl 2:44-45"},"33":{"text":"Sawltahpite in vanglietna lienpi tawh Topa Jesu’ thawkiana thu teci a pang vua, amate zosie tungah Pasien’ hepina lienpi a tung hi."},"34":{"text":"A neisa uh inn le lote zua-in a nga uh sumte a tawi ciet ziehun amate lahah a tasam koima a om sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in sawltahpite keng zungah tua sumte koi-in a kisapna dung zui-in mi zosie a hawmpieh uhi."},"36":{"text":"Cyprus khuo-a pieng, Joseph kici Levi-te khat, sawltahpite in Barnabas (Hanthawn Siempa’ Tapa a cinopna) a ci uh mipa khat a om hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in a neisa logam khat zua-in a sum teng peipi-in sawltahpite’ keng phungah a koi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ananias kici pasal khat in a zi Sapphira’ thukimna tawh a neisa uh khat a zua hi.","title":"Ananias le Sapphira"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a zi’ thei-in sum kimkhat hendap a, halkhat beh peipi-in nuazuite’ keng phungah a lui hi."},"3":{"text":"Peter in, “Ananias aw, Hlagau Siengtho sol ding le na logam zua man sum pawlkhat a hendap dingin Satan in bang dingin na lungsim kizosah na hei?"},"4":{"text":"Na zua masangin nangma-a’ hi a, na zua zaw ciengin zong nangma-a’ ma hi lo amah? Bang dinga tua banga gamtat ding hanciem na hei? Kote ei sol na hi sih a, Pasien sol na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ananias in tam thu teng a zah behin puasuhin a si hi. Tam thu a za zosie zong a zau mama uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tangvalte pei-in puon tawh a luong a tun vua, tua ciengin ama puo-in a vui uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zaw nai thum bang ciengin a zi zong thupieng teng thei loin a lut hi."},"8":{"text":"Peter in tua nu kungah, “Nang le na pasal in na logam uh tamza ma na khawh uh amah, ei gen in,” ci-in dong hi. Tua nu in, “Hi hi, tua za ma hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in ama kungah, “ Topa’ Hlagau ze-et dingin bang dinga hici kithukim gel na hi uh ahei? En in, na pasal vuite kot lamah om hi, nang zong ang puokhie ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in a keng phungah tua nu puasuhin a si pai hi. Tangvalte a lut ciengun a sisa-in ama a mu vua, tuaci’n amate in puodawhin a pasal gei-ah a vui uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpi buppi le tami thu a za zosie a zau mama uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in sawltahpite tungtawnin mite lahah lim le na lamdang tampi a pieng hi. Tuale Solomon’ Talap ah amate a omton uhi.","title":"Sawltahpite in Mi Tampi Damsah"},"13":{"text":"Koima dang in amate a kipawlpi ngam sih vua, ahi vangin mite in amate a pimu mama uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin thu um mi numei le pasalte a tam semsem vua, nidang sangin Topa sungah mi a kibelaplap hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n Peter in tua mun nawhin a pei ciengin amate kimkhat tungah a hlim a tuh khah nadingin, lampi-ah cinate puo-in lupna tung le pheh tungah a siel uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jerusalem kima a om khuote panin zong mi tampi kisutuo-in cinate le hlabua in a bawlsiet mite a peipi vua, a unpi-un damna a nga uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa in na sep a sawm ta hi; ama le a kipawlpi zosie in (Sadducees pawlte a ci na) hazatna tawh a kidim ziehun,","title":"Sawltahpite Kibawlsie"},"18":{"text":"sawltahpite manin taangpi thong sungah a khum uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin zan lai-in Topa’ vantungmi khat in thong kotte hongin amate a hladawh a,"},"20":{"text":"“Pei-in biehinnpi sungah ding unlen, mite tungah hinna thu bucing va hil ta un,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam thu a zah ciengun khuova behin biehinnpi sungah lutin a thuhilna maban a zom uhi. Siempu lien pa le a pawlte a tun uh ciengin, amate in biehna uliente le Israel upa buppi kikhawmsahin amate hlakhie dingin thong sungah a sawl uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin khumnah biehinncing palihte a tun ciengun thong sungah amate a mu sih uhi. Tua ahi ciengin a kilekia vua, amate in,"},"23":{"text":"“Thonginn kot hoitahin kikilin kot mai-a ding thongcingte ka mu vua, ahi vangin kot ka hon ciengun a sungah koima ka mu sih uhi,” ci-in thu a zasah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Biehinnpi uhpa le siempu liente in tam thu bang ang suoh diei izaw! ci-in a lungmang uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin mi khat ang tung a, “En un, thong sunga na khum uh mite in biehinnpi sungah dingin mite thu a hil uhi!” ci-in a kiko hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinnpi uhpa le palihte in amate bangma bawlsie loin a zawpi uhi, azieh pen mite in amate suong tawh a se khah ding a zau uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amate a tunpi zaw ciengun biehna uliente mai-ah a dingsah uhi. Siempu lien pa in amate thu dong a,"},"28":{"text":"“Tam pa’ min tawh thu na hil nawn lo nadingun khautahin thu kang pieh hi napi na thuhilna un Jerusalem khuo sung teng na dim zo ta vua, ko tungah tam pa’ sisan ang tun nadingin zong na hanciem uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 27:25"},"29":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter le nuazuite in, “Mihing’ thu sangin Pasien’ thu ka man uh kulzaw ding hi."},"30":{"text":"I pu i pate’ Pasien in singkhuom tunga na khailia pa uh Jesu a thokiasah zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasien in Israel-te tungah kisiana le mawmaina a pieh nadingin a zietlamah Lamkai pa ding le Hundam pa dingin ama a tawisang zo hi."},"32":{"text":"Tam thu-ah kote teci ka hi vua, Pasien in a thu a mang mite tungah a pieh Hlagau Siengtho zong teci ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in tam thu a zah ciengun a lungthah mama vua, sawltahpite tha a sawm uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin biehna uliente sung panin mi zosie in a zatah Gamaliel a kici thukham hil sie Pharisees-te khat ding to-in bakhat sung tua mite a pusuo nadingun thu a pie hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in tua mite kungah, “Israel-te aw, note in tam mite tunga na bawl dingte uh pilvangin kidawm un."},"36":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile masang lai khatin kei zong mi khat ma ka hi hi, a kici Theudas ang khang a, mi zali bang in ama a pawlpi uhi; ahi vangin tua pa kithat a, tuale ama a zui zosie kithezahin a mangthai sieng uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ama’ nua, mi phaza a kisim hun sungin Galilee mi Judah ang khang leuleu a, ama in zong nuazui ding mi a nei hi; ama a si ciengin a nuazui zosie zong a kithezah uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaci’n tulaitah i thu tawh kisai-a kang gen nuom ah, amate pel-in hici opsah phot lel un; azieh pen tami gelna le sepna pen mihing pana ang kipan ahile ang kisie lel ding hi;"},"39":{"text":"ahi vangin Pasien tung pana ang kipan ahile lah na zo sih ding vua, tami thu-ah Pasien tawh kido-in ang kimu zaw ding uhi!” a ci hi. Amate in tua pa thugen a sang thei vua,"},"40":{"text":"inn sungah sawltahpite hlanin a satziel uhi. Tua ciengin Jesu’ min tawh thu a gen nawn lo nadingun amate thu a pieh zaw ciengun a hlakia uhi."},"41":{"text":"Biehna uliente kung pan a peikhiet ciengun amate in ama’ min ziehin mindaina thuoh tah sa-in a lungdam mama uhi."},"42":{"text":"Nisimin biehinnpi sung le inn sungah Jesu, Messiah ahi hi, ci-in khawl loin thu hilin a tangko uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hunin nuazuite khang tehtehin Greek ham a zang Jew mite in nisim anneh hawmna-ah a meigongte uh kithudon lo hi, ci-in Hebrew mite a mawsah uhi.","title":"Nasem dingin Upa Sagi Kiteel"},"2":{"text":"Sawm le nite in zong nuazui mi buppi hlanin amate kungah, Pasien thu gen ding don man lo lienga anneh tuidawn vai tawh kang kitala ding uh ko adingin kilawm lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin lawmte aw, no sung panin mite in a zatah, Hlagau le pilna tawh a kidim pasal sagi teel unlen tami nasep a sem dingin ka koi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ko ka hi ule thungetna le thuhilna lamah kang kipumpieh ding uhi,” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amau’ thugen in mi honpite lungkimsah ahi ziehin, amate in upna le Hlagau Siengtho tawh a kidim Stephen, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Judah biehna panin a kikhel Antioch khuomi Nicolas-te a teel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in sawltahpite mai-ah tua mite dingsahin a lu tung vuah khut nga-in thu a ngetpieh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Pasien’ thu kizel suohin Jerusalem ah nuazuite nahpi tahin khang a, siempu tampite in zong tua upna thu a zui uhi."},"8":{"text":"Stephen, hepina le vanglietna tawh kidim a, ama in mite lahah lim le na lamdang thupite a bawl hi.","title":"Stephen a Kimatna"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin Suohta Mite’ kikhopna (amau’ kilawna) panin mi pawlkhat, Cyrene-te, Alexander-te, Cilicia gam le Asia gam panin mite in Stephen langpangin a kisel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle ama in pilna le Hlagau tawh a gen thute amate in a nang zo tuon sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in, “Ama in Moses le Pasien simmawna thu a gen ka za uhi,” ci-a a gen dingin mi pawlkhat a hantawh vua, a cieldap uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in mipite, upate le thukham hil siete zong a tawhnawi uhi; tua ciengin Stephen tawh kitalsihin ama manin biehna uliente kungah a puoh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Zuouthu teci dingin zong mi a ciel vua, “Tam mipa in tami siengtho mun le thukham a gensie zing mielmuol hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami Nazareth mi Jesu in tam mun susie gawpin Moses ei pieh ngainate zong ka khelmang ding hi, ci-in a gen ka za uhi,” a cisah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Biehna uliente kikhopna sunga to mi zosie in Stephen a etcien ule amate in a maitang, vantungmi’ maitang tawh kibangin a mu ciet uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa in ama kungah, “Tam thu a man ma amah?” ci-in dong hi.","title":"Biehna Uliente tunga Stephen’ Thugenna"},"2":{"text":"Stephen in: “Sanggamte le pate aw, na ngai un. Haran khuo ah i pu uh Abraham a ten masang, Mesopotamia gama a op lai-in ama kungah vanglien Pasien na kilah a,"},"3":{"text":"‘Na gam na lei le na be na phungte nuasie inlen, nangma kang lah ding gamah pei in,’ na ci hi.","ref":"Pien 12:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in Chaldea-te gam nuasie-in Haran khuo ah a teng hi. A pa a si zaw ciengin Pasien in tua panin tu-a na tenna uh gamah na lalsah hi.","ref":"Pien 11:31; 12:4"},"5":{"text":"Ama in tua gamah a luo ding leitang kephangcie khat nangawn a na pie sih a, ta a nei sih vangin ama’ nua-a pieng a suon a hlahte tungah tua gam pieh dingin a na kamciem hi.","ref":"Pien 12:7; 13:15; 15:18; 17:8"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin midang gam khatah a suon a hlahte pemta-in omin salin kiman ding a, amate in kum zali sung bawlsietna a thuoh ding uhi, ci-in Pasien in tam bangin a gen hi."},"7":{"text":"‘Ahi vangin keima in amau’ na a semsah tua minam tungah thu ka khen ding hi,’ Pasien in ci a, ‘Tua zaw ciengin amate pusuohin tam munah keima ei bie ding uhi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 15:13-14; Pei 3:12"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien in ama teptan thuciemna a pie hi. Tuaci’n Abraham pen Isaac’ pa hi a, a suo zaw ni giet ni-in a tep a tanpieh hi. Isaac pen Jacob’ pa hi a, Jacob pen sawm le nite’ pienna pupi ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 17:10-14; 21:2-4; 25:26; 29:31–35:18"},"9":{"text":"Pupite in Joseph a na haza vua, Egypt gamah a na zua uhi; hizongle Pasien in ama a oppi a,","ref":"Pien 37:11, 28; 39:2, 21"},"10":{"text":"gentheina panin ama na hunkhie-in Egypt kumpi pa Pharaoh mai-ah a din ciengin pilna le maipha na ngasah ahi ziehin Egypt gam le ama’ inn sung vai zosie a uhsah hi.","ref":"Pien 41:39-41"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Egypt gam le Canaan gam sung teng zosie-ah kielpi le hahsatna lienpi tung a, i pu i pate in an neh ding a na mu zo sih uhi.","ref":"Pien 42:1-2"},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jacob in Egypt gamah an om hi, ci a zah bepin tua munah a khatveina a haw dingin i pate a na sawl hi."},"13":{"text":"A niveina a haw ciengun Joseph in a sanggamte kungah ama koi ahei, ci ama le ama na kigen a, tuaci’n Pharoah in Joseph’ innkuonpi teng na thei hi.","ref":"Pien 45:1, 16"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin Joseph in mi sawlin ama kunga pei dingin a pa Jacob le a hieng a san teng zosie hlansah a, amate a unpi-un sawm sagi le nga a pha uhi;","ref":"Pien 45:9-10, 17-18; 46:27"},"15":{"text":"tuaci’n Egypt gamah Jacob peisuh a, i pu i pate ma bangin tua gamah ama zong a si hi.","ref":"Pien 46:1-7; 49:33"},"16":{"text":"Shechem-ah a luong uh kipuokia a, Abraham in Shechem khuomi Hamor’ tapate tung panin dangka tawh a na leisa hankhuh sungah ama kivui hi.","ref":"Pien 23:3-16; 33:19; 50:7-13; Josh 24:32"},"17":{"text":"Pasien in Abraham tunga a bawl a thuciemna a tun kuonin Egypt gamah ei mite pungin a tam tehteh vua,"},"18":{"text":"Egypt gamah Joseph thei lo kumpi dang khat a khan cieng dongin amate a pung a meng uhi.","ref":"Pei 1:7-8"},"19":{"text":"Ama in i minamte a ngien tawh bawl a, a tasente uh a si nadingin a paimang nadingun i pu i pate zawthaw bawlin a sawl hi.","ref":"Pei 1:10-11, 22"},"20":{"text":"Tua hun sungin Moses suoh a, ama pen Pasien mai-ah a meel hoi mama hi. A pa inn ah ama hla thum sung kikem hi.","ref":"Pei 2:2"},"21":{"text":"Ama a kipaimang ciengin Pharaoh’ tanu in a tapa dingin la a, ama in a tapa bang lienin bawlin a khansuo hi.","ref":"Pei 2:3-10"},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n Egypt pilna zosie Moses kihil a, thugenna le na sepna-ah mi thupi mama khat a suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kum sawmli a phah ciengin a sanggam Israel-te kunga haw ding a lungsim ah a kilo hi."},"24":{"text":"Egypt mi khat in a mipite khat a bawlsiet a mu ciengin phu la a, ama in a bawlsiet pa humin Egypt pa a that hi."},"25":{"text":"Pasien in ama tungtawnin amate a hunkhie ding ahi lamtah a tanaute in a thei ding sa a, ahi vangin amate in a thei sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"A zing ciengin amate lahah a kihau mi pawlkhat kungah pei-in lemtuo ding hanciem a, ‘Guoite aw, sanggam na hi bo uhi; bang dinga kihau na hi uh ahei?’ a va ci ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin a vengpa a bawlsie pa in Moses thalsawn a, ‘Ko ei uh ding le thu ei khen dinga koi in nang ang se ahei?"},"28":{"text":"Zani-a Egypt mipa na tha banga kei zong ei tha sawm na hi amah?’ na ci giap hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam thu a zah ciengin Moses taimangin Midian gamah pemta-in a va om ta a, khum gamah tapa ni a va nei ta hi.","ref":"Pei 2:11-15; Pei 18:3-4"},"30":{"text":"“Kum sawmli a cin zaw ciengin Sinai Muol gamlah sawlbawh kawm meikuong sung panin vantungmi khat ama kungah a va kilah ta hi."},"31":{"text":"Moses in tua a sil mu pen lamdang a sa mama hi; a en dingin ama in a va nai ta leh tua panin Topa’ aw ging a:"},"32":{"text":"‘Kei pen na pu na pate uh’ Pasien, Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob-te’ Pasien ka hi hi,’ a ci hi. Moses citun gawpin a en ngam sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa in ama kungah, ‘Na dinna mun leitang a siengtho ahi ziehin na kedap suo in."},"34":{"text":"Keima in Egypt gama ka mite kibawlsietna ka mu tahtah ta a, a tauna uh zong ka za zo ta a, amate hunkhie dingin keima kang kumsuh zo hi. Tu-in hing pei in, Egypt gamah nang kang sawl ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 3:1-10"},"35":{"text":"“Moses pen amate in, ‘Koi in ei uh ding le thukhen dinga nang ang se ahei? ci-a a niel pa uh ahi a, tu-in ahile Pasien in sawlbawh kawm ama tunga a kilah vantungmi tungtawnin a uh ding le a hunkhie dinga a sawl pa ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 2:14"},"36":{"text":"Ama in Egypt gam, San tuipi le senel gam sungah kum sawmli sung lim le na lamdangte a bawl zaw ciengin amate a peipi hi.","ref":"Pei 7:3; 14:21; Gam 14:33"},"37":{"text":"‘Pasien in note adingin na mipite sung panin kei tawh a kibang kamsang khat ang piengsah ding hi,’ ci-a Israel-te kunga a gen pa khu tami Moses ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:15, 18"},"38":{"text":"Ama pen senel gam mihon kikhopna lah, Sinai Muol tunga ama a hopi vantungmi, le i pu i pate tawh a omton pa ahi hi. Eite tunga ei pieh ding thuphuonte a sangsawn pa zong a hi hi.","ref":"Pei 19:1–20:17; Thkna 5:1-33"},"39":{"text":"I pu i pate in ama’ thu a mang nuom sih uhi; tuale mahin ama na puse-in Egypt gamah kilekia nopna lungsim a nei vua,"},"40":{"text":"Aaron kungah, ‘Ka lampi vuah kote ei pui dingin pasien-te ei bawlpieh in; azieh pen Egypt panin ei peipi tami Moses lah bang tuoh a ta ahei, ka thei zo ta sih uhi,’ a ci uhi.","ref":"Pei 32:1"},"41":{"text":"Tua hunin amate in bawngno lim khat bawl pai-in tua milim adingin kithoina silpieh a pie vua, amate in a khut vua a bawl uh a nasepte uh tungah a kipah mama uhi.","ref":"Pei 32:2-6"},"42":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in amate elngat a, a kamsangte laibu sungah a kigiel ma bangin vantung nate a bie dingin amate a pie ta hi: ‘Israel innkuonte aw, gamlahah kum sawmli sung, gante go-in na biehpiehnate uh kei tunga nei pieh uh ahi ngel ei mah?"},"43":{"text":"Ahi sih hi; note in Moloch pasien’ puonbuh tawh, na pasien uh ahi Rephan aasi le na bieh ding vua na bawl uh milimte na puoton uhi. Tuaci’n Babylon galah note kang hemkhie ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Amos 5:25-27"},"44":{"text":"I pu i pate in gamlahah teci panna puonbuh a nei vua, tua khu Pasien in Moses kunga a na hilsa, a musa a lim banga kibawl ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 25:9, 40"},"45":{"text":"Pasien in i pu i pate mai-a a na naw dawh minamte’ leitang a suonmang ciengun, i pu i pate in Joshua tawh tua puonbuh na puo leuleu vua, tua munah David hun cieng dong a om hi.","ref":"Josh 3:14-17"},"46":{"text":"David in Pasien’ maipha nga a, Jacob’ biehinn opna mun khat a mu thei nadingin Pasien kungah thu ngen hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-16; 1Khg 17:1-14"},"47":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama adinga biehinn a lampieh pa pen Solomon ahi bo hi.","ref":"1Kum 6:1-38; 2Khg 3:1-17"},"48":{"text":"Ahi vangin mihingte’ khut tawh a kibawl inn sungah Sangpen Pasien a teng sih hi. Kamsang pa in a gen bangin:"},"49":{"text":"‘Vantung ka tona ahi a, leitung, ka keng ngahna ahi hi. Kei adingin bang inn lam ding na hi uh ahei? Ahi sihle ka khawl nading bang mun ahei? Topa in ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Tamte zosie keima’ khutsuo vive hi lo amah?’ a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 66:1-2"},"51":{"text":"“No a lungkhau, na lungsim ule na bil vua tep kitan lo mite aw, na pu na pate uh’ gamtat bang lienin na gamta vua, Hlagau Siengtho na langpang ngitnget uhi.","ref":"Isa 63:10"},"52":{"text":"Na pu na pate un a bawlsiet lo kamsang koi om ahei? Amate in Midih Pa pei nadinga thu magente a that vua, tu-in note pen tua pa a lehehte le a thatte na suoh ta uhi."},"53":{"text":"Note in vantung mite tung pana ang kipie thukham na nga vangun na zui tuom sih uhi,” a ci hi."},"54":{"text":"Tam thute a zah ciengun amate lungso-in Stephen a ha a gawisan uhi.","title":"Suong tawh Stephen a Kiseliana"},"55":{"text":"Ahi vangin Stephen pen Hlagau Siengtho tawh kidim a, ama in vantung a ento leh Pasien’ vanglietna le Pasien’ zietlama a ding Jesu a mu hi."},"56":{"text":"Ama in, “En un,” vantungte kihongin Pasien’ zietlamah mihing Tapa a ding ka mu hi!” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Hizongle amate in a bil uh humin awging tah tawh kiko-in ama lamah a honpi-un a tai uhi."},"58":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuo pulamah ama kaiphit gawpin suong tawh a sep uhi. Tecite in a puontungsilte uh Saul a kici tangval pa khat’ keng phungah a koi uhi."},"59":{"text":"Amate in suong tawh Stephen a se laitahun ama in thungen a, “ Topa Jesu aw, ka hla la ta’n,” a ci hi."},"60":{"text":"Tua ciengin khupdinin nahpi tahin kiko a, “ Topa aw , amate na mawsah sin,” a ci zaw ciengin a si hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni-in Jerusalem ah hlattuom pawlpi bawlsietna lienpi kipan a, sawltahpite simlo mi zosie, Judea gam le Samaria gam mun zosie-ah a kithethang uhi.","title":"Saul in Pawlpi Bawlsie"},"2":{"text":"Pasien’ thu-a kipumpieh mite in Stephen a vui vua, ama ziehin nahpi tahin a kap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle inn khat zaw inn khatah Saul lutin hlattuom pawlpi susie a, numei le pasalte kaiphitin thong sungah a khum hi.","ref":"Sawl 22:4-5; 26:9-11"},"4":{"text":"Tu-in a kithethang mite mun khat pan mun khatah a vah kawikawi vua, Pasien’ thu a tangko uhi.","title":"Samaria ah Philip in Thugen"},"5":{"text":"Samaria khuopi khatah Philip peisuh a, amate kungah Messiah thu a tangko hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihonpi in Philip’ thugente za-in, a na lamdang bawlte a mu ciengun lungsim kikhatin a thu gente lawptahin a ngai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen dawivei mi tampite sung panin hlabua nei mite a awng vagua uhi; tuale amate zong pusuohin phalsi le khelbai mi tampi in damna a nga uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n tua khuopi sungah kipahna lienpi a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuami khuo sungah Simon kici mi khat om a, ama in ni dangin mitphiel lahin, Samaria mite a na cizasah mama a, kei zong mi thupi khat ka hi hi, na kici hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a neupen panin a golpen dongin a unpi-un a thugen lawptahin a ngai vua, “Tam pa khu Vanglienpa a kici Pasien’ vanglietna ahi hi,” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a mitphiel tawh hun sauveipi sung amate lamdang sasah ahi ziehin amate in a thugen lawptahin a ngai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Pasien’ manggam lungdamna thu le Jesu Khris’ min a tangko Philip a up uh ciengin a numei pasalin a ki-baptize uhi."},"13":{"text":"Simon mama nangawn in zong a um hi. A ki-baptize zaw ciengin Philip kungah ama om den a, a pieng limte le na lamdang lienpite a mu ciengin lamdang a sa mama hi."},"14":{"text":"Samaria-te in Pasien’ thu sang thei ta uhi, ci thu Jerusalem-a om sawltahpite in a zah ciengun amate kungah Peter le John a sawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama gel peisuhin Samaria-te in Hlagau Siengtho a nga nadingun thu a ngetpieh uhi."},"16":{"text":"(azieh pen amate khat beh tungah Hlagau tung nai lo hi. Amate ahile Topa Jesu’ min beh tawh a ki-baptize zo pan ahi na bo uhi)."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter le John in amate tungah khut a nga vua, tuale amate in Hlagau Siengtho a nga uhi."},"18":{"text":"Sawltahpite’ khut ngahna tawh Hlagau a kipieh lam Simon in a mu ciengin ama gel tungah sum lui-in,"},"19":{"text":"“Mi khatpo tunga khut ka ngah ciengin Hlagau Siengtho a nga thei nadingin tami vanglietna kei zong ei pie gel in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter in ama kungah, “Sum tawh Pasien’ letsong nga sawm na hi ziehin na sum tawh mangthaiton in."},"21":{"text":"Pasien mai-ah na lungtang dih lo ahi ziehin tami thu-ah na kihal thei sih a, tanh zong na nei sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tami na gitlona panin kisiakia inlen Topa kungah thu ngen in. Ama in na lungsim sunga na ngaisutna ang maisah thei kha ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sinkha bangin na lungsim zong kha a, gitlona in nang ang kanbawm lam ka mu hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Simon in, “Na thugen khat beh ka tunga ang tun lo nadingin Topa kungah thu ei ngetpieh in,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Peter le John in teci pangin Topa’ thu a gen zaw cieng gelin Jerusalem khuopi ah kilekia-in Samaria khuo tampite-ah lungdamna thu a tangko uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Topa’ vantungmi khat in Philip kungah, “Tho inlen Jerusalem pan Gaza lam zotna leitaw lamah va pei ta’n,” a ci hi. (Tua khu senel gam lampi ahi hi.)","title":"Philip le a Kiget Ethiopia Mangpa"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama zong tho-in a pei pai hi. Khumin Ethiopia kumpinu Candace’ khut nei-a vaihawm mangpa le kumpinu’ gou zosie a uh cilgesa Ethiopia mangpa khat a om hi. Pasien bie dingin Jerusalem khuo ah ama a pei hi."},"28":{"text":"A kilekia ciengin a sakol leeng tung tuong kawmin kamsang Isaiah’ laibu a sim hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciengin Hlagau in Philip kungah, “Pei inlen tami sakol leeng zui in,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n Philip zong tua pa kungah tai phei a, kamsang Isaiah laibu a sim a za hi. Ama in, “Tua na laisim a thu na telsiem ei mah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Ei hil a op sih leh bang ka ci thei ding ahei?” ci-in a dawng hi. Leeng tungah tua pa tuongin ama gei-a to dingin Philip a ciel hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua a lai siengtho mun sim khu tami ahi hi: “Tha dinga kipeipi tuu bangin ama kipeipi hi. A mul metpa mai-ah a ham lo tuuno bangin ama in a kam a kah sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama a kiniemkhieh ziehin ama tungah thutang kizang lo hi. Ama’ khanggui koi in sut thei ding ahei? Azieh pen leitung panin ama’ hinna kila zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 53:7-8"},"34":{"text":"Cilgesa Ethiopia mangpa in Philip kungah, “Thu khat hing dong vang, tami kamsangpa ama le ama kigen amah, ahi sihle midang khat’ thu gen hizaw ahei?” ci-in a dong hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciengin Philip thugen kipan a, tua a lai siengtho simna mun panin ama kungah Jesu’ thu ahi lungdamna thu a tangko hi."},"36":{"text":"Lampi-ah amate a pei laitahun tui opna mun khatah a tung uhi. Cilgesa mangpa in, “En un, tanah tui a om hi! Ka ki-baptize ding bang in ei kham ahei?” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuale Philip in, “Na lungsim zosie tawh na up leh na ki-baptize thei hi,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Jesu Khris pen Pasien’ Tapa ahi hi, ci-in ka um hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in a leeng khawlsah a, tui sungah Philip le cilgesa mangpa a nipi-in a kumsuh vua, Philip in ama a baptize hi."},"39":{"text":"Tui sung panin ama gel a kato ciengun Topa’ Hlagau in Philip a lato hi; tua cilgesa mangpa in ama a mu nawn sih a, tuale ama’ lampi-ah lungdam tahin a pei ta hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in Azotus khuo-ah Philip mukia a, ama in tua gam teng nawh a, Caesarea a tun dongin khuo zosie-ah lungdamna thu a tangko hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul in tua hun sung tengin Topa’ nuazuite tha dingin galgihin husang na lai a, siempu lien pa kungah pei-in,","title":"Saul a Kikhelna"},"2":{"text":"tua Lampi a zui numei pasal a mu popo uh hensa-in Jerusalem a tut thei nadingun ama in Damascus khuo-a biehinn uhte kungah phalna lai ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama pei-in Damascus khuo a tun kuon ciengin vantung panin khuovah khat in a kimkot thakhatin a khawsuh hi."},"4":{"text":"Leilahah ama puasuh a, “Saul, Saul aw, bangzieh a kei nei ci bawlsiet ahei?” ci-in awging khat a za hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa aw, nang koi na hei?” ci-in dong hi. Ama in, “Nei bawlsiet Jesu ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hizongle tho inlen khuopi sungah lut lacin na bawl ding thu ang kigen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"A khuolzinpi mite in tua awging a zah vangun koima in mu lo ahi ziehin gen ding thei loin a dinggaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"Leilah panin Saul thoto a, a mit a ha vangin khuo a mu thei sih hi; tuaci’n amate in a khut tawh ama tu-in Damascus khuo sungah a peipi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in ni thum sung khuo mu thei loin, an ne lo tui dawn loin a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Khumin Damascus ah Ananias kici nuazui khat a om hi. Topa in a mangmuna sungah, “Ananias,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Tanah om ing, Topa aw, ” ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in ama kungah, “Tho inlen Lampi Zang a kici khatah pei-in, tuale Judas’ inn ah Tarsus khuomi Saul a kici pa va sui ta’n. Tu laitahin ama thungenin a om a,"},"12":{"text":"ama in khuo a mukia thei nadingin Annaias a kici mi khat pei-in ama’ lu tungah a khut a ngahna thu, a mangmuna sungah a mu hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Ananias in, “ Topa aw, tam pa in Jerusalem-a na misiengthote tungah bangza tahin sietna bawl ahei ci thu mi tampite tung panin ka za zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam sunga om na min a lo mi zosie a hen thei nadingin ama in siempupite tung panin thu a nga zo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in ama kungah, “Va pei in, bangzieh ahei cile ama pen Gentile-te, kumpite, le Israel-te mai-ah ka min a puo dinga ka tuomtelsa ka vanzah khat ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in keima’ min ziehin bangza-in gimna thuoh ding ahei, ci pen kei mama in ama ka lah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n Ananias pei-in tua inn sungah a lut hi. Ama in Saul tungah a khut nga a, “Sanggam pa Saul aw, nangma in khuo mu theikia-in Hlagau Siengtho tawh na kidim thei nadingin tami mun na peina lampi-a ang kilah ahi Topa Jesu in kei ei sawl hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale thakhatin Saul’ mit panin ngalip tawh a kibang na khat kiesuh a, ama zong tho-in ki-baptize pai a,"},"19":{"text":"an halkhat a neh zaw ciengin a tha a hatkia hi. Damascus khuo-a om nuazuite tawh ama ni tampi a omton hi."},"20":{"text":"Kikhopna inn sungah, “Ama Pasien’ Tapa ahi hi,” ci-in thakhatin Jesu’ thu tangko ding a kipan hi.","title":"Saul in Damascus ah Thuhil"},"21":{"text":"A thugen a za zosie in lamdang sa-in, “ Tam mipa, Jerusalem-a Jesu’ min a lote a bawlsie pa hi lo amah? Siempupite mai-ah amate hensa-a puoh ding a ngimna tawh ama tana ang pei hi lo amah?” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Saul vang nei semsem a, Jesu in Messiah ahi hi, ci-in a hilcien ziehin ama in Damascus-a teng Jew mite a amtumsah hi."},"23":{"text":"Ni tampi zaw ciengin Jew mite in ama a daptha sawm vua,","title":"Jew Mite Kung pan Saul Suohta"},"24":{"text":"hinanle amate in a tha sawm lamtah Saul in a thei hi. Ama a tha thei nadingun sun le zanin tunkot tengah a pang uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin zan lai-in a nuazuite in Saul peipi-in kulvang panin bawng tawh a khiesuh uhi.","ref":"2Cor 11:32-33"},"26":{"text":"Jerusalem ah ama a tun ciengin nuazuite tawh kipawl ding a hanciem hi; tuale amate in nuazui dingin ama um zo lo uh ahi ziehin amate zosie in ama a giing uhi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Saul"},"27":{"text":"Hizongle Barnabas in Saul hlanin sawltahpite kungah peipi a, a lam pei laitaha ama a hopi Topa a mu dan, Damascus khuo-a Jesu min’ tawh hangtaha a thugen dan zosie teng amate a hilcien hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalem khuo sunga om amate lahah ama sungtum pusuohin a om hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama pen Greek ham a zang Jew mite tawh zong thu a kisel hi; hinanle amate in ama tha a sawm uhi."},"30":{"text":"Thu um mite in tua thu a thei ciengun Caesarea khuo ah ama peipi suhin Tarsus khuo ah a hla uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua hun sung tengin Judea gam, Galilee gam le Samaria gam zosie-a om hlattuom pawlpite in lungmuonna le kilamna a nga uhi. Topa zatahna sung le Hlagau Siengtho henepna sungah a nuntah ziehun amate a pung semsem uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tu-in thu um mite lahah Peter zin kawikawi a, Lydda khuo-a om mi siengthote kungah zong a peisuh hi.","title":"Aeneas a Kidamsahna"},"33":{"text":"Tua munah ama in a phalsi, kum giet sung lupmun tung ngah Aeneas kici mi khat a mu hi."},"34":{"text":"Peter in tua pa kungah, “Aeneas aw, Jesu Khris in ang damsah zo ta hi; tho inlen na lupna ziel in!” a ci hi. Tuale thakhatin ama a tho pai hi."},"35":{"text":"Lydda le Sharon khuo-a teng mi zosie in tua pa a mu uh ciengin Topa lamah a kihei uhi."},"36":{"text":"Khumin Joppa khuo ah Tabitha a kici nuazui numei khat om a, a min pen Greek kamin Dorcas ahi hi. Ama pen sil hoite sem ding le mi khuotuona lam sem dinga kipumpieh ahi hi.","title":"Peter, Lydda le Joppa Khuo ah"},"37":{"text":"Tua laitahin tua nu a ci na-in a si hi. Tua nu’ luong a buol zaw ciengun inndan tungnungah ama a siel uhi."},"38":{"text":"Lydda khuo pen Joppa khuo tawh kinai hi a, tua khuo ah Peter a op lam nuazuite in a zah ciengun mi ni sawlin, “Kiheh loin ko kungah hing hawpah ta’n,” ci-in a thumsah uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n Peter zong dingin amate tawh a zawhton pai hi; ama a tun ciengin amate in inndan tungnungah ama a zawpi uhi. Peter gei-ah meigong zosie a ding vua, a kaa kawmun Dorcas tawh a opton lai vua a gat songkholte le puontuolte ama a ensah uhi."},"40":{"text":"Peter in amate zosie pusuohsah a, tua ciengin ama khupdingin thu a ngen hi. Siluong lamah kihei-in, “Tibatha aw, tho in,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin tua nu a mit hah a, Peter a mu ciengin tho-in a to hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in tua nu a khut hlahin a dingsah hi. Tua ciengin misiengthote le meigongte hlan a, tua a hing numei nu a ensah hi."},"42":{"text":"Joppa khuo muncin tengah tam thu kizel a, mi tampi in Topa a um uhi."},"43":{"text":"Khum hun sung tengin Simon a kici savun bawlpa khat tawh Joppa khuo ah bakhat sung ama a taam hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khumin Ceasarea khuo-ah Italy Galkapte a kici lahah mi zakhat a uh Cornelius min nei galkapmang khat a om hi.","title":"Peter le Cornelius"},"2":{"text":"Ama pen a innkuonpite tawh biehna lama kipumpieh Pasien a zatah mi khat ahi hi; ama in kiphaltahin mite tungah huna pie-in Pasien kungah thu ngen den hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in nitah nai thum pawlin mang mu a, Pasien’ vantungmi khat pei-in ama kungah “Cornelius aw,” ci-in a hopina kicientahin a mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a zau kawmin tua pa encien a, “Bang ahei Topa ?” a ci hi. Ama in, “Na thungetna le na kipiehnate, a kiphawh zing dingin Pasien mai-ah tungto zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Joppa khuo ah mi sawl inlen a min Peter kici Simon hlansah in."},"6":{"text":"Ama pen tuipi gei-a teng savun bawlpa Simon inn ah a tung hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama a hopi vantungmi a peikhiet zaw ciengin ama’ silate mi ni le ama’ na sem a galkapte lahah Pasien lamah a pawnthaw galkap khat hlan a,"},"8":{"text":"ama in amate kungah thu zosie a gen zaw ciengin Joppa khuo ah a sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"A zing ni ciengin amate khuol a zin vua, khuopi a tun kuon uh sunkim pawl ciengin thungen dingin innkhumzang ah Peter kato hi."},"10":{"text":"Peter a gilkielin bangkhat a ne nuom hi; tuale an a kihuon laitahin Peter haitu pah a, mang khat a mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Van kihong a, tuale ama in a pheng golpi khat tawh a kibang na khat ang kumsuhin a ningli tawh leitunga ang kikhiehsuh a mu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua sungah kengli a nei ganhing namcin, a awm tawh a kithol ganhing namcin, le vana a leng va namcin a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin, “Peter aw, tho inlen tuate go-in ne in,” a ci aw khat a za hi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle Peter in, “ Topa aw, hi thei lo ding hi; azieh pen a bua le a sieng lo na khat popo ka ne ngai malmal sih hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua aw in ama a niveina hopi a, “Pasien in a sienga a bawlsate a bua ci paupau sin,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Thumvei dongin tua bangin pieng a, khum zaw ciengin vantung lamah tua sil a kilato kia ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua a mang muna pen bang a cinopna hi ding ahei, ci-in Peter a lungman mama laitahin Cornelius’ sawl mite in Simon’ inn a kan kawikawi vua, tunkot gei-ah thakhatin a ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua munah Peter a kici Simon a tung ei mah, ci-in amate in a galdawh uhi."},"19":{"text":"A mang muna thu Peter in a ngaisut laitahin Hlagau in ama kungah, “En in, mihing thum in nang ang sui uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in tho-in kumsuh inlen uoikai loin amate tawh zawh in; azieh pen amate keima’ ang sawl ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mite kungah Peter peisuh a, “Na sui pa uh keima ka hi hi; bang dinga tana hing pei na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in, “Nangma’ thugen ngai dingin Pasien a giing, Judah minam zosie in a zatah, mi zakhat a uh galkapmangpa Cornelius in ama’ inn ah nang ang hlan dingin vantungmi siengtho khat in thu pie zo hi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n Peter in inn sungah amate hlanin zin a tungsah hi. A zing ciengin tho-in amate tawh a peiton a, tuale Joppa panin zong thu um mite pawlkhat in ama a zui uhi."},"24":{"text":"A zing ciengin Ceasarea khuo a tung uhi. Amate tun ding a lamet ziehin Cornelius in a hieng a san le a lawm a guolte na hlan hi."},"25":{"text":"Peter a tun ciengin Cornelius in ama na dawn a, a keng phungah bawhin a bie hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin Peter in ama phongto a, “Ding in; kei zong mihing ka hi lel bo hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama tawh a kiho kawmin inn sungah Peter a lut leh a kikhawm mi tampi a mu hi."},"28":{"text":"Peter in amate kungah, “Judah mi khat adingin Gentile mi khat tawh kigop ding le kikawm ding pen thukham tawh kituoh lo hi, ci noma ma in na theisa uh ahi hi; ahi vangin mi khatpo a bua hi, ahi sihle a sieng lo ahi hi, ka ci lo nadingin Pasien in keima tungah ei lah zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n kei ei kihlat ciengin niel loin ka pei hi, tu-in note in bang dinga nei hlat uh ahiei?” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Cornelius in, “A tawpsa ni li lai tu bang hun nai thumin ka inn sungah thu ka nget laitahin puonpah a sil pasal khat thakhatin ka mai-ah ang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in, “Cornelius aw, na thungetna kiza zo a, Pasien mai-ah na kipiehnate zong kiciemte zo hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Joppa ah mi sawl inlen, Peter a kici Simon va sui sah ta’n; tuipi gei-a teng savun bawlpa Simon inn ah ama a tung hi,” ei ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ke’n zong nang ang hlan dingin mi kang sawl pai a, nang pei thei ziehin hoi mama hi. Tuaci’n Topa in na gen dinga ang sawl thu zosie a ngai dingin tu-in Pasien mai-ah ka om uhi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate kungah Peter thu gen a kipan hi: “ Pasien in mi khentuom nei lo hi, ci thu ka thei tahtah a,","title":"Gentile-te in Lungdamna Thu Za","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"35":{"text":"ama in minam zosie lahah ama giingin dihtaha a gamta mite a sang hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in Israel mite tunga thu a na puoh, Jesu Khris zieha a kigen kilemna thu note in na thei uhi. Ama pen mi zosie’ Topa ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"John in baptize-na thu a gen zaw ciengin Galilee gam panin Judea gam zosie-ah tua thu a kizel hi:"},"38":{"text":"Pasien in Hlagau Siengtho le vanglietna tawh Nazareth mi Jesu sathau a nu hi; ama pei kawikawi-in na hoi a sem a, dawi mangpa’ bawlsiet mi zosie a damsah hi, azieh pen ama tawh Pasien a omton hi."},"39":{"text":"Judah gam sung le Jerusalem khuo sunga ama’ bawl na zosie-ah kote teci ka hi uhi. Amate in sing tungah ama khai-in a that uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanle a ni thum ni-in Pasien in ama thosahkia-in mi tungah ama kilahsah a,"},"41":{"text":"mi zosie tungah hi loin, misite panin ama a thawkia zaw ciengin Pasien in teci dinga ei teelsa, ama tawh an neton tuidawnton kote mai-ah ama ang kilah hi."},"42":{"text":"Ama pen misite le a hinglai mite thu khen dingin Pasien in a sekhol pa ahi hi, ci thu mite tunga tangko ding le teci pang dingin Pasien in kote thu ei pie zo hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama a um tapo in ama’ min ziehin mawmaina a nga ding uhi, ci-in kamsang zosie in ama thu teci a pang zo uhi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Peter in tam thu a gen laitahin tua thu a za mi zosie tungah Hlagau Siengtho a tung hi.","title":"Gentile-te in Hlagau Siengtho Sang"},"45":{"text":"Peter tawh a zawhton a tep kitan thu um mite in Gentile-te tung nangawnah Hlagau Siengtho letsong a kibuoh ciengin lamdang a sa mama uhi."},"46":{"text":"Azieh pen tua mite kam tuomtuom tawh hamin Pasien’ min a phat uh amate in a za uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in, “Eima banga Hlagau Siengtho a nga tam mite a ki-baptize lo nadingin koi in tui kham thei ding ahei?” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in Jesu Khris’ min tawh a ki-baptize nadingun amate thu a pie hi. Tua ciengin ni tampi sung a tam lai nadingin amate in ama a hlo uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Gentile-te in zong Pasien’ thu sang zo ta uhi, ci thu Judea gama om sawltahpite le thu umte in a za uhi.","title":"Jerusalem Pawlpi tunga Peter Thuzahsahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n Jerusalem ah Peter a peito ciengin a tep kitan thu um mite in,"},"3":{"text":"“Bang ziehin a tep kitan lo mite kungah tungin amate tawh an neton mawh na hei? ci-in a mawsah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter in a thu omzie teng a banbanin amate kungah sut a,"},"5":{"text":"“Joppa khuo ah thu ngenin ka haituh laitahin mang ka mu hi. Keima in vantung panin a ningli ciet pana a kikhaisuh a peh golpi bang khat ka kunga ang tusuh ka mu hi;"},"6":{"text":"tuami limtahin ka et leh keng li a nei ganhingte, sasielne gamsate, a bawhva ganhingte le vana a leng vate ka mu hi."},"7":{"text":"Awging khat in, “Peter aw, tho inlen, go-in ne in,” ei ci zong ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in, ‘ Topa , hi thei malmal sih; azieh pen a bua ahi sihle a sieng lo nate ka kam sungah a tum ngai nai vawt sih hi,’ ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua awging ma in vantung panin a niveina ei dawng a, ‘Pasien in a sienga a bawlsate a bua hi bo ci paupau sin,’ ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-a bangin thumvei ang pieng a, tua ciengin tua teng zosie a unpi-in vantungah a kikaito kia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua laitahin ka opna inn ah Caesarea pana ang kisawl mi thumte thakhatin ang tung uhi."},"12":{"text":"Eite le amau’ kikalah khentuom ci nei loin amate tawh a zawhton dingin kei kungah Hlagau in ei gen zo hi. Tami i sanggam guhte in zong ei zui vua, tua mipa’ inn ah ka tung uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in ka kung vuah a inn sunga vantungmi khat a din a mu dan le, ‘Joppa khuo-ah mi sawl inlen Peter a kici Simon hlansah in."},"14":{"text":"Nangma le na innkuonpi bup un hutdamna na nga thei nading uh thu ang gen ding hi,’ a ci dan teng ei gen hi."},"15":{"text":"Thu gen ka kipat laitahin eite tungah Hlagau Siengtho a tuncil lai bangin amate tungah zong ang tung hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale Topa in, ‘John in tui tawh na baptize a, ahi vangin note na hi ule Hlagau Siengtho tawh ang ki-baptize ding hi,’ ci-in a gen ka phawhkia hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:5"},"17":{"text":"Topa Jesu Khris i up ciengin Pasien in letsong ei pieh bangin amate tungah zong a kibanga a pieh ahileh Pasien’ nasepna a khahtan zo dingin kei koi hi lel ka hei?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tami thu a zah ciengun amate a dai dide uhi. “Tua ciengin Pasien in Gentile-te tung nangawn ah zong hinna nga thei nading kisiakiana thu a pie hi,” ci-in amate in Pasien a phat uhi."},"19":{"text":"Stephen tungah bawlsietna a tun ziehin a kithethangte in Phoenicia gam, Cyprus tuikul, le Antioch dongin a banzin vua, amate in Jew mite kung simlo koima kungah thu a hil sih uhi.","title":"Antioch Khuo-a Pawlpi","ref":"Sawl 8:1-4"},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Antioch khuo-a pei, Cyprus tuikul le Cyrene khuo mite pawlkhat in Greek ham a zang Jew mite kungah zong Topa Jesu’ thu a tangko uhi."},"21":{"text":"Topa’ khut amate tawh om a, Topa lamah thu um mi tampitah a kihei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem-a om hlattuom pawlpite in tami thu thate a zah ciengun Antioch khuo ah Barnabas a sawl uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama tungin Pasien’ hepina thupha a mu ciengin a lungdam a, tuale ama in tupna kip tawh Topa tungah a citah nadingun amate a hanthawn hi."},"24":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama pen mi hoi, Hlagau Siengtho le upna tawh a kidim mi khat ahi ziehin Topa sungah mi tampi a kibelap hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tarsus khuo ah Saul sui dingin Barnabas pei a,"},"26":{"text":"tuale ama a mu ciengin Antioch khuo ah a zawpi hi. Ama gel zong kum khat sung tungtawn hlattuom pawlpi mite tawh kimu-in mi tampi thu a hil uhi. “Tapidawte” ci-in a min kilo masa pente Antioch khuo-a nuazuite ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hunin Jerusalem panin Antioch ah kamsangte a peisuh uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate sung panin Agabus a kici mipa khat dingto-in, leitung gam zosie-ah a siehuoi kielpi khat tung ding hi, ci-in Hlagau tungtawnin a magen hi; tuale Claudias hun lai-in tuami thu tung ngai zo hi.","ref":"Sawl 21:10"},"29":{"text":"Nuazuite in ahi zaw za ciet utawh Judea gama teng thu um mite huna sum hlah dingin a khensat uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in tua bangin a bawl vua, Barnabas le Saul tung panin upate kungah a hlah uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun sawng tengin Herod Kumpipa in hlattuom pawlpi mi kimkhat a bawlsie hi.","title":"James Kithat, Peter Thongkie"},"2":{"text":"Ama in John’ sanggampa James zong namsau tawh thatsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua thu in Jew mite lungkimsah hi, ci a mu bepin ama in Peter zong mansah leuleu hi. (tua hun pen Tolsawlo Anlum Pawi hun sung ahi hi.)"},"4":{"text":"Ama a mat zaw ciengin ama in thong sungah khum a, Peisan Pawi a ven ciengin mipi mai-a peipi dingin li ta-a om galkap pawl lite’ cin dingin ap hi.","ref":"Pei 12:1-27"},"5":{"text":"Thong sungah Peter a kikhum laitahin hlattuom pawlpi mite in ama adingin Pasien kungah nahpi tahin thu a ngetpieh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Herod in Peter a lahkhiet ding kuon tuami zan ma-in siakhau gui ni tawh a kikhisa-in galkap nite kikalah Peter lum a, kot mai-ah thongcingte in a cing uhi.","title":"Thong panin Peter Kihla"},"7":{"text":"Topa ’ vantungmi khat thakhatin kilang a, thong inn sung teng khuovah khat in a tanvah hi. Vantungmi in Peter a pang behpieh a, “Mallangin tho in,” ci-in a phong leh a khuta siakhaute a kiphelmang hi."},"8":{"text":"Vantungmi in, “Na kawnggah gah inlen na kedap bul in,” a ci bangin ama in zong a bawl hi. Tua ciengin vantungmi in, “Na puonzal vat inlen ei zui in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Peter zong pusuohin ama a zui hi; ama in tua vantungmi’ huna tawh a pieng thu teng a tahtah ahi lam a thei vateh sih a, mangmu-in a kingaisun lel hi."},"10":{"text":"A khatna le a nina thongcingte a kal zaw ciengun khuopi sung lutna siakotpi mai a tung uhi. Tua kotpi ama thu-in ama gel adingin kihong a, tuale ama gel pusuohin lampi khat a zui laitahun vantungmi in thakhatin Peter a nuasie hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin Peter khuophawh a, “Tu-in Topa in a vantungmi sawlin, Herod’ khut sung pan le Judah-te’ kinepna zosie sung panin ei hunkhie zo hi, ci thu ka theicien ta hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in tam thu a thei behin a mindang khat Mark a kici John’ nu Mary inn ah haw a, tua sungah mi tampi kikhawmin thu a na ngen uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a pulam kot a kiu leh a dawng dingin Roda kici nasem numei khat a pei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua nu in Peter’ aw ahi lam a thei bepin a kipah seng ziehin kot honpieh tah zawh sangin inn sungah tai-in Peter kotah ding hi, ci-in a va gen ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in tua nu kungah, “A maw na mah!” a ci uhi. Hizongle tua nu in a om tahtah ma ahi hi, a ci paupau ciengin amate in, “Ama’ vantungmi hi bo va,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua sung tengin Peter in kot a kiukiu hi; tuale amate in kot a hon ciengun ama a mu vua, lamdang a sa mama uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a ham lo nadingun amate a khut tawh lah a, Topa in thong sung panin ama a lahkhiet dan teng a gen hi. Ama in, “James le thu um mite kungah tam thu va gen ta un,” a ci be lai hi. Tua ciengin ama in tua mun nuasie-in mundangah a pei hi."},"18":{"text":"A zing ciengin galkapte lahah Peter bangci ta ahei, ci thu buoina lienpi a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Herod in ama suisahin a mu lo bepin thongcingte thu sit a, tuale tha dingin amate thu a pie hi. Tua ciengin Judea gam panin Caesarea khuo-ah Herod peisuhin tua munah a tam hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Tyre le Sidon mite tungah Herod lungthah mama hi. Tuaci’n amate kithutuoh tahin ama kungah a pei uhi. Amau’ gam pen kumpipa’ gama anneh ding puasui ahi bo ziehun amate in kumpi’ inn sunga vaihawm ulien Blastus a zol zaw ciengun kilemna ding a ngen uhi.","title":"Herod’ Sina"},"21":{"text":"Kiciem ni a tun ciengin Herod in a kumpi puontuol sil a, kumpi’ topha tungah to-in amate kungah thu a gen hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin mite in, “Tam pen mihing’ aw ahi sih a, pasien khat’ aw ahi hi!” ci-in a awng uhi."},"23":{"text":"Herod in Pasien’ min a phat lo ziehin thakhatin Pasien’ vantungmi khat in ama a ci nasah a, than in netumin a si hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ thu khangin thuzui mi a pung semsem hi."},"25":{"text":"A nasep uh a man zaw ciengun Barnabas le Saul in a mindang khatah Mark a kici pa John zawpi-in Jerusalem ah a kilekia uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Antioch khuo-a hlattuom pawlpi sungah kamsangte le siete a om uhi: Tuate pen Barnabas, Niger kici Simeon, Cyrene khuo mi Lucius, gam uhpa Herod’ thukhen zuma vaihawm pa khat ahi Manaen le Saul ahi uhi.","title":"Barnabas le Paul Kisawl"},"2":{"text":"Topa bie-in an tangin a op laitahun Hlagau Siengtho in, “Amate in kei adingin ka hlatna nasep a sem dingin Barnabas le Saul ei tuomkhen pieh un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in zong an tangin thu a nget zaw ciengun ama gel tungah a khut uh nga-in a sawlkhie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci’n Hlagau Siengtho sawl ahi ziehin Seleucia khuo ah a peisuh uhi; tua panin tembaw tawh Cyprus tuikul-ah a pei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Salamis khuo a tun ciengun Jew mite kikhopna inn sungah Pasien’ thu a hil uhi. John zong amate hu dingin a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua tuikul tung zosie-ah a zin kawikawi vua, Paphos khuo a tun dong uh a pei zaw ciengun Bar-Jesus a kici aisan siem Judah kamsang zuou khat tawh a kituoh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ama pen a pil mama gam uhpa Dergius Paulus tawh a omton hi. Tua gam uhpa in Pasien’ thu a zah nop ziehin Barnabas le Saul a hlansah hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua mitphiel siempa Elymas (azieh pen tua khu ama’ min kiletkhietna ahi hi) in amate na langpan a, tua upna panin gam uhpa heikhiet ding a hanciem hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Paul a kici Saul zong Hlagau Siengtho tawh kidimin Elimas limtahin en a,"},"10":{"text":"“Dawimangpa’ tapa, thudih zosie’ galpa, solna le tatsietna namcin tawh a kidim pa aw, a tang Topa’ lampite a kawi-a na bawl pen tawp nai lo ding na mah?"},"11":{"text":"Ngai in, tu-in Topa’ khut in nang ang langpang a, na mit taw-in bakhat sung khuo na mu thei sih ding hi,” a ci hi. Thakhatin meii le khuomiel in a tuom ziehin tua pa in a khuta a kai ding mi a sui kawikawi hi."},"12":{"text":"A piengsa thute a mu ciengin gam uhpa in a um pai hi, bangzieh ahei cile ama in Topa’ thuhilnate lamdang a sa hi."},"13":{"text":"Paphos panin Paul le a lawmte tembaw tung tuongin Pamphylia gam Perga khuo a tung uhi. Ahi vangin tua khuo panin John in amate nuasie-in Jerusalem ah a kilekia hi;","title":"Pisidia Gam Antioch ah Paul le Barnabas"},"14":{"text":"ahi vangin Perga panin amate peisuohin Pisidia gam Antioch a tung uhi. Tuale sabbath ni-in kikhopna inn sungah amate lutin a to uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in thukham laibu le kamsangte’ laibute a sim zaw ciengun biehinn uhpa in amate kungah mi sawlin, “Sanggamte aw, mite adingin hanthotna thu na gen nop uleh gen un,” a cisah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Paul dingto a, a khut vihin thugen kipan a, “No Israel-te le Pasien giing midangte aw, ngai un."},"17":{"text":"Tami Israel-te’ Pasien in i pu i pate na teel a, Egypt leitanga a op lai-un minam lien khatin na bawl a, tua gam panin a kilamto ama’ banhat tawh amate na peipi hi.","ref":"Pei 1:7; 12:51"},"18":{"text":"Ama in gamlahah kum sawmli sung amate a na oppi kenkon hi.","ref":"Gam 14:34; Thkna 1:31"},"19":{"text":"Canaan gam sunga om minam sagite a suhsiet zaw ciengin a luo dingun a gam uh amate a pie a,","ref":"Thkna 7:1; Josh 14:1"},"20":{"text":"kum zali sung bang a luosah hi. Tua zaw ciengin ama in kamsang Samuel khang dongin amate tungah thukhente a pie hi.","ref":"Thkn 2:16; 1Sam 3:20"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kumpi khat a ngen vua, Pasien in kum sawmli sung amau’ kumpi dingin Benjamin minam sung panin Kish’ tapa Saul a pie hi.","ref":"1Sam 8:5; 10:21"},"22":{"text":"Saul a hepkhiet zaw ciengin ama in a kumpi dingun David ahisah hi. Ama’ thu a teci panna sungah ama in, ‘Ka deina zosie a sem dingin ka lungsim a su Jesse’ tapa David ka mu zo hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 13:14; 16:12; Late 89:20"},"23":{"text":"Pasien in a kamciemsa bangin tam mipa’ suonlehlahte sung panin Israel mite tungah Gumpa Jesu a piengsah hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama’ pei masangin John in Israel mi zosie tungah mawna pana kisiakiana tawh kisai baptize na thu na hil zo hi.","ref":"Mrk 1:4; Luk 3:3"},"25":{"text":"Tuale John in a sep ding teng a zaw kuon ciengin, ‘Kei koi hi va nei ci vuoi? Kei tua pa ka hi sih hi. Ka nua-ah mi khat ang pei lai ding hi; ama’ kenga a kedap gui sutpieh dingin zong ka kilawm sih hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:11; Mrk 1:7; Luk 3:16; Jhn 1:20, 27"},"26":{"text":"“Abraham innkuon’ suonlehlah ka sanggamte le note lahah Pasien a giing midangte aw, note kungah tami hutdamna thu ang kipuoh zo ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem-a tengte le a makaite un ama hile sabbath ni siela kisim kamsangte’ thugente hile a thei lo ziehun, amate in ama tunga mawmatna tawh tua thute a na tangtungsah uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in sina thukhenna ding za-in ama tungah thu mu sih nan ule Pilat kungah a kitha thei nading a na ngen paupau uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:22-23; Mrk 15:13-14; Luk 23:21-23; Jhn 19:15"},"29":{"text":"Ama’ thu a kigiel zosie a tangtunsah zaw ciengun singkhuom tung panin ama lakhie-in hankhuh sungah a siel uhi.","ref":"Mat 27:57-61; Mrk 15:42-47; Luk 23:50-56; Jhn 19:38-42"},"30":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in misite lah panin ama thosah zo hi;"},"31":{"text":"tuale Galilee gam panin Jerusalem dong ama a zawpi mite kungah ni tampi sung kilah a, amate tu-in mite mai-ah teci ahi uhi.","ref":"Sawl 1:3"},"32":{"text":"Ko ka hi ule Pasien in i pu i pate tunga a na ciemsa lungdamna thu ang puoh ka hi vua,"},"33":{"text":"ei a tate adingin ama in Jesu a thawsahkiana tawh a tangtun zo hi. Late dawng nina sungah zong, ‘Nang ka Tapa na hi hi; tuni-in nang kang piengsah zo hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Late 2:7"},"34":{"text":"Muotna a zuonkia nawn lo dingin misite lah panin ama a thawsahkiana tawh kisai-in ama in, ‘David tunga ka ciemsa a siengtho kamciemte nangma kang pie ding hi,’ ci-in tam bangin a gen hi.","ref":"Isa 55:3"},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Late mundang khatah zong, ‘Na Misiengtho Pa muotna na thuohsah sih ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Late 16:10"},"36":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile David in a khan sungin Pasien’ deina banga na a sep zaw ciengin si a, a pu a pate gei-ah kivui-in muotna a thuoh hi;"},"37":{"text":"ahi vangin Pasien in a thawsah pa ahile muotna thuoh lo hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka sanggamte aw, tam mipa ziehin note tungah mawmaisahna thu ang kitangko ahina thu kithei taheh;"},"39":{"text":"tami Jesu ziehin Moses’ thukham zieha na suotah thei lona uh mawna zosie panin na suohta zo ta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note tungah kamsangte’ thugen ang tun lo nadingin kidawm un:"},"41":{"text":"‘No mi zakote aw, en un!
