Lamdang sa unlen, mangthai ta un, azieh pen mi khat in na kung vua ang gen leh na up ngai vawt lo ding uh nasep khat na hin sungun ka bawl ding hi,’ ci-in a hil hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Hab 1:5"},"42":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas a pusuo laitahun mite in sabbath ni kia ciengin tam thute ei gen in,” ci-in a zawl uhi."},"43":{"text":"Kikhopna a man zaw ciengin Judah mi tampite le Judah biehna pana a kikhelsa a kipumpieh mite in Paul le Barnabas a zui vua, ama gel in zong Pasien’ hepina sungah tua mite a op den nadingun thu hilin a hanthawn uhi."},"44":{"text":"Sabbath ni kia ciengin a khuozang phielin Topa’ thu ngai dingin a kikhawm uhi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanle Jew mite in mihonpi a mu ciengun a thangsie mama vua, tuale amate in Paul’ thugen langpangin a gensie uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciengin Paul le Barnabas in hangtahin thu a gen tuoh vua, “Kote in na kung vuah Pasien’ thu kang gen masah ding uh a kisam hi. Note in tua thu nielin hin tawntungna nga dinga kilawm na kisah lo ziehun tu-in Gentile-te kungah ka kihei ta uhi."},"47":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in eite thu ei pie a, ‘Leimong dongah hutdamna thu na puoh thei nadingun, Gentile-te tungah khuovah ahi dingin note kang koi zo ta hi’ ei ci hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Isa 42:6; 49:6"},"48":{"text":"Gentile-te in tam thu a zah ciengun lungdamin Topa’ thu a patawi uhi. Kumtawn hinna a nga dinga a kisesa zaza in thu a um uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tua bangin gam buppi-ah Topa’ thu a kizel hi."},"50":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jew mite in Pasien’ thu a hakat, a zatahhuoi numeite le khuopi sunga om makaite a hantawh vua, tuaci’n Paul le Barnabas bawlsiesahin a gam panun a notmang uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in a keng vua leivuite thingin Iconium khuo ah a pei uhi.","ref":"Mat 10:14; Mrk 6:11; Luk 9:5; 10:11"},"52":{"text":"Nuazuite ahi ule Hlagau Siengtho tawh kidimin a kipah mama uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Iconium khuo Jew mite kikhopna inn ah Paul le Barnabas lutin tua bang danin ama gel in thu a hil uh ciengin Jew mite le Greek-te tampitah thu um mi a suoh vua, tuaci’n tua khuo sungah a piengsa thu teng ma a piengkia hi.","title":"Iconium ah Paul le Barnabas"},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin thu um lo Jew mite in Gentile-te holtuo-in a sanggamte ledo dingin lungsim hoi lo a guon uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n sauveipitah a tam vua, Topa adingin amate in hangtahin thu a hil uhi. Ama’ hepina thu teci a pang sawltahpite tungtawnin Topa in amate tungah lim le na lamdangte bawl theina thu a pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuo sunga teng mite a kiphalsuo vua, pawlkhat in Jew mite panpi-in adang pawlkhat in sawltahpite a panpi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gentile-te le Jew mite in a uliente utawh sawltahpite bawlsie-in suong tawh se ding a hanciem vua,"},"6":{"text":"sawltahpite in tua thu a thei ciengun Lycaonia khuopite ahi Lystra, Derbe le a kima gamah a tai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua gamah lungdamna thuhil a zomsuoh uhi."},"8":{"text":"Lystra khuo ah a suocil a kipan a keng a zang thei lo, lam zong pei thei loin a mawh to mi khat a om hi.","title":"Lystra le Derbe ah Paul le Barnabas"},"9":{"text":"Paul in thu a gen laitahin tua pa in a ngai hi. Tuale Paul in limtahin en a, tua pa in dam thei nading upna a nei lam mu ahi ziehin,"},"10":{"text":"“Na keng tawh dingtang in,” ci-in nahpi-in a kiko leh tua pa kitomin lam pei a kipan pai hi."},"11":{"text":"Paul’ nasepsate mihonpite in a mu ciengun amate in Lyconia-te’ ham tawh, “Eite kungah mihing mel puo-in pasien-te ang kumsuh uhi!” ci-in nahpitahin a kiko uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in Barnabas pen Zeus ci-in a minvaw vua, Paul pen a thugenpi pen ahi ziehin Hermes ci-in minvaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khuo pulama a om Zeus pasien’ siempu pa in tunkotah bawngtang le paakuolte peipi a, ama le mihonpi in kithoina a bawl nop lam uh"},"14":{"text":"sawltahpite ahi Barnabas le Paul in a zah ciengun a puon uh balkehin mihonpi lahah tai-in a kiko vua,"},"15":{"text":"“Lawmte aw, bang dinga tam bang na bawl uh ahei? Ko zong noma banga mihing ma ka hi bo uhi. Kimanna a nei lo tami nate panin van le lei, tuipi le a sunga om na zosie a siem a hingzing Pasien lama na kihei nadingun note tungah lungdamna thu ang puoh ka hi bo uhi.","ref":"Pei 20:11; Late 146:6"},"16":{"text":"Khanglui lai-in minam zosie in a deina uh lampi ciet a zui ding uh ama in a phal hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanle ama in sil hoi a bawlna sungah teci om loin a nuasie sih a, ama in note tungah vantung panin guotui le khuohun hoite hing pie-in, an le tui zong ang kidimsah a, na lungtang uzong kipahna tawh ang kidimsah hi,” a ci uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam bang thute nangawn tawh ama gel tungah kithoina a bawl lo nadingun mihonte a khah zo lieiliei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Antioch le Iconium khuo panin tua munah Jew mite pei-in mihonpi a thuzaw gawp uhi. Tua ciengin amate in suong tawh Paul a sep gawp vua, a si hi ta va ci-in khuo pulamah a kaiphit uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin nuazuite in ama a kimkot ciengin ama zong tho-in khuo sungah a lut hi. A zing ciengin Derbe khuo ah Barnabas tawh a peisuoh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in tua khuo ah lungdamna thu a gen vua, mi tampitah nuazui a suohsah zaw uh ciengin Iconium le Antioch lamah a kilekia uhi.","title":"Syria gam Antioch ah Peikiana"},"22":{"text":"Khum tahah nuazuite thakhausahin upna sungah a amate a kip den nadingun a hanthawn vua, “Pasien’ manggam sungah i lut thei nadingin bawlsietna tampi i thuoh ding uh kul hi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama gel in hlattuom pawlpi simah hlattuom pawlpi upate a koipieh zaw ciengun, a muonte uh thungetna le antanna tawh Topa tungah a ap uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in Pisidia gam a nawh vua, tuaci’n Pamphylia gam a tung uhi."},"25":{"text":"Perga khuo ah Pasien’ thu a gen zaw uh ciengin Attalia khuo ah a peisuh uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua khuo panin a muolsuosa uh nasep a sem dinga Pasien’ hepina sunga a ki-apna uh ahi Antioch lam zuonin tembaw tawh a peikia uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua mun a tun ciengun hlattuom pawlpi mite a kaikhawm vua, Pasien in amate tungtawna a sep zosie le Gentile-te adinga upna kot a honpiehna thute a sut uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tua khuo ah nuazuite tawh sawtveipi a tam uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Judea gam panin mi pawlkhat a hawsuh vua, “Moses’ ngaina tawh kizui-in na tep uh na tan sih uleh note in hutdamna na nga thei sih ding uhi,” ci-in amate in sanggamte thu a hil uhi.","title":"Jerusalem-a Thu Kikupna","ref":"Siem 12:3"},"2":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas in amate tawh nahpitahin kinielna le kiselna a nei zaw ciengun, tam thudawhna tawh kisai-in sawltahpite le upate tawh Jerusalem ah peito-in thu kikum dingin Paul, Barnabas, le adang pawlkhat kise hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n hlattuom pawlpi in lampi-ah amate a va hla ta vua, Phoenicia gam le Samaria gam a kantan kawmun Gentile-te a kikhelna uh thu a zasah vua, tuaci’n amate in thu um mi zosie a nuomsah mama uhi."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem a tun ciengun hlattuom pawlpi mite, sawltahpite, le upate in amate a na dawn vua, amate tung tawnin Pasien’ nasepna zosie a zasah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pharisee pawlte sung panin thu um mi pawlkhat ding to-in, “Amate in Moses’ thukham zui-in a tep uh a tan nadingun thu i pieh uh kul hi,” a ci uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tami thu a lungngai dingin sawltahpite le upate a kikhawm uhi."},"7":{"text":"Sawtveipi a kisel zaw ciengun Peter zong dingto a, “Sanggamte aw, kei tung panin Gentile-te in lungdamna thu za-in thu um mi a suo thei nadingun sawtveipi lai panin note lahah Pasien in kei ei teelna thu na thei uhi.","ref":"Siem 12:3"},"8":{"text":"Mihingte’ lungtang sung a thei Pasien in eite tunga ei pieh bang lienin amate tungah zong Hlagau Siengtho a piehna tawh teci a pang zo hi.","ref":"Sawl 2:4; 10:44"},"9":{"text":"Amate le eite kikalah khentuom nei loin upna tawh amau’ lungsim a siengthosah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nuazuite ngawngah i pu i pate le eite in i puoh zawh lo uh hahkol suonin bang dingin Pasien ze-et ding i hi ahei?"},"11":{"text":"Tua bang ding ahi sih hi. Topa Jesu’ hepina ziehin eite ei kihundam ding hi, ci-in i up ma bangin amate zong kihundam ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas in ama gel tungtawnin Pasien in Gentile-te lahah lim le na lamdang a bawlsa zosie a gen laitahun a kikhawm mihon vannuoi in sip dide-in a ngai uhi."},"13":{"text":"A thugen uh a man zaw ciengin James in, “Sanggamte aw, ka thugen na ngai un."},"14":{"text":"Pasien in a min adingin amate sung panin kimkhat a teelkhiet nadingin, a masa-in bangci bangin Gentile-te tungah maipha pie ahei ci thute Simeon in ang gen zo ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Kamsangte’ thugente tam tawh kituoh hi."},"16":{"text":"‘Tua zaw ciengin kang peikia ding a, a puasa David’ tenna inn ka lam kia ding hi; a kisiesate panin ka lamkia ding a, ka tungding kia ding hi,"},"17":{"text":"tuaci’n midangte le ka mina kihlan Gentile-te zosie nangawn in Topa a sui ding uhi,"},"18":{"text":"ci-in tanglai peh panin tam thute ei theisah Topa in a gen hi,’ ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Amos 9:11-12"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kote in Pasien lamah ang kihei Gentile-te suhbuoi lo zawh ding khensatna ka nei vua,"},"20":{"text":"tuale mahin amate in milim biehna, numei-pasal pahtatna, lawlmeh sa popo le sisan nehnate panin amate a kibuasah lo nadingun lai hlahzaw leih pha ka sa hi.","ref":"Pei 34:15-17; Siem 17:10-16; 18:6-23"},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sabbath nisielin kikhopna innte-ah Moses’ thukhamte ma a gingin kisim ngitnget a, tanglai peh panin zong khuo cin tengah ama’ thugente ma hil penin kinei hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin sawltahpite, upate le hlattuom pawlpi buppi in amate sung panin mi pawlkhat teelin Antioch khuo ah Paul le Barnabas peitonsah dingin a khensat uhi. Amate in sanggamte lahah makai ahi Barsabbas a kici Judas le Silas a sawl vua,","title":"Thu um Gentile-te tunga Thukikumte’ Laihlah"},"23":{"text":"tam bangin lai gielin a puosah uhi: “Sanggamte aw, sawltahpite le upate in Antioch khuo-a kipanin Syria gam le Cylicia gama om Gentile mi-a pieng thu um mite kang hopi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ko sawl lopi-in ko kung panin mi pawlkhat a piekhie vua, no buoi nading thute genin na lungsim uh ang amsah zo uhi, ci thu ka na za uhi."},"25":{"text":"Kote in na kung vua kang sawl ding uh tangmite ka teel vua, tuale Barnabas le Paul tawh ang zawhton dingin lungkimtahin ka khensat zo ta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama gel pen i Topa Jesu Khris’ min ziehin a hinna uh a pie ngamte ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate mama in a kam utawh tam thute ma ang gen dingin Judas le Silas kang sawl uhi."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen kote in tam thupoimawte sanga a gihzaw vangih dang note tunga kang guonbe lo nading uh, Hlagau Siengtho le kote in hoi ka sa uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua a kisam thute in: Milim kithoina ante, sisan, a kilawlmeh sa, le numei-pasal pahtatnate na tan ding uh ahi hi. Tam teng na tan zawh nah po uleh note adingin hoikhop ta lel hi. Na damta un,” ci-in lai a hlah uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate sawlin Antioch khuo ah a peisuh uhi. Amate in mipi a kaikhop zaw ciengun tua laihlah a pie uhi."},"31":{"text":"Pawlpi mite in laihlah a sim ciengun hanthawtnate ziehin amate lungdam mama uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate mama zong kamsang ahi Judas le Silas-te in thu tampitah a gen vua, thu um mite hanthawnin a thakhausah uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua tahah amate bakhat sung a tam zaw ciengun thu um mite in amate a sawlkhie mite kungah lungnuom tahin a peisahkia uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanle tua munah Silas a tam lai ding hoi a sa uhi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin Antioch khuo ah Paul le Barnabas-te a tam vua, amate in midang tampite tungah Topa’ thu a tangko uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ni phabep khat zaw ciengin Paul in Barnabas kungah, “Hing pei in, peikia vai-in, Topa’ thu i hilnasa khuopi zosie-a om thu um mite kungah haw-in bang a ci vuoi mah va en tavai,” a ci hi.","title":"Paul le Barnabas Kikhen"},"37":{"text":"Barnabas in Mark kici John zawpi nuom hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vang in Paul in Pamphylia khuo ah amate nuasie-in a nasepna vua a zui nuom lo mipa zawpi lo dingin a khensat hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:13"},"39":{"text":"Kinah niel luo uh ahi ziehin a kikhenlaw vawt uhi; Barbabas in Mark a zawpi a, tembaw tawh Cyprus tuikul ah a pei uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hizongle Paul in Silas teel a, Topa’ hepina sungah thu um mite in ama apin a kuonkhie uhi."},"41":{"text":"Syria gam le Cilicia gam nawhin ama pei-in hlattuom pawlpite a thakhausah hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul peisuoh lai-in Derbe le Lystra khuo ah a tung a, tua munah thu um Jew mi numei khat’ tapa Timothy a kici nuazui khat a om hi; ahi vangin a pa pen Greek mi ahi hi.","title":"Timothy in Paul le Silas Zui"},"2":{"text":"Lystra le Iconium khuo-a thu um mite in ama a genpha mama uhi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in Timothy a kithuopi nuom hi; tua mun tenga a teng Jew mite ziehin tua pa zawpi-in a tep a tanpieh hi, azieh pen amate in a pa Greek mi ahi lam a unpi-un a thei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khuopi khat pan khuopi khat zin kawikawi-in Jerusalem-a sawltahpite le upate in zui dinga khensatna a bawlsate uh amate tungah a pie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n upna sungah hlattuom pawlpite thahatsahin nisimin thu um mimal a khang hi."},"6":{"text":"Hlagau Siengtho in Asia gam sungah Pasien thu a hil ding uh phal lo ahi ziehin Phrygia le Galatia gam tengah a zin uhi.","title":"Paul’ Mang Sunga Macedonia Mipa"},"7":{"text":"Mysia gamgi a tun uh ciengin Bithynia gam a lut sawm vangun Jesu’ Hlagau in amate a phal sih hi;"},"8":{"text":"tuaci’n Mysia gam nawt suohin Troas khuo ah a peisuh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zanlai-in Paul in mang khat a mu hi; tua munah Macedonia mi khat dingin, “Macedonia gamah hing galkai inlen kote ei hu in,” ci-in a thum hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in mang a mu zaw ciengin amate kungah lungdamna thu a tangko dingin Pasien in eite ei hlan zo hi, ci-in ngaisun ka hi ziehun Macedonia galkai ding thakhatin ka sawm pai uhi."},"11":{"text":"Troas khuo panin gunkuong tung tuongin Samothrace tuikul lam zuonin tangtahin ka pei vua, a zing ni-in Neapolis khuo tungin,","title":"Lydia a Kikhelna"},"12":{"text":"tua mun panin Macedonia gamkhen sunga khuo thupi pen le Rome mite tenna Philipi khuo ah ka tung uhi. Tami khuo ah ni tampi sung ka tam uhi."},"13":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in khuopi tunkot pulamah ka pusuoh vua, thungetna mun hi kha ding hi, ci-a ka upmawna uh gun gei lamah ka pei uhi; tuale ka to vua, khum sunga a kikhawm numeite tawh ka kiholim uhi."},"14":{"text":"Pasien a bie Lydia a kici numei khat in ka thugen uh a ngai hi; tua nu pen Thyatira pana puon dupsan zua ahi hi. Ama in Paul’ thugente lawp tahin a ngai thei nadingin Topa in a lungsim a honpieh hi."},"15":{"text":"A innkuonpite tawh a ki-baptize ciengin ama in kei kungah, “Note in kei, Topa adingin mi muonhuoi khat a nei ngaisut uleh hing pei unlen ka inn ah hing tung ta un,” ci-in ei zawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Nikhat, thungetna mun zuona ka pei laitahun, dawi lawm nei, mailam thugenna tawh a pute sum tampi a suipieh sila numei khat tawh ka kituoh kha uhi.","title":"Paul le Silas Thong Sungah"},"17":{"text":"Tua nu in Paul le ko ei zui laitahin, “Tam mite pen na kung vua hutdamna lampi ang tangko Sangpen Pasien’ silate ahi uhi,” ci-in ang kiko hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua bangin ni tampi sung a awng den mielmuol hi. Ahi vangin Paul in tuapa seda mama a, tuale ama kihei-in tua hlagau kungah, “Tam nu sung panin na pusuo nadingin Jesu Khris’ minin thu kang pie hi,” a ci hi. Tua hun lien ma-in tua hlagau a pusuoh pai hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pute in a sum mu nading uh lametna tawp zo hi, ci-in a thei bepun amate in Paul le Silas-te a man vua, tuale vanzuana mun thuneite mai-ah a kaiphit uhi."},"20":{"text":"Thukhenmangte kung a tut uh ciengin amate in, “Tam mite in i khuo sung a buoisah uhi; ama gel pen Jew mite ahi vua,"},"21":{"text":"tuale kote Rome mi ka hina utawh ko adingin pom ding le zui dinga kilawm lo ngainate ei hil uhi,” a ci uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mihonpite in ama gel a vuohpi valuoi vua, tuale thukhenmangte in zong a puon uh hawhmang piehin ciengpum tawh a sat nadingun thu a pie uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in nahpitahin a sat zaw ciengun thong sungah a khum vua, hoitaha a cin nadingin thongcing pa a vaihlah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Thongcing pa in zong tam kivaihlahnate ma bangin thonginn sungtawng penah ama gel koi-in kengkol a bul hi."},"25":{"text":"Zankim pawlin Paul le Silas in thu ngenin Pasien tungah phatna late a sa vua, tuale thongkiete in a ngai uhi."},"26":{"text":"Thakhatin zil ling a, tua zil a natsiet seng ziehin thonginn a zung dongin a lawhthing gawp hi. Thakhatin kotkhah zosie kihong a, mi zosiete’ kikhina siakhaute a kiphel sieng hi."},"27":{"text":"Thongcing pa zong khanglo-in thong kotpi zosie kihong sa-a om a mu bepin, thongkie zosie a pit sieng hi ta va, ci-in ngaisun a, tua ziehin a namsau dawhin ama le ama a kithat dingin a kisa hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin Paul in, “Nang le nang bangma kilaw sin, azieh pen tanah ka unpi-un ka om uhi,” ci-in a aw neiza tawh a kiko hi."},"29":{"text":"Thongcing pa in meivah ngenin thong sung a nawlut pai a, Paul le Silas-te mai-ah a citunsa-in a khupbawh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama gel a pusuopi a, tuale ama in, “Siete aw, hutdamna ka nga nadingin bang bawl ding ka hei?” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama gel in, “ Topa Jesu um in, tua hile nang le na innkuonpite in hutdamna na nga ding uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ama gel in tua pa kung le a inn sunga om mi zosie kungah Topa’ thu a hil uhi."},"33":{"text":"Khum zan tua hun lien ma-in tua pa in ama gel peipi-in a maliemte uh a sawp siengpieh hi; tua ciengin ama le a innkuonpite zosie a ki-baptize pai uhi."},"34":{"text":"A inn ah ama gel peipi-in a mai vuah ankuong zong a lui hi; tuale ama pen Pasien sunga thu um mi khat hi ta ahi ziehin ama le a innkuon buppi a lungdam uhi."},"35":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin thukhenmangte in palih khat sawlin, “Tua mite hlakhie ta un,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Thongcing pa in Paul kungah thu puoh a, “Thukhenmangte in no gel hla nadingin kam ei kivaihlah zo hi; tua ziehin tu-in pusuoh unlen lungnuom tahin pei ta un,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin Paul in, “Amate in Rome gammi ahi kote, mawsahna thu om lopi-in mizapi mai-ah ei satin thong ei khie uhi; tu-in zong koima’ thei lo-in ei dap hla sawm uh amah? Hi thei lo ding hi! Amate mama hing pei-in ei hla uheh,” ci-in a dawngkia hi."},"38":{"text":"Palihte in thukhenmangte kungah tam thute a ko vua, amate Rome gammi ahi uh a zah bepun a zau mama uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama gel kungah amate pei-in a va thum ta vua, thong panin ama gel la dawhin khuopi a nuasie nadingun a zawl uhi."},"40":{"text":"Thong panin a peikhiet zaw ciengun Lydia inn ah a haw uhi; sanggam pasal le sanggam numeite tawh tua munah kimu-in a hanthot zaw cieng gelin tua panin a dingkhie uhi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul le Silas-te in Amphipolis le Apollonia khuote nawhin Judah-te’ kikhopna inn opna Thessalonica khuo a tung uhi.","title":"Thessalonica Khuo-a Buoina"},"2":{"text":"A pei ngaina ma bangin kikhopna inn sungah Paul tumin, Lai Siengtho pansie-in sabbath ni thum sung amate tawh thu kikum a,"},"3":{"text":"Messiah in gimna thuohin misite lah panin a thawkia ding a kisapna thute hilcienin lahtel a, “Note kunga kang tangko Jesu khu Messiah ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate pawlkhat lunglutin Paul le Silas a pawl vua, tua ma bangin Pasien a giing Greek mi tampite le numei makai tampi in zong a pawl uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jew mite haza-in vanzuana muna om migilote pawlkhat a ciel vua, tuaci’n amate in mihonpi khawmin khuopi sung a buoisah uhi. Mihonpi mai-a kaikhiet dingin Paul le Silas a sui laitahun amate in Jason’ inn a bulu uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama gel a mul zo lo bepun amate in Jason le thu umte pawlkhat kaiphitin khuopi thuneite’ mai-ah a tut vua, “Leitung kikhulehsah tam mite tami munah zong ang tung ta vua,"},"7":{"text":"Jason in a inn ah amate zin a tungsah hi. Amate in a unpi-un kumpipa’ thupiehte tawh a kikelbulin a gamta vua, Jesu a kici kumpi dang khat om hi, a ci uhi,” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mipite le khuosung uliente in tami thu a zah ciengun a buoi mama vua,"},"9":{"text":"tuale amate in Jason le adangte tat nading sum a lah zaw ciengun a hlakhie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zan ma-in thu um mite in Beroea khuo ah Paul le Silas a peisah uhi; ama gel a tun ciengun Jew-te’ kikhopna inn sungah a lut uhi.","title":"Beroea Khuo ah Paul le Silas"},"11":{"text":"Thessalonica-te sangin tami Juda mite in Pasien’ thu a sang theizaw uhi, azieh pen amate in Pasien’ thu kigente lunglut tahin pomin tua a kigen thute ahi ma amah, ci-in nisielin Lai Siengtho tawh a sittel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate tampi in Pasien’ thu a um vua, tua mite lahah Greek numei tawmno khat le dinmun sangpi a nei Greek pasalte zong a kihal uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanle Beroea khuo-ah zong Paul in Pasien’ thu tangko zo hi, ci Thessalonica khuo-a Jew mite in a thei ciengun amate zong tuanah pei-in mipite holtuo-in a satsuo uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin thu um mite in tuipi lamah thakhatin Paul a hladap vua, ahi vangin Silas le Timothy-te a tam lai uhi."},"15":{"text":"Paul a zawpi mite in Athen cieng dong a hla uhi; tuale Silas le Timothy-te in a gang theithei-in Paul ang pawlkia nading uh thu vaihlahna a nga zaw uh ciengin a kilekia uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama gel ngahin Athen khuo ah Paul a op laitahin milim tawh a kidim tua khuo mu-in a lungsim a na mama hi.","title":"Athen Khuo ah Paul"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in kikhopna inn sungah Jew mite le Pasien a zatah mite thu kuppi a, vanzuana munah a kituopi khah mite tawh zong nisielin thu a kikum uhi."},"18":{"text":"Thuthuh pilna nei Epicurea le Stoic-te pawlkhat ama tawh thu a kiniel uhi. Pawlkhat in, “Tami a kipilsah thu mawh gengen pa khu bang gen nuom ahiei?” a ci uhi. A dangte in, gamdang pasien-te’ thu gen hile kilawm ve aw,” a ci uhi. (Ama in Jesu’ Lungdamna thu le thawkiana thu a gen zieh ahi hi.)"},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in Paul hlanin Areopagus mun a tut vua, “Kote in na gengen tami thuhilna tha ka theithei ding vuoi mah?"},"20":{"text":"Kote adingin thu tuomdang pi khat ahi a, bang a ci nopna ahei ka thei nuom uhi,” a ci uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in Athen khuomi zosie le tua khuo-a a teng gamdang mi zosie in thu tha pawlkhat genna ding ahi sihle tua thute ngaina ding ci simlo, a hunte uh bangma dangin a zang sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Areopagus mai-ah Paul ding a, “Athen mite aw, biehna thu a pawnthaw mama mite na hina uh pen na gamtatna zosie vuah kang thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile khuo sung muncin tengah vah kawikawi-in na bieh uh nate ka cienvel ciengin maitam tung khatah, ‘A kithei kha lo pasien ading,’ ci-a kigiel lai khat ka mu hi. Tua ahi ziehin na kung vuah thei khah lopi-a na bieh pa uh ang tangko ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Leitung le a sunga a om na vannuoi a siem Pasien pen lei le van a uh Topa ahi a, ama pen mihingte’ khut tawh a kibawl biehbuhte sungah teng lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama ma in mi zosie tungah hinna, nahuu le na vannuoi a pieh ziehin ama pen tasap khatpo a nei bang danin mihingte’ khut in ama’ na a seppieh ding kisam lo hi.","ref":"1Kum 8:27; Isa 42:5"},"26":{"text":"Ama in pupi khat tung panin leitung buppi a luo dingin minam zosie bawl a, amau’ hin tanvei ding le amau’ tenna ding gamgite sesa-in a koipieh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua khu amate in Pasien sui-in a mu thei khah uleh ci deina ahi a, ahi vangin ama ahile i kung ciet panin a gamla op sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile, ‘Ama sungah eite nungta-in i pia valiai vua, mihing hina i nei uhi,’ kici a, na laphuote uh pawlkhat nangawn in, ‘Azieh pen eite zong ama’ hlah le suonte i hi uhi,’ na na ci uhi."},"29":{"text":"Eite i hi ule Pasien’ tate i hi ziehun i Pasien pen mihingte’ khutsiemna le ngaisutna in a bawl le a zep ngun le kham, suongtumte le milimte tawh a kibanga i ngaisut ding uh a kilawm sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Mihingte’ thei lo hun lai-in Pasien in phamaw a na sa sih a, tu-in ahile ama in mun zosie-a om mi zosie a kisiakia nadingun thu a pie hi."},"31":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a sesa mipa tungtawnin dihna tawh thu a khen nading ni khat a sekhol zo hi. Misite lah panin ama a thawsahkiana tawh tami thu a man a hina mi zosie tungah hla muonna a pie zo hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in a sisa mite thawkiana thu a zah ciengun pawlkhat in a simmawbawl uhi; ahi vangin adangte in, “Tami thu khatvei za nuom lai ung,” a ci uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua laitahin Paul in amate a nuasie hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate kimkhat in ama panpi-in thu um mi a suoh vua, tuate lahah Areopagus’ pawlmi Dionysius, le Damaris a kici numei khat le adangte kihal hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Athen nuasie-in Corinth khuo ah Paul a pei hi.","title":"Corinth Khuo ah Paul"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah ama in Pontus gammi Aquila kici Judah mi khat mu a, ama pen Claudius in Rome gam nuasie dingin Jew mite zosie thupie zo ahi ziehin a zinu Priscilla tawh Italy gam pana ang tun uh a sawt nai lo ahi hi. Ama gel tawh kimu dingin Paul pei a,"},"3":{"text":"ama zong ama gel tawh a nasep a kibah ziehin a inn vuah tungin na a semton uhi, ama gel pen puonbuh khui nasep semte ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Sabbath nisielin ama in kikhopna inn ah Jew mite le Greek-te zawl sawmin thu a kikuppi hi."},"5":{"text":"Macedonia gam panin Silas le Timothy a tun ciengin Paul thuhil lamah kitahla-in Messiah in Jesu ahi hi, ci-in Jew mite kungah teci a pang hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in ama langpangin a gensiet ciengun Paul in a puon tunga leivui bangte thingin amate kungah, “Na lutung vuah na sisan uh tu taheh! Kei maw ka peng hi. Tu-a kipanin Gentile-te kungah ka pei ta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in kikhopna mun nuasie-in Titius Justus a kici Pasien bie pa khat’ inn ah a tung hi; a inn pen kikhopna inn gei mama ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kikhopna inn uhpa Crispus le a innkuonpi zosie in Topa a um uhi; tuale Paul’ thugen a za Corinth-te tampitah zong thu um mi suohin a ki-baptize uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zan khat Paul in mang mu a, ama’ mang sungah Topa in, “Zau sin, thu gen inlen dai op zaw sin;"},"10":{"text":"keima in nang kang ompi ziehin na tungah koima in a khut hlangin ang liemsah sih ding hi, azieh pen tami khuo sungah mi tampi ka nei hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum tahah kum khat le hlaguh tamin amate lahah Pasien’ thu a hil hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Gallio pen Achaia gam uhpa ahi ciengin Jew mite in kilungtuohin Paul a busim vua, thukhen zumah a tut uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in, “Tam pa in thukham tawh kilebulin Pasien bie dingin mite a zawl hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Thugen dingin Paul a kisah laitahin Gallio in Jew mite kungah, “Jew mite aw, tami thu pen gamtat khielna le gitlona thu khat popo ahile na thu uh kang ngaisut pieh ding hi;"},"15":{"text":"ahi vangin tami thu pen kammal zatziete po, minte po le na thukham zieh po vua a pieng thute ahi bo ziehin no le no in vaihawm zaw un; tami thute ah thukhenmang ka sem nuom sih hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale ama in thukhen zum panin amate a notmang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in kikhopna inn uhpa Sosthenes manin thukhenna zum mai-ah a unpi-un a satgawp uhi. Ahi vangin Gallio in tua thute phamaw a sa vet sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua munah sawtveipi sung a tam zaw ciengin Paul in thu um mite mangpha a pai a, Priscilla le Aquila tawh tembaw tung tuongin Syria gam zuonin a pei hi. Ama in kiciemna khat nei ahi ziehin Cenchreae-ah a sam a heu hi.","title":"Antioch Khuo-a Paul a Kilekiana","ref":"Gam 6:18"},"19":{"text":"Ephesus khuo a tun ciengun Paul in tua tahah Priscilla le Aquila a nuasie hi. Ahi vangin amasa penin ama ma kikhopna inn ah lutin Jew mite tawh thu kikupna a nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in a sawt tam dingin a hlo uleh ama in a khia hi;"},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin amate tawh a kikhen ding ciengin, “Pasien deina a op leh na kung vuah kang zinkia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Ephesus khuo panin tembaw tawh ama a pei hi."},"22":{"text":"Caesarea khuo a tun ciengin Jerusalem ah peito-in hlattuom pawlpite hopi a, tua ciengin Antioch-ah a peisuh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua tahah bakhat sung hun a zah zaw ciengin peikia a, Galatia le Phrygia gam sung tengah mun khat zaw mun khat pei kawikawi-in nuazui zosie a va thakhausah ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in Ephesus ah Alexander khuomi Apollos a kici Judah mi khat haw hi. Ama pen mi dangnal le Lai Siengtho thei mama khat ahi hi.","title":"Apollos’ Nasepna"},"25":{"text":"Ama pen Topa’ Lampi-ah zong a kisinsa ahi hi; ama in John’ baptize na thu beh a thei vangin Jesu tawh kisai thute lawptahin genin mantahin a hil hi."},"26":{"text":"Kikhopna inn sungah hangtahin ama thugen a kipan hi; hinanle Priscilla le Aquila-te in tua thu a zah ciengun ama hlanin a manzaw-in Pasien’ Lampi thu a hilcien uhi."},"27":{"text":"Achaia gamah a galkai nuom ciengin thu um mite in ama a hanthawn vua, nuazuite in a na lamdot nadingun lai a hlah uhi. Tua gam a tun ciengin ama in hepina zieha thu um a na suohsa mite nahpitahin a panpi hi."},"28":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in mipi mai-ah Jew mite khautahin niel gawp a, Messiah pen Jesu ahi hi, ci-in Lai Siengtho pansia-in amate a lah hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Corinth khuo ah Apollos a op laitahin gam sung muncin tengah Paul zin kawikawi-in Ephesus khuo tung a, tua tahah nuazui pawlkhat tawh a kimu hi.","title":"Ephesus Khuo ah Paul"},"2":{"text":"Ama in amate kungah, “Thu um mi na suo zaw ciengun Hlagau Siengtho na nga vuoi mah?” a ci hi. Amate in, “Ka nga sih uhi, Hlagau Siengtho a op lam nangawn zong ka za ngai sih uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “Tua ahile bang baptize-na na nga vuoi?” a ci hi. Amate in, “John’ baptize-na ka nga uhi,” ci-in a dawng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Paul in, “John in kisiakiana tawh baptize-na pie a, ama’ nua-a pei ding pa Jesu a up nadingun mipite kungah a gen hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 3:11; Mrk 1:4, 7-8; Luk 3:4, 16; Jhn 1:26-27"},"5":{"text":"Amate in tam thu a zah ciengun Topa Jesu’ min tawh a ki-baptize uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amate tungah Paul in a khut a ngah zaw ciengin Hlagau Siengtho tung a, kam tuomtuom tawh hamin thu a gen uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a kigawmin mi sawm le ni a pha uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kikhopna inn sungah ama lutin hla thum sung Pasien’ manggam thu kikuppi a, mi lungsim zo theithei dingin thu a gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat a lung uh khau a, amate in um nuom loin mipite mai-ah tua Lampi thu a gensiet ciengun amate kung panin nuazuite tawh Paul kihem dawhin Tyrannus thuhilna innpi sungah nisielin thu a kikuppi hi."},"10":{"text":"Asia gam sunga a teng Jew mite le Greek-te in a unpi-un Topa’ thu a zah thei nadingun tam bangin kum ni sung a zomsuoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasien in Paul tungtawnin na lamdang thupite bawl a,","title":"Sceva’ Tapate"},"12":{"text":"tuaci’n ama’ citung tawh a kithusa mainulte hile puonte hile cinate kungah a kipeipi ciengin, a natnate uh damin amate kung panin hla gilote a taimang hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin dawi hawlkhie-a a vah kawikawi Jew mite pawlkhat in Topa Jesu’ min zah sawmin dawilut mite kungah, “Paul in a genpa Jesu’ min tawh thu kang pie hi,” a ci uhi."},"14":{"text":"Sceva a kici Judah siempu lien pa’ tapa sagite in tua bangin a bawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin hla gilo in amate kungah, “Jesu ka thei a, Paul zong ka thei hi; no koi na hi uh ahei?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate tungah dawivei pa kitomin amate a unpi-un a zo gawp a, a zawthaw bawl seng ziehin puon sil loin amate a liemsa-in inn panin a taimang uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ephesus khuo-a teng Jew mite le Ephesus mite zosie in tam thu a thei ciengun zau-in Topa Jesu’ min a phat uhi."},"18":{"text":"Thu-umsa tampite in zong a gamtatnate uh pulahin a thum uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aisan thei mi tampite in a laibute uh a khawm vua, amate in mipi’ muna-ah a haltum uhi; tua laibute a man a kituot ciengin ngun peh tul sawm nga man hi, ci kithei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n Topa’ thu thahat tahin khangin a guolzo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in tam thu zosie a pien zaw ciengin Paul in Macedonia le Achai-a gamte nawhin Jerusalem khuo ah peisuoh ding a khensat hi. Ama in, “Khumtah ka tun zaw ciengin Rome zong ka mu kul ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Ephesus Khuo-a Buoina"},"22":{"text":"Ama in Macedonia gamah ama a hu mi ni ahi Timothy le Erastus-te sawl a, Asia gam sungah bakhat sung a tam lai hi."},"23":{"text":"Khum hun pawlin Lampi thu tawh kisai buoina lienpi a tung hi."},"24":{"text":"Demetrius a kici ngunkheng pa khat in ngun tawh Artemis biehna inn neute bawl a, khutsiemte adingin sumsuina lien mama khat a suohsah hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in tua mite le a nasep uh a kibang nasemte kaikhawm a, “Guoite aw, tami nasepna panin hauna i nga lam na thei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tami Paul in Ephesus khuo guoh hi loin Asia gam mun zosie phielah khut tawh a kibawl pasien-te pen pasien ahi sih hi,” ci-in gen a, ama in mihon tampitah zawlin a kaimang sieng hi, ci thu zong mu-in na za uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hi a, tami i sumsui nasepna guoh ang minsie khop sih ding a, a lien mama nusien Artemis’ biehinnpi ang kisimmaw bawlin, tuale Asia gam zosie le leitunga kibie numei nu’ thupina teng zong ang maiman khah ding a zauhuoi mama hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in tam thu a zah uh ciengin a lungthah nah mama vua, “Ephesus mite’ Artemis lien mama hi!” ci-in a kiko uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci’n khuosung teng buoina tawh kidim a, mipite in mihon kikhopna innpi sungah Paul’ khuolzinpi Macedonia mi Gaius le Aristarhus a kaiphit uhi."},"30":{"text":"Mihonte lahah Paul pei nuom a, ahi vangin nuazuite in a lut sah sih uhi."},"31":{"text":"Paul’ lawmte ahi Asia gam ulien pawlkhat nangawn in zong mihon kikhopna innpi sunga a lut lo nading uh mi sawlin a thum uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua hun sungin a kikhawm mite a buoi ziehun mi pawlkhat in thudang gen a, adangte in thudang khat ma genin a kiho vua, a tamzawte in bang zieha kikhawm uh ahei, ci thu a thei sih uhi. Jew mite in a mai lama a tawsawn uh Alexander pen mipite mai-ah ang tut ziehun mihon pawlkhat in a mawsah uhi. Tuale Alexander in mipite tungah a kidal nading thu gen nuom a, mipi a dai nadingin a khut a lamto hi.","merge":"33"},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in Alexander pen Judah mi khat ahi lam a thei uh ciengin, amate zosie in Ephesus mite’ Artemis lien mama hi,” ci-in kithutuoh tahin nai ni phiel bang a kiko uhi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanle khuopi lai-atpa in mihonpi a daisah zaw ciengin ama in, “Ephesus mite aw, Ephesus mite pen a lien mama nusien Artemis’ biehinn le vantung pansa ang kiesuh biehna suongcingte ahi lam uh a thei lo koi om na hi uh ahei?"},"36":{"text":"Tami thute pen niel thei lo thu ahi kalsie daitahin om a, ngaisutna mel a nei lo gamtatnate na bawl lo ding uh kilawm hi."},"37":{"text":"Note in biehinnpi bulute le i nusien-te zong a gensie lo tam mite tanah nang tut uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Demetrius le a seppi khutsiemte in mi khatpo tawh thu a nei nop uleh thukhenna zumte kihong den a, thukhenmangte zong a om hi. Tuate mai-ah khatlekhat thu kinei uheh."},"39":{"text":"Note in thu khatpopo na kan nop lai uleh ngaina bangin mipi kikhopna-ah kikhen ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile tam buoina thu tungah eite in bangma pansia ding thu pie thei lo i hi ziehin, tuni-a pieng buoina tawh thu ei kisit khah ding zauhuoi hi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in tami thu a gen zaw ciengin kikhopna a khawlsah hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua buoina a ven zaw ciengin Paul in nuazuite hlanin a hanthot zaw ciengin mangpha pai-in Macedonia gamah a pei hi.","title":"Macedonia le Greek gamah Paul Haw"},"2":{"text":"Tua gam tengah ama zin kawikawi a, thu um mite hanthotna tampi a pieh zaw ciengin Greek gamah tung a,"},"3":{"text":"tua munah hla thum sung a tam hi. Tembaw tawh Syria gam pei ding a kisah laitahin Jew mite in ama a tha sawm ziehun Macedonia gam tawnin kilekia ding a khensat hi."},"4":{"text":"Beroea khuomite Pyrrhus’ tapa Sopater, Thessalonica khuomi Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe khuo mite Gaius le Timothy, Asia gam pan Tychicus le Trophimus-te in ama a zui uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amate na mapei-in Troas khuo ah ei na ngah uhi;"},"6":{"text":"ahi vangin Tolsawlo Anlum Pawi a ven zaw ciengin tembaw tawh Philippi panin ka peikhie vua, ni nga sungin Troas khuo ah amate ka pha vua, tua munah ni sagi sung ka tam uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nipi kalkhat sung a ni masa pen ni-in, khomun balnen dingin ka kikhop uh ciengin Paul in amate tawh kikupna khat a bawl hi; a zing ciengin ama a pei sawm ziehin zankim dongin a thugen a zomsuoh hi.","title":"Troas-ah Mangphapai-in Paul a Zinna"},"8":{"text":"Ka kikhopna uh innkhan tungnung ah meivah tampi kivah hi."},"9":{"text":"Paul in thu a sawtgen kikal sungin tawlet tunga a tuong Eutychus kici tangval pa khat a kimut suohin a lusu hi. A kimut nahsuo seng ahi ziehin dawl thumna panin kiesuhin a sisa-in a luong kiphong hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanle Paul kumsuh pai a, ama tungah bawhsuhin a kawipom a, “Patau sih un, azieh pen ama sungah a hinna om lai hi,” ci-in kiko hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin innkhan tungnung ah Paul kato a, ama in khomun balnenin ne a, amate tawh khuovah dongin a holim zaw ciengin a pei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua sung tengin amate in tangval pa a hingin a zawpi vua, a kipah mama uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kote in Paul ka lah sawm ziehun Assos khuo ah tembaw tawh ka na mapei uhi; azieh pen Paul in leilam tawh pei ding a gelsa mal ahi hi.","title":"Troas Pan Miletus ah Tembaw tawh Peina"},"14":{"text":"Assos khuo ah ei mu ciengin kohawn zong ama tembaw tungah tuongsahin Mitylene khuo ah ka pei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua panin tembaw tawh ka dingkhie vua, a zing ciengin Chios tuikul tawh a kigalsaina mun ka tung uhi. A zing ni-in Samos tuikul ka tung vua, a thai ni-in Miletus khuo ka tung uhi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen Paul in Asia gam sungah a hun zang loin Ephesus khuo nawtsuoh dinga a khensatsa ahi hi; ahi theile Pentcost pawi ni-in Jerusalem-ah a om nuom mama hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in Melitus khuo panin Ephesus khuo ah mi sawl a, pawlpi upate in ama a kimupi nadingun a thuta hi.","title":"Paul in Ephesus Upate Hopi"},"18":{"text":"Ama kung a tun ciengun amate kungah, “Asia gam kang tun masah ni-a kipanin note lahah ka op sunga ka hindan zosie na thei sieng ta vua,"},"19":{"text":"Jew mite in ei na tha sawmna zieh vua ang tung gimnate keima in ka na thuoh a, kiniemkhiehna le hlitui naptui tawh Topa’ na ka na sem hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima in na phattuom nading uh thute khat zong hen nei loin mipi mai-ah ahi a, inn khat zaw inn khatah ahi zongin hing genin kang hil zo ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in Jew mite le Greek-te tungah Pasien lama kisiakiana thu le Topa Jesu lama upna thute teci ka pan zo lam noma ma in na thei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in Hlagau’ sila ka hi ma bangin, kei tungah bang hing pieng ding ci thei lopi-in Jerusalem khuo-a pei ding ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuale khuopi zosie-ah thongkiehna le bawlsietnate in ei ngah gige a hina thu Hlagau Siengtho in kei tungah teci a pang hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ hepina ziehin Topa Jesu kung pana ka nga lungdamna thu ka teci pan nading ahi ka lampi le ka nasepnate ka zaw thei nading ahi nah po leh kei adingin ka hinna man nei-in ka ngaisun sih hi.","ref":"2Tim 4:7"},"25":{"text":"“Tu-in ahile note lahah hing vah kawikawi-in Pasien’ gam thu kang hil ahi note koima khat beh in ka mai nei mu ngai nawn sih ding uhi, ci ka thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin tuni-in note khatpo’ sisan ziehin maw ka puo sih hi, ci thu kang gen hi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien’ gelna buppi ip nei loin note tungah teci ka pang zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien in a Tapa’ sisan tawh a leisa ama’ hlattuom pawlpi a vah dingin, Hla Siengtho in note’ khut sunga ang koi na tuuhon zosie ule noma ma limtahin na kem un."},"29":{"text":"Ka pei zaw ciengin note lahah ngie gilote hing lutin tuuhonte ang dawm vawt sih ding uhi, ci ka thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Noma’ pawl sung pan nangawnin zong mi kimkhat in amate lamah nuazuite a zawl nadingun thuman a lehei mi ang pieng ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kigalging unlen, kum thum sung a sun a zanin khawl loin hlitui luong kawmin mi zosie tunga kang thuhilte na phawh bo un."},"32":{"text":"Tu-in Pasien in note hing lamkipin a siensuosa mi zosie lahah gouluo ang pie ama’ hepina thu sungah note kang ap hi."},"33":{"text":"Koima’ neisa, ngun ahi a, kham ahi a, puonsil nihten ahi zongin ka deigaw sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka khut tawh na ka sem a, keima le ka guolte’ kisapnate ka sihna thu noma ma in na thei uhi."},"35":{"text":"‘Ngana sangin piehna-ah thupha tamzaw hi,’ ci Topa Jesu’ thugente phawhin tam bang nasep hakatna tawh a thanemte i hu ding uhi, ci-in na kung vuah gamtat zie ding kang lah zo hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in thu a gen zaw ciengin khupdinin amate zosie tawh thu a ngen hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate zosie nahpi-in kapin Paul kawi-in a nam vua,"},"38":{"text":"a diehdiehin amate in ei mu nawn lo ding uhi, a ci ziehin a da mama uhi. Tua ciengin amate in tembaw tung dong ama a hla uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate tawh ka kikhen zaw ciengun tembaw tawh Cos tuikul ah tangtahin ka pei vua, a zing ni-in Rodes tuikul tungin tua panin Patara khuo ka tung uhi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Paul a Zinna"},"2":{"text":"Phoenicia gam zuon ding tembaw khat ka mu ziehun tua tembaw tuongin ka pei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Cyprus tuikul ka mu ciengun a veilamah ka pei vua, Syria gam galkai-in Tyre khuo ka tun ciengun tembaw in a vante suo ding ahi ziehin tua munah ka kum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua munah nuazuite ka mu vua, ni sagi sung ka tam uhi. Jerusalem ah Paul a peisuoh lo nadingin Hlagau Siengtho tungtawnin amate in a gen uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khum munah ka nite uh a tawp ciengin ding dawhin ka khuolzinna uh ka zom uhi; tuale amate in a unpi-un a zi a tate utawh khuo pulamah ei hla uhi. Kohaw zong tua mun tuipieu ah khupdingin thu ka ngen vua,"},"6":{"text":"khatlekhat mangpha ka kipai uhi. Tua ciengin tembaw tungah ka tuong vua, amate inn lamah a kilekia ta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tyre khuo panin tuipi tung khuolzin a tawp ciengin Ptolemais khuopi ka tung uhi; tua munah thu um mite hopi-in amate tawh ni khat ka omton uhi."},"8":{"text":"A zing ciengin pei-in Caesarea khuo ka tung uhi; tuale upa sagite lahah khat ahi lungdamna thugen pa Philip inn ah ka tam uhi.","ref":"Sawl 6:5; 8:5"},"9":{"text":"Ama in pasal nei nai lo kamsang letsong a nga tanu li a nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua munah ni tampi ka tam sungun Judah gam panin Agabus min nei kamsang khat ang peisuh hi.","ref":"Sawl 11:28"},"11":{"text":"Kote kungah ama hing pei a, Paul’ kawnggah la-in tua tawh a khut le a kengte a khi zaw ciengin, “Hlagau Siengtho in, ‘Jew mite in Jerusalem khuo ah tami kawnggah nei pa tam bangin khi-in Gentile-te khut sungah pie ding uhi,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tami thu ka zah ciengun kote le tua sunga om mite in Jerusalem ah Paul a peito lo nadingin ka hlo uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin Paul in, “Bang dingin note tam bangin kapin ka lungsim kitapkhap nadingin gamta na hi uh ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile hencipna hi khop loin Topa Jesu’ min adingin Jerusalem ah sina nangawn a thuoh dinga a kithawisa ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama a kizawl zawh lo ciengin, “ Topa’ deina bang hi taheh!” ci simlo ka dai khawl ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nite zaw ciengin kithawi-in Jerusalem khuo ah ka peito uhi."},"16":{"text":"Caesarea khuo panin zong nuazui pawlkhat in ei zui vua, ka zintun nading uh nuazui masa khat ahi Cyprus-te Mnason inn dongah ei hla uhi."},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem khuo ka tun ciengun sanggamte in lungdam tahin ei na dawn uhi.","title":"James Kungah Paul Haw"},"18":{"text":"A zing ciengin James kungah Paul tawh ka va haw ta vua, upate zosie zong a na om uhi."},"19":{"text":"Paul in amate a hopi zaw ciengin a nasepna tungtawnin Gentile-te lahah Pasien’ nasepnate khat zaw khat a bansut hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in tua thu a zah ciengun Pasien a phat uhi. Tua ciengin amate in, “Sanggam pa aw, Jew mite lahah thu um mi tul bangza om zo ci na thei a, a unpi-un thukham zui ding lam a pawnthaw mamate ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gentile-te lahah a teng Jew mite zosie in Moses’ thukham a taisan nading ule a tate uzong a tep uh kitan loin a ngainate uh a zui lo nadingun genin na hil lam amate kungah kigen zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in tam sunga nang tun lam za valon ding uh ahi ciengin bang law ding i hi ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n kang gen bangun bawl in. Kote in a kiciemsa mi li ka nei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuate tawh kipawl inlen ngaina kisiensuona ah amate tawh va kihalin a lu a heukieu man ding uzong sum va pie ta’n. Tua bangin bawl lacin mi zosie in nang tungtang a gensa thu uh bangma ahi lo lam le nang mama zong thukham zui na hi lam ang thei ta ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 6:13-21"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin Gentile thu um mite ading ahile milim biehna ante, sasi, lawlmeh sate le numei-pasal pahtatnate a tan nading uh, ka thukhensatna uh lai ka hlah zo uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Sawl 15:29"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciengin Paul in tua mite zawpi a, a zing ni-in amate tawh amama a kisiensuo zaw-in biehinnpi sungah lut a, siensuona ni a tawp hun ding le amate ciet in biehpiehna a bawl ding uh hunte a va theisah ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Ni sagi a cin kuon ciengin Asia gam pana Jew mite in biehinnpi sungah ama a mu ciengun mihonte hantawhin a man vua,","title":"Biehinnpi Sungah Paul Kiman"},"28":{"text":"“Israel mite aw, ei panpi un! I mite, i thu kham le tami mun langpangin muncin tenga om mi zosie tungah thu hil kawikawi pa tam pa ahi hi; tua banah ama in Gentile-te peipi-in biehinnpi sungah lutsah a, tami mun siengtho a buasah hi,” ci-in a awng vapuoh uhi."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen masanglai khatin khuo sungah ama le Ephesus khuomi Trophimus a kithuo a mu vua, tuaci’n biehinnpi sungah Paul in ama ang lutpi hi ngelngel va, ci-in a ngaisun uhi.","ref":"Sawl 20:4"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin khuozang buppi buoi a, mite zong a hontai uhi. Amate in Paul a man vua, biehinnpi sung panin ama kaiphitin thakhatin kotpite a kha pai uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in Paul tha a sawm laitahun Jerusalem khuopi buppi buoi hi, ci-in galkapmangpa kungah thu na kipuoh hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in thakhatin galkapte le galkap bute hlanin amate lamah a taisuh pai uhi. Amate in galkapmangpa le galkapte a mu ciengun Paul a vuo nawn sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkapmangpa zong pei a, ama manin siakhau ni tawh khi dingin thu a pie hi; ama koi hi a, bang sem ahei ci thu ama in dong hi."},"34":{"text":"Mihonpi lahah pawlkhat in thu khat gen a, adang pawlkhat in thudang khat ma genin a awng gawp uhi; mihonte buoi mama a, ama in lah a thu a theicien lo ziehin galkap len sungah Paul a peipi nadingun thu a pie hi."},"35":{"text":"Kenlei cielah Paul a tun ciengin mihonte gilo seng ahi ziehin galkapte in ama a puo uhi."},"36":{"text":"A zui mihonpi in “Ama that un!” ci-in a awng vapo uhi."},"37":{"text":"Galkap len sungah Paul a lutpi kuonun ama in galkapmangpa kungah, “Thu khat kang gen thei diei mah?” ci-in dong hi. Galkapmangpa in, “Greek ham na thei ei mah?","title":"Paul Ama le Ama Kisut"},"38":{"text":"Tua ciengin masang lai khat a kumpi ledo dinga mi holtuo, senel gama misuom tul li a peipi Egypt mipa hi lo na mah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"39":{"text":"Paul in, “Khuopi thupi mama khat ahi Cilicia gam Tarsus khuopi-a pieng Judah mi khat ka hi hi; hepina tawh mipite kungah thu ei gensah in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama in phalna a pieh ciengin Paul zong kenlei ciel tungah dingin mipite a dai thei nadingin a khut zah phei-in a sip bepun Hebrew kam tawh thu gen a:"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sanggamte le pate aw, tu-in na mai vuah ka kihutna dinga kang gen thu ngai un,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Amate in Hebrew hama a thugen a zah ciengun a sip tasem vua, tua ciengin Paul in:"},"3":{"text":"“Kei pen Cilicia gam Tarsus khuopi-a suoh Judah mi khat ka hi a, ahi vangin tami khuo sunga Gamaliel’ kengbula a khang ka hi a, i pu i pate’ thukhamte khautahin ei na kihil a, tu ni-a no teng zosie ma bangin Pasien lamah ka na pawnthaw mama hi.","ref":"Sawl 5:34-39"},"4":{"text":"Keima in tami Lampi a zui numei pasal a koimapo manin thong sung denna-in ka nei a, a si dongun ka bawlsie hi."},"5":{"text":"Siempu lien pa le upa buppi in zong kei thu teci a pang thei ding uhi. Damascus khuopi-a sanggamte a kihen nadingin keima in amate tung panin phalna laite ka na nga a, tuaci’n amate dan a kipieh thei nadingin khau tawh a hen ding le Jerusalem khuopi ah a puohkia dingin tua tahah ka va kuon ta hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 26:9-11"},"6":{"text":"“Ka khuolzinna lampi ah Damascus khuo ka tun kuon sunkim pawl laitahin, vantung panin khuovah golpi khat in thakhatin ei khawsuh hi.","title":"Paul in a Kikhelna Gen"},"7":{"text":"Tuolah ka pua a, tuale aw khat in keima kungah, ‘Saul, Saul aw, bang dinga kei nei ci bawlsiet ahei?’ ei ci ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in, ‘ Topa aw nang koi na hei?’ ci-in ka dong leh ama in keima kungah, ‘Na bawlsiet Nazareth khuomi Jesu ka hi hi,’ ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua laitahin ka zawpi mite in tua khuovah a mu vangun kei kunga thu ei gen pa’ aw a za sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in, ‘Bang ka bawl diei Topa ?’ ci-in ka dong hi. Topa in keima kungah, ‘Tho inlen Damascus khuo ah pei-in, tuanah Pasien in sep dinga a sesa thu zosie ang kigen ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua khuovah’ vang tang luo ahi ziehin khuo ka mu thei ta sih a, ka zawpite in ka khutin ei kai vua, Damascus khuo lamah ei peipi uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Thukham tawh kituoha biehna pawnthaw mama le Jew mite zosie in a na genphat uh Ananias kici mi khat tua tahah a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale ama hing pei-in ka gei-ah ang ding a, “Sanggam pa Saul aw, khuo mukia in!’ ei ci hi. Tua hun lienin ka mit ang vah a, ama ka mu thei pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in, “I pu i pate’ Pasien in ama’ deina a thei ding, Midih Pa a mu ding le ama’ aw a za dingin nang ang teel zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na musa le na zahsa thute, mi zosie tunga teci a pang ding na hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in zong bang dinga kiheh na hei? Tho-in ki-baptize inlen, ama’ min lo inlen na mawnate sawp siengsah in,’ a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"“Jerusalem ah ka kilekia zaw biehinnpi sungah thu ka nget laitahin mumang bangin ka om hi.","title":"Gentile-te Kungah Paul Kisawl"},"18":{"text":"Keima in Jesu ka mu a, tuale ama in, ‘Kinaw inlen Jerusalem panin peikhie meng in, azieh pen amate in keima thu na teci panna ang sang sih ding uhi,’ ci-in ei gen hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in, “ Topa aw, kikhopna inn cintengah nang ang um mite thongkhie-in, ka sat lam amate mama in ei thei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma’ teci pa Stephen’ sisan a luon laitahin kei mama zong ama gei-ah ka ding a, ama a si ding thukimin a thatte’ puon ka keppieh lai hi,’ ka ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:58"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “A gamlapi khata a om Gentile-te kungah hing sawl ding ka hi ziehin pei in,’ ei ci hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam thu a gen dong cieng amate in a thugen uh a ngai lai vua, ahi vangin amate in, “Tam bang mihing leitung panin hemkhie un! Azieh pen ama a hing dingin a kilawm sih hi,” ci-in a kiko vapual uhi.","title":"Paul le Rome Galkap Mangpa"},"23":{"text":"Amate a kiko kawmun a puontuolte uh suo dawhin van lamah leivuite a the laitahun,"},"24":{"text":"amate in Paul a hici awhsanna uh azieh bang pen ahei ci a thei nadingin galkapmangpa in satna tawh ama thusit dingin galkap lenah a peipi nadingun thu a pie hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin savun khauhuol tawh ama a khi ciengun Paul in a gei-a ding galkap bupa kungah, “Khiel hi, ci-a thu kikhen lopi-in Rome mi khat na sat ding uh thukham tawh kituoh ma amah?” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Galkap bupa in tua thu a zah bepin galkapmangpa kungah pei-in, “Nang bang sem ding na hei? Tam mipa, Rome gammi ahi bo hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"27":{"text":"Galkapmangpa pei-in Paul kungah, “Nang Rome gammi na hi amah? ei gen in,” a ci hi. Tuale ama in, “Ka hi ma hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Galkapmangpa in, “Rome gammi ka nga nadingin sum tampitah ka tawp hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Paul in, “Kei ka suo-a kipanin Rome gammi-a pieng ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in ama kung panin thu sit dinga a kisa mite a kilekia pai uhi; tuale galkapmangpa in siakhau tawh a khi Paul pen Rome gammi khat ahi lam thei ahi ziehin a zau mama hi."},"30":{"text":"Bang zieha Jew mite in Paul a mawmat uh ahei ci thu galkapmang pa in a thei nop ziehin a zing ni-in ama hlansah a, a kimutuo dingin siempu uhpite le biehna uliente zosie thu a pie hi. Ama in Paul peipisuhin a mai vuah a dingsah hi.","title":"Biehna Uliente Mai-ah Paul"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul in biehna uliente a etcien laitahin ama in, “Sanggamte aw, keima in tuni cieng dongin Pasien mai-ah lungsim kisuonna om loin hinkhuo ka na mang hi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ciengin siempu lien pa Ananias in a gei-a ding mite kungah Paul’ nephu behpieh un ci-in thu a pie hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin Paul in ama kungah, “A kizutngo kawm aw, Pasien in nang ang beng ding hi! Kei tungah thukham tawh a kituoha thukhen dingin tua sunga to hi napi cin, bang dinga a lelama thu na khen a, kei nephu beh dinga thu na pieh ahei?” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 23:27-28"},"4":{"text":"A gei-a a ding mite in, “Nang, Pasien’ siempu lien pa zako viel ding na mah?” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Paul in, “Sanggamte aw, ama siempu lien pa ahi lam ka thei sih hi; azieh pen, ‘Na mite uh’ makai pa na gensie sih ding uhi,’ ci-in kigiel ma hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 22:28"},"6":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte pen Sadducees-te hi a, adangte Pharisees-te ahi lam Paul in a thei bepin ama in, “Sanggamte aw, kei zong Pharisees-te’ tapa, Pharisee mi khat ma ka hi hi. Misite thawkia tawh kisai lametna thu ziehin thusitna thuoh ka hi hi,” ci-in biehna uliente mai-ah a kiko hi.","ref":"Sawl 26:5; Phil 3:5"},"7":{"text":"Ama in tua thu a gen ciengin Sadducees-te le Pharisee-te kikalah kiselna pieng a, tua a kikhawm mite phalni a kisuo uhi."},"8":{"text":"(Sadducees-te in misite thawkiana om lo a, vantung mite hile, hlagau kicite hile om lo hi, a ci uhi; hizongle Pharisee-te in tua thu thumte om hi, ci-in pom uhi.)","ref":"Mat 22:23; Mrk 12:18; Luk 20:27"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin buoina lienpi tung a, Pharisee pawlte lah panin thukham hil siete pawlkhat dingin nahpi tahin a niel vua, “Tam pa tungah bangma mawna ka mu sih uhi. Hlagau ahiei vantungmi ahiei khat in ama kunga thu a gen hi kha mawh leh bang na law ta ding vuoi?” a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kiselna a husiet mama ciengin amate in Paul hing ehmal kha va uh ci-in galkapmangpa a lunghimaw ziehin, galkapte peisuhin zawthawthu tawh ama la-in galkap len-ah a peipi nadingun thu a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum zanin Paul kungah Topa ding a, “Kilungkhausah in! Bangzieh ahei cile Jerusalem khuo ah keima’ thu teci na pan bangin Rome khuopi ah zong teci na pang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin Jew mite in kidap zopna khat bawlin Paul a tha masangsie uh an ne lo tui dawn loin a op nadingun kiciemna a bawl uhi.","title":"Paul Tha Kisawm"},"13":{"text":"Tami sawmdapna sunga a kihal mi sawm li val bang a hi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Siempu uhpi pa le upate kungah amate pei-in, “Paul ka tha masangsie-un bangma an ciem lo dingin khautahin ka kiciem zo uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin tu-in note le na biehna uliente in Paul’ thu a kicien zaw-a thu sit nuom kinei unlen, galkapmang pa in na kung vua ama ang peipisuh nadingin theisah un. Ama ang tun masangin a that dingin a kiging sa-in ka om uhi,” a ci uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua laitahin Paul sanggamnu’ tapa in a kibuhdapna thu a zah ciengin galkap len sungah lutin Paul kungah a gen hi."},"17":{"text":"Paul in galkap bute khat hlan a, “Tami tangval pa in galkapmangpa kungah gen ding thu kimkhat nei ahi ziehin ama kungah va zawpi ta’n,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n galkap bupa in galkapmangpa kungah tua tangval pa zawpi a, “Thongkie pa Paul in keima ei hlansah a, tami tangval pa in nang tungah gen ding thu nei ahi ziehin ama na kunga ang puoh dingin kei ei sawl hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Galkapmangpa in tua pa a khut tawh kai-in ama ni guoh a peikhie vua, “Nei gen ding thu bang ahei,” ci-in a dongdap hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Jew mite in Paul’ thu a kicing zaw-a a thei nuom kipangin zing ciengin biehna uliente mai-ah Paul na peipi nadingin ang nget ding uh kithukim zo uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin amau’ thu mang sin, azieh pen ama buhdap dingin mihing sawmli val bang a om uhi. Amate in ama a tha masangsie uh an ne lo tui dawn lo dingin kiciemna a nei uhi. Tu-in amate in nangma kung panin kamciem beh ngahin kiging sa-in a om uhi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaci’n galkapmangpa in tangval pa kungah, “Keima kungah tami thu nei ko lam koima tungah gen sin,” ci-in vaihlahin a peisah hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in galkap bute ni hlan a, “Tu zan nai kuo-in Caesarea khuo-a pei dingin galkap za ni, sakol galkap sawm sagi le teipi tawi galkap za ni tawh a baisa-in om in.","title":"Gam Uhpa Felix Kungah Paul Kipuoh"},"24":{"text":"Paul’ tuon nading sakolte zong pie unlen, uhpi pa Felix kungah hoitahin peipi un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in tam bangin laihlah khat giel hi:"},"26":{"text":"“Keima Claudius Lysias in a Lien uhpi pa Felix kang hopi hi."},"27":{"text":"Jew mite in tampa a that dihtah vua, ahi vangin ama Rome mi khat ahi lam ka thei bepin ka galkapte tawh pei-in ama ka va hun dawh ta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ama a mawsahna thu uh thei nuom ka hi ziehin keima in a biehna uliente uh mai-ah ka peipi hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama pen amau’ thukham tungtanga kimawsah na hi lel a, thong khieh nadingin ahi a, tha nadingin ahi zongin a kilawm khielna ka mu sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Tam pa tha kisawm hi, ci thu ka thei ciengin na kungah ama thakhatthu-in kang peisah a, a mawmat mite in a mawsahna thu uh na kunga ang sun nadingun thu ka pie zo hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n galkapte in a kisawlna bangin Paul la-in Antipatris khuo ah a peipi uhi."},"32":{"text":"A zing ciengin sakol galkapte tawh ama peisuohsah a, amate ahile galkap lenah a kilekia uhi."},"33":{"text":"Caesaria khuo a tun ciengun uhpi pa kungah a lai puoh a pie vua, Paul zong ama tungah a ap uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in tua laihlah sim a, nang bang gam pan na hei, ci-in dong a, ama in Cilicia gammi ahi lam a thei ciengin"},"35":{"text":"ama in, “Ang mawmat mite ang tun ciengin na thu kang sit ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciengin Herod kumpi inn sungah ama koi-in a cin nadingun thu a pie hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw ni nga ciengin upa pawl khat le Tertullus a kici sitni khat tawh siempu lien pa Ananias a peisuh vua, amate in uhpi pa mai-ah Paul a mawsahna uh thute a sung uhi.","title":"Caesarea Khuo Felix Mai-ah Paul"},"2":{"text":"Paul a kihlat zaw ciengin Tertullas in ama mawsahna thugen a kipan hi: “A Lien Mangpipa aw, nangma ziehin lungmuong tahin sawtpitah ka om vua, nangma’ vaihawm siemna tawh tami minamte adingin puophatnate zong kibawl zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kote in mun zosie le vai zosie-ah tam na vaihawmnate lungdamna lienpi tawh ka sang uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin kote in sawtveipi kang buoisah nuom lo ziehun tomkima kang gen ding thute hepina tawh nei ngaipieh nadingin kang thum hi."},"5":{"text":"Kote in tam mipa pen buoina a piengsah pa ahi a, leitung bup Jew mite lahah mi holtuo pa khat le Nazareth pawlte’ makai pa khat ahi lam ka thei zo ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in biehinnpi nangawn buasah a sawm ziehin kote in ama ka man uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kote in ka thukham utawh kituohin ama tungah thu ka khen sawm uhi. Hizongle galkapmangpa Lysias hing pei-in ko kung panin pauhat thu tawh ama ei lahpieh hi."},"8":{"text":"Nang mama in thu hing sit lacin ama tunga ka mawmatna zosie uh a man ahi lam na thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jew mite in zong ama panpi-in tami a thugente zosie a man ma ahi hi, a ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Uhpi pa in thu gen dingin Paul lamah khut a van ciengin ama in, “Nangma in tam minam tungah kum tampi sung thukhenpa na hi lam ka thei ziehin lungdam tahin ka kisutna ding thu ang gen ka hi hi.","title":"Felix Mai-ah Paul a Kisutna"},"11":{"text":"Na mu thei ding ma bangin Jerusalem ah Pasien bie dinga ka peito zaw ni sawm le ni ni zong a val nai sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in biehinnpi sungah mi khatpo tawh ka kiselna hile, kikhopna inn sung ah hile, khuopi sung muncin tengah hile mihonpi ka holtuona bangma a mu sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-a amate in ang sun uh ei mawmatna thu uzong a manna thu ang lah thei tuon sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle keima in pawltuom a ci uh tami Lampi zui-in ka pu ka pate’ Pasien ka bie a, thukham laibu sung le kamsangte’ laibu sunga a kigielsa thu zosie ka um hi, ci thu na kungah kang pulah hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate mama in zong midihte le midih lote’ thawkiana om tuoh ding hi, ci-in a san bangun keima in Pasien sungah lametna ka nei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin keima in Pasien tung le mi zosie tungah kisuonna ka nei lo nadingin ka hi thei za tawh ka hanciem hi."},"17":{"text":"Kum tampi zaw ciengin ka minamte kungah huna sum puoh ding le biehna lui dingin tu-a ang kuon ka hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in biehinnpi sungah tamte bawlin ka op ei mu lai-un mihonpi om lo, buoina zong om vawt loin kisiensuona ziatan ka man zo lien leh amate in kei ei na mu uhi.","ref":"Sawl 21:17-28"},"19":{"text":"Hizongle Asia gam pana ang pei Jew mite pawlkhat zong a om vua, amate in kei tungah mawsah ding thu khatpo ei nei uleh hing pei-in na mai-ah ei mawmatna uh thu ang sun ding uh a kilawm hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi sihle zong biehna uliente mai-a ka din lai-in tam mite in keima tungah bang khielna mu uh ahei ci gensah inlen,"},"21":{"text":"amate mai-a ka din lai-in, ‘Misite thawkiana thu tawh kisai-in tuni-in na mai vuah thusitna ka thuoh hi,’ ci-a ka kiko pen ahi lo buong leh bangma om lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:6"},"22":{"text":"Hinanle Lampi thu a theizaw Felix in a thu khen ding sot to a, “Galkapmangpa Lysias ang tun ciengin keima in na thu uh kang khenpieh ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkap bupa in ama a cin nadingin thu pie a, hinanle ama in phabep cieng khat suotahna a pieh nading le a kisapnate a en nuom a lawmte khatpo a kham lo nadingin zong thu a pie hi."},"24":{"text":"Ni bangza ahei khat a sawt zaw ciengin Felix in Judah numei khat ahi, a zi Drusilla tawh pei-in Paul hlansah a, Jesu Khris upna thu a gen a ngai uhi."},"25":{"text":"Paul in dihna thu, pumpi kidehzawhna thu le ang tung ding thukhenna thute a kuppi ciengin Felix zau a, “Tu-in pei phot inlen hun lem ka nga ciengin kang hlansah kia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Khum hun ma-in Paul in sum ei pie kha leh ci lametna tawh ama hlan thimthemin hopi zel hi."},"27":{"text":"Kum ni a cin zaw ciengin Felix’ za laihin Porcius Festus pang a, Felix in Judah-te’ maipha a mu nop ziehin thong kiasa-in Paul a nuasie hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua gam a tunzaw ni thum ciengin Caesarea khuo panin Jerusalem ah Festus peito a,","title":"Paul in Kumpipa Kungah Thukhang"},"2":{"text":"tua munah siempu uhpite le Judah makaite in Paul a mawmatna thu uh ama kungah na sung uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate a angvanna-in Jerusalem ah Paul a puoh nadingin Festus kungah ngenin a thum uhi. A tahtahin amate in lamkalah ama a tha sawm uh ahi bo hi."},"4":{"text":"Festus in zong, Caesarea ah Paul kikhum a, kei mama zong tua munah a sawt loin pei ka sawm hi, ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in, “Na thunei uliente utawh ei peisuhsah unlen tampa tawh kisai-in khielna khatpo a op leh kimawmat ta uheh,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate lahah ni giet ahiei ni sawm ahiei sanga a tamzaw lo khat a tam zaw ciengin Caesarea khuo-ah a peisuh hi; a zing ni ciengin thukhenna topha tungah to a, ama in Paul a kipeipi nadingin thu a pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Paul a tun ciengin Jerusalem pana a peisuh Jew mite in a imtawm pai vua, amate in teci tawh a lah thei lo uh mawsietna thulien tampite tawh ama a mawmat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Paul in a kisutna ah, “Jew mite’ thukham tungah hile, biehinnpi tungah hile, kumpipa tungah hile bangma khielna ka bawl sih hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin Festus in Jew mite’ maipha a nga nuom ziehin Paul kungah, “Tami thu tawh kisai-in keima mai-ah thusit dingin Jerusalem ah nang peito nuom ei mah?” ci-in a dong hi."},"10":{"text":"Paul in, “Kumpipa’ thukhenna topha mai-a a ding ka hi hi; tam mun pen thu ei kisit nadinga a kilawm mun ahi hi. Nang in nei thei siem ma bangin Jew mite tungah khielna bangma ka bawl sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in kei ka khiel khah a, si nading lawm bawlkhiel ka nei leh, sina tawh kipel thei nadingin ka hanciem sih ding hi; ahi vangin ei mawmatna uh a dih lopi ahile koima in amau’ khut sungah ei ap thei tuon sih ding hi. Kumpipa kungah ka thu ka khang hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama’ upa vaihawmte tawh a kikup zaw ciengin Festus in, “Kumpipa kungah na thu na khang zo hi; kumpipa kungah na pei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni tampi zaw ciengin Festus dawn dingin Caesarea khuo-ah Kumpi Agrippa le Bernice a tung uhi.","title":"Festus in Kumpi Agrippa Thukum"},"14":{"text":"Tua khuo-ah ni tampi a taam zaw ciengun Festus in kumpipa mai-ah Paul’ thu sung a, “Felix in thong sunga a tapnuasie mi khat tanah a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem-a ka om lai-in siempu uhpite le Judah upate in kei kungah ama’ thu ei ko vua, a thu ei khenpieh in, ci-in ang thum uhi."},"16":{"text":"Keima in amate kungah, “Mawsahna a thuohte in a mawsahte tawh kimaituo-in a kimawsahna thu a phel thei nadingin hun lemtang khat a nga masangsie, a mawsahte’ khut sungah mi khatpo ap ding pen Rome ngaina hi lo hi, ci-in amate kungah ka gen hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n tam munah amate kimu-in a zing ciengin thukhenna topha tungah to pai-in, tua mipa ang kipeipi nadingin thu ka pie hi."},"18":{"text":"A mawsahte ang din ciengun ka upmaw bang loin mawmatna bangma a gen tuon sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"A kithutu pen uh ahile a biehna vai ule a sisa kimlai Paul in hingkia ta, a ci Jesu’ tungtang guol bep no khat na hi lel hi."},"20":{"text":"Tami dawhnate bangci kantel ding ci thei lo ka hi ziehin Jerusalem ah pei-in tua tahah thusit ding na nuom eimah, ci-in ama ka dong hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Paul in a Vanglien Kumpipa khen dingin thu khang zo ta ahi ziehin, ama kumpipa kunga ka puoh zo masangsie thong sunga khum phot dingin thu ka pie hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Agrippa in Festus kungah, “Kei mama in tami pa thu ka za nuom hi,” a ci ciengin, “Zing ciengin ama’ thu na za ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaci’n a zing ciengin Agrippa le Bernice-te thupitah le kiliensah tahin ang pei vua, kumpi galkapmangte le khuo sunga mi thupite tawh mipi kikhopna inn sungah ang lut uhi. Tua ciengin Festus in thu pie a, Paul kilutpi hi.","title":"Agrippa Mai-ah Paul Kipeipi"},"24":{"text":"Tuale Festus in, “Kumpi Agrippa le kote tawh tana om mi zosie aw, Jerusalem khuo sung le tami khuo sungah a sawt hin dingin kilawm lo hi, ci-in Judah mi zosiete awngin kei kunga ang nget uh ahi tam mipa note in na mu uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin a sina za va-ia dingin ke’n a gamtat khielna bangma ka mu sih hi; ama in a Vanglien Kumpipa tungah a thu khang zo ta ahi ziehin ama peisah dingin ka khensat zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin thunei pen pa tungah ama’ thu ka giel ding a kicien bangma ka nei sih hi. Tua ahi ziehin na mai vuah ama kang puoh a, ama thu i sit zaw ciengin giel ding thu pawlkhat nei kha leng cina tawh, adiehdiehin nang Kumpi Agrippa kunga kang puoh ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen a kimawsahna thu bang teng ahei, ci gen lopi-in thongkie mi khat mawh hla ding ci pen kei adingin a thu kicingtah ka sa zo sih hi,” a ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Agrippa in Paul kungah, “Na thu na gen thei nading phalna kang pie hi,” ci-in a gen ciengin Paul in a khut zahin a kisutna ding thu a gen hi:","title":"Agrippa Mai-ah Paul Kisut"},"2":{"text":"“Kumpi Agrippa aw, tuni-in ahile na mai-ah Jew mite’ ei mawsahna thu zosie ka kisutna ding thu gen ding ka hi tah ziehin hampha ka kisa hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen nangma in Jew mite’ ngaina zosie le a kikalna uh thu zosie na theicien deudeu hi. Tua ahi ziehin ka thugente lungduoi taha nei ngaipieh nadingin kang thum hi."},"4":{"text":"“A cila patin Jerusalem khuo ka mipite lahah hinkhuo ka na zang a, ka khangno lai-a kipanin Jew mite zosie in keima’ hindan ei na theisiem uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ka biehna sung vuah a khau penpen ahi Pharisee pawl ka hi lam le ka hindante teci a pan nuom uleh a sawtpi lai-a kipanin a theisa uh ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:6; Phil 3:5"},"6":{"text":"Pasien in ka pu ka pate uh a na pieh kamciem ka lamet ziehin tu-in tam munah thusitna thuoha a ding ka hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Minam sawm le nite in tuami kamciem nga dinga a kilamet ziehun sun le zanin kukal tahin Pasien a na bie mielmuol uhi. A Lien Mangpipa aw, tami lametna thu zieha Jew mite in kei ei mawmat uh ahi hi!"},"8":{"text":"Note khatpo in Pasien in misite thosah hi, ci thu bang dinga uphuoi lo-a na ngaisut uh ahei?"},"9":{"text":"“Kei mama in Nazareth mi Jesu’ min langpanga na tampi sep ding kilawm hi, ci-in ka na ngaisun ngai hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in tua bangin Jerusalem ah ka na sem pai hi; siempu uhpite’ phalna tawh misiengtho tampi tahte thong sungah ka khum banah amate si nading thu a kikhen ciengin zong thukimna me ka na pie lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Zawthaw thu tawh Pasien a gensiet nadingun kikhopna inn zosie-ah amate tamveipi dan ka pie hi; amate tungah lungthah luo ka hi ziehin gamdang khuopite lah nangawnah amate ka sulzui hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4-5"},"12":{"text":"“Tam thu lungsimah kuo kawmin siempu uhpite’ thuneina le sawlna tawh Damascus ah ka va zin ta a,","title":"Paul in a Kikhelna Thu Gen"},"13":{"text":"a Lien Mangpipa aw, sunkim pawl lampi-a ka pei laitahin keima le ka zawpite kimvelah ni sanga a tangzaw khuovah khat vantung panin ang tang ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka unpi-un lei lahah ka puasuh ciengun Hebrew ham tawh, ‘Saul, Saul aw, bang dinga nei bawlsiet ahei? Keng tawh ciengzum khat sui lacin nangma kiliemsuo na hi lel hi,’ ei ci aw khat ka za hi."},"15":{"text":"‘ Topa aw, nang koi na hei?’ ci-a ka dawh ciengin Topa in, ‘Na bawlsiet pa Jesu ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin tho inlen na keng tawh ding in; bangzieh ahei cile nang in keima sunga na musa nate le na tunga keima kang kilah lai nading thute a sem ding le teci a pang dinga kang se zieha na kunga ang kilah ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate kunga kang sawl nading ahi na mite le Gentile-te’ khut sung panin nangma kang hunkhie ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Khuomiel sung panin khuovah sung le Satan’ vanglietna panin Pasien lamah Gentile-te a kihei ziehun a mawnate uh a kimaisah thei nading le, keima sunga om a upna ziehun amate in a kisiensuosa mite lahah mun a nga thei nadingun, a mit uh a honpieh dingin nangma kang sawl ding hi,’ ei ci hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tua zaw ciengin Kumpi Agrippa aw, vantung mangmuna thu mang loin ka om sih a,","title":"A Thuhilna Paul in Gen"},"20":{"text":"ahi vangin amate kisiakia-in Pasien lam ang kihei nading ule kisiakiana tawh a kituoh gamtatnate ang lah nadingun, a masa penin Damascus khuo, tua zaw ciengin Jerusalem khuo, Judea gam teng le Gentile-te kungah zong ka tangko hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:20, 28-29"},"21":{"text":"Tami thu hang tawh Jew mite in biehinnpi sungah kei ei manin ei tha sawm uhi."},"22":{"text":"Keima in Pasien kung panin huna ka nga a, tuni cieng dongin tam munah dingin, a neu a lien tungah teci ka pang a, bangma dang gen loin Moses le kamsangte in ang pieng ding hi, ci-a a gensa uh thu ma ka gen hi:"},"23":{"text":"Tua thu in: Messiah in sina thuohin misite lah panin a tho masa pen hi ding a, i mipite kung le Gentile-te kungah khuovah thu a tangko ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 42:6; 49:6; 1Cor 15:20"},"24":{"text":"Ama in tami a kisutna thu a gen laitahin Festus in, “Paul aw, nang mimaw na hi hi! Na pilna tampi sinna in nang ang lemotsah ta hi!” ci-in nahpitahin ama a kiko hi."},"25":{"text":"Hizongle Paul in, “Hoi tungtuong Festus aw, kei pen a maw ka hi malmal sih a, pilvang taha thuman thutah gen ka hizaw bo hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa in tami thute na thei tahtah ziehin nop bangbangin kang gen ahi hi; azieh pen tami thute khat mama zong a kidapbawl hi valawh lo ahi ziehin na thei khah lo om lo dingin ka um hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpi Agrippa aw, kamsangte na um ei mah? Na up lam ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Agrippa in Paul kungah, “Hun tomno khat sungin Tapidaw suoh dinga ei zawl na hi amah?” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Paul in, “Hun a tom a, a sau zongin nang beh hi loin tuni-a ka thugen a ngai mi zosiete in tami siakol bulnate ci longal ah kei ei bah kim nading vua Pasien kunga thu ngen ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpipa le uhpi pa a dingto vua, tuale Bernice le a topi mite zong a ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amate a peikhiet zaw ciengun, “Tam pa in si nading le thongkieh nading za-in bangma bawl lo hi,” khatlekhat a kici uhi."},"32":{"text":"Agrippa in Festus kungah, “Tam pa in kumpipa tungah a thu a na khang zo nai lo khat hi leh kihla thei lel ma hiven,” a ci hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Italy gamah tembaw tawh ka pei ding uh thu a kikhensat zaw ciengin amate in Augustus galkap honte lahah zakhat a uh Julius kici galkap bupa’ khut sungah Paul le thongkie dang pawlkhatte a ap uhi.","title":"Rome ah Tembaw tawh Paul Pei"},"2":{"text":"Asia gam tuipi dung teng pei dinga a kisa Adramyttium tembaw tungah tuongin tuipi tungah ka om vua, Thessalonica pana ang pei Macedonia mi khat ahi Aristarchus in zong ko ei zui hi."},"3":{"text":"A zing ciengin Sidon khuo ah ka tung uhi; Julius in Paul na limbawl mama a, ama’ tasapnate a et thei nadingun a lawmte kungah ama a hawsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua khuo panin tuipi tungah ka peikia vua, hui ang lelan ziehin Cyprus tuikul kiliesahin ka pei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Cilicia le Pamphylia gam gala om tuipi ka kantan zaw ciengun Lycia gama om Mura khuo ka tung uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua munah zakhat a uh galkap bupa in Italy lam zuon ding Alexandra tembaw khat mu a, tua tungah ei tuongsah hi."},"7":{"text":"A muon muon no-in ni tampi sung ka pei vua, hamsapi-in Cnidus khuo ka pautun uhi. Tuale hui ang lelan ziehin Crete tuikul ka kiliesah vua, Salmone galah ka pei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hamsapi-in tuipi gei zui-in ka pei vua, Lasea khuopi gei Khawlmun Nuom kici mun ka tung uhi."},"9":{"text":"Antan hun a tawp zo zieh le tuipi tung khuolzinna a zauhuoi ziehin Paul in,"},"10":{"text":"“Siete aw, i tuipi khuolzinna-ah tuohsie-in supna tampi om ding a, tembaw le i van puohte uh i sup ban vuah i hinna uh i tanlaw ding uh zauhuoi hi, ci ka mu thei hi,” ci-in amate tungah ngaisutna a pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin galkap bupa in Paul’ thugen sangin tembaw uhpa le tembaw nei pa’ thu a mangzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Phalbi hun sunga op nadingin tua tembaw khawlna pen mun gina ahi seng lo ziehin tua mun panin Phoenix tembaw khawlna i tun zawh khah uleh tua munah tamin phalbi hun i mang ding uhi, ci-in mi a tamzawte’ deina tawh a pei suoh uhi. Tua mun pen leilu nisuona le leitaw nitumna lam a maingat Crete tuikul tembaw khawlna mun ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Leitaw lam hui ang lan hiauhiau ciengin a tupna uh a tung zo-in kingaisut uh ahi ziehin tembaw khina siakawi bot dawhin Crete tuikul pangzui teng nehin khuolzin a kipan uhi.","title":"Tuipi Tungah Huipi"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a sawt loin Crete tuikul lam panin sah-nisuo a kici huipi hat mama khat ang langsuh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hui in tembaw sem gawpin maiphu zo ta lo ahi ziehin hui lanna lamlamah ka pei mawh ta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Cauda a kici tuikul neu khat in kiliesahin ka tai laitahun tembaw’ gunkuong a siet lo nadingin ka hu zo paupau uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in tembaw tungah gunkuong a kaito zaw ciengun tembaw a kip nadingin khauhuol tawh a gah uhi. Syrtis sehtalte a phuh khah ding a zau ziehun siakawi khaisa-in hui in tembaw a tawsah uhi."},"18":{"text":"Huipi in ei nah sem gawp ta ahi ziehin a zing ciengin amate in tembaw vante paimangin,"},"19":{"text":"a ni thum ni-in tembaw’ vanzahte a khut utawh a paimang uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ni tampi sung ni le aasite ang dawh nawn loin huipi ang hat semsem ciengin, kote in suotah nading lametna kici zosie ka nuasie ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Sawtveipi an ne loin a op zaw ciengun amate lahah Paul dingin, “Lawmte aw, ka thugen ei mangin Crete tuikul pana a peikhie lo hi poma leih tam sietna le supna tawh i kipel ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in kilungkhausah un, azieh pen tembaw khat simlo note lahah mihing a si koima na om sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tuzanin keima ei nei le ka bieh Pasien’ vantungmi khat ka gei-ah ang ding a,"},"24":{"text":"‘Paul aw, zau malmal sin; kumpipa mai-ah na ding valon ding hi; tuale Pasien in tuipi tunga nangma le na zawpite zosie tungah bihna ang pie zo hi,’ ei ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n lawmte aw, kilungkhausah un, azieh pen ei kigensa bangin ang pieng tahpi ding hi, ci-in Pasien sungah upna ka nei hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuikul tung khatah i tung teitei ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Huipi in ei mut ziehin Adria tuipi tungah ka lam kawikawi laitah uh a zan sawm le lina zankim pawlin tembaw nasemte in lei tawh i kinai ta hi, ci-in ang ummaw uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate in tuithuhna ang te uleh lam sawm ni bang thuh hi, ci-in ang mu uhi; bano khat zaw ciengin ang tekia uleh lam sawm le lam nga a thuh hi."},"29":{"text":"Suongtum ka phuh khah ding uh ka zau ziehun tembaw nua lamah tembaw khawlsahna siakawi li ka khiesuh vua, zingmawng khuovah nading thu ka ngen uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hizongle tembaw tung panin tembaw nasemte daptai sawm uh ahi ziehin tembaw khawlsahna siakawi a khiesuh kinei-in tuipi sungah gunkuong a khie dap uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuale Paul in mi zakhat uh galkap bupa le galkapte kungah, “Tam mite tembaw sunga a op sih uleh, no zong na suohta zo sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciengin galkapte in gunkuong khina khauzamte attanin tui sungah a khiesuh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Khuo vah kuon ciengin Paul in amate zosie an ne dingin sawl a, “Tuni pen patau-in bangma an ne loin na om zaw uh a ni sawm le ni li a cin ni ahi ta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin an halkhat ne teitei bo un, kang thum hi, azieh pen tua in note ang hinsuo ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile note khat beh in na samzam khat zong na mansuo sih ding uhi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in tam thu a gen zaw ciengin khomun a la hi; tuale mi zosie’ mitmu-in Pasien kungah nuomthu tut a, ama in phalsuo-in a ne dingin a kipan hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate zosie zong a lung uh ang nuom a, an a ne ciet uhi."},"37":{"text":"(Tembaw sunga om mi a unpi-in zani sawm sagi le guh ka pha uhi)."},"38":{"text":"An khamtahin a neh zaw ciengun tembaw a zan nadingin tuipi tungah mangbu vuite a pai uhi."},"39":{"text":"Zingmawng ciengin leitung bang mun tung ci a thei sih vangun amate in tuipi pieuzang khat a mu vua, ahi thei leh tua munah tembaw khawlsah dingin a gel uhi.","title":"Tembaw Kisietna"},"40":{"text":"Tuaci’n tembaw khina siakawipi a khiesuh vua, tuipi sungah tuate a nuasie uhi. Tua hun sung ma-in amate in tembaw hawlna’ a khina khaute a sut dawh vua, huipi in mutin tuipieu lam a pei thei nadingun a mailama tembaw puon a khaisang uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ahi vangin tuihuol ni in a tetuona muna om sehtal khosang khat a phuh khah ziehin leitungah tembaw a kinga ta hi. Tembaw’ a malam teng tumin a pia thei ta sih a, ahi vangin tuihuol in a nualam a satkeh gawp hi."},"42":{"text":"Galkapte’ gelna pen thongkiete khat mama in tui ngapin a suotah lo nadingun amate tha sawm ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Hinanle mi zakhat a uh galkap bupa in Paul a suohtahsah nuom ziehin a ngimna bang vua a bawl lo nadingun amate a kham hi. Ama in tuingap theite tui sungah leng masa-in galkai-in,"},"44":{"text":"tuale a om lai teng singpehte tung po le tembaw van them tung po-ah tuongin a pei nadingun thu a pie hi.
