Tua bangin leitungah mi zosie galkai-in a suohta kim uhi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka suotah zaw ciengun tua tuikul pen Malta kici ahi lam ka thei na bo uhi.","title":"Malta Tuikulah Paul"},"2":{"text":"Tua tuikul mite in lamet lopi-in ka tung vuah migitna ei lah uhi. Guo ang zu-in khuo ang vot pan ta ahi ziehin amate in ka kimkot vuah mei ei tawpiehin ei na zin do uhi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in singkang lomkhat tomin meikuolai-ah a vang leh meisa lah panin gulsum khat hing pusuohin Paul khutah a kiviel hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuikul mite in Paul khuta gul kiviel a mu ciengun, “Tam pa pen tuol that khat hi ngelngel ding hi; tuipi tung panin ang suotah vangin a thutang Pasien in a hin ding phal lo hi ding hi,” ci-in khatlekhat a kiho uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin Paul in tua gul meikuolai-ah thing dawh a, bangma a ci sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in ama pen hing pawmzahin ahi sihle hing thalpua-in ang si ding hi, ci-in sawtveipitah a khuongai vangun ama tungah thu lamdang a pien lo lam a mu bepun a lungsim uh kikhelin ama pasien khat hi va, a ci ta leuleu uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuami mun tawh a kigamla seng lo ah Publius a kici tuikul hausapa’ neisa logamte om a, tuapa in kote ei tungsahin ni thum sung limtahin zin ei do hi."},"8":{"text":"Publius’ a pa cithua natna le gilsan vei-in lup mun tung ngahin na om hi. Ama kungah Paul va haw a, ama tungah a khut nga a, thu ngetpiehin a damsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami thu a pien zaw ciengin tuikul tunga om cina dangte zong hing pei-in damna a nga uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in patawina tampi ei pie vua, ka pei kuon ciengun lamkala zah ding a kisamte zong tembaw tungah ei guonpieh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hla thum zaw ciengin tua tuikul ah phalbi sunga a na tamsa Unau Kopsuo nite’ lim kisuong Alexandria tembawpi khat zui-in ka pei uhi.","title":"Rome ah Paul Tung"},"12":{"text":"Sirakus khuo ah ka tung vua, tua munah ni thum sung ka tam uhi;"},"13":{"text":"tua ciengin ding leuleu-in Rhegium khuo ka tung uhi. Tua munah ni khat zaw ciengin leitaw lam hui hing langin a ni ni ni-in Puteoli khuo ka tung uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua munah thu um mite ka mu vua, amate in ni sagi tam dingin ei ciel uhi. Tuaci’n Rome lam zuonin ka pei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua Rome-a om thu um mite in ka haw lam a zah ciengun pawlkhatte kei ei dawn dingin Appius Sumbuh le Zinbuh Thum dongah ang pei uhi. Paul in amate a mu ciengin Pasien kungah nuomthu tutin a lung a nuom mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Rome khuo ka tun ciengun ama a cing galkap pa tawh a dei bangbanga a op nadingin Paul phalna kipie hi."},"17":{"text":"Ni thum zaw ciengin ama in tuol sung Jew makaite a kikhawmsah hi. Amate a kikhop ciengun ama in amate kungah, “Sanggamte aw, keima in i mipite tungah hile, i pu i pate’ ngaina tungah hile ka sepkhiel bangma om lo napi-in, amate in Jerusalem khuo ah ei manin thong ei khie vua, tua panin Rome-te’ khut sungah ei ap uhi.","title":"Rome-ah Paul le Judah Makaite"},"18":{"text":"Amate in thu ei sit zaw ciengun Rome-te in kei ei hla nuom uhi, azieh pen ka thu tawh kisai-in keima in sina dan ka thuoh nading a hang om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Hizongle Jew mite in ang niel ciengun- ka mipite tungah mawsahna bangma ka nei sih vangin-kumpipa tungah ka thu ka khan lo ang phamaw veve hi.","ref":"Sawl 25:11"},"20":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin note tawh kimu-in a kiholim dinga kang khop uh ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile Israel-te’ lametna thu ziehin tam banga siakhau tawh ei kikhi ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in, “Judea gam panin nang thu tawh kisai lai bangma ka na nga sih vua, tana ang pei sanggamte koima khat beh in zong nang thu ei ko-in a sie lama ei gen a om sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin mun zosie-ah tam biehna pawlte’ thu a kigensie hi, ci thei ka hi ziehun, nang tung panin na ngaisutnate ka za nuom uhi,” a ci uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama tawh a kimu nading uh ni khat a se zaw ciengun Paul zintunna-ah mi tampitah a va haw ta uhi. Ama in zingmawng panin nitah dongin Moses’ thukham le kamsangte’ laibu panin amate thuhil a, Pasien’ manggam thu teci pangin Jesu’ thu lamah amate a thuzaw ding a hanciem hi.","title":"Rome ah Paul in Thuhil"},"24":{"text":"Ama’ thugen ziehin mi pawl khatte in a um vua, hinanle adangte in a um sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n amate khatlekhat kithutuoh loin a om uhi. Amate a peikhiet ciengun Paul in thugenna khat neibe lai hi: Kamsang Isaiah tungtawnin na pu na pate uh’ kunga Hlagau Siengtho’ thugen khu a man ahi a,"},"26":{"text":"‘Tam mite kungah pei-in gen in, note in na zah vangun na tel zo ngai sih ding uhi. Note in na et vangun na mucien ngai sih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen tami mite lungsim a bol a, a bilte un khuo za thei loin, a mit a siing uhi. Tua hi sihle amate in a mit utawh cien mu-in, kei lamah amate hing kihei-in, keima in amate kadam sah ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciengin Gentile-te kungah tami Pasien’ hutdamna thu kipuoh zo hi; amate in a ngai ding uhi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"29":{"text":"Paul in tam thute a gen zaw ciengin Jew mite pei dawhin amate sungah kiselna nahpi tahin a om hi."},"30":{"text":"Paul, kum ni sung vilvel ama le ama kisihin om a, ama kunga a haw mi zosie hoitahin na lamdotin,"},"31":{"text":"a lie a dal om loin Pasien’ manggam le Topa Jesu Khris’ thu hangtahin a hil hi."}}}}},"45":{"info":{"name":"Rome-te","shortname":"Rom","abbr":[],"desc":"Rome-te tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to the romans)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ lungdamna thu gen dinga ei kituomkoi, sawltahpi dinga ei kihlan, Jesu Khris’ nasem keima Paul in kang hopi uhi.","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"Pasien in Lai Siengtho sungah a kamsangte tungtawnin a na ciemkholsa ahi a,"},"3":{"text":"tua pen cilesa lamah David’ suon a Tapa tawh kisai lungdamna thu ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Siengthona hlagau’ lamsangah misite lah panin vanglietna tawh a thawsahkiana ziehin Pasien’ tapa Topa Jesu Khris a hina thu a pholah hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama tungtawn le ama’ min ziehin Gentile-te zosie lahah upna le thumanna a op thei nadingin kote in hepina le sawltahpi za ka nga vua,"},"6":{"text":"Jesu Khris a nei dinga a kihlan mite lahah note zong na kihal uhi."},"7":{"text":"Misiengthote ahi dinga kihlan Rome khuo-a om Pasien in a it mi zosie tungah: I Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung panin hepina le lungmuonna note tungah ang tung taheh."},"8":{"text":"A masa-in leitung mun zosie-ah na upna uh kithang ahi ziehin note zosie ziehin Jesu Khris’ minin ka Pasien tungah nuomthu ka tut hi.","title":"Lungdamko Thungetna"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tatsat loin ka thungetnate ah note kang phawden lamtah, ama tapa’ lungdamna thu hilin ka lungsim tahpi tawh ama’ na ka seppieh Pasien ka teci ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien’ deina a op leh lam khat popo panin na kung vuah a sawt loin kang haw thei teitei nadingin thu ka ngen hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note ang thakhausah ding Hlagau letsong pawlkhat kang hopsawn thei nadingin note kang mu ding ka lunggul mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi sihle note’ upna le keima’ upna khatlekhat tha i kipieh thei nading ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Sanggam pasalte le sanggam numeite aw, Gentile dangte lahah ga ka law bangin, note lahah zong ga pawlkhat ka law thei nadingin (ahi vangin tu tanpha-in ei kikhahtan hi) na kung vua haw ding ka sawmsawm hi, ci nei theipi ding uh ka dei hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"14":{"text":"Greek-te le tuolniem mite tungah leibat ka nei bangin, mi pilte le mi mawte tungah zong ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Rome khuo-a om note kungah zong lungdamna thu hil ding ka lawp mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima in lungdamna thu ka maizumpi sih hi; tua thu pen a um zosie in hutdamna a nga nading Pasien’ vanglietna ahi hi. A masa-in Jew mite ading ahi a, Greek-te ading zong ahi hi.","title":"Lungdamna Thu’ Vanglietna","ref":"Mrk 8:38"},"17":{"text":"“Midih pa in upna tawh a nungta ding hi,” ci-in a kigiel bangin lungdamna thu sungah upna tawh Pasien’ dihna ang kilang hi.","ref":"Hab 2:4"},"18":{"text":"Pasien um lote le migilote in a gitlona utawh thuman thutah a netcip ziehun vantung panin amate zosie tungah Pasien’ thangpaina ang kilang hi.","title":"Pasien Mai-ah Gentile-te’ Mawna"},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen amate tungah Pasien in lah zo ta ahi ziehin, a thei ding vua kilawm nate amate tungah cientahin a kilang hi."},"20":{"text":"Leitung a siemcil a kipan ama’ pienzie ahi a tawntung vanglietna le Pasien ahina thute a kimu thei lo vangin a piensah nate panin kitheitelin kimu zo ta ahi ziehin amate in paulap ding a nei sih uhi;"},"21":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile amate in Pasien thei sam napi ahina za-in Pasien a zatah sih vua, ama tungah nuomthu zong tut loin a lungsim vuah thu ginalo vive ngaisunin a mot lungsim uh a miel keikui hi.","ref":"Eph 4:17-18"},"22":{"text":"Pil a kisah vangun mimaw ahi bo uhi;"},"23":{"text":"amate in a si thei mihing, vate, keng li nei ganhingte, le a bawhva ganhingte tawh a kisun limte po tawh a si thei lo Pasien’ vanglietna a khel uhi.","ref":"Thkna 4:16-18"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a pumpi uh amate ma in a sietsah thei nadingun, Pasien in a lunggulna uh zui-in pahtatna sungah amate a pie dawh ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in zuouthu tawh Pasien’ thuman thutah a khel vua, kumtawna kipatawi ding ahi Siempupa sangin ama’ siemsate bie-in a na uh a sem zawsop uhi! Amen."},"26":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin Pasien in amate zumhuoi huasanna sungah a pie dawh ta hi. A numeite un ngaina banga pasal tawh optonna pen ngaina ahi lo tawh a khel vua,"},"27":{"text":"tua ma bangin pasalte in zong a ngaina banga numeite tawh a optonnate uh nuasie-in pasal le pasal po a kilunggul vangut uhi. Zum mel nei loin pasal le pasal a omton vua, tuaci’n amate in a khielna utawh kituohin dan a thuoh ciet uhi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien a thei nop lo ziehun a kilawm lo-a gamta dingin Pasien in amate lungsim hoi lo a guon hi."},"29":{"text":"Gitlona namcin, sietna, duhopna, mudana, ki-enna, tuolthana, kihauna, kisolna, mi gensietna tawh a kidim vua,"},"30":{"text":"mi daisahte, Pasien mudate, a kihisahte, a kigolsahte, a kisielte, thusie suite, le nu le pa thu manglote,"},"31":{"text":"mi mawlawmte, upna nei lote, itna nei lote, hepina nei lote ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in tua banga gamtate a si dinga kilawm ahi hi, ci-in Pasien’ thukhenna thei napi, tua banga a gamtat paupau ban vuah tua banga a gamtate nangawn a thukimpi lai vaset uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin midangte tunga thukhen note pen koikoi na hi zongun hamlap ding na nei sih uhi; bangzieh ahei cile midangte tunga thu na khen uh ciengin noma zong tua bang lien ma-a gamta veve na hi ziehun no le no kimawsah na hi uhi.","title":"A dih Pasien’ Thukhenna","ref":"Mat 7:1; Luk 6:37"},"2":{"text":"Note in, “Tua banga a gamta mite tungah Pasien’ thukhenna pen thuman thutah tawh kituoh ahi hi, ci i thei uhi,” na ci uhi."},"3":{"text":"Koikoi hi nan locin tua banga gamtate tungah thu khen napi, no zong tua bang ma-a na gamtat veve uh ciengin Pasien’ thukhenna panin a suohta dingin na kingaisun uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Ahi sihle a kicing ama’ migitna, a thuohhatna le a lungduoinate simmaw na hi uh amah? Pasien’ migitna in kisiakiana lamah note ang pui ahi lam thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin lungtang khau-in na kisia nop lo ziehun Pasien’ lungthahna le a thukhenna dihtah ang kilah ni hun ciengin na thuoh ding uh ahi lungthahna a kholkhol na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile ama in mi zosie tungah amau’ gamtatna tawh kituohin a thuhkia ding hi:","ref":"Late 62:12; Pau 24:12"},"7":{"text":"A hoi gamtatna le lungduoina tawh minthanna, patawina le si thei lona a sui mite tungah kumtawn hinna a pie ding hi;"},"8":{"text":"ama’ ang sung beh khuolin thuman thutah zui loin gitlona a zuite tungah a lungthahna le a lunghamna a tung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Sietna a bawl mi zosie tungah lungkhamna le gimna tung ding a, a masa-in Jew mite tungah tungin Greek-te tungah zong tung ding hi,"},"10":{"text":"ahi vangin a hoi a bawl mi zosie tungah vanglietna, patawina, le nopsahna tungin a masa-in Jew mite tungah tungin Greek-te tungah zong tung ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien in angvan tuom a nei sih hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"12":{"text":"Thukham lo tawh a maw mite pen thukham lo ma tawh kisie ding a, thukham khut nei-a a maw mite zosie pen thukham ma in thu a khen ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien muna-ah thukham a zate a dih hi loin, thukham a zuite beh a dih hizaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Thukham nei lo Gentile-te in a pienpi uh lungsim bangin thukham in a kalh thute a sep uh ciengin amate in thukham a nei sih vangun, amate adingin tua thute thukham suoh veve hi."},"15":{"text":"A lungsim sung vuah thukham in a kalh thute kigiel hi, ci-in amate in a lah vua, amau’ kitheina lungsim in zong teci a pang hi. A kitukal a lungsimte un amate mawsah zelin maisah zel a,"},"16":{"text":"keima’ lungdamna thu dung zui-in Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasien in mi zosie’ phuolsel ngaisutnate a khen ni ciengin tam bangin a khen ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin nangma le nangma Jew mi khat ka hi hi, kici-in thukham tungah na kingah a, Pasien tawh na kizopna na kisielpi leh,","title":"Judah Mite le Thukham"},"18":{"text":"thukham na sinna ziehin ama’ deina thei-in a hoi pente a khen thei pa na hi a,"},"19":{"text":"mittawte lamlah pa, khuomiel sunga om mite adinga khuovah,"},"20":{"text":"mimawte thu a hil pa, naupangte’ siepa, thukham zieha pilna le thuman thutah nei na hi tahtah leh,"},"21":{"text":"nang, midangte a hilpa, nangma le nangma kihil phot lo ding na mah? Guhtat lo ding a genpa, nangma in zong gu hi lo na mah?"},"22":{"text":"Angkawm sih un a ci pa, nangma in angkawm hi lo na mah? Milim a kidahpa, nangma in milim biehinnpi bulu hi lo na mah?"},"23":{"text":"Thukham a kisielpi pa, nangma in thukham palsatna tawh Pasien’ min daisah hi lo na mah?"},"24":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile, “Note ziehin Gentile-te lahah Pasien’ min kigensie hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Isa 52:5"},"25":{"text":"Thukham na zui uleh tep tanna in phattuomna nei a, hinanle thukham na palsat uleh na tep tanna uh teptan lo ma a suoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n teptan lote in thukham in a kalh thute a zui uleh a teptan lo uh pen teptan ma bangin kisimpieh lo ding amah?"},"27":{"text":"Tuaci’n tahsa tep tan sih nan ule thukham a zuite in, tep kitanin a kigiel thukhamte nei napi tua thukhamte a palsat note tungah thu hing khen ding uh hi lo amah?"},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi khat pen a putham beh tawh Judah mi ahi sih a, tep tanna tahtah i ci zong tahsa le a putham beh ahi sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Judah mi i cite pen a sung lama Judah mi ahite hizaw a, teptan tahtah i ci zong lai-a kigiel thukham zieh hi loin, hlagau lam tawh kisai-a lungsim teptanna ahi hi. Tua bang mi in midangte tung pan hi loin Pasien tung panin phatna a nga hi.","ref":"Thkna 30:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile Jew mite in bang hamphatna nei ahi uh ahei? Tua ahi sihle teptan a manphatna bang ahei?"},"2":{"text":"Lam tampi-ah phattuomna a om hi. Azieh pen a masa penin Pasien’ thuphuonte gen dingin Jew mite kingansie hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte muonhuoi sih leh bang a ci ta diei? Amau’ uplona in Pasien’ citahna maimangsah ding amah?"},"4":{"text":"Maimangsah vawt lo ding hi! “Na thukhenna-a na zawna ding le ka kammal ah dihna na tan nading ahi hi, ci-in a kigiel bangin, mi zosie in zuouthu gen nan ule, Pasien’ thumanna kilang taheh.","ref":"Late 51:4"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite’ dih lona in Pasien’ dihna a lah leh eite in bang i gen ta ding vuoi? Eite tungah a lungthahna ang tunsah ziehin Pasien a thuman lo ahi ta amah? (Mihingte gen banga ka gen ahi hi)"},"6":{"text":"Hi vawt lo hi! Tua bang hi mawh leh Pasien in leitung mite tungah thu bangci khen thei ding ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima’ zuouna ziehin Pasien’ thumanna in a minthanna khangsah ahile, bang dingin mawnei khat bangin kei thu ei khen lai ding ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Tuale (pawlkhat in i ham ding uh bawltawmin eite ei daisah bangin) bang dingin, “A pha a pien nadingin a sie bawl vai,” ci lel lo i hi uh ahei?” a ci uhi. Amau’ dan thuoh pen a thuoh tah ma ahi bo hi!"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahile bang himawh ahei! Eite i hoizaw tuom uh amah? I hoizaw tuom vawt sih uhi; azieh pen Jew mite le Greek-te a ni tuohin mawna’ vanglietna nei-ah a om uhi, ci-in kang gen zo hi.","title":"Midih Koima Om lo"},"10":{"text":"A kigielsa bangin: “Midih koima a om sih a, khat zong a om sih hi;"},"11":{"text":"a thei khat zong a om sih a, Pasien a sui khat zong a om sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi zosie lam a piel sieng vua, kimanna nei lo a suohton ta uhi; a hoi-a gamta koima a om sih a, khat nangawn a om sih hi,”","ref":"Late 14:1-3; 53:1-3"},"13":{"text":"“A lawl uh hankhuh kihong bang a, zuou genna-in a leii a zang uhi.; “A nephu nei vuah gulgu a om hi.”","ref":"Late 5:9; 140:3"},"14":{"text":"“A kam uh pen hamsiet le kamkha tawh a kidim hi.”","ref":"Late 10:7"},"15":{"text":"“Sisan a suo dingin a kal uh a naw suon vua,"},"16":{"text":"a lampite vuah sietna le lungzinna a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in nopna lampi a thei sih uhi.”","ref":"Isa 59:7-8"},"18":{"text":"“A mittang vuah Pasien zatahna om lo hi,” kici hi.","ref":"Late 36:1"},"19":{"text":"Kam kici zosie a kihum thei nading le leitung mi vannuoi in Pasien mai-ah sittelna a thuoh thei nadingin, thukham in a gen popo pen thukham nei-a om mite kunga a gen ahi lam tu-in eite in i thei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Thukham tungtawnin mawna a op lam a kithei ziehin, thukham banga gamtatna ziehin mihingte koima in ama mai-ah dih a tang sih ding uhi.","ref":"Late 143:2; Gal 2:16"},"21":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in ahile thukham loin Pasien’ dihna kilang zo ta a, thukham le kamsangte in tam thu-ah teci a pang uhi.","title":"Upna Zieha Dihtanna"},"22":{"text":"Tua khu a um mi vannuoi adingin Jesu Khris upna tungtawna a kipie Pasien’ dihna ahi hi. Tua ahi zieh in kilamdanna a om sih hi.","ref":"Gal 2:16"},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie maw uh ahi ziehin Pasien’ minthanna a tang zo ta sih uhi;"},"24":{"text":"Jesu Khris sunga a om tatkhietna ziehin letsong ahi Pasien’ hepina tawh tu-in amate dih kitangsah zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Upna ziehin ama’ sisan tawh thoidamna biehpiehna-a kipie dingin Pasien in ama a koi ta hi. Tami khu ama’ dihna a lahna ahi hi, azieh pen Pasien in ama’ lungduoina sungah a tawpsa huna mawnate a ciemte nawn sih hi;"},"26":{"text":"tu hunin amama zong dih a, tua in Jesu a um mite dih a tansahna thu a lah nading ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahile i kisielpi ding uh bang om ahei? Tua khu a kipuse zo ta hi. Bang thukham zieha kipuse ahiei? Zui ding thukham amah? Hi lo hi, upna thukham zieh ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi khat thukham zuina zieh hi loin upna ziehin dih kitangsah zo hi, ci-in eite in i pom uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi sihle Pasien pen Jew mite’ Pasien beh amah? Gentile-te’ Pasien zong ahi sih amah? Hima hi, Gentile-te’ Pasien zong ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Pasien khat beh ahi hi; tua Pasien in a upna ziehun Jew mite dih a tansah bangin, ama in a tep kitan lote zong tua upna tungtawn ma-in dih a tangsah ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:4; Gal 3:20"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahile tami upna thu hang tawh eite in thukham i paimang ta uh amah? Tua bang hi vawt lo hi! Tuale mahin thukham a kipsah zaw i hi uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile i pu uh Abraham in tahsa lam tawh a na nga phattuomna khu eite in bang i gen ding vuoi?","title":"Abraham Tawh Gentena"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen gamtatna zieha Abraham dih kitangsah ahile ama in kisah thei nading thu pawlkhat nei hi, hinanle tua pen Pasien mai-ah ahi sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Lai Siengtho in bang a gen ei? “Abraham in Pasien um a, tua pen ama tungah dihna-in kisimpieh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pien 15:6; Gal 3:6"},"4":{"text":"Nasem mi khat tunga a kipie a thaman pen letsongin kisimpieh loin sep thaman kici zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat in na a sep lo vangin ama in migilote dih tangsah pa a muon leh, tua bang upna pen dihna-in kisimpieh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ma bangin sepna kihal lo, Pasien in midih hi, ci-a a sim mite’ hamphatna thu David in zong tam bangin gen hi:"},"7":{"text":"“A tatkhielnate uh kimaisah a, a mawnate uh a kisinpieh mite mi hampha ahi uhi;"},"8":{"text":"Topa in ama’ mawna a ciepte lo pa mi hampha ahi hi,” a ci hi .","ref":"Late 32:1-2"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahile tami hamphatna pen teptan mite tung beha kipie amah? Ahi sihle teptan lo mite tunga zong kipie ahei? Eite in, “Abraham upna pen dihna-in kisimpieh hi,” i ci uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahile tua pen bang hun pana kisimpieh ahei? A teptan masang amah? Ahi sihle a teptan zaw ahei? A teptan zaw hi loin a teptan masang hizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Teptan ahi nai lo lai-in upna zieha a na neisa dihtanna ciemtena dinga ama in tua teptanna lim a na nga hizaw hi. A deina in ama pen a tep kitan lo thu um mi zosie le a upna uh dihna-a a kisimpieh mi zosie’ pupi a suo thei nading ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 17:10"},"12":{"text":"Tua ma bangin ama pen a tep kitante’ pupi beh hi loin, tep a kitan masanga i pa uh Abraham in a na nei a ettehuoi upna thu a zui mite adingin zong pupi a suo nading ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in leitung luo dingin Abraham le a suonlehlahte tungah a kamciem pen thukham zuina zieh ahi sih a, upna zieha dihtatna tawh hizaw hi.","title":"Upna Tawh Thuciemna Tangtung","ref":"Pien 17:4-6; 22:17-18; Gal 3:29"},"14":{"text":"Thukham zuite beh gouluo ding hi poma leh upna pen bangma lo ahi ta ding a, thuciemna zong a mawhna a suoh ta ding hi.","ref":"Gal 3:18"},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thukham in Pasien’ lungthahna piengsah hi; ahi vangin thukham a op lona munah tatkhielna zong om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin tua kamciem pen hepina tunga kinga ahi thei nading le ama’ suonlehlahte zosie tungah thukip ahi thei nadingin, thukham zuite beh in nga loin Abraham’ upna banga a um mite in zong a nga thei nadingin upna bulphu-a kipie ahi hi. (Bangzieh ahei cile Abraham pen eite zosie’ pa ahi a,","ref":"Gal 3:7"},"17":{"text":"“Minam tampite’ pa dingin kang bawl zo hi,” ci-in a kigiel ma bangin), ama in misite hingsahin a om nai lote a omsah pa ahi a up pa Pasien muna-ah eite zosie’ pa a suoh hi.","ref":"Pien 17:5"},"18":{"text":"Ama kungah, “Na suon na hlahte tam bangin tam ding hi,” ci-a a kigen ma bangin, “Minam zosie’ pa,” ahi thei nading lametna om lopi-in ama in a muong kenkon hi.","ref":"Pien 15:5"},"19":{"text":"Ama’ pumpi a si zo tawh a kibahna thu le (azieh pen ama kum zakhat bang pha ta hi) Sarah’ nau nei thei lona thute a ngaisut ciengin upna lamah a tha a kiem tuon sih hi.","ref":"Pien 17:17"},"20":{"text":"Pasien’ kamciemna tungtang thu-a muonlana in ama a hawisah zo sih a, a upna sungah thakhau semsemin Pasien’ min thangsah a,"},"21":{"text":"Pasien in a kamciem ang tangtun zo tahtah ding hi, ci-in a um lenlon hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a upna pen, “Ama adingin dihna-in kisimpieh hi,” ci-in kigiel hi."},"23":{"text":"Tu-in, “Ama adingin kisimpieh hi,” ci-a kigiel kammalte ama ading beha kigiel ahi sih a,"},"24":{"text":"eite ading zong ahi hi. Misite lah panin i Topa Jesu a thosah pa a um eite tungah tua upna pen dihna-a ei kisimpieh ding ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Eite’ khielna ziehin a si dingin ama kipie a, eite’ dihtan nadingin ama kithosah zo hi.","ref":"Isa 53:4-5"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin upna ziehin dih tang zo i hi ziehin, eite in Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasien tawh kilemna i nei ta uhi.","title":"Dihtanna Zieha Kingate"},"2":{"text":"Ama tungtawnin i opna uh tami hepina sungah eite in lut theina thu i nga zo ta uhi; tuale eite in Pasien tawh minthanna a ngaton dingin i kinep ziehun i kipah uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua tham loin i thuoh gimnate vuah zong eite i kipah veve vua, tua gimnate in thuoh zawhna piengsahin,"},"4":{"text":"thuoh zawhna in gamtat hoi piengsah a, gamtat hoi in lametna piengsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua lametna in eite ei lungkiesah lo hi, bangzieh ahei cile eite tunga ei kipie Hlagau Siengtho tungtawnin eite’ lungsim sungah Pasien’ itna ang kibuosuh zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Eite thanem-a i op laitah a kilawm hunin Pasien thei lote adingin Khris ang si hi."},"7":{"text":"A tahtahin ci leih mi hoi khat adingin a si ngam mi om kha phiel nanle midih khat adingin a si ngam mi kikhat ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin mawnei mi i hi laitahin eite adingin Khris ang sina ziehin Pasien in eite ei itna thu ei lah zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin tu-in ama’ sisan ziehin dihtansah i hi ngalun, ama tungtawnin Pasien’ lungthahna panin hutdamin i omzaw kan lai ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen galte i hi lai bawnun ama Tapa’ sina tungtawnin Pasien tawh na kilem thei sam i hi uleh, i kilem zaw ciengin ama’ hinna ziehin hutdamin i om zaw kan lai ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua teng beh ahi khop sih a, tu-in ama tungtawna kilemna i ngana uh ahi i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasien tung nangawnah i kisiel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mi khat vangin leitungah mawna tung a, mawna ziehin sina a tung hi. Tuale mi zosie maw zo ta ahi ziehin mikim tungah sina a kizel hi.","title":"Adam le Khris","ref":"Pien 3:6"},"13":{"text":"Thukham a op masang lai pehin leitungah mawna a om zo ta bo a, ahi vangin thukham a op lo lai-in mawna pen mawna-in na kisim lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle Adam huna kipanin Moses hun dongin Adam’ palsatna bang ma-in a khiel lote tung nangawnah zong sina in a uh hi. Tua Adam pen ang pei ding pa’ lim ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite ei kihlawnpieh letsong pen thupalsatna tawh kibang lo hi. Bangzieh ahei cile mi khat’ thupalsatna ziehin mi tampi in silaw uh ahile, Pasien’ hepina le mi khat ahi Jesu Khris’ hepina sunga ei kihlawnpieh letsong pen mi tampi adingin kicing tahtah zawkan lai hi."},"16":{"text":"A kihlawnpieh letsong le mi khat’ mawna zieha a pieng thu kibang lo hi. Bangzieh ahei cile thupalsatna khat ziehin thukhenna in mawsahna tun a, ahi vangin thupalsatna tampite ziehin ei kihlawnpieh letsong in dihtanna tun hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khat’ thupalsatna ziehin sina in tua mi khat tungtawnin ei uh ahile, a kicing hepina le a kihlawnpieh dihna letsong a sangte in mi khat ahi Jesu Khris tungtawnin a nuntahna sung vuah uh zawkan lai ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin mi khat’ thupalsatna in mi zosie adingin mawsah thukhenna a tut bangin, mi khat’ a dih gamtatna in zong mi zosie adingin dihtanna le hinna thu tun hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khat’ thuman lona in mi tampitah mawnei a suosah bang lienin mi khat’ thumanna in mi tampite midih a suohsah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin thupalsatna a tam semsem nadingin thukham ang pei hi; ahi vangin mawna khanna munah hepina khangzaw sem hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua khu sina sungah mawna in a uh bang lien ma-in i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin kumtawn hinna a tunpi dingin hepina in dihna tungtawnin a uh thei nading ahi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile bang i gen ding vuoi? Hepina a khan thei nadingin mawna bawlbawl ding i hi uh amah?","title":"Sina le Jesu tawh Thawna"},"2":{"text":"Bawlbawl buong lo e! Mawna thu-a a sisa eite in bangci bangin tua mawna sungah hing thei lai ding i hi uh ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Khris Jesu sungah a ki-baptize sa eite zosie pen ama’ sina sungah zong a ki-baptize sa i hi lamtah thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin sina-ah i ki-baptize ziehin ama tawh a kivuiton i hi vua, tuaci’n Pa’ vanglietna tawh misite lah panin Khris ang thawkia ma bangin eite zong hinna tha-ah i hin thei nading uh ahi hi.","ref":"Col 2:12"},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen a sina sungah ama tawh pum khat i suo leh, a thawkiana sungah zong ama tawh pum khat i suoh tahtah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Eite in mawna pumpi kisusie-in mawna sungah sal tanga i op nawn lo nadingin Khris tawh singlamte tungah i milui uh kikhailia zo hi, ci thu i thei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a sisa mi khat popo pen mawna pana a suohta zo ahi ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Jesu tawh i siton zo uleh ama tawh zong i hington ding hi, ci thu i um uhi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile misite lah pana a thokia Khris pen si ngai nawn lo ding hi, ci thu i thei hi; sina in zong ama tungah thu a nei thei nawn sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama’ thuoh sina pen mawna thu-ah a kimang den ding khatvei sina hi a, ahi vangin ama’ hinna pen Pasien adinga hing ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n noma mama zong mawna lamah si-in Pasien lamah Jesu Khris ziehin a hinga na kingaisut ding uh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a si thei na pumpi sung vuah na tahsa uh’ deina ang zuisah thei ahi mawna in thu neisah sih un."},"13":{"text":"Na pumpi nate uh gitlona vanzah dingin mawna-ah na pie nawn sih unlen, sina pan tho-in hinna a ngasa mite bangin dihna vanzah dingin Pasien tungah na pumpi uh’ nate na piezaw un."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thukham nei-ah na om nawn sih vua, hepina nei-ah om zo ta na hi ziehun note tungah mawna in thu a nei nawn sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahile bang himawh ahei? Thukham nei-ah om nawn loin hepina nei-ah om ta i hi ziehin eite in mawna i bawl nading vuoi mah? Bawl nawn buong lo e!","title":"Dihna’ Silate"},"16":{"text":"Sila thumangte bangin mi khatpo kungah noma mama na kipieh uleh tua a thu na man pa uh’ sila na hi pai ta vua, sina ang tut mawna sila ahi a, dihna ang tut thumanna sila ahi zongin, khat zawzaw’ sila na hi lam thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin nidang lai-in mawna sila ahi ngai note in lungsim tahpi tawh na tung vua ang ki-apsa thuhilnate na man zo tah ziehun Pasien kungah nuom thu i tut uhi."},"18":{"text":"Note pen mawna panin suohta-in dihna’ sila na hi ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na tahsa hindan uh a zawngkhal ziehin mihing’ ham banga kang gen ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile nidang lai-in siengtho lona le gitlona a bawl semsem dingin na pumpi nate na pieh bang lien ma-un, tuaci’n tu-in a siengtho hinkhuo adingin dihtanna lamah sal bangin na pumpi nate na pie un."},"20":{"text":"Mawna’ sila na hi lai-un dihna tawh kisai thu-ah a suohta na hi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahile tulai taha na zumpi uh nate panin bang phattuomna nga na hi uh ahei? Tua nate’ tawpna lampi khu sina ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in ahile mawna panin suohta-in Pasien’ sila na hi ta uhi. Note in na nga uh phattuomna in sienthona hi a, lam tawpna khu kumtawn hinna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen mawna’ thaman in sina hi a, ahi vangin Pasien ei’ hlawnpieh letsong ahile Topa Jesu Khris sunga a om kumtawn hinna ahi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, a hin sung teng beh thukham in mi khat tungah thu nei hi, ci na thei sih uh amah? Azieh pen thukham theite tunga thu gen ka hi hi.","title":"Kinunna Tawh Tekahna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin pasal nei numei khat, a pasal a hin laisie thukham in a pasal tawh a khitha hi; ahi vangin a pasal a si leh tua numei pen a pasal tawh kisai thukham panin a suohta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ma bangin a pasal hin sungin pasal dang a kinunpi leh ama pen angkawmnu kici ding hi. Ahi vangin a pasal a si leh tua thukham panin ama a suohta ahi a, midang khat a kinunpi leh zong ama pen angkawmnu ahi sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ma bangin ka lawmte aw, Pasien ading ga na ga thei nading ule midang kici misite lah pana kithosah pa-a’ na hi thei nadingun, Khris pumpi ziehin thukham lamah a si na hi ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Cilesa sungah i nuntah lai-un thukham in mawna bawlnopna lungsim thosah a, i pumpi nate sungah si nading ga i ga nadingin na a sem hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in a kigiel thukham lui khut nei-ah om loin Hlagau hinkhuo tha sungah i hin thei nadingin ei hencip thukham thu-ah i si zo ta vua, tua panin i suohta ta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahile bang gen ding i hei? Thukham khu mawna ahi amah? Hi laizang lo e! Ahi vangin thukham na om lo hi leh mawna kici a thei kha ding ka hi sih hi. Thukham in, “Na deigaw sih ding hi,” na ci lo hi leh deigawna bang ahei ci zong ka thei kha sih ding hi.","title":"I Sunga Om Mawna","ref":"Pei 20:17; Thkna 5:21"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin mawna in thupieh sungah hun lem sui-in ka sungah deigawna namcin a piengsah hi. Thukham om loin mawna pen a si ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in thukham om loin ka na hing a, ahi vangin thupieh ang tun ciengin mawna hing kia-in,"},"10":{"text":"kei ka si a, hinna ding ei kamciem tua thupieh tehteh pen ma kei adingin sina ang lehi zaw ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen thupieh sungah mawna in hun lemtang sui-in ei sol a, tua tawh ei that hi.","ref":"Pien 3:13"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n thukham pen a siengtho hi a, thupieh zong siengtho-in dihin hoi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahile sil hoite in kei tungah sina ang tun ahi amah? Tua bang hi laizang lo e! Mawna pen mawna tahtah ahi lam a kilah nadingin sil hoi tungtawnin mawna in keima sungah sina na a sem ahi hi. Thupieh tungtawnin mawna pen tezawh lo a siehuoi mama ahina thu kilang hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thukham pen hlagau lam thu ahi, ci i thei hi; ahi vangin kei ka hile cilesa tawh om mi ka hi a, mawna sungah sila banga ei kizua ka hi hi.","title":"Sungtawng lam Buoina"},"15":{"text":"Ka gamtatna mama zong ka thei sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile ka bawl nop teng ka bawl sih a, ka huot teng ka lebawl zawsop hi.","ref":"Gal 5:17"},"16":{"text":"Tu-in ka bawl nop lo teng ma bawl veve ka hi leh kei pen thukham hoi hi, ci-a a thukimpi ka hi mawh ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua bang a bawl tahtah pen kei ka hi nawn sih a, ka sunga a teng mawna ahi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen ka tahsa pumpi sungah sil hoi khat beh a ten lo lam ka thei hi. A pha bawl ding ka lunggul vangin ka bawl thei vawt sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen ka bawl nuom sil hoi ka bawl sih a, ka bawl nuom lo gitlona ka lebawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in ka bawl nuom lo pen bawl ka hi leh a bawl pen kei ka hi nawn sih a, ka sunga a teng mawna’ bawl ahi zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n sil hoi ka bawl nop ciengin ka kungah sietna ang om hi, ci thu khat ka mukhie hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka sunglam mi in Pasien’ thukham sungah nuom sa a,"},"23":{"text":"ahi vangin ka pumpi nate sunga om thukham dang khat le ka lungsim thukham kido a, tua in ka pumpi nate sunga a teng mawna thukham sungah sala ei mat lam ka mu hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi genthei lah ka hi mawh in! Tami sina pumpi panin koi in ei hunkhie ding ahei?"},"25":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris ziehin Pasien tungah lungdam ka ko hi! Tuaci’n ka lungsim tawh Pasien thukham’ sila ka hi a, ahi vangin ka tahsa tawh mawna thukham’ sila ka hi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Khris Jesu sunga a omte adingin tu-in mawsah thukhenna a om nawn sih hi.","title":"Hlagau Sunga Hinna"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen Jesu Khris sunga om hinna Hlagau’ thukham in mawna le sina thukham panin note ang suohtasah zo ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Cilesa zieha a thanem thukham in a bawl zawh lote, Pasien in a bawl zo hi; ama in mawna thoidam nadingin mawna kidim cilesa mel a puo ama’ Tapa ang sawlna tawh cilesa sunga om mawna tungah thu a khen hi."},"4":{"text":"Tami in cilesa deina bang hi loin Hlagau’ deina banga a kalsuon eite sungah thukham in a kalh dihna thu a tangtun nading ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile cilesa deina banga a nungtate in a lungsim vuah cilesa tawh kisai thute a lunggul vua, ahi vangin Hlagau deina banga a nungtate in Hlagau tawh kisai thute ma a lunggul uhi."},"6":{"text":"Cilesa tawh kisai thute lunggulna in sina hi a, Hlagau tawh kisai thute lunggulna in hinna le lungmuonna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin cilesa tawh kisai lunggulna pen Pasien gal bawlna ahi a, tua in Pasien’ thukham a zui sih a, zong a zui thei mawng sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Cilesa sunga a om mite in Pasien a lungdamsah thei sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin na sung vuah Pasien’ Hlagau ang ten ziehin note pen cilesa sunga om na hi sih vua, Hlagau sunga om na hi uhi. Khris’ Hlagau a nei lo poma Khris-a’ ahi sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin na sung vuah Khris a op leh mawna ziehin na pumpite uh a si vangin dihna ziehin na Hlagau uh a hing hi."},"11":{"text":"Na sung vuah misite lah panin Jesu a thosah ama’ Hlagau ang ten leh misite lah panin Khris a thosah pa ahi ama in na sung vua a teng ama’ Hlagau tungtawnin a si thei na pumpite uzong hinna ang pie ding hi.","ref":"1Cor 3:16"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin sanggamte aw, eite pen cilesa deina zui dinga cilesa tunga leibate i hi sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen cilesa deina banga na hin uleh na si ding vua, ahi vangin Hlagau ziehin pumpi gamtatnate na thalia uleh na hing ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ Hlagau in a pui mite zosie Pasien’ tate ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen note in zauna sunga puakia nading sila hina hlagau na nga sih vua, tapa hina hlagau a nga zo na hizaw uhi. “Abba! Pa!” ci-a i kiko ciengin,","ref":"Mrk 14:36; Gal 4:6"},"16":{"text":"Pasien’ tate i hi, ci thu tua Hlagau ma in eite’ hlagau tawh teci a pangton hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n tate i hi uleh gouluote, Pasien’ gouluote le Khris tawh gouluo tonte i hi vua, Khris tawh i thuohton tahpi uleh eite zong ama tawh i minthangton ding uhi.","ref":"Gal 4:5-7"},"18":{"text":"Tuhun taha i thuoh gimnate pen khatvei ciengin eite tunga minthanna ang kilang ding pen tawh tekah tah ka sa vet sih hi.","title":"Mailam Hun Minthanna"},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kisiem nate in lawptahin Pasien’ tate kilah ding kal a ngahla mama uhi;"},"20":{"text":"azieh pen a kisiem nate kimanna nei lo suoh a, tua pen amau’ nop thu hi loin lametna sungah kimanna a nei lo a suohsah pa’ deina banga pieng ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Pien 3:17-19"},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a kisiem nate mama zong a muot dinga a kihenna panin kihlakhie-in a vanglien Pasien tate’ suohtatna a nga ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuhun dongin a kisiem na vannuoi nausuoh takei natna vei bangin tau-in a om uhi, ci i thei hi."},"23":{"text":"A kisiem nate beh ahi sih a, Hlagau’ ga masate a nei eite mama in zong tate ei suohsah ding ahi i pumpite uh tatkhietna ni ngah kawmin i sungtawng vuah khuisa-in i tau vangut uhi.","ref":"2Cor 5:2-4"},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen lametna sungah hutdamin i om zo ta uhi. Tu-in i musate i lametna pen lametna hi lo hi. Bang ding ahei cile koi in a musate lamen na lai ding ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite in i mu nai lote i lamet ciengin lungduoi tahin i ngah ngetngut uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ma bangin i thanemna ah Hlagau in eite ei panpi hi; azieh pen eite in nget dinga kilawmte i ngen thei sih vua, ahi vangin tua Hlagau mama in kamtenga gen thei lo tauna tawh eite adingin ei thumpieh hi."},"27":{"text":"Lungsim a sui Pasien in tua Hlagau’ lungsim a thei hi, bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ deina dung zui-in Hlagau in misiengthote adingin a thumpieh hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien a it mite, ama’ ngimna dung zui-a a hlatsa mite adingin sil bangkim in a hoi lamin a seppieh hi, ci thu i thei hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasien’ Tapa pen a kunta mama innkuon sungah tacil ahi thei nadingin ama in a theikholsa mite, a Tapa’ lim sun dinga a laitansa ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in tua banga a laitansate hlanin a hlatsate dih tangsah pai a, dih a tansahsate zong a min a thangsah hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahile tam thu tungtang ah bang i gen ding vuoi? Eite lamah Pasien a pan po leh eite lang khatah koi pang zo ding ahei?","title":"Jesu Khris Sunga Pasien’ Itna"},"32":{"text":"A Tapa khat neisun sit loin eite zosie adinga ei piekhie Pasien in adang na vannuoi zong a Tapa tawh ei pieton loin a om ding amah?"},"33":{"text":"Pasien’ teelsa mite koi in mawsah ding ahei? Dih ei tangsah pa pen Pasien ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Mawsah thukhen ding koi pen ahiei? Sina a thuoh beh tham loin sina panin thokia a, Pasien’ zietlamah a om, eite adinga thu ei ngetpieh pa khu Khris Jesu ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Koi in Khris’ itna panin ei khen zo ding ahei? Hamsatna, lungmanna, bawlsietna, gilkielna, zawnna, zauhuoina, le namsaute in ei khen zo ding amah?"},"36":{"text":"Lai Siengtho sungah, “Nangma ziehin sunthapai-in thana ka thuoh uhi; a kigo ding tuu bangin ei kisim hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Late 44:22"},"37":{"text":"Bangma in ei khen zo vawt sih ding a, eite ei it ama ziehin bangkimah guolzo pente i hi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Azieh pen sina ahi a, hinna ahi zongin, vantung mite ahi a, thuneite ahi zongin, tuhun nate ahi a, ang tung ding nate ahi zongin, vanglietna neite ahi a,"},"39":{"text":"a sangna ahi a, a thuhna ahi zongin, adang a kisiem na vannuoi lahah na khat beh in i Topa Jesu Khris sunga Pasien’ ei itna tawh ei khen zo vawt lo ding hi, ci thu ka theitel hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khris sungah thutah ka gen a, ka zuou ahi sih hi; kei le kei ka kitheina lungsim in tua khu Hlagau Siengtho tawh a kipsah a,","title":"Pasien In Israel-te a Teelna"},"2":{"text":"ka lungsim sungah dana lienpi le a tawp thei lo lunggimna ka nei hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile cilesa panin ka mipi ka unaute tangin Khris panin kei mama samsiet le pampai-in om mai leng ka nuom hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate pen Israel-te ahi vua, tapa hina, minthanna, thuciemna, thukham piehna, biehpiehna, le kamciemte zosie amau-a’ ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 9:4"},"5":{"text":"Tanglai pupite zong amau-a’ ma ahi a, cilesa lam panin cilei Messiah zong amate sung pana ang pieng ahi hi. Na zosie a uh Pasien phat zingin om taheh. Amen."},"6":{"text":"Tam bang ka ci ciengin Pasien’ kammal tangtung lo hi, a ci ka hi sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile Israel-te zosie zong Israel mi tahtah ahi kim sih a,"},"7":{"text":"Abraham’ tate zosie zong ama’ suonlehlah tahtah hi kim tuon lo hi; “Isaac tungtawnin na suonlehlahte a min kivaw ding hi,” kici zaw hi.","ref":"Pien 21:12"},"8":{"text":"Tami in Pasien’ tate i ci pen cilesa lam pana tate hi lo a, kamciem tawh a kipawl tate beh suonlehlah a kisim hizaw hi, a ci nuom ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen tua kamciem in, “Tuhun pawl ciengin kang kilekia ding a, Sarah in tapa khat nei ding hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Pien 18:10"},"10":{"text":"Tua teng beh zong ahi tham sih hi; Rebecca in a pasal ahi i pupi uh Isaac tawh nau ang paai ciengin ama tungah zong tua bang ma-in a pieng hi."},"11":{"text":"A suo masang nangawn ule a sie le a pha khatpo a bawl thei masangun (teelna tawh kisai Pasien’ lungtup a kizop suoh nadingin,"},"12":{"text":"sepna tawh hi loin ama’ hlatna tawh) Rebecca kungah, “A tazaw pa in a nauzaw pa’ na sem ding hi,” na kici zo hi.","ref":"Pien 25:23"},"13":{"text":"Tua ma bangin, “ Keima in Jacob ka it vangin Esau ka muda hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Mal 1:2-3"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahile bang i gen ta ding vuoi? Pasien a thutang lo ahi mawh ta diei? Tua bang hi buong lo e!"},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in Moses kungah, “Ka hepi nuomte ka hepi ding a, ka khuotuo nuomte ka khuotuo ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pei 33:19"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n tam thu pen mihingte’ deina le hanciemna zieh hi loin Pasien’ hepina zieh hizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen Lai Siengtho in Pharoah kungah, “Nangma sungah ka vanglietna ka lah thei nading le leitung zosie-ah ka min a kiphuongzah thei nading ngimna tawh nang kang lamto zo hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pei 9:16"},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in hepi dinga a teel mi poma hepi a, a lungkhau dinga a teel mi poma lungkhausah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahile, “Bang ziehin ama in mite mawsah lailai ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile koi in ama’ deina nang zo ding ahei?” na ci ding uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Lungthahna le Hepina"},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien tawh a kisel dingin nang mihing koi tahtah na hi ahei? A kibawl sil khat in a bawlpa kungah, “Bang dinga nei hici bawl ahei?” a ci ding amah?","ref":"Isa 29:16; 45:9"},"21":{"text":"Beelkheng pa in tungman lom khat panin a thupi zawdeu a zah ding le a thangzah dingin bawl theina thu nei hi lo amah?"},"22":{"text":"Pasien in a lungthahna lah nuomin ama’ vanglietna a kitheisah nuom ziehin, ama in a kisie dinga kibawlsa lungthahna beelte lungduoi tahin thuoh ngetngut ahile bang gen nawn ding i hi uh ahei?"},"23":{"text":"Ama’ minthan nadinga a bawl kholsa, a khuotuona a nga mite tungah ama in a kicing a minthanna a theisah nadingin,"},"24":{"text":"a hlatsate lah panin Jew mite beh hi loin Gentile-te lahah eite zong tua bangin ei hlan ahile bang gen nawn ding i hi ahei?"},"25":{"text":"Ama in Hosea sungah, “Ka mi hilote tungah, ‘ka mite’ na hi uhi, ka ci ding a, a ki-it lo nu zong ‘ka it mi’ ka ci ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"26":{"text":"Amate kungah, “Ka mite hi sih uteh,’ ci-a a kigenna mun ma-ah amate, ‘A nungta Pasien’ tate,’ kici ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.","ref":"Hos 1:10"},"27":{"text":"Israel tawh kisai-in Isaiah in a tangkona-ah, “Israel’ tate pen tuipi gei-a senel za-in a tam vangin, asangh teng beh in hutdamna nga ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa in leitungah mallang tah le kiptahin thu a khen ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 10:22-23"},"29":{"text":"Isaiah in tam thu a genkholna-ah, “Vanglien Topa in eite adingin a hinglaite ei nuasie lo hileh Sodom khuo mite i bang ding vua, Gomorrah khuo mite bangin ei kibawl ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 1:9"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahile eite in bang i gen ding vuoi? Dihna nga nading a hanciem lo ahi Gentile-te in a nga zo ta uhi, tua pen upna tungtawna a nga uh dihna ahi hi;","title":"Israel-te Uplona"},"31":{"text":"ahi vangin thukham bulphu-in dihna nga ding a hanciem Israel-te in thukham a zui zo kim sih uhi."},"32":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile amate in upna bulphu-in a hanciem sih vua, sepna bulphu-in a hanciem zieh uh ahi hi. Kipalpuana suongah amate a kipalpua ta uhi."},"33":{"text":"“En un, mite kipal nading suong, amate a puasah ding suongpi khat Zion ah ka koi a, ama a um mi poma kimaizumsah lo ding hi,” ci-in kigiel hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, amate dinga ka lunggulna le Pasien kunga ka thungetpiehna ahile amate hutdam-a a op thei nading uh ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Amate Pasien lamah a pawnthaw mama vua, hinanle theina dih a nei lo lamtah uh teci ka pang hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in Pasien kung pana ang pei dihna a thei lo zieh ule amau’ dihna a kip thei nading a sui ziehun Pasien’ dihna thu a mang sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen thukham a tawpna Khris ahi a, tua khu a um mi vannuoi in dihna a nga thei nading ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Thukham pana ang pei dihna tawh kisai-in Moses in, “Tam nate banga a gamta mi in tamte ziehin a hing ding hi,” ci-in a giel hi.","title":"Mi Vannuoi ading Hutdamna","ref":"Siem 18:5"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin upna pana ang pei dihna tawh kisai-in, “Na lungsim sungah, ‘Vantungah koi va kato ding ahei?’ ci sin.” (tua pen Khris lasuh ding ci na ahi hi)"},"7":{"text":"Ahi sihle, ‘Taw nei lo leihawm thuhpi sungah koi kumsuh ding ahei?’ zong ci sin,” a ci hi. (Tua pen misite lah panin Khris lato ding ci na ahi hi)."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua in bang gen ahei? Tua thu pen nang tawh a kinai a, na kam le na lungtang sungah a om hi,” a ci hi. (Tua pen ka gen uh upna thu ahi hi).","ref":"Thkna 30:12-14"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Jesu pen Topa ahi hi, ci-in na kam tawh pulahin, na lungtang sungah Pasien in misite lah panin ama thosah zo hi, ci-a na up leh hutdamna na nga ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khat in a lungtang tawh a up ziehin dihna nga a, a kam tawh a pulah ziehin hutdamna nga hi."},"11":{"text":"Lai Siengtho in, “Ama a um mi koima in maizumna thuoh lo ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Isa 28:16"},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Judah mi le Greek mi kikalah a kikhiehna a om sih hi. Tua Topa ma pen mi zosie’ Topa ahi a, ama’ min a lo mi zosie tungah phaltahin thupha a pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile, “ Topa’ min a lo mi zosie in hutdamna a nga ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joel 2:32"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a up lo pa uh kungah thu bangci nget thei ding uh ahei? Amate in a thu a zah ngai lo pa uh bangci up thei ding uh ahei? Thugen mi om sih leh amate in bang a ci zah thei ding uh ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Kisawl sih leh amate in bang a ci gen thei ding uh ahei? A kigielsa bangin, “Lungdamna thu a phuongzah mite’ keng bang za-in etlawm ahei!”","ref":"Isa 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Hizongle a unpi-un lungdamna thu a um kim sih uhi. Azieh pen Isaiah in, “ Topa aw, ka thugen uh koi in a um ahei?” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 53:1"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n zahna panin upna pieng a, Khris’ thu kihilna tungtawnin tua thu kiza hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a za sih uh amah? ci-in ka dong leh amate in a za zo tahtah ta uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile, “A aw un leitung zosie zel zo a, a kammalte un leimong dong ban zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 19:4"},"19":{"text":"Israel-te in a tel sih uh amah? ci-in ka dong hi. A masa penin Moses in, “Minam ahi lote a eng dingin kang bawl ding a, a mawlawm minamte ziehin kang lungthahsah ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:21"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciengin Isaiah in hangtahin, “Ei sui lote in kei ei mu zo vua, ei kan lote kungah keima ma ka kilah zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 65:1"},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Israel-te tawh kisai-in ama in, “Thu mang loin a letat mite adingin sunthapai-in ka ban ka zah hi,” ci-in a gen hi.","ref":"Isa 65:2"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile Pasien in a mite a nuol ta amah? ci-in ka dong hi. Nuol poma lo hi! Keima ma zong Israel mi ka hi a, Abraham’ suon, Benjamin minam ka hi hi.","title":"Israel-te Kinuolna Thutawpna Hilo","ref":"Phil 3:5"},"2":{"text":"Pasien in a thei kholsa mite a nuol ngai sih hi. Israel-te langkhatah Pasien kunga a thum Elijah thu, Lai Siengtho in bangci gen ci thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa aw, amate in na kamsangte thatin na maitamte zong a susie gawp uhi; kei ngentang ka om ta bo a, amate in kei nangawn zong ei tha sawm lai uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:10, 14"},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien in ama bangin a dawngkia ei? “Keima adingin Baal mai-ah a khupdin ngai lo mi tul sagi ka koi zo hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:18"},"5":{"text":"Tua ma bangin tuhunin zong hepina tawh a kiteel mi themkhat om lai hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua teelna pen hepina zieh ahile, sepna bulphu-a teelna ahi nawn sih hi, tua bang hi sihle hepina pen hepina hi nawn lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ahi ta diei? Israel-te in a suisui pen a nga sih uhi. A teeltuom mite in nga a, ahi vangin adangte ahile a lung uh khau a,"},"8":{"text":"a kigiel ma bangin, “Pasien in tuni dongin amate thadana lungsim, khuo a mu thei lo mittang le, khuo a za thei lo bilte a pie hi,” kici hi.","ref":"Thkna 29:4; Isa 29:10"},"9":{"text":"David in zong, “A sabuoite uh thang le piel suoh hinlen, amate adingin puana le thuhkiana suoh taheh;"},"10":{"text":"amate in khuo a mu lo nadingun a mit uh miel hinlen, a ngum uh kul den taheh,” ci hi.","ref":"Late 69:22-23"},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n a pua nading dongun amate a kipalkha ta uh amah? ci-in ka dong hi. Tua bang hi lo hi! Ahi vangin amau’ puana ziehin Gentile-te tungah hutdamna thu a tun pen Israel-te’ thangsiet nadinga kibawl ahi bo hi.","title":"Gentile-te Kihutdamna"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in amate puana pen leitung mite adingin hauna a suo a, amate guollelna zong Gentile-te adingin hauna suoh ahile, Khris sunga Jew mite zosie a kihuopkimna zong bangza tahin hauna suoh zawkan lai ding ahei!"},"13":{"text":"No Gentile-te tunga thu ang gen ka hi hi. Gentile-te adinga sawltahpi ka hi ziehin ka nasepna a genpha ka hi a,"},"14":{"text":"tua tawh ka mipite in ka etsah thei khah a, amate lahah mi pawlkhat ka hutdam thei khah leh ka ci na ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate kinuolna pen leitung mite tawh kilemkiana ahile, amate kipomkiana zong khu sina panin hinna lobuong bang dang hi ding ahei!"},"16":{"text":"Ga masa-a kipie bunel lomkhat a sientho nah po leh bunel lompi zong a siengtho pai ahi hi; a zungpi a sientho nah po leh a bate zong a siengthosa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua a bate pawlkhat kisattanin tua munah gamlah olive dawng ahi note pen tuate tungah ang kipe-in tua olive zung pana ang pei khanna tui a dawnton na hi uhi,"},"18":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin a bate tungah kisiel kha sih un. Na kisiel uleh a zungpi a puo tahtah pen no na hi sih vua, a zungpi in no ang puoh ahi zawh lam phawh un."},"19":{"text":"Note in, “Kei ei kipe nadinga a bate kisattan ahi hi,” na ci ding uh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua pen thuman ahi hi! Amate a kisattna pen a up lo zieh uh ahi a, ahi vangin note na hi uleh upna zieha amate munah a ding thei na hi bo uhi. Tua hi a, kisathei sih unlen zau zaw un."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in a ba ahi ngaite bawn za lo ahile note zong ang za tuom kha sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien’ migitna le a khauna kithei un: Ama pen a puate tungah khau a, ahi vangin a migitna sunga na op suoh uleh note tungah ang migi ding hi; tua bang na hi sih uleh no zong ang kisattan ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel-te nangawn zong uplana sunga a op suoh sih uleh kipekia veve ding hi, azieh pen Pasien in amate pekia thei nading thu a nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note bawn pienpi gamlah olive kung panin ang kisattanin pienpi tawh kilebula a kisuon olive kung tungah ang kipe sam ahile, olive kungah tami pienpi a bate kipekia zawkan lai lo ding amah?"},"25":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, no sangin ka pilzaw hi, na kici lo nadingun note in tam thuthuh na thei ding uh ka dei hi: Gentile-te a lut ding za ang lutkim masangsie Israel-te pawlkhat tungah lungkhauna a tung tadi phot ahi bo hi.","title":"Israel Zosie in Hutdamna Nga ding"},"26":{"text":"Tua hi a, Israel-te zosie in hutdamna a nga ding uhi; Lai Siengtho sungah, “Zion panin Tanpa ang pei ding a, ama in Jacob panin Pasien zatah lona a hemkhie ding hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Isa 59:20"},"27":{"text":"“Amau’ mawnate ka lahmang ciengin, tami khu amate tawh ka thuciemna ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 27:9; Jer 31:33-34"},"28":{"text":"Lungdamna thu tawh kisai-in na hamphat nadingun amate pen Pasien’ galte a suoh vua, ahi vangin teelna tawh kisai-in amate pen a pu a pate uh ziehin itte ahi veve uhi."},"29":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Pasien’ letsongte le Pasien’ hlatna pen a kikhel thei ahi sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in note in Pasien’ thu na mang sih vua, ahi vangin tu-in amau’ thuman lona ziehin hepina na nga ma bangun,"},"31":{"text":"note tunga a kilah hepina ziehin amate in zong hepina a nga nadingun thumang loin a om tadi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in mi zosie a hepi nadingin thumanlona-ah mi zosie a khumcip phot hi."},"33":{"text":"Aw, Pasien’ hauna, pilna le theinate thuh talawm sam e izaw! A thukhennate kan zawh ding ahi sih a, a lampite zong thei zawh ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Isa 55:8"},"34":{"text":"“Azieh pen koi in Topa’ lungsim thei a, a thudawhpi-in koi pang ngai ahei?","ref":"Isa 40:13"},"35":{"text":"“Ahi sihle letsong a thuhkia dingin koi in ama tungah letsong pie ngai ahei?","ref":"Job 41:11"},"36":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na zosie, ama kung pan, ama tungtawn le ama ading ahi hi. Ama in minthanna nga zingzing taheh. Amen.","ref":"1Cor 8:6"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin sanggamte aw, Pasien tungah a siengtho le a santah hingtang biehpiehna bangin na pumpite uh na pieh nadingun Pasien’ hepina zalin kang thum hi, tua khu na hlagau biehpiehna uh ahi hi.","title":"Khris Sunga Hinna Tha"},"2":{"text":"Tam leitung mite dan bangin om sih unlen, a hoi, a sanhuoi le a bukim Pasien’ deina bang ahei, ci-in na khinkhai thei nadingun na lungsim uh thasuosah unlen na lim uh na kilamdang sah un."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile keima ei kipie hepina ziehin note lah mi zosie tunga kang gen nuom thu in, na hina za sanga a sangzaw-in no le no na kingaisun sih unlen, Pasien in note ang pieh upna za tawh kizui-in a kilawm cieng bep khatin kingaisun zaw un."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite in pumpi khat tungah pumpi’ nate tampi i nei vua, tua nate zosie in a nasepnate uh a kibah lo ma bangin,"},"5":{"text":"a tampi ahi eite zong Khris sungah pumpi khat i hi vua, eite khatlekhat pumpi nate i hi uhi.","ref":"1Cor 12:12"},"6":{"text":"Eite ei kipie hepina tawh kizui-in letsong a tuom ciet i nei uhi: Kamsang za nga mi in a upna za tawh kituohin kamsang taheh."},"7":{"text":"Nasepna za a nga mi in tua na sem taheh; thuhil za a nga mi in thuhil taheh;"},"8":{"text":"hansuona za a nga mi in hansuo taheh; a piekhie mi in kiphaltahin pie taheh; makai za a nga mi in kukal tahin makai taheh; lainatna nasep a sem mi in lungtai tahin sem taheh.","ref":"1Cor 12:4-11"},"9":{"text":"Itna pen a tahtah hi heh; gitlona huo unlen sil hoi na tukon un;","title":"Tapidaw Tahtahte’ Kimelcina"},"10":{"text":"khatlekhat na ki-it tuoh unlen ki-zatah bawlna lamah khatlekhat a sangzaw-in na kidem un."},"11":{"text":"Pawnthawna lamah na thasie sih unlen lungsim thalawp tahin Topa’ na sem un."},"12":{"text":"Kinepna-ah lungdam unlen, gimna ang tun ciengin thuoh keikui-in thunget na pawnthaw mama un."},"13":{"text":"Misiengthote a kisapna bangin na hawm unlen, lengla na do siem un."},"14":{"text":"Ang bawlsiete thupha na pie unlen, amate samsie loin thupha na pie un.","ref":"Mat 5:44; Luk 6:28"},"15":{"text":"A lungdamte tawh lungdamton unlen, a kapte tawh kapton un."},"16":{"text":"Khatlekhat na kithuhuol un; kiliensah sih un; tuolniem mite tawh na kigop unlen, no le no a pilin na kingaisun sih un.","ref":"Pau 3:7"},"17":{"text":"Mi khatpo’ gitlona pen gitlona ma tawh na thuhkia sih un. Mi zosie muna-ah a kilawm pen dingin na ngaisun zaw un."},"18":{"text":"Ahi thei leh no thu ahi laisie mi zosie tawh na kilem un."},"19":{"text":"Ka itte aw, no le no phu na kila sih unlen, Pasien’ lungthahna dingin mun na awn zaw un; bangzieh ahei cile, “Phulahna keima-a’ ahi a, keima in ka thuhkia ding hi, ci-in Topa in a gen hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:35"},"20":{"text":"Hi lo hi, “Na galpa a gil a kiel leh an pie-in a dangta leh a dawn ding tui na pie un; azieh pen tam banga na bawlna ziehun a lutung vuah meikamsa a buohsuh na hi ding uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pau 25:21-22"},"21":{"text":"Sietna in kizo sah sih unlen sietna pen hoina tawh na zo zaw un."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi zosie in uhna a nei mite’ thu mang uheh; azieh pen Pasien kung pan ci simlo thuneina a om thei sih a, uhna thuneite zong Pasien’ koi mite ahi bo hi.","title":"Thuneite’ Thumanna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin uhna thunei mipa a langdo poma Pasien’ koisa mipa a langdo ahi a, tua bang a langdo mite in thukhenna a thuoh ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile gam-uhte pen a gamtat hoi lo mite adingin a giinhuoi hi beh a, a gamtat hoi mite adingin a giinhuoi ahi sih hi. Thunei mipa giing loin na om nuom vuoi mah? Na op nuom uleh a hoi lamin gamta un, tua hile ama’ patahna na nga ding uhi;"},"4":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ama pen na hoi nading vua Pasien’ nasempa ahi hi. Ahi vangin na gamtat siet uleh ama na giin ding uh ahi hi, azieh pen thunei pa in a mawhna-in namsau a tawi sih hi! Ama ahile a gamtatsie mite tungah lungthahna dan a pie ding Pasien’ nasem ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama’ lungthahna na zauna zieh beh utawh hi loin, no le no kitheina lungsim tawh zong a thu man ding ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen thuneite ahile tam bang thute a buoipi Pasien’ nasemte ahi ziehun, tami thute zieh ma-in zong note in phiengsie na pieh uh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A nga ding vua kilawm bangin mi zosie tungah pie un, sieh nga dinga kilawmte sieh pie un, phiengsie nga dinga kilawmte phiengsie pie un, zatah dinga kilawmte zatah unlen, patawi dinga a kilawmte patawi un.","ref":"Mat 22:21; Mrk 12:17; Luk 20:25"},"8":{"text":"Khatlekhat ki-it ding ci simlo khatlekhat lei na kibasah sih un; bangzieh ahei cile midang a it pa in thukham’ deina a zui sieng ahi ta hi.","title":"Khatlekhat’ Ki-Itna"},"9":{"text":"“Ang kawm sin; tuol that sin; gu sin; mi neisa deigaw sin; a kici thupiehte le thupieh dang a om popo, “Nangma na ki-it bangin na vengpa it in,” a kici thupieh in a huom sieng hi.","ref":"Pei 20:13-15, 17; Siem 19:18; Thkna 5:17-19, 21"},"10":{"text":"Itna in a vengpa’ sietna ding a bawl sih hi; tua ahi ziehin itna i ci pen thukham zosie zui bukimna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam thu banah tuhun pen bang hun hi a, note adingin kimutna panin bangci khahlaw ding ci zong na thei uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile i upcil lai sangin eite adingin tu-in hutdamna ang nai zaw hi;","title":"Naw Thumna"},"12":{"text":"zan hun tawpin sun hun ang nai ta hi. Tua ahile eite in khuomiel nasepnate pai-in khuovah galhiemte tawh kivon vai."},"13":{"text":"Sun huna om bangin eite zong kilawm tahin gamta-in, guol nopna le zukhamna, huana lanna, thangtatna, kihauna le kihazatnate bawl sih vai."},"14":{"text":"Tuale mahin note in Topa Jesu Khris puon bangin sil unlen, tahsa lungkim nading bangma bawl sih un."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upna lama zawngkhal mite na pawlbawl unlen, a ngaisutnate uh kinielpi sih un.","title":"Midangte Tungah Thukhen Sih Un"},"2":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in an khat popo neh thei dingin a um vua, hinanle upna neu mite in ante lohing mete beh a ne uhi."},"3":{"text":"A ne mite in a tang mite simmaw sih hinlen, a tang mite in zong a ne mite tungah thu khen sih heh; bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in amate zong sang veve hi."},"4":{"text":"Midang khat’ nasemte tungah thu khen ding koi na hi vuoi? A pupa uh mai-ah amate kip thei-in zong pua thei uhi. Tuale Topa in kipsah thei ahi ziehin amate a kip ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in ni khat pen adang khat sangin a thupizaw-in a ngaisun uhi; adangte leuleu in ni zosie a kibangin a ngaisun uhi. Mi zosie in amau’ lungsim cietah kithei ciet ta uheh."},"6":{"text":"Ni a tangte in Topa zatahna tawh a tan uh ahi hi. An ne mite in zong Pasien tungah lungdam ko veve ahi ziehin Topa zatahna ma tawh a ne ahi uhi; an tangte in zong Topa zatahna tawh a tang ahi a, Pasien tungah lungdam a ko uhi.","ref":"Col 2:16"},"7":{"text":"Eima dinga a hing mi koima i om sih a, eima dinga a si zong koima i om sih hi."},"8":{"text":"I hin leh Topa adinga hing i hi a, i si le zong Topa ading ma-a si i hi uhi. Tua ahi ciengin i hing a, i si zongin Topa -a’ ma i hi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Khris in a sisa mite le a hinglai mite’ Topa ahi thei nadingin si-in a hingkia hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang in bang dinga na sanggam pa tunga thu na khen ahei? Ahi sihle bang dinga na sanggam pa na simmaw ahei? Azieh pen eite zosie zong i unpi-un Pasien’ thukhenna topha mai-ah a ding ciet ding i hi uhi.","ref":"2Cor 5:10"},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen Lai Siengtho sungah, “Kei ka hin ma bangin ka mai-ah mi zosie khupdinin, leii zosie in Pasien phat ding uhi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Isa 45:23"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin eite khat ciet in Pasien kungah i kungtung ciet i kisut ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khatlekhat thu kikhen nawn loin, midang khat’ peina lampi-ah a pal thei ding le a khahtan thei dingte i koi ngai lo nadingin i lungsim uh khensat va vui.","title":"Midangte Puasah Sin"},"14":{"text":"Keima in Topa Jesu sungah a siengtho lo bangma om lo hi, ci thei-in ka kizo hi; ahi vangin a siengtho lo-a a ngaisun mi khatpo adingin tua pen a siengtho lo hi pai hi."},"15":{"text":"Na nehna ziehun na sanggam pa’ lungsim na natsah uleh itna sungah a kalsuon na hi nawn sih uhi. Na an nehna ziehun Khris in a silaw mi khat’ siet nading piengsah sih un."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n mite in na hoinate uh a sie lamin kigensah sih un."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ manggam pen neh le dawn thute ahi sih a, Hlagau Siengtho sungah dihna, lungmuonna le kipahna hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua banga Khris ading na a sem mi in Pasien mai-ah a sanhuoi suohin mite’ lungkimpi zong ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin kilem nading le khatlekhat kilapsang tuoh thei nading a piengsah thute delin hanciem vai."},"20":{"text":"An nehna ziehin Pasien’ nasepna susie sih un. A tahtahin na zosie siengtho a, hizongle na neh na tah ziehun midangte na puasah ule a khiel na hi uhi;"},"21":{"text":"na sanggamte a puasah thei na khatpopo ahi, an nehna, zu nehnate bawl lo ding hoi hi."},"22":{"text":"Na nei upna pen nangma le Pasien kikal thu hisah in. Man a sah uh nate ziehin amau le amau a kimawpai lo mite pen mi hampha ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lungkaa mite in a neh ule zong upna tawh a neh lo ziehun mawsah thukhenna a thuoh ding uhi; bangzieh ahei cile upna pana a pei lo poma mawna ahi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A thahat eite in eima’ lungkim nading beh sui loin a thanem mite’ gitnat lonate i thuohpi ding uh kilawm hi.","title":"Nangma Hiloin Midangte Lungkimsah in."},"2":{"text":"Eite zosie in i vengte hoi nadingin amate lungkimsah a, i khansuo ding uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Khris zong ama le ama a kilungkimsah sih hi; hizongle Lai Siengtho sungah, “No ang zako mite’ ang zakona teng kei tung ang tu hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Late 69:9"},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite in Lai Siengtho pana i nga thuohzawna le henepna ziehin lametna i nei nadingin nidang lai-a na kigiel popo eite thuhil nadinga kigiel ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuohzawhna le hanthotna’ Pasien in Khris Jesu’ deina tawh kituohin note khatlekhat kithuhuolin hing omsah ta heh."},"6":{"text":"Tua hile note zong aw khatin luongtonin Pasien le i Topa Jesu Khris Pa’ min na thangsah thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Khris in note ang san bangin Pasien’ minthan nadingin note zong khatlekhat na kisang un.","title":"Jew Mite le Gentile-te ading Lungdamna Thu"},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in i pupite tunga a na piehsa kamciemte a suhkip thei nadingin Pasien’ thuman thutah hangin Khris pen teptan mite’ nasem suohsah zo hi, ci-in kang gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua pen Gentile-te in ama’ hepina ziehin Pasien’ min a thansah thei nading uh ahi hi. Lai Siengtho sungah, “Tua ahi ziehin Gentile-te lahah kang pulah ding a, na min phatna la-in ka sa ding hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"2Sam 22:50; Late 18:49"},"10":{"text":"Khatvei a genkiana-ah, “Gentile-te aw, a mite tawh lungdamton un,’ a ci hi;","ref":"Thkna 32:43"},"11":{"text":"a cina le, “No Gentile-te zosie aw, Topa phat unlen, mi zosie in zong ama phat uheh,” a cikia hi;","ref":"Late 117:1"},"12":{"text":"tuale Isaiah in, “Jessi’ zungpi ang meng ding a, Gentile-te uh ding mi khat ang khang ding hi; Gentile-te in ama a lamen ding uhi,” na ci leuleu hi.","ref":"Isa 11:10"},"13":{"text":"Hlagau Siengtho’ vanglietna ziehin lametna tawh note na kidimlet thei nadingun, lametna Pasien in kipahna zosie le upna zieha lungmuonna zosie tawh note hing dim taheh."},"14":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, noma mama pen hoina bukim le theina zosie tawh kidimin khatlekhat a kihil thei dingin kang muong hi.","title":"Gentile-te tungah Paul in Hangtaha a Laigielna Thu"},"15":{"text":"Hinanle note’ phawkia dingin keima in hangsantahin na kung vuah thu pawlkhat kang giel zo hi. Pasien in ei pieh hepina ziehin,"},"16":{"text":"kei pen Gentile-te’ silpiehte pomtah ahi thei nading le Hlagau Siengtho in a siensuo thei nadingin, Gentile-te kungah siempu nasepna tawh Pasien’ lungdamna thu a gen ding Khris’ nasempa khat ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Khris Jesu sungah Pasien ading ka sepnate tungah kisiel nading thu ka nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen sepna le genna tawh Khris in kei tungtawna a sepkhietsa nate simlo bangma kang gen ngam sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasien’ Hlagau vanglietna tawh lim le na lamdangte bawlin Jerusalem-a kipanin Illyricum gam dongah Khris’ lungdamna thu ka phuongzah sieng zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin midangte phusa khuombul tunga a lam ka hi lo nadingin Khris’ min a kilaw khah lona munte-ah lungdamna thu gen ding pen keima’ lungtup ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi vangin Lai Siengtho sungah, “Ama’ thu a kigen ngai lona mite in a mu ding vua, ama’ thu a za ngai lote in a theitel ding uhi,” ci-a kigielsa bang ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 52:15"},"22":{"text":"Note kunga kang haw ding ei khahtan zelzel pen tami thu ahi hi.","title":"Rom ah Paul Zinsawm","ref":"Rom 1:13"},"23":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in tam kuol tengah ka sep nading mun a op tah lo zieh le na kung vua kang haw ding ka lunggul zaw kum tampi a phah tah ziehin,"},"24":{"text":"Spain ka pei ciengin na kung uh kang pha nuom hi. Azieh pen ka khuolzinna-ah note tawh kimu-in bakhat sung i kithuo zaw ciengin ka pei nading munah nei puohkia ding uh ka lamen hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanle tu tadi-in mi siengthote’ na a sem dingin Jerusalem ah ka pei phot ding hi;"},"26":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile Macedonia gam le Achaia gam sunga mite in Jerusalem-a om misiengtho a zawngte lahah a neisate uh a hawm nuom uhi.","ref":"1Cor 16:1-4"},"27":{"text":"Amate in tam bangin a sem nuom uhi, a tahtahin amate in tuate tungah leiba nei ahi uhi; azieh pen Gentile-te in Jew mite tawh Hlagau thupha ngaton uh ahile, amate in zong tahsa lam thupha tawh Jew mite a hu ding uh a kilawm ahi hi.","ref":"1Cor 9:11"},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tami nasep manin amate tungah a kidongsa sumte ka pieh zaw ciengin, no kungah hing baang kawmin Spain gamah ka pei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Na kung vua kang haw ciengin Khris’ thupha a dimtah tawh kang tun ding lam ka thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note in i Topa Jesu Khris le Hlagau’ itna ziehin keima dingin Pasien kungah nahpi tahin thu ngetna tawh nei panpi nading ule,"},"31":{"text":"Judea gama om thu um lote’ khut sung panin keima suohta-in, mi siengthote in Jerusalem-a ka nasepnate ang pom thei nadingun thu nei ngetpieh dingun kang thum hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua khu Pasien’ deina tawh na kung vuah kipah tahin hing pei a, note tawh kithuo-in tha tha i ngaton thei nading uh ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Kilemna ei pie Pasien in note zosie hing ompi taheh. Amen."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cenchreae khuo-a om numei pawlpi upa ahi, i sanggam nu Phoebe pen mihoi ahi lam kang theisah hi.","title":"Aituom Hopinate"},"2":{"text":"Ama pen mi tampi le kei mama zong ei panpi khat ahi ziehin, a kisapna khatpopo-ah na hu unlen, misiengthote’ sep dinga a kilawm ahi ma bangin Topa’ min tawh ama na sang un."},"3":{"text":"Khris Jesu sungah ka seppi Prisca le Aquila-te zong ei na noset pieh un.","ref":"Sawl 18:2"},"4":{"text":"Ama gel pen kei dinga a si ngam ahi vua, ama gel tungah kei beh a lungdam ka hi sih a, Gentile hlattuom pawlpi zosie zong lungdam uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama gel’ inn a kikhawm hlattuom pawlpite zong ei na noset pieh un. Asia gamah Khris adinga a kikhel masa pen, ka lawm it Epaenetus ei na noset pieh un."},"6":{"text":"Note lahah nasep pawnthaw mama ahi Mary zong ei na noset pieh un."},"7":{"text":"Ka thongkiehpi le keima’ tanaute Andronicus le Junia zong ei na noset pieh un.; ama gel pen sawltahpite lahah mi thupi ahi vua, kei sangin zong Khris a um masa zawte ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Topa sungah ka it Ampliatus ei na noset pieh un."},"9":{"text":"Khris sunga i seppi uh ahi Urbanus le ka it Stachys-te ei na noset pieh un."},"10":{"text":"Khris sunga mi citah Apelles zong ei na noset pieh un. Aristobulus’ innkuonpite zong ei na noset pieh un."},"11":{"text":"Ka tanau Herodion zong ei na noset pieh un. Topa sunga a om Narcissus innkuonpite ei na noset pieh un."},"12":{"text":"Topa sunga nasem Tryphaena le Tryphosa-te zong ei na noset pieh un. Topa sunga nasep pawnthaw ka lawm it Persis zong ei na noset pieh un."},"13":{"text":"Topa sunga a kiteel Rufus ei na noset pieh un; keima in zong nu ka ci ama’ nu ei na noset pieh un.","ref":"Mrk 15:21"},"14":{"text":"Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas le amate tawh a omton tanaute zong ei na noset pieh un."},"15":{"text":"Philologus le Julia, Nereus le a sanggam nu, Olympas le amate tawh omton misiengthote zosie zong ei na noset pieh un."},"16":{"text":"Note khatlekhat siengtho kitawpna tawh ei na noset pieh un. Hlattuom Khris’ pawlpi zosie in note ang noset uhi."},"17":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note in na sinsa uh ahi thuhilna tawh ki-elngat, pawl kikhenna le khielna a piengsah mite encienin pel un, ci-in kang hanthawn hi.","title":"A Nukhia Thuhilnate"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua bang mite pen i Topa Khris’ na sem ahi ngap sih vua, amau’ ankam tui nading bepin kamsiem le mi maitang phatna tawh mimawlte’ lungsim sol ahi bo uhi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen thu na manna uh mi zosie in thei ahi ziehin note vangin ka kipah a, thuhoi lamah mipil na hi ding ule, thusie lamah maw baang lo na hi ding uh ka dei hi."},"20":{"text":"Nopsahna Pasien in a sawt loin Satan tuoncilin na keng nei vuah ang koi ding hi. Note tawh i Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina hing om taheh!"},"21":{"text":"Ka naseppi Timothy in ang noset a, tua ma bangin ka tanaute ahi Lucius, Jason le Sosipater-te in zong ang noset uhi.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"22":{"text":"Tam laigiel pa ahi keima Tertius in zong Topa’ min tawh kang noset uhi."},"23":{"text":"Keima le hlattuom pawlpi buppi zin ei do Gaius in zong note ang noset hi. Khuopi sumkem pa Erastus le i sanggam pa uh Quartus-te in ang noset uhi.","ref":"Sawl 19:29; 1Cor 1:14; 2Tim 4:20"},"24":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris’ ei hepina note zosie tawh hing om taheh. Amen."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in kum sawtveipi sung a kiselcip thuthuh kilahna tawh kizui-in keima in ka hil lungdamna thu le Jesu Khris’ thu tangkona tawh note ang thakhausah thei pa pen Pasien ahi a,","title":"Pasien Phatna tawh Thukhupna"},"26":{"text":"hizongle tawntung Pasien’ thupieh dung zui le kamsangte’ gielsa thute tungtawnin Gentile-te zosie tungah theisahin upna thu aman thei nadingun ama in tu-in tua thu a pholah zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Jesu Khris tungtawnin a pil Pasien khat beh tungah minthanna om tawntung taheh! Amen."}}}}},"46":{"info":{"name":"1 Corinth","shortname":"1cor","abbr":[],"desc":"Corinth masa corint tapidawte tunga paul’ laihlah masa (paul’s first letter to the corinthians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ deina tawh Khris’ sawltahpi dinga kihlan Paul le i sanggam pa Sosthenes in,","title":"Hopina","ref":"Sawl 18:1"},"2":{"text":"Corinth khuo Khris Jesu sungah a kisiensuosa mite a kipan misiengtho dinga kihlante le Topa Jesu Khris’ min a lo muncin tenga om mi zosiete tungah,"},"3":{"text":"i Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung pan hepina le lungmuonna na tung vuah om taheh."},"4":{"text":"Khris Jesu sungah note adinga ang kipiesa Pasien’ hepina ziehin Pasien tungah nuom thu ka tut ngitnget hi.","title":"Lungdamkona"},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note pen ama sungah thugenna le theina namcin tawh na bukim zo ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Note lahah Khris’ thu teci panna a kikipsah zo ma bangin,"},"7":{"text":"i Topa Jesu Khris ang kilah ding ngahin na om sungun zong Hlagau letsong tasap na nei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris’ ni ciengin kaw baang lo-a na op thei nadingun ama in a tawp tanpha-in ang thakhausah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A Tapa i Topa Jesu Khris tawh kipawlna sungah note ang hlan pa Pasien muonhuoi hi."},"10":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na unpi-un kithutuoh-in note lahah pawlkhenna a op lo nading le, lungsim le tupna kibang khat sungah na kigawm thei nadingun Topa Jesu Khris’ min tawh kang thum hi.","title":"Hlattuom Pawlpi Sung Kikhenna"},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka sanggamte aw, note lahah kihauna om hi, ci thu Chloe’ mite pawlkhat in ei zasah zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka ci nopna-ah note khat ciet in, ‘Kei Paul’ pawl, kei Apollos’ pawl, kei Chephas’ pawl, kei Khris’ pawl ka hi hi,” na ci deidoi uhi.","ref":"Sawl 18:24"},"13":{"text":"Khris a kikhen amah? Note adingin singlamte tungah Paul a kikhailia amah? Ahi sihle Paul’ min suongin na ki-baptize uh amah?"},"14":{"text":"Crispus le Gaius simlo koima khat beh kang bapitize khah lo ziehin Pasien kungah nuom thu ka tut hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:8; 19:29; Rom 16:23"},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n koima in keima’ min suongin ka ki-baptize hi, ei ci thei sih hi."},"16":{"text":"(Stephanas-te innkuon zong ka baptize hi; tua lo adang ka baptize lam ka thei kha sih hi.)","ref":"1Cor 16:15"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen Khris in mi baptize dinga ei sawl hi loin lungdamna thu hil dinga ei sawl ahi zaw a, ka thugen siem man zong ahi sih hi. Hi mawh leh Khris’ singlamte vanglietna a hawmsuohsah kha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a mangthai mite adingin singlamte’ thu pen motna ahi a, ahi vangin hutdamsa eite adingin Pasien’ vanglietna ahi hi.","title":"Khris, Pasien’ Pilna le Vanglietna"},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen, “A pilte’ pilna ka susie ding a, miteite’ teina ka sumai ding hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Isa 29:14"},"20":{"text":"Mipil hei-ah om ahei? Laisiem pa hei-ah om ahei? Tuhun mi thu nielsiem pa hei-ah om ahei? Pasien in leitung pilna pen motna suohsah zo hi lo amah?","ref":"Job 12:17; Isa 19:12; 33:18; 44:25"},"21":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Pasien’ pilna sungah leitung mite in a pilna uh tungtawnin Pasien a thei lo tah ziehun, a mothuoi kote’ thuhilna tungtawnin Pasien in a um mite hutdam dingin a khensat hi."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen Jew mite in lim ngenin Greek-te in pilna a deigaw uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle kote in Jew mite adingin kisui khahna suong le Greek-te adingin motna ahi a kikhailia Khris’ thu ka hil uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hizongle a hlatsa Jew mite le Greek-te adingin Khris pen Pasien’ vanglietna le Pasien’ pilna ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen mihing’ pilna sangin Pasien’ motna pilzaw a, mihing’ hatna sangin Pasien’ thanemna hatzaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, ang kihlat lai-a na dinmun uh ngaisun un; mihing muna panin note a tamzaw mipil hi loin, mi vanglien zong na tam sih vua, pienpi nampi zong tampi na om sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin mipilte a maizumsah dingin leitungah Pasien in mimawte teel a, a kihatsahte muolpho nadingin Pasien in a thanem mite a teel hi."},"28":{"text":"A omsa nate bangma loin a kiemsuh nadingin Pasien in leitungah a gina lo nate le a kisimmawte a teel hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua khu Pasien mai-ah koima a kisiel thei lo nading ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama pen Khris Jesu sungah na hinna zungpi uh ahi a, Pasien in Khris pen i pilna, i dihna, i sienthona le i kitatkhietna a suohsah hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ziehin, “A kisiel poma, Topa sungah kisiel taheh,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Jer 9:24"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na kung vuah Pasien’ thu thuhpi a phuongzah dingin kang haw lai-in kihisahna kam le pilna kamte ka zang sih hi.","title":"A Kikhailia Khris’ Thu Phuongzahna"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen note lahah singlamte tunga a kikhailia Jesu Khris simlo bangma thei ka sawm sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Na kung vuah kang pei lai-in ka tha a nem a, zau-in ka ci nahpi-in a tun hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:9"},"4":{"text":"Ka kamham le ka thu phuongzahte zong pilna kam tawh ahi sih a, Pasien’ Hlagau le a vanglietna tawh ahi zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuami in na upna uh mihing pilna tungah kinga loin Pasien’ vanglietna tungah a kingah zawh nading ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanle kote in a picingsate lahah pilna thu ka gen uhi, tua pilna pen tu khanghun ahi sihle a maimang kuonkuon ta ding ahi tu khanghun gam-uhte’ pilna ahi sih hi.","title":"Pasien’ Pilna Tahtah"},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin kote in leitung pien masang peha eite minthan nadinga Pasien in a na sekholsa Pasien’ pilna, a thusim le a phuolsel thute ka gen uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tam khanghun lai-a gam-uhte khat beh in tami thu a telsiem sih uhi; azieh pen amate in a na telsiem uh hileh minthang Topa a na khailia sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin, “Mit in a mu ngai lo, bil in a zah ngai lo, mihing lungsim in a ngaisut ngai lo, Pasien in ama a it mite adingin a bawlpiehsa thu ahi hi,” ci-a a kigiel bang ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 64:4"},"10":{"text":"Pasien in tam thu teng Hlagau tungtawnin ei theisah zo hi; azieh pen Hlagau in na vannuoi sui a, Pasien’ thuthuhte nangawn a kankhie hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a sunga a om mihing’ hlagau simlo koi mihing in tua mihing tahtah pen thei ahei?
