Tua ma bangin Pasien’ Hlagau simlo Pasien’ ngaisutna tahtahte koima in thei zo lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in eite pen leitung hlagau nga i hi sih vua, Pasien in eite tunga ei pieh letsongte i telsiem thei nadingin Pasien tung pana ang pei hlagau nga i hizaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale kote pen mihing pilna tawh a kihil kammalte zanga thu gen ka hi sih vua, Hlagau’ pilna tawh hlagau mite kungah hlagau lam thute letkhie-in a gen ka hizaw uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hlagau mi ahi lote adingin Pasien’ Hlagau letsongte pen motna hi lel ahi ziehin amate in a sang zo sih uhi, bangzieh ahei cile tuate pen hla lam thu beh tawh kikhentel thei ahi ziehin amate in a telthei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hlagau mite in na vannuoi a khentel thei vua, amate in koima’ sittelna a thuoh sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Azieh pen Topa a hil thei nadingin koi in ama’ lungsim thei ahei?” kici hi. Ahi vangin eite in Khris’ lungsim i nei uhi.","ref":"Isa 40:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin sanggamte aw, hlagau mite tunga thugen bangin kang gen thei sih a, tahsa mite tunga thugen bang le Khris upna sungah nausente tunga thugen bangin kang genzaw hi.","title":"Corinth Hlattuom Pawlpi Sunga Kikhenna"},"2":{"text":"Note in antah ne zo nai lo na hi ziehun antah kang pie sih a, nawizu tawh kang va hi. Note in tu nangawnin zong na ne zo nai sih uhi,","ref":"Heb 5:12-13"},"3":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile na tahsa tawn lai uhi. Note lahah hazatna le kihauna a op laisie, note pen tahsa tawnin leitung mihing lungsim’ deina banga a gamta na hi sih uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khat in, “Kei Paul’ pawl ka hi hi,” ci-in, adang khat in, “Kei Apollos’ pawl ka hi hi,” na ci nah valuoi ciengun mihing lel ma hi lo na hi uh amah?","ref":"1Cor 1:12"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahile Apollos bang hi poma ahei? Paul zong bang hi mawh ahei? Amate tungtawnin note in na up thei nadingun amate sep dinga Topa in a guot ciet nasemte ahi lel bo uhi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in ka suon a, Apollos in tui a buoh hi, ahi vangin a khangsah pen Pasien ahi bo hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:4-11, 24-28"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n a suon pa hile, tuibuoh pa hile a thupi sih a, a khangsah Pasien a thupi hi beh hi."},"8":{"text":"A suon pa le tuibuoh pa’ lungtup a kibang hi a, a sepna uh tawh kizui-in thaman a nga tuoh ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kote pen na a semton Pasien’ nasemte ka hi vua, note na hi ule Pasien’ logam, Pasien’ inn na hi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien in keima tunga ei pieh hepina dung zui-in innlam siem pa khat bangin khuombul khat ka phut zo a, tuaci’n midang khat in tua tungah a lam hi. Tua tunga inn lam poma in bangci lam ding ci pen pilvangtaha a teel ciet ding uh kul hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen a kiphutsa Jesu Khris longal khuombul dang koima in phut thei lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi khatpo in tua khuombul tungah kham, ngun, suong manpha, sing, lopa gaw le butu tawh inn a lam leh,"},"13":{"text":"tuami Ni in a nasepna uh pholah ding ahi ziehin, a lamte’ sepna ciet zong mu thei-in ang om ding hi, azieh pen tua sepnate mei tawh kisit ding a, mite’ nasepna ciet mei in a ze-et ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Khuombul tunga a lamsate bangma a ci sih leh, a lam pa in thaman a nga ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nasepna a kahtum leh a lam pa a sum hi ding hi; a lampa suohta ding a, ahi vangin ama pen mei sung pana a suohta bang dan lelin suohta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Note pen Pasien’ biehinnpi na hi vua, na sung vuah Pasien’ Hlagau a ten lam na thei sih uh amah?","ref":"1Cor 6:19; 2Cor 6:16"},"17":{"text":"Mi khat in Pasien’ biehinnpi a suhsiet leh Pasien in ama zong susie ding hi. Azieh pen biehinnpi siengtho a, note zong tua biehinnpi na hi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Noma le noma kisol sih un. Tam khanghun sungah a pila na kingaisut uleh a pil na suo thei nadingun mi maw suoh phot un."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen tam leitung pilna pen Pasien adingin motna ahi hi. Azieh pen, “Ama in mipilte amau’ ngian ma-ah a man hi,” ci-in kigiel hi. Tuale khatvei,","ref":"Job 5:13"},"20":{"text":"“ Topa in a pilte’ ngaisutna pen a mawhna ahi lam thei hi,” ci-in kigielkia hi.","ref":"Late 94:11"},"21":{"text":"Tuaci’n koima in mihing makaite kisielpi da heh. Bangzieh ahei cile na vannuoi noma-a’ ahi a,"},"22":{"text":"Paul hile, Apollos hile, Chephas hile, leitung hile, tuhun hile, mailam hun hile, a unpi-in noma-a’ ahi hi,"},"23":{"text":"note zong Khris-a’ na hi vua, Khris zong Pasien-a’ ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kote pen Khris’ nasemte le Pasien’ thusim kemte bangin ei ngaisun un.","title":"Sawltahpite’ Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Tua tham loin thusim kemte pen a muonhuoi ding uh kisam hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin note na hi vua, leitung thukhen zum ahi zongin kei tunga thu nei khen uleh tua pen kei adingin thuneu khat hi lel hi. Kei le kei nangawn thu ka kikhen sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in ei kimawsah nading bangma khat beh ka thei sih hi, ahi vangin tua ka ci ziehin kei maw peng ka hi pai tuon sih hi. Kei tunga thukhenpa pen Topa ahi bo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin khuomiel sungah tu-a sil kiphuoldapte khuovah sung a tut ding le lungsim sunga gelnate a pholah dingin Topa ang pei ding hun masangin thu na khen sih un. Tua hun ciengin Pasien kung panin mikim in phatna a nga ciet ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note phattuom nadingin, “A kigielsa valin gamta sih un,” a ci pen khu ko tungtawnin note in a khietna na sin thei nading ule mi khat kisahtheipi-in adang khat na niel lo nadingun Apollos le kei mama tungah tami thu zosie ka zang zo ta hi. Tuaci’n note in mi khatpo kisahtheipi-in adang khatpo na pum niel sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen koi in na sung vuah kilamdanna khatpo a mu ahei? Na nga lo uh bang nei na hi uh ahei? A nga na hi ule zong bang dinga a nga lo bang dan a kisathei na hi uh ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Note in na dei zosie uh na nei zo ta uhi! A hau zo na hi ta uhi! Ko tawh loin kumpi na suoh zo ta uhi! Note tawh kumpi i suoton thei nadingin kumpi suoh tahpi locin ka nuom hi."},"9":{"text":"Ko sawltahpite ka hi ule sina thukhenna thuoh dingte bangin Pasien in mi zosie lahah a zaneu penin ei koi zo tawh kibang ka sa hi, bangzieh ahei cile kote pen leitung mite, vantung mite le mihingte adingin guolnopna pawi sunga etnop ka suoh ta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Khris ziehin mimaw ka hi ta vua, ahi vangin note pen Khris sungah mipil na hi uhi! Ko ka thanem vua, ahi vangin no na thakhau uhi. No ang kipatawi a, ahi vangin ko ei kisimmaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni cieng dong gilkiel dangta-in puonsil ding nei loin ka om vua, satna thuohin inn le lo nei loin ka om uhi."},"12":{"text":"Koma’ khut ma tawh gim le tawlin na ka sem uhi. Ei kisimmaw ciengin thupha ka pie uhi; ei kibawlsiet ciengin ka thuoh kenkon uhi;","ref":"Sawl 18:3"},"13":{"text":"ei kidaisah ciengin kamhlum tawh ka dawngkia uhi. Kote ka hi ule leitung buathah lom tawh ka kibang vua, tuni dong ciengin sil bangkim’ buathah dopniehte ka bang bep lel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam pen na zum nading vua kang giel ahi sih a, ka it ka tate banga kang thuhilna uh hizaw hi.","title":"Pa Hina Tawh Thuhilna"},"15":{"text":"Note in Khris sungah ang kem mi tul sawm nei phiel nan locin pa tampi na nei sih uhi. A tahtahin lungdamna thu ziehin Khris Jesu sungah na pa uh ka suoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin note in kei nei ette dingun kang thum hi.","ref":"1Cor 11:1; Phil 3:17"},"17":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin keima in muncin tenga om hlattuom pawlpi zosie thu ka hil bangin Khris Jesu sungah ka gamtat ziete ang phawhsah kia dingin na kung vuah Topa sunga ka it mama le a muonhuoi ka tapa Timothy kang sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in na kung vua ang haw lo dinga ei ngaisut ziehun a kiphasah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in lem a sah leh na kung vuah a sawt loin kang haw ding a, tua a kiphasah mite’ kamham beh hi loin amau’ vanglietna ka mu ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ manggam pen kamham tunga kinga hi loin, vanglietna tunga kinga ahi zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Na kung vuah ciengduoi tawh kang pei diei mah? Ahi sihle itna le lungnemna tawh kang pei diei? Koi deizaw na hi uh ahei?"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lahah lawkite lah nangawn a zong a om ngai lo numei-pasal pahtatna a om hi, ci-in ang kigen tahpi hi; azieh pen mi khat in a pa’ zi a kinunpi hi.","title":"Numei-Pasal Pahtatna in Hlattuom Pawlpi Buasah","ref":"Thkna 22:30"},"2":{"text":"Note kisahthei mawh uteh! Note lah panin tua banga a gamta mipa hemkhie ding na hi ziehun a da a kap ding na hizaw sih uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen tahsa tawh kang ompi lo vangin hlagau tawh kang ompi veve hi; tuale a omton za ma bangin keima in tua banga a gamta mipa tungah"},"4":{"text":"Topa Jesu Khris’ minin thu ka khen zo ta hi. Na kikhop ton ciengun Topa Jesu’ vanglietna tawh ka hlagau in note ang ompi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ ni ang tun ciengin ama’ hlagau in hutdamna a nga thei nadingin Satan’ khut sungah suhsiet dingin tuami tahsa na pie ta un."},"6":{"text":"Na kisahthei mawh pen uh a hoi sih hi. Tol themno khat in annel lompi zelin a pawmsah thei lamtah na thei sih uh amah?","ref":"Gal 5:9"},"7":{"text":"Note tol saw lo annel lom tha na hi tahpi bangun na hi suoh nadingun tol lui teng na hemsieng un. Azieh pen biehpiehna dingin eite’ peisan tuuno ahi Khris kigo zo hi.","ref":"Pei 12:5"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin eite in kheltatna le gitlona tol luite tawh hi loin, lungsim siengthona le thuman thutah ahi tol kisaw lo anlum tawh pawi bawl zaw va vui.","ref":"Pei 13:7; Thkna 16:3"},"9":{"text":"Numei-pasal pahtatte tawh na kigop lo nadingun kang laihlah sungah ka giel zo hi.","title":"Numei-Pasal Pahtatna Thukhen Kul"},"10":{"text":"Tua bang ka ci ciengin tami leitunga a pahtatte, a huoihamte le a gutate, ahi sihle milim a biete ka ci nopna hi lo hi. Tua bang hi mawh leh leitung pana na pusuo uh ngai ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in sanggam min puo sam napi a pahtat le a huoiham, milim a bie, mi a gensie, zukham, ahi sihle a guta khatpo tawh na kigop sih un, ci-a na kung vua lai ang giel ka hizaw hi. Tua bang mite tawh an nangawn na ne ton sih un."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen pulam mite tunga thu khen ding pen kei tawh bang kisai ahei? A sunga om mite tunga thukhen ding na hi sih uh amah?"},"13":{"text":"A pulam mite tungah Pasien in thu a khen ding hi. “Note lah panin tam migilo pa na notmang un,” na ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 13:5; 17:7"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lahah khatpo in midang khat tawh a kisiet ciengin misiengthote kungah tutzaw lo a, bang dinga thukhen zum midih lote mai-ah tut ngam ahei?","title":"Thu umte Lahah Kihehna"},"2":{"text":"Misiengthote in leitung mite’ thu a khen ding lamtah na thei sih uh amah? Leitung thu khen ding na hi uleh, note in tua bang thu neute na khenla talawm uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Thu maimaite gen tah lo, eite pen vantung mite’ thu a khen ding i hi lam thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tua bang thu maimaite na nei ciengun note in hlattuom pawlpi sunga kithusim lo mite thu na khensah uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Tami pen na maizum nading vua kang gen ahi hi. No thu um mi khatlekhat kikal thukhen dingin note lahah a pil koima a op lo pen a pieng thei ding ma amah?"},"6":{"text":"Tua hi napi-in, thu um mi khat in thu um mi khat ma tawh thu kinei-in zum na kitut vua, thu um lote mai-ah tua danin kiheh hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"A tahtahin khatlekhat na kithunei uh pen note adingin guollelna hi zo ta hi. Bang dingin khiel tang zaw mai lo na hi uh ahei? Bang dingin sol thuoh zaw mai lo na hi uh ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin noma ma kisu-in na kisol vua, thu umte tungah zong tua bangin na bawl tazang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Migilote in Pasien’ manggam a luo thei lo ding lam na thei sih uh amah? Mi solin om sih un! Numei tawh a pahtatte, milim biete, angkawmte, pasal kizuate, pasal le pasal pahtatte,"},"10":{"text":"mi gutate, mi huoihamte, zukhamte, mi gensiete, le mi neisa lahpiehte in Pasien’ manggam a luo sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Note kimkhat tam bang na hi ngai uhi. Hizongnanle i Topa Jesu Khris’ min le eite Pasien’ Hlagau ziehin note pen sawpsieng le siensuo na hi ta vua, dih na tang ta uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Bangkim sep thei nading thu ka nei mawh vangin bangkim sep ding a kilawm tuom sih hi. “Bangkim sep thei nading thu ka nei mawh vangin tuate khatpo’ uhna sungah ka om tuom sih ding hi.","title":"Pumpi le Hlagau ah Pasien Phat in","ref":"1Cor 10:23"},"13":{"text":"“An pen gilpi ading ahi a, gilpi zong an ading ma ahi hi.” Pasien in tua tegel a nipi-in susie ding hi. Pumpi pen numei-pasal pahtatna-a zah ding ahi sih a, Topa adinga zah ding ahi zaw hi, Topa zong pumpi ading ahi bo hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasien in Topa thosah a, ama in eite zong a vanglietna tawh ei thosah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na pumpi uh Khris’ pumpi’ nate ahi lam na thei sih uh amah? Tua ahi tah ziehin Khris pumpi’ nate khat la-in numei pahtatte pumpi’ nate suohsah ding ka hi amah? Suohsah buong lo e!"},"16":{"text":"Numei pahtat nu a va luppi mi poma tua nu tawh pumkhat suoh ahi lam na thei sih uh amah? Bangzieh ahei cile, “Tua ni tegel sa khat a suoh hi,” kici hi.","ref":"Pien 2:24"},"17":{"text":"Hizongle Topa tawh a kigawm mi poma ama tawh hlagau-ah pumkhat a suoh hi."},"18":{"text":"Numei-pasal pahtatna na pel un! Mi khat in a bawl mawna zosie a pumpi pulam ahi hi; hinanle numei tawh pahtat pa pen ama’ pumpi tunga khiel ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi sihle na pumpi uh pen Pasien tung pana na nga uh note sunga om Hlagau Siengtho’ biehinnpi ahi hi; note zong noma-a’ na hi lo lam na thei sih uh amah?","ref":"1Cor 3:16; 2Cor 6:16"},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note man tawh ang kileisa na hi ta uhi; tua ahi ziehin na pumpi utawh Pasien’ min na thangsah un."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in note in lai-a nang giel uh thute tawh kisai-in: “Pasal khat in numei a khoi khah lo ding hoizaw hi,” na ci uhi.","title":"Kinunna Tawh Kisai Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"Hizongle numei pasal pahtatna a tam seng ziehin pasal in ama’ zi, numei in ama’ pasal ciet nei uleh hoi hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal in a zi a luppi ding a kilawm za-in luppi ding a, tua ma bangin a zi in zong a pasal a luppi ding a kilawm za-in a luppi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen a zi in ama’ pumpi tungah thu nei loin a pasal in a neizaw a, tua ma bangin a pasal in zong ama’ pumpi tungah thu nei loin a zi in a neizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Thungen dinga na kipumpieh thei nadingun na thukimna utawh kideh hun ding tawmno khat na bawl khah uleh ci simlo, khatlekhat lupton lo ding po na kideh sih un. Na pumpi kidehlana zieh vua Satan in note ang ze-et zo lo nadingin tua zaw ciengin na lumtonkia pai un."},"6":{"text":"Tam pen thupieh bang hi loin ahi thei banga kang gen ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi zosie kei banga a op zawh uleh hoi ka sa hi. Ahi vangin mikim in Pasien tung panin letsong tuomtuom a nei ciet vua, mi khat in tami letsong nga a, adang khat in a tuom khat nga hi."},"8":{"text":"Kinunpi a nei nai lote le meigong numeite tunga ka cina-ah keima bangin kinunpi nei loin a op suoh uleh amate adingin hoi ka sa hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin a kideh zawh ngap sih uleh kinei zaw uheh. Azieh pen hua-in lanin kitulmaw a op sangin nei ding hoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Kinunpi a neisate tungah- kei thupieh hi lo Topa’ thupieh hizaw- zi in a pasal taisan sih heh, ci thu ka pie hi."},"11":{"text":"(ahi vangin a taisan tah leh pasal nei loin mang suoh heh, tua ahi sihle a pasal tawh kilemkia hinlen), a pasal in a zi khul sih taheh.","ref":"Mat 5:32; 19:9; Mrk 10:11-12; Luk 16:18"},"12":{"text":"Adangte tungah tami thu ka gen hi- Topa gen ahi lo keima gen- thu um mi khatpo in thu um lo mi khat zi-in nei a, tua nu in ama tawh opton ding a thukim nah po leh khul sih taheh."},"13":{"text":"Numei khat in thu um lo pasal khat nei-in tua pa in tua nu tawh opton ding a thukim nah po leh khul sih taheh."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a zi ziehin thu um lo pasal kisiengthosah a, thu um lo a zi zong a pasal ziehin kisiengthosah hi. Tua hi sih mawh leh na tate uh a bua hi ding a, hinanle tu-a ma bangin amate a siengtho uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin thu um lo zaw pen in kikhen ding a nop po leh kikhen uheh; tam bang thu-ah sanggam pa hile, sanggam nu hile a khi a om sih hi. Pasien in eite a kilem dinga ei hlatsa ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Zi aw, na pasal na hutdam thei ding le na hutdam thei lo ding bangci thei na hei? Pasal aw, na zi na hutdam thei ding le na hutdam thei lo ding bangci thei na hei?"},"17":{"text":"Bangbang hile mikim in Pasien’ hlatna tawh kituohin Topa’ sena bangin a hinkhuo uh zang ciet uheh. Tam thu pen keima in hlattuom pawlpi zosiete tunga ka pieh zui ding ngaina ahi hi.","title":"Pasien’ Sesa Hinkhuo"},"18":{"text":"Mi khatpo a kihlat hunin teptansa ahi ta amah? Tua pa in a teptanna lim phiet sawm tuon sih heh. Mi khatpo a kihlat hunin teptan lo ahi amah? Tua pa in teptan ding sawm nawn da mai heh."},"19":{"text":"Teptanna bangma ahi sih a, teptan lona zong bangma ahi tuon sih hi. Ahi vangin Pasien’ thupiehte zui ding a thupi pen ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"No mi zosie in ang kihlat huna na op bangbang vua na op ding uh ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ang kihlat laitahin nang sila na hi amah? Tua thu tawh kilunghimawsah sin. Suotahna nga phiel nan lacin nidang lai-a sangin tu laitah na dinmun pen hamphatna-in zangzaw in."},"22":{"text":"Azieh pen sila ahi lai-in Topa sunga kihlan poma Topa -a’ hi a, tua bang ma-in a kihlat laitahin a suohta poma zong Khris’ sila ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Note na hi uleh man tawh ang kileisa na hi uhi; mihing pute’ sila suoh sih un."},"24":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, ang kihlat lai-a na op dan bangun Pasien tawh na om suoh un."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Topa kung panin ngahnu siengthote tawh kisai thupieh ka nei sih hi, ahi vangin Topa’ hepina tawh a muontah keima’ ngaisutna kang pie uhi.","title":"Kinunpi a Nei Lote le Meigongte"},"26":{"text":"Ang tung bai ding hahsatna thute ngaisun lei na op ngai bang vua na op suoh ding uh hoi va ci-in ka ngaisun hi."},"27":{"text":"Zi tawh na kipaikan amah? Na kipaikan tah leh kikhen ding sawm sin. Zi nei nai lo na hiei mah? Na hi leh zi sui da in."},"28":{"text":"Zi na nei tah leh a khiel na hi sih hi, ngahnu khat in pasal a nei leh zong a khiel ahi tuon sih hi. Ahi vangin kinunpi a neite in tami hinkhuo-ah hamsatna a thuoh ding vua, tua tawh note kang kipelsah nuom hi."},"29":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tua bang ka ci ciengin a kise hun ang nai mama ta hi, a ci nuom ka hi hi; tu-a kipanin zi neite pen zi nei lo bang danin om uh hinlen,"},"30":{"text":"a da mite a da lo bang danin, a lungdam mite zong a lungdam lo bang danin kingaisun a, van leite zong bangma nei lo bang danin om uheh."},"31":{"text":"Leitunga a kivaite zong a kivai lo bang danin om uheh. Azieh pen tam leitung dante a mangthai ding ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Lunghimawna na nei lo ding uh kang deisah hi. Zi nei lopa in Topa a lungkimsah thei nadingin Topa’ vai teng a buoipi hi."},"33":{"text":"Hizongle zi nei pa in a zi a lungkimsah thei nadingin leitung vai teng a buoipi hi;"},"34":{"text":"tuaci’n a lunglutna khen ni a kisuo hi. Tuale pasal nei lo numei le ngahnu siengtho in a pumpi ule a lungsim uh a sientho thei nadingin Topa’ thute a buoipi vua, hinanle pasal nei numei in a pasal a lungkimsah thei nadingin leitung nate a buoipi hi."},"35":{"text":"Note’ phattuom nadinga tam thute kang gen ahi a, kang uhcip nop zieh uh hi loin, a kilawm op dan tawh gamta-in Topa tunga na ki-apna uh a khahtan lo nading ka deina ahi zaw hi."},"36":{"text":"Mi khatpo in ama tawh a kikhamsa ahi numei tungah a kilawm loin gamta-in a kingaisut a, a lunggulna a khau seng ziehin a kinunpi sawm leh a lunggul bangin kinunpi taheh; tua pen mawna ahi sih hi. Ama gel kinung uheh."},"37":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ lungsim sungah a kikhampi nu tenpi lo dingin khautahin khensatin koima’ pau bawl hi lo ama’ lunggulna kideh zo-in a khentatna tunga a dingkip mi khat ahile a kinunpi lo vangin phamaw lo hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua bang ahile a kikhampi nu a kinunpi pa pen na hoi sem ahi hi; tua nu kinunpi loin a kideh zote hoizaw lai hi."},"39":{"text":"Zi pen a pasal a hin laisie a kikhaukhi ahi hi. A pasal a si leh a dei khatpopo kinunpi thei a, hizongle Topa sung behah hi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanle keima ngaisutna-ah pasal nei loin tua bangin om suoh leh a lung nuomzaw ding hi. Tua hi a, kei zong Pasien’ Hlagau nei-in ka kingaisun hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in milim biehna-a kizangsa an tawh kisai-in: “I unpi-un theina i nei uhi,” a ci eite in i thei uhi. Theina in mi a kisatheisah a, itna in mi a kipsah hi.","title":"Milimte Kipie An"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat in ka thei hi, ci-a a kingaisut leh a thei ding za-a thei nai lo ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien a it mi poma ama in a na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin milim biehna-ah a kipiesa an nehna tawh kisai-in eite in, “Lei tungah milim om tahtah lo hi,” a ci thu le, “Pasien khat beh simlo adang om lo hi,” a ci thu i thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Vantungah ahi a, leitungah ahi zongin pasien-te om a, pasien-te le topate tampi tah a om phiel zongin,"},"6":{"text":"eite adingin Pa ahi Pasien khat beh om a, ama panin sil bangkim pieng a, eite zong ama dinga nungta i hi uhi. Topa khat beh om a, ama pen Jesu Khris ahi hi. Ama tungtawnin sil bangkim pieng a, eite zong ama tungtawnin i nungta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mi zosie in tami theina a nei kim sih uhi. Pawlkhat in milim biehna zongsang luo ta uh ahi ziehin, tua bang ante a neh ciengun tudong ciengin milim kunga kipiesa ci-in a ngaisunsun lai uhi; amau’ kitheina lungsim a thazawm ziehin tua an a bua a suoh hi."},"8":{"text":"“An in eite Pasien tawh ei kinai sah tuon lo ding hi. I neh lo vangin zong i siezaw tuom sih a, i neh vangin zong i hoizaw tuom sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin tami na suotahna uh pen a thanem mite’ puana a suo khah lo nadingin kidawm un."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile no thu thei-a kineite in milim biehna inn sunga na an neh uh pen milim biehna sunga an ne dinga amau’ kitheina lungsim lamah a thanemte in hing mu kha ta leh, a tha pie na suoh ta sih ding uh amah?"},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n note’ theina ziehin amate dinga Khrist in sina a thuohpi, a thanem thu umte in a kisietlaw uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in na innkuonpite tung vuah tam bangin na maw vua, a tha zawngkhal amau’ kitheina lungsim na liemsah ciengun Khris tungah note zong a maw na hi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amau’ puana a hang pen ka an nehna zieh ahile amate khat zong ka puasah khah lo nadingin sa kici ka ne ngai sih ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei a suohta mi hi lo ka mah? Kei sawltahpi khat hi lo ka mah? I Topa Jesu mu zo hi lo ka mah? Note zong Topa sunga ka nasep hi lo na hi uh amah?","title":"Sawltahpi Khat’ Nga Theite"},"2":{"text":"Adangte tungah sawltahpi ka hi sih lezong note adingin ka hi buong sam hi; azieh pen Topa sungah sawltahpi ka hina ciemtena pen note na hi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kei ei sittel mite tungah ka kidalna tami ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ko zong neh le dawn nga thei ding ma hi lo ka hi uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Sawltahpi dangte, Topa’ naute le Cephas ma bangin ko zong thu um zite a zawpi thei ding hi lo ka hi uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi sihle ka neh suina uh nasepna panin keima le Banabas beh a awngtang thei lo ka hi uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"Ama’ sum tawh galkap na a sem koi ahei? Lengga kung suon napi a ga khat zong a ne lo koi ahei? Ahi sihle gan khawi napi a nawi a dawn lo koi ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Tam thu teng mihing thuneina tawh ang gen ka hi amah? Thukham in zong tam bang ma-in gen hi lo amah?"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen Moses’ thukham sungah, “Bawngtangin bu a cil laitahin a nephu na hen sih ding uhi,” ci-in kigiel hi. Bawngtang adingin Pasien a lunghimaw amah?","ref":"Thkna 25:4; 1Tim 5:18"},"10":{"text":"Ahi sihle eite ading ngiet a a gen hi lo amah? Eite ading ma-a a giel ngiet ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile lo hlo mi poma in lametna tawh lo kai a, ancil mi poma in zong a nga ding lametna tawh an a cil hi."},"11":{"text":"Note lahah hlagau khaici hing vaw zo ka hi ziehun no tung panin na leitung’ nate ka at ule zong a tam seng ahi ding amah?","ref":"Rom 15:27"},"12":{"text":"Midangte in note tungah thu a nei thei leh kote in a tamzaw ka nei thei lai sam sih ding uh amah? Hizongle kote in tami thuneina zang loin, Khris’ lungdamna thu a kikhahtan lo nadingin na khatpopo ka thuoh kenkon zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Biehinnpi sunga nasemte in biehinnpi panin neh a nga vua, maitam-a nasemte in zong maitam tunga kiluite a nga lam uh thei lo na hi uh amah?","ref":"Thkna 18:1"},"14":{"text":"Tua ma bangin lungdamna thu a tangkote in lungdamna thu panin kivana a nga ding uhi, ci-in Topa in thu a pie hi.","ref":"Mat 10:10; Luk 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Hizongle tam bang nga thei dingte khat zong ka zang sih a, keima tunga tamte ang kizah nadinga tami lai ang giel zong ka hi sih hi. Koima in keima’ kisahtheina a hang a susie vawt sih ding hi, tua bang sangin ka sizaw bawn ding hi!"},"16":{"text":"Lungdamna thu ka tangko ziehin kisiel nading thu mawngmawng ka nei sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile tua thu a hil ding ma a ka tunga mawpuoh ei kisuon ahi bo hi. Lungdamna thu ka tangko sih leh gimna ka thuoh ding hi!"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen keima nop thu-a sem hi leng sep thaman ka nei ding hi; ahi vangin keima nop thu-a sem ka hi sihle tua pen sep dinga ei kingansie na a sem ka hi lel bo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahile ka thaman ding bang ahiei? Ka thugennate-ah lungdamna thu sunga ka nga ding hamphatnate zang sieng loin, a man ngen loin lungdamna thu ka tangkona pen keima’ thaman ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile koima’ sila ka hi sih vangin mi a tam theithei ka nga thei nadingin mi zosie’ sila ka kisuohsah hi."},"20":{"text":"Jew mite ka nga thei nadingin Jew mite kungah Jew mi khat bang ka suoh hi. Thukham khut nei-a om mite ka nga thei nadingin (kei mama thukham nei-ah om lo napi) thukham nei-a omte tungah thukham nei-a om bangin ka om hi."},"21":{"text":"Thukham nei lote ka nga zawh nadingin (Pasien’ thukham panin a suohta hi tuon loin Khris’ thukham nei-a a om hizaw nanleng) thukham nei lote lahah thukham nei lote khat bangin ka om hi."},"22":{"text":"A thanem mite ka nga thei nadingin a thanem mite lahah a thanem bangin ka om hi. Lam khatpopo tawh mi pawlkhat ka hutdam thei nadingin mi zosie adingin sil bangkim ka suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Lungdamna thuphate-ah tanh ka nga thei nadingin lungdamna thu ziehin tam thu zosie ka bawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tai kidemna-ah mi zosie a tai vangin khat beh in patawina a nga lam thei lo na hi uh amah? Note in zong patawina na nga nadingun tua bangin tai un."},"25":{"text":"Kidemna-a a kihal dingte in na vannuoi-ah amau le amau a kideh uhi; amate ahi ule a kisie thei paakuol nga nadinga kidem ahi bo vua, ahi vangin eite i hi uleh a kisie thei lo paakuol nga dinga a kidem i hi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaci’n ngimna nei loin ka tai sih a, hui lah a mawh tuptup bang zong ka hi sih hi;"},"27":{"text":"ahi vangin keima in midangte tungah thu ka hil zaw ciengin kidemna-ah a kihal zo lo ka suo khah lo nadingin ka pumpi helbawl gawpin ka thuthu ka mangsah hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, meiipi nei-ah i pu i pate na omin a unpi-un san tuipi a na kantan vua,","title":"Israel-te Tangthu pan Hilkholna","ref":"Pei 13:21-22; 14:22-29"},"2":{"text":"amate a unpi-un meeipi le tuipi sung Moses kungah a na ki-baptize uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un a kibang hlagau an a ne vua,","ref":"Pei 16:35"},"4":{"text":"a unpi ma-un a kibang hlagau tui a dawn ciet uhi. Azieh pen amate in a nua a zui uh hlagau suongpi panin tui a dawn uhi, tua suongpi pen Khris ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 17:6; Gam 20:11"},"5":{"text":"Hinanle amate a tamzaw tungah Pasien lungkim lo ahi ziehin gamlahah a kisatlia sieng hi.","ref":"Gam 14:29-30"},"6":{"text":"Amate bangin eite in thusie i lunggul lo nadingin eite’ ette dinga tami thute ang pieng ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 11:4"},"7":{"text":"“Ne ding dawn dingin mipite a to vua, a lam dingin a dingto uhi,” ci-in a kigiel ma bangin amate kimkhat in a bieh bangun milim biete na suoh sih un.","ref":"Pei 32:6"},"8":{"text":"Amate kimkhat in a numei pasal pahtatna a bawl vua, ni khat thu-in mi tul sawm ni le tul thum a si bangun eite in numei pasal pahtatna i bawl poma sih ding hi.","ref":"Gam 25:1-18"},"9":{"text":"Amate kimkhat in Khris na ze-et uh ahi ziehin gul in a na tuhkia bangin i ze-et sih ding uhi.","ref":"Gam 21:5-6"},"10":{"text":"Amate kimkhat bangin phunphun sih un, tuaci’n a susie pa in a amate a susie sieng hi.","ref":"Gam 16:41-49"},"11":{"text":"A pieng tam thute pen etsahna dingin amate tunga na pieng ahi a, leitung tawpkuon hun sunga a om eite hil nadinga na kigiel ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n a dingkip a na kingaisut leh na pua lo nadingin kidawm in."},"13":{"text":"Note tungah mi zosie tunga a tung ngai lo ze-etna ang tung sih ding hi. Pasien pen a thuman ahi a, ama in na thuoh zawh lo uh ze-etna ang thuohsah sih ding hi. Note in na thuoh zawh nadingun tua ze-etna panin suotah nading lampi zong ang bawlpieh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka lawm itte aw, milim biehna panin na tai un."},"15":{"text":"Thu ngaisun theite kunga gen banga kang gen ahi hi. Ka gen thute noma mama in khentel un."},"16":{"text":"Eite in lungdam i ko uh tua lungdamna hai khu Khris’ sisan sunga i kihalna uh hi lo amah? Eite in i balnen uh ahi tua khomun i nehna uh zong khu Khris’ pumpi sunga i kihalna uh hi lo amah?","ref":"Mat 26:26-28; Mrk 14:22-24; Luk 22:19-20"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile khomun lum khat om a, eite zosie in tua khomun lum khat i nehton ziehun, a tampi ahi eite pumkhat i hi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Israel mite thu ngaisun un. Biehpiehna an a ne mite pen maitam tawh kipawl hi lo uh amah?","ref":"Siem 7:6"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahile bang gen nuom ka hi ahei? Milim biehna ante thupi a ci ka mah? Ahi sihle milim biehna thupi a ci ka hei?"},"20":{"text":"Hi lo hi, ka gen nop thu in, lawkite’ kithoina pen dawite tunga a kithoina uh ahi bo a, Pasien tunga a biehpiehna uh ahi sih hi. Dawite tawh na kipawl ding uh ka dei sih hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:17"},"21":{"text":"Topa’ hai le dawite’ hai na dawnton thei sih ding uhi. Note in Topa’ sabuoi le dawite’ sabuoi ah an na imton thei sih ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi sihle eite in Topa’ hazatna a sosah ding i hi uh amah? Ama sangin i hatzaw uh amah?","ref":"Thkna 32:21"},"23":{"text":"“Bangkim sep thei nading thu a op vangin bangkim phattuomna hi tuon lo hi. Bangkim sep thei nading thu a op vangin bangkim in ei kipsah tuon lo hi.","title":"Bangkim Pasien’ Minthan nadingin Sem in","ref":"1Cor 6:12"},"24":{"text":"Noma’ phattuom nading beh sui loin mi dangte phattuom nading suizaw un."},"25":{"text":"A sie le a pha theina lungsim ziehin bangma dong vateh loin sa zuana-a kizua sa khat popo ne lel un."},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Leitung le a sunga sil bangkim Topa -a’ ahi hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Late 24:1"},"27":{"text":"Thu um lo mi khat in an ne dingin ang hlat a, haw na sawm leh lungsim kisuonna a op lo nadingin na mai-a kilui popo dong loin ne suh lel in."},"28":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khatpo in na kungah, ‘Tami milim biehna sa ahi hi,’ ang ci leh tua ang gen mipa na khuolna le a sie le a pha theina lungsim ziehin na ne da mai in."},"29":{"text":"Kitheina lungsim ka ci ciengin nang-a’ beh a ci nuom ka hi sih a, adangte-a’ zong a ci nuom ka hi hi. Ka suotahna pen bang dingin midang khat’ kitheina lungsim in thu khensah laizang ding ka hei?"},"30":{"text":"Lungdamna tawh ka neh leh lungdam ko-a ka nehna ziehin bang dingin ei kigensie ding ahei?"},"31":{"text":"Tuaci’n nehna dawnna-a kipanin na sil bawl poma uh bangkimah Pasien’ minthan nadingin na bawl un."},"32":{"text":"Jew mite ahi a, Greek-te ahi a, Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpi ahi zongin lungkhamsah sih unlen,"},"33":{"text":"amate hutdam ahi thei nadingun ka sepna bangkimah keima’ phattuom nading sui loin, mi zosie’ phattuom nading sui-in, mikim lungkim nading ka hanciem ma bangin no zong na hanciem un."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khris ka ette bangin kei ei ette un.","ref":"1Cor 4:16; Phil 3:17"},"2":{"text":"Na vannuoi-ah kei ei phawhin note tunga kang piehsawn tang ngainate na zui ziehun kang pahta mama uhi.","title":"Lutuomna"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi zosie’ lutang pen Khris hi a, zi’ lutang pen pasal hi-in, Khris’ lutang pen Pasien ahi hi, ci thu note in na thei ding uh ka dei hi."},"4":{"text":"A lutuom kawmin thu ngenin kam a sang pasal poma pen a lutang daisah ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin numei khatpo in lu tuom loin thu ngenin kam a san leh tua pen a lutang’ daisah ahi a, a sam kimettol numei tawh kibang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile numei in a lu a tuom sih ding leh a sam a heu ding ahi hi. Sam heu ding ahi a, a met tol ding ahi zongin zumhuoi a sah leh a lu a tuom ding ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen pasal pen Pasien’ lim le mel kilahna ahi ziehin a lu a tuom ding a kilawm sih hi. Hinanle numei pen pasal’ mel kilahna ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 1:26-27"},"8":{"text":"A tahtahin cilei numei panin pasal kipiengsah lo a, pasal pana numei kipieng sah ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Numei adinga pasal kipiengsah hi lo a, pasal adinga numei kipiengsah hizaw hi.","ref":"Pien 1:26-27"},"10":{"text":"Tami thu zieh le vantung mite ziehin numei in a lu tungah thu a kineina lim a nei dingin kilawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangbang hitale Topa sungah pasal loin numei tuomdin zo lo a, pasal zong numei lo-in tuomdin zo tuon lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen pasal panin numei a pien ma bangin pasal zong numei sung pana pieng ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"No le no thu kikhen un: Numei khat in a lu tuom loin Pasien kunga thu a nget ding a kilawm amah?"},"14":{"text":"Pasal in a sam a sausah leh zumhuoi hi, ci thu leitung pienzie mama in zong ang hil uh hi lo amah?"},"15":{"text":"Hinanlezong numei a sam a sau leh ama’ minthanna hi lo amah? Azieh pen ama’ sam sau pen a kituom nadinga kipie ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle tami thu a niel nuom a op khah leh eite in tua bang ngaina i nei sih vua, Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpite in zong a nei tuon sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in a nei-a kithuhilnate-ah note kang pahta sih hi. Bangzieh ahei cile na kikhop ciengun hoina hi loin sietna hizaw hi.","title":"Nitah An Zahkhielnate"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a masa penah hlattuom pawlpi khat banga na kikhop ciengun note lahah kikhennate om hi, ci ka za a, tua pen bangtan cieng ahiei khat man dingin ka um hi."},"19":{"text":"A tahtahin note lahah kikhenna a om ding ma ahi hi, azieh pen tua bang cieng ma behin note lahah a tahtah teng ang kitel pan ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na kikhop uh cienga na neh uh pen Topa’ nitah an ne tahtah na hi sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a hun a tun ciengin noma’ an ciet na kineh masah vua, pawlkhat gilkielin adang pawlkhat zukhamin a om uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khu bang bep ahei! Na neh na dawn nading uh inn nei lo na hi uh amah? Tua ahi sihle Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpi simmaw-in bangma nei lote a zumsisah nuom na hi uh amah? Note kungah bang hing gen leng kilawm ding ahei? Note kang pahta ding amah? Tami thu-ah kang pahta vawt sih ding hi!"},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa tung pana ka nga, note tunga kang gensawn thu in, ama a kileheh ni zan-in Topa Jesu in khomun la-in","title":"Nitah An a Pienna"},"24":{"text":"lungdam a ko zaw ciengin phalsuo a, “Tami in note adinga a kipie ka pumpi ahi hi. Kei nei phaw nadingun tam bangin na bawl un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ma bangin nitah an a neh zaw ciengun hai la a, “Tami hai in ka sisan sunga thuciemna tha ahi hi. Tam banga na dawn sielun kei nei phaw nadingun na bawl un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 24:6-8; Jer 31:31-34"},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in tami khomun ne-in hai na dawn sielun ama ang pei masangsie Topa’ sina a tangkoko na hi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a kilawm lopi-in khomun ne-in Topa’ hai a dawn poma Topa’ pumpi le a sisan tungah a maw ahi hi.","title":"Kilawm Lopi-in Nitah An Nehna"},"28":{"text":"No le no kisittel phot unlen, tua zaw cieng behin khomun ne-in hai dawn pan un."},"29":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama’ pumpi telcien lopi-a a ne a dawn poma in ama tungah thukhenna a tun nadinga a ne a dawn ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua thu ziehin note lahah mi tampi zawngkhalin a dammaw vua, mi pawlkhat in a silaw uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin ei le ei thu i kikhen zo tah leh thukhenna i thuoh ta sih ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanle Topa in thu ei khen ciengin leitung mite tawh mawsah thukhenna i thuoh lo nadinga eite thu ei kihil ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin sanggamte aw, Topa’ nitah an ne dinga na kikhop ciengun khatlekhat na kingah bo un."},"34":{"text":"Tua banga na kikhop uh ciengin mawsah thukhenna na thuoh lo nadingun, na gil uh a kiel leh na inn vuah an ne masa un. Keima kang tun ciengin thudangdang teng kang hil ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tu-in hlagau letsongte tawh kisai thu na thei lo ding uh ka dei sih hi.","title":"Hlagau Letsongte"},"2":{"text":"Lawki na hi lai-un a ham thei lo milimte opna munah note ang kizawlin ang kipuimang lam na thei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien’ Hlagau tawh thu gen koima in, “Jesu kisamsie heh!” ci ngai lo a, Hlagau Siengtho hang longal tawh koima in, “Jesu in Topa hi,” a ci thei lo lam na thei ding uh ka dei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in ahile letsong tuomtuom a op vangin Hlagau a kibang ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nasepna tuomtuom a op vangin Topa a kibang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Sil bawlna tuomtuom a op vangin mi zosie sungah tuate zosie ei semsah Pasien a kibang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mikim’ hoi nadingin mi zosie tungah Hlagau kilahna kipie ciet hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua Hlagau tungtawnin mi khat tungah pilna kipie a, tua Hlagau ma tawh adang khat tungah thu theina,"},"9":{"text":"adang khat tungah tua Hlagau ma tawh upna kipie a, adang khat tungah tuami Hlagau ma tawh cina damsah theina letsongte,"},"10":{"text":"adang khat tungah na lamdang bawl theina, adang khat tungah kamsan theina, adang khat tungah hlate khentel theina, adang khat tungah ham nam tuomtuomte ham theina, adang khat tungah tua hamte a khietna gen theina ci bangin kipie hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam teng zosie a kibang hlagau khat guoh nasep ahi a, ama’ deina bangin mimal khat ciet tungah a hawmpieh hi.","ref":"Rom 12:6-8"},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile pumpi pen khat ahi a, tua in nate tampi nei hi. Pumpi’ na zosie tampi a phah vangin pumpi khat beh hi a, Khris zong tua ma bang ahi hi.","title":"Pumpi Khat le Pumpi’ Nate","ref":"Rom 12:4-5"},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen Jew mite ahi a, Greek-te ahi zongin, silate ahi a, sila lote ahi zongin, eite i unpi-un Hlagau khat in pumpi khat sungah ei baptize zo ta hi. Eite i unpi-un Hlagau khat a dawnton dingin ei kibawl zo hi."},"14":{"text":"A tahtahin pumpi in na khat beh nei loin tampi tawh kibawl hizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Keng in, “Khut ka hi lo ziehin pumpi-a’ ka hi sih hi,” ci leh tua a cina lel tawh pumpi’ nate khat ahi khiem tuon lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuale bil in, “Mittang ka hi lo ziehin pumpi-a’ ka hi sih hi,” ci leh tua a ci na lel tawh pumpi’ nate khat ahi khiem tuon lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pumpi zosie mittang hi sieng leh khuozah theina ding hei sungah a om ta ding ahei? Pumpi zosie khuozah theina hi sieng ta leuleu leh zong a gimnam zah theina ding hei sungah a om ta ding ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Hinanle Pasien in ama’ deiteel bangin pumpi sungah tua nate a guong kim hi."},"19":{"text":"A unpi-un pumpi’ na khat beh hi sieng leh pumpi hei-ah om ta ding ahei?"},"20":{"text":"Ahi bang cietun pumpi’ na tampi a op vangin pumpi khat beh a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Mittang in khut kungah, “Nang kang tulmaw sih hi,” a ci thei sih a, lutang in zong keng kungah, “Nang kang tulmaw sih hi,” a ci thei tuon sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuale mahin a thanem zaw tawh a kibang pumpi’ nate pen a kitulmaw teng hi thei zaw a,"},"23":{"text":"i thupi sim khol lo pumpi’ nate pen i nah patawite hi thei zawsop hi. I zatah khol lo nate zong nahpi taha i zatahte hi thei zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Kilawm i sah i pumpi’ nate a kisam lo zawteng ahi hi. Ahi vangin Pasien in tua bangin pumpi a lem dinga a na bawl ahi a, ama in a gina lo nate a patawi huoi zaw-in na koi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaci’n pumpi sungah kithutuo lona ci om loin pumpi nate khatlekhat a kikep ciet thei nading uh ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Khat in gimna a thuoh leh a unpi-un thuohton cietin khat in patawina a nga leh zong a unpi-un a lungdamton ciet uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tu-in note pen Khris’ pumpi na hi vua, mi khat ciet zong pumpi’ nate na hi kim uhi."},"28":{"text":"Pasien in hlattuom pawlpi sungah a masa penin sawltahpite, a nina-ah kamsangte, a thumna-ah lai hilte, tua ciengin na lamdang bawlte, tua ciengin cina damsah theina letsong ngate, mi hu theite, vaihawm makaite, ham nam tuomtuom ham theite ci bangin a se hi.","ref":"Eph 4:11"},"29":{"text":"A unpi-un sawltahpite ahi uh amah? A unpi-un kamsangte ahi uh amah? A unpi-un thuhil siete ahi uh amah? A unpi-un na lamdang a bawl uh amah?"},"30":{"text":"A unpi-un cina damsahna letsongte a nei uh amah? A unpi-un ham tuomtuomte a ham uh amah? A unpi-un a khietna a gen uh amah?"},"31":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in a thupizaw letsongte na nga thei nadingun na hanciem un. Keima in a thupizaw lai lampi note kang lah ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihingte’ ham le vantung mite’ hamin thu gen phiel ma nanleng itna ka nei sih leh zampi ginsie le daltuo ging bang lel ka hi bo hi.","title":"Itna Letsong"},"2":{"text":"Keima in kamsan theina nei-in thuthuh zosie le theina zosie zong nei-in, muolte kinsah zawh nading upna ka nei phiel ta zongin itna ka nei sih leh kei bangma ka hi tuon sih hi.","ref":"Mat 17:20; 21:21; Mrk 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Keima in ka neisa zosie hawm siengin ka kisiel nadingin ka pumpi pie phiel nanleng zong itna ka nei sih leh phattuomna a om tuon sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Itna in lungduoi-in migi hi; itna in thangsie loin a kipha sah sih a, zong a kiliensah sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Itna in a ama’ ang sung ding beh a khuoltentun sih a, lungthah bai loin mi’ mawna ciemte lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Thuman lote kipahpi loin thuman thutahah a kipah hi."},"7":{"text":"Itna in thu zosie puo zo a, thu zosie zong um hi. Na vannuoi lamen a, na zosie thuoh zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Itna in tawp hun nei lo hi. Ahi vangin kamsannate mangthai ding hi; kamtuom hamte khawl ding hi; theinate zong tawp ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen eite in a bukim loin i thei vua, a bukim loin kam i sang uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin a bukim thu ang tun ciengin a bukim lo pen maimang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Naupang ka hi lai-in, naupang bangin thu ka gen a, naupang bangin thu ngaisunin naupang bangin ka lungngai hi; ahi vangin ka khangham ciengin naupang vai teng ka tawpsan hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tu-in eite in limlang a et bangin kicien loin ahi milmielin i mu bep vua, hinanle khum hun tah ciengin kimaituo-in i mu ding uhi. Tu-in a bukim loin ka thei hi; khum hun ciengin a kicing a ei kithei bangin ken zong a bukimin ka thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale tu-in upna, lametna, le itna tam teng thum a om den uhi. Tam teng lahah a thupi pen itna ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itna del unlen, hlagau letsongte lunggul un, adiehin kamsang a thugenna lunggul pen un.","title":"Kamsanna le Kamtuom Letsongte"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kamsang a thugente in mihingte kunga thugen hi loin Pasien kunga thugen ahi zaw uhi; azieh pen amate in hlagau sungah thuthuhpite a gen ziehun koima in amau’ thugen a theithei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin kamsang thu hilte pen midangte’ kilam nading, a kihanthot nading le a kihenep nading vua thugen ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kamtuom tawh a hamte in amau le amau kikipsah ahi a, ahi vangin kamsang a thu hilte in hlattuom pawlpi a kipsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in na unpi-un kamtuom tawh na ham ding uh ka dei a, hinanle kamsang a thu na hil ding uh ka deizaw pehpeh hi. Hlattuom pawlpi a kilam nadingin mi khat in kamtuom a thuhil pa’ thugen a phenpieh sih leh ama sangin kamsang a thuhil pa a thupizaw ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in sanggamte aw, na kung vua kang haw ciengin kamtuom tawh thu hing genin, kilahna ahi a, theina ahi zongin, kamsanna ahi a, thuhilnate ahi zongin kimkhat hing gen sih mawh leng bangci bangin note hing phatuomsah ding ka hei?"},"7":{"text":"Hinna a nei lo tum thei vante ahi theile, harp lasahnate zong tua bang ma ahi uhi. A aw cientahin hing ging sih mawh leh bang awkaih tawh kitum ahei, ci pen koi-in theithei ding ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Pengkul zong kicientahin ging sih leh galsim dingin koi kithawi thei ding ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Note zong tua bang ma na hi uhi; note in a kithei lo ham tawh thugen locin na thugen uh koi in bangci theithei ding ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile hui lahah thugen na hi lel ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Leitungah kamham nam tuomtuom tampi om tahpi a, a khietna nei lo khat beh a om sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin kamham a khietna ka thei sih leh thugen pa adingin kei pen gamdang mi ka suoh a, thugen pa zong kei adingin gamdang mi a suoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note zong tua ma bang na hi uhi; note in Hlagau letsongte lunggulin na nei tah ngalun hlattuom pawlpi a kilamkip nadingin a thupizawte nei ding na hanciem un."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kamtuom tawh thu gen mi in a khietna a gen thei nadingin thu ngen heh."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kamtuom tawh thu ngen leng ka hlagau tawh thu ngen ka hi vangin ka lungsim in phattuomna a nga sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ka law ta diei? Keima in hlagau tawh thu ka ngen ding a, ahi vangin lungsim tawh zong thu ka ngen ding hi; keima in hlagau tawh la ka sa ding a, ahi vangin lungsim tawh zong la ka sa ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bang ahi sihle na hlagau tawh lungdam na ko ciengin pulam mi khatpo in na lungdam kona-a na thugente a thei lo ziehin bangci bangin “Amen’ ci thei ding ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Nang na hile hoitaha lungdam a ko na hi kha ding a, ahi vangin tua in midangte a kipsah sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima in note zosie sangin kamtuom tawh thu gen theizaw ka hi ziehin Pasien tungah ka lungdam hi."},"19":{"text":"Hizongle hlattuom pawlpi sungah midangte thuhil nadingin kamtuom teng tul sawm ka ham sangin a kithei kamteng nga ka gen nuomzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na thu ngaisutna vuah naupang bang sih un; gitlona lamah ahi thei tanin nausen bang unlen, ahi vangin thu ngaisutna lamah khanghamte bang un."},"21":{"text":"Thukham laibu sungah, “A lamdang mite’ ham le gamdang mite’ ham tawh tam mite tungah thu ka gen ding a, tua cieng nangawnin zong amate in ka thugente a ngai sih ding uhi,” ci-in kigiel hi, Topa in a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 28:11-12"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciengin kamtuomte pen thu um mite adingin lim hi loin thu um lo mite ading hizaw hi. Tua ma bangin kamsang a thuhilna zong thu um lo mite ading hi loin thu um mite ading hizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin hlattuom pawlpi buppi kikhawmin kamtuomte tawh ham cietin, a pulam mite ahi sihle thu um lo mite hing lut uleh mimaw lomtang hi bo, ang ci sih ding uh amah?"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note in na unpi-un kamsang a thu na hil laitahun thu um lo mi khat ahi a, pulam mi khat ahi zongin hing lut leh mi zosie in tua pa a mawsah ding vua, mi zosie in ama’ khielna a kiphawhsah ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Thu um lo mipa’ lungtang sunga a thusimte kipholah zaw ciengin, Pasien mai-ah tua pa kunin bie-in, “Note lahah Pasien om tahtah hi,” ci ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin ka lawmte aw, bang bawl ding i hei? Note na kikhop ciengun biehna la khat ahiei, hil ding khat ahiei, kilahna khat ahiei, kamtuom khat ahiei, a khietna genna khat ahiei, khat ta na nei ciet uhi. Sil bangkim kilamkip nadingin na zang un.","title":"A Kilawm Biehpiehna"},"27":{"text":"Mi khatpo in kamtuom tawh thu a gen leh mi ni ahi sihle a tam pen mi thum in khat zaw khat a banbanin gen beh hinlen khat in kamphen taheh."},"28":{"text":"Kamphen ding koima a op sih leh kikhopna sungah kamtuom tawh a gen dingte sip dide uh hinlen, amau le amau Pasien tawh kiho ta uheh."},"29":{"text":"Kamsang ni ahi sihle thum bang in thu gen hinlen, adang teng in a kigente khinkhai uheh."},"30":{"text":"A gei-a to midang khat tungah Pasien kilahna a tun leh thugen masa pa sip phot heh."},"31":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie in thu a thei nading ule a kihanthawn thei nadingun na unpi-un khat zaw khat a banbanin kamsangin thu na hil thei uhi."},"32":{"text":"Kamsangte’ hlate kamsangte’ uhna nei-ah a om uhi."},"33":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien pen buoina Pasien hi loin kilemna Pasien hizaw hi. (Misiengte’ hlattuom pawlpi zosie-ah a kizah dan bangin,"},"34":{"text":"biehinn sungah numeite sip dide uheh. Bangzieh ahei cile amate a thu gen ding uh a kiphal sih a, thukham in zong a gen ma bangin amate pen uhna nei-a om ding hizaw uhi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in thei nop khatpo a nei uleh inn ah a pasal ciet uh dong ta uheh. Azieh pen hlattuom pawlpi sungah numei khat in thu a gen ding a zumhuoi ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi sihle no tung pana Pasien’ thu hing kipan amah? Ahi sihle Pasien’ thu tunna no beh na hi uh amah?"},"37":{"text":"Mi khatpo, kamsang ahi sihle hlagau vanglietna nei bang khata a kingaisut leh ama in na kung vua kang gielte Topa’ thupiehin sang taheh."},"38":{"text":"Mi khatpo in tam thute a thudon sih leh ama zong thudon da pai un."},"39":{"text":"Tuaci’n ka lawmte aw, note in kamsang a thuhil ding lunggul penin na nei unlen, kamtuom tawh thugen zong na kham sam sih un."},"40":{"text":"Ahi vangin sil bangkim a kilawm a kituoha bawl ding ahi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in sanggamte aw, note kunga kang gen, note in zong na sansa ule kiptaha na dinpisa uh lungdamna thute na phawkia ding uh ka dei hi.","title":"Khris’ Thawkiana"},"2":{"text":"Keima in na kung vua kang gen thute note in hoitaha na tuhkip nah uleh lungdamna thu tungtawnin gupna nga na hi vua, tua ahi sihle na upna uh a mawhna ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a thupi masa penin keima in ka sansa kang hopsawn thu in tami ahi hi: Lai Siengtho in a gen ma bangin eite’ mawna tangin Khris in sina thuoh a,","ref":"Isa 53:5-12"},"4":{"text":"ama kivui-in Lai Siengtho in a gen bangin a ni thum ni-in thokia a,","ref":"Late 16:8-10; Mat 12:40; Sawl 2:24-32"},"5":{"text":"Peter tungah kilahin tua ciengin sawm le nite kungah kilah hi.","ref":"Luk 24:34, 36; Mat 28:16-17; Mrk 16:14; Jhn 20:19"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin sanggam za nga sanga a tamzawte tungah thakhatin kilah a, tuate lahah pawlkhat a si zo tah vangun a tamzaw in ei hinpi lai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin James kungah ama kilah a, tua ciengin sawltahpite zosie kungah zong kilah hi."},"8":{"text":"A nukhia penin a hun cing lopi-a a suoh nausen tawh a kibang keima kungah ang kilah hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:3-6"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kei pen sawltahpite lahah a gina lo pen ka hi a, Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpi ka bawlsiet ziehin sawltahpi ci dingin zong a kilawm ka hi sih hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3"},"10":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ hepina ziehin kei pen ka hi bang ka hi a, ama in kei tunga ei pieh a hepina pen a mawhna suoh lo hi. Tuale mahin amate khatpo sangin zong nasep ka hakat zaw a, - tua khu kei sep hi sih nanle - keima ei ompi Pasien’ hepina in a sep ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahile keima ka hi a, amate ahi zongin tua bangin thu ka hil vua, note in zong tua bang ma-in na um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in sina panin Khris thokia zo hi, ci-in kihil zo ahile no pawlkhat in bangci dan a misite’ thawkiana om lo hi, ci thei na hi uh ahei?","title":"Misite Thawkiana"},"13":{"text":"Misite thawkiana om lo hi leh Khris zong a kithosah lo hi ding hi;"},"14":{"text":"Khris a kithosah lo khat hi poma leh ka thugenna uh a mawhna suoh ding a, na upna uzong a mawhna ma suoh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Misite thokia lo hi, ci thu a man tahpi leh Pasien in Khris zong a thosah lo ahi hi. Pasien in sina panin Khris thosahkia zo hi, ci-in teci ka pan ziehun kote nangawn zong Pasien thu’ a man lopi-a genin ei kimu ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile misite thokia lo hi leh Khris zong a thokia lo hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khris a thokia lo hi leh na upna uh a thawn hi ding a, na mawna sung vua omlai na hi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin Khris sunga a sisa mite zong a mangthai sieng ahi ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Khris sungah tami hinkhuo ading beha lametna nei i hi uleh mi zosie lahah a hepihuoi pen i hi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanle sina panin Khris thokia tahtah zo a, a sisa mite lah panin ga masa pen ahi ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khat ziehin sina a tun ma bangin mi khat tungtawn ma-in misite thawkiana a tung hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Adam sungah mi zosie a si bangin Khris sungah mi zosie kihingsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle a hun ciet uh zui-in hi ding hi: Khris ahile ga masa pen hi a, ama ang peikia ciengin Khris-a’ teng a hingkia ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin tawpna hun ang tung ding a, ama in vaihawmte zosie, thuneite zosie, le vanglietna zosie a suhsiet zaw ciengin Pa Pasien kungah kumpi gam a ap ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a galte zosie a keng nei-ah a koi masangsie vai a hawm ding hi.","ref":"Late 110:1"},"26":{"text":"A kisusie ding gal nukhia pen sina ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Pasien in ama’ keng nei-ah sil bangkim koi zo hi,” kici hi. Hinanle, “Ama’ keng nei-ah sil bangkim kikoi zo hi,” a ci ciengin Khris’ nei-ah sil bangkim a koi Pasien a huom khah lo lam kitel hi.","ref":"Late 8:6"},"28":{"text":"Khris’ khut nei-ah sil bangkim a kikoi ciengin Pasien pen sil bangkim ah sil bangkim ahi thei nadingin a khut nei-a sil bangkim a koi Pasien’ khut nei-ah Tapa mama zong a om ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua hi sih mawh leh misite tanga ki-baptize mite in bang a bawl ta ding vuoi? Misite a thokia lo hi leh amate tangin bang dingin mite ki-baptize uh ahei?"},"30":{"text":"Tuale bang dingin ko le ko a nai simin kizausah den uh ka hei?"},"31":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note ziehin i Topa Jesu Khris sungah ka kisahthei zakhat ma bangin nisimin sina a thuohthuoh ka hi hi!"},"32":{"text":"Mihing lametna maimai tawh hi leh Ephesus khuo-a gamsate tawh ka kibawna bang phattuompi leltah ding ka hei? Misite kithosah lo hi leh, “Zing cienga si ding i hi tah ziehun kineh kidawn va vui,” i ci lel ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 22:13"},"33":{"text":"Mi kisolsah sih un: “Kigoppi hoi lo in opdan hoite siesah hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Hoitahin thu ngaisun pha unlen na maw nawn sih un; bangzieh ahei cile mi kimkhat in Pasien thu a thei sih uhi. Keima in na maizum nading vua kang gen ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi pawlkhatte in, “Misite bangci danin ang thokia ding uh ahei? Bangci pumpi tawh ang tho ding uh ahei?” ci-in ang dong ding uhi.","title":"A Thokia Pumpi"},"36":{"text":"Mimaw pa! Na khaici tu pen a si phot sih leh a hing thei sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua na tu khaici khu ang po ding pen ahi sih a, mangbu hile, adang khatpo hile a tang tahtah na tuzaw hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama’ teelsa bangin Pasien in a kung posah a, khaici namciet ah ama’ kung ciet a pie hi."},"39":{"text":"Sa zosie zong a kibangkim sih a, mihing sa, ganhing sa, va sa, nga sa, ci bangin a nam tuomtuom a om hi."},"40":{"text":"Van pumpite om a, lei pumpite zong a om hi, ahi vangin van pumpite’ thupina nam khat hi a, lei’ pumpite’ thupina a tuom khat ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Ni in thupina nam khat nei a, hlapi in thupina a tuom khat nei-in, aasite in zong a tuom khat ma nei uhi; a tahtahin ci leih aasi khat le khat zong a thupina kilamdang hi."},"42":{"text":"Misite thawkiana zong tua ma bang ahi hi. A kitu pen a sie thei hi a, a thokia pen a sie thei lo ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A melsie-in kitu a, a mel hoi-in ang thokia hi. A thanemin kitu a, a vanglienin ang thokia hi."},"44":{"text":"Tahsa pumpi kitu a, hla pumpi-in ang thokia hi. Tahsa pumpi om ahile hla pumpi zong a om hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin, “Mi masa Adam pen hinna a nei mi khat ang suoh hi,” ci-in kigiel hi; hizongle a nukhia Adam pen hinna a pie hlagau a suoh hi.","ref":"Pien 2:7"},"46":{"text":"Ahi vangin hla pumpi om masa lo a, tahsa pumpi om masa-in tua ciengin hla pumpi a om ahi na bo hi."},"47":{"text":"Mi masapen pa leitung pan ahi a, leivui tawh kibawl mi ahi hi; a nina pa pen vantung pan ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Leivui-a kisiem mite pen leivui pana kisiem pa ma tawh kibang a, van mite pen vantung pana ang peipa ma tawh kibang hi."},"49":{"text":"Eite in leivui-a kibawl mihing mel i puoh ma bangin vanmi mel zong i puo ding uhi."},"50":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na kung vua kang gennop pen tami thu ahi hi: Tahsa le sisan in Pasien’ manggam a luo thei sih a, a kisie theite in a kisie thei lote a luo thei sih hi."},"51":{"text":"Ngai un, thuthuh khat kang gen ding hi! Eite zosie a si sieng ding i hi sih vua,"},"52":{"text":"pengkul nukhia pen ang gin ciengin mitphet kal bano khat sungin i unpi-un i kikhel sieng ding uhi. Azieh pen pengkul ang ging ding a, a sisa mite a sie thei nawn lo dingin ang tho ding a, eite i kikhel ding uhi.","ref":"1Thes 4:15-17"},"53":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami a sie thei pumpi in siet thei lona sil ta ding a, tami a si thei pumpi in zong si thei lona sil ta ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Tami a sie thei pumpi in siet thei lona silin, tami a si thei pumpi in si thei lona a sil ciengin, “Guol zawna sungah sina kival tum zo hi,”","ref":"Isa 25:8"},"55":{"text":"“Sina aw, na gu hei-ah a om ta a, sina aw, na guolzawna hei-ah a om ta ahei?” ci-a a kigielsa thu ang tangtung ding hi.","ref":"Hos 13:14"},"56":{"text":"Sina gu in mawna hi a, mawna’ vanglietna in thukham ahi hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahi vangin i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawna guolzawna ei pie Pasien tungah lungdam i ko hi."},"58":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kang itte aw, kiptahin dingin kilawh sih unlen, note in Topa sunga na nasepna uh a mawhna a hi lo lam thei na hi ziehun Topa’ nasepna ah a hoi thei penin ma na pang zing un."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in misiengthote ading sumpi kaikhopna tawh kisai-in: Galati pawlpite in a zui ding uh thu ka piehsa bangin note in zong na bawl un.","title":"Misiengthote ading Sumpi Kaikhopna","ref":"Rom 15:25-26"},"2":{"text":"Keima kang haw ciengin sumpi kaikhoptawm a a kisam lo dingin nipi kal khat sungah a ni masa ni-in khat ciet in na sum nga uh a val popo na tuomkoi unlen na khol un."},"3":{"text":"Kang tun ciengin Jerusalem ah na letsongte uh a puoh dingin pha na sah uh mi khatpo sawlin lai tawh kang peisah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei zong ka va pei ding hoi i sah leh amate tawh ka va kithuo ta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Macedonia gam nawhin khuolzin sawm ka hi ziehin Macedonia gam ka zin zaw ciengin na kung vuah kang haw ding a,","title":"Paul’ Khuolzin Gelna","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"6":{"text":"ka khuolzinna ka peina khat popo-ah nei panpi thei nadingun na kung vuah bakhat sung ahi sihle phalbi sung nangawn kang tam thei kha mai ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tu-in note kungah ang lambang pahin i kimu ding ka nuom sih hi. Topa’ awina a op leh note tawh bakhat sung i opton ding ka lamen hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pentecost pawi dong Ephesus khuo ah ka tam ding hi.","ref":"Siem 23:15-21; Thkna 16:9-11"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ei langpang mi tampi a op tei vangin kei adingin a lawcing nasep theina kot a golpi-in kihong zo hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:8-10"},"10":{"text":"Timothy ang haw khah leh ama zong keima banga Topa’ na sem ahi tah ziehin note lahah bangma pautau loin a op nadingin na vaihawmpi un;","ref":"1Cor 4:17"},"11":{"text":"tua ahi ziehin koima na simmawsah sih un. Ama kei kunga ang kilekia thei nadingin a lampi-ah nuomtahin na hla un; azieh pen a sanggamte tawh ama ang zawhton dingin ka lamen hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in i sanggam pa uh Apollos tawh kisai-in, keima in sanggam dangte tawh na kung vua ang haw nadingin nahpi-in ka hanthawn hi. Ahi vangin tu tadi-a ang haw pai ding pen a lunglut nai sih hi. Hun lemtang a nga ciengin ama ang haw ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Pilvangin upna-ah dingkip unlen hangsanin thahat un.","title":"A Tawpna Thugenna le Hopinate"},"14":{"text":"Na sep na bawlna zosie vuah itna tawh sem un."},"15":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tu-in Stephanas’ innkuon pen Achaia gama thu um masa pente ahi vua, amate mama zong misiengthote’ nasepna-ah kipumpieh uhi, ci na thei uhi.","ref":"1Cor 1:16"},"16":{"text":"Note in tua bang mite le amate tawh a semton mi zosie’ thu na man dingun kang hanthawn hi."},"17":{"text":"Na op lo sung uh awng hu pah dingin Stephanas, Fortunatus le Achaicus-te ang haw thei ziehun ka kipah mama hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen amate in keima’ lungsim le nomau-a’ zong ei thakhausah hi. Tuaci’n tua bang mite na theisiem un."},"19":{"text":"Asia gama hlattuom pawlpite in ang noset uhi. Aquila le Prisca-te in zong ama’ inn sunga a kikhawm hlattuom pawlpi mite tawh Topa sungah lungsim tah tawh ang noset uhi.","ref":"Sawl 18:2"},"20":{"text":"Sanggamte zosie in zong ang noset uhi. A siengtho kinapna tawh khatlekhat na kinoset un."},"21":{"text":"Keima Paul in ka khut mama tawh tami kihopina lai kang giel ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa a it lo a koima po in samsiet thuoh taheh. I Topa ang pei hi!"},"23":{"text":"Note tawh Topa Jesu’ ei hepina hing om taheh."},"24":{"text":"Jesu Khris sungah note kang itna in note zosie tawh ang om den taheh."}}}}},"47":{"info":{"name":"2 Corinth","shortname":"2cor","abbr":[],"desc":"Corinth nina corinth tapidawte tunga paul’ laihlah nina (paul’s second letter to the corinthians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien deina zieha Jesu Khris’ sawltahpi Paul le i sanggam pa Timothy in, Corinth khuo Pasien’ hlattuom tung le Achaia gam sung tenga om misiengtho zosie tungah:","title":"Hopina","ref":"Sawl 18:1"},"2":{"text":"I Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung panin hepina le lungnopna thupha na tung vuah hing tung taheh."},"3":{"text":"Hepinate’ Pa le henepna zosie’ Pasien ahi i Topa Jesu Khris’ Pa Pasien in thupha nga taheh.","title":"Gentheina a Thuoh Zaw Cienga Paul’ Lungdam Kona"},"4":{"text":"Pasien in komama ei henep ziehin kote in zong gentheina khatpo a thuohte ka henep thei nadingun, ka gim thuohna zosie uh panin ama in ei henem hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Khris sungah gimna tampi ka thuoh ma bangun ama in Khris tungtawn ma-in a kicing henepna ei pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote in gimna ka thuoh uleh zong note’ henepna le kihutdam nading ahi hi; kote ei kihenep leh tuami pen kote thuoh bangbang note in na thuoh zawh nading vua thuohzawh hatna ang guon henepna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Note dinga ka kinepna uh a kip hi; azieh pen note in kote thuoh teng nei thuohpi ziehun kote nga ding henepna zong nei ngapi ding uhi, ci-in ka thei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Asia gam sunga ka thuoh uh gimnate thei lo-a na op ding uh ka dei sih hi; bangzieh ahei cile kote in thuoh zawh lo ding za-in gimna ka thuoh vua, hin tu zo lo ding za-in ka lung uh a kie gawp hi.","ref":"1Cor 15:32"},"9":{"text":"Hi tahpi hi, kote ka hi ule si nading thukhenna thuohin ka kingaisun vua, ahi vangin kote thuoh gimna pen ko le ko kimuong loin misite a thosah Pasien ka muon thei nading uh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in tua zataha a zauhuoi si theina panin ei hunkhie zo a, zong ei honkhie lai ding hi, ci-in ama tungah kinepna ka nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mi tampite’ thungetna tungtawnin kote ei kipie thupha ziehin mi tampi in kote’ adingin lungdamna ei kopieh thei nadingun, note in zong na thungetna utawh ei na panpi un."},"12":{"text":"Kote’ kitheina teci panna tahtah tami ahi hi: Kote ka hi ule leitung pilna tawh hi loin Pasien’ hepina vang tawh siengtah le Pasien’ dei lungsim tahpi tawh leitungah ka gamta vua, note tungah a hoizaw kanin kang gamta uhi.","title":"Paul’ Haw Ding a Hun Kisotto"},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na sim thei ding ule na theithei dingte uh ci simlo bangma kang giel sih uhi; a tawp donga a tel sieng dingin kang lamen uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesu’ ni ang tun ciengin kote pen note’ kisahtheina ka hi ma bangun, note nangawn zong kote’ kisahtheina na hi lam uh note in ka thu uh phabep khat na thei zo ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in tami thu ka theicien ziehin note in nivei patatna na nga thei nadingun na kung vuah kang haw masa nuom hi."},"16":{"text":"Macedonia gam ka pei kawmin note kungah hing lambangin, Macedonia panin zong kang hawkia ding a, Judea gam ka peina lamah ei hla locin ka nuom hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"17":{"text":"Tam bang ka bawl nuom ciengin lungsim a khel themthom ka hi amah? Gelnate ka nei ciengin mi maimaite dan bangin, “Ing heh,” ci vanuh a, “Hi sih,” a cikia nianua pawl ka hi amah?"},"18":{"text":"Pasien pen a muonhuoi tahpi ma bangin na kung vua kang thugente zong, “Ing heh,” zong ahi sih a, “Hi sih,” zong ahi tuon sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen Silvanus, Timothy le keima in note lahah kang hil uh Pasien’ Tapa Jesu Khris pen, “Ing heh,” ci-in, “Hi sih,” a cikia nianua pa hi lo hi; ama sungah, “Hi hi,” a ci vive ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:5"},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen ama sungah Pasien’ kamciemte zosie, “Hi hi,” vive ahi a, tam thu ziehin Pasien’ min a than thei nadingin kote in ama tungtawnin, “Amen,” ka ci ciet uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanle Khris sungah note tawh kote ei kipsah pa le sathau ei nu pa pen Pasien ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in eite tungah ama’ ciemtena seal hing tum a, i lungsim sungah ama’ Hlagau ahi malep ei guon zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin Corinth khuo-a kang hawkia lona pen note kang hepina ahi zawh lam ka teci dingin Pasien ka ko hi."},"24":{"text":"Na upna uh tungah thu nei nopna zieha tam bang a gen ka hi sih uhi; kote ka hi ule na lungdam nading vua note tawh nasemte ka hizaw uhi, azieh pen upna sungah note na ding kip uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in note a dasah kia dinga kang haw lo nadingin ka lungsim ka khensat zo hi."},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen note hing dasah mawh leng kang dasah nomate simlo ei lungdamsah ding koi om tuon ding ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Kang pei ciengin keima ei lungdamsah lawmte tung panin lungkhamna ka thuoh lo nadingin tami lai ang giel ka hi hi; bangzieh ahei cile keima’ lungdamna pen note zosie’ lungdamna zong hi ding hi, ci-in muonna ka nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note ang lungkhamsah nuom ka hi sih a, a kicing itna tawh note kang it lam kang theisah nopna ziehin hahsatna lienpi le lungkhamna teng kawmkal panin hlitui tampi luongin lai ang hlah ka hizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khatpo in dana a piensah leh keima tung beha ang bawl ahi sih a, ka uong genna ahi sih a, ama in no teng zosie tungah zong bangtan cieng khat ang bawl hizaw hi.","title":"A khiel Mi Maisahna"},"6":{"text":"Mi a tamzawte’ danpiehna pen tua bang mipa adingin kicing zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n lungkham seng kisa-in tua dana in ama a vuacip lo nadingin a mawna maisahin na henem zaw un."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in ama na itna uh na kipsahkia nading uh kang thum hi."},"9":{"text":"Note in sil bangkimah thu na mang vuoi mah, ci kang ze-et nopna le kang thei nopna zieha tami lai kang giel ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in maw na maisah popo uh ke’n zong ka maisah hi. Mawna ka maisahte zong nomate zieha Khris’ min tawh ka maisah ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Satan in ei nop neh lo nadinga eite in tamte i bawl ahi hi; azieh pen satan’ gelnate a thei lo i hi sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Khris’ lungdamna thu phuongzah dingin Troas khuo ka tun ciengin kei adingin Topa sungah kot khat ang kihong hi;","title":"Troas Khuo-a Paul’ Lunghimawna"},"13":{"text":"ahi vangin tua tahah ka sanggam pa Titus ka mu lo ziehin ka lung a nuom sih hi. Tuaci’n amate mangpha pai-in Macedonia ah ka peisuoh hi.","ref":"Sawl 20:1"},"14":{"text":"Khris sunga zawna pawikhamna ah kote ei pui-in muncin tengah Khris theina gimnamtui ang kizelsah Pasien tungah nuomthu tung taheh."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile gup nga mite le a mangthai mite lahah kote pen Pasien tungah Khris’ gimnamtui ka hi uhi;"},"16":{"text":"kote ka hi ule a kisie mi khat adingin sina pan sina a ngasah gimnamtui ka hi vua, adang khat adingin hinna pan hinna a ngasah gimnamtui ka hi uhi. Tam bang nate a sem dingin koi kicing zo ding ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kote ka hi ule sum nga thei nadinga Pasien’ thu a thangbawl mi tampite bang ka hi sih vua, Pasien kung pana kisawl mite bangin ama mai-ah mi citahte ka hina utawh Khris sunga thu gente ka hizaw uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ko le ko a kiphatkia dinga kipan ka hi ta uh amah? A tahtahin mi kimkhatte in a bawl bangin note kungah ahi sihle note tung panin genphatna lai ka kisam uh amah?","title":"Thuciem Tha Nasemte"},"2":{"text":"Note mama pen ka lungtang tung vua a kigiel, mi zosie in simin a thei kote’ lai na hi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Note na hi ule kote ei kipuosah Khris’ lai na hi vua, laitui tawh kigiel ahi lo, a hing zing Pasien’ hlagau tawh a kigiel, suongpeh tunga kigiel ahi lo, mihing’ lungtang suongpeh tunga a kigiel Khris’ lai na hina na lah uhi.","ref":"Pei 24:12; Jer 31:33; Ezk 11:19; 36:26"},"4":{"text":"Khris tungtawnin kote in Pasien lamah tua bang kimuonna ka nei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na khat popo ko tung pana pieng hi a, ko le ko in ka sem zo uhi, a ci ka hi sih uhi; ka sep zawhna uh pen Pasien kung pan ahi zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in thuciem tha nasem siemte ei suohsah zo a, tua pen lai-a kigiel thukham tawh hi loin Hlagau tawh hinna ei pie zo hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31"},"7":{"text":"Tu-in a muol thei ama’ maitang pana ang kikhaw a minthanna vang ziehin Israel mite in Mose’ maitang a etcien thei lo za a, sina a piengsah nasepna ahi suongpehte tunga kigielkuoh laimalte bawn minthanna tawh ang tung ahile,","ref":"Pei 34:29"},"8":{"text":"Hlagau nasepna khu bangza tahin minthanna tawh ang tungzaw kan lai ding ahei?"},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen mawsah thukhenna nasep bawn tua za-in minthang ahile, dih tanna nasepna khu nah minthan zaw kan lai ven izaw!"},"10":{"text":"A tahtahin a lienzaw minthanna om ta ahi ziehin nidanga a nei minthanna a nei nawn sih hi;"},"11":{"text":"azieh pen a kipaimangte bawn minthanna tawh tung buong sam ahile tua a kip tawntungte minthanna tawh tung zawkan lai lo ding amah!"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin kote in tam bang lametna nei ka hi ziehun hangtaha a sem ka hi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kote ka hi ule ama’ minthanna vang a kipaimang lam Israel mite in a mu khah lo nadingun a maitang diel tawh a khu Moses bang ka hi sih uhi.","ref":"Pei 34:33"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lungsim uh a khau mama hi. Tuni dong ciengin amate in thuciem lui a kisim a zah ciengun tua a kikhuna diel pen ma om lai hi, azieh pen Khris sung behah tua diel kipaimang hi."},"15":{"text":"A tahtahin tuni dongin Moses’ thukham laite a kisim sielin tua diel in amau’ lungsim a khu lai hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa lamah mi khat a kihei ciengin a mai a khu diel kihawpieh hi.","ref":"Pei 34:34"},"17":{"text":"Tu-in ahile Topa pen Hlagau ahi a, Topa’ Hlagau opna munah suotahna a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Eite in i unpi-un maitang kikhu loin limlang sunga ei lensawn bangin Topa’ minthanna vang i mu vua, ama’ mel sun dingin minthanna khat panin minthanna khatah i kikhel uhi; bangzieh ahei cile tami pen Hlagau ahi Topa kung pana ang pei ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kote in Pasien’ ei hepina tawh tami nasepna ka nei ziehun ka lungkie vawt sih uhi.","title":"Leibeel Sunga Gougil"},"2":{"text":"Kote in a simtham le a zumhuoi nate ka tawpsan uhi; misol bawlnate zang loin Pasien’ thu zong ka deikai sih uhi; ahi vangin thuman thutah a langtangin ka pholah vua, Pasien’ mitmu-ah mi zosie’ kitheina lungsim tawh kituoh dingin ka gamta zaw uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ka lungdamna thu hilte uh a kikhu leh a mangthaite tung beha kikhu ahi bo hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ lim ahi Khris’ minthanna zieha ang tang lungdamna khuovah a mu thei lo nadingun tami leitung pasien in a um lo mite’ lungsim mit a tawsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile koma’ thu a gen ka hi sih vua, Jesu Khris in Topa hi, ci thu le tua Jesu ziehin note’ sila ka hina uh ang gen ka hizaw uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Khuomiel lahah khuovah tang heh,” a ci Pasien in kote tungah Jesu Khris’ maitanga a tang Pasien’ minthanna theitheina khuovah ei pieh nadingin ama in kote’ lungsim sungah khuovah ang tangsah hi.","ref":"Pien 1:3"},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lien mama tami vanglietna pen ko kung pana ang pei hi loin Pasien-a’ ahi hi, ci thu a kicien thei nadingin kote in leibeel sungah tami gougil ka nei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Gimna tuomtuom ka thuoh vua, hinanle netcipin ka om sih uhi; lungmangin ka om vua, hinanle lungdongin ka om sih uhi;"},"9":{"text":"bawlsietna ka thuoh vua, hinanle taisanin ka om sih uhi; ei kisatpua a, hinanle ei kisusie lo hi;"},"10":{"text":"ka pumpi sung vuah Jesu’ hinna a kimu thei nadingin ka pumpi tung vuah Jesu’ sina ka puo zing uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a si thei ka pum tung vuah Khris’ hinna a kimu thei nadingin ka hin sungun Jesu ziehin sina a thuoh dinga a kipiekhie zing ka hi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n sina in kote sungah nasem a, ahi vangin hinna in note sungah na sem hi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongle, “Keima in ka um a, tuaci’n ka genkhie hi,” ci-a kigiel Lai Siengtho dung zui-in upna hlagau kibang ka nei ziehun kote in zong umin ka gen uhi.","ref":"Late 116:10"},"14":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa Jesu a thosah pa in kote zong Jesu tawh ei thosah kia-in, note tawh ama opna-ah ei tun ding hi, ci ka thei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hi hi, sil bangkim note khuolna ahi a, Pasien’ minthan nadingin mi tam semsemte tunga a tung tua hepina in lungdamkona a khansah thei nading ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n kote ka hi uleh ka lung uh a kie tuon sih hi. Ka pulam pienzie un muot lam ding a manaw vangin, ka sunglam pienzie uh a nini-in thasuo semsem hi.","title":"Upna Tawh Nungta"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a gentah lo bano khat sung ka thuoh uh tami gentheina in kote adingin tezawh lo a lien mama kumtawn minthanna ei bawlkhol pieh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen kote in a kimu thei nate mitsuon loin a kimu thei lo nate a mitsuon ka hi uhi; bangzieh ahei cile a kimu thei nate bakhat sung beh om ahi bo a, a kimu thei lo nate ahile kumtawnin a om hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Azieh pen i tenna uh leisiet puonbuh a kisiet a ahile khut tawh a kibawl lo, Pasien in a bawlsa kumtawn inn khat vantungah i nei lamtah i thei uhi."},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei i cile vantunga i ten nading mun ei kisilsah ding kal ngahla-in tami puonbuh ah khuisa-in i tau vangut uhi."},"3":{"text":"Eite in tuami i sil tahtah ciengin guohtanga om bangin ei kimu nawn sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen tami puonbuh sungah i op laitahin eite in vagih puo-in khuisa-in i tau vangut uhi, tua pen eite in puon i sil nuom lo zieh uh ahi sih a, puon ei kisebe ding i nop zieh ule hinna in a si thei pumpi a valtum ding i nop zieh uh hizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tami thu ei na bawlkholpieh pa pen khamkholna van dinga Hlagau ei pie Pasien ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n eite i hi leh lungmuongtahin i om zing uhi; i pumpi sunga i op laisie Topa tawh i kigamla hi, ci i thei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile muna tawh hi loin upna tawh i kalsuon uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hi hi, eite lungmuongtahin i om vua, pumpi tawh kigamla-in Topa tawh opton ding i nuomzaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n eite in inn ah i om a, a gamla-ah i om zongin, ama lungdamsah ding tup penin i nei uhi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Khris’ thukhenna topha mai-ah eite zosie i unpi-un i kilaa valon ding vua, tuaci’n i pumpi-a i bawlsa i gamtatna utawh kizui-in a sie ahi a, a pha ahi zongin a nga ciet ding i hi hi.","ref":"Rom 14:10"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin kote in Topa zatah dan ding ka thei ziehun midangte zawl ding ka hakat uhi; ahi vangin Pasien in koma mama ei theitel a, note in zong a sie le a pha na theina lungsim sung vuah ei theitel dingin kang lamen uhi.","title":"Kilemkiana Nasep"},"12":{"text":"Note mai-ah ko le ko a kiphattawm kia ka hi sih vua, a lungsim tawng uh ahi lo, a putham a kisahtheipi mite na dawnkia thei nading ule kote zieha na kisahthei nading uh hizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen ka mot uleh Pasien ading hi a, ka pil ule zong note ading ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie adingin mi khat si zo hi, ci thu thei ka hi ziehun tua Khris’ itna in kote ei thuzaw hi; tua ahi ziehin mi zosie a si uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale ama pen mi zosie adinga ang si ahi a, tua ahi ziehin a hing tasunte zong amau’ adinga a hing hi nawn loin, amau’ adingin si-in a thokiasah pa adinga hing ahi zaw uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-a kipanin kote in mihing mudan tawh koima ka mu nawn sih uhi; hun khat lai-in mihing mudan tawh Khris ka na thei ngai vangun, tua bang danin ama ka thei nawn sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi khatpo Khris sunga a op leh a kisiemtha ahi ta hi: a lui nate zosie mangthai zo hi; en un sil bangkim a tha a suoh zo hi!"},"18":{"text":"Tami thu zosie pen Khris tungtawnin ama tawh kote ei kilemsahkia Pasien kung pan ahi hi; ama in kote tungah kilemkiana nasep ei pie zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua pen a deina bang ahei cile Pasien in amau’ thupalsatnate ciemte loin, Khris sungah leitung mite le ama a kilemsahkia a, ama in tua kilemkiana thu a gen dinga kote ei ngansie ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaci’n kote pen Khris adingin palaite ka hi uhi; Pasien tawh na kilem un, ci-in Pasien in kote tungtawnin ang thum ma bangin kote in zong Khris tangin kang thum uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama sungah Pasien’ dihna ka tan thei nadingun, mawna a thei lo pa pen kote tang dingin Pasien in mawnei mi a suohsah hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama tawh na semton ka hi bangun Pasien’ hepina a mawhna-a a sang ka suo lo nadingun kang thum uhi."},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in, “San thei hunin na thu gen uh ka ngai a, hutdamna ni ciengin note kang hu hi,” a ci hi. En un, tulaitah pen san thei hun tah ahi hi; tulaitah pen hutdamna ni ahi hi!","ref":"Isa 49:8"},"3":{"text":"Ka nasep vuah khielna a kimu lo nadingin mi khatpo’ lampi-ah pua nading bangma ka koi sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle ko mama in Pasien’ nasemte ka hina uh sil bangkimah ka kilangsah uhi: thuohzawhna lienpite, genthei liengvainate, hahsatnate, vangsietnate,"},"5":{"text":"satnate, thongkiehnate, buoinate, na ham sepnate, zanlai-a kimutmaw law nate, le gilkielnate ahi a;","ref":"Sawl 16:23"},"6":{"text":"siengthona, thu theina, lungduoina, migitna, lungsim siengthona, itna tahtah tawh,"},"7":{"text":"thuman thutah genna le Pasien’ vanglietnate a kipan, zietlam le veilam ading dihna galhiemte tawh,"},"8":{"text":"patawina le simmawna ahi zongin, gensietna le genphatnate dong ciengah ka langsah uhi. Kote pen mi thumante ka hi vangun zuouthu gente bangin ei kingaisun hi;"},"9":{"text":"mi zosie in ei theitel vangin koima’ thei lote ka bang uhi; nei thei bangun a hing ka hi vangun a si dihtahte bangin ei kingaisun hi; gawtna dan ka thuoh vangun thalupin ka om sih uhi;"},"10":{"text":"a date tawh ka kibah vangun ka lungdam zing uhi; a zawng ka bah mawh vangun mi tampi ka hausah uhi; bangma nei lo ka bah vangun na zosie ka nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"No Corinth mite kungah siengtahin kang gen zo vua, ka lungsim uh ka golhon uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kote’ itna sungah ciengtan bangma a om sih a, noma’ sunga om hizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Kote-a’ bangin a kilawmin nei thuhkiana-un note in zong na lungsim uh golhon un, ci-in tate tunga thugen bangin kang gen hi."},"14":{"text":"Thu um lo mite tawh a kituoh lo hahkol na puoton sih un. Azieh pen dihna le gitlona kikalah bang kipawlna om thei ding ahei? Ahi sihle khuovah le khuomiel kikalah bang kipawlna om thei ding ahei?","title":"A Nungta Pasien’ Biehinnpi"},"15":{"text":"Khris in Beliar tawh bang thukimna nei ahei? Ahi sihle thu um mi khat in thu um lo mi khat tawh bang neiton ahei?"},"16":{"text":"Pasien’ biehinnpi in milimte tawh bang kithukimna nei ahei? Bangzieh ahei cile eite pen a hing zing Pasien’ biehinnpi i hi uhi. Pasien in, “Amate sungah tengin a lah vuah ka vah ding a, amau’ Pasien hi-in, amate keima’ mi ahi ding uhi.","ref":"1Cor 3:16; 6:19; Siem 26:12; Ezk 37:27"},"17":{"text":"Tua ziehin amate kung panin hing peikhie unlen, amate lah panin a tuomin om un, Topa in ci hi.
