A sieng lo poma tham kha sih un, tua hile keima in note kang sang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 52:11"},"18":{"text":"Keima na pa uh kang hi ding a, note zong keima’ tapate le tanute na hi ding uhi,” Vanglien Topa in ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:14; 1Khg 17:13; Isa 43:6; Jer 31:9"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka itte aw, eite in tam bang thuciemte i nei zo tah ngalin pumpi le hlagau buana zosie panin eima le eima kisiensuo-in Pasien zatahna lamah siengthona bukimsah vai."},"2":{"text":"Na lungtang sung vuah kote ading mun ei pie un; koima tungah ka khiel kha sih vua, koima khat zong siesah loin kote’ phattuom nadingin koima khat zong ka zang sih uhi.","title":"Pawlpite’ Kisiakia Zieha Paul’ Kipahna"},"3":{"text":"Note mawsah nopna tawh tami thu a gen ka hi sih hi, azieh pen i si leh sitonin i hin lezong a hington dingin ka lungsim sung vuah na om uhi, ci-in masang lai-in kang gen zo ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Note tungtangah tamveipi ka kisathei hi; note tungah kisahtheina lienpi ka nei hi; henepna tawh ka kidim hi; ka thuoh uh gentheina zosie-ah genzawh loin ka lung a dam hi."},"5":{"text":"Macedonia ka tun cieng nangawnun ka pumpi un khawl hun ci a nei sih a, ka kiheina zosie vuah gimna thuohin, a pulamah kihauna, le a sunglamah zaunate a om hi.","ref":"2Cor 2:13"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin a lungkie mite a henem Pasien in Titus ang tunna tawh kote ei henem a,"},"7":{"text":"ama ang tunna hang beh hi loin, note in ama na henepna hang uh zong ahi hi. Note in kei nei lunggulna uh, na dana ule keima dinga nei deisahnate uh zong ei gen a, tuaci’n ka kipah semsem lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kang laihlahna tawh note kang dasah lezong ka kisiakia sih a, (kisiakia nanleng tua laihlah tawh kang dasahna uh pen bakhat sung beh hi lel hi, ci ka thei hi)."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in kei ka kipah hi; na da zieh vua kipah ka hi sih a, na dana un ang kisiakiasahna zieha kipah ka hizaw hi; bangzieh ahei cile banglam banglamah kote ziehin bangma suplaw loin Pasien’ deina tawh kituoha a da na hizaw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien’ deina tawh a kituoh dana in hutdamna ei tut thei kisiakiana piengsah a, da nading bangma a om sih hi, ahi vangin leitung dana in sina a piengsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami Pasien lama dana in note sungah bang citahna, no le no kisiensuo nadingin bang lawpna, bang lungthahna, bang patauna, bang lunggulna, bang pawnthawna, bang gawtnate piengsah ahei ci thu en un! Note in tami thu-ah bang mun bang munah na maw lo lam uh na kilangsah zo ta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n keima in lai kang hlah vangin khielna bawl pa ahi sihle khielna thuoh pa zieha kang giel ahi sih a, note in Pasien mai-ah kote nei deisahna a kilah thei nadinga ang giel ka hizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tami thu-ah ka lung uh a nuom mama hi. Kote lungmuonna beh hi loin note zosie zieha Titus in lungsim tawldamna nga ahi ziehin ama’ lungdamna ziehin ka lungdam deudeu hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note kang kisielpina thu pawlkhat ama kungah gen nanleng ka maizum tuon sih hi; hinanle a hi bangbanga note tunga kang gensa thu zosie a man ahi ma bangin, Titus tunga ka kipawhna uzong a man ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Note zosie in bangci bangin thumangin zauna le linna tawh ama na sanna lam uh a ngaisutkia ciengin note ang itna a khang semsem hi."},"16":{"text":"Note tungah a bukim lungmuonna ka nei ziehin ka kipah mama hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note in Macedonia gam hlattuom pawlpite tunga kipie Pasien’ hepina thu na thei ding uh ka dei hi;","title":"Phaltaha Pieh ding Hanthotna"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen amate in gentheina lienpi a thuoh hun sungun zawng mama nan ule zong a lungdamna uh lien luo ahi ziehin amau’ lam panin piehkhietna lamsang a kiphal mama uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in a nei za uh dung zui-in pieh nopna lungsim tawh a pie vua, a nei za uh sanga a tamzaw nangawnin zong a pie uhi, ci thu teci ka pang hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam misiengthote adinga nasepna-ah amate kihalin hamphatna a nga thei nadingun kote kungah ang thum ngetngut uhi.","ref":"Rom 15:26"},"5":{"text":"Tua khu kote’ lametna maimai bang ahi sih a, amate mama Topa tungah kipie masa-in, tua zaw ciengin Pasien’ deina bangin amate in ko tunga ang kipiekhie uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n Titus in tam bang nasep a patsa ahi ma bangin, amate in note lahah tami phalna nasep a sep suoh nadingun amate ka hanthawn uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in note in thu upna, thugenna, thu theina, nasep hakatna le nei itna vua kipanin midangte sangin bang kimah na tung tuon zawh ma bangun, tami phalna nasepna-ah zong na tungtuong un."},"8":{"text":"Thupieh dan banga ang gen ka hi sih a, midangte’ hakatna tawh sittelin na itna uh a tahtah amah ci thu ka theinopna hizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen i Topa Jesu Khris zong hau mama napi note ang khuolna ziehin ama’ zawnna tawh note mihau na suo thei nadingun, note ziehin ama mizawng hing suoh ahi ziehin note in kiphalna tawh ama’ nasepna na thei uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tami thu-ah ka ngaisutna kang pie hi: Nuasie kumin bang khat sep ding a pan masa beh na hi sih vua, bang khat sep ding nangawn a lunggul note adingin tua bang na bawl ding uh a kilawm ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Na neisa uh tawh kizui-in note in na hakatna ule na nasep man ding uh a kituo thei nadingin tu-in tami nasep zo sieng un."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thanopna a op nah po leh nei lona pansia loin neina tawh kizui-a kipie letsong pen a santah ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi dangte donghu dinga ang pau bawl hi loin,"},"14":{"text":"na kikal vuah na kihu diemdiem nading uh ka cinopna hizaw a, tulai taha na citheina un amau’ tasapna hu-in, amau’ citheina in zong note’ tasapna ang hukia ding ka deina ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tampi a khawmte-a’ val tuon loin them khat a khawmte-a’ zong cingla tuon lo hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Pei 16:8"},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin Titus’ lungsim sungah kei nei banga thanopna lungsim a guon pa Pasien tungah nuomthu ka tut hi.","title":"Titus’ Pahtahna"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in kote’ ngetna ei sang khop loin, nidang sangin a thanop zawh ziehin ama’ thu-a na kung vua ang haw sawm ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungdamna thu a genna zieha hlattuom pawlpi zosie-ah a kithang sanggampa khat ama tawh kang zawhsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua beh hi loin, Topa mama’ minthan nading le ka lungsim hoina uh a kilah nadingin, ama pen tami phalna nasepna ka sep sungun ka khuolzinpi ding vua hlattuom pawlpite in a se pa zong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Phalna tawh a kipie tami letsongte ka zehna vuah koima in ei mawsah lo nadingin ka kidawm mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa muna behah a man gamtat sawm hi khop loin, mihingte muna-ah zong a man a gamtat sawm ka hi uhi.","ref":"Pau 3:4"},"22":{"text":"Tua thu tamveipitah sittelin citah hi, ci-a ka mu sa uh i sanggam pa khat amate tawh kang zawhsah hi. Ama in note ang muon mama ziehin a lawp tasem hi."},"23":{"text":"Titus pen note ading nasepna-ah ka kithuopi le ka naseppi ahi hi; i sanggamte ahi ule Khris’ min a thangsah hlattuom pawlpite’ kamtaite ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note’ itna le kote in note zieha ka kisielna uh a hang bang ahei ci hlattuom pawlpite mai-ah siengtahin na lah un."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in misiengthote adinga nasepna tawh kisai-in lai kang hlah ding uh a kisam nawn sih hi,","title":"Jerusalem-a Tapidawte ading Sumdonna"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen na mi hunopna lungsim uh ka thei a, tua pen Macedonia mite tunga ka kisielpisa ahi hi. Ning kuma kipanin Achaia gam mite a kithawikhol zo ta uhi, ci-in ka na gen hi; tua na lawpna un amate a tamzaw a thanuomsah tuom hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanle keima in tami thu-ah kang kisielpina uh a mawhna a suo lo nadingin na kigingkhol un, kang cisa ma bangin na kiginkhol thei nadingun sanggamte kang sawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bang hi loin keima kang pei ciengin Macedonia-te pawlkhat in ei zui hinlen, na kiginkhol lo lam uh hing muhai kha mawh uleh nohaw’ maizum ding genda vai, tami nasepna-ah ka mai uh a zum mama ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n pieh dinga na kamciemsa uh tami huna letsongte a baisa-in omin, sawl zawh thu tawh hi lo, phalna tawh ahi nadinga thu vaihawm dingin na kung vuah sanggamte ang mahaw thei nadingin kut ding kisam ka sa hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka gennop thu tami ahi hi: Khaici themkhat a vawte in themkhat a at ding vua, tampi a vawte in tampi ma at ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mi zosie in na lungsim sung vuah pieh dinga na khensatsa bangun na pie ciet ding vua, lungsi pipi ahi sihle pieh lo phamaw ci dan tawh na pie sih ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in lungtaitaha a pie mite a it hi."},"8":{"text":"Sil bangkim a kicinga na nei zing nading ule na hoi sepna zosie-ah kicingtaha na kihal thei nadingun Pasien in thupha namcin a kiningcingin note ang pie thei hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ama in hawmthangin, mizawngte tungah pie a, ama’ dihna kip tawntung hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Late 112:9"},"10":{"text":"Khaici vawpa tungah khaici le neh ding an a sih pa in na vaw ding uh khaici zong hing sih ding a, na vaw ding uh khaici hing khangsahin na dihna uh zong hing pungsah ding hi.","ref":"Isa 55:10"},"11":{"text":"Na kiphalna lienpi uh ziehin na zosie-ah ang kihausah ding a, tua in kote tungtawnin Pasien tungah lungdamkona a piengsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami nasepna in misiengthote tasapna beh a sih ahi khop sih a, Pasien tungah lungdam ko nading tampi tawh zong a dimletsah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tami nasepna sittelna tungtawnin note in Khris’ lungdamna pulahna thu na manna ule, amate le midang zosiete tawh phal taha na piehnate ziehun Pasien’ min na thangsah uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tezawh lo note ang kipie Pasien’ hepina ziehin amate in ang lunggul mama vua, thu zong ang ngetpieh uhi."},"15":{"text":"A kigen zo lo ei hlawnpieh ama’ letsong ziehin Pasien tungah lungdam i ko uhi!"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note tawh i kimaituo cienga a kiniemsah pa le i kigamlat cienga note tunga a hangsan pa keima Paul in Khris’ nunnemna le migitna tawh kang thum hi!","title":"Paul in Ama’ Nasepna a Hutna"},"2":{"text":"Leitung mite dan tawh a gamta-a ei ngaisunte tungah keima kang op ciengin hang taha ci ka sawm bangin ci a kul lo nadingin kang thum hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitung mite bangin ka ten vangun leitung mite’ zie zui-in gal ka do sih uhi;"},"4":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile kote’ zah galdona hiemte ahile mihingte’ galhiem maimaite ahi sih a, galte’ panmun phuolpite a susie zo Pasien’ vanglietna hizaw hi. Kote in kiselnate le"},"5":{"text":"Pasien’ thu theina ding a khahtan thei kiphatsahna vannuoi ka susie gawp vua, Khris’ thu a mang dingin ngaisutna vannuoi salin ka man uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na thumanna uh a kicin ciengin thumang lo zosie dan pie dingin a kigingsa-in ka om uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na maitang vua nate en un. Khris-a’ ka hi hi, ci-in na kimuon uleh note, Khris-a’ na hi ma bangun ko zong Khris-a’ ma ka hina thu uh phawh ta un."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in note suhsiet nading hi lo, na kilam nadingun Topa in ei pieh thuneina tawmkhat hing kinah sielpi phiel leng zong ka maizum sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka laihlahte tawh ang zausah ka suo khah ding ka nuom sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in, “A laihlahte khau-in nasie mama napi eite tawh a opton tah ciengin thahat vawt loin, a thugente zong bangma ahi sih hi,” ei ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bang mite in kang op lo sung vua laihlah tawh ka gente uh kang op tah ciengun ang sem ding ka hi lam uh na kithei ta uheh."},"12":{"text":"Kote ka hi ule amau le amau a kiphattawmte tawh a kisimton ahi sihle a kitekah ngam ka hi sih uhi. Ahi vangin amate khatlekhat a kitekah ciengun theisiemna a nei sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongle a kalvalin ka kisiel sih ding vua, ahi vangin Pasien in kote adinga ei sesahsa za ahi note kung dong nangawn zong kang bat zawhna uh cieng behah ka kisiel ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen na kung vua kang tun ciengun ka ciengtan uh vala a kalsuon ka hi sih uhi; kote ka hi ule note kungah Khris’ lungdamna thu tawh ang tung masa pente ka hi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Midangte’ nasepnate-ah a kalvalin ka kisiel sih vua, hinanle kote lametna ahile na upna uh a khanna tawh kizui-in ka nasepna huong uzong na tangzaisah semsem ding uh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hile kote in midangte nasepna huong sunga kisemsate kisielpi loin na gam uh hlengin lungdamna thu ka tangko thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"“A kisiel mi in Topa sungah kisiel taheh”.","ref":"Jer 9:24"},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen ama le ama a kiphattawm mipa kisang lo a, ahi vangin Topa in a phat mite kisang hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka mot opna nengneng teng ei ngaisiem locin ka nuom hi. Ei ngaisiem bo un!","title":"Paul le Sawltahpi Manlo te"},"2":{"text":"Note adingin Pasien’ ei deisahna ka nei hi, bangzieh ahei cile keima in pasal khat tawh kinung ngahnu siengtho khat bangin Khris tunga pieh dingin note kang kamciem zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin gulpi in a ngienku tawh Eve a na sol bangin Khris tungah a dih le a siengtho na kipumpiehna panun na ngaisutnate uh na pielsah khah ding uh ka lung a himaw hi.","ref":"Pien 3:1-5, 13"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khatpo ang pei-in kang hilsa uh ahi lo adang Jesu’ thu ang hil a, ahi sihle note in na ngasa uh ahi lo adang hlagau khat nga-in, ahi sihle na sansa uh lungdamna thu ahi lo adang lungdamna thu khat ang hil ciengin na sang paipai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kote ka hi ule tami a thupi mama sawltahpite sangin a neu zaw-in ka kingaisun tuon vawt sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Thugen lamah ei kicil lo ka hi thei mai ding a, hinanle theina lamah ei kicil lo ka hi sam sih hi; note tungah tam bang ka hina sil bangkimah a kicien sinsenin ka langsah zo uhi."},"7":{"text":"Note ang kitawisang nadingin keima le keima kiniemsahin man ngen loin Pasien’ lungdamna thu ka gen ziehin mawna a bawl ka hi amah?"},"8":{"text":"Na na sem dingin hlattuom pawlpi dangte tung panin huna sang ka hi ziehin amau’ sum a lahpieh ka suoh hi."},"9":{"text":"Note tawh omtonin kisapna ka nei ciengin Macedonia gam pana ang pei ka lawmte in ka sapnate ei sih ziehun koima vangih ka suon sih hi. Tuaci’n lam khatpopo-ah note’ vangih ka suo lo nadingin ka kideh a, ka kideh lai ding hi.","ref":"Phil 4:15-18"},"10":{"text":"Keima sungah Khris’ thuman thutah a op ma bangin Achaia gam sung muncin tengah tami ka kisahtheipi pen gen loin ka dai op sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahile bangzieh ahei? Ke’n note kang it lo zieh amah? Kang it lam uh Pasien in thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Kote tawh a kikim dan a ciemtena a deite’ kisielna ka niel zawh nadingin ke’n zong ka sep pen ma ka semsuoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua bang mite pen sawltahpi man lote ahi a, amau le amau Khris’ sawltahpi a kipang mi sol nasemte ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua pen lamdang sah ding ahi sih hi! Azieh pen Satan nangawn khuovah vantungmi khat bangin a kipangtawm thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n dihna tate bangin ama’ nasemte a kipantawm uleh lamdang sah ding ahi sih hi. Amau’ gamtatna bangin a tawpna-ah a thuoh ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Koima in a maw-in ei ngaisun sih un, ci-in kang genkia hi; hinanle a maw a nei ngaisut uleh tawmkhat beh ka kisiel thei nadingin mimawte bangin ei ngaisunin ei sang veve un.","title":"Sawltahpi Ahina Tawh Paul’ Thuohnate"},"17":{"text":"Kimuong a, tami ka kisielna tungtanga kang gen ding thute pen Topa’ thuneina tawh ang gen ka hi sih a, mimaw khat banga ang gen ka hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Mi tampite in leitung ziete a kisielpi ziehun kei zong ka kisiel ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile nomate na pil ziehun lungdamtahin mimawte na thuoh zo veve uhi."},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khat in salin hing bawlin, ahi sihle hing netumin, ahi sihle hing metbawlin, ahi sihle kiliensahin ang pheta beh ciengin zong note in na thuoh zo uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua banga bawl ding lamah kote ka thanem nah mama uhi, ci-in maizum pipi-in kang gen hi! Ahi vangin mimaw khat bangin thu hing gen leng: Mi khatpo in a kisielpi ngam pen kei zong ka kisielpi ngam hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate Hebrew-te ahi uh amah? Kei zong ka hi hi. Amate Israel-te ahi uh amah? Kei zong ka hi hi. Amate Abraham’ suonlehlahte ahi uh amah? Kei zong tua bang ma ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate Khris’ nasemte ahi uh amah? Mimaw khat bangin ham tadi leih, amate sangin ka hoizaw buong sam hi: Amate sangin na ka nahsep zaw a, thong zong ka tamkieh zaw hi. Simzawh lo satna ka thuoh a, tamveipitah sikhielin ka ommun zaw hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:23"},"24":{"text":"Judah-te’ satna sawmli-ah khat a kiemin ngavei tah ka thuoh hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:3"},"25":{"text":"Ciengpum tawh thumvei ei kisat a, khatvei suong tawh ei kisep hi. Tembaw kisietna thumvei ka tuoh ngai hi; sun khat le zan khat tuipi tungah ka om ngai hi;","ref":"Sawl 16:22; 14:19"},"26":{"text":"khuol ka zin munnate-ah keima in guntui khang panin zauhuoina, misuomte tung panin zauhuoina, ka mipite tung panin zauhuoina, Gentile-te tung panin zauhuoina, khuopi sunga zauhuoina, gamlaha zauhuoina, tuipi tunga zauhuoinate a kipanin sanggam man lote tung panin zauhuoinate ka tuoh a,","ref":"Sawl 9:23; 14:5"},"27":{"text":"nasep gimin hamsatna sungah omin, zan lai-in tamveipi tah kimu maw liengin ka om hi. Tuale gilkielna le dangtana a kipanin neh ding nei loin tamveipi ka om a, puon sil ding nei loin damsi-in ka om ngitnget hi."},"28":{"text":"Thudangte banah hlattuom pawlpi zosiete ading lunghimaw-in ka lunggimpi lai hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka thanempi lo koi om ahei? Ka lungkhampi lo-a mawna sunga kipuasah koi om ahei?"},"30":{"text":"Kisiel lo phamaw ding ahile ka thanemna ei kilangsah nate ma ka kisielpi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasien le Topa Jesu’ Pa (ama in thupha nga tawntung taheh!) in ka zuou lo lamtah thei hi."},"32":{"text":"Keima ei mat thei nadingin Damascus khuo Kumpi Aretas’ khut nei-a om gam-uhpa in Damascus khuopi a cingsah hi."},"33":{"text":"Hizongle seu khat sungah ei kikoi-in kul kotneu vang panin ei kikhiesuh a, ama’ khut sung panin ka suohta hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:23-25"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangma phattuom nading om sih nanle ka kisiel ding a kisam ahi hi; hinanle ka mangmunate le Topa’ ang kilahnate ka gengen ding hi.","title":"Paul Mangmunate le Kilahnate"},"2":{"text":"Tu masang kum sawm le kum li lai-in Khris sunga a om mi khat vantung dawl thumna-ah a kilahto lam ka thei a, a pumpi tawh amah, a pumpi lo tawh ahei ci ka thei sih hi; Pasien in a thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua mipa, a pumpi tawh amah, a pumpi lo tawh ahei ci zong ka thei sih hi; Pasien in a thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Paradise ah a kilato a, gen lo ding thute, mihing koima khat beh in a genkia dinga a kiphal lo thute a za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bang mi pa khat ziehin ka kisiel ding a, hizongle ka thanemnate ah ci simlo ka kisiel sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin thutah gen ding ka hi ziehin kisiel nuom leng mimaw ka hi tuon sih ding hi, a zieh pen keima sunga a mu ule keima tung pana a zahte uh sangin a thupizaw-a koima in ei ngaisut lo nadingin kisiel ding ka kidawm a,"},"7":{"text":"tua a lamdang kilahna dante nangawn ngaisutin ka nei sih hi. Tua ahi ziehin ka kisahthei luot lo nadingin ka tahsa sungah ei bawlsie ding Satan’ kamtai ahi ling khat ei kipie hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei tung panin tua lingtang a kilahkhiet nadingin Topa tungah thumvei thu ka ngen a,"},"9":{"text":"hinanle ama in keima kungah, “Nangma dingin ka hepina a kicing hi, azieh pen thanemna sungah ka vanglietna a kicing hi,” ei ci hi. Tuaci’n ka sungah Khris’ vanglietna a ten thei nadingin kipahtahin ka thanemnate ka kisielpi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin Khris hangin thanemnate, zakonate, hahsatnate tungah ka lung a kim hi; azieh pen ka thanem ciengin ka tha a hat hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei mimaw ka hi ta hi! Tua dinga nei paubawl uh ahi hi. A tahtahin kei pen nei pahtah lawm uh ka hi hi, bangzieh ahei cile bangma ka hi lo vangin tami sawltahpi lien pente sangin ka neuzaw tuon sih hi.","title":"Corinth Hlattuomte ading Paul’ Deisahna"},"12":{"text":"Note lahah sawltahpi man khat’ hina a lah ahi limte, sil lamdangte, le vanglietna nasepnate kibawl zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei mama in note vangih kang suon lo ci simlo hlattuom pawlpi dangte sangin bangci-in a siezaw-in na om ngai ta uh ahei? Tami ka khiel khahna ei ngaidam un!"},"14":{"text":"Na kung vua ang haw dinga ka kiginna tami khu a thumveina vawt ahi ta hi. Na neisate uh a deigaw ka hi sih a, noma mama ang dei ka hi zawh ziehin note’ vangih ka suoh sih ding hi; bangzieh ahei cile tate in nu le pate dingin nei le lam kholpieh loin, nu le pate in tate adingin a kholpieh ding hizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Note adingin ka neisate kipahtahin ka zang ding a, keima ma zong ka kipumpieh nuom hi. Note hing it semsem leng ei tawm it semsem ding na hi uh amah?"},"16":{"text":"Note vangih ang suon loin ei kingaisun taheh. Ahi vangin note in kei mi ngiansiem ka hi ziehin solna tawh ang manin nei gen uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na kung vua kang sawl mi khatpo tungtawnin a met lahna-in kang nei uh amah?"},"18":{"text":"Na kung vua haw dingin Titus ka kun a, i sanggam pa kang zuisah hi. Titus in note a met lahna-in ang nei sih hi, hi lo amah? Lungsim kibanga a semton hi lo uh ka mah? Ka kalsuonzie uh kibang hi lo amah?"},"19":{"text":"Note mai-ah koma le koma a kiphelphelin ei ngaisun na hi uh amah? Kote pen Khris sunga omte bangin Pasien mai-a thugengen ka hi uhi. Ka itte aw, ka sepna zosie uh pen note kilamkip nading ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kang tun ciengin ka dei banga kang mu lo khah ding ule note in zong na dei bang vua nei mu lo khah ding uh ka zau hi; note lahah kihauna, hazatna, lungthahna, huoihamna, kidaisahna, kigensietna, kihisahna, le buoinate a op khah ding ka zau hi."},"21":{"text":"Kang hawkia ciengin ka Pasien in na mai vuah ei niemkhiehin nidanga na khielnasa uh mawnate ahi, siengtho lona, nulepa mawna, thangtatnate vang tawh maw napi a kisia lo ziehun mi tampi ziehin da le kapin ka op khah ding ka zau hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na kung vua kang haw nading a thumveina ahi ta hi. “Mawmatna khatpopo teci ni ahi sihle thum’ theipina tawh a kip hi ding hi,” kici hi.","title":"Adang Thuhilnate","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"2":{"text":"Mawna a bawl mite le midang zosie tungah thuhilna kang nei zo hi, a niveina kang haw lai-in zong kang hilsa ma bangin tu ka op lo sungin kang hil a, kang hawkia leh koima kang za nawn sih ding hi,"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen note in kei tungah Khris in thu a gen lam a kicien lahtelna na dei sese uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thanemna ziehin singlamte tungah a na kithalia mawh vangin Pasien’ vanglietna tawh ama a hingkia hi. Azieh pen ama sungah ka tha uh a nem a, hinanle note tawh kipawlna-ah Pasien’ vanglietna ziehin ama tawh ka hington ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Upna sunga a nungta na hi ngel vuoi mah ci no le no kisittel un. No le no kize-et un. Na kisittelna vuah a lawsam na hi sih nah uleh na sung vuah Khris a op lam thei lo na hi uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Note in a lawsam ka hi lo lam uh ei thei na va uteh ci-in ka lamen hi."},"7":{"text":"A lawcing ka hina uh a kilah ding deina hi loin, note a mana na gamtat nading uh deina tawh thu ngen ka hizaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kote in thuman thutah langdo-in bangma ka sem thei sih vua, thuman thutah ading behin ka semzaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen kote thanemin note na thahat ciengun ka kipah uhi. Kote’ thungetna pen note’ kicingtah thei nading ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima kang tun ciengin note siet nading hi loin na kilamkip nadingun, na tung vuah Topa in keima ei pieh thuneina kang khauzah seng lo nadingin note tawh i kigamlat sung vua tami lai kang giel ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A tawpna-ah sanggamte aw, mangpha na man ta un. Na opdante uh puopha-in kang ngetnate na ngai unlen, khatlekhat kithutuohin kilemin na om un; tua hile itna le kilemna Pasien in note ang ompi ding hi.","title":"A Tawpna Hopina le Thupha Piehna"},"12":{"text":"A siengtho kinapna tawh khatlekhat na kinoset un."},"13":{"text":"Misiengtho zosie in note ang noset uhi."},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesu Khris’ ei hepina, Pasien’ ei itna le Hlagau Siengtho tawh kipawl theina in note zosie tawh hing om taheh."}}}}},"48":{"info":{"name":"Galatia-te","shortname":"Gal","abbr":[],"desc":"Galatia-te tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to the galatians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihingte sawlna tawh ahi lo, thunei mihingte tung pan zong hi loin Jesu Khris le misite lah panin ama a thosah Pasien tung panin sawltahpi khat ahi keima Paul le","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"ka ompi Pasien’ innkuonpite zosie in, Galati gam hlattuom pawlpite tungah:"},"3":{"text":"Note tungah i Pa Pasien le i Topa Jesu Khris tung panin hepina le kilemna hing tung taheh, ci-in kang hopi uhi."},"4":{"text":"I Pa Pasien’ deina tawh kizui-in tuhun khang gilo panin ei hunkhie dingin eite’ mawna zieha ama le ama ang kipiekhie pa ahi,"},"5":{"text":"ama tungah minthanna om zingzing taheh. Amen."},"6":{"text":"Khris’ hepina sungah note ang hlan pa nuasie-in adang lungdamna thu-ah na kihei tahzuoi uh lamdang ka sa mama hi.","title":"Adang Lungdamna Thu Om lo"},"7":{"text":"Lungdamna thu adang a om sih a, ahi vangin mi kimkhat in note hing buoisahin tua Khris’ lungdamna thu a lehei sawm uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hizongle note tungah kang hilsa uh lungdamna thu tawh a kilengatin kote nangawnin ahi a, vantung panin vantungmi khat in ahi zongin note tunga ang gen a op leh tua mi pa in samsietna nga taheh!"},"9":{"text":"Masang lama kang gensa bangin kang genkiana-ah, note kungah na sansa uh thu tawh a kilengat ahi adang lungdamna thu ang gen mi khatpo a op leh tua mi pa in samsietna thuoh taheh!"},"10":{"text":"Tu-in mihingte’ maipha sui ka mah, ahi sihle Pasien’ maipha sui ka hei? Mite po a lungdamsah sawm lailai ka hi mawh leh Khris’ nasem ka hi sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, keima in kang hil lungdamna thu pen mihingte’ bawltawm ahi lo lam na thei ding uh ka dei hi;","title":"Paul in Sawltahpi Za a Hutna"},"12":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile tua thu pen mihing tung pana ka nga hi loin ei kihil zong ahi sih a, Jesu Khris’ ang kilahna pana ka nga ahi bo hi."},"13":{"text":"Note in Judah biehna sunga ka om lai-a ka hinkhuo masa lamte na za zo ta uhi. Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpite nahpi tahin ka na bawlsie a, suhsiet ding ka na hanciem hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4-5; 26:9-11"},"14":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate’ tang ngainate pawnthaw mama ka hi ziehin Jew biehna sunga ka mipi ka khanguolte lahah a madawh penin ka na om hi.","ref":"Sawl 22:3"},"15":{"text":"Hinanle ka suo masangin kei ei tuom koi-a ama’ hepina tungtawnin keima ei hlan Pasien in,"},"16":{"text":"Gentile-te lahah ama’ thu ka gen thei nadingin keima tungah lungkimtahin a Tapa ang kilahsah lai-in mi koima khat zong ka dong sih a,","ref":"Sawl 9:3-6; 22:6-10; 26:13-18"},"17":{"text":"ka masanga sawltahpi na suohsate dong dingin zong Jerusalem ah peito tuon loin, thakhatthu-in Arabia gamah ka pei zaw a, tua zaw ciengin Damascus ah ka kilekia hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zaw kum thum ciengin Cephas kunga haw dingin Jerusalem ah ka peito a, ama kungah ni sawm le ni nga sung ka tam hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:26-30"},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ sanggam pa James simlo sawltahpi dangte khat zong ka mu kha sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Note tunga kang giel laite pen Pasien mai-a kang giel ahi a, zuouthu ka gen vawt sih hi!"},"21":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin Syria le Cilicia gam sung teng ah ka pei hi."},"22":{"text":"Khris sunga a om Judea gam hlattuom pawlpite in ka melin kei ei thei nai sih uhi;"},"23":{"text":"amate in, “Masang lama ei bawlsie pa in khatvei lai-a suhsiet a sawm tua upna thu tu-in tangko ta mel,” ci-a a kigen thu beh a za uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuale keima ziehin amate in Pasien’ min a phat uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zaw kum sawm le kum li ciengin Barnabas tawh Jerusalem khuo ah ka peito kia a, Titus zong ka zawpi hi.","title":"Paul le Sawltahpi Dangte","ref":"Sawl 11:30; 15:2"},"2":{"text":"Kilahna dung zui-a a pei ka hi hi. Tua ciengin (a makai deute beh a tuomin ka kimupi vangin) a mawhna-a tai ka suo lo nadingin amate mai-ah Gentile-te lahah ka hilsa lungdamna thu ka va lui ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Hizongle ka zawpi pa Titus nangawn zong Greek-te khat ahi vangin a tep tan dingin a kipausawl tuon sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in sila ei suosah thei nadingun kote in Khris Jesu sunga ka nei uh suotahna thu a kandap dingin a zuou thei thu umte ang daplut zieha tua banga kibawl ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Note tawh lungdamna thuman thutah a op suoh thei nadingin kote in mitphet kal sung nangawn amau’ thu ka mang sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Makai-a kinei mite tung panin (kei tungah amate in kilamdanna a bawl tuon sih uhi; Pasien in maitang zatah tuom nei lo hi) - tua makaite in kei tungah bangma ei sep pieh tuom sih uhi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"7":{"text":"Tuale mahin tep kitan mite kunga lungdamna thuhil ding pen Peter tungah a ki-ap ma bangin, teptan lo mite kunga lungdamna thuhil ding zong keima tunga ei ki-apna thu a mu zawsop uhi."},"8":{"text":"(Bangzieh ahei cile a tep kitansate dinga sawltahpi a suosah ahi Peter tungtawnin na a sem pa in kei tungtawnin zong na hing semin Gentile-te adingin ei sawl a,)"},"9":{"text":"khuompi banga a kiciemte makaite ahi James, Cephas le John-te in keima tungah hepina ei kipie zo hi, ci thu a thei ciengun Barbabas le keima tungah kilawmtatna zietlam khut ei pie vua, ko gel pen Gentile-te kungah pei-in, amate ahile tep kitan mite kunga pei ding a thukim uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in mizawngte ka phaw ding uh beh ei kal vua, tua thu lah ka sep nop pen ma uh hi pai hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle Antioch khuo ah Peter ang tun ciengin ama mawsah nading thu om ahi ziehin a maitangah ka sel pai hi,","title":"Paul in Antioch ah Peter Phawhsie"},"12":{"text":"azieh pen James kung pana ang pei mi pawlkhat ang tun masangun Peter pen Gentile-te tawh an neton let kimlai, amate ang tun tah ciengun tep kitan pawlte a giin ziehin nuatawnin ama le ama a kiningkoi ta vanuh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jew midangte in tami kineitawmna pen a zui pai mintah vua, a kineitawmna un Banabas nangawn zong a peikhielsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin lungdamna thuman thutah tawh kituohin a gamtat lo lam uh ka mu ciengin amate zosie’ zahin Peter kungah, “Nang Jew mite khat lawmlawm in Jew mite khat bangin om loin Gentile-te khat banga a nungta lel na hi leh, Jew mite banga Gentile-te a nuntat nadingun bangci bangin paubawl sawm teitei thei ding na hei?” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Eimate mama zong Judah mi-a pieng vive i hi vua, mawnei Gentile-te i hi sih uhi;","title":"Jew Mite le Gentile-te Upna Tawh Kihundam"},"16":{"text":"hinanle eite in thukham zuina hang hi loin, Jesu Khris upna tungtawnin mi khat in dihtansahna nga hi, ci thu i thei uhi. Eite in zong thukham zuina hang hi loin, Khris upna hang tawh dihtansahna i nga thei nadingun Khris Jesu i um uhi, azieh pen koima in thukham zuina tawh dihtansahna nga lo ding hi.","ref":"Late 143:2; Rom 3:20, 22"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite in Khris sungah dihtansahna i nga nadinga i hanciemna un ei le ei mawnei i hi lam ei kimusah ahile, Khris pen mawna’ sila pa ahi amah? Hi poma lo hi!"},"18":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka phelsa nate ma ka lamkia leh thukham palsat pa ka hi lam kei le kei a kipulah ka hi gige hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien adinga ka hin thei nadingin thukham tungtawnin thukham ah kei ka si hi. Singlamte tungah Khris tawh ka kikhaiton zo hi;"},"20":{"text":"a hing lai pen kei hi nawn loin ka sunga ang teng Khris hizaw hi. Tuale ka tahsa sungah tu-a ka hinna pen keima ei it a, keima dinga ama le ama ang kipie Pasien upna tawh a hing ahi bo hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in Pasien’ hepina ka paikhie sih hi; bangzieh ahei cile thukham tungtawna dihtansahna kinga hi leh Khris pen a mawhna-a si hi ta ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No Galati mimawte! Koi in ang bumlawm ta uh ahei? Singlamte tungah Jesu Khris a kikhailia bangin na mitmu-un kicientahin ang kilah zo hi!","title":"Thukham ahi sihle Upna"},"2":{"text":"Note tung panin tami thukhat beh ka thei nuom hi: Thukham zuina hang tawh Hlagau nga na hi uh amah, ahi sihle na zah uh thu na upna zieh vua a nga na hizaw uh ahei?"},"3":{"text":"Tamza taha maw na hi talawm uh amah? Hlagau tawh na kipat zaw ciengun, tu-in cilesa tawh khup sawm na hi uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"tua za taha na gim thuohna uh a mawhna suoh ding a ta amah?"},"5":{"text":"Hoi hi, tuale thukham na zui ziehun Pasien in Hlagau hing pie-in note lahah nalamdang ang sep ahi amah, ahi sihle na zahte uh na upna zieh uh hizaw ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Abraham in, “Pasien um a, tua a upna pen dihna-in kisimpieh hi,”.","ref":"Pien 15:6; Rom 4:3"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in a um mite Abraham’ suonlehlahte hi, ci thei ta un.","ref":"Rom 4:16"},"8":{"text":"Pasien in upna tawh Gentile-te dih a tansah ding lam Lai Siengtho in na mukhol a, “Nangma sungah Gentile-te zosie thupha kipie ding hi,” ci-in Abraham tungah lungdamna thu na magen zo hi.","ref":"Pien 12:3"},"9":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin a um mite, Abraham tawh thupha kipieton hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen thukham zuina tunga a kinga mi zosie pen samsietna nei-a om ahi uhi; bang ding ahei cile, “Thukham laibu sunga kigiel thu zosie zui-in a mang lo mi zosie in samsietna a thuoh uhi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:26"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ahile thukham zuina tawh koima in Pasien mai-ah dih a tan zo lo lam kicien mama hi; azieh pen, “Midih pa upna tawh nungta ding hi,” kici hi.","ref":"Hab 2:4"},"12":{"text":"Hizongle upna tungah thukham a kinga sih hi; tuale mahin, “Thukham a zui mi poma tuate ma tawh a nungta ding hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Siem 18:5"},"13":{"text":"Khris in thukham samsietna panin ei tankhie zo a, eite adingin a kisamsie pa ang suoh hi. Bangzieh ahei cile, “Singkhuom tunga kikhai mi zosie samsiet thuoh ahi hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Thkna 21:23"},"14":{"text":"Tua pen Gentile-te kungah Khris Jesu sunga om Abraham’ thuphate a tun thei nading le upna tungtawnin eite in Hlagau’ kamciem i nga thei nading uh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, nisim hinkhuo panin gentena khat kang gen ding hi: Mi khat’ thuciemna pen khatvei a kikipsah zaw ciengin koima in belap thei loin, zong phiet thei lo hi.","title":"Abraham Tunga Kamciem"},"16":{"text":"Tu-in ahile Abraham le ama’ suonlehlah pa tungah kamciemte kibawl zo hi. “Na suonlehlahte,” ci-in mi tampi gen hi loin, mi khat beh ahi Khris gennopna-in, “Na suonlehlah pa,” na cizaw hi.","ref":"Pien 12:7"},"17":{"text":"Ka gennop tami ahi hi: Tua kamciem a kiphiet thei nadingin tua zaw kum zali le sawm thum cienga a tung pan thukham in masang lai-a Pasien in a kipsahsa tua thuciemna pen a phiet thei malmal sih hi.","ref":"Pei 12:40"},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen thukham panin gouluoza ang pei hi mawh leh kamciemna zieh hi nawn lo ding hi; ahi vangin Pasien in kamciemna tungtawnin Abraham tungah tua gouluoza a pie hi.","ref":"Rom 4:14"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahile bang dinga thukham na kipie ahei? Ama tungah kamciem a kibawlna ama’ suonlehlah pa ang tun masangsie, tua tawnkhielnate zieha kipiehbe ahi bo hi; tua thukham pen vantung mite tungtawnin palai khat tawh kikipsah ahi hi.","title":"Thukham’ Tupna"},"20":{"text":"Tu-in ahile mi khat sanga a tamzaw munah palai kizang hi; ahi vangin Pasien khat beh ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahile thukham in Pasien’ kamciemte a langpan amah? A langpan vawt sih hi! Bangzieh ahei cile hinna a pie thei thukham na kipie ahile dihtansahna pen thukham tungtawna ang pei tahtah hi ta ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hizongle Jesu Khris upna tungtawnin a um mite tungah tua a kikamciem pen a kipieh thei nadingin Lai Siengtho in mawna vanglietna nei-ah sil bangkim a khumcip hi."},"23":{"text":"Upna ang tun masang, upna thu ang kilah masang tengin thukham nei-ah eite ei kikhumcipin ei kicing hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin upna tawh dih i tan thei nadingin Khris ang pei cieng dong, tua thukham pen eite ei cingpa a suoh hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in upna ang tun zo tah ziehin tua a cingpa’ khut nei-ah i om nawn sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen na unpi-un upna tungtawnin Khris Jesu sungah Pasien’ tate na hi ta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Khris sungah a ki-baptize sa note zosie in Khris na sil uhi."},"28":{"text":"Judah mi le Greek mi ci om nawn lo a, sila le suohta mi, numei le pasal ci bang om nawn lo hi; azieh pen na unpi-un Khris Jesu sungah khat na hi ta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Note Khris-a’ na hi uleh Abraham’ suonlehlahte na hi ta vua, kamciemna bangin gouluote zong na hi ta uhi.","ref":"Rom 4:13"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka gennop tami ahi hi: Gouluo dingte pen neisa zosie a luo dingte hinanle naupang ahi laisie uh sila sangin a thupizaw kan sih uhi."},"2":{"text":"Ahi vangin a pa sesa hun ciengtan a tun masangsie a cing le a kemte’ uhna nei-ah a om uhi."},"3":{"text":"Eite zong tua bang ma i hi uhi; naupang i hi hun sungin leitung thungehte khut nei-ah salin i om uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin hun bukim ang tun ciengin Pasien in numei pana a pieng thukham nei-a a suoh a Tapa ang sawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua in thukham khut nei-a om mite ei tat nading le a tate banga tapa suona i nga thei nading ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tapate na hi ziehun Pasien in eite’ lungtangah a tapa’ Hlagau ang sawl a, “Abba! Pa!” ci-in ei kikosah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n note na hi ule sila hi nawn loin tapa na hi ta vua, tapa na hi uleh gouluo pa zong na hi ta uhi.","ref":"Rom 8:15-17"},"8":{"text":"Nidang Pasien na thei lo hun lai-un a pien limin Pasien ahi lote’ suoh le salin na om uhi.","title":"Paul in Galati-te Hosie"},"9":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in Pasien na thei ta vua, Pasien in zong note ang thei ta hi, tua ahile bangci bangin a thanem le a gina lo ahi leitung thungehte lam po-ah kihei-in khatvei salsuoh nuomkia na hi uh ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Note in ni thupite, hlate, khuohunte, le kumte na tang talawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"Note dinga ka nasep a mawhna a suo khah ding ka lunghimaw mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Lawmte aw, kang thum hi, note op banga kang op ma bangin note zong kei op bangin hing om vawi un. Note in kei tungah khielna na bawl sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Note tungah lungdamna thu kang gen masahna pen tahsa zawngkhalna zieh ahi lam na thei uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ka omdan pen note adingin ze-etna a suo vangin ei muda-in nei simmaw tuon sih vua, Khris Jesu le Pasien’ vantungmi khat bangin nei limbawl zawsop uhi."},"15":{"text":"Na ngasa uh lungnopna bang na law ta uh ahei? Azieh pen ahi thei hi leh na mittangte uh ladawhin nei pie nuom va-ia uhi, ci teci ka pang hi."},"16":{"text":"Thuman thutah kang hilna ziehin tu-in na gal uh ka suoh ta amah?"},"17":{"text":"Amate in ang thupibawl mama vua, hinanle a ngimna uh a hoi sih hi; note in amate na thupisim nadingun ko kung pana ang khenkhie nuom uh ahi lel bo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngimna hoi ahi nah po leh note tawh ka op sung beh hi loin, hun zosie-ah kithupi sim ding pen a hoi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka it taneute aw, note sungah Khris pienzie lim ang op masangsie note adingin nausuo takei natna thuoh bangin ka omkia hi."},"20":{"text":"Na tungtang thu vuah amkham gawp ka hi ziehin note tawh ang omtonin ka thugen zong ka khel nuom va-ia hi."},"21":{"text":"No thukham nei-a a om nuomkia mite aw, ei gen vawi un, thukham in a gen thu bang ahei ci za lo na hi uh amah?","title":"Hagar le Sarah tawh Tekahna"},"22":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Abraham in tapa ni nei-in, khat pen a sila numei tawh a nei hi a, adang khat pen a suohta numei tawh a nei ahi hi, ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Pien 16:15; 21:2"},"23":{"text":"Ahi vangin sila numei tawh a nei tapa pen cilesa ngaina banga pieng hi a, a suohta numei tawh a nei tapa pen kamciemna tungtawna pieng ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in tami pen tekahna ahi hi: Tami numei ni tegel pen thuciemna nite ahi hi. Numei khat pen Sinai Muol pana ang pei Hagar hi a, ama in sila a suoh ding tate a nei hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Hagar pen Arabia gama Sinai Muol ahi a, tu hun Jerusalem tawh kibang hi, azieh pen a tate tawh ama salin a om hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi vangin adang numei pen a tung lama om Jerusalem tawh kibang hi; ama pen suohta a, eite’ nu ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile, “Ta nei lo-a a ciing numei aw, lungdamin kipah in. Nausuo gimna a thuoh ngai lo nu aw, awng inlen nahpi-in kiko in; bangzieh ahei cile pasal nei numei nu sangin a kinuasie numei nu in ta hauzaw hi,” ci-in kigiel hi.","ref":"Isa 54:1"},"28":{"text":"Lawmte aw, note tu-in Isaac banga kamciemna’ tate na hi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hizongle tua hun lai-in cilesa dan tawh a suoh pa in Hlagau dan tawh a suoh pa a na bawlsiet bangin tu-in zong tua bang ma-in a bawlsie hi.","ref":"Pien 21:9"},"30":{"text":"Hinanle Lai Siengtho in bang a gen ei? “Sila numei le a tapa notdawh ta’n; azieh pen sila numei’ tapa in a suohta numei’ tapa tawh gou luoton thei lo ding hi,” na kici hi.","ref":"Pien 21:10"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahile lawmte aw, eite pen sila numei’ tate i hi sih vua, suohta numei’ tate i hizaw uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Azieh pen suotahna i nga nadingin Khris in eite ei suohtasah hi. Tua ahi ziehin suotahna sungah dingkipin saltanna hahkol kisuonkia nawn sih un."},"2":{"text":"Ngai un! Keima Paul in na kung vuah kang gen ding hi, tep na kitansah uleh Khris in note adingin kimanna a nei poma sih ding hi.","title":"TapidawSuotahna’ Pienzie"},"3":{"text":"Tep a kitansah mi zosie tunga teci kang pan kiana-ah, tua mi pa in adang thukham vannuoi a zui lo a phamaw ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham zuina tawh dihtan a sawm note na hi ule Khris tawh kikhenin hepina panin a puamat na hi ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kote in upna tawh a kinga dihna pen Hlagau tungtawnin lametna tawh lawptahin ka nga uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Khris sungah teptan mi hile, teptan lo mi hile bangma thupi lo hi; itna tungtawna nasep theina upna khat beh a thupi ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Note na hi uleh taikidemna-ah hoitahin na tai uhi; note in thuman thutah na zui lo nadingun koi in ang kham ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Tam bang kizawlna pen note ang hlanpa kung pan hi lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tol themno khat in annel lom buppi a zel sieng hi.","ref":"1Cor 5:6"},"10":{"text":"Note in lungsim tuom nei sih va uteh, ci-in Topa sungah kang muong uhi. Ahi vangin koikoi hinanle note ang subuoi poma in dan a thuoh ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hizongnanle sanggamte aw, teptanna thu a gen lai hi leng bang dinga ei kibawlsie lailai ding ahei? Tua banga hil hi leng singlamte zieha mawsahna a kihemkhie zo ahi ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Note ang buoisah mite ama le ama kiget vet uleh ka nuom hi!"},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sanggamte aw, no na hi ule a suohta dinga ang kihlante na hi vua, na suotahna uh noma’ dei banga gamtatna dingin zang loin, itna tungtawnin khatlekhat’ sila na suohzaw un."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thupieh khat beh ahi, “Nangma na ki-it bangin na vengte na it ding hi,” a ci in thukham buppi a huomsieng ahi ta hi.","ref":"Siem 19:18"},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin note khatlekhat kipet kibalin na op ule zong khatlekhat na kisietsuo khah lo nadingun kidawm bo un."},"16":{"text":"Hlagau tawh na nungta unlen cilesa lunggulnate na tangtungsah sih un, kang ci hi.","title":"Cilesa’ Nasepte"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile cilesa lunggulnate in Hlagau deina tawh kiledo a, Hlagau deinate in zong cilesa lunggulna tawh kiledo hi; azieh pen tahsa deina pen Hlagau’ deina tawh a ki-elngat a, Hlagau’ deina zong khu tahsa’ deina tawh a ki-elngat hi; bangzieh ahei cile tam tegel pen khatlekhat a kiledo uh ahi hi.","ref":"Rom 7:15-23"},"18":{"text":"Hinanle Hlagau in ang makai uleh thukham nei-ah na om sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in cilesa nasepnate kician mama a, tuate in: numei-pasal pahtatna, siengtho lona, thangtatna,"},"20":{"text":"milim biehna, mibumna, mudana, kimat lona, thangsietna, lungthahna, kihauna, kilungtawh lona, kipawl khenna;"},"21":{"text":"deigawna, zukhamna, a kalval guolnop pawi bawlnate le tua bang nam zosie ahi hi; nidanga kang genkholsa bangin kang genkhol ding hi: Tam bang sil a bawl mite in Pasien’ manggam a luo sih ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"A kilebulin gen vai ci lei, Hlagau’ ga in ki-itna, lungdamna, kilemna, lungduoina, migitna, kiphalna, muonhuoina,","title":"Hlagau’ Ga"},"23":{"text":"nunnemna le pumpi uhzawhnate ahi hi. Tam thute tawh a kituoh lo thukham khat beh om lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Khris Jesu-a’ ahi mite in a cilesa deinate ule a lunggulnate uh singlamte tungah a kilcip zo ta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hlagau vanga nungta i hi uleh eite zong Hlagau makaina bangin kalsuon vai."},"26":{"text":"Eite kiphasah loin khatlekhat kidem loin, khatlekhat zong kithangsiet sih va vui."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lawmte aw, mi khatpo in khielna bawl hi, ci-a na thei uleh Hlagau a ngasa note in lungsim nunnem tawh tua mipa na phongkia ding uhi. Ze-etna na thuoh lo nadingun no le no kikem un.","title":"Khatlekhat Vangih Kipuohpi Un"},"2":{"text":"Khatlekhat vangih na kipuohpi un, tua hile tam bang dan tawh Khris’ thukham na tangtun ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen bangma ahi lote a kithupi ngaisut uleh amau le amau kisol ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi zosie in a vengte’ nasepna tawh ki-ette zaw loin amau’ nasepna ciet kisittel phot uheh; tua hile a kisielna uh ahang pen a nasepna uh ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie in amau’ van ciet a puo ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pasien’ thu a kihil mite in amau’ siepa tawh sil hoi bangkim a ngaton valon ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mi kisolsah sih un; Pasien pen simmawbawl thei ahi sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile na vaw bangin na atkia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Cilesa ading khaici na vaw leh cilesa panin sietna na at ding hi; ahi vangin Hlagau adingin khaici na vaw leh Hlagau pan ma-in kumtawn hinna na at ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin na hoi sep ding cimtah sih vai, azieh pen lungkie lo-a i sep nah po leh a hun tun ciengin a ga i at ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n hun lemtang i nei petun mi zosie adingin sil hoi bawlin, a deudeu-in upna lama innkuonpite tungah bawl vai."},"11":{"text":"Keima’ khut tawh kang giel laimal golpite en vawi vun!","title":"A Tawpna Thuhilna le Thuphapiehna"},"12":{"text":"Cilesa lamah mihoi a hina uh a talang nuomte in Khris’ singlamte zieha bawlsietna a thuoh lo nadingun note teptan dinga ang paubawl uh ahi bo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tep kitansa mite nangawn in thukham a zui tuon sih vua, ahi vangin na cilesa tung vuah amate ang kisiel nop ziehun tep ang tansah nuom uh ahi bo hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei ka hi leh Topa Jesu Khris’ singlamte simlo bang khatpo ka kisielpi ngai sih ding hi, tua singlamte ziehin keima tungah leitung kikhailia-in, keima zong leitungah ka kikhailia zo ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen teptanna le teptan lona pen a thupi hi loin, a thupi pen siemthana hizaw hi!"},"16":{"text":"Tami zui ding thu banga kalsuon sawmte tung le Pasien’ minam Israel-te tungah lungnopna le hepina om taheh."},"17":{"text":"Tu-a kipanin koima in ei subuoi ta sih heh; azieh pen ka pumpi tungah Jesu’ melcina himapawn a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina in na hlagau utawh hing om taheh. Amen."}}}}},"49":{"info":{"name":"Ephesus-te","shortname":"Eph","abbr":[],"desc":"Ephesus-te tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to the ephesians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ deina ziehin Khris Jesu’ sawltahpi Paul in, Ephesus khuo-a om misiengthote, Khris Jesu sunga mi muonhuoite tungah:","title":"Hopina","ref":"Sawl 18:19-21; 19:1"},"2":{"text":"I Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung pan hepina le kilemna om taheh."},"3":{"text":"Khris sungah vantung munte sunga om hlagau thupha namcin tawh eite thupha ei pie, i Topa Jesu Khris’ Pa Pasien in thupha nga ta hinlen,","title":"Khris Sunga Hlagau Thuphate"},"4":{"text":"eite in ama mai-ah itna hang tawh siengtho-in paubanna i nei lo nadingin leitung pien masangin ama in Khris sungah ei teel zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’ hoisah le ama’ dei dan tawh kizui-in ama in Jesu Khris tungtawnin ama’ tate ahi dinga tapa za nga dingin ei na laitan kholsa ahi a,"},"6":{"text":"tua khu a Itpa sungah eite ei hlawnpieh ahi, a minthang ama’ hepina i patawi thei nading uh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Eite in ama’ sisan tungtawnin ama sungah tatkhietna i nga vua, ama’ hepina zieha haunate tawh kizui-in i thupalsatnate uh tungah ngaidamna i nga vua,","ref":"Col 1:14"},"8":{"text":"ama in pilna namcin le thuthuh theina tawh eite tungah a dimlet a ei pieh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Khris sunga a koisa ama’ hoisah dan tawh kizui-in ama’ deina thuthuhpi zong ei theisah zo ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua thuthuhpi i ci pen in, a hun a cin ciengin vantung le leitunga a om sil bangkim Khris sunga gawmtuo ding gelna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A ngaisutna le a deina tawh kituoha sil bangkim a muolsuo pa in ama’ ngimna tawh kituohin a laitansa bangin kote in zong Khris sungah gouluo za ka nga vua,"},"12":{"text":"Khris tungah lametna a koi masa kote a minthanna a patawi dinga ka nuntat thei nading uh ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Note in ang kihutdamna lungdamna thu ahi thuman thutah za-in ama na up zaw ciengun, nohaw zong ama sungah kamciemna tawh kipawl Hlagau Siengtho tawh ang kiciemtesa na hi ta uhi;"},"14":{"text":"tua khu ama’ minthanna patawi nadingin Pasien neisa mite’ tatkhietna dongin i luo ding ei khamkholna gou ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in Topa Jesu sunga na upna ule misiengthote zosie tunga na itna uh ka na za zo ta a, tua thu ziehin","title":"Paul’ Thungetna"},"16":{"text":"ka thungetnate-ah hing phawh kawmin note adingin khawl hun nei loin lungdam ka ko den hi."},"17":{"text":"Note in ama na thei ziehun i Topa Jesu Khris Pasien, a minthang Pa in note lungpilna le kilahna ang pieh thei nading,"},"18":{"text":"na lungsim mitte uh vahsahin note ang hlatna tawh kipawl lametna, misiengthote lahah a minthang ama’ gouluo zieha haunate,"},"19":{"text":"le a lien ama’ vanglietna nasep thupite dung zui-in a um eite adingin tezawh ahi lo ama’ vanglietna lienpite bang ahei ci note in na thei nadingun thu kang ngetpieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasien in sina panin ama thosahin, vantung munte sunga ama’ zietlamah a tosah lai-in Khris sungah na sem dingin tami vanglietna guonpieh a,","ref":"Late 110:1"},"21":{"text":"vaihawmna le thuneina, vanglietna le uhna vannuoite tungah hile, tu khanghun beh ah hi loin, ang tung ding khanghun ah zong hile a kiphuo min zosie tungah a tosah hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasien in ama’ keng nei-ah sil bangkim koi a, a hlattuom pawlpi adingin a lutangin ama a bawl zo hi.","ref":"Late 8:6"},"23":{"text":"Tua hlattuom pawlpi pen ama’ pumpi ahi a, bangkimah bangkim a kicingsah pa’ kicinna ahi hi.","ref":"Col 1:18"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note na hi ule khielnate le mawnate ziehin na si vua,","title":"Sina Pan Hinna"},"2":{"text":"tami leitung tawndante, tulaitaha thumang lote lahah na a sem hlagau ahi hui lah a uh pa’ deina bangin zui-in tuate sungah na tuolbuol ngai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Eihaw zosie in i lungsim le i pumpi’ lunggulnate zui-in amate lahah cilesa deinate sungah i na nungta ngai vua, i pienpi ngainate ziehin eite zong midangte bangin thangpaina’ tate i na hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuotuona a hau Pasien in a lien mama eite ei itna ziehin"},"5":{"text":"i khielnate tungtawnin si-a i op laitah nangawnun Khris tawh ei hingtonsah a, hepina ziehin hutdamin i om ta uhi.","ref":"Col 2:13"},"6":{"text":"Pasien in Khris tawh eite ei thotonsah a, vantung munte-a om Khris Jesu sungah ama tawh ei totonsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua khu ang tung ding khang hunah Khris Jesu sunga a om tezawh lo ama’ hepina ziehin eite tungah ama’ migitna ei lah thei nading ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen hepina ziehin upna tawh hutdamsa na hi ta vua, tua khu noma’ sepna zieh ahi vawt sih hi; Pasien’ letsong ahi bo hi."},"9":{"text":"Nasep zieh ahi lo ziehin koima in a kisahtheipi thei sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite pen nasep hoite a sem dinga Khris Jesu sunga ei kipiengsah ama’ bawlsate i hi vua, tua khu Pasien in a na gelkholsa i nuntahzie ding uh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin nidang lai-in pienpi Gentile-te na hi vua, “tep kitante ka hi uhi,” a kici mite in- cilesa tungah mihing’ khut tawh tahsa teptanna- a tep kitan lo mite ang ci uh phawh un.","title":"Khris sungah Pumkhat"},"12":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Khris nei loin Israel innkuon belpawl panin ang kipuse-in kamciem tawh a kipawl thuciemnate a nga lo gamdang mite na hi vua, leitungah lametna nei lo le Pasien nei lote na hi lam uh phawh un."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Khris’ sisan ziehin hun khat lai-a gamlapi-a om note, tu-in ama in Khris Jesu sungah ang kinaisah ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen ama eite’ kilemna ahi hi; ama in ama’ cilesa ah eite kikala a om huotna a kici dalna kulpi cimsahin pawl nite pawlkhat a suohsah zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in amama’ sungah tua minam nite munah minam tha khat a siem thei nadingin, thukham’ thupiehte, le tawndan ngainate phietmangin kilemna bawl a,","ref":"Col 2:14"},"16":{"text":"singlamte tungtawnin Pasien tungah pawl nite pumkhat a suoh dingin ei lemtuo kia-in, tua tungtawnin ama in kigalbawlnate a sisah hi.","ref":"Col 1:20"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama pei-in a gamlapi-a om note le a nai-a om mite kungah kilemna thu a gen zo hi.","ref":"Isa 57:19"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ei minam nite in ama tungtawnin Hlagau khat sungah Pa kung lut theina thu i nei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n note pen khuolmi le gamdang mite hi nawn loin misiengthote tawh gammi suohtonin Pasien’ innkuon sung mite zong na hi ta vua,"},"20":{"text":"innkiu suongpi Jesu Khris mama tawh khuombul ahi sawltahpite le kamsangte tunga a kilam na hi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama sungah tua inn buppi kizom dimdiemin khang a, tuaci’n Topa sungah a siengtho biehinnpi khat a suoh hi;"},"22":{"text":"note zong Pasien a Hlagau-a ang tenna mun a suoh dingin a kilamton na hi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin no Gentile-te tangin Khris Jesu adinga thongkie pa keima Paul in,","title":"Gentile-te tunga Paul’ Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"note adingin Pasien’ hepina nasep kei tunga ei kipiehna le,"},"3":{"text":"lai tawh a tomno-a kang giel bangin keima tungah kilahna tawh tua thuthuh bangci bangin ei kitheisah ahei, ci thu na za zo tham ta ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tami lai na sim ciengun Khris’ thuthuh ka theitel zie na thei ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuhun ciengin a siengtho ama’ sawltahpite le a kamsangte tungah tami thuthuh a kitheisah bangin nidang khang hunin mihingte tungah na kitheisah kha lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua thuthuh i ci in: Lungdamna thu tungtawnin Gentile-te in Israel-te tawh gou luo tonin, pumpi khat’ nate suoh tonin Khris Jesu sungah kamciem a nga tonte ahi ta uhi.","ref":"Col 1:26-27"},"7":{"text":"Keima tunga ei kipie Pasien’ hepina letsong tawh kizui-in ama’ vanglietna nasepna hang tawh kei zong tami lungdamna thu’ nasempa khat a suoh ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei ka hile misiengtho zosiete lahah a neupen ka hi vangin Gentile-te tungah ciengtan a nei lo Khris’ haunate ahi lungdamna thute a puoh ding le,"},"9":{"text":"sil bangkim a piengsah pa Pasien sungah tangtawng peh pana a na kiphuoldap ahi tua thuthuh tawh kisai gelna pen bang ahei, ci mi zosie a musah dingin tami hepina ei kipie zo a,"},"10":{"text":"tua khu tuhun hlattuom pawlpi tungtawnin vantung munte-a om thuneite le uhna a neite tungah a kicing Pasien’ pilna namcin a kitheisah nading ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami pen kumtawn ama’ tupna dung zui-in ama in i Topa Jesu Khris sunga a sepsa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Eite in ama i upna uh tungtawnin ama sunga a om hangsanna le muonna tawh Pasien kung i lut thei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note adinga ka thuohnate uh ziehin keima in na lungkieh lo nadingun thu kang ngetpieh hi; tuate pen note’ minthanna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin ka Pa mai-ah ka khupdin a,","title":"Laisimte ading Thungetna"},"15":{"text":"ama tung panin vantung le leitunga innkuon zosie a min kivaw ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a minthang a haunate dung zui-in ama’ Hlagau vanglietna tawh na sunglam mi uh ang thakhausah nading le,"},"17":{"text":"upna tungtawnin note’ lungsim sungah Khris ang tengin itna sungah na kiphungvua thei nadingun thu kang ngetpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Note in zong misiengthote zosie tawh Khris’ ei itna adung avai, a sanna le a thuhnate na thei nadingun vanglietna nei-in,"},"19":{"text":"Pasien’ bukimna namcin tawh kidim a, theina in a bat zawh lo Khris’ itna na thei nadingun thu kang ngetpieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in i nget thei zosie le i lunggel thei zosie sanga a nah thupi zawtham le, eite sungah a vanglietna tawh kizui-a a sem thei pa tungah,"},"21":{"text":"khang zosie tungah hlattuom pawlpi sung le Khris Jesu sunga a om minthanna kumtawnin hing om zing taheh. Amen."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Topa sunga thongkie pa keima Paul in ang kihlatna utawh kituohin hinkhuo na nei thei nadingun kang thum hi.","title":"Khris Pumpi Sunga Kipumkhatna"},"2":{"text":"Sil bangkimah kiniemkhiehna, lungnemna, lungduoina tawh kidimin, itna sungah khatlekhat na kithuohpi ciet unlen,","ref":"Col 3:12-13"},"3":{"text":"note ang khiton kilemna sungah Hlagau kipumkhatna na tuhkip thei nadingun na hi thei tawpun na bawl un."},"4":{"text":"Note ang kihlatna ah lametna khat sunga ang kihlan ahi ma bangin pumpi khat le Hlagau khat,"},"5":{"text":"Topa khat, upna khat, baptize-na khat,"},"6":{"text":"na zosie tunga om, na zosie tungtawna na zosie sunga a om pa, mi zosie’ Pa le Pasien khat beh a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin Khris’ letsong ei kipiehna zaza tawh kituohin eite khat ciet tungah hepina ei kipie hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin, “Ama a sangna-ah a kato ciengin a kimansa salte zawpito a, ama in mite tungah letsongte a pie hi,” kici hi.","ref":"Late 68:18"},"9":{"text":"(“Ama kato hi,” a ci ciengin bang deina ahei cile ama zong lei sungtawng tengah na kumsuh zo hi, a cinopna hi lo amah?"},"10":{"text":"Sil bangkim a kicinsah thei nadingin a kumsuh pa pen vantungte zosie sanga a sangzaw-a kato pa ma ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama’ pieh letsongte ahile pawlkhat sawltahpite, pawlkhat kamsangte, pawlkhat lungdamna thu gente, pawlkhat pawlpi kem siete le laihil siete hi a,"},"12":{"text":"amate in Khris’ pumpi a kilam nadingin Pasien’ na a sem ding misiengthote pantah ding a,"},"13":{"text":"tua khu upna le Pasien’ Tapa theitheina-ah eihaw zosie pumkhat suohin picing a, a bukim Khris’ cingtahna zaza cieng dong i tun thei nading uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Eite i hi ule mihingte’ ngiensiemna le a pilkhel a zuouthu gelna uh ahi thuhilna hui namcin in ei mutna zieha a hawisuh a hawito kawikawi naupangte i hi nawn sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lutang ahi Khris sungah i khanto bukim thei nadingun itna tawh thuman thutah i genzaw ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama tung panin pumpi buppi tawh thahui thazam zosie kizomin kiphan dimdiem a, pumpi nate in a sep ding ciet uh hoitahin a sep ciengun itna sungah tua pumpi khangin ama le ama a kilamkip hi.","ref":"Col 2:19"},"17":{"text":"Tu-in keima in tami thu sukipin Topa sunga kang paugen ahi hi: Kimanna a nei lo amau’ lungsim bangin Gentile-te a nuntah bangun note nungta nawn sih un.","title":"Hinna Tha le Hinna Lui"},"18":{"text":"A lungkhauna zieh ule a lungmawlnate ziehun a thu theinate uh suhmielin a om ta a, tuaci’n Pasien’ hinna panin a kikhenkhie ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in maizumna mel thei nawn loin thangtatna lamah a kipumpieh sieng vua, a siengtho lo sil bangkim a sem dingin lunggulna a nei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khris’ thu na sin uh pen tua bang ahi sih hi!"},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Jesu sungah thuman thutah a op bangin note in ama’ thu na za zo tahpi vua, ama sungah thu ang kihil zo ta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Nidang lai-a na hindan lui uh ahi cilesa lunggulna’ solna zieha a muot thei na milui uh a paimang ding,","ref":"Col 3:9"},"23":{"text":"na lungsim puohziete uh a kibawltha ding le,"},"24":{"text":"dihna le siengthona tahtah sungah Pasien tawh a kisun dinga ang kisiemsa na hina uh dung zui-in, mitha na sil nadingun thu ang kihil ahi hi.","ref":"Col 3:10; Pien 1:26"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin eite khatlekhat pumpi nate i hi ciet ziehun zuouthu gennate paimangin i unpi-un i vengte kungah thuman thutah gen ciet vai.","title":"Hinna Tha adinga Zui ding Thute","ref":"Zech 8:16"},"26":{"text":"Lungthah unlen ahi vangin maw sih un; lungthahna tawh ni na tumsah sih unlen,","ref":"Late 4:8"},"27":{"text":"dawimangpa mun na pie sih un."},"28":{"text":"Gutate in gu nawn loin, tasamte bang khatpo a hopsawn thei nadingun a khut utawh thuman tahin gimpipi-in na semzaw uheh."},"29":{"text":"Na kamham un a za mite phattuomna a pieh thei nadingin, na kam sung panun kam gilo pusuohsah sih unlen, kisapna a om bangin mite kilamkip nadingin a kimang thei kamte beh na hamzaw un."},"30":{"text":"Tatna ni adinga ang kiciemtena uh Pasien’ Hlagau Siengtho na dasah sih un."},"31":{"text":"Note kung panin kilunghimawna, thangpaina, lungthahna, kihau kiselna, le kigensietna zosie, thangsietnate zosie tawh na paimangtha un."},"32":{"text":"Khatlekhat kihepi-in lainatna na kinei unlen, Pasien in Khris sungah note’ mawna ang maisah bangin note zong khatlekhat na kimaisah un.","ref":"Col 3:13"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ang ki-it tate na hi ziehun Pasien a ette mite na hi unlen,"},"2":{"text":"Khris in eite ei itin, eite adingin Pasien tungah a namtui silpieh le biehpiehna dingin ama le ama a kipieh bangin itna sungah na nungta un.","ref":"Pei 29:18; Late 40:6"},"3":{"text":"Hinanle misiengthote lahah a om dinga a kilawm lo ahi bang ma-in note lahah numei-pasal pahtatna, sil sieng lo nam khat popo le huoihamna kicite nangawn genin kinei vet sih heh.","title":"Lawki Tawndante Taisan Un"},"4":{"text":"Na kam panun zummaw hamna, mot-hamna, a thanghuoi ciemmuina cite na omsah sih un; tua bang sangin lungdamkona na neizaw un."},"5":{"text":"Numei-pasal khielna a bawl mi, a siengtho lo mi, le a huoiham mi in (milim bie pa a cinopna) Khris le Pasien’ gamah gouluo bangma a nei sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tam thute ziehin mi thunung lote tungah Pasien’ thangpaina tung ding ahi ziehin, koima in thugina lote tawh kisolsah sih un."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin amate tawh kigop sih un."},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen nidang lai-in note khuomiel sungah na om vua, ahi vangin tu-in ahile Topa sungah khuovah na hi ta uhi. Khuovah’ tate bangin na nungta un,"},"9":{"text":"azieh pen a hoi, a dih, le a man sil bangkimah khuovah’ ga kimu hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ lungkimna bang ahei, ci na mu nadingun na hakat un."},"11":{"text":"A ga nei lo khuomiel nasepnate ah kihal loin tuate na pholah zaw un."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua bang mite in guhsima a septe uh gen ding nangawnin zumhuoi hi;"},"13":{"text":"hizongle khuovah in a pholah sil zosie mu thei a suoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen tua a kimu thei sil zosie khuovah ahi hi. Tua ahi ziehin, “A kimu mi aw, khanglo in! Sina panin tho in, tua hile nangma tungah Khris in ang tanvah ding hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin a pil lote bang hi loin, a pilte bangin na nuntah ziete uh kidawm unlen,"},"16":{"text":"hun le nite a siet tah ziehin na hun neisunte uh a hoi lamin zang un.","ref":"Col 4:5"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n mawlawm sih unlen, Topa’ deina bang ahei, ci theisiemzaw un."},"18":{"text":"Zu in mi siesah thei ahi ziehin zu kham sih unlen, Hlagau tawh kidimzaw un."},"19":{"text":"Note lahah phatna late, biehna late, le hlagau lam late na sah ciengun, na lung sung vuah kihuol tahin Topa tungah na sa un."},"20":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris’ minin sil bangkim adingin Pa Pasien tungah nuomthu tut zing un.","ref":"Col 3:16-17"},"21":{"text":"Khris zatahna zalin khatlekhat thu na kimang un.","title":"Tapidaw Innkuon"},"22":{"text":"Zite aw, Topa’ thu na man bangun na pasalte’ thu na mang un.","ref":"Col 3:18; 1Pet 3:1"},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen Khris in hlattuom pawlpi’ lutang ahi ma bangin pasal in a zi’ lutang ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpi in Khris’ thu a man bangin zite in zong sil bangkimah a pasalte’ thu a man ding uh kilawm hi."},"25":{"text":"Pasalte aw, Khris in hlattuom pawlpi itin ama adingin ama ma a kipieh bangin na zite na it un.","ref":"Col 3:19; 1Pet 3:7"},"26":{"text":"Ama in hlattuom pawlpi a sienthosah thei nadingin thu tungtawnin tui tawh sawp sieng a,"},"27":{"text":"tua in hlattuom pawlpi pen a nieh, a vuntun le tua bang nam khatpopo om loin, ama ma tungah a siengtho le kawbang loin etlawm taha a kipieh thei nading ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ma bangin pasalte in a pumpi uh a it bangun a zite a it ding uh kilawm hi."},"29":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile ama’ pumpi a muda koima a om ngai sih a, Khris in a hlattuom pawlpi va-in a kep bangin ama’ pumpi va-in kemzaw hi."},"30":{"text":"Azieh pen eite ama’ pumpi nate i hi uhi."},"31":{"text":"“Tami thu ziehin pasal in a nu le a pa nuasie-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a, tua nite sa khat a suoh ding uhi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pien 2:24"},"32":{"text":"Tami pen thuthuhpi khat hi a, Khris le hlattuom pawlpite tunga a zang ka hi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi vangin note a koi mapo in ama le ama a ki-it bangin na zite uh na it ding uh kilawm hi. Zi in zong a pasal a zatah ding kilawm hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tate aw, Topa sungah na nu na pate uh na it un, azieh pen tami khu thudih ahi hi.","title":"Tate le Nu le Pate","ref":"Col 3:20"},"2":{"text":"“Na nu le na pa zatah in,” tami in kamciem tawh kikop thupieh masa pen ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Tuaci’n leitungah note nuomsa-in na dam sawt ding uhi.”","ref":"Pei 20:12; Thkna 5:16"},"4":{"text":"Pate aw, na tate lungthahsah sih unlen, pattahna le Topa lamlahna ah khangliensah zaw un.”","ref":"Col 3:21"},"5":{"text":"Silate aw, note in Khris’ thu na man bangun zauna le linna tawh lung khat khai-in na leitung pute uh’ thu na mang un.","title":"Silate le a Pute"},"6":{"text":"Amate ang mu sungin a lungkim nading beh uh hi loin, Khris’ silate bangin na lungtang sung vuah Pasien’ deina bangin na sem un."},"7":{"text":"Numei le pasalte’ na a sem bang hi loin Topa’ na a sem bangin thanopna tawh na sem un."},"8":{"text":"Silate i hi a, sila lote i hi zongin, Topa kung panin na hoi i sep poma a kibangin i ngakia ding uhi, ci i thei uhi.","ref":"Col 3:22-25"},"9":{"text":"Pute aw, amate tungah tua bang ma-in na bawl un. No gel pen vantungah na ni-un pu kibang nei na hi vua, ama in deidan a nei lo lam thei unlen, na silate na hugih nawn sih un.","ref":"Col 3:25; 4:1; Thkna 10:17"},"10":{"text":"A tawpna-ah Topa sung le ama’ vangliet thahatna sungah thakhauh un.","title":"Pasien’ Galvan Bukim"},"11":{"text":"Dawimangpa’ solna na nan zawh nadingun Pasien’ galvan bukim tawh kivon un."},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite do pen tahsa le sisan nei galte hi loin, uhna neite, thuneinate, tu hun tami leitung khuomiel vanglietnate, le vantung munte a om hlagau gilo galkapte ahi zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin sietna ni ang tun ciengin na nan zawh nading ule sil bangkim na sep zaw ciengun na dinkip zawh nadingun Pasien’ galvan bukim keng un."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na kawng vuah thutah kawnggah gah unlen, dihna awmdal tawh kivonin ding un.","ref":"Isa 11:5; 59:17"},"15":{"text":"Kedap bangin na keng vuah kilemna lungdamna thu bulin a baisa-in om un.","ref":"Isa 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Gilopa’ meikuong thaltangte na suhmit zawh nadingun tam teng zosie tawh upna lum na tawi un."},"17":{"text":"Hutdamna sia lukhu le Pasien’ kammal ahi Hlagau namsau tawi un.","ref":"Isa 59:17"},"18":{"text":"Hun zosie-ah Hlagau Siengtho tawh thungetna namcin le thumna namcin na nei un. Tua banga na bawl thei nadingun pilvang unlen, misiengthote zosie adingin thu na ngetpieh zing un."},"19":{"text":"Ka thu gen ciengin ka gen ding thu ei kipieh nading le lungdamna thuthuh hangtaha ka theisah thei nadingin kei adingin zong thu ei na ngetpieh un."},"20":{"text":"Kei ka hile tua thu ziehin kol kibul palai khat ka hi hi. Ka gen ding bangin hangsan taha ka gen thei nadingin thu ei na ngetpieh bo un."},"21":{"text":"Note in zong kei bangci op a, bang sem ka hei, ci thu nei thei nadingun Tychicus in na kung vuah thu zosie ang gen ding hi. Ama pen Topa sungah nasem muonhuoi ka it sanggam khat ahi hi.","title":"Aituom Thute le Thuphapiehna","ref":"Sawl 20:4; 2Tim 4:12"},"22":{"text":"Kote bangci op ci note in na thei nading ule na lungsimte uh ang hansuo thei nading mama tupna tawh na kung vuah ama kang sawl hi.","ref":"Col 4:7-8"},"23":{"text":"Mi buppi tungah Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung panin upna tawh kipawl itna le kilemna hing tung taheh."},"24":{"text":"A tul thei lo itna tawh i Topa Jesu Khris a it mi zosie tungah zong hepina om taheh."}}}}},"50":{"info":{"name":"Philippi-te","shortname":"Phil","abbr":[],"desc":"Philippi-te tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to the philippians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khris Jesu’ nasemte ahi Paul le Timothy in, Philippi khuo-a om Khris Jesu sunga misiengthote zosie a kipan hlattuom pawlpi makaite le upate tungah:","ref":"Sawl 16:12"},"2":{"text":"I Pa uh Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung panin kilemna le hepina hing om taheh."},"3":{"text":"Note kang phaw sielin ka Pasien tungah lungdamna ka ko a,","title":"Philippi-te dinga Paul’ Thungetna"},"4":{"text":"ka thungetna cintengah note adingin a tawntungin kipahna tawh thu ka ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"A kipat cil lai-a kipan tu ni dong ciengin lungdamna thu sungah nang kihal ziehun ka lung a dam hi."},"6":{"text":"Note lahah nasep hoi a pan pa in Jesu Khris’ ni cieng dongin bawl muolsuoh ding hi, ci-in ka muong hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lungsim sung vuah nei vei ziehun note zosie tam bang dan a kang ngaisut ding pen kei adingin a man ahi hi, azieh pen ka thongkiehna, lungdamna thu ka hunna le ka kipsahna ah keima tawh kibangin note zosie in zong Pasien’ hepina na tang uhi."},"8":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Khris’ ei lungsietna tawh note zosie kang ngai ngetngut lam pen Pasien ka teci ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka thungetna ahile, note’ itna in theina le thu khentel theina bukim tawh dimlet semsem a,"},"10":{"text":"sil hoi pen bang ahei, ci thu khentel thei-in, Khris’ ni ciengin siengtho-in kawbanna om loin"},"11":{"text":"Pasien’ minthan nading le ama’ min a kiphat nadingin Jesu Khris tungtawna ang pei dihna’ gate tawh na kidim nading uh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kang itte aw, kei tunga a pieng thute in lungdamna thu a kizel nadingin a panpi tahpi zo hi, ci thu note in na thei ding uh ka dei hi.","title":"Tulaitah Paul’ Omdante"},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n kumpi inncing galkapte le midangte zosie in Khris adinga ka thongkiehna thu a thei sieng ta uhi.","ref":"Sawl 28:30"},"14":{"text":"Ka thongkiehna ziehin sanggam a tamzawte in Topa muonna-in a nei vua, zau lo tah le hangsanna lienpi tawh thu a gen ngam uhi."},"15":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in hazatna le demna tawh Khris’ thu a gen vua, ahi vangin adangte in lungsim hoi tawh a gen uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bang mite in kei pen lungdamna thu a hung dinga tam sunga ei kikoi ahi lam a thei ziehun itna tawh Khris’ thu a gen uhi;"},"17":{"text":"adangte in lungsimtahpi tawh hi loin, ka thongkiehna-a ka gim thuohte a kibelap thei nading bepin angsung khuolna tawh Khris’ thu a gen zawsop uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahile bang phamaw ahei? Ngimna zuou tawh ahi a, ngimna man tawh ahi zongin banglam banglam hi tase le Khris’ thu a kigen zo lang kalsie tuami thu-ah ka kipah mama lel hi. Hi hi, ka kipah suoh lai ding hi,"},"19":{"text":"azieh pen keima in note’ ei thungetpiehna le Jesu Khris Hlagau’ ei panpina tungtawnin tami thu in ka suotahna piengsah ding hi, ci thu ka thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Sina tawh ahi a, hinna tawh ahi a, lam khatpopo-ah ahi zongin keima in muolphona thuoh loin, hangsanna kici zosie tawh thu ka genna ziehin ka pumpi tahsa tungah tu le a tawntungin Khris a kipatawi thei nading pen ka lunggul luot thu le ka kinepna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei dingin ahile hinna pen Khris ading ahi a, sina zong khu metna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tahsa tawh a nungta lai ding hi leng kei adingin ka nasep lawcing mama ding ahi ziehin si ding le hin ding pen teel zawh ding ka thei sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Tami thu nite kikalah teel zawh kuom ding mel thei loin tangciehin ka om hi: ka lunggul pen ahile peikhie dawhin Khris tawh ka omton nuom hi, bangzieh ahei cile tua pen nahpi tahin hoizaw tham hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi vangin tahsa pumpi-a ka nuntah ding pen note adingin kisamzaw tham lai hi."},"25":{"text":"Tami thu ka theitel lang kalsie na khanto nading ule upna sunga na lungdam nadingun note zosie tawh ka opton suoh lai ding ka thei a,"},"26":{"text":"tuaci’n na kung vua kang hawkia ciengin Khris Jesu sungah na kisahtheina uh ahi keima in zong kicingtahin note kang kisahtheipi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Khris lungdamna thu tawh kituoh kilawmin na hinkhuo uh hing mang phot un, tua hile kei hing haw-in note tawh kimu-in ahi a, ka op lo kalin na thu uh ka galzah ahi zongin, hlagau khat sunga na dinkipna ule lungdamna thu tawh kipawl upna adingin lungsim kikhatin na hanciemna uh ka thei ta ding hi."},"28":{"text":"No ang langpangte ziehin zong zau vawt sih un. Tam pen amate adingin a kisietna uh a talang thu khat ahi a, hizongle tua pen note’ kihutdamna ahi zaw hi. Tam pen Pasien’ nasepna ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in Khris na up nading beh uh hi loin, ama adinga na thuoh thei nading uh hamphatna zong hepina tawh note tungah ang pie zo ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka thuohsa bangin note in zong na thuoh lam uh na thei lang kalsie uh tu-in thuoh ding a nei lai ka hi lam zong thei ta un.","ref":"Sawl 16:19-40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Khris sungah kihansuona, itna tawh kihenepna, hlagau sunga kipawl theina, kilainatna le kilungsietna khatpo a op leh,","title":"Khris’ Kiniemkhiehna Ette Ding"},"2":{"text":"lungsim kibang kuo-in, itna kibang nei a, lungsim kihuolin kithutuoh unlen, ka lungnopna kicingsah un."},"3":{"text":"Huoihamna le kihisahna tawh bangma sem loin, kiniemkhiehin noma sangin midangte a hoizaw-in ngaisun un."},"4":{"text":"Noma’ phattuomna ding beh ngaisun loin, midangte’ phattuomna ding zong ngaisutpieh un."},"5":{"text":"Khris Jesu sunga a om tami lungsim, note sungah zong omsah un."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Pasien’ pienzie nei napi, Pasien tawh kizakim ding a tu tentun sih a,"},"7":{"text":"ama le ama kihawmsuohsah tawmin, sila lim la-in mihing bangin ang piengzaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihing mel hing puo a, ama le ama kiniemkhieh tawmin, a sina tanpha-in thu mangin, singlamte tung nangawnah sina a thuoh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien in ama thupi tahin tawisang a, min zosiete sangin a thupizaw min a pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n vantung, leitung le lei nei-a om zosiete in Jesu’ minin a khupdin ding vua,"},"11":{"text":"Pa Pasien’ minthan nadingin leii zosie in Jesu Khris khu Topa ahi hi, ci-in a pulah ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 45:23"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka itte aw, note in ka thu nei man zingsa ma bangun, ka op sung beh hi loin, tu ka op lo sungin zong ei mangzaw kan lai unlen, zauna le linna lungsim tawh na hutdamna uh na cingtahsah un.","title":"Leitungah Khuovahte Bangin Tang ding"},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama’ lungkimna banga na sep nop nading ule na sep thei nadingun note sunga na ang sem pa, Pasien ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Phun lo niel loin sil bangkim sem un,"},"15":{"text":"tua hile lungsim kawi le a letat khang mite laizangah mukawh om lo, nuol bei le khielna a nei lo Pasien’ tate na suoh ding vua, leitungah aasi bangin na tang ding uhi.","ref":"Thkna 32:5"},"16":{"text":"Hinna thu na tuhkip ziehun Khris’ ni ang tun ciengin kei pen a mawh tai le a mawh sep ka suo lona thu ka kisiel thei ta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin na upna ziehun silpieh ding le biehpiehna-a gaw dingin ei kisungsuh nanle note zosie tawh lungdamin ka kipah veve hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ma bangin note zong kipahin keima tawh a lungdamton ding na hi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Note’ thu ka zahna ziehin keima zong ka lungnop tuom nadingin a sawt loin na kung vuah Timothy kang sawl ding hi, ci-in Topa sungah ka kinem hi.","title":"Timothy le Epaphroditus"},"20":{"text":"Note’ phattuom nadinga ang lunghimawpi tahtah ding ama bang koima dang ka nei sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in a unpi-un Jesu Khris’ phattuom nading sui loin amau’ phattuom nading a sui uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hizongle tapa in a pa tawh na a septon bangin, ama in lungdamna thu nasepna-ah keima tawh na semton zo a, note in zong Timothy’ manphatna na thei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka vai ding a kitel zaw lien ciengin ama ang sawl pai dingin ka kilamen hi."},"24":{"text":"Keima zong a sawt loin ang haw thei dingin Topa tungah muonna ka nei hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka sanggampa, ka naseppi le ka galkappi pa, ka kitasapna ei seppieh, na kamtai pa Epaphroditus zong na kung vuah sawl ding kisam hi, ci-in ka ngaisun lai hi."},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in note zosie ang ngai ngetngut a, note in a dam lona thu na zah ziehun ama zong a lunghel mama hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama pen a cina tahpi hi a, zong a si dihtah phiel ahi hi. Hizongle Pasien in ama hepi a, ama beh hi loin kei zong ei hepi hi. Tua hi sihle ka dana a kibelap to sawnsawn ding ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin note in ama na mukia ciengun na lungdam thei nading ule ka lunghimawna a kiem tuom nadingin ama kang peisah ding ka kin semsem hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin Topa sungah lungdam tahin ama na sang unlen, tam bang mite na patawi bo un."},"30":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama pen Khris’ nasepna dingin note in nei seppieh thei lo uh nasepnate a sem dinga a hinna khamin a silaw dihtah vawt pa ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tawpna-ah ka sanggamte aw, Topa sungah lungdam un. Note tungah a kibang ma gielkia ding pen gimhuoi ka sa sih a, tua khu note adingin kihumbitna a suoh zaw hi.","title":"A Tawpsa Hun Tawh Kikhenna"},"2":{"text":"Uite na pel un, gilo nasemte na pel unlen tahsa atkeh gawpte na pel un!"},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite pen cilesa a suong lo, Pasien’ hlagau tawh biehna a pie, Khris Jesu sunga a kisiel le teptanna a man a zangte i hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle ke’n zong cilesa sungah suon ding thu ka nei veve hi. Midang khatpo in cilesa sungah suon ding nei-a a kingaisut leh ke’n ka nei zaw kan lai hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni giet ni-in ka tep ei kitan a, Israel’ mi, Benjamin suon, Hebrew-te pana a pieng Hebrew mi, thukham lamah zong Pharisee mi,","ref":"Rom 11:1; Sawl 23:6; 26:5"},"6":{"text":"pawnthawna lamah cilei hlattuom pawlpi a bawlsie pa, thukham tawh kisai dihna lamah zong gen a baang lo pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4; 26:9-11"},"7":{"text":"Hizongle ka nei hamphatna kici poma, Khris ziehin supna-in ka ngaisun hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua tham loin, sil bangkim sanga a manphazaw ka Topa Jesu Khris’ thu ka theina ziehin sil bangkim supna-in ka ngaisun hi. Ama ziehin sil bangkim ka tanlaw a, tuate buathah lomtang bangin ka ngaisun hi. Tua khu Khris ka nga thei nading le"},"9":{"text":"ama sungah ei kimu thei nading ahi a, thukham pana ang pei keima’ dihna a nei ka hi sih a, Khris upna tungtawnin Pasien pana ang pei upna bulphu dihna a nei ka hizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in Khris le a thawkia vanglietna le, ama’ sina sungah ama bang hina tawh ama’ thuohnate thuohpi theina thu ka thei nuom hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua pen lampi khatpopo tawh misite lah panin thawkiana ka nga thei khah leh a ci ka hi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tami ka nga zo ta a, ka mungtup ka tung zo ta hi, a ci ka hi sih a, hizongle Khris in ama’ neisa banga ei bawl ziehin keima in zong tua pen keima-a’ ka hisah thei nadingin mai ka nawt tentun hi.","title":"Mungtup Lam Mainawtin Tai"},"13":{"text":"Ka Itte aw, tuate a nei zo-in ka kingaisun nai sih hi; hizongle ka sil bawl khat pen tami ahi hi: Nua lam thute mangngil bawlin mai lama om nate hanciemin ka del tentun a,"},"14":{"text":"Khris Jesu sungah vantung pana Pasien’ hlatna ahi patawina ka nga thei nadingin ka mungtup lam ka manaw vevaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin a picingsa eite in tam bang lungsim nei ciet vai;
