thu khatpo ziehin lungsim dang na nei uleh Pasien in tua thu zong ang teltheisah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"I ngasa uh thu beh tukip ciet bo vai."},"17":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, keima ei ette unlen, kote tung pana na nga uh gamtat zie tawh kituohin a nungta mite ciemte un.","ref":"1Cor 4:16; 11:1"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Khris singlamte’ galte bangin mi tampi a nungta uhi; amau’ thu tamveipi kang gen ngai ta a, tu-in zong hlitui nangawn tawh kang genkia lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Amau’ lam tawpna pen kisietna ahi hi; a pasien uh zong gilpi ahi hi; maizum nadingte-ah a kisiel zawsop vua, leitung nate beh ngaisutin a nei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Gammi i hina uh pen vantung ahi zaw a, tua panin Topa Jesu Khris Gumpa khat ang pei ding lawptahin i ngah uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in sil bangkim ama’ khut nei-a a koisah vanglietna tawh a gina lo i pumpi pen a minthang ama’ pumpi tawh a kibang dingin ei khelpieh ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka sanggamte, kang it kang hlenla ka kipahna, le ka kumpi lukhute ahi ka itte aw, Topa sungah na dingkip un."},"2":{"text":"Topa sungah Euodia le Syntyche-te a kilungtuo nadingun ka thum hi.","title":"Kihanthotnate"},"3":{"text":"Hi hi, a muonhuoi ka guolpa aw, tami numeite gel na panpi nadingin zong kang thum hi, bangzieh ahei cile Clement le hinna laibu sunga a min kikhumsa adang ka naseppite tawh lungdamna thu tangko nasepna ah ka panga a ding nasep hanciem mamate ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Topa sungah lungdam tawntung un; khatvei kang cikia-in, Lungdam un."},"5":{"text":"Mi zosie kungah na lungnemna uh theisah un. Topa ang nai ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangma thu-ah lunghimaw seng sih unlen, sil bangkimah thungetna le thumna tawh nuomthu tut kawmin na ngette uh Pasien theisah un."},"7":{"text":"Tua hile mihing’ theina in a bat zawh lo Pasien’ lungnopna in Khris Jesu sungah na lungtang ule na lungsimte uh ang kemcing ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A tawpna-ah kang itte aw, a man poma, a patawihuoi poma, thutang poma, a siengtho poma, a deihuoi poma, a phathuoi poma, a hoipen le a phattah pen khat poma a op leh tami thute ngaisutin na nei bo un."},"9":{"text":"Keima sunga na sinsa uh, na ngasa ule na zahsa uh thute bawl den pai un, tua hile kilemna Pasien in note ang ompi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in a tawpna-ah nei deisahna uh nang thasuosah ziehun Topa sungah nahpitahin ka lung a dam hi; kei adingin nei deisah tahpi vua, ahi vangin nei lah nading uh hunlem na nei sih uhi.","title":"Philippi-te’ Letsong Lungdamkona"},"11":{"text":"Ka tasap zieha guitam ka hi vawt sih hi; bangzieh ahei cile kei pen ka nei popo tawh a lungkim dinga a kisinsa ka hi lel hi."},"12":{"text":"Tasap kici bang hi a, kiningcing kici bang ahei ci ka thei hi. Bang khatpo le opdan cintengah gilkielna le gilvana, hauna le zawnna’ thusimte zong ka sin zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima ei thahatsah pa ahi ama tungtawnin sil bangkim ka bawl thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Thu khatpopo ah ka hamsatna nei thuohpi ziehun ka lung a dam hi."},"15":{"text":"No Philippi-te in lungdamna thu ang kipat cil, Macedonia gam nuasie-a ka zin lai-in piehna le ngana lamah nomate longal ei panpi hlattuom pawlpi khat beh a op lo lam na thei uh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Thessalonica khuo-a ka op sung nangawnin zong ka sapna-a zah dingin panpina khatvei sanga a tamzaw nei hlah uhi.","ref":"Sawl 17:1; 2Cor 11:9"},"17":{"text":"Letsong sui ka hi sih a, note’ sumkholna sazien sungah a met a na kikhol nading a sui ka hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka nga ding za a kimin ka nga zo ta a, a kicing ding za sangin zong a tamzaw ka nei ta hi; Epaphroditus tung pana nei hlah uh letsong zong tu-in ka na nga a, ka kicing mama ta mai hi, tuate pen ahile Pasien a lungkimsah a santah biehpiehna le a namtui silpiehte ahi hi.","ref":"Pei 29:18"},"19":{"text":"Khris Jesu sungah a minthang ama’ hauna tawh kizui-in ka Pasien in na kisapna zosie uh a kimin ang sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"I Pasien le i Pa tungah a tawntungin minthanna omden taheh. Amen."},"21":{"text":"Khris Jesu sunga om misiengtho zosie ei na noset pieh un. Keima tawh a omton lawmte in zong ang noset uhi.","title":"Tawpna Hopinate le Thupha Piehna"},"22":{"text":"Misiengthote zosie, a diehdiehin kumpi innkuonte in ang noset uhi."},"23":{"text":"Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina in na hlagau uh hing ompi taheh."}}}}},"51":{"info":{"name":"Colosse-te","shortname":"Col","abbr":[],"desc":"Colosse-te tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to the colossians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ deina bangin Khris Jesu sawltahpi Paul le i sanggampa Timothy in,"},"2":{"text":"Colosse khuopi-a om Khris sunga misiengthote le a citah sanggamte tungah: Note tungah i Pasien tung panin hepina le lungmuonna hing om taheh."},"3":{"text":"Khris Jesu sunga na upna ule misiengthote zosie na itna uh ahi a, note dinga vantunga ang kikholpieh lametna thute ahi zongin za zo ka hi ziehun note adingin i Topa Jesu Khris’ Pa Pasien tungah lungdamna kang kopieh zing uhi.","title":"Colosse-te adingin Paul in Pasien tungah Nuomthu Tut","merge":"4"},"6":{"text":"Na tung vua ang tung tua lungdamna thu in leitung buppi-ah a ga suongin a khan ma bangin, note in zong thuman thutah sungah Pasien’ hepina thu za-in na thei tahtah ni vua kipanin note lahah ga a ga zo ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tam thu pen note in ka it ka naseppi uh Epaphras kung pana na zahsa uh ahi hi. Ama pen note tanga Khris’ nasem muonhuoi khat ahi hi.","ref":"Col 4:12; Phm 23"},"8":{"text":"Hlagau sungah itna na neinate uzong ama in ei theisah zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin na thu uh ka zah ni vua kipanin, hlagau lam pilna le theitelna zosie nei-in Pasien’ deina theitheina tawh na kidim nadingun thu kang ngetpieh zing uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n note in Topa’ deina bang ahi hinkhuote mang thei-in ama na lungkimsah bukim ding vua, sil hoi namkimah zong ga suongin Pasien’ thutheina-ah na khang semsem ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Kipahtahin lungduoina tawh sil bangkim thuoh dingin kithawi a, khuovah sungah misiengthote tawh note gou ang luotonsah thei Pa tungah lungdamna na ko thei nadingun, a minthang ama’ vanglietna in thahatna zosie tawh hing thakhausah ta uheh.","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Ama in khuomiel thuneina gam panin eite ei hunkhie-in, a it a Tapa gam sungah ei koi a,"},"14":{"text":"eite in ama sungah tatkhietna le maw kimaisahnate i nei uhi .","ref":"Eph 1:7"},"15":{"text":"Ama pen mu thei lo Pasien’ lim hi a, a kipiengsah zosiete lahah a pieng masa pen ahi hi;","title":"Tungnung pen Khris’"},"16":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile ama sungah vantung le leitunga om nate, a kimuthei le a kimuthei lo nate, kumpi tophate, ahi sihle uhnate, ahi sihle gam-uhte, ahi sihle vanglietnate kisiem hi, ama ading le ama tungtawnin sil bangkim kisiem zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Sil bangkim a op masang in Ama a om zo ta bo a, ama sungah sil bangkim a kizom dimdiem hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama pen hlattuom pawlpi ahi pumpi’ lutang ahi hi; sil bangkimah a tungnung pen ahi thei nadingin ama a kipatna le misite lah panin a kithokiasah tacil ahi hi.","ref":"Eph 1:22-23"},"19":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile ama sungah Pasien’ bukimna zosie a ten ding pen Pa lungkimna hi a,"},"20":{"text":"ama tungtawnin ama tawh lei le vana sil bangkim kilemsahin, a singlamte sisan tungtawnin kilemna ei bawlpieh hi.","ref":"Eph 2:16"},"21":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in lungsim gilo-in na gamtat siet ziehun Pasien tawh na kigamla vua,"},"22":{"text":"tu-in ahile ama mai-ah a siengtho, nuol om lo le muhkawna om loin sina tungtawnin ama’ tahsa pumpi sungah ang lemtuo zo ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua khu na zahsa uh lungdamna thu in note ang kamciem lametna panin kihei loin, na upna uh na zop suoh uleh cina hi a, vansin nei-a a om a kipiengsah zosiete tungah a kitangko hi. Keima Paul zong tam lungdamna thu’ nasem khat ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in keima in note dinga ka thuoh gimnate-ah ka lung a dam a, ka tahsa-a ka thuoh gimnate tawh hlattuom pawlpi ahi ama’ pumpi tangin Khris in a thuoh ding a kisam lai teng thuohin a bukimsah ka hi hi.","title":"Colosse-te ading Paul’ Lunglutna"},"25":{"text":"Pasien’ thu a kicing tahin a kithei nadingin note adingin keima tunga ei kipie Pasien’ sawlna dung zui-in a nasem pa khat ka hi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua thuthuh pen a khangkhangin na kiselcip nanle tu hunin ama’ misiengthote tungah ang kipholah ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Pasien in tami a minthang thuthuh haunate bangza-in lien ahei, ci Gentile-te le amate tungah a theisah dingin keima ei teel a, note sunga om Khris pen tua thuthuh a minthang lametna ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Khris sungah mi zosie a picingsa-a ka pieh thei nadingun pilna namkim tawh mi vannuoi tungah genkholin, thu hilin ka tangko pen uh ama ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami thu adingin Khris in keima sunga ei guot ahi ka thahatna teng zosie tawh na semin ka hanciem hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note le Laodicia khuomite a kipanin ka maitang ei mu ngai nai lo mi zosie adingin keima in bangza-in hanciemin sem ka hei, ci na thei ding uh ka dei hi."},"2":{"text":"A lungsim sung vuah amate kihanthawnin itna sungah kipumkhat a, tuaci’n amate in hauna kicing theitelna bukim le, Khris mama ahi Pasien’ thu thuhpi theina a nei ding uh ka dei a,"},"3":{"text":"ama sungah pilna le theina gougil zosie kiphuolin a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Thu hoi lim a sut mawh vangin thuman lote tawh koima in note ang sol zo lo nadinga tami thu kang gen ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ka pumpi tawh kang oppi sih vangin Hlagau sungah kang oppi veve a, na lungsim puoh dante ule Khris sungah a kip na upna uh ka mu ciengin ka kipah mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note in Khris Jesu Topa na sansa uh ahi ma bangin na hinkhuote uh ama sungah nungta suoh a,","title":"Khris Sunga Om Hinna Bukim"},"7":{"text":"ang kihilsa bang tehtehin ama sungah zunghla-in, kilamin upna-ah na bulkip unlen, a kicing lungdamkona na nei un."},"8":{"text":"Khris’ deina dan tawh a kituoh lo, mihingte’ tang ngainate le leitung a uh hlagaute’ dei dan tawh a kituoh thuthuh ngaisutnate le a hawmpi ahi kisolnate tungtawnin koima in note sala ang mat lo nadingin kikem un."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama’ pumpi-ah Pasien’ pienzie bukim om a,"},"10":{"text":"note in a uhte le aana neite zosie’ lutang ahi ama sungah hinna bukim na nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Note zong Khris’ teptanna sungah cilesa pumpi suokhie-in khut tawh a kitan ahi lo, hlagau teptanna tawh ama sungah tep kitansa na hi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Baptize-na sungah Khris tawh na kivuiton ciengun sina panin ama a thosah Pasien’ vanglietna sungah upna tungtawnin note zong ama tawh ang thotonsah kia ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Na khielnate ule na cilesa teptannate sung vuah na si lai-un Pasien in ama tawh a hington dingin note ang bawl a, na khielna zosie uh ang ngaidam lai-in,","ref":"Eph 2:1-5"},"14":{"text":"ama in eite langah thukham’ ei kalh ciemtena laite phietmangin hemkhie dawh a, singlamte tungah a kildet ta hi.","ref":"Eph 2:15"},"15":{"text":"Ama in a uhte le thuneite gal lelsah a, singlamte hang tawh tuate tungah a guolzo a, mipi’ ette dingin tuate a bawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin anneh tuidawn ahi a, biehna pawite, hladet pawite, le sabbath tanna thute-ah ahi zongin, na tung vuah koima in thu na khensah sih un.","ref":"Rom 14:1-6"},"17":{"text":"Tamte pen ang tung ding nate’ hlim beh ahi a, a tahtah pen Khris hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in mangmuna a mu ziehun a thupi deu-in a kingaisun vua, tuaci’n a dih lo kiniemkhiehna le vantung mite bieh ding a paugen mite khatpo in na thaman uh na tan nadingun kibawlsah sih un. Tua bang mite pen a hang om lopi-in mihing’ ngaisutna tawh a kimot phatsah uh ahi a,"},"19":{"text":"tua a lutang pen a tudet sih uhi, tua panin pumpi na zosie in thahatna nga-in, gu le tangte le thahuite tawh kizom dimdiem a, Pasien kung pana khanna tawh a khangto hi.","ref":"Eph 4:16"},"20":{"text":"Khris tawh leitung thungehte a sisa na hi tah uleh, bang dingin leitung tawh kipawl bangin nungta lai na hi uh ahei? Bang dingin note in tam bang ngainate ahi,","title":"Zuouthei Siete Tunga Hilkholna"},"21":{"text":"tham sin, ciem sin, khoi kha sin, ci thute mang na hi uh ahei?"},"22":{"text":"Tam ngaina zosie pen eite tawh a kisietha ding nate a genna hi a, tuate pen mihingte’ thupieh le thuhilnate hi lel hi."},"23":{"text":"Tamte pen bawltawm biehna, kiniemkhiehna, le tahsa genthei bawlnate a khangsah pilna tawh a kibah vangin nop banga gamtatna kham nadingin kimanna a nei sih uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaci’n Khris tawh a thoto zo na hi tah uleh, note in Pasien’ zietlam kumpi topha tunga a to Khris opna mun ahi tunglam nate sui-in nei un.","title":"Khris Sungah Hinna Tha","ref":"Late 110:1"},"2":{"text":"Leitunga om nate tungah na lungsim uh nga sih unlen, tunglam a om nate tungah nga un,"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen note na si zo ta vua, na hinna uh Khris tawh Pasien sungah kiphuoltonin a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Note’ hinna ahi Khris ang kilah ciengin note zong ama’ minthanna sungah ama tawh na kilahton ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na tahsa sung vua om numei-pasal pahtatna, siengtho lona, huana lanna, gitlo deigawna, le milim biehna ahi huoihamna-a kipan leitung sil poma na thatlia un."},"6":{"text":"Tam teng ziehin mi thunung lote tungah Pasien’ lungthahna a tung ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in note zong tam bang gamtatnate tawh a nungta ngaite na hi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hizongle tu-in na kam sung panun tua bang nate ahi, lungthahna, thangpaina, mudana, mindaisahna, le kam gilo poma na paimang un."},"9":{"text":"Hindan lui le gamtatna luite a suokhiesa na hi lam uh kithei-in khatlekhat kisol sih un.","ref":"Eph 4:22"},"10":{"text":"Note pen ang piengsah pa’ lim le mel tawh kisunin theitelna lamah a kibawltha ahi mitha silte na hi ta uhi.","ref":"Eph 4:24; Pien 1:26"},"11":{"text":"Tua thasuona sungah Gentile-te le Jew mite, teptan le teptan lote, nam tuolte, Scythia-te, silate le sila lote ci bang a om nawn sih hi; hizongle Khris pen bangkim ahi a, bangkimah ama a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Note pen Pasien’ teelsa a siengtho le a ithuoite na hi ma bangun lainatna, migitna, kiniemkhiehna, lungnemna le lungduoina-te na sil un."},"13":{"text":"Mi khatpo in adang khat tungah mawsah nading a nei leh khatlekhat kithuoh zo-in na kimaisah un. Topa in note’ mawna ang maisah bangin note zong khatlekhat maw na kimaisah un.","ref":"Eph 4:2"},"14":{"text":"Tamte zosie tungah note in sil bangkim kihuol taha a khiton itna na sil un."},"15":{"text":"Pumkhat ahi dinga note ang hlan Khris’ kilemna in na lungtang na uhsah unlen, kipah tahin na om un."},"16":{"text":"Note sungah Khris’ thu kicingtahin tengsah un; pilna bukim tawh khatlekhat thu kihilin na kisam un; na lungtang vuah lungdamna tawh Pasien tungah phatna late, biehna late, le hlagau late na sa un."},"17":{"text":"Na hamna vuah ahi a, na gamtatna vuah ahi zongin Topa Jesu’ minin sil bangkim na bawl unlen, ama tungtawnin Pa Pasien tungah lungdam na ko un.","ref":"Eph 5:19-20"},"18":{"text":"Zite aw, Topa sunga na bawl ding uh a kilawm ahi ma bangin na pasalte’ thu na mang un.","title":"Tapidaw Innkuonte’ Zui ding Thute","ref":"Eph 5:22; 1Pet 3:1"},"19":{"text":"Pasalte aw, na zite it unlen amate tungah sitsie lungham vapual ngai sih un.","ref":"Eph 5:25; 1Pet 3:7"},"20":{"text":"Tate aw, sil bangkimah na nu na pate thu na mang un, azieh pen tam pen Topa sungah a bawltah na nasep uh ahi hi.","ref":"Eph 6:1"},"21":{"text":"Pate aw, na tate uh thangpaisah sih un, tua hi sihle amate ang lungkie kha ding uhi.","ref":"Eph 6:4"},"22":{"text":"Silate aw, sil bangkimah leitung na pute uh’ thu na mang un, ang kimu sung beh ule amate lungkim thei nadinga thumang hi loin, Topa na zatahna ziehun na lungsimtahpi utawh thu mang na hizaw un."},"23":{"text":"Na sepna khat popo vuah na pute uh’ nasem bangin na kingaisun sih unlen, Topa adinga nasem bangin na kingaisun un."},"24":{"text":"Topa tung panin thaman dingin gouluo na nga ding uhi, ci na thei uhi; note pen Topa Khris’ nasemte na hi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen deisahtuom om loin, a bawlkhiel na khatpo ziehin tua khielna bawlpa tungah kithuhkia ding hi.","ref":"Eph 6:5-8; Thkna 10:17; Eph 6:9"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pute aw, na silate uh dihtah le kilawmtahin na bawl un, azieh pen note in zong vantungah pu khat na nei lam na thei uhi.","ref":"Eph 6:9"},"2":{"text":"Kikemcing kawmin lungdamkona tawh thunget na pawnthaw un.","title":"Thuhilbena"},"3":{"text":"Khris’ thuthuh zieha thongkie ka hi a, Pasien in kot ei honpiehin tua thu ka phuongzah thei nading le,"},"4":{"text":"keima in ka hil ding bangin a kicien taha ka hil thei nadingin tu mama-in kote adingin zong thu ei na ngetpieh un."},"5":{"text":"Pulam mite tungah na gamtat zie uh pilvang unlen, hun hoi na nga zosie uh na zah siem un.","ref":"Eph 5:16"},"6":{"text":"Mikim tungah bangci dawn dinga kilawm ahei, ci na thei nadingun na kamham uh nemsah zingin ci bangin na alsah un."},"7":{"text":"Tychicus in kei vai thutha zosie note kungah ang gen ding hi; ama pen Topa sunga ka it sanggampa, nasem muonhuoi, le ka naseppi ahi hi.","title":"A Tawpna Hopinate le Thupha Piehna","ref":"Sawl 20:4; 2Tim 4:12"},"8":{"text":"Kote pen bangci bang ka hi uh ahei ci nei thei nading ule na lungnop thei nading uh ngimna tawh na kung vua ama kang sawl ahi hi;","ref":"Eph 6:21-22"},"9":{"text":"note lahah khat ahi a muonhuoi, i it sanggampa Onesimus zong ama tawh ang zawh hi. Ama gel in tam sunga thupieng zosie na kung vuah ang gen ding uhi.","ref":"Phm 10–12"},"10":{"text":"Barnabas’ tupa Mark in ang noset bangin ka thongkiehpi Aristarchus in zong ang noset uhi, a thu kang gen na zahsa uh ahi hi, ama ang pei leh na na dawn un.","ref":"Sawl 19:29; 27:2; Phm 24; Sawl 12:12, 25; 13:13; 15:37-39"},"11":{"text":"Justus a kici Jesu in zong ang noset uhi. Pasien’ manggam adinga ka naseppite lahah tam teng pen tep kitan a omsun teng hi a, kei adingin amate pen ka hlamuonna ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Note lahah Khris Jesu’ nasem khat ahi Epaphras in ang noset uhi. Ama pen note picingin na dinkip nading ule Pasien’ deina zosie a bukima na telcien thei nadingun note tangin nahpitaha thu ang ngetpieh zing pa ahi hi.","ref":"Col 1:7; Phm 23"},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen ama in note ading le Laodicea khuo le Hierapolis khuo-a om mite adingin na a hasepna thu keima a teci ka hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Eite in i it mama uh sievuonpa Luke le Demas in zong ang noset uhi.","ref":"2Tim 4:10-11; Phm 24"},"15":{"text":"Laodicea-a sanggamte, Nympha le ama’ inn a kikhawm hlattuom pawlpi mite ei na noset pieh un."},"16":{"text":"Na lah vuah tu-a kang laihlah na sim zaw ciengun Laodicea khuo-a om hlattuom pawlpi mite tungah na simsah un; Laodicea pana ki-at lai zong na simthuo pai un."},"17":{"text":"Tuale Archippus kungah, “ Topa sunga na nga nasep zo sieng in,” ci-in na gen un.","ref":"Phm 2"},"18":{"text":"Tami hopina lai pen keima Paul in ka khut mama tawh ka giel ahi hi. Ei kikolbulna thu na phawh zing un. Note tawh hepina hing om taheh."}}}}},"52":{"info":{"name":"1 Thessalonica","shortname":"1thes","abbr":[],"desc":"Thessalonica masa thessalonica tapidawte tunga paul’ laihlah masa (paul’s first letter to the thessalonians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silvanus, le Timothy-te in, Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris sunga a om Thessalonica khuo hlattuom pawlpite tungah: Note tungah hepina le lungmuonna thupha ang om taheh.","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"2":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris sungah upna tawh na nasepnate uh, itna tawh na hanciemnate ule lam-etna kip na neinate uh, i Pa Pasien mai-ah hing phawh denin, kote in ka thungetna sung vuah na min uh loin, note zosie adingin lungdamna ka ko zing uhi.","title":"Thessalonica-te’ Upna le Hinkhuo","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in a it sanggamte aw, ama in note ang tel zo lam ka thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Note lahah ka op laitahun note adingin bangci bang mi ka hi uh ahei, ci kang lah uh na thei ma bangun, ka gen uh lungdamna thu zong note tungah kam beh tawh hi loin, vanglietna sung le Hlagau siengtho sungah a bukim kithei cienna tawh ang tung ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Note in bawlsietna na thuoh vangun Hlagau Siengtho ziehin kipahna tawh Pasien’ thu na sang vua, kote le Topa’ ette mite na suoh uhi.","ref":"Sawl 17:5-9"},"7":{"text":"Tuaci’n note pen Macedonia gam le Achaia gam sunga thu um mite zosie tungah limpha na suoh uhi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note kung panin Macedonia gam sung le Achaia gam sung teng ah Topa’ kammal a kiza hi beh loin, muncin tengah na Pasien upna uh kithei sieng zo ahi ziehin kang gen ding uh a kisam nawn sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen tua gam sung tenga a om mite in note lahah ko bang ei kici zindo ci thu le, a hing zing le a man Pasien’ na a sem dingin milimte panin Pasien lamah note bangci kihei ci thute le,"},"10":{"text":"ang tung ding thangpaina panin ei suohtasah ding pa Jesu, sina pana a thawsahkia, a Tapa vantung pana ang pei ding ngah a na op lam uh ang gen hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na kung vua kang hawna thu a mawhna suoh lo ding hi, ci pen no mama in na thei uhi.","title":"Thessalonica Khuo-a Paul Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Hizongle na theisa ma bangun Philippi khuo ah gimna thuohin zumhuoi tahin ei kibawlsie a, langpanna nasie tahin a op vangin, na kung vuah Pasien’ lungdamna thu a gen dingin i Pasien sungah hansanna ka nei uhi.","ref":"Sawl 16:19-24; 17:1-9"},"3":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile kote in kang ngetna uh pen zuouthu le ngimna sieng lo pan hi loin, sol bawla zawl ang sawm zong ka hi sih vua,"},"4":{"text":"lungdamna thu a gen dinga Pasien in ei thukimpisa ka hi ma bangun, thu gen nan uleng zong mite lungkim nading hi loin, ka lungtang uh ei sittel Pasien lungdam nadinga a gen ka hizaw uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na thei ma bangun phatna kamteng tawh hitale kote’ phattuom nading ngaisutna tawh hitale kang pei ngai lo lam uh Pasien ka teci uh ahi hi;"},"6":{"text":"Khris’ sawltahpite bangin thu khatpopo kang kalh thei vangun note tung pan ahi a, midangte tung pan ahi zongin phatna ka sui sih uhi. Tuale mahin nupi naukem khat in a tate nunnemtahin a zen a khoi bangin note lahah ka nunnem uhi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Tuaci’n note kang nah it seng ziehun Pasien’ lungdamna thu beh hi loin, ka hinna mama uzong hop dingin ka khensat va-ia uhi, bangzieh ahei cile ko tungah na it huoi mama uhi."},"9":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na tung vuah Pasien’ lungdamna thu kang hil lai-un, koima’ vangih ka suo lo nadingun sun le zanin gimpipi-a na ka sep lam na thei uhi."},"10":{"text":"No thu um mite tungah ka gamtatna uh bangza-in siengtho-in dih a, mawsah nading om lo hi, ci thu Pasien zong teci ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pa in a tate a bawl bangin note khat ciet kang bawlna na thei ma bangun,"},"12":{"text":"ama’ gam le a minthanna sungah ang hlanpa Pasien’ deina tawh kituoha na nuntah thei nadingun kang kunkun vua, hanthawnin zong kang thum uhi."},"13":{"text":"Note in ko kung pana na zah uh Pasien’ thu na san lai-un, mihingte thugen bang hi loin, no thu um mite sungah zong na a sem Pasien’ thu bang lienin note in pom na hi ziehun kote in zong Pasien tungah nuomthu ka tut zing uhi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sanggamte aw, note na hi ule Judea gam sunga om, Khris Jesu sunga Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpite’ ette na suoh uhi, azieh pen amate in Jew mite’ bawlsietna a thuoh ma bangun note in zong na mipite’ bawlsietna na thuoh uhi.","ref":"Sawl 17:5"},"15":{"text":"Tuale amate in Topa Jesu le kamsangte thatin ko zong ei delmang uhi; amate in Pasien lungkimsah loin mi zosie a langbawl vua,","ref":"Sawl 9:23, 29; 13:45, 50; 14:2, 5, 19; 17:5, 13; 18:12"},"16":{"text":"Gentile-te hutdam nadinga amate kunga ka thu hil ding uh zong ei kham uhi. Tua bangin amate in a mawnate uh a dim zing uhi; ahi vangin a tawpna ah Pasien’ thangpaina in amate a nuaphah veve hi."},"17":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, kote ka hi ule note tawh, lungtang tawh hi loin tahsa pumpi tawh, bakhat sung i kikhen sungin taga banga nei opsah ciengun kimaituo-a i kimu ding nahpi tahin ka lunggul mama uhi.","title":"Thessalonica-te Kunga Paul a Hawkia Nopna"},"18":{"text":"Na kung vuah hing haw nuom ka hi ziehun, keima Paul in ka sawm zelzel a, hizongle Satan in ka lampi uh ei khahtan hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile i Topa Jesu Khris ang pei ciengin ama mai-ah ka lametna uh, ka kipahna ule ka kisielpi ding uh lukhu bang hi mawh ahei? Note hi lo na hi uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"Hi hi, note pen ka minthanna ule ka kipahna na hi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka thuoh zawh nawn vawt lo ciengun, Athen khuo-a om suoh dingin ka khensat ta uhi;","ref":"Sawl 17:15"},"2":{"text":"tuale na upna uh ang thakhausah ding le ang hanthawn dingin Khris lungdamna thu tangkona ah Pasien’ na ka seppi uh i sanggam pa Timothy kang sawl vua,"},"3":{"text":"tua pen bawlsietnate ziehin koima na linglawn lo nading uh deina ahi hi. Kote ka hi ule tam bang bawlsietna a thuoh dinga laitansa ka hi lam uh na theisa uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A tahtahin, note tawh i opton lai-in bawlsietna ka thuoh ding uh kang magensa uh ahi ta bo hi; na thei ma bangun tua bangin ang pieng mintah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tami thu hang tawh ka thuoh zawh nawn lo ciengin na upna uh a kan dinga ama kang sawl ahi hi; mi ze-et pa in lam khatpo tawh note hing ze-et in ka sep gimnate uh a mawhna a suo khah ding ka lunghimaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin tu-in no kung panin ko kungah Timothy ang tung pan lien ahi a, ama in ko tungah na upna ule nei itna uh lungdamna thu thate ei puoh hi. Note kang munop ma bangun note in limtahin kote ei phawhin nei munopna thu zong ama in ei gen zo ta hi.","title":"Thalawphuoi Timothy’ Thupuoh","ref":"Sawl 18:5"},"7":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tami thu ziehin lunggimna le bawlsietna ka thuoh hun sungun note’ upna tungtawnin ka na kihenem uhi."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Topa sungah na dinkip suoh nah po uleh tu-in a hing ka hi ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien mai-ah note ziehin ka lungdamna zosie uh thuhkia nadingin Pasien kungah bangci bangin a kicing lungdamna ko theikia ding ka hi uh ahei?"},"10":{"text":"Note tawh kimaituo-in upna lamah na kisap popo uh na ngakia thei nadingun sun le zanin nahpi tahin thu ka ngen uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in eite’ Pa mama le i Pasien le i Topa Jesu in na kung vua kang haw thei nading uh ma ei pui taheh."},"12":{"text":"Note kang it bangun note khatlekhat na ki-itna ule mi zosie na itna uh Topa in hing khangsah taheh."},"13":{"text":"Ama’ misiengtho zosiete tawh i Topa Jesu ang pei ciengin, ama in i Pasien le i Pa uh mai-ah paubanna na nei lo nadingun siengthona sungah na lungtangte uh hing thakhausah taheh."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nukhia penin sanggamte aw, Pasien lungkim nadingin bangci nuntah lei kilawm ding ahei, ci thute ko tung pana na sinsa uh ahi ma bangin (a gamta tahtah na hi ma bangun) na sep semsem nadingun i Topa Jesu minin thumin kang hanthawn uhi.","title":"Pasien a Lungkimsah Hinkhuo"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in Topa Jesu tungtawna kang pieh uh thuhilnate na thei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na siengtho nading uh Pasien’ deina ahi ziehin numei-pasal pahtatna na pel un:"},"4":{"text":"Note khat ciet in siengthona le zatahna tawh noma’ pumpi ciet bangci uh ding ci thei unlen,"},"5":{"text":"Pasien a thei lo Gentile-te bangin cilesa lunggulnate-ah na uong seng sih un."},"6":{"text":"Tam thute-ah koima a sanggamte tungah khiel sih hinlen a met zong sui sih heh, azieh pen kang magensa ule khau taha kang hilsa uh ma bangin tam thute zosie tungah a thuhkia pa pen Topa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in a thangtat dinga ei hlat ahi sih a, a siengtho dinga ei hlat ahi zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tam thu a niel mi poma pen mihing thuneina a niel hi loin, note tungah ama’ Hlagau Siengtho ang pie pa Pasien a niel ahi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin sanggam ki-itna tawh kisai-in mi khatpo in note tungah lai tawh ang giel ding na kisam nawn sih uhi, azieh pen khatlekhat na ki-it nadingun Pasien in note mama ang hil zo ta hi;"},"10":{"text":"tuaci’n note in Macedonia gam kuoma om sanggamte zosie zong na it tahpi uhi. Ahi vangin ka itte aw, tua banga na it semsem ding uh kang hanthawn uhi."},"11":{"text":"Kang hilsa ma bangun daitaha hinkhuo na man thei nadingun noma vai behah buoi unlen, na khut utawh hanciemin na sem un,"},"12":{"text":"tua hile a pulam mite mai-ah kilawmtahin na gamta thei ding vua, koima tungah na kingam ta sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hizongle sanggamte aw, lametna a nei lo midangte banga na da luot lo nadingun a sisa mite thu thei lo-a na op ding uh ka dei sih uhi.","title":"Ang Pei Nading"},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite in Jesu si-in thokia zo hi, ci-in i up ma bangin, Jesu tungtawnin Pasien in a sisa mite nangawn zong Jesu tawh ang zawpi ding hi, ci-in i um uhi."},"15":{"text":"Azieh pen kote in na kung vuah Topa’ kammal kang tangko uh thu in, Topa ang pei cieng dong a nungta a omlai eite in a sisa mite i makhel vawt sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile tua Topa mama, thupiehna awging tawh, vantungmi mangpa kikona le Pasien’ pengkul aw tawh ang kum suh ding a, Khris sungah a sisa mite ang tho masa ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin a nungta a omlai eite i hi ule Topa tawh hui lahah a kimu dingin amate tawh meii tungah ei kilato ding a, tuaci’n Topa tawh i omton den ta ding uhi.","ref":"1Cor 15:51-52"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note khatlekhat tami thute tawh na kihenem un."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tu-in a ni le a hun tawh kisai-in bang khatpo gielpieh na ngai sih uhi."},"2":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile zanlai-a guta bangin Topa’ ni ang tun ding noma ma in na theitelsa uh ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 24:43; Luk 12:39; 2Pet 3:10"},"3":{"text":"Amate in, “Kilemna le lungmuonna om hi,” a ci laitahun numei gai khat takei natna in a tut bangin amate tungah thakhatin sietna tung ding a, a suohta koima a om sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin no kang itte aw, khuomiel sunga om na hi lo ziehun tua ni in guta bangin ang phawng sih ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"azieh pen note zosie khuovah tate le sunlai tate na hi uhi; eite pen zanlai tate ahi sihle khuomiel tate i hi sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin midangte bangin kimu loin, khangloin pilvangin om vai."},"7":{"text":"Azieh pen a kimu mite zanin kimu a, zukham mite in zanlai-in zu a kham uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hizongle sunlai tate i hi lang kalsie uh pilvangin upna le itna awmdal bulin, sialukhu bangin i lamet uh hutdamna khu vai.","ref":"Isa 59:17; Eph 6:13-17"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite pen Pasien in a thangpaina thuoh dinga ei laitan ahi sih a, i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin hutdamna nga dinga ei laitansa i hizaw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Eite i khanglo a, i kimu zongin ama tawh i hinton thei nadingin eite adinga ama ang si ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tu-a na bawl bang lienun note khatlekhat kihanthawnin na kilamkip ciet un."},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin sanggamte aw, noma lahah nasep a pawnthaw mite, Topa sungah ang cingte le ang thuhil mite na zatah nadingun kang thum uhi;","title":"A Tawpna Hanthotnate, Hopinate le Thuphapiehna"},"13":{"text":"a nasepna uh ziehin itna sungah amate nahpitahin na thupi bawl un. Nomate lahah zong kilemna na omsah un."},"14":{"text":"Kang itte aw, mi thasiete thu hil unlen, a lungneu mite tha pie-in, a thanem mite panpi a, amate zosie tungah na lungsau nadingun kang hanthawn hi."},"15":{"text":"Koima khat beh in sietna pen sietna ma tawh thuhkia loin, khatlekhat tung le mi zosie tungah na hoi sep ding hanciemin na nei zingzaw un."},"16":{"text":"Lungdam zing unlen,"},"17":{"text":"thu ngen zing un;"},"18":{"text":"a pieng na vannuoi-ah lungdamna ko un; azieh pen tua khu note adinga Khris Jesu sungah Pasien’ deina ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hlagau na sumit sih un."},"20":{"text":"Kamsangte’ gen thute simmawbawl sih unlen,"},"21":{"text":"sil bangkim sittel pha un; thu hoite na tukip un;"},"22":{"text":"sietna namkim pel un."},"23":{"text":"Lungmuonna Pasien mama in note hing siengthosah sinsen hinlen, i Topa Jesu Khris ang pei ciengin na hlagau uh, na lungsim ule na pumpi uh nuol bei-in hing kem taheh."},"24":{"text":"Note ang hlan pa Pasien muonhuoi a, ama in tua khu ang sem ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Kang itte aw, kote adingin thu ei ngetpieh un."},"26":{"text":"A siengtho kinapna tawh sanggamte zosie na noset un."},"27":{"text":"Amate zosie tungah tami kang laihlah na sim un, ci-in Topa’ min tawh lipkhap tahin thu kang pie uhi."},"28":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina note tawh hing om taheh."}}}}},"53":{"info":{"name":"2 Thessalonica","shortname":"2thes","abbr":[],"desc":"Thessalonica nina thessalonica tapidawte tunga paul’ laihlah nina (paul’s second letter to the thessalonians)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silvanus le Timothy-te in, i Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris sunga a om Thessalonica khuo hlattuom pawlpite tungah lai kang hlah uhi.","title":"Hopina","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"2":{"text":"I Pa Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung pan hepina le lungnopna in note tungah ang tung taheh."},"3":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na upna uh nahpi tahin khangin khatlekhat na ki-itna uh zong khang semsem ahi ziehin, note adingin Pasien tungah lungdam ka ko zing ding uh a kilawm ahi hi.","title":"Lungdamkona"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note in na thuoh uh bawlsietna le gimna zosie-ah thuohzawhna le upna nei na hi ziehun komate ma zong Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpite lahah ka na kisiel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tami thute in Pasien’ manggam tawh a kilawm dinga note ang kibawl sawmna ahi a dih Pasien’ thukhenna kilangsah a, note in zong tua thute zieha na thuoh uh ahi hi.","title":"Khris Ang pei Cienga Thukhenna"},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note ang gentheisah mite tungah Pasien in gentheina ma tawh thuhkia valon ding a,"},"7":{"text":"Topa Jesu in vantung panin a thahat a vantung mite tawh ang kilat ciengin gimna a thuoh note le kote tungah zong tawldamna ei piehton ding pen a thuman hi a,"},"8":{"text":"Pasien a thei lo mite le i Topa Jesu’ lungdamna thu a mang lo mite, meikuong sungah phulahna tawh a thuhkia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa opna pan le a thupi ama’ vanglietna panin tam mite kikhenkhie-in tawntung sietna dan a thuoh ding vua,","ref":"Isa 2"},"10":{"text":"a misiengthote ziehin minthanna nga dingin ang pei ciengin note kunga ka teci pan uh a ki-up ziehin tua ni ciengin ama a umsa mi zosiete lahah lamdang kisa ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam thu a tangtun nadingin i Pasien in ama’ hlatna tawh kituohin hing siemin, a vanglietna tawh na lunggulna hoi zosie ule upna nasep hoite ang kicinsah thei nadingin note adingin thu ka ngen zing uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n i Pasien le i Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina tawh kizui-in note sungah i Topa Jesu minthangin, ama sungah note na minthan thei nading uh thu ngen zing ka hi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris ang peikia ding vai le ama kungah eite i kikaituo nading vai tawh kisai-in,","title":"Thukham Palsat Mipa","ref":"1Thes 4:15-17"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ ni ang tung ta hi, ci-in hlagau zieh ahiei, thu kigensawn zieh ahiei, ahi sihle ko kung pana ang pei dan a kibawltawm laihahte ziehin ahiei, lunghimaw-in na patau pai lo nadingun na tung vuah kang thum hi."},"3":{"text":"Lam khat popo-ah koima in kisolsah sih un; azieh pen ledona ang tung masa-in, manthaina thuoh dinga laitansa ahi thukham palsat pa ang kilah masangsie-in tua ni ang tung sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in pasien a kici zosie le a kibie zosie langpangin ama le ama kitawisang ding a, tuaci’n Pasien’ biehinnpi sungah ama to-in Pasien ka hi hi, ci-in ama le ama kipulah ding hi.","ref":"Dan 11:36; Ezk 28:2"},"5":{"text":"Note tawh kang opton lai-in na kung vuah tam thute kang gen na phawh nawn sih uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"A hun ang tun ciengin ama ang kilah thei nadingin, bang in ama kham ahei, ci thu na thei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua thukham palsatna thuthuh in na sem zo a, ahi vangin tu-a ama a khamcip pa a kihep masangsie-in ama in khamcip lai ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin thukham palsat pa ang kilang ding a, Topa Jesu in a kam panin ama’ huu tawh ama susie ding a, ama ang peina zieha a kilahna tawh ama sumaimang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:4"},"9":{"text":"Vanglietna zosie, limte, le a lamdang solnate a zang Satan’ nasepna sungah thukham palsat pa ang pei ahi lamtah kilang a,","ref":"Mat 24:24"},"10":{"text":"a kisie ding mite in hutdam hi thei nadingin thuman thutah pom ding a nuol ziehun solna namkim a thuoh ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin amate in zuouthu a up nadingun Pasien in amate tungah solna lienpi tungsah a,"},"12":{"text":"tua thuman thutah um loin, thuman lona sungah nuom a sa mite zosie tungah mawsah thukhenna a tun thei nading ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa’ ang it sanggamte aw, Hlagau kisiensuona tungtawn le thuman thutah na upna uh tungtawnin hutdamna nga nadinga ga masa dingin Pasien in note ang teel ziehin, note adingin Pasien kungah lungdam ka ko zing ding uh ahi hi.","title":"Hutdam Nga dingin Kiteel"},"14":{"text":"Tami ngimna ziehin note in Topa Jesu Khris’ minthanna na nga thei nadingun ama in ka tangko uh lungdamna thu tha tungtawnin note ang hlan zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin sanggamte aw, note in kam tawh hile, lai tawh hile kang hilsa uh ngainate pomdetin kiptahin ding un."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in i Topa Jesu Khris mama le eite ei it a, kumtawn henepna le hepina tungtawnin lametna hoi ei pie pa i pa uh Pasien in,"},"17":{"text":"na lungsimte uh hing henem hinlen, thu hoi le nasep hoi namcin-ah hing thakhausah taheh."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, a nukhia penin note lahah a piengsa bang tehtehin mun zosie-ah Topa’ thu a mallangin kizelin a kithan thei nading le,","title":"Thungetpieh ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"mi hoilote le mi gilote kung panin ka suotah thei nadingun thu ei na ngetpieh un; bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie in upna a nei sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa a muonhuoi a, note hing thahat sahin gilopa kung panin ang kem ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Note in kang thupiehte uh na zui vua, Topa sungah a zui suoh lai dingin zong kang muong uhi."},"5":{"text":"Pasien’ itna le Khris’ thuohzawhna lamah na lungsim uh Topa in lam hing lah taheh."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in kang itte aw, kote tung panin amate in a sansa uh ngainate tawh kituoh loin nasep a thada thu umte na pelh nadingun i Topa Jesu Khris’ minin thu kang pie hi.","title":"Thasiet lo ding Hilkholna"},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kote nei ette ding vua kilawm ahi lam no mama in na theisa uh ahi hi; note tawh ka opton sungun ka thasie sih vua,"},"8":{"text":"a man pie loin koima’ an ka mawh neh sih uhi; mi khatpo’ vangih ka suo lo nadingun gimpipi-in sun le zanin na ka semzaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua bang neh theina ding thu a nei lo ka hi tuon sih vua, note’ ette ding limpha kang lah nop man uh ahi zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note tawh ka opton lai nangawnun zong nasem nuom lo mi poma in an ne sih heh, ci-in thu kang pie zo ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note lahah mi pawl khat thasie-in bangma sem loin mi nasepnate-ah kikumthaw-in a op lam uh ka za uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in tua bang mite in a anneh ding uh thalaw-in, a na uh a sep khinkhian nadingun kote in Topa Jesu Khris minin thu pie-in ka hanthawn uhi."},"13":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na hoi sep ding cimtah sih un."},"14":{"text":"Tami lai sunga ka thugente uh a mang nuom lote ciemte unlen, a maizum thei nadingun na kigop sih un."},"15":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate gal bangin ngaisun sih unlen, thu umte bangin thu hil un."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in kilemna Topa mama in na vai zosie vuah a tawntungin lungnopna hing pie taheh. Topa in note zosie hing ompi taheh.","title":"A Tawpna Hopinate le Thupha Piehna"},"17":{"text":"Keima Paul in ka khut mama tawh tami nosetna lai kang giel ahi hi. Ka laihah zosie tam banga ka ciemte ahi a, tami khu ka lai gieldan ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Note tawh i Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina hing om taheh."}}}}},"54":{"info":{"name":"1 Timothy","shortname":"1tim","abbr":[],"desc":"Timothy masa timothy tunga paul’ laihlah masa (paul’s first letter to timothy)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I hundampa Pasien le i lamet pa uh Khris Jesu thupiehna tawh Jesu Khris’ sawltahpi keima Paul in,"},"2":{"text":"upna sungah ka ta tahtah ahi Timothy tungah: Pa Pasien le i Topa Jesu Khris kung panin hepina, khuotuona le lungnopna om taheh.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"3":{"text":"Macedonia gam lam manaw-in ka pei lai-a kang gensa ma bangin Ephesus khuo-ah tam inlen, mi pawlkhat in thuhilna dang khatpo a hil lo nading ule,","title":"Thuhilna Man Lote"},"4":{"text":"upna tawh a kithei Pasien’ vaihawmna ahi lo, kinielna a piengsah thei phuotawm tangmite le mong nei lo khanggui ciemtena po-ah amate a kipumpieh lo nadingun thu na hil thei nadingin kang hanthawn hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin tam bang thuhilna’ a tupna pen lungsim siengtho, ei le ei kitheina hoi, le upna tahtah pana a pei itna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua itna panin mi pawlkhatte pielmangin a khietna nei lo holimna lamah a kihei vua,"},"7":{"text":"a thugente ule kiptaha a thugente uh telsiem lopi-in Pasien’ thukham hil sie po a suoh nuom na lai uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in mi khat in thukham pen ahi banga a zah nah leh hoi hi, ci i thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami a ci nopna in thukham pen midihte dinga kibawl ahi sih a, thukham palsatte le thu mang lote, Pasien mi ahi lote le mawneite, a siengtho lote le mi thanghuoite, a nu a pa thatte, tuolthatte,"},"10":{"text":"nu le pa mawna a bawlte, pasal le pasal mawna a bawlte, sila zua-a sum bawlte, zuouthu gente, zuouthu tawh a kiciemte a kipanin thuhilna a man tawh a kilebul mite dinga kibawl ahi hi, ci theisiemna ahi a,"},"11":{"text":"tua pen thupha tawh a kidim a minthang Pasien in keima ei kepsah lungdamna thu tawh a kituoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama’ nasem dingin keima ei se a, mi muonhuoi bangin ei ngaisun ahi ziehin i Topa Jesu Khris tungah ka lung a dam hi.","title":"Hepina Zieha Lungdamna"},"13":{"text":"Masang lai-in migensie pa, mi bawlsie pa, le mi ngongtat pa ka hi vangin, uplana zieh le theilana zieha a gamta ka hi ziehin khuotuona ka nga a,","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 9:4-5"},"14":{"text":"Khris Jesu sunga a om upna le itna tawh kei adingin i Topa’ hepina a dimlet hi."},"15":{"text":"Khris Jesu in mawneite hundam dingin leitungah ang pei hi, ci-a kigen pen a man hi a, a unpi-in san dingin kilawm hi, tua mawneite lahah kei a siehuoi pen ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua thu hang ma-in ama umin kumtawm hinna a nga ding mite’ ette thei dingin Jesu Khris in a gilo pen keima sungah ahi theina za tawh lungduoina ei lah thei nadingin khuotuona ka nga zo ta hi."},"17":{"text":"A si thei lo, a kimu thei lo, le ama beh Pasien ahi, kumtawn Kumpipa tungah patawina le minthanna om zing taheh. Amen."},"18":{"text":"Ka ta Timothy aw, keima in masang lai-a nang tawh kisai genkholna thute tawh kizui-in tami thuhilna kang pie hi. Tua thute zui-in gal dona pha na do thei nadingin,"},"19":{"text":"upna le kitheina lungsim hoi nei in. A sie le a pha theina lungsim a nuol ziehun mi pawlkhatte in tembaw kisie bangin a upna uh a kisiesah vua,"},"20":{"text":"amate lahah Pasien gensiet lo nading a sin dingin Satan tunga ka apsa Hymenaeus le Alexander-te kihal uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin amasa penin note in mi zosie ading ngetnate, thungetnate, thumpiehnate le lungdamkonate na bawl ding uh kang hanthawn hi.","title":"Thungetna Tawh Kisai Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"Eite in Pasien’ mi hina le zatah huoina ah lungmuong tah le kilem tahin i hinkhuo i man thei nadingun kumpite le thunei zosiete adingin thu ngetpieh un."},"3":{"text":"Tam pen thudih ahi a, eite’ hundam pa Pasien muna-ah a sanhuoi suohin,"},"4":{"text":"mi vannuoi in hutdamna nga-in, thuman thutah a theikim ding uh ama in a dei hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien khat beh a om hi; Pasien le mihingte kikalah zong palai khat beh om a, tua khu mihing ma ahi Khris Jesu ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in mi zosie tat nadingin ama le ama kipie a, tua teci panna thu pen a hun lienin kipie hi."},"7":{"text":"Tami adingin keima tangko pa le sawltahpi dingin ei kise zo a, (zuouthu gen loin thutah a gen ka hi hi), kei pen upna le thutah ah Gentile-te’ siepa ka hi hi.","ref":"2Tim 1:11"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin mun zosie-a om pasalte in lungthah kisel cite om loin khut siengthote lamto-in thu a nget ding uh ka dei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ma bangin numeite zong opdan siemin puonsil nihten a kituoh a kilawm tawh kizem uheh, samtumna, ahi sihle ngun le kham le puon manham pipite tawh kizepnate nei loin,","ref":"1Pet 3:3"},"10":{"text":"Pasien ka zatah hi, a ci numeite dinga a kilawm pen ahi nasep hoite tawh kizemzaw un."},"11":{"text":"Numei in thumanna bukim tawh sip dide-in thu sin ta uheh."},"12":{"text":"Numei in pasal tungah thuhilin uhna aana a nei ding ka phal sih hi; ama pen a sip dide ding ahi bo hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Adam kipiengsah masa a, tua zaw ciengin Eve kipiengsah hi.","ref":"Pien 2:7, 21-22"},"14":{"text":"Adam na kisol lo a, numei na kisolin mawnei na suoh hi.","ref":"Pien 3:1-6"},"15":{"text":"Hizongle numei in opdan siemin upna, itna, le siengthona a nei suoh po leh nau neina tungtawnin ama hutdamin a om ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi khatpo in hlattuom pawlpi sie panmun a lunggul leh nasep thupi sem nuom ahi hi, ci-a na kigen khu thuman ahi hi.","title":"Hlattuom Pawlpi Siete Nei ding Thute"},"2":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpi kem siepa pen genbang lo mi, zi khat beh a nei mi, a kideh zo mi, a pilvang mi, a zatahhuoi mi, zindo siem mi, thuhil siem mi,"},"3":{"text":"zukham lo mi, ngongtat loin a nunnem mi, mi tawh a kihau nuom lo mi, le sumlepai lamah a duhop lo mi hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A innkuon sungah vaihawm siem ding a, sil bangkimah zatahna tawh a tate a thunungsah mi hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khat in ama’ innkuon sung vaihawm zie ding a thei sih leh Pasien’ hlattuom pawlpi bangci kep thei ding ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Ama pen a piengtha cil mi hi lo ding hi, tua hi sihle ama kiphasahin dawimangpa ma bangin thukhenna a thuoh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua tham loin a mindai lo nading le dawimangpa’ thangah a aw lo nadingin a pulam mite’ zatah mi hi pelmaw ding hi.","ref":"Titu 1:6-9"},"8":{"text":"Tua ma bangin upa dingte zong a zatahhuoi mi, thu a legen kawikawi lo mi, zu hai lo mi, sumlepai lamah a huoiham lo mi hi ding hi;","title":"Hlattuom Pawlpi Upate Nei ding Thute"},"9":{"text":"amate in kitheina lungsim siengtho tawh upna thuthuh tukip ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"A masa-in amate kisittel phot uheh; tua zaw ciengin amau le amau genbang lo a kisah uleh upa sem ta uheh."},"11":{"text":"Tua ma bangin numeite zong a zatahhuoi mi, mi gensiet hat lo mi, sil bangkimah pilvangin a muonhuoi mi hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpi upate pen zi khat beh nei mi hi hinlen, a tate le a innkuonpite hoitahin uh ta uheh;"},"13":{"text":"azieh pen hlattuom pawlpi upa hoitaha a semte in mite’ zatahna nga a, Khris Jesu sunga a om upna thu ah zong hangsanna lienpi nga uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na kung vuah ang haw bai dingin ka kilamen a, ahi vangin na kung vuah tam thuhilnate kang giel hi.","title":"I Biehna’ Thuthuh Lienpi"},"15":{"text":"Kang kiheh khah tah lezong note in thuman thutah’ khuompi le bulkip ahi a hingzing Pasien’ innkuon sungah bangci gamtat ding ci thu na thei ding uh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Upla huoi lo a lien mama i biehna thuthuhpi in: Tahsa-in ama hing kilangin, hlagau sungah dih hi, ci-in na kilah a, vantung mite in mu-in, Gentile-te lahah kitangko a, leitung muncin tengah ki-umin, minthanna tawh ama kilato hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Hlagau in kicientahin a gen thu in, hun nukhia ciengin mi pawlkhat in upna thu taisanin zuou thei hlagaute’ thugen le dawite’ thuhilnate a mang ding uhi.","title":"A Man lo Pumpi Kidehnate"},"2":{"text":"Tam banga thuhilna pen sia-emsa tawh a lungsim uh a kihalgawsa zuou thugente’ kineitawmna tungtawna ang pieng ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in kiten kipinate a kham vua, thuman thutah thei-in a um mite in lungdamkona tawh a san zieu ding vua Pasien in a piensah ante a tan nadingun thu a pie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien’ piensah na vannuoi hoi a, lungdam kona tawh a kisan nah leh niel ding khat zong a om sih hi;"},"5":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile tuate pen Pasien’ kammal le thungetna tawh a kisiengsahsa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Na zuisa upna thu le thuhilna hoite tawh kiva-in sanggamte kungah tami kithuhilnate na gen nah leh Khris Jesu nasem hoi khat na hi ding hi.","title":"Khris Jesu’ Nasem Hoi"},"7":{"text":"Pasien’ thu tawh a kituoh lo a mothuoi tangmite le pivuoite’ gen tangmite tawh kisaw kha sin. Pasien’ mi hina lamah nang le nang kisin in."},"8":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile pumpi kisinna in phattuomna pawlkhat nei a, ahi vangin Pasien’ mi hina in tuhun hinkhuo ding le ang tung ding hinkhuo adingin kamciem a nei ziehin na zosie ah a manpha hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami pen a buppi-in san dinga a kilawm a muonhuoi thu kigen khat ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen eite in mi zosie, a diehdiehin a um mite’ Hundampa tungah i lametna uh i koi ziehun, tami thu-ah na semin nahpi tahin i hanciem uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tami thute hil inlen na hawmsawn in."},"12":{"text":"Koima in na khangnona kisimmaw sah sinlen, kamhamna, gamtatna, itna, upna le siengthona lamah thu um mite ette dingin na om in."},"13":{"text":"Kang pei masangin mipite mai-ah Lai Siengtho simna, hanthotna le thuhilnate na pawnthaw in."},"14":{"text":"Kamsanna tungtawnin upate in khutngahna tawh na tunga ang kipie letsong thudon loin om sin."},"15":{"text":"Mi zosie in na khantona a mu thei nadingin tami thute-ah nang mama kipumpiehin kisin in."},"16":{"text":"Nang mama kikepsiemin na thuhilnate-ah pilvangin; tami thute zomsuoh in, bangzieh ahei cile tam banga na bawlna ziehin nangma le na thugen a za mite na hunkhie ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang sanga a khanghamzawte khautahin hopi sinlen, pa bangin hopi zaw in. A khangdawng zawte zong sanggam bangin hopi in.","title":"Thu um Mite Tunga Tavuonte"},"2":{"text":"Siengthona tahtah tawh a tazaw numeite na nu bang in hopi inlen, a khangdawng zaw numeite sanggam nu bangin hopi in."},"3":{"text":"Meigong tahtahte na zatah bawl in."},"4":{"text":"Meigong khat in tate ahi a, tute ahi zongin a nei leh a nu a pate tungah lungdam a thuhkia thei nadingin a innkuon sung vuah a biehna utawh kisai a mawpuohna uh sin masa phot uheh; bangzieh ahei cile tami in Pasien a lungkimsah hi."},"5":{"text":"A kem a khoi ding om loin ama tanga kinuasie meigong tahtah numei nu in Pasien tungah a lametna nga a, sun le zanin thu ngetna le thumna nei ngitnget hi;"},"6":{"text":"ahi vangin noptatna lamah a nungta numei nu ahile a hin sung nangawnin a si zo ahi ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a kimawsiet thei lo nadingin amate tungah tam thute gen sawn in."},"8":{"text":"Mi khatpo in a tanaute, a diehdiehin a innkuonpite a va nuom sih leh upna thu niel ahi a, thu um lo mipa sanga a siezaw ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Meigong numei khat kum sawmguh sangin tawm zaw loin, khatvei beh pasal nei ngaisa ahile meigong sazien sungah khumsah in."},"10":{"text":"Ama pen a gamtat hoina zieha phatna a nga mi, a tate mi suo-in zindo a siem mi hi ding a, mi siengthote’ keng silpiehin, cimaw dongtuohte khoi a, vai zosie-ah na hoi sem dinga ama le ama a kipumpieh mi hi teitei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin khangdawng meigongte ahile sazien sunga khum ding niel un; azieh pen a si le sa lunggulna uh khangin pasal a nei nuom kia ciengun Khris a taisan vua,"},"12":{"text":"tuaci’n a kamciemna masa uh a palsat ziehun amate in mawsah thukhenna a thuoh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banah amate in bangma sem loin hun mawh tawpsah ding sinin, inn khat zaw inn khat pei kawikawi-in a vah thapai vua, tuaci’n a hun mawh tawpsah beh hi loin mi gensiet hatin, mi dangte’ thu-ah kikumthaw-in gen dinga kilawm lo thute a gen lai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin i langpa’ ei gensiet nading a op lo nadingin khangdawng meigongte in pasal nei-in ta le nau nei a, a inn sung a vaihawm ding ka dei hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Satan nua zui dingin pawlkhat a lampiel zo tazaw uhi."},"16":{"text":"Thu um numei khatpo in meigong tahtah tanaute a nei leh amate panpi taheh; tuaci’n hlattuom pawlpite vangih suon loin meigong tahtahte kipanpi thei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Thu vaihawm siem ahi hlattuom pawlpi upate, a diehdiehin thugenna le thuhilna lamah a kukalte pen patawina a za ni pieh dingin kilawm hi;"},"18":{"text":"azieh pen Lai Siengtho in, “Bawngtang in bu a cil laitahin a nephu na tuom sih ding uhi,” ci a, tua ciengin, “Nasem pa in a thaman a nga ding kilawm hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:4; Mat 10:10; Luk 10:7"},"19":{"text":"Upa khat mawsah nadingin mi ni ahi sihle thum in teci a pan lo buong le thulah ngai sin.","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"20":{"text":"Mawna a bawl paupaute tawh kisai-in adangte a zau thei nadingin mi zosie mai-ah na phawhsie in."},"21":{"text":"Huptuom paituom le khentuom nei loin tami thuhilnate na zui nadingin Pasien mai, Khris Jesu mai le a kiteel vantung mite mai-ah thu kang pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi khatpo tungah na khut nga-in kipsah paipai sin; midangte mawna-ah kihal loin nang le nang a siengtho-in kikem in."},"23":{"text":"Na gilpi ading le na cinat paipai nate a dam thei nadingin tuisih beh dawn nawn sinlen, lenggazu zong tawmtawm na dawn in."},"24":{"text":"Pawlkhatte’ mawna pen kilang pai a, thukhenna ah tuate a na matun zo hi, midangte’ mawna in tuate a nuazui hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin gamtatna hoite zong a kilang pai sinsen hi; a kilang lote nangawn zong kiphuol suoh zo tuon lo hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ min le thuhilna a kigensiet lo nadingin sila hahkol nei-a a om zosiete in a pute tungah zatahna zosie pieh tah hi, ci-in ngaisun uheh."},"2":{"text":"Thu um mi pu-a a neite in hlattuom pawlpi mi ahina hang utawh amate zatah loin om tuon sih uheh; amau’ nasepna a phattuompite pen thu um mite le a itte uh ma ahi ziehin a hoizaw sema amau’ na a seppieh ding uh hizaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Tami tavuonte hilin na hansuo ding hi. Pasien’ mi hina tawh kituohin a siengtho i Topa Jesu Khris’ thute le thuhilna a sang thei lo mi poma pen","title":"A Dihlo Thuhilna le a Dih Hauna"},"4":{"text":"a kihisah ahi a, bangma thei lo mi ahi hi. Tua bang mi poma thu kiselna le kinielna lamah lunggulna man lo a neite ahi uhi. Tua teng panin kithangsietna, kihauna, kigensietna, a hoi lo lama ki-upmawnate,"},"5":{"text":"le lungsim sie nei-in thuman thutah a pom lo, Pasien’ mi hina pen hau theina ding lampi-a a ngaisun mite lahah kihau kiselna lienpi a pieng hi."},"6":{"text":"Lungkimna tawh a kikop Pasien’ mi hina pen metna lienpi hi tahpi hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile eite in leitungah bangma i keng sih vua, tua panin zong bangma i puo thei sih uhi;"},"8":{"text":"hizongle anneh ding le puonsil ding i nei nah po leh tuate tawh i lungkim ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin a hau nuom mite pen ze-etna sungah a pua vua, a motvai le a siesah thei lunggulna tampite sungah awhcipin, tuate in sietna le suhsietna sungah a lutpi hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile sum deigawna in sietna namkim’ zungpi hi a, a hau nop luotna ziehun upna panin mi pawlkhat pielin lungkhamna tampi a thuohlaw uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle Pasien’ mipa aw, nang in tam thu zosie na pel in; dihna, Pasien’ mi hina, upna, itna, thuohzawhna, le lungnemna na del in.","title":"Upna-ah Galdona Hoi"},"12":{"text":"Upna galdona hoi na do in; kumtawn hinna na tukip in, tami dinga ang kihlan ahi a, nang in teci tampite mai-ah a hoi pulahna na bawl zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Na zosie tungah hinna a pie pa Pasien mai le Pontius Pilat mai-ah pulahna hoi bawlin teci a pang pa Khris Jesu’ mit mu-in,","ref":"Jhn 18:37"},"14":{"text":"i Topa Jesu Khris ang kilahkia masangsie mawsahna le genbanna om loin a thupiehte na zui nadingin thu kang pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpite’ Kumpi, topate’ Topa , thupha nga-in Thunei pen pa ahi ama beh in hun a sah ciengin ang piengsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama beh a si thei lo le a kineh thei lo khuovah sunga a teng pa hi a, koima in ama mu ngai loin zong mu thei lo hi; ama tungah patawina le kumtawn uhna om taheh. Amen."},"17":{"text":"Tu huna mihaute ahile kisathei loin a kicien lo haunate tungah a lametna uh zong nga loin, i lungnop thei nadingin sil bangkim kicing taha ei sih pa Pasien tungah a ngah zawh nadingun amate thu pie in."},"18":{"text":"Amate in sil hoi bawlin a pha tampi sem a, a neisate uh phalna tawh mi a hop thei nading uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ang tung ding hun adingin amate mama in tua bangin bulkip hoi gougil khat khol uheh, tua hile amate in tua hinna tahtah a tukip thei ta ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Timothy aw, nang tunga ang ki-apsa thute kemsiem in. A siengtho lo kamham le a man lopi-a thu theina a kici kiniel kiselnate na pel in;","title":"Mimal Thuhilnate le Thupha Piehna"},"21":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile mi pawlkhatte in tua bang pilna nei-in a kingaisut ziehun upna laigil panin a pielmang ta uhi. Note tawh hepina hing om taheh."}}}}},"55":{"info":{"name":"2 Timothy","shortname":"2tim","abbr":[],"desc":"Timothy nina timothy tunga paul’ laihlah nina (paul’s second letter to timothy)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khris Jesu sunga om hinna kamciem tawh kizui-in Pasien’ deina tawh Khris’ sawltahpi ahi Paul in,","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"Pa Pasien le i Topa Jesu Khris tung panin hepina, khuotuona le lungmuonna in ka it ka tapa Timothy tungah hing tung taheh.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"3":{"text":"Ka thungetna ah sun le zanin nang kang phaw zing ciengin, ka pu ka pate ma bangin lungsim siengtho tawh a na ka seppieh Pasien tungah lungdam thu ka tut hi.","title":"Lungdamkona le Hanthotna"},"4":{"text":"Lungnopna tawh ka kidim thei nadingin na hlitui luonnate phawhkia-in kang mu ding kal ka ngahla mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Lungsim tahpi tawh na upna ka phawh a, na pi Lois le na nu Eunice sungah tua upna na nungta masa-in, tu-in nang sungah ang nungta hi, ci thu ka theicien hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"6":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin nangma tungah khut kang ngahna tungtawnin keima in na sunga a om Pasien’ letsong na kuontawkia ding kang phawhsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in meipuona lungsim ei pie sih a, vanglietna, itna, le ki-uh zawhna lungsim ei pie hizaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin i Topa’ thu tecipanna maizumpi loin, ama zieha thongkie ahi keima zong ei maizumpi sinlen, Pasien’ vanglietna tungah kingam kawmin lungdamna thu adinga ka genthei thuohna ah ei thuohpi zaw in."},"9":{"text":"Ama in eite’ nasepna zieh hi loin ama’ ngimnasa bangin a hepina ziehin eite ei hundamin a siengtho hlatna tawh ei hlan hi. Tami hepina pen leitung pien masang Khris Jesu sunga ei piehsa ahi ta bo hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle sina sumaimang a, lungdamna thu ziehin hinna le si thei lona a kilangsah i hundam pa Khris Jesu ang kilahna tungtawnin tu-in tua hepina ang kilang zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami lungdamna thu adinga a tangkopa, sawltahpi le siepa dinga ei kisesa ahi a,","ref":"1Tim 2:7"},"12":{"text":"tami thu hang tawh ka sep banga a thuoh ka hi hi. Hizongle ka mai a zum sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile ka up pa ka thei a, ama tunga ka silpiehte zong ama in khum Ni dongin ei keppieh zo ding hi, ci ka cienthei hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima tung pana na zahsa thuhilna dihte, Khris Jesu sunga a om upna le itna sungah pomkip in."},"14":{"text":"Ei sunga a teng Hlagau Siengtho thahatna tawh nangma tunga ang ki-ap tua sil hoi kemcing in."},"15":{"text":"Asia gam sunga om zosie in kei ei taisan vua, tuate lahah Phygelus le Hermogenes-te zong kihal hi, ci thu na thei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Onesiphorus innkuonte tungah Topa in khuotuona pie taheh, azieh pen ama in ei thahatsah ngitnget a, ka thongkiehna zong ei maizumpi sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Rome ah ama ang tun ciengin keima ei sui-in ei mu pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Khumi ni ciengin Topa kung panin ama in khuotuona a mu thei nading Topa in pie taheh! Ama in Ephesus khuo ah kei adingin bangza tahin ei seppieh ahei ci thu na theisa ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin nang ka tapa aw, Khris Jesu sunga om hepina sungah thahat in;","title":"Khris Jesu’ Galkap Hoi"},"2":{"text":"teci tampite tungtawnin kei tung pana na zahsa thute, midangte zong a hilsawn thei ding mi muonhuoite tungah na ap in."},"3":{"text":"Khris Jesu’ galkap hoi khat bangin hamsatna ei thuohpi in."},"4":{"text":"Galkap a sem lai mi koima in nisim vaite ah a kisawpawi sih hi; tua galkap pa’ lungtup in nasep a guon a bupa lungkimsah ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Kidemna sungah a kihal mi koima in thuhlun tawh kituohin a dem sih leh lukhu a nga sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Lohlo nasem pa in zong lo-a pieng gate a nga masah dinga a kilawm ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka thugen ngaisun in, bang ding ahei cile Topa in sil bangkimah theina ang pie ding hi."},"8":{"text":"David’ suonlehlah ahi sina panin a thokia Jesu Khris phawh in, tua khu keima hil lungdamna thu ahi a,"},"9":{"text":"tua thu ziehin gimna ka thuoh a, tuolthat khat bangin kolbulna cieng nangawn ka thuoh hi. Hizongle Pasien’ thu kol kibul thei lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a teelsa mite in zong Khris Jesu sunga hutdamna le tawntung minthanna a ngaton thei nadingun amau’ ziehin sil bangkim ka thuoh hi."},"11":{"text":"A muontah mama thu in: Ama tawh i siton uleh eite zong ama tawh i hington ding uhi;"},"12":{"text":"eite in i thuohzawh uleh ama tawh zong i mangton ding uhi; eite in ama i niel uleh ama in zong eite ei niel ding hi;","ref":"Mat 10:33; Luk 12:9"},"13":{"text":"eite i muonhuoi sih uleh zong, ama a muonhuoi zing hi, azieh pen ama le ama ki niel thei lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam thu theisah inlen, thu ginalo, thu ngai mite a siesah thei bep ding kam kinielnate a pel nadingun Pasien mai-ah amate thuhil in.","title":"A Kipahta Nasempa"},"15":{"text":"Maizum om lo thuman thutah mantaha a gen, ama in a pahtat nasempa khat bangin Pasien tungah na ki-ap thei nadingin na thei tawpin bawl in."},"16":{"text":"A thanghuoi a mawhna kamte na pel in, azieh pen tua bang thute in Pasien up lona lamah mite pui semsem ding a,"},"17":{"text":"a thugente uh zong a dam thei lo a bantawn hima bangin kizel ding hi. Tua bang mite lahah Hymenaeus le Philetus zong a kihal vua,"},"18":{"text":"ama gel in thawkiana tung zo hi, ci-in thuman thutah panin pielin mi pawlkhatte’ upna a subuoi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi vangin Pasien’ khuombul kiptahin ding a, tam bangin kiciemte hi: “ Topa in ama-ate’ thei hi,” ci thu le, “ Topa mina a kilo mi zosie in gitlona panin kihemkhie heh,” ci thu ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 6:5"},"20":{"text":"Inn golpi khat sungah ngun le kham beh a om sih a, sing le lei tawh a kibawl vanzahte zong a om hi, pawlkhatte a thupi-a zah ding, pawlkhatte pen a kithangzah ding ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka gensa silte panin amau le amau a kisiensuo mi zosie pen nasep hoi namcin sem dingin a baisa-a om, inn neipa dinga kimanna a nei, a thupi-a zah dinga a ki-apsa vanzahte a suoh ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Khangno lunggulnate pel inlen, lungsim siengtho panin Topa a hlan mite tawh dihna, upna, itna le kilemna del in."},"23":{"text":"Hizongle a mothuoi le theitel lopi-a kam kiselnate tawh na kicisaw kha sin; tuate in kihaunate piengsah hi, ci thu na theisa ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa’ nasempa pen mi tawh kihau poma lo ding a, tuale mahin mikim tungah a nunnem, thuhil lam a kiva, a lungduoi,"},"25":{"text":"ama a langpang mite lungnemna tawh a hil mi hi ding hi. Pasien in amate kisiasahin thuman thutah theina pie theikha ding a,"},"26":{"text":"tuale dawimangpa’ thang panin ama’ deina lam sem dinga a matsa mite a suohta thei ding uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nukhia ni ciengin hahsatna hun ang tung ding hi, ci theisiem in.","title":"Ni Nukhia Huna Pasien Zatahlona"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen mite ahile, amau le amau ki-itte, sum dei luote, a kipumphatte, a kihisahte, mi sietgente, nu le pa thu a mang lote, a lungdam thei lote, a siengtho lote,"},"3":{"text":"mihing lungsim a kuo lote, itna nei lote, a maisah nuom lote, mi gensiet hatte, sum thangzahte, a ngongtatte, thu hoi huote,"},"4":{"text":"ciempelte, a gamhtatte, a kipum phatsahte, Pasien it ding sanga noptatna a lunggul zawte ahi ding vua,"},"5":{"text":"a puthamin Pasien’ mi hina nei sam napi a vanglietna a nielte ahi ding uhi. Tua mite na pel in!"},"6":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate lahah mi pawlkhat kinelnelin mi inn ah lutin, a mawna zieh vua lunggulna namcin teng in a suhnawh a tonawh numei mawlawmte manin a thuzaw uhi,"},"7":{"text":"tua bang numeite ahi ule thu a kihilhil vangin thuman thutah a theitel zo ngai lote ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jannes le Jambres in Moses a langpan ma bangin tam mite in zong thuman thutah a langpang vua, lungsim kisie gawpsa le upna man lo mite ahi uhi.","ref":"Pei 7:11"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in ma a sot sih ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile tua mi nite tungtang thu ma bangin amau’ motna zong mikim tungah kitheisah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in nangma in ka thuhilna, ka gamtatna, ka nuntahna-ah ka lungtup, ka upna, ka lungduoina, ka itna, ka thuohzawh hatna,","title":"Timothy Tunga Paul Thuhilna"},"11":{"text":"bawlsietna ka thuohna, gimna ka thuohna, le Antioch, Iconium, le Lystra khuote ah keima tunga thupiengte na theisa uh ahi hi. Bawlsietna thuoh sam ing ei! Hizongle Topa in tuate zosie panin ei hunkhie hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:14-52; 14:1-20"},"12":{"text":"A tahtahin, Khris Jesu sungah Pasien’ mi hinkhuo a mang nuom zosie pen a kibawlsie ding ma ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin migilote le misol hatte sie semsem ding a, midangte a sol bangun amate zong kisol ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang na hi leh koi kung pana na sin ahei ci na theisa ahi a, tua na sinsa le kiptaha na upsa silte zom peisuoh in."},"15":{"text":"Jesu Khris upna tungtawnin gupna na nga thei nadingin ang hil Lai Siengtho pen na neu lai-a kipanin bang na ci thei ahei ci thu zong na theisa ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Lai Siengtho zosie Pasien’ humopsa hi a, thuhil nading, mi phawsiet nading, bawlphat nading, le dihna thu-ah mi pantah nadingin kimang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua in sil hoi namcin a sem dingin Pasien’ mi zosie pantahin nasep a siem thei nading uh ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien mai le a hing laite le a site thukhen dinga ama ang kilaa nading le ama’ kumpi gam ngaisutna tawh Jesu Khris mai-ah lipkhap tahin kang hanthawn hi:"},"2":{"text":"Pasien’ thu phuongzah in; hun a lemtang a, a lemtang sih zongin kin ngaisut den in; a thu telsah in, phawhin hanthawn inlen, lungduoi tawpna tawh hil in."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mite in kihilna man a ngai nop nawn lo uh hun ang tung ding a, bil thahin amau’ deina beh tawh a kituoh thuhil siete, amate adingin a kaikhawm ding vua,"},"4":{"text":"thuman thutah ngaina panin kihei mangin, phuotawm tangmite ngai-in a vahthap ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Pilvang zing in, hamsatna thuoh bembom in, lungdamna thugen nasep sem inlen, tua na nasep a unpi-in muolsuo in."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen kei ka hi leh dawnthei biehna banga sun dingin a kithawi sa-in ka om zo a, ka pei ding hun ang tung ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Galdona pha do zo-in, tai kidemna a mong dongin ka tai zo a, upna thu ka kemcing zo ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-a kipanin kei adingin dihna lukhu kikoi zo a, tua ni ciengin a dih thukhenpa ahi Topa in keima ei pie ding hi, kei tung beh hi loin ama ang kilaa ding a lamen mi zosiete tungah zong a pie ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima kungah a mallang theithei-a nang haw nadingin hing hanciem ta’n.","title":"Aituom Thuhilnate"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen Demas in tami leitung a it ziehin keima ei taisanin Thessalonica khuo ah a pei zo hi; Galatia gamah Crescens ama pei zo a, Dalmatia gamah Titus pei zo hi.","ref":"Col 4:14; Phm 24; 2Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; Titu 1:4"},"11":{"text":"Luke beh tawh a omton ka hi hi. Mark hing ciel inlen hing zawpi ta’n, bangzieh ahei cile ka nasepna ah ama kizang thei mama hi.","ref":"Col 4:10, 14; Phm 24; Sawl 12:12, 25; 13:13; 15:37-39"},"12":{"text":"Ephesus khuo ah Tychicus ka sawl zo hi.","ref":"Sawl 20:4; Eph 6:21-22; Col 4:7-8"},"13":{"text":"Nang pei ciengin Troas khuo Carpus kunga ka nuasie ka puontuolpi, laibute zong, a diehdiehin savun laiziel zosie hing puo ta’n.","ref":"Sawl 20:6"},"14":{"text":"Siakhengpa Alexander in ei nah bawlsiet mama hi; a gamtatna bangin Topa in thuhkia ding hi.","ref":"1Tim 1:20; Late 62:12; Rom 2:6"},"15":{"text":"Ama in i thuhilna nahpi-in ei langpan ahi ziehin nang zong ama tungah na kidawm mama in."},"16":{"text":"Keima’ kihutna thu ka gen masah lai-in koima in ei panpi sih a, mi zosie in ei taisan sieng uhi. Tua thu ziehin amate kimawsah da kon heh!"},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin Topa in ei panpi a, keima tungtawnin Gentile-te zosie in tua thu a zah thei nadingin a bukima ka tangko nading thahatna ei guon hi. Tuaci’n humpi kam sung panin ei kihunkhie hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in gitlona tawh ei kidona namcin panin ei hunkhie ding a, ama’ vantung gam adingin ei hundam ding hi. Ama tungah kumtawnin minthanna om taheh. Amen."},"19":{"text":"Prisca, Aquila le Onesiphorus-te innkuon ei na noset pieh in.","title":"A Tawpna Hopinate le Thupha Piehna","ref":"Sawl 18:2; 2Tim 1:16-17"},"20":{"text":"Corinth khuo ah Erastus tam suoh a, Miletus khuo ah Trophimus a cinasa-in ka nuasie hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:22; Rom 16:23; Sawl 20:4; 21:29"},"21":{"text":"Phalbi masanga nang haw nading hing hanciem ta’n. Eubulus in nang ang noset a, Pudens, Linus, Claudia le sanggamte zosie in zong ang noset uhi."},"22":{"text":"Topa le na hlagau hing om taheh. Note tawh hepina hing om taheh."}}}}},"56":{"info":{"name":"Titus","shortname":"Titu","abbr":[],"desc":"Titus tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to titus)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ nasem le Jesu Khris’ sawltahpi keima Paul in, Pasien’ teeltuom mite upna zieh le Pasien’ mi hina tawh kituoh thuman thutah ziehin,"},"2":{"text":"zuouthu a gen ngai lo Pasien in leitung kipat masanga a ciemsa, kumtawn hinna lametna ah,"},"3":{"text":"a hun a tun ciengin eite’ Hundampa Pasien’ thupiehna tawh keima ei ki-ap tangkona tungtawnin ama’ thu hing kilangsah a,"},"4":{"text":"eite in i neiton uh upna sungah ka tapa tahtah ahi Titus tungah lai kang hlah hi: Pa Pasien le i Hundampa Khris Jesu tung panin hepina le lungmuonna na tungah hing tung taheh.","ref":"2Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; 2Tim 4:10; 2Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; 2Tim 4:10"},"5":{"text":"Crete tuikul ah kang nuasiena thu pen tam thu zieh ahi hi. Nangma na hile a kinuasie nasep bangsam teng na man sieng thei nading le kang lamlahsa bangin khuopi cin tengah hlattuom pawlpi upate se-in a koi ding na hi hi.","title":"Cerete Tuikulah Titus"},"6":{"text":"Tua upa dingte pen paubanna a om lo mi, zi khatvei beh a nei mi hi ding a, a tate zong thu um mi hi-in, huasanin thu mang lo hi, ci-a a kimawsah lo mite hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile hlattuom pawlpi kem siepa pen Pasien’ neisa a kempa ahi ma bangin paubanna a nei lo mi hi ding hi; a kiphasah lo, a thangpai bai lo, zu a hai lo, mi tawh a kihau lo, a gamhtat lo, met nading sui-in a hawhdah lo mi hi ding hi;"},"8":{"text":"tuale mahin zindo siem mi, thuhoi dei mi, a pilvang mi, a pumpi ki-uh zo mi, a thutang mi, biehna lam a pawnthaw mi le a kideh zo mi hi pelmaw ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuhilna man tawh thu a hil thei nading le thuman a nielte a thuh thei nadingin ama in thuhilna dung zui-in a muontah thu a tukip mi hi pelmaw ding hi.","ref":"1Tim 3:2-7"},"10":{"text":"A paupeng mi, thu mot gengen mi, le mi sol thei mi tampi zong om a, a diehdiehin tep kitan mite lahah tam deu hi;"},"11":{"text":"amate pen a sip dide ding uhi, a zieh pen amate in a dih lo sum nga nadingin hil dinga a kilawm lo thute hilin, innkuon buppi a buoisah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amate lahah a kamsang pa khat in, “Crete gam mite pen zuouphuo dente, gamsa gilo, a thasie le a gongsante ahi uhi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tami teci panna pen a man ahi hi. Bangzieh ahei cile upna lamah a maan nading ule,"},"14":{"text":"Jew mite’ tangmite le thuman thutah a nielte’ thupiehte a thudon lo nadingun amate khautahin phawhsie in."},"15":{"text":"A siengtho mite adingin na zosie siengtho a, hinanle a kisiete le thu um lo mite adingin a siengtho khat zong om lo hi. Amau’ lungsim mama le a kitheina lungsim uh a kisie hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasien thei a kinei vua, ahi vangin a gamtatna utawh ama a nuol uhi. Amate pen a mudahuoi, thu mang lo, nasep hoi khatpo sem dinga a kilawm lo mite ahi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang na hile thuhilna man tawh kituohin thu na hil in.","title":"Thuhilna Man Hil in"},"2":{"text":"Pasal khanghamte pen a kideh zo mi, a zatah huoi mi, a pilvang mi, upna man a nei mi, itna a nei mi, le thuoh zawhna a nei mi ahi nadingun na gen in."},"3":{"text":"Tua ma bangin numei khanghamte zong a gamtatna uh zatah baang mi, mi gensie lo mi, zu’ sila a suoh lo mi ahi nadingun na gen in; amate in thu a hil ding vua,"},"4":{"text":"tuaci’n nupilate in a pasalte le a tate uh a it nadingun hanthawnin,"},"5":{"text":"Pasien’ thu a kigensiet lo nadingin amau le amau a ki-uh thei, a gamtat siengtho, inn sung vaihawm siem mi, a migi, le a pasalte thu a mang mi a suo nading uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ma bangin pasal khangdawngte in a pumpi uh a ki-uh zo ciet nadingun hanthawn in."},"7":{"text":"Nang mama in sil bangkimah gamtat hoina limpha na lah inlen, na thuhilna ah citahna le zatah huoina lahin,"},"8":{"text":"a kimawsah thei lo thutah na zang in; tua hile ei langpan mite in ei gensiet nading uh bangma thu mu loin a maizum ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Silate in a pute uh thu mang a, sil bangkimah amate a lungkimsah thei nading uh gen in; amate selkia loin,"},"10":{"text":"a nate uzong guhdappieh loin sil bangkimah i hundam pa uh Pasien’ thuhilna a etlawmsah ahi thei nadingun a kicing le a bukim a muonhuoina uh a kilahsah thei nadingun gen in."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi zosie tunga hutdamna thu a puoh Pasien’ hepina ang kilang zo a,"},"12":{"text":"tua hepina in Pasien zatah lona le leitung cilesa deigawnate paimang dingin eite ei hil a, tuhun leitungah i pumpi ki-uh zo-in, thutang le Pasien zataha i hin nadingin ei hil kawmin,"},"13":{"text":"a lien i Pasien le i hundam pa Jesu Khris vanglien tahin ang kilah nading a manpha lametna ngahin i om uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in eite gitlona zosie panin ei tankhie-in ama’ neituom mite ei sienthosah nading le nasep hoi i sep nop nadingin eite adingin amama ang kipumpieh zo hi.","ref":"Late 130:8; Pei 19:5; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; 1Pet 2:9"},"15":{"text":"Tami thute gen inlen, thuneina zosie tawh hanthawnin phawhsie in. Koima’ simmaw-in om sin."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate in gam-uhte le thuneite’ thu mangin, sil hoi zosie sem dingin a baisa-in a om vua,","title":"Gamtat Hoite Zomsuoh in"},"2":{"text":"koima tungah kamsie ham loin mi tawh kihau kisel ding a pelh nading ule nunnemin mi vannuoi tungah gamtat khuoheh hoi a lah thei nading uh amate na phawhsah in."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite mama zong hun khat lai-in mi mawlawm, thu mang lo, a lampiel mangte, cilesa lunggulna le nopsahna tuomtuomte’ sila i na hi ngai vua, eite in gitlona le hazatna sungah i hun i nite zangin, mite in ei muda a, eite khatlekhat zong a kimuda ngaite i hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi vangin i Hundam pa uh Pasien’ migitna le itna ang kilaa tah ciengin,"},"5":{"text":"eite sepsa dihna khatpo zieh hi loin, tui tawh suokiana le Hlagau Siengtho zieha thasuona tungtawnin, ama’ ei khuotuona hang tawh ama in eite ei hunkhie hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in i Hundam pa Jesu Khris tungtawnin eite tungah tua Hlagau siengtho cingtahin ang sungsuh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua pen ama’ hepina tawh eite dih ei kitangsah a, i lamet uh ahi kumtawn hinna tawh kizui-in gouluote i suo nading ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam thu kigen pen a man ahi hi. Pasien a umsa mite in kidawm taha nasep hoi sem dinga amau le amau a kipumpieh thei nadingun amate in tami thute a thupisim ding uh ka dei hi; tam thu teng pen mi zosie adingin sil hoi tungtuong pen le sil phatuom pen ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin a mot huoi kiselnate, khangsimnate, kihaunate le thukham vai-a kiselnate na pel in, azieh pen tua thute in phattuomna le kimanna a nei sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Kikhen nading a piengsah mi poma khatvei ahi sihle nivei thu na hil zaw ciengin na thudon nawn sin."},"11":{"text":"Tua bang mite pen a kisiesa mi le mawna tawh a kidim mi ahi a, ama le ama a kimawpai ahi lam na thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Artemas ahiei, Tychicus ahiei na kunga kang sawl ciengin Nicopolis khuo ka kungah nang haw thei nadingin hing hanciem ta’n, bangzieh ahei cile khumnah phalbi sung a tam dingin ka khensat zo hi.","title":"Thugen Nukhiate le Thupha Piehna","ref":"Sawl 20:4; Eph 6:21-22; Col 4:7-8; 2Tim 4:12"},"13":{"text":"Khuolzinna lamkalah bangma tasap nei lo dingin upadi siempa Zenas le Apollos-te na hi thei za-in na hu in.","ref":"Sawl 18:24; 1Cor 16:12"},"14":{"text":"Mite ommawh loin tasap awnghu thei ding le nasep hoite sem dinga amau le amau a kipieh nadingun na kisin pelmaw uheh."},"15":{"text":"Keima tawh a om mi zosie in nang ang noset uhi. Upna sungah ei it mite ei na noset pieh in. Note zosie tungah hepina hing om taheh."}}}}},"57":{"info":{"name":"Philemon","shortname":"Phm","abbr":[],"desc":"Philemon tunga paul’ laihlah (paul’s letter to philemon)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khris Jesu hang tawh thongkie Paul le ka sanggam pa uh Timothy in, ka lawm it ule ka naseppi uh Philemon le","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"ka sanggam nu uh Apphia, ka galkappi uh Archippus le nangma’ inna a kikhawm pawlpi tungah:","ref":"Col 4:17"},"3":{"text":"I Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris tung panin hepina le lungmuonna note tungah hing tung taheh."},"4":{"text":"Ka thungetna ah note kang phaw sielin ka Pasien tungah nuomthu ka tut zing hi.","title":"Philemon Itna le Upna"},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile misiengthote zosie na it dan ule Topa Jesu na upnate uh ka na za hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote in Khris adingin na hoi zosie ka sep thei lam uh na thei ciengin, na upna na hopsawnna ah a muibut thei nadingin thu kang nget pieh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka sanggam pa aw, nang tungtawnin misiengthote’ lungsim thasuosah zo na hi ziehin, keima in na itna tung panin lungdamna lienpi le hanthotna ka na nga tahtah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tami thu ziehin na tavuon na sep nadingin Khris sungah hang tahin thu hing pie ngam nanleng,","title":"Onesimus Tanga Thumpiehna"},"9":{"text":"itna bulphu-in kang thumzaw hi. A khangham keima Paul in tulai tahin Jesu Khris adingin thongkie ka hi a,"},"10":{"text":"ka thongkieh sunga ama’ pa a suoh keima in ka tapa Onesimus adingin kang thumpieh hi.","ref":"Col 4:9"},"11":{"text":"Nidangin nang adingin ama a kizang thei sih a, ahi vangin tu-in nang le kei adingin a kizang thei tahtah ahi ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima’ pumpi za ma-in ngaisunin na kungah ama kang sawlkia hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungdamna thu zieha ka thongkieh sungin nangma tanga ei kem dingin ka kungah ama ka omsah nuom hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanle na gamtatna hoite paubawl hi loin nangma’ thu tawh a sem na hi thei nadingin, na thukimpina om lopi-in bangma ka bawl nuom sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Khan tawntungin ama na neikia thei nadinga bakhat sung kikhen pah zong na hi kha thei ding a,"},"16":{"text":"tu-in ama pen sila bang hi nawn loin sila sanga thupizaw sanggam it khat ang hita hi, adieh diehin kei adingin ama a manphat ma bangin cilesa sung le Topa sungah sanggam khat ahina tawh nang adingin manphazaw kan lai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n na naseppi banga nei ngaisut leh, kei nei san bangin ama zong na sangkia in."},"18":{"text":"Ama in lam khatpopo-ah nangma tunga suhkhiel a nei a, leibat khatpo a nei khah leh keima’ batin na ciemte in."},"19":{"text":"Keima Paul in kang sangkia ding hi, ci thu ka khut mama tawh kang giel ahi hi: Nangma’ pumpi mama nangawn zong kei tunga nei bat hi, ci thu bangma a gen ka hi sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi hi, sanggam aw, nangma tung panin Topa sungah tami hamphatna ei ngasah in!
