Khris sungah ka lungsim hing thasuosah in."},"21":{"text":"Ei mang dingin kang muong a, kang nget sanga a hoizaw nangawn hing bawl na vateh ci thu thei kawmin lai kang giel hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua banah kei adingin ka zin tunna ding innkhan khat a baisa-in na bawl un, azieh pen na thungetna uh tungtawnin na kung vua ang tung theikia dingin ka kilamen hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu Khris sungah thong ka kiehpi Epaphras a kipanin,","title":"A Tawpna Hopina le Thupha Piehna","ref":"Col 1:7; 4:12"},"24":{"text":"ka naseppite ahi Mark, Aristarchus, Demas le Luke in zong ang noset hi.","ref":"Sawl 12:12, 25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Col 4:10, 14; 2Tim 4:10, 11"},"25":{"text":"Topa Jesu Khris’ hepina, na hlagau utawh hing om taheh."}}}}},"58":{"info":{"name":"Hebrew","shortname":"Heb","abbr":[],"desc":"Hebrew-te tunga laihlah (the letter to the hebrews)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tanglai-in Pasien in kamsangte tungtawnin i pu i pate tungah lampi tuomtuom tawh tamveipi thu na gen a,","title":"A Tapa Tungtawnin Pasien in Thugen"},"2":{"text":"ahi vangin tami ni nukhiate ah leitung a bawlpa, sil bangkim a luo dinga a sepa ahi a Tapa tungtawnin eite tungah thu ang gen zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Pasien’ minthanna kilahna le Pasien’ hina bang lien puo a, a vanglien ama’ kammal tawh sil bangkim a tukip hi. Ama in mawnate adingin kisiensuona a bawl zaw ciengin sang pen muna om Vanglienpa’ zietlamah a to hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in vantung mite sangin min thupizaw a luo ma bangin vantung mite sanga a tungtuongzaw tham ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien in vantungmi kungah, “Nang ka Tapa na hi hi; tuni-in kang piengsah zo hi,” a ci ngai ta amah? Ahi sihle khatvei tawh, “Kei ama’ Pa ka hi ding a, ama ka tapa hi ding hi,” a ci ngai amah?","ref":"Late 2:7; 2Sam 7:14; 1Khg 17:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua banah leitungah a tacil ang peipi ciengin ama in, “Pasien’ vantungmi zosie in ama bie uheh,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:43"},"7":{"text":"Vantung mite tawh kisai-in ama in, “Ama in a vantung mite hui suohsah a, ama’ nasemte meikuong a suohsah hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 104:4"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin Tapa tawh kisai-in ama in, “Pasien aw, na kumpi topha kumtawnin om ding a, dihna ciengkhut pen na kumpi gam uhna ciengkhut hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang in dihna na it a, gitlona na muda hi; tua ahi ziehin Pasien, na Pasien in nang pen na guolte hlengin kipahna sathau tawh ang nu zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 45:6-7"},"10":{"text":"Tuale, “ Topa aw, a cilin leitung na phut a, vantungte nangma’ khutsuo ahi hi;"},"11":{"text":"tuate kisie nanle nang na om den ding a, puon bangin tuate zosie a tulmang ding hi;"},"12":{"text":"puontuol bangin tuate kizieltum ding a, puonsil bangin tuate kikhel ding hi. Hizongle nang na kibang den ding a, na kumte tawp ngai lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 102:25-27"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in vantung mite koi pen tungah, “Na galte na keng ngahna ka hisah masangsie ka zietlamah to in,” a ci ngai ta ahei?","ref":"Late 110:1"},"14":{"text":"Pasien’ nasepna ah vantung mite zosie pen hutdamna luo ding mite’ nasem dinga kisawl hlate hi lo uh amah?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin eite i tolmang lo nadingin i zahsa thute nahpi tahin i thudon mama uh kul ding hi.","title":"Thudon Ding Hilkholna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile vantung mite tungtawnin thu kigen pen kip a, tua thute mang loin a palsat mi poma in a kituoh mawna dan thuoh uh ahile,"},"3":{"text":"tua zataha a lien hutdamna thudon loin om leih bangci bangin suotah thei ding i hei? Tua thu pen Topa in amasa-in ei gen zo a, a thugen a za mite in eite tungah a thuman ahina ei lah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Pasien in zong limte, a lamdangte, na lamdang tuomtuomte, le a deina banga a hawm Hlagau Siengtho letsongte tungtawnin tua thu teci a panbe hi."},"5":{"text":"Eite in i gengen ahi ang tung ding leitung pen Pasien in vantung mite’ khut sungah koi lo hi.","title":"Tuolniemna Tungtawna Lapsangna"},"6":{"text":"Hizongle mi kimkhat in a teci panna uh mun khatah, “Na ngaisut tham dingin mihing bang hi lel a, na thudon tham dingin mihing tapa bang hi lel ahei?"},"7":{"text":"Vantung mite sangin amate a niemzaw hiau-in na bawl a, minthanna le patawina na khusah a,"},"8":{"text":"a keng nei vuah sil bangkim koi-in na uh sah hi,” ci-in teci kipang zo hi. Tu-in sil bangkim amate uhna nei-ah koi a, Pasien in amate a uhsah lo bangma a om sih hi. Tua hi napi tu tadi-in sil bangkim a uh lam i mu nai sih uhi.","ref":"Late 8:4-6"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin vantung mite sanga a niemzaw deu dingin bakhat sung a kibawl pah Jesu in Pasien hepina hang tawh mi zosie adingin sina a ciep thei nadingin ama in sina a thuoh ziehin tu-in minthanna le patawina lukhu kikhusah zo hi, ci i mu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ama ading le ama tungtawnin sil bangkim a piengsah Pasien in ta tampite, minthanna ah a peipi thei nadingin a thuohna tawh hutdamna a bawlcil pa Jesu a bukimsah ding pen a kilawm mawng ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a siengthosah pa le a kisiengthosah mite in a unpi-un pa khat beh a nei uhi. Tam thu ziehin Jesu in sanggamte ci-a amate a hlat ding pen maizum lo a,"},"12":{"text":"ama in, “Ka sanggamte tungah na min ka phuong ding a, mihonpi laikimah nangma kang phat ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 22:22"},"13":{"text":"Tuale, “Ama ka muong ding hi,” a cikia hi. Tuale, “Pasien ei piehsa tate tawh tanah ka om hi,” a cikia leuleu hi.","ref":"Isa 8:17, 18"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tate pen cilesa nei mite ahi ziehin, ama in zong sina tungtawnin sina vanglietna a nei dawimangpa a suhsiet thei nadingin ama ma zong tua bang ma-in cilesa nei-in ang pieng phot a,"},"15":{"text":"si ding a giin ziehun sala a kiman mi zosie a hlakhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile ama pen vangtung mite hu dinga ang pei ahi sih a, Abraham’ suonlehlahte hizaw hi, ci ang kicien hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien nasepna sungah mi lainat siem le a muonhuoi siempu lienpa a suo thei nading le, mipite mawna ziehin thoidamna a bawl thei nadingin sil bangkimah a sanggamte banga ang suo ding ma ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Azieh pen gimna thuohna tawh ama ma na ki ze-et ngai zo ahi ziehin, ama in ze-etna a thuoh mite ei hu thei hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin vantung lam hlatna a nga a siengtho ka kithuopite aw, eite in i pulah uh sawltahpi le siempu lienpa Jesu thu lungngai un.","title":"Moses a Nasempa, Khris a Tapa"},"2":{"text":"Moses zong Pasien’ inn sung zosie-ah a muonhuoi ma bangin ama zong nasep a guonpa tungah a muonhuoi hi.","ref":"Gam 12:7"},"3":{"text":"Ahi vangin a inn sangin a innlam pa a kipatawi zawh ma bangin Jesu pen Moses sanga a thupi zaw patawina nga dingin a kilawm hi."},"4":{"text":"(Bangzieh ahei cile inn zosie pen a lam mi khat om a, ahi vangin sil zosie a lampa Pasien ahi hi.)"},"5":{"text":"A nua cienga a kigen ding thute tungah teci pang dingin tu-in Moses pen nasem khat bangin Pasien’ inn sung buppi-ah muonhuoi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin tapa khat hina tawh Khris pen Pasien’ inn sungah muonhuoi hi. I muonna le i kisahtheipi uh lametna i tuhkip leh ama’ innkuonpi i hi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Lai Siengtho in a gen ma bangin, “Tu-in ama’ aw na zah uleh","title":"Uplona Zieha Thuhilna"},"8":{"text":"gamlahah ze-etna hun sunga a ledo bangun, na lungtang uh khausah sih un."},"9":{"text":"Kum sawmli sung ka silbawlte a mu vangun, tua munah na pu na pate un ei na ze-et uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tua khang mite tungah ka lung a thah a, keima in, ‘A lungtang uh lampiel zing a, ka lampite a thei sih uhi,’ ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka lung a thah a, ‘Ka tawlngahna-ah amate a lut sih ding uhi,’ ci-in ka kiciem hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 95:7-8"},"12":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note a koima po in a hingzing Pasien kung panin ang pielmangsah uplana lungsim a nei migilo na nei khah lo nadingun kidawm un."},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin “tuni” a kici sungin mawna solna ziehin koima in na lungsim uh na khausah lo nadingun nisimin khatlekhat na kihanthawn un."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite in i kimuonna masa pen a tawp donga i tuhkip nah leh Khris’ pawlte i suoh zo ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lai siengtho in, “Tuni-in ama’ aw na zah uleh, ledo lai hun bangin na lungtang uh khausah sih un,” na ci hi.","ref":"Late 95:7-8"},"16":{"text":"Za zo napi a ledo lai koite ahi uh ahei? Moses makaina nei-ah Egypt gam a nuasie mi zosie hi lo uh amah?"},"17":{"text":"Hizongle kum sawmli sung ama koi tunga lungthah ahei? Mawna a bawl zieh vua gamlahah a pumpi a puamatte tungah hi lo amah?"},"18":{"text":"Ka tawlngahna munah amate a lut sih ding uhi, ci-in ama in a tomlaw, thu mang lote tung simlo koi tungah hi ding ahei?","ref":"Gam 14:1-35"},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n up lona ziehin amate a lut thei sih uhi, ci thu i thei hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi tah ziehin ama’ tawlngahna sungah lut thei nading kamciem kihong lai ahi ziehin koima tua mun a tung zo lo na suo khah lo nadingun kidawm vai.","title":"Pasien’ Kamciem Tawlngahna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate kunga lungdamna thu a tun bang lienin, eite kungah zong ang tung zo ta hi; hinanle tua thu a za mite in upna tawh kop lo ahi ziehin a zahsa uh thu in amate a phatuomsah sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen ei a um mite i hi leh tua tawlngahna munah i lut vua, leitung a kiphu cila kipanin a silbawlte a man siengsa hi napi Pasien in, ‘Ka tawlngahna-ah amate a lut sih ding uhi,’ a ci ma bangin, “Ka lungthah a, ka kiciem zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 95:11"},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen ni sagina thu tawh kisai-in mun khatah tam bangin gen a, “A ni sagi ni-in a nasepna zosie panin Pasien tawlnga hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pien 2:2"},"5":{"text":"Tami mun ma-ah, “Ka tawlngahna ah amate a lut sih ding uhi,” cikia hi.","ref":"Late 95:11"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tua mun a lut ding mi pawlkhat om lai a, thuman lona hang tawh lungdamna thuhoi a za masate lut thei lo a,"},"7":{"text":"ama in, “Tuni-in ama’ aw na zah uleh na lungsim uh khausah sih un,” ci-in a kigen bangin tua zaw a sawtpi ciengin David tungtawnin ama in, “tuni” a kici nidang khat a sekia hi.","ref":"Late 95:7-8"},"8":{"text":"Azieh pen Joshua in amate tawlngahna a na pie zo hi leh Pasien in nidang khat thu a na nuagen nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:7; Josh 22:4"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien mite adingin sabbath tawlngahna khat a omlai hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen a nasepna panin Pasien a tawlngah bangin Pasien’ tawlngahna sunga a lut mite zong a nasepna panun a tawlnga ciet uhi.","ref":"Pien 2:2"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin tua banga amau’ thumanlona ziehin koima pua loin tua tawlngahna mun i lut thei nadingin i hi theina za tawh hanciem ciet vai."},"12":{"text":"Pasien’ thu nungta-in na sem thei a, a langni tuoha a hiem namsau sangin hiemzaw a, hlagau le lungsim, guletang kituonate le cintuigu dong phalsuo-in sun pailet thei hi; tua in lungtang’ ngaisutnate le tupnate zong theicien thei hi."},"13":{"text":"A mai-ah a kiselcip thei a kipiengsah na khat beh a om sih a, i thu tut nading pa mitmu ah na zosie a lie a dal om loin kilang sinsen hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin eite in vantungte kalin a pei pa, a lien siempu lien pa Pasien’ tapa Jesu i nei lang kalsie i pulah uh tua upna kiptahin tu ciet vai.","title":"Siempu Lienpen Pa Jesu"},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile i thanemnate-ah ei lainat thei lo siempu lien pa a nei i hi sih vua, tuale mahin eite ma bangin ze-etna namcin na thuoh ngai napi mawna a nei lo siempu lien khat a nei i hi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin eite in i kisap huna ei panpi dingin khuotuona nga-in hepina i mu thei nadingin hangsan tahin hepina topha nai ciet vai."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihingte lah panin a kiteel siempu lien poma pen amate tangin Pasien tawh a kisai silte tungah vaipuo ding le, letsongte le mawna zieha biehpiehnate pie ding ahi uhi."},"2":{"text":"Amama in thanemna na thuoh ngai zo ahi ziehin thu thei lote le a lungkhau mite lungnem tahin kem thei hi;"},"3":{"text":"tam thu ziehin ama in ama’ mawnate ading beh hi loin, mipite’ mawna ziehin zong biehpiehna a pieh ding kul hi.","ref":"Siem 9:7"},"4":{"text":"Koima in tua patawina ama thu-in nga thei lo a, Pasien in Aaron a hlat bang tehteha a hlat mite beh in nga thei hi.","ref":"Pei 28:1"},"5":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempu lien pa a suo thei nadingin Khris ama le ama a kipatawi sih a, ahi vangin ama kungah, “Nang ka Tapa na hi hi, tuni-in nang kang piengsah zo hi,” a ci pa in a sesa ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Late 2:7"},"6":{"text":"Mundang khatah zong ama in, “Melchizedek’ gui zui-in tawntung siempu na hi ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 110:4"},"7":{"text":"Cilesa tawh ama a op hun lai-in Jesu in sina panin a hunkhie thei pa tungah hlitui tawh thungetnate le thumnate nei-in nahpi-in kiko a, tuaci’n zatahna tawh ama’ ki-apnate Pasien in a za hi.","ref":"Mat 26:36-46; Mrk 14:32-42; Luk 22:39-46"},"8":{"text":"Ama Tapa khat ahi vangin a thuohna tungtawnin thumanna a sin hi;"},"9":{"text":"bukim tahin a kibawl zaw ciengin ama’ thu a mang mi zosie adingin kumtawn hutdamna’ nah suoh a,"},"10":{"text":"Melchizedek’ gui zui-in Pasien in siempu lien dingin a se zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami thu tawh kisai gen ding tampi i nei a, ahi vangin thu tel zo paipai lo na hi ziehun teltahin gen ding a hamsa hi.","title":"Pua Lo nading Hilkholna"},"12":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note tam bang hunah sie na suo ding uh hun ta napi Pasien thutah bulpite ang hil ding mi khat na kisam uhi. Antah hi nai loin nawizu na kisam uhi;"},"13":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile nawizu a hinpi na lai poma nausen hi lai ahi ziehin dihna thu a theisiem thei sih uhi.","ref":"1Cor 3:2"},"14":{"text":"Hizongle antah i ci pen sielepha khen nadingin a ngaisutnate uh zangin a kisinsa mi picingte ading ahi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Khris thu a kipat cilna thuhilna lelte nuasie vai-in, picinna lam manaw vai. Pasien upna lam le a sisa nasepnate panin kisiakiana lamah bulkip phut nawn loin,","title":"Pua Ding A Zauhuoina"},"2":{"text":"baptize-na tawh kisai thuhilna, khut ngahna, misite thawkiana le kumtawn thukhennate bulpat kiakia nawn sih vai."},"3":{"text":"Pasien in pha a sah leh tami i bawl ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khatvei khuovah in tanvahin vantung letsong a ciem ngaisa, Hlagau Siengtho sungah satanh nga zo a,"},"5":{"text":"ang tung ding khanghun vanglietnate le Pasien’ thu hoina a ciemsa mite"},"6":{"text":"a pua uleh, amate nopthu tawh Pasien’ tapa khailia kia-in simmaw thuoh dinga a pholah uh ahi ziehin amate adingin kisiakia-in a kipuophat ding uh pieng thei nawn lo hi."},"7":{"text":"A tunga a kie guotuite hupin angkung posah a, a hlote a phatuomsah leitang in Pasien tung panin thupha a sang hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua leitang in ling le khau a posah leh kimanna nei lo ahi a, samsiet thuoh bai ding ahi hi; a tawpna ah kihaltum ding hi.","ref":"Pien 3:17-18"},"9":{"text":"Kang itte aw, tam banga thu i gen vangin, no tawh a kisai hutdamna tawh kizomin sil hoizawte nomau-a’ ahi hi, ci-in ka lung a muong hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien a thutang lo ahi sih hi; ama in na nasepna uh, ama hang tawh misiengthote na vana ule na va lai dingte uh tungah itna na lahnate uh ang kitheimaw bawl sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Lametna bukim ang tun nadingin note khat ciet in a tawp tanpha-in tua banga hanciemna na lah ciet ding uh kang deisah hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n note pen mi thasiete suoh loin, upna le lungduoina tungtawnin kamciem a luote in a ette mite na suo zawh ding uh kang deisah hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien in Abraham tungah kamciem a pieh lai-in, ama sanga a lienzaw kiciem nading koima om lo ahi ziehin ama le ama kiciem a,","title":"A kicien Pasien’ Kamciem"},"14":{"text":"“Thupha kang pie tahtah ding a, kang pungsah ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pien 22:16-17"},"15":{"text":"Tua bangin Abraham in lungduoi tahin a thuoh zaw ciengin tua kamciem nga hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate sanga a lienzaw mi khat’ min tawh mihingte a kiciem vua, tua kiciemna in thu kigen pen kipsahin kithutuna zosie a vengsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ma bangin Pasien in a kamciem a luote tungah a kikhel ngai lo ama’ tupna thute a kicien zaw lai dingin a lah nuom ciengin, ama in kiciemna khat tawh a kipsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaci’n a kikhel thei lo thu nite tungtawnin Pasien in zuouthu a gen ding pen pieng thei lo a, tua pen ama a beel eite in i mai-a kikoi lametna i tuhkip nadingin nahpi tahin i kihanthot thei nading uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Eite in hlagau ading a kicien le a kip tembaw khina siakawi ahi tami upna i nei vua, tua upna in puondal nualam mun siengtho sungah a lut hi.","ref":"Siem 16:2"},"20":{"text":"Tua munah eite tangin lamsiel pa Jesu na lut zo a, Melchizedek’ gui zui-in tawntung siempu lien a suoh zo hi.","ref":"Late 110:4"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami Melchizedek kici pen Salem kumpipa, Sangpen Pasien’ siempu hi a, ama in kumpite a zawna panin ang kilekia Abraham na dawnin thupha a pie hi.","title":"Melchizedek Siempu Nam"},"2":{"text":"Abraham in zong ama tungah a neisa zosie sung panin sawm-ah-khat a pie hi. A masa penin a min a khietna, “Dihna kumpipa,” hi a, tua banah, ‘Kilemna kumpipa,’ a cina ahi, “Salem kumpipa,” zong ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 14:17-20"},"3":{"text":"Ama pen pa nei lo, nu nei lo, khanggui nei lo hi a, hinkhuo kipatna le tawpna zong nei loin, hizongle Pasien’ Tapa tawh kisunin kumtawn siempu-in a om den hi."},"4":{"text":"En un, ama bangza-a lien ahiei! Pupi Abraham nangawn in a galvan matte panin sawm-ah-khat ama na pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Siempu za a nga Levi suonlehlahte pen Abraham suonlehlahte ma hi napi, a sanggam a mipite kung panin sawm-ah-khat a kai nadingun thupiehna na nga uhi.","ref":"Gam 18:21"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate khanggui sungah a kihal lo tam pa in Abraham tung panin sawm-ah-khat na sang a, kamciemnate a nga pa zong thupha na pie lai hi."},"7":{"text":"A lienzaw pa in a neuzaw pa thupha a pieh pen niel thei ding hi lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Thu khatah a si thei mihingte in sawm-ah-khat sang uhi; a thudang khatah ama hing hi, ci-a teci panna a nga mi pa in tua sawm-ah-khat a sang hi."},"9":{"text":"Sawm-ah-khat a sang Levi mama nangawn in Abraham tungtawnin sawm-ah-khat pie hi, kici thei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen Melchizedek in Abraham a vaidot lai-in Levi pen a pupi’ taai sungah omlai hi."},"11":{"text":"Levi-te siempu hina tungtawnin kicinna kinga hileh- azieh pen mite in tami siempu hina nei-ah thukham a na nga uh ahi a- bang dingin Aaron gui zui ahi lo, Melchizedek gui zui siempu dang khat a pien ding kisam lai ding ahei?","title":"Melchizedek Tawh Kibang Siempu Dangkhat"},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen siempu hina a kikhel ciengin, a thukham zong a kikhel ding kisam hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in tam bang thute a kigenna pa pen maitam-a na a sem ngai lo minam dang sung pan ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile i Topa uh pen Judah minam sung pana ang pieng ahina kitel mama a, Moses in tua minam tawh kisai-in siempute thu bangma a gen sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Melchizedek tawh a kibang siempu dang khat ang pien ciengin tami thu ang kicien deudeu a,"},"16":{"text":"tua siempu ang suoh pa pen pumpi tawh kisai a kisam ngainate tungtawna ang suoh hi loin, a kisie thei lo hinna’ vanglietna tungtawna ang pei ahi bo hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile, “Nang in Melchizedek gui zui-in kumtawn siempu na hi hi,” ci-in ama thu teci a pang zo hi.","ref":"Late 110:4"},"18":{"text":"Thu khatah thupieh lui thanemin a kizah thei tah lo ziehin kituomkhin zo hi."},"19":{"text":"(Azieh pen thukham in bangma a bukimsah thei sih hi); thu dang khatah eite in Pasien kung i nai thei nadingin a hoizaw lametna khat ei kipie ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam pen kiciemna khat tawh kikipsah hi; bangzieh ahei cile siempu a suoh dangte in kiciemna lo tawh siempu za nga ahi uhi,"},"21":{"text":"ahi vangin ama kunga thugen mi khat in, “ Topa kiciem zo a, a lungsim a khel sih ding hi. ‘Nang, tawntung siempu na hi hi,’ ” na ci ahi ziehin siempu ang suoh ahi hi.","ref":"Late 110:4"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ma bangin Jesu zong a hoizaw thuciemna kipsah pa ang suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua teng banah sina in amate nasep zopsuoh ding khahtan ahi ziehin siempu masate pen tampi a pha uhi;"},"24":{"text":"ahi vangin ama hing zing ahi ziehin a siempu za zong a tukip den hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi dung zui-in ama tungtawnin Pasien a nai mite a thumpieh dingin hing zing ahi ziehin ama in a tawntungin a hundam thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a siengtho, paubanna a nei lo, a buabang lo, mawneite lah panin a kikoicing, vantungte tunga a kitawisang tua bang siempu lien pa khat nei ding pen a kilawm mama ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama pen siempu lien dangte tawh a kibang sih a, a masa-in ama mawna ading, tua zaw ciengin a mipite mawna adingin nisielin biehpiehna a pieh ding a kisam sih hi; ama in tami pen khatvei beh a bawlna tawh a kimang den dinga a sep ahi ta hi.","ref":"Siem 9:7"},"28":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thukham in siempu liente dingin a thanem mite se a, hizongle thukham nua-a ang pei kiciemna thu in ahile kumtawnin a bukim dinga kibawlsa Tapa a se hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in i gen nop bulpi pen tami ahi hi: Eite in vantunga Thupina kumpi topha zietlam-ah a to tua bang siempu lien khat i nei vua,","title":"A Hoizaw Thuciemna Palai","ref":"Late 110:1"},"2":{"text":"ama pen mihingte lamsa ahi lo, Topa in a lam puonbuh tahtah ahi siengtho muna a sem pa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile siempu lien zosie, letsongte le biehpiehnate pie dinga kisesa ahi hi; tua ahi ciengin tami siempu pa in zong a pieh ding sil khat a nei ding kisam hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham dung zui-in letsongte a pie ding siempute om ta ahi ziehin, tu-in ama leitunga om hi leh siempu ahi thei vawt sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in mun siengtho khat sungah biehna a lui vua, tua khu vantunga om thu’ a lim maimai le a hlim ahi lel bo hi; azieh pen puonbuh lam dinga Moses a kipat ciengin, “Muol tunga ang kilahsa lim bang tehtehin na zosie na bawl ding kithei gige in,” ci-in thu kipie hi.","ref":"Pei 25:40"},"6":{"text":"Hinanle tu-in Jesu in a thupizaw nasepna khat nga zo a, tua dinmun ah ama pen thuciemna tawh a kikipsahsa a thupizaw thuciemna’ palai ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thuciemna masa a khiel lo hi leh thuciemna nina pen sui a ngai sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien in amate mawsah nading mu-in ama in tam bangin a ci ciengin: “Israel innkuon le Judah innkuonte tawh thuciemna tha ka phu ding ni ang tung valon ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt gam panin amate peipi dinga a pu a pate uh ka khut tawh ka kai lai-a, amate tawh ka bawlsa thuciemna bang ahi sih ding hi; azieh pen amate in ka thuciemna a zop sih vua, tuaci’n ken zong amate ka thudon sih hi, Topa in a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tami in Israel innkuon tawh, tua hun zaw cienga ka bawl ding ka thuciemna ahi hi. A lungsim sung vuah ka thukhamte ka guong ding a, a lungtang tung vuah tuate gielin, amau’ Pasien ka hi ding a, amate zong khu keima mi ahi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in, ‘ Topa thei in,’ ci-in khatlekhat kihil loin, khatlekhat a kici sih ding hi. Azieh pen amate zosie in a neu pen pan a gol pen dongin keima ei thei ta ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen keima in a khielnate vuah ka khuotuo ding a, keima in a mawnate uh ka phawhkha ta sih ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31-34"},"13":{"text":"A ma in, “Thuciemna tha khat,” a gen ciengin a masa pen a tul a suohsah zo hi. Tua a tulsa le a lui pen a sawt lo-a maimang ding ahi ta hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuciemna masa pen nangawn in biehna-a zah ding ngainate le leitung mun siengtho zong a nei hi.","title":"Leitung le Vantung Mun Siengthote"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen puonbuh khat kilam a, a dan masa pen sungah meivah tunna, sabuoi, le Ompina khomun om a, tua pen Siengtho Mun kici hi.","ref":"Pei 26:1-30; 25:31-40; 25:23-30"},"3":{"text":"Puonkhai a nina nualam ah Siengtho Pen a kici puonbuh khat a om hi.","ref":"Pei 26:31-33"},"4":{"text":"Tua sungah kham tawh a kibawl panamtui hal nading maitam le a kimvel zosie-ah kham tawh a kizut thuciemna singkuong kitung a, tua sungah mana koina kham beel, Aaron ciengkhut meng le thuciemna suongpehte a om hi;","ref":"Pei 30:1-6; 25:10-16; 16:33; Gam 17:8-10; Pei 25:16; Thkna 10:3-5"},"5":{"text":"tua tungah minthanna Cherub-te in hepina topha a liesuh uhi. Tu-in tami thute a neng a nawi-in i gen sieng thei sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam bangin kithawi kholnate a kibawl zaw ciengin, amau’ nasep ngai teng sem dingin puonbuh a dan masa sungah siempute a lut ngitnget uhi.","ref":"Gam 18:2-6"},"7":{"text":"Hinanle a dan nina sungah siempu lien pa kum khatin khatvei beh lut a, thei lona ziehin amama ading le mite mawna adingin sisan tawi-in biehna a pie hi.","ref":"Siem 16:2-34"},"8":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin puonbuh a dan masa pen a om laisie, mun siengtho lut nading lampi kihong nai lo hi, ci thu Hlagau Siengtho in ei lah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami in tuhun ading etsahna lim hi a, letsongte le biehpiehnate a pieh hun sungun a bie mite’ kitheina lungsim a bukimsah thei sih a,"},"10":{"text":"tuate pen neh le dawn le baptize-na tuomtuomte, le pumpi tawh kisai ngainate beh hi lel a, puophat hun a tun masangsie zui dingte ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin ang tungsa sil hoite a sem ding siempu lien ahi Khris ang tun ciengin, (khut tawh a kibawl lo, tami a kisiemsa nate ahi lo,) a lienzaw le a bukim puonbuh tungtawnin,"},"12":{"text":"keel le bawngno sisante ahi lo, ama’ sisan tawh a kimang den dingin siengtho munah khatvei beh lut a, tua bangin ama in eite kumtawn tatkhietna ei ngasah hi."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen a bua mite tunga a kithe ahi keel si, bawngtang site, le bawnglaa halna vutte in a tahsa uh siengthosah ahile,","ref":"Siem 16:15-16; Gam 19:9, 17-19"},"14":{"text":"kumtawn Hlagau tungtawnin paubanna a nei lo, Pasien tunga ama le ama a kipie Khris’ sisan in a si nasepna panin a hingzing Pasien i bieh thei nadingin eite’ sielepha theina lungsim bangza tahin siengthosah zawkan lai ding ahei?"},"15":{"text":"Tam thu zieh ma-in ama in thuciemna masa nei-a a tawnkhielnate panun amate a tat nadingin sina thuoh zo a hi ziehin, a kihlante in a kikamciemsa tawntung gou a luo thei nadingun, ama pen thuciemna tha palai ang hi ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Sinua gamhluona lai bawlna-ah, tua lai bawlpa a sina thu kipsah phot kul hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tua gamhluona lai a bawlpa a hin laisie tuami lai in thu nei thei lo a, ama a si cieng behin tua gamhluona lai kizang thei pan hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin thuciemna masa nangawn zong sisan loin kizang thei lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen thukham dung zui-in Moses in mi zosie tungah thupiehna vannuoi a gen lai-in, tui tawh bawngno’ si, keelte’ si la-in samul puon dupsan, hyssop sungah die-in tuate tawh laiziel le mipi zosie the a,"},"20":{"text":"“Tam pen Pasien in note adinga a sesa thuciemna sisan ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pei 24:6-8"},"21":{"text":"Tua ma bangin ama in puonbuh le biehpiehna sunga a om vanzahte zosie zong sisan the hi.","ref":"Siem 8:15"},"22":{"text":"A tahtahin thukham khut nei-ah na zosie a unpi phielin sisan tawh kisiengsah a, si kibuo loin maw maisahna a om sih hi.","ref":"Siem 17:11"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin vantung nate’ lim maimaite pen tam bang bawldan ngainate tawh siensuo ding kisam a, ahi vangin vantung nate ahile tamte sanga a hoizaw biehpiehnate tawh siensuo ding kisam hi.","title":"Khris’ Biehpiehna in Mawna Lakhie"},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen Khris in a tahtah tawh a kisun maimai, khut tawh a kibawl siengtho pen munah lut zaw loin, Pasien mai-ah eite tanga kilah dingin tu-in vantungah a va lut ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Siempu lien pa in ama’ sisan ahi lo ganhing sisan tawh siengtho pen munah kumsiela a lut bangin Khris in ama le ama kum siela a kipieh kiakia ding kisam lo hi;"},"26":{"text":"kisam hi leh leitung piencil a kipanin tamveipi si zo ding hi. Ahi vangin khang tawpna-ah mawnate a pai dawh dingin ama le ama biehpiehna-in ang kizang a, a tawntung adingin khatvei ang kilang zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihingte adingin ahile khatvei si ding pen sesa ahi a, tua zaw ciengin thukhenna a om ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaci’n mi tampite mawna a puo dingin Khris in khatvei kipie zo a, mawna tawh kisai hi nawn loin, ama lam-enin a ngah mite hunkhie dingin a niveina ang kilah ding hi.","ref":"Isa 53:12"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thukham pen ang tung ding sil hoite’ hlim beh hi a, a tahtahte’ melpuoh mantah hi loin, kum khat zaw kum khat a kipie kiakia a kibang veve biehpiehnate ziehin tuami in ama a nai mite picingsah zo ngai lo hi.","title":"A Kimang Den Ding Khris’ Biehpiehna"},"2":{"text":"Picingsah thei hi leh a bie mite khatvei beh tawh a kimang den dingin a kisienthosah zo lang kalsie, mawna ziehin kisuonna kici poma nei nawn lo ding ahi ziehun biehna pieh ding a khawl ta sih ding uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Hinanle tami biehpiehnate a kipieh sielin a kum kumin mite’ mawna a kiphawsah kiakia ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen bawngtang’ sisan le keel’ sisan in mawna a lakhie mang thei sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin leitungah Khris ang pei lai-in ama in, “Biehpiehnate le silpiehte na deigaw sih a, ahi vangin kei adingin pumpi khat nei bawlpieh zo hi;"},"6":{"text":"meihal biehnate le mawna silpiehte ah nang na lungkim zo sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in, (laiziel sungah keima’ thu a kigiel bangin) ‘Pasien, en in, na deina bang bawl dingin keima kang pei hi, Pasien aw,’ ka ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 40:6-8"},"8":{"text":"A tung lamah ama in, “Biehpiehnate, silpiehte a kipanin meihal biehnate le mawna zieha silpiehte na lunggul sih a, tuate-ah zong na lungkim tuon sih hi,” a ci ciengin, (tamte thukham dung zui-a kipie ahi a)"},"9":{"text":"tua ciengin ama in, “Na dei bang a sem dingin kang pei zo ta hi,” a cibe kia hi. Ama in a nina pen a kipsah thei nadingin a masa pen a phietmang hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien’ deina bangin a kimang den dingin Jesu Khris’ pumpi khatvei beh a kipiehna tungtawnin eite ei kisiensuo zo ahi ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaci’n siempu kici poma in a nasepna ah ni khat zaw ni khat adingin, mawnate a ladawh thei lo, a kibang biehpiehnate ma a pie ngitnget uhi.","ref":"Pei 29:38"},"12":{"text":"Ahi vangin Khris in mawna adingin a kimang den ding biehpiehna khat ngentang a pieh zaw ciengin Pasien’ zietlamah to a,"},"13":{"text":"khum huna kipanin ama in a galte a keng ngahna a suosah dongin a ngah hi.","ref":"Late 110:1"},"14":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a kisiengtho sahsa mite khatvei lien biehna tawh kumtawn adingin a bukimsah zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Hlagau siengtho in zong eite tungah tami thu teci pang a,"},"16":{"text":"“ Topa in tam bangin ci hi: Tua nite zaw ciengin amate tawh thuciem ka bawl ding a, a lungtang sung vuah ka thukhamte koi-in, a lungsim sung vuah ka giel ding hi,” a ci zaw ciengin,","ref":"Jer 31:33"},"17":{"text":"ama in zong, “Keima in a mawnate ule thukham palsat-a a gamtatnate uh ka phawh nawn sih ding hi,” ci-in genbe lai hi.","ref":"Jer 31:34"},"18":{"text":"Tamte a kimaisahna munah mawna hanga biehnate om nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka lawmte aw, eite in Jesu’ sisan ziehin mun siengtho lut nading kimuonna i nei lang kalsie,","title":"Thuoh Kenkon nadinga Cielna"},"20":{"text":"tua puonkhai tungtawnin (ama’ tahsa tungtawnin a ci na ahi hi) eite adingin hinna lampi tha ei honpieh a,"},"21":{"text":"eite in zong Pasien innkuon tungah a vaihawm siempu lien khat i nei ziehin,"},"22":{"text":"sielepha i theina uh lungsim dih lo panin i lungtangte tui tawh thesiengsa le i pumpite tui siengtho tawh sawpsiengsa-in, a kicien upna bukim le lungsim mantah tawh ama kung zuon ciet vai.","ref":"Siem 8:30; Ezk 36:25"},"23":{"text":"Ei kamciem pa pen muonhuoi ahi ziehin lungkaa loin i lametna uh i pulahna thu tudet vai."},"24":{"text":"Eite khatlekhat itna le gamtat hoina lamah i kithanopsuo thei nadingin ngaisun ciet vai."},"25":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte kingainase bang hi loin kikhop ding thu nelsie sih vai. Topa’ Ni ang naina thu na thei ma bangun note khatlekhat na kihanthawn un."},"26":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile thuman thutah thei-in i san zaw ciengin thei giagua pi ma-in mawna i bawl leh tua mawnate mai thei nading biehpiehna om nawn lo a,"},"27":{"text":"ahi vangin a zauhuoi thukhenna le a langpangte a katum ding thangpaina meikuong beh omlai hi.","ref":"Isa 26:11"},"28":{"text":"Mosies thukham a palsat mi poma teci ni ahi sihle thum a op nah leh hepina om loin a si hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahile Pasien’ Tapa simmaw bawlin, amate a siengthosah kiciemna sisan buasahin, hepina Hlagau a lungthahsah mite in bangza taha a nasie zaw gimna dan a thuoh dingin kilawm na sa uh ahei?","ref":"Pei 24:8"},"30":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile eite in, “Phulahna keima-a’ ahi a, keima in ka thuhkia ding hi,” a ci pa le, “ Topa in a mite tungah thu a khen ding hi,” a ci pa i thei uhi.","ref":"Thkna 32:35-36"},"31":{"text":"A hingzing Pasien khut sunga i pua khah ding uh zauhuoi mama hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in khuovah na nga zaw ciengun gentheina thuohin hamsa taha buoina na thuoh lai hun luite phawh kia unlen,"},"33":{"text":"khat veivei mipi mai-ah zakona le hamsatna thuohin, khat veivei lah tua banga a kibawlsie mite na thuohpi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Azieh pen note in thongkie mite na khuotuo vua, a hoizaw le a kipzaw neisa khat nei na hi lam uh na kithei ziehun, na neisate uh ang kilahpieh zongun lungdam tahin na sang uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin thaman lienpi ang ngasah ding na lungmuonna uh nuasie sih un."},"36":{"text":"Azieh pen note in Pasien’ deina semin ang kikamciemsa thu na nga thei nadingun thuohzawhna na kisam uhi."},"37":{"text":"Azieh pen,” Bakhat sunga ang pei ding pa ang tung ding a, ang kiheh nawn sih ding hi;"},"38":{"text":"hinanle ka midih in upna tawh nungta ding hi. A kinuale poma tungah ka lungkim lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Hab 2:3-4"},"39":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite i hi ule nuatolin a kisie mite lahah i kihal sih vua, upna nei-in gupna a ngasa mite lahah i kihal zaw uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in upna i ci in i lametnate-ah lungmuonna hi a, i mu nai lo thute theicien na ahi hi.","title":"Upna a Khietna"},"2":{"text":"A tahtahin upna ziehin i pu i pate in patahna a na nga uhi."},"3":{"text":"Eite in i mu thei nate pen i mu thei lo nate pana kibawl hi lo a, Pasien’ kammal tawh leitungte a kisiem ahi hi, ci thu upna tawh i theithei hi.","ref":"Pien 1:1; Late 33:6, 9; Jhn 1:3"},"4":{"text":"Upna ziehin Abel in Pasien kungah Cain-a’ sangin a sanhuoi zaw biehpiehna a pie hi. Tam tungtawnin ama midih ahi hi, ci patatna nga a, Pasien mama in ama’ silpiehte a thukimpi hi; ama a si zo vangin ama’ upna tungtawnin thu ei gengen lai hi.","title":"Ette ding Abel, Enoch, le Noah","ref":"Pien 4:3-10"},"5":{"text":"Enoch in sina a thuoh lo nadingin upna tawh ama kilato hi; tuale, “Pasien in ama lato zo ahi ziehin ama a kimu nawn sih hi. Ama a kilahto masangin, “Ama in Pasien lungkimsah zo hi, ci-in teci kipang hi.","ref":"Pien 5:21-24"},"6":{"text":"Upna lo tawh Pasien kilungkimsah zo lo hi, azieh pen Pasien a nai poma in ama om tahpi hi, ci thu le ama a suite thaman pie hi, ci thu pen a up ding ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Upna ziehin a kimu nai lo thupiengte tawh Noah in Pasien’ thuhilna na mang a, a innkuonpite a hotkhiet thei nadingin tembawpi khat na bawl hi; tuami tawh ama in leitung mawsah a, tuale upna dung zui-a kinga dihna’ gou luopa a suoh hi.","ref":"Pien 6:13-22"},"8":{"text":"Upna tawh a gouluo nga nadinga a kiciemna mun pei dingin Abraham a kihlat lai-in, a pei nading mun nangawn thei lo napi, thumangin upna tawh a pei hi.","title":"Abraham’ Upna","ref":"Pien 12:1-5"},"9":{"text":"A kikamciemna gamah upna tawh bakhat sung teng a, ama tawh kibanga kamciem a luopi ding Isaac le Jacob-te tawh pemta bangin gamdang puonbuh sungah a teng hi.","ref":"Pien 35:27"},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ama in a gelpa le a lampa Pasien ahi bulkip nei khuopi a lamen hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama vuoi mama tale upna tawh nau nei theina thu nga hi, Sarah mama zong a ciing hi tama le upna tawh kamciem a pie pa muonhuoi sa ahi ziehin nau nei theina thu nga hi.","ref":"Pien 18:11-14; 21:2"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a si tawh a kibang mi khat panin vana aasi za-a a tam, simzawh lo-a a tam tuipi pieu-a senel bangin suonlehlahte a pieng hi.","ref":"Pien 15:5; 22:17; 32:12"},"13":{"text":"Tam mite zosie in a kikamciemsa gam nga lo-in, upna sungah a na si vua, hizongle a gamlapi panin amate galmu-in a na hopi uhi. Leitungah gamdang mi le peemta ahi lam uh a kithei uhi,","ref":"Pien 23:4; 1Khg 29:15; Late 39:12"},"14":{"text":"azieh pen tua banga thu gen mite in a ten nading uh gam khat sui ahi lam uh a kilangsah uhi."},"15":{"text":"A nuasiesa uh gam a ngaisun kia uh hi leh a kilekia nading uh hun lemtang nei zo tham ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanle amate in a hoizaw gam ahi tua vantung gam a na lunggul uhi. Tua ahi ziehin Pasien in amau’ Pasien a kici ding a na maizumpi vawt sih hi; a tahtahin ama in amate adingin khuopi khat bawl kholpieh zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ze-etna a thuoh ciengin Abraham in upna tawh Isaac a pie hi. Kamciem a nga pa in a tapa neisun pie dingin kithawi a,","ref":"Pien 22:1-14"},"18":{"text":"ama tung ma-ah, “Isaac tungtawnin nang adingin na suonlehlahte’ min kivaw ding hi,” ci-in kigen zo hi.","ref":"Pien 21:12"},"19":{"text":"Pasien in misite lah pan nangawnin mi khatpo thokiasah thei hi, ci-in ama in ngaisun a, tekahna-in gen leih ama in Isaac a ngakia hi."},"20":{"text":"Upna ziehin Isaac in mailam hun adingin Jacob le Esau tungah thupha pie hi.","ref":"Pien 27:27-29, 39-40"},"21":{"text":"Upna ziehin Jacob in a si kuonin Joseph’ tate tungah thupha pie a, a ciengkhut dawnah kunin a na bie hi.","ref":"Pien 47:31–48:20"},"22":{"text":"Joseph in upna tawh a si kuonin Egypt gam panin Israel-te peikhiet ding thu na gen a, ama in ama’ kivui ding thu zong na vaihlah hi.","ref":"Pien 50:24-25; Pei 13:19"},"23":{"text":"Upna ziehin a nu le a pate in Moses hla thum sung phuol uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile amate in tua nausen a mel hoi lam a mu vua, kumpipa’ thupiehna giing loin upna tawh hla thum sung a phuol uhi.","title":"Moses’ Upna","ref":"Pei 2:2; 1:22"},"24":{"text":"Moses a gol ciengin Pharoah tanu’ tapa a kici ding nuom loin,","ref":"Pei 2:10-12"},"25":{"text":"mawna sungah bakhat sung nopsah ding sangin Pasien’ mite tawh bawlsietna thuohton ding a teelzaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in mailam huna ama’ thaman ding mituhin a nei ziehin ama in Egypt’ neilelam teng sangin Khris adingin simmaw zako a thuohna pen a thupi zaw-in ngaisun hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in upna hang tawh kumpipa’ lungthah ding giing loin, Egypt gam na nuasie hi; azieh pen mu thei lo pa a mu bang danin ama in a thuoh kenkon hi.","ref":"Pei 2:10-12"},"28":{"text":"Ta masa a susie pa in Israel-te’ tapa ta pen a suhkhah lo nadingin ama in upna tawh Peisan Pawi bawlin sisan a the hi.","ref":"Pei 12:21-30"},"29":{"text":"Mite in upna tawh leigaw tunga lampei bangin San Tuipi a kantan uhi, ahi vangin Egypt-te in tua bang a bawl sawm ciengun tui in amate a taimang sieng hi.","title":"Adang Israel Galhangte’ Upna","ref":"Pei 14:21-31"},"30":{"text":"Amate in ni sagi sung upna tawh a kimvel zaw uh ciengin Jericho kulpi cimmang hi.","ref":"Josh 6:12-21"},"31":{"text":"Numei pahtat nu Rahab in upna tawh thukante hoi tahin zin a na do ziehin, thumang lo mite tawh ama kisieton lo hi.","ref":"Josh 6:22-25; 2:1-21"},"32":{"text":"Tua ahile bang i genbe lai ding vuoi? Azieh pen Gideon, Barak, Samson, Zephthah, David, Samuel-te a kipanin kamsangte tungtang thu gen nading hun kicing lo hi.","ref":"Thkn 6:11–8:32; 4:6–5:31; 13:2–16:31; 11:1–12:7; 1Sam 16:1–1Kum 2:11; 1Sam 1:1–25:1"},"33":{"text":"Upna tungtawnin amate in kumpi gamte na zo gawpin, thutang tawh gam a na uh vua, kamciemte nga-in humpinelkai’ kam na hucip uhi.","ref":"Dan 6:1-27"},"34":{"text":"Meikuongpi mit sahin, namsau’ ma panin na suohta vua, thanemna panin thakhauna nga kia-in, galdona-ah vang a na nei vua, gamdang galkapte a na delmang uhi.","ref":"Dan 3:1-30"},"35":{"text":"Nupite in thawkiana tawh a misite a ngakia uhi. Adangte in a hoizaw thawkiana a nga thei nadingun a kihla ding nuom loin bawlsietna a thuoh uhi.","ref":"1Kum 17:17-24; 2Kum 4:25-37"},"36":{"text":"Adangte in ahile simmawna le satna a thuoh vua, siakhau tawh kikhi-in thongkiehna nangawn a thuoh uhi.","ref":"1Kum 22:26-27; 2Khg 18:25-26; Jer 20:2; 37:15; 38:6"},"37":{"text":"Suong tawh amate kisepin, sing-at tawh kituntan a, namsau tawh kithat hi; amate in tuuvun po le keelvun po silin, bangma nei loin a na vahvai vua, bawlsietna le khelbawlna na thuoh uhi.","ref":"2Khg 24:21"},"38":{"text":"Amate adingin leitung a kilawm nawn sih a, senel gam muoltung lah, leihawm lah le suonghawm sung lah po-ah a vah kawikawi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tam mite zosie in a upna ziehun phatna a na nga vangun a kikamciemsa thute a nga tuom sih uhi."},"40":{"text":"Pasien in eite adingin a hoizaw na khat ei pie zo ahi ciengin eite lo tawh amate a bukim thei tuon sih uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin i kimkot-ah taza taha a tam teci meiilomte in ei tuomcip lang kalsie, vangih zosie le ei gahcip mawnate hemkhie-in i masang vua kikoi tai kidemna-ah thuohzawhna tawh tai ciet vai.","title":"Ette ding Jesu"},"2":{"text":"I upna a piengsah pa le a bukimsah pa, ama mai-a kikoi lungdamna ziehin zumna khawh a sa lo, singlamte tungah gimna thuohin Pasien’ topha zietlamah a to Jesu mittuhna’n nei vai."},"3":{"text":"Note lungkie-in na thanem lo nadingun mawnei mite’ huotbawlna a thuoh pa ngaisun un."},"4":{"text":"Mawna tawh na kidona vuah note in sisan luonna za cieng dongin na do nai sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Note in tapate bangin hing hopi-in ang hanthotnate na mangngil ta vua, “Ka ta aw, Topa ang thuhilna zangkhai ngaisut sinlen, dan ang pieh ciengin zong lungkie sin."},"6":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile Topa in a it mite thuhil a, ama in a san a tate zosie a sat hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Job 5:17; Pau 3:11-12"},"7":{"text":"Thu ang kihil nadingin gimnate thuoh un. Pasien in tate banga ang bawl uh ahi hi; azieh pen nu le pate’ thu hil lo tapa khu bangci ta ahi ahei?"},"8":{"text":"Tate zosie in a na tuo uh thuhilna na thuoh khah sih vua ahile ta tahtah hi loin zawlta na hi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua tham loin, eite in thu ei hil ding leitung pate i nei vua, amate i zatah uhi. Eite in hlagaute’ Pa thu mangin i hingzaw sam sih ding uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen leitunga i pate in bano khat sung adingin hoi a sah pen bangun thu ei hil vua, hinanle Pasien in ama’ siengthona i nga thei nading ule eite hoi nadingin thu ei hil hi."},"11":{"text":"Ei kithuhil laitahin nuom kisa loin na kisa mama a, hizongle tua tawh a kisinsa mite in a nua lam ciengin lungmuonna tawh kipawl dihna ga a ga uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a zaw na khutte uh lamto unlen, a thanem na khupte uh khausah un.","ref":"Isa 35:3"},"13":{"text":"Khelbaite kilawi loin a dam sieng thei nadingin na keng vua dingin lamphei siel un.","ref":"Pau 4:26"},"14":{"text":"Mi zosie tawh kilem ding le siengtho ding lam na del un, bangzieh ahei cile siengthona lo tawh koima in Topa a mu sih ding hi.","title":"Pasien’ Hepina Niel Lo ding Hilkholna"},"15":{"text":"Pasien’ hepina nga loin koima a op lo nading le, sing zungkha po in buoina piengsah a, tua hangin mi tampi a bua lo nadingin pilvang un.","ref":"Thkna 29:18"},"16":{"text":"Numei-pasal pahtatna a bawlte, an kam khat tawh innluoza a khawng, le a Pasien mi lo Isau bang koima a op lo nadingin pilvang un.","ref":"Pien 25:29-34"},"17":{"text":"A nua lam ciengin Esau in thupha ngakia nuomin hlitui naptui tawh a suisui vangin kisiakia nading hunpha mu nawn lo ahi ziehin ama kiniel ta hi, ci thu na thei uhi.","ref":"Pien 27:30-40"},"18":{"text":"A kitham thei, meikuong, khuomiel, lungzinna le huipi,"},"19":{"text":"pengkul ging, le tua awging a zate in amate tungah tua bang thu a kigenkia lo nadinga a thum vawtna uh mun khat a tung na hi sih uhi.","ref":"Pei 19:16-22; 20:18-21; Thkna 4:11-12; 5:22-27"},"20":{"text":"(Azieh pen amate in, “Ganhing khat nangawn in tua muolpi a suhkhah leh suong tawh kiseplia ding hi,” ci-a thu kipie pen a thuoh zo sih uhi.","ref":"Pei 19:12-13"},"21":{"text":"A tahtahin, tua a mu pen khu a cizathuoi seng ziehin Moses in, “Zau-in ka ci tun hi,” na ci hi.)","ref":"Thkna 9:19"},"22":{"text":"Ahi vangin note pen Zion muol, a hingzing Pasien’ khuopi ahi vantung Jerusalem, simzawh lo pawibawl vantung mite kisuhtuona,"},"23":{"text":"vantunga min kikhumsa tapa a ta pente kikhopna mun, mi zosie thu a khen Pasien kung, le a kipicingsah midihte’ hlagau opna,"},"24":{"text":"thuciemna tha’ palai ahi Jesu kung le Abel’ sisan sanga thu hoizaw a gen sisan kithena mun na tung zo ta uhi.","ref":"Pien 4:10"},"25":{"text":"Tua thu ang gen pa na niel khah lo nadingun pilvang un; azieh pen leitungah amate in thu hilkhol pa a niel ciengin amate suohta zo lo uh ahile, eite in vantung pana thu ei hil pa niel leih bangza tahin suohta la kan zaw lai ding i hi uh ahei!","ref":"Pei 20:22"},"26":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in ama’ awging in leitung kithingsah a, ahi vangin tu-in ama in, “Leitung beh kithingsah loin, vantung zong khatvei ka kithingsah ding hi,” ci-in ei kamciem zo hi.","ref":"Hag 2:6"},"27":{"text":"Tami, “Khatvei tawh” a ci kamteng in a kipiengsah nate ahi a kilawh thei zosie a kipaimang nading le a kilawh thei lote a op suoh thei nading thu a kawh ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin eite in a kilawh zo lo kumpi gam nga zo i hi ziehin i kipah ding vua, tuaci’n eite in zatahna le zauna tawh Pasien tungah san thei biehna i lui ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Azieh pen eite’ Pasien in a haltum thei meikuong ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatlekhat na ki-itna uh kipsuoh taheh.","title":"Pasien a Lungdamsah Nasep"},"2":{"text":"Khuol mite zin do ding thusim loin om sih un, azieh pen tua bang zindona-ah pawlkhatte in thei khah loin vantung mite zin do ahi gige uhi.","ref":"Pien 18:1-8; 19:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Amate tawh thongkieton bangin kingaisun unlen, thong sunga om mite phawh un; note mama zong bawlsietna a thuoh na hi ziehun bawlsiet na a thuoh mite na phawh un."},"4":{"text":"Mi zosie in kiten kipina thupisah hinlen, nupa lupna zong buasah sih uheh; azieh pen numei-pasal mawna a bawlte le angkawmte tungah Pasien in thu a khen ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Sum deigawna panin na hinkhuo uh kemcing unlen na nei bangbang utawh lungkim un; azieh pen ama in, “Ke’n nang kang nuasie ngai sih ding a, zong kang taisan ngai sih ding hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:6, 8; Josh 1:5"},"6":{"text":"Tuaci’n eite in kimuonna tawh, “ Topa pen ei panpi pa ahi hi; ka zau sih ding hi. Mite in bang ei law zo ding ahei?” i ci ngam uhi.","ref":"Late 118:6"},"7":{"text":"Note tungah Pasien’ thu ang gen na lamkaite phawh zing un; amau’ luhinzie pana ang pieng thute ngaisunin a upna uh ette un."},"8":{"text":"Jesu Khris pen zani, tuni le a tawntungin kibang den hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuhilna lamdang tuomtuomte in na kipuimangsah sih un; bangzieh ahei cile a zui mite dinga phatuomna a om lo anneh tuidawn tawh kisai ngainate hang tawh hi loin, hepina hanga lungsim khau pen a hoi ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Puonbuh sunga nasemte in a neh thei lo maitam khat eite in i nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen mawhna zieha biehpiehna dingin siempu lien pa in siengtho muna a peipi sisan kilahna tua ganhingte’ pumpi pen giephuol pulamah kihaltum hi.","ref":"Siem 16:27"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Jesu in ama’ sisan tawh mite a sienthosah nadingin khuopi kot pulamah sina a thuoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin eite zong giephuol pulamah pei-in, ama thuoh maizumna thuoh vai."},"14":{"text":"Azieh pen tami munah a kip khuopi i nei sih vua, eite in ang tung ding khuopi i suizaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin ama tungtawnin eite in Pasien tungah phatna biehpiehna tatsat loin pie vai. Tua khu ama’ min i pulahna i kamte’ ga ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Sil hoi bawl ding le na neisate uh mi hop ding kitheimaw bawl sih un, bangzieh ahei cile tam bang biehpiehnate in Pasien a lungdamsah mama hi."},"17":{"text":"Na lamkaite uh’ thu na mang unlen, amate tungah na ki-ap un, azieh pen amate ahile na hlagau ang vilpieh ahi vua, a nasepnate uh Pasien kunga a pulah ding uh ahi hi. Tami pen lunggimna tawh semsah sih unlen, lungdamna tawh semsah zaw un. Bangzieh ahei cile tua bang hi loin, da pipi-a a sep ciengun note adingin phattuomna a om sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ko adingin thu ei nget pieh un; bangzieh ahei cile kote in sil zosie-ah patawi huoi taha sep ding ka dei vua, tuaci’n ko le ko kitheina lungsim siengtho ka nei lam uzong ka theicien uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na kung vuah a sawt lo-a kang pei baikia thei nadingin tua banga thu nei ngetpieh dingun kang thum hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumtawn thuciemna sisan ziehin tuucing lien pa, sina panin i Topa Jesu a thokiasah pa, kilemna Pasien in,","title":"Thupha Piehna"},"21":{"text":"ama’ deina banga na sep thei nadingun sil hoi bangkim ah ang bucingsah pa, Jesu Khris tungtawnin eite lahah ama’ lungkimna banga na a sem ama tungah a tawntungin minthanna om den taheh. Amen."},"22":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na kung vuah tomkimin lai hing hlah zo ka hi ziein, kang hanthotnate nei thuoh kenkon dingun kang thum hi.","title":"A Tawpna Hanthotna le Hopinate"},"23":{"text":"I sanggam pa Timothy kihla zo ta hi, ci thu na thei un; a hunlapin ama ang tun khah leh note tawh i kimu ciengin ama tawh zong kang haw ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na makaite zosie ule misiengthote zosie ei na noset pieh in. Italy gam pana ang hawte in zong ang noset uhi."},"25":{"text":"Note zosie tawh hepina hing om taheh."}}}}},"59":{"info":{"name":"James","shortname":"Jas","abbr":[],"desc":"James tung pan laihlah (the letter from james)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien le Topa Jesu Khris’ nasem khat ahi keima James in, a kithethang Judah minam sawm le nite: kang hopi uhi.","title":"Hopina","ref":"Mat 13:55; Mrk 6:3; Sawl 15:13; Gal 1:19"},"2":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, thuhahsa nam khatpopo na tuo sielun bangma-in sim sih unlen, kipahna-in tuot zaw un,","title":"Upna le Pilna"},"3":{"text":"azieh pen na upna uh ang kisittelna in thuohzawhna a piengsah hi, ci na thei uhi;"},"4":{"text":"bangma lawsapna nei loin, a picing le a cingtah na suo thei nadingun thuohzawhna in a bukimin semsah suoh un."},"5":{"text":"Note lahah mi khatpo in pilna a kitasap leh koima hosie loin mi zosie tungah vau taha a pie Pasien kungah ngen heh, tua hile kipie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin ama in lunghei nei loin upna tawh ngen taheh, bangzieh ahei cile lunghei nei mite pen hui in a mut cienga a kilawh kawikawi tuihuol tawh kibang hi;"},"7":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile lunghei nei mi, sepna bangkimah a lungkaa mi le lungkip a nei lo mipa in Topa kung panin na khatpo a nga dingin kilamen vet sih heh.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"A neilut thu um mi pa a kitawisang ziehin kisathei heh.","title":"Zawnna le Hauna"},"10":{"text":"Mihaute a kiniemkhieh suh ciengin lungdam lel uheh, bangzieh ahei cile mihaute zong gamlah paape bangin a mangthai ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen a satna tawh ni ang suo ciengin leitang gawtasah hi; a paate pulin a mel hoina teng a tulmang hi; mihaute zong tua bang ma ahi uhi; amate sumbawlin a kitala laitahun a vulmang ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 40:6-7"},"12":{"text":"Ze-etna a thuoh zo mi poma mi hampha ahi hi. Tua bang mipa in ze-etna a thuoh zaw ciengin Topa in ama a it mite tungah a na kamciemsa hinna lukhu a nga ding hi.","title":"Thuhahsa le Ze-etna"},"13":{"text":"Mi khat a kize-et ciengin, “Pasien in kei ei ze-et hi,” ci sih heh; azieh pen gitlona tawh Pasien kize-et thei lo a, amama in koima a ze-et sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin mi khat’ lunggulna in ama zawlin a kai ciengin ze-etna a thuoh ahi bo hi;"},"15":{"text":"tua ciengin tua lunggulna gai-in mawna piengsah a, tua mawna ang khangliet ciengin sina a piengsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka itte aw, mite solin om sih un."},"17":{"text":"Deisahna tawh piehkhietna nasep vannuoi le a bukim letsong vannuoi pen tunglam pana ang pei ahi a, kikhelna nei loin ni hlim kihei bangin a kihei kawikawi lo khuovahte’ Pa kung pana ang kumsuh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama’ piensahte lahah ga masa pente i suo thei nading le ama’ lungtup a tangtun thei nadingin thuman thutah tawh ei piengsah zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka itte aw, tami thu thei ta un: A koimapo thungai ding mallang hinlen, kamham ding ahi a, lungthah ding ahi zongin kiheh heh;","title":"Zahna le Sepna"},"20":{"text":"azieh pen note’ lungthahna in Pasien’ dihtatna a piengsah sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin a kidahhuoi gamtatna zosie le a valkai gitlonate paimang unlen, note’ hlagaute ang hunkhie thei na sung vua a kisuonsa thu lungnem tahin na sang un."},"22":{"text":"Hinanle noma le noma kisolin a za maimaite hi sih unlen, na zah uh thu bangin a gamtate hizaw un."},"23":{"text":"Azieh pen mi khatpo in thu za napi thu banga a gamtat sih leh ama pen hlimlangah ama’ maitang a ki-en mipa tawh kibang ahi hi;"},"24":{"text":"azieh pen ama le ama a ki-et zaw ciengin peikhie a, ama bang tawh kibang ahei ci a mangngil pai hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi vangin a bucing suotahna thukham limtahin enin zui suoh a, za-in a mangngil mi hi loin, sepna tawh a zah thu a zui mi in a sepna-ah thupha nga ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi khatpo in biehna mi ka hi hi, ci napi a leii a kep siem sih leh ama le ama kisol hi lel a, ama’ biehna in kimanna a nei sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Pa Pasien mai-ah a siengtho le a buabang lo biehna i ci in: Tagate le meigong meithaite’ hahsatnate ah va kep va khoi ding le leitung’ buana panin kikoicing ding ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, na mi deidan kawmpi ma-un a minthang i Topa Jesu a um tahtah ma na hi uh amah?","title":"Mi Deidan lo ding Hilkholna"},"2":{"text":"Azieh pen na kikhopna sung vuah kham khutsip bun puonhoi sil khat le mizawng puonsie sil khat ang peiton uleh,"},"3":{"text":"puonhoi sil pa limbawl deu-in, “Tana tona ah hing to in,” na ci vua, tua laitahin mizawng pa kungah “Tuanah na ding phot in,” ahi sihle, “Ka keng gei-ah hing to in,” na tuomci uleh,"},"4":{"text":"no le no sungah kideidanna bawl na hi vua, tuaci’n note pen gitlona lungsim tawh thukhente suoh hi ta lo na hi uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Kang it sanggamte aw, ngai un. Pasien in leitungah mizawngte pen upna lamah a hau ding le ama a it mite tunga a kamciemsa kumpi gam a luote ahi dingin teel zo hi lo amah?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in mizawngte na simmaw bawl uhi. No ang gawtte, mihaute hi lo uh amah? Thukhenna zumah ang kaite zong amate hi lo uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"Note ang kiphuo min ngaipen a gensiete zong amate ma hi lo uh amah?"},"8":{"text":"Lai Siengtho sungah “Nangma na ki-it bangin na vengte na it ding hi,” a ci dung zui-in thukham lienpi na zui zo tahpi uleh a hoi sep na hi ta uhi.","ref":"Siem 19:18"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin note in deidanna na nei uleh mawna bawl na hi vua, thukham palsatte ma bangin note zong thukham in maw ang tangsah hi."},"10":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile mi khat in thukham zosie a zui sieng vangin khat a zuila leh a unpi-in a khiel ma hi veve hi."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Ang kawm sin,” a ci mipa in, “Tuol that sin,” zong ci hi. Ang na kawm sih vangin tuol na tha leh thukham palsat khat ma na hi veve hi.","ref":"Pei 20:13-14; Thkna 5:17-18"},"12":{"text":"Tuaci’n suotahna thukham in thu a khen ding mite bangin thu genin gamta un."},"13":{"text":"Azieh pen khuotuona a nei lo mi poma tungah khuotuona om loin thu kikhen ding hi; khuotuona in thukhenna tungah a guolzo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, mi khat in upna ka nei hi, a ci vangin gamtatna tawh a lah sih leh bang phattuomna om ding ahei? Upna in ang hundam zo ding amah?","title":"Sepna Omlo Upna a Si hi."},"15":{"text":"Sanggam pa khat ahi sihle sanggam nu khat in sil ding puon nei loin nisiel a neh ding an tasam a,"},"16":{"text":"tuale note khatpo in amau’ pumpi kitasapna bangma pie lo pi-in amate kungah, “Nuom tahin na pei un; na khuo uh lumin na gilva un,” mawh ci locin bang phattuomna om ding ahei?"},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n gamtatna a nei lo upna guoh pen a si ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanle mi pawlkhatte in, “Nang in upna na nei a, ke’n gamtatna ka nei hi,” ci ding uhi. Na gamtatna in a zui lo na upna ei lah inlen, ke’n ka gamtatna tawh ka upna kang lah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasien khat beh om hi, ci na um uhi; na hoi sep hi. Dawite nangawn in umin zau-in a ling uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nang mimaw pa aw, gamtatna in a zui lo upna a si ahi lam ang kilah ding na dei ei mah?"},"21":{"text":"I pupi uh ahi Abraham in maitam tungah a tapa Isaac a na pieh lai-in gamtatna tawh dih na tang hi lo amah?","ref":"Pien 22:1-14"},"22":{"text":"Upna in a gamtatna tawh na semton a, gamtatna in upna kicingsah hi, ci note in na thei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Lai Siengtho sungah, “Abraham in Pasien um a, tua khu ama tungah dihna-in a kisimpieh hi,” a ci thu ang tangtung ta a, ama pen Pasien’ lawmpa kici hi.","ref":"Pien 15:6; 2Khg 20:7; Isa 41:8"},"24":{"text":"Upna beh tawh hi loin gamtatna tawh mi khat dih kitangsah hi, ci thu note in na thei uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ma bangin numei pahtat Rahab in zong thukante zin tungsahin lampi dang khatah a sawlkhiet hun lai-in, a gamtatna ziehin dih kitangsah hi lo amah?","ref":"Josh 2:1-21"},"26":{"text":"Azieh pen hlagau om lo pumpi a si ahi ma bangin gamtatna om lo upna zong a si ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, thu a hil kote pen a khauzaw-in thu ei kikhen ding ahi ziehin note tampi zong sie na suo sawm da mai un.","title":"Leii Zuolsahna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile ei teng zosie in khielna tampi i bawl uhi. Mi khatpo in a thugenna-ah khielna a nei sih leh ama mi cingtah ahi a, a pumpi zosie a kemcing siem pa zong ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakolte in i thu a man thei nadingin a kam sung vuah kamkaih vaw leih a pumpi zosie uh i kiheisah thei kawikawi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi sihle tembawte en un: Tuate khu a gol mama a, huipi khauh mama in a mut vangin a hawlpa’ deina popo-ah a heina neuno khat tawh kihei kawikawi thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ma bangin leii zong i pumpi tungah a neu mama van khat hi napi thu lienpite-ah a kisathei mama hi. Meikuong neuno khat in gammang tulah katumsah thei hi!"},"6":{"text":"Tuale leii pen meikuong khat ma ahi hi. Tua leii pen i pumpi nate lahah gitlona lompi khat bangin kikoi hi; tua in i pumpi tung vannuoi buasahin i pienzie buppi mei tawh hal a, hell meikuong tawh ama le ama zong kihaltum hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile gamsa namcin, va namcin, a bawhva ganhingte le tuipi sunga ganhing namcin kikhawizuol thei a, mihingte in tuate na khawizuol zo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanle leii pen a om ngim thei lo a gilo, si theina gu tawh kidim hi a, koima in zuolsah zo lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua leii tawh Topa le Pa i phat vua, tua leii ma tawh Pasien’ lim le mel suna a kibawl mihingte i samsie uhi.","ref":"Pien 1:26"},"10":{"text":"A kibang kam sung khat panin phatna le samsietna pusuoh ton hi. Ka sanggamte aw, tam bang ahi ding pen kilawm vawt lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuinah khat pan tuisieng le ciatui a pulton thei amah?"},"12":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, theikung in olive ga-in, lengga gui panin thei a ga thei amah? Citui in tuisieng pulsah thei lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Note lahah a pil le thuthei koi om ahei? Pilna pana a pieng nunnemna ziehin hinkhuo hoi tawh na sepnate uh ei lah un.","title":"Pilna Nam Ni"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin na lungtang sung vuah a khalawng thangsietna le angsung khuolna lungsim na nei uleh thuman thutah tungah kisielin zuou sih un."},"15":{"text":"Tua bang pilna pen a tunglam pana ang peisuh hi loin leitung pilna, cilesa pilna le dawi pilna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen kithangsietna le angsung khuolna a opna munah kilem lona le gitlona namcin a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Hizongle tunglam pana ang pei pilna in a masa penin siengtho a, tua zaw ciengin kilemna dei-in, nunnem a, thuman nopna nei-in, khuotuona le ga hoi tawh kidim a, deidanna om loin kineitawmna zong a om sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Kilemna a bawlte adingin lungnuom taha a tu uh khaici panin dihna ga a at uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lahah a om tua bang kidona le kihaunate hei pana ang pei ahei? Noma sunga gal a bawl den ahi lunggulna pana tuate ang pei hi lo amah?","title":"Leitung tawh Kilawmtatna"},"2":{"text":"Na khatpo na deigaw vua, na nei tuom sih uhi; tuaci’n tuol na that uhi. Tuale na khat na deigaw vua, na nga zo sih uhi; tuaci’n kihau-in na kido uhi. Note in na nget lo ziehun na nei sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na ngen vua, na nga sih uhi, azieh pen note in noptat nadingin na nget khiel ziehun na nga sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Angkawmte aw! Leitung tawh kilawmtatna pen Pasien tawh kigalneina ahi lam na thei sih uh amah? Tua ahi ziehin leitung tawh a kilawmta nuom poma Pasien’ gal a suoh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi sihle Lai Siengtho in, “Ama in eite sunga ang tensah hlagau pen Pasien in ngai mama hi,” a ci khu bangma lo a na ngaisut uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Hizongle ama in a lienzaw hepina ei pie a, tua ahi ziehin, “Pasien in a kisatheite do a, a kiniemkhiehte tungah hepina a pie hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pau 3:34"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin noma ma in Pasien’ thu na mang un. Dawimangpa na do un, tua hile na kung panun a taimang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasien kung neh un, tua hile ama in zong ang neh ding hi. No mawneite aw, na khut uh silsieng un, no a lungkaa mite aw, na lungtangte uh siensuo un."},"9":{"text":"Da-in kapin mau un. Na nuina uh dana suoh hinlen, na kipahna uh maigumna suoh taheh."},"10":{"text":"Topa mai-ah noma le noma kiniemkhieh un, tua hile ama in note ang lamsang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, khatlekhat na kigensie sih un. Midang khat a gensie, ahi sihle midang khat tunga thu khen poma thukham gensie ahi a, thukham tunga thu khen ahi hi; thukham tunga thu na khen leh thukham zui pa na hi sih a, thukhen pa na hizaw hi.","title":"Midangte tunga Thukhen ding Hilkholna"},"12":{"text":"Ei hundam thei le ei susie thei thukham pie pa khat le thukhen pa khat a om hi. Tua ahile na veng pa tunga thu a khen nang koi hi viel na hei?"},"13":{"text":"“Tuni ahiei zingcieng ahiei khatin tanah ahi sihle tua khuopite ah pei-in tuanah kum khat sung tamin, van lei van zua-in sumbawlin sum va sui tavai,” a ci note aw, tu-in ka thugen ngai un.","title":"Zingcieng Thu-a Kisielna"},"14":{"text":"Zingcieng bang pieng ding ci thu na thei sih uhi. Na hinna uh bang hi lel ahei? Bang ding ahei cile note pen bano khat sung ang kilaa zaw cienga a thengkia pai tuikhu bang na hi lel bo uhi.","ref":"Pau 27:1"},"15":{"text":"Note in, “ Topa’ awina a op leh eite nungta-in, tami ahiei khumi ahiei khat i sem ding hi,” na ci ding uh ahi zaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin kiphasahin na kisiel sih un; tua banga kisielnate zosie gitlona ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin mi khatpo in bang bawl leng a hoi diei ci thei napi-in a bawl sih leh mawna bawl ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No mihaute aw, tu-in hing pei unlen note tunga ang tung ding hamsatnate ziehin kap in mau un.","title":"Mi Bawlsie Mihaute Hilkholna"},"2":{"text":"Na haunate uh muotmangin, na puonsilte uh nget in netum sieng zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Na ngun na khamte uh sam-eh kaisieng zo a, na lang vuah sam-eh teci hing pangin meikuong bangin na sa uh a ne ding hi. Note in ni nukhia ni adingin ngun le kham na khol zo uhi.","ref":"Mat 6:19"},"4":{"text":"Ngai un! Note in solin a thaman na pieh lo uh, na lo uh ang hlawpieh nasemte a kiko vua, vanglien Topa bil ah anlate kikona tung zo hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:14-15"},"5":{"text":"Leitungah noptat zulzau-in na nungta vua, nuomsa-in gawlup ni adingin na kivathau phitphet uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na thu uh ang niel zo lo midih pa mawsahin na that uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin it le ngaite aw, Topa ang pei dongin lungduoi tahin om un. Leitang pana ga manphate a nga thei nadingin lohlo pa in guo masa le guo nukhia a zuh dongin lungduoi tahin a ngah hi.","title":"Thuohna ah Lungduoina"},"8":{"text":"No zong na lungduoi un. Topa ang pei bai ta ding ahi ziehin na lungsimte uh na khausah un."},"9":{"text":"It le ngaite aw, thukhenna na thuoh lo nadingun khatlekhat na kiphunsan sih un. En un, kotpi gei-ah Thukhen Pa a ding hi!"},"10":{"text":"It le ngaite aw, gimthuohna leh lungduoina lamah Topa’ min tawh thu a gen kamsangte ette-in na nei un."},"11":{"text":"A tahtahin kote in a thuohzo mite mi hampha ahi hi, ka ci uhi. Note in Job’ thuohzawhna na za zo vua, tuaci’n Topa’ siltup le Topa’ in bangza tahin ama lungsietin khuotuo ahei ci zong na thei zo ta uhi.","ref":"Job 1:21-22; 2:10; Late 103:8"},"12":{"text":"Tam teng zosie banah, kang itte aw, vantung tawh ahi a, leitung tawh ahi zongin adang kiciemna khatpo tawh na kiciem sih un. Mawsahna na thuoh lo nadingun, a hite, “Ahi,” ahi lote, “A hilo,” hisah pai un.","ref":"Mat 5:34-37"},"13":{"text":"Note lahah mi khatpo gimna thuoh a om eimah? Amate in thungen uheh. A lungdam mi khatpo a om ei mah? Amate in phatna la sa uheh.","title":"Upna Thungetna"},"14":{"text":"Note lahah a cina mi khatpo a om eimah? Hlattuom pawlpi upate hlanin amate in thungetpieh uh hinlen, amate tungah Topa’ minin sathau nu uheh.","ref":"Mrk 6:13"},"15":{"text":"Upna tawh thungetna in cinate damsah ding a, Topa in amate a phongto ding hi. Mawna a bawl mi khatpo zong a mawna kimaisah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na dam sieng thei nadingun khatlekhat na mawnate uh kipulah tuohin khatlekhat thu kingetpieh ciet un. Midihte’ thungetna in vang nei-in na lienpi sem thei hi."},"17":{"text":"Elijah zong eite bangin mihing khat ma hi lel napi, guo a zuh lo nadingin nahpi tahin thungen a, tuaci’n kum thum le hlaguh sung leitungah guo zu loin a om hi.","ref":"1Kum 17:1; 18:1"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin thu a ngenkia leuleu leh vantung in guo zusahin leitung in galete a piengsah hi.","ref":"1Kum 18:42-45"},"19":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, note lahah thuman thutah panin mi khatpo pielin, midang khat in tuapa ang nuatutkia leh,"},"20":{"text":"a vahvaina panin mawnei mi khat a tunpikia poma in sina panin tua mawnei pa’ hlagau hundamin, mawna tampitah a selpieh ahi ding hi, ci thu tua mipa in thei taheh.","ref":"Pau 10:12; 1Pet 4:8"}}}}},"60":{"info":{"name":"1 Peter","shortname":"1pet","abbr":[],"desc":"Peter masa peter laihlah masa (the first letter from peter)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Khris’ sawltahpi keima Peter in, Pontius gam, Galatia gam, Cappadocia gam, Asia gam, le Bithynia gamte-ah galtai-a a Kithethang Mite kungah lai kang hlah hi.","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"Pa Pasien in a sekholsa le a teelsa mite, Jesu Khris’ thu a mang ding le a sisan tawh a kithe dinga Hlagau Siengtho in a siensuosa mite tungah: Hepina le kilemna a kicingin hing om taheh."},"3":{"text":"I Topa Jesu Khris’ Pa le Pasien in thupha nga taheh! Ama’ ei khuotuona lienpi ziehin sina panin Jesu Khris’ thawkiana tungtawnin ahing lametna a nei dingin eite a tha-in ei suohsah zo a,","title":"Ahing Lametna"},"4":{"text":"note adingin vantungah a kisie thei lo, a buabang lo, le a vul thei lo na gouluo ding uh ang kikoipieh zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Note pen upna tungtawnin hun nukhia ciengin a kilang dinga a baisa-a a om hutdamna a nga dingin Pasien’ vanglietna tawh ang kikemcingte na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in note in bakhat sung hahsatna tuomtuomte na thuoh pah zongun, tami thu-ah lungdam un,"},"7":{"text":"tua in mei tawh a kisittel zaw cienga a kisie thei kham sanga a manphazaw na upna tahtah uh hing kilangsahin, Jesu Khris ang kilaa ciengin phatna, minthanna le patawina na nga thei nading uh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama mu ngai lo napi na it uhi; tu-in ama mu sih nan locin na um vua gen zawh lo za dongin kipahin nahpi tahin na lungdam uhi,"},"9":{"text":"azieh pen na upna uh’ tupna bulpi ahi na hlagau uh’ kihutdamna a nga na hi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tami hutdamna tawh kisai-in note nga ding hepina thu a genkhol kamsangte in limtahin sui-in a kantel vua,"},"11":{"text":"amate sunga om Khris’ Hlagau in Khris’ thuoh dinga a kisesa teng le tua zaw cienga a nga ding minthanna thu teci a pankhol lai-in, koi a cina ahi a, bang hun ding ahei ci-in a kan hi."},"12":{"text":"Vantung pana ang kisawl Hlagau Siengtho tawh note tunga lungdamna thu ang hil mite in na kung vuah tu-a ang kigensa thute ang hil lai-un, amau’ na sem hi loin note’ na sem ahi lam amate tungah a kilah zo hi, tam thute pen vantung mite nangawn in a mu nop uh thu ahi hi!"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin nasem dingin na lungsim uh a kigingsa-in om un; no le no pilvang unlen, Jesu Khris ang kilah hun cienga ang kipie ding hepina tungah na lametna uh nga un.","title":"Hindan Siengtho dinga Hlatna"},"14":{"text":"Thumang tate ma bangin bangma na thei lo uh hun lai-a na lunggulnate vuah buol nawn sih un."},"15":{"text":"Note ang hlan pa a siengtho ahi ma bangin no zong na gamtatna zosie vuah na siengtho un."},"16":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Kei a siengtho ka hi ziehin note zong na siengtho ding uhi,” ci-in kigiel hi."},"17":{"text":"A gamtatnate utawh kizui-in mi zosie tungah deidat nei lo-a thu a khen pa tungah Pa bangin thu na nget uleh, na galtai uh hun sungin ama giingin gamta un."},"18":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh tung pana na luosuh uh a ginalo gamtatna panin a kisie thei nate ahi ngun le khamte tawh ang kitan ahi sih a,"},"19":{"text":"mapawn nei lo le nuolbang lo tuuno tawh a kibang a manpha Khris’ sisan tawh ang kitan ahi lam na thei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama pen leitung pien masangin a kisekholsa hi a, ahi vangin note adingin hun nukhia cienga ang kilahsah pan ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Pasien tungah na upna ule na lametna uh a kingah thei nadingin, ama tungtawnin sina panin ama a thosah le minthanna a pie pa Pasien sungah muonna a nei na hi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in note itna tahtah tawh khatlekhat na ki-it thei nading ule na lungtang tawng panun khatlekhat na ki-it thei nadingun thuman thutah zuina tawh na hlagau uh na siensuo zo uhi."},"23":{"text":"A kisie thei khaici tawh hi loin, a kisie thei lo khaici ahi, a hing le a kip a kho Pasien’ thu tawh a tha-a a suohkia na hi ta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Mihing zosie lopa tawh kibang a, ama’ minthanna zosie zong lopa paa tawh kibang hi. Lopate vulin paate pul a,"},"25":{"text":"ahi vangin Topa’ thu ahile a tawntungin kip hi,” a ci hi. Tami thu in na kung vua ang kigensa lungdamna thu ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin gitlona zosie, mi solna zosie, thangsietna le kigensietna zosie paimang un.","title":"A Hing Suong le Teeltuom Mi"},"2":{"text":"Hutdamna ah na khangliet thei nadingun nausen suohcilte bangin hlagau lam nawizu siengtho na lunggul un."},"3":{"text":"Note in Topa a hoi lam na ciem zo tahtah ta uhi.","ref":"Late 34:8"},"4":{"text":"Mite in a nuolsa ahi vangin Pasien muna-ah manpha hi, ci-a a teel tua a hing suongpi ahi ama kungah hing pei unlen,"},"5":{"text":"note zong Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasien’ san thei dingin hlagau tawh kisai biehpiehna a bawl ding le a siengtho siempu nam ahi dingin noma le noma hlagau innpi kilamna-a kizang a hing suongte bang na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen Lai Siengtho sungah, “En un, a kiteel a manpha innkiu suong khat, Zion ah ka koi hi, ama a um mi poma kimaizumsah lo ding hi,” kici hi.","ref":"Isa 28:16"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin no a um mite adingin ama manpha a, ahi vangin a um lo mite adingin ahile, “Inn lamte’ nilkhiet suong, innkiu suong bulpi a suoh zo hi,”","ref":"Late 118:22"},"8":{"text":"a cina le, “Amate a kipalsah suong le a puasah suong khat a suoh hi,” a ci hi. Azieh pen amate in thu a man lo ziehun a kipalpua uhi, bangzieh ahei cile tua bang ding ma-a laitansa ahi uhi.","ref":"Isa 8:14-15"},"9":{"text":"Ahi vangin note na hi uleh khuomiel panin a lamdang ama’ khuovah sungah ang hlan pa’ nasepna lamdangte a phuongzah dinga ang kiteeltuom minam, kumpi siempu nam, a siengtho minam, le Pasien’ mite na hi uhi.","ref":"Pei 19:5-6; Isa 43:20-21; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; Titu 2:14; Isa 9:2"},"10":{"text":"Hun khat lai-in minam hi sih nan locin, tu-in Pasien’ mi na hi ta uhi; hun khat lai-in khuotuona nga sih nan locin, tu-in khuotuona na nga zo ta uhi.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"11":{"text":"Ka itte aw, na hlagau uh ang do den cilesa’ deinate panin na kideh zo nadingun pemtate le galtaite bangin note tungah kang thum hi.","title":"Pasien’ Nasemte Bangin Nungta un."},"12":{"text":"Gentile-te in sietna bawlte ci-in ang minsietsah vangun, thukhen dinga Pasien ang pei ciengin amate in note’ gamtat hoite mu-in Pasien’ min a phat thei nadingun amate lahah zatah huoi-in na gamta un."},"13":{"text":"Topa vang tawh mihingte in a koi aana nei zosie’ thu na mang un. Thunei pen ahi kumpipa’ thu ahi a,"},"14":{"text":"a khielte gawtin a dihtatte a phat dinga ama in a sawl uhpite thu ahi zongin na mang un."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile note in sil hoi na sepna uh ziehin bangma thei lo mimawte na sipsah ding uh pen Pasien’ deina ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"A suohta mite bangin nungta un, hizongle gitlo sel nading po-in na suotahna uh na zang sih unlen, Pasien’ nasemte bangin na nungta zaw un."},"17":{"text":"Mi zosie na zatah un. Thu um innkuonte na it un. Pasien zong giingin kumpi pa zong na zatah un."},"18":{"text":"Silate aw, zatahna kici zosie tawh na pute uh’ thu na mang un. A thusiem le a nunnemte’ thu beh hi loin, a gilo na pute uh’ thu zong na mang un.","title":"Ette ding Khris’ Thuohna"},"19":{"text":"Azieh pen note in Pasien theina tawh a dih lopi-in gentheina na thuoh laitahun na thuoh zawh uleh patahna a nga na hi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na tatkhielna ziehun ang kisat ciengin na thuoh zawh uleh bang patahna om ding ahei? Hizongle note in sil hoi semin gimna na thuoh ciengun na thuoh zawh uleh Pasien’ thukimna a nga na hi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tam ding ma-a note ang kihlan ahi hi. Azieh pen Khris in note adingin na thuoh zo a, tuaci’n ama’ ketot teng na zui thei dingun ette ding lim ang nuasie hi."},"22":{"text":"“Ama in mawna bawl lo a, a kam sungah zuouthu kimu lo hi,”","ref":"Isa 53:9"},"23":{"text":"Ama a kihosiet ciengin hosietna ma tawh thuhkia lo a, gimna a thuoh ciengin zong koima galgih tuon lo hi; hinanle dih taha thukhen pa tungah ama le ama a ki-apzaw hi.","ref":"Isa 53:7"},"24":{"text":"Mawnate panin eite suohta-in dihna adinga i nuntah thei nadingin amama in ama’ pumpi tawh singlamte tungah eite’ mawna a puo hi. Ama’ liemnate ziehin note na dam zo ta uhi.","ref":"Isa 53:5"},"25":{"text":"Azieh pen note tuu bangin lam na piel vua hinanle tu-in na hlagaute uh ang kem le ang cing pa kungah nang kilekia uhi.","ref":"Isa 53:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ma bangin zite aw, na pasalte’ uhna na mang un. Tua hileh amate kimkhat in Pasien’ thu mang sih nan ule, a zite uh’ gamtatzie,","title":"Zite leh Pasalte","ref":"Eph 5:22; Col 3:18"},"2":{"text":"a siengtho le a zatahhuoi a hinkhuote uh a mu uh ciengin, kam khat zong ham kul sese loin amate kizo thei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Note’ kizepna pen samtumna, kham kizepna, le puonsil hoi nono silnate ahi putham kizepnate hi loin,","ref":"1Tim 2:9"},"4":{"text":"Pasien mai-ah a manpha mama, a tul thei lo hoina ahi lungnemna le lungsim dai dide tawh na sunglam hinna uh na zemzaw un."},"5":{"text":"Tanglai Pasien um numei siengthote zong tam bangin kizemin a pasalte’ uhna a na mang uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin Sarah in zong Abraham’ thu mangin ‘topa’ na ci hi. Note zong a hoi-in gamta-in patauna dipkuotna na nei lo laisie uh Sarah’ tanute na hi ta uhi.","ref":"Pien 18:12"},"7":{"text":"Tua bang ma-in no pasalte aw, na thungetnate uh bangma in ang khahtan lo nadingin, na zite utawh hinkhuo na mantonna vuah amate zong hepina zieha hinna letsong luote ahi tah ziehun, no sanga a thanem zawte ahi lam uh theisiemin amate na zatah bawl un.","ref":"Eph 5:25; Col 3:19"},"8":{"text":"A tawpna-ah, note in na unpi-un lungsim kihuolna, khuotuona, khatlekhat ki-itna, lungnemna, le lungsim kiniemkhiehna nei ciet un.","title":"A Pha Bawl Zieha Thuohna"},"9":{"text":"Gitlona pen gitlona tawh thuhkia loin, hosietna zong hosietna tawh thuhkia sih un; tuale mahin thupha tawh na thuhkia zaw un. Note in thupha khat na nga thei nadingun tam dinga ang kihlan na hi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Azieh pen, “Hinna a it mite le ni hoite a mu nuom mite in gitlona panin a leii uh kemin, zuou genna panin a kam uh kem ta uheh;"},"11":{"text":"gitlona panin amate kihei-in, a pha bawl uheh; amate in kilemna sui-in tua kilemna thu del ta uheh."},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen Topa’ mit in midihte en a, amate thungetna zong a bil a daw hi. Hinanle gitlona a bawl mite Topa in a huo hi.”","ref":"Late 34:12-16"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in a pha bawl ding lawp mama hi locin, koi in no hing bawlsie ding ahei?"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin sil hoi bawl ziehin gimna na thuoh ule zong, thupha na nga ding uhi. Amau’ giinte giing sih unlen, zau seng sih un."},"15":{"text":"Hinanle na lungsim sung vuah Khris pen Topa bangin zatah un. Na sung vua om lametna thu ang dong popo a hilcien thei dingin a kigingsa-in om zing un;"},"16":{"text":"hizongle lungnemna le zatahna tawh gen un. Khris sunga na gamtat hoina uh a gensiete in ang hosiet ciengin a maizum thei nadingun, na lungsim vuah kisuonna a om lo dingin a siengtho-in na om un.","ref":"Mat 5:10; Isa 8:12-13"},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen thuohna khu Pasien’ deina ahile, a sie bawlna zieha thuohna sangin a pha bawlna zieha thuohna hoizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien kungah note ang tut thei nadingin, midih ahi Khris in zong mawnate ziehin midih lote adingin a kimang den dingin khatvei gimna a thuoh hi. Ama in cilesa tawh sina a thuoh vangin hlagau tawh kihingsah kia zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama zong tua hlagau tawh pei-in thong sunga om hlagaute tungah thu a va hil ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuate pen nidang lai, Noah in tembawpi a bawl hun lai-a Pasien in lungduoi taha a na nga ngetngut thumang lo hlate ahi uhi. Tua tembawpi sungah mi themkhat, mi giet beh, tui in a suohtasah hi.","ref":"Pien 6:1–7:24"},"21":{"text":"Tami tui in tu-a no ang hunkhie tuiphumna etsahna hi a, pumpi tahsa ciniehte silsiengna bang hi loin, Jesu Khris thawkiana tungtawnin sielepha theina lungsim hoi nei thei nadinga Pasien tunga thumna hizaw hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua Jesu Khris pen vantungah a pei zo ta a, Pasien’ zietlamah omin ama’ thuneina nei-ah vantung mite, uhna neite, vanglietna neite zosie a om uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Khris in cilesa sungah gimna a thuoh lang kalsie, no mama in zong tua bang ngaisutna ma tawh na kigalging un. (Azieh pen cilesa sunga gimna a thuoh poma mawna a tawpsan ahi ta hi).","title":"Pasien’ Hepina Kem Mihoite"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n a omlai na leisiet hinkhuote uh mihingte’ deina bangin hing nawn loin, Pasien’ deina banga a hing ding na hizaw ta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Note in Gentile-te’ sep nop ahi thangtatna, huasanna, zukhamna, guolnopna, zu-uong dawnna, thukham palsat a milim biehnate ah na hun uh na zang sieng ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amate tawh kibangin tua uongtat thanghuoina na zop nawn lo ciengun amate in lamdang sa-in ang gensie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin amate in a hinglaite le a sisate’ thukhen dinga a kigingsa-a om pa mai-ah thudawhna a thuoh ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Azieh pen tami thu zieh ma-a misite kung nangawnah lungdamna thu a kitangko hi a, mi zosie thu kikhensa ahi ma bangin, amate zong cilesa sungah thukhensa hinan ule, Pasien ma bangin hlagau sungah a hin thei nading uh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Sil bangkim a tawp ding hun ang nai ta hi; tua ahi ziehin thu na nget thei nadingun no le no ki-uh zo le pilvang tahin na om un."},"8":{"text":"Tua teng zosie banah note khatlekhat nahpi tahin na ki-it un; bangzieh ahei cile itna in mawna tampite a selcip hi.","ref":"Pau 10:12"},"9":{"text":"Phun vawt loin khatlekhat zin na kido un."},"10":{"text":"Pasien’ hepina nam tuomtuom a zah siemte bangin note khat ciet in na nga uh ahi letsong popo tawh khatlekhat’ na na kiseppieh un."},"11":{"text":"Sil bangkim ah Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasien’ min a than thei nadingin thu a gen tapo in Pasien’ kammal beh ma a genpa bangin gen taheh; na sem tapo in zong Pasien’ pieh thahatna tawh sem taheh.
