Tua hile Jesu Khris tungtawnin sil bangkim ah Pasien’ min a thang ding hi. Ama tungah minthanna le uhzawhna om den tawntung taheh. Amen."},"12":{"text":"Ka itte aw, na tung vuah ang sittel ding gimna meikuong ang tun ciengin sil lamdangpi khat ang tung dan bangin ngaisunin lamdangsa sih un.","title":"Tapidaw Hina Zieha Thuohna"},"13":{"text":"Ama’ minthanna ang kilah ciengin note zong lungdam kipahin na kiko thei nadingun, tu tanpha-in Khris’ thuohnate na thuohpina vuah na lungdamzaw un."},"14":{"text":"Khris’ min vangin note ang kihosiet leh a hampha na hi uhi, bangzieh ahei cile na tung vuah Pasien’ Hlagau ahi minthanna hlagau a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Note koima khat beh, tuolthat, guta, mawna lien bawl, ahi sihle thusie bawlte bangin gimna thuohte hi kha sih un."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin note khatpo in Tapidaw hina zieha gimna na thuoh uleh zong maizumna-in ngaisun sih unlen, tami min na puoh ziehun Pasien na phatzaw un."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ innkuonpite tawh kipanin thukhen nading hun ang tung ta hi; tua pen eite tawh kipan ahile Pasien’ lungdamna thu a mang lo mite’ hun tawpna ding thu bang ahi ta diei?"},"18":{"text":"Tuale “Midihte hutdam nading hamsa ahile, Pasien thei lote le mawneite bang a suoh ta ding vuoi?”","ref":"Pau 11:31"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin Pasien’ deina tawh kituohin gimna a thuohte in a sil pha bawl uh zom suohin, ciem pel lo a Siempa tungah amau le amau ki-ap uheh."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in keimama upa khat hi-in Khris’ thuohnate teci a pang pa, ang kilang ding minthanna zong a nga ding pa in note lahah a om upate kang hanthawn hi.","title":"Pasien’ Tuuhon Cing Un"},"2":{"text":"Note’ kep dinga ang kipie Pasien’ tuuhonte, pausawl thu tawh hi lo, a siengtho lo sum nga nopna tawh zong hi loin, Pasien in note ang dei bangin thanopna lungsim tawh na cingzaw un.","ref":"Jhn 21:15-17"},"3":{"text":"Note’ kep dinga ang kipie tuuhonte uhcip sih unlen, tuuhonte’ ette na hizaw un."},"4":{"text":"Tua hile tuucing pipa ang kilah ciengin note in a vul thei lo minthanna lukhu na nga ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ma bangin no a khangdawng zawdeute in a khanghamte’ thu na mang un. Na unpi-un khatlekhat tungah kiniemkhiehna puon bangin na sil un, azieh pen, “Pasien in mi kiphasahte langpan a, mi kiniemkhiehte hepina a pie hi.”","ref":"Pau 3:34"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ama in pha a sah hun ciengin note ang lapsang thei nadingin a vanglien Pasien khut nei-ah noma le noma na kiniemkhieh un.","ref":"Mat 23:12; Luk 14:11; 18:14"},"7":{"text":"Ama in note ang don ziehin na lungkhamna zosie uh ama tungah nga un."},"8":{"text":"No le no ki-uh unlen khuo phawh un. Na galpa uh dawimangpa in koi ka valtum thei diei ci-in sui-in a hawh vapom humpinelkai bangin a vah kawikawi hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitung mun zosie-a om na sanggamte un zong note thuoh banga a thuoh ahina thu thei na hi ziehun, ama do unlen na upna vuah kip un."},"10":{"text":"Note in gentheina bakhat sung na thuoh zaw ciengun Khris sungah tawntung minthanna nga dinga ang hlan pa, hepina zosie’ Pasien mama in note a ngaingai ang bangsah ding a, ama in hing panpi-in hing thahatsahin zong ang kipsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama tungah a tawntungin thuneina om den taheh. Amen."},"12":{"text":"Keima in sanggam muonhuoi khat a ka ngaituo Silvanus tungtawnin note hanthot nading le tam pen Pasien’ hepina tahtah ahina thu teci ka pan nadingin tami laihlah tomno kang giel ahi hi. Tua thu-ah kip un.","title":"A Nukhia pen Hopina le Thuphapiehna","ref":"Sawl 15:22, 40"},"13":{"text":"Note tawh a kiteelton Babylon khuo-a om pawlpi mite in ang noset uhi. Ka tapa Mark in zong ang noset uhi.","ref":"Sawl 12:12, 25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Col 4:10; Phm 24"},"14":{"text":"Note khatlekhat itna kinapna tawh na kinoset un. Note zosie tungah Khris sunga nopna hing om taheh."}}}}},"61":{"info":{"name":"2 Peter","shortname":"2pet","abbr":[],"desc":"Peter nina peter tung pan laihlah nina (the second letter from peter)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Khris’ nasem le sawltahpi ahi Simeon Peter in, i Pa Pasien le hundampa Jesu Khris’ dihna tungtawnin kote’ upna za ma a ngasa mite tungah lai kang hlah hi:","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"Pasien le i Topa Jesu’ thu na theina ziehun note tungah hepina le lungmuonna a kicingin hing tung semsem taheh."},"3":{"text":"Ama’ minthanna le a hoinate tawh eite ei hlan, ama i theina tungtawnin i nuntah thei nading le Pasien’ mi i hi thei nadingin ama’ Pasien vanglietna in eite kisapna zosie ei pie zo hi.","title":"Tapidawte’ Kihlatna le Kiteelna"},"4":{"text":"Tua bangin ama in eite tungah a manpha le a thupi mama kamciemte ei pie zo a, tua kamciemte tungtawnin lunggulna hang tawh leitunga om kisietnate panin note suohta-in Pasien’ pienzie a neite na suoh ta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tami thu zieh ma-in hanciem thei tawpin na upna uh hoina tawh belap unlen, hoina pen thu theina,"},"6":{"text":"thu theina pen ki-uhzawhna, ki-uhzawhna pen thuohzawhna, thuoh zawhna pen Pasien’ mi hina,"},"7":{"text":"Pasien’ mi hina pen khatlekhat ki-itna, khatlekhat ki-itna pen itna tawh na belap un."},"8":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tami nate pen nomau-a’ hi a, note lahah tamte ang khan semsem leh i Topa Jesu Khris’ theitelna-ah kimanna nei lona le a ga galonate panin ang kem ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Azieh pen tami nate a nei lo poma muna tom le mittaw hi a, a mawna luite pana a kisiensah zo lam a mangngil ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin sanggamte aw, note ang kihlatna le ang kiteelna a kip nading na hakat semsem un, azieh pen tam banga na bawl uleh na pua ngai sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tam bang ziehin i Topa le i Hundam pa uh Jesu Khris’ tawntung gam sungah lut thei nading thu a kicing tahin note ang kipie ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin note in na theisa ule na kung vua ang tungsa thuman thutah sungah a kip a khosa hinan locin, tam thute ang phawhsah kiakia sawm ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tami pumpi sunga ka op laisie, tam thute kang phawsahkia ding pen thuman hi, ci-in ka ngaisun hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima tungah i Topa Jesu Khris in teltahin ei lahsa ma bangin ka sina ding ang tung bai ta ding hi, ci ka thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei ka peikhiet zaw ciengin note in tam thute na phawh den thei nadingun ka hi thei tawpin ka hanciem ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile na kung vuah i Topa Jesu Khris’ vanglietna le ang peikia nading thute kang theisah lai-un, pilvai tawh a kiphuotawm tangmite’ nua po a zuite hi loin, ama’ thupina mit tawh a mute ka hizaw uhi.","title":"Khris’ Minthanna Mit tawh a Mute"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Vanglien Minthang Pa in, “Tam pen ka it ka tapa ahi hi, ama tungah ka lung a kim mama hi,” ci-in tua aw a gin lai-in ama in Pa Pasien tung panin patawina le minthanna a sang hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama tawh muol siengtho tungah ka opton laitahun koma mama in vantung pana ang pei tami awging ka za uhi.","ref":"Mat 17:1-5; Mrk 9:2-7; Luk 9:28-35"},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n kote in a kipzaw lai ahi kamsangte’ thugen ka nei uhi. Na lungsim sung vuah zingsol hing suohin khuo ang va masangin khuomiel lahah meivah tang bangin tam thute thupi sim locin hoi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A masa penin note in na tel ding uh thu in: Lai Siengtho sunga genkholna thu poma mi khat guoh’ dei banga lekhiet thei hi lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile genkholna khat zong mihing’ deina tawh a pieng ngai sih a, Hlagau Siengtho’ sawlna tawh numei pasal in Pasien kung pana ang pei thute a gen uh ahi zaw hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hizongle mite lahah kamsang zuoute a na op bang tehtehin note lahah zong sie zuoute ang om ding a, amate in sietna a piengsah thei ngaisutnate ang dap lutpi ding uhi. Amate a lei pa ahi a pupa nangawn a niel ding vua, amate mama in thakhatin sietna a thuohlaw ding uhi.","title":"Kamsang Zuoute le Amau’ Thuoh ding Dan (Jude 4–13)"},"2":{"text":"Tua bang hinanle zong mi tampite in amau’ thangtatna lampite ma zui-in tami siete ziehin thuman thutah lampi kigensie ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A huoiham seng ziehun amate in zuouthu genna tawh note sum suina-in ang nei ding uhi. Amate tungah mawsahna thukhenna in tanglai-a kipan uoikai loin, a kisuhsiet nading uh zong haitu lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh pen vantungmite a maw ciengin Pasien in dawm vawt loin hell sungah khiesuh a, thukhen ni donga kep dingin khuomiel dum thuhpi sungah na khumcip ahile,"},"5":{"text":"ama in tanglai leitung zong dawm tuon loin Pasien a zatah lo mite tungah tuizin tungsah napi in, dihna thu a tangko Noah le adang mi sagite hunkhie veve ahile,","ref":"Pien 6:1–7:24"},"6":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah khuote mawsahin vut le vai a suo dongin haltum a, a maimang dingin amate tungah mawsahna thukhenin, Pasien’ mi lote tungah a pieng ding thute etsahna suohsah ahile,","ref":"Pien 19:24"},"7":{"text":"ama in thukham palsatin thangtatnate in a lunggimsah midih pa Lot na hunkhie ahile,","ref":"Pien 19:1-16"},"8":{"text":"(azieh pen amate lahah tua midih pa teng a, ama in amau’ gamtat sietnate nisimin mu-in za den ahi ziehin tuate in a dih mama ama’ lungsim a gimsah hi),"},"9":{"text":"tua ciengin Topa in hahsatna panin midihte hutkhiet ding dan le thukhen ni dongin midih lote gawt kawmin a kep dan ding thei a,"},"10":{"text":"a deudeu-in cilesa lunggulna lama kipie mite le thuneite a simmawte a gawt dan ding a thei hi. Amate hangsanin mot lungkhau-in minthanna a neite a gensie ngam giap uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate sangin vantung mite hatzaw-in vanglienzaw nan ule, Topa mai-ah amate gensie-in mawsahna thu a tut sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanle tam mite ahile mat ding le tha ding bepa ang suoh ngaisutna nei lo ganhing maimaite tawh a kibang ahi uhi. Amate in a thei lo uh thute a gensie vua, tua ganhingte a kisuhsiet ciengin amate zong kisusie ding a,"},"13":{"text":"a tatkhielna ziehun dan a thuoh ding uhi. Amate in sun tanglaipi-a thangtat guolnopna pen nopsahna-in a ngaisun uhi. Amate in note tawh pawi a bawl ciengun a thanghuoi guolnopna uh pen note adingin a niehbang le mawsahna ahi ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Amau’ mitte in angkawm nopna tawh kidimin mawna bawl ding a cim thei sih uhi. Amate in mawna bawl dingin lungsim kip lo mite zawlin, huoihamna lamah a kicilsa lungtang a nei uhi. Samsiet tate ahi uhi!"},"15":{"text":"Lampi tang nuasie-in a pielmang ta vua, sil hoi lo gamtatna thaman a deigaw Bosor’ tapa Balaam lampi a zui uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hizongle a tawnkhielna ziehin ama na kiphawhsie a, a ham thei lo laa khat, mihing’ aw tawh hamin kamsang pa mottatna a khawlsah hi.","ref":"Gam 22:4-35"},"17":{"text":"Tam bang mite pen a kanggawsa ciatui le huipi in a semmang meiilum bang ahi uhi; amate adingin khuomiel thuhpi a kikoipieh zo ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile a mot ziehun a kiphatsah ham vua, tuaci’n amate in a tahsa thangtat lunggulnate utawh khielna sunga a nungta mite sung panin a suohta cil mite a zawl uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amate mama zong sietna’ sila hi napi mite tungah suotahna thu a kamciem na lai uhi; bang ding ahei cile mite pen amate a zo na khatpopo’ sila a suoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen i Topa le Hundampa Jesu Khris theina tungtawnin leitung’ buanate panin a suotah zaw ciengun tuate sungah awhin a kizawsahkia ngeingei uleh, amau’ pienzie nukhia pen in a pienzie masa pen uh sangin a siehuoizaw a suoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang ding ahei cile dihna lampi a thei zaw ciengun, amate tungah a kipie a siengtho thupieh panin a kilekia uh sangin tua lampi a na thei ngai mawng lo uh hi leh, amate adingin hoizaw tham ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A man paunah in a na gen dung zui-in, “Ui in a luoh nekia,” a ci le, “A kisilsiengsa vohpi buon lahah buolkia,” ci thu amate tungah a pieng hi.","ref":"Pau 26:11"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka itte aw, na kung vuah tami kang laihah pen a ni veina ahi ta hi; tua gel sungah na ngaisutna siengtho uh hing phawhsahkia-in ang hantawh ka hi hi.","title":"Ang Peikia ding Thuciemna"},"2":{"text":"Tua pen nidang lai-a kamsang siengthote’ gen thute le na sawltahpite uh tungtawna Topa le Hunpa in a gen thupiehte na phawkia nading uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Amasa penin note in na thei ding uh thu in, ni nukhia hun ciengin mi simmaw hatte ang pieng ding a, a cilesa deina uh bangin gamta-in mi a simmaw ding vua,","ref":"Jude 18"},"4":{"text":"“Ama ang peikia nading thuciemna hei sungah om ahei? Azieh pen amate in i pu i pate si zaw a kipanin sil bangkim a kipiensah cila bangin kizom toto lai hi!” ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tangtawng lai-in Pasien’ kammal tawh vantungte na om a, tui lah panin tui tawh leitung kibawl ahi lam a thei gegu pi uh theimaw a kipang vua,","ref":"Pien 1:6-9"},"6":{"text":"tua tuite tungtawnin khum hun lai-a leitung zong tuizin tungsahin kisusie hi.","ref":"Pien 7:11"},"7":{"text":"Hizongle tua Pasien’ thu ma tawh tulai taha a om van le lei pen mei tawh haltum dinga kikoikhol ahi a, Pasien’ thu mang lote thukhenna hun ding le a kisuhsiet ding hun donga kikemcing ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka itte aw, tami thu khat na nelsie sih un. Topa adingin ni khat pen kum tulkhat tawh kibang a, kum tulkhat pen ni khat tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Late 90:4"},"9":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte in kiheh a sah bangun a thuciemna-ah Topa a kiheh vawt sih hi. Ama in koima khat beh a kisiet ding dei loin mi zosie a kisiakia ding a dei ziehin note ang thuoh kenkon ahi zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Hizongle guta bangin Topa’ ni ang tung ding a, tua ciengin a gin ngai mama aw tawh vante mangthai-in, mei in vantung nate katumin zungmang ding a, tuaci’n leitung le a sunga om na zosie katum sieng ding hi.","ref":"Mat 24:43; Luk 12:39; 1Thes 5:2; Kln 16:15"},"11":{"text":"Tam nate zosie tam bang danin zungmang sieng ding ahi ziehin, meikuong in vanpi hulin zungmang ding a, mei tawh vantung nate a tui suo ding hun ahi Pasien’ ni ang tung bai ta ding hi, ci-in note in lawp tahin lamen kawmin, a siengtho hinkhuo le Pasien’ mi hina lamah a nungta dingin bangci bang mi na hi ding uh kilawm ahei?","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Ahi vangin eite i hi leh ama’ ei kamciem dung zui-in dihna a opna mun van thate le lei tha lamenin i om hi.","ref":"Isa 65:17; 66:22; Kln 21:1"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ka itte aw, tam thute lamenin na op laitahun, ama in note a nieh bang lo le muhkaw om loin lungmuong taha na op lam uh ang tuo nadingin na hanciem un.","title":"A Nukhia Pen Hanthotna le Phatna La"},"15":{"text":"Topa’ thuohzawhna pen hutdamna-in na ngaisun ta un. Tua ma bangin zong i it mama uh sanggampa Paul in ama tunga kipie pilna tawh kizui-in, na tung vuoh lai ang hlah zo ta a,"},"16":{"text":"a laihlah zosie-ah tami thu a gen hi. Tua a laihlahte sungah a telha thu tampi om a, thu thei lote le lungsim kip lote in a kisiet na bep dingun Lai Siengtho dangte a lekaih bangun tuate zong a lekaih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin no kang itte aw, note ang kimahil zo ta ahi ziehin thukham palsatte’ khielna in hing puimangin na bulkip uh na hlasuo khah lo nadingun na kidawm un."},"18":{"text":"Hizongle i Topa le Hundampa Jesu Khris’ hepina le theina-ah na khangto un. Ama tungah tu le a tawntungin minthanna om den taheh. Amen."}}}}},"62":{"info":{"name":"1 John","shortname":"1jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John masa john laihlah masa (the first letter of john)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kipat cila na omsa, ka na zahsa uh, ka mit vua ka na musa uh, ka na etciensa ule ka na thamsa uh hinna thu tawh kisai-in note kungah kang gen uhi.","title":"Hinna Thu","ref":"Jhn 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Tami hinna pen ang kilang zo ta a, kote in mu-in tua thu teci a pang ka hi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Note zong kote tawh na kipawlton thei nadingun ka musa ule ka zahsa uh thute no tungah kang tangko hi; a tahtahin kote zong Pa le a Tapa tawh kipawltonin ka om uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kote’ lungdamna a bukim thei nadingin tami thute ang giel ka hi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kote in ama tung panin ka zah zaw ciengun note tunga kang tangko uh thu in, Pasien pen khuovah ahi a, ama sungah khuomiel a om sih hi.","title":"Pasien in Khuovah hi"},"6":{"text":"Ama tawh kipawlton ka hi hi, ci napi khuomiel sungah i gamtat leh zuouthu gen i hi a, thuman a zui lo i hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi vangin khuovah sungah ama ma a op ma bangin eite zong khuovah sungah kalsuonin khatlekhat i kipawlton leh a Tapa Jesu’ sisan in i mawna zosie ei silsieng hi."},"8":{"text":"Mawna ka nei sih hi, i ci leh eima le eima a kisol i hi a, i sungah thuman thutah a om sih hi."},"9":{"text":"I mawnate uh pulah leih a muonhuoi le a thutang ama in i mawnate ei maisahin i dihlonate zosie ei silsieng ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Eite in mawna ka bawl sih hi, i ci leh ama zuou gen i suohsah a, i sungah ama’ thu a om lo ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tanote aw, na maw khah lo nadingun tam thute ang giel ka hi hi. Hizongle mi khatpo in mawna a bawl leh eite in Pa tawh a omton hupa Jesu Khris i nei uhi;","title":"Khris, Eite Ei Hupa"},"2":{"text":"ama pen eite ading beh hi tham loin leitung mi zosie’ mawsut nading biehpiehna zong ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in ama’ thupiehte i zui leh ama thei i hi lam uh i kitheicien uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khatpo in, “Ama ka thei zo hi,” a ci vangin ama’ thupiehte a zui tuon sih leh zuouthu gen mi ahi a, tua pa sungah thuman thutah a om sih hi;"},"5":{"text":"hinanle ama’ thu a zui mi khatpo sungah Pasien’ itna a bukimin a tung tahtah zo hi. Tami thu ziehin eite in ama sunga i op lam i theicien uhi:"},"6":{"text":"“Ama sungah ka teng hi,” a ci poma in Jesu Khris gamtat banga a gamtat ding ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka itte aw, tu-a kang giel pen thupieh tha ahi sih a, a kipat cil pana na neisa uh thupieh lui pen ma ahi bo hi; tua thupieh lui pen na zahsa uh thu ahi hi.","title":"Thupieh Tha","ref":"Jhn 13:34"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin keima in ama tung le note tungah thupiehna tha a maan ang giel ka hi hi. Azieh pen khuomiel vengin khuovah tahtah ang tang zo ta hi."},"9":{"text":"“Khuovah sungah ka om hi,” ci napi a sanggampa a muda poma khuomiel sunga omlai ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"A sanggampa a it poma khuovah sunga teng ahi a, tua bang mi sungah pua nading a om sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanle thu um mi adang khat a muda poma khuomiel sungah omin khuomiel sunga lam pei ahi a, khuomiel in ama mittawsah ahi ziehin a pei nading lampi a thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tanote aw, ama’ min hang tawh na mawnate uh kimaisah zo ahi ziehin, note lai kang hlah hi."},"13":{"text":"Pate aw, a cil a kipanin a om pa, na thei ziehun note lai kang hlah hi. Khangnote aw, gilopa na zaw ziehun note lai kang hlah hi."},"14":{"text":"Tanote aw, Pa na thei ziehun note lai kang hlah hi. Pate aw, a cila a om pa na thei ziehun note lai kang hlah hi. Khangnote aw, na tha uh hat a, na sung vuah Pasien’ thu tengin, gilopa zozo na hi ziehun note lai kang hlah hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitung le leitunga om nate it sih un. Leitung a it mite sungah Pa itna om lo hi;"},"16":{"text":"azieh pen leitunga om sil bangkim, cilesa lunggulna, mittang’ deigawna, hauna zieha kisahtheina, cite pen Pasien kung pana ang pei ahi sih a, leitung pana ang pei hizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung le a deigawna mangthai thei a, hinanle Pasien’ deina banga gamtate kumtawnin a kip den hi."},"18":{"text":"Tate aw, tuhun pen hun nukhia ahi ta hi! Khris langpang ahi antikhris ang pieng ding hi, ci thu na zahsa uh ahi ma bangin, tu-in antikhris tampitah ang pieng zo hi. Tami panin eite in hun nukhia ahi lam i thei uhi.","title":"Antikhris-te Hilkholna"},"19":{"text":"Amate pen ei kung pana a peikhie ahi uhi, ahi vangin amate ei pawl ahi sih uhi; ei pawl hi uleh ei tawh ang omton peisuoh ding uhi. Ahi vangin a peikhietna panun amate khat mama zong ei pawl ahi lo lam ei theiciensah hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin Siengtho Pa in note sathau ang nu zo ta a, tuaci’n note zosie in theina na nei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Thuman thutah na thei lo zieh uh hi loin, na thei zieh ma ule tua thuman thutah panin zuouthu a pien lo lam na thei zieh vua ang giel ka hizaw hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu pen Khris ahi hi, ci-a a nielte simlo zuou thugen i cite koi ahei? Pa le Tapa a niel mite pen antikhris ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tapa a niel koima in Pa a nei sih a, Tapa a sang mi zosie in Pa a nei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Note in a cil a kipanin na zahsa uh thute na sung vuah tengsah un. Note in a cil a kipanin na zahsa uh thute na sung vua a ten leh Pa le Tapa sungah zong na teng ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuale tam pen ama in eite ei ciemsa tawntung hinna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Note ang sol mite tawh kisai-in na kung vuah tam thu teng ang giel ka hi hi."},"27":{"text":"Note na hi uleh na sung vuah ama tung pana na nga uh sathau nuna a op den ziehin ang hil ding mi koima na kisam sih uhi. Ahi vangin tua sathau nuna in note thu zosie ang hil bangin tua ang hil thute thuman ahi a, tua pen zuouthu ahi lo ziehin ang hil bang lienin ama sungah teng un."},"28":{"text":"Ka tanote aw, ama ang kilah ciengin eite in kimuonna nei-in ama ang pei ciengin ama mai-ah i maizum lo nadingin tu-in ama sungah teng un."},"29":{"text":"Note in ama dih hi, ci-a na thei uleh sil dih bawl zosie ama’ piensah ahi hi, ci na thei uhi.","title":"Pasien’ Tate"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasien’ tate ei kici thei nadingin bangza tahin Pa in ei it ahei ci thei un; eite zong lah tua ma i hi pai uhi. Leitung in eite ei thei lona a hang pen ama a thei lo zieh ahi hi.","ref":"Jhn 1:12"},"2":{"text":"Ka itte aw, tu-in Pasien’ tate i hi ta uhi; mai lamah bang hi lai ding i hei, ci ei kilah nai lo hi. Eite’ thei thu pen tami ahi hi: Ama ang kilah ciengin ama tawh i kibang ding uhi, bangzieh ahei cile eite in ama ahi bangin i mu ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama sungah tami lametna a nei zosie in ama’ sientho bang lienin amau le amau zong siengtho uheh."},"4":{"text":"Mawna a bawl poma thukham palsat ahi hi; mawna pen thukham palsatna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mawna lakhie dingin ama ang kilang hi, ci thu le ama sungah mawna om lo hi, ci thu na thei uhi.","ref":"Jhn 1:29"},"6":{"text":"Ama sunga a teng koima in mawna a bawl sih hi; mawna a bawl mi koima in ama a mu lo le a thei lo ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tanote aw, koima in kisolsah sih un. Ama a dih bang lienin a diha gamta mi poma midih ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Mawna a bawl poma dawimangpa’ ta ahi hi; bangzieh ahei cile a kipatcil a kipan dawimangpa pen mawna bawl ahi hi. Dawimangpa’ nasepte a susie dingin Pasien’ Tapa ang kilang hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasien’ piensah mite in mawna a bawl sih uhi, bangzieh ahei cile amate sungah Pasien’ khaici a teng hi; Pasien’ piensah mite ahi ziehun amate in mawna a bawl thei sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tam bang danin Pasien’ tate le dawimangpa’ tate a kilang hi: A dihin gamta loin a sanggamte a it lo zosie pen Pasien kung pana ang pei ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Note in a kipat cila kipanin na zahsa uh thu ahile khatlekhat i ki-it nading thu ahi hi.","title":"Khatlekhat Ki-it Un","ref":"Jhn 13:34"},"12":{"text":"Gilopa kung pana ang pei a naupa a that Cain i bang sih ding uhi. Tuale bang dinga a sanggam pa a tha ahiei? Azieh pen ama gamtat sie-in a sanggampa a gamtat a dih zieh ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, leitung in ang muda leh lamdang sa sih un."},"14":{"text":"Eite khatlekhat i ki-it ziehin sina kantanin hinna ah i galkai zo ta hi, ci thu i thei hi. Itna a nei lo poma pen sina sunga a omlai ahi hi.","ref":"Jhn 5:24"},"15":{"text":"A sanggam muda zosiete mi that ahi a, mi thatte in tawntung hinna a nei lo lam na thei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in eite adingin a hinna ei pieh ziehin tuami tawh itna thu i thei uhi. Eite zong khatlekhat i hinna uh i kipieh ding a kilawm ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung’ haunate nei-in a sanggam khat’ kisapna mu giagua napi a hu nuom lo mi khatpo sungah bangci bangin Pasien’ itna om thei ding ahei?"},"18":{"text":"Tanote aw, thu le kam beh tawh ki-it loin, thutah sungah sepna tawh ki-it vai."},"19":{"text":"Tuale tami thu ziehin eite pen thutah pana pieng i hi vua, i lungtang in eite ei mawsah sielin ama mai-ah i lung a nuomsahkia dingte i hi lam i thei ding uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile i lungtang sangin Pasien lienzaw a, ama in sil bangkim a thei hi.","merge":"20"},"21":{"text":"Ka itte aw, i lungtang in ei mawsah sih leh Pasien mai-ah eite in hanna i nei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Eite in ama’ thupiehte zui-in ama lungkim nading i gamtat ziehin ama tung panin i nget popo i nga uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama’ thupiehna tami ahi hi. Ama’ tapa Jesu Khris’ min i up ding le ama’ ei sawlna bang lienin khatlekhat i ki it ding ahi hi.","ref":"Jhn 13:34; 15:12, 17"},"24":{"text":"Ama’ thupiehte a zui zosie ama sungah teng a, ama zong tua mite sungah a teng hi. Tuale eite sungah ama a ten lam pen ama’ ei pieh Hlagau tawh i theithei uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka itte aw, hlagau popo um pai sih unlen, Pasien tung pana ang pei amah ci-in sittel bo un. Bangzieh ahei cile leitungah kamsang zuou tampi tah pei zo ta hi.","title":"Hlagaute Sittel Un"},"2":{"text":"Tam thu tawh Pasien’ Hlagau na thei ding uhi: Jesu Khris tahsa sungah ang pei zo hi, ci-a a sang poma Pasien tung pan hi a,"},"3":{"text":"Jesu a sang lo hlagau poma Pasien tung pan ahi sih hi. Tam pen ang pei ding hi ci-a na zahsa uh antikhris’ hlagau hi a, tu-in leitungah a om zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tanote aw, note pen Pasien pan na hi vua, amate na zozo uhi. Azieh pen leitunga a om pa sangin note sunga a om pa lienzaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate pen leitung pan ahi uhi; tua ahi ziehin amate in leitung thu genin leitung in a thugen uh a ngai hi."},"6":{"text":"Eite i hi leh Pasien pan i hi uhi. Pasien a thei poma in i thu gen a ngai vua, Pasien pan ahi lo poma in i thu gen a ngai sih uhi. Tam panin eite in hlagau man le hlagau zuou i theithei hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka itte aw, khatlekhat na ki-it un; bangzieh ahei cile itna pen Pasien pana ang pei ahi hi; mi a it thei zosie Pasien’ piensah hi a, tuaci’n Pasien a thei hi.","title":"Pasien Itna Ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Itna a nei lo poma in Pasien a thei sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile Pasien pen itna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Eite lahah Pasien’ itna tam bangin ang kilang hi: Ama tungtawnin eite i hin thei nadingin Pasien in leitungah a Tapa neisun ang sawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Itna i ci tami ahi hi. Eite pen Pasien it i hi sih vua, ama in eite ei itin i mawnate zieha thoidam biehpiehna dingin a tapa ang sawl hizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka itte aw, Pasien in taza tahin eite ei it ahile eite zong khatlekhat i ki-it ding uh a kilawm ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Koima in Pasien mu ngai lo hi; eite khatlekhat i ki-it leh eite sungah Pasien teng a, tuaci’n ama’ itna in eite sungah a bukim hi.","ref":"Jhn 1:18"},"13":{"text":"Ama in ama’ Hlagau ei pie zo ahi ziehin ama sungah eite i om a, eite sungah zong ama a op lam tami thu tawh i thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Pa in leitung’ Hunpa dingin a Tapa ang sawlna thu eite in mu-in teci i pang zo ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu pen Pasien’ Tapa ahi hi, ci-a a sang mite sungah Pasien teng a, amate zong Pasien sungah a teng uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n Pasien in eite ei itna thu, eite in thei-in i um zo ta uhi. Pasien pen itna ahi hi, itna sunga a tengte pen Pasien sunga teng ahi a, Pasien zong amate sungah a teng hi."},"17":{"text":"Thukhen ni ciengin eite in hansanna i nei thei nadingin eite lahah tam bangin itna ang kicingsah hi, azieh pen ama bangin eite zong leitunga pieng i hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Itna sungah zauna om lo a, ahi vangin itna bukim in zauna a paimang hi; bangzieh ahei cile zauna pen dan thuoh ding ginna ahi a, tuaci’n a zau poma itna sungah a cingtah nai lo ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in eite ei it masah ziehin eite in ama i it uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Pasien ka it hi,” ci napi a sanggamte a mudate pen zuou gente ahi uhi; azieh pen a mu thei a sanggam pa a it lote in a mu thei lo Pasien a it thei sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Eite in ama tung panin tami thupieh i nei uhi: Pasien a itte in a sanggamte zong a it uh kul hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in Khris ahi hi, ci-a a um poma Pasien’ piensah mi hi a, nulepa a it poma in zong a ta a it hi.","title":"Upna in Leitung Zo"},"2":{"text":"Pasien itin ama’ thupiehte i zui ciengin eite in tami tawh Pasien’ tate i it lam i thei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen Pasien i itna i ci in ama’ thupiehte i zuina ahi hi. Ama ei thupiehte zong a zuiha ahi seng sih hi.","ref":"Jhn 14:15"},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ piensah mi poma in leitung a zo hi. Leitung a zo guolzawna i ci pen eite’ upna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu in Pasien’ Tapa hi, ci-a a um mi simlo leitung a zo koi ahei?"},"6":{"text":"Tui le sisan tawh ang pei pa in Jesu Khris ahi a, tui beh tawh hi loin, tui le sisan tawh ang pei hi. Tua teci pang pa pen Hlagau ahi hi, azieh pen tua Hlagau pen thuman thutah ahi hi.","title":"Pasien’ Tapa Tungtang Teci Panna"},"7":{"text":"Teci pang thum a om hi:"},"8":{"text":"Tua teng pen Hlagau, tui le sisan ahi a, tami thum teng a kithutuoh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Eite in mihing teci panna sang thei i hi leh Pasien’ teci panna pen a lienzaw ahi hi. Azieh pen Pasien in tu-a bangin a Tapa’ thu teci a pang hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasien’ tapa a umte in a lungsim sung vuah teci panna a nei uhi. Pasien a um lote in Pasien in a tapa tungtang teci a panna um lo uh ahi ziehin ama zuougen a suohsah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuale tami pen teci panna ahi hi: Pasien in eite kumtawn hinna ei pie a, a Tapa sungah tami hinna a om hi.","ref":"Jhn 3:36"},"12":{"text":"Tapa a nei poma in hinna a nei hi; Pasien’ tapa a nei lo poma in hinna a nei sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasien tapa’ min a um note in kumtawn hinna na nei lam uh na thei nadingun note tungah tami thute kang giel hi.","title":"Thukhupna"},"14":{"text":"Ama sunga i nei uh lungmuonna pen tami ahi a, eite in ama’ deina tawh kituohin na khatpo i nget nah leh ama in ei za hi."},"15":{"text":"I nget khat popo ei za hi, ci i thei leh ama kunga i nget popo i nga zo hi, ci i thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Na sanggampa in sina dong ding ahi lo mawna a bawl na mu leh thu na nget pieh ding a, Pasien in sina dong ding ahi lo mawna bawlte tungah hinna a pie ding hi. Sina dong a tun mawna a om hi; tuate adingin thu nget pieh in a ci ka hi sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Gamtat khielna zosie mawna hi a, hinanle sina a tun lo mawna a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasien’ piensah mite in mawna a bawl sih hi, ci thu eite in i thei a, Pasien’ piensah mipa in amate kemcing ahi ziehin gilo pa in amate a thamkha sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasien’ tate i hi lam le gilopa’ uhna sungah leitung mi zosie a op lam eite in i thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Eite in ama a thuman ahi lam i thei nadingin Pasien’ Tapa hing pei zo a ci le theitheina ei pie zo ci zong i thei hi; eite i hi uleh tua a thuman a Tapa Jesu Khris sungah i om uhi. Ama pen a thuman Pasien le tawntung hinna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tanote aw, milimte panin no le no na kikem un."}}}}},"63":{"info":{"name":"2 John","shortname":"2jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John nina john laihlah nina (the second letter of john)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khangham pa in, thuman thutah sunga ka it, kei beh hi loin thuman a thei mi zosie in zong a it,","title":"Hopina"},"2":{"text":"kote sunga a om, le kote tawh ang om zing ding tua thuman thutah ziehin teeltuom upa nu le a tate tungah:"},"3":{"text":"Pa Pasien le Pa’ Tapa Jesu Khris tung panin hepina, khuotuona le lungnopna in thuman thutah le itna tawh eite ei ompi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Pa in eite ei thupieh bang lienin thuman thutah sungah na tate pawlkhat a kalsuon uh ka mu ziehin ka kipah mama hi.","title":"Thuman Thutah le Itna"},"5":{"text":"Ahi vangin numei aw, tu-in na kungah thupieh tha ang giel dan ka hi sih a, a kipat cil a kipan i neisa uh thupieh pen ma tawh khatlekhat ki-it bo vai ci-a ang thum ka hizaw hi.","ref":"Jhn 13:34; 15:12, 17"},"6":{"text":"Ama’ ei thupiehte banga i zuina pen itna ahi hi; note in a kipat cila na zahsa uh bang lienin itna sungah na kalsuon un, ci thu pen thupieh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Cilesa sungah Jesu Khris ang pei zo hi, ci thu a sang lo misol tampi, leitungah ang pieng zo ta hi. Tua bang a gen mi poma misol ahi a, anti-khris ahi hi!"},"8":{"text":"Note in ka bawlsa uh nate mansuo loin thaman a kimtaha na san thei nadingun na kidawm un."},"9":{"text":"Khris’ thuhilna-ah kip loin a valkai pei zosie Pasien nei lo ahi hi; a thuhilna-a a kip poma in Pa le Tapa a neiton ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Note kungah mi khatpo ang pei-in tami thuhilna ang vom sih leh na hopi sih unlen, na inn vuah zong na tungsah sih un."},"11":{"text":"Azieh pen khum bang mipa hopina pen ama’ gitlo nasepna sunga kihalna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Na kung vuah giel ding tampi ka nei vangin laitui le laikung zang zaw loin, tua sangin i lungdamna a kicin thei nadingin na kung vuah hing haw-in kimutuo-a i kiho ding ka lamen hi.","title":"A Nukhia Hopina"},"13":{"text":"A kiteel na sanggam nu’ tate in note ang noset uhi."}}}}},"64":{"info":{"name":"3 John","shortname":"3jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John thumna laihlah a thumna (the third letter of john)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khangham pa in thuman thutah sunga om ka lawm it Gaius tungah.","title":"Hopina","ref":"Sawl 19:29; Rom 16:23; 1Cor 1:14"},"2":{"text":"Ka lawm it aw, na hlagau a cidam bang ma-in na zosie ah na lawcin thei nading le na cidam thei nading thu ka ngen hi.","title":"A Zindo Siem Ziehin Gaius Kipahta"},"3":{"text":"Lawmte pawlkhat ang tungin thuman thutah sungah na muonhuoina le thuman thutah sungah na kalsuon dan ang gen ciengun ka na kipah mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka tate thuman thutah ah a kalsuon ka zaha ka kipahna za sangin a lienzaw kipahna ka nei sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka it lawm aw, amate gelta hi napi lawmte tunga na bawl bangin amate tungah muonhuoi tahin na bawl hi;"},"6":{"text":"amate in hlattuom pawlpite mai-ah note’ itna thu teci a pang uhi. Pasien tungah gamtat dinga a kilawm za-in a lampi vuah amate na hla lacin sil hoi bawl na hi ta ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"bangzieh ahei cile amate pen Khris’ min hang tawh khuolzin kipan ahi bo vua, thu um lo mite tung panin bangma panpina a nga sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin thuman thutah tawh nasem tonte i suo thei nadingin tua bang mite i hu ding vua kilawm ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpi tungah lai pawlkhat ka hlah zo a, ahi vangin lamkai suoh nuom pa ahi Diotrephes in ka thu ei mang nuom sih hi.","title":"Diotrephes le Demetrius"},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n kang haw khah leh kote tungah aman lo-a ei mawsahna le ei gensietna teng kang phawhsah ding hi. Mi gensietna tawh lungkim nai vaset loin, lawmte zong zin tungsah nuom lo a, a tungsah nuomte nangawn khamin hlattuom pawlpi panin a hawlkhie hi."},"11":{"text":"Kang it lawm aw, thusiete ette loin, thu hoite ette zaw in. A hoi-a gamta poma Pasien pan ahi hi; a sie-a gamta poma Pasien a mu nai lo ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi zosie in Demetrius a phat vua, tua thuman thutah mama in zong teci a pang hi. Kote in zong ama ka phat vua, ka teci panna uh a man lam na thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Na kungah giel ding tampi ka nei a, ahi vangin laitui le laikung tawh giel ka sawm sih hi;","title":"A Nukhia Hopina"},"14":{"text":"nang tawh kimu bai ding ka lamen a, kimaitang tuo-in i kiho ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang tungah nopna hing tung taheh. Lawmte in zong ang noset uhi. Khum sunga om lawmte a milipin khatciet ei na noset pieh in."}}}}},"65":{"info":{"name":"Jude","shortname":"Jude","abbr":[],"desc":"Jude tung pan laihlah (the letter from jude)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Khris’ nasem khat le James’ sanggam pa Jude in, Pa Pasien sunga it le ngaite le Jesu Khris dinga a bihtaha kikem a kihlansate tungah lai kang hlah hi:","ref":"Mat 13:55; Mrk 6:3"},"2":{"text":"Hepina, lungmuonna le itna tampite no-a’ hing hi taheh."},"3":{"text":"Ka itte aw, na kung vuah i neiton uh hutdamna ka giel nuom mama laitahin, mi siengthote tungah a kimang den dinga khatvei beh a kipie tua upna adingin gal na do nading uh kutna lai giel ding a kisap lam ka mu hi.","title":"Laihlahna Ahang"},"4":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile tanglai-a kipanin tami mawsah thukhenna a thuoh dinga eite lahah a na kisesa Pasien a zatah lo mi honkhat ang dap lut zo a, amate in i Pasien uh’ hepina pen numei-pasal thangtatna lamah hei-in eite in i neisun uh ahi Mangpa le Topa Jesu Khris a niel uhi."},"5":{"text":"A kicinga na theisa uh hizongle note in a kimang den dinga khatvei beh tawh a mite a hunkhie pa Topa in a nua ciengin Egypt gam hunkhie-in, a um lo mite a suhsietna thu kang phawhsah kia nuom hi.","title":"Sie Zuoute tunga Thukhenna","ref":"Pei 12:51; Gam 14:29-30"},"6":{"text":"Ama in ni thupi ni-in thukhenna thuoh dingin a panmun kemcing loin a tenna a nuasie vantung mite zong khuomiel thuhpi sungah tawntung siakhau tawh a khicip hi."},"7":{"text":"Sodom, Gomorrah le a kimvela om khuopi mite zong amate bangin gamta-in numei-pasal pahtatna le mihing ngaina dan ahi lo cilesa lunggulna lamah a kipumpieh ziehun mite’ ette dingin kumtawn meikuong tawh gawtna a thuoh uhi.","ref":"Pien 19:1-24"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua bang ma-in mangmante in a tahsa uh a buasah vua, thuneina zong nielin a minthanna a neite a gensie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanle vantungmi mangpa Michael in dawimangpa tawh Moses luong kitu-in a kisel laitahun, dawimangpa tungah mawsah gensietna kammal zang ngam loin, “ Topa in nang ang phawhsie hi,” beh na ci hi.","ref":"Dan 10:13, 21; 12:1; Kln 12:7; Thkna 34:6; Zech 3:2"},"10":{"text":"Hizongnanle tam mite in a thei lo uh thu khatpopo a mawh gensiet vua, ngaisutna a nei lo ganhingte bangin a pienpi lungsim utawh a thei uh thute in amate a susie hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in gimna a thuoh ding uhi! Bangzieh ahei cile sum nga thei nadingin Cain lampi zui-in Balaam khielna-ah amau le amau a kipiekhie vua, tuaci’n Korah ledona-ah a kisie sieng uhi.","ref":"Pien 4:3-8; Gam 22:1-35; 16:1-35"},"12":{"text":"Tua mite pen na itna pawi vua a nieh bangte ahi vua, zum mel nei loin no tawh an ne tonin amau le amau an kivate ahi uhi. Hui in a mut kawikawi guo lah a zusah bep lo meei tawh a kibang vua, amate ga a ga lo, nivei a si, a kiphungkal phalbi singkungte ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amau’ maizumna pen a phuonsah tuipi huol husiete le a leng kawikawi aahsite tawh kibang ahi vua, amate adingin a tawntungin khuomiel thuhpi kikoipieh zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Adam panin a khang sagina Enoch in tami thute a na magen zo ta a, “En un, a misiengtho tul sawm tampite tawh Topa hing pei-in,","ref":"Pien 5:18, 21-24"},"15":{"text":"mi zosie tungah thu khen ding le, milip in tua banga a bawl uh ahi Pasien zatah lo gamtat ziete le Pasien zatah lo mawneite in ama langpanin a gen khah uh kamkhau zosie a mawsah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam mite ahile a phun hatte le lungkim hun a nei ngai lote ahi uhi; a lunggulna bangun a gamta uhi; amate ahile kam dimdimin hamin a phattuom nading vua mi maipah siemte ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi vangin ka itte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris’ sawltahpite in na kung vua ang genkholsa thute phawh un.","title":"Thuhilna le Hanthotnate"},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile amate in, “Hun nukhia ciengin Pasien zatahna zie ahi lo a pumpi uh’ deigawna lam a zui mi simmawte ang pieng ding hi,” ci-in note tungah ang gen zo uhi.","ref":"2Pet 3:3"},"19":{"text":"Tua bang mite pen hlagau nei lo, kikhenna a piengsah a tahsa tai mite ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanle no ka itte aw, a siengtho pen na upna uh tungah noma le noma kilam unlen, Hlagau Siengtho tawh thu ngen un."},"21":{"text":"Pasien’ itna sungah noma le noma kikem un; kumtawn hinna ang tun ding ahi i Topa Jesu Khris’ khuotuona na lamen bo un."},"22":{"text":"A lungkaa mi pawlkhat khuotuo un;"},"23":{"text":"meikuong sung panin midangte kaikhie-in hunkhie un; amau’ tahsa zieha a buabang a puonsilte nangawn uh muda-in zauna tawh midangte tungah khuotuona na nei un."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in na pua lo nading vua ang kem zo pa, mawsahna om loin ama’ minthanna munah kipahna tawh ang tut zo pa,","title":"Thupha Piehna"},"25":{"text":"i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin hunpa Pasien khat beh tungah minthanna thupina, vanglietna le thuneinate in a tawpsa hun zosie-a kipanin tu le kumtawnin hing om den taheh, Amen."}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Kilahna","shortname":"Kln","abbr":[],"desc":"Kilahna john tunga kilahna (the revelation to john)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami pen a sawt lo-a ang tung bai ding, a nasemte tungah a lah dinga Pasien in ama a pieh Jesu Khrist kilahna ahi hi; ama in vantung mite sawlin ama’ nasempa John theisah a,","title":"Thupatna le Hopina"},"2":{"text":"John in Pasien’ thu le Jesu Khris’ teci panna a mu zosie nangawn teci a pang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua kamsanna thute a ginga a simte mi hampha ahi a, a sunga kigiel thute za-in a zui mite mi hampha ahi hi; azieh pen a hun a nai ta hi."},"4":{"text":"John in Asia gam sunga om hlattuom pawlpi sagite kungah: Tuhun, a tawpsa hun, le mailam huna ang om lai ding pa le ama’ topha mai-a om hlagau sagite pan le,","ref":"Pei 3:14; Kln 4:5"},"5":{"text":"a muonhuoi teci pa, misite lah panin a suoh masa pen, leitung kumpite a uhpa, Jesu Khris tung pan hepina le lungnopna note tungah hing om taheh. Eite ei it a, a sisan ziehin i mawnate panin ei suohtasah,","ref":"Isa 55:4; Late 89:27"},"6":{"text":"ama’ Pa Pasien nasem dinga kumpi le siempu ei suohsah pa tungah a tawntungin minthanna le uhzawhna om den taheh. Amen.","ref":"Pei 19:6; Kln 5:10"},"7":{"text":"En un! Meiipi tawh ama ang pei hi; mit zosie in ama mu ding a, ama a sun mite nangawnin mu ding uhi; ama ziehin leitung minam zosie a kap ding uhi. Tua bang ang hi ding hi. Amen.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Mat 24:30; Mrk 13:26; Luk 21:27; 1Thes 4:17; Zech 12:10; Jhn 19:34, 37"},"8":{"text":"Tuhun, a tawpsa hun, le mailam huna ang om lai ding a Vanglien Topa Pasien in, “Keima a kipatna le a tawpna ka hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Kln 22:13; Pei 3:14"},"9":{"text":"Jesu sungah bawlsietna-a kipan kumpi gam ahi a, lungduoina tawh thuohzawhna ahi zongin, note tawh a thuohton na sanggam uh keima John in Pasien’ thu le Jesu’ teci panna ziehin Patmos a kici tuikul ah ka om hi.","title":"Khris’ Mang Muna"},"10":{"text":"Topa’ ni-in hlagau-ah omin ka nua lamah pengkul banga a gin ngai mama aw khat ka za a,"},"11":{"text":"“Na mu teng laibu khatah giel inlen, hlattuom pawlpi sagite ahi Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, le Laodecia-te tungah hlah in,” ei ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ei hopi awging mu nuomin ka kihei leh kham meivah tunna sagi ka mu a,"},"13":{"text":"tua meivah tunnate laikim ah puontuolpi silin a awm-ah kham awmgah a gah Mihing Tapa tawh a kibang khat ka mu hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; 10:5"},"14":{"text":"A lutang le a sam tuumul bangin kangin vua bangin paa hi; a mittangte meikuong kileh tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Dan 7:9"},"15":{"text":"A keng pen pummei sunga sumngo kihal sieng kinawtval bang a, a awgin pen tui tampi a luongton ging tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Dan 10:6; Ezk 1:24; 43:2"},"16":{"text":"A zietlam khutah aahsi sagi tawi a, a kam panin a langni-a a hiem namsau khat pusuoh hi. A maitang sunkim nisa tang pempom tawh kibang hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama ka mu ciengin a keng zungah a si bangin ka pua hi. Ahi vangin ama in ka tungah a zietlam khut hing ngamin, “Zau sin; kei pen a kipatna le a tawpna ka hi a,","ref":"Isa 44:6; 48:12; Kln 2:8; 22:13"},"18":{"text":"a hing zing pa zong ka hi hi. Ka na si ngai a, en in, kumtawn kumtawna a hing zing ka hi hi; keima in Sina le Misi khuo tawhtangte ka nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in na musa nate, tu-a om nate, tam zaw cienga ang pieng lai ding nate zosie giel in."},"20":{"text":"Ka zietlam khutah na mu aasi sagite le kham meivah tunna sagite’ thu tami ahi hi: Aasi sagite pen hlattuom pawlpi sagite’ vantung mite ahi a, meivah tunna sagite pen hlattuom pawlpi sagite ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ephesus hlattuom pawlpi’ vantungmi tungah giel in: Tam teng pen a zietlam khutah aasi sagi tawi-in kham meivah tunna sagi lahah a vah kawikawi pa’ kammal ahi hi:","title":"Ephesus Halttuom Pawlpi Tunga Thu Kigen"},"2":{"text":"“Keima in na nasepte, na gimnate le na thuohzawh hatnate ka thei hi. Nang in sietna bawlte na thuoh zawh lo lam ka thei hi; sawltahpi hi lopi sawltahpi ka hi uhi, a ci mite sittelin a zuou ahi lam uh na munate zong ka thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima’ min ziehin lungduoi tahin thuohin na cimtah lo lam zong ka thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Hizongle kang mawsahna khat om veve a, tua khu nang in itna masa pen na nuasie ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin bang ka ci pua ta ahei ci phawh inlen, kisiakia-in na sil bawl masate bawlkia in. Na kisiakia sih poma leh nangma kungah hing pei-in a opna mun panin na meivah tunna ka hemkhie ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanle nang ang kipatatna pen tami ahi hi: Keima in zong ka muda ahi Nicolas pawlte’ nasepna na muda hi."},"7":{"text":"Hlagau in hlattuom pawlpite tunga a thugente khu bil nei poma in za taheh. Keima in a guolzo mi zosie tungah Pasien’ paradise sunga a om hinna singkung neh theina thu ka pie ding hi.","ref":"Pien 2:9; Kln 22:2; Ezk 28:13; 31:8; Pien 2:9; Kln 22:2; Ezk 28:13; 31:8"},"8":{"text":"“Smyrna hlattuom pawlpi’ vantungmi tungah giel in: A masa pen le a nukhia pen, a si ngaisa le a hingkia pa’ thugen tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Smyrna Hlattuom Pawlpi Tunga Thu Kigen","ref":"Isa 44:6; 48:12; Kln 1:17; 22:13"},"9":{"text":"“Nang na hau vangin na gentheina le na zawnna ka thei hi. Jew mi hi lo napi ka hi uhi, ci-in kigenin hizongle Satan’ pawl ahi zawte’ ang gensietna ka thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Na gim thuoh dingte zau vawt sin. Pilvang in, dawimangpa in nang ang ze-et nadingin note kimkhat thong sungah hing khumin ni sawm sung gentheina na thuoh ding uhi. Si tanpha-in muonhuoi in, tua hile keima in hinna lukhu kang pie ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpite tunga Hlagau thugen khu bil nei poma in za taheh. A guolzo poma nivei sina in a gimsah sih ding hi.","ref":"Kln 20:14; 21:8"},"12":{"text":"“Pergamum hlattuom pawlpi’ vantungmi tungah giel in: A langni-a a hiem namsau nei pa’ thugen tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Pergamum Hlattuom Pawlpi Tunga Thu Kigen"},"13":{"text":"“Satan’ kumpi topha opna muna a teng na hi lam kang thei hi. Hinanle ka min na pomdet a, Satan opna mun note lahah a kithat ka teci, ka mi muonhuoi pa Antipas khan lai nangawnin kei nei upna na niel sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Hizongle na tungah mawsahna themkhat ka nei hi: Nang in milimte mai-ah kithoina ante nesahin numei-pasal pahtatna a bawl nadingun, Israel mite mai-ah suikhah ding na khat koi dingin Balak tunga thu a hil Balaam’ thuhilna a pom mi kimkhat na nei hi.","ref":"Gam 22:5, 7; 31:16; Thkna 23:4; Gam 25:1-3"},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n nang in Nicolas thuhilna a pom mi pawlkhat zong na nei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ciengin kisiakia in. Na kisiakia sih leh na kungah kang naw pei ding a, ka kam sunga namsau tawh amate ka do ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpite tunga Hlagau thugen khu bil nei poma in za taheh. Keima in a guolzo mi zosiete tungah phuolsel manna kimkhat ka pie ding a, suongkang khat le a tunga min tha kigiel khat zong ka pie ding hi. Tua suongkang pen a ngate simlo koima in thei lo ding hi.","ref":"Pei 16:14-15; 16:33-34; Jhn 6:48-50; Isa 62:2; 65:15"},"18":{"text":"“Thyatira hlattuom pawlpi’ vantung mi tungah giel in: Meikuong kileh banga mit nei pa le sumngo banga keng nei pa’ thugen tam bang teng ahi hi:","title":"Thyatira Hlattuom Pawlpi Tunga Thu Kigen"},"19":{"text":"“Na gamtatnate- itna, upna, nasepna, le lungduoi taha na thuozawhnate ka thei hi. Na sep masa pen sangin na sep nukhia pen a thupi zawh lam zong ka thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi vangin nang tungah mawsah ding thu tami ka nei hi: Nang in numei-pasal pahtatna le milim biehna ante ne dingin ka nasemte hilin a puikhiel, ama le ama kamsang a kici numei Jezebel na kham sih hi.","ref":"1Kum 16:31; 2Kum 9:22, 30"},"21":{"text":"Tua numei a kisia nading hun ka pieh vangin a numei-pasal pahtatna panin a kisia nuom tuon sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Kidawm un, tua nu tawh a pahtatnate uh panin a kisiakia sih uleh, tua numei le ama tawh a pahtat zosie lupna ka ngahsah ding a, gimna lienpi ka thuohsah ding hi;"},"23":{"text":"tuale keima in tua numei’ tate ka satlia ding hi. Tua ciengin hlattuom pawlpite zosie in kei pen lungsim le lungtang a sui pa ka hi lam ei thei ding vua, khat ciet tungah na gamtatna utawh kituohin kang thuhkia ding hi.","ref":"Late 7:9; Jer 17:10; Late 62:12"},"24":{"text":"Hinanle Thyatira khuo sunga om tami thuhilna a pom lo, mi pawlkhat in, ‘Satan’ thuthuh pite,’ a ci thute zong a sin kha vawt lo no adang teng tungah keima in vangih dang khatpo kang suon sih hi, ci thu kang gen hi."},"25":{"text":"Kang pei masangin na neisun teng uh na tukip bembom un."},"26":{"text":"A guolzo le ka nasepna a tawp tanpha-a a zomsuoh mi zosie tungah, keima in minamte tungah thuneina ka pie ding a,"},"27":{"text":"leibeelte a kisatguoi bangin ama in sia ciengpum tawh amate uh ding hi,","ref":"Late 2:8-9"},"28":{"text":"keima zong ka Pa kung panin thuneina nga ka hi hi. Keima in zong a guolzo mi pa tungah zingsol aasi ka pie ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpite tunga Hlagau thugen khu bil nei poma in za taheh."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sardis khuo hlattuom pawlpi’ vantungmi tungah giel in: Pasien’ hlagau sagi le aasi sagi a nei pa’ thugen tam bang ahi hi: “Na nasepte ka thei a, a hing min na puoh vangin a si na hi bo hi.","title":"Sardis Hlattuom Pawlpi Tunga Thu Kigen"},"2":{"text":"Khanglo inlen, a si dihtaha om a hing lai mite thakhausah in. Bangzieh ahei cile ka Pasien mai-ah na nasepnate a bucingin ka mu sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin na sansa le na zahsa thute phawhkia inlen, tua thute zui-in kisiakia in. Na khahlaw sih leh na kungah guta bangin kang pei ding a, kang pei hun ding na thei sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat 24:43-44; Luk 12:39-40; Kln 16:15"},"4":{"text":"Hizongle Sardis khuo ah a puonsil uh a niehsah lo mi themkhat na nei lai hi. Amate a kilawm ahi ziehin puonpaa silin kei tawh vah kawikawi ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na guolzaw leh nang zong amate bangin puonpaa ang kisilsah ding a, hinna laibu sung panin na min ka phiet sih ding hi. Ka Pa mai le ama’ vantungmite mai-ah na min ka pulah ding hi.","ref":"Pei 32:32-33; Late 69:28; Kln 20:12; Mat 10:32; Luk 12:8"},"6":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpite tunga Hlagau thugen khu bil nei poma in za taheh."},"7":{"text":"“Philadelphia khuo hlattuom pawlpi’ vantung mi tungah giel in: A siengtho, a thuman pa, David’ tawhtang nei pa, a hon ciengin koima in kha zo loin, a kha ciengin koima in a hon zo lo pa’ thugen tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Philadelphia Hlattuom Pawlpi tunga Thu Kigen","ref":"Isa 22:22; Job 12:14"},"8":{"text":"“Na nasepnate ka thei hi. En in, koima in a kha zo lo kot honsa khat na mai-ah ka koi hi. Thahatna themno khat beh na nei vangin ka thu zui-in keima’ min na nuol lo lam ka thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Na mai-ah Jew mi hi lo napi ka hi uhi, ci-a zuou a gen Satan’ pawlte peisahin na kephungah ka bawhsah ding a, tuaci’n nang kang it lam amate ka theisah ding hi.","ref":"Isa 49:23; 60:14; 43:4"},"10":{"text":"Lungduoi tahin thuohzawhna thu tawh kisai ka thu zui zo na hi ziehin, leitunga teng mite sittel nadingin leitung buppi-a ang tung ding hahsatna hun panin kang kem ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima kang pei bai ta ding hi; koima in na kumpi lukhu ang lahpieh lo nadingin na neisate tukip in."},"12":{"text":"Guol na zaw leh ka Pasien’ biehinnpi sungah khuompi kang suohsah ding a, tua panin na pusuoh ngai nawn sih ding hi. Ama tungah ka Pasien’ min le ka Pasien kung vantung pana ang kumsuh Jerusalem khuo tha ahi, ka Pasien’ khuopi’ min le keima’ min tha ka giel ding hi.","ref":"Kln 21:2; Isa 62:2; 65:15"},"13":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpite tunga Hlagau thugen khu bil nei poma in za taheh."},"14":{"text":"“Laodicea khuo hlattuom pawlpi’ vantungmi tungah giel in: Pasien’ siem nate’ a bul, a muonhuoi le a thuman teci ahi Amen’ thugen tam bang ahi hi:","title":"Laodicea Hlattuom Pawlpi Tunga Thu Kigen","ref":"Pau 8:22"},"15":{"text":"“Na nasepnate ka thei hi; vot lah vot lo, sa lah sa loin na om hi. Na vot leh vot kicien inlen, na sat lezong sa kicien vet lacin ka dei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n vot lah vot lo, sa lah sa loin lum lemlem na hi ziehin ka kam sung panin kang sekhie ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Azieh pen nang in, ‘Kei ka hau a, ka nuomsa hi. Tasap bangma ka nei sih hi,’ na ci hi. Hinanle a genthei, a hepihuoi, a zawng, a mittaw, le a guohtanga om na hi lam na kithei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin na hau thei nadingin kei kung panin mei tawh a kihalsiengsa kham, guohtanga om na hi lam mite ang muna panin na zum sel nadingin na sil ding puonpaa, khuo na mu thei nadingin mitza na lei nadingin thu kang hil hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in ka itte phawhsie-in thu ka hil hi.","ref":"Pau 3:12; Heb 12:6"},"20":{"text":"Ngai in! Kotkhah gei-ah dingin kot ka kiu hi; ka aw za a, kot nei hon leh na sungah hing lutin nang tawh an netonin, nang in zong kei tawh an na neton ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Keimama guolzo-in ka Pa tawh ama’ topha tungah ka toton ma bangin, a guolzo pa zong ka topha tungah keima tawh a toton thei nading mun khat ka pie ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hlattuom pawlpite tunga Hlagau thugen khu bil nei poma in za taheh,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin ka khuodah leh vantungah kot kihongsa khat ka mu hi! Tuale pengkul tawh a kibang, ei hopi awging ka zah masa pen in, “Tanah hing kato in, tam zaw cienga thupieng dingte kang lah ding hi,” ei ci hi.","title":"Vantung Biehna"},"2":{"text":"Thakhatthu-in hlagau in ei luodim a, tuale vantungah kumpi topha khat ang kidaw a, tua kumpi topha tungah mi khat ang to hi!"},"3":{"text":"Khumi kumpi topha tunga a to pa pen jasper le carnelian suongmanpha tawh kibang a, kumpi topha kimvelah emerald suongmanpha tawh a kibang sakhi-guihlung khat a om hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:26-28; 10:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua kumpi topha kimvelah kumpi topha sawm ni le li ma om a, tua kumpi tophate tungah puontuol kang silin a lu tung vuah kham lukhu a khu upa sawm ni le li a to uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua kumpi topha panin tun ang phe a, keh kie-in van ang to vapual a, tuaci’n kumpi topha mai-ah Pasien’ hlagau sagite ahi meivah sagi kivah hi.","ref":"Pei 19:16; Kln 8:5; 11:19; 16:18; Ezk 1:13; Kln 1:4; Zech 4:2"},"6":{"text":"Kumpi topha mai-ah crystal suong tawh a kibang le limlang tuipi tawh a kibang khat a om hi. Kumpi topha kimvel le a pang tuohah a nua a ma-ah mittang a dima a nei ganhing li a om hi:","ref":"Ezk 1:22"},"7":{"text":"Ganhing masa pen humpi tawh kibang a, a nina pen bawngtang tawh kisunin, a thumna pen in mihing maitang bang nei a, a lina pen a lenglai muvanlai tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:5-10; 10:14"},"8":{"text":"Ganhing lite in hla guh ciet nei-in, tua a hlate’ kimvel le a sung lamah mittang a dim hi. A sun a zanin khawl loin, “A omsa, tuhun-a om, le ang pei lai ding Vanglien Topa Pasien, Siengtho, siengtho, siengtho hi, ci-in la a sa uhi.","ref":"Ezk 1:18; 10:12; Isa 6:2-3"},"9":{"text":"Tua ganhingte in kumpi topha tunga a to a hingzing pa tungah minthanna, patawina le lungdamkona a nei sielun,"},"10":{"text":"kumpi topha tunga a to a hingzing pa mai-ah tua upa sawmni le lite in khupbawhin a bie uhi. Amate in kumpi topha mai-ah a lukhute uh pai-in,"},"11":{"text":"“Kote’ Topa le Pasien aw, minthanna, patawina, le vanglietna nga dingin na kilawm hi. Azieh pen sil bangkim na piengsah a, na deina bangin tuate omin kipiengsah hi, ” ci-in la a sa uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi topha tunga a to pa zietlam khutah a sunglam le a pulama kigiel ciemtena sagi tawh kiciemte laiziel khat ka mu hi.","title":"Laiziel le Tuuno","ref":"Ezk 2:9-10; Isa 29:11"},"2":{"text":"Tuale a thahat vantungmi khat in, “Tua laiziel a phen ding le a ciemtenate a phel dinga a kilawm koi ahei,” ci-in awging tawh a kiko ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuale vantung ahi a, leitung ahi a, leinei ahi zongin tuami laiziel phenin a sung a en thei ding koima om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua laiziel a phen ding le a sung a en dinga a kilawm mi koima a kimu lo ziehin nahpi tahin ka kap hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin upate khat in keima kungah, “Kap sin. En in, David’ Zungpi Judah minam Humpi in laiziel le a ciemtenate a phen thei nadingin guolzo ta hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Pien 49:9; Isa 11:1, 10"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin tua kumpi topha le ganhing lite kikal le upate lahah a kigosa tawh a kibang, ki sagi le mittang sagi a nei tuuno a ding khat ka mu a, tuate pen leitung zosie-a kisawl Pasien’ hlagau sagite ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 53:7; Zech 4:10"},"7":{"text":"Ama pei-in kumpi topha tunga a to pa’ zietlam khuta laiziel a la hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua laiziel a lah zaw ciengin tuuno mai-ah ganhing lite le upa sawmni le lite a khupbawh uhi. Amate in mi siengthote’ thungetna ahi harp lasahna khat ciet le panamtui a dima kikoi kham kuong khat ciet a tawi uhi.","ref":"Late 141:2"},"9":{"text":"Amate in la tha khat, “Laiziel a la ding le a ciemtenate a phen dingin nang na kilawm hi, azieh pen nang ang kigo zo a, Pasien adingin be namcin, ham namcin, mi namcin, minam namcin panin na sisan tawh mite na tan zo hi;","ref":"Late 33:3; 98:1; Isa 42:10"},"10":{"text":"ka Pasien uh’ na a sem dingin kumpi za le siempu za na pie zo a, amate in leitung a uh ding uhi,” ci-in a sa uhi.","ref":"Pei 19:6; Kln 1:6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka khuodah leh kumpi topha, ganhingte le upate kimvela a om vantungmite’ awging ka za hi. A tam dan uh ahile a tul a then ahi vua,","ref":"Dan 7:10"},"12":{"text":"amate in, “A kigo tuuno khu vanglietna le hauna, pilna le thahatna, patawina, minthanna, le phatna nga dingin a kilawm hi!” ci-in a aw nei za-in la a sa uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantung, leitung, leinei, tuipi sung le tuate sunga a om a kipiengsah ganhing zosie in, Kumpi topha tunga a to pa tung le Tuuno tungah phatna, patawina, minthanna le vanglietna om den tawntung taheh!” ci-in la a sa uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuale ganhing lite in, “Amen!” a ci vua, a upate in zong khupbawhin a bie uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin Tuuno in ciemtena sagite lahah khat a phen ka mu a, ganhing lite lah pan khat in vanto ging bangin, “Hing pei in! “ a ci ka za hi.","title":"Ciemtena Sagite"},"2":{"text":"Ka khuodah leh sakol kang khat na om hi! Sakol tunga a tuong pa in thal khat tawi-in ama tungah kumpi lukhu khat kipie a, tuaci’n guolzo pa hina tawh a guolzo dingin ama a kuonkhie hi.","ref":"Zech 1:8; 6:3, 6"},"3":{"text":"Ciemtena a nina a phen ciengin ganhing a nina in, “Hing pei in! “ a ci ka za hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin sakol san dang khat ang pusuoh hi. Tuale mite khatlekhat a kitha thei nadingun a tunga tuong pa in leitung panin kilemna a lahkhiet thei nadingin thu kipie hi; namsau golpi khat zong kipie lai hi.","ref":"Zech 1:8; 6:2"},"5":{"text":"Ciemtena a thumna a phen ciengin ganhing a thumna in, “Hing pei in! “ a ci ka za hi. Ka khuodah leh sakol vom khat na om hi! A tunga tuong pa in tawitena kop khat a khutah tawi hi.","ref":"Zech 6:2, 6"},"6":{"text":"Tuale ganhing lite laikimah awging tawh a kibang khat ka za a, “Ni khat thaman dingin mangbu quart khat le ni khat thaman dingin mangbu-ham quart thum hi a, ahi vangin oliv thau le lenggazu susie sin!” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ciemtena a lina a phen ciengin ganhing a lina in, “Hing pei in! “ a ci ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka khuodah leh sakol kang daang khat na om hi! A tunga tuong pa’ min pen Sina hi a, Misi khuo in ama nua a zui hi. Amate in namsau, kielpi, pulnatna, le gamsate tawh leitung seli-suo-sekhat a tha thei nadingun thuneina kipie hi.","ref":"Ezk 14:21"},"9":{"text":"Ciemtena a ngana a phen ciengin maitam nei-ah Pasien’ thu hang le teci a panna hang vua thana a thuoh mite’ hlagau ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in, “A thuman le a siengtho, Thunei pen pa aw, nangma in leitunga a teng mite tungah thukhenin ka sisan phu uh na lah masang bangtan sawt lai ding ahei?” ci-in nahpi tahin a kiko uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate tungah puontuol kang khat ciet kipie a, amate a kitha bangin a sawt lo-a kithat lai ding a naseppite ule a sanggamte uh a kim sieng masangsie bakhat sung a khawl phot dingun amate kungah kigen hi."},"12":{"text":"Ciemtena a guhna a phen ciengin ka khuodah leh, zil nasie tahin ang ling a, ni zong la-ip puon bangin ang vomin, hlapi pen a buppi-in sisan bangin ang san hi.","ref":"Kln 11:13; 16:18; Isa 13:10; Joel 2:10, 31; 3:15; Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25"},"13":{"text":"Huipi a lan ciengin theipuomte a pul sieng bangin vana aasite lei-ah ang kiesuh hi."},"14":{"text":"Laiziel a kizieltum bangin vanpi zong kizielin ang maimang a, muolpi le tuikul zosie a opna mun panin ang kikhinmang uhi.","ref":"Isa 34:4; Kln 16:20"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin leitung kumpite, miliente, galkapmangte, mihaute, mi thuneite, silate le sila lote a kipanin mi zosie, leikuohawm sung lah le muoltung suongpite lahah a kibu vua,","ref":"Isa 2:19, 21"},"16":{"text":"tua muolte le suongpite kungah, “Ka tung vuah hing kiesuh un, kumpi topha tunga a to pa’ maitang pan le Tuuno thangpaina panin ei lie un;","ref":"Hos 10:8; Luk 23:30"},"17":{"text":"azieh pen amau’ thangpaina ni thupi hing tung zo ta ahi ziehin koi in thuoh zo ding ahei?” a ci uhi.","ref":"Joel 2:11; Mal 3:2"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin leitung kiuli-a a ding vantungmi li ka mu a, amate in leitung, tuipi tung, le singkung khatpo a mutmang zo lo nadingin tua leitung hui lite a tukon uhi.","title":"A Kiciemtesa Israel Mi 144,000","ref":"Jer 49:36; Dan 7:2; Zech 6:5"},"2":{"text":"Nisuona lam panin a hingzing Pasien’ ciemtena a nei vantungmi adang khat ang kato ka mu a, ama in leitung le tuipi a suhsiet thei nadinga vanglietna kipiesa vantungmi lite nahpi tahin hlan a,"},"3":{"text":"amate kungah, “I Pasien nasemte’ talpang tungah ciemtena i khet zo masangsie leitung, tuipi, le singkungte susie nai sih un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Ezk 9:4, 6"},"4":{"text":"Tuale cieptesa mi phaza a kisim ka za a, Israel mi nam zosie sung panin mi tul za le tul sawmli le tul li cieptesa ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Judah be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Reuben be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Gad be panin tul sawm le tul ni,"},"6":{"text":"Asher be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Napthtali be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Manasseh be panin tul sawm le tul ni,"},"7":{"text":"Simeon be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Levi be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Issachar be panin tul sawm le tul ni,"},"8":{"text":"Zebulun be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Joseph be panin tul sawm le tul ni, Benjamin be panin tul sawm le tul ni kiciemte hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam zaw ciengin ka khuodah leh mi namcin, be namcin, micin, le ham namcin panin koima’ simzawh lo mihonpi in puonpaa silin, a khut sung vuah lutu na a tawi vua, tuaci’n kumpi topha mai le Tuuno mai-ah a ding uhi.","title":"Minam Zosie panin Mihonpi"},"10":{"text":"Nahpi tahin amate awngin, “Hutdamna khu kumpi topha tunga a to i Pasien ule Tuuno-a’ ahi hi!” a ci uhi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpi topha, upate, le ganhing lite kimvela a ding vantungmi zosie in kumpi topha mai-ah kunin Pasien a bie vua,"},"12":{"text":"“Amen! I Pasien uh tungah minthanna, pilna, lungdam kona, patawina, vanglietna, le hatna om den tawntung taheh! Amen” ci-in la a sa uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin upate khat in, “Tami puontuol paa silte koite hi a, hei pana hing pei uh ahei?” ci-in ei dong hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in, “Siepa aw, a thei nang na hi hi,” ka ci hi. Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “Tam mite pen gimna lienpi pana ang pei ahi uhi; amate in a puontuolte uh Tuuno sisan sungah sawp siengin a paasah zo uhi.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Mat 24:21; Mrk 13:19"},"15":{"text":"Tami ziehin amate Pasien’ topha mai-ah a om vua, sun le zanin a biehinnpi sungah ama’ na a sem uhi. Kumpi topha tunga a to pa in amate a dal ding hi"},"16":{"text":"Amate gilkiel ngai nawn loin, zong dangta ngai nawn lo ding uhi; nisa in zong ka ngai nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Isa 49:10"},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile kumpi topha laikima om Tuuno khu amate a cing pa hi ding a, hinna tuinah ah amate a peipi ding hi. Tuale Pasien in a mittang panun hlitui zosie a nulsieng pieh ding hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Late 23:1; Ezk 34:23; Late 23:2; Isa 49:10; 25:8"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuuno in ciemtena sagina a phen ciengin nai lang sung bang vantungah a kisip dide hi.","title":"Ciemtena Sagina le Gimnamtui Halna Kham Kuong"},"2":{"text":"Tuale Pasien mai-a a ding vantungmi sagi ka mu a, amate pengkul sagi kipie hi."},"3":{"text":"Gimnamtui halna kham kuong a tawi vantungmi adang khat hing pei-in maitam ah ang ding hi; misiengtho zosie’ thungetna tawh kumpi topha mai-a kham maitam tungah a piehton dingin ama tungah panamtui tampitah kipie hi.","ref":"Amos 9:1; Pei 30:1, 3"},"4":{"text":"Misiengthote’ thungetna tawh tua vantungmi’ khut sung panin Pasien mai-ah gimnamtui khute a kato hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungmi in tua gimnamtui kuong la a, a sungah maitam panin mei-am a dimin koi-in leitungah a paisuh leh van hing to-in keh ang kie a, tun ang phe-in zil ang ling hi.","ref":"Siem 16:12; Ezk 10:2; Pei 19:16; Kln 11:19; 16:18"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin pengkul sagi a tawi vantungmi sagite pengkul mut dingin a baisa-in a om uhi.","title":"Pengkul Sagite"},"7":{"text":"A khatna vantungmi in a pengkul a mut leh sisan tawh a kihal giel le mei ang omin leitungah tuate a kisepsuh hi; tuale leitung sethum-suo-sekhat katumin singkung sethum-suo-sekhat zong katum a, lopa zosie zong a katum hi.","ref":"Pei 9:23-25; Ezk 38:22"},"8":{"text":"A nina vantungmi in a pengkul a mut leh mei in a kah muol golpi tawh a kibang na khat tuipi sungah kipaisuh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuipi sethum-suo-sekhat sisan suohin tuipi sunga a om ganhing sethum-suo-sekhat si a, tembaw sethum-suo-sekhat kisie hi."},"10":{"text":"A thumna vantungmi in a pengkul a mut leh meila banga a kuong aasi golpi khat vantung panin ang kiesuh a, gunte le tuinahte sethum-suo-sekhat tungah tusuh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:12"},"11":{"text":"Tua aasi’ min Gamsai ahi hi. Tuite sethum-suo-sekhat gamsai tui suoh a, tuami tui pen aicimtangkha a bah ziehin a dawn mi tampitah a si uhi.","ref":"Jer 9:15"},"12":{"text":"A lina vantungmi in a pengkul a mut leh a tanna uh sethum-suo-sekhat a miel thei nadingin ni sethum-suo-sekhat, hla zong sethum-suo-sekhat ma, le aasi sethum-suo-sekhat kisusie a, tuaci’n sun zong sethum-suo-sekhat miel a, tua ma bangin zan zong sethum-suo-sekhat ma a miel hi.","ref":"Isa 13:10; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:10, 31; 3:15"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka khuodah leh vankim lai-ah muvanlai khat a len kawmin, “Adang vantungmi thumte in a mut dinga a kisah uh pengkul gingte ziehin leitunga teng mite tungah, “Gimna, gimna, gimna ang tung ding hi!” ci-in nahpi taha a kiko ka za hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ngana vantungmi in a pengkul a mut leh van panin lei ah aasi kiesuh khat ka mu a, mong nei lo kuohawm vang honna tawhtang ama kipie hi;"},"2":{"text":"ama in tua kuohawm vang ang hong leh meiphuolpi pana meikhu bangin tua a vang panin meikhu ang pusuoh a, tua a vang pana meikhu ziehin ni le van a miel hi.","ref":"Pien 19:28"},"3":{"text":"Tua meikhu sung panin leitungah kauphete ang pusuoh a, leitungah mom-aite’ thuneina bangin amate thuneina kipie hi.","ref":"Pei 10:12-15"},"4":{"text":"Leitunga a po lopate, sing hingte, le singkung khat popo susie loin, a talpang tung vua Pasien’ ciemtena a nei lote beh susie dingin amate thu kipie hi.","ref":"Ezk 9:4"},"5":{"text":"Amate in tua mite that loin hla nga sung a bawlsiet nadingun phalna kipie a, amau’ thuoh gimna ahile mom-ai in mi a pe cienga a nat bang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum ni ciengin mite in sina a sui ding vua, ahi vangin a mu sih ding uhi; a si nuom ding vua, ahi vangin amate kung panin sina a taimang ding hi.","ref":"Job 3:21; Jer 8:3"},"7":{"text":"Tua kauphete’ melpuoh dan pen gal kuon dinga a kivon sakolte tawh kibang hi. A lu tung vuah kham lukhu tawh kibang a khu vua, a maitang uh pen mihing maitang tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Joel 2:4"},"8":{"text":"A sam uh numeite sam bang a, a hate uh humpite’ ha tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Joel 1:6"},"9":{"text":"Sia awmdal tawh a kibang awmdal a nei vua, a hlazap ging uh pen gal sim dinga a tai sakol leeng honpite’ gin tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Joel 2:5"},"10":{"text":"Mom-ai bangin mei nei-in mi de thei a, a mei vuah hla nga sung mite gimsah thei nading gu nei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in kumpi-in mong nei lo tua kuohawm a uh vantungmi a nei uhi; a min Hebrew hamin Abaddon kici a, Greek hamin Apollyon kici hi."},"12":{"text":"Gimna masa pen tawp zo hi. Gimna nam ni ang tung lai ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciengin a guhna vantungmi in pengkul a tum leh Pasien mai-a om kham maitam’ ki li panin awging ka za a,","ref":"Pei 30:1-3"},"14":{"text":"pengkul nei vantungmi a guhna kungah, “Euphrates gunpi-a kihen vantungmi lite hlakhie in,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaci’n mihingte sethum-suo-sekhat a tha ding uh a kum, a hla, a ni, a nai ngaha a baisa-a kikoi tua vantungmi lite a kihlakhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Sakol tung tuong galkapte awn zani a pha hi; tuaci’n keima in a mi phaza ka za hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka mangmuna sunga sakolte ka mu dan tam bang ahi hi: Sakol tung tuongte in mei, sapphire suong manpha le kaat mel tawh a kibang awmdalte a sil uh ka mu hi. Tua sakolte’ lutang pen humpite’ lutang tawh kibang a, a kam panun meikuong, meikhu, le kaat a pusuoh hi."},"18":{"text":"A kam pan vua a pusuoh meikuong, meikhu, le kaat, tam gimna thumte in mihingte sethum-suo-sekhat a thatlia hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile sakolte’ vanglietna pen a kam le a mei vuah a om hi. A mei uh pen gul tawh kibangin lutang nei a, a meite utawh mi a liemsah uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tami gimnate ziehin a si lo a omlai mite in a khut vua a bawl uh nasepte panin a kisia sih vua, dawite le a mu thei lo, a za thei lo, le a pei thei lo kham, ngun, sumngo, le sing le suong milimte a bieh uh a tawp tuom sih uhi.","ref":"Late 115:4-7; 135:15-17; Dan 5:23"},"21":{"text":"A mi thana, a aisanna, a numei-pasal pahtathna, le a guhtatnate uh panin zong a kisia tuom sih uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale vantung panin a thahat adang vantungmi khat ang kumsuh ka mu a, ama meiipi-in a kituom a, a lu tung sonah sakhi-guihlung khat a om hi; a maitang ni bangin tang a, a kengte meikuong khuompite tawh kibang hi.","title":"Vantungmi le Laiziel Neu"},"2":{"text":"A khut sungah laiziel neu khat phensa-in a tawi hi. Tuipi tungah a zietlam keng nga-in leitungah a veilam keng nga a,"},"3":{"text":"humpi hawh bangin a hawh vapuoh hi. A hawh ciengin vanto sagite aw ang ging hi."},"4":{"text":"Vanto sagite ang gin zaw ciengin kei zong a giel dingin ka kisa leh, “Vanto sagite’ thugente giel sinlen imcip in,” ci-in vantung panin aw khat ka za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka musa tuipi tung le leitunga a ding vantungmi in, van lamah a zietlam khut lamto-in"},"6":{"text":"kumtawnin a hingzing pa, vantung le a sunga omte, leitung le a sunga omte, tuipi le a sunga omte a siempa tawh kiciem hi: “A kiheh nawn sih ding hi,"},"7":{"text":"ahi vangin a sagina vantungmi in a pengkul ang mut ding ni ciengin ama in kamsang ama’ nasemte kungah a tangko ma bangin Pasien’ thusim ang tangtung ta ding hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Pei 20:11; Thkna 32:40; Dan 12:7; Amos 3:7"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantung panin ei kihopina aw khat ka zakia a, “Pei inlen tuipi tung le leitunga a ding vantungmi khut sunga a kiphensa laiziel va la ta’n,” ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci’n vantungmi kungah ka pei a, tua laiziel neu ei pie in, ci-in ka gen hi; tuale ama in keima kungah, “Tami la inlen ne in; na gilpi sungah ang kha ding a, hinanle na kam sungah khuoizu bangin ang hlum ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaci’n vantungmi khut sung panin tua laiziel neu la-in ka ne hi; ka kam sungah khuoizu bangin hlum a, ahi vangin ka neh zaw ciengin ka gilpi a khasah hi.","ref":"Ezk 2:8–3:3"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin amate in keima kungah, “Nang in mi tampite, minamte, ham tuomtuomte, le kumpite tawh kisai genkholnate, na genkia pelmaw ding hi,” ei ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ciengkhut tawh kibang tena cieng khat ei kipie a, “Hing pei-in Pasien’ biehinnpi le maitam te inlen, biehinnpi sunga om a bie mite zong sim in,” ei kici hi,","title":"Teci Nite","ref":"Ezk 40:3; Zech 2:1-2"},"2":{"text":"ahi vangin biehinnpi pulam tuol pen te sinlen nuasie in; azieh pen tua khu minam dangte’ khut sunga a kipiesa ahi a, amate in khuopi siengtho hla sawmli le hla ni sung a tuoncil ding uhi.","ref":"Luk 21:24"},"3":{"text":"Ka teci nite la-ip puonpi silin ni tulkhat zani le sawmguh sung thugen theina ka pie ding hi,” ei ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua teci nite pen leitung Topa mai-a a ding oliv singkung nite le meivah tunna nite ahi uhi.","ref":"Zech 4:3, 11-14"},"5":{"text":"Tuale mi khatpo in ama gel a suhsiet nop leh a kam sung panun meikuong pusuohin a galte katum ding a, ama gel susie nuom popo tam bangin kithat ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A thugen hun sungun ama gel tungah guo a zuh lo nadingin van a khacip nading thuneina, tuite sisan suosah thei nading thuneina, a dei hunhunun gimna namcin tawh leitung a suhsiet thei nading thuneina kipie hi.","ref":"1Kum 17:1; Pei 7:17-19; 1Sam 4:8"},"7":{"text":"Amau’ teci panna a man zaw ciengin a mong nei lo kuohawm pana ang kato gamsa in tua teci pangte gel simin zogawpin that ding a,","ref":"Dan 7:7, 21; Kln 13:5-7; 17:8"},"8":{"text":"tuale ama gel’ luonghawm pen a Topa uh zong singlamte tunga a kikhaina mun khuopi lampi tungah kisiel ding hi, tua khuopi’ minhem pen Sodom le Egypt kici hi.","ref":"Isa 1:9-10"},"9":{"text":"Be le phung, kamham, le minam zosie panin mite in ni thum le alang sung amau’ luonghawm a en ding vua, hankhuh sunga a kivui ding a phal sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tami kamsang nite in leitunga tengte tungah bawlsietna a tunsah ziehun ama’ gel sina hangin leitunga tengte thangpha-in pawi bawlin khatlekhat letsong a kipie ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi vangin ni thum le a lang zaw ciengin ama gel sungah Pasien’ hu lutin, a keng-un ang ding vua, tuaci’n ama gel a mu mite a zau mama uhi.","ref":"Ezk 37:10"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama gel in, “Tanah hing kato ta gel in!” ci-in vantung panin awging ngai khat a za uhi. Tuale a galte uh’ mitmu-in meii tung tuongin vantungah a kato ta gel hi.","ref":"2Kum 2:11"},"13":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin nasie tahin zil ang ling a, khuopi sesawm-suo-sekhat cimguoi-in zil a lin ziehin mi tul sagi si a, adang teng zausi-in vantunga om Pasien a phat uhi.","ref":"Kln 6:12; 16:18"},"14":{"text":"Gimna nina tawp zo ta hi. Gimna a thumna ang tung bai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungmi sagina in a pengkul a mut leh vantungah aw ngai mama khat ang ging a, Leitung kumpi gam pen i Topa ule ama’ Messiah-a’ suoh zo a, ama in kumtawnin uh zing ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Pengkul Sagina","ref":"Pei 15:18; Dan 2:24; 7:14, 27"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciengin Pasien mai a topha ciet vua a to upa sawmni le lite a mai vuah kunin Pasien a bie vua,"},"17":{"text":"“Tulai tahin a om, a om ngaisa, Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, lungdam kang ko uhi, azieh pen nang in na vanglietna lienpi na la zo a, gam uh dingin na kipan zo ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Minamte a thangpai vua, hinanle na lungthahna ang tung zo ta hi. Misite tunga thukhen ding hun le, na nasem kamsangte, na min a zatah na misiengtho a neu a lien in, patah man pieh ding hun le, leitung a susie mite a kisuhsiet ding hun ang tung zo ta hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Late 2:5; 110:5; 115:13"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantunga om Pasien’ biehinnpi kihong a, tua biehinnpi sungah thuciemna singkuong kimu hi; tuale tun ang phe a, van ang to-in keh ang kie a, zil ang lingin gielpi ang kie hi.","ref":"Kln 8:5; 16:18, 21"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantungah a gol lim lamdang khat ang kilang a, numei khat in puon sil bangin ni silin a keng nei-ah hlapi koi a, a lu tungah aasi sawm le ni tawh a kizem kumpi lukhu a khu hi.","title":"Numei le Gulhiempi"},"2":{"text":"Tua numei pen a gai ahi a, nau suoh natna in a tut ziehin na sa-in a peng vagua hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungah lim lamdang adang khat ang kilang leuleu hi: gulhiempi a san a gol mama khat in lutang sagi le ki sawm nei-in, a lu tungah kumpi lukhu sagi khu hi.","ref":"Dan 7:7"},"4":{"text":"A mei in vantunga aasite sethum-suo-sekhat kaikhie-in tua teng leitungah kikhiesuh hi. Tua ciengin nau a suo lien cienga a neh thei nadingin nau suoh kuon numei nu mai-ah tua gulhiempi a ding hi.","ref":"Dan 8:10"},"5":{"text":"Numei ang suoh a, sia ciengkhut tawh minam zosie a uh ding ta pasal khat ang nei hi. Ahi vangin a tapa kila-in Pasien le a topha tungah kipeipi hi.","ref":"Isa 66:7; Late 2:9"},"6":{"text":"Ni tul le zani le sawmguh sung a kiva dingin Pasien in a bawlpiehsa mun khatah tua numei nu a tai hi."},"7":{"text":"Vantungah gal kidona ang om hi; Michael le ama’ vantungmite in gulhiempi a do uhi. Tua gulhiempi le vantungmite in zong a dokia vua,","title":"Michael in Gulhiempi Zo","ref":"Dan 10:13, 21; 12:1; Jude 9"},"8":{"text":"ahi vangin gal lel uh ahi ziehin vantungah amate adingin mun a om nawn sih hi."},"9":{"text":"A gol mama gulhiempi, dawimangpa le Satan a kici leitung buppi a sol pa, tanglai gulpi lei ah kikhiesuh hi, ama pen a vantungmite tawh kikhiesuh hi.","ref":"Pien 3:1; Luk 10:18"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungah aw ngai mama khat ka za a, “Tu-in i Pasien’ hutdamna, a vanglietna, a gam le ama’ Messiah thuneina ang tung zo ta hi. Azieh pen i Pasien mai-ah i kithuopite sun le zana mawsah pa kikhiesuh zo ta hi.","ref":"Job 1:9-11; Zech 3:1"},"11":{"text":"Hizongle amate in Tuuno sisan zieh le amau’ teci panna thu ziehin ama a zo uhi. Azieh pen amate in sina a thuoh dongun a nuntahna nangawn uh a it sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hi a, no vantungte le a sunga tengte aw, kipah un! Ahi vangin leitung le tuipi in gimna a thuoh ding uhi, azieh pen dawimangpa in a hun a tom lamtah a thei ziehin lungthahna lienpi tawh na kung vuah ang peisuh hi!” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaci’n gulhiempi in leitungah ama a kikhiehsuh zo lamtah a thei bepin ama in ta pasal a nei numei ang del hi.","title":"Gulhiempi in Leitung Simkia"},"14":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua gulpi kung panin suohta-in hun khat, hunte, le hun lang sung a kiva nading ama’ mun ahi gamlahah a len thei nadingin a gol mama muvanlai’ hla ni tua numei kipie hi.","ref":"Dan 7:25; 12:7"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuikhang in numei a tawmang thei nadingin gulpi in a kam panin guntui bangin numei nu’ nua lamah tui a luongsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi vangin lei in numei nu panpi a, a kam kahin tua gulhiempi in a kam pana a pusuoh guntui a hupkang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin numei tungah gulhiempi thangpai a, Pasien’ thupieh a pomte, Jesu’ teci panna a pomte, le a omlai numei’ suonlehlahte sim dingin a kuonkhie hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin tuipi gei-a senel tungah gulpi a ding hi.","title":"A Khatna Gamsa"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuale ki sawm le lutang sagi a nei gamsa khat tuipi pana ang pusuoh ka mu hi; a kite tungah kumpi lukhu sawm omin, a lutangte tungah Pasien gensietna minte a om hi.","ref":"Dan 7:3; Kln 17:3, 7-12"},"2":{"text":"Tua ka gamsa mu pen kamkei tawh kibang a, a kengte vompi-a’ tawh kibangin, a kam humpinelkai’ kam tawh kibang hi. Tuale gulhiempi in a vanglietna, a kumpi topha, le a thuneina lienpi ama a pie hi.","ref":"Dan 7:4-6"},"3":{"text":"A lutang khat in si nading za dongin liemma nei leh kilawm a, hinanle tuami si thei nading liemma pen damkia zo hi. Leitung bup in lamdangsa-in tua gamsa nua a zui uhi."},"4":{"text":"Gulhiempi in tua gamsa tungah thuneina a pieh zo tah ziehin amate in ama a bie vua, “Gamsa tawh a kibang koi om a, koi in ama do zo ding ahei?” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kiphatsahna le Pasien gensietna kammalte a gen nadingin tua gamsa tungah kam khat kipie a, a thuneina a zah hun ding hla sawmli le hla ni sung kipie hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Pasien a gensie dingin a kam kah a, ama’ min le ama’ tenna le vantunga a tengte zosie a gensie hi.","ref":"Dan 7:8, 25; 11:36"},"7":{"text":"Misiengthote tungah galbawlin a zaw nadingin zong phalna kipie hi.
