Ama tungah phung namcin, micin, ham namcin le minam cin kipie a,"},"8":{"text":"leitung piencil a kipanin a kigosa Tuuno’ hinna laibu sunga a min kigiel lo ahi leitunga teng mi zosie in ama a bie ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zah nading bil nei a koimapo in ngai un:"},"10":{"text":"Saltang dinga ang kikai leh saltang ding ma-in na pei ding hi; namsau tawh mi na tha leh namsau ma tawh ang kithat ding hi. Tam sungah misiengthote’ thuohzawh na le upna kalh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin leitung pana ang pusuoh gamsa dang khat ka mu hi; ama in tuuno bangin ki ni nei a, gulhiempi bangin a ham hi.","title":"A Nina Gamsa"},"12":{"text":"Ama in amasa gamsa tangin thuneina zosie zang a, leitung le a sunga tengte in a si nading liemma a damsa tua gamsa masa pen a biesah hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a lien a lamdang limte bawl a, mi zosie’ mu-in vantung pan leitungah mei nangawn a kiesah hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in amasa gamsa tanga a kibawlsah lim lamdangte tawh leitunga a tengte sol a, namsau tawh a liemsa hi napi a hingkia ahi gamsa’ lim khat a bawl nadingun amate thu a pie hi;"},"15":{"text":"tua gamsa’ lim a ham thei nading le gamsa’ lim a bie lote a kitha thei nadingin tua gamsa’ lim sungah hu kimop hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a neu a lien, a zawng a hau, sila le sila lo, mi zosiete a zietlam khut ahi sihle a talpangah a ciemtesah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaci’n gamsa’ min ahi sihle a min’ nambat ahi ciemtena a nei lo poma in van lei thei loin zong zua thei lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tami thu-ah pilna a kisam hi: Pilna a nei poma in tua gamsa’ nambat tuot taheh, bangzieh ahei cile tua pen mi khat’ nambat ahi hi. Tua nambat pen zaguh sawmguh guh ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka khuodah leh Zion Muol tungah Tuuno a dingin na om hi! A talpang tung vua ama’ min le a pa’ min a kigiel mi tul za le tul sawmli le tulli zong ama tawh a omton uhi.","title":"Tuuno le Mi 144,000","ref":"Ezk 9:4; Kln 7:3"},"2":{"text":"Tuale tui tampi ging bang le vanto ging tawh a kibang a ginngai mama aw khat ka za hi. Tua ka zah awging pen harp tumte in a harp lasahna uh a tum cienga awging tawh kibang a,"},"3":{"text":"amate in kumpi topha mai, ganhing lite mai, le upate mai-ah la tha khat a sa uhi. Leitung pana a kitankhiesa mi tulza le tul sawmli le tul lite ci simlo koima dang in tua la sa thei lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam mite ahile numei tawh a bua ngai nai sih uhi, azieh pen amate tangval ahi uhi; tam mite in Tuuno’ peipeina ah a zui kawikawi uhi. Amate Pasien le Tuuno adingin a ga masa pente ahi vua,"},"5":{"text":"a kam sung vuah zuouthu kici kimu loin paubanna a nei sih uhi.","ref":"Zeph 3:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin leitunga a teng mi namkim, be namkim, le mi zosie kungah kumtawn lungdamna thu phuongzah dinga van kimlai-a a leng vantungmi dang khat ka mu hi.","title":"Vantungmi Thumte’ Thugen"},"7":{"text":"Nahpi tahin ama kiko a, “A thukhen nading hun ang tung ta ahi ziehin Pasien giing unlen, ama phat un; van le lei le tuipi le tuinahte a siem pa ama bie un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nina vantungmi dang khat in ei zui a, “Cim ta, a lien mama Babylon khuopi cim ta! Ama nu in a numei-pasal pahtatna tawh a kipawl lungthahna lenggazu minam zosie a dawnsah hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 21:9; Jer 51:8; Kln 18:2"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a thumna vantungmi dang khat in amate zui-in aw lienpi tawh, “Tua gamsa le a lim bie-in a talpang tung uh ahi sihle a khut tung vuah ciemtena khat a nga mite in,"},"10":{"text":"Pasien’ thangpaina hai sungah bangma tawh kihal lo-a kisung Pasien’ lungthahna lenggazu zong a dawn ding vua, amate pen a siengtho vantungmite mai le Tuuno mai-ah meikuong le kaat tawh kibawlsie ding hi.","ref":"Isa 51:17; Pien 19:24; Ezk 38:22"},"11":{"text":"Amau’ kibawlsietna meikhu kumtawnin a kitungto valuh hi. Gamsa le a lim a bie mite le tua gamsa’ min ciemtena a nga tapo adingin sun ahi a, zan ahi zongin tawlngahna himhim a om sih hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.","ref":"Isa 34:10"},"12":{"text":"Tami sungah Pasien thupieh a zui mite le Jesu’ upna a pom misiengthote’ thuohzawhna kalh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuale vantung panin aw khat ka za a, “Tami giel in: Tu-a kipan Topa sunga a site mi hampha ahi hi,” a ci hi. Hlagau in, “Hi hi,” a ci a, “A sepnate un amate nuazui ding ahi ziehin a nasep gimna uh panin a tawlnga ta ding uhi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin ka khuodah leh meiilum kang khat na kai a, tua meiilum kang tungah Mihing Tapa tawh a kibang mi khat to-in, kham lukhu khat khu a, a khut sungah phieukawi hiem khat a tawi hi!","title":"Leitung Anlahna","ref":"Dan 7:13"},"15":{"text":"Biehinnpi panin vantungmi dang khat ang pusuoh a, meiilum kang tunga a to mipa nahpi tahin hlanin, “Leitung an lah hun ang tung zo ta ahi ziehin na phieukawi zang inlen at in, azieh pen leitunga ante min siengin kuotgawp ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joel 3:13"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci’n meiilum tunga a to mipa in leitungah a phieukawi a vat kawikawi leh leitung atsa a suoh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinnpi panin vantung-mi adang khat ang pusuoh a, ama in zong phieukawi hiem khat ma nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciengin mei tunga thunei vantungmi dang khat maitam panin ang pusuoh a, phieukawi hiem tawi mipa nahpi tahin hlanin, “Lenggate min zo ta ahi ziehin na phieukawi hiem zang inlen, leitung lengga gui panin lengga bawhte khawm in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaci’n vantungmi in leitungah a phieukawi a vat kawikawi a, lenggate khawmin Pasien’ thangpaina lengga cilna phuolah a pai hi."},"20":{"text":"Khuopi pulamah lengga kicil a, tua lengga cilna phuol panin sisan luongin, tai zani bang a gamlatna dongah sakol kamkai cieng banin a luong hi.","ref":"Isa 63:3; Kaa 1:15; Kln 19:15"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungah a cizat huoi le a lien mama lim dang khat ka mu a, tua khu a nukhia pen gimna nam sagi a tawi vantungmi sagite ahi uhi, azieh pen amate tawh Pasien’ thangpaina a tawp ahi ta hi.","title":"A Nukhia pen Gimna Sagi tawh Vantungmite"},"2":{"text":"Tuale mei tawh a kihal limlang tuipi bang dan khat ka mu a, gamsa le ama’ min le ama’ nambat tunga guolzote in a khut vuah Pasien’ lasahna harp-te tawi-in tuipi limlang gei-ah a ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in Pasien’ nasem Moses’ la le Tuuno’ la a sa uhi: Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, na nasepte lienin cizat a huoi hi! Minamte’ Kumpipa aw, na lampite thumanin thutang hi!","ref":"Pei 15:1"},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, koi in nang hing giing loin, na min hing phat lo ding ahei? Azieh pen nang beh na siengtho hi. Na thukhennate kilah zo ahi ziehin minam zosie hing pei-in nangma mai-ah ang bie ding uhi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Jer 10:7; Late 86:9"},"5":{"text":"Tua zaw ciengin ka khuodah leh vantunga teci panna puonbuh ahi biehinnpi honsa-in om a,","ref":"Pei 38:21"},"6":{"text":"biehinnpi sung panin gimna sagi tawh vantungmi sagite ang pei vua, a vam lihleh saihadiel puon silin kham kawnggah tawh a awm a gah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciengin ganhing lite sung panin khat in vantungmi sagite, kumtawna a hingzing Pasien’ thangpaina a dim kham hai sagi a pie hi;"},"8":{"text":"tuale Pasien’ minthanna le a vanglietna panin meikhu in biehinnpi sung teng dim a, vantungmi sagite’ gimna sagi a ven masangsie tua biehinnpi sungah koima lut thei lo hi.","ref":"Pei 40:34; 1Kum 8:10-11; 2Khg 5:13-14; Isa 6:4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin biehinnpi panin a gin ngai mama aw khat in vantungmi sagite kungah, “Pei unlen leitungah Pasien’ thangpaina hai sagite va buo ta un,” a ci ka za hi.","title":"Pasien’ Thangpaina Haite"},"2":{"text":"Tuaci’n vantungmi amasa pen pei-in leitungah a hai a buosuh leh gamsa ciemtena a nei le ama’ lim a bie mite tungah a kidahhuoi hima huoisie a tung hi.","ref":"Pei 9:10"},"3":{"text":"Vantungmi a nina in tuipi tungah a hai a buosuh leh tua tuipi pen misite’ sisan tawh kibang a, tuipi sunga a om hinna a nei ganhing zosie a sigam sieng hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantungmi a thumna in gunte le tuinahte tungah a hai a buosuh leh tuate sisan a suoh sieng hi.","ref":"Pei 7:17-21; Late 78:44"},"5":{"text":"Tuale tuite’ a uh vantungmi in, “Nang tulaitaha om, a omsa, Siengtho Pa aw, tam thu teng na khen ziehin nang na thutang hi;"},"6":{"text":"amate in mi siengthote le kamsangte’ sisan a luonsah ziehun, a thuoh ding vua a kilawm bangin a dawn ding uh sisan na pie zo hi!” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuale maitam in, “Hi hi, Vanglien Topa Pasien aw, na thukhente manin thutang hi!” ci-in a dawnkia ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Vantungmi a lina in ni tungah a hai a buosuh leh, ni in amate mei tawh a halgawp thei nadingin phalna kipie hi."},"9":{"text":"A sa mama mei in amate lieu gawp a, hizongle amate in tam gimnate tunga thunei ahi Pasien’ min a gausam vua, kisiakia nuom loin ama a phat nuom sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Vantungmi a ngana in gamsa’ kumpi topha tungah a hai a buosuh leh ama’ gam teng khuo a miel hi; mite in na a sah ziehun a lei uh a pet vua,","ref":"Pei 10:21"},"11":{"text":"tuale a thuoh uh natnate le a himate ziehun van Pasien a gausam vua, a gamtatna uh panin a kisia tuom sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Vantungmi a guhna in Eupharates gun golpi tungah a hai a buosuh leh nisuona lam panin kumpite peina lam siel khol dingin tua tui a gawkang hi.","ref":"Isa 11:15"},"13":{"text":"Tuale gulhiempi’ kam sung, gamsa’ kam sung, le zuou thei kamsangpa’ kam sung panin ukeng tawh a kibang a gilo hlagau thum ang pusuoh ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tamte pen na lamdang bawl dawite’ hla ahi a, leitung buppi-a om kumpite kungah pei-in, Vanglien Pasien’ ni thupi ni-a gal do dingin amate a kaikhawm dinga kuon ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"(“En un, guta bangin kang pei ding hi! A guohtangin pei-in a muolpho lo nadingin khanglo zing a, puon a sil pa pen thupha nga ahi hi,” a ci hi.)","ref":"Mat 24:43-44; Luk 12:39-40; Kln 3:3"},"16":{"text":"Hebrew hamin Harmagedon a kici munah amate in kumpite a khawm uhi.","ref":"2Kum 23:29; Zech 12:11"},"17":{"text":"Vantungmi a sagina in huilahah a hai a buosuh leh biehinnpi sung kumpi topha panin aw ngai mama khat ang ging a, “Man zo hi!” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuale tun ang phe a, van ang to-in keh ang kie a, nahpi-in zil ang lingin gielpi ang kie hi. Leitunga mite a opzaw a kipanin tua bang zil linna a om ngai nai sih hi.","ref":"Kln 8:5; 11:13, 19"},"19":{"text":"Khuopi lien khen thum kisuo-in, minamte’ khuopite a cimmang hi. Pasien in a lien mama Babylon a phawh a, ama’ lungsona lenggazu-hai ama a pie hi.","ref":"Isa 51:17"},"20":{"text":"Tuikul zosie taimang siengin muolte kimu nawn lo hi.","ref":"Kln 6:14"},"21":{"text":"Van panin mite tungah pound zakhat ta a gih giel golpite kiesuhin, gielpi gimna ziehin amate in Pasien a gausam za ding dongin tua gimna zauhuoi mama hi.","ref":"Pei 9:23; Kln 11:19"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin hai sagi a tawi vantungmi sagi hing pei-in keima kungah, “Hing pei in, tuipi tampite tunga a to a lien numei pahtat nu tunga thukhenna kang lah ding hi.","title":"A Lien Numei Pahtat le Gamsa","ref":"Jer 51:13"},"2":{"text":"Leitung kumpite in ama nu tawh pahtatna a bawlton vua, leitunga teng mite in amau’ pahtatna lenggazu a kham uhi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Isa 23:17; Jer 51:7"},"3":{"text":"Tuaci’n ama in hlagau tawh gamlahah ei puomang a, lutang sagi le ki sawm a nei, gensietna minte tawh a kidim a sandup gamsa tunga a to numei khat ka mu hi.","ref":"Kln 13:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua numei in a sandup le a ausan puonte silin, kham, suongmanphate le tui kepte tawh kizem a, a kidahhuoi nate le a pahtatna a niehte tawh a kidim kham hai khat a khutah a tawi hi.","ref":"Jer 51:7"},"5":{"text":"Tuale a talpang tungah: “A lien Babylon khuopi, numei pahtatte le leitunga a kidahhuoi nate’ nu,” ci-in a thuthuh min khat kigiel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua numei in misiengthote’ sisan le Jesu tunga teci a pang mite’ sisan khamin a om ka mu hi. Keima in tua nu ka mu ciengin lamdang ka sa mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Hizongle vantungmi in keima kungah, “Bang dinga lamdang na sah ahei? Tua numei le lutang sagi le ki sawm a nei, ama nu a puo gamsa tawh kisai thuthuh na kungah kang gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua na mu gamsa pen nidangin om ngai-in tu-in om nawn lo hi., mong nei lo lei kawhawm panin a pusuoh dingin ang kisa a, tuale sietna thuoh dingin a pei ding hi. Tua gamsa pen om ngai zo a, tu-in om nawn lo napi ang peikia ding ahi ziehin leitung kisiem cila kipanin hinna laibu sunga a min a kigiel kha lo leitunga teng mite in tua gamsa a mu ciengun lamdang a sa ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 7:7; Kln 11:7; Late 69:28"},"9":{"text":"“Tami thu-ah lungsim pilna kisam hi: Lutang sagite pen tua numei nu tona muol sagite ahi hi; kumpi sagite zong ahi vua,"},"10":{"text":"tuate lahah nga pua zo a, khat om lai a, adang khat pen ang pei nai lo hi; ama ang pei ciengin bakhat sung beh kip ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Khatvei a omsa, tu-in a om nawn lo gamsa pen kumpi gietna hi napi, kumpi sagite-a’ zong hi vanuh a, tuaci’n ama sietna ah a pei hi."},"12":{"text":"Na mu ki sawmte pen kumpi gam a nga nai lo kumpi sawmte ahi vua, hizongle amate in tua gamsa tawh kumpite bangin nai khat sung thuneina a nga ding uhi.","ref":"Dan 7:24"},"13":{"text":"Tua teng kithutuohin a vanglietna ule a thuneina uh tua gamsa tungah a pie uhi;"},"14":{"text":"amate in Tuuno a do ding vua, Tuuno in amate a zo ding hi, azieh pen ama topate’ Topa le kumpite’ Kumpipa ahi a, ama tawh a omton mite ahile a kihlansa, a kiteelsa, le a muonhuoi mite vive ahi uhi,” ei ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuale ama in keima kungah, “Na musa tua numei pahtat nu tona tuite pen mite, mihonpite, minamte, le ham namcinte ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Na musa ki sawmte le tua gamsa in numei pahtat nu a muda ding uhi; amate in tua nu’ neisa zosie lahpiehin a guohtangin a omsah ding vua, a sa ne-in mei tawh a haltum ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Bangzieh ahei cile Pasien’ kammalte a tangtun masangsie, ama’ lungtup a sem dingin kithukimin tua gamsa tungah a kumpi gam uh a pieh nadingun Pasien in amate lungsim sungah tua thu koi zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua na mu numei pen leitung kumpite a uh khuopi lien ahi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami zaw ciengin vantung panin thuneina lienpi a nei vantungmi dang khat ang kumsuh ka mu hi; ama’ thupina tawh leitung a salvah hi.","title":"Babylon Khuopi Cipna"},"2":{"text":"Ama nahpi tahin kiko a, “A lien Babylon khuopi kicim, kicim! Dawite’ tenna mun suoh zo ta a, hlabua zosie’ zuolna mun, a nieh va namcin’ zuolna mun, a kidahhuoi le a mudahuoi gamsa namcin’ zuolna mun suoh zo hi.","ref":"Isa 21:9; Jer 51:8; Kln 14:8; Isa 13:21; Jer 50:39"},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen ama’ pahtatna zieha thangpaina zu khu minam zosie in a kham zo ta vua, leitung kumpite in ama nu tawh pahtatna a bawl vua, leitung sumbawlte in tua nu’ nopsahna a haulaw uhi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 23:17; Jer 51:7"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin van panin awging dang khat ka za a, “Ka mite aw, a mawnate sungah kihalin, a gimnate na thuohpi lo nadingun, tua nu kung panin hing peikhie un.","ref":"Isa 48:20; Jer 50:8; 51:6, 45"},"5":{"text":"Azieh pen tua nu’ mawnate in vantung banin kiciengto a, Pasien in ama nu’ khielnate, a phawh zo hi.","ref":"Pien 18:20-21; Jer 51:9"},"6":{"text":"Ama nu in note ang bawl bangin ama nu tungah zong bawl unlen, ama nu’ gamtatnate a za ni-in thuhkia un; ama in a hal hai sungah ama adingin a za ni-a a cia zu halpieh un.","ref":"Late 137:8; Jer 50:29"},"7":{"text":"Ama le ama kisielin a noptat zaza, bawlsietna le dan a ama nu pie un. Ama nu in a lungsim sungah, ‘Kumpi nu bangin ka uh hi; kei meigong ka hi sih a, dana ka thuoh ngai sih ding hi,’ ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ziehin ni khat thu-in ama nu gimnate ahi, pul natna, kaana, le kielpi- ang tung ding a, mei tawh ama nu kihaltum ding hi. Azieh pen ama nu thu a khen Topa Pasien a vanglien hi.","ref":"Isa 47:7-9"},"9":{"text":"Ama nu tawh pahtatna bawlin a noptatton ahi leitung kumpite in a kihalna meikhu a mu ciengun ama nu kaa-in a mau ding uhi;"},"10":{"text":"ama nu’ thuohna giingin a gamlapi-ah a ding ding vua, “Kadei, kadei, khuopi lien, a vanglien khuopi Babylon! Nai khat sungin na tungah thukhenna ang tung zo hi,” ci ding uhi.","ref":"Ezk 26:16-17"},"11":{"text":"Leitung sumbawlte da-in ama nu a kaa ding uhi, azieh pen a summet bawlna vante ahi","ref":"Ezk 27:31, 36"},"12":{"text":"kham, ngun, suong manphate, le tuikepte, saihadiel puon, a ausan, nai puon le puon sandupte, sing namtui namcin, saiha tawh a kibawl na namcin, a manpha singgai namcin, sumngo, sia le, suongngo,"},"13":{"text":"cinnamon sing namtui, gimnamtui, halnamtui, myrrh panamtui kha, panamtui, lenggazu, oliv sathau, bawnghon le tuuhon, sakol le sakol leengte, silate, le mihing nuntahnate koima in lei nawn lo hi.","ref":"Ezk 27:12, 13, 22"},"14":{"text":"Na kung panun na lunggul uh gate peimangin, sil tuituoh le sil thupi zosie maimang ta a, kimu ngai nawn lo ding hi!” a ci uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nu kung panin a nga uh tami vante tawh a hau sumbawlte in ama’ thuohna ziehin amate zau-in gamlapi ah dingin da-in nahpi-in a kap ding vua,","ref":"Ezk 27:31, 36"},"16":{"text":"“Kadei, kadei, saiha diel puon, puon ausan le puon dupsante silin, kham, suong manphate, le kep suongte tawh a kizem ngai khuopi lien!"},"17":{"text":"Tam haunate zosie nai khat sungin a maimang dawh ta’n! a ci uhi. Tuale tembaw uhte zosie, tembaw tawh khuolzinte, tembaw nasemte, tuipi tunga summet bawlte zosie gamlapi ah dingin","ref":"Isa 23:14; Ezk 27:26-30"},"18":{"text":"ama nu kihalna meikhu a mu ciengun, “Tami khuopi tawh a kibang bang khuopi om ahei?” ci-in a kiko uhi.","ref":"Ezk 27:32"},"19":{"text":"A kaa a mau kawmun a lutung vuah leivui the-in, “Kadei, kadei, tuipi tunga tembaw nei zosie in ama nu citheina zieha a haulaw uh, khuopi lien khu! Nai khat sungin a maimang ta hi.","ref":"Ezk 27:30-34"},"20":{"text":"Vantung le no mi siengthote, sawltahpite, le kamsangte aw, ama nu ziehin kipah un, azieh pen Pasien in ama nu tungah note adingin thukhenna pie zo hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Thkna 32:43; Jer 51:48"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciengin a thahat vantungmi khat in an gawina suong tawh a kibang suong golpi khat la-in tuipi sungah sepsuh a, “Babylon khuopi lien khu tam bangin nahpi-in kisepsuh ding a, a kimu nawn sih ding hi;","ref":"Jer 51:63-64; Ezk 26:21"},"22":{"text":"nang sungah harp lasahna gingte, lasate’ awgingte, theile tumte awging le pengkul gingte, kiza nawn lo ding hi; na sungah khutsiem nasemte khat zong kimu nawn loin, na sungah an gawina gingte kiza nawn lo ding hi;","ref":"Ezk 26:13; Isa 24:8"},"23":{"text":"na sungah meivah zong a kivah nawn sih ding a, na sungah mopi pa le motha nu’ awging kiza nawn lo ding hi. Bangzieh ahei cile na sumbawlte uh, leitunga miliente ahi vua, na ai utawh mi nam zosie a kisolmang sieng hi.","ref":"Jer 7:34; 25:10"},"24":{"text":"Nangma sungah kamsangte, mi siengthote, le leitunga thana a thuoh zosie’ sisan kimu zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 51:49"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami zaw ciengin vantungah mihon tampite’ awging tawh a kibang khat ka za a, Hallelujah! Hutdamna, minthanna, le vanglietna eite’ Pasien-a’ ahi hi,","title":"Vantungah Kipahna"},"2":{"text":"azieh pen ama’ thukhennate thumanin thutang hi; ama in a pahtatna tawh leitung a siesah numei patat nu tungah thukhen zo a, ama’ nasemte’ sisan ziehin ama nu tungah phu a la zo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:43; 2Kum 9:7"},"3":{"text":"Amate in khatvei, “Hallelujah! Ama nu’ kihalna meikhu kumtawnin a kato hi,” a ci uhi.","ref":"Isa 34:10"},"4":{"text":"Upa sawmni le lite le ganhing lite kunin kumpi topha tunga a to Pasien a bie vua, “Amen, Hallelujah!” a ci uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi topha panin aw khat ang ging a, “No a nasemte zosie, no ama a zatah a neu a lien in, i Pasien phat un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Late 115:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin keima in tui tampi gin le a gin ngaih keh kieh tawh a kibang mi honpite’ awging bang khat ka za a, “Hallelujah! Azieh pen a vanglien i Topa Pasien in a uh zo ta hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:24; Late 93:1; 97:1; 99:1"},"7":{"text":"Eite in lungdam kipahin ama i phat ding hi, bangzieh ahei cile Tuuno mopi hun ang tung ta a, kithawisa-in a monu om zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama tungah a sieng le a vam lihleh saihadiel puon kipie zo hi,” a ci uhi. Bangzieh ahei cile saihadiel puon pen mi siengthote’ gamtatna dihte ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuale vantungmi in keima kungah, “Tami giel in: tuuno mopi pawi-a a kihlan mite mi hampha ahi hi,” ei ci hi. Tuale ama in keima kungah, “Tamte pen a thuman Pasien’ kammalte ahi hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Mat 22:2-3"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama bie dingin a ke phungah ka bawh a, hinanle ama in kei kungah, “Tam bang bawl sin! Kei pen nang le Jesu teci panna a pom na kithuopi mite tawh na semton ka hi bo hi. Pasien bie zaw’n! Bangzieh ahei cile tua Jesu’ teci panna pen kamsanna’ lungsim ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin vanpi ang kihong ka mu a, sakol kang khat a om hi! A tunga tuong pa min pen a Citah le a Thuman kici a, ama in dihna tawh thukhenin gal a bawl hi.","title":"Sakol Kang Tunga Tuong Pa","ref":"Ezk 1:1; Late 96:13; Isa 11:4"},"12":{"text":"A mittangte meikuong bang a, a lutungah kumpi lukhu tampitah khu hi; ama simlo koima in a thei lo min khat ama tungah kigiel hi.","ref":"Dan 10:6"},"13":{"text":"Ama in sisan sunga a kidie puontuol sil a, ama’ min pen Pasien’ Thu kici hi."},"14":{"text":"Vantung galkapte in a siengtho le a vam saihadiel puon a sil vua, sakol kangte tungah tuongin ama a zui uhi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte a satpai dingin a kam sung panin namsau hiem khat ang pusuoh a, ama in sia ciengkhut khat tawh amate a uh ding hi; vanglien Pasien thangpai-in a lungsona ahi lengga suhna ama in tuoncil ding hi.","ref":"Late 2:9; Isa 63:3; Joel 3:13; Kln 14:20"},"16":{"text":"Ama in a puontuol tung le a phei tungah, “Kumpite’ kumpipa le tote’ Topa ,” ci-a kigiel min nei hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciengin ni sunga a ding vantungmi khat ka mu a, ama in aw ngaitah tawh vankimlai-a leng va zosie hlanin, “Hing pei un, a thupi Pasien’ nitah ankuong luina ah hing kikhawm unlen,","title":"Gamsa le Ama’ Galkapte in Gallel"},"18":{"text":"kumpite’ sa, galkapmangte’ sa, mi thahatte’ sa, sakolte le a tunga tuongte’ sa- mi zosiete’ sa, suohta mi le silate a kipanin a neu a lien zosiete’ sa ne dingin hing kikhawm un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Ezk 39:17-20"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciengin sakol tunga tuong pa le a galkapte sim dinga amau’ galkapte a kaikhawm gamsa le leitung kumpite ka mu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua gamsa le ama opna munah na lamdangte bawlna tawh gamsa ciemtena a nga mite le ama’ lim a biete a sol kamsang zuoupa tawh ama a kiman ton hi.","ref":"Kln 13:1-18"},"21":{"text":"A omlai teng pen sakol tunga tuong pa’ kam sung pana a pusuoh namsau in that sieng a, va zosie in amau’ sa khamtahin a ne uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantung panin vantungmi khat hing kumsuhin a khutah mong nei lo kawhawm honna tawhtang le siakhau golpi khat a tawi ka mu hi.","title":"Kum Tul Khat"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Dawimangpa le Satan a kici tanglai gulpi ahi gulhiempi manin kum tulkhat sung hencip a,","ref":"Pien 3:1"},"3":{"text":"kuohawmpi sungah sepsuhin kum tulkhat a tawp masangsie minamte a sol nawn lo nadingin tawh kilin ama tungah a ciemte hi. Tua zaw ciengin bakhat sung ama kihla ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciengin kumpi tophate ka mu a, tuate tunga a tote tungah thukhen nading aana kipie hi. Jesu tunga teci panna le Pasien’ thu zieha ngawngtanna a thuohte’ hlate zong ka mu hi. Amate in gamsa ahi a, a lim ahi zongin bie loin, a talpang tung vuah ahi a, a khut tung vuah ahi zongin gamsa ciemtena zong a nga sih uhi. Amate ang hingkia vua, Khris tawh kum tulkhat sung a mangton uhi.","ref":"Dan 7:9, 22"},"5":{"text":"(Kum tulkhat a tawp masangsie a omlai misite a hingkia nai sih uhi.) Tami pen thawkiana masa pen ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Thawkiana masa sunga a kihalte pen mi hampha le mi siengthote ahi uhi. Tua mite tungah nivei sina in thu a nei nawn sih a, tuale mahin amate pen Pasien le Khris’ siempute ahi ding vua, ama tawh kum tulkhat sung a mangton ta ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kum tulkhat a tawp ciengin a thongkiehna panin Satan kihla ding a,","title":"Satan’ Kisietna"},"8":{"text":"Gog le Magog kici lei kiuli-a minamte sol dingin kuonkhie ding a, a galsimpi dingin amate a kaikhawm ding hi. Amate ahile tuipi gei-a senel za-in a tam uhi.","ref":"Ezk 7:2; 38:2, 9, 15"},"9":{"text":"Leitung maitang dimin amate a kuon vua, misiengthote’ giephuol le a it a khuopi a kimkot uhi. Tuale vantung panin meikuong ang kiesuhin amate a haltum sieng hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate a sol dawimangpa pen gamsa le kamsang zuou pa opna mun, kaat le meilipi sungah kikhiesuh a, tuaci’n amate sun le zanin kumtawn bawlsietna kithuohsah den ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciengin a lien kumpi topha kang khat le a tunga to pa ka mu hi; ama opna mun panin leitung le vantung taimang a, ama gel adingin mun kimu zo lo hi.","title":"Misite Thu Kikhen"},"12":{"text":"Tuale kumpi topha mai-a a ding a sisa a lien a neu ka mu a, tuaci’n laibute zong kiphen hi. Hinna laibu ahi laibu dang khat zong kiphen hi. A sisate tungah a gamtatnasate uh laibu sunga kiciemte tawh kizui-in thu kikhen hi.","ref":"Dan 7:9-10"},"13":{"text":"Tuipi in a sunga om misite puohto-in, Sina le Misi khuo in zong amate sunga om misite hing puohto a, a sepnasa uh tawh kizui-in a unpi-un amate tungah thu kikhen hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciengin meilipi sungah Sina le Misikhuo kikhiesuh hi. Tami meilipi pen sina nina ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinna laibu sunga a min kigiel kha lo poma tua meilipi sungah kikhiesuh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin van tha le lei tha khat ka mu hi; azieh pen van masa le lei masa mangmai zo a, tuipi zong a om nawn sih hi.","title":"Van Tha le Lei Tha","ref":"Isa 65:17; 66:22; 2Pet 3:13"},"2":{"text":"Motha khat a pasal adingin a kizemsa-in a kithawi bangin vantung Pasien kung panin ang kumsuh khuopi siengtho ahi Jerusalem tha ka mu hi.","ref":"Isa 52:1; Kln 3:12; Isa 61:10"},"3":{"text":"Tuale kumpi topha panin awging ngai khat ka za a, “En in, mihingte lahah Pasien’ inn a om ta hi. Amau’ Pasien ahi dingin amate tawh ama a tengton ding hi; amate pen ama’ mite hi ding a, Pasien mama amate tawh a omton ding hi;","ref":"Ezk 37:27; Siem 26:11, 12"},"4":{"text":"ama in amau’ mit panin a hlitui zosie uh a siapieh ding hi. Sil masate maimang zo ahi ziehin, Sina kici a om nawn sih ding hi; dana, kaana, le natna cite zong om nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 25:8; 35:10; 65:19"},"5":{"text":"Tuale kumpi topha tunga a to pa in, “En in, sil bangkim a tha-in ka bawl hi,” a ci hi. Ama in, “Tami thute muontahin thuman ahi ziehin giel in,” ei ci lai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciengin ama in keima kungah, “Kizo ta hi! Kei pen Alpha le Omega, a kipatna le a tawpna ka hi hi. Keima in a dangta mite tungah hinna tuinah panin tui a hlawn-in ka pie ding hi.","ref":"Isa 55:1"},"7":{"text":"A guolzo mite in tami nate luo ding a, tuaci’n kei pen amau’ Pasien ka hi ding a, amate, keima’ tate ahi ding uhi.","ref":"2Sam 7:14; Late 89:26-27"},"8":{"text":"Ahi vangin a meipuote, upna nei lote, a lampielte, tuolthatte, numei-pasal pahtatte, aisante, milim biete, le zuou thugen zosiete om nading mun pen sina ahi kaat tawh kihalna mun meilipi sung hi ding a, tua pen sina nina ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciengin a nukhia pen gimna sagite a dima om hai sagi a tawi vantungmi sagite sung panin khat hing pei-in keima kungah, “Hing pei in, Tuuno’ zi ahi motha nu kang lah ding hi,” ei ci hi.","title":"Jerusalem Khuo Tha Mangmuna"},"10":{"text":"Tuale hlagau tawh a gol mama muol sangpi khatah ei peipi a, vantung Pasien kung pana ang kumsuh a siengtho Jerusalem khuopi ei lah hi.","ref":"Ezk 40:2"},"11":{"text":"Tua khuopi in Pasien’ minthanna vang nei-in, a tanna dan pen a cieu mama suongmanpha le Jasper suongmanpha tawh kibang a, crystal suongmanpha bangin sieng kilkel hi."},"12":{"text":"A gol mama kul sangpi nei a, tunkot sawm le ni nei-in, tua tunkotte ah vantungmi sawm le ni om a, tunkotte tungah Israel minam sawm le nite’ min kigiel hi."},"13":{"text":"Nisuona lamah tunkot thum, leilu lamah tunkot thum, leitaw lamah tunkot thum, nitumna lamah tunkot thum ci bangin a om hi.","ref":"Ezk 48:30-35"},"14":{"text":"Tua khuopi kulpi in suong tawpha sawm le ni nei a, tuate tungah Tuuno sawltahpi sawm le nite’ min a tuong hi."},"15":{"text":"Ei hopi vantungmi in khuopi le a tunkotte, a kulpite te nadingin kham a kibawl tena ciengpum khat nei hi.","ref":"Ezk 40:3"},"16":{"text":"Tua khuopi in ning li nei a, adung avai kikim hi; tuale ama in a ciengpum tawh tua khuopi a te leh, tai tul le tai zanga pha hi; adung avai le a sanna kikim hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a kul zong te a, vantungmi in mihing te banga a te ahi a, tong za le tong sawmli le tong li a pha hi."},"18":{"text":"A kul pen Jasper suongmanpha tawh kilam a, a khuopi pen kham citah tawh kilamin limlang bangin sieng kilkel hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuopi kul suong tawphate pen suongmanpha namcin tawh kizem hi; a masa pen Jasper suongmanpha hi a, a nina sapphire, a thumna agate, a lina emerald,"},"20":{"text":"a ngana onyx, a guhna carnelian, a sagina chrysolite, a gietna beryl, a kuona topaz, a sawmna chrysoprase, a sawm le khatna Jacinth, a sawm le lina amethyst suongmanphate ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuale tunkot sawm le nite pen tuikep suong sawm le ni tawh kibawl hi a, tunkot khatta pen tuikep suong khatta ma tawh kibawlin, khuopi lampi pen kham citah tawh kibawl hi a, limlang bangin a pailetin kimu thei hi.","ref":"Isa 54:11-12"},"22":{"text":"Tua khuopi sungah biehinnpi ka mu sih hi, bangzieh ahei cile Vanglien Topa Pasien le Tuuno pen tua khuopi’ biehinnpi ahi ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasien’ minthanna vang pen ama’ khuovah hi a, a meivah zong Tuuno hi zo ta ahi ziehin tua khuopi tanvah dingin ni tang le hla tang zong a kisam sih hi.","ref":"Isa 60:19-20"},"24":{"text":"Ama’ khuovah tawh minamte lam a pei ding vua, leitung kumpite in zong tua khuopi sungah a minthanna uh ang peipi ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 60:3"},"25":{"text":"Sun lai-in tua khuopi tunkot kikha ngai lo ding a, khum munah zan hun kici a om ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Mite in tua khuopi sungah minamte’ minthanna le patawinate ang peipi ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 60:11"},"27":{"text":"Ahi vangin tua sungah a siengtho lo bangma lut thei lo ding a, a kidahhuoi le zuouphuote khatpo zong lut thei loin, Tuuno hinna laibu sunga a min kigielte beh lut thei ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 52:1; Ezk 44:9"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciengin vantungmi in Pasien le Tuuno topha pana ang luongkhie, crystal suongmanpha banga a cim kilkel hinna guntui ei lah a,","title":"Hinna Gunpi","ref":"Ezk 47:1; Zech 14:8"},"2":{"text":"tua pen khuopi lampi laikimah a luongsuh hi. Tua gun pang tuohah ga nam sawm le nam ni a nei hinna singkung po a, hla sielin ga hi; tua singkung a tete pen minamte damna ding ahi hi.","ref":"Pien 2:9"},"3":{"text":"Khum munah samsiet mi koima kimu kha nawn lo ding hi. Ahi vangin tua sungah Pasien le Tuuno’ topha om ding a, a nasemte in ama a bie ding uhi;","ref":"Zech 14:11; Pien 3:17"},"4":{"text":"amate in ama’ maitang a mu ding vua, a talpang tung vuah ama’ min a tuong ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Zan hun ci om nawn lo ding a, Pasien pen amau’ khuovah hi ta ding ahi ziehin amate in meivah tang le ni tang kisam nawn loin kumtawnin a mang den ta ding uhi.","ref":"Isa 60:19; Dan 7:18"},"6":{"text":"Ama in keima kungah, “Tami thute pen muontah a, thuman ahi hi, bangzieh ahei cile kamsangte hlagau ahi Topa Pasien in a nasemte tungah ang tung bai ding thute a lah dingin a vantungmi a sawl zo hi,” ei ci hi."},"7":{"text":"“En in, kang pei bai ta ding hi! Tami laibu sunga kamsanna thute a zui pa mi hampha ahi hi,” ei ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima John pen tami thute za-in a mu pa ka hi hi. Tuate za-in ka mu ciengin keima kunga tuate ei lah vantungmi kephungah a bie dingin ka bawhsuh hi;","title":"Thukhupna le Thupha Piehna"},"9":{"text":"ahi vangin ama in keima kungah, “Tam bang bawl sin! Nang le kamsang na kithuopite tawh nasemton khat ka hi bo hi. Pasien bie zaw’n!” ei ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuale ama in keima kungah, “A hun ang nai ta ahi ziehin tami laibu sunga kamsanna thute khacip sin."},"11":{"text":"Sietna bawlpa in bawl lai hinlen, a niehte nieh lailai-in, midihte dih suoh hinlen, a siengthote siengtho suoh ta uheh,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Dan 12:10"},"12":{"text":"“En in, kang pei bai ta ding hi! Mi zosie a gamtatna uh tawh kizui-in a thuhkia dingin keima kungah ka thaman a om hi.","ref":"Isa 40:10; 62:11; Late 28:4; Jer 17:10"},"13":{"text":"Kei pen Alpha le Omega, amasa pen le a nukhia pen ka hi a, a kipatna le a tawpna zong ka hi hi.","ref":"Kln 1:8; 1:17; 2:8; Isa 44:6; 48:12"},"14":{"text":"Hinna singkung nei thei nading le tunkotte panin khuopi sung lut nading thu nei thei nadinga a puontuol uh a sawpsiengte mi hampha ahi uhi.","ref":"Pien 2:9; 3:22"},"15":{"text":"A pulamah uite, bum tawite, numei-pasal pahtatna bawlte, tuolthatte, milim biete, le zuouphuo nuomsa-in zuouthu gente zosie a om uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Keima Jesu in hlattuom pawlpite ading tami teci panna thu na kunga ang gen dingin ka vantungmi kang sawl hi. Keima pen David’ zungpi le a suon ahi, zingsol ka hi hi,” ei ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:1, 10"},"17":{"text":"Hlagau le motha in “Hing pei ta’n,” a ci uhi. Tuale a za zosie in, “Hing pei ta’n,” ci ta uheh. A dangta zosie hing pei uheh. A dei zosie in hinna tui a hlawn-in hing la uheh.","ref":"Isa 55:1"},"18":{"text":"Keima in tami laibu sunga kamsanna thu a za zosie kang hilkhol hi: Mi khatpo in tuate a belap leh Pasien in zong tami laibu sunga kigielsa gimnate tua mipa tungah a belap ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi khatpo in tami kamsanna laibu sunga thute a lahkhiet leh, Pasien in zong tami laibu sunga kigielsa ahi hinna singkung le khuopi siengtho sunga tua mipa nga ding satanh a lahpieh ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:2; 12:32"},"20":{"text":"Tami thute teci a pang mipa in, “Kang pei bai tahtah ta ding hi,” ei ci hi. Amen. Topa Jesu aw, Hing pei ta’n!"},"21":{"text":"Misiengtho zosiete tawh Topa Jesu’ hepina hing om taheh. Amen."}}}}}}}
